entries.text: After Dark
entries.literal: "After Dark"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been mindlessly staring at the wall in front of me for a few minutes. When that finally registered, I slowly spun around.
entries.literal: "I'd been mindlessly staring at the wall in front of me for a few minutes. When that finally registered, I slowly spun around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd always thought I'd be quick at adapting to sudden changes, but I'd recently realized how mistaken that was. Still unable to process everything, my brain continually struggled to accept that the previous few days had really happened.
entries.literal: "I'd always thought I'd be quick at adapting to sudden changes, but I'd recently realized how mistaken that was. Still unable to process everything, my brain continually struggled to accept that the previous few days had really happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I wasn't familiar with the walls around me, but I'd always known of the place. Next to me was Shiroya, less willing to acknowledge her surroundings. Keeping her gaze on the floor, she suddenly spoke for the first time since we'd entered.
entries.literal: "...I wasn't familiar with the walls around me, but I'd always known of the place. Next to me was Shiroya, less willing to acknowledge her surroundings. Keeping her gaze on the floor, she suddenly spoke for the first time since we'd entered."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I think it'll be time soon.
entries.literal: "...I think it'll be time soon."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, probably less than twenty minutes.
entries.literal: "Yeah, probably less than twenty minutes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was all I managed to muster. Even though I was still the same Atsuki as always, it felt like I'd been rewritten into an entirely different entity in only a few days.
entries.literal: "That was all I managed to muster. Even though I was still the same Atsuki as always, it felt like I'd been rewritten into an entirely different entity in only a few days."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't try to say anything else. During the previous two weeks, I'd grown accustomed to those brief interactions with Shiroya. After I spoke, the lost look in her eyes returned. We had both agreed to go together, but it seemed like neither of us knew what we were doing.
entries.literal: "I didn't try to say anything else. During the previous two weeks, I'd grown accustomed to those brief interactions with Shiroya. After I spoke, the lost look in her eyes returned. We had both agreed to go together, but it seemed like neither of us knew what we were doing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We awkwardly scanned the vast hall, moving forward tiny steps at a time and awaiting further instructions.
entries.literal: "We awkwardly scanned the vast hall, moving forward tiny steps at a time and awaiting further instructions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Neither of us had any strength; I'd known Shiroya for more than fifteen years, and not once had she looked so empty. On top of everything else, I hadn't even been able to make her feel any better.
entries.literal: "Neither of us had any strength; I'd known Shiroya for more than fifteen years, and not once had she looked so empty. On top of everything else, I hadn't even been able to make her feel any better."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite that, at almost {time=9}, we were inside Ashiya Tower.
entries.literal: "Despite that, at almost {time=9}, we were inside Ashiya Tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The biggest building in Yushibana—the town where we'd always lived. It was situated on the outskirts, and we had never entered it before.
entries.literal: "The biggest building in Yushibana—the town where we'd always lived. It was situated on the outskirts, and we had never entered it before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the outside, the tower's contrast with its surroundings was immense. Beyond all the similar-looking houses, its size made it visible anywhere in the town. It was that contrast which had caused it to be called a "tower", but it was only as big as an urban building. The structure itself was more or less a cube, essentially as wide as it was tall, but it seemed towering to people who had spent their whole lives in a rural area.
entries.literal: "From the outside, the tower's contrast with its surroundings was immense. Beyond all the similar-looking houses, its size made it visible anywhere in the town. It was that contrast which had caused it to be called a \"tower\", but it was only as big as an urban building. The structure itself was more or less a cube, essentially as wide as it was tall, but it seemed towering to people who had spent their whole lives in a rural area."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a place Shiroya and I had always avoided because of the stigma associated with it. A significant amount of the citizens opposed the tower's existence due to both the group who owned it and its unnatural size.
entries.literal: "It was a place Shiroya and I had always avoided because of the stigma associated with it. A significant amount of the citizens opposed the tower's existence due to both the group who owned it and its unnatural size."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't very familiar with the topic. Apparently, decades in the past, when the building hadn't been anywhere near as large, it was the original Ashiya family's home. It was known that they were a shady family, but they never suffered any real consequences. At that time, they held a silent power over the town, and over the years, it gradually grew stronger.
entries.literal: "I wasn't very familiar with the topic. Apparently, decades in the past, when the building hadn't been anywhere near as large, it was the original Ashiya family's home. It was known that they were a shady family, but they never suffered any real consequences. At that time, they held a silent power over the town, and over the years, it gradually grew stronger."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They became the image of Yushibana. Anyone visiting from the outside knew about that family before anything else in the town. Over the years, the old residence transformed into a focal point for business and tourism.
entries.literal: "They became the image of Yushibana. Anyone visiting from the outside knew about that family before anything else in the town. Over the years, the old residence transformed into a focal point for business and tourism."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had never immersed myself in the matter, but that was common information that I couldn't even recall where I'd heard first.
entries.literal: "I had never immersed myself in the matter, but that was common information that I couldn't even recall where I'd heard first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The place was some sort of museum, and behind it extended a mountain range that encircled Yushibana. It was known for housing numerous caves that held valuable gemstones, so enthusiasts tended to visit often. The Ashiya family had taken advantage of it and utilized their building as a gallery for the different gemstones that could be found in the nearby mountains.
entries.literal: "The place was some sort of museum, and behind it extended a mountain range that encircled Yushibana. It was known for housing numerous caves that held valuable gemstones, so enthusiasts tended to visit often. The Ashiya family had taken advantage of it and utilized their building as a gallery for the different gemstones that could be found in the nearby mountains."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And when that happened, the part of the town in favor of the tower increased due to the incoming flow of people who specialized in those gemstones. That was what caused a split in the population; the younger residents generally didn't mind Ashiya, while the older maintained their private discontent.
entries.literal: "And when that happened, the part of the town in favor of the tower increased due to the incoming flow of people who specialized in those gemstones. That was what caused a split in the population; the younger residents generally didn't mind Ashiya, while the older maintained their private discontent."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was why we had never entered it, and on top of our more recent circumstances, I thought Shiroya might've been experiencing a feeling of betrayal simply by being there. While I couldn't say I shared that strong of an emotion toward it, I wasn't very fond of the whole thing either.
entries.literal: "That was why we had never entered it, and on top of our more recent circumstances, I thought Shiroya might've been experiencing a feeling of betrayal simply by being there. While I couldn't say I shared that strong of an emotion toward it, I wasn't very fond of the whole thing either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}The reason why we were inside wasn't one I could easily put into words.
entries.literal: "...{w}The reason why we were inside wasn't one I could easily put into words."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There had been constant publicity about the day's event for two weeks. According to Ashiya, they were going to showcase a major discovery, one found in the very same mountains around the town.
entries.literal: "There had been constant publicity about the day's event for two weeks. According to Ashiya, they were going to showcase a major discovery, one found in the very same mountains around the town."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But that wasn't something that particularly interested me, and I wasn't sure what to expect. Our motivation for coming to the tower wasn't anything as simple as curiosity.
entries.literal: "But that wasn't something that particularly interested me, and I wasn't sure what to expect. Our motivation for coming to the tower wasn't anything as simple as curiosity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was December 15th. Outside, the environment was cold and coated in snow, and while the temperature inside was regulated, we'd been outside for so long that we still felt unpleasant.
entries.literal: "It was December 15th. Outside, the environment was cold and coated in snow, and while the temperature inside was regulated, we'd been outside for so long that we still felt unpleasant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at Shiroya, who didn't return my look. Feeling slightly agitated, I turned a little.
entries.literal: "I glanced at Shiroya, who didn't return my look. Feeling slightly agitated, I turned a little."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see a line of people who had come thanks to Ashiya's ambitious advertisements. Shiroya and I had been at the front of it for a long time.
entries.literal: "I could see a line of people who had come thanks to Ashiya's ambitious advertisements. Shiroya and I had been at the front of it for a long time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to us was a man I'd never seen before. He was tall and had dark hair, and like us, he seemed distant from everyone else. I hadn't seen him so much as look at me, so I hadn't paid attention to him.
entries.literal: "Next to us was a man I'd never seen before. He was tall and had dark hair, and like us, he seemed distant from everyone else. I hadn't seen him so much as look at me, so I hadn't paid attention to him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were next to him because we would go see the gemstone in groups of three. Since we'd been the initial three to show up, we formed the first group.
entries.literal: "We were next to him because we would go see the gemstone in groups of three. Since we'd been the initial three to show up, we formed the first group."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The entrance fee had been expensive, but we'd paid it well in advance. From our perspective, it had been worth it.
entries.literal: "The entrance fee had been expensive, but we'd paid it well in advance. From our perspective, it had been worth it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We remained by the door that would open at {time=9}, simply waiting for that to happen. At our left was another door that would open at the same time, and according to what we'd been told, both led to the main floor of the tower.{w} On that particular day, not many people seemed to care about that, as everyone who could be seen was in our same line.
entries.literal: "We remained by the door that would open at {time=9}, simply waiting for that to happen. At our left was another door that would open at the same time, and according to what we'd been told, both led to the main floor of the tower.{w} On that particular day, not many people seemed to care about that, as everyone who could be seen was in our same line."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For a moment, I wondered what the big deal was. Yushibana wasn't a large town, so the amount of people waiting behind us was fairly impressive. All that for a gemstone didn't seem quite right to me.
entries.literal: "For a moment, I wondered what the big deal was. Yushibana wasn't a large town, so the amount of people waiting behind us was fairly impressive. All that for a gemstone didn't seem quite right to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But perhaps it made sense, given that it was Ashiya's event. They cared about appearances, as anyone could attest. They had their hands in all types of business, but the most important one was looking good.
entries.literal: "But perhaps it made sense, given that it was Ashiya's event. They cared about appearances, as anyone could attest. They had their hands in all types of business, but the most important one was looking good."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Apart from the line, the only other people in the lobby were guards talking with a policeman, a woman behind the reception desk checking everyone's tickets, and a janitor who had been scrubbing the same part of the floor for a while.
entries.literal: "Apart from the line, the only other people in the lobby were guards talking with a policeman, a woman behind the reception desk checking everyone's tickets, and a janitor who had been scrubbing the same part of the floor for a while."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was all unsettling and alien. The event itself was an abstract thing to me, and my view on the people who ran it was far from positive. All I could do was look at things and wait for it all to start.
entries.literal: "It was all unsettling and alien. The event itself was an abstract thing to me, and my view on the people who ran it was far from positive. All I could do was look at things and wait for it all to start."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd been asked to leave our phones outside for the duration of our stay, as nothing of the sort was permitted in the building. That meant that I had no way of looking at the time; there weren't any clocks on the walls.
entries.literal: "We'd been asked to leave our phones outside for the duration of our stay, as nothing of the sort was permitted in the building. That meant that I had no way of looking at the time; there weren't any clocks on the walls."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Adding the fact that the person I was with was clearly uncomfortable and trying to hide it, the long wait had been much more tedious than I'd hoped.
entries.literal: "Adding the fact that the person I was with was clearly uncomfortable and trying to hide it, the long wait had been much more tedious than I'd hoped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued looking at her, not knowing how to deal with the situation better. Finally, after minutes of looking down, she suddenly lifted her head as if she'd just remembered that she was in a public environment.
entries.literal: "I continued looking at her, not knowing how to deal with the situation better. Finally, after minutes of looking down, she suddenly lifted her head as if she'd just remembered that she was in a public environment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Following behind, she looked at me and seemed to try to smile.
entries.literal: "Following behind, she looked at me and seemed to try to smile."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it was barely visible before vanishing again.
entries.literal: "But it was barely visible before vanishing again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I kept falling back into negative thoughts. No matter how I tried, I couldn't help that.
entries.literal: "...I kept falling back into negative thoughts. No matter how I tried, I couldn't help that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I needed to be stronger and help lift Shiroya out of the pit she was in, but that was tricky, seeing as I first had to get out of the same one.
entries.literal: "I needed to be stronger and help lift Shiroya out of the pit she was in, but that was tricky, seeing as I first had to get out of the same one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So I just struggled against my feelings, wishing all the while that I could go back to how things had been before.
entries.literal: "So I just struggled against my feelings, wishing all the while that I could go back to how things had been before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Minutes later, a well-dressed man who'd been standing near the entrance told us that if we weren't waiting for the event, we could go through the left door.
entries.literal: "Minutes later, a well-dressed man who'd been standing near the entrance told us that if we weren't waiting for the event, we could go through the left door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shortly after, a tall, blonde woman wearing a suit entered through the one on the right.
entries.literal: "Shortly after, a tall, blonde woman wearing a suit entered through the one on the right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd seen her in a coat earlier, before she'd disappeared through one of the doors. She looked over everyone present and began to explain what the procedure would be.
entries.literal: "I'd seen her in a coat earlier, before she'd disappeared through one of the doors. She looked over everyone present and began to explain what the procedure would be."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Sorry for the wait, everyone. We'll now begin the group entrances.{w} My name is Naomi. I'll be chaperoning today's guided visit.
entries.literal: "Sorry for the wait, everyone. We'll now begin the group entrances.{w} My name is Naomi. I'll be chaperoning today's guided visit."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: As you likely already know, groups of three will move forward in turns. Each viewing is estimated to take approximately fifteen minutes.{w} Once inside, I will personally explain what we have prepared, and I will also be available to answer questions within the specified time.
entries.literal: "As you likely already know, groups of three will move forward in turns. Each viewing is estimated to take approximately fifteen minutes.{w} Once inside, I will personally explain what we have prepared, and I will also be available to answer questions within the specified time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi's explanation was directed at everyone present, but it was hard to believe anyone farther back could've heard her. She continued in a monotone voice.
entries.literal: "Naomi's explanation was directed at everyone present, but it was hard to believe anyone farther back could've heard her. She continued in a monotone voice."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Keep in mind that phones and video cameras are strictly prohibited. I ask for all of you to please be patient and await your turn.
entries.literal: "Keep in mind that phones and video cameras are strictly prohibited. I ask for all of you to please be patient and await your turn."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When her scripted message was over, she relaxed her posture and directed her look at us.
entries.literal: "When her scripted message was over, she relaxed her posture and directed her look at us."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: You three are the first group, correct?
entries.literal: "You three are the first group, correct?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seconds later, nobody had answered. The two people at my sides had barely paid attention to her, so I spoke before she would have to ask again.
entries.literal: "Seconds later, nobody had answered. The two people at my sides had barely paid attention to her, so I spoke before she would have to ask again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: ...All right, then. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...All right, then. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd heard that word many times recently. As soon as she said it, she turned around and walked through the same door she'd entered from.
entries.literal: "I'd heard that word many times recently. As soon as she said it, she turned around and walked through the same door she'd entered from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked to my right to check on Shiroya. Her demeanor hadn't changed, but she was aware of the situation.
entries.literal: "I looked to my right to check on Shiroya. Her demeanor hadn't changed, but she was aware of the situation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: By the time I turned back, the man on my left had nearly reached the door. It seemed he was taking the initiative despite his unenthused appearance.
entries.literal: "By the time I turned back, the man on my left had nearly reached the door. It seemed he was taking the initiative despite his unenthused appearance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Rather, it was probably better to think of myself as lagging behind than him being proactive. I followed, motioning to Shiroya as I did. She approached me, still wearing her heavy-looking coat.
entries.literal: "Rather, it was probably better to think of myself as lagging behind than him being proactive. I followed, motioning to Shiroya as I did. She approached me, still wearing her heavy-looking coat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We found ourselves in a long hallway. We could see many doors lining each wall, some opened and connected by a decorative handrail. However, there were no traces of Naomi or the man.
entries.literal: "We found ourselves in a long hallway. We could see many doors lining each wall, some opened and connected by a decorative handrail. However, there were no traces of Naomi or the man."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The floor seemed pointlessly wide. Up to the end of the hall, I could see a number of security cameras hanging from the ceiling. As we started walking, unclear about where to go, I found it appropriate to try talking with Shiroya again.
entries.literal: "The floor seemed pointlessly wide. Up to the end of the hall, I could see a number of security cameras hanging from the ceiling. As we started walking, unclear about where to go, I found it appropriate to try talking with Shiroya again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you feeling better?
entries.literal: "Are you feeling better?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh... Yeah, I'm fine. Don't worry about it.
entries.literal: "Oh... Yeah, I'm fine. Don't worry about it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...She continued walking, assuming that was the end of our exchange.
entries.literal: "...She continued walking, assuming that was the end of our exchange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to press it a bit further.
entries.literal: "I tried to press it a bit further."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Do you regret coming?
entries.literal: "...Do you regret coming?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...No, of course not.{w} I'm seriously glad we're here. I mean it.
entries.literal: "...No, of course not.{w} I'm seriously glad we're here. I mean it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know how you feel, okay? It's... the same for me. It doesn't help a lot to say it, but I don't want to see you sad.
entries.literal: "I know how you feel, okay? It's... the same for me. It doesn't help a lot to say it, but I don't want to see you sad."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm here because I want to be, Atsuki. I'm okay. This is where I need to be right now. Sorry, I must look terrible.
entries.literal: "I'm here because I want to be, Atsuki. I'm okay. This is where I need to be right now. Sorry, I must look terrible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She wasn't being very convincing.
entries.literal: "She wasn't being very convincing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You know this isn't something you need to apologize for. Nothing about this is your fault.
entries.literal: "...You know this isn't something you need to apologize for. Nothing about this is your fault."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm... not so sure. I wish I didn't have to be a drag for you now.
entries.literal: "I'm... not so sure. I wish I didn't have to be a drag for you now."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: H-Hey, come on. If you want to leave, we still can. Don't feel like you have to push yourself for my sake.
entries.literal: "H-Hey, come on. If you want to leave, we still can. Don't feel like you have to push yourself for my sake."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's all right. Thank you.{w} Let's continue, though. I was the one who wanted to do this.
entries.literal: "It's all right. Thank you.{w} Let's continue, though. I was the one who wanted to do this."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd hoped coming to the exhibition would be for the better. Once it was settled that we wouldn't back out, I looked around hesitantly until a voice calling for us came from the middle of the hallway, through an open door.
entries.literal: "We'd hoped coming to the exhibition would be for the better. Once it was settled that we wouldn't back out, I looked around hesitantly until a voice calling for us came from the middle of the hallway, through an open door."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: You two, hurry up! The clock is ticking.
entries.literal: "You two, hurry up! The clock is ticking."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her unprofessional shout broke the silence and drew us forward.
entries.literal: "Her unprofessional shout broke the silence and drew us forward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw her figure in a seemingly empty room. Through the other doors, there were cabinets covered by red cloths.
entries.literal: "I saw her figure in a seemingly empty room. Through the other doors, there were cabinets covered by red cloths."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Good, we're all finally here. Now we can start.
entries.literal: "Good, we're all finally here. Now we can start."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I went inside, I realized my initial impression had been wrong. The room would've been barren if it weren't for a single cabinet covered by a velvet curtain.
entries.literal: "Once I went inside, I realized my initial impression had been wrong. The room would've been barren if it weren't for a single cabinet covered by a velvet curtain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The black-haired man was there, yet again looking entirely aloof and fixing his eyes on the plain opposite wall.
entries.literal: "The black-haired man was there, yet again looking entirely aloof and fixing his eyes on the plain opposite wall."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: All right. It would be helpful if you could tell me your names since you know mine.
entries.literal: "All right. It would be helpful if you could tell me your names since you know mine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While she said that, she closed the door we'd come through, and I took notice of the security camera in one of the corners, which was fitting for the place we were in. There was another closed door on the opposite wall, so we had fifteen minutes ahead of us where we would be shut inside.
entries.literal: "While she said that, she closed the door we'd come through, and I took notice of the security camera in one of the corners, which was fitting for the place we were in. There was another closed door on the opposite wall, so we had fifteen minutes ahead of us where we would be shut inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi looked at me expectantly, probably because I'd been the one to speak earlier.
entries.literal: "Naomi looked at me expectantly, probably because I'd been the one to speak earlier."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Atsuki Hakutoki.
entries.literal: "Atsuki Hakutoki."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Shiroya Mirana.
entries.literal: "Shiroya Mirana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without being cajoled, Shiroya spoke her name. To my relief, she was looking directly at Naomi, and her posture was significantly less stiff than before.
entries.literal: "Without being cajoled, Shiroya spoke her name. To my relief, she was looking directly at Naomi, and her posture was significantly less stiff than before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The black-haired man didn't respond immediately when we eyed him.
entries.literal: "The black-haired man didn't respond immediately when we eyed him."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: And your name?
entries.literal: "And your name?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...{w}Akaro.{w} Akaro Esata.
entries.literal: "...{w}Akaro.{w} Akaro Esata."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Perfect. Happy to meet the three of you.
entries.literal: "Perfect. Happy to meet the three of you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was hard to read him. He looked passive, but he must've been interested in the exhibition.
entries.literal: "It was hard to read him. He looked passive, but he must've been interested in the exhibition."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi moved aside and placed herself before the velvet curtain.{w} Then, she took out a keyring from her pocket as she got ready to begin the introduction.
entries.literal: "Naomi moved aside and placed herself before the velvet curtain.{w} Then, she took out a keyring from her pocket as she got ready to begin the introduction."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: As you might already know, what's behind this curtain is not to be taken lightly, and being the first public viewers is a bigger privilege than you might think.
entries.literal: "As you might already know, what's behind this curtain is not to be taken lightly, and being the first public viewers is a bigger privilege than you might think."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: What's being kept here is among the rarest pieces that we've ever seen, and it's only been two weeks since the discovery.
entries.literal: "What's being kept here is among the rarest pieces that we've ever seen, and it's only been two weeks since the discovery."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: We estimate that the value of this cabinet's contents is immense. A proper appraisal has already occurred, but more estimates will come forth as everyone realizes just what we have on our hands.
entries.literal: "We estimate that the value of this cabinet's contents is immense. A proper appraisal has already occurred, but more estimates will come forth as everyone realizes just what we have on our hands."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Part of the experience is the touch, so I will open the cabinet and let you experience it yourselves. However, I must insist that you be gentle and keep your hands inside the cabinet at all times.
entries.literal: "Part of the experience is the touch, so I will open the cabinet and let you experience it yourselves. However, I must insist that you be gentle and keep your hands inside the cabinet at all times."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: We know, and don't need this introduction, so let's move along. You've been praising this find of yours in every advertisement. Let's see how your claims hold up.
entries.literal: "We know, and don't need this introduction, so let's move along. You've been praising this find of yours in every advertisement. Let's see how your claims hold up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro's sudden input took us by surprise, but it made it clear that he did actually care about the event.
entries.literal: "Akaro's sudden input took us by surprise, but it made it clear that he did actually care about the event."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: M-My apologies. Let's start, then.
entries.literal: "M-My apologies. Let's start, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi put a small key into a lock on the left side of the cabinet and turned it.
entries.literal: "Naomi put a small key into a lock on the left side of the cabinet and turned it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Admittedly, all the build-up was making me slightly curious, but for all I knew, we were talking about a slightly shining rock, nothing that would ever interest me very much.
entries.literal: "Admittedly, all the build-up was making me slightly curious, but for all I knew, we were talking about a slightly shining rock, nothing that would ever interest me very much."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Let's stop with the teasing. Here's what you've come here to see, named "The Sekimeiya".
entries.literal: "Let's stop with the teasing. Here's what you've come here to see, named \"The Sekimeiya\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With one hand, she grabbed the bottom of the curtain and began to raise it.
entries.literal: "With one hand, she grabbed the bottom of the curtain and began to raise it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But even though my focus should've been on the cabinet, something else took priority.
entries.literal: "But even though my focus should've been on the cabinet, something else took priority."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I was least expecting it, smoke rose instead of the curtain, accompanied by a familiar, putrid smell that invaded the room.
entries.literal: "When I was least expecting it, smoke rose instead of the curtain, accompanied by a familiar, putrid smell that invaded the room."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Wha... What is this!?
entries.literal: "Wha... What is this!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without bothering to ask myself questions, I tried to find Shiroya. At my right, I saw her face morphing into shock.
entries.literal: "Without bothering to ask myself questions, I tried to find Shiroya. At my right, I saw her face morphing into shock."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Atsuki... Wha...
entries.literal: "Atsuki... Wha..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her last word faded out quietly, and it was then when I realized that my consciousness was getting cloudy. All of a sudden, the only thing I could see was very dark smoke filling my field of vision. I couldn't believe it was happening again.
entries.literal: "Her last word faded out quietly, and it was then when I realized that my consciousness was getting cloudy. All of a sudden, the only thing I could see was very dark smoke filling my field of vision. I couldn't believe it was happening again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi's hand had immediately released the curtain, and she was trying to steady herself while covering her nose. I couldn't find Akaro until I looked down and saw that he had already fallen to the floor.
entries.literal: "Naomi's hand had immediately released the curtain, and she was trying to steady herself while covering her nose. I couldn't find Akaro until I looked down and saw that he had already fallen to the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The smoke filled up the entire room at once. In just a few seconds, my legs stopped responding, and every effort at getting my muscles to obey me met with failure.
entries.literal: "The smoke filled up the entire room at once. In just a few seconds, my legs stopped responding, and every effort at getting my muscles to obey me met with failure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At last, my entire body gave up, and I plummeted down. Thanks to the view I had from the floor, I could see Shiroya's outcome had not been any different, and from the falling noise I heard, the same could be said for Naomi.
entries.literal: "At last, my entire body gave up, and I plummeted down. Thanks to the view I had from the floor, I could see Shiroya's outcome had not been any different, and from the falling noise I heard, the same could be said for Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind Shiroya was the door we'd come through. The smoke had covered the ceiling, so everything was dark. Amid the confusion, I was able to notice the lack of light under the door, something which should've been easily noticeable from where I was.
entries.literal: "Behind Shiroya was the door we'd come through. The smoke had covered the ceiling, so everything was dark. Amid the confusion, I was able to notice the lack of light under the door, something which should've been easily noticeable from where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After I ultimately accepted there was nothing I could do to salvage the situation, I had a few seconds where I could only think about what was going on. Our room and its surroundings were fully silent: I couldn't hear a thing despite what had happened, and I wasn't able to produce any noise.
entries.literal: "After I ultimately accepted there was nothing I could do to salvage the situation, I had a few seconds where I could only think about what was going on. Our room and its surroundings were fully silent: I couldn't hear a thing despite what had happened, and I wasn't able to produce any noise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What the fuck had just happened? I was able to recognize how strange it was. Both doors had been closed, so I had no idea where the smoke came from.
entries.literal: "What the fuck had just happened? I was able to recognize how strange it was. Both doors had been closed, so I had no idea where the smoke came from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Knowing the smoke was blotting out our awareness, I realized it had been done deliberately, and there were many reasons I could come up with as to why, going off what we'd just been told.
entries.literal: "Knowing the smoke was blotting out our awareness, I realized it had been done deliberately, and there were many reasons I could come up with as to why, going off what we'd just been told."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As my remaining consciousness faded away, I could only hope I would quickly wake up to see Shiroya again. I wanted to pretend that I knew nothing would happen, but the images came back to me. ...Seeing that hole in the floor.
entries.literal: "As my remaining consciousness faded away, I could only hope I would quickly wake up to see Shiroya again. I wanted to pretend that I knew nothing would happen, but the images came back to me. ...Seeing that hole in the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heartbeat slowed and became inaudible. I knew that resisting was completely futile, so I closed my eyes, hoping to fast-forward to being awake again. The thought of dying there was pathetic, but without a choice in the matter, I resigned myself to what was happening.
entries.literal: "My heartbeat slowed and became inaudible. I knew that resisting was completely futile, so I closed my eyes, hoping to fast-forward to being awake again. The thought of dying there was pathetic, but without a choice in the matter, I resigned myself to what was happening."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before all my senses faded, the silence was broken by a loud alarm, which had taken a while to be broadcast after the appearance of the smoke. Further in the background, I briefly perceived a much fainter and rougher sound that I couldn't identify.
entries.literal: "Before all my senses faded, the silence was broken by a loud alarm, which had taken a while to be broadcast after the appearance of the smoke. Further in the background, I briefly perceived a much fainter and rougher sound that I couldn't identify."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lay on the floor of that smoky room with three other people, completely powerless and clueless.
entries.literal: "I lay on the floor of that smoky room with three other people, completely powerless and clueless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon after the alarm played, the darkness became absolute, and all my thoughts vanished.
entries.literal: "Soon after the alarm played, the darkness became absolute, and all my thoughts vanished."

entries.text: Cave-in
entries.literal: "Cave-in"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: An indeterminate amount of time had passed. I was a complete mess, and a constant pain pounded against the interior of my skull.
entries.literal: "An indeterminate amount of time had passed. I was a complete mess, and a constant pain pounded against the interior of my skull."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing had changed apart from the walls and ceiling, which had been tainted by the smoke.
entries.literal: "Nothing had changed apart from the walls and ceiling, which had been tainted by the smoke."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I confirmed that I was still in the event room, I tried to battle the intense headache mercilessly hammering me from the inside, focusing my vision in an attempt to spot Shiroya.
entries.literal: "As I confirmed that I was still in the event room, I tried to battle the intense headache mercilessly hammering me from the inside, focusing my vision in an attempt to spot Shiroya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There she was, still on the floor. She hadn't moved since I'd blacked out.
entries.literal: "There she was, still on the floor. She hadn't moved since I'd blacked out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I used all the energy I could muster to try to rise, and after a few attempts, I was able to sit up.
entries.literal: "I used all the energy I could muster to try to rise, and after a few attempts, I was able to sit up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I crawled to Shiroya, I looked behind me. As expected, Akaro's body still lay on the floor, but he was far from my first priority.
entries.literal: "While I crawled to Shiroya, I looked behind me. As expected, Akaro's body still lay on the floor, but he was far from my first priority."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached Shiroya and turned her to face me. Her eyes were half-open, and she seemed conscious, which was exactly what I needed to see.
entries.literal: "I reached Shiroya and turned her to face me. Her eyes were half-open, and she seemed conscious, which was exactly what I needed to see."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are y—*cough* *cough*
entries.literal: "Are y—*cough* *cough*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My sentence was cut off by dry coughing that took over my body. It seemed I had inhaled a bit of the smoke, but it might've meant that we hadn't been unconscious for a long time.
entries.literal: "My sentence was cut off by dry coughing that took over my body. It seemed I had inhaled a bit of the smoke, but it might've meant that we hadn't been unconscious for a long time."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes... I think so. *cough*
entries.literal: "Yes... I think so. *cough*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her eyes opened fully, and she tried to steady herself with an arm.
entries.literal: "Her eyes opened fully, and she tried to steady herself with an arm."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That smoke... W-Was it...?
entries.literal: "That smoke... W-Was it...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe. Liste—*cough* {w}Listen. We'll find out what happened. Just stay there for a minute, okay? Do you feel okay?
entries.literal: "Maybe. Liste—*cough* {w}Listen. We'll find out what happened. Just stay there for a minute, okay? Do you feel okay?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-Yes...
entries.literal: "Y-Yes..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could tell that she was barely keeping it together. She must've been afraid of the worst, just like I was, but that time we'd woken up safely.
entries.literal: "I could tell that she was barely keeping it together. She must've been afraid of the worst, just like I was, but that time we'd woken up safely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around me. It was a bizarre sight, and the disgusting smell was still present after the smoke had faded.{w} The room had been painted black. The curtain's beautiful red, the walls, the ceiling... They'd all been corrupted by an ugly, dark color, almost purple.
entries.literal: "I looked around me. It was a bizarre sight, and the disgusting smell was still present after the smoke had faded.{w} The room had been painted black. The curtain's beautiful red, the walls, the ceiling... They'd all been corrupted by an ugly, dark color, almost purple."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The floor, however, had not received the same treatment. It had become gray, but it was nowhere near the strong black that consumed the ceiling.
entries.literal: "The floor, however, had not received the same treatment. It had become gray, but it was nowhere near the strong black that consumed the ceiling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And there was something much more important that I quickly noticed.
entries.literal: "And there was something much more important that I quickly noticed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Naomi's gone... She's not here.
entries.literal: "Naomi's gone... She's not here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...What? Y-You're right. Wh-Where could she have gone?
entries.literal: "...What? Y-You're right. Wh-Where could she have gone?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The door's open.
entries.literal: "The door's open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door opposite the one we'd entered was very slightly ajar. Naomi could've woken up and left through it, maybe to understand what had happened after seeing that we were still knocked out.
entries.literal: "The door opposite the one we'd entered was very slightly ajar. Naomi could've woken up and left through it, maybe to understand what had happened after seeing that we were still knocked out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even reaching that small conclusion took a lot out of me, but the headache was beginning to fade almost as quickly as it had come on.
entries.literal: "Even reaching that small conclusion took a lot out of me, but the headache was beginning to fade almost as quickly as it had come on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I noticed our voices had woken Akaro, who still hadn't moved at all.
entries.literal: "I noticed our voices had woken Akaro, who still hadn't moved at all."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Ugh.

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What the... fuck is this?
entries.literal: "What the... fuck is this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He felt his face with his hand as he grimaced. Then, he slowly stood up and attempted to balance himself while perplexedly looking around him.
entries.literal: "He felt his face with his hand as he grimaced. Then, he slowly stood up and attempted to balance himself while perplexedly looking around him."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hey, what is all this? You said Naomi's gone? What the fuck just happened...? I think a lot of smoke suddenly appeared out of nowhere, right? Did it knock us out?
entries.literal: "Hey, what is all this? You said Naomi's gone? What the fuck just happened...? I think a lot of smoke suddenly appeared out of nowhere, right? Did it knock us out?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For the first time, he started a conversation with us. Before answering, I began to clean my face, as the smoke had created a sticky mask on it as well.
entries.literal: "For the first time, he started a conversation with us. Before answering, I began to clean my face, as the smoke had created a sticky mask on it as well."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I have no idea. But yes, th-that smoke must've had something in it that made us fall unconscious.
entries.literal: "I have no idea. But yes, th-that smoke must've had something in it that made us fall unconscious."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And a few seconds before I fainted, a very loud alarm went off.
entries.literal: "And a few seconds before I fainted, a very loud alarm went off."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: An alarm? I must've fallen unconscious too fast. All I remember is getting dizzy as hell out of nowhere and falling over.
entries.literal: "An alarm? I must've fallen unconscious too fast. All I remember is getting dizzy as hell out of nowhere and falling over."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I don't think I heard it either. Did it say anything?
entries.literal: "...I don't think I heard it either. Did it say anything?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, it was only a loud sound.
entries.literal: "No, it was only a loud sound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I was still attempting to stand up, Akaro walked to the open door and looked through it.
entries.literal: "While I was still attempting to stand up, Akaro walked to the open door and looked through it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh... What the hell happened here?{w} It's dark in this room, but the hallway is too. The walls and ceiling are black, and I can't see anyone. The whole hallway's covered. How much smoke was there?
entries.literal: "Oh... What the hell happened here?{w} It's dark in this room, but the hallway is too. The walls and ceiling are black, and I can't see anyone. The whole hallway's covered. How much smoke was there?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Everyone must've evacuated when they heard the alarm, even though it came a bit after the smoke appeared.
entries.literal: "Everyone must've evacuated when they heard the alarm, even though it came a bit after the smoke appeared."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Did you see where the smoke came from? I didn't see anything, and there's nothing here.
entries.literal: "...Did you see where the smoke came from? I didn't see anything, and there's nothing here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: N-No, but you're right. It surrounded us in an instant, and it probably appeared in this room and in the hallways at the same time.
entries.literal: "N-No, but you're right. It surrounded us in an instant, and it probably appeared in this room and in the hallways at the same time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Both of these doors were closed, so the origin had to have been here. Something must've happened while we were unconscious.
entries.literal: "Both of these doors were closed, so the origin had to have been here. Something must've happened while we were unconscious."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why are we alone, though? There were police officers outside. Why haven't they come?
entries.literal: "Why are we alone, though? There were police officers outside. Why haven't they come?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea.{w} Still a bit disoriented, I forced my neck to turn. The only thing in the room was the covered cabinet. However, I doubted the Sekimeiya would still be there. The easiest conclusion to reach was that the smoke had been part of an attack designed to steal it.
entries.literal: "I had no idea.{w} Still a bit disoriented, I forced my neck to turn. The only thing in the room was the covered cabinet. However, I doubted the Sekimeiya would still be there. The easiest conclusion to reach was that the smoke had been part of an attack designed to steal it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: The smoke wasn't released in the other rooms in the hallway.
entries.literal: "The smoke wasn't released in the other rooms in the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything was giving me a surreal vibe. I had no idea what was going on, but at first glance, the danger seemed to have faded away.
entries.literal: "Everything was giving me a surreal vibe. I had no idea what was going on, but at first glance, the danger seemed to have faded away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My headache was nearly gone, thankfully. That meant that I could start thinking things through. {w}What had happened? Why had it happened? How was I going to find the person responsible?
entries.literal: "My headache was nearly gone, thankfully. That meant that I could start thinking things through. {w}What had happened? Why had it happened? How was I going to find the person responsible?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Maybe I was just trying to distract myself from reality by thinking things like that, but I had a personal stake in it. I couldn't forgive whoever was responsible.
entries.literal: "Maybe I was just trying to distract myself from reality by thinking things like that, but I had a personal stake in it. I couldn't forgive whoever was responsible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya probably felt the same way. We couldn't just ignore it, and someone was missing.
entries.literal: "Shiroya probably felt the same way. We couldn't just ignore it, and someone was missing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room was empty, and it had been empty before we'd fallen unconscious. Only the cabinet had been with us, but if the smoke had come out of it, it wouldn't have surrounded us so fast.{w} We had been stained, but not as much on the lower parts of our bodies. The ceiling was significantly darkened, the floor not so much. The smoke's density was low.
entries.literal: "The room was empty, and it had been empty before we'd fallen unconscious. Only the cabinet had been with us, but if the smoke had come out of it, it wouldn't have surrounded us so fast.{w} We had been stained, but not as much on the lower parts of our bodies. The ceiling was significantly darkened, the floor not so much. The smoke's density was low."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Did that mean that the origin of the smoke had been the very center of the room? How did that make any sense?
entries.literal: "...Did that mean that the origin of the smoke had been the very center of the room? How did that make any sense?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya staggered slightly. I reached out to try and hold her shoulder, but as my body was still recovering, both of us fell back to the floor.
entries.literal: "Shiroya staggered slightly. I reached out to try and hold her shoulder, but as my body was still recovering, both of us fell back to the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without looking at us, Akaro walked to the door we'd entered through.
entries.literal: "Without looking at us, Akaro walked to the door we'd entered through."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It happened here too.
entries.literal: "It happened here too."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Yeah. When I fell to the floor, I noticed there was no light below that door. Given how dark the room had become, I thought the hallway must've been just as dark. ...The smoke was released at the same time, even though both places looked empty.
entries.literal: "...Yeah. When I fell to the floor, I noticed there was no light below that door. Given how dark the room had become, I thought the hallway must've been just as dark. ...The smoke was released at the same time, even though both places looked empty."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...What the fuck is this about? That woman disappeared, but she fell unconscious too, didn't she? And you're right. Why is no one else here?
entries.literal: "...What the fuck is this about? That woman disappeared, but she fell unconscious too, didn't she? And you're right. Why is no one else here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although those points were very strange, I was still relieved that none of us had been harmed. I lay on the floor for a bit, attempting to gather more strength.{w} When thoughts came to me, it was calming to realize that they were different from what had recently filled my head.
entries.literal: "Although those points were very strange, I was still relieved that none of us had been harmed. I lay on the floor for a bit, attempting to gather more strength.{w} When thoughts came to me, it was calming to realize that they were different from what had recently filled my head."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This room connects two parallel hallways, which were attacked alongside this room all at once. Was this done to isolate us?
entries.literal: "This room connects two parallel hallways, which were attacked alongside this room all at once. Was this done to isolate us?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Someone attacked the building to steal the Sekimeiya, right? That must've been the intention. The smoke formed an easy path for whoever had planned it to make their way here, obtain the Sekimeiya, and leave.
entries.literal: "Someone attacked the building to steal the Sekimeiya, right? That must've been the intention. The smoke formed an easy path for whoever had planned it to make their way here, obtain the Sekimeiya, and leave."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It sounds like a messy, risky plan, but it's the obvious thing that comes to mind. The open door seems to back it up, even though Naomi must have left through one anyway.
entries.literal: "It sounds like a messy, risky plan, but it's the obvious thing that comes to mind. The open door seems to back it up, even though Naomi must have left through one anyway."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Do I have to conclude that Naomi was part of this, and while we were out, she took the Sekimeiya and left? ...Making herself look suspicious immediately? Being a staff member, she'd know many things about the security system... and we were the first group to enter, meaning out of us four, she was the only one that wasn't part of the first visit coincidentally.
entries.literal: "Do I have to conclude that Naomi was part of this, and while we were out, she took the Sekimeiya and left? ...Making herself look suspicious immediately? Being a staff member, she'd know many things about the security system... and we were the first group to enter, meaning out of us four, she was the only one that wasn't part of the first visit coincidentally."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Or, I could say that if I knew Akaro at all. I did think he looked distant from everything else.
entries.literal: "Or, I could say that if I knew Akaro at all. I did think he looked distant from everything else."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Maybe Akaro was aware of the fact the smoke would appear. He could have immediately faked his unconsciousness by throwing himself to the floor, knowing he would avoid breathing in anything from the upper half of the room. The fact the floor is barely stained proves the smoke never came down.
entries.literal: "Maybe Akaro was aware of the fact the smoke would appear. He could have immediately faked his unconsciousness by throwing himself to the floor, knowing he would avoid breathing in anything from the upper half of the room. The fact the floor is barely stained proves the smoke never came down."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Once we're all out of it, he obtains the Sekimeiya.{w} I should also consider that the smoke first arose shortly after Naomi unlocked the cabinet. This doesn't mean much, given that she could have had her key taken after she was unconscious, but if whoever did this didn't know much about the cabinet's mechanism, it makes sense they waited until it was unlocked.
entries.literal: "Once we're all out of it, he obtains the Sekimeiya.{w} I should also consider that the smoke first arose shortly after Naomi unlocked the cabinet. This doesn't mean much, given that she could have had her key taken after she was unconscious, but if whoever did this didn't know much about the cabinet's mechanism, it makes sense they waited until it was unlocked."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But how did they know exactly when that was? Doesn't this mean that they must've been inside the room? Or, again, doesn't this mean that only Akaro could've done it? Assuming this precise timing actually happened... how did he trigger the smoke? It could simply be that he gave some sort of signal to someone else outside, but phones aren't allowed here.
entries.literal: "But how did they know exactly when that was? Doesn't this mean that they must've been inside the room? Or, again, doesn't this mean that only Akaro could've done it? Assuming this precise timing actually happened... how did he trigger the smoke? It could simply be that he gave some sort of signal to someone else outside, but phones aren't allowed here."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: After we regained consciousness, he seemed to be perfectly fine physically. However, the mass difference between his body and our nineteen-year-old ones is significant. It makes sense that the substance had a somewhat weaker effect on him.
entries.literal: "After we regained consciousness, he seemed to be perfectly fine physically. However, the mass difference between his body and our nineteen-year-old ones is significant. It makes sense that the substance had a somewhat weaker effect on him."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is Akaro in possession of the Sekimeiya right now, or did he leave it somewhere? If so, why did he come back? Only to avoid suspicion? But this doesn't explain Naomi's disappearance. And how did the smoke appear, or why did the alarm sound late? And what kind of risky plan is this?
entries.literal: "Is Akaro in possession of the Sekimeiya right now, or did he leave it somewhere? If so, why did he come back? Only to avoid suspicion? But this doesn't explain Naomi's disappearance. And how did the smoke appear, or why did the alarm sound late? And what kind of risky plan is this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grimaced. I was getting carried away without realizing how far I was going. In the first place, it was ridiculous to suspect anyone until I had information.
entries.literal: "I grimaced. I was getting carried away without realizing how far I was going. In the first place, it was ridiculous to suspect anyone until I had information."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I knew. I could never let things remain as they were. Someone was responsible, and I wouldn't let them get away. I only had to bide my time.
entries.literal: "But I knew. I could never let things remain as they were. Someone was responsible, and I wouldn't let them get away. I only had to bide my time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could stand, I realized there was another avenue open to me. There was a security camera on the ceiling.
entries.literal: "Before I could stand, I realized there was another avenue open to me. There was a security camera on the ceiling."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If someone was looking at the footage and the smoke came out of an automated system, this would make a lot more sense. However, Akaro could've simply been the one to wait for the automated smoke and then followed up with whatever plan they had. This must've happened during the first visit for a reason.
entries.literal: "If someone was looking at the footage and the smoke came out of an automated system, this would make a lot more sense. However, Akaro could've simply been the one to wait for the automated smoke and then followed up with whatever plan they had. This must've happened during the first visit for a reason."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It means that whoever was looking at the direct footage would've been the one to activate the smoke system.
entries.literal: "It means that whoever was looking at the direct footage would've been the one to activate the smoke system."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I was doing it again, almost like a coping mechanism. I had to make sure Shiroya was really okay before anything else.
entries.literal: "...{w}I was doing it again, almost like a coping mechanism. I had to make sure Shiroya was really okay before anything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I attempted to lift my head, my body thankfully obeyed. I stared at the curtain that concealed the so-called Sekimeiya. It was dark, and the substance the smoke was composed of had dried up on it.
entries.literal: "When I attempted to lift my head, my body thankfully obeyed. I stared at the curtain that concealed the so-called Sekimeiya. It was dark, and the substance the smoke was composed of had dried up on it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Can you stand up?
entries.literal: "...Can you stand up?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think so.
entries.literal: "I think so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Supporting each other, Shiroya and I slowly steadied ourselves. Then, I realized Akaro had gone to the hallway.
entries.literal: "Supporting each other, Shiroya and I slowly steadied ourselves. Then, I realized Akaro had gone to the hallway."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Finally! Thank goodness!
entries.literal: "Finally! Thank goodness!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A shout came from the same area. It was a feminine voice, which at least indicated we weren't alone.
entries.literal: "A shout came from the same area. It was a feminine voice, which at least indicated we weren't alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked to it slowly as I wiped more of the solidified substance off of myself. I was curious to see if the Sekimeiya was still in the cabinet, but we would find that out very soon regardless.
entries.literal: "We walked to it slowly as I wiped more of the solidified substance off of myself. I was curious to see if the Sekimeiya was still in the cabinet, but we would find that out very soon regardless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hallway was almost as dark as the room. The smoke had coated every light bulb, but since there were many of them, some light could make it past the barrier.
entries.literal: "The hallway was almost as dark as the room. The smoke had coated every light bulb, but since there were many of them, some light could make it past the barrier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The smoke had created a thorough cover on the walls and ceilings, which must've been an intended result. It had set up a dark environment, but that couldn't be the sole purpose: something had been added to the smoke to create the same effect on every surface it touched.
entries.literal: "The smoke had created a thorough cover on the walls and ceilings, which must've been an intended result. It had set up a dark environment, but that couldn't be the sole purpose: something had been added to the smoke to create the same effect on every surface it touched."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Close to the start of the hallway, near the door Naomi had first appeared through, I saw human figures. Our approaching footsteps were noticed by one, and it rose from its knees.
entries.literal: "Close to the start of the hallway, near the door Naomi had first appeared through, I saw human figures. Our approaching footsteps were noticed by one, and it rose from its knees."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We got closer and saw two more people kneeling down. Akaro was with them, and after finally arriving where they were, I noticed a small body on the floor.
entries.literal: "We got closer and saw two more people kneeling down. Akaro was with them, and after finally arriving where they were, I noticed a small body on the floor."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla's finally waking up. Thank God.
entries.literal: "Isla's finally waking up. Thank God."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That woman was the person we'd heard. She had the little girl on her lap and was looking at her closed eyes with concern.
entries.literal: "That woman was the person we'd heard. She had the little girl on her lap and was looking at her closed eyes with concern."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I see. So, you three were also unable to evacuate.
entries.literal: "I see. So, you three were also unable to evacuate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The person who had stood up was a well-dressed old man. As he said that, the two kneeling people turned their heads to face us.
entries.literal: "The person who had stood up was a well-dressed old man. As he said that, the two kneeling people turned their heads to face us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But the words "unable to evacuate" were more ominous than I'd expected, especially due to his rough voice.
entries.literal: "But the words \"unable to evacuate\" were more ominous than I'd expected, especially due to his rough voice."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Is she okay?
entries.literal: "Is she okay?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I... I think so. She's finally breathing fine.
entries.literal: "I... I think so. She's finally breathing fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya sat next to the others and worriedly looked at the girl who'd been called Isla. Next to them was a guy my age, who was staring at the girl in silence.
entries.literal: "Shiroya sat next to the others and worriedly looked at the girl who'd been called Isla. Next to them was a guy my age, who was staring at the girl in silence."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Smoke appeared out of nowhere and knocked us out. Do you know what happened?
entries.literal: "Smoke appeared out of nowhere and knocked us out. Do you know what happened?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I'm afraid I don't.{w} You were in the event room, right? Shouldn't another woman be with you?
entries.literal: "...I'm afraid I don't.{w} You were in the event room, right? Shouldn't another woman be with you?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Naomi, yes. She was gone when we woke up.
entries.literal: "Naomi, yes. She was gone when we woke up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite the dim light, I was able to discern his frown.
entries.literal: "Despite the dim light, I was able to discern his frown."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm pretty sure she passed out too, but the door to the other hallway was open when we woke up.
entries.literal: "I'm pretty sure she passed out too, but the door to the other hallway was open when we woke up."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...She left while you were still unconscious? That's strange. I inspected this floor a bit and didn't find her.
entries.literal: "...She left while you were still unconscious? That's strange. I inspected this floor a bit and didn't find her."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Is that strange? Maybe she exited the building entirely.
entries.literal: "Is that strange? Maybe she exited the building entirely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When his look lowered again, I realized there was something very important that we were missing. Why was nobody else there? Why had the unconscious child not been taken outside, at the very least?
entries.literal: "When his look lowered again, I realized there was something very important that we were missing. Why was nobody else there? Why had the unconscious child not been taken outside, at the very least?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: She couldn't have left. If she fell unconscious like the rest of you, she still has to be here.
entries.literal: "She couldn't have left. If she fell unconscious like the rest of you, she still has to be here."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The man didn't answer immediately, so I took that time to look him over. Due to the lighting, I'd just gotten the impression that he was a simple well-dressed old man, but those weren't casual clothes.
entries.literal: "The man didn't answer immediately, so I took that time to look him over. Due to the lighting, I'd just gotten the impression that he was a simple well-dressed old man, but those weren't casual clothes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Did all of you hear the alarm that played throughout the building? After I heard it, I saw all the smoke.
entries.literal: "Did all of you hear the alarm that played throughout the building? After I heard it, I saw all the smoke."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those words made me consider an important detail. His shirt was white and a lot less stained than ours, indicating that it hadn't been hit by the smoke during its release. In contrast, the woman and the other guy had the same smoke pattern we did, being more stained on their top halves.
entries.literal: "Those words made me consider an important detail. His shirt was white and a lot less stained than ours, indicating that it hadn't been hit by the smoke during its release. In contrast, the woman and the other guy had the same smoke pattern we did, being more stained on their top halves."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I am responsible for this building's security system. When the smoke appeared, I was in the security room, found in the other hallway.
entries.literal: "I am responsible for this building's security system. When the smoke appeared, I was in the security room, found in the other hallway."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Since today was a special day, most of the visitors were in the lobby awaiting their turn for the event, so they had no problem leaving safely when they saw the smoke. You might know that this tower has many floors, but only this one is open to the public, and no one was on the higher levels.
entries.literal: "Since today was a special day, most of the visitors were in the lobby awaiting their turn for the event, so they had no problem leaving safely when they saw the smoke. You might know that this tower has many floors, but only this one is open to the public, and no one was on the higher levels."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It was a big shock to see all that smoke, so I panicked and spent a while in the security room trying to figure out what had happened. When I realized I couldn't get anywhere, I exited and began searching through this floor. It seems you all were the first two groups of three for today's event.
entries.literal: "It was a big shock to see all that smoke, so I panicked and spent a while in the security room trying to figure out what had happened. When I realized I couldn't get anywhere, I exited and began searching through this floor. It seems you all were the first two groups of three for today's event."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes. We were told to wait here after the first group moved forward.
entries.literal: "Yes. We were told to wait here after the first group moved forward."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, that's right. I remember seeing her earlier, now that I look at her closer.
entries.literal: "Oh, that's right. I remember seeing her earlier, now that I look at her closer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I also recalled seeing the three of them behind us in the lobby. I was still trying to understand the older man's words, though, as he had said the security room was in the other hallway. At the same time, we cleaned the rest of the smoke off our bodies until only a few traces remained.
entries.literal: "I also recalled seeing the three of them behind us in the lobby. I was still trying to understand the older man's words, though, as he had said the security room was in the other hallway. At the same time, we cleaned the rest of the smoke off our bodies until only a few traces remained."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You said you saw the smoke, but your clothes are much cleaner than ours. Did it not hit you?
entries.literal: "You said you saw the smoke, but your clothes are much cleaner than ours. Did it not hit you?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's right. I didn't leave the room while it was in the hallway. When I said I saw the smoke, I was talking about the security cameras.
entries.literal: "That's right. I didn't leave the room while it was in the hallway. When I said I saw the smoke, I was talking about the security cameras."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, I see.
entries.literal: "Oh, I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...So, he was the person I'd just accused in my head.
entries.literal: "...So, he was the person I'd just accused in my head."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I wasn't able to figure anything out through the cameras, unfortunately. When I left a few minutes later, I saw all the walls were black.
entries.literal: "I wasn't able to figure anything out through the cameras, unfortunately. When I left a few minutes later, I saw all the walls were black."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew he was slowly giving me information, so I didn't want to interrupt him. However, more questions were coming to my mind, such as why he hadn't come across our group first.
entries.literal: "I knew he was slowly giving me information, so I didn't want to interrupt him. However, more questions were coming to my mind, such as why he hadn't come across our group first."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait, you saw what the hallway looked like after you left the security room? Don't you have enough security cameras to see it from there?
entries.literal: "Wait, you saw what the hallway looked like after you left the security room? Don't you have enough security cameras to see it from there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't help myself from asking for details. The more I tried to coast through things, the more I resisted it. I needed to know as much as possible.
entries.literal: "I couldn't help myself from asking for details. The more I tried to coast through things, the more I resisted it. I needed to know as much as possible."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No. The thing is, they became useless after the smoke appeared. It instantly covered the lens of every camera that was hit by it.
entries.literal: "No. The thing is, they became useless after the smoke appeared. It instantly covered the lens of every camera that was hit by it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...That makes sense. It must be why the smoke created this film on every surface it touched. It worked to disable the cameras.
entries.literal: "...That makes sense. It must be why the smoke created this film on every surface it touched. It worked to disable the cameras."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. While I was there, I had no way to know what was happening in the hallways or in the event room. I took my time to look at the footage of all the other rooms, but I didn't see anything suspicious at all. No people, either.
entries.literal: "Yes. While I was there, I had no way to know what was happening in the hallways or in the event room. I took my time to look at the footage of all the other rooms, but I didn't see anything suspicious at all. No people, either."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...But I should get into what's most important. The alarm that played wasn't your usual emergency alarm. It was one that hadn't played before.
entries.literal: "...But I should get into what's most important. The alarm that played wasn't your usual emergency alarm. It was one that hadn't played before."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I said that I stayed in the security room out of panic, but that's not all. Even if I'd left, it would've been pointless. One of the special functions of the alarm is to shut down all methods of escape. This means that we have no way to leave this building, and that people outside can't enter.
entries.literal: "I said that I stayed in the security room out of panic, but that's not all. Even if I'd left, it would've been pointless. One of the special functions of the alarm is to shut down all methods of escape. This means that we have no way to leave this building, and that people outside can't enter."

entries.speaker: i
