entries.text: ...Although I'd been kind of anticipating those words, it was still a heavy blow. Shiroya and I looked at each other. It seemed everything insisted on getting worse.
entries.literal: "...Although I'd been kind of anticipating those words, it was still a heavy blow. Shiroya and I looked at each other. It seemed everything insisted on getting worse."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hang on, hang on. What the fuck? We're trapped in here? How long does it close the exit for? Why!? And is there no way to undo it or contact the outside!?
entries.literal: "Hang on, hang on. What the fuck? We're trapped in here? How long does it close the exit for? Why!? And is there no way to undo it or contact the outside!?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...It closes all the exit routes for twelve hours. The reason as to why is a bit complicated, and for our purposes, confidential. I'm sorry, but I can't get into that.
entries.literal: "...It closes all the exit routes for twelve hours. The reason as to why is a bit complicated, and for our purposes, confidential. I'm sorry, but I can't get into that."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: As for a way to contact the outside, there should be one. We can try it.
entries.literal: "As for a way to contact the outside, there should be one. We can try it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya wasn't faring well, and Akaro seemed to be in complete disbelief at what he was hearing.
entries.literal: "Shiroya wasn't faring well, and Akaro seemed to be in complete disbelief at what he was hearing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Hey.

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...It's going to be fine. Okay?
entries.literal: "...It's going to be fine. Okay?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. Yeah, okay.
entries.literal: "Yeah. Yeah, okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned back to the others. Barring Akaro, none of them seemed very surprised about the situation.
entries.literal: "I turned back to the others. Barring Akaro, none of them seemed very surprised about the situation."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is this not a shock for you?
entries.literal: "Is this not a shock for you?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I already told them. Getting Isla out of here would normally have been the first thing any of us would have done.
entries.literal: "I already told them. Getting Isla out of here would normally have been the first thing any of us would have done."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't seem like the type of building to have medical equipment stored in it, so the woman must have immediately tried to extract who I could only assume was her daughter.
entries.literal: "It didn't seem like the type of building to have medical equipment stored in it, so the woman must have immediately tried to extract who I could only assume was her daughter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no reason to think that some secret entrance existed, so I more or less had to assume that we really were trapped for half a day. The existence of such an alarm seemed absurd, but it also might've succeeded at trapping whoever'd been responsible for the smoke.
entries.literal: "There was no reason to think that some secret entrance existed, so I more or less had to assume that we really were trapped for half a day. The existence of such an alarm seemed absurd, but it also might've succeeded at trapping whoever'd been responsible for the smoke."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: S-So, you're right, Naomi still has to be here.{w} And is that everyone? I get that most people were in the lobby, but if someone else entered the hallways, they couldn't have evacuated either.
entries.literal: "S-So, you're right, Naomi still has to be here.{w} And is that everyone? I get that most people were in the lobby, but if someone else entered the hallways, they couldn't have evacuated either."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Is it possible the smoke in the hallway wasn't as dense, which gave people time to run from it before the alarm went off?
entries.literal: "Is it possible the smoke in the hallway wasn't as dense, which gave people time to run from it before the alarm went off?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, that can't be.
entries.literal: "No, that can't be."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The guy who'd remained quiet finally spoke.
entries.literal: "The guy who'd remained quiet finally spoke."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We were right here when the smoke appeared. The moment we inhaled a bit of it, we were out like a light. We pretty much collapsed instantly.
entries.literal: "We were right here when the smoke appeared. The moment we inhaled a bit of it, we were out like a light. We pretty much collapsed instantly."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I see. Then I couldn't tell you.
entries.literal: "I see. Then I couldn't tell you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...From what I could see from there, the other rooms in the hallway were clean. If someone had been in one, they were definitely trapped too. I could recall that the alarm played approximately twenty seconds after the smoke's appearance, but it was unlikely that had been enough time for it to entirely dissipate.
entries.literal: "...From what I could see from there, the other rooms in the hallway were clean. If someone had been in one, they were definitely trapped too. I could recall that the alarm played approximately twenty seconds after the smoke's appearance, but it was unlikely that had been enough time for it to entirely dissipate."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I-I can't believe what you're telling us. What the fuck does this mean? Why are we trapped here!?
entries.literal: "I-I can't believe what you're telling us. What the fuck does this mean? Why are we trapped here!?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I sincerely apologize. I'm confused as well, but there's nothing I can tell you. We'll have to be here all day, but I'll try to figure out what happened. My name is Katei Kuiji.
entries.literal: "I sincerely apologize. I'm confused as well, but there's nothing I can tell you. We'll have to be here all day, but I'll try to figure out what happened. My name is Katei Kuiji."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was ridiculous, but we couldn't do anything about it. After a period of silence where nobody knew how to react, the woman spoke.
entries.literal: "It was ridiculous, but we couldn't do anything about it. After a period of silence where nobody knew how to react, the woman spoke."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She's Isla, my daughter. She's been unconscious since the smoke appeared, but her breathing's steadier now. I'm Erina.
entries.literal: "She's Isla, my daughter. She's been unconscious since the smoke appeared, but her breathing's steadier now. I'm Erina."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I'm Shiroya.
entries.literal: "...I'm Shiroya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And my name's Atsuki. We came here together. ...How old is she?
entries.literal: "And my name's Atsuki. We came here together. ...How old is she?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She'll be ten in a bit more than a week. Her birthday is two days before Christmas.
entries.literal: "She'll be ten in a bit more than a week. Her birthday is two days before Christmas."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Realizing the rest of his group had introduced themselves, the guy followed.
entries.literal: "Realizing the rest of his group had introduced themselves, the guy followed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm Sai.
entries.literal: "I'm Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked back at the man separated from us.
entries.literal: "We looked back at the man separated from us."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Akaro.
entries.literal: "Akaro."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immediately, the silence returned. What the hell had happened? I thought back on the wordless alarm that had locked us in. It communicated zero information, seemingly only designed to tell us that we'd been trapped.
entries.literal: "Immediately, the silence returned. What the hell had happened? I thought back on the wordless alarm that had locked us in. It communicated zero information, seemingly only designed to tell us that we'd been trapped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It made sense if the culprit was one of us, but not even the staff member who was still there had any idea who it could have been, which made things difficult.
entries.literal: "It made sense if the culprit was one of us, but not even the staff member who was still there had any idea who it could have been, which made things difficult."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And the target of the attack... It had to be the Sekimeiya. There was no way it wasn't related. The very first showing of a newly-discovered gemstone being interrupted meant only one thing.
entries.literal: "And the target of the attack... It had to be the Sekimeiya. There was no way it wasn't related. The very first showing of a newly-discovered gemstone being interrupted meant only one thing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't checked whether the Sekimeiya was still in the room, but it was confirmed that it was still in the building with us, even if it had been taken out of its cabinet.
entries.literal: "We hadn't checked whether the Sekimeiya was still in the room, but it was confirmed that it was still in the building with us, even if it had been taken out of its cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The attack had been deliberate. That was the most important point. Whoever was responsible, I wanted to find them out and expose them. It was deeply personal.
entries.literal: "The attack had been deliberate. That was the most important point. Whoever was responsible, I wanted to find them out and expose them. It was deeply personal."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: *cough*... *cough*
entries.literal: "*cough*... *cough*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all glanced at Isla's pained face. After the second cough, she proceeded to slightly open her eyes.
entries.literal: "We all glanced at Isla's pained face. After the second cough, she proceeded to slightly open her eyes."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla! Finally! Are you okay? How do you feel?
entries.literal: "Isla! Finally! Are you okay? How do you feel?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina's sudden outburst seemed to confuse her daughter. She raised her head and blinked blearily at all of us.
entries.literal: "Erina's sudden outburst seemed to confuse her daughter. She raised her head and blinked blearily at all of us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Looking back at her mother, she coughed weakly again and spoke.
entries.literal: "Looking back at her mother, she coughed weakly again and spoke."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Wh-Where are we...? What are we... d-doing here?
entries.literal: "Wh-Where are we...? What are we... d-doing here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her disorientation definitely wasn't helped by the fact that all the walls were stained black. Shiroya seemed like she wanted to say something, but she held back and let Erina speak.
entries.literal: "Her disorientation definitely wasn't helped by the fact that all the walls were stained black. Shiroya seemed like she wanted to say something, but she held back and let Erina speak."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We're still inside Ashiya Tower. Do you remember all that smoke? It knocked us out, and you're the last one to wake up.
entries.literal: "We're still inside Ashiya Tower. Do you remember all that smoke? It knocked us out, and you're the last one to wake up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina stroked Isla's hair gently, which seemed to soothe her.
entries.literal: "Erina stroked Isla's hair gently, which seemed to soothe her."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Weren't we going to see the Sekimeiya? I'm trying to remember what happened after that, but I can't. Did we ever do that?
entries.literal: "Weren't we going to see the Sekimeiya? I'm trying to remember what happened after that, but I can't. Did we ever do that?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No, sweetie. We were waiting for that in this very hallway when the smoke came out. Do you not remember?
entries.literal: "No, sweetie. We were waiting for that in this very hallway when the smoke came out. Do you not remember?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh... smoke? I'm not sure... Is this that hallway? Why is everything black?
entries.literal: "Oh... smoke? I'm not sure... Is this that hallway? Why is everything black?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's also the smoke's doing. It stained everything it touched.
entries.literal: "That's also the smoke's doing. It stained everything it touched."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya finally spoke up. Isla seemed to realize that everyone else had faint black stains on their clothes, so she looked down at her own to find them almost completely clean. At her height, her head had been primarily affected, but Erina had evidently wiped off the remnants already.
entries.literal: "Shiroya finally spoke up. Isla seemed to realize that everyone else had faint black stains on their clothes, so she looked down at her own to find them almost completely clean. At her height, her head had been primarily affected, but Erina had evidently wiped off the remnants already."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Do you feel okay? You've been out for a long time. I was really worried...
entries.literal: "Do you feel okay? You've been out for a long time. I was really worried..."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Sorry... I think I feel okay, but my head hurts.
entries.literal: "Sorry... I think I feel okay, but my head hurts."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: But why are we here? Why is there no light, and why are we alone?
entries.literal: "But why are we here? Why is there no light, and why are we alone?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all looked at each other, and for a few seconds, nobody knew how to answer. Katei quickly decided it was his job to do so.
entries.literal: "We all looked at each other, and for a few seconds, nobody knew how to answer. Katei quickly decided it was his job to do so."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We're not aware of what caused the smoke, but it must've triggered a special alarm that shut down all entrance and exit methods. That means that we will have to stay here for the next twelve hours, and it's possible there's only eight of us who didn't evacuate in time.
entries.literal: "We're not aware of what caused the smoke, but it must've triggered a special alarm that shut down all entrance and exit methods. That means that we will have to stay here for the next twelve hours, and it's possible there's only eight of us who didn't evacuate in time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all slightly lowered our heads, unsure whether his abrupt explanation had been a good idea to direct at a kid who had just woken up.
entries.literal: "We all slightly lowered our heads, unsure whether his abrupt explanation had been a good idea to direct at a kid who had just woken up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla processed that information in silence for a minute. I didn't expect she'd take it well.
entries.literal: "Isla processed that information in silence for a minute. I didn't expect she'd take it well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But against my own prediction, she passively tossed out some words in response.
entries.literal: "But against my own prediction, she passively tossed out some words in response."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh... I see... What are we going to do until then?
entries.literal: "Oh... I see... What are we going to do until then?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was relieved that she hadn't reacted badly. Telling a kid something like that could've gone much worse.
entries.literal: "I was relieved that she hadn't reacted badly. Telling a kid something like that could've gone much worse."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Sadly, there's not much to do here. This first floor is filled with exhibition rooms, and it's officially called the "crystal floor" in reference to all the gems. The upper floors are nothing but offices, and I'm afraid they're as uninteresting as they sound.
entries.literal: "...Sadly, there's not much to do here. This first floor is filled with exhibition rooms, and it's officially called the \"crystal floor\" in reference to all the gems. The upper floors are nothing but offices, and I'm afraid they're as uninteresting as they sound."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: They're offices? Does that mean we could use them to communicate with the outside? Is that what you meant earlier when you said that could be possible?
entries.literal: "They're offices? Does that mean we could use them to communicate with the outside? Is that what you meant earlier when you said that could be possible?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, no. Usually, that would be the case, but the local internet connection is also something that the alarm shuts down, precisely to block all communication methods.
entries.literal: "Oh, no. Usually, that would be the case, but the local internet connection is also something that the alarm shuts down, precisely to block all communication methods."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You people cut the internet too? Is that only going to come back when the exit opens?
entries.literal: "You people cut the internet too? Is that only going to come back when the exit opens?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. We can't access it until then. There's no phone either, and I don't have mine here.
entries.literal: "Yes. We can't access it until then. There's no phone either, and I don't have mine here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What did you mean, then? How do we have any way to speak to anyone outside?
entries.literal: "What did you mean, then? How do we have any way to speak to anyone outside?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The room where I work, the security room, has a function that lets us enable communication with the outside. That one should not be out of commission.
entries.literal: "The room where I work, the security room, has a function that lets us enable communication with the outside. That one should not be out of commission."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was slightly relieving. If we could talk with people and understand the situation better, that'd make the wait much more bearable.
entries.literal: "That was slightly relieving. If we could talk with people and understand the situation better, that'd make the wait much more bearable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, it seemed strange to me that a communication method wouldn't be disabled. Entirely blocking off the exit and shutting down the internet connection seemed to indicate the goal was to fully isolate the interior. Leaving one method available didn't fit, which meant it wasn't one anyone would know how to access.
entries.literal: "However, it seemed strange to me that a communication method wouldn't be disabled. Entirely blocking off the exit and shutting down the internet connection seemed to indicate the goal was to fully isolate the interior. Leaving one method available didn't fit, which meant it wasn't one anyone would know how to access."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla stood up and brushed herself off. She seemed ready to say something else, but a nearby sound startled us.
entries.literal: "Isla stood up and brushed herself off. She seemed ready to say something else, but a nearby sound startled us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We turned to face it and were met with a door opening. It was the one that led to the lobby.
entries.literal: "We turned to face it and were met with a door opening. It was the one that led to the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had someone else gotten trapped? I thought that until I saw Sai next to the door. Then, I realized he hadn't said anything since he'd told us his name.
entries.literal: "Had someone else gotten trapped? I thought that until I saw Sai next to the door. Then, I realized he hadn't said anything since he'd told us his name."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His left hand was gripping the knob.
entries.literal: "His left hand was gripping the knob."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Where are you going?
entries.literal: "Where are you going?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It looked like we were all a little confused that he'd been about to leave without warning.
entries.literal: "It looked like we were all a little confused that he'd been about to leave without warning."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm going to check the lobby. I'm not doubting what Katei has said, but I haven't personally seen the exit closed, so I'm curious if it could be forced open, for example.
entries.literal: "I'm going to check the lobby. I'm not doubting what Katei has said, but I haven't personally seen the exit closed, so I'm curious if it could be forced open, for example."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody said anything. Instead, everyone but Shiroya, who was still sitting down, began to slowly walk to the door.
entries.literal: "Nobody said anything. Instead, everyone but Shiroya, who was still sitting down, began to slowly walk to the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the opportunity to pull her aside and check on her.
entries.literal: "I took the opportunity to pull her aside and check on her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...This was a deliberate attack, and I want to find out who did it if I can. Are you okay with that?
entries.literal: "...This was a deliberate attack, and I want to find out who did it if I can. Are you okay with that?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why are you asking me that?
entries.literal: "Why are you asking me that?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If you want to just hole up in a room for twelve hours, I'll respect it. But I don't want the person or people responsible getting away, and I think you feel the same way.
entries.literal: "If you want to just hole up in a room for twelve hours, I'll respect it. But I don't want the person or people responsible getting away, and I think you feel the same way."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Yeah. I'm... I just don't want you to get caught up in something dangerous, Atsuki.
entries.literal: "...Yeah. I'm... I just don't want you to get caught up in something dangerous, Atsuki."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's not like I'm some detective... I know that. But if you notice someone lying, or find out something I don't, I want to know.
entries.literal: "It's not like I'm some detective... I know that. But if you notice someone lying, or find out something I don't, I want to know."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I just figure if we really are trapped here, we should keep track of what happens. The culprit must've gotten trapped, so we can't trust anyone here.
entries.literal: "I just figure if we really are trapped here, we should keep track of what happens. The culprit must've gotten trapped, so we can't trust anyone here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I know. Usually, the police would handle this, but... if the cameras are all covered, there might be no records.
entries.literal: "I know. Usually, the police would handle this, but... if the cameras are all covered, there might be no records."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And if they got away... If they got away, I'd...
entries.literal: "And if they got away... If they got away, I'd..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew perfectly well what she meant without her finishing the sentence.
entries.literal: "I knew perfectly well what she meant without her finishing the sentence."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm hoping that whoever did this was stupid enough to get caught on camera before that happened, but we'll see. I know you're right. We're not the police. I just don't know who we can trust.
entries.literal: "I'm hoping that whoever did this was stupid enough to get caught on camera before that happened, but we'll see. I know you're right. We're not the police. I just don't know who we can trust."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: S-Sorry, I'm just trying to... process everything. I didn't mean to be so quiet until now. I feel the same way you do.
entries.literal: "S-Sorry, I'm just trying to... process everything. I didn't mean to be so quiet until now. I feel the same way you do."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Maybe I feel worse, actually. I... hate this. I want this to be over.
entries.literal: "Maybe I feel worse, actually. I... hate this. I want this to be over."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah... Yeah. Me too. Let's get going.
entries.literal: "Yeah... Yeah. Me too. Let's get going."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I helped Shiroya to her feet, and we headed to where everyone else had gone.
entries.literal: "I helped Shiroya to her feet, and we headed to where everyone else had gone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if we'd stepped into another world, the lobby looked almost as it had when we'd last been there. The lights weren't blackened, but some had been turned off, most likely automatically. Only a bit of the smoke had sneaked through the gaps of the doors, forming a dark outline around them.
entries.literal: "As if we'd stepped into another world, the lobby looked almost as it had when we'd last been there. The lights weren't blackened, but some had been turned off, most likely automatically. Only a bit of the smoke had sneaked through the gaps of the doors, forming a dark outline around them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That would've been all if it weren't for the metal shutter blocking the door we'd entered through. Aside from the reception desk, the only things of note in the room were the couch and cleaning bucket.
entries.literal: "That would've been all if it weren't for the metal shutter blocking the door we'd entered through. Aside from the reception desk, the only things of note in the room were the couch and cleaning bucket."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone seemed to have lapsed into silence except for Katei, who simply appeared as if he didn't know what to tell us.
entries.literal: "Everyone seemed to have lapsed into silence except for Katei, who simply appeared as if he didn't know what to tell us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Oh. Guess there's no way we're opening that.
entries.literal: "...Oh. Guess there's no way we're opening that."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Isn't it... a bit excessive? Why would they trap us like this?
entries.literal: "Isn't it... a bit excessive? Why would they trap us like this?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I agree that this looks over the top, but I'm afraid the same has occurred with every window of the tower, and all the blockades are designed to not let sound pass. We won't be leaving earlier than intended. I apologize that this has happened.
entries.literal: "I agree that this looks over the top, but I'm afraid the same has occurred with every window of the tower, and all the blockades are designed to not let sound pass. We won't be leaving earlier than intended. I apologize that this has happened."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Can't you at least tell us why? Why is there a metal shutter here? This doesn't look normal at all.
entries.literal: "Can't you at least tell us why? Why is there a metal shutter here? This doesn't look normal at all."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: My apologies, but as I said earlier, I'm not allowed to supply that information.
entries.literal: "My apologies, but as I said earlier, I'm not allowed to supply that information."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But don't misinterpret me. Even though I could give you some details, I'm mostly kept in the dark when it comes to knowing the reasons. I'm only charged with making sure the system is functional, so I wouldn't be able to tell you much about what you want to know.
entries.literal: "But don't misinterpret me. Even though I could give you some details, I'm mostly kept in the dark when it comes to knowing the reasons. I'm only charged with making sure the system is functional, so I wouldn't be able to tell you much about what you want to know."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What are the details you know, then? Look at it from our perspective. We deserve the basics.
entries.literal: "What are the details you know, then? Look at it from our perspective. We deserve the basics."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I understand, I promise. However, I can't say anything.
entries.literal: "I understand, I promise. However, I can't say anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all felt the need to sigh. Knowing information was being kept from us wasn't a pleasant thought, and it disrupted any cooperation we might've wished for. However, it would've been pointless to press the issue further.
entries.literal: "We all felt the need to sigh. Knowing information was being kept from us wasn't a pleasant thought, and it disrupted any cooperation we might've wished for. However, it would've been pointless to press the issue further."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Twelve hours it is, then.
entries.literal: "Twelve hours it is, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After saying that, he walked up to the shutter and tried to move it aside to confirm that it was as sturdy as it looked.
entries.literal: "After saying that, he walked up to the shutter and tried to move it aside to confirm that it was as sturdy as it looked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, it didn't budge at all.{w} Shrugging a little, Sai turned back.
entries.literal: "Of course, it didn't budge at all.{w} Shrugging a little, Sai turned back."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This door wasn't closed, by the way. It was slightly open.
entries.literal: "This door wasn't closed, by the way. It was slightly open."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, I saw that.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I saw that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And look, very little smoke passed through it.
entries.literal: "And look, very little smoke passed through it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So it was opened after the smoke was released.
entries.literal: "So it was opened after the smoke was released."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. It was closed when we were knocked out.
entries.literal: "Yes. It was closed when we were knocked out."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I was the one who opened it.
entries.literal: "I was the one who opened it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I see.
entries.literal: "...I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the other door. Although it was closed, it appeared that more smoke had gone through it.
entries.literal: "I looked at the other door. Although it was closed, it appeared that more smoke had gone through it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}There was something else piquing my curiosity.
entries.literal: "...{w}There was something else piquing my curiosity."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Katei, you said all methods of escape were sealed. What are those? Or rather, how many of them are on this floor?
entries.literal: "Katei, you said all methods of escape were sealed. What are those? Or rather, how many of them are on this floor?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: On this floor, only this one. There are no windows at ground level, so this is all that's locked. The other floors do have windows, though, and they were fully sealed too as soon as the alarm went off.
entries.literal: "On this floor, only this one. There are no windows at ground level, so this is all that's locked. The other floors do have windows, though, and they were fully sealed too as soon as the alarm went off."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. I assumed the point of the smoke was to isolate the event room for an easy path to it, obtain the gem, and then leave with it. But that's strange.
entries.literal: "I see. I assumed the point of the smoke was to isolate the event room for an easy path to it, obtain the gem, and then leave with it. But that's strange."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Strange? I think that's the most likely scenario too.
entries.literal: "Strange? I think that's the most likely scenario too."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I say that because the lobby has been left alone. If the goal was to bring the Sekimeiya outside, why wouldn't they also release the smoke here? After all, two full hallways were attacked, so why not the lobby too?
entries.literal: "I say that because the lobby has been left alone. If the goal was to bring the Sekimeiya outside, why wouldn't they also release the smoke here? After all, two full hallways were attacked, so why not the lobby too?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. If the goal was to bring the Sekimeiya out during all the confusion, it doesn't make sense that they didn't do it here.{w} I don't know what released the smoke. I didn't see anything in the hallways, but this is a much bigger room. It could be that whatever method they used simply wouldn't have worked here.
entries.literal: "Yeah. If the goal was to bring the Sekimeiya out during all the confusion, it doesn't make sense that they didn't do it here.{w} I don't know what released the smoke. I didn't see anything in the hallways, but this is a much bigger room. It could be that whatever method they used simply wouldn't have worked here."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Maybe. If you wanted to block off the security cameras and then immediately get spotted in this hall, your plan obviously wasn't very well thought out.
entries.literal: "Maybe. If you wanted to block off the security cameras and then immediately get spotted in this hall, your plan obviously wasn't very well thought out."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Could it be that leaving with the Sekimeiya wasn't the goal of the plan? Or maybe that they intend to do it later?{w} ...Is it realistic to think anyone could cause panic with the smoke, leave with this incredibly rare item, and not be caught immediately? Even if the cameras were blocked, once outside, you're still one of the last people to exit and would be searched.
entries.literal: "Could it be that leaving with the Sekimeiya wasn't the goal of the plan? Or maybe that they intend to do it later?{w} ...Is it realistic to think anyone could cause panic with the smoke, leave with this incredibly rare item, and not be caught immediately? Even if the cameras were blocked, once outside, you're still one of the last people to exit and would be searched."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There is something that comes to mind, and it's why I only asked about this floor's escape routes.{w} The lobby was never used to escape. Now, Katei says the windows on the upper floors are sealed, but when they're open, they provide a feasible way out.
entries.literal: "There is something that comes to mind, and it's why I only asked about this floor's escape routes.{w} The lobby was never used to escape. Now, Katei says the windows on the upper floors are sealed, but when they're open, they provide a feasible way out."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Keeping in mind that the alarm came late and that we never actually saw the Sekimeiya, could it be that by the time we stepped into the room, it already wasn't there?
entries.literal: "Keeping in mind that the alarm came late and that we never actually saw the Sekimeiya, could it be that by the time we stepped into the room, it already wasn't there?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The culprit could've gone up a floor to escape through the windows. Katei hasn't spoken about the footage of this timeframe, so he might not have been looking at the cameras. Then again, even if the cameras spotted the culprit, they'd be able to leave through a prepared window route and flee immediately once outside.
entries.literal: "The culprit could've gone up a floor to escape through the windows. Katei hasn't spoken about the footage of this timeframe, so he might not have been looking at the cameras. Then again, even if the cameras spotted the culprit, they'd be able to leave through a prepared window route and flee immediately once outside."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Then... use an automated mechanism to create the smoke and lock the tower right before the Sekimeiya is ever shown to the public. For the people outside, this would make it look as if it's still in the building and entirely obscure the time in which it was stolen.
entries.literal: "Then... use an automated mechanism to create the smoke and lock the tower right before the Sekimeiya is ever shown to the public. For the people outside, this would make it look as if it's still in the building and entirely obscure the time in which it was stolen."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: We started our session a bit later than expected because Shiroya and I were slightly delayed, but even if we'd gone faster and seen the missing Sekimeiya, it wouldn't have meant anything to the person who'd successfully stolen it since we'd soon be locked inside.
entries.literal: "We started our session a bit later than expected because Shiroya and I were slightly delayed, but even if we'd gone faster and seen the missing Sekimeiya, it wouldn't have meant anything to the person who'd successfully stolen it since we'd soon be locked inside."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If I assume some cameras recorded the culprit leaving through the window, it doesn't make sense that the smoke would then be deployed. However, if they also had a way around those cameras using another method, it'd give off the illusion that someone who got trapped must've been the one to steal the Sekimeiya, and only after the smoke showed up. After all, the lobby was left untouched, and no one would've left through it after the smoke appeared.
entries.literal: "If I assume some cameras recorded the culprit leaving through the window, it doesn't make sense that the smoke would then be deployed. However, if they also had a way around those cameras using another method, it'd give off the illusion that someone who got trapped must've been the one to steal the Sekimeiya, and only after the smoke showed up. After all, the lobby was left untouched, and no one would've left through it after the smoke appeared."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Since the alarm came later, whatever else the culprit did one floor above must've triggered it. Maybe the culprit triggered it purposely, which is why it didn't match the smoke's timing. That would be a bit involved, but it would work.
entries.literal: "Since the alarm came later, whatever else the culprit did one floor above must've triggered it. Maybe the culprit triggered it purposely, which is why it didn't match the smoke's timing. That would be a bit involved, but it would work."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I might be deluding myself a bit too much. I'm also assuming they were able to get the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet without being noticed, which is probably too hard to believe. Not to mention Naomi unlocked the cabinet with her key, meaning it was locked by that time, so why would the culprit lock it after getting the Sekimeiya out, let alone have a way to do it...?
entries.literal: "I might be deluding myself a bit too much. I'm also assuming they were able to get the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet without being noticed, which is probably too hard to believe. Not to mention Naomi unlocked the cabinet with her key, meaning it was locked by that time, so why would the culprit lock it after getting the Sekimeiya out, let alone have a way to do it...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I believe it's far simpler than that, Sai.
entries.literal: "I believe it's far simpler than that, Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei took a while to answer. While I'd been thinking, he also had.
entries.literal: "Katei took a while to answer. While I'd been thinking, he also had."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: After all, the lobby doesn't have security cameras.
entries.literal: "After all, the lobby doesn't have security cameras."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized immediately I'd already gone too far and got slightly embarrassed. Making up complicated theories was a habit of mine, but making a leap without even considering the facts was the last kind of mistake I needed to be making given the circumstances.
entries.literal: "I realized immediately I'd already gone too far and got slightly embarrassed. Making up complicated theories was a habit of mine, but making a leap without even considering the facts was the last kind of mistake I needed to be making given the circumstances."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Regardless, that seemed pretty ridiculous. It was a big lobby, so even though I couldn't spot any cameras, I had figured they were well-hidden. All of us frowned, doubting that decision.
entries.literal: "Regardless, that seemed pretty ridiculous. It was a big lobby, so even though I couldn't spot any cameras, I had figured they were well-hidden. All of us frowned, doubting that decision."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I know it might sound strange. Next to the main door are guards who inspect everyone who enters, making sure they don't possess any kind of suspicious item. For this very reason, the fact that a big quantity of smoke was somehow released from the inside is already very strange.
entries.literal: "I know it might sound strange. Next to the main door are guards who inspect everyone who enters, making sure they don't possess any kind of suspicious item. For this very reason, the fact that a big quantity of smoke was somehow released from the inside is already very strange."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There's nothing of value in this lobby. The only way to access any valuable item is by entering the actual exhibition section through one of the two hallways. There is no other way to reach the gemstones aside from these two doors.
entries.literal: "There's nothing of value in this lobby. The only way to access any valuable item is by entering the actual exhibition section through one of the two hallways. There is no other way to reach the gemstones aside from these two doors."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Since there are cameras in the hallways, the entrance to the valuables is monitored. Having them here is simply not necessary.
entries.literal: "Since there are cameras in the hallways, the entrance to the valuables is monitored. Having them here is simply not necessary."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the hell...? You guys aren't very good at this security thing, are you?
entries.literal: "What the hell...? You guys aren't very good at this security thing, are you?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We have our reasons, but nobody could steal anything and leave without being recorded.
entries.literal: "We have our reasons, but nobody could steal anything and leave without being recorded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it meant, with the smoked hallways, it was actually possible someone could've stolen something and left without being seen by the cameras. However, it was pretty hard to believe that they could've managed to leave with the stolen object, even more so after seeing how harsh the security measures were.
entries.literal: "But it meant, with the smoked hallways, it was actually possible someone could've stolen something and left without being seen by the cameras. However, it was pretty hard to believe that they could've managed to leave with the stolen object, even more so after seeing how harsh the security measures were."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You said there's no way to make it to the actual rooms containing the gemstones. Then what about that door?
entries.literal: "You said there's no way to make it to the actual rooms containing the gemstones. Then what about that door?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was pointing at a smaller door situated behind the reception desk.
entries.literal: "She was pointing at a smaller door situated behind the reception desk."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, that leads to a room right under us. Past the door, a staircase goes to the room that stores the main boiler for the building, the electricity meter, the circuit breakers, and some pieces of furniture that we don't use anymore. Naturally, there are no cameras there either.
entries.literal: "Oh, that leads to a room right under us. Past the door, a staircase goes to the room that stores the main boiler for the building, the electricity meter, the circuit breakers, and some pieces of furniture that we don't use anymore. Naturally, there are no cameras there either."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's right under us...?
entries.literal: "It's right under us...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. The staircase is a semicircle, so that room, which we call the mechanical room, is below the lobby.
entries.literal: "Yes. The staircase is a semicircle, so that room, which we call the mechanical room, is below the lobby."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What about that computer? Can we use it for anything?
entries.literal: "What about that computer? Can we use it for anything?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No. As I said earlier, the internet connection has been cut. That's not all, though. The alarm also disabled this computer so that the people trapped inside couldn't look through its files.
entries.literal: "No. As I said earlier, the internet connection has been cut. That's not all, though. The alarm also disabled this computer so that the people trapped inside couldn't look through its files."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is the door locked?
entries.literal: "Is the door locked?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's not. Since it's right behind the reception counter, visitors can't enter it.
entries.literal: "It's not. Since it's right behind the reception counter, visitors can't enter it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I doubt that room could've been used for anything regarding this incident. Even if someone managed to make it inside, they would've needed a key to access the breakers, but it's not like the lights went out.
entries.literal: "I doubt that room could've been used for anything regarding this incident. Even if someone managed to make it inside, they would've needed a key to access the breakers, but it's not like the lights went out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Would Naomi have had that key?
entries.literal: "Would Naomi have had that key?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Naomi? No, that's not part of her job. I do have it, but I don't think I've ever used it.
entries.literal: "Naomi? No, that's not part of her job. I do have it, but I don't think I've ever used it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: As a thought, could we power off the system in charge of the alarm to open up the exit?
entries.literal: "As a thought, could we power off the system in charge of the alarm to open up the exit?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No, of course not. It'd be a big oversight if a thief could go there, force open the lid, and then break free. Not every circuit can be handled from that room—only the basic ones that power on the lights and such. Essential operations like the security system and maintenance functions can't be turned off.
entries.literal: "No, of course not. It'd be a big oversight if a thief could go there, force open the lid, and then break free. Not every circuit can be handled from that room—only the basic ones that power on the lights and such. Essential operations like the security system and maintenance functions can't be turned off."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I see.
entries.literal: "...I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With another escape method eliminated, our spirits sank.
entries.literal: "With another escape method eliminated, our spirits sank."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Meanwhile, Isla had been watching our discussion and stared at us intensely.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, Isla had been watching our discussion and stared at us intensely."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What is that?
entries.literal: "What is that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She seemed to be looking at Shiroya's neck.
entries.literal: "She seemed to be looking at Shiroya's neck."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Hm, this?{w} It's a pendant.
entries.literal: "...Hm, this?{w} It's a pendant."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I believe it's tanzanite, right?
entries.literal: "I believe it's tanzanite, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh, it's really pretty! I want one like it!
entries.literal: "Oh, it's really pretty! I want one like it!"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Tanzanite? I doubt that. This seems to be an imitation; they're very common.
entries.literal: "Tanzanite? I doubt that. This seems to be an imitation; they're very common."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Is that so? I don't know.
entries.literal: "...Is that so? I don't know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya gave him a terse reply, obviously displeased.
entries.literal: "Shiroya gave him a terse reply, obviously displeased."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: If it's not, then that gem must be worth quite a lot.
entries.literal: "If it's not, then that gem must be worth quite a lot."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Ah. ...It doesn't matter, though. I really like it.
entries.literal: "Ah. ...It doesn't matter, though. I really like it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Isla, you wanted to say something else before, right? What was it?
entries.literal: "Isla, you wanted to say something else before, right? What was it?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah...! We came here for the Sekimeiya, right? I just wanted to go see it...
entries.literal: "Yeah...! We came here for the Sekimeiya, right? I just wanted to go see it..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She glanced down, expecting to get scolded, but nobody reacted that way.
entries.literal: "She glanced down, expecting to get scolded, but nobody reacted that way."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's no way it's still there, right? What even was it?
entries.literal: "There's no way it's still there, right? What even was it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai began looking at me and ended his sentence at Akaro. We hadn't mentioned that we never directly saw the Sekimeiya, so since I'd referred to it being stolen, it was only natural for him to assume it was missing.
entries.literal: "Sai began looking at me and ended his sentence at Akaro. We hadn't mentioned that we never directly saw the Sekimeiya, so since I'd referred to it being stolen, it was only natural for him to assume it was missing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Actually, we don't know... We were gonna check it when we woke up, but Erina's shout interrupted us.
entries.literal: "Actually, we don't know... We were gonna check it when we woke up, but Erina's shout interrupted us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you serious...?
entries.literal: "Are you serious...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and Akaro nodded as well, and everyone else had the same look as Sai. It seemed they'd all assumed the Sekimeiya had been stolen.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and Akaro nodded as well, and everyone else had the same look as Sai. It seemed they'd all assumed the Sekimeiya had been stolen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, without warning, Sai made his way out of the lobby. Isla was the first to follow him. No one objected, as we were all curious about what the Sekimeiya actually was and whether it would even be there.
entries.literal: "Once again, without warning, Sai made his way out of the lobby. Isla was the first to follow him. No one objected, as we were all curious about what the Sekimeiya actually was and whether it would even be there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I made our way back to the room where we'd fallen unconscious. Once Katei entered, our seven pairs of eyes focused on the dark-colored curtain that blocked the view to the cabinet's interior.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I made our way back to the room where we'd fallen unconscious. Once Katei entered, our seven pairs of eyes focused on the dark-colored curtain that blocked the view to the cabinet's interior."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, none of you saw what was behind this curtain before or after the smoke, right?
entries.literal: "So, none of you saw what was behind this curtain before or after the smoke, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. Naomi was about to raise it, but then the smoke appeared.
entries.literal: "Yes. Naomi was about to raise it, but then the smoke appeared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: People went quiet at the mention of Naomi. Given the alarm had played when she'd been there, her disappearance was still peculiar.
entries.literal: "People went quiet at the mention of Naomi. Given the alarm had played when she'd been there, her disappearance was still peculiar."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's see, then. What do you guys think? Is it still here?
entries.literal: "Let's see, then. What do you guys think? Is it still here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was very hard to think it still would be, and going off their expressions, everyone else agreed with me.
entries.literal: "...It was very hard to think it still would be, and going off their expressions, everyone else agreed with me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I say it is. That would make things more interesting, wouldn't it? And I'm curious about how it looks.
entries.literal: "I say it is. That would make things more interesting, wouldn't it? And I'm curious about how it looks."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After those questionable words, Sai proceeded to slowly raise the curtain, exaggerating his own action.
entries.literal: "After those questionable words, Sai proceeded to slowly raise the curtain, exaggerating his own action."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As the curtain was being raised, dust that had gotten stuck on it shook loose and formed a little pile on the floor.
entries.literal: "As the curtain was being raised, dust that had gotten stuck on it shook loose and formed a little pile on the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The majority of the curtain was covering clean wood that contrasted the stained room. Finally, a transparent pane of glass sheltering a cushion came into view.
entries.literal: "The majority of the curtain was covering clean wood that contrasted the stained room. Finally, a transparent pane of glass sheltering a cushion came into view."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The curtain had been fully raised. Because of the darkness of the room, it took us a bit to see what was behind that glass.
entries.literal: "The curtain had been fully raised. Because of the darkness of the room, it took us a bit to see what was behind that glass."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Let me see, is it there?
entries.literal: "Let me see, is it there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai, directly next to the cabinet, stared inside. We all got closer as well.
entries.literal: "Sai, directly next to the cabinet, stared inside. We all got closer as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Inside was a red cushion, a color that would've definitely looked beautiful if not for the lack of proper illumination.
entries.literal: "Inside was a red cushion, a color that would've definitely looked beautiful if not for the lack of proper illumination."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And on that cushion, occupying the middle of it, was what appeared to be a white-colored sphere. Looking closer, it wasn't actually a sphere, but an egg-shaped stone. It shined very faintly.
entries.literal: "And on that cushion, occupying the middle of it, was what appeared to be a white-colored sphere. Looking closer, it wasn't actually a sphere, but an egg-shaped stone. It shined very faintly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It could easily have been mistaken for an actual egg, albeit a large one. However, we all knew it wasn't. Naomi had told us that it was an incredibly rare gem, and despite its simplicity, it was pretty and elegant.
entries.literal: "It could easily have been mistaken for an actual egg, albeit a large one. However, we all knew it wasn't. Naomi had told us that it was an incredibly rare gem, and despite its simplicity, it was pretty and elegant."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's this, right? It wasn't taken.
entries.literal: "It's this, right? It wasn't taken."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So this is Ashiya's big find? How can we be sure it's the real thing?
entries.literal: "So this is Ashiya's big find? How can we be sure it's the real thing?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It is. I have seen it before. I happen to spend hours in front of the security cameras.
entries.literal: "It is. I have seen it before. I happen to spend hours in front of the security cameras."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla looked dumbfounded and couldn't help but stare.
entries.literal: "Isla looked dumbfounded and couldn't help but stare."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: How disappointing. I guess it'd still please all those other people, but I came here purely out of curiosity. Despite not having any kind of expectations, I'm embarrassed to admit I'm a bit let down. You can call this thing rare all you want, but it's just an egg.
entries.literal: "How disappointing. I guess it'd still please all those other people, but I came here purely out of curiosity. Despite not having any kind of expectations, I'm embarrassed to admit I'm a bit let down. You can call this thing rare all you want, but it's just an egg."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: An incredibly valuable one, apparently.
entries.literal: "An incredibly valuable one, apparently."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: And it's still here? What was all the smoke for, then?
entries.literal: "And it's still here? What was all the smoke for, then?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I know I said I hoped for this to be the case, but I'm not too sure anymore. This probably means that the culprit's plan wasn't really all that elaborate.{w} They might just plan to spend twelve hours with us and take this thing out of here when it's time to leave.
entries.literal: "I know I said I hoped for this to be the case, but I'm not too sure anymore. This probably means that the culprit's plan wasn't really all that elaborate.{w} They might just plan to spend twelve hours with us and take this thing out of here when it's time to leave."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...And how exactly will they pull that off?
entries.literal: "...And how exactly will they pull that off?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know, but it's practically impossible that what's happening doesn't have to do with this, right? The end goal must be to steal it, so this just means that the plan isn't over yet.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but it's practically impossible that what's happening doesn't have to do with this, right? The end goal must be to steal it, so this just means that the plan isn't over yet."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm not so sure.{w} Hey, Katei, do you know if Naomi was aware of the existence of that alarm?
entries.literal: "I'm not so sure.{w} Hey, Katei, do you know if Naomi was aware of the existence of that alarm?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Naomi? She should not have been, but I couldn't tell you for sure. Why?
entries.literal: "Naomi? She should not have been, but I couldn't tell you for sure. Why?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Imagine this for a second. Naomi's job is perfectly positioned for this. She acted confused when the attack happened but was prepared for the smoke.
entries.literal: "Imagine this for a second. Naomi's job is perfectly positioned for this. She acted confused when the attack happened but was prepared for the smoke."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: However, the alarm that locked her inside didn't factor into her plan because she wasn't aware of it.
entries.literal: "However, the alarm that locked her inside didn't factor into her plan because she wasn't aware of it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Atsuki, you said you heard the alarm a few seconds after the smoke was released. Do you know how many, approximately?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, you said you heard the alarm a few seconds after the smoke was released. Do you know how many, approximately?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Twenty, maybe?
entries.literal: "...Twenty, maybe?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So twenty seconds later, pretty much everyone is unconscious and Naomi hears this alarm. By this point, she doesn't know that it's trapping her in the tower. If she had, she would've pretended to be unconscious until we all woke up.
entries.literal: "So twenty seconds later, pretty much everyone is unconscious and Naomi hears this alarm. By this point, she doesn't know that it's trapping her in the tower. If she had, she would've pretended to be unconscious until we all woke up."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: But she didn't. Instead, she obtained the Sekimeiya thanks to her key and left with it to proceed with her plan.
entries.literal: "But she didn't. Instead, she obtained the Sekimeiya thanks to her key and left with it to proceed with her plan."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm not sure how it continues now or how she intended to escape, but she realized that the exit had been blocked off. Katei said this was a very specific alarm that hadn't gone off before, so it'd make sense if she didn't recognize the sound.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure how it continues now or how she intended to escape, but she realized that the exit had been blocked off. Katei said this was a very specific alarm that hadn't gone off before, so it'd make sense if she didn't recognize the sound."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Well, as she finished searching for an exit or a way to continue with her plan, she thought her only choice was to come back and play the confused card. But, as she was coming back, she probably heard me opening this door and backed out.
entries.literal: "...Well, as she finished searching for an exit or a way to continue with her plan, she thought her only choice was to come back and play the confused card. But, as she was coming back, she probably heard me opening this door and backed out."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It's clear she's the most suspicious person in the building. It's possible she was listening to us and heard that we didn't look behind the curtain. By leaving before doing so, we gave her a chance to look innocent.
entries.literal: "It's clear she's the most suspicious person in the building. It's possible she was listening to us and heard that we didn't look behind the curtain. By leaving before doing so, we gave her a chance to look innocent."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: When we were in the hallway, she simply entered the room again and placed the Sekimeiya back in the cabinet. Now it's possible we'll find her playing dumb or pretending to be knocked out somewhere, claiming she was disoriented and trying to assess the situation. It's impossible she's not trapped in here with us.
entries.literal: "When we were in the hallway, she simply entered the room again and placed the Sekimeiya back in the cabinet. Now it's possible we'll find her playing dumb or pretending to be knocked out somewhere, claiming she was disoriented and trying to assess the situation. It's impossible she's not trapped in here with us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. That would make sense. It could very well be that this top-secret alarm only played whenever someone tried to get the Sekimeiya out of here and that she hadn't been informed of it.
entries.literal: "I see. That would make sense. It could very well be that this top-secret alarm only played whenever someone tried to get the Sekimeiya out of here and that she hadn't been informed of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai shot Katei a glance, clearly displeased that he had to make that assumption based on limited information.
entries.literal: "Sai shot Katei a glance, clearly displeased that he had to make that assumption based on limited information."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Come on. We haven't found her yet, so shouldn't you wait to draw conclusions until we do? For all we know, she's looking for a way out to help us.
entries.literal: "Come on. We haven't found her yet, so shouldn't you wait to draw conclusions until we do? For all we know, she's looking for a way out to help us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You're right. We can't assume that Naomi is responsible, and we need to establish something that clears her name a little bit.
entries.literal: "...You're right. We can't assume that Naomi is responsible, and we need to establish something that clears her name a little bit."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Even though you guys just tried to explain things with the delayed alarm, it doesn't make a lot of sense to me.
entries.literal: "Even though you guys just tried to explain things with the delayed alarm, it doesn't make a lot of sense to me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Naomi's job was to explain everything about the Sekimeiya and make sure the exhibition happened smoothly. An alarm that's triggered when the Sekimeiya is removed is something she would know about, so thinking that she was unaware of it is pretty ridiculous.{w} And, while her position is convenient to orchestrate this, it also makes her a very strong suspect from the get-go.
entries.literal: "Naomi's job was to explain everything about the Sekimeiya and make sure the exhibition happened smoothly. An alarm that's triggered when the Sekimeiya is removed is something she would know about, so thinking that she was unaware of it is pretty ridiculous.{w} And, while her position is convenient to orchestrate this, it also makes her a very strong suspect from the get-go."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can't be sure of this, but before the time I heard the alarm, I did hear the sound of a body falling, and given all three of us were already down on the floor, it must've been Naomi's. On top of that, the cabinet hadn't been opened, so if she opened it while I was on the floor and triggered the alarm, I think I would've heard it.{w} Not to mention how risky this is. Surely she would've waited until all of us were definitely unconscious to get the Sekimeiya out.
entries.literal: "I can't be sure of this, but before the time I heard the alarm, I did hear the sound of a body falling, and given all three of us were already down on the floor, it must've been Naomi's. On top of that, the cabinet hadn't been opened, so if she opened it while I was on the floor and triggered the alarm, I think I would've heard it.{w} Not to mention how risky this is. Surely she would've waited until all of us were definitely unconscious to get the Sekimeiya out."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This also implies the alarm was unstable. Even if she triggered it by opening the cabinet, she had previously unlocked it. Wouldn't the alarm have gone off when someone forced it open, not when someone opened it after unlocking it?
entries.literal: "This also implies the alarm was unstable. Even if she triggered it by opening the cabinet, she had previously unlocked it. Wouldn't the alarm have gone off when someone forced it open, not when someone opened it after unlocking it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Also, there's one thing that's totally impossible, and that is that the Sekimeiya was first stolen and then brought back.
entries.literal: "Also, there's one thing that's totally impossible, and that is that the Sekimeiya was first stolen and then brought back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro seemed intrigued to know why his idea was incorrect.
entries.literal: "Akaro seemed intrigued to know why his idea was incorrect."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Remember the curtain back then?
entries.literal: "Remember the curtain back then?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh...{w} I think I see what you mean.
entries.literal: "Oh...{w} I think I see what you mean."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The black substance was already dried on the curtain. But just now, when Sai raised it, a bunch of those particles fell on the floor, and almost none of them stayed on the curtain.
entries.literal: "The black substance was already dried on the curtain. But just now, when Sai raised it, a bunch of those particles fell on the floor, and almost none of them stayed on the curtain."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So it didn't move after you left.
entries.literal: "So it didn't move after you left."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: And it's not possible to touch the glass without moving the curtain. ...The Sekimeiya must've also been here when we woke up.
entries.literal: "And it's not possible to touch the glass without moving the curtain. ...The Sekimeiya must've also been here when we woke up."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It could be that Naomi brought back the Sekimeiya while we were still sleeping. That wouldn't contradict anything since the substance might not have fully dried on the curtain by that point. That doesn't make sense either, though.
entries.literal: "It could be that Naomi brought back the Sekimeiya while we were still sleeping. That wouldn't contradict anything since the substance might not have fully dried on the curtain by that point. That doesn't make sense either, though."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: She would've only done that if she hadn't accounted for the alarm, so if she gave up on her plan and placed the Sekimeiya back before we woke up, she would've also closed her eyes and laid on the floor as if nothing had happened.
entries.literal: "She would've only done that if she hadn't accounted for the alarm, so if she gave up on her plan and placed the Sekimeiya back before we woke up, she would've also closed her eyes and laid on the floor as if nothing had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Regardless of what the exact events had been, the Sekimeiya was inside its cabinet. What had the point of the smoke been? What had triggered the alarm, and what would happen next...? It still felt surreal, everything that had suddenly happened.
entries.literal: "Regardless of what the exact events had been, the Sekimeiya was inside its cabinet. What had the point of the smoke been? What had triggered the alarm, and what would happen next...? It still felt surreal, everything that had suddenly happened."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Can I touch it?
entries.literal: "Can I touch it?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...What!? No, don't.
entries.literal: "...What!? No, don't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla had been staring at the Sekimeiya with an astonished face. Maybe because it seemed to be the core of everything, touching it must have sounded almost dangerous.
entries.literal: "Isla had been staring at the Sekimeiya with an astonished face. Maybe because it seemed to be the core of everything, touching it must have sounded almost dangerous."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why not? Naomi was going to let us do it.
entries.literal: "Why not? Naomi was going to let us do it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Is this even open? It looks like the glass is shut.
entries.literal: "Is this even open? It looks like the glass is shut."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It shouldn't be. According to what Naomi said earlier, the key she had would've unlocked it.
entries.literal: "It shouldn't be. According to what Naomi said earlier, the key she had would've unlocked it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: If it's open, you should be able to move the glass.
entries.literal: "If it's open, you should be able to move the glass."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Let me see.
entries.literal: "Let me see."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's open, yes. I can scroll the glass down.
entries.literal: "It's open, yes. I can scroll the glass down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The glass had a little opening to put your fingers in and push it down. If the lock was open, we'd be able to move it.
entries.literal: "The glass had a little opening to put your fingers in and push it down. If the lock was open, we'd be able to move it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the looks of it, it wasn't particularly sturdy or thick glass, so breaking it with force seemed possible too.
entries.literal: "From the looks of it, it wasn't particularly sturdy or thick glass, so breaking it with force seemed possible too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai scrolled it all the way down, and we fixed our eyes on the Sekimeiya, no longer protected by any layer of security.
entries.literal: "Sai scrolled it all the way down, and we fixed our eyes on the Sekimeiya, no longer protected by any layer of security."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla extended her arm slowly. Nobody except Erina looked concerned about her doing it, but I could tell that Shiroya was still agitated by the fact that none of them wanted to drop everything and find the missing person.
entries.literal: "Isla extended her arm slowly. Nobody except Erina looked concerned about her doing it, but I could tell that Shiroya was still agitated by the fact that none of them wanted to drop everything and find the missing person."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before Isla got to touch the Sekimeiya, she spoke.
entries.literal: "Before Isla got to touch the Sekimeiya, she spoke."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: It's cold.
entries.literal: "It's cold."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right, actually. The air inside the cabinet is cold.
entries.literal: "You're right, actually. The air inside the cabinet is cold."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, right, I was told about this. Apparently, the Sekimeiya must remain in a cold place. This was a very basic thing everyone was told, and it sounded very important.
entries.literal: "Oh, right, I was told about this. Apparently, the Sekimeiya must remain in a cold place. This was a very basic thing everyone was told, and it sounded very important."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Why would that be needed?
entries.literal: "Why would that be needed?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm afraid I'm clueless. This is why the temperature inside the cabinet is very low, though.
entries.literal: "I'm afraid I'm clueless. This is why the temperature inside the cabinet is very low, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That sounded interesting. For whatever reason, the Sekimeiya had to always stay in a cold place, or at least that was what the Ashiya family had instructed.
entries.literal: "That sounded interesting. For whatever reason, the Sekimeiya had to always stay in a cold place, or at least that was what the Ashiya family had instructed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do we check what happens if we get it out?
entries.literal: "Do we check what happens if we get it out?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What!? Of course not! The Sekimeiya must remain inside this cabinet. We were very specifically told not to remove it or subject it to any kind of heat.
entries.literal: "What!? Of course not! The Sekimeiya must remain inside this cabinet. We were very specifically told not to remove it or subject it to any kind of heat."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I suppose it's still Katei's duty to act according to the rules. If something happened to the Sekimeiya, there would probably not be a positive outcome for him given that he was basically supervising us.
entries.literal: "I suppose it's still Katei's duty to act according to the rules. If something happened to the Sekimeiya, there would probably not be a positive outcome for him given that he was basically supervising us."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Assuming the blame didn't get shifted to Naomi for some reason, at least.
entries.literal: "Assuming the blame didn't get shifted to Naomi for some reason, at least."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If the Sekimeiya was actually left here due to the cold temperature, it follows whoever put the attack together must've somehow learned of that requirement...
entries.literal: "If the Sekimeiya was actually left here due to the cold temperature, it follows whoever put the attack together must've somehow learned of that requirement..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, who'd paused her movement due to Katei's serious voice, continued moving her arm toward the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Isla, who'd paused her movement due to Katei's serious voice, continued moving her arm toward the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In just a second, she placed her small hand on top of it. Silently, she felt it for a few moments before letting out an amazed gasp.
entries.literal: "In just a second, she placed her small hand on top of it. Silently, she felt it for a few moments before letting out an amazed gasp."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh...! It's super smooth. I love it!
entries.literal: "Oh...! It's super smooth. I love it!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She started feeling it conspicuously with a smile on her face.
entries.literal: "She started feeling it conspicuously with a smile on her face."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Is it? Naomi did say that touching it was part of the experience.
entries.literal: "Is it? Naomi did say that touching it was part of the experience."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya joined her, evidently trying to make Isla feel better.
entries.literal: "Shiroya joined her, evidently trying to make Isla feel better."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're right, this feels very pleasant to the touch, and also really cold.
entries.literal: "You're right, this feels very pleasant to the touch, and also really cold."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Worth all the advertisements and expectations?
entries.literal: "Worth all the advertisements and expectations?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes!
entries.literal: "Yes!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...N-No, not really, but touching it is pretty relaxing. It feels almost silky.
entries.literal: "...N-No, not really, but touching it is pretty relaxing. It feels almost silky."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Given our situation and the fact Naomi is missing, we should let this be. I know we'll most likely be here for twelve hours, but this piece is very important, and we should not be careless.
entries.literal: "Given our situation and the fact Naomi is missing, we should let this be. I know we'll most likely be here for twelve hours, but this piece is very important, and we should not be careless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and I were going to be the next ones to touch it, but we had to respect that. Without responding verbally, Isla and Shiroya removed their hands from the cabinet. Katei's request was a reasonable one, and we still had more important things to think about. Even though six of us had come to see the Sekimeiya, only Isla seemed to have a legitimately strong interest in it.
