entries.literal: "Sai and I were going to be the next ones to touch it, but we had to respect that. Without responding verbally, Isla and Shiroya removed their hands from the cabinet. Katei's request was a reasonable one, and we still had more important things to think about. Even though six of us had come to see the Sekimeiya, only Isla seemed to have a legitimately strong interest in it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the left side of the cabinet, expecting to find something. There was the keyhole Naomi had used.
entries.literal: "I looked at the left side of the cabinet, expecting to find something. There was the keyhole Naomi had used."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It says "unlocked" right here. This is how Naomi unlocked the cabinet. Katei, do you know how many keys can open it?
entries.literal: "It says \"unlocked\" right here. This is how Naomi unlocked the cabinet. Katei, do you know how many keys can open it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know for sure, but certainly not many. I'm only aware of the one Naomi had.
entries.literal: "I don't know for sure, but certainly not many. I'm only aware of the one Naomi had."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: So the only person who can open this is Naomi, who just happened to disappear and might be hiding somewhere.
entries.literal: "So the only person who can open this is Naomi, who just happened to disappear and might be hiding somewhere."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Stop assuming her intentions are bad just because we haven't seen her yet. We have to find her as soon as we can.
entries.literal: "...Stop assuming her intentions are bad just because we haven't seen her yet. We have to find her as soon as we can."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes, but before that, we have to contact the outside from the security room. I would like to know what our situation actually looks like, and if Naomi went upstairs all by herself and chose to leave us unconscious, I won't be prioritizing her now.
entries.literal: "Yes, but before that, we have to contact the outside from the security room. I would like to know what our situation actually looks like, and if Naomi went upstairs all by herself and chose to leave us unconscious, I won't be prioritizing her now."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I guess so. Splitting up is probably a bad idea, but if she isn't back when we finish, we really need to go looking.
entries.literal: "I guess so. Splitting up is probably a bad idea, but if she isn't back when we finish, we really need to go looking."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There wasn't any other opposition. If Naomi intended to show herself to us, she would come back eventually.{w} We worked under the assumption that she still had the cabinet key. However, if she'd ever fallen unconscious, someone could've easily grabbed it, maybe failing to recognize that the cabinet was already unlocked. If she'd woken up as that happened, the culprit might've panicked and been responsible for her disappearance.
entries.literal: "There wasn't any other opposition. If Naomi intended to show herself to us, she would come back eventually.{w} We worked under the assumption that she still had the cabinet key. However, if she'd ever fallen unconscious, someone could've easily grabbed it, maybe failing to recognize that the cabinet was already unlocked. If she'd woken up as that happened, the culprit might've panicked and been responsible for her disappearance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But that was a worst-case scenario, and not something we could easily jump to. It was true that contacting the outside was much more important.
entries.literal: "...But that was a worst-case scenario, and not something we could easily jump to. It was true that contacting the outside was much more important."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Let's go to the security room. That is where I work. We're very close to it, actually. It is beneficial to have it on the lowest floor, next to the entrance.
entries.literal: "Let's go to the security room. That is where I work. We're very close to it, actually. It is beneficial to have it on the lowest floor, next to the entrance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei closed the glass and gave us a look that once again indicated how precious of an item the Sekimeiya was.
entries.literal: "Katei closed the glass and gave us a look that once again indicated how precious of an item the Sekimeiya was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Subsequently, he opened the opposite door of the room. Past it was a very similar hallway.
entries.literal: "Subsequently, he opened the opposite door of the room. Past it was a very similar hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like in the other one, the ceiling and walls were stained by an ugly, dark color. It had been a while since the smoke's release, so the substance was fully dried up, letting more light pass through.
entries.literal: "Like in the other one, the ceiling and walls were stained by an ugly, dark color. It had been a while since the smoke's release, so the substance was fully dried up, letting more light pass through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once everyone was with us, I peeked into one of the rooms in front of us.
entries.literal: "Once everyone was with us, I peeked into one of the rooms in front of us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Akaro had said, it looked clean, creating the same contrast as the lobby. The light worked perfectly, and there was almost no trace of the smoke apart from the small amount that had passed through the gaps of the door.
entries.literal: "As Akaro had said, it looked clean, creating the same contrast as the lobby. The light worked perfectly, and there was almost no trace of the smoke apart from the small amount that had passed through the gaps of the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed the function of the room was only to showcase different kinds of gemstones placed inside cabinets. I couldn't be sure, though, as all of them were covered by curtains.
entries.literal: "It seemed the function of the room was only to showcase different kinds of gemstones placed inside cabinets. I couldn't be sure, though, as all of them were covered by curtains."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's that door.
entries.literal: "It's that door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without moving, Katei indicated the single door that stood out.
entries.literal: "Without moving, Katei indicated the single door that stood out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While all the others were normal wooden doors, that one was gray and looked much more sturdy. Once Katei approached it, we walked behind.
entries.literal: "While all the others were normal wooden doors, that one was gray and looked much more sturdy. Once Katei approached it, we walked behind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On it was a nameplate with the words "security room".
entries.literal: "On it was a nameplate with the words \"security room\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=0.6}Katei grabbed the doorknob, and upon turning it, he tried to push the door forward. However, it didn't budge.
entries.literal: "{w=0.6}Katei grabbed the doorknob, and upon turning it, he tried to push the door forward. However, it didn't budge."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, right. I locked it earlier. Let me see.
entries.literal: "Oh, right. I locked it earlier. Let me see."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You locked it?
entries.literal: "You locked it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, I have the key right here.
entries.literal: "Yes, I have the key right here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Taking a couple of keys out of his pocket, Katei inserted one of them in the keyhole.
entries.literal: "Taking a couple of keys out of his pocket, Katei inserted one of them in the keyhole."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is an important room. When I left, I wasn't exactly aware of the situation, given I couldn't see through some of the cameras. I found it appropriate to lock the only room that allows communication with the outside until I knew more about what had happened.
entries.literal: "This is an important room. When I left, I wasn't exactly aware of the situation, given I couldn't see through some of the cameras. I found it appropriate to lock the only room that allows communication with the outside until I knew more about what had happened."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That was probably a good idea.
entries.literal: "That was probably a good idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a simple turn, the door was audibly unlocked. Before entering, I inquired about something I found next to it.
entries.literal: "With a simple turn, the door was audibly unlocked. Before entering, I inquired about something I found next to it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, is this a map? I almost didn't notice it since the entire wall looks the same.
entries.literal: "Oh, is this a map? I almost didn't notice it since the entire wall looks the same."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. It's a map of this first floor. The rooms labeled with a letter and a number are what we call the "crystal rooms". They're the exhibition rooms, where all the gemstones are displayed.
entries.literal: "Yes. It's a map of this first floor. The rooms labeled with a letter and a number are what we call the \"crystal rooms\". They're the exhibition rooms, where all the gemstones are displayed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I brushed off the dry dust and looked at it.
entries.literal: "I brushed off the dry dust and looked at it."

entries.text: Minimap unlocked.   Press {} or {} to access it.   You can display it permanently in Settings > General > Other.
entries.literal: 'Minimap unlocked.   Press {} or {} to access it.   You can display it permanently in Settings > General > Other.'

entries.text: Minimap unlocked.   Press {} to access it.   You can display it permanently in Settings > General > Other.
entries.literal: 'Minimap unlocked.   Press {} to access it.   You can display it permanently in Settings > General > Other.'

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Katei had said, the map only showed the first floor's contents, and it seemed stairs and an elevator would lead us to the others. It was the only floor that was usually open to the public, so there were a large number of rooms to visit.
entries.literal: "As Katei had said, the map only showed the first floor's contents, and it seemed stairs and an elevator would lead us to the others. It was the only floor that was usually open to the public, so there were a large number of rooms to visit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We found ourselves in hallway A, next to the security room, and had plenty left of the whole floor to look through.
entries.literal: "We found ourselves in hallway A, next to the security room, and had plenty left of the whole floor to look through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As a notable point, the event room was the only place that connected both hallways apart from the lobby and the perpendicular hallway C. As expected, there were bathrooms too, so we wouldn't have to worry on that front.
entries.literal: "As a notable point, the event room was the only place that connected both hallways apart from the lobby and the perpendicular hallway C. As expected, there were bathrooms too, so we wouldn't have to worry on that front."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's light coming from the end of the hallways. That means the horizontal one wasn't hit by the smoke, right?
entries.literal: "There's light coming from the end of the hallways. That means the horizontal one wasn't hit by the smoke, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, only these sections were.
entries.literal: "Yes, only these sections were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei, who'd claimed to have slightly inspected the floor, showed us exactly where the smoke had been released.
entries.literal: "Katei, who'd claimed to have slightly inspected the floor, showed us exactly where the smoke had been released."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hm...{w} So, if one of the goals of the smoke was to disable the security cameras, they didn't use hallway C for anything.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} So, if one of the goals of the smoke was to disable the security cameras, they didn't use hallway C for anything."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. I looked at the live footage of it while I was in this room, and no one showed up. They still would've had two available ways to cross the hallways, though.
entries.literal: "Yes. I looked at the live footage of it while I was in this room, and no one showed up. They still would've had two available ways to cross the hallways, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone looked pensive, including Isla, but they voiced none of their thoughts.
entries.literal: "Everyone looked pensive, including Isla, but they voiced none of their thoughts."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The layout was pretty simple. Remembering it wouldn't be a problem, but we could always look at the map again.
entries.literal: "The layout was pretty simple. Remembering it wouldn't be a problem, but we could always look at the map again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei waited until everyone was done examining it to open the door.
entries.literal: "Katei waited until everyone was done examining it to open the door."

entries.text: Window Net
entries.literal: "Window Net"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like the lobby and the room I'd just looked into, the place was completely clean, and no traces of smoke could be found, not even any that had slipped through the door. However, the contrast wasn't as noticeable given the room's darker colors and faint light.
entries.literal: "Like the lobby and the room I'd just looked into, the place was completely clean, and no traces of smoke could be found, not even any that had slipped through the door. However, the contrast wasn't as noticeable given the room's darker colors and faint light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Paying no mind to everyone's silence, Katei made his way to the chair and sat down. When he moved the mouse, the computer exited its suspended state and reactivated the three monitors above it, showing us what the last person to use it had been doing.
entries.literal: "Paying no mind to everyone's silence, Katei made his way to the chair and sat down. When he moved the mouse, the computer exited its suspended state and reactivated the three monitors above it, showing us what the last person to use it had been doing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Above those three screens were many more monitors that displayed the real time footage of the cameras. While there was no way every room of every floor was shown there, at first glance, there was no trace of Naomi or another person.
entries.literal: "Above those three screens were many more monitors that displayed the real time footage of the cameras. While there was no way every room of every floor was shown there, at first glance, there was no trace of Naomi or another person."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All these security cameras... Does this mean we'll be able to look at the recorded footage?
entries.literal: "All these security cameras... Does this mean we'll be able to look at the recorded footage?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...We should be able to. I don't believe you'd be authorized to, but given the situation, we might be able to look at it after we talk with the outside.
entries.literal: "...We should be able to. I don't believe you'd be authorized to, but given the situation, we might be able to look at it after we talk with the outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was an interesting proposition. Looking at the recorded footage might have revealed the source of the smoke, if someone else hadn't been able to evacuate, and information on Naomi's whereabouts.
entries.literal: "That was an interesting proposition. Looking at the recorded footage might have revealed the source of the smoke, if someone else hadn't been able to evacuate, and information on Naomi's whereabouts."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all got closer to Katei and looked at the screens. It seemed the computer was using a standard operating system.
entries.literal: "We all got closer to Katei and looked at the screens. It seemed the computer was using a standard operating system."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Is this the time it is right now?
entries.literal: "Is this the time it is right now?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, yes. It's {time=9:41.}
entries.literal: "Oh, yes. It's {time=9:41.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Katei said, next to the numbers that displayed the date, the current time showed {time=9:41.} That meant the exit would unlock at approximately {time=21:05}, in eleven hours and twenty minutes.
entries.literal: "As Katei said, next to the numbers that displayed the date, the current time showed {time=9:41.} That meant the exit would unlock at approximately {time=21:05}, in eleven hours and twenty minutes."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: We started a bit late, so I think the smoke appeared five minutes after we left the lobby. I'd say we've been awake for more than twenty minutes already, so this would mean we were unconscious for about fifteen minutes.
entries.literal: "We started a bit late, so I think the smoke appeared five minutes after we left the lobby. I'd say we've been awake for more than twenty minutes already, so this would mean we were unconscious for about fifteen minutes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, this matches with the amount of time I stayed here after I saw the smoke.
entries.literal: "Yes, this matches with the amount of time I stayed here after I saw the smoke."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Shortly after that, the alarm went off, so I knew I was already trapped. During that time until I exited, I kept my eyes on the cameras. I also tried to use the computer to look up information about what had happened, but the alarm even shut down my internet connection.
entries.literal: "Shortly after that, the alarm went off, so I knew I was already trapped. During that time until I exited, I kept my eyes on the cameras. I also tried to use the computer to look up information about what had happened, but the alarm even shut down my internet connection."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wait, what? Why would it do that? You said you still have a way to communicate with the outside, so why didn't you use it?
entries.literal: "Wait, what? Why would it do that? You said you still have a way to communicate with the outside, so why didn't you use it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, I did not find it appropriate. My top priority was to find out what was happening here, so I focused on looking at all the cameras that remained functional.
entries.literal: "Oh, I did not find it appropriate. My top priority was to find out what was happening here, so I focused on looking at all the cameras that remained functional."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Don't you think a very good way to find out what was happening would've been to ask the outside?
entries.literal: "Don't you think a very good way to find out what was happening would've been to ask the outside?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You might be right. That could've been the smarter choice, but I did not think it through well enough.
entries.literal: "You might be right. That could've been the smarter choice, but I did not think it through well enough."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: So, even though the internet connection is cut off, you have a communication method?
entries.literal: "So, even though the internet connection is cut off, you have a communication method?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. This computer is connected to all the computers on the upper floors. Even though there's no connection, a way exists to connect with the Ashiya family, and only the security staff knows about it. It does not use the normal internet connection, and it was designed in case of emergencies.
entries.literal: "Yes. This computer is connected to all the computers on the upper floors. Even though there's no connection, a way exists to connect with the Ashiya family, and only the security staff knows about it. It does not use the normal internet connection, and it was designed in case of emergencies."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, if you weren't here, we would have to spend twelve hours locked up not knowing what's actually happening and without a way to communicate with the outside world.
entries.literal: "So, if you weren't here, we would have to spend twelve hours locked up not knowing what's actually happening and without a way to communicate with the outside world."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes... It sounds rough, but this alarm doesn't go off for no reason. We should just be content with the fact that I stayed inside. I wouldn't have been doing my job if I'd evacuated.
entries.literal: "Yes... It sounds rough, but this alarm doesn't go off for no reason. We should just be content with the fact that I stayed inside. I wouldn't have been doing my job if I'd evacuated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody had anything else to add, so Katei proceeded.
entries.literal: "Nobody had anything else to add, so Katei proceeded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Deep within many folders, he started up a program that contained a very simple interface. After inputting a username and a password we couldn't read, he pressed the enter key.
entries.literal: "Deep within many folders, he started up a program that contained a very simple interface. After inputting a username and a password we couldn't read, he pressed the enter key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The small window shifted into a much larger and empty one. The first thing we noticed was that a loud, unintelligible audio feed was being played. Seconds later, a video appeared in the center of the window.
entries.literal: "The small window shifted into a much larger and empty one. The first thing we noticed was that a loud, unintelligible audio feed was being played. Seconds later, a video appeared in the center of the window."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Is this a car?
entries.literal: "Is this a car?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yeah, it looks like a car seat.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it looks like a car seat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone looked at Katei, but he shrugged and kept watching.
entries.literal: "Everyone looked at Katei, but he shrugged and kept watching."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The video was probably live, and the echo was obnoxiously loud. We could hear many people talking in the background, but it was impossible to make out any words.
entries.literal: "The video was probably live, and the echo was obnoxiously loud. We could hear many people talking in the background, but it was impossible to make out any words."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We continued staring at the screen, unsure what we were actually looking at.
entries.literal: "We continued staring at the screen, unsure what we were actually looking at."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Is anything going to change?
entries.literal: "Is anything going to change?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After more than fifteen seconds, nothing had happened, and the audio continued playing.
entries.literal: "After more than fifteen seconds, nothing had happened, and the audio continued playing."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is for communication, right? Can they hear us right now?
entries.literal: "This is for communication, right? Can they hear us right now?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: They actually should be able to.{w} ...Hello? Can anyone hear us?
entries.literal: "They actually should be able to.{w} ...Hello? Can anyone hear us?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Hello? Can anyone hear me!?
entries.literal: "Hello? Can anyone hear me!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Amid the messy noise, we noticed one of the voices was getting louder.
entries.literal: "Amid the messy noise, we noticed one of the voices was getting louder."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm from Ashiya, talking from inside the tower. Is anyone there?
entries.literal: "I'm from Ashiya, talking from inside the tower. Is anyone there?"

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: ...Oh, yes, it's coming from inside. There's finally an incoming connection.
entries.literal: "...Oh, yes, it's coming from inside. There's finally an incoming connection."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: My apologies. He-Hello? Is this working? Do you see me?
entries.literal: "My apologies. He-Hello? Is this working? Do you see me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The camera was manually moved by the person who sat in front of it. Still inside a car, a police officer was uncertainly fixing his eyes on the lens.
entries.literal: "The camera was manually moved by the person who sat in front of it. Still inside a car, a police officer was uncertainly fixing his eyes on the lens."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Y-Yes. By the looks of it, you're aware of the situation.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes. By the looks of it, you're aware of the situation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei said that because Ashiya Tower could be seen through the car's windows. A great deal of police officers were in front of it, and I could see that the metal shutter looked just as ridiculous from the other side.
entries.literal: "Katei said that because Ashiya Tower could be seen through the car's windows. A great deal of police officers were in front of it, and I could see that the metal shutter looked just as ridiculous from the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a bizarre thought knowing that we were inside. We definitely hadn't been on a streak of good luck, but getting trapped inside a building the first time we'd stepped into it let us know that life wouldn't feel like redeeming itself any time soon.
entries.literal: "It was a bizarre thought knowing that we were inside. We definitely hadn't been on a streak of good luck, but getting trapped inside a building the first time we'd stepped into it let us know that life wouldn't feel like redeeming itself any time soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had been trying to act composed and stave off all my negative thoughts, but the prospect of having to spend another eleven hours trapped in a building was daunting, and Shiroya surely felt similarly.
entries.literal: "I had been trying to act composed and stave off all my negative thoughts, but the prospect of having to spend another eleven hours trapped in a building was daunting, and Shiroya surely felt similarly."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: We know what occurred, yes. The Ashiya family was in contact with us, and we were informed of this communication method. Since a member of the security staff was assumed to still be in the tower, we kept this device with us expecting it to be activated at any moment.{w} I'm a police officer. My name is Suripo.
entries.literal: "We know what occurred, yes. The Ashiya family was in contact with us, and we were informed of this communication method. Since a member of the security staff was assumed to still be in the tower, we kept this device with us expecting it to be activated at any moment.{w} I'm a police officer. My name is Suripo."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: So, can you see us?
entries.literal: "So, can you see us?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Ah... No. I can only receive audio feed.
entries.literal: "Ah... No. I can only receive audio feed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The man sounded a bit thrown off after hearing the voice of a little girl. It was only natural, given the vast majority of the people who'd been inside were adults.
entries.literal: "The man sounded a bit thrown off after hearing the voice of a little girl. It was only natural, given the vast majority of the people who'd been inside were adults."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: What happened in there? How many of you are inside?
entries.literal: "What happened in there? How many of you are inside?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There should be eight of us, even though only seven are present. However, we can't be certain someone else didn't get trapped either. We have not inspected the entire building yet.
entries.literal: "There should be eight of us, even though only seven are present. However, we can't be certain someone else didn't get trapped either. We have not inspected the entire building yet."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: You're in the security room, right? If there were more people, couldn't you see them through the security cameras?
entries.literal: "You're in the security room, right? If there were more people, couldn't you see them through the security cameras?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Let me see. We just got here, so we haven't looked extensively. Some cameras have been disabled by the smoke, and some places are without cameras, but I can try looking through the ones that remain functional.
entries.literal: "Let me see. We just got here, so we haven't looked extensively. Some cameras have been disabled by the smoke, and some places are without cameras, but I can try looking through the ones that remain functional."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since the number of monitors wasn't enough to display all the live cameras at once, Katei started to move through them with a program that seemed to manage the entire system. Presumably, only the first floor was being monitored continuously, being the one with unfettered public access.
entries.literal: "Since the number of monitors wasn't enough to display all the live cameras at once, Katei started to move through them with a program that seemed to manage the entire system. Presumably, only the first floor was being monitored continuously, being the one with unfettered public access."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was able to change all the cameras being displayed at once, making the process simple and brief.{w} As he'd said, the only thing to be seen through a handful of them was a black screen created by the smoke. Even after the substance had solidified, there was no chance we could see well through it.
entries.literal: "He was able to change all the cameras being displayed at once, making the process simple and brief.{w} As he'd said, the only thing to be seen through a handful of them was a black screen created by the smoke. Even after the substance had solidified, there was no chance we could see well through it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Strangely enough, the last cameras that Katei displayed showcased a much different environment. The first floor had contained all the exhibition rooms, and from there, it had only been dull offices. But some of the cameras were displaying a bedroom.
entries.literal: "Strangely enough, the last cameras that Katei displayed showcased a much different environment. The first floor had contained all the exhibition rooms, and from there, it had only been dull offices. But some of the cameras were displaying a bedroom."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This must look odd to you all, correct? Do you know the story behind this place? This was the Ashiya family's residence until a decade ago. Then, its purpose changed, and work floors began to be added.{w} This is why it's called a tower. The townspeople saw that floors kept being constructed, and they started to call it a tower sarcastically, as if it would never stop increasing in height. I don't know if Ashiya liked the name or if they officialized it to counter its negative connotations. You might've also heard it called the "Ashiya skyscraper".
entries.literal: "This must look odd to you all, correct? Do you know the story behind this place? This was the Ashiya family's residence until a decade ago. Then, its purpose changed, and work floors began to be added.{w} This is why it's called a tower. The townspeople saw that floors kept being constructed, and they started to call it a tower sarcastically, as if it would never stop increasing in height. I don't know if Ashiya liked the name or if they officialized it to counter its negative connotations. You might've also heard it called the \"Ashiya skyscraper\"."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What you're seeing is the very top floor. When the structure was expanded, for a while, the living area was kept as the highest floor, and now it's referred to as the Ashiya floor or the attic. It's not possible to enter it without a very particular key, one I most certainly don't possess. In fact, I have never set foot inside it despite monitoring these cameras daily.
entries.literal: "What you're seeing is the very top floor. When the structure was expanded, for a while, the living area was kept as the highest floor, and now it's referred to as the Ashiya floor or the attic. It's not possible to enter it without a very particular key, one I most certainly don't possess. In fact, I have never set foot inside it despite monitoring these cameras daily."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Of course, the cameras were installed after the place stopped being their residence, and they were only placed in some of the rooms before continuing was deemed unnecessary.{w} The initial reason was to make sure it was preserved well, given that it was of great importance to the Ashiya family. They were installed with the thought of someone breaking in and expecting to find unguarded, hidden information. However, the installation process was never completed.
entries.literal: "Of course, the cameras were installed after the place stopped being their residence, and they were only placed in some of the rooms before continuing was deemed unnecessary.{w} The initial reason was to make sure it was preserved well, given that it was of great importance to the Ashiya family. They were installed with the thought of someone breaking in and expecting to find unguarded, hidden information. However, the installation process was never completed."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: While I don't know many of the details, I can say that not one time have I seen anything of importance happening inside.
entries.literal: "While I don't know many of the details, I can say that not one time have I seen anything of importance happening inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That was all well and good, but it didn't mean much to us. Those cameras still showed an entirely desolate space.
entries.literal: "...That was all well and good, but it didn't mean much to us. Those cameras still showed an entirely desolate space."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Every room with a camera is empty at the moment. This doesn't account for places like bathrooms, areas where the cameras are blocked by smoke, the lobby, other staff-only rooms, and the section of the attic that's not monitored.
entries.literal: "Every room with a camera is empty at the moment. This doesn't account for places like bathrooms, areas where the cameras are blocked by smoke, the lobby, other staff-only rooms, and the section of the attic that's not monitored."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm just curious, but this room doesn't have a camera either, does it? I didn't see it on the monitors.
entries.literal: "I'm just curious, but this room doesn't have a camera either, does it? I didn't see it on the monitors."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No, it doesn't. For now, the number of us in the building is no lower than eight. We haven't been able to find the eighth person yet, but she must be here. I'm talking about Naomi Cabca, another staff member.
entries.literal: "No, it doesn't. For now, the number of us in the building is no lower than eight. We haven't been able to find the eighth person yet, but she must be here. I'm talking about Naomi Cabca, another staff member."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: I understand. Give me the name of everyone present. I will add Miss Cabca to the list.
entries.literal: "I understand. Give me the name of everyone present. I will add Miss Cabca to the list."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I am Katei Kuiji. I'm the main person in charge of the tower's security system. Everyone else I have with me is a visitor.
entries.literal: "I am Katei Kuiji. I'm the main person in charge of the tower's security system. Everyone else I have with me is a visitor."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Understood. What are your names?
entries.literal: "Understood. What are your names?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm Erina Majutsu. My daughter, Isla Majutsu, is who spoke earlier.
entries.literal: "I'm Erina Majutsu. My daughter, Isla Majutsu, is who spoke earlier."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: I'm noting it down.
entries.literal: "I'm noting it down."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Akaro Esata.
entries.literal: "Akaro Esata."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Atsuki Hakutoki.
entries.literal: "Atsuki Hakutoki."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Shiroya Mirana.
entries.literal: "Shiroya Mirana."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sai.
entries.literal: "Sai."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Sai what?
entries.literal: "Sai what?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sai Yomiya.
entries.literal: "Sai Yomiya."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: All right, thank you.
entries.literal: "All right, thank you."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: So, adding in Miss Cabca, these are the eight people we know for sure are currently inside. This will be helpful.
entries.literal: "So, adding in Miss Cabca, these are the eight people we know for sure are currently inside. This will be helpful."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. Right now, she has to be in a place we can't see from here. The chances someone else is too are slim.
entries.literal: "Yes. Right now, she has to be in a place we can't see from here. The chances someone else is too are slim."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So, how's our situation looking? We'd also appreciate having information.
entries.literal: "So, how's our situation looking? We'd also appreciate having information."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: We don't have much to work with, only the testimony from people who were inside at the time. Given all the visitors were in the lobby, we don't have a comprehensive rundown to give you.
entries.literal: "We don't have much to work with, only the testimony from people who were inside at the time. Given all the visitors were in the lobby, we don't have a comprehensive rundown to give you."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Unidentified smoke appeared on the first floor, and shortly after, an alarm went off. An effect of this alarm was to seal all the exit routes.
entries.literal: "Unidentified smoke appeared on the first floor, and shortly after, an alarm went off. An effect of this alarm was to seal all the exit routes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We already know this. Why was the alarm triggered, and how can we leave?
entries.literal: "We already know this. Why was the alarm triggered, and how can we leave?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: There's one thing that triggers the alarm. According to what we've been told, it's forcing open the Sekimeiya cabinet.
entries.literal: "There's one thing that triggers the alarm. According to what we've been told, it's forcing open the Sekimeiya cabinet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What do you mean? We were there just now, and the cabinet looked fine. Not only that, but when the alarm went off, I was in the room with that very cabinet, and I didn't hear anything happening to it.
entries.literal: "What do you mean? We were there just now, and the cabinet looked fine. Not only that, but when the alarm went off, I was in the room with that very cabinet, and I didn't hear anything happening to it."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: That... doesn't sound right. This is reliable information that's been provided to us, so I don't know if it's possible something else triggered it. Maybe the system broke.
entries.literal: "That... doesn't sound right. This is reliable information that's been provided to us, so I don't know if it's possible something else triggered it. Maybe the system broke."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What's for sure is that we just observed the Sekimeiya. Everything there is intact.
entries.literal: "What's for sure is that we just observed the Sekimeiya. Everything there is intact."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: I'm sure the Ashiya family will be glad to hear that. I'll tell them immediately. However, that is as expected, seeing as all that was stolen were a few gemstones of little value.
entries.literal: "I'm sure the Ashiya family will be glad to hear that. I'll tell them immediately. However, that is as expected, seeing as all that was stolen were a few gemstones of little value."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone had a hard time processing that last sentence. Meanwhile, Suripo looked to be sending a text message, most likely to Ashiya, assuring the well-being of the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Everyone had a hard time processing that last sentence. Meanwhile, Suripo looked to be sending a text message, most likely to Ashiya, assuring the well-being of the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What do you mean? What was stolen?
entries.literal: "...What do you mean? What was stolen?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Well, naturally, after the alarm went off, it took a while to confine everyone who had evacuated. A young individual carrying a black suitcase dashed off, so they were pulled aside. Inside it, we found various gemstones that belonged to Ashiya.
entries.literal: "Well, naturally, after the alarm went off, it took a while to confine everyone who had evacuated. A young individual carrying a black suitcase dashed off, so they were pulled aside. Inside it, we found various gemstones that belonged to Ashiya."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: That individual has refused to say anything. However, we assumed that some part of their actions triggered the alarm. If the Sekimeiya cabinet hasn't been damaged, we'll have to reconsider.
entries.literal: "That individual has refused to say anything. However, we assumed that some part of their actions triggered the alarm. If the Sekimeiya cabinet hasn't been damaged, we'll have to reconsider."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If their plan triggered the alarm, how did they manage to avoid getting trapped?
entries.literal: "If their plan triggered the alarm, how did they manage to avoid getting trapped?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: We don't know, but since nothing is wrong with the Sekimeiya, this seems to confirm the goal was to divert everyone's attention and steal a bunch of regular gems while everyone in charge thought that they knew the next target.
entries.literal: "We don't know, but since nothing is wrong with the Sekimeiya, this seems to confirm the goal was to divert everyone's attention and steal a bunch of regular gems while everyone in charge thought that they knew the next target."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What do you mean the next target? ...And how long will we need to stay here as a result of this stunt?
entries.literal: "What do you mean the next target? ...And how long will we need to stay here as a result of this stunt?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Both of your questions are related, actually. I assume this means you haven't heard of the past incidents?
entries.literal: "Both of your questions are related, actually. I assume this means you haven't heard of the past incidents?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Past incidents? What does that mean?
entries.literal: "Past incidents? What does that mean?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I read about it not too long ago, in Yushinews. About how Ashiya Tower had suffered another robbery yet again by a group called Xyn, I believe.
entries.literal: "I read about it not too long ago, in Yushinews. About how Ashiya Tower had suffered another robbery yet again by a group called Xyn, I believe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Yushinews was a monthly newspaper that released a compilation of every notable recent event. Given our town wasn't very big, it was a popular way to keep oneself updated, but it wasn't something I often looked at.
entries.literal: "Yushinews was a monthly newspaper that released a compilation of every notable recent event. Given our town wasn't very big, it was a popular way to keep oneself updated, but it wasn't something I often looked at."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Exactly. The Ashiya family and Xyn have a history together. Even though Ashiya are perceived as a major influence around here, when they attracted people interested in their business, they inevitably drew in competition and enemies too.
entries.literal: "Exactly. The Ashiya family and Xyn have a history together. Even though Ashiya are perceived as a major influence around here, when they attracted people interested in their business, they inevitably drew in competition and enemies too."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: That's when Xyn started moving in. They're a long-running group that specializes in robberies of valuable objects, alongside similar criminal activities. When the Ashiya family became an established and wealthy entity, they also became a perfect target for Xyn. The fact they had developed in such a calm environment meant their security measures weren't adequate.
entries.literal: "That's when Xyn started moving in. They're a long-running group that specializes in robberies of valuable objects, alongside similar criminal activities. When the Ashiya family became an established and wealthy entity, they also became a perfect target for Xyn. The fact they had developed in such a calm environment meant their security measures weren't adequate."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: It's rumored that Xyn is a small group of people who work together and put a great deal of effort into their plans. None of them have ever been caught, which evidently gave them a reputation among plenty of people.
entries.literal: "It's rumored that Xyn is a small group of people who work together and put a great deal of effort into their plans. None of them have ever been caught, which evidently gave them a reputation among plenty of people."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: While the Ashiya family might look like an almighty entity for Yushibana residents, they're not one at all in the bigger picture. This led to them focusing on expanding themselves before even foreseeing or trying to prevent these attacks, which have only been getting bolder.
entries.literal: "While the Ashiya family might look like an almighty entity for Yushibana residents, they're not one at all in the bigger picture. This led to them focusing on expanding themselves before even foreseeing or trying to prevent these attacks, which have only been getting bolder."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: The first one happened two years ago. The security at the time was nothing special, so it looked like a small job, not anything of particular note...
entries.literal: "The first one happened two years ago. The security at the time was nothing special, so it looked like a small job, not anything of particular note..."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: However, since then, the attacks increased in both scale and frequency. I couldn't tell you how big this group calling itself Xyn really is, but they've been tormenting Ashiya for a while now.
entries.literal: "However, since then, the attacks increased in both scale and frequency. I couldn't tell you how big this group calling itself Xyn really is, but they've been tormenting Ashiya for a while now."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Stopping them has been pretty problematic, and now they're moving in broad daylight with mass panic like this. At least, we assume they're involved here.
entries.literal: "Stopping them has been pretty problematic, and now they're moving in broad daylight with mass panic like this. At least, we assume they're involved here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Had such a battle actually been happening in the town I'd always lived in? I'd purposely avoided anything to do with that aspect of Yushibana, but I hadn't heard of Xyn even once. I could vaguely recall hearing about Ashiya Tower being robbed, but I'd never imagined the situation was so large scale.{w} No one I frequently talked to had an interest in the topic, so if it was common knowledge, I'd never been told. Ashiya had always felt like a taboo, and I'd never personally researched them.
entries.literal: "...{w}Had such a battle actually been happening in the town I'd always lived in? I'd purposely avoided anything to do with that aspect of Yushibana, but I hadn't heard of Xyn even once. I could vaguely recall hearing about Ashiya Tower being robbed, but I'd never imagined the situation was so large scale.{w} No one I frequently talked to had an interest in the topic, so if it was common knowledge, I'd never been told. Ashiya had always felt like a taboo, and I'd never personally researched them."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I think the last time this happened wasn't too long ago, right? I was a bit hesitant to bring Isla here, but she was really excited.
entries.literal: "I think the last time this happened wasn't too long ago, right? I was a bit hesitant to bring Isla here, but she was really excited."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. On the 24th of November, 21 days ago, Xyn attacked again. Ignoring the latest security upgrades, they made their way in during the night and stole a lot of valuable gems. It was one of the worst blows Ashiya's taken.
entries.literal: "Yes. On the 24th of November, 21 days ago, Xyn attacked again. Ignoring the latest security upgrades, they made their way in during the night and stole a lot of valuable gems. It was one of the worst blows Ashiya's taken."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Correct. Nothing actually indicates Xyn were the ones involved, and in fact, nothing ever does. However, the way everything goes smoothly and all of Ashiya's efforts are proven futile screams "Xyn" to everyone.
entries.literal: "Correct. Nothing actually indicates Xyn were the ones involved, and in fact, nothing ever does. However, the way everything goes smoothly and all of Ashiya's efforts are proven futile screams \"Xyn\" to everyone."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So this time, Ashiya took it a step further, right?
entries.literal: "So this time, Ashiya took it a step further, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps we'd all been thinking that. It looked like we had simply been caught in the middle of a rivalry, and Ashiya's latest move had imprisoned us.
entries.literal: "Perhaps we'd all been thinking that. It looked like we had simply been caught in the middle of a rivalry, and Ashiya's latest move had imprisoned us."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: ...Yes.{w} It's possible that Xyn aren't actually involved, given the stolen gems were found. Nonetheless, the method used to get them out is still unknown. They were in one of the deepest rooms of the floor you're on.
entries.literal: "...Yes.{w} It's possible that Xyn aren't actually involved, given the stolen gems were found. Nonetheless, the method used to get them out is still unknown. They were in one of the deepest rooms of the floor you're on."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: What closed the exit was the alarm, which had never gone off in the past. While Ashiya are denying it, malfunctions are a possibility.{w} The alarm was supposed to only go off whenever the Sekimeiya cabinet was forced open. If stealing the gems we found was what triggered it, it doesn't make sense that they were brought outside. And on top of that, you're telling me the Sekimeiya and the cabinet are completely fine...
entries.literal: "What closed the exit was the alarm, which had never gone off in the past. While Ashiya are denying it, malfunctions are a possibility.{w} The alarm was supposed to only go off whenever the Sekimeiya cabinet was forced open. If stealing the gems we found was what triggered it, it doesn't make sense that they were brought outside. And on top of that, you're telling me the Sekimeiya and the cabinet are completely fine..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It all sounded very strange, and I was admittedly intrigued.
entries.literal: "It all sounded very strange, and I was admittedly intrigued."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: I've been given authority to tell you about Ashiya's latest move against Xyn, which led to this incident.
entries.literal: "I've been given authority to tell you about Ashiya's latest move against Xyn, which led to this incident."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I see. This is what I felt I couldn't say earlier.
entries.literal: "I see. This is what I felt I couldn't say earlier."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Keep in mind that what I'm about to tell you is a confidential matter that you're only allowed to hear because of your circumstances.
entries.literal: "Keep in mind that what I'm about to tell you is a confidential matter that you're only allowed to hear because of your circumstances."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: One constant that has always followed with Xyn's attacks is that they attack during the night, presumably to minimize risks.
entries.literal: "One constant that has always followed with Xyn's attacks is that they attack during the night, presumably to minimize risks."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Since Xyn bypassed anything Ashiya did without an issue, they recently put their full effort into a way to eliminate the threat.
entries.literal: "Since Xyn bypassed anything Ashiya did without an issue, they recently put their full effort into a way to eliminate the threat."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: The Sekimeiya exhibition... was no more than bait they put out to lure in Xyn. That, and the alarm they secretly designed, were the main two factors of their plan.{w} The tower is equipped with cameras and security. However, Ashiya hoped Xyn wouldn't anticipate such an abrupt jump in their measures.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya exhibition... was no more than bait they put out to lure in Xyn. That, and the alarm they secretly designed, were the main two factors of their plan.{w} The tower is equipped with cameras and security. However, Ashiya hoped Xyn wouldn't anticipate such an abrupt jump in their measures."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: There was so much advertising done for this particular showing that everyone in town bought into it. That was the goal. But, on the side, Ashiya secretly designed the alarm.
entries.literal: "There was so much advertising done for this particular showing that everyone in town bought into it. That was the goal. But, on the side, Ashiya secretly designed the alarm."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: It was going to be activated whenever the cabinet was forced open. Only one key for the cabinet was made, and the lock was very carefully designed to only allow the correct one. The cabinet itself, however, was one they already had and could easily be broken with force.
entries.literal: "It was going to be activated whenever the cabinet was forced open. Only one key for the cabinet was made, and the lock was very carefully designed to only allow the correct one. The cabinet itself, however, was one they already had and could easily be broken with force."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Obviously, breaking the glass of the cabinet would also activate the alarm. It was done so that any method of getting the Sekimeiya out without the key would trigger the alarm and trap the culprit with no way to escape.
entries.literal: "Obviously, breaking the glass of the cabinet would also activate the alarm. It was done so that any method of getting the Sekimeiya out without the key would trigger the alarm and trap the culprit with no way to escape."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What the hell is this about? That shutter could've injured people as they were escaping!
entries.literal: "What the hell is this about? That shutter could've injured people as they were escaping!"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: No. The mechanism is equipped with a sensor. If anyone had been in front of the shutter before it closed, it would've stopped moving until they stepped away.
entries.literal: "No. The mechanism is equipped with a sensor. If anyone had been in front of the shutter before it closed, it would've stopped moving until they stepped away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all kept silent at the realization that our situation was far more unusual than we'd thought.
entries.literal: "We all kept silent at the realization that our situation was far more unusual than we'd thought."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: The final element of the plan was the room you're currently in: the security room.
entries.literal: "The final element of the plan was the room you're currently in: the security room."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: The alarm, along with blocking off all methods of escape, has other smaller functions such as disabling the elevator, some lights, and communication methods. The maximum time the exit was going to be shut was twelve hours.
entries.literal: "The alarm, along with blocking off all methods of escape, has other smaller functions such as disabling the elevator, some lights, and communication methods. The maximum time the exit was going to be shut was twelve hours."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Maximum time? Does that mean it can be less than that?
entries.literal: "...Maximum time? Does that mean it can be less than that?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Yes, but please don't get your hopes up.
entries.literal: "Yes, but please don't get your hopes up."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: After the alarm, the Xyn members that got trapped inside would have no way to leave. You might've noticed the security room's door is sturdier than the others. The last function of the alarm was to lock it.{w} Like the cabinet's lock, once the security room's door is locked, it can only be opened with the actual key, which is possessed by the security staff. Every staff member worked to put this mechanism and plan into effect, and they knew very well what they had to do. Today, only Katei Kuiji was present.
entries.literal: "After the alarm, the Xyn members that got trapped inside would have no way to leave. You might've noticed the security room's door is sturdier than the others. The last function of the alarm was to lock it.{w} Like the cabinet's lock, once the security room's door is locked, it can only be opened with the actual key, which is possessed by the security staff. Every staff member worked to put this mechanism and plan into effect, and they knew very well what they had to do. Today, only Katei Kuiji was present."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: A security member would be inside the room constantly, monitoring the cameras. Of course, this is always done. Xyn have shown multiple ways to overcome the cameras, but this time, this was of little importance.
entries.literal: "A security member would be inside the room constantly, monitoring the cameras. Of course, this is always done. Xyn have shown multiple ways to overcome the cameras, but this time, this was of little importance."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: During the time anyone from Xyn was trapped, the security member in the security room would have one job: to relay information between the inside and the outside. This is why the security room is the only place where communication methods aren't cut off.
entries.literal: "During the time anyone from Xyn was trapped, the security member in the security room would have one job: to relay information between the inside and the outside. This is why the security room is the only place where communication methods aren't cut off."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Once it was all over, the security staff would be able to unlock the exit before twelve hours had passed. To ultimately ensure nothing funny occurred, that request would have to be approved by the Ashiya family themselves. Only then would the exit be opened before the maximum time.
entries.literal: "Once it was all over, the security staff would be able to unlock the exit before twelve hours had passed. To ultimately ensure nothing funny occurred, that request would have to be approved by the Ashiya family themselves. Only then would the exit be opened before the maximum time."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So what, they aren't approving it?
entries.literal: "So what, they aren't approving it?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: No. They can't.{w} They don't know why, but they are unable to even access the command that would let them give their approval to open the exit.
entries.literal: "No. They can't.{w} They don't know why, but they are unable to even access the command that would let them give their approval to open the exit."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: They aren't sure, but most likely something went wrong. Given the cause of the alarm is unknown, the most reasonable explanation is a malfunction.
entries.literal: "They aren't sure, but most likely something went wrong. Given the cause of the alarm is unknown, the most reasonable explanation is a malfunction."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey, Katei, you knew about this function, right? Why did you say that we'd be here for twelve hours without mentioning that you had the chance to open the shutter earlier?
entries.literal: "Hey, Katei, you knew about this function, right? Why did you say that we'd be here for twelve hours without mentioning that you had the chance to open the shutter earlier?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh... Back then, I didn't think I was allowed to explain the mechanism and reason behind the alarm, but I was certain we wouldn't be leaving before the time was up.
entries.literal: "Oh... Back then, I didn't think I was allowed to explain the mechanism and reason behind the alarm, but I was certain we wouldn't be leaving before the time was up."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: When I was still in this room, I noticed the same thing the Ashiya family noticed. I didn't have permission to access that command. That meant that we would have to spend the full time here.
entries.literal: "When I was still in this room, I noticed the same thing the Ashiya family noticed. I didn't have permission to access that command. That meant that we would have to spend the full time here."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: In case something went wrong, this failsafe was designed: the exit would always open twelve hours after it locked. Obviously, that much time ensured that if a Xyn member had gotten trapped, they couldn't escape when the time ran out.
entries.literal: "In case something went wrong, this failsafe was designed: the exit would always open twelve hours after it locked. Obviously, that much time ensured that if a Xyn member had gotten trapped, they couldn't escape when the time ran out."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: How is it possible that you don't have access to it? Can't you fix it?
entries.literal: "How is it possible that you don't have access to it? Can't you fix it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm afraid I wouldn't know where to start. I have no clue what caused it, but if the Ashiya family is encountering the same error, it doesn't look like something I could solve.
entries.literal: "I'm afraid I wouldn't know where to start. I have no clue what caused it, but if the Ashiya family is encountering the same error, it doesn't look like something I could solve."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Then... isn't there a way to take down the shutters from the outside?
entries.literal: "Then... isn't there a way to take down the shutters from the outside?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: No.{w} ...The attack was assumed to come during the night, but it happened this morning instead. I don't know a lot of details about this, but evidently Ashiya were going to trap at least one Xyn member inside and try to squeeze them for information over the security room microphone.
entries.literal: "No.{w} ...The attack was assumed to come during the night, but it happened this morning instead. I don't know a lot of details about this, but evidently Ashiya were going to trap at least one Xyn member inside and try to squeeze them for information over the security room microphone."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: No one really knows how big Xyn is, but the shutters were designed in such a way that, in case members came to rescue their trapped comrades, they couldn't do anything from the outside. This is why, in much the same way, we can't do anything to break them down without a method that would also collapse the entire building. They might look flimsy, but I guarantee you they're not.
entries.literal: "No one really knows how big Xyn is, but the shutters were designed in such a way that, in case members came to rescue their trapped comrades, they couldn't do anything from the outside. This is why, in much the same way, we can't do anything to break them down without a method that would also collapse the entire building. They might look flimsy, but I guarantee you they're not."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm confused. Katei, if you knew about this, why did you ever leave the security room? Why didn't you use the microphone to talk to the trapped culprit, as you'd all agreed?
entries.literal: "I'm confused. Katei, if you knew about this, why did you ever leave the security room? Why didn't you use the microphone to talk to the trapped culprit, as you'd all agreed?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: To tell you the truth, I did. All of you were unconscious, though, so you didn't hear me. I didn't receive any reply, and since the most important cameras had been disabled, I wanted to see for myself what had happened.
entries.literal: "To tell you the truth, I did. All of you were unconscious, though, so you didn't hear me. I didn't receive any reply, and since the most important cameras had been disabled, I wanted to see for myself what had happened."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So, all of this means that there's no way out right now. At all.
entries.literal: "So, all of this means that there's no way out right now. At all."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Yes. Ashiya informed us of this plan days ago. They were certain Xyn would attack, so the police had to be caught up.
entries.literal: "Yes. Ashiya informed us of this plan days ago. They were certain Xyn would attack, so the police had to be caught up."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Since today was the last possible day, we were all anticipating Xyn to come during the night. Long before {time=9}, I myself was in the tower, aware that the chances of a theft were incredibly likely. I was in contact with Ashiya staff about what the procedure would be if something were to happen.
entries.literal: "Since today was the last possible day, we were all anticipating Xyn to come during the night. Long before {time=9}, I myself was in the tower, aware that the chances of a theft were incredibly likely. I was in contact with Ashiya staff about what the procedure would be if something were to happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sure enough, after thinking about it, I recalled seeing him next to the entrance while we'd been waiting.
entries.literal: "Sure enough, after thinking about it, I recalled seeing him next to the entrance while we'd been waiting."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: I left before the hallway doors opened. We were told something could still happen, and one of us had also been pretty insistent in saying there'd be an attack. That's why we stayed outside and were able to contain everyone who evacuated very quickly.
entries.literal: "I left before the hallway doors opened. We were told something could still happen, and one of us had also been pretty insistent in saying there'd be an attack. That's why we stayed outside and were able to contain everyone who evacuated very quickly."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: I believe this is the scenario Ashiya will be going with: this was an attack by Xyn intended to subvert their expectations and target a lot of regular gems instead of the Sekimeiya. Maybe it would've been a success if it hadn't been for the new alarm. The suitcase was discovered right away, and all the gems were retrieved.
entries.literal: "I believe this is the scenario Ashiya will be going with: this was an attack by Xyn intended to subvert their expectations and target a lot of regular gems instead of the Sekimeiya. Maybe it would've been a success if it hadn't been for the new alarm. The suitcase was discovered right away, and all the gems were retrieved."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: It's possible the alarm went off due to a malfunction, which is also preventing them from opening the exit before the maximum time. Right now, all they can do is wait and tell you guys to do the same. They don't believe anything else has happened and will most likely be calling this their victory.
entries.literal: "It's possible the alarm went off due to a malfunction, which is also preventing them from opening the exit before the maximum time. Right now, all they can do is wait and tell you guys to do the same. They don't believe anything else has happened and will most likely be calling this their victory."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: I'm sorry I can't be of more help. While some details are still unclear, it all more or less makes sense.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry I can't be of more help. While some details are still unclear, it all more or less makes sense."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right. Is there anything else you should tell us?
entries.literal: "All right. Is there anything else you should tell us?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: ...I don't believe so. There's nothing you should worry about besides having to be in there for a while. I personally apologize for all the inconvenience, and I'm sure Ashiya will compensate all of you for being innocently trapped.
entries.literal: "...I don't believe so. There's nothing you should worry about besides having to be in there for a while. I personally apologize for all the inconvenience, and I'm sure Ashiya will compensate all of you for being innocently trapped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody wanted to mention that someone among us might not have been "innocently" trapped, and instead we stayed silent, thinking about the hours that awaited us.
entries.literal: "Nobody wanted to mention that someone among us might not have been \"innocently\" trapped, and instead we stayed silent, thinking about the hours that awaited us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was that really everything, though? Was it all just a malfunction? Was Xyn actually involved? I knew many things didn't quite add up.{w} What the hell had happened to Naomi, on top of it all?
entries.literal: "Was that really everything, though? Was it all just a malfunction? Was Xyn actually involved? I knew many things didn't quite add up.{w} What the hell had happened to Naomi, on top of it all?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Recently, there had been... a similar attack in Yushibana, where smoke had also been released. Assuming that Xyn were involved in the attack on the tower, it was a pretty easy leap to assume that they had been behind the other.
entries.literal: "Recently, there had been... a similar attack in Yushibana, where smoke had also been released. Assuming that Xyn were involved in the attack on the tower, it was a pretty easy leap to assume that they had been behind the other."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...So, what are we gonna do? Twelve hours is a lot of time. Can we go to the Sekimeiya again?
entries.literal: "...So, what are we gonna do? Twelve hours is a lot of time. Can we go to the Sekimeiya again?"

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: I think you should first reunite with Miss Cabca. After that, make sure not to do anything Ashiya might not be happy with, or they could find a way to avoid compensating you.
entries.literal: "I think you should first reunite with Miss Cabca. After that, make sure not to do anything Ashiya might not be happy with, or they could find a way to avoid compensating you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suripo forced a smile and was about to put an end to the conversation.
entries.literal: "Suripo forced a smile and was about to put an end to the conversation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, out of the three computer monitors, the leftmost one went black.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, out of the three computer monitors, the leftmost one went black."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh-What? What just happened to this screen?
entries.literal: "Wh-What? What just happened to this screen?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai, who was the one in front of it, was first to react.
entries.literal: "Sai, who was the one in front of it, was first to react."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me see... It's possible the computer stopped recognizing the screen. One second...
entries.literal: "Let me see... It's possible the computer stopped recognizing the screen. One second..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's overreaction threw everyone off, including Suripo. That was because we had only been looking at the middle screen, and the computer was still working. The leftmost screen had been displaying nothing but an empty part of the desktop.
entries.literal: "Sai's overreaction threw everyone off, including Suripo. That was because we had only been looking at the middle screen, and the computer was still working. The leftmost screen had been displaying nothing but an empty part of the desktop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Regardless, Sai quickly grabbed the mouse and navigated to the screen configuration settings.
entries.literal: "Regardless, Sai quickly grabbed the mouse and navigated to the screen configuration settings."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: At least you aren't using some custom operating system. I know what I'm looking for.
entries.literal: "At least you aren't using some custom operating system. I know what I'm looking for."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see... How strange. The left monitor isn't being detected at all...
entries.literal: "I see... How strange. The left monitor isn't being detected at all..."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: Does it matter? The computer didn't actually shut down, did it?
entries.literal: "Does it matter? The computer didn't actually shut down, did it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, no, obviously not. We can still hear and see you. Sorry, I was just confused. I don't know what caused it, though. It just stopped detecting it out of the blue.
entries.literal: "Oh, no, obviously not. We can still hear and see you. Sorry, I was just confused. I don't know what caused it, though. It just stopped detecting it out of the blue."

entries.speaker: su
entries.text: You'll have time to figure it out. For now, there are better thi—
entries.literal: "You'll have time to figure it out. For now, there are better thi—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suripo never finished that sentence. Before he could, the other two screens also went black.
entries.literal: "Suripo never finished that sentence. Before he could, the other two screens also went black."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What... happened now?
entries.literal: "What... happened now?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It wasn't only the screens this time. The computer seems to have shut down too.
entries.literal: "It wasn't only the screens this time. The computer seems to have shut down too."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: How...? What the hell?
entries.literal: "How...? What the hell?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya, Erina, and Isla were looking upward. It seemed the three computer screens weren't the only ones to turn off.
entries.literal: "Shiroya, Erina, and Isla were looking upward. It seemed the three computer screens weren't the only ones to turn off."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: All the security cameras too...? Oh no...
entries.literal: "All the security cameras too...? Oh no..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The light works, so it can't be a power outage.
entries.literal: "The light works, so it can't be a power outage."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Did a cable get disconnected?
entries.literal: "Did a cable get disconnected?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei crouched under the desk and looked behind the computer.
entries.literal: "Katei crouched under the desk and looked behind the computer."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There's nothing that looks wrong.
entries.literal: "There's nothing that looks wrong."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He pressed the power button multiple times, but the computer refused to start up.
entries.literal: "He pressed the power button multiple times, but the computer refused to start up."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell just happened?
entries.literal: "What the hell just happened?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Was it Naomi?
entries.literal: "Was it Naomi?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Naomi...?
entries.literal: "Naomi...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We were almost done with Suripo, and it was time to look at the recorded footage. If it implicated her, she might be responsible for the computer shutting off.
entries.literal: "We were almost done with Suripo, and it was time to look at the recorded footage. If it implicated her, she might be responsible for the computer shutting off."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Is... Is she listening to us?
entries.literal: "Is... Is she listening to us?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei sprinted out of the room and looked at both sides of the hallway. He even peeked at the lobby.
entries.literal: "Katei sprinted out of the room and looked at both sides of the hallway. He even peeked at the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While he was out and everyone's focus had diverted to the door, I noticed something behind me.
entries.literal: "While he was out and everyone's focus had diverted to the door, I noticed something behind me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had just taken his arm away from the leftmost monitor.
entries.literal: "Sai had just taken his arm away from the leftmost monitor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he noticed I was looking at him, our eyes met, and he smirked.
entries.literal: "When he noticed I was looking at him, our eyes met, and he smirked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could think, noise filled the room again.
entries.literal: "Before I could think, noise filled the room again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei came back, panting. It seemed the possibility of being spied on in his workroom had really gotten to him.
entries.literal: "Katei came back, panting. It seemed the possibility of being spied on in his workroom had really gotten to him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We didn't have to ask to know he'd found nothing.
entries.literal: "We didn't have to ask to know he'd found nothing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you know how someone would have turned off the computer from outside the room?
