entries.literal: "Do you know how someone would have turned off the computer from outside the room?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No... That should be impossible.
entries.literal: "No... That should be impossible."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: As I said earlier, underneath the lobby is the panel that handles the tower's electricity. While it isn't incredibly well protected, it should be impossible to power off the main computer from there.
entries.literal: "As I said earlier, underneath the lobby is the panel that handles the tower's electricity. While it isn't incredibly well protected, it should be impossible to power off the main computer from there."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That doesn't make sense... Are you sure it wouldn't be possible?
entries.literal: "That doesn't make sense... Are you sure it wouldn't be possible?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I have worked here for many years, so yes.
entries.literal: "I have worked here for many years, so yes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe we should go check anyway.
entries.literal: "Maybe we should go check anyway."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I agree. Let me go with you, esteemed visitor.
entries.literal: "I agree. Let me go with you, esteemed visitor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without waiting for a reply, Sai grabbed me by my shirt and lightly ushered me out of the room.
entries.literal: "Without waiting for a reply, Sai grabbed me by my shirt and lightly ushered me out of the room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hey, wait.
entries.literal: "Hey, wait."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't wait.
entries.literal: "He didn't wait."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I-It's fine. I'll be right back.
entries.literal: "I-It's fine. I'll be right back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That must have been enough for Shiroya, because she didn't follow us.
entries.literal: "That must have been enough for Shiroya, because she didn't follow us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I did actually want to see the panel, so I let Sai do what he wanted. It was better to not put up a fight if it gave me the same result either way.
entries.literal: "I did actually want to see the panel, so I let Sai do what he wanted. It was better to not put up a fight if it gave me the same result either way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd talked about the room before, so we knew how to access it even though it wasn't marked on the map.
entries.literal: "We'd talked about the room before, so we knew how to access it even though it wasn't marked on the map."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai started walking without uttering a word, and I followed behind.
entries.literal: "Sai started walking without uttering a word, and I followed behind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to ask what exactly was up with him, but the words didn't leave my mouth.
entries.literal: "I wanted to ask what exactly was up with him, but the words didn't leave my mouth."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went past the reception desk. Being behind it was a strange feeling, but I didn't have time to look around.
entries.literal: "We went past the reception desk. Being behind it was a strange feeling, but I didn't have time to look around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Katei had said, the door to the mechanical room was unlocked. Past it was a very narrow and dark staircase that made a sharp turn to the right.
entries.literal: "As Katei had said, the door to the mechanical room was unlocked. Past it was a very narrow and dark staircase that made a sharp turn to the right."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How scary. You go first.
entries.literal: "How scary. You go first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His nonchalant way of speaking made it clear he wasn't being serious. If it was supposed to be a joke, it didn't seem very appropriate.
entries.literal: "His nonchalant way of speaking made it clear he wasn't being serious. If it was supposed to be a joke, it didn't seem very appropriate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, I entered the stairwell first. The ceiling became a bit lower, which required me to crouch to advance. Both of us stepped into the mechanical room after opening a smaller second door.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, I entered the stairwell first. The ceiling became a bit lower, which required me to crouch to advance. Both of us stepped into the mechanical room after opening a smaller second door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The temperature didn't change, but the light was very dim, much worse in quality than the other ones used throughout the tower. The illumination was worse than the smoke-filled hallways'.
entries.literal: "The temperature didn't change, but the light was very dim, much worse in quality than the other ones used throughout the tower. The illumination was worse than the smoke-filled hallways'."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: High up on the wall was the panel Katei described. I had to move aside a low table to walk up to it, but reaching it didn't present a problem: I could easily touch the ceiling with my hand.
entries.literal: "High up on the wall was the panel Katei described. I had to move aside a low table to walk up to it, but reaching it didn't present a problem: I could easily touch the ceiling with my hand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around me. Past all the cobwebs, I could see the boiler Katei had mentioned, and it emitted a constant buzzing sound. There were also small, worn-out pieces of furniture littered around, presumably because nothing bigger could fit through the staircase.
entries.literal: "I looked around me. Past all the cobwebs, I could see the boiler Katei had mentioned, and it emitted a constant buzzing sound. There were also small, worn-out pieces of furniture littered around, presumably because nothing bigger could fit through the staircase."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It seems he was right. All the switches are on.
entries.literal: "It seems he was right. All the switches are on."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Yeah. This probably hasn't been used lately. It's covered in dust.
entries.literal: "...Yeah. This probably hasn't been used lately. It's covered in dust."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I agree.
entries.literal: "I agree."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The panel was protected by a plastic cover with a key lock, and every switch had a label on top of it. They were hard to read, but the one labeled "security room", just like all the others, was on.
entries.literal: "The panel was protected by a plastic cover with a key lock, and every switch had a label on top of it. They were hard to read, but the one labeled \"security room\", just like all the others, was on."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Can I ask something?
entries.literal: "Can I ask something?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you believe a word of what Katei's been saying?
entries.literal: "Do you believe a word of what Katei's been saying?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-What...?{w} What do you mean?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?{w} What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That took me by surprise. Maybe not so much the fact that he'd been suspecting Katei, but that he'd asked me so suddenly.
entries.literal: "That took me by surprise. Maybe not so much the fact that he'd been suspecting Katei, but that he'd asked me so suddenly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I mean what I said. Everything that Katei has said... There's no way you believe it, right?
entries.literal: "I mean what I said. Everything that Katei has said... There's no way you believe it, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: From the beginning, when he found us. When he claimed to have searched the entire floor without finding your group.{w} About monitoring the cameras and trying to open the exit.
entries.literal: "From the beginning, when he found us. When he claimed to have searched the entire floor without finding your group.{w} About monitoring the cameras and trying to open the exit."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Remember what he said? That he hadn't found it appropriate to try to talk to the outside and instead kept looking at the available cameras?
entries.literal: "Remember what he said? That he hadn't found it appropriate to try to talk to the outside and instead kept looking at the available cameras?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You can't seriously tell me you believe that.
entries.literal: "You can't seriously tell me you believe that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... I don't know.
entries.literal: "I... I don't know."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's true that I've thought that some of his claims sounded a bit off, but this might be taking it a bit too far.
entries.literal: "It's true that I've thought that some of his claims sounded a bit off, but this might be taking it a bit too far."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can't definitely doubt what he said, that he panicked and prioritized figuring out what was happening before trying to contact anyone.
entries.literal: "I can't definitely doubt what he said, that he panicked and prioritized figuring out what was happening before trying to contact anyone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's weird that he didn't find us, yeah, but he said he hadn't thoroughly examined the floor...
entries.literal: "It's weird that he didn't find us, yeah, but he said he hadn't thoroughly examined the floor..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He's been helpful to us and let us contact the police. I don't think he's as suspicious as you think.
entries.literal: "He's been helpful to us and let us contact the police. I don't think he's as suspicious as you think."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...{w} Then I'll put it bluntly.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} Then I'll put it bluntly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says.
entries.literal: "I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}How can you be sure...?
entries.literal: "...{w}How can you be sure...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're free to not believe me. I told you this because I thought you'd realized it earlier.
entries.literal: "You're free to not believe me. I told you this because I thought you'd realized it earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He smiled the same way as earlier and left the room with a shrug. From his face, all I could make out was that he was trying to have fun, but I couldn't tell if he was just messing with me.
entries.literal: "He smiled the same way as earlier and left the room with a shrug. From his face, all I could make out was that he was trying to have fun, but I couldn't tell if he was just messing with me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went upstairs. Through the door, I saw Sai in hallway B. I wanted to shout at him, but I caught up to him instead.
entries.literal: "I went upstairs. Through the door, I saw Sai in hallway B. I wanted to shout at him, but I caught up to him instead."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's hallway C ahead, the one that's clean. Do you feel like investigating the upper floors?
entries.literal: "There's hallway C ahead, the one that's clean. Do you feel like investigating the upper floors?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What? Let's go back.
entries.literal: "...What? Let's go back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He ignored me and kept walking forward.{w} Instead of repeating myself, I felt like being the one to ask something.
entries.literal: "He ignored me and kept walking forward.{w} Instead of repeating myself, I felt like being the one to ask something."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What do you think happened to Naomi?
entries.literal: "What do you think happened to Naomi?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't quite grasp Sai's behavior, but he was also trying to piece things together and might've agreed that more than met the eye was going on.{w} He didn't seem unintelligent, and since his approach appeared different from mine, his input was potentially useful.
entries.literal: "I couldn't quite grasp Sai's behavior, but he was also trying to piece things together and might've agreed that more than met the eye was going on.{w} He didn't seem unintelligent, and since his approach appeared different from mine, his input was potentially useful."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I couldn't tell you for sure. Katei seemed fine looking through the monitors, but it was also not his priority.
entries.literal: "I couldn't tell you for sure. Katei seemed fine looking through the monitors, but it was also not his priority."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This probably means that either he doesn't think much of Naomi's disappearance, or he knew we wouldn't spot her even if we looked through all the available cameras.
entries.literal: "This probably means that either he doesn't think much of Naomi's disappearance, or he knew we wouldn't spot her even if we looked through all the available cameras."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure she really passed out?
entries.literal: "Are you sure she really passed out?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm almost certain, yes.
entries.literal: "I'm almost certain, yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then it's hard to believe she regained consciousness before a person as big as Akaro did. If she really inhaled the smoke and wasn't there by the time the three of you woke up, the easy explanation is that she was moved.
entries.literal: "Then it's hard to believe she regained consciousness before a person as big as Akaro did. If she really inhaled the smoke and wasn't there by the time the three of you woke up, the easy explanation is that she was moved."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Who would do that though, and why?
entries.literal: "Who would do that though, and why?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How about the only person out of all of us who was conscious at the time?
entries.literal: "How about the only person out of all of us who was conscious at the time?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But why?
entries.literal: "But why?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't ask me. It certainly makes him look obviously suspicious, so if he still did it, he must've had a good reason.
entries.literal: "Don't ask me. It certainly makes him look obviously suspicious, so if he still did it, he must've had a good reason."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's check the Sekimeiya. I entered this hallway so that they wouldn't see us from the security room.
entries.literal: "Let's check the Sekimeiya. I entered this hallway so that they wouldn't see us from the security room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why?
entries.literal: "Why?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He turned to the left and opened the event room door. Why else, though? He wanted to see if it was still there.
entries.literal: "He turned to the left and opened the event room door. Why else, though? He wanted to see if it was still there."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If it's not here, Naomi took it. It's as simple as that, so I'm only curious.
entries.literal: "If it's not here, Naomi took it. It's as simple as that, so I'm only curious."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sure, go ahead.
entries.literal: "Sure, go ahead."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It'd be pretty interesting if it wasn't here.
entries.literal: "It'd be pretty interesting if it wasn't here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We would know we hadn't taken it, but the other five wouldn't. Not only has this room's camera been blocked off, now they can't access any.
entries.literal: "We would know we hadn't taken it, but the other five wouldn't. Not only has this room's camera been blocked off, now they can't access any."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Imagine we tell them the cabinet was empty. They would have three suspects. If we look throughout the entire tower and can't find Naomi, do you think they'd suspect us?
entries.literal: "Imagine we tell them the cabinet was empty. They would have three suspects. If we look throughout the entire tower and can't find Naomi, do you think they'd suspect us?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They would insist it could have only been us—that Naomi was never trapped to begin with, and we would be the only ones to know the truth. How would you suggest we'd defend ourselves?
entries.literal: "They would insist it could have only been us—that Naomi was never trapped to begin with, and we would be the only ones to know the truth. How would you suggest we'd defend ourselves?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I don't know. I'm sure Shiroya would believe me. I honestly doubt they would actually suspect us.
entries.literal: "...I don't know. I'm sure Shiroya would believe me. I honestly doubt they would actually suspect us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm, you might be right. What if I claim you took off running and came here? ...That could be why we took so long.
entries.literal: "Hm, you might be right. What if I claim you took off running and came here? ...That could be why we took so long."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Why the hell are you acting like this?
entries.literal: "...Why the hell are you acting like this?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't worry, I wouldn't do that.{w} Let's see. In case it's not here, should we tell them?
entries.literal: "Don't worry, I wouldn't do that.{w} Let's see. In case it's not here, should we tell them?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Of course.
entries.literal: "Of course."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why? We would be certain only Naomi or a mysterious ninth person could've taken it, but from their point of view, we would be possible suspects too.
entries.literal: "Why? We would be certain only Naomi or a mysterious ninth person could've taken it, but from their point of view, we would be possible suspects too."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If we didn't tell them, we could proceed to split up. Someone would find out that the Sekimeiya was stolen, which would lead to many more possible suspects, and their focus on us would decrease. They'd have no way to know we had already seen the empty cabinet.
entries.literal: "If we didn't tell them, we could proceed to split up. Someone would find out that the Sekimeiya was stolen, which would lead to many more possible suspects, and their focus on us would decrease. They'd have no way to know we had already seen the empty cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It might be unfair for them since we're giving them a bunch of fake suspects, but I'd say it's pretty fair for us since we know we didn't do it, right?
entries.literal: "It might be unfair for them since we're giving them a bunch of fake suspects, but I'd say it's pretty fair for us since we know we didn't do it, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure how to respond. I didn't disagree with him, but it was hard for me to humor his presumptuous attitude. Although I couldn't easily imagine being suspected, the thought of him falsely accusing me was a bit unnerving.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure how to respond. I didn't disagree with him, but it was hard for me to humor his presumptuous attitude. Although I couldn't easily imagine being suspected, the thought of him falsely accusing me was a bit unnerving."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai didn't make a lot of sense to me unless I assumed that he was just messing around for the sake of messing around.
entries.literal: "Sai didn't make a lot of sense to me unless I assumed that he was just messing around for the sake of messing around."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Whatever, let's look first.
entries.literal: "Whatever, let's look first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked forward and raised the curtain. Unlike before, very few dust particles fell off, leaving the pile on the floor practically unchanged.
entries.literal: "I walked forward and raised the curtain. Unlike before, very few dust particles fell off, leaving the pile on the floor practically unchanged."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Here it is.
entries.literal: "Here it is."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to say something along the lines of "see, you're just being paranoid", but he beat me to it.
entries.literal: "I wanted to say something along the lines of \"see, you're just being paranoid\", but he beat me to it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course it is.{w} After all, if it weren't, it could only have been Naomi, and that'd be too simple.
entries.literal: "Of course it is.{w} After all, if it weren't, it could only have been Naomi, and that'd be too simple."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Are you sure you wouldn't want to consider the other five conspiring together and taking it while we were in the mechanical room? Then they could point the finger at us.
entries.literal: "...{w}Are you sure you wouldn't want to consider the other five conspiring together and taking it while we were in the mechanical room? Then they could point the finger at us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What exactly is your deal? What were you even doing behind the monitor earlier?
entries.literal: "What exactly is your deal? What were you even doing behind the monitor earlier?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's what I was talking about. You should think about what I told you.
entries.literal: "That's what I was talking about. You should think about what I told you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could only sigh. I lowered the curtain and left the room.
entries.literal: "I could only sigh. I lowered the curtain and left the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we returned to the security room, everyone but Katei was next to the monitors. He was on the ground, and from the looks of it, he hadn't fixed a thing.
entries.literal: "When we returned to the security room, everyone but Katei was next to the monitors. He was on the ground, and from the looks of it, he hadn't fixed a thing."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You were gone for a while.
entries.literal: "You were gone for a while."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, we took the time to go to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "Yeah, we took the time to go to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no reason not to call him out, but that might've pointlessly complicated things or ended up being exactly what he wanted. ...His approach to our situation was an enigma.
entries.literal: "I had no reason not to call him out, but that might've pointlessly complicated things or ended up being exactly what he wanted. ...His approach to our situation was an enigma."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya was looking right at me, so I decided to ignore Sai's lie and moved on.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was looking right at me, so I decided to ignore Sai's lie and moved on."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How are things going?
entries.literal: "How are things going?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Katei has been trying to power the computer back on. It doesn't seem like he's achieving much, though.
entries.literal: "Katei has been trying to power the computer back on. It doesn't seem like he's achieving much, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He appeared to be messing with some cables under the table. After a few seconds, he got out and stood up.
entries.literal: "He appeared to be messing with some cables under the table. After a few seconds, he got out and stood up."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Let's try again...
entries.literal: "Let's try again..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He pressed the power button, but nothing happened.
entries.literal: "He pressed the power button, but nothing happened."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Damn it... I don't know what the problem is.
entries.literal: "Damn it... I don't know what the problem is."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, I assume all the power switches were on, correct?
entries.literal: "Oh, I assume all the power switches were on, correct?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He sighed and kneeled down once again. I didn't know what he was trying, but so far, it hadn't given him any results.
entries.literal: "He sighed and kneeled down once again. I didn't know what he was trying, but so far, it hadn't given him any results."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everybody kept looking at him even though there wasn't much to observe, as Katei's body covered all that he was doing.
entries.literal: "Everybody kept looking at him even though there wasn't much to observe, as Katei's body covered all that he was doing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's indictment replayed in my mind.
entries.literal: "Sai's indictment replayed in my mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says."
entries.literal: "\"I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why had Sai sounded so sure? And how was Katei trying to fix the issue?
entries.literal: "Why had Sai sounded so sure? And how was Katei trying to fix the issue?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If Katei was part of that group, Xyn, and had been shamelessly working under the pretense of security, their massive success rate could begin to be explained.
entries.literal: "If Katei was part of that group, Xyn, and had been shamelessly working under the pretense of security, their massive success rate could begin to be explained."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Under the table, he kept sighing methodically while making noise with the cables.
entries.literal: "Under the table, he kept sighing methodically while making noise with the cables."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I can't figure out what the problem is. It could be that electricity stopped coming from an outlet. I've been trying many different things, but this is just an incomprehensible mess of cables, and I'm not sure the problem is here.
entries.literal: "I can't figure out what the problem is. It could be that electricity stopped coming from an outlet. I've been trying many different things, but this is just an incomprehensible mess of cables, and I'm not sure the problem is here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Some seconds after nobody had answered, he repeated the cycle of trying to power on the computer, kneeling down again, messing further with the cables, and standing back up.
entries.literal: "Some seconds after nobody had answered, he repeated the cycle of trying to power on the computer, kneeling down again, messing further with the cables, and standing back up."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I apologize, but I don't seem able to fix this. I don't know what the cause was nor what's remaining a problem. All I could do here has proven useless.
entries.literal: "I apologize, but I don't seem able to fix this. I don't know what the cause was nor what's remaining a problem. All I could do here has proven useless."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We understand. The way it happened was odd in the first place.
entries.literal: "We understand. The way it happened was odd in the first place."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Do you not have any idea what could've gone wrong? Everything just turned off instantly, and this is the office where you work.
entries.literal: "Do you not have any idea what could've gone wrong? Everything just turned off instantly, and this is the office where you work."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I just told you... I can't begin to think of anything. However, it wasn't all instant, was it? This monitor was the first one to stop functioning.
entries.literal: "I just told you... I can't begin to think of anything. However, it wasn't all instant, was it? This monitor was the first one to stop functioning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was talking, of course, about the leftmost computer monitor. He approached it and examined it carefully.
entries.literal: "He was talking, of course, about the leftmost computer monitor. He approached it and examined it carefully."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Everything looks fine... It pains me to say it, but I'm completely lost.
entries.literal: "Everything looks fine... It pains me to say it, but I'm completely lost."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had Sai created the situation? The smirk he'd given me alongside what he'd said seemed to indicate that he at least had something to do with it.
entries.literal: "Had Sai created the situation? The smirk he'd given me alongside what he'd said seemed to indicate that he at least had something to do with it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey, Katei, are you done with the cables? Since you got up from there, you haven't tried to power on the computer. Why not?
entries.literal: "Hey, Katei, are you done with the cables? Since you got up from there, you haven't tried to power on the computer. Why not?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, you're right. I did this a few times when you two were gone, but nothing worked. This last time I didn't actually change anything important, so it hardly mattered.
entries.literal: "Oh, you're right. I did this a few times when you two were gone, but nothing worked. This last time I didn't actually change anything important, so it hardly mattered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While he said that, he approached the computer. With a single finger, he pressed the power button.
entries.literal: "While he said that, he approached the computer. With a single finger, he pressed the power button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the blink of an eye, the middle screen lit up and a sound that indicated the computer had begun to run echoed throughout the narrow room.
entries.literal: "In the blink of an eye, the middle screen lit up and a sound that indicated the computer had begun to run echoed throughout the narrow room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai met Katei's eyes quietly, and Isla was the first to break the silence.
entries.literal: "Sai met Katei's eyes quietly, and Isla was the first to break the silence."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: It's finally working, right? Great!
entries.literal: "It's finally working, right? Great!"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Y-Yes... It seems so.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes... It seems so."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Do you think you were the one to fix it?
entries.literal: "...Do you think you were the one to fix it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There's no way. This is as strange as it powering off... I really don't even think I ended up changing anything since the last time I tried it.
entries.literal: "There's no way. This is as strange as it powering off... I really don't even think I ended up changing anything since the last time I tried it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How bizarre.
entries.literal: "How bizarre."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes... It very much is.
entries.literal: "Yes... It very much is."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Do you think this was also done from outside the room?
entries.literal: "Do you think this was also done from outside the room?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I can't tell. It's possible the electrical system was the problem and that it just fixed itself.
entries.literal: "I can't tell. It's possible the electrical system was the problem and that it just fixed itself."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wouldn't the system have powered on automatically if that had happened?
entries.literal: "Wouldn't the system have powered on automatically if that had happened?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Possibly...
entries.literal: "Possibly..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei sat back on his chair and grabbed the mouse once the computer had finished booting up. After bringing the keyboard closer to him, he logged onto his user account.
entries.literal: "Katei sat back on his chair and grabbed the mouse once the computer had finished booting up. After bringing the keyboard closer to him, he logged onto his user account."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What happened to the cameras, though?
entries.literal: "What happened to the cameras, though?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though the computer had been brought back online, a dozen powered-off screens still remained on the wall.
entries.literal: "Even though the computer had been brought back online, a dozen powered-off screens still remained on the wall."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This computer is connected to the entire tower. That includes the computers upstairs and the security system. I must first initiate the program that will display the footage up there in real time.
entries.literal: "This computer is connected to the entire tower. That includes the computers upstairs and the security system. I must first initiate the program that will display the footage up there in real time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Upon saying that, he double-clicked on a security camera logo, and a program with a messy interface covered the entire screen.
entries.literal: "Upon saying that, he double-clicked on a security camera logo, and a program with a messy interface covered the entire screen."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This was running earlier as well, but it was minimized. The cameras won't be shown without it open.
entries.literal: "This was running earlier as well, but it was minimized. The cameras won't be shown without it open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After looking at the taskbar icon, I did recognize it from earlier, and it was the same one he'd used to change the cameras being displayed.
entries.literal: "After looking at the taskbar icon, I did recognize it from earlier, and it was the same one he'd used to change the cameras being displayed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei once again typed out what looked like gibberish as the username and a password that was obfuscated from us. After he pressed the enter key, access was granted.
entries.literal: "Katei once again typed out what looked like gibberish as the username and a password that was obfuscated from us. After he pressed the enter key, access was granted."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: All right, this button will start up the system.
entries.literal: "All right, this button will start up the system."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Below the text "Logged in as Katei Kuiji" was a button that read "Initialize Camera Monitoring", which Katei quickly clicked on.
entries.literal: "Below the text \"Logged in as Katei Kuiji\" was a button that read \"Initialize Camera Monitoring\", which Katei quickly clicked on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, upon doing so, an error window showed up. The text "Couldn't detect video footage" was written on it.
entries.literal: "However, upon doing so, an error window showed up. The text \"Couldn't detect video footage\" was written on it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-What...? What the hell does this mean? I-I've never seen this error message.
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? What the hell does this mean? I-I've never seen this error message."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You can't look through the cameras?
entries.literal: "You can't look through the cameras?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. Usually, after pressing this button, the screens would turn on and automatically display the live feed the cameras are recording.
entries.literal: "Yes. Usually, after pressing this button, the screens would turn on and automatically display the live feed the cameras are recording."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What if you check the saved footage?
entries.literal: "What if you check the saved footage?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, that's what I was going to try...
entries.literal: "Yes, that's what I was going to try..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cursor, controlled by Katei, hovered over and clicked on the "archived footage" button.
entries.literal: "The cursor, controlled by Katei, hovered over and clicked on the \"archived footage\" button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, though, an error window followed by an obnoxious sound appeared, containing the text: "No archived footage detected. No camera system detected."
entries.literal: "Once again, though, an error window followed by an obnoxious sound appeared, containing the text: \"No archived footage detected. No camera system detected.\""

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Okay, what the hell is this!? This has never happened before!
entries.literal: "Okay, what the hell is this!? This has never happened before!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's outright saying the camera system isn't being detected...
entries.literal: "It's outright saying the camera system isn't being detected..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai made his way out of the room and returned before anyone had time to be confused.
entries.literal: "Sai made his way out of the room and returned before anyone had time to be confused."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I looked at one of the hallway's security cameras. It's showing a tiny green light. That means it's currently functioning and recording, right?
entries.literal: "I looked at one of the hallway's security cameras. It's showing a tiny green light. That means it's currently functioning and recording, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. If the green light is there, it means the camera is recording.
entries.literal: "Yes. If the green light is there, it means the camera is recording."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, the problem here is that we can't currently access the live footage or look at the recordings. The cameras are still actually functioning.
entries.literal: "So, the problem here is that we can't currently access the live footage or look at the recordings. The cameras are still actually functioning."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, I think so. For some reason, the computer won't connect to the system.
entries.literal: "Yes, I think so. For some reason, the computer won't connect to the system."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Heh. Looking at the recorded footage so easily sounded too good to be true anyway.
entries.literal: "Heh. Looking at the recorded footage so easily sounded too good to be true anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been doubting we would find anything in the recordings since the relevant cameras had been disabled by the smoke, but it was true that it could've given us crucial information, especially regarding Naomi.
entries.literal: "I'd been doubting we would find anything in the recordings since the relevant cameras had been disabled by the smoke, but it was true that it could've given us crucial information, especially regarding Naomi."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, let's talk to the police again. They might know what caused this.
entries.literal: "Well, let's talk to the police again. They might know what caused this."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're right, we should still be able to do that.
entries.literal: "You're right, we should still be able to do that."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Give me a second.
entries.literal: "Give me a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei did everything he'd done the last time. When the small window appeared, he input a password and pressed the enter key.
entries.literal: "Katei did everything he'd done the last time. When the small window appeared, he input a password and pressed the enter key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Access Denied" appeared in red letters below the login information.
entries.literal: "\"Access Denied\" appeared in red letters below the login information."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-What...!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...!?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Access denied? What the fuck does it mean by that!?
entries.literal: "Access denied? What the fuck does it mean by that!?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's what I was about to say! I know I'm repeating myself here, but this has never happened before!
entries.literal: "That's what I was about to say! I know I'm repeating myself here, but this has never happened before!"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'll try again...
entries.literal: "I'll try again..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He reentered the login information four times, but that same message kept appearing.
entries.literal: "He reentered the login information four times, but that same message kept appearing."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't understand this...
entries.literal: "I don't understand this..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you think your authority has been revoked?
entries.literal: "Do you think your authority has been revoked?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I-It must... But why? Why would that happen now!?
entries.literal: "I-It must... But why? Why would that happen now!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not like we can contact the outside to ask. I know you said earlier that the alarm cut off access to the internet, but everything's out of order anyway, so there's no harm in checking.
entries.literal: "It's not like we can contact the outside to ask. I know you said earlier that the alarm cut off access to the internet, but everything's out of order anyway, so there's no harm in checking."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, you're right. It might not be disabled.
entries.literal: "Yes, you're right. It might not be disabled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei double-clicked on the browser icon, and we were met with a white screen containing the text: "There is no internet connection".
entries.literal: "Katei double-clicked on the browser icon, and we were met with a white screen containing the text: \"There is no internet connection\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To further make sure, he typed a common URL, but the same screen appeared.
entries.literal: "To further make sure, he typed a common URL, but the same screen appeared."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I guess we're not getting that lucky...
entries.literal: "I guess we're not getting that lucky..."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm sorry... I don't think I can do anything about this.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry... I don't think I can do anything about this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's okay, it's not your fault. If we can't access the security cameras or connect to the outside, our priority should be to investigate this whole building. Naomi's still a mystery.
entries.literal: "It's okay, it's not your fault. If we can't access the security cameras or connect to the outside, our priority should be to investigate this whole building. Naomi's still a mystery."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's true... We should try to find her and gather any useful information we can.
entries.literal: "That's true... We should try to find her and gather any useful information we can."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: B-But, how could this have happened? I don't understand it.{w} The timing was too coincidental. Did Ashiya remotely power off the computer to revoke my access? All I could do with it was talk to them.{w} Maybe the problem with the security system is a side effect of whatever happened...{w} I will stay here for a bit, while you go. I have a couple more things to do.
entries.literal: "B-But, how could this have happened? I don't understand it.{w} The timing was too coincidental. Did Ashiya remotely power off the computer to revoke my access? All I could do with it was talk to them.{w} Maybe the problem with the security system is a side effect of whatever happened...{w} I will stay here for a bit, while you go. I have a couple more things to do."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Such as?
entries.literal: "Such as?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Well, I'd like to investigate more about what caused the shutdown. The security system not being detected is very strange, and in addition, it seems my authority might've been revoked.
entries.literal: "Well, I'd like to investigate more about what caused the shutdown. The security system not being detected is very strange, and in addition, it seems my authority might've been revoked."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You must understand how odd of a situation this is for me. I'd like to see if I can figure something out.
entries.literal: "You must understand how odd of a situation this is for me. I'd like to see if I can figure something out."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: However, there are a few things I'll work on for sure. This computer is still connected to the rest of the tower, so I can undo a few smaller effects of the alarm. I can try to restore power to the elevator and some lights; those don't really require any kind of login. I'll catch up with you all once I'm done.
entries.literal: "However, there are a few things I'll work on for sure. This computer is still connected to the rest of the tower, so I can undo a few smaller effects of the alarm. I can try to restore power to the elevator and some lights; those don't really require any kind of login. I'll catch up with you all once I'm done."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. That sounds fair to me. We'll go, then.
entries.literal: "I see. That sounds fair to me. We'll go, then."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Should we really be splitting up? It'd be better if we moved in groups, at least.
entries.literal: "Should we really be splitting up? It'd be better if we moved in groups, at least."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There's no real point to any of you staying here. I am the only person here who knows how to access these parts of the system, and it would be better to have the elevator available than not. Go on ahead.
entries.literal: "There's no real point to any of you staying here. I am the only person here who knows how to access these parts of the system, and it would be better to have the elevator available than not. Go on ahead."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...All right. Good luck. It's weird to think that Naomi is out there and hasn't tried to reach us, so I'm a bit worried.
entries.literal: "...All right. Good luck. It's weird to think that Naomi is out there and hasn't tried to reach us, so I'm a bit worried."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You're right. Let's go with them, Isla.
entries.literal: "You're right. Let's go with them, Isla."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everybody started to look a bit more tense in the hallway, maybe because we hadn't yet seen anything beyond the first floor, or maybe because the reality of being trapped was creeping in.
entries.literal: "Everybody started to look a bit more tense in the hallway, maybe because we hadn't yet seen anything beyond the first floor, or maybe because the reality of being trapped was creeping in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the cameras and noticed that the tiny, green recording light could only be noticed on some of them, as the dried smoke fully covered a good number.
entries.literal: "I looked at the cameras and noticed that the tiny, green recording light could only be noticed on some of them, as the dried smoke fully covered a good number."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked together a few steps until we all stopped silently. Our task was to investigate a huge building we had never entered before only to track down someone who could've been hiding with malicious intent.
entries.literal: "We walked together a few steps until we all stopped silently. Our task was to investigate a huge building we had never entered before only to track down someone who could've been hiding with malicious intent."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla started talking casually to Erina about their daily life. I didn't disturb them, figuring it was better if Isla remained as calm as possible.
entries.literal: "Isla started talking casually to Erina about their daily life. I didn't disturb them, figuring it was better if Isla remained as calm as possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I leaned against a wall, next to Shiroya. I didn't think she wanted to talk, so I kept quiet.{w} The handrail made the position uncomfortable, but I tried not to mind it. Instead, I focused on thinking...
entries.literal: "I leaned against a wall, next to Shiroya. I didn't think she wanted to talk, so I kept quiet.{w} The handrail made the position uncomfortable, but I tried not to mind it. Instead, I focused on thinking..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What exactly had happened in the security room? What had Sai done?
entries.literal: "What exactly had happened in the security room? What had Sai done?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at him. He wore a silent, carefree expression, appearing almost on a different plane from the rest of us.
entries.literal: "I looked at him. He wore a silent, carefree expression, appearing almost on a different plane from the rest of us."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Earlier, when I looked at him after Katei rushed out of the room, he took his hand out from behind the leftmost monitor. What exactly did I see?
entries.literal: "Earlier, when I looked at him after Katei rushed out of the room, he took his hand out from behind the leftmost monitor. What exactly did I see?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Let me take a different approach. Assuming the monitor powering off was his doing, what could the reason be?
entries.literal: "Let me take a different approach. Assuming the monitor powering off was his doing, what could the reason be?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What did he do right after the monitor stopped working? He tried to see what had happened... But if he'd been the one to cause it, that couldn't have been his goal...
entries.literal: "What did he do right after the monitor stopped working? He tried to see what had happened... But if he'd been the one to cause it, that couldn't have been his goal..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After considering a couple of possibilities, an idea came to me. If I was right, what he'd told me later made sense.
entries.literal: "After considering a couple of possibilities, an idea came to me. If I was right, what he'd told me later made sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says."
entries.literal: "\"I guarantee you that everything he's said has been a lie. Don't trust anything he says.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: At that point, with what he did to the monitor, he was probably confirming his suspicion.
entries.literal: "At that point, with what he did to the monitor, he was probably confirming his suspicion."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He was right: a lot of things Katei has been saying have been questionable at best, but now that I think about it, there was one major thing that I overlooked.
entries.literal: "He was right: a lot of things Katei has been saying have been questionable at best, but now that I think about it, there was one major thing that I overlooked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Katei grabbed the doorknob, and upon turning it, he tried to push the door forward. However, it didn't budge."
entries.literal: "\"Katei grabbed the doorknob, and upon turning it, he tried to push the door forward. However, it didn't budge.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Oh, right. I locked it earlier. Let me see."
entries.literal: "\"Oh, right. I locked it earlier. Let me see.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I bet Sai noticed this. Katei didn't think the door would be locked.
entries.literal: "I bet Sai noticed this. Katei didn't think the door would be locked."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He was quick to make up a lie. He said that since it's an important room, he thought it appropriate to lock it before going outside to inspect things.
entries.literal: "He was quick to make up a lie. He said that since it's an important room, he thought it appropriate to lock it before going outside to inspect things."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He even claimed to have done it because the room contained the single way to communicate with the outside, but later, he showed us that you could only enable it with a password that only the security staff knew.
entries.literal: "He even claimed to have done it because the room contained the single way to communicate with the outside, but later, he showed us that you could only enable it with a password that only the security staff knew."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's probably not that he thought the door would be open, but that he didn't realize it wouldn't be.
entries.literal: "It's probably not that he thought the door would be open, but that he didn't realize it wouldn't be."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: After all, we know what actually locked it—the alarm.
entries.literal: "After all, we know what actually locked it—the alarm."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Suripo explained the entire function and mechanism behind the alarm to us. The person inside the security room would relay information between the people that got trapped and the outside. The door of the security room would close alongside the exit, and it would be impossible to open it with anything but the right key.
entries.literal: "Suripo explained the entire function and mechanism behind the alarm to us. The person inside the security room would relay information between the people that got trapped and the outside. The door of the security room would close alongside the exit, and it would be impossible to open it with anything but the right key."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Meaning that if I'm right, from the time I heard the alarm to the time we entered the security room... no one was inside it.
entries.literal: "Meaning that if I'm right, from the time I heard the alarm to the time we entered the security room... no one was inside it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Katei had actually never been inside the security room. This was a huge lie, and most likely something Sai assumed after noticing Katei's actions before he opened the door, or when the alarm's functions were explained.
entries.literal: "Katei had actually never been inside the security room. This was a huge lie, and most likely something Sai assumed after noticing Katei's actions before he opened the door, or when the alarm's functions were explained."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: A lot of things Katei said hinge on him being in the security room during the time the smoke was released.
entries.literal: "A lot of things Katei said hinge on him being in the security room during the time the smoke was released."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Seeing the smoke appearing out of nowhere through the cameras, looking at the available ones and not seeing anyone, not trying to contact the outside, not being allowed to input his command to open up the exit...
entries.literal: "Seeing the smoke appearing out of nowhere through the cameras, looking at the available ones and not seeing anyone, not trying to contact the outside, not being allowed to input his command to open up the exit..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: All those claims are impossible if I assume he was never in the security room during that period of time. Even seeing the smoke through the cameras and then exiting the room before the alarm went off would be far from believable. This would have both stained his clothes and knocked him out.
entries.literal: "All those claims are impossible if I assume he was never in the security room during that period of time. Even seeing the smoke through the cameras and then exiting the room before the alarm went off would be far from believable. This would have both stained his clothes and knocked him out."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I should question something important if he truly was never in the room. Katei's clothes weren't stained, but he still knew about the smoke. Did Erina's group tell him and he acted as if he'd seen it through the cameras? Did he see it from far away? Or did he have another way to know about it without personally seeing it?
entries.literal: "I should question something important if he truly was never in the room. Katei's clothes weren't stained, but he still knew about the smoke. Did Erina's group tell him and he acted as if he'd seen it through the cameras? Did he see it from far away? Or did he have another way to know about it without personally seeing it?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: To maintain his claim of seeing the smoke appear through the cameras, it's possible he knew it would appear and quickly left the security room with a mask and spare clothes right before the alarm sounded. Like this, he would've been able to lie about his location the whole time. After all, it would have been too risky for him to leave before the smoke was released.
entries.literal: "To maintain his claim of seeing the smoke appear through the cameras, it's possible he knew it would appear and quickly left the security room with a mask and spare clothes right before the alarm sounded. Like this, he would've been able to lie about his location the whole time. After all, it would have been too risky for him to leave before the smoke was released."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If this is what he did, he must've used the time we were unconscious to do something. What's for certain is that aside from seeing the smoke through the cameras, if he wasn't in the room by the time the alarm went off, all his other claims become impossible.
entries.literal: "If this is what he did, he must've used the time we were unconscious to do something. What's for certain is that aside from seeing the smoke through the cameras, if he wasn't in the room by the time the alarm went off, all his other claims become impossible."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...But he also might not have been on this floor during the attack. If he showed up later, that could explain why he found Erina's group before ours. They told him what had happened, and he made up a lie accordingly. This would mean that everything he's told us has been a fabrication.
entries.literal: "...But he also might not have been on this floor during the attack. If he showed up later, that could explain why he found Erina's group before ours. They told him what had happened, and he made up a lie accordingly. This would mean that everything he's told us has been a fabrication."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Once I assume Katei was never in the room, the exact reason for that lie is not too important. What it means is that he's untrustworthy and that he has an ulterior motive.
entries.literal: "Once I assume Katei was never in the room, the exact reason for that lie is not too important. What it means is that he's untrustworthy and that he has an ulterior motive."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And... it is very possible his authority as a security member has been revoked. The timing was too precise to be a coincidence. It could be that Ashiya and the police figured something out about him and removed his privilege as a security member. However, they'd know that doing so would also prevent us from contacting them again, so they must've had a very good reason.
entries.literal: "And... it is very possible his authority as a security member has been revoked. The timing was too precise to be a coincidence. It could be that Ashiya and the police figured something out about him and removed his privilege as a security member. However, they'd know that doing so would also prevent us from contacting them again, so they must've had a very good reason."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Then, what Sai did to confirm his theory...
entries.literal: "Then, what Sai did to confirm his theory..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He pulled it off shamelessly, in front of everybody. I'm sure he could've done it later alone, but it's possible he feared Katei would've prevented it with a new lie.
entries.literal: "He pulled it off shamelessly, in front of everybody. I'm sure he could've done it later alone, but it's possible he feared Katei would've prevented it with a new lie."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Right before Sai started, he asked Suripo: "Is there anything else you should tell us?" He wanted to check something as soon as possible, before Katei could interfere again.
entries.literal: "Right before Sai started, he asked Suripo: \"Is there anything else you should tell us?\" He wanted to check something as soon as possible, before Katei could interfere again."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Once Suripo said he'd told us everything we needed to know, Sai unplugged the cord behind the leftmost monitor—the one he was next to.
entries.literal: "Once Suripo said he'd told us everything we needed to know, Sai unplugged the cord behind the leftmost monitor—the one he was next to."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This was only done to have a justification for checking the screen settings. He quickly grabbed the mouse and opened them from the desktop.
entries.literal: "This was only done to have a justification for checking the screen settings. He quickly grabbed the mouse and opened them from the desktop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I see... How strange. The left monitor isn't being detected at all..."
entries.literal: "\"I see... How strange. The left monitor isn't being detected at all...\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, that's not what Sai was actually looking at.
entries.literal: "However, that's not what Sai was actually looking at."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When we all entered the security room, Katei quickly went to use the computer.
entries.literal: "When we all entered the security room, Katei quickly went to use the computer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Paying no mind to everyone's silence, Katei made his way to the chair and sat down. When he moved the mouse, the computer exited its suspended state and reactivated the three monitors above it, showing us what the last person to use it had been doing."
entries.literal: "\"Paying no mind to everyone's silence, Katei made his way to the chair and sat down. When he moved the mouse, the computer exited its suspended state and reactivated the three monitors above it, showing us what the last person to use it had been doing.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I bet Sai's goal was actually to look at how long it'd take for the computer to enter sleep mode, which is information found on the same settings screen. That's because Katei said he'd used it while he'd been in the room.
entries.literal: "I bet Sai's goal was actually to look at how long it'd take for the computer to enter sleep mode, which is information found on the same settings screen. That's because Katei said he'd used it while he'd been in the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Shortly after that, the alarm went off, so I knew I was already trapped. During that time until I exited, I kept my eyes on the cameras. I also tried to use the computer to look up information about what had happened, but the alarm even shut down my internet connection."{w} He'd also said that he tried to input the command to unlock the exit.
entries.literal: "\"Shortly after that, the alarm went off, so I knew I was already trapped. During that time until I exited, I kept my eyes on the cameras. I also tried to use the computer to look up information about what had happened, but the alarm even shut down my internet connection.\"{w} He'd also said that he tried to input the command to unlock the exit."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: We know the alarm went off at approximately {time=9:05.} Thanks to the time the computer displayed and that it was in sleep mode when we entered the room, if the settings perhaps showed that an hour of inactivity had been needed to enter that state, Sai could've confirmed that Katei had not been there at all.
entries.literal: "We know the alarm went off at approximately {time=9:05.} Thanks to the time the computer displayed and that it was in sleep mode when we entered the room, if the settings perhaps showed that an hour of inactivity had been needed to enter that state, Sai could've confirmed that Katei had not been there at all."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And, apparently, it did confirm it. That's why he was sure that Katei was lying.
entries.literal: "And, apparently, it did confirm it. That's why he was sure that Katei was lying."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This also explains his subsequent action. When I saw Sai taking his arm out from behind the leftmost monitor, he'd just plugged the cord back in.
entries.literal: "This also explains his subsequent action. When I saw Sai taking his arm out from behind the leftmost monitor, he'd just plugged the cord back in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite sounding risky, he'd had nothing to lose, and if he'd waited longer, Katei could've prevented it.
entries.literal: "Despite sounding risky, he'd had nothing to lose, and if he'd waited longer, Katei could've prevented it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And Sai's timing had been great: right after that, all the monitors and even the computer stopped working. That probably wasn't his doing, even though Katei implied otherwise.
entries.literal: "And Sai's timing had been great: right after that, all the monitors and even the computer stopped working. That probably wasn't his doing, even though Katei implied otherwise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "However, it wasn't all instant, was it? This monitor was the first one to stop functioning."
entries.literal: "\"However, it wasn't all instant, was it? This monitor was the first one to stop functioning.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He said it as if both things were connected, but I don't think that was right. Sai unplugged the first monitor, but the rest must've had a different cause.
entries.literal: "He said it as if both things were connected, but I don't think that was right. Sai unplugged the first monitor, but the rest must've had a different cause."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: One thing is for sure: Sai has confirmed his theory and is now certain Katei has fed us lie after lie.{w} And I should probably think the same.
entries.literal: "One thing is for sure: Sai has confirmed his theory and is now certain Katei has fed us lie after lie.{w} And I should probably think the same."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is this it, then...? Is Katei simply a blatant liar with an ulterior motive?
entries.literal: "Is this it, then...? Is Katei simply a blatant liar with an ulterior motive?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about everything that had happened up until then and shortly noticed another inconsistency Katei presented very early on. He'd later introduced a contradiction himself.
entries.literal: "I thought about everything that had happened up until then and shortly noticed another inconsistency Katei presented very early on. He'd later introduced a contradiction himself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Did all of you hear the alarm that played throughout the building? After I heard it, I saw all the smoke."
entries.literal: "\"Did all of you hear the alarm that played throughout the building? After I heard it, I saw all the smoke.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He claimed to have heard the alarm, then seen the smoke. However, just after that, he said the smoke disabled the cameras instantly. Given the alarm went off some seconds after the smoke was released, he could only have seen smoke after hearing the alarm if he had been outside the security room.{w} It's a bit strange that he said that but was still correct in saying that the smoke disabled the cameras.
entries.literal: "He claimed to have heard the alarm, then seen the smoke. However, just after that, he said the smoke disabled the cameras instantly. Given the alarm went off some seconds after the smoke was released, he could only have seen smoke after hearing the alarm if he had been outside the security room.{w} It's a bit strange that he said that but was still correct in saying that the smoke disabled the cameras."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If he planned his phrasing well enough to make it sound as if he'd been inside the room, to the point of realizing that the cameras would've become useless, it follows he wouldn't have mentioned the huge inconsistency of seeing the smoke after hearing the alarm.
entries.literal: "If he planned his phrasing well enough to make it sound as if he'd been inside the room, to the point of realizing that the cameras would've become useless, it follows he wouldn't have mentioned the huge inconsistency of seeing the smoke after hearing the alarm."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If there's a reason for this, it must be that without looking at the monitors, he knew the smoke would've left them useless. However, he must not have thought about it too hard, or else he would've never contradicted himself so blatantly.
entries.literal: "If there's a reason for this, it must be that without looking at the monitors, he knew the smoke would've left them useless. However, he must not have thought about it too hard, or else he would've never contradicted himself so blatantly."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There is one simple way this could've happened: if he designed the plan. He would've known the effects of the smoke but would not have thought of what they would've entailed if he'd truly been in the security room.
entries.literal: "There is one simple way this could've happened: if he designed the plan. He would've known the effects of the smoke but would not have thought of what they would've entailed if he'd truly been in the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to believe that. Not because I trusted a stranger by default, but because I wasn't sure if I was only deluding myself by believing it.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to believe that. Not because I trusted a stranger by default, but because I wasn't sure if I was only deluding myself by believing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went back to my previous thought. Could Katei have still been inside the security room until he'd left it before the alarm had played? That would've made him a bit more trustworthy, even if it wasn't much.
entries.literal: "I went back to my previous thought. Could Katei have still been inside the security room until he'd left it before the alarm had played? That would've made him a bit more trustworthy, even if it wasn't much."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The problem was, once again, that he didn't have any traces of smoke on him. Even if he'd changed clothes, his face and hair would've been noticeably stained.{w} Technically, there was a way to get around that. I knew hallway B had been hit by the smoke by the point I'd noticed the lack of light under the door. However, I couldn't be sure the same thing could be said of hallway A, the third and last section that had been inundated. We'd only seen it filled with smoke after waking up.
entries.literal: "The problem was, once again, that he didn't have any traces of smoke on him. Even if he'd changed clothes, his face and hair would've been noticeably stained.{w} Technically, there was a way to get around that. I knew hallway B had been hit by the smoke by the point I'd noticed the lack of light under the door. However, I couldn't be sure the same thing could be said of hallway A, the third and last section that had been inundated. We'd only seen it filled with smoke after waking up."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But if he left because he saw the smoke through the cameras, he realistically would've mentioned that hallway A hadn't yet been darkened by that point...
entries.literal: "But if he left because he saw the smoke through the cameras, he realistically would've mentioned that hallway A hadn't yet been darkened by that point..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The only confirmed fact is that he wasn't in the room from the time the alarm went off to the point we entered it. It could be that he saw the smoke disabling the cameras, left the room, and then the alarm locked it. If this happened, the smoke in hallway A must've been released afterward.
entries.literal: "The only confirmed fact is that he wasn't in the room from the time the alarm went off to the point we entered it. It could be that he saw the smoke disabling the cameras, left the room, and then the alarm locked it. If this happened, the smoke in hallway A must've been released afterward."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Finally, if I'm only pointlessly trying to reduce the number of lies Katei has been spewing, it could be that he was in the room but never touched the computer. Then, the sleep mode settings wouldn't mean anything, but lying about using the PC seems pointless.
entries.literal: "Finally, if I'm only pointlessly trying to reduce the number of lies Katei has been spewing, it could be that he was in the room but never touched the computer. Then, the sleep mode settings wouldn't mean anything, but lying about using the PC seems pointless."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is there a way to go against Sai's confirmed theory?
entries.literal: "Is there a way to go against Sai's confirmed theory?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I suppose there's only one.
entries.literal: "I suppose there's only one."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If the computer's current time is incorrect, the time shown in the screen settings could be refuted.
entries.literal: "If the computer's current time is incorrect, the time shown in the screen settings could be refuted."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Considering that when we talked to Suripo, at no point was the actual time mentioned... if it wasn't actually {time=9:41} when we checked the time, it could all hold up.
entries.literal: "Considering that when we talked to Suripo, at no point was the actual time mentioned... if it wasn't actually {time=9:41} when we checked the time, it could all hold up."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If the computer was an hour behind and the real time was {time=10:45}, we would've been unconscious for longer than we thought, and everything could fit. Katei could have been in the security room, and enough time for the suspended state to be reached could've passed.
entries.literal: "If the computer was an hour behind and the real time was {time=10:45}, we would've been unconscious for longer than we thought, and everything could fit. Katei could have been in the security room, and enough time for the suspended state to be reached could've passed."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, this single last possibility was denied by the only person who didn't fall unconscious... Katei himself.
entries.literal: "However, this single last possibility was denied by the only person who didn't fall unconscious... Katei himself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Yes, this matches with the amount of time I stayed here after I saw the smoke."
entries.literal: "\"Yes, this matches with the amount of time I stayed here after I saw the smoke.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed it was unquestionable. For one reason or another, Katei had lied about what he'd been doing during the incident. He hadn't been where he should've been, and he had continuously claimed to do things that would've been impossible.
entries.literal: "It seemed it was unquestionable. For one reason or another, Katei had lied about what he'd been doing during the incident. He hadn't been where he should've been, and he had continuously claimed to do things that would've been impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before we'd all entered the security room, he wasn't fast enough to think that the alarm would have locked the door. He simply tried to open it manually, as he hadn't locked it himself.
entries.literal: "Before we'd all entered the security room, he wasn't fast enough to think that the alarm would have locked the door. He simply tried to open it manually, as he hadn't locked it himself."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What is Katei after...? Why did he lie so much? After all, he was the one who told us about the way to communicate with the outside. All of his actions have been bizarre.
entries.literal: "What is Katei after...? Why did he lie so much? After all, he was the one who told us about the way to communicate with the outside. All of his actions have been bizarre."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Hang on... I haven't considered this, but what if he isn't who he claimed to be?
entries.literal: "Hang on... I haven't considered this, but what if he isn't who he claimed to be?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Could it be he isn't actually part of the security staff? He refused to explain anything because it would've been "confidential", but then Suripo didn't have an issue doing so. What if he simply didn't know anything? The only thing he said was that we'd be locked inside the building for twelve hours and that he knew of the way to communicate with the outside.
entries.literal: "Could it be he isn't actually part of the security staff? He refused to explain anything because it would've been \"confidential\", but then Suripo didn't have an issue doing so. What if he simply didn't know anything? The only thing he said was that we'd be locked inside the building for twelve hours and that he knew of the way to communicate with the outside."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: His clothes weren't stained, but he knew about the smoke. He had a safe place he should've stayed in, but he wasn't in it. He had the security room key, but he didn't think the door would be locked. He investigated this floor, but he didn't look in the event room...
entries.literal: "His clothes weren't stained, but he knew about the smoke. He had a safe place he should've stayed in, but he wasn't in it. He had the security room key, but he didn't think the door would be locked. He investigated this floor, but he didn't look in the event room..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If this was all his plan... it could be that he borrowed the name of Katei, an actual security staff member. Not only his name, but also his clothes and room. Then, those stained clothes the actual Katei was wearing would've been disposed of.
entries.literal: "If this was all his plan... it could be that he borrowed the name of Katei, an actual security staff member. Not only his name, but also his clothes and room. Then, those stained clothes the actual Katei was wearing would've been disposed of."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Suripo admitted that a security staff member hadn't evacuated the tower, and he was familiar with the name "Katei Kuiji", but this could simply mean that the real Katei Kuiji is still trapped with us. Maybe his body was hidden in a spot out of the cameras' reach.
entries.literal: "Suripo admitted that a security staff member hadn't evacuated the tower, and he was familiar with the name \"Katei Kuiji\", but this could simply mean that the real Katei Kuiji is still trapped with us. Maybe his body was hidden in a spot out of the cameras' reach."
