entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Suripo talked to Katei, but he was a simple police officer and had no way to confirm that the voice belonged to the actual staff member. On top of that, he never actually saw us. It was only audio from our end.
entries.literal: "Suripo talked to Katei, but he was a simple police officer and had no way to confirm that the voice belonged to the actual staff member. On top of that, he never actually saw us. It was only audio from our end."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Since I couldn't arrive at a conclusion, I lowered my head after being lost in thought for a while.
entries.literal: "...{w}Since I couldn't arrive at a conclusion, I lowered my head after being lost in thought for a while."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya was standing near me, looking almost as detached as I was sure I did.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was standing near me, looking almost as detached as I was sure I did."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya?
entries.literal: "Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: H-Hm?
entries.literal: "H-Hm?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.literal: "Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah... I am.
entries.literal: "Yeah... I am."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I rubbed at my face with one hand and pulled her aside, speaking in a hushed tone.
entries.literal: "I rubbed at my face with one hand and pulled her aside, speaking in a hushed tone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya. It's fine. We're fine. Naomi is fine too. You can't let this stuff get to you.
entries.literal: "Shiroya. It's fine. We're fine. Naomi is fine too. You can't let this stuff get to you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-I'm not...
entries.literal: "I-I'm not..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't get sucked into some depressive loop, okay? I'm here. We're going to find her.
entries.literal: "Don't get sucked into some depressive loop, okay? I'm here. We're going to find her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I mean it.
entries.literal: "I mean it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: All right. I'm sorry. It was just... the camera footage is...
entries.literal: "All right. I'm sorry. It was just... the camera footage is..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The police will recover it.
entries.literal: "The police will recover it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...You're right.
entries.literal: "...You're right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Somewhat satisfied, I patted her shoulder and stepped back into the middle of the hallway.
entries.literal: "Somewhat satisfied, I patted her shoulder and stepped back into the middle of the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Close by, Isla, who had finished talking with her mother, was walking to the event room.
entries.literal: "Close by, Isla, who had finished talking with her mother, was walking to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were supposed to investigate the building, but we had all silently agreed to wait a bit out of either anxiety or hesitation.
entries.literal: "We were supposed to investigate the building, but we had all silently agreed to wait a bit out of either anxiety or hesitation."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Where are you going?
entries.literal: "Where are you going?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I wanna see it again!
entries.literal: "I wanna see it again!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without further explanation, she quickly made her way into the room.
entries.literal: "Without further explanation, she quickly made her way into the room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina followed behind her. The rest of us did the same since staying by ourselves didn't seem very useful.
entries.literal: "Erina followed behind her. The rest of us did the same since staying by ourselves didn't seem very useful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The previous two weeks had been difficult for Shiroya and me. I knew the cheerful Shiroya I was fond of would take a longer time to come back, but all things considered, both of us were handling the situation pretty well. I was just concerned about pushing her too far.
entries.literal: "The previous two weeks had been difficult for Shiroya and me. I knew the cheerful Shiroya I was fond of would take a longer time to come back, but all things considered, both of us were handling the situation pretty well. I was just concerned about pushing her too far."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla was in front of the cabinet. I entered the room just as she was about to uncover the cabinet, and Akaro and Sai followed silently after me.
entries.literal: "Isla was in front of the cabinet. I entered the room just as she was about to uncover the cabinet, and Akaro and Sai followed silently after me."

entries.text: Blue Light
entries.literal: "Blue Light"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Look at how pretty it is! Now that the light has gotten a bit better, I like it even more.
entries.literal: "Look at how pretty it is! Now that the light has gotten a bit better, I like it even more."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I agree, it's pretty elegant-looking.
entries.literal: "I agree, it's pretty elegant-looking."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro and Sai walked in farther. However, once Akaro stopped, Sai did not.
entries.literal: "Akaro and Sai walked in farther. However, once Akaro stopped, Sai did not."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He placed himself in front of the cabinet and stared at the Sekimeiya. In the same way, everybody else just stared at him while he thought to himself.
entries.literal: "He placed himself in front of the cabinet and stared at the Sekimeiya. In the same way, everybody else just stared at him while he thought to himself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, with the same neutral expression, he scrolled the glass down.
entries.literal: "Then, with the same neutral expression, he scrolled the glass down."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What are you doing...?
entries.literal: "What are you doing...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of responding, he reached to touch the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Instead of responding, he reached to touch the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Or that's what I first thought. Instead, he grabbed it and took it out of the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Or that's what I first thought. Instead, he grabbed it and took it out of the cabinet."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hey, what's up with you!? Didn't Katei say not to take it out!?
entries.literal: "Hey, what's up with you!? Didn't Katei say not to take it out!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I guess he did. However, right now, he's in the security room doing God knows what.
entries.literal: "I guess he did. However, right now, he's in the security room doing God knows what."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...What are you trying to do?
entries.literal: "...What are you trying to do?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla extended her arm and let out a charming "Can I have it?"
entries.literal: "Isla extended her arm and let out a charming \"Can I have it?\""

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, of course, here.
entries.literal: "Yeah, of course, here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the camera in the upper right corner and saw the flickering green light. After handing Ashiya's precious gem to the nine-year-old, Sai answered Akaro.
entries.literal: "I looked at the camera in the upper right corner and saw the flickering green light. After handing Ashiya's precious gem to the nine-year-old, Sai answered Akaro."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I was just considering that what Katei said earlier might've been false. Just in case he's not been the most sincere person.
entries.literal: "I was just considering that what Katei said earlier might've been false. Just in case he's not been the most sincere person."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What part of it?
entries.literal: "What part of it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm talking about when he said that the Sekimeiya has to be kept in a cold place.
entries.literal: "I'm talking about when he said that the Sekimeiya has to be kept in a cold place."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm just floating the possibility of him saying it to scare us into not taking it out.
entries.literal: "I'm just floating the possibility of him saying it to scare us into not taking it out."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Why would he lie like that? And really, why else would the cabinet be refrigerated other than because it's beneficial for the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Why would he lie like that? And really, why else would the cabinet be refrigerated other than because it's beneficial for the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why would he lie? I just told you: so that we keep it in the cabinet. Keeping this thing cold might be "beneficial", but he made it sound essential.
entries.literal: "Why would he lie? I just told you: so that we keep it in the cabinet. Keeping this thing cold might be \"beneficial\", but he made it sound essential."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...And look.
entries.literal: "...And look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai pointed at Isla, who looked to be enjoying her time despite the serious situation. She was clearly delighted at being able to hold the Sekimeiya, something she would never have been able to do under normal circumstances.
entries.literal: "Sai pointed at Isla, who looked to be enjoying her time despite the serious situation. She was clearly delighted at being able to hold the Sekimeiya, something she would never have been able to do under normal circumstances."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right now, the Sekimeiya looks perfectly fine to me, yet it's not inside a cabinet that provides it a very low temperature. Curious, isn't it?
entries.literal: "Right now, the Sekimeiya looks perfectly fine to me, yet it's not inside a cabinet that provides it a very low temperature. Curious, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You don't know how the temperature might damage it. It could slowly crack it, which would be very bad. Its strongest point is how smooth it is... Right, Isla?
entries.literal: "You don't know how the temperature might damage it. It could slowly crack it, which would be very bad. Its strongest point is how smooth it is... Right, Isla?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla nodded strongly. She definitely agreed, as she wouldn't stop fiddling with it.
entries.literal: "Isla nodded strongly. She definitely agreed, as she wouldn't stop fiddling with it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right. I was just testing what would happen.
entries.literal: "You're right. I was just testing what would happen."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What if the Sekimeiya melted after getting it out? Do you know the consequences that would follow!?
entries.literal: "What if the Sekimeiya melted after getting it out? Do you know the consequences that would follow!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then Katei would've been telling the truth. Right now, the Sekimeiya looks perfectly normal to me, and it's not like Katei told us exactly what a higher temperature would do. He was just "told" a low one was needed.
entries.literal: "Then Katei would've been telling the truth. Right now, the Sekimeiya looks perfectly normal to me, and it's not like Katei told us exactly what a higher temperature would do. He was just \"told\" a low one was needed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't worry, though. If it had melted, we all would've said that he'd forgotten to warn us and they would've busted his ass.
entries.literal: "Don't worry, though. If it had melted, we all would've said that he'd forgotten to warn us and they would've busted his ass."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't think that's something Katei made up. Naomi also said something similar.
entries.literal: "I don't think that's something Katei made up. Naomi also said something similar."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if he'd been summoned, Katei appeared behind the open door.
entries.literal: "As if he'd been summoned, Katei appeared behind the open door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, plenty aware of impending trouble, instinctively hid the Sekimeiya behind her back. But she wasn't fast enough.
entries.literal: "Isla, plenty aware of impending trouble, instinctively hid the Sekimeiya behind her back. But she wasn't fast enough."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What are you guys doing here...? Why is the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet!?
entries.literal: "What are you guys doing here...? Why is the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Rather, what were you doing in the security room? Did you find a way to restore the security system or contact the outside again?
entries.literal: "Rather, what were you doing in the security room? Did you find a way to restore the security system or contact the outside again?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...No. Nothing worked. I did undo some effects of the alarm, though. The elevator is now functioning, and proper illumination has been restored.
entries.literal: "...No. Nothing worked. I did undo some effects of the alarm, though. The elevator is now functioning, and proper illumination has been restored."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sounds great.
entries.literal: "Sounds great."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What do you mean, "sounds great"!? Why did you get the Sekimeiya out!? I told you how important it is not to remove it from the cabinet!
entries.literal: "What do you mean, \"sounds great\"!? Why did you get the Sekimeiya out!? I told you how important it is not to remove it from the cabinet!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei, who looked and probably was rightfully angry, walked forward and forcefully took the Sekimeiya out of Isla's hands. She gave him a blank, depressing look in response.
entries.literal: "Katei, who looked and probably was rightfully angry, walked forward and forcefully took the Sekimeiya out of Isla's hands. She gave him a blank, depressing look in response."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Important why? What is the higher temperature gonna do? It looks perfectly fine to me.{w} Don't tell me: it's a real egg, right? It must be kept cold so it doesn't hatch.
entries.literal: "Important why? What is the higher temperature gonna do? It looks perfectly fine to me.{w} Don't tell me: it's a real egg, right? It must be kept cold so it doesn't hatch."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Listen, kid. I know you might find this a boring situation and you're trying to stay entertained. However, you should understand how serious this is.
entries.literal: "Listen, kid. I know you might find this a boring situation and you're trying to stay entertained. However, you should understand how serious this is."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed Katei had correctly assumed that the whole thing was Sai's idea.
entries.literal: "It seemed Katei had correctly assumed that the whole thing was Sai's idea."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know what the effects will be. I don't know if they'll happen immediately, but I know one thing. I know that my superiors told me that no matter the circumstances, the Sekimeiya could never be taken out of this cabinet, and that while they were saying it, their eyes were as serious as they could've been.
entries.literal: "I don't know what the effects will be. I don't know if they'll happen immediately, but I know one thing. I know that my superiors told me that no matter the circumstances, the Sekimeiya could never be taken out of this cabinet, and that while they were saying it, their eyes were as serious as they could've been."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The cameras here are disabled, so I'm sure you think you can do as you please without facing consequences. For your own good, or for our entire good, rather, do not think of doing this again.
entries.literal: "The cameras here are disabled, so I'm sure you think you can do as you please without facing consequences. For your own good, or for our entire good, rather, do not think of doing this again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei placed the Sekimeiya back in the cabinet, shut the glass and the curtain, and looked into Sai's eyes as he finished.
entries.literal: "Katei placed the Sekimeiya back in the cabinet, shut the glass and the curtain, and looked into Sai's eyes as he finished."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai kept staring back, unfazed, but his expression had slightly changed.
entries.literal: "Sai kept staring back, unfazed, but his expression had slightly changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I had to guess what he was thinking... It was probably something along the lines of "You're one hell of an actor."
entries.literal: "If I had to guess what he was thinking... It was probably something along the lines of \"You're one hell of an actor.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, to me, it didn't look like Katei was lying. I didn't rule it out, but I could believe he was very worried the orders he'd been given wouldn't be followed, foreseeing the punishment he'd be dealt by the Ashiya family.
entries.literal: "However, to me, it didn't look like Katei was lying. I didn't rule it out, but I could believe he was very worried the orders he'd been given wouldn't be followed, foreseeing the punishment he'd be dealt by the Ashiya family."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, sure.
entries.literal: "Yeah, sure."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know why you don't seem able to believe me. I can't tell you everything, but if it's going to make you feel better, I can tell you all that I know about the Sekimeiya. Maybe I can earn your trust like this.
entries.literal: "I don't know why you don't seem able to believe me. I can't tell you everything, but if it's going to make you feel better, I can tell you all that I know about the Sekimeiya. Maybe I can earn your trust like this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't only look at Sai, but also at the rest of us. Suddenly, he seemed very serious about proving his sincerity. Perhaps he felt that everybody had been suspecting him in some way.
entries.literal: "He didn't only look at Sai, but also at the rest of us. Suddenly, he seemed very serious about proving his sincerity. Perhaps he felt that everybody had been suspecting him in some way."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Again, I was told about this very briefly and only to have the needed context as part of the security staff. I can't elaborate much on it, but given all that Suripo said, it's probably fine if I tell you the basic outline I know.
entries.literal: "Again, I was told about this very briefly and only to have the needed context as part of the security staff. I can't elaborate much on it, but given all that Suripo said, it's probably fine if I tell you the basic outline I know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of saying anything, everybody stayed silent, intrigued by whatever Katei could have to say.
entries.literal: "Instead of saying anything, everybody stayed silent, intrigued by whatever Katei could have to say."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...As you all already know, the Sekimeiya was no more than bait for Xyn. After the last time the tower was attacked, on the 24th of November, Ashiya began to look for something they could use.
entries.literal: "...As you all already know, the Sekimeiya was no more than bait for Xyn. After the last time the tower was attacked, on the 24th of November, Ashiya began to look for something they could use."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yushibana is now full of people who dedicate their lives to gemstone location and extraction. The number of them increased exponentially when the tower's opening informed people of the valuable gems in the nearby mountains.
entries.literal: "Yushibana is now full of people who dedicate their lives to gemstone location and extraction. The number of them increased exponentially when the tower's opening informed people of the valuable gems in the nearby mountains."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: For many people, going and finding these all around the mountains became a successful gamble. The Sekimeiya was found by a single person who did just that, on the 27th of November.
entries.literal: "For many people, going and finding these all around the mountains became a successful gamble. The Sekimeiya was found by a single person who did just that, on the 27th of November."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Another common practice upon finding a rare or valuable gem is informing the Ashiya family with hopes that they'll be interested in it. For this reason, we were the first ones to be informed of the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Another common practice upon finding a rare or valuable gem is informing the Ashiya family with hopes that they'll be interested in it. For this reason, we were the first ones to be informed of the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: A unique-looking gemstone worked perfectly for Ashiya. Regardless of its actual value, it did look special, so that was enough to work as the bait they needed.
entries.literal: "A unique-looking gemstone worked perfectly for Ashiya. Regardless of its actual value, it did look special, so that was enough to work as the bait they needed."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: After paying the original discoverer for the Sekimeiya and their silence, they purposely touted the Sekimeiya's value as hard as they could. The first mention of the Sekimeiya by that name was made on the 29th, as you probably know. Ashiya told everyone who would listen they were in possession of something incredibly rare and that it'd be shown today, on the 15th of December.
entries.literal: "After paying the original discoverer for the Sekimeiya and their silence, they purposely touted the Sekimeiya's value as hard as they could. The first mention of the Sekimeiya by that name was made on the 29th, as you probably know. Ashiya told everyone who would listen they were in possession of something incredibly rare and that it'd be shown today, on the 15th of December."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Every night until today, we've been expecting Xyn's attack.{w} Everyone was led to think Ashiya had their rarest find in a while, so as Suripo said earlier, regardless of its actual initial worth, after all the publicity, the Sekimeiya was incredibly valuable for Xyn.
entries.literal: "Every night until today, we've been expecting Xyn's attack.{w} Everyone was led to think Ashiya had their rarest find in a while, so as Suripo said earlier, regardless of its actual initial worth, after all the publicity, the Sekimeiya was incredibly valuable for Xyn."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We sold many tickets for today's event—you all saw how far the line of people extended in the lobby. Despite realizing Xyn could pass up on the bait, Ashiya still went with the option of letting the Sekimeiya they'd praised nonstop be seen.
entries.literal: "We sold many tickets for today's event—you all saw how far the line of people extended in the lobby. Despite realizing Xyn could pass up on the bait, Ashiya still went with the option of letting the Sekimeiya they'd praised nonstop be seen."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Naomi was instructed to give out a bunch of made-up facts about it and its worth during her guided visit to try to justify all the hype. To add interaction and lengthen the visit time, the visitors were going to touch its surface, but only inside the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Naomi was instructed to give out a bunch of made-up facts about it and its worth during her guided visit to try to justify all the hype. To add interaction and lengthen the visit time, the visitors were going to touch its surface, but only inside the cabinet."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: To tell you guys the truth, Xyn did actually attempt to steal the Sekimeiya once. Suripo had no reason to inform you of this, but almost as soon as its existence was announced, Xyn made a move for it.
entries.literal: "To tell you guys the truth, Xyn did actually attempt to steal the Sekimeiya once. Suripo had no reason to inform you of this, but almost as soon as its existence was announced, Xyn made a move for it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: As you can see, their plan ended in failure. We even came close to catching someone from Xyn for the first time, but they were able to escape. This was almost Ashiya's success, but this information was never published even though it would've been seen as Xyn's first failure.
entries.literal: "As you can see, their plan ended in failure. We even came close to catching someone from Xyn for the first time, but they were able to escape. This was almost Ashiya's success, but this information was never published even though it would've been seen as Xyn's first failure."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The reason was that they wanted to keep up the charade and put the plan in motion to catch Xyn for real. The Sekimeiya wasn't in this building yet, so the mechanism we had designed wasn't activated.
entries.literal: "The reason was that they wanted to keep up the charade and put the plan in motion to catch Xyn for real. The Sekimeiya wasn't in this building yet, so the mechanism we had designed wasn't activated."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Additionally, even though Xyn were the ones to try to steal it, Ashiya had no way to prove it. Since the circumstances were unusual and everyone knew they wanted to crush Xyn, people could've thought they'd made it all up, as no one had actually been apprehended.
entries.literal: "Additionally, even though Xyn were the ones to try to steal it, Ashiya had no way to prove it. Since the circumstances were unusual and everyone knew they wanted to crush Xyn, people could've thought they'd made it all up, as no one had actually been apprehended."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's all I can say about this. Now, the cold temperature rule was not something Ashiya realized, but something the seller instructed. They said that it had to always be kept chilled to preserve it based on their own experience.
entries.literal: "That's all I can say about this. Now, the cold temperature rule was not something Ashiya realized, but something the seller instructed. They said that it had to always be kept chilled to preserve it based on their own experience."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The fact they knew that putting it under a higher temperature could damage it implies they did so at one point and noticed the damaging effects. However, as Sai said, after you all took it out for a bit, it still seemed to be fine. They probably did the same and found out that leaving it for longer could be harmful.
entries.literal: "The fact they knew that putting it under a higher temperature could damage it implies they did so at one point and noticed the damaging effects. However, as Sai said, after you all took it out for a bit, it still seemed to be fine. They probably did the same and found out that leaving it for longer could be harmful."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Ashiya did not particularly care, so they naturally accepted and followed that single rule without much of a concern. Ashiya already had this cabinet, alongside others that also possess temperature functions, so it was a convenient place to keep it after stylizing it a little.
entries.literal: "Ashiya did not particularly care, so they naturally accepted and followed that single rule without much of a concern. Ashiya already had this cabinet, alongside others that also possess temperature functions, so it was a convenient place to keep it after stylizing it a little."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Since it was found pretty high up on the mountains behind the tower, the temperature there was already very low. At their request, the location where it was found was revealed to Ashiya.
entries.literal: "Since it was found pretty high up on the mountains behind the tower, the temperature there was already very low. At their request, the location where it was found was revealed to Ashiya."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: A vast mountain range surrounds Yushibana, which I'm sure you see daily. On Airun, a mountain close to this building, there is a little upward path that was much more visible a few years ago.{w} That part of the range has almost been abandoned. Over time, many fewer gemstones have been found on Airun than the others.
entries.literal: "A vast mountain range surrounds Yushibana, which I'm sure you see daily. On Airun, a mountain close to this building, there is a little upward path that was much more visible a few years ago.{w} That part of the range has almost been abandoned. Over time, many fewer gemstones have been found on Airun than the others."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Eventually, up that mountain is a small field that's pretty well-hidden. It's not easy to spot, and you have to deviate onto a smaller path. All I was told was that it's fairly tucked away.
entries.literal: "Eventually, up that mountain is a small field that's pretty well-hidden. It's not easy to spot, and you have to deviate onto a smaller path. All I was told was that it's fairly tucked away."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's where this was found.
entries.literal: "That's where this was found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei pointed at the cabinet.{w} That was all interesting and consistent with what we knew, but my mind had gone someplace else.
entries.literal: "Katei pointed at the cabinet.{w} That was all interesting and consistent with what we knew, but my mind had gone someplace else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I expected, when I looked at Shiroya, she was already looking at me. It seemed she'd thought the same thing.
entries.literal: "As I expected, when I looked at Shiroya, she was already looking at me. It seemed she'd thought the same thing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Bizarre as it sounded, the location Katei had just described matched perfectly with the place where we used to play as kids. Past that grassy terrain, there used to be a cabin she and I would frequently visit.
entries.literal: "Bizarre as it sounded, the location Katei had just described matched perfectly with the place where we used to play as kids. Past that grassy terrain, there used to be a cabin she and I would frequently visit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the same mountain, the same narrow path, and maybe the same plain and grassy field which were covered by snow.
entries.literal: "It was the same mountain, the same narrow path, and maybe the same plain and grassy field which were covered by snow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed pointless to think much of it; we hadn't been there for more than a decade, but back in the day, it was the perfect hidden place for us to go spend our time.{w} Not once had we seen anyone else there, but eventually, going to the mountains just to play was seen as rude by the people who tried to make a daily living on them.
entries.literal: "It seemed pointless to think much of it; we hadn't been there for more than a decade, but back in the day, it was the perfect hidden place for us to go spend our time.{w} Not once had we seen anyone else there, but eventually, going to the mountains just to play was seen as rude by the people who tried to make a daily living on them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Admittedly, we also didn't want to have anything to do with the strangers on the mountain, which decreased the frequency of our visits until we finally stopped going altogether. The final visit was something we hadn't even realized was final.
entries.literal: "Admittedly, we also didn't want to have anything to do with the strangers on the mountain, which decreased the frequency of our visits until we finally stopped going altogether. The final visit was something we hadn't even realized was final."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Do you remember?
entries.literal: "...Do you remember?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, of course. I'm not sure the place is the same, but thinking back on those times makes me happy.
entries.literal: "Yeah, of course. I'm not sure the place is the same, but thinking back on those times makes me happy."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're right. We used to have a lot of fun there.
entries.literal: "You're right. We used to have a lot of fun there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Reminiscing evoked a very particular feeling within me. When the weather was ideal, we would spend entire afternoons in our unreachable hidden place, playing all sorts of different games. We brought things from home every day we went to make it ours.
entries.literal: "Reminiscing evoked a very particular feeling within me. When the weather was ideal, we would spend entire afternoons in our unreachable hidden place, playing all sorts of different games. We brought things from home every day we went to make it ours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though if you were to look at Shiroya, you might not have believed it, her usual self was a very cheerful one, so remembering some of those early memories was bittersweet.
entries.literal: "Even though if you were to look at Shiroya, you might not have believed it, her usual self was a very cheerful one, so remembering some of those early memories was bittersweet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the other hand, after I looked at her... She was smiling, and wore an expression that had lately disappeared from her face. The memories we shared from that time were very special.
entries.literal: "On the other hand, after I looked at her... She was smiling, and wore an expression that had lately disappeared from her face. The memories we shared from that time were very special."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter what I'd tried to say, I hadn't been able to cheer her up. That might've been the first time in two weeks she'd clearly reacted positively to anything, and I probably knew why.
entries.literal: "No matter what I'd tried to say, I hadn't been able to cheer her up. That might've been the first time in two weeks she'd clearly reacted positively to anything, and I probably knew why."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those memories were so old that Miiya had not yet appeared in our lives. That was why Shiroya was able to think about them without sparking the negative reactions that obfuscated everything else.
entries.literal: "Those memories were so old that Miiya had not yet appeared in our lives. That was why Shiroya was able to think about them without sparking the negative reactions that obfuscated everything else."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe we should go back one day and see what it looks like now.
entries.literal: "Maybe we should go back one day and see what it looks like now."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah... That is a good idea.
entries.literal: "Yeah... That is a good idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though her smile had slightly faded, she seemed to genuinely mean that. It was reassuring to hear, and it made me trust that everything would eventually get better.
entries.literal: "Even though her smile had slightly faded, she seemed to genuinely mean that. It was reassuring to hear, and it made me trust that everything would eventually get better."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei had continued talking while I'd been digging up old memories, but he'd only gone back over his previous points.
entries.literal: "Katei had continued talking while I'd been digging up old memories, but he'd only gone back over his previous points."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is all I know. It's not much, but hopefully you can at least believe me.
entries.literal: "This is all I know. It's not much, but hopefully you can at least believe me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You sure are good at coming up with stories to cover your ass. It's honestly impressive.
entries.literal: "You sure are good at coming up with stories to cover your ass. It's honestly impressive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai said that, but it didn't look like he disbelieved Katei's explanation. He was most likely referring to everything else Katei said previously with the sole intention to provoke him.
entries.literal: "Sai said that, but it didn't look like he disbelieved Katei's explanation. He was most likely referring to everything else Katei said previously with the sole intention to provoke him."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: If that didn't please you, there's not much else I can say. This was probably more than I am allowed to, actually.
entries.literal: "If that didn't please you, there's not much else I can say. This was probably more than I am allowed to, actually."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Ah. I see.
entries.literal: "Ah. I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though I could've seen Sai's playful behavior as intriguing earlier, it had become off-putting. After shifting my thoughts to some of my childhood memories, the thought of getting out of the tower was much more appealing.
entries.literal: "Even though I could've seen Sai's playful behavior as intriguing earlier, it had become off-putting. After shifting my thoughts to some of my childhood memories, the thought of getting out of the tower was much more appealing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finding out who was responsible for the attack was a goal, but as long as the police had some way to recover the camera footage, they could handle that. They could have already captured the person responsible for all we knew. Ashiya's compensation was certainly a nice thought to keep in mind, too.
entries.literal: "Finding out who was responsible for the attack was a goal, but as long as the police had some way to recover the camera footage, they could handle that. They could have already captured the person responsible for all we knew. Ashiya's compensation was certainly a nice thought to keep in mind, too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was more important to keep an eye out for anyone doing anything suspicious and nail them once we got out than constantly and baselessly accuse anyone in the vicinity like Sai seemed to want to.
entries.literal: "It was more important to keep an eye out for anyone doing anything suspicious and nail them once we got out than constantly and baselessly accuse anyone in the vicinity like Sai seemed to want to."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Anyway... weren't you all supposed to be investigating the building? I think it's time for that. We keep repeating this, but Naomi's disappearance gets weirder by the second.
entries.literal: "Anyway... weren't you all supposed to be investigating the building? I think it's time for that. We keep repeating this, but Naomi's disappearance gets weirder by the second."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, we should go.
entries.literal: "Yeah, we should go."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I agree. Let's look through this floor first; it's where she was when the smoke appeared, and it has plenty of disabled cameras.
entries.literal: "I agree. Let's look through this floor first; it's where she was when the smoke appeared, and it has plenty of disabled cameras."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We made our way to hallway A. Finally starting to inspect the huge building was an imposing task.{w} A lot of time had already passed, so I had no idea what to think of Naomi's disappearance. She was either incapable of reaching us... or didn't want to.
entries.literal: "We made our way to hallway A. Finally starting to inspect the huge building was an imposing task.{w} A lot of time had already passed, so I had no idea what to think of Naomi's disappearance. She was either incapable of reaching us... or didn't want to."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: How do we do it? Do we split up?
entries.literal: "How do we do it? Do we split up?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No. Let's make the situation clear first. Funny things can happen later.
entries.literal: "No. Let's make the situation clear first. Funny things can happen later."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's enter every room in this hallway and then move on to the other one. After we're done with this floor, we'll move up one at a time.
entries.literal: "Let's enter every room in this hallway and then move on to the other one. After we're done with this floor, we'll move up one at a time."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yeah. Let's begin there.
entries.literal: "Yeah. Let's begin there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina looked at the crystal room in front of the security room. It was the one labeled "A1" on the map.
entries.literal: "Erina looked at the crystal room in front of the security room. It was the one labeled \"A1\" on the map."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Given the floor's layout, if there was someone who wanted to avoid being seen, as long as we didn't split up, they could easily achieve that.
entries.literal: "Given the floor's layout, if there was someone who wanted to avoid being seen, as long as we didn't split up, they could easily achieve that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were three different ways to make it from one hallway to the other, so we would never be able to rule out a sneaky moving culprit.
entries.literal: "There were three different ways to make it from one hallway to the other, so we would never be able to rule out a sneaky moving culprit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Taking that same possibility in mind, though, the thought of splitting up was distressing. It was better to investigate together and hope that wouldn't happen.
entries.literal: "Taking that same possibility in mind, though, the thought of splitting up was distressing. It was better to investigate together and hope that wouldn't happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were in front of the room we'd start with. Katei opened it, and yet again, I felt the same recurring sensation of stepping into a different world.
entries.literal: "We were in front of the room we'd start with. Katei opened it, and yet again, I felt the same recurring sensation of stepping into a different world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A clean floor, walls, and ceiling awaited us. Just like in the room I'd looked at, there were many cabinets, presumably displaying different kinds of valuable gemstones.
entries.literal: "A clean floor, walls, and ceiling awaited us. Just like in the room I'd looked at, there were many cabinets, presumably displaying different kinds of valuable gemstones."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Why are they covered?
entries.literal: "Why are they covered?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Isla said, the interior of the cabinets wasn't visible. Velvet curtains, as pretty as the Sekimeiya's had once been, were neatly placed over all of them.
entries.literal: "As Isla said, the interior of the cabinets wasn't visible. Velvet curtains, as pretty as the Sekimeiya's had once been, were neatly placed over all of them."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, yes, this is something that we do every morning. Except on Sundays, when the tower is closed.
entries.literal: "Oh, yes, this is something that we do every morning. Except on Sundays, when the tower is closed."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: While at {time=9:00}, the floor opens to the public, it isn't until {time=9:10} that the showcase cabinets are uncovered. This is purely done for dramatic effect and, honestly, to give the visitors the impression that they're about to witness something very valuable.
entries.literal: "While at {time=9:00}, the floor opens to the public, it isn't until {time=9:10} that the showcase cabinets are uncovered. This is purely done for dramatic effect and, honestly, to give the visitors the impression that they're about to witness something very valuable."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh... Can I?
entries.literal: "Oh... Can I?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yeah, of course. Let me raise them for you.
entries.literal: "Yeah, of course. Let me raise them for you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the same manner that Katei might've seen it done daily through the cameras, he carefully rolled up every curtain, letting us see what they were hiding.
entries.literal: "In the same manner that Katei might've seen it done daily through the cameras, he carefully rolled up every curtain, letting us see what they were hiding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As amazed as a little girl trapped in a building could be, Isla lit up while Katei uncovered the next mysterious interior.
entries.literal: "As amazed as a little girl trapped in a building could be, Isla lit up while Katei uncovered the next mysterious interior."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai gave it a similar look, one I couldn't help but question.
entries.literal: "Sai gave it a similar look, one I couldn't help but question."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cabinets in those rooms were different from the Sekimeiya's. They were lower to the ground, and on top of them was a screen of glass that sheltered the gemstones.
entries.literal: "The cabinets in those rooms were different from the Sekimeiya's. They were lower to the ground, and on top of them was a screen of glass that sheltered the gemstones."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Wow, look at this black one, Mom! Isn't it pretty? I love it.
entries.literal: "Wow, look at this black one, Mom! Isn't it pretty? I love it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's quite pretty. I wish I could wear it as a necklace.
entries.literal: "It's quite pretty. I wish I could wear it as a necklace."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If nothing else, it was good that Erina treated Isla as if they were in a normal visit, letting her feel comfortable.
entries.literal: "If nothing else, it was good that Erina treated Isla as if they were in a normal visit, letting her feel comfortable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shortly, Katei finished with every cabinet.{w} They had all contained gemstones of different shapes and tones. Some also had a brief explanation below them, detailing where they'd been found along with the name of who'd found them. Most were discovered in the mountains I was used to seeing in the background of Yushibana.
entries.literal: "Shortly, Katei finished with every cabinet.{w} They had all contained gemstones of different shapes and tones. Some also had a brief explanation below them, detailing where they'd been found along with the name of who'd found them. Most were discovered in the mountains I was used to seeing in the background of Yushibana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite the events and my lack of interest, I spent some time looking at each one, immersing myself in them without noticing it. Everyone else did the same, drawn into Isla's rhythm briefly.
entries.literal: "Despite the events and my lack of interest, I spent some time looking at each one, immersing myself in them without noticing it. Everyone else did the same, drawn into Isla's rhythm briefly."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Do you like this one?
entries.literal: "Do you like this one?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya was pointing at a tiny, light blue jewel with round white marks on its smooth surface. She'd said it because I'd been looking at it for a while, and she knew that shade of blue was my favorite color.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was pointing at a tiny, light blue jewel with round white marks on its smooth surface. She'd said it because I'd been looking at it for a while, and she knew that shade of blue was my favorite color."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I really do. I wouldn't mind going to the mountains someday if I can manage to find one like this.
entries.literal: "I really do. I wouldn't mind going to the mountains someday if I can manage to find one like this."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm sure it wouldn't be easy, but it'd be worth the effort.
entries.literal: "I'm sure it wouldn't be easy, but it'd be worth the effort."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After talking about going back to our personal playground, I started to really look forward to the time where we'd visit it again, spending a day trying to find a gem as pretty as that one.
entries.literal: "After talking about going back to our personal playground, I started to really look forward to the time where we'd visit it again, spending a day trying to find a gem as pretty as that one."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Can I see it again, Tanya?
entries.literal: "Can I see it again, Tanya?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Huh? Are you talking to me?
entries.literal: "...Huh? Are you talking to me?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes! Can I see your pendant?
entries.literal: "Yes! Can I see your pendant?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A bit confused, Shiroya took it out.
entries.literal: "A bit confused, Shiroya took it out."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I knew it! It's even prettier than everything here!
entries.literal: "I knew it! It's even prettier than everything here!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...What's with that name, though?
entries.literal: "...What's with that name, though?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm? Tanya? That's you! It's for tanzanite.
entries.literal: "Hm? Tanya? That's you! It's for tanzanite."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, I see.
entries.literal: "Oh, I see."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'll admit I'm a bit fascinated by these myself.
entries.literal: "I'll admit I'm a bit fascinated by these myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's voice sounded from behind us as he peeked over my shoulder.
entries.literal: "Sai's voice sounded from behind us as he peeked over my shoulder."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I came here of my own volition, after all. We shouldn't spend so much time doing this in the next rooms, though. We have other priorities.
entries.literal: "I came here of my own volition, after all. We shouldn't spend so much time doing this in the next rooms, though. We have other priorities."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. Sorry, Isla, but once we're done, we'll have more than enough time to revisit every room.
entries.literal: "Yes. Sorry, Isla, but once we're done, we'll have more than enough time to revisit every room."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm. You'll still let me see them though, right?
entries.literal: "Hm. You'll still let me see them though, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yeah. We'll briefly look over them.
entries.literal: "Yeah. We'll briefly look over them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We moved on to the next room, which looked almost identical.
entries.literal: "We moved on to the next room, which looked almost identical."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The same procedure was repeated: Katei uncovered every cabinet, and Isla had a few seconds to appreciate all of their contents.
entries.literal: "The same procedure was repeated: Katei uncovered every cabinet, and Isla had a few seconds to appreciate all of their contents."

entries.text: Undercurrent
entries.literal: "Undercurrent"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After we finished with it, Akaro spoke.
entries.literal: "After we finished with it, Akaro spoke."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Do we really have to look at the inside of every cabinet? It's only slowing us down.
entries.literal: "Do we really have to look at the inside of every cabinet? It's only slowing us down."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. It doesn't take up a lot of time, and remember what Suripo said. He mentioned some gems on this floor had been stolen. We need to find that room and see if there's something to find there.
entries.literal: "Yes. It doesn't take up a lot of time, and remember what Suripo said. He mentioned some gems on this floor had been stolen. We need to find that room and see if there's something to find there."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, yes, that's true. He said it happened in one of the farther back rooms.
entries.literal: "Oh, yes, that's true. He said it happened in one of the farther back rooms."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're right... I'd forgotten about that, but it still sounds very weird to me. What do these gems have to do with anything? It sounded like Ashiya have already assumed those gems were the target, which feels off considering nobody even knows how they were brought outside.
entries.literal: "You're right... I'd forgotten about that, but it still sounds very weird to me. What do these gems have to do with anything? It sounded like Ashiya have already assumed those gems were the target, which feels off considering nobody even knows how they were brought outside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You mean to say they were probably a measure to distract, right?
entries.literal: "You mean to say they were probably a measure to distract, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I agree. If this supposed theft is over or already failed, it could be that some kind of trick was used to get the gems outside and make Ashiya think they were the goal. Once their guard is lowered, steal the actual target: the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I agree. If this supposed theft is over or already failed, it could be that some kind of trick was used to get the gems outside and make Ashiya think they were the goal. Once their guard is lowered, steal the actual target: the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, something like that, even though I can't really visualize how the plan would work.
entries.literal: "Yeah, something like that, even though I can't really visualize how the plan would work."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Before you assume that, there's something else to consider in opposition.
entries.literal: "Before you assume that, there's something else to consider in opposition."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...What would that be?
entries.literal: "...What would that be?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well... the two side hallways and the event room were put out of commission with the smoke. If the gems were the goal, it could be assumed that the event room was, for some reason, only attacked because it's the only way to go from the middle of one hallway to the other.
entries.literal: "Well... the two side hallways and the event room were put out of commission with the smoke. If the gems were the goal, it could be assumed that the event room was, for some reason, only attacked because it's the only way to go from the middle of one hallway to the other."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: However, that has a flaw. Even though the smoke certainly disabled the security cameras, the room those gems were stolen from wasn't ever subjected to the smoke, according to what Katei told us.
entries.literal: "However, that has a flaw. Even though the smoke certainly disabled the security cameras, the room those gems were stolen from wasn't ever subjected to the smoke, according to what Katei told us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's weird, don't you think? It outright implies that the room's security camera was never a factor they took into consideration. So, if that were the case, why did they disable all the others?
entries.literal: "That's weird, don't you think? It outright implies that the room's security camera was never a factor they took into consideration. So, if that were the case, why did they disable all the others?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What I mean to say is that the robbery of those gems could've been executed without needing to release smoke in the event room, and the substance to cover the lenses of the security cameras wouldn't have been needed.
entries.literal: "What I mean to say is that the robbery of those gems could've been executed without needing to release smoke in the event room, and the substance to cover the lenses of the security cameras wouldn't have been needed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If being spotted by the security cameras in the room of the robbery wasn't an issue, it means the only other goal of the smoke was to provide a clear route to the outside. The event room and the opposite hallway wouldn't have been needed, and there would be no point in disabling the cameras. This immediately indicates that the gems were never the goal, which shatters any illusion with them.
entries.literal: "If being spotted by the security cameras in the room of the robbery wasn't an issue, it means the only other goal of the smoke was to provide a clear route to the outside. The event room and the opposite hallway wouldn't have been needed, and there would be no point in disabling the cameras. This immediately indicates that the gems were never the goal, which shatters any illusion with them."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe you're right... If they were the goal, only one hallway and that very room would've been attacked.
entries.literal: "Maybe you're right... If they were the goal, only one hallway and that very room would've been attacked."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And you also can't assume the smoke was released to make everyone nearby fall unconscious because not all the rooms where people could've been were attacked.
entries.literal: "And you also can't assume the smoke was released to make everyone nearby fall unconscious because not all the rooms where people could've been were attacked."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: And yet those gems were brought outside in a suitcase before the exit closed...
entries.literal: "And yet those gems were brought outside in a suitcase before the exit closed..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, only for that person to then be arrested immediately. I can't quite figure out what the whole deal is here, especially given the Sekimeiya is still with us.
entries.literal: "Yeah, only for that person to then be arrested immediately. I can't quite figure out what the whole deal is here, especially given the Sekimeiya is still with us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The people outside think the gems were the goal and that the robbery was a failure. However, part of that relies on them not knowing the exact rooms that were covered in the smoke.{w} I'm sure more people will conclude what I'm saying once they enter the tower. If the culprit intended to use those gems as a feint, this plan is lacking.
entries.literal: "The people outside think the gems were the goal and that the robbery was a failure. However, part of that relies on them not knowing the exact rooms that were covered in the smoke.{w} I'm sure more people will conclude what I'm saying once they enter the tower. If the culprit intended to use those gems as a feint, this plan is lacking."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's no way it ends with someone sneaking the Sekimeiya out as soon as the exit opens, right? That would be beyond stupid. Not to mention that stealing the gems would be rendered useless since Ashiya would quickly notice that the Sekimeiya has been stolen too. Then, the gems would ultimately return to Ashiya, and the person who had them would be arrested.
entries.literal: "There's no way it ends with someone sneaking the Sekimeiya out as soon as the exit opens, right? That would be beyond stupid. Not to mention that stealing the gems would be rendered useless since Ashiya would quickly notice that the Sekimeiya has been stolen too. Then, the gems would ultimately return to Ashiya, and the person who had them would be arrested."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't taken those gemstones into consideration for any of my thoughts, but he was right.
entries.literal: "I hadn't taken those gemstones into consideration for any of my thoughts, but he was right."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hey, Katei. I know you brought this up earlier, but are you sure that the exit was sealed immediately after the alarm went off?
entries.literal: "Hey, Katei. I know you brought this up earlier, but are you sure that the exit was sealed immediately after the alarm went off?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Hm... While it is the first time the alarm has been activated, it's how it was programmed to work. Anything else would be pointless, really.
entries.literal: "Hm... While it is the first time the alarm has been activated, it's how it was programmed to work. Anything else would be pointless, really."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Could it have been another malfunction? I was just thinking that Naomi might have brought the gems out.
entries.literal: "Could it have been another malfunction? I was just thinking that Naomi might have brought the gems out."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Naomi? But that should be impossible, right?
entries.literal: "Naomi? But that should be impossible, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not if that malfunction actually occurred. When Suripo mentioned the person who brought them outside, he only said it had been an "individual". It could've been a woman, but I think he would've said it when we mentioned Naomi was still with us.
entries.literal: "Not if that malfunction actually occurred. When Suripo mentioned the person who brought them outside, he only said it had been an \"individual\". It could've been a woman, but I think he would've said it when we mentioned Naomi was still with us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If the alarm's effects were delayed, Suripo would've brought it up, or someone from the outside would've entered. But it is true that Naomi, who's disappeared and knows the entire layout of the tower, is a pretty good candidate to take out a bunch of gems and play this silly role of purposely getting arrested with a conspicuous suitcase.
entries.literal: "If the alarm's effects were delayed, Suripo would've brought it up, or someone from the outside would've entered. But it is true that Naomi, who's disappeared and knows the entire layout of the tower, is a pretty good candidate to take out a bunch of gems and play this silly role of purposely getting arrested with a conspicuous suitcase."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If that is what happened, targeting the event room too would make sense even if the goal was elsewhere. It was Naomi's location, and she would've needed a way to escape.
entries.literal: "If that is what happened, targeting the event room too would make sense even if the goal was elsewhere. It was Naomi's location, and she would've needed a way to escape."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're... right. I hadn't thought of this, but I'm not convinced.{w} Targeting both hallways still wouldn't make much sense, and most importantly, it implies her plan only worked because the alarm's effects got delayed; it would've been no so-called malfunction.
entries.literal: "You're... right. I hadn't thought of this, but I'm not convinced.{w} Targeting both hallways still wouldn't make much sense, and most importantly, it implies her plan only worked because the alarm's effects got delayed; it would've been no so-called malfunction."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah... Also, we still don't know what actually triggered the alarm, and while I could be wrong, it really seemed to me like Naomi did fall unconscious in our room.
entries.literal: "Yeah... Also, we still don't know what actually triggered the alarm, and while I could be wrong, it really seemed to me like Naomi did fall unconscious in our room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...{w} Remember what Suripo said? If anyone was in front of the shutter as it closed, it would've stopped. It's possible it was delayed, which gave Naomi enough time to leave even though she was in the event room when the alarm played.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} Remember what Suripo said? If anyone was in front of the shutter as it closed, it would've stopped. It's possible it was delayed, which gave Naomi enough time to leave even though she was in the event room when the alarm played."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's true, but Suripo would've told us as well.
entries.literal: "That's true, but Suripo would've told us as well."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait, no. I don't think that could've happened.
entries.literal: "Wait, no. I don't think that could've happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why not?
entries.literal: "Why not?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: When I heard the alarm, there was another sound too, much fainter. I just realized that must've been the shutter closing, because it was pretty rough and came from the lobby.{w} That means there was no delay, and there was a louder sound at the end when it hit the floor. I'm almost certain it went the whole time without stopping.
entries.literal: "When I heard the alarm, there was another sound too, much fainter. I just realized that must've been the shutter closing, because it was pretty rough and came from the lobby.{w} That means there was no delay, and there was a louder sound at the end when it hit the floor. I'm almost certain it went the whole time without stopping."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If that's true, it confirms Naomi's still here.
entries.literal: "If that's true, it confirms Naomi's still here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...Is this a key?
entries.literal: "...Is this a key?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw Shiroya staring at the floor, confused as to where to direct her gaze.
entries.literal: "I saw Shiroya staring at the floor, confused as to where to direct her gaze."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Oh, you're right. What's this doing here?
entries.literal: "...Oh, you're right. What's this doing here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we went quiet, the two people who hadn't participated in the conversation spoke.{w} They were a bit ahead of us, so we walked up to them. After focusing on the point where they were staring, we saw what Isla had found. Next to the right wall was a small, rusty key.
entries.literal: "When we went quiet, the two people who hadn't participated in the conversation spoke.{w} They were a bit ahead of us, so we walked up to them. After focusing on the point where they were staring, we saw what Isla had found. Next to the right wall was a small, rusty key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla kneeled to pick it up. Once in her hands, she showed it to us.
entries.literal: "Isla kneeled to pick it up. Once in her hands, she showed it to us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Was this on the floor?
entries.literal: "Was this on the floor?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes... I just saw it.
entries.literal: "Yes... I just saw it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's no way we've missed it until now, right?
entries.literal: "There's no way we've missed it until now, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: The color is close to the floor's, and the lighting is bad. I'd say we did since it took me a few seconds to see it.
entries.literal: "The color is close to the floor's, and the lighting is bad. I'd say we did since it took me a few seconds to see it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Really? It was right next to the event room.
entries.literal: "...Really? It was right next to the event room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: More importantly, what's it for? Do you recognize it, Katei?
entries.literal: "More importantly, what's it for? Do you recognize it, Katei?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...No. I don't think I've ever seen this key before.
entries.literal: "...No. I don't think I've ever seen this key before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei grabbed it to give it a closer look. It appeared very old and rusty; it wasn't the kind of key that would be used in a modern building.
entries.literal: "Katei grabbed it to give it a closer look. It appeared very old and rusty; it wasn't the kind of key that would be used in a modern building."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's impossible this belongs here. I know it's an old building and there are keys I don't possess, but it must be for something else.{w} Keys are not prohibited items in this tower. It's possible someone dropped it and didn't realize it.
entries.literal: "It's impossible this belongs here. I know it's an old building and there are keys I don't possess, but it must be for something else.{w} Keys are not prohibited items in this tower. It's possible someone dropped it and didn't realize it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: How would you not notice it? If you drop it here, it would make a noise when it hit the floor.
entries.literal: "How would you not notice it? If you drop it here, it would make a noise when it hit the floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: For sure. Which means that whoever dropped it knew they did and then didn't pick it back up.
entries.literal: "For sure. Which means that whoever dropped it knew they did and then didn't pick it back up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It would have been a bit ridiculous to think that it had been left purposely to indirectly pass it on to someone or something of the sort. Given what we knew had happened so far, what Sai said made a lot of sense.
entries.literal: "It would have been a bit ridiculous to think that it had been left purposely to indirectly pass it on to someone or something of the sort. Given what we knew had happened so far, what Sai said made a lot of sense."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You get what I mean, right? This key probably belonged to the culprit.
entries.literal: "You get what I mean, right? This key probably belonged to the culprit."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: As they were running against a timer that would trap them, they dropped this key. Naturally, they didn't waste time stopping to retrieve it.
entries.literal: "As they were running against a timer that would trap them, they dropped this key. Naturally, they didn't waste time stopping to retrieve it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It could be a pretty important key if it's one the culprit was holding as they were committing a crime.
entries.literal: "It could be a pretty important key if it's one the culprit was holding as they were committing a crime."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'll keep it safe and give it to the police as soon as I can.
entries.literal: "I'll keep it safe and give it to the police as soon as I can."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's a good idea.
entries.literal: "That's a good idea."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You might be jumping to conclusions again, though. It could belong to an innocent person who rushed to escape from the tower.
entries.literal: "You might be jumping to conclusions again, though. It could belong to an innocent person who rushed to escape from the tower."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You think so? I'm not sure that's possible. I've gone over this.
entries.literal: "You think so? I'm not sure that's possible. I've gone over this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why would an innocent person ever rush to escape? One reason would be if they saw smoke appearing out of nowhere. However, they would've fallen unconscious if they ran through this hallway.
entries.literal: "Why would an innocent person ever rush to escape? One reason would be if they saw smoke appearing out of nowhere. However, they would've fallen unconscious if they ran through this hallway."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The other reason would be if they heard an unknown alarm, but this can also be ruled out because the alarm blocked off the exit. Naturally, this key doesn't belong to any of us, right?
entries.literal: "The other reason would be if they heard an unknown alarm, but this can also be ruled out because the alarm blocked off the exit. Naturally, this key doesn't belong to any of us, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody answered.{w} He was saying that no innocent person aware of danger could've escaped through the hallway.
entries.literal: "Nobody answered.{w} He was saying that no innocent person aware of danger could've escaped through the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If the key didn't belong to the culprit, it had to belong to someone who'd also gotten trapped and we hadn't seen. Even Naomi didn't make sense as a candidate—I'd been with her up until the alarm had sounded.{w} If someone had fallen unconscious there, they could have dropped the key and failed to realize it upon waking up. Perhaps even the sound of it falling was obscured by the alarm, but I considered it unlikely.
entries.literal: "If the key didn't belong to the culprit, it had to belong to someone who'd also gotten trapped and we hadn't seen. Even Naomi didn't make sense as a candidate—I'd been with her up until the alarm had sounded.{w} If someone had fallen unconscious there, they could have dropped the key and failed to realize it upon waking up. Perhaps even the sound of it falling was obscured by the alarm, but I considered it unlikely."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I doubt this was here before the attack. There was a janitor cleaning the floor in the lobby, so I'm sure these hallways were cleaned today too.
entries.literal: "I doubt this was here before the attack. There was a janitor cleaning the floor in the lobby, so I'm sure these hallways were cleaned today too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...On the surface, that appeared to be a very solid argument, but there was a way around it, and it involved something I'd thought before.
entries.literal: "...On the surface, that appeared to be a very solid argument, but there was a way around it, and it involved something I'd thought before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We didn't know for a fact the smoke in hallway A had been released at the same time as in the other two places. There was no reason to believe it hadn't been, but it also would've allowed one of Katei's claims be the truth.{w} One part of me wanted to directly ask Katei, but I held off.
entries.literal: "We didn't know for a fact the smoke in hallway A had been released at the same time as in the other two places. There was no reason to believe it hadn't been, but it also would've allowed one of Katei's claims be the truth.{w} One part of me wanted to directly ask Katei, but I held off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If someone had heard yells coming from the lobby or seen smoke coming through the door of the event room, they might've rushed out without stopping to retrieve their key...{w} I recalled that I'd heard only silence when we were about to fall unconscious.
entries.literal: "If someone had heard yells coming from the lobby or seen smoke coming through the door of the event room, they might've rushed out without stopping to retrieve their key...{w} I recalled that I'd heard only silence when we were about to fall unconscious."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw Isla in front of the next door. Even though she'd found a key, she didn't seem very interested. Inspecting the contents of every cabinet was probably far more exciting for her.
entries.literal: "I saw Isla in front of the next door. Even though she'd found a key, she didn't seem very interested. Inspecting the contents of every cabinet was probably far more exciting for her."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Let's continue for now. If this was important for the culprit, it's likely they'll try to get it back, so I'll make sure to keep it safe until we get out.
entries.literal: "Let's continue for now. If this was important for the culprit, it's likely they'll try to get it back, so I'll make sure to keep it safe until we get out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We accepted that and moved on.{w} The next room was no different from the previous. Katei went ahead and began to make sure nothing had been stolen from its cabinets.
entries.literal: "We accepted that and moved on.{w} The next room was no different from the previous. Katei went ahead and began to make sure nothing had been stolen from its cabinets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai approached me while I was separated from the others. Anticipating his reason, I was first to speak.
entries.literal: "Sai approached me while I was separated from the others. Anticipating his reason, I was first to speak."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you still doubt Katei? I think he did a good job of proving his sincerity.
entries.literal: "Do you still doubt Katei? I think he did a good job of proving his sincerity."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, of course I do. I'll agree that he's pretty good at lying.
entries.literal: "Oh, of course I do. I'll agree that he's pretty good at lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You already realized he was never in the security room, right? Why are you defending him?
entries.literal: "You already realized he was never in the security room, right? Why are you defending him?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I looked at Katei. He was putting up with Isla and acting interested in the gems he'd presumably seen hundreds of times.
entries.literal: "...I looked at Katei. He was putting up with Isla and acting interested in the gems he'd presumably seen hundreds of times."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you certain he wasn't?
entries.literal: "Are you certain he wasn't?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He couldn't have been there after the alarm went off. I checked the time needed for the computer to go to sleep, and that confirmed it. The only other possibility is that he was there and lied about using the computer, but that doesn't make it any better.
entries.literal: "He couldn't have been there after the alarm went off. I checked the time needed for the computer to go to sleep, and that confirmed it. The only other possibility is that he was there and lied about using the computer, but that doesn't make it any better."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Have you considered that the computer time might not have been accurate?
entries.literal: "Have you considered that the computer time might not have been accurate?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The computer time?
entries.literal: "The computer time?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. If it was wrong, Katei could've had the time to be there without lying.
entries.literal: "Yes. If it was wrong, Katei could've had the time to be there without lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, and then lied about how much time he spent outside it.
entries.literal: "Yeah, and then lied about how much time he spent outside it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know. Maybe you're right and there's no other explanation.
entries.literal: "I know. Maybe you're right and there's no other explanation."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I have considered the computer time being wrong, and not only that.
entries.literal: "I have considered the computer time being wrong, and not only that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai raised his sleeve. Under it, there was a digital wristwatch.
entries.literal: "Sai raised his sleeve. Under it, there was a digital wristwatch."

entries.speaker: sai
