entries.text: I always wear this. It doesn't seem like there are wall clocks anywhere, so the time displayed on the computer is the only source we have available.
entries.literal: "I always wear this. It doesn't seem like there are wall clocks anywhere, so the time displayed on the computer is the only source we have available."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Besides my wristwatch, that is. My time and the computer's are the same.
entries.literal: "Besides my wristwatch, that is. My time and the computer's are the same."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see... So that can't be it either.
entries.literal: "I see... So that can't be it either."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, as I said, I didn't consider that the computer time was wrong, but rather that someone went way further than that.
entries.literal: "Well, as I said, I didn't consider that the computer time was wrong, but rather that someone went way further than that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh... I-I see what you mean. Yeah, that should be the only way out Katei has.
entries.literal: "Oh... I-I see what you mean. Yeah, that should be the only way out Katei has."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. If someone messed with my wristwatch while I was unconscious, they could've made me falsely confirm the computer's time.{w} Someone could have done that to frame Katei.{w} It's too ridiculous to consider it seriously. They'd need to know that Katei would say everything he said only to turn around and disprove it with the computer's sleep mode, risking the possibility of nobody noticing it.
entries.literal: "Yeah. If someone messed with my wristwatch while I was unconscious, they could've made me falsely confirm the computer's time.{w} Someone could have done that to frame Katei.{w} It's too ridiculous to consider it seriously. They'd need to know that Katei would say everything he said only to turn around and disprove it with the computer's sleep mode, risking the possibility of nobody noticing it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And not only that, but it's also something that only works with the people who got trapped. This wouldn't mean anything if we brought it up outside.{w} And Katei, who didn't fall unconscious, would've said the time was wrong. It would be insane for him to create a problem for himself by changing my watch time.{w} He also let us talk to Suripo, who could've mentioned the time at any moment.
entries.literal: "And not only that, but it's also something that only works with the people who got trapped. This wouldn't mean anything if we brought it up outside.{w} And Katei, who didn't fall unconscious, would've said the time was wrong. It would be insane for him to create a problem for himself by changing my watch time.{w} He also let us talk to Suripo, who could've mentioned the time at any moment."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...But why would Katei lie about being in the security room? Do you actually think he's responsible?
entries.literal: "...But why would Katei lie about being in the security room? Do you actually think he's responsible?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Or heavily involved in some way. There's no way he's not hiding anything or looking to gain something.
entries.literal: "Or heavily involved in some way. There's no way he's not hiding anything or looking to gain something."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, you don't believe his story about how the Sekimeiya was found? You were accusing him of lying about that too.
entries.literal: "So, you don't believe his story about how the Sekimeiya was found? You were accusing him of lying about that too."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, no. I do believe everything that he said there. It just gave him even more of a motive.
entries.literal: "Oh, no. I do believe everything that he said there. It just gave him even more of a motive."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I still think the Sekimeiya has to be the core of all this. That has to be right.{w} Now, don't you find it strange that a simple security member would know all that?
entries.literal: "I still think the Sekimeiya has to be the core of all this. That has to be right.{w} Now, don't you find it strange that a simple security member would know all that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He said it in a desperate time because he wanted to earn our trust, which is why he relied on factual truth to lessen our suspicion.
entries.literal: "He said it in a desperate time because he wanted to earn our trust, which is why he relied on factual truth to lessen our suspicion."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But what I think he did was change his own perspective. I'm telling you this in case you think I'm missing something, but I think all he did was merge his version with what Suripo told us to form an accurate story and pass it off as something Ashiya told him.
entries.literal: "But what I think he did was change his own perspective. I'm telling you this in case you think I'm missing something, but I think all he did was merge his version with what Suripo told us to form an accurate story and pass it off as something Ashiya told him."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't follow.
entries.literal: "I don't follow."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm saying he could be the the guy who originally found the Sekimeiya. He didn't know about what Suripo told us beforehand. Otherwise, he would've said it all to earn our trust.{w} Once he knew about Suripo's factual story, he combined his own knowledge with it to make us believe he truly works in the tower.
entries.literal: "I'm saying he could be the the guy who originally found the Sekimeiya. He didn't know about what Suripo told us beforehand. Otherwise, he would've said it all to earn our trust.{w} Once he knew about Suripo's factual story, he combined his own knowledge with it to make us believe he truly works in the tower."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The way he detailed some things was very questionable. He knew the exact location where the Sekimeiya was found, and everything he told us was information the person who found it would've known after hearing Suripo's story.
entries.literal: "The way he detailed some things was very questionable. He knew the exact location where the Sekimeiya was found, and everything he told us was information the person who found it would've known after hearing Suripo's story."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...That might be true, but it sounds like a pretty big assumption, and didn't he say the seller was already paid?
entries.literal: "...That might be true, but it sounds like a pretty big assumption, and didn't he say the seller was already paid?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'll tell you one of the theories I formed. It's all speculation, yes, but I think it could make sense given whoever's behind this already went pretty far with all the smoke.
entries.literal: "I'll tell you one of the theories I formed. It's all speculation, yes, but I think it could make sense given whoever's behind this already went pretty far with all the smoke."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I haven't told you this since it might not mean anything. You and I both showed up early and were at the front of the line for a while, in front of the hallway B door.
entries.literal: "I haven't told you this since it might not mean anything. You and I both showed up early and were at the front of the line for a while, in front of the hallway B door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right. We didn't have a way to check the time, but we were definitely there for a few hours.
entries.literal: "Right. We didn't have a way to check the time, but we were definitely there for a few hours."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right. So at approximately {time=8}, I saw Katei in the lobby. The reason why I started questioning him so quickly was because when I first saw him, he was wearing normal clothes.
entries.literal: "All right. So at approximately {time=8}, I saw Katei in the lobby. The reason why I started questioning him so quickly was because when I first saw him, he was wearing normal clothes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course, back then, I didn't think anything of it. I don't know what he did either. I just saw him for a few seconds, and I'm certain he was never actually in line.
entries.literal: "Of course, back then, I didn't think anything of it. I don't know what he did either. I just saw him for a few seconds, and I'm certain he was never actually in line."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Considering everything, I think this is one of the ways everything could've played out. Take whatever you want from it.
entries.literal: "Considering everything, I think this is one of the ways everything could've played out. Take whatever you want from it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The person claiming to be called Katei found the Sekimeiya a couple weeks ago. He contacted the Ashiya family, and given their interest, they bought it from him.
entries.literal: "The person claiming to be called Katei found the Sekimeiya a couple weeks ago. He contacted the Ashiya family, and given their interest, they bought it from him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: At no point did he expect they'd set up so much advertisement for his own find. It's possible Ashiya said things that were wrong only to draw people in, and perhaps not being credited with the discovery bothered him.
entries.literal: "At no point did he expect they'd set up so much advertisement for his own find. It's possible Ashiya said things that were wrong only to draw people in, and perhaps not being credited with the discovery bothered him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's a pretty plain motive, but think about it. If you sold it to them and they started playing up its value like crazy, would you be happy about how little you were paid? The scale of this attack is a bit much for one normal person to come up with, but things line up here.
entries.literal: "It's a pretty plain motive, but think about it. If you sold it to them and they started playing up its value like crazy, would you be happy about how little you were paid? The scale of this attack is a bit much for one normal person to come up with, but things line up here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Xyn isn't behind this, which is why it's happening during the day. He enters the tower at {time=8:00} this morning. He could have somehow met with the real Katei Kuiji and learned about the alarm and emergency contact line from him.
entries.literal: "Xyn isn't behind this, which is why it's happening during the day. He enters the tower at {time=8:00} this morning. He could have somehow met with the real Katei Kuiji and learned about the alarm and emergency contact line from him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The way he learned that information isn't important. At the very least, I know the man with us right now wasn't in the lobby shortly after I saw him. What matters is that they met and he put on Katei's clothes. Then, he proceeded to hide Katei somewhere without cameras.
entries.literal: "The way he learned that information isn't important. At the very least, I know the man with us right now wasn't in the lobby shortly after I saw him. What matters is that they met and he put on Katei's clothes. Then, he proceeded to hide Katei somewhere without cameras."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He could have done this any number of ways, but Katei was charged with keeping track of the security cameras, so obviously nobody would notice his body being hidden if he was the one who was supposed to watch everything.
entries.literal: "He could have done this any number of ways, but Katei was charged with keeping track of the security cameras, so obviously nobody would notice his body being hidden if he was the one who was supposed to watch everything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Along with the clothes, he also took the security room key. Then, he released the smoke in the two hallways and event room through some method I'm unaware of. It's likely he knew he'd get trapped by doing so.
entries.literal: "Along with the clothes, he also took the security room key. Then, he released the smoke in the two hallways and event room through some method I'm unaware of. It's likely he knew he'd get trapped by doing so."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He acted as if he'd found us and played the role of a security member to justify his presence in the tower.
entries.literal: "He acted as if he'd found us and played the role of a security member to justify his presence in the tower."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Naomi... It's possible he hid her body while she was unconscious. He'd have a good reason for it, because Naomi would've revealed that he doesn't work in the tower.
entries.literal: "Naomi... It's possible he hid her body while she was unconscious. He'd have a good reason for it, because Naomi would've revealed that he doesn't work in the tower."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: By saying everything is confidential, he's managed to avoid explaining anything he doesn't know. He lied about spending any time in the security room since he'd been carrying out this plan of his. That's why he knew things only a person inside the room with all the monitors would've known without actually being there.
entries.literal: "By saying everything is confidential, he's managed to avoid explaining anything he doesn't know. He lied about spending any time in the security room since he'd been carrying out this plan of his. That's why he knew things only a person inside the room with all the monitors would've known without actually being there."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Suripo clearly told us that security staff would stay in the room and relay information through the installed microphone. But Katei told us that he left it because he didn't know about that before talking to Suripo. He said he used the microphone while we were unconscious, but I'm sure he was lying.
entries.literal: "Suripo clearly told us that security staff would stay in the room and relay information through the installed microphone. But Katei told us that he left it because he didn't know about that before talking to Suripo. He said he used the microphone while we were unconscious, but I'm sure he was lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know why he let us talk to the outside, but it's possible he had something to gain from that. Maybe he wanted everyone outside to think that Katei Kuiji really is in the tower and that everything here is going well.{w} Maybe he wanted to make sure the bait gemstones worked and tricked Ashiya. This is so messy that it almost feels unrelated to what he did, but that can't be it.
entries.literal: "I don't know why he let us talk to the outside, but it's possible he had something to gain from that. Maybe he wanted everyone outside to think that Katei Kuiji really is in the tower and that everything here is going well.{w} Maybe he wanted to make sure the bait gemstones worked and tricked Ashiya. This is so messy that it almost feels unrelated to what he did, but that can't be it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anyway, it all comes down to this: he had no way to get the Sekimeiya out without spending twelve hours here, so he's intentionally spending twelve hours here.
entries.literal: "Anyway, it all comes down to this: he had no way to get the Sekimeiya out without spending twelve hours here, so he's intentionally spending twelve hours here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know how this plan ends. I have no idea how he intends to get the Sekimeiya out once the exit opens, but consider the following. If he manages to do it, nobody will miss him—none of us will know who he actually was. I'm only speculating that he originally found the Sekimeiya to give an easy explanation for all the knowledge he's had since the start.
entries.literal: "I don't know how this plan ends. I have no idea how he intends to get the Sekimeiya out once the exit opens, but consider the following. If he manages to do it, nobody will miss him—none of us will know who he actually was. I'm only speculating that he originally found the Sekimeiya to give an easy explanation for all the knowledge he's had since the start."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Once he makes it out, only the Sekimeiya will be missing. Katei Kuiji will still be here, since he's where that guy talking to Isla right now hid him. This ghost of a person will have escaped with the real target.
entries.literal: "Once he makes it out, only the Sekimeiya will be missing. Katei Kuiji will still be here, since he's where that guy talking to Isla right now hid him. This ghost of a person will have escaped with the real target."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...After saying it all out loud, I know it sounds pretty absurd, but whatever this plan is, it has to be far from over. There are a lot of things that don't make sense, and somehow, the Sekimeiya is still in its cabinet as if nothing happened.
entries.literal: "...After saying it all out loud, I know it sounds pretty absurd, but whatever this plan is, it has to be far from over. There are a lot of things that don't make sense, and somehow, the Sekimeiya is still in its cabinet as if nothing happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Also, one last thing.{w} We only think that what we saw is the Sekimeiya because Katei told us so. The plan could already be further along. The real Sekimeiya could've been replaced while we were asleep.{w} That could be another reason why Naomi's presence had to be taken care of, as she would expose that illusion.
entries.literal: "Also, one last thing.{w} We only think that what we saw is the Sekimeiya because Katei told us so. The plan could already be further along. The real Sekimeiya could've been replaced while we were asleep.{w} That could be another reason why Naomi's presence had to be taken care of, as she would expose that illusion."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I'm done. What do you think? Do you agree with anything?
entries.literal: "...I'm done. What do you think? Do you agree with anything?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was looking at the floor, and I'd been listening to everything expressionlessly. Katei remained engaged with Isla while her mother looked on from behind. Akaro and Shiroya were leaning against the wall, waiting to move on. Before I responded, we all walked to the next room, A4.
entries.literal: "I was looking at the floor, and I'd been listening to everything expressionlessly. Katei remained engaged with Isla while her mother looked on from behind. Akaro and Shiroya were leaning against the wall, waiting to move on. Before I responded, we all walked to the next room, A4."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited for Katei and Isla to begin uncovering the cabinets before resuming the conversation with Sai.
entries.literal: "I waited for Katei and Isla to begin uncovering the cabinets before resuming the conversation with Sai."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: *sigh* I don't think I can directly object to anything you said...
entries.literal: "*sigh* I don't think I can directly object to anything you said..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Admittedly, I did think Sai's theory was a leap. It didn't have to be wrong, and I had come to a similar idea myself, but some of his assumptions were a bit of a reach. Despite Sai's fervor, I cared about what was going on as well.
entries.literal: "Admittedly, I did think Sai's theory was a leap. It didn't have to be wrong, and I had come to a similar idea myself, but some of his assumptions were a bit of a reach. Despite Sai's fervor, I cared about what was going on as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way it had been an accident. Many things indicated that nothing had happened coincidentally: the particular day, the smoke locations, the alarm, the recurring Xyn events, Naomi...
entries.literal: "There was no way it had been an accident. Many things indicated that nothing had happened coincidentally: the particular day, the smoke locations, the alarm, the recurring Xyn events, Naomi..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Before anything else, there are two options to choose from. The plan failed, probably because of the new alarm, or the plan hasn't ended yet.
entries.literal: "Before anything else, there are two options to choose from. The plan failed, probably because of the new alarm, or the plan hasn't ended yet."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If whatever this plan is hasn't ended, it's almost certain that a culprit must be here with us.{w} Who would that be, and what do they intend to do next?
entries.literal: "If whatever this plan is hasn't ended, it's almost certain that a culprit must be here with us.{w} Who would that be, and what do they intend to do next?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There weren't that many possibilities.
entries.literal: "There weren't that many possibilities."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Everything has pointed to Katei, and there are multiple ways to construct it. If he's really a security member, he probably would've had an easy time setting this up. If he's not, Sai's theory is valid too. He's definitely the most suspicious person here.
entries.literal: "Everything has pointed to Katei, and there are multiple ways to construct it. If he's really a security member, he probably would've had an easy time setting this up. If he's not, Sai's theory is valid too. He's definitely the most suspicious person here."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Unless I choose to doubt Sai, it's almost a guarantee that Katei lied about being in the security room during the attack. There could be many reasons behind the lie, though. If Katei is actually innocent, a similar plan could be adapted around anyone who got trapped.
entries.literal: "Unless I choose to doubt Sai, it's almost a guarantee that Katei lied about being in the security room during the attack. There could be many reasons behind the lie, though. If Katei is actually innocent, a similar plan could be adapted around anyone who got trapped."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Of course, I can rule myself and Shiroya out. We've come here innocently and never expected anything like this to happen. Shiroya and I have spent our entire lives together, and I know she'd never think of doing such a thing, not even with her being less than fond of Ashiya.
entries.literal: "Of course, I can rule myself and Shiroya out. We've come here innocently and never expected anything like this to happen. Shiroya and I have spent our entire lives together, and I know she'd never think of doing such a thing, not even with her being less than fond of Ashiya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I myself don't suffer from memory loss or split personalities, nor do I have a particular interest in ruining my life after failing a robbery attempt.
entries.literal: "I myself don't suffer from memory loss or split personalities, nor do I have a particular interest in ruining my life after failing a robbery attempt."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Akaro was the last person in our group. Out of us seven, I feel he's the easiest person to suspect after Katei. He claimed not to care much about today's event but was here from the very beginning. Earlier, his behavior was clearly off, but it's gotten better since we woke up.
entries.literal: "Akaro was the last person in our group. Out of us seven, I feel he's the easiest person to suspect after Katei. He claimed not to care much about today's event but was here from the very beginning. Earlier, his behavior was clearly off, but it's gotten better since we woke up."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It could be that he's letting the time pass so that his plan can conclude. But since he stands out from the rest of us, he's an easy target to blame for a plan Sai and I have concocted.
entries.literal: "It could be that he's letting the time pass so that his plan can conclude. But since he stands out from the rest of us, he's an easy target to blame for a plan Sai and I have concocted."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The same could be said for Erina and Isla, even though it sounds less likely. It's too naïve to rule them out because of Isla's age. A well-constructed plan could take advantage of that to lower our guard.
entries.literal: "The same could be said for Erina and Isla, even though it sounds less likely. It's too naïve to rule them out because of Isla's age. A well-constructed plan could take advantage of that to lower our guard."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Out of the six of us that were waiting for the event, only they have their early arrival justified... Isla's the only one who seemed to care about the event, but I can only truly rule out Shiroya and myself.
entries.literal: "Out of the six of us that were waiting for the event, only they have their early arrival justified... Isla's the only one who seemed to care about the event, but I can only truly rule out Shiroya and myself."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And Sai... I don't believe he's the culprit, but if he's even crazier than he seems, he could've designed the whole thing and then messed with me for entertainment, maybe even to prevent my suspicion and interference. He could be trying to manipulate me into thinking whatever is convenient for him.
entries.literal: "And Sai... I don't believe he's the culprit, but if he's even crazier than he seems, he could've designed the whole thing and then messed with me for entertainment, maybe even to prevent my suspicion and interference. He could be trying to manipulate me into thinking whatever is convenient for him."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I don't think that's likely, though. Similarly, he might've determined I'm not a likely suspect.
entries.literal: "I don't think that's likely, though. Similarly, he might've determined I'm not a likely suspect."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There are two more options: Naomi, and an unknown person.
entries.literal: "There are two more options: Naomi, and an unknown person."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If Naomi wants to wait until the exit opens to execute the last part of her plan, then hiding from us is probably a good idea. She's been hidden from the very beginning and will spend all the remaining time without being spotted, able to move by herself whenever she needs to. There's gotta be a good hiding spot somewhere in this huge building.
entries.literal: "If Naomi wants to wait until the exit opens to execute the last part of her plan, then hiding from us is probably a good idea. She's been hidden from the very beginning and will spend all the remaining time without being spotted, able to move by herself whenever she needs to. There's gotta be a good hiding spot somewhere in this huge building."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Using Naomi as the culprit helps explain the alarm triggering. Suripo said that the only way to activate it was by breaking open the Sekimeiya cabinet, and when I heard the alarm, Naomi was the one next to it.
entries.literal: "Using Naomi as the culprit helps explain the alarm triggering. Suripo said that the only way to activate it was by breaking open the Sekimeiya cabinet, and when I heard the alarm, Naomi was the one next to it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If she silently "broke" it in a way she knew would work and then faked being unconscious, she could've covertly trapped us. Then, when we looked at the cabinet, we failed to recognize what had triggered the mechanism.
entries.literal: "If she silently \"broke\" it in a way she knew would work and then faked being unconscious, she could've covertly trapped us. Then, when we looked at the cabinet, we failed to recognize what had triggered the mechanism."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Why would she do that? Could she have wanted to make it look like it was a malfunction, so anything else could be a malfunction too? The fact that the alarm went off right after Naomi unlocked the cabinet with her key also leads me to think that the source of the alarm had to be something else.
entries.literal: "Why would she do that? Could she have wanted to make it look like it was a malfunction, so anything else could be a malfunction too? The fact that the alarm went off right after Naomi unlocked the cabinet with her key also leads me to think that the source of the alarm had to be something else."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, this also could have been done purposely to make the three of us confirm that by the time the alarm was set off, there was no reason to force the cabinet open. After all, there's no way Naomi could've known I'd stay conscious for enough time to hear the alarm.
entries.literal: "However, this also could have been done purposely to make the three of us confirm that by the time the alarm was set off, there was no reason to force the cabinet open. After all, there's no way Naomi could've known I'd stay conscious for enough time to hear the alarm."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But if Naomi is innocent, is there more than one option behind her disappearance? Unless she woke up ahead of time and saw the culprit, the only person with a clear motive would've been Katei. She could still be trapped and walking around, but I'm not sure why she wouldn't have shown herself already if she has nothing to do with the attack...
entries.literal: "But if Naomi is innocent, is there more than one option behind her disappearance? Unless she woke up ahead of time and saw the culprit, the only person with a clear motive would've been Katei. She could still be trapped and walking around, but I'm not sure why she wouldn't have shown herself already if she has nothing to do with the attack..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is it actually possible Naomi is currently outside the tower? This would mean that the alarm had a delayed effect and Naomi's not innocent at all. I'm pretty sure what I heard in the event room was the shutter, but I can't be totally certain.
entries.literal: "Is it actually possible Naomi is currently outside the tower? This would mean that the alarm had a delayed effect and Naomi's not innocent at all. I'm pretty sure what I heard in the event room was the shutter, but I can't be totally certain."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The only way she could be outside is if Naomi is a culprit. Otherwise, Suripo surely would've said that she was outside when we brought up her name. The only way this wouldn't have happened is if Naomi was the "individual" with the suitcase whose identity was kept a secret.
entries.literal: "The only way she could be outside is if Naomi is a culprit. Otherwise, Suripo surely would've said that she was outside when we brought up her name. The only way this wouldn't have happened is if Naomi was the \"individual\" with the suitcase whose identity was kept a secret."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The "unknown person" option is basically the same, but better. After all, with Naomi, we'd know the identity of the culprit by the end. If an unknown person has stayed with us and somehow plans to sneak out with the Sekimeiya when the time comes, we'll have no way to know who they were.
entries.literal: "The \"unknown person\" option is basically the same, but better. After all, with Naomi, we'd know the identity of the culprit by the end. If an unknown person has stayed with us and somehow plans to sneak out with the Sekimeiya when the time comes, we'll have no way to know who they were."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The lobby doesn't have security cameras. When everyone evacuated, someone hid behind the reception desk or entered the staircase to the mechanical room. Once the smoke faded, they hid in a better place, maybe after moving Naomi's body. Maybe they were in one of the rooms in a hallway, and that's why they made sure we couldn't look at the recorded footage.
entries.literal: "The lobby doesn't have security cameras. When everyone evacuated, someone hid behind the reception desk or entered the staircase to the mechanical room. Once the smoke faded, they hid in a better place, maybe after moving Naomi's body. Maybe they were in one of the rooms in a hallway, and that's why they made sure we couldn't look at the recorded footage."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Once this is all listed out, there are a few extra options, like two people working together. If Naomi and Katei were in cahoots, one would cover what doesn't make sense if the other person is working alone.
entries.literal: "Once this is all listed out, there are a few extra options, like two people working together. If Naomi and Katei were in cahoots, one would cover what doesn't make sense if the other person is working alone."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The two staff members could have easily designed an internal attack thanks to the knowledge they possess. Katei made us think the Sekimeiya we saw was the real deal. Now, Naomi can do as she pleases since she'll be constantly covered by Katei, who will guide all of us as the most knowledgeable person here.{w} ...Perhaps that's unlikely since he had no problem staying behind in the security room while we went to investigate.
entries.literal: "The two staff members could have easily designed an internal attack thanks to the knowledge they possess. Katei made us think the Sekimeiya we saw was the real deal. Now, Naomi can do as she pleases since she'll be constantly covered by Katei, who will guide all of us as the most knowledgeable person here.{w} ...Perhaps that's unlikely since he had no problem staying behind in the security room while we went to investigate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surprisingly, the conclusion I drew was that if the plan was still being carried out, Sai's theory was close to what I believed to be likely.
entries.literal: "Surprisingly, the conclusion I drew was that if the plan was still being carried out, Sai's theory was close to what I believed to be likely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had to know what triggered the alarm. It would clear up multiple doubts and remove possibilities such as the person responsible already escaping.
entries.literal: "We had to know what triggered the alarm. It would clear up multiple doubts and remove possibilities such as the person responsible already escaping."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe what you said is the most likely possibility. A lot of things point to Katei being suspicious, and he knew about the alarm from the start. That could mean that he's the most likely person to be carrying out a plan that involves waiting for the alarm's timer.
entries.literal: "Maybe what you said is the most likely possibility. A lot of things point to Katei being suspicious, and he knew about the alarm from the start. That could mean that he's the most likely person to be carrying out a plan that involves waiting for the alarm's timer."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Yes, I agree.{w} Either him or Naomi, but with the scenario I constructed, Naomi's already taken care of. Most things are, actually. I don't know how the smoke was released, what triggered the alarm, and how Katei plans to disappear with the Sekimeiya. It's also good to note that regardless of the method, a member of security staff like him could easily design a way to release the smoke.
entries.literal: "...Yes, I agree.{w} Either him or Naomi, but with the scenario I constructed, Naomi's already taken care of. Most things are, actually. I don't know how the smoke was released, what triggered the alarm, and how Katei plans to disappear with the Sekimeiya. It's also good to note that regardless of the method, a member of security staff like him could easily design a way to release the smoke."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It'd be wise to keep track of him at all times. He stayed alone earlier, and in the security room of all places. I'm very curious to know how he intends to make this plan work. He'll probably make sure that we don't come across Naomi or the body of the real Katei, if I'm also right about that.
entries.literal: "It'd be wise to keep track of him at all times. He stayed alone earlier, and in the security room of all places. I'm very curious to know how he intends to make this plan work. He'll probably make sure that we don't come across Naomi or the body of the real Katei, if I'm also right about that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You seem pretty excited.
entries.literal: "You seem pretty excited."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: A bit. Aren't you?{w} Aren't you looking forward to knowing which theory ends up being the correct one? Or maybe to find out that we were both incorrect. What if this is all bigger than we think, or just a coincidental accident?
entries.literal: "A bit. Aren't you?{w} Aren't you looking forward to knowing which theory ends up being the correct one? Or maybe to find out that we were both incorrect. What if this is all bigger than we think, or just a coincidental accident?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I want to make a lot of theories and then have the best one turn out to be right. That would be great.
entries.literal: "I want to make a lot of theories and then have the best one turn out to be right. That would be great."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: For example, think about this. Everything we've thought about has been in part based on the call with Suripo. However, our main assumption right now is that Katei is responsible for all this.
entries.literal: "For example, think about this. Everything we've thought about has been in part based on the call with Suripo. However, our main assumption right now is that Katei is responsible for all this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You brought up a good point earlier when you asked why Katei said we could communicate with the outside. You're right. If he's a security member while also being the culprit, he'd look incredibly bad to the police if he never told us about it.
entries.literal: "You brought up a good point earlier when you asked why Katei said we could communicate with the outside. You're right. If he's a security member while also being the culprit, he'd look incredibly bad to the police if he never told us about it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But if I'm right and he doesn't work here, it wasn't very smart of him to bring it up voluntarily.
entries.literal: "But if I'm right and he doesn't work here, it wasn't very smart of him to bring it up voluntarily."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're saying that Suripo was an accomplice, and they planned what to tell us?
entries.literal: "You're saying that Suripo was an accomplice, and they planned what to tell us?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Exactly. ...He spoke very highly of Xyn.{w} What if he was speaking very highly of himself? The group he works for, alongside Katei?
entries.literal: "Exactly. ...He spoke very highly of Xyn.{w} What if he was speaking very highly of himself? The group he works for, alongside Katei?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He had a police uniform and was in a car next to the tower, ignored by everyone around it. If it was a real video feed, he's an actual policeman. Wouldn't things make sense if Xyn was involved with the police?
entries.literal: "He had a police uniform and was in a car next to the tower, ignored by everyone around it. If it was a real video feed, he's an actual policeman. Wouldn't things make sense if Xyn was involved with the police?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That program hidden deep within the computer's folders could've been another factor of this plan designed by Xyn. They knew Ashiya were working on a mechanism to defeat them, so they created this plan to keep their superiority. Assuming part of what he told us was the truth.
entries.literal: "That program hidden deep within the computer's folders could've been another factor of this plan designed by Xyn. They knew Ashiya were working on a mechanism to defeat them, so they created this plan to keep their superiority. Assuming part of what he told us was the truth."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: As soon as he began to explain things, my suspicions about Katei immediately lessened. After all, what that policeman was saying matched up well with the information Katei gave us. Now, if they were working together, made-up details would appear like the absolute truth, and they'd make all of Katei's subsequent claims sound authentic.
entries.literal: "As soon as he began to explain things, my suspicions about Katei immediately lessened. After all, what that policeman was saying matched up well with the information Katei gave us. Now, if they were working together, made-up details would appear like the absolute truth, and they'd make all of Katei's subsequent claims sound authentic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Suripo mainly spoke to Katei. If they were following a script, they could pretty easily deceive us. Suripo is the only reliable source we think we have.
entries.literal: "Suripo mainly spoke to Katei. If they were following a script, they could pretty easily deceive us. Suripo is the only reliable source we think we have."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And after he was done, the power conveniently went out. Not only that, but Katei was unable to contact him again. How believable is that, really? Did the Ashiya family really revoke his authority, knowing they'd leave us incommunicado for twelve hours?
entries.literal: "And after he was done, the power conveniently went out. Not only that, but Katei was unable to contact him again. How believable is that, really? Did the Ashiya family really revoke his authority, knowing they'd leave us incommunicado for twelve hours?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wouldn't it be exciting if we were in the middle of such a plan? Would you stop Xyn if you saw through everything?
entries.literal: "Wouldn't it be exciting if we were in the middle of such a plan? Would you stop Xyn if you saw through everything?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I'm not excited about being caught up in this, I can say that much. But if I get the chance to take these guys down, I absolutely would. I won't let them get away with this... this shit.
entries.literal: "...I'm not excited about being caught up in this, I can say that much. But if I get the chance to take these guys down, I absolutely would. I won't let them get away with this... this shit."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see.{w} Me, I'm just curious. I can't wait to know how this plan ends. Sadly, there's still a while until that. Maybe they need these twelve hours for something... Suripo corroborated the amount of time Katei said, so it would be strange if it turned out to be wrong.
entries.literal: "I see.{w} Me, I'm just curious. I can't wait to know how this plan ends. Sadly, there's still a while until that. Maybe they need these twelve hours for something... Suripo corroborated the amount of time Katei said, so it would be strange if it turned out to be wrong."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We'll have to see what happens.
entries.literal: "We'll have to see what happens."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose so, but if this is an ongoing plan, they won't make it obvious. If they're trying to trick the Ashiya family, we might get tricked too. I'm just not going to get fooled so easily.
entries.literal: "I suppose so, but if this is an ongoing plan, they won't make it obvious. If they're trying to trick the Ashiya family, we might get tricked too. I'm just not going to get fooled so easily."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm.
entries.literal: "Hm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't feel like saying anything else. A part of me thought that everything Sai was saying entailed pointless danger. I related to the interest, but not so much to his approach.
entries.literal: "I didn't feel like saying anything else. A part of me thought that everything Sai was saying entailed pointless danger. I related to the interest, but not so much to his approach."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In our situation, there was no reason for us to be in danger. It was something between Ashiya and Xyn, and we'd just been caught up in the middle of it. Letting everything happen without giving our own input to strangers seemed like the smarter course of action.
entries.literal: "In our situation, there was no reason for us to be in danger. It was something between Ashiya and Xyn, and we'd just been caught up in the middle of it. Letting everything happen without giving our own input to strangers seemed like the smarter course of action."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, trying to piece things together on the side probably wouldn't do any harm.
entries.literal: "However, trying to piece things together on the side probably wouldn't do any harm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although I hadn't reacted, what Sai said was intriguing. I'd let Suripo influence my thoughts with no opposition, but it was true that Katei had been the one who'd let us hear him.
entries.literal: "Although I hadn't reacted, what Sai said was intriguing. I'd let Suripo influence my thoughts with no opposition, but it was true that Katei had been the one who'd let us hear him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The first thing he'd said was that Ashiya instructed the police to talk to us, but he'd never proven that at all. It hadn't sounded all that strange, but instead of telling the police what to let us know, Ashiya could've said everything directly.
entries.literal: "The first thing he'd said was that Ashiya instructed the police to talk to us, but he'd never proven that at all. It hadn't sounded all that strange, but instead of telling the police what to let us know, Ashiya could've said everything directly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suripo also said that Ashiya told them about the communication method. Initially, the other side should've been picked up by Ashiya, who'd supposedly passed it off to the police...
entries.literal: "Suripo also said that Ashiya told them about the communication method. Initially, the other side should've been picked up by Ashiya, who'd supposedly passed it off to the police..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While there was room for suspicion, thinking that he was an actual corrupt policeman was probably incorrect. If he had fed us false information, he would be exposed after we got out.
entries.literal: "While there was room for suspicion, thinking that he was an actual corrupt policeman was probably incorrect. If he had fed us false information, he would be exposed after we got out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could feel my head getting cloudy. The tiredness was coming back, so I tried to cool off.
entries.literal: "I could feel my head getting cloudy. The tiredness was coming back, so I tried to cool off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room's inspection finished without anything missing. Once again, we silently moved on to the next one.
entries.literal: "The room's inspection finished without anything missing. Once again, we silently moved on to the next one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After not talking for two weeks, my voice had easily come out in front of Sai. As I'd thought, it was only Shiroya who I had difficulty talking to.
entries.literal: "After not talking for two weeks, my voice had easily come out in front of Sai. As I'd thought, it was only Shiroya who I had difficulty talking to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the same time, the incident had given me something else to think about after so long. It was likely I was trying to fill up my mind with it, as I knew what would fill it otherwise.
entries.literal: "At the same time, the incident had given me something else to think about after so long. It was likely I was trying to fill up my mind with it, as I knew what would fill it otherwise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Isla didn't look tired of repeating the same procedure. She ran to the door, eagerly awaiting Katei.
entries.literal: "...Isla didn't look tired of repeating the same procedure. She ran to the door, eagerly awaiting Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd noticed that every room had a specific theme. Before leaving, I'd glanced at the cabinets and seen a bunch of unimpressive white gemstones, much smaller in size than the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I'd noticed that every room had a specific theme. Before leaving, I'd glanced at the cabinets and seen a bunch of unimpressive white gemstones, much smaller in size than the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Labeled A5, the last crystal room in the hallway was left before the storeroom. When Isla turned the knob, we expected to be met with the same scene as the other rooms.
entries.literal: "Labeled A5, the last crystal room in the hallway was left before the storeroom. When Isla turned the knob, we expected to be met with the same scene as the other rooms."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The entire room was tinted black, and it was shaped differently. The ceiling and four walls had been deprived of their color, as a dry, dark coating had taken hold of them.
entries.literal: "The entire room was tinted black, and it was shaped differently. The ceiling and four walls had been deprived of their color, as a dry, dark coating had taken hold of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every cabinet was covered by a curtain, but instead of bright red, they were gray, black, and purple, colors that removed all of their elegance.
entries.literal: "Every cabinet was covered by a curtain, but instead of bright red, they were gray, black, and purple, colors that removed all of their elegance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the same appearance the hallways bore. We immediately understood the smoke had also gotten into the last room.{w} We only found it a shocking sight because of what Katei previously told us.
entries.literal: "It was the same appearance the hallways bore. We immediately understood the smoke had also gotten into the last room.{w} We only found it a shocking sight because of what Katei previously told us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. This makes a lot of sense.
entries.literal: "I see. This makes a lot of sense."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What does? Didn't Katei say that the smoke hadn't been released in any other room?
entries.literal: "What does? Didn't Katei say that the smoke hadn't been released in any other room?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of clarifying, Sai moved forward. He stained his hand black by grabbing the bottom of a curtain, and without any care, he raised it to show us the interior of the cabinet it was covering.
entries.literal: "Instead of clarifying, Sai moved forward. He stained his hand black by grabbing the bottom of a curtain, and without any care, he raised it to show us the interior of the cabinet it was covering."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What...? There isn't anything...
entries.literal: "What...? There isn't anything..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He did the same with every cabinet, and the result never differed.
entries.literal: "He did the same with every cabinet, and the result never differed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see, this is the room that was robbed. The gems found in the suitcase came from these cabinets.
entries.literal: "I see, this is the room that was robbed. The gems found in the suitcase came from these cabinets."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes, that has to be it. But the smoke...
entries.literal: "Yes, that has to be it. But the smoke..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You all remember what I said earlier, right?{w} That this part of the plan didn't make a ton of sense. The gems were stolen without releasing smoke in their room, which implied that the smoke had another purpose.
entries.literal: "You all remember what I said earlier, right?{w} That this part of the plan didn't make a ton of sense. The gems were stolen without releasing smoke in their room, which implied that the smoke had another purpose."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But it seems the smoke was released in this room too. Of course, that's required if they wanted to make it seem like those various gems were the target.
entries.literal: "But it seems the smoke was released in this room too. Of course, that's required if they wanted to make it seem like those various gems were the target."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The lens of the single camera was stained black, showing that we weren't being recorded. The green light had been buried under the same blackness, but it was still discernible.
entries.literal: "The lens of the single camera was stained black, showing that we weren't being recorded. The green light had been buried under the same blackness, but it was still discernible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei told us the places where the smoke was released. Obviously, he wouldn't have said that if he hadn't been sure of it, so I believed him.
entries.literal: "Katei told us the places where the smoke was released. Obviously, he wouldn't have said that if he hadn't been sure of it, so I believed him."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm sorry. I must've made a mistake.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry. I must've made a mistake."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No. I have no idea why you did that, but this settles it: this proves you were not in the security room when the alarm went off.
entries.literal: "No. I have no idea why you did that, but this settles it: this proves you were not in the security room when the alarm went off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai glanced at me to let me know that he'd been correct. I was probably the only person aside from Katei who knew what he was talking about.
entries.literal: "Sai glanced at me to let me know that he'd been correct. I was probably the only person aside from Katei who knew what he was talking about."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What do you mean...?
entries.literal: "What do you mean...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Exactly! What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "Exactly! What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You didn't even suspect it? This is about the fifth thing that confirms it, but this one lets me bring it up openly. After all, it also rules out a few things I talked about with Atsuki.
entries.literal: "You didn't even suspect it? This is about the fifth thing that confirms it, but this one lets me bring it up openly. After all, it also rules out a few things I talked about with Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I more or less understood why Sai said that. Without inspecting every room, Katei felt confident in saying that only three different places had been hit with the smoke, but he'd been incorrect.{w} That indicated he hadn't been behind the attack itself, since he wouldn't have made that mistake. It let Sai confront him since he no longer believed he was confronting Xyn, but a mere suspicious individual.
entries.literal: "I more or less understood why Sai said that. Without inspecting every room, Katei felt confident in saying that only three different places had been hit with the smoke, but he'd been incorrect.{w} That indicated he hadn't been behind the attack itself, since he wouldn't have made that mistake. It let Sai confront him since he no longer believed he was confronting Xyn, but a mere suspicious individual."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know what you mean... How does this indicate in any way that I wasn't in the security room?
entries.literal: "I don't know what you mean... How does this indicate in any way that I wasn't in the security room?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's very simple, but let me ask first: why did you say that only the hallways and the event room had smoke released in them?
entries.literal: "It's very simple, but let me ask first: why did you say that only the hallways and the event room had smoke released in them?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I had a bit of time to inspect these rooms before I found Erina's group. Every room I entered was clean, so I simply assumed it was the case with all of them. I shouldn't have made such an assumption.
entries.literal: "...I had a bit of time to inspect these rooms before I found Erina's group. Every room I entered was clean, so I simply assumed it was the case with all of them. I shouldn't have made such an assumption."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right. This proves it further. You were not in the security room.
entries.literal: "All right. This proves it further. You were not in the security room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You all get it too, right?
entries.literal: "You all get it too, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei has said multiple times that during the time the smoke was released, he was locked inside the security room. He also claimed that he tried to monitor what the situation was on this floor by looking through the available cameras.
entries.literal: "Katei has said multiple times that during the time the smoke was released, he was locked inside the security room. He also claimed that he tried to monitor what the situation was on this floor by looking through the available cameras."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not only that, but he also said that he saw the smoke rising out of nowhere. I'm saying that if he really was looking through the cameras when the smoke appeared, he would've seen it being released here.
entries.literal: "Not only that, but he also said that he saw the smoke rising out of nowhere. I'm saying that if he really was looking through the cameras when the smoke appeared, he would've seen it being released here."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? No. I was in a rush, so I never realized it.
entries.literal: "What? No. I was in a rush, so I never realized it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't understand it at all. You were never in the security room and you never inspected the first floor. So then, why did you say that only three places had been hit by the smoke? Why were you certain you could say that, despite being wrong?
entries.literal: "I don't understand it at all. You were never in the security room and you never inspected the first floor. So then, why did you say that only three places had been hit by the smoke? Why were you certain you could say that, despite being wrong?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was the same question I'd been wondering. If Sai was right, Katei wouldn't have stated incorrect information he hadn't been able to verify, which meant that he felt certain about the room's appearance without personally seeing it.
entries.literal: "That was the same question I'd been wondering. If Sai was right, Katei wouldn't have stated incorrect information he hadn't been able to verify, which meant that he felt certain about the room's appearance without personally seeing it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Your assumption is mistaken. I can explain what led to that assertion.{w} When I was in the security room, most of the cameras from this floor were being displayed. It is true that I saw the smoke appearing out of nowhere, but at that time, this room's camera was not being shown. Usually, monitoring the interior of a room isn't needed if another camera shows its door.
entries.literal: "Your assumption is mistaken. I can explain what led to that assertion.{w} When I was in the security room, most of the cameras from this floor were being displayed. It is true that I saw the smoke appearing out of nowhere, but at that time, this room's camera was not being shown. Usually, monitoring the interior of a room isn't needed if another camera shows its door."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Then, I proceeded to look through all the other cameras while trying to determine what was happening. As you saw with your own eyes, some of them had been disabled; because of the smoke, a black screen was all that I could see through them.
entries.literal: "Then, I proceeded to look through all the other cameras while trying to determine what was happening. As you saw with your own eyes, some of them had been disabled; because of the smoke, a black screen was all that I could see through them."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: So, all that this room's camera showed was a black screen. This means that I was unable to recognize that one of the disabled screens belonged to this room.{w} Since both hallways possess numerous cameras, I did not notice there were one too many black screens. Later, since I looked into most of the clean rooms, I wrongly assumed that they all were the same.
entries.literal: "So, all that this room's camera showed was a black screen. This means that I was unable to recognize that one of the disabled screens belonged to this room.{w} Since both hallways possess numerous cameras, I did not notice there were one too many black screens. Later, since I looked into most of the clean rooms, I wrongly assumed that they all were the same."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm.
entries.literal: "Hm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all thought about it. Did what Katei said make sense? If I'd been in their places, it's likely I would've believed it, but Sai and I had more reasons to think Katei had never been in the security room and that he was fabricating another lie out of nowhere.
entries.literal: "We all thought about it. Did what Katei said make sense? If I'd been in their places, it's likely I would've believed it, but Sai and I had more reasons to think Katei had never been in the security room and that he was fabricating another lie out of nowhere."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Are you really sure about this, Sai?
entries.literal: "Are you really sure about this, Sai?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Absolutely.
entries.literal: "Absolutely."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now answer me this. At first, you saw the smoke being released through some cameras. To assess the situation, you looked at all the remaining places on this floor, and this room wasn't initially being displayed.
entries.literal: "Now answer me this. At first, you saw the smoke being released through some cameras. To assess the situation, you looked at all the remaining places on this floor, and this room wasn't initially being displayed."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Correct. That is why I never saw the smoke appearing here.
entries.literal: "Correct. That is why I never saw the smoke appearing here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right. So then you switched the displayed cameras. This means that at some point, you switched one of the cameras for this room's. You're seriously saying that when you did that, you didn't realize the smoke had also been released here?
entries.literal: "All right. So then you switched the displayed cameras. This means that at some point, you switched one of the cameras for this room's. You're seriously saying that when you did that, you didn't realize the smoke had also been released here?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, I see what you mean. That eventually, I must've chosen to observe the live footage of this room by manually selecting its camera and I would've noticed the black screen.
entries.literal: "Oh, I see what you mean. That eventually, I must've chosen to observe the live footage of this room by manually selecting its camera and I would've noticed the black screen."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's understandable you'd think that, but no. That would've been slow and suboptimal given the situation. Do you remember earlier, when I looked through the cameras while talking to Suripo?
entries.literal: "It's understandable you'd think that, but no. That would've been slow and suboptimal given the situation. Do you remember earlier, when I looked through the cameras while talking to Suripo?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The program that manages them lets me replace the nine cameras being displayed at once for the ones that come next on the list. That's what I did.
entries.literal: "The program that manages them lets me replace the nine cameras being displayed at once for the ones that come next on the list. That's what I did."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I was nervous and switched the cameras nine at a time. I never consciously acknowledged that one of the new cameras belonged to this room. As I already said, I simply failed to recognize that there was an extra black screen. The crystal rooms all look very similar, so I didn't really miss this one.
entries.literal: "I was nervous and switched the cameras nine at a time. I never consciously acknowledged that one of the new cameras belonged to this room. As I already said, I simply failed to recognize that there was an extra black screen. The crystal rooms all look very similar, so I didn't really miss this one."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The shape of this one is completely different, though.
entries.literal: "The shape of this one is completely different, though."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: To tell you the truth, it all threw me off. The mere sight of the screens displaying nothing but black was disconcerting because they're equipped with night vision and I'd never seen them like that. I wasn't really thinking about the number of crystal rooms.
entries.literal: "To tell you the truth, it all threw me off. The mere sight of the screens displaying nothing but black was disconcerting because they're equipped with night vision and I'd never seen them like that. I wasn't really thinking about the number of crystal rooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei's explanation was unconvincing, but there was nothing Sai could use to object to it. At least, not without the computer's sleep mode timer, which Sai didn't appear to be using for his argument.
entries.literal: "Katei's explanation was unconvincing, but there was nothing Sai could use to object to it. At least, not without the computer's sleep mode timer, which Sai didn't appear to be using for his argument."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei hadn't addressed the event room either. If he'd seen the smoke appearing in the event room, it should've been a given that our group had been trapped in the tower, but that wasn't what he said when we met.
entries.literal: "Katei hadn't addressed the event room either. If he'd seen the smoke appearing in the event room, it should've been a given that our group had been trapped in the tower, but that wasn't what he said when we met."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was unbelievable that the event room wouldn't have been displayed on such a special day. If it really hadn't been, it meant that Katei hadn't failed to notice one extra black camera, but two. And it was still very questionable that he had stopped at Erina's group before ours.
entries.literal: "It was unbelievable that the event room wouldn't have been displayed on such a special day. If it really hadn't been, it meant that Katei hadn't failed to notice one extra black camera, but two. And it was still very questionable that he had stopped at Erina's group before ours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone else looked dubious as well, but less so, as they hadn't yet entertained that possibility.
entries.literal: "Everyone else looked dubious as well, but less so, as they hadn't yet entertained that possibility."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not for a second do I believe anything that you're saying.
entries.literal: "Not for a second do I believe anything that you're saying."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I apologize for not being more convincing. I understand why you might find what I'm telling you strange, but I promise all of you that I'm telling the truth.
entries.literal: "I apologize for not being more convincing. I understand why you might find what I'm telling you strange, but I promise all of you that I'm telling the truth."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, you switched all the cameras at once and, for some reason, assumed only three places had been exposed to the smoke.
entries.literal: "So, you switched all the cameras at once and, for some reason, assumed only three places had been exposed to the smoke."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. I saw the smoke appearing in the hallways, which disabled multiple cameras. I mistakenly assumed all of them belonged to the hallways.
entries.literal: "Yes. I saw the smoke appearing in the hallways, which disabled multiple cameras. I mistakenly assumed all of them belonged to the hallways."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And after that, despite not having looked through every room, you claimed that the smoke hadn't been released anywhere else but in the three places we'd all personally observed.
entries.literal: "And after that, despite not having looked through every room, you claimed that the smoke hadn't been released anywhere else but in the three places we'd all personally observed."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Correct. I apologize for my mistake. It seems it led you to suspect something about me, but I repeat that it was all a mistake I made in a rush.
entries.literal: "Correct. I apologize for my mistake. It seems it led you to suspect something about me, but I repeat that it was all a mistake I made in a rush."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me be clear: I don't believe you nor intend to do so. You are full of shit. However, I don't know why you told us that only those three places had been hit, and it's pissing me off.{w} Do you remember when you said you'd left the lobby door open? Like Atsuki pointed out, it was opened after the smoke was released since almost none went through it. Still saying that's true?
entries.literal: "Let me be clear: I don't believe you nor intend to do so. You are full of shit. However, I don't know why you told us that only those three places had been hit, and it's pissing me off.{w} Do you remember when you said you'd left the lobby door open? Like Atsuki pointed out, it was opened after the smoke was released since almost none went through it. Still saying that's true?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, of course.
entries.literal: "Yes, of course."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, when you said that, I looked at the hallway A door. That one was properly closed.
entries.literal: "Well, when you said that, I looked at the hallway A door. That one was properly closed."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...And?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: According to you, after you left the security room, you ended up where we were without going through the event room. If you'd done that, you would've gone through the lobby, so you should've opened both doors.
entries.literal: "According to you, after you left the security room, you ended up where we were without going through the event room. If you'd done that, you would've gone through the lobby, so you should've opened both doors."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Which is what I did.
entries.literal: "Which is what I did."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And why did you leave the hallway A door closed but not the other one?
entries.literal: "And why did you leave the hallway A door closed but not the other one?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Because the three of you were unconscious in hallway B, and I hurried to kneel beside you.
entries.literal: "...Because the three of you were unconscious in hallway B, and I hurried to kneel beside you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sure, I imagined you'd say that. However, if you really opened that door, what I find most likely is that you didn't come from the security room and that you never went through the other one. Maybe it was Naomi who opened it and you had to say you did it because of the movements you'd already claimed you made.
entries.literal: "Sure, I imagined you'd say that. However, if you really opened that door, what I find most likely is that you didn't come from the security room and that you never went through the other one. Maybe it was Naomi who opened it and you had to say you did it because of the movements you'd already claimed you made."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're ridiculous.
entries.literal: "You're ridiculous."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Okay, but if you'd never looked at the cameras or entered the rooms, why the hell did you say something that could easily be wrong...? Were you misinformed about the plan you took part in? That's what would be ridiculous.
entries.literal: "Okay, but if you'd never looked at the cameras or entered the rooms, why the hell did you say something that could easily be wrong...? Were you misinformed about the plan you took part in? That's what would be ridiculous."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: *sigh* I already told you what happened. If you find it hard to believe, there's nothing else I can do.
entries.literal: "*sigh* I already told you what happened. If you find it hard to believe, there's nothing else I can do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were a few seconds of silence during which nobody knew what to say. In the background, Isla ignored us and kept looking through the cabinets, hoping something had been left behind.
entries.literal: "There were a few seconds of silence during which nobody knew what to say. In the background, Isla ignored us and kept looking through the cabinets, hoping something had been left behind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina followed everything she did with her eyes, obviously unwilling to needlessly engage in the barrage Sai was firing off.
entries.literal: "Erina followed everything she did with her eyes, obviously unwilling to needlessly engage in the barrage Sai was firing off."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You know... It's possible you're right. It's possible that not noticing the extra black screen and the missing crystal room is too unlikely. Even under the stress of not knowing what was happening.
entries.literal: "You know... It's possible you're right. It's possible that not noticing the extra black screen and the missing crystal room is too unlikely. Even under the stress of not knowing what was happening."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What if this room was clean at that time? It has already been a long time since I looked through the cameras. The smoke could've been released here afterward.
entries.literal: "What if this room was clean at that time? It has already been a long time since I looked through the cameras. The smoke could've been released here afterward."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This wouldn't contradict anything, and it might make even more sense than what I first believed.
entries.literal: "This wouldn't contradict anything, and it might make even more sense than what I first believed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Quick lie revision? Are we supposed to listen to that?
entries.literal: "Quick lie revision? Are we supposed to listen to that?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Well, I don't know why that would've been done, but you can't deny it just because you find it unlikely.{w} It could very well be that it happened after I left the security room. The rooms all look very similar, so maybe I did see this one when I looked through the cameras. Now I'm not sure. I don't know which of the two possibilities I'm presenting is the correct one.
entries.literal: "Well, I don't know why that would've been done, but you can't deny it just because you find it unlikely.{w} It could very well be that it happened after I left the security room. The rooms all look very similar, so maybe I did see this one when I looked through the cameras. Now I'm not sure. I don't know which of the two possibilities I'm presenting is the correct one."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You know very well they're both incorrect. But yes, I can deny the second one.
entries.literal: "You know very well they're both incorrect. But yes, I can deny the second one."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: How would you do that?
entries.literal: "How would you do that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It has to do with something very important. Normally, I would've brought it up straight away.
entries.literal: "It has to do with something very important. Normally, I would've brought it up straight away."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It makes this whole situation much easier to understand. Remember the two questions from earlier? Why were the gemstones stolen, and how were they brought outside before the alarm went off?
entries.literal: "It makes this whole situation much easier to understand. Remember the two questions from earlier? Why were the gemstones stolen, and how were they brought outside before the alarm went off?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm fairly sure the answers are, respectively, to make it seem like they were the goal of the attack, and because they were stolen before the time we thought.
entries.literal: "I'm fairly sure the answers are, respectively, to make it seem like they were the goal of the attack, and because they were stolen before the time we thought."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I mean, the curtains here were lowered when we entered. Most importantly, they were stained with the smoke.{w} This means that during the time the smoke was released, the cabinets were covered.
entries.literal: "I mean, the curtains here were lowered when we entered. Most importantly, they were stained with the smoke.{w} This means that during the time the smoke was released, the cabinets were covered."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If someone stole the contents of these cabinets when the smoke was being released, as the Ashiya family thinks right now, why would they have lowered the curtains again? No way they would've all fallen down by themselves.
entries.literal: "If someone stole the contents of these cabinets when the smoke was being released, as the Ashiya family thinks right now, why would they have lowered the curtains again? No way they would've all fallen down by themselves."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You all see what I'm saying, right? It would have been a pointless waste of time to lower them. After the smoke was released in this room, the curtains weren't moved.{w} To put it simply, the gemstones that were once here were stolen before the smoke was released. This is why someone was able to bring them outside before the exit closed.
entries.literal: "You all see what I'm saying, right? It would have been a pointless waste of time to lower them. After the smoke was released in this room, the curtains weren't moved.{w} To put it simply, the gemstones that were once here were stolen before the smoke was released. This is why someone was able to bring them outside before the exit closed."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I suppose that makes sense, but how did they do that?
entries.literal: "I suppose that makes sense, but how did they do that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You tell me. What's important is that they could've been stolen during the night. Then, before the exit closed, they were brought out.
entries.literal: "You tell me. What's important is that they could've been stolen during the night. Then, before the exit closed, they were brought out."

entries.speaker: sai
