entries.text: By releasing the smoke here too, they tried to make it look like the gems were stolen at a later time and that they were the actual target of the theft.
entries.literal: "By releasing the smoke here too, they tried to make it look like the gems were stolen at a later time and that they were the actual target of the theft."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What you're saying makes sense, but I still have a hard time visualizing how this plan works.
entries.literal: "...What you're saying makes sense, but I still have a hard time visualizing how this plan works."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me too. A very important thing we don't know yet is whether the alarm was taken into consideration. You said it was a top-secret alarm, right?
entries.literal: "Me too. A very important thing we don't know yet is whether the alarm was taken into consideration. You said it was a top-secret alarm, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. I believe it's nearly impossible that Xyn designed a plan with it in mind.
entries.literal: "Yes. I believe it's nearly impossible that Xyn designed a plan with it in mind."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If so, that means the smoke here couldn't have been released after you left the security room. That would only have been done if they already knew the exit was getting locked down.
entries.literal: "If so, that means the smoke here couldn't have been released after you left the security room. That would only have been done if they already knew the exit was getting locked down."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I believe you're right. If they didn't know about the alarm, they would not have staggered the smoke in this room. It would've been released everywhere at once.
entries.literal: "I believe you're right. If they didn't know about the alarm, they would not have staggered the smoke in this room. It would've been released everywhere at once."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Exactly.
entries.literal: "...Exactly."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Can I say something? We're only assuming the gems here were stolen before the time of the attack because the curtains were down. That makes sense, but wouldn't they have thought of it?
entries.literal: "...Can I say something? We're only assuming the gems here were stolen before the time of the attack because the curtains were down. That makes sense, but wouldn't they have thought of it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's true. If Xyn didn't know about the alarm, they must've expected Ashiya to rush in right away. They would only have seen these curtains, not that the gems were missing.
entries.literal: "That's true. If Xyn didn't know about the alarm, they must've expected Ashiya to rush in right away. They would only have seen these curtains, not that the gems were missing."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. After all, they only believe these random gems were the target because they don't have access to the tower. Isn't it as if the alarm is working positively for the culprit?
entries.literal: "Yeah. After all, they only believe these random gems were the target because they don't have access to the tower. Isn't it as if the alarm is working positively for the culprit?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah... There's no way Xyn would've ignored the curtains giving away the timing of the theft, right?
entries.literal: "Yeah... There's no way Xyn would've ignored the curtains giving away the timing of the theft, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not if they didn't know about the alarm. If they did, and the intent was to simply let Ashiya think what they think until the tower unlocks, it doesn't matter that we've figured it out. After all, it's not like we can contact the outside to tell them, is it?
entries.literal: "Not if they didn't know about the alarm. If they did, and the intent was to simply let Ashiya think what they think until the tower unlocks, it doesn't matter that we've figured it out. After all, it's not like we can contact the outside to tell them, is it?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're wrong. Then they would've had no reason to release the smoke here.
entries.literal: "You're wrong. Then they would've had no reason to release the smoke here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm, I'm not sure. We did have the chance to talk to the police, but it happened before we came here.{w} I'm saying this was done to trick Ashiya into thinking the gems were the goal. However, I also think that the plan must somehow end by stealing the Sekimeiya, which will directly reveal that the gems were never the goal. It could definitely be that the smoke was released to trick us—the people who got trapped. It all depends on whether someone is trying to trick us.
entries.literal: "Hm, I'm not sure. We did have the chance to talk to the police, but it happened before we came here.{w} I'm saying this was done to trick Ashiya into thinking the gems were the goal. However, I also think that the plan must somehow end by stealing the Sekimeiya, which will directly reveal that the gems were never the goal. It could definitely be that the smoke was released to trick us—the people who got trapped. It all depends on whether someone is trying to trick us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were a few seconds of silence. Would Xyn have put so much effort into deceiving us? It didn't sound likely, but it was true that we had a method to contact the outside and could've informed Ashiya of every suspicious detail we'd noticed. It was strange, because if the culprit had always been able to disable the communication method, there would have been no point in doing any of it.
entries.literal: "There were a few seconds of silence. Would Xyn have put so much effort into deceiving us? It didn't sound likely, but it was true that we had a method to contact the outside and could've informed Ashiya of every suspicious detail we'd noticed. It was strange, because if the culprit had always been able to disable the communication method, there would have been no point in doing any of it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Do you actually believe the alarm was considered?
entries.literal: "...Do you actually believe the alarm was considered?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who knows? If the gems were stolen during the night through some method Xyn are capable of, they'd leave the curtains lowered to prevent it from being noticed through the cameras and so that the visitors couldn't see them before {time=9:10.}
entries.literal: "Who knows? If the gems were stolen during the night through some method Xyn are capable of, they'd leave the curtains lowered to prevent it from being noticed through the cameras and so that the visitors couldn't see them before {time=9:10.}"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I wasn't the guard on duty last night, so I can't help you with that.
entries.literal: "I wasn't the guard on duty last night, so I can't help you with that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Well, they were forced to leave the cabinets covered, but doing so also indicates that the gems were stolen before the doors were open to the public...
entries.literal: "...{w}Well, they were forced to leave the cabinets covered, but doing so also indicates that the gems were stolen before the doors were open to the public..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know why. I've approached it from different angles, but I can't come up with something that makes sense.{w} In some way, these gems must've only been a side part of the plan. Them getting stolen before the smoke was released is close to confirmation, but how everything pieces together is not as simple to figure out.
entries.literal: "I don't know why. I've approached it from different angles, but I can't come up with something that makes sense.{w} In some way, these gems must've only been a side part of the plan. Them getting stolen before the smoke was released is close to confirmation, but how everything pieces together is not as simple to figure out."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I apologize that I can't be of more help. I assume this is Xyn's doing, but I don't know what they intend to do. I am equally clueless when it comes to how these gems could've been stolen before this morning.
entries.literal: "I apologize that I can't be of more help. I assume this is Xyn's doing, but I don't know what they intend to do. I am equally clueless when it comes to how these gems could've been stolen before this morning."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai, I know you don't believe much of what I say, but I have been honest from the beginning. I have just been trying to help and provide you with as much information as I can.
entries.literal: "Sai, I know you don't believe much of what I say, but I have been honest from the beginning. I have just been trying to help and provide you with as much information as I can."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is that so?
entries.literal: "Is that so?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While everyone stood still, Sai began to examine the room. Even though it looked drastically different from the others, only the illumination and shape varied. It was still a simple room that only contained cabinets.
entries.literal: "While everyone stood still, Sai began to examine the room. Even though it looked drastically different from the others, only the illumination and shape varied. It was still a simple room that only contained cabinets."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't think there's much to do here. Every cabinet is empty, and the same kind of smoke was released, most likely at the same time as in the other places. We should move on.
entries.literal: "I don't think there's much to do here. Every cabinet is empty, and the same kind of smoke was released, most likely at the same time as in the other places. We should move on."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Yeah. Let's get going.
entries.literal: "...Yeah. Let's get going."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla seemed happy with that proposition as well. We all agreed and left quietly to avoid any more conflict.
entries.literal: "Isla seemed happy with that proposition as well. We all agreed and left quietly to avoid any more conflict."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only the storeroom remained in hallway A. We tried to enter it together, but it was too narrow for all of us.
entries.literal: "Only the storeroom remained in hallway A. We tried to enter it together, but it was too narrow for all of us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a stretched-out, dim room. While the name implied that its purpose was to store things, the amount of space didn't allow for much of that, and it only contained a few empty shelves and a dusty couch that looked dangerous to sit in. Even the door was lower quality than the rest.
entries.literal: "It was a stretched-out, dim room. While the name implied that its purpose was to store things, the amount of space didn't allow for much of that, and it only contained a few empty shelves and a dusty couch that looked dangerous to sit in. Even the door was lower quality than the rest."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I exited the room as Akaro and Erina entered it. Sai seemed to be enjoying himself, considering different options in an attempt to "win".
entries.literal: "I exited the room as Akaro and Erina entered it. Sai seemed to be enjoying himself, considering different options in an attempt to \"win\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If we parted from the assumption that there was a plan more complex than met the eye, I had something to consider.
entries.literal: "If we parted from the assumption that there was a plan more complex than met the eye, I had something to consider."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had all assumed that the gems were stolen before the smoke was released since the curtains had been lowered. If anyone stole the gems after the attack, there was no reason to waste their time lowering the curtains again.{w} However, that was a very simple indicator of the time the gems had been stolen, and one that would not have been overlooked.
entries.literal: "We had all assumed that the gems were stolen before the smoke was released since the curtains had been lowered. If anyone stole the gems after the attack, there was no reason to waste their time lowering the curtains again.{w} However, that was a very simple indicator of the time the gems had been stolen, and one that would not have been overlooked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So, what if the curtains had been lowered again precisely for that reason? To make us, or anyone who looked at it, think that they had been stolen before the time of the attack. After all, anything else would've been a huge mistake.
entries.literal: "So, what if the curtains had been lowered again precisely for that reason? To make us, or anyone who looked at it, think that they had been stolen before the time of the attack. After all, anything else would've been a huge mistake."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't think of an immediate benefit, but deliberately misleading us about the time or reason behind an action was a potent move. That effect wouldn't have been achieved if the tower had really been robbed at night and the curtains were left down. {w} ...And realistically, even though Xyn could've been involved, how could they have emptied so many cabinets during the night? Hadn't the police been nearby? Hadn't the cameras been monitoring everything?
entries.literal: "I couldn't think of an immediate benefit, but deliberately misleading us about the time or reason behind an action was a potent move. That effect wouldn't have been achieved if the tower had really been robbed at night and the curtains were left down. {w} ...And realistically, even though Xyn could've been involved, how could they have emptied so many cabinets during the night? Hadn't the police been nearby? Hadn't the cameras been monitoring everything?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could determine if there was a better conclusion to reach, everyone left the storeroom, Katei returning last.
entries.literal: "Before I could determine if there was a better conclusion to reach, everyone left the storeroom, Katei returning last."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We didn't all have to enter. There isn't anywhere to hide in here.
entries.literal: "We didn't all have to enter. There isn't anywhere to hide in here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What's this room even for? It's called the storeroom, but there isn't much inside, and I doubt it'd be much use with how small it is.
entries.literal: "What's this room even for? It's called the storeroom, but there isn't much inside, and I doubt it'd be much use with how small it is."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Things have been stored here before, but it's true that now it looks like a useless room. I heard that this room already existed before this building started to be used for business, and it was too small to give it any other purpose.
entries.literal: "Things have been stored here before, but it's true that now it looks like a useless room. I heard that this room already existed before this building started to be used for business, and it was too small to give it any other purpose."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see...
entries.literal: "I see..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door didn't look that different from the others. However, once you opened it, the room would detract from the aesthetic the place usually had. I figured that when the building was repurposed, they replaced the door but left the inside unchanged.
entries.literal: "The door didn't look that different from the others. However, once you opened it, the room would detract from the aesthetic the place usually had. I figured that when the building was repurposed, they replaced the door but left the inside unchanged."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...So we're halfway done with this floor. Maybe we'll find something in hallway B.
entries.literal: "...So we're halfway done with this floor. Maybe we'll find something in hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To get there, we stepped into hallway C for the first time, which contained the stairs and elevator to move through the different floors.
entries.literal: "To get there, we stepped into hallway C for the first time, which contained the stairs and elevator to move through the different floors."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What's this...?
entries.literal: "What's this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something immediately caught our attention.
entries.literal: "Something immediately caught our attention."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's a suitcase, Katei.
entries.literal: "It's a suitcase, Katei."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Yes. What is it doing here?
entries.literal: "...Yes. What is it doing here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all approached it. Just like he said, a small and conspicuous black suitcase was lying in the middle of the hallway, next to the wall.
entries.literal: "We all approached it. Just like he said, a small and conspicuous black suitcase was lying in the middle of the hallway, next to the wall."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's see... There might be something inside.
entries.literal: "Let's see... There might be something inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai went ahead and unclasped it. He opened it up on the floor and exposed its interior.
entries.literal: "Sai went ahead and unclasped it. He opened it up on the floor and exposed its interior."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Nothing...?
entries.literal: "Nothing...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's disappointing, but I suppose otherwise they wouldn't have left it here.
entries.literal: "That's disappointing, but I suppose otherwise they wouldn't have left it here."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did you see this when you looked through the security cameras?
entries.literal: "Did you see this when you looked through the security cameras?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina looked at Katei. The cameras in hallway C hadn't been touched, so Katei should've been able to look through them.
entries.literal: "Erina looked at Katei. The cameras in hallway C hadn't been touched, so Katei should've been able to look through them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He didn't.
entries.literal: "He didn't."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Right. I would've told you if I had.
entries.literal: "Right. I would've told you if I had."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I see. Does that mean that it was left after we woke up?
entries.literal: "I see. Does that mean that it was left after we woke up?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, of course not. Did you not hear anything I said? He never looked through the cameras.
entries.literal: "No, of course not. Did you not hear anything I said? He never looked through the cameras."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're still going with that? I guess you'll never change your mind.
entries.literal: "You're still going with that? I guess you'll never change your mind."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I understand you can't say that you saw this suitcase since it'd be suspicious you hadn't told us, but you should give up on the lie. It's kind of pathetic.
entries.literal: "I understand you can't say that you saw this suitcase since it'd be suspicious you hadn't told us, but you should give up on the lie. It's kind of pathetic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If you really didn't see this, it would mean that someone was here after or right before we woke up. It's not impossible, but I don't find it more likely than you lying.
entries.literal: "If you really didn't see this, it would mean that someone was here after or right before we woke up. It's not impossible, but I don't find it more likely than you lying."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei looked at us. He was asking if we all thought the same, and no replies were heard.
entries.literal: "Katei looked at us. He was asking if we all thought the same, and no replies were heard."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Look at where the cameras are positioned. A bit of smoke covered them, but not enough to block the image completely.
entries.literal: "Look at where the cameras are positioned. A bit of smoke covered them, but not enough to block the image completely."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: One encompasses the bathrooms, and the other records the staircase and elevator. This middle section isn't shown at all. Even if the suitcase was here, I wouldn't have seen it. That's why none of us saw it earlier when we briefly looked through the monitors.
entries.literal: "One encompasses the bathrooms, and the other records the staircase and elevator. This middle section isn't shown at all. Even if the suitcase was here, I wouldn't have seen it. That's why none of us saw it earlier when we briefly looked through the monitors."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I figured you'd say that, but it's only an excuse. If you actually inspected this floor, there's no way you never came across it.
entries.literal: "I figured you'd say that, but it's only an excuse. If you actually inspected this floor, there's no way you never came across it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I inspected part of this floor and didn't see it. Not because I didn't come here, but because it wasn't here yet.
entries.literal: "I inspected part of this floor and didn't see it. Not because I didn't come here, but because it wasn't here yet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. It's a shame the recorded footage just so happened to stop being accessible.
entries.literal: "I see. It's a shame the recorded footage just so happened to stop being accessible."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're right, that's unfortunate. It'd be an easy way to prove myself.
entries.literal: "You're right, that's unfortunate. It'd be an easy way to prove myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Isla continued examining the suitcase, but they didn't find anything. No smaller compartments appeared to exist, so it was actually empty.
entries.literal: "Sai and Isla continued examining the suitcase, but they didn't find anything. No smaller compartments appeared to exist, so it was actually empty."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Look. I can see traces of the smoke.
entries.literal: "Look. I can see traces of the smoke."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, right. There's no way it was hit directly, though.
entries.literal: "Oh, right. There's no way it was hit directly, though."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. Perhaps it made contact with it before it had fully faded. I'm not sure.
entries.literal: "Yeah. Perhaps it made contact with it before it had fully faded. I'm not sure."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why was it left here, then? If it happened after you looked around, it's a big red flag telling us that someone else is still here.
entries.literal: "Why was it left here, then? If it happened after you looked around, it's a big red flag telling us that someone else is still here."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But we already know that. It must've been Naomi.{w} After she did something, she must've wanted to get rid of this and didn't care about leaving it here. It makes sense that she would have disabled the security system before dropping it.
entries.literal: "But we already know that. It must've been Naomi.{w} After she did something, she must've wanted to get rid of this and didn't care about leaving it here. It makes sense that she would have disabled the security system before dropping it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's stupid. Footage is still being recorded, so I doubt she'd care whether we saw her or not. Especially given that leaving the suitcase after we woke up tells us she's here.
entries.literal: "That's stupid. Footage is still being recorded, so I doubt she'd care whether we saw her or not. Especially given that leaving the suitcase after we woke up tells us she's here."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...The culprit must've wanted to get rid of the suitcase as soon as possible since it's linked to the robbery attempt. Suripo did tell us an "individual" was found outside with a black suitcase, so being seen with one wouldn't be desirable.
entries.literal: "...The culprit must've wanted to get rid of the suitcase as soon as possible since it's linked to the robbery attempt. Suripo did tell us an \"individual\" was found outside with a black suitcase, so being seen with one wouldn't be desirable."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If Katei is telling the truth, it means that whoever left it here could've only been Naomi or an unknown culprit. ...There's technically another possibility, but it's too ridiculous to consider it seriously.
entries.literal: "If Katei is telling the truth, it means that whoever left it here could've only been Naomi or an unknown culprit. ...There's technically another possibility, but it's too ridiculous to consider it seriously."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: When we went to the mechanical room, you all stayed together, right?
entries.literal: "When we went to the mechanical room, you all stayed together, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For better or worse, Sai had been thinking the same.
entries.literal: "For better or worse, Sai had been thinking the same."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes. Nobody left the security room.
entries.literal: "Yes. Nobody left the security room."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You want to suspect us this openly? Did you two get separated at all when you left?
entries.literal: "You want to suspect us this openly? Did you two get separated at all when you left?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: N-Now that you mention it, yes.{w} I went to the mechanical room while Atsuki said he would inspect the rest of this floor.
entries.literal: "N-Now that you mention it, yes.{w} I went to the mechanical room while Atsuki said he would inspect the rest of this floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.literal: "Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a strange sensation, seeing everyone turn to me while I silently waited for Sai to retract what he said.
entries.literal: "It was a strange sensation, seeing everyone turn to me while I silently waited for Sai to retract what he said."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...He's messing with you.
entries.literal: "...He's messing with you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Probably. We didn't get separated.
entries.literal: "Probably. We didn't get separated."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You aren't being funny.
entries.literal: "You aren't being funny."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, I'm just surprised you don't find us suspicious.
entries.literal: "Well, I'm just surprised you don't find us suspicious."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why would we? Even though you left, that's not enough of a reason.
entries.literal: "Why would we? Even though you left, that's not enough of a reason."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Ah, no. That's not what I meant. I think you have a good reason to suspect us.{w} Don't you remember when we got back? We said we'd gone to the bathroom, didn't we?
entries.literal: "Ah, no. That's not what I meant. I think you have a good reason to suspect us.{w} Don't you remember when we got back? We said we'd gone to the bathroom, didn't we?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Did you? I didn't hear you from under the desk.
entries.literal: "Did you? I didn't hear you from under the desk."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I bet you regret not accusing us first, then.
entries.literal: "I bet you regret not accusing us first, then."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did we go to the bathroom and miss this suitcase? It could be Katei was right and it wasn't here yet.
entries.literal: "Did we go to the bathroom and miss this suitcase? It could be Katei was right and it wasn't here yet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Don't take him seriously. We didn't go.
entries.literal: "...Don't take him seriously. We didn't go."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course. Katei wouldn't really tell the truth, would he? Admittedly, we were a bit late, so we agreed we'd say that so we weren't suspected of anything.
entries.literal: "Of course. Katei wouldn't really tell the truth, would he? Admittedly, we were a bit late, so we agreed we'd say that so we weren't suspected of anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We never came here, but I knew we should've. Didn't I tell you?
entries.literal: "We never came here, but I knew we should've. Didn't I tell you?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: So you accuse me of lying and immediately admit to lying yourself. Your arguments keep falling apart.
entries.literal: "So you accuse me of lying and immediately admit to lying yourself. Your arguments keep falling apart."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...We don't really have a way to know when this was left here, but I'd say it's likely it wasn't one of us. It must've been left by the people behind the attack.
entries.literal: "...We don't really have a way to know when this was left here, but I'd say it's likely it wasn't one of us. It must've been left by the people behind the attack."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right, and most likely before we woke up. There could be a reason why they had to leave it here.
entries.literal: "Right, and most likely before we woke up. There could be a reason why they had to leave it here."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Like what?
entries.literal: "...Like what?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No clue. I'm only saying that because the smoke wasn't released here. Even though this exact spot isn't recorded, whoever left the suitcase must've been seen by one of these two cameras.
entries.literal: "No clue. I'm only saying that because the smoke wasn't released here. Even though this exact spot isn't recorded, whoever left the suitcase must've been seen by one of these two cameras."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If you wanted to dispose of something incriminating, I'd say you'd do it in a place without cameras, and there are many.
entries.literal: "If you wanted to dispose of something incriminating, I'd say you'd do it in a place without cameras, and there are many."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's true. If it was put here after Katei inspected this floor, whoever did it is back to hiding.
entries.literal: "That's true. If it was put here after Katei inspected this floor, whoever did it is back to hiding."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Which is why we should keep investigating. Let's finish checking the crystal floor and move up.
entries.literal: "Which is why we should keep investigating. Let's finish checking the crystal floor and move up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The bathrooms were empty, so we were ready to move on. Regarding the suitcase, we weren't sure what to think, but we didn't take it with us.{w} The location where it had been discarded was the only information we had to work with. I didn't want to think too deeply into every detail, but something came to mind.
entries.literal: "The bathrooms were empty, so we were ready to move on. Regarding the suitcase, we weren't sure what to think, but we didn't take it with us.{w} The location where it had been discarded was the only information we had to work with. I didn't want to think too deeply into every detail, but something came to mind."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It could be that Katei was right this time. The location someone chose to leave the suitcase was one we hadn't yet been in.{w} If the culprit left it there before we woke up, I can't think of a reason why they wouldn't have left it in one of the two main hallways. After all, the plan only involved them and the event room at a glance. At no point was it necessary to enter hallway C, which has security cameras.
entries.literal: "It could be that Katei was right this time. The location someone chose to leave the suitcase was one we hadn't yet been in.{w} If the culprit left it there before we woke up, I can't think of a reason why they wouldn't have left it in one of the two main hallways. After all, the plan only involved them and the event room at a glance. At no point was it necessary to enter hallway C, which has security cameras."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt someone might've been nearby and had known we hadn't yet been in hallway C. They'd chosen it so that we couldn't be sure it hadn't been there the whole time. If they'd known we couldn't access the saved footage anymore, they could've tricked us. If they'd left it in one of the two parallel hallways instead, we would've immediately known it wasn't there before.
entries.literal: "I felt someone might've been nearby and had known we hadn't yet been in hallway C. They'd chosen it so that we couldn't be sure it hadn't been there the whole time. If they'd known we couldn't access the saved footage anymore, they could've tricked us. If they'd left it in one of the two parallel hallways instead, we would've immediately known it wasn't there before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In addition, that spot wasn't in range of any of the cameras, so we couldn't have seen it while we'd been in the security room.{w} ...But the trick wouldn't work on Katei, who'd already inspected the area.
entries.literal: "In addition, that spot wasn't in range of any of the cameras, so we couldn't have seen it while we'd been in the security room.{w} ...But the trick wouldn't work on Katei, who'd already inspected the area."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, there was a plethora of reasons to believe he was lying. The culprit could've known that Katei had never been in hallway C, and unaware he had lied about it, placed the suitcase to trick him as well.
entries.literal: "However, there was a plethora of reasons to believe he was lying. The culprit could've known that Katei had never been in hallway C, and unaware he had lied about it, placed the suitcase to trick him as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There weren't many better places to do that. It was true that upper floors existed, but according to Katei, they weren't open to the public. No matter the way I thought about it, it was baffling that it hadn't been left in a room without cameras like the storeroom.
entries.literal: "There weren't many better places to do that. It was true that upper floors existed, but according to Katei, they weren't open to the public. No matter the way I thought about it, it was baffling that it hadn't been left in a room without cameras like the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about it as we entered hallway B, and an ominous feeling hit me. If I was right, someone else trapped there was still very close to us.
entries.literal: "I thought about it as we entered hallway B, and an ominous feeling hit me. If I was right, someone else trapped there was still very close to us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked to the first room, which had a sign stuck on its door. When we removed the smoke dust on it, we saw an image of a mop and a bucket.
entries.literal: "We walked to the first room, which had a sign stuck on its door. When we removed the smoke dust on it, we saw an image of a mop and a bucket."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: As you see, the cleaning cart is left here when it's not in use, alongside cleaning products and items.
entries.literal: "As you see, the cleaning cart is left here when it's not in use, alongside cleaning products and items."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yeah, there's probably nothing of importance here. It's not a big room.
entries.literal: "Yeah, there's probably nothing of importance here. It's not a big room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro was the first to step inside and glance around. As he'd said, the room was small and only served the obvious purpose of storing cleaning materials. After stepping in and out, we all agreed and silently moved on to the crystal rooms in hallway B.
entries.literal: "Akaro was the first to step inside and glance around. As he'd said, the room was small and only served the obvious purpose of storing cleaning materials. After stepping in and out, we all agreed and silently moved on to the crystal rooms in hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had the first one in front—B6. Once Katei and Isla made sure nothing was off, we moved to the next door.
entries.literal: "We had the first one in front—B6. Once Katei and Isla made sure nothing was off, we moved to the next door."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: This is the staff room, right?
entries.literal: "This is the staff room, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. Visitors are not supposed to go in, but it's not locked.
entries.literal: "Yes. Visitors are not supposed to go in, but it's not locked."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: So we can't go in?
entries.literal: "So we can't go in?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Don't worry. It's fine under the circumstances.
entries.literal: "Don't worry. It's fine under the circumstances."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei opened the door. Behind it, we saw another small room, different than all the others we'd been in.
entries.literal: "Katei opened the door. Behind it, we saw another small room, different than all the others we'd been in."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Every staff member has their own space here. We use it to leave and pick up personal objects, and it's where we store our uniforms before heading off.
entries.literal: "Every staff member has their own space here. We use it to leave and pick up personal objects, and it's where we store our uniforms before heading off."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see. So the belongings of some employees are still in these lockers.
entries.literal: "I see. So the belongings of some employees are still in these lockers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla soon stopped looking interested, but for the rest of us, it was the most notable room yet.
entries.literal: "Isla soon stopped looking interested, but for the rest of us, it was the most notable room yet."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, but everyone tends to lock them.
entries.literal: "Yes, but everyone tends to lock them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's see if any are open.
entries.literal: "Let's see if any are open."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm not sure we should. We might get in trouble.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure we should. We might get in trouble."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You kidding me? There could be a phone or something in here. I'd call that incredibly useful.
entries.literal: "You kidding me? There could be a phone or something in here. I'd call that incredibly useful."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: As I said, they're not usually left open. You can check if you want.
entries.literal: "As I said, they're not usually left open. You can check if you want."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai went ahead and tried to open every locker.{w} Shortly, we confirmed that Katei was right: they were all locked tight.
entries.literal: "Sai went ahead and tried to open every locker.{w} Shortly, we confirmed that Katei was right: they were all locked tight."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You have your own locker, right? Do you keep anything that could be useful in it?
entries.literal: "You have your own locker, right? Do you keep anything that could be useful in it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No. They do allow us to bring phones in as long as we keep them here, but I never bring mine. Right now, the only thing in my locker should be my coat.
entries.literal: "No. They do allow us to bring phones in as long as we keep them here, but I never bring mine. Right now, the only thing in my locker should be my coat."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Can we see it?
entries.literal: "Can we see it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You want to see my coat?
entries.literal: "You want to see my coat?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Partly yes, but I also want to see the lack of other things.
entries.literal: "Partly yes, but I also want to see the lack of other things."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do you still think I'm lying? Very well, it's good that this is something I can easily prove.
entries.literal: "Do you still think I'm lying? Very well, it's good that this is something I can easily prove."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei took a few keys out of his pocket. One of them was the one he'd used to unlock the security room.
entries.literal: "Katei took a few keys out of his pocket. One of them was the one he'd used to unlock the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He inserted a small one into a locker and turned it. Without a problem, he opened the door and showed us what was inside.
entries.literal: "He inserted a small one into a locker and turned it. Without a problem, he opened the door and showed us what was inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We could only see a coat, but Katei went ahead and brought it out to show that nothing else was hidden behind it. He went as far as to show us every empty pocket.
entries.literal: "We could only see a coat, but Katei went ahead and brought it out to show that nothing else was hidden behind it. He went as far as to show us every empty pocket."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You see? I understand it's easy to suspect me, but I've only been telling the truth.
entries.literal: "You see? I understand it's easy to suspect me, but I've only been telling the truth."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: One truth doesn't make up for all the previous lies. Certainly, if the contents of your locker were harmful to you, you would've claimed not to have any.
entries.literal: "One truth doesn't make up for all the previous lies. Certainly, if the contents of your locker were harmful to you, you would've claimed not to have any."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I really can't make you happy. Do you have more requests that would prove my sincerity?
entries.literal: "I really can't make you happy. Do you have more requests that would prove my sincerity?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, not really.
entries.literal: "No, not really."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei put the coat back inside and locked it up again.
entries.literal: "Katei put the coat back inside and locked it up again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All the lockers were very tall and had an extra smaller compartment in their upper part. Three horizontal bars could be seen in the metallic doors, slits that allowed us to somewhat see the interior of those smaller compartments. However, I couldn't spot anything of importance, as the darkness concealed what was in them.
entries.literal: "All the lockers were very tall and had an extra smaller compartment in their upper part. Three horizontal bars could be seen in the metallic doors, slits that allowed us to somewhat see the interior of those smaller compartments. However, I couldn't spot anything of importance, as the darkness concealed what was in them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone was listening closely to the conversations between Katei and Sai. Sai had continually reiterated that Katei was openly lying to us, so it was no surprise that they wanted to form their own thoughts.
entries.literal: "Everyone was listening closely to the conversations between Katei and Sai. Sai had continually reiterated that Katei was openly lying to us, so it was no surprise that they wanted to form their own thoughts."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Sai knew nothing would be found inside the locker, so I suspect he wanted to see that coat. If it was the same one he'd seen Katei wearing in the lobby, it could back up his identity.
entries.literal: "Sai knew nothing would be found inside the locker, so I suspect he wanted to see that coat. If it was the same one he'd seen Katei wearing in the lobby, it could back up his identity."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Since he didn't react to it, it's fair to assume it was the same one, but it doesn't settle anything. One extra step of his impersonation plan could've involved changing the locker's contents while we were unconscious.
entries.literal: "Since he didn't react to it, it's fair to assume it was the same one, but it doesn't settle anything. One extra step of his impersonation plan could've involved changing the locker's contents while we were unconscious."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Could there be a way to force open the lockers? One of them must be Naomi's, so it'd be interesting to look inside it.
entries.literal: "Could there be a way to force open the lockers? One of them must be Naomi's, so it'd be interesting to look inside it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? No, please don't think about that. There are no tools to do it with, the lockers are quite sturdy, and I'm sure Ashiya would not be happy about it.
entries.literal: "What? No, please don't think about that. There are no tools to do it with, the lockers are quite sturdy, and I'm sure Ashiya would not be happy about it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Similarly, I'm not happy with spending twelve boring hours here without getting to conclusions. Right now, Naomi is very suspicious.
entries.literal: "Similarly, I'm not happy with spending twelve boring hours here without getting to conclusions. Right now, Naomi is very suspicious."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: And what if she is? What do you think you'll find inside her locker? I'm letting you overstep a little. You shouldn't be allowed in this room, but I will not be giving you free reign. Please, get this idea out of your head.
entries.literal: "And what if she is? What do you think you'll find inside her locker? I'm letting you overstep a little. You shouldn't be allowed in this room, but I will not be giving you free reign. Please, get this idea out of your head."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'll keep thinking whatever I want, but I agree. It'd probably be a worthless hassle. If Naomi is the culprit, she must know how suspicious she is, so she wouldn't have left anything relevant in her locker.
entries.literal: "I'll keep thinking whatever I want, but I agree. It'd probably be a worthless hassle. If Naomi is the culprit, she must know how suspicious she is, so she wouldn't have left anything relevant in her locker."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...That's what I'm saying.
entries.literal: "...That's what I'm saying."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla tugged at Erina's clothes.
entries.literal: "Isla tugged at Erina's clothes."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Let's go. There's nothing in here...
entries.literal: "Let's go. There's nothing in here..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We kept moving at a good pace until we had searched through the remaining five crystal rooms in hallway B. They all looked the same, and nothing felt out of place.
entries.literal: "We kept moving at a good pace until we had searched through the remaining five crystal rooms in hallway B. They all looked the same, and nothing felt out of place."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: This is it. We knew that if someone was hiding, it wouldn't be easy to find them.
entries.literal: "This is it. We knew that if someone was hiding, it wouldn't be easy to find them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. It's already past {time=10.} One more person is confirmed to be with us, so if she hasn't appeared yet, she must not intend to show herself.
entries.literal: "Yeah. It's already past {time=10.} One more person is confirmed to be with us, so if she hasn't appeared yet, she must not intend to show herself."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Sai and I considered that Naomi's body might've been hidden. If that's what happened, it's likely no one else is hiding. The main point that indicates otherwise is the suitcase, but if Katei lied about it, he could be the one who hid Naomi.
entries.literal: "...Sai and I considered that Naomi's body might've been hidden. If that's what happened, it's likely no one else is hiding. The main point that indicates otherwise is the suitcase, but if Katei lied about it, he could be the one who hid Naomi."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We'll have to move up, then. We might find something on the higher floors.
entries.literal: "We'll have to move up, then. We might find something on the higher floors."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Our priority should be to understand the structure of this place and find Naomi. We'll have many hours to go after that, which won't make it easy for anyone to stay hidden.
entries.literal: "Our priority should be to understand the structure of this place and find Naomi. We'll have many hours to go after that, which won't make it easy for anyone to stay hidden."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We approached the hallway C staircase.
entries.literal: "We approached the hallway C staircase."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Only employees ever go to the other floors. The structure of this building is like this...
entries.literal: "Only employees ever go to the other floors. The structure of this building is like this..."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Right now, we are on the crystal floor. The five floors above us are offices, and they were empty during the attack.
entries.literal: "Right now, we are on the crystal floor. The five floors above us are offices, and they were empty during the attack."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Why are there so many offices?
entries.literal: "Why are there so many offices?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: When the structure of the building was first expanded, it served the purpose of containing many offices that worked for Ashiya. This was before they thought of using the lowest floor as a sort of museum.
entries.literal: "When the structure of the building was first expanded, it served the purpose of containing many offices that worked for Ashiya. This was before they thought of using the lowest floor as a sort of museum."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That was the case for a while, until the perception people had of this place shifted to what it is now: the single remaining entity of Ashiya in Yushibana and a tourist attraction point.
entries.literal: "That was the case for a while, until the perception people had of this place shifted to what it is now: the single remaining entity of Ashiya in Yushibana and a tourist attraction point."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Nowadays, not many people who work in the offices remain, and they closed entirely just this December. Ashiya doesn't make much use of them anymore, so they might disappear and be reworked eventually.
entries.literal: "Nowadays, not many people who work in the offices remain, and they closed entirely just this December. Ashiya doesn't make much use of them anymore, so they might disappear and be reworked eventually."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The seventh floor is the Ashiya floor, also called the attic. I explained that one earlier.
entries.literal: "The seventh floor is the Ashiya floor, also called the attic. I explained that one earlier."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Can we go in there?
entries.literal: "Can we go in there?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There's no way. As I said, I've never entered it, and only a handful of people who remain here have. Ashiya are very fond of it since it's where they once lived, or at least that's what they claim. Regardless of the reason, they want to preserve it well.
entries.literal: "There's no way. As I said, I've never entered it, and only a handful of people who remain here have. Ashiya are very fond of it since it's where they once lived, or at least that's what they claim. Regardless of the reason, they want to preserve it well."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How would we go about getting in?
entries.literal: "How would we go about getting in?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Like most places, you enter with a key. One that I don't have.
entries.literal: "Like most places, you enter with a key. One that I don't have."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei pointed his finger up the stairs, where a door prevented us from making it all the way up.
entries.literal: "Katei pointed his finger up the stairs, where a door prevented us from making it all the way up."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I have the key for this one since it only keeps us from accessing the offices.
entries.literal: "I have the key for this one since it only keeps us from accessing the offices."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He walked up and inserted another key of his in the keyhole. As he'd already done twice, he turned it.
entries.literal: "He walked up and inserted another key of his in the keyhole. As he'd already done twice, he turned it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unlike previously, however, the door didn't appear to smoothly unlock.
entries.literal: "Unlike previously, however, the door didn't appear to smoothly unlock."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? It's not letting me.
entries.literal: "What? It's not letting me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hold on.
entries.literal: "Hold on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai stepped up to him, twisted the knob, and pushed the door forward.
entries.literal: "Sai stepped up to him, twisted the knob, and pushed the door forward."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was open.
entries.literal: "It was open."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: O-Oh... That's strange. Sometimes this door is left open, but it's weird that it was now. Nobody has worked upstairs for two weeks.
entries.literal: "O-Oh... That's strange. Sometimes this door is left open, but it's weird that it was now. Nobody has worked upstairs for two weeks."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not really strange. Naomi also had the key, right? It just means that she probably opened it or someone did with her key. If it was you, you're not very good at remembering whether you locked a door.
entries.literal: "It's not really strange. Naomi also had the key, right? It just means that she probably opened it or someone did with her key. If it was you, you're not very good at remembering whether you locked a door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'll ask one more time so you guys understand it better. Katei, you did not see anyone when you looked through the security cameras, right?
entries.literal: "I'll ask one more time so you guys understand it better. Katei, you did not see anyone when you looked through the security cameras, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Correct.
entries.literal: "...Correct."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then, once again, that's strange. It's very likely someone unlocked this door and went through it. If they wanted to hide from us, they wouldn't have done so on this floor, meaning that it's likely they went up some floors before we woke up and while you were allegedly in the security room.
entries.literal: "Then, once again, that's strange. It's very likely someone unlocked this door and went through it. If they wanted to hide from us, they wouldn't have done so on this floor, meaning that it's likely they went up some floors before we woke up and while you were allegedly in the security room."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You won't stop trying to find ways to frame me, will you?{w} You're wrong. They would've known I was inside the security room and must've only gone up when they saw I'd left it.
entries.literal: "You won't stop trying to find ways to frame me, will you?{w} You're wrong. They would've known I was inside the security room and must've only gone up when they saw I'd left it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei was right. Sai's thoughts operated under the assumption that Katei hadn't been in the room, so he hadn't considered that simple angle.
entries.literal: "Katei was right. Sai's thoughts operated under the assumption that Katei hadn't been in the room, so he hadn't considered that simple angle."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, let's go up. I bet the person we're searching for is currently above us.
entries.literal: "Well, let's go up. I bet the person we're searching for is currently above us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We began to climb up the stairs.
entries.literal: "We began to climb up the stairs."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Can't we take the elevator? There's a lot of stairs to get to the top, right?
entries.literal: "Can't we take the elevator? There's a lot of stairs to get to the top, right?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The elevator...? I'm not sure that'd be appropriate.
entries.literal: "The elevator...? I'm not sure that'd be appropriate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all slowly stepped down. We had entirely ignored the elevator.
entries.literal: "We all slowly stepped down. We had entirely ignored the elevator."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There shouldn't be an issue.
entries.literal: "There shouldn't be an issue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator door was fully metallic, so we weren't able to see the inside without opening it. Next to it was the button to call it with, and nowhere did it indicate whether it was being used or on which floor it was situated.
entries.literal: "The elevator door was fully metallic, so we weren't able to see the inside without opening it. Next to it was the button to call it with, and nowhere did it indicate whether it was being used or on which floor it was situated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei called it quietly. Many seconds later, the button lit up for a second, indicating that the elevator had arrived. Then, Katei opened the door, exposing an empty and narrow interior.
entries.literal: "Katei called it quietly. Many seconds later, the button lit up for a second, indicating that the elevator had arrived. Then, Katei opened the door, exposing an empty and narrow interior."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It wasn't on this floor... It took a while, so it must've been pretty high up.
entries.literal: "It wasn't on this floor... It took a while, so it must've been pretty high up."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That doesn't mean anything, does it? It could've been up before today's event even started.
entries.literal: "That doesn't mean anything, does it? It could've been up before today's event even started."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right. Katei, do you happen to know where the elevator should've been?
entries.literal: "You're right. Katei, do you happen to know where the elevator should've been?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Not at all. I didn't have the night shift, and I didn't see it being used.
entries.literal: "Not at all. I didn't have the night shift, and I didn't see it being used."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It'd be good to know when it last moved.
entries.literal: "It'd be good to know when it last moved."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Doesn't this elevator bypass the door in the middle of the staircase?
entries.literal: "Doesn't this elevator bypass the door in the middle of the staircase?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, it does.
entries.literal: "Yes, it does."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Then what's the point of locking it...?
entries.literal: "Then what's the point of locking it...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I just said that it's not unusual for it to be left unlocked. In the past, when the offices were actively used, measures were stricter. Since nothing ever happened, everyone started to be more lenient, often leaving the door unlocked.
entries.literal: "I just said that it's not unusual for it to be left unlocked. In the past, when the offices were actively used, measures were stricter. Since nothing ever happened, everyone started to be more lenient, often leaving the door unlocked."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: A similar change occurred to the elevator. Look inside.
entries.literal: "A similar change occurred to the elevator. Look inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all peeked in. What Katei was referring to was above the floor buttons.
entries.literal: "We all peeked in. What Katei was referring to was above the floor buttons."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Keyholes? Do you need a key to make the elevator move?
entries.literal: "Keyholes? Do you need a key to make the elevator move?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: In the past, you needed the same key that opens the door to reach floors 2 to 6 from here. That regulation was removed since the door was continuously left open and there were some complaints about it being pointless.
entries.literal: "In the past, you needed the same key that opens the door to reach floors 2 to 6 from here. That regulation was removed since the door was continuously left open and there were some complaints about it being pointless."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: However, this other keyhole is still mandatory. To reach floor 7—the attic—a special key is needed. The same key opens the door that leads up to it.
entries.literal: "However, this other keyhole is still mandatory. To reach floor 7—the attic—a special key is needed. The same key opens the door that leads up to it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So that's the only floor we can't get to at all.
entries.literal: "So that's the only floor we can't get to at all."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Right.
entries.literal: "Right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla hopped into the elevator by herself, causing Erina to gasp slightly.
entries.literal: "Isla hopped into the elevator by herself, causing Erina to gasp slightly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is interesting, actually.
entries.literal: "This is interesting, actually."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What is?
entries.literal: "...What is?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, whoever went up to hide from us used the door instead of the elevator.
entries.literal: "Well, whoever went up to hide from us used the door instead of the elevator."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're right. They wouldn't have needed to.
entries.literal: "You're right. They wouldn't have needed to."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't think so, at least. If it's true that it should've been locked, by leaving it unlocked, they're telling us they possess the key.{w} Naomi wouldn't do that purposely because it makes her suspicious. It's possible someone who's not a staff member unlocked the door.
entries.literal: "I don't think so, at least. If it's true that it should've been locked, by leaving it unlocked, they're telling us they possess the key.{w} Naomi wouldn't do that purposely because it makes her suspicious. It's possible someone who's not a staff member unlocked the door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see what you mean. There could've been a reason why they didn't use the elevator instead.
entries.literal: "I see what you mean. There could've been a reason why they didn't use the elevator instead."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: For example?
entries.literal: "For example?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, if the elevator wasn't on this floor, and the culprit knew it while they were in a hurry, they would've gone through the door instead of waiting for the elevator to arrive.
entries.literal: "Well, if the elevator wasn't on this floor, and the culprit knew it while they were in a hurry, they would've gone through the door instead of waiting for the elevator to arrive."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose so.
entries.literal: "I suppose so."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's a bit strange they didn't lock the door behind them, but there's any number of reasons for that.
entries.literal: "It's a bit strange they didn't lock the door behind them, but there's any number of reasons for that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm. This should help us visualize this person's movements a bit more.
entries.literal: "Hm. This should help us visualize this person's movements a bit more."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Are we going to go up?
entries.literal: "Are we going to go up?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Don't be impatient. We can't all go up at once.
entries.literal: "Don't be impatient. We can't all go up at once."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With Katei keeping the door open, I was able to see why he'd said that. Inside the elevator was a sign indicating the number of people that could board it before the weight could prove a problem.
entries.literal: "With Katei keeping the door open, I was able to see why he'd said that. Inside the elevator was a sign indicating the number of people that could board it before the weight could prove a problem."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Only four of us can be inside at once. It's a fairly old elevator.{w} The stairs really aren't so bad, so let's walk up.
entries.literal: "Only four of us can be inside at once. It's a fairly old elevator.{w} The stairs really aren't so bad, so let's walk up."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No! I wanna use the elevator.
entries.literal: "No! I wanna use the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...We hadn't yet had an issue with Isla's behavior, so we didn't want something so trivial to put an end to that.
entries.literal: "...We hadn't yet had an issue with Isla's behavior, so we didn't want something so trivial to put an end to that."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Sweetie, come on. We can't demand things like this.
entries.literal: "Sweetie, come on. We can't demand things like this."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I wanna use the elevator... If not, I can just stay on this floor and go back to the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I wanna use the elevator... If not, I can just stay on this floor and go back to the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's fine. We've already spent a while investigating, and it's getting old. Let's move it along.
entries.literal: "It's fine. We've already spent a while investigating, and it's getting old. Let's move it along."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If someone's hiding from us and we want to find them, we won't accomplish it if we stay together. The culprit has an elevator, stairs, and knowledge of the layout. Much like on this floor, they could easily avoid us.
entries.literal: "If someone's hiding from us and we want to find them, we won't accomplish it if we stay together. The culprit has an elevator, stairs, and knowledge of the layout. Much like on this floor, they could easily avoid us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: To speed it up and increase our chances of finding them, let's split into two groups.
entries.literal: "To speed it up and increase our chances of finding them, let's split into two groups."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Weren't you against that earlier?
entries.literal: "Weren't you against that earlier?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm fine with it depending on the groups. Isla and Erina will take the elevator up to the sixth floor. As long as Atsuki and Shiroya go up with them, it should be all right.
entries.literal: "I'm fine with it depending on the groups. Isla and Erina will take the elevator up to the sixth floor. As long as Atsuki and Shiroya go up with them, it should be all right."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why us?
entries.literal: "Why us?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: To isolate the least suspicious people, of course. A problem with splitting up would be if someone could take advantage of it before we're able to thoroughly inspect this building. Katei, Akaro, and I will start with floor 2 and progress upward until we meet you guys again.
entries.literal: "To isolate the least suspicious people, of course. A problem with splitting up would be if someone could take advantage of it before we're able to thoroughly inspect this building. Katei, Akaro, and I will start with floor 2 and progress upward until we meet you guys again."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Okay!
entries.literal: "Okay!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is that a good idea...?
entries.literal: "Is that a good idea...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Any reason why it's a bad one?
entries.literal: "Any reason why it's a bad one?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's fine by me, but we don't have to do it like this. We could use the elevator twice or simply take it to the second floor.
entries.literal: "It's fine by me, but we don't have to do it like this. We could use the elevator twice or simply take it to the second floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at everyone else, and their reactions indicated indifference toward Sai's arrangement. It was true that it'd increase our speed and chances of finding the culprit, and as long as Isla's whim was satisfied, she wouldn't complain.
entries.literal: "I looked at everyone else, and their reactions indicated indifference toward Sai's arrangement. It was true that it'd increase our speed and chances of finding the culprit, and as long as Isla's whim was satisfied, she wouldn't complain."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right, let's go.
entries.literal: "All right, let's go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai went up the stairs and quickly disappeared from my field of vision. Akaro and Katei followed him, and I held the door Katei had kept open until then.
entries.literal: "Sai went up the stairs and quickly disappeared from my field of vision. Akaro and Katei followed him, and I held the door Katei had kept open until then."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Let's go too.
entries.literal: "...Let's go too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla went in first, followed by her mother. After Shiroya had entered, I boarded it last and closed the door behind us.
entries.literal: "Isla went in first, followed by her mother. After Shiroya had entered, I boarded it last and closed the door behind us."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: This isn't exactly spacious. I'm surprised it's supposed to support four people.
entries.literal: "This isn't exactly spacious. I'm surprised it's supposed to support four people."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the cramped space, Shiroya moved her finger up to the floor 6 button. Admittedly, she was right, since Isla didn't occupy the space of an adult and ended up buried in the back.
entries.literal: "In the cramped space, Shiroya moved her finger up to the floor 6 button. Admittedly, she was right, since Isla didn't occupy the space of an adult and ended up buried in the back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as the button was pressed, the translucent secondary doors closed, and we slowly began to rise.
entries.literal: "As soon as the button was pressed, the translucent secondary doors closed, and we slowly began to rise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=0.6}The elevator didn't shake at all, so we only knew we were moving because of the screechy noise the ropes above us were making.
entries.literal: "{w=0.6}The elevator didn't shake at all, so we only knew we were moving because of the screechy noise the ropes above us were making."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=0.6}They were a quiet few seconds, and since the doors to the other floors were fully opaque, they were also dim. I felt a vague sense of claustrophobia for the first time since we had awakened.
entries.literal: "{w=0.6}They were a quiet few seconds, and since the doors to the other floors were fully opaque, they were also dim. I felt a vague sense of claustrophobia for the first time since we had awakened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=0.6}Once the elevator slowed down and we were allowed to leave, I opened the door that would lead us to an unknown place.
entries.literal: "{w=0.6}Once the elevator slowed down and we were allowed to leave, I opened the door that would lead us to an unknown place."

entries.text: Line Art
entries.literal: "Line Art"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=0.6}We stepped out and looked around us. A long hallway composed of calm colors extended far ahead.
entries.literal: "{w=0.6}We stepped out and looked around us. A long hallway composed of calm colors extended far ahead."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Is this really the same building?
entries.literal: "...Is this really the same building?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Compared to what we'd seen downstairs, it was far more pleasant. We even felt a slight cold breeze that alleviated some of the tension we'd been accumulating.
entries.literal: "Compared to what we'd seen downstairs, it was far more pleasant. We even felt a slight cold breeze that alleviated some of the tension we'd been accumulating."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: More bathrooms?
entries.literal: "More bathrooms?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Since people used to work here, there might be two on every floor.
entries.literal: "Since people used to work here, there might be two on every floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Outside the elevator, we found ourselves in a wide corridor that only contained a few potted plants. At our right were the bathrooms and the staircase that led to floor 5.
entries.literal: "Outside the elevator, we found ourselves in a wide corridor that only contained a few potted plants. At our right were the bathrooms and the staircase that led to floor 5."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I suppose we should look around.
entries.literal: "I suppose we should look around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other three entered their bathroom while I stepped into the men's by myself. Like the one on the crystal floor, it was spacious, but only contained a sink with a mirror, a garbage bin, and a toilet. It was immediately evident that I was the only person inside.
entries.literal: "The other three entered their bathroom while I stepped into the men's by myself. Like the one on the crystal floor, it was spacious, but only contained a sink with a mirror, a garbage bin, and a toilet. It was immediately evident that I was the only person inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although a potentially dangerous culprit might've been hiding from us, I loosened up a little. The thought of looking through those huge floors without restriction released some strain from my body, which allowed me to think about needs that had disappeared from my mind, like using the bathroom for its intended purpose.
entries.literal: "Although a potentially dangerous culprit might've been hiding from us, I loosened up a little. The thought of looking through those huge floors without restriction released some strain from my body, which allowed me to think about needs that had disappeared from my mind, like using the bathroom for its intended purpose."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Outside, I found the others waiting for me behind the door, and we went ahead to see if anything of importance awaited us nearby.
entries.literal: "Outside, I found the others waiting for me behind the door, and we went ahead to see if anything of importance awaited us nearby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We turned left past the large hallway and were met with a narrower path whose left wall was made of glass.
entries.literal: "We turned left past the large hallway and were met with a narrower path whose left wall was made of glass."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What's this?
entries.literal: "What's this?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: These must be the offices. I can only see desks and computers.
entries.literal: "These must be the offices. I can only see desks and computers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya felt the handle and realized that the door wasn't locked. She easily pushed it open without making a sound and let us pass.
entries.literal: "Shiroya felt the handle and realized that the door wasn't locked. She easily pushed it open without making a sound and let us pass."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: There's another door in the back. This floor is as big as the first one, so it must have a bunch of these to fill the space.
entries.literal: "There's another door in the back. This floor is as big as the first one, so it must have a bunch of these to fill the space."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla walked up to the far door and opened it.
entries.literal: "Isla walked up to the far door and opened it."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: It looks the same.
entries.literal: "It looks the same."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We glanced through it and saw a replica of the room. It looked identical down to the last object, with the same arrangement of desks and computers.
entries.literal: "We glanced through it and saw a replica of the room. It looked identical down to the last object, with the same arrangement of desks and computers."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There's another door there.
entries.literal: "There's another door there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We approached it. Although the first wall was made of glass, the next two partitions were separated by plastic that heavily obscured the other side.
entries.literal: "We approached it. Although the first wall was made of glass, the next two partitions were separated by plastic that heavily obscured the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=0.6}Through the door, we were able to see that, once again, the third section looked exactly like the first two. The exception was the lack of a door leading to a fourth.
entries.literal: "{w=0.6}Through the door, we were able to see that, once again, the third section looked exactly like the first two. The exception was the lack of a door leading to a fourth."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though the initial concept of inspecting a huge building had sounded somewhat involved, the layout made it a trivial task.
entries.literal: "Even though the initial concept of inspecting a huge building had sounded somewhat involved, the layout made it a trivial task."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There's nothing here either.
entries.literal: "There's nothing here either."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's look around a bit. I doubt it, but we might find something.
entries.literal: "Let's look around a bit. I doubt it, but we might find something."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. Let's see.
entries.literal: "Yeah. Let's see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We dispersed ourselves throughout the three large partitions, and I was left with the third one. The desks all had drawers, but upon further inspection, they didn't contain anything relevant to us. The only thing of note was that each desk contained a computer tower inside its lower, larger compartment.
entries.literal: "We dispersed ourselves throughout the three large partitions, and I was left with the third one. The desks all had drawers, but upon further inspection, they didn't contain anything relevant to us. The only thing of note was that each desk contained a computer tower inside its lower, larger compartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I returned to the second partition.
entries.literal: "I returned to the second partition."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There are even cameras here?
entries.literal: "There are even cameras here?"

entries.speaker: s
