entries.text: Yeah, I saw them. They do look a bit out of place.{w} No idea what they're so paranoid about.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I saw them. They do look a bit out of place.{w} No idea what they're so paranoid about."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure these would help them much.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure these would help them much."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Maybe it was to make sure the workers here didn't slack off.
entries.literal: "Maybe it was to make sure the workers here didn't slack off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though it had sounded like a joke, I understood she hadn't intended it as one. After all, in the second and third partitions, you couldn't be seen from outside. The wall covered the partitions' sides, and a cloudy white one kept them from seeing each other. It was a pretty cramped place, and I couldn't imagine myself working calmly with that camera pointed at me.
entries.literal: "Even though it had sounded like a joke, I understood she hadn't intended it as one. After all, in the second and third partitions, you couldn't be seen from outside. The wall covered the partitions' sides, and a cloudy white one kept them from seeing each other. It was a pretty cramped place, and I couldn't imagine myself working calmly with that camera pointed at me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure what the jobs there entailed, but judging from the number of computers, a large amount of people must've worked at once. Adding the fact that five similar floors were supposed to exist, it felt a bit excessive.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure what the jobs there entailed, but judging from the number of computers, a large amount of people must've worked at once. Adding the fact that five similar floors were supposed to exist, it felt a bit excessive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped into the first partition to see Erina and Isla looking at a lit screen. Upon noticing me, they were first to speak.
entries.literal: "I stepped into the first partition to see Erina and Isla looking at a lit screen. Upon noticing me, they were first to speak."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I powered on this computer, but it's taking a while to boot up.
entries.literal: "I powered on this computer, but it's taking a while to boot up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the screen, I could see a progress bar that was nearly finished. I briefly worried that Ashiya would review the footage of us using the computers, but it wasn't like we were doing anything illicit.
entries.literal: "On the screen, I could see a progress bar that was nearly finished. I briefly worried that Ashiya would review the footage of us using the computers, but it wasn't like we were doing anything illicit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, Shiroya came from the middle partition and the four of us stared at the same screen.
entries.literal: "Soon, Shiroya came from the middle partition and the four of us stared at the same screen."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Found anything?
entries.literal: "...Found anything?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, and I don't imagine we will.
entries.literal: "No, and I don't imagine we will."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see. I haven't either.
entries.literal: "I see. I haven't either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla was mimicking what she'd seen Shiroya do, opening and closing the drawers. She appeared visibly sad when the last one still contained only pens and papers.
entries.literal: "Isla was mimicking what she'd seen Shiroya do, opening and closing the drawers. She appeared visibly sad when the last one still contained only pens and papers."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, look. I doubt we'll be able to access anything.
entries.literal: "Oh, look. I doubt we'll be able to access anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the screen were two text boxes demanding a username and a password. Without them, we wouldn't be able to look at anything.
entries.literal: "On the screen were two text boxes demanding a username and a password. Without them, we wouldn't be able to look at anything."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's unfortunate.
entries.literal: "That's unfortunate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just in case, I tried inputting common default information, but nothing yielded a positive result.
entries.literal: "Just in case, I tried inputting common default information, but nothing yielded a positive result."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, these won't be any use.
entries.literal: "Yeah, these won't be any use."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gave up and straightened myself.
entries.literal: "I gave up and straightened myself."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Let's keep going. The lower floors will probably be the same, so we'll go through them faster.
entries.literal: "Let's keep going. The lower floors will probably be the same, so we'll go through them faster."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: The stairs leading to floor 5 were next to the elevator, but let's see what's on the other side first.
entries.literal: "The stairs leading to floor 5 were next to the elevator, but let's see what's on the other side first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked out, Isla holding the door for us. Shiroya gave her a charming smile and helped her before Erina exited.
entries.literal: "We walked out, Isla holding the door for us. Shiroya gave her a charming smile and helped her before Erina exited."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as we turned left, we were met with something I'd seen from behind the glass.
entries.literal: "As soon as we turned left, we were met with something I'd seen from behind the glass."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What's that for?
entries.literal: "What's that for?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, right, I forgot about these.
entries.literal: "Oh, right, I forgot about these."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two big windows were in the wall, but as we'd been told, a shutter prevented us from seeing through them.
entries.literal: "Two big windows were in the wall, but as we'd been told, a shutter prevented us from seeing through them."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yeah, they're the windows. These are the same kind of shutter as the one in the lobby.
entries.literal: "Yeah, they're the windows. These are the same kind of shutter as the one in the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla made a thinking sound. I also hadn't thought of the windows, and since they were barely visible from the first partition, their purpose must not have been to relax the workers.
entries.literal: "Isla made a thinking sound. I also hadn't thought of the windows, and since they were barely visible from the first partition, their purpose must not have been to relax the workers."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I remember seeing them from outside.
entries.literal: "I remember seeing them from outside."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, they should be facing the front of the tower. We'd normally be able to see most of Yushibana from here.
entries.literal: "Yes, they should be facing the front of the tower. We'd normally be able to see most of Yushibana from here."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I knew it.
entries.literal: "I knew it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla approached the shutters with her hand and felt them a bit. They seemed properly sturdy.
entries.literal: "Isla approached the shutters with her hand and felt them a bit. They seemed properly sturdy."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm not sure this would be the most viable escape route for a criminal. We're on the sixth floor, so to escape through here, you'd definitely need special help.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure this would be the most viable escape route for a criminal. We're on the sixth floor, so to escape through here, you'd definitely need special help."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. They took no risks this time.
entries.literal: "Yeah. They took no risks this time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm. It would be tough, but even this window could serve as an exit with a proper plan.
entries.literal: "Hm. It would be tough, but even this window could serve as an exit with a proper plan."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, who had been acting as if she were at home, left us behind and went to explore what looked to be another corridor.
entries.literal: "Isla, who had been acting as if she were at home, left us behind and went to explore what looked to be another corridor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After understanding that nothing was to be done with the windows, we moved along too.
entries.literal: "After understanding that nothing was to be done with the windows, we moved along too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A narrower path was on the other side of the floor. However, it didn't appear to lead anywhere.
entries.literal: "A narrower path was on the other side of the floor. However, it didn't appear to lead anywhere."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Is it a dead end?
entries.literal: "Is it a dead end?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh.
entries.literal: "Oh."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla turned around when she realized it.
entries.literal: "Isla turned around when she realized it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As nothing else was left to be inspected, we walked back and returned to the initial hallway.
entries.literal: "As nothing else was left to be inspected, we walked back and returned to the initial hallway."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I guess this was floor 6. Let's see if anything's different on the others.
entries.literal: "I guess this was floor 6. Let's see if anything's different on the others."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We came to the conclusion that it's very likely the culprit is here, so this layout makes things easy for us.
entries.literal: "We came to the conclusion that it's very likely the culprit is here, so this layout makes things easy for us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We arrived on floor 5 in silence. It looked very similar to the sixth, and it had the same bathrooms at our right.
entries.literal: "We arrived on floor 5 in silence. It looked very similar to the sixth, and it had the same bathrooms at our right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked at them while making sure nobody could sneak past us and go a floor up. At first glance, the floor appeared to have the same structure as the previous.
entries.literal: "We looked at them while making sure nobody could sneak past us and go a floor up. At first glance, the floor appeared to have the same structure as the previous."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I inspected one of the plants just to be safe.
entries.literal: "I inspected one of the plants just to be safe."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The soil in these is actually really shallow. I don't think anyone could hide something in here.
entries.literal: "The soil in these is actually really shallow. I don't think anyone could hide something in here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The pots themselves weren't hollow, either. Nobody could hide anything underneath them. I didn't think anyone had, but in case there was still something else going on, I wanted to have my bases covered.
entries.literal: "The pots themselves weren't hollow, either. Nobody could hide anything underneath them. I didn't think anyone had, but in case there was still something else going on, I wanted to have my bases covered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't actually tell if the plants were fake or not.
entries.literal: "I couldn't actually tell if the plants were fake or not."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I visualized the layout of the floors in my head as I considered how unlikely it actually was for someone to be hiding in them.
entries.literal: "I visualized the layout of the floors in my head as I considered how unlikely it actually was for someone to be hiding in them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After walking farther into it, it was clear that it was almost identical.
entries.literal: "After walking farther into it, it was clear that it was almost identical."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Is every floor exactly like this?
entries.literal: "Is every floor exactly like this?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: They probably are, but we'll have to look at them to be sure.
entries.literal: "They probably are, but we'll have to look at them to be sure."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Why is this place so big?
entries.literal: "Why is this place so big?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Come on, Isla. You're bothering Shiroya and Atsuki. We need to keep moving.
entries.literal: "Come on, Isla. You're bothering Shiroya and Atsuki. We need to keep moving."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: As long as someone stays in the first partition and can look through the glass, we can make sure nobody moves between the floors unseen.
entries.literal: "As long as someone stays in the first partition and can look through the glass, we can make sure nobody moves between the floors unseen."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Right. One person always needs to stay out of the last two.
entries.literal: "Right. One person always needs to stay out of the last two."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: All right.
entries.literal: "All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since we'd seen no stairs going down, I walked to the other side.
entries.literal: "Since we'd seen no stairs going down, I walked to the other side."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, that's what I figured. The stairs to the fourth floor are here.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that's what I figured. The stairs to the fourth floor are here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked back as the others entered the first partition. Once again, the four of us found ourselves in a room full of desks and computers.
entries.literal: "I walked back as the others entered the first partition. Once again, the four of us found ourselves in a room full of desks and computers."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I've been trying not to think about it, but what if there's someone in one of the next two rooms? What do we plan to do?
entries.literal: "I've been trying not to think about it, but what if there's someone in one of the next two rooms? What do we plan to do?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went quiet for a bit.
entries.literal: "We went quiet for a bit."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: She's right. We've been going about this with a light-hearted attitude, but things can change drastically in an instant.
entries.literal: "She's right. We've been going about this with a light-hearted attitude, but things can change drastically in an instant."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: We don't know what we're up against, but the truth of the matter is that we're in a dangerous situation. Maybe we should just stay put.
entries.literal: "We don't know what we're up against, but the truth of the matter is that we're in a dangerous situation. Maybe we should just stay put."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without Sai around, that sounded a lot smarter. Erina'd been playing along with us, but she was almost definitely afraid something could happen to Isla.
entries.literal: "Without Sai around, that sounded a lot smarter. Erina'd been playing along with us, but she was almost definitely afraid something could happen to Isla."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I doubt they'd want to hurt us, but without Akaro, our only physical advantage is that there are four of us. ...Although I guess if someone's hiding, nothing guarantees it's only one person.
entries.literal: "I doubt they'd want to hurt us, but without Akaro, our only physical advantage is that there are four of us. ...Although I guess if someone's hiding, nothing guarantees it's only one person."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As our perspective on the situation shifted over a single comment, I slowly moved toward the door in front of me.
entries.literal: "As our perspective on the situation shifted over a single comment, I slowly moved toward the door in front of me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though those walls weren't transparent, they let light through. If someone were right next to them, we'd see a fuzzy outline of them. Slightly tense, I placed my hand on the handle and slowly opened the door.
entries.literal: "Even though those walls weren't transparent, they let light through. If someone were right next to them, we'd see a fuzzy outline of them. Slightly tense, I placed my hand on the handle and slowly opened the door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I don't see anybody. I'll check the last one.
entries.literal: "...I don't see anybody. I'll check the last one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya kept the door open so that my voice could still reach the first partition. I grabbed the next handle and pushed the door forward.
entries.literal: "Shiroya kept the door open so that my voice could still reach the first partition. I grabbed the next handle and pushed the door forward."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's empty too.
entries.literal: "It's empty too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I loosened my grip and walked back to the others. It seemed nobody had been on floor 5 either.
entries.literal: "I loosened my grip and walked back to the others. It seemed nobody had been on floor 5 either."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Should we also look around here?
entries.literal: "Should we also look around here?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We probably won't find anything, but I think we should.
entries.literal: "We probably won't find anything, but I think we should."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I agree. We're not only looking for people. In the instance that the culprit wanted to get rid of something like they probably did with the suitcase, they wouldn't have had many places to do so.
entries.literal: "I agree. We're not only looking for people. In the instance that the culprit wanted to get rid of something like they probably did with the suitcase, they wouldn't have had many places to do so."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's true. The crystal floor has a simple layout, but these are even worse. If you wanted to hide something here, you'd only have these drawers.
entries.literal: "That's true. The crystal floor has a simple layout, but these are even worse. If you wanted to hide something here, you'd only have these drawers."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's what I mean. Someone was likely here since that door at the stairs was unlocked, so let's see if we can find something.
entries.literal: "That's what I mean. Someone was likely here since that door at the stairs was unlocked, so let's see if we can find something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla took that as her cue to start opening all the drawers. Again, I went to the third partition while Shiroya stayed in the middle one.
entries.literal: "Isla took that as her cue to start opening all the drawers. Again, I went to the third partition while Shiroya stayed in the middle one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Opening every drawer was all I could do. There wasn't anything under the desks that could hide something, and the floor had nothing on it but cables.
entries.literal: "Opening every drawer was all I could do. There wasn't anything under the desks that could hide something, and the floor had nothing on it but cables."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In less than two minutes, I could be sure that nothing of importance existed in that section of floor 5. I left it to find Shiroya nearly done with hers.
entries.literal: "In less than two minutes, I could be sure that nothing of importance existed in that section of floor 5. I left it to find Shiroya nearly done with hers."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Nothing, I imagine?
entries.literal: "Nothing, I imagine?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. I looked at some of these papers, but I don't think they have anything to tell us. Some were financial reports, but others I didn't understand at all.
entries.literal: "Yeah. I looked at some of these papers, but I don't think they have anything to tell us. Some were financial reports, but others I didn't understand at all."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's about what I saw on the other floor. I tried not to look at them too much since a camera was right behind me.
entries.literal: "That's about what I saw on the other floor. I tried not to look at them too much since a camera was right behind me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, yeah. They'll probably look through the footage to make sure nothing strange happened.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah. They'll probably look through the footage to make sure nothing strange happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She apologized, facing the camera, before opening the door to the first partition. ...She might have been doing better than I thought, gradually moving back to her usual persona. I smiled at her and went through the door she'd opened, calmed by the thought that my worries about her had been overblown.
entries.literal: "She apologized, facing the camera, before opening the door to the first partition. ...She might have been doing better than I thought, gradually moving back to her usual persona. I smiled at her and went through the door she'd opened, calmed by the thought that my worries about her had been overblown."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Are you done? We didn't find anything.
entries.literal: "Are you done? We didn't find anything."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Neither did we.
entries.literal: "Neither did we."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We can move on, then. If the other group went at the same pace, we should find them on the next floor.
entries.literal: "We can move on, then. If the other group went at the same pace, we should find them on the next floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were about to leave when a sound alerted me.
entries.literal: "We were about to leave when a sound alerted me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A vanishingly faint but deep noise that lasted almost two seconds was very slightly audible from where we were. Two of us visibly reacted at the reminder that our situation was uncertain, and hearing it after moving through two harmless floors amplified its effect.
entries.literal: "A vanishingly faint but deep noise that lasted almost two seconds was very slightly audible from where we were. Two of us visibly reacted at the reminder that our situation was uncertain, and hearing it after moving through two harmless floors amplified its effect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, however, appeared unfazed. Perhaps ignorance was bliss, but it seemed like she had no concerns whatsoever.
entries.literal: "Isla, however, appeared unfazed. Perhaps ignorance was bliss, but it seemed like she had no concerns whatsoever."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You guys heard that, right?
entries.literal: "You guys heard that, right?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm? I didn't hear anything.
entries.literal: "Hm? I didn't hear anything."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-I'm not sure I did. What was it?
entries.literal: "I-I'm not sure I did. What was it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know, but I heard it too. It was quiet, but I think it came from this floor.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but I heard it too. It was quiet, but I think it came from this floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and Erina looked a bit unnerved and focused their hearing in case something else made a noise.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and Erina looked a bit unnerved and focused their hearing in case something else made a noise."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...It must've been the others.
entries.literal: "...It must've been the others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door. I wanted the initial inspection to finally end, to permanently release the stress I'd been building up at the concept of someone hiding.
entries.literal: "I opened the door. I wanted the initial inspection to finally end, to permanently release the stress I'd been building up at the concept of someone hiding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized Erina and Shiroya were coming along. We only had two directions to choose, and I hadn't made out the origin of the sound. However, since the right path led to floor 6, it was fair to assume it had come from the left.
entries.literal: "I realized Erina and Shiroya were coming along. We only had two directions to choose, and I hadn't made out the origin of the sound. However, since the right path led to floor 6, it was fair to assume it had come from the left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina quickly checked the right hallway and indicated that she hadn't seen anything. As I reached the end of the glass through which Isla was watching me, I peeked into the next corridor.
entries.literal: "Erina quickly checked the right hallway and indicated that she hadn't seen anything. As I reached the end of the glass through which Isla was watching me, I peeked into the next corridor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I don't see anything.
entries.literal: "...I don't see anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya looked too and saw the completely empty path.
entries.literal: "Shiroya looked too and saw the completely empty path."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It might've come from floor 4.
entries.literal: "It might've come from floor 4."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Possibly. I couldn't tell.
entries.literal: "Possibly. I couldn't tell."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the first partition again, where Isla was calmly sitting on a rotating chair and staring at our distressed faces.
entries.literal: "We entered the first partition again, where Isla was calmly sitting on a rotating chair and staring at our distressed faces."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Do we keep going...?
entries.literal: "Do we keep going...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. We need to ask the others what that sound was.
entries.literal: "Yes. We need to ask the others what that sound was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of us felt it appropriate to exhale. However, Isla disagreed.
entries.literal: "All of us felt it appropriate to exhale. However, Isla disagreed."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: You don't need to look so worried. Nothing bad will happen.
entries.literal: "You don't need to look so worried. Nothing bad will happen."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I would always have imagined I'd be the one saying that in a time like this...
entries.literal: "...I would always have imagined I'd be the one saying that in a time like this..."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Believe me. There's no reason to be scared.
entries.literal: "Believe me. There's no reason to be scared."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Any particular reason you're saying that?
entries.literal: "Any particular reason you're saying that?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm... I know nothing will happen. We just need to wait until we can leave.
entries.literal: "Hm... I know nothing will happen. We just need to wait until we can leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya stared at her skeptically. She knew optimism was great when it hadn't failed you yet.
entries.literal: "Shiroya stared at her skeptically. She knew optimism was great when it hadn't failed you yet."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You're probably right. We only got caught up in an inconvenient situation.
entries.literal: "You're probably right. We only got caught up in an inconvenient situation."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah. We'll be back home in just a few hours, so let's go back down already.
entries.literal: "Yeah. We'll be back home in just a few hours, so let's go back down already."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If nothing else, her playful smile made it clear that she was aware she was being unreasonable with that last part. Her high spirits were genuinely impressive.
entries.literal: "If nothing else, her playful smile made it clear that she was aware she was being unreasonable with that last part. Her high spirits were genuinely impressive."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: But I'm being serious. We don't need to search for any hidden person. There's no one here.
entries.literal: "But I'm being serious. We don't need to search for any hidden person. There's no one here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We're searching precisely to know that for sure.
entries.literal: "We're searching precisely to know that for sure."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I'm already telling you. These floors are a lot more boring than the crystal floor, so we don't need to waste our time like this.
entries.literal: "I'm already telling you. These floors are a lot more boring than the crystal floor, so we don't need to waste our time like this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Waste our time"... If I had intended to take her seriously, I couldn't have helped but laugh.
entries.literal: "\"Waste our time\"... If I had intended to take her seriously, I couldn't have helped but laugh."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So you know the result of a search that hasn't finished?
entries.literal: "So you know the result of a search that hasn't finished?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes!
entries.literal: "Yes!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya's and Erina's expressions told me that arguing would lead us nowhere.{w} But I was stubborn and slightly curious about her attitude.
entries.literal: "Shiroya's and Erina's expressions told me that arguing would lead us nowhere.{w} But I was stubborn and slightly curious about her attitude."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How can you possibly know that?
entries.literal: "How can you possibly know that?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Because I was told!
entries.literal: "Because I was told!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}My brain processed that line as another thoughtless remark she had made up to justify what she was saying. Only after a few seconds of silence did I fully comprehend it.
entries.literal: "...{w}My brain processed that line as another thoughtless remark she had made up to justify what she was saying. Only after a few seconds of silence did I fully comprehend it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What do you mean? ...Who told you?
entries.literal: "What do you mean? ...Who told you?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: My friend.
entries.literal: "My friend."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Not again... Don't take her seriously. She's been acting like this lately.
entries.literal: "Not again... Don't take her seriously. She's been acting like this lately."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What do you mean? Maybe she's a bit careless, but she's a kid. I don't think it's anything strange.
entries.literal: "What do you mean? Maybe she's a bit careless, but she's a kid. I don't think it's anything strange."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't just mean the lies. Her behavior has been changing recently...
entries.literal: "I don't just mean the lies. Her behavior has been changing recently..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: In what way?
entries.literal: "In what way?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, who was right there, responded with a disgruntled look.
entries.literal: "Isla, who was right there, responded with a disgruntled look."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Well... I've talked to her a bit about this. I don't know why, but a few weeks ago she started talking about this friend of hers.
entries.literal: "Well... I've talked to her a bit about this. I don't know why, but a few weeks ago she started talking about this friend of hers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Again, Isla exhaled in a sad manner, as if she were being ridiculed unfairly.
entries.literal: "Again, Isla exhaled in a sad manner, as if she were being ridiculed unfairly."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: She just doesn't wanna believe me, but I know I'm right. I only tried to make you feel better...
entries.literal: "She just doesn't wanna believe me, but I know I'm right. I only tried to make you feel better..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What kind of friend do you mean? Who are they?
entries.literal: "What kind of friend do you mean? Who are they?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I can't tell you that. It's our secret.
entries.literal: "I can't tell you that. It's our secret."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: See, this is what she says. Recently, she started constantly referencing this intangible friend of hers. At first, I was happy to hear her talking about a friend since the teachers at her school usually tell me that she's more on the lonely side. She never really talked about her friends until now.
entries.literal: "See, this is what she says. Recently, she started constantly referencing this intangible friend of hers. At first, I was happy to hear her talking about a friend since the teachers at her school usually tell me that she's more on the lonely side. She never really talked about her friends until now."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: But she made it sound as if she was always with them and kept telling me things that she'd been told. I knew she made it all up because I never saw her with anyone, and the things she'd presumably been told were all things that she'd said before or things I already felt she would say.
entries.literal: "But she made it sound as if she was always with them and kept telling me things that she'd been told. I knew she made it all up because I never saw her with anyone, and the things she'd presumably been told were all things that she'd said before or things I already felt she would say."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: "We watched my favorite movie together, and it was her favorite too!" and "She went to the aquarium last month, just like us!" You see what I mean?
entries.literal: "\"We watched my favorite movie together, and it was her favorite too!\" and \"She went to the aquarium last month, just like us!\" You see what I mean?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So she's a girl too?
entries.literal: "So she's a girl too?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes. That's the only thing we agreed we could say.
entries.literal: "Yes. That's the only thing we agreed we could say."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'd probably be taking it better if it was the only thing that changed, but she also started to behave differently in other ways. She stopped listening to what I told her to do, spent less time with me, and one day I found out that she hadn't gone to school because she "didn't feel like it". I really don't know what's gotten into her.
entries.literal: "I'd probably be taking it better if it was the only thing that changed, but she also started to behave differently in other ways. She stopped listening to what I told her to do, spent less time with me, and one day I found out that she hadn't gone to school because she \"didn't feel like it\". I really don't know what's gotten into her."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: An imaginary friend at her age isn't too strange, but it makes me feel a bit uncomfortable, especially if it comes with so many more changes.
entries.literal: "An imaginary friend at her age isn't too strange, but it makes me feel a bit uncomfortable, especially if it comes with so many more changes."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...Why won't you believe me? She is real, I keep telling you...
entries.literal: "...Why won't you believe me? She is real, I keep telling you..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't think you need to do anything about it, do you? Let her have fun with her friend.
entries.literal: "I don't think you need to do anything about it, do you? Let her have fun with her friend."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So she told you that everything would be fine and that we'd make it out safely, right?
entries.literal: "So she told you that everything would be fine and that we'd make it out safely, right?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I believe you. There's nothing wrong with what you're saying.
entries.literal: "I believe you. There's nothing wrong with what you're saying."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Thank you, Tanya.
entries.literal: "Thank you, Tanya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So, how is she handling this? Did she like the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "So, how is she handling this? Did she like the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla looked confused, as if she'd been betrayed by the first person who'd accepted her.
entries.literal: "Isla looked confused, as if she'd been betrayed by the first person who'd accepted her."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No, of course not... She's not here, right?
entries.literal: "No, of course not... She's not here, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: O-Oh, no, I suppose not.
entries.literal: "O-Oh, no, I suppose not."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: She told me that we would make it out safely before we came to the tower.
entries.literal: "She told me that we would make it out safely before we came to the tower."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What are you trying to say...? What exactly did she tell you?
entries.literal: "What are you trying to say...? What exactly did she tell you?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You shouldn't listen to her. Don't you see this isn't something to take seriously? I've tried it, but it's pointless.
entries.literal: "You shouldn't listen to her. Don't you see this isn't something to take seriously? I've tried it, but it's pointless."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm... She told me that something would happen in the tower, but not to worry. She said that if we stayed calm in one place, nobody would be hurt. And she promised I'd be able to see and touch the Sekimeiya, so she was right, wasn't she?
entries.literal: "Hm... She told me that something would happen in the tower, but not to worry. She said that if we stayed calm in one place, nobody would be hurt. And she promised I'd be able to see and touch the Sekimeiya, so she was right, wasn't she?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Before answering, I kept trying to make sense of such a confusing bunch of words. I was starting to think that her story could be seen in a completely different way—a much more ominous one.
entries.literal: "...{w}Before answering, I kept trying to make sense of such a confusing bunch of words. I was starting to think that her story could be seen in a completely different way—a much more ominous one."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You never lied like this until a month ago. What happened?
entries.literal: "You never lied like this until a month ago. What happened?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Do you mind telling us details about this person? How old is she, for example?
entries.literal: "Do you mind telling us details about this person? How old is she, for example?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I won't tell you anything. That's what we promised...
entries.literal: "I won't tell you anything. That's what we promised..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Erina, you said she's an honest kid. Do you think there's a chance she's telling the truth?
entries.literal: "Erina, you said she's an honest kid. Do you think there's a chance she's telling the truth?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I understand you'd think that, but no. I'm sure that she's lying. She always makes it sound as if her friend lives with us, but of course, I know that's not possible. We live alone.
entries.literal: "I understand you'd think that, but no. I'm sure that she's lying. She always makes it sound as if her friend lives with us, but of course, I know that's not possible. We live alone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Isla, we're talking about a human person, right?
entries.literal: "Isla, we're talking about a human person, right?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes. Animals can't talk.
entries.literal: "Yes. Animals can't talk."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: R-Right. You got me there.
entries.literal: "R-Right. You got me there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was clearly unhappy with our reactions, but we had no other way to respond to what she was saying. Obviously, no friend would appear out of nowhere and start living with you. If that was what Isla claimed, then I agreed with Erina's conclusion.
entries.literal: "She was clearly unhappy with our reactions, but we had no other way to respond to what she was saying. Obviously, no friend would appear out of nowhere and start living with you. If that was what Isla claimed, then I agreed with Erina's conclusion."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, what did she tell you about today's incident? Any more details?
entries.literal: "So, what did she tell you about today's incident? Any more details?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Why would I tell you if you won't believe me? She couldn't come, so she said that even though she didn't know how it would end or how long we'd stay here for, she'd wait for me at home.
entries.literal: "Why would I tell you if you won't believe me? She couldn't come, so she said that even though she didn't know how it would end or how long we'd stay here for, she'd wait for me at home."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: She didn't know how it would end? What does that mean? And why couldn't she come?
entries.literal: "She didn't know how it would end? What does that mean? And why couldn't she come?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: She can't see the future. She was right about a lot of stuff, so I trusted her. And today, she couldn't come here because I was supposed to.
entries.literal: "She can't see the future. She was right about a lot of stuff, so I trusted her. And today, she couldn't come here because I was supposed to."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You were supposed to? What does that even mean?
entries.literal: "You were supposed to? What does that even mean?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I was supposed to come here, right? We planned this since the Sekimeiya was announced, and I was really excited, so you even let me skip today's classes. If she had come, you would've seen her, so that's why she couldn't.
entries.literal: "I was supposed to come here, right? We planned this since the Sekimeiya was announced, and I was really excited, so you even let me skip today's classes. If she had come, you would've seen her, so that's why she couldn't."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: All right, then. I apologize for putting a damper on your fun.
entries.literal: "All right, then. I apologize for putting a damper on your fun."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Don't worry about that. What matters is that nobody else is here. We don't really need to keep searching.
entries.literal: "Don't worry about that. What matters is that nobody else is here. We don't really need to keep searching."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is that something your friend mentioned? Did she tell you the people who would get trapped?
entries.literal: "Is that something your friend mentioned? Did she tell you the people who would get trapped?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...Maybe. I'm not really sure if I should tell you, but she didn't say a lot about it.
entries.literal: "...Maybe. I'm not really sure if I should tell you, but she didn't say a lot about it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It might be helpful, so we'd appreciate it.
entries.literal: "It might be helpful, so we'd appreciate it."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Well... She didn't tell me the names of everyone, but she did say that only seven people would get trapped, and that if we kept calm, nothing bad would happen.
entries.literal: "Well... She didn't tell me the names of everyone, but she did say that only seven people would get trapped, and that if we kept calm, nothing bad would happen."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Seven people? But Naomi must also be here.
entries.literal: "Seven people? But Naomi must also be here."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm... She wanted to be helpful, so she told me as much as she could. She said it'd be me, Mom, three boys, and two girls. ...And that they wouldn't be bad people.
entries.literal: "Hm... She wanted to be helpful, so she told me as much as she could. She said it'd be me, Mom, three boys, and two girls. ...And that they wouldn't be bad people."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Come on, Isla. How can you possibly explain her knowing that?
entries.literal: "Come on, Isla. How can you possibly explain her knowing that?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: She's very smart. A lot smarter than me. But she was wrong here, so I think I might not be remembering right...
entries.literal: "She's very smart. A lot smarter than me. But she was wrong here, so I think I might not be remembering right..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. According to her, three men and four women would end up trapped. As things are right now, it's four men and three women, not counting Naomi.
entries.literal: "Yeah. According to her, three men and four women would end up trapped. As things are right now, it's four men and three women, not counting Naomi."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's true, see? If she was wrong about this, she might've been wrong when she said that nobody else would get trapped.
entries.literal: "That's true, see? If she was wrong about this, she might've been wrong when she said that nobody else would get trapped."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: But, no... That's not right. I might be wrong about the number of boys and girls, but I'm sure she said that only seven people would stay.
entries.literal: "But, no... That's not right. I might be wrong about the number of boys and girls, but I'm sure she said that only seven people would stay."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Listen, we can't stop searching because of what someone told you before we came here. She couldn't have known anything. Don't you get it?
entries.literal: "Listen, we can't stop searching because of what someone told you before we came here. She couldn't have known anything. Don't you get it?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...But she was right. We ended up trapped, and it's seven of us. She even said that all the windows would lock down.
entries.literal: "...But she was right. We ended up trapped, and it's seven of us. She even said that all the windows would lock down."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm very confused about this. Are you just making this up for fun? Because only a very select number of people would've known about the alarm's existence. If she really said that, could it be that your friend works here?
entries.literal: "I'm very confused about this. Are you just making this up for fun? Because only a very select number of people would've known about the alarm's existence. If she really said that, could it be that your friend works here?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No, that's impossible. I won't say anything else or I might put her in danger... You can believe what I said if you want.
entries.literal: "No, that's impossible. I won't say anything else or I might put her in danger... You can believe what I said if you want."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Standing up from the chair, Isla reached for the door and left. Despite all she'd said, we still saw leaving her alone as dangerous, so we followed her toward the fourth floor.
entries.literal: "Standing up from the chair, Isla reached for the door and left. Despite all she'd said, we still saw leaving her alone as dangerous, so we followed her toward the fourth floor."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What the hell was all of that?
entries.literal: "What the hell was all of that?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There really are only two options. Either Isla is lying, or someone who knew the attack would happen has been in contact with her.
entries.literal: "There really are only two options. Either Isla is lying, or someone who knew the attack would happen has been in contact with her."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'm not sure I want to believe her, but I think it's much more likely that the first option is correct. Creating an imaginary friend and making up all sorts of lies and excuses to justify their existence isn't the most uncommon behavior.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure I want to believe her, but I think it's much more likely that the first option is correct. Creating an imaginary friend and making up all sorts of lies and excuses to justify their existence isn't the most uncommon behavior."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But some things she said are really strange...
entries.literal: "But some things she said are really strange..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If she was trying to justify her friend's existence, why would she purposely list out the number of men and women incorrectly? And given how likely it is for Naomi to still be here, why would she claim otherwise? Wouldn't finding Naomi disprove her friend?
entries.literal: "If she was trying to justify her friend's existence, why would she purposely list out the number of men and women incorrectly? And given how likely it is for Naomi to still be here, why would she claim otherwise? Wouldn't finding Naomi disprove her friend?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If someone told Isla about the alarm, they had to work here. We've been told multiple times that very few people knew about it.
entries.literal: "If someone told Isla about the alarm, they had to work here. We've been told multiple times that very few people knew about it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I guess another possibility is that Xyn found out about the alarm and its features. Isla did say that her friend doesn't work here.
entries.literal: "I guess another possibility is that Xyn found out about the alarm and its features. Isla did say that her friend doesn't work here."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Now the big question: why would Xyn make contact with Isla and tell her all that? What's there to gain, and why Isla?
entries.literal: "Now the big question: why would Xyn make contact with Isla and tell her all that? What's there to gain, and why Isla?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There's no way her friend lives with them like she said. That would mean that Xyn instructed her to lie about her friend's identity so that the actual person couldn't be found.{w} But why the hell would they let her speak about it at all instead of telling her to keep fully quiet?
entries.literal: "There's no way her friend lives with them like she said. That would mean that Xyn instructed her to lie about her friend's identity so that the actual person couldn't be found.{w} But why the hell would they let her speak about it at all instead of telling her to keep fully quiet?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Isla told us that she promised her friend not to reveal information about her, but it doesn't seem like they agreed not to reveal information about today's incident.
entries.literal: "Isla told us that she promised her friend not to reveal information about her, but it doesn't seem like they agreed not to reveal information about today's incident."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I have no idea what anyone would have to gain by telling Isla about any of this, but if their intention was to manipulate her actions in some way, there has to be a very important reason...
entries.literal: "I have no idea what anyone would have to gain by telling Isla about any of this, but if their intention was to manipulate her actions in some way, there has to be a very important reason..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: One last thing is that Isla's friend didn't know how things would end. This appears to back up Sai's theory: the plan isn't over yet.
entries.literal: "One last thing is that Isla's friend didn't know how things would end. This appears to back up Sai's theory: the plan isn't over yet."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, she also said that she didn't know how long we'd stay here for.{w} Twelve hours is the maximum time... Is it possible that depending on how some events play out, we could leave earlier?
entries.literal: "However, she also said that she didn't know how long we'd stay here for.{w} Twelve hours is the maximum time... Is it possible that depending on how some events play out, we could leave earlier?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Incidentally, her friend told her that everything would be fine if we stayed put somewhere. Could it be that Xyn doesn't want us to search around the building?
entries.literal: "Incidentally, her friend told her that everything would be fine if we stayed put somewhere. Could it be that Xyn doesn't want us to search around the building?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'm not sure how I should be handling this. It doesn't seem as if she was instructed to tell us any of this. She just mentioned it out of honest concern after seeing how worried we were. If none of her actions were coerced and she was only given details, I can't think of a single reason why Xyn would do something so pointlessly risky.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure how I should be handling this. It doesn't seem as if she was instructed to tell us any of this. She just mentioned it out of honest concern after seeing how worried we were. If none of her actions were coerced and she was only given details, I can't think of a single reason why Xyn would do something so pointlessly risky."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If her friend is an actual person who knew this incident would occur, it follows that they knew she would end up involved in it.
entries.literal: "If her friend is an actual person who knew this incident would occur, it follows that they knew she would end up involved in it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Since I can't think of why Xyn would do it, the smallest thing I can construct has, once again, Katei as the focus.
entries.literal: "Since I can't think of why Xyn would do it, the smallest thing I can construct has, once again, Katei as the focus."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The only things Isla revealed about her friend's identity were her gender and the fact that she doesn't work in this building. I've been thinking of Katei as the core suspect, so it's easy to pin him as the identity behind Isla's friend.
entries.literal: "The only things Isla revealed about her friend's identity were her gender and the fact that she doesn't work in this building. I've been thinking of Katei as the core suspect, so it's easy to pin him as the identity behind Isla's friend."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If he instructed Isla to make sure not to reveal his identity, she would've called her friend a girl, and the one thing she would've denied would've been them working in the tower.
entries.literal: "If he instructed Isla to make sure not to reveal his identity, she would've called her friend a girl, and the one thing she would've denied would've been them working in the tower."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'm not sure how much credit I should give Isla or if I'm going off too many branches, but even though she's a kid, she should surely be able to bring things up without making it evident she'd been waiting for a good moment.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure how much credit I should give Isla or if I'm going off too many branches, but even though she's a kid, she should surely be able to bring things up without making it evident she'd been waiting for a good moment."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I have no idea what any of this accomplishes, but since only some Ashiya workers should've known about the alarm's existence, only they or an attacker with inside information could've been in contact with Isla.{w} Reasons aside, an Ashiya employee could have been relaying information to her. Two happen to come to mind, one being a man, and the other a woman.
entries.literal: "I have no idea what any of this accomplishes, but since only some Ashiya workers should've known about the alarm's existence, only they or an attacker with inside information could've been in contact with Isla.{w} Reasons aside, an Ashiya employee could have been relaying information to her. Two happen to come to mind, one being a man, and the other a woman."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the end, though, I went back to thinking that the most likely possibility was that Isla had made everything up. Maybe she had randomly thought of mentioning the number of men and women but purposely said them incorrectly as an unusual thing there would've been no reason to make up. Maybe she'd intended to say it the right way but quickly realized that she miscounted.
entries.literal: "In the end, though, I went back to thinking that the most likely possibility was that Isla had made everything up. Maybe she had randomly thought of mentioning the number of men and women but purposely said them incorrectly as an unusual thing there would've been no reason to make up. Maybe she'd intended to say it the right way but quickly realized that she miscounted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The whole thing really messed with me, and I kept trying to make sense of it as we reached the fourth floor.
entries.literal: "...The whole thing really messed with me, and I kept trying to make sense of it as we reached the fourth floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It appeared desolate as soon as we arrived. The chances of finding people increased with each floor, so with a bit of precaution, we moved toward the offices.
entries.literal: "It appeared desolate as soon as we arrived. The chances of finding people increased with each floor, so with a bit of precaution, we moved toward the offices."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Is the other group not here yet?
entries.literal: "Is the other group not here yet?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The first partition looked empty. Once again, we saw the same layout as the other floors.
entries.literal: "The first partition looked empty. Once again, we saw the same layout as the other floors."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe they found something. I'd think they would've already arrived here.
entries.literal: "Maybe they found something. I'd think they would've already arrived here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I repeated the earlier process and quickly deemed the three partitions empty.
entries.literal: "I repeated the earlier process and quickly deemed the three partitions empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next were the two bathrooms. However, before we headed to them, I thought I noticed another sound, just as faint as the last.
entries.literal: "Next were the two bathrooms. However, before we headed to them, I thought I noticed another sound, just as faint as the last."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was easy to pinpoint its origin. I peeked into the right corridor and saw two human figures standing next to the staircase.
entries.literal: "It was easy to pinpoint its origin. I peeked into the right corridor and saw two human figures standing next to the staircase."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: They're here.
entries.literal: "They're here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our attention was quickly diverted. The other three with me quickly spotted them as well.
entries.literal: "Our attention was quickly diverted. The other three with me quickly spotted them as well."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Where's Katei?
entries.literal: "Where's Katei?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Isla pointed out, only Sai and Akaro were there. As soon as they noticed us, they stopped talking and gestured at us to come over.
entries.literal: "As Isla pointed out, only Sai and Akaro were there. As soon as they noticed us, they stopped talking and gestured at us to come over."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How did things go? Anything notable?
entries.literal: "How did things go? Anything notable?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Nothing. Are the other two floors like this one?
entries.literal: "Nothing. Are the other two floors like this one?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Exactly the same. They only contain three big rooms full of offices.
entries.literal: "Exactly the same. They only contain three big rooms full of offices."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Where did Katei go? Why is he not with you?
entries.literal: "...Where did Katei go? Why is he not with you?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well, it's not the easiest thing to explain.
entries.literal: "Well, it's not the easiest thing to explain."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sure it is. Naomi showed up and requested to talk to him privately.
entries.literal: "Sure it is. Naomi showed up and requested to talk to him privately."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Huh? Where was she?
entries.literal: "...Huh? Where was she?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What...? Naomi shouldn't be here.
entries.literal: "What...? Naomi shouldn't be here."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's time to stop, Isla. Don't keep going when it's clear you were wrong.
entries.literal: "It's time to stop, Isla. Don't keep going when it's clear you were wrong."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why shouldn't she be here? We were about to move up to this floor when Naomi came from the second. I'm positive she came from the stairs.
entries.literal: "Why shouldn't she be here? We were about to move up to this floor when Naomi came from the second. I'm positive she came from the stairs."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: From the stairs? Shouldn't you guys have inspected floor 2?
entries.literal: "From the stairs? Shouldn't you guys have inspected floor 2?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: We did. It's very possible she was on the crystal floor since there was no place to hide on the second one.
entries.literal: "We did. It's very possible she was on the crystal floor since there was no place to hide on the second one."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And she voluntarily appeared to talk to Katei?
entries.literal: "And she voluntarily appeared to talk to Katei?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Pretty much. It looked like she wanted to talk to Akaro first, but as soon as she saw Katei, she forgot about him.
entries.literal: "Pretty much. It looked like she wanted to talk to Akaro first, but as soon as she saw Katei, she forgot about him."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Well, she approached me first because I was closer to the stairs. Then they went down to talk.
entries.literal: "...Well, she approached me first because I was closer to the stairs. Then they went down to talk."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. We finished up floor 3 and have been waiting here since we looked at the two bathrooms. They left about fifteen minutes ago.
entries.literal: "Yeah. We finished up floor 3 and have been waiting here since we looked at the two bathrooms. They left about fifteen minutes ago."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you not try to follow them? What did they want to talk about?
entries.literal: "Did you not try to follow them? What did they want to talk about?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Naomi went ahead and asked us not to follow them, so unfortunately, I had to abandon my plan of tagging along. Realistically, if they made sure they were alone, we couldn't have done anything to eavesdrop without being noticed. The quarters here are pretty tight.
entries.literal: "Naomi went ahead and asked us not to follow them, so unfortunately, I had to abandon my plan of tagging along. Realistically, if they made sure they were alone, we couldn't have done anything to eavesdrop without being noticed. The quarters here are pretty tight."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It sounded like they wanted to talk about "confidential" matters. When I first saw Naomi, I got really surprised, but she must've been even more than me. She looked preoccupied and determined at the same time—that's how she was when insisted that Katei talk with her privately.
entries.literal: "It sounded like they wanted to talk about \"confidential\" matters. When I first saw Naomi, I got really surprised, but she must've been even more than me. She looked preoccupied and determined at the same time—that's how she was when insisted that Katei talk with her privately."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see...
entries.literal: "I see..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We were debating the contents of their discussion just now. I gave Akaro the rundown regarding Katei, and he really hadn't considered anything.
entries.literal: "We were debating the contents of their discussion just now. I gave Akaro the rundown regarding Katei, and he really hadn't considered anything."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I still think you're overthinking a few things, but I can't deny they're the two most suspicious people. Sai really thinks they're up to no good.
entries.literal: "I still think you're overthinking a few things, but I can't deny they're the two most suspicious people. Sai really thinks they're up to no good."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Am I being unreasonable? If I was wrong, they would've told us the main gist of it. Naomi might not have been with us the whole time, but she must've been conscious of the situation and our perception of her. Despite that, she barely acknowledged us.
entries.literal: "Am I being unreasonable? If I was wrong, they would've told us the main gist of it. Naomi might not have been with us the whole time, but she must've been conscious of the situation and our perception of her. Despite that, she barely acknowledged us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm still trying to process everything. So Naomi really was here. Doesn't that mean the most likely scenario is that she was the one to leave the suitcase downstairs?
entries.literal: "I'm still trying to process everything. So Naomi really was here. Doesn't that mean the most likely scenario is that she was the one to leave the suitcase downstairs?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. She might not have been aware of how wary we were of her and openly showed up to talk with the other main suspect. Katei didn't look like he was expecting it, so perhaps he thought she should've remained hidden. Regardless, it's safe to assume they're now talking about their plan.
entries.literal: "Yes. She might not have been aware of how wary we were of her and openly showed up to talk with the other main suspect. Katei didn't look like he was expecting it, so perhaps he thought she should've remained hidden. Regardless, it's safe to assume they're now talking about their plan."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You should trust them a bit more... Since the two of them work here, I think it's very possible they're talking about Ashiya matters.
entries.literal: "You should trust them a bit more... Since the two of them work here, I think it's very possible they're talking about Ashiya matters."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Okay, then why did Naomi hide from us? Why did she appear out of nowhere and not even try to explain anything? Her actions are strange even if she's on the culprit's side, but her face wasn't the one of someone who suddenly got trapped and looked for people for an entire hour.
entries.literal: "Okay, then why did Naomi hide from us? Why did she appear out of nowhere and not even try to explain anything? Her actions are strange even if she's on the culprit's side, but her face wasn't the one of someone who suddenly got trapped and looked for people for an entire hour."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Her perspective might be different from ours, being an Ashiya employee that's aware of Xyn's attacks.
entries.literal: "Her perspective might be different from ours, being an Ashiya employee that's aware of Xyn's attacks."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And I acknowledge that possibility. Her actions simply make it unlikely.
entries.literal: "And I acknowledge that possibility. Her actions simply make it unlikely."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We'll have to wait for them to come back. I'm sure they'll clarify all of this.
entries.literal: "We'll have to wait for them to come back. I'm sure they'll clarify all of this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. We decided to stay here to make sure they couldn't escape, but we were also waiting for you four.
entries.literal: "Yeah. We decided to stay here to make sure they couldn't escape, but we were also waiting for you four."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If there are more than two of us, we can split ourselves through the first three floors while someone stays here to make sure they're confined below.
entries.literal: "If there are more than two of us, we can split ourselves through the first three floors while someone stays here to make sure they're confined below."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wouldn't they be able to use the elevator?
entries.literal: "Wouldn't they be able to use the elevator?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, but we would know. I meant to ask you guys about that.
entries.literal: "Yes, but we would know. I meant to ask you guys about that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: A few minutes ago, after Katei and Naomi left, we heard the elevator moving through our floor. Even though we were next to it, we weren't able to determine the direction it was going.
entries.literal: "A few minutes ago, after Katei and Naomi left, we heard the elevator moving through our floor. Even though we were next to it, we weren't able to determine the direction it was going."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: But since you took it to the sixth floor, it could only have been going down. We only heard it once.
entries.literal: "But since you took it to the sixth floor, it could only have been going down. We only heard it once."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, so that was the elevator.
entries.literal: "Oh, so that was the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That made sense. It had been a deep noise that had lingered for a bit. Since it was moving, the exact position and floor it had come from hadn't been easily distinguishable.
entries.literal: "That made sense. It had been a deep noise that had lingered for a bit. Since it was moving, the exact position and floor it had come from hadn't been easily distinguishable."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: As I thought, none of you used it. That's strange, right?
entries.literal: "As I thought, none of you used it. That's strange, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We're sure it was the elevator because it made the same noise we heard when you used it on the lowest floor. Even if you'd decided to go back down for some reason, we found it appropriate to stay here.
entries.literal: "We're sure it was the elevator because it made the same noise we heard when you used it on the lowest floor. Even if you'd decided to go back down for some reason, we found it appropriate to stay here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you sure it only moved one more time?
entries.literal: "Are you sure it only moved one more time?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, we were right next to it and only heard it once. So if Katei and Naomi use it, we'll know.
entries.literal: "Yeah, we were right next to it and only heard it once. So if Katei and Naomi use it, we'll know."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We could even call it and keep the door open. That way, they wouldn't be able to use it at all.
entries.literal: "We could even call it and keep the door open. That way, they wouldn't be able to use it at all."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right, that's what I thought you'd suggest.
entries.literal: "Right, that's what I thought you'd suggest."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I stayed here for another reason too, which is why we didn't call it here and do that immediately. The sound might make it possible to anticipate the elevator. We might be quick enough to press the button before it goes past us. That would trap them inside it, and we could open the door before they could start moving again.
entries.literal: "I stayed here for another reason too, which is why we didn't call it here and do that immediately. The sound might make it possible to anticipate the elevator. We might be quick enough to press the button before it goes past us. That would trap them inside it, and we could open the door before they could start moving again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see.{w} The sound from earlier doesn't make much sense, though. We left the elevator on floor 6 and heard it moving on floor 5. Like you said, it could only have been going down.
entries.literal: "I see.{w} The sound from earlier doesn't make much sense, though. We left the elevator on floor 6 and heard it moving on floor 5. Like you said, it could only have been going down."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yeah, I don't get it. By floor 5, we knew nobody could've been above us.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I don't get it. By floor 5, we knew nobody could've been above us."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Is it possible someone sneaked past you while you investigated? If all of you were inside the offices without looking through the glass, it could've happened.
entries.literal: "Is it possible someone sneaked past you while you investigated? If all of you were inside the offices without looking through the glass, it could've happened."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I really don't think so. I stayed in front for the most part, and I really doubt I missed anyone.
entries.literal: "I really don't think so. I stayed in front for the most part, and I really doubt I missed anyone."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, if you didn't, then someone below us could've called it, and what we heard was the empty elevator.
entries.literal: "Well, if you didn't, then someone below us could've called it, and what we heard was the empty elevator."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh? It must've been either Katei or Naomi, so if you didn't hear it again, they must've called it and then not used it.
entries.literal: "Huh? It must've been either Katei or Naomi, so if you didn't hear it again, they must've called it and then not used it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right. Maybe they wanted it easily available on floor 1 if they needed to use it.
entries.literal: "Right. Maybe they wanted it easily available on floor 1 if they needed to use it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We began to hear footsteps in the distance. We all quieted down at the same time, straining to check if we'd imagined it.
entries.literal: "We began to hear footsteps in the distance. We all quieted down at the same time, straining to check if we'd imagined it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They didn't stop. The sound became more and more perceptible until it was clear that only one pair of legs was approaching.
entries.literal: "They didn't stop. The sound became more and more perceptible until it was clear that only one pair of legs was approaching."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's see what's up.
entries.literal: "Let's see what's up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stared at the staircase, where the sound was coming from, until Katei's white hair peeked from below.
entries.literal: "We stared at the staircase, where the sound was coming from, until Katei's white hair peeked from below."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he saw all of us, he looked up with a plain expression and stopped moving partway up the stairs.
entries.literal: "When he saw all of us, he looked up with a plain expression and stopped moving partway up the stairs."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Where's Naomi?
entries.literal: "Where's Naomi?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...{w}We went to the crystal floor, but she didn't want to come back.
entries.literal: "...{w}We went to the crystal floor, but she didn't want to come back."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why not?
entries.literal: "Why not?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's immediate reaction threw Katei off, and he took a few seconds to answer.
entries.literal: "Sai's immediate reaction threw Katei off, and he took a few seconds to answer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: During that time, he looked at the rest of us. It might've been just my impression, but it felt like he particularly fixed his eyes on me.
entries.literal: "During that time, he looked at the rest of us. It might've been just my impression, but it felt like he particularly fixed his eyes on me."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: She didn't explain it. I asked her to come since I knew I'd be suspicious otherwise, but she refused. She left the room where we were, and I stayed there a few more minutes, sorting my thoughts out before returning here.
entries.literal: "She didn't explain it. I asked her to come since I knew I'd be suspicious otherwise, but she refused. She left the room where we were, and I stayed there a few more minutes, sorting my thoughts out before returning here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What did you talk about?
entries.literal: "What did you talk about?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: About the incident, of course. It surprised me a bit, but her intention was to clear her name. She told me she hadn't done anything.
entries.literal: "About the incident, of course. It surprised me a bit, but her intention was to clear her name. She told me she hadn't done anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That was what she wanted to talk to you about privately?
entries.literal: "That was what she wanted to talk to you about privately?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. I didn't believe her, though.
entries.literal: "Yes. I didn't believe her, though."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...You didn't?
entries.literal: "...You didn't?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No. Her words sounded forced, as if she was trying to cover herself up with lies. I know you've been suspecting me, but since I know I'm innocent, my main suspicions were directed to Naomi from the beginning.
entries.literal: "No. Her words sounded forced, as if she was trying to cover herself up with lies. I know you've been suspecting me, but since I know I'm innocent, my main suspicions were directed to Naomi from the beginning."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: She saw her explanations weren't working and refused to appear before you all. She must've tried her luck with me because we've worked together for a long time.
entries.literal: "She saw her explanations weren't working and refused to appear before you all. She must've tried her luck with me because we've worked together for a long time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So you're the only one she wanted to convince?
entries.literal: "So you're the only one she wanted to convince?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. I don't know why, though. Even if she'd achieved that, it's not like she could've convinced the police. Hearing her justifications made me even more convinced that she's involved in some way.{w} Even though she ran away, I didn't try to find her immediately since I figured there was no way she could keep hiding. She still has to be somewhere on the crystal floor.
