entries.literal: "Yes. I don't know why, though. Even if she'd achieved that, it's not like she could've convinced the police. Hearing her justifications made me even more convinced that she's involved in some way.{w} Even though she ran away, I didn't try to find her immediately since I figured there was no way she could keep hiding. She still has to be somewhere on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Out of curiosity, did you ever call the elevator?
entries.literal: "Out of curiosity, did you ever call the elevator?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The elevator? No. Why?
entries.literal: "The elevator? No. Why?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We heard it moving down, so if it wasn't you, Naomi might've called it. It didn't go up again, though.
entries.literal: "We heard it moving down, so if it wasn't you, Naomi might've called it. It didn't go up again, though."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I see... So she's definitely still under us.
entries.literal: "I see... So she's definitely still under us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Regardless, what did Naomi tell you? What was it that made you suspect her even harder?
entries.literal: "Regardless, what did Naomi tell you? What was it that made you suspect her even harder?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...{w}She spat out nothing but inconsistencies.{w} She said that she'd been trying to find help since waking up. She couldn't answer why she'd gone up to the office floors instead of aiding Erina's group or staying with everyone in the event room.
entries.literal: "...{w}She spat out nothing but inconsistencies.{w} She said that she'd been trying to find help since waking up. She couldn't answer why she'd gone up to the office floors instead of aiding Erina's group or staying with everyone in the event room."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: She tried to make me believe that she'd been searching for people until now and that, coincidentally, she hadn't found us yet. There was no way I could have believed that.
entries.literal: "She tried to make me believe that she'd been searching for people until now and that, coincidentally, she hadn't found us yet. There was no way I could have believed that."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: According to her, she had nothing to do with the power outage or the suitcase. She said she didn't see the suitcase the first time she went up, but it was there when she came back down.
entries.literal: "According to her, she had nothing to do with the power outage or the suitcase. She said she didn't see the suitcase the first time she went up, but it was there when she came back down."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I assume you didn't find anyone, naturally.
entries.literal: "...I assume you didn't find anyone, naturally."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Right.
entries.literal: "Right."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Then that has to settle it. If nobody else is here, only she could've left the suitcase in hallway C. She almost broke down as she thought of more ways to explain herself. You'll see when we find her.
entries.literal: "Then that has to settle it. If nobody else is here, only she could've left the suitcase in hallway C. She almost broke down as she thought of more ways to explain herself. You'll see when we find her."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: By the way, when the elevator moved, couldn't it have been the higher group?
entries.literal: "By the way, when the elevator moved, couldn't it have been the higher group?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Us? No. We didn't use it again.
entries.literal: "Us? No. We didn't use it again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Is that so? And you didn't get separated?
entries.literal: "...Is that so? And you didn't get separated?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Again, he said that while looking directly at me.
entries.literal: "Again, he said that while looking directly at me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...No. We stayed together until now.
entries.literal: "...No. We stayed together until now."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you sure?
entries.literal: "Are you sure?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why are you being so insistent? Do you have a reason to think we split up?
entries.literal: "Why are you being so insistent? Do you have a reason to think we split up?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, no, I don't think so. Forgive me, Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Oh, no, I don't think so. Forgive me, Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What the hell was up with him? That had sounded like a taunt without feeling like one.
entries.literal: "What the hell was up with him? That had sounded like a taunt without feeling like one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His behavior toward me had changed in some way. I didn't know the reason, but it felt like he was trying to incite me to say something.
entries.literal: "His behavior toward me had changed in some way. I didn't know the reason, but it felt like he was trying to incite me to say something."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sure they didn't split up. The four of them came from floor 5, and nobody could've gone past us while we were investigating floors 2 and 3.
entries.literal: "I'm sure they didn't split up. The four of them came from floor 5, and nobody could've gone past us while we were investigating floors 2 and 3."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...All right, then.
entries.literal: "...All right, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if we were all conspiring against him, he turned around and stopped moving. I was a bit puzzled, trying to understand how to interpret his new attitude.
entries.literal: "As if we were all conspiring against him, he turned around and stopped moving. I was a bit puzzled, trying to understand how to interpret his new attitude."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Well, we will always be able to check the security footage once that's fixed. For now, we should make sure to find Naomi, I'd say.
entries.literal: "Well, we will always be able to check the security footage once that's fixed. For now, we should make sure to find Naomi, I'd say."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Implying one more time that there was more to our actions than we'd let on, he breathed slowly and started to go back down without turning around.
entries.literal: "Implying one more time that there was more to our actions than we'd let on, he breathed slowly and started to go back down without turning around."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Someone should stay here in case Naomi tries to go up. The rest of us will split downstairs to make sure she's found.{w} Another person will also be needed to stay on floor 2 to make sure she doesn't intend to pointlessly go hide there. Three will be enough to inspect the whole first floor. One person will stay in the lobby, the other in hallway C, and the last person will check every room in both hallways. She will not escape.
entries.literal: "Someone should stay here in case Naomi tries to go up. The rest of us will split downstairs to make sure she's found.{w} Another person will also be needed to stay on floor 2 to make sure she doesn't intend to pointlessly go hide there. Three will be enough to inspect the whole first floor. One person will stay in the lobby, the other in hallway C, and the last person will check every room in both hallways. She will not escape."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The person at the lobby will look through hallway B, and the one at hallway C will look through hallway A. This time, Naomi won't be able to cross between hallways. Let's go. I'll stay in the lobby and check the mechanical room.
entries.literal: "The person at the lobby will look through hallway B, and the one at hallway C will look through hallway A. This time, Naomi won't be able to cross between hallways. Let's go. I'll stay in the lobby and check the mechanical room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...All right. That doesn't sound bad to me.
entries.literal: "...All right. That doesn't sound bad to me."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'll look through the rooms. I think I should be the one to do that.
entries.literal: "I'll look through the rooms. I think I should be the one to do that."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla and I will stay here since only four people are needed. We'll keep watch at the elevator.
entries.literal: "Isla and I will stay here since only four people are needed. We'll keep watch at the elevator."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No! I'll look through the rooms too!
entries.literal: "No! I'll look through the rooms too!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Be a bit cooperative, Isla. I think staying here would be better for everyone.
entries.literal: "Be a bit cooperative, Isla. I think staying here would be better for everyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if she hadn't heard her mother, Isla ran down the stairs. Instead of trying to convince her, the others thought it better to follow behind.
entries.literal: "As if she hadn't heard her mother, Isla ran down the stairs. Instead of trying to convince her, the others thought it better to follow behind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya, Sai, and I were the ones without an assigned position, which left us unaware of what to do.
entries.literal: "Shiroya, Sai, and I were the ones without an assigned position, which left us unaware of what to do."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not ideal, but I'll quickly check through floors 3 and 2 with Akaro's help and then stay in hallway C. You two make sure the elevator doesn't let Naomi escape.
entries.literal: "It's not ideal, but I'll quickly check through floors 3 and 2 with Akaro's help and then stay in hallway C. You two make sure the elevator doesn't let Naomi escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without waiting for a reply, Sai left both of us on the fourth floor, all by ourselves.
entries.literal: "Without waiting for a reply, Sai left both of us on the fourth floor, all by ourselves."

entries.text: Ring Chain
entries.literal: "Ring Chain"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right then. Here we are.
entries.literal: "All right then. Here we are."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Hopefully they can find her and clear everything up.
entries.literal: "...Hopefully they can find her and clear everything up."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can't imagine Naomi hiding from them unless she knows about some secret spot.
entries.literal: "I can't imagine Naomi hiding from them unless she knows about some secret spot."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. It won't take very long either.
entries.literal: "Yeah. It won't take very long either."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm curious to see what'll happen. It's unfortunate she showed up while we weren't there.
entries.literal: "I'm curious to see what'll happen. It's unfortunate she showed up while we weren't there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But it's very likely she actually did appear since the three of them would have no reason to lie together.
entries.literal: "But it's very likely she actually did appear since the three of them would have no reason to lie together."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Were you thinking that maybe Naomi was never there at all?
entries.literal: "Were you thinking that maybe Naomi was never there at all?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, not really. I just couldn't take it completely seriously since we hadn't seen her.
entries.literal: "No, not really. I just couldn't take it completely seriously since we hadn't seen her."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You thought Katei was lying to us earlier, right? Have you changed your mind?
entries.literal: "You thought Katei was lying to us earlier, right? Have you changed your mind?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thinking back on what Katei had just said... I wasn't sure how to approach it.
entries.literal: "Thinking back on what Katei had just said... I wasn't sure how to approach it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know. Honestly, everything Katei said regarding Naomi just now was pretty questionable, but it seemed like he really wanted us to find her. You heard how determined he sounded. I'm not sure he'd lie about what Naomi told him only to turn around and make us find her.
entries.literal: "I don't know. Honestly, everything Katei said regarding Naomi just now was pretty questionable, but it seemed like he really wanted us to find her. You heard how determined he sounded. I'm not sure he'd lie about what Naomi told him only to turn around and make us find her."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So it's likely it was all the truth.
entries.literal: "So it's likely it was all the truth."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm really not sure.{w} Anyway, how are you holding up? Sorry, I've just been trying to think about—
entries.literal: "I'm really not sure.{w} Anyway, how are you holding up? Sorry, I've just been trying to think about—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were both startled. Though louder and clearer, the same sound we'd heard earlier repeated.
entries.literal: "We were both startled. Though louder and clearer, the same sound we'd heard earlier repeated."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: She took the elevator...!
entries.literal: "She took the elevator...!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why would she run away?
entries.literal: "Why would she run away?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled what Sai had said too late. We weren't close enough to stop it on the fourth floor. Trying to avoid wasting time, we ran toward the other side to arrive at her destination before we missed her.{w} In our defense, we'd heard the sound when the elevator had been about to pass us by, so stopping it in time wouldn't have been possible.
entries.literal: "I recalled what Sai had said too late. We weren't close enough to stop it on the fourth floor. Trying to avoid wasting time, we ran toward the other side to arrive at her destination before we missed her.{w} In our defense, we'd heard the sound when the elevator had been about to pass us by, so stopping it in time wouldn't have been possible."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We should've just kept it open...! I didn't think she would actually go up!
entries.literal: "We should've just kept it open...! I didn't think she would actually go up!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And I didn't think fast enough, damn it! Sai just wanted us to keep them in place.
entries.literal: "And I didn't think fast enough, damn it! Sai just wanted us to keep them in place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya ran behind me. I wanted to tell her to slow down and let me go by myself, but it would've been inconsiderate. If I thought going up was dangerous, I would've tried to make her stay behind, but Naomi was presumably running around defenseless, so the odds were probably in our favor.
entries.literal: "Shiroya ran behind me. I wanted to tell her to slow down and let me go by myself, but it would've been inconsiderate. If I thought going up was dangerous, I would've tried to make her stay behind, but Naomi was presumably running around defenseless, so the odds were probably in our favor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though the floors were very wide, the path to the next one was straightforward enough to make it a quick trip.
entries.literal: "Even though the floors were very wide, the path to the next one was straightforward enough to make it a quick trip."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We arrived on floor 5. We thought the elevator hadn't stopped there because it seemed to linger for a bit too long, but I still quickly went through the three partitions while Shiroya stayed next to the first door.{w} As I'd thought, they were empty.
entries.literal: "We arrived on floor 5. We thought the elevator hadn't stopped there because it seemed to linger for a bit too long, but I still quickly went through the three partitions while Shiroya stayed next to the first door.{w} As I'd thought, they were empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I met Shiroya by the door with a dubious look. We would hear it if Naomi used the elevator to go back down, so there was no way she'd make it past us unnoticed.
entries.literal: "I met Shiroya by the door with a dubious look. We would hear it if Naomi used the elevator to go back down, so there was no way she'd make it past us unnoticed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Nothing. She must be upstairs.
entries.literal: "Nothing. She must be upstairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We directed ourselves toward the sixth floor, but Shiroya stopped me.
entries.literal: "We directed ourselves toward the sixth floor, but Shiroya stopped me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: H-Hold on, let's check this.
entries.literal: "H-Hold on, let's check this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She tried to open the elevator, but the door didn't budge. Since that meant it was above us, she pressed the button to call it.
entries.literal: "She tried to open the elevator, but the door didn't budge. Since that meant it was above us, she pressed the button to call it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shortly, the button lit up orange in silence. Then, Shiroya opened the door and we saw the empty elevator.
entries.literal: "Shortly, the button lit up orange in silence. Then, Shiroya opened the door and we saw the empty elevator."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: With how fast it got here, it must've been on the sixth floor.
entries.literal: "With how fast it got here, it must've been on the sixth floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Technically, there was just one more possibility: the attic.{w} But you'd need a unique key for that, and Shiroya was right. The elevator only took a few seconds to arrive, indicating that there had only been a single floor of separation.{w} By moving it, we'd also prevented Naomi from using it upstairs.
entries.literal: "Technically, there was just one more possibility: the attic.{w} But you'd need a unique key for that, and Shiroya was right. The elevator only took a few seconds to arrive, indicating that there had only been a single floor of separation.{w} By moving it, we'd also prevented Naomi from using it upstairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We quickly went up to the sixth floor, where the elevator had been taken. It was only used once, so someone was definitely there. Naomi was very close.
entries.literal: "We quickly went up to the sixth floor, where the elevator had been taken. It was only used once, so someone was definitely there. Naomi was very close."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The bathrooms were empty, so she had to be farther ahead.
entries.literal: "The bathrooms were empty, so she had to be farther ahead."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'll go check. Make sure nobody can leave.
entries.literal: "I'll go check. Make sure nobody can leave."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What? It might not be safe. Don't just go alone.
entries.literal: "What? It might not be safe. Don't just go alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a meaningless head gesture, she ran off and left me by myself. She was clearly not content with the thought of waiting behind again.
entries.literal: "With a meaningless head gesture, she ran off and left me by myself. She was clearly not content with the thought of waiting behind again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew I had to go with her. Letting someone escape was far less important than letting Shiroya confront potential danger, but I couldn't bring myself to move.
entries.literal: "I knew I had to go with her. Letting someone escape was far less important than letting Shiroya confront potential danger, but I couldn't bring myself to move."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She had disappeared from my field of vision. Given the layout of the floor, she wouldn't be able to make sure nobody could sneak past her, so I had to wait behind in anticipation.
entries.literal: "She had disappeared from my field of vision. Given the layout of the floor, she wouldn't be able to make sure nobody could sneak past her, so I had to wait behind in anticipation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If she first checked the opposite corridor and someone was hiding in the offices, they could then escape. If someone was in the corridor and she chose to first inspect the offices, they could also escape.
entries.literal: "If she first checked the opposite corridor and someone was hiding in the offices, they could then escape. If someone was in the corridor and she chose to first inspect the offices, they could also escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, that didn't actually hold up perfectly. To inspect the corridor, she would only have to see if it was empty from a position that would still let her see the inside of the first partition. That could let the culprit escape, but at least they'd be seen.
entries.literal: "However, that didn't actually hold up perfectly. To inspect the corridor, she would only have to see if it was empty from a position that would still let her see the inside of the first partition. That could let the culprit escape, but at least they'd be seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt like she'd known I'd been about to ask her to stay behind and had chosen to reverse our roles before I had a chance to act. Trying not to let undesired thoughts get the best of me, I attempted to stay calm as Shiroya had asked.
entries.literal: "I felt like she'd known I'd been about to ask her to stay behind and had chosen to reverse our roles before I had a chance to act. Trying not to let undesired thoughts get the best of me, I attempted to stay calm as Shiroya had asked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Almost half a minute passed, and I began to get impatient and a bit anxious. While the floor was big, it was also silent except for air movement. If she felt she was in danger, I would be able to hear her shout easily.
entries.literal: "...Almost half a minute passed, and I began to get impatient and a bit anxious. While the floor was big, it was also silent except for air movement. If she felt she was in danger, I would be able to hear her shout easily."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only a few seconds after that, I snapped. What was I doing, standing there and leaving her up against an unknown person who'd been involved in the attack? I prepared to take off running as soon as the realization finally came to me.
entries.literal: "Only a few seconds after that, I snapped. What was I doing, standing there and leaving her up against an unknown person who'd been involved in the attack? I prepared to take off running as soon as the realization finally came to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But before I could, I saw Shiroya's figure coming out of the narrow passageway.
entries.literal: "But before I could, I saw Shiroya's figure coming out of the narrow passageway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She approached me slowly and noticed my anxiety.
entries.literal: "She approached me slowly and noticed my anxiety."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: D-Did something happen?
entries.literal: "D-Did something happen?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...No, nothing. You took a bit, so I started to worry.
entries.literal: "...No, nothing. You took a bit, so I started to worry."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, really...? I'm sorry. I didn't find anyone, though.
entries.literal: "Oh, really...? I'm sorry. I didn't find anyone, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...How is that possible? There should've been someone.
entries.literal: "...How is that possible? There should've been someone."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I know. But look, this is what I wanted to show you.
entries.literal: "I know. But look, this is what I wanted to show you."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, she walked back to where she'd come from, instructing me to follow her. Had she found something important?
entries.literal: "Once again, she walked back to where she'd come from, instructing me to follow her. Had she found something important?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of stopping in front of the offices, she continued toward the other corridor.
entries.literal: "Instead of stopping in front of the offices, she continued toward the other corridor."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Earlier, we thought this place was empty and completely missed a door.
entries.literal: "Earlier, we thought this place was empty and completely missed a door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: See, look. But it's closed.
entries.literal: "See, look. But it's closed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was right. At the far back of what had appeared to be a dead end, there was a small door that we'd entirely failed to notice.
entries.literal: "She was right. At the far back of what had appeared to be a dead end, there was a small door that we'd entirely failed to notice."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, of course. We were told this door existed.
entries.literal: "Oh, of course. We were told this door existed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It looked just like a plain door. Instinctively, I reached for the doorknob and tried to get it open to no avail—it was tightly locked. Under it was a big keyhole that would require an equally big key to unlock the special section of the tower.
entries.literal: "It looked just like a plain door. Instinctively, I reached for the doorknob and tried to get it open to no avail—it was tightly locked. Under it was a big keyhole that would require an equally big key to unlock the special section of the tower."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, past this door must be the attic, where Ashiya lived for years.
entries.literal: "So, past this door must be the attic, where Ashiya lived for years."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, it has to be that. There must be different stairs leading up to it since it's a floor higher.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it has to be that. There must be different stairs leading up to it since it's a floor higher."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right, so it's very likely whoever came up here had a way to open this door. There's no other explanation, really.
entries.literal: "Right, so it's very likely whoever came up here had a way to open this door. There's no other explanation, really."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I thought about it a little, and that doesn't make sense to me.
entries.literal: "I thought about it a little, and that doesn't make sense to me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I looked through this corridor first, and since you were covering the only exit, I knew I had plenty of time, so I walked farther and realized we'd missed this door.
entries.literal: "I looked through this corridor first, and since you were covering the only exit, I knew I had plenty of time, so I walked farther and realized we'd missed this door."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I tried to open it, but it was already locked. Then I went to the offices, which were empty. Since nobody could've left this floor, the only explanation is that they went through here.
entries.literal: "I tried to open it, but it was already locked. Then I went to the offices, which were empty. Since nobody could've left this floor, the only explanation is that they went through here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What doesn't make sense to me is that they got off on this floor with the elevator.
entries.literal: "What doesn't make sense to me is that they got off on this floor with the elevator."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You're right. We determined it was here, so if whoever used it was able to open this door, they would've just taken the elevator all the way up.
entries.literal: "...You're right. We determined it was here, so if whoever used it was able to open this door, they would've just taken the elevator all the way up."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. Katei specifically said that the key works for both the door and the elevator.
entries.literal: "Yeah. Katei specifically said that the key works for both the door and the elevator."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to look through the keyhole and under the door, but nothing could be seen. Was there someone behind it, possibly listening to us?
entries.literal: "I tried to look through the keyhole and under the door, but nothing could be seen. Was there someone behind it, possibly listening to us?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We went up fast, so I doubt they could've taken the elevator up to the attic and then sent it to the sixth floor to conceal where they'd gone.
entries.literal: "We went up fast, so I doubt they could've taken the elevator up to the attic and then sent it to the sixth floor to conceal where they'd gone."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, we experienced how slow it was. There wouldn't have been time for that.{w} I thought that maybe this door was already unlocked or that they had the key hidden somewhere on this floor.
entries.literal: "Yeah, we experienced how slow it was. There wouldn't have been time for that.{w} I thought that maybe this door was already unlocked or that they had the key hidden somewhere on this floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I doubt the door was unlocked. We could've easily found it earlier, so they wouldn't have let us enter it like that.
entries.literal: "I doubt the door was unlocked. We could've easily found it earlier, so they wouldn't have let us enter it like that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Also, it's locked now. If it was actually open, unless it can be manually locked from the inside, they must've had the key.
entries.literal: "Also, it's locked now. If it was actually open, unless it can be manually locked from the inside, they must've had the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stayed quiet for a bit. Were we on the right line of thinking? If the culprit had access to the attic, a few things we'd considered would be invalidated.
entries.literal: "I stayed quiet for a bit. Were we on the right line of thinking? If the culprit had access to the attic, a few things we'd considered would be invalidated."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What if the elevator was empty?
entries.literal: "What if the elevator was empty?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And someone sent it here from the crystal floor?
entries.literal: "And someone sent it here from the crystal floor?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure what the intention would be, but it's possible whoever sent it was hoping to lure us out of where we were.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure what the intention would be, but it's possible whoever sent it was hoping to lure us out of where we were."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, yeah. If they wanted to get to the fourth floor, they could've sent the elevator to make us follow it, but that seems pointless. It'd give them time, but they'd still be cornered. It's not that difficult to inspect every floor.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah. If they wanted to get to the fourth floor, they could've sent the elevator to make us follow it, but that seems pointless. It'd give them time, but they'd still be cornered. It's not that difficult to inspect every floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...And Sai did say that he would check the second and third floors before staying in hallway C. Unless he was the one who moved it, the culprit would've also had to make it past him.
entries.literal: "...And Sai did say that he would check the second and third floors before staying in hallway C. Unless he was the one who moved it, the culprit would've also had to make it past him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Such a theory sounded very unlikely, but if it was right, we'd soon find out. We couldn't know if the elevator had moved before the others reached the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Such a theory sounded very unlikely, but if it was right, we'd soon find out. We couldn't know if the elevator had moved before the others reached the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I was also thinking that if the person we're searching for has access to the attic, they might've been responsible for the first time we heard the elevator.
entries.literal: "I was also thinking that if the person we're searching for has access to the attic, they might've been responsible for the first time we heard the elevator."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We made sure floors 5 and 6 were empty, but if that person was one floor higher, they could've called the elevator resting on floor 6 and then gone down with it. That would explain why it didn't immediately go back up.
entries.literal: "We made sure floors 5 and 6 were empty, but if that person was one floor higher, they could've called the elevator resting on floor 6 and then gone down with it. That would explain why it didn't immediately go back up."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm... Then the same person must've been who used it just now. It's possible they got off on floor 6 instead of the attic because they knew it would be empty and could easily reach this door.{w} If we noticed the elevator and followed it, it would look like it was empty, but if they went directly to the attic instead, we might've noticed it went there if we called it fast enough.
entries.literal: "Hm... Then the same person must've been who used it just now. It's possible they got off on floor 6 instead of the attic because they knew it would be empty and could easily reach this door.{w} If we noticed the elevator and followed it, it would look like it was empty, but if they went directly to the attic instead, we might've noticed it went there if we called it fast enough."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. Something along these lines might make the most sense. We should go see if the others found Naomi.
entries.literal: "I see. Something along these lines might make the most sense. We should go see if the others found Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We slowly walked back. I'd always seen Shiroya as intelligent, and she had just shown that sharing my thoughts with her was a good idea despite her recent state of mind.
entries.literal: "We slowly walked back. I'd always seen Shiroya as intelligent, and she had just shown that sharing my thoughts with her was a good idea despite her recent state of mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps she had been silently thinking by herself until then. Regardless, that was the longest conversation we'd had in many days, but it already felt like we were many steps closer to normalcy.
entries.literal: "Perhaps she had been silently thinking by herself until then. Regardless, that was the longest conversation we'd had in many days, but it already felt like we were many steps closer to normalcy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew things wouldn't quite feel right for a much longer time, but if we went back to being our normal selves around each other, we could get there much quicker.
entries.literal: "I knew things wouldn't quite feel right for a much longer time, but if we went back to being our normal selves around each other, we could get there much quicker."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been thinking about it nonstop. I didn't know if wishing to go back to how things used to be meant that I was a bad person, but I couldn't change the way I felt.
entries.literal: "I'd been thinking about it nonstop. I didn't know if wishing to go back to how things used to be meant that I was a bad person, but I couldn't change the way I felt."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before we reached the staircase, we noticed that fast but quiet footsteps were approaching. We stopped awkwardly and waited to see who they belonged to.
entries.literal: "Before we reached the staircase, we noticed that fast but quiet footsteps were approaching. We stopped awkwardly and waited to see who they belonged to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was Akaro. He came running from floor 5.
entries.literal: "...It was Akaro. He came running from floor 5."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What are you doing here? We need you two to come to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "What are you doing here? We need you two to come to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you find Naomi?
entries.literal: "Did you find Naomi?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No, quite the opposite. Sai said that all of us should be there to discuss what happened.
entries.literal: "No, quite the opposite. Sai said that all of us should be there to discuss what happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: A-All right... Let's go, then.
entries.literal: "A-All right... Let's go, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro, out of breath, turned around without wasting time.
entries.literal: "Akaro, out of breath, turned around without wasting time."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I didn't think you'd be on the highest floor. Weren't you supposed to wait on the fourth?
entries.literal: "I didn't think you'd be on the highest floor. Weren't you supposed to wait on the fourth?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We began to go down the stairs. Meanwhile, we told Akaro that we'd determined the elevator stopped on the sixth floor and there was no one there.
entries.literal: "We began to go down the stairs. Meanwhile, we told Akaro that we'd determined the elevator stopped on the sixth floor and there was no one there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our conversation continued as we quickly circled through floors 5 and 4. Akaro was hurrying up a fair bit, and he hadn't given us much context.
entries.literal: "Our conversation continued as we quickly circled through floors 5 and 4. Akaro was hurrying up a fair bit, and he hadn't given us much context."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, right. We heard the elevator going up too, but Sai told us not to chase it since you two would take care of it and could've been sent as bait.
entries.literal: "Oh, right. We heard the elevator going up too, but Sai told us not to chase it since you two would take care of it and could've been sent as bait."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I suppose he gave us too much credit. We didn't react immediately, but I doubt we could've intercepted it.
entries.literal: "I suppose he gave us too much credit. We didn't react immediately, but I doubt we could've intercepted it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those were the last words we heard during the way down, as neither of them chose to reply with anything else.
entries.literal: "Those were the last words we heard during the way down, as neither of them chose to reply with anything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once we'd made it to the last set of stairs, we slowed down our pace as I began to think about what could've happened to warrant the demand of our immediate presence.
entries.literal: "Once we'd made it to the last set of stairs, we slowed down our pace as I began to think about what could've happened to warrant the demand of our immediate presence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The others were all next to the stairs, waiting for us.
entries.literal: "The others were all next to the stairs, waiting for us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That took a bit. Where were you?
entries.literal: "That took a bit. Where were you?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: On the sixth floor.
entries.literal: "On the sixth floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, so you had to check every floor.
entries.literal: "Oh, so you had to check every floor."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I just ran up hoping to eventually find them, and they said they hadn't seen anyone.
entries.literal: "I just ran up hoping to eventually find them, and they said they hadn't seen anyone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's where the elevator stopped, but we're not sure anyone came out of it.
entries.literal: "It's where the elevator stopped, but we're not sure anyone came out of it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So I was right. For some reason, they just wanted it to be followed.
entries.literal: "So I was right. For some reason, they just wanted it to be followed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I doubt it, honestly. They could only gain time doing that, and given there are eleven hours left, it seems silly. It's possible they don't know that they've been trapped here for twelve hours, but they can't be simply trying to buy themselves time. I think they actually might've escaped by using the elevator.
entries.literal: "I doubt it, honestly. They could only gain time doing that, and given there are eleven hours left, it seems silly. It's possible they don't know that they've been trapped here for twelve hours, but they can't be simply trying to buy themselves time. I think they actually might've escaped by using the elevator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How?
entries.literal: "How?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Before that, why don't you tell us what happened? Was Naomi here?
entries.literal: "Before that, why don't you tell us what happened? Was Naomi here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see her, so it was safe to assume that wasn't the case. I wanted to get straight to the point before suggesting that the person hiding from us might've had access to the attic.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see her, so it was safe to assume that wasn't the case. I wanted to get straight to the point before suggesting that the person hiding from us might've had access to the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We haven't looked through the whole floor yet, actually.
entries.literal: "We haven't looked through the whole floor yet, actually."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I quickly made sure nobody was on the third and second floors while the others prevented anyone from sneaking past. That was when the elevator was used, and I assume you couldn't stop it.
entries.literal: "I quickly made sure nobody was on the third and second floors while the others prevented anyone from sneaking past. That was when the elevator was used, and I assume you couldn't stop it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No, we weren't expecting it so soon.
entries.literal: "No, we weren't expecting it so soon."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whatever. We went to the first floor, and we did what you heard Katei propose. He went ahead and looked through the lobby and the mechanical room. When he was done, he stayed next to the door leading to hallway B.
entries.literal: "Whatever. We went to the first floor, and we did what you heard Katei propose. He went ahead and looked through the lobby and the mechanical room. When he was done, he stayed next to the door leading to hallway B."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Akaro began to look through the hallway B rooms since he'd looked at the bathrooms previously. Isla wanted to join him, so Erina had to follow behind. The three of them started to enter the rooms while I stayed here, looking at hallway A so that nobody could escape.
entries.literal: "Akaro began to look through the hallway B rooms since he'd looked at the bathrooms previously. Isla wanted to join him, so Erina had to follow behind. The three of them started to enter the rooms while I stayed here, looking at hallway A so that nobody could escape."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Since the elevator had already gone up, it was pointless to call it and leave its door open. I couldn't see the three of them looking inside the rooms since I was staring at the other hallway and blocking the staircase, though.
entries.literal: "Since the elevator had already gone up, it was pointless to call it and leave its door open. I couldn't see the three of them looking inside the rooms since I was staring at the other hallway and blocking the staircase, though."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anyway, apparently when they entered the event room, Isla went ahead and raised the curtain on the cabinet. The "It's gone!" shout I heard even from here conveyed her surprise pretty well.
entries.literal: "Anyway, apparently when they entered the event room, Isla went ahead and raised the curtain on the cabinet. The \"It's gone!\" shout I heard even from here conveyed her surprise pretty well."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What...? The Sekimeiya's gone?
entries.literal: "What...? The Sekimeiya's gone?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes... It should've still been there, but I didn't see it anywhere.
entries.literal: "Yes... It should've still been there, but I didn't see it anywhere."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei abandoned his post after hearing Isla shout, but I didn't want to rush inside and leave an easy escape route open. When they came and told me what had happened, I thought you two had to get down here. Since we're dealing with this situation, I found it appropriate to join up and make sure nothing slipped away.
entries.literal: "Katei abandoned his post after hearing Isla shout, but I didn't want to rush inside and leave an easy escape route open. When they came and told me what had happened, I thought you two had to get down here. Since we're dealing with this situation, I found it appropriate to join up and make sure nothing slipped away."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I told Akaro to go find you, and I took that time to check if it really had disappeared while the others waited here.{w} It's gone. I stayed there a while, thinking about what could've happened, and expecting to find you two when I came back. Anyway, many of these rooms haven't been investigated yet. We stayed here until you came back to secure the only exits.
entries.literal: "I told Akaro to go find you, and I took that time to check if it really had disappeared while the others waited here.{w} It's gone. I stayed there a while, thinking about what could've happened, and expecting to find you two when I came back. Anyway, many of these rooms haven't been investigated yet. We stayed here until you came back to secure the only exits."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I understand... It's good that the stairs and the elevator are next to each other.{w} Can I go see it?
entries.literal: "I understand... It's good that the stairs and the elevator are next to each other.{w} Can I go see it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If you're looking forward to seeing an empty cabinet, go ahead. As long as someone stays here, we can move through this floor.
entries.literal: "If you're looking forward to seeing an empty cabinet, go ahead. As long as someone stays here, we can move through this floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone else had been looking at us without uttering a word. Shiroya and I slowly walked toward hallway A, and as we saw that nobody was stopping us, we sped up to the event room.
entries.literal: "Everyone else had been looking at us without uttering a word. Shiroya and I slowly walked toward hallway A, and as we saw that nobody was stopping us, we sped up to the event room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's really not here.
entries.literal: "It's really not here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I suppose he was right. There wasn't much of a point in checking.
entries.literal: "I suppose he was right. There wasn't much of a point in checking."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Not really.
entries.literal: "Not really."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We left through the same door and approached the others as I thought about it: what had happened? Were there really that many possibilities?
entries.literal: "We left through the same door and approached the others as I thought about it: what had happened? Were there really that many possibilities?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Was it gone, or did we all lie?
entries.literal: "Was it gone, or did we all lie?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Apparently not.
entries.literal: "...Apparently not."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The Sekimeiya has been stolen this early, which is surprising. Anyone have a suggestion regarding what could've happened before we resume our search?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya has been stolen this early, which is surprising. Anyone have a suggestion regarding what could've happened before we resume our search?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It could only have been Naomi, right?
entries.literal: "It could only have been Naomi, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No. It could only have been Naomi, Katei, or an unknown person.
entries.literal: "No. It could only have been Naomi, Katei, or an unknown person."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you going to suspect me forever?
entries.literal: "Are you going to suspect me forever?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It seems so. When we split up in two groups, it's possible either Naomi or an unknown person had already stolen the Sekimeiya. That's very easy to conclude. When we were in hallway B, Naomi could've entered the event room from hallway A, for example.
entries.literal: "It seems so. When we split up in two groups, it's possible either Naomi or an unknown person had already stolen the Sekimeiya. That's very easy to conclude. When we were in hallway B, Naomi could've entered the event room from hallway A, for example."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The group that took the elevator—Atsuki, Shiroya, Erina, and Isla—couldn't have gotten to this floor.
entries.literal: "The group that took the elevator—Atsuki, Shiroya, Erina, and Isla—couldn't have gotten to this floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you sure? It's possible they went past us and we didn't notice.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? It's possible they went past us and we didn't notice."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You already tried to say this earlier, didn't you? They couldn't have done that.{w} The way we looked through the floors would've made that impossible, and they couldn't have used the elevator since we only heard it once.
entries.literal: "You already tried to say this earlier, didn't you? They couldn't have done that.{w} The way we looked through the floors would've made that impossible, and they couldn't have used the elevator since we only heard it once."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And, naturally, when you came here with Naomi, you would've had an easy time picking up the Sekimeiya and then hiding it somewhere. Later, we'll check that mechanical room you were so happy to inspect.
entries.literal: "And, naturally, when you came here with Naomi, you would've had an easy time picking up the Sekimeiya and then hiding it somewhere. Later, we'll check that mechanical room you were so happy to inspect."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is ridiculous. Didn't I say how important it was for the Sekimeiya to stay in its cabinet? Why would I hide it? There aren't even places to hide it in this building, and it would be pointless!
entries.literal: "This is ridiculous. Didn't I say how important it was for the Sekimeiya to stay in its cabinet? Why would I hide it? There aren't even places to hide it in this building, and it would be pointless!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I will admit that I have no idea what your reason could be, but similarly, I can't think of one regardless of who the culprit is. It is true that there aren't many hiding spots, and it's very early for this.
entries.literal: "I will admit that I have no idea what your reason could be, but similarly, I can't think of one regardless of who the culprit is. It is true that there aren't many hiding spots, and it's very early for this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If one thing's for sure, it's that right now, the Sekimeiya must be on this floor with the culprit. There's no other possibility unless you question me and think that Akaro and I could've gone down instead of waiting on floor 4.
entries.literal: "If one thing's for sure, it's that right now, the Sekimeiya must be on this floor with the culprit. There's no other possibility unless you question me and think that Akaro and I could've gone down instead of waiting on floor 4."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't believe that's true. You looked through floors 3 and 2 for Naomi, but if the Sekimeiya was left there, you might've missed it.
entries.literal: "I don't believe that's true. You looked through floors 3 and 2 for Naomi, but if the Sekimeiya was left there, you might've missed it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, correct. That's a possibility too, but since the elevator that went up was probably empty, nobody can still be upstairs and hide it further, so we can go look for it above if nothing's found on this floor.
entries.literal: "Oh, correct. That's a possibility too, but since the elevator that went up was probably empty, nobody can still be upstairs and hide it further, so we can go look for it above if nothing's found on this floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Even though floors 2 and 3 were a possibility, I knew it was also very possible that the culprit had gone to the attic holding the Sekimeiya. If our search amounted to nothing, I would bring up the conclusion Shiroya and I had reached.
entries.literal: "...Even though floors 2 and 3 were a possibility, I knew it was also very possible that the culprit had gone to the attic holding the Sekimeiya. If our search amounted to nothing, I would bring up the conclusion Shiroya and I had reached."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's proceed, then. We'll need to start from the beginning. Someone else go look through the lobby and the mechanical room, though.
entries.literal: "Let's proceed, then. We'll need to start from the beginning. Someone else go look through the lobby and the mechanical room, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe we should start with that one.
entries.literal: "Maybe we should start with that one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I directed my look at the room where the gemstones had been stolen—A5.
entries.literal: "I directed my look at the room where the gemstones had been stolen—A5."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Because of the camera?
entries.literal: "Because of the camera?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. Like Sai said, hiding anything on this floor right now seems weird since we should be able to find it easily. We have plenty of time, and it's not a hard task. ...Not to mention that even if we can't find it, Ashiya surely will. It feels pretty redundant.
entries.literal: "Yes. Like Sai said, hiding anything on this floor right now seems weird since we should be able to find it easily. We have plenty of time, and it's not a hard task. ...Not to mention that even if we can't find it, Ashiya surely will. It feels pretty redundant."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But there must be an actual reason behind it, and if they really intended to hide it from us, a room that's not being recorded seems to be the most likely place. Even if it's found, Ashiya will never be able to look at the footage to see who hid it.
entries.literal: "But there must be an actual reason behind it, and if they really intended to hide it from us, a room that's not being recorded seems to be the most likely place. Even if it's found, Ashiya will never be able to look at the footage to see who hid it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This is a bit confusing, though. It's true that our three suspects are Katei, Naomi, and an unknown person. All of them would've had access to the Sekimeiya while we were knocked out, so I wonder why they didn't hide it then.
entries.literal: "This is a bit confusing, though. It's true that our three suspects are Katei, Naomi, and an unknown person. All of them would've had access to the Sekimeiya while we were knocked out, so I wonder why they didn't hide it then."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's true...{w} Well, we can check there first if someone stays here.
entries.literal: "That's true...{w} Well, we can check there first if someone stays here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai walked to the room and gestured at me to follow him. Everyone else stayed next to the stairs, as it wasn't yet a thorough search that would require further positioning.
entries.literal: "Sai walked to the room and gestured at me to follow him. Everyone else stayed next to the stairs, as it wasn't yet a thorough search that would require further positioning."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's see. We should keep the door open. Otherwise, we won't see anything.
entries.literal: "Let's see. We should keep the door open. Otherwise, we won't see anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At first glance, there wasn't anything odd in the room. It all looked as it had when we'd last been there. Even though cabinets were the only thing inside, Sai started slowly examining them.
entries.literal: "At first glance, there wasn't anything odd in the room. It all looked as it had when we'd last been there. Even though cabinets were the only thing inside, Sai started slowly examining them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I began looking through the opposite side of the room. There were plenty of places to hide a small object.{w} Behind the cabinets, under the pillows that normally held gemstones... A cabinet even had empty drawers.
entries.literal: "I began looking through the opposite side of the room. There were plenty of places to hide a small object.{w} Behind the cabinets, under the pillows that normally held gemstones... A cabinet even had empty drawers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I looked at Sai, I realized that even though their appearances were nearly identical, not every cabinet was the same. He was inspecting the expansive interior of a cabinet after he'd opened up the heavy-looking lid. It seemed that the upper sections, where the gemstones usually were, could be lifted up.
entries.literal: "As I looked at Sai, I realized that even though their appearances were nearly identical, not every cabinet was the same. He was inspecting the expansive interior of a cabinet after he'd opened up the heavy-looking lid. It seemed that the upper sections, where the gemstones usually were, could be lifted up."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is there anything there?
entries.literal: "Is there anything there?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Yes. Some of these have hollow interiors, most likely to store things. Look, though.
entries.literal: "...Yes. Some of these have hollow interiors, most likely to store things. Look, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to get close to him, as the lack of illumination made it impossible to see what he was holding.{w} It was nothing noteworthy; he was cupping a small, yellow gemstone on his palm.
entries.literal: "I had to get close to him, as the lack of illumination made it impossible to see what he was holding.{w} It was nothing noteworthy; he was cupping a small, yellow gemstone on his palm."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They must keep some of these inside the cabinets to swap out the displayed ones. Apparently, not all of this room's valuables were stolen.
entries.literal: "They must keep some of these inside the cabinets to swap out the displayed ones. Apparently, not all of this room's valuables were stolen."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. I guess this could make for a decent hiding spot.
entries.literal: "I see. I guess this could make for a decent hiding spot."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sort of. The others were taking a while earlier, so they probably opened up some cabinets too. It's still an obvious spot if you're trying to find something.
entries.literal: "Sort of. The others were taking a while earlier, so they probably opened up some cabinets too. It's still an obvious spot if you're trying to find something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I went ahead and opened up a cabinet that looked like the one Sai was next to. It was a lot easier than it looked, and a wide but completely empty compartment appeared before me. As all the displays were usually attached to the surface below the glass, when the lid was opened up like a chest, they wouldn't roll.
entries.literal: "...I went ahead and opened up a cabinet that looked like the one Sai was next to. It was a lot easier than it looked, and a wide but completely empty compartment appeared before me. As all the displays were usually attached to the surface below the glass, when the lid was opened up like a chest, they wouldn't roll."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's nothing in this one.
entries.literal: "There's nothing in this one."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, the first one I looked at was empty as well.
entries.literal: "Yeah, the first one I looked at was empty as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Not many more cabinets were left. Shortly after that, we had looked through all of them.
entries.literal: "Not many more cabinets were left. Shortly after that, we had looked through all of them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It seems you were wrong. It's not here.
entries.literal: "It seems you were wrong. It's not here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started to go over the cabinets Sai had looked through to be confident.
entries.literal: "I started to go over the cabinets Sai had looked through to be confident."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you doubt my searching abilities, or do you think I hid it here and ignored it?
entries.literal: "Do you doubt my searching abilities, or do you think I hid it here and ignored it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Neither, I just want to make sure we don't miss anything.
entries.literal: "...Neither, I just want to make sure we don't miss anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I answered without looking at him. It didn't take me long to come to the same conclusion: the Sekimeiya was not in the room.
entries.literal: "I answered without looking at him. It didn't take me long to come to the same conclusion: the Sekimeiya was not in the room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you done? We'll take forever if every room takes us this long.
entries.literal: "Are you done? We'll take forever if every room takes us this long."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We should probably look for anyone on this floor and then do a slower search for the Sekimeiya. The chances of someone and the Sekimeiya being here are pretty much the same.
entries.literal: "We should probably look for anyone on this floor and then do a slower search for the Sekimeiya. The chances of someone and the Sekimeiya being here are pretty much the same."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That could be a good idea. Let's go back.
entries.literal: "That could be a good idea. Let's go back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he turned around, I fixed my eyes on Sai's back. Specifically, at the hip pack going around his waist. He stopped when he noticed I was still staring at him.
entries.literal: "When he turned around, I fixed my eyes on Sai's back. Specifically, at the hip pack going around his waist. He stopped when he noticed I was still staring at him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you looking at this?
entries.literal: "Are you looking at this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He turned it around him and showed me its contents. I could only see a wallet and lip balm appropriate for the cold.
entries.literal: "He turned it around him and showed me its contents. I could only see a wallet and lip balm appropriate for the cold."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't be stupid. It might fit in here, but it'd be more than noticeable. Did you think I'd found it and masterfully put it in without your notice?
entries.literal: "Don't be stupid. It might fit in here, but it'd be more than noticeable. Did you think I'd found it and masterfully put it in without your notice?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, no. I was just looking at it.
entries.literal: "Oh, no. I was just looking at it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I quite like it too. One of those birthday presents I first shrugged off and then ended up using frequently.
entries.literal: "I quite like it too. One of those birthday presents I first shrugged off and then ended up using frequently."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, he turned around and quickly left the room.{w} I sighed and followed his steps. Outside, he was already next to the others.
entries.literal: "Once again, he turned around and quickly left the room.{w} I sighed and followed his steps. Outside, he was already next to the others."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Anything...?
entries.literal: "Anything...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nothing.
entries.literal: "Nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to think of places where the Sekimeiya could've been hidden, but I couldn't come up with any good ones. If it was still on the crystal floor, we should've been able to find it.
entries.literal: "I tried to think of places where the Sekimeiya could've been hidden, but I couldn't come up with any good ones. If it was still on the crystal floor, we should've been able to find it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In a locker, maybe? That's the only safe place I can think of.
entries.literal: "In a locker, maybe? That's the only safe place I can think of."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Oh, how about there?
entries.literal: "Oh, how about there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The suitcase was still on the floor of hallway C.
entries.literal: "The suitcase was still on the floor of hallway C."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did they bank on us not checking it again?
entries.literal: "Did they bank on us not checking it again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I got closer to it, my confidence in that theory decreased. Surely they hadn't relied on such a simple trick.
entries.literal: "As I got closer to it, my confidence in that theory decreased. Surely they hadn't relied on such a simple trick."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was still empty.
entries.literal: "It was still empty."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Let's start, then. I suppose checking the bathrooms again is pointless since nobody could've entered them.
entries.literal: "Let's start, then. I suppose checking the bathrooms again is pointless since nobody could've entered them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without waiting, Akaro stood up and headed toward hallway B. Isla followed behind, which obligated Erina to go with them.
entries.literal: "Without waiting, Akaro stood up and headed toward hallway B. Isla followed behind, which obligated Erina to go with them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's continue with hallway A, actually. It's about time we find out if someone else is here, so let's first check for that. Akaro, before you move on to hallway B, look through the mechanical room too. Mind being the one in the lobby this time, Atsuki? Katei and I will stay here to watch hallway B.
entries.literal: "Let's continue with hallway A, actually. It's about time we find out if someone else is here, so let's first check for that. Akaro, before you move on to hallway B, look through the mechanical room too. Mind being the one in the lobby this time, Atsuki? Katei and I will stay here to watch hallway B."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Sure.
entries.literal: "...Sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The others accepted it easily and began with hallway A, ignoring the room we'd just gotten out of.
entries.literal: "The others accepted it easily and began with hallway A, ignoring the room we'd just gotten out of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Presumptuous as it was, Sai could've kept ordering us around as long as it was efficient. Since Shiroya didn't have a fixed position, she moved to the lobby door with me.
entries.literal: "Presumptuous as it was, Sai could've kept ordering us around as long as it was efficient. Since Shiroya didn't have a fixed position, she moved to the lobby door with me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From there, we looked at the three people checking every room. Akaro led the pack.
entries.literal: "From there, we looked at the three people checking every room. Akaro led the pack."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My first idea was that someone left the Sekimeiya in a room without active security cameras. While the first location had been incorrect, that was still the most likely possibility.
entries.literal: "My first idea was that someone left the Sekimeiya in a room without active security cameras. While the first location had been incorrect, that was still the most likely possibility."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Five other rooms that met that criterion were still available: the staff room, the cleaning room, the mechanical room, the security room, and the storeroom.{w} I looked inside the cleaning bucket, the only place in the lobby where the Sekimeiya could've been hidden from view, but it only contained soapy water.
entries.literal: "Five other rooms that met that criterion were still available: the staff room, the cleaning room, the mechanical room, the security room, and the storeroom.{w} I looked inside the cleaning bucket, the only place in the lobby where the Sekimeiya could've been hidden from view, but it only contained soapy water."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The storeroom was examined, but they were just quickly looking for people—not the Sekimeiya. It was very possible it was in one of those rooms, and if Naomi had put it inside her locker in the staff room, for example, there wasn't much we could do about it. That was one of the only good hiding spots I could think of.
entries.literal: "The storeroom was examined, but they were just quickly looking for people—not the Sekimeiya. It was very possible it was in one of those rooms, and if Naomi had put it inside her locker in the staff room, for example, there wasn't much we could do about it. That was one of the only good hiding spots I could think of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They entered the event room once again. After that, the security room, another place with a route to it that had no concern for cameras, was acknowledged as clean.
entries.literal: "They entered the event room once again. After that, the security room, another place with a route to it that had no concern for cameras, was acknowledged as clean."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I'd seen them come out of every room and claim that nobody had been in them, Akaro went to look at the mechanical room. Even though Isla remained outside, uninterested, Erina joined him as well.
entries.literal: "Once I'd seen them come out of every room and claim that nobody had been in them, Akaro went to look at the mechanical room. Even though Isla remained outside, uninterested, Erina joined him as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They took a considerably longer time with it since the messy interior made a proper search difficult. Once they returned, their expressions indicated that again, nothing of relevance had been found inside, refuting Sai's suspicion. Afterward, they moved on to hallway B.
entries.literal: "They took a considerably longer time with it since the messy interior made a proper search difficult. Once they returned, their expressions indicated that again, nothing of relevance had been found inside, refuting Sai's suspicion. Afterward, they moved on to hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I headed to the hallway B door too, as it wasn't necessary to keep watching A any longer. As soon as it was confirmed empty, the only remaining concern was whether someone could move from hallway B to A through the event room, and since Sai and Katei had watched hallway B, it wasn't a real possibility.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I headed to the hallway B door too, as it wasn't necessary to keep watching A any longer. As soon as it was confirmed empty, the only remaining concern was whether someone could move from hallway B to A through the event room, and since Sai and Katei had watched hallway B, it wasn't a real possibility."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Technically, only two people were needed to optimally search through the whole floor as long as someone stayed next to the stairs while looking into hallway A. Then, the other person could safely look through every room. We'd only been doing it differently because it was what Katei had suggested.
entries.literal: "Technically, only two people were needed to optimally search through the whole floor as long as someone stayed next to the stairs while looking into hallway A. Then, the other person could safely look through every room. We'd only been doing it differently because it was what Katei had suggested."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They started from the rooms on the lobby side onward. Shiroya and I could clearly see Sai and Katei standing on the other exit of the hallway, enacting tight control over the few rooms that remained for Naomi or an extra person to be inside.
entries.literal: "They started from the rooms on the lobby side onward. Shiroya and I could clearly see Sai and Katei standing on the other exit of the hallway, enacting tight control over the few rooms that remained for Naomi or an extra person to be inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If nobody was found in them, the possibility Shiroya and I had come up with would be almost confirmed: that the actual culprit had been in the attic until we'd heard the elevator going down, and that they'd brought the Sekimeiya up with them to hide on a floor we couldn't access.
entries.literal: "If nobody was found in them, the possibility Shiroya and I had come up with would be almost confirmed: that the actual culprit had been in the attic until we'd heard the elevator going down, and that they'd brought the Sekimeiya up with them to hide on a floor we couldn't access."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As that theory grew more likely, I thought further on it and quickly picked up on an important inconsistency.
entries.literal: "As that theory grew more likely, I thought further on it and quickly picked up on an important inconsistency."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro and Sai said that when they'd heard the elevator sound, Naomi had already shown up and left with Katei.{w} If that was the case, Naomi could not have been in the attic the way I'd thought about things. To make it work, I had to slightly change it.
entries.literal: "Akaro and Sai said that when they'd heard the elevator sound, Naomi had already shown up and left with Katei.{w} If that was the case, Naomi could not have been in the attic the way I'd thought about things. To make it work, I had to slightly change it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing was out of place if we'd missed Naomi when we'd inspected the crystal floor together, she went up to the third floor to talk with Katei, and she then called the elevator to keep it on the first floor. Later, she'd used it to move to the attic as soon as she'd obtained the Sekimeiya, probably because she'd realized she couldn't convince Katei.
entries.literal: "Nothing was out of place if we'd missed Naomi when we'd inspected the crystal floor together, she went up to the third floor to talk with Katei, and she then called the elevator to keep it on the first floor. Later, she'd used it to move to the attic as soon as she'd obtained the Sekimeiya, probably because she'd realized she couldn't convince Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The first three rooms were handled with ease. The others kept going and looked through the event room once again despite the fact that it was impossible anything in it had changed.
entries.literal: "The first three rooms were handled with ease. The others kept going and looked through the event room once again despite the fact that it was impossible anything in it had changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonchalantly—almost forgetting what could've been resting in any of the rooms—Akaro opened the door in front of it. He looked inside, and his body froze.
entries.literal: "Nonchalantly—almost forgetting what could've been resting in any of the rooms—Akaro opened the door in front of it. He looked inside, and his body froze."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From afar, I was able to see his expression shifting to a blank and pale one. With his hand on the doorknob, he turned around, frantically trying to meet someone else's gaze.
entries.literal: "From afar, I was able to see his expression shifting to a blank and pale one. With his hand on the doorknob, he turned around, frantically trying to meet someone else's gaze."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What's wrong...? Anything inside?
entries.literal: "What's wrong...? Anything inside?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The silent corridors allowed us to make out their words. On the other side, Sai and Katei had also realized that something unusual was inside that room.
entries.literal: "The silent corridors allowed us to make out their words. On the other side, Sai and Katei had also realized that something unusual was inside that room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Wh-What!? Isla, stop!
entries.literal: "...Wh-What!? Isla, stop!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina, after peeking over Akaro's shoulder, immediately pushed aside Isla, who'd been about to glance into the room.
entries.literal: "Erina, after peeking over Akaro's shoulder, immediately pushed aside Isla, who'd been about to glance into the room."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm...? Let me see...
entries.literal: "Hm...? Let me see..."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Guys, come here. It seems we weren't wrong.
entries.literal: "Guys, come here. It seems we weren't wrong."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With an altered voice, Akaro instructed we could abandon our positions, as the search had finished.
entries.literal: "With an altered voice, Akaro instructed we could abandon our positions, as the search had finished."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unnerved, we went to see what had caused those reactions. Sai brushed past Akaro to see what he'd found. Despite his constant effort at appearing unfazed and composed, the moment he set his eyes inside, he was visibly startled.
entries.literal: "Unnerved, we went to see what had caused those reactions. Sai brushed past Akaro to see what he'd found. Despite his constant effort at appearing unfazed and composed, the moment he set his eyes inside, he was visibly startled."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: S-Seriously...?
entries.literal: "S-Seriously...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room, B4, was in the middle of the hallway. Katei, Shiroya, and I arrived at the same time, silently glancing at each other. Erina was still tightly holding Isla, and both of them moved back to let us see through the door.
entries.literal: "The room, B4, was in the middle of the hallway. Katei, Shiroya, and I arrived at the same time, silently glancing at each other. Erina was still tightly holding Isla, and both of them moved back to let us see through the door."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh God, no...
entries.literal: "Oh God, no..."

entries.text: Darkroom
entries.literal: "Darkroom"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took us not even a second to understand it. On the floor lay the body of Naomi over a pool of blood. On the wall, close to the door, were traces of more blood.
