Not only that, but a strange odor became noticeable as soon as I stepped inside. I couldn't associate it to anything, but it wasn't prominent enough to be aggravating.
entries.literal: "It took us not even a second to understand it. On the floor lay the body of Naomi over a pool of blood. On the wall, close to the door, were traces of more blood. Not only that, but a strange odor became noticeable as soon as I stepped inside. I couldn't associate it to anything, but it wasn't prominent enough to be aggravating."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, if you're gonna kill somebody, don't make it so obvious.
entries.literal: "Katei, if you're gonna kill somebody, don't make it so obvious."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was far from the first time Sai had said something careless, but it was far over the line for all of us that time. Especially Erina, who had been trying to keep Isla unaware of what had happened.
entries.literal: "It was far from the first time Sai had said something careless, but it was far over the line for all of us that time. Especially Erina, who had been trying to keep Isla unaware of what had happened."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You must be joking... Don't even think about accusing me.
entries.literal: "You must be joking... Don't even think about accusing me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai moved over to the body. With two fingers, he confirmed its status.
entries.literal: "Sai moved over to the body. With two fingers, he confirmed its status."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: She's definitely dead. She probably already was when we got back to this floor. This room wasn't searched earlier, right?
entries.literal: "She's definitely dead. She probably already was when we got back to this floor. This room wasn't searched earlier, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No. We stopped at the event room. This one was next, so you could be right.
entries.literal: "No. We stopped at the event room. This one was next, so you could be right."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No, th-that's...
entries.literal: "No, th-that's..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wait!
entries.literal: "Wait!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, who hadn't yet put up any resistance, was able to escape from Erina's grip. Her shock escalated when she understood that we were telling the truth.
entries.literal: "Isla, who hadn't yet put up any resistance, was able to escape from Erina's grip. Her shock escalated when she understood that we were telling the truth."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: But... that's impossible! Why did—
entries.literal: "But... that's impossible! Why did—"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's clearly possible, just look at her. And I'll sure think about it, Katei. You are the only person who could've done this.
entries.literal: "It's clearly possible, just look at her. And I'll sure think about it, Katei. You are the only person who could've done this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While they were audibly reacting, I found myself silently aghast, which I hadn't been prepared for. I'd been carelessly going over the entire incident, but as soon as the image of the dead Naomi met my eyes, any focus on reality departed from my body.
entries.literal: "While they were audibly reacting, I found myself silently aghast, which I hadn't been prepared for. I'd been carelessly going over the entire incident, but as soon as the image of the dead Naomi met my eyes, any focus on reality departed from my body."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya, at my side, looked identical to me. The concept of death and loss had recently been changed for us.{w} She and I hadn't experienced it until two weeks ago, when the world we'd created together crumbled down without warning.
entries.literal: "Shiroya, at my side, looked identical to me. The concept of death and loss had recently been changed for us.{w} She and I hadn't experienced it until two weeks ago, when the world we'd created together crumbled down without warning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi's lifeless body was an immediate reminder. One that came as soon as I started having hope for the future again.
entries.literal: "Naomi's lifeless body was an immediate reminder. One that came as soon as I started having hope for the future again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I fixed my eyes on Shiroya's face as the others kept up their arguing. They wouldn't have noticed the sheer panic she was experiencing, but I knew her better. Her effort at moving on had been denied by reality; we'd been put back in our place.
entries.literal: "I fixed my eyes on Shiroya's face as the others kept up their arguing. They wouldn't have noticed the sheer panic she was experiencing, but I knew her better. Her effort at moving on had been denied by reality; we'd been put back in our place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I never knew how to respond. Thoughtless reassurance wouldn't achieve anything. However, even though it might not have been any help, I tried to put everything I wanted to say into a hand that I placed on her shoulder—as a way to distance myself from the insentient and inanimate support I'd been until then.
entries.literal: "I never knew how to respond. Thoughtless reassurance wouldn't achieve anything. However, even though it might not have been any help, I tried to put everything I wanted to say into a hand that I placed on her shoulder—as a way to distance myself from the insentient and inanimate support I'd been until then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I knew each other since our first year of elementary school, where we became classmates for the first time. Our parents were friends, which quickly tied us together.{w} We would see one another during school and our parents' meetings, so we rapidly grew close. Before becoming classmates, we'd already met a few times, but we'd never really spoken.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I knew each other since our first year of elementary school, where we became classmates for the first time. Our parents were friends, which quickly tied us together.{w} We would see one another during school and our parents' meetings, so we rapidly grew close. Before becoming classmates, we'd already met a few times, but we'd never really spoken."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our parents worked for Yushibana's hospital, but their work involved securing deals with entities outside the town, which made them travel very often. We'd been told that the four of them were a group of friends since long before we were born, and that they all met when they were lower down their workplace's ladder.
entries.literal: "Our parents worked for Yushibana's hospital, but their work involved securing deals with entities outside the town, which made them travel very often. We'd been told that the four of them were a group of friends since long before we were born, and that they all met when they were lower down their workplace's ladder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A bit more than a year prior, they accepted a job offer overseas. Despite their insistent attempts at making us accompany them, we were strongly against it, as we'd lived in Yushibana our whole lives. The idea of traveling to another continent wasn't a pleasant one. Unlike them, we didn't even know the language there.
entries.literal: "A bit more than a year prior, they accepted a job offer overseas. Despite their insistent attempts at making us accompany them, we were strongly against it, as we'd lived in Yushibana our whole lives. The idea of traveling to another continent wasn't a pleasant one. Unlike them, we didn't even know the language there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They eventually had to give up and accepted paying for our necessary expenses like food and rent. We'd lived by ourselves since then.
entries.literal: "They eventually had to give up and accepted paying for our necessary expenses like food and rent. We'd lived by ourselves since then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One year ago, Shiroya and I finished high school together. In Yushibana, people tended to move out if they planned to attend university, seeing as the closest one was hours away. That was why we hadn't yet decided on what to do and thought of the year 2011 as a pivotal point where we'd decide. Money wasn't an immediate problem for either of us, and we weren't sure what we wanted to study if we decided to move.
entries.literal: "One year ago, Shiroya and I finished high school together. In Yushibana, people tended to move out if they planned to attend university, seeing as the closest one was hours away. That was why we hadn't yet decided on what to do and thought of the year 2011 as a pivotal point where we'd decide. Money wasn't an immediate problem for either of us, and we weren't sure what we wanted to study if we decided to move."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The last important factor that influenced our decision first made an appearance in our lives when we started middle school. Most of us were the same people who had attended elementary school together, but a new classmate named Miiya moved to Yushibana that year.
entries.literal: "The last important factor that influenced our decision first made an appearance in our lives when we started middle school. Most of us were the same people who had attended elementary school together, but a new classmate named Miiya moved to Yushibana that year."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At first, Shiroya and I didn't talk to her much, and neither did our usual group of friends. Miiya quickly became comfortable with other people in our class, which kept some distance between us.
entries.literal: "At first, Shiroya and I didn't talk to her much, and neither did our usual group of friends. Miiya quickly became comfortable with other people in our class, which kept some distance between us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That changed three years later, the day she approached me when I was alone. She was curious about us and wanted to hang out. I never really understood what drove her to do that, but we spent an entire afternoon together, and following that day, she would spend some time with me every so often.
entries.literal: "That changed three years later, the day she approached me when I was alone. She was curious about us and wanted to hang out. I never really understood what drove her to do that, but we spent an entire afternoon together, and following that day, she would spend some time with me every so often."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few months later, she appeared when Shiroya and I were together, and they introduced themselves in more depth. Since then, the three of us started to become comfortable around each other after school. It was out of the ordinary for us since we were used to being alone, but we quickly took a liking to Miiya.{w} She was a blunt and sincere girl—one who didn't seem to have many worries in life or think too hard about things. Even though she'd made her way into our lives out of the blue, we became accustomed to her presence.
entries.literal: "A few months later, she appeared when Shiroya and I were together, and they introduced themselves in more depth. Since then, the three of us started to become comfortable around each other after school. It was out of the ordinary for us since we were used to being alone, but we quickly took a liking to Miiya.{w} She was a blunt and sincere girl—one who didn't seem to have many worries in life or think too hard about things. Even though she'd made her way into our lives out of the blue, we became accustomed to her presence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Initially, she passed the time with us sporadically and acted as another link between Shiroya and me, but the frequency increased to the point where the three of us would spend almost every afternoon together.
entries.literal: "Initially, she passed the time with us sporadically and acted as another link between Shiroya and me, but the frequency increased to the point where the three of us would spend almost every afternoon together."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Last year, the end of high school became somewhat of an obstacle for what had grown to be our daily lives. Miiya was different from us in the sense that she knew she didn't want to continue studying, and she instead started searching for a job in Yushibana while living with her parents.
entries.literal: "Last year, the end of high school became somewhat of an obstacle for what had grown to be our daily lives. Miiya was different from us in the sense that she knew she didn't want to continue studying, and she instead started searching for a job in Yushibana while living with her parents."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The previous summer was not an easy one for us. Shiroya and I weren't sure what to do with our futures, and we knew that if our decisions differed, we might stop seeing each other. Behind everything else, that was always my biggest worry, and at the same time, Miiya was only focused on searching for a job that wanted her.{w} I felt like I was stuck in the past, wishing that our school days could continue as always. Meanwhile, the uncertainty of the future prevented Shiroya from resting easy. That made it hard for us to keep up with each other, and even though the circumstances were perfect for a summer together, the three of us spent it alone.
entries.literal: "The previous summer was not an easy one for us. Shiroya and I weren't sure what to do with our futures, and we knew that if our decisions differed, we might stop seeing each other. Behind everything else, that was always my biggest worry, and at the same time, Miiya was only focused on searching for a job that wanted her.{w} I felt like I was stuck in the past, wishing that our school days could continue as always. Meanwhile, the uncertainty of the future prevented Shiroya from resting easy. That made it hard for us to keep up with each other, and even though the circumstances were perfect for a summer together, the three of us spent it alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It all started to shift back to normal once Shiroya and I decided that neither of us wanted to move out for the time being. We would spend one extra year thinking about it, so at first, that was a perfect excuse to go back to how everything had been before the holidays.
entries.literal: "It all started to shift back to normal once Shiroya and I decided that neither of us wanted to move out for the time being. We would spend one extra year thinking about it, so at first, that was a perfect excuse to go back to how everything had been before the holidays."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unfortunately, all of our conversations had grown stiff. Shiroya and I talked frequently about our decisions through messages, but the three of us hadn't personally seen each other in a while. None of us were at our best, and none of us felt anything resembling enthusiasm. Our relationships loosened even further, and the distance between us widened into a chasm.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, all of our conversations had grown stiff. Shiroya and I talked frequently about our decisions through messages, but the three of us hadn't personally seen each other in a while. None of us were at our best, and none of us felt anything resembling enthusiasm. Our relationships loosened even further, and the distance between us widened into a chasm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I recognized what it had all turned into, I grew despondent. I couldn't do anything to return to our routine, and I wasn't sure if they wanted to. Other friends I had from school completely disappeared from my life in the blink of an eye.
entries.literal: "When I recognized what it had all turned into, I grew despondent. I couldn't do anything to return to our routine, and I wasn't sure if they wanted to. Other friends I had from school completely disappeared from my life in the blink of an eye."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For two or three months, my old life continued fading away.{w} ...That was until I received a call from Miiya. She confessed to feeling a lot like I had and wanting to restore everything. I immediately called Shiroya, who sounded like she was in the same position.
entries.literal: "For two or three months, my old life continued fading away.{w} ...That was until I received a call from Miiya. She confessed to feeling a lot like I had and wanting to restore everything. I immediately called Shiroya, who sounded like she was in the same position."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was just over two weeks before the Sekimeiya showing when we met at my house. We'd gone our longest ever without meeting, but we still recognized each other as the people we'd spent the entirety of our teenage years with. It was difficult at first, but since we knew the three of us wanted to finally get over our new barriers, the constricting ice that had formed around us broke much more easily than I'd anticipated.
entries.literal: "It was just over two weeks before the Sekimeiya showing when we met at my house. We'd gone our longest ever without meeting, but we still recognized each other as the people we'd spent the entirety of our teenage years with. It was difficult at first, but since we knew the three of us wanted to finally get over our new barriers, the constricting ice that had formed around us broke much more easily than I'd anticipated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We said that we'd go back to how everything had been during the start of the year. The three of us needed it and all feared that it had ended long ago.{w} Even though we'd settled that, there weren't many things to do during the winter in Yushibana. Hanging out and talking for hours used to work in the past, but if we were starting fresh, that might not have sufficed. That was how we came across Ashiya's advertisement; on December 15th, their biggest event to date would be held.
entries.literal: "We said that we'd go back to how everything had been during the start of the year. The three of us needed it and all feared that it had ended long ago.{w} Even though we'd settled that, there weren't many things to do during the winter in Yushibana. Hanging out and talking for hours used to work in the past, but if we were starting fresh, that might not have sufficed. That was how we came across Ashiya's advertisement; on December 15th, their biggest event to date would be held."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I disliked Ashiya to an extent, but Miiya, having moved to Yushibana as a kid, didn't share the same feeling that had been prominently pushed onto us by the older residents. She had only been vaguely told about the main outline of it all, so when she proposed that we attend the event, we didn't refuse.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I disliked Ashiya to an extent, but Miiya, having moved to Yushibana as a kid, didn't share the same feeling that had been prominently pushed onto us by the older residents. She had only been vaguely told about the main outline of it all, so when she proposed that we attend the event, we didn't refuse."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It honestly sounded like a fine idea to us. Anything the three of us could go to was good.{w} According to the announcement, an event was held in Ashiya Tower every Thursday, each one requiring special entrance tickets.
entries.literal: "It honestly sounded like a fine idea to us. Anything the three of us could go to was good.{w} According to the announcement, an event was held in Ashiya Tower every Thursday, each one requiring special entrance tickets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We accepted it and bought them before they ran out. December had always been a special month for me and Shiroya: my birthday was on the 21st, while hers was on the 19th. We were happy we had reunited just in time for them.
entries.literal: "We accepted it and bought them before they ran out. December had always been a special month for me and Shiroya: my birthday was on the 21st, while hers was on the 19th. We were happy we had reunited just in time for them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As no other special matters were scheduled to happen in Yushibana, we decided to keep looking through Ashiya's events. One that might've been interesting was scheduled for January 26th, when every gemstone in the building would be replaced. We thought that if we enjoyed it the first Thursday, maybe that'd be a good day to return. Meanwhile, we agreed to meet up frequently until the 15th.
entries.literal: "As no other special matters were scheduled to happen in Yushibana, we decided to keep looking through Ashiya's events. One that might've been interesting was scheduled for January 26th, when every gemstone in the building would be replaced. We thought that if we enjoyed it the first Thursday, maybe that'd be a good day to return. Meanwhile, we agreed to meet up frequently until the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, just the next day, Miiya died. We found ourselves in an incident that took her life, and Shiroya had to be hospitalized.
entries.literal: "However, just the next day, Miiya died. We found ourselves in an incident that took her life, and Shiroya had to be hospitalized."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was comically tragic. Everything we thought we had regained was immediately ripped away from us.
entries.literal: "It was comically tragic. Everything we thought we had regained was immediately ripped away from us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya was in a coma for a few days, but she ultimately didn't suffer from anything major. The days during which I waited still, thinking that I might've lost the last two people remaining from my normal life, were harder than anything I ever thought I'd have to suffer. To add unnecessary cruelty, neither my parents nor Shiroya's were able to show up, and they only talked to police officers and doctors over the phone.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was in a coma for a few days, but she ultimately didn't suffer from anything major. The days during which I waited still, thinking that I might've lost the last two people remaining from my normal life, were harder than anything I ever thought I'd have to suffer. To add unnecessary cruelty, neither my parents nor Shiroya's were able to show up, and they only talked to police officers and doctors over the phone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My parents even used the opportunity to tell me once again that I should go live with them. They'd been very insistent about that in the past, and the incident gave them the chance to force it even further.
entries.literal: "My parents even used the opportunity to tell me once again that I should go live with them. They'd been very insistent about that in the past, and the incident gave them the chance to force it even further."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had almost never talked to Miiya's parents, but when I saw them talking to the agent in charge of things, it was clear that they were devastated; everything in their lives had collapsed in the span of a single day.
entries.literal: "I had almost never talked to Miiya's parents, but when I saw them talking to the agent in charge of things, it was clear that they were devastated; everything in their lives had collapsed in the span of a single day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Shiroya woke up, I was in her hospital room and told her about what happened. She couldn't even cry—she must've despised everything that led to that outcome. After the doctors told her that she wouldn't have to spend more time in the hospital, I offered to let her stay at my house. Having each other as company should've been beneficial for both of us, and my parents' house was big enough.
entries.literal: "When Shiroya woke up, I was in her hospital room and told her about what happened. She couldn't even cry—she must've despised everything that led to that outcome. After the doctors told her that she wouldn't have to spend more time in the hospital, I offered to let her stay at my house. Having each other as company should've been beneficial for both of us, and my parents' house was big enough."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She almost accepted immediately, but she ended up saying she'd think about it. I insisted, saying that she wouldn't be a bother, and accompanied her to her apartment.{w} The next day, she accepted and came over for a temporary stay.
entries.literal: "She almost accepted immediately, but she ended up saying she'd think about it. I insisted, saying that she wouldn't be a bother, and accompanied her to her apartment.{w} The next day, she accepted and came over for a temporary stay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite all my efforts at being helpful, I spent the days closed up physically and mentally, hating myself for that too. I remained shut in my room, sleeping during the day and glancing through the window at night.
entries.literal: "Despite all my efforts at being helpful, I spent the days closed up physically and mentally, hating myself for that too. I remained shut in my room, sleeping during the day and glancing through the window at night."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The life we'd lived for years had met an abrupt end immediately after resuming itself. It wasn't something anyone should have experienced, and it was nothing short of impossible for us to stop wallowing in our own pathetic misery.
entries.literal: "The life we'd lived for years had met an abrupt end immediately after resuming itself. It wasn't something anyone should have experienced, and it was nothing short of impossible for us to stop wallowing in our own pathetic misery."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to distance myself from Shiroya; facing the thought of being left alone was unbearable. That was why I'd immediately asked her to remain together for a few days. At home, we briefly saw each other every day, but no conversations aside from simple words to coordinate ourselves came from either of us.{w} At least, she spent the days with Maxi and Umi, a dog and a cat that had lived with me for years, which I hoped made her feel less lonely. I also got to hear her voice a handful of times when she talked to her parents over the phone, but they were too busy to leave.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to distance myself from Shiroya; facing the thought of being left alone was unbearable. That was why I'd immediately asked her to remain together for a few days. At home, we briefly saw each other every day, but no conversations aside from simple words to coordinate ourselves came from either of us.{w} At least, she spent the days with Maxi and Umi, a dog and a cat that had lived with me for years, which I hoped made her feel less lonely. I also got to hear her voice a handful of times when she talked to her parents over the phone, but they were too busy to leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the 14th, the day before the event, we met in the living room and saw the three tickets we'd bought for it inside the brown purse Miiya would sometimes carry. Knowing that our plans would never happen completely tore me up. I didn't know whether to throw the tickets away, but before I could decide, Shiroya spoke.
entries.literal: "On the 14th, the day before the event, we met in the living room and saw the three tickets we'd bought for it inside the brown purse Miiya would sometimes carry. Knowing that our plans would never happen completely tore me up. I didn't know whether to throw the tickets away, but before I could decide, Shiroya spoke."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Should we still go?"
entries.literal: "\"Should we still go?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't something I'd expected to hear at all, but it conveyed everything Shiroya had been feeling. ...I'd been trying to muster the strength to say it myself too. Despite our sudden loss, she didn't want us to grow cold again.
entries.literal: "It wasn't something I'd expected to hear at all, but it conveyed everything Shiroya had been feeling. ...I'd been trying to muster the strength to say it myself too. Despite our sudden loss, she didn't want us to grow cold again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We decided we'd go anyway, trying not to let the death of our closest friend directly kill our relationship too. We saw it as confirmation that even though everything looked more than grim, we'd do all we could to make it eventually get better.
entries.literal: "We decided we'd go anyway, trying not to let the death of our closest friend directly kill our relationship too. We saw it as confirmation that even though everything looked more than grim, we'd do all we could to make it eventually get better."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We finally talked a bit before the night came. Our schedules were all over the place, and we had to wake up very early to make it to Ashiya Tower before {time=9.}{w} As the night went on, it was clear that neither of us would be able to sleep.
entries.literal: "We finally talked a bit before the night came. Our schedules were all over the place, and we had to wake up very early to make it to Ashiya Tower before {time=9.}{w} As the night went on, it was clear that neither of us would be able to sleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Painfully conscious of our surroundings, we both stayed awake, unable to rest in any way. Once it was clear that it would persist, Shiroya suggested leaving early. It was a relieving thought, one I'd also considered.
entries.literal: "Painfully conscious of our surroundings, we both stayed awake, unable to rest in any way. Once it was clear that it would persist, Shiroya suggested leaving early. It was a relieving thought, one I'd also considered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I agreed immediately. I needed to move and feel the cold night air. Shiroya took two of the three tickets from Miiya's purse and put them in hers, along with our identification to validate them and the keys to my house. As we stepped outside, a calm and pleasant night welcomed us back to our town. We walked through desolate streets without an objective in mind, letting time move at its own pace.
entries.literal: "I agreed immediately. I needed to move and feel the cold night air. Shiroya took two of the three tickets from Miiya's purse and put them in hers, along with our identification to validate them and the keys to my house. As we stepped outside, a calm and pleasant night welcomed us back to our town. We walked through desolate streets without an objective in mind, letting time move at its own pace."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, we reached the outskirts. We were close to Ashiya; we wouldn't usually walk through that part of Yushibana, but we waited right outside the tower in a little plaza Ashiya kept clean, waiting for the sun to rise.
entries.literal: "Eventually, we reached the outskirts. We were close to Ashiya; we wouldn't usually walk through that part of Yushibana, but we waited right outside the tower in a little plaza Ashiya kept clean, waiting for the sun to rise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At {time=6}, everything around us was covered in snow, and even though we'd grown used to the sheer cold of the mountains, staying outside for that long exceeded our limit. We walked to the entrance of the tower and were told by a guard that we could wait inside until the doors opened to the public.
entries.literal: "At {time=6}, everything around us was covered in snow, and even though we'd grown used to the sheer cold of the mountains, staying outside for that long exceeded our limit. We walked to the entrance of the tower and were told by a guard that we could wait inside until the doors opened to the public."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were met by a lady sorting a bunch of papers behind the reception desk. Shiroya and I hadn't talked much, but staying with each other was more than enough. The only other person there was a man in the middle of the room, wearing a lost look. He glanced at us for an instant before going back to how he had been.{w} We'd later learn his name was Akaro, and I would speak to him for the first time in the event room.
entries.literal: "We were met by a lady sorting a bunch of papers behind the reception desk. Shiroya and I hadn't talked much, but staying with each other was more than enough. The only other person there was a man in the middle of the room, wearing a lost look. He glanced at us for an instant before going back to how he had been.{w} We'd later learn his name was Akaro, and I would speak to him for the first time in the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Things had continued and led to... death. Once again, the cruel sensation of death had appeared before us after avoiding it for almost twenty years.
entries.literal: "Things had continued and led to... death. Once again, the cruel sensation of death had appeared before us after avoiding it for almost twenty years."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took a single dead body to make me reminisce over my whole life. I'd started to think that I'd been climbing the first steps to get over what happened by immersing myself in our present incident, but that was far from accurate. Even though I'd gotten Shiroya to start returning to her usual self, at that moment, her face gave away how meaningless that was.
entries.literal: "It took a single dead body to make me reminisce over my whole life. I'd started to think that I'd been climbing the first steps to get over what happened by immersing myself in our present incident, but that was far from accurate. Even though I'd gotten Shiroya to start returning to her usual self, at that moment, her face gave away how meaningless that was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Words started making sense again. Sai, who had been thoughtlessly messing with me without a clue what my last few days had been like, was accusing Katei of murder.
entries.literal: "Words started making sense again. Sai, who had been thoughtlessly messing with me without a clue what my last few days had been like, was accusing Katei of murder."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're out of your mind! I would never kill anyone!
entries.literal: "You're out of your mind! I would never kill anyone!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then why did you? Don't you recall what we've been doing? Nobody else could've been here to do this.
entries.literal: "Then why did you? Don't you recall what we've been doing? Nobody else could've been here to do this."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What if you were the one who did it, Sai?
entries.literal: "What if you were the one who did it, Sai?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was pissing me off. It was reasonable to think that Katei was the culprit, but accusing anyone of stealing someone's life so lightly was something I really didn't like. Even Shiroya didn't expect me to suddenly spit that out.
entries.literal: "It was pissing me off. It was reasonable to think that Katei was the culprit, but accusing anyone of stealing someone's life so lightly was something I really didn't like. Even Shiroya didn't expect me to suddenly spit that out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Excuse me? I was with Akaro on the fourth floor, and the last time we entered this room, we all saw it was empty.
entries.literal: "Excuse me? I was with Akaro on the fourth floor, and the last time we entered this room, we all saw it was empty."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: He's right, we didn't move from there. Are you saying that maybe we both did it to frame Katei?
entries.literal: "He's right, we didn't move from there. Are you saying that maybe we both did it to frame Katei?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No. Sure, that might also be a possibility that lets Katei not be a murderer, but Sai had an easier way all by himself.{w} He said it earlier, right? That he went to check if the Sekimeiya had truly disappeared while you all waited next to the stairs.
entries.literal: "No. Sure, that might also be a possibility that lets Katei not be a murderer, but Sai had an easier way all by himself.{w} He said it earlier, right? That he went to check if the Sekimeiya had truly disappeared while you all waited next to the stairs."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He even admitted to spending a while thinking about what happened. The event room connects both hallways, and from the stairs, you wouldn't have seen what was happening in hallway B. You saw Naomi and chased her over to this room. You definitely could've done this.
entries.literal: "He even admitted to spending a while thinking about what happened. The event room connects both hallways, and from the stairs, you wouldn't have seen what was happening in hallway B. You saw Naomi and chased her over to this room. You definitely could've done this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't let out the word "kill" easily since I didn't believe that Sai being responsible was the most likely thing, but I didn't want to let him forcibly label Katei as a murderer if other possibilities existed.
entries.literal: "I couldn't let out the word \"kill\" easily since I didn't believe that Sai being responsible was the most likely thing, but I didn't want to let him forcibly label Katei as a murderer if other possibilities existed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're not being serious, are you? Don't you think Naomi would've yelled? There's blood on the wall, so since blood is coming from the back of her head, she was probably pushed into it. It follows that she was seeing her killer as it happened, so she would've yelled.
entries.literal: "You're not being serious, are you? Don't you think Naomi would've yelled? There's blood on the wall, so since blood is coming from the back of her head, she was probably pushed into it. It follows that she was seeing her killer as it happened, so she would've yelled."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We would only have missed a yell like that if Katei and Naomi were the only ones present on this floor at the time.
entries.literal: "We would only have missed a yell like that if Katei and Naomi were the only ones present on this floor at the time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But what if she didn't yell? You can't possibly be saying that blood on the wall means she had to. Maybe it happened too fast for her to react, or maybe her mouth was covered.
entries.literal: "But what if she didn't yell? You can't possibly be saying that blood on the wall means she had to. Maybe it happened too fast for her to react, or maybe her mouth was covered."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, don't be stupid. You must also be aware that Katei has to be the one who did this.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, don't be stupid. You must also be aware that Katei has to be the one who did this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The blood on the wall is next to the door, and Naomi's body is perpendicular to the wall. If you're gonna push someone against a wall, you'll need to be farther from it than your victim, right?
entries.literal: "The blood on the wall is next to the door, and Naomi's body is perpendicular to the wall. If you're gonna push someone against a wall, you'll need to be farther from it than your victim, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Meaning that the culprit was farther from the door than Naomi. You could infer from there that they either entered the room before Naomi or that they entered at the same time.
entries.literal: "Meaning that the culprit was farther from the door than Naomi. You could infer from there that they either entered the room before Naomi or that they entered at the same time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That makes sense if Katei was the culprit, but if I chased Naomi here, I wouldn't have had an easy time pushing her into this wall. She would've been farther into the room than me, so I would've had to push her against one of the other three walls.{w} Ignoring, obviously, that she would not have run into a room and cornered herself; she would've escaped from the hallway.
entries.literal: "That makes sense if Katei was the culprit, but if I chased Naomi here, I wouldn't have had an easy time pushing her into this wall. She would've been farther into the room than me, so I would've had to push her against one of the other three walls.{w} Ignoring, obviously, that she would not have run into a room and cornered herself; she would've escaped from the hallway."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Or maybe you entered the room first and the noise lured her in. Maybe you chased her down when she was in the middle of the room, and since she headed to the exit, you pushed her against this wall.
entries.literal: "Or maybe you entered the room first and the noise lured her in. Maybe you chased her down when she was in the middle of the room, and since she headed to the exit, you pushed her against this wall."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not trying to accuse you, but stop acting as if Katei must be responsible.
entries.literal: "I'm not trying to accuse you, but stop acting as if Katei must be responsible."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Also, what the hell is this smell? Does anyone recognize it?
entries.literal: "Also, what the hell is this smell? Does anyone recognize it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone denied it with nearly imperceptible movements. They'd all noticed it, but seeing so much blood under a body must've forced them to ignore it. We had to continue for eleven hours bearing the thought of being trapped with someone who had killed a person.
entries.literal: "Everyone denied it with nearly imperceptible movements. They'd all noticed it, but seeing so much blood under a body must've forced them to ignore it. We had to continue for eleven hours bearing the thought of being trapped with someone who had killed a person."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I have no idea what it is.
entries.literal: "...I have no idea what it is."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me neither, but fine. Atsuki, do you honestly believe I killed Naomi? There's a working security camera here, for fuck's sake. Do you think I'd ruin my life to kill someone I didn't even know a couple hours ago?
entries.literal: "Me neither, but fine. Atsuki, do you honestly believe I killed Naomi? There's a working security camera here, for fuck's sake. Do you think I'd ruin my life to kill someone I didn't even know a couple hours ago?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't really think you're responsible.
entries.literal: "I don't really think you're responsible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then you're accusing Katei too! Sure, I could've had the chance to do it, but there's no other possibility. If you're saying you think I didn't do it, you're also saying you think Katei did.
entries.literal: "Then you're accusing Katei too! Sure, I could've had the chance to do it, but there's no other possibility. If you're saying you think I didn't do it, you're also saying you think Katei did."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I would never kill a person. This has gone too far, Sai.
entries.literal: "I would never kill a person. This has gone too far, Sai."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, shut the fuck up.
entries.literal: "Oh, shut the fuck up."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're wrong. There's at least one more possibility.
entries.literal: "You're wrong. There's at least one more possibility."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What, did Naomi jump into the wall and break her head open?
entries.literal: "What, did Naomi jump into the wall and break her head open?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Remember when the elevator went up before you all reached this floor? It stopped on the sixth. Shiroya and I made sure nobody could've gone unnoticed, but there's a way around that.
entries.literal: "...Remember when the elevator went up before you all reached this floor? It stopped on the sixth. Shiroya and I made sure nobody could've gone unnoticed, but there's a way around that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right, through the door we can't open.
entries.literal: "Right, through the door we can't open."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The one leading to the attic.
entries.literal: "The one leading to the attic."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...He's right. Someone could've gone in before we got there.
entries.literal: "...He's right. Someone could've gone in before we got there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya was trying not to let the shock and despair consume her, and I was glad to be backed up. Even though Erina and Isla should've reacted to the mention of a door they hadn't seen, they didn't so much as twitch.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was trying not to let the shock and despair consume her, and I was glad to be backed up. Even though Erina and Isla should've reacted to the mention of a door they hadn't seen, they didn't so much as twitch."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But it was locked, right? Didn't Katei say that a unique key was required to enter the attic?
entries.literal: "But it was locked, right? Didn't Katei say that a unique key was required to enter the attic?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, but imagining a culprit with that key isn't all that crazy, is it?
entries.literal: "Yes, but imagining a culprit with that key isn't all that crazy, is it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Please... This is just pathetic to watch.
entries.literal: "Please... This is just pathetic to watch."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm? What is?
entries.literal: "Hm? What is?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It also took me by surprise. Katei was looking directly at me.
entries.literal: "It also took me by surprise. Katei was looking directly at me."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Atsuki, stop trying to find nonexistent ways out.{w} You are the one who killed Naomi.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, stop trying to find nonexistent ways out.{w} You are the one who killed Naomi."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're kidding, right...? You're accusing him?
entries.literal: "You're kidding, right...? You're accusing him?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He absolutely could not have done it. You had the opportunity to at least accuse me.
entries.literal: "He absolutely could not have done it. You had the opportunity to at least accuse me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was still recovering from the most unexpected words I could've heard. He had, without warning, accused me of killing Naomi...
entries.literal: "I was still recovering from the most unexpected words I could've heard. He had, without warning, accused me of killing Naomi..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I'm sorry, but how do you think I did that? I was always with Shiroya, and security cameras recorded every one of my actions on the upper floors.
entries.literal: "...I'm sorry, but how do you think I did that? I was always with Shiroya, and security cameras recorded every one of my actions on the upper floors."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: And not only that, he didn't have a chance to make it down without being spotted.
entries.literal: "And not only that, he didn't have a chance to make it down without being spotted."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's why I have to come to the conclusion that you're all lying to me. All of you.
entries.literal: "That's why I have to come to the conclusion that you're all lying to me. All of you."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm sure of it. Atsuki was here when Naomi and I were on this floor. You guys are giving him a very solid alibi, one that's not possible to circumvent. That's why you must all be lying.
entries.literal: "I'm sure of it. Atsuki was here when Naomi and I were on this floor. You guys are giving him a very solid alibi, one that's not possible to circumvent. That's why you must all be lying."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: However, it is as you say. Security cameras had to record what happened in this room and on the office floors. Your lie won't last long once the system is recovered.
entries.literal: "However, it is as you say. Security cameras had to record what happened in this room and on the office floors. Your lie won't last long once the system is recovered."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What's gotten into you...? At least your lies earlier had some effort.
entries.literal: "What's gotten into you...? At least your lies earlier had some effort."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He's right. This is almost disappointing. Try to convince anyone of that.
entries.literal: "He's right. This is almost disappointing. Try to convince anyone of that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For the first time, one of Sai's retorts was well-received by everyone else. Katei had alleged they were all liars, but they knew the truth: I hadn't killed Naomi.
entries.literal: "For the first time, one of Sai's retorts was well-received by everyone else. Katei had alleged they were all liars, but they knew the truth: I hadn't killed Naomi."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're only digging your own grave by acting as if we're all conspiring against you. You had an actual method of escape that Atsuki provided you with. Taking it would've been a much smarter decision than accusing him.
entries.literal: "You're only digging your own grave by acting as if we're all conspiring against you. You had an actual method of escape that Atsuki provided you with. Taking it would've been a much smarter decision than accusing him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's especially idiotic even for this guy. Why are you saying that Atsuki was on this floor?
entries.literal: "It's especially idiotic even for this guy. Why are you saying that Atsuki was on this floor?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Because I saw him!{w} After Naomi left, when she understood that I wasn't buying it, I heard a noise. In this hallway, B, I saw Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Because I saw him!{w} After Naomi left, when she understood that I wasn't buying it, I heard a noise. In this hallway, B, I saw Atsuki."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It surprised me, so I kept silent and waited for him to move. However, trying not to be seen also made me lose track of him completely. I looked around a bit, but I couldn't find him or Naomi again.
entries.literal: "It surprised me, so I kept silent and waited for him to move. However, trying not to be seen also made me lose track of him completely. I looked around a bit, but I couldn't find him or Naomi again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: When I went back up, I saw him with the others, and you all said that he could not have been downstairs. That's what leads me to the conclusion that you've all been lying to me.
entries.literal: "When I went back up, I saw him with the others, and you all said that he could not have been downstairs. That's what leads me to the conclusion that you've all been lying to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That ridiculous claim, if anything, explained why Katei had insisted multiple times that the elevator group might've been able to sneak down. Naturally, though, it was met with silence and shared disapproval.
entries.literal: "...That ridiculous claim, if anything, explained why Katei had insisted multiple times that the elevator group might've been able to sneak down. Naturally, though, it was met with silence and shared disapproval."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: At least this proves you're nothing but a lying machine. Your fuel must've run out and now you can only fabricate these limp little things.
entries.literal: "At least this proves you're nothing but a lying machine. Your fuel must've run out and now you can only fabricate these limp little things."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You think you sound smart, but I believe all of us here know that you are the one lying.
entries.literal: "You think you sound smart, but I believe all of us here know that you are the one lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me just tell it to you straight. In the one in a million chance that you're either telling the truth or hallucinating, what you saw could not have been Atsuki. If you actually saw someone, it wasn't him.
entries.literal: "Let me just tell it to you straight. In the one in a million chance that you're either telling the truth or hallucinating, what you saw could not have been Atsuki. If you actually saw someone, it wasn't him."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Incorrect. I am certain it was him. His clothes could've been borrowed, but borrowing a face and the size of someone's body is much different. I don't know why you're all lying and aiding a criminal, but I'm certain of what I saw.
entries.literal: "Incorrect. I am certain it was him. His clothes could've been borrowed, but borrowing a face and the size of someone's body is much different. I don't know why you're all lying and aiding a criminal, but I'm certain of what I saw."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then we're left with a hallucination. You get your brain checked recently?
entries.literal: "Then we're left with a hallucination. You get your brain checked recently?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I will refrain from saying anything else. When this is all thoroughly investigated by the police, the truth will be proven.
entries.literal: "I will refrain from saying anything else. When this is all thoroughly investigated by the police, the truth will be proven."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I knew I hadn't killed anyone, I hadn't been seriously considering any of it. I'd ruled it as just Katei's desperate, pathetic, and ineffective way of not being suspected.
entries.literal: "As I knew I hadn't killed anyone, I hadn't been seriously considering any of it. I'd ruled it as just Katei's desperate, pathetic, and ineffective way of not being suspected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My attention had been drawn to one of the cabinets present with us in the room. At first glance, it looked like every other cabinet we'd seen, but there was something unusual about it.
entries.literal: "My attention had been drawn to one of the cabinets present with us in the room. At first glance, it looked like every other cabinet we'd seen, but there was something unusual about it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On its right side was what looked to be a small wheel. To get a closer look, I approached it, making sure not to step on any of the blood. As I moved to it, I was once again reminded of the inexplicable odor I had never smelled before, which was starting to blend in seamlessly.
entries.literal: "On its right side was what looked to be a small wheel. To get a closer look, I approached it, making sure not to step on any of the blood. As I moved to it, I was once again reminded of the inexplicable odor I had never smelled before, which was starting to blend in seamlessly."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Did you see something?
entries.literal: "...Did you see something?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, this.{w} Oh, it's a temperature regulator.
entries.literal: "Yes, this.{w} Oh, it's a temperature regulator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How interesting. What's it set at?
entries.literal: "How interesting. What's it set at?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Nothing. It says "room temperature".
entries.literal: "Nothing. It says \"room temperature\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around to meet Katei's eyes.
entries.literal: "I turned around to meet Katei's eyes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Some cabinets have temperature functions, like the Sekimeiya's. This room has them.
entries.literal: "...Some cabinets have temperature functions, like the Sekimeiya's. This room has them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The white wheel looked a bit damaged, which was what caught my attention. Anything could've caused that, but it stood out from everything else in the room.
entries.literal: "The white wheel looked a bit damaged, which was what caught my attention. Anything could've caused that, but it stood out from everything else in the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept inspecting it. Behind it, I quickly noticed another similar wheel, a bit smaller in size.
entries.literal: "I kept inspecting it. Behind it, I quickly noticed another similar wheel, a bit smaller in size."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And what's this one for?
entries.literal: "And what's this one for?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That one? It regulates the temperature.
entries.literal: "That one? It regulates the temperature."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can see the degrees symbol, but this one isn't set to anything, not even to "room temperature". I mean, why are there two of them?
entries.literal: "I can see the degrees symbol, but this one isn't set to anything, not even to \"room temperature\". I mean, why are there two of them?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Well, I think that one regulates the temperature of the gems behind the glass while the big one regulates the temperature inside the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Well, I think that one regulates the temperature of the gems behind the glass while the big one regulates the temperature inside the cabinet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see, to store gems that also require a determined temperature.
entries.literal: "I see, to store gems that also require a determined temperature."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to lift up the cover, but it was too heavy.
entries.literal: "I tried to lift up the cover, but it was too heavy."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How do I open it, though? I don't seem to be able to.
entries.literal: "How do I open it, though? I don't seem to be able to."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know, I've never opened one.
entries.literal: "I don't know, I've never opened one."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And you've never seen anyone opening one through the cameras.
entries.literal: "And you've never seen anyone opening one through the cameras."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Perhaps I have. I think they first look behind the cabinet, but I'm not sure what the process is. These cabinets have an actual method of locking them so that the temperature inside is well-preserved.
entries.literal: "...Perhaps I have. I think they first look behind the cabinet, but I'm not sure what the process is. These cabinets have an actual method of locking them so that the temperature inside is well-preserved."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried following his instructions. Behind the cabinet and next to the wheel, there was a tiny plastic latch that I was able to open.
entries.literal: "I tried following his instructions. Behind the cabinet and next to the wheel, there was a tiny plastic latch that I was able to open."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think it should be unlocked now...
entries.literal: "I think it should be unlocked now..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put my hands under the lid and brought it up while everyone else stared at me dubiously. Then, Sai began to approach me with curiosity.
entries.literal: "I put my hands under the lid and brought it up while everyone else stared at me dubiously. Then, Sai began to approach me with curiosity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like before, I was able to open it with ease. When I had fully opened it and kept the lid supported against the wall, I looked inside.
entries.literal: "Like before, I was able to open it with ease. When I had fully opened it and kept the lid supported against the wall, I looked inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no appreciable change in temperature, as the wheel hadn't been set to anything. However, there certainly was something inside. I saw the Sekimeiya resting at the bottom, covered by walls with a velvet texture and emitting a faint glow.
entries.literal: "There was no appreciable change in temperature, as the wheel hadn't been set to anything. However, there certainly was something inside. I saw the Sekimeiya resting at the bottom, covered by walls with a velvet texture and emitting a faint glow."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I-It's here.{w} I have no idea why, but it's here.
entries.literal: "I-It's here.{w} I have no idea why, but it's here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before the others could react, I stretched out my arm to grab it. With one hand, I leaned on the cabinet to support my weight while I put the other inside. As I slowly approached it, I thought to myself: what possible purpose could anyone have for leaving the Sekimeiya there?
entries.literal: "Before the others could react, I stretched out my arm to grab it. With one hand, I leaned on the cabinet to support my weight while I put the other inside. As I slowly approached it, I thought to myself: what possible purpose could anyone have for leaving the Sekimeiya there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without giving it much thought, I touched the surface of the egg-shaped object.{w} A burst of heat flowed through my fingers, and the world broke.
entries.literal: "Without giving it much thought, I touched the surface of the egg-shaped object.{w} A burst of heat flowed through my fingers, and the world broke."

entries.text: B-Side
entries.literal: "B-Side"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The burning sensation vanished, and I was no longer stretching out my arm. Before me was a long corridor that I'd seen before.{w} My body froze, and I broke out in a cold sweat. A heavy cloak of confusion was cast on me as my heart took off like a rocket.
entries.literal: "The burning sensation vanished, and I was no longer stretching out my arm. Before me was a long corridor that I'd seen before.{w} My body froze, and I broke out in a cold sweat. A heavy cloak of confusion was cast on me as my heart took off like a rocket."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something had happened to me—something that I hadn't ever experienced before. When I slowly began to discern my surroundings, I saw that I was in hallway A, next to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Something had happened to me—something that I hadn't ever experienced before. When I slowly began to discern my surroundings, I saw that I was in hallway A, next to the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to calm down and think. I timidly moved my head and saw the huge shutter blocking my way to the outside world. Around the hallway A door, dark marks left by the smoke were easily noticeable.
entries.literal: "I tried to calm down and think. I timidly moved my head and saw the huge shutter blocking my way to the outside world. Around the hallway A door, dark marks left by the smoke were easily noticeable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, I moved my legs forward. I was still able to control my whole body; nothing seemed to have changed in that regard. I moved up to hallway B, which surrounded me with its dark, unsettling scenery and pure silence.
entries.literal: "Next, I moved my legs forward. I was still able to control my whole body; nothing seemed to have changed in that regard. I moved up to hallway B, which surrounded me with its dark, unsettling scenery and pure silence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the right wall, I could see the door of the room I'd been in a few seconds ago. It was closed, like all the others.
entries.literal: "In the right wall, I could see the door of the room I'd been in a few seconds ago. It was closed, like all the others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I gently approached it, I tried to think about what could've happened. However, it was as bizarre as it sounded: I had touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in the lobby.
entries.literal: "As I gently approached it, I tried to think about what could've happened. However, it was as bizarre as it sounded: I had touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Not only that, but it had been instantaneous. Not a moment of time had seemed to pass before my surroundings changed.
entries.literal: "Not only that, but it had been instantaneous. Not a moment of time had seemed to pass before my surroundings changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gripped the knob. As soon as I started to open the door, I saw blood. On the floor, Naomi's dead body rested, her face clearly distressed. My senses alerted me of another change: the strange smell didn't appear to exist anymore.
entries.literal: "I gripped the knob. As soon as I started to open the door, I saw blood. On the floor, Naomi's dead body rested, her face clearly distressed. My senses alerted me of another change: the strange smell didn't appear to exist anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept looking inside the room. Everyone else had already left it, and the cabinet I'd opened was closed.
entries.literal: "I kept looking inside the room. Everyone else had already left it, and the cabinet I'd opened was closed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The haunting atmosphere radiating throughout the room was overwhelming, and it chased me out. I closed the door behind me and made an effort at breathing properly to calm myself down. What the hell was happening?
entries.literal: "The haunting atmosphere radiating throughout the room was overwhelming, and it chased me out. I closed the door behind me and made an effort at breathing properly to calm myself down. What the hell was happening?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was there a blank spot in my memory? Had I forgotten about something past the last memory I had?
entries.literal: "Was there a blank spot in my memory? Had I forgotten about something past the last memory I had?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing made sense. It couldn't make sense. The others had disappeared, and I had, in the blink of an eye, moved from one place to another.
entries.literal: "Nothing made sense. It couldn't make sense. The others had disappeared, and I had, in the blink of an eye, moved from one place to another."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Was I knocked out?{w} I had my back against the others when I reached for the Sekimeiya, but wouldn't I remember it? Wouldn't I feel pain in my head if I was hit?
entries.literal: "...Was I knocked out?{w} I had my back against the others when I reached for the Sekimeiya, but wouldn't I remember it? Wouldn't I feel pain in my head if I was hit?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And... when I realized I was somewhere different than before, I was standing up. If I'd been knocked out, I would've woken up on the floor...
entries.literal: "And... when I realized I was somewhere different than before, I was standing up. If I'd been knocked out, I would've woken up on the floor..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter how I thought of it, it felt as if no time had passed between the Sekimeiya's touch and the change in what I was looking at. To put it bluntly, it felt as if I had teleported between places.
entries.literal: "No matter how I thought of it, it felt as if no time had passed between the Sekimeiya's touch and the change in what I was looking at. To put it bluntly, it felt as if I had teleported between places."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, that was impossible. There must've been a reason why it had felt like that.
entries.literal: "However, that was impossible. There must've been a reason why it had felt like that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door to the event room. Nothing but a single, ugly cabinet was inside. I couldn't see its contents, but I didn't care. I kept looking through every room in the hallway to find the people that should've been there—to confirm that I hadn't been left alone and to understand what had happened to me.
entries.literal: "I opened the door to the event room. Nothing but a single, ugly cabinet was inside. I couldn't see its contents, but I didn't care. I kept looking through every room in the hallway to find the people that should've been there—to confirm that I hadn't been left alone and to understand what had happened to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened and closed every door in quick succession until I knew that I was on a desolate floor. ...Where was Shiroya?
entries.literal: "I opened and closed every door in quick succession until I knew that I was on a desolate floor. ...Where was Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In front of me was the elevator door. I wanted to see the others, so I called it. If they were somewhere above me, they would hear the sound and come down to find me.
entries.literal: "In front of me was the elevator door. I wanted to see the others, so I called it. If they were somewhere above me, they would hear the sound and come down to find me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After I pressed the button, though, nothing happened.
entries.literal: "After I pressed the button, though, nothing happened."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Is it here?
entries.literal: "...Is it here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the handle of the large, metallic door. As I'd suspected, I was able to open it.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the handle of the large, metallic door. As I'd suspected, I was able to open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since I wouldn't be able to draw people down to me, I had to modify my idea. I boarded the tiny elevator and pressed the button for the sixth floor. If anyone could hear it, I hoped they'd be lured.
entries.literal: "Since I wouldn't be able to draw people down to me, I had to modify my idea. I boarded the tiny elevator and pressed the button for the sixth floor. If anyone could hear it, I hoped they'd be lured."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was my second time taking a full six-floor trip in that gloomy space, and being alone only made it worse. Just what had happened? I'd been accumulating questions since we'd gotten trapped, but the situation I was in surpassed all of them.
entries.literal: "It was my second time taking a full six-floor trip in that gloomy space, and being alone only made it worse. Just what had happened? I'd been accumulating questions since we'd gotten trapped, but the situation I was in surpassed all of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Being alone let me look inside the elevator freely. ...I stared at the red button with the word "stop" on it. They would usually stop it abruptly, mostly in case someone got stuck on a door. Other times, they'd only play a loud alarm throughout the building.
entries.literal: "Being alone let me look inside the elevator freely. ...I stared at the red button with the word \"stop\" on it. They would usually stop it abruptly, mostly in case someone got stuck on a door. Other times, they'd only play a loud alarm throughout the building."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the wall next to it, there was a little paper with instructions detailing how it worked. I took the time to read it, trying to calm myself down.
entries.literal: "On the wall next to it, there was a little paper with instructions detailing how it worked. I took the time to read it, trying to calm myself down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Pressing the stop button will instantly deactivate the elevator and contact an emergency line. It is strictly prohibited to press it without a good reason, and to prevent ulterior uses, the elevator won't be enabled again until a staff member consents. Keep in mind that you are being recorded."
entries.literal: "\"Pressing the stop button will instantly deactivate the elevator and contact an emergency line. It is strictly prohibited to press it without a good reason, and to prevent ulterior uses, the elevator won't be enabled again until a staff member consents. Keep in mind that you are being recorded.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked behind me, and sure enough, I saw a small camera in an upper corner with a green light on it. It seemed Ashiya had made sure the button would only be used during a real emergency. Regarding the contact line, it was likely it had been nullified by the alarm.
entries.literal: "I looked behind me, and sure enough, I saw a small camera in an upper corner with a green light on it. It seemed Ashiya had made sure the button would only be used during a real emergency. Regarding the contact line, it was likely it had been nullified by the alarm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The remaining seconds once again left me in awe at how unsettling that small and quiet elevator could get. Even though I could hear the friction of the ropes, that imposing and deep sound that was more than apparent outside couldn't be appreciated well from the interior.
entries.literal: "The remaining seconds once again left me in awe at how unsettling that small and quiet elevator could get. Even though I could hear the friction of the ropes, that imposing and deep sound that was more than apparent outside couldn't be appreciated well from the interior."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the highest accessible floor and hastily pushed the door open. The sight was just as I remembered. I remained solitary and was met with another silently overwhelming floor.
entries.literal: "I went to the highest accessible floor and hastily pushed the door open. The sight was just as I remembered. I remained solitary and was met with another silently overwhelming floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I hoped people had heard me and were coming, I had to know whether there was someone around. We'd seen how easy it was to inspect those floors, so I started the same procedure from before.
entries.literal: "While I hoped people had heard me and were coming, I had to know whether there was someone around. We'd seen how easy it was to inspect those floors, so I started the same procedure from before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the empty left corridor. A door was hiding from my field of vision, but there was nobody to be seen.
entries.literal: "I looked at the empty left corridor. A door was hiding from my field of vision, but there was nobody to be seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I made my way to the offices to see if they weren't vacant for some reason.{w} There was something I recognized in the first one.
entries.literal: "Then, I made my way to the offices to see if they weren't vacant for some reason.{w} There was something I recognized in the first one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The computer we'd powered on earlier still showed a lit screen and an empty prompt to input access information.
entries.literal: "The computer we'd powered on earlier still showed a lit screen and an empty prompt to input access information."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without paying any mind to it, I entered the second partition. Being alone meant that I couldn't keep watch over the connecting corridor.
entries.literal: "Without paying any mind to it, I entered the second partition. Being alone meant that I couldn't keep watch over the connecting corridor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the second and third partitions, my only company was a functioning camera recording my every movement.{w} I sat on a chair and sighed deeply, unraveling at the sudden turn things had taken. Did we not have enough already? What the fuck had just happened!? My whole body hadn't stopped shaking for a second. I rejected the thought that any of it was real.
entries.literal: "In the second and third partitions, my only company was a functioning camera recording my every movement.{w} I sat on a chair and sighed deeply, unraveling at the sudden turn things had taken. Did we not have enough already? What the fuck had just happened!? My whole body hadn't stopped shaking for a second. I rejected the thought that any of it was real."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the offices once I felt ready to continue, but I was still hopeless.{w} I was about to repeat my movements on the floors below when I heard a very distinguishable sound coming from my left.
entries.literal: "I left the offices once I felt ready to continue, but I was still hopeless.{w} I was about to repeat my movements on the floors below when I heard a very distinguishable sound coming from my left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Footsteps. And ones I knew I'd heard many times in the past. I turned around and saw Shiroya coming out of the left corridor.
entries.literal: "Footsteps. And ones I knew I'd heard many times in the past. I turned around and saw Shiroya coming out of the left corridor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have time to act surprised or throw a bunch of questions at her before she spoke.
entries.literal: "I didn't have time to act surprised or throw a bunch of questions at her before she spoke."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, you're here. I found something.
entries.literal: "Oh, you're here. I found something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Completely unfazed, she opened the transparent door and entered the first partition. I was left outside, utterly bewildered.{w} Without looking back, she stepped to the next door.
entries.literal: "Completely unfazed, she opened the transparent door and entered the first partition. I was left outside, utterly bewildered.{w} Without looking back, she stepped to the next door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How was that her reaction after seeing me? I was too shocked to follow her. Even though my confusion had only intensified, I was at least glad to see I wasn't alone, and she had appeared from the left corridor...
entries.literal: "How was that her reaction after seeing me? I was too shocked to follow her. Even though my confusion had only intensified, I was at least glad to see I wasn't alone, and she had appeared from the left corridor..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked over to it. I knew an extra door was located at the end, so I approached it, wondering if she'd come out of it.
entries.literal: "I walked over to it. I knew an extra door was located at the end, so I approached it, wondering if she'd come out of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it was still locked, and there was nothing out of the ordinary about it.
entries.literal: "But it was still locked, and there was nothing out of the ordinary about it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trying to decipher what she said, I ran back to the door of the offices and entered them in a desperate attempt at understanding.
entries.literal: "Trying to decipher what she said, I ran back to the door of the offices and entered them in a desperate attempt at understanding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The first partition was empty. So was the second one. A chill ran down my spine when the third one didn't appear any different.
entries.literal: "The first partition was empty. So was the second one. A chill ran down my spine when the third one didn't appear any different."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I froze for a few seconds, questioning what had happened to me and Shiroya.
entries.literal: "I froze for a few seconds, questioning what had happened to me and Shiroya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled teleporting from one place to another. She couldn't have disappeared from the offices, could she? I exited them to look at the other corridor.
