entries.literal: "I recalled teleporting from one place to another. She couldn't have disappeared from the offices, could she? I exited them to look at the other corridor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nobody there.
entries.literal: "There was nobody there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Dumbfounded, I went down the stairs.
entries.literal: "Dumbfounded, I went down the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nobody on the outer part of the fifth floor, so I looked through the partitions.{w} The three of them were empty.
entries.literal: "There was nobody on the outer part of the fifth floor, so I looked through the partitions.{w} The three of them were empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I was about to make it out, I stopped myself in the middle partition, far beyond confusion. What the hell was my objective?
entries.literal: "As I was about to make it out, I stopped myself in the middle partition, far beyond confusion. What the hell was my objective?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hadn't I just found Shiroya and been completely ignored? She'd acted as if I was a ghost and moved on only to immediately disappear again.
entries.literal: "Hadn't I just found Shiroya and been completely ignored? She'd acted as if I was a ghost and moved on only to immediately disappear again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been in continuous motion since we'd gotten trapped, but that was the first time I couldn't settle on an objective to pursue. I took advantage of it to sit on a chair for a little while, attempting to calm my alarmed heart down.
entries.literal: "I'd been in continuous motion since we'd gotten trapped, but that was the first time I couldn't settle on an objective to pursue. I took advantage of it to sit on a chair for a little while, attempting to calm my alarmed heart down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it was useless. I thought about what had happened and felt as if I was driving myself crazy. What could I make of Shiroya's behavior after feeling like I'd literally teleported? It was insane, and I feared there was something wrong with me.
entries.literal: "But it was useless. I thought about what had happened and felt as if I was driving myself crazy. What could I make of Shiroya's behavior after feeling like I'd literally teleported? It was insane, and I feared there was something wrong with me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a while, I knew I had to continue looking around, but no determination came to me. Since I'd already seen Shiroya, everyone else should've been nearby, so I kept moving down the floors.
entries.literal: "After a while, I knew I had to continue looking around, but no determination came to me. Since I'd already seen Shiroya, everyone else should've been nearby, so I kept moving down the floors."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the fourth floor and looked through it. I slowly moved down to the third and repeated the same process.
entries.literal: "I went to the fourth floor and looked through it. I slowly moved down to the third and repeated the same process."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't see any signs of life.
entries.literal: "I didn't see any signs of life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I repeated the same inefficient movements on floor 2, and yet again, the result was the same. The crystal floor, where my lonely adventure had begun, was the one that remained.
entries.literal: "I repeated the same inefficient movements on floor 2, and yet again, the result was the same. The crystal floor, where my lonely adventure had begun, was the one that remained."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surely anyone would've been able to make it past me while I'd been looking through the offices, so I couldn't even be certain nobody was above me, even less so having spent minutes inside one of them.
entries.literal: "Surely anyone would've been able to make it past me while I'd been looking through the offices, so I couldn't even be certain nobody was above me, even less so having spent minutes inside one of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know where to begin, but I quickly spotted an obvious point. After peeking at both hallways, I saw an open door in hallway B.
entries.literal: "I didn't know where to begin, but I quickly spotted an obvious point. After peeking at both hallways, I saw an open door in hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It belonged to the room where we'd found Naomi's corpse—where I'd last seen the others.
entries.literal: "It belonged to the room where we'd found Naomi's corpse—where I'd last seen the others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached it, but I couldn't see what was behind it through the small gap.{w} As I approached, I started to hear something. There were voices, ones that sounded shocked.
entries.literal: "I approached it, but I couldn't see what was behind it through the small gap.{w} As I approached, I started to hear something. There were voices, ones that sounded shocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The doorknob was finally in reach. I ignored it, simply pushing the door open, and a very familiar sight appeared before me.
entries.literal: "The doorknob was finally in reach. I ignored it, simply pushing the door open, and a very familiar sight appeared before me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wh-What...!? How did you...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...!? How did you...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Where the fuck did you go?
entries.literal: "Where the fuck did you go?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya rushed to me and asked the same thing. Meanwhile, I looked at the six pairs of eyes focusing their most intense gazes on mine. ...On the floor, Naomi still lay in her own blood.
entries.literal: "Shiroya rushed to me and asked the same thing. Meanwhile, I looked at the six pairs of eyes focusing their most intense gazes on mine. ...On the floor, Naomi still lay in her own blood."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I-I don't know? What exactly are you asking me?
entries.literal: "...I-I don't know? What exactly are you asking me?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Just a minute ago, you were looking inside that cabinet. How did you make it out of the room?
entries.literal: "Just a minute ago, you were looking inside that cabinet. How did you make it out of the room?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Just a minute ago"? Were they messing with me? There was no way Shiroya would...
entries.literal: "\"Just a minute ago\"? Were they messing with me? There was no way Shiroya would..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You mean to say that I disappeared from in front of the cabinet?
entries.literal: "...You mean to say that I disappeared from in front of the cabinet?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, don't fuck around. We don't mean to say that you disappeared, we're asking you how you did it.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, don't fuck around. We don't mean to say that you disappeared, we're asking you how you did it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I didn't do anything. I touched the Sekimeiya and instantly appeared in hallway A.
entries.literal: "...I didn't do anything. I touched the Sekimeiya and instantly appeared in hallway A."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.literal: "Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We were talking about how you were the true culprit of this murder. You clearly did something to shift our focus.
entries.literal: "We were talking about how you were the true culprit of this murder. You clearly did something to shift our focus."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wait a second, though. What's in this cabinet is not the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Wait a second, though. What's in this cabinet is not the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh? I'm certain it was. I touched it and felt a burn on my fingers.
entries.literal: "Huh? I'm certain it was. I touched it and felt a burn on my fingers."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not the one we saw earlier, at least. Look.
entries.literal: "Not the one we saw earlier, at least. Look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He put his right arm inside the cabinet and removed it, holding an object that looked very similar to the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "He put his right arm inside the cabinet and removed it, holding an object that looked very similar to the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. That's the only thing that was inside.
entries.literal: "Yeah. That's the only thing that was inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I have no idea how you made it to the hallway. There's nothing else in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I have no idea how you made it to the hallway. There's nothing else in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My eyes were still directed at the Sekimeiya in Sai's hand. It no longer glowed at all, and it was gray.
entries.literal: "My eyes were still directed at the Sekimeiya in Sai's hand. It no longer glowed at all, and it was gray."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm telling the truth. Wh-What I found in the cabinet looked like the Sekimeiya we'd seen. I saw it glowing in the dark.
entries.literal: "I'm telling the truth. Wh-What I found in the cabinet looked like the Sekimeiya we'd seen. I saw it glowing in the dark."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to explain myself however I could, but I had no concept of what had happened.
entries.literal: "I had to explain myself however I could, but I had no concept of what had happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But this thing doesn't glow. Katei says he doesn't know what it is, even though that means nothing.
entries.literal: "But this thing doesn't glow. Katei says he doesn't know what it is, even though that means nothing."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I'm telling you what I know. This Sekimeiya was never here.
entries.literal: "...I'm telling you what I know. This Sekimeiya was never here."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Atsuki, let me try to understand what you're saying. You mean that when you touched that thing, you teleported outside?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, let me try to understand what you're saying. You mean that when you touched that thing, you teleported outside?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Th-That's what it felt like.
entries.literal: "...{w}Th-That's what it felt like."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone looked skeptical, but they remained quiet.
entries.literal: "Everyone looked skeptical, but they remained quiet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You weren't here by that point yet, though. When I found myself in the lobby, I entered this room and only saw Naomi's body on the floor.{w} I went up to the sixth floor to find you and eventually went back down. That's when I just found you here.
entries.literal: "...You weren't here by that point yet, though. When I found myself in the lobby, I entered this room and only saw Naomi's body on the floor.{w} I went up to the sixth floor to find you and eventually went back down. That's when I just found you here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt strangely uncomfortable while I attempted to explain myself. I sounded crazy, and if I wasn't, they were the ones tricking me. The only explanation was that I'd been knocked out in some way and they were acting as if it had just happened seconds ago.
entries.literal: "I felt strangely uncomfortable while I attempted to explain myself. I sounded crazy, and if I wasn't, they were the ones tricking me. The only explanation was that I'd been knocked out in some way and they were acting as if it had just happened seconds ago."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Isla, still between Erina's arms, looked the least dubious of me, but she still seemed to be trying to process that her friend's prediction hadn't come true.
entries.literal: "...Isla, still between Erina's arms, looked the least dubious of me, but she still seemed to be trying to process that her friend's prediction hadn't come true."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, you want to make us believe that you traveled to the past. That's impressive.
entries.literal: "So, you want to make us believe that you traveled to the past. That's impressive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "To the past", right. That was the conclusion to draw from what I'd said.{w} Not only teleportation, but time travel too. It was a ridiculous claim even if they'd really seen me disappear.
entries.literal: "\"To the past\", right. That was the conclusion to draw from what I'd said.{w} Not only teleportation, but time travel too. It was a ridiculous claim even if they'd really seen me disappear."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you hearing him? I bet you all thought he was innocent before seeing his true colors. You can't honestly tell me you believe a word of what he's saying.
entries.literal: "Are you hearing him? I bet you all thought he was innocent before seeing his true colors. You can't honestly tell me you believe a word of what he's saying."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Then how do you think he escaped from this room? I... I saw him vanish with my own eyes, and I believe we all did. You told us there's no hidden paths in these rooms.
entries.literal: "Then how do you think he escaped from this room? I... I saw him vanish with my own eyes, and I believe we all did. You told us there's no hidden paths in these rooms."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Tell us, Atsuki. How did you do it? There is a security camera here, so your trick has been recorded. Are you going to claim ignorance and state that you traveled to the past?
entries.literal: "Tell us, Atsuki. How did you do it? There is a security camera here, so your trick has been recorded. Are you going to claim ignorance and state that you traveled to the past?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did I travel to the past? I couldn't have. That's impossible.
entries.literal: "Did I travel to the past? I couldn't have. That's impossible."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Even if such a thing were possible, would everything hold up?
entries.literal: "Even if such a thing were possible, would everything hold up?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I have no idea what caused it, but if the others didn't knock me out, I must've teleported in some way. I guess traveling to the past only adds a bit more impossibility to that.
entries.literal: "I have no idea what caused it, but if the others didn't knock me out, I must've teleported in some way. I guess traveling to the past only adds a bit more impossibility to that."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: At least, one thing would begin to make sense if that's what happened. Earlier, when I looked in this room, Naomi was already dead. Didn't Katei say this? That I was on this floor during the time Naomi died?
entries.literal: "At least, one thing would begin to make sense if that's what happened. Earlier, when I looked in this room, Naomi was already dead. Didn't Katei say this? That I was on this floor during the time Naomi died?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Through normal means, I wouldn't have been able to be on the crystal floor. I was upstairs, and I would've been noticed if I'd headed down. This would make it possible.
entries.literal: "Through normal means, I wouldn't have been able to be on the crystal floor. I was upstairs, and I would've been noticed if I'd headed down. This would make it possible."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It would be absurd to immediately justify Katei's accusation like this, but it would explain why he decided to make such a nonsensical claim in the first place, and it would make a lot of what he said believable.
entries.literal: "It would be absurd to immediately justify Katei's accusation like this, but it would explain why he decided to make such a nonsensical claim in the first place, and it would make a lot of what he said believable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd seen it countless times: time travel appearing out of nowhere to construct crazy events. I'd experienced many stories that were ruined by such an exploitable mechanic. Thinking about it, I felt as if the same thing was happening to my reasoning.
entries.literal: "I'd seen it countless times: time travel appearing out of nowhere to construct crazy events. I'd experienced many stories that were ruined by such an exploitable mechanic. Thinking about it, I felt as if the same thing was happening to my reasoning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I couldn't explain my own experience, did I have to assume that time traveling was possible? Had it been a factor the whole time?{w} I thought about the full sequence of events up until that point. If they were somehow related to time travel, how were we supposed to think about that?
entries.literal: "If I couldn't explain my own experience, did I have to assume that time traveling was possible? Had it been a factor the whole time?{w} I thought about the full sequence of events up until that point. If they were somehow related to time travel, how were we supposed to think about that?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What would be more reasonable? To deny its existence and ignore my unexplained experience, or to think that it could be possible?
entries.literal: "What would be more reasonable? To deny its existence and ignore my unexplained experience, or to think that it could be possible?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt no enthusiasm thinking about either option, so I thought back on the previous few minutes.
entries.literal: "I felt no enthusiasm thinking about either option, so I thought back on the previous few minutes."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: How would this even work? Whenever time travel comes up, the word "paradox" is usually thrown all around. Depending on its rules, the way time travel works can greatly differ.
entries.literal: "How would this even work? Whenever time travel comes up, the word \"paradox\" is usually thrown all around. Depending on its rules, the way time travel works can greatly differ."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: One simple type of paradox is the famous "going back to the past and preventing your birth". Would you instantly disappear, or would you live a life in a world where you never existed? Either way, the past was changed.
entries.literal: "One simple type of paradox is the famous \"going back to the past and preventing your birth\". Would you instantly disappear, or would you live a life in a world where you never existed? Either way, the past was changed."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: On the other side is the bootstrap paradox: you find a key, open a door with it, find a time travel machine inside, use it to go back to the past, and finally place the key on the floor so that your past self can find it.
entries.literal: "On the other side is the bootstrap paradox: you find a key, open a door with it, find a time travel machine inside, use it to go back to the past, and finally place the key on the floor so that your past self can find it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In that case, did time travel matter at all? The past was not changed, so by traveling back, you only understood how it all came to happen. Essentially, it's a loop without a starting point, and it only occurred because it occurred.
entries.literal: "In that case, did time travel matter at all? The past was not changed, so by traveling back, you only understood how it all came to happen. Essentially, it's a loop without a starting point, and it only occurred because it occurred."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That's a concept far from sensible. It could come in handy to justify grand motives in a story, but it's nothing short of completely impractical.
entries.literal: "That's a concept far from sensible. It could come in handy to justify grand motives in a story, but it's nothing short of completely impractical."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, no matter how I feel, I think that everything points to this direction: that if I have just traveled to the past, I haven't actually changed anything. It seems like I just reexperienced the events I previously lived.
entries.literal: "However, no matter how I feel, I think that everything points to this direction: that if I have just traveled to the past, I haven't actually changed anything. It seems like I just reexperienced the events I previously lived."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The starting point seems to have been making physical contact with the Sekimeiya. As nothing that I did once I arrived in the past directly led to my travel, I'm not sure I'd quite perceive it as that kind of paradox.
entries.literal: "The starting point seems to have been making physical contact with the Sekimeiya. As nothing that I did once I arrived in the past directly led to my travel, I'm not sure I'd quite perceive it as that kind of paradox."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Looking ahead, though, it seems that I unconsciously repeated the past I had lived with Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Looking ahead, though, it seems that I unconsciously repeated the past I had lived with Shiroya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Just a minute ago, you were looking inside that cabinet." According to this, I can draw that I supposedly went back about twenty minutes to the past. That's the time I estimate I spent confusedly looking around for people.
entries.literal: "\"Just a minute ago, you were looking inside that cabinet.\" According to this, I can draw that I supposedly went back about twenty minutes to the past. That's the time I estimate I spent confusedly looking around for people."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: By that point, Naomi had already been killed. Shortly after, I took the elevator that was on this floor up to the sixth.
entries.literal: "By that point, Naomi had already been killed. Shortly after, I took the elevator that was on this floor up to the sixth."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This cleanly holds up with what we experienced... At that point, the elevator was on the crystal floor, as it had probably arrived there when we'd heard it on the fifth.{w} Then, when I went up to the sixth would be when Shiroya and I rushed to follow it up.
entries.literal: "This cleanly holds up with what we experienced... At that point, the elevator was on the crystal floor, as it had probably arrived there when we'd heard it on the fifth.{w} Then, when I went up to the sixth would be when Shiroya and I rushed to follow it up."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What the hell is this? Did I, without being aware of it, replicate the past I'd experienced?
entries.literal: "What the hell is this? Did I, without being aware of it, replicate the past I'd experienced?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I think that something curious happened when we chased the elevator up. If the elevator hadn't been empty, we had to assume that whoever went up entered the attic. The only other explanation was that the person inside vanished.
entries.literal: "I think that something curious happened when we chased the elevator up. If the elevator hadn't been empty, we had to assume that whoever went up entered the attic. The only other explanation was that the person inside vanished."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But... it seems that what I just went through explains what actually occurred.
entries.literal: "But... it seems that what I just went through explains what actually occurred."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I got out of the elevator and looked through the sixth floor. The corridor appeared empty, and I spent a bit of time inside the offices.
entries.literal: "I got out of the elevator and looked through the sixth floor. The corridor appeared empty, and I spent a bit of time inside the offices."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: As I was there, Shiroya and another version of myself were chasing me. They called the elevator to the fifth floor, but as I saw earlier, that wouldn't have made a noticeable sound from where I was.
entries.literal: "As I was there, Shiroya and another version of myself were chasing me. They called the elevator to the fifth floor, but as I saw earlier, that wouldn't have made a noticeable sound from where I was."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Then, as I remember, the previous me stayed next to the elevator while Shiroya looked through the two main parts of the floor. She also mentioned how she'd first looked through the opposite corridor.
entries.literal: "Then, as I remember, the previous me stayed next to the elevator while Shiroya looked through the two main parts of the floor. She also mentioned how she'd first looked through the opposite corridor."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: She and I saw each other when I was about to continue looking for people. She was about to look through each partition.
entries.literal: "She and I saw each other when I was about to continue looking for people. She was about to look through each partition."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That's why she reacted the way she did. From her perspective, I should've been next to the elevator, but where she found me, my job still would have worked. From there, you could still prevent anyone from escaping, so she thought I had moved from next to the elevator to outside the offices.
entries.literal: "That's why she reacted the way she did. From her perspective, I should've been next to the elevator, but where she found me, my job still would have worked. From there, you could still prevent anyone from escaping, so she thought I had moved from next to the elevator to outside the offices."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, to her, it appeared as if the floor had been empty. She didn't realize that she'd actually seen the person who'd brought the elevator up.
entries.literal: "So, to her, it appeared as if the floor had been empty. She didn't realize that she'd actually seen the person who'd brought the elevator up."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, you're here. I found something.
entries.literal: "Oh, you're here. I found something."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That was her reaction when she thought I'd slightly moved.
entries.literal: "That was her reaction when she thought I'd slightly moved."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Similarly, when she was done investigating, something she said did throw me off a little.
entries.literal: "Similarly, when she was done investigating, something she said did throw me off a little."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But look, this is what I wanted to show you.
entries.literal: "But look, this is what I wanted to show you."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: She was referencing what she'd told me just before that point, unaware that she wasn't talking to the same person.
entries.literal: "She was referencing what she'd told me just before that point, unaware that she wasn't talking to the same person."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When she reacted coldly to my presence and said she'd found something in the corridor, I thought I had to look at it, so I went to check. During that time, she confirmed that the offices were empty.
entries.literal: "When she reacted coldly to my presence and said she'd found something in the corridor, I thought I had to look at it, so I went to check. During that time, she confirmed that the offices were empty."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I didn't see anything of importance in the corridor because what she had found was the attic door itself. I entered the partitions to demand a further explanation, but she was already talking to the previous me, next to the elevator.
entries.literal: "I didn't see anything of importance in the corridor because what she had found was the attic door itself. I entered the partitions to demand a further explanation, but she was already talking to the previous me, next to the elevator."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When I left, the two of them had gone around to inspect the door they'd just discovered.
entries.literal: "When I left, the two of them had gone around to inspect the door they'd just discovered."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And later, I spent a few minutes inside the offices of the fifth floor, so I didn't notice Akaro going up or the three of us going down.
entries.literal: "And later, I spent a few minutes inside the offices of the fifth floor, so I didn't notice Akaro going up or the three of us going down."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: After a while, I continued looking through every floor until I reached the point I'd traveled from.
entries.literal: "After a while, I continued looking through every floor until I reached the point I'd traveled from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Even though I couldn't easily accept such a concept, it neatly explained many things.{w} Was it all a ridiculous coincidence...? A trick, maybe?
entries.literal: "...Even though I couldn't easily accept such a concept, it neatly explained many things.{w} Was it all a ridiculous coincidence...? A trick, maybe?"

entries.text: Insulation
entries.literal: "Insulation"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Do you intend to answer?
entries.literal: "...Do you intend to answer?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd briefly fallen silent. Once I'd thought of the possibility, answers had quickly fallen into place.
entries.literal: "I'd briefly fallen silent. Once I'd thought of the possibility, answers had quickly fallen into place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something so outlandish certainly sounded impossible under any normal circumstances, but the simple fact was that it had happened to me. Unless there was another explanation I was missing, there was no choice but to accept it.
entries.literal: "Something so outlandish certainly sounded impossible under any normal circumstances, but the simple fact was that it had happened to me. Unless there was another explanation I was missing, there was no choice but to accept it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... don't have a reason to deny that traveling to the past seems to be the most likely answer. Rather, it's the only one.
entries.literal: "I... don't have a reason to deny that traveling to the past seems to be the most likely answer. Rather, it's the only one."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Pathetic. You were accusing me of being a bad liar, Sai?
entries.literal: "Pathetic. You were accusing me of being a bad liar, Sai?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If that was truly what had happened, it also meant that Katei had to be the killer.
entries.literal: "If that was truly what had happened, it also meant that Katei had to be the killer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator going up was my doing, so there'd been nobody else on the first floor. Nobody had gone to the attic.
entries.literal: "The elevator going up was my doing, so there'd been nobody else on the first floor. Nobody had gone to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But a line of reasoning that time traveling demolished was another one that it created. That was the can of worms that thinking about possibilities involving time travel opened.{w} After all, I had randomly teleported to hallway A. Someone could've been on the same floor, killed Naomi before we'd thoroughly investigated it, and then traveled through time to an entirely different place.
entries.literal: "But a line of reasoning that time traveling demolished was another one that it created. That was the can of worms that thinking about possibilities involving time travel opened.{w} After all, I had randomly teleported to hallway A. Someone could've been on the same floor, killed Naomi before we'd thoroughly investigated it, and then traveled through time to an entirely different place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was still one thing to keep in mind: the first time the elevator had gone down.
entries.literal: "There was still one thing to keep in mind: the first time the elevator had gone down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was possible someone had been in the attic before we'd heard it. They could've gone down with the elevator, killed Naomi, and then traveled to the past, back inside the attic. Thinking about tight possibilities with such uncertain and volatile mechanics was impossible.
entries.literal: "It was possible someone had been in the attic before we'd heard it. They could've gone down with the elevator, killed Naomi, and then traveled to the past, back inside the attic. Thinking about tight possibilities with such uncertain and volatile mechanics was impossible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So according to you, his claim is as bad as or worse than yours, but yours were all easily disproven. Can you give an alternative to what Atsuki's saying?
entries.literal: "So according to you, his claim is as bad as or worse than yours, but yours were all easily disproven. Can you give an alternative to what Atsuki's saying?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you going to tell me that because I don't know how he made it out of this room, he must've time traveled? For the love of God, Sai, and you were trying to act smart?
entries.literal: "Are you going to tell me that because I don't know how he made it out of this room, he must've time traveled? For the love of God, Sai, and you were trying to act smart?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, let me tell you something. If Atsuki didn't time travel, he can't be Naomi's killer. If he did, though, it's still an option.
entries.literal: "Well, let me tell you something. If Atsuki didn't time travel, he can't be Naomi's killer. If he did, though, it's still an option."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Shiroya had realized the same thing. I was really there by the time she died.
entries.literal: "Sai and Shiroya had realized the same thing. I was really there by the time she died."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Okay, it might happen to explain that Katei saw Atsuki here, but it doesn't make it any less insane.
entries.literal: "...Okay, it might happen to explain that Katei saw Atsuki here, but it doesn't make it any less insane."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm, why not? I think it makes sense.
entries.literal: "Hm, why not? I think it makes sense."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...What? Don't be crazy. We can't use time travel to explain anything...
entries.literal: "...What? Don't be crazy. We can't use time travel to explain anything..."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Why not?
entries.literal: "Why not?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'd say that's a fair question. By the way, it seems Katei was right about something. The Sekimeiya appears to have broken, right?
entries.literal: "I'd say that's a fair question. By the way, it seems Katei was right about something. The Sekimeiya appears to have broken, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were all taken aback by that question, but we quickly understood what he meant. It had changed colors to a much less pleasant gray.
entries.literal: "We were all taken aback by that question, but we quickly understood what he meant. It had changed colors to a much less pleasant gray."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: See! This is all because it was removed from the cabinet!
entries.literal: "See! This is all because it was removed from the cabinet!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you sure? It was still white when I saw it.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? It was still white when I saw it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Go ahead and prove that. Did you put it there and just want to avoid facing the consequences?
entries.literal: "Go ahead and prove that. Did you put it there and just want to avoid facing the consequences?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Shut up. God.{w} This is what Atsuki asked about earlier. It's a function to regulate the cabinet's temperature, is it not?
entries.literal: "Shut up. God.{w} This is what Atsuki asked about earlier. It's a function to regulate the cabinet's temperature, is it not?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, but it's set to room temperature.
entries.literal: "Yes, but it's set to room temperature."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's slightly damaged, though. And let's think: out of all of us, who would hide the Sekimeiya in a place that has a cold temperature function?
entries.literal: "It's slightly damaged, though. And let's think: out of all of us, who would hide the Sekimeiya in a place that has a cold temperature function?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Even when I'm proven innocent, you still insist on suspecting me.
entries.literal: "...Even when I'm proven innocent, you still insist on suspecting me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This guy was scared out of his mind at his bosses, remember? He would be dumb enough to hide the Sekimeiya here after he told us that story.
entries.literal: "This guy was scared out of his mind at his bosses, remember? He would be dumb enough to hide the Sekimeiya here after he told us that story."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do I have to repeat it? The cold function wasn't activated.
entries.literal: "Do I have to repeat it? The cold function wasn't activated."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who cares about that? It was still hidden here of all places. You'd also be the only one to know about the function of the cabinets, right?
entries.literal: "Who cares about that? It was still hidden here of all places. You'd also be the only one to know about the function of the cabinets, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? Didn't Atsuki notice it too? That's why he appeared intrigued by this cabinet while he was being accused, acting as if he'd found the Sekimeiya he hid. I bet he put it here to frame me after I explained the cold rule.
entries.literal: "What? Didn't Atsuki notice it too? That's why he appeared intrigued by this cabinet while he was being accused, acting as if he'd found the Sekimeiya he hid. I bet he put it here to frame me after I explained the cold rule."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...That's not at all what happened, and the cameras will eventually prove it.
entries.literal: "...That's not at all what happened, and the cameras will eventually prove it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm sure they will. For now, let's hurry up and put this thing where it belongs. Just in case it's not too late.
entries.literal: "I'm sure they will. For now, let's hurry up and put this thing where it belongs. Just in case it's not too late."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, sure. We can try that.
entries.literal: "Yeah, sure. We can try that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Holding the Sekimeiya in his hands, Sai closed the cabinet, which made a metallic sound as if it had locked automatically. Then, he left the room followed by Katei.{w} Shiroya was still unsure of what to say, and Akaro and Erina both looked at me with uncertainty.
entries.literal: "Holding the Sekimeiya in his hands, Sai closed the cabinet, which made a metallic sound as if it had locked automatically. Then, he left the room followed by Katei.{w} Shiroya was still unsure of what to say, and Akaro and Erina both looked at me with uncertainty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were in front of the event room. I squeezed my eyes shut and rubbed at the bridge of my nose, remembering that someone in the building had actually died. Things were moving too fast. A death, moving through time after touching a gem...{w} But it would have been even more dangerous to stop thinking. Before I entered the room, I realized that something else went against the theory that Katei hadn't killed Naomi.
entries.literal: "We were in front of the event room. I squeezed my eyes shut and rubbed at the bridge of my nose, remembering that someone in the building had actually died. Things were moving too fast. A death, moving through time after touching a gem...{w} But it would have been even more dangerous to stop thinking. Before I entered the room, I realized that something else went against the theory that Katei hadn't killed Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was holding the Sekimeiya with his hands. However, I recalled feeling a painful burn on my fingers during the split second before I'd disappeared from the room.
entries.literal: "Sai was holding the Sekimeiya with his hands. However, I recalled feeling a painful burn on my fingers during the split second before I'd disappeared from the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At that moment, the Sekimeiya was glowing white, so if that was still the same object, it meant it had changed colors as soon as I'd traveled. In other words, it had powered off.
entries.literal: "At that moment, the Sekimeiya was glowing white, so if that was still the same object, it meant it had changed colors as soon as I'd traveled. In other words, it had powered off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So, if anyone had consciously vanished from the first floor after killing Naomi, it should've powered off just like it did when I'd been the one to travel.
entries.literal: "So, if anyone had consciously vanished from the first floor after killing Naomi, it should've powered off just like it did when I'd been the one to travel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't know how it worked, but the fact that I'd seen it glowing might've indicated that nobody had traveled before me—that Katei was the only suspect.{w} In addition, the Sekimeiya had been inside a locked cabinet. To travel and leave it inside, the culprit must've had to shut themselves inside it and then touch the Sekimeiya...
entries.literal: "I couldn't know how it worked, but the fact that I'd seen it glowing might've indicated that nobody had traveled before me—that Katei was the only suspect.{w} In addition, the Sekimeiya had been inside a locked cabinet. To travel and leave it inside, the culprit must've had to shut themselves inside it and then touch the Sekimeiya..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was another problem, though. I didn't think about it until we'd all entered the room.{w} "Touching the Sekimeiya made me travel to the past". Ignoring how an item with such an obvious power could've made it to a place where they'd let us touch it, something directly contradicted its powers.
entries.literal: "There was another problem, though. I didn't think about it until we'd all entered the room.{w} \"Touching the Sekimeiya made me travel to the past\". Ignoring how an item with such an obvious power could've made it to a place where they'd let us touch it, something directly contradicted its powers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Earlier, Isla had touched it inside its cabinet, and so had Shiroya. Following that, Sai even took it out of the cabinet while holding it with his hands, and none of them teleported at all.
entries.literal: "Earlier, Isla had touched it inside its cabinet, and so had Shiroya. Following that, Sai even took it out of the cabinet while holding it with his hands, and none of them teleported at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was I the difference? Since I hadn't touched it back then, I couldn't discern whether the differing factor was the person to touch it or something about the Sekimeiya itself.
entries.literal: "Was I the difference? Since I hadn't touched it back then, I couldn't discern whether the differing factor was the person to touch it or something about the Sekimeiya itself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Maybe it wasn't actually powered off. It could be that Sai couldn't travel.
entries.literal: "Maybe it wasn't actually powered off. It could be that Sai couldn't travel."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Can I touch it again?
entries.literal: "Can I touch it again?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course. Have at it.
entries.literal: "Of course. Have at it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He handed me the gray gemstone.{w} I felt no burn, and I remained where I was. However, I was able to appreciate the smooth surface of the Sekimeiya, which definitely hadn't disappeared with its beautiful white.
entries.literal: "He handed me the gray gemstone.{w} I felt no burn, and I remained where I was. However, I was able to appreciate the smooth surface of the Sekimeiya, which definitely hadn't disappeared with its beautiful white."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're putting on such a pathetic show. You should know that.
entries.literal: "You're putting on such a pathetic show. You should know that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're beginning to get on my nerves. I know how crazy I sound, but if anyone's been putting on a pathetic show from the start, it's been you.
entries.literal: "You're beginning to get on my nerves. I know how crazy I sound, but if anyone's been putting on a pathetic show from the start, it's been you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, he caught you.
entries.literal: "Oh, he caught you."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is unbelievable. Put it in the cabinet already.
entries.literal: "This is unbelievable. Put it in the cabinet already."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to argue further, so I opened the glass covering and placed it inside. The colder temperature became easily noticeable as I left it on top of the cushion.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to argue further, so I opened the glass covering and placed it inside. The colder temperature became easily noticeable as I left it on top of the cushion."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then I closed it again, and everyone remained staring at the mysterious source of the day's incident.
entries.literal: "Then I closed it again, and everyone remained staring at the mysterious source of the day's incident."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...What? Did it change back?
entries.literal: "...What? Did it change back?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It did...?
entries.literal: "It did...?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes! It's white!
entries.literal: "Yes! It's white!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all saw it firsthand. A couple seconds after I put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet, it regained its old white glow.
entries.literal: "We all saw it firsthand. A couple seconds after I put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet, it regained its old white glow."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's interesting. The temperature brought it back.
entries.literal: "That's interesting. The temperature brought it back."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's it, then. We must not take it out of here until the front door opens. It's clear that will bring us a bunch of issues with Ashiya.
entries.literal: "That's it, then. We must not take it out of here until the front door opens. It's clear that will bring us a bunch of issues with Ashiya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, this thing made Atsuki travel through time. Can you shut up for a second about goddamn Ashiya?
entries.literal: "Katei, this thing made Atsuki travel through time. Can you shut up for a second about goddamn Ashiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You were right. The cold fixed it, so isn't it strange? According to your story from earlier, the original discoverer of the Sekimeiya realized the cold was needed.
entries.literal: "You were right. The cold fixed it, so isn't it strange? According to your story from earlier, the original discoverer of the Sekimeiya realized the cold was needed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If this can send you to the past, they must've certainly touched and tried all sorts of things to keep it stable. Could they have not noticed its power?
entries.literal: "If this can send you to the past, they must've certainly touched and tried all sorts of things to keep it stable. Could they have not noticed its power?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What power!? Kid, this thing will not send you to the past! Something like that is impossible!
entries.literal: "What power!? Kid, this thing will not send you to the past! Something like that is impossible!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Didn't we touch it earlier? Isla definitely held it, and nothing happened to her.
entries.literal: "Didn't we touch it earlier? Isla definitely held it, and nothing happened to her."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: That's true... Why didn't it make me go anywhere?
entries.literal: "That's true... Why didn't it make me go anywhere?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Because it's just a gemstone!
entries.literal: "Because it's just a gemstone!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, it appears to have fixed itself. Shall we test it?
entries.literal: "Well, it appears to have fixed itself. Shall we test it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm beginning to wonder if you process any of what I say. We're not taking this out of here again.
entries.literal: "I'm beginning to wonder if you process any of what I say. We're not taking this out of here again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Okay. Sure thing.
entries.literal: "Okay. Sure thing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's insincere reply left us with a few seconds of silence. Erina was the one to break it.
entries.literal: "Sai's insincere reply left us with a few seconds of silence. Erina was the one to break it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Isn't that a lock?
entries.literal: "...Isn't that a lock?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tilted my head to look at where Erina was pointing. Under the keyhole, on the left side of the cabinet, there was a small arrow directed to the word "unlocked", with "locked" being right under it.
entries.literal: "I tilted my head to look at where Erina was pointing. Under the keyhole, on the left side of the cabinet, there was a small arrow directed to the word \"unlocked\", with \"locked\" being right under it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's just indicating the status of the cabinet, right?
entries.literal: "That's just indicating the status of the cabinet, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let me see.
entries.literal: "Let me see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a finger, I rotated the dial. It didn't appear to move at first, but as soon as I applied a bit of pressure, it gave out and locked itself into place with a click.
entries.literal: "With a finger, I rotated the dial. It didn't appear to move at first, but as soon as I applied a bit of pressure, it gave out and locked itself into place with a click."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Did that do it?
entries.literal: "...Did that do it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai, next to the glass, tried to scroll it down.
entries.literal: "Sai, next to the glass, tried to scroll it down."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I think so. I did hear a sound coming from here.
entries.literal: "...I think so. I did hear a sound coming from here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I attempted to set it back to "unlocked", but it was impossible.
entries.literal: "I attempted to set it back to \"unlocked\", but it was impossible."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You must actually need the key for that.
entries.literal: "You must actually need the key for that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So we can lock it manually but not unlock it again. That's almost fair.
entries.literal: "So we can lock it manually but not unlock it again. That's almost fair."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, you work here, right? Did you not know about this mechanism with how much you've insisted to keep the Sekimeiya inside?
entries.literal: "Katei, you work here, right? Did you not know about this mechanism with how much you've insisted to keep the Sekimeiya inside?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I didn't. It seems changes were made to this cabinet, as the others don't possess this function.
entries.literal: "...I didn't. It seems changes were made to this cabinet, as the others don't possess this function."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, congratulations. You did it. Now we'll have to keep it here for the remainder of the day. Ashiya will be pleased.
entries.literal: "Well, congratulations. You did it. Now we'll have to keep it here for the remainder of the day. Ashiya will be pleased."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since we'd evidently not looked through the cabinet well enough, I inspected it further. Shortly, I noticed something else.
entries.literal: "Since we'd evidently not looked through the cabinet well enough, I inspected it further. Shortly, I noticed something else."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's an outlet behind it, and the cabinet's connected to it.
entries.literal: "There's an outlet behind it, and the cabinet's connected to it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Of course. It's needed for the temperature regulation. Every cabinet with that function has to be connected to a power supply.
entries.literal: "Of course. It's needed for the temperature regulation. Every cabinet with that function has to be connected to a power supply."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had already happened a few times, but once again, the immediate shock of hearing something we couldn't have heard infested the room. From outside, we all distinctly heard the sound of a door closing.
entries.literal: "It had already happened a few times, but once again, the immediate shock of hearing something we couldn't have heard infested the room. From outside, we all distinctly heard the sound of a door closing."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...That was a door, right?
entries.literal: "...That was a door, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Shit, there's actually someone else here!
entries.literal: "Shit, there's actually someone else here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all hurried to open the right door, but we were stopped by Sai.
entries.literal: "We all hurried to open the right door, but we were stopped by Sai."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What are you doing? Someone look at hallway A too!{w} The staircase is there, so we can't all leave from here.
entries.literal: "What are you doing? Someone look at hallway A too!{w} The staircase is there, so we can't all leave from here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai, Shiroya, and Akaro exited through the right door since they'd been next to it. I'd been to the left of the cabinet, so I went with the others through the left door.
entries.literal: "Sai, Shiroya, and Akaro exited through the right door since they'd been next to it. I'd been to the left of the cabinet, so I went with the others through the left door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As usual, hallway A appeared empty. We'd continuously done the same thing, but it seemed we had to search it one more time. ...Was it really possible a hidden culprit had remained unspotted for that long? The question had already come back.
entries.literal: "As usual, hallway A appeared empty. We'd continuously done the same thing, but it seemed we had to search it one more time. ...Was it really possible a hidden culprit had remained unspotted for that long? The question had already come back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Looking through the whole tower left me exhausted, so I moved to the lobby door to make sure nobody was there and to keep watching the hallway.
entries.literal: "Looking through the whole tower left me exhausted, so I moved to the lobby door to make sure nobody was there and to keep watching the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The atmosphere continuously shifted in the span of a few seconds. After looking at the empty hallway C, Erina and Isla entered every room together while Katei checked through some others to speed up the process. My position guaranteed that nobody could come out of a room while the others were busy inspecting them.
entries.literal: "The atmosphere continuously shifted in the span of a few seconds. After looking at the empty hallway C, Erina and Isla entered every room together while Katei checked through some others to speed up the process. My position guaranteed that nobody could come out of a room while the others were busy inspecting them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed deeply. If nothing was found in either of the two hallways, would we have to move upward once again and look through every floor? The door we'd heard couldn't have closed on its own.
entries.literal: "I sighed deeply. If nothing was found in either of the two hallways, would we have to move upward once again and look through every floor? The door we'd heard couldn't have closed on its own."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surprisingly, the others were taking a while with every room, as they knew that they all contained cabinets with empty interiors big enough to fit a person. While I stared ahead, I realized that making such an obvious sound seemed to defy the persistent stealth of the culprit.
entries.literal: "Surprisingly, the others were taking a while with every room, as they knew that they all contained cabinets with empty interiors big enough to fit a person. While I stared ahead, I realized that making such an obvious sound seemed to defy the persistent stealth of the culprit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: About ten minutes later, the search in our hallway concluded. I could hear that Isla, who was still holding up surprisingly well, had slowed them down, constantly asking to stay with the gems for longer. My group came to me and reported the result I'd already seen. The mechanical room still remained unchecked, so since I'd stayed put, I told them to make sure nobody appeared in the hallway while I went to inspect it myself.
entries.literal: "About ten minutes later, the search in our hallway concluded. I could hear that Isla, who was still holding up surprisingly well, had slowed them down, constantly asking to stay with the gems for longer. My group came to me and reported the result I'd already seen. The mechanical room still remained unchecked, so since I'd stayed put, I told them to make sure nobody appeared in the hallway while I went to inspect it myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the way, I looked at the few drawers the reception desk had, which were only filled with papers.
entries.literal: "On the way, I looked at the few drawers the reception desk had, which were only filled with papers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Downstairs, I was reminded of the fact that such an off-putting place existed on that same floor. Being alone there was much different from the time I'd looked through it with Sai, and when I considered that I was searching for a hidden culprit that could easily catch me off guard, tension constricted my body once more.
entries.literal: "Downstairs, I was reminded of the fact that such an off-putting place existed on that same floor. Being alone there was much different from the time I'd looked through it with Sai, and when I considered that I was searching for a hidden culprit that could easily catch me off guard, tension constricted my body once more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Fortunately, it wasn't a big space, so confirming it was empty was easy. I went back up to see my group where I'd left them, and I saw that the others were by the end of hallway B.
entries.literal: "Fortunately, it wasn't a big space, so confirming it was empty was easy. I went back up to see my group where I'd left them, and I saw that the others were by the end of hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached my group first. Erina told me that nothing had happened in hallway A, so we regrouped in C.
entries.literal: "I approached my group first. Erina told me that nothing had happened in hallway A, so we regrouped in C."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nothing, huh?
entries.literal: "Nothing, huh?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yeah, the rooms were all empty.
entries.literal: "Yeah, the rooms were all empty."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...So, if a person made the noise, they must be above us right now.
entries.literal: "...So, if a person made the noise, they must be above us right now."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Someone watched your hallway to make sure it was always being observed, right?
entries.literal: "Someone watched your hallway to make sure it was always being observed, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes, Sai did. We also checked the bathrooms once we were done.
entries.literal: "Yes, Sai did. We also checked the bathrooms once we were done."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who remained outside in yours?
entries.literal: "Who remained outside in yours?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It was Atsuki.
entries.literal: "It was Atsuki."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, my friend Atsuki? That's good.{w} Say, did Katei look at any room all by himself?
entries.literal: "Oh, my friend Atsuki? That's good.{w} Say, did Katei look at any room all by himself?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I did. Are you implying that perhaps I ignored something on purpose?
entries.literal: "I did. Are you implying that perhaps I ignored something on purpose?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yup. Stay here. Sorry for slowing the process down, but I can't just take his word for it.
entries.literal: "Yup. Stay here. Sorry for slowing the process down, but I can't just take his word for it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai stepped into hallway A. He didn't ask for the rooms Katei had entered and simply went ahead with looking through all of them.
entries.literal: "Sai stepped into hallway A. He didn't ask for the rooms Katei had entered and simply went ahead with looking through all of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't blame him for suspecting Katei, and the rest of us felt the same: there was no complaint besides Katei's outraged look.
entries.literal: "I couldn't blame him for suspecting Katei, and the rest of us felt the same: there was no complaint besides Katei's outraged look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After the smoky crystal room, Sai entered the storeroom. We expected him to silently move on to the next one again, but once he exited it, he directed his look at us and showed what he had between his hands.
entries.literal: "After the smoky crystal room, Sai entered the storeroom. We expected him to silently move on to the next one again, but once he exited it, he directed his look at us and showed what he had between his hands."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Upon processing the sight, we ran to him in a daze.
entries.literal: "Upon processing the sight, we ran to him in a daze."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What...? Was it in the storeroom?
entries.literal: "What...? Was it in the storeroom?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Held in Sai's hands was the Sekimeiya. It was white, as being touched hadn't changed its color at all.
entries.literal: "Held in Sai's hands was the Sekimeiya. It was white, as being touched hadn't changed its color at all."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. I found it hidden behind the sofa.
entries.literal: "Yes. I found it hidden behind the sofa."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without warning, he moved the object to make contact with my skin. It scared me a bit, but nothing happened.
entries.literal: "Without warning, he moved the object to make contact with my skin. It scared me a bit, but nothing happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So it's not working now.
entries.literal: "So it's not working now."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anyway, Katei, did you look through this room?
entries.literal: "Anyway, Katei, did you look through this room?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Not only that, but it was the first one he entered.
entries.literal: "Not only that, but it was the first one he entered."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's true, I remember.
entries.literal: "That's true, I remember."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But that's because it's the farthest room from this side. I was looking for a person, so I didn't look behind the sofa.
entries.literal: "But that's because it's the farthest room from this side. I was looking for a person, so I didn't look behind the sofa."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What a convenient excuse.
entries.literal: "What a convenient excuse."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do you actually think I hid it? I couldn't have done that. We locked the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Do you actually think I hid it? I couldn't have done that. We locked the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, was Katei the last person to exit the event room? He might've had a key.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, was Katei the last person to exit the event room? He might've had a key."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know, but we all left very fast. I don't think he could've had the time.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but we all left very fast. I don't think he could've had the time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Someone stay here. This floor is definitely empty, but we need to check the event room while making sure that nobody can move between the floors.
entries.literal: "Someone stay here. This floor is definitely empty, but we need to check the event room while making sure that nobody can move between the floors."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: All right. We'll stay behind.
entries.literal: "All right. We'll stay behind."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Can't we go too...?
entries.literal: "Can't we go too...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla, enough. You all can go.
entries.literal: "Isla, enough. You all can go."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's see what happened.
entries.literal: "Let's see what happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina and Isla stayed where they were. That was the safest option up until that point, but as things were, staying in an uncertain spot such as the stairs was more dangerous than moving through an empty floor. It was something Erina must not have realized, but her demeanor was clear: she wasn't leaving Isla alone.{w} Nonetheless, the rest of us agreed and entered the event room once again.
entries.literal: "Erina and Isla stayed where they were. That was the safest option up until that point, but as things were, staying in an uncertain spot such as the stairs was more dangerous than moving through an empty floor. It was something Erina must not have realized, but her demeanor was clear: she wasn't leaving Isla alone.{w} Nonetheless, the rest of us agreed and entered the event room once again."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I-It's really not here. How's that possible?
entries.literal: "I-It's really not here. How's that possible?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Raising the curtain revealed that the Sekimeiya we'd left there a few minutes ago was gone.
entries.literal: "Raising the curtain revealed that the Sekimeiya we'd left there a few minutes ago was gone."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It shouldn't be, right? We made sure nobody was in the two hallways.
entries.literal: "It shouldn't be, right? We made sure nobody was in the two hallways."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's why I said that the last person to exit must've already had it.
entries.literal: "That's why I said that the last person to exit must've already had it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Look. It's unlocked.
entries.literal: "Look. It's unlocked."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course it is. Katei must have a key.
entries.literal: "Of course it is. Katei must have a key."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I already said that I don't have it. There's no way I could've unlocked this cabinet.
entries.literal: "...I already said that I don't have it. There's no way I could've unlocked this cabinet."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Could he even have unlocked it if he had it? Did he enter this room again?
entries.literal: "Could he even have unlocked it if he had it? Did he enter this room again?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Not that I saw. When they were done, I went to the mechanical room, so he might've had his chance then. Erina would've brought it up, though.
entries.literal: "Not that I saw. When they were done, I went to the mechanical room, so he might've had his chance then. Erina would've brought it up, though."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see, so he had an opportunity.
entries.literal: "I see, so he had an opportunity."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But there's no way he did that, right? Our group was done quickly, so we could've appeared at any moment. And Erina would've had to keep this from us.
entries.literal: "But there's no way he did that, right? Our group was done quickly, so we could've appeared at any moment. And Erina would've had to keep this from us."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's amusing to see that now you have to resort to this to keep suspecting me. Erina wouldn't lie to you.
entries.literal: "It's amusing to see that now you have to resort to this to keep suspecting me. Erina wouldn't lie to you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Weren't we all liars a second ago? And what else makes sense? Did it disappear magically?
entries.literal: "Weren't we all liars a second ago? And what else makes sense? Did it disappear magically?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well... It made me teleport. Would it be that crazy to think that maybe it did?
entries.literal: "Well... It made me teleport. Would it be that crazy to think that maybe it did?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And it unlocked the cabinet too, right? Did the fucking Sekimeiya send the cabinet to the past to when it wasn't locked and just stroll on out of it?
entries.literal: "And it unlocked the cabinet too, right? Did the fucking Sekimeiya send the cabinet to the past to when it wasn't locked and just stroll on out of it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I didn't discard the possibility of you traveling to the past purely because nothing else explained what happened. This has a simple explanation: Katei did it.
entries.literal: "I didn't discard the possibility of you traveling to the past purely because nothing else explained what happened. This has a simple explanation: Katei did it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I know that you think he didn't have the time, but I don't care about that. I left this room when he was inside, so for all I know, he could've easily done it, even if all of you are lying.
entries.literal: "I know that you think he didn't have the time, but I don't care about that. I left this room when he was inside, so for all I know, he could've easily done it, even if all of you are lying."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, you're free to think that. I highly doubt it, though.
entries.literal: "Well, you're free to think that. I highly doubt it, though."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It seems that your reasoning has stopped being so influenced by Sai. That's good, Atsuki.
entries.literal: "It seems that your reasoning has stopped being so influenced by Sai. That's good, Atsuki."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Now put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet at once. It hasn't changed colors yet.
entries.literal: "Now put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet at once. It hasn't changed colors yet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Fine. There you go.
entries.literal: "Fine. There you go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai put it in the cabinet and closed the glass. It was a slightly funny sight after hearing him say that we wouldn't take it out again.
entries.literal: "Sai put it in the cabinet and closed the glass. It was a slightly funny sight after hearing him say that we wouldn't take it out again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do we lock it?
entries.literal: "Do we lock it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why would we? Katei will be able to keep getting it out.
entries.literal: "Why would we? Katei will be able to keep getting it out."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You can watch everything I do if you so desire. I will never get the Sekimeiya out of here.
entries.literal: "You can watch everything I do if you so desire. I will never get the Sekimeiya out of here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You said that Naomi had the only key to open this cabinet, right?
entries.literal: "You said that Naomi had the only key to open this cabinet, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The only one I'm aware of, yes.
entries.literal: "The only one I'm aware of, yes."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But she's... The culprit must have her key.
entries.literal: "But she's... The culprit must have her key."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: We saw her unlocking the cabinet before the smoke appeared. If the culprit didn't take it, could anyone have picked it up from her dead body?
entries.literal: "We saw her unlocking the cabinet before the smoke appeared. If the culprit didn't take it, could anyone have picked it up from her dead body?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai checked her pulse, isn't that right?
entries.literal: "Sai checked her pulse, isn't that right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I did. Why, are you concerned that she had a key up by her neck?
entries.literal: "I did. Why, are you concerned that she had a key up by her neck?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No, but only you approached her.
entries.literal: "No, but only you approached her."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That was after you killed her, though. It sounds to me like you had a much better opportunity.
entries.literal: "That was after you killed her, though. It sounds to me like you had a much better opportunity."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Sai couldn't have picked it up. I was paying attention.
entries.literal: "...Sai couldn't have picked it up. I was paying attention."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Thank God someone's competent enough. Nobody else checked her corpse after that, so the key must've already been gone.
entries.literal: "Thank God someone's competent enough. Nobody else checked her corpse after that, so the key must've already been gone."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Why don't we go see if we can find it?
entries.literal: "Why don't we go see if we can find it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Sure.
entries.literal: "...Sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai opened the hallway A door to indicate to Erina and Isla that we'd go check the other hallway.
entries.literal: "Sai opened the hallway A door to indicate to Erina and Isla that we'd go check the other hallway."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They're still there, so let's go see if we find the key.
entries.literal: "They're still there, so let's go see if we find the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Opposite to the event room in hallway B was the room where we'd found Naomi—B4. The last time, we hadn't searched her body.
entries.literal: "Opposite to the event room in hallway B was the room where we'd found Naomi—B4. The last time, we hadn't searched her body."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who wants to look for it? I'd do it, but I don't wanna be suspected even more.
entries.literal: "Who wants to look for it? I'd do it, but I don't wanna be suspected even more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody volunteered. Being close to a corpse was already enough for us.
entries.literal: "Nobody volunteered. Being close to a corpse was already enough for us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Fine. I'll do it, but if I find it, don't suggest that I could've skillfully placed it in one of her pockets.
entries.literal: "Fine. I'll do it, but if I find it, don't suggest that I could've skillfully placed it in one of her pockets."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Go ahead already.
entries.literal: "Go ahead already."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai started feeling every pocket of Naomi's clothes. It didn't take long for him to find something.
entries.literal: "Sai started feeling every pocket of Naomi's clothes. It didn't take long for him to find something."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Here, these are keys.
entries.literal: "Here, these are keys."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, this is the pocket where she had the cabinet key.
entries.literal: "Yeah, this is the pocket where she had the cabinet key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was holding a keyring containing three keys: two big ones and a small one.
entries.literal: "Sai was holding a keyring containing three keys: two big ones and a small one."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's none of those. They wouldn't fit.
entries.literal: "It's none of those. They wouldn't fit."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, that's what I thought. Do you know what these three open?
entries.literal: "Yeah, that's what I thought. Do you know what these three open?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That one opens the door in the floor 2 staircase. I don't know about the other two, though.
entries.literal: "That one opens the door in the floor 2 staircase. I don't know about the other two, though."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So she doesn't have the key for the cabinet?
entries.literal: "So she doesn't have the key for the cabinet?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me keep looking.
entries.literal: "Let me keep looking."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai searched through the remaining pockets, but they were all empty.
entries.literal: "Sai searched through the remaining pockets, but they were all empty."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It seems not. Her killer took the cabinet key after killing her, and we know who that was.
entries.literal: "It seems not. Her killer took the cabinet key after killing her, and we know who that was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei looked at me while everyone else looked at him.
entries.literal: "Katei looked at me while everyone else looked at him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't try it again, Katei. You must have killed Naomi and then unlocked the cabinet with her key. You've proven yourself to be quite stupid a few times, so you must've hidden the Sekimeiya in a room you looked through hoping we'd ignore it.
entries.literal: "Don't try it again, Katei. You must have killed Naomi and then unlocked the cabinet with her key. You've proven yourself to be quite stupid a few times, so you must've hidden the Sekimeiya in a room you looked through hoping we'd ignore it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's ridiculous. I'd have no reason to do that, let alone the time. It's baffling how you don't realize only Atsuki could've done this.
entries.literal: "That's ridiculous. I'd have no reason to do that, let alone the time. It's baffling how you don't realize only Atsuki could've done this."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What now?
entries.literal: "...What now?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You killed Naomi, so naturally, you got your hands on her key. Then, while you were looking at hallway A from the lobby, you went to the event room. You unlocked the cabinet and left the Sekimeiya in a room I had searched in order to frame me. There's no other way.
entries.literal: "You killed Naomi, so naturally, you got your hands on her key. Then, while you were looking at hallway A from the lobby, you went to the event room. You unlocked the cabinet and left the Sekimeiya in a room I had searched in order to frame me. There's no other way."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Don't you know how risky that'd be? He could've been seen at any time.
entries.literal: "Don't you know how risky that'd be? He could've been seen at any time."

entries.speaker: k
