entries.text: Likewise, if you intend to blame me, you're implying I took the same risk.
entries.literal: "Likewise, if you intend to blame me, you're implying I took the same risk."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The difference is that Atsuki had a reason to move it: to frame me. If his plan succeeded, I would've been the main culprit. However, by hiding it, I wouldn't gain anything.
entries.literal: "The difference is that Atsuki had a reason to move it: to frame me. If his plan succeeded, I would've been the main culprit. However, by hiding it, I wouldn't gain anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Neither of your motives are enough, and Atsuki would've been more likely to be seen with the Sekimeiya. You're not going to convince anyone.
entries.literal: "Neither of your motives are enough, and Atsuki would've been more likely to be seen with the Sekimeiya. You're not going to convince anyone."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Why don't we do a thorough search, then? Let's search each other to see who has the key.
entries.literal: "Why don't we do a thorough search, then? Let's search each other to see who has the key."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course not. Nobody would be dumb enough to keep it on themselves. I bet you already disposed of it in another one of the rooms you inspected.
entries.literal: "Of course not. Nobody would be dumb enough to keep it on themselves. I bet you already disposed of it in another one of the rooms you inspected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though he said that, I still showed my empty pockets.
entries.literal: "Even though he said that, I still showed my empty pockets."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Atsuki doesn't have a motive. Please, stop accusing him... There's so much blood, so this is where everything happened, and to do this to someone in front of a camera... You'd need to have a real reason for it.{w} We need to find the person who did this to Naomi. They made that noise earlier...{w} L-Look at Naomi's face. She must've been terrified, and being afraid of this happening might even be why she hid from us.
entries.literal: "Atsuki doesn't have a motive. Please, stop accusing him... There's so much blood, so this is where everything happened, and to do this to someone in front of a camera... You'd need to have a real reason for it.{w} We need to find the person who did this to Naomi. They made that noise earlier...{w} L-Look at Naomi's face. She must've been terrified, and being afraid of this happening might even be why she hid from us."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You said that, right, Akaro? That she looked preoccupied when she appeared. She didn't do anything, and the real person responsible took her life.
entries.literal: "You said that, right, Akaro? That she looked preoccupied when she appeared. She didn't do anything, and the real person responsible took her life."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: And why would they do that? It's true that she looked like the culprit, and that's why I still think she was. By killing her, they'd only be confirming that she was innocent.
entries.literal: "And why would they do that? It's true that she looked like the culprit, and that's why I still think she was. By killing her, they'd only be confirming that she was innocent."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Or involved in a way that's harmful for them. We need to know what happened to her and find who's actually behind it.
entries.literal: "...Or involved in a way that's harmful for them. We need to know what happened to her and find who's actually behind it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...We shouldn't leave her like this, though. She doesn't deserve to spend eleven more hours lying face-up with that expression.
entries.literal: "...We shouldn't leave her like this, though. She doesn't deserve to spend eleven more hours lying face-up with that expression."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What, do you wanna cover it?
entries.literal: "What, do you wanna cover it?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Isn't that... what you do for corpses?
entries.literal: "Isn't that... what you do for corpses?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We should prioritize maintaining the crime scene.
entries.literal: "We should prioritize maintaining the crime scene."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't think so... She died in this room, and cameras recorded it. There's nothing to preserve, and we can give her some dignity.
entries.literal: "I don't think so... She died in this room, and cameras recorded it. There's nothing to preserve, and we can give her some dignity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her stance was understandable, and nobody wanted to argue against it. It was possible I'd get in trouble for it, but I went ahead and detached a curtain from a cabinet and laid it over Naomi's body, covering the face that communicated how she'd spent her last moments.
entries.literal: "Her stance was understandable, and nobody wanted to argue against it. It was possible I'd get in trouble for it, but I went ahead and detached a curtain from a cabinet and laid it over Naomi's body, covering the face that communicated how she'd spent her last moments."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Thank you... I'm sure she would appreciate it.
entries.literal: "Thank you... I'm sure she would appreciate it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm not sure that was a great idea, but now let's make sure to find the person who did it. Doesn't it feel like they're taunting us, making noise to let us know they're there and refusing to appear?
entries.literal: "I'm not sure that was a great idea, but now let's make sure to find the person who did it. Doesn't it feel like they're taunting us, making noise to let us know they're there and refusing to appear?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But even so, they wouldn't have had a chance to move the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "But even so, they wouldn't have had a chance to move the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Can we really be sure? Our priority should be to find them. I don't think any of us did this. There's a real culprit who murdered Naomi and is responsible for the Sekimeiya vanishing. ...Who knows what else will happen if we don't stop them immediately?
entries.literal: "Can we really be sure? Our priority should be to find them. I don't think any of us did this. There's a real culprit who murdered Naomi and is responsible for the Sekimeiya vanishing. ...Who knows what else will happen if we don't stop them immediately?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't know how they did everything or how they weren't found, but we have to hurry. They're somewhere on a higher floor right now, so let's find them.
entries.literal: "I don't know how they did everything or how they weren't found, but we have to hurry. They're somewhere on a higher floor right now, so let's find them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We left the room behind, and with it Naomi's corpse, which lay under a beautiful red cloth. She had lost her life in the tower with us, and yet we knew nothing about her or the identity and intentions of her murderer. I was trying not to let it get the best of me, but my mind was all over the place. I couldn't allow anything to happen to me and Shiroya, and the moment I'd instantaneously moved between places kept replaying in my head.
entries.literal: "We left the room behind, and with it Naomi's corpse, which lay under a beautiful red cloth. She had lost her life in the tower with us, and yet we knew nothing about her or the identity and intentions of her murderer. I was trying not to let it get the best of me, but my mind was all over the place. I couldn't allow anything to happen to me and Shiroya, and the moment I'd instantaneously moved between places kept replaying in my head."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We met up with Erina and Isla and summarized the few conclusions we'd been able to draw. Once again, we had five floors to go through.
entries.literal: "We met up with Erina and Isla and summarized the few conclusions we'd been able to draw. Once again, we had five floors to go through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were we going to find anyone a second time? It must've been almost {time=11}, implying that someone might've been able to remain unseen for two full hours.
entries.literal: "Were we going to find anyone a second time? It must've been almost {time=11}, implying that someone might've been able to remain unseen for two full hours."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: This is starting to get old, so let's be fast. This person only wants to hide from us, and they're also being recorded by cameras, so our only goal is to find them and question them.
entries.literal: "This is starting to get old, so let's be fast. This person only wants to hide from us, and they're also being recorded by cameras, so our only goal is to find them and question them."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Since it couldn't have been any of us, splitting up won't matter. Everyone make sure a floor is empty and then stay somewhere outside the offices. This way, someone who's hiding can only escape by moving between floors, and they'll be easily spotted.
entries.literal: "Since it couldn't have been any of us, splitting up won't matter. Everyone make sure a floor is empty and then stay somewhere outside the offices. This way, someone who's hiding can only escape by moving between floors, and they'll be easily spotted."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: After a few minutes, it'll be impossible not to have found them, so we'll all move back to this floor with that person in tow.
entries.literal: "After a few minutes, it'll be impossible not to have found them, so we'll all move back to this floor with that person in tow."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't think this is needed at all.
entries.literal: "I don't think this is needed at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went up the stairs, following Akaro. If none of us were the culprit or had ulterior motives, then the plan would work. It was only slightly faster than moving up progressively, but it'd be equally successful.
entries.literal: "We went up the stairs, following Akaro. If none of us were the culprit or had ulterior motives, then the plan would work. It was only slightly faster than moving up progressively, but it'd be equally successful."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We'll stay here, then.
entries.literal: "We'll stay here, then."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm.
entries.literal: "Hm."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Actually, never mind. This arrangement of yours is a great idea.
entries.literal: "...Actually, never mind. This arrangement of yours is a great idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After we checked that nobody was in the bathrooms, Erina and Isla were left behind on floor 2, free to enter the partitions. Sai said he'd inspect and wait on floor 3.
entries.literal: "After we checked that nobody was in the bathrooms, Erina and Isla were left behind on floor 2, free to enter the partitions. Sai said he'd inspect and wait on floor 3."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'll look through this one. The rest of you keep going up.
entries.literal: "I'll look through this one. The rest of you keep going up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With Akaro staying on the fourth floor, Shiroya and I remained on the fifth. Katei was left with the last one, and he said that he'd make sure nobody could stay hidden there.
entries.literal: "With Akaro staying on the fourth floor, Shiroya and I remained on the fifth. Katei was left with the last one, and he said that he'd make sure nobody could stay hidden there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We easily looked through our three sections. There was nobody there, so we stayed next to the elevator.
entries.literal: "We easily looked through our three sections. There was nobody there, so we stayed next to the elevator."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We'll have to wait, then.
entries.literal: "We'll have to wait, then."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We can head downstairs whenever Katei comes back.
entries.literal: "We can head downstairs whenever Katei comes back."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We have to find someone this time, right? Someone must've been on the crystal floor when we heard that noise.
entries.literal: "We have to find someone this time, right? Someone must've been on the crystal floor when we heard that noise."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'd say so. Unless they can make it to the attic, the only way we could miss them is if someone purposely covers for them.
entries.literal: "I'd say so. Unless they can make it to the attic, the only way we could miss them is if someone purposely covers for them."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you tired? When did you wake up yesterday?
entries.literal: "Are you tired? When did you wake up yesterday?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Sometime in the afternoon. I'm okay, though, just a bit hungry.
entries.literal: "Sometime in the afternoon. I'm okay, though, just a bit hungry."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, I'm the same. I'm glad I ate a bit before leaving. Do you not carry cereal bars with you anymore? You always used to have one or two in your purse.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I'm the same. I'm glad I ate a bit before leaving. Do you not carry cereal bars with you anymore? You always used to have one or two in your purse."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That was at school. I brought the ones I had when I came over, but I finished them off a few days ago. I wouldn't be surprised if they stopped people from bringing food in here anyway.
entries.literal: "That was at school. I brought the ones I had when I came over, but I finished them off a few days ago. I wouldn't be surprised if they stopped people from bringing food in here anyway."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Right. I didn't think about that.
entries.literal: "...Right. I didn't think about that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I was thinking that if we want to go find that old cabin, we could do it tomorrow. It hasn't snowed in a bit, so that should help us get there. It was pretty far.
entries.literal: "I was thinking that if we want to go find that old cabin, we could do it tomorrow. It hasn't snowed in a bit, so that should help us get there. It was pretty far."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Are you sure it'll still be there? I don't think I remember how to get to it, and I'm sure it's changed a lot since then.
entries.literal: "...Are you sure it'll still be there? I don't think I remember how to get to it, and I'm sure it's changed a lot since then."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It wasn't that fragile of a cabin. I'm sure it held out against the weather, but maybe the door is buried in snow. We'll have to see.
entries.literal: "It wasn't that fragile of a cabin. I'm sure it held out against the weather, but maybe the door is buried in snow. We'll have to see."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You know, I thought of something earlier. Do you remember Danny?
entries.literal: "You know, I thought of something earlier. Do you remember Danny?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Danny?
entries.literal: "...Danny?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Danny the tiger.
entries.literal: "Danny the tiger."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh! That stuffed thing? Yeah, of course. It's been forever since I thought about that.
entries.literal: "Oh! That stuffed thing? Yeah, of course. It's been forever since I thought about that."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I haven't been able to find him in years. I just thought that maybe I left him in that cabin.
entries.literal: "I haven't been able to find him in years. I just thought that maybe I left him in that cabin."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You think so...? You definitely brought him there a few times. Maybe I left something there too. Now I want to go even more.{w} Katei didn't mention a cabin in his story, but I'd be shocked if it was the same place. There are probably a few similar fields on that mountain.
entries.literal: "You think so...? You definitely brought him there a few times. Maybe I left something there too. Now I want to go even more.{w} Katei didn't mention a cabin in his story, but I'd be shocked if it was the same place. There are probably a few similar fields on that mountain."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Mmm. I'd be happy if we could find him. I used to have him with me all the time.
entries.literal: "Mmm. I'd be happy if we could find him. I used to have him with me all the time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. We'll get through this. We'll find the person who made that noise and put an end to everything. There was a pretty big couch in the lobby, so you can probably rest there if you need to.
entries.literal: "Yeah. We'll get through this. We'll find the person who made that noise and put an end to everything. There was a pretty big couch in the lobby, so you can probably rest there if you need to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya didn't reply. I was forcing myself to be optimistic and distract her from what was going on, but it wasn't enough. Naomi's empty eyes weren't something she was going to easily forget. She lowered her shoulders, trying to loosen up, but her posture was still completely rigid.
entries.literal: "Shiroya didn't reply. I was forcing myself to be optimistic and distract her from what was going on, but it wasn't enough. Naomi's empty eyes weren't something she was going to easily forget. She lowered her shoulders, trying to loosen up, but her posture was still completely rigid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our arrangement was efficient, but if someone had gone to the sixth floor, Katei could pretend it was empty. Due to the attic door, we wouldn't be able to prove he lied unless we had the security footage.
entries.literal: "Our arrangement was efficient, but if someone had gone to the sixth floor, Katei could pretend it was empty. Due to the attic door, we wouldn't be able to prove he lied unless we had the security footage."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, it seemed like Katei was serious about finding the culprit. If he hadn't been making that up, he would report his part of the search truthfully.
entries.literal: "However, it seemed like Katei was serious about finding the culprit. If he hadn't been making that up, he would report his part of the search truthfully."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I thought of him, I heard muffled noises coming from above us. They were incredibly faint footsteps we could hear solely because of the pure silence surrounding us, which indicated that Katei was walking across the sixth floor.
entries.literal: "As I thought of him, I heard muffled noises coming from above us. They were incredibly faint footsteps we could hear solely because of the pure silence surrounding us, which indicated that Katei was walking across the sixth floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Do you think I could've time traveled?
entries.literal: "...Do you think I could've time traveled?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Huh? I don't know. It's kind of unbelievable...{w} Do you think you did?
entries.literal: "...Huh? I don't know. It's kind of unbelievable...{w} Do you think you did?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think so. Experiencing it myself makes me doubt that anything else could've happened.
entries.literal: "I think so. Experiencing it myself makes me doubt that anything else could've happened."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see... How was it? Did it hurt at all?
entries.literal: "I see... How was it? Did it hurt at all?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, no. It was immediate. Did I really disappear from your perspective?
entries.literal: "Oh, no. It was immediate. Did I really disappear from your perspective?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Yes. I thought I must've imagined it somehow, but my first impression was that you instantly vanished. I actually ran up to the cabinet to check if you fell inside, but I could only see the gray Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...Yes. I thought I must've imagined it somehow, but my first impression was that you instantly vanished. I actually ran up to the cabinet to check if you fell inside, but I could only see the gray Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If anyone else said that, I would've left it open for doubt. Someone else could deliberately lie to make me think I'd teleported when they knew what actually happened.{w} But I had to take Shiroya's experience at face value. If I intended to think of an alternative to time travel, I had to factor in her viewpoint as well.
entries.literal: "If anyone else said that, I would've left it open for doubt. Someone else could deliberately lie to make me think I'd teleported when they knew what actually happened.{w} But I had to take Shiroya's experience at face value. If I intended to think of an alternative to time travel, I had to factor in her viewpoint as well."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm also pretty sure I time traveled because of what happened on the sixth floor earlier. You saw me next to the offices and thought I'd moved over there, right?
entries.literal: "I'm also pretty sure I time traveled because of what happened on the sixth floor earlier. You saw me next to the offices and thought I'd moved over there, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, that's right. When I got back, you were next to the elevator again. I was gonna bring it up, but you looked a bit nervous, and I thought something might've happened.
entries.literal: "Oh, that's right. When I got back, you were next to the elevator again. I was gonna bring it up, but you looked a bit nervous, and I thought something might've happened."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So you were the one who brought the elevator up?
entries.literal: "So you were the one who brought the elevator up?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It seems so...
entries.literal: "It seems so..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Traveling to the past had caused her search to come up empty, but the circumstances of that were highly specific. For our second search, everyone was watching over a separate floor, so it was unlikely something like that would repeat.
entries.literal: "Traveling to the past had caused her search to come up empty, but the circumstances of that were highly specific. For our second search, everyone was watching over a separate floor, so it was unlikely something like that would repeat."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I'm sorry. If I hadn't brought up coming here, this wouldn't have happened.
entries.literal: "...I'm sorry. If I hadn't brought up coming here, this wouldn't have happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You don't have to apologize for that. I wanted to go too.
entries.literal: "...You don't have to apologize for that. I wanted to go too."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you sure? Nothing has happened to us yet, but depending on what's really going on, we might be in danger. Someone is... dead.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? Nothing has happened to us yet, but depending on what's really going on, we might be in danger. Someone is... dead."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I feel... horrible about what happened to Naomi, but it's likely she was involved with this plan in some way. There's no reason for anyone to target us.
entries.literal: "I feel... horrible about what happened to Naomi, but it's likely she was involved with this plan in some way. There's no reason for anyone to target us."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But we're searching for the person who did it, right? That might be a motive in itself. They killed Naomi in front of the security cameras, so they're not afraid of being recorded. ...And there's also this teleportation.
entries.literal: "But we're searching for the person who did it, right? That might be a motive in itself. They killed Naomi in front of the security cameras, so they're not afraid of being recorded. ...And there's also this teleportation."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Not only that, but a lot of things don't seem right, do they? How did the Sekimeiya disappear just now?
entries.literal: "Not only that, but a lot of things don't seem right, do they? How did the Sekimeiya disappear just now?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, someone must have used the key to open the cabinet...
entries.literal: "Well, someone must have used the key to open the cabinet..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But nobody could have. And if someone did, it was one of us seven. Or, I guess, either Sai or Akaro. You were looking at hallway A, right?
entries.literal: "But nobody could have. And if someone did, it was one of us seven. Or, I guess, either Sai or Akaro. You were looking at hallway A, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That sounded reasonable from her point of view. She wouldn't have kept track of Sai and Akaro while she'd looked through the hallway B rooms.
entries.literal: "That sounded reasonable from her point of view. She wouldn't have kept track of Sai and Akaro while she'd looked through the hallway B rooms."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, but that's not really the case. Sai, Akaro, Katei, Erina, Isla, and an unknown person could've still done it.
entries.literal: "Yes, but that's not really the case. Sai, Akaro, Katei, Erina, Isla, and an unknown person could've still done it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: When I went to look inside the mechanical room, Katei, Erina, and Isla were looking at hallway A. During that time, they had the chance to enter the event room.{w} Although it would imply that they were either working together or threatened into silence.
entries.literal: "When I went to look inside the mechanical room, Katei, Erina, and Isla were looking at hallway A. During that time, they had the chance to enter the event room.{w} Although it would imply that they were either working together or threatened into silence."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Similarly, if they didn't keep watching the hallway or were working with an unknown person, that person could've also had the opportunity to enter. That doesn't make much sense to me, and it means that they had Naomi's key even before we found her body.
entries.literal: "Similarly, if they didn't keep watching the hallway or were working with an unknown person, that person could've also had the opportunity to enter. That doesn't make much sense to me, and it means that they had Naomi's key even before we found her body."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But what you said about Sai and Akaro doesn't make much sense either because the Sekimeiya was found in the storeroom—in hallway A. Sai and Akaro were looking through hallway B, so they could've opened the cabinet by picking up the key from Naomi's body and then going to the event room.
entries.literal: "But what you said about Sai and Akaro doesn't make much sense either because the Sekimeiya was found in the storeroom—in hallway A. Sai and Akaro were looking through hallway B, so they could've opened the cabinet by picking up the key from Naomi's body and then going to the event room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But then they couldn't have left it inside one of the hallway A rooms.
entries.literal: "But then they couldn't have left it inside one of the hallway A rooms."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. The only way to do that would've been by cooperating with Katei and Erina. When I was in the mechanical room, either of them could've entered the event room knowing that their hallway B companion had unlocked the cabinet, or maybe they let them hide it.
entries.literal: "Yeah. The only way to do that would've been by cooperating with Katei and Erina. When I was in the mechanical room, either of them could've entered the event room knowing that their hallway B companion had unlocked the cabinet, or maybe they let them hide it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So, in the end, the only possibilities are that either Katei and Erina are the culprits, worked with them, or were forced to keep quiet.{w} ...Nobody could've hidden it in the storeroom without being seen by both of them... and Isla too, I suppose.
entries.literal: "So, in the end, the only possibilities are that either Katei and Erina are the culprits, worked with them, or were forced to keep quiet.{w} ...Nobody could've hidden it in the storeroom without being seen by both of them... and Isla too, I suppose."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's right. And if it's true that no more keys exist and they weren't threatened, they must've been behind what happened to Naomi... They wouldn't have been able to unlock the cabinet otherwise, unless they cooperated with someone from hallway B.
entries.literal: "That's right. And if it's true that no more keys exist and they weren't threatened, they must've been behind what happened to Naomi... They wouldn't have been able to unlock the cabinet otherwise, unless they cooperated with someone from hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "At least three people are lying to us or nothing makes sense". That was the conclusion we'd come to, and Shiroya looked pretty defeated about it.
entries.literal: "\"At least three people are lying to us or nothing makes sense\". That was the conclusion we'd come to, and Shiroya looked pretty defeated about it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What you said earlier... that nobody from hallway B could've hidden the Sekimeiya in the storeroom... Could there be a way around that?
entries.literal: "What you said earlier... that nobody from hallway B could've hidden the Sekimeiya in the storeroom... Could there be a way around that?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I considered that it was Sai. He entered the storeroom and acted like he'd found the Sekimeiya inside, when in reality, he'd had it on him the whole time.
entries.literal: "I considered that it was Sai. He entered the storeroom and acted like he'd found the Sekimeiya inside, when in reality, he'd had it on him the whole time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's the only way I can think of, but it's not really possible. Technically, Sai could have hidden the Sekimeiya in his hip pack.{w} However, we talked for a bit before he went to examine hallway A, and his back was facing us when he entered the two rooms there.
entries.literal: "That's the only way I can think of, but it's not really possible. Technically, Sai could have hidden the Sekimeiya in his hip pack.{w} However, we talked for a bit before he went to examine hallway A, and his back was facing us when he entered the two rooms there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm sure that if the Sekimeiya had been there, one of us would've noticed. His pack would've looked bulkier than normal.
entries.literal: "I'm sure that if the Sekimeiya had been there, one of us would've noticed. His pack would've looked bulkier than normal."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're probably right. He wouldn't have any other way to keep it hidden.{w} ...So the only possibility is that Katei and Erina did it while you weren't there.
entries.literal: "You're probably right. He wouldn't have any other way to keep it hidden.{w} ...So the only possibility is that Katei and Erina did it while you weren't there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think so... They must've had the key before we found Naomi, and only Katei could've killed her.{w} However, Katei can't be responsible just by himself since he wouldn't have been able to get the Sekimeiya before I went to the mechanical room. By that point, he was already with Erina and Isla.
entries.literal: "I think so... They must've had the key before we found Naomi, and only Katei could've killed her.{w} However, Katei can't be responsible just by himself since he wouldn't have been able to get the Sekimeiya before I went to the mechanical room. By that point, he was already with Erina and Isla."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: When I left the mechanical room, Erina told me that nothing had happened. So she was either working with Katei, or she was threatened to keep quiet. Nothing works involving someone from hallway B acting on their own, and the only other possibility could be an extra person threatening Erina and Katei to keep quiet.{w} You were with your group in hallway C when you finished, so it's unlikely that person came down from a higher floor. They might've been in one of the hallway A rooms we checked.
entries.literal: "When I left the mechanical room, Erina told me that nothing had happened. So she was either working with Katei, or she was threatened to keep quiet. Nothing works involving someone from hallway B acting on their own, and the only other possibility could be an extra person threatening Erina and Katei to keep quiet.{w} You were with your group in hallway C when you finished, so it's unlikely that person came down from a higher floor. They might've been in one of the hallway A rooms we checked."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm...{w} Someone else was definitely on that floor, right? So that shouldn't be impossible.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} Someone else was definitely on that floor, right? So that shouldn't be impossible."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's true, and if someone was threatened like that, they wouldn't reveal the culprit's position now even if they found them... In fact, they might still be on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "That's true, and if someone was threatened like that, they wouldn't reveal the culprit's position now even if they found them... In fact, they might still be on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So... maybe the way everyone spread out on these floors wasn't the best idea.
entries.literal: "So... maybe the way everyone spread out on these floors wasn't the best idea."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I can hardly take myself seriously, but I have to think about time travel and teleportation too. I just don't want to miss possibilities, and... ones involving what should be impossible have now become potential realities. I can't deny what I experienced.
entries.literal: "I can hardly take myself seriously, but I have to think about time travel and teleportation too. I just don't want to miss possibilities, and... ones involving what should be impossible have now become potential realities. I can't deny what I experienced."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I have no idea what the rules would be, but if the Sekimeiya grants time travel abilities, it makes a lot of sense that someone's chasing after it or trying to accomplish something with it. They could know more about its powers than we do—they might've been making use of them from the beginning.
entries.literal: "I have no idea what the rules would be, but if the Sekimeiya grants time travel abilities, it makes a lot of sense that someone's chasing after it or trying to accomplish something with it. They could know more about its powers than we do—they might've been making use of them from the beginning."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But why would anyone bother hiding the Sekimeiya? No matter what I think, there doesn't appear to be a clear purpose since it would always be trivial to locate it if it's not brought to a locker or the attic.
entries.literal: "But why would anyone bother hiding the Sekimeiya? No matter what I think, there doesn't appear to be a clear purpose since it would always be trivial to locate it if it's not brought to a locker or the attic."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But let's assume the culprit wanted to hide it in the storeroom, whatever their reason. If they truly did it with the time travel that occurs upon touching the Sekimeiya, it follows that in the future, they'll have access to it.{w} So someone could be ready to go to the past and hide it in the storeroom right this moment. They might intend to make it out of here with the Sekimeiya in some way.
entries.literal: "But let's assume the culprit wanted to hide it in the storeroom, whatever their reason. If they truly did it with the time travel that occurs upon touching the Sekimeiya, it follows that in the future, they'll have access to it.{w} So someone could be ready to go to the past and hide it in the storeroom right this moment. They might intend to make it out of here with the Sekimeiya in some way."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It teleports you to the past, doesn't it? One goal could be to make it to the past holding the Sekimeiya itself or other gemstones. It would appear as if they'd disappeared from inside the tower, and only one of us could be responsible. But I wasn't holding the Sekimeiya when I traveled to hallway A, so how would you go to the past with it?
entries.literal: "It teleports you to the past, doesn't it? One goal could be to make it to the past holding the Sekimeiya itself or other gemstones. It would appear as if they'd disappeared from inside the tower, and only one of us could be responsible. But I wasn't holding the Sekimeiya when I traveled to hallway A, so how would you go to the past with it?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Avoiding the two hallway groups is more than possible if someone used time travel: first, they lured us out of the event room by making the sound we heard.
entries.literal: "Avoiding the two hallway groups is more than possible if someone used time travel: first, they lured us out of the event room by making the sound we heard."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Then, they appeared inside the event room from the future.{w} I don't know what could determine the position you teleport to, because I appeared in hallway A when I hadn't been there twenty minutes before, but if the culprit touches the Sekimeiya while holding the cabinet key, they could appear inside the event room with it.
entries.literal: "Then, they appeared inside the event room from the future.{w} I don't know what could determine the position you teleport to, because I appeared in hallway A when I hadn't been there twenty minutes before, but if the culprit touches the Sekimeiya while holding the cabinet key, they could appear inside the event room with it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Once we were all in hallway C, they got out of the event room and left it in the storeroom while they hid elsewhere.{w} If they had already lived through that portion of time, they could've known the entire sequence of events—that they would be safe in the event room until we found the Sekimeiya. But then they'd also know that it would be found right away, so why bother doing all this?
entries.literal: "Once we were all in hallway C, they got out of the event room and left it in the storeroom while they hid elsewhere.{w} If they had already lived through that portion of time, they could've known the entire sequence of events—that they would be safe in the event room until we found the Sekimeiya. But then they'd also know that it would be found right away, so why bother doing all this?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Regardless, that leaves open the possibility of the culprit still being on the crystal floor. They could've even disappeared by touching the Sekimeiya if it was necessary, and even though it was white when we found it, maybe it didn't make us travel because someone else had just used it.
entries.literal: "Regardless, that leaves open the possibility of the culprit still being on the crystal floor. They could've even disappeared by touching the Sekimeiya if it was necessary, and even though it was white when we found it, maybe it didn't make us travel because someone else had just used it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: My initial thought is some sort of cooldown: after I traveled, nobody else could travel. Once the cold restored it, it allowed for one more travel. That still doesn't explain the strange color change it underwent right as I touched it.
entries.literal: "My initial thought is some sort of cooldown: after I traveled, nobody else could travel. Once the cold restored it, it allowed for one more travel. That still doesn't explain the strange color change it underwent right as I touched it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If we're chasing a culprit who has knowledge of how to disappear and go to the past easily, it makes a lot of sense that we haven't found them yet. It also explains why they're trying to hide from us when we would normally find someone right away in this building.
entries.literal: "If we're chasing a culprit who has knowledge of how to disappear and go to the past easily, it makes a lot of sense that we haven't found them yet. It also explains why they're trying to hide from us when we would normally find someone right away in this building."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But the person who lured us out of the event room would've had to go up the floors before traveling to the past, and they can't disappear from there since the Sekimeiya's still on the crystal floor.{w} ...Once again, though, the attic makes it possible.
entries.literal: "But the person who lured us out of the event room would've had to go up the floors before traveling to the past, and they can't disappear from there since the Sekimeiya's still on the crystal floor.{w} ...Once again, though, the attic makes it possible."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Nonetheless, if no time travel or teleportation was involved at all in what happened, Katei, Erina, and Isla know the truth of it. If it really was a factor, I wonder how far we are from understanding anything at all that's happened.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, if no time travel or teleportation was involved at all in what happened, Katei, Erina, and Isla know the truth of it. If it really was a factor, I wonder how far we are from understanding anything at all that's happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Katei's coming.
entries.literal: "Katei's coming."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I anticipated his arrival thanks to the echoing footsteps. He came from the floor above.
entries.literal: "I anticipated his arrival thanks to the echoing footsteps. He came from the floor above."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did anything happen?
entries.literal: "Did anything happen?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...No. There was no one there, so as we agreed, I stayed on that floor for a while to make sure no one escaped there with the elevator. More than enough time has passed, so we should go back down.
entries.literal: "...No. There was no one there, so as we agreed, I stayed on that floor for a while to make sure no one escaped there with the elevator. More than enough time has passed, so we should go back down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He shot me another incensed look, but I tried to ignore it.
entries.literal: "He shot me another incensed look, but I tried to ignore it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: If anyone was here, they must've been found.
entries.literal: "If anyone was here, they must've been found."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Okay. Let's go to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "...Okay. Let's go to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We took the stairs down. Akaro was waiting for us, uncertain of what to do. He also hadn't found anyone.
entries.literal: "We took the stairs down. Akaro was waiting for us, uncertain of what to do. He also hadn't found anyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One floor below was Sai. According to him, the third floor was empty and nothing had happened after we'd left.
entries.literal: "One floor below was Sai. According to him, the third floor was empty and nothing had happened after we'd left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The situation was the same on the second, where Erina and Isla had remained. There was no point to it, but as we'd said earlier, we all moved down to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "The situation was the same on the second, where Erina and Isla had remained. There was no point to it, but as we'd said earlier, we all moved down to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well. Did anyone find the culprit and let them escape?
entries.literal: "Well. Did anyone find the culprit and let them escape?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone stated that they had found no one. We'd just searched through the entire tower without a result, so the only remaining possibilities were that the culprit had access to the attic, that one of us was lying, or that they'd managed to escape by teleporting through time, which should've only been possible on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Everyone stated that they had found no one. We'd just searched through the entire tower without a result, so the only remaining possibilities were that the culprit had access to the attic, that one of us was lying, or that they'd managed to escape by teleporting through time, which should've only been possible on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...So that's a no?
entries.literal: "...So that's a no?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all kept quiet, as we'd already announced our results.
entries.literal: "We all kept quiet, as we'd already announced our results."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They have to be in the attic, then. We just searched every other floor, after all.
entries.literal: "They have to be in the attic, then. We just searched every other floor, after all."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: O-Oh, wait, I can actually think of another place where they could be.
entries.literal: "O-Oh, wait, I can actually think of another place where they could be."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure...? We looked through the whole tower. The way we did it didn't allow for anyone to hide from us. Where else could they have been?
entries.literal: "Are you sure...? We looked through the whole tower. The way we did it didn't allow for anyone to hide from us. Where else could they have been?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There.
entries.literal: "There."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya turned around and pointed at the elevator.
entries.literal: "Shiroya turned around and pointed at the elevator."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, inside the elevator? Nobody went into it, correct?
entries.literal: "Oh, inside the elevator? Nobody went into it, correct?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No one spoke up. Could someone have been inside the elevator the whole time, banking on us ignoring it?
entries.literal: "No one spoke up. Could someone have been inside the elevator the whole time, banking on us ignoring it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Which floor should it be on?
entries.literal: "Which floor should it be on?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We were the last ones to use it. We called it from floor 5 to test which floor it stopped on when we followed it up.
entries.literal: "We were the last ones to use it. We called it from floor 5 to test which floor it stopped on when we followed it up."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's good. If we left it here, they could've come out as soon as we went up. At least we don't have to search this floor again.
entries.literal: "That's good. If we left it here, they could've come out as soon as we went up. At least we don't have to search this floor again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Anything wrong?
entries.literal: "Anything wrong?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Plenty. Wait a second.
entries.literal: "Plenty. Wait a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Following the out of place sigh, he walked up to the elevator and pressed the button to call it.{w} After a few seconds, the orange light surrounding the button told us that it had arrived, and Sai immediately grabbed the handle.
entries.literal: "Following the out of place sigh, he walked up to the elevator and pressed the button to call it.{w} After a few seconds, the orange light surrounding the button told us that it had arrived, and Sai immediately grabbed the handle."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's see, I suppose. There's no way anyone's inside. They would've gotten out as soon as they heard people leaving the floor it was on, and if they'd still been inside, they could've pressed any floor button before this one to stop it earlier.
entries.literal: "Let's see, I suppose. There's no way anyone's inside. They would've gotten out as soon as they heard people leaving the floor it was on, and if they'd still been inside, they could've pressed any floor button before this one to stop it earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He opened the door. It was empty, as we'd all expected.
entries.literal: "He opened the door. It was empty, as we'd all expected."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, I meant to ask you something, Katei. The instructions inside state that pressing the stop button will enable contact with an emergency line. Is that possible right now?
entries.literal: "Oh, I meant to ask you something, Katei. The instructions inside state that pressing the stop button will enable contact with an emergency line. Is that possible right now?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No. Naturally, the alarm shuts that down. The line can enable communication both with the outside and the security room, but right now it's disabled completely.
entries.literal: "No. Naturally, the alarm shuts that down. The line can enable communication both with the outside and the security room, but right now it's disabled completely."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I'd strongly recommend that none of you touch it. It was originally installed knowing Xyn could try to secure the elevator, but there's no point in that now, and we left up clear instructions.{w} If you press it as the elevator is moving, it won't move again until permission is granted from outside, and given communication has been temporarily disabled, I fear nothing could be done until the exit unlocks.
entries.literal: "...I'd strongly recommend that none of you touch it. It was originally installed knowing Xyn could try to secure the elevator, but there's no point in that now, and we left up clear instructions.{w} If you press it as the elevator is moving, it won't move again until permission is granted from outside, and given communication has been temporarily disabled, I fear nothing could be done until the exit unlocks."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's scary. We'll keep it in mind.
entries.literal: "That's scary. We'll keep it in mind."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anyway, given how long it took to get here, it was on the fifth floor.
entries.literal: "Anyway, given how long it took to get here, it was on the fifth floor."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: You can tell?
entries.literal: "You can tell?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. I've never used it, but it's fairly slow. The seconds I counted match up with it being on the fifth floor, assuming it doesn't take very long for the doors to close and to start moving.
entries.literal: "Yes. I've never used it, but it's fairly slow. The seconds I counted match up with it being on the fifth floor, assuming it doesn't take very long for the doors to close and to start moving."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That would add five seconds at most.
entries.literal: "That would add five seconds at most."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Which is what I added. I tried to open the door as soon as the button lit up, but since it didn't budge, it must light up before the inner doors open.
entries.literal: "Which is what I added. I tried to open the door as soon as the button lit up, but since it didn't budge, it must light up before the inner doors open."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: But as you said, if someone stopped it before it got here, it would have taken longer. What if it was on the third floor and had someone stopped it on the second?
entries.literal: "But as you said, if someone stopped it before it got here, it would have taken longer. What if it was on the third floor and had someone stopped it on the second?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No. That whole process would've taken even longer.{w} If it wasn't on the fifth floor, the only way I could get the time I counted is if the door was open before I called it.{w} This is kind of batshit, but if someone kept the door open upstairs and closed it a few seconds after I called it, it would've started to go down later than I expected. That would have made it seem like it was higher.
entries.literal: "No. That whole process would've taken even longer.{w} If it wasn't on the fifth floor, the only way I could get the time I counted is if the door was open before I called it.{w} This is kind of batshit, but if someone kept the door open upstairs and closed it a few seconds after I called it, it would've started to go down later than I expected. That would have made it seem like it was higher."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: And why would anyone do that, let alone know when you called it?
entries.literal: "And why would anyone do that, let alone know when you called it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No idea, I'm just saying it's possible. Is there a light that indicates someone is trying to call it while the door's being kept open?
entries.literal: "No idea, I'm just saying it's possible. Is there a light that indicates someone is trying to call it while the door's being kept open?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No such thing exists.
entries.literal: "No such thing exists."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then it's incredibly unlikely that's what happened.
entries.literal: "Then it's incredibly unlikely that's what happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So it was on the fifth floor, right? There's no point in thinking too hard about this.
entries.literal: "So it was on the fifth floor, right? There's no point in thinking too hard about this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Incorrect. There's a very big inconsistency with the elevator being on the fifth floor, but it has to do with something I haven't mentioned yet. I imagined someone else would've figured it out, though.
entries.literal: "Incorrect. There's a very big inconsistency with the elevator being on the fifth floor, but it has to do with something I haven't mentioned yet. I imagined someone else would've figured it out, though."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What is it...?
entries.literal: "What is it...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I found it quite intriguing, and I wasn't gonna comment on it immediately if you hadn't brought the elevator up. Let me explain what I heard.
entries.literal: "I found it quite intriguing, and I wasn't gonna comment on it immediately if you hadn't brought the elevator up. Let me explain what I heard."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I was on the third floor, waiting right outside the offices. Imagine my surprise when I heard the elevator moving.
entries.literal: "I was on the third floor, waiting right outside the offices. Imagine my surprise when I heard the elevator moving."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait, the elevator moved?
entries.literal: "Wait, the elevator moved?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. Did nobody else hear it?
entries.literal: "Yes. Did nobody else hear it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For the third time, one of Sai's answers was received with silence. Personally, I hadn't heard anything.
entries.literal: "For the third time, one of Sai's answers was received with silence. Personally, I hadn't heard anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: See, what makes this weird is that I know I heard the elevator three times. Did not even one of you hear it?
entries.literal: "See, what makes this weird is that I know I heard the elevator three times. Did not even one of you hear it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No one had.
entries.literal: "No one had."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You heard it three times and didn't follow it?
entries.literal: "You heard it three times and didn't follow it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course not. I didn't know if it was going up or down, and we all agreed to stay put. I also didn't want to unwittingly bite some bait.
entries.literal: "Of course not. I didn't know if it was going up or down, and we all agreed to stay put. I also didn't want to unwittingly bite some bait."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Unfortunately, since there's no light that indicates the door's open on another floor, I couldn't know which floors it stopped on by counting the seconds as soon as I heard it moving.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, since there's no light that indicates the door's open on another floor, I couldn't know which floors it stopped on by counting the seconds as soon as I heard it moving."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: But three times? Surely something must've been happening.
entries.literal: "But three times? Surely something must've been happening."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who remained on each floor above me?
entries.literal: "Who remained on each floor above me?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Erina and Isla remained on the second floor, apparently you heard the elevator from the third, Akaro stayed on the fourth, Atsuki and Shiroya on the fifth, and I went up by myself to the sixth.
entries.literal: "...Erina and Isla remained on the second floor, apparently you heard the elevator from the third, Akaro stayed on the fourth, Atsuki and Shiroya on the fifth, and I went up by myself to the sixth."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And when you went down, everyone was still on their appropriate floors, correct?
entries.literal: "And when you went down, everyone was still on their appropriate floors, correct?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: A lot of things could've happened, but some people here have to be lying. After three trips, no matter where the elevator started from, anyone could've gone to a different floor and then back to their own.
entries.literal: "A lot of things could've happened, but some people here have to be lying. After three trips, no matter where the elevator started from, anyone could've gone to a different floor and then back to their own."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, two trips would be required, and the third one could've been them calling the elevator for the first time.
entries.literal: "Yes, two trips would be required, and the third one could've been them calling the elevator for the first time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's wrong. That order of events is impossible.
entries.literal: "That's wrong. That order of events is impossible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The elevator was on the fifth floor, right? I could've only heard someone who called it from below me. If Akaro called it from floor 4, I wouldn't have heard it.
entries.literal: "The elevator was on the fifth floor, right? I could've only heard someone who called it from below me. If Akaro called it from floor 4, I wouldn't have heard it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, if Erina and Isla called it and then I heard it two more times, the elevator would've stopped under me. And I just determined it was on the fifth. That couldn't have happened.
entries.literal: "So, if Erina and Isla called it and then I heard it two more times, the elevator would've stopped under me. And I just determined it was on the fifth. That couldn't have happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If anyone above me used it, I wouldn't have heard them calling it. The strange thing is that I heard it three times, and I'm sure of that.{w} This is the inconsistency here: even if someone above me used it, it would not have ended up on the fifth floor because I heard it three times.
entries.literal: "If anyone above me used it, I wouldn't have heard them calling it. The strange thing is that I heard it three times, and I'm sure of that.{w} This is the inconsistency here: even if someone above me used it, it would not have ended up on the fifth floor because I heard it three times."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was there initially, right? The first trip was the elevator going down, then it went up, and then down again. There is no other combination that works, of course. Despite that, the elevator ended up above me.
entries.literal: "It was there initially, right? The first trip was the elevator going down, then it went up, and then down again. There is no other combination that works, of course. Despite that, the elevator ended up above me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were a bit speechless, unaware of how to take all that.
entries.literal: "We were a bit speechless, unaware of how to take all that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Erina, Isla, and Akaro. Are you sure you didn't hear the elevator even once?
entries.literal: "Erina, Isla, and Akaro. Are you sure you didn't hear the elevator even once?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I didn't.
entries.literal: "I didn't."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Me neither, but the first time was almost unnoticeable, so it's possible we missed it. We were far away from it.
entries.literal: "...Me neither, but the first time was almost unnoticeable, so it's possible we missed it. We were far away from it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm sure I didn't hear it either.
entries.literal: "I'm sure I didn't hear it either."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the hell? I heard the elevator three times, so it had to be on floors 4 and 2 also three times.
entries.literal: "What the hell? I heard the elevator three times, so it had to be on floors 4 and 2 also three times."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Be honest. Are you just making this up? I'm sure I would've heard it at least once if it passed my floor multiple times.
entries.literal: "Be honest. Are you just making this up? I'm sure I would've heard it at least once if it passed my floor multiple times."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's a way you would've missed it only once, but it's almost as unlikely.
entries.literal: "There's a way you would've missed it only once, but it's almost as unlikely."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We understand, it couldn't have started on floor 5 if you heard it three times. So if you actually did, it must have been on floors 1 or 2 at the start.
entries.literal: "We understand, it couldn't have started on floor 5 if you heard it three times. So if you actually did, it must have been on floors 1 or 2 at the start."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: As an example, what if it was on the second floor and then went to the fourth? After that, from the fourth to the second, then from the second to the fifth.
entries.literal: "As an example, what if it was on the second floor and then went to the fourth? After that, from the fourth to the second, then from the second to the fifth."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Just now, we didn't hear any sound. We only knew the elevator was here because the button lit up. If it stops on your floor, you won't necessarily notice it.
entries.literal: "Just now, we didn't hear any sound. We only knew the elevator was here because the button lit up. If it stops on your floor, you won't necessarily notice it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm... So Erina and Isla couldn't have noticed it at all, and Akaro would only have had the chance to notice it when it went to the fifth.
entries.literal: "Hm... So Erina and Isla couldn't have noticed it at all, and Akaro would only have had the chance to notice it when it went to the fifth."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And we wouldn't have heard it either when it stopped on ours.
entries.literal: "And we wouldn't have heard it either when it stopped on ours."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well, hang on. This doesn't explain anything. Nobody got off on my floor.
entries.literal: "Well, hang on. This doesn't explain anything. Nobody got off on my floor."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I'm certain nobody got off on ours either. We were next to the offices, keeping an eye on the elevator from a bit away. We might've missed the button lighting up, but not someone getting out.
entries.literal: "...I'm certain nobody got off on ours either. We were next to the offices, keeping an eye on the elevator from a bit away. We might've missed the button lighting up, but not someone getting out."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, I get that. So whoever was inside the elevator didn't open the door when they came to a stop.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I get that. So whoever was inside the elevator didn't open the door when they came to a stop."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...And what would the purpose of doing that be? They're only alerting us that they're moving.
entries.literal: "...And what would the purpose of doing that be? They're only alerting us that they're moving."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know, but you should understand that hearing the elevator three times already confirms that someone moved the elevator before we started searching. It's confirming the presence of a ninth person.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but you should understand that hearing the elevator three times already confirms that someone moved the elevator before we started searching. It's confirming the presence of a ninth person."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It couldn't have been on the fifth floor, right? It was on one of the first two.{w} Why would someone move it like that when all it does is reveal them?
entries.literal: "It couldn't have been on the fifth floor, right? It was on one of the first two.{w} Why would someone move it like that when all it does is reveal them?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Maybe it really was on the fifth floor... It's not completely impossible.{w} You heard it three times, Sai, and that put it below you. When we all came back here, someone got out and sent it up to the fifth before we called it. We wouldn't have heard it no matter where it was.
entries.literal: "Maybe it really was on the fifth floor... It's not completely impossible.{w} You heard it three times, Sai, and that put it below you. When we all came back here, someone got out and sent it up to the fifth before we called it. We wouldn't have heard it no matter where it was."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It could also be that it moved four times and you missed one. That'd solve everything easily, excluding who moved it, of course.
entries.literal: "It could also be that it moved four times and you missed one. That'd solve everything easily, excluding who moved it, of course."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You know what I find to be the most likely scenario? That you're all deaf.
entries.literal: "You know what I find to be the most likely scenario? That you're all deaf."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: These situations you're all presenting are ridiculous, so let me detail what probably happened.
entries.literal: "These situations you're all presenting are ridiculous, so let me detail what probably happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: When I entered the storeroom and found the Sekimeiya, the rest of you remained in this hallway, next to the elevator. Someone, probably Katei, called it here knowing it'd be unnoticeable.
entries.literal: "When I entered the storeroom and found the Sekimeiya, the rest of you remained in this hallway, next to the elevator. Someone, probably Katei, called it here knowing it'd be unnoticeable."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Excuse me...! Are you blaming me again for something that doesn't make sense?
entries.literal: "Excuse me...! Are you blaming me again for something that doesn't make sense?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. It could've been Akaro, Atsuki, or Shiroya—anyone who later searched above me.
entries.literal: "Yes. It could've been Akaro, Atsuki, or Shiroya—anyone who later searched above me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe someone wanted to create the illusion that it was impossible for anyone above me to use the elevator. I don't know.
entries.literal: "Maybe someone wanted to create the illusion that it was impossible for anyone above me to use the elevator. I don't know."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But this relies on knowing that we'd separate across the floors, all our positions, and that you'd both hear the elevator and not follow it.
entries.literal: "But this relies on knowing that we'd separate across the floors, all our positions, and that you'd both hear the elevator and not follow it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not too plausible, is it? It's also possible some hidden culprit moved it down before our search started, but the truth of the matter remains that we looked through this entire building and found nobody else. The sound we heard is no confirmation of anything.
entries.literal: "Not too plausible, is it? It's also possible some hidden culprit moved it down before our search started, but the truth of the matter remains that we looked through this entire building and found nobody else. The sound we heard is no confirmation of anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Once we were all in place, Katei used the elevator. He first called it up to the sixth floor, which I heard. Then, he took it down.
entries.literal: "Once we were all in place, Katei used the elevator. He first called it up to the sixth floor, which I heard. Then, he took it down."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nobody saw the elevator stopping on their floor, but that's fine if he stopped here. I heard it three times no matter what happened, so that means it went down at least once. Since Erina and Isla didn't see anyone coming out, the times it went down must've been to the crystal floor.{w} Afterward, Katei took it back up, to the sixth. He knew it should've initially been on the fifth, so he sent it back there.
entries.literal: "Nobody saw the elevator stopping on their floor, but that's fine if he stopped here. I heard it three times no matter what happened, so that means it went down at least once. Since Erina and Isla didn't see anyone coming out, the times it went down must've been to the crystal floor.{w} Afterward, Katei took it back up, to the sixth. He knew it should've initially been on the fifth, so he sent it back there."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's not at all what happened, and I would've noticed that the elevator was far below me with how long it would take to arrive. I just can't wait to show you the security footage once this is all over and see the look on your face.
entries.literal: "That's not at all what happened, and I would've noticed that the elevator was far below me with how long it would take to arrive. I just can't wait to show you the security footage once this is all over and see the look on your face."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I also really don't believe we would've missed the elevator three times.
entries.literal: "I also really don't believe we would've missed the elevator three times."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya's right. Even if it was a faint sound, we were paying attention right next to it.
entries.literal: "Shiroya's right. Even if it was a faint sound, we were paying attention right next to it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I agree. No way we would have missed it.
entries.literal: "I agree. No way we would have missed it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...All I can say is that we didn't hear anything and nobody stopped on the second floor.
entries.literal: "...All I can say is that we didn't hear anything and nobody stopped on the second floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's clear as day, isn't it? He's just making this up.
entries.literal: "It's clear as day, isn't it? He's just making this up."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Most likely. The elevator was where it should've been, after all. There's probably no inconsistency.
entries.literal: "Most likely. The elevator was where it should've been, after all. There's probably no inconsistency."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Just in case, all of you take a hearing test after we're out. At least one of you has to be lying—that's for sure.
entries.literal: "Just in case, all of you take a hearing test after we're out. At least one of you has to be lying—that's for sure."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: According to what you heard, someone got off here, right?
entries.literal: "According to what you heard, someone got off here, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, and we know what the reason would be. We didn't lock the cabinet the last time, so someone must've realized they had a free path to the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Yes, and we know what the reason would be. We didn't lock the cabinet the last time, so someone must've realized they had a free path to the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Let's see if it's there, then. If it's not, that'll give you some credibility.
entries.literal: "Let's see if it's there, then. If it's not, that'll give you some credibility."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course. We're in front of the stairs, so there was no reason to hurry. Let's see what we find.
entries.literal: "Of course. We're in front of the stairs, so there was no reason to hurry. Let's see what we find."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That time, all of us went to the event room. We'd just looked through every single floor, and even though some things still didn't make sense, it felt pointless to guard the exit.
entries.literal: "That time, all of us went to the event room. We'd just looked through every single floor, and even though some things still didn't make sense, it felt pointless to guard the exit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered through hallway A. As soon as we set foot inside, the status of the Sekimeiya became apparent.
entries.literal: "We entered through hallway A. As soon as we set foot inside, the status of the Sekimeiya became apparent."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: See? It's still here! Nobody came down at all.
entries.literal: "See? It's still here! Nobody came down at all."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's what I thought. You're just trying to have a bit too much fun.
entries.literal: "That's what I thought. You're just trying to have a bit too much fun."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's true, but I did definitely hear the elevator, so I'm not sure what happened. They might've had another reason to come here.
entries.literal: "That's true, but I did definitely hear the elevator, so I'm not sure what happened. They might've had another reason to come here."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm confused. Do you think it was one of us or someone we still haven't found?
entries.literal: "I'm confused. Do you think it was one of us or someone we still haven't found?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who fucking knows? If it was one of us, it could have only been someone who was above me and is still lying.
entries.literal: "Who fucking knows? If it was one of us, it could have only been someone who was above me and is still lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If it was someone else, there's one extremely tight explanation: unless someone is still working with the culprit, they would need to have been inside the elevator from the beginning.{w} The elevator would've been below me and not where it was left, but then all its movements become useless.
entries.literal: "If it was someone else, there's one extremely tight explanation: unless someone is still working with the culprit, they would need to have been inside the elevator from the beginning.{w} The elevator would've been below me and not where it was left, but then all its movements become useless."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You might just be mistaken about the goal. Yes, if they wanted to come down here, there was no reason to ever send the elevator up. There's not much reason for someone to stay down here, though.{w} What you heard could've been someone going up to the attic. They get to hole up there and nobody sees anyone coming out.
entries.literal: "You might just be mistaken about the goal. Yes, if they wanted to come down here, there was no reason to ever send the elevator up. There's not much reason for someone to stay down here, though.{w} What you heard could've been someone going up to the attic. They get to hole up there and nobody sees anyone coming out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So this person was in the attic, which is why we didn't find them. From there, they called the empty elevator up, went down once, and finally back to the attic again. Is that it?
entries.literal: "So this person was in the attic, which is why we didn't find them. From there, they called the empty elevator up, went down once, and finally back to the attic again. Is that it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe, but I have no idea what the purpose would be. They also would have sent it to the fifth again. It'd explain why we didn't find anyone, and nobody would have to be lying.
entries.literal: "Maybe, but I have no idea what the purpose would be. They also would have sent it to the fifth again. It'd explain why we didn't find anyone, and nobody would have to be lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You'd all still be deaf, and why would the culprit come here from the attic if they'd been here just minutes prior? Surely this same person made the noise we heard?
entries.literal: "You'd all still be deaf, and why would the culprit come here from the attic if they'd been here just minutes prior? Surely this same person made the noise we heard?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is risky anyway. If anyone from below entered the elevator before they called it back up, you could make it to the attic without the need for the key.
entries.literal: "This is risky anyway. If anyone from below entered the elevator before they called it back up, you could make it to the attic without the need for the key."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I guess so...{w} Meaning that it's really difficult to explain this unless one of us is lying.
entries.literal: "I guess so...{w} Meaning that it's really difficult to explain this unless one of us is lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And conveniently, we know of someone who's been lying from the beginning.
entries.literal: "And conveniently, we know of someone who's been lying from the beginning."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Talking about yourself, or Atsuki?
entries.literal: "Talking about yourself, or Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not sure what to think anymore. If the Sekimeiya's still here, there's no reason to come down in such a risky manner.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure what to think anymore. If the Sekimeiya's still here, there's no reason to come down in such a risky manner."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unfortunately, even though I was allowed to reason things out with time travel in mind, it didn't make them any easier. The issue of the motive was just as hard to settle despite the fact that I could create even more theories.
