entries.literal: "Unfortunately, even though I was allowed to reason things out with time travel in mind, it didn't make them any easier. The issue of the motive was just as hard to settle despite the fact that I could create even more theories."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could suppose that someone was inside the elevator on the crystal floor and went to the attic. Then, the same person time traveled to the crystal floor. They wanted to go to the attic again, so they called the elevator and went back up.{w} It had significant risk, but it was another way to justify the likely truth of being lied to.
entries.literal: "I could suppose that someone was inside the elevator on the crystal floor and went to the attic. Then, the same person time traveled to the crystal floor. They wanted to go to the attic again, so they called the elevator and went back up.{w} It had significant risk, but it was another way to justify the likely truth of being lied to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai looked at his watch and turned his wrist to show us the time. It was {time=11:20}, and right above it, the date was also shown: 2011-12-15.
entries.literal: "Sai looked at his watch and turned his wrist to show us the time. It was {time=11:20}, and right above it, the date was also shown: 2011-12-15."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...It's been a pretty eventful couple hours. I wonder if we'll be able to figure everything out before our time runs out.
entries.literal: "...It's been a pretty eventful couple hours. I wonder if we'll be able to figure everything out before our time runs out."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Who cares about that? The police will investigate what happened a lot better than we can. We shouldn't keep overstepping this much.
entries.literal: "Who cares about that? The police will investigate what happened a lot better than we can. We shouldn't keep overstepping this much."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They'll definitely question all of us. Not every camera works, so their understanding of what happens here will depend pretty heavily on our testimony.
entries.literal: "They'll definitely question all of us. Not every camera works, so their understanding of what happens here will depend pretty heavily on our testimony."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, whose mood had greatly diminished over time, was quietly looking at the Sekimeiya through the glass. Her friend's prediction ended up entirely incorrect, and Erina made an attempt to comfort her.
entries.literal: "Isla, whose mood had greatly diminished over time, was quietly looking at the Sekimeiya through the glass. Her friend's prediction ended up entirely incorrect, and Erina made an attempt to comfort her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Right as the atmosphere seemed to calm down a bit, something that we'd already experienced repeated itself.
entries.literal: "Right as the atmosphere seemed to calm down a bit, something that we'd already experienced repeated itself."

entries.text: The Third Law
entries.literal: "The Third Law"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What the hell was that...!?
entries.literal: "What the hell was that...!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I think it was a door closing again, but slightly quieter.
entries.literal: "I think it was a door closing again, but slightly quieter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had no time to rest. We knew that a foreign sound implied another long search if we didn't get results immediately.
entries.literal: "We had no time to rest. We knew that a foreign sound implied another long search if we didn't get results immediately."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since it hadn't come from close by, we didn't rush out like the previous time. Instead, Sai approached hallway A and opened the door.
entries.literal: "Since it hadn't come from close by, we didn't rush out like the previous time. Instead, Sai approached hallway A and opened the door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We can see the exit from hallway A. Splitting up was useless last time and only caused more questions, so let's stick together while making sure the exit is being guarded.
entries.literal: "We can see the exit from hallway A. Splitting up was useless last time and only caused more questions, so let's stick together while making sure the exit is being guarded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For the first sound, we'd all rushed to the right door because it seemed like it came from hallway B. However, the location of what we'd just heard was harder to discern.
entries.literal: "For the first sound, we'd all rushed to the right door because it seemed like it came from hallway B. However, the location of what we'd just heard was harder to discern."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We'll stay next to the stairs.
entries.literal: "We'll stay next to the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla didn't object. She already understood that we weren't playing around.{w} The procedure of opening every room started once again.
entries.literal: "Isla didn't object. She already understood that we weren't playing around.{w} The procedure of opening every room started once again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since the sound was distant, it was very possible the source was no longer on our floor. Regardless, we couldn't move any faster because so many rooms had cabinets where a person could hide.
entries.literal: "Since the sound was distant, it was very possible the source was no longer on our floor. Regardless, we couldn't move any faster because so many rooms had cabinets where a person could hide."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every door in hallway A was opened and closed until we acknowledged each room was empty. Since Erina and Isla were by the stairs, we moved on to hallway B after Akaro claimed the mechanical room was vacant too.
entries.literal: "Every door in hallway A was opened and closed until we acknowledged each room was empty. Since Erina and Isla were by the stairs, we moved on to hallway B after Akaro claimed the mechanical room was vacant too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We didn't relent despite quickly running out of rooms. The last time we'd gotten complacent, a body had suddenly appeared.{w} The event room, acting as the midpoint of the hallway, still stored the Sekimeiya. ...If a culprit remained with us, they were trapped within the few last rooms.
entries.literal: "We didn't relent despite quickly running out of rooms. The last time we'd gotten complacent, a body had suddenly appeared.{w} The event room, acting as the midpoint of the hallway, still stored the Sekimeiya. ...If a culprit remained with us, they were trapped within the few last rooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, nothing was found inside them. The room where Naomi had died, the last crystal rooms, the staff room, and the cleaning room were all devoid of life.
entries.literal: "However, nothing was found inside them. The room where Naomi had died, the last crystal rooms, the staff room, and the cleaning room were all devoid of life."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: How does this keep happening!? There must be someone else here!
entries.literal: "How does this keep happening!? There must be someone else here!"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Maybe it's a ghost?
entries.literal: "Maybe it's a ghost?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: A ghost, huh? That'd explain a lot.
entries.literal: "A ghost, huh? That'd explain a lot."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Ghosts don't exist. This is two times we've heard a noise, so it's clear a person caused them.
entries.literal: "Ghosts don't exist. This is two times we've heard a noise, so it's clear a person caused them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I figured Isla was serious. We were chasing behind someone who could vanish, make sounds without being seen, commit crimes in front of security cameras, and create innumerable questions doing so.
entries.literal: "I figured Isla was serious. We were chasing behind someone who could vanish, make sounds without being seen, commit crimes in front of security cameras, and create innumerable questions doing so."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do we actually have to investigate upstairs again? Why don't we stop playing with the culprit and let the police handle this?
entries.literal: "Do we actually have to investigate upstairs again? Why don't we stop playing with the culprit and let the police handle this?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Because I'm not fond of that idea. They made a sound twice and then disappeared. They must be conscious of what they're doing, so let's go up again without splitting up. We'll leave the elevator open here so that they can't use it.
entries.literal: "Because I'm not fond of that idea. They made a sound twice and then disappeared. They must be conscious of what they're doing, so let's go up again without splitting up. We'll leave the elevator open here so that they can't use it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait...{w} We're forgetting one place again.
entries.literal: "Wait...{w} We're forgetting one place again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are we?{w} ...Oh, right. The bathrooms.
entries.literal: "Are we?{w} ...Oh, right. The bathrooms."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...That's true. And nobody could've left them yet.
entries.literal: "...That's true. And nobody could've left them yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The map indicated that the left door was the women's and the right one the men's. We walked up to them while Erina and Isla blocked access to the other floors.
entries.literal: "The map indicated that the left door was the women's and the right one the men's. We walked up to them while Erina and Isla blocked access to the other floors."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya went ahead and opened the women's bathroom; it was completely empty.
entries.literal: "Shiroya went ahead and opened the women's bathroom; it was completely empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, Sai grabbed the opposite knob and turned it to open its door.{w}{w=0.5} ...He seemed to be having trouble.
entries.literal: "Then, Sai grabbed the opposite knob and turned it to open its door.{w}{w=0.5} ...He seemed to be having trouble."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I don't think I can open this.
entries.literal: "...I don't think I can open this."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What? Is the door locked?
entries.literal: "What? Is the door locked?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It could be. You can lock it from the inside without a key.
entries.literal: "It could be. You can lock it from the inside without a key."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Are you sure it's locked? Try turning it the other way.
entries.literal: "Are you sure it's locked? Try turning it the other way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai didn't even try it. He was clearly sure it wouldn't open and caught the implication of what Katei said.
entries.literal: "Sai didn't even try it. He was clearly sure it wouldn't open and caught the implication of what Katei said."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's someone inside...?
entries.literal: "There's someone inside...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I-I suppose there must be.{w} Hey! Open the door, you don't have any way to escape!
entries.literal: "I-I suppose there must be.{w} Hey! Open the door, you don't have any way to escape!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd all seen the interior of that bathroom once before. There was nothing that could serve as a way out, so even if someone inside intended to wait us out, the police would end up breaking the door down.
entries.literal: "We'd all seen the interior of that bathroom once before. There was nothing that could serve as a way out, so even if someone inside intended to wait us out, the police would end up breaking the door down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai crouched, trying to see through the gap.
entries.literal: "Sai crouched, trying to see through the gap."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's barely any space. I was hoping I could see shoes or something.
entries.literal: "There's barely any space. I was hoping I could see shoes or something."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Can you open the door for us, Katei?
entries.literal: "Can you open the door for us, Katei?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Hm... Now that you mention it, I might be able to.
entries.literal: "Hm... Now that you mention it, I might be able to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a keyhole next to the doorknob, so it was possible to unlock the door without the manual inner lock.
entries.literal: "There was a keyhole next to the doorknob, so it was possible to unlock the door without the manual inner lock."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There's a key that unlocks all the bathrooms. We have it in case an accident happens or someone locks themselves inside for too long, but I've never used it.
entries.literal: "There's a key that unlocks all the bathrooms. We have it in case an accident happens or someone locks themselves inside for too long, but I've never used it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Which also means that someone with that key could've locked the door from outside.
entries.literal: "Which also means that someone with that key could've locked the door from outside."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. It's not a guarantee that someone is still inside.
entries.literal: "Yes. It's not a guarantee that someone is still inside."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Every employee should have a key. I'll go check if I can find one in the security room. I think I recall seeing it in a drawer.
entries.literal: "Every employee should have a key. I'll go check if I can find one in the security room. I think I recall seeing it in a drawer."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Okay. We'll wait here.
entries.literal: "Okay. We'll wait here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei went off to hallway A while the rest of us remained in front of the door.
entries.literal: "Katei went off to hallway A while the rest of us remained in front of the door."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'll bring this to the security room. I don't want it to stay here.
entries.literal: "I'll bring this to the security room. I don't want it to stay here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On his way, he grabbed the empty suitcase and disappeared with it. It didn't seem like a bad idea, because it would make it harder for the culprit if they wanted to retrieve it at some point.
entries.literal: "On his way, he grabbed the empty suitcase and disappeared with it. It didn't seem like a bad idea, because it would make it harder for the culprit if they wanted to retrieve it at some point."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...So, if there's nobody inside, it'll mean that Naomi's killer likely took the bathroom key from her alongside the cabinet's.
entries.literal: "...So, if there's nobody inside, it'll mean that Naomi's killer likely took the bathroom key from her alongside the cabinet's."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: And you think Katei did it, right?
entries.literal: "And you think Katei did it, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If I had to pick somebody, it'd be him. I wonder if he had the key on him the whole time and wants to act like he found it in the security room.
entries.literal: "If I had to pick somebody, it'd be him. I wonder if he had the key on him the whole time and wants to act like he found it in the security room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Didn't he ask to search everyone earlier? We could've found it.
entries.literal: "Didn't he ask to search everyone earlier? We could've found it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, but at that point, this door wasn't locked yet. He might not have planned to use it later, and even if we found it, he could have lied to us about what it was.
entries.literal: "Yes, but at that point, this door wasn't locked yet. He might not have planned to use it later, and even if we found it, he could have lied to us about what it was."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: But he couldn't have locked this door, could he? That had to be related to the sound we just heard.
entries.literal: "But he couldn't have locked this door, could he? That had to be related to the sound we just heard."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He definitely had a chance. It's likely someone above floor 3 took the elevator here, remember? Katei was on floor 6 and is the most likely person to have killed Naomi.
entries.literal: "He definitely had a chance. It's likely someone above floor 3 took the elevator here, remember? Katei was on floor 6 and is the most likely person to have killed Naomi."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He just said that every employee has one of these keys, so whoever locked the door could have gotten it from somewhere else.
entries.literal: "He just said that every employee has one of these keys, so whoever locked the door could have gotten it from somewhere else."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's true, but everything keeps casting more and more doubt on Katei. First, let's see if anyone's inside. If we don't find anyone, Katei will be the most likely suspect once again.
entries.literal: "That's true, but everything keeps casting more and more doubt on Katei. First, let's see if anyone's inside. If we don't find anyone, Katei will be the most likely suspect once again."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Why do you think so? Even if nobody's inside, he must've been trying to hide something by locking this door. He wouldn't have told us how to unlock it.
entries.literal: "...Why do you think so? Even if nobody's inside, he must've been trying to hide something by locking this door. He wouldn't have told us how to unlock it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Assuming he comes back with the key. The other possibility is that we're still dealing with an unknown person, someone who took the key off Naomi and wants us to spend a while in front of an empty bathroom...
entries.literal: "Assuming he comes back with the key. The other possibility is that we're still dealing with an unknown person, someone who took the key off Naomi and wants us to spend a while in front of an empty bathroom..."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm... It's the smell again...
entries.literal: "Hm... It's the smell again..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Smell? ...Oh, you're right. It's hard to tell, but it's there. The same as before.
entries.literal: "Smell? ...Oh, you're right. It's hard to tell, but it's there. The same as before."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You say that, but I don't think it ever faded away. I've been noticing it the entire time I looked through these rooms.
entries.literal: "You say that, but I don't think it ever faded away. I've been noticing it the entire time I looked through these rooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all visibly sniffed the air. I didn't notice it greatly, but I could somewhat pick out the strange smell from before. Shortly after that, we spotted Katei coming from the hallway. As soon as he made eye contact with us, he showed us a silver key in his hand.
entries.literal: "We all visibly sniffed the air. I didn't notice it greatly, but I could somewhat pick out the strange smell from before. Shortly after that, we spotted Katei coming from the hallway. As soon as he made eye contact with us, he showed us a silver key in his hand."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I was... not doing too well the first time we noticed it, but I feel like I've smelled this before.
entries.literal: "I was... not doing too well the first time we noticed it, but I feel like I've smelled this before."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Really...? I don't feel that way at all.
entries.literal: "Really...? I don't feel that way at all."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I think it's this one.
entries.literal: "I think it's this one."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm, it's not like any that Naomi had.
entries.literal: "Hm, it's not like any that Naomi had."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh? Of course not. This doesn't mean that her key must've been stolen, if that's what you're thinking. I doubt any employee would always have theirs, seeing as we never need them.
entries.literal: "Oh? Of course not. This doesn't mean that her key must've been stolen, if that's what you're thinking. I doubt any employee would always have theirs, seeing as we never need them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Fine. Just try to open the door.
entries.literal: "Fine. Just try to open the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei sighed and inserted the key. It turned, showing that he'd picked the correct one.{w} The door made a clearly audible sound, and Katei proceeded to gently open it.
entries.literal: "Katei sighed and inserted the key. It turned, showing that he'd picked the correct one.{w} The door made a clearly audible sound, and Katei proceeded to gently open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once we saw what awaited inside, all of us froze, failing to comprehend what we were looking at.
entries.literal: "Once we saw what awaited inside, all of us froze, failing to comprehend what we were looking at."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What the fuck...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Th-This is impossible...
entries.literal: "Th-This is impossible..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all must've experienced a strong feeling of déjà vu.{w} On the floor of the men's bathroom lay Naomi's unmoving body.
entries.literal: "We all must've experienced a strong feeling of déjà vu.{w} On the floor of the men's bathroom lay Naomi's unmoving body."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instinctively, Erina ushered Isla aside, but she had already seen what was in the room.
entries.literal: "Instinctively, Erina ushered Isla aside, but she had already seen what was in the room."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Why the hell would anyone lock her body in here?
entries.literal: "...Why the hell would anyone lock her body in here?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Lock her body in? Didn't we just look at it a second ago?
entries.literal: "...Lock her body in? Didn't we just look at it a second ago?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was right. We'd entered the room where Naomi died and seen her.
entries.literal: "She was right. We'd entered the room where Naomi died and seen her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Or had we? Had we perhaps only seen the curtain that should've been covering her...? Everyone else was likely thinking the same, but Sai instructed us to take it slow.
entries.literal: "Or had we? Had we perhaps only seen the curtain that should've been covering her...? Everyone else was likely thinking the same, but Sai instructed us to take it slow."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hold on. We can see that room from here, so there's no point in running to it. There's no security camera in the bathroom, so we need to make sure we don't miss anything right now.
entries.literal: "Hold on. We can see that room from here, so there's no point in running to it. There's no security camera in the bathroom, so we need to make sure we don't miss anything right now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It felt like a pointless attempt, but I crouched to check Naomi's pulse like Sai did the first time.{w} I felt nothing.
entries.literal: "It felt like a pointless attempt, but I crouched to check Naomi's pulse like Sai did the first time.{w} I felt nothing."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What are you doing? Did you think she might've revived?
entries.literal: "What are you doing? Did you think she might've revived?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No... but this isn't right. There should be a bit of blood oozing from her, shouldn't there? But there's none. And the floor... it's completely clean.
entries.literal: "No... but this isn't right. There should be a bit of blood oozing from her, shouldn't there? But there's none. And the floor... it's completely clean."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What...? You're right—there's no blood at all.
entries.literal: "What...? You're right—there's no blood at all."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: At least this confirms that the lock wasn't set from the inside. Someone locked her inside with the key.
entries.literal: "At least this confirms that the lock wasn't set from the inside. Someone locked her inside with the key."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's nothing else here... We need to check the other body.
entries.literal: "There's nothing else here... We need to check the other body."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all ran to room B4 except for Erina and Isla, who stayed guarding the bathrooms and in sight of the stairs. In hallway B, in front of the event room, Naomi had died. We'd left her body under a curtain to preserve her dignity...
entries.literal: "We all ran to room B4 except for Erina and Isla, who stayed guarding the bathrooms and in sight of the stairs. In hallway B, in front of the event room, Naomi had died. We'd left her body under a curtain to preserve her dignity..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai forcibly opened the door. In very quick succession, another impossibility immediately appeared before us.
entries.literal: "Sai forcibly opened the door. In very quick succession, another impossibility immediately appeared before us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cloth's sides had been tainted by blood, which was all around it. In the middle of the huge, red circle was a bulge the size of a human.
entries.literal: "The cloth's sides had been tainted by blood, which was all around it. In the middle of the huge, red circle was a bulge the size of a human."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It can't be... She's still here.
entries.literal: "It can't be... She's still here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We couldn't form a response. Her body was still beneath the curtain.
entries.literal: "We couldn't form a response. Her body was still beneath the curtain."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It appears Atsuki was correct, then. Something very out of the ordinary is going on.
entries.literal: "It appears Atsuki was correct, then. Something very out of the ordinary is going on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai ran out of breath at the end of his sentence. Not even he could easily fathom it.
entries.literal: "Sai ran out of breath at the end of his sentence. Not even he could easily fathom it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He approached the body and gently removed the curtain from it. The result was what we'd expected, yet it still seemed impossible. Naomi's corpse hadn't moved in the slightest.
entries.literal: "He approached the body and gently removed the curtain from it. The result was what we'd expected, yet it still seemed impossible. Naomi's corpse hadn't moved in the slightest."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the hell is this...?
entries.literal: "What the hell is this...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, let's get this out of the way. Does Naomi have a fucking twin?
entries.literal: "Katei, let's get this out of the way. Does Naomi have a fucking twin?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: U-Um... Not that I know. I wasn't close enough to her.
entries.literal: "U-Um... Not that I know. I wasn't close enough to her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: A-A twin wouldn't explain this. Look here.
entries.literal: "A-A twin wouldn't explain this. Look here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her suit had a product label by its neck, containing four numbers.
entries.literal: "Her suit had a product label by its neck, containing four numbers."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: 63-22? Was it the same in the bathroom?
entries.literal: "63-22? Was it the same in the bathroom?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Yes. I saw it when I felt for her pulse. Katei, you know Ashiya. Is that just a model number or something?
entries.literal: "...Yes. I saw it when I felt for her pulse. Katei, you know Ashiya. Is that just a model number or something?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...It isn't. Those are individual product run numbers.
entries.literal: "...It isn't. Those are individual product run numbers."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then this is the exact same suit.
entries.literal: "Then this is the exact same suit."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So there's... no doubt that Atsuki was telling the truth. The killer used the Sekimeiya's powers to do this.
entries.literal: "So there's... no doubt that Atsuki was telling the truth. The killer used the Sekimeiya's powers to do this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei could no longer deny it; two identical dead bodies had appeared before him.
entries.literal: "Katei could no longer deny it; two identical dead bodies had appeared before him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still in the cabinet, so they must've returned it...
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was still in the cabinet, so they must've returned it..."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...A-All right. According to you guys, the Sekimeiya made Atsuki time travel. How would traveling through time lead to this?
entries.literal: "...A-All right. According to you guys, the Sekimeiya made Atsuki time travel. How would traveling through time lead to this?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We don't know how it works. There might be more to it than it first seemed, but just consider this... What would happen if you tried to make a dead body time travel?
entries.literal: "We don't know how it works. There might be more to it than it first seemed, but just consider this... What would happen if you tried to make a dead body time travel?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Normally, you'd think nothing would happen, but what if the dead body actually traveled through time?
entries.literal: "Normally, you'd think nothing would happen, but what if the dead body actually traveled through time?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-Yeah... Someone might've made Naomi's body time travel by touching it with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Y-Yeah... Someone might've made Naomi's body time travel by touching it with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If they knew Naomi would appear in the bathroom, they could've locked it preemptively. If not, maybe they just moved the identical body inside and locked it. That has to be related to that noise we heard.
entries.literal: "If they knew Naomi would appear in the bathroom, they could've locked it preemptively. If not, maybe they just moved the identical body inside and locked it. That has to be related to that noise we heard."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: An identical body... We should inspect it more thoroughly. We don't know what happened, but that other Naomi might have something important on her.
entries.literal: "An identical body... We should inspect it more thoroughly. We don't know what happened, but that other Naomi might have something important on her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We didn't have much else we could do to figure anything out, so we went back to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "We didn't have much else we could do to figure anything out, so we went back to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other Naomi hadn't moved.
entries.literal: "The other Naomi hadn't moved."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me check...
entries.literal: "Let me check..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I watched Sai carefully to make sure he couldn't do anything in secret. All he did was check every pocket, and they were all empty.
entries.literal: "I watched Sai carefully to make sure he couldn't do anything in secret. All he did was check every pocket, and they were all empty."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh... She doesn't have any keys. Not even the keys that the other body had.
entries.literal: "Huh... She doesn't have any keys. Not even the keys that the other body had."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So that theory was probably wrong. If whoever did this created an identical body in the past, it would've had the same keys.
entries.literal: "So that theory was probably wrong. If whoever did this created an identical body in the past, it would've had the same keys."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-If that's how it worked... I'd think so.
entries.literal: "I-If that's how it worked... I'd think so."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Couldn't the culprit just have taken them?
entries.literal: "Couldn't the culprit just have taken them?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But why? They didn't take them from the original body.
entries.literal: "But why? They didn't take them from the original body."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There are two more things that don't hold up.{w} The clothes are the first. If Naomi's body traveled to the past, her clothes would've been stained with blood, just like they were at the time it traveled.{w} And second: you all saw me vanish when it happened to me, right? If the same thing happened to Naomi, the first body should've disappeared.
entries.literal: "There are two more things that don't hold up.{w} The clothes are the first. If Naomi's body traveled to the past, her clothes would've been stained with blood, just like they were at the time it traveled.{w} And second: you all saw me vanish when it happened to me, right? If the same thing happened to Naomi, the first body should've disappeared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Technically, with how little we knew, my points could've still been refuted.
entries.literal: "Technically, with how little we knew, my points could've still been refuted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "What if the replica of the body only takes into consideration the state of the body in the past?"{w} With the way I'd traveled, I couldn't be sure whether my then-present body had teleported into the past, or if the body I'd arrived in was identical to how it was at the point in time I appeared.
entries.literal: "\"What if the replica of the body only takes into consideration the state of the body in the past?\"{w} With the way I'd traveled, I couldn't be sure whether my then-present body had teleported into the past, or if the body I'd arrived in was identical to how it was at the point in time I appeared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If Naomi had gone back to the past far enough, to a point before her death, her clothes might've been clean. Even though she was alive at that point, if the body that had traveled was dead, she probably would've appeared dead in the past. ...Otherwise, she would have come back to life.
entries.literal: "If Naomi had gone back to the past far enough, to a point before her death, her clothes might've been clean. Even though she was alive at that point, if the body that had traveled was dead, she probably would've appeared dead in the past. ...Otherwise, she would have come back to life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It also implied that the second body had been with us in the tower before we'd found the first one and had only just been shown to us. ...Given how we'd been unable to find the culprit, it couldn't be ruled out.
entries.literal: "It also implied that the second body had been with us in the tower before we'd found the first one and had only just been shown to us. ...Given how we'd been unable to find the culprit, it couldn't be ruled out."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is there another way to make this work? I've thought of a few things involving time travel, but now we have no other choice. There's nothing else that could begin to explain this, so what I went through has to be related to the truth of what happened.
entries.literal: "Is there another way to make this work? I've thought of a few things involving time travel, but now we have no other choice. There's nothing else that could begin to explain this, so what I went through has to be related to the truth of what happened."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This body is dead, but there's no blood around it. Could it be that she appeared dead from the future and that's why no blood is anywhere? That her body is as it was when she was alive, yet her true state is from after her death?
entries.literal: "This body is dead, but there's no blood around it. Could it be that she appeared dead from the future and that's why no blood is anywhere? That her body is as it was when she was alive, yet her true state is from after her death?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The only other thing I can think of slightly contradicts my own experience, but it'd sound more believable if not for that.
entries.literal: "The only other thing I can think of slightly contradicts my own experience, but it'd sound more believable if not for that."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It would only require the past to be malleable. I didn't personally change anything when I traveled back in time, but that's not enough reason to think that's impossible.
entries.literal: "It would only require the past to be malleable. I didn't personally change anything when I traveled back in time, but that's not enough reason to think that's impossible."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What if Naomi traveled back in time when she was alive? Two of them would've existed in the past. Then, all the culprit needed to do was kill both of them.
entries.literal: "What if Naomi traveled back in time when she was alive? Two of them would've existed in the past. Then, all the culprit needed to do was kill both of them."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This should never be possible; it's a paradox. By killing the Naomi who will travel to the past, you're making it impossible for the new one to exist.
entries.literal: "This should never be possible; it's a paradox. By killing the Naomi who will travel to the past, you're making it impossible for the new one to exist."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But I don't know if these kinds of paradoxes exist. What if Naomi's actions upon traveling made it impossible for her initial self to travel? Two of them would permanently exist at the same time, and us finding two dead bodies would work.
entries.literal: "But I don't know if these kinds of paradoxes exist. What if Naomi's actions upon traveling made it impossible for her initial self to travel? Two of them would permanently exist at the same time, and us finding two dead bodies would work."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, if this isn't a possible occurrence in our universe, I can't think of anything else. The mere fact that traveling makes your body instantly disappear means that, without paradoxes, two of the same person couldn't exist at once as corpses.
entries.literal: "However, if this isn't a possible occurrence in our universe, I can't think of anything else. The mere fact that traveling makes your body instantly disappear means that, without paradoxes, two of the same person couldn't exist at once as corpses."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: To circumvent the paradox, I can suppose that a dead body can travel to the past and create a new dead body. This still hits the barrier of "the original body should've disappeared as soon as it traveled", but it's not absolute: maybe the first dead body will travel back in the future, and that's why it's still there.
entries.literal: "To circumvent the paradox, I can suppose that a dead body can travel to the past and create a new dead body. This still hits the barrier of \"the original body should've disappeared as soon as it traveled\", but it's not absolute: maybe the first dead body will travel back in the future, and that's why it's still there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And on top of all this, there has to be a motive. A motive for all of this to be happening. For a culprit to create this mess, to kill the same person twice, and for something with time traveling powers to be publicly exposed in this place. Is Xyn actually behind it...?
entries.literal: "And on top of all this, there has to be a motive. A motive for all of this to be happening. For a culprit to create this mess, to kill the same person twice, and for something with time traveling powers to be publicly exposed in this place. Is Xyn actually behind it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody had said anything in a while. We were all dumbfounded, staring at the impossible image.
entries.literal: "Nobody had said anything in a while. We were all dumbfounded, staring at the impossible image."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm, that's interesting.{w} She has a bump on the back of her head. It's similar to her other body, but blood's not coming out of this one.
entries.literal: "Hm, that's interesting.{w} She has a bump on the back of her head. It's similar to her other body, but blood's not coming out of this one."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Is that so?{w} Then this body isn't the same as when she was alive despite the lack of blood.
entries.literal: "...Is that so?{w} Then this body isn't the same as when she was alive despite the lack of blood."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's go test it. Let's try to understand how the Sekimeiya works.
entries.literal: "Let's go test it. Let's try to understand how the Sekimeiya works."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Hey! Stop!
entries.literal: "Hey! Stop!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But Sai continued toward the event room, housing what we believed to be the center of every mystery.
entries.literal: "But Sai continued toward the event room, housing what we believed to be the center of every mystery."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: None of us wanted to stop him. Instead, we ran behind him, forcing Katei to follow us.
entries.literal: "None of us wanted to stop him. Instead, we ran behind him, forcing Katei to follow us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the room at the same time and saw the Sekimeiya still in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "We entered the room at the same time and saw the Sekimeiya still in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's good that we didn't lock this. Only the culprit has the key, so it only hurts us.
entries.literal: "It's good that we didn't lock this. Only the culprit has the key, so it only hurts us."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai, you'll get all of us in trouble...
entries.literal: "Sai, you'll get all of us in trouble..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What might get us in trouble is the murderer that's somewhere in this place. If something happens to the Sekimeiya, it's their fault.
entries.literal: "What might get us in trouble is the murderer that's somewhere in this place. If something happens to the Sekimeiya, it's their fault."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He proceeded to scroll down the glass and then took the Sekimeiya out.
entries.literal: "He proceeded to scroll down the glass and then took the Sekimeiya out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stared at him as he held it in his hands. He remained nonchalant, and there was no reaction.
entries.literal: "We stared at him as he held it in his hands. He remained nonchalant, and there was no reaction."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Nothing?
entries.literal: "Nothing?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe I just cloned myself in the past—who's to know? I'm clearly still here, though.
entries.literal: "Maybe I just cloned myself in the past—who's to know? I'm clearly still here, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without asking, he dropped it between my hands. It was really cold, and it didn't send me anywhere. Its color wasn't changing either.
entries.literal: "Without asking, he dropped it between my hands. It was really cold, and it didn't send me anywhere. Its color wasn't changing either."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't understand it. Maybe the Sekimeiya didn't do anything and something else is the actual cause of this phenomenon.
entries.literal: "I don't understand it. Maybe the Sekimeiya didn't do anything and something else is the actual cause of this phenomenon."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But it changed colors, right? Both when Atsuki touched it and when we put it here.
entries.literal: "But it changed colors, right? Both when Atsuki touched it and when we put it here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's keep it outside. We'll see if it happens again.
entries.literal: "Let's keep it outside. We'll see if it happens again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I won't allow that.{w} I couldn't stop you from getting it out, but you only proved that the Sekimeiya isn't at all related to what's going on. Put it back in.
entries.literal: "I won't allow that.{w} I couldn't stop you from getting it out, but you only proved that the Sekimeiya isn't at all related to what's going on. Put it back in."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Mind if I go poke Naomi's body with it first? Something could happen.
entries.literal: "Mind if I go poke Naomi's body with it first? Something could happen."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're losing your mind. That'd be beyond disgraceful.
entries.literal: "You're losing your mind. That'd be beyond disgraceful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei took the Sekimeiya from my hands and put it in its cabinet.
entries.literal: "Katei took the Sekimeiya from my hands and put it in its cabinet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh... I might've realized something.
entries.literal: "Oh... I might've realized something."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What is it?
entries.literal: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's not directly related to the Sekimeiya, but I just remembered something when you mentioned touching Naomi's body.
entries.literal: "It's not directly related to the Sekimeiya, but I just remembered something when you mentioned touching Naomi's body."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They all waited for me to continue and reveal something important, but I wasn't sure if I was right. Instead, I took off toward the room with the original body of Naomi.
entries.literal: "They all waited for me to continue and reveal something important, but I wasn't sure if I was right. Instead, I took off toward the room with the original body of Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was followed in. Inside, I kneeled beside the body and looked around it.
entries.literal: "I was followed in. Inside, I kneeled beside the body and looked around it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What are you doing?
entries.literal: "...What are you doing?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Good, it's still here.
entries.literal: "Good, it's still here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I showed them the result of my successful search: the keyring we'd found in one of Naomi's pockets.
entries.literal: "I showed them the result of my successful search: the keyring we'd found in one of Naomi's pockets."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What about this? Do you know what they're for?
entries.literal: "What about this? Do you know what they're for?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Oh! Of course, this big one...
entries.literal: "...Oh! Of course, this big one..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. I think it might be the key to the attic.
entries.literal: "Yes. I think it might be the key to the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...A-Are you serious?
entries.literal: "...A-Are you serious?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I am. We saw the keyhole upstairs, and it needed a big key like this one. The elevator has one too, but you can't really determine the shape of the key from it, so I understand why you didn't notice it.
entries.literal: "I am. We saw the keyhole upstairs, and it needed a big key like this one. The elevator has one too, but you can't really determine the shape of the key from it, so I understand why you didn't notice it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What do you say, Katei?
entries.literal: "What do you say, Katei?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Honestly, I can't tell. He could be right, but I'm not sure why Naomi would have it.
entries.literal: "...Honestly, I can't tell. He could be right, but I'm not sure why Naomi would have it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So we could have access to the attic, where the culprit might've been hiding all this time.
entries.literal: "So we could have access to the attic, where the culprit might've been hiding all this time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Not only that. If I'm right, we've had access for a while. We could've entered it during our last search.
entries.literal: "Not only that. If I'm right, we've had access for a while. We could've entered it during our last search."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But I can't think we would've found someone there so easily. First, it would mean that they have another key. Second, they hid there knowing we had access to it. Third, they didn't take this key from Naomi.{w} ...And yet the one for the cabinet was taken.
entries.literal: "But I can't think we would've found someone there so easily. First, it would mean that they have another key. Second, they hid there knowing we had access to it. Third, they didn't take this key from Naomi.{w} ...And yet the one for the cabinet was taken."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So maybe they don't care about us going to the attic.
entries.literal: "So maybe they don't care about us going to the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This doesn't matter. Let's just go see if it fits.
entries.literal: "This doesn't matter. Let's just go see if it fits."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I removed the key from the set and was about to exit the room until Shiroya made us aware of something.
entries.literal: "I removed the key from the set and was about to exit the room until Shiroya made us aware of something."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Where is Akaro?
entries.literal: "...Where is Akaro?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked around in bewilderment. She was right: Akaro wasn't with us.
entries.literal: "We looked around in bewilderment. She was right: Akaro wasn't with us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did he even come in here?
entries.literal: "Did he even come in here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked around hallway B, but it appeared empty. In front of us was the event room, which we could also see was empty through the door.
entries.literal: "We looked around hallway B, but it appeared empty. In front of us was the event room, which we could also see was empty through the door."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Where the hell did he go?
entries.literal: "Where the hell did he go?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did he go off on his own? No way someone attacked him, right? It's hard to believe we wouldn't have heard anything, and restraining Akaro would require quite a bit of effort. This floor should've been clear too.
entries.literal: "Did he go off on his own? No way someone attacked him, right? It's hard to believe we wouldn't have heard anything, and restraining Akaro would require quite a bit of effort. This floor should've been clear too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We kept talking as we looked through the other hallway. Erina and Isla were still next to the stairs, alone.
entries.literal: "We kept talking as we looked through the other hallway. Erina and Isla were still next to the stairs, alone."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do we try to go to the attic before looking for him thoroughly? It's just fantastic that someone disappeared as soon as we found our way in...
entries.literal: "Do we try to go to the attic before looking for him thoroughly? It's just fantastic that someone disappeared as soon as we found our way in..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But he might be in danger...
entries.literal: "But he might be in danger..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If he is in danger, he will be even if we search for him. If he walked away by himself, he wouldn't let us just find him again, and if the culprit took him, they've been dodging us for quite a while.{w} This is the first time we've been in this situation and have access to the attic, so we should go there first. Afterward, we'll move down if we haven't found him.
entries.literal: "If he is in danger, he will be even if we search for him. If he walked away by himself, he wouldn't let us just find him again, and if the culprit took him, they've been dodging us for quite a while.{w} This is the first time we've been in this situation and have access to the attic, so we should go there first. Afterward, we'll move down if we haven't found him."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No. Akaro must still be here. Let's look for him.
entries.literal: "No. Akaro must still be here. Let's look for him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Fine. He better have a very good reason if he separated from us on purpose.
entries.literal: "...{w}Fine. He better have a very good reason if he separated from us on purpose."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Do you really think he did...?
entries.literal: "Do you really think he did...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isn't he incredibly suspicious? He's been cooperative, but he's felt out of place from the beginning. He showed no interest in anything going on here, but he got trapped because he arrived so early.
entries.literal: "Isn't he incredibly suspicious? He's been cooperative, but he's felt out of place from the beginning. He showed no interest in anything going on here, but he got trapped because he arrived so early."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Aren't you in the same position?
entries.literal: "Aren't you in the same position?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, but you are. I came here out of curiosity.
entries.literal: "No, but you are. I came here out of curiosity."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Regardless, hallway B was empty when we entered Naomi's room. If someone took him by surprise, they would've had to come from behind. Unless you wanna say that maybe they materialized right behind Akaro, it's a dubious thing to think, because we looked through this entire floor not long ago.
entries.literal: "Regardless, hallway B was empty when we entered Naomi's room. If someone took him by surprise, they would've had to come from behind. Unless you wanna say that maybe they materialized right behind Akaro, it's a dubious thing to think, because we looked through this entire floor not long ago."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But the Sekimeiya's still here. What other reason could he have to vanish like that?
entries.literal: "But the Sekimeiya's still here. What other reason could he have to vanish like that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know, to make us waste time? Isn't that what the culprit has been doing from the beginning?
entries.literal: "I don't know, to make us waste time? Isn't that what the culprit has been doing from the beginning?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We explained everything to Erina and Isla while Sai called the elevator. It was still on our floor, so it probably hadn't been used. If it had, we wouldn't have heard it, so we couldn't be sure. Erina and Isla would've needed to miss the button lighting up for a couple seconds.
entries.literal: "We explained everything to Erina and Isla while Sai called the elevator. It was still on our floor, so it probably hadn't been used. If it had, we wouldn't have heard it, so we couldn't be sure. Erina and Isla would've needed to miss the button lighting up for a couple seconds."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: He suddenly disappeared...? Nobody could've gone up.
entries.literal: "He suddenly disappeared...? Nobody could've gone up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Lend me the key, Atsuki. I wanna see if it fits.
entries.literal: "Lend me the key, Atsuki. I wanna see if it fits."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Here.
entries.literal: "Here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gave him the big, brown key that I'd detached from the keyring. Sai took it and attempted to insert it in the keyhole inside the elevator.
entries.literal: "I gave him the big, brown key that I'd detached from the keyring. Sai took it and attempted to insert it in the keyhole inside the elevator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...You were correct. It's this one.
entries.literal: "...You were correct. It's this one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As he turned it, the seventh button lit up, indicating it had become available.
entries.literal: "As he turned it, the seventh button lit up, indicating it had become available."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Seriously? That's very strange...{w} I'm not sure you understand how restricted that place is. I'm not certain we should even go.
entries.literal: "Seriously? That's very strange...{w} I'm not sure you understand how restricted that place is. I'm not certain we should even go."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, we're going, but first we'll see if we can find Akaro here. The culprit must have another key to the attic, given they left this one on Naomi.
entries.literal: "Oh, we're going, but first we'll see if we can find Akaro here. The culprit must have another key to the attic, given they left this one on Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Sai took the key out, the light surrounding the button turned off. Then, he handed it back to me. As I put it in my pocket, he carefully shut the elevator and let go before it was fully closed. By doing so, he created a small gap between the door and the elevator.
entries.literal: "When Sai took the key out, the light surrounding the button turned off. Then, he handed it back to me. As I put it in my pocket, he carefully shut the elevator and let go before it was fully closed. By doing so, he created a small gap between the door and the elevator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Good, this works. We can keep it open like this without sticking something in there. Later, if we do a thorough search, we'll be able to do this so nobody can call it.
entries.literal: "Good, this works. We can keep it open like this without sticking something in there. Later, if we do a thorough search, we'll be able to do this so nobody can call it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Since Akaro can only be here, let's see if we can find him real quick. After that, our priority is looking for something important in the attic.
entries.literal: "Since Akaro can only be here, let's see if we can find him real quick. After that, our priority is looking for something important in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He closed the elevator again. We'd gotten used to the crystal floor searches, so it didn't feel like an imposing task anymore. Erina and Isla remained where they'd been while the rest of us chose individual rooms to look through, including the bathrooms and the mechanical room.{w} Every single one of them was empty, so we reunited by the stairs.
entries.literal: "He closed the elevator again. We'd gotten used to the crystal floor searches, so it didn't feel like an imposing task anymore. Erina and Isla remained where they'd been while the rest of us chose individual rooms to look through, including the bathrooms and the mechanical room.{w} Every single one of them was empty, so we reunited by the stairs."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Either Akaro managed to disappear or the culprit managed to make him disappear. The Sekimeiya didn't work for us earlier, so a lot of this isn't adding up. I'm not sure what Akaro has to do with this, but for now, let's get moving.
entries.literal: "Either Akaro managed to disappear or the culprit managed to make him disappear. The Sekimeiya didn't work for us earlier, so a lot of this isn't adding up. I'm not sure what Akaro has to do with this, but for now, let's get moving."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We can't all fit in the elevator, so let's go through the main door. It'd be better to stick together.
entries.literal: "We can't all fit in the elevator, so let's go through the main door. It'd be better to stick together."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I agree.
entries.literal: "I agree."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without wasting time, we moved through the floors to reach the sixth.{w} It was surreal not having Akaro with us. Naomi's second appearance eclipsed the oddity of his disappearance, but it was also something that I couldn't even begin to understand.
entries.literal: "Without wasting time, we moved through the floors to reach the sixth.{w} It was surreal not having Akaro with us. Naomi's second appearance eclipsed the oddity of his disappearance, but it was also something that I couldn't even begin to understand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "The Sekimeiya didn't work for us earlier, so a lot of this isn't adding up."{w} Sai implied that the Sekimeiya must've caused Akaro's disappearance, but there was an important discrepancy: it was shut behind the glass. If it was involved, it worked in a way beyond what we knew.
entries.literal: "\"The Sekimeiya didn't work for us earlier, so a lot of this isn't adding up.\"{w} Sai implied that the Sekimeiya must've caused Akaro's disappearance, but there was an important discrepancy: it was shut behind the glass. If it was involved, it worked in a way beyond what we knew."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh, I didn't see this door.
entries.literal: "Oh, I didn't see this door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's my first time looking at it too. It's pretty sturdy—no way we'd be opening it without the key.
entries.literal: "It's my first time looking at it too. It's pretty sturdy—no way we'd be opening it without the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They all looked at me expectantly. I took the key out of my pocket and inserted it into the keyhole. I'd been half expecting something to go wrong, but I was able to smoothly turn it and unlock the door to the mysterious attic.
entries.literal: "They all looked at me expectantly. I took the key out of my pocket and inserted it into the keyhole. I'd been half expecting something to go wrong, but I was able to smoothly turn it and unlock the door to the mysterious attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai quickly dragged the door open. There was a narrow staircase leading upward that obligated us to form a line.
entries.literal: "Sai quickly dragged the door open. There was a narrow staircase leading upward that obligated us to form a line."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's pretty dark...
entries.literal: "It's pretty dark..."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm... Do we need to go?
entries.literal: "Hm... Do we need to go?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: These stairs are like this because there's no room directly above us. They had to link this door to the closest room. It wasn't an easy task, and there wasn't much space to make a wider staircase.
entries.literal: "These stairs are like this because there's no room directly above us. They had to link this door to the closest room. It wasn't an easy task, and there wasn't much space to make a wider staircase."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...You saw the attic earlier through the cameras. It's a tidy floor in the layout of a normal household. Since not many people can access it, they didn't bother making a more pleasant entryway.
entries.literal: "...You saw the attic earlier through the cameras. It's a tidy floor in the layout of a normal household. Since not many people can access it, they didn't bother making a more pleasant entryway."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: But won't we get in trouble for going in?
entries.literal: "But won't we get in trouble for going in?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We might. I'm advising you all not to keep going.{w} It's a restricted area, and I doubt Ashiya will be understanding even if our circumstances require this.
entries.literal: "We might. I'm advising you all not to keep going.{w} It's a restricted area, and I doubt Ashiya will be understanding even if our circumstances require this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai, who was in front, continued up the stairs.
entries.literal: "Sai, who was in front, continued up the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The rest of us followed him and quickly reached the top of the short staircase, where we found another door at our left.
entries.literal: "The rest of us followed him and quickly reached the top of the short staircase, where we found another door at our left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The space above wasn't large enough for all of us, so Erina and Isla could barely see the door. Sai grabbed the aged handle and realized that it was slightly open. Finally, he pushed open the last barrier preventing us from seeing what we were up against.
entries.literal: "The space above wasn't large enough for all of us, so Erina and Isla could barely see the door. Sai grabbed the aged handle and realized that it was slightly open. Finally, he pushed open the last barrier preventing us from seeing what we were up against."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A rusty creak rang out as the door slowly opened. Sai had to put unusual strength into it—the door kept getting stuck on the floor. Once he'd won that battle, I was able to see inside.
entries.literal: "A rusty creak rang out as the door slowly opened. Sai had to put unusual strength into it—the door kept getting stuck on the floor. Once he'd won that battle, I was able to see inside."

entries.text: Condemned
entries.literal: "Condemned"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It looked like an old living room, and not at all Japanese-styled. A sofa with a suitcase on it quickly came into view, along with a few lights hanging from the ceiling. I could see two more doors in the corner of the room, and as I thoroughly inspected it, I questioned why Sai hadn't yet moved.
entries.literal: "It looked like an old living room, and not at all Japanese-styled. A sofa with a suitcase on it quickly came into view, along with a few lights hanging from the ceiling. I could see two more doors in the corner of the room, and as I thoroughly inspected it, I questioned why Sai hadn't yet moved."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Wait up. Look at the floor.
entries.literal: "...Wait up. Look at the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took it as if he'd been talking to me because I was the one with the best view. As soon as he pointed it out, I understood what he was looking at.
entries.literal: "I took it as if he'd been talking to me because I was the one with the best view. As soon as he pointed it out, I understood what he was looking at."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There was someone here...
entries.literal: "There was someone here..."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, there are footprints on the floor. Someone must've been here.
entries.literal: "Yeah, there are footprints on the floor. Someone must've been here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The entire floor was covered by a blue carpet, and any steps someone took on it would remain visible thanks to its thickness. Over time, they would become harder and harder to discern until they disappeared altogether. It was definite proof that someone had walked around there recently.
entries.literal: "The entire floor was covered by a blue carpet, and any steps someone took on it would remain visible thanks to its thickness. Over time, they would become harder and harder to discern until they disappeared altogether. It was definite proof that someone had walked around there recently."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, someone must have been here. Sure. This is exactly why we couldn't find the person we were looking for. The second Naomi didn't have a keyring, so it's very possible they still have easy access to this place. That isn't exactly what I meant, though.
entries.literal: "Yeah, someone must have been here. Sure. This is exactly why we couldn't find the person we were looking for. The second Naomi didn't have a keyring, so it's very possible they still have easy access to this place. That isn't exactly what I meant, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't you see it? These footprints don't make sense. Nobody could've entered through this door.
entries.literal: "Don't you see it? These footprints don't make sense. Nobody could've entered through this door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took me a moment to see why he'd said that since there were footprints right next to the door. The key to that statement was their origin.
entries.literal: "It took me a moment to see why he'd said that since there were footprints right next to the door. The key to that statement was their origin."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, you're right... How did this happen?
entries.literal: "Wait, you're right... How did this happen?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Against the wall before us was a red sofa. In front of it, the footprints began and walked up to the door Sai had opened. From there, they headed toward another door.
entries.literal: "Against the wall before us was a red sofa. In front of it, the footprints began and walked up to the door Sai had opened. From there, they headed toward another door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not sure what to gather from this, but once we enter, these footprints will fade away and merge with ours, so let's not disrupt the rightmost part of the room yet.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure what to gather from this, but once we enter, these footprints will fade away and merge with ours, so let's not disrupt the rightmost part of the room yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once Sai entered, I was free to do so as well, and the people behind me all slowly made their way into what seemed to be the living room.
entries.literal: "Once Sai entered, I was free to do so as well, and the people behind me all slowly made their way into what seemed to be the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to the sofa was a modest table, and in front of it a shelf supporting an old but large CRT television.
entries.literal: "Next to the sofa was a modest table, and in front of it a shelf supporting an old but large CRT television."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell is this doing here...?
entries.literal: "What the hell is this doing here...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was talking about the suitcase. It looked like the one he'd taken from hallway C minutes prior, and it couldn't have somehow moved to the attic ahead of us since we hadn't heard the elevator. It had to be an entirely different suitcase.
entries.literal: "He was talking about the suitcase. It looked like the one he'd taken from hallway C minutes prior, and it couldn't have somehow moved to the attic ahead of us since we hadn't heard the elevator. It had to be an entirely different suitcase."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's empty too, and it looks like the one downstairs. It's exactly the same suitcase.
entries.literal: "It's empty too, and it looks like the one downstairs. It's exactly the same suitcase."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: The same one, literally? Or do you mean the same model?
entries.literal: "The same one, literally? Or do you mean the same model?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Probably the same model, but honestly, I can't be sure. Naomi's body appeared twice, so this could still be the exact same suitcase depending on what happened.
entries.literal: "Probably the same model, but honestly, I can't be sure. Naomi's body appeared twice, so this could still be the exact same suitcase depending on what happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh, look. It also has faint traces of smoke...
entries.literal: "Huh, look. It also has faint traces of smoke..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Do they not belong to people who work here, Katei? There's no way two of these were snuck into the tower, right?
entries.literal: "Do they not belong to people who work here, Katei? There's no way two of these were snuck into the tower, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Three, in fact. One more was being carried by the person holding the stolen gemstones. And no, I don't recognize it at all.{w} More importantly, what is it doing here?
entries.literal: "Three, in fact. One more was being carried by the person holding the stolen gemstones. And no, I don't recognize it at all.{w} More importantly, what is it doing here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around me. There were no visible security cameras, and I recalled that I hadn't seen the living room through the monitors. I was sure that one of us would've noticed the suitcase otherwise, and maybe even the person who had been hiding.
entries.literal: "I looked around me. There were no visible security cameras, and I recalled that I hadn't seen the living room through the monitors. I was sure that one of us would've noticed the suitcase otherwise, and maybe even the person who had been hiding."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Honestly, I have no idea. I'm not sure why they'd bring this here, no matter what its contents were. If they wanted to leave it behind, they could've done so downstairs, which is what we thought they did.
entries.literal: "...{w}Honestly, I have no idea. I'm not sure why they'd bring this here, no matter what its contents were. If they wanted to leave it behind, they could've done so downstairs, which is what we thought they did."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Right. What's the point of leaving one on the crystal floor and another one here?
entries.literal: "Right. What's the point of leaving one on the crystal floor and another one here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whatever it is, it's less strange than the footprints we've walked over. Atsuki and Shiroya realized it.
entries.literal: "Whatever it is, it's less strange than the footprints we've walked over. Atsuki and Shiroya realized it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The footprints started right in front of the suitcase, moved toward the staircase, and then to that door over there. What's past it?
entries.literal: "The footprints started right in front of the suitcase, moved toward the staircase, and then to that door over there. What's past it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That door leads to the hallway. From there, you can access the elevator and the bedrooms. The other door you see leads to the kitchen, which is also connected to the hallway.
entries.literal: "That door leads to the hallway. From there, you can access the elevator and the bedrooms. The other door you see leads to the kitchen, which is also connected to the hallway."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But I see what you mean. If no more footprints exist, they couldn't begin by the sofa.
entries.literal: "But I see what you mean. If no more footprints exist, they couldn't begin by the sofa."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, no, they could. If someone spent a few hours on the sofa, the next time they walked around, their previous footprints would've faded away, so it would look as if the starting point was the sofa itself.
entries.literal: "Well, no, they could. If someone spent a few hours on the sofa, the next time they walked around, their previous footprints would've faded away, so it would look as if the starting point was the sofa itself."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They could've also come from the kitchen, but they must've jumped onto the sofa to avoid leaving footprints, which sounds insane.
entries.literal: "They could've also come from the kitchen, but they must've jumped onto the sofa to avoid leaving footprints, which sounds insane."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai, careful not to step on the preexisting footprints, opened the door to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "Sai, careful not to step on the preexisting footprints, opened the door to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The floor here is different, so we won't be able to know if anyone came from the kitchen. Now, should we check everyone's shoes?
entries.literal: "The floor here is different, so we won't be able to know if anyone came from the kitchen. Now, should we check everyone's shoes?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why do you think I preserved a few of these? Naturally, to check if one of us has been here already. Naomi's killer would've had a way in with the same key we used or the one that the other Naomi might've had.
entries.literal: "Why do you think I preserved a few of these? Naturally, to check if one of us has been here already. Naomi's killer would've had a way in with the same key we used or the one that the other Naomi might've had."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: These are barely recognizable, though. We might not be able to compare them well.
entries.literal: "These are barely recognizable, though. We might not be able to compare them well."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's fine. The size itself should be enough. ...Strangely, nobody should've been able to enter this place through the stairs we just came from because no footprints start there.
entries.literal: "That's fine. The size itself should be enough. ...Strangely, nobody should've been able to enter this place through the stairs we just came from because no footprints start there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai opened the remaining door.
entries.literal: "Sai opened the remaining door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Look, this hallway has a wooden floor too, and I can see the elevator right there. Using that, anyone could've come up here with the key.
entries.literal: "Look, this hallway has a wooden floor too, and I can see the elevator right there. Using that, anyone could've come up here with the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That sounded right. Our own footprints were still very much visible, so they wouldn't fade immediately. The door had gotten stuck on the floor when Sai tried to open it, and the markings from that were still on the carpet. However, we had no way to tell if it had been opened earlier.
entries.literal: "That sounded right. Our own footprints were still very much visible, so they wouldn't fade immediately. The door had gotten stuck on the floor when Sai tried to open it, and the markings from that were still on the carpet. However, we had no way to tell if it had been opened earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way to jump to the sofa from the staircase, so accepting Sai's claim was reasonable. I looked up to see if I could notice a ceiling opening to drop from, but I didn't spot anything.
entries.literal: "There was no way to jump to the sofa from the staircase, so accepting Sai's claim was reasonable. I looked up to see if I could notice a ceiling opening to drop from, but I didn't spot anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I agreed with him fully, it was important to remember that we were likely up against someone cunning who was trying to mislead us while avoiding detection. Like Akaro said before he disappeared, it felt as if they had been taunting us at times.
