entries.literal: "Before I agreed with him fully, it was important to remember that we were likely up against someone cunning who was trying to mislead us while avoiding detection. Like Akaro said before he disappeared, it felt as if they had been taunting us at times."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If their intention was to play with our reasoning again, they could have intentionally made us think that the main door was unused and the elevator was the only method of entering.
entries.literal: "If their intention was to play with our reasoning again, they could have intentionally made us think that the main door was unused and the elevator was the only method of entering."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The key behind that was the state of the footprints. They'd clearly been there for a while, so it wasn't simple to determine the way they were facing. Even though we'd all interpreted the sofa to be the starting point, that wasn't guaranteed to be the case.
entries.literal: "The key behind that was the state of the footprints. They'd clearly been there for a while, so it wasn't simple to determine the way they were facing. Even though we'd all interpreted the sofa to be the starting point, that wasn't guaranteed to be the case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To trick us, the culprit could've purposely walked from the door to the sofa. From there, making it to the kitchen without stepping on the floor again seemed easy, and they could've gone around the room through the hallway, then exited through the main door.
entries.literal: "To trick us, the culprit could've purposely walked from the door to the sofa. From there, making it to the kitchen without stepping on the floor again seemed easy, and they could've gone around the room through the hallway, then exited through the main door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It sounded excessive, and it implied they'd left the suitcase there so that we would find it, but we still had to ask ourselves an important question: why would someone leave the key to the attic in Naomi's pocket when the Sekimeiya cabinet key was removed?
entries.literal: "It sounded excessive, and it implied they'd left the suitcase there so that we would find it, but we still had to ask ourselves an important question: why would someone leave the key to the attic in Naomi's pocket when the Sekimeiya cabinet key was removed?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If they had known that we were going to look at the room, they might've prepared something like that. But I couldn't identify the goal of it, because the idea that they hadn't come from the main door didn't seem to contradict anything yet.
entries.literal: "If they had known that we were going to look at the room, they might've prepared something like that. But I couldn't identify the goal of it, because the idea that they hadn't come from the main door didn't seem to contradict anything yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}The more I stared at the footprints, the more I doubted whether they were facing the way I was thinking. I wasn't sure anymore, but I was confident that only one pair of shoes had left them.
entries.literal: "...{w}The more I stared at the footprints, the more I doubted whether they were facing the way I was thinking. I wasn't sure anymore, but I was confident that only one pair of shoes had left them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If they were backwards, there were more arrangements. Perhaps they entered from the staircase, went to the hallway to take the elevator down, and quickly returned from the staircase so they could walk over to the sofa.
entries.literal: "If they were backwards, there were more arrangements. Perhaps they entered from the staircase, went to the hallway to take the elevator down, and quickly returned from the staircase so they could walk over to the sofa."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, are you gonna show me your shoes, or do I need to compare your footprints?
entries.literal: "Well, are you gonna show me your shoes, or do I need to compare your footprints?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Look, mine are a little bigger, see? It's very simple.
entries.literal: "Look, mine are a little bigger, see? It's very simple."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Fine, here. I know you're still suspecting me, but you must admit that mine are also considerably larger.
entries.literal: "Fine, here. I know you're still suspecting me, but you must admit that mine are also considerably larger."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...{w} Who did you steal those from?
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} Who did you steal those from?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not used to ruling you out so quickly. That's all.
entries.literal: "I'm not used to ruling you out so quickly. That's all."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Unfortunately, we can't really look at Akaro's for the moment, but I'm sure they'd be bigger too.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, we can't really look at Akaro's for the moment, but I'm sure they'd be bigger too."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anyway, Atsuki, you're next on the suspect list.
entries.literal: "Anyway, Atsuki, you're next on the suspect list."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And I just let you know about the attic key?
entries.literal: "And I just let you know about the attic key?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Just show me your shoes. I'm pretty lost when it comes to the intentions of the culprit, anyway.
entries.literal: "Just show me your shoes. I'm pretty lost when it comes to the intentions of the culprit, anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked at them, and once again, there was no match.
entries.literal: "He looked at them, and once again, there was no match."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Shiroya?
entries.literal: "Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She left a footprint, and Sai looked at it for a few seconds with a conspicuous frown on his face.
entries.literal: "She left a footprint, and Sai looked at it for a few seconds with a conspicuous frown on his face."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yours are awfully close, but I can't say for sure they're the same. The size is at least very similar.
entries.literal: "Yours are awfully close, but I can't say for sure they're the same. The size is at least very similar."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...So what? Are you gonna move me above Atsuki on your list?
entries.literal: "...So what? Are you gonna move me above Atsuki on your list?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This might give you enough points for that, but I'll admit I was only hoping for Katei's shoes to match. That would've meant a lot more than your size coinciding.
entries.literal: "This might give you enough points for that, but I'll admit I was only hoping for Katei's shoes to match. That would've meant a lot more than your size coinciding."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anyway, Erina, mind playing along too?
entries.literal: "Anyway, Erina, mind playing along too?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You can see mine are slightly bigger too.
entries.literal: "You can see mine are slightly bigger too."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right. Let's see if we can find something else, then.
entries.literal: "You're right. Let's see if we can find something else, then."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Are you not gonna look at mine?
entries.literal: "Are you not gonna look at mine?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh... sure. Isla, do you understand what'll happen to you if your shoes match?
entries.literal: "Oh... sure. Isla, do you understand what'll happen to you if your shoes match?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't worry. They're not even close.
entries.literal: "Don't worry. They're not even close."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: That's what I thought.
entries.literal: "That's what I thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai moved to the television and tried to power it on.{w} Nothing happened.
entries.literal: "Sai moved to the television and tried to power it on.{w} Nothing happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I guess this is broken, seeing as it's plugged in.{w} ...Anyway, let's look around the area.
entries.literal: "I guess this is broken, seeing as it's plugged in.{w} ...Anyway, let's look around the area."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We started with the kitchen. It had an empty refrigerator, an oven, and some compartments to store food that no longer contained anything but dust.
entries.literal: "We started with the kitchen. It had an empty refrigerator, an oven, and some compartments to store food that no longer contained anything but dust."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, we all stepped over to the hallway. The floor was a little creaky, and the walls were beige. Everything about the place was old, but it was still well-preserved.
entries.literal: "Next, we all stepped over to the hallway. The floor was a little creaky, and the walls were beige. Everything about the place was old, but it was still well-preserved."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This room used to serve as a storeroom, but it's empty now, and it seems the ceiling light stopped working. Pressing the switch isn't doing anything.
entries.literal: "This room used to serve as a storeroom, but it's empty now, and it seems the ceiling light stopped working. Pressing the switch isn't doing anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We ignored the elevator and began to look through the other rooms. According to Katei, the two doors farthest back led to bedrooms.
entries.literal: "We ignored the elevator and began to look through the other rooms. According to Katei, the two doors farthest back led to bedrooms."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: There's a second floor?
entries.literal: "There's a second floor?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Inside the spacious bedroom, Isla noticed a ladder that led to a room above us. However, we should've already been on the highest floor.
entries.literal: "Inside the spacious bedroom, Isla noticed a ladder that led to a room above us. However, we should've already been on the highest floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, not quite. Back then, when this was a residence, it's true that the house had two floors. The second one wasn't fully preserved when the building was expanded, but as you can see, remnants are still present in these bedrooms.
entries.literal: "Oh, not quite. Back then, when this was a residence, it's true that the house had two floors. The second one wasn't fully preserved when the building was expanded, but as you can see, remnants are still present in these bedrooms."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh... What's up there, then?
entries.literal: "Oh... What's up there, then?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Another bedroom like this one. These were used as double rooms back in the day, so Ashiya specified that the higher ones shouldn't be demolished.
entries.literal: "Another bedroom like this one. These were used as double rooms back in the day, so Ashiya specified that the higher ones shouldn't be demolished."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat on the bed, still pretty tired from not sleeping the night before. It wasn't really comfortable due to how long it had gone unused, but the sheets made it look like it was still maintained daily.
entries.literal: "I sat on the bed, still pretty tired from not sleeping the night before. It wasn't really comfortable due to how long it had gone unused, but the sheets made it look like it was still maintained daily."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up as soon as I noticed a security camera recording me. I definitely recalled seeing the bedroom through the monitors.
entries.literal: "I stood up as soon as I noticed a security camera recording me. I definitely recalled seeing the bedroom through the monitors."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya, Isla, and I went up to the second level of the bedroom. Like Katei said, it was similar, and there were only two beds and a closet. I opened it, given that we were still looking for Akaro, but it only contained a few articles of clothing.
entries.literal: "Shiroya, Isla, and I went up to the second level of the bedroom. Like Katei said, it was similar, and there were only two beds and a closet. I opened it, given that we were still looking for Akaro, but it only contained a few articles of clothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went back down. Another door was in front of the bedroom.
entries.literal: "We went back down. Another door was in front of the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It led to a mirrored version of the bedroom I'd seen, and it also had a ladder.
entries.literal: "It led to a mirrored version of the bedroom I'd seen, and it also had a ladder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Above, nothing was different. There were effectively four bedrooms on the floor.
entries.literal: "Above, nothing was different. There were effectively four bedrooms on the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The final area was the bathroom. It had a shower, a shelf, and a modest carpet on the floor. It was bigger and fancier than the ones below, but the door didn't have a locking mechanism.
entries.literal: "The final area was the bathroom. It had a shower, a shelf, and a modest carpet on the floor. It was bigger and fancier than the ones below, but the door didn't have a locking mechanism."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The entire floor had a simple layout. According to Katei, the household used to be quite bigger in the past, but not much of that remained.
entries.literal: "The entire floor had a simple layout. According to Katei, the household used to be quite bigger in the past, but not much of that remained."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In addition, the hallway wasn't as long as the ones downstairs, meaning that the attic didn't make use of the whole space the large building provided, probably because it had been significantly expanded at one point.
entries.literal: "In addition, the hallway wasn't as long as the ones downstairs, meaning that the attic didn't make use of the whole space the large building provided, probably because it had been significantly expanded at one point."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd looked through every room while someone always remained in the hallway, so we'd determined that we were alone. Once we were done, Sai called us from the elevator.
entries.literal: "We'd looked through every room while someone always remained in the hallway, so we'd determined that we were alone. Once we were done, Sai called us from the elevator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There are light switches everywhere, but every light was turned on. Is that normal?
entries.literal: "There are light switches everywhere, but every light was turned on. Is that normal?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, it doesn't mean anyone turned them on separately. The lights turn off automatically at night, and every morning we manually turn them all on at once, including the attic's. That's why the office floors were lit up as well.
entries.literal: "Yes, it doesn't mean anyone turned them on separately. The lights turn off automatically at night, and every morning we manually turn them all on at once, including the attic's. That's why the office floors were lit up as well."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That sounds like a huge waste.
entries.literal: "That sounds like a huge waste."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei nodded but stayed in the hallway's bend so that nobody could enter without him seeing. We realized Sai had called the elevator as soon as we saw the button lighting up.
entries.literal: "Katei nodded but stayed in the hallway's bend so that nobody could enter without him seeing. We realized Sai had called the elevator as soon as we saw the button lighting up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right, so we haven't found anyone. That's fair. As we said earlier, we now need to make sure to thoroughly inspect every floor, so we'll leave the elevator here and disable it by keeping the door open.
entries.literal: "All right, so we haven't found anyone. That's fair. As we said earlier, we now need to make sure to thoroughly inspect every floor, so we'll leave the elevator here and disable it by keeping the door open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just like he'd done downstairs, he held it with his hands so that it wouldn't close. Once he let go of it, the door didn't have the force to close itself and remained stationary.
entries.literal: "Just like he'd done downstairs, he held it with his hands so that it wouldn't close. Once he let go of it, the door didn't have the force to close itself and remained stationary."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If we make it all the way down without finding anyone, we'll have to consider some pretty outlandish things. Until then, we have to expect to at least find Akaro.
entries.literal: "If we make it all the way down without finding anyone, we'll have to consider some pretty outlandish things. Until then, we have to expect to at least find Akaro."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the living room. Sai and Katei went through the kitchen, as it was the last place anyone could've hoped to sneak in.
entries.literal: "We entered the living room. Sai and Katei went through the kitchen, as it was the last place anyone could've hoped to sneak in."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What does this look like to you guys?
entries.literal: "...What does this look like to you guys?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped them without giving them context. They weren't sure what I was referring to, so I made it clearer.
entries.literal: "I stopped them without giving them context. They weren't sure what I was referring to, so I made it clearer."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The footprints, I mean. They can look like an impossibility, but there's a simple explanation for them, right?
entries.literal: "The footprints, I mean. They can look like an impossibility, but there's a simple explanation for them, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Teleportation?
entries.literal: "Teleportation?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Yes. Earlier, I did consider our mystery culprit teleporting to the attic. If they appeared next to the sofa, that'd be the natural beginning of their footprints.
entries.literal: "...Yes. Earlier, I did consider our mystery culprit teleporting to the attic. If they appeared next to the sofa, that'd be the natural beginning of their footprints."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Here's something else: these footprints probably belong to a woman. What's your shoe size, Shiroya?
entries.literal: "Here's something else: these footprints probably belong to a woman. What's your shoe size, Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And the only other person we know who could have a similar shoe size is Naomi. Furthermore, we found two Naomis, and on the sofa, where she would've teleported to, there's a suitcase that we've also seen before.
entries.literal: "And the only other person we know who could have a similar shoe size is Naomi. Furthermore, we found two Naomis, and on the sofa, where she would've teleported to, there's a suitcase that we've also seen before."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: See? This is what I told you guys earlier. Naomi had the suitcase from the beginning. Once she teleported or time traveled to this living room, the suitcase was replicated and she must've left it here.
entries.literal: "See? This is what I told you guys earlier. Naomi had the suitcase from the beginning. Once she teleported or time traveled to this living room, the suitcase was replicated and she must've left it here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, are you just gung-ho about time travel now? You were ridiculing Atsuki for it earlier.
entries.literal: "Oh, are you just gung-ho about time travel now? You were ridiculing Atsuki for it earlier."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Well, it's become clear that something strange is going on. These footprints are even further proof.
entries.literal: "Well, it's become clear that something strange is going on. These footprints are even further proof."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If this is what happened, Naomi must've traveled here while she was holding the suitcase—before we found it on the crystal floor. That would mean two Naomis have existed for quite a while, and that not only did we miss both of them, they were also killed.{w} And let me tell you, there are some pesky contradictions down that line of thought. First, during the time Naomi could've been holding the suitcase, the Sekimeiya was in its cabinet. It wasn't locked inside, but we touched it and nothing happened to us. If that's how she time traveled up here, it again begs the question of why it worked for her.
entries.literal: "If this is what happened, Naomi must've traveled here while she was holding the suitcase—before we found it on the crystal floor. That would mean two Naomis have existed for quite a while, and that not only did we miss both of them, they were also killed.{w} And let me tell you, there are some pesky contradictions down that line of thought. First, during the time Naomi could've been holding the suitcase, the Sekimeiya was in its cabinet. It wasn't locked inside, but we touched it and nothing happened to us. If that's how she time traveled up here, it again begs the question of why it worked for her."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Honestly, I assumed that being outside the cabinet without refrigeration was what made the Sekimeiya transport Atsuki into the past. However, the fact that we found the Sekimeiya still in its cabinet minutes before seeing that suitcase might imply that was wrong.
entries.literal: "Honestly, I assumed that being outside the cabinet without refrigeration was what made the Sekimeiya transport Atsuki into the past. However, the fact that we found the Sekimeiya still in its cabinet minutes before seeing that suitcase might imply that was wrong."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not wrong, right? If Naomi touched it while it was out of the cabinet, we would've found it outside.{w} The next contradiction is what we talked about earlier: Naomi would've disappeared upon traveling, so we couldn't have found her corpse and the suitcase twice.
entries.literal: "I'm not wrong, right? If Naomi touched it while it was out of the cabinet, we would've found it outside.{w} The next contradiction is what we talked about earlier: Naomi would've disappeared upon traveling, so we couldn't have found her corpse and the suitcase twice."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I get what you're saying regarding the Sekimeiya, but after traveling back, she could've gone downstairs to pick it up from the floor. She would've known where she'd traveled from, so she could've returned it to the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I get what you're saying regarding the Sekimeiya, but after traveling back, she could've gone downstairs to pick it up from the floor. She would've known where she'd traveled from, so she could've returned it to the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Incorrect, I think.{w} Remember what Katei said after we got the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet?
entries.literal: "Incorrect, I think.{w} Remember what Katei said after we got the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What did I say?
entries.literal: "...What did I say?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That you restored power to the elevator. According to you, the alarm disabled it.
entries.literal: "That you restored power to the elevator. According to you, the alarm disabled it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, right. I got it running again after I stopped trying to understand what caused the power outage.
entries.literal: "Oh, right. I got it running again after I stopped trying to understand what caused the power outage."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see, so Naomi couldn't have used the elevator before we saw the Sekimeiya in the cabinet, and right after that, we saw the suitcase in hallway C, which probably means that Naomi would've already traveled.
entries.literal: "I see, so Naomi couldn't have used the elevator before we saw the Sekimeiya in the cabinet, and right after that, we saw the suitcase in hallway C, which probably means that Naomi would've already traveled."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? She could've just left through the staircase.
entries.literal: "What? She could've just left through the staircase."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, I don't think so. It's likely that the first time we heard the elevator moving down, Naomi used it from here. There's still no other explanation for that, and there's something else that makes me think she couldn't have exited through the door. That's the last contradiction I can point out.
entries.literal: "No, I don't think so. It's likely that the first time we heard the elevator moving down, Naomi used it from here. There's still no other explanation for that, and there's something else that makes me think she couldn't have exited through the door. That's the last contradiction I can point out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: When Naomi traveled with the suitcase, it's very safe to assume she also had her keys. She had them before the smoke appeared and when we found her first corpse. Her cabinet key had been removed, but that probably only happened after she was killed.
entries.literal: "When Naomi traveled with the suitcase, it's very safe to assume she also had her keys. She had them before the smoke appeared and when we found her first corpse. Her cabinet key had been removed, but that probably only happened after she was killed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now recall the footprints we found here. They start next to the sofa, go over to the staircase, then toward the hallway door.
entries.literal: "Now recall the footprints we found here. They start next to the sofa, go over to the staircase, then toward the hallway door."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, so Naomi's first movements after appearing would've been to try leaving through the staircase.
entries.literal: "Oh, so Naomi's first movements after appearing would've been to try leaving through the staircase."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Exactly. And despite that, she went back to the hallway. The reasonable explanation is that she didn't have the key to get out.
entries.literal: "Exactly. And despite that, she went back to the hallway. The reasonable explanation is that she didn't have the key to get out."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Then why would she go to the door?
entries.literal: "Then why would she go to the door?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: To try opening it? Maybe she thought she still had her keys, but when she went down the stairs and was about to take them out, she realized she didn't have them. Her only way out was through the elevator, so she came back up and went to the hallway. Eventually, she must've used it when the power came back.
entries.literal: "To try opening it? Maybe she thought she still had her keys, but when she went down the stairs and was about to take them out, she realized she didn't have them. Her only way out was through the elevator, so she came back up and went to the hallway. Eventually, she must've used it when the power came back."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Since the footprints are all similar, there's only one other explanation that makes sense to me: she had the key and exited the room. Either before or after all this, she entered the attic again and went straight to the hallway.{w} But the footprints were all in similar condition, so there must not have been a lot of time between them. I'm not sure why she'd enter again only to use the elevator and go down. ...If she didn't want to be noticed, the elevator noise wouldn't do her any favors.
entries.literal: "Since the footprints are all similar, there's only one other explanation that makes sense to me: she had the key and exited the room. Either before or after all this, she entered the attic again and went straight to the hallway.{w} But the footprints were all in similar condition, so there must not have been a lot of time between them. I'm not sure why she'd enter again only to use the elevator and go down. ...If she didn't want to be noticed, the elevator noise wouldn't do her any favors."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: She thought she'd have her keys, then...? Maybe she didn't know that much about the Sekimeiya even though she used it so early on.{w} I think that makes the most sense. She would be the second Naomi we found. I still don't understand how we missed her if she was the one who took the elevator down, or who killed her, but the truth is that we didn't find any keys on her body.
entries.literal: "She thought she'd have her keys, then...? Maybe she didn't know that much about the Sekimeiya even though she used it so early on.{w} I think that makes the most sense. She would be the second Naomi we found. I still don't understand how we missed her if she was the one who took the elevator down, or who killed her, but the truth is that we didn't find any keys on her body."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And the person who killed her didn't remove them the first time, so they wouldn't have cared if the second Naomi had them either.
entries.literal: "And the person who killed her didn't remove them the first time, so they wouldn't have cared if the second Naomi had them either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The footprints painted a clear picture: she thought she had keys she didn't have. Was that due to the travel itself, or had she lost them beforehand?
entries.literal: "The footprints painted a clear picture: she thought she had keys she didn't have. Was that due to the travel itself, or had she lost them beforehand?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's head back down for now. When we get to the crystal floor, we'll know if the footprints could've belonged to her. If not, Shiroya's gonna have to move up a few spots on the naughty list.
entries.literal: "Let's head back down for now. When we get to the crystal floor, we'll know if the footprints could've belonged to her. If not, Shiroya's gonna have to move up a few spots on the naughty list."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no point in arguing that, so we made our way to the sixth floor. Through normal means, there was no way anyone could still be in the attic, so we didn't have to worry about the elevator for once.
entries.literal: "There was no point in arguing that, so we made our way to the sixth floor. Through normal means, there was no way anyone could still be in the attic, so we didn't have to worry about the elevator for once."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We followed an exceedingly simple plan: Erina and Isla remained outside the office partitions while the rest of us looked through them. Only one person was needed for that, but by grouping up, we avoided picking one single person to do the important and potentially dangerous job.
entries.literal: "We followed an exceedingly simple plan: Erina and Isla remained outside the office partitions while the rest of us looked through them. Only one person was needed for that, but by grouping up, we avoided picking one single person to do the important and potentially dangerous job."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Afterward, we inspected the bathrooms. Opening the doors was enough to determine they were desolate, but we remained on high alert after what we'd found in the crystal floor's bathroom.
entries.literal: "Afterward, we inspected the bathrooms. Opening the doors was enough to determine they were desolate, but we remained on high alert after what we'd found in the crystal floor's bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we finished with floor 6, we were sure that nobody else was on the two highest floors, so we went down to repeat the process.
entries.literal: "When we finished with floor 6, we were sure that nobody else was on the two highest floors, so we went down to repeat the process."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The fifth floor wasn't any different. Even though we believed that Akaro and whoever the culprit was had to be somewhere in the tower, they would never remain on an office floor if they intended to hide.{w} Since we knew that, the most important reason why we were following that procedure was to isolate the crystal floor and be able to thoroughly look there once again.
entries.literal: "The fifth floor wasn't any different. Even though we believed that Akaro and whoever the culprit was had to be somewhere in the tower, they would never remain on an office floor if they intended to hide.{w} Since we knew that, the most important reason why we were following that procedure was to isolate the crystal floor and be able to thoroughly look there once again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As the search of the fourth floor was completed without an issue, I wondered again what might've happened to Akaro. Even if he'd been able to travel through time, it wouldn't have made things much different, since that would mean we'd failed to spot the extra Akaro at some point.
entries.literal: "As the search of the fourth floor was completed without an issue, I wondered again what might've happened to Akaro. Even if he'd been able to travel through time, it wouldn't have made things much different, since that would mean we'd failed to spot the extra Akaro at some point."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, that was assuming he'd undergone a similar experience to mine. If he'd traveled much farther into the past or appeared outside the tower, we'd be unable to find him again. Maybe we'd find him outside once the shutter retracted, but we couldn't think about that until our search ended with no results.
entries.literal: "Of course, that was assuming he'd undergone a similar experience to mine. If he'd traveled much farther into the past or appeared outside the tower, we'd be unable to find him again. Maybe we'd find him outside once the shutter retracted, but we couldn't think about that until our search ended with no results."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't found traces of a single person as we stepped on the last set of stairs, and unless we wanted to toss in the possibility of someone recently teleporting upstairs, nobody could've remained anywhere but on the crystal floor. There was no point in considering that Erina and Isla could've let the culprit pass deliberately, so we put our full focus on the final floor.
entries.literal: "We hadn't found traces of a single person as we stepped on the last set of stairs, and unless we wanted to toss in the possibility of someone recently teleporting upstairs, nobody could've remained anywhere but on the crystal floor. There was no point in considering that Erina and Isla could've let the culprit pass deliberately, so we put our full focus on the final floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You two stay here again. We'll do this quickly.
entries.literal: "You two stay here again. We'll do this quickly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were about to begin when something caught our attention. From where we were, we could see that the door to the men's bathroom was slightly open.
entries.literal: "We were about to begin when something caught our attention. From where we were, we could see that the door to the men's bathroom was slightly open."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did we leave it like that...?
entries.literal: "Did we leave it like that...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The rest of us weren't sure either, but we'd all felt something was off. We still instructed Erina and Isla to stay next to the stairs and approached the bathroom with caution.
entries.literal: "The rest of us weren't sure either, but we'd all felt something was off. We still instructed Erina and Isla to stay next to the stairs and approached the bathroom with caution."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as we peeked inside, we knew we'd been right: the door had been opened farther. Next to Naomi's body was the toilet, and on top of it, Akaro sat, focusing his gaze on the wall in front of him.{w} When he noticed us, he slowly turned his head to the door and stood up.
entries.literal: "As soon as we peeked inside, we knew we'd been right: the door had been opened farther. Next to Naomi's body was the toilet, and on top of it, Akaro sat, focusing his gaze on the wall in front of him.{w} When he noticed us, he slowly turned his head to the door and stood up."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Akaro? What are you doing?
entries.literal: "...Akaro? What are you doing?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: By which she means, where the fuck did you go?
entries.literal: "By which she means, where the fuck did you go?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}He barely reacted to our presence.{w} ...He slowly turned his head again and spent a few seconds in silence until he acknowledged us.
entries.literal: "...{w}He barely reacted to our presence.{w} ...He slowly turned his head again and spent a few seconds in silence until he acknowledged us."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hey. I have a question...
entries.literal: "Hey. I have a question..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He took a bit of time to stand up. Maintaining a plain expression and breathing deeply, seemingly to calm his nerves, he spoke.
entries.literal: "He took a bit of time to stand up. Maintaining a plain expression and breathing deeply, seemingly to calm his nerves, he spoke."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Sai, you had a wristwatch, right? What... time is it?
entries.literal: "Sai, you had a wristwatch, right? What... time is it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What?{w} It's {time=11:36.}
entries.literal: "What?{w} It's {time=11:36.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {time=11:36.} So it had been sixteen minutes since we'd heard the noise in the event room. It felt like more time had passed since the contents of those minutes had been dense, but it didn't seem wrong.
entries.literal: "{time=11:36.} So it had been sixteen minutes since we'd heard the noise in the event room. It felt like more time had passed since the contents of those minutes had been dense, but it didn't seem wrong."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: {time=11:36}, I see. Of course, it appears you were wrong, Atsuki. We didn't travel through time...
entries.literal: "{time=11:36}, I see. Of course, it appears you were wrong, Atsuki. We didn't travel through time..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: "We"? Did you travel too?
entries.literal: "\"We\"? Did you travel too?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No, I just said I didn't. I think... we just hallucinated or something...
entries.literal: "No, I just said I didn't. I think... we just hallucinated or something..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh...! Akaro, where were you?
entries.literal: "Oh...! Akaro, where were you?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: We were looking for you.
entries.literal: "We were looking for you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina and Isla came to us once they realized we'd found something. From where we were, we could still see the stairs, so if someone went up, we'd at least spot them.
entries.literal: "Erina and Isla came to us once they realized we'd found something. From where we were, we could still see the stairs, so if someone went up, we'd at least spot them."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You hallucinated...? What exactly happened, and why did you disappear?
entries.literal: "You hallucinated...? What exactly happened, and why did you disappear?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I disappeared? Right, it seemed as if I teleported, and I heard some noise. I was still here, though, and after that... I just waited here until you appeared.
entries.literal: "I disappeared? Right, it seemed as if I teleported, and I heard some noise. I was still here, though, and after that... I just waited here until you appeared."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Why did you wait here? What made you teleport?
entries.literal: "...Why did you wait here? What made you teleport?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For some reason, Akaro was somewhat unresponsive. Was the cause... the teleportation itself? It might've been a shock, but at no point had I experienced a similar effect.
entries.literal: "For some reason, Akaro was somewhat unresponsive. Was the cause... the teleportation itself? It might've been a shock, but at no point had I experienced a similar effect."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I looked around the hallways a bit, and then I felt like waiting here. And I'm not sure what caused it. Maybe... it was the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I looked around the hallways a bit, and then I felt like waiting here. And I'm not sure what caused it. Maybe... it was the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you sure? We touched it right before you vanished and nothing happened.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? We touched it right before you vanished and nothing happened."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well, yeah... I'm not sure, then.
entries.literal: "Well, yeah... I'm not sure, then."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It doesn't make sense. I thought about it earlier.{w} If you touched the Sekimeiya, why was it shut in the cabinet after you disappeared?
entries.literal: "It doesn't make sense. I thought about it earlier.{w} If you touched the Sekimeiya, why was it shut in the cabinet after you disappeared?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Huh...?{w} I don't know.
entries.literal: "Huh...?{w} I don't know."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Akaro, just tell us exactly what happened.
entries.literal: "Akaro, just tell us exactly what happened."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I am. It seemed as if I teleported, and then I searched around a bit, very confused. ...I waited in here until you showed up. Nothing else, and the time makes it clear: I didn't time travel. At most, I could have teleported, but I think something was wrong with me, and I imagined it.
entries.literal: "I am. It seemed as if I teleported, and then I searched around a bit, very confused. ...I waited in here until you showed up. Nothing else, and the time makes it clear: I didn't time travel. At most, I could have teleported, but I think something was wrong with me, and I imagined it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You didn't imagine anything. You actually disappeared.
entries.literal: "You didn't imagine anything. You actually disappeared."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No... I did, I did imagine it. Teleporting is impossible.
entries.literal: "No... I did, I did imagine it. Teleporting is impossible."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well, we found the key to the attic. Naomi had it. We went up and looked for you, but we didn't find anything.
entries.literal: "Well, we found the key to the attic. Naomi had it. We went up and looked for you, but we didn't find anything."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea what had happened to him. Had teleporting changed him so much? It was reasonable to conclude that he was making it all up. The Sekimeiya hadn't worked for us, so why would he have been able to travel? And according to him, he hadn't moved through time, just space...
entries.literal: "I had no idea what had happened to him. Had teleporting changed him so much? It was reasonable to conclude that he was making it all up. The Sekimeiya hadn't worked for us, so why would he have been able to travel? And according to him, he hadn't moved through time, just space..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: In other news, these shoes match. It's likely Naomi was in the attic.
entries.literal: "In other news, these shoes match. It's likely Naomi was in the attic."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Shiroya, don't you want to cover her body again?
entries.literal: "...Shiroya, don't you want to cover her body again?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh...? Oh, yes, we should do that too.
entries.literal: "Huh...? Oh, yes, we should do that too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...We all looked at each other, wondering what to think. No cameras existed in the bathroom, but since they were functional in hallway C, it was probably fine to at least do that much. However, Akaro's question had come out of left field.
entries.literal: "...We all looked at each other, wondering what to think. No cameras existed in the bathroom, but since they were functional in hallway C, it was probably fine to at least do that much. However, Akaro's question had come out of left field."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Shiroya went off on their own. They came back at the same time, and Shiroya was holding a velvet curtain.
entries.literal: "Sai and Shiroya went off on their own. They came back at the same time, and Shiroya was holding a velvet curtain."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The Sekimeiya's still there. I touched it too, and nothing happened.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya's still there. I touched it too, and nothing happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Akaro, did you touch it? What caused your teleportation?
entries.literal: "Akaro, did you touch it? What caused your teleportation?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I did. I think touching it is what triggered it.
entries.literal: "I did. I think touching it is what triggered it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Why did you touch it? Didn't we all go to the next room? We had just touched it too.
entries.literal: "Why did you touch it? Didn't we all go to the next room? We had just touched it too."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you wanna steal it, maybe?
entries.literal: "Did you wanna steal it, maybe?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Shiroya covered Naomi's body with the curtain, Akaro took a few seconds to think about it.
entries.literal: "As Shiroya covered Naomi's body with the curtain, Akaro took a few seconds to think about it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I was only curious since I hadn't personally touched it yet. I didn't expect anything to happen.
entries.literal: "I was only curious since I hadn't personally touched it yet. I didn't expect anything to happen."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: And where did you appear? We searched for you.
entries.literal: "And where did you appear? We searched for you."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Somewhere in hallway C, I think.
entries.literal: "...Somewhere in hallway C, I think."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not possible. We searched all around this floor, and you weren't here.
entries.literal: "That's not possible. We searched all around this floor, and you weren't here."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, that's right. I did see and hear you searching, but you didn't see me. I never left this floor...
entries.literal: "Oh, that's right. I did see and hear you searching, but you didn't see me. I never left this floor..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...What? That should be impossible.
entries.literal: "...What? That should be impossible."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It's not, because it's what I experienced myself... After that, I stayed here until now.
entries.literal: "It's not, because it's what I experienced myself... After that, I stayed here until now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea how to interpret what he was saying.{w} At my side, Naomi's body rested under a beautiful cloth that practically occupied the entire bathroom floor. Given the surroundings, it wasn't the most respectful thing, but we couldn't do much else for her.
entries.literal: "I had no idea how to interpret what he was saying.{w} At my side, Naomi's body rested under a beautiful cloth that practically occupied the entire bathroom floor. Given the surroundings, it wasn't the most respectful thing, but we couldn't do much else for her."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...So you didn't see the culprit? Or go to the other floors? We entered the attic. ...Don't you want to go?
entries.literal: "...So you didn't see the culprit? Or go to the other floors? We entered the attic. ...Don't you want to go?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No... not yet. You guys go, and I'll follow in a bit.
entries.literal: "No... not yet. You guys go, and I'll follow in a bit."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We can wait for you.
entries.literal: "We can wait for you."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No, please, leave me alone for a bit longer. I'm still a bit curious about what this attic might be, so I'll go up shortly.
entries.literal: "No, please, leave me alone for a bit longer. I'm still a bit curious about what this attic might be, so I'll go up shortly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you serious? You'll have some explaining to do.
entries.literal: "Are you serious? You'll have some explaining to do."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes... Just leave me here for now.
entries.literal: "Yes... Just leave me here for now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of us hesitated, baffled. We'd expected to get answers from Akaro if we found him, but he'd only given us more questions. It was possible he was just acting, but that wouldn't explain his disappearance. If he was correct, the Sekimeiya only made him travel through space...
entries.literal: "All of us hesitated, baffled. We'd expected to get answers from Akaro if we found him, but he'd only given us more questions. It was possible he was just acting, but that wouldn't explain his disappearance. If he was correct, the Sekimeiya only made him travel through space..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It couldn't be. He couldn't have appeared in hallway C, or we would've found him. ...He was either lying or had a mistaken perspective.
entries.literal: "It couldn't be. He couldn't have appeared in hallway C, or we would've found him. ...He was either lying or had a mistaken perspective."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was there any other choice? I could only theorize that maybe our perspective was wrong instead, but I couldn't come up with an explanation beyond that.
entries.literal: "Was there any other choice? I could only theorize that maybe our perspective was wrong instead, but I couldn't come up with an explanation beyond that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't content with Sai's claim, so I made sure to check the event room. The mysterious egg was still inside the cabinet, and as Sai had done, I went ahead and touched it, receiving no response.
entries.literal: "I wasn't content with Sai's claim, so I made sure to check the event room. The mysterious egg was still inside the cabinet, and as Sai had done, I went ahead and touched it, receiving no response."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lowered the curtain again and headed toward the stairs.
entries.literal: "I lowered the curtain again and headed toward the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why would it have worked for Akaro? Why had it worked for me the other time? And what about when Naomi traveled, since it was basically confirmed that she appeared in the attic...? Was there a recurring factor among the times it had worked?
entries.literal: "Why would it have worked for Akaro? Why had it worked for me the other time? And what about when Naomi traveled, since it was basically confirmed that she appeared in the attic...? Was there a recurring factor among the times it had worked?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ultimately, we went up again. We hoped that Akaro would soon regain his composure so that we could draw more information out of him, but if he truly wasn't stable, it was best to leave him be. We told him that the elevator might still be disabled by the time he decided to go up and that we'd leave the door on floor 6 unlocked.
entries.literal: "Ultimately, we went up again. We hoped that Akaro would soon regain his composure so that we could draw more information out of him, but if he truly wasn't stable, it was best to leave him be. We told him that the elevator might still be disabled by the time he decided to go up and that we'd leave the door on floor 6 unlocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We moved back up, unaware of what our goal had become and knowing that we hadn't thoroughly inspected the crystal floor. It was technically possible someone remained down there, as the sound we'd heard in the event room was yet to be explained, but we decided to ignore that and go along with what Akaro asked.
entries.literal: "We moved back up, unaware of what our goal had become and knowing that we hadn't thoroughly inspected the crystal floor. It was technically possible someone remained down there, as the sound we'd heard in the event room was yet to be explained, but we decided to ignore that and go along with what Akaro asked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Going up and down the stairs so often was getting tiring, but we couldn't take the elevator.
entries.literal: "Going up and down the stairs so often was getting tiring, but we couldn't take the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had Akaro really only teleported without moving through time? I kept circling around that detail.{w} Since we knew barely anything about the mechanism behind the Sekimeiya, I couldn't definitely object. However, I estimated that I went about twenty minutes to the past. If that was variable, it was possible Akaro hadn't realized he'd gone less than a minute to the past thanks to the time on Sai's wristwatch.
entries.literal: "Had Akaro really only teleported without moving through time? I kept circling around that detail.{w} Since we knew barely anything about the mechanism behind the Sekimeiya, I couldn't definitely object. However, I estimated that I went about twenty minutes to the past. If that was variable, it was possible Akaro hadn't realized he'd gone less than a minute to the past thanks to the time on Sai's wristwatch."

entries.text: Walls Of Glass
entries.literal: "Walls Of Glass"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the attic again. We'd left the door unlocked, and the key was still inserted in its hole. Since we didn't have anything in mind, we dispersed ourselves throughout the few rooms, waiting for Akaro's arrival.
entries.literal: "We entered the attic again. We'd left the door unlocked, and the key was still inserted in its hole. Since we didn't have anything in mind, we dispersed ourselves throughout the few rooms, waiting for Akaro's arrival."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Katei remained in the living room while Shiroya, Erina, Isla, and I entered the right bedroom. We'd been a group earlier, so staying together felt right. Shiroya and I threw ourselves onto the spacious bed and tried to rest for a bit, both of us pretty worn down.
entries.literal: "Sai and Katei remained in the living room while Shiroya, Erina, Isla, and I entered the right bedroom. We'd been a group earlier, so staying together felt right. Shiroya and I threw ourselves onto the spacious bed and tried to rest for a bit, both of us pretty worn down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other two mimicked us and sat at our side.
entries.literal: "The other two mimicked us and sat at our side."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: *yawn*
entries.literal: "*yawn*"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you tired?
entries.literal: "Are you tired?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes... I hate waking up so early. Mom made me set my alarm to {time=6.}
entries.literal: "Yes... I hate waking up so early. Mom made me set my alarm to {time=6.}"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That early? Do you live far from the tower?
entries.literal: "That early? Do you live far from the tower?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No, but I knew a lot of people would come today. I wanted us to be some of the first visitors so that I could drop Isla off at school afterward.
entries.literal: "No, but I knew a lot of people would come today. I wanted us to be some of the first visitors so that I could drop Isla off at school afterward."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see. You must be pretty happy that you'll get to skip the entire school day.
entries.literal: "I see. You must be pretty happy that you'll get to skip the entire school day."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah, but I already knew that would happen.
entries.literal: "Yeah, but I already knew that would happen."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Oh, right.
entries.literal: "...Oh, right."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So, is this the first time you came here?
entries.literal: "So, is this the first time you came here?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yup. I didn't know this place was so cool.
entries.literal: "Yup. I didn't know this place was so cool."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's surprising. With how much you seem to like gemstones, I figured you would've come here before.
entries.literal: "That's surprising. With how much you seem to like gemstones, I figured you would've come here before."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She's had many passing interests. She just got back from school one day and told me she wanted to come to this place.
entries.literal: "She's had many passing interests. She just got back from school one day and told me she wanted to come to this place."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Because Amelie came to school with a really pretty bracelet. She said it was... uh, athemist like the ones in Ashiya Tower. She let everyone touch it but me. I don't know why, but she doesn't like me.
entries.literal: "Because Amelie came to school with a really pretty bracelet. She said it was... uh, athemist like the ones in Ashiya Tower. She let everyone touch it but me. I don't know why, but she doesn't like me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I see. That's why you looked so happy downstairs.
entries.literal: "...I see. That's why you looked so happy downstairs."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I actually told her that I didn't want to bring her here at first. I should've just stuck to that, but she kept mentioning it, and when she's infatuated with something, she doesn't talk about anything else. ...I caved in too quickly.
entries.literal: "I actually told her that I didn't want to bring her here at first. I should've just stuck to that, but she kept mentioning it, and when she's infatuated with something, she doesn't talk about anything else. ...I caved in too quickly."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: That was only when Amelie said that her parents wouldn't let her go see the Sekimeiya. She was saying really ugly things about her mom, but she always buys her anything she asks for. I don't get it.
entries.literal: "That was only when Amelie said that her parents wouldn't let her go see the Sekimeiya. She was saying really ugly things about her mom, but she always buys her anything she asks for. I don't get it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's good that you're not like that. I'm sure she'll be embarrassed about that when she's older.
entries.literal: "It's good that you're not like that. I'm sure she'll be embarrassed about that when she's older."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Everyone really likes her, though. I don't hate her, but she's really mean sometimes.
entries.literal: "Everyone really likes her, though. I don't hate her, but she's really mean sometimes."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So you live in Yushibana, right? You probably go to the same school Atsuki and I attended. There were some people like that when we were your age, but they all matured eventually. I think that's an effect of there being so few people.
entries.literal: "So you live in Yushibana, right? You probably go to the same school Atsuki and I attended. There were some people like that when we were your age, but they all matured eventually. I think that's an effect of there being so few people."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh! You went to my school? Do you know Miss Bisky?
entries.literal: "Oh! You went to my school? Do you know Miss Bisky?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The teacher?
entries.literal: "The teacher?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah!
entries.literal: "Yeah!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: She still works there? I remember her, yeah. She was always really nice to us.
entries.literal: "She still works there? I remember her, yeah. She was always really nice to us."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: She's my favorite teacher. I'll tell her that I met you two.
entries.literal: "She's my favorite teacher. I'll tell her that I met you two."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm surprised she's still there. She was pretty old when she taught us.
entries.literal: "I'm surprised she's still there. She was pretty old when she taught us."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She knew we were going to come here, so she might be a bit worried if she heard about what happened. She's usually the person behind Isla's sudden interests. One day, she told her that she had an aquarium at home. The next few weeks, I didn't hear about anything except wanting to go to an aquarium.
entries.literal: "She knew we were going to come here, so she might be a bit worried if she heard about what happened. She's usually the person behind Isla's sudden interests. One day, she told her that she had an aquarium at home. The next few weeks, I didn't hear about anything except wanting to go to an aquarium."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Do you remember how interested you became in fish out of nowhere? Where did that passion go? Did you read all the books I bought you?
entries.literal: "Do you remember how interested you became in fish out of nowhere? Where did that passion go? Did you read all the books I bought you?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I still love them! And yes, I read all of them. Did you know that fish can get sunburned when they're near the surface?
entries.literal: "I still love them! And yes, I read all of them. Did you know that fish can get sunburned when they're near the surface?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I prefer them pan-seared.{w} Why are you all on the bed? We didn't inspect this floor that thoroughly, so you should be looking for clues.
entries.literal: "I prefer them pan-seared.{w} Why are you all on the bed? We didn't inspect this floor that thoroughly, so you should be looking for clues."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why don't you do that?
entries.literal: "Why don't you do that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sorry, I need to keep my eyes on Katei in case he kills Naomi a third time. Let me know if you find something.
entries.literal: "Sorry, I need to keep my eyes on Katei in case he kills Naomi a third time. Let me know if you find something."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...Sai is so weird.
entries.literal: "...Sai is so weird."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, maybe you should forget what I said about people here maturing.
entries.literal: "Yeah, maybe you should forget what I said about people here maturing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He doesn't go to our school, right? He's around our age, and I don't think I've seen him before.
entries.literal: "He doesn't go to our school, right? He's around our age, and I don't think I've seen him before."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: He might go to the one outside town. I don't know him either.
entries.literal: "He might go to the one outside town. I don't know him either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of doing what Sai said, we reclined on the bed. Unlike me, Shiroya had always been good at dealing with kids. The tone of her voice changed significantly when she talked to Isla. I wished the conversation would continue just so that I could keep hearing it.
entries.literal: "Instead of doing what Sai said, we reclined on the bed. Unlike me, Shiroya had always been good at dealing with kids. The tone of her voice changed significantly when she talked to Isla. I wished the conversation would continue just so that I could keep hearing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The three of them had all been holding something to contain their belongings. Just like Sai had his hip pack, Shiroya carried a modest purse she'd had for a long time. Isla had a child-sized shoulder purse, and Erina had a bigger, black purse with her.
entries.literal: "The three of them had all been holding something to contain their belongings. Just like Sai had his hip pack, Shiroya carried a modest purse she'd had for a long time. Isla had a child-sized shoulder purse, and Erina had a bigger, black purse with her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something caught my attention, so I stood back up.
entries.literal: "Something caught my attention, so I stood back up."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What are you looking at? That's mine.
entries.literal: "What are you looking at? That's mine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see inside Shiroya's or Erina's, but Isla's had remained slightly open while she was lying face-up. Inside, something felt out of place.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see inside Shiroya's or Erina's, but Isla's had remained slightly open while she was lying face-up. Inside, something felt out of place."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What's that for?
entries.literal: "What's that for?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm? That's my purse. I don't use it every day, but I took it today.
entries.literal: "Hm? That's my purse. I don't use it every day, but I took it today."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I mean that device.
entries.literal: "I mean that device."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Device? What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "...Device? What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina and Isla got up and frowned when they saw what had intrigued me.
entries.literal: "Erina and Isla got up and frowned when they saw what had intrigued me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Oh, is that a recorder? It has a play and record button.
entries.literal: "...Oh, is that a recorder? It has a play and record button."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What...? I don't know. I've never seen it.
entries.literal: "What...? I don't know. I've never seen it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It was inside your purse. Where did you get it?
entries.literal: "It was inside your purse. Where did you get it?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I just said I've never seen it before... I don't know what it's doing here.
entries.literal: "I just said I've never seen it before... I don't know what it's doing here."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Are you making things up again? What's it doing in your purse if you've never seen it before?
entries.literal: "...Are you making things up again? What's it doing in your purse if you've never seen it before?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I'm telling you that I don't know!
entries.literal: "I'm telling you that I don't know!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't very big, but it occupied most of the space in the purse. It was hard to believe anyone could've dropped it inside while Isla had been wearing it, and I hadn't seen her leaving it behind anywhere and giving someone an opportunity to plant an object in it. Shiroya grabbed the device and began to fiddle with it.
entries.literal: "It wasn't very big, but it occupied most of the space in the purse. It was hard to believe anyone could've dropped it inside while Isla had been wearing it, and I hadn't seen her leaving it behind anywhere and giving someone an opportunity to plant an object in it. Shiroya grabbed the device and began to fiddle with it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There's a record button and a recording saved. I think we can listen to it. This seems to be a speaker.
entries.literal: "There's a record button and a recording saved. I think we can listen to it. This seems to be a speaker."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On one side of the recorder, a symbol indicated that audio could come out of it. On the back was a slot for an SD card, but there wasn't one inserted.
entries.literal: "On one side of the recorder, a symbol indicated that audio could come out of it. On the back was a slot for an SD card, but there wasn't one inserted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Shiroya pressed the "record" button, a message appeared. It said: "Delete previous recording before starting a new one".{w} Instead of doing that, Shiroya selected the single audio track with the circle pad and pressed the play button.
entries.literal: "When Shiroya pressed the \"record\" button, a message appeared. It said: \"Delete previous recording before starting a new one\".{w} Instead of doing that, Shiroya selected the single audio track with the circle pad and pressed the play button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A time bar appeared on the screen. Static started playing immediately, and we frowned, waiting for something else to happen.{w} On the screen, the seconds ticked up for a while as the static went on. ...Were we hearing footsteps?{w} Eventually, that noise was interrupted by a very loud one. It sounded as if someone had sat right next to us. Then, that person heaved a sigh, and as soon as they started speaking, we recognized who they were.
entries.literal: "A time bar appeared on the screen. Static started playing immediately, and we frowned, waiting for something else to happen.{w} On the screen, the seconds ticked up for a while as the static went on. ...Were we hearing footsteps?{w} Eventually, that noise was interrupted by a very loud one. It sounded as if someone had sat right next to us. Then, that person heaved a sigh, and as soon as they started speaking, we recognized who they were."

entries.speaker: ak2
entries.text: Well... what do we do now?
entries.literal: "Well... what do we do now?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We immediately recognized it as Akaro's voice.
entries.literal: "We immediately recognized it as Akaro's voice."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Wh-Why did I have this?
entries.literal: "Wh-Why did I have this?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Does it show the date anywhere?
entries.literal: "Does it show the date anywhere?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No... there's nothing like that.
entries.literal: "No... there's nothing like that."

entries.speaker: sai2
entries.text: What do you want to do? We might've been here for more than a month and the exit's not open. Unless you wanna take down the shutter by hand, we can only keep waiting.
entries.literal: "What do you want to do? We might've been here for more than a month and the exit's not open. Unless you wanna take down the shutter by hand, we can only keep waiting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya's eyes met mine in disbelief. "More than a month"? Our fear was amplified by the next sentence we heard.
entries.literal: "Shiroya's eyes met mine in disbelief. \"More than a month\"? Our fear was amplified by the next sentence we heard."

entries.speaker: ak2
entries.text: I don't get it. What the hell happened? Did Ashiya just abandon their own building with us inside...? And we thought we'd be free after twelve hours...
entries.literal: "I don't get it. What the hell happened? Did Ashiya just abandon their own building with us inside...? And we thought we'd be free after twelve hours..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What...!? Th-This can't mean...?
entries.literal: "What...!? Th-This can't mean...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And once again, the recording hammered us with the hardest hit yet.
entries.literal: "And once again, the recording hammered us with the hardest hit yet."

entries.speaker: sai2
entries.text: Atsuki, what are you thinking about? Do you have any more ideas...? And hey, Erina, what's with that face?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, what are you thinking about? Do you have any more ideas...? And hey, Erina, what's with that face?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It almost seemed as if Sai had been talking to us directly. We were speechless, wondering if we were there too.
entries.literal: "It almost seemed as if Sai had been talking to us directly. We were speechless, wondering if we were there too."

entries.speaker: ak2
entries.text: What, not going to answer?
entries.literal: "What, not going to answer?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, we heard the recorder play the sound of a door being pushed, and following it, gasps. Expressions of pure shock filled our ears, which perfectly conveyed the bewilderment shared by everyone who'd been recorded.
entries.literal: "Then, we heard the recorder play the sound of a door being pushed, and following it, gasps. Expressions of pure shock filled our ears, which perfectly conveyed the bewilderment shared by everyone who'd been recorded."

entries.speaker: sai2
entries.text: Isla...! What the hell!?
entries.literal: "Isla...! What the hell!?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...? Isla, when did this happen?
entries.literal: "What...? Isla, when did this happen?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She indicated that she had no idea with a gesture, so we kept waiting while the device emitted nothing but silence.
entries.literal: "She indicated that she had no idea with a gesture, so we kept waiting while the device emitted nothing but silence."

entries.speaker: ak2
entries.text: Hey, answer us...! Wh-What are you looking at!?
entries.literal: "Hey, answer us...! Wh-What are you looking at!?"

entries.speaker: il2
entries.text: ...{w}Where am I...?
entries.literal: "...{w}Where am I...?"

entries.speaker: sai2
entries.text: Wh-What do you mean? We're still in Ashiya Tower. Do you not remember?
entries.literal: "Wh-What do you mean? We're still in Ashiya Tower. Do you not remember?"

entries.speaker: il2
entries.text: No, I know. What I mean is... what happened to me? Where am I?
entries.literal: "No, I know. What I mean is... what happened to me? Where am I?"

entries.speaker: ak2
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro's confusion must've been shared by the rest of us. What kind of question was that, regardless of the context?
entries.literal: "Akaro's confusion must've been shared by the rest of us. What kind of question was that, regardless of the context?"

entries.speaker: il2
entries.text: No... I should be...
entries.literal: "No... I should be..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Following that, there were a couple of unsteady, heavy footfalls, most likely someone staggering. During the next few seconds, Isla cried, and nobody spoke, inside or outside the recording.
entries.literal: "Following that, there were a couple of unsteady, heavy footfalls, most likely someone staggering. During the next few seconds, Isla cried, and nobody spoke, inside or outside the recording."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Huh...?{w} I've never... done this.
entries.literal: "Huh...?{w} I've never... done this."

entries.speaker: ak2
entries.text: I-Isla, what's gotten into you? ...What are you holding?{w} And Erina, why aren't you doing anything!?
entries.literal: "I-Isla, what's gotten into you? ...What are you holding?{w} And Erina, why aren't you doing anything!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a final sob... the recording ended.{w} The screen left us with a button to rewind the audio, and we remained motionless, with expressions we'd never worn before.
entries.literal: "With a final sob... the recording ended.{w} The screen left us with a button to rewind the audio, and we remained motionless, with expressions we'd never worn before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd fallen unconscious from a smoke attack, probably traveled to the past, and found two dead bodies that belonged to the same person. However, the sensation left by that bizarre recording surpassed all of those.
entries.literal: "I'd fallen unconscious from a smoke attack, probably traveled to the past, and found two dead bodies that belonged to the same person. However, the sensation left by that bizarre recording surpassed all of those."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...It said that we'd be here for over a month. It's not possible, right? Even if the exit doesn't open, the people outside would find a way to rescue us.
entries.literal: "...It said that we'd be here for over a month. It's not possible, right? Even if the exit doesn't open, the people outside would find a way to rescue us."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Y-Yes. This must be a trap created by Sai and Akaro.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes. This must be a trap created by Sai and Akaro."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Usually, I would have also jumped to that possibility, but Isla was in that recording too. Could she have been in on it?
entries.literal: "Usually, I would have also jumped to that possibility, but Isla was in that recording too. Could she have been in on it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remembered Isla's "friend". Were Sai and Akaro somehow involved in everything?
entries.literal: "I remembered Isla's \"friend\". Were Sai and Akaro somehow involved in everything?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You and Atsuki were mentioned as if you were there, but you didn't actually say anything. And Katei and I weren't mentioned at all, but with how short it was, that doesn't mean anything.
entries.literal: "You and Atsuki were mentioned as if you were there, but you didn't actually say anything. And Katei and I weren't mentioned at all, but with how short it was, that doesn't mean anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't mean anything, but it was still unsettling. According to the recorded Sai, I'd been quiet for a while and Erina's behavior had also been strange.
entries.literal: "It didn't mean anything, but it was still unsettling. According to the recorded Sai, I'd been quiet for a while and Erina's behavior had also been strange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If we were to believe the contents of the recording, it meant that it had somehow traveled to the past from one month in the future. I couldn't even imagine why and how that would've happened.
entries.literal: "If we were to believe the contents of the recording, it meant that it had somehow traveled to the past from one month in the future. I couldn't even imagine why and how that would've happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Isla, sorry to ask again, but be as honest as you can. Have you really never seen this device? Have you really never spoken the words we just heard? And do you really not know anything about it?
entries.literal: "Isla, sorry to ask again, but be as honest as you can. Have you really never seen this device? Have you really never spoken the words we just heard? And do you really not know anything about it?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I promise... I have no idea where this came from, and I never said any of that... You believe me, Tanya, right?
entries.literal: "I promise... I have no idea where this came from, and I never said any of that... You believe me, Tanya, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-Yes, but this is surreal.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes, but this is surreal."

entries.speaker: i
