entries.text: Isla had begun to sound like she had in the recording, trying not to break down. The four of us had just been handed a month-long sentence with no bail, and it sounded as if it could be extended indefinitely.
entries.literal: "Isla had begun to sound like she had in the recording, trying not to break down. The four of us had just been handed a month-long sentence with no bail, and it sounded as if it could be extended indefinitely."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't worry. This recording must've been manipulated. There are plenty of things in it that don't make sense.
entries.literal: "Don't worry. This recording must've been manipulated. There are plenty of things in it that don't make sense."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Of course, as Shiroya said, we'll be rescued if things go wrong when the exit is supposed to open. There's no food here, so it's impossible we could be here for an entire month. Akaro and Sai sounded perfectly healthy, didn't they?
entries.literal: "Of course, as Shiroya said, we'll be rescued if things go wrong when the exit is supposed to open. There's no food here, so it's impossible we could be here for an entire month. Akaro and Sai sounded perfectly healthy, didn't they?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's right. I bet they didn't think this through. There's still nine hours until we can leave, but no more than that. Don't believe any of this, Isla. We're fine. We'll all be fine.
entries.literal: "That's right. I bet they didn't think this through. There's still nine hours until we can leave, but no more than that. Don't believe any of this, Isla. We're fine. We'll all be fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like Isla, I was looking forward to making it out a lot more than I appeared. I wanted my life to get back on track and go to the mountains with Shiroya as we'd agreed.
entries.literal: "Like Isla, I was looking forward to making it out a lot more than I appeared. I wanted my life to get back on track and go to the mountains with Shiroya as we'd agreed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The thought of remaining imprisoned crushed down on my shoulders. We had come to the tower for the purpose of getting a fresh start, and the recording threatened to turn all of that on its head once again.
entries.literal: "The thought of remaining imprisoned crushed down on my shoulders. We had come to the tower for the purpose of getting a fresh start, and the recording threatened to turn all of that on its head once again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I believe we heard something else that stood out. Apart from what Isla said, the way Sai phrased it...{w} "We might've been here for more than a month."{w} ...This "might've" is very odd.
entries.literal: "I believe we heard something else that stood out. Apart from what Isla said, the way Sai phrased it...{w} \"We might've been here for more than a month.\"{w} ...This \"might've\" is very odd."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, that's right... Why would he not be sure?
entries.literal: "Oh, that's right... Why would he not be sure?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's true that we could easily lose track of time after spending a month locked in here, but we could know how long it's been just by looking at the date.
entries.literal: "It's true that we could easily lose track of time after spending a month locked in here, but we could know how long it's been just by looking at the date."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: And on the crystal floor, we have a computer that displays it. Even Sai himself has a watch in case the computer stopped working.
entries.literal: "And on the crystal floor, we have a computer that displays it. Even Sai himself has a watch in case the computer stopped working."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It has to be a trick, and one that's easy to see right through. Someone must've put this recorder in your purse.
entries.literal: "It has to be a trick, and one that's easy to see right through. Someone must've put this recorder in your purse."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Do you know when that could've happened?
entries.literal: "Do you know when that could've happened?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No... I had it the whole time since we left home.
entries.literal: "No... I had it the whole time since we left home."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: When you entered the tower, a guard looked at your purse, right? Do you remember if it was there?
entries.literal: "When you entered the tower, a guard looked at your purse, right? Do you remember if it was there?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I-I don't know. I didn't look, I just gave it to him.
entries.literal: "I-I don't know. I didn't look, I just gave it to him."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Isla, mind telling us the identity of your friend now? She could've had access to it, and somehow, she knew this incident would happen. Not only that, but she lied to you, right? About the number of people and when she said that nothing bad would happen.
entries.literal: "...{w}Isla, mind telling us the identity of your friend now? She could've had access to it, and somehow, she knew this incident would happen. Not only that, but she lied to you, right? About the number of people and when she said that nothing bad would happen."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: N-No! She has nothing to do with this, I promise! She was wrong, but she didn't lie. She's waiting for me outside, and I don't wanna leave her alone for long. Christmas is in ten days, and we promised we'd spend it together...
entries.literal: "N-No! She has nothing to do with this, I promise! She was wrong, but she didn't lie. She's waiting for me outside, and I don't wanna leave her alone for long. Christmas is in ten days, and we promised we'd spend it together..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could press her further, the door opened and Sai appeared with Katei behind him. They forcibly stepped in and closed the door again.
entries.literal: "Before I could press her further, the door opened and Sai appeared with Katei behind him. They forcibly stepped in and closed the door again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey guys. I found a little thing.
entries.literal: "Hey guys. I found a little thing."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Can you just say what it is already?
entries.literal: "Can you just say what it is already?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, that's why we came here. It wouldn't have been the same without them.
entries.literal: "Yes, that's why we came here. It wouldn't have been the same without them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about it. Was Sai hiding something from us? If he was, it must've been something pretty significant.
entries.literal: "I thought about it. Was Sai hiding something from us? If he was, it must've been something pretty significant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of asking questions, we waited for what he had to say. While he wasn't paying attention, Erina put the recorder back inside Isla's purse to avoid being questioned. Isla and Erina could easily be called suspicious if anyone knew they had it.
entries.literal: "Instead of asking questions, we waited for what he had to say. While he wasn't paying attention, Erina put the recorder back inside Isla's purse to avoid being questioned. Isla and Erina could easily be called suspicious if anyone knew they had it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who wants to read this?
entries.literal: "Who wants to read this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was holding a folded piece of paper. Since there were no volunteers, he handed it to me.
entries.literal: "Sai was holding a folded piece of paper. Since there were no volunteers, he handed it to me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You've been chosen. I found this in a drawer in the kitchen.
entries.literal: "You've been chosen. I found this in a drawer in the kitchen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed faintly and began to read.
entries.literal: "I sighed faintly and began to read."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: "Sir, I have done as you instructed, and I didn't spot any difference in the attic since Xyn's last attack. I believe it wasn't targeted."
entries.literal: "\"Sir, I have done as you instructed, and I didn't spot any difference in the attic since Xyn's last attack. I believe it wasn't targeted.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: "I've finished this month's preservations, but some paint has begun to wear off, so next month I'll attempt to fix that on my own. Until then, thank you for your trust and let me know if you have any new requests."
entries.literal: "\"I've finished this month's preservations, but some paint has begun to wear off, so next month I'll attempt to fix that on my own. Until then, thank you for your trust and let me know if you have any new requests.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: "Naomi".
entries.literal: "\"Naomi\"."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...It's a letter from Naomi?
entries.literal: "...It's a letter from Naomi?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Precisely—your ears do work. It sounds as if Naomi was tasked with keeping this attic tidy. It's addressed to the head of the Ashiya family, who must've lived here back in the day.
entries.literal: "Precisely—your ears do work. It sounds as if Naomi was tasked with keeping this attic tidy. It's addressed to the head of the Ashiya family, who must've lived here back in the day."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I see.
entries.literal: "...I see."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Understand? It means that Katei has lied yet again! It's great, he never stops. We're going to set a world record at this rate.
entries.literal: "Understand? It means that Katei has lied yet again! It's great, he never stops. We're going to set a world record at this rate."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I suppose you're right. He must've known about this, so finding the attic key in Naomi's pocket shouldn't have been a big surprise.
entries.literal: "I suppose you're right. He must've known about this, so finding the attic key in Naomi's pocket shouldn't have been a big surprise."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I didn't know. I don't look through these cameras very often, and according to this letter, she worked here once a month. It makes sense that I never saw her.
entries.literal: "I didn't know. I don't look through these cameras very often, and according to this letter, she worked here once a month. It makes sense that I never saw her."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Holy shit, Katei. You know that you're fucked once we get out, right? You said that you work here with Naomi and that she tried to personally convince you of her innocence earlier because of that.{w} ...But you didn't know what her job entailed?
entries.literal: "Holy shit, Katei. You know that you're fucked once we get out, right? You said that you work here with Naomi and that she tried to personally convince you of her innocence earlier because of that.{w} ...But you didn't know what her job entailed?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I didn't. It's not my business to know what everyone does. I certainly didn't see her often, so I never knew exactly what her work was.
entries.literal: "I didn't. It's not my business to know what everyone does. I certainly didn't see her often, so I never knew exactly what her work was."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, of course. She's probably been handling this floor by herself for years, and you, who takes care of the security of the entire building, never knew that. This letter mentions Xyn, so it must be recent enough, most likely from last month.
entries.literal: "Yeah, of course. She's probably been handling this floor by herself for years, and you, who takes care of the security of the entire building, never knew that. This letter mentions Xyn, so it must be recent enough, most likely from last month."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It must've happened when I wasn't present in the tower, since I only have the night shift every two weeks. For example, if she only came the first day of every month, I would never have seen her.
entries.literal: "It must've happened when I wasn't present in the tower, since I only have the night shift every two weeks. For example, if she only came the first day of every month, I would never have seen her."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Was it not a second ago when you said you'd seen her a few times?
entries.literal: "Was it not a second ago when you said you'd seen her a few times?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei never answered, but he looked enraged during the moments of silence that followed.
entries.literal: "Katei never answered, but he looked enraged during the moments of silence that followed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, it seems Naomi had direct communication with Ashiya and she was a trusted individual tasked with maintaining this special floor. I bet that's why she was chosen for her new job and told the secret of the Sekimeiya's true purpose.
entries.literal: "Well, it seems Naomi had direct communication with Ashiya and she was a trusted individual tasked with maintaining this special floor. I bet that's why she was chosen for her new job and told the secret of the Sekimeiya's true purpose."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...None of us appeared to care much about the letter given what we'd just heard. Sai was excited to find something that strengthened his suspicions about Katei, but we'd all accepted at some point that he was lying about a number of things. It was routine.
entries.literal: "...None of us appeared to care much about the letter given what we'd just heard. Sai was excited to find something that strengthened his suspicions about Katei, but we'd all accepted at some point that he was lying about a number of things. It was routine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We heard the sound of a zipper being unfastened coming from the bed.
entries.literal: "We heard the sound of a zipper being unfastened coming from the bed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Hey, Shiroya, what's that?
entries.literal: "...Hey, Shiroya, what's that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all turned to her and saw a key in her hand.
entries.literal: "We all turned to her and saw a key in her hand."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you get that from your purse? Isn't that...?
entries.literal: "Did you get that from your purse? Isn't that...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, it's the cabinet key. The Sekimeiya cabinet's.
entries.literal: "Yes, it's the cabinet key. The Sekimeiya cabinet's."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-I think it is. It was inside.
entries.literal: "I-I think it is. It was inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What were you looking for?
entries.literal: "What were you looking for?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, nothing. I don't know how this got here, though...
entries.literal: "Oh, nothing. I don't know how this got here, though..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She wouldn't admit it, but after Isla found something so bizarre inside her own purse, Shiroya must've felt the need to check hers too—and it yielded a result.
entries.literal: "She wouldn't admit it, but after Isla found something so bizarre inside her own purse, Shiroya must've felt the need to check hers too—and it yielded a result."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see, so you had the key. Very interesting.
entries.literal: "I see, so you had the key. Very interesting."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Someone had to put it in here without me noticing.
entries.literal: "...Someone had to put it in here without me noticing."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Is that so? Don't I get to suspect you?
entries.literal: "...Is that so? Don't I get to suspect you?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I mean, it wasn't inside, but in this side pocket that should've been empty and where anyone could've easily dropped it.
entries.literal: "I mean, it wasn't inside, but in this side pocket that should've been empty and where anyone could've easily dropped it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose you would've left it in the main section, where the zipper could hide it. I'm fine believing that.
entries.literal: "I suppose you would've left it in the main section, where the zipper could hide it. I'm fine believing that."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Before we realized that this key was missing from the first Naomi, only the real culprit or the group that inspected hallway B could've picked it up. So Shiroya, Sai, and Akaro.
entries.literal: "...Before we realized that this key was missing from the first Naomi, only the real culprit or the group that inspected hallway B could've picked it up. So Shiroya, Sai, and Akaro."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, who searched the room with Naomi?
entries.literal: "Sai, who searched the room with Naomi?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Akaro.
entries.literal: "Akaro."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So he could've picked it up and later dropped it inside Shiroya's purse. However, he couldn't have unlocked the Sekimeiya cabinet, right?
entries.literal: "So he could've picked it up and later dropped it inside Shiroya's purse. However, he couldn't have unlocked the Sekimeiya cabinet, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Yes. Nobody entered the event room.
entries.literal: "...Yes. Nobody entered the event room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Okay, then the only suspects are Sai, Akaro, and whoever the killer was. Shiroya didn't enter Naomi's room, so she couldn't have even picked that key up.
entries.literal: "Okay, then the only suspects are Sai, Akaro, and whoever the killer was. Shiroya didn't enter Naomi's room, so she couldn't have even picked that key up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Surely she could've if she killed Naomi, right? I know she's supposed to have an alibi, but remember that you traveled to the past and anyone might've been able to appear on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Surely she could've if she killed Naomi, right? I know she's supposed to have an alibi, but remember that you traveled to the past and anyone might've been able to appear on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The real suspect here is obviously Sai.{w} Akaro couldn't have done anything with the key, but Sai could've unlocked the cabinet because he was outside the hallway B rooms during the search.
entries.literal: "The real suspect here is obviously Sai.{w} Akaro couldn't have done anything with the key, but Sai could've unlocked the cabinet because he was outside the hallway B rooms during the search."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But I didn't do it, and I definitely couldn't have hidden the Sekimeiya in the storeroom, so ultimately, the only suspect here is Katei, who killed Naomi. Shiroya's been wearing her purse off to her side, so it wouldn't be too hard to hide a small key in there without her knowing.
entries.literal: "But I didn't do it, and I definitely couldn't have hidden the Sekimeiya in the storeroom, so ultimately, the only suspect here is Katei, who killed Naomi. Shiroya's been wearing her purse off to her side, so it wouldn't be too hard to hide a small key in there without her knowing."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: God! I didn't kill Naomi, and if I had to hide a key, I'd hide it in a room. If I put it in someone's purse, I'd at least make sure they could actually be suspected. Shiroya couldn't have picked it up, so there's no reason to do that.
entries.literal: "God! I didn't kill Naomi, and if I had to hide a key, I'd hide it in a room. If I put it in someone's purse, I'd at least make sure they could actually be suspected. Shiroya couldn't have picked it up, so there's no reason to do that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Can you think of who could've had the best chance to do it?
entries.literal: "Can you think of who could've had the best chance to do it?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...No. I'm sure anyone could have done it at some point.
entries.literal: "...No. I'm sure anyone could have done it at some point."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We'll have to call Akaro out when he comes. You still haven't searched around here?
entries.literal: "We'll have to call Akaro out when he comes. You still haven't searched around here?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...We haven't. What's there to find?
entries.literal: "...We haven't. What's there to find?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We search precisely to figure that out. This letter was pretty well-hidden, and there are a few drawers and hiding spots I can see around here.
entries.literal: "We search precisely to figure that out. This letter was pretty well-hidden, and there are a few drawers and hiding spots I can see around here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Fine, let me look around.
entries.literal: "Fine, let me look around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up from the bed and casually crouched to open some drawers. I could see some worn out papers, expired promotions, and some more ancient stuff that wouldn't be any use.
entries.literal: "I stood up from the bed and casually crouched to open some drawers. I could see some worn out papers, expired promotions, and some more ancient stuff that wouldn't be any use."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While everyone watched me, I moved through the drawers until something notable caught my attention. It was, again, a key.
entries.literal: "While everyone watched me, I moved through the drawers until something notable caught my attention. It was, again, a key."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you recognize this, Katei?
entries.literal: "Do you recognize this, Katei?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, yes. It's the key to this bedroom. The only one that remains.{w} The other bedroom also has one, but the keys shouldn't be interchangeable.
entries.literal: "Oh, yes. It's the key to this bedroom. The only one that remains.{w} The other bedroom also has one, but the keys shouldn't be interchangeable."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. It still won't help us much, then.
entries.literal: "I see. It still won't help us much, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I finished looking through the drawers without finding anything else. There was a wardrobe upstairs, but I didn't bother going. Instead, I looked at the door and found the keyhole I'd ignored. There was also a chain that would lock the door from the inside without needing a key.
entries.literal: "I finished looking through the drawers without finding anything else. There was a wardrobe upstairs, but I didn't bother going. Instead, I looked at the door and found the keyhole I'd ignored. There was also a chain that would lock the door from the inside without needing a key."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Wait, was there a chain in the other room as well?
entries.literal: "...Wait, was there a chain in the other room as well?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Not anymore. It broke years ago, so only this bedroom has one.
entries.literal: "Not anymore. It broke years ago, so only this bedroom has one."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh.
entries.literal: "Oh."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I'm not sure what Akaro's doing down there, but I'll look around a bit more until he comes since it's clear you're all slacking off.
entries.literal: "...I'm not sure what Akaro's doing down there, but I'll look around a bit more until he comes since it's clear you're all slacking off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure what exactly he expected to find, but he went up the ladder. It wasn't so much that we were slacking off; rather, the recording had sapped every trace of our remaining initiative.{w} I sat down again and blankly stared at my lap.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure what exactly he expected to find, but he went up the ladder. It wasn't so much that we were slacking off; rather, the recording had sapped every trace of our remaining initiative.{w} I sat down again and blankly stared at my lap."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...I can't come to a likely conclusion. How could the recording be fake? If Isla isn't hiding anything important from us, it's clear that we have to basically consider it as truthful after everything that's already happened.
entries.literal: "...I can't come to a likely conclusion. How could the recording be fake? If Isla isn't hiding anything important from us, it's clear that we have to basically consider it as truthful after everything that's already happened."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, if this recording is going to occur in the future, why did we find it now? And most importantly, why did we find it inside Isla's purse when she doesn't think anyone had the chance to put it there?
entries.literal: "However, if this recording is going to occur in the future, why did we find it now? And most importantly, why did we find it inside Isla's purse when she doesn't think anyone had the chance to put it there?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It can still be some sort of bizarre trap. One that involves Isla as a participant with the intention of making us believe we won't be free in nine hours.
entries.literal: "It can still be some sort of bizarre trap. One that involves Isla as a participant with the intention of making us believe we won't be free in nine hours."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Moreover, we've already heard the recording. If we're still here in a month, why would anyone record anything? What would the point of recording a few minutes of a random conversation be? Why would the person behind it even have a voice recorder inside the tower, and how would it travel back to us?
entries.literal: "Moreover, we've already heard the recording. If we're still here in a month, why would anyone record anything? What would the point of recording a few minutes of a random conversation be? Why would the person behind it even have a voice recorder inside the tower, and how would it travel back to us?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When I time traveled, it seemed like causal loops are the way things work. It follows that if we let Sai and Akaro listen to the recording, the chances that it'll happen in the future will vanish. There's no way they would repeat everything exactly as they heard it. Although if the twelfth hour comes and we're still trapped, we'll have to let them know what our future looks like.
entries.literal: "When I time traveled, it seemed like causal loops are the way things work. It follows that if we let Sai and Akaro listen to the recording, the chances that it'll happen in the future will vanish. There's no way they would repeat everything exactly as they heard it. Although if the twelfth hour comes and we're still trapped, we'll have to let them know what our future looks like."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My initial reaction was that not letting anyone else listen to the recording was the smarter choice. It would prevent fear, commotion, being suspected, and potentially falling into a trap.{w} That just so happened to go along nicely with the way the universe seemed to function, as letting Sai or Akaro listen to the recording could've immediately made its own existence an impossibility.
entries.literal: "My initial reaction was that not letting anyone else listen to the recording was the smarter choice. It would prevent fear, commotion, being suspected, and potentially falling into a trap.{w} That just so happened to go along nicely with the way the universe seemed to function, as letting Sai or Akaro listen to the recording could've immediately made its own existence an impossibility."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to believe it.{w} It was a chilling thought in many ways. I had a dog and a cat to take care of. Being locked away for a month would end the worst way possible if the people outside neglected both them and us at the same time.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to believe it.{w} It was a chilling thought in many ways. I had a dog and a cat to take care of. Being locked away for a month would end the worst way possible if the people outside neglected both them and us at the same time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Meanwhile, the cabinet key appearing in Shiroya's purse had a much straighter line of reasoning. I silently gestured at her so that she'd come to the hallway with me. Outside, I closed the door behind us while she looked slightly confused.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, the cabinet key appearing in Shiroya's purse had a much straighter line of reasoning. I silently gestured at her so that she'd come to the hallway with me. Outside, I closed the door behind us while she looked slightly confused."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did you think of something?
entries.literal: "Did you think of something?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sort of... I think we must have something backward. I think I know what happened with the key. ...It was put in your purse by whoever picked it up from Naomi's body.
entries.literal: "Sort of... I think we must have something backward. I think I know what happened with the key. ...It was put in your purse by whoever picked it up from Naomi's body."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, I was probably the easiest target.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I was probably the easiest target."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Exactly, which is why if the person who killed Naomi did it, they wouldn't have chosen you. They would've chosen a possible suspect or a spot within a room that a suspect had access to.
entries.literal: "Exactly, which is why if the person who killed Naomi did it, they wouldn't have chosen you. They would've chosen a possible suspect or a spot within a room that a suspect had access to."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The first time it disappeared, the Sekimeiya was in a cabinet in the room where Naomi died. However, the cabinet in the event room hadn't been locked, so the key wasn't needed.{w} Then, we split up between both hallways and the Sekimeiya was taken. That's when the key was used.
entries.literal: "The first time it disappeared, the Sekimeiya was in a cabinet in the room where Naomi died. However, the cabinet in the event room hadn't been locked, so the key wasn't needed.{w} Then, we split up between both hallways and the Sekimeiya was taken. That's when the key was used."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Later, when we returned from the higher floors without finding anyone, the Sekimeiya hadn't been stolen yet. It was still in the cabinet. ...And according to Sai, someone took the elevator down.{w} I don't think the killer's intention was to take the Sekimeiya.{w} If it had been, and they'd purposely removed the cabinet key from Naomi's set, they wouldn't have taken the Sekimeiya while we'd been searching both hallways. They would've waited for us to leave, and they wouldn't have dropped the key in your purse.
entries.literal: "...Later, when we returned from the higher floors without finding anyone, the Sekimeiya hadn't been stolen yet. It was still in the cabinet. ...And according to Sai, someone took the elevator down.{w} I don't think the killer's intention was to take the Sekimeiya.{w} If it had been, and they'd purposely removed the cabinet key from Naomi's set, they wouldn't have taken the Sekimeiya while we'd been searching both hallways. They would've waited for us to leave, and they wouldn't have dropped the key in your purse."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So someone took an opportunity after we found Naomi's body.
entries.literal: "So someone took an opportunity after we found Naomi's body."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. The culprit spent time removing it from her set of keys but didn't take the attic key.{w} All of us found Naomi's body at the same time, and even though I disappeared, you're positive nobody could've picked the key up before I came back, right?
entries.literal: "Yeah. The culprit spent time removing it from her set of keys but didn't take the attic key.{w} All of us found Naomi's body at the same time, and even though I disappeared, you're positive nobody could've picked the key up before I came back, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I am, and even more so if they had to take it off the keyring.
entries.literal: "I am, and even more so if they had to take it off the keyring."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: In that case, when we left her body to put the Sekimeiya in the event room cabinet, it's very likely she still had all of her keys. The people that could've picked it up from that point on were your group and the person who made the sound—someone who couldn't have gone on to use it to unlock the cabinet. It's also likely they were the true culprit, seeing as they didn't pick it up after killing Naomi.
entries.literal: "In that case, when we left her body to put the Sekimeiya in the event room cabinet, it's very likely she still had all of her keys. The people that could've picked it up from that point on were your group and the person who made the sound—someone who couldn't have gone on to use it to unlock the cabinet. It's also likely they were the true culprit, seeing as they didn't pick it up after killing Naomi."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It goes back to what we said earlier: the suspects are pretty much only Sai and Akaro.
entries.literal: "It goes back to what we said earlier: the suspects are pretty much only Sai and Akaro."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I began moving toward the living room, and Shiroya followed me without asking anything.
entries.literal: "I began moving toward the living room, and Shiroya followed me without asking anything."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Akaro entered the room where Naomi died, but he couldn't have unlocked the cabinet. Sai, though, had the chance to do both things. If the search ended while one of them still had the key, they would've chosen to leave it in your purse because you were in their group.{w} You also investigated hallway B, so if Sai hadn't denied it, you could've had a chance to get the key too.
entries.literal: "Akaro entered the room where Naomi died, but he couldn't have unlocked the cabinet. Sai, though, had the chance to do both things. If the search ended while one of them still had the key, they would've chosen to leave it in your purse because you were in their group.{w} You also investigated hallway B, so if Sai hadn't denied it, you could've had a chance to get the key too."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And then Akaro started acting weirdly, purposely remaining on the crystal floor all by himself.
entries.literal: "And then Akaro started acting weirdly, purposely remaining on the crystal floor all by himself."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Yeah. None of this makes sense because we found the Sekimeiya in the storeroom. This part is what feels like we might have it backward.
entries.literal: "...Yeah. None of this makes sense because we found the Sekimeiya in the storeroom. This part is what feels like we might have it backward."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: How so?
entries.literal: "How so?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure yet, because I doubt there could've been any normal method to make the Sekimeiya appear there. Maybe it has to do with its powers, but I think we should look through hallway B in case we can find hints of what actually happened.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure yet, because I doubt there could've been any normal method to make the Sekimeiya appear there. Maybe it has to do with its powers, but I think we should look through hallway B in case we can find hints of what actually happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without an objection, we continued heading down. I wasn't exactly sure what line we were pursuing, but I knew something strange had to have happened with the hallway B group.
entries.literal: "Without an objection, we continued heading down. I wasn't exactly sure what line we were pursuing, but I knew something strange had to have happened with the hallway B group."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: When the Sekimeiya was hidden in room B4, where we first found Naomi...{w} It was hidden inside a temperature regulation cabinet, and that would have happened at a time where we didn't know that the cabinets had inner compartments yet.
entries.literal: "When the Sekimeiya was hidden in room B4, where we first found Naomi...{w} It was hidden inside a temperature regulation cabinet, and that would have happened at a time where we didn't know that the cabinets had inner compartments yet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Anyone could've secretly known this, but think about Katei's perspective. Suripo told him that gemstones had been stolen from a room, and he didn't know which one.{w} Therefore, he had no reason to think they had been gemstones on display instead of the ones kept in those inner compartments, right? ...But the first time we searched, he never looked in those or let us know about them.
entries.literal: "Anyone could've secretly known this, but think about Katei's perspective. Suripo told him that gemstones had been stolen from a room, and he didn't know which one.{w} Therefore, he had no reason to think they had been gemstones on display instead of the ones kept in those inner compartments, right? ...But the first time we searched, he never looked in those or let us know about them."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Maybe he wanted to keep them a secret.
entries.literal: "...Maybe he wanted to keep them a secret."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's possible.
entries.literal: "It's possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as we reached floor 5, we faintly heard someone approaching.
entries.literal: "As soon as we reached floor 5, we faintly heard someone approaching."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Oh, hey. Were you coming for me?
entries.literal: "...Oh, hey. Were you coming for me?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sort of... The others are waiting for you in the attic, but we'll go right back up in a bit. What were you doing down there?
entries.literal: "Sort of... The others are waiting for you in the attic, but we'll go right back up in a bit. What were you doing down there?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Nothing, as I said. I stayed where I was for a few more minutes, sorting my thoughts out.
entries.literal: "Nothing, as I said. I stayed where I was for a few more minutes, sorting my thoughts out."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Any reason why you chose a bathroom with a body to stay in?
entries.literal: "Any reason why you chose a bathroom with a body to stay in?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't think so... I'll be going. I'm sure Sai's eager to question me.
entries.literal: "I don't think so... I'll be going. I'm sure Sai's eager to question me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He took off without waiting for a response.
entries.literal: "He took off without waiting for a response."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Maybe he's back to normal. He looked really off earlier.
entries.literal: "Maybe he's back to normal. He looked really off earlier."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He did... I'm not sure how it was for him, but he must've experienced something completely unnatural.
entries.literal: "He did... I'm not sure how it was for him, but he must've experienced something completely unnatural."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We continued moving down as we wondered what exactly had been up with Akaro.
entries.literal: "We continued moving down as we wondered what exactly had been up with Akaro."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: He said he only teleported and the Sekimeiya was the trigger. Do you believe him?
entries.literal: "He said he only teleported and the Sekimeiya was the trigger. Do you believe him?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure. It probably was caused by the Sekimeiya in some way, but right before that point, it didn't have any effect on us. I thought earlier that maybe he just traveled a few seconds to the past, which would have been unnoticeable.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure. It probably was caused by the Sekimeiya in some way, but right before that point, it didn't have any effect on us. I thought earlier that maybe he just traveled a few seconds to the past, which would have been unnoticeable."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, that's true. But he said he still appeared on the crystal floor, so I think he would've noticed it, and we should've seen him...
entries.literal: "Oh, that's true. But he said he still appeared on the crystal floor, so I think he would've noticed it, and we should've seen him..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah... Maybe the shock stopped him from thinking properly, I don't know. I also wonder why he didn't show himself if he was right there the whole time and saw us. And there's still the fact that if he really touched the Sekimeiya, we shouldn't have seen it behind the glass in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Yeah... Maybe the shock stopped him from thinking properly, I don't know. I also wonder why he didn't show himself if he was right there the whole time and saw us. And there's still the fact that if he really touched the Sekimeiya, we shouldn't have seen it behind the glass in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: None of it makes much sense.
entries.literal: "None of it makes much sense."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I'm already doubting what I said regarding the Sekimeiya's disappearance.
entries.literal: "...{w}I'm already doubting what I said regarding the Sekimeiya's disappearance."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I said that if Naomi's killer took her key, they would've waited before taking the Sekimeiya; they wouldn't have done it while we were all searching the crystal floor.{w} That's not definitely true, though. If Sai or Akaro took the key, they would've waited too.
entries.literal: "I said that if Naomi's killer took her key, they would've waited before taking the Sekimeiya; they wouldn't have done it while we were all searching the crystal floor.{w} That's not definitely true, though. If Sai or Akaro took the key, they would've waited too."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}Yeah.{w}{w=0.4} They would've kept the key until a better chance came.
entries.literal: "...{w}Yeah.{w}{w=0.4} They would've kept the key until a better chance came."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right?{w} But instead, the Sekimeiya was taken while the search was going on.{w} Why? There has to be a reason why they didn't wait.{w} After all, the fact that it happened during the search feels wrong, because it means that nobody who searched could've done it.{w} How did they do it? Whoever hid the Sekimeiya took advantage of the search to appear clean—they didn't wait for a calmer opportunity.
entries.literal: "Right?{w} But instead, the Sekimeiya was taken while the search was going on.{w} Why? There has to be a reason why they didn't wait.{w} After all, the fact that it happened during the search feels wrong, because it means that nobody who searched could've done it.{w} How did they do it? Whoever hid the Sekimeiya took advantage of the search to appear clean—they didn't wait for a calmer opportunity."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's so confusing! People in both hallways could've worked together when I wasn't looking, but is that really it...?{w} It doesn't make any sense! They rushed to hide the Sekimeiya in the storeroom, but they didn't rush to take it out of the cabinet the next time we left the crystal floor. In fact, it should still be there.
entries.literal: "It's so confusing! People in both hallways could've worked together when I wasn't looking, but is that really it...?{w} It doesn't make any sense! They rushed to hide the Sekimeiya in the storeroom, but they didn't rush to take it out of the cabinet the next time we left the crystal floor. In fact, it should still be there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Damn it... I don't want to baselessly suspect everyone, but I don't know how else to approach this.
entries.literal: "Damn it... I don't want to baselessly suspect everyone, but I don't know how else to approach this."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's okay, Atsuki. You're just trying to be careful. I wish I could be more help.
entries.literal: "It's okay, Atsuki. You're just trying to be careful. I wish I could be more help."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We arrived at the crystal floor. If no one was hiding nearby, we were the only people there. It was fainter, but as we walked down the last staircase, we could still perceive the smell from earlier.
entries.literal: "We arrived at the crystal floor. If no one was hiding nearby, we were the only people there. It was fainter, but as we walked down the last staircase, we could still perceive the smell from earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps because nothing about it made sense, we instinctively went to check the second of Naomi's bodies, the place where Akaro had remained.
entries.literal: "Perhaps because nothing about it made sense, we instinctively went to check the second of Naomi's bodies, the place where Akaro had remained."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't think anything's different here.
entries.literal: "I don't think anything's different here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It looks the same. Someone must've locked her inside, and that was the sound we heard...
entries.literal: "It looks the same. Someone must've locked her inside, and that was the sound we heard..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If so, then they should've still been somewhere while we searched.
entries.literal: "If so, then they should've still been somewhere while we searched."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well, when we heard the sound, we all went out of the event room toward hallway A. From there, we could see the staircase and elevator, so we know nobody ran up a floor after that.
entries.literal: "Well, when we heard the sound, we all went out of the event room toward hallway A. From there, we could see the staircase and elevator, so we know nobody ran up a floor after that."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: If the person responsible expected that and quickly entered the event room from hallway B just behind us, they might've been able to use the Sekimeiya to escape. We still don't know how it works, and we locked the cabinet, but it's possible...
entries.literal: "If the person responsible expected that and quickly entered the event room from hallway B just behind us, they might've been able to use the Sekimeiya to escape. We still don't know how it works, and we locked the cabinet, but it's possible..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It supposedly made Akaro travel later, so that could be right. It might just be inconsistent about when it actually does something.
entries.literal: "It supposedly made Akaro travel later, so that could be right. It might just be inconsistent about when it actually does something."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But then they wouldn't have relied on it to escape. If they used it, they must've known how to properly use it.{w} There's still the same problem, though. The glass in the cabinet would have been down.
entries.literal: "But then they wouldn't have relied on it to escape. If they used it, they must've known how to properly use it.{w} There's still the same problem, though. The glass in the cabinet would have been down."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's right...
entries.literal: "That's right..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As the conversation had once again shifted to the Sekimeiya's mechanics, we walked to the center of the floor.
entries.literal: "As the conversation had once again shifted to the Sekimeiya's mechanics, we walked to the center of the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered through hallway B and found ourselves in the barren space, only shared by the covered cabinet. The darkness in there was a stark reminder that we'd been victims of an attack, and one that was most likely far from over. I walked up to the cabinet as I spoke.
entries.literal: "We entered through hallway B and found ourselves in the barren space, only shared by the covered cabinet. The darkness in there was a stark reminder that we'd been victims of an attack, and one that was most likely far from over. I walked up to the cabinet as I spoke."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you still have the key?
entries.literal: "Do you still have the key?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No, it must still be on the bed, assuming nobody picked it up. I didn't wanna just put it back in my purse.
entries.literal: "No, it must still be on the bed, assuming nobody picked it up. I didn't wanna just put it back in my purse."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So the potentially solitary method to unlock the cabinet was in anyone's possession. I raised the curtain, hoping to finally get more information on what the Sekimeiya could really do.
entries.literal: "So the potentially solitary method to unlock the cabinet was in anyone's possession. I raised the curtain, hoping to finally get more information on what the Sekimeiya could really do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, instead of helping us piece things together, it appeared the curtain was only covering more questions. Behind it, the glass only protected a cushion, as the Sekimeiya had once again disappeared.
entries.literal: "However, instead of helping us piece things together, it appeared the curtain was only covering more questions. Behind it, the glass only protected a cushion, as the Sekimeiya had once again disappeared."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...It's not here? Didn't you see it just before we went up?
entries.literal: "...It's not here? Didn't you see it just before we went up?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I-I did... I even touched it.
entries.literal: "I-I did... I even touched it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Then was Akaro just acting? He could've easily taken it out...
entries.literal: "Then was Akaro just acting? He could've easily taken it out..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Unless we assume an unknown culprit is somehow still here, it was him. He did tell us to leave him alone, but I have no idea why he'd want to hide it.
entries.literal: "Unless we assume an unknown culprit is somehow still here, it was him. He did tell us to leave him alone, but I have no idea why he'd want to hide it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This question still pisses me off. Why would anyone hide the Sekimeiya? There's nothing to gain from it because we can always find it by just searching thoroughly.
entries.literal: "This question still pisses me off. Why would anyone hide the Sekimeiya? There's nothing to gain from it because we can always find it by just searching thoroughly."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There might be another reason... What if what they're trying to do is remove it from the cabinet instead of hiding it?
entries.literal: "There might be another reason... What if what they're trying to do is remove it from the cabinet instead of hiding it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Just removing it? Oh, because of the temperature?
entries.literal: "Just removing it? Oh, because of the temperature?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Maybe. The first time, we found it inside a cabinet that could keep it cool, but it wasn't powered on. It might be related to that.
entries.literal: "Maybe. The first time, we found it inside a cabinet that could keep it cool, but it wasn't powered on. It might be related to that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: They could just unplug this cabinet, which would be much harder to notice. By moving it, they also exposed themselves in front of the cameras.
entries.literal: "They could just unplug this cabinet, which would be much harder to notice. By moving it, they also exposed themselves in front of the cameras."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked behind just in case, and the cabinet's plug was still inserted into the outlet.
entries.literal: "I looked behind just in case, and the cabinet's plug was still inserted into the outlet."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: The cameras make me think that the culprit doesn't mind being seen. It'd make sense if it was always Akaro, because he's leaving himself as the only suspect by hiding the Sekimeiya now anyway.
entries.literal: "The cameras make me think that the culprit doesn't mind being seen. It'd make sense if it was always Akaro, because he's leaving himself as the only suspect by hiding the Sekimeiya now anyway."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But to accomplish everything, he needs to have used the Sekimeiya's powers multiple times and still did his best to always hide from us. Whoever the culprit is, why do they care so much about avoiding us but aren't fazed by the cameras?
entries.literal: "But to accomplish everything, he needs to have used the Sekimeiya's powers multiple times and still did his best to always hide from us. Whoever the culprit is, why do they care so much about avoiding us but aren't fazed by the cameras?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I don't know. They must've caused the power outage in the security room, but all that did was stop us from looking at the recordings. The cameras are still working, so once everyone outside can get back in, they'll be able to look through all of it.
entries.literal: "...I don't know. They must've caused the power outage in the security room, but all that did was stop us from looking at the recordings. The cameras are still working, so once everyone outside can get back in, they'll be able to look through all of it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It might just be that they're confident in their plan. If they intend to vanish as soon as Ashiya enter this place, even if their identity is exposed, they'd still be long gone.
entries.literal: "It might just be that they're confident in their plan. If they intend to vanish as soon as Ashiya enter this place, even if their identity is exposed, they'd still be long gone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The fact that they're trying so hard to avoid being seen by us might mean that we already know them. If they're making use of the Sekimeiya, understand how it works, and are creating an alibi for themselves, we could just restrain them once we know who they are. It's like they're hiding the Sekimeiya while also hiding themselves thanks to it.
entries.literal: "The fact that they're trying so hard to avoid being seen by us might mean that we already know them. If they're making use of the Sekimeiya, understand how it works, and are creating an alibi for themselves, we could just restrain them once we know who they are. It's like they're hiding the Sekimeiya while also hiding themselves thanks to it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And at the same time, the fact that Akaro is the main suspect could mean that he isn't responsible; every other action performed by the culprit has managed to keep their identity hidden, but this would directly reveal it.
entries.literal: "And at the same time, the fact that Akaro is the main suspect could mean that he isn't responsible; every other action performed by the culprit has managed to keep their identity hidden, but this would directly reveal it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Even though Katei has always looked like the most suspicious person, he could've accomplished almost everything through normal means. At no point was it necessary for him to use the Sekimeiya for anything, and it's very likely the culprit has been making use of it to stay out of sight and remain less suspicious.
entries.literal: "Even though Katei has always looked like the most suspicious person, he could've accomplished almost everything through normal means. At no point was it necessary for him to use the Sekimeiya for anything, and it's very likely the culprit has been making use of it to stay out of sight and remain less suspicious."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So the blame just falls on Katei?
entries.literal: "So the blame just falls on Katei?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I doubt it's just that. He's still hiding a bunch of things for sure. Regarding the Sekimeiya, the attic, and the way we got trapped.
entries.literal: "I doubt it's just that. He's still hiding a bunch of things for sure. Regarding the Sekimeiya, the attic, and the way we got trapped."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: For now, since we're here, we could try to find the Sekimeiya. The others must be questioning Akaro and, well, wondering where we are. There aren't many places to hide it, and if we do find it, we could learn something important. Assuming Akaro didn't do it, it means that someone else took advantage of him being distracted.
entries.literal: "For now, since we're here, we could try to find the Sekimeiya. The others must be questioning Akaro and, well, wondering where we are. There aren't many places to hide it, and if we do find it, we could learn something important. Assuming Akaro didn't do it, it means that someone else took advantage of him being distracted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It could've been an "unknown culprit", but Sai and Katei were actually viable suspects too, as they'd claimed to be in the living room while we'd been occupied by an impossible recording. They would've had just enough time.
entries.literal: "It could've been an \"unknown culprit\", but Sai and Katei were actually viable suspects too, as they'd claimed to be in the living room while we'd been occupied by an impossible recording. They would've had just enough time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Or would you prefer to go back to the attic? Sorry, I just dragged you all the way down here without asking you. Being alone could be dangerous, so we can go back if you want.
entries.literal: "Or would you prefer to go back to the attic? Sorry, I just dragged you all the way down here without asking you. Being alone could be dangerous, so we can go back if you want."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...No, I'd like to look for it.{w} We were going to look through hallway B, so let's start with that. If we figure out how the Sekimeiya appeared in the storeroom, we might be able to find out who did it.
entries.literal: "...No, I'd like to look for it.{w} We were going to look through hallway B, so let's start with that. If we figure out how the Sekimeiya appeared in the storeroom, we might be able to find out who did it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded. It wasn't impossible someone was hiding, but they could've easily left already, and it wasn't our goal to begin a full search of the building. We intended to find the Sekimeiya, which was more likely to be on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "I nodded. It wasn't impossible someone was hiding, but they could've easily left already, and it wasn't our goal to begin a full search of the building. We intended to find the Sekimeiya, which was more likely to be on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Which room do we start with?
entries.literal: "Which room do we start with?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It shouldn't matter. I think that's the first one Akaro looked through.
entries.literal: "It shouldn't matter. I think that's the first one Akaro looked through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked to room B3 in silence...{w} It was undeniable that staying put somewhere was much safer than being there by ourselves; someone had died, and we were up against an elusive unknown...
entries.literal: "We walked to room B3 in silence...{w} It was undeniable that staying put somewhere was much safer than being there by ourselves; someone had died, and we were up against an elusive unknown..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd even heard that bizarre recording just minutes ago, but we were trying to understand what had happened to the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "We'd even heard that bizarre recording just minutes ago, but we were trying to understand what had happened to the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After all, it made me travel through time.{w} We hadn't spoken about it at length, but it was evident both of us wanted to understand how it worked...
entries.literal: "After all, it made me travel through time.{w} We hadn't spoken about it at length, but it was evident both of us wanted to understand how it worked..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...We opened the door and entered without high hopes.
entries.literal: "...We opened the door and entered without high hopes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started with the rightmost cabinets. Only a few of them could be opened up, but there was always space behind and under them, making it a considerably lengthy process.
entries.literal: "I started with the rightmost cabinets. Only a few of them could be opened up, but there was always space behind and under them, making it a considerably lengthy process."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just as I thought that, Shiroya spoke.
entries.literal: "Just as I thought that, Shiroya spoke."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: W-Wait, it's here.
entries.literal: "W-Wait, it's here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around abruptly. Shiroya was looking inside the cabinet she'd started with. I approached her, thinking that perhaps I'd misheard.
entries.literal: "I turned around abruptly. Shiroya was looking inside the cabinet she'd started with. I approached her, thinking that perhaps I'd misheard."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Do you mean the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...Do you mean the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes... Look, it's under the cushion, and there's a lot of space beneath it too. I thought I saw a slight bump, so I checked.
entries.literal: "Yes... Look, it's under the cushion, and there's a lot of space beneath it too. I thought I saw a slight bump, so I checked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spotted it when I got closer. Shiroya had removed the cushion with the gems, which uncovered the space beneath it. There, the Sekimeiya was hidden.
entries.literal: "I spotted it when I got closer. Shiroya had removed the cushion with the gems, which uncovered the space beneath it. There, the Sekimeiya was hidden."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...So, once again, out of all the places to choose from, they chose to hide it in a room with security cameras.
entries.literal: "...So, once again, out of all the places to choose from, they chose to hide it in a room with security cameras."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd gotten used to our searches not ending as desired, so such a quick result threw me off.
entries.literal: "We'd gotten used to our searches not ending as desired, so such a quick result threw me off."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It can't have been here for very long. What do we do? Do you wanna try to, um... activate it?
entries.literal: "It can't have been here for very long. What do we do? Do you wanna try to, um... activate it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...The last time, it worked right after it was hidden. It's obvious that the culprit is behind this, so by learning how it works, we might be able to understand a few things.
entries.literal: "...The last time, it worked right after it was hidden. It's obvious that the culprit is behind this, so by learning how it works, we might be able to understand a few things."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's true, but won't it be dangerous? ...You saw how Akaro reacted.
entries.literal: "That's true, but won't it be dangerous? ...You saw how Akaro reacted."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I felt fine the last time. I also touched it before going to the attic and nothing happened, so it's possible it won't be any different now.
entries.literal: "I felt fine the last time. I also touched it before going to the attic and nothing happened, so it's possible it won't be any different now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It might've been dangerous, but I wanted to know if going to the past was truly achievable. I felt overwhelmed by the simple-looking object I had in front of me.
entries.literal: "It might've been dangerous, but I wanted to know if going to the past was truly achievable. I felt overwhelmed by the simple-looking object I had in front of me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see. ...Try it, then.
entries.literal: "I see. ...Try it, then."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If it works, I'll go back to the past again. If that happens, it means that I might already be outside the door, waiting for the past me to travel. Assuming that's the case, I'll come in as soon as I disappear to meet back up with you. Keep looking at the Sekimeiya in case it changes colors.
entries.literal: "If it works, I'll go back to the past again. If that happens, it means that I might already be outside the door, waiting for the past me to travel. Assuming that's the case, I'll come in as soon as I disappear to meet back up with you. Keep looking at the Sekimeiya in case it changes colors."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: A-All right.
entries.literal: "A-All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was another version of me... right outside the room?{w} If we went to look and that version acted surprised to be found... assuming the past couldn't be changed and only looked at from a different perspective, it would mean that I needed to travel to the past and recreate a fake reaction.
entries.literal: "Was another version of me... right outside the room?{w} If we went to look and that version acted surprised to be found... assuming the past couldn't be changed and only looked at from a different perspective, it would mean that I needed to travel to the past and recreate a fake reaction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something like that was ridiculous; if we went to check outside, that version of me would know that we'd done so and would hide accordingly. It was pointless to even try it, as we didn't know if the travel would work in the first place.
entries.literal: "Something like that was ridiculous; if we went to check outside, that version of me would know that we'd done so and would hide accordingly. It was pointless to even try it, as we didn't know if the travel would work in the first place."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'll touch it. If nothing happens, let's bring it upstairs. Leaving it in the cabinet would just provide the culprit with another opportunity to hide it, assuming it wasn't Akaro's doing.
entries.literal: "I'll touch it. If nothing happens, let's bring it upstairs. Leaving it in the cabinet would just provide the culprit with another opportunity to hide it, assuming it wasn't Akaro's doing."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah.{w} I'll wait here. I'm a little scared to touch it, but I think it's better if one of us stays here.
entries.literal: "Yeah.{w} I'll wait here. I'm a little scared to touch it, but I think it's better if one of us stays here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I agree.
entries.literal: "I agree."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stretched my arm toward it. Hesitant at what was about to happen, Shiroya backed up while I shortened the distance between my hand and the Sekimeiya.{w} As soon as I made the slightest physical contact with it, I felt a ridiculously painful burn on my fingers. It lasted less than a split second, and I was somewhere else.
entries.literal: "I stretched my arm toward it. Hesitant at what was about to happen, Shiroya backed up while I shortened the distance between my hand and the Sekimeiya.{w} As soon as I made the slightest physical contact with it, I felt a ridiculously painful burn on my fingers. It lasted less than a split second, and I was somewhere else."

entries.text: Behind Bars
entries.literal: "Behind Bars"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could comprehend that it worked, I fell to the floor and hurt myself. Disoriented, I looked around.
entries.literal: "Before I could comprehend that it worked, I fell to the floor and hurt myself. Disoriented, I looked around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took me a few seconds to recognize where I was. In front of me were blank screens, and my surroundings were overall dim. It was the security room.{w} My pose had also changed. I'd appeared in front of the desk and immediately fallen backward, hitting my back on the chair.
entries.literal: "It took me a few seconds to recognize where I was. In front of me were blank screens, and my surroundings were overall dim. It was the security room.{w} My pose had also changed. I'd appeared in front of the desk and immediately fallen backward, hitting my back on the chair."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck...? Was I sitting...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...? Was I sitting...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was what it felt like. I'd been sitting on top of nothing, which resulted in my fall.
entries.literal: "That was what it felt like. I'd been sitting on top of nothing, which resulted in my fall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed and stood up. It had worked again, and I'd appeared in the security room instead. I was about to exit the room when I realized that I had a much smarter option.
entries.literal: "I sighed and stood up. It had worked again, and I'd appeared in the security room instead. I was about to exit the room when I realized that I had a much smarter option."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dragged the chair I'd knocked away back to its place and sat on it. Then, I moved the mouse around to power on the screens.
entries.literal: "I dragged the chair I'd knocked away back to its place and sat on it. Then, I moved the mouse around to power on the screens."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They all lit up at once, which made me squint momentarily.{w} ...The large desktop appeared, but I only directed my eyes at the lower right side of the middle screen.{w} {time=11:10} was the time that I saw.
entries.literal: "They all lit up at once, which made me squint momentarily.{w} ...The large desktop appeared, but I only directed my eyes at the lower right side of the middle screen.{w} {time=11:10} was the time that I saw."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I did go back to the past once again... This is confirmation that I wasn't going crazy.
entries.literal: "I did go back to the past once again... This is confirmation that I wasn't going crazy."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The last time we checked the time, Sai said it was {time=11:36}, and he already confirmed to me that his time is the same as this computer's.
entries.literal: "The last time we checked the time, Sai said it was {time=11:36}, and he already confirmed to me that his time is the same as this computer's."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'd estimate that after that point, fifteen more minutes passed until I touched the Sekimeiya, which means that I went approximately forty minutes into the past.
entries.literal: "I'd estimate that after that point, fifteen more minutes passed until I touched the Sekimeiya, which means that I went approximately forty minutes into the past."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Forty minutes... twice the last amount. Is that a coincidence...?
entries.literal: "Forty minutes... twice the last amount. Is that a coincidence...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It could just be that the amount of time traveled is also determined randomly. I thought earlier that could be the case with the location you go to, but given I appeared sitting down right in front of this desk, there must be more to that.
entries.literal: "It could just be that the amount of time traveled is also determined randomly. I thought earlier that could be the case with the location you go to, but given I appeared sitting down right in front of this desk, there must be more to that."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: At this point in time, I should be on the fifth floor with Shiroya. At {time=11:20}, we were all inside the event room after regrouping, discussing the elevator movements.
entries.literal: "At this point in time, I should be on the fifth floor with Shiroya. At {time=11:20}, we were all inside the event room after regrouping, discussing the elevator movements."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When we heard a noise...{w=0.5} that's right!{w=0.4} I can attempt to see what made it, and most importantly...{w} what happened to Naomi.
entries.literal: "When we heard a noise...{w=0.5} that's right!{w=0.4} I can attempt to see what made it, and most importantly...{w} what happened to Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tensed up. It was possible a murder was about to occur. We'd deemed the bathroom empty before searching the other floors, and I was in the timeframe where the second Naomi had died.
entries.literal: "I tensed up. It was possible a murder was about to occur. We'd deemed the bathroom empty before searching the other floors, and I was in the timeframe where the second Naomi had died."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I exited the security room slowly. We'd searched through the whole floor before going up, so there shouldn't have been anyone hiding who I didn't know about. However, the elevator movements still remained unexplained. Someone had arrived on the crystal floor while we'd been investigating the others.
entries.literal: "I exited the security room slowly. We'd searched through the whole floor before going up, so there shouldn't have been anyone hiding who I didn't know about. However, the elevator movements still remained unexplained. Someone had arrived on the crystal floor while we'd been investigating the others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could I even consider preventing Naomi's death? If causal loops were how time travel worked, I wouldn't be able to. ...Did I have a way to be sure, though?
entries.literal: "Could I even consider preventing Naomi's death? If causal loops were how time travel worked, I wouldn't be able to. ...Did I have a way to be sure, though?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though what happened the first time indicated that modifying the past wouldn't happen, the only way I could learn that with certainty was by attempting it.
entries.literal: "Even though what happened the first time indicated that modifying the past wouldn't happen, the only way I could learn that with certainty was by attempting it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Incidentally, by attempting to change the past, I was putting myself at risk. We hadn't found my dead body, so I could feel a bit calm in that regard. However, if my actions could alter the past, that would no longer be valid.
entries.literal: "Incidentally, by attempting to change the past, I was putting myself at risk. We hadn't found my dead body, so I could feel a bit calm in that regard. However, if my actions could alter the past, that would no longer be valid."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Should I be worried about that? If I try to prevent Naomi's death and subsequently die for it, that could make my time travel an impossibility and lead into an obvious paradox. How would the universe handle that? Would it even allow it?
entries.literal: "Should I be worried about that? If I try to prevent Naomi's death and subsequently die for it, that could make my time travel an impossibility and lead into an obvious paradox. How would the universe handle that? Would it even allow it?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Maybe anything I try to change the past will be completely futile. I just have to wait and see what I can do.
entries.literal: "Maybe anything I try to change the past will be completely futile. I just have to wait and see what I can do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From hallway A, I saw people walking down the stairs. I dashed toward the lobby, knowing that they wouldn't see me.
entries.literal: "From hallway A, I saw people walking down the stairs. I dashed toward the lobby, knowing that they wouldn't see me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: They've already come, so the elevator movements have already occurred. It's possible Naomi's already dead. Did I appear too late to see what happened...?
entries.literal: "They've already come, so the elevator movements have already occurred. It's possible Naomi's already dead. Did I appear too late to see what happened...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to hallway B. I knew we'd shortly enter the event room through the opposite door, so I'd be safe there.
entries.literal: "I moved to hallway B. I knew we'd shortly enter the event room through the opposite door, so I'd be safe there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Are they really not going to see me...? I went forty minutes into the past, and even though nobody claimed to have seen me, it appears I was always on this floor...
entries.literal: "Are they really not going to see me...? I went forty minutes into the past, and even though nobody claimed to have seen me, it appears I was always on this floor..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached the bathrooms slowly, trying to remain silent. From the middle of the hallway, though, I noticed that something important hadn't happened yet.
entries.literal: "I approached the bathrooms slowly, trying to remain silent. From the middle of the hallway, though, I noticed that something important hadn't happened yet."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The door... It's open.
entries.literal: "The door... It's open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd found the bathroom door locked, and inside was Naomi's body. Since it wasn't locked at that moment, something was bound to happen if I just watched from a distance.
entries.literal: "We'd found the bathroom door locked, and inside was Naomi's body. Since it wasn't locked at that moment, something was bound to happen if I just watched from a distance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unfortunately, the door was only barely ajar, so I couldn't see inside.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, the door was only barely ajar, so I couldn't see inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept moving and entered the cleaning room, which would provide me with the best view of the bathrooms without being spotted.
entries.literal: "I kept moving and entered the cleaning room, which would provide me with the best view of the bathrooms without being spotted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A little paranoid, I looked behind me to make sure there was no one else there.
entries.literal: "A little paranoid, I looked behind me to make sure there was no one else there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Who's going to appear? Will I be able to see the killer's identity? Naomi might also show up at any moment, but from where?
entries.literal: "Who's going to appear? Will I be able to see the killer's identity? Naomi might also show up at any moment, but from where?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This floor was empty, and the rest up to the attic were just investigated too... Maybe whoever's about to appear will travel from the future if they haven't been in the attic the whole time.
entries.literal: "This floor was empty, and the rest up to the attic were just investigated too... Maybe whoever's about to appear will travel from the future if they haven't been in the attic the whole time."

entries.speaker: n
