entries.text: It's unlikely anyone exited the attic through the main door, given the footprints. Even though the elevator should've been on the fifth floor, it was below the third. Someone from the attic could've called it, arrived here, and then sent it back up with no one inside. That'd fall into place with what Sai heard.
entries.literal: "It's unlikely anyone exited the attic through the main door, given the footprints. Even though the elevator should've been on the fifth floor, it was below the third. Someone from the attic could've called it, arrived here, and then sent it back up with no one inside. That'd fall into place with what Sai heard."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It also means that person must now be on this floor, and most importantly, that Shiroya and I missed the elevator's sound three times. Is that really a possibility...?
entries.literal: "It also means that person must now be on this floor, and most importantly, that Shiroya and I missed the elevator's sound three times. Is that really a possibility...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept watching for a few minutes. Eventually, the indistinct voices I'd been hearing faded away, indicating that the group had gone to the event room.
entries.literal: "I kept watching for a few minutes. Eventually, the indistinct voices I'd been hearing faded away, indicating that the group had gone to the event room."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...It has to happen at any moment. We did hear a noise, and the door hasn't been locked yet.
entries.literal: "...It has to happen at any moment. We did hear a noise, and the door hasn't been locked yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remained motionless, peeking through the small gap in my door. Was I about to witness a murder? Would I see a person popping into existence out of nowhere? Where would they go then?
entries.literal: "I remained motionless, peeking through the small gap in my door. Was I about to witness a murder? Would I see a person popping into existence out of nowhere? Where would they go then?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If the second Naomi isn't dead yet, both her and the culprit have to come. One of them is accounted for given the elevator movements, but what about the other one? ...Or were both of them responsible for the elevator trips?
entries.literal: "If the second Naomi isn't dead yet, both her and the culprit have to come. One of them is accounted for given the elevator movements, but what about the other one? ...Or were both of them responsible for the elevator trips?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could continue imagining all sorts of scenarios, it began. Naomi was coming from hallway C.
entries.literal: "Before I could continue imagining all sorts of scenarios, it began. Naomi was coming from hallway C."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There she is...! Should I show myself?
entries.literal: "There she is...! Should I show myself?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't decide if that was a good idea. There was still no culprit to be found, so I chose to hold off.
entries.literal: "I couldn't decide if that was a good idea. There was still no culprit to be found, so I chose to hold off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro's description of Naomi's face fell short of her actual expression. She was visibly terrified, breathing heavily, moving oddly, and stopping in place every few seconds.
entries.literal: "Akaro's description of Naomi's face fell short of her actual expression. She was visibly terrified, breathing heavily, moving oddly, and stopping in place every few seconds."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though I was a fair distance away, I saw pure distress all over her. What had she experienced? Did she know her own body had been found?{w} Was she aware of what would happen to her...?
entries.literal: "Even though I was a fair distance away, I saw pure distress all over her. What had she experienced? Did she know her own body had been found?{w} Was she aware of what would happen to her...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She must've traveled to the past at least once, or her own existence wouldn't make sense...
entries.literal: "She must've traveled to the past at least once, or her own existence wouldn't make sense..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, after a very long breath that seemed to give her some confidence, she did what I thought she'd do: she headed toward the bathrooms.
entries.literal: "Finally, after a very long breath that seemed to give her some confidence, she did what I thought she'd do: she headed toward the bathrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She opened the women's and looked inside it. It appeared she was searching for something, and given she didn't look around very much, it might've been a person.
entries.literal: "She opened the women's and looked inside it. It appeared she was searching for something, and given she didn't look around very much, it might've been a person."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Quickly, something caught her attention inside the other bathroom. I couldn't know what it was, but as she placed her hand on the doorknob, her stance gave away that she was wary of whatever was behind the door.
entries.literal: "Quickly, something caught her attention inside the other bathroom. I couldn't know what it was, but as she placed her hand on the doorknob, her stance gave away that she was wary of whatever was behind the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't seen anything strange happening in the bathroom since I'd begun watching. Was it possible that someone had been there the whole time?
entries.literal: "I hadn't seen anything strange happening in the bathroom since I'd begun watching. Was it possible that someone had been there the whole time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi opened the door carefully, keeping her guard as high as it could've been.{w} I bit my lip tightly. When the door was open, she looked inside.
entries.literal: "Naomi opened the door carefully, keeping her guard as high as it could've been.{w} I bit my lip tightly. When the door was open, she looked inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since the knob was on the left, it was impossible for me to see what she'd seen, but her tension slightly lowered once she saw the contents of the tiny room. At the same time, mine increased, as I knew what was probably about to happen.
entries.literal: "Since the knob was on the left, it was impossible for me to see what she'd seen, but her tension slightly lowered once she saw the contents of the tiny room. At the same time, mine increased, as I knew what was probably about to happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was too far to hear her, but she was speaking. Someone had really been inside the bathroom the entire time.
entries.literal: "I was too far to hear her, but she was speaking. Someone had really been inside the bathroom the entire time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't make sense. That person had to be the source of the elevator movements, so where had Naomi come from? She didn't have the attic key, and she couldn't have come from the future either, as that was about to become impossible...
entries.literal: "It didn't make sense. That person had to be the source of the elevator movements, so where had Naomi come from? She didn't have the attic key, and she couldn't have come from the future either, as that was about to become impossible..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, Naomi's body was pulled from the inside.{w} I felt as if my heart was pulled along with her. I couldn't see her anymore, and two people were in the bathroom, their figures hidden from me.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, Naomi's body was pulled from the inside.{w} I felt as if my heart was pulled along with her. I couldn't see her anymore, and two people were in the bathroom, their figures hidden from me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd probably never had the chance to stop it, and a camera must've at least caught the image of her murderer, but during the few seconds that I was pathetically scared without actually being in danger, I knew that the life of a person was being taken right in front of me. Despite my future knowledge and advantageous position, I hadn't done anything to prevent it.
entries.literal: "I'd probably never had the chance to stop it, and a camera must've at least caught the image of her murderer, but during the few seconds that I was pathetically scared without actually being in danger, I knew that the life of a person was being taken right in front of me. Despite my future knowledge and advantageous position, I hadn't done anything to prevent it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been thinking that at least the culprit would have to escape while I watched until I realized how inhuman that was.
entries.literal: "I'd been thinking that at least the culprit would have to escape while I watched until I realized how inhuman that was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The universe wouldn't allow me to change the past? That was ridiculous, and if anything, it was providing me with a way to do it.{w} I bolted to the bathroom as fast as I could. I definitely still had time to change the past.
entries.literal: "The universe wouldn't allow me to change the past? That was ridiculous, and if anything, it was providing me with a way to do it.{w} I bolted to the bathroom as fast as I could. I definitely still had time to change the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't too late, and I could trap the culprit inside. I wouldn't let them escape, and it would change the past in some way.
entries.literal: "It wasn't too late, and I could trap the culprit inside. I wouldn't let them escape, and it would change the past in some way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But that thought evaporated when I heard a sound in front of me.{w} Before I could reach the bathroom, the door was forcefully shut from the inside and then locked. I recognized the sound as soon as I heard it: it was the one we'd heard from the event room.
entries.literal: "But that thought evaporated when I heard a sound in front of me.{w} Before I could reach the bathroom, the door was forcefully shut from the inside and then locked. I recognized the sound as soon as I heard it: it was the one we'd heard from the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...How? It should've been impossible since the killer was still inside. However, I didn't have time to think about it. Faster than I'd ever run, I scrambled to the stairs, knowing that in less than a couple seconds, Erina's gaze would seal off the entire floor.
entries.literal: "...How? It should've been impossible since the killer was still inside. However, I didn't have time to think about it. Faster than I'd ever run, I scrambled to the stairs, knowing that in less than a couple seconds, Erina's gaze would seal off the entire floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made it before I was spotted only because I'd reacted fast enough, but... it didn't make any sense.{w} We were going to search through the entire floor and find no culprit.
entries.literal: "I made it before I was spotted only because I'd reacted fast enough, but... it didn't make any sense.{w} We were going to search through the entire floor and find no culprit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were Erina and Isla going to let them escape? If so, I was about to see it, and since I was one floor higher, I could hear the elevator too. It was still on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Were Erina and Isla going to let them escape? If so, I was about to see it, and since I was one floor higher, I could hear the elevator too. It was still on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I waited, watching over the stairs from afar.{w} However, a couple minutes later, nobody had gone up. At that time, we were already next to the locked door, and we would only find Naomi inside.
entries.literal: "Once again, I waited, watching over the stairs from afar.{w} However, a couple minutes later, nobody had gone up. At that time, we were already next to the locked door, and we would only find Naomi inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The way we'd coordinated ourselves back then had been effective. Erina and Isla prevented me from going down and seeing what happened to Akaro, which was also something I'd wanted to find out.
entries.literal: "The way we'd coordinated ourselves back then had been effective. Erina and Isla prevented me from going down and seeing what happened to Akaro, which was also something I'd wanted to find out."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, by rushing to the door, I didn't change anything.{w} That always happened, and yet we didn't find the person who should've been inside. Like I thought, the past won't change. As soon as I determined that I was going to do it, I was blocked off.
entries.literal: "So, by rushing to the door, I didn't change anything.{w} That always happened, and yet we didn't find the person who should've been inside. Like I thought, the past won't change. As soon as I determined that I was going to do it, I was blocked off."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Although before I say that for sure, I have to verify that they really didn't find someone and that everything is happening as I remember.
entries.literal: "Although before I say that for sure, I have to verify that they really didn't find someone and that everything is happening as I remember."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...{w}But this means that something happened to the killer. Did they go back to the past before we found them? They locked the door as soon as I approached it, so they must've escaped after that point.
entries.literal: "...{w}But this means that something happened to the killer. Did they go back to the past before we found them? They locked the door as soon as I approached it, so they must've escaped after that point."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There's a big problem. The Sekimeiya is currently in the event room. It's clear that under some circumstances, it does make you travel to the past, but they couldn't have used it unless we're severely misunderstanding how it works.
entries.literal: "There's a big problem. The Sekimeiya is currently in the event room. It's clear that under some circumstances, it does make you travel to the past, but they couldn't have used it unless we're severely misunderstanding how it works."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If touching it physically is a requirement to travel, anyone inside the bathroom couldn't have used it. Is there any way to get around that?
entries.literal: "If touching it physically is a requirement to travel, anyone inside the bathroom couldn't have used it. Is there any way to get around that?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: For example, since we had inspected the whole floor earlier, it's very likely that the culprit appeared from the future. Could they have brought the Sekimeiya with them and then used it to escape from the bathroom?
entries.literal: "For example, since we had inspected the whole floor earlier, it's very likely that the culprit appeared from the future. Could they have brought the Sekimeiya with them and then used it to escape from the bathroom?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I don't know how that would be possible. The Sekimeiya is the cause of the travels, so you shouldn't be able to travel with it too.
entries.literal: "I don't know how that would be possible. The Sekimeiya is the cause of the travels, so you shouldn't be able to travel with it too."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So then, what method could they have used to disappear like that...? Why did they kill Naomi? And while we're at it, who the fuck is this person?
entries.literal: "So then, what method could they have used to disappear like that...? Why did they kill Naomi? And while we're at it, who the fuck is this person?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Someone who will travel to the past".{w} We have that person: Akaro.{w} He's about to travel to the past right now, but for some reason, we won't find him again until later.
entries.literal: "\"Someone who will travel to the past\".{w} We have that person: Akaro.{w} He's about to travel to the past right now, but for some reason, we won't find him again until later."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did he have a way to escape the bathroom? Was he the one who shut and locked the door before I reached it...?
entries.literal: "Did he have a way to escape the bathroom? Was he the one who shut and locked the door before I reached it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My whole body felt like a coiled spring, and I'd been continuously biting my lip. I couldn't get the thought that I'd let Naomi die out of my head.
entries.literal: "My whole body felt like a coiled spring, and I'd been continuously biting my lip. I couldn't get the thought that I'd let Naomi die out of my head."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...How was that even possible, though!? She had died twice!
entries.literal: "...How was that even possible, though!? She had died twice!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made a plan in my head: if Akaro was responsible, he had to be the one who'd hidden the Sekimeiya while we were in the attic.{w} We'd walk up in a few minutes, and I knew for a fact that we wouldn't look through every floor.
entries.literal: "I made a plan in my head: if Akaro was responsible, he had to be the one who'd hidden the Sekimeiya while we were in the attic.{w} We'd walk up in a few minutes, and I knew for a fact that we wouldn't look through every floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As long as I hid myself in a partition, I wouldn't be seen. Afterward, I could go down again and see who'd hidden the Sekimeiya. Once more, I'd have a chance to see the murderer firsthand.{w} And if Akaro had been telling the truth about seeing us during our inspection, I would see him for sure.
entries.literal: "As long as I hid myself in a partition, I wouldn't be seen. Afterward, I could go down again and see who'd hidden the Sekimeiya. Once more, I'd have a chance to see the murderer firsthand.{w} And if Akaro had been telling the truth about seeing us during our inspection, I would see him for sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled our movements downstairs. Erina and Isla stayed in place, observing the path between floors while the rest of us moved back and forth between the two rooms with their individual Naomis. Eventually, after exiting the event room, we lost track of Akaro.
entries.literal: "I recalled our movements downstairs. Erina and Isla stayed in place, observing the path between floors while the rest of us moved back and forth between the two rooms with their individual Naomis. Eventually, after exiting the event room, we lost track of Akaro."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd searched through the whole floor after that, and I could attempt to repeat that myself.{w} I waited out the brief time until there was a safe way down.
entries.literal: "We'd searched through the whole floor after that, and I could attempt to repeat that myself.{w} I waited out the brief time until there was a safe way down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After four or five minutes, I saw the group coming up the stairs. We were going to the attic, which confirmed that Erina and Isla had never gone anywhere. They were definitely watching the entire time.
entries.literal: "After four or five minutes, I saw the group coming up the stairs. We were going to the attic, which confirmed that Erina and Isla had never gone anywhere. They were definitely watching the entire time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slipped into the offices to avoid being seen.
entries.literal: "I slipped into the offices to avoid being seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When the group was gone, I slowly stepped out. Nobody had the chance to pass by after them—I'd been watching the glass from the second partition.{w} The crystal floor was isolated, and according to Akaro, he had to be there.
entries.literal: "When the group was gone, I slowly stepped out. Nobody had the chance to pass by after them—I'd been watching the glass from the second partition.{w} The crystal floor was isolated, and according to Akaro, he had to be there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved down. I couldn't do an optimal search since I was only one person, but I should've been able to find someone who wasn't deliberately hiding from me.
entries.literal: "I moved down. I couldn't do an optimal search since I was only one person, but I should've been able to find someone who wasn't deliberately hiding from me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro specifically said he'd only "teleported". Regardless of the veracity of that, he had to still be on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Akaro specifically said he'd only \"teleported\". Regardless of the veracity of that, he had to still be on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door to the elevator, revealing its barren interior.
entries.literal: "I opened the door to the elevator, revealing its barren interior."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, I looked at the bathrooms, which only contained Naomi's body the way I remembered leaving it—not yet covered by a curtain. It was further confirmation that I was reliving something I'd already experienced, just from another viewpoint.
entries.literal: "Next, I looked at the bathrooms, which only contained Naomi's body the way I remembered leaving it—not yet covered by a curtain. It was further confirmation that I was reliving something I'd already experienced, just from another viewpoint."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro had stated that he didn't go up any floors, so even though I couldn't keep track of the entire area, he had to be lying if I didn't see him.
entries.literal: "Akaro had stated that he didn't go up any floors, so even though I couldn't keep track of the entire area, he had to be lying if I didn't see him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I began looking through every room. I'd seen other people do it, but I'd never personally been the one to inspect.{w} Investigating like that felt a bit paradoxical: if Akaro was in one of the rooms, he would see me even though he'd never mentioned it to us. Despite that, I continued.
entries.literal: "I began looking through every room. I'd seen other people do it, but I'd never personally been the one to inspect.{w} Investigating like that felt a bit paradoxical: if Akaro was in one of the rooms, he would see me even though he'd never mentioned it to us. Despite that, I continued."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cleaning and staff rooms were empty, and so were the first few crystal rooms. Once I entered the event room, I saw the Sekimeiya still there, revealing that it would soon be moved.
entries.literal: "The cleaning and staff rooms were empty, and so were the first few crystal rooms. Once I entered the event room, I saw the Sekimeiya still there, revealing that it would soon be moved."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued with the remaining rooms in hallway B, which all appeared empty. Even though Akaro's body was the biggest out of everyone's, he could still fit inside a cabinet. It was outlandish to think he would hide in one, but I couldn't ignore them just because of that.
entries.literal: "I continued with the remaining rooms in hallway B, which all appeared empty. Even though Akaro's body was the biggest out of everyone's, he could still fit inside a cabinet. It was outlandish to think he would hide in one, but I couldn't ignore them just because of that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After the mechanical room, I began the hallway A search.{w} A few minutes later, I'd confirmed that it was fully vacant.
entries.literal: "After the mechanical room, I began the hallway A search.{w} A few minutes later, I'd confirmed that it was fully vacant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew how suspicious that was. Surely, if Akaro was there and wasn't up to anything, he would've been drawn in by the noise. I should've seen him.
entries.literal: "I knew how suspicious that was. Surely, if Akaro was there and wasn't up to anything, he would've been drawn in by the noise. I should've seen him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had he seen me all by myself and avoided me? If so, he would know that I was about to travel to the past when he saw me and Shiroya heading downstairs—we'd told him that we all stayed together the whole time...{w} If he'd hidden the Sekimeiya, he would be aware that we were about to find it. And despite that, he hadn't stopped or questioned us.
entries.literal: "Had he seen me all by myself and avoided me? If so, he would know that I was about to travel to the past when he saw me and Shiroya heading downstairs—we'd told him that we all stayed together the whole time...{w} If he'd hidden the Sekimeiya, he would be aware that we were about to find it. And despite that, he hadn't stopped or questioned us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to the cleaning room again, knowing that Akaro would eventually enter the men's bathroom. Immediately, I noticed two things.
entries.literal: "I moved to the cleaning room again, knowing that Akaro would eventually enter the men's bathroom. Immediately, I noticed two things."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One: the bathroom's door looked exactly like it had when we'd come back down. We'd seen that it looked different from how we'd left it.
entries.literal: "One: the bathroom's door looked exactly like it had when we'd come back down. We'd seen that it looked different from how we'd left it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The second thing I noticed was that I'd been responsible for it. I had looked inside it and left the door slightly more open than it had been.
entries.literal: "The second thing I noticed was that I'd been responsible for it. I had looked inside it and left the door slightly more open than it had been."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What the hell was up with that bathroom? I knew Akaro would be inside it in a few minutes, but the door threw me for a loop.
entries.literal: "What the hell was up with that bathroom? I knew Akaro would be inside it in a few minutes, but the door threw me for a loop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unable to piece together what was happening, I stood still, waiting for what was bound to occur. At the point Akaro asked Sai for the time, it was {time=11:36.}
entries.literal: "Unable to piece together what was happening, I stood still, waiting for what was bound to occur. At the point Akaro asked Sai for the time, it was {time=11:36.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After the time I'd taken to investigate every room, I didn't have to wait very long before I saw the others appearing from the other side of hallway C. They had just searched every upper floor after visiting the attic for the first time.
entries.literal: "After the time I'd taken to investigate every room, I didn't have to wait very long before I saw the others appearing from the other side of hallway C. They had just searched every upper floor after visiting the attic for the first time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They noticed the difference with the bathroom's door and went to check it. Inside, they saw Akaro.
entries.literal: "They noticed the difference with the bathroom's door and went to check it. Inside, they saw Akaro."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't completely rule out that he'd entered it, but the position of the door indicated otherwise. ...Something extremely peculiar had happened inside that small room.
entries.literal: "I couldn't completely rule out that he'd entered it, but the position of the door indicated otherwise. ...Something extremely peculiar had happened inside that small room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a bit, Sai turned around and headed toward the event room at the same time that Shiroya went to grab a curtain. I reacted fast enough to avoid being seen, but I hadn't anticipated it. Regardless, everything was happening just as I'd already experienced it.
entries.literal: "After a bit, Sai turned around and headed toward the event room at the same time that Shiroya went to grab a curtain. I reacted fast enough to avoid being seen, but I hadn't anticipated it. Regardless, everything was happening just as I'd already experienced it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What had happened to Akaro? The truth was likely obscured behind his odd claim—his lack of time travel.
entries.literal: "What had happened to Akaro? The truth was likely obscured behind his odd claim—his lack of time travel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he'd disappeared from our side, we were unable to find him. Before that point, Naomi's killer also vanished completely from the bathroom. And Akaro, who we found there, claimed to have only teleported. Properly piecing all that together had to reveal the truth or form another piece to place somewhere.
entries.literal: "When he'd disappeared from our side, we were unable to find him. Before that point, Naomi's killer also vanished completely from the bathroom. And Akaro, who we found there, claimed to have only teleported. Properly piecing all that together had to reveal the truth or form another piece to place somewhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But despite thinking that, I couldn't decide whether to suspect him or not, because I still didn't fully understand the way the Sekimeiya worked. The little I did know was contradicted by everything I'd witnessed from my new point of view.
entries.literal: "But despite thinking that, I couldn't decide whether to suspect him or not, because I still didn't fully understand the way the Sekimeiya worked. The little I did know was contradicted by everything I'd witnessed from my new point of view."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After my past self went to check the Sekimeiya, everyone but Akaro left.{w} I saw Isla's and Shiroya's purses, and they were oblivious of what they were carrying. No matter how much I thought about the abnormal death of the second Naomi, the recording that the four of us were about to hear had remained in the back of my mind.
entries.literal: "After my past self went to check the Sekimeiya, everyone but Akaro left.{w} I saw Isla's and Shiroya's purses, and they were oblivious of what they were carrying. No matter how much I thought about the abnormal death of the second Naomi, the recording that the four of us were about to hear had remained in the back of my mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Being abandoned inside the building for a month, buying into some trick, falling into disarray along with Shiroya... The last thing I wanted was to be a victim of any of that.
entries.literal: "Being abandoned inside the building for a month, buying into some trick, falling into disarray along with Shiroya... The last thing I wanted was to be a victim of any of that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From that spot, I kept watching. I knew the Sekimeiya would be moved before Shiroya and I returned, and the cleaning room provided me with a way to look at Akaro while listening to the event room and the room I'd traveled from. If either door was opened, I was fairly certain I'd hear it.
entries.literal: "From that spot, I kept watching. I knew the Sekimeiya would be moved before Shiroya and I returned, and the cleaning room provided me with a way to look at Akaro while listening to the event room and the room I'd traveled from. If either door was opened, I was fairly certain I'd hear it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In a bit more than ten minutes, I would reach my own present and meet up with Shiroya again. I still had an important chance to understand what was going on.
entries.literal: "In a bit more than ten minutes, I would reach my own present and meet up with Shiroya again. I still had an important chance to understand what was going on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...So my thoughts fixated on the culprit. The person responsible for everything.
entries.literal: "...So my thoughts fixated on the culprit. The person responsible for everything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The incident, the two murders, and hiding the Sekimeiya. At first, since we hadn't known what the Sekimeiya was capable of, we'd strongly considered someone else was trapped with us and that they were behind it all. However, that was no longer as concrete.
entries.literal: "The incident, the two murders, and hiding the Sekimeiya. At first, since we hadn't known what the Sekimeiya was capable of, we'd strongly considered someone else was trapped with us and that they were behind it all. However, that was no longer as concrete."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The culprit had used the Sekimeiya and possessed knowledge of it. I'd been pretty sure of that already, but seeing them vanish from the bathroom was a stark confirmation. They knew what they were doing, and they were consciously escaping from us.{w} While it was possible that a ninth person was present, thanks to the Sekimeiya, it wasn't necessarily the case. Everything that the "culprit" had done could've been done by one of us as long as they had knowledge of the Sekimeiya's mechanics.
entries.literal: "The culprit had used the Sekimeiya and possessed knowledge of it. I'd been pretty sure of that already, but seeing them vanish from the bathroom was a stark confirmation. They knew what they were doing, and they were consciously escaping from us.{w} While it was possible that a ninth person was present, thanks to the Sekimeiya, it wasn't necessarily the case. Everything that the \"culprit\" had done could've been done by one of us as long as they had knowledge of the Sekimeiya's mechanics."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had previously brought up the idea that Katei originally found the Sekimeiya. If so, he was a good candidate to know how it worked. However, he'd repeatedly told us to keep it in the cabinet while it had already been removed three times.
entries.literal: "Sai had previously brought up the idea that Katei originally found the Sekimeiya. If so, he was a good candidate to know how it worked. However, he'd repeatedly told us to keep it in the cabinet while it had already been removed three times."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The power outage, hiding the Sekimeiya in the storeroom, the two killings of Naomi, and whatever might've happened in the attic... I still couldn't explain any of that, but something odd had happened in every one of those instances, meaning that the person responsible must have deliberately used the Sekimeiya to their advantage.
entries.literal: "The power outage, hiding the Sekimeiya in the storeroom, the two killings of Naomi, and whatever might've happened in the attic... I still couldn't explain any of that, but something odd had happened in every one of those instances, meaning that the person responsible must have deliberately used the Sekimeiya to their advantage."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So then, who were they? What was their purpose? I never stopped asking myself that last question. Why did they need to kill Naomi?{w} Did their bizarre plan involve trapping us inside the building for the next few weeks...?
entries.literal: "So then, who were they? What was their purpose? I never stopped asking myself that last question. Why did they need to kill Naomi?{w} Did their bizarre plan involve trapping us inside the building for the next few weeks...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reassured myself that there was no way they could accomplish that...{w} However, it was undeniable that the cameras recorded them. They surely intended to prevent anyone outside from viewing the recordings. We'd already seen an "Access Denied" message, after all.
entries.literal: "I reassured myself that there was no way they could accomplish that...{w} However, it was undeniable that the cameras recorded them. They surely intended to prevent anyone outside from viewing the recordings. We'd already seen an \"Access Denied\" message, after all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though it was clear that Katei was the most suspicious person there, he had also gotten more and more questionable by the second. That was what made me hesitant.
entries.literal: "Even though it was clear that Katei was the most suspicious person there, he had also gotten more and more questionable by the second. That was what made me hesitant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued waiting. At around {time=11:50}, I'd travel to the past, and before that, the Sekimeiya would be stolen and Akaro would leave. At least I was safe where I was—I knew Shiroya and I hadn't entered the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "I continued waiting. At around {time=11:50}, I'd travel to the past, and before that, the Sekimeiya would be stolen and Akaro would leave. At least I was safe where I was—I knew Shiroya and I hadn't entered the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like before, the minutes passed and nothing changed. I couldn't see Akaro inside the bathroom, but I knew he was still there, and he'd also told us that he didn't leave until he went to the attic.
entries.literal: "Like before, the minutes passed and nothing changed. I couldn't see Akaro inside the bathroom, but I knew he was still there, and he'd also told us that he didn't leave until he went to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though I knew I'd hear him, I kept glancing at the other side of the hallway every once in a while. If Akaro was responsible for the Sekimeiya's disappearance, though, he'd have to move first.
entries.literal: "Even though I knew I'd hear him, I kept glancing at the other side of the hallway every once in a while. If Akaro was responsible for the Sekimeiya's disappearance, though, he'd have to move first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what I was about to see, but in the meantime, the floor was completely silent. There were no traces of anyone else, and Akaro didn't appear to have been lying for the time being.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what I was about to see, but in the meantime, the floor was completely silent. There were no traces of anyone else, and Akaro didn't appear to have been lying for the time being."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few more minutes passed; our past selves were occupied with listening to the recording. {w} There wasn't a lot more time left until we'd appear, but I knew for sure that Akaro would first exit the bathroom.
entries.literal: "A few more minutes passed; our past selves were occupied with listening to the recording. {w} There wasn't a lot more time left until we'd appear, but I knew for sure that Akaro would first exit the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Or was that necessarily the case? Hadn't I just experienced someone vanishing from that same bathroom? I started to feel uncertain, but that sensation quickly disappeared. About eight minutes after the group had disappeared, Akaro did, in fact, leave the bathroom.
entries.literal: "...Or was that necessarily the case? Hadn't I just experienced someone vanishing from that same bathroom? I started to feel uncertain, but that sensation quickly disappeared. About eight minutes after the group had disappeared, Akaro did, in fact, leave the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked tired and still a bit groggy. After breathing deeply, he walked off toward the stairs and disappeared from my field of vision.{w} We'd told him the elevator wasn't functional, so he went up by foot. That meant Shiroya and I were about to head down.
entries.literal: "He looked tired and still a bit groggy. After breathing deeply, he walked off toward the stairs and disappeared from my field of vision.{w} We'd told him the elevator wasn't functional, so he went up by foot. That meant Shiroya and I were about to head down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Similarly, the Sekimeiya was about to be stolen. Keeping an eye on hallway B, I moved toward the bathroom, as I still felt something was off with it. I quickly saw the curtain on the floor, covering Naomi.
entries.literal: "Similarly, the Sekimeiya was about to be stolen. Keeping an eye on hallway B, I moved toward the bathroom, as I still felt something was off with it. I quickly saw the curtain on the floor, covering Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The killer had disappeared from the inside, and Akaro might have appeared in the same place. I'd thought that someone could only travel by making physical contact with the Sekimeiya, so I wanted to see if that was somehow possible from the bathroom.
entries.literal: "The killer had disappeared from the inside, and Akaro might have appeared in the same place. I'd thought that someone could only travel by making physical contact with the Sekimeiya, so I wanted to see if that was somehow possible from the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There weren't many places to check. I looked in the toilet, in the water tank, and in the garbage can. I couldn't find anything of importance.
entries.literal: "There weren't many places to check. I looked in the toilet, in the water tank, and in the garbage can. I couldn't find anything of importance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No Sekimeiya that had traveled from the future, and nothing that indicated how someone would disappear from the inside. Only the Sekimeiya could've made the culprit disappear, and there was no way it had vanished through the toilet...
entries.literal: "No Sekimeiya that had traveled from the future, and nothing that indicated how someone would disappear from the inside. Only the Sekimeiya could've made the culprit disappear, and there was no way it had vanished through the toilet..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was checking the bathroom about twenty minutes after the culprit had escaped it, but that shouldn't have mattered. When we'd first discovered Naomi's body, nobody had the chance to remove anything because I was the only person to even set foot inside. After that, Erina and Isla were watching from the stairs, so moving around the area was also impossible.
entries.literal: "I was checking the bathroom about twenty minutes after the culprit had escaped it, but that shouldn't have mattered. When we'd first discovered Naomi's body, nobody had the chance to remove anything because I was the only person to even set foot inside. After that, Erina and Isla were watching from the stairs, so moving around the area was also impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once the group moved to the attic, I'd quickly come back from the second floor and opened the door to see if Akaro was present. There were a few seconds around then where someone could've tampered with the bathroom's interior, but since we'd just searched through the entire floor, they needed to have traveled from the future...{w} I could justify it like that, but there was hardly any chance of it.
entries.literal: "Once the group moved to the attic, I'd quickly come back from the second floor and opened the door to see if Akaro was present. There were a few seconds around then where someone could've tampered with the bathroom's interior, but since we'd just searched through the entire floor, they needed to have traveled from the future...{w} I could justify it like that, but there was hardly any chance of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After that, I checked every room on the floor. Someone could've entered the bathroom at that time, but the door hadn't moved when I returned to the cleaning room—it would be open wider if someone went through it.
entries.literal: "After that, I checked every room on the floor. Someone could've entered the bathroom at that time, but the door hadn't moved when I returned to the cleaning room—it would be open wider if someone went through it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So the state of the bathroom was almost certainly identical to how it was when we found Naomi's body, and there was nothing that allowed the culprit to escape. If you could travel back in time and bring the Sekimeiya with you, that was one method, but nothing indicated it was possible.
entries.literal: "So the state of the bathroom was almost certainly identical to how it was when we found Naomi's body, and there was nothing that allowed the culprit to escape. If you could travel back in time and bring the Sekimeiya with you, that was one method, but nothing indicated it was possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Could the key to what happened have been removed by Akaro? Whatever it was, had he left the bathroom with it just then...?
entries.literal: "...{w}Could the key to what happened have been removed by Akaro? Whatever it was, had he left the bathroom with it just then...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had nothing in his hands when he left. Aside from that, he only had a couple small pockets in his pants.
entries.literal: "He had nothing in his hands when he left. Aside from that, he only had a couple small pockets in his pants."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of the blue, I heard a sound while I was still watching hallway B. The sound itself didn't surprise me since I knew someone else had to be skulking around to hide the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Out of the blue, I heard a sound while I was still watching hallway B. The sound itself didn't surprise me since I knew someone else had to be skulking around to hide the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trying not to announce my presence, I observed the hallway, knowing that it couldn't yet have been me and Shiroya. Nobody appeared to be there, which was odd.{w} Shortly after, I heard another sound come from the opposite hallway.
entries.literal: "Trying not to announce my presence, I observed the hallway, knowing that it couldn't yet have been me and Shiroya. Nobody appeared to be there, which was odd.{w} Shortly after, I heard another sound come from the opposite hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached hallway A, a little nervous. As soon as I peeked in, I saw who else was there.
entries.literal: "I approached hallway A, a little nervous. As soon as I peeked in, I saw who else was there."

entries.text: Thunderhead
entries.literal: "Thunderhead"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Sai...{w} He had made the sound and was in front of the event room... However, that shouldn't have been possible. At that moment, he was in the attic. We'd left him in the bedroom after he climbed the ladder to look around.
entries.literal: "It was Sai...{w} He had made the sound and was in front of the event room... However, that shouldn't have been possible. At that moment, he was in the attic. We'd left him in the bedroom after he climbed the ladder to look around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I paused, unsure of how to react, he noticed me. As if he'd seen a deadly creature, he visibly recoiled. He had clearly not expected to see me there, and once we made eye contact, he was left petrified just like I was.
entries.literal: "While I paused, unsure of how to react, he noticed me. As if he'd seen a deadly creature, he visibly recoiled. He had clearly not expected to see me there, and once we made eye contact, he was left petrified just like I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what his next action would be, so I moved over to him. I was half expecting him to run away, but he stood immobile, waiting for me to arrive.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what his next action would be, so I moved over to him. I was half expecting him to run away, but he stood immobile, waiting for me to arrive."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Um.{w=0.4} Hey,{w=0.3} Atsuki.{w=0.4} How are you doing?
entries.literal: "...Um.{w=0.4} Hey,{w=0.3} Atsuki.{w=0.4} How are you doing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I quickly noticed it. He was pretending not to know what he was carrying in his hip pack.
entries.literal: "I quickly noticed it. He was pretending not to know what he was carrying in his hip pack."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All's good—trying to get the most out of my imprisonment. What about you?
entries.literal: "All's good—trying to get the most out of my imprisonment. What about you?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Coincidentally, me too. Has that led you anywhere?
entries.literal: "Coincidentally, me too. Has that led you anywhere?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Let's go to the lobby.
entries.literal: "...{w}Let's go to the lobby."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh? Why?
entries.literal: "Huh? Why?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know, so we don't freeze the world or something.
entries.literal: "I don't know, so we don't freeze the world or something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I were about to arrive. To avoid anything undesirable, we walked to the lobby even though I didn't elaborate further to Sai.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I were about to arrive. To avoid anything undesirable, we walked to the lobby even though I didn't elaborate further to Sai."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you like it better here?
entries.literal: "Do you like it better here?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Yes. Let's not be too loud, either. Anyway, where were you gonna bring that?
entries.literal: "...Yes. Let's not be too loud, either. Anyway, where were you gonna bring that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Bring what?
entries.literal: "Bring what?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What you're hiding there.
entries.literal: "What you're hiding there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai frowned. He tilted his head down, toward his hip pack. Without changing his expression, he unzipped it, and {tip=future}the Sekimeiya was uncovered{/tip}.
entries.literal: "Sai frowned. He tilted his head down, toward his hip pack. Without changing his expression, he unzipped it, and {tip=future}the Sekimeiya was uncovered{/tip}."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the...?
entries.literal: "What the...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is going to sound funny, but I had no idea this was here.
entries.literal: "This is going to sound funny, but I had no idea this was here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Additionally, the Sekimeiya wasn't white. It was gray—the same shade it had shifted to the last time.
entries.literal: "Additionally, the Sekimeiya wasn't white. It was gray—the same shade it had shifted to the last time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It does sound funny. Did you accidentally get it from the cabinet and put it there? Or did it maybe teleport inside?
entries.literal: "It does sound funny. Did you accidentally get it from the cabinet and put it there? Or did it maybe teleport inside?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: More importantly, how did you get here?
entries.literal: "More importantly, how did you get here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You mean that I shouldn't be here, right? I figured. And no, I definitely didn't put it in here. It's not heavy at all, so I didn't notice I had it.
entries.literal: "You mean that I shouldn't be here, right? I figured. And no, I definitely didn't put it in here. It's not heavy at all, so I didn't notice I had it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He took it out. It didn't make him travel, and nothing seemed to have happened.
entries.literal: "He took it out. It didn't make him travel, and nothing seemed to have happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, that's hard to believe. Right now, the Sekimeiya has disappeared. You must've taken it out and just been about to hide it.
entries.literal: "Well, that's hard to believe. Right now, the Sekimeiya has disappeared. You must've taken it out and just been about to hide it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The past Shiroya and I had surely already arrived. We went to the bathroom first, and then to the event room.{w} ...So if Sai had the Sekimeiya, had I interrupted his actions, thereby changing the past?
entries.literal: "...The past Shiroya and I had surely already arrived. We went to the bathroom first, and then to the event room.{w} ...So if Sai had the Sekimeiya, had I interrupted his actions, thereby changing the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If that was it, my travel would become impossible. Was something terrible about to happen...? None of my other actions had resulted in anything similar.
entries.literal: "If that was it, my travel would become impossible. Was something terrible about to happen...? None of my other actions had resulted in anything similar."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...{w} Yeah, I did see the Sekimeiya disappeared. Was it Akaro, or was it you?
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} Yeah, I did see the Sekimeiya disappeared. Was it Akaro, or was it you?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It wasn't either of us. I heard Akaro going up the stairs as soon as he left the bathroom, so it wasn't him. I couldn't look at both hallways at the same time, so I can't be sure that you did it, but you just so happen to be holding it.
entries.literal: "It wasn't either of us. I heard Akaro going up the stairs as soon as he left the bathroom, so it wasn't him. I couldn't look at both hallways at the same time, so I can't be sure that you did it, but you just so happen to be holding it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Apparently, I am. You traveled from the future, right?
entries.literal: "Apparently, I am. You traveled from the future, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why, because I shouldn't be here?
entries.literal: "Why, because I shouldn't be here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Maybe.
entries.literal: "...Maybe."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I might've traveled, yes. You did too, right?
entries.literal: "I might've traveled, yes. You did too, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me? Don't be stupid. I don't know where the Sekimeiya is. I was just searching for it, and it seems I didn't realize I had it.
entries.literal: "Me? Don't be stupid. I don't know where the Sekimeiya is. I was just searching for it, and it seems I didn't realize I had it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I had no idea how I was supposed to take that. I was about to travel with the Sekimeiya from room B3, so why did Sai have it? Of course, believing that he didn't know it was in his hip pack was ridiculous.
entries.literal: "...I had no idea how I was supposed to take that. I was about to travel with the Sekimeiya from room B3, so why did Sai have it? Of course, believing that he didn't know it was in his hip pack was ridiculous."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You definitely traveled, right? Did you already have it in your hip pack when you appeared? Is that what you mean?
entries.literal: "You definitely traveled, right? Did you already have it in your hip pack when you appeared? Is that what you mean?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...That's an interesting thought, even though I didn't travel.
entries.literal: "...That's an interesting thought, even though I didn't travel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If that had happened, it meant that the Sekimeiya traveled with him too, but what would the reason for that be?{w} ...And even then, who hid the Sekimeiya from the cabinet? It was a fact that we'd seen it empty, but I didn't notice anyone entering the room where Shiroya found it.
entries.literal: "If that had happened, it meant that the Sekimeiya traveled with him too, but what would the reason for that be?{w} ...And even then, who hid the Sekimeiya from the cabinet? It was a fact that we'd seen it empty, but I didn't notice anyone entering the room where Shiroya found it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It turned white again...
entries.literal: "It turned white again..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right. How bizarre.
entries.literal: "You're right. How bizarre."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had put the Sekimeiya back in his pack, and out of nowhere, it changed colors again, recovering its white glow.
entries.literal: "Sai had put the Sekimeiya back in his pack, and out of nowhere, it changed colors again, recovering its white glow."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, it went back to normal without needing a lower temperature.
entries.literal: "So, it went back to normal without needing a lower temperature."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe it works again, then. Why don't you try touching it?
entries.literal: "Maybe it works again, then. Why don't you try touching it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Because that'd be very stupid of me. I'd disappear and leave the Sekimeiya here with you. What if you're the one who keeps hiding it?
entries.literal: "Because that'd be very stupid of me. I'd disappear and leave the Sekimeiya here with you. What if you're the one who keeps hiding it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't want to hide it anywhere, and you'd appear in the past. You could make it here the moment you disappear to prevent me from hiding it.
entries.literal: "I don't want to hide it anywhere, and you'd appear in the past. You could make it here the moment you disappear to prevent me from hiding it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's assuming I appear inside the tower. If I appear outside, you could do anything you wanted with it.
entries.literal: "That's assuming I appear inside the tower. If I appear outside, you could do anything you wanted with it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He zipped the Sekimeiya inside his pack.
entries.literal: "He zipped the Sekimeiya inside his pack."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I didn't respond, but he wouldn't break the silence before I did.
entries.literal: "...{w}I didn't respond, but he wouldn't break the silence before I did."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you really expect me to believe that you're not going to run off with it? Come on, Sai. I get how you work at this point, more or less.
entries.literal: "Do you really expect me to believe that you're not going to run off with it? Come on, Sai. I get how you work at this point, more or less."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What does that mean, exactly?
entries.literal: "What does that mean, exactly?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You just like seeing how things play out. You took the Sekimeiya and did something to end up here. I'm not Katei, and you know I'm trustworthy, so why are you trying to lie to me?
entries.literal: "You just like seeing how things play out. You took the Sekimeiya and did something to end up here. I'm not Katei, and you know I'm trustworthy, so why are you trying to lie to me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'd never lie to you, Atsuki. You know that. We're partners. This brief time we've spent together has awoken my deepest feelings for you, in fact.
entries.literal: "I'd never lie to you, Atsuki. You know that. We're partners. This brief time we've spent together has awoken my deepest feelings for you, in fact."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Can you stop fucking with me just for the sake of it? I want this gem put back in the cabinet. That's all.
entries.literal: "...Can you stop fucking with me just for the sake of it? I want this gem put back in the cabinet. That's all."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'd love to do that. I was just following your orders. You haven't told me to move since you brought me here, so I was waiting for your next command.
entries.literal: "I'd love to do that. I was just following your orders. You haven't told me to move since you brought me here, so I was waiting for your next command."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Put it back in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Put it back in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you not hear me?
entries.literal: "Did you not hear me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I heard you.
entries.literal: "I heard you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, was that all? What cabinet? There are almost a hundred of them.
entries.literal: "Oh, was that all? What cabinet? There are almost a hundred of them."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...The one in the event room.
entries.literal: "...The one in the event room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That one, huh? Sure thing.{w} Give me a second, though. This is my self-reflection moment of the day.
entries.literal: "That one, huh? Sure thing.{w} Give me a second, though. This is my self-reflection moment of the day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What the hell was with his face? His appearance was totally blank.
entries.literal: "What the hell was with his face? His appearance was totally blank."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the floor for a while, thinking to myself while Sai let me be. He didn't seem to want to move, so I just observed him in silence.
entries.literal: "I stared at the floor for a while, thinking to myself while Sai let me be. He didn't seem to want to move, so I just observed him in silence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't like I wanted to get into a fight with him, but he clearly had a problem with me. He shifted his weight from one leg to the other in the few minutes we spent in silence, sighing slightly as well. I ran in circles mentally, getting nowhere fast in understanding what the hell was up with him or what had happened with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It wasn't like I wanted to get into a fight with him, but he clearly had a problem with me. He shifted his weight from one leg to the other in the few minutes we spent in silence, sighing slightly as well. I ran in circles mentally, getting nowhere fast in understanding what the hell was up with him or what had happened with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I should have already disappeared, assuming things happened as I remember them. Shiroya must be waiting. Follow me. Got it?
entries.literal: "...{w}I should have already disappeared, assuming things happened as I remember them. Shiroya must be waiting. Follow me. Got it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sure. I gotta say, it's not the same without mint tea.
entries.literal: "Sure. I gotta say, it's not the same without mint tea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the hallway B room where we'd found the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I walked to the hallway B room where we'd found the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was empty.
entries.literal: "It was empty."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Sh-She's not here.
entries.literal: "...Sh-She's not here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did your girlfriend abandon you? That's tragic.
entries.literal: "Did your girlfriend abandon you? That's tragic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped in farther, but I stopped right as I heard Sai taking off behind me.
entries.literal: "I stepped in farther, but I stopped right as I heard Sai taking off behind me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hey! Stop!
entries.literal: "Hey! Stop!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around to chase after him. Fortunately, I'd reacted fast enough to grab him as he was opening the door to the event room.
entries.literal: "I turned around to chase after him. Fortunately, I'd reacted fast enough to grab him as he was opening the door to the event room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What the fuck are you doing?
entries.literal: "...What the fuck are you doing?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're fast. I just got really antsy to see if the Sekimeiya was here. That's all.
entries.literal: "You're fast. I just got really antsy to see if the Sekimeiya was here. That's all."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You were totally running from me. And here, you can see that it's not.
entries.literal: "You were totally running from me. And here, you can see that it's not."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, it appears I'm holding it.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it appears I'm holding it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sudden acceleration wore me out for a moment, so I breathed heavily for a few seconds. I had no idea what Sai was doing there, and it seemed Shiroya had gone somewhere as well.
entries.literal: "The sudden acceleration wore me out for a moment, so I breathed heavily for a few seconds. I had no idea what Sai was doing there, and it seemed Shiroya had gone somewhere as well."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Anyway, put it inside.
entries.literal: "Anyway, put it inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The Sekimeiya? Of course, that's what I was gonna do. Let me try not to touch it.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya? Of course, that's what I was gonna do. Let me try not to touch it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He unzipped his pack and hid his hand under his sleeve.
entries.literal: "He unzipped his pack and hid his hand under his sleeve."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Since keeping the Sekimeiya in the pack doesn't make me travel, it could be that it requires physical contact with your skin. I'll try to only touch it with my shirt.
entries.literal: "Since keeping the Sekimeiya in the pack doesn't make me travel, it could be that it requires physical contact with your skin. I'll try to only touch it with my shirt."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He held it in his hand, which was covered by cloth. He didn't disappear, so what he said made sense. Then, I scrolled open the glass for him, and he placed the Sekimeiya on top of the cushion. Finally, I closed the glass again.
entries.literal: "He held it in his hand, which was covered by cloth. He didn't disappear, so what he said made sense. Then, I scrolled open the glass for him, and he placed the Sekimeiya on top of the cushion. Finally, I closed the glass again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose I was correct.
entries.literal: "I suppose I was correct."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe, but touching it has done nothing a few times. It's possible it wouldn't have worked even if you'd touched it directly.
entries.literal: "Maybe, but touching it has done nothing a few times. It's possible it wouldn't have worked even if you'd touched it directly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Uh... I doubt it, actually. Feel this.
entries.literal: "Uh... I doubt it, actually. Feel this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He touched my arm with his sleeve.{w} It was hot.
entries.literal: "He touched my arm with his sleeve.{w} It was hot."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It wasn't hot at all when it was gray, but now it is—even the pack is. I bet something would happen if I touched it. That's probably why the refrigeration is needed.
entries.literal: "It wasn't hot at all when it was gray, but now it is—even the pack is. I bet something would happen if I touched it. That's probably why the refrigeration is needed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But that's strange. We took it out of the cabinet earlier and touched it while it was white, but it was still cold.
entries.literal: "But that's strange. We took it out of the cabinet earlier and touched it while it was white, but it was still cold."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe something else is needed to activate it. Who knows?
entries.literal: "Maybe something else is needed to activate it. Who knows?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Whatever. What are you doing here? You should still be in the attic.
entries.literal: "Whatever. What are you doing here? You should still be in the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And I am. Consider the me you're talking to right now as a ghost.
entries.literal: "And I am. Consider the me you're talking to right now as a ghost."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Are you just fucking with me? You traveled to the past, just like I did.
entries.literal: "...Are you just fucking with me? You traveled to the past, just like I did."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No way. Traveling to the past is impossible.
entries.literal: "No way. Traveling to the past is impossible."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're getting irritating. I admitted I traveled to the past, so just do the same.
entries.literal: "You're getting irritating. I admitted I traveled to the past, so just do the same."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't get me wrong, I would if I had. It's just that I haven't. I haven't traveled in time, teleported, or activated the Sekimeiya successfully even once.
entries.literal: "Don't get me wrong, I would if I had. It's just that I haven't. I haven't traveled in time, teleported, or activated the Sekimeiya successfully even once."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's bullshit. How can you be here, then? It's not possible.
entries.literal: "That's bullshit. How can you be here, then? It's not possible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You said I should be in the attic, right? Consider this: what if I touch the Sekimeiya in a bit to go back to the past, then go to the attic? I don't have to be the version that's already traveled. I can be the original.
entries.literal: "You said I should be in the attic, right? Consider this: what if I touch the Sekimeiya in a bit to go back to the past, then go to the attic? I don't have to be the version that's already traveled. I can be the original."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...So, at some point, the Sai that was around us changed places with you?
entries.literal: "...So, at some point, the Sai that was around us changed places with you?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course not. I was only letting you know that it's not impossible. I'm telling you, just treat me as a ghost you hallucinated. I can't be here, you know? I'm in the attic.
entries.literal: "Of course not. I was only letting you know that it's not impossible. I'm telling you, just treat me as a ghost you hallucinated. I can't be here, you know? I'm in the attic."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why are you being so stubborn? After Shiroya and I headed downstairs, you did too. Then you traveled to the past, and that's why you're here now.
entries.literal: "Why are you being so stubborn? After Shiroya and I headed downstairs, you did too. Then you traveled to the past, and that's why you're here now."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Except that won't happen. You might not believe me, but it's the truth.
entries.literal: "Except that won't happen. You might not believe me, but it's the truth."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then how can you be here?
entries.literal: "Then how can you be here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure I truly am? Am I not a figment of your imagination?
entries.literal: "Are you sure I truly am? Am I not a figment of your imagination?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You're not.
entries.literal: "...You're not."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suddenly thought of something I could corner him with.
entries.literal: "I suddenly thought of something I could corner him with."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed Sai's hand. It was definitely corporeal: he was no ghost. Without explaining, I dragged him to the security room.
entries.literal: "I grabbed Sai's hand. It was definitely corporeal: he was no ghost. Without explaining, I dragged him to the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immediately, I noticed something odd.
entries.literal: "Immediately, I noticed something odd."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, did you enter this room?
entries.literal: "Sai, did you enter this room?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Didn't we all enter it at some point?
entries.literal: "Didn't we all enter it at some point?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Did you enter it during the past forty minutes?
entries.literal: "...Did you enter it during the past forty minutes?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, I didn't.
entries.literal: "No, I didn't."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's strange, because the door wasn't completely shut. And look, the computer isn't suspended.
entries.literal: "That's strange, because the door wasn't completely shut. And look, the computer isn't suspended."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And so what, I must've entered it?
entries.literal: "And so what, I must've entered it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked forward to see the time displayed on the computer. It said it was {time=11:57.}
entries.literal: "I walked forward to see the time displayed on the computer. It said it was {time=11:57.}"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I used this computer 47 minutes ago, at {time=11:10.} You determined that Katei wasn't in this room during the attack thanks to the sleep timer, so it must be more than 45 minutes.
entries.literal: "I used this computer 47 minutes ago, at {time=11:10.} You determined that Katei wasn't in this room during the attack thanks to the sleep timer, so it must be more than 45 minutes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, fifty minutes of inactivity are needed for the computer to power off the screens.
entries.literal: "Yes, fifty minutes of inactivity are needed for the computer to power off the screens."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So if we wait these remaining three minutes, we'll be able to see if I was the last person to use the computer. If the screens stay on, someone else used it.
entries.literal: "So if we wait these remaining three minutes, we'll be able to see if I was the last person to use the computer. If the screens stay on, someone else used it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Brilliant.
entries.literal: "Brilliant."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Also, the last time this door should've been opened was earlier, when we searched through the entire floor. We made it a point to close every door when we were done for efficiency, so it would be harder for anyone hiding to move between rooms.
entries.literal: "Also, the last time this door should've been opened was earlier, when we searched through the entire floor. We made it a point to close every door when we were done for efficiency, so it would be harder for anyone hiding to move between rooms."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, I saw the computer was powered on, which told me that someone had used it in the past hour. The others didn't pay much mind to it, and neither did you. After that, we closed the door.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I saw the computer was powered on, which told me that someone had used it in the past hour. The others didn't pay much mind to it, and neither did you. After that, we closed the door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So you remember. Good.{w} Despite that, it was open a little bit just now. Someone must have come in here. This door isn't loose, and it won't open all by itself.
entries.literal: "So you remember. Good.{w} Despite that, it was open a little bit just now. Someone must have come in here. This door isn't loose, and it won't open all by itself."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, and? Do you think it was me?
entries.literal: "Yes, and? Do you think it was me?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, I found you in hallway A, and you said you were searching for the Sekimeiya. Did you really not enter this room?
entries.literal: "Well, I found you in hallway A, and you said you were searching for the Sekimeiya. Did you really not enter this room?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I didn't. And even if I had, would you have anything to say?
entries.literal: "I didn't. And even if I had, would you have anything to say?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure yet. Let me tell you the reason I brought you here.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure yet. Let me tell you the reason I brought you here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Show me your wristwatch.
entries.literal: "Show me your wristwatch."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...My what?
entries.literal: "...My what?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's hidden beneath your sleeve, but I saw you still have it. This is the only room that provides us with the current time, so show me what your own watch displays.
entries.literal: "It's hidden beneath your sleeve, but I saw you still have it. This is the only room that provides us with the current time, so show me what your own watch displays."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why?
entries.literal: "Why?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Because it might reveal your lie.{w} Let's say you traveled from {time=12:10.} It's possible the time displayed would now be something like {time=12:20.}
entries.literal: "Because it might reveal your lie.{w} Let's say you traveled from {time=12:10.} It's possible the time displayed would now be something like {time=12:20.}"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. That would reveal that I've come from the future. It's a smart idea.{w} I even said earlier that my time matches the computer's, didn't I?
entries.literal: "I see. That would reveal that I've come from the future. It's a smart idea.{w} I even said earlier that my time matches the computer's, didn't I?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You did.{w} If your time's ahead, you time traveled. If it's the same, it's possible that the body you appear with is identical to how it was at that point in time. That would help us confirm what happened with the second Naomi.
entries.literal: "...You did.{w} If your time's ahead, you time traveled. If it's the same, it's possible that the body you appear with is identical to how it was at that point in time. That would help us confirm what happened with the second Naomi."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What if someone edited the computer's time? It'd be trivial.
entries.literal: "What if someone edited the computer's time? It'd be trivial."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, if someone did that, it would've been you. The door was opened, and the screens are still lit. Although I did check the time fifty minutes ago, so I guess it couldn't have been modified recently. Technically, I guess you could have changed your wristwatch's time instead.
entries.literal: "Well, if someone did that, it would've been you. The door was opened, and the screens are still lit. Although I did check the time fifty minutes ago, so I guess it couldn't have been modified recently. Technically, I guess you could have changed your wristwatch's time instead."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I actually don't even know how to do that.
entries.literal: "I actually don't even know how to do that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just as he said that, the computer entered sleep mode.
entries.literal: "Just as he said that, the computer entered sleep mode."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, unfortunately, there goes your little theory.
entries.literal: "Well, unfortunately, there goes your little theory."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So did someone enter this room and not use the computer? There's no way the door just opened.
entries.literal: "So did someone enter this room and not use the computer? There's no way the door just opened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who knows?
entries.literal: "Who knows?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Just show me your watch.
entries.literal: "Just show me your watch."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: My what?
entries.literal: "My what?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Your watch.
entries.literal: "Your watch."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But I'm watching you right now.
entries.literal: "But I'm watching you right now."

entries.speaker: i
