entries.text: He clearly had a problem with showing me the time, so I knew I was correct. I quickly positioned myself in front of the door so that he couldn't escape again.
entries.literal: "He clearly had a problem with showing me the time, so I knew I was correct. I quickly positioned myself in front of the door so that he couldn't escape again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If you don't want to, you can just admit that you traveled. It's not very hard to figure out.
entries.literal: "If you don't want to, you can just admit that you traveled. It's not very hard to figure out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After he spent a few more seconds in silence, I decided to act first. I grabbed his arm and looked at the miniature screen on his wrist.
entries.literal: "After he spent a few more seconds in silence, I decided to act first. I grabbed his arm and looked at the miniature screen on his wrist."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What?{w} Did you just do this?
entries.literal: "...What?{w} Did you just do this?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh? What's the time?
entries.literal: "Huh? What's the time?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't be stupid. {tip=9999}It's broken{/tip}.
entries.literal: "Don't be stupid. {tip=9999}It's broken{/tip}."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: E-Excuse me?
entries.literal: "E-Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The screen was blank. Nothing was being displayed on it.
entries.literal: "The screen was blank. Nothing was being displayed on it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Really...? When did it stop working?
entries.literal: "Really...? When did it stop working?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you just fucking with me again? Did you do this right now, somehow?
entries.literal: "Are you just fucking with me again? Did you do this right now, somehow?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I didn't do anything. You were looking at me. I didn't even touch the watch.
entries.literal: "I didn't do anything. You were looking at me. I didn't even touch the watch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't object to that. Even though he'd been buying time, he hadn't touched it at all.
entries.literal: "I couldn't object to that. Even though he'd been buying time, he hadn't touched it at all."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You might have anticipated I was gonna ask this and disabled it as soon as we entered this room.
entries.literal: "You might have anticipated I was gonna ask this and disabled it as soon as we entered this room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's flattering if you think I did that, but honestly, I have no idea what happened. I've had it for a long time, so perhaps the battery ran out. I don't even know how I'd "disable" it.
entries.literal: "It's flattering if you think I did that, but honestly, I have no idea what happened. I've had it for a long time, so perhaps the battery ran out. I don't even know how I'd \"disable\" it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let me look at it.
entries.literal: "Let me look at it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was already grabbing his arm, so I inspected the wristwatch a bit more. It had two buttons on its sides, probably to edit the time and other parameters.
entries.literal: "I was already grabbing his arm, so I inspected the wristwatch a bit more. It had two buttons on its sides, probably to edit the time and other parameters."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Can you remove it?
entries.literal: "Can you remove it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. I take it off every night.
entries.literal: "Yes. I take it off every night."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You've become pretty uncooperative. Just take it off.
entries.literal: "...You've become pretty uncooperative. Just take it off."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you confiscating it? You've taken a liking to this watch.
entries.literal: "Are you confiscating it? You've taken a liking to this watch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While he continued speaking in his frivolous tone, he handed it to me. I'd gotten curious about what happened since Sai clearly didn't want to show me his watch at all.
entries.literal: "While he continued speaking in his frivolous tone, he handed it to me. I'd gotten curious about what happened since Sai clearly didn't want to show me his watch at all."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How did you do it? I don't see a power button.
entries.literal: "How did you do it? I don't see a power button."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I didn't do anything. It just so happened to run out of battery now.
entries.literal: "I didn't do anything. It just so happened to run out of battery now."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That'd be a little too convenient.
entries.literal: "That'd be a little too convenient."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You can call it fate. Don't worry, though, I didn't have anything to hide in the first place.
entries.literal: "You can call it fate. Don't worry, though, I didn't have anything to hide in the first place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the backside of the watch, there was a slot for the battery. It took some effort, but I opened it to see a single lithium battery.
entries.literal: "On the backside of the watch, there was a slot for the battery. It took some effort, but I opened it to see a single lithium battery."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How long have you had it for?
entries.literal: "How long have you had it for?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: A few years.
entries.literal: "A few years."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How many, approximately?
entries.literal: "How many, approximately?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Seven or eight.
entries.literal: "Seven or eight."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe it would have run out now, but I'm not sure. Lithium batteries are more expensive, but they last a very long time. They outlast plenty of devices.
entries.literal: "Maybe it would have run out now, but I'm not sure. Lithium batteries are more expensive, but they last a very long time. They outlast plenty of devices."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey, you're pretty good. In that case, maybe the watch itself broke.
entries.literal: "Hey, you're pretty good. In that case, maybe the watch itself broke."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It looks perfectly fine to me.
entries.literal: "It looks perfectly fine to me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Unfortunate, then. I'm curious about what happened too, but it might be a bigger mystery than we thought.
entries.literal: "Unfortunate, then. I'm curious about what happened too, but it might be a bigger mystery than we thought."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're ridiculous. You know exactly what you did to avoid being exposed.
entries.literal: "You're ridiculous. You know exactly what you did to avoid being exposed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I think you're the one being silly here. First, I didn't have anything to hide, and second, I did nothing to this watch. I take good care of it, so I wouldn't break it on a whim.
entries.literal: "I think you're the one being silly here. First, I didn't have anything to hide, and second, I did nothing to this watch. I take good care of it, so I wouldn't break it on a whim."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}You know, remember upstairs, in the attic?{w} I looked through a few drawers and found a bunch of useless junk. I believe I might've seen a compatible battery somewhere.
entries.literal: "...{w}You know, remember upstairs, in the attic?{w} I looked through a few drawers and found a bunch of useless junk. I believe I might've seen a compatible battery somewhere."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...And you were talking about conveniences. You're pretty insistent.
entries.literal: "...And you were talking about conveniences. You're pretty insistent."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I want to know what happened. It's not uncommon to have a couple batteries like this lying around. It's also true that I didn't see you mess with the watch, and since it's not damaged, the most likely explanation is a faulty battery or that it actually was time for it to run out. Let's see if we can power this back on.
entries.literal: "I want to know what happened. It's not uncommon to have a couple batteries like this lying around. It's also true that I didn't see you mess with the watch, and since it's not damaged, the most likely explanation is a faulty battery or that it actually was time for it to run out. Let's see if we can power this back on."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This watch doesn't receive the time from a satellite. You sounded pretty convincing earlier when you said that you didn't know how to edit the time. Maybe you just didn't foresee this at all and the battery actually stopped working.{w} If the battery ran out when the displayed time was, say, {time=12:10}, it could pick up from there when we put in a new one—watches like that exist. Also, this watch was working just earlier, when you said it was {time=11:36.} Let's see what happens when we insert a new battery.
entries.literal: "This watch doesn't receive the time from a satellite. You sounded pretty convincing earlier when you said that you didn't know how to edit the time. Maybe you just didn't foresee this at all and the battery actually stopped working.{w} If the battery ran out when the displayed time was, say, {time=12:10}, it could pick up from there when we put in a new one—watches like that exist. Also, this watch was working just earlier, when you said it was {time=11:36.} Let's see what happens when we insert a new battery."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you being serious...? We can't go to the attic.
entries.literal: "Are you being serious...? We can't go to the attic."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I bet I know why. You're up there and we'd see your past self. Additionally, you don't remember anyone going up.{w} Where did you stay? We could just avoid anyone else.
entries.literal: "I bet I know why. You're up there and we'd see your past self. Additionally, you don't remember anyone going up.{w} Where did you stay? We could just avoid anyone else."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're getting annoying. I don't know what the people above us are doing.
entries.literal: "You're getting annoying. I don't know what the people above us are doing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's go, then.
entries.literal: "Let's go, then."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Where did you see the battery?
entries.literal: "Where did you see the battery?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: In the living room, under the television.
entries.literal: "In the living room, under the television."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Hm, okay. Let's be quick.
entries.literal: "...Hm, okay. Let's be quick."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That works.
entries.literal: "That works."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made sure to keep my grip on Sai's sleeve so that he couldn't escape. I hadn't disregarded Shiroya, so before moving up, I looked through hallway B and still found no trace of her.
entries.literal: "I made sure to keep my grip on Sai's sleeve so that he couldn't escape. I hadn't disregarded Shiroya, so before moving up, I looked through hallway B and still found no trace of her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I started to get a bit worried. She wouldn't have gone off anywhere.
entries.literal: "...I started to get a bit worried. She wouldn't have gone off anywhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd entered the room soon after we'd left, and she no longer seemed to be on the crystal floor... She couldn't have been attacked, could she? We would've heard a yell, and there hadn't been that much time for anything to happen.
entries.literal: "I'd entered the room soon after we'd left, and she no longer seemed to be on the crystal floor... She couldn't have been attacked, could she? We would've heard a yell, and there hadn't been that much time for anything to happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: By going to the attic, I could also check whether she was on the higher floors. For that reason and because the elevator was still supposed to be disabled, we took the stairs up.
entries.literal: "By going to the attic, I could also check whether she was on the higher floors. For that reason and because the elevator was still supposed to be disabled, we took the stairs up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We circled through every floor without finding her.{w} The attic was unlocked, so we went up the last, narrow staircase and entered the living room.
entries.literal: "We circled through every floor without finding her.{w} The attic was unlocked, so we went up the last, narrow staircase and entered the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The floor showed we'd surpassed the time we'd gone down—I could see Shiroya's and my own footprints heading out. I looked at them for a few seconds, but it was difficult to determine if anyone had left after us.
entries.literal: "The floor showed we'd surpassed the time we'd gone down—I could see Shiroya's and my own footprints heading out. I looked at them for a few seconds, but it was difficult to determine if anyone had left after us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It should be here.
entries.literal: "It should be here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kneeled down and opened a drawer. I had to let go of Sai's hand, but he didn't run away. He at least seemed to be genuinely confused about what happened to his wristwatch.
entries.literal: "I kneeled down and opened a drawer. I had to let go of Sai's hand, but he didn't run away. He at least seemed to be genuinely confused about what happened to his wristwatch."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, here it is.
entries.literal: "Yeah, here it is."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right. Let's leave.
entries.literal: "All right. Let's leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If he wanted to leave, the most likely reason was that he'd lived through that time already and knew the people who were still in the bedrooms wouldn't notice us. If that was the case, there was no point in defying what he'd experienced.
entries.literal: "If he wanted to leave, the most likely reason was that he'd lived through that time already and knew the people who were still in the bedrooms wouldn't notice us. If that was the case, there was no point in defying what he'd experienced."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Both of us stepped out of the living room. Before moving down, I looked at the floor one last time, making a mental note of the arrangement of footprints for later.
entries.literal: "Both of us stepped out of the living room. Before moving down, I looked at the floor one last time, making a mental note of the arrangement of footprints for later."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Will it work?
entries.literal: "Will it work?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, I think so. It should be compatible with your watch.
entries.literal: "Yes, I think so. It should be compatible with your watch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was still inside its original package, so it hadn't been used at all. It took me a couple of minutes to get it out with no tools, and as soon as I succeeded, it became clear that it would easily fit. It looked the same as the one that was already inside the wristwatch.
entries.literal: "It was still inside its original package, so it hadn't been used at all. It took me a couple of minutes to get it out with no tools, and as soon as I succeeded, it became clear that it would easily fit. It looked the same as the one that was already inside the wristwatch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I uncovered the battery slot again and removed the original battery. I headed to the first partition and left it in a drawer since I didn't have a proper place to dispose of it.
entries.literal: "I uncovered the battery slot again and removed the original battery. I headed to the first partition and left it in a drawer since I didn't have a proper place to dispose of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After that, I put the new one in place. It was small, so it took me a bit, but it fit perfectly. Finished, I put the cover back on and left the packaging in the same drawer.
entries.literal: "After that, I put the new one in place. It was small, so it took me a bit, but it fit perfectly. Finished, I put the cover back on and left the packaging in the same drawer."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Anything?
entries.literal: "...Anything?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned the watch around and immediately saw that something had changed.
entries.literal: "I turned the watch around and immediately saw that something had changed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It did, but I was wrong.
entries.literal: "It did, but I was wrong."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I told you. I wasn't hiding anything.
entries.literal: "...I told you. I wasn't hiding anything."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not quite what I meant. Look.
entries.literal: "That's not quite what I meant. Look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I showed him what the screen displayed.
entries.literal: "I showed him what the screen displayed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The four digits displaying the time showed a "--:--", which most likely indicated that no time had been set.{w} I would have assumed that the battery removal reset the internal system if not for what was above the time.
entries.literal: "The four digits displaying the time showed a \"--:--\", which most likely indicated that no time had been set.{w} I would have assumed that the battery removal reset the internal system if not for what was above the time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's strange... It might've been like this when I first got the watch.
entries.literal: "That's strange... It might've been like this when I first got the watch."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This should be displaying the current date, right?
entries.literal: "This should be displaying the current date, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It wasn't.
entries.literal: "...It wasn't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The date, above the time, showed "9999-12-31".
entries.literal: "The date, above the time, showed \"9999-12-31\"."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I suppose there was no point to my plan, then. I don't know if you purposely arranged this, but something definitely happened to this watch.
entries.literal: "...I suppose there was no point to my plan, then. I don't know if you purposely arranged this, but something definitely happened to this watch."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It still works, though. The battery had to be the problem. Give it to me.
entries.literal: "It still works, though. The battery had to be the problem. Give it to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I handed it over, and he began to fiddle with the buttons.
entries.literal: "I handed it over, and he began to fiddle with the buttons."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see, I can easily set the time with these.
entries.literal: "I see, I can easily set the time with these."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The time began displaying numbers, and Sai set it to {time=4:00.}
entries.literal: "The time began displaying numbers, and Sai set it to {time=4:00.}"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I really don't get what happened, but I'm glad I won't have to get rid of it. I'll make sure to thank Ashiya for the new battery too.
entries.literal: "I really don't get what happened, but I'm glad I won't have to get rid of it. I'll make sure to thank Ashiya for the new battery too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to object again, but I couldn't find the words. I didn't know anymore if Sai was aware of what had happened.
entries.literal: "I wanted to object again, but I couldn't find the words. I didn't know anymore if Sai was aware of what had happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You traveled to the past, right?
entries.literal: "You traveled to the past, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me?
entries.literal: "Me?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's say you appeared in hallway A. I'll even believe what you said: you realized the Sekimeiya was gone and failed to notice it was in your hip pack.
entries.literal: "Let's say you appeared in hallway A. I'll even believe what you said: you realized the Sekimeiya was gone and failed to notice it was in your hip pack."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You have a watch, so you would've looked at it to find out how far back you went.{w} Did you do that?
entries.literal: "You have a watch, so you would've looked at it to find out how far back you went.{w} Did you do that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}I didn't.{w} However, I didn't travel to the past either, so your question is pretty pointless.
entries.literal: "...{w}I didn't.{w} However, I didn't travel to the past either, so your question is pretty pointless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The date was the odd point. Swapping the batteries shouldn't have changed it to "9999-12-31", and it was unlikely Sai edited it. Needless to say, it was the highest date the format of the watch would allow.
entries.literal: "The date was the odd point. Swapping the batteries shouldn't have changed it to \"9999-12-31\", and it was unlikely Sai edited it. Needless to say, it was the highest date the format of the watch would allow."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anyway, let's go back down.
entries.literal: "Anyway, let's go back down."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: To the crystal floor?
entries.literal: "To the crystal floor?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. I have something to do.
entries.literal: "Yes. I have something to do."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...All right.
entries.literal: "...All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We started moving down. I didn't know what Sai planned to do, but I still had to find Shiroya, who most likely was somewhere below us.
entries.literal: "We started moving down. I didn't know what Sai planned to do, but I still had to find Shiroya, who most likely was somewhere below us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya's not currently in the attic, right?
entries.literal: "Shiroya's not currently in the attic, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who's that?
entries.literal: "Who's that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I let it go before he got on my nerves.
entries.literal: "I let it go before he got on my nerves."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We silently walked all the way down. At first glance, the floor still appeared desolate.
entries.literal: "We silently walked all the way down. At first glance, the floor still appeared desolate."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What did you want to do?
entries.literal: "What did you want to do?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, let's go to the security room.
entries.literal: "Oh, let's go to the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through hallway A, we began walking toward it. His pace was slow, and I'd been in front of him the whole time.
entries.literal: "Through hallway A, we began walking toward it. His pace was slow, and I'd been in front of him the whole time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I was about to reach the doorknob, I heard a sound behind me.
entries.literal: "Once I was about to reach the doorknob, I heard a sound behind me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw an empty hallway as I heard the event room closing.
entries.literal: "I saw an empty hallway as I heard the event room closing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Upon realizing I'd lowered my guard, I sprinted as fast as I could.
entries.literal: "Upon realizing I'd lowered my guard, I sprinted as fast as I could."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the event room, but it was empty. By the time I opened the door to hallway B, I'd lost him.
entries.literal: "I entered the event room, but it was empty. By the time I opened the door to hallway B, I'd lost him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every door around me was closed except the lobby's. I didn't know where he'd gone, but as soon as I picked the wrong path, Sai would escape.
entries.literal: "Every door around me was closed except the lobby's. I didn't know where he'd gone, but as soon as I picked the wrong path, Sai would escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Running toward hallway C meant facing the task of searching through every floor, and going to the lobby meant that he could already have been in hallway A. Instead, I opened a bunch of doors in hallway B hoping he'd taken shelter in one of them, as I couldn't hear the distant sound of running footsteps.
entries.literal: "Running toward hallway C meant facing the task of searching through every floor, and going to the lobby meant that he could already have been in hallway A. Instead, I opened a bunch of doors in hallway B hoping he'd taken shelter in one of them, as I couldn't hear the distant sound of running footsteps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were all empty, and I didn't bother searching too deeply into them.{w} I understood what Sai's business on that floor was. He needed us to go there to have a chance at escaping—he had no way of dodging me on the upper floors.
entries.literal: "They were all empty, and I didn't bother searching too deeply into them.{w} I understood what Sai's business on that floor was. He needed us to go there to have a chance at escaping—he had no way of dodging me on the upper floors."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed. Perhaps I should've expected it, but I didn't blame myself too much. I'd lost Sai, and he'd accomplished his goal of ditching me. Just in case, I went to the security room, where he said he wanted to go.
entries.literal: "I sighed. Perhaps I should've expected it, but I didn't blame myself too much. I'd lost Sai, and he'd accomplished his goal of ditching me. Just in case, I went to the security room, where he said he wanted to go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was empty, and the computer remained suspended. In a corner, I saw the suitcase that Katei had brought there from hallway C.
entries.literal: "It was empty, and the computer remained suspended. In a corner, I saw the suitcase that Katei had brought there from hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was Sai's deal, exactly? Maybe I'd have a better idea once I returned to the attic, but I still needed to find Shiroya.
entries.literal: "What was Sai's deal, exactly? Maybe I'd have a better idea once I returned to the attic, but I still needed to find Shiroya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to look at the computer's time, which read {time=12:18.}{w} I sat on the chair and sighed in exasperation for a few seconds. There were plenty of things to think about, but instead my mind went to something that continued to gnaw at me.
entries.literal: "I went to look at the computer's time, which read {time=12:18.}{w} I sat on the chair and sighed in exasperation for a few seconds. There were plenty of things to think about, but instead my mind went to something that continued to gnaw at me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Sai's watch. More specifically, the date "9999-12-31".
entries.literal: "Sai's watch. More specifically, the date \"9999-12-31\"."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When I found Sai, he should've been in the attic. This means that it's very possible he traveled through time in some capacity, even though he kept denying it. If he did, his watch would've done the same.
entries.literal: "When I found Sai, he should've been in the attic. This means that it's very possible he traveled through time in some capacity, even though he kept denying it. If he did, his watch would've done the same."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "9999-12-31" hints at that even further.{w} It's the highest date the watch could display, so it could be linked to another common concept related to time travel: loops.
entries.literal: "\"9999-12-31\" hints at that even further.{w} It's the highest date the watch could display, so it could be linked to another common concept related to time travel: loops."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Looping through time—reliving the same portion of time over and over. I'm jumping to this thought not only because of the date, but also because the battery ran out before the time it was supposed to.
entries.literal: "Looping through time—reliving the same portion of time over and over. I'm jumping to this thought not only because of the date, but also because the battery ran out before the time it was supposed to."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: For example, if the watch is in the process of traveling from {time=12:20} to the past, until it reaches the travel point, the time displayed would increase per travel. If that's repeated infinite times, the date would eventually hit its maximum value and stay there.
entries.literal: "For example, if the watch is in the process of traveling from {time=12:20} to the past, until it reaches the travel point, the time displayed would increase per travel. If that's repeated infinite times, the date would eventually hit its maximum value and stay there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If the watch had repeated that process infinitely when I saw it, the date could make a bit of sense. Similarly, every few years, the battery would run out, so replacing it would allow the time to continue advancing.
entries.literal: "If the watch had repeated that process infinitely when I saw it, the date could make a bit of sense. Similarly, every few years, the battery would run out, so replacing it would allow the time to continue advancing."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, assuming something of the sort is what happened, is it a coincidence that I just so happened to experience the loop in which the battery had to be replaced?{w} There would be times in which the watch would appear functional and ones in which the date wouldn't have reached the year 9,999 yet. All of those would have to reach the same loop point, which contradicts the way I thought this worked, because traveling to the past would end up modifying it in different manners.
entries.literal: "So, assuming something of the sort is what happened, is it a coincidence that I just so happened to experience the loop in which the battery had to be replaced?{w} There would be times in which the watch would appear functional and ones in which the date wouldn't have reached the year 9,999 yet. All of those would have to reach the same loop point, which contradicts the way I thought this worked, because traveling to the past would end up modifying it in different manners."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But I suppose it's pointless to think about this because a bunch of other contradictions prevent anything like that from ever happening.
entries.literal: "But I suppose it's pointless to think about this because a bunch of other contradictions prevent anything like that from ever happening."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: To begin with, if the wristwatch had traveled back insane amounts of times, it would have physically degraded. If it had survived at least the 8,000 years needed to reach 9,999, the metal would've appeared rusty, and it's hard to believe it wouldn't have just disintegrated instantly.
entries.literal: "To begin with, if the wristwatch had traveled back insane amounts of times, it would have physically degraded. If it had survived at least the 8,000 years needed to reach 9,999, the metal would've appeared rusty, and it's hard to believe it wouldn't have just disintegrated instantly."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Also, Sai had to be the one to bring it back through time, so he'd be older, and he couldn't have existed for the same number of years without dying. This would be circumvented if going to the past replicated your past body, but then the watch's date and time would reset after every travel too.
entries.literal: "Also, Sai had to be the one to bring it back through time, so he'd be older, and he couldn't have existed for the same number of years without dying. This would be circumvented if going to the past replicated your past body, but then the watch's date and time would reset after every travel too."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This is not how the Sekimeiya works. If you travel thirty minutes to the past, during those thirty minutes, two versions of you exist at the same time. If Sai went back with his watch that many times, he would have created a new copy of himself each travel.
entries.literal: "This is not how the Sekimeiya works. If you travel thirty minutes to the past, during those thirty minutes, two versions of you exist at the same time. If Sai went back with his watch that many times, he would have created a new copy of himself each travel."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That isn't all. Naturally, I'm thinking about this to justify the watch's date, but there's no apparent reason why Sai would travel back to the same spot more than once.{w} And if he somehow could circumvent aging, it'd mean that after the point he traveled from, he couldn't exist anymore; if there is a point in time in which he always travels back, he could never make it past that point. Despite that, I'm sure that if I go to the attic right now, I'll see him.
entries.literal: "That isn't all. Naturally, I'm thinking about this to justify the watch's date, but there's no apparent reason why Sai would travel back to the same spot more than once.{w} And if he somehow could circumvent aging, it'd mean that after the point he traveled from, he couldn't exist anymore; if there is a point in time in which he always travels back, he could never make it past that point. Despite that, I'm sure that if I go to the attic right now, I'll see him."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The origin of the Sai I was talking to a few minutes ago should give me some insight, but I'm not sure how much, because he himself seemed unaware of what happened to his watch.
entries.literal: "The origin of the Sai I was talking to a few minutes ago should give me some insight, but I'm not sure how much, because he himself seemed unaware of what happened to his watch."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did the date go up to the year 9,999 for no reason? Was it a malfunction, maybe? Tied with the battery's loss of power, it seems like a bit of a stretch to treat it as one.
entries.literal: "Did the date go up to the year 9,999 for no reason? Was it a malfunction, maybe? Tied with the battery's loss of power, it seems like a bit of a stretch to treat it as one."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The facts are as follows: Sai probably only traveled once because countless versions of himself didn't exist at the same time. The watch can't be in a regular time loop because the Sekimeiya doesn't work like that and because the watch would physically degrade before reaching the year 9,999.{w} And yet the date reached its highest possible value. I really feel that something of significance might be the cause behind it...
entries.literal: "The facts are as follows: Sai probably only traveled once because countless versions of himself didn't exist at the same time. The watch can't be in a regular time loop because the Sekimeiya doesn't work like that and because the watch would physically degrade before reaching the year 9,999.{w} And yet the date reached its highest possible value. I really feel that something of significance might be the cause behind it..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: One last important thing I can take from this is that if the watch's status was caused by Sai traveling to the past, adding that he was surprised to see it disabled and that it was working at {time=11:36}, it's possible that he hadn't yet traveled by that time.
entries.literal: "One last important thing I can take from this is that if the watch's status was caused by Sai traveling to the past, adding that he was surprised to see it disabled and that it was working at {time=11:36}, it's possible that he hadn't yet traveled by that time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I also had to keep in mind that Sai had some good reason to escape from me and that he was in the middle of doing something when I found him. The battery's power running out also felt like it was pretty important, but I couldn't reach any conclusion regarding that.
entries.literal: "I also had to keep in mind that Sai had some good reason to escape from me and that he was in the middle of doing something when I found him. The battery's power running out also felt like it was pretty important, but I couldn't reach any conclusion regarding that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shifted my focus. I had to find Shiroya, but I'd already looked through the crystal floor twice.
entries.literal: "I shifted my focus. I had to find Shiroya, but I'd already looked through the crystal floor twice."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Being in front of the computer made me think of the cameras. It was possible the system had restored, so I tried to see if I could do something with it and find out where Shiroya and Sai were.
entries.literal: "Being in front of the computer made me think of the cameras. It was possible the system had restored, so I tried to see if I could do something with it and find out where Shiroya and Sai were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I clicked on the program with a security camera icon. The text "logged in as Katei Kuiji" was still on the bottom. When I noticed it, I wondered if Katei intentionally left his account logged in to use the excuse that anyone could've used it.
entries.literal: "I clicked on the program with a security camera icon. The text \"logged in as Katei Kuiji\" was still on the bottom. When I noticed it, I wondered if Katei intentionally left his account logged in to use the excuse that anyone could've used it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, I pressed "Initialize Camera Monitoring", but as before, I was met with a message box containing the "Couldn't detect video footage" text. Trying to look at the archived footage yielded no result either.{w} In the lower right corner was a button that read "Power system off", but it was grayed out.
entries.literal: "Next, I pressed \"Initialize Camera Monitoring\", but as before, I was met with a message box containing the \"Couldn't detect video footage\" text. Trying to look at the archived footage yielded no result either.{w} In the lower right corner was a button that read \"Power system off\", but it was grayed out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a messy and hard to follow interface, so the only thing I recognized was a symbol of a wrench that was probably the settings menu.
entries.literal: "It was a messy and hard to follow interface, so the only thing I recognized was a symbol of a wrench that was probably the settings menu."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I clicked on it, a panel with several options appeared. One in particular caught my eye: "Footage".
entries.literal: "When I clicked on it, a panel with several options appeared. One in particular caught my eye: \"Footage\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A new screen appeared after selecting it, showing the path where the recordings could be found. The set path was "B:\Archived", which sounded simple enough.
entries.literal: "A new screen appeared after selecting it, showing the path where the recordings could be found. The set path was \"B:\\Archived\", which sounded simple enough."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In case the program was the cause of the issue, I went ahead and looked for that specific folder. "B:\" indicated that it wasn't saved on the main drive.
entries.literal: "In case the program was the cause of the issue, I went ahead and looked for that specific folder. \"B:\\\" indicated that it wasn't saved on the main drive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I searched for it, but I couldn't find it. No extra drive appeared to exist whatsoever, so it made sense that the footage wasn't being detected.
entries.literal: "I searched for it, but I couldn't find it. No extra drive appeared to exist whatsoever, so it made sense that the footage wasn't being detected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept looking, but to no avail. I performed a thorough search for the word "Archived", but none of the results interested me. The time had been passing fast, and I didn't want to waste any more of it. The computer displayed {time=12:31.}
entries.literal: "I kept looking, but to no avail. I performed a thorough search for the word \"Archived\", but none of the results interested me. The time had been passing fast, and I didn't want to waste any more of it. The computer displayed {time=12:31.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up from the chair. I had to search through the entire floor, but going to the attic for aid was potentially a better choice. Although I didn't think Shiroya would go hide, searching alone was never ideal.
entries.literal: "I stood up from the chair. I had to search through the entire floor, but going to the attic for aid was potentially a better choice. Although I didn't think Shiroya would go hide, searching alone was never ideal."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I left the room, I was once again met with the cold silence of a barren floor. The door closing behind me didn't echo as well as it should've because the smoke cover on the ceiling didn't allow the sound to bounce back properly.
entries.literal: "Once I left the room, I was once again met with the cold silence of a barren floor. The door closing behind me didn't echo as well as it should've because the smoke cover on the ceiling didn't allow the sound to bounce back properly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite that, I still noticed the sound of someone approaching from hallway C.
entries.literal: "Despite that, I still noticed the sound of someone approaching from hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Shiroya. As soon as she saw me, she sped up with a concerned look. As if I were her reflection, I reacted the same way.
entries.literal: "It was Shiroya. As soon as she saw me, she sped up with a concerned look. As if I were her reflection, I reacted the same way."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Where were you...!? Are you okay?
entries.literal: "Where were you...!? Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Y-Yeah, I'm fine... I've been on this floor, for the most part. I was searching for you.
entries.literal: "Y-Yeah, I'm fine... I've been on this floor, for the most part. I was searching for you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I went to the room where you said you'd return to, but you weren't there...
entries.literal: "I went to the room where you said you'd return to, but you weren't there..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You went there? You just had to wait.
entries.literal: "You went there? You just had to wait."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No... Right as you touched the Sekimeiya, I disappeared too.
entries.literal: "No... Right as you touched the Sekimeiya, I disappeared too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Those words came as a surprise, so I forced my breathing to remain normal.
entries.literal: "...{w}Those words came as a surprise, so I forced my breathing to remain normal."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You traveled too? At the same time...?{w} Why did I never see you, then?
entries.literal: "You traveled too? At the same time...?{w} Why did I never see you, then?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well... Just as you touched it, I appeared on the second floor, inside the offices. It was disorienting, like I changed places instantly. That's what happened to you too, right? I thought your travel might've somehow taken me along with you.
entries.literal: "Well... Just as you touched it, I appeared on the second floor, inside the offices. It was disorienting, like I changed places instantly. That's what happened to you too, right? I thought your travel might've somehow taken me along with you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I couldn't believe it was real... Talking about it and having it happen are two totally different things. Where did it send you?
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it was real... Talking about it and having it happen are two totally different things. Where did it send you?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I appeared in the security room. Do you know how far back you went?
entries.literal: "I appeared in the security room. Do you know how far back you went?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think so. I spent a few minutes sitting down since I could barely understand what happened... Then I went to the attic to confirm I'd really traveled back in time. When I saw that the door was still locked, I figured it had really happened.
entries.literal: "I think so. I spent a few minutes sitting down since I could barely understand what happened... Then I went to the attic to confirm I'd really traveled back in time. When I saw that the door was still locked, I figured it had really happened."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Eventually, I started to go back down until I heard sounds approaching me from below that made me hide on the fourth floor. It was a group of people, so I thought it was us when we first entered the attic.
entries.literal: "Eventually, I started to go back down until I heard sounds approaching me from below that made me hide on the fourth floor. It was a group of people, so I thought it was us when we first entered the attic."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I figured I could go to the crystal floor to look at the time. I looked at the computer and estimated I'd gone back about forty minutes.
entries.literal: "I figured I could go to the crystal floor to look at the time. I looked at the computer and estimated I'd gone back about forty minutes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So you opened the door to the security room... We both traveled the same amount of time, then.{w} I-I see... I was in the cleaning room when you came down, so we didn't see each other.
entries.literal: "So you opened the door to the security room... We both traveled the same amount of time, then.{w} I-I see... I was in the cleaning room when you came down, so we didn't see each other."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm...{w} The others returned and then went up again. I knew they were going to the attic, so I followed them to see if everything was actually repeating.{w} I didn't go up immediately, so when I got there, Sai and Katei were already in the bedroom. I entered and listened from the hallway, and they were saying the same things as before.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} The others returned and then went up again. I knew they were going to the attic, so I followed them to see if everything was actually repeating.{w} I didn't go up immediately, so when I got there, Sai and Katei were already in the bedroom. I entered and listened from the hallway, and they were saying the same things as before."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I was so scared of being seen, Atsuki. If the past changes, do things just... unravel?
entries.literal: "I was so scared of being seen, Atsuki. If the past changes, do things just... unravel?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I have no idea. Nobody noticed me this entire time, so it was all consistent with the past that we know. I think nothing changed. Everything I experienced with people from the past was just me observing them without them knowing I was there, so nothing deviated. I even tried to change the past by saving the second Naomi, but it was useless.
entries.literal: "I have no idea. Nobody noticed me this entire time, so it was all consistent with the past that we know. I think nothing changed. Everything I experienced with people from the past was just me observing them without them knowing I was there, so nothing deviated. I even tried to change the past by saving the second Naomi, but it was useless."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Anyway, Sai and Katei really didn't leave the attic, did they...?
entries.literal: "Anyway, Sai and Katei really didn't leave the attic, did they...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't think so, no. I knew we'd be going down in a bit, so I hid in the floor 6 offices. I stayed there for a while so Akaro didn't see me as he went up. Then I came here to meet with you, but you weren't in the room.
entries.literal: "I don't think so, no. I knew we'd be going down in a bit, so I hid in the floor 6 offices. I stayed there for a while so Akaro didn't see me as he went up. Then I came here to meet with you, but you weren't in the room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I wasn't...? I suppose I might've spent a few minutes with Sai in the lobby, but I thought you'd stay there.
entries.literal: "I wasn't...? I suppose I might've spent a few minutes with Sai in the lobby, but I thought you'd stay there."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: With Sai? But he was in the attic. What do you mean? I waited a bit in the room until I got worried something had gone wrong. I saw the Sekimeiya too. It was still where we left it, but it changed colors to the gray from before.
entries.literal: "With Sai? But he was in the attic. What do you mean? I waited a bit in the room until I got worried something had gone wrong. I saw the Sekimeiya too. It was still where we left it, but it changed colors to the gray from before."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So activating it is what powers it off like that.
entries.literal: "So activating it is what powers it off like that."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Probably, but I didn't try to touch it again. I closed the cabinet before I looked around this floor briefly, and I thought that you might be back in the attic. I went there, but not much had seemed to change.{w} I stayed in the hallway to listen to the conversation going on in the bedroom. Even if they'd seen me, it wouldn't have mattered much since we had just left from their perspective.
entries.literal: "Probably, but I didn't try to touch it again. I closed the cabinet before I looked around this floor briefly, and I thought that you might be back in the attic. I went there, but not much had seemed to change.{w} I stayed in the hallway to listen to the conversation going on in the bedroom. Even if they'd seen me, it wouldn't have mattered much since we had just left from their perspective."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: At that point, Sai was still there, right?
entries.literal: "At that point, Sai was still there, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes. He was leading the conversation, telling everyone not to follow us down. Akaro was there too, and he confirmed that he saw us. Sai told them all to wait for us because we'd be responsible for anything that happened after leaving of our own volition...
entries.literal: "Yes. He was leading the conversation, telling everyone not to follow us down. Akaro was there too, and he confirmed that he saw us. Sai told them all to wait for us because we'd be responsible for anything that happened after leaving of our own volition..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I see. So he wanted the others not to come down.
entries.literal: "...I see. So he wanted the others not to come down."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: He kept saying it. He never left, and the elevator was still there with the door open. The conversation started winding down, and when they talked about going to the bathroom, I left right away so nobody would see me.{w} I stayed in the living room for a couple minutes with the doors closed, but I think that they all took that time to go to the bathroom, so I started going down again to find you. I looked through every floor until I saw you right as I was about to start with this one.
entries.literal: "He kept saying it. He never left, and the elevator was still there with the door open. The conversation started winding down, and when they talked about going to the bathroom, I left right away so nobody would see me.{w} I stayed in the living room for a couple minutes with the doors closed, but I think that they all took that time to go to the bathroom, so I started going down again to find you. I looked through every floor until I saw you right as I was about to start with this one."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm...{w} I suppose it makes sense we never saw each other. Five minutes before the point we traveled from, I saw Sai on this floor. I thought he traveled from the future because he was supposed to still be upstairs.{w} If he actually was there during that time, I had to be right in some way. He escaped from me more than ten minutes ago, so I'm not sure where he is right now.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} I suppose it makes sense we never saw each other. Five minutes before the point we traveled from, I saw Sai on this floor. I thought he traveled from the future because he was supposed to still be upstairs.{w} If he actually was there during that time, I had to be right in some way. He escaped from me more than ten minutes ago, so I'm not sure where he is right now."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, I haven't seen him anywhere.
entries.literal: "Oh, I haven't seen him anywhere."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I guess he didn't go up.
entries.literal: "I guess he didn't go up."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well, I looked inside every partition, so he might've been able to.
entries.literal: "Well, I looked inside every partition, so he might've been able to."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know what his goal was, but he's probably accomplished it by now. Regardless, the most important thing is that you were able to travel without touching the Sekimeiya. Not only that, but you went back just as far as me.
entries.literal: "I don't know what his goal was, but he's probably accomplished it by now. Regardless, the most important thing is that you were able to travel without touching the Sekimeiya. Not only that, but you went back just as far as me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I considered that I went back twice as far as my initial travel, but that shouldn't matter anymore since this was your first.
entries.literal: "I considered that I went back twice as far as my initial travel, but that shouldn't matter anymore since this was your first."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And our locations were also different. I'm not sure why I appeared on the second floor.
entries.literal: "And our locations were also different. I'm not sure why I appeared on the second floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah... It could be that it chooses random nearby locations, but that might be a bit of a stretch. It would mean that we could keep trying it until we appear outside the tower, but that recording didn't seem to indicate that will be possible.{w} There's no way it was real, though...
entries.literal: "Yeah... It could be that it chooses random nearby locations, but that might be a bit of a stretch. It would mean that we could keep trying it until we appear outside the tower, but that recording didn't seem to indicate that will be possible.{w} There's no way it was real, though..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Forty minutes before we traveled, both of us were together, moving down from the fifth floor. It can't be that where we appear is decided based on that position, or we would've appeared together.
entries.literal: "Forty minutes before we traveled, both of us were together, moving down from the fifth floor. It can't be that where we appear is decided based on that position, or we would've appeared together."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, I don't know. The amount of time traveled and the location might just be random.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I don't know. The amount of time traveled and the location might just be random."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Both were different than the first time I traveled, but when I disappeared in front of all of you, nobody else went with me. Why did it affect you as well this time?
entries.literal: "Both were different than the first time I traveled, but when I disappeared in front of all of you, nobody else went with me. Why did it affect you as well this time?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I thought about this... I was a few steps behind, and I'm sure at least Sai was closer to you the first time. He was walking to you before you disappeared.
entries.literal: "I thought about this... I was a few steps behind, and I'm sure at least Sai was closer to you the first time. He was walking to you before you disappeared."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But Sai didn't vanish. From that, we can probably assume that the Sekimeiya has an effective range around itself.
entries.literal: "But Sai didn't vanish. From that, we can probably assume that the Sekimeiya has an effective range around itself."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You think so...?
entries.literal: "You think so...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, even though you were picked up too, it's not like the people in the attic traveled. There's a specific distance from the Sekimeiya in which people can travel if it's activated.{w} The first time, it was smaller, which is why Sai didn't travel.
entries.literal: "Well, even though you were picked up too, it's not like the people in the attic traveled. There's a specific distance from the Sekimeiya in which people can travel if it's activated.{w} The first time, it was smaller, which is why Sai didn't travel."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...If that's the case, are the distance it picks people up and the distance you move through time related?
entries.literal: "...If that's the case, are the distance it picks people up and the distance you move through time related?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That was my first thought too. The first time, I went twenty minutes into the past, and Sai, who was a few steps behind me, wasn't within range. This time, I went forty minutes into the past, and you went too despite being a bit farther away.{w} Both times before traveling, I felt a painful burn on my fingers for a split second. The Sekimeiya was searing. I believe the second time it was even hotter, so that could be tied to this as well.{w} Inside its cabinet, the Sekimeiya is kept cold. Once it's removed, it begins to get progressively hotter at an unnatural rate. Sai brought up something like this earlier.
entries.literal: "That was my first thought too. The first time, I went twenty minutes into the past, and Sai, who was a few steps behind me, wasn't within range. This time, I went forty minutes into the past, and you went too despite being a bit farther away.{w} Both times before traveling, I felt a painful burn on my fingers for a split second. The Sekimeiya was searing. I believe the second time it was even hotter, so that could be tied to this as well.{w} Inside its cabinet, the Sekimeiya is kept cold. Once it's removed, it begins to get progressively hotter at an unnatural rate. Sai brought up something like this earlier."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: After traveling, I paid attention to the room where we found the Sekimeiya, but I didn't see anyone hiding it there. We don't know how long it was there, but it should've been outside the cabinet for longer than the first time.
entries.literal: "After traveling, I paid attention to the room where we found the Sekimeiya, but I didn't see anyone hiding it there. We don't know how long it was there, but it should've been outside the cabinet for longer than the first time."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It could be something like that, yeah. The distance traveled, the range around it, and how hot it gets could all increment slowly as soon as the Sekimeiya's away from a regulated temperature.
entries.literal: "It could be something like that, yeah. The distance traveled, the range around it, and how hot it gets could all increment slowly as soon as the Sekimeiya's away from a regulated temperature."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The place we teleport to still seems to be completely unrelated, though. Despite everything we've learned, I'm not sure if there's some other factor given that it hasn't responded on touch sometimes.
entries.literal: "The place we teleport to still seems to be completely unrelated, though. Despite everything we've learned, I'm not sure if there's some other factor given that it hasn't responded on touch sometimes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It seems that when it's activated, the energy stored is released completely, and the Sekimeiya turns gray and cools off immediately. I think it starts glowing again after some time, but exposing it to the cold might accelerate that, like we saw. I'm saying this because the Sai I met had the Sekimeiya on him, and it went from gray to white before we put it in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "It seems that when it's activated, the energy stored is released completely, and the Sekimeiya turns gray and cools off immediately. I think it starts glowing again after some time, but exposing it to the cold might accelerate that, like we saw. I'm saying this because the Sai I met had the Sekimeiya on him, and it went from gray to white before we put it in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I still don't follow what you're saying about this Sai. We should go upstairs already to see what he's been getting up to. He was priming everyone to suspect us.
entries.literal: "I still don't follow what you're saying about this Sai. We should go upstairs already to see what he's been getting up to. He was priming everyone to suspect us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, but hang on a second...
entries.literal: "Yes, but hang on a second..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't fully explained to her what I'd gone through upon traveling to the past. The big mystery I'd experienced was still the killer vanishing from the bathroom without being able to touch the Sekimeiya. I'd gotten to the conclusion that, most likely, the bathroom was completely empty when we saw Naomi's second body.
entries.literal: "I hadn't fully explained to her what I'd gone through upon traveling to the past. The big mystery I'd experienced was still the killer vanishing from the bathroom without being able to touch the Sekimeiya. I'd gotten to the conclusion that, most likely, the bathroom was completely empty when we saw Naomi's second body."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And we'd just learned of a supposed "range". It would let someone travel without needing to touch the Sekimeiya, but they'd need to be close to it. Since the Sekimeiya was in its cabinet at that time, it wouldn't have been possible.
entries.literal: "And we'd just learned of a supposed \"range\". It would let someone travel without needing to touch the Sekimeiya, but they'd need to be close to it. Since the Sekimeiya was in its cabinet at that time, it wouldn't have been possible."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I was in front of the bathroom when it was locked, so if that was when the culprit disappeared, it would've teleported me as well alongside the others in the event room, assuming that was the source.{w} After we heard the sound, we first searched through hallway A. During that time, is it possible that someone used the Sekimeiya and the range encompassed the culprit in the bathroom? Given that we still found it inside the cabinet after finding the second Naomi, that doesn't seem feasible.
entries.literal: "I was in front of the bathroom when it was locked, so if that was when the culprit disappeared, it would've teleported me as well alongside the others in the event room, assuming that was the source.{w} After we heard the sound, we first searched through hallway A. During that time, is it possible that someone used the Sekimeiya and the range encompassed the culprit in the bathroom? Given that we still found it inside the cabinet after finding the second Naomi, that doesn't seem feasible."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But... there might be one way. According to Shiroya, she returned to room B3 and found the Sekimeiya in the cabinet where I'd activated it, and at that point, Sai had a disabled Sekimeiya in his hip pack. Was there a second Sekimeiya at the same time as another?{w} While the culprit was locked in the bathroom, could it be that someone made them escape with another Sekimeiya? ...Someone who remained in hallway B, maybe? Could it have happened from the second floor?{w} And then, did both that person and the culprit escape to the past? If so, where the hell have they been all this time? This concept of "range" must start to explain what happened...
entries.literal: "But... there might be one way. According to Shiroya, she returned to room B3 and found the Sekimeiya in the cabinet where I'd activated it, and at that point, Sai had a disabled Sekimeiya in his hip pack. Was there a second Sekimeiya at the same time as another?{w} While the culprit was locked in the bathroom, could it be that someone made them escape with another Sekimeiya? ...Someone who remained in hallway B, maybe? Could it have happened from the second floor?{w} And then, did both that person and the culprit escape to the past? If so, where the hell have they been all this time? This concept of \"range\" must start to explain what happened..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Before we go up, let's check the Sekimeiya. Katei might get unreasonably angry if we don't leave it in the cabinet, and something's still really strange.
entries.literal: "...Before we go up, let's check the Sekimeiya. Katei might get unreasonably angry if we don't leave it in the cabinet, and something's still really strange."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What is?
entries.literal: "What is?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, Sai was holding a powered-off Sekimeiya in his hip pack right when we both traveled.
entries.literal: "Well, Sai was holding a powered-off Sekimeiya in his hip pack right when we both traveled."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm, so there were two of them at that point.
entries.literal: "Hm, so there were two of them at that point."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If the past wasn't changed at all, yes. Sai seemed legitimately surprised to see himself holding it, but it's insane to think that it was put there without him noticing. Even if he somehow traveled from the future holding it, he should've been conscious that he had it.
entries.literal: "If the past wasn't changed at all, yes. Sai seemed legitimately surprised to see himself holding it, but it's insane to think that it was put there without him noticing. Even if he somehow traveled from the future holding it, he should've been conscious that he had it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: How would you appear while taking it with you, though?
entries.literal: "How would you appear while taking it with you, though?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can't think of anything. But right now, more than one Sekimeiya might exist.{w} If you had two, you could bring one to the past. You just need to be holding one while you touch the other.{w} I really don't think that can be the answer. The second one would've spawned out of nowhere.
entries.literal: "I can't think of anything. But right now, more than one Sekimeiya might exist.{w} If you had two, you could bring one to the past. You just need to be holding one while you touch the other.{w} I really don't think that can be the answer. The second one would've spawned out of nowhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the event room, where that Sai and I had left his Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "We entered the event room, where that Sai and I had left his Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the cabinet was empty.
entries.literal: "However, the cabinet was empty."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh... What?
entries.literal: "Oh... What?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What's wrong?
entries.literal: "What's wrong?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right, the Sekimeiya Sai had... We put it here.
entries.literal: "Right, the Sekimeiya Sai had... We put it here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh? Then, did he...?
entries.literal: "Huh? Then, did he...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of answering, I opened the opposite door and entered the room we'd traveled from.
entries.literal: "Instead of answering, I opened the opposite door and entered the room we'd traveled from."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You closed the glass again. Did you also put the cushion back in place?
entries.literal: "You closed the glass again. Did you also put the cushion back in place?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes. It was left out, and I put it back with the Sekimeiya under it so that it wouldn't stand out. I didn't want to touch it, and I thought you had to be nearby.
entries.literal: "Yes. It was left out, and I put it back with the Sekimeiya under it so that it wouldn't stand out. I didn't want to touch it, and I thought you had to be nearby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went ahead and grabbed it.{w} It didn't take me long to confirm that nothing was below it.
entries.literal: "I went ahead and grabbed it.{w} It didn't take me long to confirm that nothing was below it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...It's not here.
entries.literal: "...It's not here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's...
entries.literal: "That's..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, Sai must've taken it. Both of them.
entries.literal: "Yeah, Sai must've taken it. Both of them."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He had the perfect chance and alibi. After he slipped away, he came here. Maybe he hid it somewhere else.
entries.literal: "He had the perfect chance and alibi. After he slipped away, he came here. Maybe he hid it somewhere else."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Really? What's he trying to do...?
entries.literal: "Really? What's he trying to do...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know, but he might have an extra Sekimeiya at his disposal. If he travels to the past holding one, he could appear where I saw him and explain the existence of it.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but he might have an extra Sekimeiya at his disposal. If he travels to the past holding one, he could appear where I saw him and explain the existence of it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But... like you said, this is a paradox, right? The other Sekimeiya has no origin, and him traveling with it is what allowed him to travel with it.
entries.literal: "But... like you said, this is a paradox, right? The other Sekimeiya has no origin, and him traveling with it is what allowed him to travel with it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Which is why I think there has to be more to it. We need to go talk to him.
entries.literal: "Which is why I think there has to be more to it. We need to go talk to him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya agreed, and I repositioned the cushion before leaving. Since the elevator should've still been out of commission, we took the stairs up.
entries.literal: "Shiroya agreed, and I repositioned the cushion before leaving. Since the elevator should've still been out of commission, we took the stairs up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In a short time, we were in front of the top staircase. Before stepping inside the attic, I asked Shiroya to hold up.
entries.literal: "In a short time, we were in front of the top staircase. Before stepping inside the attic, I asked Shiroya to hold up."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I looked at these footprints before leaving. They've all degraded, but I believe these are new.
entries.literal: "...I looked at these footprints before leaving. They've all degraded, but I believe these are new."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pointed at the pair of footprints that looked more prominent.
entries.literal: "I pointed at the pair of footprints that looked more prominent."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You can tell? These should be mine since I was the last person to leave the attic. They fit.
entries.literal: "You can tell? These should be mine since I was the last person to leave the attic. They fit."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I thought so. Meaning that nobody else entered or left through this door apart from you...
entries.literal: "I thought so. Meaning that nobody else entered or left through this door apart from you..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked in. Nobody was in the living room, but faint voices could be heard coming from the bedroom where we'd been. Upon opening the door, five pairs of eyes fixed themselves on us, and Sai took the initiative to begin speaking without letting anyone else react.
entries.literal: "We walked in. Nobody was in the living room, but faint voices could be heard coming from the bedroom where we'd been. Upon opening the door, five pairs of eyes fixed themselves on us, and Sai took the initiative to begin speaking without letting anyone else react."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey, you two. Did you enjoy your fifty minute trip downstairs? What the hell were you doing?
entries.literal: "Hey, you two. Did you enjoy your fifty minute trip downstairs? What the hell were you doing?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We were getting worried...! Why did you leave without saying anything?
entries.literal: "We were getting worried...! Why did you leave without saying anything?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, we went to check if the Sekimeiya was where we thought it'd be.
entries.literal: "Well, we went to check if the Sekimeiya was where we thought it'd be."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? We left it in the cabinet! Where else would it be? And that doesn't take fifty minutes!
entries.literal: "What? We left it in the cabinet! Where else would it be? And that doesn't take fifty minutes!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Before we explain ourselves, let me request something. Sai, can you show me your wristwatch?
entries.literal: "Before we explain ourselves, let me request something. Sai, can you show me your wristwatch?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What? Do you wanna know the time? It's {time=12:37.}
entries.literal: "What? Do you wanna know the time? It's {time=12:37.}"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, just show it to me.
entries.literal: "No, just show it to me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you not believe me? Look.
entries.literal: "Do you not believe me? Look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He turned his wrist around. That was the time displayed on the watch's screen, along with the correct date: "2011-12-15".
entries.literal: "He turned his wrist around. That was the time displayed on the watch's screen, along with the correct date: \"2011-12-15\"."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you just set the date back to normal?
entries.literal: "Did you just set the date back to normal?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What do you mean? Why would I need to change it?
entries.literal: "What do you mean? Why would I need to change it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Forget it. When we went down, we found the Sekimeiya in room B3 after seeing that the cabinet in the event room was empty.
entries.literal: "Forget it. When we went down, we found the Sekimeiya in room B3 after seeing that the cabinet in the event room was empty."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What...? That's impossible.
entries.literal: "What...? That's impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all instinctively looked at Akaro, who seemed like the only person who could've done it, but he denied any involvement.
entries.literal: "We all instinctively looked at Akaro, who seemed like the only person who could've done it, but he denied any involvement."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After that, we told them about our respective travels, about seeing Sai on the crystal floor with a disabled Sekimeiya, about being unable to find Shiroya for a while, about coming to the attic, and about Sai's escape. It all amounted to the fifty minutes we'd been gone, but from our perspective, we'd been gone for about an hour and thirty minutes.
entries.literal: "After that, we told them about our respective travels, about seeing Sai on the crystal floor with a disabled Sekimeiya, about being unable to find Shiroya for a while, about coming to the attic, and about Sai's escape. It all amounted to the fifty minutes we'd been gone, but from our perspective, we'd been gone for about an hour and thirty minutes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is a laughable story you're making up. You hid the Sekimeiya and are now trying to blame me.
entries.literal: "This is a laughable story you're making up. You hid the Sekimeiya and are now trying to blame me."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: It can't be... Sai was here the whole time.
entries.literal: "It can't be... Sai was here the whole time."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you sure? Did he ever have the time to go down?
entries.literal: "Are you sure? Did he ever have the time to go down?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No, he didn't leave.
entries.literal: "No, he didn't leave."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, do you really not know what I'm talking about?
entries.literal: "Sai, do you really not know what I'm talking about?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I have no clue.
entries.literal: "I have no clue."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If that's the case, you'll eventually travel back to the past and experience what I said.
entries.literal: "If that's the case, you'll eventually travel back to the past and experience what I said."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sorry, but that won't happen. You've said that you spotted me in hallway A, so if I ever go back to the past, I'll avoid being seen.{w} It's that simple. You've told me what happened, so you've made sure I won't ever let it occur. If I travel to the past, I'll quickly check my hip pack, so there's no way I won't know I had the Sekimeiya there. This proves you're just making it all up.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry, but that won't happen. You've said that you spotted me in hallway A, so if I ever go back to the past, I'll avoid being seen.{w} It's that simple. You've told me what happened, so you've made sure I won't ever let it occur. If I travel to the past, I'll quickly check my hip pack, so there's no way I won't know I had the Sekimeiya there. This proves you're just making it all up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I didn't know how to refute that. If he was truly unaware of the events downstairs, he couldn't live out what I'd experienced unless he lost his memory of me describing it. After all, when I saw him, he'd looked legitimately surprised to see me because I shouldn't have been there. If the Sai in front of me traveled, he would know about it, causing that reaction to be either impossible or fake.
entries.literal: "...I didn't know how to refute that. If he was truly unaware of the events downstairs, he couldn't live out what I'd experienced unless he lost his memory of me describing it. After all, when I saw him, he'd looked legitimately surprised to see me because I shouldn't have been there. If the Sai in front of me traveled, he would know about it, causing that reaction to be either impossible or fake."

entries.speaker: sai
