entries.text: You know, Atsuki... Are you sure you're not just creating an alibi for Shiroya? She seems like the most suspicious person to me, given what you told us.
entries.literal: "You know, Atsuki... Are you sure you're not just creating an alibi for Shiroya? She seems like the most suspicious person to me, given what you told us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm sorry...?
entries.literal: "I'm sorry...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya frowned too. How was she any more suspicious than I was?
entries.literal: "Shiroya frowned too. How was she any more suspicious than I was?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This version of myself you describe... It just seems like your imagination. I was here the whole time, so what's with this Sai appearing down there for no reason and clearly holding the Sekimeiya, which told you he was up to something...?
entries.literal: "This version of myself you describe... It just seems like your imagination. I was here the whole time, so what's with this Sai appearing down there for no reason and clearly holding the Sekimeiya, which told you he was up to something...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: According to you, Shiroya went back to the past. She knew where to hide the Sekimeiya and was the only one who could've done it. She also wasn't where you agreed to meet, right? This version of myself you saw, who couldn't have existed, is nothing but an excuse to remove suspicion from her. Am I wrong?
entries.literal: "According to you, Shiroya went back to the past. She knew where to hide the Sekimeiya and was the only one who could've done it. She also wasn't where you agreed to meet, right? This version of myself you saw, who couldn't have existed, is nothing but an excuse to remove suspicion from her. Am I wrong?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're being ridiculous. If anything, I now know you're very aware of what I saw, or else you would've suspected both of us. You know my story is true.
entries.literal: "You're being ridiculous. If anything, I now know you're very aware of what I saw, or else you would've suspected both of us. You know my story is true."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't act like a smartass. I just chose to suspect her before you. Are you sure you can really trust her that much? Didn't she have the cabinet key in her purse?
entries.literal: "Don't act like a smartass. I just chose to suspect her before you. Are you sure you can really trust her that much? Didn't she have the cabinet key in her purse?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I also remember that she couldn't have hidden the Sekimeiya in the storeroom.
entries.literal: "I also remember that she couldn't have hidden the Sekimeiya in the storeroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's true! Unfortunately, nobody else could have, which means that someone who appears not to have been able to do it did it anyway. What if it was her?
entries.literal: "That's true! Unfortunately, nobody else could have, which means that someone who appears not to have been able to do it did it anyway. What if it was her?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Don't look at me like that. You're the two people who left us without saying a word, and now you claim the Sekimeiya disappeared from the cabinet. Either you two are responsible, or only one is. I was only trying to trust you, Atsuki.
entries.literal: "...Don't look at me like that. You're the two people who left us without saying a word, and now you claim the Sekimeiya disappeared from the cabinet. Either you two are responsible, or only one is. I was only trying to trust you, Atsuki."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm going to make this very clear for you, Sai. Don't try to push her around. You can say what you want about Katei, even about me, but you'd seriously better think twice before you go accusing her. She's done nothing wrong. In fact, she's the last person who would ever try to take advantage of this incident, right after me.
entries.literal: "I'm going to make this very clear for you, Sai. Don't try to push her around. You can say what you want about Katei, even about me, but you'd seriously better think twice before you go accusing her. She's done nothing wrong. In fact, she's the last person who would ever try to take advantage of this incident, right after me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't follow.
entries.literal: "I don't follow."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You don't need to. Sometimes, you just need to be quiet and listen.
entries.literal: "You don't need to. Sometimes, you just need to be quiet and listen."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I-I still can't believe this is all for real. Are you two being serious? Did you travel through time? Atsuki said it before, but...
entries.literal: "I-I still can't believe this is all for real. Are you two being serious? Did you travel through time? Atsuki said it before, but..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. I'm completely sure now. There's no other explanation for what we experienced.
entries.literal: "Yes. I'm completely sure now. There's no other explanation for what we experienced."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm certain too. Somehow, the Sekimeiya has that power.
entries.literal: "I'm certain too. Somehow, the Sekimeiya has that power."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Listen, if I'd hidden a device that lets me travel to the past, I'd currently be buying yesterday's lottery ticket, not hanging around here.
entries.literal: "Listen, if I'd hidden a device that lets me travel to the past, I'd currently be buying yesterday's lottery ticket, not hanging around here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The rules seem a bit volatile, so maybe you're not aware of them. Something led me to believe that the Sai I met never traveled before. Your purpose might be to experiment with it or to try to leave this building with it.
entries.literal: "The rules seem a bit volatile, so maybe you're not aware of them. Something led me to believe that the Sai I met never traveled before. Your purpose might be to experiment with it or to try to leave this building with it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you lose your mind? How would I get out and still keep it?
entries.literal: "Did you lose your mind? How would I get out and still keep it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: At one point earlier, two copies of the Sekimeiya might've existed at once. I'm not sure how that came to happen, but by hiding only one, you could lead Ashiya to believe the Sekimeiya hadn't been stolen while keeping the other one hidden to retrieve it later.
entries.literal: "At one point earlier, two copies of the Sekimeiya might've existed at once. I'm not sure how that came to happen, but by hiding only one, you could lead Ashiya to believe the Sekimeiya hadn't been stolen while keeping the other one hidden to retrieve it later."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, unfortunately, this second Sekimeiya is just part of your imagination. It can't exist, and it seems both of them vanished. We're not going to take any of this seriously when it comes from the most likely suspect behind this new disappearance.
entries.literal: "Well, unfortunately, this second Sekimeiya is just part of your imagination. It can't exist, and it seems both of them vanished. We're not going to take any of this seriously when it comes from the most likely suspect behind this new disappearance."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you no longer think an "unknown culprit" is behind this?
entries.literal: "Do you no longer think an \"unknown culprit\" is behind this?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's still the second most likely possibility along with Akaro.
entries.literal: "That's still the second most likely possibility along with Akaro."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It wasn't me. I promise.
entries.literal: "It wasn't me. I promise."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We have to go downstairs. If someone hid it again, we should be able to find it just like before.
entries.literal: "We have to go downstairs. If someone hid it again, we should be able to find it just like before."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's true. We keep repeating this, but the cameras are still working. They will eventually expose everything to the police.
entries.literal: "That's true. We keep repeating this, but the cameras are still working. They will eventually expose everything to the police."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro seemed to have gone back to his normal self. He was probably right, but a culprit with time traveling knowledge might not have cared too much about that.
entries.literal: "Akaro seemed to have gone back to his normal self. He was probably right, but a culprit with time traveling knowledge might not have cared too much about that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do we need to? We can just stay here, where we're more comfortable.
entries.literal: "Do we need to? We can just stay here, where we're more comfortable."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm not fond of staying with people I know are plotting something, especially when it's more than one of you. Let's go see what these two are talking about.
entries.literal: "I'm not fond of staying with people I know are plotting something, especially when it's more than one of you. Let's go see what these two are talking about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We agreed to go down. Meanwhile, I continued to debate whether the Sai next to us the one I'd seen on the crystal floor. If so, how had he managed to trick all of us?
entries.literal: "We agreed to go down. Meanwhile, I continued to debate whether the Sai next to us the one I'd seen on the crystal floor. If so, how had he managed to trick all of us?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Because if he wasn't the same one, the origin of the extra Sai remained as the hardest mystery to solve, alongside his motive and actions.
entries.literal: "...Because if he wasn't the same one, the origin of the extra Sai remained as the hardest mystery to solve, alongside his motive and actions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had two Sekimeiya ever existed at the same time? Was that still the case? And if so, how had it happened?{w} I hoped we'd quickly have a better idea of all that, but in the meantime, I continued running through my previous thoughts. We were only four hours into our imprisonment, and we were already dealing with a seemingly incomprehensible pile of questions.
entries.literal: "Had two Sekimeiya ever existed at the same time? Was that still the case? And if so, how had it happened?{w} I hoped we'd quickly have a better idea of all that, but in the meantime, I continued running through my previous thoughts. We were only four hours into our imprisonment, and we were already dealing with a seemingly incomprehensible pile of questions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before leaving the attic, we made sure nobody else was there. The elevator was still open, and we left it that way.
entries.literal: "Before leaving the attic, we made sure nobody else was there. The elevator was still open, and we left it that way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As we moved down the floors, we entered all the offices; once we were done with the ones on floor 2, nobody could've been above us. At the end, only the crystal floor remained.
entries.literal: "As we moved down the floors, we entered all the offices; once we were done with the ones on floor 2, nobody could've been above us. At the end, only the crystal floor remained."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of us went to the event room, leaving Erina and Isla by hallway A to watch the stairs like before. Shiroya and I had left the cabinet uncovered, so everyone else immediately had a view of the empty interior.
entries.literal: "All of us went to the event room, leaving Erina and Isla by hallway A to watch the stairs like before. Shiroya and I had left the cabinet uncovered, so everyone else immediately had a view of the empty interior."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Atsuki, be aware that if this is your doing, Ashiya will figure it out.
entries.literal: "...Atsuki, be aware that if this is your doing, Ashiya will figure it out."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's fine. We had nothing to do with it. It must've been Sai.
entries.literal: "That's fine. We had nothing to do with it. It must've been Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We waited a couple seconds for his denial, but it never came.
entries.literal: "We waited a couple seconds for his denial, but it never came."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait... Is he not here?
entries.literal: "Wait... Is he not here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We turned around to discover that Sai wasn't with us. Shiroya, next to the other door we'd left open, peeked at hallway B.
entries.literal: "We turned around to discover that Sai wasn't with us. Shiroya, next to the other door we'd left open, peeked at hallway B."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Where are you going...?
entries.literal: "Where are you going...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai didn't reply. When I looked at the hallway, I saw him in front of a door. Even though he'd heard us, he ignored our call and disappeared off to hallway C.
entries.literal: "Sai didn't reply. When I looked at the hallway, I saw him in front of a door. Even though he'd heard us, he ignored our call and disappeared off to hallway C."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck is he doing now...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck is he doing now...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei gestured at Erina to stay in the opposite hallway. Shiroya and I were interested in the room Sai'd been next to, so we approached it with Katei behind us.
entries.literal: "Katei gestured at Erina to stay in the opposite hallway. Shiroya and I were interested in the room Sai'd been next to, so we approached it with Katei behind us."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai! Come here! Where did you go...!?
entries.literal: "Sai! Come here! Where did you go...!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya reached the door first and opened it. Inside was the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "Shiroya reached the door first and opened it. Inside was the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure what Sai planned to do, but we'd seen him standing in front of the door. Shiroya and I entered while Katei continued toward hallway C in pursuit of him.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure what Sai planned to do, but we'd seen him standing in front of the door. Shiroya and I entered while Katei continued toward hallway C in pursuit of him."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: He stopped himself, but I saw his arm about to open this door. He was definitely going to go in here.
entries.literal: "He stopped himself, but I saw his arm about to open this door. He was definitely going to go in here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was only one reason why. He wanted to activate the Sekimeiya there after previously hiding it. If he did that, he could disappear without us noticing it.
entries.literal: "There was only one reason why. He wanted to activate the Sekimeiya there after previously hiding it. If he did that, he could disappear without us noticing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya was looking around while I questioned Sai's ambiguous action. If he'd concealed the Sekimeiya in that room, I wasn't sure why he left upon realizing that we'd seen him. He had the opportunity to give up, but instead, he left for hallway C.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was looking around while I questioned Sai's ambiguous action. If he'd concealed the Sekimeiya in that room, I wasn't sure why he left upon realizing that we'd seen him. He had the opportunity to give up, but instead, he left for hallway C."

entries.text: Airtight Room
entries.literal: "Airtight Room"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I had time to think about it, the dim environment around me changed; a large light was illuminating the much more comforting room. I felt no confusion that time, as I realized immediately that I had teleported to the living room in the attic.
entries.literal: "Before I had time to think about it, the dim environment around me changed; a large light was illuminating the much more comforting room. I felt no confusion that time, as I realized immediately that I had teleported to the living room in the attic."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This is getting too crazy... What the fuck happened now...?
entries.literal: "This is getting too crazy... What the fuck happened now...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew I had traveled, but I wasn't the one to activate the Sekimeiya. It didn't catch me completely off guard—I already knew that was possible.
entries.literal: "I knew I had traveled, but I wasn't the one to activate the Sekimeiya. It didn't catch me completely off guard—I already knew that was possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That meant I had just been in the range of the Sekimeiya. It was most likely in the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "That meant I had just been in the range of the Sekimeiya. It was most likely in the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And Shiroya was probably been the one to activate it, meaning that she should've also appeared somewhere.
entries.literal: "And Shiroya was probably been the one to activate it, meaning that she should've also appeared somewhere."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: How far did I go this time...?
entries.literal: "How far did I go this time...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I thought that, I considered some implications of what had occurred. The past hour was extremely dense; Sai managed to appear and disappear, and Shiroya had investigated every floor. Assuming that Shiroya traveled with me, we had both remained unseen for that entire duration. I looked behind me and saw that the door to the staircase was open.
entries.literal: "Once I thought that, I considered some implications of what had occurred. The past hour was extremely dense; Sai managed to appear and disappear, and Shiroya had investigated every floor. Assuming that Shiroya traveled with me, we had both remained unseen for that entire duration. I looked behind me and saw that the door to the staircase was open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Drawn to my noise, a figure appeared from the hallway. It was Shiroya, with a disoriented expression.
entries.literal: "Drawn to my noise, a figure appeared from the hallway. It was Shiroya, with a disoriented expression."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh...! You're here. Wh-What time is it...?
entries.literal: "Oh...! You're here. Wh-What time is it...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No idea. You just traveled from the cleaning room, right?
entries.literal: "No idea. You just traveled from the cleaning room, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes. You did too?
entries.literal: "Yes. You did too?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I did. I appeared here, so I don't know the time.
entries.literal: "I did. I appeared here, so I don't know the time."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see... I thought I saw something inside the cleaning cart. I reached out for it, and I suddenly felt pain and appeared in this hallway. I think there was {tip=grenades}something else{/tip} pretty small and dark next to the Sekimeiya, but I didn't get to see what it was.
entries.literal: "I see... I thought I saw something inside the cleaning cart. I reached out for it, and I suddenly felt pain and appeared in this hallway. I think there was {tip=grenades}something else{/tip} pretty small and dark next to the Sekimeiya, but I didn't get to see what it was."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So I did get caught in your travel.
entries.literal: "So I did get caught in your travel."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Regarding your question, I think I might know the time, approximately.
entries.literal: "...Regarding your question, I think I might know the time, approximately."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The staircase door is open, so this is past the time we unlocked the attic. There are a bunch of footprints next to the door, but I don't see ours. This must mean that you and I haven't gone down yet.
entries.literal: "The staircase door is open, so this is past the time we unlocked the attic. There are a bunch of footprints next to the door, but I don't see ours. This must mean that you and I haven't gone down yet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: These are probably the ones that we left after going back up, when we found Akaro in the bathroom. We're not before that point since there are too many.
entries.literal: "These are probably the ones that we left after going back up, when we found Akaro in the bathroom. We're not before that point since there are too many."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Then we're all in the bedroom right now?
entries.literal: "Then we're all in the bedroom right now?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Most likely... I think we should hurry.
entries.literal: "Most likely... I think we should hurry."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.literal: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started moving toward the hallway as I explained it.
entries.literal: "I started moving toward the hallway as I explained it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I whispered to her.
entries.literal: "I whispered to her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Earlier, you said that you followed the group up, and when you got to the attic, Katei and Sai were already in the bedroom telling us about Naomi's letter. This is happening now, so we're about to head downstairs, and your past self hiding inside the floor 6 offices is going to come up here.
entries.literal: "Earlier, you said that you followed the group up, and when you got to the attic, Katei and Sai were already in the bedroom telling us about Naomi's letter. This is happening now, so we're about to head downstairs, and your past self hiding inside the floor 6 offices is going to come up here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's... Right, yeah, and we weren't seen.
entries.literal: "That's... Right, yeah, and we weren't seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't left any footprints right in front of the door. The ones around the room would blend in with the others, making it unnoticeable that we'd appeared there. In a few minutes, Sai and I would also arrive, and that past me wouldn't pay any mind to those footprints.
entries.literal: "We hadn't left any footprints right in front of the door. The ones around the room would blend in with the others, making it unnoticeable that we'd appeared there. In a few minutes, Sai and I would also arrive, and that past me wouldn't pay any mind to those footprints."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Should we take the elevator?
entries.literal: "Should we take the elevator?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Its door was open. If Shiroya was on floor 6, she'd probably hear it, and she said that it hadn't been used once.
entries.literal: "Its door was open. If Shiroya was on floor 6, she'd probably hear it, and she said that it hadn't been used once."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to use it, but not only because of that. By going down, my past self who was looking around for Akaro on the crystal floor could see us. During the following minutes, Shiroya and I had inspected every floor and managed to miss each other.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to use it, but not only because of that. By going down, my past self who was looking around for Akaro on the crystal floor could see us. During the following minutes, Shiroya and I had inspected every floor and managed to miss each other."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure what we should do. Hiding from ourselves purely because we didn't see anyone in the past seems pointless and kind of crazy, but the only place we can actually stay hidden is this floor.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure what we should do. Hiding from ourselves purely because we didn't see anyone in the past seems pointless and kind of crazy, but the only place we can actually stay hidden is this floor."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah... We should probably stay here. Maybe we'll be able to understand what Sai did, too.
entries.literal: "Yeah... We should probably stay here. Maybe we'll be able to understand what Sai did, too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was right, and we had three places to choose from: the elevator, the storeroom, and the other bedroom. We knew every other place would be entered eventually, so of course, we chose the more spacious bedroom.
entries.literal: "She was right, and we had three places to choose from: the elevator, the storeroom, and the other bedroom. We knew every other place would be entered eventually, so of course, we chose the more spacious bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As we headed there, our bodies froze for a second.
entries.literal: "As we headed there, our bodies froze for a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Coming from the bedroom where our past selves surely were, we heard footsteps approaching us.
entries.literal: "Coming from the bedroom where our past selves surely were, we heard footsteps approaching us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We knew we had to speed up, so we opened the opposite door and closed it slowly to avoid making noise.
entries.literal: "We knew we had to speed up, so we opened the opposite door and closed it slowly to avoid making noise."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What do we do...?
entries.literal: "What do we do...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In a quiet voice, Shiroya asked the same question I had. It was my third trip through time, but that instance didn't seem like we'd get much out of it, given how Shiroya had already witnessed the attic the previous travel.
entries.literal: "In a quiet voice, Shiroya asked the same question I had. It was my third trip through time, but that instance didn't seem like we'd get much out of it, given how Shiroya had already witnessed the attic the previous travel."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Was this door closed while you watched from the hallway?
entries.literal: "Was this door closed while you watched from the hallway?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We should just stay here, then. It's hard to believe anything important will happen, but we didn't come back until fifty minutes after we left, so we might have to be here a while.
entries.literal: "We should just stay here, then. It's hard to believe anything important will happen, but we didn't come back until fifty minutes after we left, so we might have to be here a while."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see...
entries.literal: "I see..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a bit frustrating because the only reason we couldn't head down and suss out the situation was that we'd already done that; we couldn't easily exist on a lower floor. Traveling under those circumstances had turned out to be a literal waste of time, but something was piquing my curiosity.
entries.literal: "It was a bit frustrating because the only reason we couldn't head down and suss out the situation was that we'd already done that; we couldn't easily exist on a lower floor. Traveling under those circumstances had turned out to be a literal waste of time, but something was piquing my curiosity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though there shouldn't have been any danger, we didn't feel safe staying there because someone could discover us simply by opening the door. For that reason, we went up the ladder and sat on a bed above, where we could speak without being easily heard.
entries.literal: "Even though there shouldn't have been any danger, we didn't feel safe staying there because someone could discover us simply by opening the door. For that reason, we went up the ladder and sat on a bed above, where we could speak without being easily heard."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a pillow and shook it, removing a bit of dust from the cover. It wasn't hygienic in the slightest, but I rested my head on it since my body noticeably demanded it.
entries.literal: "I took a pillow and shook it, removing a bit of dust from the cover. It wasn't hygienic in the slightest, but I rested my head on it since my body noticeably demanded it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While Shiroya did the same, we were startled by a sound. As was becoming common, it was the sound of a door closing, and it came from the hallway.
entries.literal: "While Shiroya did the same, we were startled by a sound. As was becoming common, it was the sound of a door closing, and it came from the hallway."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It must be us...
entries.literal: "It must be us..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right. We'll be back in fifty minutes, then.
entries.literal: "Right. We'll be back in fifty minutes, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before that thought could become too overwhelming, I began speaking about a detail that I'd noticed.
entries.literal: "Before that thought could become too overwhelming, I began speaking about a detail that I'd noticed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, Sai most likely stored the Sekimeiya in the cleaning cart. He wanted to either activate it or move it. I'm not sure why, but he knew a search was coming.
entries.literal: "So, Sai most likely stored the Sekimeiya in the cleaning cart. He wanted to either activate it or move it. I'm not sure why, but he knew a search was coming."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: He might've hidden two of them, right? I never really got to see it, so it's possible there were two inside the cart. The plastic bag and the light being dim meant I couldn't exactly see inside it, and I only noticed something strange when I saw a glow coming from the inside.
entries.literal: "He might've hidden two of them, right? I never really got to see it, so it's possible there were two inside the cart. The plastic bag and the light being dim meant I couldn't exactly see inside it, and I only noticed something strange when I saw a glow coming from the inside."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. You did feel a burn, didn't you?
entries.literal: "I see. You did feel a burn, didn't you?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes, when I touched the Sekimeiya. It disappeared as soon as I changed places.
entries.literal: "Yes, when I touched the Sekimeiya. It disappeared as soon as I changed places."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Precisely. I think this means that our bodies now aren't the same ones we traveled with. If they were, the burn would still persist, and you'd still feel it.
entries.literal: "Precisely. I think this means that our bodies now aren't the same ones we traveled with. If they were, the burn would still persist, and you'd still feel it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I suppose so...
entries.literal: "I suppose so..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think we went about an hour to the past. I'm not sure if this is a coincidence, but that's twenty minutes more than my second travel. First, I went twenty minutes back. Then forty, now maybe an hour. Every subsequent travel has had an incremental increase of twenty minutes.
entries.literal: "I think we went about an hour to the past. I'm not sure if this is a coincidence, but that's twenty minutes more than my second travel. First, I went twenty minutes back. Then forty, now maybe an hour. Every subsequent travel has had an incremental increase of twenty minutes."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But I activated the Sekimeiya this time, and this is only my second time.
entries.literal: "But I activated the Sekimeiya this time, and this is only my second time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know, which is why I still think it could be a coincidence.
entries.literal: "I know, which is why I still think it could be a coincidence."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Remember what we thought earlier? That the time traveled is dependent on the amount of time the Sekimeiya's not in the cold? That might remain consistent.{w} I'd say we traveled at approximately {time=12:40.} The one before this was at {time=11:50}, and after that, you saw the Sekimeiya had powered off. That Sekimeiya shouldn't have been put in the cabinet again, so if it's the one you activated, it was out of the cabinet for a long time.
entries.literal: "Remember what we thought earlier? That the time traveled is dependent on the amount of time the Sekimeiya's not in the cold? That might remain consistent.{w} I'd say we traveled at approximately {time=12:40.} The one before this was at {time=11:50}, and after that, you saw the Sekimeiya had powered off. That Sekimeiya shouldn't have been put in the cabinet again, so if it's the one you activated, it was out of the cabinet for a long time."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Right, so we would've gone this far back.
entries.literal: "Right, so we would've gone this far back."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But the origin of the Sai I saw downstairs still doesn't make sense. He traveled to the past at some point to appear there, but if he did it between this time span, he would have reset the Sekimeiya. You didn't see him going down from the attic, and neither did the others... I can't figure out what happened with him.
entries.literal: "But the origin of the Sai I saw downstairs still doesn't make sense. He traveled to the past at some point to appear there, but if he did it between this time span, he would have reset the Sekimeiya. You didn't see him going down from the attic, and neither did the others... I can't figure out what happened with him."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Can't he just go back to the past after {time=12:40}?
entries.literal: "Can't he just go back to the past after {time=12:40}?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, but if that's what happened, it means that his surprise at seeing me was fake. It means he knew everything that would occur. I really don't think that's what happened.
entries.literal: "Yes, but if that's what happened, it means that his surprise at seeing me was fake. It means he knew everything that would occur. I really don't think that's what happened."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm...{w} Well, there's still the Sekimeiya he had in his hip pack, right? Maybe he traveled using that one.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} Well, there's still the Sekimeiya he had in his hip pack, right? Maybe he traveled using that one."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can't say since the origin of that Sekimeiya is a mystery in itself. If he did use that one, it was somewhere else when we traveled from the cleaning room. It could be that Sai ignored us to go use that one instead...
entries.literal: "I can't say since the origin of that Sekimeiya is a mystery in itself. If he did use that one, it was somewhere else when we traveled from the cleaning room. It could be that Sai ignored us to go use that one instead..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Both of us sighed. The possibility of spending a very long time there had forced its way in front of us, and if we knew what was going on, the thought might've been a bit more bearable. On the other hand, it was also useful to have information that could protect us.
entries.literal: "Both of us sighed. The possibility of spending a very long time there had forced its way in front of us, and if we knew what was going on, the thought might've been a bit more bearable. On the other hand, it was also useful to have information that could protect us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya had apparently recovered somewhat from her grief at Naomi's death, but I was sure it was due to absurdity. Someone dying twice made the whole thing surreal and removed from reality.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had apparently recovered somewhat from her grief at Naomi's death, but I was sure it was due to absurdity. Someone dying twice made the whole thing surreal and removed from reality."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spoke again after a few seconds, as I hadn't yet explained what had piqued my curiosity about our travel.
entries.literal: "I spoke again after a few seconds, as I hadn't yet explained what had piqued my curiosity about our travel."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The place we teleport to has seemed random every travel. But if we believe the amount of time traveled isn't at all random, it's hard to believe the place would be.
entries.literal: "The place we teleport to has seemed random every travel. But if we believe the amount of time traveled isn't at all random, it's hard to believe the place would be."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You thought of something?
entries.literal: "You thought of something?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Not exactly, but I appeared in the living room while you appeared in the hallway. There was a time when those were our locations, right?
entries.literal: "Not exactly, but I appeared in the living room while you appeared in the hallway. There was a time when those were our locations, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh? Definitely not an hour before we traveled, right? At that point, we were all in the other bedroom.{w} Oh, you mean later?
entries.literal: "Huh? Definitely not an hour before we traveled, right? At that point, we were all in the other bedroom.{w} Oh, you mean later?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes... When I explained to the others what Sai and I did downstairs, I mentioned that we briefly came up to the attic. I didn't elaborate on that, but we went to grab a battery. At that point, you were in the hallway, listening to the conversation going on. That coincides with the locations we appeared at, right?
entries.literal: "Yes... When I explained to the others what Sai and I did downstairs, I mentioned that we briefly came up to the attic. I didn't elaborate on that, but we went to grab a battery. At that point, you were in the hallway, listening to the conversation going on. That coincides with the locations we appeared at, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I... think so. I didn't notice you two back then since I was paying close attention to the bedroom.
entries.literal: "I... think so. I didn't notice you two back then since I was paying close attention to the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That had to indicate something. On the surface, the location you appeared could seem like something trivial, but with how many things didn't make sense, understanding smaller mysteries could work well to decipher others.
entries.literal: "That had to indicate something. On the surface, the location you appeared could seem like something trivial, but with how many things didn't make sense, understanding smaller mysteries could work well to decipher others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For example, if we figured out what determined our arriving location, we could predict where we'd appear if we were to touch the Sekimeiya. That could help us decide if traveling purposely would be a good idea.
entries.literal: "For example, if we figured out what determined our arriving location, we could predict where we'd appear if we were to touch the Sekimeiya. That could help us decide if traveling purposely would be a good idea."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh... So where we appeared might be related. We went an hour to the past, and at around {time=12:10} both of us were in the attic, right?
entries.literal: "Oh... So where we appeared might be related. We went an hour to the past, and at around {time=12:10} both of us were in the attic, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That would hold up, I think. That's around when Sai and I went to the living room.
entries.literal: "That would hold up, I think. That's around when Sai and I went to the living room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well, you said we traveled at around {time=12:40}, so to {time=11:40.} That means {time=12:10} was the middle point.
entries.literal: "Well, you said we traveled at around {time=12:40}, so to {time=11:40.} That means {time=12:10} was the middle point."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, hm... You're right.
entries.literal: "Oh, hm... You're right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about it and quickly found direct contradictions.
entries.literal: "I thought about it and quickly found direct contradictions."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's not consistent, though.
entries.literal: "It's not consistent, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: "The location we appear at is determined by the midpoint of the distance traveled". It sounds promising, but it only happened during this travel.
entries.literal: "\"The location we appear at is determined by the midpoint of the distance traveled\". It sounds promising, but it only happened during this travel."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The first time, I appeared in hallway A. I went twenty minutes to the past, so at the midpoint before traveling, ten minutes later, I would've been next to the stairs. That was when I was being told that the Sekimeiya disappeared from the cabinet for the first time.
entries.literal: "The first time, I appeared in hallway A. I went twenty minutes to the past, so at the midpoint before traveling, ten minutes later, I would've been next to the stairs. That was when I was being told that the Sekimeiya disappeared from the cabinet for the first time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: However, now that I think about it, around five minutes later, at fifteen out of those twenty, I was in the hallway, keeping watch from the lobby while the others looked through every room. That's pretty much where I appeared, so it could actually have been that same position.
entries.literal: "However, now that I think about it, around five minutes later, at fifteen out of those twenty, I was in the hallway, keeping watch from the lobby while the others looked through every room. That's pretty much where I appeared, so it could actually have been that same position."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-I see. So you appeared where you were at three-fourths of the distance traveled...?
entries.literal: "I-I see. So you appeared where you were at three-fourths of the distance traveled...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I have no idea. I said I was there fifteen minutes after the point I appeared, but I can't be sure about the exact number of minutes.
entries.literal: "I have no idea. I said I was there fifteen minutes after the point I appeared, but I can't be sure about the exact number of minutes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This falls apart in the second travel, though. We went forty minutes to the past, and I appeared in the security room while you appeared in the floor 2 offices. Not only that, but I was sitting down in midair.
entries.literal: "This falls apart in the second travel, though. We went forty minutes to the past, and I appeared in the security room while you appeared in the floor 2 offices. Not only that, but I was sitting down in midair."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We traveled from {time=11:50} to {time=11:10}, and during those forty minutes, I was never in the security room. We just found the second Naomi and moved back and forth between the attic and the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "We traveled from {time=11:50} to {time=11:10}, and during those forty minutes, I was never in the security room. We just found the second Naomi and moved back and forth between the attic and the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah... During that time, I never entered the second floor's offices either. Well, before we found Akaro in the bathroom, we came down from the attic and searched every floor, but I didn't step very far into the partitions since everyone else was looking too. I appeared deep into the second one, so it can't be from that time.
entries.literal: "Yeah... During that time, I never entered the second floor's offices either. Well, before we found Akaro in the bathroom, we came down from the attic and searched every floor, but I didn't step very far into the partitions since everyone else was looking too. I appeared deep into the second one, so it can't be from that time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So we can't get anywhere with this. Appearing where both of us were at {time=12:10} could be a coincidence, but if it isn't, I have no idea what determined it.
entries.literal: "So we can't get anywhere with this. Appearing where both of us were at {time=12:10} could be a coincidence, but if it isn't, I have no idea what determined it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I said that, I thought of another valuable thing we could get out of figuring out what determined the appearing location.
entries.literal: "As I said that, I thought of another valuable thing we could get out of figuring out what determined the appearing location."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were dealing with Sai and a culprit who had traveled with the Sekimeiya. If the place you appeared somehow depended on a previous location, we could know exactly where someone had been in the past if we knew the location they'd appeared in, effectively drawing information out of them.{w} I couldn't apply it to Sai, since I hadn't seen him appearing anywhere, but it was something to keep in mind in the future.
entries.literal: "We were dealing with Sai and a culprit who had traveled with the Sekimeiya. If the place you appeared somehow depended on a previous location, we could know exactly where someone had been in the past if we knew the location they'd appeared in, effectively drawing information out of them.{w} I couldn't apply it to Sai, since I hadn't seen him appearing anywhere, but it was something to keep in mind in the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...After that, the silence persisted. Both of us lay down completely and gave our bodies their needed rest. We had fifty blank minutes in which our existences were isolated from the rest of the world, so we weren't in any type of hurry.
entries.literal: "...After that, the silence persisted. Both of us lay down completely and gave our bodies their needed rest. We had fifty blank minutes in which our existences were isolated from the rest of the world, so we weren't in any type of hurry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My eyes closed, and I realized that I was a lot more tired than I'd thought. I'd been awake for over twenty hours.
entries.literal: "My eyes closed, and I realized that I was a lot more tired than I'd thought. I'd been awake for over twenty hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I thought that, it all came back to me. How we'd spent our past week and everything about Miiya.
entries.literal: "As soon as I thought that, it all came back to me. How we'd spent our past week and everything about Miiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see Shiroya's face, but her immobile body gave away that she was exhausted too. Our deep breathing became background noise as I subconsciously reminisced about how our life had been until recently.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see Shiroya's face, but her immobile body gave away that she was exhausted too. Our deep breathing became background noise as I subconsciously reminisced about how our life had been until recently."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew none of that would go back to the way it was, but even though I had already accepted it, I still felt the same sharp pain every time I acknowledged the truth.
entries.literal: "I knew none of that would go back to the way it was, but even though I had already accepted it, I still felt the same sharp pain every time I acknowledged the truth."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And instead of moving through things normally, the Sekimeiya had appeared before us. It was still unbelievable, but I'd traveled back through time more than once. It was real, and highly ironic.
entries.literal: "And instead of moving through things normally, the Sekimeiya had appeared before us. It was still unbelievable, but I'd traveled back through time more than once. It was real, and highly ironic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: During the past two weeks, I'd pointlessly thought about it a number of times. "If only I could go back in time."
entries.literal: "During the past two weeks, I'd pointlessly thought about it a number of times. \"If only I could go back in time.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every time something negative of significance occurred in my life, I'd resorted to those useless thoughts. They were necessary, though, as immersing myself in a better world often seemed to temporarily alleviate the pain.
entries.literal: "Every time something negative of significance occurred in my life, I'd resorted to those useless thoughts. They were necessary, though, as immersing myself in a better world often seemed to temporarily alleviate the pain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I thought of a world in which Miiya hadn't met such an abrupt end, I could successfully depart from the real one briefly. The only way to truly achieve that, I'd thought, was by traveling through time and avoiding the path that led to her death.
entries.literal: "While I thought of a world in which Miiya hadn't met such an abrupt end, I could successfully depart from the real one briefly. The only way to truly achieve that, I'd thought, was by traveling through time and avoiding the path that led to her death."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And then, as if the universe was laughing in our faces, time travel had become possible right in front of us. However, instead of reopening the door to the normal world, it created a tangled mess, threatening to trap us in the tower for weeks.
entries.literal: "And then, as if the universe was laughing in our faces, time travel had become possible right in front of us. However, instead of reopening the door to the normal world, it created a tangled mess, threatening to trap us in the tower for weeks."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Not only that, but it seemed that even if we managed to solve every riddle surrounding the Sekimeiya, it would be useless for us. Changing the past was not possible—traveling back would just form a loop.
entries.literal: "Not only that, but it seemed that even if we managed to solve every riddle surrounding the Sekimeiya, it would be useless for us. Changing the past was not possible—traveling back would just form a loop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If we were right about the power storage, left the Sekimeiya out of the cold for a very long time, and traveled more than two weeks to the past, we wouldn't be able to change anything. Perhaps that wasn't the real way to put it: something would prevent us from traveling like that in the first place, as it was an impossibility. ...Or maybe we'd travel and suffer an accident before we could try to defy reality.
entries.literal: "If we were right about the power storage, left the Sekimeiya out of the cold for a very long time, and traveled more than two weeks to the past, we wouldn't be able to change anything. Perhaps that wasn't the real way to put it: something would prevent us from traveling like that in the first place, as it was an impossibility. ...Or maybe we'd travel and suffer an accident before we could try to defy reality."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way Shiroya hadn't thought of it already. If we went back prior to Miiya's death, we'd just have to suffer it again from another angle.
entries.literal: "There was no way Shiroya hadn't thought of it already. If we went back prior to Miiya's death, we'd just have to suffer it again from another angle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In my head, as my consciousness slowly dissipated more and more, it all sounded like an outlandish story I was making up. Although, in reality, plenty of time travel stories revolved around going back to the past to prevent an incident from taking place.
entries.literal: "In my head, as my consciousness slowly dissipated more and more, it all sounded like an outlandish story I was making up. Although, in reality, plenty of time travel stories revolved around going back to the past to prevent an incident from taking place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Be it to save a person or save humanity—I wasn't the originator of that idea. It might have been present within every person; haphazardly thinking of going back in time after a bad experience was fairly common.
entries.literal: "Be it to save a person or save humanity—I wasn't the originator of that idea. It might have been present within every person; haphazardly thinking of going back in time after a bad experience was fairly common."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I laughed inwardly because something else usually present in those stories had occurred in the incident two weeks ago... Miiya's body hadn't been found.
entries.literal: "I laughed inwardly because something else usually present in those stories had occurred in the incident two weeks ago... Miiya's body hadn't been found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I would've already jumped into all sorts of possibilities if it had only been that. In fact, Miiya's body couldn't have been found. It disappeared in the blink of an eye due to the explosion that took her life.
entries.literal: "But I would've already jumped into all sorts of possibilities if it had only been that. In fact, Miiya's body couldn't have been found. It disappeared in the blink of an eye due to the explosion that took her life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite that, parts of her had been quickly found. Her jaw confirmed her identity with zero chance of doubt. Her clothes were identified all over the place as well, and it hadn't been anything short of a miracle that Shiroya and I made it out safely without critical injuries.
entries.literal: "Despite that, parts of her had been quickly found. Her jaw confirmed her identity with zero chance of doubt. Her clothes were identified all over the place as well, and it hadn't been anything short of a miracle that Shiroya and I made it out safely without critical injuries."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was why thinking about giving another meaning to the past was also futile. It was the only way to get around causal loops: going back to the past to explain what had happened in a different way. Lamentably, her jaw had been found, preventing that completely.
entries.literal: "That was why thinking about giving another meaning to the past was also futile. It was the only way to get around causal loops: going back to the past to explain what had happened in a different way. Lamentably, her jaw had been found, preventing that completely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was aware that I was about to fall asleep. I didn't want to, but I also couldn't resist it. I didn't know if Shiroya had already given up, but she hadn't moved in a while.
entries.literal: "I was aware that I was about to fall asleep. I didn't want to, but I also couldn't resist it. I didn't know if Shiroya had already given up, but she hadn't moved in a while."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Can I not go back to the past, save Miiya, and threaten the forensic technicians to say that they've found her jaw?"{w} Something like that was a complete delusion. Had I already saved Miiya? Of course not. I often used to be optimistic as I fell asleep, and I'd realize how foolish I'd been immediately after waking up.
entries.literal: "\"Can I not go back to the past, save Miiya, and threaten the forensic technicians to say that they've found her jaw?\"{w} Something like that was a complete delusion. Had I already saved Miiya? Of course not. I often used to be optimistic as I fell asleep, and I'd realize how foolish I'd been immediately after waking up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In reality, I'd personally seen pieces of her clothes with burnt skin stuck on them. I could have very slightly embellished it by thinking that they could've belonged to someone else and that Miiya had already been saved by one of my future travels, but I knew that the flesh I'd seen really belonged to her no matter how many imaginary scenarios I intended to make up.
entries.literal: "In reality, I'd personally seen pieces of her clothes with burnt skin stuck on them. I could have very slightly embellished it by thinking that they could've belonged to someone else and that Miiya had already been saved by one of my future travels, but I knew that the flesh I'd seen really belonged to her no matter how many imaginary scenarios I intended to make up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next thought I had was very different.
entries.literal: "The next thought I had was very different."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: {w=0.5}...I fell asleep.
entries.literal: "{w=0.5}...I fell asleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: During all my fantastic thoughts, my consciousness had receded. It felt like no time had passed, but I knew better, as sometimes that meant I'd been asleep for a full day.
entries.literal: "During all my fantastic thoughts, my consciousness had receded. It felt like no time had passed, but I knew better, as sometimes that meant I'd been asleep for a full day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't easy to move. When I tried to stand up, I saw that Shiroya had fallen asleep on the other bed. I sat up, aware that since nobody had come for us, not much time could've passed.
entries.literal: "It wasn't easy to move. When I tried to stand up, I saw that Shiroya had fallen asleep on the other bed. I sat up, aware that since nobody had come for us, not much time could've passed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to wake her, but I also wouldn't leave her behind to go explore. So I simply waited, as that brought no downsides.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to wake her, but I also wouldn't leave her behind to go explore. So I simply waited, as that brought no downsides."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My head was cloudy, and my muscles informed me that I hadn't chosen a good position to sleep in. With how tired I was, though, I barely cared about that.
entries.literal: "My head was cloudy, and my muscles informed me that I hadn't chosen a good position to sleep in. With how tired I was, though, I barely cared about that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My movements had a delayed effect on Shiroya, so I didn't have to wait very long. She woke up seconds after I'd started to lie against the wall.
entries.literal: "My movements had a delayed effect on Shiroya, so I didn't have to wait very long. She woke up seconds after I'd started to lie against the wall."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Mmm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With her eyes almost closed, she turned to face me. It wasn't a new sight, as I'd seen her woozy morning face a few times in the previous days.
entries.literal: "With her eyes almost closed, she turned to face me. It wasn't a new sight, as I'd seen her woozy morning face a few times in the previous days."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Sorry, I fell asleep... How long has it been?
entries.literal: "Sorry, I fell asleep... How long has it been?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know, I slept too. Since nobody has come for us yet, probably not that long.
entries.literal: "I don't know, I slept too. Since nobody has come for us yet, probably not that long."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see...
entries.literal: "I see..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of sitting up, she went straight back to how she was. Sleeping for such a short time used to make me feel even more tired, but since there was no guarantee I could continue, I forced myself to resist.
entries.literal: "Instead of sitting up, she went straight back to how she was. Sleeping for such a short time used to make me feel even more tired, but since there was no guarantee I could continue, I forced myself to resist."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was clear that we needed to sleep for much longer, but we were still in an uncertain situation around someone who'd murdered the same person twice. Seeing it that way, it was mortifying to think we'd fallen asleep, because once our fifty minutes ran out, we'd be completely defenseless. ...Technically, nothing prevented anyone in the other bedroom from entering ours as soon as Shiroya left the hallway.
entries.literal: "It was clear that we needed to sleep for much longer, but we were still in an uncertain situation around someone who'd murdered the same person twice. Seeing it that way, it was mortifying to think we'd fallen asleep, because once our fifty minutes ran out, we'd be completely defenseless. ...Technically, nothing prevented anyone in the other bedroom from entering ours as soon as Shiroya left the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was sure that Shiroya felt it too, probably more strongly than I did. A creeping fear that we could be killed at any moment, forced deep down inside of us by the rapid pace of developments inside the tower. It was a testament to her resilience that she hadn't outwardly broken down, and I didn't know how I was managing it.
entries.literal: "I was sure that Shiroya felt it too, probably more strongly than I did. A creeping fear that we could be killed at any moment, forced deep down inside of us by the rapid pace of developments inside the tower. It was a testament to her resilience that she hadn't outwardly broken down, and I didn't know how I was managing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A couple of minutes later, Shiroya had rolled in bed a few times until coming to the realization that she wasn't going to easily fall asleep again.
entries.literal: "A couple of minutes later, Shiroya had rolled in bed a few times until coming to the realization that she wasn't going to easily fall asleep again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Being more aware of the risks might have prevented her from doing so that time. After a moment, she perked up and slowly exhaled while rubbing her eyes. With a final yawn, she decided to speak.
entries.literal: "Being more aware of the risks might have prevented her from doing so that time. After a moment, she perked up and slowly exhaled while rubbing her eyes. With a final yawn, she decided to speak."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Well, what do we do?
entries.literal: "...Well, what do we do?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If we look through the door, we should be able to know if we used up all our time or not.
entries.literal: "If we look through the door, we should be able to know if we used up all our time or not."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: All right... Let's see if anyone is still there.
entries.literal: "All right... Let's see if anyone is still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to balance myself after standing up—my body didn't react well to the abrupt change. After I was steady, Shiroya grabbed her purse, and we went down the ladder.
entries.literal: "I had to balance myself after standing up—my body didn't react well to the abrupt change. After I was steady, Shiroya grabbed her purse, and we went down the ladder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gripped the handle and peeked through the small gap that let me see the hallway.
entries.literal: "I gripped the handle and peeked through the small gap that let me see the hallway."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Is the other bedroom still closed?
entries.literal: "Is the other bedroom still closed?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, but we also closed it when all of us went to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Yes, but we also closed it when all of us went to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, so how do we figure out if anyone's inside?
entries.literal: "Oh, so how do we figure out if anyone's inside?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm... Maybe the footprints could tell us.
entries.literal: "Hm... Maybe the footprints could tell us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked carefully through the hallway. Having no sense of time was a peculiar feeling, but our surroundings were fully silent. If people were still in the other bedroom, the door was perfectly hiding their presence.{w} Once we got to the living room, we identified a slight change.
entries.literal: "We walked carefully through the hallway. Having no sense of time was a peculiar feeling, but our surroundings were fully silent. If people were still in the other bedroom, the door was perfectly hiding their presence.{w} Once we got to the living room, we identified a slight change."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did we leave it like this?
entries.literal: "Did we leave it like this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were used to looking at the footprints in front of the door, but that was no longer possible. The door was closed, and the movement of it had erased every single footprint nearby, creating an empty arc.
entries.literal: "We were used to looking at the footprints in front of the door, but that was no longer possible. The door was closed, and the movement of it had erased every single footprint nearby, creating an empty arc."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We must have. This means that the group already left, though.
entries.literal: "We must have. This means that the group already left, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though the motion of the door wiped out the nearby marks, there were many around the entire room. They were much fainter than the last time I'd seen them, but I was still able to recognize that new ones existed.
entries.literal: "Even though the motion of the door wiped out the nearby marks, there were many around the entire room. They were much fainter than the last time I'd seen them, but I was still able to recognize that new ones existed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at the elevator. Its door had not yet been closed.
entries.literal: "I glanced at the elevator. Its door had not yet been closed."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We'll need to go down, then. We traveled from the cleaning room right after we got to the crystal floor, so it'll be fine.
entries.literal: "We'll need to go down, then. We traveled from the cleaning room right after we got to the crystal floor, so it'll be fine."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. Let's see if something happened. I figure the others must be searching for us.
entries.literal: "Yeah. Let's see if something happened. I figure the others must be searching for us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door, retracing its arc, and we began going down the stairs after I left it open. The next door was closed too, but it was unlocked.
entries.literal: "I opened the door, retracing its arc, and we began going down the stairs after I left it open. The next door was closed too, but it was unlocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stepped onto the sixth floor and were met by less comforting scenery. It was a strong reminder of our situation. We didn't have the will to check every office, so we walked around the floor at a slower speed than normal, gradually regaining our rhythm.
entries.literal: "We stepped onto the sixth floor and were met by less comforting scenery. It was a strong reminder of our situation. We didn't have the will to check every office, so we walked around the floor at a slower speed than normal, gradually regaining our rhythm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't used the elevator, but there was no real point to that. As we headed down, our echoing footsteps were all that we could hear.
entries.literal: "We hadn't used the elevator, but there was no real point to that. As we headed down, our echoing footsteps were all that we could hear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The silent path ended at the final staircase. Even though we logically should have heard people, we only encountered more silence.
entries.literal: "The silent path ended at the final staircase. Even though we logically should have heard people, we only encountered more silence."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There should be people here...
entries.literal: "There should be people here..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's go to the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "Let's go to the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Right, maybe the Sekimeiya's still there. I also want to know what else was in that cart.
entries.literal: "Right, maybe the Sekimeiya's still there. I also want to know what else was in that cart."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked up to the door, which hadn't been fully closed. As soon as we opened it, we instantly noticed the drastic change the room had undergone.
entries.literal: "We walked up to the door, which hadn't been fully closed. As soon as we opened it, we instantly noticed the drastic change the room had undergone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cleaning cart that had previously been there was nowhere to be seen.
entries.literal: "The cleaning cart that had previously been there was nowhere to be seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled that it was in the corner of the small room. Aside from its disappearance, I didn't think anything else had changed.
entries.literal: "I recalled that it was in the corner of the small room. Aside from its disappearance, I didn't think anything else had changed."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did someone take it with the Sekimeiya inside?
entries.literal: "Did someone take it with the Sekimeiya inside?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: N-No, I don't think so.
entries.literal: "N-No, I don't think so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, that should've been my first thought, but there was an inconsistency.
entries.literal: "Of course, that should've been my first thought, but there was an inconsistency."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd looked at the cleaning cart a few times before. Underneath and around it, there were three buckets storing scourers and chemicals like bleach.{w} ...Those hadn't moved.
entries.literal: "I'd looked at the cleaning cart a few times before. Underneath and around it, there were three buckets storing scourers and chemicals like bleach.{w} ...Those hadn't moved."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: These three buckets... One was under the cart, right?
entries.literal: "These three buckets... One was under the cart, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think so.
entries.literal: "I think so."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: They must have put it under it because there's not a lot more space here, but if you tried to move the cart, you'd hit it and the other two. You'd need to take them out first, and then you could move the cart.
entries.literal: "They must have put it under it because there's not a lot more space here, but if you tried to move the cart, you'd hit it and the other two. You'd need to take them out first, and then you could move the cart."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: O-Oh, yeah, I guess so.
entries.literal: "O-Oh, yeah, I guess so."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can't say for sure that nobody moved them, but if they had, it would be really odd for them to put them back in the exact same spots...
entries.literal: "I can't say for sure that nobody moved them, but if they had, it would be really odd for them to put them back in the exact same spots..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I suppose. Nobody would get the cart out, anyway...
entries.literal: "I suppose. Nobody would get the cart out, anyway..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This means that the cart disappeared too, right? And only the cart—not the buckets under it. In other words, what you were touching. This also means that we're past the time we traveled from.
entries.literal: "This means that the cart disappeared too, right? And only the cart—not the buckets under it. In other words, what you were touching. This also means that we're past the time we traveled from."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Are you serious?{w} That can't be it, you were touching the cabinet when you traveled for the first time. How come it didn't disappear?
entries.literal: "...Are you serious?{w} That can't be it, you were touching the cabinet when you traveled for the first time. How come it didn't disappear?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Th-That's true. I supported my body on it with my left hand, so I was touching the cabinet.{w} That's strange. If this cart disappeared when we traveled, did it appear somewhere else...?
entries.literal: "...Th-That's true. I supported my body on it with my left hand, so I was touching the cabinet.{w} That's strange. If this cart disappeared when we traveled, did it appear somewhere else...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya leaned forward with a frown. She was looking inside the buckets.
entries.literal: "Shiroya leaned forward with a frown. She was looking inside the buckets."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait... It's here! Look, inside this one.
entries.literal: "Wait... It's here! Look, inside this one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Adopting a similar frown, I walked ahead to see what was inside. I saw it immediately: the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Adopting a similar frown, I walked ahead to see what was inside. I saw it immediately: the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was inside the bucket that had been under the cart, on top of a pack of sponges. It was white, indicating that it was already powered on.
entries.literal: "It was inside the bucket that had been under the cart, on top of a pack of sponges. It was white, indicating that it was already powered on."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why is it here now...?
entries.literal: "Why is it here now...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think this actually makes sense.
entries.literal: "I think this actually makes sense."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}M-Maybe you're right.
entries.literal: "...{w}M-Maybe you're right."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If our travel made the cleaning cart disappear, the Sekimeiya, which was inside it, would've fallen in here.
entries.literal: "If our travel made the cleaning cart disappear, the Sekimeiya, which was inside it, would've fallen in here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But why is it still here? Did nobody enter this room?
entries.literal: "But why is it still here? Did nobody enter this room?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: They must not have...
entries.literal: "They must not have..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well, what do we do with it?
entries.literal: "Well, what do we do with it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought for a few seconds. We'd lived out a portion of our recent past from up to three different perspectives. There was no need to immediately touch it again unless we needed to figure out what had happened after we'd traveled.
entries.literal: "I thought for a few seconds. We'd lived out a portion of our recent past from up to three different perspectives. There was no need to immediately touch it again unless we needed to figure out what had happened after we'd traveled."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let me do what Sai did earlier to avoid traveling. We should investigate before we think about activating it.
entries.literal: "Let me do what Sai did earlier to avoid traveling. We should investigate before we think about activating it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hid my hand under my sleeve and kneeled to grab the Sekimeiya. I touched it with my shirt, and nothing around me changed. As I stood back up while holding it, I noticed something was wrong.
entries.literal: "I hid my hand under my sleeve and kneeled to grab the Sekimeiya. I touched it with my shirt, and nothing around me changed. As I stood back up while holding it, I noticed something was wrong."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait... It's not hot at all.
entries.literal: "Wait... It's not hot at all."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Earlier, when Sai did this, the Sekimeiya felt really hot for him. He even touched me with his sleeve. Now, though, it's actually cold.
entries.literal: "Earlier, when Sai did this, the Sekimeiya felt really hot for him. He even touched me with his sleeve. Now, though, it's actually cold."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So it won't do anything right now?
entries.literal: "So it won't do anything right now?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to test it, and I got close to Shiroya so that if it worked, the range would encompass her too. Perhaps it was a bad idea since nothing assured us we'd appear together, but it was better to try it like that.{w} Without overthinking it, I placed my entire left hand on top of the Sekimeiya.{w} After a full second, nothing had happened.
entries.literal: "I wanted to test it, and I got close to Shiroya so that if it worked, the range would encompass her too. Perhaps it was a bad idea since nothing assured us we'd appear together, but it was better to try it like that.{w} Without overthinking it, I placed my entire left hand on top of the Sekimeiya.{w} After a full second, nothing had happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, it doesn't work.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it doesn't work."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's strange...{w} Can you think of why?
entries.literal: "That's strange...{w} Can you think of why?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Not at all. At least not if it stays consistent with the previous events. If the mechanics are completely random, it can just be that it takes a random amount of time until it starts to get hot.{w} However, minutes after the Sekimeiya that Sai had in his pack turned white, it was already really hot.
entries.literal: "Not at all. At least not if it stays consistent with the previous events. If the mechanics are completely random, it can just be that it takes a random amount of time until it starts to get hot.{w} However, minutes after the Sekimeiya that Sai had in his pack turned white, it was already really hot."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't get it, then.
entries.literal: "I don't get it, then."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's... pretty confusing, yeah.
entries.literal: "It's... pretty confusing, yeah."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You know, aside from the obvious time travel, a lot of bizarre things keep happening around this, and someone with us is behind this whole thing.
entries.literal: "You know, aside from the obvious time travel, a lot of bizarre things keep happening around this, and someone with us is behind this whole thing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We've put it in its main cabinet a few times, but they keep getting it out. The last time we saw the cabinet key was in the attic, but we shouldn't go back up just to see if it's still there.
entries.literal: "We've put it in its main cabinet a few times, but they keep getting it out. The last time we saw the cabinet key was in the attic, but we shouldn't go back up just to see if it's still there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We should try to understand how it works. I think working on that is better than just putting it back where it came from.
