entries.literal: "We should try to understand how it works. I think working on that is better than just putting it back where it came from."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So what do you wanna do?
entries.literal: "So what do you wanna do?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This time, let's be the ones to hide it.{w} Later, we'll be able to see if anything has changed and hopefully understand how it functions a bit better. We have a chance since, for some reason, nobody appears to be here...
entries.literal: "This time, let's be the ones to hide it.{w} Later, we'll be able to see if anything has changed and hopefully understand how it functions a bit better. We have a chance since, for some reason, nobody appears to be here..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you sure? The cameras are still recording, and we know that every place where we can hide it is somewhere someone will eventually look at.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? The cameras are still recording, and we know that every place where we can hide it is somewhere someone will eventually look at."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Regarding the cameras, I'm not sure we should worry. The culprit has been recorded plenty of times, and we'll be able to justify our actions if that ever becomes necessary.
entries.literal: "Regarding the cameras, I'm not sure we should worry. The culprit has been recorded plenty of times, and we'll be able to justify our actions if that ever becomes necessary."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: When it comes to hiding spots, I can think of a couple.
entries.literal: "When it comes to hiding spots, I can think of a couple."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The times we were trying to find the Sekimeiya, we only really looked through this floor, and I believe every spot in the attic would also be easy to find.
entries.literal: "The times we were trying to find the Sekimeiya, we only really looked through this floor, and I believe every spot in the attic would also be easy to find."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, I have two suggestions. One is inside a computer tower.{w} I saw screwdrivers in the attic. If we open up a computer tower and hide the Sekimeiya inside it, it's hard to think anyone will easily find it. It requires thinking about it and unscrewing every other tower until you find it.
entries.literal: "So, I have two suggestions. One is inside a computer tower.{w} I saw screwdrivers in the attic. If we open up a computer tower and hide the Sekimeiya inside it, it's hard to think anyone will easily find it. It requires thinking about it and unscrewing every other tower until you find it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That'd be a bit of a hassle for us, though, so here's my better option: a locker.
entries.literal: "That'd be a bit of a hassle for us, though, so here's my better option: a locker."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I thought of it earlier... the last key in Naomi's keyring.{w} It's likely it belonged to her locker, given that every staff member has one, and the size of the key seemed appropriate for it.
entries.literal: "I thought of it earlier... the last key in Naomi's keyring.{w} It's likely it belonged to her locker, given that every staff member has one, and the size of the key seemed appropriate for it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wouldn't Katei have recognized it?
entries.literal: "Wouldn't Katei have recognized it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, just like how he should've recognized the attic's. We can try it.
entries.literal: "Yes, just like how he should've recognized the attic's. We can try it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd thought that maybe Shiroya would be more hesitant, and I'd been ready to abandon the idea, but she didn't oppose it. Given the purpose was to further understand the Sekimeiya, it was likely she was also hopelessly thinking about using it to rewrite our recent past.
entries.literal: "I'd thought that maybe Shiroya would be more hesitant, and I'd been ready to abandon the idea, but she didn't oppose it. Given the purpose was to further understand the Sekimeiya, it was likely she was also hopelessly thinking about using it to rewrite our recent past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With that thought in mind, it was the first time we felt the countdown ticking along. The exit was presumably going to be unlocked in fewer than eight hours, and we still had to confirm what time it was. We only had those hours to understand what the rules were and if the Sekimeiya would ever be useful to us.
entries.literal: "With that thought in mind, it was the first time we felt the countdown ticking along. The exit was presumably going to be unlocked in fewer than eight hours, and we still had to confirm what time it was. We only had those hours to understand what the rules were and if the Sekimeiya would ever be useful to us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But the specter of the voice recorder haunted us; we'd found something that implied we'd be there for a whole month.{w} For the first time, that sounded just a bit desirable, as it would've given us more time to comprehend what was going on and how to use the Sekimeiya. It was possible someone was angling to trap us for a month just to accomplish that, but I couldn't begin to imagine how the rest of the plan would unfold in that case.
entries.literal: "But the specter of the voice recorder haunted us; we'd found something that implied we'd be there for a whole month.{w} For the first time, that sounded just a bit desirable, as it would've given us more time to comprehend what was going on and how to use the Sekimeiya. It was possible someone was angling to trap us for a month just to accomplish that, but I couldn't begin to imagine how the rest of the plan would unfold in that case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the same time, the exit was going to open at some point, and the Sekimeiya would be exposed to the world. Supposedly, it had been found two weeks prior on a nearby mountain. It was hard to believe nobody had experienced its supernatural powers, but as I thought that, I recalled that I was also harmlessly holding it in my hands.
entries.literal: "At the same time, the exit was going to open at some point, and the Sekimeiya would be exposed to the world. Supposedly, it had been found two weeks prior on a nearby mountain. It was hard to believe nobody had experienced its supernatural powers, but as I thought that, I recalled that I was also harmlessly holding it in my hands."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered B4, the room with the first Naomi. I remembered where the keys were, so I found them easily.{w} Two keys remained: the small one I wanted and the one for the door in the first staircase. I took the smaller one off the keyring; otherwise, it was too large to keep on my person, and it might've made noise.
entries.literal: "We entered B4, the room with the first Naomi. I remembered where the keys were, so I found them easily.{w} Two keys remained: the small one I wanted and the one for the door in the first staircase. I took the smaller one off the keyring; otherwise, it was too large to keep on my person, and it might've made noise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, we moved to the staff room.{w} I inserted the key into a locker—I'd once again been correct about the purpose of a key.
entries.literal: "Then, we moved to the staff room.{w} I inserted the key into a locker—I'd once again been correct about the purpose of a key."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm pretty sure it'll work. It's not for this locker, so let me find the right one.
entries.literal: "I'm pretty sure it'll work. It's not for this locker, so let me find the right one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I inserted the key into another locker and attempted to turn it, to no avail. Then, I repeated the process with others until one opened.
entries.literal: "I inserted the key into another locker and attempted to turn it, to no avail. Then, I repeated the process with others until one opened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Good. It's this one.
entries.literal: "Good. It's this one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two compartments were inside: a small and empty one on the top, and the bigger, main one that had Naomi's coat hung inside it.
entries.literal: "Two compartments were inside: a small and empty one on the top, and the bigger, main one that had Naomi's coat hung inside it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I placed the Sekimeiya in the smaller one and took the coat out. I felt through the pockets, but they were all empty aside from a single handkerchief that I left alone.{w} I put the coat back inside. It was a bit disappointing that we hadn't found anything substantial, but I hadn't expected to.
entries.literal: "I placed the Sekimeiya in the smaller one and took the coat out. I felt through the pockets, but they were all empty aside from a single handkerchief that I left alone.{w} I put the coat back inside. It was a bit disappointing that we hadn't found anything substantial, but I hadn't expected to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed the door and locked it with the key while Shiroya observed all my actions from the side.
entries.literal: "I closed the door and locked it with the key while Shiroya observed all my actions from the side."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's it, then. At least there are no security cameras here, so we won't be seen hiding it.
entries.literal: "That's it, then. At least there are no security cameras here, so we won't be seen hiding it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I know. That's good.
entries.literal: "I know. That's good."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: By the way, regarding the cart disappearing...{w} I think it makes more sense than not. What's really strange is that apparently nobody noticed the Sekimeiya after it fell.
entries.literal: "By the way, regarding the cart disappearing...{w} I think it makes more sense than not. What's really strange is that apparently nobody noticed the Sekimeiya after it fell."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: For example: when I touched the Sekimeiya, why did I teleport, but not the cabinet? And why did my clothes teleport?
entries.literal: "For example: when I touched the Sekimeiya, why did I teleport, but not the cabinet? And why did my clothes teleport?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I was stepping on my shoes, so they teleported. My shoes were stepping on the floor, though, so why didn't the floor teleport?{w} It's probably just because my clothes were under my possession, while the floor wasn't.
entries.literal: "I was stepping on my shoes, so they teleported. My shoes were stepping on the floor, though, so why didn't the floor teleport?{w} It's probably just because my clothes were under my possession, while the floor wasn't."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Similarly, the cabinet I was touching wasn't in my possession, but the cart was in yours. Isn't that interesting? The cart is designed to be moved by whoever is holding it while the cabinets aren't. That's why the simple act of touching the cart makes it "yours", but touching a cabinet or the floor isn't enough.
entries.literal: "Similarly, the cabinet I was touching wasn't in my possession, but the cart was in yours. Isn't that interesting? The cart is designed to be moved by whoever is holding it while the cabinets aren't. That's why the simple act of touching the cart makes it \"yours\", but touching a cabinet or the floor isn't enough."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's about what I imagined, but it means that the Sekimeiya somehow recognized the cart was movable and the cabinet wasn't.
entries.literal: "That's about what I imagined, but it means that the Sekimeiya somehow recognized the cart was movable and the cabinet wasn't."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Exactly, which is convenient for us, or else we could've made a bunch of other things disappear just because we were making contact with them.
entries.literal: "Exactly, which is convenient for us, or else we could've made a bunch of other things disappear just because we were making contact with them."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Remember the suitcase in the attic? Something similar must've happened. Naomi traveled holding it, so it traveled along too.{w} We didn't find it strange at all since it's natural to imagine it'd happen, but your purse has traveled both times when it was only touching your clothes. It has to be because it's recognized as part of your whole entity when you travel.
entries.literal: "Remember the suitcase in the attic? Something similar must've happened. Naomi traveled holding it, so it traveled along too.{w} We didn't find it strange at all since it's natural to imagine it'd happen, but your purse has traveled both times when it was only touching your clothes. It has to be because it's recognized as part of your whole entity when you travel."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But we didn't appear upstairs with the cart, while I had my purse.
entries.literal: "But we didn't appear upstairs with the cart, while I had my purse."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right. If the cart actually appeared somewhere else, that would indicate again that the location where we appear isn't determined by where we are when we touch the Sekimeiya, or else it would've appeared with us.
entries.literal: "Right. If the cart actually appeared somewhere else, that would indicate again that the location where we appear isn't determined by where we are when we touch the Sekimeiya, or else it would've appeared with us."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So if the cart has appeared somewhere else, that position is determined by where the cart was at another point in time... And it should be easy to draw conclusions from that because it spent the entire time in the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "So if the cart has appeared somewhere else, that position is determined by where the cart was at another point in time... And it should be easy to draw conclusions from that because it spent the entire time in the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'd think so. Finally, consider this as well: when the cart traveled, everything that formed the "cleaning cart" disappeared alongside it. That included the bag covering its interior and the cleaning products that were placed at the front of it. All of that disappeared. It was treated like a single element you were holding.
entries.literal: "I'd think so. Finally, consider this as well: when the cart traveled, everything that formed the \"cleaning cart\" disappeared alongside it. That included the bag covering its interior and the cleaning products that were placed at the front of it. All of that disappeared. It was treated like a single element you were holding."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's why it's notable that the Sekimeiya didn't disappear while it was also part of the cart. It was inside it, so it should've been part of what you were touching with your other hand. However, it remained in place and fell in the bucket that was underneath it, which didn't teleport as it wasn't attached to the cart.
entries.literal: "That's why it's notable that the Sekimeiya didn't disappear while it was also part of the cart. It was inside it, so it should've been part of what you were touching with your other hand. However, it remained in place and fell in the bucket that was underneath it, which didn't teleport as it wasn't attached to the cart."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And just like we thought, the Sekimeiya can't go along with us.
entries.literal: "And just like we thought, the Sekimeiya can't go along with us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Pretty much. Even though it's what allows you to travel in the first place, it should've been included in your possessions. That wasn't necessarily the case in the previous travels—I wasn't holding the cabinets in the same sense.{w} The Sekimeiya must exclude itself when it comes to what it makes travel. And lastly, even if it had traveled, it's unlikely we would've appeared with it, which is what I speculated happened with the Sekimeiya in Sai's hip pack. Since the cart didn't appear with us in the attic, the Sekimeiya probably wouldn't have either.
entries.literal: "Pretty much. Even though it's what allows you to travel in the first place, it should've been included in your possessions. That wasn't necessarily the case in the previous travels—I wasn't holding the cabinets in the same sense.{w} The Sekimeiya must exclude itself when it comes to what it makes travel. And lastly, even if it had traveled, it's unlikely we would've appeared with it, which is what I speculated happened with the Sekimeiya in Sai's hip pack. Since the cart didn't appear with us in the attic, the Sekimeiya probably wouldn't have either."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I guess you're right... This clears a few things up.{w} We should probably try to get an idea of what happened here, though.
entries.literal: "I guess you're right... This clears a few things up.{w} We should probably try to get an idea of what happened here, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, the others should still be around. I'd imagine they looked at the place we disappeared from, so I have no idea why the Sekimeiya was still there. Let's go find them.
entries.literal: "Yeah, the others should still be around. I'd imagine they looked at the place we disappeared from, so I have no idea why the Sekimeiya was still there. Let's go find them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd been moving through hallway B for a few minutes, so it seemed appropriate to begin there. It was unlikely anyone had been near us, but we weren't going to lose much time by making sure to glance over every room.
entries.literal: "We'd been moving through hallway B for a few minutes, so it seemed appropriate to begin there. It was unlikely anyone had been near us, but we weren't going to lose much time by making sure to glance over every room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The start was the two bathrooms, and aside from Naomi's body, there was nothing there. Rapidly, we began to open every door to see if anything we could easily spot was around. The Sekimeiya cabinet, as expected, was empty.
entries.literal: "The start was the two bathrooms, and aside from Naomi's body, there was nothing there. Rapidly, we began to open every door to see if anything we could easily spot was around. The Sekimeiya cabinet, as expected, was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The original Naomi was still partially under a curtain after I'd grabbed her key, so I covered her properly again. The last crystal rooms were as they'd been from the start.
entries.literal: "The original Naomi was still partially under a curtain after I'd grabbed her key, so I covered her properly again. The last crystal rooms were as they'd been from the start."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To cross to the opposite hallway, we went through the lobby, knowing that the mechanical room was also on our way.{w} Unexpectedly, our search came to an abrupt stop when we stepped into the large hall.
entries.literal: "To cross to the opposite hallway, we went through the lobby, knowing that the mechanical room was also on our way.{w} Unexpectedly, our search came to an abrupt stop when we stepped into the large hall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: People were next to the metallic shutter. We recognized them immediately: Erina, Akaro, and Katei were kneeling down next to the wall, while Sai looked at them from above.
entries.literal: "People were next to the metallic shutter. We recognized them immediately: Erina, Akaro, and Katei were kneeling down next to the wall, while Sai looked at them from above."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as we opened the door, their heads lifted to meet our gazes. After a couple quiet seconds, Katei was first to further acknowledge our presence and stood up from the floor. He began walking toward us, and we did the same until we met in the middle of the room.
entries.literal: "As soon as we opened the door, their heads lifted to meet our gazes. After a couple quiet seconds, Katei was first to further acknowledge our presence and stood up from the floor. He began walking toward us, and we did the same until we met in the middle of the room."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Where were you...? What the hell happened earlier?
entries.literal: "Where were you...? What the hell happened earlier?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While the conversation started, we approached the others who had kept silent. Strangely, they were looking down again, wearing unsettling expressions.
entries.literal: "While the conversation started, we approached the others who had kept silent. Strangely, they were looking down again, wearing unsettling expressions."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You mean when Sai sneaked away? Right, we disappeared. The Sekimeiya made us go to the past again, and this time we appeared in the attic.
entries.literal: "You mean when Sai sneaked away? Right, we disappeared. The Sekimeiya made us go to the past again, and this time we appeared in the attic."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh. I... see.
entries.literal: "Oh. I... see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After his strangely short response, we went over to the shutter. Something might've happened, as everyone else appeared quiet and unresponsive. I wondered why they'd decided to stay there, too.
entries.literal: "After his strangely short response, we went over to the shutter. Something might've happened, as everyone else appeared quiet and unresponsive. I wondered why they'd decided to stay there, too."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did you search for us at all?
entries.literal: "Did you search for us at all?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since that wasn't a question directed at anyone in particular, Sai decided to speak.
entries.literal: "Since that wasn't a question directed at anyone in particular, Sai decided to speak."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You were in the attic, you said? Why didn't you come down sooner?
entries.literal: "You were in the attic, you said? Why didn't you come down sooner?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We fell asleep and lost track of time. Did something happen?{w} Where's Isla?
entries.literal: "We fell asleep and lost track of time. Did something happen?{w} Where's Isla?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I asked that instinctively, but I hadn't consciously realized that Isla wasn't with them.
entries.literal: "I asked that instinctively, but I hadn't consciously realized that Isla wasn't with them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina, who I'd imagined would quickly answer, remained looking down at her lap, hiding her face from us. Strain filled my body, as that mere action made me imagine that something terrible could've happened.
entries.literal: "Erina, who I'd imagined would quickly answer, remained looking down at her lap, hiding her face from us. Strain filled my body, as that mere action made me imagine that something terrible could've happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: None of the others decided to respond either, and instead shut their eyes before lowering their heads. Finally, I noticed that their expressions were tinged with sorrow.
entries.literal: "None of the others decided to respond either, and instead shut their eyes before lowering their heads. Finally, I noticed that their expressions were tinged with sorrow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They understood that their own reactions had started to fill us in. After a few unsettling seconds, Sai began speaking in a faint voice, uncharacteristic of the way he'd come across at any other time.
entries.literal: "They understood that their own reactions had started to fill us in. After a few unsettling seconds, Sai began speaking in a faint voice, uncharacteristic of the way he'd come across at any other time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I, along with the others against the wall, listened to the words that narrated what had taken place while we'd been sleeping six floors above.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I, along with the others against the wall, listened to the words that narrated what had taken place while we'd been sleeping six floors above."

entries.text: Hidden Cliff
entries.literal: "Hidden Cliff"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At the same time that Shiroya and Atsuki disappeared from the cleaning room, Erina and Isla, who were in the opposite hallway, saw Sai appearing from hallway C.
entries.literal: "At the same time that Shiroya and Atsuki disappeared from the cleaning room, Erina and Isla, who were in the opposite hallway, saw Sai appearing from hallway C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as they made eye contact, Sai's body visibly relaxed. As if he'd changed personalities in an instant, he began slowly walking toward the two next to the event room, who hadn't said anything yet.
entries.literal: "As soon as they made eye contact, Sai's body visibly relaxed. As if he'd changed personalities in an instant, he began slowly walking toward the two next to the event room, who hadn't said anything yet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Without a care in the world, he was the first to ask a question.
entries.literal: "Without a care in the world, he was the first to ask a question."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: What's going on? Where did the others go?
entries.literal: "What's going on? Where did the others go?"

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: What...? They went to find you since you disappeared all of a sudden. Why did you do that?
entries.literal: "What...? They went to find you since you disappeared all of a sudden. Why did you do that?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naturally, Erina didn't know how to react, given that the others had made it seem essential to guard hallway A in case Sai went there before they could get him.
entries.literal: "Naturally, Erina didn't know how to react, given that the others had made it seem essential to guard hallway A in case Sai went there before they could get him."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: What do you mean? We were gonna start searching for the Sekimeiya, so I just went ahead first.
entries.literal: "What do you mean? We were gonna start searching for the Sekimeiya, so I just went ahead first."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: What? Why didn't you tell us, then? Didn't you go to hallway B?
entries.literal: "What? Why didn't you tell us, then? Didn't you go to hallway B?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Yes, but I headed over here since it's a better place to start with. I was gonna tell you two to come, but you were looking at me weird, so I wasn't sure if anything happened.
entries.literal: "Yes, but I headed over here since it's a better place to start with. I was gonna tell you two to come, but you were looking at me weird, so I wasn't sure if anything happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Those weren't very convincing words, but Erina didn't question him further, mostly because Sai's own question cut in.
entries.literal: "Those weren't very convincing words, but Erina didn't question him further, mostly because Sai's own question cut in."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Where are the others?
entries.literal: "Where are the others?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Peeking inside the event room with a frown, Sai noticed the lack of other people.
entries.literal: "Peeking inside the event room with a frown, Sai noticed the lack of other people."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: Didn't I just say they went behind you? They're in hallway B.
entries.literal: "Didn't I just say they went behind you? They're in hallway B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door to the opposite hallway was open, and Akaro could be seen with his own frown, evidently ignoring the sound of their conversation.
entries.literal: "The door to the opposite hallway was open, and Akaro could be seen with his own frown, evidently ignoring the sound of their conversation."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai said Akaro's name out loud, and a few seconds later, his head finally turned to face them. Upon asking him what he was worried about, he let them know that Shiroya and Atsuki had not yet left the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "Sai said Akaro's name out loud, and a few seconds later, his head finally turned to face them. Upon asking him what he was worried about, he let them know that Shiroya and Atsuki had not yet left the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai, showing the strongest reaction, approached the room while letting out a conspicuous grunt.{w} He opened the door and stayed still for some time. Then, he entered the small space. Before the others had time to wonder what he was doing, he exited and told them that it was empty.
entries.literal: "Sai, showing the strongest reaction, approached the room while letting out a conspicuous grunt.{w} He opened the door and stayed still for some time. Then, he entered the small space. Before the others had time to wonder what he was doing, he exited and told them that it was empty."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro, who had a hard time believing it, stepped forward and became aware of the glaring contradiction within the room.
entries.literal: "Akaro, who had a hard time believing it, stepped forward and became aware of the glaring contradiction within the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Seeing his dumbfounded face, Erina and Isla got closer too. The four of them saw that not only had Shiroya and Atsuki vanished from the room, the cleaning cart had too.
entries.literal: "Seeing his dumbfounded face, Erina and Isla got closer too. The four of them saw that not only had Shiroya and Atsuki vanished from the room, the cleaning cart had too."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A disappearing cart was nothing compared to everything that had already happened. Once the other three stepped in, they became aware of the cause. The Sekimeiya sat inside one of the few buckets that remained on the floor of the cramped room.
entries.literal: "A disappearing cart was nothing compared to everything that had already happened. Once the other three stepped in, they became aware of the cause. The Sekimeiya sat inside one of the few buckets that remained on the floor of the cramped room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Sai who first questioned its status, as it somewhat contradicted a few things they'd concluded earlier. It was white instead of the gray color they thought it'd become after teleporting two people and a whole cleaning cart.
entries.literal: "It was Sai who first questioned its status, as it somewhat contradicted a few things they'd concluded earlier. It was white instead of the gray color they thought it'd become after teleporting two people and a whole cleaning cart."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Not much discussion was had. Up until then, they'd grown accustomed to Katei's voice immediately instructing them to put the Sekimeiya back in its cabinet. It was the lack of those words that alerted them that Katei wasn't there.
entries.literal: "Not much discussion was had. Up until then, they'd grown accustomed to Katei's voice immediately instructing them to put the Sekimeiya back in its cabinet. It was the lack of those words that alerted them that Katei wasn't there."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Where is Katei?
entries.literal: "Where is Katei?"

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: He followed you to hallway C.
entries.literal: "He followed you to hallway C."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Me? Then why didn't he come to the event room when we were in hallway A?
entries.literal: "Me? Then why didn't he come to the event room when we were in hallway A?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Doubtful looks were the only answer. Sai, Erina, and Isla had spent a few seconds talking next to its door. Of course, Katei should have been visible.
entries.literal: "Doubtful looks were the only answer. Sai, Erina, and Isla had spent a few seconds talking next to its door. Of course, Katei should have been visible."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Taking advantage of Katei's absence, they removed their full focus from the Sekimeiya and left it where they'd found it, prioritizing finding him.
entries.literal: "Taking advantage of Katei's absence, they removed their full focus from the Sekimeiya and left it where they'd found it, prioritizing finding him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: All of them assumed that attempting to locate Shiroya and Atsuki was futile, as they'd most likely teleported through time and were somewhere else entirely. Sai was first to suggest going to see where Katei had gone, which shouldn't have taken a long time.
entries.literal: "All of them assumed that attempting to locate Shiroya and Atsuki was futile, as they'd most likely teleported through time and were somewhere else entirely. Sai was first to suggest going to see where Katei had gone, which shouldn't have taken a long time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With Akaro in the front and Sai in the back, the four left the room and saw the empty hallway C. The stairs presented the possibility of Katei moving upstairs, but hallway A was the most likely option.
entries.literal: "With Akaro in the front and Sai in the back, the four left the room and saw the empty hallway C. The stairs presented the possibility of Katei moving upstairs, but hallway A was the most likely option."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Shiroya and Atsuki should still be here even if they traveled back in time. It could be that Katei took advantage of this situation to do something.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and Atsuki should still be here even if they traveled back in time. It could be that Katei took advantage of this situation to do something."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai called out Katei's name while Akaro viewed the entire situation with suspicion, as he'd seen Sai in front of the cleaning room, where the Sekimeiya turned out to be. He asked Sai why he'd disappeared earlier, which was answered the same way he'd justified his actions to Erina.
entries.literal: "Sai called out Katei's name while Akaro viewed the entire situation with suspicion, as he'd seen Sai in front of the cleaning room, where the Sekimeiya turned out to be. He asked Sai why he'd disappeared earlier, which was answered the same way he'd justified his actions to Erina."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They stopped in front of the stairs, and Sai sighed as soon as he saw the other long, empty hallway.
entries.literal: "They stopped in front of the stairs, and Sai sighed as soon as he saw the other long, empty hallway."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You all rushed too quickly to find me when I was only trying to move things along, and now this happened. We found the Sekimeiya already, at least, but now we have to search for three people, which is just great...
entries.literal: "You all rushed too quickly to find me when I was only trying to move things along, and now this happened. We found the Sekimeiya already, at least, but now we have to search for three people, which is just great..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai began directing the others. With Atsuki and Katei gone, his demands met no resistance. His arrangement consisted of Erina and Isla staying next to the stairs and Akaro checking hallway B, while he himself looked through the hallway A rooms. That way, the search wouldn't take more than two minutes.
entries.literal: "Sai began directing the others. With Atsuki and Katei gone, his demands met no resistance. His arrangement consisted of Erina and Isla staying next to the stairs and Akaro checking hallway B, while he himself looked through the hallway A rooms. That way, the search wouldn't take more than two minutes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As they put that into practice, Sai continued yelling out Katei's name. He wasn't being drawn to the noise, so it followed that he wasn't nearby.{w} Drawing a zigzag pattern, Akaro and Sai met in the lobby after looking through every room in their respective hallways. In the meantime, Isla observed next to her mother. Despite her initial optimism, she was aware of what the situation had become.{w} Sai put an end to the search by concluding that the mechanical room was empty.
entries.literal: "As they put that into practice, Sai continued yelling out Katei's name. He wasn't being drawn to the noise, so it followed that he wasn't nearby.{w} Drawing a zigzag pattern, Akaro and Sai met in the lobby after looking through every room in their respective hallways. In the meantime, Isla observed next to her mother. Despite her initial optimism, she was aware of what the situation had become.{w} Sai put an end to the search by concluding that the mechanical room was empty."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They walked back to the starting point, where Erina and Isla waited. Once the four of them knew that they were the only people on that floor, they could only speculate on where Katei'd gone off to. With a free way to the other floors, he could have been anywhere, and even though they'd quickly accepted that Shiroya and Atsuki had once again traveled through time, they should've reappeared by that point.
entries.literal: "They walked back to the starting point, where Erina and Isla waited. Once the four of them knew that they were the only people on that floor, they could only speculate on where Katei'd gone off to. With a free way to the other floors, he could have been anywhere, and even though they'd quickly accepted that Shiroya and Atsuki had once again traveled through time, they should've reappeared by that point."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki's and Shiroya's actions weren't openly questioned. After all, everyone had assumed they'd found the Sekimeiya and touched it without malicious intentions. After Akaro revealed that Sai had been about to enter the cleaning room, Erina couldn't help but suspect that they were being shamelessly manipulated.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's and Shiroya's actions weren't openly questioned. After all, everyone had assumed they'd found the Sekimeiya and touched it without malicious intentions. After Akaro revealed that Sai had been about to enter the cleaning room, Erina couldn't help but suspect that they were being shamelessly manipulated."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She sat on the stairs.{w} She was tired and had to bear the constant burden of bringing her daughter into danger. They were locked up in a huge building with a murderer, and the people she wanted to trust had accepted that time travel was an ongoing factor they'd used to explain the mysteries pressing down on them.
entries.literal: "She sat on the stairs.{w} She was tired and had to bear the constant burden of bringing her daughter into danger. They were locked up in a huge building with a murderer, and the people she wanted to trust had accepted that time travel was an ongoing factor they'd used to explain the mysteries pressing down on them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Mentally, she was exhausted. Ever since the first time they had found Naomi's body, she had been especially careful not to let Isla out of her sight or go off with anyone else. She simply couldn't fully trust them. From finding Naomi's second body onward, it was irrefutable that something unnatural was happening, but her only priority was her daughter's safety.
entries.literal: "Mentally, she was exhausted. Ever since the first time they had found Naomi's body, she had been especially careful not to let Isla out of her sight or go off with anyone else. She simply couldn't fully trust them. From finding Naomi's second body onward, it was irrefutable that something unnatural was happening, but her only priority was her daughter's safety."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Isla had initially been eager to go to what was supposed to be a routine event, but it had morphed into something incomprehensible. Erina couldn't imagine that someone would want to harm her, but the risk of being there at all gradually eroded any confidence she had in that notion.
entries.literal: "Isla had initially been eager to go to what was supposed to be a routine event, but it had morphed into something incomprehensible. Erina couldn't imagine that someone would want to harm her, but the risk of being there at all gradually eroded any confidence she had in that notion."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: By taking a seat, she only wanted to show that she needed a short break before the search that inevitably followed. Her own daughter, though, didn't grasp that intention, as she suddenly walked off toward hallway A while the others watched her curiously.
entries.literal: "By taking a seat, she only wanted to show that she needed a short break before the search that inevitably followed. Her own daughter, though, didn't grasp that intention, as she suddenly walked off toward hallway A while the others watched her curiously."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: Sweetie...? Where are you going?
entries.literal: "Sweetie...? Where are you going?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With distress and concern lacing her voice, Erina asked that question, looking up from the stairs. Isla turned around and saw her mother's face, which she found a bit tricky to decipher. Choosing to answer the question with her own actions, she continued walking and stopped next to room A5. It was the place where gemstones had been stolen, the sole crystal room exposed to the smoke.
entries.literal: "With distress and concern lacing her voice, Erina asked that question, looking up from the stairs. Isla turned around and saw her mother's face, which she found a bit tricky to decipher. Choosing to answer the question with her own actions, she continued walking and stopped next to room A5. It was the place where gemstones had been stolen, the sole crystal room exposed to the smoke."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Isla reached up to grab the doorknob and turned it to open her way in. From the stairs, three people looked at her, finding what they were seeing very odd. As soon as they saw Isla entering the room, Erina gave up on her brief rest and stood.
entries.literal: "Isla reached up to grab the doorknob and turned it to open her way in. From the stairs, three people looked at her, finding what they were seeing very odd. As soon as they saw Isla entering the room, Erina gave up on her brief rest and stood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While she approached the room, she timidly called Isla's name. Once she was by the door, the two men behind started to approach her, intrigued by Isla's behavior.
entries.literal: "While she approached the room, she timidly called Isla's name. Once she was by the door, the two men behind started to approach her, intrigued by Isla's behavior."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Isla had left the door open, so Erina was the first one to see the interior. Just as she remembered, it was dirtied by a purplish black color, and almost no brightness penetrated the coating on the ceiling.{w} The light leaking in from hallway C was the main source of illumination. It took her a second to spot Isla with how dark it was; she was putting all of the force she could into opening up a cabinet. Unbeknownst to Erina, what would then occur would not leave her memories until they all faded away.
entries.literal: "Isla had left the door open, so Erina was the first one to see the interior. Just as she remembered, it was dirtied by a purplish black color, and almost no brightness penetrated the coating on the ceiling.{w} The light leaking in from hallway C was the main source of illumination. It took her a second to spot Isla with how dark it was; she was putting all of the force she could into opening up a cabinet. Unbeknownst to Erina, what would then occur would not leave her memories until they all faded away."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Applying force with her two small arms, Isla lifted up the heavy cover of the cabinet, found deep in the room. To prevent it from closing, she leaned it on the wall. After that, she attempted to peek inside, but her short body didn't make it easy. With both hands, she grabbed the top of the cabinet and propelled herself upward to see inside it.
entries.literal: "Applying force with her two small arms, Isla lifted up the heavy cover of the cabinet, found deep in the room. To prevent it from closing, she leaned it on the wall. After that, she attempted to peek inside, but her short body didn't make it easy. With both hands, she grabbed the top of the cabinet and propelled herself upward to see inside it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once her eyes made contact with what lay within the compartment she'd uncovered, a nightmarish scream tore through the room, terrifying Erina while she looked in from the hallway.
entries.literal: "Once her eyes made contact with what lay within the compartment she'd uncovered, a nightmarish scream tore through the room, terrifying Erina while she looked in from the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But that was only half of what she had to witness. Isla's face was hidden in the cabinet, so Erina was unable to see that her confident look had shifted into an agonizing expression.
entries.literal: "But that was only half of what she had to witness. Isla's face was hidden in the cabinet, so Erina was unable to see that her confident look had shifted into an agonizing expression."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina's mind reeled in response, and as she began running to aid her daughter, she frantically questioned what the cause of such a horrible scream could've been. Had it been physical pain, or a reaction to something she'd seen?
entries.literal: "Erina's mind reeled in response, and as she began running to aid her daughter, she frantically questioned what the cause of such a horrible scream could've been. Had it been physical pain, or a reaction to something she'd seen?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As Erina rushed inside, Isla's instincts told her to get out of the position she'd put herself in. However, due to jumping upward, the front of the cabinet had suspended her in midair, painfully pressing into her stomach and preventing her legs from reaching the floor.{w} The only way she could move was by leaning forward.
entries.literal: "As Erina rushed inside, Isla's instincts told her to get out of the position she'd put herself in. However, due to jumping upward, the front of the cabinet had suspended her in midair, painfully pressing into her stomach and preventing her legs from reaching the floor.{w} The only way she could move was by leaning forward."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Next to the door, Erina's senses all perceived the same thing: Isla, in her helpless state, inclined forward and fell inside the cabinet. Only the sound of her body landing was audible, as no yell came out. Like the curtain falling after a play, the impact made the lid fall, shaken out of its precarious balance.
entries.literal: "Next to the door, Erina's senses all perceived the same thing: Isla, in her helpless state, inclined forward and fell inside the cabinet. Only the sound of her body landing was audible, as no yell came out. Like the curtain falling after a play, the impact made the lid fall, shaken out of its precarious balance."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina let out a cry and ran as fast as she could. Meanwhile, Sai and Akaro looked on from the door.{w} When Erina reopened the lid and leaned in, she finally saw what the ominous cabinet contained.
entries.literal: "Erina let out a cry and ran as fast as she could. Meanwhile, Sai and Akaro looked on from the door.{w} When Erina reopened the lid and leaned in, she finally saw what the ominous cabinet contained."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nothing.{w} Erina didn't see anything but the five faces of the cabinet, covered by a velvet texture that, while untainted by the smoke, appeared black due to the lack of light.
entries.literal: "Nothing.{w} Erina didn't see anything but the five faces of the cabinet, covered by a velvet texture that, while untainted by the smoke, appeared black due to the lack of light."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She stood still while her heart took off. Then, she snapped and began to feel its walls, trying to understand how that cabinet had swallowed up her daughter.
entries.literal: "She stood still while her heart took off. Then, she snapped and began to feel its walls, trying to understand how that cabinet had swallowed up her daughter."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unable to find anything, she desperately looked around the cabinet in case she'd misinterpreted what had happened. Akaro and Sai, however, both bewildered, had arrived just in time to corroborate that Isla's lower body had fallen inside.
entries.literal: "Unable to find anything, she desperately looked around the cabinet in case she'd misinterpreted what had happened. Akaro and Sai, however, both bewildered, had arrived just in time to corroborate that Isla's lower body had fallen inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They stepped in while Erina's next reaction was to open up the adjacent cabinets in hope of a hidden connection. Within all of them, the only contents were a handful of gems.
entries.literal: "They stepped in while Erina's next reaction was to open up the adjacent cabinets in hope of a hidden connection. Within all of them, the only contents were a handful of gems."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As that wordless commotion continued, Sai moved toward the cabinet Isla had fallen into. He looked inside it for a few seconds and verified with his own eyes that there was nobody inside. Just as Erina had done, he couldn't suppress the need to reach in, attempting to find a hidden passageway. He felt the entire interior, and once he was done, he stood back up to gesture at Akaro that Erina was right: there was nothing there.
entries.literal: "As that wordless commotion continued, Sai moved toward the cabinet Isla had fallen into. He looked inside it for a few seconds and verified with his own eyes that there was nobody inside. Just as Erina had done, he couldn't suppress the need to reach in, attempting to find a hidden passageway. He felt the entire interior, and once he was done, he stood back up to gesture at Akaro that Erina was right: there was nothing there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They turned to Erina, who had gone completely immobile. Every cabinet had been opened and closed, and she was leaning against the last one without the strength to look up. Before the others had to wait, she spoke with a nearly broken voice.
entries.literal: "They turned to Erina, who had gone completely immobile. Every cabinet had been opened and closed, and she was leaning against the last one without the strength to look up. Before the others had to wait, she spoke with a nearly broken voice."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: Where did she go...? She couldn't have disappeared.
entries.literal: "Where did she go...? She couldn't have disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In their circumstances, that normally sensible claim had no basis. Of course she could have disappeared, as such a thing had already happened multiple times. The real question they had to ask themselves was how. Sai and Akaro knew that, but they didn't reply, unable to find appropriate words.
entries.literal: "In their circumstances, that normally sensible claim had no basis. Of course she could have disappeared, as such a thing had already happened multiple times. The real question they had to ask themselves was how. Sai and Akaro knew that, but they didn't reply, unable to find appropriate words."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: Tell me. Something must've happened to her, and it has to do with this... teleportation you two keep talking about. What happened...!?
entries.literal: "Tell me. Something must've happened to her, and it has to do with this... teleportation you two keep talking about. What happened...!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They had realized that the room was empty. Isla had suddenly disappeared without leaving a trace. Even though disappearances had become commonplace, they'd thought that the Sekimeiya had to be directly involved for one to occur.{w} Despite that, they'd found it in the cleaning room and left it there. Furthermore, Atsuki's earlier explanation of the "range" emitted by the Sekimeiya couldn't explain what had occurred, as nobody else nearby had disappeared along with Isla.
entries.literal: "They had realized that the room was empty. Isla had suddenly disappeared without leaving a trace. Even though disappearances had become commonplace, they'd thought that the Sekimeiya had to be directly involved for one to occur.{w} Despite that, they'd found it in the cleaning room and left it there. Furthermore, Atsuki's earlier explanation of the \"range\" emitted by the Sekimeiya couldn't explain what had occurred, as nobody else nearby had disappeared along with Isla."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And even though it seemed of less importance, there was one last thing without an explanation: Isla's scream. She'd let out a terrifying cry as soon as she looked inside the cabinet. However, Erina had immediately looked inside and seen nothing.
entries.literal: "And even though it seemed of less importance, there was one last thing without an explanation: Isla's scream. She'd let out a terrifying cry as soon as she looked inside the cabinet. However, Erina had immediately looked inside and seen nothing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai and Akaro told all of that to Erina, who until that point hadn't completely considered the full implications of the paranormal events she had witnessed. They wanted to reassure Erina that even though Isla had somehow disappeared, she had gone to the past and was safe somewhere else.
entries.literal: "Sai and Akaro told all of that to Erina, who until that point hadn't completely considered the full implications of the paranormal events she had witnessed. They wanted to reassure Erina that even though Isla had somehow disappeared, she had gone to the past and was safe somewhere else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina knew that what had happened couldn't be immediately answered, so she rushed out to find Isla, hoping they would reunite soon. They had a whole building to search through and no guarantee that Isla was still in it. At the same time, a part of Erina was still trying to understand why Isla had suddenly walked up to that cabinet.
entries.literal: "Erina knew that what had happened couldn't be immediately answered, so she rushed out to find Isla, hoping they would reunite soon. They had a whole building to search through and no guarantee that Isla was still in it. At the same time, a part of Erina was still trying to understand why Isla had suddenly walked up to that cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She tried to comfort herself when she remembered the recording they'd heard in the attic since, in the worst-case scenario, it told her that Isla was going to be safe in a month. For the first time, Erina viewed it as a failsafe instead of one of the worst possibilities.
entries.literal: "She tried to comfort herself when she remembered the recording they'd heard in the attic since, in the worst-case scenario, it told her that Isla was going to be safe in a month. For the first time, Erina viewed it as a failsafe instead of one of the worst possibilities."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Only three people were part of the group that still remained on the crystal floor. They wanted to urgently find Isla, whose vanishing had suddenly generated the first real instance of chaos since the start of their imprisonment. They confirmed that the Sekimeiya hadn't moved from the cleaning room, and their rushed search began.
entries.literal: "Only three people were part of the group that still remained on the crystal floor. They wanted to urgently find Isla, whose vanishing had suddenly generated the first real instance of chaos since the start of their imprisonment. They confirmed that the Sekimeiya hadn't moved from the cleaning room, and their rushed search began."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They continually yelled Isla's name, hoping that she would appear before them. Even though a single disappearance hadn't yet been linked to direct danger, Erina's nerves were clearly shot, which was why they went through the whole building as fast as they could.
entries.literal: "They continually yelled Isla's name, hoping that she would appear before them. Even though a single disappearance hadn't yet been linked to direct danger, Erina's nerves were clearly shot, which was why they went through the whole building as fast as they could."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Having recently looked through the entire bottom floor, they were done with it swiftly. The elevator should've still been disabled in the attic, so their search continued through the stairs.
entries.literal: "Having recently looked through the entire bottom floor, they were done with it swiftly. The elevator should've still been disabled in the attic, so their search continued through the stairs."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Emitting clear desperation, they hastily looked through the rest of the building, yelling for Isla.
entries.literal: "Emitting clear desperation, they hastily looked through the rest of the building, yelling for Isla."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once they finished, the result took a bit of time to sink in. Not only had they not found Isla, but Katei, Shiroya, and Atsuki hadn't been drawn to their yells either.
entries.literal: "Once they finished, the result took a bit of time to sink in. Not only had they not found Isla, but Katei, Shiroya, and Atsuki hadn't been drawn to their yells either."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As they thought, the elevator was still open, and they chose not to reenable it yet.
entries.literal: "As they thought, the elevator was still open, and they chose not to reenable it yet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With a much slower pace and devoid of energy, they headed downstairs, surrounded by the haunting silence. Erina's thoughts kept returning to the recording, which she could no longer make Sai and Akaro listen to even if she wanted to, as it had disappeared along with Isla's purse.
entries.literal: "With a much slower pace and devoid of energy, they headed downstairs, surrounded by the haunting silence. Erina's thoughts kept returning to the recording, which she could no longer make Sai and Akaro listen to even if she wanted to, as it had disappeared along with Isla's purse."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The crystal floor was just as empty as before. None of them knew what to do, so they lethargically walked to the lobby.
entries.literal: "The crystal floor was just as empty as before. None of them knew what to do, so they lethargically walked to the lobby."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before them was the immutable shutter preventing them from escaping and obtaining help. Erina leaned against it while the other two stayed still. Imagining how much Erina was suffering, being faced with the precarious disappearance of her child, they had chosen long ago not to say anything unnecessary.
entries.literal: "Before them was the immutable shutter preventing them from escaping and obtaining help. Erina leaned against it while the other two stayed still. Imagining how much Erina was suffering, being faced with the precarious disappearance of her child, they had chosen long ago not to say anything unnecessary."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For a while, they stayed there, powerless against the confusing reality, hoping that waiting would lead them somewhere.
entries.literal: "For a while, they stayed there, powerless against the confusing reality, hoping that waiting would lead them somewhere."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They knew where the Sekimeiya was, but without Katei, dealing with it seemed far from their priority. It appeared impossible that it had been related to Isla's disappearance, but no other explanation existed. Out of the blue, they found themselves alone in a huge building with two identical corpses after four people had vanished.
entries.literal: "They knew where the Sekimeiya was, but without Katei, dealing with it seemed far from their priority. It appeared impossible that it had been related to Isla's disappearance, but no other explanation existed. Out of the blue, they found themselves alone in a huge building with two identical corpses after four people had vanished."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The silence had continued uninterrupted since they'd set foot on the crystal floor, but the three of them had been thinking about drastically different things.{w} It was an outside sound that finally breached the empty air, coming from hallway A.
entries.literal: "The silence had continued uninterrupted since they'd set foot on the crystal floor, but the three of them had been thinking about drastically different things.{w} It was an outside sound that finally breached the empty air, coming from hallway A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They immediately lifted their heads. The door had been left open, so they all rushed to see if they could spot the origin of the sound.
entries.literal: "They immediately lifted their heads. The door had been left open, so they all rushed to see if they could spot the origin of the sound."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They did so easily. Katei's figure was in the middle of the wide floor, his shoulders slumped. As soon as they saw each other, Katei hurried over to them.
entries.literal: "They did so easily. Katei's figure was in the middle of the wide floor, his shoulders slumped. As soon as they saw each other, Katei hurried over to them."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Where did you go...? We searched for you.
entries.literal: "Where did you go...? We searched for you."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai shot the first question, and an immediate answer came that left the three of them unsatisfied.
entries.literal: "Sai shot the first question, and an immediate answer came that left the three of them unsatisfied."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I don't know. I think I experienced what Atsuki said... That teleportation. I've been searching for you.
entries.literal: "I don't know. I think I experienced what Atsuki said... That teleportation. I've been searching for you."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That brief explanation was all they got, as the next thing that came out of his mouth was the question they'd known would come.
entries.literal: "That brief explanation was all they got, as the next thing that came out of his mouth was the question they'd known would come."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Where are Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya?
entries.literal: "Where are Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei looked through the door and saw the empty hall. Three faces lowered in front of him, communicating what had occurred. Akaro, knowing how hard it was for Erina to hear those words, chose to speak and briefly explained the recent events.
entries.literal: "Katei looked through the door and saw the empty hall. Three faces lowered in front of him, communicating what had occurred. Akaro, knowing how hard it was for Erina to hear those words, chose to speak and briefly explained the recent events."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was a lot of information to take in for Katei, and it only made everything that had recently happened even more confusing. Despite that, he had a few thoughts that he chose to keep to himself.
entries.literal: "It was a lot of information to take in for Katei, and it only made everything that had recently happened even more confusing. Despite that, he had a few thoughts that he chose to keep to himself."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I see. I'm sorry, but I have no clue what happened to any of us. You said you searched the building, right...?
entries.literal: "I see. I'm sorry, but I have no clue what happened to any of us. You said you searched the building, right...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The others nodded.
entries.literal: "The others nodded."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They'd told him where Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya had disappeared from, so he began walking to where they'd last seen Isla, as that part of the story was what he least understood.
entries.literal: "They'd told him where Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya had disappeared from, so he began walking to where they'd last seen Isla, as that part of the story was what he least understood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They all entered room A5 and were hit by the memory of Isla's body falling into that looming void. They'd lowered every lid before leaving, so Sai pointed at the one in question.
entries.literal: "They all entered room A5 and were hit by the memory of Isla's body falling into that looming void. They'd lowered every lid before leaving, so Sai pointed at the one in question."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei approached it, finding it hard to believe that nothing had been found inside. He completely denied the thought of any opening or passage within the cabinet, so he wanted to see if he could get a good idea of what had happened or if he could reinforce what he believed had truly occurred.
entries.literal: "Katei approached it, finding it hard to believe that nothing had been found inside. He completely denied the thought of any opening or passage within the cabinet, so he wanted to see if he could get a good idea of what had happened or if he could reinforce what he believed had truly occurred."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He gripped the lower part of the lid with his right arm and lifted it. As soon as the smallest gap appeared, he peeked inside.{w} Even though there was very little light, he frowned.
entries.literal: "He gripped the lower part of the lid with his right arm and lifted it. As soon as the smallest gap appeared, he peeked inside.{w} Even though there was very little light, he frowned."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As he continued revealing the cabinet, that frown shifted into a much darker expression. Once he was done, he could only gesture at the others to see with their own eyes, as he couldn't bring himself to say the words out loud.
entries.literal: "As he continued revealing the cabinet, that frown shifted into a much darker expression. Once he was done, he could only gesture at the others to see with their own eyes, as he couldn't bring himself to say the words out loud."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hearing his faint but trembling voice, Erina ran up to see what he'd seen.
entries.literal: "Hearing his faint but trembling voice, Erina ran up to see what he'd seen."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When she saw the body of her daughter lying face-up, her mind broke, and all of her thoughts were defied. Isla almost looked like she was sleeping, but the lack of her chest rising made Erina fear the worst.
entries.literal: "When she saw the body of her daughter lying face-up, her mind broke, and all of her thoughts were defied. Isla almost looked like she was sleeping, but the lack of her chest rising made Erina fear the worst."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Without thinking, she reached inside, and as soon as she felt Isla's skin, she gave out and collapsed onto the cabinet, creating a sight reminiscent of the last time Isla had been seen.
entries.literal: "Without thinking, she reached inside, and as soon as she felt Isla's skin, she gave out and collapsed onto the cabinet, creating a sight reminiscent of the last time Isla had been seen."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had felt no trace of life—only a cold piece of flesh with a texture far from the one she recognized as her daughter's.
entries.literal: "She had felt no trace of life—only a cold piece of flesh with a texture far from the one she recognized as her daughter's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While the others stared with pity, Erina didn't move, her sharp cries piercing the air. The recording, which she had begun to see as proof of hope, had become an impossibility.
entries.literal: "While the others stared with pity, Erina didn't move, her sharp cries piercing the air. The recording, which she had begun to see as proof of hope, had become an impossibility."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After some time, Katei looked inside the cabinet again while everyone kept an eye on him. He didn't see anything else; Isla rested alone in the space she'd disappeared from.
entries.literal: "After some time, Katei looked inside the cabinet again while everyone kept an eye on him. He didn't see anything else; Isla rested alone in the space she'd disappeared from."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The others knew how heartless it was to attempt to solve what had happened right away, but nobody could help but think about how little sense it all made. Isla had disappeared from an empty cabinet and reappeared inside it later, the only change her status from alive to dead.
entries.literal: "The others knew how heartless it was to attempt to solve what had happened right away, but nobody could help but think about how little sense it all made. Isla had disappeared from an empty cabinet and reappeared inside it later, the only change her status from alive to dead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A third death had surfaced, and that time, someone who'd been with the group from the start was the victim. Once again, a number of questions came along with it, but no answers—not even the cause of death.
entries.literal: "A third death had surfaced, and that time, someone who'd been with the group from the start was the victim. Once again, a number of questions came along with it, but no answers—not even the cause of death."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Regardless, the unfortunate reality was that a mother had lost her child on what should've been an enjoyable day which had transfigured into an inexplicable nightmare. The rest of them verified that Isla was no longer alive, and while they were hit hard by such a tragedy, they knew they couldn't begin to imagine what Erina was feeling.
entries.literal: "Regardless, the unfortunate reality was that a mother had lost her child on what should've been an enjoyable day which had transfigured into an inexplicable nightmare. The rest of them verified that Isla was no longer alive, and while they were hit hard by such a tragedy, they knew they couldn't begin to imagine what Erina was feeling."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They exchanged looks without interfering with her, her body trembling as she hid her face. Eventually, she stood up abruptly and bolted out of the room, briefly displaying her tormented expression.
entries.literal: "They exchanged looks without interfering with her, her body trembling as she hid her face. Eventually, she stood up abruptly and bolted out of the room, briefly displaying her tormented expression."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina had left due to her recollection of Naomi's death. A killer was nearby and had managed to remain unseen.
entries.literal: "Erina had left due to her recollection of Naomi's death. A killer was nearby and had managed to remain unseen."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Even though she couldn't begin to take in what had happened, she understood that her life had warped into something terrible, regret her only companion. She took advantage of the last amount of strength she had within herself and used it while adrenaline still let her.
entries.literal: "Even though she couldn't begin to take in what had happened, she understood that her life had warped into something terrible, regret her only companion. She took advantage of the last amount of strength she had within herself and used it while adrenaline still let her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Frantically, she opened every door in the hallway. Then, she looked through every cabinet in case the killer had brazenly hidden in one. Her thoughts on the matter were clear, and she knew who to suspect. Katei, Atsuki, and Shiroya could've been responsible in some way.
entries.literal: "Frantically, she opened every door in the hallway. Then, she looked through every cabinet in case the killer had brazenly hidden in one. Her thoughts on the matter were clear, and she knew who to suspect. Katei, Atsuki, and Shiroya could've been responsible in some way."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, as soon as she entered the huge and overwhelming lobby, her body gave out under the full weight of her daughter's death. She wouldn't be able to find her killer, and most likely, she would never begin to understand what had happened to her.{w} Suffering from the ultimate feeling of emptiness, she slumped on a wall and slowly slid to the ground.
entries.literal: "However, as soon as she entered the huge and overwhelming lobby, her body gave out under the full weight of her daughter's death. She wouldn't be able to find her killer, and most likely, she would never begin to understand what had happened to her.{w} Suffering from the ultimate feeling of emptiness, she slumped on a wall and slowly slid to the ground."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai, Akaro, and Katei, upon noticing that the sound of Erina's movements had abruptly faded, walked to the lobby and saw her sitting on the floor ahead.
entries.literal: "Sai, Akaro, and Katei, upon noticing that the sound of Erina's movements had abruptly faded, walked to the lobby and saw her sitting on the floor ahead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They approached her slowly and remained at her side.{w} A loud noise resounded through the entire floor... and they understood what it had been.
entries.literal: "They approached her slowly and remained at her side.{w} A loud noise resounded through the entire floor... and they understood what it had been."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The cabinet's lid had fallen when nobody had been looking, sealing Isla inside while also letting her rest peacefully.
entries.literal: "The cabinet's lid had fallen when nobody had been looking, sealing Isla inside while also letting her rest peacefully."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody chose to leave the lobby. They knew that gravity, a simple law of the universe, had closed Isla's coffin by itself.{w} However, they didn't know the true consequences that sound had brought, and spent the time unaware until the hallway B door opened.
entries.literal: "Nobody chose to leave the lobby. They knew that gravity, a simple law of the universe, had closed Isla's coffin by itself.{w} However, they didn't know the true consequences that sound had brought, and spent the time unaware until the hallway B door opened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai finished summarizing what had happened, avoiding explicit words that would've hurt Erina even more. It was way too much to take in, and it revealed that we'd slept for longer than we'd thought.
entries.literal: "Sai finished summarizing what had happened, avoiding explicit words that would've hurt Erina even more. It was way too much to take in, and it revealed that we'd slept for longer than we'd thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I looked at Erina, who hadn't raised her head since we'd entered, I saw the wet stains on her lap that I'd missed before.
entries.literal: "As I looked at Erina, who hadn't raised her head since we'd entered, I saw the wet stains on her lap that I'd missed before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya looked crushed. She couldn't believe such a sudden and tragic story had unfolded while she'd slept.{w} I began to feel guilty about my recent actions, ones I'd taken in ignorance.
entries.literal: "Shiroya looked crushed. She couldn't believe such a sudden and tragic story had unfolded while she'd slept.{w} I began to feel guilty about my recent actions, ones I'd taken in ignorance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to say, so I just stood there, repelling the thought that Isla was really no longer with us.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to say, so I just stood there, repelling the thought that Isla was really no longer with us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt terrible for her and Erina, but also unimaginably pissed off. Instead of having the chance to mourn privately, Erina had to spend hours locked up with us, not understanding how or why her daughter had passed away.
entries.literal: "I felt terrible for her and Erina, but also unimaginably pissed off. Instead of having the chance to mourn privately, Erina had to spend hours locked up with us, not understanding how or why her daughter had passed away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a bad idea, but I asked it regardless, in a quiet voice.
entries.literal: "It was a bad idea, but I asked it regardless, in a quiet voice."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Can I go see?
entries.literal: "...Can I go see?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai nodded hesitantly, as it wasn't his decision. Shiroya must have been horrified at the thought of seeing Isla with her own eyes. I didn't want to see her either, but I wanted to understand what had happened more than anything. It was the least we could do.
entries.literal: "Sai nodded hesitantly, as it wasn't his decision. Shiroya must have been horrified at the thought of seeing Isla with her own eyes. I didn't want to see her either, but I wanted to understand what had happened more than anything. It was the least we could do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know how to act, only that attempting to comfort Erina was foolish. We'd told her how sorry we were as soon as Sai mentioned Isla's death, but that had been it.
entries.literal: "I didn't know how to act, only that attempting to comfort Erina was foolish. We'd told her how sorry we were as soon as Sai mentioned Isla's death, but that had been it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could move, Erina stood up and looked at us. Although she didn't have the strength to speak, she breathed while wiping her face and walked toward hallway A.
entries.literal: "Before I could move, Erina stood up and looked at us. Although she didn't have the strength to speak, she breathed while wiping her face and walked toward hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She needed to know what had occurred. Many things stood out, starting with Isla's behavior. She had gone to that cabinet by herself without explaining why, so there had to be something important there.
entries.literal: "She needed to know what had occurred. Many things stood out, starting with Isla's behavior. She had gone to that cabinet by herself without explaining why, so there had to be something important there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, her yell upon seeing its contents. Given how Erina had found the cabinet empty, it seemed possible to conclude what Isla had witnessed... And even though the Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning room, there was a chance that two existed.
