entries.literal: "Then, her yell upon seeing its contents. Given how Erina had found the cabinet empty, it seemed possible to conclude what Isla had witnessed... And even though the Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning room, there was a chance that two existed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If Isla's disappearance had been caused by the Sekimeiya, it was possible that she had seen a human body. It would have warranted the scream, and humans were all that the Sekimeiya seemed to make travel. Maybe there'd been someone in the cabinet and they'd disappeared at the same time as Isla.
entries.literal: "If Isla's disappearance had been caused by the Sekimeiya, it was possible that she had seen a human body. It would have warranted the scream, and humans were all that the Sekimeiya seemed to make travel. Maybe there'd been someone in the cabinet and they'd disappeared at the same time as Isla."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I kept in mind what Shiroya and I had just discussed. If falling into the cabinet made Isla touch what was inside, she might've traveled with it if it had become something she possessed, for lack of a better term.
entries.literal: "However, I kept in mind what Shiroya and I had just discussed. If falling into the cabinet made Isla touch what was inside, she might've traveled with it if it had become something she possessed, for lack of a better term."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And if that was what had happened, the source of the range had to have been outside the cabinet, or else the Sekimeiya would've remained inside it.{w} If the range came from the Sekimeiya in the cleaning room, Erina, by the entrance to room A5, should've traveled as well. Sai and Akaro saw Isla falling into the cabinet, so Katei, who had just disappeared, could've been who'd activated it. In that case, nobody would have noticed he'd traveled too.
entries.literal: "And if that was what had happened, the source of the range had to have been outside the cabinet, or else the Sekimeiya would've remained inside it.{w} If the range came from the Sekimeiya in the cleaning room, Erina, by the entrance to room A5, should've traveled as well. Sai and Akaro saw Isla falling into the cabinet, so Katei, who had just disappeared, could've been who'd activated it. In that case, nobody would have noticed he'd traveled too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the crystal floor had just been searched, so if Katei's range had encompassed the whole cabinet... it might have come from floor 2.{w} If the range went through solid objects and Katei was above the room, the ceiling was no obstacle.
entries.literal: "However, the crystal floor had just been searched, so if Katei's range had encompassed the whole cabinet... it might have come from floor 2.{w} If the range went through solid objects and Katei was above the room, the ceiling was no obstacle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In fact, my third travel suggested that the range could go through solid objects. The Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning cart and I'd been picked up too, so if the Sekimeiya was the nucleus of the range, the cart's walls should've prevented me from traveling.
entries.literal: "In fact, my third travel suggested that the range could go through solid objects. The Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning cart and I'd been picked up too, so if the Sekimeiya was the nucleus of the range, the cart's walls should've prevented me from traveling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After Isla's disappearance, the group searched through the whole building and didn't find Katei. If he activated the travel from floor 2, he could appear on the crystal floor, escaping the search.{w} However, it was important to note that they never found me and Shiroya, so their search wasn't perfect.{w} That theory explained Katei's and Isla's disappearances along with the lack of the Sekimeiya in the cabinet. ...Would it mean that it was all just a very unfortunate coincidence, though?
entries.literal: "After Isla's disappearance, the group searched through the whole building and didn't find Katei. If he activated the travel from floor 2, he could appear on the crystal floor, escaping the search.{w} However, it was important to note that they never found me and Shiroya, so their search wasn't perfect.{w} That theory explained Katei's and Isla's disappearances along with the lack of the Sekimeiya in the cabinet. ...Would it mean that it was all just a very unfortunate coincidence, though?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla had found something peculiar about the cabinet, and there had been something frightening inside it...
entries.literal: "Isla had found something peculiar about the cabinet, and there had been something frightening inside it..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were all in front of it. Since nobody else was going to step in, I walked forward myself.
entries.literal: "We were all in front of it. Since nobody else was going to step in, I walked forward myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was afraid and worried about how Isla would look, but I needed to find something that hinted at what had happened. I began raising the lid while everyone kept their eyes slightly diverted from me.
entries.literal: "I was afraid and worried about how Isla would look, but I needed to find something that hinted at what had happened. I began raising the lid while everyone kept their eyes slightly diverted from me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I carefully leaned it on the wall so that it wouldn't close again. Then, I finally looked inside, hoping that the dim light would prevent the sight from being too harsh.
entries.literal: "I carefully leaned it on the wall so that it wouldn't close again. Then, I finally looked inside, hoping that the dim light would prevent the sight from being too harsh."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: W-Wait...{w} This isn't what you said.
entries.literal: "W-Wait...{w} This isn't what you said."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What isn't?
entries.literal: "What isn't?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai, thinking that I'd accused him of lying, walked forward while everyone else frowned. As soon as he looked, he understood what I meant.
entries.literal: "Sai, thinking that I'd accused him of lying, walked forward while everyone else frowned. As soon as he looked, he understood what I meant."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh? I-I don't get it, why is this...?
entries.literal: "Huh? I-I don't get it, why is this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The others all got closer. They saw Isla resting face-up with her knees folded.{w} However, my own tiny wish had been denied by the Sekimeiya beside her, emitting a faint light which illuminated her more than I'd wanted.
entries.literal: "The others all got closer. They saw Isla resting face-up with her knees folded.{w} However, my own tiny wish had been denied by the Sekimeiya beside her, emitting a faint light which illuminated her more than I'd wanted."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? I-It shouldn't be here...{w} I haven't gone to the cleaning room myself, but I'm certain that when I saw her, there was nothing else here. I didn't find it appropriate to blame them for leaving the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet since Isla had disappeared, but none of us could have moved it.
entries.literal: "What? I-It shouldn't be here...{w} I haven't gone to the cleaning room myself, but I'm certain that when I saw her, there was nothing else here. I didn't find it appropriate to blame them for leaving the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet since Isla had disappeared, but none of us could have moved it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Y-Yes. I'm sure the Sekimeiya wasn't here when we left.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes. I'm sure the Sekimeiya wasn't here when we left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina, who had been the only one to refrain from looking, gave a small nod when our eyes met.
entries.literal: "Erina, who had been the only one to refrain from looking, gave a small nod when our eyes met."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There's no way it got here by itself.
entries.literal: "There's no way it got here by itself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei left the room as he gestured at us to follow. Naturally, he was going to the cleaning room, so Shiroya and I instinctively looked at each other, knowing how that would end.
entries.literal: "Katei left the room as he gestured at us to follow. Naturally, he was going to the cleaning room, so Shiroya and I instinctively looked at each other, knowing how that would end."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the...?{w} Oh, right, you said the cleaning cart disappeared after our travel.
entries.literal: "What the...?{w} Oh, right, you said the cleaning cart disappeared after our travel."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is too much. Does it simply not exist anymore?
entries.literal: "This is too much. Does it simply not exist anymore?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd hidden the Sekimeiya, but admitting it was pointless, as that had nothing to do with Isla's death and would only make us extremely suspicious. I made sure to communicate my stance on it to Shiroya by appearing to be surprised.
entries.literal: "We'd hidden the Sekimeiya, but admitting it was pointless, as that had nothing to do with Isla's death and would only make us extremely suspicious. I made sure to communicate my stance on it to Shiroya by appearing to be surprised."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not here... We left the Sekimeiya in this bucket.
entries.literal: "It's not here... We left the Sekimeiya in this bucket."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What, then? Did it teleport to Isla?
entries.literal: "What, then? Did it teleport to Isla?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Listen, Atsuki. I don't want to throw out useless accusations right now, but you understand that you and Shiroya are the only two people who could've moved it, right?
entries.literal: "Listen, Atsuki. I don't want to throw out useless accusations right now, but you understand that you and Shiroya are the only two people who could've moved it, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's not true... Someone who came from the future could've done it too.
entries.literal: "That's not true... Someone who came from the future could've done it too."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right, but assuming that didn't happen, it could only have been you two. Katei could've taken it as well, but he couldn't have left it in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "You're right, but assuming that didn't happen, it could only have been you two. Katei could've taken it as well, but he couldn't have left it in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is the first time you've seen the cleaning cart gone, right? You came to the lobby from hallway B, so did you not explore these rooms? Why did you go straight to the lobby?
entries.literal: "This is the first time you've seen the cleaning cart gone, right? You came to the lobby from hallway B, so did you not explore these rooms? Why did you go straight to the lobby?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Understand that what you've told us is that you two spent all this time asleep in the attic. Despite this, you weren't found.
entries.literal: "Understand that what you've told us is that you two spent all this time asleep in the attic. Despite this, you weren't found."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You didn't find Katei either, so you obviously didn't do a great job. And you were in a rush, so you kept yelling Isla's name while quickly looking. I bet you didn't look at the upper levels of the bedrooms, which is where we were, and since we were asleep, we didn't hear you.
entries.literal: "...You didn't find Katei either, so you obviously didn't do a great job. And you were in a rush, so you kept yelling Isla's name while quickly looking. I bet you didn't look at the upper levels of the bedrooms, which is where we were, and since we were asleep, we didn't hear you."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And yes, we found it unlikely you'd be in a crystal room, so our first instinct was to go to the event room and then to the lobby.
entries.literal: "And yes, we found it unlikely you'd be in a crystal room, so our first instinct was to go to the event room and then to the lobby."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Forgive me, but I find this hard to believe. You came from hallway B, which is unneeded for what you're saying. In fact, since you knew the Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning room, what I find most believable is that you came here straight away.
entries.literal: "Forgive me, but I find this hard to believe. You came from hallway B, which is unneeded for what you're saying. In fact, since you knew the Sekimeiya had been in the cleaning room, what I find most believable is that you came here straight away."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We didn't. We just had to go to the bathroom after sleeping, so we took hallway B afterward.
entries.literal: "We didn't. We just had to go to the bathroom after sleeping, so we took hallway B afterward."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Both of you?
entries.literal: "Both of you?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. Does that matter?
entries.literal: "Yes. Does that matter?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If I'm not misremembering, there's a corpse covering the entire floor of the men's. Did it not bother you?
entries.literal: "If I'm not misremembering, there's a corpse covering the entire floor of the men's. Did it not bother you?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Don't be stupid. I used the other one too.
entries.literal: "...{w}Don't be stupid. I used the other one too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd admittedly missed that, but Sai stopped talking, as it had started to feel very disrespectful. I wasn't sure if he was accusing us of hiding the Sekimeiya or of being involved in Isla's death. I didn't have to say it, but I'd been ready to claim that if we'd hidden it in Isla's cabinet, we would have appeared from hallway A.
entries.literal: "I'd admittedly missed that, but Sai stopped talking, as it had started to feel very disrespectful. I wasn't sure if he was accusing us of hiding the Sekimeiya or of being involved in Isla's death. I didn't have to say it, but I'd been ready to claim that if we'd hidden it in Isla's cabinet, we would have appeared from hallway A."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, no matter how, the Sekimeiya moved from here to the cabinet. I don't know why the culprit would do this.
entries.literal: "Well, no matter how, the Sekimeiya moved from here to the cabinet. I don't know why the culprit would do this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I had hidden the Sekimeiya in Naomi's locker, so it was even more confusing for us. Nobody could've put it in the cabinet, the goal seemed impossible to decipher, and there was the entire existence of another Sekimeiya to deal with.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I had hidden the Sekimeiya in Naomi's locker, so it was even more confusing for us. Nobody could've put it in the cabinet, the goal seemed impossible to decipher, and there was the entire existence of another Sekimeiya to deal with."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Something Sai had said bothered me: "the culprit".{w} He was implying that what happened to Isla was someone's fault, and one who had orchestrated everything deliberately. I wasn't so convinced about that, so we moved again to where Isla lay to determine an important fact: the cause of her death.
entries.literal: "...Something Sai had said bothered me: \"the culprit\".{w} He was implying that what happened to Isla was someone's fault, and one who had orchestrated everything deliberately. I wasn't so convinced about that, so we moved again to where Isla lay to determine an important fact: the cause of her death."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd left the lid uncovered, and as I peeked inside, I saw that the Sekimeiya was still present. It was white, and it emitted a bit of light around itself.
entries.literal: "We'd left the lid uncovered, and as I peeked inside, I saw that the Sekimeiya was still present. It was white, and it emitted a bit of light around itself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I covered my hand with my sleeve and reached in to grab it. I underestimated the depth of the cabinet, and my fingers brushed the Sekimeiya, causing it to roll and contact Isla's face.{w} Frowning, I retrieved it properly and stood up straight.
entries.literal: "I covered my hand with my sleeve and reached in to grab it. I underestimated the depth of the cabinet, and my fingers brushed the Sekimeiya, causing it to roll and contact Isla's face.{w} Frowning, I retrieved it properly and stood up straight."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Remember what we thought about Naomi? That maybe the Sekimeiya replicated her dead body...? Well, I accidentally knocked it into Isla's cheek, and given how the Sekimeiya is still white and I wasn't picked up by any range, it's unlikely anything happened.
entries.literal: "Remember what we thought about Naomi? That maybe the Sekimeiya replicated her dead body...? Well, I accidentally knocked it into Isla's cheek, and given how the Sekimeiya is still white and I wasn't picked up by any range, it's unlikely anything happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is it hot?
entries.literal: "Is it hot?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Slightly, yes.
entries.literal: "Slightly, yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Really, it was almost hot enough to hurt, but I didn't feel like indulging Sai.
entries.literal: "Really, it was almost hot enough to hurt, but I didn't feel like indulging Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since I didn't know what to do with it, I made my way to the event room and put it in the cabinet. I explored the possibility of activating it myself, but I discarded it quickly, as it was clear that we didn't truly know how it worked, and a death that seemed to have been closely tied to its mechanics had just taken place.
entries.literal: "Since I didn't know what to do with it, I made my way to the event room and put it in the cabinet. I explored the possibility of activating it myself, but I discarded it quickly, as it was clear that we didn't truly know how it worked, and a death that seemed to have been closely tied to its mechanics had just taken place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Going back, I met Katei in the hallway.
entries.literal: "Going back, I met Katei in the hallway."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I went to grab this from the security room. It's a little flashlight I use to move around this floor when the lights are off. It should be helpful.
entries.literal: "I went to grab this from the security room. It's a little flashlight I use to move around this floor when the lights are off. It should be helpful."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. It will.
entries.literal: "I see. It will."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I returned, I showed the light to Erina, letting her know that it'd help us examine Isla and the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Once I returned, I showed the light to Erina, letting her know that it'd help us examine Isla and the cabinet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Erina, are you okay with this? If you prefer, we can wait until the police investigate. I... do want to see if there's anything to find and learn what happened, but I understand if you want us to hold off.
entries.literal: "...Erina, are you okay with this? If you prefer, we can wait until the police investigate. I... do want to see if there's anything to find and learn what happened, but I understand if you want us to hold off."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...No. Go... Go ahead.
entries.literal: "...No. Go... Go ahead."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.literal: "...Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If nothing else, it was good to see that she didn't strongly suspect us of being responsible even though it seemed that only Shiroya and I could've had the chance to move the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "If nothing else, it was good to see that she didn't strongly suspect us of being responsible even though it seemed that only Shiroya and I could've had the chance to move the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Based on the story that Sai told us, it should've also been possible for Sai, Akaro, and Katei to be working together and put the Sekimeiya there themselves, but I considered it far from likely.
entries.literal: "Based on the story that Sai told us, it should've also been possible for Sai, Akaro, and Katei to be working together and put the Sekimeiya there themselves, but I considered it far from likely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped forward again. My intention was not to touch Isla directly, and even though I'd appreciated the lack of proper illumination earlier, I was about to use a light myself. It made me uneasy, but the darkness could easily obscure something vital.
entries.literal: "I stepped forward again. My intention was not to touch Isla directly, and even though I'd appreciated the lack of proper illumination earlier, I was about to use a light myself. It made me uneasy, but the darkness could easily obscure something vital."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I turned it on, the flashlight proved to be potent. I illuminated the entire room, and for the first time, we clearly saw what the walls and ceiling looked like. They could almost be called disfigured, but nothing else stood out.
entries.literal: "As soon as I turned it on, the flashlight proved to be potent. I illuminated the entire room, and for the first time, we clearly saw what the walls and ceiling looked like. They could almost be called disfigured, but nothing else stood out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to the cabinet, and aside from Erina, who remained by the door, the rest got closer too.
entries.literal: "I moved to the cabinet, and aside from Erina, who remained by the door, the rest got closer too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could clearly see Isla's hauntingly peaceful face. It was overwhelming, and for an instant, I thought I'd suddenly wake back up in the attic.
entries.literal: "I could clearly see Isla's hauntingly peaceful face. It was overwhelming, and for an instant, I thought I'd suddenly wake back up in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, apart from that, the result wasn't what I expected. The cabinet wasn't concealing anything from us. In fact, the interior was exactly as it appeared. Not a single drop of blood had stained it, and there was no hint toward the way Isla lost her life.
entries.literal: "However, apart from that, the result wasn't what I expected. The cabinet wasn't concealing anything from us. In fact, the interior was exactly as it appeared. Not a single drop of blood had stained it, and there was no hint toward the way Isla lost her life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For the first time, and with a slight frown, I reached my hand out to touch her.{w} However, any doubts I had were wiped away by contacting her lifeless skin. Even though nothing indicated how it had happened, Isla was not alive.
entries.literal: "For the first time, and with a slight frown, I reached my hand out to touch her.{w} However, any doubts I had were wiped away by contacting her lifeless skin. Even though nothing indicated how it had happened, Isla was not alive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How had the leap from life to death happened? I had no good guess.{w} I spoke in a faint voice so that Erina wouldn't hear me. Two weeks prior, a death had destroyed my life, but that was almost minuscule compared to how Erina must have felt. If I had any answers for her, they needed to be certain.
entries.literal: "How had the leap from life to death happened? I had no good guess.{w} I spoke in a faint voice so that Erina wouldn't hear me. Two weeks prior, a death had destroyed my life, but that was almost minuscule compared to how Erina must have felt. If I had any answers for her, they needed to be certain."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can't know what happened to her just by looking, but there's no blood at all. It reminds me a bit of the second Naomi.
entries.literal: "I can't know what happened to her just by looking, but there's no blood at all. It reminds me a bit of the second Naomi."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So physical damage wasn't the cause, unless brain damage from a blow didn't leave a wound. It could've been poisoning.
entries.literal: "So physical damage wasn't the cause, unless brain damage from a blow didn't leave a wound. It could've been poisoning."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You think someone had the chance to poison her in a situation like this?
entries.literal: "You think someone had the chance to poison her in a situation like this?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm just keeping my options open.
entries.literal: "I'm just keeping my options open."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know.{w} If someone did this to her, sure, but in terms of natural deaths, not many things would apply. Children don't really have their hearts suddenly fail very often.
entries.literal: "I don't know.{w} If someone did this to her, sure, but in terms of natural deaths, not many things would apply. Children don't really have their hearts suddenly fail very often."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was involved in some way, so we have to think about more out of the ordinary causes.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was involved in some way, so we have to think about more out of the ordinary causes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. ...What if traveling is what caused this to begin with? When she disappeared, she traveled through time and appeared somewhere else. If she couldn't have existed at that point, it's possible she appeared in this state.{w} Even though she reminds me of the second Naomi, that body had a head wound. ...I can't see any such thing here, though.
entries.literal: "Yeah. ...What if traveling is what caused this to begin with? When she disappeared, she traveled through time and appeared somewhere else. If she couldn't have existed at that point, it's possible she appeared in this state.{w} Even though she reminds me of the second Naomi, that body had a head wound. ...I can't see any such thing here, though."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What else would leave her in this state? Starvation, for example?
entries.literal: "What else would leave her in this state? Starvation, for example?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well... she would have died of dehydration before starvation, and that has effects on the skin.
entries.literal: "Well... she would have died of dehydration before starvation, and that has effects on the skin."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gently pinched Isla's cheek, lightly pulled it, and then released it.
entries.literal: "I gently pinched Isla's cheek, lightly pulled it, and then released it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If someone is dehydrated, their skin isn't very elastic. I don't see anything indicating it here. It looks normal. Also, she'd have to have spent a pretty long time in here. Definitely more than a day.
entries.literal: "If someone is dehydrated, their skin isn't very elastic. I don't see anything indicating it here. It looks normal. Also, she'd have to have spent a pretty long time in here. Definitely more than a day."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What about asphyxiation?
entries.literal: "What about asphyxiation?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Someone could easily do that since she's a kid... but there are no marks on her neck.
entries.literal: "Someone could easily do that since she's a kid... but there are no marks on her neck."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Uh, I meant... asphyxiation within the cabinet. It doesn't seem very large, so could that have happened?
entries.literal: "Uh, I meant... asphyxiation within the cabinet. It doesn't seem very large, so could that have happened?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I doubt it. It's true that something was up with this cabinet, but that'd require her to spend a long time inside, and there's no reason why she wouldn't have gotten out. That would take a lot less time than dehydration, but it's still considerable.{w} Let's say that she couldn't escape, though. The way she'd die would be from carbon dioxide intoxication, not from lack of oxygen. Even in a small space like this, I think it'd take six or seven hours. Maybe even more since a child would breathe less.
entries.literal: "...{w}I doubt it. It's true that something was up with this cabinet, but that'd require her to spend a long time inside, and there's no reason why she wouldn't have gotten out. That would take a lot less time than dehydration, but it's still considerable.{w} Let's say that she couldn't escape, though. The way she'd die would be from carbon dioxide intoxication, not from lack of oxygen. Even in a small space like this, I think it'd take six or seven hours. Maybe even more since a child would breathe less."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was far less than seven hours ago when we last looked through this room and these cabinets.
entries.literal: "It was far less than seven hours ago when we last looked through this room and these cabinets."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right. The way this happened, we can't tell if it was a homicide or an accident caused by the Sekimeiya. She most likely traveled to the past, but even if she spent that time in the cabinet, it wouldn't have been enough to kill her. And since Erina wasn't picked up by the travel, it's likely she didn't go very far back.
entries.literal: "Right. The way this happened, we can't tell if it was a homicide or an accident caused by the Sekimeiya. She most likely traveled to the past, but even if she spent that time in the cabinet, it wouldn't have been enough to kill her. And since Erina wasn't picked up by the travel, it's likely she didn't go very far back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was another reason why I believed something like that might've happened, and it was Isla's yell. If she'd traveled to the past and spent time in the cabinet, it meant that Isla screamed because she saw her own body.{w} However, that same travel would've made two bodies travel back, multiplying the number every time. That couldn't be right, and it also meant that the body she saw was alive.
entries.literal: "There was another reason why I believed something like that might've happened, and it was Isla's yell. If she'd traveled to the past and spent time in the cabinet, it meant that Isla screamed because she saw her own body.{w} However, that same travel would've made two bodies travel back, multiplying the number every time. That couldn't be right, and it also meant that the body she saw was alive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}What I'd just said replayed in my mind: probably six or seven hours would've been needed for her to suffocate inside the cabinet. That time could be cut in half if two Islas had been in the cabinet, breathing twice as much air...
entries.literal: "...{w}What I'd just said replayed in my mind: probably six or seven hours would've been needed for her to suffocate inside the cabinet. That time could be cut in half if two Islas had been in the cabinet, breathing twice as much air..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, if that was completely off the mark, there was no other possibility except a bizarre homicide, which was one of the most unnerving thoughts that could come to me.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, if that was completely off the mark, there was no other possibility except a bizarre homicide, which was one of the most unnerving thoughts that could come to me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I still have no idea why the Sekimeiya appeared here. You're sure it wasn't here before you left, right?
entries.literal: "I still have no idea why the Sekimeiya appeared here. You're sure it wasn't here before you left, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes, we checked around her.
entries.literal: "Yes, we checked around her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then something else happened that put it here. If someone brought it deliberately, it was the culprit, who needed it for whatever happened. If not, then it means that the Sekimeiya can teleport on its own.
entries.literal: "Then something else happened that put it here. If someone brought it deliberately, it was the culprit, who needed it for whatever happened. If not, then it means that the Sekimeiya can teleport on its own."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe that's why we didn't find it when Isla disappeared. The Sekimeiya she traveled with also teleported.
entries.literal: "Maybe that's why we didn't find it when Isla disappeared. The Sekimeiya she traveled with also teleported."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes... but if that's it, it would've appeared with Isla's body, not later.
entries.literal: "Yes... but if that's it, it would've appeared with Isla's body, not later."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We continued looking at her face, slight traces of pain present behind its seeming serenity. A few hot tears stung the corners of my eyes. The peaceful appearance she had was a cruel joke, nothing more.
entries.literal: "We continued looking at her face, slight traces of pain present behind its seeming serenity. A few hot tears stung the corners of my eyes. The peaceful appearance she had was a cruel joke, nothing more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although I kept trying to reach a conclusion, everything was too broad and nebulous to definitely conclude anything. At my side, Shiroya hadn't taken her eyes off Isla, and she hadn't spoken in a while.
entries.literal: "Although I kept trying to reach a conclusion, everything was too broad and nebulous to definitely conclude anything. At my side, Shiroya hadn't taken her eyes off Isla, and she hadn't spoken in a while."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, we turned around. Erina was by the door, looking at the ground. I couldn't imagine what her thoughts were, but we let her know the gist of what we'd determined.
entries.literal: "Eventually, we turned around. Erina was by the door, looking at the ground. I couldn't imagine what her thoughts were, but we let her know the gist of what we'd determined."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She accepted what we said with almost imperceptible nods. We didn't know what else to do, but as we were about to leave, she stepped into the room and walked up to Isla again.
entries.literal: "She accepted what we said with almost imperceptible nods. We didn't know what else to do, but as we were about to leave, she stepped into the room and walked up to Isla again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure why until I saw her staring inside and crying again. ...We silently watched her, understanding how excruciating the sight was but that she still had to look.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure why until I saw her staring inside and crying again. ...We silently watched her, understanding how excruciating the sight was but that she still had to look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When she was ready, she stood up straight and approached us. We had only known her for a few hours, but I felt the most sincere pity for her.
entries.literal: "When she was ready, she stood up straight and approached us. We had only known her for a few hours, but I felt the most sincere pity for her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Excluding Naomi, Isla was the second death I'd had to directly face. If the past two weeks hadn't drained me like they had, I probably would've been unable to control my emotions.
entries.literal: "Excluding Naomi, Isla was the second death I'd had to directly face. If the past two weeks hadn't drained me like they had, I probably would've been unable to control my emotions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled the recording that told us Isla would be alive in a month. How to treat it, I had no idea, but it had ironically become a last hope.{w} Could the Sekimeiya have the power to bring a person back to life? It wasn't that crazy of a thought depending on how it worked, so the recording coming true at the cost of spending a month in the tower was the best-case scenario.
entries.literal: "I recalled the recording that told us Isla would be alive in a month. How to treat it, I had no idea, but it had ironically become a last hope.{w} Could the Sekimeiya have the power to bring a person back to life? It wasn't that crazy of a thought depending on how it worked, so the recording coming true at the cost of spending a month in the tower was the best-case scenario."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If one thing was certain, it was that some kind of plan existed behind it. Out of everyone there, the recorder had appeared inside Isla's purse. Not only that, the audio on it was downright bizarre. In a few hours, at {time=21}, we'd have a much better understanding of its veracity. Although we hadn't checked, it was very likely within that mysterious cabinet, still inside Isla's purse.
entries.literal: "If one thing was certain, it was that some kind of plan existed behind it. Out of everyone there, the recorder had appeared inside Isla's purse. Not only that, the audio on it was downright bizarre. In a few hours, at {time=21}, we'd have a much better understanding of its veracity. Although we hadn't checked, it was very likely within that mysterious cabinet, still inside Isla's purse."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After giving the flashlight back to Katei, he brought it to the security room. Once again, we moved to the lobby due to its proximity to the outside world and how spacious it was.{w} Shiroya, Katei, and I sat on the couch. There were chairs next to the reception desk, but everyone else chose to sit on the floor in silence, leaning against a wall.{w} Every speck of motivation within me had been crushed. While I wanted to know what was going on even more, I only had the energy to think to myself.
entries.literal: "After giving the flashlight back to Katei, he brought it to the security room. Once again, we moved to the lobby due to its proximity to the outside world and how spacious it was.{w} Shiroya, Katei, and I sat on the couch. There were chairs next to the reception desk, but everyone else chose to sit on the floor in silence, leaning against a wall.{w} Every speck of motivation within me had been crushed. While I wanted to know what was going on even more, I only had the energy to think to myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was almost sure that two Sekimeiya existed and that one had been the source of Isla's death. I still held the key to the other one.
entries.literal: "I was almost sure that two Sekimeiya existed and that one had been the source of Isla's death. I still held the key to the other one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My intent was to eventually check on the Sekimeiya that we had, so I had to eventually decide what to do regarding that.{w} We were all sitting down, letting the time pass and waiting for our release. If I didn't do anything, it was possible the police would find the key on me, giving away that I'd been the one to hide the Sekimeiya. I would have to discard it before it was too late.
entries.literal: "My intent was to eventually check on the Sekimeiya that we had, so I had to eventually decide what to do regarding that.{w} We were all sitting down, letting the time pass and waiting for our release. If I didn't do anything, it was possible the police would find the key on me, giving away that I'd been the one to hide the Sekimeiya. I would have to discard it before it was too late."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see Shiroya next to me, staring at the tiles. She'd still been trying to accept Miiya's death, Naomi's had surely made things worse, and Isla, who had taken a liking to Shiroya fairly quickly, was gone too. The best thing I could do for her was let her process it.
entries.literal: "I could see Shiroya next to me, staring at the tiles. She'd still been trying to accept Miiya's death, Naomi's had surely made things worse, and Isla, who had taken a liking to Shiroya fairly quickly, was gone too. The best thing I could do for her was let her process it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unlike two weeks ago, we'd seen Isla's dead body, meaning that using the Sekimeiya to prevent her death was almost certainly impossible. Despite that, it would probably still be useful to understand what had happened if we used it to go to the past.
entries.literal: "Unlike two weeks ago, we'd seen Isla's dead body, meaning that using the Sekimeiya to prevent her death was almost certainly impossible. Despite that, it would probably still be useful to understand what had happened if we used it to go to the past."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Can the past be changed? There are many different ways the universe could work.
entries.literal: "Can the past be changed? There are many different ways the universe could work."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Upon traveling, would the timeline we live in change instantly? If so, the person who traveled would be the only one aware of the change, and everyone else would only have memories of the new timeline.
entries.literal: "Upon traveling, would the timeline we live in change instantly? If so, the person who traveled would be the only one aware of the change, and everyone else would only have memories of the new timeline."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Another way would be that once you travel and change the past, a new flow of time is created with that change. In this case, the original world would continue without being affected, and the person who had traveled would stop existing in it altogether.
entries.literal: "Another way would be that once you travel and change the past, a new flow of time is created with that change. In this case, the original world would continue without being affected, and the person who had traveled would stop existing in it altogether."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But it doesn't seem like the Sekimeiya allows for either one. We travel to the past, to the very same timeline, and don't change anything. Yet, the travels do allow for occurrences to happen that we've already experienced before traveling.
entries.literal: "But it doesn't seem like the Sekimeiya allows for either one. We travel to the past, to the very same timeline, and don't change anything. Yet, the travels do allow for occurrences to happen that we've already experienced before traveling."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's impossible to feel sure about this, but hours ago, I tried to save Naomi. As soon as I became determined to change the past, and just when it seemed possible, the universe put a barrier in front of me and made everything occur as it had.{w} Even though it might have already been too late to save Naomi when I ran to the bathroom, I had already decided not to let her killer escape. Even that was seamlessly denied.
entries.literal: "It's impossible to feel sure about this, but hours ago, I tried to save Naomi. As soon as I became determined to change the past, and just when it seemed possible, the universe put a barrier in front of me and made everything occur as it had.{w} Even though it might have already been too late to save Naomi when I ran to the bathroom, I had already decided not to let her killer escape. Even that was seamlessly denied."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd kept the Sekimeiya we last traveled with inside Naomi's locker. If we were right about it sending us farther back in time the longer it wasn't cold, we might've been able to use it to go more than two weeks into the past.
entries.literal: "We'd kept the Sekimeiya we last traveled with inside Naomi's locker. If we were right about it sending us farther back in time the longer it wasn't cold, we might've been able to use it to go more than two weeks into the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew nothing good would come from that, but at least seeing Miiya again was a vague possibility.{w} However, the Sekimeiya hadn't appeared to work when we hid it, so we simply had to hope it would start working again before doing anything. ...To go back far enough, the time traveled couldn't be less than or equal to the time stored, but I didn't think was the case.
entries.literal: "I knew nothing good would come from that, but at least seeing Miiya again was a vague possibility.{w} However, the Sekimeiya hadn't appeared to work when we hid it, so we simply had to hope it would start working again before doing anything. ...To go back far enough, the time traveled couldn't be less than or equal to the time stored, but I didn't think was the case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...If keeping the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet for twenty minutes resulted in a twenty-minute travel, we couldn't go so far back. But if a minute stored resulted in a thirty-minute travel, it could become possible, although it wouldn't correspond to my three travels.
entries.literal: "...If keeping the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet for twenty minutes resulted in a twenty-minute travel, we couldn't go so far back. But if a minute stored resulted in a thirty-minute travel, it could become possible, although it wouldn't correspond to my three travels."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about something.{w} Why had the Sekimeiya not worked when we stored it in the locker? Could the universe have prevented it from working? What if, after traveling, we would've been guaranteed to change what had already occurred? Maybe the Sekimeiya would disallow any travel that was going to lead into an impossibility.
entries.literal: "I thought about something.{w} Why had the Sekimeiya not worked when we stored it in the locker? Could the universe have prevented it from working? What if, after traveling, we would've been guaranteed to change what had already occurred? Maybe the Sekimeiya would disallow any travel that was going to lead into an impossibility."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once more, a thought led me back to the recorder that informed us we'd spend my and Shiroya's birthdays in the tower. If it came true, we could possibly store the Sekimeiya for thirty days, granting what would surely be a massive travel. We'd found the recorder in our present, so a clear implication was that someone had traveled from the future to bring it to us.
entries.literal: "Once more, a thought led me back to the recorder that informed us we'd spend my and Shiroya's birthdays in the tower. If it came true, we could possibly store the Sekimeiya for thirty days, granting what would surely be a massive travel. We'd found the recorder in our present, so a clear implication was that someone had traveled from the future to bring it to us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had appeared inside Isla's purse, but she couldn't have been the one to bring it back since she was dead. Yet somehow, it also seemed to prove that she would be alive in a month, and to top it off, the recorded voices of Sai and Akaro had sounded particularly surprised to see her.
entries.literal: "It had appeared inside Isla's purse, but she couldn't have been the one to bring it back since she was dead. Yet somehow, it also seemed to prove that she would be alive in a month, and to top it off, the recorded voices of Sai and Akaro had sounded particularly surprised to see her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got a bit dizzy. Just what was the reality of it all? It had to be related to Isla's mysterious friend.
entries.literal: "I got a bit dizzy. Just what was the reality of it all? It had to be related to Isla's mysterious friend."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Someone in that silent room with me could have had the intention to trap us for an entire month. Potentially so that they could achieve a very far travel.{w} As I thought about it, I cemented more and more how important it was to fully understand the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...Someone in that silent room with me could have had the intention to trap us for an entire month. Potentially so that they could achieve a very far travel.{w} As I thought about it, I cemented more and more how important it was to fully understand the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While the person responsible had to be around us, it was possible they hadn't thought of it yet. Since Erina and Shiroya had heard the recording, I found it unlikely either of them would be the one to eventually cause that outcome. If they did, their idea of staying for one more month would've originally come from hearing the recording, just like how I'd thought of some of its benefits only because the idea had been presented to me. A causal loop like that, generating an idea from nothing, still sounded irrational to me.
entries.literal: "While the person responsible had to be around us, it was possible they hadn't thought of it yet. Since Erina and Shiroya had heard the recording, I found it unlikely either of them would be the one to eventually cause that outcome. If they did, their idea of staying for one more month would've originally come from hearing the recording, just like how I'd thought of some of its benefits only because the idea had been presented to me. A causal loop like that, generating an idea from nothing, still sounded irrational to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was the one who first presented the draft of a theory I was using—that the time the Sekimeiya spent outside of its cabinet was what determined the amount of time traveled.{w} If that was the fundamental motive of our extended imprisonment, Sai was the best candidate to suspect. He had never listened to the audio. However, that same recording also made it sound as if we'd been abandoned by the world outside, so it was potentially foolish to blame someone in the building instead.
entries.literal: "Sai was the one who first presented the draft of a theory I was using—that the time the Sekimeiya spent outside of its cabinet was what determined the amount of time traveled.{w} If that was the fundamental motive of our extended imprisonment, Sai was the best candidate to suspect. He had never listened to the audio. However, that same recording also made it sound as if we'd been abandoned by the world outside, so it was potentially foolish to blame someone in the building instead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But the reality was that we were most likely still sharing space with a murderer who had killed anywhere from one to three times. The death of the second Naomi had almost certainly been a normal homicide, but I wasn't sure if the case was the same with Isla.{w} The culprit's actions had been linked to the Sekimeiya from the beginning, and they had managed to escape us so far. It was strange how they'd known about the Sekimeiya's powers straight away, and it had begun to seem like they were from the far future.
entries.literal: "But the reality was that we were most likely still sharing space with a murderer who had killed anywhere from one to three times. The death of the second Naomi had almost certainly been a normal homicide, but I wasn't sure if the case was the same with Isla.{w} The culprit's actions had been linked to the Sekimeiya from the beginning, and they had managed to escape us so far. It was strange how they'd known about the Sekimeiya's powers straight away, and it had begun to seem like they were from the far future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...We could all easily have been in the middle of their process.{w} All of us had learned about the Sekimeiya's powers. Then, someone decided to trap us for an entire month and would actually accomplish it somehow.{w} In the future, once the required time passed, they would travel back and exist at the start of the day's events with a full understanding of the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...We could all easily have been in the middle of their process.{w} All of us had learned about the Sekimeiya's powers. Then, someone decided to trap us for an entire month and would actually accomplish it somehow.{w} In the future, once the required time passed, they would travel back and exist at the start of the day's events with a full understanding of the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They would cause what they'd once seen, which meant that at that moment, a future version of one of us existed somewhere. It was a bit paradoxical too, but depending on how they would replicate the events they'd experienced, it might've made sense.{w} It was like the first time I'd traveled to the past, when Shiroya hadn't realized that I was from the future.{w} What if we had already found the culprit in one of our searches but didn't realize it? Could they have impersonated their past self at some point?
entries.literal: "They would cause what they'd once seen, which meant that at that moment, a future version of one of us existed somewhere. It was a bit paradoxical too, but depending on how they would replicate the events they'd experienced, it might've made sense.{w} It was like the first time I'd traveled to the past, when Shiroya hadn't realized that I was from the future.{w} What if we had already found the culprit in one of our searches but didn't realize it? Could they have impersonated their past self at some point?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I might've been completely off, and without the recording's existence, my thoughts would've been vastly different. If it had been faked in order to mislead us, it had proven to be very effective.
entries.literal: "I might've been completely off, and without the recording's existence, my thoughts would've been vastly different. If it had been faked in order to mislead us, it had proven to be very effective."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If we had to trust it, the fact that the person who traveled brought the voice recorder with them was still crucial. They surely had a solid reason to do that, one I wanted to believe they'd come up with independently. Not just "because they previously experienced the reality in which the voice recorder was brought back to the past".
entries.literal: "If we had to trust it, the fact that the person who traveled brought the voice recorder with them was still crucial. They surely had a solid reason to do that, one I wanted to believe they'd come up with independently. Not just \"because they previously experienced the reality in which the voice recorder was brought back to the past\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We wouldn't have food to survive, and there was no way Ashiya and the police would abandon us. However, if the recording we'd heard would truly occur in the future, there was one last thing I had to consider.
entries.literal: "We wouldn't have food to survive, and there was no way Ashiya and the police would abandon us. However, if the recording we'd heard would truly occur in the future, there was one last thing I had to consider."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I believed that, somehow, it would be one of us who would trap everyone inside the tower for longer than we expected. While it sounded impossible, we possessed the Sekimeiya, which had powers we didn't know the extent of. It was likely that keeping the tower shut would be even harder from the outside.
entries.literal: "I believed that, somehow, it would be one of us who would trap everyone inside the tower for longer than we expected. While it sounded impossible, we possessed the Sekimeiya, which had powers we didn't know the extent of. It was likely that keeping the tower shut would be even harder from the outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Inside, we had access to the computer that managed the security system—altering the alarm's functions was well in reach.{w} It wasn't that simple, though. Even if one of us permanently locked the exit, the outside would have to get us out in less than a month, as it would become a life or death situation.
entries.literal: "Inside, we had access to the computer that managed the security system—altering the alarm's functions was well in reach.{w} It wasn't that simple, though. Even if one of us permanently locked the exit, the outside would have to get us out in less than a month, as it would become a life or death situation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They had said that blowing off the shutters wasn't viable, but there had to be something they could do if it came down to it. An underground passage, for example; there was no way shutters alone would keep us trapped for a month.{w} And regarding the motive, I didn't think I was being unrealistic. It might've been to use the Sekimeiya in a specific way, and I couldn't think of anything else. That would confirm that the time traveled wasn't determined with a 1:1 ratio.
entries.literal: "They had said that blowing off the shutters wasn't viable, but there had to be something they could do if it came down to it. An underground passage, for example; there was no way shutters alone would keep us trapped for a month.{w} And regarding the motive, I didn't think I was being unrealistic. It might've been to use the Sekimeiya in a specific way, and I couldn't think of anything else. That would confirm that the time traveled wasn't determined with a 1:1 ratio."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If ten stored minutes resulted in a travel of ten minutes, storing more time, or up to a month, would be useless. No matter how much time the Sekimeiya spent outside of its cabinet, activating it would always send you to the point where time had begun to be stored.
entries.literal: "If ten stored minutes resulted in a travel of ten minutes, storing more time, or up to a month, would be useless. No matter how much time the Sekimeiya spent outside of its cabinet, activating it would always send you to the point where time had begun to be stored."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I thought of that, I came to a pretty unsettling realization.{w} If that was the motive of someone's grand plan, the Sekimeiya would have stored a great deal of time after a month—at least one month back, probably more. We'd reached the conclusions that the range was likely proportional to the time traveled and that it most likely went through solid objects.
entries.literal: "When I thought of that, I came to a pretty unsettling realization.{w} If that was the motive of someone's grand plan, the Sekimeiya would have stored a great deal of time after a month—at least one month back, probably more. We'd reached the conclusions that the range was likely proportional to the time traveled and that it most likely went through solid objects."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If the range of a forty-minute travel had equaled a sizable room, a thirty-day range would surely reach far outside the tower. That would encompass many people outside, and they'd be sent back alongside the culprit who activated the Sekimeiya. Of course, there hadn't been any reports of a bunch of people suddenly arriving from the future.
entries.literal: "If the range of a forty-minute travel had equaled a sizable room, a thirty-day range would surely reach far outside the tower. That would encompass many people outside, and they'd be sent back alongside the culprit who activated the Sekimeiya. Of course, there hadn't been any reports of a bunch of people suddenly arriving from the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The minutes continued to pass, and the mutual silence remained broken.{w} I went back over everything I'd considered, but ultimately, we would have to wait to decide further on any theory. At the very least, considering all those options would prepare me for whatever would end up happening.
entries.literal: "The minutes continued to pass, and the mutual silence remained broken.{w} I went back over everything I'd considered, but ultimately, we would have to wait to decide further on any theory. At the very least, considering all those options would prepare me for whatever would end up happening."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't reach any conclusion. Everything that came to mind, I had already thought of.
entries.literal: "I didn't reach any conclusion. Everything that came to mind, I had already thought of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Waiting like that only slowed our perception of time, but there was nothing else we could do. Shiroya kept looking at her lap, breathing deeply every so often. Erina hadn't moved in a long time, and her knees hid her face from us. Sai's, Akaro's, and Katei's expressions alternated between concern and thought, and they rarely lifted their heads.
entries.literal: "Waiting like that only slowed our perception of time, but there was nothing else we could do. Shiroya kept looking at her lap, breathing deeply every so often. Erina hadn't moved in a long time, and her knees hid her face from us. Sai's, Akaro's, and Katei's expressions alternated between concern and thought, and they rarely lifted their heads."

entries.text: 30 Minutes Later
entries.literal: "30 Minutes Later"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We remained frozen like that for a long time, during which we all must've been thinking about Isla, Naomi, the Sekimeiya, and the culprit behind it all.{w} The sound that resumed time's march came from one of us. We turned our blank faces and saw Katei standing up, stretching his arms a little.
entries.literal: "We remained frozen like that for a long time, during which we all must've been thinking about Isla, Naomi, the Sekimeiya, and the culprit behind it all.{w} The sound that resumed time's march came from one of us. We turned our blank faces and saw Katei standing up, stretching his arms a little."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm going to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "I'm going to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a faint but hoarse voice, showing that he hadn't cleared his throat in a while, he let us know his destination. Nobody responded to him, so he left through hallway A.
entries.literal: "With a faint but hoarse voice, showing that he hadn't cleared his throat in a while, he let us know his destination. Nobody responded to him, so he left through hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We turned our eyes back down as if nothing had happened. What he'd just done was easy to label as suspicious behavior, but nobody said anything.
entries.literal: "We turned our eyes back down as if nothing had happened. What he'd just done was easy to label as suspicious behavior, but nobody said anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was in its unlocked cabinet. However, it was kept cold, and Shiroya and I were in possession of the other one. Katei wouldn't be able to activate it and go substantially back into the past. All he could do was move it, leaving himself as the only suspect.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was in its unlocked cabinet. However, it was kept cold, and Shiroya and I were in possession of the other one. Katei wouldn't be able to activate it and go substantially back into the past. All he could do was move it, leaving himself as the only suspect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At least, that was what I thought until another sound reached our ears.
entries.literal: "At least, that was what I thought until another sound reached our ears."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'll go too. It's been a while...
entries.literal: "I'll go too. It's been a while..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without paying attention to our reactions, Sai stood up and left through hallway B, which he'd been closer to. All of a sudden, the two most questionable people had gone off on their own, and they'd closed both doors behind them.
entries.literal: "Without paying attention to our reactions, Sai stood up and left through hallway B, which he'd been closer to. All of a sudden, the two most questionable people had gone off on their own, and they'd closed both doors behind them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It didn't change what I thought: they couldn't go back to the past.{w} Shiroya and I looked at each other, but we decided to ignore them and wait.
entries.literal: "...It didn't change what I thought: they couldn't go back to the past.{w} Shiroya and I looked at each other, but we decided to ignore them and wait."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a little strange that Sai had left right after Katei. Perhaps he was still wary of him and wanted to see what he'd gone to do.{w} I thought further on it: was the possibility of one of them going considerably back to the past truly something I could rule out?{w} If everything was as we thought, yes. I'd personally put the Sekimeiya in its cabinet, and at that moment, I felt the cold temperature. After that, nobody had entered the room. It wouldn't have been possible for anyone to unplug the cabinet or take the Sekimeiya out later...
entries.literal: "It was a little strange that Sai had left right after Katei. Perhaps he was still wary of him and wanted to see what he'd gone to do.{w} I thought further on it: was the possibility of one of them going considerably back to the past truly something I could rule out?{w} If everything was as we thought, yes. I'd personally put the Sekimeiya in its cabinet, and at that moment, I felt the cold temperature. After that, nobody had entered the room. It wouldn't have been possible for anyone to unplug the cabinet or take the Sekimeiya out later..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We remained on the floor, waiting for Katei and Sai to come back as we kept every thought to ourselves. The atmosphere had suddenly become a lot more uneasy as soon as one of us departed.{w} Akaro kept looking at the door Katei had disappeared through, visibly doubting him. Erina, on the other hand, hadn't reacted to Sai's movements in the slightest.
entries.literal: "We remained on the floor, waiting for Katei and Sai to come back as we kept every thought to ourselves. The atmosphere had suddenly become a lot more uneasy as soon as one of us departed.{w} Akaro kept looking at the door Katei had disappeared through, visibly doubting him. Erina, on the other hand, hadn't reacted to Sai's movements in the slightest."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two minutes passed without either of them returning. It was nothing alarming, but every second dragged on. I expected Katei to come back first, so as I watched the hallway A door, I considered how odd it was that he'd left through it.
entries.literal: "Two minutes passed without either of them returning. It was nothing alarming, but every second dragged on. I expected Katei to come back first, so as I watched the hallway A door, I considered how odd it was that he'd left through it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After more than five minutes, I began to worry. I'd chosen not to pointlessly voice my suspicions because of Isla's death, but Sai and Katei might've purposely abused that.
entries.literal: "After more than five minutes, I began to worry. I'd chosen not to pointlessly voice my suspicions because of Isla's death, but Sai and Katei might've purposely abused that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'll see if I can find them.
entries.literal: "I'll see if I can find them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up and directed myself toward hallway B. I didn't want to be the third person to leave suspiciously, so I only intended to check if I could see anyone next to the bathrooms.
entries.literal: "I stood up and directed myself toward hallway B. I didn't want to be the third person to leave suspiciously, so I only intended to check if I could see anyone next to the bathrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could reach the doorknob, the opposite door opened. From behind it came Katei, who quickly saw me and gave me a conspicuous frown.
entries.literal: "Before I could reach the doorknob, the opposite door opened. From behind it came Katei, who quickly saw me and gave me a conspicuous frown."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Where are you going?
entries.literal: "Where are you going?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...To see if I could find you and Sai. Why did you take so long?
entries.literal: "...To see if I could find you and Sai. Why did you take so long?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I went to the bathroom, so that's not a very appropriate question. ...Did Sai go to find me too?
entries.literal: "I went to the bathroom, so that's not a very appropriate question. ...Did Sai go to find me too?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, he said he'd also go to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "No, he said he'd also go to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you not see him? Also, forgive me for all these questions, but why did you leave and come back from hallway A if you went to the bathroom?
entries.literal: "Did you not see him? Also, forgive me for all these questions, but why did you leave and come back from hallway A if you went to the bathroom?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Atsuki, do you not remember what's in the bathroom on this floor? I could have chosen to go to the women's, but I went to the one on floor 2 instead. That's likely why I didn't see Sai.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, do you not remember what's in the bathroom on this floor? I could have chosen to go to the women's, but I went to the one on floor 2 instead. That's likely why I didn't see Sai."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm... All right.
entries.literal: "Hm... All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps I'd jumped the gun too quickly, even though Sai's long absence was still on my mind. He'd gone to a different bathroom, so he hadn't had to wait for it to become available.
entries.literal: "Perhaps I'd jumped the gun too quickly, even though Sai's long absence was still on my mind. He'd gone to a different bathroom, so he hadn't had to wait for it to become available."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I resumed what I was doing and opened the hallway B door. I saw it devoid of anyone and with every door closed, including the bathrooms in the distance.
entries.literal: "I resumed what I was doing and opened the hallway B door. I saw it devoid of anyone and with every door closed, including the bathrooms in the distance."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't see anyone. It's been almost ten minutes, so I'll try to find him.
entries.literal: "I don't see anyone. It's been almost ten minutes, so I'll try to find him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could leave, Shiroya stood up and came with me.
entries.literal: "Before I could leave, Shiroya stood up and came with me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'll help you. I... can't just keep sitting there.
entries.literal: "I'll help you. I... can't just keep sitting there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right. We shouldn't take too long.
entries.literal: "All right. We shouldn't take too long."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Sai had done, we closed the door behind us. I knew Shiroya had spent plenty of time silently mourning our loss, so I understood her—repeating it was unbearable, and I needed to occupy myself with something after sitting for so long. I was sure she felt the same about Sai's behavior being off; he'd openly accused her earlier, so her impression of him had to be poor.
entries.literal: "As Sai had done, we closed the door behind us. I knew Shiroya had spent plenty of time silently mourning our loss, so I understood her—repeating it was unbearable, and I needed to occupy myself with something after sitting for so long. I was sure she felt the same about Sai's behavior being off; he'd openly accused her earlier, so her impression of him had to be poor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's check the event room first.
entries.literal: "Let's check the event room first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We headed there and verified that the Sekimeiya was still present. I looked behind the cabinet and saw the cord plugged into the outlet too.
entries.literal: "We headed there and verified that the Sekimeiya was still present. I looked behind the cabinet and saw the cord plugged into the outlet too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, we moved to the bathrooms.
entries.literal: "Next, we moved to the bathrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although the doors were closed, neither one was locked, and Sai wasn't inside.
entries.literal: "Although the doors were closed, neither one was locked, and Sai wasn't inside."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It looks like he really took this chance to do something. If he went to a bathroom above, Katei would've seen him.
entries.literal: "It looks like he really took this chance to do something. If he went to a bathroom above, Katei would've seen him."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I feel like he might've gone to search for the Sekimeiya that we have. It was the one he hid in the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "I feel like he might've gone to search for the Sekimeiya that we have. It was the one he hid in the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, it's possible. He's probably somewhere on this floor.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it's possible. He's probably somewhere on this floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Beginning with the hallway B rooms, we opened every door and briefly searched for him. We'd learned already which cabinets had interiors large enough to contain a person, and after what had happened to Isla, checking them was less due to routine and moreso necessity.
entries.literal: "Beginning with the hallway B rooms, we opened every door and briefly searched for him. We'd learned already which cabinets had interiors large enough to contain a person, and after what had happened to Isla, checking them was less due to routine and moreso necessity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We decided that there was no purpose in checking the Sekimeiya in Naomi's locker since we could've been seen, we didn't want to move it or activate it, and it was possible it wasn't working anyway. Shiroya sounded hesitant about that decision, but I also hadn't abandoned the thought of trying to use it later and find out what had happened to Isla, at the very least.
entries.literal: "We decided that there was no purpose in checking the Sekimeiya in Naomi's locker since we could've been seen, we didn't want to move it or activate it, and it was possible it wasn't working anyway. Shiroya sounded hesitant about that decision, but I also hadn't abandoned the thought of trying to use it later and find out what had happened to Isla, at the very least."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered a room, made sure it was empty, and moved on to the next one.
entries.literal: "We entered a room, made sure it was empty, and moved on to the next one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I was checking the cabinets in the room where we'd found the first Naomi, the interior of one of them immediately let me know something about it was different. Upon unlocking it and opening its cover, a frigid burst of air hit my face.
entries.literal: "As I was checking the cabinets in the room where we'd found the first Naomi, the interior of one of them immediately let me know something about it was different. Upon unlocking it and opening its cover, a frigid burst of air hit my face."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei had stated that room contained the cabinets with temperature regulation functions. However, the previous times we'd opened them, no special temperature had been set. Shiroya noticed my reaction and came to see if anything was wrong. After feeling the cold air that had begun to diffuse through the room, she checked the wheel on the right side of the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Katei had stated that room contained the cabinets with temperature regulation functions. However, the previous times we'd opened them, no special temperature had been set. Shiroya noticed my reaction and came to see if anything was wrong. After feeling the cold air that had begun to diffuse through the room, she checked the wheel on the right side of the cabinet."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's set to 0 °C.
entries.literal: "It's set to 0 °C."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm... It had to have been changed recently. There's nothing inside, so that's pretty strange.
entries.literal: "Hm... It had to have been changed recently. There's nothing inside, so that's pretty strange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a different cabinet than the one I'd first traveled from, and I wasn't sure why it would be done since the Sekimeiya hadn't been put inside.
entries.literal: "It was a different cabinet than the one I'd first traveled from, and I wasn't sure why it would be done since the Sekimeiya hadn't been put inside."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: When we got the locker key from Naomi, it might've already been like this, so we can't just suspect Sai and Katei.
entries.literal: "When we got the locker key from Naomi, it might've already been like this, so we can't just suspect Sai and Katei."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, and we can't blindly believe Sai's story either. Regardless, whoever did this didn't let the others know, so we should probably revert the temperature.
entries.literal: "Yeah, and we can't blindly believe Sai's story either. Regardless, whoever did this didn't let the others know, so we should probably revert the temperature."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Someone might be counting on this cabinet for later if they changed the temperature in preparation. If I switch the wheel to "room temperature", we should be able to close the lid.
entries.literal: "...Someone might be counting on this cabinet for later if they changed the temperature in preparation. If I switch the wheel to \"room temperature\", we should be able to close the lid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded, and she did so before we left the room. It wasn't clear if setting it to room temperature would make the inside of the cabinet match the outside or if it would only stop the regulation, but leaving the lid open would communicate to whoever changed the temperature that their measures had been reversed.
entries.literal: "I nodded, and she did so before we left the room. It wasn't clear if setting it to room temperature would make the inside of the cabinet match the outside or if it would only stop the regulation, but leaving the lid open would communicate to whoever changed the temperature that their measures had been reversed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We proceeded to the other rooms and resumed the search. We didn't want to waste much time, or we'd become the suspicious ones. As soon as hallway B was done, we began with the parallel hallway.
entries.literal: "We proceeded to the other rooms and resumed the search. We didn't want to waste much time, or we'd become the suspicious ones. As soon as hallway B was done, we began with the parallel hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The first room we entered was the storeroom, continuing with our backward order.
