It was one of the smallest rooms on the entire floor, and its purpose was still a bit unclear, as it wasn't storing anything that was particularly useful.{w} Given how small it was, we should've left it immediately, but Shiroya noticed something that prolonged our stay.
entries.literal: "The first room we entered was the storeroom, continuing with our backward order. It was one of the smallest rooms on the entire floor, and its purpose was still a bit unclear, as it wasn't storing anything that was particularly useful.{w} Given how small it was, we should've left it immediately, but Shiroya noticed something that prolonged our stay."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, come here. Look at this part of the wall.
entries.literal: "Wait, come here. Look at this part of the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya, who'd gone to the end of the dimly lit room, was pointing her finger at the place she wanted me to see. I stepped in, making my way through the cluttered, narrow space. Then, I looked beyond her finger, faintly illuminated by the single light.
entries.literal: "Shiroya, who'd gone to the end of the dimly lit room, was pointing her finger at the place she wanted me to see. I stepped in, making my way through the cluttered, narrow space. Then, I looked beyond her finger, faintly illuminated by the single light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took me a while to understand what she meant. She was pointing at the left corner, and after glancing up and down in search of anything out of place, I finally noticed the oddity she'd found.
entries.literal: "It took me a while to understand what she meant. She was pointing at the left corner, and after glancing up and down in search of anything out of place, I finally noticed the oddity she'd found."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh... How did you even notice this?
entries.literal: "Huh... How did you even notice this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The wall was dirty and uneven from years of aging. You could still see the outline of a grid that separated the wall into tiny squares. They were all defined by white lines which had started to fade with time.
entries.literal: "The wall was dirty and uneven from years of aging. You could still see the outline of a grid that separated the wall into tiny squares. They were all defined by white lines which had started to fade with time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On one of the squares touching the left wall, Shiroya had seen a slight lack of dust, which was otherwise present over every surface of the room.{w} Even though the poor illumination made it hard to see, what seemed to be fingerprints existed on it. Not only that, but its close surroundings were a bit cleaner than the rest of the walls.
entries.literal: "On one of the squares touching the left wall, Shiroya had seen a slight lack of dust, which was otherwise present over every surface of the room.{w} Even though the poor illumination made it hard to see, what seemed to be fingerprints existed on it. Not only that, but its close surroundings were a bit cleaner than the rest of the walls."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: From the door, I saw this area reflecting the hallway C light a lot more. I don't know when, but it looks like someone touched this corner.
entries.literal: "From the door, I saw this area reflecting the hallway C light a lot more. I don't know when, but it looks like someone touched this corner."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I suppose so...{w} But I doubt it means anything, and we can't even be sure it happened today.
entries.literal: "I suppose so...{w} But I doubt it means anything, and we can't even be sure it happened today."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hold on. These fingerprints... It's hard to see, but they're not vertical, right?
entries.literal: "Hold on. These fingerprints... It's hard to see, but they're not vertical, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, they look horizontal.
entries.literal: "Yeah, they look horizontal."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You wouldn't touch any wall with three fingers in this horizontal position... accidentally.
entries.literal: "You wouldn't touch any wall with three fingers in this horizontal position... accidentally."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I wouldn't think so. Just touching it would leave them vertical, and more separated.
entries.literal: "I wouldn't think so. Just touching it would leave them vertical, and more separated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shaped my hand to match the three fingerprints and placed it over them. My arm formed a right angle with the left wall, but it didn't make me understand the meaning of what we'd found.
entries.literal: "I shaped my hand to match the three fingerprints and placed it over them. My arm formed a right angle with the left wall, but it didn't make me understand the meaning of what we'd found."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I have no idea why you'd ever touch a corner of a room like this.
entries.literal: "I have no idea why you'd ever touch a corner of a room like this."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There's nothing important in this room either.
entries.literal: "There's nothing important in this room either."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Huh?{w} Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "...{w}Huh?{w} Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I removed my hand from the wall, I felt something.
entries.literal: "As I removed my hand from the wall, I felt something."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did something happen?
entries.literal: "Did something happen?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: When I took away my hand, it seemed as if this square moved a bit.
entries.literal: "When I took away my hand, it seemed as if this square moved a bit."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Hm? I didn't see anything.
entries.literal: "...Hm? I didn't see anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pressed my fingers on the square again. Instead of pulling away, I moved my hand around, and as I'd thought, it was a bit loose.
entries.literal: "I pressed my fingers on the square again. Instead of pulling away, I moved my hand around, and as I'd thought, it was a bit loose."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're right. It's moving a little.
entries.literal: "You're right. It's moving a little."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't go anywhere, though. I could only move it sideways, and it wouldn't detach from the wall.
entries.literal: "It didn't go anywhere, though. I could only move it sideways, and it wouldn't detach from the wall."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This must be why someone touched this spot, but it's not doing anything.
entries.literal: "This must be why someone touched this spot, but it's not doing anything."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Will it move any more than that?
entries.literal: "Will it move any more than that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was sliding side to side, almost imperceptibly. Realizing that I hadn't been applying enough force, I attempted to move it past its apparent limit.
entries.literal: "It was sliding side to side, almost imperceptibly. Realizing that I hadn't been applying enough force, I attempted to move it past its apparent limit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of a sudden, as if it were a door, the wall opened, revealing a hidden space behind.
entries.literal: "All of a sudden, as if it were a door, the wall opened, revealing a hidden space behind."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-It's a hidden door!?
entries.literal: "I-It's a hidden door!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd slid the moving piece to the right, and before I could think, my hand had pushed open the entire wall. It was revealed to be very thin, and past it, the corridor extended.
entries.literal: "I'd slid the moving piece to the right, and before I could think, my hand had pushed open the entire wall. It was revealed to be very thin, and past it, the corridor extended."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: They've even got secret passages here? What is this place...?
entries.literal: "They've even got secret passages here? What is this place...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No light existed on the other side, but it seemed to lead to a narrow area.
entries.literal: "No light existed on the other side, but it seemed to lead to a narrow area."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There's another door...
entries.literal: "There's another door..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Y-Yes, but it doesn't have a handle. At first I thought it was just another wall.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes, but it doesn't have a handle. At first I thought it was just another wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to push it open, but it didn't move. Where a handle or a doorknob should have been, there were two round holes: a big one with metallic pieces inside, and a smaller, empty one.
entries.literal: "I tried to push it open, but it didn't move. Where a handle or a doorknob should have been, there were two round holes: a big one with metallic pieces inside, and a smaller, empty one."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Someone here knows about this, right? Those marks have to mean someone opened this recently.
entries.literal: "Someone here knows about this, right? Those marks have to mean someone opened this recently."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...And no matter if they went through this door, the culprit could've easily escaped from us if they just hid here.
entries.literal: "...And no matter if they went through this door, the culprit could've easily escaped from us if they just hid here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why was something like this even built in the first place?
entries.literal: "Why was something like this even built in the first place?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It might've been part of Ashiya's countermeasures to Xyn, but that means that Katei would have to know about it.
entries.literal: "It might've been part of Ashiya's countermeasures to Xyn, but that means that Katei would have to know about it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I mean, no matter what it's for, there's no way he doesn't know about this, right...?
entries.literal: "I mean, no matter what it's for, there's no way he doesn't know about this, right...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That part of the storeroom felt colder than the rest of the building, likely because the temperature regulation didn't reach it. Still awestruck, I kept examining the door.
entries.literal: "That part of the storeroom felt colder than the rest of the building, likely because the temperature regulation didn't reach it. Still awestruck, I kept examining the door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think there should be a handle here. When you remove a handle with a keyhole from a door, you're left with these holes. I think the small one is where the keyhole would be, and the bigger one is what connects the handle with the turning mechanism. This means that this door can usually be unlocked with a key, but without the handle, we won't be able to open it even if we find the right one.
entries.literal: "I think there should be a handle here. When you remove a handle with a keyhole from a door, you're left with these holes. I think the small one is where the keyhole would be, and the bigger one is what connects the handle with the turning mechanism. This means that this door can usually be unlocked with a key, but without the handle, we won't be able to open it even if we find the right one."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, I guess someone could've unscrewed it on purpose to make sure it's never unlocked again.
entries.literal: "Oh, I guess someone could've unscrewed it on purpose to make sure it's never unlocked again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. I have no idea what's through here, but we can't find out. It looks like a sturdy enough door, so it won't open without both the handle and the key.
entries.literal: "Yeah. I have no idea what's through here, but we can't find out. It looks like a sturdy enough door, so it won't open without both the handle and the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried it a few more times, but it didn't budge at all.
entries.literal: "I tried it a few more times, but it didn't budge at all."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: Hey!
entries.literal: "Hey!"

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: What the hell is going on!?
entries.literal: "What the hell is going on!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sudden voice startled us, and we turned around instantly. Katei's silhouette was behind us, the single light only hitting his back.
entries.literal: "The sudden voice startled us, and we turned around instantly. Katei's silhouette was behind us, the single light only hitting his back."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...We found this hidden section behind the wall. Where does this door lead to?
entries.literal: "...We found this hidden section behind the wall. Where does this door lead to?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You must be screwing with me! A hidden section? There's no way.
entries.literal: "You must be screwing with me! A hidden section? There's no way."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're seeing it right now. Did you not know about it...?
entries.literal: "You're seeing it right now. Did you not know about it...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No, I did not know about it! What is this!?
entries.literal: "No, I did not know about it! What is this!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whoa, look at this. Good find, Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Whoa, look at this. Good find, Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From behind Katei, another silhouette appeared. Without a doubt, the voice belonged to Sai.
entries.literal: "From behind Katei, another silhouette appeared. Without a doubt, the voice belonged to Sai."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya found it, actually.
entries.literal: "Shiroya found it, actually."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, you finally did something. Good job.
entries.literal: "Oh, you finally did something. Good job."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's condescending attitude had already resurfaced. He skittered over to us and began to examine the door.
entries.literal: "Sai's condescending attitude had already resurfaced. He skittered over to us and began to examine the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two more figures peeked in from the entrance. As they stepped in, the light revealed they were the last two remaining people: Akaro and Erina.
entries.literal: "Two more figures peeked in from the entrance. As they stepped in, the light revealed they were the last two remaining people: Akaro and Erina."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We were gonna search for you. Did you take this chance to sneak into your hideout?
entries.literal: "We were gonna search for you. Did you take this chance to sneak into your hideout?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We actually found it while we were searching for you, so you tell us. Where did you go? The bathrooms here were empty.
entries.literal: "We actually found it while we were searching for you, so you tell us. Where did you go? The bathrooms here were empty."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're all always in a rush as soon as I go somewhere. I just went to the floor 2 bathrooms since Naomi's still in the one down here.
entries.literal: "You're all always in a rush as soon as I go somewhere. I just went to the floor 2 bathrooms since Naomi's still in the one down here."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wait, what? No, you didn't. I was there, and you definitely didn't come.
entries.literal: "Wait, what? No, you didn't. I was there, and you definitely didn't come."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}All right, let's settle this quickly. Katei is lying. I was up there, and he never showed up.
entries.literal: "...{w}All right, let's settle this quickly. Katei is lying. I was up there, and he never showed up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I bet he already told you he'd gone upstairs, right? Now, since I revealed I was there, he couldn't back out of his lie, so he chose to accuse me. That's Katei for you.
entries.literal: "I bet he already told you he'd gone upstairs, right? Now, since I revealed I was there, he couldn't back out of his lie, so he chose to accuse me. That's Katei for you."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is getting old. You guys can choose to believe him if you want, but he's only manipulating you.
entries.literal: "This is getting old. You guys can choose to believe him if you want, but he's only manipulating you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, we found a hidden passage, so stop trying to always be the center of attention. Let's cut to the chase: did you leave the bathroom's door open or closed?
entries.literal: "Katei, we found a hidden passage, so stop trying to always be the center of attention. Let's cut to the chase: did you leave the bathroom's door open or closed?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Closed. I always close doors behind me when I leave an empty room.
entries.literal: "Closed. I always close doors behind me when I leave an empty room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Unfortunately, he's right. I closed the door, so take him up on his offer and believe me.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, he's right. I closed the door, so take him up on his offer and believe me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now look at this. Someone removed the keyhole from this door to prevent us from opening it.{w} Hm... Not only that, but the inner mechanism was broken too. This won't allow for a new handle to be inserted.
entries.literal: "Now look at this. Someone removed the keyhole from this door to prevent us from opening it.{w} Hm... Not only that, but the inner mechanism was broken too. This won't allow for a new handle to be inserted."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whoever the culprit is, they're likely to still be somewhere, so they might be behind this door right now, which is how they keep avoiding us.
entries.literal: "Whoever the culprit is, they're likely to still be somewhere, so they might be behind this door right now, which is how they keep avoiding us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, be smart for once and tell us where this goes.
entries.literal: "Katei, be smart for once and tell us where this goes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You heard me earlier. I was unaware of this hidden area entirely.
entries.literal: "You heard me earlier. I was unaware of this hidden area entirely."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're awful at your job, then. Ashiya must've constructed this for a reason, and it's impossible you weren't aware of it.
entries.literal: "You're awful at your job, then. Ashiya must've constructed this for a reason, and it's impossible you weren't aware of it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Do you guys not think it might lead to the left side of the tower?
entries.literal: "Do you guys not think it might lead to the left side of the tower?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...You mean, outside?
entries.literal: "...You mean, outside?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes.{w} This entire corridor now stretches farther than the crystal rooms. I think it might extend far enough to reach outside.
entries.literal: "Yes.{w} This entire corridor now stretches farther than the crystal rooms. I think it might extend far enough to reach outside."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's some hope you're giving us. Katei didn't know about this door, so if it leads outside, the alarm shouldn't have blocked it.
entries.literal: "That's some hope you're giving us. Katei didn't know about this door, so if it leads outside, the alarm shouldn't have blocked it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Th-That's right. I can assure you that the alarm did not do anything to this door.
entries.literal: "Th-That's right. I can assure you that the alarm did not do anything to this door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Someone did, though. The keyhole was removed, probably to prevent us from unlocking it with the key. Isn't that implying that one of us has it? Otherwise, the lock would be enough of a barrier.
entries.literal: "Someone did, though. The keyhole was removed, probably to prevent us from unlocking it with the key. Isn't that implying that one of us has it? Otherwise, the lock would be enough of a barrier."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, nothing around here looks modern. If this door is old, the chances of picking the lock are high. Maybe it was done to prevent that.
entries.literal: "Well, nothing around here looks modern. If this door is old, the chances of picking the lock are high. Maybe it was done to prevent that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: True, yeah. How did you spot the hidden opening, Shiroya?
entries.literal: "True, yeah. How did you spot the hidden opening, Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I saw some light reflecting off one of the tiles. Someone's fingerprints had removed some dust in the corner of the wall. That ended up being the way to open it.
entries.literal: "...I saw some light reflecting off one of the tiles. Someone's fingerprints had removed some dust in the corner of the wall. That ended up being the way to open it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Listen, then. This was recent. If the door leads outside, the culprit might actually have escaped with the handle. This building is situated at the outskirts of town, so the sides and back are never seen by anyone and are empty, grassy fields.
entries.literal: "Listen, then. This was recent. If the door leads outside, the culprit might actually have escaped with the handle. This building is situated at the outskirts of town, so the sides and back are never seen by anyone and are empty, grassy fields."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sure the police are keeping watch outside, but probably only at the front, where the entrance and windows are. They shouldn't be aware of this door either, so escaping unseen is certainly doable.
entries.literal: "I'm sure the police are keeping watch outside, but probably only at the front, where the entrance and windows are. They shouldn't be aware of this door either, so escaping unseen is certainly doable."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There's no way this leads out of the building. I've never seen the outline of a door from the outside, and there's no light coming from behind the door. It's absolutely impossible this kind of way out exists.
entries.literal: "There's no way this leads out of the building. I've never seen the outline of a door from the outside, and there's no light coming from behind the door. It's absolutely impossible this kind of way out exists."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: The gaps aren't big enough to let light pass, or the door is wider than it seems. Just think about it, though. Why would this secret passage exist?{w} If they had something to hide in it, they wouldn't have another locked door past it. They would just hide it in the secret passage itself. Otherwise, this door wouldn't be here or be locked.{w} This passage is the secret itself. It's hidden because this door leads outside. If the middle wall didn't exist, the length of the room would reveal it.
entries.literal: "The gaps aren't big enough to let light pass, or the door is wider than it seems. Just think about it, though. Why would this secret passage exist?{w} If they had something to hide in it, they wouldn't have another locked door past it. They would just hide it in the secret passage itself. Otherwise, this door wouldn't be here or be locked.{w} This passage is the secret itself. It's hidden because this door leads outside. If the middle wall didn't exist, the length of the room would reveal it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I think you're right. That's what this wall is hiding.
entries.literal: "I think you're right. That's what this wall is hiding."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So, we're a single door away from making it out...? Can we break it down?
entries.literal: "So, we're a single door away from making it out...? Can we break it down?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's no way, just look at it. Whoever removed the handle knew very well that we couldn't do that.
entries.literal: "There's no way, just look at it. Whoever removed the handle knew very well that we couldn't do that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I know this is bound to happen eventually, but do you realize what will occur if we manage to force it open? We'll reveal that the Sekimeiya has time traveling powers. What kind of consequences will that have?
entries.literal: "I know this is bound to happen eventually, but do you realize what will occur if we manage to force it open? We'll reveal that the Sekimeiya has time traveling powers. What kind of consequences will that have?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That was completely inconsiderate. Erina was still next to us, and she hadn't said anything in a very long time. Our priority had to be making it out as soon as possible so that the police could understand what happened to Isla even if it invalidated the recording.
entries.literal: "...That was completely inconsiderate. Erina was still next to us, and she hadn't said anything in a very long time. Our priority had to be making it out as soon as possible so that the police could understand what happened to Isla even if it invalidated the recording."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't get me wrong. I'm not worried. I'm just intrigued.{w} How is it even remotely possible the Sekimeiya exists? How did it make it here without anyone finding out about its powers? These big picture questions are what I'm most lost about.
entries.literal: "Don't get me wrong. I'm not worried. I'm just intrigued.{w} How is it even remotely possible the Sekimeiya exists? How did it make it here without anyone finding out about its powers? These big picture questions are what I'm most lost about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hit the door, and the sound echoed heavily throughout the corridor. I repeated that a few times, trying to be as loud as I could and intending to be heard from the outside.
entries.literal: "I hit the door, and the sound echoed heavily throughout the corridor. I repeated that a few times, trying to be as loud as I could and intending to be heard from the outside."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Nobody will come. I refuse to believe this leads outside. I'm more inclined to think the culprit is currently behind this door, listening.
entries.literal: "Nobody will come. I refuse to believe this leads outside. I'm more inclined to think the culprit is currently behind this door, listening."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Is there nothing else we can do? Sliding anything through the gaps, for example?
entries.literal: "Is there nothing else we can do? Sliding anything through the gaps, for example?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What, a letter? We're too far from the entrance to be heard, and I doubt anyone is currently looking at this side. Regardless, these gaps are way too thin—probably to hide the door's existence from the outside.
entries.literal: "What, a letter? We're too far from the entrance to be heard, and I doubt anyone is currently looking at this side. Regardless, these gaps are way too thin—probably to hide the door's existence from the outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was incredibly frustrating. We'd finally discovered an exit that the alarm shouldn't have affected, but the culprit had made sure to finish the job. ...Was it just in case we found the moving wall, or was there a deeper reason?
entries.literal: "It was incredibly frustrating. We'd finally discovered an exit that the alarm shouldn't have affected, but the culprit had made sure to finish the job. ...Was it just in case we found the moving wall, or was there a deeper reason?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And how did the culprit know about it, but not Katei? Why was it there in the first place? Not only did the door lock us inside, but it also produced even more questions. Feeling defeated, we left what had become a narrow, dim corridor to return to the wider but still dark hallway A.
entries.literal: "And how did the culprit know about it, but not Katei? Why was it there in the first place? Not only did the door lock us inside, but it also produced even more questions. Feeling defeated, we left what had become a narrow, dim corridor to return to the wider but still dark hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought something was noteworthy. Even though a perfect hiding spot existed, the Sekimeiya had never been hidden in it.{w} ...Why? Earlier, it had been hidden in the storeroom. Therefore, the person who hid it there was probably not aware of the movable wall.
entries.literal: "I thought something was noteworthy. Even though a perfect hiding spot existed, the Sekimeiya had never been hidden in it.{w} ...Why? Earlier, it had been hidden in the storeroom. Therefore, the person who hid it there was probably not aware of the movable wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...We'd ignored the little fight between Sai and Katei, but there weren't many layers to it. One of them was lying, and it was nothing new, as they'd surely lied more than once already. The fact that one of them took advantage of the situation with Isla to act on their own, though, proved that they weren't to be taken lightly. In addition, one of them could've easily been responsible for the cold cabinet Shiroya and I had returned to normal.
entries.literal: "...We'd ignored the little fight between Sai and Katei, but there weren't many layers to it. One of them was lying, and it was nothing new, as they'd surely lied more than once already. The fact that one of them took advantage of the situation with Isla to act on their own, though, proved that they weren't to be taken lightly. In addition, one of them could've easily been responsible for the cold cabinet Shiroya and I had returned to normal."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Mechanically, we went to the event room. It didn't have anything new to tell us, as the Sekimeiya was still present behind the glass.
entries.literal: "Mechanically, we went to the event room. It didn't have anything new to tell us, as the Sekimeiya was still present behind the glass."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So it hasn't moved. It's clear that either Sai or Katei didn't go to the bathroom earlier, so they were up to some other business.
entries.literal: "So it hasn't moved. It's clear that either Sai or Katei didn't go to the bathroom earlier, so they were up to some other business."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Good thought. Tell us, Katei, what exactly were you doing that justified lying to us?
entries.literal: "Good thought. Tell us, Katei, what exactly were you doing that justified lying to us?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: *sigh* It's time to put an end to this. Sai won't stop lying as much as he pleases, so we'll have to wait until the security footage reveals all of his actions.
entries.literal: "*sigh* It's time to put an end to this. Sai won't stop lying as much as he pleases, so we'll have to wait until the security footage reveals all of his actions."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You keep saying that, but do you really believe the footage will be salvaged? Even though the cameras are recording, is it really being saved somewhere?
entries.literal: "You keep saying that, but do you really believe the footage will be salvaged? Even though the cameras are recording, is it really being saved somewhere?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Of course. The computer isn't detecting the system, but as soon as that's solved, it'll have access to all the stored footage. Did you perhaps think you'd be able to roam freely without consequences?
entries.literal: "Of course. The computer isn't detecting the system, but as soon as that's solved, it'll have access to all the stored footage. Did you perhaps think you'd be able to roam freely without consequences?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, but I have trouble swallowing that. The culprit made sure to cut our access to the system, but why would they do that if Ashiya will come in and be able to look at what happened?
entries.literal: "No, but I have trouble swallowing that. The culprit made sure to cut our access to the system, but why would they do that if Ashiya will come in and be able to look at what happened?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not all they did, though. At the same time, our only method of communication was removed. I believe the reason behind that entire thing was to prevent us from conveying what's happening while we're still here. It's possible that whoever did it doesn't care about Ashiya finding out.
entries.literal: "That's not all they did, though. At the same time, our only method of communication was removed. I believe the reason behind that entire thing was to prevent us from conveying what's happening while we're still here. It's possible that whoever did it doesn't care about Ashiya finding out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You try to make that sound interesting, but it's idiotic. They were able to power off the computer, but it turned back on minutes later, so why didn't they choose to keep it off forever?
entries.literal: "You try to make that sound interesting, but it's idiotic. They were able to power off the computer, but it turned back on minutes later, so why didn't they choose to keep it off forever?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Most likely, the reason they let us use it again was because they'd made sure that the recordings wouldn't be accessible. Additionally, it clearly told us that they could somehow disable our communication method.
entries.literal: "Most likely, the reason they let us use it again was because they'd made sure that the recordings wouldn't be accessible. Additionally, it clearly told us that they could somehow disable our communication method."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, to be honest, even though the cameras are still functional, I find it hard to believe what's being recorded will ever be seen. There's no way the person responsible would be fine with being seen once we get out, so if we can't access the system, it's doubtful Ashiya or the police will be able to.
entries.literal: "So, to be honest, even though the cameras are still functional, I find it hard to believe what's being recorded will ever be seen. There's no way the person responsible would be fine with being seen once we get out, so if we can't access the system, it's doubtful Ashiya or the police will be able to."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I feel like you're right about that. It would also explain why they keep putting themselves in front of the cameras.
entries.literal: "I feel like you're right about that. It would also explain why they keep putting themselves in front of the cameras."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now, I understand I'm repeating myself, but wouldn't you think that the security staff member among us who conveniently avoided giving us information, has lied multiple times, and could've had knowledge of the secret passage is the most likely candidate to have orchestrated this?
entries.literal: "Now, I understand I'm repeating myself, but wouldn't you think that the security staff member among us who conveniently avoided giving us information, has lied multiple times, and could've had knowledge of the secret passage is the most likely candidate to have orchestrated this?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's enough, Sai.
entries.literal: "That's enough, Sai."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is that all you have to say? Of course, once your "the security cameras will prove that I'm right" excuse runs out, you have no arguments to defend yourself with.
entries.literal: "Is that all you have to say? Of course, once your \"the security cameras will prove that I'm right\" excuse runs out, you have no arguments to defend yourself with."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed the discussions between those two wouldn't cease until one was proven wrong definitively. I knew that Sai wasn't any less of a liar than Katei, but if that hadn't been the case, I would've quickly sided with him.
entries.literal: "It seemed the discussions between those two wouldn't cease until one was proven wrong definitively. I knew that Sai wasn't any less of a liar than Katei, but if that hadn't been the case, I would've quickly sided with him."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Why don't we stop with this and wait until we can leave?
entries.literal: "...Why don't we stop with this and wait until we can leave?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surprisingly, it was Erina who tried to calm them down. Her voice came out like the wind rustling on dried leaves.
entries.literal: "Surprisingly, it was Erina who tried to calm them down. Her voice came out like the wind rustling on dried leaves."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's easy to say, but Katei will just take advantage of that again.
entries.literal: "That's easy to say, but Katei will just take advantage of that again."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...No matter who's in the right, someone is guilty. Although we don't know who it is, can't we lock ourselves up in one place so they can't move around freely?
entries.literal: "...No matter who's in the right, someone is guilty. Although we don't know who it is, can't we lock ourselves up in one place so they can't move around freely?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is anyone opposed to that? Technically, only the culprit should have a problem with it.
entries.literal: "Is anyone opposed to that? Technically, only the culprit should have a problem with it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If that was what Erina wanted, I'd attempt to make it happen. She wanted to avoid any more tragedy and only intended to wait for external help.
entries.literal: "If that was what Erina wanted, I'd attempt to make it happen. She wanted to avoid any more tragedy and only intended to wait for external help."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Locking ourselves up...? Isn't that going a bit too far?
entries.literal: "Locking ourselves up...? Isn't that going a bit too far?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why would it be? You'd agree if you were innocent, and if something happens while we're staying somewhere, it means the culprit was never one of us.
entries.literal: "Why would it be? You'd agree if you were innocent, and if something happens while we're staying somewhere, it means the culprit was never one of us."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Could we even do that if we wanted to?
entries.literal: "...Could we even do that if we wanted to?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I doubt it. We can lock the bathrooms, but they're not big enough for all of us.
entries.literal: "I doubt it. We can lock the bathrooms, but they're not big enough for all of us."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Are there no other places?
entries.literal: "Are there no other places?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What about the security room? Didn't Katei have the key for it?
entries.literal: "What about the security room? Didn't Katei have the key for it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We won't be able to lock ourselves in there. From the inside, the lock can be undone with just the doorknob.
entries.literal: "We won't be able to lock ourselves in there. From the inside, the lock can be undone with just the doorknob."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What about the lobby? The hallway doors are locked until {time=9}, isn't that right?
entries.literal: "What about the lobby? The hallway doors are locked until {time=9}, isn't that right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: They aren't. Permission to move ahead is simply not granted until that time. They can be locked, but I don't have the keys.
entries.literal: "They aren't. Permission to move ahead is simply not granted until that time. They can be locked, but I don't have the keys."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: If we do this... we'll have to commit to it. Locking ourselves in a place with the key to unlock it doesn't prove anyone's sincerity since they could leave any time they wanted.
entries.literal: "If we do this... we'll have to commit to it. Locking ourselves in a place with the key to unlock it doesn't prove anyone's sincerity since they could leave any time they wanted."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But that's all we could do if we managed to find the right keys. We won't be able to lock ourselves inside and leave the key out because the doors won't close if the deadbolt is set.
entries.literal: "But that's all we could do if we managed to find the right keys. We won't be able to lock ourselves inside and leave the key out because the doors won't close if the deadbolt is set."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you all forgetting about the attic bedrooms? We saw they had a keyhole, one had a working chain, and they're spacious enough for all of us. Could they work?
entries.literal: "Are you all forgetting about the attic bedrooms? We saw they had a keyhole, one had a working chain, and they're spacious enough for all of us. Could they work?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wouldn't we run into the same problem?
entries.literal: "Wouldn't we run into the same problem?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around, and after staring at the door for a short time, I spoke.
entries.literal: "I turned around, and after staring at the door for a short time, I spoke."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm... I don't think so, actually. I can think of a difference that would let us lock ourselves up without being able to leave.
entries.literal: "Hm... I don't think so, actually. I can think of a difference that would let us lock ourselves up without being able to leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The silence let me know that nobody would directly oppose me. I began to walk until I thought of a question to ask.
entries.literal: "The silence let me know that nobody would directly oppose me. I began to walk until I thought of a question to ask."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, does anyone have the cabinet key? If we're gonna stay put, let's make sure to lock the cabinet too and keep the key with us. It's possible the person behind all this has a duplicate, but nothing actually proves that.
entries.literal: "Oh, does anyone have the cabinet key? If we're gonna stay put, let's make sure to lock the cabinet too and keep the key with us. It's possible the person behind all this has a duplicate, but nothing actually proves that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, nobody said anything.
entries.literal: "Once again, nobody said anything."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...If not, it has to still be where I left it, on top of that bed in the attic.
entries.literal: "...If not, it has to still be where I left it, on top of that bed in the attic."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's see if it's there, then.
entries.literal: "Let's see if it's there, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We took the stairs up. The elevator had already been out of commission for a very long time, and it was better to keep it like that, as it had caused us a few headaches during the short time it worked.
entries.literal: "We took the stairs up. The elevator had already been out of commission for a very long time, and it was better to keep it like that, as it had caused us a few headaches during the short time it worked."

entries.text: Wind Shelter
entries.literal: "Wind Shelter"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's actually still here. Good.
entries.literal: "It's actually still here. Good."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surprisingly enough, the key hadn't been taken while everyone had a chance. I picked it up and glanced at the door.
entries.literal: "Surprisingly enough, the key hadn't been taken while everyone had a chance. I picked it up and glanced at the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I messed with it a little. It appeared to be a double cylinder lock, meaning that to unlock it, the key would be needed from each side, as opposed to the security room's lock.
entries.literal: "I messed with it a little. It appeared to be a double cylinder lock, meaning that to unlock it, the key would be needed from each side, as opposed to the security room's lock."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's going to work. We won't have to lock it either.
entries.literal: "It's going to work. We won't have to lock it either."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: How?
entries.literal: "How?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went ahead and looked through the drawers I'd inspected earlier. First, I took out the key to the room.
entries.literal: "I went ahead and looked through the drawers I'd inspected earlier. First, I took out the key to the room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We'll have to leave this outside. Now, I'll explain how we can technically do this, but it's not exactly a smooth way.
entries.literal: "We'll have to leave this outside. Now, I'll explain how we can technically do this, but it's not exactly a smooth way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The second thing I took out of the drawer was a screwdriver. Admittedly, what I'd thought of had been inspired by the secret door we'd just found.
entries.literal: "The second thing I took out of the drawer was a screwdriver. Admittedly, what I'd thought of had been inspired by the secret door we'd just found."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Removing a handle is incredibly easy. We can take it out, leave it outside, and close the door. Since we'll be unable to turn it, even though the door will be unlocked, we won't be able to open it. That's the big difference with this door—the handles on the crystal floor don't have visible screws to detach.
entries.literal: "Removing a handle is incredibly easy. We can take it out, leave it outside, and close the door. Since we'll be unable to turn it, even though the door will be unlocked, we won't be able to open it. That's the big difference with this door—the handles on the crystal floor don't have visible screws to detach."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Since the keyhole isn't on the handle itself, we would need to leave the key outside. Otherwise, we could still get the door to open by inserting the key and turning it. Even though the lock wouldn't be set, it would act as a turn of a handle, and the door could be dragged open. On top of that, we can remove the outer handle as well so that no one can easily get in.
entries.literal: "Since the keyhole isn't on the handle itself, we would need to leave the key outside. Otherwise, we could still get the door to open by inserting the key and turning it. Even though the lock wouldn't be set, it would act as a turn of a handle, and the door could be dragged open. On top of that, we can remove the outer handle as well so that no one can easily get in."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Finally, even though we'd hide the key outside, if someone found it and wanted to enter, they couldn't do it. They could find the key and open the door like I just described, but we can set the chain from the inside. If we do this, the door shouldn't be opened until the police enter the building. There's no way it'll be broken down.
entries.literal: "Finally, even though we'd hide the key outside, if someone found it and wanted to enter, they couldn't do it. They could find the key and open the door like I just described, but we can set the chain from the inside. If we do this, the door shouldn't be opened until the police enter the building. There's no way it'll be broken down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody was sure what to say. Personally, I knew that it meant giving up on understanding the Sekimeiya's mechanics, but after what happened to Isla, it was clear that something terrible could come out of that.
entries.literal: "Nobody was sure what to say. Personally, I knew that it meant giving up on understanding the Sekimeiya's mechanics, but after what happened to Isla, it was clear that something terrible could come out of that."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You must be joking... This is Ashiya's special place, and we're currently being recorded. Do you not understand what will happen if they see us ripping the handles apart?
entries.literal: "You must be joking... This is Ashiya's special place, and we're currently being recorded. Do you not understand what will happen if they see us ripping the handles apart?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Honestly, who cares? It'll be easy to reattach them. We could do that right as the tower opens, but we'll unfortunately have to leave the handles out of the room or else we could leave at any point.
entries.literal: "Honestly, who cares? It'll be easy to reattach them. We could do that right as the tower opens, but we'll unfortunately have to leave the handles out of the room or else we could leave at any point."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That reminds me... What time is it? It's been a while since the last time I checked it.
entries.literal: "That reminds me... What time is it? It's been a while since the last time I checked it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a brief sigh indicating that he wasn't fond of my proposition, Sai turned his wrist. I looked at his watch and saw that the displayed time was {time=14:56.}
entries.literal: "With a brief sigh indicating that he wasn't fond of my proposition, Sai turned his wrist. I looked at his watch and saw that the displayed time was {time=14:56.}"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Almost {time=15}, I see. We're past the halfway point, so with all that's happened, let's spend the last six hours calmly until the police enter and we can have a better understanding of what's been going on.
entries.literal: "Almost {time=15}, I see. We're past the halfway point, so with all that's happened, let's spend the last six hours calmly until the police enter and we can have a better understanding of what's been going on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was an easy way to finally test the recording. If nothing happened after we waited those last six hours, we would have to have a long discussion about it.
entries.literal: "It was an easy way to finally test the recording. If nothing happened after we waited those last six hours, we would have to have a long discussion about it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: This is what I wanted. Thank you.
entries.literal: "This is what I wanted. Thank you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina's gratitude was the ultimate deciding factor. We'd lock ourselves away from the Sekimeiya, ensuring that its powers wouldn't influence our peaceful wait. Hopefully, we'd also be preventing the culprit's plan from moving along.
entries.literal: "Erina's gratitude was the ultimate deciding factor. We'd lock ourselves away from the Sekimeiya, ensuring that its powers wouldn't influence our peaceful wait. Hopefully, we'd also be preventing the culprit's plan from moving along."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'd go lock the Sekimeiya cabinet myself, but we're trying to act together by doing this. Let's avoid separating now and creating chances to prepare anything.
entries.literal: "I'd go lock the Sekimeiya cabinet myself, but we're trying to act together by doing this. Let's avoid separating now and creating chances to prepare anything."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Any objection?
entries.literal: "...Any objection?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Katei rolled their eyes, but they kept quiet. If we were alone with both Sekimeiya locked in place as well, nobody could use them.{w} Everyone looked uncertain, and Sai seemed depressed. He'd made it obvious he was enjoying his time in the tower, and instead of having another six hours to play with a time travel device, it was already over.
entries.literal: "Sai and Katei rolled their eyes, but they kept quiet. If we were alone with both Sekimeiya locked in place as well, nobody could use them.{w} Everyone looked uncertain, and Sai seemed depressed. He'd made it obvious he was enjoying his time in the tower, and instead of having another six hours to play with a time travel device, it was already over."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the event room and saw that the Sekimeiya hadn't moved. I made sure the glass was properly adjusted, and I manually locked it. From that point on, only the key that I had could open it, so I possessed the keys to both Sekimeiya. Regarding the locker key, I'd have to surreptitiously leave it somewhere in the bedroom after waiting a while. That way, anyone could've had it.
entries.literal: "We entered the event room and saw that the Sekimeiya hadn't moved. I made sure the glass was properly adjusted, and I manually locked it. From that point on, only the key that I had could open it, so I possessed the keys to both Sekimeiya. Regarding the locker key, I'd have to surreptitiously leave it somewhere in the bedroom after waiting a while. That way, anyone could've had it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, we went up again. We'd just gone through staircases eighteen times, so we were pretty exhausted. The idea of waiting calmly in a bedroom with three big beds started to sound slightly more pleasant.
entries.literal: "Finally, we went up again. We'd just gone through staircases eighteen times, so we were pretty exhausted. The idea of waiting calmly in a bedroom with three big beds started to sound slightly more pleasant."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We'll be here for six hours, so it's the right time to use the bathroom.
entries.literal: "We'll be here for six hours, so it's the right time to use the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once inside, we'd have no way to exit, so everyone made sure to prevent a future problem. All of us went to the bathroom one at a time, and when we were all set, Sai spoke.
entries.literal: "Once inside, we'd have no way to exit, so everyone made sure to prevent a future problem. All of us went to the bathroom one at a time, and when we were all set, Sai spoke."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sure, if we're gonna do this, let's do it well. We're dealing with someone who's teleported and gone back in time before, so regardless of whether they're one of us or not, we need to keep that in mind.
entries.literal: "Sure, if we're gonna do this, let's do it well. We're dealing with someone who's teleported and gone back in time before, so regardless of whether they're one of us or not, we need to keep that in mind."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We need to make sure the door won't be opened no matter what, but a single key can ruin that.
entries.literal: "We need to make sure the door won't be opened no matter what, but a single key can ruin that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He went to grab the bedroom key that I'd left on top of the drawers.
entries.literal: "He went to grab the bedroom key that I'd left on top of the drawers."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, are you sure the key in the other bedroom won't work?
entries.literal: "Katei, are you sure the key in the other bedroom won't work?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I said it earlier: they're not interchangeable.
entries.literal: "I said it earlier: they're not interchangeable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai moved from one room to the other and came back with the key for the neighboring bedroom.
entries.literal: "Sai moved from one room to the other and came back with the key for the neighboring bedroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right. They're different.
entries.literal: "You're right. They're different."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He attempted to insert the wrong key into the door's keyhole, but it only went halfway in.
entries.literal: "He attempted to insert the wrong key into the door's keyhole, but it only went halfway in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He went to return it and closed the door behind him once he came back to the hallway.
entries.literal: "He went to return it and closed the door behind him once he came back to the hallway."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now, there've been instances where we thought the Sekimeiya teleported. The first time was when it appeared in the storeroom, but recently, it appeared inside the cabinet, next to Isla...
entries.literal: "Now, there've been instances where we thought the Sekimeiya teleported. The first time was when it appeared in the storeroom, but recently, it appeared inside the cabinet, next to Isla..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya could've put it there, but if they didn't, it might've moved by itself. That's not a random location either, so if it was part of the culprit's plan, there's a chance they understand how to exploit this self-teleportation.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Shiroya could've put it there, but if they didn't, it might've moved by itself. That's not a random location either, so if it was part of the culprit's plan, there's a chance they understand how to exploit this self-teleportation."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's more likely they moved it themselves, but keep in mind that if that's what happened, they had to travel from the future because we inspected the whole building before that point. If we're gonna stay here until the end, that means that none of us will have the chance to go back in time and move the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It's more likely they moved it themselves, but keep in mind that if that's what happened, they had to travel from the future because we inspected the whole building before that point. If we're gonna stay here until the end, that means that none of us will have the chance to go back in time and move the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The four main possibilities are: the culprit isn't one of us and we kept missing them.{w} The Sekimeiya teleported there randomly.{w} The culprit made the Sekimeiya teleport there without touching it.{w} One of us will go back to the past after spending six hours here.
entries.literal: "The four main possibilities are: the culprit isn't one of us and we kept missing them.{w} The Sekimeiya teleported there randomly.{w} The culprit made the Sekimeiya teleport there without touching it.{w} One of us will go back to the past after spending six hours here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No matter which one is right, before we lock ourselves away, we need to thoroughly inspect this bedroom. Both levels.{w} If a Sekimeiya's already here, the imprisonment wouldn't mean anything, as anyone could leave at any time after making sure nobody else is in range. A key would do the trick too, and we've seen that some kind of replication has occurred. We found two identical suitcases and two Naomis.
entries.literal: "No matter which one is right, before we lock ourselves away, we need to thoroughly inspect this bedroom. Both levels.{w} If a Sekimeiya's already here, the imprisonment wouldn't mean anything, as anyone could leave at any time after making sure nobody else is in range. A key would do the trick too, and we've seen that some kind of replication has occurred. We found two identical suitcases and two Naomis."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't mention it, but even though I hadn't seen both at the same time, two Sekimeiya had to have existed too, at least at one point.
entries.literal: "He didn't mention it, but even though I hadn't seen both at the same time, two Sekimeiya had to have existed too, at least at one point."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Searching for an extra key to this bedroom might sound paranoid since nothing indicates it exists, but it's necessary. If we ignore these precautions, we're leaving a potential escape route for the culprit that can be used at any time.{w} They have higher knowledge of the Sekimeiya than we do, so we have no guarantee that they couldn't obtain a key they would hide later, use it to escape, go back to the past, and preemptively hide a replicated key inside knowing we'd lock ourselves in here.
entries.literal: "Searching for an extra key to this bedroom might sound paranoid since nothing indicates it exists, but it's necessary. If we ignore these precautions, we're leaving a potential escape route for the culprit that can be used at any time.{w} They have higher knowledge of the Sekimeiya than we do, so we have no guarantee that they couldn't obtain a key they would hide later, use it to escape, go back to the past, and preemptively hide a replicated key inside knowing we'd lock ourselves in here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Yeah. Our intention is to be safe in here, so let's search around beforehand.
entries.literal: "...{w}Yeah. Our intention is to be safe in here, so let's search around beforehand."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're saying "be safe", but at the same time, you and Sai keep implying that one of us is behind all this. This person has already killed up to three times, so if what we're doing opposes their plan, wouldn't they just kill us instead of escaping in this convoluted way?
entries.literal: "You're saying \"be safe\", but at the same time, you and Sai keep implying that one of us is behind all this. This person has already killed up to three times, so if what we're doing opposes their plan, wouldn't they just kill us instead of escaping in this convoluted way?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I wouldn't say they'd have an easy time of it, but let's see...{w} Hey, jackass, if you're actually here, we're gonna lock ourselves in this room for six hours.{w} If you intend to kill us to continue with your plan at some point, hurry up and do it now before you need to deal with breaking the door down.
entries.literal: "I wouldn't say they'd have an easy time of it, but let's see...{w} Hey, jackass, if you're actually here, we're gonna lock ourselves in this room for six hours.{w} If you intend to kill us to continue with your plan at some point, hurry up and do it now before you need to deal with breaking the door down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody moved, but it was clear that we all had our guard up. If someone was around and didn't care about killing us if they had to, the right call would likely be to start after we were locked inside so that nobody could run away.
entries.literal: "Nobody moved, but it was clear that we all had our guard up. If someone was around and didn't care about killing us if they had to, the right call would likely be to start after we were locked inside so that nobody could run away."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not like anyone has really spoken up against this plan, right? It might even be that by staying here, we're not inconveniencing some mastermind. In any case, it's undeniably safer than continuing to roam around.
entries.literal: "It's not like anyone has really spoken up against this plan, right? It might even be that by staying here, we're not inconveniencing some mastermind. In any case, it's undeniably safer than continuing to roam around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That seemed to assuage Akaro's worries.{w} The six of us went to the upper section of the bedroom to inspect it. I used that time to try to prevent something really bad from happening, as Sai's insistence made me realize something else was to come.
entries.literal: "That seemed to assuage Akaro's worries.{w} The six of us went to the upper section of the bedroom to inspect it. I used that time to try to prevent something really bad from happening, as Sai's insistence made me realize something else was to come."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The space was small, so we shortly determined that there were no keys anywhere.
entries.literal: "The space was small, so we shortly determined that there were no keys anywhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We repeated the process below, and once again, it seemed nothing had been preemptively hidden, revealing that nobody had already attempted to outsmart us.
entries.literal: "We repeated the process below, and once again, it seemed nothing had been preemptively hidden, revealing that nobody had already attempted to outsmart us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We're ready, then.
entries.literal: "We're ready, then."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't be silly. We're missing the most important part.
entries.literal: "Don't be silly. We're missing the most important part."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.literal: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We need to search everyone. Someone could currently have the key.
entries.literal: "We need to search everyone. Someone could currently have the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, as I'd thought, Sai wouldn't miss such an obvious procedure. It was very important to do it, but in our situation, it meant something else: the key to Naomi's locker that I'd kept on myself was likely about to be found.
entries.literal: "Of course, as I'd thought, Sai wouldn't miss such an obvious procedure. It was very important to do it, but in our situation, it meant something else: the key to Naomi's locker that I'd kept on myself was likely about to be found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya must've been aware of it too. As soon as I found myself in that unavoidable situation, there was nothing I could do without being seen. ...All I managed to do was prepare a risky trick before we went up the ladder, and I'd already begun to run through possible excuses while foolishly regretting that I hadn't hidden it in the bathroom.
entries.literal: "Shiroya must've been aware of it too. As soon as I found myself in that unavoidable situation, there was nothing I could do without being seen. ...All I managed to do was prepare a risky trick before we went up the ladder, and I'd already begun to run through possible excuses while foolishly regretting that I hadn't hidden it in the bathroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: When we were up top, I made sure nobody had the funny idea of leaving anything hidden for later. I am very sure that, right now, both sections of this bedroom don't contain anything the culprit has deliberately left here.{w} I'll begin.
entries.literal: "When we were up top, I made sure nobody had the funny idea of leaving anything hidden for later. I am very sure that, right now, both sections of this bedroom don't contain anything the culprit has deliberately left here.{w} I'll begin."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai showed us the contents of every one of his pockets, his hip pack, and shoes. He held the original key to the bedroom, but he'd been gripping it even before we'd started to look around. However, he took something else from one of his back pockets.
entries.literal: "Sai showed us the contents of every one of his pockets, his hip pack, and shoes. He held the original key to the bedroom, but he'd been gripping it even before we'd started to look around. However, he took something else from one of his back pockets."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is the key to my house and my identification, and this is the ticket for today's event. I have nothing else on me.
entries.literal: "This is the key to my house and my identification, and this is the ticket for today's event. I have nothing else on me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's all do the same.
entries.literal: "Let's all do the same."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hold on. You don't mean to say that proves you're clean, do you?
entries.literal: "Hold on. You don't mean to say that proves you're clean, do you?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My objection had a reason behind it.{w} That method of showing we didn't possess anything was highly disadvantageous for me. Even though letting them find my key wouldn't have been the worst, Shiroya and I would've become very suspicious, and if anyone realized what the key was for, they would all see the Sekimeiya in the locker. Furthermore, it'd bring back the commotion Erina had been trying to eliminate. That was why I took the single chance I believed I had.
entries.literal: "My objection had a reason behind it.{w} That method of showing we didn't possess anything was highly disadvantageous for me. Even though letting them find my key wouldn't have been the worst, Shiroya and I would've become very suspicious, and if anyone realized what the key was for, they would all see the Sekimeiya in the locker. Furthermore, it'd bring back the commotion Erina had been trying to eliminate. That was why I took the single chance I believed I had."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, of course... Do you want me to get naked?
entries.literal: "No, of course... Do you want me to get naked?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Just a while ago, you said we should do this well. You could have a key under your clothes, yes, but you don't have to undress.
entries.literal: "Just a while ago, you said we should do this well. You could have a key under your clothes, yes, but you don't have to undress."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to him, and like a security agent, I began patting his body from top to bottom.
entries.literal: "I walked up to him, and like a security agent, I began patting his body from top to bottom."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right, now you can say you're clean.
entries.literal: "All right, now you can say you're clean."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, thank God. I was going to do this too, don't worry. ...Let's continue with you, then.
entries.literal: "Well, thank God. I was going to do this too, don't worry. ...Let's continue with you, then."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I just wanted to make sure, and that's fine, since you won't find anything.
entries.literal: "I just wanted to make sure, and that's fine, since you won't find anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I immediately knew that I had sounded a little off. It was intentional, to set the expectation that nothing would be found on me.{w} As such, when he got to the right pocket of my pants, he looked at me with a frown, noticing that I'd been incorrect.
entries.literal: "I immediately knew that I had sounded a little off. It was intentional, to set the expectation that nothing would be found on me.{w} As such, when he got to the right pocket of my pants, he looked at me with a frown, noticing that I'd been incorrect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took that brief moment of surprise to take out what he'd felt from my pocket.
entries.literal: "I took that brief moment of surprise to take out what he'd felt from my pocket."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Ah, right. I'd forgotten I put this key there.
entries.literal: "Ah, right. I'd forgotten I put this key there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With two fingers, I was gripping the Sekimeiya cabinet key. I moved aside and placed it on top of the drawers.
entries.literal: "With two fingers, I was gripping the Sekimeiya cabinet key. I moved aside and placed it on top of the drawers."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'll leave it here; we need to lock ourselves inside with it, as I said before.
entries.literal: "I'll leave it here; we need to lock ourselves inside with it, as I said before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trying to appear nonchalant, I walked back and told Sai to continue. Like I'd done to him, he finished checking the lower part of my body.
entries.literal: "Trying to appear nonchalant, I walked back and told Sai to continue. Like I'd done to him, he finished checking the lower part of my body."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Okay, you're clean too.{w} Katei, mind being next?
entries.literal: "...Okay, you're clean too.{w} Katei, mind being next?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a deep, discreet breath. Shiroya had been fixing her eyes on me, but I'd attempted not to meet them. I stepped back, and Katei took my place.
entries.literal: "I took a deep, discreet breath. Shiroya had been fixing her eyes on me, but I'd attempted not to meet them. I stepped back, and Katei took my place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to Shiroya's side; she was probably wondering if I'd already gotten rid of the key. Later, without being heard, I'd have to tell her what I'd done. Despite how things seemed, it was still located in my right pocket.
entries.literal: "I moved to Shiroya's side; she was probably wondering if I'd already gotten rid of the key. Later, without being heard, I'd have to tell her what I'd done. Despite how things seemed, it was still located in my right pocket."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before going up the ladder, I'd thought that I had only one way to avoid being found out; I would've been easily noticed if I attempted to leave the key somewhere.{w} Taking advantage of the fact that I also had the cabinet key and that it was slightly bigger, I'd removed the locker key from my back pocket and slid it into the same pocket as the cabinet's. Until that point, I'd avoided keeping both together so that I didn't produce metallic noises as I walked.
entries.literal: "Before going up the ladder, I'd thought that I had only one way to avoid being found out; I would've been easily noticed if I attempted to leave the key somewhere.{w} Taking advantage of the fact that I also had the cabinet key and that it was slightly bigger, I'd removed the locker key from my back pocket and slid it into the same pocket as the cabinet's. Until that point, I'd avoided keeping both together so that I didn't produce metallic noises as I walked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The locker key was small. I'd purposely put it horizontally behind the cabinet's so that Sai would press his hand on it and only notice the bigger shape at the front.{w} Fortunately, I'd been able to abuse his minor surprise by taking out the cabinet key and leaving the smaller one inside. When the body inspection proceeded, he assumed the right pocket was clean and didn't check it again.
entries.literal: "The locker key was small. I'd purposely put it horizontally behind the cabinet's so that Sai would press his hand on it and only notice the bigger shape at the front.{w} Fortunately, I'd been able to abuse his minor surprise by taking out the cabinet key and leaving the smaller one inside. When the body inspection proceeded, he assumed the right pocket was clean and didn't check it again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Hm, what's this?
entries.literal: "...Hm, what's this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked up. Sai was feeling one of Katei's pockets, and it appeared he'd found something inside. That time, it was Sai who first put his hand in and retrieved, yet again, a key.
entries.literal: "I looked up. Sai was feeling one of Katei's pockets, and it appeared he'd found something inside. That time, it was Sai who first put his hand in and retrieved, yet again, a key."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, right. I'd also forgotten I had this.
entries.literal: "Oh, right. I'd also forgotten I had this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all recognized it. It was the old-looking key we'd found on the floor of hallway A.
entries.literal: "We all recognized it. It was the old-looking key we'd found on the floor of hallway A."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Didn't you say you'd keep it somewhere safe?
entries.literal: "Didn't you say you'd keep it somewhere safe?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I forgot, but don't worry. My pocket is plenty safe.
entries.literal: "I forgot, but don't worry. My pocket is plenty safe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After staring at it, Sai put the key back in.{w} In the next pocket, he found something else. For the third time in a row, they were keys.
entries.literal: "After staring at it, Sai put the key back in.{w} In the next pocket, he found something else. For the third time in a row, they were keys."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You know these four as well. One is for the bathrooms, another is for the security room, this one opens my locker in the staff room, and this one is for the door leading to floor 2.
entries.literal: "You know these four as well. One is for the bathrooms, another is for the security room, this one opens my locker in the staff room, and this one is for the door leading to floor 2."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Silently, Sai finished the inspection without finding anything else. Still unsatisfied, he took out all the keys once again and attempted to insert them into the door's keyhole.
entries.literal: "Silently, Sai finished the inspection without finding anything else. Still unsatisfied, he took out all the keys once again and attempted to insert them into the door's keyhole."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They don't work.{w} You're done, then.
entries.literal: "They don't work.{w} You're done, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He gave the keys back to Katei, and before the next person could be examined, I voiced a thought.
entries.literal: "He gave the keys back to Katei, and before the next person could be examined, I voiced a thought."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That first key... Could it be for the hidden door we found?
entries.literal: "That first key... Could it be for the hidden door we found?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I just thought the same thing. Both have this feeling of being fairly old, and there's no other door in this building that does.
entries.literal: "I just thought the same thing. Both have this feeling of being fairly old, and there's no other door in this building that does."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Huh. You might be right, actually.
entries.literal: "Huh. You might be right, actually."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We thought the culprit dropped it in a hurry. If that's what happened, it could be why they had to remove the handle.
entries.literal: "We thought the culprit dropped it in a hurry. If that's what happened, it could be why they had to remove the handle."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But the key spent a long time on the floor, so why didn't they retrieve it before we found it? They already left the suitcase in hallway C at some point.
entries.literal: "But the key spent a long time on the floor, so why didn't they retrieve it before we found it? They already left the suitcase in hallway C at some point."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went quiet at the mention of the suitcase. We'd more or less assumed that Naomi had left it there, but we weren't sure anymore.
entries.literal: "We went quiet at the mention of the suitcase. We'd more or less assumed that Naomi had left it there, but we weren't sure anymore."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right... Maybe they wanted to avoid every possibility of being spotted and didn't want to step into hallway A.{w} The fingerprints that you saw... Are they clear enough to be useful? If the police can figure out who they belong to, that could be a path to the culprit.
entries.literal: "You're right... Maybe they wanted to avoid every possibility of being spotted and didn't want to step into hallway A.{w} The fingerprints that you saw... Are they clear enough to be useful? If the police can figure out who they belong to, that could be a path to the culprit."
