entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure. The clear ones were all replaced by mine, but there might've been some more around because you need to push the wall in order to open it.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure. The clear ones were all replaced by mine, but there might've been some more around because you need to push the wall in order to open it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. If whoever it is doesn't go erase them upon realizing that we found them, some should still remain. But if they're one of us, the fingerprints won't mean anything since it won't be provable that they were left before we found the door.
entries.literal: "I see. If whoever it is doesn't go erase them upon realizing that we found them, some should still remain. But if they're one of us, the fingerprints won't mean anything since it won't be provable that they were left before we found the door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. There's one more thing, too.{w} When we discovered the secret door, my first thought was that someone bypassed our searches by hiding there.
entries.literal: "Yeah. There's one more thing, too.{w} When we discovered the secret door, my first thought was that someone bypassed our searches by hiding there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: However, even though the light wasn't very bright, what Shiroya and I initially saw were three distinguishable fingerprints. I don't think any were overlapping.
entries.literal: "However, even though the light wasn't very bright, what Shiroya and I initially saw were three distinguishable fingerprints. I don't think any were overlapping."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You mean that the door was only recently opened once?
entries.literal: "You mean that the door was only recently opened once?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: From hallway A, maybe. If it was only opened once, it can't be that someone went to hide there all the times we searched unless they spent hours inside. Maybe that proves it wasn't one of us.
entries.literal: "From hallway A, maybe. If it was only opened once, it can't be that someone went to hide there all the times we searched unless they spent hours inside. Maybe that proves it wasn't one of us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh...{w} I suppose they could've used the Sekimeiya to teleport inside without opening the wall, but that doesn't sound likely.{w} Anyway, who's next?
entries.literal: "Huh...{w} I suppose they could've used the Sekimeiya to teleport inside without opening the wall, but that doesn't sound likely.{w} Anyway, who's next?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya volunteered.{w} In her case, nothing was found in her clothes. Her purse was almost empty and only contained a wallet, two of the three tickets we'd bought for the event, our personal identification to match the tickets, and the key to my house.
entries.literal: "Shiroya volunteered.{w} In her case, nothing was found in her clothes. Her purse was almost empty and only contained a wallet, two of the three tickets we'd bought for the event, our personal identification to match the tickets, and the key to my house."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro was next. In the same way, his inspection was handled quickly, and once again, personal keys, his identification, and his own entrance ticket were all we found on him. It wasn't surprising, as the same kind of body search would also be performed before entering the tower.
entries.literal: "Akaro was next. In the same way, his inspection was handled quickly, and once again, personal keys, his identification, and his own entrance ticket were all we found on him. It wasn't surprising, as the same kind of body search would also be performed before entering the tower."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right, done. Finally, I don't mean to suspect you, Erina, but ignoring you would defeat the purpose of what you're trying to accomplish.
entries.literal: "All right, done. Finally, I don't mean to suspect you, Erina, but ignoring you would defeat the purpose of what you're trying to accomplish."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I know. That's fine.
entries.literal: "...I know. That's fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She moved ahead. Usually, it would've been worth considering that the person who proposed the arrangement had a secret reason, but I knew Erina was genuine. Sai gently made sure she hadn't been concealing anything, and by letting us know that her purse was clean as well, he put an end to our last measure.{w} Personal keys and identification had also been found in her purse. We were specifically searching for hidden keys, so even though it was normal we all possessed ours, Sai made sure to confirm that their shape didn't match the bedroom door's.
entries.literal: "She moved ahead. Usually, it would've been worth considering that the person who proposed the arrangement had a secret reason, but I knew Erina was genuine. Sai gently made sure she hadn't been concealing anything, and by letting us know that her purse was clean as well, he put an end to our last measure.{w} Personal keys and identification had also been found in her purse. We were specifically searching for hidden keys, so even though it was normal we all possessed ours, Sai made sure to confirm that their shape didn't match the bedroom door's."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Good, this went well. Now, doing what I explained should be easy.
entries.literal: "Good, this went well. Now, doing what I explained should be easy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since nobody had any complaints, I took one screwdriver out of a drawer and compared it with the screws that kept the door's handle attached.
entries.literal: "Since nobody had any complaints, I took one screwdriver out of a drawer and compared it with the screws that kept the door's handle attached."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It'll work. It's not a perfect match, but it'll definitely suffice.
entries.literal: "It'll work. It's not a perfect match, but it'll definitely suffice."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We wanted to hide the key and outer handle outside, right? There's not much of a point to it since the chain will prevent anyone from entering, but can you think of a good place to hide it?
entries.literal: "We wanted to hide the key and outer handle outside, right? There's not much of a point to it since the chain will prevent anyone from entering, but can you think of a good place to hide it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I feel like under the bathroom carpet is good enough. Like you said, it's not too important.{w} Regarding the handle, no great spot comes to mind, but it doesn't matter anyway. The attic's full of removable handles, so someone outside could probably unscrew one to use it on the door if they really wanted to open it. In case that happens, we have the chain to rely on.
entries.literal: "I feel like under the bathroom carpet is good enough. Like you said, it's not too important.{w} Regarding the handle, no great spot comes to mind, but it doesn't matter anyway. The attic's full of removable handles, so someone outside could probably unscrew one to use it on the door if they really wanted to open it. In case that happens, we have the chain to rely on."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, that sounds fine.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that sounds fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the hallway, we clearly saw Sai leaving the key under the carpet without any kind of trick involved.
entries.literal: "From the hallway, we clearly saw Sai leaving the key under the carpet without any kind of trick involved."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There it is. Only one thing to do, then.
entries.literal: "There it is. Only one thing to do, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all moved back inside. With the big screwdriver, I removed the four screws of the inner handle, which fell on my hands.
entries.literal: "We all moved back inside. With the big screwdriver, I removed the four screws of the inner handle, which fell on my hands."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...It'd be great if we could use this on the storeroom door.
entries.literal: "...It'd be great if we could use this on the storeroom door."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We should all get ready to face the consequences of this. Don't be surprised if Ashiya blows this tiny action out of proportion.
entries.literal: "We should all get ready to face the consequences of this. Don't be surprised if Ashiya blows this tiny action out of proportion."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We get it. That's fine, they can do what they want.
entries.literal: "We get it. That's fine, they can do what they want."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I unscrewed the outer handle too and left both of them under the bed in the opposite bedroom.{w} In the door, only one hole became visible, as the keyhole wasn't found on the handles themselves. I made sure that the door couldn't be opened through the hole. A very short metal cylinder was poking out, but it was incredibly tight; we weren't going to turn it from the inside. When I was certain, I asked one last time.
entries.literal: "I unscrewed the outer handle too and left both of them under the bed in the opposite bedroom.{w} In the door, only one hole became visible, as the keyhole wasn't found on the handles themselves. I made sure that the door couldn't be opened through the hole. A very short metal cylinder was poking out, but it was incredibly tight; we weren't going to turn it from the inside. When I was certain, I asked one last time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Okay, this is it. If I close this door, we won't be able to open it again. Any final objection?
entries.literal: "Okay, this is it. If I close this door, we won't be able to open it again. Any final objection?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the five of them, who knew what their next six hours would be like. Nobody opened their mouth, so I proceeded with the most important action.
entries.literal: "I looked at the five of them, who knew what their next six hours would be like. Nobody opened their mouth, so I proceeded with the most important action."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Slowly, I pushed the door forward. There was no friction against the floor, so I applied force until it satisfyingly set into place.
entries.literal: "Slowly, I pushed the door forward. There was no friction against the floor, so I applied force until it satisfyingly set into place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...We'd sealed ourselves in. Surprisingly, it had taken a fair amount of concord. It was clear that nobody wanted to oppose the request because Erina made it. Any regrets were no longer meaningful.
entries.literal: "...We'd sealed ourselves in. Surprisingly, it had taken a fair amount of concord. It was clear that nobody wanted to oppose the request because Erina made it. Any regrets were no longer meaningful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As the icing on the cake, we set the chain. I attempted to pull the door inward and push it outward, and as expected, it didn't budge. It had become a barrier from both sides, and the only way to unlock it would be telling the police where we'd left the key and detaching the chain for them. Cooperation from both sides was needed.
entries.literal: "As the icing on the cake, we set the chain. I attempted to pull the door inward and push it outward, and as expected, it didn't budge. It had become a barrier from both sides, and the only way to unlock it would be telling the police where we'd left the key and detaching the chain for them. Cooperation from both sides was needed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now we wait. We could do with a deck of cards.
entries.literal: "Now we wait. We could do with a deck of cards."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We don't have any, so just try to stay still and quiet for once. You have been enough of a handful for one day.
entries.literal: "We don't have any, so just try to stay still and quiet for once. You have been enough of a handful for one day."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, there's a lot of resentment within you. How does it feel to know that after we wait six hours, you're gonna go straight to prison?
entries.literal: "Katei, there's a lot of resentment within you. How does it feel to know that after we wait six hours, you're gonna go straight to prison?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I haven't done anything, so that won't happen.
entries.literal: "I haven't done anything, so that won't happen."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, Ashiya doesn't seem to think the same, remember? Wasn't your authority revoked?
entries.literal: "Well, Ashiya doesn't seem to think the same, remember? Wasn't your authority revoked?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What's the time?
entries.literal: "...What's the time?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did nothing else happen to your watch? Seems like it's still working fine.
entries.literal: "Did nothing else happen to your watch? Seems like it's still working fine."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.literal: "Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, you know about that? Yeah, we fixed it earlier.
entries.literal: "Oh, you know about that? Yeah, we fixed it earlier."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, when we were waiting in the lobby, before you two appeared.
entries.literal: "Yes, when we were waiting in the lobby, before you two appeared."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.literal: "Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...You didn't know? Sai asked me if I had lithium batteries because his watch wasn't working. He didn't mention that part when he told you what happened, but it was insignificant.
entries.literal: "...You didn't know? Sai asked me if I had lithium batteries because his watch wasn't working. He didn't mention that part when he told you what happened, but it was insignificant."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's right. How did you know that, Atsuki?
entries.literal: "That's right. How did you know that, Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I wasn't talking about that. It didn't work once before that point. You're still claiming that wasn't you, right?
entries.literal: "I wasn't talking about that. It didn't work once before that point. You're still claiming that wasn't you, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Probably, since I don't know what you're talking about. It was convenient that Katei had the right type of battery in the security room.
entries.literal: "Probably, since I don't know what you're talking about. It was convenient that Katei had the right type of battery in the security room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What time and date was displayed when you changed the battery?
entries.literal: "What time and date was displayed when you changed the battery?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Some minutes earlier than the time shown on the computer, which is when it must've stopped working. Then, I synced it properly again.
entries.literal: "Some minutes earlier than the time shown on the computer, which is when it must've stopped working. Then, I synced it properly again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is that so...?
entries.literal: "Is that so...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know what you two are talking about, but I bet Sai failed at looking innocent again, right?
entries.literal: "I don't know what you two are talking about, but I bet Sai failed at looking innocent again, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Your irony knows no limits. Are you already thinking about how you'll lie to the police?
entries.literal: "Your irony knows no limits. Are you already thinking about how you'll lie to the police?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Stop. We decided to stay here to end these discussions.
entries.literal: "Stop. We decided to stay here to end these discussions."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I know. We're already locked in, though, so I have to rub it in Katei's face. I bet he's crying internally since his plan can't be finished now.
entries.literal: "I know. We're already locked in, though, so I have to rub it in Katei's face. I bet he's crying internally since his plan can't be finished now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But Katei was right. Sai had noticed his watch stopped working again, so like I did, he asked for lithium batteries. That was further indication that he remembered the time he and I fixed the watch.
entries.literal: "...But Katei was right. Sai had noticed his watch stopped working again, so like I did, he asked for lithium batteries. That was further indication that he remembered the time he and I fixed the watch."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I'll go up and wait there.
entries.literal: "...I'll go up and wait there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before the conversation snowballed again, Erina was the one who stopped Sai. To get as far from the door as possible, she chose to go rest in the upper bedroom. I knew that the illusion of tranquility was well achieved there, so taking advantage of her opening, I decided to follow her.
entries.literal: "Before the conversation snowballed again, Erina was the one who stopped Sai. To get as far from the door as possible, she chose to go rest in the upper bedroom. I knew that the illusion of tranquility was well achieved there, so taking advantage of her opening, I decided to follow her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We will too. Separating ourselves into two groups of three will be the best way to utilize the space.
entries.literal: "We will too. Separating ourselves into two groups of three will be the best way to utilize the space."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Taking my cue, Shiroya went up with me. It seemed that Erina wanted to distance herself from the commotion that Sai and Katei continued to spawn, so by claiming the upstairs area for ourselves, we at least had a chance to remain unbothered for a long time.
entries.literal: "Taking my cue, Shiroya went up with me. It seemed that Erina wanted to distance herself from the commotion that Sai and Katei continued to spawn, so by claiming the upstairs area for ourselves, we at least had a chance to remain unbothered for a long time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina was sitting on a bed. She didn't pay much attention to our presence, so we silently sat on the opposite one.{w} Although six hours still had to pass, I promptly realized that I was still exhausted. It was possible I could sleep and fast-forward to {time=21.}
entries.literal: "Erina was sitting on a bed. She didn't pay much attention to our presence, so we silently sat on the opposite one.{w} Although six hours still had to pass, I promptly realized that I was still exhausted. It was possible I could sleep and fast-forward to {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd closed the hatch, so we couldn't hear the people under us. If they decided to keep arguing with moderate voices, we wouldn't hear it.
entries.literal: "We'd closed the hatch, so we couldn't hear the people under us. If they decided to keep arguing with moderate voices, we wouldn't hear it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was time to disconnect. I'd been actively trying to piece everything together, but after choosing to abandon that, only time would force me to go back, in the case that something horrible awaited us at the end of the road.{w} At least, that was what I'd been ready to accept.
entries.literal: "It was time to disconnect. I'd been actively trying to piece everything together, but after choosing to abandon that, only time would force me to go back, in the case that something horrible awaited us at the end of the road.{w} At least, that was what I'd been ready to accept."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You two didn't do anything to Isla, right...?
entries.literal: "You two didn't do anything to Isla, right...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Taking both of us by surprise, Erina broke the silence she had set up. We raised our heads to see her deep eyes peering at us.
entries.literal: "Taking both of us by surprise, Erina broke the silence she had set up. We raised our heads to see her deep eyes peering at us."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Absolutely not...! We were sleeping in the other bedroom when everything happened.
entries.literal: "Absolutely not...! We were sleeping in the other bedroom when everything happened."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Is it possible one of you left while the other was sleeping?
entries.literal: "Is it possible one of you left while the other was sleeping?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...There's no way that happened.
entries.literal: "...There's no way that happened."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Do you two... trust each other that much even though there's a... a killer around? Are you two related? I saw that only one of you had house keys.
entries.literal: "Do you two... trust each other that much even though there's a... a killer around? Are you two related? I saw that only one of you had house keys."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...We're just friends. Unfortunately, we have no way to prove it, but I promise that we left after... Isla was found.
entries.literal: "...We're just friends. Unfortunately, we have no way to prove it, but I promise that we left after... Isla was found."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Earlier, I thought that Sai had a point. Why did you go straight to the lobby from hallway B without looking at the cleaning room?
entries.literal: "...Earlier, I thought that Sai had a point. Why did you go straight to the lobby from hallway B without looking at the cleaning room?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That was my mistake. I should've acted as if we had already seen the cart and the missing Sekimeiya, but without a second thought, I had tried to appear surprised to make it seem like we'd never entered the room and couldn't have hidden it.
entries.literal: "...That was my mistake. I should've acted as if we had already seen the cart and the missing Sekimeiya, but without a second thought, I had tried to appear surprised to make it seem like we'd never entered the room and couldn't have hidden it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It might sound iffy, but what we said earlier was the truth. We went to the bathroom and then checked the event room and the lobby, where we thought people could be.
entries.literal: "It might sound iffy, but what we said earlier was the truth. We went to the bathroom and then checked the event room and the lobby, where we thought people could be."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Then, is Katei the only person who could've done it?
entries.literal: "Then, is Katei the only person who could've done it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Him...? Right, a lot of things regarding his whereabouts still don't make sense, but it shouldn't be that straightforward. It could've been an accident caused by the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Him...? Right, a lot of things regarding his whereabouts still don't make sense, but it shouldn't be that straightforward. It could've been an accident caused by the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It was no accident. Isla saw something inside that cabinet, so she must've been lured there. Katei could've made her disappear; he's known about the Sekimeiya for longer than anyone else.{w} Then, he showed up after he left Isla's body in the cabinet... You two have experienced what the Sekimeiya does, but I don't know how to think about it.
entries.literal: "It was no accident. Isla saw something inside that cabinet, so she must've been lured there. Katei could've made her disappear; he's known about the Sekimeiya for longer than anyone else.{w} Then, he showed up after he left Isla's body in the cabinet... You two have experienced what the Sekimeiya does, but I don't know how to think about it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's possible that she... was sent to the cabinet from the future, right? Isn't that similar to something you said a while ago? If that happened, it could've been anyone, but she would have to still... be alive.
entries.literal: "It's possible that she... was sent to the cabinet from the future, right? Isn't that similar to something you said a while ago? If that happened, it could've been anyone, but she would have to still... be alive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was clear that Erina was attaching herself to the slightest gleam of hope that still persisted. The recording "proved" that Isla would be alive in the future, so Erina needed the time to pass to know if there was any trust left to be placed in it. She must've suggested waiting in the room in the hope of nothing occurring at {time=21.}
entries.literal: "It was clear that Erina was attaching herself to the slightest gleam of hope that still persisted. The recording \"proved\" that Isla would be alive in the future, so Erina needed the time to pass to know if there was any trust left to be placed in it. She must've suggested waiting in the room in the hope of nothing occurring at {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I've been thinking about it, but I don't know what could've happened. I-I'm sorry...
entries.literal: "I've been thinking about it, but I don't know what could've happened. I-I'm sorry..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to give her even more hope, but I stopped myself, knowing that it would only make things worse if I was wrong. Even if Isla would somehow be alive in a month, her fate had already been shown to us: she would end up dead in the crystal floor's cabinet even if she had to travel there from a month in the future.
entries.literal: "I wanted to give her even more hope, but I stopped myself, knowing that it would only make things worse if I was wrong. Even if Isla would somehow be alive in a month, her fate had already been shown to us: she would end up dead in the crystal floor's cabinet even if she had to travel there from a month in the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At least, that was what I thought until I remembered that the two Naomi bodies defied that belief.{w} I believed that no matter what had happened to Isla, being dead inside the cabinet had to be the end of her path. However, two identical corpses hinted that the Sekimeiya could have some sway even after death. That was the actual hope Erina had to rely on—the recording didn't guarantee a bright future even if it turned out to be legitimate.
entries.literal: "At least, that was what I thought until I remembered that the two Naomi bodies defied that belief.{w} I believed that no matter what had happened to Isla, being dead inside the cabinet had to be the end of her path. However, two identical corpses hinted that the Sekimeiya could have some sway even after death. That was the actual hope Erina had to rely on—the recording didn't guarantee a bright future even if it turned out to be legitimate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In that instant, I felt a bubble of hope growing in my head.{w} The Sekimeiya hadn't caused any apparent effect when it touched Isla's dead body, even though we might not have seen it immediately. If that had created a living version of her at an earlier point in time like I speculated with Naomi... My thoughts were directed to Miiya once again.
entries.literal: "In that instant, I felt a bubble of hope growing in my head.{w} The Sekimeiya hadn't caused any apparent effect when it touched Isla's dead body, even though we might not have seen it immediately. If that had created a living version of her at an earlier point in time like I speculated with Naomi... My thoughts were directed to Miiya once again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But that bubble popped as soon as images of her burnt pieces of flesh appeared in my mind. The Sekimeiya had to exist somewhere two weeks in the past, but how could I touch a body that had been blown to pieces?
entries.literal: "...But that bubble popped as soon as images of her burnt pieces of flesh appeared in my mind. The Sekimeiya had to exist somewhere two weeks in the past, but how could I touch a body that had been blown to pieces?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I forced myself to stop thinking. The three of us present in the room had all lost someone very dear to us, and we all silently prayed that somehow they could be brought back.
entries.literal: "I forced myself to stop thinking. The three of us present in the room had all lost someone very dear to us, and we all silently prayed that somehow they could be brought back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was cruel to consider that there was a culprit somewhere who had killed at least once, possessing a higher knowledge of how the Sekimeiya worked—exactly what all of us needed the most.
entries.literal: "It was cruel to consider that there was a culprit somewhere who had killed at least once, possessing a higher knowledge of how the Sekimeiya worked—exactly what all of us needed the most."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...It's my fault, isn't it? It doesn't matter who did it... I brought her here.
entries.literal: "...It's my fault, isn't it? It doesn't matter who did it... I brought her here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I bought the tickets for today... to make Isla happy. And instead, she...
entries.literal: "I bought the tickets for today... to make Isla happy. And instead, she..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It should have been me. Why would anyone want to hurt Isla?
entries.literal: "It should have been me. Why would anyone want to hurt Isla?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea how to respond to something as dark as that, and Shiroya clearly didn't either. We lapsed into silence for a few minutes. Part of Erina, I was sure, believed that Isla was still alive somewhere, while another part accepted that she was dead and already mourned her.
entries.literal: "I had no idea how to respond to something as dark as that, and Shiroya clearly didn't either. We lapsed into silence for a few minutes. Part of Erina, I was sure, believed that Isla was still alive somewhere, while another part accepted that she was dead and already mourned her."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Do you know about Akashic Park?
entries.literal: "...Do you know about Akashic Park?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: The amusement park?
entries.literal: "The amusement park?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd heard about it. It was a few hours away from Yushibana. Apparently, it was surrounded by mountains, and it competed worldwide for the largest park in size. Its selling point was that it contained "all possible configurations of every ride in the world", so despite my low interest, it had piqued my curiosity more than once.
entries.literal: "I'd heard about it. It was a few hours away from Yushibana. Apparently, it was surrounded by mountains, and it competed worldwide for the largest park in size. Its selling point was that it contained \"all possible configurations of every ride in the world\", so despite my low interest, it had piqued my curiosity more than once."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You might've thought Isla was obsessed with the gems downstairs, but that didn't even come close to how much she wanted to go there. ...She brought it up countless times, but it's really expensive, and I've always been a bit afraid of ride malfunctions.
entries.literal: "You might've thought Isla was obsessed with the gems downstairs, but that didn't even come close to how much she wanted to go there. ...She brought it up countless times, but it's really expensive, and I've always been a bit afraid of ride malfunctions."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I was going to have more money than usual this month since it's the end of the year. I decided to finally give in and surprise her with a trip after Christmas...
entries.literal: "I was going to have more money than usual this month since it's the end of the year. I decided to finally give in and surprise her with a trip after Christmas..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I told her about it less than a week ago, in case she preferred to hold off with the money and plan a trip during the summer instead. Even though she was really excited at first, she actually told me that she didn't want to go.
entries.literal: "I told her about it less than a week ago, in case she preferred to hold off with the money and plan a trip during the summer instead. Even though she was really excited at first, she actually told me that she didn't want to go."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I couldn't believe it, but she said that she didn't want to leave her friend alone while she went to have fun. At one point, she also said that she would only come to see the Sekimeiya because I already bought the tickets and she didn't want to make me waste money... even though she started to talk about her friend before we got the tickets.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it, but she said that she didn't want to leave her friend alone while she went to have fun. At one point, she also said that she would only come to see the Sekimeiya because I already bought the tickets and she didn't want to make me waste money... even though she started to talk about her friend before we got the tickets."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I told you the other ways her behavior changed, right? I forgot one. Sometimes, she hid something from me. A small object, I believe.
entries.literal: "I told you the other ways her behavior changed, right? I forgot one. Sometimes, she hid something from me. A small object, I believe."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's what it felt like. I noticed... a few times, she'd keep her hand in a fist for a long time. If I asked her to show me what she was hiding, she would run off, so I had to ignore it. It must've been something very small.
entries.literal: "That's what it felt like. I noticed... a few times, she'd keep her hand in a fist for a long time. If I asked her to show me what she was hiding, she would run off, so I had to ignore it. It must've been something very small."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I can't get it all out of my head... Whatever happened to Isla started weeks ago, and I never realized it.
entries.literal: "I can't get it all out of my head... Whatever happened to Isla started weeks ago, and I never realized it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of that was difficult to respond to, so I stayed quiet. However, Shiroya said something far from the shallow answers I'd kept to myself.
entries.literal: "All of that was difficult to respond to, so I stayed quiet. However, Shiroya said something far from the shallow answers I'd kept to myself."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hold on... Erina, I might know who Isla's friend was.
entries.literal: "Hold on... Erina, I might know who Isla's friend was."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh-What...? Who?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? Who?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned. How could she have known that? The only ideas I'd kept in mind were an imaginary friend, a Xyn member, and a staff member from the tower.
entries.literal: "I frowned. How could she have known that? The only ideas I'd kept in mind were an imaginary friend, a Xyn member, and a staff member from the tower."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm not sure if it makes sense... When we learned about her friend's story, we hadn't experienced the Sekimeiya's powers yet. But just now... I thought of something that could make a lot of sense.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure if it makes sense... When we learned about her friend's story, we hadn't experienced the Sekimeiya's powers yet. But just now... I thought of something that could make a lot of sense."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Apparently, she and her friend were living together, but you said that was impossible since you hadn't seen her.
entries.literal: "Apparently, she and her friend were living together, but you said that was impossible since you hadn't seen her."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Could it be that her friend was herself? After traveling to the past?
entries.literal: "Could it be that her friend was herself? After traveling to the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}With that sentence, the huge but simple possibility opened up in my mind. I hadn't considered it at all since I'd been blinded by conspiracies, but I immediately understood why Shiroya reached that idea.
entries.literal: "...{w}With that sentence, the huge but simple possibility opened up in my mind. I hadn't considered it at all since I'd been blinded by conspiracies, but I immediately understood why Shiroya reached that idea."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: H-Herself...? What are you talking about!? I would've seen her!
entries.literal: "H-Herself...? What are you talking about!? I would've seen her!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... think Shiroya might be right.
entries.literal: "I... think Shiroya might be right."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You would've seen her, yes. You said that she started to disobey you sometimes, and you even found her at home once instead of being at school.
entries.literal: "You would've seen her, yes. You said that she started to disobey you sometimes, and you even found her at home once instead of being at school."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Right. They were actively keeping her identity from you because they felt like they couldn't reveal that another Isla had appeared, but when one of them went to school or to do what you instructed her to do, the other couldn't follow. During those instances, you could have been seeing the Isla who came from the future.
entries.literal: "Right. They were actively keeping her identity from you because they felt like they couldn't reveal that another Isla had appeared, but when one of them went to school or to do what you instructed her to do, the other couldn't follow. During those instances, you could have been seeing the Isla who came from the future."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh-What...? Did I just imagine that her behavior changed? She distanced herself and spent much less time with me...
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? Did I just imagine that her behavior changed? She distanced herself and spent much less time with me..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then this is one of the few things that explains it. Why else would she hide a friend from you? She didn't have bad intentions, and neither did her friend.
entries.literal: "Then this is one of the few things that explains it. Why else would she hide a friend from you? She didn't have bad intentions, and neither did her friend."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "We watched my favorite movie together, and it was her favorite too!" "She went to the aquarium last month, just like us!" I recalled a few things Erina had said.
entries.literal: "\"We watched my favorite movie together, and it was her favorite too!\" \"She went to the aquarium last month, just like us!\" I recalled a few things Erina had said."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The way Isla described her friend made it sound as if she'd made up a persona that had her own traits and experienced the same events. However, it was herself from the future, wasn't it...? She wasn't lying.
entries.literal: "The way Isla described her friend made it sound as if she'd made up a persona that had her own traits and experienced the same events. However, it was herself from the future, wasn't it...? She wasn't lying."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why else would she refuse to go to the amusement park? Both of them couldn't go at once, so she must not have wanted to leave her behind, knowing firsthand how much she wanted to go too.
entries.literal: "Why else would she refuse to go to the amusement park? Both of them couldn't go at once, so she must not have wanted to leave her behind, knowing firsthand how much she wanted to go too."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Then, right now, she's outside...!
entries.literal: "Then, right now, she's outside...!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Isla... specifically said her friend was waiting for her outside.
entries.literal: "Isla... specifically said her friend was waiting for her outside."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That has to be it! She will exist in a month!
entries.literal: "That has to be it! She will exist in a month!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I didn't want to deny it, but it wasn't that simple.{w} In fact, nothing about her fate had changed.{w} I could assemble things the following way: "when Isla disappeared from the cabinet, she went far into the past. The range should've been a lot bigger, but we might be wrong about that part. In a month, that Isla will somehow enter the tower".
entries.literal: "...I didn't want to deny it, but it wasn't that simple.{w} In fact, nothing about her fate had changed.{w} I could assemble things the following way: \"when Isla disappeared from the cabinet, she went far into the past. The range should've been a lot bigger, but we might be wrong about that part. In a month, that Isla will somehow enter the tower\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Tragically, no matter what I thought up, the following step had to be: "Isla travels to the past and ends up dead in the cabinet". There was no way to end it differently.{w} However, even though the voice recorder had appeared in Isla's purse, the origin of it was still unexplained with that theory.
entries.literal: "Tragically, no matter what I thought up, the following step had to be: \"Isla travels to the past and ends up dead in the cabinet\". There was no way to end it differently.{w} However, even though the voice recorder had appeared in Isla's purse, the origin of it was still unexplained with that theory."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina's head lowered, and her expression went back to how it had been minutes before.
entries.literal: "Erina's head lowered, and her expression went back to how it had been minutes before."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I don't know. I appreciate that you want to believe Isla, but there's no way what she said was true. You remember what her friend supposedly told her about today's incident, right?
entries.literal: "...I don't know. I appreciate that you want to believe Isla, but there's no way what she said was true. You remember what her friend supposedly told her about today's incident, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I'd tried to leave the major inconsistency for the end, but Erina was right.
entries.literal: "...I'd tried to leave the major inconsistency for the end, but Erina was right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Hm... She told me that something would happen in the tower, but not to worry. She said that if we stayed calm in one place, nobody would be hurt. And she promised I'd be able to see and touch the Sekimeiya, so she was right, wasn't she?"
entries.literal: "\"Hm... She told me that something would happen in the tower, but not to worry. She said that if we stayed calm in one place, nobody would be hurt. And she promised I'd be able to see and touch the Sekimeiya, so she was right, wasn't she?\""

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah... According to her, there was going to be no danger. ...And she said that only seven people would get trapped.
entries.literal: "Yeah... According to her, there was going to be no danger. ...And she said that only seven people would get trapped."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Exactly. There's no way she'd say those things after seeing Naomi's body and after everything else that happened.
entries.literal: "Exactly. There's no way she'd say those things after seeing Naomi's body and after everything else that happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Actually, this isn't what I'm the most worried about. Thinking about it conceptually, this is something that cannot work.
entries.literal: "Actually, this isn't what I'm the most worried about. Thinking about it conceptually, this is something that cannot work."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Conceptually...? You have time traveled, right? Things that would normally be impossible are happening. You've said so yourself.
entries.literal: "Conceptually...? You have time traveled, right? Things that would normally be impossible are happening. You've said so yourself."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not what I mean. We've come to the conclusion that the past can't be changed, so what we're suggesting is that Isla met her own self who had traveled from the future. They kept her existence hidden from you, and the friend let the original Isla know about today's events.
entries.literal: "That's not what I mean. We've come to the conclusion that the past can't be changed, so what we're suggesting is that Isla met her own self who had traveled from the future. They kept her existence hidden from you, and the friend let the original Isla know about today's events."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Ignoring that what she was told was incorrect, the next step is flawed. She can't go back to the past and "relive what she experienced". She would have to replicate exactly what her friend had done and said, as the past would occur exactly as it already had. There's naturally no way she would willingly do that.
entries.literal: "Ignoring that what she was told was incorrect, the next step is flawed. She can't go back to the past and \"relive what she experienced\". She would have to replicate exactly what her friend had done and said, as the past would occur exactly as it already had. There's naturally no way she would willingly do that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Isla said they'd been hanging out a lot, so as I said, conceptually, it's incredibly unreasonable to think that she spent the time as her friend knowing how everything would play out.{w} You saw her once when she hadn't gone to school, which should be an impossibility since she would've known you would see her, and she would've avoided that.
entries.literal: "Isla said they'd been hanging out a lot, so as I said, conceptually, it's incredibly unreasonable to think that she spent the time as her friend knowing how everything would play out.{w} You saw her once when she hadn't gone to school, which should be an impossibility since she would've known you would see her, and she would've avoided that."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I see... Y-You're right. It's not possible. I hadn't seen it like that...
entries.literal: "I see... Y-You're right. It's not possible. I hadn't seen it like that..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Everything we think about goes back to the same core: we don't really understand how the Sekimeiya works. We can't say it's not possible, but the way we're currently thinking about it can't function.
entries.literal: "Everything we think about goes back to the same core: we don't really understand how the Sekimeiya works. We can't say it's not possible, but the way we're currently thinking about it can't function."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I've made up arbitrary rules to explain a few things that have occurred, but as long as they work, we can't discard them. If traveling so long to the past made Isla's memory fuzzy, for example, she might not have remembered the time she spent with herself.
entries.literal: "I've made up arbitrary rules to explain a few things that have occurred, but as long as they work, we can't discard them. If traveling so long to the past made Isla's memory fuzzy, for example, she might not have remembered the time she spent with herself."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: From her perspective, that would've been happening for the first time, so she would've acted on her own without being aware that she was repeating everything. She would've also misremembered what occurred today and given Isla false information that she trusted completely.
entries.literal: "From her perspective, that would've been happening for the first time, so she would've acted on her own without being aware that she was repeating everything. She would've also misremembered what occurred today and given Isla false information that she trusted completely."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: All right... Thank you.
entries.literal: "All right... Thank you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of continuing, Erina turned around and lay on the bed while Shiroya and I looked lost. Her idea had a lot of promise, but it appeared ultimately impossible until we had more information.{w} I'd usually been able to create a patchwork design out of the loose ends of a theory, but in that case, I couldn't think of anything else. Needless to say, I didn't think any part of my memory had been erased upon traveling—although, to be fair, perhaps I wouldn't have realized it.
entries.literal: "Instead of continuing, Erina turned around and lay on the bed while Shiroya and I looked lost. Her idea had a lot of promise, but it appeared ultimately impossible until we had more information.{w} I'd usually been able to create a patchwork design out of the loose ends of a theory, but in that case, I couldn't think of anything else. Needless to say, I didn't think any part of my memory had been erased upon traveling—although, to be fair, perhaps I wouldn't have realized it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were we completely off-base? Was it all just a scheme planned by someone? Before I gave up on the idea, an extra piece of the puzzle that we'd ignored came back to me.
entries.literal: "Were we completely off-base? Was it all just a scheme planned by someone? Before I gave up on the idea, an extra piece of the puzzle that we'd ignored came back to me."

entries.speaker: il2
entries.text: ...Where am I...?
entries.literal: "...Where am I...?"

entries.speaker: sai2
entries.text: Wh-What do you mean? We're still in Ashiya Tower. Do you not remember?
entries.literal: "Wh-What do you mean? We're still in Ashiya Tower. Do you not remember?"

entries.speaker: il2
entries.text: No, I know. What I mean is... What happened to me? Where am I?
entries.literal: "No, I know. What I mean is... What happened to me? Where am I?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Following that, there were a couple of unsteady, heavy footfalls, most likely someone staggering. During the next few seconds, Isla cried, and nobody spoke, inside or outside the recording."
entries.literal: "\"Following that, there were a couple of unsteady, heavy footfalls, most likely someone staggering. During the next few seconds, Isla cried, and nobody spoke, inside or outside the recording.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those were words said by Isla, and they were scheduled to happen in about a month. Was the dark meaning behind Isla's future actions... that she'd discovered the fate that awaited her?
entries.literal: "Those were words said by Isla, and they were scheduled to happen in about a month. Was the dark meaning behind Isla's future actions... that she'd discovered the fate that awaited her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had she found out that she had died and that her fate had been sealed?
entries.literal: "Had she found out that she had died and that her fate had been sealed?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "...What happened to me? Where am I?" I remembered the agonizing way that sounded.
entries.literal: "\"...What happened to me? Where am I?\" I remembered the agonizing way that sounded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I breathed deeply, but anxiety began to crawl up my back, exacerbated by my own lack of knowledge.{w} I hated exploring all sorts of options without knowing if I'd ever find the truth. Isla's bleak ending had already been revealed to us, making the process of putting together its outline all the more draining.
entries.literal: "I breathed deeply, but anxiety began to crawl up my back, exacerbated by my own lack of knowledge.{w} I hated exploring all sorts of options without knowing if I'd ever find the truth. Isla's bleak ending had already been revealed to us, making the process of putting together its outline all the more draining."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya was resting her head on top of a large pillow. We'd been there for a little while, and the people below us hadn't interrupted us yet. It seemed like relaxing would be an actual option.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was resting her head on top of a large pillow. We'd been there for a little while, and the people below us hadn't interrupted us yet. It seemed like relaxing would be an actual option."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I climbed over Shiroya and lay down, making contact with the cold wall. She was occupying both pillows, so I knew I'd have a hard time staying in a comfortable position. Trying to not mind it, I closed my eyes.
entries.literal: "I climbed over Shiroya and lay down, making contact with the cold wall. She was occupying both pillows, so I knew I'd have a hard time staying in a comfortable position. Trying to not mind it, I closed my eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As usual, attempting to keep my mind blank was futile, but the contents of what tormented me were very different. Time travel, a smoke attack, body doubles, murders, suspicion... What kind of mess were we in?
entries.literal: "As usual, attempting to keep my mind blank was futile, but the contents of what tormented me were very different. Time travel, a smoke attack, body doubles, murders, suspicion... What kind of mess were we in?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was aware that there was no guarantee I'd ever feel my own bed again, depending on what the truth around us really was. Ironically, the stiff bed began to help me get rid of those thoughts, and my senses slowly faded away.
entries.literal: "I was aware that there was no guarantee I'd ever feel my own bed again, depending on what the truth around us really was. Ironically, the stiff bed began to help me get rid of those thoughts, and my senses slowly faded away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody moved for many minutes.
entries.literal: "Nobody moved for many minutes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Atsuki! Who do you think you are!?
entries.literal: "Atsuki! Who do you think you are!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to lose touch with reality when a sound brought me back to my surroundings. The three of us were startled simultaneously and looked at the hatch that had just opened.
entries.literal: "I was about to lose touch with reality when a sound brought me back to my surroundings. The three of us were startled simultaneously and looked at the hatch that had just opened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei appeared through the hatch with a dour expression. Since he'd addressed me, I tried to stand up, but I could only support my torso with an arm.
entries.literal: "Katei appeared through the hatch with a dour expression. Since he'd addressed me, I tried to stand up, but I could only support my torso with an arm."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Atsuki!{w} Did you really think you could get out of this with simple threats? Those will not work on me, so once we make it out, you can say goodbye to your normal life.
entries.literal: "Atsuki!{w} Did you really think you could get out of this with simple threats? Those will not work on me, so once we make it out, you can say goodbye to your normal life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't comprehend a word of what he was saying. He'd sat on the bed and put his face up close to mine. His eyes told me that he was being serious, but I couldn't help but respond with an exaggerated frown.
entries.literal: "I couldn't comprehend a word of what he was saying. He'd sat on the bed and put his face up close to mine. His eyes told me that he was being serious, but I couldn't help but respond with an exaggerated frown."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you listening to me!?
entries.literal: "Are you listening to me!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the hell are you on about...?
entries.literal: "What the hell are you on about...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Stop with your façade. It all makes sense, and I know Shiroya must be working with you.
entries.literal: "Stop with your façade. It all makes sense, and I know Shiroya must be working with you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For a second, I thought he might've figured out we'd hidden the Sekimeiya and decided to blow it out of proportion.
entries.literal: "For a second, I thought he might've figured out we'd hidden the Sekimeiya and decided to blow it out of proportion."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Don't worry, Erina, I know he's been threatening you from the start. We're all locked up here, so now he can't pull one of his tricks.
entries.literal: "Don't worry, Erina, I know he's been threatening you from the start. We're all locked up here, so now he can't pull one of his tricks."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: When I left the lobby earlier, you were who followed me, not Sai. However, you made the others cover for you. That wasn't a smart move, idiot.
entries.literal: "When I left the lobby earlier, you were who followed me, not Sai. However, you made the others cover for you. That wasn't a smart move, idiot."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I didn't realize that everything was a fabrication. You killed the first Naomi and had everyone else lie about it. That's why you made up the elevator noise: to frame me or someone else.
entries.literal: "I didn't realize that everything was a fabrication. You killed the first Naomi and had everyone else lie about it. That's why you made up the elevator noise: to frame me or someone else."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you fucking out of your mind...? Why would I want to frame you if everyone else was covering for me?
entries.literal: "Are you fucking out of your mind...? Why would I want to frame you if everyone else was covering for me?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do not try to change the facts. When the second Naomi died, conveniently, I ended up on floor 6 while you and everyone you'd threatened were under me. That's why you could all act as if you had an alibi for her death.
entries.literal: "Do not try to change the facts. When the second Naomi died, conveniently, I ended up on floor 6 while you and everyone you'd threatened were under me. That's why you could all act as if you had an alibi for her death."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You knew about the attic key and had been here already. You could've had every key from the beginning.
entries.literal: "You knew about the attic key and had been here already. You could've had every key from the beginning."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Right! How did I ignore such suspicious behavior? You and Shiroya left the attic and didn't come back for fifty minutes! And then the Sekimeiya mysteriously disappeared!
entries.literal: "...Right! How did I ignore such suspicious behavior? You and Shiroya left the attic and didn't come back for fifty minutes! And then the Sekimeiya mysteriously disappeared!"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But you instructed Sai to immediately act suspiciously as soon as we went down to confuse me.
entries.literal: "But you instructed Sai to immediately act suspiciously as soon as we went down to confuse me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite everything that had occurred, my bewilderment thus far couldn't compare to what I felt from the words I was hearing.
entries.literal: "Despite everything that had occurred, my bewilderment thus far couldn't compare to what I felt from the words I was hearing."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: And then... Isla died. You were behind that, right? You tried to make us believe that you were sleeping as it happened! How did I swallow that lie...?{w} Shiroya found the hidden passage in the storeroom? How was I so stupid...? You were about to use it...!
entries.literal: "And then... Isla died. You were behind that, right? You tried to make us believe that you were sleeping as it happened! How did I swallow that lie...?{w} Shiroya found the hidden passage in the storeroom? How was I so stupid...? You were about to use it...!"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Before showing up in the lobby, you came from hallway B! You were too stupid to appear from hallway A after removing the Sekimeiya from the cleaning room!
entries.literal: "Before showing up in the lobby, you came from hallway B! You were too stupid to appear from hallway A after removing the Sekimeiya from the cleaning room!"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No wonder you sided with Erina and wanted everyone to stay locked in here. After all, you'd hidden the Sekimeiya and could safely sleep like you were doing just now. Did you actually think any of this would work?
entries.literal: "No wonder you sided with Erina and wanted everyone to stay locked in here. After all, you'd hidden the Sekimeiya and could safely sleep like you were doing just now. Did you actually think any of this would work?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Are you just fucking around, or are you really this dumb?
entries.literal: "...{w}Are you just fucking around, or are you really this dumb?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I suppose you're not going to give up. You two are the culprits behind this incident.{w} Why were you in the first group of the guided visit when you've shown no interest in the gems? Now that I've learned about it, you must confess. I know you didn't attempt to threaten me individually since I work here and there's no way I'd give in to you.
entries.literal: "I suppose you're not going to give up. You two are the culprits behind this incident.{w} Why were you in the first group of the guided visit when you've shown no interest in the gems? Now that I've learned about it, you must confess. I know you didn't attempt to threaten me individually since I work here and there's no way I'd give in to you."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm having a hard time following. Do you actually believe what you're saying?
entries.literal: "I'm having a hard time following. Do you actually believe what you're saying?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei's face shifted. I couldn't understand what was happening.
entries.literal: "Katei's face shifted. I couldn't understand what was happening."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I never thought you were brilliant, but come on. There are some huge inconsistencies with everything that you said. What's gotten into you?
entries.literal: "I never thought you were brilliant, but come on. There are some huge inconsistencies with everything that you said. What's gotten into you?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of replying, he looked at Erina. Upon seeing that she didn't immediately corroborate his story, he breathed faintly to keep calm.
entries.literal: "Instead of replying, he looked at Erina. Upon seeing that she didn't immediately corroborate his story, he breathed faintly to keep calm."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm serious, tell me. Did you just rub some brain cells together for this and come here thinking that you'd cracked the mystery? I discarded a few theories earlier because they relied on you being completely brainless, but now I should reconsider them.
entries.literal: "I'm serious, tell me. Did you just rub some brain cells together for this and come here thinking that you'd cracked the mystery? I discarded a few theories earlier because they relied on you being completely brainless, but now I should reconsider them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, he decided to remain quiet.
entries.literal: "Once again, he decided to remain quiet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Subsequently, he retraced his steps and looked through the hatch. My perception of him had been changing as time advanced, but it had suddenly taken a significant turn. I still hadn't processed a few of the things he said.
entries.literal: "Subsequently, he retraced his steps and looked through the hatch. My perception of him had been changing as time advanced, but it had suddenly taken a significant turn. I still hadn't processed a few of the things he said."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell...? That son of a bitch...!
entries.literal: "What the hell...? That son of a bitch...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was time to stand up. I moved first since Katei had forcefully changed my mood. I walked up to him, and ignoring his awkwardly placed body, I kneeled down, trying to understand what he was looking at.
entries.literal: "...It was time to stand up. I moved first since Katei had forcefully changed my mood. I walked up to him, and ignoring his awkwardly placed body, I kneeled down, trying to understand what he was looking at."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What? There's no way...
entries.literal: "...What? There's no way..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Akaro weren't there.{w} From the hatch, I could see the entire lower bedroom devoid of any human presence.
entries.literal: "Sai and Akaro weren't there.{w} From the hatch, I could see the entire lower bedroom devoid of any human presence."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Where are they? They couldn't have left...
entries.literal: "Where are they? They couldn't have left..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went down the ladder.{w} They weren't in the wardrobe or under the bed.{w} Countless questions hammered from inside my head, but I immediately went to check the door.
entries.literal: "I went down the ladder.{w} They weren't in the wardrobe or under the bed.{w} Countless questions hammered from inside my head, but I immediately went to check the door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The chain isn't set.
entries.literal: "The chain isn't set."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I said that out loud to inform the others who still remained upstairs. I attempted to get the door to open, but it still was locked in place.
entries.literal: "I said that out loud to inform the others who still remained upstairs. I attempted to get the door to open, but it still was locked in place."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't get it... How did they do it?
entries.literal: "I don't get it... How did they do it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had to be around {time=15:30.} I doubted we'd been in the bedroom for more than 25 minutes. No matter what had happened, it was clear that calmness wasn't what awaited us.
entries.literal: "It had to be around {time=15:30.} I doubted we'd been in the bedroom for more than 25 minutes. No matter what had happened, it was clear that calmness wasn't what awaited us."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...At first, Sai began telling me that you'd threatened him and went into detail explaining how you'd managed to accomplish everything.
entries.literal: "...At first, Sai began telling me that you'd threatened him and went into detail explaining how you'd managed to accomplish everything."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I didn't believe him at all, but he started to make some compelling arguments. It was Sai, though, so I didn't take him seriously.
entries.literal: "I didn't believe him at all, but he started to make some compelling arguments. It was Sai, though, so I didn't take him seriously."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: However, even though Akaro had been looking at him with skepticism from the start, after a while, he confirmed Sai's story and gave us his version. He said you'd threatened him too, that Erina had fallen victim as well.
entries.literal: "However, even though Akaro had been looking at him with skepticism from the start, after a while, he confirmed Sai's story and gave us his version. He said you'd threatened him too, that Erina had fallen victim as well."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm sorry... But at that time, everything was pieced together, and I truly believed them.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry... But at that time, everything was pieced together, and I truly believed them."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This is too much... So they escaped after you went through the hatch?
entries.literal: "This is too much... So they escaped after you went through the hatch?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know how, but yes.
entries.literal: "I don't know how, but yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea what was happening. Leaving should've been impossible, let alone in such a short time.
entries.literal: "I had no idea what was happening. Leaving should've been impossible, let alone in such a short time."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Both of them probably wanted you to go up so they could leave without being seen.
entries.literal: "Both of them probably wanted you to go up so they could leave without being seen."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And your stupidity was the perfect base for that to work. Like flour in a cake.
entries.literal: "And your stupidity was the perfect base for that to work. Like flour in a cake."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Maybe the lock could be forced with something like a card, but it'd take a long time. There's no way they could've escaped in less than a minute.
entries.literal: "Maybe the lock could be forced with something like a card, but it'd take a long time. There's no way they could've escaped in less than a minute."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The chain isn't set, so they definitely left through the door.
entries.literal: "The chain isn't set, so they definitely left through the door."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Would we not have heard it if they'd forced it open? Maybe it was removed as a trick, to make us think they used the door.
entries.literal: "Would we not have heard it if they'd forced it open? Maybe it was removed as a trick, to make us think they used the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hated that feeling. We'd been shoved into another mystery without solving anything, and Sai's plan had worked. Additionally, it appeared that Akaro had no problem working with him to create a story where I was the main culprit.
entries.literal: "I hated that feeling. We'd been shoved into another mystery without solving anything, and Sai's plan had worked. Additionally, it appeared that Akaro had no problem working with him to create a story where I was the main culprit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We would've left eventually, but the notion that nobody would be able to go back to the past if we stayed there was already obsolete. It had become possible for Sai and Akaro to appear in the past, if that was part of their intent.
entries.literal: "We would've left eventually, but the notion that nobody would be able to go back to the past if we stayed there was already obsolete. It had become possible for Sai and Akaro to appear in the past, if that was part of their intent."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though Erina hadn't reacted strongly, there was an important implication: Sai and Akaro worked together, so they could've orchestrated the recording if they'd either worked with Isla or threatened her.
entries.literal: "Even though Erina hadn't reacted strongly, there was an important implication: Sai and Akaro worked together, so they could've orchestrated the recording if they'd either worked with Isla or threatened her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Does it even matter? This is the logic Sai used when Shiroya and I left the attic: if something happens, it'll be their fault. Can we not apply it now?
entries.literal: "Does it even matter? This is the logic Sai used when Shiroya and I left the attic: if something happens, it'll be their fault. Can we not apply it now?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Admittedly, I was tired, and my body demanded me to sleep again.
entries.literal: "Admittedly, I was tired, and my body demanded me to sleep again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're crazy. They played us like this!
entries.literal: "You're crazy. They played us like this!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: They played you. Do you want to break the door open? We agreed to stay here until the police come, and now we've learned who the culprits were. They must've had a goal in mind, and it's very likely they accomplished it already. You can go search for them if you think that'll do anything.
entries.literal: "They played you. Do you want to break the door open? We agreed to stay here until the police come, and now we've learned who the culprits were. They must've had a goal in mind, and it's very likely they accomplished it already. You can go search for them if you think that'll do anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was exhausted. I let my body fall onto the bed at my side and disconnected from the conversation.
entries.literal: "I was exhausted. I let my body fall onto the bed at my side and disconnected from the conversation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei began knocking on the door and yelling. I didn't know what to think, as I couldn't bring myself to completely trust his story. If everything actually happened like he said, Sai and Akaro would have clearly communicated that they had ulterior motives—which they'd managed to keep mostly hidden until that point—even though they escaped.
entries.literal: "Katei began knocking on the door and yelling. I didn't know what to think, as I couldn't bring myself to completely trust his story. If everything actually happened like he said, Sai and Akaro would have clearly communicated that they had ulterior motives—which they'd managed to keep mostly hidden until that point—even though they escaped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Leaving anyway meant that they'd needed to get out so badly, they didn't care.
entries.literal: "Leaving anyway meant that they'd needed to get out so badly, they didn't care."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: *sigh* Should we try to leave? They were probably hoping we'd still stay here after they escaped, which is why they blatantly did so.
entries.literal: "*sigh* Should we try to leave? They were probably hoping we'd still stay here after they escaped, which is why they blatantly did so."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't want to. I'm not sure what Akaro's deal is, but if Sai was the only one to escape, I would've thought that his motive was to make us chase after him to undo the bedroom lock.{w} If they're still in the tower, there's not much they can do. They can go to the past or hide the Sekimeiya, but they'd still be trapped in here. Even if they went far back enough to exit the tower, there's no reason for us to chase them.
entries.literal: "I don't want to. I'm not sure what Akaro's deal is, but if Sai was the only one to escape, I would've thought that his motive was to make us chase after him to undo the bedroom lock.{w} If they're still in the tower, there's not much they can do. They can go to the past or hide the Sekimeiya, but they'd still be trapped in here. Even if they went far back enough to exit the tower, there's no reason for us to chase them."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But what if one of them had the handle for the hidden exit? They could leave with the Sekimeiya!
entries.literal: "But what if one of them had the handle for the hidden exit? They could leave with the Sekimeiya!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then they're already gone. However, if they could open it, they would've done that earlier.
entries.literal: "Then they're already gone. However, if they could open it, they would've done that earlier."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Th-They could've figured out a way to open the door after they found it!
entries.literal: "Th-They could've figured out a way to open the door after they found it!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei sighed in exasperation and set the chain again. The key was outside, so the chain would prevent Akaro and Sai from returning.
entries.literal: "Katei sighed in exasperation and set the chain again. The key was outside, so the chain would prevent Akaro and Sai from returning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Why is the culprit hiding the Sekimeiya if we'll be able to find it?" That recurring question felt similar to our present situation.{w} What could they have wanted to achieve by making it out? Unless they wanted to experiment with the Sekimeiya or hide it, the only reason I could produce was that they'd needed to go back in time to finish something off.
entries.literal: "\"Why is the culprit hiding the Sekimeiya if we'll be able to find it?\" That recurring question felt similar to our present situation.{w} What could they have wanted to achieve by making it out? Unless they wanted to experiment with the Sekimeiya or hide it, the only reason I could produce was that they'd needed to go back in time to finish something off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other question was a lot more intriguing to me: how had they escaped? There was time to break the door open, and there was no way we'd missed a hidden person who'd opened it from the outside.
entries.literal: "The other question was a lot more intriguing to me: how had they escaped? There was time to break the door open, and there was no way we'd missed a hidden person who'd opened it from the outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To open the door, the key would have been needed. There was no other way to accomplish it. However, we knew it couldn't have been inside the bedroom.{w} As I'd thought earlier, the only way to undo the lock was by using the key from the outside and then unsetting the chain from the inside.
entries.literal: "To open the door, the key would have been needed. There was no other way to accomplish it. However, we knew it couldn't have been inside the bedroom.{w} As I'd thought earlier, the only way to undo the lock was by using the key from the outside and then unsetting the chain from the inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With my eyes closed and without giving it much thought, I could reach a very easy explanation, similar to what Sai proposed before we'd locked ourselves in the bedroom:{w} "they left through the door and went to the past with the Sekimeiya. Then, they opened the bedroom's door with the key that we hid under the bathroom carpet. To escape, they simply pulled the door open from the inside, which would've been slightly open".
entries.literal: "With my eyes closed and without giving it much thought, I could reach a very easy explanation, similar to what Sai proposed before we'd locked ourselves in the bedroom:{w} \"they left through the door and went to the past with the Sekimeiya. Then, they opened the bedroom's door with the key that we hid under the bathroom carpet. To escape, they simply pulled the door open from the inside, which would've been slightly open\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was reminiscent of the first bootstrap paradox concept I'd thought of a few hours earlier. The clean, brief way they'd managed to escape could have been an indication that it was accepted in our universe.
