entries.literal: "It was reminiscent of the first bootstrap paradox concept I'd thought of a few hours earlier. The clean, brief way they'd managed to escape could have been an indication that it was accepted in our universe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was an inherent property of those types of paradoxes: they had no origin. They were closed loops that occurred with no root or motive whatsoever.
entries.literal: "There was an inherent property of those types of paradoxes: they had no origin. They were closed loops that occurred with no root or motive whatsoever."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Their escape method, though, had a real origin.{w} Sai's and Akaro's thoughts.
entries.literal: "Their escape method, though, had a real origin.{w} Sai's and Akaro's thoughts."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If one of them had thought of the way to escape, the final thing they needed to perform it was the universe's approval. They would've set an intangible origin of the loop, making it fundamentally different from a causal loop.
entries.literal: "If one of them had thought of the way to escape, the final thing they needed to perform it was the universe's approval. They would've set an intangible origin of the loop, making it fundamentally different from a causal loop."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The key to the Sekimeiya cabinet isn't there...
entries.literal: "The key to the Sekimeiya cabinet isn't there..."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.literal: "Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd realized that to accomplish that sort of plan, they had to escape with the cabinet key to be able to go to the past. Upon turning my head, I'd seen that it wasn't on top of the drawers where I'd left it anymore.
entries.literal: "I'd realized that to accomplish that sort of plan, they had to escape with the cabinet key to be able to go to the past. Upon turning my head, I'd seen that it wasn't on top of the drawers where I'd left it anymore."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell did they want to do?
entries.literal: "What the hell did they want to do?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In short, Sai and Akaro could've attempted one type of escape route: they knew where the Sekimeiya was, so they were in reach of one of the points necessary to accomplish the creation of the loop. After thinking of the way things would play out, they baited Katei out of the room. Subsequently, they left through an unlocked door.
entries.literal: "In short, Sai and Akaro could've attempted one type of escape route: they knew where the Sekimeiya was, so they were in reach of one of the points necessary to accomplish the creation of the loop. After thinking of the way things would play out, they baited Katei out of the room. Subsequently, they left through an unlocked door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The last thing they had to do was travel back in time and unlock the door. If a result of their travel hadn't incited the idea to travel in the first place, their loop had a clear starting point. It also implied they were both culprits in the incident—we knew that any culprit possessed higher knowledge of the Sekimeiya's mechanics and limits.
entries.literal: "The last thing they had to do was travel back in time and unlock the door. If a result of their travel hadn't incited the idea to travel in the first place, their loop had a clear starting point. It also implied they were both culprits in the incident—we knew that any culprit possessed higher knowledge of the Sekimeiya's mechanics and limits."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a slight problem: unlocking the door from the outside would make a bit of noise. If it happened before they thought of the concept, the loop would have no origin, as the noise itself would tell them what to do.{w} I couldn't think of a way to circumvent it easily. If the key could fit under the door, their future selves could've slid it inside. However, the gap wasn't big enough, or else we would've simply locked ourselves in and slid it out of the bedroom.
entries.literal: "There was a slight problem: unlocking the door from the outside would make a bit of noise. If it happened before they thought of the concept, the loop would have no origin, as the noise itself would tell them what to do.{w} I couldn't think of a way to circumvent it easily. If the key could fit under the door, their future selves could've slid it inside. However, the gap wasn't big enough, or else we would've simply locked ourselves in and slid it out of the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Beyond that concept, I felt that Katei's story was iffy. As likely as it was that Sai and Akaro could've conspired together, nothing told us Katei hadn't been in on it too.{w} They could've spent half an hour unlocking the door and then made it seem as if they'd magically escaped. Katei immediately suggested unlocking the bedroom to us, making for a simple motive if all three of them were secretly against Erina's request.
entries.literal: "Beyond that concept, I felt that Katei's story was iffy. As likely as it was that Sai and Akaro could've conspired together, nothing told us Katei hadn't been in on it too.{w} They could've spent half an hour unlocking the door and then made it seem as if they'd magically escaped. Katei immediately suggested unlocking the bedroom to us, making for a simple motive if all three of them were secretly against Erina's request."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai! Akaro! What the hell are you trying to do!?
entries.literal: "Sai! Akaro! What the hell are you trying to do!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei continued knocking on the door, acting accordingly for someone who'd been played as badly as him.
entries.literal: "Katei continued knocking on the door, acting accordingly for someone who'd been played as badly as him."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Hey! Sai! Akaro!
entries.literal: "Hey! Sai! Akaro!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, Katei. I'm sure they'll come back if you ask nicely.
entries.literal: "Yes, Katei. I'm sure they'll come back if you ask nicely."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you not worried at all about what they could be trying to do?
entries.literal: "Are you not worried at all about what they could be trying to do?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Not very much. If they're the culprits, we're safer now that they left. All they can do is go back in time, which sounds fairly harmless at this point—and unavoidable.
entries.literal: "Not very much. If they're the culprits, we're safer now that they left. All they can do is go back in time, which sounds fairly harmless at this point—and unavoidable."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're right there. It's now clear that they were the culprits, so if they come back, we won't let them in.
entries.literal: "You're right there. It's now clear that they were the culprits, so if they come back, we won't let them in."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sure, so you can stop with the knocking. They have the Sekimeiya, though, so I'm betting they could teleport back inside if they really wanted to.
entries.literal: "Sure, so you can stop with the knocking. They have the Sekimeiya, though, so I'm betting they could teleport back inside if they really wanted to."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...That's not a great thought to keep in mind.
entries.literal: "...That's not a great thought to keep in mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei stepped aside. It appeared we'd decided to stay.
entries.literal: "Katei stepped aside. It appeared we'd decided to stay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though Shiroya and Erina hadn't given their input, I figured they wanted that too and were likely dumbfounded by the fact that our self-imposed imprisonment hadn't even lasted for thirty minutes.
entries.literal: "Even though Shiroya and Erina hadn't given their input, I figured they wanted that too and were likely dumbfounded by the fact that our self-imposed imprisonment hadn't even lasted for thirty minutes."

entries.text: Cable-Stayed
entries.literal: "Cable-Stayed"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Synchronized, we all looked at the door. As we thought, Katei was no longer in front of it.
entries.literal: "Synchronized, we all looked at the door. As we thought, Katei was no longer in front of it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the...? Did they come back?
entries.literal: "What the...? Did they come back?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Hey! Who is it!?
entries.literal: "...Hey! Who is it!?"

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: It's me. What are you doing here?
entries.literal: "It's me. What are you doing here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without a doubt, Akaro was behind the door.
entries.literal: "Without a doubt, Akaro was behind the door."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Don't play dumb. We won't let you in!
entries.literal: "Don't play dumb. We won't let you in!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Wait, wh-who...?{w} What the fuck happened to this handle...?
entries.literal: "Wait, wh-who...?{w} What the fuck happened to this handle...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ignoring Katei's assertion, Akaro began to forcefully attempt to open the door. We understood he had the key, as we heard it being turned over and over.
entries.literal: "Ignoring Katei's assertion, Akaro began to forcefully attempt to open the door. We understood he had the key, as we heard it being turned over and over."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell are you doing!? You're not getting back in!
entries.literal: "What the hell are you doing!? You're not getting back in!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But he was mistaken. After a few seconds of Akaro's struggle, the chain burst out and the door opened. Akaro's figure was behind it, and we saw the key placed in the outer keyhole.
entries.literal: "But he was mistaken. After a few seconds of Akaro's struggle, the chain burst out and the door opened. Akaro's figure was behind it, and we saw the key placed in the outer keyhole."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...That's not a very good chain.
entries.literal: "...That's not a very good chain."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What do you think you're doing!? Where's Sai!?
entries.literal: "What do you think you're doing!? Where's Sai!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone was speechless. The chain hadn't broken, but it had been forced open. It was old, so it wasn't too surprising. Apparently, my plan had an obvious hole from the start.
entries.literal: "Everyone was speechless. The chain hadn't broken, but it had been forced open. It was old, so it wasn't too surprising. Apparently, my plan had an obvious hole from the start."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Strangely, Akaro wore a very confused expression. He looked at us one by one.
entries.literal: "Strangely, Akaro wore a very confused expression. He looked at us one by one."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What the fuck...? Who are you?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...? Who are you?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seconds of silence followed. Nobody knew how to answer, as we weren't sure who that had been directed at.
entries.literal: "Seconds of silence followed. Nobody knew how to answer, as we weren't sure who that had been directed at."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Who, me...?
entries.literal: "Who, me...?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes!
entries.literal: "Yes!"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What's your game? Are you going to pretend you don't recognize me?
entries.literal: "...What's your game? Are you going to pretend you don't recognize me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro responded by looking at the rest of us, expecting to be backed up. However, his confusion only grew when he realized we found his words to be the strange ones.
entries.literal: "Akaro responded by looking at the rest of us, expecting to be backed up. However, his confusion only grew when he realized we found his words to be the strange ones."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Excuse me? Why are you all looking at me like that? Where the fuck did this man appear from?
entries.literal: "...Excuse me? Why are you all looking at me like that? Where the fuck did this man appear from?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You will not trick me twice.
entries.literal: "You will not trick me twice."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Where's Sai?
entries.literal: "Where's Sai?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Sai? I have no idea. He left the room earlier and didn't come back. What are you all even doing here?
entries.literal: "Sai? I have no idea. He left the room earlier and didn't come back. What are you all even doing here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I saw how lost he looked, I began to take him seriously. He sounded genuine, but not a thing he was saying made sense.
entries.literal: "As I saw how lost he looked, I began to take him seriously. He sounded genuine, but not a thing he was saying made sense."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What do you mean? Do you really not remember Katei?
entries.literal: "What do you mean? Do you really not remember Katei?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Katei? Is that his name?{w} Where should I remember him from?
entries.literal: "Katei? Is that his name?{w} Where should I remember him from?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He's been with us the whole time.
entries.literal: "He's been with us the whole time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He took a few seconds to answer, during which he eyed me like I'd gone insane.
entries.literal: "He took a few seconds to answer, during which he eyed me like I'd gone insane."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Why... are you all lying? What's happening?
entries.literal: "Why... are you all lying? What's happening?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...H-Huh? What do you mean?
entries.literal: "...H-Huh? What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, he looked at Shiroya. Like the rest of us, she was taken aback, as the two of them had barely exchanged words since we'd gotten trapped.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, he looked at Shiroya. Like the rest of us, she was taken aback, as the two of them had barely exchanged words since we'd gotten trapped."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I mean... what I said. Why are you all here?
entries.literal: "I mean... what I said. Why are you all here?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We tried to stay put in one place together. Do you not remember that?
entries.literal: "We tried to stay put in one place together. Do you not remember that?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No, I do. That doesn't answer my question, though.
entries.literal: "No, I do. That doesn't answer my question, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How does it not answer your question? You and Sai escaped, and now you came back.
entries.literal: "How does it not answer your question? You and Sai escaped, and now you came back."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What!? That's not true! I didn't escape.
entries.literal: "What!? That's not true! I didn't escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't quite grasp it, but something felt off about Akaro's behavior. Past his bizarre claims, he seemed more aggressive, and his voice sounded more composed. Not only that, but he'd been fixing his gaze on Shiroya.
entries.literal: "I couldn't quite grasp it, but something felt off about Akaro's behavior. Past his bizarre claims, he seemed more aggressive, and his voice sounded more composed. Not only that, but he'd been fixing his gaze on Shiroya."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Akaro, why did you come back? Do you intend to stay here again?
entries.literal: "Akaro, why did you come back? Do you intend to stay here again?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: The door was locked, so were you all waiting here? I'm very confused.
entries.literal: "The door was locked, so were you all waiting here? I'm very confused."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What you are is a lying piece of shit. Do you think you can simply come back acting as if nothing happened?
entries.literal: "What you are is a lying piece of shit. Do you think you can simply come back acting as if nothing happened?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't know who you are, but don't yell at me. I'm not opposed to staying here, but you'll all need to explain yourselves.
entries.literal: "I don't know who you are, but don't yell at me. I'm not opposed to staying here, but you'll all need to explain yourselves."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina moved forward and took the key out of the door. She brought Akaro inside, closed the door, and locked it. Then, she set the chain again.
entries.literal: "Erina moved forward and took the key out of the door. She brought Akaro inside, closed the door, and locked it. Then, she set the chain again."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Even if the chain can be ignored from the outside, we'll easily hear it if someone tries to force it open again.{w} I was probably wrong before. We should've kept the key inside to avoid all this. I'll keep it with me. This way, if Sai comes, he won't be able to enter or let anyone leave easily.
entries.literal: "Even if the chain can be ignored from the outside, we'll easily hear it if someone tries to force it open again.{w} I was probably wrong before. We should've kept the key inside to avoid all this. I'll keep it with me. This way, if Sai comes, he won't be able to enter or let anyone leave easily."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What about Isla? Aren't you going to go get her?
entries.literal: "What about Isla? Aren't you going to go get her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: None of us could believe what we were hearing. Had he forgotten what had happened, or was he talking about her dead body?
entries.literal: "None of us could believe what we were hearing. Had he forgotten what had happened, or was he talking about her dead body?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know what you're trying, but it's futile. You're revealing your true colors by trying to play dumb.
entries.literal: "I don't know what you're trying, but it's futile. You're revealing your true colors by trying to play dumb."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I don't understand anything. I saw that the elevator was fixed, but how did you all get here?
entries.literal: "...I don't understand anything. I saw that the elevator was fixed, but how did you all get here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Again, such an ambiguous question couldn't be answered by any of us since we didn't comprehend its meaning.
entries.literal: "Again, such an ambiguous question couldn't be answered by any of us since we didn't comprehend its meaning."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...The elevator? That was fixed a long time ago. And where do you mean...?
entries.literal: "...The elevator? That was fixed a long time ago. And where do you mean...?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Here, the Ashiya floor.
entries.literal: "Here, the Ashiya floor."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Uh... With the key Naomi had. Do you actually not remember that?
entries.literal: "Uh... With the key Naomi had. Do you actually not remember that?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Are you fucking with me...?
entries.literal: "Are you fucking with me...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: She's not. What's wrong with that?
entries.literal: "She's not. What's wrong with that?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well... I don't get it. Where was the key, exactly?
entries.literal: "Well... I don't get it. Where was the key, exactly?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: In one of her pockets.
entries.literal: "In one of her pockets."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: But... there's no way.
entries.literal: "But... there's no way."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you not remember that Naomi died?
entries.literal: "Do you not remember that Naomi died?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What? No... I mean, when was her body found?
entries.literal: "What? No... I mean, when was her body found?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Many hours ago.
entries.literal: "Many hours ago."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro closed his eyes and took a deep breath. He was as confused as us.
entries.literal: "Akaro closed his eyes and took a deep breath. He was as confused as us."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Are you all lying to me?
entries.literal: "Are you all lying to me?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's funny of you to say. Wasn't it you who told me that Atsuki had been threatening everyone?
entries.literal: "That's funny of you to say. Wasn't it you who told me that Atsuki had been threatening everyone?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Excuse me...? I never said that.
entries.literal: "Excuse me...? I never said that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My head was going numb. I had no way to interpret what I was hearing.
entries.literal: "My head was going numb. I had no way to interpret what I was hearing."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: This is ridiculous. Did you all go insane?
entries.literal: "This is ridiculous. Did you all go insane?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If you're being sincere, it's clear that your memories contradict ours. What time do you think it is?
entries.literal: "If you're being sincere, it's clear that your memories contradict ours. What time do you think it is?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I have no idea, but I don't think it's {time=16} yet.
entries.literal: "I have no idea, but I don't think it's {time=16} yet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right, that matches the current time. What do you remember, beginning at the start of our imprisonment?
entries.literal: "Right, that matches the current time. What do you remember, beginning at the start of our imprisonment?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Atsuki, please don't tell me you're playing along. He's trying to manipulate us, and this time it's a lot more obvious.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, please don't tell me you're playing along. He's trying to manipulate us, and this time it's a lot more obvious."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Shut up. As I said, we stayed put, but eventually, you all left. Then, I went to find you and I heard knocks coming from here.
entries.literal: "Shut up. As I said, we stayed put, but eventually, you all left. Then, I went to find you and I heard knocks coming from here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not how it happened. You and Sai were the only ones who left. Do you not remember anything from the time before we started to wait?
entries.literal: "That's not how it happened. You and Sai were the only ones who left. Do you not remember anything from the time before we started to wait?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I understood why Katei didn't want me to humor Akaro, but not too long ago, I'd considered the possibility that the Sekimeiya could cause memory loss. I wanted to know if that was possible, as it could've let Isla's story occur as we'd imagined it.{w} If Akaro had traveled through time after escaping, it could have been the direct cause of the state he was in.
entries.literal: "I understood why Katei didn't want me to humor Akaro, but not too long ago, I'd considered the possibility that the Sekimeiya could cause memory loss. I wanted to know if that was possible, as it could've let Isla's story occur as we'd imagined it.{w} If Akaro had traveled through time after escaping, it could have been the direct cause of the state he was in."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I-I'm having trouble understanding what you're referring to. Before we started to wait? We investigated the building, and Naomi appeared briefly just to disappear again.
entries.literal: "...I-I'm having trouble understanding what you're referring to. Before we started to wait? We investigated the building, and Naomi appeared briefly just to disappear again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not true. You were surprised that Naomi's body was found, but not that she died. Subconsciously, you must've known that, but you didn't remember finding her. Is that right?
entries.literal: "That's not true. You were surprised that Naomi's body was found, but not that she died. Subconsciously, you must've known that, but you didn't remember finding her. Is that right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you sure that nothing happened right before we began to wait?
entries.literal: "Are you sure that nothing happened right before we began to wait?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't know what you're talking about.
entries.literal: "I don't know what you're talking about."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We found a hidden passage in the storeroom, and a door that could lead outside.
entries.literal: "We found a hidden passage in the storeroom, and a door that could lead outside."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You can't be serious. A hidden exit? Why are we still here, then?
entries.literal: "You can't be serious. A hidden exit? Why are we still here, then?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We had no way to open it. Do you really not recall any of that?
entries.literal: "We had no way to open it. Do you really not recall any of that?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't, because it didn't happen. There are no gaps in my memory, so don't treat me as if I'm delusional. Shiroya, tell me, is this some sort of trap?
entries.literal: "I don't, because it didn't happen. There are no gaps in my memory, so don't treat me as if I'm delusional. Shiroya, tell me, is this some sort of trap?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I understand. That's fair, I suppose.
entries.literal: "I understand. That's fair, I suppose."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm sorry to sound so blunt, but is there a reason why you keep talking to her specifically?
entries.literal: "I'm sorry to sound so blunt, but is there a reason why you keep talking to her specifically?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Huh...{w} I don't know how to answer this. I sympathize with you two, as I've already said. That's why it's surprising to see you lying like this.
entries.literal: "Huh...{w} I don't know how to answer this. I sympathize with you two, as I've already said. That's why it's surprising to see you lying like this."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're really saying that this guy has been with us the whole time... I suppose I deserve this treatment, don't I? Why don't you be straight with me, then?
entries.literal: "You're really saying that this guy has been with us the whole time... I suppose I deserve this treatment, don't I? Why don't you be straight with me, then?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Akaro... What the fuck are you talking about?
entries.literal: "Akaro... What the fuck are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You sympathize with us...?
entries.literal: "You sympathize with us...?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Just drop it.
entries.literal: "Just drop it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the hell does that mean!? Everything about you has been suspicious from the start!
entries.literal: "What the hell does that mean!? Everything about you has been suspicious from the start!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I get it.
entries.literal: "I get it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What do you get? Is your plan to drive us insane? Because you're doing a great job!
entries.literal: "What do you get? Is your plan to drive us insane? Because you're doing a great job!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Why won't you answer? ...Why did you say that you sympathize with us?
entries.literal: "Why won't you answer? ...Why did you say that you sympathize with us?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Maybe you're the ones who lost your memories and forgot about the time when you told me.
entries.literal: "Maybe you're the ones who lost your memories and forgot about the time when you told me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Are you out of your mind? Why the hell would we tell you anything about us?{w} No, I get it, the Sekimeiya must've inserted false memories into your head, right? Is that what you're going to say next?
entries.literal: "...Are you out of your mind? Why the hell would we tell you anything about us?{w} No, I get it, the Sekimeiya must've inserted false memories into your head, right? Is that what you're going to say next?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: The Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, you forgot about it too? That's funny.
entries.literal: "Oh, you forgot about it too? That's funny."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I didn't forget about it, of course not. Why would it give me false memories, though?
entries.literal: "I didn't forget about it, of course not. Why would it give me false memories, though?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... wasn't being serious.
entries.literal: "I... wasn't being serious."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was beginning to lose it. Until then, I'd been trying to tackle every mystery calmly no matter how crazy it had been. That time, though, knowing that Akaro could've been lying to us, I couldn't do the same. Was he messing with us and hinting at knowing more about us deliberately? I couldn't tell if he'd been referring to that.
entries.literal: "I was beginning to lose it. Until then, I'd been trying to tackle every mystery calmly no matter how crazy it had been. That time, though, knowing that Akaro could've been lying to us, I couldn't do the same. Was he messing with us and hinting at knowing more about us deliberately? I couldn't tell if he'd been referring to that."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...{w}I could tell you weren't serious, but why did you mention the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...{w}I could tell you weren't serious, but why did you mention the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do I have to give you the rundown? We found out the Sekimeiya could make us travel to the past, so we locked ourselves up to escape from the culprit who's been using it.
entries.literal: "Do I have to give you the rundown? We found out the Sekimeiya could make us travel to the past, so we locked ourselves up to escape from the culprit who's been using it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro didn't answer, but he remained pensive. Since he hadn't objected to the existence of a time travel stone, he must've known about it in some capacity, even if some of his memories had really disappeared.
entries.literal: "Akaro didn't answer, but he remained pensive. Since he hadn't objected to the existence of a time travel stone, he must've known about it in some capacity, even if some of his memories had really disappeared."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is there anything wrong with what I said?
entries.literal: "Is there anything wrong with what I said?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Of course.
entries.literal: "Of course."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You don't seem too fazed after hearing that the Sekimeiya made us travel through time. But earlier, you didn't mention it when you explained your version of events, so how did you know about it?
entries.literal: "You don't seem too fazed after hearing that the Sekimeiya made us travel through time. But earlier, you didn't mention it when you explained your version of events, so how did you know about it?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...{w}I'm not sure.
entries.literal: "...{w}I'm not sure."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're pathetic, Akaro. What's your goal with these theatrics?
entries.literal: "You're pathetic, Akaro. What's your goal with these theatrics?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Shut the fuck up...
entries.literal: "Shut the fuck up..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...In the case he was telling the truth, some of his memories must've remained hidden within his mind, as Naomi's death and the Sekimeiya's powers hadn't been received as a surprise.
entries.literal: "...In the case he was telling the truth, some of his memories must've remained hidden within his mind, as Naomi's death and the Sekimeiya's powers hadn't been received as a surprise."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you really not remember Katei at all? He works in this building, managing the security system. He told us about all of that a while ago.
entries.literal: "Do you really not remember Katei at all? He works in this building, managing the security system. He told us about all of that a while ago."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: None of that happened.
entries.literal: "None of that happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I laughed in frustration. Since we'd gotten trapped, not a single thing had made sense, and when we'd thought we'd begun to have the slightest grasp on some events, Akaro appeared and threw it all into question. If touching the Sekimeiya had caused it, we had probably ignored an extra effect of the travels from the beginning.
entries.literal: "I laughed in frustration. Since we'd gotten trapped, not a single thing had made sense, and when we'd thought we'd begun to have the slightest grasp on some events, Akaro appeared and threw it all into question. If touching the Sekimeiya had caused it, we had probably ignored an extra effect of the travels from the beginning."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wha... Isla?{w} Isla!
entries.literal: "Wha... Isla?{w} Isla!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of a sudden, Erina snapped. Her whole face shifted into the most desperate expression a human could make, and she dashed toward the door, slamming into it.{w} Ignoring that she had the right key and that the chain was set, she tried to pull it open frantically until her motions abruptly stopped.
entries.literal: "All of a sudden, Erina snapped. Her whole face shifted into the most desperate expression a human could make, and she dashed toward the door, slamming into it.{w} Ignoring that she had the right key and that the chain was set, she tried to pull it open frantically until her motions abruptly stopped."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What are you doing!?
entries.literal: "What are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up from the bed, reacting to her sudden change. With Shiroya's help, I grabbed her shoulders before she stopped moving, thinking that she might've suffered from a panic or anxiety attack. Before we could say anything else, she crumpled down and started crying.
entries.literal: "I stood up from the bed, reacting to her sudden change. With Shiroya's help, I grabbed her shoulders before she stopped moving, thinking that she might've suffered from a panic or anxiety attack. Before we could say anything else, she crumpled down and started crying."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla... She's there. I heard her.
entries.literal: "Isla... She's there. I heard her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In a voice distorted by sobs, she let out those words. The four of us exchanged looks, unsettled by that claim.
entries.literal: "In a voice distorted by sobs, she let out those words. The four of us exchanged looks, unsettled by that claim."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though Akaro seemed to have forgotten about Isla's death, he looked confused as well since none of us had heard anything.
entries.literal: "Even though Akaro seemed to have forgotten about Isla's death, he looked confused as well since none of us had heard anything."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She was suffering... I could hear her yell. She's here, outside this door.{w} There. You all hear her too... right?
entries.literal: "She was suffering... I could hear her yell. She's here, outside this door.{w} There. You all hear her too... right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whenever Erina stopped speaking, pure silence filled the room. After she asked us that, we paid attention, but no sound entered our ears.
entries.literal: "Whenever Erina stopped speaking, pure silence filled the room. After she asked us that, we paid attention, but no sound entered our ears."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes... it's her!
entries.literal: "Yes... it's her!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Erina, there's nobody outside...
entries.literal: "Erina, there's nobody outside..."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't hear anything. You should lie down.
entries.literal: "I don't hear anything. You should lie down."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What? No, there's no way...
entries.literal: "What? No, there's no way..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though she said that, her body gave out even further, as she understood that what she was saying couldn't be true.
entries.literal: "Even though she said that, her body gave out even further, as she understood that what she was saying couldn't be true."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She tried to steady herself by supporting her body on the door. I helped her stand back up and brought her closer to the bed.
entries.literal: "She tried to steady herself by supporting her body on the door. I helped her stand back up and brought her closer to the bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was forcefully shutting her eyes as a measure to resist the pain. What had happened to Isla might have suddenly rushed back to her—it was trauma she could never truly forget. She had surely hallucinated the sound, given how no one else had heard it.
entries.literal: "She was forcefully shutting her eyes as a measure to resist the pain. What had happened to Isla might have suddenly rushed back to her—it was trauma she could never truly forget. She had surely hallucinated the sound, given how no one else had heard it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hey... you don't mean to say that Isla...?
entries.literal: "Hey... you don't mean to say that Isla...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded, making eye contact with him. Even though we knew nothing about Akaro, if he was acting disconcerted, it meant he'd maintained a façade from the start and had begun taking advantage of the low amount of suspicion we'd openly thrown at him.
entries.literal: "I nodded, making eye contact with him. Even though we knew nothing about Akaro, if he was acting disconcerted, it meant he'd maintained a façade from the start and had begun taking advantage of the low amount of suspicion we'd openly thrown at him."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's... It can't be. She was with us the entire time.
entries.literal: "That's... It can't be. She was with us the entire time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro sat on the other bed and placed his hands on his forehead, staring at his lap. He had stopped questioning us since we had mentioned the Sekimeiya, realizing that we hadn't been lying. Instead, he seemed to be trying to comprehend what had happened to him and why his memories didn't match ours.
entries.literal: "Akaro sat on the other bed and placed his hands on his forehead, staring at his lap. He had stopped questioning us since we had mentioned the Sekimeiya, realizing that we hadn't been lying. Instead, he seemed to be trying to comprehend what had happened to him and why his memories didn't match ours."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you remember touching the Sekimeiya after leaving with Sai, even vaguely...? Touching the Sekimeiya with your skin makes you travel to the past. You know that, right?
entries.literal: "Do you remember touching the Sekimeiya after leaving with Sai, even vaguely...? Touching the Sekimeiya with your skin makes you travel to the past. You know that, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No, stop. I haven't seen Sai in a while, since he left the room, and I haven't touched the Sekimeiya like that either.
entries.literal: "No, stop. I haven't seen Sai in a while, since he left the room, and I haven't touched the Sekimeiya like that either."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not true. You admitted to touching it a while after we found the second Naomi.
entries.literal: "That's not true. You admitted to touching it a while after we found the second Naomi."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: The second...? I have no idea what you're saying. Please, shut up.
entries.literal: "The second...? I have no idea what you're saying. Please, shut up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was seriously straining him, so I refrained from continuing.
entries.literal: "I was seriously straining him, so I refrained from continuing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He knew what time it was and didn't remember touching the Sekimeiya even once...{w} If he was being honest, it indicated that he hadn't traveled far through time. His internal clock would've differed from ours if he had, and if he'd looked at the time, he would've known it was earlier than it should've been, as he didn't remember the exact moment of the travel.{w} ...So if his memory issues were caused by the Sekimeiya, it was unlikely it was due to traveling farther than I had yet.
entries.literal: "He knew what time it was and didn't remember touching the Sekimeiya even once...{w} If he was being honest, it indicated that he hadn't traveled far through time. His internal clock would've differed from ours if he had, and if he'd looked at the time, he would've known it was earlier than it should've been, as he didn't remember the exact moment of the travel.{w} ...So if his memory issues were caused by the Sekimeiya, it was unlikely it was due to traveling farther than I had yet."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm sorry, but can you leave me alone? I don't feel well, and it's hard to breathe with so many people around.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry, but can you leave me alone? I don't feel well, and it's hard to breathe with so many people around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He might not have been aware of how unreasonable his demand was since he hadn't yet accepted what Erina was going through. His face was identical to the one he'd been making when we found him in the bathroom—maybe he had a tendency to seek solitude when overwhelmed.
entries.literal: "He might not have been aware of how unreasonable his demand was since he hadn't yet accepted what Erina was going through. His face was identical to the one he'd been making when we found him in the bathroom—maybe he had a tendency to seek solitude when overwhelmed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina gave an immediate, wordless response in the form of standing up and moving to the ladder, obviously intent on going up.
entries.literal: "Erina gave an immediate, wordless response in the form of standing up and moving to the ladder, obviously intent on going up."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right. Let us know if anything comes to you.
entries.literal: "All right. Let us know if anything comes to you."

entries.text: Mind Over Matter
entries.literal: "Mind Over Matter"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I followed Akaro's request too, and Katei, while he maintained an offended expression full of doubt, joined us last. He closed the hatch so that anything he said couldn't reach Akaro's ears.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I followed Akaro's request too, and Katei, while he maintained an offended expression full of doubt, joined us last. He closed the hatch so that anything he said couldn't reach Akaro's ears."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Atsuki, I thought you were a bit smarter than this. Are you going to let him trick you so blatantly?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, I thought you were a bit smarter than this. Are you going to let him trick you so blatantly?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The irony of his question was almost nauseating, but I fought back the urge to object to it. I was in no mood for pointless discussion. He sighed and sat on the same bed as Erina, in front of Shiroya and myself. He tried a few positions until he decided to lean back against the wall.
entries.literal: "The irony of his question was almost nauseating, but I fought back the urge to object to it. I was in no mood for pointless discussion. He sighed and sat on the same bed as Erina, in front of Shiroya and myself. He tried a few positions until he decided to lean back against the wall."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: And we need to leave him the entire lower bedroom so that he doesn't cry. Meanwhile, only God knows what Sai is doing.
entries.literal: "And we need to leave him the entire lower bedroom so that he doesn't cry. Meanwhile, only God knows what Sai is doing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, nobody acknowledged Katei's presumptuous and poorly timed jabs. He rolled his eyes, accepting that nobody would humor him.
entries.literal: "Once again, nobody acknowledged Katei's presumptuous and poorly timed jabs. He rolled his eyes, accepting that nobody would humor him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His behavior had clearly changed gradually as time had gone on. While he'd attempted to look composed and firm at the start, he was no longer actively suppressing his anger and frustration.
entries.literal: "His behavior had clearly changed gradually as time had gone on. While he'd attempted to look composed and firm at the start, he was no longer actively suppressing his anger and frustration."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to clear my head a bit. Nothing about Akaro's or Erina's recent actions made sense, but I knew I'd be lost if I tried to tackle those questions. Instead, I went one step back as I realized that I'd missed an important detail during all the fuss.
entries.literal: "I tried to clear my head a bit. Nothing about Akaro's or Erina's recent actions made sense, but I knew I'd be lost if I tried to tackle those questions. Instead, I went one step back as I realized that I'd missed an important detail during all the fuss."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Akaro was able to enter the room on his own, and when he did, we saw that the key was placed in the outer keyhole of the door. Since Akaro later told us that he'd only been drawn to the bedroom after hearing Katei's knocks, it's very unlikely that he had the key on him.
entries.literal: "Akaro was able to enter the room on his own, and when he did, we saw that the key was placed in the outer keyhole of the door. Since Akaro later told us that he'd only been drawn to the bedroom after hearing Katei's knocks, it's very unlikely that he had the key on him."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Instead, it must've already been placed in the keyhole, and he used it to open the door. This is a solid indicator of how Akaro and Sai managed to escape: the door was opened from the outside, using the key we'd hidden.
entries.literal: "Instead, it must've already been placed in the keyhole, and he used it to open the door. This is a solid indicator of how Akaro and Sai managed to escape: the door was opened from the outside, using the key we'd hidden."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Of course, it's always possible they left it there to make us think that, but that seems a bit pointless because they didn't hesitate to leave us behind, openly telling us that we should suspect them anyway. Once they made it out, they probably left the key in the keyhole since they didn't need it for anything else.
entries.literal: "Of course, it's always possible they left it there to make us think that, but that seems a bit pointless because they didn't hesitate to leave us behind, openly telling us that we should suspect them anyway. Once they made it out, they probably left the key in the keyhole since they didn't need it for anything else."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Outside help was used to escape, and they accepted it by unsetting the chain. This supports what I thought of earlier, regarding the looped set of actions they could've fabricated on the spot.
entries.literal: "Outside help was used to escape, and they accepted it by unsetting the chain. This supports what I thought of earlier, regarding the looped set of actions they could've fabricated on the spot."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: They thought of the loop, lured Katei up here, saw that the door had been opened, exited through it, traveled back in time, unlocked the door from the outside, and left the key in the outer keyhole. If the universe accepted this, it was a completely viable way out.
entries.literal: "They thought of the loop, lured Katei up here, saw that the door had been opened, exited through it, traveled back in time, unlocked the door from the outside, and left the key in the outer keyhole. If the universe accepted this, it was a completely viable way out."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In fact, since the door had to be opened from the outside, not much else works. It's very unlikely anyone else could've fulfilled that role. If one of us exits the room with the key that Erina has in a while and goes to the past to unlock the door, we'd still be creating a causal loop, as the only reason Erina has the key is because someone unlocked the way out for Akaro and Sai.
entries.literal: "In fact, since the door had to be opened from the outside, not much else works. It's very unlikely anyone else could've fulfilled that role. If one of us exits the room with the key that Erina has in a while and goes to the past to unlock the door, we'd still be creating a causal loop, as the only reason Erina has the key is because someone unlocked the way out for Akaro and Sai."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So if someone does go back to the past to unlock the door, for it to be a cohesive travel, that person will have to be unrelated to our imprisonment, and going back to the past can't be a result of our actions after we locked ourselves in here. Each of those actions branches out from the fact that Akaro and Sai have left.
entries.literal: "So if someone does go back to the past to unlock the door, for it to be a cohesive travel, that person will have to be unrelated to our imprisonment, and going back to the past can't be a result of our actions after we locked ourselves in here. Each of those actions branches out from the fact that Akaro and Sai have left."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: With how likely it is that Akaro and Sai dealt with the Sekimeiya after escaping, the person who will or already has traveled through time must use the Sekimeiya we hid in Naomi's locker, as its location hasn't been influenced by the escape.
entries.literal: "With how likely it is that Akaro and Sai dealt with the Sekimeiya after escaping, the person who will or already has traveled through time must use the Sekimeiya we hid in Naomi's locker, as its location hasn't been influenced by the escape."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Lastly, there's a much easier solution: that there was always someone else inside the building who we missed.{w} Just now, Erina acted like she heard Isla outside the bedroom. Even though nobody else heard anything, if it truly happened, she could've opened the door for Akaro and Sai if her existence there wasn't in any capacity derived from their escape.
entries.literal: "Lastly, there's a much easier solution: that there was always someone else inside the building who we missed.{w} Just now, Erina acted like she heard Isla outside the bedroom. Even though nobody else heard anything, if it truly happened, she could've opened the door for Akaro and Sai if her existence there wasn't in any capacity derived from their escape."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I tried to calm Erina down by saying that nobody was outside, and I thought that it was impossible. However, it shouldn't be. It follows Shiroya's theory from earlier, in fact.{w} If Isla went weeks back in time, dying in the cabinet must be the final step of her travels. However, she said that her friend would wait for her outside the tower, meaning that there can be a living Isla somewhere right now.
entries.literal: "I tried to calm Erina down by saying that nobody was outside, and I thought that it was impossible. However, it shouldn't be. It follows Shiroya's theory from earlier, in fact.{w} If Isla went weeks back in time, dying in the cabinet must be the final step of her travels. However, she said that her friend would wait for her outside the tower, meaning that there can be a living Isla somewhere right now."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And we found a door that might lead outside. We can't open it from here since we have no handle to turn, but the story might be different from the outside. Thinking about it, it's technically possible for anyone to have entered the tower after the last time we did a thorough search, so they could've opened the bedroom's door. Of course, they would've required knowledge of what was going on inside...
entries.literal: "And we found a door that might lead outside. We can't open it from here since we have no handle to turn, but the story might be different from the outside. Thinking about it, it's technically possible for anyone to have entered the tower after the last time we did a thorough search, so they could've opened the bedroom's door. Of course, they would've required knowledge of what was going on inside..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was still fixated on the thought that Akaro and Sai had the chance to retroactively open the door through the mere idea of having thought of a causal loop well-aligned with the circumstances...
entries.literal: "I was still fixated on the thought that Akaro and Sai had the chance to retroactively open the door through the mere idea of having thought of a causal loop well-aligned with the circumstances..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If it was possible, it was a very powerful concept to put into practice, and the only requirement was to properly think of what you had to do. I knew I could be seen as suspicious, but I decided to attempt it.
entries.literal: "If it was possible, it was a very powerful concept to put into practice, and the only requirement was to properly think of what you had to do. I knew I could be seen as suspicious, but I decided to attempt it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Erina, can you lend me the key for a second?
entries.literal: "Erina, can you lend me the key for a second?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hm...? Why?
entries.literal: "Hm...? Why?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What are you doing?
entries.literal: "What are you doing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A slight frown also appeared on Shiroya's face in response to my request.
entries.literal: "A slight frown also appeared on Shiroya's face in response to my request."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I honestly just want to understand how Akaro and Sai left. I won't use it.
entries.literal: "I honestly just want to understand how Akaro and Sai left. I won't use it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Then why do you want it?
entries.literal: "Then why do you want it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Because I need it to see if what I'm thinking of could work.
entries.literal: "...Because I need it to see if what I'm thinking of could work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Technically, I'd lied. If it worked, I would end up using the key.
entries.literal: "Technically, I'd lied. If it worked, I would end up using the key."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Is it important...?
entries.literal: "Is it important...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think so.
entries.literal: "I think so."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...{w}Okay. As long as you don't run off with it or anything.
entries.literal: "...{w}Okay. As long as you don't run off with it or anything."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'll be back in a second.
entries.literal: "I'll be back in a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She gave me the key with her trust. My idea might have been rushed, but I didn't think that posed an issue. Essentially, I wanted to replicate what I thought Akaro and Sai did to escape.
entries.literal: "She gave me the key with her trust. My idea might have been rushed, but I didn't think that posed an issue. Essentially, I wanted to replicate what I thought Akaro and Sai did to escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They didn't need to have the key inside since it was outside the room from the beginning and they could've used it after traveling. However, if I just managed to leave the room, I couldn't open the door after traveling. The key would be inside with Erina. That wouldn't allow the loop to work, so I wouldn't be able to exit in the first place.
entries.literal: "They didn't need to have the key inside since it was outside the room from the beginning and they could've used it after traveling. However, if I just managed to leave the room, I couldn't open the door after traveling. The key would be inside with Erina. That wouldn't allow the loop to work, so I wouldn't be able to exit in the first place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hence, my idea had to be shifted a little bit.{w} I would go down and attempt to open the door. If it was open, it'd mean that the loop could be completed. I'd leave, and on the crystal floor, I would unlock Naomi's locker and activate the Sekimeiya.{w} It was likely I would go back far enough, given how long the Sekimeiya had already been there. Then, when the time came, I would unlock the door from the outside with the key Erina had handed me, allowing the loop to be created.
entries.literal: "Hence, my idea had to be shifted a little bit.{w} I would go down and attempt to open the door. If it was open, it'd mean that the loop could be completed. I'd leave, and on the crystal floor, I would unlock Naomi's locker and activate the Sekimeiya.{w} It was likely I would go back far enough, given how long the Sekimeiya had already been there. Then, when the time came, I would unlock the door from the outside with the key Erina had handed me, allowing the loop to be created."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, once my original self left the room, I'd enter it immediately after experiencing the whole loop. For them, it would seem as if I hadn't gone anywhere.
entries.literal: "Finally, once my original self left the room, I'd enter it immediately after experiencing the whole loop. For them, it would seem as if I hadn't gone anywhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the hatch and went down, a little nervous to see if it would work. Akaro raised his head, but he didn't say anything until I began to walk toward the door.
entries.literal: "I opened the hatch and went down, a little nervous to see if it would work. Akaro raised his head, but he didn't say anything until I began to walk toward the door."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Are you leaving?
entries.literal: "...Are you leaving?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No idea.
entries.literal: "No idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If it worked, the door would be very slightly open, enough to allow me to drag it inward. Since Akaro had been sitting on the bed the whole time, in the future, I would have to open the door very slowly so that I didn't make noise he could notice.
entries.literal: "If it worked, the door would be very slightly open, enough to allow me to drag it inward. Since Akaro had been sitting on the bed the whole time, in the future, I would have to open the door very slowly so that I didn't make noise he could notice."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I unset the chain, put two fingers in the hole, and dragged the door toward me.
entries.literal: "I unset the chain, put two fingers in the hole, and dragged the door toward me."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You need to use the key.
entries.literal: "You need to use the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't budge.
entries.literal: "It didn't budge."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could such a thing really not occur...? I sighed, slightly disappointed, and set the chain again.{w} Figuring the trick out would've felt like good progress toward understanding the Sekimeiya, so it was unfortunate that I couldn't know the reason why it hadn't functioned.
entries.literal: "Could such a thing really not occur...? I sighed, slightly disappointed, and set the chain again.{w} Figuring the trick out would've felt like good progress toward understanding the Sekimeiya, so it was unfortunate that I couldn't know the reason why it hadn't functioned."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Ignore me. Do you remember anything else?
entries.literal: "Ignore me. Do you remember anything else?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No, and I won't ever, since I have nothing to remember.
entries.literal: "No, and I won't ever, since I have nothing to remember."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...If you say so.
entries.literal: "...If you say so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I accepted his claim and went back up.
entries.literal: "I accepted his claim and went back up."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did you find anything out...?
entries.literal: "Did you find anything out...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I doubt it.
entries.literal: "I doubt it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gave the key back to Erina and sat where I'd been before. I heaved a sigh, ignoring the odd looks I received, and wondered if I could work with the result of my little test.
entries.literal: "I gave the key back to Erina and sat where I'd been before. I heaved a sigh, ignoring the odd looks I received, and wondered if I could work with the result of my little test."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This is really frustrating... There's no way to know why it didn't work.{w} While it's easy to assume that the existence of this kind of loop is impossible, or perhaps willingly creating one is... I can't draw a single conclusion. There are too many factors that could've stopped the loop from reaching its end, effectively denying its existence.
entries.literal: "This is really frustrating... There's no way to know why it didn't work.{w} While it's easy to assume that the existence of this kind of loop is impossible, or perhaps willingly creating one is... I can't draw a single conclusion. There are too many factors that could've stopped the loop from reaching its end, effectively denying its existence."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: For example, what if Akaro is lying to us?{w} He became cautious of my presence as soon as I approached the door, so if I'd gotten it to open, he might've restrained me if what he's after is preventing us from leaving and allowing Sai to roam freely. That could be why he prompted the four of us to go up top.
entries.literal: "For example, what if Akaro is lying to us?{w} He became cautious of my presence as soon as I approached the door, so if I'd gotten it to open, he might've restrained me if what he's after is preventing us from leaving and allowing Sai to roam freely. That could be why he prompted the four of us to go up top."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If he did that, I couldn't proceed, so the door would never have been open.{w} Similarly, what if Sai took the Sekimeiya out of Naomi's locker? Downstairs, I couldn't have used it to go back to the past, yet again cutting off the loop.
entries.literal: "If he did that, I couldn't proceed, so the door would never have been open.{w} Similarly, what if Sai took the Sekimeiya out of Naomi's locker? Downstairs, I couldn't have used it to go back to the past, yet again cutting off the loop."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Depending on what determines the amount of time traveled, it's possible that activating the Sekimeiya wouldn't have sent me back far enough to open the door and that this problem would've repeated in the future if I'd tried it again. There are plenty of unknown factors that would make this loop an impossibility.
entries.literal: "Depending on what determines the amount of time traveled, it's possible that activating the Sekimeiya wouldn't have sent me back far enough to open the door and that this problem would've repeated in the future if I'd tried it again. There are plenty of unknown factors that would make this loop an impossibility."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recognized another potential point that could've interfered with my plan, and it was a pretty big oversight, as it had to do with the biggest difference between what I'd attempted and what I thought Akaro and Sai might've done.
entries.literal: "I recognized another potential point that could've interfered with my plan, and it was a pretty big oversight, as it had to do with the biggest difference between what I'd attempted and what I thought Akaro and Sai might've done."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Right... When Shiroya and I traveled from the cleaning room, even though the cart disappeared, it didn't appear in the attic with us, as the bodies we appeared in were most likely identical to how they had been at {time=12:10}, when both of us were in the attic in those same locations...
entries.literal: "Right... When Shiroya and I traveled from the cleaning room, even though the cart disappeared, it didn't appear in the attic with us, as the bodies we appeared in were most likely identical to how they had been at {time=12:10}, when both of us were in the attic in those same locations..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This means that if I had traveled holding the bedroom key, chances are I wouldn't have appeared with it in the past. Akaro and Sai wouldn't have encountered that problem since, for them, the key would've always been under the bathroom's carpet.{w} But... no, that shouldn't have been a problem. I could've used one of the handles we left under the beds. There might've been another screwdriver in the opposite bedroom, and even if there wasn't, putting in screws without a screwdriver isn't too hard. Could it be that wasn't possible because it wasn't part of the loop I'd thought of...? Or maybe I just wouldn't have been able to do it without alerting Akaro.
entries.literal: "This means that if I had traveled holding the bedroom key, chances are I wouldn't have appeared with it in the past. Akaro and Sai wouldn't have encountered that problem since, for them, the key would've always been under the bathroom's carpet.{w} But... no, that shouldn't have been a problem. I could've used one of the handles we left under the beds. There might've been another screwdriver in the opposite bedroom, and even if there wasn't, putting in screws without a screwdriver isn't too hard. Could it be that wasn't possible because it wasn't part of the loop I'd thought of...? Or maybe I just wouldn't have been able to do it without alerting Akaro."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Or, what if I wouldn't have been able to travel? When we left the Sekimeiya in Naomi's locker, it wasn't working. Perhaps it never started to function again for some reason.
entries.literal: "Or, what if I wouldn't have been able to travel? When we left the Sekimeiya in Naomi's locker, it wasn't working. Perhaps it never started to function again for some reason."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, I thought about the most interesting reason why the loop might not have worked for me, and I was reminded of how messy time travel could become in the blink of an eye.
entries.literal: "Finally, I thought about the most interesting reason why the loop might not have worked for me, and I was reminded of how messy time travel could become in the blink of an eye."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: We've already been here for more than forty minutes, and we think that the location we travel to is somehow determined by where we were in the recent past.
entries.literal: "We've already been here for more than forty minutes, and we think that the location we travel to is somehow determined by where we were in the recent past."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, for example, it's possible that I would've gone thirty minutes to the past and appeared where I'd been fifteen minutes prior. Since I've been here in both of those time coordinates, I would've appeared in this bedroom.
entries.literal: "So, for example, it's possible that I would've gone thirty minutes to the past and appeared where I'd been fifteen minutes prior. Since I've been here in both of those time coordinates, I would've appeared in this bedroom."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Even if I appeared with the key, that would cause a situation that I never experienced. Going to the past would've immediately changed things, overwriting the way in which I'd gone to the past in the first place. The loop would've become impossible if this happened, resulting in my failed attempt.{w} ...And Akaro and Sai, who spent less time in the bedroom and most likely used a different Sekimeiya, might not have faced this issue either.
entries.literal: "Even if I appeared with the key, that would cause a situation that I never experienced. Going to the past would've immediately changed things, overwriting the way in which I'd gone to the past in the first place. The loop would've become impossible if this happened, resulting in my failed attempt.{w} ...And Akaro and Sai, who spent less time in the bedroom and most likely used a different Sekimeiya, might not have faced this issue either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For a few minutes, my mind lapsed into silence. I'd managed to ignore how tired I was, but the feeling was starting to kick back in.
entries.literal: "For a few minutes, my mind lapsed into silence. I'd managed to ignore how tired I was, but the feeling was starting to kick back in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The four of us kept shifting around, mindlessly looking at the ceiling or at the walls. We were all powerless, and our lack of mutual trust wore us down from constantly being on guard.
entries.literal: "The four of us kept shifting around, mindlessly looking at the ceiling or at the walls. We were all powerless, and our lack of mutual trust wore us down from constantly being on guard."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't discard my recent thoughts. Akaro and Sai had found a way to escape that involved outside help. Furthermore, if the Akaro below us wasn't acting, he had undergone something that caused his memories to differ from ours.
entries.literal: "I didn't discard my recent thoughts. Akaro and Sai had found a way to escape that involved outside help. Furthermore, if the Akaro below us wasn't acting, he had undergone something that caused his memories to differ from ours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The more I thought about it, the more I realized how powerful it would be if you could create loops that ensured your success from the beginning. The culprit we'd chased behind could've taken advantage of it, making sure that their movements would always work.
entries.literal: "The more I thought about it, the more I realized how powerful it would be if you could create loops that ensured your success from the beginning. The culprit we'd chased behind could've taken advantage of it, making sure that their movements would always work."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's bizarre, but if you understood how the Sekimeiya works thoroughly, you could abuse this concept to a sky-high extent.
entries.literal: "It's bizarre, but if you understood how the Sekimeiya works thoroughly, you could abuse this concept to a sky-high extent."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: You want to cross a hallway full of doors and deadly traps, but you can think of many ways to do it and you're not sure which one will work.
entries.literal: "You want to cross a hallway full of doors and deadly traps, but you can think of many ways to do it and you're not sure which one will work."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: With the Sekimeiya, if you could be the creator of causal loops, assuring success in these situations would be a way to use them.
entries.literal: "With the Sekimeiya, if you could be the creator of causal loops, assuring success in these situations would be a way to use them."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: You could think: "I will try doors 1, 3, and 5, and I'll walk touching the right wall. After I make it across, I will go around from the outside and leave a mark behind the door to this place."
entries.literal: "You could think: \"I will try doors 1, 3, and 5, and I'll walk touching the right wall. After I make it across, I will go around from the outside and leave a mark behind the door to this place.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If you look where you'll leave a mark and find it, you'll know that arrangement of doors and movements will work. If the mark isn't there, you'll know you would die midway, rendering you unable to leave the mark.{w} You can keep thinking of different arrangements until the mark appears. Since you'll only move forth once you see the mark, it's an effective bootstrap—the end result is what allows it to happen. But despite being a "paradox", there's actually an origin to it.
entries.literal: "If you look where you'll leave a mark and find it, you'll know that arrangement of doors and movements will work. If the mark isn't there, you'll know you would die midway, rendering you unable to leave the mark.{w} You can keep thinking of different arrangements until the mark appears. Since you'll only move forth once you see the mark, it's an effective bootstrap—the end result is what allows it to happen. But despite being a \"paradox\", there's actually an origin to it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Even though this is an extreme situation, it can apply in any circumstance because it removes the generalized risk associated with going back to the past.{w} Regardless of the circumstances, you can think something up in your head. If it'll work, you'll see the successful result, and if it won't, nothing will happen. You would be guaranteed to never fail, no matter what you attempt.{w} The killer could've used this method before killing Naomi; "if I move this specific way after killing her and I'm not seen, I'll let my current self know by leaving a drawer in the next room open", for example.
entries.literal: "Even though this is an extreme situation, it can apply in any circumstance because it removes the generalized risk associated with going back to the past.{w} Regardless of the circumstances, you can think something up in your head. If it'll work, you'll see the successful result, and if it won't, nothing will happen. You would be guaranteed to never fail, no matter what you attempt.{w} The killer could've used this method before killing Naomi; \"if I move this specific way after killing her and I'm not seen, I'll let my current self know by leaving a drawer in the next room open\", for example."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Another big advantage is that you'd be able to make any move that's currently hard to accomplish by deciding it to occur retroactively.{w} At some point, the killer might have wanted to prevent us from entering a room. However, they couldn't go and lock it, or they would've been seen.
entries.literal: "Another big advantage is that you'd be able to make any move that's currently hard to accomplish by deciding it to occur retroactively.{w} At some point, the killer might have wanted to prevent us from entering a room. However, they couldn't go and lock it, or they would've been seen."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Their solution would've been to decide: "in the future, I'll go to the past and lock it, so it's already locked now". This doesn't have to be a bootstrap paradox, but it's fundamentally very similar to what I'm thinking.
entries.literal: "Their solution would've been to decide: \"in the future, I'll go to the past and lock it, so it's already locked now\". This doesn't have to be a bootstrap paradox, but it's fundamentally very similar to what I'm thinking."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Depending on how it works, the possibilities could be limitless. There's even a higher step to reach.
entries.literal: "Depending on how it works, the possibilities could be limitless. There's even a higher step to reach."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's considerably different, but it follows along with a few things I thought about earlier, regarding the date displayed on Sai's watch.
entries.literal: "It's considerably different, but it follows along with a few things I thought about earlier, regarding the date displayed on Sai's watch."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Out of the countless examples, could you go back in time, trade information with someone, write it all down, and leave it all on a note that you'd see before traveling through time?
entries.literal: "Out of the countless examples, could you go back in time, trade information with someone, write it all down, and leave it all on a note that you'd see before traveling through time?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: You'd read the note and go back to the past. However, since you would already know the contents of it, you'd have no reason to exchange the information—all you'd have to do is leave behind the note you'd read so that you could read it before traveling.
entries.literal: "You'd read the note and go back to the past. However, since you would already know the contents of it, you'd have no reason to exchange the information—all you'd have to do is leave behind the note you'd read so that you could read it before traveling."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The note itself would be a paradox that you caused, but was the past truly changed? Was a past in which you exchanged information truly overwritten? ...Or did it never exist in the first place?
entries.literal: "The note itself would be a paradox that you caused, but was the past truly changed? Was a past in which you exchanged information truly overwritten? ...Or did it never exist in the first place?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...If Sai's watch got to "9999-12-31" by spending infinite time in a loop, did the pasts in which the time counted up to that date really exist in any capacity?
entries.literal: "...If Sai's watch got to \"9999-12-31\" by spending infinite time in a loop, did the pasts in which the time counted up to that date really exist in any capacity?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The final step is one I'm not willing to accept:{w} could you witness a very smoothly committed crime, decide that you were the perpetrator, and go back to the past to replicate it?
entries.literal: "The final step is one I'm not willing to accept:{w} could you witness a very smoothly committed crime, decide that you were the perpetrator, and go back to the past to replicate it?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The loops until now always had some kind of origin to them, but this one doesn't. It firmly defies causality.
entries.literal: "The loops until now always had some kind of origin to them, but this one doesn't. It firmly defies causality."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, what would be possible is going back in time, preventing the real perpetrator from committing their crime, and then replicating it being certain of your success. That's just a way to use a time travel device.
entries.literal: "However, what would be possible is going back in time, preventing the real perpetrator from committing their crime, and then replicating it being certain of your success. That's just a way to use a time travel device."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The Sekimeiya must operate on one of these levels, the lowest one being "thought-up loops aren't possible". If this is the case, Akaro and Sai must've received outside help from a third party.
