entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya must operate on one of these levels, the lowest one being \"thought-up loops aren't possible\". If this is the case, Akaro and Sai must've received outside help from a third party."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Level 1, using a loop they created mentally, would've allowed them to escape on their own in the way I've been thinking about.
entries.literal: "Level 1, using a loop they created mentally, would've allowed them to escape on their own in the way I've been thinking about."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Level 2 would complicate things, and it's more of an interesting concept than anything. The recorder in Isla's purse made me think that there are some possible benefits of staying here for a much longer time even though it seemed incredibly negative at first.
entries.literal: "Level 2 would complicate things, and it's more of an interesting concept than anything. The recorder in Isla's purse made me think that there are some possible benefits of staying here for a much longer time even though it seemed incredibly negative at first."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If I found a very important reason to stay, and a method to accomplish it, probably through the security room's computer... Could I grab the recorder, go back to the past with it, and place it in Isla's purse for the sole purpose of reproducing everything exactly and to get to the point in which I decided to turn it into reality? ...That would be level 2.
entries.literal: "If I found a very important reason to stay, and a method to accomplish it, probably through the security room's computer... Could I grab the recorder, go back to the past with it, and place it in Isla's purse for the sole purpose of reproducing everything exactly and to get to the point in which I decided to turn it into reality? ...That would be level 2."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: For now, I'll ignore it.{w} Would I send the recorder back in time to reproduce everything instead of writing a note that details it all thoroughly purely because "I didn't live that"? That's ridiculous.
entries.literal: "For now, I'll ignore it.{w} Would I send the recorder back in time to reproduce everything instead of writing a note that details it all thoroughly purely because \"I didn't live that\"? That's ridiculous."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Even though level 1 appears to have endless applications, there should be a daunting barrier to cross: the memories of the person who thinks of the loop. Someone who did this would always have to work around the past that they remember.{w} Let's say the culprit wanted to kill someone in the event room and then had to choose between hallways A and B to escape.
entries.literal: "Even though level 1 appears to have endless applications, there should be a daunting barrier to cross: the memories of the person who thinks of the loop. Someone who did this would always have to work around the past that they remember.{w} Let's say the culprit wanted to kill someone in the event room and then had to choose between hallways A and B to escape."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: These loops always entail going back to the past. If the culprit had seen hallway A empty after the point Naomi would be killed, later, when they thought that they had to create the loop, they'd know they couldn't use hallway A.{w} If they'd seen both hallways A and B empty instead, they would've put themselves into a corner and would be unable to create a loop in which they escaped successfully.
entries.literal: "These loops always entail going back to the past. If the culprit had seen hallway A empty after the point Naomi would be killed, later, when they thought that they had to create the loop, they'd know they couldn't use hallway A.{w} If they'd seen both hallways A and B empty instead, they would've put themselves into a corner and would be unable to create a loop in which they escaped successfully."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It sounds a bit crazy; "it doesn't matter if they saw these hallways empty—if they hadn't looked at them, they still would've been empty".{w} That's not the case, though. That logic clashes with the most important part of this concept: that the origin of the loop is the mind of the person who will execute it.
entries.literal: "It sounds a bit crazy; \"it doesn't matter if they saw these hallways empty—if they hadn't looked at them, they still would've been empty\".{w} That's not the case, though. That logic clashes with the most important part of this concept: that the origin of the loop is the mind of the person who will execute it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Both hallways were empty. Why hadn't the culprit seen their future self escaping through one of them? The reason is that seeing their escape route would've told them about the plan they'd later think of, and the origin would've disappeared.{w} So one would never see a result of a future loop before having thought of it, as that could induce or highly influence its creation, resulting in the classic bootstrap "they thought of the loop because they had experienced it".
entries.literal: "Both hallways were empty. Why hadn't the culprit seen their future self escaping through one of them? The reason is that seeing their escape route would've told them about the plan they'd later think of, and the origin would've disappeared.{w} So one would never see a result of a future loop before having thought of it, as that could induce or highly influence its creation, resulting in the classic bootstrap \"they thought of the loop because they had experienced it\"."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If the culprit is operating under this knowledge, that'd be a very good reason to stay hidden. If they spent all their time in front of the security screens observing what occurred in real time across the building, whenever they needed to make a retroactive move, their own memories of all the empty places would be the one thing preventing them from accomplishing it.{w} Of course, this is also because the past can't be changed, so if they observed too much, they would make any future loop impossible, as they would never see a loop in action before thinking of it.
entries.literal: "If the culprit is operating under this knowledge, that'd be a very good reason to stay hidden. If they spent all their time in front of the security screens observing what occurred in real time across the building, whenever they needed to make a retroactive move, their own memories of all the empty places would be the one thing preventing them from accomplishing it.{w} Of course, this is also because the past can't be changed, so if they observed too much, they would make any future loop impossible, as they would never see a loop in action before thinking of it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What it basically boils down to is that, in some instances, having a lack of knowledge could actually be far more beneficial than knowing everything.
entries.literal: "What it basically boils down to is that, in some instances, having a lack of knowledge could actually be far more beneficial than knowing everything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a very intriguing concept, but nothing assured me it was applicable.{w} I was still a bit upset that I had no indication of why my plan hadn't worked... Would it work if I could slide the key under the door and wait a few minutes before trying to leave?
entries.literal: "It was a very intriguing concept, but nothing assured me it was applicable.{w} I was still a bit upset that I had no indication of why my plan hadn't worked... Would it work if I could slide the key under the door and wait a few minutes before trying to leave?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That would've matched Akaro's and Sai's circumstances more closely, but it could've led into even more reasons behind the failure. For example, Sai could've taken the key from under the door if he'd been nearby.{w} ...I wasn't sure what to do or think.
entries.literal: "That would've matched Akaro's and Sai's circumstances more closely, but it could've led into even more reasons behind the failure. For example, Sai could've taken the key from under the door if he'd been nearby.{w} ...I wasn't sure what to do or think."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There might've been indications of how loops are handled already.
entries.literal: "There might've been indications of how loops are handled already."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Technically, the first time I traveled to the past, I could have created a bootstrap unconsciously.
entries.literal: "Technically, the first time I traveled to the past, I could have created a bootstrap unconsciously."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: From room B4, I traveled twenty minutes to the past. I didn't know what had happened, so I ended up taking the elevator to the sixth floor.{w} That action made our original selves follow the elevator up, and eventually, it all led into me traveling through time.
entries.literal: "From room B4, I traveled twenty minutes to the past. I didn't know what had happened, so I ended up taking the elevator to the sixth floor.{w} That action made our original selves follow the elevator up, and eventually, it all led into me traveling through time."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If I hadn't gone up with the elevator, things would have played out considerably differently. We would've remained on floor 4, and everyone else's thoughts would've varied.
entries.literal: "If I hadn't gone up with the elevator, things would have played out considerably differently. We would've remained on floor 4, and everyone else's thoughts would've varied."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In short, if I hadn't gone up, it's possible I wouldn't have ended up traveling to the past. Therefore, traveling to the past is, in a way, what led me to traveling to the past.{w} I'm not sure it was a bootstrap, but what's certain is that I didn't intend for it to occur; by traveling, I merely finished up the past that had already taken place.
entries.literal: "In short, if I hadn't gone up, it's possible I wouldn't have ended up traveling to the past. Therefore, traveling to the past is, in a way, what led me to traveling to the past.{w} I'm not sure it was a bootstrap, but what's certain is that I didn't intend for it to occur; by traveling, I merely finished up the past that had already taken place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ceased my thoughts—I was getting dizzy. The minutes had continued passing, and as expected, nothing had occurred.
entries.literal: "I ceased my thoughts—I was getting dizzy. The minutes had continued passing, and as expected, nothing had occurred."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were facing a dilemma regarding Sai. We knew he was probably still down there, but we didn't know whether following him was what he wanted. His intent was unclear whether it was disrupting the peace, experimenting with the Sekimeiya, or following along with his bigger plan.{w} Ultimately, we had once again decided to continue staying locked up because of Erina's input.
entries.literal: "We were facing a dilemma regarding Sai. We knew he was probably still down there, but we didn't know whether following him was what he wanted. His intent was unclear whether it was disrupting the peace, experimenting with the Sekimeiya, or following along with his bigger plan.{w} Ultimately, we had once again decided to continue staying locked up because of Erina's input."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My thoughts had trailed off and were revived by Shiroya's yawn. The silence had become unsettling, as it had gone on for more than thirty minutes since we'd left Akaro below.
entries.literal: "My thoughts had trailed off and were revived by Shiroya's yawn. The silence had become unsettling, as it had gone on for more than thirty minutes since we'd left Akaro below."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Are you guys really fine with this?
entries.literal: "...Are you guys really fine with this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei took my renewed awareness as a chance to question our actions again.
entries.literal: "Katei took my renewed awareness as a chance to question our actions again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We're letting Sai run free and ignoring Akaro's obvious lies. Don't you understand they set this up? Akaro's just making sure we don't head down. Why else would he have come back?
entries.literal: "We're letting Sai run free and ignoring Akaro's obvious lies. Don't you understand they set this up? Akaro's just making sure we don't head down. Why else would he have come back?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't you think that if that was what he wanted, he wouldn't have chosen to tell us such a wild story?
entries.literal: "Don't you think that if that was what he wanted, he wouldn't have chosen to tell us such a wild story?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Of course I don't. Before they left, they made up this whole scenario where you were the mastermind. I'm betting they thought of this "Akaro has lost his memories" story precisely to make us think it's too ridiculous to be a lie.
entries.literal: "Of course I don't. Before they left, they made up this whole scenario where you were the mastermind. I'm betting they thought of this \"Akaro has lost his memories\" story precisely to make us think it's too ridiculous to be a lie."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, if you wanna leave, you're alone on that. We've already decided what we'll do.
entries.literal: "Well, if you wanna leave, you're alone on that. We've already decided what we'll do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He glared at me with an incensed look and attempted to calm himself.
entries.literal: "He glared at me with an incensed look and attempted to calm himself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't insist further before closing his eyes again.{w} I thought he had given up, but not long after, he opened his mouth again.
entries.literal: "He didn't insist further before closing his eyes again.{w} I thought he had given up, but not long after, he opened his mouth again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Fine. Stay here if you want, but unlike you, I won't let anyone laugh in my face like Akaro is doing right now.
entries.literal: "Fine. Stay here if you want, but unlike you, I won't let anyone laugh in my face like Akaro is doing right now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With three silent pairs of eyes looking at him, he approached the hatch and opened it. He roughly climbed down the ladder, not letting go of his indignation for one second.
entries.literal: "With three silent pairs of eyes looking at him, he approached the hatch and opened it. He roughly climbed down the ladder, not letting go of his indignation for one second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We returned our gazes to where they had been, intending to continue letting time pass quietly.
entries.literal: "We returned our gazes to where they had been, intending to continue letting time pass quietly."

entries.speaker: k4
entries.text: What the...? What a joke.{w} Atsuki! Come here!
entries.literal: "What the...? What a joke.{w} Atsuki! Come here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei's voice boomed through the open hatch. Shiroya and Erina looked at me, in search of my reaction. I simply sighed and stood up.
entries.literal: "Katei's voice boomed through the open hatch. Shiroya and Erina looked at me, in search of my reaction. I simply sighed and stood up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I mimicked Katei's actions and climbed down. Upon stepping off the ladder, it didn't take me even half a second to comprehend Katei's shout.
entries.literal: "I mimicked Katei's actions and climbed down. Upon stepping off the ladder, it didn't take me even half a second to comprehend Katei's shout."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, this is just great.
entries.literal: "Well, this is just great."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Stop messing around. Perhaps the two of them weren't so far off the mark earlier.
entries.literal: "Stop messing around. Perhaps the two of them weren't so far off the mark earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With intrigued looks, Shiroya and Erina peeked through the hatch. From it, they could see the empty room around Katei and me.
entries.literal: "With intrigued looks, Shiroya and Erina peeked through the hatch. From it, they could see the empty room around Katei and me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Is he gone again...?
entries.literal: "Is he gone again...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Well, he's not here! So yes!
entries.literal: "Well, he's not here! So yes!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I rubbed my eyes at Katei's obnoxious voice. Meanwhile, I got closer to the door as he confirmed that Akaro wasn't anywhere.
entries.literal: "I rubbed my eyes at Katei's obnoxious voice. Meanwhile, I got closer to the door as he confirmed that Akaro wasn't anywhere."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The chain is still set. That's strange.
entries.literal: "The chain is still set. That's strange."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Strange? No, Atsuki, you really screwed up this time.
entries.literal: "Strange? No, Atsuki, you really screwed up this time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From Shiroya's face, I could tell she and I knew word by word the accusation Katei was about to make.
entries.literal: "From Shiroya's face, I could tell she and I knew word by word the accusation Katei was about to make."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What's strange is what you did earlier. You took the key from Erina, came here, and unlocked the door for Akaro. Then you set the chain.
entries.literal: "What's strange is what you did earlier. You took the key from Erina, came here, and unlocked the door for Akaro. Then you set the chain."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why the hell would I do that?
entries.literal: "Why the hell would I do that?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: To let him escape, idiot!
entries.literal: "To let him escape, idiot!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wasn't he the one who decided to come in the first place?
entries.literal: "Wasn't he the one who decided to come in the first place?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. It appears both of you aren't quite on the bright side. If I'm wrong, go ahead and illuminate us: why did you want the key?
entries.literal: "Yes. It appears both of you aren't quite on the bright side. If I'm wrong, go ahead and illuminate us: why did you want the key?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: To see if I could retroactively open the door.
entries.literal: "To see if I could retroactively open the door."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...You think you're smart, don't you? You have gone too far. It seems that Atsuki, Akaro, and Sai were working together the whole time. Shiroya, are you part of the group too?
entries.literal: "...You think you're smart, don't you? You have gone too far. It seems that Atsuki, Akaro, and Sai were working together the whole time. Shiroya, are you part of the group too?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of answering, she came down, followed by Erina. She looked around, but Akaro wasn't anywhere. He'd disappeared without leaving a trace, as if he'd been an illusion from the start.
entries.literal: "Instead of answering, she came down, followed by Erina. She looked around, but Akaro wasn't anywhere. He'd disappeared without leaving a trace, as if he'd been an illusion from the start."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the same time, I couldn't blame Katei that much for suspecting me since I understood how questionable my actions looked.
entries.literal: "At the same time, I couldn't blame Katei that much for suspecting me since I understood how questionable my actions looked."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Anyway, this is more than enough. We're leaving.{w} Atsuki, this time, that camera clearly recorded your actions when you let Akaro escape. Don't think this will go unpunished.
entries.literal: "Anyway, this is more than enough. We're leaving.{w} Atsuki, this time, that camera clearly recorded your actions when you let Akaro escape. Don't think this will go unpunished."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh shit. How could I forget about it?
entries.literal: "Oh shit. How could I forget about it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to stop taking him seriously, as that would eventually drive me insane.
entries.literal: "I had to stop taking him seriously, as that would eventually drive me insane."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He pushed me aside, unset the chain, and tried to open the door, but only met with failure.
entries.literal: "He pushed me aside, unset the chain, and tried to open the door, but only met with failure."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: All right, Erina, we've tried your suggestion, but it's not going to work if half of us have different intentions. We need to go find Akaro and Sai. We can't even trust these two kids.
entries.literal: "All right, Erina, we've tried your suggestion, but it's not going to work if half of us have different intentions. We need to go find Akaro and Sai. We can't even trust these two kids."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't feel like giving my input, so I remained quiet. So did Erina, who looked down uncertainly.
entries.literal: "I didn't feel like giving my input, so I remained quiet. So did Erina, who looked down uncertainly."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Enough already!
entries.literal: "Enough already!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Remembering the pocket in which she'd hidden the key, Katei suddenly reached inside and retrieved it at the cost of startling her. Without reacting further, she stayed immobile, watching him insert the key into the door.
entries.literal: "Remembering the pocket in which she'd hidden the key, Katei suddenly reached inside and retrieved it at the cost of startling her. Without reacting further, she stayed immobile, watching him insert the key into the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With abrupt and stiff motions, he turned it and dragged the door open. Without looking back, he walked away. He opted not to lock us inside and kept the door as it was.
entries.literal: "With abrupt and stiff motions, he turned it and dragged the door open. Without looking back, he walked away. He opted not to lock us inside and kept the door as it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: None of us said anything or looked at each other. Instead, against my own expectations, Erina walked forward and exited the room too.
entries.literal: "None of us said anything or looked at each other. Instead, against my own expectations, Erina walked forward and exited the room too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, Shiroya and I exchanged looks. She gave me a bitter smile that I replied to with a long sigh.{w} I estimated it was around {time=16:20}, meaning that less than five hours remained until our scheduled freedom. We stayed still for a few seconds, contemplating the open door in front of us that symbolized our utter failure to keep everyone in one place.
entries.literal: "Then, Shiroya and I exchanged looks. She gave me a bitter smile that I replied to with a long sigh.{w} I estimated it was around {time=16:20}, meaning that less than five hours remained until our scheduled freedom. We stayed still for a few seconds, contemplating the open door in front of us that symbolized our utter failure to keep everyone in one place."

entries.text: Satellite
entries.literal: "Satellite"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm guessing you wanted to try to see if Akaro and Sai could've escaped alone?
entries.literal: "I'm guessing you wanted to try to see if Akaro and Sai could've escaped alone?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. It didn't work, though.
entries.literal: "Yes. It didn't work, though."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I figured... Maybe we really missed a hidden person, then.
entries.literal: "I figured... Maybe we really missed a hidden person, then."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe.
entries.literal: "Maybe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shrugged lightly. I didn't know how else to approach their disappearance.
entries.literal: "I shrugged lightly. I didn't know how else to approach their disappearance."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, do you wanna stay here?
entries.literal: "Well, do you wanna stay here?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm not sure... First, we should fix that.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure... First, we should fix that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She pointed at the handleless door. The handles should've still been under the bed in the other bedroom.
entries.literal: "She pointed at the handleless door. The handles should've still been under the bed in the other bedroom."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right, we shouldn't keep them detached.
entries.literal: "Right, we shouldn't keep them detached."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After more than an hour, I stepped out of the room and viewed the scenery of the attic again.
entries.literal: "After more than an hour, I stepped out of the room and viewed the scenery of the attic again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I entered the other bedroom and kneeled to see that both handles were still there.
entries.literal: "Then, I entered the other bedroom and kneeled to see that both handles were still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With the same screwdriver as before, I put them in place. I turned both to test that they worked properly, and I removed the key that Katei had left in the inner keyhole. Finally, I put it back in the drawers where we'd found it, along with the screwdriver.
entries.literal: "With the same screwdriver as before, I put them in place. I turned both to test that they worked properly, and I removed the key that Katei had left in the inner keyhole. Finally, I put it back in the drawers where we'd found it, along with the screwdriver."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Remember this?
entries.literal: "Remember this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From my pocket, I took out the key to Naomi's locker.
entries.literal: "From my pocket, I took out the key to Naomi's locker."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh... You still had it?
entries.literal: "Oh... You still had it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, I used the cabinet key to hide it. Akaro and Sai likely left with that later.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I used the cabinet key to hide it. Akaro and Sai likely left with that later."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think so, if they needed to use the Sekimeiya. I guess that's why Akaro was in such an odd state.
entries.literal: "I think so, if they needed to use the Sekimeiya. I guess that's why Akaro was in such an odd state."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Most likely, if he wasn't lying. We could've been lucky the times we traveled since nothing happened to us. Maybe Akaro and Isla suffered from a side effect...
entries.literal: "Most likely, if he wasn't lying. We could've been lucky the times we traveled since nothing happened to us. Maybe Akaro and Isla suffered from a side effect..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like before, Shiroya went quiet at the mention of Isla. It had already been quite a while since we'd learned about her fate.
entries.literal: "Like before, Shiroya went quiet at the mention of Isla. It had already been quite a while since we'd learned about her fate."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...By the way, is it me, or is the smell from earlier back?
entries.literal: "...By the way, is it me, or is the smell from earlier back?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, yes, now that you mention it... It's really similar to the one all around the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Oh, yes, now that you mention it... It's really similar to the one all around the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm... I can't tell where it's coming from, and it's not easy to perceive.
entries.literal: "Hm... I can't tell where it's coming from, and it's not easy to perceive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved around to see if getting closer to the source would be noticeable, but I felt no change.
entries.literal: "I moved around to see if getting closer to the source would be noticeable, but I felt no change."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I spent a while going over the way Akaro and Sai could've escaped, but I focused on the fact that the key was left in the outer keyhole. But even though Akaro escaped again, the chain is intact.
entries.literal: "...I spent a while going over the way Akaro and Sai could've escaped, but I focused on the fact that the key was left in the outer keyhole. But even though Akaro escaped again, the chain is intact."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I know. I think we should go down to see what happened with the Sekimeiya. We could come across the person who opened the door for Akaro and Sai too.
entries.literal: "I know. I think we should go down to see what happened with the Sekimeiya. We could come across the person who opened the door for Akaro and Sai too."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right.
entries.literal: "All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't inspected Akaro after he'd come back, so it was possible he had a key on him. Despite that, he couldn't have left the chain set when he exited.
entries.literal: "We hadn't inspected Akaro after he'd come back, so it was possible he had a key on him. Despite that, he couldn't have left the chain set when he exited."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We took timid steps out of the bedroom, as if an invisible net was still pulling us in. Once we were in the hallway, the first thing I did was enter the kitchen.
entries.literal: "We took timid steps out of the bedroom, as if an invisible net was still pulling us in. Once we were in the hallway, the first thing I did was enter the kitchen."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's been so long since I drank anything. I bet you're thirsty too. We should've anticipated it.
entries.literal: "It's been so long since I drank anything. I bet you're thirsty too. We should've anticipated it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. I tried to drink water when I went to the bathroom, but it wasn't very good.
entries.literal: "Yeah. I tried to drink water when I went to the bathroom, but it wasn't very good."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened a cabinet to grab a glass. Tap water wasn't my preference at all, but it would suffice. I turned the valve, filled up the glass, and quickly took a sip.
entries.literal: "I opened a cabinet to grab a glass. Tap water wasn't my preference at all, but it would suffice. I turned the valve, filled up the glass, and quickly took a sip."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, what the...?{w} You're right, no way this is drinkable.
entries.literal: "Oh, what the...?{w} You're right, no way this is drinkable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grimaced at the taste. Not much water had flowed out of the tap, but although it was pretty transparent, it wasn't something I could drink.{w} It had slightly alleviated the dryness, at least.
entries.literal: "I grimaced at the taste. Not much water had flowed out of the tap, but although it was pretty transparent, it wasn't something I could drink.{w} It had slightly alleviated the dryness, at least."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the glass on the countertop and went to inspect one of the many things we had to check: the living room's floor.
entries.literal: "I left the glass on the countertop and went to inspect one of the many things we had to check: the living room's floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Look at this. I can see different pairs of footprints going between the entrance and the hallway, and there are many more under them that have degraded a lot.{w} It's too hard to conclude anything from them, though.
entries.literal: "Look at this. I can see different pairs of footprints going between the entrance and the hallway, and there are many more under them that have degraded a lot.{w} It's too hard to conclude anything from them, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina and Katei had just left, so two of the pairs probably belonged to them. As I looked at the footprints more, I realized that at least three different pairs were distinguishable. One set was fairly small, another was medium-sized, and the last was the biggest. In addition, the smaller ones were older.
entries.literal: "Erina and Katei had just left, so two of the pairs probably belonged to them. As I looked at the footprints more, I realized that at least three different pairs were distinguishable. One set was fairly small, another was medium-sized, and the last was the biggest. In addition, the smaller ones were older."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: H-Huh...{w} A-Are these Isla's? They can't be, right? And I think they're a bit too big.
entries.literal: "H-Huh...{w} A-Are these Isla's? They can't be, right? And I think they're a bit too big."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, look. The elevator's door is shut.
entries.literal: "Wait, look. The elevator's door is shut."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked back to the hallway and saw that the elevator was back in operation. After the many hours it had spent stuck in the attic, someone had chosen to reenable it.
entries.literal: "I walked back to the hallway and saw that the elevator was back in operation. After the many hours it had spent stuck in the attic, someone had chosen to reenable it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wondered if Erina or Katei had done it. What it meant was that the footprints wouldn't reveal the exact number of people who'd entered or exited the attic.
entries.literal: "I wondered if Erina or Katei had done it. What it meant was that the footprints wouldn't reveal the exact number of people who'd entered or exited the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We wanted to understand what had gone on while we'd stayed in the bedroom, so we chose to walk down a floor.
entries.literal: "We wanted to understand what had gone on while we'd stayed in the bedroom, so we chose to walk down a floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The attic key was still in the door. The vast and desolate sight of the sixth floor, which contrasted the comfort of the attic, was a stark reminder of how things had progressed since that morning.
entries.literal: "The attic key was still in the door. The vast and desolate sight of the sixth floor, which contrasted the comfort of the attic, was a stark reminder of how things had progressed since that morning."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We should find Sai. He has to be somewhere, and he could know what happened to Akaro.
entries.literal: "We should find Sai. He has to be somewhere, and he could know what happened to Akaro."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure he'll willingly talk to us after what he did. If he's still around, though, we'll find him.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure he'll willingly talk to us after what he did. If he's still around, though, we'll find him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The same applied to Akaro, and there was a possibility one last person was to be found. Had Erina imagined her dead daughter's yells, or was there some truth behind them? After everything we'd thought, we couldn't fully rule out a living Isla being present around us.
entries.literal: "The same applied to Akaro, and there was a possibility one last person was to be found. Had Erina imagined her dead daughter's yells, or was there some truth behind them? After everything we'd thought, we couldn't fully rule out a living Isla being present around us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We monotonously circled down the floors like we'd done many times. We didn't waste time looking through the offices, as making it to the crystal floor was our priority. Although using the elevator would've been expedient, we wanted to stretch our legs and at least give a cursory glance through the drab center of the tower.
entries.literal: "We monotonously circled down the floors like we'd done many times. We didn't waste time looking through the offices, as making it to the crystal floor was our priority. Although using the elevator would've been expedient, we wanted to stretch our legs and at least give a cursory glance through the drab center of the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After moving down three floors, an unexpected sound interrupted the overwhelming silence. It was the elevator, moving through floor 4.
entries.literal: "After moving down three floors, an unexpected sound interrupted the overwhelming silence. It was the elevator, moving through floor 4."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...There it is again.
entries.literal: "...There it is again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were in front of the elevator, but the opaque door didn't reveal any information.
entries.literal: "We were in front of the elevator, but the opaque door didn't reveal any information."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I wish the button would light up when the elevator's moving.{w} I doubt Erina and Katei would've used it already, no matter the reason. I'd say it was probably someone else.
entries.literal: "I wish the button would light up when the elevator's moving.{w} I doubt Erina and Katei would've used it already, no matter the reason. I'd say it was probably someone else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't tried to open its door in the attic, so we couldn't know the direction it was moving toward. However, it was likely it had been used to move from one extreme of the building to the other.
entries.literal: "We hadn't tried to open its door in the attic, so we couldn't know the direction it was moving toward. However, it was likely it had been used to move from one extreme of the building to the other."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We would've gone back up if we'd known for sure that the elevator wasn't in the attic and was logically going up. Instead, it took us a few seconds to circle the outer corridors until we were by the staircase leading to floor 2.
entries.literal: "We would've gone back up if we'd known for sure that the elevator wasn't in the attic and was logically going up. Instead, it took us a few seconds to circle the outer corridors until we were by the staircase leading to floor 2."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There, the sound repeated, but it was much harder to notice.
entries.literal: "There, the sound repeated, but it was much harder to notice."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Again?
entries.literal: "Again?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm... It's only been a few seconds, so the first time, someone must've called it.
entries.literal: "Hm... It's only been a few seconds, so the first time, someone must've called it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're right, yeah. So, either someone called it from under us and they just went up, or the opposite. I wouldn't think we missed someone above us, so I'd say the elevator was going up this last time.
entries.literal: "You're right, yeah. So, either someone called it from under us and they just went up, or the opposite. I wouldn't think we missed someone above us, so I'd say the elevator was going up this last time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If we were about to find an empty crystal floor, we'd go up again. Since the attic key was still in the door, unless the elevator had been called from the attic, it could've only reached floor 6. Of course, assuming another key hadn't been used, but it wasn't likely one existed.
entries.literal: "If we were about to find an empty crystal floor, we'd go up again. Since the attic key was still in the door, unless the elevator had been called from the attic, it could've only reached floor 6. Of course, assuming another key hadn't been used, but it wasn't likely one existed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Knowing that it still could've been going down, we continued heading toward the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Knowing that it still could've been going down, we continued heading toward the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shortly, we were in front of the stairs that led to that dark place where everything had started.
entries.literal: "Shortly, we were in front of the stairs that led to that dark place where everything had started."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no revealing sight that immediately met our eyes. The floor spread out in front of us exactly as we remembered it.{w} In hallway A, the light had begun to find a path through the dark coating and bounced off the walls more than it had the last time I'd been there. The strange smell hadn't faded since we'd been in the attic, and it had started to seem like the natural scent of the tower. It wasn't unpleasant, only intriguing, as I couldn't associate it to anything I'd ever smelled, and we couldn't identify its source.
entries.literal: "There was no revealing sight that immediately met our eyes. The floor spread out in front of us exactly as we remembered it.{w} In hallway A, the light had begun to find a path through the dark coating and bounced off the walls more than it had the last time I'd been there. The strange smell hadn't faded since we'd been in the attic, and it had started to seem like the natural scent of the tower. It wasn't unpleasant, only intriguing, as I couldn't associate it to anything I'd ever smelled, and we couldn't identify its source."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's see.
entries.literal: "Let's see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At our left was the elevator. I approached it and grabbed its handle.
entries.literal: "At our left was the elevator. I approached it and grabbed its handle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With little force, I attempted to open it, and there was unexpectedly no resistance. The door moved, uncovering an empty elevator and my mistaken assumption.
entries.literal: "With little force, I attempted to open it, and there was unexpectedly no resistance. The door moved, uncovering an empty elevator and my mistaken assumption."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It was going down...? Was there someone above us who we didn't see?
entries.literal: "It was going down...? Was there someone above us who we didn't see?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: If so, they must be here now.
entries.literal: "If so, they must be here now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That left me more confused than I expected. While it was possible that someone went up and down from the crystal floor or sent an empty elevator down upon arriving in the attic, Shiroya's claim was the most probable one.
entries.literal: "That left me more confused than I expected. While it was possible that someone went up and down from the crystal floor or sent an empty elevator down upon arriving in the attic, Shiroya's claim was the most probable one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, if we'd already missed someone on the upper floors, they'd probably stayed away from us intentionally, so using the elevator to reveal their existence was a little strange. I moved aside, trying not to obsess over it yet.
entries.literal: "However, if we'd already missed someone on the upper floors, they'd probably stayed away from us intentionally, so using the elevator to reveal their existence was a little strange. I moved aside, trying not to obsess over it yet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Before any of that, we should check if the Sekimeiya we left in the cabinet is still there.
entries.literal: "Before any of that, we should check if the Sekimeiya we left in the cabinet is still there."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, but I wouldn't bet on it.
entries.literal: "Yeah, but I wouldn't bet on it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stepped into hallway A. The cabinet key had been taken by Akaro and Sai, so no part of me expected to find a shiny egg behind the curtain.
entries.literal: "We stepped into hallway A. The cabinet key had been taken by Akaro and Sai, so no part of me expected to find a shiny egg behind the curtain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the event room, and I approached the cabinet to see if my expectations would be betrayed twice in a row.
entries.literal: "We entered the event room, and I approached the cabinet to see if my expectations would be betrayed twice in a row."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's not there, right?
entries.literal: "It's not there, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...No.{w} I can't wait to find Sai and hear the excuses he'll come up with.
entries.literal: "...No.{w} I can't wait to find Sai and hear the excuses he'll come up with."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I let the curtain fall, I tried to scroll the glass open, and it moved along with my fingers easily.
entries.literal: "Before I let the curtain fall, I tried to scroll the glass open, and it moved along with my fingers easily."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The cabinet was definitely unlocked with the key, so there's no way the Sekimeiya "teleported itself out".
entries.literal: "The cabinet was definitely unlocked with the key, so there's no way the Sekimeiya \"teleported itself out\"."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Isn't that still a little strange?
entries.literal: "Isn't that still a little strange?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What is?
entries.literal: "What is?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That they didn't lock it again. Maybe it's not, since it's obvious that Akaro and Sai did it, but I thought they would've done that to hide that they used the key.
entries.literal: "That they didn't lock it again. Maybe it's not, since it's obvious that Akaro and Sai did it, but I thought they would've done that to hide that they used the key."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure. They could've been in a hurry, but they knew they'd be suspected regardless.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure. They could've been in a hurry, but they knew they'd be suspected regardless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the glass had been shut, not showing any signs of a hurry. The cabinet wasn't even locked, which was trivial to do manually. It was possible that there was more to Shiroya's input, but we had no way to be sure.
entries.literal: "However, the glass had been shut, not showing any signs of a hurry. The cabinet wasn't even locked, which was trivial to do manually. It was possible that there was more to Shiroya's input, but we had no way to be sure."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Earlier, I thought that they were maybe taking the Sekimeiya out so the cold wouldn't affect it. If that was the case, I'm pretty sure they would've locked the cabinet to prevent us from putting it back if we found it.
entries.literal: "Earlier, I thought that they were maybe taking the Sekimeiya out so the cold wouldn't affect it. If that was the case, I'm pretty sure they would've locked the cabinet to prevent us from putting it back if we found it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There are other cabinets with temperature functions, but I think you're right. I'm sure they could've taken care of the others in different ways too.
entries.literal: "There are other cabinets with temperature functions, but I think you're right. I'm sure they could've taken care of the others in different ways too."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I suppose it's time to check our Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I suppose it's time to check our Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's impossible anyone took it, but it might be working now. Do you want to activate it...?
entries.literal: "It's impossible anyone took it, but it might be working now. Do you want to activate it...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know. It could be dangerous, but nothing happened to us the other times. It sounds reckless, but it can take us to the past... If it started working at some point, we might be able to go quite a few hours back.
entries.literal: "I don't know. It could be dangerous, but nothing happened to us the other times. It sounds reckless, but it can take us to the past... If it started working at some point, we might be able to go quite a few hours back."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: If that happens, we won't appear in the tower, because there's no way we missed ourselves from the beginning. It could put us outside instantly.
entries.literal: "If that happens, we won't appear in the tower, because there's no way we missed ourselves from the beginning. It could put us outside instantly."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Technically, we could've been in the secret part of the storeroom... You're right, though. It could take us out.
entries.literal: "Technically, we could've been in the secret part of the storeroom... You're right, though. It could take us out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seeing it like that, it was a lucky chance. Did the Sekimeiya have the power to kill us, erase our memories... and free us from the tower? Could it even let us see Miiya again?
entries.literal: "Seeing it like that, it was a lucky chance. Did the Sekimeiya have the power to kill us, erase our memories... and free us from the tower? Could it even let us see Miiya again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't made up my mind. If we had the chance, activating it would always be tempting, as it could let us understand its mechanics and what had been going on. Undecided, we exited through hallway B.
entries.literal: "I hadn't made up my mind. If we had the chance, activating it would always be tempting, as it could let us understand its mechanics and what had been going on. Undecided, we exited through hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Directly at our left was the staff room, housing our own Sekimeiya. We couldn't feel the presence of anyone else, so we entered it.
entries.literal: "Directly at our left was the staff room, housing our own Sekimeiya. We couldn't feel the presence of anyone else, so we entered it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Remembering which locker belonged to Naomi, I stepped toward it while Shiroya stayed by the door to alert me of any sound.
entries.literal: "Remembering which locker belonged to Naomi, I stepped toward it while Shiroya stayed by the door to alert me of any sound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the key out of my pocket and inserted it into the keyhole. With two fingers, I turned it to undo the lock. The sharp sound told me that I'd been successful.
entries.literal: "I took the key out of my pocket and inserted it into the keyhole. With two fingers, I turned it to undo the lock. The sharp sound told me that I'd been successful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Lastly, I removed the key, which opened the metallic door at the same time. I saw the narrow interior, with the coat hanging as we'd left it. Then, I raised my line of sight to reach the higher compartment.
entries.literal: "Lastly, I removed the key, which opened the metallic door at the same time. I saw the narrow interior, with the coat hanging as we'd left it. Then, I raised my line of sight to reach the higher compartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't storing anything.{w} Its interior contained nothing but an empty space waiting to be filled. ...My dumbfounded look persisted until the realization fully sank in.
entries.literal: "It wasn't storing anything.{w} Its interior contained nothing but an empty space waiting to be filled. ...My dumbfounded look persisted until the realization fully sank in."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hey, this is the right locker, isn't it? We left it up here.
entries.literal: "Hey, this is the right locker, isn't it? We left it up here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes... Is it not there?
entries.literal: "Yes... Is it not there?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Look, there's nothing.
entries.literal: "Look, there's nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She approached me with a neutral face. Not a slight hint of surprise emanated from her. By that point, something truly impressive would need to occur to evoke genuine shock from us. We felt like we'd seen it all.
entries.literal: "She approached me with a neutral face. Not a slight hint of surprise emanated from her. By that point, something truly impressive would need to occur to evoke genuine shock from us. We felt like we'd seen it all."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We definitely left it here. Was it still locked?
entries.literal: "We definitely left it here. Was it still locked?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We let out exasperated sighs. We had kept the Sekimeiya hidden so that nobody else would find it, but it seemed it decided to spite us and disappear. Even though it hadn't made us travel before we'd left it, it evidently did have powers, as nobody should have been able to take it out.
entries.literal: "We let out exasperated sighs. We had kept the Sekimeiya hidden so that nobody else would find it, but it seemed it decided to spite us and disappear. Even though it hadn't made us travel before we'd left it, it evidently did have powers, as nobody should have been able to take it out."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did it teleport like Sai's been saying?
entries.literal: "Did it teleport like Sai's been saying?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, he and Akaro couldn't have taken it...
entries.literal: "Well, he and Akaro couldn't have taken it..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: If it did, we might know when.{w} We've never seen two Sekimeiya exist at the same time, but it should've happened when one supposedly appeared in Sai's hip pack, right?
entries.literal: "If it did, we might know when.{w} We've never seen two Sekimeiya exist at the same time, but it should've happened when one supposedly appeared in Sai's hip pack, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded, unsure.
entries.literal: "I nodded, unsure."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Maybe there were two right then, but they had to be the same one and one had traveled from the future. Sai told you he didn't know he had it and he never put it there. He could've been telling the truth.
entries.literal: "Maybe there were two right then, but they had to be the same one and one had traveled from the future. Sai told you he didn't know he had it and he never put it there. He could've been telling the truth."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: At that point, there was another Sekimeiya in that cabinet in room B3, and we used it to travel to the past. If it can randomly teleport itself, it could be traveling to the past as well. After all, when we came back to that room, the Sekimeiya in the cabinet had disappeared after the time I saw it was gray.
entries.literal: "At that point, there was another Sekimeiya in that cabinet in room B3, and we used it to travel to the past. If it can randomly teleport itself, it could be traveling to the past as well. After all, when we came back to that room, the Sekimeiya in the cabinet had disappeared after the time I saw it was gray."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right, but we thought Sai took it.
entries.literal: "Right, but we thought Sai took it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It could've traveled to the past, to Sai's hip pack. I get Sai's own existence is another mystery, though.{w} ...After that, he hid it in the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "It could've traveled to the past, to Sai's hip pack. I get Sai's own existence is another mystery, though.{w} ...After that, he hid it in the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Next, we hid it in this locker, but at some point, the same thing happened. It teleported to the hallway A cabinet, with Isla...{w} This time, it didn't even have to go to the past. It could've simply teleported.
entries.literal: "Next, we hid it in this locker, but at some point, the same thing happened. It teleported to the hallway A cabinet, with Isla...{w} This time, it didn't even have to go to the past. It could've simply teleported."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Then, since we brought it to the event room, Akaro and Sai could take it with the key. This could also explain how it appeared in the storeroom at the start...
entries.literal: "Then, since we brought it to the event room, Akaro and Sai could take it with the key. This could also explain how it appeared in the storeroom at the start..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spent a few seconds in thought.
entries.literal: "I spent a few seconds in thought."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, is it disappearing randomly?{w} There are a couple things I'm not sure about. Even though it could have teleported to the storeroom, the cabinet in the event room was unlocked, so I think one of us moved it...{w} I suppose it's possible someone hid it in hallway B and it teleported to the storeroom, but that's hard to believe.
entries.literal: "So, is it disappearing randomly?{w} There are a couple things I'm not sure about. Even though it could have teleported to the storeroom, the cabinet in the event room was unlocked, so I think one of us moved it...{w} I suppose it's possible someone hid it in hallway B and it teleported to the storeroom, but that's hard to believe."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And there's one unexplained thing I can think of: the first time Isla disappeared from the cabinet, before appearing again.{w} Nothing was found inside it, so the Sekimeiya couldn't have teleported from this locker yet.
entries.literal: "And there's one unexplained thing I can think of: the first time Isla disappeared from the cabinet, before appearing again.{w} Nothing was found inside it, so the Sekimeiya couldn't have teleported from this locker yet."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, something else is needed to explain that, yeah. I guess maybe it moved from the locker to another place, Katei activated it, and then it traveled again to the cabinet with Isla.
entries.literal: "Oh, something else is needed to explain that, yeah. I guess maybe it moved from the locker to another place, Katei activated it, and then it traveled again to the cabinet with Isla."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's one way to put it together. I think everything holds up.{w} Anyway, if the Sekimeiya was actually taken from here by someone, it's very possible they put it inside Isla's cabinet. Honestly, it feels out of place to think that it's been teleporting itself through time at random intervals.
entries.literal: "That's one way to put it together. I think everything holds up.{w} Anyway, if the Sekimeiya was actually taken from here by someone, it's very possible they put it inside Isla's cabinet. Honestly, it feels out of place to think that it's been teleporting itself through time at random intervals."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well, how else could it have disappeared from here? There's no way this lock was picked, right?
entries.literal: "Well, how else could it have disappeared from here? There's no way this lock was picked, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After thinking about it, I spotted a couple of alternative paths to take.
entries.literal: "After thinking about it, I spotted a couple of alternative paths to take."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The door was still locked, so I highly doubt the lock was picked and then set again. Only one thing would've been needed to get the Sekimeiya out of here if it never disappeared all by itself: the key.{w} Duplication can be easily achieved by traveling to the past since two versions of yourself exist at the same time. I'm still not sure about everything you can do with it, but it can work with objects, like how we're replicating our clothes after traveling.
entries.literal: "The door was still locked, so I highly doubt the lock was picked and then set again. Only one thing would've been needed to get the Sekimeiya out of here if it never disappeared all by itself: the key.{w} Duplication can be easily achieved by traveling to the past since two versions of yourself exist at the same time. I'm still not sure about everything you can do with it, but it can work with objects, like how we're replicating our clothes after traveling."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't believe that ever happened to this key, but it's not out of the question. Since the time we found the first Naomi up to this point, it never traveled through time.
entries.literal: "I don't believe that ever happened to this key, but it's not out of the question. Since the time we found the first Naomi up to this point, it never traveled through time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Before that point, though, we don't know. While the mystery of the second Naomi is as unsolved as ever, she didn't have any keys on her, which makes me think that her keyring wasn't replicated alongside her body and clothes.
entries.literal: "Before that point, though, we don't know. While the mystery of the second Naomi is as unsolved as ever, she didn't have any keys on her, which makes me think that her keyring wasn't replicated alongside her body and clothes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But that's not necessarily the truth. The main reason why I think that is because of the initial footprints in the attic and because her keys weren't removed from her first body. Maybe the reason for that is the killer had a replica of Naomi's keyring from the start.{w} It's even possible an entirely different person killed the second Naomi and grabbed her keys...
entries.literal: "But that's not necessarily the truth. The main reason why I think that is because of the initial footprints in the attic and because her keys weren't removed from her first body. Maybe the reason for that is the killer had a replica of Naomi's keyring from the start.{w} It's even possible an entirely different person killed the second Naomi and grabbed her keys..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: They would've hidden them somewhere, so after how much we've searched, it's impressive if we still haven't found them. Since we searched everyone before locking ourselves up in the attic, it can't be that someone still had the four keys from the second Naomi at that point.
entries.literal: "They would've hidden them somewhere, so after how much we've searched, it's impressive if we still haven't found them. Since we searched everyone before locking ourselves up in the attic, it can't be that someone still had the four keys from the second Naomi at that point."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...While it's possible, I don't think another key like this one exists. I'm inclined to believe that the second Naomi never had any keys on her.
entries.literal: "...While it's possible, I don't think another key like this one exists. I'm inclined to believe that the second Naomi never had any keys on her."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, so nobody could've opened the locker.
entries.literal: "Yeah, so nobody could've opened the locker."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, we could have.{w} We have the key, so we could go back to the past and unlock it.
entries.literal: "No, we could have.{w} We have the key, so we could go back to the past and unlock it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh... Well, I guess so.
entries.literal: "Oh... Well, I guess so."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But this can't be it. I've spent a while thinking about these kinds of loops, and even though they seem possible, I find it hard to accept them.
entries.literal: "But this can't be it. I've spent a while thinking about these kinds of loops, and even though they seem possible, I find it hard to accept them."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If we go back to the past and get the Sekimeiya out of this locker, would the origin be that we realized it had happened? Would we be choosing to explain this mystery in our way?
entries.literal: "If we go back to the past and get the Sekimeiya out of this locker, would the origin be that we realized it had happened? Would we be choosing to explain this mystery in our way?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Even if we go back to the past and get it out because we realize that Sai or Akaro will do it otherwise, the fundamental reason would still be that we've witnessed the end result already. On the surface, it sounds possible, but I don't believe it is.
entries.literal: "Even if we go back to the past and get it out because we realize that Sai or Akaro will do it otherwise, the fundamental reason would still be that we've witnessed the end result already. On the surface, it sounds possible, but I don't believe it is."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya appraised me with an odd look. Perhaps listening to me toss out those words sounded bizarre, as we'd never had conversations remotely similar to that.
entries.literal: "Shiroya appraised me with an odd look. Perhaps listening to me toss out those words sounded bizarre, as we'd never had conversations remotely similar to that."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're still saying that there's no other possibility, right?
entries.literal: "You're still saying that there's no other possibility, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, I'm saying that, right now, there's likely only one:{w} someone else will grab this key, go back to the past, and use it to unlock the locker.
entries.literal: "No, I'm saying that, right now, there's likely only one:{w} someone else will grab this key, go back to the past, and use it to unlock the locker."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh.
entries.literal: "Huh."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Such an abrupt response made me laugh. I might've been deluding myself a little, but I thought I'd reached that conclusion through semi-logical reasoning.
entries.literal: "Such an abrupt response made me laugh. I might've been deluding myself a little, but I thought I'd reached that conclusion through semi-logical reasoning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shook some thoughts away and closed the locker without locking it. Then, I left the room and told Shiroya to follow me.
entries.literal: "I shook some thoughts away and closed the locker without locking it. Then, I left the room and told Shiroya to follow me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the women's bathroom and waited for her to come in. While she looked at me quizzically, I opened the toilet's lid, dropped the key inside, and flushed it.
entries.literal: "I entered the women's bathroom and waited for her to come in. While she looked at me quizzically, I opened the toilet's lid, dropped the key inside, and flushed it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There it goes. What are you doing?
entries.literal: "There it goes. What are you doing?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, it seems I was wrong. Perhaps I'm taking myself too seriously.{w} The universe didn't break, and I doubt the past changed.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it seems I was wrong. Perhaps I'm taking myself too seriously.{w} The universe didn't break, and I doubt the past changed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: My theory involved someone else using the key to go back to the past and taking our Sekimeiya, so this was an easy way to deny that reality. It appears the answer was another one, though, meaning that the Sekimeiya vanished differently.
entries.literal: "My theory involved someone else using the key to go back to the past and taking our Sekimeiya, so this was an easy way to deny that reality. It appears the answer was another one, though, meaning that the Sekimeiya vanished differently."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It could be teleporting itself.
entries.literal: "It could be teleporting itself."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Maybe it's just becoming invisible.
entries.literal: "...Maybe it's just becoming invisible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...We went back to the staff room. If, against all odds, my action had changed the past without breaking the universe or altering our memories, the locker would be locked and we'd have no way of getting the Sekimeiya out.
entries.literal: "...We went back to the staff room. If, against all odds, my action had changed the past without breaking the universe or altering our memories, the locker would be locked and we'd have no way of getting the Sekimeiya out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped inside and tried to open it.
entries.literal: "I stepped inside and tried to open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd left it unlocked, so it opened. Once again, the winter coat was the only thing inside.{w} I brushed my hand through the higher compartment just to make sure that it wasn't actually going invisible or anything. I shrugged and closed the locker, unable to lock it anymore.
entries.literal: "I'd left it unlocked, so it opened. Once again, the winter coat was the only thing inside.{w} I brushed my hand through the higher compartment just to make sure that it wasn't actually going invisible or anything. I shrugged and closed the locker, unable to lock it anymore."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Still nothing.
entries.literal: "Still nothing."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well, Sai seems like a bottom feeder, so maybe you flushed the key into his home.
entries.literal: "Well, Sai seems like a bottom feeder, so maybe you flushed the key into his home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I exited the room without revealing that I'd been about to consider something similar. I smiled slightly to myself and looked around the hallway.
entries.literal: "I exited the room without revealing that I'd been about to consider something similar. I smiled slightly to myself and looked around the hallway."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I guess we should try to find the others. We have to be close to someone.
entries.literal: "I guess we should try to find the others. We have to be close to someone."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, let's see who we come across.
entries.literal: "Yeah, let's see who we come across."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After the longest time, we put into action the usual procedure.{w} We began with the cleaning room at our side. Next was the crystal room B6, found on the opposite side.
entries.literal: "After the longest time, we put into action the usual procedure.{w} We began with the cleaning room at our side. Next was the crystal room B6, found on the opposite side."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Atsuki, the Sekimeiya's on the floor.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, the Sekimeiya's on the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been about to move to the next room when Shiroya's casual voice stopped me in place. I turned around slowly to see her nodding at my disbelief.{w} I approached the door and looked through it.
entries.literal: "I'd been about to move to the next room when Shiroya's casual voice stopped me in place. I turned around slowly to see her nodding at my disbelief.{w} I approached the door and looked through it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In front of a cabinet was the Sekimeiya, lying on the floor and glowing white. Once again, Shiroya had found it as soon as we started to search.
entries.literal: "In front of a cabinet was the Sekimeiya, lying on the floor and glowing white. Once again, Shiroya had found it as soon as we started to search."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's sudden. Who would've left it there?
entries.literal: "That's sudden. Who would've left it there?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Nobody. I bet someone activated it, disappeared, and didn't come back.
entries.literal: "Nobody. I bet someone activated it, disappeared, and didn't come back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought of Akaro's case. If he'd forgotten about traveling from that room, he wouldn't have come back. Similarly, if someone had time traveled and appeared outside the tower, the Sekimeiya would've stayed there.
entries.literal: "I thought of Akaro's case. If he'd forgotten about traveling from that room, he wouldn't have come back. Similarly, if someone had time traveled and appeared outside the tower, the Sekimeiya would've stayed there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked up to it with guarded stances. The sight was reminiscent of an anglerfish's lure, so we'd instinctively scanned the empty room before stepping in.
entries.literal: "We walked up to it with guarded stances. The sight was reminiscent of an anglerfish's lure, so we'd instinctively scanned the empty room before stepping in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kneeled, hid my right hand under my sleeve, and stood back up holding the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I kneeled, hid my right hand under my sleeve, and stood back up holding the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's definitely working. It burns.
entries.literal: "It's definitely working. It burns."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What do we do with it?
entries.literal: "What do we do with it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't hold it for very long due to the heat increasing rapidly through my shirt. I started to walk toward the door as I thought about it.
entries.literal: "I couldn't hold it for very long due to the heat increasing rapidly through my shirt. I started to walk toward the door as I thought about it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Either we use it or we leave it in its cabinet. There's no point in hiding it again if we're not gonna ever activate it.
entries.literal: "Either we use it or we leave it in its cabinet. There's no point in hiding it again if we're not gonna ever activate it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The potential for danger was real, but greed and curiosity were powerful. In my hands, I had the key to every mystery. I thought we had given up on understanding it, but if we figured out how to use a time travel device before it was exposed to the world, it was undeniable that the options were endless.
entries.literal: "The potential for danger was real, but greed and curiosity were powerful. In my hands, I had the key to every mystery. I thought we had given up on understanding it, but if we figured out how to use a time travel device before it was exposed to the world, it was undeniable that the options were endless."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Given what happened while we were in the attic, it seems likely that whoever took the Sekimeiya was the main culprit behind everything. Despite that, they simply left it here, probably after using it. They haven't come back for it, so maybe that's a hint to their goal—or their failure.{w} Regardless, it was probably activated recently, so we shouldn't go too far back, just enough to understand what went down while we were in the attic.{w} Also, I don't think it's as hot as it was in the past, so depending on how far back we go, we could confirm that correlation.
entries.literal: "Given what happened while we were in the attic, it seems likely that whoever took the Sekimeiya was the main culprit behind everything. Despite that, they simply left it here, probably after using it. They haven't come back for it, so maybe that's a hint to their goal—or their failure.{w} Regardless, it was probably activated recently, so we shouldn't go too far back, just enough to understand what went down while we were in the attic.{w} Also, I don't think it's as hot as it was in the past, so depending on how far back we go, we could confirm that correlation."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...All right. Let's see what happens.
entries.literal: "...All right. Let's see what happens."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She moved closer to me, stating that she wanted to be in the range too. It was potentially a horrible idea, but the Sekimeiya's existence felt like nothing short of a miracle which we'd otherwise regret not taking advantage of. It could've been about to doom the entire world, but during those twelve hours, we had it all to ourselves... and a race to understand it could easily have been happening behind the scenes.
entries.literal: "She moved closer to me, stating that she wanted to be in the range too. It was potentially a horrible idea, but the Sekimeiya's existence felt like nothing short of a miracle which we'd otherwise regret not taking advantage of. It could've been about to doom the entire world, but during those twelve hours, we had it all to ourselves... and a race to understand it could easily have been happening behind the scenes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't inspected the whole building yet, so the possibility of traveling to the recent past was open. I took my left hand out of my sleeve and brought it toward the Sekimeiya with intentions of further figuring out its mechanics, limits, and what had occurred outside the bedroom walls.
entries.literal: "We hadn't inspected the whole building yet, so the possibility of traveling to the recent past was open. I took my left hand out of my sleeve and brought it toward the Sekimeiya with intentions of further figuring out its mechanics, limits, and what had occurred outside the bedroom walls."

entries.text: A Step Forward
entries.literal: "A Step Forward"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I felt the direct heat on my fingers, I saw a door.
entries.literal: "As soon as I felt the direct heat on my fingers, I saw a door."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'm... back here.
entries.literal: "I'm... back here."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait, the handle is attached.
entries.literal: "Wait, the handle is attached."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard a sound coming from behind me. As I turned around, I saw Shiroya climbing down the ladder.
entries.literal: "I heard a sound coming from behind me. As I turned around, I saw Shiroya climbing down the ladder."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Did you just appear there?
entries.literal: "...Did you just appear there?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. We traveled from room B6, right?
entries.literal: "Yeah. We traveled from room B6, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, and look, there's the handle. Either we went more than an hour and a half into the past, or just a few minutes.
entries.literal: "Yes, and look, there's the handle. Either we went more than an hour and a half into the past, or just a few minutes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I slowly scanned the place we'd traveled to, but we didn't spot anything else noteworthy. We'd appeared in the bedroom where we'd just been.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I slowly scanned the place we'd traveled to, but we didn't spot anything else noteworthy. We'd appeared in the bedroom where we'd just been."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You said it didn't feel as hot as the previous times, so probably the latter.
entries.literal: "You said it didn't feel as hot as the previous times, so probably the latter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was right, meaning that we weren't going to see what had happened while we'd been locked up. However, every single travel revealed plentiful factors to analyze. Comparing them with earlier travels felt like the best way to get to conclusions.
entries.literal: "She was right, meaning that we weren't going to see what had happened while we'd been locked up. However, every single travel revealed plentiful factors to analyze. Comparing them with earlier travels felt like the best way to get to conclusions."

entries.speaker: a
