entries.text: This is my fourth travel, and again, nothing bad has directly come out of it. I don't know what happened to Isla and Akaro, but I doubt the mere act of traveling is bringing any danger.
entries.literal: "This is my fourth travel, and again, nothing bad has directly come out of it. I don't know what happened to Isla and Akaro, but I doubt the mere act of traveling is bringing any danger."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Regarding my memories, I summarized the basic events in case there was a glaring contradiction she could find.
entries.literal: "Regarding my memories, I summarized the basic events in case there was a glaring contradiction she could find."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, that's all that happened. Unless traveling affected our memories in the same way, there's nothing wrong with what you said.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that's all that happened. Unless traveling affected our memories in the same way, there's nothing wrong with what you said."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm starting to think more and more that Akaro lied to us. He reacted to the mention of the Sekimeiya, but that could've been intentional, to relate his memory loss to it and make it more believable. I feel that Katei was right and he was trying to prevent us from leaving. After his job was done, he escaped somehow.
entries.literal: "I'm starting to think more and more that Akaro lied to us. He reacted to the mention of the Sekimeiya, but that could've been intentional, to relate his memory loss to it and make it more believable. I feel that Katei was right and he was trying to prevent us from leaving. After his job was done, he escaped somehow."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...How, though?
entries.literal: "...How, though?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know, but I can come up with a bit of an idea.{w} We had the key, and the chain was left set. That makes it likely that he teleported out. ...I thought that perhaps Sai did that.{w} Maybe he traveled next to the door to encompass Akaro and make him escape since neither of them could open the door. It could be that he made us go to the upper bedroom so that we wouldn't travel with him. I don't know why they'd do any of that, but there's not much else I can think of.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but I can come up with a bit of an idea.{w} We had the key, and the chain was left set. That makes it likely that he teleported out. ...I thought that perhaps Sai did that.{w} Maybe he traveled next to the door to encompass Akaro and make him escape since neither of them could open the door. It could be that he made us go to the upper bedroom so that we wouldn't travel with him. I don't know why they'd do any of that, but there's not much else I can think of."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Actually, no, Akaro could've escaped all by himself and left the chain set.{w} Maybe he suddenly disappeared from the room, traveling to the past. Then, in the past, he activated the Sekimeiya to encompass the bed on which he was sitting; it wasn't necessary for Sai to do that as long as Akaro had thought of it.
entries.literal: "Actually, no, Akaro could've escaped all by himself and left the chain set.{w} Maybe he suddenly disappeared from the room, traveling to the past. Then, in the past, he activated the Sekimeiya to encompass the bed on which he was sitting; it wasn't necessary for Sai to do that as long as Akaro had thought of it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That must've happened before someone traveled from room B6, then.
entries.literal: "That must've happened before someone traveled from room B6, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked out. When I looked at the living room, I instantly recognized our own footprints.
entries.literal: "We walked out. When I looked at the living room, I instantly recognized our own footprints."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: These are definitely ours, and they're very recent. We went a few minutes to the past.
entries.literal: "These are definitely ours, and they're very recent. We went a few minutes to the past."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Someone used the Sekimeiya very shortly before us. We can't see what happened, but we can be pretty sure of that.
entries.literal: "Someone used the Sekimeiya very shortly before us. We can't see what happened, but we can be pretty sure of that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And if Akaro never actually escaped the way I said, it's possible they went very far into the past. We spent a long time in the bedroom, so there was a lot of time for the Sekimeiya to store energy.{w} You know, this could've been what Akaro and Sai worked together to accomplish. The stored time was originally Sai's idea.
entries.literal: "And if Akaro never actually escaped the way I said, it's possible they went very far into the past. We spent a long time in the bedroom, so there was a lot of time for the Sekimeiya to store energy.{w} You know, this could've been what Akaro and Sai worked together to accomplish. The stored time was originally Sai's idea."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Akaro's job could have been to keep us from exiting the bedroom, letting the Sekimeiya store time for a while. Once they'd waited the required amount, they activated it and went far enough into the past to exit the tower. Since the Sekimeiya was left on the floor, it's possible they aren't here anymore.
entries.literal: "Akaro's job could have been to keep us from exiting the bedroom, letting the Sekimeiya store time for a while. Once they'd waited the required amount, they activated it and went far enough into the past to exit the tower. Since the Sekimeiya was left on the floor, it's possible they aren't here anymore."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm... And they couldn't simply have waited more before escaping the bedroom because the Sekimeiya was chilled.{w} There's still the disappearing Sekimeiya in the locker to explain, but that'd be the only thing.
entries.literal: "Hm... And they couldn't simply have waited more before escaping the bedroom because the Sekimeiya was chilled.{w} There's still the disappearing Sekimeiya in the locker to explain, but that'd be the only thing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah.{w} Sai seemed to be having fun, so exiting the tower doesn't seem like something he'd want to do. However, they did this right after discovering the storeroom's secret exit.{w} As soon as they saw that, they probably realized they could go back many hours in time, find that door from the outside, and try to enter and exit with the Sekimeiya. They might be about to try coming back in since doing it earlier would've made their own travel impossible.
entries.literal: "Yeah.{w} Sai seemed to be having fun, so exiting the tower doesn't seem like something he'd want to do. However, they did this right after discovering the storeroom's secret exit.{w} As soon as they saw that, they probably realized they could go back many hours in time, find that door from the outside, and try to enter and exit with the Sekimeiya. They might be about to try coming back in since doing it earlier would've made their own travel impossible."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Let's go down and keep an eye on the Sekimeiya. It's a bit hard to believe that everyone doesn't want to escape with it.
entries.literal: "Let's go down and keep an eye on the Sekimeiya. It's a bit hard to believe that everyone doesn't want to escape with it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded. Shiroya rushed to the elevator and called it after seeing that the door wouldn't open.
entries.literal: "I nodded. Shiroya rushed to the elevator and called it after seeing that the door wouldn't open."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh... This happened again.
entries.literal: "Huh... This happened again."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The elevator, remember? We were the ones to call it, it seems. This also happened at the beginning, during my first travel.
entries.literal: "The elevator, remember? We were the ones to call it, it seems. This also happened at the beginning, during my first travel."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh... I didn't even think about it.
entries.literal: "Oh... I didn't even think about it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's coming up, meaning that it was below us when we heard it on the office floors. We're going to the crystal floor, where we saw it already arrived.
entries.literal: "It's coming up, meaning that it was below us when we heard it on the office floors. We're going to the crystal floor, where we saw it already arrived."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: According to her, she called it without realizing that she was about to cause the noise we'd already heard. The belief that every event had an origin point was reinforced once more, as she'd unconsciously reenacted the past. Us hearing the elevator had derived into traveling to the past, but the action of calling the elevator had an organic origin.{w} Not only that, we'd explained the single sign of life we'd experienced, so we had to seriously wonder what happened to Sai, Akaro, Erina, and Katei.
entries.literal: "According to her, she called it without realizing that she was about to cause the noise we'd already heard. The belief that every event had an origin point was reinforced once more, as she'd unconsciously reenacted the past. Us hearing the elevator had derived into traveling to the past, but the action of calling the elevator had an organic origin.{w} Not only that, we'd explained the single sign of life we'd experienced, so we had to seriously wonder what happened to Sai, Akaro, Erina, and Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When the button lit up, she opened the door, and we boarded the elevator. Without a second thought, she pressed the floor 1 button.
entries.literal: "When the button lit up, she opened the door, and we boarded the elevator. Without a second thought, she pressed the floor 1 button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While it started to move down, we once again experienced the claustrophobic atmosphere that the dim light and opaque doors effortlessly created. We soon passed floor 3, where our past selves surely found themselves wondering who was inside the elevator and where it was headed.
entries.literal: "While it started to move down, we once again experienced the claustrophobic atmosphere that the dim light and opaque doors effortlessly created. We soon passed floor 3, where our past selves surely found themselves wondering who was inside the elevator and where it was headed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We weren't in a big hurry, but we knew that we would soon appear on the crystal floor from the stairs. I thought of what to do to escape our past field of vision.
entries.literal: "We weren't in a big hurry, but we knew that we would soon appear on the crystal floor from the stairs. I thought of what to do to escape our past field of vision."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We entered the event room from hallway A, and after seeing the empty cabinet, we looked inside Naomi's locker. We should go to the lobby, where we won't be seen.
entries.literal: "We entered the event room from hallway A, and after seeing the empty cabinet, we looked inside Naomi's locker. We should go to the lobby, where we won't be seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It sounded like the best idea, so we moved there and closed the hallway A door behind us. Even though there wasn't much to be tense about, we felt safe staying there, and we began to automatically move toward the metal shutter.
entries.literal: "It sounded like the best idea, so we moved there and closed the hallway A door behind us. Even though there wasn't much to be tense about, we felt safe staying there, and we began to automatically move toward the metal shutter."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Remember what I thought the time you appeared in the living room? It seemed like we appeared where we'd been in the midpoint of the time traveled.
entries.literal: "Remember what I thought the time you appeared in the living room? It seemed like we appeared where we'd been in the midpoint of the time traveled."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, and this time, something similar happened. I noticed it too.
entries.literal: "Yes, and this time, something similar happened. I noticed it too."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think it was the opposite. You appeared in the lower level of the bedroom, and I was upstairs, next to the hatch. Those exact positions occurred before we unlocked the bedroom.
entries.literal: "I think it was the opposite. You appeared in the lower level of the bedroom, and I was upstairs, next to the hatch. Those exact positions occurred before we unlocked the bedroom."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right. I followed Katei down, and you peeked from the hatch when I was already below. That might've been the location.
entries.literal: "Right. I followed Katei down, and you peeked from the hatch when I was already below. That might've been the location."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And that probably happened a bit more than ten minutes before we touched the Sekimeiya. After that, we discussed whether to leave, placed the handles back on the door, walked down to the crystal floor, and talked about the Sekimeiya vanishing.{w} We appeared in the bedroom before the time we'd heard the elevator... We might've appeared where we'd been ten minutes prior to traveling while only going back five. It's the opposite of what I thought before. It swapped the two points, although I'm not sure if the times fit that well.
entries.literal: "And that probably happened a bit more than ten minutes before we touched the Sekimeiya. After that, we discussed whether to leave, placed the handles back on the door, walked down to the crystal floor, and talked about the Sekimeiya vanishing.{w} We appeared in the bedroom before the time we'd heard the elevator... We might've appeared where we'd been ten minutes prior to traveling while only going back five. It's the opposite of what I thought before. It swapped the two points, although I'm not sure if the times fit that well."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That could be it, but it's still not consistent with any of the past travels. If there aren't set rules, there's no point in trying to understand how the Sekimeiya works. But what's most important is that a past position was once again used to determine where we appeared, even if it was done differently.
entries.literal: "That could be it, but it's still not consistent with any of the past travels. If there aren't set rules, there's no point in trying to understand how the Sekimeiya works. But what's most important is that a past position was once again used to determine where we appeared, even if it was done differently."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We heard an indistinct sound coming from hallway A, made by a door.
entries.literal: "We heard an indistinct sound coming from hallway A, made by a door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's us. We just entered the event room.
entries.literal: "That's us. We just entered the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We waited, and seconds later, the same sound came from hallway B. Unmistakably, a closing door had created it.
entries.literal: "We waited, and seconds later, the same sound came from hallway B. Unmistakably, a closing door had created it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Now we're in the staff room. We'll travel very soon.
entries.literal: "Now we're in the staff room. We'll travel very soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We thought we only had to wait until Shiroya became aware of one thing we'd missed.
entries.literal: "We thought we only had to wait until Shiroya became aware of one thing we'd missed."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: H-Hey, look at the floor, there. Isn't that blood?
entries.literal: "H-Hey, look at the floor, there. Isn't that blood?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was pointing at a spot next to the hallway A door. From afar, I could see a tiny red spot, close to the cleaning bucket. Both of us walked to it, and as the sight became clearer, Shiroya's interpretation proved to be right. A single drop of blood existed on the spacious floor of the lobby.
entries.literal: "She was pointing at a spot next to the hallway A door. From afar, I could see a tiny red spot, close to the cleaning bucket. Both of us walked to it, and as the sight became clearer, Shiroya's interpretation proved to be right. A single drop of blood existed on the spacious floor of the lobby."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's definitely blood...
entries.literal: "It's definitely blood..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The contrast with the shiny, white floor was immense. I looked around the entire room, but the drop Shiroya had found was the only one I could see. Fortunately, it was enough to tell us something very important.
entries.literal: "The contrast with the shiny, white floor was immense. I looked around the entire room, but the drop Shiroya had found was the only one I could see. Fortunately, it was enough to tell us something very important."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's almost dry. It's been here for a little while.
entries.literal: "It's almost dry. It's been here for a little while."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: From when we were locked up in the attic. Blood dripped off someone...{w} Akaro didn't look injured when he came back, but that doesn't mean much.
entries.literal: "From when we were locked up in the attic. Blood dripped off someone...{w} Akaro didn't look injured when he came back, but that doesn't mean much."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Isn't it strange that it was left here? If someone was in a hurry or being chased by an attacker, they wouldn't have cleaned it, but I feel like the culprit would have, right? Maybe it's not evidence worth cleaning up, but it tells us that something happened.
entries.literal: "Isn't it strange that it was left here? If someone was in a hurry or being chased by an attacker, they wouldn't have cleaned it, but I feel like the culprit would have, right? Maybe it's not evidence worth cleaning up, but it tells us that something happened."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Blood can never be a good sign... I feel like this is a place where evidence would be removed because it doesn't have security cameras.
entries.literal: "Blood can never be a good sign... I feel like this is a place where evidence would be removed because it doesn't have security cameras."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the single drop of blood.{w} Something about it was intriguing—while it wasn't a puddle, it was fairly wide. It wasn't a single drop that would come out of an innocuous scratch. Despite that, there was only one mark.{w} Since any wound that produced a drop of that size would keep bleeding, it was likely it had been covered to prevent further blood loss.
entries.literal: "I stared at the single drop of blood.{w} Something about it was intriguing—while it wasn't a puddle, it was fairly wide. It wasn't a single drop that would come out of an innocuous scratch. Despite that, there was only one mark.{w} Since any wound that produced a drop of that size would keep bleeding, it was likely it had been covered to prevent further blood loss."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Erina and Katei must be somewhere, but they can't have anything to do with this.{w} Even though Akaro didn't appear injured, it's possible he dripped blood before traveling to the past, and time traveling could have undone a recent injury.
entries.literal: "Erina and Katei must be somewhere, but they can't have anything to do with this.{w} Even though Akaro didn't appear injured, it's possible he dripped blood before traveling to the past, and time traveling could have undone a recent injury."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After saying that, a thought came to me. "Is the Sekimeiya reconstructing our past bodies?" We'd asked ourselves that question many times before, and I had found a way to answer it.
entries.literal: "After saying that, a thought came to me. \"Is the Sekimeiya reconstructing our past bodies?\" We'd asked ourselves that question many times before, and I had found a way to answer it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Abruptly, I put my hand in my right pocket and felt something. I took it out and showed it to Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Abruptly, I put my hand in my right pocket and felt something. I took it out and showed it to Shiroya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Ah, that's for Naomi's locker! Did you appear with it after traveling?
entries.literal: "Ah, that's for Naomi's locker! Did you appear with it after traveling?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I must have. I flushed it away before touching the Sekimeiya, but since I had it when we were in the bedroom, I appeared with it in my pocket.
entries.literal: "I must have. I flushed it away before touching the Sekimeiya, but since I had it when we were in the bedroom, I appeared with it in my pocket."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Like we suspected, the Sekimeiya has been replicating our past bodies exactly as they were in the past. In the bedroom, I appeared facing the door. Even the position of my body matched, and yours must have too.
entries.literal: "Like we suspected, the Sekimeiya has been replicating our past bodies exactly as they were in the past. In the bedroom, I appeared facing the door. Even the position of my body matched, and yours must have too."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Since the key was "under my possession" at that point, it was also on the body I appeared in. Again, that's why the cleaning cart didn't appear anywhere in the past. What's more likely is that it ceased existing as soon as you traveled touching it.
entries.literal: "Since the key was \"under my possession\" at that point, it was also on the body I appeared in. Again, that's why the cleaning cart didn't appear anywhere in the past. What's more likely is that it ceased existing as soon as you traveled touching it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see, yeah... That must be how it works.
entries.literal: "I see, yeah... That must be how it works."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed my eyes. It was very likely we'd concluded something regarding the Sekimeiya's travels, but at first glance, it didn't seem too important. I had even thought of it before without giving it much consideration.
entries.literal: "I closed my eyes. It was very likely we'd concluded something regarding the Sekimeiya's travels, but at first glance, it didn't seem too important. I had even thought of it before without giving it much consideration."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, we could be almost certain that the Sekimeiya replicated our past bodies exactly as they'd once been. As soon as I tried to explore that concept, something major came to me. It was proof that small details could open seemingly sealed doors and that we had to explore every little path.
entries.literal: "However, we could be almost certain that the Sekimeiya replicated our past bodies exactly as they'd once been. As soon as I tried to explore that concept, something major came to me. It was proof that small details could open seemingly sealed doors and that we had to explore every little path."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Escaping alive was our main goal at the start. Then, escaping with a time travel device had begun to sound like an achievable goal that some of us probably shared.{w} However, Shiroya and I had internally sought an unreachable peak while we'd been taunted by such inconsequential time travel. That was saving our friend who'd died two weeks earlier.
entries.literal: "Escaping alive was our main goal at the start. Then, escaping with a time travel device had begun to sound like an achievable goal that some of us probably shared.{w} However, Shiroya and I had internally sought an unreachable peak while we'd been taunted by such inconsequential time travel. That was saving our friend who'd died two weeks earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though it had appeared impossible regardless of the approach, concluding that last detail might've opened the first real path to it, no matter how vague or improbable.{w} If we could understand what determined the exact amount of time to be traveled, and most importantly, the appearing location...{w} If there had been a time in which I'd been touching Miiya, and I could replicate that body...
entries.literal: "Even though it had appeared impossible regardless of the approach, concluding that last detail might've opened the first real path to it, no matter how vague or improbable.{w} If we could understand what determined the exact amount of time to be traveled, and most importantly, the appearing location...{w} If there had been a time in which I'd been touching Miiya, and I could replicate that body..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The possibility that Miiya would appear with me was potentially real. While it didn't sound all that special, the locker key had just been brought back into existence. I'd flushed it away through the toilet, and I'd managed to get it back with the Sekimeiya. Miiya's circumstances were the same, with the sole difference that she was a human being.
entries.literal: "The possibility that Miiya would appear with me was potentially real. While it didn't sound all that special, the locker key had just been brought back into existence. I'd flushed it away through the toilet, and I'd managed to get it back with the Sekimeiya. Miiya's circumstances were the same, with the sole difference that she was a human being."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My past body and my possessions of the past could be replicated, but Miiya might not have counted if I'd simply been "touching her".{w} But what if I could think of a time where I'd been holding her hand or her shirt? None immediately came to mind, but they could apply.
entries.literal: "My past body and my possessions of the past could be replicated, but Miiya might not have counted if I'd simply been \"touching her\".{w} But what if I could think of a time where I'd been holding her hand or her shirt? None immediately came to mind, but they could apply."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at Shiroya, whose pensive look surely resembled mine. We'd remained silent for many seconds, and while I hadn't thought of voicing my recent thoughts to her, it was a path she could also find herself.
entries.literal: "I looked at Shiroya, whose pensive look surely resembled mine. We'd remained silent for many seconds, and while I hadn't thought of voicing my recent thoughts to her, it was a path she could also find herself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a couple steps back to lean on the column, trying to break through the single wall that blocked my reasoning.
entries.literal: "I took a couple steps back to lean on the column, trying to break through the single wall that blocked my reasoning."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I might have jumped the gun by minimizing the fact that Miiya is a human.{w} While I thought that we couldn't rule this out without attempting it, I see a big problem that might just reveal its impossibility.
entries.literal: "I might have jumped the gun by minimizing the fact that Miiya is a human.{w} While I thought that we couldn't rule this out without attempting it, I see a big problem that might just reveal its impossibility."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The biggest difference between a key and a human being, is, without a doubt, the possession of consciousness.
entries.literal: "The biggest difference between a key and a human being, is, without a doubt, the possession of consciousness."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In the bedroom, our past bodies were recreated, and we appeared within them. The locker key is proof enough of that.{w} However, what happened to the brain? If our past bodies were recreated, the brain belonged to a past version of us. Despite that, we possessed memories and knowledge obtained after the recreated point.
entries.literal: "In the bedroom, our past bodies were recreated, and we appeared within them. The locker key is proof enough of that.{w} However, what happened to the brain? If our past bodies were recreated, the brain belonged to a past version of us. Despite that, we possessed memories and knowledge obtained after the recreated point."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So even though we appeared in bodies identical to our past's, the past minds were left out...
entries.literal: "So even though we appeared in bodies identical to our past's, the past minds were left out..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Why did our consciousnesses appear in our past bodies without conflicting with our past consciousnesses? That has to be because we touched the Sekimeiya while in possession of a future consciousness. Then, it was put within a past version of us—one that had a vacant mind.
entries.literal: "Why did our consciousnesses appear in our past bodies without conflicting with our past consciousnesses? That has to be because we touched the Sekimeiya while in possession of a future consciousness. Then, it was put within a past version of us—one that had a vacant mind."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, what would happen if I could replicate my body from a time I was holding Miiya? My consciousness would make it to the replicated body, but since Miiya's wouldn't travel with the Sekimeiya, there'd be none to insert into hers. Therefore, it's possible I'd appear next to a lifeless body, as past consciousnesses aren't being replicated.
entries.literal: "So, what would happen if I could replicate my body from a time I was holding Miiya? My consciousness would make it to the replicated body, but since Miiya's wouldn't travel with the Sekimeiya, there'd be none to insert into hers. Therefore, it's possible I'd appear next to a lifeless body, as past consciousnesses aren't being replicated."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But I can't know whether I'm overwriting my past consciousness every time I replicate my body or if it's merely not being replicated and I'm occupying an empty spot.{w} After all, the Sekimeiya touched Isla's dead body and she didn't travel. That's probably because there was no longer a consciousness present within her.
entries.literal: "But I can't know whether I'm overwriting my past consciousness every time I replicate my body or if it's merely not being replicated and I'm occupying an empty spot.{w} After all, the Sekimeiya touched Isla's dead body and she didn't travel. That's probably because there was no longer a consciousness present within her."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: To try to make this happen and test which hypothesis is correct, attaching ourselves to the smallest possibility, we'd have to understand the Sekimeiya completely. We would need to make one final, thorough attempt to save Miiya. Shiroya and I can't arrange the necessary circumstances by ourselves to see if it could ever work because a successful result would create an extra, permanent version of one of us...
entries.literal: "To try to make this happen and test which hypothesis is correct, attaching ourselves to the smallest possibility, we'd have to understand the Sekimeiya completely. We would need to make one final, thorough attempt to save Miiya. Shiroya and I can't arrange the necessary circumstances by ourselves to see if it could ever work because a successful result would create an extra, permanent version of one of us..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, the first step: what determines the point in time our replicated bodies are based on? It's definitely different from the amount of time traveled, and it doesn't seem to be consistent.
entries.literal: "So, the first step: what determines the point in time our replicated bodies are based on? It's definitely different from the amount of time traveled, and it doesn't seem to be consistent."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But the second step—the amount of distance traveled—appears to operate under a consistent rule: the longer the Sekimeiya spends storing energy, the farther we travel.{w} ...Meanwhile, the replicated location has differed with each travel, and there's no clear rule to draw. Nonetheless, it's hard to think only one thing would be consistent.
entries.literal: "But the second step—the amount of distance traveled—appears to operate under a consistent rule: the longer the Sekimeiya spends storing energy, the farther we travel.{w} ...Meanwhile, the replicated location has differed with each travel, and there's no clear rule to draw. Nonetheless, it's hard to think only one thing would be consistent."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The core of replicating a past location is purely teleportation. We're teleporting to a coordinate of space we were once at.{w} However, how is the Sekimeiya working with that coordinate? While the answer could be that its powers are simply magical, there's more depth to it than I first thought.
entries.literal: "The core of replicating a past location is purely teleportation. We're teleporting to a coordinate of space we were once at.{w} However, how is the Sekimeiya working with that coordinate? While the answer could be that its powers are simply magical, there's more depth to it than I first thought."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The easiest concept of teleportation to grasp consists of two containers and matter teleporting from one to the other. The teleportation point is "the other container" because it exists and can be accessed.{w} We aren't appearing inside designated and fixed containers, though, so let's assume that the coordinate of the bedroom, where I appeared, can be measured with a number.
entries.literal: "The easiest concept of teleportation to grasp consists of two containers and matter teleporting from one to the other. The teleportation point is \"the other container\" because it exists and can be accessed.{w} We aren't appearing inside designated and fixed containers, though, so let's assume that the coordinate of the bedroom, where I appeared, can be measured with a number."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When I touched the Sekimeiya, it sent me to that space coordinate after recognizing that I'd found myself there in the past. The problem is that we live on Earth, a planet that is constantly moving.
entries.literal: "When I touched the Sekimeiya, it sent me to that space coordinate after recognizing that I'd found myself there in the past. The problem is that we live on Earth, a planet that is constantly moving."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: As time went forward, Earth would've moved away from that coordinate, and it wouldn't have corresponded to the attic's bedroom anymore. If the Sekimeiya had simply sent me to one of my past coordinates, chances are I would've appeared in the middle of space.
entries.literal: "As time went forward, Earth would've moved away from that coordinate, and it wouldn't have corresponded to the attic's bedroom anymore. If the Sekimeiya had simply sent me to one of my past coordinates, chances are I would've appeared in the middle of space."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Going off Shiroya's estimate, we appeared where we were ten minutes prior to traveling while only going back five. At that point, the coordinate that had once belonged to the attic's bedroom had already been vacated by Earth...
entries.literal: "Going off Shiroya's estimate, we appeared where we were ten minutes prior to traveling while only going back five. At that point, the coordinate that had once belonged to the attic's bedroom had already been vacated by Earth..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been walking in circles around the column, absorbed in my unusual thoughts. Shiroya saw that I'd stopped and stretched her body a bit.
entries.literal: "I'd been walking in circles around the column, absorbed in my unusual thoughts. Shiroya saw that I'd stopped and stretched her body a bit."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Should we go? It's well past the time we traveled.
entries.literal: "...Should we go? It's well past the time we traveled."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, but I want to do one thing first.
entries.literal: "Yes, but I want to do one thing first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I showed her the locker key. Then, we left through hallway B.
entries.literal: "I showed her the locker key. Then, we left through hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It became evident we'd left the doors of two rooms open: the event room and room B6. I ignored them and walked to the bathrooms.
entries.literal: "It became evident we'd left the doors of two rooms open: the event room and room B6. I ignored them and walked to the bathrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like before, I raised the toilet's lid and tossed the key inside, then flushed it away.
entries.literal: "Like before, I raised the toilet's lid and tossed the key inside, then flushed it away."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Had to do it. I want to deny the reality where someone uses it in the past to take our Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Had to do it. I want to deny the reality where someone uses it in the past to take our Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Well, the universe handled it fine again. The way the Sekimeiya disappeared from the locker is still basically a locked-room mystery.
entries.literal: "Well, the universe handled it fine again. The way the Sekimeiya disappeared from the locker is still basically a locked-room mystery."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She shrugged, and while she was right, I still went to the staff room.
entries.literal: "She shrugged, and while she was right, I still went to the staff room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was able to open the locker just fine, and there was no Sekimeiya inside.
entries.literal: "I was able to open the locker just fine, and there was no Sekimeiya inside."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm...{w} Nobody else ever held that key, right? Could someone go back in time and replicate a position where they were holding it?
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} Nobody else ever held that key, right? Could someone go back in time and replicate a position where they were holding it?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Only when Sai found the whole set on the first Naomi, I'm pretty sure.
entries.literal: "Only when Sai found the whole set on the first Naomi, I'm pretty sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind had gone pretty deep into it: what if someone replicated a position in which they'd been "holding" me? Had that ever happened?{w} ...If that would create a lifeless body of mine, it could appear holding the key.
entries.literal: "My mind had gone pretty deep into it: what if someone replicated a position in which they'd been \"holding\" me? Had that ever happened?{w} ...If that would create a lifeless body of mine, it could appear holding the key."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Let's get the Sekimeiya. It still has to be in the other room.
entries.literal: "...Let's get the Sekimeiya. It still has to be in the other room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Across the hallway was the crystal room we'd traveled from. We pushed the door farther and peered into the empty space.
entries.literal: "Across the hallway was the crystal room we'd traveled from. We pushed the door farther and peered into the empty space."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We lowered our view and scanned the shining floor. With puzzled faces, we stepped in to access better angles after failing to spot the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "We lowered our view and scanned the shining floor. With puzzled faces, we stepped in to access better angles after failing to spot the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...It's not here.
entries.literal: "...It's not here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That didn't make any sense. Had someone taken it while we were in the lobby?
entries.literal: "That didn't make any sense. Had someone taken it while we were in the lobby?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: When we traveled, it would've fallen to the floor. Did it roll somewhere?
entries.literal: "When we traveled, it would've fallen to the floor. Did it roll somewhere?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked all around me and shook my head.{w} Then, I continued circling the room with my eyes until I noticed an oddity.
entries.literal: "I looked all around me and shook my head.{w} Then, I continued circling the room with my eyes until I noticed an oddity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few cabinets were composed of drawers instead of having a hollow interior compartment. One of the drawers was sticking out more than the others.
entries.literal: "A few cabinets were composed of drawers instead of having a hollow interior compartment. One of the drawers was sticking out more than the others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to it, unsure if it was anything important. When Shiroya saw what I was staring at, she also realized what was off.{w} Upon closer examination, even though the difference was minimal, my observation was proven correct: the lowest drawer of a cabinet wasn't fully closed. Before I could reach it, Shiroya spoke about a detail I'd missed.
entries.literal: "I walked up to it, unsure if it was anything important. When Shiroya saw what I was staring at, she also realized what was off.{w} Upon closer examination, even though the difference was minimal, my observation was proven correct: the lowest drawer of a cabinet wasn't fully closed. Before I could reach it, Shiroya spoke about a detail I'd missed."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: This is the cabinet the Sekimeiya was next to, right?
entries.literal: "This is the cabinet the Sekimeiya was next to, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, earlier? You're right, it was on the floor, in front of it...
entries.literal: "Oh, earlier? You're right, it was on the floor, in front of it..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Which meant that, most likely, the person who left the Sekimeiya behind also opened the drawer.{w} I extended my arm and pulled the drawer toward me. Immediately, an object within rolled around the narrow interior, making dry noises as it hit the wood.
entries.literal: "Which meant that, most likely, the person who left the Sekimeiya behind also opened the drawer.{w} I extended my arm and pulled the drawer toward me. Immediately, an object within rolled around the narrow interior, making dry noises as it hit the wood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After it stopped rolling, the immobile Sekimeiya met our eyes, letting out a surrounding faint glow. Aside from it, there was nothing else inside.
entries.literal: "After it stopped rolling, the immobile Sekimeiya met our eyes, letting out a surrounding faint glow. Aside from it, there was nothing else inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I looked at each other, well aware that what we were seeing didn't make sense. The Sekimeiya had disappeared only to reappear inside a nearby drawer.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I looked at each other, well aware that what we were seeing didn't make sense. The Sekimeiya had disappeared only to reappear inside a nearby drawer."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is it even the same one? The drawer wasn't shut all the way, so we can probably ignore the self-teleportation we've been thinking of. Someone most likely put it here.
entries.literal: "Is it even the same one? The drawer wasn't shut all the way, so we can probably ignore the self-teleportation we've been thinking of. Someone most likely put it here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But... who would've failed to properly close a drawer? Once again, it seemed as if we'd been lured to the Sekimeiya's whereabouts.
entries.literal: "But... who would've failed to properly close a drawer? Once again, it seemed as if we'd been lured to the Sekimeiya's whereabouts."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before questioning anything else, I put my shirt between my hand and the Sekimeiya's surface, as I'd been trained to do. However, I couldn't last more than a couple seconds before I had to take my hand off.
entries.literal: "Before questioning anything else, I put my shirt between my hand and the Sekimeiya's surface, as I'd been trained to do. However, I couldn't last more than a couple seconds before I had to take my hand off."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck...!? It's burning.
entries.literal: "What the fuck...!? It's burning."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: If we're right, that must mean that it's been here for a while...
entries.literal: "If we're right, that must mean that it's been here for a while..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "The longer the Sekimeiya spends away from a cold temperature, the hotter it gets, the farther back in time you go, and the bigger the range is". If that was correct, she must've been right.
entries.literal: "\"The longer the Sekimeiya spends away from a cold temperature, the hotter it gets, the farther back in time you go, and the bigger the range is\". If that was correct, she must've been right."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm pretty sure it wasn't this hot during previous travels.
entries.literal: "I'm pretty sure it wasn't this hot during previous travels."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was an imposing claim. Every time we'd found the Sekimeiya, the decision of whether to touch it had been quick to arrive. If the proposition was to go substantially back through time, I wasn't so sure about it, as it would make our presence in the tower hard to accomplish and we would still be unable to change the past.
entries.literal: "It was an imposing claim. Every time we'd found the Sekimeiya, the decision of whether to touch it had been quick to arrive. If the proposition was to go substantially back through time, I wasn't so sure about it, as it would make our presence in the tower hard to accomplish and we would still be unable to change the past."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Let's put it in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Let's put it in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at Shiroya and was met with a bitter expression. She'd already made up her mind.{w} Touching it could have brought us out of the tower, but it also had the chance to considerably drag out our stay while we'd be unable to have any impact on a history which had already occurred. I nodded and began thinking about how to move it without burning myself.
entries.literal: "I looked at Shiroya and was met with a bitter expression. She'd already made up her mind.{w} Touching it could have brought us out of the tower, but it also had the chance to considerably drag out our stay while we'd be unable to have any impact on a history which had already occurred. I nodded and began thinking about how to move it without burning myself."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think we should just stop altogether... Let's just wait until we can leave.{w} We can travel through time, which is still insane to think about, but there's no point to it, right? At most, it can help us understand what's going on, but there are cameras all over the place, and the police are probably a few hours away from entering.{w} We don't even know how the Sekimeiya got inside the drawer, and it's clear that we don't understand anything about what we got caught up in. Touching it again could just be dangerous, so there's no point in risking it...
entries.literal: "I think we should just stop altogether... Let's just wait until we can leave.{w} We can travel through time, which is still insane to think about, but there's no point to it, right? At most, it can help us understand what's going on, but there are cameras all over the place, and the police are probably a few hours away from entering.{w} We don't even know how the Sekimeiya got inside the drawer, and it's clear that we don't understand anything about what we got caught up in. Touching it again could just be dangerous, so there's no point in risking it..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tacitly listened to her giving multiple reasons not to touch it. It left me a bit confused, as she hadn't been opposed to it mere minutes ago.
entries.literal: "I tacitly listened to her giving multiple reasons not to touch it. It left me a bit confused, as she hadn't been opposed to it mere minutes ago."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I'm sure you can imagine that I've been thinking about how we could undo what happened... but it's not possible. The more time I spend thinking about it, the further I am from being able to let the wound heal. I don't think having hope itself is bad, but it is if we know that it doesn't really exist. The Sekimeiya is useless.
entries.literal: "...I'm sure you can imagine that I've been thinking about how we could undo what happened... but it's not possible. The more time I spend thinking about it, the further I am from being able to let the wound heal. I don't think having hope itself is bad, but it is if we know that it doesn't really exist. The Sekimeiya is useless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was left dumbfounded by those harsh words, and I found myself trying to think about a reply before realizing that I agreed with her. I'd been going on about Isla's decided fate while obsessing over a way to reverse Miiya's. In reality, both were just as impossible to change. ...I recalled the pensive face Shiroya had been making in the lobby, where she must've reached that ultimate conclusion.
entries.literal: "I was left dumbfounded by those harsh words, and I found myself trying to think about a reply before realizing that I agreed with her. I'd been going on about Isla's decided fate while obsessing over a way to reverse Miiya's. In reality, both were just as impossible to change. ...I recalled the pensive face Shiroya had been making in the lobby, where she must've reached that ultimate conclusion."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We said we'd go to Airun after we get out to see what's become of the cabin. Let's make sure that happens.
entries.literal: "We said we'd go to Airun after we get out to see what's become of the cabin. Let's make sure that happens."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I felt a breaking wave of emotions, I managed to give her a nod. I'd let the desire to escape become a background goal, while it should've been the only thing to strive for. It had been sudden, but after all those dreamlike hours, Shiroya brought me back to reality—Miiya's death was irreversible.{w} I breathed deeply, trying to keep myself balanced.
entries.literal: "As I felt a breaking wave of emotions, I managed to give her a nod. I'd let the desire to escape become a background goal, while it should've been the only thing to strive for. It had been sudden, but after all those dreamlike hours, Shiroya brought me back to reality—Miiya's death was irreversible.{w} I breathed deeply, trying to keep myself balanced."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: A-All right... I agree.{w} Let's wait patiently and ignore whatever the hell the others are doing. At {time=21}, the front door has to open.
entries.literal: "A-All right... I agree.{w} Let's wait patiently and ignore whatever the hell the others are doing. At {time=21}, the front door has to open."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Right... What's going on here has nothing to do with us, and it's gotten too big to try to understand. You said Akaro and Sai could enter from the outside to grab the Sekimeiya, so let's leave it in the cabinet and wait next to it.
entries.literal: "Right... What's going on here has nothing to do with us, and it's gotten too big to try to understand. You said Akaro and Sai could enter from the outside to grab the Sekimeiya, so let's leave it in the cabinet and wait next to it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the bottom of my shirt with my left hand to create a small hammock where I placed the Sekimeiya. As the cloth wasn't touching my skin, I was able to transport the Sekimeiya safely. I quickly headed toward the door, and we left the room.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the bottom of my shirt with my left hand to create a small hammock where I placed the Sekimeiya. As the cloth wasn't touching my skin, I was able to transport the Sekimeiya safely. I quickly headed toward the door, and we left the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were in hallway B. My perspective on the recording had been fluctuating drastically, and once again, it had become one of the worst possibilities. If it did occur, despite meaning that Isla would be alive in the future, that was only the illusion of an upside: she'd end up going to the past to die inside the room A5 cabinet.
entries.literal: "We were in hallway B. My perspective on the recording had been fluctuating drastically, and once again, it had become one of the worst possibilities. If it did occur, despite meaning that Isla would be alive in the future, that was only the illusion of an upside: she'd end up going to the past to die inside the room A5 cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took short steps so that the Sekimeiya would stay still. Eventually, I reached the open door that led to the event room, where we would again attempt a wait, detaching ourselves from our surroundings.
entries.literal: "I took short steps so that the Sekimeiya would stay still. Eventually, I reached the open door that led to the event room, where we would again attempt a wait, detaching ourselves from our surroundings."

entries.text: Touch the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Touch the Sekimeiya."

entries.text: Enter the room.
entries.literal: "Enter the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The world froze.{w} However, strangely, movement was still within.
entries.literal: "The world froze.{w} However, strangely, movement was still within."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya lived in a delicate universe. A single modification could collapse the complex structure they were climbing.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Shiroya lived in a delicate universe. A single modification could collapse the complex structure they were climbing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...However, the structure could be partially frozen and then changed.
entries.literal: "...However, the structure could be partially frozen and then changed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This universe will be frozen, and that will permit its observation. It will become a universe that would collapse if set in motion.
entries.literal: "This universe will be frozen, and that will permit its observation. It will become a universe that would collapse if set in motion."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Rules have to be bent abstractly—the flow must stop. Only that will allow an impossibility.
entries.literal: "Rules have to be bent abstractly—the flow must stop. Only that will allow an impossibility."

entries.text: Theater Under The Sun
entries.literal: "Theater Under The Sun"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya were in front of the event room. Unbeknownst to them, instead of deftly weaving their way through myriad, tangled threads, those very same strings took hold of their own bodies.{w} Atsuki's hand reached for the Sekimeiya, and as his brain was informed of the most painful burn he'd ever felt, his eyes took in the sudden darkness that appeared around him.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Shiroya were in front of the event room. Unbeknownst to them, instead of deftly weaving their way through myriad, tangled threads, those very same strings took hold of their own bodies.{w} Atsuki's hand reached for the Sekimeiya, and as his brain was informed of the most painful burn he'd ever felt, his eyes took in the sudden darkness that appeared around him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He attempted to understand where he'd appeared, but the lack of light made it futile. He'd touched the Sekimeiya, going against what he'd agreed with Shiroya. However, while there hadn't been a reason behind it, he didn't question his action.
entries.literal: "He attempted to understand where he'd appeared, but the lack of light made it futile. He'd touched the Sekimeiya, going against what he'd agreed with Shiroya. However, while there hadn't been a reason behind it, he didn't question his action."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a few seconds lost within the darkness, his eyes began to adjust, and he spotted a faint light coming from his left. Immediately, he recognized where he was.
entries.literal: "After a few seconds lost within the darkness, his eyes began to adjust, and he spotted a faint light coming from his left. Immediately, he recognized where he was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It belonged to the reception desk found in the lobby of Ashiya Tower. That was where he had appeared.
entries.literal: "It belonged to the reception desk found in the lobby of Ashiya Tower. That was where he had appeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had to determine the time. While the lack of light wasn't a complete giveaway, he knew he hadn't traveled just a short time back.
entries.literal: "He had to determine the time. While the lack of light wasn't a complete giveaway, he knew he hadn't traveled just a short time back."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He approached the hallway B door and surreptitiously turned the doorknob, spending a while locating it. Without offering any resistance, it opened the path to the wide corridor, which resembled nothing more than a haunting void. It was just as dark as the lobby, with no light to verify his surroundings.
entries.literal: "He approached the hallway B door and surreptitiously turned the doorknob, spending a while locating it. Without offering any resistance, it opened the path to the wide corridor, which resembled nothing more than a haunting void. It was just as dark as the lobby, with no light to verify his surroundings."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, he knew the layout and began to move forward. Even though he was lost in time, his movements hinted at a goal.{w} After a few steps, his motion was halted by a sound that echoed off the walls.
entries.literal: "However, he knew the layout and began to move forward. Even though he was lost in time, his movements hinted at a goal.{w} After a few steps, his motion was halted by a sound that echoed off the walls."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: Stop moving at once! Stay still and do not run away.
entries.literal: "Stop moving at once! Stay still and do not run away."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The sudden, robotic noise pierced through Atsuki's chest, accomplishing its demand before the words could be processed. Atsuki understood the meaning behind the voice, as it had been explained to him. It must've belonged to the microphone installed in the security room.
entries.literal: "The sudden, robotic noise pierced through Atsuki's chest, accomplishing its demand before the words could be processed. Atsuki understood the meaning behind the voice, as it had been explained to him. It must've belonged to the microphone installed in the security room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He hadn't seen it, but a speaker was surely placed somewhere in the walls. Conclusions could be drawn from the overly loud voice: someone was in the security room, and most importantly, the hallway cameras were functioning. As Katei had told them, they possessed night vision. Atsuki had traveled to a point that met those conditions.
entries.literal: "He hadn't seen it, but a speaker was surely placed somewhere in the walls. Conclusions could be drawn from the overly loud voice: someone was in the security room, and most importantly, the hallway cameras were functioning. As Katei had told them, they possessed night vision. Atsuki had traveled to a point that met those conditions."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Awaiting his next instructions, he stayed immobile, showing no intention of defying what he'd been told. However, when the voice played again, a frown drew itself over his face.
entries.literal: "Awaiting his next instructions, he stayed immobile, showing no intention of defying what he'd been told. However, when the voice played again, a frown drew itself over his face."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: What are you doing!? You cannot escape!
entries.literal: "What are you doing!? You cannot escape!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki was beginning to lose his sense of direction, as he still couldn't discern the walls around him. Those words let him know that he was not aware of the situation either.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was beginning to lose his sense of direction, as he still couldn't discern the walls around him. Those words let him know that he was not aware of the situation either."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was unlikely the last message had been addressed to him because he hadn't moved at all. To test it, he walked forward, waiting to see if his existence would be recognized.
entries.literal: "It was unlikely the last message had been addressed to him because he hadn't moved at all. To test it, he walked forward, waiting to see if his existence would be recognized."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a few steps, no new message reverberated.{w} He looked up and saw a distant and faint green light. It belonged to a security camera, but he couldn't know if it was working.
entries.literal: "After a few steps, no new message reverberated.{w} He looked up and saw a distant and faint green light. It belonged to a security camera, but he couldn't know if it was working."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, he had a way to assure he remained unseen. Attempting to achieve a safer position, he took a few more steps and began to feel the cold left wall.
entries.literal: "However, he had a way to assure he remained unseen. Attempting to achieve a safer position, he took a few more steps and began to feel the cold left wall."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He shortly spotted a door and took hold of its knob. Then, he felt an alien pain in his hand that startled him. Confused, he tried with his other hand and pushed open the door with ease.{w} To comprehend where he was, he reached for the closest wall. After recognizing the shape of a locker, he knew he'd picked the correct door and had arrived in the staff room.
entries.literal: "He shortly spotted a door and took hold of its knob. Then, he felt an alien pain in his hand that startled him. Confused, he tried with his other hand and pushed open the door with ease.{w} To comprehend where he was, he reached for the closest wall. After recognizing the shape of a locker, he knew he'd picked the correct door and had arrived in the staff room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd chosen it for its lack of cameras. He thought something was happening around him, so he didn't want to be mistaken for an escaping culprit, and he could feel slightly more comfortable in a closed-off space.
entries.literal: "He'd chosen it for its lack of cameras. He thought something was happening around him, so he didn't want to be mistaken for an escaping culprit, and he could feel slightly more comfortable in a closed-off space."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There, he waited. He didn't know why it had all come to that, but the imposing darkness only allowed him to wait until he could understand what was happening.
entries.literal: "There, he waited. He didn't know why it had all come to that, but the imposing darkness only allowed him to wait until he could understand what was happening."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Just a few minutes earlier, he'd been talking to Shiroya about making it out of the tower and resuming their old life. He couldn't yet be sure if touching the Sekimeiya had made that easier.
entries.literal: "Just a few minutes earlier, he'd been talking to Shiroya about making it out of the tower and resuming their old life. He couldn't yet be sure if touching the Sekimeiya had made that easier."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stood next to the door, certain that he'd notice it if someone were to try to open it.
entries.literal: "He stood next to the door, certain that he'd notice it if someone were to try to open it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But what he'd expected to be a short wait eventually morphed into more than half an hour of pure silence. As the empty minutes kept going by, ominous emotions began to fill his mind. Would he be mistaken for a criminal at the end of his wait? Was he alone, even though someone else must've been addressed earlier? If someone else was present, should he try to evade them or go look for them?
entries.literal: "But what he'd expected to be a short wait eventually morphed into more than half an hour of pure silence. As the empty minutes kept going by, ominous emotions began to fill his mind. Would he be mistaken for a criminal at the end of his wait? Was he alone, even though someone else must've been addressed earlier? If someone else was present, should he try to evade them or go look for them?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Countless thoughts passed through his brain, yet he couldn't decide. Wherever that point in time was, Atsuki spent a full hour of it as the sole guard of the staff room while uncertainty permeated his being.
entries.literal: "Countless thoughts passed through his brain, yet he couldn't decide. Wherever that point in time was, Atsuki spent a full hour of it as the sole guard of the staff room while uncertainty permeated his being."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suddenly, he checked his pocket. There, he found a small key, which he recognized had the shape of Naomi's locker's.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, he checked his pocket. There, he found a small key, which he recognized had the shape of Naomi's locker's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Without warning, the lights turned on, emitting no noise. Instead of being startled, Atsuki shut his eyes forcibly, attacked by the intense illumination.{w} After a few attempts at reopening them, his vision finally adapted, and he looked around the room where he'd spent so much time. He confirmed that it was the staff room, looking exactly as he'd thought.
entries.literal: "Without warning, the lights turned on, emitting no noise. Instead of being startled, Atsuki shut his eyes forcibly, attacked by the intense illumination.{w} After a few attempts at reopening them, his vision finally adapted, and he looked around the room where he'd spent so much time. He confirmed that it was the staff room, looking exactly as he'd thought."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The lights indicated that he wasn't alone in the building, but they were no cue to start moving. His dilemma hadn't yet been solved, so he remained indecisive.
entries.literal: "The lights indicated that he wasn't alone in the building, but they were no cue to start moving. His dilemma hadn't yet been solved, so he remained indecisive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before he could give his updated situation much thought, he heard a sound coming from the hallway, resembling the one of footsteps he'd heard a few times during the past hours.
entries.literal: "Before he could give his updated situation much thought, he heard a sound coming from the hallway, resembling the one of footsteps he'd heard a few times during the past hours."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Further amplifying their presence, the person in the hallway continued to make noise. Atsuki heard a door being opened and closed as well as sounds coming from behind the wall to his left.
entries.literal: "Further amplifying their presence, the person in the hallway continued to make noise. Atsuki heard a door being opened and closed as well as sounds coming from behind the wall to his left."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki's heart began to beat faster. As much as he wanted to understand what was happening, he had no desire to be found. He was paying close attention to every sound, but he failed to recognize that someone was right behind the door.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's heart began to beat faster. As much as he wanted to understand what was happening, he had no desire to be found. He was paying close attention to every sound, but he failed to recognize that someone was right behind the door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He heard the knob being gripped and looked at it turning. He stepped back, and as soon as the door opened, Atsuki fixed his gaze on the eyes of the person who'd finally found him.
entries.literal: "He heard the knob being gripped and looked at it turning. He stepped back, and as soon as the door opened, Atsuki fixed his gaze on the eyes of the person who'd finally found him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The figure was immediately taken aback while its expression shaped into one of defiance. Atsuki, on the other hand, wore an unsure look after immediately recognizing the man.
entries.literal: "The figure was immediately taken aback while its expression shaped into one of defiance. Atsuki, on the other hand, wore an unsure look after immediately recognizing the man."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Wh-What the fuck are you doing?" Those were the first words Atsuki heard in more than an hour.{w} He didn't know how to reply, so he moved forward, drawn in by the scenery behind the man.
entries.literal: "\"Wh-What the fuck are you doing?\" Those were the first words Atsuki heard in more than an hour.{w} He didn't know how to reply, so he moved forward, drawn in by the scenery behind the man."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, he stopped himself when he spotted something of massive importance. The man was transporting a black suitcase.
entries.literal: "However, he stopped himself when he spotted something of massive importance. The man was transporting a black suitcase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Aren't you going to fucking answer me!? Who are you!?"
entries.literal: "\"Aren't you going to fucking answer me!? Who are you!?\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Since Atsuki knew that explaining wouldn't serve a purpose, he produced an inquiry of his own.
entries.literal: "Since Atsuki knew that explaining wouldn't serve a purpose, he produced an inquiry of his own."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "What's that suitcase for?"{w} The man's expression instantly morphed again. Those cold words were interpreted as a clear and sudden attack, but he tried to hide his reaction.
entries.literal: "\"What's that suitcase for?\"{w} The man's expression instantly morphed again. Those cold words were interpreted as a clear and sudden attack, but he tried to hide his reaction."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: What do you mean? It's just a suitcase. How were you even here?
entries.literal: "What do you mean? It's just a suitcase. How were you even here?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: First, tell me what you need the suitcase for.
entries.literal: "First, tell me what you need the suitcase for."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: Are you trying to imply something? I'm not following.
entries.literal: "Are you trying to imply something? I'm not following."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Huh... I understand what's going on now. Are the gems already inside it, or were you about to go get them?
entries.literal: "Huh... I understand what's going on now. Are the gems already inside it, or were you about to go get them?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Being able to reason something out had calmed Atsuki. Every trace of fear had left his body, replaced by confidence. "...Can the past be changed after all?" That question floated into Atsuki's mind.
entries.literal: "Being able to reason something out had calmed Atsuki. Every trace of fear had left his body, replaced by confidence. \"...Can the past be changed after all?\" That question floated into Atsuki's mind."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The man's face didn't change. He was lost in thought after Atsuki's abrupt accusation.
entries.literal: "The man's face didn't change. He was lost in thought after Atsuki's abrupt accusation."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nonchalantly, he entered the room and locked his piercing eyes on Atsuki, who didn't waver.
entries.literal: "Nonchalantly, he entered the room and locked his piercing eyes on Atsuki, who didn't waver."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suddenly, he grabbed Atsuki's neck and threw him into the wall.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, he grabbed Atsuki's neck and threw him into the wall."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: What the fuck do you know? Were you waiting for me?
entries.literal: "What the fuck do you know? Were you waiting for me?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki's reasoning had given him reassurance, but it hadn't prepared him. He had future information, so he should've had the upper hand. However, his discussions with Sai had given him false expectations, and he hadn't reacted properly to an abrupt physical attack.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's reasoning had given him reassurance, but it hadn't prepared him. He had future information, so he should've had the upper hand. However, his discussions with Sai had given him false expectations, and he hadn't reacted properly to an abrupt physical attack."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: Kid, no matter what you think you know, you are done for. You are sticking your nose into something very delicate, and this will not stand.
entries.literal: "Kid, no matter what you think you know, you are done for. You are sticking your nose into something very delicate, and this will not stand."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Those words didn't reach Atsuki, as his head had slammed too hard into the wall. While the man threw more and more threats at him, he was unaware that Atsuki's sight was only registering a blurry image of his face.
entries.literal: "Those words didn't reach Atsuki, as his head had slammed too hard into the wall. While the man threw more and more threats at him, he was unaware that Atsuki's sight was only registering a blurry image of his face."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once he had told him everything he'd deemed necessary, he let go of him, thinking that he'd managed to convey the seriousness of the situation. However, Atsuki's body plummeted down, the same lost gaze looking upward at the ceiling.
entries.literal: "Once he had told him everything he'd deemed necessary, he let go of him, thinking that he'd managed to convey the seriousness of the situation. However, Atsuki's body plummeted down, the same lost gaze looking upward at the ceiling."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as he understood what he'd done, the man rushed to grab him, hoping that he was only being tricked. However, that was far from the truth. Atsuki's remaining time alive was in a countdown, and as it ticked down, he couldn't even process that his fresh start with Shiroya would never begin.
entries.literal: "As soon as he understood what he'd done, the man rushed to grab him, hoping that he was only being tricked. However, that was far from the truth. Atsuki's remaining time alive was in a countdown, and as it ticked down, he couldn't even process that his fresh start with Shiroya would never begin."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the man realized he'd become a murderer, he froze, inheriting Atsuki's dilemma. He couldn't move, and he knew that the hallway's cameras would record him. For that reason, he stood next to the door, spending the minutes growing accustomed to the thought that his life had been ruined.
entries.literal: "When the man realized he'd become a murderer, he froze, inheriting Atsuki's dilemma. He couldn't move, and he knew that the hallway's cameras would record him. For that reason, he stood next to the door, spending the minutes growing accustomed to the thought that his life had been ruined."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He ran through many courses of action. Suddenly, he concluded that there was some hope left for him. Even though exiting the room would cement the reality of his actions, he might've had a way around it. After what had happened, though, he was unsure he could count on it.
entries.literal: "He ran through many courses of action. Suddenly, he concluded that there was some hope left for him. Even though exiting the room would cement the reality of his actions, he might've had a way around it. After what had happened, though, he was unsure he could count on it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Eventually, the previous events repeated themselves. The door was opened from the outside, and the man met face to face with the first person who'd see him as a killer.
entries.literal: "Eventually, the previous events repeated themselves. The door was opened from the outside, and the man met face to face with the first person who'd see him as a killer."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the floor, Atsuki spent the last seconds of his life facing up, unable to move any part of his body. Resembling a hallucination, he saw his killer being startled by the knob's movement. When the door completed its arc and bounced on the wall, three more figures entered Atsuki's sight, but he couldn't distinguish their expressions.{w} In front of him, he saw four people.
entries.literal: "On the floor, Atsuki spent the last seconds of his life facing up, unable to move any part of his body. Resembling a hallucination, he saw his killer being startled by the knob's movement. When the door completed its arc and bounced on the wall, three more figures entered Atsuki's sight, but he couldn't distinguish their expressions.{w} In front of him, he saw four people."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two men, a woman, and a girl. It seemed all of them were looking at him, and he felt something: he knew all of them. He recognized their clothes, bodies, and faces. He saw the last three of them rushing to him, but his mind cut off.
entries.literal: "Two men, a woman, and a girl. It seemed all of them were looking at him, and he felt something: he knew all of them. He recognized their clothes, bodies, and faces. He saw the last three of them rushing to him, but his mind cut off."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was the last image Atsuki saw. Then, his consciousness didn't fade away, as he had none.
entries.literal: "That was the last image Atsuki saw. Then, his consciousness didn't fade away, as he had none."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Similarly, none of this happened, as it couldn't. If the frozen sections could've been reached, everything would've crumbled down.
entries.literal: "Similarly, none of this happened, as it couldn't. If the frozen sections could've been reached, everything would've crumbled down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But... that wasn't all. Something else denied the whole structure's connection.
entries.literal: "But... that wasn't all. Something else denied the whole structure's connection."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Another rule had been defied.
entries.literal: "...Another rule had been defied."

entries.text: Ending: Ethereal Arc
entries.literal: "Ending: Ethereal Arc"

entries.text: A Step Forward
entries.literal: "A Step Forward"

entries.text: Only White
entries.literal: "Only White"

entries.speaker: i
