entries.text: Still cupping the Sekimeiya with my shirt, I stepped into its room, where I saw the cabinet and another open door. Shiroya came after me, glancing at the cabinet, which was partially covered by the dark curtain.
entries.literal: "Still cupping the Sekimeiya with my shirt, I stepped into its room, where I saw the cabinet and another open door. Shiroya came after me, glancing at the cabinet, which was partially covered by the dark curtain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She scrolled open the glass and helped me place the Sekimeiya inside. After we closed it again, we had a question to ask ourselves.
entries.literal: "She scrolled open the glass and helped me place the Sekimeiya inside. After we closed it again, we had a question to ask ourselves."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Should we lock it?
entries.literal: "Should we lock it?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think we should. We said we wouldn't use it anymore, so there's no reason not to.
entries.literal: "I think we should. We said we wouldn't use it anymore, so there's no reason not to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded after thinking about it. Akaro and Sai took the key when they left the bedroom, so it stood to reason that they still had it. If they'd traveled through time far enough to appear outside the tower, they wouldn't have appeared with it—if they planned to enter once more, they would have hidden it somewhere to retrieve it easily.
entries.literal: "I nodded after thinking about it. Akaro and Sai took the key when they left the bedroom, so it stood to reason that they still had it. If they'd traveled through time far enough to appear outside the tower, they wouldn't have appeared with it—if they planned to enter once more, they would have hidden it somewhere to retrieve it easily."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, locking it would prevent everyone else from opening it. I moved to the left side of the cabinet and crouched to manually turn the wheel.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, locking it would prevent everyone else from opening it. I moved to the left side of the cabinet and crouched to manually turn the wheel."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There. Only someone with the key will be able to open it. We'll stay here, though, so that won't happen.
entries.literal: "There. Only someone with the key will be able to open it. We'll stay here, though, so that won't happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She tried to move the glass and confirmed that I had locked it properly. To achieve a better effect, she pulled down the curtain and proceeded to glance around the room noncommittally, unsure of what else to do.
entries.literal: "She tried to move the glass and confirmed that I had locked it properly. To achieve a better effect, she pulled down the curtain and proceeded to glance around the room noncommittally, unsure of what else to do."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We haven't seen Erina and Katei since we left the bedroom. Do you wanna search for them before we decide to stay put?
entries.literal: "We haven't seen Erina and Katei since we left the bedroom. Do you wanna search for them before we decide to stay put?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She didn't answer. I thought she was considering the whereabouts of Akaro and Sai, who we had to find as well, but a single word defied my assumption.
entries.literal: "She didn't answer. I thought she was considering the whereabouts of Akaro and Sai, who we had to find as well, but a single word defied my assumption."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Look.
entries.literal: "Look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her gaze was fixed on the floor. I traced the line, spotting a drop of blood in the middle of a room for the second time.
entries.literal: "Her gaze was fixed on the floor. I traced the line, spotting a drop of blood in the middle of a room for the second time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were right next to it and hadn't seen it easily. It was smaller than the one in the lobby, but there was a much more important distinction.
entries.literal: "We were right next to it and hadn't seen it easily. It was smaller than the one in the lobby, but there was a much more important distinction."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: This one isn't that old. It's not completely dry.
entries.literal: "This one isn't that old. It's not completely dry."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is someone walking around and bleeding?
entries.literal: "Is someone walking around and bleeding?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite what it seemed, there had to be something more to it. If what we'd seen in the lobby was only a single drop, it came from a fairly serious injury. The one in front of us didn't give the same impression. I looked all over the floor again and didn't see even another speck.
entries.literal: "Despite what it seemed, there had to be something more to it. If what we'd seen in the lobby was only a single drop, it came from a fairly serious injury. The one in front of us didn't give the same impression. I looked all over the floor again and didn't see even another speck."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think we should try to find the others, in case something bad has happened.
entries.literal: "I think we should try to find the others, in case something bad has happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a good look at the blood. It wasn't fully dry like the spot in the lobby, indicating that the bleeding could've gone on for a while. If a wound had started to clot, it explained the smaller drop.
entries.literal: "I took a good look at the blood. It wasn't fully dry like the spot in the lobby, indicating that the bleeding could've gone on for a while. If a wound had started to clot, it explained the smaller drop."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Small amounts of blood dry up fast. While many factors are involved, I could estimate it would take, say, half an hour for a bit of it to fully dry in our conditions. This spot is close to meeting that mark, while the one in the lobby dried up before we saw it...
entries.literal: "Small amounts of blood dry up fast. While many factors are involved, I could estimate it would take, say, half an hour for a bit of it to fully dry in our conditions. This spot is close to meeting that mark, while the one in the lobby dried up before we saw it..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How do we do it, then? Does one of us stay here to make sure nobody takes the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "How do we do it, then? Does one of us stay here to make sure nobody takes the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After all we'd considered, exploring the possibility of a deliberate trap to send us out wasn't that ridiculous. In truth, the two drops of blood didn't feel very natural.
entries.literal: "After all we'd considered, exploring the possibility of a deliberate trap to send us out wasn't that ridiculous. In truth, the two drops of blood didn't feel very natural."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think we should do what we've been doing up until now. One of us stays in hallway C while the other looks through the rooms. It's unlikely anyone had an accident and bled on and off for so long... We should be careful.
entries.literal: "I think we should do what we've been doing up until now. One of us stays in hallway C while the other looks through the rooms. It's unlikely anyone had an accident and bled on and off for so long... We should be careful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't opposed, so we entered hallway A. Our tension had gradually escalated since we'd seen blood on the floor of the lobby. Using that arrangement felt safe enough, as we wouldn't be forced to separate ourselves while searching. Moving to the mechanical room would be the only unavoidable instance of that.
entries.literal: "I wasn't opposed, so we entered hallway A. Our tension had gradually escalated since we'd seen blood on the floor of the lobby. Using that arrangement felt safe enough, as we wouldn't be forced to separate ourselves while searching. Moving to the mechanical room would be the only unavoidable instance of that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'll see if I find anyone, then.
entries.literal: "I'll see if I find anyone, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She nodded sharply, standing next to hallway C. Volunteering to look through some rooms was no heroic task, but I felt a bit better doing it myself.
entries.literal: "She nodded sharply, standing next to hallway C. Volunteering to look through some rooms was no heroic task, but I felt a bit better doing it myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naturally, my attention was first directed at the storeroom. I opened the door with Shiroya looking on from behind. The long corridor still extended up to the door without a handle, and I stepped in to see if I could spot any change.
entries.literal: "Naturally, my attention was first directed at the storeroom. I opened the door with Shiroya looking on from behind. The long corridor still extended up to the door without a handle, and I stepped in to see if I could spot any change."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, everything was identical, just as I remembered it. I had no way to know if the door had been opened from either side, but I was certain that I still couldn't do it.
entries.literal: "However, everything was identical, just as I remembered it. I had no way to know if the door had been opened from either side, but I was certain that I still couldn't do it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In front was room A5, where the gems were stolen. Although "the room where Isla was found" was a more suitable name... I looked down as I entered it, knowing that I'd have to see her face again.
entries.literal: "In front was room A5, where the gems were stolen. Although \"the room where Isla was found\" was a more suitable name... I looked down as I entered it, knowing that I'd have to see her face again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There she was, immobile, her skin already showing a slight ashen tint. There was nothing next to her, so I quickly closed the lid and looked through the other cabinets.
entries.literal: "There she was, immobile, her skin already showing a slight ashen tint. There was nothing next to her, so I quickly closed the lid and looked through the other cabinets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After I'd seen all of their harmless interiors, I moved to the next room. Deeming it vacant was an easy task, which was repeated for the next four identical ones.
entries.literal: "After I'd seen all of their harmless interiors, I moved to the next room. Deeming it vacant was an easy task, which was repeated for the next four identical ones."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only the security room remained. After it, I'd go to the mechanical room, make sure nobody had entered the event room, and Shiroya would move toward hallway B. That would prevent anyone from using the event room as a bridge to remain hidden.
entries.literal: "Only the security room remained. After it, I'd go to the mechanical room, make sure nobody had entered the event room, and Shiroya would move toward hallway B. That would prevent anyone from using the event room as a bridge to remain hidden."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But when I opened the door, I was met with a sudden and unexpected sight.{w} My mind reeled as I stared at it, too stunned to react differently. I abruptly turned to face Shiroya, who responded to me with a plain expression.{w} I yelled at her to come over, and she sprinted toward me. Not only had I seen something that put an end to the search, but I also knew that Shiroya and I absolutely couldn't be separated.
entries.literal: "But when I opened the door, I was met with a sudden and unexpected sight.{w} My mind reeled as I stared at it, too stunned to react differently. I abruptly turned to face Shiroya, who responded to me with a plain expression.{w} I yelled at her to come over, and she sprinted toward me. Not only had I seen something that put an end to the search, but I also knew that Shiroya and I absolutely couldn't be separated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as she peeked inside, she visibly recoiled. Then, she had to force herself to breathe deeply and try to look again. Once she did, she saw she hadn't been mistaken.
entries.literal: "As soon as she peeked inside, she visibly recoiled. Then, she had to force herself to breathe deeply and try to look again. Once she did, she saw she hadn't been mistaken."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei's body was on the floor, partially under his desk. It appeared the two drops of blood had been a mere introduction to the sea we saw in the security room. His clothes, the desk, the floor... they'd all been splashed by the same red substance.
entries.literal: "Katei's body was on the floor, partially under his desk. It appeared the two drops of blood had been a mere introduction to the sea we saw in the security room. His clothes, the desk, the floor... they'd all been splashed by the same red substance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even after trying to process the image for a full minute, I couldn't bring myself to move. The thick smell of blood began to disperse through the open door, repelling us.
entries.literal: "Even after trying to process the image for a full minute, I couldn't bring myself to move. The thick smell of blood began to disperse through the open door, repelling us."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wh-What is this...? There's no way...
entries.literal: "Wh-What is this...? There's no way..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At some point, she said that, radiating pure disbelief. I couldn't bring myself to reply, but I took a step forward, scanning the dimly lit room.
entries.literal: "At some point, she said that, radiating pure disbelief. I couldn't bring myself to reply, but I took a step forward, scanning the dimly lit room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Three bright lights were situated in front of me. They were the three main computer monitors, which indicated that less than fifty minutes ago, it had been used.
entries.literal: "Three bright lights were situated in front of me. They were the three main computer monitors, which indicated that less than fifty minutes ago, it had been used."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya entered behind me, taking careful steps to avoid the blood that covered the majority of the floor. We looked at Katei's face, under the shadow of the desk. His darkened expression looked distressed and agitated, reminiscent of the one he'd made in the attic.
entries.literal: "Shiroya entered behind me, taking careful steps to avoid the blood that covered the majority of the floor. We looked at Katei's face, under the shadow of the desk. His darkened expression looked distressed and agitated, reminiscent of the one he'd made in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I swallowed my accumulated saliva and carefully crouched to check his pulse, but I didn't feel anything.
entries.literal: "I swallowed my accumulated saliva and carefully crouched to check his pulse, but I didn't feel anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried not to look in Shiroya's direction and continued inspecting Katei until I saw that a bit of blood was still pouring out of his skull. I didn't have to turn his head too much to see a huge crack. I immediately averted my eyes, with no doubts about what I would've seen if his white hair hadn't prevented it.
entries.literal: "I tried not to look in Shiroya's direction and continued inspecting Katei until I saw that a bit of blood was still pouring out of his skull. I didn't have to turn his head too much to see a huge crack. I immediately averted my eyes, with no doubts about what I would've seen if his white hair hadn't prevented it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up, shaken by the eerie background noise that the arrhythmic sound of dripping blood and the whirring computer had joined forces to create.
entries.literal: "I stood up, shaken by the eerie background noise that the arrhythmic sound of dripping blood and the whirring computer had joined forces to create."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...There's a horizontal crack in the back of his head. Given how much blood is on the desk, I think he fell on its edge.
entries.literal: "...There's a horizontal crack in the back of his head. Given how much blood is on the desk, I think he fell on its edge."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, Shiroya looked down at the pool of blood. It was natural for a head injury to bleed so much, and what I'd observed didn't reveal much. For all we knew, it was an accident.{w} The way I imagined it, if he'd fallen back, he would've hit his head against the desk, ended up under it, and pushed the chair away. Despite how much blood covered the floor, there were no bloody footprints leaving the room.
entries.literal: "Once again, Shiroya looked down at the pool of blood. It was natural for a head injury to bleed so much, and what I'd observed didn't reveal much. For all we knew, it was an accident.{w} The way I imagined it, if he'd fallen back, he would've hit his head against the desk, ended up under it, and pushed the chair away. Despite how much blood covered the floor, there were no bloody footprints leaving the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the gruesome scenery obligated us to think that someone could've done it. Pushing Katei would've achieved the same result.{w} Vast pools of blood would take a long time to dry, so I easily spotted smaller drops on the sides of the desk. Those were much closer to drying up, reminding me of the one in the event room.
entries.literal: "However, the gruesome scenery obligated us to think that someone could've done it. Pushing Katei would've achieved the same result.{w} Vast pools of blood would take a long time to dry, so I easily spotted smaller drops on the sides of the desk. Those were much closer to drying up, reminding me of the one in the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter what happened, though... he was dead. Katei, who was an enigma of his own and never stopped claiming his innocence, met his sudden end right after freeing himself from confinement in the attic.
entries.literal: "No matter what happened, though... he was dead. Katei, who was an enigma of his own and never stopped claiming his innocence, met his sudden end right after freeing himself from confinement in the attic."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Look at the screen. There's a message.
entries.literal: "...Look at the screen. There's a message."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I quickly glanced at it. As she'd said, in the center of the middle screen, I saw a tiny message box, containing one single line of text.
entries.literal: "I quickly glanced at it. As she'd said, in the center of the middle screen, I saw a tiny message box, containing one single line of text."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased".
entries.literal: "\"{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased\"."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, what...? At {time=10:04}?
entries.literal: "Oh, what...? At {time=10:04}?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That must've been when Katei was here alone. We checked the time at {time=9:41.}.. Twenty minutes later was when we left, and he stayed behind, trying to fix the system.
entries.literal: "That must've been when Katei was here alone. We checked the time at {time=9:41.}.. Twenty minutes later was when we left, and he stayed behind, trying to fix the system."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're right. And instead, he erased the existing footage and shut down the cameras. That's what this is saying.
entries.literal: "You're right. And instead, he erased the existing footage and shut down the cameras. That's what this is saying."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The most conspicuous hint, a message left on the computer, was potential proof that Katei had been the culprit we were trying to ferret out. I reached for the mouse and dragged the message aside.{w} Behind it, the program Katei had attempted to display the footage with was the only thing seen on the screen. It had a list of all the cameras, but they were useless if they'd actually been disabled.
entries.literal: "The most conspicuous hint, a message left on the computer, was potential proof that Katei had been the culprit we were trying to ferret out. I reached for the mouse and dragged the message aside.{w} Behind it, the program Katei had attempted to display the footage with was the only thing seen on the screen. It had a list of all the cameras, but they were useless if they'd actually been disabled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lowered my eyes. The taskbar contained the single clock we had at our disposal. As soon as I glanced at it, the numbers switched from {time=16:59} to {time=17:00.}
entries.literal: "I lowered my eyes. The taskbar contained the single clock we had at our disposal. As soon as I glanced at it, the numbers switched from {time=16:59} to {time=17:00.}"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's {time=17.} Only four hours are left.
entries.literal: "It's {time=17.} Only four hours are left."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Let's get out of here. From this room too. The smell is getting unbearable.
entries.literal: "...Let's get out of here. From this room too. The smell is getting unbearable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no complaints. Even though the hallway's illumination was worse, we left the much darker room and breathed steadily after the minutes we'd spent inside.
entries.literal: "I had no complaints. Even though the hallway's illumination was worse, we left the much darker room and breathed steadily after the minutes we'd spent inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The message on the screen... Without a doubt, it belonged to the security system program, but was that full proof of its trustworthiness? With such an obvious message being found next to him, I had to ask myself if it was legitimate or a diversion left by his killer. Not only did the room leave the possibility of an accident open, it also displayed an incriminating message next to Katei.
entries.literal: "The message on the screen... Without a doubt, it belonged to the security system program, but was that full proof of its trustworthiness? With such an obvious message being found next to him, I had to ask myself if it was legitimate or a diversion left by his killer. Not only did the room leave the possibility of an accident open, it also displayed an incriminating message next to Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was the message a fabrication by the real culprit to pin the blame on Katei and play it off as an accident while they were the ones to deal with the cameras and the security system? It wasn't easy to tell, and I wasn't sure which idea I was more inclined to lean toward.
entries.literal: "Was the message a fabrication by the real culprit to pin the blame on Katei and play it off as an accident while they were the ones to deal with the cameras and the security system? It wasn't easy to tell, and I wasn't sure which idea I was more inclined to lean toward."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, no. It doesn't make any sense. Look.
entries.literal: "Wait, no. It doesn't make any sense. Look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I followed Shiroya's line of sight again, that time up to the ceiling.
entries.literal: "I followed Shiroya's line of sight again, that time up to the ceiling."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That green light is supposed to indicate that the camera's recording, right? There's no way they were disabled so long ago.
entries.literal: "That green light is supposed to indicate that the camera's recording, right? There's no way they were disabled so long ago."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'd forgotten about that... You're right.{w} However... it was Katei who told us what the green light meant. We can't be certain about it.
entries.literal: "I'd forgotten about that... You're right.{w} However... it was Katei who told us what the green light meant. We can't be certain about it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: They haven't stopped flickering, and I'm sure they also were before {time=10}, so if the cameras really aren't recording, the lights must simply indicate that they're powered on.
entries.literal: "They haven't stopped flickering, and I'm sure they also were before {time=10}, so if the cameras really aren't recording, the lights must simply indicate that they're powered on."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's strange that Katei would tell a lie like that. If he disabled the cameras, part of the reason would be that he didn't want the police to see him when they entered. Despite that, he incriminated himself by lying to us about what the lights mean.
entries.literal: "It's strange that Katei would tell a lie like that. If he disabled the cameras, part of the reason would be that he didn't want the police to see him when they entered. Despite that, he incriminated himself by lying to us about what the lights mean."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah, that's... not consistent. Could someone else have left that message to blame him?
entries.literal: "Yeah, that's... not consistent. Could someone else have left that message to blame him?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure, but thinking about it more, there's no way this was an accident...{w} If Katei fell backward and hit his head against the desk, it means he was exiting the room. Why would he try to leave with that message being shown on the screen? Another person had to be involved somehow.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure, but thinking about it more, there's no way this was an accident...{w} If Katei fell backward and hit his head against the desk, it means he was exiting the room. Why would he try to leave with that message being shown on the screen? Another person had to be involved somehow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya agreed with me. After a few pensive seconds, being presented once again with the fact that a murderer was nearby, we had to decide on what to do.
entries.literal: "Shiroya agreed with me. After a few pensive seconds, being presented once again with the fact that a murderer was nearby, we had to decide on what to do."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you want to search for the others?
entries.literal: "Do you want to search for the others?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: W-We should. We don't know what happened to Akaro and Sai, but I'm worried about Erina. Just... We can't split up, Atsuki. We have to stay together no matter what.
entries.literal: "W-We should. We don't know what happened to Akaro and Sai, but I'm worried about Erina. Just... We can't split up, Atsuki. We have to stay together no matter what."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't say it was unlikely for Erina to become a target for the culprit. Katei was employed by Ashiya, a member of the security staff, but Isla had died despite being a complete outsider and a child. Any one of us could've been next.
entries.literal: "I couldn't say it was unlikely for Erina to become a target for the culprit. Katei was employed by Ashiya, a member of the security staff, but Isla had died despite being a complete outsider and a child. Any one of us could've been next."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, okay. Let's stick together and find Erina. Let's just be extremely careful. We have nothing to defend ourselves with if we're suddenly attacked.
entries.literal: "Yeah, okay. Let's stick together and find Erina. Let's just be extremely careful. We have nothing to defend ourselves with if we're suddenly attacked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She gave me a strained, saddened look. Even though only four hours remained, seeing the outside world felt infinitely far away.
entries.literal: "She gave me a strained, saddened look. Even though only four hours remained, seeing the outside world felt infinitely far away."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's see if the Sekimeiya's still here.
entries.literal: "Let's see if the Sekimeiya's still here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the event room.
entries.literal: "We entered the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya hadn't been taken while our attention was grabbed by the security room, so it was unlikely that was the intent of the culprit's plan. As a routine effort, I lowered the curtain again.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya hadn't been taken while our attention was grabbed by the security room, so it was unlikely that was the intent of the culprit's plan. As a routine effort, I lowered the curtain again."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We have to find Erina. It's... not good that we haven't seen her yet.
entries.literal: "We have to find Erina. It's... not good that we haven't seen her yet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right. There's no need to separate at all. We're only trying to find her, and she wouldn't hide from us. It could be dangerous to try to corner the culprit.
entries.literal: "All right. There's no need to separate at all. We're only trying to find her, and she wouldn't hide from us. It could be dangerous to try to corner the culprit."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Right. Let's finish up this floor...
entries.literal: "Right. Let's finish up this floor..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went to the lobby to access the mechanical room. Down the staircase was the strangely imposing room which could have served purposes beyond our understanding.
entries.literal: "We went to the lobby to access the mechanical room. Down the staircase was the strangely imposing room which could have served purposes beyond our understanding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were some spots out of reach from the stairs—under a table or behind some chairs in the back. Stepping farther in revealed the lack of any hidden person.
entries.literal: "There were some spots out of reach from the stairs—under a table or behind some chairs in the back. Stepping farther in revealed the lack of any hidden person."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I doubt Erina would be in a hallway B room, but let's look before going up.
entries.literal: "I doubt Erina would be in a hallway B room, but let's look before going up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The first room we looked into was empty. Failing to stumble upon anyone made things grow gradually more unsettling... We knew someone had to have traveled with the Sekimeiya shortly before we did...
entries.literal: "The first room we looked into was empty. Failing to stumble upon anyone made things grow gradually more unsettling... We knew someone had to have traveled with the Sekimeiya shortly before we did..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd explored the thought that, perhaps, if the range was huge, Erina had the chance to be caught up in it and escape the tower. However, Katei had gone downstairs before her and should've traveled as well. Since the dryness of his blood indicated that he'd died almost half an hour before we'd found him, I was willing to disregard that theory.
entries.literal: "I'd explored the thought that, perhaps, if the range was huge, Erina had the chance to be caught up in it and escape the tower. However, Katei had gone downstairs before her and should've traveled as well. Since the dryness of his blood indicated that he'd died almost half an hour before we'd found him, I was willing to disregard that theory."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I proceeded to the next room. Of course, if they'd traveled out of the tower after leaving the attic, it was possible Katei had reentered the tower through the storeroom entrance and then died. If the search for Erina yielded no results, that angle would gain some traction.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I proceeded to the next room. Of course, if they'd traveled out of the tower after leaving the attic, it was possible Katei had reentered the tower through the storeroom entrance and then died. If the search for Erina yielded no results, that angle would gain some traction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next room underwent an identical search. Halfway through, we realized that searching inside the cabinets defeated the point of what we agreed on. They were only a potential hiding spot for a culprit we'd decided was out of our reach.
entries.literal: "The next room underwent an identical search. Halfway through, we realized that searching inside the cabinets defeated the point of what we agreed on. They were only a potential hiding spot for a culprit we'd decided was out of our reach."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We opened the door to room B4.
entries.literal: "We opened the door to room B4."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Past it, on the floor, Naomi's corpse reminded us that it was the room where we'd found her. The sight stopped us in place, leaving us dumbstruck.
entries.literal: "Past it, on the floor, Naomi's corpse reminded us that it was the room where we'd found her. The sight stopped us in place, leaving us dumbstruck."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Because at her right, Erina lay, her clothes tinted maroon by all the blood on them.{w} Shiroya looked at me with the clear wish to deny reality. It hit us like a truck: Erina was dead too, and the only people remaining with us were dangers who we wanted to avoid.
entries.literal: "Because at her right, Erina lay, her clothes tinted maroon by all the blood on them.{w} Shiroya looked at me with the clear wish to deny reality. It hit us like a truck: Erina was dead too, and the only people remaining with us were dangers who we wanted to avoid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gulped before I took short steps forward. She was lying sideways, which let us see all the blood on her chest, though not extensively on the floor. There was some on her stomach and legs too. Unlike Katei's expression, hers looked almost serene despite everything the tower had put her through.
entries.literal: "I gulped before I took short steps forward. She was lying sideways, which let us see all the blood on her chest, though not extensively on the floor. There was some on her stomach and legs too. Unlike Katei's expression, hers looked almost serene despite everything the tower had put her through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I turned around, I saw Shiroya kneeling down, burying her face in her hands. Someone around us had killed a mother who'd just lost her daughter, and we would have to continue fearing that looming danger... for four more hours. I had no words for the horrendous view I was forced to accept.
entries.literal: "When I turned around, I saw Shiroya kneeling down, burying her face in her hands. Someone around us had killed a mother who'd just lost her daughter, and we would have to continue fearing that looming danger... for four more hours. I had no words for the horrendous view I was forced to accept."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stared at the scene in silence. Erina's clothes were slightly torn, signaling a physical fight, and the color of the blood indicated that it had been drying long enough to almost be a solid, just like Katei's.
entries.literal: "We stared at the scene in silence. Erina's clothes were slightly torn, signaling a physical fight, and the color of the blood indicated that it had been drying long enough to almost be a solid, just like Katei's."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's it... I can't look at her. Let's go...
entries.literal: "That's it... I can't look at her. Let's go..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lowered my head even more than it already was, clenching my fists. Seeing Shiroya like that was heartbreaking, but it was ultimately impressive how strong she'd been. On my end, I only found myself rejecting reality, never fully allowing the deaths we'd seen to sink in.
entries.literal: "I lowered my head even more than it already was, clenching my fists. Seeing Shiroya like that was heartbreaking, but it was ultimately impressive how strong she'd been. On my end, I only found myself rejecting reality, never fully allowing the deaths we'd seen to sink in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped out of the room, but I couldn't avoid turning around again and witnessing the end of two women we'd met that day.
entries.literal: "I stepped out of the room, but I couldn't avoid turning around again and witnessing the end of two women we'd met that day."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Give me a second.
entries.literal: "Give me a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi's body was covered by an elegant curtain, so I didn't want to leave Erina behind without one. The cameras might not even have been recording, so I went ahead and detached another curtain from a cabinet, laying it over Erina. With that small attempt at dignity, we left the room.
entries.literal: "Naomi's body was covered by an elegant curtain, so I didn't want to leave Erina behind without one. The cameras might not even have been recording, so I went ahead and detached another curtain from a cabinet, laying it over Erina. With that small attempt at dignity, we left the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked to the event room, lost. A threatening atmosphere had reared its ugly head with more finality than before; two murders in a row, and perhaps while we were on the same floor as them. Given the state of Erina's blood, it was more than likely that her body had been in that room for a while.
entries.literal: "We walked to the event room, lost. A threatening atmosphere had reared its ugly head with more finality than before; two murders in a row, and perhaps while we were on the same floor as them. Given the state of Erina's blood, it was more than likely that her body had been in that room for a while."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't reacted strongly to the past two—or three—deaths. It wasn't that we were desensitized, but that our feelings seemed insignificant compared to what was going in that place, as if our defeat had been unavoidable from the start. There had been no time to really stop and consider the true gravity of being sealed away with one or more murderers, at least not for me. Thinking of ways to either avoid or root out danger had taken priority.
entries.literal: "We hadn't reacted strongly to the past two—or three—deaths. It wasn't that we were desensitized, but that our feelings seemed insignificant compared to what was going in that place, as if our defeat had been unavoidable from the start. There had been no time to really stop and consider the true gravity of being sealed away with one or more murderers, at least not for me. Thinking of ways to either avoid or root out danger had taken priority."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But things had changed. Shiroya and I being the only ones left hammered in just how deadly the situation was. With all color drained from the world, we simply moved forth, feeling like birds with clipped wings trapped in a cage.
entries.literal: "But things had changed. Shiroya and I being the only ones left hammered in just how deadly the situation was. With all color drained from the world, we simply moved forth, feeling like birds with clipped wings trapped in a cage."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made sure the Sekimeiya was inside the cabinet and sat next to the hallway A door. Then, Shiroya leaned against the wall in front of me. More than likely, we were no match for the culprit behind those deaths, so there was no point in trying to do anything else. We had nowhere to possibly hide. Wishing for only stillness, we quietly let time carry us.
entries.literal: "I made sure the Sekimeiya was inside the cabinet and sat next to the hallway A door. Then, Shiroya leaned against the wall in front of me. More than likely, we were no match for the culprit behind those deaths, so there was no point in trying to do anything else. We had nowhere to possibly hide. Wishing for only stillness, we quietly let time carry us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With nothing left to do, I meaninglessly ran through the possibility of trusting one of the others.
entries.literal: "With nothing left to do, I meaninglessly ran through the possibility of trusting one of the others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was one detail that felt off. Doubting that Akaro and Sai were the culprits was foolish... but one thing pointed me toward it.
entries.literal: "There was one detail that felt off. Doubting that Akaro and Sai were the culprits was foolish... but one thing pointed me toward it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the drop of blood we'd found in the lobby. It was completely dry, meaning that it was left there while we'd been locked in the attic. However, the blood around Katei's and Erina's bodies had been, naturally, from a time after we unlocked the bedroom.
entries.literal: "It was the drop of blood we'd found in the lobby. It was completely dry, meaning that it was left there while we'd been locked in the attic. However, the blood around Katei's and Erina's bodies had been, naturally, from a time after we unlocked the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Therefore, during the time Akaro and Sai should've been the only people outside the attic's bedroom, someone had lost blood. In addition, I thought that a small injury wouldn't have produced a single drop as big as that one.
entries.literal: "Therefore, during the time Akaro and Sai should've been the only people outside the attic's bedroom, someone had lost blood. In addition, I thought that a small injury wouldn't have produced a single drop as big as that one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had every possibility of being an accident. Akaro and Sai also could've fought, resulting in Akaro's victory, going off the lack of injuries when he'd joined us again. However, the truth had the potential to be slightly more convoluted: perhaps Katei or Erina traveled to the past after leaving the attic. Then, they'd been attacked in the lobby and finished off even later.
entries.literal: "It had every possibility of being an accident. Akaro and Sai also could've fought, resulting in Akaro's victory, going off the lack of injuries when he'd joined us again. However, the truth had the potential to be slightly more convoluted: perhaps Katei or Erina traveled to the past after leaving the attic. Then, they'd been attacked in the lobby and finished off even later."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter what had happened, it was clear that something went wrong while we were at the top of the tower. And no matter who was left nearby, we didn't want to cross paths with them anymore.
entries.literal: "No matter what had happened, it was clear that something went wrong while we were at the top of the tower. And no matter who was left nearby, we didn't want to cross paths with them anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, we were guarding the Sekimeiya. We hadn't discussed it again, but it was what we'd intended to do before seeing the last two corpses. If the culprit showed themselves to obtain it, in the instance we had to escape, there were doors on both sides of the room which we'd left open.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, we were guarding the Sekimeiya. We hadn't discussed it again, but it was what we'd intended to do before seeing the last two corpses. If the culprit showed themselves to obtain it, in the instance we had to escape, there were doors on both sides of the room which we'd left open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed my eyes and left my mind blank. It felt nice after going over so many thoughts. But as soon as I did, different questions came to me.
entries.literal: "I closed my eyes and left my mind blank. It felt nice after going over so many thoughts. But as soon as I did, different questions came to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of how... why? Why had someone killed Erina? What could anyone have gained with that? Had it been out of pure malice, taking advantage of the disabled cameras?
entries.literal: "Instead of how... why? Why had someone killed Erina? What could anyone have gained with that? Had it been out of pure malice, taking advantage of the disabled cameras?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That didn't feel right; we all would have been killed by that point. With the Sekimeiya around, actions were bound to have more depth than they appeared to, and I had a hard time believing that someone who had actively chosen to remain undiscovered for so long would have no real motive.
entries.literal: "That didn't feel right; we all would have been killed by that point. With the Sekimeiya around, actions were bound to have more depth than they appeared to, and I had a hard time believing that someone who had actively chosen to remain undiscovered for so long would have no real motive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't be sure with Katei, but Erina hadn't done anything to warrant her death. At most, I could assume she'd found the culprit.
entries.literal: "I couldn't be sure with Katei, but Erina hadn't done anything to warrant her death. At most, I could assume she'd found the culprit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went back to the small theory I'd put together. If she had traveled to the past and confronted Akaro and Sai while the rest of us were in the bedroom, that could have given them a motive for her death...{w} Even though they were the only suspects, they hadn't shown back up, so it was appropriate to think that they might never intend to.
entries.literal: "I went back to the small theory I'd put together. If she had traveled to the past and confronted Akaro and Sai while the rest of us were in the bedroom, that could have given them a motive for her death...{w} Even though they were the only suspects, they hadn't shown back up, so it was appropriate to think that they might never intend to."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait... the recording!
entries.literal: "Wait... the recording!"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: According to Akaro and Sai, Erina was alive.
entries.literal: "According to Akaro and Sai, Erina was alive."

entries.speaker: sai2
entries.text: Atsuki, what are you thinking about? Do you have any more ideas...? And hey, Erina, what's with that face?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, what are you thinking about? Do you have any more ideas...? And hey, Erina, what's with that face?"

entries.speaker: ak2
entries.text: I-Isla, what's gotten into you? ...What are you holding?{w} And Erina, why aren't you doing anything!?
entries.literal: "I-Isla, what's gotten into you? ...What are you holding?{w} And Erina, why aren't you doing anything!?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Even though the scenario played out as if Erina and I were present, that isn't possible anymore. Who did that recording actually intend to trick...?
entries.literal: "Even though the scenario played out as if Erina and I were present, that isn't possible anymore. Who did that recording actually intend to trick...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It couldn't be a coincidence that Akaro and Sai were the only other people still alive and the only ones to have been mentioned in the recording. However, Erina's death nullified its chances of being real.
entries.literal: "It couldn't be a coincidence that Akaro and Sai were the only other people still alive and the only ones to have been mentioned in the recording. However, Erina's death nullified its chances of being real."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Or did it? I tried to think about it.
entries.literal: "...Or did it? I tried to think about it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Even though Isla's already dead, she was the third and last person to appear in the recording. But her death wasn't enough to completely deny it being real.
entries.literal: "Even though Isla's already dead, she was the third and last person to appear in the recording. But her death wasn't enough to completely deny it being real."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And that's solely thanks to the Sekimeiya's existence. It's possible that Isla's still alive, she'll be part of the recording in the future, and will travel to the past to end up in the cabinet where we found her corpse. There might be different arrangements, but the gist would always be the same.
entries.literal: "And that's solely thanks to the Sekimeiya's existence. It's possible that Isla's still alive, she'll be part of the recording in the future, and will travel to the past to end up in the cabinet where we found her corpse. There might be different arrangements, but the gist would always be the same."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Could something similar apply to Erina...? Nothing supports it in her case, but the exact same thing could be going on with her, couldn't it?
entries.literal: "Could something similar apply to Erina...? Nothing supports it in her case, but the exact same thing could be going on with her, couldn't it?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So not even her dead body is enough to disregard the recording. Not while the Sekimeiya exists.
entries.literal: "So not even her dead body is enough to disregard the recording. Not while the Sekimeiya exists."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite my uncomfortable position, my sight began to fade, and I started to feel drowsy.
entries.literal: "Despite my uncomfortable position, my sight began to fade, and I started to feel drowsy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every time I rested a little, my body reminded me of how tired I was and of its strong demand for a full sleep.
entries.literal: "Every time I rested a little, my body reminded me of how tired I was and of its strong demand for a full sleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw that Shiroya's eyes were shut. I desperately wanted to resist it, but I couldn't help but close mine too, lay my head on my shoulder, and put my body against the wall.
entries.literal: "I saw that Shiroya's eyes were shut. I desperately wanted to resist it, but I couldn't help but close mine too, lay my head on my shoulder, and put my body against the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew that my consciousness was soon to fade, but having to wait for almost another four hours made any attempt at preventing it futile. I let myself go, temporarily abandoning the nightmarish tower engulfed in mystery.
entries.literal: "I knew that my consciousness was soon to fade, but having to wait for almost another four hours made any attempt at preventing it futile. I let myself go, temporarily abandoning the nightmarish tower engulfed in mystery."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My subconscious was alert at all times, aware that I was surrounded by ever-present danger. For that reason, as soon as the faintest sound met my ears, all my senses came back.
entries.literal: "My subconscious was alert at all times, aware that I was surrounded by ever-present danger. For that reason, as soon as the faintest sound met my ears, all my senses came back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if I'd traveled through time, I opened my eyes, unaware of how long I'd been there for. Thanks to the open doors, I discerned the origin of the noise. I stared ahead, where hallway B was.
entries.literal: "As if I'd traveled through time, I opened my eyes, unaware of how long I'd been there for. Thanks to the open doors, I discerned the origin of the noise. I stared ahead, where hallway B was."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wha—!
entries.literal: "Wha—!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I froze. The dry sound of my heart echoed within me and stuttered.
entries.literal: "I froze. The dry sound of my heart echoed within me and stuttered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just behind the door was Shiroya. As soon as she looked inside the event room, she saw my piercing gaze and returned it with her own.
entries.literal: "Just behind the door was Shiroya. As soon as she looked inside the event room, she saw my piercing gaze and returned it with her own."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After an eternity of a second, she turned around and sped up, her figure rapidly disappearing.
entries.literal: "After an eternity of a second, she turned around and sped up, her figure rapidly disappearing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, without moving, I looked at... Shiroya. She was still sitting down and leaning against the wall before my very eyes, resting her head on her arms.
entries.literal: "Then, without moving, I looked at... Shiroya. She was still sitting down and leaning against the wall before my very eyes, resting her head on her arms."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: H-Hey... Are you awake?
entries.literal: "H-Hey... Are you awake?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya...!
entries.literal: "Shiroya...!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She lifted her face and looked at me with nearly closed eyes.
entries.literal: "She lifted her face and looked at me with nearly closed eyes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Were you sleeping?
entries.literal: "Were you sleeping?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Sorry... yeah.
entries.literal: "Sorry... yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up, clueless, my mind cluttered.
entries.literal: "I stood up, clueless, my mind cluttered."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No... It might sound ridiculous, but I just saw you.
entries.literal: "No... It might sound ridiculous, but I just saw you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dashed to hallway B. It was empty.{w} My mind still reeling, I reentered the event room.
entries.literal: "I dashed to hallway B. It was empty.{w} My mind still reeling, I reentered the event room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm being serious. Footsteps woke me up, and I saw you in hallway B. You saw me too, but you walked toward hallway C, and there's no one here.
entries.literal: "I'm being serious. Footsteps woke me up, and I saw you in hallway B. You saw me too, but you walked toward hallway C, and there's no one here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What? How long have I been asleep?
entries.literal: "What? How long have I been asleep?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know.
entries.literal: "I don't know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What I saw could only have been achieved with the Sekimeiya, so I uncovered the curtain.
entries.literal: "What I saw could only have been achieved with the Sekimeiya, so I uncovered the curtain."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The Sekimeiya's still here, and it's locked.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya's still here, and it's locked."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't understand. Are you sure it was me?
entries.literal: "I don't understand. Are you sure it was me?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, but... there was a big difference. You were wearing different clothes.
entries.literal: "Yes, but... there was a big difference. You were wearing different clothes."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Different clothes...? Were they mine?
entries.literal: "Different clothes...? Were they mine?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, but I think I recognized them. You still had your coat, but you were wearing a different shirt and pants, and I think I saw them earlier in one of the attic wardrobes.
entries.literal: "No, but I think I recognized them. You still had your coat, but you were wearing a different shirt and pants, and I think I saw them earlier in one of the attic wardrobes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was too lost to respond, and understandably so. It meant that in the future, she was guaranteed to travel to the past and live out what I'd experienced. But it all went far beyond my comprehension, especially her strange behavior and clothing.
entries.literal: "She was too lost to respond, and understandably so. It meant that in the future, she was guaranteed to travel to the past and live out what I'd experienced. But it all went far beyond my comprehension, especially her strange behavior and clothing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Stay here for a second.
entries.literal: "Stay here for a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I rushed out of the room and ran to hallway C. It was empty as well.{w} Had it been a hallucination? There was no way—I was sure of what I'd seen.
entries.literal: "I rushed out of the room and ran to hallway C. It was empty as well.{w} Had it been a hallucination? There was no way—I was sure of what I'd seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I circled the floor and entered the event room from hallway A. It appeared the Shiroya I'd seen had deliberately hidden herself, so I wasn't sure if searching in depth was a good idea.
entries.literal: "I circled the floor and entered the event room from hallway A. It appeared the Shiroya I'd seen had deliberately hidden herself, so I wasn't sure if searching in depth was a good idea."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's go to the attic. I need to see if I'm right about this.
entries.literal: "Let's go to the attic. I need to see if I'm right about this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She shot me another questioning look and approached with her hand on her forehead. No matter how much we wanted to spend the remainder of our time in the event room, Shiroya's bizarre apparition indicated that something else was happening or just about to.
entries.literal: "She shot me another questioning look and approached with her hand on her forehead. No matter how much we wanted to spend the remainder of our time in the event room, Shiroya's bizarre apparition indicated that something else was happening or just about to."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Should we check the time first?
entries.literal: "Should we check the time first?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, probably.
entries.literal: "Oh, probably."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hallway A was still completely vacant. Shiroya had clearly seen me and chosen to walk away. It made no sense. If that was a future version of her, she already knew that I would see her.
entries.literal: "Hallway A was still completely vacant. Shiroya had clearly seen me and chosen to walk away. It made no sense. If that was a future version of her, she already knew that I would see her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Sai's dilemma all over again. I had just explained what I saw to Shiroya, so if she ever did travel to the past and repeat what I'd told her, she would be completing a loop with no origin. It couldn't be that she purposely let me see her just because I said so.{w} If Shiroya ever traveled again, she'd immediately recognize that the situation I described could come at any time. There was no chance for it to happen without foreknowledge, like when she'd called the elevator in the attic...
entries.literal: "It was Sai's dilemma all over again. I had just explained what I saw to Shiroya, so if she ever did travel to the past and repeat what I'd told her, she would be completing a loop with no origin. It couldn't be that she purposely let me see her just because I said so.{w} If Shiroya ever traveled again, she'd immediately recognize that the situation I described could come at any time. There was no chance for it to happen without foreknowledge, like when she'd called the elevator in the attic..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The state of the security room was unchanged. I saw some drops of blood had fully dried up, which was consistent with the time displayed on the computer:{w} {time=17:29.}
entries.literal: "The state of the security room was unchanged. I saw some drops of blood had fully dried up, which was consistent with the time displayed on the computer:{w} {time=17:29.}"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya! Are you there!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Are you there!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was such a nonsensical sight. The person I was calling for was next to me, but she wasn't who my shouts were directed to.
entries.literal: "It was such a nonsensical sight. The person I was calling for was next to me, but she wasn't who my shouts were directed to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, if I tried to continue reasoning with my assumption that "everything has to have an origin of some kind", the most simple explanation behind things was that Shiroya would eventually lose her memories.
entries.literal: "Once again, if I tried to continue reasoning with my assumption that \"everything has to have an origin of some kind\", the most simple explanation behind things was that Shiroya would eventually lose her memories."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was getting a headache. I'd wanted to finally put a stop to all those maddening lines of thought, but I couldn't. Not after the way the Shiroya in the hallway stared right through me.
entries.literal: "I was getting a headache. I'd wanted to finally put a stop to all those maddening lines of thought, but I couldn't. Not after the way the Shiroya in the hallway stared right through me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The elevator is still here, so if you went up, you probably didn't use it. Let's walk.
entries.literal: "The elevator is still here, so if you went up, you probably didn't use it. Let's walk."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She simply nodded. I understood that since she hadn't personally seen herself, she was too baffled and sleepy to feel the urgency I did.
entries.literal: "She simply nodded. I understood that since she hadn't personally seen herself, she was too baffled and sleepy to feel the urgency I did."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I went up, I reassured myself of what I believed.
entries.literal: "As I went up, I reassured myself of what I believed."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Something else has to be happening. The way we think the Sekimeiya works does not explain this.
entries.literal: "Something else has to be happening. The way we think the Sekimeiya works does not explain this."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Both of us wanted to stay in the event room until {time=21}, but it was a different Shiroya who made us leave. What if whatever's about to happen leads into Shiroya traveling and she experiences her side of what I just saw?
entries.literal: "Both of us wanted to stay in the event room until {time=21}, but it was a different Shiroya who made us leave. What if whatever's about to happen leads into Shiroya traveling and she experiences her side of what I just saw?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That doesn't make a single bit of sense. Again, the reason why we left the room would be because we left the room and then made ourselves leave the room. There's something clearly missing.
entries.literal: "That doesn't make a single bit of sense. Again, the reason why we left the room would be because we left the room and then made ourselves leave the room. There's something clearly missing."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Not only is this a bootstrap paradox, it contradicts our own interests. We both had every intention of staying there, so what could the meaning behind this actually be?
entries.literal: "Not only is this a bootstrap paradox, it contradicts our own interests. We both had every intention of staying there, so what could the meaning behind this actually be?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hoped that whatever the attic contained, there would be some kind of hint. The other Shiroya was wearing clothes I thought I'd seen up there, which amplified how outlandish it would be for that bootstrap to occur.
entries.literal: "I hoped that whatever the attic contained, there would be some kind of hint. The other Shiroya was wearing clothes I thought I'd seen up there, which amplified how outlandish it would be for that bootstrap to occur."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why was she dressed in clothes from the attic? Instead of going over how unlikely causal loops were, I had to shift my approach—the answer had to be something that wouldn't directly come from me seeing her wearing the clothes.
entries.literal: "Why was she dressed in clothes from the attic? Instead of going over how unlikely causal loops were, I had to shift my approach—the answer had to be something that wouldn't directly come from me seeing her wearing the clothes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, that had already happened, and I'd told her about it. So what possibilities remained? What could the masked answer have been?{w} ...Reason. That was what I needed to locate.
entries.literal: "However, that had already happened, and I'd told her about it. So what possibilities remained? What could the masked answer have been?{w} ...Reason. That was what I needed to locate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We arrived at the entrance to the attic. The key was still in the keyhole, so we began to go up the narrow staircase.
entries.literal: "We arrived at the entrance to the attic. The key was still in the keyhole, so we began to go up the narrow staircase."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: A reason behind the Shiroya I just saw, who still has to be somewhere...
entries.literal: "A reason behind the Shiroya I just saw, who still has to be somewhere..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is it a coincidence that the hardest mysteries to solve have involved double selves? Now that I think about it, almost everyone but me has produced this mystery individually.
entries.literal: "Is it a coincidence that the hardest mysteries to solve have involved double selves? Now that I think about it, almost everyone but me has produced this mystery individually."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Naomi's body appeared dead twice. Sai existed both in the attic and on the crystal floor, and simple time travel couldn't explain it. What about the Akaro who had different memories?{w} Isla and Erina have died despite the fact they're supposed to be alive in the future. Now, a Shiroya that's very hard to explain with pure time travel has suddenly shown herself.
entries.literal: "Naomi's body appeared dead twice. Sai existed both in the attic and on the crystal floor, and simple time travel couldn't explain it. What about the Akaro who had different memories?{w} Isla and Erina have died despite the fact they're supposed to be alive in the future. Now, a Shiroya that's very hard to explain with pure time travel has suddenly shown herself."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The core mystery is always the origin of the extra person and their reason for existing. Something else might have been happening right under our noses, and we just haven't noticed yet.
entries.literal: "The core mystery is always the origin of the extra person and their reason for existing. Something else might have been happening right under our noses, and we just haven't noticed yet."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Could it be related to...
entries.literal: "Could it be related to..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: A second Katei hasn't appeared. Is that related to what Akaro said in the bedroom?
entries.literal: "A second Katei hasn't appeared. Is that related to what Akaro said in the bedroom?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He didn't know who Katei was...{w} but he knew me.
entries.literal: "He didn't know who Katei was...{w} but he knew me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It doesn't seem like anyone's been here recently, going off the floor.
entries.literal: "It doesn't seem like anyone's been here recently, going off the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered, leaving behind the first footprints in a while. If anyone had entered or exited the attic, they used the elevator. However, since the key was still in the door below us, it was unlikely that the elevator could possibly have gone up so far.
entries.literal: "We entered, leaving behind the first footprints in a while. If anyone had entered or exited the attic, they used the elevator. However, since the key was still in the door below us, it was unlikely that the elevator could possibly have gone up so far."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I believe it's in the right bedroom. The wardrobe had a few articles of clothing.
entries.literal: "I believe it's in the right bedroom. The wardrobe had a few articles of clothing."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That one, right? I saw them too.
entries.literal: "That one, right? I saw them too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded and opened it up. Inside, a few old-looking clothes hung in the empty space.
entries.literal: "I nodded and opened it up. Inside, a few old-looking clothes hung in the empty space."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I thought so. You were wearing these.
entries.literal: "I thought so. You were wearing these."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took out a moderately sized white shirt and dark pants, neither of which looked to have been designed for a young girl.
entries.literal: "I took out a moderately sized white shirt and dark pants, neither of which looked to have been designed for a young girl."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: These? I'm not sure I like them.
entries.literal: "These? I'm not sure I like them."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, there isn't much else to choose from.
entries.literal: "Well, there isn't much else to choose from."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I suppose, yeah. I imagine I'd pick these if I wanted to use this wardrobe to get dressed.
entries.literal: "...I suppose, yeah. I imagine I'd pick these if I wanted to use this wardrobe to get dressed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And you were wearing them even though they're still here.
entries.literal: "And you were wearing them even though they're still here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm very lost about this, but does it mean that I'll go back to the past with them?
entries.literal: "I'm very lost about this, but does it mean that I'll go back to the past with them?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... don't know.
entries.literal: "I... don't know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could something else have been the answer? I thought about that first.{w} I'd just put together how unlikely it was that anyone had entered the attic recently. That meant the Shiroya I'd seen probably hadn't hurried up to the attic and returned those clothes to the wardrobe.
entries.literal: "Could something else have been the answer? I thought about that first.{w} I'd just put together how unlikely it was that anyone had entered the attic recently. That meant the Shiroya I'd seen probably hadn't hurried up to the attic and returned those clothes to the wardrobe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't imagine that had happened, but it wasn't out of the question. If that Shiroya had possessed another key to the attic, she could've come faster than us while we'd gone to the security room.
entries.literal: "I didn't imagine that had happened, but it wasn't out of the question. If that Shiroya had possessed another key to the attic, she could've come faster than us while we'd gone to the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure if she had the ability to use the single key we knew existed. The elevator had probably been on the crystal floor, so even if she had the key, she would've had to go up with it, leave the clothes behind, take the elevator down to the sixth floor, send it to the crystal floor, and place the key back in the attic's keyhole.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure if she had the ability to use the single key we knew existed. The elevator had probably been on the crystal floor, so even if she had the key, she would've had to go up with it, leave the clothes behind, take the elevator down to the sixth floor, send it to the crystal floor, and place the key back in the attic's keyhole."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Even though they look the same, I'm willing to assume these clothes aren't the exact same ones I saw you wearing. Meaning that two identical sets exist at the moment, if your other self is still here somewhere.
entries.literal: "...{w}Even though they look the same, I'm willing to assume these clothes aren't the exact same ones I saw you wearing. Meaning that two identical sets exist at the moment, if your other self is still here somewhere."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It feels pointless trying to think about how it happened when I'm completely clueless as to why it did. But if you travel to the past and see me in the event room, something similar to our last travel has to happen.
entries.literal: "It feels pointless trying to think about how it happened when I'm completely clueless as to why it did. But if you travel to the past and see me in the event room, something similar to our last travel has to happen."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You mean that I'd need to wear the clothes for a while and then travel with the Sekimeiya. After that, I'd have to appear far back enough and the place I show up would have to be from the time I was wearing the clothes.
entries.literal: "You mean that I'd need to wear the clothes for a while and then travel with the Sekimeiya. After that, I'd have to appear far back enough and the place I show up would have to be from the time I was wearing the clothes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was getting incredibly overwhelmed. The way she described it was one way for it to work. Other arrangements existed, such as traveling far to the past, borrowing the clothes, seeing me in the event room, and eventually going to the past again to return them to the wardrobe.
entries.literal: "I was getting incredibly overwhelmed. The way she described it was one way for it to work. Other arrangements existed, such as traveling far to the past, borrowing the clothes, seeing me in the event room, and eventually going to the past again to return them to the wardrobe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, it didn't make any sense. Why would she do that? It was so bizarre and unlike anything else that had happened, I couldn't think of even a semi-logical explanation.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, it didn't make any sense. Why would she do that? It was so bizarre and unlike anything else that had happened, I couldn't think of even a semi-logical explanation."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let me see... It's possible we'll come across that version of you again, even though she didn't look too surprised to see me. Just in case we do...
entries.literal: "Let me see... It's possible we'll come across that version of you again, even though she didn't look too surprised to see me. Just in case we do..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the drawers and took a marker out.
entries.literal: "I opened the drawers and took a marker out."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I hope this hasn't dried yet. If these cameras are actually still working, I might get in trouble for this, but it could tell us something of value.
entries.literal: "I hope this hasn't dried yet. If these cameras are actually still working, I might get in trouble for this, but it could tell us something of value."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you gonna leave a mark?
entries.literal: "Are you gonna leave a mark?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. Washing it won't get rid of it, so I'll make it tiny.
entries.literal: "Yes. Washing it won't get rid of it, so I'll make it tiny."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the collar of the shirt, I drew a tiny black cross.
entries.literal: "On the collar of the shirt, I drew a tiny black cross."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The more I think about it, the more unlikely it seems that whatever happened was accomplished by traveling from the future. It'd be a loop without origin, which is not how a consistent timeline would work.
entries.literal: "The more I think about it, the more unlikely it seems that whatever happened was accomplished by traveling from the future. It'd be a loop without origin, which is not how a consistent timeline would work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just like I'd thought when we were locked in the bedrooms, there was a way to place the origin of the loop inside Shiroya's mind.{w} If she'd created a plan downstairs in the event room where a future self of hers would lure us out to accomplish something, and she'd later travel to make that happen, I'd begin to accept it as possible. Since it had happened to Shiroya, though, I wasn't able to reason it out like that.
entries.literal: "Just like I'd thought when we were locked in the bedrooms, there was a way to place the origin of the loop inside Shiroya's mind.{w} If she'd created a plan downstairs in the event room where a future self of hers would lure us out to accomplish something, and she'd later travel to make that happen, I'd begin to accept it as possible. Since it had happened to Shiroya, though, I wasn't able to reason it out like that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If we ever see that version of you again and you're wearing these clothes, I'll check this spot.{w} If the mark is there, it'll mean that you traveled from the future with it somehow. If it's not, that'll tell us the truth is different.
entries.literal: "If we ever see that version of you again and you're wearing these clothes, I'll check this spot.{w} If the mark is there, it'll mean that you traveled from the future with it somehow. If it's not, that'll tell us the truth is different."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I ran into that Shiroya and saw no mark, there were next to no ways to explain it with her coming from the future, and they all relied on returning the clothes to the wardrobe before we found them. Once again, I couldn't help but experience an impending and threatening pressure when I tried to think about what reason existed behind it all.
entries.literal: "If I ran into that Shiroya and saw no mark, there were next to no ways to explain it with her coming from the future, and they all relied on returning the clothes to the wardrobe before we found them. Once again, I couldn't help but experience an impending and threatening pressure when I tried to think about what reason existed behind it all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the marker inside the drawer and sat on the bed. Shiroya joined me at my side, evidently not fully accepting yet that a mysterious version of her was most likely roaming around downstairs.
entries.literal: "I left the marker inside the drawer and sat on the bed. Shiroya joined me at my side, evidently not fully accepting yet that a mysterious version of her was most likely roaming around downstairs."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You don't plan to travel to the past or put on those clothes, right? How could that have happened if you'll never make it happen?
entries.literal: "You don't plan to travel to the past or put on those clothes, right? How could that have happened if you'll never make it happen?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I won't, no, and I don't know either. I think it's just as strange as you're making it out to be.
entries.literal: "I won't, no, and I don't know either. I think it's just as strange as you're making it out to be."

entries.speaker: i
