entries.text: I replayed the moment in my head. That expressionless person who'd unmistakably been Shiroya... What were her thoughts at the time?
entries.literal: "I replayed the moment in my head. That expressionless person who'd unmistakably been Shiroya... What were her thoughts at the time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lay back in frustration. That was the first time the bizarre "double body" situation happened to someone I could trust and freely speak with, but she had no idea what the meaning behind it was. Perhaps that also applied to every other case.
entries.literal: "I lay back in frustration. That was the first time the bizarre \"double body\" situation happened to someone I could trust and freely speak with, but she had no idea what the meaning behind it was. Perhaps that also applied to every other case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It could be that the original Naomi wouldn't have been able to explain the existence of her double self either. Could something have been creating replicas of us without our notice?
entries.literal: "It could be that the original Naomi wouldn't have been able to explain the existence of her double self either. Could something have been creating replicas of us without our notice?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way. Otherwise, the other Shiroya would've run to me as soon as she'd seen me. And even if the answer was that she had a reason to borrow the clothes from the attic, they wouldn't have still been in the wardrobe.
entries.literal: "There was no way. Otherwise, the other Shiroya would've run to me as soon as she'd seen me. And even if the answer was that she had a reason to borrow the clothes from the attic, they wouldn't have still been in the wardrobe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I clicked my tongue, sighed, and rolled on the bed... I hated everything about it. When I looked at Shiroya, all I got from her face was a despondent expression.
entries.literal: "I clicked my tongue, sighed, and rolled on the bed... I hated everything about it. When I looked at Shiroya, all I got from her face was a despondent expression."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That version of you had some goal. If she was lost somehow or suddenly popped into existence, she wouldn't have ignored me.
entries.literal: "That version of you had some goal. If she was lost somehow or suddenly popped into existence, she wouldn't have ignored me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What kind of goal...?
entries.literal: "What kind of goal...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, look at what she accomplished. By wearing clothes from the attic, not responding to my shouts, and quickly hiding from view... she brought us here.
entries.literal: "Well, look at what she accomplished. By wearing clothes from the attic, not responding to my shouts, and quickly hiding from view... she brought us here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You think I wanted to lead us far away from the event room?
entries.literal: "You think I wanted to lead us far away from the event room?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Honestly, what else could it be? That's where the Sekimeiya is. I'm not accusing you of anything—I'm sure you would have had a good reason for doing it...
entries.literal: "Honestly, what else could it be? That's where the Sekimeiya is. I'm not accusing you of anything—I'm sure you would have had a good reason for doing it..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No... that can't be it. I'm sure I don't want to touch the Sekimeiya again.
entries.literal: "No... that can't be it. I'm sure I don't want to touch the Sekimeiya again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But you could've come from the future with further knowledge and a specific plan to achieve.
entries.literal: "But you could've come from the future with further knowledge and a specific plan to achieve."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You just said earlier that doesn't make sense, right? Even if I ever think of a good reason to travel back to this point and use the Sekimeiya, I'd know how to do it just because me doing it already happened. I'd be repeating what you saw thanks to the fact that I repeated what you saw. ...That can't be it.
entries.literal: "You just said earlier that doesn't make sense, right? Even if I ever think of a good reason to travel back to this point and use the Sekimeiya, I'd know how to do it just because me doing it already happened. I'd be repeating what you saw thanks to the fact that I repeated what you saw. ...That can't be it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't object. I'd used that same argument to deny a multitude of theories, but it wasn't fully reliable, as we didn't know the rules of the universe regarding time travel.
entries.literal: "I couldn't object. I'd used that same argument to deny a multitude of theories, but it wasn't fully reliable, as we didn't know the rules of the universe regarding time travel."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's go back down, I suppose. We'll see if the Sekimeiya's still there, and there's a chance we'll see you again.
entries.literal: "Let's go back down, I suppose. We'll see if the Sekimeiya's still there, and there's a chance we'll see you again."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Accompanied by an unsettling, gloomy mood, we entered the hallway. We weren't feeling too energetic, so we called the elevator.
entries.literal: "Accompanied by an unsettling, gloomy mood, we entered the hallway. We weren't feeling too energetic, so we called the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a few seconds, the button lit up orange. I opened the door and entered after her.
entries.literal: "After a few seconds, the button lit up orange. I opened the door and entered after her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After pressing the lowest button, I leaned on the uncomfortable handrail and wished for everything to finally end. We began to descend, surrounded by the unassuming sound of the elevator's motion and my deep sighs.
entries.literal: "After pressing the lowest button, I leaned on the uncomfortable handrail and wished for everything to finally end. We began to descend, surrounded by the unassuming sound of the elevator's motion and my deep sighs."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya also realized that we'd stopped earlier than expected. As the secondary doors opened, we saw the floor 3 button blinking.
entries.literal: "Shiroya also realized that we'd stopped earlier than expected. As the secondary doors opened, we saw the floor 3 button blinking."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you hit it accidentally?
entries.literal: "Did you hit it accidentally?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No.
entries.literal: "No."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked at each other, puzzled, before staring at the opaque door that led to the third floor. We were unaware of what awaited us, but we expected something to happen.
entries.literal: "We looked at each other, puzzled, before staring at the opaque door that led to the third floor. We were unaware of what awaited us, but we expected something to happen."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Someone must've pressed the button while we were inside...
entries.literal: "Someone must've pressed the button while we were inside..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the door didn't immediately open. The only explanation was that someone had called it from the third floor, but they weren't getting in.{w} I cautiously reached forward and pushed the door.
entries.literal: "However, the door didn't immediately open. The only explanation was that someone had called it from the third floor, but they weren't getting in.{w} I cautiously reached forward and pushed the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A desolate corridor came into view, with zero apparent signs of life.
entries.literal: "A desolate corridor came into view, with zero apparent signs of life."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't see anyone...
entries.literal: "I don't see anyone..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped out with Shiroya right behind. I looked at the button, but nothing indicated whether it had been pressed.
entries.literal: "I stepped out with Shiroya right behind. I looked at the button, but nothing indicated whether it had been pressed."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're sure you didn't hit it, right?
entries.literal: "You're sure you didn't hit it, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah, definitely.
entries.literal: "Yeah, definitely."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, the elevator kept moving to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Oh, the elevator kept moving to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya called it again as I walked a few automatic steps, attempting to comprehend what could've happened.
entries.literal: "Shiroya called it again as I walked a few automatic steps, attempting to comprehend what could've happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did someone run away after pressing the button...?
entries.literal: "Did someone run away after pressing the button...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached the stairs, the most likely route anyone would've chosen to hide in a rush. I couldn't immediately see anyone, so we'd have to choose which way to go.
entries.literal: "I approached the stairs, the most likely route anyone would've chosen to hide in a rush. I couldn't immediately see anyone, so we'd have to choose which way to go."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's really no one here. Should we keep going down?
entries.literal: "There's really no one here. Should we keep going down?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I guess so...
entries.literal: "I guess so..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Maybe we should continue on foot. It could've been the other version of you.
entries.literal: "Maybe we should continue on foot. It could've been the other version of you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}Okay.

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our synchronized footsteps began to lightly echo around the wide interior, setting up an uncomfortable atmosphere we'd gotten very familiar with.
entries.literal: "Our synchronized footsteps began to lightly echo around the wide interior, setting up an uncomfortable atmosphere we'd gotten very familiar with."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was barely ahead of Shiroya. After a few steps, I reached the left turn, where the entrance to the offices was.
entries.literal: "I was barely ahead of Shiroya. After a few steps, I reached the left turn, where the entrance to the offices was."

entries.text: Bloodhound
entries.literal: "Bloodhound"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, I saw a hand gripping a knife swing toward me.{w} My heart didn't have time to stop before I began to see the motion slowly. Without being able to give it any thought, I turned my whole body around as fast as possible.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, I saw a hand gripping a knife swing toward me.{w} My heart didn't have time to stop before I began to see the motion slowly. Without being able to give it any thought, I turned my whole body around as fast as possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a breeze at my side from the swipe whiffing and looked up to witness Shiroya's expression progressively changing to a terrified mask. As fast as my worn-out body let me, I bolted to her and grabbed her hand, running the opposite direction.
entries.literal: "I felt a breeze at my side from the swipe whiffing and looked up to witness Shiroya's expression progressively changing to a terrified mask. As fast as my worn-out body let me, I bolted to her and grabbed her hand, running the opposite direction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We ran as fast as possible and began to hear a third person coming from behind us. We were being chased.
entries.literal: "We ran as fast as possible and began to hear a third person coming from behind us. We were being chased."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The distance between us and the attacker was minimal. While we desperately sprinted, we saw the elevator and the floor 4 staircase in front of us.
entries.literal: "The distance between us and the attacker was minimal. While we desperately sprinted, we saw the elevator and the floor 4 staircase in front of us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was certain we weren't going to have time to open the elevator and use it before being caught. The staircase was our single option.
entries.literal: "I was certain we weren't going to have time to open the elevator and use it before being caught. The staircase was our single option."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I fully focused on running as hard as I could, tightly gripping Shiroya's hand. Without a doubt, the person we heard behind us had tried to kill me.
entries.literal: "I fully focused on running as hard as I could, tightly gripping Shiroya's hand. Without a doubt, the person we heard behind us had tried to kill me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before we reached the stairs, I let go of her hand and prayed we could go up fast enough. Halfway up, the crisp steps below us let us know the attacker hadn't given up and would continue to chase us.
entries.literal: "Before we reached the stairs, I let go of her hand and prayed we could go up fast enough. Halfway up, the crisp steps below us let us know the attacker hadn't given up and would continue to chase us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart began to race faster than I'd ever felt it. Despite how unreal it seemed, the idea that someone around us wanted our death had proven correct. As soon as we reached the higher floor, we took off again.
entries.literal: "My heart began to race faster than I'd ever felt it. Despite how unreal it seemed, the idea that someone around us wanted our death had proven correct. As soon as we reached the higher floor, we took off again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked to my side, ensuring that Shiroya was still okay. She met my look with terror, not a trace of wooziness remaining in her. What had we done, and why had we been attacked? A myriad of similar questions flooded my mind as we kept running through the straightaway.
entries.literal: "I looked to my side, ensuring that Shiroya was still okay. She met my look with terror, not a trace of wooziness remaining in her. What had we done, and why had we been attacked? A myriad of similar questions flooded my mind as we kept running through the straightaway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though the bathrooms could be locked from the inside, Katei said that his key opened all of them. We were most definitely being chased by his killer, who could've picked it up or could go back to the security room to do so.{w} Entering the partitions would only doom us too. Instead, with the distance between us and our attacker beginning to extend, we did our best not to slow down for even a second.
entries.literal: "Even though the bathrooms could be locked from the inside, Katei said that his key opened all of them. We were most definitely being chased by his killer, who could've picked it up or could go back to the security room to do so.{w} Entering the partitions would only doom us too. Instead, with the distance between us and our attacker beginning to extend, we did our best not to slow down for even a second."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's go to the attic...!
entries.literal: "Let's go to the attic...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In a hoarse voice, I let out what I'd intended to be reassurance. I'd realized our only chance relied on the attic: the key should've still been there, so if we could keep the same pace until we arrived at the door, we'd have enough time to lock ourselves inside.
entries.literal: "In a hoarse voice, I let out what I'd intended to be reassurance. I'd realized our only chance relied on the attic: the key should've still been there, so if we could keep the same pace until we arrived at the door, we'd have enough time to lock ourselves inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once more, we forced our exhausted bodies up the floor 5 staircase while the adrenaline's effect started to wear off. I desperately needed to slow down, but I pushed myself more than I'd ever thought I could. I wasn't going to die; I rejected that thought more than anything.
entries.literal: "Once more, we forced our exhausted bodies up the floor 5 staircase while the adrenaline's effect started to wear off. I desperately needed to slow down, but I pushed myself more than I'd ever thought I could. I wasn't going to die; I rejected that thought more than anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed Shiroya's hand again and sprinted toward the offices. We hadn't come to the tower to die! It had been the complete opposite!
entries.literal: "I grabbed Shiroya's hand again and sprinted toward the offices. We hadn't come to the tower to die! It had been the complete opposite!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Almost four hours remained, and the footfalls behind us continually warned us how badly someone wanted us dead. Despite their lower speed, they were still running.
entries.literal: "Almost four hours remained, and the footfalls behind us continually warned us how badly someone wanted us dead. Despite their lower speed, they were still running."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had to go to the attic—that was our only way to survive. Somehow, the culprit had a knife.
entries.literal: "We had to go to the attic—that was our only way to survive. Somehow, the culprit had a knife."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I considered how nonsensical that was, a flash of Erina's death came to me. There had been a bloodstain on her chest, and although we hadn't inspected it, the same knife had surely taken her life.
entries.literal: "As soon as I considered how nonsensical that was, a flash of Erina's death came to me. There had been a bloodstain on her chest, and although we hadn't inspected it, the same knife had surely taken her life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The last staircase we'd have to power through was in reach. Shiroya's body began to tremble as a sign of how much she'd pushed herself to escape from the danger of death.
entries.literal: "The last staircase we'd have to power through was in reach. Shiroya's body began to tremble as a sign of how much she'd pushed herself to escape from the danger of death."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Only one more... We'll lock ourselves up in the attic!
entries.literal: "Only one more... We'll lock ourselves up in the attic!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind started to feel numb as soon as I spat out some words. She nodded almost imperceptibly while the terrifying echo of our persistent attacker refused to fade.
entries.literal: "My mind started to feel numb as soon as I spat out some words. She nodded almost imperceptibly while the terrifying echo of our persistent attacker refused to fade."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped up the stairs, unable to match our prior pace. Our bodies couldn't withstand much more.{w} As much as I tried to keep up for just a few more seconds, my legs were barely responding. Seeing how the same thing was happening to Shiroya, I feared that our lack of sleep would finally catch up to us.
entries.literal: "I stepped up the stairs, unable to match our prior pace. Our bodies couldn't withstand much more.{w} As much as I tried to keep up for just a few more seconds, my legs were barely responding. Seeing how the same thing was happening to Shiroya, I feared that our lack of sleep would finally catch up to us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't been able to see the body of the attacker, but there weren't many options. They were chasing us with a knife, so we weren't going to die without knowing our killer's identity.
entries.literal: "I hadn't been able to see the body of the attacker, but there weren't many options. They were chasing us with a knife, so we weren't going to die without knowing our killer's identity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stepped onto the sixth floor and resumed what could no longer be called running, but a forced stagger. Fortunately, our pursuer seemed to be in similar shape, as they hadn't used our exhaustion to catch up despite their continuous, audible steps.
entries.literal: "We stepped onto the sixth floor and resumed what could no longer be called running, but a forced stagger. Fortunately, our pursuer seemed to be in similar shape, as they hadn't used our exhaustion to catch up despite their continuous, audible steps."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's still there!
entries.literal: "It's still there!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The attic's door was open, and I could see the shining key placed in it. Merely wishing not to faint, we forced a last sprint as we heard the noise behind us growing louder.
entries.literal: "The attic's door was open, and I could see the shining key placed in it. Merely wishing not to faint, we forced a last sprint as we heard the noise behind us growing louder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My body had already given out, but thankfully too late to spell disaster for me. I took the key and entered the narrow staircase with Shiroya right behind me. As fast as I could, I shut the door and inserted the key in the inner keyhole. With a trembling hand, I turned and locked it. As soon as the tumbler clicked, I stopped trying to control my body and collapsed between the two walls.
entries.literal: "My body had already given out, but thankfully too late to spell disaster for me. I took the key and entered the narrow staircase with Shiroya right behind me. As fast as I could, I shut the door and inserted the key in the inner keyhole. With a trembling hand, I turned and locked it. As soon as the tumbler clicked, I stopped trying to control my body and collapsed between the two walls."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Are you okay?
entries.literal: "...Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We spent a full minute catching our breath, during which no other sound reached our ears. Even though we'd achieved our only available goal, in instance that whoever it was had another key to the attic, there'd be nothing we could do.
entries.literal: "We spent a full minute catching our breath, during which no other sound reached our ears. Even though we'd achieved our only available goal, in instance that whoever it was had another key to the attic, there'd be nothing we could do."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-I'm fine... Let's go up.
entries.literal: "I-I'm fine... Let's go up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up as soon as I felt able to. Still staggering, we began walking up the stairs to distance ourselves as much as possible from the door. The culprit hadn't even tried to open it after chasing us the entire way up, which made it all even more unsettling.
entries.literal: "I stood up as soon as I felt able to. Still staggering, we began walking up the stairs to distance ourselves as much as possible from the door. The culprit hadn't even tried to open it after chasing us the entire way up, which made it all even more unsettling."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You didn't see their face, right?
entries.literal: "You didn't see their face, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No... I only saw a knife coming out of the corridor, and I think their sleeve was black. They must've had it hidden somewhere.
entries.literal: "No... I only saw a knife coming out of the corridor, and I think their sleeve was black. They must've had it hidden somewhere."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure... but it could only be Akaro or Sai. I found out earlier that I run faster than Sai, which I very much doubt is the case with Akaro...
entries.literal: "I'm not sure... but it could only be Akaro or Sai. I found out earlier that I run faster than Sai, which I very much doubt is the case with Akaro..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It... has to be him, then.
entries.literal: "It... has to be him, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to think. Someone had really tried to take my life when I had done nothing. Was I a threat, or were they just a psychopath...? If it was Sai, I couldn't honestly decide.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to think. Someone had really tried to take my life when I had done nothing. Was I a threat, or were they just a psychopath...? If it was Sai, I couldn't honestly decide."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know, but we might be safe here.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but we might be safe here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked by my feet. No new footprints had been left since the last time we'd looked at the floor.
entries.literal: "I looked by my feet. No new footprints had been left since the last time we'd looked at the floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's supposed to be only one key for this place, but who can really tell... Duplication is a trivial matter at this point.
entries.literal: "There's supposed to be only one key for this place, but who can really tell... Duplication is a trivial matter at this point."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: At least if they haven't made a duplicate yet, they won't be able to do it now. We could be all right...
entries.literal: "At least if they haven't made a duplicate yet, they won't be able to do it now. We could be all right..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm... not sure. If this is the same culprit who's been using the Sekimeiya all this time, I'm certain they'd have a way to replicate the key even if we have it with us.{w} If it's Sai, he could go back to the past and replicate his body during a time he was holding it.
entries.literal: "I'm... not sure. If this is the same culprit who's been using the Sekimeiya all this time, I'm certain they'd have a way to replicate the key even if we have it with us.{w} If it's Sai, he could go back to the past and replicate his body during a time he was holding it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The pale fear projected on her face for a single instant was more than soul-crushing. I'd been with her for so many years and never seen anything like it—not even recently.
entries.literal: "The pale fear projected on her face for a single instant was more than soul-crushing. I'd been with her for so many years and never seen anything like it—not even recently."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was why I didn't voice the much more frightening way the culprit could make their way in. By traveling from the future, they could deliberately materialize themselves in the attic if their location was simply based on a time they'd been there.
entries.literal: "That was why I didn't voice the much more frightening way the culprit could make their way in. By traveling from the future, they could deliberately materialize themselves in the attic if their location was simply based on a time they'd been there."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Let's make sure we're alone.
entries.literal: "Let's make sure we're alone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah...
entries.literal: "Yeah..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter who the attacker had been, two people would still be unaccounted for between Sai, Akaro, and the other Shiroya. We'd been in the attic just a couple minutes earlier, but it wasn't impossible that someone else had also been present at the time.
entries.literal: "No matter who the attacker had been, two people would still be unaccounted for between Sai, Akaro, and the other Shiroya. We'd been in the attic just a couple minutes earlier, but it wasn't impossible that someone else had also been present at the time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We quietly walked around while a piercing feeling invaded my chest. Erina and Katei had recently died. I was barely able to accept it, and their killer had shifted to targeting us, the last people remaining.
entries.literal: "We quietly walked around while a piercing feeling invaded my chest. Erina and Katei had recently died. I was barely able to accept it, and their killer had shifted to targeting us, the last people remaining."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I truly hoped that, at {time=21}, the police would come. I needed to get out with Shiroya at that time. There was no way I could make it even a second longer without breaking down.
entries.literal: "I truly hoped that, at {time=21}, the police would come. I needed to get out with Shiroya at that time. There was no way I could make it even a second longer without breaking down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...My heart still racing, I went to the hallway through the kitchen and looked at the storeroom while Shiroya stayed in the corner. After I'd seen the empty bathroom, we'd isolated the two bedrooms.
entries.literal: "...My heart still racing, I went to the hallway through the kitchen and looked at the storeroom while Shiroya stayed in the corner. After I'd seen the empty bathroom, we'd isolated the two bedrooms."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'll go up the ladder. Stay here.
entries.literal: "I'll go up the ladder. Stay here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She came to the two parallel doors and watched me while I climbed up the ladder in the rightmost bedroom. I was easily able to confirm nobody was hiding.
entries.literal: "She came to the two parallel doors and watched me while I climbed up the ladder in the rightmost bedroom. I was easily able to confirm nobody was hiding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I repeated the process in the opposite one to conclude that we were the only people in the attic.
entries.literal: "I repeated the process in the opposite one to conclude that we were the only people in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya joined me inside. Our lives were at risk of being cut short, but we couldn't do anything else. She sat on a bed, knowing that we were possibly in the path of an unstoppable force.
entries.literal: "Shiroya joined me inside. Our lives were at risk of being cut short, but we couldn't do anything else. She sat on a bed, knowing that we were possibly in the path of an unstoppable force."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But life took no pity on us. Before we could speak any words, a heart-stopping sound came from the hallway. Through a terrified whisper, Shiroya's raw anguish tore at the foundations of my will. The sound had made it clear: we were dealing with the real culprit, who had been able to enter our makeshift fortress. Trying to escape was futile.
entries.literal: "But life took no pity on us. Before we could speak any words, a heart-stopping sound came from the hallway. Through a terrified whisper, Shiroya's raw anguish tore at the foundations of my will. The sound had made it clear: we were dealing with the real culprit, who had been able to enter our makeshift fortress. Trying to escape was futile."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I couldn't think of anything else. During the few seconds in which the approaching footsteps grew louder, only a single course of action came to me.
entries.literal: "But I couldn't think of anything else. During the few seconds in which the approaching footsteps grew louder, only a single course of action came to me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The key...! We need to lock ourselves in again!
entries.literal: "The key...! We need to lock ourselves in again!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: An equally terrified whisper came from within me. I rushed to the drawers, where the key to the bedroom should've been. The bedroom we were in didn't have a chain, and crossing the hallway was too risky.
entries.literal: "An equally terrified whisper came from within me. I rushed to the drawers, where the key to the bedroom should've been. The bedroom we were in didn't have a chain, and crossing the hallway was too risky."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What!?{w} It's not here!
entries.literal: "What!?{w} It's not here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The bathroom's door was opened and closed; the culprit was searching for us. Within my panic, I remembered it. Sai had tried to use that bedroom's key to unlock the opposite door, and we hadn't seen where he left it afterward.
entries.literal: "The bathroom's door was opened and closed; the culprit was searching for us. Within my panic, I remembered it. Sai had tried to use that bedroom's key to unlock the opposite door, and we hadn't seen where he left it afterward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Another door was opened. It wasn't ours, but the one in front, leading to the bedroom where we'd spent more than an hour locked inside.
entries.literal: "Another door was opened. It wasn't ours, but the one in front, leading to the bedroom where we'd spent more than an hour locked inside."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Fuck! We could shut the culprit inside with the key, but entering to get it might be too dangerous.
entries.literal: "Fuck! We could shut the culprit inside with the key, but entering to get it might be too dangerous."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...We need to leave!
entries.literal: "...We need to leave!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I said that, I took my shoes off and gestured at Shiroya to quickly do the same. We'd been able to hear the approaching culprit because of their shoes. Without them, walking on wood would be almost imperceptible.
entries.literal: "As I said that, I took my shoes off and gestured at Shiroya to quickly do the same. We'd been able to hear the approaching culprit because of their shoes. Without them, walking on wood would be almost imperceptible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked through the door and heard movements coming from the other bedroom. We didn't have much time. Shiroya and I nodded at each other and left while making the least amount of noise possible, holding our shoes with our hands.
entries.literal: "I looked through the door and heard movements coming from the other bedroom. We didn't have much time. Shiroya and I nodded at each other and left while making the least amount of noise possible, holding our shoes with our hands."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We approached the living room and began to increase our speed. The culprit had somehow entered the attic, but we didn't know their method. If they'd taken the elevator, it was likely still there, but we couldn't afford the risk of waiting for it to arrive.
entries.literal: "We approached the living room and began to increase our speed. The culprit had somehow entered the attic, but we didn't know their method. If they'd taken the elevator, it was likely still there, but we couldn't afford the risk of waiting for it to arrive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without giving it much thought, we entered the living room. As soon as we did, the dry noise of footsteps on wood froze us in place again.
entries.literal: "Without giving it much thought, we entered the living room. As soon as we did, the dry noise of footsteps on wood froze us in place again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were coming to us. Instead of entering the other bedroom, very faint footsteps were approaching the living room, where we were.
entries.literal: "They were coming to us. Instead of entering the other bedroom, very faint footsteps were approaching the living room, where we were."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait.
entries.literal: "Wait."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No, we can't rush out.{w} We might be going up against Sai, and he wouldn't let us escape like this. If he entered the attic with another key, he could be luring us to the staircase.
entries.literal: "No, we can't rush out.{w} We might be going up against Sai, and he wouldn't let us escape like this. If he entered the attic with another key, he could be luring us to the staircase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd been so desperate that I'd left our key on the floor, next to the attic door. If Sai had managed to enter and then locked the door... If he'd also picked up our key, we couldn't leave, and we would just corner ourselves by walking down the stairs.
entries.literal: "We'd been so desperate that I'd left our key on the floor, next to the attic door. If Sai had managed to enter and then locked the door... If he'd also picked up our key, we couldn't leave, and we would just corner ourselves by walking down the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced down and saw footprints that didn't belong to us. Our pursuer had definitely walked across the carpet after our arrival.
entries.literal: "I glanced down and saw footprints that didn't belong to us. Our pursuer had definitely walked across the carpet after our arrival."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The terror locked my muscles in place. While the sound got closer, I began to explore the thought of attacking the culprit as soon as they entered the living room.
entries.literal: "The terror locked my muscles in place. While the sound got closer, I began to explore the thought of attacking the culprit as soon as they entered the living room."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Fuck! Why didn't I think about this!? They have a knife, and I can't just tell Shiroya to help me!
entries.literal: "Fuck! Why didn't I think about this!? They have a knife, and I can't just tell Shiroya to help me!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: W-We can't go that way.
entries.literal: "W-We can't go that way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She'd been telling me to hurry up with her eyes, but that could've sealed our fates. I grabbed her available hand and dashed to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "She'd been telling me to hurry up with her eyes, but that could've sealed our fates. I grabbed her available hand and dashed to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What are you doing...!?
entries.literal: "What are you doing...!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trying to leave through the main door didn't sound right, but we might've already been done for. The only other way out, the elevator, was no guarantee either.{w} The person behind us had waited a couple minutes before making their entrance, so if they'd used that time to disable the elevator below us, we were completely trapped.
entries.literal: "Trying to leave through the main door didn't sound right, but we might've already been done for. The only other way out, the elevator, was no guarantee either.{w} The person behind us had waited a couple minutes before making their entrance, so if they'd used that time to disable the elevator below us, we were completely trapped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the kitchen, we heard the living room's door being opened. We had to make our move.
entries.literal: "From the kitchen, we heard the living room's door being opened. We had to make our move."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If they look at the footprints, it's possible they could see that we're in the kitchen. We have to get out of here.
entries.literal: "If they look at the footprints, it's possible they could see that we're in the kitchen. We have to get out of here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But a different thought came to me. If they recognized the footprints and anticipated our actions, they could wait in the hallway, knowing we'd immediately leave.{w} It was too late, as I'd already grabbed Shiroya's hand, and I wasn't able to stop mine from turning the handle of the door.
entries.literal: "But a different thought came to me. If they recognized the footprints and anticipated our actions, they could wait in the hallway, knowing we'd immediately leave.{w} It was too late, as I'd already grabbed Shiroya's hand, and I wasn't able to stop mine from turning the handle of the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hallway was empty, but we could see the open door to the living room. With very little time to think, I could only come up with two courses of action.
entries.literal: "The hallway was empty, but we could see the open door to the living room. With very little time to think, I could only come up with two courses of action."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Do we go to the other bedroom where we can lock the door, or do we try to use the elevator!?
entries.literal: "Do we go to the other bedroom where we can lock the door, or do we try to use the elevator!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't decide. Once again, I considered that we were potentially up against Sai, who'd taken some time to think up a strategy specifically so that we couldn't run away. He would have thought far enough ahead to disable the elevator below us.
entries.literal: "I couldn't decide. Once again, I considered that we were potentially up against Sai, who'd taken some time to think up a strategy specifically so that we couldn't run away. He would have thought far enough ahead to disable the elevator below us."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But... he just left the bedroom, and earlier, I put the key inside the drawer where we'd found it. What if he just took it, and going there will trap us as well?
entries.literal: "But... he just left the bedroom, and earlier, I put the key inside the drawer where we'd found it. What if he just took it, and going there will trap us as well?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had the chain, but it was unreliable. We'd seen how Akaro burst through it in five seconds. Not only that, but even though we were supposed to possess the single key to the attic, someone had managed to make their way in. The same thing could repeat in the bedroom.{w} Earlier, Akaro and Sai had escaped with its key, and we knew they'd then activated the Sekimeiya in some way. It was possible they'd produced a spare key already.
entries.literal: "We had the chain, but it was unreliable. We'd seen how Akaro burst through it in five seconds. Not only that, but even though we were supposed to possess the single key to the attic, someone had managed to make their way in. The same thing could repeat in the bedroom.{w} Earlier, Akaro and Sai had escaped with its key, and we knew they'd then activated the Sekimeiya in some way. It was possible they'd produced a spare key already."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: L-Let's try the elevator. Trying to call it is all we can do. If it doesn't come, we'll have to leave.
entries.literal: "L-Let's try the elevator. Trying to call it is all we can do. If it doesn't come, we'll have to leave."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.literal: "...Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heartbeat running wild inside my ears almost drowned out our voices. The culprit hadn't entered the kitchen, meaning that they were either in the living room or the staircase. We'd have to pass through the open door to get to the elevator, so we had to hope they'd gone down the stairs and wouldn't see us.
entries.literal: "My heartbeat running wild inside my ears almost drowned out our voices. The culprit hadn't entered the kitchen, meaning that they were either in the living room or the staircase. We'd have to pass through the open door to get to the elevator, so we had to hope they'd gone down the stairs and wouldn't see us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In an instant, we were on the other side. I'd been able to glance through the door and seen an empty living room.
entries.literal: "In an instant, we were on the other side. I'd been able to glance through the door and seen an empty living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We sped up toward the elevator, but I stopped myself as soon as I remembered something.
entries.literal: "We sped up toward the elevator, but I stopped myself as soon as I remembered something."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: W-Wait... Th-This could be bad.
entries.literal: "W-Wait... Th-This could be bad."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything carried the threat of a trap, and even though we were in close proximity to a killer, we had to attempt to think rationally. We'd been instinctively running away to gain time, but we knew that was utterly pointless if every place was in reach of them. There was one goal we could strive for.
entries.literal: "Everything carried the threat of a trap, and even though we were in close proximity to a killer, we had to attempt to think rationally. We'd been instinctively running away to gain time, but we knew that was utterly pointless if every place was in reach of them. There was one goal we could strive for."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The noise behind us resumed. Again, the culprit was approaching.
entries.literal: "The noise behind us resumed. Again, the culprit was approaching."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: We don't have time to run to the elevator and hope it's either here or functioning. This is definitely a trap.
entries.literal: "We don't have time to run to the elevator and hope it's either here or functioning. This is definitely a trap."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the storeroom and dashed inside.
entries.literal: "I opened the storeroom and dashed inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through the gap of the door, we could see the hallway. The sound of the culprit's movements still reached our ears, but it had become too hard to discern the way they were going.
entries.literal: "Through the gap of the door, we could see the hallway. The sound of the culprit's movements still reached our ears, but it had become too hard to discern the way they were going."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: They're not coming here.
entries.literal: "They're not coming here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think it's very possible that after we left the event room, the Sekimeiya was taken out. We have to rely on that and try to find it since we don't have the key to open the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I think it's very possible that after we left the event room, the Sekimeiya was taken out. We have to rely on that and try to find it since we don't have the key to open the cabinet."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If we find it, we can choose a place to stay hidden until we're unavoidably found. Then, we can activate it.{w} If we go far into the past, we won't be able to think of ambushing the culprit knowing where they'll be since it'd contradict them finding us, but we could make it outside the tower if we're lucky enough.{w} If we travel to the recent past, we could find a new place to hide that this person had just looked at. It'd only be buying us more time, but it's better than having to confront someone with a knife or keep exhausting ourselves.
entries.literal: "If we find it, we can choose a place to stay hidden until we're unavoidably found. Then, we can activate it.{w} If we go far into the past, we won't be able to think of ambushing the culprit knowing where they'll be since it'd contradict them finding us, but we could make it outside the tower if we're lucky enough.{w} If we travel to the recent past, we could find a new place to hide that this person had just looked at. It'd only be buying us more time, but it's better than having to confront someone with a knife or keep exhausting ourselves."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This has to work. On the third floor, our attacker was by the offices' corner and not in the staircase next to the elevator. That was either to watch us from afar or prevent us from going down to the crystal floor; they wanted to chase us up instead of down.
entries.literal: "This has to work. On the third floor, our attacker was by the offices' corner and not in the staircase next to the elevator. That was either to watch us from afar or prevent us from going down to the crystal floor; they wanted to chase us up instead of down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Eventually, every sound faded away, and we could only hear our shaking breaths. In the cramped storeroom, we had to prepare for what our next and most important move would be.
entries.literal: "...Eventually, every sound faded away, and we could only hear our shaking breaths. In the cramped storeroom, we had to prepare for what our next and most important move would be."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Why are they not moving anymore...? Are they waiting for us?
entries.literal: "Why are they not moving anymore...? Are they waiting for us?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Should we try to call the elevator?
entries.literal: "Should we try to call the elevator?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: N-No. I remembered how this all started when I stopped myself.{w} We were going down with the elevator and stopped on floor 3 because someone called it knowing we were inside. No matter who this is, at this point, they must've thought of disabling the elevator under us so that we can't use it to escape.
entries.literal: "N-No. I remembered how this all started when I stopped myself.{w} We were going down with the elevator and stopped on floor 3 because someone called it knowing we were inside. No matter who this is, at this point, they must've thought of disabling the elevator under us so that we can't use it to escape."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If we called the elevator anyway and it came, it would definitely be a trap and they intend to do the same thing as before. As soon as we go down, they could call it.{w} The last time, they waited next to the offices, but this time, I'm sure they'd be right outside to make sure we can't continue moving.{w} Think about it, it's also possible we're dealing with both Akaro and Sai. If one of them is on a floor under us, they could be hoping we take the elevator and lose any way out.
entries.literal: "If we called the elevator anyway and it came, it would definitely be a trap and they intend to do the same thing as before. As soon as we go down, they could call it.{w} The last time, they waited next to the offices, but this time, I'm sure they'd be right outside to make sure we can't continue moving.{w} Think about it, it's also possible we're dealing with both Akaro and Sai. If one of them is on a floor under us, they could be hoping we take the elevator and lose any way out."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But there's nothing else we can do, is there...?
entries.literal: "But there's nothing else we can do, is there...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Assuming the elevator hasn't been used again... it should still be on floor 3. If the culprit, or one of them, is waiting next to the floor 6 elevator and we call it from here, they'd hear it going up. Then, they'd know we'd be about to board it and use it, so they could call it to intercept us.
entries.literal: "Assuming the elevator hasn't been used again... it should still be on floor 3. If the culprit, or one of them, is waiting next to the floor 6 elevator and we call it from here, they'd hear it going up. Then, they'd know we'd be about to board it and use it, so they could call it to intercept us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was experiencing the most unsettling silence possible. Waiting in the storeroom wasn't an option, so I could only find three:{w} trying to use the elevator to go down, trying to lock ourselves in a bedroom, and trying to leave the attic through the main door.
entries.literal: "I was experiencing the most unsettling silence possible. Waiting in the storeroom wasn't an option, so I could only find three:{w} trying to use the elevator to go down, trying to lock ourselves in a bedroom, and trying to leave the attic through the main door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The person outside wasn't moving. They could've been close by or far away. Regardless, it was certain they'd thought of a course of action to apprehend us.
entries.literal: "The person outside wasn't moving. They could've been close by or far away. Regardless, it was certain they'd thought of a course of action to apprehend us."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Why would they have stopped searching for us when it's certain we're in the attic?{w} ...It could mean they're working alone. If they quit looking and want to ambush us instead, it could mean nobody is working with them. Their partner would've taken care of that while the other kept trying to find us.
entries.literal: "Why would they have stopped searching for us when it's certain we're in the attic?{w} ...It could mean they're working alone. If they quit looking and want to ambush us instead, it could mean nobody is working with them. Their partner would've taken care of that while the other kept trying to find us."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, where are they waiting? No matter who we're dealing with, they aren't stupid: they must've grabbed the bedroom key just now, so going there is too obvious of a mistake.
entries.literal: "So, where are they waiting? No matter who we're dealing with, they aren't stupid: they must've grabbed the bedroom key just now, so going there is too obvious of a mistake."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If the elevator is working, it means they have a contingency for us going down. It sounds illogical, but trying to walk out could be the best idea.
entries.literal: "If the elevator is working, it means they have a contingency for us going down. It sounds illogical, but trying to walk out could be the best idea."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It doesn't make sense to think they're just outside of the storeroom, waiting for us to leave. That implies they know we're somewhere around here, and if they did, they would be rushing in. After all, they were opening every room earlier...
entries.literal: "It doesn't make sense to think they're just outside of the storeroom, waiting for us to leave. That implies they know we're somewhere around here, and if they did, they would be rushing in. After all, they were opening every room earlier..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Therefore, for some reason, they might've left the attic. Even though we're exhausted, we're also faster than them. We should be able to run away again if they see us on a floor below, where there's more space.
entries.literal: "Therefore, for some reason, they might've left the attic. Even though we're exhausted, we're also faster than them. We should be able to run away again if they see us on a floor below, where there's more space."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about going to a bedroom to pick up a screwdriver. It was the only weapon I could think of, but I abandoned the thought. It was no match against a knife, and the more I thought about it, the more I felt that going back to a bedroom was a bad idea.{w} Furthermore, if the person chasing us had taken the key, they would probably have taken such an obvious weapon as well.
entries.literal: "I thought about going to a bedroom to pick up a screwdriver. It was the only weapon I could think of, but I abandoned the thought. It was no match against a knife, and the more I thought about it, the more I felt that going back to a bedroom was a bad idea.{w} Furthermore, if the person chasing us had taken the key, they would probably have taken such an obvious weapon as well."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Let's go. We'll try to leave through the main entrance.
entries.literal: "...Let's go. We'll try to leave through the main entrance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya responded with a confused look, but she didn't object. We had to hope that, out of the few options we had, one would let us live. I wasn't confident I'd picked the correct one, but that applied to all of them.
entries.literal: "Shiroya responded with a confused look, but she didn't object. We had to hope that, out of the few options we had, one would let us live. I wasn't confident I'd picked the correct one, but that applied to all of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stepped into the hallway, praying that the faint noise our feet produced wasn't being conveyed to the attacker.
entries.literal: "We stepped into the hallway, praying that the faint noise our feet produced wasn't being conveyed to the attacker."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every corner made my heart stop, and my senses were on higher alert than they'd ever been. Knowing a knife could suddenly swing at any time, we took short steps forward until we saw the entire empty hallway.
entries.literal: "Every corner made my heart stop, and my senses were on higher alert than they'd ever been. Knowing a knife could suddenly swing at any time, we took short steps forward until we saw the entire empty hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But our terror couldn't subside yet. Silently, I peeked into the living room and let out a long-coming breath as soon as I saw it empty.
entries.literal: "But our terror couldn't subside yet. Silently, I peeked into the living room and let out a long-coming breath as soon as I saw it empty."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Okay, we need to leave.
entries.literal: "Okay, we need to leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The tension I felt when I found myself in the middle of the living room was unlike anything I'd ever experienced. There were three doors someone could suddenly appear through. We paid attention to everything in our surroundings until the staircase came into view.
entries.literal: "The tension I felt when I found myself in the middle of the living room was unlike anything I'd ever experienced. There were three doors someone could suddenly appear through. We paid attention to everything in our surroundings until the staircase came into view."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody was there, but I knew I had to look for something else.
entries.literal: "Nobody was there, but I knew I had to look for something else."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's our key...
entries.literal: "That's our key..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the floor, the key we'd used to lock ourselves in showed that the culprit hadn't taken it.
entries.literal: "On the floor, the key we'd used to lock ourselves in showed that the culprit hadn't taken it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: We can leave, at least.
entries.literal: "We can leave, at least."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Making it to wherever the Sekimeiya was still felt like the single goal we could attempt to achieve. We started to walk down at the same time. At the bottom, I crouched to pick up the key, but midway through, I realized we wouldn't need it to leave: the door wasn't closed.
entries.literal: "Making it to wherever the Sekimeiya was still felt like the single goal we could attempt to achieve. We started to walk down at the same time. At the bottom, I crouched to pick up the key, but midway through, I realized we wouldn't need it to leave: the door wasn't closed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Look. This settles it. They have another key for this door, and that's how they entered.
entries.literal: "Look. This settles it. They have another key for this door, and that's how they entered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While they could've teleported inside and unlocked the door with our own key, they wouldn't have left it behind. I reached for the door and began to push it from a distance so that I'd be able to quickly turn around if someone was behind it.
entries.literal: "While they could've teleported inside and unlocked the door with our own key, they wouldn't have left it behind. I reached for the door and began to push it from a distance so that I'd be able to quickly turn around if someone was behind it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But nobody was. The barren scenery of floor 6 felt almost harmless, although nothing would've made us fully lower our guard.
entries.literal: "...But nobody was. The barren scenery of floor 6 felt almost harmless, although nothing would've made us fully lower our guard."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, one second.
entries.literal: "Wait, one second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya turned around and grabbed the attic key from the floor. Then, from the outside, she locked it.
entries.literal: "Shiroya turned around and grabbed the attic key from the floor. Then, from the outside, she locked it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: If they're still inside and disabled the elevator, I just locked them in. If they already left, they might think we locked ourselves inside again.
entries.literal: "If they're still inside and disabled the elevator, I just locked them in. If they already left, they might think we locked ourselves inside again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a good idea. She put the key in her purse, and attaching ourselves to the left wall, we picked up a fairly brisk pace, intending to reach the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "It was a good idea. She put the key in her purse, and attaching ourselves to the left wall, we picked up a fairly brisk pace, intending to reach the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every floor was packed with perilous turns where our attacker could've been waiting, and I found it very likely they were near an elevator door, expecting us to use it at any point.
entries.literal: "Every floor was packed with perilous turns where our attacker could've been waiting, and I found it very likely they were near an elevator door, expecting us to use it at any point."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We circled through the entire sixth floor and went down the first staircase. We still had our shoes in our hands, so we were making the least amount of noise possible. Unfortunately, the strong echo amplified our steps enough to nullify the effect.
entries.literal: "We circled through the entire sixth floor and went down the first staircase. We still had our shoes in our hands, so we were making the least amount of noise possible. Unfortunately, the strong echo amplified our steps enough to nullify the effect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Running through floor 5, I thought of what we'd do if the Sekimeiya hadn't been taken from the cabinet. Unable to undo our own lock, we'd be done for. Going to the security room to try and get Katei's bathroom key would be the last thing we could depend on. However, it was very likely the killer had taken it.
entries.literal: "Running through floor 5, I thought of what we'd do if the Sekimeiya hadn't been taken from the cabinet. Unable to undo our own lock, we'd be done for. Going to the security room to try and get Katei's bathroom key would be the last thing we could depend on. However, it was very likely the killer had taken it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We made it to floor 4. We continually made a series of turns moving down through the building; meanwhile, I kept trying to force out the thought that any of those plain walls could be the last thing we ever saw.
entries.literal: "We made it to floor 4. We continually made a series of turns moving down through the building; meanwhile, I kept trying to force out the thought that any of those plain walls could be the last thing we ever saw."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=0.6}The same knife, the same breeze at my side... After leaving the partitions, as if the culprit had teleported behind me, I saw another missed swing that was incredibly close to taking my life. It had happened again—a sudden ambush.
entries.literal: "{w=0.6}The same knife, the same breeze at my side... After leaving the partitions, as if the culprit had teleported behind me, I saw another missed swing that was incredibly close to taking my life. It had happened again—a sudden ambush."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya let out a cry at my side. We didn't stop running, but something had taken my desire to react. That time, I saw it.
entries.literal: "Shiroya let out a cry at my side. We didn't stop running, but something had taken my desire to react. That time, I saw it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hand gripping the knife—and a wristwatch.
entries.literal: "The hand gripping the knife—and a wristwatch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, the voice of the person who'd tried to kill me broke out and resounded through the entire floor.
entries.literal: "Then, the voice of the person who'd tried to kill me broke out and resounded through the entire floor."

entries.speaker: saicenter
entries.text: {w=0.7}"Atsuki! {w=0.5}You son of a bitch!"{w=1.1}{nw}
entries.literal: "{w=0.7}\"Atsuki! {w=0.5}You son of a bitch!\"{w=1.1}{nw}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's voice echoed in my mind. Without stopping, we turned our heads around to see an enraged expression full of malice. Then, he took off behind us, knife in hand.
entries.literal: "Sai's voice echoed in my mind. Without stopping, we turned our heads around to see an enraged expression full of malice. Then, he took off behind us, knife in hand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The chase resumed. Shiroya and I sprinted as fast as we could toward the staircase to floor 3 while I reeled at the fact that it had actually been Sai.{w} Why... and why then? His face had made it clear that trying to ask would be our end.
entries.literal: "The chase resumed. Shiroya and I sprinted as fast as we could toward the staircase to floor 3 while I reeled at the fact that it had actually been Sai.{w} Why... and why then? His face had made it clear that trying to ask would be our end."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, as soon as I forced my body to move, it rejected me. I understood there was no way I could run for much longer, and the same surely applied to Shiroya. As we headed toward the staircase, I thought of something.
entries.literal: "However, as soon as I forced my body to move, it rejected me. I understood there was no way I could run for much longer, and the same surely applied to Shiroya. As we headed toward the staircase, I thought of something."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Sai's pretty far behind... It's very likely the elevator is still on floor 3, just under the stairs, since Shiroya called it before we were attacked. If it is, we might be able to get in before he can catch us this time.
entries.literal: "Sai's pretty far behind... It's very likely the elevator is still on floor 3, just under the stairs, since Shiroya called it before we were attacked. If it is, we might be able to get in before he can catch us this time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It sounded feasible. As soon as we got to the lower floor, we could attempt to open the elevator. If Sai had disabled it, it was likely still there. We'd concluded that he probably entered the attic through the main door, meaning that it wasn't in the attic.
entries.literal: "It sounded feasible. As soon as we got to the lower floor, we could attempt to open the elevator. If Sai had disabled it, it was likely still there. We'd concluded that he probably entered the attic through the main door, meaning that it wasn't in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was risky, but our bodies were on the verge of giving up, our lives balanced on a knife's edge.
entries.literal: "It was risky, but our bodies were on the verge of giving up, our lives balanced on a knife's edge."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Even if Akaro's working with Sai, as long as the elevator is here, that shouldn't be a problem... If Sai's really working with him, what's likely is that Akaro was the one to go to the attic while Sai waited here to ambush us.
entries.literal: "Even if Akaro's working with Sai, as long as the elevator is here, that shouldn't be a problem... If Sai's really working with him, what's likely is that Akaro was the one to go to the attic while Sai waited here to ambush us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The way it happened, I imagined Sai was hiding inside the first partition, waiting for us to pass by.{w} We began to speed down the stairs while I tried to decide on what to do. Sai hadn't started to chase us until he'd yelled my name, which had created enough distance between us to seriously consider the elevator.
entries.literal: "The way it happened, I imagined Sai was hiding inside the first partition, waiting for us to pass by.{w} We began to speed down the stairs while I tried to decide on what to do. Sai hadn't started to chase us until he'd yelled my name, which had created enough distance between us to seriously consider the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite that, it still felt off. Our attacker was Sai—not many things slipped by him. The elevator wasn't particularly fast, but most importantly... would he really let us use it? Even though we could outrun him at full speed, trying and failing to open the elevator was time we didn't know we had, considering we weren't going to be able to keep running for long.
entries.literal: "Despite that, it still felt off. Our attacker was Sai—not many things slipped by him. The elevator wasn't particularly fast, but most importantly... would he really let us use it? Even though we could outrun him at full speed, trying and failing to open the elevator was time we didn't know we had, considering we weren't going to be able to keep running for long."

entries.text: Try to enter the elevator.
entries.literal: "Try to enter the elevator."

entries.text: Continue running down.
entries.literal: "Continue running down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The world froze.{w} However, strangely, movement was still within.
entries.literal: "The world froze.{w} However, strangely, movement was still within."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya lived in a delicate universe. A single modification could collapse the complex structure they were climbing.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Shiroya lived in a delicate universe. A single modification could collapse the complex structure they were climbing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...However, the structure could be partially frozen and then changed.
entries.literal: "...However, the structure could be partially frozen and then changed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This universe will be frozen, and that will permit its observation. A universe that would collapse if set in motion.
entries.literal: "This universe will be frozen, and that will permit its observation. A universe that would collapse if set in motion."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Rules have to be bent abstractly—the flow must stop. Only that will allow an impossibility.
entries.literal: "Rules have to be bent abstractly—the flow must stop. Only that will allow an impossibility."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Ultimately, just before stepping onto the third floor, Atsuki changed his mind. He was exhausted, and at that point, the elevator seemed safe.
entries.literal: "Ultimately, just before stepping onto the third floor, Atsuki changed his mind. He was exhausted, and at that point, the elevator seemed safe."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: One second! I'll try to open the elevator!
entries.literal: "One second! I'll try to open the elevator!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya had also been thinking about it, but she hadn't thought that Atsuki would attempt to use it.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had also been thinking about it, but she hadn't thought that Atsuki would attempt to use it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was next to the staircase, so it didn't take him very long to confirm it: the elevator was still on the third floor, and it hadn't been disabled. He opened it, and its empty interior came into their view.
entries.literal: "It was next to the staircase, so it didn't take him very long to confirm it: the elevator was still on the third floor, and it hadn't been disabled. He opened it, and its empty interior came into their view."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: All right, get in!
entries.literal: "All right, get in!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before Sai could catch them, both of them boarded the elevator. They had enough time to press a button, but that was yet another decision to make. They looked at the panel and decided to touch one of the eight available buttons.
entries.literal: "Before Sai could catch them, both of them boarded the elevator. They had enough time to press a button, but that was yet another decision to make. They looked at the panel and decided to touch one of the eight available buttons."

entries.text: Go back to the attic and lock yourselves in a bedroom.
entries.literal: "Go back to the attic and lock yourselves in a bedroom."

entries.text: Change of Mind
entries.literal: "Change of Mind"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki's plan was simple. He wanted to take advantage of the distance they'd gained from Sai.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's plan was simple. He wanted to take advantage of the distance they'd gained from Sai."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Perhaps they could trick him. He thought they were going to continue running down, so if they went back up, Sai might've thought they'd already turned toward the offices. In addition, they knew the elevator couldn't be heard if it arrived at or left the floor one was on.
entries.literal: "Perhaps they could trick him. He thought they were going to continue running down, so if they went back up, Sai might've thought they'd already turned toward the offices. In addition, they knew the elevator couldn't be heard if it arrived at or left the floor one was on."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With eyes almost closed, Atsuki waited a few seconds so that Sai would have time to arrive and miss the sound. Meanwhile, he reached into Shiroya's purse to grab the attic key and used it to unlock the floor 7 button, which he confidently pressed.
entries.literal: "With eyes almost closed, Atsuki waited a few seconds so that Sai would have time to arrive and miss the sound. Meanwhile, he reached into Shiroya's purse to grab the attic key and used it to unlock the floor 7 button, which he confidently pressed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But what was really crossing Atsuki's mind? Had that been the plan he'd designed and decided on? Sai must've known the elevator was available, and using it would've ceased their echoing footfalls. At his side, Shiroya couldn't help but be confused by the action he'd chosen to take.
entries.literal: "But what was really crossing Atsuki's mind? Had that been the plan he'd designed and decided on? Sai must've known the elevator was available, and using it would've ceased their echoing footfalls. At his side, Shiroya couldn't help but be confused by the action he'd chosen to take."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: I hate that it's come to this, but we can't escape from Sai for more than three hours. We have to put all our faith in locking ourselves up in a bedroom.
entries.literal: "I hate that it's come to this, but we can't escape from Sai for more than three hours. We have to put all our faith in locking ourselves up in a bedroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya was speechless at his sudden change, but she couldn't object to him. She decided not to reply and trusted the decision her oldest friend had made to save both of their lives.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was speechless at his sudden change, but she couldn't object to him. She decided not to reply and trusted the decision her oldest friend had made to save both of their lives."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Up there, we'll set the chain and physically prevent the door from opening. Even if Sai has the key, he won't be able to break the door down. In case he enters... we can try to use something to defend ourselves.
entries.literal: "Up there, we'll set the chain and physically prevent the door from opening. Even if Sai has the key, he won't be able to break the door down. In case he enters... we can try to use something to defend ourselves."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They had seen Sai's murderous expression and felt how strongly he'd desired their eradication. Even though the physical demand was high, keeping a chained door from opening was much more reasonable than perpetually running away.
entries.literal: "They had seen Sai's murderous expression and felt how strongly he'd desired their eradication. Even though the physical demand was high, keeping a chained door from opening was much more reasonable than perpetually running away."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The elevator stopped and began to slowly open its doors. The trip had created a great deal of tension that was released when they burst out of it. They were back in the hallway they'd just escaped from, but they'd shifted their goal.
entries.literal: "The elevator stopped and began to slowly open its doors. The trip had created a great deal of tension that was released when they burst out of it. They were back in the hallway they'd just escaped from, but they'd shifted their goal."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They ran, ignoring the turns they'd previously handled with care. They wanted to enter the bedroom, which they began to see as their only salvation.
entries.literal: "They ran, ignoring the turns they'd previously handled with care. They wanted to enter the bedroom, which they began to see as their only salvation."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both open doors were in sight. Only the right one possessed a chain, so they didn't hesitate over which one to enter. Running, the lack of friction between Atsuki's socks and the wooden flooring almost made him trip, but he managed to steady himself. Shiroya made her way in first and immediately shut the door as soon as Atsuki joined her.
entries.literal: "Both open doors were in sight. Only the right one possessed a chain, so they didn't hesitate over which one to enter. Running, the lack of friction between Atsuki's socks and the wooden flooring almost made him trip, but he managed to steady himself. Shiroya made her way in first and immediately shut the door as soon as Atsuki joined her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the left side of the door, the chain began to swing in response to the abrupt slam. As Atsuki hurried to check the drawers, Shiroya's trembling arm set the chain, recalling how unreliable it had been in the past.
entries.literal: "On the left side of the door, the chain began to swing in response to the abrupt slam. As Atsuki hurried to check the drawers, Shiroya's trembling arm set the chain, recalling how unreliable it had been in the past."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Do you see the key?
entries.literal: "Do you see the key?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki remembered. He had left it in the top drawer of the stand.
entries.literal: "Atsuki remembered. He had left it in the top drawer of the stand."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Yes!" He let out a cry of joy when he saw that {tip=key}it hadn't been taken{/tip}. Their chances of surviving had just drastically increased.
entries.literal: "\"Yes!\" He let out a cry of joy when he saw that {tip=key}it hadn't been taken{/tip}. Their chances of surviving had just drastically increased."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But nothing had been settled. While holding the key, the nightmarish sound of a bursting door struck Atsuki's ears. When he turned around, he saw Shiroya's body being knocked away.
entries.literal: "But nothing had been settled. While holding the key, the nightmarish sound of a bursting door struck Atsuki's ears. When he turned around, he saw Shiroya's body being knocked away."

entries.speaker: c
