entries.text: Past the door, the terrifying silhouette of Sai paralyzed Atsuki's mind. The knife was still gripped in his right hand, and as soon as he saw Atsuki's defeated expression, Sai grinned.
entries.literal: "Past the door, the terrifying silhouette of Sai paralyzed Atsuki's mind. The knife was still gripped in his right hand, and as soon as he saw Atsuki's defeated expression, Sai grinned."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the floor, Shiroya yelled desperately, but Sai ignored her. He began to approach Atsuki, who stared at him in regret. He hadn't even had time to grab the screwdriver.
entries.literal: "On the floor, Shiroya yelled desperately, but Sai ignored her. He began to approach Atsuki, who stared at him in regret. He hadn't even had time to grab the screwdriver."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Stop!"{w} Shiroya cried again, but anything she could say was meaningless to Sai, who was certain of her fate.
entries.literal: "\"Stop!\"{w} Shiroya cried again, but anything she could say was meaningless to Sai, who was certain of her fate."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki's hands let go of his shoes, and he made his first step backward, inevitably backing himself into the wall. When he made eye contact with his killer, he noticed Sai had a bit of blood in his mouth. Such trivial information had become utterly pointless, but he thought that blood might've dripped off him some time in the past.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's hands let go of his shoes, and he made his first step backward, inevitably backing himself into the wall. When he made eye contact with his killer, he noticed Sai had a bit of blood in his mouth. Such trivial information had become utterly pointless, but he thought that blood might've dripped off him some time in the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He made no attempt at putting that information to use. His mind had broken down, and he couldn't move. He'd realized his reckless action had resulted in not only his own death, but Shiroya's.
entries.literal: "He made no attempt at putting that information to use. His mind had broken down, and he couldn't move. He'd realized his reckless action had resulted in not only his own death, but Shiroya's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She placed her hand on the floor and attempted to stand up. Wasting no time, she launched herself toward Sai, whose murderous aura had spoken every needed word.
entries.literal: "She placed her hand on the floor and attempted to stand up. Wasting no time, she launched herself toward Sai, whose murderous aura had spoken every needed word."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once again, she was ignored, and instead, Sai dashed forward. ...Atsuki had no time to even react.
entries.literal: "Once again, she was ignored, and instead, Sai dashed forward. ...Atsuki had no time to even react."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he looked down, he saw the knife had pierced through his stomach. "So this is how being stabbed feels". Such a ridiculous thought was all that crossed his mind. The sensation surprised him; it hadn't been as painful as he'd expected.
entries.literal: "When he looked down, he saw the knife had pierced through his stomach. \"So this is how being stabbed feels\". Such a ridiculous thought was all that crossed his mind. The sensation surprised him; it hadn't been as painful as he'd expected."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But his body crumpled down, unable to keep supporting itself. From a lower perspective, he saw that Sai's face had become even more warped. Behind him, Shiroya's fell into disrepair. She reached for Atsuki, but Sai did not allow it.
entries.literal: "But his body crumpled down, unable to keep supporting itself. From a lower perspective, he saw that Sai's face had become even more warped. Behind him, Shiroya's fell into disrepair. She reached for Atsuki, but Sai did not allow it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Mercilessly, he moved his arm in an arc, drawing a long horizontal cut through Shiroya's chest. Inwardly, Atsuki cried in anguish.{w} But Sai frowned. After instinctively reacting to Shiroya's attempt at aiding Atsuki, he looked at his second victim in disbelief.
entries.literal: "Mercilessly, he moved his arm in an arc, drawing a long horizontal cut through Shiroya's chest. Inwardly, Atsuki cried in anguish.{w} But Sai frowned. After instinctively reacting to Shiroya's attempt at aiding Atsuki, he looked at his second victim in disbelief."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "{tip=pendulum}What...?{/tip}" He sounded surprised, but soon snapped out of it. Before Atsuki could make a last effort at understanding why they'd had to be finished off like that, Sai jumped back at him and stabbed him a second time.
entries.literal: "\"{tip=pendulum}What...?{/tip}\" He sounded surprised, but soon snapped out of it. Before Atsuki could make a last effort at understanding why they'd had to be finished off like that, Sai jumped back at him and stabbed him a second time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And then a third, and a fourth... All of them felt much more painful, but he couldn't move. "You brought this on yourself, you fucking idiot!"{w} Those words were received as static noise. An irreversible cloudiness began to fill Atsuki's consciousness, and eventually, his brain stopped interpreting the splashes of blood that every stab produced, shortly cutting off forever.
entries.literal: "And then a third, and a fourth... All of them felt much more painful, but he couldn't move. \"You brought this on yourself, you fucking idiot!\"{w} Those words were received as static noise. An irreversible cloudiness began to fill Atsuki's consciousness, and eventually, his brain stopped interpreting the splashes of blood that every stab produced, shortly cutting off forever."

entries.text: Ending: Pendulum
entries.literal: "Ending: Pendulum"

entries.text: Bloodhound
entries.literal: "Bloodhound"

entries.text: Stay inside the elevator.
entries.literal: "Stay inside the elevator."

entries.text: Self-Causality
entries.literal: "Self-Causality"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Atsuki ran down through all the buttons, he realized there was one he hadn't considered. Above the others, a red button with the word "Stop" immediately grabbed his attention.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki ran down through all the buttons, he realized there was one he hadn't considered. Above the others, a red button with the word \"Stop\" immediately grabbed his attention."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: The stop button! We'll be safe if we lock ourselves in here!
entries.literal: "The stop button! We'll be safe if we lock ourselves in here!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya's eyes widened in amazement. Both of them had failed to recall its existence.{w} They thought back on Katei's words. He'd told them that if the button was pressed while the elevator was moving, only an entity from outside the tower could enable it again.
entries.literal: "Shiroya's eyes widened in amazement. Both of them had failed to recall its existence.{w} They thought back on Katei's words. He'd told them that if the button was pressed while the elevator was moving, only an entity from outside the tower could enable it again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before Sai had time to arrive and open the door, Atsuki rushed to press the floor 4 button. That was solely done to begin motion, since stopping it while stationary might've left the outer button functional.
entries.literal: "Before Sai had time to arrive and open the door, Atsuki rushed to press the floor 4 button. That was solely done to begin motion, since stopping it while stationary might've left the outer button functional."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as they departed the third floor, Atsuki pressed the stop button. Without any delay, the whole structure abruptly ceased moving and kept itself suspended between the third and fourth floors.
entries.literal: "As soon as they departed the third floor, Atsuki pressed the stop button. Without any delay, the whole structure abruptly ceased moving and kept itself suspended between the third and fourth floors."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: There we go... It worked!
entries.literal: "There we go... It worked!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both of them breathed with relief. An inaccessible elevator in the middle of an inaccessible tunnel; they'd reached the safest position within the tower.
entries.literal: "Both of them breathed with relief. An inaccessible elevator in the middle of an inaccessible tunnel; they'd reached the safest position within the tower."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Like Katei said, no connection with the outside occurred because it's something the alarm disabled. We'll have to wait until the front door opens to be rescued, but that's more than okay.
entries.literal: "Like Katei said, no connection with the outside occurred because it's something the alarm disabled. We'll have to wait until the front door opens to be rescued, but that's more than okay."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya agreed with a faint voice. They knew they had slightly more than three hours to go, and a narrow elevator was all the space they had. Deciding to rest as best they could, they put their shoes on and let their bodies drop until they sat on the floor.
entries.literal: "Shiroya agreed with a faint voice. They knew they had slightly more than three hours to go, and a narrow elevator was all the space they had. Deciding to rest as best they could, they put their shoes on and let their bodies drop until they sat on the floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After the elevator had stopped, not the faintest external sound had been heard. Their bodies were still tired, so despite the long wait, they knew they could wait through it with ease. Leaning on opposite corners, they let their bodies loosen, starting to feel their heartbeats slowing down.
entries.literal: "After the elevator had stopped, not the faintest external sound had been heard. Their bodies were still tired, so despite the long wait, they knew they could wait through it with ease. Leaning on opposite corners, they let their bodies loosen, starting to feel their heartbeats slowing down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both of them wanted to talk to the other, but didn't do so. Instead, they used their imaginations to explore what they'd do after escaping.
entries.literal: "Both of them wanted to talk to the other, but didn't do so. Instead, they used their imaginations to explore what they'd do after escaping."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya had been living in Atsuki's house for a week, and they'd never set an end date. She hoped she could stay with him for a little bit longer without being a bother.{w} In the meantime, Atsuki's mind kept going to what they'd talked about hours previously. It had been so long since they'd visited their old cabin that he really felt a strong desire to go back there with her.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had been living in Atsuki's house for a week, and they'd never set an end date. She hoped she could stay with him for a little bit longer without being a bother.{w} In the meantime, Atsuki's mind kept going to what they'd talked about hours previously. It had been so long since they'd visited their old cabin that he really felt a strong desire to go back there with her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But he knew what had been happening around them. He knew that, for some reason, Sai wanted them dead. He'd somehow acquired a knife and abused the Sekimeiya's powers. It was very unlikely he could reach their position, but depending on his true motives, the chase might've continued even after exiting the tower.
entries.literal: "But he knew what had been happening around them. He knew that, for some reason, Sai wanted them dead. He'd somehow acquired a knife and abused the Sekimeiya's powers. It was very unlikely he could reach their position, but depending on his true motives, the chase might've continued even after exiting the tower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After all, it appeared the cameras hadn't been working, and with the aid of the Sekimeiya, Sai could've known how to avoid being caught by the police. Even if they'd outsmarted him once, it was impossible to be at peace yet.
entries.literal: "After all, it appeared the cameras hadn't been working, and with the aid of the Sekimeiya, Sai could've known how to avoid being caught by the police. Even if they'd outsmarted him once, it was impossible to be at peace yet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Minutes started to pass. Not a thing had reached their ears, but as they were between two floors, it was unlikely even a loud sound could have.
entries.literal: "Minutes started to pass. Not a thing had reached their ears, but as they were between two floors, it was unlikely even a loud sound could have."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Every now and then, they'd raise their heads to check on each other. It was impossible to keep a comfortable position, so they continued slightly adjusting themselves.
entries.literal: "Every now and then, they'd raise their heads to check on each other. It was impossible to keep a comfortable position, so they continued slightly adjusting themselves."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as Atsuki realized that he was still thirsty, he knew he wouldn't be able to get it out of his mind. He was about to attempt some small talk by saying it, but stopped himself, as it could've made Shiroya feel the same way.
entries.literal: "As soon as Atsuki realized that he was still thirsty, he knew he wouldn't be able to get it out of his mind. He was about to attempt some small talk by saying it, but stopped himself, as it could've made Shiroya feel the same way."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A few more minutes went by. Atsuki didn't know how long they'd been in the elevator. Without a watch, and given how tired they were, it was far too difficult to tell. Any range from ten to twenty minutes seemed possible to him.
entries.literal: "A few more minutes went by. Atsuki didn't know how long they'd been in the elevator. Without a watch, and given how tired they were, it was far too difficult to tell. Any range from ten to twenty minutes seemed possible to him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But... a sudden, dark atmosphere began to creep up on them.
entries.literal: "But... a sudden, dark atmosphere began to creep up on them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With a broken sense of time, Atsuki remembered one of the most mysterious events they'd experienced. They had listened to a recording that had claimed the exit would never open... that the alarm's effects would be permanent.
entries.literal: "With a broken sense of time, Atsuki remembered one of the most mysterious events they'd experienced. They had listened to a recording that had claimed the exit would never open... that the alarm's effects would be permanent."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he'd made the rushed decision of activating the emergency stop function of the elevator, he hadn't thought of it. If it was legitimate, nobody was going to let them out.{w} When the thought came to him, Atsuki's heart began to speed up again.
entries.literal: "When he'd made the rushed decision of activating the emergency stop function of the elevator, he hadn't thought of it. If it was legitimate, nobody was going to let them out.{w} When the thought came to him, Atsuki's heart began to speed up again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Had Shiroya thought of it? He couldn't tell her. In less than a minute, the claustrophobic sensation had begun to invade Atsuki's body.
entries.literal: "Had Shiroya thought of it? He couldn't tell her. In less than a minute, the claustrophobic sensation had begun to invade Atsuki's body."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: ...Are you okay?
entries.literal: "...Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Yes, don't worry.
entries.literal: "Yes, don't worry."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya noticed he'd started to take deeper and faster breaths. Their decision was irreversible, but the process to learn if it had been the correct one was what began to assault Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Shiroya noticed he'd started to take deeper and faster breaths. Their decision was irreversible, but the process to learn if it had been the correct one was what began to assault Atsuki."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Had his finger already sealed their fate? He didn't know how much longer they'd have to wait to find out. Atsuki began to sweat nervously as he imagined the terrifying scenarios they could've already caught themselves in.
entries.literal: "Had his finger already sealed their fate? He didn't know how much longer they'd have to wait to find out. Atsuki began to sweat nervously as he imagined the terrifying scenarios they could've already caught themselves in."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How long until {time=21}? If they could be sure that point in time would mark the end to their suffering, reaching it wouldn't be an issue. As soon as Atsuki had thought of the not-unlikely worst scenario, though, every second had begun to feel unbearable.
entries.literal: "How long until {time=21}? If they could be sure that point in time would mark the end to their suffering, reaching it wouldn't be an issue. As soon as Atsuki had thought of the not-unlikely worst scenario, though, every second had begun to feel unbearable."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Would they die inside the elevator if help never came? It should've been impossible. After all, if the recording was legitimate and they'd spend a month in the tower, it must've also been true that Atsuki would survive until it occurred.
entries.literal: "Would they die inside the elevator if help never came? It should've been impossible. After all, if the recording was legitimate and they'd spend a month in the tower, it must've also been true that Atsuki would survive until it occurred."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...However, what about Shiroya? She hadn't been mentioned in it.
entries.literal: "...However, what about Shiroya? She hadn't been mentioned in it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki was used to feeling betrayed by his own mind. Shiroya had been wearing a neutral expression, but if nothing had happened in three hours... what kind of expression would she have? Would he be the only one to survive after seeing his friend deteriorate?
entries.literal: "Atsuki was used to feeling betrayed by his own mind. Shiroya had been wearing a neutral expression, but if nothing had happened in three hours... what kind of expression would she have? Would he be the only one to survive after seeing his friend deteriorate?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The rational part of him denied it: there was no food anywhere, and none of them could survive for so long. Yet, he couldn't relieve any of his worries.
entries.literal: "The rational part of him denied it: there was no food anywhere, and none of them could survive for so long. Yet, he couldn't relieve any of his worries."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stood up and stretched his body as much as he could. Maintaining the verbal silence, he sat back down. His mind begged for noise, the lack of anything else happening driving him mad.
entries.literal: "He stood up and stretched his body as much as he could. Maintaining the verbal silence, he sat back down. His mind begged for noise, the lack of anything else happening driving him mad."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He wasn't sure how much longer they had to wait for... Perhaps they'd been inside for half an hour. As much as he wanted the time to pass, he knew an inevitable time would come: almost {time=21.}
entries.literal: "He wasn't sure how much longer they had to wait for... Perhaps they'd been inside for half an hour. As much as he wanted the time to pass, he knew an inevitable time would come: almost {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The uncertain period of time in which nothing would be known. Was it past {time=21}, and they were already doomed? Was the way out about to unlock? ...How could they know?
entries.literal: "The uncertain period of time in which nothing would be known. Was it past {time=21}, and they were already doomed? Was the way out about to unlock? ...How could they know?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If it was truly never going to open... when would they know it? Would they have to wait for six hours before being sure that their perception of time hadn't shattered?
entries.literal: "If it was truly never going to open... when would they know it? Would they have to wait for six hours before being sure that their perception of time hadn't shattered?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't know what to think. Nearby, Sai might've been trying to find a way to kill them. Could it be that he wouldn't let the exit open precisely to achieve that?
entries.literal: "He didn't know what to think. Nearby, Sai might've been trying to find a way to kill them. Could it be that he wouldn't let the exit open precisely to achieve that?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The tendency Atsuki had to overthink everything made for the perfect paranoid mind. Beyond everything, thinking about a reality in which they'd be trapped there forever, sharing a long and agonizing end while he could only blame himself, was the most petrifying conclusion he could imagine.
entries.literal: "The tendency Atsuki had to overthink everything made for the perfect paranoid mind. Beyond everything, thinking about a reality in which they'd be trapped there forever, sharing a long and agonizing end while he could only blame himself, was the most petrifying conclusion he could imagine."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And it wouldn't occur.{w} He had spent the past few minutes with his eyes closed when he opened them after a sudden noise.
entries.literal: "And it wouldn't occur.{w} He had spent the past few minutes with his eyes closed when he opened them after a sudden noise."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He looked up. A knife had been stabbed into his chest, one gripped by a hand. When it was taken out, blood began to pour out of him, wetting his shirt.
entries.literal: "He looked up. A knife had been stabbed into his chest, one gripped by a hand. When it was taken out, blood began to pour out of him, wetting his shirt."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A cold and simultaneously hot pain invaded his whole torso. He couldn't comprehend what had happened and looked at the blood in disbelief.
entries.literal: "A cold and simultaneously hot pain invaded his whole torso. He couldn't comprehend what had happened and looked at the blood in disbelief."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, his gaze turned to Shiroya's expression. It was one he'd never seen on her.
entries.literal: "Then, his gaze turned to Shiroya's expression. It was one he'd never seen on her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His mind fell into disarray as he frantically looked around the cramped space. He couldn't believe what he was seeing. The situation was so laughable that he couldn't bring himself to scream or utter a word.
entries.literal: "His mind fell into disarray as he frantically looked around the cramped space. He couldn't believe what he was seeing. The situation was so laughable that he couldn't bring himself to scream or utter a word."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Flickering shreds of sound began to fill his ears while his sight blackened. "No, why...?" Those words echoed within himself, unable to be released.
entries.literal: "Flickering shreds of sound began to fill his ears while his sight blackened. \"No, why...?\" Those words echoed within himself, unable to be released."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He opened his eyes to confirm it one more time: indeed, what he saw was a senseless nightmare. Every scenario he'd thought of had been erased.
entries.literal: "He opened his eyes to confirm it one more time: indeed, what he saw was a senseless nightmare. Every scenario he'd thought of had been erased."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki felt a disconnect from reality, as if his body had been hijacked. Without the strength to resist, he gave out on keeping hold of himself, and as soon as he collapsed to the ground, his consciousness burst like a bubble.
entries.literal: "Atsuki felt a disconnect from reality, as if his body had been hijacked. Without the strength to resist, he gave out on keeping hold of himself, and as soon as he collapsed to the ground, his consciousness burst like a bubble."

entries.text: Ending: Personal Paradox
entries.literal: "Ending: Personal Paradox"

entries.text: Bloodhound
entries.literal: "Bloodhound"

entries.text: Catch-22
entries.literal: "Catch-22"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Entering the elevator was too risky; that was my final conclusion. There was no way Sai hadn't prepared for it.
entries.literal: "Entering the elevator was too risky; that was my final conclusion. There was no way Sai hadn't prepared for it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We set foot on the third floor. I glanced at my right and saw the shut elevator. That meant it probably hadn't been disabled, giving off a further feeling of a trap. I saw the bathrooms again as well.
entries.literal: "We set foot on the third floor. I glanced at my right and saw the shut elevator. That meant it probably hadn't been disabled, giving off a further feeling of a trap. I saw the bathrooms again as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had the opportunity to lock ourselves inside one, but I doubted the inner lock would be able to withstand the force of someone turning a key from outside. Ignoring both options, we continued running forward.
entries.literal: "We had the opportunity to lock ourselves inside one, but I doubted the inner lock would be able to withstand the force of someone turning a key from outside. Ignoring both options, we continued running forward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had probably been waiting for us inside the first partition of the previous floor, so running next to them was hair-raising. Behind us, Sai's noisy attempts at catching up began growing audible throughout the entire floor. We had to put the distance between us to good use.
entries.literal: "Sai had probably been waiting for us inside the first partition of the previous floor, so running next to them was hair-raising. Behind us, Sai's noisy attempts at catching up began growing audible throughout the entire floor. We had to put the distance between us to good use."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we arrived on the second floor, my limbs began to tremble, pushed harder than I had ever expected.
entries.literal: "When we arrived on the second floor, my limbs began to tremble, pushed harder than I had ever expected."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: W-W-We should probably go to the... event room... to s-see if the Sekimeiya's still there.
entries.literal: "W-W-We should probably go to the... event room... to s-see if the Sekimeiya's still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya didn't react to what I said, but we continued to make our way through the floor.{w} There was another reason we had to target the event room: if Sai was our only attacker, for as long as we circled in and out of it, we wouldn't be caught. Of course, we couldn't do that for the remaining three hours, but it was better than putting ourselves in a corner.
entries.literal: "Shiroya didn't react to what I said, but we continued to make our way through the floor.{w} There was another reason we had to target the event room: if Sai was our only attacker, for as long as we circled in and out of it, we wouldn't be caught. Of course, we couldn't do that for the remaining three hours, but it was better than putting ourselves in a corner."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The final staircase was just ahead of us. We'd begun to slow down, but Sai hadn't been able to close the distance between us. We could hear his footsteps still descending the previous flight of stairs.
entries.literal: "The final staircase was just ahead of us. We'd begun to slow down, but Sai hadn't been able to close the distance between us. We could hear his footsteps still descending the previous flight of stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we crossed the door in the middle of the staircase, we saw the floor of hallway A. Without hesitating, we kept running toward the door in the middle.
entries.literal: "When we crossed the door in the middle of the staircase, we saw the floor of hallway A. Without hesitating, we kept running toward the door in the middle."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There was another drop of blood... on the floor of hallway C.
entries.literal: "There was another drop of blood... on the floor of hallway C."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It looked recent too...
entries.literal: "It looked recent too..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had someone been occasionally bleeding small drops for two hours...? I had no time to wonder about it as I pushed open the door in front of us.
entries.literal: "Had someone been occasionally bleeding small drops for two hours...? I had no time to wonder about it as I pushed open the door in front of us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the dark room, the covered cabinet appeared camouflaged by the walls. Drawn by its overwhelming aura, I grabbed the bottom of the curtain and lifted it.
entries.literal: "In the dark room, the covered cabinet appeared camouflaged by the walls. Drawn by its overwhelming aura, I grabbed the bottom of the curtain and lifted it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Really...?
entries.literal: "Really...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What do we do?
entries.literal: "What do we do?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was behind the glass. Neither the mysterious Shiroya nor Sai had taken it.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was behind the glass. Neither the mysterious Shiroya nor Sai had taken it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to open it, which confirmed that our lock was still in effect. Only the key would deliver the Sekimeiya back to us, and Akaro or Sai surely had it. ...And even though another Sekimeiya could exist, that was no guarantee.
entries.literal: "I tried to open it, which confirmed that our lock was still in effect. Only the key would deliver the Sekimeiya back to us, and Akaro or Sai surely had it. ...And even though another Sekimeiya could exist, that was no guarantee."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We can't keep running away forever, but there's no safe place...!
entries.literal: "We can't keep running away forever, but there's no safe place...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I froze, trying to think, but my nerves prevented me from doing so. There was nothing we could do but keep running to escape from Sai.
entries.literal: "I froze, trying to think, but my nerves prevented me from doing so. There was nothing we could do but keep running to escape from Sai."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Another Sekimeiya could be somewhere, but we can't enter any of the rooms to find it, or we could be backing ourselves into a dead end...
entries.literal: "Another Sekimeiya could be somewhere, but we can't enter any of the rooms to find it, or we could be backing ourselves into a dead end..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The intense sound of Sai's footsteps hadn't been audible since we'd arrived on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "The intense sound of Sai's footsteps hadn't been audible since we'd arrived on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's go. I don't know where, but we should at least be in a hallway to see him coming.
entries.literal: "Let's go. I don't know where, but we should at least be in a hallway to see him coming."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hallway B door hadn't been closed. We rushed to it, but that thoughtless action immediately proved to be a critical mistake.
entries.literal: "The hallway B door hadn't been closed. We rushed to it, but that thoughtless action immediately proved to be a critical mistake."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...There we go.{w=0.5} You two were starting to really tire me out.
entries.literal: "...There we go.{w=0.5} You two were starting to really tire me out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as we tried to leave, Sai's body collided with mine at full speed. I was knocked down and fell by his feet.{w} When his terrifying voice made me look up, I saw the knife we'd been running from, pointed right in front of my face.
entries.literal: "As soon as we tried to leave, Sai's body collided with mine at full speed. I was knocked down and fell by his feet.{w} When his terrifying voice made me look up, I saw the knife we'd been running from, pointed right in front of my face."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai... what the fuck are you doing!?
entries.literal: "Sai... what the fuck are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew I couldn't run away. Behind me, I could feel Shiroya's trembling legs. She still had the chance to escape, but the shaking of her body ruled that out.
entries.literal: "I knew I couldn't run away. Behind me, I could feel Shiroya's trembling legs. She still had the chance to escape, but the shaking of her body ruled that out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Tell me, Atsuki. What do you think I'm doing?
entries.literal: "Tell me, Atsuki. What do you think I'm doing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His face shifted into an unsettling smile while he slowly brought the knife closer to me.
entries.literal: "His face shifted into an unsettling smile while he slowly brought the knife closer to me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Please, stop! Wh-Why do you want to kill us!?
entries.literal: "Please, stop! Wh-Why do you want to kill us!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: "Us"? Don't worry, I was only chasing Atsuki. I'm not gonna be the one to kill you.
entries.literal: "\"Us\"? Don't worry, I was only chasing Atsuki. I'm not gonna be the one to kill you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Do you mean... someone else will?
entries.literal: "Do you mean... someone else will?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Precisely.
entries.literal: "Precisely."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shut the fuck up! There's no way she'll die!
entries.literal: "Shut the fuck up! There's no way she'll die!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh... I guess you haven't seen it? I thought for sure you had.
entries.literal: "Oh... I guess you haven't seen it? I thought for sure you had."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.literal: "Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me make it clear for you: Shiroya's fate is death. She is close to dying, and I will be the cause behind it if I have to be.
entries.literal: "Let me make it clear for you: Shiroya's fate is death. She is close to dying, and I will be the cause behind it if I have to be."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Unfortunately, you won't get to see it. You brought this upon yourself for being so fucking stupid.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, you won't get to see it. You brought this upon yourself for being so fucking stupid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The knife seemed to grow bigger as it approached me. Was I truly about to die, without understanding anything, in that pathetic position...?
entries.literal: "The knife seemed to grow bigger as it approached me. Was I truly about to die, without understanding anything, in that pathetic position...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait! Stop!
entries.literal: "Wait! Stop!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Tell me, at least! Why do you want to kill me!?
entries.literal: "Tell me, at least! Why do you want to kill me!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started to use my arms to drag myself backward. Sai followed my movements with his knife, his expression growing absent.
entries.literal: "I started to use my arms to drag myself backward. Sai followed my movements with his knife, his expression growing absent."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Answer me!
entries.literal: "Answer me!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No, just let him go! He hasn't done anything!
entries.literal: "No, just let him go! He hasn't done anything!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You stay right there.
entries.literal: "You stay right there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For the first time, Sai's voice wavered.
entries.literal: "For the first time, Sai's voice wavered."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Why...? Did he realize something?
entries.literal: "Why...? Did he realize something?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, he stared at my eyes with the most incensed and serious expression I'd seen on him.
entries.literal: "Then, he stared at my eyes with the most incensed and serious expression I'd seen on him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'll ask again: why do you think?
entries.literal: "I'll ask again: why do you think?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know! That's why I'm asking!
entries.literal: "I don't know! That's why I'm asking!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued to move back, and he stopped following me. When I'd separated myself enough from him, I stood up, but I couldn't run away. I'd ended up in the corner of the room, and there was no real method of getting around him.
entries.literal: "I continued to move back, and he stopped following me. When I'd separated myself enough from him, I stood up, but I couldn't run away. I'd ended up in the corner of the room, and there was no real method of getting around him."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you okay...?
entries.literal: "Are you okay...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded uncertainly. Keeping her eyes on Sai, she walked up to me, abandoning any remaining chance of fleeing. Sai at least appeared not to be an immediate threat to Shiroya, so I didn't tell her to stay back.
entries.literal: "I nodded uncertainly. Keeping her eyes on Sai, she walked up to me, abandoning any remaining chance of fleeing. Sai at least appeared not to be an immediate threat to Shiroya, so I didn't tell her to stay back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I looked at Sai with a clearer mind, I saw something of importance that stood out: there was a bit of blood in his mouth. Immediately, I associated it with the drops we'd found.
entries.literal: "When I looked at Sai with a clearer mind, I saw something of importance that stood out: there was a bit of blood in his mouth. Immediately, I associated it with the drops we'd found."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Why is your mouth bleeding? When did that happen?
entries.literal: "...Why is your mouth bleeding? When did that happen?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After looking down for a few seconds, he lifted his head back up, regaining his imposing aura.
entries.literal: "After looking down for a few seconds, he lifted his head back up, regaining his imposing aura."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you laughing at me?
entries.literal: "Are you laughing at me?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...? No, why?
entries.literal: "What...? No, why?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: To answer your question, not more than thirty minutes ago.
entries.literal: "To answer your question, not more than thirty minutes ago."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: O-Oh.
entries.literal: "O-Oh."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was that supposed to mean something? The way he said it made it sound like he wanted to convey something more.
entries.literal: "Was that supposed to mean something? The way he said it made it sound like he wanted to convey something more."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I thought you might've left some blood behind, like that drop, for example.
entries.literal: "...I thought you might've left some blood behind, like that drop, for example."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pointed at the floor, where the fully dried-up drop was.
entries.literal: "I pointed at the floor, where the fully dried-up drop was."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know where that came from, but it's not mine. That has been here for longer than thirty minutes.
entries.literal: "I don't know where that came from, but it's not mine. That has been here for longer than thirty minutes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I thought so...{w} Have you stopped trying to kill me...? I don't understand what you're doing.
entries.literal: "I thought so...{w} Have you stopped trying to kill me...? I don't understand what you're doing."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Shut up.
entries.literal: "Shut up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unable to feel completely relieved, Shiroya and I glanced at each other. Had Sai been trying to kill me for something he thought I did? His murderous intent previously seemed incredibly determined, but my own bewilderment caused it to diminish out of nowhere.
entries.literal: "Unable to feel completely relieved, Shiroya and I glanced at each other. Had Sai been trying to kill me for something he thought I did? His murderous intent previously seemed incredibly determined, but my own bewilderment caused it to diminish out of nowhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Pensively, Sai glanced around the room. Suddenly, in visible shock, his whole body went one step backward.
entries.literal: "Pensively, Sai glanced around the room. Suddenly, in visible shock, his whole body went one step backward."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did something happen...?
entries.literal: "Did something happen...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, tell me something. What time do you think it is?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, tell me something. What time do you think it is?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Uh... Right now... it should be around {time=17:40.}
entries.literal: "Uh... Right now... it should be around {time=17:40.}"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right. My watch says it's {time=17:41}, and I'm sure it's correct.
entries.literal: "You're right. My watch says it's {time=17:41}, and I'm sure it's correct."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Does that tell you anything?
entries.literal: "...Does that tell you anything?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose so, but I'm not sure what.
entries.literal: "I suppose so, but I'm not sure what."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What the fuck...? Did he think I'd say an incorrect time?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...? Did he think I'd say an incorrect time?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Do you know where Akaro is?
entries.literal: "Do you know where Akaro is?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That son of a bitch? No idea.
entries.literal: "That son of a bitch? No idea."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did something happen between you two? You escaped the bedroom together. How did you do it?
entries.literal: "Did something happen between you two? You escaped the bedroom together. How did you do it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Try to figure it out yourself. Telling you anything I've concluded wouldn't be smart. I don't think Akaro is with us anymore, though. He might be outside.
entries.literal: "Try to figure it out yourself. Telling you anything I've concluded wouldn't be smart. I don't think Akaro is with us anymore, though. He might be outside."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What? Using the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "What? Using the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, most likely.
entries.literal: "Yes, most likely."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: A few minutes after you two left, Akaro came back to the bedroom.
entries.literal: "A few minutes after you two left, Akaro came back to the bedroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.literal: "Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes. He said he didn't remember leaving, but he disappeared again without removing the chain.
entries.literal: "Yes. He said he didn't remember leaving, but he disappeared again without removing the chain."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck?{w} Don't tell me you believed him. I knew he could try to enter from the storeroom door, but I haven't guarded it the entire time.
entries.literal: "What the fuck?{w} Don't tell me you believed him. I knew he could try to enter from the storeroom door, but I haven't guarded it the entire time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You think he entered from the outside after escaping? ...Still, he vanished, and the Sekimeiya is right here.
entries.literal: "You think he entered from the outside after escaping? ...Still, he vanished, and the Sekimeiya is right here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Show me.
entries.literal: "Show me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya went ahead and raised the curtain, which had fallen by itself at some point. As we'd seen, the Sekimeiya was behind the glass.
entries.literal: "Shiroya went ahead and raised the curtain, which had fallen by itself at some point. As we'd seen, the Sekimeiya was behind the glass."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you two put it inside?
entries.literal: "Did you two put it inside?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, a long while ago.
entries.literal: "Yes, a long while ago."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Was it in the farthest back room in hallway B? B6?
entries.literal: "...{w}Was it in the farthest back room in hallway B? B6?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about it again. The origin of that Sekimeiya still didn't make sense.
entries.literal: "I thought about it again. The origin of that Sekimeiya still didn't make sense."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Where?
entries.literal: "Where?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: First, it was on the floor. We used it, but when we came back, we couldn't find it. Then we found it inside a drawer in the same room.
entries.literal: "First, it was on the floor. We used it, but when we came back, we couldn't find it. Then we found it inside a drawer in the same room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Huh. I see.{w} It teleported there after you used it... I get it.
entries.literal: "...{w}Huh. I see.{w} It teleported there after you used it... I get it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How did you know we found it in that room?
entries.literal: "How did you know we found it in that room?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I just remembered that it could have been there. Now, let me pass.
entries.literal: "I just remembered that it could have been there. Now, let me pass."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Move away.
entries.literal: "Move away."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you want the Sekimeiya? Do you have the key?
entries.literal: "Do you want the Sekimeiya? Do you have the key?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Shut up and move away.
entries.literal: "Shut up and move away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't decipher his intent. His voice had changed completely, and he sounded as if we were the present threat instead of him, keeping him away from the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I couldn't decipher his intent. His voice had changed completely, and he sounded as if we were the present threat instead of him, keeping him away from the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You just wanted to kill me! Why would we let you use the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "You just wanted to kill me! Why would we let you use the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you really this dense? I have a knife.
entries.literal: "Are you really this dense? I have a knife."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's a fair point. Are you going to kill us if we don't step aside?
entries.literal: "That's a fair point. Are you going to kill us if we don't step aside?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no determination in that threat. For some reason, everything murderous about him was gone.
entries.literal: "There was no determination in that threat. For some reason, everything murderous about him was gone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Where did you even get that knife!? Did you kill Katei and Erina?
entries.literal: "Where did you even get that knife!? Did you kill Katei and Erina?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No. I haven't killed anyone.
entries.literal: "No. I haven't killed anyone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't lie. You have a knife which was definitely used to kill Erina.{w} You're trying to trick us, aren't you? You used the Sekimeiya to escape the tower, and then you entered again through the storeroom with that knife that you brought from the outside.{w} You traveled from the hallway B room, which is how you knew we found the Sekimeiya there.{w} The state we saw Akaro in... did you do that?
entries.literal: "Don't lie. You have a knife which was definitely used to kill Erina.{w} You're trying to trick us, aren't you? You used the Sekimeiya to escape the tower, and then you entered again through the storeroom with that knife that you brought from the outside.{w} You traveled from the hallway B room, which is how you knew we found the Sekimeiya there.{w} The state we saw Akaro in... did you do that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Regarding where I found this knife... I just did. I'm not gonna tell you where, but I found it inside this building, poorly hidden.
entries.literal: "Regarding where I found this knife... I just did. I'm not gonna tell you where, but I found it inside this building, poorly hidden."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...? And you mean to tell us that we never found it before?
entries.literal: "What...? And you mean to tell us that we never found it before?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Listen, here's a good question for you. I've seen Katei's and Erina's corpses. If I killed them, how come there's no blood on my clothes?
entries.literal: "Listen, here's a good question for you. I've seen Katei's and Erina's corpses. If I killed them, how come there's no blood on my clothes?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was taken aback. He was right: blood would've splashed onto the killer's clothes after killing both of them, but Sai's were completely clean.
entries.literal: "I was taken aback. He was right: blood would've splashed onto the killer's clothes after killing both of them, but Sai's were completely clean."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, a needle pierced my heart when I remembered something. ...The Shiroya who'd changed clothes.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, a needle pierced my heart when I remembered something. ...The Shiroya who'd changed clothes."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That doesn't mean anything. If you used the Sekimeiya to travel back in time after you killed them, it would have given you clean clothes from a past point, and the stained ones would have disappeared forever.
entries.literal: "That doesn't mean anything. If you used the Sekimeiya to travel back in time after you killed them, it would have given you clean clothes from a past point, and the stained ones would have disappeared forever."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...She's right. You could've easily gotten rid of them like that.
entries.literal: "...She's right. You could've easily gotten rid of them like that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Heh... That's wrong.
entries.literal: "Heh... That's wrong."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What is?
entries.literal: "What is?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What you two just said... is wrong.{w} However, I didn't have to get rid of any clothes, seeing as I didn't kill anyone.
entries.literal: "What you two just said... is wrong.{w} However, I didn't have to get rid of any clothes, seeing as I didn't kill anyone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What exactly are we wrong about?
entries.literal: "What exactly are we wrong about?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: As I said before, telling you anything wouldn't be smart.
entries.literal: "As I said before, telling you anything wouldn't be smart."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were we wrong? ...About what?{w} His clothes still had very faint traces of the smoke on them. If he had traveled outside the tower and then entered from the storeroom, there would've been no smoke on them. ...Was that wrong as well?
entries.literal: "Were we wrong? ...About what?{w} His clothes still had very faint traces of the smoke on them. If he had traveled outside the tower and then entered from the storeroom, there would've been no smoke on them. ...Was that wrong as well?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know how to object. After Katei and Erina died, it was unlikely anyone activated the Sekimeiya. How had it appeared inside the drawer? Either it teleported there, or someone deliberately left it inside. Going off how clumsily that drawer was shut, the latter sounded a lot more plausible.
entries.literal: "I didn't know how to object. After Katei and Erina died, it was unlikely anyone activated the Sekimeiya. How had it appeared inside the drawer? Either it teleported there, or someone deliberately left it inside. Going off how clumsily that drawer was shut, the latter sounded a lot more plausible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Regardless, it was still shut, so nobody could have traveled after leaving the Sekimeiya there. The window for that explanation was incredibly tight—it had to have happened before that point or after the present time if the Sai we were talking to was the result of an upcoming time travel.{w} We also couldn't rule out the possibility that someone took the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, used it, and placed it back inside.
entries.literal: "Regardless, it was still shut, so nobody could have traveled after leaving the Sekimeiya there. The window for that explanation was incredibly tight—it had to have happened before that point or after the present time if the Sai we were talking to was the result of an upcoming time travel.{w} We also couldn't rule out the possibility that someone took the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, used it, and placed it back inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Anyway, I wouldn't want to kill you two now since there's more stuff I want to think about. I'd still get out of my way if I were you, though.
entries.literal: "...Anyway, I wouldn't want to kill you two now since there's more stuff I want to think about. I'd still get out of my way if I were you, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You definitely have the key for the cabinet, right? You took it from the bedroom before escaping... Does that mean that Akaro never had it? It doesn't sound as if you two got along too well despite leaving together.
entries.literal: "You definitely have the key for the cabinet, right? You took it from the bedroom before escaping... Does that mean that Akaro never had it? It doesn't sound as if you two got along too well despite leaving together."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, overcome your stupidity and move. Do you want to put her in danger?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, overcome your stupidity and move. Do you want to put her in danger?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't want to move either. Giving the Sekimeiya to you can't be a good idea no matter what.
entries.literal: "I don't want to move either. Giving the Sekimeiya to you can't be a good idea no matter what."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I have a knife, for the love of God! You were scared out of your minds running away before. Where did your balls come from?
entries.literal: "I have a knife, for the love of God! You were scared out of your minds running away before. Where did your balls come from?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: At this point, I'm pretty sure that you don't intend to use it.
entries.literal: "At this point, I'm pretty sure that you don't intend to use it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's lips curved into a grin.{w} Then, he kneeled and left the knife on the floor.
entries.literal: "Sai's lips curved into a grin.{w} Then, he kneeled and left the knife on the floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right, let's play your game then.
entries.literal: "All right, let's play your game then."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What game?
entries.literal: "What game?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You two don't understand anything. You think you do, and it's laughable.{w} Right. I don't want to use my knife because overpowering you physically right now would be a loss. I'll have to go one step further and show you how pathetic your resistance is.
entries.literal: "You two don't understand anything. You think you do, and it's laughable.{w} Right. I don't want to use my knife because overpowering you physically right now would be a loss. I'll have to go one step further and show you how pathetic your resistance is."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without abandoning his unsettling smirk, he dashed out of the room, toward hallway B.
entries.literal: "Without abandoning his unsettling smirk, he dashed out of the room, toward hallway B."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't understand anything, but Sai had a plan. Given what had happened the previous time, I hesitated to chase after him, but I immediately realized that was a mistake.{w} To prevent him from completely leaving our line of sight, I sprinted toward the door and looked down the hallway.
entries.literal: "I didn't understand anything, but Sai had a plan. Given what had happened the previous time, I hesitated to chase after him, but I immediately realized that was a mistake.{w} To prevent him from completely leaving our line of sight, I sprinted toward the door and looked down the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I got there, the loud noise of a door being slammed boomed out. By the time I arrived, all I saw was a bunch of closed doors with no indication of which one had created the noise.
entries.literal: "Before I got there, the loud noise of a door being slammed boomed out. By the time I arrived, all I saw was a bunch of closed doors with no indication of which one had created the noise."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...He has to be inside one of them. No way he had time to get to hallway C or the lobby.
entries.literal: "...He has to be inside one of them. No way he had time to get to hallway C or the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Going off what he said, I figured he would have created that noise to lure us out and make us mistakenly think that he was still in the hallway, but that couldn't be it—with such a brief window of time, he was definitely in one of those rooms.
entries.literal: "Going off what he said, I figured he would have created that noise to lure us out and make us mistakenly think that he was still in the hallway, but that couldn't be it—with such a brief window of time, he was definitely in one of those rooms."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: He must think we'll search for him, but he has something in mind... Do you want this just in case?
entries.literal: "He must think we'll search for him, but he has something in mind... Do you want this just in case?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya had retrieved the knife from the floor. I understood her proposition, but I declined it.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had retrieved the knife from the floor. I understood her proposition, but I declined it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If he wanted to harm us, he would've done so just now. He wants to trick us somehow.
entries.literal: "If he wanted to harm us, he would've done so just now. He wants to trick us somehow."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But how...? He's in one of the rooms, so how would he be able to do anything?
entries.literal: "But how...? He's in one of the rooms, so how would he be able to do anything?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: His goal was clearly to open the Sekimeiya cabinet, so there's a very simple way.
entries.literal: "His goal was clearly to open the Sekimeiya cabinet, so there's a very simple way."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It seems he understands how the Sekimeiya works better than us... and it's still possible another one exists.{w} If he entered the room where he knew the other Sekimeiya was, he could've gone back to the past. Maybe he thought both of us would chase behind him and he could immediately enter the event room from hallway A.{w} That's why it should be fine if you stay here, looking at the hallway. I'll open the doors while you make sure Sai doesn't leave and nobody enters from the other side.
entries.literal: "It seems he understands how the Sekimeiya works better than us... and it's still possible another one exists.{w} If he entered the room where he knew the other Sekimeiya was, he could've gone back to the past. Maybe he thought both of us would chase behind him and he could immediately enter the event room from hallway A.{w} That's why it should be fine if you stay here, looking at the hallway. I'll open the doors while you make sure Sai doesn't leave and nobody enters from the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya walked back and closed the hallway A door, hindering any entrance. She nodded, knowing we couldn't just ignore him.
entries.literal: "Shiroya walked back and closed the hallway A door, hindering any entrance. She nodded, knowing we couldn't just ignore him."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Just watch out, okay? He dropped the knife to bait us into following him. He sounded pretty confident, and knowing Sai, he's got some plan...
entries.literal: "Just watch out, okay? He dropped the knife to bait us into following him. He sounded pretty confident, and knowing Sai, he's got some plan..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know... I'll be careful, but he still has to be here, and it's important to find him. Even though he gave it to us, the fact is we have his knife. If we find him, we can keep him in one place until we're out of here.
entries.literal: "I know... I'll be careful, but he still has to be here, and it's important to find him. Even though he gave it to us, the fact is we have his knife. If we find him, we can keep him in one place until we're out of here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She agreed. I stepped out of the room, glancing around me as I put my shoes on. I was absolutely certain that one of the closed doors hid Sai behind it.
entries.literal: "She agreed. I stepped out of the room, glancing around me as I put my shoes on. I was absolutely certain that one of the closed doors hid Sai behind it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With how fast everything happened, it was also likely he hadn't gone to any room on the extremes of the hallway. However, I started with those to rule them out.
entries.literal: "With how fast everything happened, it was also likely he hadn't gone to any room on the extremes of the hallway. However, I started with those to rule them out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On full alert, I turned the doorknob of the cleaning room and pushed the door open.
entries.literal: "On full alert, I turned the doorknob of the cleaning room and pushed the door open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The empty space came into view, still missing the cart that used to occupy much of it. I knew he could've used a Sekimeiya to escape, so I briefly searched around for it. There were some shelves and buckets, but I doubted something as big as the Sekimeiya could be hidden there.
entries.literal: "The empty space came into view, still missing the cart that used to occupy much of it. I knew he could've used a Sekimeiya to escape, so I briefly searched around for it. There were some shelves and buckets, but I doubted something as big as the Sekimeiya could be hidden there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before moving on, I saw something.{w} On top of one shelf, there was a key.
entries.literal: "Before moving on, I saw something.{w} On top of one shelf, there was a key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surprised, I jumped to grab it. In my hand was a small key I hadn't seen before, so I put it in my pocket.
entries.literal: "Surprised, I jumped to grab it. In my hand was a small key I hadn't seen before, so I put it in my pocket."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I don't get it... This room has been searched before with the intention of finding the Sekimeiya, right? How come this key was never found?
entries.literal: "I don't get it... This room has been searched before with the intention of finding the Sekimeiya, right? How come this key was never found?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was no time to wonder that, so I exited as soon as I determined nothing else was hidden out of sight.
entries.literal: "It was no time to wonder that, so I exited as soon as I determined nothing else was hidden out of sight."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room in front of me, B6, was where we'd found the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "The room in front of me, B6, was where we'd found the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered it and looked in every cabinet and drawer. All of them were empty.
entries.literal: "I entered it and looked in every cabinet and drawer. All of them were empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I set foot in the staff room, I remembered that a complete search couldn't be performed. What if Sai could open one of the lockers?
entries.literal: "As soon as I set foot in the staff room, I remembered that a complete search couldn't be performed. What if Sai could open one of the lockers?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait, no. That's fine.
entries.literal: "Wait, no. That's fine."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: They can't be locked from the inside. Although they're big enough to contain a person, if Sai had the brilliant idea to hide in one, it must currently be unlocked.
entries.literal: "They can't be locked from the inside. Although they're big enough to contain a person, if Sai had the brilliant idea to hide in one, it must currently be unlocked."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And if he used a Sekimeiya that he hid inside one, he needed to unlock it first. So after traveling, it would remain unlocked...
entries.literal: "And if he used a Sekimeiya that he hid inside one, he needed to unlock it first. So after traveling, it would remain unlocked..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to try opening every single one. The higher compartments had three narrow slits I could barely put my fingers through. I used them to try pulling the doors toward me, sure that they'd open if they were unlocked.
entries.literal: "I had to try opening every single one. The higher compartments had three narrow slits I could barely put my fingers through. I used them to try pulling the doors toward me, sure that they'd open if they were unlocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One locker opened: Naomi's. Only her coat was inside, and I made sure its pockets were empty. After that, no more doors budged.
entries.literal: "One locker opened: Naomi's. Only her coat was inside, and I made sure its pockets were empty. After that, no more doors budged."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Not here either...{w} Unless he used the Sekimeiya and then it teleported itself away like he said happened earlier...
entries.literal: "Not here either...{w} Unless he used the Sekimeiya and then it teleported itself away like he said happened earlier..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the following crystal room, and after the same quick search, I confirmed neither Sai nor the Sekimeiya were inside.
entries.literal: "I entered the following crystal room, and after the same quick search, I confirmed neither Sai nor the Sekimeiya were inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the event room, Shiroya let me know that nothing had happened on her end. She was looking at hallway B to prevent Sai's escape while paying very close attention to the door behind her.
entries.literal: "From the event room, Shiroya let me know that nothing had happened on her end. She was looking at hallway B to prevent Sai's escape while paying very close attention to the door behind her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps Sai could enter from it at any time, make it to the cabinet faster than Shiroya, and then overpower her. However, he willingly gave up his knife, and that was his best opportunity to do so.
entries.literal: "Perhaps Sai could enter from it at any time, make it to the cabinet faster than Shiroya, and then overpower her. However, he willingly gave up his knife, and that was his best opportunity to do so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, I entered room B4. It exuded a sinister aura, exhibiting Naomi's and Erina's deaths. Trying to ignore my sudden heartache, I inspected every cabinet where Sai or the Sekimeiya could be.{w} As usual, they were all empty.
entries.literal: "Next, I entered room B4. It exuded a sinister aura, exhibiting Naomi's and Erina's deaths. Trying to ignore my sudden heartache, I inspected every cabinet where Sai or the Sekimeiya could be.{w} As usual, they were all empty."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Just three more... We have to find something in one of these.
entries.literal: "Just three more... We have to find something in one of these."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued by entering the room on my left. At first glance, it was another empty crystal room where nothing of importance had occurred.
entries.literal: "I continued by entering the room on my left. At first glance, it was another empty crystal room where nothing of importance had occurred."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After looking through every cabinet, that sensation hadn't changed: yet again, a few spare gems were all I was able to find inside them.
entries.literal: "After looking through every cabinet, that sensation hadn't changed: yet again, a few spare gems were all I was able to find inside them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the same in the next one. It was full of uninteresting cabinets storing nothing but air and gemstones.
entries.literal: "It was the same in the next one. It was full of uninteresting cabinets storing nothing but air and gemstones."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's only one more... Could it be we left the correct one for the end?
entries.literal: "There's only one more... Could it be we left the correct one for the end?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya looked unsure. She was constantly glancing behind her while giving Sai no time to escape hallway B.
entries.literal: "Shiroya looked unsure. She was constantly glancing behind her while giving Sai no time to escape hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door and stepped into the last crystal room. Nothing appeared different from the others. To prevent a sudden attack, I'd been getting used to immediately looking behind the doors. That first step was completed without an issue.
entries.literal: "I opened the door and stepped into the last crystal room. Nothing appeared different from the others. To prevent a sudden attack, I'd been getting used to immediately looking behind the doors. That first step was completed without an issue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those cabinets were the sole remaining places where Sai could be. Starting from the right ones, I uncovered their lids one by one, progressively narrowing down the last options.
entries.literal: "Those cabinets were the sole remaining places where Sai could be. Starting from the right ones, I uncovered their lids one by one, progressively narrowing down the last options."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And when I opened the last one, it was finally confirmed: Sai wasn't anywhere.
entries.literal: "And when I opened the last one, it was finally confirmed: Sai wasn't anywhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Feeling defeated, I returned to hallway B and rejoined Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Feeling defeated, I returned to hallway B and rejoined Shiroya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't get it... There's not much he could've done.
entries.literal: "I don't get it... There's not much he could've done."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: He said the Sekimeiya could teleport itself after being used. Maybe that's why you didn't find it.
entries.literal: "He said the Sekimeiya could teleport itself after being used. Maybe that's why you didn't find it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But... do you think that's what he did?
entries.literal: "But... do you think that's what he did?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I mean, I've searched enough to be sure that he isn't in any of these rooms, but there might be a very good spot I've missed where he hid the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I mean, I've searched enough to be sure that he isn't in any of these rooms, but there might be a very good spot I've missed where he hid the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But why would he do that? Does he really want to get his hands on the Sekimeiya in the cabinet when he knew where another one was?
entries.literal: "But why would he do that? Does he really want to get his hands on the Sekimeiya in the cabinet when he knew where another one was?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And was his plan simply to use it, lure us out while he trusted his hiding spot, and enter the event room from hallway A? There's no way, right?
entries.literal: "And was his plan simply to use it, lure us out while he trusted his hiding spot, and enter the event room from hallway A? There's no way, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Probably not... He knew one of us would stay here.
entries.literal: "Probably not... He knew one of us would stay here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. He left his knife behind to make us chase after him, but there's no way he thought both of us would go.
entries.literal: "Yeah. He left his knife behind to make us chase after him, but there's no way he thought both of us would go."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Do you think he had time to go to hallway C or the lobby?
entries.literal: "Do you think he had time to go to hallway C or the lobby?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He wasn't very fast when he was chasing us, and I doubt he faked his speed just for this... I suppose we can't completely rule it out, but I didn't hear his footsteps in the distance.
entries.literal: "He wasn't very fast when he was chasing us, and I doubt he faked his speed just for this... I suppose we can't completely rule it out, but I didn't hear his footsteps in the distance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whatever Sai was planning... we had to stop it. He might've given up on killing us, but nothing guaranteed he hadn't simply held off on it after realizing something important.
entries.literal: "Whatever Sai was planning... we had to stop it. He might've given up on killing us, but nothing guaranteed he hadn't simply held off on it after realizing something important."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We need to search hallway A, but the lobby and hallway C are a problem.{w} Wait here, watching over this hallway and the other door like you were doing. I'll be back in a second.
entries.literal: "We need to search hallway A, but the lobby and hallway C are a problem.{w} Wait here, watching over this hallway and the other door like you were doing. I'll be back in a second."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.literal: "...Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took off toward the lobby. Nobody was there, and I made sure to check that Sai wasn't behind the columns and couch. It was unlikely for him to hide in the mechanical room, but I had to look.
entries.literal: "I took off toward the lobby. Nobody was there, and I made sure to check that Sai wasn't behind the columns and couch. It was unlikely for him to hide in the mechanical room, but I had to look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door and headed down the stairs. It was going to be hard to conclude that nobody was hiding with the provided light, but I had to do it. If nothing else, I felt like I didn't have to be scared of sudden physical attacks.
entries.literal: "I opened the door and headed down the stairs. It was going to be hard to conclude that nobody was hiding with the provided light, but I had to do it. If nothing else, I felt like I didn't have to be scared of sudden physical attacks."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After some time, I was sure the room was uninhabited, and I didn't see the Sekimeiya either.
entries.literal: "After some time, I was sure the room was uninhabited, and I didn't see the Sekimeiya either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I headed back up, knowing what I'd do next.
entries.literal: "I headed back up, knowing what I'd do next."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of joining Shiroya through hallway B, I entered hallway A and opened the door to the event room.
entries.literal: "Instead of joining Shiroya through hallway B, I entered hallway A and opened the door to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It startled her, but she quickly realized it was me.
entries.literal: "It startled her, but she quickly realized it was me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait, don't come over. The lobby is empty, and from here, I can see hallway A, the event room, and the way to the other floors...
entries.literal: "Wait, don't come over. The lobby is empty, and from here, I can see hallway A, the event room, and the way to the other floors..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do what I did from the other side. Check the bathrooms and come here through hallway A. If you do that, we'll have successfully isolated this hallway, and we'll be able to make sure nobody enters from floor 2.
entries.literal: "Do what I did from the other side. Check the bathrooms and come here through hallway A. If you do that, we'll have successfully isolated this hallway, and we'll be able to make sure nobody enters from floor 2."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Got it.
entries.literal: "Got it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She disappeared from view, walking toward hallway C. For some seconds, I did what she'd been doing earlier: keep track of the event room and the hallway simultaneously.
entries.literal: "She disappeared from view, walking toward hallway C. For some seconds, I did what she'd been doing earlier: keep track of the event room and the hallway simultaneously."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as she appeared from hallway C, I could stop focusing on the event room because nobody could've been behind us. I knew not to lower my guard, though, given Sai's evident confidence.
entries.literal: "As soon as she appeared from hallway C, I could stop focusing on the event room because nobody could've been behind us. I knew not to lower my guard, though, given Sai's evident confidence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw her trying to open the elevator door, but it wasn't there. Then, she sprinted toward me.
entries.literal: "I saw her trying to open the elevator door, but it wasn't there. Then, she sprinted toward me."

entries.speaker: s
