entries.text: ...He wasn't in the bathrooms. I didn't find the Sekimeiya either.
entries.literal: "...He wasn't in the bathrooms. I didn't find the Sekimeiya either."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, if he's still on this floor, he has to be inside a room in this hallway.{w} We'll do the same thing, then.
entries.literal: "So, if he's still on this floor, he has to be inside a room in this hallway.{w} We'll do the same thing, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya came to my side, where she would stand while I entered every remaining room.
entries.literal: "Shiroya came to my side, where she would stand while I entered every remaining room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That was, until a sound made us turn around.
entries.literal: "...That was, until a sound made us turn around."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right.{w} What are you doing over there? Searching for me?
entries.literal: "All right.{w} What are you doing over there? Searching for me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Next to the cabinet, Sai stood, the Sekimeiya between his hands. He hadn't teleported yet, and he was covering his skin under his shirt.
entries.literal: "...Next to the cabinet, Sai stood, the Sekimeiya between his hands. He hadn't teleported yet, and he was covering his skin under his shirt."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a smile, he closed the glass and let go of the curtain.
entries.literal: "With a smile, he closed the glass and let go of the curtain."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck...? What did you just do?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...? What did you just do?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me make something clear. If you try to approach me, I'll touch it immediately, and I'll disappear. Even though I'd go just a bit back in time, that's all I need.
entries.literal: "Let me make something clear. If you try to approach me, I'll touch it immediately, and I'll disappear. Even though I'd go just a bit back in time, that's all I need."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...All you need for what? You'd leave the Sekimeiya with us.
entries.literal: "...All you need for what? You'd leave the Sekimeiya with us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't care about that. I've definitely thought about what I'm doing, don't worry.
entries.literal: "I don't care about that. I've definitely thought about what I'm doing, don't worry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though it wasn't visible, as soon as he'd gotten the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, it started to build up time and energy. I was able to see the cabinet key in his other hand, explaining how he'd been able to get it open so easily.
entries.literal: "Even though it wasn't visible, as soon as he'd gotten the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, it started to build up time and energy. I was able to see the cabinet key in his other hand, explaining how he'd been able to get it open so easily."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's with those faces? Are you that surprised to see me again?
entries.literal: "What's with those faces? Are you that surprised to see me again?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't be silly. You weren't in hallway B. You probably just traveled from the future and arrived someplace I'd already investigated.
entries.literal: "Don't be silly. You weren't in hallway B. You probably just traveled from the future and arrived someplace I'd already investigated."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But I didn't do that at all. I haven't touched the Sekimeiya once since I last talked with you.
entries.literal: "But I didn't do that at all. I haven't touched the Sekimeiya once since I last talked with you."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't lie. You had the other Sekimeiya hidden somewhere, and you activated it to go back to the past. You'll touch it again in the future, and you'll appear in one of the hallway B rooms I just checked. Maybe you just traveled some seconds into the past from one room to the other, making it all more simple. Am I wrong?
entries.literal: "Don't lie. You had the other Sekimeiya hidden somewhere, and you activated it to go back to the past. You'll touch it again in the future, and you'll appear in one of the hallway B rooms I just checked. Maybe you just traveled some seconds into the past from one room to the other, making it all more simple. Am I wrong?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Didn't I just tell you that? Yes.
entries.literal: "Didn't I just tell you that? Yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I also just said what my plan relies on: I must go back to the past, but I don't need to go too far. If I had another Sekimeiya hidden, what would the point of using this one be? I would just go back to the past with the other one I have, right?
entries.literal: "I also just said what my plan relies on: I must go back to the past, but I don't need to go too far. If I had another Sekimeiya hidden, what would the point of using this one be? I would just go back to the past with the other one I have, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is an actual question. If I know where another Sekimeiya is like you say, why would I not simply use that one?
entries.literal: "This is an actual question. If I know where another Sekimeiya is like you say, why would I not simply use that one?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know! But enlighten us, how come you weren't anywhere if you didn't use the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "I don't know! But enlighten us, how come you weren't anywhere if you didn't use the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, are you just trying to be funny? You said you haven't touched the Sekimeiya, but you simply got caught up in the range of a travel you knew you'd create after traveling, right? So you didn't actually "touch" it.
entries.literal: "Oh, are you just trying to be funny? You said you haven't touched the Sekimeiya, but you simply got caught up in the range of a travel you knew you'd create after traveling, right? So you didn't actually \"touch\" it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You just jumped ten steps too far, Atsuki. It's baffling how easy it is to trick you.{w} I really just relied on a trick I felt could work, which you might discover eventually.
entries.literal: "You just jumped ten steps too far, Atsuki. It's baffling how easy it is to trick you.{w} I really just relied on a trick I felt could work, which you might discover eventually."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What trick!?
entries.literal: "...What trick!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't feel like telling you. Take my word for it, though—I did not travel with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I don't feel like telling you. Take my word for it, though—I did not travel with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's no way. You weren't in hallway B. Your only way out was going to the past.
entries.literal: "There's no way. You weren't in hallway B. Your only way out was going to the past."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh*{w} Aren't you missing a really easy way I could've escaped?
entries.literal: "*sigh*{w} Aren't you missing a really easy way I could've escaped?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Fine, I'll tell you. I don't need her cooperation any longer.
entries.literal: "Fine, I'll tell you. I don't need her cooperation any longer."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sorry, Shiroya, I'm nullifying our deal. Atsuki deserves to know what happened.{w} It was simple. Atsuki, the first room you went to was the cleaning room, right? You were close—I was in the staff room.{w} The moment you entered it, I left. In the hallway, Shiroya winked at me and let me escape. I feel awful keeping you in the dark, honestly.
entries.literal: "Sorry, Shiroya, I'm nullifying our deal. Atsuki deserves to know what happened.{w} It was simple. Atsuki, the first room you went to was the cleaning room, right? You were close—I was in the staff room.{w} The moment you entered it, I left. In the hallway, Shiroya winked at me and let me escape. I feel awful keeping you in the dark, honestly."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What are you talking about!? Why would I let you go!?
entries.literal: "What are you talking about!? Why would I let you go!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Feigning ignorance, huh? That's okay. You can keep lying to him for all I care.
entries.literal: "Feigning ignorance, huh? That's okay. You can keep lying to him for all I care."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're not gonna trick me, Sai. You used the Sekimeiya in some way.
entries.literal: "You're not gonna trick me, Sai. You used the Sekimeiya in some way."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: As if I'd ever side with you. You're a horrible person.
entries.literal: "As if I'd ever side with you. You're a horrible person."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That hurts. I really thought we had something going.
entries.literal: "That hurts. I really thought we had something going."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm kidding, of course. I just used my invisibility cloak. Now I'll peace out and appear somewhere in the past. After I do what I need to do, I'll show up again, so you won't have to wait too long for me. From your perspective, I'll probably enter from the door as soon as I disappear. I bet a future version of me is waiting in hallway B for his cue to enter.
entries.literal: "I'm kidding, of course. I just used my invisibility cloak. Now I'll peace out and appear somewhere in the past. After I do what I need to do, I'll show up again, so you won't have to wait too long for me. From your perspective, I'll probably enter from the door as soon as I disappear. I bet a future version of me is waiting in hallway B for his cue to enter."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Stop! What do you even need to do? You said you didn't necessarily need to travel too far back. Why not?
entries.literal: "Stop! What do you even need to do? You said you didn't necessarily need to travel too far back. Why not?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Perhaps you'll get something right for once if you keep thinking. I can definitely wait a little more.
entries.literal: "Perhaps you'll get something right for once if you keep thinking. I can definitely wait a little more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He put the cabinet key in his pocket, signaling that he could use his free hand at any time to activate the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "He put the cabinet key in his pocket, signaling that he could use his free hand at any time to activate the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Fuck! We can't let him travel. I'm not sure what he's doing, but he just has to go a few minutes back in time... He might need it to escape from us in hallway B. That must be what we're missing. He's just trying to mess with my head by accusing Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Fuck! We can't let him travel. I'm not sure what he's doing, but he just has to go a few minutes back in time... He might need it to escape from us in hallway B. That must be what we're missing. He's just trying to mess with my head by accusing Shiroya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But if that's the case, is there a point in trying to stop him? He already escaped, so he's guaranteed to succeed.
entries.literal: "But if that's the case, is there a point in trying to stop him? He already escaped, so he's guaranteed to succeed."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait, no. What am I thinking? When he took off toward hallway B, his goal was already to touch this Sekimeiya—he has another reason to use it, no matter what it is. It's still possible the travel he's about to perform will let him not be found, though.
entries.literal: "Wait, no. What am I thinking? When he took off toward hallway B, his goal was already to touch this Sekimeiya—he has another reason to use it, no matter what it is. It's still possible the travel he's about to perform will let him not be found, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I met Shiroya's eyes. She was at my right, and silently, she communicated to me that we had to stop him. He'd tried to kill me and had been holding a knife; whatever his intentions were, we had to assume they weren't great.
entries.literal: "I met Shiroya's eyes. She was at my right, and silently, she communicated to me that we had to stop him. He'd tried to kill me and had been holding a knife; whatever his intentions were, we had to assume they weren't great."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No more questions?
entries.literal: "No more questions?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stood, looking at each other. No matter how much he waited or what he said, he would never be at risk.
entries.literal: "We stood, looking at each other. No matter how much he waited or what he said, he would never be at risk."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm all ears. I might just go already, though.
entries.literal: "I'm all ears. I might just go already, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait.
entries.literal: "Wait."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to say. I was trying to think of a way to get the upper hand.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to say. I was trying to think of a way to get the upper hand."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nothing?
entries.literal: "Nothing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The seconds continued ticking, and most of them were filled with silence. Our disadvantage was too significant.
entries.literal: "The seconds continued ticking, and most of them were filled with silence. Our disadvantage was too significant."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Why are you not activating it?
entries.literal: "...Why are you not activating it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Throw me your guesses. Why am I not activating it? I had fun figuring my stuff out, but it's better if I can see how ignorant you still are.
entries.literal: "Throw me your guesses. Why am I not activating it? I had fun figuring my stuff out, but it's better if I can see how ignorant you still are."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Why is he not activating it...? He said he didn't care about traveling shortly into the past, but what else could it be?
entries.literal: "Why is he not activating it...? He said he didn't care about traveling shortly into the past, but what else could it be?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Yet again, silence engulfed us while Sai looked at ease, ready to touch the Sekimeiya at any moment.
entries.literal: "Yet again, silence engulfed us while Sai looked at ease, ready to touch the Sekimeiya at any moment."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why are you so tense? I'm doing this to take care of one little thing, and you have no way to stop me, so instead of trying to do that, you can keep displaying how much you don't get.
entries.literal: "Why are you so tense? I'm doing this to take care of one little thing, and you have no way to stop me, so instead of trying to do that, you can keep displaying how much you don't get."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I can assure you I'll accomplish what I want, so relax a bit. When I disappear, I'll show up immediately, and I won't try to do anything to the Sekimeiya. Until then, I'm not in a hurry.
entries.literal: "I can assure you I'll accomplish what I want, so relax a bit. When I disappear, I'll show up immediately, and I won't try to do anything to the Sekimeiya. Until then, I'm not in a hurry."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the hell do you want, then?
entries.literal: "What the hell do you want, then?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't you want to keep begging for my knowledge? I'm sure you're curious about a bunch of things.
entries.literal: "Don't you want to keep begging for my knowledge? I'm sure you're curious about a bunch of things."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're the one who keeps refusing to answer. I bet you're trying to feel really smart.
entries.literal: "You're the one who keeps refusing to answer. I bet you're trying to feel really smart."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right. I'm so smart that I turn myself on. That's true, though. I suppose it's not fair if I won't answer anything.{w} Remember at the beginning? I had no issues sharing my thoughts with you, but that changed at one point. There's no way you're dense enough to not know when.
entries.literal: "Right. I'm so smart that I turn myself on. That's true, though. I suppose it's not fair if I won't answer anything.{w} Remember at the beginning? I had no issues sharing my thoughts with you, but that changed at one point. There's no way you're dense enough to not know when."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What, when the Sekimeiya made me travel?
entries.literal: "What, when the Sekimeiya made me travel?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We found out we were next to a time travel device, yes. Then, keeping everything to myself became the smarter option.{w} I did not in any way suspect what the Sekimeiya would be capable of, but I was expecting something to occur. I thought I'd have to be very perceptive to understand whatever could be going on, but everything happened in front of our eyes.
entries.literal: "We found out we were next to a time travel device, yes. Then, keeping everything to myself became the smarter option.{w} I did not in any way suspect what the Sekimeiya would be capable of, but I was expecting something to occur. I thought I'd have to be very perceptive to understand whatever could be going on, but everything happened in front of our eyes."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What were you expecting? Xyn to attack?
entries.literal: "What were you expecting? Xyn to attack?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, but that was fairly obvious. However, I suppose I came across {tip=traces}traces of the Sekimeiya{/tip} some time ago.
entries.literal: "Yeah, but that was fairly obvious. However, I suppose I came across {tip=traces}traces of the Sekimeiya{/tip} some time ago."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's my answer. You were complaining I wasn't giving you any, so you have something to decipher if you please. That's a lot more fun than being straightforward for no reason.
entries.literal: "That's my answer. You were complaining I wasn't giving you any, so you have something to decipher if you please. That's a lot more fun than being straightforward for no reason."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then tell me, why did you try to kill me and then stop?
entries.literal: "Then tell me, why did you try to kill me and then stop?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not like I understand everything. I'm partly humoring you for the hell of it, but I'd also like to hear what you think. For old times' sake, give me your best deductions. Why do you think?
entries.literal: "It's not like I understand everything. I'm partly humoring you for the hell of it, but I'd also like to hear what you think. For old times' sake, give me your best deductions. Why do you think?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I told you that I have no idea! Hearing that I didn't know why you were chasing us seemed to be what made you stop, so maybe you thought I did something I actually didn't.
entries.literal: "I told you that I have no idea! Hearing that I didn't know why you were chasing us seemed to be what made you stop, so maybe you thought I did something I actually didn't."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If you're telling the truth, that's enough of an answer. I suppose I have to think of a cryptic response from my point of view.
entries.literal: "If you're telling the truth, that's enough of an answer. I suppose I have to think of a cryptic response from my point of view."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I thought you'd overstepped, but it seems I was the one who had.
entries.literal: "I thought you'd overstepped, but it seems I was the one who had."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You have no idea what I'm talking about. I understand, and it's great. I promise there's some meaning behind that, but don't think I'll be stupid enough to tell you anything undesirable.{w} Now, explain something for me. I thought about it a little, and I don't understand what you said regarding Akaro.{w} He came back up to the bedroom and opened the door with the key, which was later left in the original drawer—
entries.literal: "You have no idea what I'm talking about. I understand, and it's great. I promise there's some meaning behind that, but don't think I'll be stupid enough to tell you anything undesirable.{w} Now, explain something for me. I thought about it a little, and I don't understand what you said regarding Akaro.{w} He came back up to the bedroom and opened the door with the key, which was later left in the original drawer—"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So you really grabbed it when you were chasing us? You wanted to trap us in the bedroom.
entries.literal: "So you really grabbed it when you were chasing us? You wanted to trap us in the bedroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is very confusing. Shut up for now.
entries.literal: "This is very confusing. Shut up for now."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What exactly did he say, and how did he escape?
entries.literal: "What exactly did he say, and how did he escape?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: He said he didn't remember escaping in the first place. Then he left again, probably the same way you did.
entries.literal: "He said he didn't remember escaping in the first place. Then he left again, probably the same way you did."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left out a lot of information purposely, and I didn't think he'd used the same method, but there was no way I'd give Sai an accurate response.
entries.literal: "I left out a lot of information purposely, and I didn't think he'd used the same method, but there was no way I'd give Sai an accurate response."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But where was the key left after he escaped? You retrieved it at the end and were able to open the door, so he didn't leave it outside, right?
entries.literal: "But where was the key left after he escaped? You retrieved it at the end and were able to open the door, so he didn't leave it outside, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How intriguing. I just glossed over it when you mentioned his reappearance, but I'm not certain what to think anymore.{w} When you let him enter, you made sure he didn't have a key on his person, right?
entries.literal: "How intriguing. I just glossed over it when you mentioned his reappearance, but I'm not certain what to think anymore.{w} When you let him enter, you made sure he didn't have a key on his person, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Of course. We're not that stupid.
entries.literal: "Of course. We're not that stupid."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then, there's only one way he could've disappeared...
entries.literal: "Then, there's only one way he could've disappeared..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He let us know he wouldn't continue, but there was no doubt he was talking about the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "He let us know he wouldn't continue, but there was no doubt he was talking about the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Where did you get this knife?
entries.literal: "Where did you get this knife?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No cryptic answer needed. I was honest earlier.
entries.literal: "No cryptic answer needed. I was honest earlier."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You just found it, right?
entries.literal: "You just found it, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Good memory.
entries.literal: "Good memory."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to ask about what he'd said regarding Shiroya's fate, but I couldn't bring myself to do it with her next to me.
entries.literal: "I wanted to ask about what he'd said regarding Shiroya's fate, but I couldn't bring myself to do it with her next to me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you done?
entries.literal: "Are you done?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'll repeat an earlier question: what the fuck are you trying to do now?
entries.literal: "I'll repeat an earlier question: what the fuck are you trying to do now?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...{w} I'm just finishing off your ignorance.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} I'm just finishing off your ignorance."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How did I know you'd respond with a stupid-sounding "what"? Did you not understand I'm purposely being unclear? Being told the answer is no fun. I'm sorry if you disagree.
entries.literal: "How did I know you'd respond with a stupid-sounding \"what\"? Did you not understand I'm purposely being unclear? Being told the answer is no fun. I'm sorry if you disagree."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why would I even assume you're not being misleading?
entries.literal: "Why would I even assume you're not being misleading?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why would you assume that? Naturally, you should keep it in mind, but understanding what I'm saying and then deciding whether to trust it is what I'd advise.
entries.literal: "Why would you assume that? Naturally, you should keep it in mind, but understanding what I'm saying and then deciding whether to trust it is what I'd advise."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you not going to touch the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Are you not going to touch the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you that eager to see me disappear? I will, don't worry. It's been eleven minutes already, so I'd have no problem leaving now.
entries.literal: "Are you that eager to see me disappear? I will, don't worry. It's been eleven minutes already, so I'd have no problem leaving now."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Where were you? Why did you not show yourself until now?
entries.literal: "...Where were you? Why did you not show yourself until now?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I was here, searching for you.
entries.literal: "I was here, searching for you."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's no way you didn't see us for so long.
entries.literal: "There's no way you didn't see us for so long."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, it's not my problem if you're not content with my answers.
entries.literal: "Well, it's not my problem if you're not content with my answers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I fell quiet again. I had no idea how to interpret his attitude, but I wouldn't refuse to ask more questions if he had some of his own to respond with.
entries.literal: "I fell quiet again. I had no idea how to interpret his attitude, but I wouldn't refuse to ask more questions if he had some of his own to respond with."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why did I not find you in hallway B?
entries.literal: "Why did I not find you in hallway B?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Because you are incompetent.
entries.literal: "Because you are incompetent."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Where were you, then?
entries.literal: "Where were you, then?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: In hallway B.
entries.literal: "In hallway B."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Who killed Katei?
entries.literal: "...{w}Who killed Katei?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Either Akaro or Erina.
entries.literal: "Either Akaro or Erina."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Who killed Erina?
entries.literal: "...Who killed Erina?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me.
entries.literal: "Me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm just kidding. It was Isla.
entries.literal: "I'm just kidding. It was Isla."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm just kidding. Either Akaro or Katei.
entries.literal: "I'm just kidding. Either Akaro or Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped caring about his behavior. Additionally, I'd found a reason to stall for time.
entries.literal: "I stopped caring about his behavior. Additionally, I'd found a reason to stall for time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You perfectly remember when we went up to the attic to get the lithium battery, right?
entries.literal: "You perfectly remember when we went up to the attic to get the lithium battery, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course.
entries.literal: "Of course."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How did you do that?
entries.literal: "How did you do that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I said you're incompetent, but at least you're doing your best, unlike the others.
entries.literal: "I said you're incompetent, but at least you're doing your best, unlike the others."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's my answer. I suppose it just appeared impressive from your point of view.
entries.literal: "That's my answer. I suppose it just appeared impressive from your point of view."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Okay, then who killed Naomi? Who's the culprit behind everything?
entries.literal: "Okay, then who killed Naomi? Who's the culprit behind everything?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The culprit? Don't be silly.{w} And I'm not sure why you're asking me this when I recall saying over and over that Katei did it.
entries.literal: "The culprit? Don't be silly.{w} And I'm not sure why you're asking me this when I recall saying over and over that Katei did it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then... why the fuck were there two Naomis?
entries.literal: "Then... why the fuck were there two Naomis?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's a big one. I only have vague ideas, unfortunately, and none that I'm willing to share.
entries.literal: "That's a big one. I only have vague ideas, unfortunately, and none that I'm willing to share."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You talk a lot, but you're not really saying anything. How did you escape from the bedroom?
entries.literal: "You talk a lot, but you're not really saying anything. How did you escape from the bedroom?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: With this.
entries.literal: "With this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked down at the Sekimeiya and signaled that it was his answer.
entries.literal: "He looked down at the Sekimeiya and signaled that it was his answer."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What about this blood on the floor? Whose is it?
entries.literal: "What about this blood on the floor? Whose is it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No idea.
entries.literal: "No idea."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What about in the lobby? It should've been left while you were alone with Akaro.
entries.literal: "What about in the lobby? It should've been left while you were alone with Akaro."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You mean the one drop, right?
entries.literal: "You mean the one drop, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What else would I mean?
entries.literal: "What else would I mean?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's a great question, as you could only mean the one drop... We said I'd answer cryptically, right?
entries.literal: "That's a great question, as you could only mean the one drop... We said I'd answer cryptically, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If I'm right, that drop belongs to a person whose blood is not currently anywhere else, and they were one of the people who did not escape the attic's bedroom before Akaro and I did. Currently, that person is alive, and is found inside the tower. Furthermore, I estimate they're on one of the first four floors, standing up.
entries.literal: "If I'm right, that drop belongs to a person whose blood is not currently anywhere else, and they were one of the people who did not escape the attic's bedroom before Akaro and I did. Currently, that person is alive, and is found inside the tower. Furthermore, I estimate they're on one of the first four floors, standing up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Also, their name starts with "Shiroy".
entries.literal: "Also, their name starts with \"Shiroy\"."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You have time to think.
entries.literal: "You have time to think."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Why would it be me? Did you actually see me?
entries.literal: "...Why would it be me? Did you actually see me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is the part where a lot of things get a little too confusing. I'm not fully certain about what I'm saying, but decently so. Nonetheless, what I said about your fate still stands, and I'm much more certain about it, so my condolences. It appears it won't be me who will kill you, though.
entries.literal: "This is the part where a lot of things get a little too confusing. I'm not fully certain about what I'm saying, but decently so. Nonetheless, what I said about your fate still stands, and I'm much more certain about it, so my condolences. It appears it won't be me who will kill you, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why are you saying this...!?
entries.literal: "Why are you saying this...!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Because I have eyes. That might sound unfair, though—you do too, but you don't understand. That's what I don't quite get.{w} Regardless, that's it. I'll touch the Sekimeiya and immediately appear from hallway B. I'll see you.
entries.literal: "Because I have eyes. That might sound unfair, though—you do too, but you don't understand. That's what I don't quite get.{w} Regardless, that's it. I'll touch the Sekimeiya and immediately appear from hallway B. I'll see you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before he could finish that sentence, Shiroya and I dashed at him, reacting the way we'd prepared ourselves to.
entries.literal: "Before he could finish that sentence, Shiroya and I dashed at him, reacting the way we'd prepared ourselves to."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Hm? What are you...?
entries.literal: "...Hm? What are you...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, we weren't going to stop him—we knew that. He was slightly taken aback, but he had more than enough time to touch the Sekimeiya before we got to him.
entries.literal: "Of course, we weren't going to stop him—we knew that. He was slightly taken aback, but he had more than enough time to touch the Sekimeiya before we got to him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, we didn't need to touch it directly. Alongside the stored time, the range of the Sekimeiya had to be small. If we could enter it before he touched it, we'd travel the same amount of time as him. Then, in the recent past, we'd have one chance to stop or understand his actions.
entries.literal: "However, we didn't need to touch it directly. Alongside the stored time, the range of the Sekimeiya had to be small. If we could enter it before he touched it, we'd travel the same amount of time as him. Then, in the recent past, we'd have one chance to stop or understand his actions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as he realized that was our plan, his face showed its first sign of uncertainty, and he rapidly moved his right arm to reach the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "As soon as he realized that was our plan, his face showed its first sign of uncertainty, and he rapidly moved his right arm to reach the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It should've been futile. The room wasn't very big, and our sprint had put us fairly close to him...
entries.literal: "It should've been futile. The room wasn't very big, and our sprint had put us fairly close to him..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, when his skin made contact with the Sekimeiya, his entire figure disappeared in an instant.
entries.literal: "However, when his skin made contact with the Sekimeiya, his entire figure disappeared in an instant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In midair, the Sekimeiya turned gray, and when it hit the floor, the sound made it seem almost like it had broken. I stared at it, dumbfounded, while it rolled around for some long seconds.
entries.literal: "In midair, the Sekimeiya turned gray, and when it hit the floor, the sound made it seem almost like it had broken. I stared at it, dumbfounded, while it rolled around for some long seconds."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I guess we weren't fast enough...
entries.literal: "I guess we weren't fast enough..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned to my side.{w} Nobody was there.
entries.literal: "I turned to my side.{w} Nobody was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya... wasn't there. I spun and saw that I was alone with the powered-off Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Shiroya... wasn't there. I spun and saw that I was alone with the powered-off Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What the fuck...?{w} Did the range reach her?{w} Why her but not me?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...?{w} Did the range reach her?{w} Why her but not me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood still and imagined where the three of us had been. ...Could the range have only missed me?
entries.literal: "I stood still and imagined where the three of us had been. ...Could the range have only missed me?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I think so...  She was at my right side, but directly faced Sai, unlike me.
entries.literal: "I think so...  She was at my right side, but directly faced Sai, unlike me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't directly prove it, but it would've made sense if the range was circular, probably spherical.
entries.literal: "It didn't directly prove it, but it would've made sense if the range was circular, probably spherical."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been visualizing it that way already, and it seemed like it fit. The range must've been small, so perhaps only she had been in it.
entries.literal: "I'd been visualizing it that way already, and it seemed like it fit. The range must've been small, so perhaps only she had been in it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know how it worked—maybe your entire body had to be part of the range, or maybe only being partially hit was enough.
entries.literal: "I didn't know how it worked—maybe your entire body had to be part of the range, or maybe only being partially hit was enough."

entries.text: Transparent Reality
entries.literal: "Transparent Reality"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Or... was there another reason? What if I was encompassed inside, but for some reason, I didn't travel?
entries.literal: "Or... was there another reason? What if I was encompassed inside, but for some reason, I didn't travel?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was very lost, and I began to have a hard time working with what had happened. Until then, a maximum of two people had traveled each time. Was that the maximum amount? Had I been excluded for another reason, maybe?
entries.literal: "I was very lost, and I began to have a hard time working with what had happened. Until then, a maximum of two people had traveled each time. Was that the maximum amount? Had I been excluded for another reason, maybe?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But... why is nothing happening?
entries.literal: "But... why is nothing happening?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Both of them just traveled to the past, so why haven't they arrived already? They must be somewhere...
entries.literal: "Both of them just traveled to the past, so why haven't they arrived already? They must be somewhere..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was what Sai had said: a version of himself might've been waiting in hallway B.{w} I approached the door and looked through it. I saw a handful of open doors that I'd left that way, but no sign of life.
entries.literal: "That was what Sai had said: a version of himself might've been waiting in hallway B.{w} I approached the door and looked through it. I saw a handful of open doors that I'd left that way, but no sign of life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around and looked at hallway A instead. While most of the doors were closed in its case, I still couldn't see anyone.
entries.literal: "I turned around and looked at hallway A instead. While most of the doors were closed in its case, I still couldn't see anyone."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Could something have happened that's preventing them from reappearing? They have to be in the tower, right?
entries.literal: "Could something have happened that's preventing them from reappearing? They have to be in the tower, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to the Sekimeiya and kneeled next to it. Then, I placed my right hand on it and felt its cold and smooth surface. Once again, it had powered off after a travel, but it hadn't teleported itself away.
entries.literal: "I walked up to the Sekimeiya and kneeled next to it. Then, I placed my right hand on it and felt its cold and smooth surface. Once again, it had powered off after a travel, but it hadn't teleported itself away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited. I was banking on something being about to happen, so I stood still, glancing back and forth between the two doors and trying to shake away the bitter taste the conversation with Sai left in my mouth.
entries.literal: "I waited. I was banking on something being about to happen, so I stood still, glancing back and forth between the two doors and trying to shake away the bitter taste the conversation with Sai left in my mouth."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, nothing was changing. I was getting worried, but I didn't know what to do.{w} After some minutes of standing up, I started to feel uncertain.
entries.literal: "However, nothing was changing. I was getting worried, but I didn't know what to do.{w} After some minutes of standing up, I started to feel uncertain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, the Sekimeiya turned white. I estimated about five minutes had passed since Sai and Shiroya vanishing, and the Sekimeiya had probably been storing energy for close to fifteen before their travel.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, the Sekimeiya turned white. I estimated about five minutes had passed since Sai and Shiroya vanishing, and the Sekimeiya had probably been storing energy for close to fifteen before their travel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at it intensely and had an idea. Could touching it while in the gray state prevent it from teleporting itself as soon as it turned white? I couldn't think of much else if Sai had been correct earlier.
entries.literal: "I looked at it intensely and had an idea. Could touching it while in the gray state prevent it from teleporting itself as soon as it turned white? I couldn't think of much else if Sai had been correct earlier."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No, that doesn't make sense... When we traveled from the cleaning room, it fell in the buckets below the cleaning cart, and when the others found it, it was already white. Of course, I'd have to believe Sai's story to be sure, but nobody objected to it.
entries.literal: "No, that doesn't make sense... When we traveled from the cleaning room, it fell in the buckets below the cleaning cart, and when the others found it, it was already white. Of course, I'd have to believe Sai's story to be sure, but nobody objected to it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was really unsure about what to do. The silence had become unbearable in just those five minutes, and I couldn't understand why neither Sai nor Shiroya had returned.
entries.literal: "I was really unsure about what to do. The silence had become unbearable in just those five minutes, and I couldn't understand why neither Sai nor Shiroya had returned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like Sai had done, I put my hand under my sleeve and grabbed the Sekimeiya. Then, I placed it inside the cold cabinet that Sai left unlocked and scrolled the glass shut. I didn't lock it—I'd just felt the need to not leave it outside, and I knew Sai was the one who had the key anyway.
entries.literal: "Like Sai had done, I put my hand under my sleeve and grabbed the Sekimeiya. Then, I placed it inside the cold cabinet that Sai left unlocked and scrolled the glass shut. I didn't lock it—I'd just felt the need to not leave it outside, and I knew Sai was the one who had the key anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Afterward, I didn't know what to do. I felt a pressing atmosphere, as if I was the sole remaining being in that immense building.
entries.literal: "Afterward, I didn't know what to do. I felt a pressing atmosphere, as if I was the sole remaining being in that immense building."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is it possible they appeared outside the tower...? Even though the distance traveled had to be short, the replicated location is an entirely different deal. Maybe that's what Sai meant when he said that he didn't care about how far he'd make it to the past, if he knew he'd appear outside regardless and was lying about immediately reappearing from hallway B.
entries.literal: "Is it possible they appeared outside the tower...? Even though the distance traveled had to be short, the replicated location is an entirely different deal. Maybe that's what Sai meant when he said that he didn't care about how far he'd make it to the past, if he knew he'd appear outside regardless and was lying about immediately reappearing from hallway B."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But it can't be that Sai's goal was to leave. He wouldn't willingly walk away from all of this. Unless he learned something very important that would've changed his mind, if he wanted to escape, it must be that he planned to eventually reenter through the storeroom...
entries.literal: "But it can't be that Sai's goal was to leave. He wouldn't willingly walk away from all of this. Unless he learned something very important that would've changed his mind, if he wanted to escape, it must be that he planned to eventually reenter through the storeroom..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And what about the other Shiroya? She should be still here.
entries.literal: "And what about the other Shiroya? She should be still here."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Given the circumstances, she's sealed inside the tower. There's no way she could've left through the storeroom since no handle could be reattached to the door—opening it from the inside is pretty much out of the question.
entries.literal: "Given the circumstances, she's sealed inside the tower. There's no way she could've left through the storeroom since no handle could be reattached to the door—opening it from the inside is pretty much out of the question."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Using the Sekimeiya to escape should've been equally hard, though. While she could've taken it out of the cabinet while we went to the attic, it was still locked inside when we came back. She couldn't have appeared outside the tower because she couldn't have left it locked again.
entries.literal: "Using the Sekimeiya to escape should've been equally hard, though. While she could've taken it out of the cabinet while we went to the attic, it was still locked inside when we came back. She couldn't have appeared outside the tower because she couldn't have left it locked again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was just trying to reinforce the thought that I wasn't alone, acting as if it was impossible.{w} What if she'd appeared outside the tower, entered through the storeroom from the outside, and left the door open to leave after placing the Sekimeiya in the cabinet? It looked like motives behind actions had stopped mattering, so being sure about any detail had started to feel impossible.
entries.literal: "I was just trying to reinforce the thought that I wasn't alone, acting as if it was impossible.{w} What if she'd appeared outside the tower, entered through the storeroom from the outside, and left the door open to leave after placing the Sekimeiya in the cabinet? It looked like motives behind actions had stopped mattering, so being sure about any detail had started to feel impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The existence of that secret door made me anxious every time I thought about my situation. Not only did I not know if more people were around, but I also had no way to know if they would enter at any time. I didn't even know if the door led outside, if opening it from the other side was possible, or if anyone would be able to enter without being seen.
entries.literal: "The existence of that secret door made me anxious every time I thought about my situation. Not only did I not know if more people were around, but I also had no way to know if they would enter at any time. I didn't even know if the door led outside, if opening it from the other side was possible, or if anyone would be able to enter without being seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But only being able to hear my own breath, more empty minutes passed.
entries.literal: "But only being able to hear my own breath, more empty minutes passed."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What could be going on? Sai said he hadn't killed anyone, so could it be that the true culprit found them and that's why they haven't come back?
entries.literal: "What could be going on? Sai said he hadn't killed anyone, so could it be that the true culprit found them and that's why they haven't come back?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At some point, my anxiety had become overwhelming. I didn't know whether to fear Sai, a different, true culprit, or the sudden solitude itself.
entries.literal: "At some point, my anxiety had become overwhelming. I didn't know whether to fear Sai, a different, true culprit, or the sudden solitude itself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked out to hallway B and began to take automatic steps toward the lobby. I'd been trying not to leave the Sekimeiya behind, but since I hadn't been able to let the proposition of being alone sink in, I succumbed to the need to wander around.
entries.literal: "I walked out to hallway B and began to take automatic steps toward the lobby. I'd been trying not to leave the Sekimeiya behind, but since I hadn't been able to let the proposition of being alone sink in, I succumbed to the need to wander around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the vast, empty lobby, and what felt like a metal ball started to make its way down my stomach. Every step I took was all I could hear.
entries.literal: "I looked at the vast, empty lobby, and what felt like a metal ball started to make its way down my stomach. Every step I took was all I could hear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I entered hallway A, I became convinced of it: Sai and Shiroya had escaped. That had to have been the meaning behind Sai's words, but it was impossible to know if I'd see them again before {time=21.}
entries.literal: "When I entered hallway A, I became convinced of it: Sai and Shiroya had escaped. That had to have been the meaning behind Sai's words, but it was impossible to know if I'd see them again before {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even the other Shiroya, whose existence seemed incredibly volatile, had hidden from me as her only action. Without a search partner, anyone could stay out of my view if they so desired.
entries.literal: "Even the other Shiroya, whose existence seemed incredibly volatile, had hidden from me as her only action. Without a search partner, anyone could stay out of my view if they so desired."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued walking toward hallway C, not even trying to find anyone. When I completed the full lap, I stepped into the event room and let out a sigh full of myriad emotions.
entries.literal: "I continued walking toward hallway C, not even trying to find anyone. When I completed the full lap, I stepped into the event room and let out a sigh full of myriad emotions."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I guess that... if I am alone, it wouldn't be that bad. I would only have to wait three hours to see Shiroya again.
entries.literal: "I guess that... if I am alone, it wouldn't be that bad. I would only have to wait three hours to see Shiroya again."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But if Sai wasn't a killer, they still have to be here. And I don't know what Sai's plan was, but it could still be in motion.
entries.literal: "But if Sai wasn't a killer, they still have to be here. And I don't know what Sai's plan was, but it could still be in motion."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I stood still and waited, leaning against the wall while a few more minutes of silence passed.
entries.literal: "Once again, I stood still and waited, leaning against the wall while a few more minutes of silence passed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to the cabinet and uncovered the curtain.
entries.literal: "I walked up to the cabinet and uncovered the curtain."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Should I try to use it...?
entries.literal: "Should I try to use it...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Anything could determine the replicated location. Perhaps Sai knew that touching the Sekimeiya would bring him outside, so the same could apply if I do it now myself.
entries.literal: "Anything could determine the replicated location. Perhaps Sai knew that touching the Sekimeiya would bring him outside, so the same could apply if I do it now myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't too bad of an idea. If anything had gone wrong for them, I had the opportunity to reproduce it with the purpose of understanding what had happened.
entries.literal: "It wasn't too bad of an idea. If anything had gone wrong for them, I had the opportunity to reproduce it with the purpose of understanding what had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the glass and rolled the cold Sekimeiya to my shirt. I knew I'd have to wait some time for it to gain energy, but it would only be a few minutes. Even if I couldn't conclude anything, I'd travel some time back, so I could retrieve the Sekimeiya as soon as I disappeared.
entries.literal: "I opened the glass and rolled the cold Sekimeiya to my shirt. I knew I'd have to wait some time for it to gain energy, but it would only be a few minutes. Even if I couldn't conclude anything, I'd travel some time back, so I could retrieve the Sekimeiya as soon as I disappeared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Out of the blue, I recalled something else.{w} Awkwardly, I put my free left hand in my right pocket and took out a key. I'd found it in the cleaning room just earlier, high on a shelf.
entries.literal: "...{w}Out of the blue, I recalled something else.{w} Awkwardly, I put my free left hand in my right pocket and took out a key. I'd found it in the cleaning room just earlier, high on a shelf."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing on it indicated what it was for, as it looked like a simple key that could unlock any normal door. I gave it a good look, sensing that something was about to come to me.
entries.literal: "Nothing on it indicated what it was for, as it looked like a simple key that could unlock any normal door. I gave it a good look, sensing that something was about to come to me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Oh... Am I actually stupid?
entries.literal: "Oh... Am I actually stupid?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It looks a lot like the one for Naomi's locker. That's what it is, even though the color is slightly different.
entries.literal: "It looks a lot like the one for Naomi's locker. That's what it is, even though the color is slightly different."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no simple way to compare them since I'd gotten rid of the other one through the toilet.
entries.literal: "I had no simple way to compare them since I'd gotten rid of the other one through the toilet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remembered that her locker had potentially been opened while we were in the attic. Could that have been the key to that mystery?
entries.literal: "I remembered that her locker had potentially been opened while we were in the attic. Could that have been the key to that mystery?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shut myself in the staff room with the Sekimeiya since I wanted it to spend a few minutes out of the cabinet. I knew which locker was Naomi's, and as I thought, it was open.{w} I attempted to insert the key in the keyhole, but it didn't fully go in.
entries.literal: "I shut myself in the staff room with the Sekimeiya since I wanted it to spend a few minutes out of the cabinet. I knew which locker was Naomi's, and as I thought, it was open.{w} I attempted to insert the key in the keyhole, but it didn't fully go in."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Huh, it's not the right one.
entries.literal: "Huh, it's not the right one."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It almost fits, though. Does it open another one?
entries.literal: "It almost fits, though. Does it open another one?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eager to find out, I left the Sekimeiya on the floor and began to insert the key in every locker.
entries.literal: "Eager to find out, I left the Sekimeiya on the floor and began to insert the key in every locker."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started with the left ones and saw that the key would always enter partially. Some of them looked like they'd almost open, but I could never turn the key. I continued with the middle group and was met with the exact same result.
entries.literal: "I started with the left ones and saw that the key would always enter partially. Some of them looked like they'd almost open, but I could never turn the key. I continued with the middle group and was met with the exact same result."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to sigh in disappointment, but when I tried to turn it after inserting it in the last one of the rightmost set, I heard a sudden, sharp sound. Understanding its meaning, I dragged the metallic door toward me and saw the interior of a new locker.
entries.literal: "I was about to sigh in disappointment, but when I tried to turn it after inserting it in the last one of the rightmost set, I heard a sudden, sharp sound. Understanding its meaning, I dragged the metallic door toward me and saw the interior of a new locker."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, its contents were painfully similar to Naomi's. There was nothing in the highest compartment, and a winter coat hung in the main one. As the biggest difference, a pair of brown, corduroy pants were folded on the bottom.
entries.literal: "However, its contents were painfully similar to Naomi's. There was nothing in the highest compartment, and a winter coat hung in the main one. As the biggest difference, a pair of brown, corduroy pants were folded on the bottom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though they didn't seem to be much use, there was a chance someone left their phone in those clothes. I put the key back in my pocket, crouched to grab the pants, and held them up with one hand while I felt them.
entries.literal: "Even though they didn't seem to be much use, there was a chance someone left their phone in those clothes. I put the key back in my pocket, crouched to grab the pants, and held them up with one hand while I felt them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Not only was there not a phone, every pocket was completely empty and clean, making it seem like the pants had been recently bought. I determined that they belonged to a considerably sized adult, probably male. Since clothes had been left in the locker, it was more than likely that it belonged to a staff member who wore a uniform during work.
entries.literal: "Not only was there not a phone, every pocket was completely empty and clean, making it seem like the pants had been recently bought. I determined that they belonged to a considerably sized adult, probably male. Since clothes had been left in the locker, it was more than likely that it belonged to a staff member who wore a uniform during work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled Katei had told us that the employees used the room to store personal objects and to leave their uniforms before heading off. There was no uniform in the locker, so everything indicated that the owner had come to work that day.
entries.literal: "I recalled Katei had told us that the employees used the room to store personal objects and to leave their uniforms before heading off. There was no uniform in the locker, so everything indicated that the owner had come to work that day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew that I'd found the key in the cleaning room, but something still felt iffy about that, preventing me from jumping to conclusions.{w} I folded the pants and put them inside before I grabbed the heavy coat.
entries.literal: "I knew that I'd found the key in the cleaning room, but something still felt iffy about that, preventing me from jumping to conclusions.{w} I folded the pants and put them inside before I grabbed the heavy coat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was pretty big, so I began to run my hand over its surface in search of anything I could find.{w} Almost immediately, I took something from a pocket.
entries.literal: "It was pretty big, so I began to run my hand over its surface in search of anything I could find.{w} Almost immediately, I took something from a pocket."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a set of four keys with a dog-shaped keychain. I had nothing to use them for, and I didn't recognize any, so I put them back in the pocket. I continued searching for anything else and shortly confirmed that every other pocket was empty.
entries.literal: "It was a set of four keys with a dog-shaped keychain. I had nothing to use them for, and I didn't recognize any, so I put them back in the pocket. I continued searching for anything else and shortly confirmed that every other pocket was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I continued feeling the surface of the coat because something had prompted my attention. I didn't know if I'd imagined it, but I thought I felt a minuscule bulge near the neck.
entries.literal: "But I continued feeling the surface of the coat because something had prompted my attention. I didn't know if I'd imagined it, but I thought I felt a minuscule bulge near the neck."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept going over the same spot until I was sure that I'd been right. Something very hard to notice was there.{w} Intrigued, I turned the cloth around and saw that part of the neck area was covered by a different type of material. I put my finger under it and found that the two layers allowed for a narrow cavity.
entries.literal: "I kept going over the same spot until I was sure that I'd been right. Something very hard to notice was there.{w} Intrigued, I turned the cloth around and saw that part of the neck area was covered by a different type of material. I put my finger under it and found that the two layers allowed for a narrow cavity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I drew my finger up to the spot where I'd felt the bulge, trying to find it on the opposite side.
entries.literal: "I drew my finger up to the spot where I'd felt the bulge, trying to find it on the opposite side."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There it is.
entries.literal: "There it is."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It felt cold and round. With my thumb, I managed to grab and extract it.
entries.literal: "It felt cold and round. With my thumb, I managed to grab and extract it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Oh, what the fuck? Isn't this...?
entries.literal: "Oh, what the fuck? Isn't this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A bug. That was what it looked like.{w} I'd never personally seen one, but it had a very similar shape to the ones I'd seen in television shows. It was circular, and on its surface was what looked like a microchip. By adding the location where I'd found it, I could only recognize it as a spying bug.
entries.literal: "A bug. That was what it looked like.{w} I'd never personally seen one, but it had a very similar shape to the ones I'd seen in television shows. It was circular, and on its surface was what looked like a microchip. By adding the location where I'd found it, I could only recognize it as a spying bug."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Was a staff member being monitored? Could Xyn have planted a bug on a staff member to learn about the measures Ashiya were taking against them?
entries.literal: "Was a staff member being monitored? Could Xyn have planted a bug on a staff member to learn about the measures Ashiya were taking against them?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No, that doesn't make a ton of sense. They wouldn't plant it on clothes that are always left in this locker.{w} Could it be the inverse, then? Did Ashiya suspect they were part of Xyn?
entries.literal: "No, that doesn't make a ton of sense. They wouldn't plant it on clothes that are always left in this locker.{w} Could it be the inverse, then? Did Ashiya suspect they were part of Xyn?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though the day's events had morphed into something nearly incomprehensible, they had started from Ashiya and Xyn's battle; it was foolish to think Xyn weren't involved in some way.
entries.literal: "Even though the day's events had morphed into something nearly incomprehensible, they had started from Ashiya and Xyn's battle; it was foolish to think Xyn weren't involved in some way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And something had been cemented as reality: one of Ashiya's staff members was being monitored. I'd already seen the interior of Katei's and Naomi's lockers, the two staff members I was familiar with. Someone else must've owned that one.
entries.literal: "And something had been cemented as reality: one of Ashiya's staff members was being monitored. I'd already seen the interior of Katei's and Naomi's lockers, the two staff members I was familiar with. Someone else must've owned that one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at it closely, haunted by the truth behind it. Could someone have been hearing my movements in a completely safe space somewhere in Yushibana? If so, they might've realized the bug had been found, but I couldn't imagine they were listening to it at all times.
entries.literal: "I looked at it closely, haunted by the truth behind it. Could someone have been hearing my movements in a completely safe space somewhere in Yushibana? If so, they might've realized the bug had been found, but I couldn't imagine they were listening to it at all times."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put the coat back in the locker, but I didn't reattach the bug to it, mainly because it looked tricky to do. Instead, I left it in one of its pockets, knowing it'd be found by the police if I mentioned it to them.
entries.literal: "I put the coat back in the locker, but I didn't reattach the bug to it, mainly because it looked tricky to do. Instead, I left it in one of its pockets, knowing it'd be found by the police if I mentioned it to them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced down at the Sekimeiya. Since I had the key to a new locker, I could lock it inside and look around the entire building for Shiroya.
entries.literal: "I glanced down at the Sekimeiya. Since I had the key to a new locker, I could lock it inside and look around the entire building for Shiroya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No, I shouldn't do that. This could be part of someone's plan.
entries.literal: "No, I shouldn't do that. This could be part of someone's plan."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: How can it be that this key was never found in the cleaning room with how much we've searched this floor? Doesn't it look like obvious bait to make someone believe they have a safe space to hide the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "How can it be that this key was never found in the cleaning room with how much we've searched this floor? Doesn't it look like obvious bait to make someone believe they have a safe space to hide the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If the culprit, or let's say Sai, found the key well-hidden or had it somewhere, they could've duplicated it with the Sekimeiya. Then, they left it in the cleaning room and hoped someone would take the bait and keep the Sekimeiya in a locker they also had access to.
entries.literal: "If the culprit, or let's say Sai, found the key well-hidden or had it somewhere, they could've duplicated it with the Sekimeiya. Then, they left it in the cleaning room and hoped someone would take the bait and keep the Sekimeiya in a locker they also had access to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it was all right. I intended to touch the Sekimeiya, so, I'd have time to search the building in the past. That way, I'd know for a fact that nobody could take it in the meantime.
entries.literal: "But it was all right. I intended to touch the Sekimeiya, so, I'd have time to search the building in the past. That way, I'd know for a fact that nobody could take it in the meantime."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put my hand behind the cloth of my shirt and felt the Sekimeiya's surface. As I thought, it had begun to heat up.
entries.literal: "I put my hand behind the cloth of my shirt and felt the Sekimeiya's surface. As I thought, it had begun to heat up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't take my eyes off of it. Sai chose to leave it behind, which made his intentions feel impossible to understand.
entries.literal: "I couldn't take my eyes off of it. Sai chose to leave it behind, which made his intentions feel impossible to understand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ever since the time he'd escaped from the attic's bedroom, he had undoubtedly learned a few key details and found some attainable goals. ...A sudden thought confused me: if a culprit had been using the Sekimeiya to never be found and was responsible for all the deaths, why had they not targeted Sai?
entries.literal: "Ever since the time he'd escaped from the attic's bedroom, he had undoubtedly learned a few key details and found some attainable goals. ...A sudden thought confused me: if a culprit had been using the Sekimeiya to never be found and was responsible for all the deaths, why had they not targeted Sai?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea, but thinking that Sai was the killer didn't fit very well either. Why had he spared my life earlier? Could he really have found a hidden knife we all missed? He even said it was poorly hidden and that he'd overstepped... What the hell did that mean?{w} "Heh... That's wrong." Sai's voice played in my head.{w} "What you two just said... is wrong."
entries.literal: "I had no idea, but thinking that Sai was the killer didn't fit very well either. Why had he spared my life earlier? Could he really have found a hidden knife we all missed? He even said it was poorly hidden and that he'd overstepped... What the hell did that mean?{w} \"Heh... That's wrong.\" Sai's voice played in my head.{w} \"What you two just said... is wrong.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That had been in direct denial of Shiroya's claim: "That doesn't mean anything. If you used the Sekimeiya to travel back in time after you killed them, it would have given you clean clothes from a past point, and the stained ones would have disappeared forever."
entries.literal: "That had been in direct denial of Shiroya's claim: \"That doesn't mean anything. If you used the Sekimeiya to travel back in time after you killed them, it would have given you clean clothes from a past point, and the stained ones would have disappeared forever.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Should I take his word at face value and accept that he knows better than us?{w} What exactly is wrong about that? I can think of three different things.
entries.literal: "Should I take his word at face value and accept that he knows better than us?{w} What exactly is wrong about that? I can think of three different things."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He might've been referring to the part where his clothes would disappear forever. Perhaps they would appear somewhere, but that doesn't sound too likely.{w} Maybe he really meant that the Sekimeiya couldn't have achieved that, but there's no way we were wrong. We know such a thing could've occurred because the key to Naomi's locker was reconstructed in my pocket by traveling.{w} Did he maybe mean that he never could've achieved that under his own circumstances? Maybe he figured out what determines the replicated location, and he knew that given the way it works, the Sekimeiya would never have replicated a point in which his clothes were clean. Could that be it...?
entries.literal: "He might've been referring to the part where his clothes would disappear forever. Perhaps they would appear somewhere, but that doesn't sound too likely.{w} Maybe he really meant that the Sekimeiya couldn't have achieved that, but there's no way we were wrong. We know such a thing could've occurred because the key to Naomi's locker was reconstructed in my pocket by traveling.{w} Did he maybe mean that he never could've achieved that under his own circumstances? Maybe he figured out what determines the replicated location, and he knew that given the way it works, the Sekimeiya would never have replicated a point in which his clothes were clean. Could that be it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was inscrutable. I had previously thought that the existence of the replicated location was something we'd finally deduced about the Sekimeiya's mechanics, and I'd been pretty confident about it. Sai could also have purely intended to taunt us and appear to have superior knowledge while we'd really been right on the mark.
entries.literal: "It was inscrutable. I had previously thought that the existence of the replicated location was something we'd finally deduced about the Sekimeiya's mechanics, and I'd been pretty confident about it. Sai could also have purely intended to taunt us and appear to have superior knowledge while we'd really been right on the mark."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is there any travel we know has occurred that directly denies our theory?
entries.literal: "Is there any travel we know has occurred that directly denies our theory?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran through every travel I knew about. Fairly quickly, I found an inconsistency.
entries.literal: "I ran through every travel I knew about. Fairly quickly, I found an inconsistency."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Oh, right, when I appeared in the security room and fell backward because the chair wasn't properly positioned for me to sit on it. The position where I appeared indicated that the replicated location was of me sitting on that chair, but I had never done that.{w} Oh, and the recording too. Of course, if it's legitimate, we assumed it was brought from the future. While there isn't a big issue, the way we were thinking the Sekimeiya worked doesn't make it that simple.
entries.literal: "Oh, right, when I appeared in the security room and fell backward because the chair wasn't properly positioned for me to sit on it. The position where I appeared indicated that the replicated location was of me sitting on that chair, but I had never done that.{w} Oh, and the recording too. Of course, if it's legitimate, we assumed it was brought from the future. While there isn't a big issue, the way we were thinking the Sekimeiya worked doesn't make it that simple."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In a month from now, someone would have to hold the voice recorder. Then, farther in the future, that same person would have to go all the way back to today and have the time in which they held it as the replicated location.{w} It's not reasonable to rule that out, but it complicates everything a lot more.{w} But I can't just abandon that way of thinking about it. It can't be that you can bring any item you have to the past, or else the cleaning cart would've appeared with Shiroya in the attic.
entries.literal: "In a month from now, someone would have to hold the voice recorder. Then, farther in the future, that same person would have to go all the way back to today and have the time in which they held it as the replicated location.{w} It's not reasonable to rule that out, but it complicates everything a lot more.{w} But I can't just abandon that way of thinking about it. It can't be that you can bring any item you have to the past, or else the cleaning cart would've appeared with Shiroya in the attic."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: How can we be wrong? There's no way we are...! We appeared in the attic exactly where we'd been prior to that point. That position was definitely based on a previous one, so we can't be completely wrong. However, there's the security room instance...{w} Like I thought back then, that can't be a random location... Sitting in front of the computer... Could it have been influenced by Katei's past position?{w} He was the one who sat on that chair a while before our travel, but why would this have mattered!?
entries.literal: "How can we be wrong? There's no way we are...! We appeared in the attic exactly where we'd been prior to that point. That position was definitely based on a previous one, so we can't be completely wrong. However, there's the security room instance...{w} Like I thought back then, that can't be a random location... Sitting in front of the computer... Could it have been influenced by Katei's past position?{w} He was the one who sat on that chair a while before our travel, but why would this have mattered!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was right. Something about what we'd said was wrong, but I didn't know what it was. It could've been a minor detail or a major contradiction.
entries.literal: "Sai was right. Something about what we'd said was wrong, but I didn't know what it was. It could've been a minor detail or a major contradiction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kneeled next to the Sekimeiya, ready to touch it. Sai had figured out a few things in a very short time, so I could do the same if I kept experimenting. The main purpose was to comprehend why Sai and Shiroya hadn't appeared, so I knew it was possible the travel wouldn't go smoothly.
entries.literal: "I kneeled next to the Sekimeiya, ready to touch it. Sai had figured out a few things in a very short time, so I could do the same if I kept experimenting. The main purpose was to comprehend why Sai and Shiroya hadn't appeared, so I knew it was possible the travel wouldn't go smoothly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hesitated and had to take a moment to steady myself. I'd gotten used to sharing each travel with Shiroya, so doing it alone again like the first time was a bit imposing.
entries.literal: "I hesitated and had to take a moment to steady myself. I'd gotten used to sharing each travel with Shiroya, so doing it alone again like the first time was a bit imposing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I relaxed myself and let some more time pass. I estimated it was fifteen minutes since I'd gotten the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, so I was about to travel just as far back as Sai and Shiroya had.
