entries.literal: "I relaxed myself and let some more time pass. I estimated it was fifteen minutes since I'd gotten the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet, so I was about to travel just as far back as Sai and Shiroya had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Remembering the loud crack the Sekimeiya made when it fell to the floor, I realized that grabbing it before activating it was a bad idea. I stopped touching the floor with my right hand and approached the unmoving Sekimeiya, determined to travel once more.
entries.literal: "Remembering the loud crack the Sekimeiya made when it fell to the floor, I realized that grabbing it before activating it was a bad idea. I stopped touching the floor with my right hand and approached the unmoving Sekimeiya, determined to travel once more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I found myself standing up in the middle of the event room, looking at the covered cabinet. That time, the instantaneous pain of the Sekimeiya's surface was interpreted by my brain as an electric shock moreso than a burn.
entries.literal: "I found myself standing up in the middle of the event room, looking at the covered cabinet. That time, the instantaneous pain of the Sekimeiya's surface was interpreted by my brain as an electric shock moreso than a burn."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...I won't be able to deduce much if I appear here, where I've been so many times. I was here just before I went to the staff room.
entries.literal: "...I won't be able to deduce much if I appear here, where I've been so many times. I was here just before I went to the staff room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I knew that the amount of time traveled was an entirely different matter. While I shouldn't have been too far back, nothing was for certain.
entries.literal: "But I knew that the amount of time traveled was an entirely different matter. While I shouldn't have been too far back, nothing was for certain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to check inside the cabinet when a sound stopped me. Someone was still there.
entries.literal: "I was about to check inside the cabinet when a sound stopped me. Someone was still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had come from hallway A, so I cautiously went to check. What I saw was something I had been wholly unprepared to see.
entries.literal: "It had come from hallway A, so I cautiously went to check. What I saw was something I had been wholly unprepared to see."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's... me. It's totally me.
entries.literal: "It's... me. It's totally me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw my own back, walking away.{w} I immediately understood where I'd gone. Definitely more than fifteen minutes back, to the point where I'd circled around the crystal floor hallways.
entries.literal: "I saw my own back, walking away.{w} I immediately understood where I'd gone. Definitely more than fifteen minutes back, to the point where I'd circled around the crystal floor hallways."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When my past self disappeared toward hallway C, I calmly stepped out of the room. I knew I'd come from the other door and wouldn't see myself.
entries.literal: "When my past self disappeared toward hallway C, I calmly stepped out of the room. I knew I'd come from the other door and wouldn't see myself."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I see. So I went about twenty minutes into the past, and I can't precisely know what point the location was based on. Most likely a recent one, though.
entries.literal: "I see. So I went about twenty minutes into the past, and I can't precisely know what point the location was based on. Most likely a recent one, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With only that, I wasn't any closer to understanding anything. I could at least be sure that the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet was related to the distance traveled and that they weren't equal; more time was traveled than the Sekimeiya spent building up energy... at least at fifteen minutes and above.
entries.literal: "With only that, I wasn't any closer to understanding anything. I could at least be sure that the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet was related to the distance traveled and that they weren't equal; more time was traveled than the Sekimeiya spent building up energy... at least at fifteen minutes and above."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put my hand in my right pocket and saw that I had the locker key. That meant the replicated location was restricted to the time where I'd been in the event room after I found it. I could make out that it wasn't Naomi's.
entries.literal: "I put my hand in my right pocket and saw that I had the locker key. That meant the replicated location was restricted to the time where I'd been in the event room after I found it. I could make out that it wasn't Naomi's."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In any case, I had a little while where I could move while my past self protected the Sekimeiya. As long as nothing happened to the present me, I'd be able to enter the staff room right after traveling from it.
entries.literal: "In any case, I had a little while where I could move while my past self protected the Sekimeiya. As long as nothing happened to the present me, I'd be able to enter the staff room right after traveling from it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was almost intimidated by my past self, who was very close to me and putting conscious effort into hearing any noise. Until he shut himself in the staff room, I wouldn't be comfortable looking around for anyone. Then again, it was incredibly unlikely the Shiroya I was searching for was close by.
entries.literal: "I was almost intimidated by my past self, who was very close to me and putting conscious effort into hearing any noise. Until he shut himself in the staff room, I wouldn't be comfortable looking around for anyone. Then again, it was incredibly unlikely the Shiroya I was searching for was close by."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So I decided to start going upstairs, feeling forced out by an old version of me I had been minutes prior. Fully comprehending how absurd it all was, I silently stepped to hallway C.
entries.literal: "So I decided to start going upstairs, feeling forced out by an old version of me I had been minutes prior. Fully comprehending how absurd it all was, I silently stepped to hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something that I hadn't seen before caught my attention. It was the drop of blood Shiroya spotted next to the stairs. I looked at it closely and determined that it was just about done drying up.
entries.literal: "Something that I hadn't seen before caught my attention. It was the drop of blood Shiroya spotted next to the stairs. I looked at it closely and determined that it was just about done drying up."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This one has to belong to Sai. The others are too old to match the blood he had in his mouth, but this one fits perfectly.
entries.literal: "This one has to belong to Sai. The others are too old to match the blood he had in his mouth, but this one fits perfectly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could he have traveled, replicated the blood in the past, and left older-looking drops? At that point, I had no idea, but I felt certain that something abnormal was behind all the drops we'd found.
entries.literal: "Could he have traveled, replicated the blood in the past, and left older-looking drops? At that point, I had no idea, but I felt certain that something abnormal was behind all the drops we'd found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I had to take Sai's word for it, the one in the lobby belonged to Shiroya, while he hadn't known about the one in the event room. It wasn't only that I didn't want to believe it, I also didn't know how that could be true. The other Shiroya hadn't looked injured at all during the brief moment I'd seen her, so I couldn't assume it came from her.
entries.literal: "If I had to take Sai's word for it, the one in the lobby belonged to Shiroya, while he hadn't known about the one in the event room. It wasn't only that I didn't want to believe it, I also didn't know how that could be true. The other Shiroya hadn't looked injured at all during the brief moment I'd seen her, so I couldn't assume it came from her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up the stairs since I wanted to look through every floor. I thought about making my presence known by using the elevator, but I decided against it.
entries.literal: "I walked up the stairs since I wanted to look through every floor. I thought about making my presence known by using the elevator, but I decided against it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I arrived on the second floor and felt, once again, a desolate atmosphere. I wasn't sure what my goal was anymore, but I looked around the bathrooms and offices.
entries.literal: "I arrived on the second floor and felt, once again, a desolate atmosphere. I wasn't sure what my goal was anymore, but I looked around the bathrooms and offices."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I was alone, I wanted to be sure about it. Every time I opened a door, I felt my heart resonating within me, remembering that it was possible I was about to find what the culprit had done to Sai and Shiroya.
entries.literal: "If I was alone, I wanted to be sure about it. Every time I opened a door, I felt my heart resonating within me, remembering that it was possible I was about to find what the culprit had done to Sai and Shiroya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I forcibly expelled that thought from my mind. There was no way Shiroya could suddenly die like that.{w} ...But as much as I tried to reassure myself of that, Miiya's abrupt end pressed down on the back of my head.
entries.literal: "I forcibly expelled that thought from my mind. There was no way Shiroya could suddenly die like that.{w} ...But as much as I tried to reassure myself of that, Miiya's abrupt end pressed down on the back of my head."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only one thing backed me up: if the Shiroya with different clothes was a result of a future travel, the original Shiroya was definitely safe.
entries.literal: "Only one thing backed me up: if the Shiroya with different clothes was a result of a future travel, the original Shiroya was definitely safe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...After dealing with the second floor, I went to the third, finding my existence there surreal.
entries.literal: "...After dealing with the second floor, I went to the third, finding my existence there surreal."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Reluctant to find anything, I repeated the process above as my isolation intensified.
entries.literal: "Reluctant to find anything, I repeated the process above as my isolation intensified."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The fourth and fifth floors weren't any different. Was someone still deliberately hiding from me? If they were the killer, why didn't they just try to take me out?
entries.literal: "The fourth and fifth floors weren't any different. Was someone still deliberately hiding from me? If they were the killer, why didn't they just try to take me out?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was in the perfect defenseless position, so if anyone wanted to harm me, that was their best chance. Going off the fact that nothing had happened to me yet, I tried to stop myself from getting too paranoid.
entries.literal: "I was in the perfect defenseless position, so if anyone wanted to harm me, that was their best chance. Going off the fact that nothing had happened to me yet, I tried to stop myself from getting too paranoid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As usual, I first glanced inside the floor 6 bathrooms to find out they were empty. Subsequently, I entered the three partitions, but I didn't see anyone either.
entries.literal: "As usual, I first glanced inside the floor 6 bathrooms to find out they were empty. Subsequently, I entered the three partitions, but I didn't see anyone either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Lastly, I walked up to the attic's door to search through the final section of the tower.
entries.literal: "Lastly, I walked up to the attic's door to search through the final section of the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=1.6}I instantly understood that I had forgotten a crucial detail.{w} I couldn't open the door since Shiroya had recently locked it. Not only that, she'd kept the key.
entries.literal: "{w=1.6}I instantly understood that I had forgotten a crucial detail.{w} I couldn't open the door since Shiroya had recently locked it. Not only that, she'd kept the key."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This isn't good... I'm locked out of the attic.
entries.literal: "This isn't good... I'm locked out of the attic."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Could it be they appeared inside and can't exit?
entries.literal: "Could it be they appeared inside and can't exit?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knocked on the door and yelled Shiroya's name a few times, but there was no response.
entries.literal: "I knocked on the door and yelled Shiroya's name a few times, but there was no response."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That doesn't make sense, though. If Shiroya appeared in the attic, her replicated location wouldn't yet have had the key, but Sai definitely would have appeared with it since he was able to chase us inside.
entries.literal: "That doesn't make sense, though. If Shiroya appeared in the attic, her replicated location wouldn't yet have had the key, but Sai definitely would have appeared with it since he was able to chase us inside."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And even if neither of them has it, they'd still have the elevator. From the inside, they could freely call it and go down.
entries.literal: "And even if neither of them has it, they'd still have the elevator. From the inside, they could freely call it and go down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, unless it had been disabled somewhere. I hadn't been checking every elevator door, which I realized had been a mistake.
entries.literal: "Of course, unless it had been disabled somewhere. I hadn't been checking every elevator door, which I realized had been a mistake."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to open the door on the sixth floor, which proved that the elevator wasn't there. Calling it was a bad idea—it would prevent me from knowing where it was beforehand.
entries.literal: "I tried to open the door on the sixth floor, which proved that the elevator wasn't there. Calling it was a bad idea—it would prevent me from knowing where it was beforehand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked down to the fifth floor and once again attempted to open the elevator to no avail.
entries.literal: "I walked down to the fifth floor and once again attempted to open the elevator to no avail."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I circled the corridors to end up on the fourth floor, but the elevator wasn't there either. I felt like the next attempt would be correct—the third floor was where Shiroya and I had been intercepted.
entries.literal: "I circled the corridors to end up on the fourth floor, but the elevator wasn't there either. I felt like the next attempt would be correct—the third floor was where Shiroya and I had been intercepted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And, as I suspected, the door opened.
entries.literal: "And, as I suspected, the door opened."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It hasn't been used since then, I suppose. I wonder if Sai prepared something in case we used it to escape.
entries.literal: "It hasn't been used since then, I suppose. I wonder if Sai prepared something in case we used it to escape."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Regardless, the door was closed, so it could have been called from the attic.
entries.literal: "Regardless, the door was closed, so it could have been called from the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was as frustrating as it was frightening to think about. Had the culprit been in the attic and prevented them from leaving? I discarded that thought, wanting to believe they'd appeared outside the tower.
entries.literal: "It was as frustrating as it was frightening to think about. Had the culprit been in the attic and prevented them from leaving? I discarded that thought, wanting to believe they'd appeared outside the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Did that really make sense, though? If Shiroya appeared outside the tower, her first move would be to tell the police about the secret door. They would have knocked it down from the outside as soon as she had disappeared.
entries.literal: "Did that really make sense, though? If Shiroya appeared outside the tower, her first move would be to tell the police about the secret door. They would have knocked it down from the outside as soon as she had disappeared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...No matter the case, with the key, the attic was a perfect place to hide from me.
entries.literal: "...No matter the case, with the key, the attic was a perfect place to hide from me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If the other Shiroya was still present and had it, it was possible I wouldn't see her in the next three hours. While her face and body were Shiroya's, I was having trouble accepting her as the same person. I'd only seen her for a couple of seconds, but her very existence felt alien, and even the Shiroya I was with thought they couldn't be one and the same.
entries.literal: "If the other Shiroya was still present and had it, it was possible I wouldn't see her in the next three hours. While her face and body were Shiroya's, I was having trouble accepting her as the same person. I'd only seen her for a couple of seconds, but her very existence felt alien, and even the Shiroya I was with thought they couldn't be one and the same."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I simply didn't know what to think. I'd done all I could on the office floors, and I had to accept that entering the attic would be impossible.
entries.literal: "I simply didn't know what to think. I'd done all I could on the office floors, and I had to accept that entering the attic would be impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started to go back down, paying as much attention to my surroundings as possible. Soon, my quiet steps reached the last staircase, leading to the floor where my past self still was.
entries.literal: "I started to go back down, paying as much attention to my surroundings as possible. Soon, my quiet steps reached the last staircase, leading to the floor where my past self still was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew I hadn't looked through every room below yet, but I still felt that task to be too perilous, knowing any sound could alert the Atsuki in the staff room.
entries.literal: "I knew I hadn't looked through every room below yet, but I still felt that task to be too perilous, knowing any sound could alert the Atsuki in the staff room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Therefore, I decided to first look through hallway A, which Shiroya and I didn't have time to start before Sai reappeared. After that, I'd wait for my past self to disappear.
entries.literal: "Therefore, I decided to first look through hallway A, which Shiroya and I didn't have time to start before Sai reappeared. After that, I'd wait for my past self to disappear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I carefully walked down the stairs and directed myself toward the storeroom.
entries.literal: "I carefully walked down the stairs and directed myself toward the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't been in there since Sai and Shiroya traveled together, but there was no change that caught my eye. Knowing whether the door had recently opened was impossible.
entries.literal: "I hadn't been in there since Sai and Shiroya traveled together, but there was no change that caught my eye. Knowing whether the door had recently opened was impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I opened the next door, something stood out. One of the cabinets had its lid open and leaning on the wall. I frowned while trying to understand if that made sense.
entries.literal: "As soon as I opened the next door, something stood out. One of the cabinets had its lid open and leaning on the wall. I frowned while trying to understand if that made sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Inside it was Isla. It was the cabinet where she'd been found. But I knew it had been closed the last time I was there.
entries.literal: "Inside it was Isla. It was the cabinet where she'd been found. But I knew it had been closed the last time I was there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And that was just before I saw Katei's death. I looked at every room, and there's no way I left this cabinet open.
entries.literal: "And that was just before I saw Katei's death. I looked at every room, and there's no way I left this cabinet open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was it a confirmation that someone else was still with me? Sai and the other Shiroya were the two likely candidates to have done it...{w} I was more confused than surprised. Why would someone have opened that cabinet... and left it open?
entries.literal: "Was it a confirmation that someone else was still with me? Sai and the other Shiroya were the two likely candidates to have done it...{w} I was more confused than surprised. Why would someone have opened that cabinet... and left it open?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no need to leave Isla's body on display, so I gingerly lowered the lid. I scanned the rest of the room, but I found nothing else of importance.
entries.literal: "There was no need to leave Isla's body on display, so I gingerly lowered the lid. I scanned the rest of the room, but I found nothing else of importance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Afterward, I proceeded with the search, my expectations of finding something suddenly higher.
entries.literal: "Afterward, I proceeded with the search, my expectations of finding something suddenly higher."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But every room was empty. I still didn't want to make any accidental noise, so I only took a peek at them. I finished at the security room, where the scene of Katei's death appeared essentially unchanged.
entries.literal: "But every room was empty. I still didn't want to make any accidental noise, so I only took a peek at them. I finished at the security room, where the scene of Katei's death appeared essentially unchanged."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved the chair and looked at the computer, which displayed {time=18:24.} I felt that going back to the staff room at {time=18:30} was appropriate, but I didn't want to risk being too early.
entries.literal: "I moved the chair and looked at the computer, which displayed {time=18:24.} I felt that going back to the staff room at {time=18:30} was appropriate, but I didn't want to risk being too early."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't exactly the most comforting room with the state Katei was in, but I decided to stay there for the remainder of the time since it gave me access to the computer's clock.
entries.literal: "It wasn't exactly the most comforting room with the state Katei was in, but I decided to stay there for the remainder of the time since it gave me access to the computer's clock."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His face was under his desk, so I didn't have to look at it, and the unsettling smell of blood quickly became an afterthought. Standing straight and with a blank mind, I stiffly waited for the time to pass.
entries.literal: "His face was under his desk, so I didn't have to look at it, and the unsettling smell of blood quickly became an afterthought. Standing straight and with a blank mind, I stiffly waited for the time to pass."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Until I remembered the chase from earlier.{w} I kneeled beside Katei and put my hand in the pocket where he'd kept most of his keys.
entries.literal: "...Until I remembered the chase from earlier.{w} I kneeled beside Katei and put my hand in the pocket where he'd kept most of his keys."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's not here... the key to the bathrooms. All the others are, though. His killer must've picked it up, or maybe it was Sai, if they're not the same person. Regardless, it definitely would've been a bad idea to hide inside one.
entries.literal: "It's not here... the key to the bathrooms. All the others are, though. His killer must've picked it up, or maybe it was Sai, if they're not the same person. Regardless, it definitely would've been a bad idea to hide inside one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Upon further inspection, I realized that the rusty key, which he'd kept in another pocket, was gone too.
entries.literal: "Upon further inspection, I realized that the rusty key, which he'd kept in another pocket, was gone too."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: They also took that old-looking key... Was the person who originally dropped it in hallway A responsible for this?{w} Maybe that's not it. I've been thinking that someone could enter the tower through the storeroom, but if that key belonged to that door, maybe they'd need it from the outside. I'm not sure they would try picking it up to appear in the past with it because their replicated locations holding the key would all be inside the tower...
entries.literal: "They also took that old-looking key... Was the person who originally dropped it in hallway A responsible for this?{w} Maybe that's not it. I've been thinking that someone could enter the tower through the storeroom, but if that key belonged to that door, maybe they'd need it from the outside. I'm not sure they would try picking it up to appear in the past with it because their replicated locations holding the key would all be inside the tower..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Unless I go back to thinking about thought-up loops, I guess. There could be something that would work.{w} The person who killed Katei took that rusty key and walked out of the tower through the storeroom door, which was open. That created a location outside the tower where they were holding the key that could be replicated. Then, they reentered and used the Sekimeiya to go back in time. In the past, they appeared outside the tower holding the key, so they were able to unlock the door and reenter with something they'd obtained outside—like a knife. They left the door open so that their past self could exit with the key and create the replicated location.
entries.literal: "Unless I go back to thinking about thought-up loops, I guess. There could be something that would work.{w} The person who killed Katei took that rusty key and walked out of the tower through the storeroom door, which was open. That created a location outside the tower where they were holding the key that could be replicated. Then, they reentered and used the Sekimeiya to go back in time. In the past, they appeared outside the tower holding the key, so they were able to unlock the door and reenter with something they'd obtained outside—like a knife. They left the door open so that their past self could exit with the key and create the replicated location."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Would that work? The key isn't here, so I can't even attempt it. But if the culprit's plan was to leave with the Sekimeiya, they would've been able to achieve it very easily by doing this.
entries.literal: "Would that work? The key isn't here, so I can't even attempt it. But if the culprit's plan was to leave with the Sekimeiya, they would've been able to achieve it very easily by doing this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood back up, trying not to meet Katei's eyes. When I glanced around the room again, I became aware of an obvious detail.
entries.literal: "I stood back up, trying not to meet Katei's eyes. When I glanced around the room again, I became aware of an obvious detail."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Hang on, this is strange.
entries.literal: "Hang on, this is strange."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The computer's screen is lit, meaning that someone used it in the past fifty minutes. It was exactly {time=17} when we found Katei's body, so it's been far more than that.
entries.literal: "The computer's screen is lit, meaning that someone used it in the past fifty minutes. It was exactly {time=17} when we found Katei's body, so it's been far more than that."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I suppose Sai did say he saw Katei here. Unless someone else was here semi-recently, he saw it after us.
entries.literal: "I suppose Sai did say he saw Katei here. Unless someone else was here semi-recently, he saw it after us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What I found most strange was that the three screens looked identical to how they had at {time=17.}
entries.literal: "What I found most strange was that the three screens looked identical to how they had at {time=17.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased". That same message was on the side I'd dragged it to, and behind it was the security camera program.
entries.literal: "\"{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased\". That same message was on the side I'd dragged it to, and behind it was the security camera program."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the mouse and clicked on its "accept" button. The program used a pretty complicated interface, and I didn't know what many things meant. As I'd seen before, there was a list of all the cameras on the left.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the mouse and clicked on its \"accept\" button. The program used a pretty complicated interface, and I didn't know what many things meant. As I'd seen before, there was a list of all the cameras on the left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I looked at it again, I saw that one in particular was selected, named "RECAM_12_01". I brought the cursor over and tried to view it.
entries.literal: "When I looked at it again, I saw that one in particular was selected, named \"RECAM_12_01\". I brought the cursor over and tried to view it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But an error sound played, accompanied by the same message. "{time=10:04}: {tip=camera}Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased{/tip}".
entries.literal: "But an error sound played, accompanied by the same message. \"{time=10:04}: {tip=camera}Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased{/tip}\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It appeared we really couldn't look at the footage, but the message still felt like it too obviously incriminated Katei. I let go of the mouse and stepped aside from the computer.
entries.literal: "It appeared we really couldn't look at the footage, but the message still felt like it too obviously incriminated Katei. I let go of the mouse and stepped aside from the computer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to think if the selected camera meant anything, but I had nothing to work with. Instead, I did what I'd planned to do and managed to let go of my thoughts until the time came.
entries.literal: "I tried to think if the selected camera meant anything, but I had nothing to work with. Instead, I did what I'd planned to do and managed to let go of my thoughts until the time came."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At {time=18:30}, I left the room. It was time to reunite with the Sekimeiya, so I went to hallway B through the event room.
entries.literal: "At {time=18:30}, I left the room. It was time to reunite with the Sekimeiya, so I went to hallway B through the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The staff room was closed, like I'd left it. Warily, I stepped up to it and turned the knob.
entries.literal: "The staff room was closed, like I'd left it. Warily, I stepped up to it and turned the knob."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pushed the door open and saw the gray Sekimeiya on the floor.{w} Since everything had gone as expected, I entered, reclaiming my place as the sole Atsuki.
entries.literal: "I pushed the door open and saw the gray Sekimeiya on the floor.{w} Since everything had gone as expected, I entered, reclaiming my place as the sole Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was relieved that nothing unexpected had occurred. I knew that I couldn't stop looking for Shiroya yet, so I picked up the Sekimeiya and put it in the newly accessible locker.
entries.literal: "I was relieved that nothing unexpected had occurred. I knew that I couldn't stop looking for Shiroya yet, so I picked up the Sekimeiya and put it in the newly accessible locker."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's good that I still have the key. If the replicated location was from earlier, I would've lost it. I shouldn't have traveled holding it, just in case.
entries.literal: "It's good that I still have the key. If the replicated location was from earlier, I would've lost it. I shouldn't have traveled holding it, just in case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the Sekimeiya above and closed the door. Then, I proceeded to lock it so that I would be able to wander around without leaving it easily accessible.
entries.literal: "I left the Sekimeiya above and closed the door. Then, I proceeded to lock it so that I would be able to wander around without leaving it easily accessible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I quickly became indecisive. Perhaps it was smarter to bring it with me while I searched so that I had an emergency escape method.
entries.literal: "I quickly became indecisive. Perhaps it was smarter to bring it with me while I searched so that I had an emergency escape method."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Having to constantly fear my death was disheartening, to say the least. While I decided, I sat next to the middle lockers. Maybe staying there was a better idea. I couldn't enter the attic, but it was clear that anyone remaining in the tower didn't want to show themselves.
entries.literal: "Having to constantly fear my death was disheartening, to say the least. While I decided, I sat next to the middle lockers. Maybe staying there was a better idea. I couldn't enter the attic, but it was clear that anyone remaining in the tower didn't want to show themselves."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt I had to look through the hallway B rooms before deciding to stop. I prayed that Shiroya was safe, but I could only assume that she wasn't nearby anymore.
entries.literal: "I felt I had to look through the hallway B rooms before deciding to stop. I prayed that Shiroya was safe, but I could only assume that she wasn't nearby anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I might've already been in the tower for longer than the initially proposed twelve hours. Adding all the time I'd relived by traveling through time, I figured I was minutes away from meeting the mark.
entries.literal: "I might've already been in the tower for longer than the initially proposed twelve hours. Adding all the time I'd relived by traveling through time, I figured I was minutes away from meeting the mark."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again thoroughly regretting my choice to ever set foot inside that building, I stood up to make sure a nightmare didn't await in hallway B.
entries.literal: "Once again thoroughly regretting my choice to ever set foot inside that building, I stood up to make sure a nightmare didn't await in hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had repeatedly considered that my hours in the tower were a dream. Had I already accepted the reality in which a time travel device existed? No matter what everything was leading to, would the world undergo a drastic change upon being exposed to the Sekimeiya? I'd wanted that day to be the first day of my new life with Shiroya... but was it set to be a turning point for every human being?
entries.literal: "I had repeatedly considered that my hours in the tower were a dream. Had I already accepted the reality in which a time travel device existed? No matter what everything was leading to, would the world undergo a drastic change upon being exposed to the Sekimeiya? I'd wanted that day to be the first day of my new life with Shiroya... but was it set to be a turning point for every human being?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The item I'd just locked away... What was it going to be responsible for? I felt like it had nearly broken when it fell in the event room, something that might honestly have been for the better.
entries.literal: "The item I'd just locked away... What was it going to be responsible for? I felt like it had nearly broken when it fell in the event room, something that might honestly have been for the better."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was walking to the door when I turned to glance at the locker. The thought of breaking the Sekimeiya crossed my mind, but my eyes locked on one spot for another reason.
entries.literal: "I was walking to the door when I turned to glance at the locker. The thought of breaking the Sekimeiya crossed my mind, but my eyes locked on one spot for another reason."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...There was something on the floor—to the left of where I'd been sitting. I approached it and saw a small piece of paper, hastily folded.
entries.literal: "...There was something on the floor—to the left of where I'd been sitting. I approached it and saw a small piece of paper, hastily folded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naturally, I frowned. I didn't recognize it from anywhere in the tower.
entries.literal: "Naturally, I frowned. I didn't recognize it from anywhere in the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed it and scanned its contents. A few lines of text had been written in black.
entries.literal: "I grabbed it and scanned its contents. A few lines of text had been written in black."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But before I read it, I had already stopped breathing. A single peek made my hand begin to tremble and my thoughts collapse entirely.
entries.literal: "But before I read it, I had already stopped breathing. A single peek made my hand begin to tremble and my thoughts collapse entirely."

entries.text: Fractal Freefall
entries.literal: "Fractal Freefall"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One day, before the afternoon ended, you could see the figures of two young students on a bench, letting a cold breeze hit their faces while they looked at the park they'd grown to love.
entries.literal: "One day, before the afternoon ended, you could see the figures of two young students on a bench, letting a cold breeze hit their faces while they looked at the park they'd grown to love."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They had been talking for a while, so they proceeded to quietly look at the younger kids run around, making good use of the last few minutes of sunlight.
entries.literal: "They had been talking for a while, so they proceeded to quietly look at the younger kids run around, making good use of the last few minutes of sunlight."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were a boy and a girl who had known each other for many years. For that reason, the level of trust they'd built allowed them to feel a peaceful warmth just by being next to each other.
entries.literal: "They were a boy and a girl who had known each other for many years. For that reason, the level of trust they'd built allowed them to feel a peaceful warmth just by being next to each other."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, after the other kids left, they would do so as well. After walking down a few streets, one of the two would take a different turn to complete the day on their own.
entries.literal: "Soon, after the other kids left, they would do so as well. After walking down a few streets, one of the two would take a different turn to complete the day on their own."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was a routine they were happy with and felt lucky to share. The boy let his mind relax, looking at the sky as it began to darken. It would soon be the winter, and the temperature would attempt to hinder those moments.{w} That was why he did as much as he could to enjoy the scenery he'd been granted, hoping the girl at his side was doing the same.
entries.literal: "That was a routine they were happy with and felt lucky to share. The boy let his mind relax, looking at the sky as it began to darken. It would soon be the winter, and the temperature would attempt to hinder those moments.{w} That was why he did as much as he could to enjoy the scenery he'd been granted, hoping the girl at his side was doing the same."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, the silence was their cue to leave. Their gazes met again, confirming that it was time. They stood up from the bench and realized that they were much colder than they'd thought.
entries.literal: "Eventually, the silence was their cue to leave. Their gazes met again, confirming that it was time. They stood up from the bench and realized that they were much colder than they'd thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were about to stretch their limbs when an overwhelming light took over their sight. They lost control of their bodies and felt as if they were about to faint.{w} When they next opened their eyes, they were unable to recognize their surroundings.
entries.literal: "They were about to stretch their limbs when an overwhelming light took over their sight. They lost control of their bodies and felt as if they were about to faint.{w} When they next opened their eyes, they were unable to recognize their surroundings."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were together, and they started to throw out questions to each other. Despite what they had experienced, they felt well physically.
entries.literal: "They were together, and they started to throw out questions to each other. Despite what they had experienced, they felt well physically."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room where they found themselves had a haunting feeling to it; it was dark but spacious. Neither of them knew where they were, and they quickly saw that there wasn't a door in any of the walls.
entries.literal: "The room where they found themselves had a haunting feeling to it; it was dark but spacious. Neither of them knew where they were, and they quickly saw that there wasn't a door in any of the walls."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Their experience had felt so surreal that just by seeing that the other was still there, their hearts refrained from building up terror and panic. Trying to stay calm, they looked around the room to find any clue as to their whereabouts.
entries.literal: "Their experience had felt so surreal that just by seeing that the other was still there, their hearts refrained from building up terror and panic. Trying to stay calm, they looked around the room to find any clue as to their whereabouts."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Very soon, the girl spotted a few words on the floor. When the boy read them, they could only share stares to see how the other had interpreted them.
entries.literal: "Very soon, the girl spotted a few words on the floor. When the boy read them, they could only share stares to see how the other had interpreted them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Both of you will spend one hundred years in this space. Once you exceed that time, you'll be brought back to your lives, but only one of you will keep your memories of your stay here."
entries.literal: "\"Both of you will spend one hundred years in this space. Once you exceed that time, you'll be brought back to your lives, but only one of you will keep your memories of your stay here.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They kept reading those ridiculous words, left in pink on the floor. Despite how nonsensical they sounded, they didn't question them. The room had two beds, no bathroom, and no kitchen. Not the conditions any human could live in.
entries.literal: "They kept reading those ridiculous words, left in pink on the floor. Despite how nonsensical they sounded, they didn't question them. The room had two beds, no bathroom, and no kitchen. Not the conditions any human could live in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Close to the letters, they found another strange sentence. It said: "Once a day, you can ask for an object to materialize, and the previous one will disappear. This is only as entertainment—so that your minds don't break."
entries.literal: "Close to the letters, they found another strange sentence. It said: \"Once a day, you can ask for an object to materialize, and the previous one will disappear. This is only as entertainment—so that your minds don't break.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of laughing at it, the boy tried it out. The way he attempted it was by thinking about the object he wanted to create.{w} Instantly, in midair, a red ball appeared. After gravity made it bounce on the floor a few times, he was left speechless by the result of his thought.
entries.literal: "Instead of laughing at it, the boy tried it out. The way he attempted it was by thinking about the object he wanted to create.{w} Instantly, in midair, a red ball appeared. After gravity made it bounce on the floor a few times, he was left speechless by the result of his thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he explained what had happened to the girl, they understood their fate would play out as predicted. They had to spend a hundred years in a bizarre world where their thoughts could materialize items but they themselves were restricted by the four walls of the room.
entries.literal: "When he explained what had happened to the girl, they understood their fate would play out as predicted. They had to spend a hundred years in a bizarre world where their thoughts could materialize items but they themselves were restricted by the four walls of the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So, the first thing they did was speak to each other. In their immediate future, it looked like a nightmare might've awaited them. Being trapped in a single room where they couldn't die sounded terrifying, but since they were together, they attempted to reassure each other by starting a pointless conversation about what had happened.
entries.literal: "So, the first thing they did was speak to each other. In their immediate future, it looked like a nightmare might've awaited them. Being trapped in a single room where they couldn't die sounded terrifying, but since they were together, they attempted to reassure each other by starting a pointless conversation about what had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When they realized it was working, the conversation stopped being forced. Neither of them looked particularly afraid, let alone terrified. They kept talking like they would every day after school, knowing what their future potentially held in store.
entries.literal: "When they realized it was working, the conversation stopped being forced. Neither of them looked particularly afraid, let alone terrified. They kept talking like they would every day after school, knowing what their future potentially held in store."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The dreamlike setting they had been forced into didn't seem like much of a dream to them. Why had they been trapped? How were they going to survive for a hundred years? Why could their thoughts materialize objects? They knew all those questions were valid, but they simply accepted things for what they were.
entries.literal: "The dreamlike setting they had been forced into didn't seem like much of a dream to them. Why had they been trapped? How were they going to survive for a hundred years? Why could their thoughts materialize objects? They knew all those questions were valid, but they simply accepted things for what they were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the floor was the red ball, which had been the boy's first thought in response to the words he'd read. They weren't going to start playing with it, but something new every day sounded like a curious proposition that could keep them sane in the far future.
entries.literal: "On the floor was the red ball, which had been the boy's first thought in response to the words he'd read. They weren't going to start playing with it, but something new every day sounded like a curious proposition that could keep them sane in the far future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They soon understood that there was no way to measure the time, so they'd have to count the days themselves, using the daily objects. It had been late in the day in their old world, and their physical tiredness had carried over. At one point, they decided to lie on the beds and quickly fell asleep.
entries.literal: "They soon understood that there was no way to measure the time, so they'd have to count the days themselves, using the daily objects. It had been late in the day in their old world, and their physical tiredness had carried over. At one point, they decided to lie on the beds and quickly fell asleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before doing so, the boy thought about what had happened. He was surprised not to feel many negative emotions nor the desire to go back to the real world. He couldn't call it being carefree, but he woke up well-rested nonetheless.
entries.literal: "Before doing so, the boy thought about what had happened. He was surprised not to feel many negative emotions nor the desire to go back to the real world. He couldn't call it being carefree, but he woke up well-rested nonetheless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The ball was still on the floor, and they could only create a new object when it disappeared. Soon, when the girl woke up, they exchanged sleepy looks they'd rarely ever seen on each other before.
entries.literal: "The ball was still on the floor, and they could only create a new object when it disappeared. Soon, when the girl woke up, they exchanged sleepy looks they'd rarely ever seen on each other before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was still the first day, but they already felt comfortable. Accepting that nothing had been a dream, they started to talk and began a long bed-to-bed conversation.
entries.literal: "It was still the first day, but they already felt comfortable. Accepting that nothing had been a dream, they started to talk and began a long bed-to-bed conversation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even when it ended, they didn't feel alone. That prevented them from seeing their future as grim.
entries.literal: "Even when it ended, they didn't feel alone. That prevented them from seeing their future as grim."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Three days later, nothing had changed. They were perhaps as far from home as any person could be, but they still found themselves able to produce any topic and talk naturally, appreciating that they had each other more than ever.
entries.literal: "Three days later, nothing had changed. They were perhaps as far from home as any person could be, but they still found themselves able to produce any topic and talk naturally, appreciating that they had each other more than ever."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They'd agreed they would trade off on deciding an object per day, but they quickly found that they didn't have many good ideas. The girl had always wanted a spinning egg chair, so she thought of one big enough to put her whole body in.{w} It turned out to be exactly as she'd wanted it, so she spent the full 24 hours inside with a joyful expression.
entries.literal: "They'd agreed they would trade off on deciding an object per day, but they quickly found that they didn't have many good ideas. The girl had always wanted a spinning egg chair, so she thought of one big enough to put her whole body in.{w} It turned out to be exactly as she'd wanted it, so she spent the full 24 hours inside with a joyful expression."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next day, the boy couldn't think of anything. He thought of trying to spawn food, curious to see what would happen, but after running down some failed ideas, he decided to call for the same chair.
entries.literal: "The next day, the boy couldn't think of anything. He thought of trying to spawn food, curious to see what would happen, but after running down some failed ideas, he decided to call for the same chair."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It would soon be the girl's turn again. She was looking up at the red top of her chair while the boy stared at the room's ceiling in the same way. Suddenly, words vibrated through the air.
entries.literal: "It would soon be the girl's turn again. She was looking up at the red top of her chair while the boy stared at the room's ceiling in the same way. Suddenly, words vibrated through the air."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I love you."
entries.literal: "\"I love you.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The girl peeked out from the chair in disbelief at what she'd heard. She saw the boy who had been her closest friend for so many years nonchalantly lying on his back.
entries.literal: "The girl peeked out from the chair in disbelief at what she'd heard. She saw the boy who had been her closest friend for so many years nonchalantly lying on his back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But that was far from how he felt inside. He couldn't believe he'd said it. Just after those three days, her overwhelming presence had prevented him from holding back what he'd been wanting to say for years.
entries.literal: "But that was far from how he felt inside. He couldn't believe he'd said it. Just after those three days, her overwhelming presence had prevented him from holding back what he'd been wanting to say for years."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He'd always wanted to tell her how much he enjoyed being with her and how thankful he was for it, but he never knew how to truly express his affection... That was why he'd grown sad, knowing that their relationship had been built with only implied trust and fondness.
entries.literal: "He'd always wanted to tell her how much he enjoyed being with her and how thankful he was for it, but he never knew how to truly express his affection... That was why he'd grown sad, knowing that their relationship had been built with only implied trust and fondness."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For that reason, the first time he let his emotions burst out, they had automatically taken the form of those simple words. While he'd been wanting to say them for a long time, he wasn't scared the reception might've been negative. He'd simply never been able to bring himself to do it, justifying it as being disconnected.{w} As soon as their new reality had been presented to them, he'd understood that he couldn't spend all that time suppressing his honest and natural feelings.
entries.literal: "For that reason, the first time he let his emotions burst out, they had automatically taken the form of those simple words. While he'd been wanting to say them for a long time, he wasn't scared the reception might've been negative. He'd simply never been able to bring himself to do it, justifying it as being disconnected.{w} As soon as their new reality had been presented to them, he'd understood that he couldn't spend all that time suppressing his honest and natural feelings."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And after saying it, his heart was pounding, like it was trying to break out of his body. He'd imagined the situation and many different outcomes, so he continued to look at the ceiling, awaiting whichever one would actually happen. He kept his mind as serene as possible in the eternity between confession and response—he was prevented from leaving the room even if he wanted to.
entries.literal: "And after saying it, his heart was pounding, like it was trying to break out of his body. He'd imagined the situation and many different outcomes, so he continued to look at the ceiling, awaiting whichever one would actually happen. He kept his mind as serene as possible in the eternity between confession and response—he was prevented from leaving the room even if he wanted to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "...Really? I definitely didn't think so. That's surprising."{w} She had a smile on her face and looked genuinely happy. Looking down and seeing it, the boy sighed in relief, knowing that no matter what would happen, he wouldn't regret having said it.
entries.literal: "\"...Really? I definitely didn't think so. That's surprising.\"{w} She had a smile on her face and looked genuinely happy. Looking down and seeing it, the boy sighed in relief, knowing that no matter what would happen, he wouldn't regret having said it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But as it turned out, that wasn't the end of it.{w} "I've liked you for a long time too. I was pretty scared to say it."{w} Keeping the same smile, she let him know his feelings were shared.
entries.literal: "But as it turned out, that wasn't the end of it.{w} \"I've liked you for a long time too. I was pretty scared to say it.\"{w} Keeping the same smile, she let him know his feelings were shared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The boy wasn't sure how to feel or respond. He wasn't good with his own emotions, but if he'd looked at their situation from the outside, he would've thought that both of them liked each other. Despite that, he had never truly believed it.
entries.literal: "The boy wasn't sure how to feel or respond. He wasn't good with his own emotions, but if he'd looked at their situation from the outside, he would've thought that both of them liked each other. Despite that, he had never truly believed it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They managed to start up a conversation so that the mood didn't fade. There were many things they wanted to say and many questions to ask.{w} Since when, how much...? The girl knew her chair would soon disappear, so she left it for her bed, where they kept talking until they fell asleep.
entries.literal: "They managed to start up a conversation so that the mood didn't fade. There were many things they wanted to say and many questions to ask.{w} Since when, how much...? The girl knew her chair would soon disappear, so she left it for her bed, where they kept talking until they fell asleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was the beginning of the time they spent together. They had so many moments to reminisce about, and many things they wanted to do. The days began to pass, and the same uplifting atmosphere stayed with them.
entries.literal: "That was the beginning of the time they spent together. They had so many moments to reminisce about, and many things they wanted to do. The days began to pass, and the same uplifting atmosphere stayed with them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once he'd made the necessary step, the boy started to open his heart, no longer restricting himself. Elated to see it, the girl responded the same way, strengthening the unbreakable bond they'd built over the years.
entries.literal: "Once he'd made the necessary step, the boy started to open his heart, no longer restricting himself. Elated to see it, the girl responded the same way, strengthening the unbreakable bond they'd built over the years."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One day, they kissed. It brought them peace in the already peaceful room, and it reminded them of the park they were so far from.
entries.literal: "One day, they kissed. It brought them peace in the already peaceful room, and it reminded them of the park they were so far from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The chair kept getting brought back every so often. One day, the boy tried it and understood why the girl liked it so much.{w} Glad to see his liking of it, she joined him inside. They hadn't ever felt as close as that, but the relaxing sensation let them spend an entire silent day together, content to be living in the moment.{w} At one point, the girl got confused, thinking the 24 hours must've passed, but she realized that the boy had already silently prolonged the duration, so she continued resting her face next to his.
entries.literal: "The chair kept getting brought back every so often. One day, the boy tried it and understood why the girl liked it so much.{w} Glad to see his liking of it, she joined him inside. They hadn't ever felt as close as that, but the relaxing sensation let them spend an entire silent day together, content to be living in the moment.{w} At one point, the girl got confused, thinking the 24 hours must've passed, but she realized that the boy had already silently prolonged the duration, so she continued resting her face next to his."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Similar days continued until they had spent months together. Despite that, no second had felt stagnant. They continued to enjoy their stay, seeing in each other the same friend they'd always gone to school with.
entries.literal: "Similar days continued until they had spent months together. Despite that, no second had felt stagnant. They continued to enjoy their stay, seeing in each other the same friend they'd always gone to school with."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Their relationship had surely surpassed the norm. They only truly had each other, but that had always been the case. Even after being secluded in that strange room for all that time, they could still talk casually about things in the normal world, making each other laugh and showing interest in what the other had to say.
entries.literal: "Their relationship had surely surpassed the norm. They only truly had each other, but that had always been the case. Even after being secluded in that strange room for all that time, they could still talk casually about things in the normal world, making each other laugh and showing interest in what the other had to say."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since he'd broken out of his old mold, the boy had grown used to only voicing his true thoughts, like he'd always wanted to do.{w} Some days, they would try to materialize new objects. When it was his turn, he created a huge trampoline. He'd always found them fun, and he'd thought of generating one for a while. They let themselves loose and used it for hours, as if their bodies couldn't wear out.
entries.literal: "Since he'd broken out of his old mold, the boy had grown used to only voicing his true thoughts, like he'd always wanted to do.{w} Some days, they would try to materialize new objects. When it was his turn, he created a huge trampoline. He'd always found them fun, and he'd thought of generating one for a while. They let themselves loose and used it for hours, as if their bodies couldn't wear out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At one point, they stopped creating new objects, knowing they could just be in the egg chair.{w} They were happy to live like that, but they knew there was a detail they'd barely talked about.
entries.literal: "At one point, they stopped creating new objects, knowing they could just be in the egg chair.{w} They were happy to live like that, but they knew there was a detail they'd barely talked about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Permanently marked on the floor, next to where they were resting, were always the same words. "Both of you will spend one hundred years in this space. Once you exceed that time, you'll be brought back to your lives, but only one of you will keep your memories of your stay here."
entries.literal: "Permanently marked on the floor, next to where they were resting, were always the same words. \"Both of you will spend one hundred years in this space. Once you exceed that time, you'll be brought back to your lives, but only one of you will keep your memories of your stay here.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They'd long since stopped keeping track of the days, aware that the final one would eventually come. They felt their sense of time had been altered since near the start, so they couldn't be sure they hadn't already spent years in that room.
entries.literal: "They'd long since stopped keeping track of the days, aware that the final one would eventually come. They felt their sense of time had been altered since near the start, so they couldn't be sure they hadn't already spent years in that room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Aren't you scared to lose your memories when we come back?"
entries.literal: "\"Aren't you scared to lose your memories when we come back?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The girl responded quickly.{w} "...Yes, but it'll be okay. We know how long we've liked each other for in the real world, so whoever remembers will just tell the other about it. There are so many things I want to do with you once we're back. Since one of us will remember, we can do all of them and more."
entries.literal: "The girl responded quickly.{w} \"...Yes, but it'll be okay. We know how long we've liked each other for in the real world, so whoever remembers will just tell the other about it. There are so many things I want to do with you once we're back. Since one of us will remember, we can do all of them and more.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "All right. Whoever keeps these memories will confess to the other as soon as we come back."{w} Then, they would live the life they'd been talking about for so long.
entries.literal: "\"All right. Whoever keeps these memories will confess to the other as soon as we come back.\"{w} Then, they would live the life they'd been talking about for so long."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was their promise. They had grown to love that room and the relationship they'd forged thanks to it. It was just a prologue for the inevitable return, but both of them saw it as much more than that.
entries.literal: "That was their promise. They had grown to love that room and the relationship they'd forged thanks to it. It was just a prologue for the inevitable return, but both of them saw it as much more than that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And, once again, time went on.{w} They didn't get tired of talking, of thinking, of caressing, and of living. They spent every second as if no time was passing.
entries.literal: "And, once again, time went on.{w} They didn't get tired of talking, of thinking, of caressing, and of living. They spent every second as if no time was passing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But, eventually, almost one hundred years had. They hadn't aged, and their physical condition hadn't deteriorated. Like they'd already done numerous times, they'd decided to bring a pool filled with water to the room, knowing how refreshing it was.
entries.literal: "But, eventually, almost one hundred years had. They hadn't aged, and their physical condition hadn't deteriorated. Like they'd already done numerous times, they'd decided to bring a pool filled with water to the room, knowing how refreshing it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Underwater, the round interior of the pool was the last thing they saw in that isolated reality. They had agreed never to say goodbye, and they couldn't have even if they wanted to. In the blink of an eye, the room didn't exist.
entries.literal: "Underwater, the round interior of the pool was the last thing they saw in that isolated reality. They had agreed never to say goodbye, and they couldn't have even if they wanted to. In the blink of an eye, the room didn't exist."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to a bench, a boy and a girl looked at each other. One was staring into the other's eyes, whereas the other had simply returned the gesture.
entries.literal: "Next to a bench, a boy and a girl looked at each other. One was staring into the other's eyes, whereas the other had simply returned the gesture."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Hm? What's up?"
entries.literal: "\"Hm? What's up?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The boy froze. Was it really over? Did the girl in front of him really not remember anything of what they'd experienced together?
entries.literal: "The boy froze. Was it really over? Did the girl in front of him really not remember anything of what they'd experienced together?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "...Is anything wrong?"
entries.literal: "\"...Is anything wrong?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had no idea what to say, but his own words echoed in his mind: "All right. Whoever keeps these memories will confess to the other as soon as we come back."
entries.literal: "He had no idea what to say, but his own words echoed in his mind: \"All right. Whoever keeps these memories will confess to the other as soon as we come back.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Hey...? Did something happen?"
entries.literal: "\"Hey...? Did something happen?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "N-Nothing, don't worry."
entries.literal: "\"N-Nothing, don't worry.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a slight frown, the girl shrugged and picked up her purse. "We should go, then."
entries.literal: "With a slight frown, the girl shrugged and picked up her purse. \"We should go, then.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He couldn't bring himself to say anything and simply stood still, petrified. He'd feared many times that he'd be the one to keep his memories, but the girl's words had kept giving him peace, letting him believe that it'd turn out fine either way.
entries.literal: "He couldn't bring himself to say anything and simply stood still, petrified. He'd feared many times that he'd be the one to keep his memories, but the girl's words had kept giving him peace, letting him believe that it'd turn out fine either way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Are you coming?"
entries.literal: "\"Are you coming?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still trying to find a place to fix his gaze on, the boy began to step forward. Something was preventing him from looking at her face.
entries.literal: "Still trying to find a place to fix his gaze on, the boy began to step forward. Something was preventing him from looking at her face."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Whoever keeps these memories will confess to the other as soon as we come back."{w} What? No... he couldn't do that.
entries.literal: "\"Whoever keeps these memories will confess to the other as soon as we come back.\"{w} What? No... he couldn't do that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had spent one hundred years loving someone, but that wasn't the girl in front of him. He had come back—and the girl he'd loved had died. She only remained in his memories.
entries.literal: "He had spent one hundred years loving someone, but that wasn't the girl in front of him. He had come back—and the girl he'd loved had died. She only remained in his memories."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had spent one hundred years finally letting himself be who he was, without judgment, without even thinking about it. However, in an instant, that had been reversed. He had never opened himself emotionally; to the eyes of the girl in front of him, he was the same reserved person he'd always been.
entries.literal: "He had spent one hundred years finally letting himself be who he was, without judgment, without even thinking about it. However, in an instant, that had been reversed. He had never opened himself emotionally; to the eyes of the girl in front of him, he was the same reserved person he'd always been."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She approached him with a worried face. "Are you okay?"{w} He wasn't confused about what had happened. He understood it perfectly well, and the only thing he felt was emptiness. After nodding, he continued walking.
entries.literal: "She approached him with a worried face. \"Are you okay?\"{w} He wasn't confused about what had happened. He understood it perfectly well, and the only thing he felt was emptiness. After nodding, he continued walking."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He hadn't seen those streets for so long, but he still remembered every detail about them. They began to walk through the quietness of the night, hearing their footsteps on the asphalt.
entries.literal: "He hadn't seen those streets for so long, but he still remembered every detail about them. They began to walk through the quietness of the night, hearing their footsteps on the asphalt."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to the boy was his first friend, who he'd loved more than he'd ever thought he could. He knew his feelings were mutual, but how did that help? He'd always imagined that.
entries.literal: "Next to the boy was his first friend, who he'd loved more than he'd ever thought he could. He knew his feelings were mutual, but how did that help? He'd always imagined that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The inevitable sadness started to build up within him. He remembered how much of himself the girl had grown to know during those years, all the conversations they'd had, and every time they'd materialized something. He'd been told that their time together would end since the first day, but he couldn't believe all of that had simply happened and been lost.
entries.literal: "The inevitable sadness started to build up within him. He remembered how much of himself the girl had grown to know during those years, all the conversations they'd had, and every time they'd materialized something. He'd been told that their time together would end since the first day, but he couldn't believe all of that had simply happened and been lost."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And there was nothing he could do. He couldn't confess his love again, and for the first time, he doubted it.
entries.literal: "And there was nothing he could do. He couldn't confess his love again, and for the first time, he doubted it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The two same barriers had come back: himself, and uncertainty. Not a second of those hundred years had mattered.{w} No, of course that was wrong. He'd have to cherish and remember the times they'd spent in that intimate room... because, in the real world, they would never happen.
entries.literal: "The two same barriers had come back: himself, and uncertainty. Not a second of those hundred years had mattered.{w} No, of course that was wrong. He'd have to cherish and remember the times they'd spent in that intimate room... because, in the real world, they would never happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The turn where they always saw each other off came.
entries.literal: "The turn where they always saw each other off came."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Are you sure you're okay?"
entries.literal: "\"Are you sure you're okay?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Don't worry, I am."
entries.literal: "\"Don't worry, I am.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Looking a little sad, the girl smiled and waved.{w} Then, as they always did, both of them took different paths. ...And yet again, only one of them found it significant.
entries.literal: "Looking a little sad, the girl smiled and waved.{w} Then, as they always did, both of them took different paths. ...And yet again, only one of them found it significant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was a story I'd once written.
entries.literal: "That was a story I'd once written."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd always been prone to letting my imagination run wild, and sometimes I'd make up full little stories.{w} Unable to sleep one night, I'd thought of that one.
entries.literal: "I'd always been prone to letting my imagination run wild, and sometimes I'd make up full little stories.{w} Unable to sleep one night, I'd thought of that one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a very shallow story, but that night, I'd felt the need to write it down, which I never tended to do. Of course, I'd never shown it to anyone, but every time I thought of it, a strong and bittersweet emotion would fill my brain.
entries.literal: "It was a very shallow story, but that night, I'd felt the need to write it down, which I never tended to do. Of course, I'd never shown it to anyone, but every time I thought of it, a strong and bittersweet emotion would fill my brain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I opened the piece of paper and read the four thin lines on it, every word of that story came back to me.
entries.literal: "When I opened the piece of paper and read the four thin lines on it, every word of that story came back to me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Hello. I'm sorry that I have to write this."
entries.literal: "\"Hello. I'm sorry that I have to write this.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "I still can't believe what happened. I haven't been able to stop crying, but I've always tried to tell myself that these things just occur."
entries.literal: "\"I still can't believe what happened. I haven't been able to stop crying, but I've always tried to tell myself that these things just occur.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "I know how selfish it is that I'm writing this, but I won't be able to live with myself if I don't."
entries.literal: "\"I know how selfish it is that I'm writing this, but I won't be able to live with myself if I don't.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "I need to say it.{w} I've always wanted to, and I can't believe I never will.{w} I love you."
entries.literal: "\"I need to say it.{w} I've always wanted to, and I can't believe I never will.{w} I love you.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My hand hadn't stopped trembling, and my heart began to catch up to it. What in the world was I reading?
entries.literal: "My hand hadn't stopped trembling, and my heart began to catch up to it. What in the world was I reading?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd jumped back to the story I'd written a couple of years prior for a very simple reason.
entries.literal: "I'd jumped back to the story I'd written a couple of years prior for a very simple reason."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The handwriting on the note was my own.
entries.literal: "The handwriting on the note was my own."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it couldn't be. I'd never written that, and I never would. However, I knew very well the single thing that could've ever made that note a reality.{w} A voice played in my mind.
entries.literal: "But it couldn't be. I'd never written that, and I never would. However, I knew very well the single thing that could've ever made that note a reality.{w} A voice played in my mind."

entries.speaker: saicenter
entries.text: "Shiroya's fate is death."{w=2.8}{nw}
entries.literal: "\"Shiroya's fate is death.\"{w=2.8}{nw}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those had been Sai's words, but they couldn't be true. I'd feared before that the day would come where I could no longer tell her how glad and thankful I was to have her, but there was no way I'd let it happen.
entries.literal: "Those had been Sai's words, but they couldn't be true. I'd feared before that the day would come where I could no longer tell her how glad and thankful I was to have her, but there was no way I'd let it happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No—it wouldn't happen. That note had my handwriting, but it didn't mean anything. I would never write it. Even if the worst happened at a later point, I wouldn't.{w} But... it existed. I had it in my hands.
entries.literal: "No—it wouldn't happen. That note had my handwriting, but it didn't mean anything. I would never write it. Even if the worst happened at a later point, I wouldn't.{w} But... it existed. I had it in my hands."

entries.speaker: i
