entries.text: Where had it even come from!? I hadn't seen it on the floor, so had it been in my pocket and fallen while I'd been sitting? Or had someone left it there, knowing I'd come back?
entries.literal: "Where had it even come from!? I hadn't seen it on the floor, so had it been in my pocket and fallen while I'd been sitting? Or had someone left it there, knowing I'd come back?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart rate alerted me of how anxious I was. My existence felt insignificant, but I still told myself I wouldn't let that reality happen.
entries.literal: "My heart rate alerted me of how anxious I was. My existence felt insignificant, but I still told myself I wouldn't let that reality happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I burst through the door and was greeted once again by the desolate hallway B.
entries.literal: "I burst through the door and was greeted once again by the desolate hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been tightly gripping the note, the thing I despised, with my right hand. I detested it and wanted to distance myself from it as much as I could, so I left it between the handrail and the wall to avoid touching it for even another second.
entries.literal: "I'd been tightly gripping the note, the thing I despised, with my right hand. I detested it and wanted to distance myself from it as much as I could, so I left it between the handrail and the wall to avoid touching it for even another second."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya! Hey! Where are you!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Hey! Where are you!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I needed to see her and know that my fears wouldn't turn out true. We'd just lost Miiya, but I knew that I wouldn't ever be myself again if something happened to Shiroya.
entries.literal: "I needed to see her and know that my fears wouldn't turn out true. We'd just lost Miiya, but I knew that I wouldn't ever be myself again if something happened to Shiroya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya! Can you hear me!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Can you hear me!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the room in front of me and left it as soon as I saw it was empty. I kept crying out, impulsively exhausting myself as much as I could.
entries.literal: "I opened the room in front of me and left it as soon as I saw it was empty. I kept crying out, impulsively exhausting myself as much as I could."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're okay, right!? If you can hear me, please come out! Say something!
entries.literal: "You're okay, right!? If you can hear me, please come out! Say something!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, my voice started to crack as I realized how close I was to the reality in which my oldest friend had died. Sai had spoken it like it was an absolute, and I'd found a note I wished I'd never read.{w} I kept telling myself that there had to be another meaning, but my shouts devolved into hopeless crying until I fell to my knees in the middle of the hallway.
entries.literal: "Soon, my voice started to crack as I realized how close I was to the reality in which my oldest friend had died. Sai had spoken it like it was an absolute, and I'd found a note I wished I'd never read.{w} I kept telling myself that there had to be another meaning, but my shouts devolved into hopeless crying until I fell to my knees in the middle of the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was so lost that I didn't consider the importance of the sound I'd heard. Footsteps... I suddenly processed it.
entries.literal: "I was so lost that I didn't consider the importance of the sound I'd heard. Footsteps... I suddenly processed it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Abruptly, I raised my head and turned to face the lobby.
entries.literal: "Abruptly, I raised my head and turned to face the lobby."

entries.text: Lap Crossing
entries.literal: "Lap Crossing"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There, I saw a slender figure looking at me.{w} It was Shiroya, her face near the breaking point. However, she wasn't the one I'd been thinking of. Her clothes were from the attic, and despite her expression, she felt wrong in a way I couldn't define.
entries.literal: "There, I saw a slender figure looking at me.{w} It was Shiroya, her face near the breaking point. However, she wasn't the one I'd been thinking of. Her clothes were from the attic, and despite her expression, she felt wrong in a way I couldn't define."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed like she could disappear at any moment. Without taking my eyes off her, I stood up. She hadn't moved since we'd seen each other, so I began to warily approach her.
entries.literal: "It seemed like she could disappear at any moment. Without taking my eyes off her, I stood up. She hadn't moved since we'd seen each other, so I began to warily approach her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Are you actually Shiroya?
entries.literal: "...Are you actually Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I'd been crying her name, I'd only been wanting to find her to be able to hug her tightly. After she'd suddenly appeared like that, though, I couldn't bring myself to go forth, unaware of whether I'd stopped myself or her overwhelming look had.
entries.literal: "When I'd been crying her name, I'd only been wanting to find her to be able to hug her tightly. After she'd suddenly appeared like that, though, I couldn't bring myself to go forth, unaware of whether I'd stopped myself or her overwhelming look had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if she hadn't heard me, she continued to stare at my chest with a melancholic look.
entries.literal: "As if she hadn't heard me, she continued to stare at my chest with a melancholic look."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-Where were you? What's with those clothes?{w} Are you the same person who disappeared with Sai?
entries.literal: "Wh-Where were you? What's with those clothes?{w} Are you the same person who disappeared with Sai?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After some seconds, she finally answered.
entries.literal: "After some seconds, she finally answered."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-I'm sorry... I'm very confused too. ...I-I guess so, though.
entries.literal: "I-I'm sorry... I'm very confused too. ...I-I guess so, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You guess so?{w} What do you mean? You remember everything, right?
entries.literal: "You guess so?{w} What do you mean? You remember everything, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Right now...
entries.literal: "Right now..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She stopped.
entries.literal: "She stopped."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes?
entries.literal: "Yes?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She looked lost and glanced over my shoulder. When I realized she hadn't paused voluntarily, I turned around, thinking she might've seen something.
entries.literal: "She looked lost and glanced over my shoulder. When I realized she hadn't paused voluntarily, I turned around, thinking she might've seen something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had failed to recognize the sound I'd been constantly anticipating. Footsteps were approaching.
entries.literal: "I had failed to recognize the sound I'd been constantly anticipating. Footsteps were approaching."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, a person came with them. I could hardly believe my eyes until I understood that what I was seeing had already occurred before.
entries.literal: "However, a person came with them. I could hardly believe my eyes until I understood that what I was seeing had already occurred before."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm glad to see you two are safe. I was a bit worried...{w} Wh-What's with those clothes? You weren't wearing them earlier, were you...?
entries.literal: "I'm glad to see you two are safe. I was a bit worried...{w} Wh-What's with those clothes? You weren't wearing them earlier, were you...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't act shocked or even surprised. Erina, who had died, was behind us, quietly approaching. It looked like she'd come from hallway C.
entries.literal: "I couldn't act shocked or even surprised. Erina, who had died, was behind us, quietly approaching. It looked like she'd come from hallway C."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Who the hell are you? Or even you... How can you two exist!?
entries.literal: "Who the hell are you? Or even you... How can you two exist!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the same thing. The "body double" I'd gone on about earlier. Erina's had appeared, and next to me must've been Shiroya's.
entries.literal: "It was the same thing. The \"body double\" I'd gone on about earlier. Erina's had appeared, and next to me must've been Shiroya's."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Where were you? How did you just appear out of nowhere!?
entries.literal: "Where were you? How did you just appear out of nowhere!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The confused expression she responded with was more than frustrating. I tried to focus on breathing to keep myself together. Just by looking at her, I'd noticed two glaring details.
entries.literal: "The confused expression she responded with was more than frustrating. I tried to focus on breathing to keep myself together. Just by looking at her, I'd noticed two glaring details."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She looked almost as if she was sedated and only partially conscious. Her voice and body movements gave off the same feeling, so it was clear that she wasn't in the best state, either physically or mentally.
entries.literal: "She looked almost as if she was sedated and only partially conscious. Her voice and body movements gave off the same feeling, so it was clear that she wasn't in the best state, either physically or mentally."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But the major point was her clothes. Her chest was covered by the same bloodstain I'd seen before, and so were her legs and the upper part of her face. I spotted the same scratches that indicated a fight, meaning that her body was identical to the one I'd seen.
entries.literal: "But the major point was her clothes. Her chest was covered by the same bloodstain I'd seen before, and so were her legs and the upper part of her face. I spotted the same scratches that indicated a fight, meaning that her body was identical to the one I'd seen."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What do you not understand? Did you just pop into existence at some point?
entries.literal: "What do you not understand? Did you just pop into existence at some point?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No... Why do you think that?
entries.literal: "No... Why do you think that?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Have you looked at that room? Your body is there.
entries.literal: "Have you looked at that room? Your body is there."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...? That one? It... can't be.
entries.literal: "What...? That one? It... can't be."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She staggered and took a while to complete her sentence. Trying to overcome whatever her condition was, she walked to it. The door was already partially open, so she just had to push it the rest of the way.
entries.literal: "She staggered and took a while to complete her sentence. Trying to overcome whatever her condition was, she walked to it. The door was already partially open, so she just had to push it the rest of the way."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I knew you were lying. I-I can't be here, of course not...
entries.literal: "I knew you were lying. I-I can't be here, of course not..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have to move. Through the door, I could see that Erina's body had disappeared. Next to Naomi was Erina's curtain, but it had been left on the floor with no trace of the corpse I'd attempted to dignify.
entries.literal: "I didn't have to move. Through the door, I could see that Erina's body had disappeared. Next to Naomi was Erina's curtain, but it had been left on the floor with no trace of the corpse I'd attempted to dignify."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Shiroya, what the hell is happening? Answer my other questions. How can you exist when it shouldn't be possible? Did the same thing happen to Erina?
entries.literal: "...Shiroya, what the hell is happening? Answer my other questions. How can you exist when it shouldn't be possible? Did the same thing happen to Erina?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: To Erina? She should be dead, right?
entries.literal: "To Erina? She should be dead, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya left my side to look through the door and saw that Naomi's corpse was the single remaining one.
entries.literal: "Shiroya left my side to look through the door and saw that Naomi's corpse was the single remaining one."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait, the cross!
entries.literal: "Wait, the cross!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was ahead of me, so I had the chance to look at the collar of her shirt, where I'd drawn a black cross.
entries.literal: "She was ahead of me, so I had the chance to look at the collar of her shirt, where I'd drawn a black cross."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's not there... I'm sure that's the spot where I marked it.
entries.literal: "It's not there... I'm sure that's the spot where I marked it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: About Erina, I think what happened isn't what you think.
entries.literal: "About Erina, I think what happened isn't what you think."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's probably right. I can't think of anything anymore.
entries.literal: "That's probably right. I can't think of anything anymore."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Under those stained clothes, there's no wound, right?
entries.literal: "...Under those stained clothes, there's no wound, right?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina looked at her own chest and was taken aback by all the blood she saw on herself.
entries.literal: "Erina looked at her own chest and was taken aback by all the blood she saw on herself."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: There never was one. The body you think disappeared is her.
entries.literal: "There never was one. The body you think disappeared is her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you mean that she never died?
entries.literal: "Do you mean that she never died?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She nodded.{w} If that was the case, it was painfully simple, and I'd failed to think about it because of all the overlapping thoughts I'd had on the matter. I'd been thinking about a replicated body who'd shared the stained blood but not any wound, while, sure enough, we'd never actually confirmed there'd been one.{w} And, of course, the blood. If it wasn't hers, there was another very clear candidate to consider.
entries.literal: "She nodded.{w} If that was the case, it was painfully simple, and I'd failed to think about it because of all the overlapping thoughts I'd had on the matter. I'd been thinking about a replicated body who'd shared the stained blood but not any wound, while, sure enough, we'd never actually confirmed there'd been one.{w} And, of course, the blood. If it wasn't hers, there was another very clear candidate to consider."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: A-Are you serious...?{w} Were you playing dead, then? Or just unconscious? It doesn't look like you feel very well.
entries.literal: "A-Are you serious...?{w} Were you playing dead, then? Or just unconscious? It doesn't look like you feel very well."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm not sure... I remember I was drawn to this room, and then I think I blacked out.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure... I remember I was drawn to this room, and then I think I blacked out."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Drawn? By a noise?
entries.literal: "Drawn? By a noise?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: N-No... Something stronger, but I'm not sure what, exactly. I don't know whose blood this is, but since I woke up, I've felt... groggy and numb.
entries.literal: "N-No... Something stronger, but I'm not sure what, exactly. I don't know whose blood this is, but since I woke up, I've felt... groggy and numb."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... see.
entries.literal: "I... see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would we have known she was alive if we'd felt her pulse, then? Her experience was enigmatic, but I understood that what had come afterward could've been a result of our mistaken assumption.
entries.literal: "Would we have known she was alive if we'd felt her pulse, then? Her experience was enigmatic, but I understood that what had come afterward could've been a result of our mistaken assumption."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya, do you remember finding her body as well? And you realized what really happened? ...You still haven't explained what you're doing here. Are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?
entries.literal: "Shiroya, do you remember finding her body as well? And you realized what really happened? ...You still haven't explained what you're doing here. Are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I wish I could explain everything to you, but I still don't really know what happened.
entries.literal: "...I wish I could explain everything to you, but I still don't really know what happened."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But, yes. I'm really glad to see you again.
entries.literal: "But, yes. I'm really glad to see you again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She smiled. It was her—the person I'd cried the name of. No matter how many questions surrounded her, she was okay...
entries.literal: "She smiled. It was her—the person I'd cried the name of. No matter how many questions surrounded her, she was okay..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-What's with those clothes, then? Why is the cross not on them? Why did you ignore me when we saw each other in the event room and when I kept shouting your name?
entries.literal: "Wh-What's with those clothes, then? Why is the cross not on them? Why did you ignore me when we saw each other in the event room and when I kept shouting your name?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Well, I—
entries.literal: "...Well, I—"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hey... I'm still confused, but I have a question.
entries.literal: "Hey... I'm still confused, but I have a question."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The Sekimeiya... does it really make you travel through time?{w} How does it work?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya... does it really make you travel through time?{w} How does it work?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: If I understand it... touching it with your skin activates it, right? And you can go far into the past if it's out of the cabinet for a while.
entries.literal: "If I understand it... touching it with your skin activates it, right? And you can go far into the past if it's out of the cabinet for a while."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's... what I've been working under, yes.
entries.literal: "That's... what I've been working under, yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at Shiroya in case she found something wrong with that, but she nodded, albeit uncertainly.
entries.literal: "I looked at Shiroya in case she found something wrong with that, but she nodded, albeit uncertainly."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I was thinking. Why don't I just go back in time to save Isla?
entries.literal: "I was thinking. Why don't I just go back in time to save Isla?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Neither of us knew how to answer. We'd concluded the past couldn't be altered, so that shouldn't have been possible.
entries.literal: "...{w}Neither of us knew how to answer. We'd concluded the past couldn't be altered, so that shouldn't have been possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the bedroom, despite managing to act semi-composed, Erina had always looked sorrowful as she tried to hope that her daughter had somehow survived. However, the woman in front of us was different.
entries.literal: "In the bedroom, despite managing to act semi-composed, Erina had always looked sorrowful as she tried to hope that her daughter had somehow survived. However, the woman in front of us was different."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't know why I didn't think of it earlier. Someone killed her a few hours ago, so I just have to go to that time and prevent it.{w} But I couldn't find the Sekimeiya. I kept looking at Isla's face for a very long time, and she told me that she could be saved. Then, I saw a girl, and after that I heard you shouting.
entries.literal: "I don't know why I didn't think of it earlier. Someone killed her a few hours ago, so I just have to go to that time and prevent it.{w} But I couldn't find the Sekimeiya. I kept looking at Isla's face for a very long time, and she told me that she could be saved. Then, I saw a girl, and after that I heard you shouting."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...A girl? You saw Shiroya?
entries.literal: "...A girl? You saw Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Um...{w} I guess it couldn't have been anyone else.{w} ...It must have been Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Um...{w} I guess it couldn't have been anyone else.{w} ...It must have been Shiroya."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I also saw what happened to Katei... It looked horrible. Did someone do that?
entries.literal: "I also saw what happened to Katei... It looked horrible. Did someone do that?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...It couldn't have been an accident.{w} But anyway, the Sekimeiya's not in the event room.
entries.literal: "...It couldn't have been an accident.{w} But anyway, the Sekimeiya's not in the event room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Are you sure...?{w} Do you know where it could be? I really need to find it.
entries.literal: "Are you sure...?{w} Do you know where it could be? I really need to find it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No. I suspect Sai or Akaro must've taken it.
entries.literal: "No. I suspect Sai or Akaro must've taken it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hated it, but I couldn't tell her where I'd hidden it. She couldn't accomplish anything by going to the past; she would just have to experience Isla's death a second time. However, we'd never seen that Erina in the past, so I could know for certain that she wouldn't travel.
entries.literal: "I hated it, but I couldn't tell her where I'd hidden it. She couldn't accomplish anything by going to the past; she would just have to experience Isla's death a second time. However, we'd never seen that Erina in the past, so I could know for certain that she wouldn't travel."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...{w}Are you lying?
entries.literal: "...{w}Are you lying?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What? No, I'm not.
entries.literal: "What? No, I'm not."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: She's been alive all this time. Could she have seen me bringing the Sekimeiya to the staff room...?
entries.literal: "She's been alive all this time. Could she have seen me bringing the Sekimeiya to the staff room...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The way you two reacted. You don't want me to save Isla, do you?
entries.literal: "The way you two reacted. You don't want me to save Isla, do you?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's not it at all... Remember that Sai and Akaro took the cabinet key. They probably have the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "That's not it at all... Remember that Sai and Akaro took the cabinet key. They probably have the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya was backing me up. I didn't know why something about her still felt off, but I was starting to accept that it was actually her. We'd just have to clear things up to understand exactly what had happened, but she remembered disappearing with Sai. That meant she already knew I'd taken the Sekimeiya myself.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was backing me up. I didn't know why something about her still felt off, but I was starting to accept that it was actually her. We'd just have to clear things up to understand exactly what had happened, but she remembered disappearing with Sai. That meant she already knew I'd taken the Sekimeiya myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But Erina didn't give in. It was clear that she didn't trust us after all, despite what we'd talked about in the attic. She went to the event room, so we quietly walked behind.
entries.literal: "But Erina didn't give in. It was clear that she didn't trust us after all, despite what we'd talked about in the attic. She went to the event room, so we quietly walked behind."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I-I knew it! You were lying...
entries.literal: "I-I knew it! You were lying..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You didn't want me to look at the cabinet!
entries.literal: "You didn't want me to look at the cabinet!"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind the curtain was the glass, and behind that, the Sekimeiya I'd just left in a locker rested on top of the cushion.
entries.literal: "Behind the curtain was the glass, and behind that, the Sekimeiya I'd just left in a locker rested on top of the cushion."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya looked at me, confused. My words had led her to think that the cabinet would be empty.
entries.literal: "Shiroya looked at me, confused. My words had led her to think that the cabinet would be empty."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's... teleporting.
entries.literal: "It's... teleporting."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'm sure it just teleported from the locker to the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I'm sure it just teleported from the locker to the cabinet."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And of course, this is no coincidental place. It must've returned to its "starting point", or something similar; a place where it's cold.
entries.literal: "And of course, this is no coincidental place. It must've returned to its \"starting point\", or something similar; a place where it's cold."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, avoiding direct contact with it. Then, she immediately let the curtain fall again to make it clear that she wouldn't put it back in.
entries.literal: "Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, avoiding direct contact with it. Then, she immediately let the curtain fall again to make it clear that she wouldn't put it back in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a long silence until the hallway A door opened. Wondering what else could happen, we turned to face it and saw someone stepping into the room.
entries.literal: "There was a long silence until the hallway A door opened. Wondering what else could happen, we turned to face it and saw someone stepping into the room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Uh...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to yell at him as soon as I saw his face, but I was too fed up to do so. I looked around me and laughed internally, having gone so quickly from thinking that I was alone to sharing a room with three people. Received with silence, Sai approached the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I wanted to yell at him as soon as I saw his face, but I was too fed up to do so. I looked around me and laughed internally, having gone so quickly from thinking that I was alone to sharing a room with three people. Received with silence, Sai approached the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's up?
entries.literal: "What's up?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What the fuck are you even doing here? Did you succeed with that plan of yours?
entries.literal: "...What the fuck are you even doing here? Did you succeed with that plan of yours?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, not quite, unfortunately. I thought Erina was dead. What's she doing with the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Oh, not quite, unfortunately. I thought Erina was dead. What's she doing with the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You thought that too? No. I'm going to go to the past to save Isla.
entries.literal: "You thought that too? No. I'm going to go to the past to save Isla."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh. I doubt that. The past can't be changed.
entries.literal: "Huh. I doubt that. The past can't be changed."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's nonsense! I'm going to the past, so I'll prevent Isla from dying. You've used the Sekimeiya before, right? How long do I need to wait to go enough hours back?
entries.literal: "That's nonsense! I'm going to the past, so I'll prevent Isla from dying. You've used the Sekimeiya before, right? How long do I need to wait to go enough hours back?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Um... It should be about fifteen minutes, but I still find it unlikely you'll change anything.
entries.literal: "Um... It should be about fifteen minutes, but I still find it unlikely you'll change anything."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai... where the fuck did you go? Were you in the attic?{w} Do you know where Shiroya went? I saw her disappear with you.
entries.literal: "Sai... where the fuck did you go? Were you in the attic?{w} Do you know where Shiroya went? I saw her disappear with you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isn't she next to you? What's with those clothes, anyway? Aren't they from there?
entries.literal: "Isn't she next to you? What's with those clothes, anyway? Aren't they from there?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...They are.
entries.literal: "...They are."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see, they're definitely an improvement for you.{w} And just ignore me, Atsuki. I was busy sorting something out.
entries.literal: "I see, they're definitely an improvement for you.{w} And just ignore me, Atsuki. I was busy sorting something out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ever since Sai had entered, Shiroya hadn't taken her eyes off him. Immediately after that last sentence, her lips curled up into a smile for a second, and her eyebrows raised.
entries.literal: "Ever since Sai had entered, Shiroya hadn't taken her eyes off him. Immediately after that last sentence, her lips curled up into a smile for a second, and her eyebrows raised."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: More moments of silence followed. Erina still showed no signs of reconsideration, and we couldn't forcefully take the Sekimeiya from her.{w} Sai had nonchalantly said that fifteen minutes would be enough to go many hours back when I'd just traveled approximately twenty minutes after storing that amount of time. I looked at Erina's purse, where the Sekimeiya was getting hotter and hotter.
entries.literal: "More moments of silence followed. Erina still showed no signs of reconsideration, and we couldn't forcefully take the Sekimeiya from her.{w} Sai had nonchalantly said that fifteen minutes would be enough to go many hours back when I'd just traveled approximately twenty minutes after storing that amount of time. I looked at Erina's purse, where the Sekimeiya was getting hotter and hotter."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait... that's...!
entries.literal: "Wait... that's...!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh, right, I'd forgotten about this too.
entries.literal: "Oh, right, I'd forgotten about this too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still sounding groggy, she traced my gaze up to her purse and took out a small piece of paper.
entries.literal: "Still sounding groggy, she traced my gaze up to her purse and took out a small piece of paper."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I found this just now. I tried to read it, but my head hurt a lot. Do you know what it is?
entries.literal: "I found this just now. I tried to read it, but my head hurt a lot. Do you know what it is?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She handed it to me, and I snatched it away, gripping it tightly. My hands started trembling as soon as I glanced at the words again and saw those familiar letters.
entries.literal: "She handed it to me, and I snatched it away, gripping it tightly. My hands started trembling as soon as I glanced at the words again and saw those familiar letters."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd left it behind without thinking about it, but I couldn't let Shiroya read it. Despite how suspicious it looked, I immediately stored it in my pocket.
entries.literal: "I'd left it behind without thinking about it, but I couldn't let Shiroya read it. Despite how suspicious it looked, I immediately stored it in my pocket."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: H-Hey... What was that?
entries.literal: "H-Hey... What was that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and Erina both found it strange, but I couldn't let them read the note under any circumstances. Shiroya would easily recognize my handwriting, so I'd run away if necessary.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and Erina both found it strange, but I couldn't let them read the note under any circumstances. Shiroya would easily recognize my handwriting, so I'd run away if necessary."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't mind me, like you said.
entries.literal: "Don't mind me, like you said."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You look pretty nervous. I saw something written there.{w} You were pretty in control of things when you pulled off that trick with the key earlier, so why is this getting you all worked up? Do you wanna hide it that badly?
entries.literal: "You look pretty nervous. I saw something written there.{w} You were pretty in control of things when you pulled off that trick with the key earlier, so why is this getting you all worked up? Do you wanna hide it that badly?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}It's just a personal paper. It has nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...{w}It's just a personal paper. It has nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Very intriguing, then.
entries.literal: "Very intriguing, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't push it further, but at my side, I saw a mix of confusion and sadness emanating from Shiroya.
entries.literal: "He didn't push it further, but at my side, I saw a mix of confusion and sadness emanating from Shiroya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was understandable. I still didn't know what she'd gone through, but before entering the tower, we'd spent many days mourning our loss, our shared company being a silent healer. By saying it was a personal matter, I'd outright said I only wanted to hide it from her.
entries.literal: "It was understandable. I still didn't know what she'd gone through, but before entering the tower, we'd spent many days mourning our loss, our shared company being a silent healer. By saying it was a personal matter, I'd outright said I only wanted to hide it from her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd never made it apparent I could've been hiding anything, no matter how small. I still had many more questions to ask her, but what would my response be if she ever inquired about it...?
entries.literal: "I'd never made it apparent I could've been hiding anything, no matter how small. I still had many more questions to ask her, but what would my response be if she ever inquired about it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When she saw that I had nothing else to say, she smiled bitterly and looked down at her feet.
entries.literal: "When she saw that I had nothing else to say, she smiled bitterly and looked down at her feet."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: So, did any of you see Miiya...?
entries.literal: "So, did any of you see Miiya...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wh...

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who?
entries.literal: "Who?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You don't know her, right? I... I knew I wasn't going insane.
entries.literal: "You don't know her, right? I... I knew I wasn't going insane."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: H-How do you know that name?
entries.literal: "H-How do you know that name?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She's the person I was with earlier, before I saw you two... It just came back to me. I don't know where she went, though.
entries.literal: "She's the person I was with earlier, before I saw you two... It just came back to me. I don't know where she went, though."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What...{w} the fuck is going on?
entries.literal: "What...{w} the fuck is going on?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's with that reaction? Don't you see she's just delirious?{w} She didn't die, but I have a pretty good idea of what happened to her. Say, did you hallucinate someone?
entries.literal: "What's with that reaction? Don't you see she's just delirious?{w} She didn't die, but I have a pretty good idea of what happened to her. Say, did you hallucinate someone?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not it. That's not just some name she made up.
entries.literal: "That's not it. That's not just some name she made up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you know this person, then?
entries.literal: "Do you know this person, then?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...We do, but Erina couldn't have seen her. She couldn't be here.
entries.literal: "...We do, but Erina couldn't have seen her. She couldn't be here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure? She could've entered through the storeroom. She could've even traveled from the future since the Sekimeiya's bound to be exposed to the outside world.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? She could've entered through the storeroom. She could've even traveled from the future since the Sekimeiya's bound to be exposed to the outside world."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not what she means... She's not anywhere right now.
entries.literal: "That's not what she means... She's not anywhere right now."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh? Is she dead?{w} ...Wait, Miiya, you said...?
entries.literal: "Oh? Is she dead?{w} ...Wait, Miiya, you said...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...No. She's with us. She has red hair, right?
entries.literal: "...No. She's with us. She has red hair, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Miiya's hair... was red.{w} I recalled Akaro's voice from the time he'd lost some of his memories. What he'd said almost implied that he knew what happened to Miiya and what we'd gone through.
entries.literal: "Miiya's hair... was red.{w} I recalled Akaro's voice from the time he'd lost some of his memories. What he'd said almost implied that he knew what happened to Miiya and what we'd gone through."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Did you actually see her? What did she say?
entries.literal: "...Did you actually see her? What did she say?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She told me her name, but she didn't look lost or anything. She knew me, too...
entries.literal: "She told me her name, but she didn't look lost or anything. She knew me, too..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She just suddenly ran away, and I haven't seen her again. I definitely thought I hadn't seen her before, but I honestly wasn't sure.
entries.literal: "She just suddenly ran away, and I haven't seen her again. I definitely thought I hadn't seen her before, but I honestly wasn't sure."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is Miiya... here?
entries.literal: "Is Miiya... here?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is she alive? Are we going to succeed and save her somehow?
entries.literal: "Is she alive? Are we going to succeed and save her somehow?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I felt hope building up, I tried to contain it. That didn't make sense. Why would she have been in the tower? Why would she not have shown herself? There was no way Miiya was nearby, or anywhere.
entries.literal: "As soon as I felt hope building up, I tried to contain it. That didn't make sense. Why would she have been in the tower? Why would she not have shown herself? There was no way Miiya was nearby, or anywhere."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know how to interpret this. Did you all agree to make up this story for when I appeared?
entries.literal: "I don't know how to interpret this. Did you all agree to make up this story for when I appeared?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shut up.
entries.literal: "Shut up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, I'm trying to figure things out myself and I thought I was close to understanding quite a bit, but now there's a bunch of shit I don't get, and it doesn't feel great.
entries.literal: "Well, I'm trying to figure things out myself and I thought I was close to understanding quite a bit, but now there's a bunch of shit I don't get, and it doesn't feel great."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't ask, but it sounded like he wasn't only talking about the sudden appearance of an unknown person.
entries.literal: "I didn't ask, but it sounded like he wasn't only talking about the sudden appearance of an unknown person."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You did mean she died, right? Is saving her with the Sekimeiya not an option?
entries.literal: "You did mean she died, right? Is saving her with the Sekimeiya not an option?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, shut the fuck up. If it was, I promise you that we would've done it.
entries.literal: "Sai, shut the fuck up. If it was, I promise you that we would've done it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, there was silence. Shiroya looked pensive, but I had no clue what was going on inside her head. I basically understood nothing about her.
entries.literal: "Once again, there was silence. Shiroya looked pensive, but I had no clue what was going on inside her head. I basically understood nothing about her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't assume that Erina had just hallucinated because she knew Miiya's name and appearance, but I also couldn't accept that she was inside the tower.
entries.literal: "I couldn't assume that Erina had just hallucinated because she knew Miiya's name and appearance, but I also couldn't accept that she was inside the tower."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did Erina just lie...?{w} How would she know about her? And why would she do that?
entries.literal: "Did Erina just lie...?{w} How would she know about her? And why would she do that?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's probably been close to fifteen minutes already, right?
entries.literal: "It's probably been close to fifteen minutes already, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'd say so.
entries.literal: "I'd say so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai looked at his watch.
entries.literal: "Sai looked at his watch."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, it's been almost fifteen minutes since I arrived.
entries.literal: "Yes, it's been almost fifteen minutes since I arrived."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Are you sure I'll go far enough back?
entries.literal: "Are you sure I'll go far enough back?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: She died at around {time=14}, right? It should be enough, yes.
entries.literal: "She died at around {time=14}, right? It should be enough, yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I understood the lies, but not the heartless way in which he was deceiving a mother into thinking she was close to saving her daughter. Regardless, it had probably been fifteen minutes already, so Erina would travel to the past if we didn't stop her.
entries.literal: "I understood the lies, but not the heartless way in which he was deceiving a mother into thinking she was close to saving her daughter. Regardless, it had probably been fifteen minutes already, so Erina would travel to the past if we didn't stop her."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That's strange. Once again, if she's about to travel to the past, how come her past self hasn't already appeared?{w} Of course, seeing her future self should be an impossibility, but why would she have decided not to show herself?
entries.literal: "That's strange. Once again, if she's about to travel to the past, how come her past self hasn't already appeared?{w} Of course, seeing her future self should be an impossibility, but why would she have decided not to show herself?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Okay. I'm going, then. Are all of you coming with me?
entries.literal: "...Okay. I'm going, then. Are all of you coming with me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't worry, we're far enough from you.
entries.literal: "Don't worry, we're far enough from you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai stepped back a bit anyway.
entries.literal: "Sai stepped back a bit anyway."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I understand. Well... goodbye for now.
entries.literal: "I understand. Well... goodbye for now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Earlier, Sai had traveled after storing energy for fifteen minutes—the same amount.{w} At that time, I hadn't traveled despite being next to Shiroya, so I knew how big the range would be. I stepped back too to be sure I wasn't included and wouldn't travel away from Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Earlier, Sai had traveled after storing energy for fifteen minutes—the same amount.{w} At that time, I hadn't traveled despite being next to Shiroya, so I knew how big the range would be. I stepped back too to be sure I wasn't included and wouldn't travel away from Shiroya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In a solemn manner and keeping her eyes on us, Erina reached for the Sekimeiya with her left hand.
entries.literal: "In a solemn manner and keeping her eyes on us, Erina reached for the Sekimeiya with her left hand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When she touched it, there was a change.
entries.literal: "When she touched it, there was a change."

entries.text: Trampoline
entries.literal: "Trampoline"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait... what?
entries.literal: "Wait... what?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: None of us could understand what had occurred.
entries.literal: "None of us could understand what had occurred."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina didn't travel... Sai did.
entries.literal: "Erina didn't travel... Sai did."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Why didn't it work!? Did Sai disappear?{w} Was everything that he said a lie...?
entries.literal: "Why didn't it work!? Did Sai disappear?{w} Was everything that he said a lie...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't fathom it. What had happened defied everything we'd learned.
entries.literal: "I couldn't fathom it. What had happened defied everything we'd learned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I had been pretty close to Erina, but going off Sai's previous travel, the range shouldn't have been large enough to pick us up.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I had been pretty close to Erina, but going off Sai's previous travel, the range shouldn't have been large enough to pick us up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd been farther back than Sai, but why had he been the only one to travel? And what I'd thought earlier still applied: where had his past self been all that time?
entries.literal: "We'd been farther back than Sai, but why had he been the only one to travel? And what I'd thought earlier still applied: where had his past self been all that time?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Admit it... Did you ever want me to save Isla? Were you... Were you involved in the first place!?
entries.literal: "Admit it... Did you ever want me to save Isla? Were you... Were you involved in the first place!?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're wrong. We don't know how the Sekimeiya works, but this shouldn't have happened...
entries.literal: "You're wrong. We don't know how the Sekimeiya works, but this shouldn't have happened..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I don't get it! Is it all nonsense? Can we not figure out how it works because it just does whatever it wants?
entries.literal: "I don't get it! Is it all nonsense? Can we not figure out how it works because it just does whatever it wants?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's been pretty consistent up until now, so what's this shit...? Why did Erina not travel but Sai did when he was out of the range?
entries.literal: "It's been pretty consistent up until now, so what's this shit...? Why did Erina not travel but Sai did when he was out of the range?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There's even another instance... The first time I traveled, I went twenty minutes back, meaning that the Sekimeiya had to have been storing energy for fifteen minutes. At the time, Sai was the closest person to me, and he was pretty much at the same distance he was from Erina just now, but he didn't travel then!
entries.literal: "There's even another instance... The first time I traveled, I went twenty minutes back, meaning that the Sekimeiya had to have been storing energy for fifteen minutes. At the time, Sai was the closest person to me, and he was pretty much at the same distance he was from Erina just now, but he didn't travel then!"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No... I'm misinterpreting it.
entries.literal: "No... I'm misinterpreting it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That has to be it... I assumed I knew what the range was since the conditions were identical to Sai's last travel.
entries.literal: "That has to be it... I assumed I knew what the range was since the conditions were identical to Sai's last travel."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I didn't travel that time, but Shiroya did, even though she was next to me. That led me to think I was just barely out of range and that only she was included.
entries.literal: "I didn't travel that time, but Shiroya did, even though she was next to me. That led me to think I was just barely out of range and that only she was included."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But that wasn't the case. I was also in range, and I didn't travel for another reason, just like how Erina didn't just now. It's what I thought: something prevented me from traveling, and it just happened again.
entries.literal: "But that wasn't the case. I was also in range, and I didn't travel for another reason, just like how Erina didn't just now. It's what I thought: something prevented me from traveling, and it just happened again."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Just earlier, I told Sai that I saw Shiroya disappear with him. He must've realized that I hadn't traveled, so he set up the same conditions for Erina's travel and felt safe at a slightly farther distance than I was from him before. However, he just fell victim to my own misinterpretation. The previous time, the range was actually big enough to encompass me, but I didn't go anywhere...
entries.literal: "Just earlier, I told Sai that I saw Shiroya disappear with him. He must've realized that I hadn't traveled, so he set up the same conditions for Erina's travel and felt safe at a slightly farther distance than I was from him before. However, he just fell victim to my own misinterpretation. The previous time, the range was actually big enough to encompass me, but I didn't go anywhere..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And in the latest travel, the four of us might've been included while only Sai disappeared. What was the reason...? It couldn't be that only two people could travel anymore. Was there anything that would make sense?
entries.literal: "And in the latest travel, the four of us might've been included while only Sai disappeared. What was the reason...? It couldn't be that only two people could travel anymore. Was there anything that would make sense?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Wait! Where did it go!?
entries.literal: "...Wait! Where did it go!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I quickly looked up and saw Erina's desperate eyes. She was staring at her purse.
entries.literal: "I quickly looked up and saw Erina's desperate eyes. She was staring at her purse."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's not here!
entries.literal: "It's not here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was wrong. Sai wasn't the only thing to disappear—the Sekimeiya also had.
entries.literal: "I was wrong. Sai wasn't the only thing to disappear—the Sekimeiya also had."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It... teleported.
entries.literal: "It... teleported."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd experienced it for the first time. The infamous teleportation we'd constantly thought about had revealed itself to us. Erina's travel activated it, taking Sai away in the process.
entries.literal: "I'd experienced it for the first time. The infamous teleportation we'd constantly thought about had revealed itself to us. Erina's travel activated it, taking Sai away in the process."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remembered what had happened just minutes prior, so I took a few steps forward.
entries.literal: "I remembered what had happened just minutes prior, so I took a few steps forward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I was in front of the cabinet, I crouched and grabbed the bottom of the curtain. I raised it violently and kept it from falling again.
entries.literal: "When I was in front of the cabinet, I crouched and grabbed the bottom of the curtain. I raised it violently and kept it from falling again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind the glass was the Sekimeiya. It had traveled from Erina's purse to its initial cabinet.
entries.literal: "Behind the glass was the Sekimeiya. It had traveled from Erina's purse to its initial cabinet."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Atsuki, tell me... What do I need to do to travel through time?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, tell me... What do I need to do to travel through time?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Exactly what Sai and I told you. I don't know why it didn't work just now.
entries.literal: "Exactly what Sai and I told you. I don't know why it didn't work just now."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And since this confirms that it can actually teleport, there's no way I still have the Sekimeiya in the locker.
entries.literal: "And since this confirms that it can actually teleport, there's no way I still have the Sekimeiya in the locker."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In fact, the teleportation probably caused the illusion from the start... The "other" Sekimeiya.{w} I'm not sure how it happened, but I bet it was the same one every time.
entries.literal: "In fact, the teleportation probably caused the illusion from the start... The \"other\" Sekimeiya.{w} I'm not sure how it happened, but I bet it was the same one every time."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Why is Sai not here already? ...Did he think of using the time he gained to do something?
entries.literal: "Why is Sai not here already? ...Did he think of using the time he gained to do something?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had likely gone about twenty minutes into the past, so he had time to think of a better course of action than rushing in as soon as possible.
entries.literal: "He had likely gone about twenty minutes into the past, so he had time to think of a better course of action than rushing in as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Realizing our confusion was sincere, Erina's face went pale, and she would've fallen backward if not for the wall behind her.
entries.literal: "Realizing our confusion was sincere, Erina's face went pale, and she would've fallen backward if not for the wall behind her."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Three towering questions just presented themselves to us, challenging everything up until this point.
entries.literal: "Three towering questions just presented themselves to us, challenging everything up until this point."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: One: was the range really the same as the last time the Sekimeiya stored time for fifteen minutes?
entries.literal: "One: was the range really the same as the last time the Sekimeiya stored time for fifteen minutes?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Two: why was Sai the only one to travel?
entries.literal: "Two: why was Sai the only one to travel?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Three: why did the Sekimeiya instantly teleport away?
entries.literal: "Three: why did the Sekimeiya instantly teleport away?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Regarding the range, we can't know how it actually functions. I've assumed it only starts to expand when time begins to be stored, but what if that's not the case? Could it also increase while the Sekimeiya's in the cabinet? Or what if the range from previous travels persists, for example?
entries.literal: "Regarding the range, we can't know how it actually functions. I've assumed it only starts to expand when time begins to be stored, but what if that's not the case? Could it also increase while the Sekimeiya's in the cabinet? Or what if the range from previous travels persists, for example?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The second is the most confusing one. Erina, Shiroya, and I haven't traveled. There's no way we weren't included in the range, is there? At least not Erina, who touched the Sekimeiya...{w} But it only worked for Sai... There has to be a reason why we were excluded, but is it reasonable to think I can figure it out?
entries.literal: "The second is the most confusing one. Erina, Shiroya, and I haven't traveled. There's no way we weren't included in the range, is there? At least not Erina, who touched the Sekimeiya...{w} But it only worked for Sai... There has to be a reason why we were excluded, but is it reasonable to think I can figure it out?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What does this do to the concept of range? Now how can we be sure that it exists? Perhaps there's no range at all, and something else entirely determines who's included in the travel.
entries.literal: "What does this do to the concept of range? Now how can we be sure that it exists? Perhaps there's no range at all, and something else entirely determines who's included in the travel."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And, finally, why did the Sekimeiya disappear from Erina's purse?
entries.literal: "And, finally, why did the Sekimeiya disappear from Erina's purse?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's impossible that happens every time it's activated: it didn't disappear when Sai and Shiroya traveled.
entries.literal: "It's impossible that happens every time it's activated: it didn't disappear when Sai and Shiroya traveled."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Without a doubt, this is the strangest travel so far. Those three questions might all be connected to one single misconception.
entries.literal: "Without a doubt, this is the strangest travel so far. Those three questions might all be connected to one single misconception."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What are we supposed to do...? How am I supposed to understand this thing if it keeps breaking its own rules? How can I ever even hope to use it for anything?
entries.literal: "What are we supposed to do...? How am I supposed to understand this thing if it keeps breaking its own rules? How can I ever even hope to use it for anything?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Can I... not save Isla? Why did it not work...?{w} Oh, of course.{w} What was I even thinking? Traveling to the past isn't possible.{w} You lied about it since the beginning, right? That's why it didn't work: it can't happen. I actually fell for it.
entries.literal: "Can I... not save Isla? Why did it not work...?{w} Oh, of course.{w} What was I even thinking? Traveling to the past isn't possible.{w} You lied about it since the beginning, right? That's why it didn't work: it can't happen. I actually fell for it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was too lost to answer. Something had happened to Erina—that was for sure. She'd just witnessed Sai's disappearance but was accusing us of lying. It seemed that trying to explain ourselves wouldn't be much help.
entries.literal: "I was too lost to answer. Something had happened to Erina—that was for sure. She'd just witnessed Sai's disappearance but was accusing us of lying. It seemed that trying to explain ourselves wouldn't be much help."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Just wait here. I'll be back in a second.
entries.literal: "Just wait here. I'll be back in a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before she could react, I moved to hallway B. I needed to check the staff room.
entries.literal: "Before she could react, I moved to hallway B. I needed to check the staff room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The locker where I'd hidden the Sekimeiya was directly to my right. I unlocked it with the key and opened the door.
entries.literal: "The locker where I'd hidden the Sekimeiya was directly to my right. I unlocked it with the key and opened the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya wasn't there. Only the pants and the coat remained inside.{w} I closed the door and locked it again.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya wasn't there. Only the pants and the coat remained inside.{w} I closed the door and locked it again."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I see... Shiroya was right, then. The other time, it did teleport away from Naomi's locker.
entries.literal: "I see... Shiroya was right, then. The other time, it did teleport away from Naomi's locker."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In hallway B, I saw Shiroya waiting for me next to the event room.
entries.literal: "In hallway B, I saw Shiroya waiting for me next to the event room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Did it disappear?
entries.literal: "...Did it disappear?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What else could've happened? I couldn't rule out another person having the key, but while I had room to construct a theory that didn't involve self-teleportation, it seemed pointless to do so.
entries.literal: "What else could've happened? I couldn't rule out another person having the key, but while I had room to construct a theory that didn't involve self-teleportation, it seemed pointless to do so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had someone put another Sekimeiya in the cabinet after entering from hallway A and taken mine out of the staff room while we were in the event room? There was no way. Nobody else had been involved.
entries.literal: "Had someone put another Sekimeiya in the cabinet after entering from hallway A and taken mine out of the staff room while we were in the event room? There was no way. Nobody else had been involved."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh-What did you want to do?
entries.literal: "Wh-What did you want to do?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, I'm just wondering about Sai's whereabouts because an extra version of him has existed somewhere in the past.
entries.literal: "Oh, I'm just wondering about Sai's whereabouts because an extra version of him has existed somewhere in the past."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did we never see him in so many hours?
entries.literal: "Did we never see him in so many hours?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "So many hours". Right, she thinks Sai went back to before Isla died. In reality, he went back about twenty minutes, if that's consistent.{w} ...Although she just went from saying time travel isn't possible to thinking it is again. She's more unstable than I thought.
entries.literal: "\"So many hours\". Right, she thinks Sai went back to before Isla died. In reality, he went back about twenty minutes, if that's consistent.{w} ...Although she just went from saying time travel isn't possible to thinking it is again. She's more unstable than I thought."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I'm not sure, but he has to be somewhere.
entries.literal: "...I'm not sure, but he has to be somewhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was a little frustrated by Shiroya's continued silence. She was definitely thinking about what had happened, but she might've had information I wasn't aware of, and nothing she had revealed yet.
entries.literal: "I was a little frustrated by Shiroya's continued silence. She was definitely thinking about what had happened, but she might've had information I wasn't aware of, and nothing she had revealed yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The three of us were going over our thoughts when, suddenly, the door to the lobby opened.
entries.literal: "The three of us were going over our thoughts when, suddenly, the door to the lobby opened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There you are. What were you doing?
entries.literal: "There you are. What were you doing?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something was strange, and it immediately became apparent. Sai had shown up from the lobby, so I was relieved to know that he wouldn't be unaccounted for. He, on the other hand, looked completely different.
entries.literal: "Something was strange, and it immediately became apparent. Sai had shown up from the lobby, so I was relieved to know that he wouldn't be unaccounted for. He, on the other hand, looked completely different."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh...? What the fuck?
entries.literal: "Wh...? What the fuck?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd never seen him so confused. He'd tried to have the upper hand in every situation, but his face told the truth: he couldn't comprehend what he was seeing. From his point of view, something was very wrong.
entries.literal: "I'd never seen him so confused. He'd tried to have the upper hand in every situation, but his face told the truth: he couldn't comprehend what he was seeing. From his point of view, something was very wrong."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...!{w} Wh-Who the fuck are you? How are you here?
entries.literal: "...!{w} Wh-Who the fuck are you? How are you here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the event room, a door opened. After everything that had just happened, when I saw who came out, I barely reacted.
entries.literal: "From the event room, a door opened. After everything that had just happened, when I saw who came out, I barely reacted."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Whoa! What's this girl doing here!?
entries.literal: "Whoa! What's this girl doing here!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those were the first words I'd heard from Akaro in hours. Recognizing the person who shared his bewilderment, he stood next to Sai while the three of us looked at each other in case someone understood what was occurring.
entries.literal: "Those were the first words I'd heard from Akaro in hours. Recognizing the person who shared his bewilderment, he stood next to Sai while the three of us looked at each other in case someone understood what was occurring."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki! Now you have to answer! Who is she?
entries.literal: "Atsuki! Now you have to answer! Who is she?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Are you actually acting as if you don't recognize me?
entries.literal: "...Are you actually acting as if you don't recognize me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course we don't!
entries.literal: "Of course we don't!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well... No.{w} Of course we do.{w} Aren't you... dead?
entries.literal: "Well... No.{w} Of course we do.{w} Aren't you... dead?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Again...!
entries.literal: "Again...!"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Shiroya's fate is death."
entries.literal: "\"Shiroya's fate is death.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I need to say it. I've always wanted to, and I can't believe I never will. I love you."
entries.literal: "\"I need to say it. I've always wanted to, and I can't believe I never will. I love you.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nightmarish memories split my brain in half. It seemed like the world was abandoning all sense, warping into something completely repulsive.
entries.literal: "Nightmarish memories split my brain in half. It seemed like the world was abandoning all sense, warping into something completely repulsive."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: M-Me...? Why would I be dead?
entries.literal: "M-Me...? Why would I be dead?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And you too, Erina! I thought you'd died!
entries.literal: "And you too, Erina! I thought you'd died!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh...? Isn't that what you said earlier?
entries.literal: "Wh...? Isn't that what you said earlier?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Earlier? What the hell are you talking about?
entries.literal: "Earlier? What the hell are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before the conversation could escalate further, I had to ask a very important question which had been repeating throughout our imprisonment.
entries.literal: "Before the conversation could escalate further, I had to ask a very important question which had been repeating throughout our imprisonment."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, what time is it?
entries.literal: "Sai, what time is it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Uh...{w} it's {time=18:43.}

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {time=18:43.}..{w} That was about twenty minutes behind the real time I estimated. That meant Sai's replicated location after traveling had been twenty minutes prior, and his watch hadn't stopped working.
entries.literal: "{time=18:43.}..{w} That was about twenty minutes behind the real time I estimated. That meant Sai's replicated location after traveling had been twenty minutes prior, and his watch hadn't stopped working."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why? Did you time travel?
entries.literal: "Why? Did you time travel?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: N-No. I didn't.
entries.literal: "N-No. I didn't."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: He's right, though. Are you a future version of Erina or something?
entries.literal: "He's right, though. Are you a future version of Erina or something?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well, you're not dead after all, but we felt your pulse... In any case, I figured you would've come from the future. What even happened to you?
entries.literal: "Well, you're not dead after all, but we felt your pulse... In any case, I figured you would've come from the future. What even happened to you?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Um... I can't remember much. I think someone hit my head, and I fell unconscious. I don't know what happened before that.
entries.literal: "Um... I can't remember much. I think someone hit my head, and I fell unconscious. I don't know what happened before that."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yeah, that's about what we knew too. Sorry that we can't be of more use.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that's about what we knew too. Sorry that we can't be of more use."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was losing it. I was about to explode. What the fuck was happening? Was it all a joke, deliberately constructed to destroy me?
entries.literal: "I was losing it. I was about to explode. What the fuck was happening? Was it all a joke, deliberately constructed to destroy me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't get it either, but I'm glad you're safe. This means you're not guaranteed to end up dead, but you... What even is your name? How did you get here?
entries.literal: "I don't get it either, but I'm glad you're safe. This means you're not guaranteed to end up dead, but you... What even is your name? How did you get here?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I've been here since the start.
entries.literal: "...I've been here since the start."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's not true.
entries.literal: "That's not true."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the same thing. In the attic, an Akaro who claimed to only possess partial memories of events had appeared. Was Sai a victim of that as well?
entries.literal: "It was the same thing. In the attic, an Akaro who claimed to only possess partial memories of events had appeared. Was Sai a victim of that as well?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hold on, though... Your name... I think I might actually remember that.{w} Shi... roya, was it? My memories are a little foggy.
entries.literal: "Hold on, though... Your name... I think I might actually remember that.{w} Shi... roya, was it? My memories are a little foggy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She nodded, speechless.
entries.literal: "She nodded, speechless."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I thought so. Like I said... I thought you'd died.
entries.literal: "I thought so. Like I said... I thought you'd died."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: As you can see, I'm alive.
entries.literal: "As you can see, I'm alive."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Do you have a twin, by any chance?
entries.literal: "Do you have a twin, by any chance?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What? No.
entries.literal: "What? No."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: But, then... It doesn't make any sense. I'm still really confused...
entries.literal: "But, then... It doesn't make any sense. I'm still really confused..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck do you mean you're "confused"!? She just showed up like that! Did you enter through the storeroom?
entries.literal: "What the fuck do you mean you're \"confused\"!? She just showed up like that! Did you enter through the storeroom?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I've been with you since {time=9}, Sai.
entries.literal: "I've been with you since {time=9}, Sai."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's a load of crap. Regardless, you'll definitely die. I'm sorry to tell you like that, but you're not making it easy for us. Atsuki, I know you know her.
entries.literal: "That's a load of crap. Regardless, you'll definitely die. I'm sorry to tell you like that, but you're not making it easy for us. Atsuki, I know you know her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I do, and she's telling the truth.
entries.literal: "...{w}I do, and she's telling the truth."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you just fucking with me? What's the point of lying so blatantly?
entries.literal: "Are you just fucking with me? What's the point of lying so blatantly?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: He's... He's telling the truth. Shiroya's been with us the entire time.
entries.literal: "He's... He's telling the truth. Shiroya's been with us the entire time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The entire time? Not even you have been here since {time=9}!
entries.literal: "The entire time? Not even you have been here since {time=9}!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: E-Excuse me?
entries.literal: "E-Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, you get what I mean. You don't remember when you got attacked or where you came from very well, right?
entries.literal: "Well, you get what I mean. You don't remember when you got attacked or where you came from very well, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course, Erina and Isla have been here the whole time, {tip=clash}but not you{/tip}.
entries.literal: "Of course, Erina and Isla have been here the whole time, {tip=clash}but not you{/tip}."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was settled. They had either gone completely insane or their plan was to make us go insane. After being told once again that Shiroya's fate was sealed, I continued to search for a method to refute it.
entries.literal: "It was settled. They had either gone completely insane or their plan was to make us go insane. After being told once again that Shiroya's fate was sealed, I continued to search for a method to refute it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned to look at her, but I couldn't make heads or tails of her expression. Her eyes fixed on a point in the distance, and that was all I knew. It had become a challenge just to know what anyone trapped in the tower was thinking.
entries.literal: "I turned to look at her, but I couldn't make heads or tails of her expression. Her eyes fixed on a point in the distance, and that was all I knew. It had become a challenge just to know what anyone trapped in the tower was thinking."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Did you notice something?
entries.literal: "...Did you notice something?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}I... need to go somewhere.
entries.literal: "...{w}I... need to go somewhere."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm sorry, I need to go to the attic.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry, I need to go to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She ran toward hallway C. There I stood, petrified, until she turned around to say one last thing.
entries.literal: "She ran toward hallway C. There I stood, petrified, until she turned around to say one last thing."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Please, don't follow me.
entries.literal: "Please, don't follow me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could only stare at her eyes, in search of any compassion. Why was she being so cryptic?
entries.literal: "I could only stare at her eyes, in search of any compassion. Why was she being so cryptic?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With an apologetic look, she spun and sprinted off.
entries.literal: "With an apologetic look, she spun and sprinted off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Please, don't follow me." Why...? Why did she want to go alone...?{w} I was sure I looked devastated, but I was only trying to decipher the sudden change of behavior my oldest friend had undergone.
entries.literal: "\"Please, don't follow me.\" Why...? Why did she want to go alone...?{w} I was sure I looked devastated, but I was only trying to decipher the sudden change of behavior my oldest friend had undergone."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wow. Are we going to just let her go? Didn't you see how suspicious that was?
entries.literal: "Wow. Are we going to just let her go? Didn't you see how suspicious that was?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, that's fine. She's just gonna get herself killed somehow. It's already unavoidable.
entries.literal: "Well, that's fine. She's just gonna get herself killed somehow. It's already unavoidable."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why!? Why is she gonna die!?
entries.literal: "Why!? Why is she gonna die!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you hit your head and lose your memories? We know it will happen.
entries.literal: "Did you hit your head and lose your memories? We know it will happen."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How!? You seem pretty certain, so prove it!
entries.literal: "How!? You seem pretty certain, so prove it!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You know we can't anymore.
entries.literal: "You know we can't anymore."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck does that mean!?
entries.literal: "What the fuck does that mean!?"

entries.speaker: i
