entries.text: Akaro looked at me as if he was witnessing a man who'd gone mad.
entries.literal: "Akaro looked at me as if he was witnessing a man who'd gone mad."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What's with that look!? Where did you even go!? You just appeared again, out of nowhere!
entries.literal: "What's with that look!? Where did you even go!? You just appeared again, out of nowhere!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Huh...? It's you who appeared again.
entries.literal: "Huh...? It's you who appeared again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hit the wall, furious. Their responses were making my blood boil, like they were sneering at me.
entries.literal: "I hit the wall, furious. Their responses were making my blood boil, like they were sneering at me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You too, Sai! Did your memories also happen to get fucked? You traveled from the event room. Remember that?
entries.literal: "You too, Sai! Did your memories also happen to get fucked? You traveled from the event room. Remember that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...From the event room? No, I don't.
entries.literal: "...From the event room? No, I don't."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Have you two just lost it completely? Or this is a side effect of the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Have you two just lost it completely? Or this is a side effect of the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You can stop trying already. Since you sided with that girl, you made it clear you'll only spit out bullshit. I don't know what you're trying to pull, but you look pathetic.{w} She'll come back whenever she feels like, if she doesn't die in the process. Meanwhile, let's keep waiting for the shutter to open. I'd appreciate it if you told the truth, though. How did she get in?
entries.literal: "You can stop trying already. Since you sided with that girl, you made it clear you'll only spit out bullshit. I don't know what you're trying to pull, but you look pathetic.{w} She'll come back whenever she feels like, if she doesn't die in the process. Meanwhile, let's keep waiting for the shutter to open. I'd appreciate it if you told the truth, though. How did she get in?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: She was with us from the beginning...
entries.literal: "She was with us from the beginning..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's false. Since she seems to be with you, I really doubt you were stupid enough to make her enter through the storeroom. That's what's strange, but perhaps you did.{w} Let me see.
entries.literal: "That's false. Since she seems to be with you, I really doubt you were stupid enough to make her enter through the storeroom. That's what's strange, but perhaps you did.{w} Let me see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Indifferent to my confusion and rage, Sai walked to hallway C.
entries.literal: "Indifferent to my confusion and rage, Sai walked to hallway C."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What are you doing!?
entries.literal: "What are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of answering, he entered the storeroom.{w} Seconds later, he returned.
entries.literal: "Instead of answering, he entered the storeroom.{w} Seconds later, he returned."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I just wanted to verify that she hasn't entered through the storeroom yet.
entries.literal: "I just wanted to verify that she hasn't entered through the storeroom yet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Have you thought of a plan to keep the Sekimeiya for yourself? Then, once you succeed, you'll eventually make her go back in time to appear inside the tower and take care of whatever your plan requires.
entries.literal: "...Have you thought of a plan to keep the Sekimeiya for yourself? Then, once you succeed, you'll eventually make her go back in time to appear inside the tower and take care of whatever your plan requires."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What are you even talking about...?
entries.literal: "What are you even talking about...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe two of you weren't enough, I don't know. Although if that's what you did, you had to know you were sending her to die, even if she was already supposed to be dead. I don't get exactly what your idea is or how this all came to happen. It's a damn mess.
entries.literal: "Maybe two of you weren't enough, I don't know. Although if that's what you did, you had to know you were sending her to die, even if she was already supposed to be dead. I don't get exactly what your idea is or how this all came to happen. It's a damn mess."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Again, what the fuck are you talking about? What does "maybe two of you weren't enough" even mean?
entries.literal: "Again, what the fuck are you talking about? What does \"maybe two of you weren't enough\" even mean?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course, I'm assuming Miiya's in on it as well.
entries.literal: "Of course, I'm assuming Miiya's in on it as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gave up. I approached the nearest wall and kneeled next to it, only capable of breathing. It was incomprehensible. Nonsense.
entries.literal: "I gave up. I approached the nearest wall and kneeled next to it, only capable of breathing. It was incomprehensible. Nonsense."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not gonna keep trying to clear your name? I suppose it'd be futile with how obvious it is that this is your doing.
entries.literal: "Not gonna keep trying to clear your name? I suppose it'd be futile with how obvious it is that this is your doing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Okay, I'll ask. How do you know about Miiya?
entries.literal: "...Okay, I'll ask. How do you know about Miiya?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What? She's been here—
entries.literal: "What? She's been here—"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's it, ignore him from now on. He can't get out of the corner he's backed himself into.
entries.literal: "That's it, ignore him from now on. He can't get out of the corner he's backed himself into."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I covered my eyes with my arm, applying as much pressure against my face as I could. Who had decided to make me go through hell, and why had Shiroya left me behind!?
entries.literal: "...I covered my eyes with my arm, applying as much pressure against my face as I could. Who had decided to make me go through hell, and why had Shiroya left me behind!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Letting out a casual laugh, Sai sat next to me.
entries.literal: "Letting out a casual laugh, Sai sat next to me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Aren't you going to follow her? It seemed really obvious that you gave her some kind of cue to leave, you know?
entries.literal: "Aren't you going to follow her? It seemed really obvious that you gave her some kind of cue to leave, you know?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: She just got this blank look and suddenly had to go... Was that all you could come up with? I gave you a little bit of credit earlier, but honestly, what happened to Erina could definitely have been all you.
entries.literal: "She just got this blank look and suddenly had to go... Was that all you could come up with? I gave you a little bit of credit earlier, but honestly, what happened to Erina could definitely have been all you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pushed Sai aside with as much force as I could gather. If my mind had already broken, he was doing all he could to scatter all the pieces around.
entries.literal: "I pushed Sai aside with as much force as I could gather. If my mind had already broken, he was doing all he could to scatter all the pieces around."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's harsh. I suppose that's the only way you can defend yourself. We'll see what your plan amounts to soon.{w} Maybe not, actually. Maybe we'll just never see that girl again. At least not alive, of course.
entries.literal: "That's harsh. I suppose that's the only way you can defend yourself. We'll see what your plan amounts to soon.{w} Maybe not, actually. Maybe we'll just never see that girl again. At least not alive, of course."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, I swear if you open your mouth again, I'm going to fucking break it.
entries.literal: "Sai, I swear if you open your mouth again, I'm going to fucking break it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I get it, I get it. Let's wait as much as you want.
entries.literal: "I get it, I get it. Let's wait as much as you want."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My vision was dark, partly covered by my arm. Standing up were Akaro and Erina, whose expressions I couldn't see.
entries.literal: "My vision was dark, partly covered by my arm. Standing up were Akaro and Erina, whose expressions I couldn't see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Beyond the meaning behind Sai's words and Akaro's appearance, I couldn't get my thoughts off Shiroya. Why had she left like that?
entries.literal: "Beyond the meaning behind Sai's words and Akaro's appearance, I couldn't get my thoughts off Shiroya. Why had she left like that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She hadn't even promised me she'd return. I tried not to let Sai's voice loop in my head, but there was no stopping it.
entries.literal: "She hadn't even promised me she'd return. I tried not to let Sai's voice loop in my head, but there was no stopping it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was she going to die...? Would I write that note? ...No. Neither of those would happen.
entries.literal: "Was she going to die...? Would I write that note? ...No. Neither of those would happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She wouldn't just leave like that if she thought there was a chance she would die. There had to be a good reason behind her actions.
entries.literal: "She wouldn't just leave like that if she thought there was a chance she would die. There had to be a good reason behind her actions."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Don't kill me, but hasn't it been a long time since she left? What do you think she's doing?
entries.literal: "...Don't kill me, but hasn't it been a long time since she left? What do you think she's doing?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Be quiet.
entries.literal: "Be quiet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Listen, she looked at me as well when she said not to follow her, so I'm being considerate by staying behind. I was just wondering if you had any idea.
entries.literal: "Listen, she looked at me as well when she said not to follow her, so I'm being considerate by staying behind. I was just wondering if you had any idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was the least of my concerns. I barely put any thought into punching him, but before I did, I saw a conspicuous smile all over his face. It only faded momentarily, returning right after the blow.
entries.literal: "Sai was the least of my concerns. I barely put any thought into punching him, but before I did, I saw a conspicuous smile all over his face. It only faded momentarily, returning right after the blow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't say anything, but he positioned himself back at my side. While I couldn't see him, his mere presence felt disgusting.
entries.literal: "He didn't say anything, but he positioned himself back at my side. While I couldn't see him, his mere presence felt disgusting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Not a single part left of me felt able to continue reasoning out what was happening. All I knew was that the last travel had been different and somehow led to Sai's behavior, with him being the only affected person.
entries.literal: "Not a single part left of me felt able to continue reasoning out what was happening. All I knew was that the last travel had been different and somehow led to Sai's behavior, with him being the only affected person."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But even though I felt stuck, I couldn't stop time from ticking. Every second I spent sheltering myself from reality was another one I spent thinking that Shiroya might never come back.
entries.literal: "But even though I felt stuck, I couldn't stop time from ticking. Every second I spent sheltering myself from reality was another one I spent thinking that Shiroya might never come back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, my attempts at calming down bore some fruit. Up until then, she and I had been making our way through the day together. The version of her that had just gone upstairs had experienced things I wasn't aware of, so she'd known that following along would've been a bad idea.
entries.literal: "Eventually, my attempts at calming down bore some fruit. Up until then, she and I had been making our way through the day together. The version of her that had just gone upstairs had experienced things I wasn't aware of, so she'd known that following along would've been a bad idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, what could she have gone to do, and why had she not explained it even vaguely? She simply left.
entries.literal: "However, what could she have gone to do, and why had she not explained it even vaguely? She simply left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...She'd gone to the attic. The Sekimeiya was in the event room, so what could she have wanted to do up there?
entries.literal: "...She'd gone to the attic. The Sekimeiya was in the event room, so what could she have wanted to do up there?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you remember anything else, Erina?
entries.literal: "Do you remember anything else, Erina?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I don't think so.
entries.literal: "...I don't think so."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I think I might have an idea about who attacked you now.
entries.literal: "I think I might have an idea about who attacked you now."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I wouldn't wanna get killed, though. Atsuki, sorry to bother you, but who do you think it was?
entries.literal: "I wouldn't wanna get killed, though. Atsuki, sorry to bother you, but who do you think it was?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I don't know.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't know."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Not even the slightest idea?
entries.literal: "...Not even the slightest idea?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What, are you going to say it was Shiroya?
entries.literal: "What, are you going to say it was Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I would never say that. However, she's the most likely suspect, isn't she?
entries.literal: "I would never say that. However, she's the most likely suspect, isn't she?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: She isn't! Why the fuck is he saying that?
entries.literal: "She isn't! Why the fuck is he saying that?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Because "she could've traveled to the past and done it"? That's bullshit! How is she more suspicious than anyone else?
entries.literal: "Because \"she could've traveled to the past and done it\"? That's bullshit! How is she more suspicious than anyone else?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey, I know it could've been anyone, but it'd be a bit strange if it wasn't her. Although I only assumed you weren't guilty because I thought you wouldn't be so stupid.
entries.literal: "Hey, I know it could've been anyone, but it'd be a bit strange if it wasn't her. Although I only assumed you weren't guilty because I thought you wouldn't be so stupid."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Does that make sense? I don't think she could've attacked her.
entries.literal: "Does that make sense? I don't think she could've attacked her."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I do. After all, aren't you basing that on what Atsuki said?
entries.literal: "I do. After all, aren't you basing that on what Atsuki said?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Wait, you're right... Atsuki, tell me the truth. Was that what you did?
entries.literal: "Wait, you're right... Atsuki, tell me the truth. Was that what you did?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shut the fuck up! I didn't do anything!
entries.literal: "Shut the fuck up! I didn't do anything!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Erina, I have a question. Did you kill Shiroya? That would explain almost everything.
entries.literal: "Erina, I have a question. Did you kill Shiroya? That would explain almost everything."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: N-No...! Of course not...!
entries.literal: "N-No...! Of course not...!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right. I wonder... could this have worked...?
entries.literal: "Right. I wonder... could this have worked...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every time I heard him, I repeated a mantra: listening to him was pointless. Not a single thing he was saying made any sense or had any value.
entries.literal: "Every time I heard him, I repeated a mantra: listening to him was pointless. Not a single thing he was saying made any sense or had any value."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Earlier, he'd tried to kill us but refused to tell us why. After undergoing a sudden change, he was acting aggressive toward me again... Was it only because he'd seen Shiroya, who he didn't remember or thought couldn't be alive?
entries.literal: "Earlier, he'd tried to kill us but refused to tell us why. After undergoing a sudden change, he was acting aggressive toward me again... Was it only because he'd seen Shiroya, who he didn't remember or thought couldn't be alive?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What about Akaro, who hadn't been anywhere for hours? What were they talking about regarding Erina? And how in the hell did they know about Miiya? Had the Sekimeiya just created an absurd clash of events and memories?
entries.literal: "What about Akaro, who hadn't been anywhere for hours? What were they talking about regarding Erina? And how in the hell did they know about Miiya? Had the Sekimeiya just created an absurd clash of events and memories?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to know what had happened to Shiroya and everyone in the tower. Sai's behavior toward me was light years different from how he'd treated me at the beginning, but he'd always operated logically. I wanted to know what had caused the immense change, but arguing with him was impossible.
entries.literal: "I wanted to know what had happened to Shiroya and everyone in the tower. Sai's behavior toward me was light years different from how he'd treated me at the beginning, but he'd always operated logically. I wanted to know what had caused the immense change, but arguing with him was impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were too many things I needed to understand. Questions had barraged me since {time=9}, and each one was more complex than the last. With the little time we had left, there was no way I could be optimistic and think that everything was magically going to be resolved.
entries.literal: "There were too many things I needed to understand. Questions had barraged me since {time=9}, and each one was more complex than the last. With the little time we had left, there was no way I could be optimistic and think that everything was magically going to be resolved."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What Shiroya and I had gotten ourselves caught up in was out of our league. So I tried to push everything that didn't directly involve us away and focused on what I most wanted to decipher.
entries.literal: "What Shiroya and I had gotten ourselves caught up in was out of our league. So I tried to push everything that didn't directly involve us away and focused on what I most wanted to decipher."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya had gone to the past with Sai, probably about twenty minutes. However, an extra version of her had already been in the tower for much longer—since I'd seen her in the event room.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had gone to the past with Sai, probably about twenty minutes. However, an extra version of her had already been in the tower for much longer—since I'd seen her in the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite not knowing what that Shiroya had lived through, it was reasonable to assume it happened in the attic, which was locked and beyond my view. As such, she'd realized she had to go there.
entries.literal: "Despite not knowing what that Shiroya had lived through, it was reasonable to assume it happened in the attic, which was locked and beyond my view. As such, she'd realized she had to go there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait... I'm not sure if this is strange, but it could be important.
entries.literal: "Wait... I'm not sure if this is strange, but it could be important."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Please, don't follow me."
entries.literal: "\"Please, don't follow me.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Yes, like Sai said, she directed that at everyone, but she was specifically looking at me. She didn't want me to follow her.
entries.literal: "Yes, like Sai said, she directed that at everyone, but she was specifically looking at me. She didn't want me to follow her."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, how would I?
entries.literal: "However, how would I?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I can't enter the attic; she would have the key, if anyone.
entries.literal: "I can't enter the attic; she would have the key, if anyone."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The way she looked at me... It was like she was telling me that if I followed her, I would hinder whatever she wanted to do.{w} But she was already in hallway C. If she really wanted me not to come along, all she had to do was use the elevator up to the attic and I'd have no way to chase her.
entries.literal: "The way she looked at me... It was like she was telling me that if I followed her, I would hinder whatever she wanted to do.{w} But she was already in hallway C. If she really wanted me not to come along, all she had to do was use the elevator up to the attic and I'd have no way to chase her."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So what does that mean? She thought I could've followed her to the attic if I'd just run behind her... That's the impression I get.
entries.literal: "So what does that mean? She thought I could've followed her to the attic if I'd just run behind her... That's the impression I get."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If I'm right, that means I can enter the attic and she doesn't have the key for it. And somehow, she knew it was unlocked when I know it wasn't just minutes ago.
entries.literal: "If I'm right, that means I can enter the attic and she doesn't have the key for it. And somehow, she knew it was unlocked when I know it wasn't just minutes ago."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...I'm sorry, but I can't keep staying here. Shiroya, maybe you've already accomplished what you wanted to do and I won't find you up there, but I need to find out what happened.
entries.literal: "...I'm sorry, but I can't keep staying here. Shiroya, maybe you've already accomplished what you wanted to do and I won't find you up there, but I need to find out what happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What time is it?
entries.literal: "What time is it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is this all the time you needed to give her?{w} Let me see... It's {time=19:08.}
entries.literal: "Is this all the time you needed to give her?{w} Let me see... It's {time=19:08.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Time was moving quickly. The shutter would retract in an hour and a half, so I the only thing I could shoot for was being with Shiroya when it happened.
entries.literal: "Time was moving quickly. The shutter would retract in an hour and a half, so I the only thing I could shoot for was being with Shiroya when it happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If you plan to go to the attic, don't think we'll let you go alone.
entries.literal: "If you plan to go to the attic, don't think we'll let you go alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up, ignoring him. He didn't hesitate to stand too, and it seemed Akaro and Erina were getting closer.
entries.literal: "I stood up, ignoring him. He didn't hesitate to stand too, and it seemed Akaro and Erina were getting closer."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Should we take the elevator?
entries.literal: "Should we take the elevator?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you have the attic key?
entries.literal: "Do you have the attic key?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What? Of course I don't. Just go to the sixth floor and enter it.
entries.literal: "What? Of course I don't. Just go to the sixth floor and enter it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator arrived soon after I'd called it, revealing that it had still been on a higher floor. When I opened the door, the other three each took a step forward to get in.
entries.literal: "The elevator arrived soon after I'd called it, revealing that it had still been on a higher floor. When I opened the door, the other three each took a step forward to get in."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, you are out of your mind if you think you're getting in the same elevator as me. Back off.
entries.literal: "Sai, you are out of your mind if you think you're getting in the same elevator as me. Back off."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Going to make me walk all the way up? Awfully rude of you.
entries.literal: "Going to make me walk all the way up? Awfully rude of you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My glare extended to Akaro, who I also refused to be close to. I knew he could overpower me if he wanted to, but he'd reiterated the claim that Shiroya would die, so I'd fight him even if it was pointless. He shrugged and moved aside.
entries.literal: "My glare extended to Akaro, who I also refused to be close to. I knew he could overpower me if he wanted to, but he'd reiterated the claim that Shiroya would die, so I'd fight him even if it was pointless. He shrugged and moved aside."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...We'll see you there, then. Hopefully, we find her easily.
entries.literal: "...We'll see you there, then. Hopefully, we find her easily."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's fine. We'll make sure she doesn't come back down the stairs. But if we can't find her, you're not going to get away with keeping quiet.
entries.literal: "It's fine. We'll make sure she doesn't come back down the stairs. But if we can't find her, you're not going to get away with keeping quiet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't look at Erina, as I had nothing against her. She entered beside me, looking just as lost as usual.
entries.literal: "I didn't look at Erina, as I had nothing against her. She entered beside me, looking just as lost as usual."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When the door closed, I pressed the floor 6 button and waited for the elevator to begin moving.
entries.literal: "When the door closed, I pressed the floor 6 button and waited for the elevator to begin moving."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd arrive faster than the other two, but I wasn't sure if we were going to find anything. Sai had mentioned that the attic's door would be open, so he might've been the one to leave it like that, assuming I could actually trust anything he said.
entries.literal: "We'd arrive faster than the other two, but I wasn't sure if we were going to find anything. Sai had mentioned that the attic's door would be open, so he might've been the one to leave it like that, assuming I could actually trust anything he said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina was at my side next to the buttons, while I was leaning back against the opposite side. Her existence likely had more mystery behind it than I knew, but it was no time to worry about it. For some reason, she had reined in her hostility toward me.
entries.literal: "Erina was at my side next to the buttons, while I was leaning back against the opposite side. Her existence likely had more mystery behind it than I knew, but it was no time to worry about it. For some reason, she had reined in her hostility toward me."

entries.text: Even Landscape
entries.literal: "Even Landscape"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Ah!{nw}
entries.literal: "Ah!{nw}"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: W—{nw}

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator stopped abruptly.
entries.literal: "The elevator stopped abruptly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It couldn't have been going too fast, but as it ceased all movement, it propelled us upward, and we slammed to the floor.
entries.literal: "It couldn't have been going too fast, but as it ceased all movement, it propelled us upward, and we slammed to the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt my right hand burning. I looked at it and saw a cut.
entries.literal: "I felt my right hand burning. I looked at it and saw a cut."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What!? You're bleeding!
entries.literal: "What!? You're bleeding!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could only process the intense pain coming from the wound. While I couldn't comprehend how it had happened, I understood that I had cut my hand with the handrail when our bodies lifted, as it had been right above me.
entries.literal: "I could only process the intense pain coming from the wound. While I couldn't comprehend how it had happened, I understood that I had cut my hand with the handrail when our bodies lifted, as it had been right above me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Blood poured out and pain poured in equally. Overwhelmed, Erina tried to open the door.
entries.literal: "Blood poured out and pain poured in equally. Overwhelmed, Erina tried to open the door."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What? We stopped on the third floor.
entries.literal: "What? We stopped on the third floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd experienced that situation once already. Had we been intercepted again? The vast amount of blood leaving my body prevented me from thinking about it, and instead, I started to feel disoriented.
entries.literal: "I'd experienced that situation once already. Had we been intercepted again? The vast amount of blood leaving my body prevented me from thinking about it, and instead, I started to feel disoriented."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Nobody's here! I... didn't press the button either!{w} We need to... stop the bleeding. We could use something from the attic!
entries.literal: "Nobody's here! I... didn't press the button either!{w} We need to... stop the bleeding. We could use something from the attic!"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No way... It hurts so much... Fuck!
entries.literal: "No way... It hurts so much... Fuck!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't too deep of a wound, but the bleeding would take a while to stop. I wouldn't pass out from it, so all I could think about was the intense pain.
entries.literal: "It wasn't too deep of a wound, but the bleeding would take a while to stop. I wouldn't pass out from it, so all I could think about was the intense pain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the one thought that came to me was what I needed. I had to get rid of the wound. It hurt way too much to spend the entire remaining time without medical assistance, and I needed to have a clear mind.
entries.literal: "However, the one thought that came to me was what I needed. I had to get rid of the wound. It hurt way too much to spend the entire remaining time without medical assistance, and I needed to have a clear mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could accomplish that. I only had to travel back in time.
entries.literal: "I could accomplish that. I only had to travel back in time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps the pain blinded me, but without a second thought, I yanked the door inward and pressed the button to go back to the first floor.
entries.literal: "Perhaps the pain blinded me, but without a second thought, I yanked the door inward and pressed the button to go back to the first floor."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What are you—
entries.literal: "What are you—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her voice cut off, and I began to descend. It was fine; I'd only take a detour. After I got rid of the ridiculous pain that wouldn't let me think properly for a long time to come, I'd go up to find Shiroya. I could even go earlier.
entries.literal: "Her voice cut off, and I began to descend. It was fine; I'd only take a detour. After I got rid of the ridiculous pain that wouldn't let me think properly for a long time to come, I'd go up to find Shiroya. I could even go earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The single requirement was the Sekimeiya. I had to activate it and replicate an earlier position of myself without the wound, retrieving all of my lost blood in the process. I had to do it quickly so that there wouldn't be many possible locations to replicate after the wound.
entries.literal: "The single requirement was the Sekimeiya. I had to activate it and replicate an earlier position of myself without the wound, retrieving all of my lost blood in the process. I had to do it quickly so that there wouldn't be many possible locations to replicate after the wound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The doors opened, so I dashed out of the elevator as fast as I could, forcing my {tip=eyes}eyes shut{/tip} to suppress the pain.
entries.literal: "The doors opened, so I dashed out of the elevator as fast as I could, forcing my {tip=eyes}eyes shut{/tip} to suppress the pain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran to the event room, a fair amount of blood dripping off my hand. I knew I'd have to wait a few minutes to activate it, but that was necessary. However, since I clearly didn't know much about how the replicated location operated, I could only hope it would actually work.
entries.literal: "I ran to the event room, a fair amount of blood dripping off my hand. I knew I'd have to wait a few minutes to activate it, but that was necessary. However, since I clearly didn't know much about how the replicated location operated, I could only hope it would actually work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt the room was a bit colder than before... I uncovered the curtain.
entries.literal: "I felt the room was a bit colder than before... I uncovered the curtain."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Why?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't there. Behind the glass, there was only a crimson cushion, and the glass {tip=cold2}wasn't fully shut{/tip}, which cooled my face while I stared in denial.
entries.literal: "It wasn't there. Behind the glass, there was only a crimson cushion, and the glass {tip=cold2}wasn't fully shut{/tip}, which cooled my face while I stared in denial."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Fuck! Do I have to search for it? Sai, Akaro, even Shiroya... they all could've taken it!
entries.literal: "...Fuck! Do I have to search for it? Sai, Akaro, even Shiroya... they all could've taken it!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was all right... I tried to tell myself. I would've had to wait a few minutes before activating the Sekimeiya anyway. Since someone had removed it from the cabinet for me, I'd just have to spend that time searching for it, as it was already storing energy.
entries.literal: "It was all right... I tried to tell myself. I would've had to wait a few minutes before activating the Sekimeiya anyway. Since someone had removed it from the cabinet for me, I'd just have to spend that time searching for it, as it was already storing energy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But desperately searching by myself sounded overwhelming. I wouldn't stop losing blood any time soon, making me more and more tired. The pain wasn't going to suddenly fade, and there was no way I would be able to tolerate it until {time=21} on top of everything else.
entries.literal: "But desperately searching by myself sounded overwhelming. I wouldn't stop losing blood any time soon, making me more and more tired. The pain wasn't going to suddenly fade, and there was no way I would be able to tolerate it until {time=21} on top of everything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed the glass and nervously stepped into hallway B, where I still found no trace of anyone. Slowly, I'd begun to perceive two things.
entries.literal: "I closed the glass and nervously stepped into hallway B, where I still found no trace of anyone. Slowly, I'd begun to perceive two things."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The strange smell felt {tip=smell2}very strong and prominent{/tip}. I wasn't sure that meant anything—I still didn't know where it was coming from or what it signified. However, it felt more noticeable than it had on previous occasions.
entries.literal: "The strange smell felt {tip=smell2}very strong and prominent{/tip}. I wasn't sure that meant anything—I still didn't know where it was coming from or what it signified. However, it felt more noticeable than it had on previous occasions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The second thing was a thought.{w} I knew I looked just like Erina had previously, so I found myself suddenly coming back to something she'd recently said.
entries.literal: "The second thing was a thought.{w} I knew I looked just like Erina had previously, so I found myself suddenly coming back to something she'd recently said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "That's nonsense! I'm going to the past, so I'll prevent Isla from dying." She had completely refused Sai's claim that the past couldn't be changed.
entries.literal: "\"That's nonsense! I'm going to the past, so I'll prevent Isla from dying.\" She had completely refused Sai's claim that the past couldn't be changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind might've been clouded, but I started to doubt my past conclusions, feeling that Erina's words could hold some weight. I wanted to go to the past, so what if I changed it?
entries.literal: "My mind might've been clouded, but I started to doubt my past conclusions, feeling that Erina's words could hold some weight. I wanted to go to the past, so what if I changed it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would the universe really not allow it? I had been working under that assumption, but that concept had begun to feel nonsensical to me. If I actively wanted to change the past, there was no way I couldn't do it, and I didn't particularly mind trying it.
entries.literal: "Would the universe really not allow it? I had been working under that assumption, but that concept had begun to feel nonsensical to me. If I actively wanted to change the past, there was no way I couldn't do it, and I didn't particularly mind trying it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the cleaning room and scanned it with my eyes. ...How would the universe stop me from changing what had been decided? I wanted to find out.
entries.literal: "I entered the cleaning room and scanned it with my eyes. ...How would the universe stop me from changing what had been decided? I wanted to find out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Many things around me pointed at the fact that Shiroya would die at one point, and even though she was alive, she had purposely left me in the dark. If I could deviate from that reality, I would. Fortunately, finding out if it was possible appeared to be fairly easy.
entries.literal: "Many things around me pointed at the fact that Shiroya would die at one point, and even though she was alive, she had purposely left me in the dark. If I could deviate from that reality, I would. Fortunately, finding out if it was possible appeared to be fairly easy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the crystal room B6, but the sheer number of cabinets was dizzying. I didn't have the strength to inspect all of them, so I backed off toward the staff room.
entries.literal: "I looked at the crystal room B6, but the sheer number of cabinets was dizzying. I didn't have the strength to inspect all of them, so I backed off toward the staff room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When my mentality hadn't been to alter the past, everything had automatically played out as I'd once lived it. I wanted to see what would happen if I consciously attempted to alter the past through my actions.
entries.literal: "When my mentality hadn't been to alter the past, everything had automatically played out as I'd once lived it. I wanted to see what would happen if I consciously attempted to alter the past through my actions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd already tried it once, but how could Sai's and Akaro's words make any sense? Weren't their realities completely different from mine? Had they traveled in time and altered the events they remembered? Was that why the effect had only worked on them while the reality I knew was completely different from theirs?
entries.literal: "I'd already tried it once, but how could Sai's and Akaro's words make any sense? Weren't their realities completely different from mine? Had they traveled in time and altered the events they remembered? Was that why the effect had only worked on them while the reality I knew was completely different from theirs?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't tell if I was deluding myself or somehow not making sense, but I felt like I must've been able to change the past and that it had happened to other people while we'd coexisted in a single timeline. If nothing of consequence could come out of time travel, what was the point of it anyway?
entries.literal: "I couldn't tell if I was deluding myself or somehow not making sense, but I felt like I must've been able to change the past and that it had happened to other people while we'd coexisted in a single timeline. If nothing of consequence could come out of time travel, what was the point of it anyway?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps it would complicate it all even further, throwing everything into even more disarray. But why would I care about that? I'd be able to change things anyway if that were the case. Not attempting it was stupid.
entries.literal: "Perhaps it would complicate it all even further, throwing everything into even more disarray. But why would I care about that? I'd be able to change things anyway if that were the case. Not attempting it was stupid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could only open two lockers, so the task was far more bearable than checking inside every cabinet. I was already staggering, so I had very little hope of finding the Sekimeiya before I couldn't continue.
entries.literal: "I could only open two lockers, so the task was far more bearable than checking inside every cabinet. I was already staggering, so I had very little hope of finding the Sekimeiya before I couldn't continue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened Naomi's locker, but the Sekimeiya wasn't inside.
entries.literal: "I opened Naomi's locker, but the Sekimeiya wasn't inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other one was locked, so I took out the key and unlocked it.
entries.literal: "The other one was locked, so I took out the key and unlocked it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the top compartment was the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "In the top compartment was the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't care how strange that was. Had it teleported back? How could I know? I only wanted to use it so that I could think straight once again. As I was holding the key with my left hand, I extended my right one, mixing the pain of the wound with a burn that made my sight warp.
entries.literal: "I didn't care how strange that was. Had it teleported back? How could I know? I only wanted to use it so that I could think straight once again. As I was holding the key with my left hand, I extended my right one, mixing the pain of the wound with a burn that made my sight warp."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was at the start of hallway B, looking toward C.
entries.literal: "I was at the start of hallway B, looking toward C."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at my hand.
entries.literal: "I stared at my hand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The wound was still there, but next to no blood was pouring out of it, and it didn't hurt as much. I saw the scar that it had left, which would likely persist for many days. Furthermore, {tip=tired}I felt very tired{/tip}, but my mind was clearer.
entries.literal: "The wound was still there, but next to no blood was pouring out of it, and it didn't hurt as much. I saw the scar that it had left, which would likely persist for many days. Furthermore, {tip=tired}I felt very tired{/tip}, but my mind was clearer."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: How's this possible? Why do I still have the wound...?
entries.literal: "How's this possible? Why do I still have the wound...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What time even is it?
entries.literal: "What time even is it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I began to walk toward the event room to check the time, but voices stopped me.
entries.literal: "I began to walk toward the event room to check the time, but voices stopped me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got close to the door and focused my hearing.
entries.literal: "I got close to the door and focused my hearing."

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: ...just suddenly ran aw— ...honestly wasn't sure.
entries.literal: "...just suddenly ran aw— ...honestly wasn't sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recognized the conversation. I'd arrived approximately a couple minutes before the point only Sai had traveled.
entries.literal: "I recognized the conversation. I'd arrived approximately a couple minutes before the point only Sai had traveled."

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: ...to interpret thi— ...Did you all—
entries.literal: "...to interpret thi— ...Did you all—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I retreated and went to hallway A through the lobby.
entries.literal: "I retreated and went to hallway A through the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The computer screens were still lit, so I walked up to them to check the exact time, trying to avoid the blood on the floor.
entries.literal: "The computer screens were still lit, so I walked up to them to check the exact time, trying to avoid the blood on the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {time=18:54}, precisely what I'd estimated. For a short time, at least, I could try to experiment and gain some form of knowledge, no matter how small. Feeling like I could trust my judgment a bit better than before, I stepped out and went over what I'd been thinking.
entries.literal: "{time=18:54}, precisely what I'd estimated. For a short time, at least, I could try to experiment and gain some form of knowledge, no matter how small. Feeling like I could trust my judgment a bit better than before, I stepped out and went over what I'd been thinking."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What if I open the door to the event room? It's completely in reach, and if I do it, I'll be changing the past...
entries.literal: "What if I open the door to the event room? It's completely in reach, and if I do it, I'll be changing the past..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was intrigued. I had to accept that nothing made sense to me. Given what I'd deduced, I shouldn't have kept the wound; I knew I was operating under numerous misconceptions. If I tried to change the past, the result had untold potential to point me in a more accurate direction.
entries.literal: "I was intrigued. I had to accept that nothing made sense to me. Given what I'd deduced, I shouldn't have kept the wound; I knew I was operating under numerous misconceptions. If I tried to change the past, the result had untold potential to point me in a more accurate direction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it was scary. Did paradoxes exist? Would the world crumble if I changed what I'd already experienced?
entries.literal: "But it was scary. Did paradoxes exist? Would the world crumble if I changed what I'd already experienced?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Maybe the universe was pressuring me into accepting what had been decided, but I didn't feel like the pressure was strong enough. I could make any change, and the only thing in my way was myself.
entries.literal: "Maybe the universe was pressuring me into accepting what had been decided, but I didn't feel like the pressure was strong enough. I could make any change, and the only thing in my way was myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I didn't want to go too many steps up. Perhaps I could change the past if I really wanted to, but what if I altered my own past actions? I would never end up traveling, so thinking that my existence could be immediately overwritten wasn't an unfounded fear.
entries.literal: "However, I didn't want to go too many steps up. Perhaps I could change the past if I really wanted to, but what if I altered my own past actions? I would never end up traveling, so thinking that my existence could be immediately overwritten wasn't an unfounded fear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How could I attempt to change the past while making sure that I could still end up traveling in the same way?
entries.literal: "How could I attempt to change the past while making sure that I could still end up traveling in the same way?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In a few minutes, Sai will appear in hallway B from the lobby while Akaro will suddenly show up from hallway A through the event room. Preventing their arrivals could still be too big of a change that might deny my travel from occurring.
entries.literal: "In a few minutes, Sai will appear in hallway B from the lobby while Akaro will suddenly show up from hallway A through the event room. Preventing their arrivals could still be too big of a change that might deny my travel from occurring."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But the more I thought about it, the more I realized that I had nothing else to alter that I could be sure I had definitely changed.
entries.literal: "But the more I thought about it, the more I realized that I had nothing else to alter that I could be sure I had definitely changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was extremely reckless, but I wanted to try it nonetheless. I wanted to understand what had happened to Shiroya and the rest of us. And although it sounded dangerous in theory, I felt no risk in play. The thought of one of my harmless actions freezing or eradicating the universe simply didn't seem right.
entries.literal: "It was extremely reckless, but I wanted to try it nonetheless. I wanted to understand what had happened to Shiroya and the rest of us. And although it sounded dangerous in theory, I felt no risk in play. The thought of one of my harmless actions freezing or eradicating the universe simply didn't seem right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So, I had an idea: a sound.{w} To start off, I could produce a loud sound I knew I hadn't heard. If I managed to make it happen, the past could be changed.
entries.literal: "So, I had an idea: a sound.{w} To start off, I could produce a loud sound I knew I hadn't heard. If I managed to make it happen, the past could be changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to the storeroom so that I'd be able to flee. I still didn't want my past self to see me, as the chances of a paradox occurring would certainly increase if it happened, and the single thing I wanted to know was whether reality could be reshaped.
entries.literal: "I walked up to the storeroom so that I'd be able to flee. I still didn't want my past self to see me, as the chances of a paradox occurring would certainly increase if it happened, and the single thing I wanted to know was whether reality could be reshaped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I twisted the knob on the door and pushed it open. It was fully in my reach: I could slam the door and generate a considerably loud sound that hadn't previously existed.{w} Was the universe about to black out? I'd shortly find out, as I really intended to do it.
entries.literal: "I twisted the knob on the door and pushed it open. It was fully in my reach: I could slam the door and generate a considerably loud sound that hadn't previously existed.{w} Was the universe about to black out? I'd shortly find out, as I really intended to do it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was using my left hand since the right one still hurt. Perhaps the impact wouldn't be as strong, but there was no way it wouldn't be heard throughout the entire floor.
entries.literal: "I was using my left hand since the right one still hurt. Perhaps the impact wouldn't be as strong, but there was no way it wouldn't be heard throughout the entire floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remembered Sai's words in the event room: "the past can't be changed". He'd gotten to the same conclusion I had earlier, but had he tried it himself? There was no way to be certain without attempting it.
entries.literal: "I remembered Sai's words in the event room: \"the past can't be changed\". He'd gotten to the same conclusion I had earlier, but had he tried it himself? There was no way to be certain without attempting it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Am I making too big of a deal about this? I'm just going to make a sound...
entries.literal: "Am I making too big of a deal about this? I'm just going to make a sound..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was hesitating. Was it the universe's prediction... that no sound would be heard?
entries.literal: "I was hesitating. Was it the universe's prediction... that no sound would be heard?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Feeling controlled, I moved my arm without thinking.
entries.literal: "Feeling controlled, I moved my arm without thinking."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There... That's it! This is a new noise! One that we didn't hear.
entries.literal: "There... That's it! This is a new noise! One that we didn't hear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to run away. The world hadn't frozen, and I was still alive. However, all that meant was that my existence was not a paradox. Letting my past self see me had an inherent problem: he'd know he'd end up traveling and doing what he'd seen, canceling out the freedom of my own actions.
entries.literal: "I had to run away. The world hadn't frozen, and I was still alive. However, all that meant was that my existence was not a paradox. Letting my past self see me had an inherent problem: he'd know he'd end up traveling and doing what he'd seen, canceling out the freedom of my own actions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...However, that wasn't necessarily the case anymore, as the past version that could see me wouldn't be the same me anymore. He would be one who heard a sound I'd never experienced, so he might not have ended up traveling like I had.
entries.literal: "...However, that wasn't necessarily the case anymore, as the past version that could see me wouldn't be the same me anymore. He would be one who heard a sound I'd never experienced, so he might not have ended up traveling like I had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran toward the stairs and quickly disappeared from view. I hadn't edited my memories at all. I still remembered the reality in which no sound had played.{w} It was a potentially massive problem; I could've created a reality in which two versions of myself existed permanently. If I'd separated myself from my past version who was on the crystal floor, he wouldn't ever travel and leave his place for me to occupy like what had been happening so far.
entries.literal: "I ran toward the stairs and quickly disappeared from view. I hadn't edited my memories at all. I still remembered the reality in which no sound had played.{w} It was a potentially massive problem; I could've created a reality in which two versions of myself existed permanently. If I'd separated myself from my past version who was on the crystal floor, he wouldn't ever travel and leave his place for me to occupy like what had been happening so far."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To understand every consequence, I'd have to wait. However, I'd already learned the most important piece of information: the past could be changed if I wanted it to. On the other hand, nothing would differ unless I intended it to.
entries.literal: "To understand every consequence, I'd have to wait. However, I'd already learned the most important piece of information: the past could be changed if I wanted it to. On the other hand, nothing would differ unless I intended it to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a piercing pain and looked at my hand. Running with clenched fists had slightly reopened the wound, and a small amount of blood was dribbling out. If I'd left some behind, it would create a trail to find my whereabouts.{w} I looked at the staircase and saw very little blood.
entries.literal: "I felt a piercing pain and looked at my hand. Running with clenched fists had slightly reopened the wound, and a small amount of blood was dribbling out. If I'd left some behind, it would create a trail to find my whereabouts.{w} I looked at the staircase and saw very little blood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The stronger pain was coming back, so I had to cover the wound. I couldn't go back down and use a curtain, and I didn't necessarily want to dirty the clothes in the attic. Instead, I entered the bathroom at my side, figuring a few strips of toilet paper would be enough.
entries.literal: "The stronger pain was coming back, so I had to cover the wound. I couldn't go back down and use a curtain, and I didn't necessarily want to dirty the clothes in the attic. Instead, I entered the bathroom at my side, figuring a few strips of toilet paper would be enough."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Toilet paper was far from appropriate or hygienic to cover wounds, but I had to use what I had at my disposal. I kept adding layers until no more blood could be seen. It took a while, but I managed to make it work.
entries.literal: "Toilet paper was far from appropriate or hygienic to cover wounds, but I had to use what I had at my disposal. I kept adding layers until no more blood could be seen. It took a while, but I managed to make it work."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I should probably stay here. I don't know if the sound I made was enough to cause a search on the crystal floor, but if it was, they'll find me no matter where I go. ...Hopefully, it didn't trigger one.
entries.literal: "I should probably stay here. I don't know if the sound I made was enough to cause a search on the crystal floor, but if it was, they'll find me no matter where I go. ...Hopefully, it didn't trigger one."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, it's possible Shiroya will still suddenly go up, so if I pay attention, I'll hear her whether she uses the elevator or goes on foot.
entries.literal: "However, it's possible Shiroya will still suddenly go up, so if I pay attention, I'll hear her whether she uses the elevator or goes on foot."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'm not sure I want to stop her, but I want to know what she went to do...
entries.literal: "I'm not sure I want to stop her, but I want to know what she went to do..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited after sitting down and slightly opening the door. It wasn't open enough to see outside, but I hoped I would hear footsteps through the gap.
entries.literal: "I waited after sitting down and slightly opening the door. It wasn't open enough to see outside, but I hoped I would hear footsteps through the gap."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put my hand in my pocket. I wanted to get rid of the note through the toilet.
entries.literal: "I put my hand in my pocket. I wanted to get rid of the note through the toilet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Strangely, I couldn't find it. It wasn't there, but I hadn't gotten rid of it.
entries.literal: "Strangely, I couldn't find it. It wasn't there, but I hadn't gotten rid of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I checked all my pockets, but the note was gone.
entries.literal: "I checked all my pockets, but the note was gone."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I didn't drop it anywhere, did I? That must mean I didn't appear with it when I traveled.
entries.literal: "I didn't drop it anywhere, did I? That must mean I didn't appear with it when I traveled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why, though? It was so strange. At least it had dematerialized for good, I supposed.
entries.literal: "Why, though? It was so strange. At least it had dematerialized for good, I supposed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Going off what I'd lived, Shiroya would be going upstairs in two to three minutes, but I had no guarantee that would repeat.
entries.literal: "...Going off what I'd lived, Shiroya would be going upstairs in two to three minutes, but I had no guarantee that would repeat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It did not. Five minutes later, the elevator hadn't been used, and nobody had gone up or down the stairs. That was proof of my change.
entries.literal: "...It did not. Five minutes later, the elevator hadn't been used, and nobody had gone up or down the stairs. That was proof of my change."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could change the past. I didn't blame myself for wrongly assuming the opposite for so long, but I'd proved that if I wanted to and was conscious of what I was doing, I could decide to alter history. To finally know with certainty was both terrifying and exhilarating.
entries.literal: "I could change the past. I didn't blame myself for wrongly assuming the opposite for so long, but I'd proved that if I wanted to and was conscious of what I was doing, I could decide to alter history. To finally know with certainty was both terrifying and exhilarating."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Less than two hours remained until {time=21.} The alarm had gone off at about {time=9:05}, and the automatic unlock was rapidly approaching. Was it enough time to try putting things into practice?{w} I still didn't know what consequences would truly come out of my change. Would I permanently have differing memories from the people around me? Would I have to coexist with another Atsuki?
entries.literal: "Less than two hours remained until {time=21.} The alarm had gone off at about {time=9:05}, and the automatic unlock was rapidly approaching. Was it enough time to try putting things into practice?{w} I still didn't know what consequences would truly come out of my change. Would I permanently have differing memories from the people around me? Would I have to coexist with another Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I found out, making use of time travel would become simple. Suddenly, I was presented with a dilemma.
entries.literal: "As soon as I found out, making use of time travel would become simple. Suddenly, I was presented with a dilemma."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Two hours remain until the front door presumably opens. In about thirty minutes is when I traveled to the past, but that might not happen anymore. This means that I could have the chance to let the Sekimeiya gather power until {time=21:05.}
entries.literal: "Two hours remain until the front door presumably opens. In about thirty minutes is when I traveled to the past, but that might not happen anymore. This means that I could have the chance to let the Sekimeiya gather power until {time=21:05.}"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'm not sure how far back I'd go. Leaving the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet for fifteen minutes resulted in twenty minutes traveled. Just now, I went back a little over forty, but I don't know how long the Sekimeiya was in the locker; it shouldn't have been there to begin with.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure how far back I'd go. Leaving the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet for fifteen minutes resulted in twenty minutes traveled. Just now, I went back a little over forty, but I don't know how long the Sekimeiya was in the locker; it shouldn't have been there to begin with."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Meaning that I have no clue how much the distance traveled advances each minute out of the cabinet. If it goes at a consistent rate, two hours wouldn't make me travel incredibly far back. As it stands, I wouldn't appear two weeks ago.
entries.literal: "Meaning that I have no clue how much the distance traveled advances each minute out of the cabinet. If it goes at a consistent rate, two hours wouldn't make me travel incredibly far back. As it stands, I wouldn't appear two weeks ago."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But what if I did somehow? What if I could save Miiya this way and prevent that entire thing? Would another Atsuki get to live a carefree and ignorant life, unaware of today's events while I still had to exist?
entries.literal: "But what if I did somehow? What if I could save Miiya this way and prevent that entire thing? Would another Atsuki get to live a carefree and ignorant life, unaware of today's events while I still had to exist?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to understand how it worked before thinking of applications. If I did something like that, I'd leave behind everything. That included the note I'd found, Shiroya's strange behavior, and everything I'd been attempting to reason out. Of course, the result would more than justify it.
entries.literal: "I had to understand how it worked before thinking of applications. If I did something like that, I'd leave behind everything. That included the note I'd found, Shiroya's strange behavior, and everything I'd been attempting to reason out. Of course, the result would more than justify it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went back to a distant thought. Could it be that the shutter wasn't going to move at {time=21} so that the Sekimeiya would store enough time to grant a lengthy travel?
entries.literal: "I went back to a distant thought. Could it be that the shutter wasn't going to move at {time=21} so that the Sekimeiya would store enough time to grant a lengthy travel?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How would that be accomplished? I was thinking about making the recording a reality just because I'd heard it, but I wouldn't complain about the origin of events if I could achieve it. However, I still understood too little about the Sekimeiya to consider anything like that. Could I know that waiting a month would be enough just because that was the time I'd heard in the recording?
entries.literal: "How would that be accomplished? I was thinking about making the recording a reality just because I'd heard it, but I wouldn't complain about the origin of events if I could achieve it. However, I still understood too little about the Sekimeiya to consider anything like that. Could I know that waiting a month would be enough just because that was the time I'd heard in the recording?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I let go of that idea. To begin with, I had no way of prolonging our stay, and as I'd previously considered, we couldn't survive for that long without food. Despite my important discovery, the recording still made no sense.
entries.literal: "I let go of that idea. To begin with, I had no way of prolonging our stay, and as I'd previously considered, we couldn't survive for that long without food. Despite my important discovery, the recording still made no sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In reality, not many things did. I could run through the day's events and find continuous unexplained mysteries. Had someone been changing reality around us, resulting in inconsistent memories and different pasts? That felt too unknowable to consider, and there was virtually no way to know if it had happened.
entries.literal: "In reality, not many things did. I could run through the day's events and find continuous unexplained mysteries. Had someone been changing reality around us, resulting in inconsistent memories and different pasts? That felt too unknowable to consider, and there was virtually no way to know if it had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The replicated location, the self-teleportation of the Sekimeiya... There were many unknown factors needed to construct a sound plan that involved changing the past.
entries.literal: "The replicated location, the self-teleportation of the Sekimeiya... There were many unknown factors needed to construct a sound plan that involved changing the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I kept waiting, as I wanted to surpass the point I'd traveled from.
entries.literal: "...I kept waiting, as I wanted to surpass the point I'd traveled from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Minutes later, I thought that going up was probably a good idea. Someone had to have intercepted our elevator trip on the third floor, and it was very possible my change downstairs hadn't influenced their actions at all. If I went up, maybe I would see them.
entries.literal: "Minutes later, I thought that going up was probably a good idea. Someone had to have intercepted our elevator trip on the third floor, and it was very possible my change downstairs hadn't influenced their actions at all. If I went up, maybe I would see them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Blood had stopped coming out of my wound, so I removed the toilet paper and flushed it. The sensation was uncomfortable, but it no longer hurt much. I still wasn't sure how I'd managed to injure myself like that, but if I didn't make abrupt motions with my arm, I could tolerate it easily.
entries.literal: "Blood had stopped coming out of my wound, so I removed the toilet paper and flushed it. The sensation was uncomfortable, but it no longer hurt much. I still wasn't sure how I'd managed to injure myself like that, but if I didn't make abrupt motions with my arm, I could tolerate it easily."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to the third floor. There was nobody in sight, so it was best to hide.
entries.literal: "I walked up to the third floor. There was nobody in sight, so it was best to hide."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was possible they would flee if they saw me—I needed to approach them when I knew they were close to the elevator.
entries.literal: "It was possible they would flee if they saw me—I needed to approach them when I knew they were close to the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the second partition, as I estimated a few minutes were left until the time we'd been intercepted.
entries.literal: "I entered the second partition, as I estimated a few minutes were left until the time we'd been intercepted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been in the lower bathroom for about twenty minutes, so I'd have to wait a little more. Unfortunately, since it was highly unlikely Erina and I would still take the elevator at the same time, I wouldn't have a way to know if I'd missed my target.
entries.literal: "I'd been in the lower bathroom for about twenty minutes, so I'd have to wait a little more. Unfortunately, since it was highly unlikely Erina and I would still take the elevator at the same time, I wouldn't have a way to know if I'd missed my target."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, the silence gave no indication of the ticking seconds. I waited for minutes moving back and forth between the second and third partitions, waiting for my cue to get out.
entries.literal: "Once again, the silence gave no indication of the ticking seconds. I waited for minutes moving back and forth between the second and third partitions, waiting for my cue to get out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't coming. Would I hear their movements if someone was nearby? I felt I was really close to the time we'd been stopped on that floor.
entries.literal: "It wasn't coming. Would I hear their movements if someone was nearby? I felt I was really close to the time we'd been stopped on that floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the offices. The corridor leading to the elevator was empty.
entries.literal: "I left the offices. The corridor leading to the elevator was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept staring at it, but I felt no trace of life.
entries.literal: "I kept staring at it, but I felt no trace of life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had the impact of my action on the crystal floor been large enough to remove the existence of whoever had initially intercepted us? I turned around and peeked at the opposite hallway, where the stairs led to floor 2.
entries.literal: "Had the impact of my action on the crystal floor been large enough to remove the existence of whoever had initially intercepted us? I turned around and peeked at the opposite hallway, where the stairs led to floor 2."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt no difference. If nobody was around, would I have to present myself downstairs and explain what I'd done?
entries.literal: "I felt no difference. If nobody was around, would I have to present myself downstairs and explain what I'd done?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator? I ran back and saw something I thought I couldn't see.
entries.literal: "The elevator? I ran back and saw something I thought I couldn't see."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That's me...{w} and Erina, as well. I remember those movements.
entries.literal: "That's me...{w} and Erina, as well. I remember those movements."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From a distance, I heard my own yells and saw blood pouring out of my hand...
entries.literal: "From a distance, I heard my own yells and saw blood pouring out of my hand..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was repeating. Despite what I'd done, the scene played out just like I remembered it.
entries.literal: "It was repeating. Despite what I'd done, the scene played out just like I remembered it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I backed off, knowing Erina would turn around and see an empty corridor. Then, abruptly, my past self closed himself in the elevator and left her outside, puzzled.
entries.literal: "I backed off, knowing Erina would turn around and see an empty corridor. Then, abruptly, my past self closed himself in the elevator and left her outside, puzzled."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...How's this possible? I know it was a small change, but how is it possible it all still led to this, occurring just like I remember it?
entries.literal: "...How's this possible? I know it was a small change, but how is it possible it all still led to this, occurring just like I remember it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped out, my footsteps alerting Erina.
entries.literal: "I stepped out, my footsteps alerting Erina."

entries.text: No Longer Anywhere
entries.literal: "No Longer Anywhere"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...? A-Atsuki!
entries.literal: "What...? A-Atsuki!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waved awkwardly and approached her.
entries.literal: "I waved awkwardly and approached her."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's not bleeding anymore... What did you do?
entries.literal: "It's not bleeding anymore... What did you do?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I used the Sekimeiya to travel to the past, and this time it worked. I wanted to get rid of the wound, but it simply stopped the bleeding, even though I'm not sure why.
entries.literal: "I used the Sekimeiya to travel to the past, and this time it worked. I wanted to get rid of the wound, but it simply stopped the bleeding, even though I'm not sure why."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wait... What? There's no way.
entries.literal: "Wait... What? There's no way."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No way what, exactly? That I traveled through time?
entries.literal: "No way what, exactly? That I traveled through time?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes! How did you do it?
entries.literal: "Yes! How did you do it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: By touching the Sekimeiya. What's wrong?
entries.literal: "By touching the Sekimeiya. What's wrong?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Nothing... I'm just... a bit confused. Ignore me. I'm happy the wound got better.
entries.literal: "Nothing... I'm just... a bit confused. Ignore me. I'm happy the wound got better."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was a bit taken aback by her words. Was she the exact same Erina I remembered?
entries.literal: "I was a bit taken aback by her words. Was she the exact same Erina I remembered?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Do you understand now why we stopped on this floor?
entries.literal: "Do you understand now why we stopped on this floor?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sorry, I don't. Are you sure you didn't hit the button accidentally?
entries.literal: "Sorry, I don't. Are you sure you didn't hit the button accidentally?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes...{w} Should we keep going up?
entries.literal: "Yes...{w} Should we keep going up?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hang on... What do you remember?
entries.literal: "Hang on... What do you remember?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Earlier, did we hear a loud door being slammed in hallway A?
entries.literal: "Earlier, did we hear a loud door being slammed in hallway A?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...{w}When, exactly?
entries.literal: "...{w}When, exactly?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: About 35 minutes ago.
entries.literal: "About 35 minutes ago."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Uh...{w} I... don't know. My head is still a bit foggy, but I don't remember that.
entries.literal: "Uh...{w} I... don't know. My head is still a bit foggy, but I don't remember that."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Why are you asking, though? Did we hear it?
entries.literal: "Why are you asking, though? Did we hear it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I'm not sure. We must have.
entries.literal: "...I'm not sure. We must have."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was bizarre. Why had we used the elevator to follow Shiroya when she never went up?
entries.literal: "It was bizarre. Why had we used the elevator to follow Shiroya when she never went up?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Did Erina not remember the sound because she hadn't heard it or because of her mental state?
entries.literal: "Did Erina not remember the sound because she hadn't heard it or because of her mental state?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had realities... converged?
entries.literal: "Had realities... converged?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's wait a second. Sai and Akaro should be coming, right?
entries.literal: "Let's wait a second. Sai and Akaro should be coming, right?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's what they said.
entries.literal: "That's what they said."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I want to talk to them.
entries.literal: "I want to talk to them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She looked uncertain, but she didn't complain. I began to walk in circles, wondering what to make of the baffling result.
entries.literal: "She looked uncertain, but she didn't complain. I began to walk in circles, wondering what to make of the baffling result."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A minute later, nobody had come. It was absolutely enough time for Sai and Akaro to arrive at the third floor...
