entries.literal: "A minute later, nobody had come. It was absolutely enough time for Sai and Akaro to arrive at the third floor..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait here. I'll be back in a second.
entries.literal: "Wait here. I'll be back in a second."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Explaining myself would've been a waste of time, especially considering the condition she was in.
entries.literal: "Explaining myself would've been a waste of time, especially considering the condition she was in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I circled down the floors until I arrived at the last staircase, not seeing anyone along the way.
entries.literal: "I circled down the floors until I arrived at the last staircase, not seeing anyone along the way."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...? Oh, it's you.
entries.literal: "Hm...? Oh, it's you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through the gray door, I saw Sai. He didn't receive me with clear hostility, so I went down the staircase.
entries.literal: "Through the gray door, I saw Sai. He didn't receive me with clear hostility, so I went down the staircase."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Where's Akaro?
entries.literal: "...Where's Akaro?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hell if I know. Why?
entries.literal: "Hell if I know. Why?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was that a result of my action? Akaro had come from hallway A, where I'd made the sound. Had that made him not appear?
entries.literal: "Was that a result of my action? Akaro had come from hallway A, where I'd made the sound. Had that made him not appear?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Are you alone?
entries.literal: "...Are you alone?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Erina's above us.{w} By the way, about 35 minutes ago, did you hear the sound of a door closing coming from hallway A?
entries.literal: "Erina's above us.{w} By the way, about 35 minutes ago, did you hear the sound of a door closing coming from hallway A?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What?{w} What kind of question is that?
entries.literal: "What?{w} What kind of question is that?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Just answer. Did you?
entries.literal: "Just answer. Did you?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}{tip=lie}Yes{/tip}, why?
entries.literal: "...{w}{tip=lie}Yes{/tip}, why?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something caught my attention. On the floor of hallway C, there were new drops of blood, close to drying.
entries.literal: "Something caught my attention. On the floor of hallway C, there were new drops of blood, close to drying."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you recognize these drops? Have they always been here?
entries.literal: "Do you recognize these drops? Have they always been here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, yes, I saw them before. Are they from that wound? What happened?
entries.literal: "Oh, yes, I saw them before. Are they from that wound? What happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Erina and I had taken the elevator, those drops hadn't existed. There were too many of them to think I hadn't seen them.{w} Sai was definitely living in the reality I'd changed, but I wasn't sure the same could be said for Erina.
entries.literal: "When Erina and I had taken the elevator, those drops hadn't existed. There were too many of them to think I hadn't seen them.{w} Sai was definitely living in the reality I'd changed, but I wasn't sure the same could be said for Erina."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew that was my blood and that I'd left it behind when I'd run away after slamming the door. As soon as I'd psyched myself up to alter the past, all my actions had surely been allowed to differ from what I'd experienced, including unconscious ones such as leaving blood behind.
entries.literal: "I knew that was my blood and that I'd left it behind when I'd run away after slamming the door. As soon as I'd psyched myself up to alter the past, all my actions had surely been allowed to differ from what I'd experienced, including unconscious ones such as leaving blood behind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked next to us, and as I thought, the other trail of blood was coming from the elevator. It was from the time I'd gone down after suffering the injury; the floor was proof of both realities at once.
entries.literal: "I looked next to us, and as I thought, the other trail of blood was coming from the elevator. It was from the time I'd gone down after suffering the injury; the floor was proof of both realities at once."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you just not going to answer me? Where's Shiroya, by the way? Is she in the attic?
entries.literal: "Are you just not going to answer me? Where's Shiroya, by the way? Is she in the attic?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Why would she be?
entries.literal: "...Why would she be?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's with these questions? She's not with you, so I figured she might be somewhere we can't get to.
entries.literal: "What's with these questions? She's not with you, so I figured she might be somewhere we can't get to."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, right... The attic is locked, isn't it?
entries.literal: "Oh, right... The attic is locked, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was just a bit ago.
entries.literal: "It was just a bit ago."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But you have the key. That's how you entered it when you were chasing us.
entries.literal: "But you have the key. That's how you entered it when you were chasing us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Excuse me? I don't have the key, no.{w} You can search me if you want. I don't have it.
entries.literal: "...Excuse me? I don't have the key, no.{w} You can search me if you want. I don't have it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was all too confusing. Sai had suddenly undergone yet another change in behavior, and just like the previous ones, I couldn't make sense of it. Everything had become just as incomprehensible as I'd feared. I couldn't discern what I'd changed and what I hadn't.
entries.literal: "It was all too confusing. Sai had suddenly undergone yet another change in behavior, and just like the previous ones, I couldn't make sense of it. Everything had become just as incomprehensible as I'd feared. I couldn't discern what I'd changed and what I hadn't."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Is there nobody else on the crystal floor?
entries.literal: "Is there nobody else on the crystal floor?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There shouldn't be.
entries.literal: "There shouldn't be."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Let's go up, then. Shiroya might actually be in the attic.
entries.literal: "...{w}Let's go up, then. Shiroya might actually be in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He shrugged and followed me up.
entries.literal: "He shrugged and followed me up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the way, we found Erina, who'd been waiting for my return. She didn't welcome us, and her eyes looked even more empty than before.
entries.literal: "On the way, we found Erina, who'd been waiting for my return. She didn't welcome us, and her eyes looked even more empty than before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She also didn't reply to Sai's carefree greeting, opting to silently follow us. The attic door was three floors above.
entries.literal: "She also didn't reply to Sai's carefree greeting, opting to silently follow us. The attic door was three floors above."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I told you. It's locked.{w} Do you not have the key?
entries.literal: "I told you. It's locked.{w} Do you not have the key?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No... It's possible Shiroya does.
entries.literal: "No... It's possible Shiroya does."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe she locked herself inside, then.
entries.literal: "Maybe she locked herself inside, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remembered what I'd concluded earlier. Had I never been able to follow her into the attic?
entries.literal: "I remembered what I'd concluded earlier. Had I never been able to follow her into the attic?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter what... I felt like Sai had to be lying. He had unlocked the door previously to chase us.
entries.literal: "No matter what... I felt like Sai had to be lying. He had unlocked the door previously to chase us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like we'd thought, he could've accomplished it by traveling inside and unlocking the door with our key, but since we'd still found it on the floor, it was very likely another one had been used.
entries.literal: "Like we'd thought, he could've accomplished it by traveling inside and unlocking the door with our key, but since we'd still found it on the floor, it was very likely another one had been used."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If he was telling the truth, I thought that perhaps someone else had entered the attic while Sai had waited downstairs to ambush us...
entries.literal: "If he was telling the truth, I thought that perhaps someone else had entered the attic while Sai had waited downstairs to ambush us..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey! Shiroya! Are you inside?{w} Why would you lock yourself in like this!?
entries.literal: "Hey! Shiroya! Are you inside?{w} Why would you lock yourself in like this!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was he just fucking around while he knew where the key was? Even if Shiroya was inside, why would she have chosen to stay hidden...?
entries.literal: "Was he just fucking around while he knew where the key was? Even if Shiroya was inside, why would she have chosen to stay hidden...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do what you said earlier and show me your pockets.
entries.literal: "Do what you said earlier and show me your pockets."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you not trust me? I suppose I almost killed you. Sure.
entries.literal: "Do you not trust me? I suppose I almost killed you. Sure."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm just kidding, of course. ...Anyway, you can see all my pockets are empty.
entries.literal: "I'm just kidding, of course. ...Anyway, you can see all my pockets are empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed and did what I'd done in the bedroom. I felt his clothes until I could be sure that he wasn't hiding anything.
entries.literal: "I sighed and did what I'd done in the bedroom. I felt his clothes until I could be sure that he wasn't hiding anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure she couldn't be anywhere else?
entries.literal: "Are you sure she couldn't be anywhere else?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We haven't searched the whole building, no, but she should still be here.
entries.literal: "We haven't searched the whole building, no, but she should still be here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then she must be hiding intentionally, and there's nothing we can do about that.
entries.literal: "Then she must be hiding intentionally, and there's nothing we can do about that."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Maybe she'll come out eventually... Let's go back down for now.
entries.literal: "Maybe she'll come out eventually... Let's go back down for now."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I agree. She must not like you very much and prefers to be alone.
entries.literal: "I agree. She must not like you very much and prefers to be alone."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait, no. You're definitely lying.
entries.literal: "Wait, no. You're definitely lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me? I don't ever lie.
entries.literal: "Me? I don't ever lie."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You don't have any keys on you. That proves you hid them, because you should have the cabinet key.
entries.literal: "You don't have any keys on you. That proves you hid them, because you should have the cabinet key."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The Sekimeiya cabinet's? Why would I?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya cabinet's? Why would I?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I saw it in your hand before you and Shiroya traveled!
entries.literal: "I saw it in your hand before you and Shiroya traveled!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Strangely, though, I don't have it. Check your sight too when you go check your hearing.
entries.literal: "Strangely, though, I don't have it. Check your sight too when you go check your hearing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could reply, the three of us were looking at the door. The lock clicked, the doorknob turned, and it began to open.
entries.literal: "Before I could reply, the three of us were looking at the door. The lock clicked, the doorknob turned, and it began to open."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...!{w} You're all right!
entries.literal: "...!{w} You're all right!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the other side of the door, Shiroya looked directly into my eyes as she panted in exhaustion.
entries.literal: "From the other side of the door, Shiroya looked directly into my eyes as she panted in exhaustion."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Oh, she was actually inside. I'm glad we found you.
entries.literal: "...Oh, she was actually inside. I'm glad we found you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wh-What!? He locked me in here!
entries.literal: "Wh-What!? He locked me in here!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me? That's funny. I locked you in, but the key's in the keyhole, right?
entries.literal: "Me? That's funny. I locked you in, but the key's in the keyhole, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was her. Not the Shiroya who'd mysteriously chosen to leave by herself, but the one I'd been with the entire time. She had her normal clothes very slightly stained with smoke and still looked at me, glad to see me again.
entries.literal: "It was her. Not the Shiroya who'd mysteriously chosen to leave by herself, but the one I'd been with the entire time. She had her normal clothes very slightly stained with smoke and still looked at me, glad to see me again."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Was he acting like he wanted to find me? He locked me in the bedroom!
entries.literal: "Was he acting like he wanted to find me? He locked me in the bedroom!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sorry?
entries.literal: "I'm sorry?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I've been here for almost two hours! He shut me in!
entries.literal: "I've been here for almost two hours! He shut me in!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So you chose to hole up in the attic and want to blame me for it... why, exactly?
entries.literal: "So you chose to hole up in the attic and want to blame me for it... why, exactly?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.literal: "Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She hadn't stopped panting, and her voice was hoarse.
entries.literal: "She hadn't stopped panting, and her voice was hoarse."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes... I just ran from the bedroom. I'm fine.
entries.literal: "Yes... I just ran from the bedroom. I'm fine."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's pretend I locked you in a bedroom. I'm not sure why I'd even do that, but how did you leave?
entries.literal: "Let's pretend I locked you in a bedroom. I'm not sure why I'd even do that, but how did you leave?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...With the key.
entries.literal: "...With the key."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But I thought I trapped you there?
entries.literal: "But I thought I trapped you there?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes, but not with the key! I know what you did!
entries.literal: "Yes, but not with the key! I know what you did!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I became a witch and learned magic, huh? We can go with that if you don't want to tell the truth.
entries.literal: "I became a witch and learned magic, huh? We can go with that if you don't want to tell the truth."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...W-Wait! Erina!
entries.literal: "...W-Wait! Erina!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're alive?
entries.literal: "You're alive?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Y-Yes...
entries.literal: "Y-Yes..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm sorry if this sounds strange, but are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?
entries.literal: "I'm sorry if this sounds strange, but are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm? Yes, I've been here since then.
entries.literal: "Hm? Yes, I've been here since then."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... see.
entries.literal: "I... see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still didn't understand anything, but I was happy to be reunited with who I thought of as the real Shiroya. The other version of her was the one who had disappeared again, and she had told me that she was the same person. How she would come to exist, though—that, I didn't know.
entries.literal: "I still didn't understand anything, but I was happy to be reunited with who I thought of as the real Shiroya. The other version of her was the one who had disappeared again, and she had told me that she was the same person. How she would come to exist, though—that, I didn't know."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We didn't check Erina's pulse, remember...?
entries.literal: "We didn't check Erina's pulse, remember...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: O-Oh! Thank God, and sorry...{w} What's with the blood, though?
entries.literal: "O-Oh! Thank God, and sorry...{w} What's with the blood, though?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't know. I got hit in the head, so my memories are a little fuzzy.
entries.literal: "I don't know. I got hit in the head, so my memories are a little fuzzy."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh. ...What time is it?
entries.literal: "Oh. ...What time is it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm... It's {time=19:40.}

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's so late... What happened while I was here? And your watch is working again?
entries.literal: "It's so late... What happened while I was here? And your watch is working again?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh? Yes, of course.
entries.literal: "Huh? Yes, of course."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I almost felt at peace. I'd changed reality in some way, but Shiroya had been unaffected up in the attic. She remembered all we'd done, and we'd be able to reach the end of the countdown together.
entries.literal: "I almost felt at peace. I'd changed reality in some way, but Shiroya had been unaffected up in the attic. She remembered all we'd done, and we'd be able to reach the end of the countdown together."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wait, what's with your clothes? You were wearing different ones.
entries.literal: "Wait, what's with your clothes? You were wearing different ones."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right. When we went to the past, we lost track of that Shiroya, but she still has to be around. I'm confused, though. Where did she come from?
entries.literal: "Right. When we went to the past, we lost track of that Shiroya, but she still has to be around. I'm confused, though. Where did she come from?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "When we went to the past". I see. He was the only one to travel, but he thinks we all did. He thinks we all appeared separately in the past and that we've been unable to find Shiroya since then. I'm not completely sure why that would be his assumption, though.
entries.literal: "\"When we went to the past\". I see. He was the only one to travel, but he thinks we all did. He thinks we all appeared separately in the past and that we've been unable to find Shiroya since then. I'm not completely sure why that would be his assumption, though."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: However, one thing is strange. Sai's watch reads {time=19:40}, which I'm pretty sure is the real time. That must mean he's synced it properly.
entries.literal: "However, one thing is strange. Sai's watch reads {time=19:40}, which I'm pretty sure is the real time. That must mean he's synced it properly."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Can you come with me for a second?
entries.literal: "Can you come with me for a second?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-Yeah.
entries.literal: "Y-Yeah."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Can't you just talk openly here?
entries.literal: "Can't you just talk openly here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ignored him and brought Shiroya down a floor.
entries.literal: "I ignored him and brought Shiroya down a floor."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You know Sai's lying, right? He really locked me in a bedroom and told me you died...! I was so worried.
entries.literal: "You know Sai's lying, right? He really locked me in a bedroom and told me you died...! I was so worried."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...? Don't worry, I believe you, even though I still don't understand Sai very much. I wanted to tell you about what just happened.
entries.literal: "What...? Don't worry, I believe you, even though I still don't understand Sai very much. I wanted to tell you about what just happened."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think... the past can be changed somehow.
entries.literal: "I think... the past can be changed somehow."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It can...? Did you try it?
entries.literal: "It can...? Did you try it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I did, but I'm not sure what to make of the results.
entries.literal: "I did, but I'm not sure what to make of the results."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's possible what I changed only affected some people. I definitely went back in time and altered the events I'd experienced. Sai recognizes the change, but I'm not sure Erina does.
entries.literal: "It's possible what I changed only affected some people. I definitely went back in time and altered the events I'd experienced. Sai recognizes the change, but I'm not sure Erina does."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It felt like both realities met, leading into differing memories. That could be what happened to Akaro, when his version of events contradicted ours. Maybe someone made some change that didn't affect us, or maybe it didn't affect Akaro.
entries.literal: "It felt like both realities met, leading into differing memories. That could be what happened to Akaro, when his version of events contradicted ours. Maybe someone made some change that didn't affect us, or maybe it didn't affect Akaro."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That sounds way too complicated... I'm not sure I follow, but you mean...
entries.literal: "That sounds way too complicated... I'm not sure I follow, but you mean..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If we go to the past, I'm pretty sure we could drastically change the way things played out. It's possible some people would still remember this reality, but the change should persist.{w} It's possible two realities just converged, but the real one comes from my change. It overlapped the last one despite some people potentially still remembering it.
entries.literal: "If we go to the past, I'm pretty sure we could drastically change the way things played out. It's possible some people would still remember this reality, but the change should persist.{w} It's possible two realities just converged, but the real one comes from my change. It overlapped the last one despite some people potentially still remembering it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Or was that really the case? I hesitated when I remembered the floor of hallway C. The two trails of blood, one from before the change and the other from after it, signified that we were living in a mix of both realities.
entries.literal: "Or was that really the case? I hesitated when I remembered the floor of hallway C. The two trails of blood, one from before the change and the other from after it, signified that we were living in a mix of both realities."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The things I was saying sounded complicated, but in practice, all they meant was that the past could be changed if we consciously wanted it to. Lingering memories might've been an issue for unaffected people, making them think they were in the wrong reality, but that was a minor issue given what we could accomplish.{w} Of course, I wasn't fully aware of how it worked. I didn't know why some memories could remain or what determined the people who kept them, but factually altering history was all that mattered.
entries.literal: "The things I was saying sounded complicated, but in practice, all they meant was that the past could be changed if we consciously wanted it to. Lingering memories might've been an issue for unaffected people, making them think they were in the wrong reality, but that was a minor issue given what we could accomplish.{w} Of course, I wasn't fully aware of how it worked. I didn't know why some memories could remain or what determined the people who kept them, but factually altering history was all that mattered."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's keep going.
entries.literal: "Let's keep going."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had some remaining time to try piecing together the information we needed. The Sekimeiya should've still been downstairs.
entries.literal: "We had some remaining time to try piecing together the information we needed. The Sekimeiya should've still been downstairs."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I last traveled from the staff room. Let's go there.
entries.literal: "I last traveled from the staff room. Let's go there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was where we headed. On the way, I checked my pocket and saw I still had the locker key. Fortunately, the note was no longer there, although I still couldn't understand why.
entries.literal: "That was where we headed. On the way, I checked my pocket and saw I still had the locker key. Fortunately, the note was no longer there, although I still couldn't understand why."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The note, the several mentions of Miiya, and Shiroya's death... Those occurred despite the factual reality, which is that Miiya is dead and Shiroya is alive.
entries.literal: "The note, the several mentions of Miiya, and Shiroya's death... Those occurred despite the factual reality, which is that Miiya is dead and Shiroya is alive."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What's all this blood...?
entries.literal: "What's all this blood...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's mine. As you can see, I hurt my hand in the elevator. I don't even know why it stopped bleeding.
entries.literal: "It's mine. As you can see, I hurt my hand in the elevator. I don't even know why it stopped bleeding."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Does it hurt? That's kind of a lot.
entries.literal: "Does it hurt? That's kind of a lot."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't worry, it's fine...
entries.literal: "Don't worry, it's fine..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we stepped into the room, we saw that the locker was open. That made sense, as I hadn't closed it before traveling.
entries.literal: "When we stepped into the room, we saw that the locker was open. That made sense, as I hadn't closed it before traveling."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...!{w} It's gone.
entries.literal: "...!{w} It's gone."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did you leave it in this locker? How?
entries.literal: "Did you leave it in this locker? How?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I found the key in the cleaning room. I know how that sounds, but I guess no one needed a key to get it. I touched it with the locker open.
entries.literal: "I found the key in the cleaning room. I know how that sounds, but I guess no one needed a key to get it. I touched it with the locker open."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh... Could anyone have taken it, then?
entries.literal: "Oh... Could anyone have taken it, then?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It would've been easy, but I'm not completely sure. The door doesn't look like it moved, so it also could've teleported.{w} While you were in the attic, we saw that happen. I definitely witnessed the Sekimeiya teleport to its cabinet.{w} But Sai could've easily grabbed it. Akaro as well. I saw him, and he should still be here somewhere. It was before I changed the past, but all I did was draw attention to hallway A. There's no way that was enough to overwrite Akaro's existence.
entries.literal: "It would've been easy, but I'm not completely sure. The door doesn't look like it moved, so it also could've teleported.{w} While you were in the attic, we saw that happen. I definitely witnessed the Sekimeiya teleport to its cabinet.{w} But Sai could've easily grabbed it. Akaro as well. I saw him, and he should still be here somewhere. It was before I changed the past, but all I did was draw attention to hallway A. There's no way that was enough to overwrite Akaro's existence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the event room. Earlier, I had suspected the Sekimeiya teleported inside the cabinet, but it wasn't there.
entries.literal: "I went to the event room. Earlier, I had suspected the Sekimeiya teleported inside the cabinet, but it wasn't there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd hoped we'd find it. If we wanted to change the past, it was better if we traveled together so that both of us could keep the memory of our original reality.
entries.literal: "I'd hoped we'd find it. If we wanted to change the past, it was better if we traveled together so that both of us could keep the memory of our original reality."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Like always, whether it teleported or someone hid it, it has to be nearby and in a place we can access. We can find it.
entries.literal: "Like always, whether it teleported or someone hid it, it has to be nearby and in a place we can access. We can find it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was right. It was one of our first questions: "why would someone hide the Sekimeiya if we'll find it no matter where it is?" If it had been teleporting, that question would be obsolete.
entries.literal: "She was right. It was one of our first questions: \"why would someone hide the Sekimeiya if we'll find it no matter where it is?\" If it had been teleporting, that question would be obsolete."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, with the inclusion of the storeroom's hidden door, it was always possible a successful plan had already stolen it, and there were a few unreachable places, such as the remaining lockers.
entries.literal: "However, with the inclusion of the storeroom's hidden door, it was always possible a successful plan had already stolen it, and there were a few unreachable places, such as the remaining lockers."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, yeah, the Sekimeiya's gone. I was searching for it before we went up.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah, the Sekimeiya's gone. I was searching for it before we went up."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I'm sure you were.
entries.literal: "...I'm sure you were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai entered from hallway A, alone.
entries.literal: "Sai entered from hallway A, alone."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's not much time left... Let's wait for the shutter to open.
entries.literal: "There's not much time left... Let's wait for the shutter to open."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What about the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "What about the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who knows? I couldn't find it, but why do you care?{w} Akaro might be responsible, and he could have taken it outside. If that happened, there's nothing we can do.{w} However, if it's still inside, the police will find it immediately, right? It can be hidden from us, but not from them.
entries.literal: "Who knows? I couldn't find it, but why do you care?{w} Akaro might be responsible, and he could have taken it outside. If that happened, there's nothing we can do.{w} However, if it's still inside, the police will find it immediately, right? It can be hidden from us, but not from them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hallway B door opened.
entries.literal: "The hallway B door opened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Erina, do you know where the Sekimeiya might be?
entries.literal: "Erina, do you know where the Sekimeiya might be?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...? No, I don't.
entries.literal: "What...? No, I don't."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then none of us do. If it was deliberately hidden, I don't see the point in searching for it anymore.
entries.literal: "Then none of us do. If it was deliberately hidden, I don't see the point in searching for it anymore."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You know where it is, right?
entries.literal: "You know where it is, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're free to enlighten me. If I knew where it was, what would my endgame be? Hoping the police don't find it? There's no way that would happen.{w} Someone took it when we weren't around. That must mean they have the means to conceal it from both us and the police. Otherwise, hiding it is pointless.
entries.literal: "You're free to enlighten me. If I knew where it was, what would my endgame be? Hoping the police don't find it? There's no way that would happen.{w} Someone took it when we weren't around. That must mean they have the means to conceal it from both us and the police. Otherwise, hiding it is pointless."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You say that, but it's been happening since this morning, and it was never hidden in a place the police wouldn't have inspected.
entries.literal: "You say that, but it's been happening since this morning, and it was never hidden in a place the police wouldn't have inspected."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You could have a plan, too. When the police enter, as soon as they find the Sekimeiya, they'll activate it. That'll make everyone around it disappear, leaving a free path for you to retrieve it.
entries.literal: "You could have a plan, too. When the police enter, as soon as they find the Sekimeiya, they'll activate it. That'll make everyone around it disappear, leaving a free path for you to retrieve it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you even listening to yourself? You think I want to steal the Sekimeiya? Sure, I wouldn't say no to having it, but that's not gonna work out.{w} First of all, they'd simply appear in the past. If a bunch of people time travel, the panic would ruin any kind of plan like that. At least a few people have to know what the Sekimeiya is capable of too, right? Why would they send the police to grab it if they know what touching it would do?
entries.literal: "Are you even listening to yourself? You think I want to steal the Sekimeiya? Sure, I wouldn't say no to having it, but that's not gonna work out.{w} First of all, they'd simply appear in the past. If a bunch of people time travel, the panic would ruin any kind of plan like that. At least a few people have to know what the Sekimeiya is capable of too, right? Why would they send the police to grab it if they know what touching it would do?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I think I agree with him... That wouldn't work.
entries.literal: "I think I agree with him... That wouldn't work."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hiding the Sekimeiya is pointless, that's a fact. Incidentally, there's no place the police would ignore. What that means is that if the Sekimeiya's here, there's no reason to search for it. What I find most likely is that it's already outside, though.
entries.literal: "Hiding the Sekimeiya is pointless, that's a fact. Incidentally, there's no place the police would ignore. What that means is that if the Sekimeiya's here, there's no reason to search for it. What I find most likely is that it's already outside, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}All right. I agree, so let's just wait.
entries.literal: "...{w}All right. I agree, so let's just wait."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya gave me a dubious look, but I had to ignore it.
entries.literal: "Shiroya gave me a dubious look, but I had to ignore it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Perfect. We've had enough headaches, so let's go to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Perfect. We've had enough headaches, so let's go to the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't actually agree at all, but more than an hour remained. If Sai was up to something, it was too early to try preventing it.
entries.literal: "I didn't actually agree at all, but more than an hour remained. If Sai was up to something, it was too early to try preventing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya's look told me she was thinking the same. Closer to the deadline, we'd push for a building search. That way, if we found the Sekimeiya, Sai wouldn't have time to arrange anything else.
entries.literal: "Shiroya's look told me she was thinking the same. Closer to the deadline, we'd push for a building search. That way, if we found the Sekimeiya, Sai wouldn't have time to arrange anything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't forget that Sai had tried to kill us. Under specific circumstances, he was willing to go that far.
entries.literal: "I couldn't forget that Sai had tried to kill us. Under specific circumstances, he was willing to go that far."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Part of me had to seriously consider that he was a Xyn plant. We had surmised early on that it was possible one of us trapped inside could be from Xyn, and Sai had sown chaos the entire time he'd been in the building, even if Katei was clearly suspicious anyway. It almost felt too obvious, given how completely unconcerned he was with the safety of others, and brandishing a knife at us didn't really earn him any points either.
entries.literal: "Part of me had to seriously consider that he was a Xyn plant. We had surmised early on that it was possible one of us trapped inside could be from Xyn, and Sai had sown chaos the entire time he'd been in the building, even if Katei was clearly suspicious anyway. It almost felt too obvious, given how completely unconcerned he was with the safety of others, and brandishing a knife at us didn't really earn him any points either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had deeply wanted to find out whatever I could and expose anyone responsible for the attack... but that had rapidly become quite difficult given the way things had gone. Even with all the information I had, I couldn't definitely conclude that he was responsible. I simply didn't know enough.
entries.literal: "I had deeply wanted to find out whatever I could and expose anyone responsible for the attack... but that had rapidly become quite difficult given the way things had gone. Even with all the information I had, I couldn't definitely conclude that he was responsible. I simply didn't know enough."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was for sure was that he was exactly the type of person to try to take the Sekimeiya for his own purposes, and I couldn't allow that. He'd been pissing me off the entire day, and after he'd almost killed me, there was no way I'd let him carry out any sort of plan if I could obstruct it. Additionally, I still wanted to find the Sekimeiya, and while it was out of the cabinet, it was storing the power we needed.
entries.literal: "What was for sure was that he was exactly the type of person to try to take the Sekimeiya for his own purposes, and I couldn't allow that. He'd been pissing me off the entire day, and after he'd almost killed me, there was no way I'd let him carry out any sort of plan if I could obstruct it. Additionally, I still wanted to find the Sekimeiya, and while it was out of the cabinet, it was storing the power we needed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If the video from all of the cameras was salvageable, there'd be no problem nailing the actual culprit, but I couldn't let something happen in the meantime.
entries.literal: "If the video from all of the cameras was salvageable, there'd be no problem nailing the actual culprit, but I couldn't let something happen in the meantime."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I whispered to Shiroya.
entries.literal: "I whispered to Shiroya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Did you lose the knife?
entries.literal: "...Did you lose the knife?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surprisingly, she shook her head and showed me the inside of her purse.
entries.literal: "Surprisingly, she shook her head and showed me the inside of her purse."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What...? She still has it?
entries.literal: "What...? She still has it?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When she disappeared from the event room, she had it, but every possible replicated location of hers that held it was placed in the event room too, and that's obviously not where she appeared...
entries.literal: "When she disappeared from the event room, she had it, but every possible replicated location of hers that held it was placed in the event room too, and that's obviously not where she appeared..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you get it from Sai after you two appeared somewhere?
entries.literal: "Did you get it from Sai after you two appeared somewhere?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No... I still don't understand it either. Both of us appeared in the attic, and I already had it. I'd forgotten to mention it, but yeah, that doesn't make sense with how we thought the Sekimeiya worked.
entries.literal: "No... I still don't understand it either. Both of us appeared in the attic, and I already had it. I'd forgotten to mention it, but yeah, that doesn't make sense with how we thought the Sekimeiya worked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the same as my wound. We'd had the Sekimeiya at our disposal for nearly eleven hours, and despite how much I'd gone over every detail, I was ashamed by how little we'd concluded.
entries.literal: "It was the same as my wound. We'd had the Sekimeiya at our disposal for nearly eleven hours, and despite how much I'd gone over every detail, I was ashamed by how little we'd concluded."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Okay, let's sit around and wait. I'm exhausted and just want to get out, so I hope nothing else happens. Whatever Xyn or the culprit are up to is no concern of ours anymore...{w} I have no idea what happened to Akaro, but I don't care. If he's behind this whole mess, he'll face the consequences.
entries.literal: "Okay, let's sit around and wait. I'm exhausted and just want to get out, so I hope nothing else happens. Whatever Xyn or the culprit are up to is no concern of ours anymore...{w} I have no idea what happened to Akaro, but I don't care. If he's behind this whole mess, he'll face the consequences."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The four of us sat next to each other on the left of the metal shutter. The entire day had been slow and dense, but it was true that very little time remained. We were nearing the end, and nothing but uncertainty awaited us.
entries.literal: "The four of us sat next to each other on the left of the metal shutter. The entire day had been slow and dense, but it was true that very little time remained. We were nearing the end, and nothing but uncertainty awaited us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Exactly one hour and ten minutes. That's all we have to get through to reclaim our freedom.
entries.literal: "Exactly one hour and ten minutes. That's all we have to get through to reclaim our freedom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One hour and ten minutes... Was there any guarantee that was even correct? I'd lost my sense of time many hours earlier, and while I knew the computer in the security room probably confirmed Sai's time, it was unreasonable to blindly believe it.
entries.literal: "One hour and ten minutes... Was there any guarantee that was even correct? I'd lost my sense of time many hours earlier, and while I knew the computer in the security room probably confirmed Sai's time, it was unreasonable to blindly believe it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, if the time truly was {time=19:50}, the end of the lengthy tunnel was near. Would freedom really be found at its exit, or would a new stretch of confinement begin? We were approaching the time where the truth behind the supposed month-away recording would be settled.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, if the time truly was {time=19:50}, the end of the lengthy tunnel was near. Would freedom really be found at its exit, or would a new stretch of confinement begin? We were approaching the time where the truth behind the supposed month-away recording would be settled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Uncomfortably leaning against the wall, we attempted to relax our bodies. Given Sai's track record and what he was likely after, we wouldn't be there for long.
entries.literal: "Uncomfortably leaning against the wall, we attempted to relax our bodies. Given Sai's track record and what he was likely after, we wouldn't be there for long."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He'd used a knife against me once. If he opposed us, it was only fair to return the favor.{w} Sai hadn't been wrong in suspecting Katei at the start, seeing through his myriad lies. However, he was insane if he thought he'd done a good job of hiding his own. The overconfidence he'd sheltered himself behind would prove useless if it was seen through.
entries.literal: "He'd used a knife against me once. If he opposed us, it was only fair to return the favor.{w} Sai hadn't been wrong in suspecting Katei at the start, seeing through his myriad lies. However, he was insane if he thought he'd done a good job of hiding his own. The overconfidence he'd sheltered himself behind would prove useless if it was seen through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But, for the time being, we waited. If everything went smoothly until the search, that'd be ideal.
entries.literal: "But, for the time being, we waited. If everything went smoothly until the search, that'd be ideal."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Wait here. I'm going to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "...Wait here. I'm going to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: About half an hour later, Shiroya stood up. It confused me at first, but I soon realized that it was not yet the move we'd silently scheduled for later, as another forty minutes still remained.
entries.literal: "About half an hour later, Shiroya stood up. It confused me at first, but I soon realized that it was not yet the move we'd silently scheduled for later, as another forty minutes still remained."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, all right.
entries.literal: "Oh, all right."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Can't you wait?
entries.literal: "Can't you wait?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No. Don't worry, though, I won't go anywhere else.
entries.literal: "No. Don't worry, though, I won't go anywhere else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She went off to hallway B. Once she disappeared, we continued with our blank looks.
entries.literal: "She went off to hallway B. Once she disappeared, we continued with our blank looks."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}She'd better come back quickly.
entries.literal: "...{w}She'd better come back quickly."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Sai, I understand everything you said, but we should try to find the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...Sai, I understand everything you said, but we should try to find the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh? Why?
entries.literal: "Huh? Why?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I-I need it... I can't just let Isla die.
entries.literal: "I-I need it... I can't just let Isla die."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Erina, it would be really bad if we searched for the Sekimeiya.{w} It's... difficult to say it, but if we do that, you'll begin to hope your daughter will be saved. I know it's harsh to hear, but it won't end well. We won't find it.
entries.literal: "...{w}Erina, it would be really bad if we searched for the Sekimeiya.{w} It's... difficult to say it, but if we do that, you'll begin to hope your daughter will be saved. I know it's harsh to hear, but it won't end well. We won't find it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Didn't you lie earlier too? Regarding how it worked?
entries.literal: "...Didn't you lie earlier too? Regarding how it worked?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That wasn't a lie; I don't understand how the Sekimeiya works myself very well. I know I said you'd go far enough back, but something must've gone wrong.
entries.literal: "That wasn't a lie; I don't understand how the Sekimeiya works myself very well. I know I said you'd go far enough back, but something must've gone wrong."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I also said I wouldn't travel, remember? That was something else I was wrong about. You didn't see it, but the travel encompassed me as well.
entries.literal: "I also said I wouldn't travel, remember? That was something else I was wrong about. You didn't see it, but the travel encompassed me as well."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What? No, we did see. You were the only one to travel.
entries.literal: "What? No, we did see. You were the only one to travel."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}What?{w} You had to have traveled as well, right?
entries.literal: "...{w}What?{w} You had to have traveled as well, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: She didn't. Only you did.
entries.literal: "She didn't. Only you did."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't wanted to tell him, as keeping him in the dark felt smarter. However, I was curious to hear what he'd have to say in response.
entries.literal: "I hadn't wanted to tell him, as keeping him in the dark felt smarter. However, I was curious to hear what he'd have to say in response."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}That... doesn't make any sense, though. Are you telling the truth?
entries.literal: "...{w}That... doesn't make any sense, though. Are you telling the truth?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina nodded as well. Sai stayed pensive for a long while, clearly puzzled by our experience.
entries.literal: "Erina nodded as well. Sai stayed pensive for a long while, clearly puzzled by our experience."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: W-Well, I suppose there's no point in thinking about it anymore. Understanding how the Sekimeiya works in such a short period of time might just be impossible.
entries.literal: "W-Well, I suppose there's no point in thinking about it anymore. Understanding how the Sekimeiya works in such a short period of time might just be impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He shrugged and seemingly gave up, but something about the whole situation still felt wrong. It seemed I'd overwritten the reality in which Sai and Akaro had talked to us in hallway B, and the Sai we were talking to had differing memories as a result.
entries.literal: "He shrugged and seemingly gave up, but something about the whole situation still felt wrong. It seemed I'd overwritten the reality in which Sai and Akaro had talked to us in hallway B, and the Sai we were talking to had differing memories as a result."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, what kind of sense did they make? He was the only one to travel, meaning that he should have gone twenty minutes into the past. If so, where had that version of him been? If he'd been nearby, he would've known that we hadn't traveled, and he'd told me that he heard the sound I made in hallway A.
entries.literal: "However, what kind of sense did they make? He was the only one to travel, meaning that he should have gone twenty minutes into the past. If so, where had that version of him been? If he'd been nearby, he would've known that we hadn't traveled, and he'd told me that he heard the sound I made in hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was too labyrinthine. I couldn't understand that whole series of events in the slightest. Warping realities, altered memories, and time travel... Such a conglomeration was bound to be nonsensical.
entries.literal: "It was too labyrinthine. I couldn't understand that whole series of events in the slightest. Warping realities, altered memories, and time travel... Such a conglomeration was bound to be nonsensical."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And so I let it go. I wanted to know what had happened, but I was forced to accept it was beyond my comprehension. Perhaps the other Shiroya's appearance would go unexplained for the rest of my life.
entries.literal: "And so I let it go. I wanted to know what had happened, but I was forced to accept it was beyond my comprehension. Perhaps the other Shiroya's appearance would go unexplained for the rest of my life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}But the real one hadn't come back after more than five minutes.{w} In addition, the other one had claimed to be the very same person, indicating that her origin point could still have been coming...
entries.literal: "...{w}But the real one hadn't come back after more than five minutes.{w} In addition, the other one had claimed to be the very same person, indicating that her origin point could still have been coming..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Stay here. I'll be back in a second.
entries.literal: "Stay here. I'll be back in a second."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Really? Are you two just ripping off Katei?
entries.literal: "Really? Are you two just ripping off Katei?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to hallway B. From there, I could clearly see that nobody was in the women's bathroom.
entries.literal: "I went to hallway B. From there, I could clearly see that nobody was in the women's bathroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How shocking, she's not there. Are you going to propose we search the whole building to find her?
entries.literal: "How shocking, she's not there. Are you going to propose we search the whole building to find her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could that have been her intention? To make us look everywhere? ...Wasn't it too early?
entries.literal: "Could that have been her intention? To make us look everywhere? ...Wasn't it too early?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Maybe she went to the bathrooms on floor 2, like Katei.
entries.literal: "Maybe she went to the bathrooms on floor 2, like Katei."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You mean when Katei lied, and in reality, I was the one who went up? In his case, the excuse worked because Naomi's in the men's bathroom. No reason Shiroya would do the same.
entries.literal: "You mean when Katei lied, and in reality, I was the one who went up? In his case, the excuse worked because Naomi's in the men's bathroom. No reason Shiroya would do the same."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai walked up to the bathrooms and opened the closed door. Through it, we only saw Naomi's second body covered by the curtain.
entries.literal: "Sai walked up to the bathrooms and opened the closed door. Through it, we only saw Naomi's second body covered by the curtain."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is this your genius plan? To act as if you're searching for Shiroya when your goal is to find the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Is this your genius plan? To act as if you're searching for Shiroya when your goal is to find the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not it at all... I don't know where she is.
entries.literal: "That's not it at all... I don't know where she is."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That can't be what she wants. She knew we could use the knife to force Sai into cooperating. By hiding, she'd be purposely removing it from the equation.
entries.literal: "That can't be what she wants. She knew we could use the knife to force Sai into cooperating. By hiding, she'd be purposely removing it from the equation."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe you're right. After all, she could just use this time to search on her own.{w} And nobody else is around... There's no danger to fear.{w} By which I mean, she didn't want to go to the bathroom. She had something else in mind. Are you telling me you don't know what it is?
entries.literal: "Maybe you're right. After all, she could just use this time to search on her own.{w} And nobody else is around... There's no danger to fear.{w} By which I mean, she didn't want to go to the bathroom. She had something else in mind. Are you telling me you don't know what it is?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, but that can't be it.
entries.literal: "No, but that can't be it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What, then? Akaro came back out of nowhere and did something to her? Did she go to the past even though the Sekimeiya's probably gone? Why? And shouldn't she have come back if that had happened?{w} I told you I was hoping for a calm end to all this. Were you two the ones who hid the Sekimeiya after all?
entries.literal: "What, then? Akaro came back out of nowhere and did something to her? Did she go to the past even though the Sekimeiya's probably gone? Why? And shouldn't she have come back if that had happened?{w} I told you I was hoping for a calm end to all this. Were you two the ones who hid the Sekimeiya after all?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Stop it. I don't know what happened.
entries.literal: "Stop it. I don't know what happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya! Are you here!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Are you here!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How strange. She's not coming.
entries.literal: "How strange. She's not coming."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the event room and verified that the cabinet was still empty. Nothing had changed there.
entries.literal: "I went to the event room and verified that the cabinet was still empty. Nothing had changed there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Could it really have been Akaro? Sai just sounded pretty confident when he said that nobody else is around, but he doesn't know of the reality in which Akaro appeared from hallway A.
entries.literal: "Could it really have been Akaro? Sai just sounded pretty confident when he said that nobody else is around, but he doesn't know of the reality in which Akaro appeared from hallway A."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: From his point of view, Akaro has been missing for hours, ever since they escaped from the bedroom together.{w} Is that it, though? ...Or am I being tricked?
entries.literal: "From his point of view, Akaro has been missing for hours, ever since they escaped from the bedroom together.{w} Is that it, though? ...Or am I being tricked?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In the reality where Akaro appeared, Sai didn't seem surprised to see him.{w} ...There were plenty of other things that had to be different, though.
entries.literal: "In the reality where Akaro appeared, Sai didn't seem surprised to see him.{w} ...There were plenty of other things that had to be different, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept calling her name in hallway A, but there was no response.
entries.literal: "I kept calling her name in hallway A, but there was no response."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And once again, nothing new caught my eye in the storeroom.
entries.literal: "And once again, nothing new caught my eye in the storeroom."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Could she have gone up?
entries.literal: "...Could she have gone up?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: She did leave the attic key in the door. Maybe she had some final business there.
entries.literal: "She did leave the attic key in the door. Maybe she had some final business there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't like it at all. Why was Shiroya surrounded by so much mystery? After finding her again, I hadn't sensed anything strange about her, but had she still kept something important from me...?
entries.literal: "I didn't like it at all. Why was Shiroya surrounded by so much mystery? After finding her again, I hadn't sensed anything strange about her, but had she still kept something important from me...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hesitating slightly, I directed myself toward the stairs.
entries.literal: "Hesitating slightly, I directed myself toward the stairs."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Man, I get it's been a bizarre day. I didn't anticipate anything like this when I woke up, but there's no reason to drag things out.
entries.literal: "Man, I get it's been a bizarre day. I didn't anticipate anything like this when I woke up, but there's no reason to drag things out."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, this has nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya. We need to find Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Sai, this has nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya. We need to find Shiroya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh* Yes, yes. You're just too stubborn.
entries.literal: "*sigh* Yes, yes. You're just too stubborn."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no reason to take the elevator, so we walked up. On the second floor, I continued yelling her name, but we didn't so much as see her shadow.
entries.literal: "There was no reason to take the elevator, so we walked up. On the second floor, I continued yelling her name, but we didn't so much as see her shadow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We continued until we were in front of the attic. Sai was right—the key was still inserted.
entries.literal: "We continued until we were in front of the attic. Sai was right—the key was still inserted."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know it sounds like she and I are up to something, but we need to actually search for her thoroughly.
entries.literal: "I know it sounds like she and I are up to something, but we need to actually search for her thoroughly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who could've guessed? ...That's fine.{w} If she's still here, we'll find her.
entries.literal: "Who could've guessed? ...That's fine.{w} If she's still here, we'll find her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I don't know if you have something in mind, but you two will stay together, making sure nobody can sneak past. Not Shiroya, not Akaro, and not someone who's hiding.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't know if you have something in mind, but you two will stay together, making sure nobody can sneak past. Not Shiroya, not Akaro, and not someone who's hiding."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Sure.{w} But do understand that the Sekimeiya exists somewhere. Using it, it's possible to bypass any regular search by teleporting back to a recently inspected place. I doubt we have to worry about that, though.
entries.literal: "...Sure.{w} But do understand that the Sekimeiya exists somewhere. Using it, it's possible to bypass any regular search by teleporting back to a recently inspected place. I doubt we have to worry about that, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went up the stairs. I looked at the floor of the living room, but I was unable to draw much from it. I could still recognize some of the very old footprints, but most of them were newer. It was at least clear that none had been left recently.
entries.literal: "We went up the stairs. I looked at the floor of the living room, but I was unable to draw much from it. I could still recognize some of the very old footprints, but most of them were newer. It was at least clear that none had been left recently."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went through the kitchen and entered the hallway.
entries.literal: "I went through the kitchen and entered the hallway."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Just stay here while I look around.
entries.literal: "Just stay here while I look around."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: At your service.
entries.literal: "At your service."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I called the elevator. Seconds later, it arrived, empty except for the blood I'd left in it. Then, I proceeded to leave the door open, disabling it as an escape method.
entries.literal: "...I called the elevator. Seconds later, it arrived, empty except for the blood I'd left in it. Then, I proceeded to leave the door open, disabling it as an escape method."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait, why isn't the handle attached? This is the room where we locked ourselves in.
entries.literal: "Wait, why isn't the handle attached? This is the room where we locked ourselves in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only the inner handle of the bedroom wasn't attached, and it was next to the door, in the hallway.
entries.literal: "Only the inner handle of the bedroom wasn't attached, and it was next to the door, in the hallway."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, what...? I have no idea.
entries.literal: "Oh, what...? I have no idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whatever happened in the attic, it had taken place some time ago, as every room was vacant. I looked through the storeroom, the bathroom, and the two bedrooms. During that time, Erina and Sai made sure we could conclude the attic was empty.
entries.literal: "Whatever happened in the attic, it had taken place some time ago, as every room was vacant. I looked through the storeroom, the bathroom, and the two bedrooms. During that time, Erina and Sai made sure we could conclude the attic was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at the elevator and saw that the door hadn't closed. I felt confident in moving on, so we headed to the sixth floor.
entries.literal: "I glanced at the elevator and saw that the door hadn't closed. I felt confident in moving on, so we headed to the sixth floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While Sai and Erina stayed outside the partitions, I looked through the three of them and then in the bathrooms. That made one more floor Shiroya wasn't on.
entries.literal: "While Sai and Erina stayed outside the partitions, I looked through the three of them and then in the bathrooms. That made one more floor Shiroya wasn't on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And quickly, those floors added up to six. One last time, the crystal floor was the final place to look through.
entries.literal: "And quickly, those floors added up to six. One last time, the crystal floor was the final place to look through."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If she's here, I hope you admit what you're doing.
entries.literal: "If she's here, I hope you admit what you're doing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Just stay put. I'll look through the rooms.
entries.literal: "Just stay put. I'll look through the rooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the storeroom, but Erina's voice stopped me.
entries.literal: "I walked to the storeroom, but Erina's voice stopped me."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: W-Wait.{w} You said Shiroya wasn't in the women's bathroom, but you didn't mention this.
entries.literal: "W-Wait.{w} You said Shiroya wasn't in the women's bathroom, but you didn't mention this."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped back. Erina had decided to inspect the bathroom herself out of either curiosity or distrust.
entries.literal: "I stepped back. Erina had decided to inspect the bathroom herself out of either curiosity or distrust."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Don't move. I'll look myself.
entries.literal: "Don't move. I'll look myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached the doors and peeked inside. What Erina had noticed was the toilet: the water tank's lid had been removed, which we hadn't seen from hallway B.
entries.literal: "I approached the doors and peeked inside. What Erina had noticed was the toilet: the water tank's lid had been removed, which we hadn't seen from hallway B."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the...?
entries.literal: "What the...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On a thin pipe, close to falling into the water, was the gray Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "On a thin pipe, close to falling into the water, was the gray Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did she activate it?
entries.literal: "Did she activate it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Touching it entailed no risk, so I put my left arm inside.
entries.literal: "Touching it entailed no risk, so I put my left arm inside."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I don't get it. It's been like ten minutes since she went to the bathroom. Even if she activated it, would it still be powered off...?
entries.literal: "I don't get it. It's been like ten minutes since she went to the bathroom. Even if she activated it, would it still be powered off...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I set the Sekimeiya on the floor and retrieved the tank lid, which was sitting between the toilet and the far wall. It was heavier than I expected, so I gently put it back in place.
entries.literal: "I set the Sekimeiya on the floor and retrieved the tank lid, which was sitting between the toilet and the far wall. It was heavier than I expected, so I gently put it back in place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked out, holding the Sekimeiya with my hand. I had put my sleeve between it and my skin, preventing it from activating when it regained power.
entries.literal: "I walked out, holding the Sekimeiya with my hand. I had put my sleeve between it and my skin, preventing it from activating when it regained power."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The Sekimeiya's not in the tower anymore, right?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya's not in the tower anymore, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isn't that it?
entries.literal: "Isn't that it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Did you hide it in the water tank?
entries.literal: "...Did you hide it in the water tank?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not me.{w} I honestly thought it must've left the building some time ago. I wonder why anyone would hide it.{w} However, it seems Shiroya activated it and went to the past. Maybe she knew where it would be if she hid it herself. It doesn't make a lot of sense that she's not here, though.
entries.literal: "Not me.{w} I honestly thought it must've left the building some time ago. I wonder why anyone would hide it.{w} However, it seems Shiroya activated it and went to the past. Maybe she knew where it would be if she hid it herself. It doesn't make a lot of sense that she's not here, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}We still haven't searched the whole floor. I'll go leave the Sekimeiya in the event room, and we won't move it again.
entries.literal: "...{w}We still haven't searched the whole floor. I'll go leave the Sekimeiya in the event room, and we won't move it again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...There's nothing else to find, is there? Do you seriously believe Shiroya will be here? We've already found the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...There's nothing else to find, is there? Do you seriously believe Shiroya will be here? We've already found the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at Sai's eyes, a little disconcerted. His voice sounded noticeably more nervous and tense than it had recently.
entries.literal: "I stared at Sai's eyes, a little disconcerted. His voice sounded noticeably more nervous and tense than it had recently."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Is there something else to find here?
entries.literal: "...Is there something else to find here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm? What would that be?
entries.literal: "Hm? What would that be?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was something hidden behind those words. Saying that was all he could do to try to prevent the search from concluding.
entries.literal: "There was something hidden behind those words. Saying that was all he could do to try to prevent the search from concluding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Shiroya's fate is death." His prediction hadn't yet become reality.
entries.literal: "\"Shiroya's fate is death.\" His prediction hadn't yet become reality."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "If she went to the past, why hasn't she shown herself yet?" It was a very good question, and one which had already come up a handful of times.
entries.literal: "\"If she went to the past, why hasn't she shown herself yet?\" It was a very good question, and one which had already come up a handful of times."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Just keep waiting here.
entries.literal: "...{w}Just keep waiting here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to ignore the insidious atmosphere around me and hesitantly moved to the event room.
entries.literal: "I tried to ignore the insidious atmosphere around me and hesitantly moved to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lowered the glass of the cabinet. When I placed the Sekimeiya inside, I didn't have to wait long for it to turn white.
entries.literal: "I lowered the glass of the cabinet. When I placed the Sekimeiya inside, I didn't have to wait long for it to turn white."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hello. I just wanted to see what you were doing. I'll be outside this room to make sure you don't do anything with the Sekimeiya. Don't think Shiroya's actions aren't suspicious. I don't want her to come from the other hallway and grab it or something.{w} Don't worry, either. I'll stay in the hallway, and I won't get it out myself.
entries.literal: "Hello. I just wanted to see what you were doing. I'll be outside this room to make sure you don't do anything with the Sekimeiya. Don't think Shiroya's actions aren't suspicious. I don't want her to come from the other hallway and grab it or something.{w} Don't worry, either. I'll stay in the hallway, and I won't get it out myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked through the door and saw that Erina hadn't moved, so I didn't have any particular problem.
entries.literal: "I looked through the door and saw that Erina hadn't moved, so I didn't have any particular problem."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Fine.
entries.literal: "Fine."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I see you haven't locked the cabinet, huh?
entries.literal: "...I see you haven't locked the cabinet, huh?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We'll deal with that later.
entries.literal: "We'll deal with that later."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I disregarded him and walked away. I knew how suspicious I sounded, but I had consciously avoided locking it.
entries.literal: "I disregarded him and walked away. I knew how suspicious I sounded, but I had consciously avoided locking it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was very likely Sai had hidden the key somewhere and could open it anyway. Regardless, I didn't have it, and I wasn't sure if I wanted to activate the Sekimeiya again.
entries.literal: "It was very likely Sai had hidden the key somewhere and could open it anyway. Regardless, I didn't have it, and I wasn't sure if I wanted to activate the Sekimeiya again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had learned the past could be changed in some capacity. Shiroya had also sounded interested in exploring that further. If I locked the cabinet, I would be preventing myself from trying it ever again. Before considering it further, I wanted to find Shiroya and avoid erasing or modifying the version of her I knew.
entries.literal: "I had learned the past could be changed in some capacity. Shiroya had also sounded interested in exploring that further. If I locked the cabinet, I would be preventing myself from trying it ever again. Before considering it further, I wanted to find Shiroya and avoid erasing or modifying the version of her I knew."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I resumed the search and went to the storeroom. As expected, it was empty, and the far door hadn't budged.
entries.literal: "I resumed the search and went to the storeroom. As expected, it was empty, and the far door hadn't budged."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If this ends and we don't find her, I'll just give up on the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "If this ends and we don't find her, I'll just give up on the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If she's not here, all I can hope is that she's outside, waiting.
entries.literal: "If she's not here, all I can hope is that she's outside, waiting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As had often happened, my thoughts derailed to the recording. The people mentioned in it were me, Sai, Akaro, Erina, and Isla.
entries.literal: "As had often happened, my thoughts derailed to the recording. The people mentioned in it were me, Sai, Akaro, Erina, and Isla."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla was debatable, but the rest should've been available. Naomi and Katei had died, so it made sense they hadn't been mentioned. Shiroya didn't seem to be anywhere... Was it all a coincidence?
entries.literal: "Isla was debatable, but the rest should've been available. Naomi and Katei had died, so it made sense they hadn't been mentioned. Shiroya didn't seem to be anywhere... Was it all a coincidence?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered room A5. We'd looked inside every cabinet fairly often, as they were potential hiding spots for people. The only time someone had been in one was that very room...
entries.literal: "I entered room A5. We'd looked inside every cabinet fairly often, as they were potential hiding spots for people. The only time someone had been in one was that very room..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I did the same thing. There was no way Shiroya would be hiding in a cabinet, but I had to make sure no places were ignored. Furthermore, Akaro's disappearance was still up in the air.
entries.literal: "I did the same thing. There was no way Shiroya would be hiding in a cabinet, but I had to make sure no places were ignored. Furthermore, Akaro's disappearance was still up in the air."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Isla hadn't changed at all over those hours. Soon, I hoped, she could be brought to a much better place, outside the tower.
entries.literal: "...Isla hadn't changed at all over those hours. Soon, I hoped, she could be brought to a much better place, outside the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next few rooms were all empty. Sai hadn't moved from next to the event room, and he shrugged every time he saw that I continued to find nothing.
entries.literal: "The next few rooms were all empty. Sai hadn't moved from next to the event room, and he shrugged every time he saw that I continued to find nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the last crystal room. After it, only the security room would remain.
entries.literal: "I entered the last crystal room. After it, only the security room would remain."

entries.text: The Last Bird
entries.literal: "The Last Bird"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to a cabinet was Shiroya. She was leaning on it with a pained face.
entries.literal: "Next to a cabinet was Shiroya. She was leaning on it with a pained face."
