entries.speaker: s
entries.text: A-Atsuki...?
entries.literal: "A-Atsuki...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frantically ran over to her. While I was relieved to see her, she didn't look well.
entries.literal: "I frantically ran over to her. While I was relieved to see her, she didn't look well."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you okay...? What happened?
entries.literal: "Are you okay...? What happened?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm fine, yes... And I... don't know. I don't feel great.
entries.literal: "I'm fine, yes... And I... don't know. I don't feel great."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-What? You don't know what happened?
entries.literal: "Wh-What? You don't know what happened?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I knew I heard you talking. Look who it is... What were you doing here?
entries.literal: "I knew I heard you talking. Look who it is... What were you doing here?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Sorry, my head's been hurting for a while.
entries.literal: "Sorry, my head's been hurting for a while."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do I look like I care? Why have you been in this room for so long?
entries.literal: "Do I look like I care? Why have you been in this room for so long?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I-I suddenly couldn't keep going...
entries.literal: "I-I suddenly couldn't keep going..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you two for real? Is this the best you could think of?
entries.literal: "Are you two for real? Is this the best you could think of?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shut the fuck up! We didn't plan any of this!
entries.literal: "Shut the fuck up! We didn't plan any of this!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not stopping. You found the Sekimeiya in the bathroom, right? Then you activated it.
entries.literal: "I'm not stopping. You found the Sekimeiya in the bathroom, right? Then you activated it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Ah... Yes, that's right.
entries.literal: "Ah... Yes, that's right."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What happened then?
entries.literal: "What happened then?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't remember. All I know is that I didn't find anyone, and I rested in this room.
entries.literal: "I don't remember. All I know is that I didn't find anyone, and I rested in this room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And you're all right now? You're standing up just fine.
entries.literal: "And you're all right now? You're standing up just fine."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I just felt dizzy. I'm better now.
entries.literal: "I just felt dizzy. I'm better now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked over her body, and a subtle discomfort wormed its way into me. Perhaps I was making it up, but her face looked almost... worn out.
entries.literal: "I looked over her body, and a subtle discomfort wormed its way into me. Perhaps I was making it up, but her face looked almost... worn out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, I guess this means you accomplished whatever you wanted to do, right? I'm very happy to hear it.
entries.literal: "Well, I guess this means you accomplished whatever you wanted to do, right? I'm very happy to hear it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The three of us stepped into hallway A. When Erina saw Shiroya, she approached us.
entries.literal: "The three of us stepped into hallway A. When Erina saw Shiroya, she approached us."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Shiroya... I'm glad you're all right. What happened to you?
entries.literal: "Shiroya... I'm glad you're all right. What happened to you?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: She chose the "oh I'm so disoriented I can barely remember anything" excuse, just like you did earlier. Don't even bother.
entries.literal: "She chose the \"oh I'm so disoriented I can barely remember anything\" excuse, just like you did earlier. Don't even bother."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: H-Huh...?

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you only not remember what happened after you touched the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Do you only not remember what happened after you touched the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I think so... Before that, we were waiting in the lobby, until I had to go to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "I think so... Before that, we were waiting in the lobby, until I had to go to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. Do you not know where the dizziness came from?
entries.literal: "I see. Do you not know where the dizziness came from?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}I don't know...
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't know..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no clue what to think. She looked sad; that was all I could perceive. Maybe she'd been attacked or had an accident. ...Perhaps it was an effect of the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I had no clue what to think. She looked sad; that was all I could perceive. Maybe she'd been attacked or had an accident. ...Perhaps it was an effect of the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, the sadness faded away, and in its place came a gentle smile.
entries.literal: "Then, the sadness faded away, and in its place came a gentle smile."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Don't worry, I'm okay. There's not a lot of time left, right?
entries.literal: "Don't worry, I'm okay. There's not a lot of time left, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's {time=20:37.}

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: See... It's almost time.
entries.literal: "See... It's almost time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Can you come here for a second?
entries.literal: "...Can you come here for a second?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-Yes.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What, going to go rub your hands together now that your plan has succeeded?
entries.literal: "What, going to go rub your hands together now that your plan has succeeded?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What plan, Sai? Do you think we did this to find the Sekimeiya you didn't want us to find?{w} You understand that doesn't make any sense, right? She found it in the bathroom. What's the point of forcing a search to find it if she already identified where it was?
entries.literal: "What plan, Sai? Do you think we did this to find the Sekimeiya you didn't want us to find?{w} You understand that doesn't make any sense, right? She found it in the bathroom. What's the point of forcing a search to find it if she already identified where it was?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Why is she faking, then?
entries.literal: "...{w}Why is she faking, then?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'm not. My head really doesn't feel good.
entries.literal: "I'm not. My head really doesn't feel good."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right.
entries.literal: "Right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I was ecstatic that we'd be able to stop dealing with Sai relatively soon. I sighed and walked back, bringing Shiroya to hallway C.
entries.literal: "...I was ecstatic that we'd be able to stop dealing with Sai relatively soon. I sighed and walked back, bringing Shiroya to hallway C."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you remember what we talked about before waiting in the lobby?
entries.literal: "Do you remember what we talked about before waiting in the lobby?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Uh...

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I said the past could be changed, remember?
entries.literal: "I said the past could be changed, remember?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: O-Oh, yes. But we didn't find the Sekimeiya in that locker, where it should've been.
entries.literal: "O-Oh, yes. But we didn't find the Sekimeiya in that locker, where it should've been."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah.{w} You traveled through time. Do you think you might've changed anything?
entries.literal: "Yeah.{w} You traveled through time. Do you think you might've changed anything?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I really don't think so.
entries.literal: "I really don't think so."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, right now, the Sekimeiya's in the cabinet, but I didn't lock it. There's only about thirty minutes left, but we can still use it.
entries.literal: "Well, right now, the Sekimeiya's in the cabinet, but I didn't lock it. There's only about thirty minutes left, but we can still use it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We might be able to change the past. If we travel together, we'll keep our memories of this reality. I'm not sure how it works yet, but I thought of something.{w} Sai's definitely suspicious of us, so I doubt he'll let us just waltz on in and take the Sekimeiya. Obviously, given the time left, it's very unlikely we'll go back far enough even if the Sekimeiya stores energy the whole time.
entries.literal: "We might be able to change the past. If we travel together, we'll keep our memories of this reality. I'm not sure how it works yet, but I thought of something.{w} Sai's definitely suspicious of us, so I doubt he'll let us just waltz on in and take the Sekimeiya. Obviously, given the time left, it's very unlikely we'll go back far enough even if the Sekimeiya stores energy the whole time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It could be a start, though. We'd go decently far into the past. Fifteen minutes sent me twenty minutes back, so every minute stored adds more than a minute.
entries.literal: "It could be a start, though. We'd go decently far into the past. Fifteen minutes sent me twenty minutes back, so every minute stored adds more than a minute."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: By which I mean, we could go more than thirty minutes into the past and change it in a way so that we can begin storing time at the point we arrive. If we repeat this, we'll go even farther, and we'll be able to store a lot more time.
entries.literal: "By which I mean, we could go more than thirty minutes into the past and change it in a way so that we can begin storing time at the point we arrive. If we repeat this, we'll go even farther, and we'll be able to store a lot more time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure it'd work, but even though we can currently only store thirty minutes, we can keep doing this to maybe keep going back more and more.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure it'd work, but even though we can currently only store thirty minutes, we can keep doing this to maybe keep going back more and more."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How do we store thirty minutes without Sai noticing? I feel like this is feasible.{w} Remember how the cabinet works? We could unplug the cord, which would stop the temperature regulation.
entries.literal: "How do we store thirty minutes without Sai noticing? I feel like this is feasible.{w} Remember how the cabinet works? We could unplug the cord, which would stop the temperature regulation."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then, even though it'd look normal, it'd actually be storing power. We can hide it in plain sight like that and activate it at the last second...
entries.literal: "Then, even though it'd look normal, it'd actually be storing power. We can hide it in plain sight like that and activate it at the last second..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...N-No, let's not.
entries.literal: "...N-No, let's not."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}You don't want to try it...?
entries.literal: "...{w}You don't want to try it...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't. Everything is fine as it is right now.
entries.literal: "I don't. Everything is fine as it is right now."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: But...{w} we'll regret it. If we don't even try it, the time will come when we'll hate not having tried it.
entries.literal: "But...{w} we'll regret it. If we don't even try it, the time will come when we'll hate not having tried it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No... That won't happen.
entries.literal: "No... That won't happen."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why? That's not how you reacted the first time I proposed changing the past.
entries.literal: "Why? That's not how you reacted the first time I proposed changing the past."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I know... I just thought about it more.{w} Let's wait until the time is up. We can end everything now.{w} We've been here for too long... I just want to get out.{w} Believe me, there's no need to do anything else.
entries.literal: "I know... I just thought about it more.{w} Let's wait until the time is up. We can end everything now.{w} We've been here for too long... I just want to get out.{w} Believe me, there's no need to do anything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really didn't get it. I couldn't blame her for saying that, but every word felt distant.
entries.literal: "I really didn't get it. I couldn't blame her for saying that, but every word felt distant."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...We just have to accept that Miiya died. Let's do what we said and try to be strong despite it.
entries.literal: "...We just have to accept that Miiya died. Let's do what we said and try to be strong despite it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know that Miiya died, but we can prevent it...!
entries.literal: "I know that Miiya died, but we can prevent it...!"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: No. Let's stop, please...
entries.literal: "No. Let's stop, please..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Tell me, at least. Why did you change your mind?
entries.literal: "...Tell me, at least. Why did you change your mind?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}To tell you the truth, I'm not even sure I'd want to do it even if we could.
entries.literal: "...{w}To tell you the truth, I'm not even sure I'd want to do it even if we could."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What does that mean...?
entries.literal: "What does that mean...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Most importantly, I just want to leave this place. We have to keep going with what we've got, and I'm sure it'll be fine.{w} This isn't a world where Miiya survives, so let's keep living the best we can.
entries.literal: "Most importantly, I just want to leave this place. We have to keep going with what we've got, and I'm sure it'll be fine.{w} This isn't a world where Miiya survives, so let's keep living the best we can."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What the hell was up with that change of philosophy? I was too lost to know if I agreed at all.
entries.literal: "What the hell was up with that change of philosophy? I was too lost to know if I agreed at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I knew one thing. I also wanted to get out, and Shiroya was safe. ...Saving Miiya had been something of a dream rather than an actual goal. The main thing, the definitely achievable thing, was leaving with Shiroya, and it finally seemed within reach.
entries.literal: "However, I knew one thing. I also wanted to get out, and Shiroya was safe. ...Saving Miiya had been something of a dream rather than an actual goal. The main thing, the definitely achievable thing, was leaving with Shiroya, and it finally seemed within reach."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you sure? I know it sounds like a stretch, but I still think my idea is worth considering.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? I know it sounds like a stretch, but I still think my idea is worth considering."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I am, yes.
entries.literal: "...I am, yes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What about the Sekimeiya? Do you not want to try using it again?
entries.literal: "What about the Sekimeiya? Do you not want to try using it again?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I definitely don't. I have no idea what will happen with it, but let's forget it exists if we can.
entries.literal: "I definitely don't. I have no idea what will happen with it, but let's forget it exists if we can."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.literal: "...Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was the end, then. I tried to think of something else to say to her, but I found nothing. If that was the life she wanted to keep living, opposing it would have been a breach of our friendship.
entries.literal: "That was the end, then. I tried to think of something else to say to her, but I found nothing. If that was the life she wanted to keep living, opposing it would have been a breach of our friendship."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What confused me was her change of heart. She'd been wanting to use the Sekimeiya to save Miiya up until it had actually become remotely possible...
entries.literal: "What confused me was her change of heart. She'd been wanting to use the Sekimeiya to save Miiya up until it had actually become remotely possible..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What reason could there have been to not want to attempt it? Was she not fond of the idea of changing the cards we'd been dealt?
entries.literal: "What reason could there have been to not want to attempt it? Was she not fond of the idea of changing the cards we'd been dealt?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had been a focus of my thoughts the entire day. Was I really going to give up so easily?
entries.literal: "It had been a focus of my thoughts the entire day. Was I really going to give up so easily?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at Shiroya's expression, which told me how serious she was. I could only be saddened and maybe a little disappointed, but logically speaking, I hadn't lost anything. Miiya was already dead before we went to the tower, and the reason we'd entered was to begin moving past it.
entries.literal: "I glanced at Shiroya's expression, which told me how serious she was. I could only be saddened and maybe a little disappointed, but logically speaking, I hadn't lost anything. Miiya was already dead before we went to the tower, and the reason we'd entered was to begin moving past it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Let's go back to the lobby.
entries.literal: "...Let's go back to the lobby."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The large room was empty. Shiroya walked up to the spot where we'd been sitting and returned to her previous position. I sat at her side, recalling the events we'd gone through. All my own recent experiences felt surreal, but I knew they had truly happened.
entries.literal: "The large room was empty. Shiroya walked up to the spot where we'd been sitting and returned to her previous position. I sat at her side, recalling the events we'd gone through. All my own recent experiences felt surreal, but I knew they had truly happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I wonder where Erina and Sai went...
entries.literal: "I wonder where Erina and Sai went..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Even if they're up to something, we just have to wait here.
entries.literal: "Even if they're up to something, we just have to wait here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Right...
entries.literal: "Right..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, Erina soon arrived from hallway B.
entries.literal: "However, Erina soon arrived from hallway B."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Here you are. I lost track of Sai at some point. Have you seen him?
entries.literal: "...Here you are. I lost track of Sai at some point. Have you seen him?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No.
entries.literal: "No."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't know where he is, then...
entries.literal: "I don't know where he is, then..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw her staring at the mechanical room. When I did, I also felt like something about it had changed. It hadn't been fully closed before, had it?
entries.literal: "I saw her staring at the mechanical room. When I did, I also felt like something about it had changed. It hadn't been fully closed before, had it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She looked away and came to sit by our side.
entries.literal: "She looked away and came to sit by our side."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: There's not much time left, right?
entries.literal: "There's not much time left, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Less than half an hour.
entries.literal: "Less than half an hour."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those twelve hours had felt so much longer. It was hard to believe they were coming to an end and that we could resume our normal lives after everything.
entries.literal: "Those twelve hours had felt so much longer. It was hard to believe they were coming to an end and that we could resume our normal lives after everything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nothing more to be said—not from someone as tired as me. I tried not to think about Sai and focused instead on keeping my mind blank.
entries.literal: "There was nothing more to be said—not from someone as tired as me. I tried not to think about Sai and focused instead on keeping my mind blank."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...We won't actually get out, right?
entries.literal: "...We won't actually get out, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We'll stay here for more than a month, won't we?
entries.literal: "We'll stay here for more than a month, won't we?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's no way. The exit will definitely open soon.
entries.literal: "There's no way. The exit will definitely open soon."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: How can that be, though? In a month, Isla will be alive here, and I haven't saved her yet. If the shutter opens, that'll become impossible.
entries.literal: "How can that be, though? In a month, Isla will be alive here, and I haven't saved her yet. If the shutter opens, that'll become impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Every time similar things came out of her mouth, I went quiet. How was I supposed to answer that? I still didn't know what had happened to Erina, but her personality had noticeably shifted at one point. She hadn't yet recovered from her sedated appearance.
entries.literal: "...Every time similar things came out of her mouth, I went quiet. How was I supposed to answer that? I still didn't know what had happened to Erina, but her personality had noticeably shifted at one point. She hadn't yet recovered from her sedated appearance."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I know it might sound shallow, but it'll be fine.{w} If Isla is fated to be alive in the future, she will be no matter what you do. You'll see her again, right? That's what the recording predicted. Now, you just have to wait until that happens.
entries.literal: "I know it might sound shallow, but it'll be fine.{w} If Isla is fated to be alive in the future, she will be no matter what you do. You'll see her again, right? That's what the recording predicted. Now, you just have to wait until that happens."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Do I have to wait a month to see her, then?
entries.literal: "...Do I have to wait a month to see her, then?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}I don't know.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't get a read on Shiroya. Was she just trying to be optimistic to calm her down...?
entries.literal: "I couldn't get a read on Shiroya. Was she just trying to be optimistic to calm her down...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Or was she actually considering that what we'd heard in the recording would occur in the future? I didn't think that was it—she also seemed to believe we were just about to leave the tower.
entries.literal: "Or was she actually considering that what we'd heard in the recording would occur in the future? I didn't think that was it—she also seemed to believe we were just about to leave the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina tried to accept what she'd heard, but after a couple minutes, it became clear that she couldn't be content with that alone.
entries.literal: "Erina tried to accept what she'd heard, but after a couple minutes, it became clear that she couldn't be content with that alone."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I'll go find Sai. I don't like thinking about what he might be doing.
entries.literal: "...I'll go find Sai. I don't like thinking about what he might be doing."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: At this point, why aren't we doing more than doubting him? There's been a culprit among us the whole time. Now, only four of us are left, and we didn't find Akaro. It can only be him, right?{w} Of us, he's the only one missing. I think he disappeared on purpose. I need to find him.
entries.literal: "At this point, why aren't we doing more than doubting him? There's been a culprit among us the whole time. Now, only four of us are left, and we didn't find Akaro. It can only be him, right?{w} Of us, he's the only one missing. I think he disappeared on purpose. I need to find him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She walked back to hallway B without giving us time to answer.
entries.literal: "She walked back to hallway B without giving us time to answer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I looked at each other, hesitant to react. We'd agreed to wait until {time=21:05}, so Erina's abrupt departure wasn't enough to disrupt that.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I looked at each other, hesitant to react. We'd agreed to wait until {time=21:05}, so Erina's abrupt departure wasn't enough to disrupt that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't like the thought of letting her and Sai both run free, but I let it go.
entries.literal: "I didn't like the thought of letting her and Sai both run free, but I let it go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were alone, and time kept passing. Three or four minutes later, Shiroya spoke.
entries.literal: "We were alone, and time kept passing. Three or four minutes later, Shiroya spoke."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}How much time is left? Less than twenty minutes, right?
entries.literal: "...{w}How much time is left? Less than twenty minutes, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Sorry, it's all fine. Ignore me.
entries.literal: "Sorry, it's all fine. Ignore me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Wh-What?
entries.literal: "...{w}Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not going to ignore you. What is it?
entries.literal: "I'm not going to ignore you. What is it?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I was just a bit confused. It's nothing important.
entries.literal: "I was just a bit confused. It's nothing important."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was almost speechless. I didn't like agreeing with Sai, but I had to. Something about Shiroya wasn't right.
entries.literal: "I was almost speechless. I didn't like agreeing with Sai, but I had to. Something about Shiroya wasn't right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The convenient loss of memory, the sudden appearance in that room... She'd also changed completely when I'd mentioned using the Sekimeiya again and contradicted her own past self.
entries.literal: "The convenient loss of memory, the sudden appearance in that room... She'd also changed completely when I'd mentioned using the Sekimeiya again and contradicted her own past self."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh... You're still here?
entries.literal: "Oh... You're still here?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah. Did you find Sai?
entries.literal: "Yeah. Did you find Sai?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: N-No.{w} Sorry to ask like this, but what time is it?
entries.literal: "N-No.{w} Sorry to ask like this, but what time is it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I'm sorry?
entries.literal: "...{w}I'm sorry?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It should be {time=20:50} soon.
entries.literal: "It should be {time=20:50} soon."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...{w}R-Really...? Okay.
entries.literal: "...{w}R-Really...? Okay."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This is starting to get ridiculous. What is up with you two?
entries.literal: "This is starting to get ridiculous. What is up with you two?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't understand... Maybe you were right, Shiroya. We'll wait...
entries.literal: "I don't understand... Maybe you were right, Shiroya. We'll wait..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina made her way to where she'd been sitting, but there was only so much I could ignore.
entries.literal: "Erina made her way to where she'd been sitting, but there was only so much I could ignore."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the hell did you just do? "What time is it"? You might as well have said "I just used the Sekimeiya, how far back did I go?" right to my face.
entries.literal: "What the hell did you just do? \"What time is it\"? You might as well have said \"I just used the Sekimeiya, how far back did I go?\" right to my face."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She'd come from hallway B, so that was where I went. Shiroya and Erina followed me without saying anything.
entries.literal: "She'd come from hallway B, so that was where I went. Shiroya and Erina followed me without saying anything."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...And the Sekimeiya's not here. You didn't even put it back?
entries.literal: "...And the Sekimeiya's not here. You didn't even put it back?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You're wrong... I didn't do this.
entries.literal: "You're wrong... I didn't do this."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why did you ask for the time, then?
entries.literal: "Why did you ask for the time, then?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: To know how much time was left.
entries.literal: "To know how much time was left."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Of course.
entries.literal: "Of course."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm telling the truth. I went to search for Sai, but I couldn't find him. I only meant to ask how much time I'd been gone.
entries.literal: "I'm telling the truth. I went to search for Sai, but I couldn't find him. I only meant to ask how much time I'd been gone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed the glass.{w} Erina had been gone for about five minutes. If she had actually traveled, a version of her that was still to touch the Sekimeiya existed somewhere.
entries.literal: "I closed the glass.{w} Erina had been gone for about five minutes. If she had actually traveled, a version of her that was still to touch the Sekimeiya existed somewhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Was everyone just a liar? She could've traveled, but Sai could've also easily hidden it himself. I hadn't locked the cabinet, so I didn't know what had happened.
entries.literal: "...Was everyone just a liar? She could've traveled, but Sai could've also easily hidden it himself. I hadn't locked the cabinet, so I didn't know what had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt disconcerted, frustrated, and even wary of Shiroya, who might've been hiding something from me.
entries.literal: "I felt disconcerted, frustrated, and even wary of Shiroya, who might've been hiding something from me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I noticed the brief instant in which Erina's expression showed surprise. She was still in hallway B, staring at her left.
entries.literal: "I noticed the brief instant in which Erina's expression showed surprise. She was still in hallway B, staring at her left."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you see something?
entries.literal: "Did you see something?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to her, but I found nothing that stood out in the hallway.
entries.literal: "I walked up to her, but I found nothing that stood out in the hallway."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I didn't see anything.
entries.literal: "I didn't see anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was getting mad. I wanted to get out with Shiroya more than anything, so what was with her continued silence?
entries.literal: "I was getting mad. I wanted to get out with Shiroya more than anything, so what was with her continued silence?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do we just ignore this, then? Do we think the police can understand even a shred of what happened here?
entries.literal: "Do we just ignore this, then? Do we think the police can understand even a shred of what happened here?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Or do we use these last minutes to find Sai and the Sekimeiya? If he took it, he must have something in mind, and as much as I want to get out, I'm not fond of letting him do as he pleases.
entries.literal: "Or do we use these last minutes to find Sai and the Sekimeiya? If he took it, he must have something in mind, and as much as I want to get out, I'm not fond of letting him do as he pleases."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Y-Yes... Maybe we should search for him.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes... Maybe we should search for him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Search complete. You all did an amazing job this time.
entries.literal: "Search complete. You all did an amazing job this time."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Ah!
entries.literal: "Ah!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's face peeked in from hallway B, the lobby side.
entries.literal: "Sai's face peeked in from hallway B, the lobby side."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did I hear that the Sekimeiya's gone? We should've counted every time it happened since the start. What's this, the twelfth?
entries.literal: "Did I hear that the Sekimeiya's gone? We should've counted every time it happened since the start. What's this, the twelfth?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And none of them were your doing, right?
entries.literal: "And none of them were your doing, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not a single one. Of course, none of you did it this time either, right?
entries.literal: "Not a single one. Of course, none of you did it this time either, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This sneaky Sekimeiya must keep teleporting away, making us doubt each other when, in reality, none of us would do something so dishonest as lying or taking it ourselves.
entries.literal: "This sneaky Sekimeiya must keep teleporting away, making us doubt each other when, in reality, none of us would do something so dishonest as lying or taking it ourselves."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And you never chased us with a knife, right?
entries.literal: "And you never chased us with a knife, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did that happen? It's {time=20:51.} Let's go to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Did that happen? It's {time=20:51.} Let's go to the lobby."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm being serious. You did try to kill me, and I still don't even know why.
entries.literal: "I'm being serious. You did try to kill me, and I still don't even know why."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, are you stupid? How would I get a knife? There's no place to hide one, right?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, are you stupid? How would I get a knife? There's no place to hide one, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That Sai was not the same one I'd punched. I clenched my fist, ready to do it for the first time again.
entries.literal: "That Sai was not the same one I'd punched. I clenched my fist, ready to do it for the first time again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure you didn't imagine it? I'm not stupid enough to kill someone, and there's no knife I could've used.
entries.literal: "Are you sure you didn't imagine it? I'm not stupid enough to kill someone, and there's no knife I could've used."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at Shiroya's purse and gestured at her to open it.
entries.literal: "I glanced at Shiroya's purse and gestured at her to open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She unzipped it and showed me its contents.
entries.literal: "She unzipped it and showed me its contents."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Where is it?
entries.literal: "...{w}Where is it?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I don't know.
entries.literal: "...I don't know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The knife wasn't there. She had traveled again, which might have gotten rid of it.
entries.literal: "The knife wasn't there. She had traveled again, which might have gotten rid of it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sure the police will do a great job at figuring out what happened. Now, let's wait in the lobby.
entries.literal: "I'm sure the police will do a great job at figuring out what happened. Now, let's wait in the lobby."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No.
entries.literal: "No."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to hallway A. Someone had hidden the Sekimeiya one last time, right before the exit would open. I had no idea what purpose that served, but there had to be one.
entries.literal: "I went to hallway A. Someone had hidden the Sekimeiya one last time, right before the exit would open. I had no idea what purpose that served, but there had to be one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to the storeroom. Every time the Sekimeiya was hidden, we were able to find it. The last few minutes we had were enough to do it one more time.
entries.literal: "I walked up to the storeroom. Every time the Sekimeiya was hidden, we were able to find it. The last few minutes we had were enough to do it one more time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You want to spend the remaining time doing this shit again? Go ahead.
entries.literal: "You want to spend the remaining time doing this shit again? Go ahead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I would. Once I felt the storeroom was empty, I moved on to the crystal room A5.
entries.literal: "I would. Once I felt the storeroom was empty, I moved on to the crystal room A5."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd hoped I wouldn't have to see Isla's face again, but there was no helping it.
entries.literal: "I'd hoped I wouldn't have to see Isla's face again, but there was no helping it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept going from room to room, meeting Sai's sneer in between. Behind him were Shiroya and Erina, completely neutral and unhelpful.
entries.literal: "I kept going from room to room, meeting Sai's sneer in between. Behind him were Shiroya and Erina, completely neutral and unhelpful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got to the security room and was assaulted by the stench of death again.
entries.literal: "I got to the security room and was assaulted by the stench of death again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The computer screens were suspended, so I pressed a key to light them up, trying not to step on all the blood. The time displayed was {time=20:55}, which matched Sai's.
entries.literal: "The computer screens were suspended, so I pressed a key to light them up, trying not to step on all the blood. The time displayed was {time=20:55}, which matched Sai's."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Most of the drawers were filled with papers I'd never bothered to read. Something that caught my attention was that one was full of batteries, but they were too packed for the Sekimeiya to be in any of them. I looked inside the suitcase, but it was still empty.
entries.literal: "Most of the drawers were filled with papers I'd never bothered to read. Something that caught my attention was that one was full of batteries, but they were too packed for the Sekimeiya to be in any of them. I looked inside the suitcase, but it was still empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, before I left, I kneeled beside Katei's body. Under the desk was the computer tower. To look behind it, I held my breath and crawled up to it.
entries.literal: "However, before I left, I kneeled beside Katei's body. Under the desk was the computer tower. To look behind it, I held my breath and crawled up to it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There it was. The Sekimeiya glowed white, contrasting the obscured space between the desk and the wall.
entries.literal: "There it was. The Sekimeiya glowed white, contrasting the obscured space between the desk and the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Making sure not to touch it with my skin, I dragged it out. It was scorching, so I had to hold it with the bottom of my shirt to leave the room with it.
entries.literal: "Making sure not to touch it with my skin, I dragged it out. It was scorching, so I had to hold it with the bottom of my shirt to leave the room with it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}You did it. Happy now?
entries.literal: "...{w}You did it. Happy now?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made my way past the three and put it in the cabinet. Without a second thought, I locked it.
entries.literal: "I made my way past the three and put it in the cabinet. Without a second thought, I locked it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Given how hot it had been, Erina had some credibility. If she had just traveled from the future, the Sekimeiya shouldn't have been that hot, and she could no longer travel after our current point—the Sekimeiya would stay locked away until the police came. Knowing her actions could've altered reality, though, it wasn't for certain.
entries.literal: "Given how hot it had been, Erina had some credibility. If she had just traveled from the future, the Sekimeiya shouldn't have been that hot, and she could no longer travel after our current point—the Sekimeiya would stay locked away until the police came. Knowing her actions could've altered reality, though, it wasn't for certain."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know what you hoped to accomplish, but there you go. Now we can wait. Is that a problem for you?
entries.literal: "I don't know what you hoped to accomplish, but there you go. Now we can wait. Is that a problem for you?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not at all. Why would it be?{w} Oh, you still think I hid the Sekimeiya myself. Now you can see you're wrong. Let's go to the lobby, as I've been saying.
entries.literal: "Not at all. Why would it be?{w} Oh, you still think I hid the Sekimeiya myself. Now you can see you're wrong. Let's go to the lobby, as I've been saying."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}All right.
entries.literal: "...{w}All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The four of us left the Sekimeiya behind and entered the lobby. In less than ten minutes, the metal shutter was supposed to open.
entries.literal: "The four of us left the Sekimeiya behind and entered the lobby. In less than ten minutes, the metal shutter was supposed to open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We approached where we'd been sitting and reclaimed our places. Everything had been set up for our departure.
entries.literal: "We approached where we'd been sitting and reclaimed our places. Everything had been set up for our departure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at the three people next to me. Sai looked indifferent, while Erina appeared serious. At my right, I began to think Shiroya was a little tense.
entries.literal: "I glanced at the three people next to me. Sai looked indifferent, while Erina appeared serious. At my right, I began to think Shiroya was a little tense."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...{w}Hm? ...Is anything wrong?
entries.literal: "...{w}Hm? ...Is anything wrong?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know. Are you looking forward to leaving?
entries.literal: "I don't know. Are you looking forward to leaving?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Yes, I can't wait.
entries.literal: "...Yes, I can't wait."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her melancholic tone took me aback, leaving me without a reply.
entries.literal: "Her melancholic tone took me aback, leaving me without a reply."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Three people had died, and Akaro had vanished. Was he somehow still in the tower? It seemed that only four of us were minutes away from feeling the cold air rolling off the mountains.
entries.literal: "Three people had died, and Akaro had vanished. Was he somehow still in the tower? It seemed that only four of us were minutes away from feeling the cold air rolling off the mountains."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya and I first entered the lobby when the night sky was above us, and in a few minutes, we would hopefully see it again. The countdown was leading toward the result of a battle only a few of us were aware of—what we'd been told about the alarm versus the recording we'd heard.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I first entered the lobby when the night sky was above us, and in a few minutes, we would hopefully see it again. The countdown was leading toward the result of a battle only a few of us were aware of—what we'd been told about the alarm versus the recording we'd heard."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In just a few minutes, one would win. It would not take much time for us to become aware of our fate.
entries.literal: "In just a few minutes, one would win. It would not take much time for us to become aware of our fate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was the only remaining person who hadn't heard the recording and fittingly looked the most carefree. Perhaps he'd soon understand that his future was much more grim than expected.
entries.literal: "Sai was the only remaining person who hadn't heard the recording and fittingly looked the most carefree. Perhaps he'd soon understand that his future was much more grim than expected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina had lost her daughter and a fair chunk of her sanity. Understanding her thoughts had, at one point, become an impossible task, and I wasn't sure what she was hoping would happen next.
entries.literal: "Erina had lost her daughter and a fair chunk of her sanity. Understanding her thoughts had, at one point, become an impossible task, and I wasn't sure what she was hoping would happen next."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One thing was certain: during those twelve hours, we hadn't figured anything out. There were too many things left unexplained—things that had eluded me and would most likely continue to do so.
entries.literal: "One thing was certain: during those twelve hours, we hadn't figured anything out. There were too many things left unexplained—things that had eluded me and would most likely continue to do so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Miiya wouldn't come back to life despite the inexplicable mentions of her. People had died for incomprehensible reasons. We'd been granted access to a time travel device and gotten nothing out of it.
entries.literal: "Miiya wouldn't come back to life despite the inexplicable mentions of her. People had died for incomprehensible reasons. We'd been granted access to a time travel device and gotten nothing out of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even just minutes previously, the Sekimeiya had been hidden, and I had no idea why. I could barely grasp most of the day's events and definitely couldn't understand some others at all.
entries.literal: "Even just minutes previously, the Sekimeiya had been hidden, and I had no idea why. I could barely grasp most of the day's events and definitely couldn't understand some others at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The inevitable outcome was right around the corner. The Sekimeiya had been part of murder cases and the smoke attack. It would soon make its way into the world, potentially leading to drastic changes.
entries.literal: "The inevitable outcome was right around the corner. The Sekimeiya had been part of murder cases and the smoke attack. It would soon make its way into the world, potentially leading to drastic changes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why had an object capable of time travel been in Ashiya Tower?
entries.literal: "Why had an object capable of time travel been in Ashiya Tower?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thinking about the time we'd stepped into the building... We'd done that looking to overcome loss. Maybe that part had gone well.
entries.literal: "Thinking about the time we'd stepped into the building... We'd done that looking to overcome loss. Maybe that part had gone well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before that day, Shiroya had barely spoken for a week. Next to me, not much of that taciturn person remained... but I felt I understood her less than before.
entries.literal: "Before that day, Shiroya had barely spoken for a week. Next to me, not much of that taciturn person remained... but I felt I understood her less than before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the past, I had never questioned her. I'd thought we'd known each other perfectly. That very thought was what allowed me to trust her even then, despite the oddness that seemed to emanate from her.
entries.literal: "In the past, I had never questioned her. I'd thought we'd known each other perfectly. That very thought was what allowed me to trust her even then, despite the oddness that seemed to emanate from her."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What's the time?
entries.literal: "What's the time?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{time=21:00.} Only these last five minutes are left.
entries.literal: "...{time=21:00.} Only these last five minutes are left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No sound was coming through the shutter, but many people were surely on the other side of it. Police, Ashiya, and even townspeople. As soon as they saw Erina's bloody clothes, they would begin to understand what we had gone through.
entries.literal: "No sound was coming through the shutter, but many people were surely on the other side of it. Police, Ashiya, and even townspeople. As soon as they saw Erina's bloody clothes, they would begin to understand what we had gone through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd probably be interrogated. We would become murder suspects, but we'd also see the streets of Yushibana again. After that, we'd be released, and Shiroya and I could go back home.
entries.literal: "We'd probably be interrogated. We would become murder suspects, but we'd also see the streets of Yushibana again. After that, we'd be released, and Shiroya and I could go back home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to expect in that regard. I'd never thought about it, but perhaps some people knew about the existence of the Sekimeiya, and once we showed our knowledge of it, we'd become a threat...
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to expect in that regard. I'd never thought about it, but perhaps some people knew about the existence of the Sekimeiya, and once we showed our knowledge of it, we'd become a threat..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Or would the police not believe a word we said? It wasn't clear yet whether the cameras had been working. If someone's plan to steal the Sekimeiya was about to succeed, the outside world could end up never believing our story.
entries.literal: "Or would the police not believe a word we said? It wasn't clear yet whether the cameras had been working. If someone's plan to steal the Sekimeiya was about to succeed, the outside world could end up never believing our story."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd all been staring at the floor or our laps—a sign of our exhaustion and need to get out. I felt I heard a sound, so I abruptly looked up.
entries.literal: "We'd all been staring at the floor or our laps—a sign of our exhaustion and need to get out. I felt I heard a sound, so I abruptly looked up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nothing.
entries.literal: "There was nothing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}What?{w} Where's Erina?
entries.literal: "...{w}What?{w} Where's Erina?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's a great question. Did she go somewhere?
entries.literal: "That's a great question. Did she go somewhere?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hallway doors were closed, and it seemed unlikely she could've left through one of them.
entries.literal: "The hallway doors were closed, and it seemed unlikely she could've left through one of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, at our right was the mechanical room. She'd been the closest to it, and it was possible she'd silently made her way inside. I couldn't imagine why she would, and I glanced around the room to be sure she really wasn't with us.
entries.literal: "However, at our right was the mechanical room. She'd been the closest to it, and it was possible she'd silently made her way inside. I couldn't imagine why she would, and I glanced around the room to be sure she really wasn't with us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You two didn't hear anything, right?
entries.literal: "You two didn't hear anything, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I didn't.
entries.literal: "...I didn't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked into Shiroya's eyes, but she didn't do the same. Instead, she had the same nervous look from earlier.
entries.literal: "I looked into Shiroya's eyes, but she didn't do the same. Instead, she had the same nervous look from earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, she stood up.
entries.literal: "Then, she stood up."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it.{w} Now stay here, and don't follow me.
entries.literal: "Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it.{w} Now stay here, and don't follow me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh—
entries.literal: "Wh—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could finish, she took off.
entries.literal: "Before I could finish, she took off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She ran to hallway B and disappeared through it.
entries.literal: "She ran to hallway B and disappeared through it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart jumped, but I couldn't move.
entries.literal: "My heart jumped, but I couldn't move."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My suspicion had been confirmed in the easiest way. That wasn't the Shiroya I knew.
entries.literal: "My suspicion had been confirmed in the easiest way. That wasn't the Shiroya I knew."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A flash came to me. Just earlier, I had looked at her purse.
entries.literal: "A flash came to me. Just earlier, I had looked at her purse."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The knife wasn't there...{w} That's fine. That doesn't mean anything.
entries.literal: "The knife wasn't there...{w} That's fine. That doesn't mean anything."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But... what else should have been in her purse?
entries.literal: "But... what else should have been in her purse?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Her wallet, my keys, our identification, and the two tickets for today's event.
entries.literal: "Her wallet, my keys, our identification, and the two tickets for today's event."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Right... I didn't realize it. At least two of those things were missing.
entries.literal: "Right... I didn't realize it. At least two of those things were missing."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: My keys weren't there, and neither were our tickets... However, there were keys. Did I recognize them...?
entries.literal: "My keys weren't there, and neither were our tickets... However, there were keys. Did I recognize them...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned my head to face Sai. Like me, he looked dumbfounded and remained immobilized by Shiroya's words.
entries.literal: "I turned my head to face Sai. Like me, he looked dumbfounded and remained immobilized by Shiroya's words."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The lights suddenly went out. Sai's face disappeared from sight as everything became dark.
entries.literal: "The lights suddenly went out. Sai's face disappeared from sight as everything became dark."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: S-Sai...?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes?
entries.literal: "Yes?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was still there. We stood up, letting out heavy breaths.
entries.literal: "He was still there. We stood up, letting out heavy breaths."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck happened...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck happened...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're asking the wrong person.
entries.literal: "You're asking the wrong person."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}What time is it?
entries.literal: "...{w}What time is it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His watch gave off a faint blue light.
entries.literal: "His watch gave off a faint blue light."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Only two minutes left...? Why did the lights go off?
entries.literal: "Only two minutes left...? Why did the lights go off?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you not notice that?
entries.literal: "Did you not notice that?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Notice what?
entries.literal: "Notice what?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: A-Ah!
entries.literal: "A-Ah!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina's voice came from the right, sounding desperate and in pain.
entries.literal: "Erina's voice came from the right, sounding desperate and in pain."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hey! What's going on? I-I think my finger is bleeding! Wh-Why are the lights off!?
entries.literal: "Hey! What's going on? I-I think my finger is bleeding! Wh-Why are the lights off!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Where were you!?
entries.literal: "Where were you!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm serious! Did you not see a flashing light?
entries.literal: "I'm serious! Did you not see a flashing light?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes! I saw it too. For an instant, I saw a flashing light! I don't know what it was!
entries.literal: "Yes! I saw it too. For an instant, I saw a flashing light! I don't know what it was!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me too... After that, the lights went off.
entries.literal: "Me too... After that, the lights went off."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What the fuck are you two talking about? I didn't see that.
entries.literal: "What the fuck are you two talking about? I didn't see that."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: A-And then my finger started hurting! It's seriously bleeding! What h-happened!?
entries.literal: "A-And then my finger started hurting! It's seriously bleeding! What h-happened!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No idea... but before the lights went off, Shiroya suddenly ran to hallway B.
entries.literal: "No idea... but before the lights went off, Shiroya suddenly ran to hallway B."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh? Then... did she do this!?
entries.literal: "Huh? Then... did she do this!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How would she!? And why the hell did you just leave!?
entries.literal: "How would she!? And why the hell did you just leave!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My eyes had begun to adapt to the darkness, and thanks to a faint light coming from the reception desk, I could see the closest wall.
entries.literal: "My eyes had begun to adapt to the darkness, and thanks to a faint light coming from the reception desk, I could see the closest wall."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wait... Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Wait... Atsuki."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Why's the shutter still there, then?
entries.literal: "Why's the shutter still there, then?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It could be about to open. We don't know exactly the time the alarm went off. Maybe it was at {time=9:06.}
entries.literal: "It could be about to open. We don't know exactly the time the alarm went off. Maybe it was at {time=9:06.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stared at it. It could open at any second.
entries.literal: "We stared at it. It could open at any second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Lost in the darkness, we stood, hoping our rescue was seconds away.
entries.literal: "Lost in the darkness, we stood, hoping our rescue was seconds away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could very faintly see the metal surface of the shutter. It was still there, looking like the same imposing blockade it always had.
entries.literal: "I could very faintly see the metal surface of the shutter. It was still there, looking like the same imposing blockade it always had."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No way...
entries.literal: "No way..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm pretty sure it should've opened already. It's been more than twelve hours.
entries.literal: "I'm pretty sure it should've opened already. It's been more than twelve hours."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I-I knew it.
entries.literal: "...I-I knew it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What did you know?
entries.literal: "What did you know?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Answer me!
entries.literal: "Answer me!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina kept silent, but we could hear her breathing.{w} Letting our hearts hammer our chests, we kept facing the sealed entrance, our promised freedom slipping away.
entries.literal: "Erina kept silent, but we could hear her breathing.{w} Letting our hearts hammer our chests, we kept facing the sealed entrance, our promised freedom slipping away."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: {time=21:08.} What the fuck? Why is it still closed!?
entries.literal: "{time=21:08.} What the fuck? Why is it still closed!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There it was. We had a winner.
entries.literal: "There it was. We had a winner."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was the recording's prediction. The tower wasn't going to open then, and it wouldn't for a very long time.
entries.literal: "That was the recording's prediction. The tower wasn't going to open then, and it wouldn't for a very long time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How could it have happened? Why would the outside abandon us?
entries.literal: "How could it have happened? Why would the outside abandon us?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is Shiroya's fault! She knew something would happen!
entries.literal: "This is Shiroya's fault! She knew something would happen!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I found the open door to hallway B and went through it. It was completely dark, but a breeze lured me to the event room.
entries.literal: "I found the open door to hallway B and went through it. It was completely dark, but a breeze lured me to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room was cold. Had Shiroya run to get the Sekimeiya? I carefully walked to the cabinet, moved aside the curtain, and tried to open the glass.
entries.literal: "The room was cold. Had Shiroya run to get the Sekimeiya? I carefully walked to the cabinet, moved aside the curtain, and tried to open the glass."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It should've been locked, but it wasn't. The glass was partially open, and I could put my hand inside.
entries.literal: "It should've been locked, but it wasn't. The glass was partially open, and I could put my hand inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt the Sekimeiya's surface and confirmed it was still there. However, something had definitely been done to the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I felt the Sekimeiya's surface and confirmed it was still there. However, something had definitely been done to the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki! Are you here? Why is it so cold?
entries.literal: "Atsuki! Are you here? Why is it so cold?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I am! Shiroya! Where did you go!?
entries.literal: "I am! Shiroya! Where did you go!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There are no light switches anywhere, right?
entries.literal: "There are no light switches anywhere, right?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Is it a power outage...?
entries.literal: "Is it a power outage...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It couldn't be. The temperature function of the cabinet was still working.
entries.literal: "It couldn't be. The temperature function of the cabinet was still working."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The security room... The doors hadn't opened, but other functions might have come back, such as the internet connection.
entries.literal: "The security room... The doors hadn't opened, but other functions might have come back, such as the internet connection."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dashed to the hallway and slammed my body into the door of the security room.
entries.literal: "I dashed to the hallway and slammed my body into the door of the security room."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...!?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued trying to push it open, but it wouldn't budge.
entries.literal: "I continued trying to push it open, but it wouldn't budge."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't tell me... Is the security room locked?
entries.literal: "Don't tell me... Is the security room locked?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I-It is.
entries.literal: "I-It is."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Can't we unlock it?
entries.literal: "Can't we unlock it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Katei had the key, but his body is inside.
entries.literal: "Katei had the key, but his body is inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's {time=21:10}! There's no way the time is wrong...! Why is this still going?
entries.literal: "It's {time=21:10}! There's no way the time is wrong...! Why is this still going?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai, who'd been ignorant of the recording since the start, hadn't foreseen such an outcome. I used the last amount of strength I had to pathetically walk back to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Sai, who'd been ignorant of the recording since the start, hadn't foreseen such an outcome. I used the last amount of strength I had to pathetically walk back to the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The metal shutter was still there, proving something other than time would be needed to get rid of it.
entries.literal: "The metal shutter was still there, proving something other than time would be needed to get rid of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My body crumpled down; I couldn't keep going.
entries.literal: "My body crumpled down; I couldn't keep going."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A month? What kind of joke was that? I couldn't bear one more second.
entries.literal: "A month? What kind of joke was that? I couldn't bear one more second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya's words played back in my head. "Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it."
entries.literal: "Shiroya's words played back in my head. \"Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I laughed, alone. I didn't know where I was, what anything had become... none of it. Nothing we'd done had any meaning. We'd made it to the end of that impossibly long day for nothing.
entries.literal: "I laughed, alone. I didn't know where I was, what anything had become... none of it. Nothing we'd done had any meaning. We'd made it to the end of that impossibly long day for nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The words Shiroya had abandoned me with... Were they supposed to be reassuring?
entries.literal: "The words Shiroya had abandoned me with... Were they supposed to be reassuring?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to continue yelling her name, but my voice broke. She'd known what would happen and hadn't warned us. She'd kept waiting at our side, bolstering our hope, until she'd run away.
entries.literal: "I tried to continue yelling her name, but my voice broke. She'd known what would happen and hadn't warned us. She'd kept waiting at our side, bolstering our hope, until she'd run away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why...!? She would never have done that... I couldn't let a single day change my view of her.
entries.literal: "Why...!? She would never have done that... I couldn't let a single day change my view of her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I couldn't help but despair. I wanted to leave. I wanted to be hit by the icy air and feel released. I wanted to talk to more people, even if they were the police.
entries.literal: "But I couldn't help but despair. I wanted to leave. I wanted to be hit by the icy air and feel released. I wanted to talk to more people, even if they were the police."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And it wouldn't happen. Could we survive an entire month? Of course not...! Shiroya hadn't been mentioned in the recording, so would I not see her for weeks?
entries.literal: "And it wouldn't happen. Could we survive an entire month? Of course not...! Shiroya hadn't been mentioned in the recording, so would I not see her for weeks?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would the nightmare persist in the Sekimeiya's domain? It was too horrible of a thought to bear. People had died, and I still didn't know who, how, why...
entries.literal: "Would the nightmare persist in the Sekimeiya's domain? It was too horrible of a thought to bear. People had died, and I still didn't know who, how, why..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The lights had gone out, so I followed their example. I closed my eyes, intensifying the darkness, before I felt once again how insignificant I was.
entries.literal: "The lights had gone out, so I followed their example. I closed my eyes, intensifying the darkness, before I felt once again how insignificant I was."

entries.text: Chapter 1 Credits
entries.literal: "Chapter 1 Credits"

entries.text: As they feared, their time in Ashiya Tower wouldn't end yet.
entries.literal: "As they feared, their time in Ashiya Tower wouldn't end yet."

entries.text: The warning they'd received hadn't been enough to prepare them.
entries.literal: "The warning they'd received hadn't been enough to prepare them."

entries.text: And their uncertain future threatened to be cruel.
entries.literal: "And their uncertain future threatened to be cruel."

entries.text: Since the mysteries had begun to stack up, they knew they couldn't withstand them.
entries.literal: "Since the mysteries had begun to stack up, they knew they couldn't withstand them."

entries.text: Many details that sheltered the truth had been left ungrasped.
entries.literal: "Many details that sheltered the truth had been left ungrasped."

entries.text: And they were ignorant to one important fact...
entries.literal: "And they were ignorant to one important fact..."

entries.text: Their lives had just been saved.
entries.literal: "Their lives had just been saved."

entries.text: Nobody could imagine why the Sekimeiya had been exposed to them.
entries.literal: "Nobody could imagine why the Sekimeiya had been exposed to them."

entries.text: Nobody could imagine the beautiful labyrinth they were creating.
entries.literal: "Nobody could imagine the beautiful labyrinth they were creating."

entries.text: A transparent labyrinth that engulfed its own creators.
entries.literal: "A transparent labyrinth that engulfed its own creators."

entries.text: A labyrinth that didn't hide truth anywhere.
entries.literal: "A labyrinth that didn't hide truth anywhere."

entries.text: And whose walls could be broken.
entries.literal: "And whose walls could be broken."

entries.text: Every riddle, no matter how small, was accompanied by an answer.
entries.literal: "Every riddle, no matter how small, was accompanied by an answer."

entries.text: However, some of those answers weren't held by anyone.
entries.literal: "However, some of those answers weren't held by anyone."

entries.text: Not by anyone inside the tower, that is.
entries.literal: "Not by anyone inside the tower, that is."

entries.text: ...What about you?
entries.literal: "...What about you?"

entries.text: Inevitably, every riddle will be unfolded.
entries.literal: "Inevitably, every riddle will be unfolded."

entries.text: Every detail will strengthen.
entries.literal: "Every detail will strengthen."

entries.text: And meaning will arise.
entries.literal: "And meaning will arise."

entries.text: When the time comes, I wish you will be prepared.
entries.literal: "When the time comes, I wish you will be prepared."

entries.text: The peak was within reach, but it felt unattainable.
entries.literal: "The peak was within reach, but it felt unattainable."

entries.text: Was the reason the path taken?
entries.literal: "Was the reason the path taken?"

entries.text: To climb to the top, others were essential.
entries.literal: "To climb to the top, others were essential."

entries.text: Only then will the puzzle be laid out and every spot contain its proper piece.
entries.literal: "Only then will the puzzle be laid out and every spot contain its proper piece."

entries.text: Inside the dark tower, there was only one thing that could be taken for granted...
entries.literal: "Inside the dark tower, there was only one thing that could be taken for granted..."

entries.text: The path to comprehension extended far past the one to freedom.
entries.literal: "The path to comprehension extended far past the one to freedom."

entries.text: Lone Thread
entries.literal: "Lone Thread"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Amidst the vast internet was a specific forum thread.
entries.literal: "Amidst the vast internet was a specific forum thread."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The date showed it had been written in the afternoon of November 24th, 2011. It contained two paragraphs.
entries.literal: "The date showed it had been written in the afternoon of November 24th, 2011. It contained two paragraphs."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: I swear this is all the truth, I'm not messing around. I'm a bit scared, though, and I'm not sure what to do.
entries.literal: "I swear this is all the truth, I'm not messing around. I'm a bit scared, though, and I'm not sure what to do."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: I think I just woke up from a really strange dream. It felt hyperrealistic, and I'm still shaking...
entries.literal: "I think I just woke up from a really strange dream. It felt hyperrealistic, and I'm still shaking..."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: I don't know if it means anything. Maybe it was a premonition, I'm not sure. However, I'd be careful on the 15th of next month.
entries.literal: "I don't know if it means anything. Maybe it was a premonition, I'm not sure. However, I'd be careful on the 15th of next month."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: If I don't say this anonymously, I'll be laughed at, or even fired... On the 15th, Ashiya will hold a big event in the tower, and there'll be a terrorist attack.
entries.literal: "If I don't say this anonymously, I'll be laughed at, or even fired... On the 15th, Ashiya will hold a big event in the tower, and there'll be a terrorist attack."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: It will be called... the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It will be called... the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: Soon, maybe they will announce it. I don't think I'm a prophet or anything, but I'm still trying to calm down. This time, it felt too real to let it pass.
entries.literal: "Soon, maybe they will announce it. I don't think I'm a prophet or anything, but I'm still trying to calm down. This time, it felt too real to let it pass."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: That's what I dreamed. It's so bizarre I still think it might've really happened. That's why I feel the need to post it, in case it actually means something.
entries.literal: "That's what I dreamed. It's so bizarre I still think it might've really happened. That's why I feel the need to post it, in case it actually means something."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: Do not go to that event if it happens. Some people even got trapped inside, but I don't know what happened to them.
entries.literal: "Do not go to that event if it happens. Some people even got trapped inside, but I don't know what happened to them."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: I think something might be wrong with me... I don't know why, but I'm not home. I can hardly believe it's still the 24th, and I don't know what I'm doing at my parents' house.
entries.literal: "I think something might be wrong with me... I don't know why, but I'm not home. I can hardly believe it's still the 24th, and I don't know what I'm doing at my parents' house."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: Sorry to rant about this, but I need to let it out somewhere. I've been suffering from a few mental issues, but nothing has been as bad as this. I've been living alone for two years while my condition has gotten worse and worse. I feel I can't continue on my own, and letting people around me know it might be a horrible idea.
entries.literal: "Sorry to rant about this, but I need to let it out somewhere. I've been suffering from a few mental issues, but nothing has been as bad as this. I've been living alone for two years while my condition has gotten worse and worse. I feel I can't continue on my own, and letting people around me know it might be a horrible idea."

entries.speaker: c4
entries.text: Anyway, maybe some of you will have some advice. I know posting here isn't the most effective thing, but it's very hard for me to talk about this out loud. Thank you for reading.
entries.literal: "Anyway, maybe some of you will have some advice. I know posting here isn't the most effective thing, but it's very hard for me to talk about this out loud. Thank you for reading."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The thread gathered very few views and only a handful of replies. It had been posted on a nearly desolate subcategory dedicated to Yushibana events.
entries.literal: "The thread gathered very few views and only a handful of replies. It had been posted on a nearly desolate subcategory dedicated to Yushibana events."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two days later came the last reply before the thread was locked. The foolish warning wasn't enough to prevent the incident, foreseen three weeks prior.
entries.literal: "Two days later came the last reply before the thread was locked. The foolish warning wasn't enough to prevent the incident, foreseen three weeks prior."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When November came to an end, the thread had gathered 33 views. However, just one month later, it had grown to the thousands.
entries.literal: "When November came to an end, the thread had gathered 33 views. However, just one month later, it had grown to the thousands."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The identity behind the poster was never released, but some figured it out.
entries.literal: "The identity behind the poster was never released, but some figured it out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And the account wasn't used again, leaving many people wondering by themselves what had happened during the days leading to the 15th and on the fated, final one.
entries.literal: "And the account wasn't used again, leaving many people wondering by themselves what had happened during the days leading to the 15th and on the fated, final one."

entries.text: Crystallized
entries.literal: "Crystallized"

entries.speaker: c
