entries.text: Maxi was startled as Atsuki and Shiroya looked at each other. The sound they'd just heard brought with it a semblance of normalcy that they'd craved.
entries.literal: "Maxi was startled as Atsuki and Shiroya looked at each other. The sound they'd just heard brought with it a semblance of normalcy that they'd craved."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Standing up from the sofa, Atsuki walked up to the front door of his house and did what he'd been waiting for all day.
entries.literal: "Standing up from the sofa, Atsuki walked up to the front door of his house and did what he'd been waiting for all day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Upon turning the handle and opening the door, he saw a figure he'd not seen in a long time. The same person he'd always known—he'd almost expected her to be uncomfortable or look out of sorts. Instead, he realized that he was the one who appeared that way.
entries.literal: "Upon turning the handle and opening the door, he saw a figure he'd not seen in a long time. The same person he'd always known—he'd almost expected her to be uncomfortable or look out of sorts. Instead, he realized that he was the one who appeared that way."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Hey."{w=0.5} After a long few seconds, Miiya put on a smile and made her way in.
entries.literal: "\"Hey.\"{w=0.5} After a long few seconds, Miiya put on a smile and made her way in."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There, she saw Shiroya walking toward the door, nearly in disbelief at seeing her after so long.
entries.literal: "There, she saw Shiroya walking toward the door, nearly in disbelief at seeing her after so long."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Miiya...! I'm glad to see you. It's been a while.
entries.literal: "Miiya...! I'm glad to see you. It's been a while."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Me too.
entries.literal: "Me too."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She glanced at her surroundings, remembering the many times she'd been there in the past. On the floor, after recognizing Miiya, Maxi looked happy to see her too.
entries.literal: "She glanced at her surroundings, remembering the many times she'd been there in the past. On the floor, after recognizing Miiya, Maxi looked happy to see her too."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: It really has been a while since we got together like this, yeah.
entries.literal: "It really has been a while since we got together like this, yeah."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.literal: "...Yeah."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...It feels like it's been way longer. It's so strange to see other people here.
entries.literal: "...It feels like it's been way longer. It's so strange to see other people here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya bent down and scratched behind Maxi's ear, an action she'd picked up from Atsuki. Both he and Shiroya watched her wordlessly, unsure what they could say.
entries.literal: "Miiya bent down and scratched behind Maxi's ear, an action she'd picked up from Atsuki. Both he and Shiroya watched her wordlessly, unsure what they could say."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Well, what have you two been up to?
entries.literal: "Well, what have you two been up to?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Um... Not much, honestly. I haven't really talked to anyone from school in a while.
entries.literal: "Um... Not much, honestly. I haven't really talked to anyone from school in a while."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: It's the same for me. No one's been around.
entries.literal: "It's the same for me. No one's been around."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya could easily recognize that they were both acting awkwardly, and the last thing she wanted after reaching out to Atsuki was for him to distance himself again.
entries.literal: "Miiya could easily recognize that they were both acting awkwardly, and the last thing she wanted after reaching out to Atsuki was for him to distance himself again."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Shame there aren't any good movies to go see. We could catch up that way.
entries.literal: "Shame there aren't any good movies to go see. We could catch up that way."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Ah, well, it's not like the theater here's that great anyway. I regret going every time.
entries.literal: "Ah, well, it's not like the theater here's that great anyway. I regret going every time."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Planning on moving to the big city so you can go to fancy theaters? I bet you want central heating too.
entries.literal: "Planning on moving to the big city so you can go to fancy theaters? I bet you want central heating too."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...I don't know. I'd rather not think about that, you know? It's not like living here is all bad or anything, but sometimes you just want... more.
entries.literal: "...I don't know. I'd rather not think about that, you know? It's not like living here is all bad or anything, but sometimes you just want... more."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Oh, us bumpkins aren't good enough? I see how it is. I feel you, though. The last time I watched a movie there was almost a year ago, and it was horrible. A better catalog would be great.
entries.literal: "Oh, us bumpkins aren't good enough? I see how it is. I feel you, though. The last time I watched a movie there was almost a year ago, and it was horrible. A better catalog would be great."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Wait, is that the one you recommended to us? The one you said not to look up or read the premise of? We never ended up going, but I still had it on my mind.
entries.literal: "Wait, is that the one you recommended to us? The one you said not to look up or read the premise of? We never ended up going, but I still had it on my mind."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Oh, did I? Very possible. It was one of a kind. I wouldn't even mind watching it again with you two, but I'll be shocked if it hasn't been discontinued.
entries.literal: "Oh, did I? Very possible. It was one of a kind. I wouldn't even mind watching it again with you two, but I'll be shocked if it hasn't been discontinued."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Hey, isn't it pretty cold in here? I'm pretty used to it outside, but I can never relax indoors if the temperature isn't just right.
entries.literal: "Hey, isn't it pretty cold in here? I'm pretty used to it outside, but I can never relax indoors if the temperature isn't just right."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Yeah, sorry. I've gotten into the habit of turning the heat on and then back off once it gets warm again.
entries.literal: "Yeah, sorry. I've gotten into the habit of turning the heat on and then back off once it gets warm again."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Maybe we can win the lottery and spring for a house with a sauna. If more than one of us enters, it's a sure thing.
entries.literal: "Maybe we can win the lottery and spring for a house with a sauna. If more than one of us enters, it's a sure thing."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: I wish.
entries.literal: "I wish."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Oh, you do? I didn't figure you were the polygamous type.
entries.literal: "Oh, you do? I didn't figure you were the polygamous type."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: What!?
entries.literal: "What!?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: She didn't mean it like that.
entries.literal: "She didn't mean it like that."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Lighten up! Both of you are so stiff.
entries.literal: "Lighten up! Both of you are so stiff."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: S-Sorry. It's just been a while. I'm not used to being around people.
entries.literal: "S-Sorry. It's just been a while. I'm not used to being around people."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I actually passed by the lottery office just now and thought about giving it a shot, but I didn't want to be late. I was also really eager to see Maxi and Umi, you know? I've been thinking of getting a few cats, and I see that Umi's been eyeing me from under that couch, so maybe she wants to come with me. God, she's so cute.
entries.literal: "I actually passed by the lottery office just now and thought about giving it a shot, but I didn't want to be late. I was also really eager to see Maxi and Umi, you know? I've been thinking of getting a few cats, and I see that Umi's been eyeing me from under that couch, so maybe she wants to come with me. God, she's so cute."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: I don't think so.
entries.literal: "I don't think so."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I figured I'd just have to bribe my parents, but they've been more stubborn than usual. Apparently, both of them are a bit allergic, but they won't even let me just have them in my room. I've been trying to get a job, but I haven't had much luck yet.
entries.literal: "I figured I'd just have to bribe my parents, but they've been more stubborn than usual. Apparently, both of them are a bit allergic, but they won't even let me just have them in my room. I've been trying to get a job, but I haven't had much luck yet."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Where have you been looking anyway?
entries.literal: "Where have you been looking anyway?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Well...
entries.literal: "Well..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They had many things to talk about, and Miiya's willingness to break the ice was much appreciated. Atsuki and Shiroya both viewed her as the missing link in their lives that had finally been restored.
entries.literal: "They had many things to talk about, and Miiya's willingness to break the ice was much appreciated. Atsuki and Shiroya both viewed her as the missing link in their lives that had finally been restored."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hours went by thanks to all the things they wanted to let out. Their future decisions, what their past months had been like, and many more thoughts they'd been keeping to themselves.
entries.literal: "Hours went by thanks to all the things they wanted to let out. Their future decisions, what their past months had been like, and many more thoughts they'd been keeping to themselves."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For Atsuki, talking about it was hard. He wanted to ignore some problems for a while instead of acknowledging them; deep down, however, he knew he couldn't do that forever. Miiya had given him an excuse to approach it.
entries.literal: "For Atsuki, talking about it was hard. He wanted to ignore some problems for a while instead of acknowledging them; deep down, however, he knew he couldn't do that forever. Miiya had given him an excuse to approach it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But as time went on, they realized they'd soon not have much to talk about or do together, and the mood began to sour. They weren't at school anymore, so talking about what their days had been like wasn't the same.
entries.literal: "But as time went on, they realized they'd soon not have much to talk about or do together, and the mood began to sour. They weren't at school anymore, so talking about what their days had been like wasn't the same."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Oh, I found this on the way here.
entries.literal: "Oh, I found this on the way here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya lifted their heads. Miiya was holding a gray flyer with wet stains from where the snow had fallen on it.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Shiroya lifted their heads. Miiya was holding a gray flyer with wet stains from where the snow had fallen on it."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: It says November 29th, so it was put up today. I found it on a streetlight close to here and thought it sounded interesting.
entries.literal: "It says November 29th, so it was put up today. I found it on a streetlight close to here and thought it sounded interesting."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Isn't that the Ashiya logo?
entries.literal: "Isn't that the Ashiya logo?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Oh, yeah. I know you two don't like them very much, but read what it says.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah. I know you two don't like them very much, but read what it says."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Intrigued, Shiroya took the paper from her and read it out loud.
entries.literal: "Intrigued, Shiroya took the paper from her and read it out loud."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: The Sekimeiya? ...On the third Thursday of next month, we will hold the largest event we have ever had the pleasure to put together in Ashiya Tower.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya? ...On the third Thursday of next month, we will hold the largest event we have ever had the pleasure to put together in Ashiya Tower."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Make sure not to miss it, as we will show the rarest gemstone to have been found in recent years. Like every Thursday, the special visit will start at {time=9.}
entries.literal: "Make sure not to miss it, as we will show the rarest gemstone to have been found in recent years. Like every Thursday, the special visit will start at {time=9.}"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I thought that we could go before your birthdays.
entries.literal: "I thought that we could go before your birthdays."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When they looked at each other, Atsuki and Shiroya knew they couldn't refuse. They'd never entered Ashiya Tower, and their families usually would've prevented them, but neither of them were personally against going once while their parents were overseas. Both of them also agreed that what they'd read sounded intriguing.
entries.literal: "When they looked at each other, Atsuki and Shiroya knew they couldn't refuse. They'd never entered Ashiya Tower, and their families usually would've prevented them, but neither of them were personally against going once while their parents were overseas. Both of them also agreed that what they'd read sounded intriguing."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Look, it says that if we want to attend, we should hurry up and buy the tickets from this website.
entries.literal: "Look, it says that if we want to attend, we should hurry up and buy the tickets from this website."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Knowing what their answer would be, Miiya walked to the computer and input the URL. With Atsuki and Shiroya looking over her shoulders, the three pricey tickets were purchased.
entries.literal: "Knowing what their answer would be, Miiya walked to the computer and input the URL. With Atsuki and Shiroya looking over her shoulders, the three pricey tickets were purchased."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was money neither Shiroya nor Atsuki had intended to spend, but to them, it was worthwhile. The thought of going somewhere together even made them smile.
entries.literal: "It was money neither Shiroya nor Atsuki had intended to spend, but to them, it was worthwhile. The thought of going somewhere together even made them smile."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They bought the tickets using Atsuki's payment details, but they all paid for their own. After that, they printed them.
entries.literal: "They bought the tickets using Atsuki's payment details, but they all paid for their own. After that, they printed them."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: There we go. I'm hoping they're not exaggerating. It said we'll go in groups of three, so we should be able to enter together.
entries.literal: "There we go. I'm hoping they're not exaggerating. It said we'll go in groups of three, so we should be able to enter together."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya felt satisfied and appreciative of Miiya. She folded the papers and put them in a purse she'd long ago left in Atsuki's house, which brought back memories of all the times she'd worn it with them.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Shiroya felt satisfied and appreciative of Miiya. She folded the papers and put them in a purse she'd long ago left in Atsuki's house, which brought back memories of all the times she'd worn it with them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki's heater, once turned on, was comfortable, so they spent the entire time in his house until it felt appropriate to leave.{w} Miiya's parents informed her they'd made dinner for her, and Shiroya took it as her cue as well. After saying their goodbyes, Atsuki saw both girls leaving on different paths.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's heater, once turned on, was comfortable, so they spent the entire time in his house until it felt appropriate to leave.{w} Miiya's parents informed her they'd made dinner for her, and Shiroya took it as her cue as well. After saying their goodbyes, Atsuki saw both girls leaving on different paths."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It hadn't been the most fun day they could recall, but at least Atsuki felt at peace, as it had been exactly what he'd needed after spending many months by himself.
entries.literal: "It hadn't been the most fun day they could recall, but at least Atsuki felt at peace, as it had been exactly what he'd needed after spending many months by himself."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He went to sleep looking forward to the next day, when they'd agreed to meet again.
entries.literal: "He went to sleep looking forward to the next day, when they'd agreed to meet again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the afternoon, and it had just started snowing. Phone in hand, Atsuki waited at the spot they'd settled on, close to the school they'd recently graduated from. He saw a flyer stuck on the bus stop, titled "The Sekimeiya", identical to the one Miiya had shown him.
entries.literal: "It was the afternoon, and it had just started snowing. Phone in hand, Atsuki waited at the spot they'd settled on, close to the school they'd recently graduated from. He saw a flyer stuck on the bus stop, titled \"The Sekimeiya\", identical to the one Miiya had shown him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He saw Miiya approaching, and she sped up upon seeing him as well. Minutes later, Shiroya came from the same direction, and the three found themselves at a bus stop with a plastic roof, not having decided where to go next.
entries.literal: "He saw Miiya approaching, and she sped up upon seeing him as well. Minutes later, Shiroya came from the same direction, and the three found themselves at a bus stop with a plastic roof, not having decided where to go next."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unfazed by the snow, they walked toward a stone path, reminiscent of the days when they'd left school together.
entries.literal: "Unfazed by the snow, they walked toward a stone path, reminiscent of the days when they'd left school together."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A few younger students could be seen in groups near benches, and some of their faces were recognizable. Like everyone else around them, they sat on one of the benches, their coats protecting them from the icy surface that remained after wiping off the snow.
entries.literal: "A few younger students could be seen in groups near benches, and some of their faces were recognizable. Like everyone else around them, they sat on one of the benches, their coats protecting them from the icy surface that remained after wiping off the snow."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I kind of missed this routine.
entries.literal: "I kind of missed this routine."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: It's definitely something you get used to. I can't believe years start going by so quickly.
entries.literal: "It's definitely something you get used to. I can't believe years start going by so quickly."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: On the plus side, we don't have to deal with anything involving physics anymore. What a drag of a class.
entries.literal: "On the plus side, we don't have to deal with anything involving physics anymore. What a drag of a class."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Please don't remind me. I can't believe how many times Miss Mayuko pulled someone out into the hallway. Why be a teacher if you're going to act like that?
entries.literal: "Please don't remind me. I can't believe how many times Miss Mayuko pulled someone out into the hallway. Why be a teacher if you're going to act like that?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Yeah. You'd think you couldn't get away with that in such a small town. All of the parents should have been up in arms about it.
entries.literal: "Yeah. You'd think you couldn't get away with that in such a small town. All of the parents should have been up in arms about it."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Isn't that normal? I almost expect small towns like this to have murder cults all the adults initiate the kids into.
entries.literal: "Isn't that normal? I almost expect small towns like this to have murder cults all the adults initiate the kids into."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Well, not mine. Unless they're part of a foreign chapter and making arrangements right now.
entries.literal: "Well, not mine. Unless they're part of a foreign chapter and making arrangements right now."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Shiroya's parents and mine would definitely be in it together.
entries.literal: "Shiroya's parents and mine would definitely be in it together."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Actually, they haven't tried to get you to move again, have they?
entries.literal: "Actually, they haven't tried to get you to move again, have they?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Oh.
entries.literal: "Oh."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: It's not constant, but sometimes, yeah. I feel guilty, but... a big part of me wants to be here. I don't like that my mom is being so pushy about it. At least she gets the message if I ignore the call or just outright tell her no, but after a couple of weeks, she'll try again.
entries.literal: "It's not constant, but sometimes, yeah. I feel guilty, but... a big part of me wants to be here. I don't like that my mom is being so pushy about it. At least she gets the message if I ignore the call or just outright tell her no, but after a couple of weeks, she'll try again."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: My parents both keep doing the same thing. Is it too strained for you?
entries.literal: "My parents both keep doing the same thing. Is it too strained for you?"

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: It really is... My birthday's coming up, and she hasn't even mentioned it. I bet the only thing she's going to do for it is ask me to leave again. Like it's a gift for me.
entries.literal: "It really is... My birthday's coming up, and she hasn't even mentioned it. I bet the only thing she's going to do for it is ask me to leave again. Like it's a gift for me."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Sorry. I shouldn't have brought it up.
entries.literal: "Sorry. I shouldn't have brought it up."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: It's fine. I just wish she supported me living the way I want to, you know? It's not like I ever got bad grades or anything when we were in school. I proved I could take care of things.
entries.literal: "It's fine. I just wish she supported me living the way I want to, you know? It's not like I ever got bad grades or anything when we were in school. I proved I could take care of things."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: I'm not so sure. You remember, what was it, five years ago? You couldn't even look at a map and tell me where you were on it.
entries.literal: "I'm not so sure. You remember, what was it, five years ago? You couldn't even look at a map and tell me where you were on it."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: That was different! It had never come up before. You can't hold that against me.
entries.literal: "That was different! It had never come up before. You can't hold that against me."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: And what about that time we had to catalog local animals? You didn't even know where to start looking.
entries.literal: "And what about that time we had to catalog local animals? You didn't even know where to start looking."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Come on, Atsuki...
entries.literal: "Come on, Atsuki..."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: No, no, I want to hear this. Go on.
entries.literal: "No, no, I want to hear this. Go on."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: We were supposed to build a list of animals that lived around here. It was one of those big, year-long projects... Actually, you were here for that, weren't you?
entries.literal: "We were supposed to build a list of animals that lived around here. It was one of those big, year-long projects... Actually, you were here for that, weren't you?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Yeah, but we didn't really know each other back then.
entries.literal: "Yeah, but we didn't really know each other back then."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Well, Shiroya had no clue what to do. We went out to the edge of town and looked for, well, anything. It was still fall then, and we actually stumbled into a bunch of lizards.
entries.literal: "Well, Shiroya had no clue what to do. We went out to the edge of town and looked for, well, anything. It was still fall then, and we actually stumbled into a bunch of lizards."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Ooh, I bet she made her usual shocked face when she sees anything that moves.
entries.literal: "Ooh, I bet she made her usual shocked face when she sees anything that moves."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Of course.
entries.literal: "Of course."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: God. You're not one to talk, Miiya.
entries.literal: "God. You're not one to talk, Miiya."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: The best part was that she, uh... panicked a bit and stepped on one of their tails. It popped right off, and she screamed.
entries.literal: "The best part was that she, uh... panicked a bit and stepped on one of their tails. It popped right off, and she screamed."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: I didn't know their tails came off and grew back! It had never come up before!
entries.literal: "I didn't know their tails came off and grew back! It had never come up before!"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: How can you not know that?
entries.literal: "How can you not know that?"

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: I just didn't! You don't even see lizards once the cold hits.
entries.literal: "I just didn't! You don't even see lizards once the cold hits."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: I honestly thought you saw a bear or something.
entries.literal: "I honestly thought you saw a bear or something."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: No way. I'd have left you for dead.
entries.literal: "No way. I'd have left you for dead."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Ice cold. Although black bears aren't that aggressive... usually.
entries.literal: "Ice cold. Although black bears aren't that aggressive... usually."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Yeah, I'd have been totally fine, and you would've regretted your betrayal. You've told me way too many things that I could use against you.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I'd have been totally fine, and you would've regretted your betrayal. You've told me way too many things that I could use against you."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Ooh, like what? You can tell me.
entries.literal: "Ooh, like what? You can tell me."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: A-Anyway, turned out that we completely misunderstood and tried to catch one too. Really, all we had to do was tell what kind of animal it was. Not the species, the, uh, genus.
entries.literal: "A-Anyway, turned out that we completely misunderstood and tried to catch one too. Really, all we had to do was tell what kind of animal it was. Not the species, the, uh, genus."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Yeah. I felt like an idiot.
entries.literal: "Yeah. I felt like an idiot."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: So you didn't catch a bear? Shame.
entries.literal: "So you didn't catch a bear? Shame."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: I've known Shiroya long enough that it wouldn't surprise me. She's good with animals, but she needs a bit of time to warm up to them. I'm sure a bear would grow a liking to her fast.
entries.literal: "I've known Shiroya long enough that it wouldn't surprise me. She's good with animals, but she needs a bit of time to warm up to them. I'm sure a bear would grow a liking to her fast."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Hmm.
entries.literal: "Hmm."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: You think so? I'd probably just play dead and hope to survive.
entries.literal: "You think so? I'd probably just play dead and hope to survive."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Well, you're always very sweet with Umi, and she seems to really like you. Honestly, I was a bit jealous of you in the past. If I didn't know better, I'd think you'd end up becoming a vet.
entries.literal: "Well, you're always very sweet with Umi, and she seems to really like you. Honestly, I was a bit jealous of you in the past. If I didn't know better, I'd think you'd end up becoming a vet."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Me...? I doubt it, yeah. I stopped considering that when I was twelve.{w} That's so much school just to get your foot in the door. It's not like I want to end up being some boring office worker or something, but I want to have time for myself too...
entries.literal: "Me...? I doubt it, yeah. I stopped considering that when I was twelve.{w} That's so much school just to get your foot in the door. It's not like I want to end up being some boring office worker or something, but I want to have time for myself too..."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Could just find a nice rich guy and become a gold digger instead.
entries.literal: "Could just find a nice rich guy and become a gold digger instead."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Heh. Yeah, I doubt that too.
entries.literal: "Heh. Yeah, I doubt that too."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: So do I. You should've seen her as a kid, Miiya. She didn't want anything to do with boys.
entries.literal: "So do I. You should've seen her as a kid, Miiya. She didn't want anything to do with boys."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Except you?
entries.literal: "Except you?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Well... I didn't want anything to do with them either most of the time. For a while, both of us didn't have a great relationship with our classmates, so... we just kind of hung out with each other. I don't really know how it happened, but our parents definitely contributed to it too.
entries.literal: "Well... I didn't want anything to do with them either most of the time. For a while, both of us didn't have a great relationship with our classmates, so... we just kind of hung out with each other. I don't really know how it happened, but our parents definitely contributed to it too."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: All the girls had their cliques, that's how. It's insane how they get in a town like this. One person says something bad about you and it spreads fast, even if it's not true. Most of them ended up maturing, fortunately, but it was really bad at the start. Atsuki was never like that, though.
entries.literal: "All the girls had their cliques, that's how. It's insane how they get in a town like this. One person says something bad about you and it spreads fast, even if it's not true. Most of them ended up maturing, fortunately, but it was really bad at the start. Atsuki was never like that, though."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Well, I'd be an asshole if I was. You're right, though, things got a lot better after middle school, probably because everyone's too busy with doing well to pick fights.
entries.literal: "Well, I'd be an asshole if I was. You're right, though, things got a lot better after middle school, probably because everyone's too busy with doing well to pick fights."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I'm not so sure about that. Look at all the old farts here who go on and on about how terrible Ashiya is.
entries.literal: "I'm not so sure about that. Look at all the old farts here who go on and on about how terrible Ashiya is."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: As far as I'm concerned, both groups suck.
entries.literal: "As far as I'm concerned, both groups suck."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: How moderate of you. A man after my own heart.
entries.literal: "How moderate of you. A man after my own heart."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They kept talking like that for quite some time, whiling away the day in the way that made them most comfortable. Existing with each other was enough for them.
entries.literal: "They kept talking like that for quite some time, whiling away the day in the way that made them most comfortable. Existing with each other was enough for them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Eventually, their coats were no longer able to protect them from the icy air. The short winter day came to an end as the sky began to darken.{w} Colliding with her own misty breath, Miiya stood up and asked whether they'd like to walk around to warm themselves up.
entries.literal: "Eventually, their coats were no longer able to protect them from the icy air. The short winter day came to an end as the sky began to darken.{w} Colliding with her own misty breath, Miiya stood up and asked whether they'd like to walk around to warm themselves up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From Seeuta D'ella Park, they would usually head home. Instead, they headed in the opposite direction, toward the more rustic part of Yushibana, which bordered the surrounding mountain range.
entries.literal: "From Seeuta D'ella Park, they would usually head home. Instead, they headed in the opposite direction, toward the more rustic part of Yushibana, which bordered the surrounding mountain range."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They weren't unfamiliar with it, but it was rare they'd end up there. It barely had shops, and most buildings were residences. However, the narrow brick streets adorned by the dim snow made it particularly cozy, quiet footsteps the only audible sound.
entries.literal: "They weren't unfamiliar with it, but it was rare they'd end up there. It barely had shops, and most buildings were residences. However, the narrow brick streets adorned by the dim snow made it particularly cozy, quiet footsteps the only audible sound."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya took out her phone and looked at the time: {time=20:27.} Aimlessly walking, they noticed the falling snow was getting lighter. People were entering their homes for the night, and some tire tracks had recently been carved into the snow.
entries.literal: "Shiroya took out her phone and looked at the time: {time=20:27.} Aimlessly walking, they noticed the falling snow was getting lighter. People were entering their homes for the night, and some tire tracks had recently been carved into the snow."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: What's that?
entries.literal: "What's that?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya had been living in Yushibana for many years, but she was well aware that the other two knew the town much better. She pointed at a bright window next to an opaque door, the view of its interior covered by a curtain.
entries.literal: "Miiya had been living in Yushibana for many years, but she was well aware that the other two knew the town much better. She pointed at a bright window next to an opaque door, the view of its interior covered by a curtain."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: I believe it's a jewelry shop. Maybe the owner lives here since there's a second level.
entries.literal: "I believe it's a jewelry shop. Maybe the owner lives here since there's a second level."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: And it's still open?
entries.literal: "And it's still open?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Every lit window on the path had been high up, so that one stood out. In recent years, a few amateur jewelers had been appearing throughout Yushibana, selling the gemstones found in the nearby mountains.
entries.literal: "Every lit window on the path had been high up, so that one stood out. In recent years, a few amateur jewelers had been appearing throughout Yushibana, selling the gemstones found in the nearby mountains."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Timidly, Shiroya approached the door and tried to open it.
entries.literal: "Timidly, Shiroya approached the door and tried to open it."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Oh!{w=0.4} Hello, it's not usual I get a late visit. Are you searching for anything in particular?
entries.literal: "Oh!{w=0.4} Hello, it's not usual I get a late visit. Are you searching for anything in particular?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While the old man stepped out from behind the reception desk, Shiroya turned around to meet Atsuki's gaze. He simply shrugged.
entries.literal: "While the old man stepped out from behind the reception desk, Shiroya turned around to meet Atsuki's gaze. He simply shrugged."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Noticing Miiya's look of interest, the owner addressed her, slowly bringing her inside.
entries.literal: "Noticing Miiya's look of interest, the owner addressed her, slowly bringing her inside."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Anything that you see can be put on a necklace, earrings, or even a ring. Are you three looking to buy matching necklaces? Kids usually ask for that.
entries.literal: "Anything that you see can be put on a necklace, earrings, or even a ring. Are you three looking to buy matching necklaces? Kids usually ask for that."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: N-Not really, no.
entries.literal: "N-Not really, no."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The owner didn't give up, looking at Shiroya for her own answer. On both sides of his shirt was the logo of the shop: Musashi Gemstones.
entries.literal: "The owner didn't give up, looking at Shiroya for her own answer. On both sides of his shirt was the logo of the shop: Musashi Gemstones."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The three of them stepped farther into the shop and heard the door closing behind them, preserving the warmth. They saw that only a few ceiling lights were on and spotted a heater on the opposite side of the room.
entries.literal: "The three of them stepped farther into the shop and heard the door closing behind them, preserving the warmth. They saw that only a few ceiling lights were on and spotted a heater on the opposite side of the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was a modest shop with wooden shelves showcasing different kinds of colored stones, each with a price tag next to it.
entries.literal: "It was a modest shop with wooden shelves showcasing different kinds of colored stones, each with a price tag next to it."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Even at my age, I regularly go to the two mountains behind us. I've found all that you see here, without exception.
entries.literal: "Even at my age, I regularly go to the two mountains behind us. I've found all that you see here, without exception."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The shop was separated by the shelves, and the three found themselves under the obligation to look through them. It was evident that many of the pieces were of lesser quality than the others and were being showcased with hopes they'd eventually be sold.
entries.literal: "The shop was separated by the shelves, and the three found themselves under the obligation to look through them. It was evident that many of the pieces were of lesser quality than the others and were being showcased with hopes they'd eventually be sold."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Being the most interested, Miiya started going through them, knowing she had enough money to buy one if it grabbed her attention. She kept in mind the ones she liked while she continued stepping farther into the shop.
entries.literal: "Being the most interested, Miiya started going through them, knowing she had enough money to buy one if it grabbed her attention. She kept in mind the ones she liked while she continued stepping farther into the shop."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya had also seemed captivated by a couple of them, but Atsuki had quickly decided to wait near the entrance, doubting he'd have an interest in anything.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had also seemed captivated by a couple of them, but Atsuki had quickly decided to wait near the entrance, doubting he'd have an interest in anything."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Don't you want to look at them? See here, I have put together a few wristbands of different colors, and I believe I still have one I'm sure would suit you very well.
entries.literal: "Don't you want to look at them? See here, I have put together a few wristbands of different colors, and I believe I still have one I'm sure would suit you very well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Atsuki looked at the first shelf, he had a quick change of heart. He saw two similar triangular stones in a shining dark blue—his favorite color.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki looked at the first shelf, he had a quick change of heart. He saw two similar triangular stones in a shining dark blue—his favorite color."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Do you like these? They're tanzanite, one of the most beautiful gems.
entries.literal: "Do you like these? They're tanzanite, one of the most beautiful gems."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Behind the shelf, Atsuki could hear the two girls who had come back to his life. He truly hoped things would stay as they were.
entries.literal: "Behind the shelf, Atsuki could hear the two girls who had come back to his life. He truly hoped things would stay as they were."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Can these be put in a pendant?" Atsuki spoke in a quiet voice, with the idea to secretly buy matching pendants for them.
entries.literal: "\"Can these be put in a pendant?\" Atsuki spoke in a quiet voice, with the idea to secretly buy matching pendants for them."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Of course! Come here.
entries.literal: "Of course! Come here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The owner took both gems and crouched behind the reception desk. In no time, he fitted the two of them into pendants.
entries.literal: "The owner took both gems and crouched behind the reception desk. In no time, he fitted the two of them into pendants."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The price was affordable, so Atsuki paid it without saying a word.
entries.literal: "The price was affordable, so Atsuki paid it without saying a word."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The two girls hadn't heard him; Shiroya had stopped in the middle of the shop and was staring at a specific display. After her was Miiya, who'd seen almost everything on offer. She was close to a wooden door, which she believed must've led to a higher level where the old man lived.
entries.literal: "The two girls hadn't heard him; Shiroya had stopped in the middle of the shop and was staring at a specific display. After her was Miiya, who'd seen almost everything on offer. She was close to a wooden door, which she believed must've led to a higher level where the old man lived."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya frowned. Upon entering, she'd barely noticed an odd smell which had become a little unpleasant. She couldn't help but feel as if she'd {tip=smell}smelled it before{/tip}, but she couldn't determine what it was.
entries.literal: "Miiya frowned. Upon entering, she'd barely noticed an odd smell which had become a little unpleasant. She couldn't help but feel as if she'd {tip=smell}smelled it before{/tip}, but she couldn't determine what it was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While the owner was putting both pendants in a bag, the door opened, making him quickly let go of them.
entries.literal: "While the owner was putting both pendants in a bag, the door opened, making him quickly let go of them."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Hello. I'm sorry for coming earlier than arranged.
entries.literal: "Hello. I'm sorry for coming earlier than arranged."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: No, don't worry! I'm happy to see you.
entries.literal: "No, don't worry! I'm happy to see you."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki saw the owner morphing his face into a big smile. Through the door came a man wearing an expensive-looking coat that covered most of his face. The owner took him to the reception table, where they began to talk in quiet voices.
entries.literal: "Atsuki saw the owner morphing his face into a big smile. Through the door came a man wearing an expensive-looking coat that covered most of his face. The owner took him to the reception table, where they began to talk in quiet voices."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From the side, Atsuki heard the man speaking briefly. After a nod, the owner walked toward the opposite side of the room and came back after a minute, bringing a heavy-looking, small box.
entries.literal: "From the side, Atsuki heard the man speaking briefly. After a nod, the owner walked toward the opposite side of the room and came back after a minute, bringing a heavy-looking, small box."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I'm not done, give me a moment. Oh, and you're aware of what I discussed with Lei, right? The price will be double the usual." Those were the sole words Atsuki was able to make out, which made him think that something of high value was being traded. Then, the owner walked back toward the opposite side.
entries.literal: "\"I'm not done, give me a moment. Oh, and you're aware of what I discussed with Lei, right? The price will be double the usual.\" Those were the sole words Atsuki was able to make out, which made him think that something of high value was being traded. Then, the owner walked back toward the opposite side."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the meantime, the other man peeked inside the box and closed it again.
entries.literal: "In the meantime, the other man peeked inside the box and closed it again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Slightly curious, Atsuki glanced at the owner, walking toward Miiya.
entries.literal: "Slightly curious, Atsuki glanced at the owner, walking toward Miiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But in an instant, he couldn't spot him anymore, as a dense, dark smoke had invaded his field of vision.
entries.literal: "But in an instant, he couldn't spot him anymore, as a dense, dark smoke had invaded his field of vision."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Behind him, he heard the sound of a door closing. Before he could put two and two together, he collapsed, incapable of movement.
entries.literal: "Behind him, he heard the sound of a door closing. Before he could put two and two together, he collapsed, incapable of movement."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The entire narrow shop had been inundated by the sudden smoke. Out of the four people, none of them were able to resist falling unconscious during the brief instants where they could be alarmed.
entries.literal: "The entire narrow shop had been inundated by the sudden smoke. Out of the four people, none of them were able to resist falling unconscious during the brief instants where they could be alarmed."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Kid! Can you hear me!?
entries.literal: "Kid! Can you hear me!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki began to recognize a few words, and his eyes shot open. When he saw that he was still in the shop, he remembered having passed out.
entries.literal: "Atsuki began to recognize a few words, and his eyes shot open. When he saw that he was still in the shop, he remembered having passed out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Battling a headache, he stood up and saw two unfamiliar men.
entries.literal: "Battling a headache, he stood up and saw two unfamiliar men."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: What the hell happened here...!? Are you okay?
entries.literal: "What the hell happened here...!? Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki didn't respond and instead peeked past one of the shelves.
entries.literal: "Atsuki didn't respond and instead peeked past one of the shelves."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There were both blood and pieces of skin scattered across the farther walls. When he took one step forward, he saw a huge hole in the floor.
entries.literal: "There were both blood and pieces of skin scattered across the farther walls. When he took one step forward, he saw a huge hole in the floor."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Wh-Where are the two girls that were here?
entries.literal: "Wh-Where are the two girls that were here?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody replied. Not because they didn't want to answer, but because they didn't know. However, going off the blood, they felt they couldn't have responded regardless.
entries.literal: "Nobody replied. Not because they didn't want to answer, but because they didn't know. However, going off the blood, they felt they couldn't have responded regardless."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Behind the two men, Atsuki spotted the owner, looking down at his feet. There was a streak of blood running across his face.
entries.literal: "Behind the two men, Atsuki spotted the owner, looking down at his feet. There was a streak of blood running across his face."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Hey! Answer me...!
entries.literal: "Hey! Answer me...!"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Th-There was an explosion a few minutes ago. That's all we know.
entries.literal: "Th-There was an explosion a few minutes ago. That's all we know."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki rushed toward the hole and looked in it, but it was pitch-black. He couldn't see a thing.
entries.literal: "Atsuki rushed toward the hole and looked in it, but it was pitch-black. He couldn't see a thing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He could hardly believe his eyes. Shiroya and Miiya had been in the impact zone. Realistically, it was impossible they were alive, but Atsuki found himself rejecting the thought, refusing the gore spread around the shop.
entries.literal: "He could hardly believe his eyes. Shiroya and Miiya had been in the impact zone. Realistically, it was impossible they were alive, but Atsuki found himself rejecting the thought, refusing the gore spread around the shop."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...We've called the police. They should be coming soon.
entries.literal: "...We've called the police. They should be coming soon."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: What the hell is down here? How did the floor break like this?
entries.literal: "What the hell is down here? How did the floor break like this?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: I came in and didn't see anyone because there was some smoke in the air. I thought the lights were off, so I flipped that switch. I instead turned off the lights, so I turned them back on. ...I think it caused a dust explosion.
entries.literal: "I came in and didn't see anyone because there was some smoke in the air. I thought the lights were off, so I flipped that switch. I instead turned off the lights, so I turned them back on. ...I think it caused a dust explosion."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: If there was gas in the air, turning on the light might've triggered one. They're powerful enough to take down walls, or this floor...
entries.literal: "If there was gas in the air, turning on the light might've triggered one. They're powerful enough to take down walls, or this floor..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki denied what he was hearing as he kept staring at the blood surrounding the hole. The entire far side of the shop had basically disappeared. He stood, stunned, recalling the powered-off heater that had been in that corner despite the warmth.
entries.literal: "Atsuki denied what he was hearing as he kept staring at the blood surrounding the hole. The entire far side of the shop had basically disappeared. He stood, stunned, recalling the powered-off heater that had been in that corner despite the warmth."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Very soon, the police appeared, followed by an ambulance. Atsuki explained what had happened, shaking every word out.
entries.literal: "Very soon, the police appeared, followed by an ambulance. Atsuki explained what had happened, shaking every word out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had to be brought to the hospital where his parents used to work in case he'd suffered any damage from either the smoke or the explosion.
entries.literal: "He had to be brought to the hospital where his parents used to work in case he'd suffered any damage from either the smoke or the explosion."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hours later, after asking continuously, he was told that below the store was a drainage channel where they'd found an unconscious person. However, only traces had been found of the other girl.
entries.literal: "Hours later, after asking continuously, he was told that below the store was a drainage channel where they'd found an unconscious person. However, only traces had been found of the other girl."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The description confirmed to Atsuki that Shiroya was alive, and whose remnants those had been.
entries.literal: "The description confirmed to Atsuki that Shiroya was alive, and whose remnants those had been."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unresponsive, Atsuki lay back, internally falling apart.
entries.literal: "Unresponsive, Atsuki lay back, internally falling apart."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya was brought to the hospital. She was in a coma from having fallen so far down, but a nearby shelf had prevented the explosion from hitting her directly.
entries.literal: "Shiroya was brought to the hospital. She was in a coma from having fallen so far down, but a nearby shelf had prevented the explosion from hitting her directly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next day, the police released the details of the events. An individual had released smoke that had put four people to sleep. A short time later, a gas explosion had occurred. It had happened due to the shop's heater being of an older design—one which lacked a failsafe. The heater had burned through all the oxygen immediately surrounding it, which had extinguished its flame but allowed it to continue releasing gas.
entries.literal: "The next day, the police released the details of the events. An individual had released smoke that had put four people to sleep. A short time later, a gas explosion had occurred. It had happened due to the shop's heater being of an older design—one which lacked a failsafe. The heater had burned through all the oxygen immediately surrounding it, which had extinguished its flame but allowed it to continue releasing gas."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Given the size of the explosion, that must've happened before the smoke had been released. Then, as everyone had fallen unconscious, nobody had been able to recognize the artificial smell of the gas and ventilate the area, causing it to build up.{w} At {time=21}, when the lights had been turned on, the small spark had ignited that gas.{w} The two people farthest from the center of the blast hadn't been critically harmed, but they'd been sent to the hospital. One girl had entered a coma after falling through the broken floor and hitting her head, and the last girl, who'd been the closest to the heater, had died instantly.
entries.literal: "Given the size of the explosion, that must've happened before the smoke had been released. Then, as everyone had fallen unconscious, nobody had been able to recognize the artificial smell of the gas and ventilate the area, causing it to build up.{w} At {time=21}, when the lights had been turned on, the small spark had ignited that gas.{w} The two people farthest from the center of the blast hadn't been critically harmed, but they'd been sent to the hospital. One girl had entered a coma after falling through the broken floor and hitting her head, and the last girl, who'd been the closest to the heater, had died instantly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The individual hadn't been caught, but their motive was unclear, as nothing had been stolen. Furthermore, it seemed the explosion itself had been an accident.
entries.literal: "The individual hadn't been caught, but their motive was unclear, as nothing had been stolen. Furthermore, it seemed the explosion itself had been an accident."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had gone to visit Shiroya, whose parents hadn't shown up. Looking at her resting face, he was unbelievably relieved that nothing had happened to her, but he couldn't process the fact that he'd never see Miiya again. Every time he remembered how happy she'd looked to be back with them, Atsuki's heart seemed to shatter once more.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had gone to visit Shiroya, whose parents hadn't shown up. Looking at her resting face, he was unbelievably relieved that nothing had happened to her, but he couldn't process the fact that he'd never see Miiya again. Every time he remembered how happy she'd looked to be back with them, Atsuki's heart seemed to shatter once more."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Days later, Shiroya woke up without having suffered any lasting mental damage, and the two of them were able to go live together, trying to support each other after what had happened.
entries.literal: "Days later, Shiroya woke up without having suffered any lasting mental damage, and the two of them were able to go live together, trying to support each other after what had happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The day before the 15th, the purse where Miiya had put the three tickets was still in view. They couldn't sleep and decided to walk to Ashiya Tower very early.
entries.literal: "The day before the 15th, the purse where Miiya had put the three tickets was still in view. They couldn't sleep and decided to walk to Ashiya Tower very early."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They looked at the night sky, knowing Miiya wasn't under it anymore. However, as they turned their eyes back to each other, both of them wanted to believe that loss could be overcome. They were still alive.
entries.literal: "They looked at the night sky, knowing Miiya wasn't under it anymore. However, as they turned their eyes back to each other, both of them wanted to believe that loss could be overcome. They were still alive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a long wait, they approached the tower and were able to find shelter in it until the event began, the warmth inside a small comfort.
entries.literal: "After a long wait, they approached the tower and were able to find shelter in it until the event began, the warmth inside a small comfort."

entries.text: Grounded Strobe
entries.literal: "Grounded Strobe"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd never entered Ashiya Tower before, but after waiting inside for so long, I'd begun to feel familiar with those walls. More and more people had continued entering through the main door, lengthening the queue behind us.
entries.literal: "I'd never entered Ashiya Tower before, but after waiting inside for so long, I'd begun to feel familiar with those walls. More and more people had continued entering through the main door, lengthening the queue behind us."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: *yawn*
entries.literal: "*yawn*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at my right and saw Atsuki's tired face. We'd been in silence for a long time, and I knew there wasn't much I could do to change that.
entries.literal: "I glanced at my right and saw Atsuki's tired face. We'd been in silence for a long time, and I knew there wasn't much I could do to change that."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: How tired are you?
entries.literal: "How tired are you?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: A bit... I'll be fine, though.
entries.literal: "A bit... I'll be fine, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Mingled with the tiredness was misery. Instead of looking back at me, he continued to stare at the rightmost column. Slightly frustrated, I awkwardly averted my eyes too.
entries.literal: "Mingled with the tiredness was misery. Instead of looking back at me, he continued to stare at the rightmost column. Slightly frustrated, I awkwardly averted my eyes too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd known him for a very long time, and he looked like a completely different person. It seemed the distance between us would keep extending despite the reason why we'd come to that building.
entries.literal: "I'd known him for a very long time, and he looked like a completely different person. It seemed the distance between us would keep extending despite the reason why we'd come to that building."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The premise had been to prevent what had happened from disrupting our relationship, but I felt that achieving that was far out of my reach. In addition, I'd had to constantly shape my attitude around it, which I hated.
entries.literal: "The premise had been to prevent what had happened from disrupting our relationship, but I felt that achieving that was far out of my reach. In addition, I'd had to constantly shape my attitude around it, which I hated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew how bad of an idea showing my discontent would've been, so I kept it to myself and continued mirroring his face.
entries.literal: "I knew how bad of an idea showing my discontent would've been, so I kept it to myself and continued mirroring his face."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: Everyone who's waiting in line, please get your tickets out.
entries.literal: "Everyone who's waiting in line, please get your tickets out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The receptionist, who'd been sharing in the quietness, stood up and walked toward us with a barcode scanner.
entries.literal: "The receptionist, who'd been sharing in the quietness, stood up and walked toward us with a barcode scanner."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were at the front of the line, so I handed her our two tickets. She hovered the machine over both barcodes until it released a quiet beep for each one.
entries.literal: "We were at the front of the line, so I handed her our two tickets. She hovered the machine over both barcodes until it released a quiet beep for each one."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: There you go.
entries.literal: "There you go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She gave them back to me with a smile, and I put them in my purse.
entries.literal: "She gave them back to me with a smile, and I put them in my purse."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: ...Oh.{w} I'm glad to see you're back. I hope you enjoy the event.
entries.literal: "...Oh.{w} I'm glad to see you're back. I hope you enjoy the event."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.literal: "Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For the first time since we'd entered, she glanced at Atsuki's face before saying that.
entries.literal: "For the first time since we'd entered, she glanced at Atsuki's face before saying that."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What did she mean...? I've never been here.
entries.literal: "What did she mean...? I've never been here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shrugged since she'd already moved on to the man at our side, but I imagined she'd probably confused him for someone else.
entries.literal: "I shrugged since she'd already moved on to the man at our side, but I imagined she'd probably confused him for someone else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was still more than an hour left until {time=9}, when the front door would open. I'd stopped being curious about what we'd be shown as a result of the overbearing mixture of tiredness and coldness. I'd been paying attention to the brief conversations I could hear to stave off boredom, and they all kept detailing how strange the whole event was.
entries.literal: "There was still more than an hour left until {time=9}, when the front door would open. I'd stopped being curious about what we'd be shown as a result of the overbearing mixture of tiredness and coldness. I'd been paying attention to the brief conversations I could hear to stave off boredom, and they all kept detailing how strange the whole event was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Standing up for so long was building up pain on the lower side of my back, so I had to force the thought of enduring it for over another hour out of my mind. I stretched my limbs and torso, trying to resist the urge to lie on the floor.
entries.literal: "Standing up for so long was building up pain on the lower side of my back, so I had to force the thought of enduring it for over another hour out of my mind. I stretched my limbs and torso, trying to resist the urge to lie on the floor."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: Shiroya...?
entries.literal: "Shiroya...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd managed to leave my mind empty, but I abruptly turned around when I heard a quiet voice coming from my left. A man was crouching next to me, and when he stood up, I saw his older face underneath white hair.
entries.literal: "I'd managed to leave my mind empty, but I abruptly turned around when I heard a quiet voice coming from my left. A man was crouching next to me, and when he stood up, I saw his older face underneath white hair."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Is this yours? I think you dropped it.
entries.literal: "Is this yours? I think you dropped it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He showed me a ticket that must've fallen from my purse when I'd stretched my muscles. I nodded and put it back inside, all while unnerved by his stiff motions.
entries.literal: "He showed me a ticket that must've fallen from my purse when I'd stretched my muscles. I nodded and put it back inside, all while unnerved by his stiff motions."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Thank you.
entries.literal: "...Thank you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After turning around, he spent a few seconds staying still until he walked toward the door on the left. He gripped the knob and opened it before slowly disappearing through it.
entries.literal: "After turning around, he spent a few seconds staying still until he walked toward the door on the left. He gripped the knob and opened it before slowly disappearing through it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We weren't supposed to enter yet, so given how nobody apprehended him, he had to be an employee. Atsuki's mood didn't seem to have improved at all, which only caused my own form of anxiety to emerge.
entries.literal: "We weren't supposed to enter yet, so given how nobody apprehended him, he had to be an employee. Atsuki's mood didn't seem to have improved at all, which only caused my own form of anxiety to emerge."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no way to get rid of it, so all I did was stand up uncomfortably with no perception of what time it was.
entries.literal: "I had no way to get rid of it, so all I did was stand up uncomfortably with no perception of what time it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a long, lonesome wait, I began to feel more confident and calm. My posture didn't change, but reminding myself that everything would get much better had borne fruits.
entries.literal: "After a long, lonesome wait, I began to feel more confident and calm. My posture didn't change, but reminding myself that everything would get much better had borne fruits."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It must've already been {time=9}, because we were told we could advance through the left door if we weren't part of the event. Nobody did, though—everyone present was gathered behind us.
entries.literal: "It must've already been {time=9}, because we were told we could advance through the left door if we weren't part of the event. Nobody did, though—everyone present was gathered behind us."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Sorry for the wait, everyone. We'll now begin the group entrances.
entries.literal: "Sorry for the wait, everyone. We'll now begin the group entrances."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A blonde woman wearing a dark suit came out of our door. I recalled seeing her face in the lobby not much earlier.
entries.literal: "A blonde woman wearing a dark suit came out of our door. I recalled seeing her face in the lobby not much earlier."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: My name is Naomi. I'll be chaperoning today's guided visit.
entries.literal: "My name is Naomi. I'll be chaperoning today's guided visit."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: As you likely already know, groups of three will move forward in turns. Each visit is estimated to take approximately fifteen minutes.
entries.literal: "As you likely already know, groups of three will move forward in turns. Each visit is estimated to take approximately fifteen minutes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Addressing the multitude all at once, she glossed over the procedure and prohibitions. Once she was done, she looked over her glasses.
entries.literal: "Addressing the multitude all at once, she glossed over the procedure and prohibitions. Once she was done, she looked over her glasses."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Are you three the first group?
entries.literal: "Are you three the first group?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure Atsuki had paid attention to her discourse, and the man at our side was visibly out of it. I opened my mouth so that we wouldn't waste more time.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure Atsuki had paid attention to her discourse, and the man at our side was visibly out of it. I opened my mouth so that we wouldn't waste more time."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yeah, we've been here for a while.
entries.literal: "Yeah, we've been here for a while."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Perfect. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Perfect. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Quietly, she turned around and walked through the door. All the chatter had faded away, so the three of us walked behind her, the sound of our footsteps filling up the space.
entries.literal: "Quietly, she turned around and walked through the door. All the chatter had faded away, so the three of us walked behind her, the sound of our footsteps filling up the space."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the other side was a long hallway with ornate decorations. There were a few open doors in both walls and a handrail linking all of them together.
entries.literal: "On the other side was a long hallway with ornate decorations. There were a few open doors in both walls and a handrail linking all of them together."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The woman stepped up to a door in the middle of the left wall and opened it for us.
entries.literal: "The woman stepped up to a door in the middle of the left wall and opened it for us."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: This is where we hold many of our events. Make your way inside.
entries.literal: "This is where we hold many of our events. Make your way inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I crossed gazes with the strange man, whose look and behavior felt out of place. He entered first and stared at the red curtain that was undoubtedly covering the gemstone we'd all come to see.
entries.literal: "I crossed gazes with the strange man, whose look and behavior felt out of place. He entered first and stared at the red curtain that was undoubtedly covering the gemstone we'd all come to see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Aside from the display case, the room was empty and only contained a security camera with a flickering green light.
entries.literal: "Aside from the display case, the room was empty and only contained a security camera with a flickering green light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: More people than I'd imagined were intrigued about the day's event. Personally, I was a little curious, so I'd proposed coming despite what had happened. Atsuki had immediately agreed to prove that he was strong enough to get through. Whether to me or himself, though, I didn't know.
entries.literal: "More people than I'd imagined were intrigued about the day's event. Personally, I was a little curious, so I'd proposed coming despite what had happened. Atsuki had immediately agreed to prove that he was strong enough to get through. Whether to me or himself, though, I didn't know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was the last to enter, and Naomi closed the door. Then, she asked for our introductions before starting to build up anticipation. According to her, we were sharing space with something of incredible value which had been found in the surrounding mountains.
entries.literal: "He was the last to enter, and Naomi closed the door. Then, she asked for our introductions before starting to build up anticipation. According to her, we were sharing space with something of incredible value which had been found in the surrounding mountains."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Part of the experience is the touch, so I will open the glass and let you experience it yourselves. However, I must insist that you be gentle and keep your hands inside the cabinet at all times.
entries.literal: "Part of the experience is the touch, so I will open the glass and let you experience it yourselves. However, I must insist that you be gentle and keep your hands inside the cabinet at all times."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She took out a keyring from her pocket and isolated one of the smaller keys, which she inserted in a keyhole next to the curtain.
entries.literal: "She took out a keyring from her pocket and isolated one of the smaller keys, which she inserted in a keyhole next to the curtain."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I have a question.
entries.literal: "I have a question."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Hm? What is it?
entries.literal: "Hm? What is it?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You keep mentioning how valuable the Sekimeiya is, but is there proof of that? The way you're explaining it, you don't even say what kind of gem it is, only that it's "rare".
entries.literal: "You keep mentioning how valuable the Sekimeiya is, but is there proof of that? The way you're explaining it, you don't even say what kind of gem it is, only that it's \"rare\"."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: But the value could've been arbitrarily created by Ashiya, as it's not being officially recognized as anything more than an unusual discovery.
entries.literal: "But the value could've been arbitrarily created by Ashiya, as it's not being officially recognized as anything more than an unusual discovery."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Well, I will let you decide that for yourself. As you said, it's not categorized because nobody was able to properly appraise it. That's all you need to be assured of its value.
entries.literal: "Well, I will let you decide that for yourself. As you said, it's not categorized because nobody was able to properly appraise it. That's all you need to be assured of its value."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I apologize for being skeptical, but you must be aware that Ashiya aren't exactly recognized for their fairness.
entries.literal: "I apologize for being skeptical, but you must be aware that Ashiya aren't exactly recognized for their fairness."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Do you have a reason to say that?
entries.literal: "Do you have a reason to say that?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes, that everyone in the lobby sounded as skeptical as I am.
entries.literal: "Yes, that everyone in the lobby sounded as skeptical as I am."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Maybe seeing it for yourself will convince you.
entries.literal: "Maybe seeing it for yourself will convince you."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's what I'm hoping.
entries.literal: "That's what I'm hoping."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki and I listened to the conversation until Naomi crouched to grab the bottom of the curtain. The real value of the Sekimeiya wasn't what had piqued my curiosity, as I thought its appearance was what caused all the excitement.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and I listened to the conversation until Naomi crouched to grab the bottom of the curtain. The real value of the Sekimeiya wasn't what had piqued my curiosity, as I thought its appearance was what caused all the excitement."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But Naomi's motion was cut off. Before she raised the curtain all the way up, my vision was obstructed by dense smoke that forced me to shut my eyes.
entries.literal: "But Naomi's motion was cut off. Before she raised the curtain all the way up, my vision was obstructed by dense smoke that forced me to shut my eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instantly, I recognized I was rapidly losing control of my body, and I fell to the floor. Nobody responded to my yell, and Atsuki's desperate gasp was all I heard before silence reigned supreme.
entries.literal: "Instantly, I recognized I was rapidly losing control of my body, and I fell to the floor. Nobody responded to my yell, and Atsuki's desperate gasp was all I heard before silence reigned supreme."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immobile on the floor, reality distanced itself from me. It was all too familiar of an experience, but before I could think about that any longer, I blacked out.
entries.literal: "Immobile on the floor, reality distanced itself from me. It was all too familiar of an experience, but before I could think about that any longer, I blacked out."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Hey!
Arcology
entries.literal: "Arcology"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The world vibrated. I saw Atsuki's hair next to my eyes, and his arm shook me while his entire figure was covered by a dark substance. When he saw I'd awakened, he backed off.
entries.literal: "The world vibrated. I saw Atsuki's hair next to my eyes, and his arm shook me while his entire figure was covered by a dark substance. When he saw I'd awakened, he backed off."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you feel okay?
entries.literal: "Do you feel okay?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Uh, y— *cough*{w} *cough* *cough*{w} Wh-What happened? We're still here?
entries.literal: "Uh, y— *cough*{w} *cough* *cough*{w} Wh-What happened? We're still here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Mixing a nod with a shrug, he glanced at the drastically changed scenery. The smoke had tainted everything it touched, including ourselves, and the room had become very dark.
entries.literal: "Mixing a nod with a shrug, he glanced at the drastically changed scenery. The smoke had tainted everything it touched, including ourselves, and the room had become very dark."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hh—{w} ...What the fuck is this...?
entries.literal: "Hh—{w} ...What the fuck is this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All I could do with my strength was look sideways, where I saw Akaro trying to sit up.
entries.literal: "All I could do with my strength was look sideways, where I saw Akaro trying to sit up."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Where did N-Naomi go?
entries.literal: "Where did N-Naomi go?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't know. She wasn't here when I woke up.
entries.literal: "I don't know. She wasn't here when I woke up."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Looks like she left through that door.
