entries.literal: "Looks like she left through that door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro managed to stand up and looked through it. Even though none of us had touched it, it was slightly open.
entries.literal: "Akaro managed to stand up and looked through it. Even though none of us had touched it, it was slightly open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The left hallway was very dark too, and I could see the smoke had blocked the ceiling lights from illuminating it. Strangely, it didn't seem like anyone else was there.
entries.literal: "The left hallway was very dark too, and I could see the smoke had blocked the ceiling lights from illuminating it. Strangely, it didn't seem like anyone else was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In addition, none of us had discerned the origin of the smoke. As my mind started to get clearer, I began to process what had happened.
entries.literal: "In addition, none of us had discerned the origin of the smoke. As my mind started to get clearer, I began to process what had happened."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did you hear the alarm before we fell unconscious?
entries.literal: "Did you hear the alarm before we fell unconscious?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What alarm?
entries.literal: "What alarm?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My look told him I hadn't either. Apparently, shortly after I'd been knocked out, a wordless alarm had played.
entries.literal: "My look told him I hadn't either. Apparently, shortly after I'd been knocked out, a wordless alarm had played."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was fairly obvious: there'd been a terrorist attack. Fortunately, Atsuki and I were safe, although all of us were clearly unsettled by the solitude.
entries.literal: "It was fairly obvious: there'd been a terrorist attack. Fortunately, Atsuki and I were safe, although all of us were clearly unsettled by the solitude."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We didn't know how long we'd been asleep or what had happened during that blank period of time. However, something stood out in the room.
entries.literal: "We didn't know how long we'd been asleep or what had happened during that blank period of time. However, something stood out in the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The three of us were staring at it, and I began to feel able to stand up.
entries.literal: "The three of us were staring at it, and I began to feel able to stand up."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Did someone do this to steal the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Did someone do this to steal the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro shrugged, wondering the same thing. While Atsuki was still on the floor, I approached the curtain.
entries.literal: "Akaro shrugged, wondering the same thing. While Atsuki was still on the floor, I approached the curtain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I resumed Naomi's action and raised the curtain all the way up.
entries.literal: "I resumed Naomi's action and raised the curtain all the way up."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, never mind. It's still here.
entries.literal: "Oh, never mind. It's still here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It is?
entries.literal: "It is?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around and nodded. Akaro approached me and saw with his own eyes the egg-shaped object contained within the glass, on top of a smooth cushion.
entries.literal: "I turned around and nodded. Akaro approached me and saw with his own eyes the egg-shaped object contained within the glass, on top of a smooth cushion."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Is this really it? I figured they were making a big deal out of nothing, but it's even more underwhelming than I thought.
entries.literal: "Is this really it? I figured they were making a big deal out of nothing, but it's even more underwhelming than I thought."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: It's glowing a little. Maybe that's why?
entries.literal: "It's glowing a little. Maybe that's why?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I wonder where Naomi is. This seems pretty fishy.
entries.literal: "...I wonder where Naomi is. This seems pretty fishy."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What do you mean...?
entries.literal: "What do you mean...?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That there's nobody here. I know this seems like an attack, but you know what I said regarding Ashiya's reputation, right?
entries.literal: "That there's nobody here. I know this seems like an attack, but you know what I said regarding Ashiya's reputation, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I find it hard to believe they'd set up so much advertisement just for this thing. I'm sure they had something in mind to use this event for. Maybe this was it.
entries.literal: "I find it hard to believe they'd set up so much advertisement just for this thing. I'm sure they had something in mind to use this event for. Maybe this was it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I don't follow.
entries.literal: "...I don't follow."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It happened right before we could see the Sekimeiya, and an employee left. Nobody entered yet, and we weren't moved. I have an idea of what's going on.
entries.literal: "It happened right before we could see the Sekimeiya, and an employee left. Nobody entered yet, and we weren't moved. I have an idea of what's going on."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm sure they wanted to use this opportunity to pull out some countermeasure against Xyn, but I don't know what it really entailed. We probably got caught in the middle of it.
entries.literal: "I'm sure they wanted to use this opportunity to pull out some countermeasure against Xyn, but I don't know what it really entailed. We probably got caught in the middle of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro filled in Atsuki, who'd never heard of Xyn.
entries.literal: "Akaro filled in Atsuki, who'd never heard of Xyn."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I still have trouble understanding what you're getting at.
entries.literal: "...I still have trouble understanding what you're getting at."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What does this situation scream to you?
entries.literal: "What does this situation scream to you?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: "Failed robbery attempt", right?
entries.literal: "\"Failed robbery attempt\", right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: They might've purposely acted out a failed attack since they're desperate to publicly say they won once against Xyn. I'm immediately noticing a bunch of odd details that point to that.
entries.literal: "They might've purposely acted out a failed attack since they're desperate to publicly say they won once against Xyn. I'm immediately noticing a bunch of odd details that point to that."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Didn't you say they always attack during the night? Why would they do it during the day?
entries.literal: "Didn't you say they always attack during the night? Why would they do it during the day?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: If anything, that points further at Xyn not being behind it, and a false flag is the possibility next in line. Let's see how much time has passed and why nobody else is here. If I'm wrong, the police or Ashiya should know.
entries.literal: "If anything, that points further at Xyn not being behind it, and a false flag is the possibility next in line. Let's see how much time has passed and why nobody else is here. If I'm wrong, the police or Ashiya should know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I helped Atsuki stay up, and we brushed the remnants of smoke off ourselves. Both of us were extremely tired. The sudden turn of events felt almost surreal, but he still looked distant, almost divorced from reality.
entries.literal: "I helped Atsuki stay up, and we brushed the remnants of smoke off ourselves. Both of us were extremely tired. The sudden turn of events felt almost surreal, but he still looked distant, almost divorced from reality."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took a few seconds for us to walk normally, but the left hallway was as we'd seen through the door—completely desolate.
entries.literal: "It took a few seconds for us to walk normally, but the left hallway was as we'd seen through the door—completely desolate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We opened the opposite door and glanced at the right hallway, where we'd come from. It was in the same state as its parallel neighbor, indicating that whatever had happened was large-scale.
entries.literal: "We opened the opposite door and glanced at the right hallway, where we'd come from. It was in the same state as its parallel neighbor, indicating that whatever had happened was large-scale."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Is that a person?
entries.literal: "Is that a person?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Y-You're right. Hey! What the hell happened...!?
entries.literal: "Y-You're right. Hey! What the hell happened...!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He sped up toward them, while I stopped.
entries.literal: "He sped up toward them, while I stopped."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Are you okay? I'm sorry I made you come here.
entries.literal: "Are you okay? I'm sorry I made you come here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No... Don't worry. None of this is your fault.
entries.literal: "No... Don't worry. None of this is your fault."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It wasn't my fault, so I didn't push it. I sighed, a bit irritated, and passed it off as loosening myself up, like I'd been getting used to doing.
entries.literal: "...It wasn't my fault, so I didn't push it. I sighed, a bit irritated, and passed it off as loosening myself up, like I'd been getting used to doing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to the lobby door, we introduced ourselves to Erina and Sai, as well as Katei—the person I'd exchanged words with before. Sai, Erina, and her daughter had been the group behind us and fell unconscious while waiting in the hallway. Katei told us he worked in the tower as a security manager and that he was trying to piece together what had happened.
entries.literal: "Next to the lobby door, we introduced ourselves to Erina and Sai, as well as Katei—the person I'd exchanged words with before. Sai, Erina, and her daughter had been the group behind us and fell unconscious while waiting in the hallway. Katei told us he worked in the tower as a security manager and that he was trying to piece together what had happened."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Naomi was gone?
entries.literal: "...Naomi was gone?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked down, worried.
entries.literal: "He looked down, worried."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'd been suspecting her, but I can't believe I was right.
entries.literal: "I'd been suspecting her, but I can't believe I was right."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We have to find her. I'm almost certain she was behind the attack.
entries.literal: "We have to find her. I'm almost certain she was behind the attack."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What do you mean, "we have to find her"? How can you even be sure she's still here?
entries.literal: "What do you mean, \"we have to find her\"? How can you even be sure she's still here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through the poor illumination, I was able to see many expressions lowering at once.
entries.literal: "Through the poor illumination, I was able to see many expressions lowering at once."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei revealed the effects of the alarm Atsuki had heard. Although the trigger was unknown, it had sealed every method of escape for twelve hours.
entries.literal: "Katei revealed the effects of the alarm Atsuki had heard. Although the trigger was unknown, it had sealed every method of escape for twelve hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite Akaro's insistence, Katei kept repeating that he wasn't allowed to reveal anything else, but he claimed he was unsure about other details.
entries.literal: "Despite Akaro's insistence, Katei kept repeating that he wasn't allowed to reveal anything else, but he claimed he was unsure about other details."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't get what you're saying. The Sekimeiya wasn't stolen: it's still in that cabinet, so you can't just ignore the activation of the alarm.
entries.literal: "I don't get what you're saying. The Sekimeiya wasn't stolen: it's still in that cabinet, so you can't just ignore the activation of the alarm."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: If that's true, I'm as clueless as you are.
entries.literal: "If that's true, I'm as clueless as you are."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What does it look like?
entries.literal: "What does it look like?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It's basically a big egg.
entries.literal: "It's basically a big egg."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're right. That's the Sekimeiya.{w} In case Naomi didn't warn you, the Sekimeiya must never be taken out of its cabinet. The temperature provided to it is essential to maintain it well. Did you keep it shut inside?
entries.literal: "You're right. That's the Sekimeiya.{w} In case Naomi didn't warn you, the Sekimeiya must never be taken out of its cabinet. The temperature provided to it is essential to maintain it well. Did you keep it shut inside?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm... I wonder if the alarm halted the plan, or if Xyn intends to take it out once the time expires.
entries.literal: "Hm... I wonder if the alarm halted the plan, or if Xyn intends to take it out once the time expires."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: See what I told you two? He already believes Xyn are behind this. That could very well be Ashiya's intention.
entries.literal: "See what I told you two? He already believes Xyn are behind this. That could very well be Ashiya's intention."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, whose mother hadn't stopped trying to bring her back to consciousness, opened her eyes and coughed a few times. After a few awkward seconds, Katei told her what had happened.
entries.literal: "Isla, whose mother hadn't stopped trying to bring her back to consciousness, opened her eyes and coughed a few times. After a few awkward seconds, Katei told her what had happened."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What...?{w} Why can't we leave?
entries.literal: "What...?{w} Why can't we leave?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The exit is blocked off, and so are all the windows above. It's to prevent thieves from escaping.
entries.literal: "The exit is blocked off, and so are all the windows above. It's to prevent thieves from escaping."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: So a thief is here?
entries.literal: "So a thief is here?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Well, we don't think anything was stolen, so it's very possible something went wrong.
entries.literal: "Well, we don't think anything was stolen, so it's very possible something went wrong."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're not giving us much to work with. What could've gone wrong?
entries.literal: "You're not giving us much to work with. What could've gone wrong?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: As I said, the system behind the alarm is new and has hardly been tested. Plenty of things could have.
entries.literal: "As I said, the system behind the alarm is new and has hardly been tested. Plenty of things could have."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: And you don't think the timing was way too precise for that?
entries.literal: "And you don't think the timing was way too precise for that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's go to the lobby. I'm curious about the blocked door.
entries.literal: "Let's go to the lobby. I'm curious about the blocked door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Interrupting the conversation, Sai stood up and told us to follow him. His intrigue was certainly shared, so we went through the door at our side.
entries.literal: "Interrupting the conversation, Sai stood up and told us to follow him. His intrigue was certainly shared, so we went through the door at our side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind it was the untouched lobby. Even though four lights had turned off, the middle one shined strongly at our eyes, causing all of us to grimace as we stared at the imposing shutter that had appeared in front of the exit. The only trace of all the people who'd been there was the janitor's bucket.
entries.literal: "Behind it was the untouched lobby. Even though four lights had turned off, the middle one shined strongly at our eyes, causing all of us to grimace as we stared at the imposing shutter that had appeared in front of the exit. The only trace of all the people who'd been there was the janitor's bucket."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Forget what I said.
entries.literal: "Forget what I said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was clearly impossible to take that down, completely keeping us shut inside.
entries.literal: "It was clearly impossible to take that down, completely keeping us shut inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: According to Katei, the remaining door in the lobby area led to a little basement below us that stored the boiler, and there was no feasible way to leave the building before it automatically opened. He also told us that the alarm had disabled the computer on the reception desk.
entries.literal: "According to Katei, the remaining door in the lobby area led to a little basement below us that stored the boiler, and there was no feasible way to leave the building before it automatically opened. He also told us that the alarm had disabled the computer on the reception desk."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were rightfully frustrated, as it seemed all of us had gotten innocently trapped, and we weren't even sure why. Thankfully, though, everyone was keeping calm.{w} I was quite tired, which might have watered down my reaction to everything. It was hard to believe what I was experiencing was real, but I would most likely fall asleep somewhere well before the deadline.
entries.literal: "We were rightfully frustrated, as it seemed all of us had gotten innocently trapped, and we weren't even sure why. Thankfully, though, everyone was keeping calm.{w} I was quite tired, which might have watered down my reaction to everything. It was hard to believe what I was experiencing was real, but I would most likely fall asleep somewhere well before the deadline."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The hallway door was slightly open, so someone went through it after the smoke was released, or else this hall would be stained as well.
entries.literal: "The hallway door was slightly open, so someone went through it after the smoke was released, or else this hall would be stained as well."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Look, the one to the other hallway's open too. Was it you, Katei?
entries.literal: "Look, the one to the other hallway's open too. Was it you, Katei?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Are all the windows this well blocked too?
entries.literal: "Are all the windows this well blocked too?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: They should be.
entries.literal: "They should be."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Do we have to spend the entire time isolated? Can we not even talk to the outside to understand what happened? This is ridiculous.
entries.literal: "Do we have to spend the entire time isolated? Can we not even talk to the outside to understand what happened? This is ridiculous."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, w—
entries.literal: "Oh, w—"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We can't, actually.
entries.literal: "We can't, actually."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I thought for a second we might've been able to, but I just realized the alarm's side effects made that impossible.
entries.literal: "I thought for a second we might've been able to, but I just realized the alarm's side effects made that impossible."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's insane. Why would this alarm even be created that way?
entries.literal: "That's insane. Why would this alarm even be created that way?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I recall telling you I'm not allowed to disclose that.
entries.literal: "I recall telling you I'm not allowed to disclose that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is there footage from all the cameras that we could look at?
entries.literal: "Is there footage from all the cameras that we could look at?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No. The alarm made that impossible as well.
entries.literal: "No. The alarm made that impossible as well."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I apologize. I personally looked at every room on this floor, and I'm confident in saying we're the only people here. Right now, our priority is finding Naomi, who I suspect is hiding upstairs.
entries.literal: "I apologize. I personally looked at every room on this floor, and I'm confident in saying we're the only people here. Right now, our priority is finding Naomi, who I suspect is hiding upstairs."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is there anything of importance you found while you investigated?
entries.literal: "Is there anything of importance you found while you investigated?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. The farthest crystal room in hallway A is the only other one in which the smoke was released. That's how we refer to the exhibition rooms, by the way.
entries.literal: "Yes. The farthest crystal room in hallway A is the only other one in which the smoke was released. That's how we refer to the exhibition rooms, by the way."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh? Smoke was released in another room? Why?
entries.literal: "Huh? Smoke was released in another room? Why?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei shook his head, indicating that he couldn't answer. As we had nowhere else to go, we were compelled to move over to it.
entries.literal: "Katei shook his head, indicating that he couldn't answer. As we had nowhere else to go, we were compelled to move over to it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A sturdy, gray door caught our attention first, and thanks to the map next to it, we learned that the security room was behind it. We could also see the basic layout of the floor we were on, named the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "A sturdy, gray door caught our attention first, and thanks to the map next to it, we learned that the security room was behind it. We could also see the basic layout of the floor we were on, named the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: As it says there, this is the security room, but we won't be able to access it. The door was locked by the alarm, and we have no means to open it.
entries.literal: "As it says there, this is the security room, but we won't be able to access it. The door was locked by the alarm, and we have no means to open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Forced to accept that, we kept walking toward the room Katei had indicated on the map, labeled A5.
entries.literal: "Forced to accept that, we kept walking toward the room Katei had indicated on the map, labeled A5."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The appearance of the narrow room perfectly replicated the hallways. Every curtain was stained black, and very little light let us see where we were.
entries.literal: "The appearance of the narrow room perfectly replicated the hallways. Every curtain was stained black, and very little light let us see where we were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, we were at least able to shine some light on the situation by revealing that the contents of all the cabinets had been removed, which Katei hadn't noticed. At first glance, we could tell it was a well-conceived plan.
entries.literal: "However, we were at least able to shine some light on the situation by revealing that the contents of all the cabinets had been removed, which Katei hadn't noticed. At first glance, we could tell it was a well-conceived plan."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite that, it was Sai who quickly proposed a different idea. The lack of gems in that room could've been a mere diversion, as it was too hard to believe something as important as the Sekimeiya hadn't been the target of a real robbery attempt.
entries.literal: "Despite that, it was Sai who quickly proposed a different idea. The lack of gems in that room could've been a mere diversion, as it was too hard to believe something as important as the Sekimeiya hadn't been the target of a real robbery attempt."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the last and shorter hallway were the bathrooms, which nobody entered.
entries.literal: "In the last and shorter hallway were the bathrooms, which nobody entered."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's in the staff room? Could we find a phone there?
entries.literal: "What's in the staff room? Could we find a phone there?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No. Every staff member has a personal locker, but we could only open mine, and I don't keep any devices inside.
entries.literal: "No. Every staff member has a personal locker, but we could only open mine, and I don't keep any devices inside."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...There's a reason why I believe Naomi hid upstairs if she's part of this, like I suspect. Above us are five desolate floors full of offices. However, there's a seventh floor that we call the attic, or the Ashiya floor.
entries.literal: "...There's a reason why I believe Naomi hid upstairs if she's part of this, like I suspect. Above us are five desolate floors full of offices. However, there's a seventh floor that we call the attic, or the Ashiya floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei explained the story behind its existence, and he left the most important detail for the end.
entries.literal: "Katei explained the story behind its existence, and he left the most important detail for the end."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't have the key to access it—only Naomi does. She's the sole, trusted individual chosen to preserve its interior as well as possible, and she possesses the only key I know of.
entries.literal: "I don't have the key to access it—only Naomi does. She's the sole, trusted individual chosen to preserve its interior as well as possible, and she possesses the only key I know of."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: So she can stay inside for as long as she pleases.
entries.literal: "So she can stay inside for as long as she pleases."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's right. If Atsuki is correct, and she was still in the event room when the alarm went off, she has to be hiding. Otherwise, she would've shown herself already. The attic makes the most sense for that.
entries.literal: "That's right. If Atsuki is correct, and she was still in the event room when the alarm went off, she has to be hiding. Otherwise, she would've shown herself already. The attic makes the most sense for that."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I didn't find anyone else on this floor, so she's most certainly above. I doubt we'll be able to do anything if she's locked in the attic, but we have to do all we can to find her.
entries.literal: "I didn't find anyone else on this floor, so she's most certainly above. I doubt we'll be able to do anything if she's locked in the attic, but we have to do all we can to find her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A door was in the middle of the staircase. Katei was surprised to see it unlocked because it shouldn't have opened in the past few days. When we were about to walk up the stairs, Isla asked whether we could take the elevator instead.
entries.literal: "A door was in the middle of the staircase. Katei was surprised to see it unlocked because it shouldn't have opened in the past few days. When we were about to walk up the stairs, Isla asked whether we could take the elevator instead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Indifferently, Sai tried to open its door, but it didn't budge.
entries.literal: "Indifferently, Sai tried to open its door, but it didn't budge."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei told us what we needed to know about it. No key was necessary to access the other floors with it except for the attic, which required Naomi's special key.
entries.literal: "Katei told us what we needed to know about it. No key was necessary to access the other floors with it except for the attic, which required Naomi's special key."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: However, it's not going to work.
entries.literal: "However, it's not going to work."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Right now, the elevator won't move if you call it. The alarm disabled it.
entries.literal: "Right now, the elevator won't move if you call it. The alarm disabled it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I see. Sorry, Isla, but there's nothing we can do about that.
entries.literal: "...I see. Sorry, Isla, but there's nothing we can do about that."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Aww.
entries.literal: "Aww."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla was displeased, but she was doing a fairly good job of not making a scene for a child her age. The wooziness left by unconsciousness probably played some part in that.
entries.literal: "Isla was displeased, but she was doing a fairly good job of not making a scene for a child her age. The wooziness left by unconsciousness probably played some part in that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The second floor looked absolutely nothing like the first. Varying shades of blue and gray surrounded us, emanating a far calmer atmosphere.
entries.literal: "The second floor looked absolutely nothing like the first. Varying shades of blue and gray surrounded us, emanating a far calmer atmosphere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our goal was to inspect the whole building. While we had Katei's guarantee that there was no one on the crystal floor, we knew nothing about the ones above it. However, assuming he was right about the attic, we wouldn't find Naomi anyway.
entries.literal: "Our goal was to inspect the whole building. While we had Katei's guarantee that there was no one on the crystal floor, we knew nothing about the ones above it. However, assuming he was right about the attic, we wouldn't find Naomi anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We began with the bathrooms.
entries.literal: "We began with the bathrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After those, we inspected the offices, occupying the main body of the floor. There were three office rooms separated by translucent walls, all containing powered-off computers.
entries.literal: "After those, we inspected the offices, occupying the main body of the floor. There were three office rooms separated by translucent walls, all containing powered-off computers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, the blocked windows made us stop. Just like below, exiting by force was out of the question.
entries.literal: "Next, the blocked windows made us stop. Just like below, exiting by force was out of the question."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Lastly, we saw the corridor leading to the third floor.
entries.literal: "Lastly, we saw the corridor leading to the third floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It looked exactly like the second, with swapped staircases.
entries.literal: "It looked exactly like the second, with swapped staircases."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We repeated the same process and concluded there was nothing to be found on it. Katei didn't have the login information for the computers, so our single way to measure the time was Sai's wristwatch. According to that, the time was {time=9:50.}
entries.literal: "We repeated the same process and concluded there was nothing to be found on it. Katei didn't have the login information for the computers, so our single way to measure the time was Sai's wristwatch. According to that, the time was {time=9:50.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With Katei at the front, we stepped onto the fourth floor. While the bathrooms were being checked, I felt someone's hand on my shoulder.
entries.literal: "With Katei at the front, we stepped onto the fourth floor. While the bathrooms were being checked, I felt someone's hand on my shoulder."

entries.text: Acid Rain
entries.literal: "Acid Rain"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Atsuki's. He was at the back of the group, maintaining his predictable reserved attitude.
entries.literal: "It was Atsuki's. He was at the back of the group, maintaining his predictable reserved attitude."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Look at this. I found it in the staircase.
entries.literal: "...Look at this. I found it in the staircase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was surprising was seeing a silver key on the palm of his hand. It looked fairly modern, and not like one that would belong to any door nearby.
entries.literal: "What was surprising was seeing a silver key on the palm of his hand. It looked fairly modern, and not like one that would belong to any door nearby."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, hm.
entries.literal: "Oh, hm."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait.
entries.literal: "Wait."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I turned around to face the others, he stopped me.
entries.literal: "When I turned around to face the others, he stopped me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'd like to not tell them.
entries.literal: "I'd like to not tell them."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At his signal, I walked down the stairs with him. Everyone else was either in the bathrooms or waiting next to them, so they didn't notice us.
entries.literal: "At his signal, I walked down the stairs with him. Everyone else was either in the bathrooms or waiting next to them, so they didn't notice us."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: This doesn't look like an ordinary key, so it should open a special door.
entries.literal: "This doesn't look like an ordinary key, so it should open a special door."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, the attic's?
entries.literal: "Oh, the attic's?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't think so. Doesn't it remind you of the security room door?
entries.literal: "I don't think so. Doesn't it remind you of the security room door?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Hm... I guess it does.
entries.literal: "Hm... I guess it does."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I could be imagining things, but I think there are a few details Katei mentioned that don't make any sense.
entries.literal: "I could be imagining things, but I think there are a few details Katei mentioned that don't make any sense."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Really...?
entries.literal: "Really...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: And if this really opens the security room, it could confirm that.{w} Wasn't Katei in front of us all this time, checking the floor as if he was looking for something?
entries.literal: "And if this really opens the security room, it could confirm that.{w} Wasn't Katei in front of us all this time, checking the floor as if he was looking for something?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Is that so? I didn't pay attention.
entries.literal: "Is that so? I didn't pay attention."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's possible he was trying to find this key, which he didn't tell us about. If it's related to the security room... it makes sense he would've kept it a secret since there are some inconsistencies there.
entries.literal: "It's possible he was trying to find this key, which he didn't tell us about. If it's related to the security room... it makes sense he would've kept it a secret since there are some inconsistencies there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While he walked around the floor, he filled me in on what he'd been suspecting. A few assertions Katei had made about the time of the attack contradicted each other.
entries.literal: "While he walked around the floor, he filled me in on what he'd been suspecting. A few assertions Katei had made about the time of the attack contradicted each other."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was taken aback. Not by the idea that Katei was potentially lying, but because Atsuki had been thinking about all of it. During the previous days, he'd looked like a person whose life had been drained out of him. At that moment, he was completely serious, which made me consider that he thought the attack was related to what had happened two weeks earlier.
entries.literal: "I was taken aback. Not by the idea that Katei was potentially lying, but because Atsuki had been thinking about all of it. During the previous days, he'd looked like a person whose life had been drained out of him. At that moment, he was completely serious, which made me consider that he thought the attack was related to what had happened two weeks earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Realizing that he'd gone back to being someone I could have a conversation with, I decided to humor him and follow him downstairs. In truth, what he was saying made sense.
entries.literal: "Realizing that he'd gone back to being someone I could have a conversation with, I decided to humor him and follow him downstairs. In truth, what he was saying made sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei specifically stated that the alarm shut the door to the security room. If he wanted to hide the existence of its key, it followed that we could open it despite whatever reason he had to prevent that.
entries.literal: "Katei specifically stated that the alarm shut the door to the security room. If he wanted to hide the existence of its key, it followed that we could open it despite whatever reason he had to prevent that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Given that he worked inside it and seemed to expect the key to be on the floor of the office rooms, maybe he'd been the one to drop it and wasn't completely sure where it fell.
entries.literal: "Given that he worked inside it and seemed to expect the key to be on the floor of the office rooms, maybe he'd been the one to drop it and wasn't completely sure where it fell."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One of Atsuki's points was undeniable: Katei had been surprised to hear Naomi was gone, but he later claimed that he inspected the entire lowest floor. He claimed to leave both doors in the lobby open while he searched, but all the crystal rooms he'd supposedly looked into were closed. It was an indication that he wanted to direct us upward, where he knew he could find his key...
entries.literal: "One of Atsuki's points was undeniable: Katei had been surprised to hear Naomi was gone, but he later claimed that he inspected the entire lowest floor. He claimed to leave both doors in the lobby open while he searched, but all the crystal rooms he'd supposedly looked into were closed. It was an indication that he wanted to direct us upward, where he knew he could find his key..."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Also, I think he actually saw it, but he didn't say anything. He probably wanted to grab it when we moved on.
entries.literal: "Also, I think he actually saw it, but he didn't say anything. He probably wanted to grab it when we moved on."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hey...! Where are you two going?
entries.literal: "Hey...! Where are you two going?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the second floor, we turned around and saw Erina and Isla. They were alone and must have realized we'd left.
entries.literal: "On the second floor, we turned around and saw Erina and Isla. They were alone and must have realized we'd left."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I found this key, and I'd like to know if it belongs to the security room.
entries.literal: "...I found this key, and I'd like to know if it belongs to the security room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without hesitating, Atsuki told Erina what his intent was, at which she looked a little surprised. After hearing that, she took Isla's hand and came with us. Isla didn't object, as it seemed the crystal floor was where she preferred to be.
entries.literal: "Without hesitating, Atsuki told Erina what his intent was, at which she looked a little surprised. After hearing that, she took Isla's hand and came with us. Isla didn't object, as it seemed the crystal floor was where she preferred to be."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If Katei had a reason to keep us away from the security room, we had no idea what it was. Atsuki was right to point out that he'd lied more than once—we couldn't trust that those lies were for the sake of confidentiality. We had no obligation to tell him what we were doing instead of just entering the room before he could think of a way to keep us out of it.
entries.literal: "If Katei had a reason to keep us away from the security room, we had no idea what it was. Atsuki was right to point out that he'd lied more than once—we couldn't trust that those lies were for the sake of confidentiality. We had no obligation to tell him what we were doing instead of just entering the room before he could think of a way to keep us out of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were in front of the security room. The metallic door did resemble the key we'd found, and it was hard to believe they weren't a match.
entries.literal: "We were in front of the security room. The metallic door did resemble the key we'd found, and it was hard to believe they weren't a match."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki inserted it in the keyhole and turned.
entries.literal: "Atsuki inserted it in the keyhole and turned."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Huh?{w} It enters all the way, but it's not unlocking it.
entries.literal: "Huh?{w} It enters all the way, but it's not unlocking it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The key was getting stuck in the middle of the turn, but as he'd said, it had to be the correct one. We stood behind him, confused.
entries.literal: "The key was getting stuck in the middle of the turn, but as he'd said, it had to be the correct one. We stood behind him, confused."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: That means the door is open, right?
entries.literal: "That means the door is open, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki looked down and met Isla's eyes. After considering her conclusion, he twisted the doorknob and pushed the door open.
entries.literal: "Atsuki looked down and met Isla's eyes. After considering her conclusion, he twisted the doorknob and pushed the door open."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You're right... What the hell? It wasn't even locked.{w} This was the right key, though...
entries.literal: "You're right... What the hell? It wasn't even locked.{w} This was the right key, though..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the hallway, we saw many lit screens in front of us illuminating a dim space. It seemed like a bit of smoke had leaked through the gaps of the door.{w} Slowly, we made our way in, wondering whether Katei had purposely lied or simply been incorrect.
entries.literal: "From the hallway, we saw many lit screens in front of us illuminating a dim space. It seemed like a bit of smoke had leaked through the gaps of the door.{w} Slowly, we made our way in, wondering whether Katei had purposely lied or simply been incorrect."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Katei said the alarm locked the door. You really think that was a lie to stop us from trying to open it...?
entries.literal: "Katei said the alarm locked the door. You really think that was a lie to stop us from trying to open it...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: If that's it, he must have something to hide, probably on the computer.
entries.literal: "If that's it, he must have something to hide, probably on the computer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On top of the desk were three monitors. The one in the middle had its entire screen occupied by a messy program related to the security cameras, while both side monitors were only displaying the desktop.
entries.literal: "On top of the desk were three monitors. The one in the middle had its entire screen occupied by a messy program related to the security cameras, while both side monitors were only displaying the desktop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We got closer to them. There was a single chair in front of the middle screen that Atsuki gripped the back of.{w} He was going to sit on it, but he stopped short.
entries.literal: "We got closer to them. There was a single chair in front of the middle screen that Atsuki gripped the back of.{w} He was going to sit on it, but he stopped short."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We thought the lights had gone off until we saw only the screens had, which darkened the room considerably. The ones above, displaying the real time footage of the security cameras, were still working.
entries.literal: "We thought the lights had gone off until we saw only the screens had, which darkened the room considerably. The ones above, displaying the real time footage of the security cameras, were still working."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did the computer shut down?
entries.literal: "Did the computer shut down?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: The fans are still going. It probably entered sleep mode because it's been a while since anyone used it.
entries.literal: "The fans are still going. It probably entered sleep mode because it's been a while since anyone used it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hm.
entries.literal: "Hm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He grabbed the mouse, and as soon as he moved it, the three screens powered back on, showing the same images as before.
entries.literal: "He grabbed the mouse, and as soon as he moved it, the three screens powered back on, showing the same images as before."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Should I try to look at anything? We might get in trouble... If Katei's plan was to keep us out of this room, he won't be able to do so anymore.
entries.literal: "Should I try to look at anything? We might get in trouble... If Katei's plan was to keep us out of this room, he won't be able to do so anymore."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Maybe he wanted to find the key and lock the door before we realized it was open. You know, so we'd believe what he said about the alarm locking it.
entries.literal: "Maybe he wanted to find the key and lock the door before we realized it was open. You know, so we'd believe what he said about the alarm locking it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thanks to the taskbar, I noticed that a few programs were working in the background. Maybe something we couldn't see was hidden in one of them.
entries.literal: "Thanks to the taskbar, I noticed that a few programs were working in the background. Maybe something we couldn't see was hidden in one of them."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hey, isn't that weird?
entries.literal: "Hey, isn't that weird?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...What is?
entries.literal: "...What is?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind the chair, Erina was looking up at the live screens. They were showing different parts of the floor we were on, although a few of them displayed only a static, black image. According to Katei, that was due to the smoke covering them.
entries.literal: "Behind the chair, Erina was looking up at the live screens. They were showing different parts of the floor we were on, although a few of them displayed only a static, black image. According to Katei, that was due to the smoke covering them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But after looking at them for a few seconds, we noticed the large inconsistency Erina had seen.
entries.literal: "But after looking at them for a few seconds, we noticed the large inconsistency Erina had seen."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yeah, that one. It's showing hallway B.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that one. It's showing hallway B."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait, you're right. How is that possible...?
entries.literal: "Wait, you're right. How is that possible...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hallway B was clearly visible through one of the monitors. Although a bit of smoke obstructed the view, it wasn't enough to block it completely. The angle was from a corner above the door to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Hallway B was clearly visible through one of the monitors. Although a bit of smoke obstructed the view, it wasn't enough to block it completely. The angle was from a corner above the door to the lobby."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's basically where we fell unconscious. It's impossible the smoke didn't hit it as much as the other cameras. The difference is huge.
entries.literal: "That's basically where we fell unconscious. It's impossible the smoke didn't hit it as much as the other cameras. The difference is huge."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Something must be wrong about this, then... This has to be the live footage since the ceiling and walls are covered by smoke.
entries.literal: "Something must be wrong about this, then... This has to be the live footage since the ceiling and walls are covered by smoke."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It followed that the difference had to be the camera itself. We turned around and stepped back into hallway A. The silence told us that nobody was close to us, but it was unlikely that would continue for very long. Erina closed the security room behind her, causing a loud noise.
entries.literal: "It followed that the difference had to be the camera itself. We turned around and stepped back into hallway A. The silence told us that nobody was close to us, but it was unlikely that would continue for very long. Erina closed the security room behind her, causing a loud noise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The covered cabinet still sat awkwardly in the event room, which we passed through to enter hallway B.
entries.literal: "The covered cabinet still sat awkwardly in the event room, which we passed through to enter hallway B."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: It's that one.
entries.literal: "It's that one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the left corner, above the lobby door, was a security camera with a flickering green light.
entries.literal: "In the left corner, above the lobby door, was a security camera with a flickering green light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of us frowned. After all, it looked identical to the other ones, but with one very important distinction.
entries.literal: "All of us frowned. After all, it looked identical to the other ones, but with one very important distinction."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: There's almost no smoke on its lens... How's that even possible?
entries.literal: "There's almost no smoke on its lens... How's that even possible?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: The camera itself is obviously stained, so there's no way the lens wasn't hit directly by the smoke.
entries.literal: "The camera itself is obviously stained, so there's no way the lens wasn't hit directly by the smoke."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did someone clean it off?{w} I doubt anyone paid attention to this camera when we were here before, so we can't know how long it's been like this.
entries.literal: "Did someone clean it off?{w} I doubt anyone paid attention to this camera when we were here before, so we can't know how long it's been like this."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: If someone wiped off some of the smoke, it could only have been Katei or Naomi. I'm pretty sure Naomi was really knocked unconscious, so only Katei is left.
entries.literal: "If someone wiped off some of the smoke, it could only have been Katei or Naomi. I'm pretty sure Naomi was really knocked unconscious, so only Katei is left."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: M-Maybe Sai could have, if he faked waking up after me. I don't know how, though.
entries.literal: "M-Maybe Sai could have, if he faked waking up after me. I don't know how, though."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Why are you sure there's no one else here?
entries.literal: "Why are you sure there's no one else here?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: A hidden person could've done it too, yeah...
entries.literal: "A hidden person could've done it too, yeah..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We haven't seen anyone else, Isla. It's too high to reach it normally, and I think removing all the smoke stuck there would take some time.
entries.literal: "We haven't seen anyone else, Isla. It's too high to reach it normally, and I think removing all the smoke stuck there would take some time."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Maybe this is what Katei was hiding from us. I don't think we would have realized this lens was clean without going into the security room. It's black like the smoke, and there's very little light here.
entries.literal: "Maybe this is what Katei was hiding from us. I don't think we would have realized this lens was clean without going into the security room. It's black like the smoke, and there's very little light here."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yeah, and we noticed as soon as we took one look inside. That might make more sense than him only wanting us to not use the computer. He could've just ordered us to not touch it.
entries.literal: "Yeah, and we noticed as soon as we took one look inside. That might make more sense than him only wanting us to not use the computer. He could've just ordered us to not touch it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Do you seriously think he's behind this?
entries.literal: "Do you seriously think he's behind this?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't know, I just thought a few of his claims didn't make sense. Being a member of the security staff would let him pull some things off, though, so maybe.
entries.literal: "I don't know, I just thought a few of his claims didn't make sense. Being a member of the security staff would let him pull some things off, though, so maybe."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You two have to know about Xyn, right?
entries.literal: "You two have to know about Xyn, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yeah, Akaro talked about them briefly.
entries.literal: "Yeah, Akaro talked about them briefly."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm sure everyone who's aware of them has assumed they're involved in this. I wouldn't rule out this whole thing being some complicated plan, so keeping this camera working might be what they want.
entries.literal: "I'm sure everyone who's aware of them has assumed they're involved in this. I wouldn't rule out this whole thing being some complicated plan, so keeping this camera working might be what they want."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked to hallway C with a few things to question the others about. It didn't seem like they were trying to find us, as we would have immediately heard them calling.
entries.literal: "We walked to hallway C with a few things to question the others about. It didn't seem like they were trying to find us, as we would have immediately heard them calling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we arrived at the fourth floor, we still hadn't found anyone.
entries.literal: "When we arrived at the fourth floor, we still hadn't found anyone."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did they keep going without us?
entries.literal: "Did they keep going without us?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I guess so.
entries.literal: "I guess so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The bathrooms, where we'd last seen them, were open and empty. We circled through the floor and arrived on the fifth one for the first time.
entries.literal: "The bathrooms, where we'd last seen them, were open and empty. We circled through the floor and arrived on the fifth one for the first time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't look different from the others, and we couldn't see anyone. We repeated the same route we had on the lower floors, reaching the last one we had access to.
entries.literal: "It didn't look different from the others, and we couldn't see anyone. We repeated the same route we had on the lower floors, reaching the last one we had access to."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: The attic door should be here, so maybe they found a way to get in.
entries.literal: "The attic door should be here, so maybe they found a way to get in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went to the opposite corridor, where we found the entrance to the next floor. Although it looked like a dead end at first, a gray door came into view when we got closer.
entries.literal: "We went to the opposite corridor, where we found the entrance to the next floor. Although it looked like a dead end at first, a gray door came into view when we got closer."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yeah, this must lead to the attic.
entries.literal: "Yeah, this must lead to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Upon turning the knob, Erina realized the door was locked, like we'd been told.
entries.literal: "Upon turning the knob, Erina realized the door was locked, like we'd been told."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It can't be that they're inside. Maybe they followed us down and we missed each other.
entries.literal: "It can't be that they're inside. Maybe they followed us down and we missed each other."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A little lost, we walked back and stood in front of the offices. We hadn't checked the last few since it had seemed unlikely the others would've still been looking through them.
entries.literal: "A little lost, we walked back and stood in front of the offices. We hadn't checked the last few since it had seemed unlikely the others would've still been looking through them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki and I checked the third partition and didn't find anyone. Then, we opened the two bathrooms, which were also vacant.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and I checked the third partition and didn't find anyone. Then, we opened the two bathrooms, which were also vacant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The same was repeated on the fifth floor with identical results.
entries.literal: "The same was repeated on the fifth floor with identical results."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we were walking down to the fourth, we stumbled upon someone going up.
entries.literal: "When we were walking down to the fourth, we stumbled upon someone going up."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, here you are! I couldn't find you.
entries.literal: "Oh, here you are! I couldn't find you."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Are you alone...?
entries.literal: "Are you alone...?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I am. Where did you go? I was using the bathroom below and saw that nobody was still outside when I left.
entries.literal: "I am. Where did you go? I was using the bathroom below and saw that nobody was still outside when I left."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh? We found the key to the security room, so we went to the crystal floor. Katei and Sai didn't come with us, though.
entries.literal: "Huh? We found the key to the security room, so we went to the crystal floor. Katei and Sai didn't come with us, though."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I-I'm confused.{w} Why did you not wait for us? Did you actually open the security room?
entries.literal: "...I-I'm confused.{w} Why did you not wait for us? Did you actually open the security room?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes, that's why we'd like to find Katei.
entries.literal: "Yes, that's why we'd like to find Katei."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I see. I looked through the remaining floors since I imagined you all kept going up, but they were empty. I got to the Ashiya floor's door, which I couldn't open. After that, I walked back down to the crystal floor, but I haven't found anyone until now.
entries.literal: "...I see. I looked through the remaining floors since I imagined you all kept going up, but they were empty. I got to the Ashiya floor's door, which I couldn't open. After that, I walked back down to the crystal floor, but I haven't found anyone until now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It appeared we'd actually missed each other. Since we'd just looked through the floors above us, we kept descending.
entries.literal: "It appeared we'd actually missed each other. Since we'd just looked through the floors above us, we kept descending."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, here you are! Where the hell did you go?{w} And where's Katei?
entries.literal: "Oh, here you are! Where the hell did you go?{w} And where's Katei?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as we stepped onto the third floor, we reunited with Sai, who rapidly approached us.
entries.literal: "As soon as we stepped onto the third floor, we reunited with Sai, who rapidly approached us."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You're alone too? ...We found the key to the security room and went to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "You're alone too? ...We found the key to the security room and went to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Where did you find it?
entries.literal: "Where did you find it?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Atsuki saw it in this staircase.
entries.literal: "Atsuki saw it in this staircase."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh, I see, and you went to check if it worked?
entries.literal: "Huh, I see, and you went to check if it worked?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We nodded, awaiting his explanation.
entries.literal: "We nodded, awaiting his explanation."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suddenly saw you were all gone and didn't know if you'd walked down or toward the offices, but I figured I hadn't noticed you'd gone down the stairs.{w} ...I didn't find anyone when I went all the way down. I was gonna search through the first floor until I heard a sound coming from the stairs that I followed up here.
entries.literal: "I suddenly saw you were all gone and didn't know if you'd walked down or toward the offices, but I figured I hadn't noticed you'd gone down the stairs.{w} ...I didn't find anyone when I went all the way down. I was gonna search through the first floor until I heard a sound coming from the stairs that I followed up here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: So we missed you on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "So we missed you on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He shrugged.
entries.literal: "He shrugged."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I get what you're saying, though. You were able to open the security room.
entries.literal: "I get what you're saying, though. You were able to open the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before we could explain the more important details, another person appeared from the office corridor.
entries.literal: "Before we could explain the more important details, another person appeared from the office corridor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, here you are! I knew I'd probably missed you up here.
entries.literal: "Oh, here you are! I knew I'd probably missed you up here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Where were you?
entries.literal: "Where were you?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I should be the one asking that. I got out of the bathroom and saw that nobody was waiting outside. There was no one on the upper floors, so I went back down. I thought that maybe all of you went down to the crystal floor for some reason.
entries.literal: "I should be the one asking that. I got out of the bathroom and saw that nobody was waiting outside. There was no one on the upper floors, so I went back down. I thought that maybe all of you went down to the crystal floor for some reason."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It didn't seem like anyone was there, so I figured that I missed all of you inside the offices somewhere.
entries.literal: "It didn't seem like anyone was there, so I figured that I missed all of you inside the offices somewhere."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hm... We probably passed each other when I was looking alone through the higher floors.
entries.literal: "Hm... We probably passed each other when I was looking alone through the higher floors."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Well, why did you all leave...? Of course, nobody has seen Naomi, right?
entries.literal: "Well, why did you all leave...? Of course, nobody has seen Naomi, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm curious about something. Why exactly is it that we can't enter the security room?
entries.literal: "I'm curious about something. Why exactly is it that we can't enter the security room?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The security room? Didn't I mention it? The alarm locked it.
entries.literal: "The security room? Didn't I mention it? The alarm locked it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And there's no way to undo that lock?
entries.literal: "And there's no way to undo that lock?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No.
entries.literal: "No."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's surprising, seeing as they found the key and unlocked it.
entries.literal: "That's surprising, seeing as they found the key and unlocked it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.literal: "Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki took the silver key out of his pocket and showed it to him.
entries.literal: "Atsuki took the silver key out of his pocket and showed it to him."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What the hell? Of course I knew this key could unlock it, but where did you find it?
entries.literal: "...What the hell? Of course I knew this key could unlock it, but where did you find it?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: In this staircase.
entries.literal: "In this staircase."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's very strange. There aren't many keys like this one, and I left mine inside the security room without thinking about it. That's why I thought we'd have no way to enter again.
entries.literal: "That's very strange. There aren't many keys like this one, and I left mine inside the security room without thinking about it. That's why I thought we'd have no way to enter again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But you said that you left after the alarm played, right? You would've had to unlock the door to get out if the alarm locked it.
entries.literal: "But you said that you left after the alarm played, right? You would've had to unlock the door to get out if the alarm locked it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...No key is needed to unlock it from the inside, and after closing the door from the outside, it automatically locked itself again since I didn't disable many of the alarm's functions.
entries.literal: "...No key is needed to unlock it from the inside, and after closing the door from the outside, it automatically locked itself again since I didn't disable many of the alarm's functions."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm confused. Even though we found the key, we didn't use it to unlock the door. It was already unlocked.
entries.literal: "I'm confused. Even though we found the key, we didn't use it to unlock the door. It was already unlocked."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...{w}Excuse me?{w} That's not how it was programmed to work.{w} Regardless, is that why you suddenly left? To see if you could open the security room?
entries.literal: "...{w}Excuse me?{w} That's not how it was programmed to work.{w} Regardless, is that why you suddenly left? To see if you could open the security room?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: None of you are permitted to enter without my consent. Why was I not informed about the key?
entries.literal: "None of you are permitted to enter without my consent. Why was I not informed about the key?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sure it was because of all the stuff you've said. I would've done the same thing. It appears the door being locked is just another false claim of yours.
entries.literal: "I'm sure it was because of all the stuff you've said. I would've done the same thing. It appears the door being locked is just another false claim of yours."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What?{w} What is wrong with what I've said?{w} And that must've been a malfunction in the alarm. I had no way to confirm the lock was set when I left since the inner knob undoes it by itself, and I didn't check behind me to see if it locked automatically. It should have, but it appears it didn't.
entries.literal: "What?{w} What is wrong with what I've said?{w} And that must've been a malfunction in the alarm. I had no way to confirm the lock was set when I left since the inner knob undoes it by itself, and I didn't check behind me to see if it locked automatically. It should have, but it appears it didn't."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose that's not too ridiculous.
entries.literal: "I suppose that's not too ridiculous."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Wait a second. We can enter the security room! Why the hell are we talking about this!? Now we have a way to communicate with the outside. I said the alarm shut it down because I thought it locked the way in. We'll be able to look at the recorded footage as well!
entries.literal: "...Wait a second. We can enter the security room! Why the hell are we talking about this!? Now we have a way to communicate with the outside. I said the alarm shut it down because I thought it locked the way in. We'll be able to look at the recorded footage as well!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh, that's fantastic. Let's go, then.
entries.literal: "Oh, that's fantastic. Let's go, then."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Although, it wouldn't exactly have been the alarm to have cut off our access to it. It would've been your ineptitude for not bringing your key out with you.
entries.literal: "Although, it wouldn't exactly have been the alarm to have cut off our access to it. It would've been your ineptitude for not bringing your key out with you."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I can't deny that. It was my mistake.
entries.literal: "...I can't deny that. It was my mistake."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And yet an identical key was found up here. We'll see if you can find yours inside the room.
entries.literal: "And yet an identical key was found up here. We'll see if you can find yours inside the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei nodded slowly and began to walk back. When the conversation ceased and the rest of us followed in silence, I glanced over at Atsuki. His brief bout of investigation had been just that: brief. Emptiness was the only thing written on his face whenever he wasn't pursuing some thought.
entries.literal: "Katei nodded slowly and began to walk back. When the conversation ceased and the rest of us followed in silence, I glanced over at Atsuki. His brief bout of investigation had been just that: brief. Emptiness was the only thing written on his face whenever he wasn't pursuing some thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody next to him had a clue how he was feeling, and he'd decided to at least pass himself off as stable. His initiative from before had been a tad surprising, but it was clear that his mind was someplace else entirely.
entries.literal: "Nobody next to him had a clue how he was feeling, and he'd decided to at least pass himself off as stable. His initiative from before had been a tad surprising, but it was clear that his mind was someplace else entirely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With how strong those emotions were supposed to be, adopting a made-up expression of sorrow was pathetically easy. Out of recent habit, the sight of his face made my own a mirror, and I let my shoulders drop.
entries.literal: "With how strong those emotions were supposed to be, adopting a made-up expression of sorrow was pathetically easy. Out of recent habit, the sight of his face made my own a mirror, and I let my shoulders drop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were walking down the stairs that led to the second floor when Sai's voice brought us to a halt.
entries.literal: "We were walking down the stairs that led to the second floor when Sai's voice brought us to a halt."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, how many keys do you have?
entries.literal: "Katei, how many keys do you have?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He turned around, staring at Sai uncertainly.
entries.literal: "He turned around, staring at Sai uncertainly."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's not too hard of a question, is it?
entries.literal: "That's not too hard of a question, is it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We understood the reason behind it. As soon as Katei began to walk down the stairs, conspicuous, metallic noises came from him.
entries.literal: "We understood the reason behind it. As soon as Katei began to walk down the stairs, conspicuous, metallic noises came from him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Earlier, you did have a few keys, but the sound you were making just now was significantly different. Like they'd doubled in number, even.
entries.literal: "Earlier, you did have a few keys, but the sound you were making just now was significantly different. Like they'd doubled in number, even."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're out of your mind.
entries.literal: "You're out of your mind."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Perhaps, which is why I'm asking.
entries.literal: "Perhaps, which is why I'm asking."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What exactly is the issue? I am entrusted with many keys so that my job goes smoothly.
entries.literal: "What exactly is the issue? I am entrusted with many keys so that my job goes smoothly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Like I said, the issue is that it sounded like you have more now. Did you recently come across a few?
entries.literal: "Like I said, the issue is that it sounded like you have more now. Did you recently come across a few?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No.
entries.literal: "No."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm intrigued, then. Care to show them? Maybe I'm going insane.
entries.literal: "I'm intrigued, then. Care to show them? Maybe I'm going insane."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'd rather not. These aren't keys visitors are supposed to have.
entries.literal: "I'd rather not. These aren't keys visitors are supposed to have."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you miss the word "show"? I'm not going to take any.
entries.literal: "Did you miss the word \"show\"? I'm not going to take any."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seeing that he was against the request, Sai took two steps forward.
entries.literal: "Seeing that he was against the request, Sai took two steps forward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although it was Katei who looked down on him, with a quick motion, Sai rapidly snaked his hand in and out of Katei's deep pocket, where the metallic sound had come from.
entries.literal: "Although it was Katei who looked down on him, with a quick motion, Sai rapidly snaked his hand in and out of Katei's deep pocket, where the metallic sound had come from."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Hey!
entries.literal: "Hey!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With one finger, Sai was holding a keyring with four keys on it.
entries.literal: "With one finger, Sai was holding a keyring with four keys on it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose these would make the noise. Why did you not want to show them to us?
entries.literal: "I suppose these would make the noise. Why did you not want to show them to us?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Because I didn't feel like humoring your condescending attitude. Are you satisfied now?
entries.literal: "Because I didn't feel like humoring your condescending attitude. Are you satisfied now?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hardly. What do they open? And what's this thing? ...Tape?
entries.literal: "Hardly. What do they open? And what's this thing? ...Tape?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Stuck on the keyring was a dark, tiny piece of material. When he separated it from the keys, we identified it as duct tape, and it had smoke residue on it.
entries.literal: "Stuck on the keyring was a dark, tiny piece of material. When he separated it from the keys, we identified it as duct tape, and it had smoke residue on it."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Wait, isn't that one...?
entries.literal: "Wait, isn't that one...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the keys and looked at them on my palm.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the keys and looked at them on my palm."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes, the Sekimeiya cabinet's. This is the keyring Naomi had.
entries.literal: "Yes, the Sekimeiya cabinet's. This is the keyring Naomi had."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, wouldn't that explain it?
entries.literal: "Oh, wouldn't that explain it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Naomi's keyring? That's a big leap you're making. This is my own, with the same keys Naomi has.
entries.literal: "Naomi's keyring? That's a big leap you're making. This is my own, with the same keys Naomi has."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure?
entries.literal: "Are you sure?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, I am aware of the keys I'm given. This was the original set, in fact. Naomi was given a replica of it since her job was recently expanded.
entries.literal: "Yes, I am aware of the keys I'm given. This was the original set, in fact. Naomi was given a replica of it since her job was recently expanded."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, all these keys belong to you and you didn't find it just now.
entries.literal: "So, all these keys belong to you and you didn't find it just now."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You do understand there's a simple way to prove whether you're lying, right?
entries.literal: "You do understand there's a simple way to prove whether you're lying, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. You don't get it.{w} You're claiming these are yours, am I right? You didn't just come across Naomi whatsoever.
entries.literal: "I see. You don't get it.{w} You're claiming these are yours, am I right? You didn't just come across Naomi whatsoever."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...You're being very irritating. How do you intend to prove whatever accusation you're making?
entries.literal: "...You're being very irritating. How do you intend to prove whatever accusation you're making?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not a definitive way, but earlier, you said that Naomi has the attic key and you don't.
entries.literal: "It's not a definitive way, but earlier, you said that Naomi has the attic key and you don't."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: sai
