entries.text: So, if one of these keys opens the attic, we can confirm you're lying, which I was already fairly certain of. How does that sound?
entries.literal: "So, if one of these keys opens the attic, we can confirm you're lying, which I was already fairly certain of. How does that sound?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I think this one might fit in the keyhole we saw.
entries.literal: "I think this one might fit in the keyhole we saw."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This one? It's definitely the odd one out. I'm glad Naomi didn't keep it separated.
entries.literal: "This one? It's definitely the odd one out. I'm glad Naomi didn't keep it separated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai turned around and started walking up the stairs. Even though going to the security room was a priority, nobody stopped him.
entries.literal: "Sai turned around and started walking up the stairs. Even though going to the security room was a priority, nobody stopped him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If he was right, and Katei had recently obtained that keyring, he knew exactly where Naomi was and had been given those keys after constructing the illusion that the attic was only accessible for her.
entries.literal: "If he was right, and Katei had recently obtained that keyring, he knew exactly where Naomi was and had been given those keys after constructing the illusion that the attic was only accessible for her."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What are you even trying to prove? There are quite a few things I'm simply not allowed to speak about.
entries.literal: "...What are you even trying to prove? There are quite a few things I'm simply not allowed to speak about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As we were reaching the sixth floor, Katei's mumbles stopped Sai.
entries.literal: "As we were reaching the sixth floor, Katei's mumbles stopped Sai."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you implying that you didn't tell us you had the key for the attic so that we wouldn't try to access it?
entries.literal: "Are you implying that you didn't tell us you had the key for the attic so that we wouldn't try to access it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm implying that you're vastly overstepping.
entries.literal: "I'm implying that you're vastly overstepping."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That might sound intimidating if you hadn't lied so much already.
entries.literal: "That might sound intimidating if you hadn't lied so much already."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You are merely assuming that.
entries.literal: "You are merely assuming that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course, I can't prove that the security room didn't stay open because of an error, so yeah, I will assume that was something you said to temporarily cover your ass.
entries.literal: "Of course, I can't prove that the security room didn't stay open because of an error, so yeah, I will assume that was something you said to temporarily cover your ass."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...You will end up regretting all this.
entries.literal: "...You will end up regretting all this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai ignored him and looked at his side, where the elevator was. He approached it and pressed the circular button, which Katei had assured us would do nothing earlier.
entries.literal: "Sai ignored him and looked at his side, where the elevator was. He approached it and pressed the circular button, which Katei had assured us would do nothing earlier."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I might as well check if the elevator is still working due to another error since it seems your claims can be ignored.
entries.literal: "I might as well check if the elevator is still working due to another error since it seems your claims can be ignored."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...The elevator was disabled. That's much more unlikely to have gone wrong. If it was working for some reason, the button would light up when it arrived.
entries.literal: "...The elevator was disabled. That's much more unlikely to have gone wrong. If it was working for some reason, the button would light up when it arrived."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Do you remember the lights in the lobby? That was also caused by the alarm, so it appears the security room was the single exception.
entries.literal: "...Do you remember the lights in the lobby? That was also caused by the alarm, so it appears the security room was the single exception."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai accepted that Katei was probably right in that instance and kept walking.
entries.literal: "Sai accepted that Katei was probably right in that instance and kept walking."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After making it around the floor, we stood in front of the sturdy-looking door.
entries.literal: "After making it around the floor, we stood in front of the sturdy-looking door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I picked the key that seemed to fit and inserted it into the keyhole. After a turn, the door was unlocked.{w} Sai wasted no time in opening it and looking within.
entries.literal: "I picked the key that seemed to fit and inserted it into the keyhole. After a turn, the door was unlocked.{w} Sai wasted no time in opening it and looking within."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I will give you all a warning. Do not enter this place. This is a very special floor that must not ever be accessed by visitors.
entries.literal: "I will give you all a warning. Do not enter this place. This is a very special floor that must not ever be accessed by visitors."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me tell you what's actually happening now. Given how likely it is that Naomi's in this place and you were planning to enter it freely, we're going to ignore your warning.
entries.literal: "Let me tell you what's actually happening now. Given how likely it is that Naomi's in this place and you were planning to enter it freely, we're going to ignore your warning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, even though Katei looked around at everyone, nobody stepped forward to side with him.
entries.literal: "Once again, even though Katei looked around at everyone, nobody stepped forward to side with him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Naomi must be in this building, and if she hasn't shown herself yet, she must want to keep on hiding. You said you wanted to find her too, right? Regardless of whether the two of you are working together, she's probably here. We just confirmed the elevator's not working, so she's cornered.
entries.literal: "Naomi must be in this building, and if she hasn't shown herself yet, she must want to keep on hiding. You said you wanted to find her too, right? Regardless of whether the two of you are working together, she's probably here. We just confirmed the elevator's not working, so she's cornered."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I can't believe what I'm hearing. Go ahead and screw yourselves over, but don't be surprised by the consequences.
entries.literal: "I can't believe what I'm hearing. Go ahead and screw yourselves over, but don't be surprised by the consequences."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without a second thought, Sai went past the door and began to climb up a dark staircase.
entries.literal: "Without a second thought, Sai went past the door and began to climb up a dark staircase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We followed behind him, forming a single-file line within the narrow space. Sai stopped at the top, in front of another closed door.
entries.literal: "We followed behind him, forming a single-file line within the narrow space. Sai stopped at the top, in front of another closed door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After applying force to open it, we could make out the room in front of him. Atsuki and I were behind, so the three of us were first to see what was on the sofa.
entries.literal: "After applying force to open it, we could make out the room in front of him. Atsuki and I were behind, so the three of us were first to see what was on the sofa."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whoa, what's that doing there? ...Is it the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Whoa, what's that doing there? ...Is it the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Y-Yes.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd only described its appearance to the people who hadn't seen it, but a bright egg was exactly what was resting on the sofa.
entries.literal: "We'd only described its appearance to the people who hadn't seen it, but a bright egg was exactly what was resting on the sofa."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What? Was it brought here?
entries.literal: "What? Was it brought here?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do you really see the Sekimeiya in there? Why are you not going in?
entries.literal: "Do you really see the Sekimeiya in there? Why are you not going in?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wait. The floor has recent footprints on it, and someone was here not long ago.
entries.literal: "Wait. The floor has recent footprints on it, and someone was here not long ago."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You don't say. If the Sekimeiya's there, someone had to have just brought it up.{w} Oh, that could be really bad...! It needs to be put in its cabinet immediately! Please, step aside.
entries.literal: "You don't say. If the Sekimeiya's there, someone had to have just brought it up.{w} Oh, that could be really bad...! It needs to be put in its cabinet immediately! Please, step aside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Do you think these footprints make any sense?
entries.literal: "...{w}Do you think these footprints make any sense?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked at the two of us.{w} I stared at the floor, trying to understand what he was getting at. A few seconds later, neither of us had responded.
entries.literal: "He looked at the two of us.{w} I stared at the floor, trying to understand what he was getting at. A few seconds later, neither of us had responded."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's a little hard to see. Maybe I'm misinterpreting them.
entries.literal: "It's a little hard to see. Maybe I'm misinterpreting them."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Can you go in so we can see what you mean?
entries.literal: "Can you go in so we can see what you mean?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Are you talking about the faded ones?
entries.literal: "Are you talking about the faded ones?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. They don't continue, and not only those.
entries.literal: "Yeah. They don't continue, and not only those."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Please, let me get through. The Sekimeiya has to be brought down...! I already told you how important that is.
entries.literal: "Please, let me get through. The Sekimeiya has to be brought down...! I already told you how important that is."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the floor again. The fuzzy carpet had preserved the more recent footprints, so the movements of the person who'd been there were recorded. It didn't seem like there was a security camera anywhere, so the footprints were our only indication.
entries.literal: "I looked at the floor again. The fuzzy carpet had preserved the more recent footprints, so the movements of the person who'd been there were recorded. It didn't seem like there was a security camera anywhere, so the footprints were our only indication."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a line of them going from our door to the sofa, and it looked like it had been traversed more than once. From the sofa, a single pair of footprints went to a door, and from there, they came back to where we were.
entries.literal: "There was a line of them going from our door to the sofa, and it looked like it had been traversed more than once. From the sofa, a single pair of footprints went to a door, and from there, they came back to where we were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai took a large step forward, trying to cover up the least possible existing footprints. Atsuki and I did the same.
entries.literal: "Sai took a large step forward, trying to cover up the least possible existing footprints. Atsuki and I did the same."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're right...! It's the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "You're right...! It's the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as he saw it, he rushed over but stopped abruptly at the sofa.
entries.literal: "As soon as he saw it, he rushed over but stopped abruptly at the sofa."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh...! It's pretty.
entries.literal: "Oh...! It's pretty."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Stop! None of you must touch it. That could make things even worse.
entries.literal: "Stop! None of you must touch it. That could make things even worse."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It doesn't seem damaged to me. Is that not how it usually looks?
entries.literal: "It doesn't seem damaged to me. Is that not how it usually looks?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina, Isla, and Akaro joined us on the left side, beside the footprints Katei had run over.
entries.literal: "Erina, Isla, and Akaro joined us on the left side, beside the footprints Katei had run over."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Are you sure it would damage it? Naomi said we could touch it.
entries.literal: "Are you sure it would damage it? Naomi said we could touch it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Under normal circumstances, yes. Have you not heard what I've been saying? The cabinet downstairs provides it with a cold temperature. If you were to touch it with your bare skin, it would heat it up even more, and that could be dangerous.
entries.literal: "Under normal circumstances, yes. Have you not heard what I've been saying? The cabinet downstairs provides it with a cold temperature. If you were to touch it with your bare skin, it would heat it up even more, and that could be dangerous."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So was it not you who left it here?
entries.literal: "So was it not you who left it here?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-What!? Of course not!
entries.literal: "Wh-What!? Of course not!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, your footprints are pretty much identical to the ones you just stepped on, and you had the key to enter.
entries.literal: "Well, your footprints are pretty much identical to the ones you just stepped on, and you had the key to enter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei frowned and looked at his feet. The footprints did look fairly recent, so it was easy to notice the resemblance.
entries.literal: "Katei frowned and looked at his feet. The footprints did look fairly recent, so it was easy to notice the resemblance."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's ridiculous. Look at Akaro's. You can't tell me they're any different.
entries.literal: "That's ridiculous. Look at Akaro's. You can't tell me they're any different."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And out of you two, who could've entered this place?
entries.literal: "And out of you two, who could've entered this place?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Neither of us, probably. To get the Sekimeiya here, I would've had to go to the crystal floor, up to the attic, and then back down. All without taking the elevator, and you all remember I appeared from below where you were. There's no way I would've had enough time.{w} Are you forgetting Naomi? She's the only person who could have left these footprints unless she gave her key to someone else. I can't believe she'd leave the Sekimeiya here. She knew full well about the cold it needs.
entries.literal: "Neither of us, probably. To get the Sekimeiya here, I would've had to go to the crystal floor, up to the attic, and then back down. All without taking the elevator, and you all remember I appeared from below where you were. There's no way I would've had enough time.{w} Are you forgetting Naomi? She's the only person who could have left these footprints unless she gave her key to someone else. I can't believe she'd leave the Sekimeiya here. She knew full well about the cold it needs."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I really don't believe these are Naomi's. According to you, she could still be here, right? Where do these two doors go?
entries.literal: "I really don't believe these are Naomi's. According to you, she could still be here, right? Where do these two doors go?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That one goes to the kitchen, and that's the hallway.
entries.literal: "That one goes to the kitchen, and that's the hallway."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}It's still visible: under the more recent footprints, there are other ones, much harder to notice and smaller in size. Like the rest, they go from the entrance to the sofa, where the Sekimeiya is.
entries.literal: "...{w}It's still visible: under the more recent footprints, there are other ones, much harder to notice and smaller in size. Like the rest, they go from the entrance to the sofa, where the Sekimeiya is."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Oh, you're right, that one's different.
entries.literal: "...Oh, you're right, that one's different."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I would assume they're from when the Sekimeiya was left on the sofa, but that can't be it. It should have still been on the crystal floor then.{w} What bugs me is they don't seem to continue. Once they get to the sofa, they don't go anywhere else. I don't believe they go back to the door either, but I might be missing the returning ones. Now that Katei walked over them, it's even harder to tell.{w} It's still somewhat possible to distinguish the size and direction they're facing. Without a doubt, they don't belong to the same person who left the other ones. That's Katei, if you were wondering.
entries.literal: "I would assume they're from when the Sekimeiya was left on the sofa, but that can't be it. It should have still been on the crystal floor then.{w} What bugs me is they don't seem to continue. Once they get to the sofa, they don't go anywhere else. I don't believe they go back to the door either, but I might be missing the returning ones. Now that Katei walked over them, it's even harder to tell.{w} It's still somewhat possible to distinguish the size and direction they're facing. Without a doubt, they don't belong to the same person who left the other ones. That's Katei, if you were wondering."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What kind of movie are you making in your head?
entries.literal: "What kind of movie are you making in your head?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You went to the sofa and probably placed the Sekimeiya there. Perhaps there was something else sitting on there that the previous person left behind. Then, you went through that hallway door, and you later came back to leave through the main door.
entries.literal: "You went to the sofa and probably placed the Sekimeiya there. Perhaps there was something else sitting on there that the previous person left behind. Then, you went through that hallway door, and you later came back to leave through the main door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: However, this doesn't make sense either. Going off the number of footprints, it seems like you went from the door to the sofa twice, but only once from the sofa to the hallway. What the hell happened there? You didn't jump to the kitchen, did you?
entries.literal: "However, this doesn't make sense either. Going off the number of footprints, it seems like you went from the door to the sofa twice, but only once from the sofa to the hallway. What the hell happened there? You didn't jump to the kitchen, did you?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is the most preposterous thing I have ever heard! We have to go back down right now.
entries.literal: "This is the most preposterous thing I have ever heard! We have to go back down right now."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I thought you wanted to find Naomi. Like I said, the older footprints don't seem to leave through the door, and the elevator doesn't work. That means she's probably still here.
entries.literal: "I thought you wanted to find Naomi. Like I said, the older footprints don't seem to leave through the door, and the elevator doesn't work. That means she's probably still here."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is a very small place. It shouldn't take more than half a minute to confirm it.
entries.literal: "This is a very small place. It shouldn't take more than half a minute to confirm it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}By the way, what's this smell?
entries.literal: "...{w}By the way, what's this smell?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I was wondering that. It's a bit strong.
entries.literal: "I was wondering that. It's a bit strong."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know. These rooms are pretty much abandoned, so it must be something from here. It's not that bad.
entries.literal: "I don't know. These rooms are pretty much abandoned, so it must be something from here. It's not that bad."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Hm...{w} I feel like I've smelled it before, but I don't know where.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} I feel like I've smelled it before, but I don't know where."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Really?
entries.literal: "Really?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...I might be imagining it.
entries.literal: "...I might be imagining it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai tried to power on the TV, but it didn't seem functional. He opened the hallway door next, evidently unconcerned about stepping over the footprints any further.
entries.literal: "Sai tried to power on the TV, but it didn't seem functional. He opened the hallway door next, evidently unconcerned about stepping over the footprints any further."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, let's see if Naomi's here. Come on.
entries.literal: "Well, let's see if Naomi's here. Come on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every room was quickly checked. The entire attic was arranged like a modest apartment, but it was well-preserved, probably thanks to Naomi.
entries.literal: "Every room was quickly checked. The entire attic was arranged like a modest apartment, but it was well-preserved, probably thanks to Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I finished at the higher level of the left bedroom. Aside from the bedrooms, there was only a bathroom, the kitchen, and an empty storage room with no light. Surprisingly, there were security cameras even in the bedrooms.
entries.literal: "I finished at the higher level of the left bedroom. Aside from the bedrooms, there was only a bathroom, the kitchen, and an empty storage room with no light. Surprisingly, there were security cameras even in the bedrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And Naomi was nowhere to be found. To make sure she couldn't have left unseen, Katei and Akaro waited in the hallway and living room respectively. We could be certain the attic was empty by the time we arrived.
entries.literal: "And Naomi was nowhere to be found. To make sure she couldn't have left unseen, Katei and Akaro waited in the hallway and living room respectively. We could be certain the attic was empty by the time we arrived."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of us reunited.
entries.literal: "All of us reunited."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't get it either. What the hell is Naomi doing...?
entries.literal: "I don't get it either. What the hell is Naomi doing...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're right. It's bizarre, but only because of the footprints I pointed out.{w} You have Naomi's keyring, so you must know where she is. In addition, it seems like your own footprints did the same as hers at least one of the times they went from the entrance to the sofa.
entries.literal: "You're right. It's bizarre, but only because of the footprints I pointed out.{w} You have Naomi's keyring, so you must know where she is. In addition, it seems like your own footprints did the same as hers at least one of the times they went from the entrance to the sofa."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I will repeat myself. Those were not mine.
entries.literal: "I will repeat myself. Those were not mine."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Honestly, the question is there no matter who they belonged to. From the sofa, the only way to stop the footprints would be by jumping to the kitchen, which isn't carpeted.
entries.literal: "Honestly, the question is there no matter who they belonged to. From the sofa, the only way to stop the footprints would be by jumping to the kitchen, which isn't carpeted."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, he turned around and entered the hallway.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, he turned around and entered the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I peeked in and saw him walking toward the elevator.
entries.literal: "I peeked in and saw him walking toward the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He grabbed its handle and tried to open it. Just like on the crystal floor, it didn't budge.
entries.literal: "He grabbed its handle and tried to open it. Just like on the crystal floor, it didn't budge."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I already checked if it was here.
entries.literal: "I already checked if it was here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once some silent seconds had passed, he pressed the elevator button, sighing after nothing occurred.
entries.literal: "Once some silent seconds had passed, he pressed the elevator button, sighing after nothing occurred."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This doesn't make any sense. Unless I misinterpreted it, the person who left the footprints should still be here. Maybe even two people.{w} Was it a trick in case we noticed them? What if the first person stayed on the sofa, and when Katei came, they exited through the main door, stepping over his footprints and taking advantage of the bigger shoe size?
entries.literal: "This doesn't make any sense. Unless I misinterpreted it, the person who left the footprints should still be here. Maybe even two people.{w} Was it a trick in case we noticed them? What if the first person stayed on the sofa, and when Katei came, they exited through the main door, stepping over his footprints and taking advantage of the bigger shoe size?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone went quiet. To Sai, it probably seemed like we found what he was saying to be a bit of a reach.
entries.literal: "Everyone went quiet. To Sai, it probably seemed like we found what he was saying to be a bit of a reach."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I know that still doesn't explain the set of Katei's footprints that didn't continue, but that could've been fabricated by him all at once if he wanted to make it seem like he walked to the sofa twice.
entries.literal: "...I know that still doesn't explain the set of Katei's footprints that didn't continue, but that could've been fabricated by him all at once if he wanted to make it seem like he walked to the sofa twice."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody said anything in response. When he realized we were all staring at something, he turned around to find the spot but failed to notice anything important.
entries.literal: "Nobody said anything in response. When he realized we were all staring at something, he turned around to find the spot but failed to notice anything important."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the hell are you all looking at?
entries.literal: "What the hell are you all looking at?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...The button. It lit up for a second, right?
entries.literal: "...The button. It lit up for a second, right?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah!
entries.literal: "Yeah!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It did.
entries.literal: "It did."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Again, he grabbed the handle and pulled it toward him.
entries.literal: "Again, he grabbed the handle and pulled it toward him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We heard and saw the elevator opening. Pressing the button had brought it to the attic, and its interior was empty.
entries.literal: "We heard and saw the elevator opening. Pressing the button had brought it to the attic, and its interior was empty."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh, it's working! Now we can use it.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's working! Now we can use it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Of course. They just left with the elevator. It has to be that.{w} Katei!
entries.literal: "...Of course. They just left with the elevator. It has to be that.{w} Katei!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We heard a sigh coming from the living room and subsequently footsteps approaching.
entries.literal: "We heard a sigh coming from the living room and subsequently footsteps approaching."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, the elevator was here?
entries.literal: "Oh, the elevator was here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, the elevator was not here. I just called it, and it arrived.
entries.literal: "No, the elevator was not here. I just called it, and it arrived."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? That's not possible.
entries.literal: "What? That's not possible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They all saw it. The elevator is working.
entries.literal: "They all saw it. The elevator is working."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But it wasn't a few minutes ago. We just tested it.
entries.literal: "But it wasn't a few minutes ago. We just tested it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Could the alarm not have affected the attic's button?
entries.literal: "Could the alarm not have affected the attic's button?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...No, it did.
entries.literal: "...No, it did."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I believe you're lying again. After all, your footprints indicated that you escaped from here the same way the other ones did, and it could only have been with the elevator.
entries.literal: "I believe you're lying again. After all, your footprints indicated that you escaped from here the same way the other ones did, and it could only have been with the elevator."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I will choose to stop playing along with you. However, if the elevator is really working, I can only think of one explanation that makes sense.{w} ...That it was just enabled, minutes or seconds ago, while we were all here.
entries.literal: "I will choose to stop playing along with you. However, if the elevator is really working, I can only think of one explanation that makes sense.{w} ...That it was just enabled, minutes or seconds ago, while we were all here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, I see. It just turned on magically. That tracks.
entries.literal: "Oh, I see. It just turned on magically. That tracks."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Have you forgotten about Naomi again? She still has to be somewhere. Not only that, you left the security room open, and she might've had enough information to know how to revert some effects of the alarm.
entries.literal: "Have you forgotten about Naomi again? She still has to be somewhere. Not only that, you left the security room open, and she might've had enough information to know how to revert some effects of the alarm."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}You're so stupid.
entries.literal: "...{w}You're so stupid."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course, if the elevator was enabled just now, Naomi, who most likely left the initial footprints, couldn't have escaped this place.
entries.literal: "Of course, if the elevator was enabled just now, Naomi, who most likely left the initial footprints, couldn't have escaped this place."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: However, you just said "you left the security room open".
entries.literal: "However, you just said \"you left the security room open\"."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Have you forgotten about the lie you told us earlier? You said that after closing the door of the security room, it would lock itself automatically.
entries.literal: "Have you forgotten about the lie you told us earlier? You said that after closing the door of the security room, it would lock itself automatically."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, did you just assume they didn't close the door after leaving? Did you see it open, maybe?
entries.literal: "So, did you just assume they didn't close the door after leaving? Did you see it open, maybe?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm pretty sure we did close it when we left.
entries.literal: "I'm pretty sure we did close it when we left."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I know it was closed when I went back up—that's why I'm saying all this. And of course, it didn't lock itself automatically, which is why he said that you'd left it open, completely ignoring the contradictory claim he made earlier to cover his previous lie up.
entries.literal: "I know it was closed when I went back up—that's why I'm saying all this. And of course, it didn't lock itself automatically, which is why he said that you'd left it open, completely ignoring the contradictory claim he made earlier to cover his previous lie up."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I'm not sure why you sound so excited.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure why you sound so excited."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, am I wrong?
entries.literal: "So, am I wrong?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're on a wrong streak. We already determined earlier that the alarm underwent an error and didn't lock the security room after I left, did we not?{w} Why would I assume that it worked after they closed it? I figured the error probably repeated, and the door wouldn't have locked itself even if they closed it.
entries.literal: "You're on a wrong streak. We already determined earlier that the alarm underwent an error and didn't lock the security room after I left, did we not?{w} Why would I assume that it worked after they closed it? I figured the error probably repeated, and the door wouldn't have locked itself even if they closed it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know what your problem is, but cut it out. As I said, Naomi might've just reenabled the elevator.
entries.literal: "I don't know what your problem is, but cut it out. As I said, Naomi might've just reenabled the elevator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How do you pretend to explain the footprints, then?
entries.literal: "How do you pretend to explain the footprints, then?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Hell if I know. I barely get what you're talking about, and I'm inclined to believe it's another delusion of yours.
entries.literal: "Hell if I know. I barely get what you're talking about, and I'm inclined to believe it's another delusion of yours."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Now, for the love of God, let's go to the crystal floor. Naomi might be there, and the Sekimeiya needs to be put in the cabinet. We have to contact the outside as well.
entries.literal: "Now, for the love of God, let's go to the crystal floor. Naomi might be there, and the Sekimeiya needs to be put in the cabinet. We have to contact the outside as well."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: All right! We'll take the elevator!
entries.literal: "All right! We'll take the elevator!"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, not all of us will be able to at once. Only four people can use it.
entries.literal: "Oh, not all of us will be able to at once. Only four people can use it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as she heard that, Isla rushed inside, dragging Erina by her shirt.
entries.literal: "As soon as she heard that, Isla rushed inside, dragging Erina by her shirt."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Me. I'm going. E-le-va-tor.
entries.literal: "Me. I'm going. E-le-va-tor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You still have the attic key, right?
entries.literal: "You still have the attic key, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We'll walk down, then. It's very important that this floor remains locked, even if Naomi has her own key. I don't want any of you coming in without my knowledge.
entries.literal: "We'll walk down, then. It's very important that this floor remains locked, even if Naomi has her own key. I don't want any of you coming in without my knowledge."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sure.
entries.literal: "Sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Akaro entered the elevator.
entries.literal: "Sai and Akaro entered the elevator."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Hurry up and leave now. You won't be able to make it back up without the key. As you see, it is required to enable the floor 7 button. We won't leave until you're gone.
entries.literal: "Hurry up and leave now. You won't be able to make it back up without the key. As you see, it is required to enable the floor 7 button. We won't leave until you're gone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai rolled his eyes and let go of the door. A few seconds later, Katei checked that the elevator had left. He spent a few seconds in thought before lightly pushing my and Atsuki's shoulders back.
entries.literal: "Sai rolled his eyes and let go of the door. A few seconds later, Katei checked that the elevator had left. He spent a few seconds in thought before lightly pushing my and Atsuki's shoulders back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since he had left the living room, Atsuki went there through the kitchen, confirming that the attic was empty, although it was clear that nobody had gone there just by looking at the floor's footprints.
entries.literal: "Since he had left the living room, Atsuki went there through the kitchen, confirming that the attic was empty, although it was clear that nobody had gone there just by looking at the floor's footprints."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei stared at the Sekimeiya for a few seconds. Then, he crouched to lift it up and held it in his hands using the long sleeves of his uniform.
entries.literal: "Katei stared at the Sekimeiya for a few seconds. Then, he crouched to lift it up and held it in his hands using the long sleeves of his uniform."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Let's go.
entries.literal: "Let's go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We carefully went down the dark staircase. Outside, I took the keyring out of my purse and locked the door.
entries.literal: "We carefully went down the dark staircase. Outside, I took the keyring out of my purse and locked the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through the silence, we descended. I caught a glimpse of Atsuki's face again. I'd been trying to avoid looking at it.
entries.literal: "Through the silence, we descended. I caught a glimpse of Atsuki's face again. I'd been trying to avoid looking at it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Usually, I figured he would've taken Sai much more seriously, but he'd hardly appeared to care about what the guy said. His suspicion toward Katei wasn't the indicator I'd been waiting for.
entries.literal: "Usually, I figured he would've taken Sai much more seriously, but he'd hardly appeared to care about what the guy said. His suspicion toward Katei wasn't the indicator I'd been waiting for."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How much longer would I have to play along for? Ever since she'd exited our lives, I'd kept telling myself that it would all eventually go back to how it was at the beginning. However, dealing with his attitude until then and with my parents in the background was way too frustrating.
entries.literal: "How much longer would I have to play along for? Ever since she'd exited our lives, I'd kept telling myself that it would all eventually go back to how it was at the beginning. However, dealing with his attitude until then and with my parents in the background was way too frustrating."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were living in his house, which had been his immediate idea. If it weren't for that, I would've assumed his mental state wasn't going to get better any time soon and that he wanted to remain alone.
entries.literal: "We were living in his house, which had been his immediate idea. If it weren't for that, I would've assumed his mental state wasn't going to get better any time soon and that he wanted to remain alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind Atsuki was Katei, who my focus switched to. His face was hardly a more pleasant sight, as it looked slightly distressed and in pain—traces that disappeared as soon as his eyes met mine. I had no clue what had happened during the attack, but plenty of things about him were iffy at best.
entries.literal: "Behind Atsuki was Katei, who my focus switched to. His face was hardly a more pleasant sight, as it looked slightly distressed and in pain—traces that disappeared as soon as his eyes met mine. I had no clue what had happened during the attack, but plenty of things about him were iffy at best."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as we began to step down the last staircase, we saw a few people in hallway A, who immediately gestured at us to hurry toward them.
entries.literal: "As soon as we began to step down the last staircase, we saw a few people in hallway A, who immediately gestured at us to hurry toward them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Take a look at the security room.
entries.literal: "Take a look at the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina and Isla were next to its door, peering inside. Katei paid no mind to Sai and pushed open the door to the event room.
entries.literal: "Erina and Isla were next to its door, peering inside. Katei paid no mind to Sai and pushed open the door to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With one hand, he raised the curtain, opened the glass, and put the Sekimeiya inside.
entries.literal: "With one hand, he raised the curtain, opened the glass, and put the Sekimeiya inside."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, give me the keys.
entries.literal: "Oh, give me the keys."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took them from my purse and handed them to him.
entries.literal: "I took them from my purse and handed them to him."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: This is a manual lock, right? Does it shut the cabinet without needing the key?
entries.literal: "This is a manual lock, right? Does it shut the cabinet without needing the key?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina, Isla, and Akaro were looking from the door, indicating with their eyes that they'd found something.
entries.literal: "Erina, Isla, and Akaro were looking from the door, indicating with their eyes that they'd found something."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. I was just going to lock it.
entries.literal: "Yes. I was just going to lock it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki turned a dial on the left side of the cabinet and verified that it could only be unlocked with a key identical to the one Naomi had used.
entries.literal: "Atsuki turned a dial on the left side of the cabinet and verified that it could only be unlocked with a key identical to the one Naomi had used."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do not take it out under any circumstances. It's very likely Naomi brought it to the attic, so we need to find her as soon as possible.
entries.literal: "Do not take it out under any circumstances. It's very likely Naomi brought it to the attic, so we need to find her as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I bet you want to know what happened in the security room first.
entries.literal: "I bet you want to know what happened in the security room first."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What happened?
entries.literal: "...What happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai jerked his head, telling us to see for ourselves.
entries.literal: "Sai jerked his head, telling us to see for ourselves."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Awkwardly, Katei made his way to the hallway and walked up to the security room.
entries.literal: "Awkwardly, Katei made his way to the hallway and walked up to the security room."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh—{w} Was it like this when you came?
entries.literal: "Wh—{w} Was it like this when you came?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. The elevator had been reenabled, so I wanted to go to the security room. This is how we found it.
entries.literal: "Yes. The elevator had been reenabled, so I wanted to go to the security room. This is how we found it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki and I, who hadn't yet seen the problem, approached the room.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and I, who hadn't yet seen the problem, approached the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was very easy to tell what was wrong from the hallway. Every monitor was displaying a black screen, and the drone of the computer had ceased.
entries.literal: "It was very easy to tell what was wrong from the hallway. Every monitor was displaying a black screen, and the drone of the computer had ceased."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Did the computer stop working?
entries.literal: "...Did the computer stop working?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's still the ceiling light, so I assume so.
entries.literal: "There's still the ceiling light, so I assume so."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The computer did not stop working. It must've been turned off. The monitors above it won't display anything while the computer's off.
entries.literal: "The computer did not stop working. It must've been turned off. The monitors above it won't display anything while the computer's off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He walked into the room while everyone entered after him.
entries.literal: "He walked into the room while everyone entered after him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, after pressing the power button, there was no change.
entries.literal: "However, after pressing the power button, there was no change."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell...?
entries.literal: "What the hell...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Also, the door was closed, but not locked, just like you figured.
entries.literal: "Also, the door was closed, but not locked, just like you figured."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I see... I have no idea what was done, but the computer couldn't have stopped working by itself.
entries.literal: "I see... I have no idea what was done, but the computer couldn't have stopped working by itself."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You didn't do it?
entries.literal: "You didn't do it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, you were on this floor before you reunited with us, right?
entries.literal: "Well, you were on this floor before you reunited with us, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I was only here for a few seconds, unlike you all.
entries.literal: "I was only here for a few seconds, unlike you all."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The computer was working when we left.
entries.literal: "The computer was working when we left."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We could've used it for several things, so someone disabled it deliberately. Who had the chance to do that?
entries.literal: "We could've used it for several things, so someone disabled it deliberately. Who had the chance to do that?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: You, Akaro, Sai, or Naomi.
entries.literal: "You, Akaro, Sai, or Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei glanced at Sai when I mentioned him, as he was under the impression he'd been with us when we went down.
entries.literal: "Katei glanced at Sai when I mentioned him, as he was under the impression he'd been with us when we went down."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, you didn't hear that, but I wasn't with them the whole time. I didn't enter this room, though.
entries.literal: "Yeah, you didn't hear that, but I wasn't with them the whole time. I didn't enter this room, though."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What about Atsuki?
entries.literal: "What about Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: The four of us went together.
entries.literal: "The four of us went together."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I see...
entries.literal: "I see..."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: {tip=suspicion}...{/tip}
entries.literal: "{tip=suspicion}...{/tip}"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: So, from your point of view, we are the only people who could've entered this room after you left it with the computer running.
entries.literal: "So, from your point of view, we are the only people who could've entered this room after you left it with the computer running."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You might be ignoring something, though. Someone used this computer after we all met up again.
entries.literal: "You might be ignoring something, though. Someone used this computer after we all met up again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The elevator was reenabled when we were in the attic, which means that Naomi turned off the computer after doing so and is still hiding. It makes sense because she knows what we could do with it.
entries.literal: "The elevator was reenabled when we were in the attic, which means that Naomi turned off the computer after doing so and is still hiding. It makes sense because she knows what we could do with it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Would she really have any idea how to power on the elevator?
entries.literal: "Would she really have any idea how to power on the elevator?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Even if she didn't know in detail, it is fairly simple to work out. I imagine she was told about the alarm and its functions, after all.
entries.literal: "Even if she didn't know in detail, it is fairly simple to work out. I imagine she was told about the alarm and its functions, after all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought that made enough sense, except for one important detail.
entries.literal: "I thought that made enough sense, except for one important detail."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: But if Naomi didn't want us to use this computer, why did she not power it off earlier?
entries.literal: "But if Naomi didn't want us to use this computer, why did she not power it off earlier?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Probably because she was in the attic. But most importantly, because she thought this room was locked, even though it remained open because the alarm failed to lock it.
entries.literal: "Probably because she was in the attic. But most importantly, because she thought this room was locked, even though it remained open because the alarm failed to lock it."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...If it's true that the alarm should've locked it after leaving, sure.{w} But even if it did malfunction, the only reason why we didn't enter before was because you'd left your key inside, right?{w} Normally, she would've expected you to bring it out and be able to open the door whenever. It doesn't make sense to say she cared about us using the computer because we should've been able to get in here right away, while it was still working.
entries.literal: "...If it's true that the alarm should've locked it after leaving, sure.{w} But even if it did malfunction, the only reason why we didn't enter before was because you'd left your key inside, right?{w} Normally, she would've expected you to bring it out and be able to open the door whenever. It doesn't make sense to say she cared about us using the computer because we should've been able to get in here right away, while it was still working."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'd forgotten about that key. You said you left yours in this room, so where is it?
entries.literal: "I'd forgotten about that key. You said you left yours in this room, so where is it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei opened a drawer and took all of its papers out as he spoke.
entries.literal: "Katei opened a drawer and took all of its papers out as he spoke."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's possible she was keeping track of what we were doing from somewhere and knew that I hadn't unlocked the room yet. When she saw you'd opened it, you gave her an easy chance to power off the computer, even though I don't know how exactly she did it. I'm not sure why you're all having such a hard time believing me.
entries.literal: "It's possible she was keeping track of what we were doing from somewhere and knew that I hadn't unlocked the room yet. When she saw you'd opened it, you gave her an easy chance to power off the computer, even though I don't know how exactly she did it. I'm not sure why you're all having such a hard time believing me."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I-It's not here...
entries.literal: "I-It's not here..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki took the key he'd found out of his pocket.
entries.literal: "Atsuki took the key he'd found out of his pocket."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: This must be your key, then.
entries.literal: "This must be your key, then."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I guess so... But how the hell did it make it to the third floor?
entries.literal: "I guess so... But how the hell did it make it to the third floor?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei took it from Atsuki's hand and left it in the same drawer he'd searched through.
entries.literal: "Katei took it from Atsuki's hand and left it in the same drawer he'd searched through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody answered him. Before, Atsuki had told me that he'd seen Katei staring at the floor on the higher levels of the building. If he'd known he needed to find the key somewhere, he must have deliberately withheld that, aware that the door had been left open.
entries.literal: "Nobody answered him. Before, Atsuki had told me that he'd seen Katei staring at the floor on the higher levels of the building. If he'd known he needed to find the key somewhere, he must have deliberately withheld that, aware that the door had been left open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, as soon as we'd managed to enter, someone had immediately taken the opportunity to power off the computer. The intentions of that person coincided with Katei's if Atsuki's theory was right.
entries.literal: "Then, as soon as we'd managed to enter, someone had immediately taken the opportunity to power off the computer. The intentions of that person coincided with Katei's if Atsuki's theory was right."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What's clear is that whoever shut down the computer enabled the elevator before doing so...
entries.literal: "What's clear is that whoever shut down the computer enabled the elevator before doing so..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And Katei's the one person who would definitely know how to do that.
entries.literal: "And Katei's the one person who would definitely know how to do that."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I agree that it seems strange Naomi would know how to accomplish that without having a lot of time to experiment.
entries.literal: "I agree that it seems strange Naomi would know how to accomplish that without having a lot of time to experiment."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: So, it could be that powering off the computer enabled the elevator at the same time. It shouldn't have been the case, but I can't rule it out with the lack of testing this alarm had.
entries.literal: "So, it could be that powering off the computer enabled the elevator at the same time. It shouldn't have been the case, but I can't rule it out with the lack of testing this alarm had."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Go see whether the lobby's lights are working again. If they are, it's possible the alarm's secondary effects were reversed when the computer was turned off, as the way to disable them is very different from the main one, which blocks the exit.
entries.literal: "Go see whether the lobby's lights are working again. If they are, it's possible the alarm's secondary effects were reversed when the computer was turned off, as the way to disable them is very different from the main one, which blocks the exit."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Even though the computer doesn't work, the camera system functions independently. I don't know if it was shut down, so it's possible the cameras are still recording and that we simply can't look at the footage.
entries.literal: "Even though the computer doesn't work, the camera system functions independently. I don't know if it was shut down, so it's possible the cameras are still recording and that we simply can't look at the footage."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I want to try a few things here and see if I can get the computer running again, so you can leave me be if you want. I will recommend once again that we find Naomi.
entries.literal: "I want to try a few things here and see if I can get the computer running again, so you can leave me be if you want. I will recommend once again that we find Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a light shrug, Sai spoke.
entries.literal: "After a light shrug, Sai spoke."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sure. We still haven't looked through this entire floor. If we can't find Naomi here, we'll have to search the entire building in more depth.{w} Oh, there's something else I meant to ask you. Inside the elevator, there's a stop button that's supposed to enable communication with the outside. Would that help us?
entries.literal: "Sure. We still haven't looked through this entire floor. If we can't find Naomi here, we'll have to search the entire building in more depth.{w} Oh, there's something else I meant to ask you. Inside the elevator, there's a stop button that's supposed to enable communication with the outside. Would that help us?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No, it won't. The alarm's effects may not have worked perfectly, but one of them was to disable that connection. If you press the button, you'll get locked inside until {time=21}, so I'd advise you not to do it.
entries.literal: "No, it won't. The alarm's effects may not have worked perfectly, but one of them was to disable that connection. If you press the button, you'll get locked inside until {time=21}, so I'd advise you not to do it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm, I see. I'm glad we didn't go for it, then.
entries.literal: "Hm, I see. I'm glad we didn't go for it, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai moved to hallway A, and the others followed him. I was about to leave as well, but Katei's look stopped me.
entries.literal: "Sai moved to hallway A, and the others followed him. I was about to leave as well, but Katei's look stopped me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once he and I were alone, he spoke in a quiet whisper.
entries.literal: "Once he and I were alone, he spoke in a quiet whisper."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: How well do you know Atsuki? The two of you are friends, right?
entries.literal: "How well do you know Atsuki? The two of you are friends, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, yeah...
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't spoken much, but we'd been together in the lobby and were the same age, so it made sense for him to assume that.
entries.literal: "We hadn't spoken much, but we'd been together in the lobby and were the same age, so it made sense for him to assume that."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do you trust him?
entries.literal: "Do you trust him?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know if you're working with him. If you are, I'm warning you to stop whatever you're doing, but if you aren't, I will tell you directly: he is lying.
entries.literal: "I don't know if you're working with him. If you are, I'm warning you to stop whatever you're doing, but if you aren't, I will tell you directly: he is lying."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: He's lying to you and everyone else. He was the one who brought the Sekimeiya to the attic.
entries.literal: "He's lying to you and everyone else. He was the one who brought the Sekimeiya to the attic."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: No, he wasn't. I've been with him the entire time.
entries.literal: "No, he wasn't. I've been with him the entire time."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Look, if you're actually unaware of whatever he's doing, make sure to keep an eye on him, and don't ever leave him alone. Make sure he can't ever take the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Look, if you're actually unaware of whatever he's doing, make sure to keep an eye on him, and don't ever leave him alone. Make sure he can't ever take the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Internally, I laughed. Of course, suspecting Atsuki hadn't at all crossed my mind. Under normal circumstances, I might possibly have believed that he was messing around and something he'd done had been misinterpreted, but Katei had just outed himself as a liar.
entries.literal: "Internally, I laughed. Of course, suspecting Atsuki hadn't at all crossed my mind. Under normal circumstances, I might possibly have believed that he was messing around and something he'd done had been misinterpreted, but Katei had just outed himself as a liar."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Out of curiosity, why are you saying he brought the Sekimeiya to the attic?
entries.literal: "Out of curiosity, why are you saying he brought the Sekimeiya to the attic?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I can't tell you that, but you can take my word for it. I am certain that he did.
entries.literal: "...I can't tell you that, but you can take my word for it. I am certain that he did."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried not to snort and walked out to hallway A. I didn't know what was up with Katei, but everything about him was questionable.
entries.literal: "I tried not to snort and walked out to hallway A. I didn't know what was up with Katei, but everything about him was questionable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why had he told me that? If it was all a lie, what did he plan to accomplish by telling me about it without even specifying any details? Even if he really did believe it, why would he have approached the person most likely to be working with his suspect?
entries.literal: "Why had he told me that? If it was all a lie, what did he plan to accomplish by telling me about it without even specifying any details? Even if he really did believe it, why would he have approached the person most likely to be working with his suspect?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From all I could tell, the guy was a moron, plain and simple. At least Sai thought about what he said, even if he came across as a loose cannon.
entries.literal: "From all I could tell, the guy was a moron, plain and simple. At least Sai thought about what he said, even if he came across as a loose cannon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I saw the others had gone to the lobby, so I joined them.
entries.literal: "...I saw the others had gone to the lobby, so I joined them."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, the lights do work.
entries.literal: "Oh, the lights do work."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The four smaller lights were functioning again. However, that couldn't be taken as confirmation of anything since Katei had been the one to suggest checking them.
entries.literal: "The four smaller lights were functioning again. However, that couldn't be taken as confirmation of anything since Katei had been the one to suggest checking them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without saying anything else, Sai walked to the other hallway.
entries.literal: "Without saying anything else, Sai walked to the other hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Strangely, he went straight to the event room.
entries.literal: "Strangely, he went straight to the event room."

entries.text: Terraformed
entries.literal: "Terraformed"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Why did you come here?
entries.literal: "Why did you come here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So Katei doesn't see me.
entries.literal: "So Katei doesn't see me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonchalantly, he put out his hand to Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Nonchalantly, he put out his hand to Atsuki."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you want the keys?
entries.literal: "Do you want the keys?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Precisely.
entries.literal: "Precisely."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Why?
entries.literal: "Why?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: To unlock the cabinet.
entries.literal: "To unlock the cabinet."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What's the point? It could be dangerous for the Sekimeiya. Let's not cause problems we can avoid.
entries.literal: "What's the point? It could be dangerous for the Sekimeiya. Let's not cause problems we can avoid."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I want to touch it, though...
entries.literal: "I want to touch it, though..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And there should be no problem with that. You said Naomi was gonna let you do it, but Katei made sure nobody would touch it.{w} You all understand he's been lying, don't you? And the Sekimeiya was brought to the attic, either by him or Naomi—the two people who should've known a higher temperature could be damaging.
entries.literal: "And there should be no problem with that. You said Naomi was gonna let you do it, but Katei made sure nobody would touch it.{w} You all understand he's been lying, don't you? And the Sekimeiya was brought to the attic, either by him or Naomi—the two people who should've known a higher temperature could be damaging."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's pretty suspicious, right? I bet he exaggerated the need for the temperature so we wouldn't get it out. However, he took it out himself earlier and brought it to the attic.
entries.literal: "That's pretty suspicious, right? I bet he exaggerated the need for the temperature so we wouldn't get it out. However, he took it out himself earlier and brought it to the attic."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You don't think it was Naomi?
entries.literal: "You don't think it was Naomi?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The keyring that Atsuki has might be hers. Katei had to lie and say he had an identical one. That means it's pretty unlikely she was the one to move the Sekimeiya, so she probably can't access the attic at the moment.
entries.literal: "The keyring that Atsuki has might be hers. Katei had to lie and say he had an identical one. That means it's pretty unlikely she was the one to move the Sekimeiya, so she probably can't access the attic at the moment."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: However, there's one thing I find incredibly strange, and I'm not sure why Katei hasn't tried to excuse it.
entries.literal: "However, there's one thing I find incredibly strange, and I'm not sure why Katei hasn't tried to excuse it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: A few minutes ago, he made you lock the attic, claiming he didn't want anyone entering it without his knowledge. Now, he said he was going to manually lock this cabinet so that nobody could open it.
entries.literal: "A few minutes ago, he made you lock the attic, claiming he didn't want anyone entering it without his knowledge. Now, he said he was going to manually lock this cabinet so that nobody could open it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But he didn't ask for the keyring and let Atsuki keep it. That's just plain contradictory, and not something he would ignore.
entries.literal: "But he didn't ask for the keyring and let Atsuki keep it. That's just plain contradictory, and not something he would ignore."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're actually right. He should've made sure to keep it for himself after locking the attic.
entries.literal: "You're actually right. He should've made sure to keep it for himself after locking the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Which leads me to a single conclusion: Katei is, to put it politely, of low intelligence.
entries.literal: "Which leads me to a single conclusion: Katei is, to put it politely, of low intelligence."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He might just be working with Naomi, who does have an identical set of keys. It's fair to assume he wanted the attic and this cabinet locked to give Naomi a way out. She can still unlock both of them, and by letting Atsuki keep the keys, he'll always be a possible suspect for Naomi's actions.
entries.literal: "He might just be working with Naomi, who does have an identical set of keys. It's fair to assume he wanted the attic and this cabinet locked to give Naomi a way out. She can still unlock both of them, and by letting Atsuki keep the keys, he'll always be a possible suspect for Naomi's actions."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Otherwise, it doesn't make sense. He must know how hard it is to believe that the keyring Atsuki has isn't Naomi's and is taking advantage of that to make us think only Atsuki can use it.
entries.literal: "Otherwise, it doesn't make sense. He must know how hard it is to believe that the keyring Atsuki has isn't Naomi's and is taking advantage of that to make us think only Atsuki can use it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It sounds like he made up that the Sekimeiya had to be kept here for a reason, right? It was in the attic and nothing happened to it.
entries.literal: "It sounds like he made up that the Sekimeiya had to be kept here for a reason, right? It was in the attic and nothing happened to it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki walked forward, unlocked the cabinet with the key, and scrolled open the glass.
entries.literal: "Atsuki walked forward, unlocked the cabinet with the key, and scrolled open the glass."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: This compartment is definitely kept pretty cold.
entries.literal: "This compartment is definitely kept pretty cold."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That hardly matters. Take it out. There's something I'm especially curious about.
entries.literal: "That hardly matters. Take it out. There's something I'm especially curious about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki sighed and looked at the useless camera that wasn't recording him. With both hands, he grabbed the cushion and took it out. Then, he placed it on top of the cabinet, with the Sekimeiya resting in the middle.
entries.literal: "Atsuki sighed and looked at the useless camera that wasn't recording him. With both hands, he grabbed the cushion and took it out. Then, he placed it on top of the cabinet, with the Sekimeiya resting in the middle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He stepped back. Katei had made it clear he didn't want us to touch it, so Atsuki didn't lay a hand on it himself and simply allowed Sai to do so if he wished.
entries.literal: "He stepped back. Katei had made it clear he didn't want us to touch it, so Atsuki didn't lay a hand on it himself and simply allowed Sai to do so if he wished."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course, nothing's happening to it.
entries.literal: "Of course, nothing's happening to it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: This is a bad idea, Sai.
entries.literal: "This is a bad idea, Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody was sure why he'd pushed back against Katei's orders so much, but Isla walked up to the cabinet and tried to reach the Sekimeiya with her arm.
entries.literal: "Nobody was sure why he'd pushed back against Katei's orders so much, but Isla walked up to the cabinet and tried to reach the Sekimeiya with her arm."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You are here. I haven't been ab—
entries.literal: "You are here. I haven't been ab—"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell...!? What are you doing!?
entries.literal: "What the hell...!? What are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seeing his expression, Isla dashed away before Katei ran to the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Seeing his expression, Isla dashed away before Katei ran to the cabinet."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I said many times how importa—
entries.literal: "I said many times how importa—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody cut him off, but that sentence never finished.
entries.literal: "Nobody cut him off, but that sentence never finished."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whoa, what the fuck?
entries.literal: "Whoa, what the fuck?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd all seen the same thing. Katei had run toward the Sekimeiya and made to grab it. ...Then, his entire figure vanished from the room.
entries.literal: "We'd all seen the same thing. Katei had run toward the Sekimeiya and made to grab it. ...Then, his entire figure vanished from the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the same time, the Sekimeiya had turned gray, as if reacting to Katei's touch.
entries.literal: "At the same time, the Sekimeiya had turned gray, as if reacting to Katei's touch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While we exchanged speechless looks, we saw Akaro staring through the hallway A door.
entries.literal: "While we exchanged speechless looks, we saw Akaro staring through the hallway A door."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...What the fuck did you just do?
entries.literal: "...What the fuck did you just do?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We approached it and saw Katei in the hallway, close to the security room.
entries.literal: "We approached it and saw Katei in the hallway, close to the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki was in just as much disbelief as the rest of us. I thought I must've missed something, but Sai's question confirmed we'd all interpreted it the same way.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was in just as much disbelief as the rest of us. I thought I must've missed something, but Sai's question confirmed we'd all interpreted it the same way."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did this man just teleport?
entries.literal: "Did this man just teleport?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like ours, Katei's eyes lacked comprehension, and he only let out some words seconds after the minimal echo had faded away.
entries.literal: "Like ours, Katei's eyes lacked comprehension, and he only let out some words seconds after the minimal echo had faded away."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I just...{w} traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "I just...{w} traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Traveled to the past? Is that what we're supposed to believe...?
entries.literal: "Traveled to the past? Is that what we're supposed to believe...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody could accuse Katei of a trick, as we'd all seen him disappear.{w} He was breathing heavily, and he started to move his arms, checking that his body worked as usual.
entries.literal: "Nobody could accuse Katei of a trick, as we'd all seen him disappear.{w} He was breathing heavily, and he started to move his arms, checking that his body worked as usual."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I know how it sounds, but that's what it felt like. No... what the hell just happened?{w} It did feel like I went back a few seconds, to when I was walking from the security room to the event room.
entries.literal: "I know how it sounds, but that's what it felt like. No... what the hell just happened?{w} It did feel like I went back a few seconds, to when I was walking from the security room to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He slowly returned to the event room and stared at the Sekimeiya, which had changed colors.
entries.literal: "He slowly returned to the event room and stared at the Sekimeiya, which had changed colors."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This thing is dangerous. Did it darken when I touched it? I know I felt it burning.
entries.literal: "This thing is dangerous. Did it darken when I touched it? I know I felt it burning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While nobody answered, he approached it and put it inside the cabinet with its cushion, avoiding direct contact with it.
entries.literal: "While nobody answered, he approached it and put it inside the cabinet with its cushion, avoiding direct contact with it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-What the hell?{w} It turned white again.
entries.literal: "Wh-What the hell?{w} It turned white again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you know this would happen?
entries.literal: "Did you know this would happen?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? Of co—
entries.literal: "What? Of co—"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is why you insisted we couldn't get the Sekimeiya out of this cabinet, that we shouldn't touch it, and it's why you never touched it directly when you brought it down.
entries.literal: "This is why you insisted we couldn't get the Sekimeiya out of this cabinet, that we shouldn't touch it, and it's why you never touched it directly when you brought it down."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What are you talking about? I'm as confused as you are.
entries.literal: "What are you talking about? I'm as confused as you are."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As he spoke, he manually locked the cabinet.
entries.literal: "As he spoke, he manually locked the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That thing just made you teleport out of the room, and either you or Naomi brought it to the attic. You knew what it would do. That's why the fucking footprints were so weird, like someone had disappeared right in front of the Sekimeiya!
entries.literal: "That thing just made you teleport out of the room, and either you or Naomi brought it to the attic. You knew what it would do. That's why the fucking footprints were so weird, like someone had disappeared right in front of the Sekimeiya!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The conversation began to sound utterly surreal, but Sai was making sense. If the Sekimeiya had really teleported Katei, it recontextualized a few things.
entries.literal: "The conversation began to sound utterly surreal, but Sai was making sense. If the Sekimeiya had really teleported Katei, it recontextualized a few things."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What are you even accusing me of? I touched it and instantly found myself in the hallway. I have no clue how it happened. I can't even believe what I'm saying!
entries.literal: "What are you even accusing me of? I touched it and instantly found myself in the hallway. I have no clue how it happened. I can't even believe what I'm saying!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't help but agree with Sai. Katei had rushed to the Sekimeiya as soon as he'd seen it above the cabinet, and he'd touched it with his own skin in his panic despite his previous caution on the top floor.
entries.literal: "I couldn't help but agree with Sai. Katei had rushed to the Sekimeiya as soon as he'd seen it above the cabinet, and he'd touched it with his own skin in his panic despite his previous caution on the top floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I came here after hearing voices to inform you that I hadn't been able to power the computer back on.
entries.literal: "I came here after hearing voices to inform you that I hadn't been able to power the computer back on."

entries.speaker: i
