entries.text: And, unbelievable as it seemed, it sounded like he was trying to change the subject.
entries.literal: "And, unbelievable as it seemed, it sounded like he was trying to change the subject."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I still have more things to try, though. I know I've repeated myself quite a few times, but it's clear now that the Sekimeiya must be kept here.
entries.literal: "...I still have more things to try, though. I know I've repeated myself quite a few times, but it's clear now that the Sekimeiya must be kept here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You said it made you travel to the past, but you're just going to ignore that?
entries.literal: "You said it made you travel to the past, but you're just going to ignore that?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I know I don't want to try it again... whatever might have really happened. I have very little information about the Sekimeiya, but this is no ordinary gem, as expected.
entries.literal: "I know I don't want to try it again... whatever might have really happened. I have very little information about the Sekimeiya, but this is no ordinary gem, as expected."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It has to stay here until the shutter opens. There's no way it isn't dangerous, and the cold temperature must keep it stable in some way. I wasn't given any information on why it's essential, but Naomi might know more about it, so we come back to the same point: we must find her.
entries.literal: "It has to stay here until the shutter opens. There's no way it isn't dangerous, and the cold temperature must keep it stable in some way. I wasn't given any information on why it's essential, but Naomi might know more about it, so we come back to the same point: we must find her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He walked toward us, and then to hallway A.
entries.literal: "He walked toward us, and then to hallway A."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...If I manage to power the computer and cameras back on, that'll be the best way to find her.
entries.literal: "...If I manage to power the computer and cameras back on, that'll be the best way to find her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, he walked to the security room and left our field of vision.
entries.literal: "Then, he walked to the security room and left our field of vision."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck...? He did it again!{w} Does he think we're idiots? He walked away from a stone that made him teleport and didn't demand the keys!
entries.literal: "What the fuck...? He did it again!{w} Does he think we're idiots? He walked away from a stone that made him teleport and didn't demand the keys!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're right, yeah. If he wanted to keep it locked in this cabinet, he would've made sure to ask for those back.
entries.literal: "You're right, yeah. If he wanted to keep it locked in this cabinet, he would've made sure to ask for those back."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He's definitely working with Naomi. Whatever it is, he isn't being truthful in the slightest.
entries.literal: "He's definitely working with Naomi. Whatever it is, he isn't being truthful in the slightest."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Unlock it again.
entries.literal: "Unlock it again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, after all that Katei had said, we could just take the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet again, and it was fairly stupid to think that we wouldn't. Without thinking about it, Atsuki undid Katei's lock.
entries.literal: "Of course, after all that Katei had said, we could just take the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet again, and it was fairly stupid to think that we wouldn't. Without thinking about it, Atsuki undid Katei's lock."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He opened the glass and once again took out the cushion holding the Sekimeiya. The gemstone had gone back to glowing white, but Atsuki didn't place it anywhere. He looked at it curiously, with both of his hands occupied.
entries.literal: "He opened the glass and once again took out the cushion holding the Sekimeiya. The gemstone had gone back to glowing white, but Atsuki didn't place it anywhere. He looked at it curiously, with both of his hands occupied."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...What, do we touch it?
entries.literal: "...What, do we touch it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Most of us looked skeptical or even embarrassed to try. Sai, who I'd imagined would be the first to attempt it, appeared hesitant.
entries.literal: "Most of us looked skeptical or even embarrassed to try. Sai, who I'd imagined would be the first to attempt it, appeared hesitant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were staring at the Sekimeiya, when in an instant, the opposite door had become our focus. From behind the shut door to hallway B came a sound we had to confirm we'd heard.
entries.literal: "We were staring at the Sekimeiya, when in an instant, the opposite door had become our focus. From behind the shut door to hallway B came a sound we had to confirm we'd heard."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Naomi... it has to be her.
entries.literal: "Naomi... it has to be her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all got closer to the door, and Akaro opened it.
entries.literal: "We all got closer to the door, and Akaro opened it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hallway was empty, but it contained many doors none of us had entered yet.
entries.literal: "The hallway was empty, but it contained many doors none of us had entered yet."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It came from pretty close to the door, but it looks like she hid already.
entries.literal: "It came from pretty close to the door, but it looks like she hid already."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Was she listening and ran away when she realized she'd been heard?
entries.literal: "Was she listening and ran away when she realized she'd been heard?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd left the way to the lobby open, but if Naomi had been sneaking up on us, it was possible she'd closed herself behind one of the multitude of doors we could see. If that was the case, we finally had a chance to confront her.
entries.literal: "We'd left the way to the lobby open, but if Naomi had been sneaking up on us, it was possible she'd closed herself behind one of the multitude of doors we could see. If that was the case, we finally had a chance to confront her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't yet inspected the whole crystal floor, and we still had to locate her. The Sekimeiya rolled slightly on top of the cushion, which Atsuki laid on the floor next to him. Meanwhile, the rest of us opened door after door and briefly looked through each room.
entries.literal: "We hadn't yet inspected the whole crystal floor, and we still had to locate her. The Sekimeiya rolled slightly on top of the cushion, which Atsuki laid on the floor next to him. Meanwhile, the rest of us opened door after door and briefly looked through each room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All the crystal rooms were empty, and midway, we noticed that some of the cabinets could be opened to reveal spacious interiors. The staff room contained numerous lockers we couldn't open, and the small cleaning room had several cleaning products, a large cart, and some buckets. In the end, we hadn't found anyone in hallway B or in the bathrooms.
entries.literal: "All the crystal rooms were empty, and midway, we noticed that some of the cabinets could be opened to reveal spacious interiors. The staff room contained numerous lockers we couldn't open, and the small cleaning room had several cleaning products, a large cart, and some buckets. In the end, we hadn't found anyone in hallway B or in the bathrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But we knew we had heard a person, so we didn't stop there. While Atsuki continued looking through hallway B, we went down to the mechanical room, which was empty and somewhat foreboding.
entries.literal: "But we knew we had heard a person, so we didn't stop there. While Atsuki continued looking through hallway B, we went down to the mechanical room, which was empty and somewhat foreboding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei was kneeling under the desk in the security room. We quietly ignored him and searched through hallway A's rooms. Again, every crystal room was identical except for the one that had been hit by the smoke. ...Like the storeroom, though, it was empty.
entries.literal: "Katei was kneeling under the desk in the security room. We quietly ignored him and searched through hallway A's rooms. Again, every crystal room was identical except for the one that had been hit by the smoke. ...Like the storeroom, though, it was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We knew Naomi had been very close to us, but we'd failed to find her, and we had to prioritize the Sekimeiya before extending the search to the higher floors. Exasperated, we returned to see Atsuki waiting on the spot where we'd last seen him.
entries.literal: "We knew Naomi had been very close to us, but we'd failed to find her, and we had to prioritize the Sekimeiya before extending the search to the higher floors. Exasperated, we returned to see Atsuki waiting on the spot where we'd last seen him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the floor were the cushion and the Sekimeiya. When it was clear we hadn't found anyone, he looked at them.
entries.literal: "On the floor were the cushion and the Sekimeiya. When it was clear we hadn't found anyone, he looked at them."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Remember the smell from the attic? It might've come from the Sekimeiya. I started noticing it here some time ago.
entries.literal: "Remember the smell from the attic? It might've come from the Sekimeiya. I started noticing it here some time ago."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, huh.
entries.literal: "Oh, huh."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm going to touch it.
entries.literal: "I'm going to touch it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I felt slight traces of tension for a second. Was it really possible he was about to travel through time? I didn't think I could really take that seriously, but seeing him about to try made me uncomfortable. It was almost laughable how all of us looked on in anticipation, trying to confirm whether we'd lost our minds or not.{w} His hand got closer and closer to the gem until no distance separated it from him.
entries.literal: "...I felt slight traces of tension for a second. Was it really possible he was about to travel through time? I didn't think I could really take that seriously, but seeing him about to try made me uncomfortable. It was almost laughable how all of us looked on in anticipation, trying to confirm whether we'd lost our minds or not.{w} His hand got closer and closer to the gem until no distance separated it from him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As he touched it, he was instantly no longer touching it. Atsuki was gone, and the Sekimeiya turned gray.
entries.literal: "As he touched it, he was instantly no longer touching it. Atsuki was gone, and the Sekimeiya turned gray."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everybody else was occupied with the realization that the Sekimeiya's powers were real, but I ran forward, perceiving another sound from hallway B.
entries.literal: "Everybody else was occupied with the realization that the Sekimeiya's powers were real, but I ran forward, perceiving another sound from hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door wasn't fully closed, so I opened it all the way. I'd heard a sound just as Atsuki had disappeared, and I knew someone was there.
entries.literal: "The door wasn't fully closed, so I opened it all the way. I'd heard a sound just as Atsuki had disappeared, and I knew someone was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The instant I peeked around it, I saw him. Hesitantly glancing from hallway C was Atsuki, whose eyes pierced mine until he removed himself from behind the corner. Slowly, he began to walk up to me as I wondered what to say.
entries.literal: "The instant I peeked around it, I saw him. Hesitantly glancing from hallway C was Atsuki, whose eyes pierced mine until he removed himself from behind the corner. Slowly, he began to walk up to me as I wondered what to say."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: So, i-it worked...? You went to the past?
entries.literal: "So, i-it worked...? You went to the past?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Um... Y-Yes. I suppose so.{w} I can't... I can't believe it, though.
entries.literal: "Um... Y-Yes. I suppose so.{w} I can't... I can't believe it, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone else was petrified, suppressing their sheer shock, but I noticed that someone who should've been there was missing.
entries.literal: "Everyone else was petrified, suppressing their sheer shock, but I noticed that someone who should've been there was missing."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Is Sai not here?
entries.literal: "Is Sai not here?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, y-you're right. I don't think he's been here for a bit.
entries.literal: "Oh, y-you're right. I don't think he's been here for a bit."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: How is this possible...? I don't get it, but if you went to the past, why didn't you appear in this room? That's what happened to Katei.
entries.literal: "How is this possible...? I don't get it, but if you went to the past, why didn't you appear in this room? That's what happened to Katei."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hm...{w} I don't think I traveled a few seconds through time, but actually minutes. About twenty, I'd say.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} I don't think I traveled a few seconds through time, but actually minutes. About twenty, I'd say."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh, what? That long ago, we were still in the attic, right?
entries.literal: "Oh, what? That long ago, we were still in the attic, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki nodded, clearly disconcerted.
entries.literal: "Atsuki nodded, clearly disconcerted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We could only look at the Sekimeiya, which was a different color than it should've been.
entries.literal: "We could only look at the Sekimeiya, which was a different color than it should've been."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: L-Let me see.
entries.literal: "L-Let me see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He crouched again and placed his hand on it.
entries.literal: "He crouched again and placed his hand on it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's not doing anything, and it's cold. ...It must do nothing when it's this color.{w} It's just a thought, but maybe I traveled farther because it spent more time out of the cabinet. When Katei touched it, it had barely been out for any time at all.
entries.literal: "It's not doing anything, and it's cold. ...It must do nothing when it's this color.{w} It's just a thought, but maybe I traveled farther because it spent more time out of the cabinet. When Katei touched it, it had barely been out for any time at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He grabbed the cushion with both hands and walked to the cabinet. Mere seconds after he put it back in its place, the Sekimeiya started glowing again.
entries.literal: "He grabbed the cushion with both hands and walked to the cabinet. Mere seconds after he put it back in its place, the Sekimeiya started glowing again."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: This again.
entries.literal: "This again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We could only stare in confusion as he closed the glass. The keyring had been left in the keyhole, so he took it out before thinking about how to phrase what he wanted to say.
entries.literal: "We could only stare in confusion as he closed the glass. The keyring had been left in the keyhole, so he took it out before thinking about how to phrase what he wanted to say."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I still can't believe what just happened to me, but I think we should go along with what Katei said and leave this in the cabinet until we can leave.
entries.literal: "...I still can't believe what just happened to me, but I think we should go along with what Katei said and leave this in the cabinet until we can leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned a little while he locked the cabinet with the wheel. He held out his arm to hand me the keyring, which I put in my purse without question, even though it confused me.
entries.literal: "I frowned a little while he locked the cabinet with the wheel. He held out his arm to hand me the keyring, which I put in my purse without question, even though it confused me."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I mean, what else would we do?
entries.literal: "...I mean, what else would we do?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki didn't answer, but I imagined the way he'd internally responded to that question. A few days ago, I'd heard the words "I wish I could go back in time" coming out of his mouth. I couldn't believe he was actually going to casually leave the Sekimeiya locked away.
entries.literal: "Atsuki didn't answer, but I imagined the way he'd internally responded to that question. A few days ago, I'd heard the words \"I wish I could go back in time\" coming out of his mouth. I couldn't believe he was actually going to casually leave the Sekimeiya locked away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Honestly, that would have been ideal. I'd been expecting a much different reaction, and I couldn't discard it entirely. He could've easily been trying to fool the others by giving the keys to me.
entries.literal: "Honestly, that would have been ideal. I'd been expecting a much different reaction, and I couldn't discard it entirely. He could've easily been trying to fool the others by giving the keys to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No one spoke up, probably only thanks to the fact that Sai wasn't around. Akaro had indicated he wasn't in hallway A either, so we had no idea if he was even nearby.
entries.literal: "No one spoke up, probably only thanks to the fact that Sai wasn't around. Akaro had indicated he wasn't in hallway A either, so we had no idea if he was even nearby."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Did you make the sound in hallway B earlier?
entries.literal: "...Did you make the sound in hallway B earlier?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, yeah, I did. That was when I realized I had really traveled through time. I moved to the second floor fast enough to stay out of sight.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah, I did. That was when I realized I had really traveled through time. I moved to the second floor fast enough to stay out of sight."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's just insane. ...Were we actually searching for you? Where the hell is Naomi, then?
entries.literal: "That's just insane. ...Were we actually searching for you? Where the hell is Naomi, then?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stepped into the gloomy hallway A.
entries.literal: "We stepped into the gloomy hallway A."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Actually, where is Sai? That's another good question.
entries.literal: "Actually, where is Sai? That's another good question."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I know he was with us when we searched this hallway.
entries.literal: "I know he was with us when we searched this hallway."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did he go somewhere...?
entries.literal: "Did he go somewhere...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Annoyed, Akaro rapidly glanced through the doors.
entries.literal: "Annoyed, Akaro rapidly glanced through the doors."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: He's not here. Did you see what happened to him?
entries.literal: "He's not here. Did you see what happened to him?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He directed that question at Atsuki, who'd gone several minutes to the past and remained hidden.
entries.literal: "He directed that question at Atsuki, who'd gone several minutes to the past and remained hidden."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...No. I was on the second floor, so all I know is that he didn't go up.
entries.literal: "...No. I was on the second floor, so all I know is that he didn't go up."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: He's still here, then...
entries.literal: "He's still here, then..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Faint sounds had been coming from the security room, where Katei was. To confirm that he was alone, we walked up to the door.
entries.literal: "Faint sounds had been coming from the security room, where Katei was. To confirm that he was alone, we walked up to the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We could see him leaning back on the chair in defeat due to all the screens still being black.
entries.literal: "We could see him leaning back on the chair in defeat due to all the screens still being black."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Oh, I haven't been able to fix anything. I apologize.{w} I am completely lost; I don't even know what the issue is. Everything is properly arranged and connected, so unless no electricity is reaching the outlets, I'm out of ideas.
entries.literal: "...Oh, I haven't been able to fix anything. I apologize.{w} I am completely lost; I don't even know what the issue is. Everything is properly arranged and connected, so unless no electricity is reaching the outlets, I'm out of ideas."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He crouched and crawled under the desk, failing to realize that Sai wasn't with us. We approached him and silently stared while he kept repeating how confused he was from the floor.
entries.literal: "He crouched and crawled under the desk, failing to realize that Sai wasn't with us. We approached him and silently stared while he kept repeating how confused he was from the floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: And you still haven't found Naomi... You were inspecting this floor just now, right?
entries.literal: "And you still haven't found Naomi... You were inspecting this floor just now, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes. She wasn't here.
entries.literal: "Yes. She wasn't here."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's very strange. She might have been able to keep dodging us, but there's no way that'll work for too long. There's no place where she could hide forever.
entries.literal: "That's very strange. She might have been able to keep dodging us, but there's no way that'll work for too long. There's no place where she could hide forever."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He crawled out and let himself fall back onto the chair, looking exhausted.
entries.literal: "He crawled out and let himself fall back onto the chair, looking exhausted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind him, all of us kept silent. We were all digesting the fact that time travel had occurred right in front of us, but it didn't seem like Katei found that particularly relevant, as he only looked concerned about his computer.
entries.literal: "Behind him, all of us kept silent. We were all digesting the fact that time travel had occurred right in front of us, but it didn't seem like Katei found that particularly relevant, as he only looked concerned about his computer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I noticed that Atsuki was remaining by himself next to the door. I wouldn't have approached him, but I saw him staring curiously into the distance.
entries.literal: "I noticed that Atsuki was remaining by himself next to the door. I wouldn't have approached him, but I saw him staring curiously into the distance."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Is there anything...{w} Oh, the elevator?
entries.literal: "...Is there anything...{w} Oh, the elevator?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I glanced at hallway C, I could see that the elevator's door was very slightly open.
entries.literal: "As soon as I glanced at hallway C, I could see that the elevator's door was very slightly open."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's not closed, yeah.
entries.literal: "It's not closed, yeah."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro approached us with a frown, but Katei addressed it before he got far.
entries.literal: "Akaro approached us with a frown, but Katei addressed it before he got far."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, it's been like that for a while. I noticed it when we walked down from the attic and figured the others purposely left it like that.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's been like that for a while. I noticed it when we walked down from the attic and figured the others purposely left it like that."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We didn't.
entries.literal: "We didn't."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It must not have closed properly when you got off, then. I've seen it happen in the past.
entries.literal: "It must not have closed properly when you got off, then. I've seen it happen in the past."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hm, I see. I didn't notice it.
entries.literal: "Hm, I see. I didn't notice it."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Me neither.{w} ...Wait, I just remembered the hallway B camera. The one that had its lens completely clean.
entries.literal: "Me neither.{w} ...Wait, I just remembered the hallway B camera. The one that had its lens completely clean."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Going by their looks, Akaro and Katei didn't know what I was talking about.
entries.literal: "Going by their looks, Akaro and Katei didn't know what I was talking about."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Excuse me...?
entries.literal: "Excuse me...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Right, the one above the door to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Right, the one above the door to the lobby."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yeah, its footage was being displayed up there.
entries.literal: "Yeah, its footage was being displayed up there."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you serious?
entries.literal: "Are you serious?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Both of them hurried out of the room while the rest of us awkwardly stayed put.
entries.literal: "Both of them hurried out of the room while the rest of us awkwardly stayed put."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla, clinging to her mother's legs, had become a little more relaxed. She inquisitively looked around, time travel evidently not much of a weight on her mind.
entries.literal: "Isla, clinging to her mother's legs, had become a little more relaxed. She inquisitively looked around, time travel evidently not much of a weight on her mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: During the silence, I approached the computer. I was slightly interested in its mysterious shutdown, but I didn't examine it too thoroughly.
entries.literal: "During the silence, I approached the computer. I was slightly interested in its mysterious shutdown, but I didn't examine it too thoroughly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't take the others long to return.
entries.literal: "It didn't take the others long to return."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: You saw it, right?
entries.literal: "You saw it, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What the hell...? Was it cleaned?
entries.literal: "What the hell...? Was it cleaned?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: There's no way we would know.
entries.literal: "There's no way we would know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked at Katei, who'd put his hand in one of his deep pockets but took it back out empty.
entries.literal: "We looked at Katei, who'd put his hand in one of his deep pockets but took it back out empty."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I don't have it anymore, but do you remember when—
entries.literal: "...I don't have it anymore, but do you remember when—"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wait, where the hell is Sai?
entries.literal: "Wait, where the hell is Sai?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}After looking at each other, we let him know we'd recently lost track of Sai. Before Katei could get too alarmed, Akaro cut in.
entries.literal: "...{w}After looking at each other, we let him know we'd recently lost track of Sai. Before Katei could get too alarmed, Akaro cut in."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What were you gonna say? We've already searched for Sai, and the Sekimeiya's locked in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "What were you gonna say? We've already searched for Sai, and the Sekimeiya's locked in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...{w}The duct tape, remember? Sai took out my keyring, and it had a piece of duct tape attached to it. That piece had smoke residue on it.
entries.literal: "...{w}The duct tape, remember? Sai took out my keyring, and it had a piece of duct tape attached to it. That piece had smoke residue on it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all remembered what he was talking about and began to understand why he'd brought it up.
entries.literal: "We all remembered what he was talking about and began to understand why he'd brought it up."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I know it was duct tape because one side was still sticky, which means that it was only hit on the front side. In other words, it was stuck somewhere when the smoke was released.
entries.literal: "I know it was duct tape because one side was still sticky, which means that it was only hit on the front side. In other words, it was stuck somewhere when the smoke was released."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Where did it even come from?
entries.literal: "Where did it even come from?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...{w}When I walked down to the crystal floor, searching for you, I found it hidden behind a handrail and put it in my pocket to inquire about it. That's when it got stuck to the keyring.
entries.literal: "...{w}When I walked down to the crystal floor, searching for you, I found it hidden behind a handrail and put it in my pocket to inquire about it. That's when it got stuck to the keyring."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: So it was placed on the lens of that camera, which prevented the smoke from hitting it. Afterward, it was removed...
entries.literal: "So it was placed on the lens of that camera, which prevented the smoke from hitting it. Afterward, it was removed..."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm confused about a few things. Why would someone do that? They had to already know the smoke attack would happen.
entries.literal: "I'm confused about a few things. Why would someone do that? They had to already know the smoke attack would happen."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: And it was removed before we entered the security room.
entries.literal: "And it was removed before we entered the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Additionally, leaving it behind a handrail seemed strange. If they wanted to throw it away, flushing it down the toilet seemed ideal, as fingerprints could otherwise present a problem.
entries.literal: "Additionally, leaving it behind a handrail seemed strange. If they wanted to throw it away, flushing it down the toilet seemed ideal, as fingerprints could otherwise present a problem."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That logic led to the thought that Katei, who might have orchestrated the whole thing, had the opportunity to place the duct tape himself and keep it in his pocket, unaware that we'd find it. I opted not to speculate about that out loud and let everyone else come to the conclusions they wanted.
entries.literal: "That logic led to the thought that Katei, who might have orchestrated the whole thing, had the opportunity to place the duct tape himself and keep it in his pocket, unaware that we'd find it. I opted not to speculate about that out loud and let everyone else come to the conclusions they wanted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the end, Katei sighed and sat on his chair again.
entries.literal: "In the end, Katei sighed and sat on his chair again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell is Naomi doing...? We can't even use the computer to figure anything out.{w} Do you all think Sai ran away on his own? Now we need to find both of them.
entries.literal: "What the hell is Naomi doing...? We can't even use the computer to figure anything out.{w} Do you all think Sai ran away on his own? Now we need to find both of them."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: We lost track of him when we were searching this hallway, which would've been a good opportunity to sneak away. I have no idea why he'd do that, though.
entries.literal: "We lost track of him when we were searching this hallway, which would've been a good opportunity to sneak away. I have no idea why he'd do that, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, Katei pressed the computer's power button in frustration while looking at all the powered-off screens.
entries.literal: "Once again, Katei pressed the computer's power button in frustration while looking at all the powered-off screens."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Maybe now you can believe that he was the one up to something. I'm just trying to do my job.
entries.literal: "Maybe now you can believe that he was the one up to something. I'm just trying to do my job."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whether they believed him or not, nobody spoke up for a while.
entries.literal: "Whether they believed him or not, nobody spoke up for a while."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even if two people had traveled through time, we all had our own reasons to keep still in the narrow room, prioritizing internal thoughts before going out to find the two missing people.
entries.literal: "Even if two people had traveled through time, we all had our own reasons to keep still in the narrow room, prioritizing internal thoughts before going out to find the two missing people."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were still behind Katei's chair, awaiting any decision, when noise came from the door.
entries.literal: "We were still behind Katei's chair, awaiting any decision, when noise came from the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As we turned around, we saw Sai staring at us next to the unassertive Atsuki.
entries.literal: "As we turned around, we saw Sai staring at us next to the unassertive Atsuki."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-Where were you!?
entries.literal: "Wh-Where were you!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me? I just took a detour to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "Me? I just took a detour to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei's smirk perfectly conveyed his reaction, but Sai ignored it. Instead, he slipped into the room.
entries.literal: "Katei's smirk perfectly conveyed his reaction, but Sai ignored it. Instead, he slipped into the room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, what are we doing here? You still can't fix your own computer?
entries.literal: "So, what are we doing here? You still can't fix your own computer?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What do you think?
entries.literal: "What do you think?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I think that we just found out we can travel to the past and are instead trying to fix a computer. Wouldn't it be a better idea to go back in time and see who did this?
entries.literal: "I think that we just found out we can travel to the past and are instead trying to fix a computer. Wouldn't it be a better idea to go back in time and see who did this?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You really can't expect us to take you seriously.
entries.literal: "You really can't expect us to take you seriously."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Sai, what were you doing just now? You definitely weren't in the bathroom.
entries.literal: "Sai, what were you doing just now? You definitely weren't in the bathroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you check all of them?
entries.literal: "Did you check all of them?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You have to give up on him. Whatever he was doing will be exposed eventually.
entries.literal: "You have to give up on him. Whatever he was doing will be exposed eventually."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anyway, who has the keys now?
entries.literal: "Anyway, who has the keys now?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I have them.
entries.literal: "I have them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. ...Is there a reason why we're here?
entries.literal: "I see. ...Is there a reason why we're here?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No. We should try to find Naomi again.
entries.literal: "No. We should try to find Naomi again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's what I'm saying.
entries.literal: "That's what I'm saying."

entries.text: Where Is The Mask
entries.literal: "Where Is The Mask"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Sai left the room, we all exchanged looks, wondering what his intentions really were. We began to disperse into hallway A behind him.
entries.literal: "As Sai left the room, we all exchanged looks, wondering what his intentions really were. We began to disperse into hallway A behind him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki hadn't yet moved from the door, and his expression had gotten considerably murkier. I had no idea what it meant anymore, so I walked up to him.
entries.literal: "Atsuki hadn't yet moved from the door, and his expression had gotten considerably murkier. I had no idea what it meant anymore, so I walked up to him."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Is it going better?
entries.literal: "Is it going better?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Huh?{w} Sorry, I don't know. I just can't believe it. I really traveled through time.
entries.literal: "...Huh?{w} Sorry, I don't know. I just can't believe it. I really traveled through time."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Well, I can't believe it either.{w} ...Are you sure you don't want to do it again?
entries.literal: "Well, I can't believe it either.{w} ...Are you sure you don't want to do it again?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What? Travel through time?
entries.literal: "What? Travel through time?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No, of course I do.
entries.literal: "No, of course I do."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm trying to understand some things. I traveled a few minutes to the past, to the attic, which might make sense. I'm not sure if that's enough, though.
entries.literal: "I'm trying to understand some things. I traveled a few minutes to the past, to the attic, which might make sense. I'm not sure if that's enough, though."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Oh, I see.
entries.literal: "...Oh, I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't seem to even notice my reply. Since he'd gone quiet again, I walked away slowly.
entries.literal: "He didn't seem to even notice my reply. Since he'd gone quiet again, I walked away slowly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Sai saw that, he approached me and spoke in a hushed tone so that his words reached only my ears.
entries.literal: "When Sai saw that, he approached me and spoke in a hushed tone so that his words reached only my ears."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You think Atsuki's hiding something, right?
entries.literal: "You think Atsuki's hiding something, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You definitely know him, but you realized something he said didn't make sense.
entries.literal: "You definitely know him, but you realized something he said didn't make sense."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What the hell are you talking about?
entries.literal: "What the hell are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Am I wrong? He traveled to the past with the Sekimeiya—that much I know.{w} Then, he simply reunited with you guys. Am I missing something?
entries.literal: "Am I wrong? He traveled to the past with the Sekimeiya—that much I know.{w} Then, he simply reunited with you guys. Am I missing something?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: N-No? What are you getting at?
entries.literal: "N-No? What are you getting at?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If I'm not missing anything, I don't know. However, he is hiding something, and apparently even from you.{w} I'm sure he'll want to use the Sekimeiya again, so if he doesn't tell you that, assume that he's lying and try to stop him.
entries.literal: "If I'm not missing anything, I don't know. However, he is hiding something, and apparently even from you.{w} I'm sure he'll want to use the Sekimeiya again, so if he doesn't tell you that, assume that he's lying and try to stop him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trying his best to sound mysterious, Sai walked away. The two most suspicious people there had inquired about Atsuki, and once again, I could only laugh inwardly as I sighed outwardly.
entries.literal: "Trying his best to sound mysterious, Sai walked away. The two most suspicious people there had inquired about Atsuki, and once again, I could only laugh inwardly as I sighed outwardly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Try to stop him." They didn't need to tell me that, but I wouldn't do anything. In any case, given that I'd been told the same thing again, it was very possible Atsuki was actually trying to pull something off.
entries.literal: "\"Try to stop him.\" They didn't need to tell me that, but I wouldn't do anything. In any case, given that I'd been told the same thing again, it was very possible Atsuki was actually trying to pull something off."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: If Naomi's really hiding, we'll never find her if we go in one group. Let's disperse ourselves through the building. There's no way we'll miss her if we do that.
entries.literal: "If Naomi's really hiding, we'll never find her if we go in one group. Let's disperse ourselves through the building. There's no way we'll miss her if we do that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What a good idea.
entries.literal: "What a good idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the blink of an eye, Atsuki and I were the only remaining people in hallway A.
entries.literal: "In the blink of an eye, Atsuki and I were the only remaining people in hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla had dragged Erina into a crystal room, Akaro had disappeared off to hallway C, and Sai and Katei had gone up the stairs individually. Despite sharing a common objective, there was no coordination, and everyone had silently chosen their own path to take.
entries.literal: "Isla had dragged Erina into a crystal room, Akaro had disappeared off to hallway C, and Sai and Katei had gone up the stairs individually. Despite sharing a common objective, there was no coordination, and everyone had silently chosen their own path to take."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were left a little puzzled, as everyone had walked away from the Sekimeiya which only I could take out of the cabinet. Was it because Atsuki told us he didn't want to use it? I couldn't exactly ask anyone.
entries.literal: "We were left a little puzzled, as everyone had walked away from the Sekimeiya which only I could take out of the cabinet. Was it because Atsuki told us he didn't want to use it? I couldn't exactly ask anyone."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Well, what do we do?
entries.literal: "...Well, what do we do?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: You're asking me? I don't know. I'm just tired.
entries.literal: "You're asking me? I don't know. I'm just tired."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Me too. You've been awake for longer, though.
entries.literal: "Me too. You've been awake for longer, though."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I know.
entries.literal: "I know."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I suppose we could go to the attic. You have the key, right?
entries.literal: "I suppose we could go to the attic. You have the key, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yeah, but we probably shouldn't go in alone, and splitting up to find Naomi won't work if half of us stay still.
entries.literal: "Yeah, but we probably shouldn't go in alone, and splitting up to find Naomi won't work if half of us stay still."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm not sure it'd work anyway. If the exit closed as the alarm went off and she's hiding somewhere, she must be confident she won't be found. And if she's working with Katei, he's definitely confident we won't find her.{w} We've already been everywhere in this building, so I don't think it's essential that we keep looking for her. If she can be found, it'll happen eventually.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure it'd work anyway. If the exit closed as the alarm went off and she's hiding somewhere, she must be confident she won't be found. And if she's working with Katei, he's definitely confident we won't find her.{w} We've already been everywhere in this building, so I don't think it's essential that we keep looking for her. If she can be found, it'll happen eventually."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...What do you want, then?
entries.literal: "...What do you want, then?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I want to go to the attic. I need to lie down for a bit.
entries.literal: "I want to go to the attic. I need to lie down for a bit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd been told not to enter without Katei's consent, but he was the one who let us keep the keys. I hesitated, but I had no reason to object, so I just shrugged and headed over to the elevator.
entries.literal: "We'd been told not to enter without Katei's consent, but he was the one who let us keep the keys. I hesitated, but I had no reason to object, so I just shrugged and headed over to the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I noticed something had changed when I reached for the handle.
entries.literal: "I noticed something had changed when I reached for the handle."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: The door's not open anymore.
entries.literal: "The door's not open anymore."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, yeah, it was earlier. {tip=perspective}Sai used it{/tip}.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah, it was earlier. {tip=perspective}Sai used it{/tip}."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: That makes sense.{w} ...And it's still here.
entries.literal: "That makes sense.{w} ...And it's still here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no resistance when I tried to open the door, meaning that Sai had gotten off on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "There was no resistance when I tried to open the door, meaning that Sai had gotten off on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki nodded before stepping in. I took the keyring from my purse and inserted the attic key into the first keyhole. The light around the floor 7 button activated, and after pressing it, we began to ascend.
entries.literal: "Atsuki nodded before stepping in. I took the keyring from my purse and inserted the attic key into the first keyhole. The light around the floor 7 button activated, and after pressing it, we began to ascend."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to think of Atsuki, but we were at least getting far away from the Sekimeiya, which felt as strange as everyone else having left. With dull eyes, he stared at the door until the trip ended. I just wished we'd gone to sleep the previous night.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to think of Atsuki, but we were at least getting far away from the Sekimeiya, which felt as strange as everyone else having left. With dull eyes, he stared at the door until the trip ended. I just wished we'd gone to sleep the previous night."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a little uncomfortable stepping onto the wooden floor, aware that there were about to be cameras pointed right at us. That sensation didn't seem to be shared by Atsuki, who directly approached the living room.
entries.literal: "I felt a little uncomfortable stepping onto the wooden floor, aware that there were about to be cameras pointed right at us. That sensation didn't seem to be shared by Atsuki, who directly approached the living room."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It doesn't look like anyone else has been here.
entries.literal: "It doesn't look like anyone else has been here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Plenty of footprints were still visible, and I figured Atsuki knew they were the same ones we'd seen before leaving.
entries.literal: "Plenty of footprints were still visible, and I figured Atsuki knew they were the same ones we'd seen before leaving."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hey, hasn't the smell from earlier faded away a lot?
entries.literal: "Hey, hasn't the smell from earlier faded away a lot?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, I think you're right.
entries.literal: "Oh, I think you're right."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I'm so exhausted... Even if we shouldn't be here, at least nobody will bother us, assuming Naomi really can't get in.
entries.literal: "...I'm so exhausted... Even if we shouldn't be here, at least nobody will bother us, assuming Naomi really can't get in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He walked down the hallway, sighing deeply. After choosing to open the right door, I heard him falling onto the bed.
entries.literal: "He walked down the hallway, sighing deeply. After choosing to open the right door, I heard him falling onto the bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the room and recalled that there was only one bed. He was already lying face-down, all energy drained out of him. I stood by the door for a moment and then closed it after stepping in.
entries.literal: "I entered the room and recalled that there was only one bed. He was already lying face-down, all energy drained out of him. I stood by the door for a moment and then closed it after stepping in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could've gone to the neighboring room, but I decided to go to the upper level instead.
entries.literal: "I could've gone to the neighboring room, but I decided to go to the upper level instead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There, I shakily sat on one of the beds, finding my situation unnerving. My whole body was stiff, and my mind felt numb. After a while, I managed to lie down, and the mattress reminded my body how tired it was.
entries.literal: "There, I shakily sat on one of the beds, finding my situation unnerving. My whole body was stiff, and my mind felt numb. After a while, I managed to lie down, and the mattress reminded my body how tired it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't fight the tiredness. Under foreign bed sheets, recorded by a camera on that forbidden floor, I pushed my consciousness away until it dissipated.
entries.literal: "I didn't fight the tiredness. Under foreign bed sheets, recorded by a camera on that forbidden floor, I pushed my consciousness away until it dissipated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I woke up, I realized I must not have slept for very long, as I didn't feel like I had dreamed at all. I was still uneasy, and I hadn't turned off the light.
entries.literal: "When I woke up, I realized I must not have slept for very long, as I didn't feel like I had dreamed at all. I was still uneasy, and I hadn't turned off the light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I didn't know the time, it was fairly likely that people were looking for us and couldn't get in the attic. I didn't care anymore; my back hurt, and I was just as tired as before. I slowly stood up and approached the light switch.
entries.literal: "While I didn't know the time, it was fairly likely that people were looking for us and couldn't get in the attic. I didn't care anymore; my back hurt, and I was just as tired as before. I slowly stood up and approached the light switch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But my hand stopped before touching it, and so did my whole body.
entries.literal: "But my hand stopped before touching it, and so did my whole body."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Did I just do this?
entries.literal: "...Did I just do this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd noticed something very important next to the bed.
entries.literal: "I'd noticed something very important next to the bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was only one thing I did before falling asleep: look at my purse. I'd stared at it and then forced myself to look away, nervous that it was so out in the open.
entries.literal: "There was only one thing I did before falling asleep: look at my purse. I'd stared at it and then forced myself to look away, nervous that it was so out in the open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Because if I'd fallen asleep, someone could've looked inside. ...And that was something that couldn't happen.
entries.literal: "Because if I'd fallen asleep, someone could've looked inside. ...And that was something that couldn't happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I crouched very slowly and then looked at it from the same position as before.
entries.literal: "I crouched very slowly and then looked at it from the same position as before."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It moved. It wasn't like that when I fell asleep.
entries.literal: "It moved. It wasn't like that when I fell asleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The difference was minimal, but I noticed it immediately, and it was no mistake.
entries.literal: "The difference was minimal, but I noticed it immediately, and it was no mistake."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No, did he...?{w} Or did I just poke it when I stood up?
entries.literal: "No, did he...?{w} Or did I just poke it when I stood up?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I widened the opening with my fingers and looked inside.
entries.literal: "I widened the opening with my fingers and looked inside."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Everything's here.
entries.literal: "Everything's here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing had been taken, but that didn't settle it.
entries.literal: "Nothing had been taken, but that didn't settle it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The keys were inside. If someone had gone through my purse, it was very likely those keys were the target, but they were far from my concern.
entries.literal: "The keys were inside. If someone had gone through my purse, it was very likely those keys were the target, but they were far from my concern."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki and I should've been alone in the attic, which had both of its entrances locked.{w} I suddenly wasn't sensing my tiredness anymore. I grabbed my purse and approached the hatch.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and I should've been alone in the attic, which had both of its entrances locked.{w} I suddenly wasn't sensing my tiredness anymore. I grabbed my purse and approached the hatch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was shut, so I slowly lifted it up.
entries.literal: "It was shut, so I slowly lifted it up."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Are you awake?
entries.literal: "...Are you awake?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Uh,{w=0.4} yes...{w=0.5} I only slept for a few minutes and couldn't do it again.
entries.literal: "Uh,{w=0.4} yes...{w=0.5} I only slept for a few minutes and couldn't do it again."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: How do you know it was only a few minutes?
entries.literal: "How do you know it was only a few minutes?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Huh? That's just what it felt like. Did you just wake up?
entries.literal: "Huh? That's just what it felt like. Did you just wake up?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a few seconds to reply while I climbed down the ladder. The light was turned on, and the sheets over him were in disarray.
entries.literal: "I took a few seconds to reply while I climbed down the ladder. The light was turned on, and the sheets over him were in disarray."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yeah, I don't know how long it's been.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I don't know how long it's been."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I spent a very long time trying to sleep again, so I think at least two hours.
entries.literal: "I spent a very long time trying to sleep again, so I think at least two hours."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, really...?
entries.literal: "Oh, really...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: *yawn*{w} Yeah, and I don't think it'll happen. Are you still tired?
entries.literal: "*yawn*{w} Yeah, and I don't think it'll happen. Are you still tired?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: No, I'm fine now.
entries.literal: "No, I'm fine now."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt as if part of my mind had cleared up. We'd seriously gotten trapped in the building, and Atsuki had traveled through time. ...Could that be true? Could that really have happened?
entries.literal: "I felt as if part of my mind had cleared up. We'd seriously gotten trapped in the building, and Atsuki had traveled through time. ...Could that be true? Could that really have happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He sat on the bed and stretched his arms.
entries.literal: "He sat on the bed and stretched his arms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was so absurd that I hadn't been able to react when I'd seen him teleport. It had all suddenly happened with no room for doubt, but what was going on? Only after waking up had I begun to comprehend how strange it was that he'd wanted to go to the attic.
entries.literal: "It was so absurd that I hadn't been able to react when I'd seen him teleport. It had all suddenly happened with no room for doubt, but what was going on? Only after waking up had I begun to comprehend how strange it was that he'd wanted to go to the attic."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Did you hear anything outside the bedroom?
entries.literal: "Did you hear anything outside the bedroom?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No. We might really have the only key to this place.
entries.literal: "No. We might really have the only key to this place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since I didn't want to ask, I approached the door. The chain wasn't set, so I turned the handle to see if he'd locked it.
entries.literal: "Since I didn't want to ask, I approached the door. The chain wasn't set, so I turned the handle to see if he'd locked it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door opened smoothly, indicating that anyone could've made their way in.
entries.literal: "The door opened smoothly, indicating that anyone could've made their way in."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you want to go back down? I was waiting for you to wake up. I'm not as tired anymore.
entries.literal: "Do you want to go back down? I was waiting for you to wake up. I'm not as tired anymore."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...{w}Yeah, sure.
entries.literal: "...{w}Yeah, sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was I being toyed with? The more seconds passed, the more I felt that way.
entries.literal: "Was I being toyed with? The more seconds passed, the more I felt that way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki stood up and silently walked to the hallway.
entries.literal: "Atsuki stood up and silently walked to the hallway."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Nobody crossed this carpet. I can hardly see the footprints anymore.{w} ...You have the key with you, right?
entries.literal: "Nobody crossed this carpet. I can hardly see the footprints anymore.{w} ...You have the key with you, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Well, we should probably use the elevator again, so I don't think we'll need it.
entries.literal: "Well, we should probably use the elevator again, so I don't think we'll need it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He tried to open the door, but he couldn't.
entries.literal: "He tried to open the door, but he couldn't."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I suppose someone called it while we were sleeping.
entries.literal: "I suppose someone called it while we were sleeping."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I leaned on the wall while he pressed the button. I was acting disinterested naturally, but I couldn't get the sight of my purse out of my head.
entries.literal: "I leaned on the wall while he pressed the button. I was acting disinterested naturally, but I couldn't get the sight of my purse out of my head."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The silent orange light indicated the elevator's arrival. Atsuki pulled the door open, and we walked in.
entries.literal: "The silent orange light indicated the elevator's arrival. Atsuki pulled the door open, and we walked in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator began to descend toward the lowest floor—the destination that Atsuki had chosen.
entries.literal: "The elevator began to descend toward the lowest floor—the destination that Atsuki had chosen."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I guess we'll have to apologize for going up, but we were really tired. I wonder if they found Naomi...
entries.literal: "I guess we'll have to apologize for going up, but we were really tired. I wonder if they found Naomi..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki was resembling Katei more and more to me, and I didn't know if I could trust him.{w} Behind him was the red stop button, which Katei claimed would confine us inside until the alarm's effects automatically reverted.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was resembling Katei more and more to me, and I didn't know if I could trust him.{w} Behind him was the red stop button, which Katei claimed would confine us inside until the alarm's effects automatically reverted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I didn't dare touch it, allowing the doors to open. After Atsuki pushed open the outer one, hallway C came into sight, just as barren as we remembered it.
entries.literal: "But I didn't dare touch it, allowing the doors to open. After Atsuki pushed open the outer one, hallway C came into sight, just as barren as we remembered it."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Let's go to the security room. Maybe we can look at the time.
entries.literal: "Let's go to the security room. Maybe we can look at the time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The light was on, but no screens were. That meant that Sai's watch was still all we had.
entries.literal: "The light was on, but no screens were. That meant that Sai's watch was still all we had."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It hasn't been fixed... I can't hear anyone, but they should be somewhere on this floor.
entries.literal: "It hasn't been fixed... I can't hear anyone, but they should be somewhere on this floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki was ready to leave, but I couldn't help but feel iffy about the computer's shutdown. Katei was the only one who tried to fix it.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was ready to leave, but I couldn't help but feel iffy about the computer's shutdown. Katei was the only one who tried to fix it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since we were alone, I crouched under the desk and stared at the mess of cables that Katei had been examining.
entries.literal: "Since we were alone, I crouched under the desk and stared at the mess of cables that Katei had been examining."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Uh...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After glancing back and forth, an oddity stood out.
entries.literal: "After glancing back and forth, an oddity stood out."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Can you even see properly down there?
entries.literal: "Can you even see properly down there?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes, and this cable isn't plugged in.
entries.literal: "Yes, and this cable isn't plugged in."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I don't know what it's for, but Katei said that everything was in place.
entries.literal: "I don't know what it's for, but Katei said that everything was in place."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Can you tell where it should go?
entries.literal: "Can you tell where it should go?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The angle was uncomfortable on my neck, but I strained to look behind the computer tower and found a slot that could fit. Forced to use my left hand, I grabbed the cable and managed to plug it into the computer.
entries.literal: "The angle was uncomfortable on my neck, but I strained to look behind the computer tower and found a slot that could fit. Forced to use my left hand, I grabbed the cable and managed to plug it into the computer."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I don't know if that did anything, but it's plugged in now.
entries.literal: "I don't know if that did anything, but it's plugged in now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I clambered out as Atsuki pressed the power button.
entries.literal: "I clambered out as Atsuki pressed the power button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few seconds later, the system began to run.
entries.literal: "A few seconds later, the system began to run."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...A-Are you serious?
entries.literal: "...A-Are you serious?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The middle screen lit up, and a loading logo glowed.
entries.literal: "The middle screen lit up, and a loading logo glowed."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't get it. Did Katei do this and hope we wouldn't look at the cables?
entries.literal: "I don't get it. Did Katei do this and hope we wouldn't look at the cables?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd begun to gather hope, but it dissipated as soon as the computer turned off again.
entries.literal: "I'd begun to gather hope, but it dissipated as soon as the computer turned off again."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Huh? Is it still not working?
entries.literal: "...Huh? Is it still not working?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Confused, Atsuki powered it on one more time.
entries.literal: "Confused, Atsuki powered it on one more time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The same thing happened: seconds after running, it automatically powered off.
entries.literal: "The same thing happened: seconds after running, it automatically powered off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki looked under the desk in case he could spot the problem.
entries.literal: "Atsuki looked under the desk in case he could spot the problem."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't see anything clearly wrong. Maybe the operating system got damaged.
entries.literal: "I don't see anything clearly wrong. Maybe the operating system got damaged."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I see... We need to tell the others about this—especially Katei.
entries.literal: "I see... We need to tell the others about this—especially Katei."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Right.
entries.literal: "Right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were about to leave when Atsuki remembered what I'd said.
entries.literal: "We were about to leave when Atsuki remembered what I'd said."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, wait. We might still be able to look at the time.
entries.literal: "Oh, wait. We might still be able to look at the time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He walked back toward the computer and powered it on. While it was running, he looked at the screen and pressed one of the suggested keys. Then, the screen changed.
entries.literal: "He walked back toward the computer and powered it on. While it was running, he looked at the screen and pressed one of the suggested keys. Then, the screen changed."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I just accessed the BIOS. If I knew more about computers, I might be able to pinpoint the issue, but look here.
entries.literal: "I just accessed the BIOS. If I knew more about computers, I might be able to pinpoint the issue, but look here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the top right corner, "{time=13:16}" was displayed in black digits.
entries.literal: "In the top right corner, \"{time=13:16}\" was displayed in black digits."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, {time=13} already. I guess I did sleep for over two hours.
entries.literal: "Oh, {time=13} already. I guess I did sleep for over two hours."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Ye—
entries.literal: "Ye—"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Did you hear that?
entries.literal: "...Did you hear that?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Hm? I didn't hear anything.
entries.literal: "Hm? I didn't hear anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He warily walked to the hallway A door and looked through it.
entries.literal: "He warily walked to the hallway A door and looked through it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I think I heard something in the lobby.
entries.literal: "I think I heard something in the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seeing how cautious he was, I approached it myself.
entries.literal: "Seeing how cautious he was, I approached it myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody was there.
entries.literal: "Nobody was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still fazed by the imposing shutter, Atsuki walked forward a little.
entries.literal: "Still fazed by the imposing shutter, Atsuki walked forward a little."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did I imagine it...?
entries.literal: "Did I imagine it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Both other doors were shut. Atsuki circled the room at a slow pace and stopped to smell the air. Then, he continued his circle with a frown.
entries.literal: "Both other doors were shut. Atsuki circled the room at a slow pace and stopped to smell the air. Then, he continued his circle with a frown."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There's this open drawer. It wasn't like this before, was it?
entries.literal: "There's this open drawer. It wasn't like this before, was it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved over to him. Behind the reception desk, one of the drawers wasn't fully closed.
entries.literal: "I moved over to him. Behind the reception desk, one of the drawers wasn't fully closed."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, no, I don't think so.
entries.literal: "Oh, no, I don't think so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked inside and confirmed that there was nothing in it. Then, Atsuki proceeded to open all the other drawers.
entries.literal: "We looked inside and confirmed that there was nothing in it. Then, Atsuki proceeded to open all the other drawers."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There's only papers in a few of them.
entries.literal: "There's only papers in a few of them."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: That's strange. I honestly can't be sure it wasn't open before.
entries.literal: "That's strange. I honestly can't be sure it wasn't open before."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Something else we'll have to ask.
entries.literal: "Something else we'll have to ask."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While walking toward hallway B, Atsuki noticed I still hadn't moved.
entries.literal: "While walking toward hallway B, Atsuki noticed I still hadn't moved."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What's up?
entries.literal: "What's up?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Come back. You hear this faint buzz, right?
entries.literal: "Come back. You hear this faint buzz, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes. It's coming from below, right?
entries.literal: "Yes. It's coming from below, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: It's the boiler. I was thinking that it must be really annoying to work at this chair with this constant noise.
entries.literal: "It's the boiler. I was thinking that it must be really annoying to work at this chair with this constant noise."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: But then I thought that it might not have been as noticeable before. You didn't go to the mechanical room, but the rest of us did. I'm not sure it was audible from up here.
entries.literal: "But then I thought that it might not have been as noticeable before. You didn't go to the mechanical room, but the rest of us did. I'm not sure it was audible from up here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: O-Oh.
entries.literal: "O-Oh."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked at the door he'd not yet gone through.
entries.literal: "He looked at the door he'd not yet gone through."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Actually, I remember beginning to hear the sound as we were going down the stairs.
entries.literal: "Actually, I remember beginning to hear the sound as we were going down the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as he opened it, the intensity of the sound strengthened. There was no light on the stairs, and they immediately made a sharp turn.
entries.literal: "As soon as he opened it, the intensity of the sound strengthened. There was no light on the stairs, and they immediately made a sharp turn."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You think the boiler got louder, then?
entries.literal: "You think the boiler got louder, then?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, that's not what I meant.
entries.literal: "Oh, that's not what I meant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a few steps forward, I confirmed my assumption: the short door leading to the mechanical room was partially open.
entries.literal: "After a few steps forward, I confirmed my assumption: the short door leading to the mechanical room was partially open."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: It's this door. It was shut when we came, so the sound didn't reach us. I don't remember if we closed it when we left.
entries.literal: "It's this door. It was shut when we came, so the sound didn't reach us. I don't remember if we closed it when we left."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Ah, I see. So at most, it means that someone went down here, but I'm sure they searched for us and Naomi. It's fine.
entries.literal: "Ah, I see. So at most, it means that someone went down here, but I'm sure they searched for us and Naomi. It's fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He began descending the stairs. If he'd really heard a sound coming from the lobby, it was possible someone was under us.
entries.literal: "He began descending the stairs. If he'd really heard a sound coming from the lobby, it was possible someone was under us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After widening the gap of the door, he stepped into the basement room, which was constantly beset by the buzzing noise. I stopped behind him, waiting for my eyes to adjust to the illumination the faint light bulb offered.
entries.literal: "After widening the gap of the door, he stepped into the basement room, which was constantly beset by the buzzing noise. I stopped behind him, waiting for my eyes to adjust to the illumination the faint light bulb offered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But even when that happened, the darkness still reigned. Atsuki started to walk slowly in order to comprehend where he was.
entries.literal: "But even when that happened, the darkness still reigned. Atsuki started to walk slowly in order to comprehend where he was."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I-I don't think there's anyone here.
entries.literal: "I-I don't think there's anyone here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could discern a few pieces of furniture that Atsuki had moved aside and the walls closest to me. Strangely, I felt relieved to hear there was nobody with us, even though we wanted to find the others.
entries.literal: "I could discern a few pieces of furniture that Atsuki had moved aside and the walls closest to me. Strangely, I felt relieved to hear there was nobody with us, even though we wanted to find the others."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait, no.
entries.literal: "Wait, no."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Look.
entries.literal: "Look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought we were about to leave, but that wasn't the case. I approached the dark blob Atsuki was next to until it was revealed to be a pile of chairs. Behind it, on the floor, was an abnormal, weak glow.
entries.literal: "I thought we were about to leave, but that wasn't the case. I approached the dark blob Atsuki was next to until it was revealed to be a pile of chairs. Behind it, on the floor, was an abnormal, weak glow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya. The gemstone we'd come to see and which possessed a mysterious power. Immobile on the floor, it resembled the ceiling light.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya. The gemstone we'd come to see and which possessed a mysterious power. Immobile on the floor, it resembled the ceiling light."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Sai was right. Katei had the key, and he used it while we were in the attic.
entries.literal: "Sai was right. Katei had the key, and he used it while we were in the attic."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.literal: "...Yeah."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm not sure why he'd hide the Sekimeiya, though.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure why he'd hide the Sekimeiya, though."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I don't think it makes any sense. He would've had better places to hide it, like his locker.
entries.literal: "I don't think it makes any sense. He would've had better places to hide it, like his locker."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You think so? We could force him to open it at any time, and it would be easily found after the exit opens.
entries.literal: "You think so? We could force him to open it at any time, and it would be easily found after the exit opens."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki crouched next to the Sekimeiya and stared at it.
entries.literal: "Atsuki crouched next to the Sekimeiya and stared at it."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Are you gonna use it?
entries.literal: "...Are you gonna use it?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: We don't know how long it's been here for, so it might not be a good idea.
entries.literal: "We don't know how long it's been here for, so it might not be a good idea."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.literal: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Well, if the time you travel depends on how long it spends out of the cabinet, you could go really far back.
entries.literal: "Well, if the time you travel depends on how long it spends out of the cabinet, you could go really far back."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh... Hm, I see.
entries.literal: "Oh... Hm, I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, he went quiet. I had no idea what he was thinking, but I knew I didn't like it.
entries.literal: "Once again, he went quiet. I had no idea what he was thinking, but I knew I didn't like it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had warned me not to let Atsuki get his hands on the Sekimeiya, and I had no idea why. All I knew was that he was keeping some of his thoughts to himself, and I suspected he'd lied to me.
entries.literal: "Sai had warned me not to let Atsuki get his hands on the Sekimeiya, and I had no idea why. All I knew was that he was keeping some of his thoughts to himself, and I suspected he'd lied to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was concocting something—that I was sure of. Not only because I knew him, he'd outright admitted it to me.
