entries.literal: "He was concocting something—that I was sure of. Not only because I knew him, he'd outright admitted it to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For once, the silence wasn't entirely pure. The mechanical room's noise was pervasive. Minutes after staring at the gemstone, Atsuki's hand hovered over it.
entries.literal: "For once, the silence wasn't entirely pure. The mechanical room's noise was pervasive. Minutes after staring at the gemstone, Atsuki's hand hovered over it."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What are you doing?
entries.literal: "What are you doing?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's hot, the air around it.
entries.literal: "It's hot, the air around it."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, that's weird.
entries.literal: "Oh, that's weird."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: When I touched it earlier, I felt a zap for an instant before I teleported. I have no idea how, but it heated up really fast. When I was holding the cushion from below, it went from cold to hot in a minute.
entries.literal: "When I touched it earlier, I felt a zap for an instant before I teleported. I have no idea how, but it heated up really fast. When I was holding the cushion from below, it went from cold to hot in a minute."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know how to answer, but the bizarre situation sunk in even further. What the hell was the Sekimeiya, and what was it doing with us?
entries.literal: "I didn't know how to answer, but the bizarre situation sunk in even further. What the hell was the Sekimeiya, and what was it doing with us?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Are you going to use it to change the past?
entries.literal: "Are you going to use it to change the past?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't know.
entries.literal: "I don't know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That answer reinforced everything I'd been feeling. He couldn't not know. He knew exactly what his goal was, and I did too. So why was he acting so reserved?
entries.literal: "That answer reinforced everything I'd been feeling. He couldn't not know. He knew exactly what his goal was, and I did too. So why was he acting so reserved?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But he didn't flesh out his answer, opting to resume his silence. Even though I couldn't see his face, his slow breathing told me all I needed to know.
entries.literal: "But he didn't flesh out his answer, opting to resume his silence. Even though I couldn't see his face, his slow breathing told me all I needed to know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I might've pushed the issue further if something hadn't hit me.
entries.literal: "I might've pushed the issue further if something hadn't hit me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When he teleported...
entries.literal: "When he teleported..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After mentioning the time he'd touched the Sekimeiya, a glaring contradiction that I'd previously ignored reared its head.
entries.literal: "After mentioning the time he'd touched the Sekimeiya, a glaring contradiction that I'd previously ignored reared its head."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: You traveled to the attic, right?
entries.literal: "You traveled to the attic, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He's lying.
entries.literal: "He's lying."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There's no way he traveled to the attic. Did he not realize that it doesn't make sense?
entries.literal: "There's no way he traveled to the attic. Did he not realize that it doesn't make sense?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He said he traveled twenty minutes to the past. At that point, all of us were in the attic as well.
entries.literal: "He said he traveled twenty minutes to the past. At that point, all of us were in the attic as well."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That's fine depending on where he appeared. It's not like he erased his past self, right? So if he appeared in one of the rooms after they'd been investigated, we wouldn't have seen him.
entries.literal: "That's fine depending on where he appeared. It's not like he erased his past self, right? So if he appeared in one of the rooms after they'd been investigated, we wouldn't have seen him."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But there's a big problem.
entries.literal: "But there's a big problem."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Where in the attic did you appear?
entries.literal: "Where in the attic did you appear?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hm? In the kitchen, and I'm pretty sure that's because I went there before we left. It's something I was trying to figure out earlier.
entries.literal: "Hm? In the kitchen, and I'm pretty sure that's because I went there before we left. It's something I was trying to figure out earlier."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Ah...

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No, he's lying.
entries.literal: "No, he's lying."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The only part of the attic where he could've appeared is the staircase at the entrance.
entries.literal: "The only part of the attic where he could've appeared is the staircase at the entrance."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Every other place doesn't make sense. When we searched the whole floor, we made sure nobody could sneak past us. Katei waited in the corner of the hallway and Akaro in the living room.
entries.literal: "Every other place doesn't make sense. When we searched the whole floor, we made sure nobody could sneak past us. Katei waited in the corner of the hallway and Akaro in the living room."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: As Erina said, twenty minutes before the time he traveled, all of us were still in the attic and were about to leave. Atsuki, who had traveled, didn't deny that.
entries.literal: "As Erina said, twenty minutes before the time he traveled, all of us were still in the attic and were about to leave. Atsuki, who had traveled, didn't deny that."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: According to him, he appeared in the kitchen and then we left. That's not right.
entries.literal: "According to him, he appeared in the kitchen and then we left. That's not right."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: For some reason, the elevator started functioning again, and Sai called it. Then he, Akaro, Erina, and Isla went to the crystal floor with it. However, Katei, Atsuki, and I left through the main door and locked it.
entries.literal: "For some reason, the elevator started functioning again, and Sai called it. Then he, Akaro, Erina, and Isla went to the crystal floor with it. However, Katei, Atsuki, and I left through the main door and locked it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Atsuki, after appearing in the kitchen, would not have been able to leave the attic.{w} He couldn't have left through the staircase before us, because there were no footprints that started from the kitchen.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, after appearing in the kitchen, would not have been able to leave the attic.{w} He couldn't have left through the staircase before us, because there were no footprints that started from the kitchen."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When we left, we locked the main door, but most importantly, we learned that when the three of us arrived at the crystal floor, Katei saw the door of the elevator slightly open.
entries.literal: "When we left, we locked the main door, but most importantly, we learned that when the three of us arrived at the crystal floor, Katei saw the door of the elevator slightly open."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: How does he not understand that what he's saying is impossible? The elevator remained open on the crystal floor until a time after he'd already reunited with us. If he was in the attic, he couldn't have called it.
entries.literal: "How does he not understand that what he's saying is impossible? The elevator remained open on the crystal floor until a time after he'd already reunited with us. If he was in the attic, he couldn't have called it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It just doesn't work. When we were in the security room, the elevator was still open, and it had to be either Sai or Naomi who finally closed it.
entries.literal: "It just doesn't work. When we were in the security room, the elevator was still open, and it had to be either Sai or Naomi who finally closed it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Could it be that it wasn't the group of four who left the door open? ...Is it possible Atsuki used the elevator immediately after them, and it was actually him who didn't close it properly?
entries.literal: "Could it be that it wasn't the group of four who left the door open? ...Is it possible Atsuki used the elevator immediately after them, and it was actually him who didn't close it properly?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I don't think he would've had enough time to call it back and go all the way down. ...And it's very unlikely the others wouldn't have seen him. It's even possible we would've heard the elevator going up and down from the offices.
entries.literal: "I don't think he would've had enough time to call it back and go all the way down. ...And it's very unlikely the others wouldn't have seen him. It's even possible we would've heard the elevator going up and down from the offices."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, how did he leave the attic?
entries.literal: "So, how did he leave the attic?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's not possible. He couldn't have. Both methods were unavailable.
entries.literal: "It's not possible. He couldn't have. Both methods were unavailable."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The only way would've been with the key that I have. Even if he somehow got out, maybe by Naomi unlocking the door, he should've mentioned that it was unlocked when it wasn't supposed to be. He's definitely lying.
entries.literal: "The only way would've been with the key that I have. Even if he somehow got out, maybe by Naomi unlocking the door, he should've mentioned that it was unlocked when it wasn't supposed to be. He's definitely lying."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I became aware of the smell surrounding me, the one which almost seamlessly blended in. Its cold sensation had persisted in my nostrils since the first time we'd encountered it, so it hadn't immediately evident that it had strengthened again.
entries.literal: "I became aware of the smell surrounding me, the one which almost seamlessly blended in. Its cold sensation had persisted in my nostrils since the first time we'd encountered it, so it hadn't immediately evident that it had strengthened again."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...All right, I'll touch it. There's one thing I absolutely have to confirm.
entries.literal: "...All right, I'll touch it. There's one thing I absolutely have to confirm."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: And what is that?
entries.literal: "And what is that?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Whether or not the past can be changed.
entries.literal: "Whether or not the past can be changed."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...You think it can't?
entries.literal: "...You think it can't?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't know; I wasn't able to change anything the last time. I have no idea how this will work.{w} I'll disappear from this room and appear somewhere else. If I try to change what I experienced, I don't know how the universe will react. Perhaps you won't notice any difference and I'll branch the world. Maybe this reality will instantly morph into the one I'm making.
entries.literal: "I don't know; I wasn't able to change anything the last time. I have no idea how this will work.{w} I'll disappear from this room and appear somewhere else. If I try to change what I experienced, I don't know how the universe will react. Perhaps you won't notice any difference and I'll branch the world. Maybe this reality will instantly morph into the one I'm making."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite how ridiculous he sounded, all he was really saying was that he was about to leave me there. That maybe I'd stay in the world he'd disappeared from while he went on to find his better reality.
entries.literal: "Despite how ridiculous he sounded, all he was really saying was that he was about to leave me there. That maybe I'd stay in the world he'd disappeared from while he went on to find his better reality."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was annoying, and given everything else going on in my head, I simply shrugged. He would leave me behind with the Sekimeiya, which would be a great chance to fulfill Sai's request.
entries.literal: "It was annoying, and given everything else going on in my head, I simply shrugged. He would leave me behind with the Sekimeiya, which would be a great chance to fulfill Sai's request."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I was going to say that if the past can't be changed, I'll be above the stairs after I disappear, but there's no way that'll be the case. If I was there right now, I'd try to make a loud noise to change the past, so I have no clue what's about to happen.
entries.literal: "...I was going to say that if the past can't be changed, I'll be above the stairs after I disappear, but there's no way that'll be the case. If I was there right now, I'd try to make a loud noise to change the past, so I have no clue what's about to happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't talk about it further. Finally, the hand that'd been teasing contact for so long dropped to touch the shining gem. Instantly, Atsuki's outline disappeared.
entries.literal: "He didn't talk about it further. Finally, the hand that'd been teasing contact for so long dropped to touch the shining gem. Instantly, Atsuki's outline disappeared."

entries.text: Ten Interloping Eyes
entries.literal: "Ten Interloping Eyes"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Wh—!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And with it, the darkness disappeared as well.
entries.literal: "And with it, the darkness disappeared as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I almost fell in place. Before I could crouch to grab the Sekimeiya, the door to the lobby was in front of me.
entries.literal: "I almost fell in place. Before I could crouch to grab the Sekimeiya, the door to the lobby was in front of me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was in hallway A. While the illumination was poor, it wasn't comparable to the mechanical room, mostly thanks to the light coming from the event room.
entries.literal: "I was in hallway A. While the illumination was poor, it wasn't comparable to the mechanical room, mostly thanks to the light coming from the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had teleported; nothing else could've happened. I took one step forward and confirmed that my legs still worked.
entries.literal: "I had teleported; nothing else could've happened. I took one step forward and confirmed that my legs still worked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A voice came from over my shoulders. I turned around and saw Atsuki, who'd stiffened.
entries.literal: "A voice came from over my shoulders. I turned around and saw Atsuki, who'd stiffened."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: D-Did I just appear out of nowhere?
entries.literal: "D-Did I just appear out of nowhere?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What...? No, that's what happened to me.
entries.literal: "What...? No, that's what happened to me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Wait.
entries.literal: "...Wait."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Were you just in the mechanical room?
entries.literal: "Were you just in the mechanical room?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes... I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago.
entries.literal: "Yes... I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I showed up here as soon as you did that. Are we in the past...?
entries.literal: "I showed up here as soon as you did that. Are we in the past...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}It teleported you as well? How come that didn't happen the other times?{w} And both of us appeared here...
entries.literal: "...{w}It teleported you as well? How come that didn't happen the other times?{w} And both of us appeared here..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey! What the fuck...!? Where have you two been!?
entries.literal: "Hey! What the fuck...!? Where have you two been!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai emerged from the event room. Behind him was Erina, who looked surprised to see us.
entries.literal: "Sai emerged from the event room. Behind him was Erina, who looked surprised to see us."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Has anything happened?
entries.literal: "...Has anything happened?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What...!? You've been gone for over two hours! Answer the question!
entries.literal: "What...!? You've been gone for over two hours! Answer the question!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki appeared wary, perhaps because Sai might have overheard what we'd been talking about.
entries.literal: "Atsuki appeared wary, perhaps because Sai might have overheard what we'd been talking about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the event room. Isla was with them, and she looked a little sad, standing next to the cabinet with its empty interior exposed. The Sekimeiya was probably still in the mechanical room at that moment.
entries.literal: "We entered the event room. Isla was with them, and she looked a little sad, standing next to the cabinet with its empty interior exposed. The Sekimeiya was probably still in the mechanical room at that moment."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We didn't get any sleep last night, so we were really tired and went to the attic. We woke up a few minutes ago.
entries.literal: "We didn't get any sleep last night, so we were really tired and went to the attic. We woke up a few minutes ago."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck? You were sleeping? Why didn't you say anything!?
entries.literal: "What the fuck? You were sleeping? Why didn't you say anything!?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Because Katei wouldn't have let us.
entries.literal: "Because Katei wouldn't have let us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Excuse me?{w} Was Katei not with you?
entries.literal: "...Excuse me?{w} Was Katei not with you?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What? No, he wasn't. We went alone.
entries.literal: "What? No, he wasn't. We went alone."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Where is he, then? We haven't seen him either, not for a long time.
entries.literal: "Where is he, then? We haven't seen him either, not for a long time."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: He wasn't with us.
entries.literal: "He wasn't with us."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We thought the three of you were in the attic, which we couldn't enter.
entries.literal: "We thought the three of you were in the attic, which we couldn't enter."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It was just the two of us.
entries.literal: "It was just the two of us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}What the fuck, then!?
entries.literal: "...{w}What the fuck, then!?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You don't have any idea where he went?
entries.literal: "You don't have any idea where he went?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, we thought you three were locked up there, so we didn't search everywhere. We even thought Naomi could have been with you since she's still missing.
entries.literal: "Well, we thought you three were locked up there, so we didn't search everywhere. We even thought Naomi could have been with you since she's still missing."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What about Akaro? Where is he?
entries.literal: "What about Akaro? Where is he?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No idea, but I saw him not too long ago. He's been here the whole time.{w} Do you still have the key to the attic?
entries.literal: "No idea, but I saw him not too long ago. He's been here the whole time.{w} Do you still have the key to the attic?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I see. That's good.
entries.literal: "...I see. That's good."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hold on. What happened to the Sekimeiya? Why is it not here?
entries.literal: "Hold on. What happened to the Sekimeiya? Why is it not here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We have no idea. We thought one of you came down to pick it up and brought it to the attic. The cabinet was locked, and none of us had the key to unlock it. If you two didn't take it out, Katei or Naomi must have another key.
entries.literal: "We have no idea. We thought one of you came down to pick it up and brought it to the attic. The cabinet was locked, and none of us had the key to unlock it. If you two didn't take it out, Katei or Naomi must have another key."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's been gone from the cabinet for a while, but Akaro and I searched this floor and found it in a drawer in the lobby.
entries.literal: "It's been gone from the cabinet for a while, but Akaro and I searched this floor and found it in a drawer in the lobby."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We put it back in here, and about twenty minutes ago, we realized it had been taken out again. Again, Katei or Naomi did that if it wasn't one of you.
entries.literal: "We put it back in here, and about twenty minutes ago, we realized it had been taken out again. Again, Katei or Naomi did that if it wasn't one of you."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}Oh, right, what time is it?
entries.literal: "...{w}Oh, right, what time is it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He showed us his wristwatch. Immediately, Atsuki turned to face me.
entries.literal: "He showed us his wristwatch. Immediately, Atsuki turned to face me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew why. At that moment, we had just walked down the stairs to the mechanical room. We'd been down there for a while, and then we had appeared in hallway A during the time we'd been in the security room.
entries.literal: "I knew why. At that moment, we had just walked down the stairs to the mechanical room. We'd been down there for a while, and then we had appeared in hallway A during the time we'd been in the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki wanted to change the past, and he had the chance to do so. I doubted that he wanted to be seen by his past self, but making a loud noise would serve as a confirmation that the possibility existed. If nothing else, I'd be able to witness it too thanks to traveling with him.
entries.literal: "Atsuki wanted to change the past, and he had the chance to do so. I doubted that he wanted to be seen by his past self, but making a loud noise would serve as a confirmation that the possibility existed. If nothing else, I'd be able to witness it too thanks to traveling with him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, it was at that moment that a sound reached our ears.
entries.literal: "However, it was at that moment that a sound reached our ears."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As we glanced at the hallway A door, the sound got louder. It didn't take much time for the door to open, revealing Akaro on the other side.
entries.literal: "As we glanced at the hallway A door, the sound got louder. It didn't take much time for the door to open, revealing Akaro on the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone present was surprised at the same time.{w} While Akaro hadn't expected to see me and Atsuki, we hadn't expected to see who he was with either.
entries.literal: "Everyone present was surprised at the same time.{w} While Akaro hadn't expected to see me and Atsuki, we hadn't expected to see who he was with either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At his side was Katei, who had supposedly been missing for quite some time. He stared at us hesitantly, evidently anticipating our reaction.
entries.literal: "At his side was Katei, who had supposedly been missing for quite some time. He stared at us hesitantly, evidently anticipating our reaction."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...H-Hey! What the fuck have you been doing!?
entries.literal: "...H-Hey! What the fuck have you been doing!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Remaining silent, Katei turned to the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Remaining silent, Katei turned to the cabinet."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You found them too...?
entries.literal: "You found them too...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They said they were sleeping alone in the attic. ...Katei, what are you waiting for? Where the fuck have you been?
entries.literal: "They said they were sleeping alone in the attic. ...Katei, what are you waiting for? Where the fuck have you been?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I've been here.{w} *sigh*
entries.literal: "...I've been here.{w} *sigh*"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sorry?
entries.literal: "I'm sorry?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I've been here this whole time. I didn't go anywhere.
entries.literal: "I've been here this whole time. I didn't go anywhere."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh-What? Do you know how long it's been since we saw you?
entries.literal: "Wh-What? Do you know how long it's been since we saw you?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm being serious. Do you have any idea how long we've been looking around for you?
entries.literal: "I'm being serious. Do you have any idea how long we've been looking around for you?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It's been almost {tip=hours}three hours{/tip}, I know. I couldn't have gone anywhere. I just came across Akaro ten minutes ago.
entries.literal: "It's been almost {tip=hours}three hours{/tip}, I know. I couldn't have gone anywhere. I just came across Akaro ten minutes ago."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I saw him in hallway C and asked him the same thing. He said he'd been here looking for us. We went to the sixth floor to find you since I'd seen you there earlier and I didn't know where Erina and Isla were.
entries.literal: "I saw him in hallway C and asked him the same thing. He said he'd been here looking for us. We went to the sixth floor to find you since I'd seen you there earlier and I didn't know where Erina and Isla were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at Atsuki, who'd been quiet for a while. He was thinking about something, but was it along the lines of everyone showing up meaning that the past couldn't change? It still should've been as simple as going to the lobby.
entries.literal: "I looked at Atsuki, who'd been quiet for a while. He was thinking about something, but was it along the lines of everyone showing up meaning that the past couldn't change? It still should've been as simple as going to the lobby."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Where is the Sekimeiya? And did I hear that you two were sleeping in the attic...? Did I not tell you—
entries.literal: "Where is the Sekimeiya? And did I hear that you two were sleeping in the attic...? Did I not tell you—"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Shut up. What the fuck did that even mean?
entries.literal: "Shut up. What the fuck did that even mean?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You said that it's almost been three hours since we saw you. How the fuck do you even know that?
entries.literal: "You said that it's almost been three hours since we saw you. How the fuck do you even know that?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? I answered your question.
entries.literal: "What? I answered your question."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: "Almost three hours" is awfully precise, and it's correct. If you truly were here, and for some reason didn't see anyone for three hours, would your sense of time be good enough to know that?
entries.literal: "\"Almost three hours\" is awfully precise, and it's correct. If you truly were here, and for some reason didn't see anyone for three hours, would your sense of time be good enough to know that?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you doing this again...? Trying to blame me for anything you can?
entries.literal: "Are you doing this again...? Trying to blame me for anything you can?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're a fucking liar! You haven't been here for hours! Where the fuck were you, and why are you back? The computer doesn't work, and I'm the only one with a watch. How did you accurately say that you've been gone for three hours!?{w} Hey, did Naomi have a watch? Does anyone remember?
entries.literal: "You're a fucking liar! You haven't been here for hours! Where the fuck were you, and why are you back? The computer doesn't work, and I'm the only one with a watch. How did you accurately say that you've been gone for three hours!?{w} Hey, did Naomi have a watch? Does anyone remember?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The three members of the first group shrugged. Atsuki and I knew there was still a way to use the computer to know the time, but I didn't even get the chance to consider if we should mention it.
entries.literal: "The three members of the first group shrugged. Atsuki and I knew there was still a way to use the computer to know the time, but I didn't even get the chance to consider if we should mention it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh...! Did you hear that!?
entries.literal: "Wh...! Did you hear that!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hear what?
entries.literal: "Hear what?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Didn't a sound come from the lobby?
entries.literal: "Didn't a sound come from the lobby?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I didn't hear anything.
entries.literal: "...I didn't hear anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody had. Probably not even Atsuki, who took no time to exit the room.
entries.literal: "Nobody had. Probably not even Atsuki, who took no time to exit the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our past selves still had to be in the mechanical room. If the past couldn't be changed, it meant that something would always prevent him from proceeding, but the arrival of Katei and Akaro hadn't conclusively proven it. Confused, the rest of us followed behind him and saw him opening the door to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Our past selves still had to be in the mechanical room. If the past couldn't be changed, it meant that something would always prevent him from proceeding, but the arrival of Katei and Akaro hadn't conclusively proven it. Confused, the rest of us followed behind him and saw him opening the door to the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once he opened that door, he didn't take even a step forward.
entries.literal: "Once he opened that door, he didn't take even a step forward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead, he froze in place, and as he stopped gripping the knob, he turned his head back to us.
entries.literal: "Instead, he froze in place, and as he stopped gripping the knob, he turned his head back to us."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Who...{w} is this?
entries.literal: "Who...{w} is this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We dashed to the door.{w} ...When we looked through it, we immediately realized that wasn't the only question to ask.
entries.literal: "We dashed to the door.{w} ...When we looked through it, we immediately realized that wasn't the only question to ask."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Ah! Isla, stay over there!
entries.literal: "Ah! Isla, stay over there!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A single body lay down on the floor over a vast pool of blood.
entries.literal: "A single body lay down on the floor over a vast pool of blood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no meaning to be found. No smell of blood, no identity of the corpse, but a death that defied reason. Furthermore, the past had changed. Not because of the appearance of a body, but because of Erina's yell, which had spread throughout the crystal floor—a yell we hadn't heard while we'd been downstairs.{w} I immediately understood that someone had been killed. I'd gone over the concept of death many times in my mind, so I simply stared at that dreamlike scene before I was pushed aside.
entries.literal: "There was no meaning to be found. No smell of blood, no identity of the corpse, but a death that defied reason. Furthermore, the past had changed. Not because of the appearance of a body, but because of Erina's yell, which had spread throughout the crystal floor—a yell we hadn't heard while we'd been downstairs.{w} I immediately understood that someone had been killed. I'd gone over the concept of death many times in my mind, so I simply stared at that dreamlike scene before I was pushed aside."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Isn't he...!?
entries.literal: "Isn't he...!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The shock had paralyzed everyone, and Katei was the first to snap out of it. He ran toward the body and turned it around, trying not to step on all the blood around it.
entries.literal: "The shock had paralyzed everyone, and Katei was the first to snap out of it. He ran toward the body and turned it around, trying not to step on all the blood around it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wait, I recognize him too. Wasn't he there?
entries.literal: "Wait, I recognize him too. Wasn't he there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai pointed at the shutter, prompting me to remember that I also knew the man, who was dressed in a police uniform.
entries.literal: "Sai pointed at the shutter, prompting me to remember that I also knew the man, who was dressed in a police uniform."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Y-Yes... That's where I s-saw him, while we were waiting. Fuck.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes... That's where I s-saw him, while we were waiting. Fuck."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki's voice cracked. He wouldn't take his eyes off the body.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's voice cracked. He wouldn't take his eyes off the body."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: He's been here at the tower recently. I don't know his name, but he was investigating a possible terrorist attack.
entries.literal: "He's been here at the tower recently. I don't know his name, but he was investigating a possible terrorist attack."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei crouched and used two fingers to verify that there was no pulse.
entries.literal: "Katei crouched and used two fingers to verify that there was no pulse."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't say it out loud.
entries.literal: "He didn't say it out loud."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This is a knife wound.
entries.literal: "This is a knife wound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The uniform on his chest had been pierced a single time, but the knife in question wasn't there.
entries.literal: "The uniform on his chest had been pierced a single time, but the knife in question wasn't there."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: A knife...? How did this person get in? Look at the blood. ...This happened minutes ago.
entries.literal: "A knife...? How did this person get in? Look at the blood. ...This happened minutes ago."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He entered the same way Katei left.
entries.literal: "He entered the same way Katei left."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You've been missing for the last three hours. Just as you reappear, this person shows up dead. This is no coincidence.
entries.literal: "You've been missing for the last three hours. Just as you reappear, this person shows up dead. This is no coincidence."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell are you talking about? How would I have left!?
entries.literal: "What the hell are you talking about? How would I have left!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know. You remember the Sekimeiya, right? As you said, it's not in the cabinet right now, and you're an excellent candidate to have taken it out.{w} It's possible this man entered the tower after it was locked down, and if you did so too, your disappearance, your knowledge of the time, and this knife you're talking about... would all make sense.
entries.literal: "I don't know. You remember the Sekimeiya, right? As you said, it's not in the cabinet right now, and you're an excellent candidate to have taken it out.{w} It's possible this man entered the tower after it was locked down, and if you did so too, your disappearance, your knowledge of the time, and this knife you're talking about... would all make sense."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I cannot believe what I'm hearing! I've been here the entire time! And I couldn't have unlocked the cabinet!
entries.literal: "I cannot believe what I'm hearing! I've been here the entire time! And I couldn't have unlocked the cabinet!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Enraged, Katei pulled up the man's shirt and uncovered his waist.
entries.literal: "Enraged, Katei pulled up the man's shirt and uncovered his waist."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, look at this! This is why I thought it must've been a knife. It was his own!{w} He still has his baton, but his knife is gone. I personally saw that he had a knife right here a few days ago.
entries.literal: "Yes, look at this! This is why I thought it must've been a knife. It was his own!{w} He still has his baton, but his knife is gone. I personally saw that he had a knife right here a few days ago."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He continued examining his clothes and pockets.
entries.literal: "He continued examining his clothes and pockets."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Oh! He has a walkie-talkie!
entries.literal: "...Oh! He has a walkie-talkie!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone's eyes widened until we saw Katei pressing every button and showing us its blank display.
entries.literal: "Everyone's eyes widened until we saw Katei pressing every button and showing us its blank display."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Is it not working? Let me see.
entries.literal: "Is it not working? Let me see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei gave Akaro the device. After fiddling with it for a while, he noticed what was wrong.
entries.literal: "Katei gave Akaro the device. After fiddling with it for a while, he noticed what was wrong."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...There's a battery missing, and the cover isn't properly attached. There's also a crack here on the bottom, look.
entries.literal: "...There's a battery missing, and the cover isn't properly attached. There's also a crack here on the bottom, look."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: These work with normal batteries?
entries.literal: "These work with normal batteries?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Apparently, and this cover can be manually removed. Maybe they failed to break it by force and removed a battery instead.
entries.literal: "Apparently, and this cover can be manually removed. Maybe they failed to break it by force and removed a battery instead."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are there batteries like these anywhere?
entries.literal: "Are there batteries like these anywhere?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: No, I really don't think so...
entries.literal: "No, I really don't think so..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He left the device on the floor.
entries.literal: "He left the device on the floor."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: So the killer did this to prevent us from talking to people outside once again.{w} I have to assume that you still have not found Naomi, so instead of blaming me, consider that it's very possible this person has been here since we got trapped, and we didn't find him just like we couldn't find Naomi.
entries.literal: "So the killer did this to prevent us from talking to people outside once again.{w} I have to assume that you still have not found Naomi, so instead of blaming me, consider that it's very possible this person has been here since we got trapped, and we didn't find him just like we couldn't find Naomi."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Okay, then you killed him?
entries.literal: "Okay, then you killed him?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...{w}Don't say stuff like that. I didn't do this.
entries.literal: "...{w}Don't say stuff like that. I didn't do this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Then who did? It seems like it could've been anyone, but your story is by far the most questionable one. Do we really have to keep listening to this Naomi boogeyman schtick?
entries.literal: "...Then who did? It seems like it could've been anyone, but your story is by far the most questionable one. Do we really have to keep listening to this Naomi boogeyman schtick?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Stop.{w} Akaro, is what you said earlier true? That you found Katei ten minutes before coming to the event room?
entries.literal: "...Stop.{w} Akaro, is what you said earlier true? That you found Katei ten minutes before coming to the event room?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Uh... Yes, I don't know if it really was ten minutes, though.
entries.literal: "Uh... Yes, I don't know if it really was ten minutes, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What time is it right now?
entries.literal: "What time is it right now?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's unlikely Katei did this, then. Six minutes ago, this hadn't happened yet.
entries.literal: "It's unlikely Katei did this, then. Six minutes ago, this hadn't happened yet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Is that so? You two were talking in hallway A. Did you look at the lobby? I recall the door was shut.
entries.literal: "...{w}Is that so? You two were talking in hallway A. Did you look at the lobby? I recall the door was shut."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We did.
entries.literal: "We did."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: He's right.
entries.literal: "He's right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At {time=13:17}, we'd walked down to the mechanical room, which meant that the man had died while we'd been under him.
entries.literal: "At {time=13:17}, we'd walked down to the mechanical room, which meant that the man had died while we'd been under him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...If you're not lying, then forget what I said. Everyone has an alibi, unless two or more people did it.{w} You two were together, Katei and Akaro were together, and me, Erina, and Isla were together.
entries.literal: "...If you're not lying, then forget what I said. Everyone has an alibi, unless two or more people did it.{w} You two were together, Katei and Akaro were together, and me, Erina, and Isla were together."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked past the door, where Erina was crouching next to Isla, comforting her from a sight she hadn't seen. Despite that, she was burying her face in her arms.
entries.literal: "We looked past the door, where Erina was crouching next to Isla, comforting her from a sight she hadn't seen. Despite that, she was burying her face in her arms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A dour mood had overtaken the entire group. I wasn't sure if it was because they had been exposed to death or because they feared the killer.
entries.literal: "A dour mood had overtaken the entire group. I wasn't sure if it was because they had been exposed to death or because they feared the killer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki's demeanor had changed the least, probably because it didn't have far to go anyway. Regardless, I had to put on the same appearance, and it came naturally after the previous two weeks. The death of that man meant nothing to me, and I was only a little intrigued. I'd always known I'd react like that, and while I knew I couldn't show it, I didn't feel it was necessarily problematic as long as nobody found out.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's demeanor had changed the least, probably because it didn't have far to go anyway. Regardless, I had to put on the same appearance, and it came naturally after the previous two weeks. The death of that man meant nothing to me, and I was only a little intrigued. I'd always known I'd react like that, and while I knew I couldn't show it, I didn't feel it was necessarily problematic as long as nobody found out."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So, it was actually Naomi...?
entries.literal: "So, it was actually Naomi...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I have no idea how this man entered the tower. It's possible he was here from the beginning, or there could actually be a secret way in. It wouldn't surprise me given the track record this place has. However, he's a police officer, so whoever did this might've killed him just because of that.
entries.literal: "I have no idea how this man entered the tower. It's possible he was here from the beginning, or there could actually be a secret way in. It wouldn't surprise me given the track record this place has. However, he's a police officer, so whoever did this might've killed him just because of that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not sure how they took his knife or how we didn't hear a fight. In fact, I have no clue what happened.{w} None of us have blood on our clothes, which I suppose doesn't mean anything since it doesn't seem like much blood sprayed out, but I'll remind you all again that the Sekimeiya was hidden a while ago. All of us go back to having no alibi when everyone is able to go to the past.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure how they took his knife or how we didn't hear a fight. In fact, I have no clue what happened.{w} None of us have blood on our clothes, which I suppose doesn't mean anything since it doesn't seem like much blood sprayed out, but I'll remind you all again that the Sekimeiya was hidden a while ago. All of us go back to having no alibi when everyone is able to go to the past."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you joking? Do you think one of us will go to the past and kill him?
entries.literal: "Are you joking? Do you think one of us will go to the past and kill him?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, you said Naomi still has a set of keys identical to yours. Whether or not that's true, we know of someone who does for sure.
entries.literal: "Well, you said Naomi still has a set of keys identical to yours. Whether or not that's true, we know of someone who does for sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Multiple pairs of eyes faced me.
entries.literal: "Multiple pairs of eyes faced me."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...I have it. We didn't hide the Sekimeiya, though.
entries.literal: "...I have it. We didn't hide the Sekimeiya, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...And if we had, we wouldn't have needed it to do this because we're the ones who saw the lobby empty just minutes ago.
entries.literal: "...And if we had, we wouldn't have needed it to do this because we're the ones who saw the lobby empty just minutes ago."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's right, which forces me to point out the topic you were discussing in hallway A.{w} "I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago." Didn't those words come out of your mouth?
entries.literal: "That's right, which forces me to point out the topic you were discussing in hallway A.{w} \"I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago.\" Didn't those words come out of your mouth?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: They did. So you lied; you didn't see the lobby before I heard you since you appeared there from the future.
entries.literal: "They did. So you lied; you didn't see the lobby before I heard you since you appeared there from the future."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...You're right, but we did see it before touching the Sekimeiya. It doesn't invalidate what we said.
entries.literal: "...You're right, but we did see it before touching the Sekimeiya. It doesn't invalidate what we said."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're admitting it, good. Is this travel yet to happen?
entries.literal: "You're admitting it, good. Is this travel yet to happen?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I think it just happened. I don't know if anything went differently this time, but we found the Sekimeiya in the mechanical room, so whoever took it hid it there.
entries.literal: "I think it just happened. I don't know if anything went differently this time, but we found the Sekimeiya in the mechanical room, so whoever took it hid it there."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Below us...? And you appeared in the hallway...
entries.literal: "Below us...? And you appeared in the hallway..."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm confused. You found the Sekimeiya? ...And I don't get how you got to that conclusion, Sai. Atsuki appeared there from the future, so he's the only one who couldn't have been able to look at the lobby before you saw them, right?
entries.literal: "I'm confused. You found the Sekimeiya? ...And I don't get how you got to that conclusion, Sai. Atsuki appeared there from the future, so he's the only one who couldn't have been able to look at the lobby before you saw them, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, both of—
entries.literal: "No, both of—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He stopped himself when he realized he'd made a mistake. His pause was what made Atsuki and me notice it.
entries.literal: "He stopped himself when he realized he'd made a mistake. His pause was what made Atsuki and me notice it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh...! You know exactly what happened, don't you?
entries.literal: "Oh...! You know exactly what happened, don't you?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You overheard our conversation, when we said we had traveled together.
entries.literal: "You overheard our conversation, when we said we had traveled together."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Akaro thought only I appeared in the hallway, but you know both of us did. I touched the Sekimeiya, which made both of us travel at the same time.
entries.literal: "Akaro thought only I appeared in the hallway, but you know both of us did. I touched the Sekimeiya, which made both of us travel at the same time."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: And you were about to say "no, both of them traveled". However, given the knowledge of the Sekimeiya you should have, that shouldn't be possible. After touching it, the Sekimeiya would power off, and it would take a while before anyone could activate it again.{w} Does that mean that you knew that was possible? You haven't explained much about what you did during the time we were in the attic.
entries.literal: "And you were about to say \"no, both of them traveled\". However, given the knowledge of the Sekimeiya you should have, that shouldn't be possible. After touching it, the Sekimeiya would power off, and it would take a while before anyone could activate it again.{w} Does that mean that you knew that was possible? You haven't explained much about what you did during the time we were in the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...What are you talking about? I was gonna say that both of you traveled together because it's what you two said. I stopped myself when I realized that Akaro was right; it didn't make sense.
entries.literal: "...What are you talking about? I was gonna say that both of you traveled together because it's what you two said. I stopped myself when I realized that Akaro was right; it didn't make sense."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...No, I don't think so.
entries.literal: "...No, I don't think so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai shook his head, disregarding Atsuki's accusation. Then, he walked to the mechanical room.
entries.literal: "Sai shook his head, disregarding Atsuki's accusation. Then, he walked to the mechanical room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, you two traveled recently, right? Should we just ignore the fact that you avoided telling us the location of the Sekimeiya, if we're to believe you didn't hide it?
entries.literal: "So, you two traveled recently, right? Should we just ignore the fact that you avoided telling us the location of the Sekimeiya, if we're to believe you didn't hide it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't wait for an answer before he began to descend the staircase. The door had been left slightly open by the two of us so that the darkness below was at least slightly alleviated.
entries.literal: "He didn't wait for an answer before he began to descend the staircase. The door had been left slightly open by the two of us so that the darkness below was at least slightly alleviated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki shared dubious looks with the others at Sai sidestepping the issue, but there was no choice except waiting for him to return.
entries.literal: "Atsuki shared dubious looks with the others at Sai sidestepping the issue, but there was no choice except waiting for him to return."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You don't think he wanted to use the Sekimeiya, do you?
entries.literal: "You don't think he wanted to use the Sekimeiya, do you?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki walked to the door, worried about Sai's intentions, but he stopped himself short after a couple steps.
entries.literal: "Atsuki walked to the door, worried about Sai's intentions, but he stopped himself short after a couple steps."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I was right. They're lying.
entries.literal: "I was right. They're lying."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What? We aren't.
entries.literal: "What? We aren't."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Where is the Sekimeiya supposed to be, then?
entries.literal: "Where is the Sekimeiya supposed to be, then?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: It was behind the pile of chairs.
entries.literal: "It was behind the pile of chairs."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Incorrect. There was nothing down there.
entries.literal: "Incorrect. There was nothing down there."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Are you sure?
entries.literal: "Are you sure?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're all free to go see by yourselves.
entries.literal: "You're all free to go see by yourselves."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew that couldn't be true. We'd most likely arrived at the lobby before we'd disappeared from the mechanical room, so the Sekimeiya had to still be there. If Sai was so blatantly lying, had he found a way to frame us?
entries.literal: "I knew that couldn't be true. We'd most likely arrived at the lobby before we'd disappeared from the mechanical room, so the Sekimeiya had to still be there. If Sai was so blatantly lying, had he found a way to frame us?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Can you open that hip pack?
entries.literal: "Can you open that hip pack?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This? Sure. Do you think I have it...?{w} I'm being serious. I didn't find it, but it's possible I missed it. Go look.
entries.literal: "This? Sure. Do you think I have it...?{w} I'm being serious. I didn't find it, but it's possible I missed it. Go look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai didn't have the Sekimeiya on him, so Atsuki accepted his suggestion and gestured at me to stay put.
entries.literal: "Sai didn't have the Sekimeiya on him, so Atsuki accepted his suggestion and gestured at me to stay put."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone silently stood in anticipation next to the still-expanding pool of blood.
entries.literal: "Everyone silently stood in anticipation next to the still-expanding pool of blood."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nothing, right?
entries.literal: "Nothing, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yeah, it's not there.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it's not there."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You should've trusted me. Do you feel like changing your version of events now?
entries.literal: "You should've trusted me. Do you feel like changing your version of events now?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No. We already told you what happened. The Sekimeiya should still be there.
entries.literal: "No. We already told you what happened. The Sekimeiya should still be there."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What, did it disappear? Guess it wouldn't be that hard to believe.
entries.literal: "What, did it disappear? Guess it wouldn't be that hard to believe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had managed to switch roles as soon as he was put on the defensive, but it didn't seem to be bothering Atsuki much. Did he think that the past had been changed and that what was happening was the result? It didn't make a lot of sense to me.
entries.literal: "Sai had managed to switch roles as soon as he was put on the defensive, but it didn't seem to be bothering Atsuki much. Did he think that the past had been changed and that what was happening was the result? It didn't make a lot of sense to me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What do you all think? It's not a good look to be caught lying like this, is it?
entries.literal: "What do you all think? It's not a good look to be caught lying like this, is it?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Don't you think that if we wanted to lie, we would've said that we found the Sekimeiya somewhere it was easy to steal?
entries.literal: "Don't you think that if we wanted to lie, we would've said that we found the Sekimeiya somewhere it was easy to steal?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm, that's always too ineffective of an excuse.
entries.literal: "Hm, that's always too ineffective of an excuse."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...This policeman either had a way to not be found for hours, or he had some way to enter the building. ...A-And... he...
entries.literal: "...This policeman either had a way to not be found for hours, or he had some way to enter the building. ...A-And... he..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki blinked several times, almost like he was fighting back tears.
entries.literal: "Atsuki blinked several times, almost like he was fighting back tears."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Someone... killed him... and it's not easy for any of us to have done it. Finally, the Sekimeiya isn't where it should be.{w} Added to the fact that Naomi hasn't been found, you can't possibly think we did this, right?
entries.literal: "Someone... killed him... and it's not easy for any of us to have done it. Finally, the Sekimeiya isn't where it should be.{w} Added to the fact that Naomi hasn't been found, you can't possibly think we did this, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You didn't?
entries.literal: "You didn't?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There's n-no way. I think Naomi's the first person to suspect. Not only has she managed to remain hidden, but she also might have the same keys that we have.{w} There are no cameras here, but we don't know if they're recording in the first place... You said you didn't inspect the whole building because you thought we were in the attic, right? We have to be missing something that the culprit is aware of. Could there be a place we're ignoring?
entries.literal: "There's n-no way. I think Naomi's the first person to suspect. Not only has she managed to remain hidden, but she also might have the same keys that we have.{w} There are no cameras here, but we don't know if they're recording in the first place... You said you didn't inspect the whole building because you thought we were in the attic, right? We have to be missing something that the culprit is aware of. Could there be a place we're ignoring?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...That's impossible.
entries.literal: "...That's impossible."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: If not, then one of you did this. Naomi's disappearance should be enough proof that we're missing something, though.
entries.literal: "If not, then one of you did this. Naomi's disappearance should be enough proof that we're missing something, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We have to find her or whoever else is here. It's almost guaranteed that this man was with us since this morning, and we didn't find him. I think that's much more likely than some hidden passage.
entries.literal: "We have to find her or whoever else is here. It's almost guaranteed that this man was with us since this morning, and we didn't find him. I think that's much more likely than some hidden passage."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: If it's neither of those, there's still an answer with the Sekimeiya. This policeman could've come from the future if he touched the Sekimeiya after {time=21}, and Naomi could've left the tower by going far to the past. We found the Sekimeiya in the attic and don't know where it is now.
entries.literal: "If it's neither of those, there's still an answer with the Sekimeiya. This policeman could've come from the future if he touched the Sekimeiya after {time=21}, and Naomi could've left the tower by going far to the past. We found the Sekimeiya in the attic and don't know where it is now."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We'll look everywhere. Not only could people still be hiding, but the Sekimeiya has to be somewhere too. I can't imagine the real person responsible doesn't know where.
entries.literal: "We'll look everywhere. Not only could people still be hiding, but the Sekimeiya has to be somewhere too. I can't imagine the real person responsible doesn't know where."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Go ahead and find Naomi for us.
entries.literal: "Go ahead and find Naomi for us."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's certainly possible someone's on this floor. Don't move from here.
entries.literal: "It's certainly possible someone's on this floor. Don't move from here."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.literal: "...Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He began by looking in the storeroom and then in the room in front. He probably didn't know about the fact that some cabinets could be opened up.
entries.literal: "He began by looking in the storeroom and then in the room in front. He probably didn't know about the fact that some cabinets could be opened up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is he doing this by himself? Does he not trust us?
entries.literal: "Is he doing this by himself? Does he not trust us?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From hallway C, six pairs of eyes stared at him moving from room to room. He took a while in each one.
entries.literal: "From hallway C, six pairs of eyes stared at him moving from room to room. He took a while in each one."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you hear that?
entries.literal: "Did you hear that?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No?
entries.literal: "No?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at Sai and discerned that he definitely still suspected Atsuki of something.
entries.literal: "I glanced at Sai and discerned that he definitely still suspected Atsuki of something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki exited from the farthest away crystal room and turned to us. Without saying anything, he entered the security room.
entries.literal: "Atsuki exited from the farthest away crystal room and turned to us. Without saying anything, he entered the security room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck is he doing?
entries.literal: "What the fuck is he doing?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Do you think he's taking advantage of this to do something?
entries.literal: "Do you think he's taking advantage of this to do something?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt like I was watching everything unfold from the sidelines, oblivious as to what was really happening. For some reason, Atsuki hadn't revealed that we'd powered on the computer despite telling me that we would.
entries.literal: "I felt like I was watching everything unfold from the sidelines, oblivious as to what was really happening. For some reason, Atsuki hadn't revealed that we'd powered on the computer despite telling me that we would."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he left the security room, he looked at us again and finally addressed us.
entries.literal: "When he left the security room, he looked at us again and finally addressed us."

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: Stay there! I'll look at the mechanical room again.
entries.literal: "Stay there! I'll look at the mechanical room again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He disappeared from our sight.{w} Soon, we began to hear the same sound of doors opening coming from hallway B.
entries.literal: "He disappeared from our sight.{w} Soon, we began to hear the same sound of doors opening coming from hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro and Sai went to look while the rest of us waited behind.
entries.literal: "Akaro and Sai went to look while the rest of us waited behind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he returned, it didn't seem like he'd found anything.
entries.literal: "When he returned, it didn't seem like he'd found anything."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There's nobody here. I didn't find the Sekimeiya or any potential hiding spot we don't know of. If Naomi's here, she's somehow above us.
entries.literal: "There's nobody here. I didn't find the Sekimeiya or any potential hiding spot we don't know of. If Naomi's here, she's somehow above us."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Are you sure you were thorough? Do you know some cabinets have compartments inside? The Sekimeiya could be there.
entries.literal: "...Are you sure you were thorough? Do you know some cabinets have compartments inside? The Sekimeiya could be there."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes, I looked in all of them.
entries.literal: "Yes, I looked in all of them."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Even the ones with temperature regulation? Did you make sure to close them?
entries.literal: "Even the ones with temperature regulation? Did you make sure to close them?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Those too, yeah. It took me a bit to figure out how to open them.
entries.literal: "Those too, yeah. It took me a bit to figure out how to open them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before moving on, Atsuki looked in both bathrooms. Finally, he grabbed the elevator's handle.
entries.literal: "Before moving on, Atsuki looked in both bathrooms. Finally, he grabbed the elevator's handle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door opened, revealing the empty elevator.
entries.literal: "The door opened, revealing the empty elevator."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I'll keep it open so that it can't be used.
entries.literal: "...I'll keep it open so that it can't be used."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: All right. Let's go.
entries.literal: "All right. Let's go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He started to go up the stairs, and I found myself following first again. After passing through the narrow, gray door, we stepped back onto the desolate second floor.
entries.literal: "He started to go up the stairs, and I found myself following first again. After passing through the narrow, gray door, we stepped back onto the desolate second floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki opened both bathroom doors and quickly dismissed them.
entries.literal: "Atsuki opened both bathroom doors and quickly dismissed them."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hm, nothing.
entries.literal: "Hm, nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hated agreeing with Sai without knowing why, but he was right. It was hard not to think that Atsuki's attitude was odd.
entries.literal: "I hated agreeing with Sai without knowing why, but he was right. It was hard not to think that Atsuki's attitude was odd."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was really frustrating. I'd always been good at reading him, but while he walked toward the offices, I had no comprehension of what his thoughts were.
entries.literal: "...It was really frustrating. I'd always been good at reading him, but while he walked toward the offices, I had no comprehension of what his thoughts were."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait here.
entries.literal: "Wait here."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Can I do it instead?
entries.literal: "Can I do it instead?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Huh? Yeah, sure.
entries.literal: "Huh? Yeah, sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His nonchalant reaction threw me off, but I opened the door without letting that show. It was his idea to look through the whole building, which was possibly why Sai distrusted him. However, my confusion went beyond that.
entries.literal: "His nonchalant reaction threw me off, but I opened the door without letting that show. It was his idea to look through the whole building, which was possibly why Sai distrusted him. However, my confusion went beyond that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He'd openly told me about his intentions to change the past, so why did the sensation that he was hiding something still persist when he'd confided in me?
entries.literal: "He'd openly told me about his intentions to change the past, so why did the sensation that he was hiding something still persist when he'd confided in me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept going over it as I opened drawers and looked behind the computers. Every time I thought that maybe it was all in my head, something else reinforced the opposite.
entries.literal: "I kept going over it as I opened drawers and looked behind the computers. Every time I thought that maybe it was all in my head, something else reinforced the opposite."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There weren't many places to look at, so I was soon done with the three partitions.
entries.literal: "There weren't many places to look at, so I was soon done with the three partitions."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I didn't find anything.
entries.literal: "I didn't find anything."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You looked everywhere, right?
entries.literal: "You looked everywhere, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It hit me that we were still alone.
entries.literal: "It hit me that we were still alone."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes, but did the others not come with us?
entries.literal: "Yes, but did the others not come with us?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I think they stayed on the crystal floor and let us go by ourselves.
entries.literal: "I think they stayed on the crystal floor and let us go by ourselves."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Really?
entries.literal: "Really?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes, and we should continue. We have to find something. Be it Naomi or the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Yes, and we should continue. We have to find something. Be it Naomi or the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shrugged lightly before we moved up to the third floor.
entries.literal: "I shrugged lightly before we moved up to the third floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There, the same process was repeated. He looked at the two bathrooms, and I handled the offices while he waited outside so that no one crossed the path.
entries.literal: "There, the same process was repeated. He looked at the two bathrooms, and I handled the offices while he waited outside so that no one crossed the path."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our repeated movements led to the first step on floor 4.
entries.literal: "Our repeated movements led to the first step on floor 4."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Let's see here... It's not possible she's not anywhere.
entries.literal: "Let's see here... It's not possible she's not anywhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind the glass, I started to look through the same places as below, all while wondering whether I'd report a result anyway.
entries.literal: "Behind the glass, I started to look through the same places as below, all while wondering whether I'd report a result anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door to the second partition and vanished from Atsuki's field of vision.
entries.literal: "I opened the door to the second partition and vanished from Atsuki's field of vision."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were only drawers that I questioned whether to keep checking. Midway through, I decided to push open the door to the last section.
entries.literal: "There were only drawers that I questioned whether to keep checking. Midway through, I decided to push open the door to the last section."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared inside.
entries.literal: "I stared inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept doing so for many seconds, gripping the door's handle with my right hand.{w} One of the many thoughts that crossed my mind was if I should move.
entries.literal: "I kept doing so for many seconds, gripping the door's handle with my right hand.{w} One of the many thoughts that crossed my mind was if I should move."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Until I realized that it wasn't up to me. It hadn't been my choice not to move. However, my hand soon let go of the handle, and the door was shut again.
entries.literal: "...Until I realized that it wasn't up to me. It hadn't been my choice not to move. However, my hand soon let go of the handle, and the door was shut again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When it did, I couldn't open it again. I stood next to it for a long time, during which I only focused on my breathing.
entries.literal: "When it did, I couldn't open it again. I stood next to it for a long time, during which I only focused on my breathing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, I comprehended that I was still able to move, and I took a step back. Strangely, neither my vision nor my mind seemed to be blurry.
entries.literal: "Eventually, I comprehended that I was still able to move, and I took a step back. Strangely, neither my vision nor my mind seemed to be blurry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the opaque wall and discerned a few silhouettes belonging to the chairs on the other side. However, I couldn't open the door again, and I didn't want to.
entries.literal: "I looked at the opaque wall and discerned a few silhouettes belonging to the chairs on the other side. However, I couldn't open the door again, and I didn't want to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd developed an irrational fear of spiders early on in my life. Whenever I knew a spider was in a room, I'd freeze behind its door, unable to open it. That was the same sensation I felt as I slowly backed away.
entries.literal: "I'd developed an irrational fear of spiders early on in my life. Whenever I knew a spider was in a room, I'd freeze behind its door, unable to open it. That was the same sensation I felt as I slowly backed away."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Nothing again?
entries.literal: "Nothing again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shook my head.
entries.literal: "I shook my head."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: If she's in the attic, she won't be able to take the elevator down, but this is very strange.
entries.literal: "If she's in the attic, she won't be able to take the elevator down, but this is very strange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked the path to the fifth floor until we reached the staircase.
entries.literal: "We walked the path to the fifth floor until we reached the staircase."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Are you all right?
entries.literal: "...Are you all right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Huh?{w} Yes.
entries.literal: "...Huh?{w} Yes."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You look zoned out. Are you tired?
entries.literal: "You look zoned out. Are you tired?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: A bit. It's okay.
entries.literal: "A bit. It's okay."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: All right, but don't push yourself.
entries.literal: "All right, but don't push yourself."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'll look myself, so wait here.
entries.literal: "I'll look myself, so wait here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't voice any complaints. I just gave him a tiny nod.{w} Outside, I kept glancing left and right until Atsuki was done.
entries.literal: "I didn't voice any complaints. I just gave him a tiny nod.{w} Outside, I kept glancing left and right until Atsuki was done."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I don't really expect Naomi to be in these, but it all gets weirder every time we move on. Could a secret place that Katei doesn't know about exist...?
entries.literal: "...I don't really expect Naomi to be in these, but it all gets weirder every time we move on. Could a secret place that Katei doesn't know about exist...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There's no way, right? If the answer is somehow a hidden spot, he must've made use of it as well.
entries.literal: "There's no way, right? If the answer is somehow a hidden spot, he must've made use of it as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One last identical floor remained, which we silently ascended to. I didn't know what emotion I'd been attacked by, but I wanted to see the others—the unknown people I'd met that day. I needed them as a temporary shelter, not continually being alone with Atsuki.
entries.literal: "One last identical floor remained, which we silently ascended to. I didn't know what emotion I'd been attacked by, but I wanted to see the others—the unknown people I'd met that day. I needed them as a temporary shelter, not continually being alone with Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sixth floor was empty as well.
entries.literal: "The sixth floor was empty as well."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}You have the key, right?
entries.literal: "...{w}You have the key, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded and took the keyring out of my purse. With the right key, I unlocked the door.
entries.literal: "I nodded and took the keyring out of my purse. With the right key, I unlocked the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki stood in front of the living room and looked at the floor.
entries.literal: "Atsuki stood in front of the living room and looked at the floor."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No recent footprints...
entries.literal: "No recent footprints..."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It'll be fine if you stay here. If I don't find anyone, I'm gonna be pretty confused.
entries.literal: "It'll be fine if you stay here. If I don't find anyone, I'm gonna be pretty confused."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}I don't get it. Was Naomi never with us?{w} How is this possible? I know we've already been here for a long time, but that doesn't make it any less confusing. Where the hell is the Sekimeiya, also?
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't get it. Was Naomi never with us?{w} How is this possible? I know we've already been here for a long time, but that doesn't make it any less confusing. Where the hell is the Sekimeiya, also?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Let's just go back down. I hope they trust what we tell them.{w} ...We can't even take the elevator, damn it.
entries.literal: "Let's just go back down. I hope they trust what we tell them.{w} ...We can't even take the elevator, damn it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked down the stairs and left the attic, heading all the way back down.
entries.literal: "We walked down the stairs and left the attic, heading all the way back down."

entries.speaker: i
