entries.text: For every floor we descended, the air got hotter, and my head number.
entries.literal: "For every floor we descended, the air got hotter, and my head number."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hearing different voices was like emerging from underwater. As my view of hallway C increased, so did the sound.
entries.literal: "Hearing different voices was like emerging from underwater. As my view of hallway C increased, so did the sound."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Where the hell are they?
entries.literal: "Where the hell are they?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I listened intently and frowned.
entries.literal: "I listened intently and frowned."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...The storeroom?
entries.literal: "...The storeroom?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh. Well, I need to go to the bathroom. I'll be back.
entries.literal: "Oh. Well, I need to go to the bathroom. I'll be back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt like he was looking at me oddly, but I didn't have time to point it out before he turned around.
entries.literal: "I felt like he was looking at me oddly, but I didn't have time to point it out before he turned around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I headed to the open storeroom. Everyone was inside, but the room didn't look as I remembered it.
entries.literal: "I headed to the open storeroom. Everyone was inside, but the room didn't look as I remembered it."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Look at what we found, {tip=Tanya}Tanya{/tip}! There was a secret wall.
entries.literal: "Look at what we found, {tip=Tanya}Tanya{/tip}! There was a secret wall."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There you are. Where's Atsuki?
entries.literal: "There you are. Where's Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...He went to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "...He went to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped in farther. The length of the room had increased, and with every step I took, the temperature lowered. The others were all gathered around another door.
entries.literal: "I stepped in farther. The length of the room had increased, and with every step I took, the temperature lowered. The others were all gathered around another door."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What's this place...? Also, was that name supposed to refer to me?
entries.literal: "What's this place...? Also, was that name supposed to refer to me?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Tanya? Yes! It's because of tanzanite.
entries.literal: "Tanya? Yes! It's because of tanzanite."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh.
entries.literal: "Oh."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I supposed it made perfect sense to her.
entries.literal: "I supposed it made perfect sense to her."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...When we were going up, Akaro and I heard a sound behind us and saw that the storeroom wasn't shut, although nobody was here. However, I noticed that a spot on the wall wasn't dusty, which let me uncover this section.
entries.literal: "...When we were going up, Akaro and I heard a sound behind us and saw that the storeroom wasn't shut, although nobody was here. However, I noticed that a spot on the wall wasn't dusty, which let me uncover this section."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What the...? Why does this place exist?
entries.literal: "What the...? Why does this place exist?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Tell her, Katei.
entries.literal: "Tell her, Katei."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know.{w} I had no idea it existed.
entries.literal: "I don't know.{w} I had no idea it existed."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What? H-How's that possible?
entries.literal: "What? H-How's that possible?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I am aware of how it sounds, but I'm the most surprised out of anyone.
entries.literal: "I am aware of how it sounds, but I'm the most surprised out of anyone."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did you search the whole building?
entries.literal: "Did you search the whole building?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Even though there was nobody here, this door is locked.
entries.literal: "Even though there was nobody here, this door is locked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed its handle and turned it. Indeed, it wouldn't budge.
entries.literal: "I grabbed its handle and turned it. Indeed, it wouldn't budge."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: You saw the door open after Atsuki closed it? Is that what you meant? So someone opened it before we moved up?
entries.literal: "You saw the door open after Atsuki closed it? Is that what you meant? So someone opened it before we moved up?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's what we were discussing. This is obviously a spot anyone could have used to hide, but Sai doesn't believe someone left through it. He thinks someone came in. Otherwise, the door wouldn't have been left open, and nobody would've left while we were investigating.
entries.literal: "That's what we were discussing. This is obviously a spot anyone could have used to hide, but Sai doesn't believe someone left through it. He thinks someone came in. Otherwise, the door wouldn't have been left open, and nobody would've left while we were investigating."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...But Atsuki had just finished looking through the whole floor.
entries.literal: "...But Atsuki had just finished looking through the whole floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Exactly.
entries.literal: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What I think is that this door leads outside. The storeroom now stretches farther out than the crystal rooms, and it's a hidden locked door that would explain the policeman's appearance and Naomi's vanishing.
entries.literal: "What I think is that this door leads outside. The storeroom now stretches farther out than the crystal rooms, and it's a hidden locked door that would explain the policeman's appearance and Naomi's vanishing."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: W-Wait, really...? If a policeman entered, why did nobody else?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, really...? If a policeman entered, why did nobody else?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who knows? Maybe the door was briefly unlocked when he got in, or maybe he was behind the plan like Naomi. Nonetheless, it appears the answer really was a hidden way outside.
entries.literal: "Who knows? Maybe the door was briefly unlocked when he got in, or maybe he was behind the plan like Naomi. Nonetheless, it appears the answer really was a hidden way outside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sure people are in front of the entrance, but I wouldn't bet the entire building is surrounded. It could be possible to enter and leave from this side without being seen.
entries.literal: "I'm sure people are in front of the entrance, but I wouldn't bet the entire building is surrounded. It could be possible to enter and leave from this side without being seen."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...{w}Can we not do anything to open it?
entries.literal: "...{w}Can we not do anything to open it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My perception of our imprisonment had changed drastically. If we could open the door, I might've been able to escape, which I had started to want more than anything.
entries.literal: "My perception of our imprisonment had changed drastically. If we could open the door, I might've been able to escape, which I had started to want more than anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Would you or Atsuki know how to pick this lock? We've knocked and made noise, but there's no way we'll be heard from here, and the gaps aren't thin enough to see or slide anything through them.
entries.literal: "Would you or Atsuki know how to pick this lock? We've knocked and made noise, but there's no way we'll be heard from here, and the gaps aren't thin enough to see or slide anything through them."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...I don't.
entries.literal: "...I don't."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, you didn't find the Sekimeiya anywhere, right?
entries.literal: "Well, you didn't find the Sekimeiya anywhere, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: No.
entries.literal: "No."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then it's possible it's not here anymore. Even if this door doesn't lead outside, it's very likely the Sekimeiya was taken away. If we're supposed to trust what Atsuki said, that could be the entire motive behind the attack.
entries.literal: "Then it's possible it's not here anymore. Even if this door doesn't lead outside, it's very likely the Sekimeiya was taken away. If we're supposed to trust what Atsuki said, that could be the entire motive behind the attack."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: That still doesn't make sense, though. I don't think anyone could've taken the Sekimeiya from the mechanical room.
entries.literal: "That still doesn't make sense, though. I don't think anyone could've taken the Sekimeiya from the mechanical room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Well, this door might lead outside, and Katei keeps assuring us he didn't know about it. Even if he's lying, it must be a secret door that's hard to find.{w} There's grass on the sides of the tower, meaning that if this door opened outwardly, it would leave conspicuous marks on the grass and could be noticed. It probably opens inward instead.
entries.literal: "...{w}Well, this door might lead outside, and Katei keeps assuring us he didn't know about it. Even if he's lying, it must be a secret door that's hard to find.{w} There's grass on the sides of the tower, meaning that if this door opened outwardly, it would leave conspicuous marks on the grass and could be noticed. It probably opens inward instead."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What the fuck is this...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck is this...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There he is. Do you know how to pick a lock?
entries.literal: "There he is. Do you know how to pick a lock?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What? N-No?
entries.literal: "What? N-No?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What we'd talked about was reiterated to Atsuki, all while he wore an unchanging expression.
entries.literal: "What we'd talked about was reiterated to Atsuki, all while he wore an unchanging expression."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did you really not know about this?
entries.literal: "Did you really not know about this?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I promise I didn't. I also don't think this door leads outside. There's no way I wouldn't have ever noticed it.
entries.literal: "I promise I didn't. I also don't think this door leads outside. There's no way I wouldn't have ever noticed it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And it makes sense that you didn't know about it if it doesn't lead outside?
entries.literal: "And it makes sense that you didn't know about it if it doesn't lead outside?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I'm just speechless. This room is practically unused, but I can't believe this existed.
entries.literal: "...I'm just speechless. This room is practically unused, but I can't believe this existed."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}Now a few things make sense, at least. As you said, nobody was found, so Naomi must've been here at some point.
entries.literal: "...{w}Now a few things make sense, at least. As you said, nobody was found, so Naomi must've been here at some point."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, yes. I'd like to advise you all on something.{w} I've made sure that if this door is opened again, I'll be able to tell.
entries.literal: "Yes, yes. I'd like to advise you all on something.{w} I've made sure that if this door is opened again, I'll be able to tell."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...What? How?
entries.literal: "...What? How?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not telling you that. One of you could potentially manage to open this, so I'd rather not give you any indication of what I've done.
entries.literal: "I'm not telling you that. One of you could potentially manage to open this, so I'd rather not give you any indication of what I've done."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked at the door curiously, but it was too dim to notice whatever Sai was talking about.
entries.literal: "We looked at the door curiously, but it was too dim to notice whatever Sai was talking about."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I think that's fair. It wouldn't be wise to demand that you tell us.
entries.literal: "...I think that's fair. It wouldn't be wise to demand that you tell us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Just trust me. I will know if the door opens. However, it's possible it won't and that the plan already finished after the Sekimeiya was brought outside.
entries.literal: "Just trust me. I will know if the door opens. However, it's possible it won't and that the plan already finished after the Sekimeiya was brought outside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's go to the attic.
entries.literal: "Let's go to the attic."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...To the attic? Why?
entries.literal: "...To the attic? Why?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you think I'll believe you were walking around for hours and we didn't see you? You either went through this door or were in the attic.
entries.literal: "Do you think I'll believe you were walking around for hours and we didn't see you? You either went through this door or were in the attic."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: He wasn't with us. We know that much.
entries.literal: "He wasn't with us. We know that much."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You've said that before. I know.
entries.literal: "You've said that before. I know."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: How do you intend to know whether I was there? I won't allow anyone in lightly.
entries.literal: "How do you intend to know whether I was there? I won't allow anyone in lightly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No? Then how come they spent three hours sleeping there?
entries.literal: "No? Then how come they spent three hours sleeping there?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I haven't forgotten about that.
entries.literal: "...I haven't forgotten about that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}In the off chance Naomi's still in the tower, she's up there, being covered by the three of you. I want to go see it by myself, and I'm sure Akaro and Erina aren't content with your words alone.
entries.literal: "...{w}In the off chance Naomi's still in the tower, she's up there, being covered by the three of you. I want to go see it by myself, and I'm sure Akaro and Erina aren't content with your words alone."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...All right. After that, we will all slow down. I can't believe this door exists, but the truth is that Naomi and the Sekimeiya weren't found anywhere. Once this request of yours is fulfilled, we'll stay put somewhere and wait.
entries.literal: "...All right. After that, we will all slow down. I can't believe this door exists, but the truth is that Naomi and the Sekimeiya weren't found anywhere. Once this request of yours is fulfilled, we'll stay put somewhere and wait."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I agree with that. It's very likely the person who killed the policeman was Naomi or someone who could enter the tower again. For our safety, we'll have to stay together.
entries.literal: "I agree with that. It's very likely the person who killed the policeman was Naomi or someone who could enter the tower again. For our safety, we'll have to stay together."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's fine.
entries.literal: "That's fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator was still open, but we couldn't all take it at once. We walked up together, our footsteps clearly conveying our presence.
entries.literal: "The elevator was still open, but we couldn't all take it at once. We walked up together, our footsteps clearly conveying our presence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody had spoken again by the time we arrived at the attic's door, where everyone stopped.
entries.literal: "Nobody had spoken again by the time we arrived at the attic's door, where everyone stopped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki looked at me, and so did the others. It took me a few seconds to realize it was because I had the key, and when I did, I remembered we hadn't locked it when we'd left.
entries.literal: "Atsuki looked at me, and so did the others. It took me a few seconds to realize it was because I had the key, and when I did, I remembered we hadn't locked it when we'd left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped forward, sensing that Atsuki was trying to tell me to hide that fact so we didn't cause an unnecessary conflict with Katei.
entries.literal: "I stepped forward, sensing that Atsuki was trying to tell me to hide that fact so we didn't cause an unnecessary conflict with Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My body was hiding the keyhole, so I inserted the key and turned it. It was already unlocked, but I casually pulled the door toward me and took the key back out.
entries.literal: "My body was hiding the keyhole, so I inserted the key and turned it. It was already unlocked, but I casually pulled the door toward me and took the key back out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody called me out, as I'd easily looked nonchalant. I glanced upward and began to ascend the staircase.
entries.literal: "Nobody called me out, as I'd easily looked nonchalant. I glanced upward and began to ascend the staircase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the floor, traces of Atsuki and me could be noticed. Sai stared at them silently before walking in.
entries.literal: "On the floor, traces of Atsuki and me could be noticed. Sai stared at them silently before walking in."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The elevator doesn't work, so stay here.
entries.literal: "The elevator doesn't work, so stay here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Akaro and Katei arrived, they went with Sai, curious to see if anything was to be found.{w} The attic was composed of only a few rooms, so they made quick work of inspecting them.
entries.literal: "When Akaro and Katei arrived, they went with Sai, curious to see if anything was to be found.{w} The attic was composed of only a few rooms, so they made quick work of inspecting them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I suppose it's possible someone's on one of the middle floors, but given we found the storeroom's secret door, I think it's much more likely that was how Naomi managed to escape.
entries.literal: "...I suppose it's possible someone's on one of the middle floors, but given we found the storeroom's secret door, I think it's much more likely that was how Naomi managed to escape."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes. You can stop suggesting we covered for Naomi since it wasn't our plan to go search alone.
entries.literal: "Yes. You can stop suggesting we covered for Naomi since it wasn't our plan to go search alone."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hmhm.{w} I suppose we might as well stay here if we're gonna remain in one place.
entries.literal: "Hmhm.{w} I suppose we might as well stay here if we're gonna remain in one place."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? No, that's not a good idea.
entries.literal: "What? No, that's not a good idea."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Listen, this place has beds, and I don't want to sit on the floor for over six hours.
entries.literal: "Listen, this place has beds, and I don't want to sit on the floor for over six hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After hearing that, Katei didn't immediately stop him, and Sai took his chance to go straight to a bedroom.
entries.literal: "After hearing that, Katei didn't immediately stop him, and Sai took his chance to go straight to a bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Having beds and a sofa sounded good to everyone, so we stood in front of the two doors; Sai opened the right one.
entries.literal: "Having beds and a sofa sounded good to everyone, so we stood in front of the two doors; Sai opened the right one."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We've already been here, so given the circumstances, I can't order you all to leave. However, do understand how important it is that you don't damage or break anything.
entries.literal: "We've already been here, so given the circumstances, I can't order you all to leave. However, do understand how important it is that you don't damage or break anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You don't have to worry about that.
entries.literal: "You don't have to worry about that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind Sai, Akaro and Katei entered the bedroom. As each one had three beds, Erina entered the left one with Isla. Being the last two, Atsuki and I quietly made our way in as well.
entries.literal: "Behind Sai, Akaro and Katei entered the bedroom. As each one had three beds, Erina entered the left one with Isla. Being the last two, Atsuki and I quietly made our way in as well."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Do you want to be down here or up top?
entries.literal: "Do you want to be down here or up top?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm, I don't care.
entries.literal: "Hm, I don't care."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No? You can choose.
entries.literal: "No? You can choose."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...Either one is okay.
entries.literal: "...Either one is okay."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Well, what about you two?
entries.literal: "Well, what about you two?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki and I shrugged.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and I shrugged."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Let's go up, then. You'll have a bed all for yourself.
entries.literal: "Let's go up, then. You'll have a bed all for yourself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla nodded and went up the ladder. From below, we heard them sitting on the two beds.
entries.literal: "Isla nodded and went up the ladder. From below, we heard them sitting on the two beds."

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: Do you feel all right?
entries.literal: "Do you feel all right?"

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: ...I see. Try to sleep if you can, then. Everything will go by much faster.
entries.literal: "...I see. Try to sleep if you can, then. Everything will go by much faster."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were eavesdropping on them, but since they hadn't closed the hatch, it was their own fault. Atsuki and I sat on the single bed we had and lay back.
entries.literal: "We were eavesdropping on them, but since they hadn't closed the hatch, it was their own fault. Atsuki and I sat on the single bed we had and lay back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A killer had been with us in the tower—that was a guarantee. Going off of the atmosphere, it seemed everyone was trying to feel safe by staying together. It could also have been that they assumed the man was only killed because he was a policeman and the rest of us would be left alone.
entries.literal: "A killer had been with us in the tower—that was a guarantee. Going off of the atmosphere, it seemed everyone was trying to feel safe by staying together. It could also have been that they assumed the man was only killed because he was a policeman and the rest of us would be left alone."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you need a pillow?
entries.literal: "Do you need a pillow?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I'm fine.
entries.literal: "I'm fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a deep sigh, Atsuki closed his eyes.
entries.literal: "After a deep sigh, Atsuki closed his eyes."

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: Have you thought about what we talked about?
entries.literal: "Have you thought about what we talked about?"

entries.speaker: il4
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: Regarding Akashic Park. I know I said we could wait until the summer, but we can go during the first week of January if you want.
entries.literal: "Regarding Akashic Park. I know I said we could wait until the summer, but we can go during the first week of January if you want."

entries.speaker: il4
entries.text: It's okay. I think it's better to wait.
entries.literal: "It's okay. I think it's better to wait."

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: Are you sure?
entries.literal: "Are you sure?"

entries.speaker: il4
entries.text: Yeah, I don't like the cold. Let's go in the summer.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I don't like the cold. Let's go in the summer."

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: I see, all right. I'm glad you made up your mind.
entries.literal: "I see, all right. I'm glad you made up your mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Silence.
entries.literal: "Silence."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If I may...
entries.literal: "If I may..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, Sai burst in and walked to the drawer.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, Sai burst in and walked to the drawer."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What are you doing...?
entries.literal: "What are you doing...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, I'm looking in these drawers for no reason whatsoever.
entries.literal: "Oh, I'm looking in these drawers for no reason whatsoever."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once he'd gone through all of them and the wardrobe, he went up the ladder.
entries.literal: "Once he'd gone through all of them and the wardrobe, he went up the ladder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: By the sound he was making, he was doing the same with the wardrobe above.
entries.literal: "By the sound he was making, he was doing the same with the wardrobe above."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He soon came back and left without explaining himself.
entries.literal: "He soon came back and left without explaining himself."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...At least he closed the door.
entries.literal: "...At least he closed the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as Sai left, Atsuki lay back. All I could assume was that he'd been looking for the Sekimeiya or something.
entries.literal: "As soon as Sai left, Atsuki lay back. All I could assume was that he'd been looking for the Sekimeiya or something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at my purse. Thankfully, he hadn't demanded to look in it, but knowing that it could happen at any moment made me very uneasy.
entries.literal: "I looked at my purse. Thankfully, he hadn't demanded to look in it, but knowing that it could happen at any moment made me very uneasy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had shut the hatch, so I could no longer hear Erina and Isla. At my left was Atsuki, resting face-up on a white pillow. That image of him with his eyes closed was one I'd started to get used to.
entries.literal: "Sai had shut the hatch, so I could no longer hear Erina and Isla. At my left was Atsuki, resting face-up on a white pillow. That image of him with his eyes closed was one I'd started to get used to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I could no longer think that his mind was completely blank. I knew for a fact that he was silently plotting something... and that it was basically guaranteed to work.
entries.literal: "However, I could no longer think that his mind was completely blank. I knew for a fact that he was silently plotting something... and that it was basically guaranteed to work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whatever plan or conclusion he'd thought of, I wouldn't be able to stop it, so it was smarter to let him be. While I couldn't help but explore the idea of going to the past myself, I had no motivation to do so, and I didn't even know what to do if the chance ever presented itself.
entries.literal: "Whatever plan or conclusion he'd thought of, I wouldn't be able to stop it, so it was smarter to let him be. While I couldn't help but explore the idea of going to the past myself, I had no motivation to do so, and I didn't even know what to do if the chance ever presented itself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I began to hear voices coming from the other side of the door, but they were too muddled to understand.
entries.literal: "...I began to hear voices coming from the other side of the door, but they were too muddled to understand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When they faded away, I thought I'd finally be able to try resting.
entries.literal: "When they faded away, I thought I'd finally be able to try resting."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sorry, I figured I'd let you know about this.
entries.literal: "Sorry, I figured I'd let you know about this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lifted my head slightly and saw him holding a note.
entries.literal: "I lifted my head slightly and saw him holding a note."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What does it say?
entries.literal: "What does it say?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was pretty hidden in the kitchen. I'll read it for you.
entries.literal: "It was pretty hidden in the kitchen. I'll read it for you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: "Sir, I have done as you instructed, and I didn't spot any difference in the attic since Xyn's last attack. I believe it wasn't targeted. I've finished this month's preservations, but some paint has begun to wear off, so next month I'll attempt to fix that on my own. Until then, thank you for your trust and let me know if you have any new requests. Naomi".
entries.literal: "\"Sir, I have done as you instructed, and I didn't spot any difference in the attic since Xyn's last attack. I believe it wasn't targeted. I've finished this month's preservations, but some paint has begun to wear off, so next month I'll attempt to fix that on my own. Until then, thank you for your trust and let me know if you have any new requests. Naomi\"."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: So it's a note that Naomi left for Ashiya.
entries.literal: "So it's a note that Naomi left for Ashiya."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's what Katei said, she kept this attic in good condition. I appreciate that you let us know, even if it doesn't mean much to us.
entries.literal: "That's what Katei said, she kept this attic in good condition. I appreciate that you let us know, even if it doesn't mean much to us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No problem. I'd go tell Erina and Isla, but they seemed pretty sleepy.
entries.literal: "No problem. I'd go tell Erina and Isla, but they seemed pretty sleepy."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: And we didn't?
entries.literal: "And we didn't?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed my eyes.
entries.literal: "I closed my eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The light was right above us, so I put my arm over my face as well.
entries.literal: "The light was right above us, so I put my arm over my face as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, some time began to pass. I wasn't tired enough to fall asleep, but lying down was surprisingly relaxing. I kept breathing as deeply as I could, appreciating the silence.
entries.literal: "Finally, some time began to pass. I wasn't tired enough to fall asleep, but lying down was surprisingly relaxing. I kept breathing as deeply as I could, appreciating the silence."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did you notice what Sai did?
entries.literal: "Did you notice what Sai did?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...What do you mean?
entries.literal: "...What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: When he left, he walked toward the living room, and he hasn't come back yet.
entries.literal: "When he left, he walked toward the living room, and he hasn't come back yet."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh... did he? I didn't pay attention.
entries.literal: "Oh... did he? I didn't pay attention."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's already been a few minutes. {tip=perspective2}Do you have any idea about where the Sekimeiya could be?{/tip}
entries.literal: "It's already been a few minutes. {tip=perspective2}Do you have any idea about where the Sekimeiya could be?{/tip}"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Me? No, not at all.{w} If it's not outside, it must be hidden pretty well...
entries.literal: "Me? No, not at all.{w} If it's not outside, it must be hidden pretty well..."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yeah. I had a couple ideas for hiding spots.
entries.literal: "Yeah. I had a couple ideas for hiding spots."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: You didn't look at them when we searched?
entries.literal: "You didn't look at them when we searched?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Well, no. One of them requires unscrewing a computer tower. I also thought that maybe one of the keys you have could open Naomi's locker. I doubt it was just hidden like that, especially since it seemed to disappear from the mechanical room. I'm not even sure anyone could've moved it.
entries.literal: "...Well, no. One of them requires unscrewing a computer tower. I also thought that maybe one of the keys you have could open Naomi's locker. I doubt it was just hidden like that, especially since it seemed to disappear from the mechanical room. I'm not even sure anyone could've moved it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went quiet, wondering if the scheme I thought he was constructing was already in his head. He didn't seem to fully understand how the Sekimeiya worked.
entries.literal: "I went quiet, wondering if the scheme I thought he was constructing was already in his head. He didn't seem to fully understand how the Sekimeiya worked."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...He's still not back.
entries.literal: "...He's still not back."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Do you want to go look for him?
entries.literal: "Do you want to go look for him?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}I think we should. I doubt he knew where the Sekimeiya was since he was searching in this room as well, but nobody from the other room has followed him.
entries.literal: "...{w}I think we should. I doubt he knew where the Sekimeiya was since he was searching in this room as well, but nobody from the other room has followed him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried not to sigh and shut my eyes forcibly. The attic wasn't locked, so the thought of going through the building again was dreadful.
entries.literal: "I tried not to sigh and shut my eyes forcibly. The attic wasn't locked, so the thought of going through the building again was dreadful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lifted my body up with both hands, all while thinking about how much I wanted to stay on that bed.
entries.literal: "I lifted my body up with both hands, all while thinking about how much I wanted to stay on that bed."

entries.text: Stay.
entries.literal: "Stay."

entries.text: Go find Sai.
entries.literal: "Go find Sai."

entries.text: Wireframe
entries.literal: "Wireframe"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The huge mountain had a delicate structure. A single modification could collapse it beyond repair.
entries.literal: "The huge mountain had a delicate structure. A single modification could collapse it beyond repair."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: To prevent that, the structure could be partially frozen.{w} But that wasn't all. It could also be reshaped.
entries.literal: "To prevent that, the structure could be partially frozen.{w} But that wasn't all. It could also be reshaped."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Reshaped in a way so that all would connect firmly and so that causality was maintained.
entries.literal: "Reshaped in a way so that all would connect firmly and so that causality was maintained."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya and Atsuki stayed in the attic. Sai had gone to the crystal floor, but they didn't follow him down.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and Atsuki stayed in the attic. Sai had gone to the crystal floor, but they didn't follow him down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya let out a sigh.
entries.literal: "Shiroya let out a sigh."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They had no strength left, so they kept resting, trying to ignore what was happening around them.
entries.literal: "They had no strength left, so they kept resting, trying to ignore what was happening around them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Closing their eyes on top of a bed would quickly begin to allow them to temporarily divorce from reality, and no noise prevented it.
entries.literal: "Closing their eyes on top of a bed would quickly begin to allow them to temporarily divorce from reality, and no noise prevented it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Very soon, both of them had abandoned consciousness.
entries.literal: "Very soon, both of them had abandoned consciousness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For a long time, stillness persisted, and even if sound could have been sensed, there was none.
entries.literal: "For a long time, stillness persisted, and even if sound could have been sensed, there was none."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki woke up. His mouth was dry, and the ceiling light shined brightly on his eyes. Soon, though, he understood why he was awake.
entries.literal: "Atsuki woke up. His mouth was dry, and the ceiling light shined brightly on his eyes. Soon, though, he understood why he was awake."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Faint noises were sporadically reaching his ears. He looked down and saw Shiroya sleeping very close to him, but he refrained from alerting her.
entries.literal: "Faint noises were sporadically reaching his ears. He looked down and saw Shiroya sleeping very close to him, but he refrained from alerting her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His unconscious mind had taken the liberty of waking him up upon the smallest perception, so he waited warily to see if he could discern what the noises were.
entries.literal: "His unconscious mind had taken the liberty of waking him up upon the smallest perception, so he waited warily to see if he could discern what the noises were."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, the answer revealed itself. After some quiet seconds, Atsuki saw the door's handle turning, and once it had opened, a recognizable figure behind it.
entries.literal: "However, the answer revealed itself. After some quiet seconds, Atsuki saw the door's handle turning, and once it had opened, a recognizable figure behind it."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Atsuki, Shiroya, come to the living room. I need to show you something.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, Shiroya, come to the living room. I need to show you something."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Immediately after tossing out that mysterious request, Sai walked away.
entries.literal: "Immediately after tossing out that mysterious request, Sai walked away."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Hm..." As Atsuki tried to process the almost surreal way in which Sai had shown up, Shiroya's moaning made him turn to her waking face.
entries.literal: "\"Hm...\" As Atsuki tried to process the almost surreal way in which Sai had shown up, Shiroya's moaning made him turn to her waking face."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Was that Sai...? What did he want?
entries.literal: "Was that Sai...? What did he want?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Did you hear him? He told us to go to the living room, that he had something to show us, and went back there.
entries.literal: "Did you hear him? He told us to go to the living room, that he had something to show us, and went back there."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya yawned, but she couldn't help the intrigue. Sai had only called for both of them, and nobody from the opposite bedroom could be heard.
entries.literal: "Shiroya yawned, but she couldn't help the intrigue. Sai had only called for both of them, and nobody from the opposite bedroom could be heard."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, as he hadn't come back, they forced their tired bodies to stand up and attentively walked to the hallway.
entries.literal: "Then, as he hadn't come back, they forced their tired bodies to stand up and attentively walked to the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door to the living room was closed. Atsuki pushed it inward and hesitantly glanced in.
entries.literal: "The door to the living room was closed. Atsuki pushed it inward and hesitantly glanced in."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai wasn't there.{w} However, on the sofa, a recognizable shining egg lay, next to the many footprints that indicated someone had walked on that floor very recently.
entries.literal: "Sai wasn't there.{w} However, on the sofa, a recognizable shining egg lay, next to the many footprints that indicated someone had walked on that floor very recently."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Sai, where the hell are you...?
entries.literal: "Sai, where the hell are you...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya slowly stepped forward, confirming that he was neither there nor in the staircase. The Sekimeiya, presented without context, must have been what Sai had wanted to show them.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Shiroya slowly stepped forward, confirming that he was neither there nor in the staircase. The Sekimeiya, presented without context, must have been what Sai had wanted to show them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As Sai had seemingly vanished, both of them wondered whether he'd intended for them to activate it.
entries.literal: "As Sai had seemingly vanished, both of them wondered whether he'd intended for them to activate it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That thought was denied when footsteps came from the hallway. Turning around, they saw Sai standing plainly in front of them.
entries.literal: "That thought was denied when footsteps came from the hallway. Turning around, they saw Sai standing plainly in front of them."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Well, there it is. I brought it here from the crystal floor. It wasn't even well-hidden.
entries.literal: "Well, there it is. I brought it here from the crystal floor. It wasn't even well-hidden."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Is that so...?
entries.literal: "Is that so...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had found it. Nonetheless, what Atsuki and Shiroya wondered was why he'd brought it there.
entries.literal: "He had found it. Nonetheless, what Atsuki and Shiroya wondered was why he'd brought it there."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I don't know how what I'm about to say will sound, but I think I have come to understand what this thing really does.
entries.literal: "I don't know how what I'm about to say will sound, but I think I have come to understand what this thing really does."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: The Sekimeiya... Whatever it is, it can do much more than making one travel through time.{w} I don't think I should just explain to you two. I've had time to learn how it functions, and it's incredible.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya... Whatever it is, it can do much more than making one travel through time.{w} I don't think I should just explain to you two. I've had time to learn how it functions, and it's incredible."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Shiroya could hardly reply. Was Sai telling the truth? They'd found out the Sekimeiya had the power to make one travel back in time, but had they failed to notice the true extent of its capabilities?
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Shiroya could hardly reply. Was Sai telling the truth? They'd found out the Sekimeiya had the power to make one travel back in time, but had they failed to notice the true extent of its capabilities?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Speechless from the anticipation, they followed Sai to the hallway. He'd picked up the gemstone without making direct contact with it. There, everyone was called.
entries.literal: "Speechless from the anticipation, they followed Sai to the hallway. He'd picked up the gemstone without making direct contact with it. There, everyone was called."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina and Isla had fallen asleep; Akaro watched with concern, sitting on the lowest bed in the other bedroom. When everyone reunited in the hallway, Sai repeated the same thing he'd told Atsuki and Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Erina and Isla had fallen asleep; Akaro watched with concern, sitting on the lowest bed in the other bedroom. When everyone reunited in the hallway, Sai repeated the same thing he'd told Atsuki and Shiroya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "What the fuck does that mean? What else can the Sekimeiya do?" Akaro was the first to react strongly to such an assertion.
entries.literal: "\"What the fuck does that mean? What else can the Sekimeiya do?\" Akaro was the first to react strongly to such an assertion."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: That's what I will show you. However, I have my reasons to not explain what I don't want to.
entries.literal: "That's what I will show you. However, I have my reasons to not explain what I don't want to."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Again, what the hell does that mean?
entries.literal: "Again, what the hell does that mean?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: It means that if, after this, you don't want to believe what I'm saying, it won't be my problem.
entries.literal: "It means that if, after this, you don't want to believe what I'm saying, it won't be my problem."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone was confused by Sai's attitude. What was he trying to accomplish, exactly?
entries.literal: "Everyone was confused by Sai's attitude. What was he trying to accomplish, exactly?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: However, I'll make sure you believe me. The Sekimeiya's powers are much greater than you think.
entries.literal: "However, I'll make sure you believe me. The Sekimeiya's powers are much greater than you think."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai opened the door to the right bedroom.
entries.literal: "Sai opened the door to the right bedroom."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Just so nobody thinks I'm trying to pull something, you can check whether there's anything strange in this bedroom.
entries.literal: "Just so nobody thinks I'm trying to pull something, you can check whether there's anything strange in this bedroom."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...What could there be?
entries.literal: "...What could there be?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I don't know, but it's so that you don't try to find objections later.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but it's so that you don't try to find objections later."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Even though nobody understood what exactly Sai was getting at, Shiroya, Atsuki, and Akaro followed his suggestion. Both levels of the bedroom were inspected, and nothing stood out.
entries.literal: "Even though nobody understood what exactly Sai was getting at, Shiroya, Atsuki, and Akaro followed his suggestion. Both levels of the bedroom were inspected, and nothing stood out."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: All right, good. It seems you're all eager to see what this thing can do. Unfortunately, you won't see it directly. The cameras aren't recording, so nobody will.
entries.literal: "All right, good. It seems you're all eager to see what this thing can do. Unfortunately, you won't see it directly. The cameras aren't recording, so nobody will."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai, still holding the glowing gem, took a couple steps into the bedroom and left it on the floor. Then, he approached the door and closed it from the inside.
entries.literal: "Sai, still holding the glowing gem, took a couple steps into the bedroom and left it on the floor. Then, he approached the door and closed it from the inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I will now lock the bedroom." From the other side of the door, Sai proceeded to set the chain. In the hallway, everyone exchanged dumbfounded looks.
entries.literal: "\"I will now lock the bedroom.\" From the other side of the door, Sai proceeded to set the chain. In the hallway, everyone exchanged dumbfounded looks."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lastly, Sai locked the door with its key, which he got from one of the drawers.
entries.literal: "Lastly, Sai locked the door with its key, which he got from one of the drawers."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I am about to touch the Sekimeiya to travel to the past.
entries.literal: "I am about to touch the Sekimeiya to travel to the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Faint footsteps came from inside the bedroom, which very shortly ceased. The next thing they heard was a door opening behind them.
entries.literal: "Faint footsteps came from inside the bedroom, which very shortly ceased. The next thing they heard was a door opening behind them."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: There we go. Now the Sekimeiya's isolated inside. It will do everything by itself.
entries.literal: "There we go. Now the Sekimeiya's isolated inside. It will do everything by itself."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai had come from the opposite bedroom, where Atsuki and Shiroya had been sleeping.
entries.literal: "Sai had come from the opposite bedroom, where Atsuki and Shiroya had been sleeping."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I traveled a few seconds to the past, from room to room.
entries.literal: "I traveled a few seconds to the past, from room to room."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...Wh-What the fuck are you even doing?
entries.literal: "...Wh-What the fuck are you even doing?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Atsuki, why don't you search me?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, why don't you search me?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...Search you?
entries.literal: "...Search you?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Check that I have nothing on me. For the same reason.
entries.literal: "Check that I have nothing on me. For the same reason."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki gave a sigh of frustration but conceded.
entries.literal: "Atsuki gave a sigh of frustration but conceded."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Aside from the personal belongings in one of his back pockets, Sai didn't have anything else.
entries.literal: "Aside from the personal belongings in one of his back pockets, Sai didn't have anything else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, Atsuki noticed something.
entries.literal: "However, Atsuki noticed something."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Is your watch not working?
entries.literal: "Is your watch not working?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: It isn't. It stopped working earlier, unfortunately, so we won't be able to measure the time.{w} Anyway, I'm glad you're all following along. Now, Isla, mind telling me a number?
entries.literal: "It isn't. It stopped working earlier, unfortunately, so we won't be able to measure the time.{w} Anyway, I'm glad you're all following along. Now, Isla, mind telling me a number?"

entries.speaker: ilnn
entries.text: A number...? Why?
entries.literal: "A number...? Why?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You'll see.
entries.literal: "You'll see."

entries.speaker: ilnn
entries.text: Hm, nine?
entries.literal: "Hm, nine?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Nine? I was expecting a longer one, but that's fine.
entries.literal: "Nine? I was expecting a longer one, but that's fine."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Shiroya, say a letter.
entries.literal: "Shiroya, say a letter."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Huh...?{w} C.

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Perfect. Now we have to wait.
entries.literal: "Perfect. Now we have to wait."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Wait for what?
entries.literal: "Wait for what?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: For the Sekimeiya to work. I bet you'd all assumed it had to be touched to activate it.
entries.literal: "For the Sekimeiya to work. I bet you'd all assumed it had to be touched to activate it."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: ...I don't think any of us are following. What will the Sekimeiya do, exactly?
entries.literal: "...I don't think any of us are following. What will the Sekimeiya do, exactly?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Actually, I'm not completely sure myself. It can do anything, so we'll see.{w} Some time from now, it will make a sound. That'll tell us it's worked.
entries.literal: "Actually, I'm not completely sure myself. It can do anything, so we'll see.{w} Some time from now, it will make a sound. That'll tell us it's worked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Some time from now"? Nobody understood yet what Sai was talking about or why he was doing anything they were seeing.
entries.literal: "\"Some time from now\"? Nobody understood yet what Sai was talking about or why he was doing anything they were seeing."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: It shouldn't take very long. If I'm right and understand how the Sekimeiya functions, it won't take many minutes.
entries.literal: "It shouldn't take very long. If I'm right and understand how the Sekimeiya functions, it won't take many minutes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Since it was clear that Sai wouldn't explain himself further, everyone decided to continue humoring him and waited.
entries.literal: "Since it was clear that Sai wouldn't explain himself further, everyone decided to continue humoring him and waited."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...What kind of sound would the Sekimeiya make? Everyone's senses had sharpened, but meanwhile, the silence was pure.
entries.literal: "...What kind of sound would the Sekimeiya make? Everyone's senses had sharpened, but meanwhile, the silence was pure."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Oh, I didn't mention it, but obviously, this door is now completely locked. Both the chain and the lock are in effect.
entries.literal: "Oh, I didn't mention it, but obviously, this door is now completely locked. Both the chain and the lock are in effect."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A couple minutes had gone by when Sai pointed out that part of the setup.
entries.literal: "A couple minutes had gone by when Sai pointed out that part of the setup."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He grabbed the handle and tried to open the door to demonstrate that it wasn't possible.
entries.literal: "He grabbed the handle and tried to open the door to demonstrate that it wasn't possible."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: It doesn't matter much, but you can see that I'm not lying about this.
entries.literal: "It doesn't matter much, but you can see that I'm not lying about this."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki repeated what Sai had attempted and confirmed that the door couldn't be opened.
entries.literal: "Atsuki repeated what Sai had attempted and confirmed that the door couldn't be opened."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: So, currently, we have no way to enter this roo—
entries.literal: "So, currently, we have no way to enter this roo—"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Oh, fuck. Actually, I might've overlooked something.
entries.literal: "Oh, fuck. Actually, I might've overlooked something."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For the first time, Sai looked uncertain. He rapidly turned around and opened the opposite bedroom.
entries.literal: "For the first time, Sai looked uncertain. He rapidly turned around and opened the opposite bedroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he came back, he had a key in his hand.
entries.literal: "When he came back, he had a key in his hand."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I forgot both bedrooms had a key. This one shouldn't work, though, right?
entries.literal: "I forgot both bedrooms had a key. This one shouldn't work, though, right?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody was sure.
entries.literal: "Nobody was sure."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai inserted the key into the keyhole, but he couldn't turn it.
entries.literal: "Sai inserted the key into the keyhole, but he couldn't turn it."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: All right, it doesn't work. Good, so the lock is effective.
entries.literal: "All right, it doesn't work. Good, so the lock is effective."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After that brief interlude, the standby was resumed. It had been confirmed that they had no way to open the door, which told everyone that, somehow, it was going to open. Otherwise, the Sekimeiya would get stuck on the other side.
entries.literal: "After that brief interlude, the standby was resumed. It had been confirmed that they had no way to open the door, which told everyone that, somehow, it was going to open. Otherwise, the Sekimeiya would get stuck on the other side."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: ...How much longer are we gonna wait?
entries.literal: "...How much longer are we gonna wait?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You don't have much patience, do you? We're waiting for magic to occur, and it's only been a few minutes. The exact time, even I don't know.
entries.literal: "You don't have much patience, do you? We're waiting for magic to occur, and it's only been a few minutes. The exact time, even I don't know."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It almost felt ridiculous, but they kept waiting, wondering if Sai was just messing with them. About ten minutes had gone by.
entries.literal: "It almost felt ridiculous, but they kept waiting, wondering if Sai was just messing with them. About ten minutes had gone by."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "There it is."{w} A metallic sound startled everyone but Sai. They stared at the locked door, as it had come from behind it.
entries.literal: "\"There it is.\"{w} A metallic sound startled everyone but Sai. They stared at the locked door, as it had come from behind it."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Hey, look. Didn't this change?
entries.literal: "Hey, look. Didn't this change?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone looked at Sai's palm. A key was on it, but everyone recognized it looked slightly different than it had moments prior. It wasn't the wrong one anymore.
entries.literal: "Everyone looked at Sai's palm. A key was on it, but everyone recognized it looked slightly different than it had moments prior. It wasn't the wrong one anymore."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: ...Are you just fucking with us? What, did the key appear in your hand out of nowhere?
entries.literal: "...Are you just fucking with us? What, did the key appear in your hand out of nowhere?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: No, Akaro, that's not it. It modified the other key. That's one of the powers the Sekimeiya possesses. That sound was the cue that it did what I thought it would do.
entries.literal: "No, Akaro, that's not it. It modified the other key. That's one of the powers the Sekimeiya possesses. That sound was the cue that it did what I thought it would do."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai didn't give anyone else a chance to object, opting to insert the key into the keyhole. He swiftly turned it, and the door unlocked with a small click.
entries.literal: "Sai didn't give anyone else a chance to object, opting to insert the key into the keyhole. He swiftly turned it, and the door unlocked with a small click."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You remember the chain as well, right? Don't think that bypassing it is something the Sekimeiya isn't capable of.
entries.literal: "You remember the chain as well, right? Don't think that bypassing it is something the Sekimeiya isn't capable of."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once the main lock had been removed, Sai pushed the door open.
entries.literal: "Once the main lock had been removed, Sai pushed the door open."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: No resistance prevented him from doing so; the chain wasn't set anymore.
entries.literal: "No resistance prevented him from doing so; the chain wasn't set anymore."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As he kept slowly opening the door, everyone thought the same thing: Sai was putting on a show. Nobody knew why, but they'd come to understand him enough to be certain of that.
entries.literal: "As he kept slowly opening the door, everyone thought the same thing: Sai was putting on a show. Nobody knew why, but they'd come to understand him enough to be certain of that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the entire bedroom came into view, so did the most important thing inside. On the floor, where the Sekimeiya had been, there was only a square piece of paper.
entries.literal: "When the entire bedroom came into view, so did the most important thing inside. On the floor, where the Sekimeiya had been, there was only a square piece of paper."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Isla, do you mind going to pick that up?
entries.literal: "Isla, do you mind going to pick that up?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Curious, she took tiny steps into the room. She bent down to grab the paper and turned it around. Then, she read the black letters written on it.
entries.literal: "Curious, she took tiny steps into the room. She bent down to grab the paper and turned it around. Then, she read the black letters written on it."

entries.speaker: ilnn
entries.text: ...9C. That's what it says.
entries.literal: "...9C. That's what it says."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...Is that it? Did the Sekimeiya hear the number and letter... and it materialized that?
entries.literal: "...Is that it? Did the Sekimeiya hear the number and letter... and it materialized that?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Precisely.
entries.literal: "Precisely."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki tried not to laugh. Not particularly because he found that unbelievable, but because of what Sai's entire charade had led to.
entries.literal: "Atsuki tried not to laugh. Not particularly because he found that unbelievable, but because of what Sai's entire charade had led to."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He took the liberty of going to the second level, where he didn't immediately see the Sekimeiya either, nor anything of importance.
entries.literal: "He took the liberty of going to the second level, where he didn't immediately see the Sekimeiya either, nor anything of importance."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You're all wondering where the Sekimeiya is, right? Don't worry, I'll tell you.{w} After it does something that requires more power than usual, it teleports to its cabinet. I'm not sure why yet, but it's what I learned.{w} You'll see. Follow me.
entries.literal: "You're all wondering where the Sekimeiya is, right? Don't worry, I'll tell you.{w} After it does something that requires more power than usual, it teleports to its cabinet. I'm not sure why yet, but it's what I learned.{w} You'll see. Follow me."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai exited the room. As his show hadn't ended, the rest followed him, still unsure how to feel.
entries.literal: "Sai exited the room. As his show hadn't ended, the rest followed him, still unsure how to feel."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They walked to the crystal floor and entered the event room. When the cabinet was uncovered, they could clearly see what was inside. Not only that, but the cabinet was locked.
entries.literal: "They walked to the crystal floor and entered the event room. When the cabinet was uncovered, they could clearly see what was inside. Not only that, but the cabinet was locked."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: There you have it. That's a glimpse of what the Sekimeiya can do.
entries.literal: "There you have it. That's a glimpse of what the Sekimeiya can do."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...Why have you done all this, though?
entries.literal: "...Why have you done all this, though?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Rather than being amazed, Atsuki asked what everyone had been wondering.
entries.literal: "Rather than being amazed, Atsuki asked what everyone had been wondering."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: To demonstrate all your misconceptions regarding the Sekimeiya. However, as I said, I didn't want to detail exactly how it works. That's why I did it in a way so that you could witness it without understanding it fundamentally.
entries.literal: "To demonstrate all your misconceptions regarding the Sekimeiya. However, as I said, I didn't want to detail exactly how it works. That's why I did it in a way so that you could witness it without understanding it fundamentally."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: This thing possesses immense power, and I can't reveal what I learned about it. We can't take it out of here again.
entries.literal: "This thing possesses immense power, and I can't reveal what I learned about it. We can't take it out of here again."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...You said you demonstrated all our misconceptions, but I can easily think of a way you could've done this by simply traveling to the past.
entries.literal: "...You said you demonstrated all our misconceptions, but I can easily think of a way you could've done this by simply traveling to the past."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: How?
entries.literal: "How?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Isn't it obvious? Now, all you have to do is activate the Sekimeiya.{w} If you really understand how it works, you can make it send you to the past and to the locked bedroom. There, you'll leave the piece of paper and make the noise we heard. Before we enter, you'll touch the Sekimeiya and vanish from the room, once again to the past.{w} That could be why you locked the door, so that we wouldn't open it immediately after hearing the noise. You definitely didn't prove that the Sekimeiya is able to materialize a piece of paper.{w} ...It's true that it might've teleported from the attic to this cabinet after that. That's the most believable part of what you're claiming, though.
entries.literal: "Isn't it obvious? Now, all you have to do is activate the Sekimeiya.{w} If you really understand how it works, you can make it send you to the past and to the locked bedroom. There, you'll leave the piece of paper and make the noise we heard. Before we enter, you'll touch the Sekimeiya and vanish from the room, once again to the past.{w} That could be why you locked the door, so that we wouldn't open it immediately after hearing the noise. You definitely didn't prove that the Sekimeiya is able to materialize a piece of paper.{w} ...It's true that it might've teleported from the attic to this cabinet after that. That's the most believable part of what you're claiming, though."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai looked surprised.
entries.literal: "Sai looked surprised."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: How about this, then? I will never touch the Sekimeiya again. I promise that.
entries.literal: "How about this, then? I will never touch the Sekimeiya again. I promise that."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...You promise?
entries.literal: "...You promise?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Yes. As I said, we should leave it in this cabinet and never take it out until the shutter opens. If I never touch it, I can't do what you're speculating.
entries.literal: "Yes. As I said, we should leave it in this cabinet and never take it out until the shutter opens. If I never touch it, I can't do what you're speculating."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: What will you do, then? Travel to the past without touching it? Maybe that's possible.
entries.literal: "What will you do, then? Travel to the past without touching it? Maybe that's possible."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: No, no. You don't understand. I will never travel to the past again. Everything's already over, and the Sekimeiya did it all.{w} Listen, Atsuki. I can prove that what you said didn't happen. If it had, another version of myself would have to be somewhere in the tower right now. Let's confirm that version of me doesn't exist.
entries.literal: "No, no. You don't understand. I will never travel to the past again. Everything's already over, and the Sekimeiya did it all.{w} Listen, Atsuki. I can prove that what you said didn't happen. If it had, another version of myself would have to be somewhere in the tower right now. Let's confirm that version of me doesn't exist."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Wait." Shiroya objected.{w} "I can think of another way, if we're supposed to believe what you're saying now."
entries.literal: "\"Wait.\" Shiroya objected.{w} \"I can think of another way, if we're supposed to believe what you're saying now.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Another way". Underwhelmingly, what Sai had intended to be confirmation of the Sekimeiya's more extensive powers could be refuted with more than one method.
entries.literal: "\"Another way\". Underwhelmingly, what Sai had intended to be confirmation of the Sekimeiya's more extensive powers could be refuted with more than one method."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: It's possible you'll really never travel to the past again, but another version of you could.{w} I remember when you made Atsuki and me go to the living room. Back then, you weren't there, and you appeared from the hallway. What if that was already another version of you?{w} If you lured us out of the bedroom, your original version could go in there to hide under the bed. From there, you heard what we were talking about in the hallway, "9C".{w} That version of you will travel to the past and appear inside the bedroom, where you'll leave the note. Then, you'll use the Sekimeiya to go back to the past again, and you'll appear before us in the living room to play out the rest.
entries.literal: "It's possible you'll really never travel to the past again, but another version of you could.{w} I remember when you made Atsuki and me go to the living room. Back then, you weren't there, and you appeared from the hallway. What if that was already another version of you?{w} If you lured us out of the bedroom, your original version could go in there to hide under the bed. From there, you heard what we were talking about in the hallway, \"9C\".{w} That version of you will travel to the past and appear inside the bedroom, where you'll leave the note. Then, you'll use the Sekimeiya to go back to the past again, and you'll appear before us in the living room to play out the rest."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Did you even hear me? If that's what happened, another version of myself should still exist somewhere! Let's see whether we can find him.
entries.literal: "Did you even hear me? If that's what happened, another version of myself should still exist somewhere! Let's see whether we can find him."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Not necessarily. If that other version of yours got out from under the bed and hurried here when we saw the note, he could've already traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "Not necessarily. If that other version of yours got out from under the bed and hurried here when we saw the note, he could've already traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You're pissing me off a little. How about this? That didn't happen either.
entries.literal: "You're pissing me off a little. How about this? That didn't happen either."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: And you can prove that? I'm not exactly sure what you did, but was it just to make us believe that you have a great understanding of the Sekimeiya and get us not to take it out of the cabinet again?
entries.literal: "And you can prove that? I'm not exactly sure what you did, but was it just to make us believe that you have a great understanding of the Sekimeiya and get us not to take it out of the cabinet again?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Yes. You're not wrong about that.
entries.literal: "Yes. You're not wrong about that."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Well, I can give you a third way you could've accomplished this by just traveling to the past.
entries.literal: "Well, I can give you a third way you could've accomplished this by just traveling to the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki explained it with a casual voice.
entries.literal: "Atsuki explained it with a casual voice."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Like I said, what I could believe is that the Sekimeiya can teleport itself. If you really came to understand how that works...{w} I remember when you claimed you forgot about the key to the other bedroom, but I don't believe you really did. That could've easily been an excuse to disappear from our sight. After all, you asked to be searched, but only before you entered the other bedroom.{w} It's possible you got both keys from that room and initially only showed us one. However, it's also possible the Sekimeiya had teleported there.{w} You touched it and went to the past, to the right bedroom. You placed the note and touched the Sekimeiya before it teleported away. You went back in time and appeared in the second level of the left bedroom. This way, as soon as you entered it, the version of yours who'd already placed the note got out, and you showed us the wrong key when you'd already done everything.
entries.literal: "Like I said, what I could believe is that the Sekimeiya can teleport itself. If you really came to understand how that works...{w} I remember when you claimed you forgot about the key to the other bedroom, but I don't believe you really did. That could've easily been an excuse to disappear from our sight. After all, you asked to be searched, but only before you entered the other bedroom.{w} It's possible you got both keys from that room and initially only showed us one. However, it's also possible the Sekimeiya had teleported there.{w} You touched it and went to the past, to the right bedroom. You placed the note and touched the Sekimeiya before it teleported away. You went back in time and appeared in the second level of the left bedroom. This way, as soon as you entered it, the version of yours who'd already placed the note got out, and you showed us the wrong key when you'd already done everything."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Aren't you forgetting something?
entries.literal: "Aren't you forgetting something?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: The noise. How would I have done that?
entries.literal: "The noise. How would I have done that?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Oh, I see.{w} ...I said you traveled to the past before the Sekimeiya teleported away, which must have been before we heard the noise. However, there are two ways around this.{w} One, the Sekimeiya teleported itself to the past after you made the noise. That would solve it, if it's possible.{w} Two, the Sekimeiya teleported itself to the opposite bedroom and then back to the initial one. That's how you could've stayed there for longer and made the sound.
entries.literal: "Oh, I see.{w} ...I said you traveled to the past before the Sekimeiya teleported away, which must have been before we heard the noise. However, there are two ways around this.{w} One, the Sekimeiya teleported itself to the past after you made the noise. That would solve it, if it's possible.{w} Two, the Sekimeiya teleported itself to the opposite bedroom and then back to the initial one. That's how you could've stayed there for longer and made the sound."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...How about this? That didn't happen either. You're just wrong.{w} In fact, I really did overlook that the other bedroom had a key as well. That was not part of what I intended to do.
entries.literal: "...How about this? That didn't happen either. You're just wrong.{w} In fact, I really did overlook that the other bedroom had a key as well. That was not part of what I intended to do."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I don't think so." Next, it was Akaro who objected.
entries.literal: "\"I don't think so.\" Next, it was Akaro who objected."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: After all, your silly trick ended with "the wrong key transformed into the correct one". That couldn't have happened unless you had the wrong key, meaning you knew from the start you'd go to the other bedroom to pick it up.
entries.literal: "After all, your silly trick ended with \"the wrong key transformed into the correct one\". That couldn't have happened unless you had the wrong key, meaning you knew from the start you'd go to the other bedroom to pick it up."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: God. That was not part of the plan at all! All I knew was that the right key would appear on me after the Sekimeiya's sound. I didn't know it would transform the wrong one.
entries.literal: "God. That was not part of the plan at all! All I knew was that the right key would appear on me after the Sekimeiya's sound. I didn't know it would transform the wrong one."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: That's very hard to believe.
entries.literal: "That's very hard to believe."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya had one last input.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had one last input."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: I bet the way you locked the room from the inside was part of your trick too. You set the chain and then locked the door with the key.{w} That created the illusion that the Sekimeiya removed the chain, but it could've been as simple as you taking it out right after locking the door. It's not like we would've noticed.
entries.literal: "I bet the way you locked the room from the inside was part of your trick too. You set the chain and then locked the door with the key.{w} That created the illusion that the Sekimeiya removed the chain, but it could've been as simple as you taking it out right after locking the door. It's not like we would've noticed."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...I actually didn't think about that.{w} However, I didn't do it.
entries.literal: "...I actually didn't think about that.{w} However, I didn't do it."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: I also bet the reason behind the "we have to wait for the Sekimeiya to make a sound" was so you could properly time whatever you did. You had to wait a specific amount of time for it to function.
entries.literal: "I also bet the reason behind the \"we have to wait for the Sekimeiya to make a sound\" was so you could properly time whatever you did. You had to wait a specific amount of time for it to function."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Incorrect.
entries.literal: "Incorrect."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: And you can prove all of this?
entries.literal: "And you can prove all of this?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: How?
entries.literal: "How?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: By doing it again.
entries.literal: "By doing it again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Annoyed, Sai asked for the key to the cabinet. Everyone was still intrigued, so they agreed to let him unlock it.
entries.literal: "Annoyed, Sai asked for the key to the cabinet. Everyone was still intrigued, so they agreed to let him unlock it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He picked up the Sekimeiya without touching it with his skin and left the room.
