entries.literal: "He picked up the Sekimeiya without touching it with his skin and left the room."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Let's go back up.
entries.literal: "Let's go back up."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: You're going to do the same thing again? Can you not do it in the bathrooms?
entries.literal: "You're going to do the same thing again? Can you not do it in the bathrooms?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I can, but that's not as aesthetic.
entries.literal: "I can, but that's not as aesthetic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A few eyes rolled, but they followed Sai up to the attic. Once again, everyone was in front of the two bedroom doors.
entries.literal: "A few eyes rolled, but they followed Sai up to the attic. Once again, everyone was in front of the two bedroom doors."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki entered the right one and checked the drawer. The key wasn't there.
entries.literal: "Atsuki entered the right one and checked the drawer. The key wasn't there."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: If the wrong key transformed into the right one, how come the original one isn't here?
entries.literal: "If the wrong key transformed into the right one, how come the original one isn't here?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Because we can't have two of the same, dumbass. Come here.
entries.literal: "Because we can't have two of the same, dumbass. Come here."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: So that you don't think any other self of mine is hiding nearby, go ahead and verify that.
entries.literal: "So that you don't think any other self of mine is hiding nearby, go ahead and verify that."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: You realize it could just appear after we search, right?
entries.literal: "You realize it could just appear after we search, right?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: That's fine.
entries.literal: "That's fine."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina and Isla saw the rest dispersing through the attic and shortly coming back, claiming not to have found anyone.
entries.literal: "Erina and Isla saw the rest dispersing through the attic and shortly coming back, claiming not to have found anyone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Repeating his past movements, Sai stepped into the right bedroom and placed the Sekimeiya on the floor, close to the door.
entries.literal: "Repeating his past movements, Sai stepped into the right bedroom and placed the Sekimeiya on the floor, close to the door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There, he stood in silence.
entries.literal: "There, he stood in silence."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: What are you waiting for?
entries.literal: "What are you waiting for?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I'm thinking about the best way to do this so that you don't have a hundred excuses later.
entries.literal: "I'm thinking about the best way to do this so that you don't have a hundred excuses later."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He remained in thought for a couple minutes. Then, looking composed, he walked to the door and closed it from the inside.
entries.literal: "He remained in thought for a couple minutes. Then, looking composed, he walked to the door and closed it from the inside."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I will only set the chain this time so that Shiroya abandons her idiotic idea.
entries.literal: "I will only set the chain this time so that Shiroya abandons her idiotic idea."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As Sai spoke, only one thought filled Atsuki's brain: "I know what you want to do."
entries.literal: "As Sai spoke, only one thought filled Atsuki's brain: \"I know what you want to do.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd purposely left Sai a way out by ignoring one last way in which he could've achieved the same result.
entries.literal: "He'd purposely left Sai a way out by ignoring one last way in which he could've achieved the same result."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Careful not to alert him, Atsuki walked to the light switch and turned off the light in the hallway.
entries.literal: "Careful not to alert him, Atsuki walked to the light switch and turned off the light in the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What he had in mind was very simple: Sai would fake his travel. He'd claim to be about to touch the Sekimeiya to lock the room from the inside and appear outside. However, he wouldn't actually touch it.
entries.literal: "What he had in mind was very simple: Sai would fake his travel. He'd claim to be about to touch the Sekimeiya to lock the room from the inside and appear outside. However, he wouldn't actually touch it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Instead, he would stay in the bedroom. That way, he would hear what was being talked about in the hallway.
entries.literal: "Instead, he would stay in the bedroom. That way, he would hear what was being talked about in the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At some point, after having written the note, he would touch the Sekimeiya and go minutes back to the past. He would appear somewhere in the attic and claim he'd just set the chain and traveled out of the room, when in reality he would have already left the note.{w} Then, he would ask for the specific number and wait out the time he'd spent in the bedroom before opening the door and finding the note.
entries.literal: "At some point, after having written the note, he would touch the Sekimeiya and go minutes back to the past. He would appear somewhere in the attic and claim he'd just set the chain and traveled out of the room, when in reality he would have already left the note.{w} Then, he would ask for the specific number and wait out the time he'd spent in the bedroom before opening the door and finding the note."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: All right, it's set. Now I will touch the Sekimeiya and appear in the past, outside the bedroom.
entries.literal: "All right, it's set. Now I will touch the Sekimeiya and appear in the past, outside the bedroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki gestured at everyone to keep quiet, and he'd also closed every other door in the hallway. By shutting off the light, he wanted to reveal Sai's trick.
entries.literal: "Atsuki gestured at everyone to keep quiet, and he'd also closed every other door in the hallway. By shutting off the light, he wanted to reveal Sai's trick."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He looked down. From under the door, light was seen, as the bedroom was illuminated. However, what Atsuki had achieved was highlighting Sai's shadow.
entries.literal: "He looked down. From under the door, light was seen, as the bedroom was illuminated. However, what Atsuki had achieved was highlighting Sai's shadow."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His body was blocking the light from going through the entire gap. That was how Atsuki intended to expose him. If that shadow didn't instantly disappear, he could prove Sai hadn't teleported out of the bedroom.
entries.literal: "His body was blocking the light from going through the entire gap. That was how Atsuki intended to expose him. If that shadow didn't instantly disappear, he could prove Sai hadn't teleported out of the bedroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai took two steps into the room, but his shadow was still acting as a barrier for the ceiling light. Atsuki wanted to verify Sai's bluff and quickly turn the light back on. He was certain that a future version of him was nearby after already placing the note.{w} If he could know what Atsuki was doing, it was possible his idea would retroactively fail. However, Atsuki was confident that'd still prevent Sai from completing his setup without a hole.
entries.literal: "Sai took two steps into the room, but his shadow was still acting as a barrier for the ceiling light. Atsuki wanted to verify Sai's bluff and quickly turn the light back on. He was certain that a future version of him was nearby after already placing the note.{w} If he could know what Atsuki was doing, it was possible his idea would retroactively fail. However, Atsuki was confident that'd still prevent Sai from completing his setup without a hole."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Like the last time, after two steps, the sound faded. The Sekimeiya was on the floor, but near the door. Therefore, even though Sai had to crouch to activate it, his shadow would still be visible from the other side.
entries.literal: "Like the last time, after two steps, the sound faded. The Sekimeiya was on the floor, but near the door. Therefore, even though Sai had to crouch to activate it, his shadow would still be visible from the other side."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki stared down. The gap was very thin, and certainly not big enough to see through. As such, using Sai's shadow was all he could do.
entries.literal: "Atsuki stared down. The gap was very thin, and certainly not big enough to see through. As such, using Sai's shadow was all he could do."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai's steps were purposely audible. However, that time, they took longer to cease, and bigger gaps were between them. Before crouching, the shadow moved left and right, as if in thought. It seemed like Sai was conscious of his movements.
entries.literal: "Sai's steps were purposely audible. However, that time, they took longer to cease, and bigger gaps were between them. Before crouching, the shadow moved left and right, as if in thought. It seemed like Sai was conscious of his movements."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I'm about to touch it.
entries.literal: "I'm about to touch it."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: All right.
entries.literal: "All right."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But despite his confidence, Atsuki saw it unmistakably: the shadow disappeared in an instant. It hadn't moved away—it had vanished.
entries.literal: "But despite his confidence, Atsuki saw it unmistakably: the shadow disappeared in an instant. It hadn't moved away—it had vanished."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Disconcerted, Atsuki still managed to react properly. He dashed to the light switch and turned it on.
entries.literal: "Disconcerted, Atsuki still managed to react properly. He dashed to the light switch and turned it on."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Instants later, the door to the living room opened.
entries.literal: "Instants later, the door to the living room opened."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Oh, right. I appeared here this time since we just came from the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Oh, right. I appeared here this time since we just came from the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: All right, let's do this again.
entries.literal: "All right, let's do this again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki tried not to look frustrated, as Sai didn't seem to have noticed what he'd attempted.
entries.literal: "Atsuki tried not to look frustrated, as Sai didn't seem to have noticed what he'd attempted."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What Atsuki had tried made sense. He had assumed the least important part of Sai's show was what the trick had relied on. However, he'd been incorrect.
entries.literal: "What Atsuki had tried made sense. He had assumed the least important part of Sai's show was what the trick had relied on. However, he'd been incorrect."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The only reason Sai had done that had been for the spectacle; to be able to claim that the Sekimeiya had unset the chain. In no way had that part been necessary to accomplish the result.
entries.literal: "The only reason Sai had done that had been for the spectacle; to be able to claim that the Sekimeiya had unset the chain. In no way had that part been necessary to accomplish the result."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It had not been a deception. Right after setting the chain and locking the door, Sai had touched the Sekimeiya and traveled to the past, outside the bedroom. By doing that, he'd left both levels of the bedroom truly devoid of life.{w} That was why Atsuki's very first solution had been that Sai would, in the future, travel to the past again and appear inside the right bedroom after it had been locked.
entries.literal: "It had not been a deception. Right after setting the chain and locking the door, Sai had touched the Sekimeiya and traveled to the past, outside the bedroom. By doing that, he'd left both levels of the bedroom truly devoid of life.{w} That was why Atsuki's very first solution had been that Sai would, in the future, travel to the past again and appear inside the right bedroom after it had been locked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yet, that was also wrong. To make that note appear, Sai wouldn't travel back to the bedroom. As a matter of fact, he hadn't done it before they'd seen it either. Incidentally, nobody had, or ever would, as he'd worked alone.
entries.literal: "Yet, that was also wrong. To make that note appear, Sai wouldn't travel back to the bedroom. As a matter of fact, he hadn't done it before they'd seen it either. Incidentally, nobody had, or ever would, as he'd worked alone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So he was more frustrated than he looked by the way Atsuki had acted. He hated feeling like someone was being superior to him.
entries.literal: "So he was more frustrated than he looked by the way Atsuki had acted. He hated feeling like someone was being superior to him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai approached the door and grabbed its handle. When he turned it, a chain prevented him from opening the door.
entries.literal: "Sai approached the door and grabbed its handle. When he turned it, a chain prevented him from opening the door."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: The chain is set, see? You didn't want me to also lock the door from the inside, so I'll do it from here.
entries.literal: "The chain is set, see? You didn't want me to also lock the door from the inside, so I'll do it from here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai made his left hand a fist and slowly opened it up as if it were a flower.
entries.literal: "Sai made his left hand a fist and slowly opened it up as if it were a flower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A key was on his palm.
entries.literal: "A key was on his palm."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: You're a clown.
entries.literal: "You're a clown."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Am I, Akaro? Because you seem very interested to figure out how exactly the Sekimeiya works.
entries.literal: "Am I, Akaro? Because you seem very interested to figure out how exactly the Sekimeiya works."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: What the fuck are you talking about?
entries.literal: "What the fuck are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai ignored him and inserted the key into the keyhole. Then, he turned it.
entries.literal: "Sai ignored him and inserted the key into the keyhole. Then, he turned it."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Why are you locking the door if it's already locked from the inside?
entries.literal: "Why are you locking the door if it's already locked from the inside?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Because the chain provides a gap you can see through. I don't want anyone seeing how the Sekimeiya writes on a note.
entries.literal: "Because the chain provides a gap you can see through. I don't want anyone seeing how the Sekimeiya writes on a note."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Don't worry. This time, I won't go anywhere. Let's do what we did before, then.{w} Isla, give me three numbers from one to nine.
entries.literal: "Don't worry. This time, I won't go anywhere. Let's do what we did before, then.{w} Isla, give me three numbers from one to nine."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Hang on. I'll give you the three numbers." Atsuki didn't want to give him any way out.
entries.literal: "\"Hang on. I'll give you the three numbers.\" Atsuki didn't want to give him any way out."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: That's fine by me.
entries.literal: "That's fine by me."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But Atsuki didn't open his mouth. Just like Sai, he formed one fist, following with the other.
entries.literal: "But Atsuki didn't open his mouth. Just like Sai, he formed one fist, following with the other."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he stuck out two fingers. Next, six, and finally, nine. Those had been his three numbers.
entries.literal: "Then, he stuck out two fingers. Next, six, and finally, nine. Those had been his three numbers."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...{w}Oh, certainly, Atsuki.{w} We can do it like this.
entries.literal: "...{w}Oh, certainly, Atsuki.{w} We can do it like this."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had done that to prevent something they'd mentioned earlier. If another version of Sai had appeared nearby, he could not have heard the numbers. All the doors were closed, so Atsuki's hands couldn't have been seen either.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had done that to prevent something they'd mentioned earlier. If another version of Sai had appeared nearby, he could not have heard the numbers. All the doors were closed, so Atsuki's hands couldn't have been seen either."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Now, do not speak about them or move in any way.
entries.literal: "Now, do not speak about them or move in any way."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai nodded as he smirked.
entries.literal: "Sai nodded as he smirked."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Do we also have to wait a random amount of time?
entries.literal: "Do we also have to wait a random amount of time?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: A random amount of time? We'll see.
entries.literal: "A random amount of time? We'll see."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Even if they weren't sure of the real reason, everyone next to Sai felt in some way that he was trying to deceive them. However, his attitude was beginning to feel imposing.
entries.literal: "Even if they weren't sure of the real reason, everyone next to Sai felt in some way that he was trying to deceive them. However, his attitude was beginning to feel imposing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Did he truly want to leave the Sekimeiya in the cabinet? That couldn't be. So, then, what exactly had he figured out?
entries.literal: "Did he truly want to leave the Sekimeiya in the cabinet? That couldn't be. So, then, what exactly had he figured out?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had asked for silence so that his three numbers wouldn't be transmitted to anyone within reach. Because of that, everyone waited silently, and for longer than before.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had asked for silence so that his three numbers wouldn't be transmitted to anyone within reach. Because of that, everyone waited silently, and for longer than before."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Ten minutes had gone by, and everyone started to realize that they'd surpassed the previous endpoint.
entries.literal: "Ten minutes had gone by, and everyone started to realize that they'd surpassed the previous endpoint."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai began to whisper very quietly so that only the people right next to him could hear him, puzzling them.
entries.literal: "Sai began to whisper very quietly so that only the people right next to him could hear him, puzzling them."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Seventeen. I had to count internally since my watch doesn't work, but it's been seventeen minutes since we began to wait.
entries.literal: "Seventeen. I had to count internally since my watch doesn't work, but it's been seventeen minutes since we began to wait."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Seventeen minutes. 2 + 6 + 9.{w} Remember when you said I'd waited an arbitrary amount of time to time everything properly? I'm glad I can now be certain I understand exactly how to use the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Seventeen minutes. 2 + 6 + 9.{w} Remember when you said I'd waited an arbitrary amount of time to time everything properly? I'm glad I can now be certain I understand exactly how to use the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai inserted the key into the keyhole and unlocked the door. When he tried to push it open, the chain didn't stop him, as it was no longer set.
entries.literal: "Sai inserted the key into the keyhole and unlocked the door. When he tried to push it open, the chain didn't stop him, as it was no longer set."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: The Sekimeiya unfastened the chain, right?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya unfastened the chain, right?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Was it you?{w} Are you my accomplice who helped me do this? If not, I'm open to alternatives.
entries.literal: "Was it you?{w} Are you my accomplice who helped me do this? If not, I'm open to alternatives."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene. The Sekimeiya had disappeared, and a small piece of paper had appeared on the floor.
entries.literal: "Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene. The Sekimeiya had disappeared, and a small piece of paper had appeared on the floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Isla walked over to it and picked it up.
entries.literal: "Isla walked over to it and picked it up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She showed it to the others.
entries.literal: "She showed it to the others."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The three numbers Atsuki had chosen filled up the entire surface of the paper.
entries.literal: "The three numbers Atsuki had chosen filled up the entire surface of the paper."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Attempting not to look flustered, he made his way to the second level of the bedroom, but there was nothing of importance to be seen.
entries.literal: "Attempting not to look flustered, he made his way to the second level of the bedroom, but there was nothing of importance to be seen."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Like before, after it was done, the Sekimeiya produced that sound and teleported to its cabinet on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Like before, after it was done, the Sekimeiya produced that sound and teleported to its cabinet on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The second time, that claim was harder to believe, as they'd just come from there. On the way down, it was much more difficult for everyone to find an explanation for what Sai had done.
entries.literal: "The second time, that claim was harder to believe, as they'd just come from there. On the way down, it was much more difficult for everyone to find an explanation for what Sai had done."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When they arrived at the event room, they saw the same thing as before.
entries.literal: "When they arrived at the event room, they saw the same thing as before."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "We didn't even lock it after we took it out, right?" Atsuki noticed the arrow on the side of the cabinet was pointing to "locked".
entries.literal: "\"We didn't even lock it after we took it out, right?\" Atsuki noticed the arrow on the side of the cabinet was pointing to \"locked\"."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: We didn't. It might be hard to take in, but the Sekimeiya did. That's what I intended to happen.
entries.literal: "We didn't. It might be hard to take in, but the Sekimeiya did. That's what I intended to happen."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: ...Are you just fucking joking? What's this, a magical stone that can do anything?
entries.literal: "...Are you just fucking joking? What's this, a magical stone that can do anything?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You thought it could only make one go back in time? Would that be much better?
entries.literal: "You thought it could only make one go back in time? Would that be much better?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: However, there's still the principal way in which you could've accomplished this that only requires you traveling to the past.
entries.literal: "However, there's still the principal way in which you could've accomplished this that only requires you traveling to the past."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Correct. It's possible that, in the future, I'll go back to the past and appear in the locked bedroom. Then, I'll write that note and touch the Sekimeiya, which will send me farther to the past.
entries.literal: "Correct. It's possible that, in the future, I'll go back to the past and appear in the locked bedroom. Then, I'll write that note and touch the Sekimeiya, which will send me farther to the past."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: But that will not happen. I purposely left this method possible so that you believe my intentions—that I sincerely don't want the Sekimeiya to be taken out of this cabinet again. ...That could go horribly.
entries.literal: "But that will not happen. I purposely left this method possible so that you believe my intentions—that I sincerely don't want the Sekimeiya to be taken out of this cabinet again. ...That could go horribly."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: My wristwatch doesn't work anymore, and I don't know if I can fix it.{w} We have no other way to look at the time. It'll be hard, but we'll spend every minute left together so that I can't go to the past and explain this your way.
entries.literal: "My wristwatch doesn't work anymore, and I don't know if I can fix it.{w} We have no other way to look at the time. It'll be hard, but we'll spend every minute left together so that I can't go to the past and explain this your way."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Additionally, before that, we can search the whole tower to make sure the version of me that this method would've left behind doesn't exist.
entries.literal: "Additionally, before that, we can search the whole tower to make sure the version of me that this method would've left behind doesn't exist."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Once this happens, you will understand. That there's no other way I could've done this but what I'm saying. This is only a glimpse of what the Sekimeiya's capable of. That... I'm sure of.
entries.literal: "Once this happens, you will understand. That there's no other way I could've done this but what I'm saying. This is only a glimpse of what the Sekimeiya's capable of. That... I'm sure of."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody could find words to reply with, let alone object with.
entries.literal: "Nobody could find words to reply with, let alone object with."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, as Atsuki's way out still seemed to exist, they went with Sai's proposition. The seven floors of Ashiya Tower were inspected, and nobody was found. Not any other self of Sai, and not Naomi either.
entries.literal: "So, as Atsuki's way out still seemed to exist, they went with Sai's proposition. The seven floors of Ashiya Tower were inspected, and nobody was found. Not any other self of Sai, and not Naomi either."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before the search had started, Sai had taken the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet and brought it with them, so nobody could've used it in the meantime.
entries.literal: "Before the search had started, Sai had taken the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet and brought it with them, so nobody could've used it in the meantime."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...What if, after touching the Sekimeiya in the bedroom, Sai would appear outside the tower? Not even that would explain everything, and it could be avoided as long as they stayed with him.
entries.literal: "...What if, after touching the Sekimeiya in the bedroom, Sai would appear outside the tower? Not even that would explain everything, and it could be avoided as long as they stayed with him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, lastly, they had to wait. After locking the attic behind them, they sat on the floor of the event room. They positioned the curtain so that it wouldn't fall down, providing a constant view of the glass.
entries.literal: "So, lastly, they had to wait. After locking the attic behind them, they sat on the floor of the event room. They positioned the curtain so that it wouldn't fall down, providing a constant view of the glass."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The idea to save Miiya... didn't go anywhere. During the following hours, it was a surreal silence that everyone shared.
entries.literal: "The idea to save Miiya... didn't go anywhere. During the following hours, it was a surreal silence that everyone shared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There were no tricks left. The few times anyone had to go to the bathroom, it was made sure nothing else happened. Finally, they'd managed to wait until {time=21}, keeping the cold in the cabinet sealed.
entries.literal: "There were no tricks left. The few times anyone had to go to the bathroom, it was made sure nothing else happened. Finally, they'd managed to wait until {time=21}, keeping the cold in the cabinet sealed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Noise came from the lobby. Without a doubt, the time had come.
entries.literal: "Noise came from the lobby. Without a doubt, the time had come."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The police rushed in and found everyone sitting in the event room. They were hastily taken outside and put in a police car.
entries.literal: "The police rushed in and found everyone sitting in the event room. They were hastily taken outside and put in a police car."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Without hesitation, Ashiya released a public statement.
entries.literal: "Without hesitation, Ashiya released a public statement."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: Nothing has been taken. Everything is safe, including the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Nothing has been taken. Everything is safe, including the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, word began to circulate in the underworld:
entries.literal: "However, word began to circulate in the underworld:"

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: Ashiya are lying. They do not have the Sekimeiya. We do.
entries.literal: "Ashiya are lying. They do not have the Sekimeiya. We do."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "We" referred to Xyn.
entries.literal: "\"We\" referred to Xyn."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The more that rumor extended, the more it strengthened, as Xyn continually stated they were in possession of the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "The more that rumor extended, the more it strengthened, as Xyn continually stated they were in possession of the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: The general consensus of the appearance is right: pure white and shaped like an egg. However, notice that Ashiya haven't shown the Sekimeiya since the incident. Why do you think they haven't?
entries.literal: "The general consensus of the appearance is right: pure white and shaped like an egg. However, notice that Ashiya haven't shown the Sekimeiya since the incident. Why do you think they haven't?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was a very fair question, which led everyone to be certain that, once again, Xyn had outsmarted Ashiya.
entries.literal: "It was a very fair question, which led everyone to be certain that, once again, Xyn had outsmarted Ashiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nonetheless, a new question shortly arose.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, a new question shortly arose."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Is Xyn going to prove it?"
entries.literal: "\"Is Xyn going to prove it?\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Weeks had gone by. Petitions to show the Sekimeiya bombarded Ashiya, but reaching Xyn wasn't as simple. Yet, after the initial statements, neither party had proven their ownership of the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Weeks had gone by. Petitions to show the Sekimeiya bombarded Ashiya, but reaching Xyn wasn't as simple. Yet, after the initial statements, neither party had proven their ownership of the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And, from one point onward, the Sekimeiya had become a myth. Neither Ashiya nor Xyn spoke again about the incredibly valuable gemstone they'd once claimed to possess.
entries.literal: "And, from one point onward, the Sekimeiya had become a myth. Neither Ashiya nor Xyn spoke again about the incredibly valuable gemstone they'd once claimed to possess."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Only a handful of people were known to have witnessed the Sekimeiya by themselves during the time they'd been locked in Ashiya Tower. However, after being talked to, none of them had valuable information to share.
entries.literal: "Only a handful of people were known to have witnessed the Sekimeiya by themselves during the time they'd been locked in Ashiya Tower. However, after being talked to, none of them had valuable information to share."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And still, many people thought they knew the truth. Many people thought that something must've happened during the twelve hours they'd spent shut away with the mysterious Sekimeiya, whose whereabouts were unknown.
entries.literal: "And still, many people thought they knew the truth. Many people thought that something must've happened during the twelve hours they'd spent shut away with the mysterious Sekimeiya, whose whereabouts were unknown."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After all, something must, in fact, have happened.
entries.literal: "After all, something must, in fact, have happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something that had caused the disappearance of a female staff member who wouldn't be seen ever again.
entries.literal: "Something that had caused the disappearance of a female staff member who wouldn't be seen ever again."

entries.text: Ending: Altered Dichotomy
entries.literal: "Ending: Altered Dichotomy"

entries.text: Ten Interloping Eyes
entries.literal: "Ten Interloping Eyes"

entries.text: A Hole in the Earth
entries.literal: "A Hole in the Earth"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...All right. ...Let's go.
entries.literal: "...All right. ...Let's go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up slowly so that I didn't lose my balance. I waited a few seconds for my blood pressure to adjust and opened my eyes once the dizziness had faded.
entries.literal: "I stood up slowly so that I didn't lose my balance. I waited a few seconds for my blood pressure to adjust and opened my eyes once the dizziness had faded."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm sorry, I can go alone.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry, I can go alone."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...No, don't worry.
entries.literal: "...No, don't worry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I forced a yawn before walking to the hallway, where all the doors were closed.
entries.literal: "I forced a yawn before walking to the hallway, where all the doors were closed."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm pretty sure he didn't come back, at least.
entries.literal: "I'm pretty sure he didn't come back, at least."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki opened the other bedroom. Katei was lying on the bed while Akaro was farther back, sitting on the floor. As soon as they heard us, they faced us reflexively.
entries.literal: "Atsuki opened the other bedroom. Katei was lying on the bed while Akaro was farther back, sitting on the floor. As soon as they heard us, they faced us reflexively."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Uh, is Sai up top?
entries.literal: "...Uh, is Sai up top?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? No, he isn't. Is he not with you?
entries.literal: "What? No, he isn't. Is he not with you?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...No? That's what we thought.
entries.literal: "...No? That's what we thought."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm pretty sure he went down.
entries.literal: "I'm pretty sure he went down."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...What the hell is that idiot doing?
entries.literal: "...What the hell is that idiot doing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Annoyed, Katei stood up, followed by Akaro. Behind us, we heard another sound.
entries.literal: "Annoyed, Katei stood up, followed by Akaro. Behind us, we heard another sound."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Did anything happen?
entries.literal: "...Did anything happen?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina was peeking down from the hatch of the other bedroom. Isla immediately appeared behind her, looking sleepy.
entries.literal: "Erina was peeking down from the hatch of the other bedroom. Isla immediately appeared behind her, looking sleepy."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai really doesn't want to leave us be. He's taking this as a joke.
entries.literal: "Sai really doesn't want to leave us be. He's taking this as a joke."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What could he want, though? Does he not realize being alone could be dangerous?
entries.literal: "What could he want, though? Does he not realize being alone could be dangerous?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I don't think he trusted Atsuki's search. He might have wanted to verify it himself.
entries.literal: "I don't think he trusted Atsuki's search. He might have wanted to verify it himself."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I can't believe that kid. He's stepping over every line.
entries.literal: "I can't believe that kid. He's stepping over every line."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: *yawn*
entries.literal: "*yawn*"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Are you two coming as well?
entries.literal: "Are you two coming as well?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'd rather that than stay alone. We should've all been in the same room. ...I'll go to the bathroom first.
entries.literal: "I'd rather that than stay alone. We should've all been in the same room. ...I'll go to the bathroom first."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're right about that.
entries.literal: "You're right about that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was the one who had allowed Sai to leave, but nobody said anything else until we got to the crystal floor. The center of the building had adopted a sinister aura, one that I could only tolerate as long as I wasn't alone.
entries.literal: "He was the one who had allowed Sai to leave, but nobody said anything else until we got to the crystal floor. The center of the building had adopted a sinister aura, one that I could only tolerate as long as I wasn't alone."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...? You all smell this too, right?
entries.literal: "What...? You all smell this too, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes, it's stronger here.
entries.literal: "Yes, it's stronger here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immediately, something else became clear: Sai had been there.
entries.literal: "Immediately, something else became clear: Sai had been there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few doors in hallway A hadn't been closed. The same applied to hallway B, although not as many.
entries.literal: "A few doors in hallway A hadn't been closed. The same applied to hallway B, although not as many."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Is he in any of them? Can you hear him?
entries.literal: "Is he in any of them? Can you hear him?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no sound to be perceived. As I'd said, it was very possible he'd wanted to search through the floors, unable to believe Atsuki.
entries.literal: "There was no sound to be perceived. As I'd said, it was very possible he'd wanted to search through the floors, unable to believe Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro entered the cleaning room while Atsuki and Katei walked up to the closest crystal rooms. I didn't have it in me to look anywhere, so I stayed behind with Erina and Isla.
entries.literal: "Akaro entered the cleaning room while Atsuki and Katei walked up to the closest crystal rooms. I didn't have it in me to look anywhere, so I stayed behind with Erina and Isla."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone seemed tired, stressed, and burned out. I no longer cared a single bit about what Sai could've been doing. I waited passively until the three of them returned from the rooms they'd entered.
entries.literal: "Everyone seemed tired, stressed, and burned out. I no longer cared a single bit about what Sai could've been doing. I waited passively until the three of them returned from the rooms they'd entered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, when Katei came out of room B6, I questioned my vision again.
entries.literal: "However, when Katei came out of room B6, I questioned my vision again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't hallucinating. Even though his outfit was white as well, I could see that he was holding the Sekimeiya, making little to no contrast.
entries.literal: "I wasn't hallucinating. Even though his outfit was white as well, I could see that he was holding the Sekimeiya, making little to no contrast."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell...!? This thing is seriously burning!
entries.literal: "What the hell...!? This thing is seriously burning!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked to be in pain even though his long sleeves were acting as protection for his skin.
entries.literal: "He looked to be in pain even though his long sleeves were acting as protection for his skin."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, what? Was it there?
entries.literal: "Oh, what? Was it there?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes...! It was just stashed inside one of the cabinets.
entries.literal: "Yes...! It was just stashed inside one of the cabinets."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What? How come it wasn't found before, then?
entries.literal: "What? How come it wasn't found before, then?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I have no clue!
entries.literal: "I have no clue!"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I don't either.
entries.literal: "...I don't either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki appeared sincerely confused despite being the one who'd guaranteed the entire floor was empty. Suddenly, it was confirmed the Sekimeiya hadn't been taken out of the tower. It didn't come as a revelation—I'd never managed to believe it anyway.
entries.literal: "Atsuki appeared sincerely confused despite being the one who'd guaranteed the entire floor was empty. Suddenly, it was confirmed the Sekimeiya hadn't been taken out of the tower. It didn't come as a revelation—I'd never managed to believe it anyway."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I need to leave this thing somewhere.
entries.literal: "I need to leave this thing somewhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He indicated for us to hurry into the event room. Anticipating his request, I took the keys out of my purse, failing to remember if the cabinet should've been locked or not.
entries.literal: "He indicated for us to hurry into the event room. Anticipating his request, I took the keys out of my purse, failing to remember if the cabinet should've been locked or not."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Y—! You scared the fuck out of me!{w} Holy shit! What the fuck are you doing!? You almost hit me with the door!
entries.literal: "Y—! You scared the fuck out of me!{w} Holy shit! What the fuck are you doing!? You almost hit me with the door!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Don't you think that's a better question for you? What are you doing!?
entries.literal: "Don't you think that's a better question for you? What are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm doing absolutely nothing.
entries.literal: "I'm doing absolutely nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We turned to Katei, who hadn't interrupted us. He was perplexed, staring at his empty hands.
entries.literal: "We turned to Katei, who hadn't interrupted us. He was perplexed, staring at his empty hands."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's up with you?
entries.literal: "What's up with you?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Where's the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...Where's the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What? I have no—
entries.literal: "What? I have no—"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I-It disappeared. I legitimately felt it disappear.
entries.literal: "I-It disappeared. I legitimately felt it disappear."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.literal: "Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It disappeared from my hands just as Akaro opened the door! I was holding it!
entries.literal: "It disappeared from my hands just as Akaro opened the door! I was holding it!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whoa, what? Where was it?
entries.literal: "Whoa, what? Where was it?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...It was in one of the cabinets.
entries.literal: "...It was in one of the cabinets."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did it just vanish? That's what we thought could've happened earlier, right?
entries.literal: "Did it just vanish? That's what we thought could've happened earlier, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai spun and looked at the cabinet covered by the curtain. Then, he looked all around the room with a slight frown.
entries.literal: "Sai spun and looked at the cabinet covered by the curtain. Then, he looked all around the room with a slight frown."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was also moderately puzzled. Katei couldn't have been lying. He didn't have the Sekimeiya, it wasn't on the floor, and he couldn't have hidden it anywhere without us seeing it.
entries.literal: "I was also moderately puzzled. Katei couldn't have been lying. He didn't have the Sekimeiya, it wasn't on the floor, and he couldn't have hidden it anywhere without us seeing it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did it teleport away, just like that? Is that it...?
entries.literal: "Did it teleport away, just like that? Is that it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei stretched his hands, still appearing slightly pained.
entries.literal: "Katei stretched his hands, still appearing slightly pained."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai, answer this first. What were you doing here?
entries.literal: "Sai, answer this first. What were you doing here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What do you think I was doing? Searching for the Sekimeiya! Do you think I was crazy for doubting Atsuki now?
entries.literal: "What do you think I was doing? Searching for the Sekimeiya! Do you think I was crazy for doubting Atsuki now?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}I didn't lie, though. I really didn't find the Sekimeiya when I looked for it.
entries.literal: "...{w}I didn't lie, though. I really didn't find the Sekimeiya when I looked for it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, it's great that you say that. Where the fuck is it now? Can it just be anywhere?
entries.literal: "Well, it's great that you say that. Where the fuck is it now? Can it just be anywhere?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That shouldn't be the case, right? If it actually disappeared from the mechanical room, that means it appeared in the cabinet where Katei found it. That's not a random place.
entries.literal: "That shouldn't be the case, right? If it actually disappeared from the mechanical room, that means it appeared in the cabinet where Katei found it. That's not a random place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai walked to the single cabinet in the room and drew back the curtain. All we saw was a crimson cushion with nothing on it.
entries.literal: "Sai walked to the single cabinet in the room and drew back the curtain. All we saw was a crimson cushion with nothing on it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh, can you tell that the smell disappeared too?
entries.literal: "Oh, can you tell that the smell disappeared too?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah... It did.
entries.literal: "Yeah... It did."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone sniffed the air and realized that Erina was right.
entries.literal: "Everyone sniffed the air and realized that Erina was right."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It might be gone. Did it disappear along with the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "It might be gone. Did it disappear along with the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't know if I can't notice it anymore or if my brain is playing a trick on me.
entries.literal: "I don't know if I can't notice it anymore or if my brain is playing a trick on me."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It's at least less noticeable. And yes, you and Sai weren't there, but Atsuki said a while ago that the smell might be coming from the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It's at least less noticeable. And yes, you and Sai weren't there, but Atsuki said a while ago that the smell might be coming from the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh, how bizarre.{w} Are we supposed to look for it now? What the hell. At least we know not to let Atsuki do it.
entries.literal: "Huh, how bizarre.{w} Are we supposed to look for it now? What the hell. At least we know not to let Atsuki do it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Could it have teleported to one of its previous pla—
entries.literal: "Could it have teleported to one of its previous pla—"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hey... What the fuck happened there?
entries.literal: "Hey... What the fuck happened there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki was looking at the end of the hallway, where the elevator was.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was looking at the end of the hallway, where the elevator was."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What is it?
entries.literal: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had to take one more step to see what had rightfully caught his attention.
entries.literal: "We had to take one more step to see what had rightfully caught his attention."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What!? Who did this!?
entries.literal: "What!? Who did this!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The metallic panel with the elevator button had been ripped off.
entries.literal: "The metallic panel with the elevator button had been ripped off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While Katei looked enraged, the rest were speechless. We'd been in hallway C instants earlier.
entries.literal: "While Katei looked enraged, the rest were speechless. We'd been in hallway C instants earlier."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Naomi...? It can't be, right? She's not here anymore.
entries.literal: "Naomi...? It can't be, right? She's not here anymore."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: She's not here? Are you still trusting Atsuki!?
entries.literal: "She's not here? Are you still trusting Atsuki!?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I didn't lie! Go ahead and look for her!
entries.literal: "I didn't lie! Go ahead and look for her!"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...Why would she take it off?
entries.literal: "...Why would she take it off?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Probably so we can't call the elevator, right?
entries.literal: "Probably so we can't call the elevator, right?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: But how?
entries.literal: "But how?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: How? By unscrewing it, I suppose.
entries.literal: "How? By unscrewing it, I suppose."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This was done just now. If the idea is to make us unable to use the elevator, it had to be done upstairs too. You all walked down from the attic, right? Maybe it's happening as we speak.
entries.literal: "This was done just now. If the idea is to make us unable to use the elevator, it had to be done upstairs too. You all walked down from the attic, right? Maybe it's happening as we speak."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai ran up the stairs, as the person we were up against could've been in reach.
entries.literal: "Sai ran up the stairs, as the person we were up against could've been in reach."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you serious...? What the hell is this?
entries.literal: "Are you serious...? What the hell is this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Up to the sixth floor, every panel had been taken off. We'd just walked down through every floor, so it was undoubtable that it had happened very recently.
entries.literal: "Up to the sixth floor, every panel had been taken off. We'd just walked down through every floor, so it was undoubtable that it had happened very recently."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm not even sure anymore about what I said earlier. Has the smell really faded away? I think it's still here.
entries.literal: "I'm not even sure anymore about what I said earlier. Has the smell really faded away? I think it's still here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w=0.7}Oh, give me the key.
entries.literal: "...{w=0.7}Oh, give me the key."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait, we didn't lock it, did we?
entries.literal: "Wait, we didn't lock it, did we?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're right... I forgot to tell you to lock it because I was annoyed that Sai left.
entries.literal: "You're right... I forgot to tell you to lock it because I was annoyed that Sai left."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whoa, then someone's definitely in here. Is it time to have a talk with Naomi? I wonder if she knows we can enter.
entries.literal: "Whoa, then someone's definitely in here. Is it time to have a talk with Naomi? I wonder if she knows we can enter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the keys out of my purse and unlocked the door.
entries.literal: "I took the keys out of my purse and unlocked the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The dark staircase appeared, challenging us to climb it. I was the first to open the door to the living room.
entries.literal: "The dark staircase appeared, challenging us to climb it. I was the first to open the door to the living room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Excuse me?
entries.literal: "...{w}Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: What's wrong?
entries.literal: "What's wrong?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Just look at the floor.
entries.literal: "Just look at the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced down, and so did Atsuki. As Sai had pointed out, there was one major inconsistency.
entries.literal: "I glanced down, and so did Atsuki. As Sai had pointed out, there was one major inconsistency."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Are our footprints gone?
entries.literal: "Are our footprints gone?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If you walked down, you definitely went across this carpet. These few aren't recent at all.
entries.literal: "If you walked down, you definitely went across this carpet. These few aren't recent at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Marked on the floor, traces of old footprints were discernible, but they couldn't be compared to all the ones we had left before leaving.
entries.literal: "Marked on the floor, traces of old footprints were discernible, but they couldn't be compared to all the ones we had left before leaving."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...This is impossible, right? Those marks couldn't have been erased.
entries.literal: "...This is impossible, right? Those marks couldn't have been erased."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: You're right... I don't see my footprints anywhere.
entries.literal: "You're right... I don't see my footprints anywhere."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This goes way beyond me. We need to find whoever removed the panels, and now.
entries.literal: "This goes way beyond me. We need to find whoever removed the panels, and now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We ran to the hallway, but something grabbed our attention immediately.
entries.literal: "We ran to the hallway, but something grabbed our attention immediately."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's even been taken off here?
entries.literal: "It's even been taken off here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the...
entries.literal: "What the..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei emerged from the kitchen and looked at the ridiculous state of things.
entries.literal: "Katei emerged from the kitchen and looked at the ridiculous state of things."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Why the hell would anyone do this...? We can still access every floor.
entries.literal: "Why the hell would anyone do this...? We can still access every floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I was thinking the purpose could've somehow been to prevent us from entering the attic, but it doesn't make sense if the panel was removed here as well.
entries.literal: "I was thinking the purpose could've somehow been to prevent us from entering the attic, but it doesn't make sense if the panel was removed here as well."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Naomi could be here. Let's make sure we aren't missing her.
entries.literal: "Naomi could be here. Let's make sure we aren't missing her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Most of us waited in the hallway while Atsuki, Akaro, and Sai inspected every room.
entries.literal: "Most of us waited in the hallway while Atsuki, Akaro, and Sai inspected every room."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Nobody's here.
entries.literal: "...Nobody's here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He's right this time.
entries.literal: "He's right this time."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: She's just somewhere downstairs, then.
entries.literal: "She's just somewhere downstairs, then."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's one place we definitely need to check: the storeroom. I'll see if the door was opened.{w} The Sekimeiya disappeared out of nowhere, but who knows what else happened with that; your footprints were erased from the living room.
entries.literal: "There's one place we definitely need to check: the storeroom. I'll see if the door was opened.{w} The Sekimeiya disappeared out of nowhere, but who knows what else happened with that; your footprints were erased from the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything was getting more unhinged. Somehow, the Sekimeiya hadn't been the primary layer of my thoughts, but that had to change. We had to figure out what we were in the middle of.
entries.literal: "Everything was getting more unhinged. Somehow, the Sekimeiya hadn't been the primary layer of my thoughts, but that had to change. We had to figure out what we were in the middle of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki went to the living room.
entries.literal: "Atsuki went to the living room."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: The screwdriver I saw earlier is still in one of the drawers. ...Also, am I the only one who feels like it's {tip=cold}a little cold{/tip}?
entries.literal: "The screwdriver I saw earlier is still in one of the drawers. ...Also, am I the only one who feels like it's {tip=cold}a little cold{/tip}?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Cold...?
entries.literal: "Cold...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody else seemed to relate. Exposure to the outside air had chilled my bones early in the morning, and the tower couldn't seem to warm me up well, so I hadn't noticed any change.
entries.literal: "Nobody else seemed to relate. Exposure to the outside air had chilled my bones early in the morning, and the tower couldn't seem to warm me up well, so I hadn't noticed any change."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I guess it's just me.
entries.literal: "I guess it's just me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you planning to search the whole tower again? Don't think we'll take your word for it this time.
entries.literal: "Are you planning to search the whole tower again? Don't think we'll take your word for it this time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After disregarding him, Atsuki walked to the staircase. I followed behind him, intrigued.
entries.literal: "After disregarding him, Atsuki walked to the staircase. I followed behind him, intrigued."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I want to look at the time.
entries.literal: "I want to look at the time."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Oh. Why didn't you ask Sai?
entries.literal: "...Oh. Why didn't you ask Sai?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I looked at his wristwatch, and it said it's {time=13:44.} I want to look at the computer's, though.
entries.literal: "I looked at his wristwatch, and it said it's {time=13:44.} I want to look at the computer's, though."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Do you know what could've happened with the footprints? That's so weird.
entries.literal: "Do you know what could've happened with the footprints? That's so weird."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No.
entries.literal: "No."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Not at all, really. I think looking at the time could be an indicator, though.
entries.literal: "Not at all, really. I think looking at the time could be an indicator, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: And regarding the elevator, I'm just as confused as everyone. I have no idea why anyone would want to make it so that we can't call it.
entries.literal: "And regarding the elevator, I'm just as confused as everyone. I have no idea why anyone would want to make it so that we can't call it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It seems like nobody is following us...{w} What if this was done to keep the Sekimeiya inside the elevator, for example? That's kind of flawed, because they'd have to stop the elevator between two floors and then touch the Sekimeiya to do it. But doing it like that, it'd be stuck inside, and not even the buttons would help you.{w} And even if it could be called with the buttons, we'd have to find them first. That would make the Sekimeiya simply hidden there instead.
entries.literal: "It seems like nobody is following us...{w} What if this was done to keep the Sekimeiya inside the elevator, for example? That's kind of flawed, because they'd have to stop the elevator between two floors and then touch the Sekimeiya to do it. But doing it like that, it'd be stuck inside, and not even the buttons would help you.{w} And even if it could be called with the buttons, we'd have to find them first. That would make the Sekimeiya simply hidden there instead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He sounded a little disconcerted. When he went quiet, he stayed that way, looking to be deep in thought until we were on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "He sounded a little disconcerted. When he went quiet, he stayed that way, looking to be deep in thought until we were on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I want to see if the BIOS's time matches Sai's wristwatch.
entries.literal: "I want to see if the BIOS's time matches Sai's wristwatch."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Uh...

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What...? It's locked.
entries.literal: "What...? It's locked."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Locked? Only Katei had the key for this door, right?
entries.literal: "Locked? Only Katei had the key for this door, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes. Naomi might be able to enter the attic, but as far as we know, only Katei's key can lock this one.
entries.literal: "Yes. Naomi might be able to enter the attic, but as far as we know, only Katei's key can lock this one."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Actually, no. Remember what happened?
entries.literal: "Actually, no. Remember what happened?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I found the key in one of the staircases and we came here, but the door was unlocked to begin with. Then, Katei said his key he'd left inside wasn't there...{w} We assumed it was the same one, but maybe that was wrong. Maybe there were two keys, and one belonged to another employee. I'm not really sure it's that, though. It felt to me like Katei was scanning the floor for something. That's how I found the key in the first place.
entries.literal: "I found the key in one of the staircases and we came here, but the door was unlocked to begin with. Then, Katei said his key he'd left inside wasn't there...{w} We assumed it was the same one, but maybe that was wrong. Maybe there were two keys, and one belonged to another employee. I'm not really sure it's that, though. It felt to me like Katei was scanning the floor for something. That's how I found the key in the first place."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: So...

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: The computer doesn't work. We can't do anything in the security room but look at the time through the BIOS, and it was locked after we figured that out. Maybe it was done to hide the time from us.
entries.literal: "The computer doesn't work. We can't do anything in the security room but look at the time through the BIOS, and it was locked after we figured that out. Maybe it was done to hide the time from us."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No matter which key was used, anyone could've done it. Katei left the key in the drawer, and we all saw that. It should've been as easy as going to pick it up.
entries.literal: "No matter which key was used, anyone could've done it. Katei left the key in the drawer, and we all saw that. It should've been as easy as going to pick it up."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We don't know how long the door's been locked for, though. I can't try to find a reason behind this when our fucking footprints disappeared from the attic.
entries.literal: "We don't know how long the door's been locked for, though. I can't try to find a reason behind this when our fucking footprints disappeared from the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Irritated, he walked to the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Irritated, he walked to the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As he reached the door, Sai came down the stairs.
entries.literal: "As he reached the door, Sai came down the stairs."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Have you let Naomi free already?
entries.literal: "Have you let Naomi free already?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I haven't even entered the room yet.
entries.literal: "...I haven't even entered the room yet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then hurry up.
entries.literal: "Then hurry up."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did we leave the movable wall in place?
entries.literal: "Did we leave the movable wall in place?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: No, I don't think we did.
entries.literal: "No, I don't think we did."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Amazing.
entries.literal: "Amazing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai demonstrated how to get it to open, and the hidden portion of the room stretched before our eyes.
entries.literal: "Sai demonstrated how to get it to open, and the hidden portion of the room stretched before our eyes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...It's gone.
entries.literal: "...It's gone."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What is?
entries.literal: "What is?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You know what I'm talking about. The door was opened.
entries.literal: "You know what I'm talking about. The door was opened."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Should we even trust you?
entries.literal: "Should we even trust you?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. The door was opened.
entries.literal: "Yes. The door was opened."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What that means is that whoever removed the buttons must either be Naomi or the culprit, who can open this door. That's why believing you right now isn't very smart.
entries.literal: "What that means is that whoever removed the buttons must either be Naomi or the culprit, who can open this door. That's why believing you right now isn't very smart."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Ah.
entries.literal: "Ah."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't know what your deal is, but you left the attic without saying anything, and the elevator buttons were taken off as soon as we followed you.
entries.literal: "I don't know what your deal is, but you left the attic without saying anything, and the elevator buttons were taken off as soon as we followed you."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We don't even know what this "mark" of yours on the door is. You could be lying about it to make us think that someone else entered the tower and is responsible for what happened.
entries.literal: "We don't even know what this \"mark\" of yours on the door is. You could be lying about it to make us think that someone else entered the tower and is responsible for what happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Thank you for openly voicing your suspicion, but turn around now. Both of you.
entries.literal: "Thank you for openly voicing your suspicion, but turn around now. Both of you."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Why?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So that I can leave the same mark in case it opens again. It's all we can do. Maybe we should always stay outside the storeroom.
entries.literal: "So that I can leave the same mark in case it opens again. It's all we can do. Maybe we should always stay outside the storeroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Go ahead. I won't do it until you turn around.
entries.literal: "Go ahead. I won't do it until you turn around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We faced hallway B.
entries.literal: "We faced hallway B."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Are you stupid? You can just turn around again at any second! Just go away.
entries.literal: "...Are you stupid? You can just turn around again at any second! Just go away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed and left. Outside, Akaro, Erina, and Isla were walking down the stairs.
entries.literal: "I sighed and left. Outside, Akaro, Erina, and Isla were walking down the stairs."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Is Sai here?
entries.literal: "Is Sai here?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Yes. He says that the door was opened.
entries.literal: "...Yes. He says that the door was opened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was. I just put another mark on it.
entries.literal: "It was. I just put another mark on it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Really...? We looked through every floor on the way down, and we didn't find anyone.
entries.literal: "Really...? We looked through every floor on the way down, and we didn't find anyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't foolishly doubt my memories, but if that was true... Only the crystal floor remained.
entries.literal: "I didn't foolishly doubt my memories, but if that was true... Only the crystal floor remained."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Where's Katei?
entries.literal: "Where's Katei?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I believe he stayed in the attic.
entries.literal: "I believe he stayed in the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you serious? Why would you leave him alone? Don't you remember he's very likely working with Naomi, who might have just reentered the tower?
entries.literal: "Are you serious? Why would you leave him alone? Don't you remember he's very likely working with Naomi, who might have just reentered the tower?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Unless she's already gone, there's only this floor left. The Sekimeiya has to be found as well.
entries.literal: "Unless she's already gone, there's only this floor left. The Sekimeiya has to be found as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki entered room A4. We saw him opening up the cabinets and inspecting their interiors.
entries.literal: "Atsuki entered room A4. We saw him opening up the cabinets and inspecting their interiors."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Does he still think we'll believe him?
entries.literal: "Does he still think we'll believe him?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if a recording of the past were replaying, while we stared in silence, Atsuki kept silently moving.
entries.literal: "As if a recording of the past were replaying, while we stared in silence, Atsuki kept silently moving."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The doors...
entries.literal: "The doors..."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: They're all closed.
entries.literal: "They're all closed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wait, y-you're right...!{w} I left some of them open, didn't I?
entries.literal: "Wait, y-you're right...!{w} I left some of them open, didn't I?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, yes... Some of them were open.
entries.literal: "Oh, yes... Some of them were open."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Honestly, I think they were already like this when we left the event room.
entries.literal: "Honestly, I think they were already like this when we left the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We could only be dumbfounded as we followed Atsuki's mesmerizing movements. Something had happened around us, but it felt absurd to think we could know what. Atsuki backtracked toward the elevator and entered the room with the missing gems.
entries.literal: "We could only be dumbfounded as we followed Atsuki's mesmerizing movements. Something had happened around us, but it felt absurd to think we could know what. Atsuki backtracked toward the elevator and entered the room with the missing gems."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The second time Atsuki came out of a room, he had the Sekimeiya between his hands. It had been in room A5.
entries.literal: "The second time Atsuki came out of a room, he had the Sekimeiya between his hands. It had been in room A5."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, shit, where was it?
entries.literal: "Oh, shit, where was it?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Like Katei said, inside a cabinet.
entries.literal: "Like Katei said, inside a cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is that where it teleported to...?
entries.literal: "Is that where it teleported to...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hold on, is this normal?{w} Katei said it was burning when he was holding it, and it was hot when I had it too. Now it's not, though.
entries.literal: "Hold on, is this normal?{w} Katei said it was burning when he was holding it, and it was hot when I had it too. Now it's not, though."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Maybe it's not gonna do anything if you touch it now?
entries.literal: "Maybe it's not gonna do anything if you touch it now?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You could try it.
entries.literal: "You could try it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}I'd rather not. Let's leave it in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "...{w}I'd rather not. Let's leave it in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Can I touch it?
entries.literal: "Can I touch it?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What? That's not safe, Isla.
entries.literal: "What? That's not safe, Isla."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: But now it should be fine, right?
entries.literal: "But now it should be fine, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla had been fairly quiet the entire time we'd been trapped, but I could see that some of her unease had receded. She was just a girl who wanted to see an exhibit.
entries.literal: "Isla had been fairly quiet the entire time we'd been trapped, but I could see that some of her unease had receded. She was just a girl who wanted to see an exhibit."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm sorry, but I think touching it could be a pretty bad idea. It's, um... Your mom is right.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry, but I think touching it could be a pretty bad idea. It's, um... Your mom is right."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm. Okay...
entries.literal: "Hm. Okay..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She seemed a bit disappointed but gave up. Atsuki was free to go to the event room, so we all entered after him.
entries.literal: "She seemed a bit disappointed but gave up. Atsuki was free to go to the event room, so we all entered after him."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...The cabinet's not locked.
entries.literal: "...The cabinet's not locked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After scrolling open the glass, he placed the Sekimeiya inside and shut it again.
entries.literal: "After scrolling open the glass, he placed the Sekimeiya inside and shut it again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once the glass separated it, Atsuki stood without facing us. We awkwardly waited behind him, thinking he had something to say, but all he ultimately did was lock the cabinet manually.
entries.literal: "Once the glass separated it, Atsuki stood without facing us. We awkwardly waited behind him, thinking he had something to say, but all he ultimately did was lock the cabinet manually."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Katei's there.
entries.literal: "Katei's there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked through the door and saw him by the stairs, looking lost.
entries.literal: "We looked through the door and saw him by the stairs, looking lost."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Here you are!
entries.literal: "Here you are!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: We found the Sekimeiya in that room. It's in the cabinet now.
entries.literal: "We found the Sekimeiya in that room. It's in the cabinet now."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, that's good. It didn't disappear this time?
entries.literal: "Oh, that's good. It didn't disappear this time?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No, and I have a question. Where's the key to the security room?
entries.literal: "No, and I have a question. Where's the key to the security room?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That one...? I left it in the drawer next to the computer. You all saw it.
entries.literal: "That one...? I left it in the drawer next to the computer. You all saw it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's what I thought. The security room is locked.
entries.literal: "That's what I thought. The security room is locked."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Locked...?
entries.literal: "Locked...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How do you know?
entries.literal: "How do you know?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Because I couldn't open the door?
entries.literal: "Because I couldn't open the door?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}But when I got here, you were in front of the storeroom. Does that mean you'd already tried to open the security room? Why was that your priority?
entries.literal: "...{w}But when I got here, you were in front of the storeroom. Does that mean you'd already tried to open the security room? Why was that your priority?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai walked to the door and confirmed that it couldn't be opened.
entries.literal: "Sai walked to the door and confirmed that it couldn't be opened."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I wanted to look at the time. I thought that maybe the computer had started working again.
entries.literal: "I wanted to look at the time. I thought that maybe the computer had started working again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Because our footprints disappeared? I'm not sure I follow that logic. Anyway, it's {time=13:50.}
entries.literal: "Because our footprints disappeared? I'm not sure I follow that logic. Anyway, it's {time=13:50.}"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: W-Wait just a minute. Why would the security room be locked?
entries.literal: "W-Wait just a minute. Why would the security room be locked?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Anyone could've taken the key from the drawer. We all saw where you left it.
entries.literal: "Anyone could've taken the key from the drawer. We all saw where you left it."

entries.speaker: sai
