entries.text: What if someone's hiding inside?{w} Naomi...? Mind coming out?
entries.literal: "What if someone's hiding inside?{w} Naomi...? Mind coming out?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I can't see anything through these gaps, but I mean, Katei's got a point; why would anyone lock this room?{w} The computer doesn't work, so unless it was done to prevent us from fixing it, I can't think of much else. There aren't that many more rooms to lock yourself up in. I can think of the bathrooms and the bedrooms, but I'm sure you'd feel much more secure behind this sturdy door.
entries.literal: "I can't see anything through these gaps, but I mean, Katei's got a point; why would anyone lock this room?{w} The computer doesn't work, so unless it was done to prevent us from fixing it, I can't think of much else. There aren't that many more rooms to lock yourself up in. I can think of the bathrooms and the bedrooms, but I'm sure you'd feel much more secure behind this sturdy door."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell do we do, then?
entries.literal: "What the hell do we do, then?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The Sekimeiya's in the cabinet, so unless it teleports itself to the security room, anyone in there is gonna have to come out eventually.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya's in the cabinet, so unless it teleports itself to the security room, anyone in there is gonna have to come out eventually."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait.{w} Is it me, or are we very stupid?
entries.literal: "Wait.{w} Is it me, or are we very stupid?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Likely you.
entries.literal: "Likely you."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I just thought that the elevator would work as a place to hide in as well, but we haven't even tried to open it on every floor. Even though we can't call it, as long as it's not stuck between two floors, we should be able to open the door of the floor it's on.
entries.literal: "I just thought that the elevator would work as a place to hide in as well, but we haven't even tried to open it on every floor. Even though we can't call it, as long as it's not stuck between two floors, we should be able to open the door of the floor it's on."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: As expected, it's you. I tried that when I came down, and no doors opened.
entries.literal: "As expected, it's you. I tried that when I came down, and no doors opened."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}You haven't, though. At least not on this floor.
entries.literal: "...{w}You haven't, though. At least not on this floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm, you're right. I saw you in front of the storeroom and it slipped my mind.
entries.literal: "Hm, you're right. I saw you in front of the storeroom and it slipped my mind."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...And the elevator should be here, right? Were we the last ones to use it? If so, we got off on this floor.
entries.literal: "...And the elevator should be here, right? Were we the last ones to use it? If so, we got off on this floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As Atsuki gripped the handle, I noticed that the door was closed. He had previously left it open to disable the elevator before searching through the higher floors.{w} When he tugged on it, the door didn't budge.
entries.literal: "As Atsuki gripped the handle, I noticed that the door was closed. He had previously left it open to disable the elevator before searching through the higher floors.{w} When he tugged on it, the door didn't budge."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Is it not on any floor, then? I suppose it could've moved.
entries.literal: "Is it not on any floor, then? I suppose it could've moved."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, I thought of this when I was walking down, so I didn't try to open it in the attic either. Did anyone?
entries.literal: "Well, I thought of this when I was walking down, so I didn't try to open it in the attic either. Did anyone?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei, Akaro, and Erina all shook their heads.
entries.literal: "Katei, Akaro, and Erina all shook their heads."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isla?
entries.literal: "Isla?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No... I didn't.
entries.literal: "No... I didn't."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It would make sense if it was left there since the attic was locked. It didn't occur to us to open it because the button had been removed there as well.
entries.literal: "It would make sense if it was left there since the attic was locked. It didn't occur to us to open it because the button had been removed there as well."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh. Maybe we are stupid.
entries.literal: "Huh. Maybe we are stupid."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I think it's very likely it is there. I have no idea what the purpose of this was, but we can access every floor. Even though it doesn't make a ton of sense, the reason behind removing all the panels could be to hide something in the elevator.
entries.literal: "I think it's very likely it is there. I have no idea what the purpose of this was, but we can access every floor. Even though it doesn't make a ton of sense, the reason behind removing all the panels could be to hide something in the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As we were going up the stairs, we noticed Akaro staring at the wires coming out of the wall.
entries.literal: "As we were going up the stairs, we noticed Akaro staring at the wires coming out of the wall."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's up?
entries.literal: "What's up?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I was just thinking that we should still be able to call the elevator if we cross two of these together. Katei, do you know what each wire is for?
entries.literal: "I was just thinking that we should still be able to call the elevator if we cross two of these together. Katei, do you know what each wire is for?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...No, but it's not going to—
entries.literal: "...No, but it's not going to—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei cut himself off, and at that moment, his look changed.
entries.literal: "Katei cut himself off, and at that moment, his look changed."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This elevator underwent maintenance a few times. We installed the stop button while aware Xyn could try using it for their plans, and I just remembered something the technician told me.
entries.literal: "This elevator underwent maintenance a few times. We installed the stop button while aware Xyn could try using it for their plans, and I just remembered something the technician told me."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The elevator measures a resistance in the panel. If the circuit is open or the resistance isn't correct, the other lines are deactivated as a safety measure. This was, of course, another measure against Xyn.
entries.literal: "The elevator measures a resistance in the panel. If the circuit is open or the resistance isn't correct, the other lines are deactivated as a safety measure. This was, of course, another measure against Xyn."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Crossing the wires won't work, but something is bothering me. If the intent was to disable the elevator, the culprit should have pushed the wires into the wall. But since they're sticking out, it feels like the culprit knows they're disabled.
entries.literal: "Crossing the wires won't work, but something is bothering me. If the intent was to disable the elevator, the culprit should have pushed the wires into the wall. But since they're sticking out, it feels like the culprit knows they're disabled."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Does anyone else know about this feature?
entries.literal: "...Does anyone else know about this feature?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I doubt it. The technician gave me the exact details when he was installing it months ago, but it was on a Sunday when the tower was closed. I have no idea who could have overheard.
entries.literal: "I doubt it. The technician gave me the exact details when he was installing it months ago, but it was on a Sunday when the tower was closed. I have no idea who could have overheard."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Akaro attempted to cross the wires, but nothing happened.
entries.literal: "...{w}Akaro attempted to cross the wires, but nothing happened."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: This isn't normal. Katei is right, anyone with any electrical knowledge would've pushed the wires into the wall.
entries.literal: "This isn't normal. Katei is right, anyone with any electrical knowledge would've pushed the wires into the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...What was the purpose behind it? That question drove us to run back up, hoping to make sense of what was occurring. Stepping up the stairs, I almost gagged at the sight of the walls surrounding me. I hated that damn building, and I no longer put any effort into repressing the deep, exasperated sigh that I let out.
entries.literal: "...What was the purpose behind it? That question drove us to run back up, hoping to make sense of what was occurring. Stepping up the stairs, I almost gagged at the sight of the walls surrounding me. I hated that damn building, and I no longer put any effort into repressing the deep, exasperated sigh that I let out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=1.3}We all stared at the door in shock. It was locked.
entries.literal: "{w=1.3}We all stared at the door in shock. It was locked."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Someone else is certainly in this building. I left the attic just now.
entries.literal: "Someone else is certainly in this building. I left the attic just now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the keys out.
entries.literal: "I took the keys out."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You mean that someone locked it while we were downstairs? Weren't all the floors inspected?
entries.literal: "You mean that someone locked it while we were downstairs? Weren't all the floors inspected?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Maybe Atsuki was right. What if someone was in the elevator and got out as soon as I left? The inner buttons should still work.
entries.literal: "Maybe Atsuki was right. What if someone was in the elevator and got out as soon as I left? The inner buttons should still work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I inserted the bronze key in the keyhole and turned it counterclockwise.
entries.literal: "I inserted the bronze key in the keyhole and turned it counterclockwise."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Huh? ...I can't unlock it.
entries.literal: "Huh? ...I can't unlock it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? How is that possible?
entries.literal: "What? How is that possible?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He took the key and tried it himself.
entries.literal: "He took the key and tried it himself."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wh-Wh...!?{w=0.5} It won't open!
entries.literal: "Wh-Wh...!?{w=0.5} It won't open!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Flustered, everyone gave it a shot, but the outcome didn't change. The key wasn't affecting the lock.
entries.literal: "Flustered, everyone gave it a shot, but the outcome didn't change. The key wasn't affecting the lock."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, show us what you have on you. This is long overdue.
entries.literal: "Katei, show us what you have on you. This is long overdue."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Can you stop with that? You were the last to leave the attic, and I have more than one reason to believe you might still have the key to enter it. Go ahead and show us that you don't.
entries.literal: "Can you stop with that? You were the last to leave the attic, and I have more than one reason to believe you might still have the key to enter it. Go ahead and show us that you don't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a disappointed look, he conceded and showed us the contents of all his pockets. Then, Sai inspected him more closely and confirmed he wasn't hiding anything else.
entries.literal: "After a disappointed look, he conceded and showed us the contents of all his pockets. Then, Sai inspected him more closely and confirmed he wasn't hiding anything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In one of Katei's deep pockets, two keys were found, which we recalled seeing in the past. According to him, they opened his locker in the staff room and the door between the first two floors.
entries.literal: "In one of Katei's deep pockets, two keys were found, which we recalled seeing in the past. According to him, they opened his locker in the staff room and the door between the first two floors."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I hope you're content. I'm not even sure a key was used to lock this door, or else we could open it.
entries.literal: "I hope you're content. I'm not even sure a key was used to lock this door, or else we could open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The set of keys I'd had before ended up rotating back to me, so I stored it away again.
entries.literal: "The set of keys I'd had before ended up rotating back to me, so I stored it away again."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: This is insane, then! How are we supposed to get in here?{w} Is Naomi really in the attic? How does she keep doing this!?
entries.literal: "This is insane, then! How are we supposed to get in here?{w} Is Naomi really in the attic? How does she keep doing this!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It could easily be any person in the world since the storeroom door was opened.
entries.literal: "It could easily be any person in the world since the storeroom door was opened."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What? It was?
entries.literal: "What? It was?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, I checked, and my mark had disappeared.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I checked, and my mark had disappeared."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We can do one thing aside from thoroughly searching the places we can access yet again. We can try to open every elevator door.
entries.literal: "We can do one thing aside from thoroughly searching the places we can access yet again. We can try to open every elevator door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Have I not said that I've already done that?
entries.literal: "...Have I not said that I've already done that?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yeah. You said you'd forgotten to check the crystal floor's, but I can think of two reasons for that to be a lie.
entries.literal: "Yeah. You said you'd forgotten to check the crystal floor's, but I can think of two reasons for that to be a lie."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: One, you wanted to keep the idea of checking them to yourself.{w} Two, one of the previous doors had already opened, so you had no reason to keep checking them after that.
entries.literal: "One, you wanted to keep the idea of checking them to yourself.{w} Two, one of the previous doors had already opened, so you had no reason to keep checking them after that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh*{w} Okay, sure. If there's currently someone in the attic, they might want to take the elevator down and back up at some point, so it's not a bad idea to keep confirming that it can't be accessed.
entries.literal: "*sigh*{w} Okay, sure. If there's currently someone in the attic, they might want to take the elevator down and back up at some point, so it's not a bad idea to keep confirming that it can't be accessed."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Would we hear it if it was used?
entries.literal: "Would we hear it if it was used?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. It does make an audible sound.
entries.literal: "Yes. It does make an audible sound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone looked drained. With what little energy we had left, we circled around the floor.
entries.literal: "Everyone looked drained. With what little energy we had left, we circled around the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki grabbed the handle of the elevator and tried to open it.
entries.literal: "Atsuki grabbed the handle of the elevator and tried to open it."

entries.text: Systemic Toxin
entries.literal: "Systemic Toxin"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart shrank. When Atsuki's eyes met the interior, his body became rock solid. What we saw paralyzed him on the spot, his raspy breathing the only part of him not immobilized.
entries.literal: "My heart shrank. When Atsuki's eyes met the interior, his body became rock solid. What we saw paralyzed him on the spot, his raspy breathing the only part of him not immobilized."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm...? Who is she?
entries.literal: "Hm...? Who is she?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Stop!
entries.literal: "Stop!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina pulled Isla into the stairwell, crouching down and speaking to her softly.
entries.literal: "Erina pulled Isla into the stairwell, crouching down and speaking to her softly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Not everyone knew they were witnessing a sight that defied reason. However, the way the two of us looked might have told them enough.
entries.literal: "Not everyone knew they were witnessing a sight that defied reason. However, the way the two of us looked might have told them enough."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It's her...
entries.literal: "It's her..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: She really was here, but...
entries.literal: "She really was here, but..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two bodies lay on the floor of the elevator. Buried in the back was Naomi, and next to her were all the elevator buttons and panels, piled up together.
entries.literal: "Two bodies lay on the floor of the elevator. Buried in the back was Naomi, and next to her were all the elevator buttons and panels, piled up together."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Are they dead?
entries.literal: "...Are they dead?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immediately, Atsuki crouched. He softly grabbed an arm and pressed his finger to its wrist.{w} His own arm lost its strength and released its grip.
entries.literal: "Immediately, Atsuki crouched. He softly grabbed an arm and pressed his finger to its wrist.{w} His own arm lost its strength and released its grip."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Does he know her...?
entries.literal: "Does he know her...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded.
entries.literal: "I nodded."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: W-Wait... isn't she the girl who died... a few days ago?
entries.literal: "W-Wait... isn't she the girl who died... a few days ago?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes...! I remember her face from the news.
entries.literal: "Yes...! I remember her face from the news."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How do you know her?
entries.literal: "How do you know her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "...She's an old friend of ours." I almost said that, but I kept it in.
entries.literal: "\"...She's an old friend of ours.\" I almost said that, but I kept it in."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, what the fuck...? What is she doing here?
entries.literal: "Well, what the fuck...? What is she doing here?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So Atsuki's plan will... fail?
entries.literal: "So Atsuki's plan will... fail?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Will he manage to save her, but she'll die again...?
entries.literal: "Will he manage to save her, but she'll die again...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: No, what the hell is this even about? How could she have been saved? The past wasn't changed, was it? I still remember everything as it happened.
entries.literal: "No, what the hell is this even about? How could she have been saved? The past wasn't changed, was it? I still remember everything as it happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I staggered forward and slowly reached for the arm Atsuki had dropped.
entries.literal: "I staggered forward and slowly reached for the arm Atsuki had dropped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no pulse. Despite that, no part of her body indicated what had happened.
entries.literal: "There was no pulse. Despite that, no part of her body indicated what had happened."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Her body wasn't found, right?
entries.literal: "...Her body wasn't found, right?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Oh...! This is how.
entries.literal: "Oh...! This is how."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I bet this is what Atsuki's idea was. He was wondering whether the past could be changed or not.
entries.literal: "I bet this is what Atsuki's idea was. He was wondering whether the past could be changed or not."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Without changing the past, he still had a shot at saving her. By going to the 30th and taking her away before the explosion.
entries.literal: "Without changing the past, he still had a shot at saving her. By going to the 30th and taking her away before the explosion."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Simply because her body wasn't found.
entries.literal: "...Simply because her body wasn't found."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Does this mean that he'll still do it? Even though he's seen that she'll die anyway? But we already verified that the past could be changed, so why would he do it like this?
entries.literal: "Does this mean that he'll still do it? Even though he's seen that she'll die anyway? But we already verified that the past could be changed, so why would he do it like this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody had words to interrupt the tragic scene. I stood up slowly and rubbed my eyes.
entries.literal: "Nobody had words to interrupt the tragic scene. I stood up slowly and rubbed my eyes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...There's a little blood on the back of Naomi's head, forming that puddle. That's definitely a wound.
entries.literal: "...There's a little blood on the back of Naomi's head, forming that puddle. That's definitely a wound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The questions didn't end there. We'd finally found Naomi, but she wouldn't be able to answer anything for us.
entries.literal: "The questions didn't end there. We'd finally found Naomi, but she wouldn't be able to answer anything for us."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I apologize for asking this, but is it possible she has a phone on her?
entries.literal: "I apologize for asking this, but is it possible she has a phone on her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Awaiting any response, we looked at Atsuki. Facing away, I assumed he had some kind of focused expression, but the instant I caught a glimpse, I realized that was far from the truth. He looked broken and unresponsive all over again, forced to experience the same death a second time.
entries.literal: "Awaiting any response, we looked at Atsuki. Facing away, I assumed he had some kind of focused expression, but the instant I caught a glimpse, I realized that was far from the truth. He looked broken and unresponsive all over again, forced to experience the same death a second time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Can I look?
entries.literal: "...Can I look?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai, you said you tried to open this door.
entries.literal: "Sai, you said you tried to open this door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And I did. A few minutes ago, the elevator wasn't here. It must've been in the attic and got brought down just one floor so nobody heard it.
entries.literal: "And I did. A few minutes ago, the elevator wasn't here. It must've been in the attic and got brought down just one floor so nobody heard it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are we supposed to believe that?
entries.literal: "Are we supposed to believe that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course? Someone just locked the attic as well, right? We're still missing the person who did this.{w} Someone killed Naomi. I have no idea what happened to this girl, but look behind Naomi's head and at the blood on the floor. Most of it is dry. She's been dead for a while; it wasn't her we were looking for.
entries.literal: "Of course? Someone just locked the attic as well, right? We're still missing the person who did this.{w} Someone killed Naomi. I have no idea what happened to this girl, but look behind Naomi's head and at the blood on the floor. Most of it is dry. She's been dead for a while; it wasn't her we were looking for."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: But why would anyone kill them?
entries.literal: "But why would anyone kill them?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How the fuck would I know? Killing Naomi can have the same motive as the policeman—just because her presence was a potential threat. But this girl...? Knowing why she was killed is far from the main question.
entries.literal: "How the fuck would I know? Killing Naomi can have the same motive as the policeman—just because her presence was a potential threat. But this girl...? Knowing why she was killed is far from the main question."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, are you responsible for this? We know she died, but her body would look much worse if she'd been dead for days. Did you do something to bring her here?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, are you responsible for this? We know she died, but her body would look much worse if she'd been dead for days. Did you do something to bring her here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surprisingly, Atsuki shook his head very slowly.
entries.literal: "Surprisingly, Atsuki shook his head very slowly."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No? You both know her, so there's no way her appearance isn't related to you. If someone got into the tower through the storeroom, could it be her?
entries.literal: "No? You both know her, so there's no way her appearance isn't related to you. If someone got into the tower through the storeroom, could it be her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That time, there was no reaction.
entries.literal: "That time, there was no reaction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai stepped forward and kneeled next to Atsuki. The first thing he did was check whether the body was truly dead.
entries.literal: "Sai stepped forward and kneeled next to Atsuki. The first thing he did was check whether the body was truly dead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, he went from pocket to pocket while Atsuki observed his movements. It didn't take long to confirm she wasn't holding anything.
entries.literal: "Then, he went from pocket to pocket while Atsuki observed his movements. It didn't take long to confirm she wasn't holding anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, he leaned forward. The spotlight wasn't on Naomi, but she might have had something important.
entries.literal: "Next, he leaned forward. The spotlight wasn't on Naomi, but she might have had something important."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And she did. The inspection finished with a single result: a key that she had in her pocket.
entries.literal: "And she did. The inspection finished with a single result: a key that she had in her pocket."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's the attic's.
entries.literal: "It's the attic's."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: So it won't be any use. We already have it, and the attic is still inaccessible.
entries.literal: "So it won't be any use. We already have it, and the attic is still inaccessible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the hell are you talking about? We can take the elevator up with the key.
entries.literal: "What the hell are you talking about? We can take the elevator up with the key."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: O-Oh! I completely ignored that.{w} ...Also, what I told you earlier was true. Naomi did have another copy of the keys.
entries.literal: "O-Oh! I completely ignored that.{w} ...Also, what I told you earlier was true. Naomi did have another copy of the keys."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The others aren't here, though. It's not the whole set.
entries.literal: "The others aren't here, though. It's not the whole set."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Did they get separated?
entries.literal: "Did they get separated?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We need to go to the attic. I don't know why the elevator was brought down, but the real culprit might be right above us.
entries.literal: "We need to go to the attic. I don't know why the elevator was brought down, but the real culprit might be right above us."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Wait... we can't take the elevator with them inside.
entries.literal: "Wait... we can't take the elevator with them inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: At least one of us can.
entries.literal: "At least one of us can."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: That's not what I mean... We should take them out. They can't be inside an elevator until the police come.
entries.literal: "That's not what I mean... We should take them out. They can't be inside an elevator until the police come."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And that takes priority?
entries.literal: "And that takes priority?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Of course!
entries.literal: "Of course!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She's right. They should be taken to the lobby so that they're seen immediately when the door opens.
entries.literal: "She's right. They should be taken to the lobby so that they're seen immediately when the door opens."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina had gone a few stairs down with Isla, but she'd clearly been listening to every word.
entries.literal: "Erina had gone a few stairs down with Isla, but she'd clearly been listening to every word."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isn't that irresponsible? We're disrupting the scene.
entries.literal: "Isn't that irresponsible? We're disrupting the scene."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Sai, they're right. Using the elevator would disrupt the scene as well, and I find it very unlikely they both died inside it.
entries.literal: "Sai, they're right. Using the elevator would disrupt the scene as well, and I find it very unlikely they both died inside it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you agree with this, Atsuki?
entries.literal: "Do you agree with this, Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It looked like he nodded as he stood up. Before anyone could interfere further, he pressed the floor 1 button and stepped aside to let the door close.
entries.literal: "It looked like he nodded as he stood up. Before anyone could interfere further, he pressed the floor 1 button and stepped aside to let the door close."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, without letting anyone see his face, he walked down the stairs.
entries.literal: "Then, without letting anyone see his face, he walked down the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina seemed like she was going to say something to us, but she kept it to herself. Behind her legs, Isla stared with wide eyes.
entries.literal: "Erina seemed like she was going to say something to us, but she kept it to herself. Behind her legs, Isla stared with wide eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro opened the elevator on the crystal floor, and the same deathly image was reiterated. Then, my reaction was similar to the first time I'd seen a dead body.
entries.literal: "Akaro opened the elevator on the crystal floor, and the same deathly image was reiterated. Then, my reaction was similar to the first time I'd seen a dead body."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were really dead, but their corpses seemed as sterile as dolls. Nothing outwardly indicated their deaths. There was no smell and no substance; despite how tragic it was, the scene itself felt underwhelming.
entries.literal: "They were really dead, but their corpses seemed as sterile as dolls. Nothing outwardly indicated their deaths. There was no smell and no substance; despite how tragic it was, the scene itself felt underwhelming."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a long breath, Akaro grabbed the first body, making it look very light. When I looked at her face properly, I saw how much paler she was than normal. She was definitely dead, but I couldn't even see a trace of blood.
entries.literal: "After a long breath, Akaro grabbed the first body, making it look very light. When I looked at her face properly, I saw how much paler she was than normal. She was definitely dead, but I couldn't even see a trace of blood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody was going to lift the other one, so we stood in place while Akaro went and came back from the lobby. Quietly, he bent down to pick up Naomi and brought her there, the closest we could get to the outside world.
entries.literal: "Nobody was going to lift the other one, so we stood in place while Akaro went and came back from the lobby. Quietly, he bent down to pick up Naomi and brought her there, the closest we could get to the outside world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Inside the elevator, only remnants of blood, buttons inside their covers, and scattered screws remained.
entries.literal: "Inside the elevator, only remnants of blood, buttons inside their covers, and scattered screws remained."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Does anyone want to come to the attic?
entries.literal: "Does anyone want to come to the attic?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I will.
entries.literal: "I will."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody else answered, so both of them stepped into the elevator, dodging the tiny pool that had formed below Naomi's head. Sai still had the attic key and inserted it to enable the floor 7 button.
entries.literal: "Nobody else answered, so both of them stepped into the elevator, dodging the tiny pool that had formed below Naomi's head. Sai still had the attic key and inserted it to enable the floor 7 button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They closed the door and let the elevator bring them to the attic, the place the person we were searching for had sealed off.{w} I turned back and saw Atsuki walking to the lobby.
entries.literal: "They closed the door and let the elevator bring them to the attic, the place the person we were searching for had sealed off.{w} I turned back and saw Atsuki walking to the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was what it seemed like at first, anyway. On the way, he made a turn and entered the event room.
entries.literal: "That was what it seemed like at first, anyway. On the way, he made a turn and entered the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still being kept in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was still being kept in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Give me the key.
entries.literal: "...Give me the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, nothing had ended yet. The Sekimeiya had the power to change the past and additionally allow us to learn what had happened. I took the keyring out and personally unlocked the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Of course, nothing had ended yet. The Sekimeiya had the power to change the past and additionally allow us to learn what had happened. I took the keyring out and personally unlocked the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He grabbed the cushion and placed it on top of the cabinet.
entries.literal: "He grabbed the cushion and placed it on top of the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From hallway A, Akaro and Erina looked at him without being able to say anything. For a while, Atsuki stared at the gemstone.
entries.literal: "From hallway A, Akaro and Erina looked at him without being able to say anything. For a while, Atsuki stared at the gemstone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But he didn't wait long. Just a couple minutes later, he reached forward and placed his left hand on it.
entries.literal: "But he didn't wait long. Just a couple minutes later, he reached forward and placed his left hand on it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...It's still not working...!{w} Wh-Why not? I'm doing the same thing.
entries.literal: "...It's still not working...!{w} Wh-Why not? I'm doing the same thing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Right. When we'd put it in the cabinet, the Sekimeiya hadn't been working. That issue persisted.
entries.literal: "Right. When we'd put it in the cabinet, the Sekimeiya hadn't been working. That issue persisted."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's just cold...
entries.literal: "It's just cold..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He glanced back and saw that the two people who'd gone to the attic hadn't returned. After a pause, he placed the cushion back inside the cabinet.
entries.literal: "He glanced back and saw that the two people who'd gone to the attic hadn't returned. After a pause, he placed the cushion back inside the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Interestingly, like the previous time, he stood in front of it for a while before turning the manual arrow.
entries.literal: "Interestingly, like the previous time, he stood in front of it for a while before turning the manual arrow."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: They're back, coming from the stairs.
entries.literal: "They're back, coming from the stairs."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you try to use the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Did you try to use the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Nothing in the attic?
entries.literal: "Nothing in the attic?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: There wasn't anyone. We only found this.
entries.literal: "There wasn't anyone. We only found this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In his hand was the key to the attic.
entries.literal: "In his hand was the key to the attic."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: This isn't the one that Naomi had. There was another one inserted in the inner lock of the door. That's why we couldn't open it from the outside.
entries.literal: "This isn't the one that Naomi had. There was another one inserted in the inner lock of the door. That's why we couldn't open it from the outside."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What? Another one?
entries.literal: "What? Another one?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, a third one which shouldn't exist.
entries.literal: "Yes, a third one which shouldn't exist."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm glad you brought that up, because I can now point out how that doesn't make sense. You're saying a third one shouldn't exist, but your keyring was supposed to have one, right? Are you and Naomi the only people with this key?
entries.literal: "I'm glad you brought that up, because I can now point out how that doesn't make sense. You're saying a third one shouldn't exist, but your keyring was supposed to have one, right? Are you and Naomi the only people with this key?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Correct. We're the only ones that I'm aware of.
entries.literal: "...Correct. We're the only ones that I'm aware of."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me remind you, I tried to open the elevator doors, and none of them opened. While the culprit could be someone who left and entered the tower, it's possible the people who came in through the storeroom were only the three victims, whose presences were harmful to the killer. Four of you were still in the attic when I went down.
entries.literal: "Let me remind you, I tried to open the elevator doors, and none of them opened. While the culprit could be someone who left and entered the tower, it's possible the people who came in through the storeroom were only the three victims, whose presences were harmful to the killer. Four of you were still in the attic when I went down."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Are you seriously accusing us of this?
entries.literal: "...Are you seriously accusing us of this?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not accusing anyone, but there weren't traces of anyone else in the attic, and the Sekimeiya is still here. It's moronic to pretend that none of you could move the elevator after I tried to open it.
entries.literal: "I'm not accusing anyone, but there weren't traces of anyone else in the attic, and the Sekimeiya is still here. It's moronic to pretend that none of you could move the elevator after I tried to open it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Then, likewise, it's very stupid to simply believe you! You wrongly claimed that no door had opened. You could've easily done that so that we wouldn't check them.
entries.literal: "Then, likewise, it's very stupid to simply believe you! You wrongly claimed that no door had opened. You could've easily done that so that we wouldn't check them."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm going up.
entries.literal: "I'm going up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now you want to?
entries.literal: "Now you want to?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After ignoring Sai again, Atsuki walked to the staircase. As soon as we saw he wasn't going to take the elevator, the rest of us followed behind.
entries.literal: "After ignoring Sai again, Atsuki walked to the staircase. As soon as we saw he wasn't going to take the elevator, the rest of us followed behind."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did you lock the door on your way down?
entries.literal: "Did you lock the door on your way down?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei inserted the single key and got the door to open. Atsuki didn't waste time before going up the stairs.
entries.literal: "Katei inserted the single key and got the door to open. Atsuki didn't waste time before going up the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's and Katei's footprints were still visible, so we stepped directly inside of them. I figured Atsuki wanted to see the state of the attic for himself, as he went ahead to the hallway.
entries.literal: "Sai's and Katei's footprints were still visible, so we stepped directly inside of them. I figured Atsuki wanted to see the state of the attic for himself, as he went ahead to the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The people who hadn't taken the elevator dispersed through the rooms, and each verified that nothing stood out.
entries.literal: "The people who hadn't taken the elevator dispersed through the rooms, and each verified that nothing stood out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the end, everyone ended up scattered through the floor. Erina and Isla sat on the sofa, Atsuki stood in the staircase, and the others remained in the right bedroom. Sai was sitting in front of the elevator, seemingly lost in thought. For many reasons, the mood was dark, and it was really burning me out.
entries.literal: "In the end, everyone ended up scattered through the floor. Erina and Isla sat on the sofa, Atsuki stood in the staircase, and the others remained in the right bedroom. Sai was sitting in front of the elevator, seemingly lost in thought. For many reasons, the mood was dark, and it was really burning me out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the bedrooms and opened the left one. I needed to throw myself onto the bed and be alone for some time.
entries.literal: "I walked to the bedrooms and opened the left one. I needed to throw myself onto the bed and be alone for some time."

entries.text: 30 Minutes Later
entries.literal: "30 Minutes Later"

entries.text: Crossover
entries.literal: "Crossover"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood in the middle of the floor 3 corridor. I didn't want to see the others, so I'd been thinking to myself.
entries.literal: "I stood in the middle of the floor 3 corridor. I didn't want to see the others, so I'd been thinking to myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As anyone could've been anywhere, all I wanted was to wait. I could perceive faint footsteps above me, signaling someone was on the fourth floor.
entries.literal: "As anyone could've been anywhere, all I wanted was to wait. I could perceive faint footsteps above me, signaling someone was on the fourth floor."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Are they gonna come?
entries.literal: "...Are they gonna come?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached a potted plant and sat next to it. I calmly felt the seconds pass, appreciating the sensation.
entries.literal: "I approached a potted plant and sat next to it. I calmly felt the seconds pass, appreciating the sensation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When someone finally arrived, it was from the staircase leading down. ...Atsuki.
entries.literal: "When someone finally arrived, it was from the staircase leading down. ...Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He jogged up to me, looking anxious and disturbed.
entries.literal: "He jogged up to me, looking anxious and disturbed."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: A-Are you alone...!? Where are the others?
entries.literal: "A-Are you alone...!? Where are the others?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...I am, and I don't know. What happened?
entries.literal: "...I am, and I don't know. What happened?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You need to come down. Did anyone pass through this floor?
entries.literal: "You need to come down. Did anyone pass through this floor?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I haven't seen anyone, no.
entries.literal: "I haven't seen anyone, no."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was pretty agitated, so I kept my composure and waited for him to tell me what had occurred. Everything about him gave away that he'd seen something frightful.
entries.literal: "He was pretty agitated, so I kept my composure and waited for him to tell me what had occurred. Everything about him gave away that he'd seen something frightful."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We need to find everyone else...
entries.literal: "We need to find everyone else..."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Are you gonna tell me what happened?
entries.literal: "Are you gonna tell me what happened?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm sorry... It's on the crystal floor, but we shouldn't separate anymore.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry... It's on the crystal floor, but we shouldn't separate anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He grabbed my hand and dashed toward the way he'd come.
entries.literal: "He grabbed my hand and dashed toward the way he'd come."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: You're scaring me... Don't tell me...
entries.literal: "You're scaring me... Don't tell me..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We ran around the second floor. When we got to the last staircase, Atsuki stopped and looked down. It wasn't visible yet.
entries.literal: "We ran around the second floor. When we got to the last staircase, Atsuki stopped and looked down. It wasn't visible yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I descended the steps until the crystal floor was visible through the open door.
entries.literal: "I descended the steps until the crystal floor was visible through the open door."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: E-Erina...!
entries.literal: "E-Erina...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina's body lay facing down over a vast pool of blood, traces of which started in the middle of the staircase. I didn't have to walk farther down to know she was dead.
entries.literal: "Erina's body lay facing down over a vast pool of blood, traces of which started in the middle of the staircase. I didn't have to walk farther down to know she was dead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind me, Atsuki hadn't yet stepped down. It was hard to meet his eyes; he looked only at the floor.
entries.literal: "Behind me, Atsuki hadn't yet stepped down. It was hard to meet his eyes; he looked only at the floor."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Damn it...! Where the hell are the others!? Still in the attic?
entries.literal: "Damn it...! Where the hell are the others!? Still in the attic?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I-I think someone was on the floor above me at some point. Were you alone when you found her?
entries.literal: "I-I think someone was on the floor above me at some point. Were you alone when you found her?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept walking down while I silently wondered why he'd been alone. On the floor of hallway C, I pressed two fingers to Erina's body and waited for any perceptible movement.
entries.literal: "I kept walking down while I silently wondered why he'd been alone. On the floor of hallway C, I pressed two fingers to Erina's body and waited for any perceptible movement."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I've already checked...
entries.literal: "I've already checked..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was truly dead. Erina, who'd been quietly following us around the entire day, was not alive anymore. It was such a bizarre sensation.
entries.literal: "She was truly dead. Erina, who'd been quietly following us around the entire day, was not alive anymore. It was such a bizarre sensation."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Where's Isla? Sh-She can't see this.
entries.literal: "Where's Isla? Sh-She can't see this."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't know where anyone is! They should be up above!
entries.literal: "I don't know where anyone is! They should be up above!"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone.
entries.literal: "It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heavy breathing was interrupting my words, and I didn't let my gaze stray from Erina. Being so close to her, I noticed that blood was coming out of the part of her head that hit the edge of a step.
entries.literal: "My heavy breathing was interrupting my words, and I didn't let my gaze stray from Erina. Being so close to her, I noticed that blood was coming out of the part of her head that hit the edge of a step."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: H-Her killer should be here on this floor, but looking for them is way too dangerous. Like I said before, don't go alone anywhere anymore.
entries.literal: "H-Her killer should be here on this floor, but looking for them is way too dangerous. Like I said before, don't go alone anywhere anymore."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes, I know.
entries.literal: "Yes, I know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We ran up the floors. On the fourth was Sai.
entries.literal: "We ran up the floors. On the fourth was Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, as it was essential to find everyone, we didn't explain fully and kept moving up.
entries.literal: "However, as it was essential to find everyone, we didn't explain fully and kept moving up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One floor higher was Katei. On the sixth, Akaro.
entries.literal: "One floor higher was Katei. On the sixth, Akaro."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw that the attic key was inserted into the door. We all entered to find the missing person.
entries.literal: "I saw that the attic key was inserted into the door. We all entered to find the missing person."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the floor's footprints—the proof that the past had changed. I had no idea how, but it was undeniable that it greatly had.
entries.literal: "I stared at the floor's footprints—the proof that the past had changed. I had no idea how, but it was undeniable that it greatly had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When every room was looked into, the final result was alarming. Isla had not been found.
entries.literal: "When every room was looked into, the final result was alarming. Isla had not been found."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Isla should be somewhere...! Where did you all see her last?
entries.literal: "Isla should be somewhere...! Where did you all see her last?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Only Isla? Then, what happened on the crystal floor...
entries.literal: "Only Isla? Then, what happened on the crystal floor..."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Is it Erina...? Both of them were here not long ago.
entries.literal: "Is it Erina...? Both of them were here not long ago."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes. They were sitting on the sofa when I left.
entries.literal: "Yes. They were sitting on the sofa when I left."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: In that case, they took the elevator. That was them.
entries.literal: "In that case, they took the elevator. That was them."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Was it up here?
entries.literal: "Was it up here?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: So Isla could be in danger...
entries.literal: "So Isla could be in danger..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of us ran back down. It was hard to believe anyone wasn't aware of what awaited them, but they had to see for themselves.
entries.literal: "All of us ran back down. It was hard to believe anyone wasn't aware of what awaited them, but they had to see for themselves."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Shit...! Why the fuck would Erina be targeted...!?
entries.literal: "Shit...! Why the fuck would Erina be targeted...!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone saw her dead body over the slowly growing pool of blood. Sai gently checked her pulse and confirmed it for everyone.
entries.literal: "Everyone saw her dead body over the slowly growing pool of blood. Sai gently checked her pulse and confirmed it for everyone."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Why is Isla not with her...? It couldn't be that...
entries.literal: "Why is Isla not with her...? It couldn't be that..."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Th-There's no way.{w} ...Should I bring her to the lobby?
entries.literal: "Th-There's no way.{w} ...Should I bring her to the lobby?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: To the lobby? Why?
entries.literal: "To the lobby? Why?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So she's with the others. Sorry, that was stupid of me. This time, this is actually where she died.
entries.literal: "So she's with the others. Sorry, that was stupid of me. This time, this is actually where she died."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went quiet. I'd begun to form a small theory, but it appeared I was wrong. After that, I realized I had no idea what had actually happened.
entries.literal: "I went quiet. I'd begun to form a small theory, but it appeared I was wrong. After that, I realized I had no idea what had actually happened."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Can we be sure she was killed? What if she fell off the stairs, which shocked Isla and made her run away?
entries.literal: "Can we be sure she was killed? What if she fell off the stairs, which shocked Isla and made her run away?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I doubt it. There's a button right here.
entries.literal: "I doubt it. There's a button right here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I followed Sai's finger to one of the higher steps. We walked up and saw a silver button which had formerly been attached to Erina's turtleneck.
entries.literal: "I followed Sai's finger to one of the higher steps. We walked up and saw a silver button which had formerly been attached to Erina's turtleneck."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You mean this points to there being a fight?
entries.literal: "You mean this points to there being a fight?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How else would it have ended up here?
entries.literal: "How else would it have ended up here?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Sai is right. This wasn't an accident, and I heard it. I-I was in the first partition of the second floor when I heard Erina.{w} Her voice hardly reached me, but the words I picked up were enough to understand what was happening. "Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them."
entries.literal: "Sai is right. This wasn't an accident, and I heard it. I-I was in the first partition of the second floor when I heard Erina.{w} Her voice hardly reached me, but the words I picked up were enough to understand what was happening. \"Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them.\""

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What!? Then that's why someone killed her... She identified them.
entries.literal: "What!? Then that's why someone killed her... She identified them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Is this true, Atsuki?
entries.literal: "...{w}Is this true, Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes! I'm not lying.
entries.literal: "Yes! I'm not lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you hear anything else?
entries.literal: "Did you hear anything else?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Y-Yes, a yell, I think, from Erina. Then, I ran here and saw her dead.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes, a yell, I think, from Erina. Then, I ran here and saw her dead."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That means the killer is on this floor, right?
entries.literal: "That means the killer is on this floor, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe when he found Erina, but not anymore. Whoever killed her could be anywhere. However, this changes things a lot.
entries.literal: "Maybe when he found Erina, but not anymore. Whoever killed her could be anywhere. However, this changes things a lot."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai went to the storeroom and came back seconds later.
entries.literal: "Sai went to the storeroom and came back seconds later."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The door hasn't been opened again...
entries.literal: "The door hasn't been opened again..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let me be clear. One thing would be possible: the real killer killed Erina. Then, they escaped from this floor immediately. If the real person behind all this killed Erina, the most likely thing is that they would've left through the storeroom so Atsuki never saw them. It's incredibly hard to believe they wouldn't have the key to unlock it.
entries.literal: "Let me be clear. One thing would be possible: the real killer killed Erina. Then, they escaped from this floor immediately. If the real person behind all this killed Erina, the most likely thing is that they would've left through the storeroom so Atsuki never saw them. It's incredibly hard to believe they wouldn't have the key to unlock it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: However, that didn't happen. Atsuki didn't find anyone when he ran here, and at this point, I seriously don't think the true culprit would've killed Erina and then hoped they wouldn't be found in a crystal room. ...So there's a second thing I could believe.
entries.literal: "However, that didn't happen. Atsuki didn't find anyone when he ran here, and at this point, I seriously don't think the true culprit would've killed Erina and then hoped they wouldn't be found in a crystal room. ...So there's a second thing I could believe."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That they activated the Sekimeiya and disappeared from this floor.
entries.literal: "That they activated the Sekimeiya and disappeared from this floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai seemed to have a point he was getting to, and so far, we were following along.
entries.literal: "Sai seemed to have a point he was getting to, and so far, we were following along."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Oh, I can tell if that happened.
entries.literal: "...Oh, I can tell if that happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He made us follow him to the event room.
entries.literal: "He made us follow him to the event room."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: The glass hasn't been opened either. It's very likely they had the key, but the Sekimeiya wasn't used.
entries.literal: "The glass hasn't been opened either. It's very likely they had the key, but the Sekimeiya wasn't used."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You can tell?
entries.literal: "You can tell?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: How?
entries.literal: "How?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}It's because of this thread that I detached from the curtain earlier.
entries.literal: "...{w}It's because of this thread that I detached from the curtain earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki explained what he'd done. The last time he'd closed the cabinet, he left a thin and short thread above the movable glass. That way, if anyone tried to get the Sekimeiya out, the thread would fall.
entries.literal: "Atsuki explained what he'd done. The last time he'd closed the cabinet, he left a thin and short thread above the movable glass. That way, if anyone tried to get the Sekimeiya out, the thread would fall."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's in the position it was when I locked the cabinet the last time.
entries.literal: "It's in the position it was when I locked the cabinet the last time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So you ripped me off? I guess that removes this option.
entries.literal: "So you ripped me off? I guess that removes this option."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all saw the thread and understood that Atsuki was telling the truth. The cabinet hadn't opened, and according to Sai, neither had the storeroom door.
entries.literal: "We all saw the thread and understood that Atsuki was telling the truth. The cabinet hadn't opened, and according to Sai, neither had the storeroom door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, would there be a way to unlock the bathrooms from the outside if you were to lock yourself in? They have keyholes.
entries.literal: "Katei, would there be a way to unlock the bathrooms from the outside if you were to lock yourself in? They have keyholes."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Yes, actually. I'm not sure if I still have it, but most employees were given a key to unlock them.
entries.literal: "...Yes, actually. I'm not sure if I still have it, but most employees were given a key to unlock them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...So there's one last thing I believe the real culprit could've likely done.
entries.literal: "...So there's one last thing I believe the real culprit could've likely done."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Locking themselves in the security room. There's no way to open it from the outside.
entries.literal: "Locking themselves in the security room. There's no way to open it from the outside."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: O-Oh, yeah. We can't check that, though.
entries.literal: "O-Oh, yeah. We can't check that, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai ran to the door and tried to open it. ...It was still locked.
entries.literal: "Sai ran to the door and tried to open it. ...It was still locked."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's true that we can't be sure nobody's currently in the security room, but it's unlikely. They can't keep shut in there after {time=21.}
entries.literal: "It's true that we can't be sure nobody's currently in the security room, but it's unlikely. They can't keep shut in there after {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Is there something you're trying to say?
entries.literal: "Is there something you're trying to say?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Definitely. I'm trying to say that it wasn't the actual person we've been chasing who killed Erina, but rather the person she thought it was.
entries.literal: "Definitely. I'm trying to say that it wasn't the actual person we've been chasing who killed Erina, but rather the person she thought it was."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you seriously saying this!? None of us would kill Erina!
entries.literal: "Are you seriously saying this!? None of us would kill Erina!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki specifically heard "Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them." What I draw from that is that she thought otherwise. She thought one of us was the culprit, but there's no guarantee she was right.
entries.literal: "Atsuki specifically heard \"Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them.\" What I draw from that is that she thought otherwise. She thought one of us was the culprit, but there's no guarantee she was right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's voice sounded serious. We had learned long ago that a killer was confined with us, and the look in everyone's eyes told me that they wanted to figure out who they were before they could become victims themselves.
entries.literal: "Sai's voice sounded serious. We had learned long ago that a killer was confined with us, and the look in everyone's eyes told me that they wanted to figure out who they were before they could become victims themselves."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I doubt she was wrong, given how it ended up.
entries.literal: "...I doubt she was wrong, given how it ended up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why? The voice came from the staircase, right? We figured there was some sort of scuffle because of that shirt button. This means there was a fight above the staircase between Erina and who she thought was the real culprit.
entries.literal: "Why? The voice came from the staircase, right? We figured there was some sort of scuffle because of that shirt button. This means there was a fight above the staircase between Erina and who she thought was the real culprit."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No matter who that person was, it could've easily ended with Erina falling or being thrown off the stairs. It doesn't matter if they killed anyone else beforehand.
entries.literal: "No matter who that person was, it could've easily ended with Erina falling or being thrown off the stairs. It doesn't matter if they killed anyone else beforehand."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: B-But none of us could've done it.
entries.literal: "B-But none of us could've done it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wrong. You could have. However, we're already believing you by thinking this way.
entries.literal: "Wrong. You could have. However, we're already believing you by thinking this way."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right off the bat, the two main possibilities are that either the person behind every other death killed Erina or that Atsuki did. They could even be the same person. Technically, Isla could've too.
entries.literal: "Right off the bat, the two main possibilities are that either the person behind every other death killed Erina or that Atsuki did. They could even be the same person. Technically, Isla could've too."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're insane.
entries.literal: "You're insane."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's possible she's still here, though. Frightening prospect, but we need to find her.
entries.literal: "It's possible she's still here, though. Frightening prospect, but we need to find her."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Could she really be here? If she hasn't shown up, doesn't that mean...?
entries.literal: "Could she really be here? If she hasn't shown up, doesn't that mean...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai looked into the first rooms in hallway A. We stared at him, nearly immobile, only twitching every time a new door was opened. He went from door to door, narrowing his vision as he peered into each new room.
entries.literal: "Sai looked into the first rooms in hallway A. We stared at him, nearly immobile, only twitching every time a new door was opened. He went from door to door, narrowing his vision as he peered into each new room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After opening the farthest away crystal room—A1—Isla's head peeked out. We ran there, relieved to see her safe.
entries.literal: "After opening the farthest away crystal room—A1—Isla's head peeked out. We ran there, relieved to see her safe."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh-What are you doing here?
entries.literal: "Wh-What are you doing here?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm? We were looking at the gems, and Mom said to stay in here.
entries.literal: "Hm? We were looking at the gems, and Mom said to stay in here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes, there's one I really like in this room.
entries.literal: "Yes, there's one I really like in this room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked at each other, speechless. She didn't know what had happened.
entries.literal: "We looked at each other, speechless. She didn't know what had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After some uncountable stretch of silence, it became clear that none of us had the strength to say it.
entries.literal: "After some uncountable stretch of silence, it became clear that none of us had the strength to say it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So you haven't moved from here?
entries.literal: "So you haven't moved from here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She nodded.
entries.literal: "She nodded."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you come here from the attic?
entries.literal: "Did you come here from the attic?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were only quiet and devastated looks. Ignorant, Isla shrugged, slightly confused by our behavior.
entries.literal: "There were only quiet and devastated looks. Ignorant, Isla shrugged, slightly confused by our behavior."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Do you wanna see it? It's really pretty.
entries.literal: "Do you wanna see it? It's really pretty."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...We'll come see it in a bit.
entries.literal: "...We'll come see it in a bit."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a smile, she walked to one of the uncovered curtains and admired a tiny, black stone displayed individually. Slowly, Sai shut the door to leave her in peace for as long as possible while she did as her mother had instructed.
entries.literal: "With a smile, she walked to one of the uncovered curtains and admired a tiny, black stone displayed individually. Slowly, Sai shut the door to leave her in peace for as long as possible while she did as her mother had instructed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We'll be back in just a minute.
entries.literal: "We'll be back in just a minute."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We looked at hallway C, once again witnessing what Isla had no idea about. As we retreated, we heard Sai talking in a whisper.
entries.literal: "We looked at hallway C, once again witnessing what Isla had no idea about. As we retreated, we heard Sai talking in a whisper."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You heard what Isla said, right? Before dying, Erina told her to stay in that room. She knew she was gonna confront the person she believed to be the killer, and she didn't want Isla to see it or interfere.{w} So now tell us, Atsuki: why did you say that none of us could've done it?
entries.literal: "You heard what Isla said, right? Before dying, Erina told her to stay in that room. She knew she was gonna confront the person she believed to be the killer, and she didn't want Isla to see it or interfere.{w} So now tell us, Atsuki: why did you say that none of us could've done it?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Because I left the attic first. I walked down, but I... couldn't really bring myself to go to the crystal floor. That's why I stayed in the first partition of the second floor, thinking to myself...{w} From there, I would've seen anyone moving through floor 2.
entries.literal: "Because I left the attic first. I walked down, but I... couldn't really bring myself to go to the crystal floor. That's why I stayed in the first partition of the second floor, thinking to myself...{w} From there, I would've seen anyone moving through floor 2."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But you didn't see Erina.
entries.literal: "But you didn't see Erina."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Like you said earlier, Erina and Isla had to use the elevator to get here.
entries.literal: "Like you said earlier, Erina and Isla had to use the elevator to get here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's right. I heard the elevator once.
entries.literal: "That's right. I heard the elevator once."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I did too.
entries.literal: "I did too."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Yes, me too.
entries.literal: "Yes, me too."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei and I were the ones who brought it to the attic, and afterward, we left through the main door. This means it's very likely the elevator was moving down and arrived on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Katei and I were the ones who brought it to the attic, and afterward, we left through the main door. This means it's very likely the elevator was moving down and arrived on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai approached the elevator and opened it successfully. ...It had been left on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Sai approached the elevator and opened it successfully. ...It had been left on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: In addition, the panels haven't been attached yet, so there was no way to call it from here. The floor 1 button was pressed from the attic.{w} Which leaves the following way possible: someone took the elevator with Erina and Isla. That's how the killer could've gotten to the crystal floor without being seen. Did anyone see both of them taking the elevator?
entries.literal: "In addition, the panels haven't been attached yet, so there was no way to call it from here. The floor 1 button was pressed from the attic.{w} Which leaves the following way possible: someone took the elevator with Erina and Isla. That's how the killer could've gotten to the crystal floor without being seen. Did anyone see both of them taking the elevator?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every head shook.
entries.literal: "Every head shook."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We could ask Isla, but even if she says that no one else was with them, we can't blindly believe that. They could have threatened her.
entries.literal: "We could ask Isla, but even if she says that no one else was with them, we can't blindly believe that. They could have threatened her."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What did everyone do, exactly?
entries.literal: "What did everyone do, exactly?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki began.
entries.literal: "Atsuki began."

entries.speaker: an
c2sn
sain
entries.text: {w=0.4}"So, you're already unable to prove you didn't take the elevator with Erina and Isla. Did anyone see you leaving through the main door?"
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"So, you're already unable to prove you didn't take the elevator with Erina and Isla. Did anyone see you leaving through the main door?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody answered.
entries.literal: "Nobody answered."

entries.speaker: sain
entries.text: {w=0.4}"Can you prove you didn't go down with them?"
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"Can you prove you didn't go down with them?\""

entries.speaker: c2sn
entries.text: {w=0.4}"No, but Atsuki saw me on the third floor immediately after he saw Erina."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"No, but Atsuki saw me on the third floor immediately after he saw Erina.\""

entries.speaker: sain
kn
entries.text: {w=0.4}"That doesn't matter. I can confirm that she didn't take the elevator."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"That doesn't matter. I can confirm that she didn't take the elevator.\""

entries.speaker: sain
entries.text: {w=0.4}"You can, Katei?"
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"You can, Katei?\""

entries.speaker: kn
entries.text:
{w=0.4}"Yes. That's because when I left the attic, only Erina, Isla, and Akaro remained. Everyone else had already left."{w}

"I looked everywhere to see who had left, and I also opened the elevator in the attic, as I thought of using it. However, I ended up walking out through the main door. Only Akaro could've taken the elevator with Erina and Isla."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"Yes. That's because when I left the attic, only Erina, Isla, and Akaro remained. Everyone else had already left.\"{w}\n\n\"I looked everywhere to see who had left, and I also opened the elevator in the attic, as I thought of using it. However, I ended up walking out through the main door. Only Akaro could've taken the elevator with Erina and Isla.\""

entries.speaker: sain
entries.text: {w=0.4}"I see. Well then, what did you do? I recall we found you on the fifth floor."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"I see. Well then, what did you do? I recall we found you on the fifth floor.\""

entries.speaker: kn
sain
kn
entries.text: {w=0.4}"I'm glad we settled this quickly. This also confirms that Sai is telling the truth. Everything that he said is correct, which means that he was on the fourth floor the whole time."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"I'm glad we settled this quickly. This also confirms that Sai is telling the truth. Everything that he said is correct, which means that he was on the fourth floor the whole time.\""

entries.speaker: sain
entries.text: {w=0.4}"Akaro, it's you left, and you understand your position, right?"
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"Akaro, it's you left, and you understand your position, right?\""

entries.speaker: akn
entries.text:
{w=0.4}"Yes, but I don't have much to say. I left the attic when Erina and Isla were still sitting on the sofa. I'm pretty sure Katei is right and they were the two people remaining in the attic."{w}

"I knew most people had left, but the sixth floor was completely desolate. I also had quite a few things to think about, so I eventually sat where you found me and spent the whole time there. I actually didn't hear the elevator, but I was pretty far from it and not paying much attention."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"Yes, but I don't have much to say. I left the attic when Erina and Isla were still sitting on the sofa. I'm pretty sure Katei is right and they were the two people remaining in the attic.\"{w}\n\n\"I knew most people had left, but the sixth floor was completely desolate. I also had quite a few things to think about, so I eventually sat where you found me and spent the whole time there. I actually didn't hear the elevator, but I was pretty far from it and not paying much attention.\""

entries.speaker: kn
entries.text: {w=0.4}"I have a question. Why didn't I hear your footsteps if I was directly below you?"
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"I have a question. Why didn't I hear your footsteps if I was directly below you?\""

entries.speaker: sain
entries.text: {w=0.4}"That I can answer. Haven't you noticed? Akaro doesn't make much sound when he walks."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"That I can answer. Haven't you noticed? Akaro doesn't make much sound when he walks.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That threw all of us off, but we confirmed it. Akaro walked around in front of us, and his footsteps were very quiet.
entries.literal: "That threw all of us off, but we confirmed it. Akaro walked around in front of us, and his footsteps were very quiet."

entries.speaker: akn
entries.text:
