{w=0.4}"I know what you're all thinking—I could've gone to the crystal floor with Erina and Isla. Of course, Isla could verify that didn't happen, but even if I'd managed to make it to the crystal floor, I couldn't have been found on the sixth."{w}

"According to Sai, Katei spent the last few minutes outside the offices, one floor below me. So if I'd killed Erina, I needed to either use the elevator or walk up to reach the sixth floor. Doing that without being found or heard would've been impossible."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"I know what you're all thinking—I could've gone to the crystal floor with Erina and Isla. Of course, Isla could verify that didn't happen, but even if I'd managed to make it to the crystal floor, I couldn't have been found on the sixth.\"{w}\n\n\"According to Sai, Katei spent the last few minutes outside the offices, one floor below me. So if I'd killed Erina, I needed to either use the elevator or walk up to reach the sixth floor. Doing that without being found or heard would've been impossible.\""

entries.speaker: sain
entries.text:
{w=0.4}"Is that it, then? Was Atsuki right? None of us could've done it?"{w}

"I'm not sure I can think of a way out that doesn't involve the Sekimeiya. We'll get there, though."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"Is that it, then? Was Atsuki right? None of us could've done it?\"{w}\n\n\"I'm not sure I can think of a way out that doesn't involve the Sekimeiya. We'll get there, though.\""

entries.speaker: c2sn
entries.text: {w=0.4}"I can think of one, I suppose."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"I can think of one, I suppose.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone looked at me, but I only had a random, unlikely-sounding thought to let out.
entries.literal: "Everyone looked at me, but I only had a random, unlikely-sounding thought to let out."

entries.speaker: c2sn
entries.text: {w=0.4}"I'm just saying that Sai and Katei could technically have done it, right? Their versions of events are just covering each other."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"I'm just saying that Sai and Katei could technically have done it, right? Their versions of events are just covering each other.\""

entries.speaker: sain
entries.text: {w=0.4}"That's not true. Did you not hear what Akaro said? He said that when he left the attic, Erina and Isla were the only two people left. That means that Katei and I couldn't have gone to the crystal floor."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"That's not true. Did you not hear what Akaro said? He said that when he left the attic, Erina and Isla were the only two people left. That means that Katei and I couldn't have gone to the crystal floor.\""

entries.speaker: c2sn
entries.text:
{w=0.4}"You could have. Erina and Isla used the elevator alone, from the attic. However, they got off on floor 4 or 5, where you two were. That way, you could've gotten to the crystal floor with a single elevator trip."{w}

"I don't mean to say I believe it to be the case, but I'm answering what you asked. Then, you could've taken the elevator back up while Atsuki and I were on the crystal floor, which we wouldn't have heard."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"You could have. Erina and Isla used the elevator alone, from the attic. However, they got off on floor 4 or 5, where you two were. That way, you could've gotten to the crystal floor with a single elevator trip.\"{w}\n\n\"I don't mean to say I believe it to be the case, but I'm answering what you asked. Then, you could've taken the elevator back up while Atsuki and I were on the crystal floor, which we wouldn't have heard.\""

entries.speaker: sain
entries.text: {w=0.4}"I see. So then you could have also done this."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"I see. So then you could have also done this.\""

entries.speaker: c2sn
entries.text: {w=0.4}"Yes, which is why we should ask Isla. Once we rule that out, it seems like all of us have some sort of alibi."
entries.literal: "{w=0.4}\"Yes, which is why we should ask Isla. Once we rule that out, it seems like all of us have some sort of alibi.\""

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then, the final method.{w} Using the Sekimeiya in the future.
entries.literal: "Then, the final method.{w} Using the Sekimeiya in the future."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki confirmed it wasn't touched up until now, but someone can use it later on. They could invalidate everything we've thought of by just appearing in the crystal room from the future. However, I believe we can figure out whether that's the answer.
entries.literal: "Atsuki confirmed it wasn't touched up until now, but someone can use it later on. They could invalidate everything we've thought of by just appearing in the crystal room from the future. However, I believe we can figure out whether that's the answer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai walked to the room where Isla was, so we followed him.
entries.literal: "Sai walked to the room where Isla was, so we followed him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With what we'd talked about, could Erina's killer be identified? I didn't think so, but there was a chance I was failing to consider something.
entries.literal: "With what we'd talked about, could Erina's killer be identified? I didn't think so, but there was a chance I was failing to consider something."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...How are you doing?
entries.literal: "...How are you doing?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm? I'm fine.
entries.literal: "Hm? I'm fine."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's good. I have a question.{w} When you came from the attic, you used the elevator, right? Were you and Erina alone?
entries.literal: "That's good. I have a question.{w} When you came from the attic, you used the elevator, right? Were you and Erina alone?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We were. Why do you ask?
entries.literal: "We were. Why do you ask?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: E-Erina...! What are you doing here!?
entries.literal: "E-Erina...! What are you doing here!?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What am I doing...?
entries.literal: "What am I doing...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was there, casually leaning against the line of cabinets. I could hardly believe what I was seeing, but there was no wariness in her eyes and not even a trace of blood near her.
entries.literal: "She was there, casually leaning against the line of cabinets. I could hardly believe what I was seeing, but there was no wariness in her eyes and not even a trace of blood near her."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What's with those looks?
entries.literal: "What's with those looks?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you not know what happened?
entries.literal: "Do you not know what happened?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No? What?
entries.literal: "No? What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai responded only by peering at Isla's curious face, which communicated to Erina that it was something her daughter couldn't hear. She stood up and came over to us, clearly oblivious.
entries.literal: "Sai responded only by peering at Isla's curious face, which communicated to Erina that it was something her daughter couldn't hear. She stood up and came over to us, clearly oblivious."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wait here, sweetie.
entries.literal: "Wait here, sweetie."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: E-Erina... What happened since you two left the attic?
entries.literal: "E-Erina... What happened since you two left the attic?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What does that mean? People were leaving, and Isla said she wanted to come down too since she still hadn't seen all the gems. I noticed she was trying to cheer herself up a little despite the... two bodies we found, so even though I didn't want to leave, I went with her just so that it took her mind off it.
entries.literal: "What does that mean? People were leaving, and Isla said she wanted to come down too since she still hadn't seen all the gems. I noticed she was trying to cheer herself up a little despite the... two bodies we found, so even though I didn't want to leave, I went with her just so that it took her mind off it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And you took the elevator?
entries.literal: "And you took the elevator?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes, she wanted to. There was still a little bit of blood inside, but she insisted.
entries.literal: "Yes, she wanted to. There was still a little bit of blood inside, but she insisted."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: A-Are you going to tell me something?
entries.literal: "A-Are you going to tell me something?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She'd noticed we all looked like we were staring at a ghost, and she began to look seriously unsettled herself.
entries.literal: "She'd noticed we all looked like we were staring at a ghost, and she began to look seriously unsettled herself."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: And you simply stayed in this room?
entries.literal: "And you simply stayed in this room?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: There's potentially still a murderer around, and I especially didn't want to move around this floor or go to the lobby. I noticed Isla was focused on one of these gems, so I told her we'd stay here. I wasn't going to leave her alone unless we guaranteed we were safe.
entries.literal: "There's potentially still a murderer around, and I especially didn't want to move around this floor or go to the lobby. I noticed Isla was focused on one of these gems, so I told her we'd stay here. I wasn't going to leave her alone unless we guaranteed we were safe."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So just earlier, when we talked to Isla, you were here?
entries.literal: "So just earlier, when we talked to Isla, you were here?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What? Yes, behind the door. I didn't know if you needed something, but of course I was inside.
entries.literal: "What? Yes, behind the door. I didn't know if you needed something, but of course I was inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, Erina noticed where our lines of sight went and turned around.
entries.literal: "Finally, Erina noticed where our lines of sight went and turned around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no pause before the gasp came.
entries.literal: "There was no pause before the gasp came."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Ah...! That's...!

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What's wrong...?
entries.literal: "What's wrong...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: N-Nothing, please, stay there...
entries.literal: "N-Nothing, please, stay there..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She approached the face-down body and recognized that it was no misinterpretation. Her clothes were the ones stained by blood, and the body was her own.
entries.literal: "She approached the face-down body and recognized that it was no misinterpretation. Her clothes were the ones stained by blood, and the body was her own."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh my God. This is... me? H-How can... There's no way!
entries.literal: "Oh my God. This is... me? H-How can... There's no way!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She broke down instantly. Before her was proof that she could soon die. Even though it had already happened, the Sekimeiya's existence allowed it to be a future event. Of course, that made everything even more strange. Would she travel to the past after coming up with a conclusion on who the killer was?
entries.literal: "She broke down instantly. Before her was proof that she could soon die. Even though it had already happened, the Sekimeiya's existence allowed it to be a future event. Of course, that made everything even more strange. Would she travel to the past after coming up with a conclusion on who the killer was?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: W-We know it happened a few minutes ago, but we have no idea what actually happened. We thought you'd left Isla in that room.
entries.literal: "W-We know it happened a few minutes ago, but we have no idea what actually happened. We thought you'd left Isla in that room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She can't see this...!
entries.literal: "She can't see this...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina ran back and tightly gripped the doorknob.
entries.literal: "Erina ran back and tightly gripped the doorknob."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Should we bring her... you... that body to the lobby?
entries.literal: "Should we bring her... you... that body to the lobby?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No, we'll have to go there eventually...! So much blood can't be removed either...
entries.literal: "No, we'll have to go there eventually...! So much blood can't be removed either..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla, I'm sorry, but we need to go back to the attic.
entries.literal: "Isla, I'm sorry, but we need to go back to the attic."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Why? I want to stay here.
entries.literal: "Why? I want to stay here."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Please, do me a favor and come with us.
entries.literal: "Please, do me a favor and come with us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We perceived a tiny nod. Relieved, Erina crouched to pick her up and brought her to the staircase, covering her face on the way.
entries.literal: "We perceived a tiny nod. Relieved, Erina crouched to pick her up and brought her to the staircase, covering her face on the way."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I'm not tired, and we can just take the elevator.
entries.literal: "I'm not tired, and we can just take the elevator."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I thought you preferred being picked up. You can walk if you want.
entries.literal: "I thought you preferred being picked up. You can walk if you want."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm... No.
entries.literal: "Hm... No."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: There we go.
entries.literal: "There we go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed the surrealism wouldn't end any time soon. Everyone was glad to see Erina safe, but sheer bewilderment was even more dominant.
entries.literal: "It seemed the surrealism wouldn't end any time soon. Everyone was glad to see Erina safe, but sheer bewilderment was even more dominant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even Atsuki, who I'd assumed would be out of it for the rest of our imprisonment, had proven otherwise. However, it made sense. After all, whatever his plan entailed was still bound to happen. That was unquestionable.
entries.literal: "Even Atsuki, who I'd assumed would be out of it for the rest of our imprisonment, had proven otherwise. However, it made sense. After all, whatever his plan entailed was still bound to happen. That was unquestionable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once Erina and Isla disappeared from view, Sai opened the elevator.
entries.literal: "Once Erina and Isla disappeared from view, Sai opened the elevator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We should send the elevator to the attic. That'll be of use.
entries.literal: "We should send the elevator to the attic. That'll be of use."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Oh, sure.
entries.literal: "Oh, sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I unlocked the floor 7 button with the key and pressed it before stepping out. After that, we walked all the way up.
entries.literal: "I unlocked the floor 7 button with the key and pressed it before stepping out. After that, we walked all the way up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the way, I had to stop to drink from a sink in one of the bathrooms. It wasn't exactly high quality water, but it somewhat satisfied my thirst, and after some of the others did the same, we arrived at the attic's door.
entries.literal: "On the way, I had to stop to drink from a sink in one of the bathrooms. It wasn't exactly high quality water, but it somewhat satisfied my thirst, and after some of the others did the same, we arrived at the attic's door."

entries.text: Eruption
entries.literal: "Eruption"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I thought you took the elevator.
entries.literal: "I thought you took the elevator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We sent it up empty.
entries.literal: "We sent it up empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We saw Isla in the living room. Before Erina could join her, Sai grabbed her sleeve.
entries.literal: "We saw Isla in the living room. Before Erina could join her, Sai grabbed her sleeve."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is a very important question.{w} Who do you think the killer is?
entries.literal: "This is a very important question.{w} Who do you think the killer is?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The killer? ...I have no idea.
entries.literal: "The killer? ...I have no idea."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't only mean the person behind whatever happened just now. I mean in general, ever since this morning.
entries.literal: "I don't only mean the person behind whatever happened just now. I mean in general, ever since this morning."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I know, and that's what I answered.
entries.literal: "I know, and that's what I answered."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: According to Atsuki, he heard you accusing someone of being the killer. Once he ran to the crystal floor, he saw your body.
entries.literal: "According to Atsuki, he heard you accusing someone of being the killer. Once he ran to the crystal floor, he saw your body."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh-What...? I don't know...! I don't have a clue who the killer could be! I don't know anything about this. Just... let me be with my daughter, please.
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? I don't know...! I don't have a clue who the killer could be! I don't know anything about this. Just... let me be with my daughter, please."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She entered the room and followed Isla to the hallway.
entries.literal: "She entered the room and followed Isla to the hallway."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Then maybe she actually saw the real culprit. Since it wasn't anyone she'd seen before, that was all she needed to know that it was them.
entries.literal: "Then maybe she actually saw the real culprit. Since it wasn't anyone she'd seen before, that was all she needed to know that it was them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You could be right. The Erina who died... she could've only come from the future.
entries.literal: "You could be right. The Erina who died... she could've only come from the future."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: So she had a better idea of who to suspect than she does right now?
entries.literal: "So she had a better idea of who to suspect than she does right now?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, that's what I mean. I have no clue how this would work, though, or why she'd travel to the past. I suppose that tells us the Sekimeiya is bound to be used again in the future.{w} Technically, all Erina needs to do to be safe is not travel to the past. But she has to... or else what happened makes no sense.
entries.literal: "Yes, that's what I mean. I have no clue how this would work, though, or why she'd travel to the past. I suppose that tells us the Sekimeiya is bound to be used again in the future.{w} Technically, all Erina needs to do to be safe is not travel to the past. But she has to... or else what happened makes no sense."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't you find something strange? How come Erina didn't hear her own words if she was in hallway A? Isla should have too, right? Didn't you say that she yelled?
entries.literal: "Don't you find something strange? How come Erina didn't hear her own words if she was in hallway A? Isla should have too, right? Didn't you say that she yelled?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes. Are you suspecting me again?
entries.literal: "Yes. Are you suspecting me again?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, no, actually. I meant to suspect Erina herself since she's another person who could've technically done this. Wouldn't that be just nuts? Suicide via murdering yourself.{w} Before you ask, I don't believe that happened, no, but it's a little strange.
entries.literal: "Oh, no, actually. I meant to suspect Erina herself since she's another person who could've technically done this. Wouldn't that be just nuts? Suicide via murdering yourself.{w} Before you ask, I don't believe that happened, no, but it's a little strange."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's not. The noise came from high in the staircase, so it had to go down and maybe through the door to reach where Erina and Isla were. Given there's less echo on the crystal floor, it makes sense they heard nothing.
entries.literal: "It's not. The noise came from high in the staircase, so it had to go down and maybe through the door to reach where Erina and Isla were. Given there's less echo on the crystal floor, it makes sense they heard nothing."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That could be it.{w} Isla nodded when I asked her "So you haven't moved from here?"{w} She probably thought "you" meant her and Erina, so by answering yes, she meant neither of them left the room.
entries.literal: "That could be it.{w} Isla nodded when I asked her \"So you haven't moved from here?\"{w} She probably thought \"you\" meant her and Erina, so by answering yes, she meant neither of them left the room."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're insistent about this.
entries.literal: "You're insistent about this."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He sat on one of the steps.
entries.literal: "He sat on one of the steps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Wondering whether he had something else to add evolved into a few minutes of silence.
entries.literal: "Wondering whether he had something else to add evolved into a few minutes of silence."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I just have no idea what's happening here. Atsuki can keep denying it, but he's behind some of it, if not all.
entries.literal: "I just have no idea what's happening here. Atsuki can keep denying it, but he's behind some of it, if not all."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Why do you think so?
entries.literal: "...Why do you think so?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You've been hiding something since right after we got trapped, and the girl who appeared in the elevator has to be related to you. Do you still deny that?
entries.literal: "You've been hiding something since right after we got trapped, and the girl who appeared in the elevator has to be related to you. Do you still deny that?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...No, I don't. I'm aware it has to be my doing, but I haven't done anything. I don't know what I would do either, and the Sekimeiya doesn't work. I promise I'm much more confused than you are.
entries.literal: "...No, I don't. I'm aware it has to be my doing, but I haven't done anything. I don't know what I would do either, and the Sekimeiya doesn't work. I promise I'm much more confused than you are."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}I don't think you did anything to Erina, and so far the four deaths could have a motive in common. The policeman could've entered through the storeroom, and then he was killed because he was a direct threat.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't think you did anything to Erina, and so far the four deaths could have a motive in common. The policeman could've entered through the storeroom, and then he was killed because he was a direct threat."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The two in the elevator could have the very same motive: they were seen as threats. Both of them could've gone through the storeroom door as well since they weren't found until much later.{w} Finally, Erina might've confronted the killer. It could be that the four dead people were all seen as threats by the same person.
entries.literal: "The two in the elevator could have the very same motive: they were seen as threats. Both of them could've gone through the storeroom door as well since they weren't found until much later.{w} Finally, Erina might've confronted the killer. It could be that the four dead people were all seen as threats by the same person."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This stupid storeroom door is what pisses me off the most. Are people really entering and leaving the tower without being seen? That's nonsense, right? But it's a fact that it was opened.
entries.literal: "This stupid storeroom door is what pisses me off the most. Are people really entering and leaving the tower without being seen? That's nonsense, right? But it's a fact that it was opened."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Remember what I said. There's no way it leads outside.
entries.literal: "Remember what I said. There's no way it leads outside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's no way it doesn't. In fact, it's still incredibly likely you went through it.
entries.literal: "There's no way it doesn't. In fact, it's still incredibly likely you went through it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I didn't! I never knew about it!
entries.literal: "...I didn't! I never knew about it!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Katei, if the culprit is just one of us, it's you. You disappeared for almost three hours and appeared right before the policeman did. Before the elevator opened on the sixth floor, I had already tried to open it, and it was you who stayed in the attic last. You could've moved the elevator from the attic to the sixth floor, and you could've also locked the attic from the inside.
entries.literal: "Katei, if the culprit is just one of us, it's you. You disappeared for almost three hours and appeared right before the policeman did. Before the elevator opened on the sixth floor, I had already tried to open it, and it was you who stayed in the attic last. You could've moved the elevator from the attic to the sixth floor, and you could've also locked the attic from the inside."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I did none of that...!
entries.literal: "I did none of that...!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What happened with Erina is what gives you the most benefit of the doubt. Right now, the people who could've killed Erina are Atsuki, Erina, Isla, the real culprit if they're none of us, and anyone who traveled from the future to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "What happened with Erina is what gives you the most benefit of the doubt. Right now, the people who could've killed Erina are Atsuki, Erina, Isla, the real culprit if they're none of us, and anyone who traveled from the future to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If we rule out those last two options, our choices will diminish greatly, and it's possible we can, like I said earlier.{w} If someone traveled from the future and killed Erina, either they're still here or they left through the storeroom. Basically, if we can't find anyone and I confirm that the storeroom door didn't open, we can remove those possibilities.
entries.literal: "If we rule out those last two options, our choices will diminish greatly, and it's possible we can, like I said earlier.{w} If someone traveled from the future and killed Erina, either they're still here or they left through the storeroom. Basically, if we can't find anyone and I confirm that the storeroom door didn't open, we can remove those possibilities."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That could be bypassed with the Sekimeiya by using it to travel to a place that's just been examined or outside the tower. However, Atsuki can confirm whether the cabinet was opened. I believe we have the circumstances here to accomplish a definitive search. Specifically, one where time travel isn't going to fuck us.
entries.literal: "That could be bypassed with the Sekimeiya by using it to travel to a place that's just been examined or outside the tower. However, Atsuki can confirm whether the cabinet was opened. I believe we have the circumstances here to accomplish a definitive search. Specifically, one where time travel isn't going to fuck us."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So you're saying that if we don't find anyone, Atsuki is our man?
entries.literal: "So you're saying that if we don't find anyone, Atsuki is our man?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: He, Erina, and Isla would become the only three people who could've done it. This is the conclusion all of us reached.
entries.literal: "He, Erina, and Isla would become the only three people who could've done it. This is the conclusion all of us reached."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Let's do it, then.
entries.literal: "Let's do it, then."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes. I think your logic is right, but Atsuki can't be responsible.
entries.literal: "Yes. I think your logic is right, but Atsuki can't be responsible."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Okay. If we do it well, no matter what the result is, it will strongly indicate something.
entries.literal: "...Okay. If we do it well, no matter what the result is, it will strongly indicate something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked up to the living room. Through the hallway door, we saw Erina and Isla getting closer.
entries.literal: "We walked up to the living room. Through the hallway door, we saw Erina and Isla getting closer."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What's that...?
entries.literal: "What's that...?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Look what I found.
entries.literal: "Look what I found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With two hands, Isla was holding one of the bed sheets, folded up into a sphere. It was wrapped around something, and I could tell what Isla was going to say before she did.
entries.literal: "With two hands, Isla was holding one of the bed sheets, folded up into a sphere. It was wrapped around something, and I could tell what Isla was going to say before she did."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: It's the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It's the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What? The Sekimeiya's on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "What? The Sekimeiya's on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No, I have it here. It was in the, um... wardrobe.{w} I knew I wasn't allowed to touch it, so I had to cover it with this.
entries.literal: "No, I have it here. It was in the, um... wardrobe.{w} I knew I wasn't allowed to touch it, so I had to cover it with this."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Great. How did this thing even get up here?
entries.literal: "Great. How did this thing even get up here?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Is that so? Let us see.
entries.literal: "Is that so? Let us see."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No... We need to put it in the cabinet, right?
entries.literal: "No... We need to put it in the cabinet, right?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Is she telling the truth?
entries.literal: "...Is she telling the truth?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't know. She opened the wardrobe and grabbed the top bed sheet. When I stood up to see what she was doing, I couldn't see what she had.
entries.literal: "I don't know. She opened the wardrobe and grabbed the top bed sheet. When I stood up to see what she was doing, I couldn't see what she had."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's no way it was brought here since we saw it in the cabinet, right? It could only have happened when we were talking to Isla, if there was a time where neither the staircase nor the elevator were being observed.
entries.literal: "There's no way it was brought here since we saw it in the cabinet, right? It could only have happened when we were talking to Isla, if there was a time where neither the staircase nor the elevator were being observed."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It really may be teleporting. If the cabinet is empty and the thread is still there, it must have teleported out.
entries.literal: "It really may be teleporting. If the cabinet is empty and the thread is still there, it must have teleported out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see, you're right.{w} Let's do what we were talking about on the way down. If we have the Sekimeiya while we search every floor, there's no way it'll be used to bypass us.
entries.literal: "I see, you're right.{w} Let's do what we were talking about on the way down. If we have the Sekimeiya while we search every floor, there's no way it'll be used to bypass us."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: But shouldn't we hurry up...?
entries.literal: "But shouldn't we hurry up...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: She's right.
entries.literal: "She's right."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You know how important it is that we do this properly. We'll be fast.
entries.literal: "You know how important it is that we do this properly. We'll be fast."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla, we'll stay here while they go down.
entries.literal: "Isla, we'll stay here while they go down."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What? No. I'll keep the Sekimeiya safe.
entries.literal: "What? No. I'll keep the Sekimeiya safe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She tightened her arms around the ball, and Erina shut her eyes. On the way to the event room was the dead body Isla couldn't see.
entries.literal: "She tightened her arms around the ball, and Erina shut her eyes. On the way to the event room was the dead body Isla couldn't see."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You should do as your mother says. You can trust us to take good care of it.
entries.literal: "You should do as your mother says. You can trust us to take good care of it."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I can do it better, and it's dangerous to be alone. That's what you said earlier.
entries.literal: "I can do it better, and it's dangerous to be alone. That's what you said earlier."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's fine, we'll go. After that, Isla, we're coming back up, okay?
entries.literal: "It's fine, we'll go. After that, Isla, we're coming back up, okay?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah!
entries.literal: "Yeah!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla looked genuinely happy to escort the Sekimeiya all the way down, but there was no chance Erina would let her finish the trip.
entries.literal: "Isla looked genuinely happy to escort the Sekimeiya all the way down, but there was no chance Erina would let her finish the trip."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The elevator is here, and we can hear it if it's used. The intent is to make this perfect, and that won't be an issue either as long as we confirm it's empty before moving on.
entries.literal: "The elevator is here, and we can hear it if it's used. The intent is to make this perfect, and that won't be an issue either as long as we confirm it's empty before moving on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We began to put that plan into effect. If one of us was the real culprit, they could purposely leave something, or someone, undiscovered. That was why all of us looked everywhere there was to look—so that everyone could agree with the result in the end.
entries.literal: "We began to put that plan into effect. If one of us was the real culprit, they could purposely leave something, or someone, undiscovered. That was why all of us looked everywhere there was to look—so that everyone could agree with the result in the end."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since Isla had claimed she'd found the Sekimeiya in one of the wardrobes, it was possible something had gone unseen for a while. We didn't only look for people, but for anything.
entries.literal: "Since Isla had claimed she'd found the Sekimeiya in one of the wardrobes, it was possible something had gone unseen for a while. We didn't only look for people, but for anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every floor had a place where someone could wait to prevent anyone else from passing. Erina and Isla took that job to make the search valid.
entries.literal: "Every floor had a place where someone could wait to prevent anyone else from passing. Erina and Isla took that job to make the search valid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Doing all of it took a while, but on floor 3, the search hadn't gone any differently from the others; we still had zero results.
entries.literal: "Doing all of it took a while, but on floor 3, the search hadn't gone any differently from the others; we still had zero results."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were in front of the floor 2 offices, ready to move on to the last floor. We expected to be stopped on the way to the staircase, as Isla couldn't be allowed to walk down.
entries.literal: "We were in front of the floor 2 offices, ready to move on to the last floor. We expected to be stopped on the way to the staircase, as Isla couldn't be allowed to walk down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And yet our expectations were betrayed.
entries.literal: "And yet our expectations were betrayed."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Look at the elevator...!
entries.literal: "Look at the elevator...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to the elevator, the metallic panel holding the button was properly attached.
entries.literal: "Next to the elevator, the metallic panel holding the button was properly attached."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, what the fuck...? Weren't all the buttons inside it when we sent it up?
entries.literal: "Oh, what the fuck...? Weren't all the buttons inside it when we sent it up?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...I don't know. Maybe one had been taken out.
entries.literal: "...I don't know. Maybe one had been taken out."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It doesn't matter. Do not press it.{w} Someone is guaranteed to have been on the crystal floor, and their only way out is the storeroom. Just in case, we shouldn't bring the elevator here.
entries.literal: "It doesn't matter. Do not press it.{w} Someone is guaranteed to have been on the crystal floor, and their only way out is the storeroom. Just in case, we shouldn't bring the elevator here."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla, give Akaro the Sekimeiya. It's too dangerous to go down.
entries.literal: "Isla, give Akaro the Sekimeiya. It's too dangerous to go down."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: H-Huh...? No.
entries.literal: "H-Huh...? No."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was the first to walk down while Atsuki looked at both bathrooms. Meanwhile, Isla kept tightening her arms, reluctant to let go of the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Sai was the first to walk down while Atsuki looked at both bathrooms. Meanwhile, Isla kept tightening her arms, reluctant to let go of the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla, this is important. You can't go down there.
entries.literal: "Isla, this is important. You can't go down there."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...It's just to the event room.
entries.literal: "...It's just to the event room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Erina, it's fine. You can both come.
entries.literal: "Erina, it's fine. You can both come."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh-What...? Not a chance.
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? Not a chance."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Look, just get down here. Don't argue.
entries.literal: "Look, just get down here. Don't argue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked through the door and understood what Sai meant. There was no blood. Not only that, I proceeded down, and there was no body anywhere.
entries.literal: "I looked through the door and understood what Sai meant. There was no blood. Not only that, I proceeded down, and there was no body anywhere."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh my God, this is ridiculous.
entries.literal: "Oh my God, this is ridiculous."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Was it all removed?
entries.literal: "Was it all removed?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What, with a mop? Wouldn't stains be visible?
entries.literal: "What, with a mop? Wouldn't stains be visible?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: The elevator button has been reattached here too.
entries.literal: "The elevator button has been reattached here too."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I'll just go to the event room.
entries.literal: "I'll just go to the event room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wait...!
entries.literal: "Wait...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina dashed ahead of her and opened the door herself.{w} It didn't seem like there was anything inside.
entries.literal: "Erina dashed ahead of her and opened the door herself.{w} It didn't seem like there was anything inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whatever, put it in. Nobody can leave this floor without being seen, at least.
entries.literal: "Whatever, put it in. Nobody can leave this floor without being seen, at least."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait, it's still here.
entries.literal: "Wait, it's still here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh... Really?
entries.literal: "Huh... Really?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki had uncovered the cabinet, and the truth was plain to see: the Sekimeiya was still on its cushion.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had uncovered the cabinet, and the truth was plain to see: the Sekimeiya was still on its cushion."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh...! There are two of them!
entries.literal: "Oh...! There are two of them!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla rapidly unwrapped the sheet to prove that she hadn't lied.
entries.literal: "Isla rapidly unwrapped the sheet to prove that she hadn't lied."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hang on, it's not here. The thread I left.
entries.literal: "Hang on, it's not here. The thread I left."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: It's not here...! The Sekimeiya!
entries.literal: "It's not here...! The Sekimeiya!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla desperately looked all through the sheet, but the Sekimeiya wasn't there.
entries.literal: "Isla desperately looked all through the sheet, but the Sekimeiya wasn't there."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I promise I didn't lie! I had it here!
entries.literal: "I promise I didn't lie! I had it here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki crouched and felt the cloth.
entries.literal: "Atsuki crouched and felt the cloth."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Y-You didn't lie...! It's burning.
entries.literal: "Y-You didn't lie...! It's burning."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yeah. It started to feel hot on the fourth floor.
entries.literal: "Yeah. It started to feel hot on the fourth floor."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You felt it when the Sekimeiya was in the center...? I'll bet it was extremely hot, then. Also, the cabinet is still locked.
entries.literal: "You felt it when the Sekimeiya was in the center...? I'll bet it was extremely hot, then. Also, the cabinet is still locked."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I-Is this what you're implying? That it was taken out of the cabinet since the thread is gone and then brought to the attic? Then, at some point, it teleported inside again?
entries.literal: "...I-Is this what you're implying? That it was taken out of the cabinet since the thread is gone and then brought to the attic? Then, at some point, it teleported inside again?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm not implying anything, but that's what could've happened.
entries.literal: "I'm not implying anything, but that's what could've happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That doesn't make sense.{w} It really doesn't—the cabinet is locked. That would mean that whoever took the Sekimeiya out locked the cabinet while it was empty.{w} I have another idea. Let me take the Sekimeiya. Akaro and Katei, you watch the stairs.
entries.literal: "That doesn't make sense.{w} It really doesn't—the cabinet is locked. That would mean that whoever took the Sekimeiya out locked the cabinet while it was empty.{w} I have another idea. Let me take the Sekimeiya. Akaro and Katei, you watch the stairs."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Why?
entries.literal: "Why?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Because the last time it wasn't working, remember? I can test if it is now without activating it.
entries.literal: "Because the last time it wasn't working, remember? I can test if it is now without activating it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.literal: "...Okay."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Is that really okay? We came here to leave it where it's safe.
entries.literal: "Is that really okay? We came here to leave it where it's safe."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We need to understand what's happening. It must be done.
entries.literal: "We need to understand what's happening. It must be done."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After all that time, I still had the keyring, so I took it out and unlocked the cabinet.
entries.literal: "After all that time, I still had the keyring, so I took it out and unlocked the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai grabbed the Sekimeiya with his sleeves, causing the curtain to fall, and put it in the middle of the sheet. He then closed the glass.
entries.literal: "Sai grabbed the Sekimeiya with his sleeves, causing the curtain to fall, and put it in the middle of the sheet. He then closed the glass."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was very cold, so let's see if that changes.
entries.literal: "It was very cold, so let's see if that changes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He wrapped it around with one layer of the cloth and waited a few seconds with his hand over it.
entries.literal: "He wrapped it around with one layer of the cloth and waited a few seconds with his hand over it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...It is getting hot—definitely.
entries.literal: "...It is getting hot—definitely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Atsuki tried it, he agreed as well.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki tried it, he agreed as well."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right, I'm sure there's someone on this floor. Don't take your eyes off the stairs. I'm not sure we'll find them, though.
entries.literal: "All right, I'm sure there's someone on this floor. Don't take your eyes off the stairs. I'm not sure we'll find them, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Why do you say that?
entries.literal: "Why do you say that?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: The last time, the Sekimeiya disappeared from my hands when I walked to the event room, and this time, it disappeared from within the sheet when we were walking to the event room. Could it be related to that?
entries.literal: "The last time, the Sekimeiya disappeared from my hands when I walked to the event room, and this time, it disappeared from within the sheet when we were walking to the event room. Could it be related to that?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Back then, you said it was burning and you could hardly hold it. Is it possible it teleports when it gets too hot?
entries.literal: "Back then, you said it was burning and you could hardly hold it. Is it possible it teleports when it gets too hot?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: And the next time we found it, it wasn't working. It could be that...
entries.literal: "And the next time we found it, it wasn't working. It could be that..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's working now, but we can test it. If the outer layer of the sheet felt hot for Isla, it's possible that it making the sheet hot made it heat up even more quickly.
entries.literal: "It's working now, but we can test it. If the outer layer of the sheet felt hot for Isla, it's possible that it making the sheet hot made it heat up even more quickly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai wrapped the Sekimeiya up completely once again.
entries.literal: "Sai wrapped the Sekimeiya up completely once again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Like this, I can't easily tell if the Sekimeiya's still in here or not.
entries.literal: "Like this, I can't easily tell if the Sekimeiya's still in here or not."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We waited a bit, but ultimately, to know if it had disappeared, the ball would have to be unwrapped.
entries.literal: "We waited a bit, but ultimately, to know if it had disappeared, the ball would have to be unwrapped."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You remember when it disappeared the last time, right? Immediately after that, our footprints vanished from the attic...
entries.literal: "You remember when it disappeared the last time, right? Immediately after that, our footprints vanished from the attic..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose I can try leaving and entering this room, if that's what's doing it.
entries.literal: "I suppose I can try leaving and entering this room, if that's what's doing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He picked up the sheet and went in and out of the door a couple times.
entries.literal: "He picked up the sheet and went in and out of the door a couple times."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It seems that if it disappears, it appears somewhere close by. It might be impossible to understand what it's doing, though, and we can at least keep it locked up if we have it.
entries.literal: "It seems that if it disappears, it appears somewhere close by. It might be impossible to understand what it's doing, though, and we can at least keep it locked up if we have it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...There's no way I'm no longer holding it, right? It must still be in the center of the sheet. Let's just finish the search.
entries.literal: "...There's no way I'm no longer holding it, right? It must still be in the center of the sheet. Let's just finish the search."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai dropped the ball on the floor of hallway A, where he could view the staircase as well. He grabbed one edge of the sheet and began to unroll it.
entries.literal: "Sai dropped the ball on the floor of hallway A, where he could view the staircase as well. He grabbed one edge of the sheet and began to unroll it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I think it's still he—
entries.literal: "...I think it's still he—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sheet disappeared.{w} Between Sai's hands, not only had the sheet vanished, but also the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "The sheet disappeared.{w} Between Sai's hands, not only had the sheet vanished, but also the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It did happen again...
entries.literal: "It did happen again..."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I was able to see that the Sekimeiya was there. It disappeared when Sai touched it.
entries.literal: "I was able to see that the Sekimeiya was there. It disappeared when Sai touched it."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: But why is the sheet gone too...?
entries.literal: "But why is the sheet gone too...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I couldn't touch it anymore because of how hot it was. That could be why it also disappeared—Isla was touching it when the Sekimeiya teleported the previous time.
entries.literal: "I couldn't touch it anymore because of how hot it was. That could be why it also disappeared—Isla was touching it when the Sekimeiya teleported the previous time."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: She couldn't have touched the Sekimeiya itself, though.
entries.literal: "She couldn't have touched the Sekimeiya itself, though."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh—!{w} Oh my God, I almost had a heart attack!
entries.literal: "Wh—!{w} Oh my God, I almost had a heart attack!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The door! It fucking closed!
entries.literal: "The door! It fucking closed!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai stood up rapidly and opened the event room, but he didn't see anyone.
entries.literal: "Sai stood up rapidly and opened the event room, but he didn't see anyone."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It didn't make a sound. ...Was it the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "It didn't make a sound. ...Was it the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai uncovered the cabinet's curtain, but that time, it was empty and still unlocked. I noticed that the hallway B door was slightly open—I thought that had changed too.
entries.literal: "Sai uncovered the cabinet's curtain, but that time, it was empty and still unlocked. I noticed that the hallway B door was slightly open—I thought that had changed too."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is going way beyond me. If there's someone on this floor, let's just fucking find them.{w} I have no idea if we were right. Maybe if the Sekimeiya overheats, it teleports away, but only this time it happened when it was touched.
entries.literal: "This is going way beyond me. If there's someone on this floor, let's just fucking find them.{w} I have no idea if we were right. Maybe if the Sekimeiya overheats, it teleports away, but only this time it happened when it was touched."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai went straight to the storeroom and came back with the information we needed to know the most.
entries.literal: "Sai went straight to the storeroom and came back with the information we needed to know the most."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...It hasn't been opened again.
entries.literal: "...It hasn't been opened again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That made everyone even tenser. The chance to find the culprit was closer than ever.
entries.literal: "That made everyone even tenser. The chance to find the culprit was closer than ever."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Fuck... Let's hurry. The Sekimeiya might've appeared on this floor.{w} I didn't think this through. If someone's actually here, there's a chance it'll allow them to escape.
entries.literal: "Fuck... Let's hurry. The Sekimeiya might've appeared on this floor.{w} I didn't think this through. If someone's actually here, there's a chance it'll allow them to escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like before, while Erina and Isla stayed outside, all of us went to inspect every individual room.
entries.literal: "Like before, while Erina and Isla stayed outside, all of us went to inspect every individual room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was first to enter room A1. Within one of the cabinets, I found the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I was first to enter room A1. Within one of the cabinets, I found the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hesitated a little, but I had no reason to keep it to myself anymore, and it was going to be found anyway. I made sure not to touch it directly and brought it to the hallway.
entries.literal: "I hesitated a little, but I had no reason to keep it to myself anymore, and it was going to be found anyway. I made sure not to touch it directly and brought it to the hallway."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You found it? Thank God.
entries.literal: "You found it? Thank God."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Was it inside a cabinet again?
entries.literal: "...Was it inside a cabinet again?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not locked anymore.
entries.literal: "It's not locked anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We faced Sai and saw he'd opened the security room. When most of us ran in, we were met with the many powered-off screens.
entries.literal: "We faced Sai and saw he'd opened the security room. When most of us ran in, we were met with the many powered-off screens."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai pressed the computer's power button, and it started up.
entries.literal: "Sai pressed the computer's power button, and it started up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, right after that, it automatically shut down.
entries.literal: "However, right after that, it automatically shut down."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell? Is some piece of hardware not being detected?
entries.literal: "What the hell? Is some piece of hardware not being detected?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hey! Come to the lobby...!
entries.literal: "Hey! Come to the lobby...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro's strained voice made us abandon the computer. Behind the door to the lobby, déjà vu was what awaited us.
entries.literal: "Akaro's strained voice made us abandon the computer. Behind the door to the lobby, déjà vu was what awaited us."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: She's gone...! Again...
entries.literal: "She's gone...! Again..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now two bodies have disappeared, and both of them were definitely dead. If they're not on this floor, I'm just lost.
entries.literal: "Now two bodies have disappeared, and both of them were definitely dead. If they're not on this floor, I'm just lost."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Wait, no. I'm so stupid...
entries.literal: "Wait, no. I'm so stupid..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What have you done?
entries.literal: "What have you done?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I know it looks like she vanished, but I think there's more to it.{w} Naomi and the policeman are still here, but do you remember when I brought both bodies to the lobby? I don't think the policeman was here.
entries.literal: "I know it looks like she vanished, but I think there's more to it.{w} Naomi and the policeman are still here, but do you remember when I brought both bodies to the lobby? I don't think the policeman was here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Excuse me?
entries.literal: "...Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I think... I just placed them near the door and hardly paid attention. I think I didn't realize the policeman had disappeared. I remember this part of the floor being completely empty for the second I looked at it.
entries.literal: "I think... I just placed them near the door and hardly paid attention. I think I didn't realize the policeman had disappeared. I remember this part of the floor being completely empty for the second I looked at it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We could hardly be surprised anymore, and there was very little reason to doubt Akaro.
entries.literal: "We could hardly be surprised anymore, and there was very little reason to doubt Akaro."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So, the policeman disappeared and reappeared...? Let's make sure we can't find the other bodies before I go insane.{w} ...Oh wait, look at Naomi's head.
entries.literal: "So, the policeman disappeared and reappeared...? Let's make sure we can't find the other bodies before I go insane.{w} ...Oh wait, look at Naomi's head."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the wound she had, quite a bit of blood was pouring out.
entries.literal: "From the wound she had, quite a bit of blood was pouring out."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes, more blood is coming out than before.
entries.literal: "Yes, more blood is coming out than before."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And it seems like it started just now, right? Otherwise, the pool on the floor would be much bigger.
entries.literal: "And it seems like it started just now, right? Otherwise, the pool on the floor would be much bigger."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: You're right...
entries.literal: "You're right..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina had kept Isla close to hallway C so that she wouldn't go near the lobby. Hammered by a thousand new questions, we confirmed there was nothing in the room below us. Afterward, I had something to say.
entries.literal: "Erina had kept Isla close to hallway C so that she wouldn't go near the lobby. Hammered by a thousand new questions, we confirmed there was nothing in the room below us. Afterward, I had something to say."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: The Sekimeiya isn't getting hotter yet. That's not normal, right?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya isn't getting hotter yet. That's not normal, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, is it not working again?
entries.literal: "Oh, is it not working again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai felt my sleeve and confirmed that it wasn't hot at all.
entries.literal: "Sai felt my sleeve and confirmed that it wasn't hot at all."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: It's just like before. After teleporting, it doesn't work.
entries.literal: "It's just like before. After teleporting, it doesn't work."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Right.
entries.literal: "...Right."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: We'll just leave it in the cabinet. We only have hallway B left.
entries.literal: "We'll just leave it in the cabinet. We only have hallway B left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Knowing that thinking about anything would be useless until every room was searched, we entered hallway B. There, the same procedure started.
entries.literal: "Knowing that thinking about anything would be useless until every room was searched, we entered hallway B. There, the same procedure started."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We moved in coordination from room to room, looking at every cabinet along the way. Rapidly, the number of remaining places decreased as we approached the bathrooms.
entries.literal: "We moved in coordination from room to room, looking at every cabinet along the way. Rapidly, the number of remaining places decreased as we approached the bathrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, there were none left. In no location had there been a person or either of the bodies that had vanished. In addition, according to Sai, the storeroom door hadn't opened again. The answer, no matter what it was, must've hinged on the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Finally, there were none left. In no location had there been a person or either of the bodies that had vanished. In addition, according to Sai, the storeroom door hadn't opened again. The answer, no matter what it was, must've hinged on the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...There's nothing else we can do. Even if there really is someone with us, they know how to not be found. It's very clear that whatever's been happening here is way over our heads.
entries.literal: "...There's nothing else we can do. Even if there really is someone with us, they know how to not be found. It's very clear that whatever's been happening here is way over our heads."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai felt my sleeve again. Failing to notice any heat, he touched the Sekimeiya, and nothing happened.
entries.literal: "Sai felt my sleeve again. Failing to notice any heat, he touched the Sekimeiya, and nothing happened."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Don't touch it again. Our priority at this point is just to make it out of here safely.
entries.literal: "Don't touch it again. Our priority at this point is just to make it out of here safely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was really no rebuttal to that. Since we'd been unable to figure anything out, a sensation lingered: if we truly were up against a real culprit, we were no match for them. And supposing multiple people had died due to being threats to that person, our single goal was not to become a threat ourselves.
entries.literal: "There was really no rebuttal to that. Since we'd been unable to figure anything out, a sensation lingered: if we truly were up against a real culprit, we were no match for them. And supposing multiple people had died due to being threats to that person, our single goal was not to become a threat ourselves."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had just performed a perfect search. There was no room for anyone to be hiding, and as a result, there was absolutely nothing more we could do to fight back. We had to resign ourselves to passing the time and nothing more.
entries.literal: "We had just performed a perfect search. There was no room for anyone to be hiding, and as a result, there was absolutely nothing more we could do to fight back. We had to resign ourselves to passing the time and nothing more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to Erina and Isla was the elevator. We walked to it, following Sai.
entries.literal: "Next to Erina and Isla was the elevator. We walked to it, following Sai."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The elevator was in the attic when we left, but I didn't count on the buttons getting reattached. I can think of one escape route.{w} We saw that the call button was there on the second floor. When we were inspecting the offices, perhaps they called the elevator. If it came from the attic, we wouldn't have heard it since we were on the same floor as the elevator.{w} Similarly, if they immediately took it to escape to another floor, we wouldn't have heard that either.
entries.literal: "The elevator was in the attic when we left, but I didn't count on the buttons getting reattached. I can think of one escape route.{w} We saw that the call button was there on the second floor. When we were inspecting the offices, perhaps they called the elevator. If it came from the attic, we wouldn't have heard it since we were on the same floor as the elevator.{w} Similarly, if they immediately took it to escape to another floor, we wouldn't have heard that either."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: N-No, that couldn't have happened.
entries.literal: "N-No, that couldn't have happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No? What do you mean?
entries.literal: "No? What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: Someone was always watching the stairs and elevator since we came to the crystal floor, right?
entries.literal: "Someone was always watching the stairs and elevator since we came to the crystal floor, right?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: So look. The elevator is open.
entries.literal: "So look. The elevator is open."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh-What?{w} You're... right.
entries.literal: "Wh-What?{w} You're... right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door wasn't properly closed; a tiny gap was keeping it open.
entries.literal: "The door wasn't properly closed; a tiny gap was keeping it open."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's nothing. All the buttons are gone. Even the blood is.{w} But I see what you mean. The elevator had to be here with the door open since we arrived, so if the culprit took it on the second floor, they got off here.
entries.literal: "There's nothing. All the buttons are gone. Even the blood is.{w} But I see what you mean. The elevator had to be here with the door open since we arrived, so if the culprit took it on the second floor, they got off here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...This doesn't make any sense. How did the elevator get here? If it came before us, we would've heard it.
entries.literal: "...This doesn't make any sense. How did the elevator get here? If it came before us, we would've heard it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, I can only think of the way I said. When we were on the second floor, our mystery person called it, which was imperceptible for us. They brought it here, left with all the panels, and kept the door open. ...That's the only thing that makes any sense, but it still doesn't explain how the hell they managed to not be found.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I can only think of the way I said. When we were on the second floor, our mystery person called it, which was imperceptible for us. They brought it here, left with all the panels, and kept the door open. ...That's the only thing that makes any sense, but it still doesn't explain how the hell they managed to not be found."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I guess there's one way.{w} The Sekimeiya disappeared from the sheet Isla was carrying, right? And we found it inside the cabinet in the event room.{w} Even if the killer was here, they couldn't have escaped with the Sekimeiya because they would've left the cabinet glass open. I guess it's possible they found it somewhere else, and it teleported to the cabinet after they touched it. That's all I can think.
entries.literal: "I guess there's one way.{w} The Sekimeiya disappeared from the sheet Isla was carrying, right? And we found it inside the cabinet in the event room.{w} Even if the killer was here, they couldn't have escaped with the Sekimeiya because they would've left the cabinet glass open. I guess it's possible they found it somewhere else, and it teleported to the cabinet after they touched it. That's all I can think."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our conclusion didn't change. There was absolutely nothing we could do.
entries.literal: "Our conclusion didn't change. There was absolutely nothing we could do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We placed the Sekimeiya in the cabinet and locked it.
entries.literal: "We placed the Sekimeiya in the cabinet and locked it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Afterward...
entries.literal: "Afterward..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had the chance to go to the security room and saw Atsuki was already there. The time displayed on the BIOS was {time=15:45}, which was five minutes after locking up the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I had the chance to go to the security room and saw Atsuki was already there. The time displayed on the BIOS was {time=15:45}, which was five minutes after locking up the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei was drawn in by the open door when the computer had already been shut down. He said he wanted to get to the bottom of the issue, so we left him behind, working in his room.
entries.literal: "Katei was drawn in by the open door when the computer had already been shut down. He said he wanted to get to the bottom of the issue, so we left him behind, working in his room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite Erina saying that she and Isla would go back to the attic after we finished searching, they were still on the crystal floor. Two corpses had disappeared, and the search indicated that one of us was likely the culprit, so Erina had no problem accepting Isla's request to stay in room A1.
entries.literal: "Despite Erina saying that she and Isla would go back to the attic after we finished searching, they were still on the crystal floor. Two corpses had disappeared, and the search indicated that one of us was likely the culprit, so Erina had no problem accepting Isla's request to stay in room A1."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It finally began to feel like our goal was waiting for the exit to unlock. For many minutes, nothing happened.
entries.literal: "It finally began to feel like our goal was waiting for the exit to unlock. For many minutes, nothing happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Akaro were in the lobby, avoiding the sight of the blood flowing out of Naomi's head. Atsuki sat on the staircase in hallway C.{w} ...I roamed around the floor a couple of times, and none of those positions changed.
entries.literal: "Sai and Akaro were in the lobby, avoiding the sight of the blood flowing out of Naomi's head. Atsuki sat on the staircase in hallway C.{w} ...I roamed around the floor a couple of times, and none of those positions changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were five hours left until {time=21}, and I'd never been good at waiting around. It didn't seem like anyone had more business with the Sekimeiya or any interest in continuing to argue. While that was the ideal scenario, having to simply wait began to stress me out.
entries.literal: "There were five hours left until {time=21}, and I'd never been good at waiting around. It didn't seem like anyone had more business with the Sekimeiya or any interest in continuing to argue. While that was the ideal scenario, having to simply wait began to stress me out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Over the span of an hour, I was the only person wandering around. Nobody said anything to me as they waited patiently.
entries.literal: "Over the span of an hour, I was the only person wandering around. Nobody said anything to me as they waited patiently."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My body started to severely reject the repetitive colors of the walls, and going over all the gems had only been entertaining for so long. I walked to the staircase, where Atsuki was.
entries.literal: "My body started to severely reject the repetitive colors of the walls, and going over all the gems had only been entertaining for so long. I walked to the staircase, where Atsuki was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Apparently, he was there to keep an eye on the storeroom so that nobody could enter the building. Before I could say anything, he asked me to briefly take over for him as he attempted to use the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Apparently, he was there to keep an eye on the storeroom so that nobody could enter the building. Before I could say anything, he asked me to briefly take over for him as he attempted to use the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Silently, we unlocked the cabinet, but it didn't seem like the Sekimeiya had started working.
entries.literal: "Silently, we unlocked the cabinet, but it didn't seem like the Sekimeiya had started working."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I'm going to the attic.
entries.literal: "I'm going to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't think anyone had left the crystal floor in a while, and even though staying with the rest was safer, we'd confirmed every floor was empty.
entries.literal: "I didn't think anyone had left the crystal floor in a while, and even though staying with the rest was safer, we'd confirmed every floor was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But it didn't make any sense. Who had removed the bodies? Who had messed with the elevator buttons? Who had opened the storeroom door?
entries.literal: "...But it didn't make any sense. Who had removed the bodies? Who had messed with the elevator buttons? Who had opened the storeroom door?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki sounded hesitant at first, but he dropped it quickly. The tiredness was kicking in, and I missed letting the time pass on a bed.
entries.literal: "Atsuki sounded hesitant at first, but he dropped it quickly. The tiredness was kicking in, and I missed letting the time pass on a bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the elevator, which I still found unsettling, and opened the door.
entries.literal: "I looked at the elevator, which I still found unsettling, and opened the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was empty. There was nobody inside. No buttons, and no blood either...
entries.literal: "It was empty. There was nobody inside. No buttons, and no blood either..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up instead. As I ascended the floors, the thought strengthened: what were we doing? Someone else was with us.
entries.literal: "I walked up instead. As I ascended the floors, the thought strengthened: what were we doing? Someone else was with us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The button had been attached on the third floor.
entries.literal: "The button had been attached on the third floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And on the fourth, on the fifth, on the sixth... I arrived at the attic door and noticed that the key was no longer inserted into the keyhole.
entries.literal: "...And on the fourth, on the fifth, on the sixth... I arrived at the attic door and noticed that the key was no longer inserted into the keyhole."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned the doorknob and opened the door slowly. It was still unlocked.
entries.literal: "I turned the doorknob and opened the door slowly. It was still unlocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I fixed my eyes on the floor of the living room. Our footprints were faded, and it didn't seem like anyone had been there recently.
entries.literal: "I fixed my eyes on the floor of the living room. Our footprints were faded, and it didn't seem like anyone had been there recently."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to the elevator was a metallic panel with its button, exactly where it was designed to be. It only made my head feel more numb. Had someone really reattached all of them when we hadn't been looking?
entries.literal: "Next to the elevator was a metallic panel with its button, exactly where it was designed to be. It only made my head feel more numb. Had someone really reattached all of them when we hadn't been looking?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I approached both bedrooms. Even though I couldn't sense anyone around, I wasn't going to look.
entries.literal: "...I approached both bedrooms. Even though I couldn't sense anyone around, I wasn't going to look."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the left door and sat on the bed.
entries.literal: "I opened the left door and sat on the bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way I could feel comfortable. The uneasiness immobilized me for a long time until I was able to lie down.
entries.literal: "There was no way I could feel comfortable. The uneasiness immobilized me for a long time until I was able to lie down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had my purse next to me, and that time, I shut the light off. That finally allowed me to close my eyes and hope that the next time I opened them, I could walk out of the tower.
entries.literal: "I had my purse next to me, and that time, I shut the light off. That finally allowed me to close my eyes and hope that the next time I opened them, I could walk out of the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't realize I'd fallen asleep, but a noise caused me to wake up. Once I regained my senses, I sharpened them to try to distinguish what I'd heard, but nothing else reached me.
entries.literal: "I didn't realize I'd fallen asleep, but a noise caused me to wake up. Once I regained my senses, I sharpened them to try to distinguish what I'd heard, but nothing else reached me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The situation repeated. I felt like I'd blinked in and out of existence, but the sound that woke me the second time was louder.
entries.literal: "The situation repeated. I felt like I'd blinked in and out of existence, but the sound that woke me the second time was louder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to me, the door opened.
entries.literal: "Next to me, the door opened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then the light came on. I had my face under the sheet, facing the wall. With no strength to react, I waited.
entries.literal: "Then the light came on. I had my face under the sheet, facing the wall. With no strength to react, I waited."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Are you awake?"{w} It was Atsuki's voice.
entries.literal: "\"Are you awake?\"{w} It was Atsuki's voice."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to reply, so I kept quiet, figuring that if he had something important to say, he'd try to wake me up.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to reply, so I kept quiet, figuring that if he had something important to say, he'd try to wake me up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead, the light turned back off.
entries.literal: "Instead, the light turned back off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, so did I.
entries.literal: "Soon, so did I."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The faintest sounds kept waking me up. They had started coming from above me.
