entries.literal: "The faintest sounds kept waking me up. They had started coming from above me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone had gone up the ladder.{w} I tried not to mind it and keep sleeping.
entries.literal: "Someone had gone up the ladder.{w} I tried not to mind it and keep sleeping."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I felt almost rested, as if I'd slept for hours. Minutes after failing to sleep again, I stretched my limbs and yawned deeply.
entries.literal: "However, I felt almost rested, as if I'd slept for hours. Minutes after failing to sleep again, I stretched my limbs and yawned deeply."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was very dark, but my purse was still on the bed. I grabbed it, slowly sat up, and then stood.
entries.literal: "It was very dark, but my purse was still on the bed. I grabbed it, slowly sat up, and then stood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no sense of space, but it wasn't unpleasant. It couldn't be too late in the day either—it was likely Atsuki or someone would come get me before the deadline, and Katei probably wouldn't be a fan of Ashiya entering the tower and finding someone sleeping in the attic.
entries.literal: "I had no sense of space, but it wasn't unpleasant. It couldn't be too late in the day either—it was likely Atsuki or someone would come get me before the deadline, and Katei probably wouldn't be a fan of Ashiya entering the tower and finding someone sleeping in the attic."

entries.text: The Pond
entries.literal: "The Pond"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, the light turned on. I found myself standing in the middle of the room, alone.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, the light turned on. I found myself standing in the middle of the room, alone."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...{w}Did you do that? Are you Atsuki?
entries.literal: "...{w}Did you do that? Are you Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the ceiling, figuring someone above me had flipped the switch, but there was no response.
entries.literal: "I looked at the ceiling, figuring someone above me had flipped the switch, but there was no response."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead, a petrifying yell came from the door.
entries.literal: "Instead, a petrifying yell came from the door."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: ...oor! ...re you!?
entries.literal: "...oor! ...re you!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the closed door before slowly approaching, wondering if I was losing it.
entries.literal: "I stared at the closed door before slowly approaching, wondering if I was losing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned the handle gently and peered into the hallway. The voice was coming from in front of me.
entries.literal: "I turned the handle gently and peered into the hallway. The voice was coming from in front of me."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: I just heard you! Please, open the door!
entries.literal: "I just heard you! Please, open the door!"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...How is this possible? It's her again.
entries.literal: "...How is this possible? It's her again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't taken aback anymore or even afraid. I just wanted out.
entries.literal: "I wasn't taken aback anymore or even afraid. I just wanted out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Between the two bedrooms, I wondered if I was being consciously punished. That couldn't be.
entries.literal: "Between the two bedrooms, I wondered if I was being consciously punished. That couldn't be."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But as much as I despised it, it was reality. Once again, the obvious laws of the world were being flagrantly defied.
entries.literal: "But as much as I despised it, it was reality. Once again, the obvious laws of the world were being flagrantly defied."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: ...You're still here, right? What are you planning?
entries.literal: "...You're still here, right? What are you planning?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was she actually talking to me? I had no idea.
entries.literal: "Was she actually talking to me? I had no idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I wanted to know what was happening, I knew I wouldn't try to open the door. Instead, concealing my presence as much as possible, I stepped back to the living room.
entries.literal: "While I wanted to know what was happening, I knew I wouldn't try to open the door. Instead, concealing my presence as much as possible, I stepped back to the living room."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I know you're here! At least answer!
entries.literal: "I know you're here! At least answer!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't tell anymore if she was still yelling. I looked down and saw recent footprints going from the hallway to the staircase.
entries.literal: "I couldn't tell anymore if she was still yelling. I looked down and saw recent footprints going from the hallway to the staircase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gripped the handle and tried to open the door.{w} It was locked.
entries.literal: "I gripped the handle and tried to open the door.{w} It was locked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From my purse, I took the keys out and got the door to open.
entries.literal: "From my purse, I took the keys out and got the door to open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the other side, I inserted the key into the keyhole again and rotated it.
entries.literal: "On the other side, I inserted the key into the keyhole again and rotated it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know whether to keep going forward. The sixth floor felt desolate, and I had no objective. Perhaps not trying to find out what was happening was smarter.
entries.literal: "I didn't know whether to keep going forward. The sixth floor felt desolate, and I had no objective. Perhaps not trying to find out what was happening was smarter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, someone had been above me in the bedroom, and they hadn't answered my question. That was what made me keep walking away from the door.
entries.literal: "However, someone had been above me in the bedroom, and they hadn't answered my question. That was what made me keep walking away from the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked down the next staircase as the echo of my own footsteps accompanied me. If people were still waiting in the lobby, I could stay there.
entries.literal: "I walked down the next staircase as the echo of my own footsteps accompanied me. If people were still waiting in the lobby, I could stay there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hardly felt like I was alive as I descended the mirrored floors; the entire sequence of events felt like nothing more than a dream. I trudged through all of them until a gray door was in front of me.
entries.literal: "I hardly felt like I was alive as I descended the mirrored floors; the entire sequence of events felt like nothing more than a dream. I trudged through all of them until a gray door was in front of me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki was no longer sitting on the lowest step behind it. Instead, there was a trail of fresh blood.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was no longer sitting on the lowest step behind it. Instead, there was a trail of fresh blood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The floor had a strange smell to it. It could've been the same one we'd smelled throughout the day, but I didn't think that was all.
entries.literal: "The floor had a strange smell to it. It could've been the same one we'd smelled throughout the day, but I didn't think that was all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Cautiously, I walked to the lobby. The blood I'd seen shouldn't have been enough to cause someone to die, but there was an imposing, foreboding atmosphere permeating the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Cautiously, I walked to the lobby. The blood I'd seen shouldn't have been enough to cause someone to die, but there was an imposing, foreboding atmosphere permeating the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Nobody.
entries.literal: "...Nobody."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The two bodies had disappeared with almost all the blood, and only the shutter remained. Partially unable to believe it, I took timid steps toward the center of the lobby, where I saw that its emptiness was absolute.
entries.literal: "The two bodies had disappeared with almost all the blood, and only the shutter remained. Partially unable to believe it, I took timid steps toward the center of the lobby, where I saw that its emptiness was absolute."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I opened the hallway B door, the sensation was identical. Was it possible I was alone?
entries.literal: "When I opened the hallway B door, the sensation was identical. Was it possible I was alone?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The urge to find someone increased. I didn't want to go back to the attic despite knowing it was inhabited. I tried to uncoil my tightly wound muscles and opened my mouth.
entries.literal: "The urge to find someone increased. I didn't want to go back to the attic despite knowing it was inhabited. I tried to uncoil my tightly wound muscles and opened my mouth."

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: ...Hey! Is anyone there...!?
entries.literal: "...Hey! Is anyone there...!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I received no answer, but one of the open doors grabbed my attention. It was the staff room's.
entries.literal: "I received no answer, but one of the open doors grabbed my attention. It was the staff room's."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It stood out, as it was very slightly open.
entries.literal: "It stood out, as it was very slightly open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached it, but once inside, I wasn't sure it'd been the right call.
entries.literal: "I approached it, but once inside, I wasn't sure it'd been the right call."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood still and smelled the air. It was somehow fairly strong, but it wasn't a particular smell anymore.
entries.literal: "I stood still and smelled the air. It was somehow fairly strong, but it wasn't a particular smell anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something Atsuki had said came to mind. One of the keys I had could belong to Naomi's locker. We hadn't tried that yet.
entries.literal: "Something Atsuki had said came to mind. One of the keys I had could belong to Naomi's locker. We hadn't tried that yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If he was right, the possibility that a phone could be found was nonzero. I looked at the keys on my palm and figured the smallest one could fit in the lockers.
entries.literal: "If he was right, the possibility that a phone could be found was nonzero. I looked at the keys on my palm and figured the smallest one could fit in the lockers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I inserted it into the first one and tried to turn it. However, the whole locker shook, refusing to open.
entries.literal: "I inserted it into the first one and tried to turn it. However, the whole locker shook, refusing to open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, a metallic sound rang out right in front of me. Something had hit the locker from the inside.
entries.literal: "Then, a metallic sound rang out right in front of me. Something had hit the locker from the inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked up and saw three slits in the door. Despite the darkness that should've existed behind them, I discerned a glow.
entries.literal: "I looked up and saw three slits in the door. Despite the darkness that should've existed behind them, I discerned a glow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It could only have been one thing. Despite being filled with questions, my mind was blank. My hand was drawn to the shape that had begun to take form behind the dark lines, and through the narrow space, I made contact, hoping with all my might that I would be brought to the awaited time.
entries.literal: "It could only have been one thing. Despite being filled with questions, my mind was blank. My hand was drawn to the shape that had begun to take form behind the dark lines, and through the narrow space, I made contact, hoping with all my might that I would be brought to the awaited time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, hallway A was my next sight.
entries.literal: "However, hallway A was my next sight."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=1.0}Then, I fell to the floor immediately after appearing.
entries.literal: "{w=1.0}Then, I fell to the floor immediately after appearing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Disoriented and confused, I stood back up. I had no way to know how far I'd been sent.
entries.literal: "Disoriented and confused, I stood back up. I had no way to know how far I'd been sent."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It mustn't have been too long; the hallway looked just as desolate as before. I walked ahead and opened the security room.
entries.literal: "It mustn't have been too long; the hallway looked just as desolate as before. I walked ahead and opened the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: An unexpected realization hit me instantly. Katei was dead—the stench of his blood had been secluded within the room.
entries.literal: "An unexpected realization hit me instantly. Katei was dead—the stench of his blood had been secluded within the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed he had managed to get the computer back to work, its buzzing adding to the surrealness. I approached cautiously, trying not to breathe.
entries.literal: "It seemed he had managed to get the computer back to work, its buzzing adding to the surrealness. I approached cautiously, trying not to breathe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I pressed a key, the three screens lit up, and on the middle one, I saw a message.{w} "{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased".
entries.literal: "When I pressed a key, the three screens lit up, and on the middle one, I saw a message.{w} \"{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased\"."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...At {time=10:04}, the recordings were erased...?
entries.literal: "...At {time=10:04}, the recordings were erased...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The screen also showed the time: {time=18:21.} Directly below it was Katei's head—the epicenter of all the blood. It was beyond doubt that he had been killed as well.
entries.literal: "The screen also showed the time: {time=18:21.} Directly below it was Katei's head—the epicenter of all the blood. It was beyond doubt that he had been killed as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled the person above me, in the bedroom. Who was that, and what had happened while I was asleep?
entries.literal: "I recalled the person above me, in the bedroom. Who was that, and what had happened while I was asleep?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the room behind. From far away, I noticed that the blood I'd seen on the staircase wasn't there yet. Slowly, I directed myself to one of the closed doors in the hallway.
entries.literal: "I left the room behind. From far away, I noticed that the blood I'd seen on the staircase wasn't there yet. Slowly, I directed myself to one of the closed doors in the hallway."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...Wait, that...?
entries.literal: "...Wait, that...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: High up, something caught my attention. Through the smoke, a circular, intermittent green light could be seen on one of the cameras. I spun in place and saw that many of them had it. I remembered that the last time I'd seen that light was very early in the morning.
entries.literal: "High up, something caught my attention. Through the smoke, a circular, intermittent green light could be seen on one of the cameras. I spun in place and saw that many of them had it. I remembered that the last time I'd seen that light was very early in the morning."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...The computer. It reenabled the cameras. This really must mean that they weren't recording until now, right...?
entries.literal: "...The computer. It reenabled the cameras. This really must mean that they weren't recording until now, right...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hopeful, I entered one of the rooms. There was something else I had to see.
entries.literal: "Hopeful, I entered one of the rooms. There was something else I had to see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cabinet was covered by its curtain. If the Sekimeiya was behind it, it was possible someone else was soon to be on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "The cabinet was covered by its curtain. If the Sekimeiya was behind it, it was possible someone else was soon to be on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It wasn't. The cabinet was completely empty. I let go of the curtain and stepped back, startled.
entries.literal: "...It wasn't. The cabinet was completely empty. I let go of the curtain and stepped back, startled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just next to my feet, I'd noticed there was a bit of blood. That made four places I'd seen some.
entries.literal: "Just next to my feet, I'd noticed there was a bit of blood. That made four places I'd seen some."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd run away from the attic, but even if I wanted to go back, it was no guarantee anyone would be there at the moment.
entries.literal: "I'd run away from the attic, but even if I wanted to go back, it was no guarantee anyone would be there at the moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hallway B was still empty, but I understood my situation. Any room could've been hiding a new death.
entries.literal: "Hallway B was still empty, but I understood my situation. Any room could've been hiding a new death."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Now the staff room is closed, unlike many others... Is someone going to enter it soon?
entries.literal: "Now the staff room is closed, unlike many others... Is someone going to enter it soon?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to the center of the hallway, dwarfed by its overwhelming walls. There, I felt genuinely scared for my life. Had I avoided being a target by going to the attic?
entries.literal: "I moved to the center of the hallway, dwarfed by its overwhelming walls. There, I felt genuinely scared for my life. Had I avoided being a target by going to the attic?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unable to decide on whether to go back up, I remained paralyzed.
entries.literal: "Unable to decide on whether to go back up, I remained paralyzed."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Who are you?
entries.literal: "...Who are you?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: E-Erina...! You scared me. Wh-What's with all that blood?{w} Wait, who am I? {tip=miiya}A-Are you...?{/tip}
entries.literal: "E-Erina...! You scared me. Wh-What's with all that blood?{w} Wait, who am I? {tip=miiya}A-Are you...?{/tip}"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Who... are you? I don't think I've seen you before. How did you get here?
entries.literal: "Who... are you? I don't think I've seen you before. How did you get here?"

entries.speaker: c2s
entries.text: I don't know what that means...! I'm Miiya, I've been here the whole time! Do you not remember?
entries.literal: "I don't know what that means...! I'm Miiya, I've been here the whole time! Do you not remember?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: M-Miiya...?{w} My head hurts a lot... I don't remember you.
entries.literal: "M-Miiya...?{w} My head hurts a lot... I don't remember you."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: What happened? Did you get hurt? Where are the others?
entries.literal: "What happened? Did you get hurt? Where are the others?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I got hit in the head, yes. And I don't know. I-I haven't seen anyone in a long time.
entries.literal: "I got hit in the head, yes. And I don't know. I-I haven't seen anyone in a long time."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: How did you get hit? You're covered in blood.
entries.literal: "How did you get hit? You're covered in blood."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't know... I was knocked out from behind.
entries.literal: "I don't know... I was knocked out from behind."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: What...? What happened to the bodies?
entries.literal: "What...? What happened to the bodies?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Naomi and the policeman. Did they disappear?
entries.literal: "Naomi and the policeman. Did they disappear?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Naomi...? No, the first one's there.
entries.literal: "Naomi...? No, the first one's there."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: There? Why?
entries.literal: "There? Why?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached the door.
entries.literal: "I approached the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the floor, two curtains lay, one covering Naomi's body.
entries.literal: "On the floor, two curtains lay, one covering Naomi's body."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: See...?

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Why was she brought here?
entries.literal: "Why was she brought here?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What? Hasn't she been here since she died?
entries.literal: "What? Hasn't she been here since she died?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: No. We brought her to the lobby. Do you really not remember?
entries.literal: "No. We brought her to the lobby. Do you really not remember?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: What about the policeman?
entries.literal: "What about the policeman?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh... What policeman?
entries.literal: "Wh... What policeman?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was definitely not mentally stable. The hit she'd suffered had clearly been grave, and going off the blood, it was likely she only survived due to luck. However, something told me that wasn't it. The dried-up blood on her... Could she have been the body that had disappeared?
entries.literal: "She was definitely not mentally stable. The hit she'd suffered had clearly been grave, and going off the blood, it was likely she only survived due to luck. However, something told me that wasn't it. The dried-up blood on her... Could she have been the body that had disappeared?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at her and forced that thought out of my mind.
entries.literal: "I stared at her and forced that thought out of my mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around the room, figuring there wasn't much to learn from Erina. However, someone had tried to kill her, so my worries had been warranted.
entries.literal: "I looked around the room, figuring there wasn't much to learn from Erina. However, someone had tried to kill her, so my worries had been warranted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I saw the camera, I realized that the green light wasn't there despite the lack of smoke. Then, my attention was grabbed by a temperature regulation wheel next to a cabinet.
entries.literal: "When I saw the camera, I realized that the green light wasn't there despite the lack of smoke. Then, my attention was grabbed by a temperature regulation wheel next to a cabinet."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Why's that broken...?
entries.literal: "Why's that broken...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hm? Oh, yeah... I think that's how we found it.
entries.literal: "Hm? Oh, yeah... I think that's how we found it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked over to it, frowning. How could the wheel have broken? It had been undamaged earlier.
entries.literal: "I walked over to it, frowning. How could the wheel have broken? It had been undamaged earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The temperature was set to 0 °C. I grabbed the bottom of the lid and tried to lift it up. It was locked, so I had to unlock it the way I'd seen it done the last time we'd all searched.
entries.literal: "The temperature was set to 0 °C. I grabbed the bottom of the lid and tried to lift it up. It was locked, so I had to unlock it the way I'd seen it done the last time we'd all searched."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Oh, what...? It's the Sekimeiya. ...And the cabinet is super cold.
entries.literal: "Oh, what...? It's the Sekimeiya. ...And the cabinet is super cold."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The Seki... But we already took it out...
entries.literal: "The Seki... But we already took it out..."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: I don't understand you.
entries.literal: "I don't understand you."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It needs to be put in the cabinet. It could get damaged.
entries.literal: "It needs to be put in the cabinet. It could get damaged."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Oh, y-yes.
entries.literal: "Oh, y-yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached into the cabinet and picked up the Sekimeiya up without directly touching it.{w} It was considerably cold. I didn't think that touching it would send me far through time, but as it could've made me stay trapped in the building for longer, I decided I wouldn't do it again.
entries.literal: "I reached into the cabinet and picked up the Sekimeiya up without directly touching it.{w} It was considerably cold. I didn't think that touching it would send me far through time, but as it could've made me stay trapped in the building for longer, I decided I wouldn't do it again."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Why are you holding it like that?
entries.literal: "...Why are you holding it like that?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Do you not remember that either?
entries.literal: "Do you not remember that either?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...{w}Oh, right...! It can send you to the past.
entries.literal: "...{w}Oh, right...! It can send you to the past."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left to hallway B, unsettled by Erina's attitude, a part of me wondering if she was trying to deceive me.
entries.literal: "I left to hallway B, unsettled by Erina's attitude, a part of me wondering if she was trying to deceive me."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Have you gone to the past?
entries.literal: "...Have you gone to the past?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: What? Y-Yes. I guess you really don't remember.
entries.literal: "What? Y-Yes. I guess you really don't remember."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "...I left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What did you do after?
entries.literal: "What did you do after?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: What does that mean?
entries.literal: "What does that mean?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did you change the past?
entries.literal: "Did you change the past?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: To some degree. Why are you asking this?
entries.literal: "To some degree. Why are you asking this?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Then, this is how...!
entries.literal: "Then, this is how...!"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: When was the last time you saw the others?
entries.literal: "When was the last time you saw the others?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I don't remember.
entries.literal: "...I don't remember."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Oh, in the attic, I think. I haven't gone back.
entries.literal: "...Oh, in the attic, I think. I haven't gone back."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Why not? What about Isla?
entries.literal: "Why not? What about Isla?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I was with her until just now.
entries.literal: "...I was with her until just now."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: What? That's not what you said before.
entries.literal: "What? That's not what you said before."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No...? I didn't say anything about her.
entries.literal: "No...? I didn't say anything about her."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: You said you hadn't seen anyone in a while.
entries.literal: "You said you hadn't seen anyone in a while."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: O-Oh, I guess so. I didn't include her...
entries.literal: "O-Oh, I guess so. I didn't include her..."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Why not? Where did you see her?
entries.literal: "Why not? Where did you see her?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She's still in the same room.
entries.literal: "She's still in the same room."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: What room?
entries.literal: "What room?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered hallway A, and Erina brought me to the farthest crystal room.
entries.literal: "We entered hallway A, and Erina brought me to the farthest crystal room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the center of the smoke-stained walls, one of the cabinets was open. Within it, Isla rested, with a pale and somewhat peaceful expression.
entries.literal: "In the center of the smoke-stained walls, one of the cabinets was open. Within it, Isla rested, with a pale and somewhat peaceful expression."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: W-Wait, she's...?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, she's...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I-I knew it. You weren't here all this time. It wasn't me.
entries.literal: "I-I knew it. You weren't here all this time. It wasn't me."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Of course I've been here! What happened to her?
entries.literal: "Of course I've been here! What happened to her?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Can't you see it? She was... killed. Was it you? You could have done it if it's true that you were here...!
entries.literal: "Can't you see it? She was... killed. Was it you? You could have done it if it's true that you were here...!"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: I don't know what you're talking about. Tell me directly. When did this happen?
entries.literal: "I don't know what you're talking about. Tell me directly. When did this happen?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It was... many hours ago. It's been hours...!
entries.literal: "It was... many hours ago. It's been hours...!"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...{w}That's not true. You're mistaken. It couldn't have been more than three hours ago.
entries.literal: "...{w}That's not true. You're mistaken. It couldn't have been more than three hours ago."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: N-No... It's been more than that.
entries.literal: "N-No... It's been more than that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That wasn't right. I let go of the breath I'd been holding and looked at Isla again. It didn't seem like there was any blood around her, but her immobile face and chest were confirmation enough of her death.
entries.literal: "That wasn't right. I let go of the breath I'd been holding and looked at Isla again. It didn't seem like there was any blood around her, but her immobile face and chest were confirmation enough of her death."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina had gone quiet too, and she was making no effort at hiding how much she was trying to focus. However, the thoughts whirling through her head were indecipherable.
entries.literal: "Erina had gone quiet too, and she was making no effort at hiding how much she was trying to focus. However, the thoughts whirling through her head were indecipherable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited, thinking she'd have something to say at any moment.
entries.literal: "I waited, thinking she'd have something to say at any moment."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Was anyone else killed? I saw Katei's body in the security room.
entries.literal: "Was anyone else killed? I saw Katei's body in the security room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...N-No. I don't think so.
entries.literal: "...N-No. I don't think so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So, the rest were in the attic. I was utterly confused, but that seemed to be the conclusion. It was possible I was sleeping up there at that moment as well.
entries.literal: "So, the rest were in the attic. I was utterly confused, but that seemed to be the conclusion. It was possible I was sleeping up there at that moment as well."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Wha—!?{w=0.3} What are you doing!?
entries.literal: "Wha—!?{w=0.3} What are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I still feel like I've never seen you before. ...Did you lock the cabinet?
entries.literal: "I still feel like I've never seen you before. ...Did you lock the cabinet?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: The cabinet...? No, I didn't.
entries.literal: "The cabinet...? No, I didn't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She had snatched the keys from my purse and was staring at them in her hand.
entries.literal: "She had snatched the keys from my purse and was staring at them in her hand."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: These keys... Why do you have them?{w} Is this one for the cabi—
entries.literal: "These keys... Why do you have them?{w} Is this one for the cabi—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a quick motion, I took them back, and she failed to react.
entries.literal: "With a quick motion, I took them back, and she failed to react."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: I don't get it! What do you—
entries.literal: "I don't get it! What do you—"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...iroya! Hey! Where are you!?
entries.literal: "...iroya! Hey! Where are you!?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Atsuki...!{w} Did he see her?
entries.literal: "Atsuki...!{w} Did he see her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dashed out of the room, paying no mind to Erina's surprise.
entries.literal: "I dashed out of the room, paying no mind to Erina's surprise."

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: Shiroya! Can you hear me!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Can you hear me!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The voice was coming from hallway B. Did that mean she was down there as well?
entries.literal: "The voice was coming from hallway B. Did that mean she was down there as well?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I rapidly reached the staircase and went up half of the way. From behind the gray door, I saw Erina's feet as she wandered in confusion.
entries.literal: "I rapidly reached the staircase and went up half of the way. From behind the gray door, I saw Erina's feet as she wandered in confusion."

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: —re okay, ri—!? If yo— ...me, ple— ...thing!
entries.literal: "—re okay, ri—!? If yo— ...me, ple— ...thing!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound stopped soon after Erina followed it.
entries.literal: "The sound stopped soon after Erina followed it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Did that mean that she'd been found, or had Atsuki given up?
entries.literal: "...Did that mean that she'd been found, or had Atsuki given up?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I'd noticed earlier, the trail of blood had disappeared from there too. That meant it was still to happen.
entries.literal: "As I'd noticed earlier, the trail of blood had disappeared from there too. That meant it was still to happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I began to slowly step down.
entries.literal: "I began to slowly step down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wondered what I'd be told if I showed myself, but it was hard to care about that with how much I wanted to know what the fuck was happening.
entries.literal: "I wondered what I'd be told if I showed myself, but it was hard to care about that with how much I wanted to know what the fuck was happening."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina wasn't there anymore. As I approached hallway B, the voices came back.
entries.literal: "Erina wasn't there anymore. As I approached hallway B, the voices came back."

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: ...earing them earlier, were you...?
entries.literal: "...earing them earlier, were you...?"

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: Who the hell are you? Or even you... How can you two exist!?
entries.literal: "Who the hell are you? Or even you... How can you two exist!?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What? ...Does he really not know why she's here?
entries.literal: "What? ...Does he really not know why she's here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They sounded close to the lobby, but I didn't peek in.
entries.literal: "They sounded close to the lobby, but I didn't peek in."

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: ...not understand? Did— ...pop into existen—
entries.literal: "...not understand? Did— ...pop into existen—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They opened a door. It must've been closer to me, as I started to understand them more easily. Erina was still clearly groggy, but I could make things out.
entries.literal: "They opened a door. It must've been closer to me, as I started to understand them more easily. Erina was still clearly groggy, but I could make things out."

entries.speaker: s4
entries.text: About Erina, I think what happened isn't what you think.
entries.literal: "About Erina, I think what happened isn't what you think."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What's with that tone of voice? When did she even get to know Erina?
entries.literal: "What's with that tone of voice? When did she even get to know Erina?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Erina even accused me of not being here previously, so why didn't she say that to her too?{w} She's the one who hasn't been here, and earlier, it sounded like she was locked in the attic. Did the person above me do that? And that still has yet to happen...
entries.literal: "Erina even accused me of not being here previously, so why didn't she say that to her too?{w} She's the one who hasn't been here, and earlier, it sounded like she was locked in the attic. Did the person above me do that? And that still has yet to happen..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm not sure... I remember I was drawn to this room, and then I think I blacked out.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure... I remember I was drawn to this room, and then I think I blacked out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was close to what she'd told me.
entries.literal: "That was close to what she'd told me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?
entries.literal: "...Are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I wish I could explain everything to you, but I still don't really know what happened.{w} But, yes. I'm really glad to see you again.
entries.literal: "...I wish I could explain everything to you, but I still don't really know what happened.{w} But, yes. I'm really glad to see you again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I didn't understand Atsuki's question, it was clear something had happened while I was asleep. It all sounded like she was alive and neither of them knew how that had come to occur.
entries.literal: "While I didn't understand Atsuki's question, it was clear something had happened while I was asleep. It all sounded like she was alive and neither of them knew how that had come to occur."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What's with those clothes, then? Why is the cross not on them? Why did you ignore me when we saw each other in the event room and when I kept shouting your name?
entries.literal: "Wh-What's with those clothes, then? Why is the cross not on them? Why did you ignore me when we saw each other in the event room and when I kept shouting your name?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Well, I—
entries.literal: "...Well, I—"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hey... I'm still confused, but I have a question.
entries.literal: "Hey... I'm still confused, but I have a question."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The Sekimeiya... does it really make you travel through time?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya... does it really make you travel through time?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...A girl? You saw Shiroya?
entries.literal: "...A girl? You saw Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Um...{w} I guess it couldn't have been anyone else.{w} ...It must have been Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Um...{w} I guess it couldn't have been anyone else.{w} ...It must have been Shiroya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina asked for the Sekimeiya, but it sounded like neither of them knew where it was. However, despite Erina's condition, we had brought it to the event room minutes earlier, so she wasn't satisfied when she was told it wasn't there.
entries.literal: "Erina asked for the Sekimeiya, but it sounded like neither of them knew where it was. However, despite Erina's condition, we had brought it to the event room minutes earlier, so she wasn't satisfied when she was told it wasn't there."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's not it at all... Remember that Sai and Akaro took the cabinet key. They probably have the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "That's not it at all... Remember that Sai and Akaro took the cabinet key. They probably have the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Their words continued to make no sense. I was the one who had the key.
entries.literal: "Their words continued to make no sense. I was the one who had the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...They entered the event room. As soon as the door closed, it acted as a barrier for the sound inside.
entries.literal: "...They entered the event room. As soon as the door closed, it acted as a barrier for the sound inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I was certain the hallway was empty, I stepped in.
entries.literal: "Once I was certain the hallway was empty, I stepped in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached the door and placed my ear against it.
entries.literal: "I approached the door and placed my ear against it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't hear anything.
entries.literal: "I couldn't hear anything."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did they leave?
entries.literal: "Did they leave?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, I heard a sound coming from the room. The opposite door had opened.
entries.literal: "Finally, I heard a sound coming from the room. The opposite door had opened."

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: ...fuck— ...ing here?{w=0.4} ...succ— ...plan of—
entries.literal: "...fuck— ...ing here?{w=0.4} ...succ— ...plan of—"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: This door is too thick to make anything out... It sounds like he's close to the cabinet.
entries.literal: "This door is too thick to make anything out... It sounds like he's close to the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recognized Sai's voice, but not what he said.
entries.literal: "I recognized Sai's voice, but not what he said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For as long as I stayed there, I didn't comprehend anything.{w} I knew I could be found out easily, but I wasn't against that. In fact, I considered opening the door, but I would listen from a distance for as long as I could.
entries.literal: "For as long as I stayed there, I didn't comprehend anything.{w} I knew I could be found out easily, but I wasn't against that. In fact, I considered opening the door, but I would listen from a distance for as long as I could."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I silently entered the staff room. Then, I placed my ear against the left wall, which was directly next to the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I silently entered the staff room. Then, I placed my ear against the left wall, which was directly next to the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...as that?
entries.literal: "...as that?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Don't mind me, like you said.
entries.literal: "Don't mind me, like you said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was still hard to hear Sai, but the thin wall made Atsuki's voice interpretable.
entries.literal: "It was still hard to hear Sai, but the thin wall made Atsuki's voice interpretable."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's just a personal paper. ...nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It's just a personal paper. ...nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Ve—
entries.literal: "Ve—"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: So, did any of you see Miiya...?
entries.literal: "So, did any of you see Miiya...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There...! Is she gonna say it?
entries.literal: "There...! Is she gonna say it?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You don't know her, right? I... I knew I wasn't going insane.
entries.literal: "You don't know her, right? I... I knew I wasn't going insane."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: H-How do you know that name?
entries.literal: "H-How do you know that name?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She's the person I was with earlier, before I saw you two... It just came back to me. I don't know where she went, though.
entries.literal: "She's the person I was with earlier, before I saw you two... It just came back to me. I don't know where she went, though."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's with— ...elirious?
entries.literal: "What's with— ...elirious?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's not it. ...not just some name she made up.
entries.literal: "That's not it. ...not just some name she made up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you kno—
entries.literal: "Do you kno—"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...We do, but Erina couldn't have seen her. She couldn't be here.
entries.literal: "...We do, but Erina couldn't have seen her. She couldn't be here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't process what I was hearing. Was I actually being punished? That insane possibility was only becoming more of a reality.
entries.literal: "I couldn't process what I was hearing. Was I actually being punished? That insane possibility was only becoming more of a reality."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's not what she means... She's not anywhere right now.
entries.literal: "That's not what she means... She's not anywhere right now."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh? ...dead?
entries.literal: "Oh? ...dead?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Dead...?{w} Are they really talking about me?
entries.literal: "Dead...?{w} Are they really talking about me?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What the fuck is this...? Of course I'm not dead!
entries.literal: "What the fuck is this...? Of course I'm not dead!"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Shut up.
entries.literal: "Shut up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...right? ...saving with— ...kimeiya not—
entries.literal: "...right? ...saving with— ...kimeiya not—"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Sai, shut the fuck up. If it was, I promise you that we would've done it.
entries.literal: "Sai, shut the fuck up. If it was, I promise you that we would've done it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was right there. I'd been right there the whole time...! What were they talking about!?
entries.literal: "I was right there. I'd been right there the whole time...! What were they talking about!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know whether I should have entered the room or not. I was a lot more hesitant, and it almost felt as if they knew that I was listening in on them.
entries.literal: "I didn't know whether I should have entered the room or not. I was a lot more hesitant, and it almost felt as if they knew that I was listening in on them."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's probably been— ...minutes already, right?
entries.literal: "It's probably been— ...minutes already, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...fifteen min—... arrived.
entries.literal: "...fifteen min—... arrived."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Are you sure I'll go far enough back?
entries.literal: "Are you sure I'll go far enough back?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I'm going, then. ...you coming with me?
entries.literal: "...I'm going, then. ...you coming with me?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Is she about to touch the Sekimeiya...?
entries.literal: "Is she about to touch the Sekimeiya...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...She said earlier she wanted to save Isla. Did they figure out how to use the Sekimeiya? They've only been there a few minutes...
entries.literal: "...She said earlier she wanted to save Isla. Did they figure out how to use the Sekimeiya? They've only been there a few minutes..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was the past going to be changed? That could have already been happening.
entries.literal: "Was the past going to be changed? That could have already been happening."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was possible that the past had changed drastically while I'd been unconscious. Was I living in a world completely different from the one I'd gone to sleep in?
entries.literal: "It was possible that the past had changed drastically while I'd been unconscious. Was I living in a world completely different from the one I'd gone to sleep in?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait... what?
entries.literal: "Wait... what?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Why didn't it work!? Did Sai disappear?{w} Was everything that he said a lie...?
entries.literal: "Why didn't it work!? Did Sai disappear?{w} Was everything that he said a lie...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't tell what had happened. Had Sai left, or had he time traveled?
entries.literal: "I couldn't tell what had happened. Had Sai left, or had he time traveled?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...you ever want me to save Isla? ...you involved in the first place!?
entries.literal: "...you ever want me to save Isla? ...you involved in the first place!?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're wrong. We don't know how the Sekimeiya works, but this shouldn't have happened...
entries.literal: "You're wrong. We don't know how the Sekimeiya works, but this shouldn't have happened..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had nothing happened...? I'd been completely frozen for minutes, trying to pick up everything I could.
entries.literal: "Had nothing happened...? I'd been completely frozen for minutes, trying to pick up everything I could."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Wait! Where did it go!?{w} It's not here!
entries.literal: "...Wait! Where did it go!?{w} It's not here!"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It... teleported.
entries.literal: "It... teleported."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The Sekimeiya... teleported.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya... teleported."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It was activated, but they didn't vanish—only the Sekimeiya teleported. That's happened before...
entries.literal: "It was activated, but they didn't vanish—only the Sekimeiya teleported. That's happened before..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Atsuki, tell me... What do I need to do to travel through time?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, tell me... What do I need to do to travel through time?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Exactly what Sai and I told you. I don't know why it didn't work just now.
entries.literal: "Exactly what Sai and I told you. I don't know why it didn't work just now."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: They haven't experienced this before... Is that it?
entries.literal: "They haven't experienced this before... Is that it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That idea was the driving force that made me immediately turn around and dash to the door.
entries.literal: "That idea was the driving force that made me immediately turn around and dash to the door."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...!{w} It's closed...! I didn't close it.
entries.literal: "...!{w} It's closed...! I didn't close it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya had seemingly vanished by itself. I'd just had an epiphany, but instead of trying to think everything through, I opened the door and ran to hallway C.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya had seemingly vanished by itself. I'd just had an epiphany, but instead of trying to think everything through, I opened the door and ran to hallway C."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There's still no blood here.
entries.literal: "There's still no blood here."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And this door...
entries.literal: "And this door..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Dismissing the elevator, I stepped up. There, I ran across the floor, releasing all my built-up energy. As soon as I reached the next staircase, I did the same.
entries.literal: "Dismissing the elevator, I stepped up. There, I ran across the floor, releasing all my built-up energy. As soon as I reached the next staircase, I did the same."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So that nothing would fall out, I held my purse tightly and continued running, planning on reaching the highest place in the building.
entries.literal: "So that nothing would fall out, I held my purse tightly and continued running, planning on reaching the highest place in the building."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't slow down, knowing that if I did, my exhaustion would catch up with me. I bolted up the fourth staircase and continued in a straight line.
entries.literal: "I didn't slow down, knowing that if I did, my exhaustion would catch up with me. I bolted up the fourth staircase and continued in a straight line."

entries.text: Delayed Reflection
entries.literal: "Delayed Reflection"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Whoa...!
entries.literal: "Whoa...!"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Atsuki...!
entries.literal: "Atsuki...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped abruptly and almost fell down. If Atsuki was there, did that mean that I'd been right?
entries.literal: "I stopped abruptly and almost fell down. If Atsuki was there, did that mean that I'd been right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What happened?
entries.literal: "Wh-What happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to pant hoarsely before I could speak again. Meanwhile, I thought of the question I wanted to ask, realizing he hadn't found my presence strange.
entries.literal: "I had to pant hoarsely before I could speak again. Meanwhile, I thought of the question I wanted to ask, realizing he hadn't found my presence strange."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...Th-This might sound strange, but... wh-what's the last place where you saw me?
entries.literal: "...Th-This might sound strange, but... wh-what's the last place where you saw me?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: The last place...? That's what I was gonna say. I saw you weren't sleeping anymore, so I was walking down to see if I could find where you'd gone.
entries.literal: "The last place...? That's what I was gonna say. I saw you weren't sleeping anymore, so I was walking down to see if I could find where you'd gone."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...{w}Then were you above me... in the bedroom?
entries.literal: "...{w}Then were you above me... in the bedroom?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, yes. Sorry, was I noisy? I just climbed down the ladder and saw you weren't there anymore.
entries.literal: "Oh, yes. Sorry, was I noisy? I just climbed down the ladder and saw you weren't there anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe it. It was him, the Atsuki I'd been with the whole day. However, on the crystal floor, there was another Atsuki—one who had said I couldn't be there.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it. It was him, the Atsuki I'd been with the whole day. However, on the crystal floor, there was another Atsuki—one who had said I couldn't be there."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Anyway, what were you in such a rush for? And that question...?
entries.literal: "...Anyway, what were you in such a rush for? And that question...?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...No, I was just going back up. I didn't realize you were in the attic too.
entries.literal: "...No, I was just going back up. I didn't realize you were in the attic too."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh.
entries.literal: "Oh."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Do you want to go up, then?
entries.literal: "...Do you want to go up, then?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Yes, we can stay there.
entries.literal: "Yes, we can stay there."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did you see anyone? They were all still waiting when I went to the attic.
entries.literal: "Did you see anyone? They were all still waiting when I went to the attic."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: I didn't.
entries.literal: "I didn't."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I see.{w} ...It should already be pretty late, but you still have the cabinet key, right?
entries.literal: "I see.{w} ...It should already be pretty late, but you still have the cabinet key, right?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked up, but my heart hadn't slowed down yet. What kind of mess were we in? No matter the answer, the right call was ignoring it and trying to make the time pass without complications.
entries.literal: "We walked up, but my heart hadn't slowed down yet. What kind of mess were we in? No matter the answer, the right call was ignoring it and trying to make the time pass without complications."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And yet I couldn't get the words out of my head. According to the people on the crystal floor, I should've been dead.
entries.literal: "And yet I couldn't get the words out of my head. According to the people on the crystal floor, I should've been dead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, a head appeared from around the office corridor. When we looked at each other, the three of us froze, everyone equally shocked.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, a head appeared from around the office corridor. When we looked at each other, the three of us froze, everyone equally shocked."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What the fuck...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Atsuki. A body identical to him, with his face and clothes, who had been waiting by the door to the offices. He looked at himself, speechless, and without moving an inch.
entries.literal: "It was Atsuki. A body identical to him, with his face and clothes, who had been waiting by the door to the offices. He looked at himself, speechless, and without moving an inch."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hey, answer me! You really were here... Are you really me? What the fuck is going on!?
entries.literal: "Hey, answer me! You really were here... Are you really me? What the fuck is going on!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For him, it must've been a surreal shock, but I looked at the bizarre scene with just as much confusion. Were there three versions of Atsuki in the building at once?
entries.literal: "For him, it must've been a surreal shock, but I looked at the bizarre scene with just as much confusion. Were there three versions of Atsuki in the building at once?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, the person in front of us spoke.
entries.literal: "Finally, the person in front of us spoke."

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: ...I didn't think you'd be here.
entries.literal: "...I didn't think you'd be here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What!? What does that mean!? You're me, right?
entries.literal: "Wh-What!? What does that mean!? You're me, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: ...I am.

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What the fuck is happening, then!? I thought it was impossible that we'd see each other. Was that wrong?
entries.literal: "What the fuck is happening, then!? I thought it was impossible that we'd see each other. Was that wrong?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: In a way, yes.
entries.literal: "In a way, yes."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What the fuck...? Tell me, then! What's going on!? How the fuck can you even exist!?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...? Tell me, then! What's going on!? How the fuck can you even exist!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I had no idea of how to interpret the scene, it was clear the Atsuki we'd bumped into had a higher understanding of what was happening. It didn't seem he found my existence strange either.
entries.literal: "While I had no idea of how to interpret the scene, it was clear the Atsuki we'd bumped into had a higher understanding of what was happening. It didn't seem he found my existence strange either."

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: ...I'm sorry, I'm not sure how to answer that question.
entries.literal: "...I'm sorry, I'm not sure how to answer that question."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What...!?

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: I know exactly how you feel, I promise. I will tell you one thing, though, since we've already met: you shouldn't worry about anything.
entries.literal: "I know exactly how you feel, I promise. I will tell you one thing, though, since we've already met: you shouldn't worry about anything."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I shouldn't worry? There's no way you're actually me, right?
entries.literal: "I shouldn't worry? There's no way you're actually me, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: ...I am. I promise, it will all be fine.
entries.literal: "...I am. I promise, it will all be fine."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What...? How can you tell? And how would that even be possible!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? How can you tell? And how would that even be possible!?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: I know how it sounds, but I genuinely don't have time to explain, and I'm not sure I could.
entries.literal: "I know how it sounds, but I genuinely don't have time to explain, and I'm not sure I could."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What does that even mean...!?
entries.literal: "What does that even mean...!?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: Look, we're the same person. Just trust me, or yourself, on this. Sincerely, everything should turn out fine.
entries.literal: "Look, we're the same person. Just trust me, or yourself, on this. Sincerely, everything should turn out fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those words almost broke the person at my side. He'd been told by himself that there was nothing to fear.
entries.literal: "Those words almost broke the person at my side. He'd been told by himself that there was nothing to fear."

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: You believe me, right? Like I said, I don't have much time.
entries.literal: "You believe me, right? Like I said, I don't have much time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Emotional, Atsuki nodded.
entries.literal: "Emotional, Atsuki nodded."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: But that c-can't be the case...! Shiroya... died again!
entries.literal: "But that c-can't be the case...! Shiroya... died again!"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: Again? What do you mean?
entries.literal: "Again? What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you not know that? She was killed here, and her body disappeared from the lobby!
entries.literal: "Do you not know that? She was killed here, and her body disappeared from the lobby!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other Atsuki looked confused and deep in thought.
entries.literal: "The other Atsuki looked confused and deep in thought."

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: You should believe what I say. I still don't fully understand how that works, but you have to trust me.
entries.literal: "You should believe what I say. I still don't fully understand how that works, but you have to trust me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...You can't explain it? Then there's no way you're actually telling the truth, right?
entries.literal: "...You can't explain it? Then there's no way you're actually telling the truth, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: I am. While I can't be fully confident about what I'm saying, I'll just ask you to believe me.
entries.literal: "I am. While I can't be fully confident about what I'm saying, I'll just ask you to believe me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}Okay.

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: ...Good. I suppose there's one thing you could do, then.
entries.literal: "...Good. I suppose there's one thing you could do, then."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: Wait here a second.
entries.literal: "Wait here a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He disappeared from where he'd come after giving me an intense gaze. I was right next to them, but I felt more distant than ever before.
entries.literal: "He disappeared from where he'd come after giving me an intense gaze. I was right next to them, but I felt more distant than ever before."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...Was that a future version of you?
entries.literal: "...Was that a future version of you?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I-I have no idea.
entries.literal: "I-I have no idea."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Then, is that true...? Will Shiroya be all right?
entries.literal: "Then, is that true...? Will Shiroya be all right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I don't know. I thought I'd try to use the Sekimeiya a bit later and go a few hours to the past... Th-That wouldn't be enough, but if I managed to keep doing that... That's the only idea I had, but I didn't even know if the Sekimeiya would work again.
entries.literal: "...I don't know. I thought I'd try to use the Sekimeiya a bit later and go a few hours to the past... Th-That wouldn't be enough, but if I managed to keep doing that... That's the only idea I had, but I didn't even know if the Sekimeiya would work again."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: I see. ...Whoever that was, we have to put all our faith in him.
entries.literal: "I see. ...Whoever that was, we have to put all our faith in him."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.literal: "...Yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He soon came back running. Between his hands was the Sekimeiya. It seemed like it might've teleported to the attic that time.
entries.literal: "He soon came back running. Between his hands was the Sekimeiya. It seemed like it might've teleported to the attic that time."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: Take this, but don't touch it.
entries.literal: "Take this, but don't touch it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki handed himself the Sekimeiya and received it, hiding his hands under his sleeves.
entries.literal: "Atsuki handed himself the Sekimeiya and received it, hiding his hands under his sleeves."

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: You two should hurry back down. On the second floor, enter the second partition, leave the Sekimeiya {tip=floor}on the floor{/tip}, and wait there.
entries.literal: "You two should hurry back down. On the second floor, enter the second partition, leave the Sekimeiya {tip=floor}on the floor{/tip}, and wait there."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: On the second floor?
entries.literal: "On the second floor?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: Yes. From there, if anyone passes by, you should hear them. If you hear the elevator four times, you can go back down and place the Sekimeiya in its cabinet. Make sure that it isn't activated again.
entries.literal: "Yes. From there, if anyone passes by, you should hear them. If you hear the elevator four times, you can go back down and place the Sekimeiya in its cabinet. Make sure that it isn't activated again."

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: However, it's possible that the first time, instead of hearing the elevator, you'll hear someone running up. If that happens, once you hear the elevator two times, you can go down and place the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "However, it's possible that the first time, instead of hearing the elevator, you'll hear someone running up. If that happens, once you hear the elevator two times, you can go down and place the Sekimeiya in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: O-Okay, and... after that, you're saying everything will be fine, right?
entries.literal: "O-Okay, and... after that, you're saying everything will be fine, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: Yes. Wait patiently with everyone on the crystal floor and make sure to get out safely. I'll pray with you for what will happen after that.
entries.literal: "Yes. Wait patiently with everyone on the crystal floor and make sure to get out safely. I'll pray with you for what will happen after that."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: All... All right.
entries.literal: "All... All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki turned around and ran back, putting all his faith in himself. As he did, the second Atsuki pierced me with his eyes.
entries.literal: "Atsuki turned around and ran back, putting all his faith in himself. As he did, the second Atsuki pierced me with his eyes."

entries.speaker: c2a2
entries.text: Goodbye, Miiya.
entries.literal: "Goodbye, Miiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In front of me, I saw a look I knew I'd seen before that day. However, he quickly turned it away from me, glancing downward.
entries.literal: "In front of me, I saw a look I knew I'd seen before that day. However, he quickly turned it away from me, glancing downward."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Goodbye.
entries.literal: "Goodbye."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Almost in a curious manner, I responded with only one word. Then, I turned around and started sprinting.
entries.literal: "Almost in a curious manner, I responded with only one word. Then, I turned around and started sprinting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki and I ran all the way down until we reached the second floor. Out of breath, he held the door to the offices open, and we entered the second one.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and I ran all the way down until we reached the second floor. Out of breath, he held the door to the offices open, and we entered the second one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He placed the Sekimeiya on the floor as instructed and stepped away from it.
entries.literal: "He placed the Sekimeiya on the floor as instructed and stepped away from it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There's no way this can work—whatever's about to happen...
entries.literal: "There's no way this can work—whatever's about to happen..."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Why not?
entries.literal: "Why not?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...He didn't know she had died again. I had the idea that she could be saved by going to the past and hiding her since she wasn't found, but doesn't this mean that she'll end up here and be killed?
entries.literal: "...He didn't know she had died again. I had the idea that she could be saved by going to the past and hiding her since she wasn't found, but doesn't this mean that she'll end up here and be killed?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Well, whoever that Atsuki was, he knew more than we do, and when you told him we'd found her dead, he still said it would be fine.
entries.literal: "Well, whoever that Atsuki was, he knew more than we do, and when you told him we'd found her dead, he still said it would be fine."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's true...
entries.literal: "That's true..."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Her body disappeared from the lobby even though we still remember it. Maybe that's what indicates that the past will be changed so she doesn't die here either.
entries.literal: "Her body disappeared from the lobby even though we still remember it. Maybe that's what indicates that the past will be changed so she doesn't die here either."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Would it work like this...?{w} It might. The proof that she's dead doesn't exist anymore.
entries.literal: "Would it work like this...?{w} It might. The proof that she's dead doesn't exist anymore."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: He can't just be a future self of mine; that wouldn't make any sense. ...The way he came to exist might be how he'll try to save Shiroya, but I have no idea what it could be.
entries.literal: "He can't just be a future self of mine; that wouldn't make any sense. ...The way he came to exist might be how he'll try to save Shiroya, but I have no idea what it could be."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard a faint, deep sound.
entries.literal: "I heard a faint, deep sound."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...That's the elevator, right? This is the first time.
entries.literal: "...That's the elevator, right? This is the first time."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Yeah. He said that he didn't have much time and was right in saying that the elevator would be used.
entries.literal: "Yeah. He said that he didn't have much time and was right in saying that the elevator would be used."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: So we have to hear it three more times until we can leave.
entries.literal: "So we have to hear it three more times until we can leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The second time came immediately.
entries.literal: "The second time came immediately."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Oh. It went through twice because it was called and then used.
entries.literal: "...Oh. It went through twice because it was called and then used."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Where should the elevator have been?
entries.literal: "Where should the elevator have been?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It was in the attic the last time I checked, from the time I went there. If that was still the case, someone just went up.
entries.literal: "It was in the attic the last time I checked, from the time I went there. If that was still the case, someone just went up."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: That must be it. It's just like he said, either the elevator would be used twice or someone would run up.
entries.literal: "That must be it. It's just like he said, either the elevator would be used twice or someone would run up."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...So he knew someone would go to the attic, but not how.
entries.literal: "...So he knew someone would go to the attic, but not how."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: And at some point, it will happen again.{w} We're supposed to hear the elevator two more times. That means it'll end up in the attic again.
entries.literal: "And at some point, it will happen again.{w} We're supposed to hear the elevator two more times. That means it'll end up in the attic again."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...If you're saying that wasn't a future version of you, how is it possible he knew all this?
entries.literal: "...If you're saying that wasn't a future version of you, how is it possible he knew all this?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}I don't know.{w} It doesn't make any sense, does it? The flow of time wouldn't work like that. It's impossible.{w} ...Also, he told us to wait safely and get out of the tower. There's no way I'll be able to use the Sekimeiya once we're outside, and that still wouldn't make any sense. Nothing does.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't know.{w} It doesn't make any sense, does it? The flow of time wouldn't work like that. It's impossible.{w} ...Also, he told us to wait safely and get out of the tower. There's no way I'll be able to use the Sekimeiya once we're outside, and that still wouldn't make any sense. Nothing does."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He's right. But she's on the crystal floor, alongside a third Atsuki. It can't be that the world was changed so that she never died, because that Atsuki was surprised to see her too.{w} One of them was probably who went up to the attic, but what will come out of this? Will different versions of us remain? The other Atsuki didn't make it sound like that.
entries.literal: "He's right. But she's on the crystal floor, alongside a third Atsuki. It can't be that the world was changed so that she never died, because that Atsuki was surprised to see her too.{w} One of them was probably who went up to the attic, but what will come out of this? Will different versions of us remain? The other Atsuki didn't make it sound like that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I should have been dead. Why?
entries.literal: "...I should have been dead. Why?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: {tip=dead}{i}I should be dead. Atsuki was right.{/i}{/tip} I should be, but I'm not.
entries.literal: "{tip=dead}{i}I should be dead. Atsuki was right.{/i}{/tip} I should be, but I'm not."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...It can't be they were talking about that, can it?
entries.literal: "...It can't be they were talking about that, can it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The answer had to revolve around the Sekimeiya's disappearance. Maybe, whenever that occurred, the changes made were applied to the world.
entries.literal: "The answer had to revolve around the Sekimeiya's disappearance. Maybe, whenever that occurred, the changes made were applied to the world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had teleported to the attic, so if nothing else happened, the state of the world would stay as it was.{w} But there were so many things to iron out. Three Atsukis existed at once. She had appeared out of nowhere in front of one of them. Not all the disappeared corpses had reappeared alive.
entries.literal: "It had teleported to the attic, so if nothing else happened, the state of the world would stay as it was.{w} But there were so many things to iron out. Three Atsukis existed at once. She had appeared out of nowhere in front of one of them. Not all the disappeared corpses had reappeared alive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was everything really going to resolve itself if we buried our heads in the sand until we could leave the building?
entries.literal: "Was everything really going to resolve itself if we buried our heads in the sand until we could leave the building?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...And the Sekimeiya was in the attic. Did it teleport there, or did he unlock the cabinet with a key of his own?
entries.literal: "...And the Sekimeiya was in the attic. Did it teleport there, or did he unlock the cabinet with a key of his own?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: I don't know, but I still have the keys. I should probably leave them somewhere before we get out.
entries.literal: "I don't know, but I still have the keys. I should probably leave them somewhere before we get out."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Did we lock the cabinet the last time?
entries.literal: "...Did we lock the cabinet the last time?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Oh, you're right. I said I'd go to the attic and we never locked it.
entries.literal: "Oh, you're right. I said I'd go to the attic and we never locked it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: So he just brought it up.
entries.literal: "So he just brought it up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...In fact, the Sekimeiya had moved twice before. Erina and I had found it in a cabinet in room B4, next to Naomi's moved body. In the future, it was in one of the lockers, and it wasn't Naomi's. We'd never seen which one was Katei's, so it might've been his.
