entries.literal: "...In fact, the Sekimeiya had moved twice before. Erina and I had found it in a cabinet in room B4, next to Naomi's moved body. In the future, it was in one of the lockers, and it wasn't Naomi's. We'd never seen which one was Katei's, so it might've been his."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was all tied together. When I'd found the Sekimeiya in the staff room, there had been blood on the crystal floor. When Atsuki had seen that I was no longer sleeping, no yells had come from the opposite bedroom.
entries.literal: "It was all tied together. When I'd found the Sekimeiya in the staff room, there had been blood on the crystal floor. When Atsuki had seen that I was no longer sleeping, no yells had come from the opposite bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But there was no way to make sense of it. Had the blood on the crystal floor disappeared at the same time as the Sekimeiya? Even if so, it was all far too volatile, and I didn't know what had happened while I was asleep.
entries.literal: "But there was no way to make sense of it. Had the blood on the crystal floor disappeared at the same time as the Sekimeiya? Even if so, it was all far too volatile, and I didn't know what had happened while I was asleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A very important question came to mind.
entries.literal: "A very important question came to mind."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: In the bedroom... did you turn on the light?
entries.literal: "In the bedroom... did you turn on the light?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, yes, sorry. I didn't know you were there.
entries.literal: "Oh, yes, sorry. I didn't know you were there."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: I mean later, when you were already above.
entries.literal: "I mean later, when you were already above."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hm? No, I didn't. I'm confused by what you mean.{w} I came down, and it seemed like you weren't there because I couldn't hear you. I did turn on the light to confirm it, but you were already gone. Is that what you meant?
entries.literal: "Hm? No, I didn't. I'm confused by what you mean.{w} I came down, and it seemed like you weren't there because I couldn't hear you. I did turn on the light to confirm it, but you were already gone. Is that what you meant?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...{w}Yes, sorry. I thought someone might have turned it on after you came.
entries.literal: "...{w}Yes, sorry. I thought someone might have turned it on after you came."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't know. I didn't hear anything.
entries.literal: "I don't know. I didn't hear anything."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What the hell, then?
entries.literal: "What the hell, then?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I don't even know if turning off the light in the upper bedroom would've turned it off where I was anyway.{w} This doesn't make any sense...!
entries.literal: "I don't even know if turning off the light in the upper bedroom would've turned it off where I was anyway.{w} This doesn't make any sense...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat on one of the chairs. I couldn't be too frustrated—the outcome had already been guaranteed. We'd soon make it out, and she was probably going to magically revive.
entries.literal: "I sat on one of the chairs. I couldn't be too frustrated—the outcome had already been guaranteed. We'd soon make it out, and she was probably going to magically revive."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Oh, fuck...
entries.literal: "Oh, fuck..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I should leave the keys somewhere before we get out because they'll look at my purse...
entries.literal: "I should leave the keys somewhere before we get out because they'll look at my purse..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And there was one more thing that couldn't be found.
entries.literal: "And there was one more thing that couldn't be found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was fine. I'd just have to flush it down the toilet or something.
entries.literal: "...It was fine. I'd just have to flush it down the toilet or something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized the contents of my purse could be seen from where it was on the floor, so I slowly moved it aside.
entries.literal: "I realized the contents of my purse could be seen from where it was on the floor, so I slowly moved it aside."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait...{w} ...Is it not here?
entries.literal: "Wait...{w} ...Is it not here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at my purse, baffled. Then, I grabbed it and took the keys out.
entries.literal: "I stared at my purse, baffled. Then, I grabbed it and took the keys out."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: ...Yeah, I'll leave these somewhere. I'd rather not be asked about why I had them.
entries.literal: "...Yeah, I'll leave these somewhere. I'd rather not be asked about why I had them."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm sure it'd be fine anyway.
entries.literal: "I'm sure it'd be fine anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {tip=note}It wasn't there.{/tip} In my purse were the keyring, the tickets we'd bought for the event, our identification, and our keys.
entries.literal: "{tip=note}It wasn't there.{/tip} In my purse were the keyring, the tickets we'd bought for the event, our identification, and our keys."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Was it really taken while I was asleep...?
entries.literal: "Was it really taken while I was asleep...?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There's no way.
entries.literal: "There's no way."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Wait, no.{w} I bet I know what happened.
entries.literal: "Wait, no.{w} I bet I know what happened."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It disappeared. That's it.
entries.literal: "It disappeared. That's it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: At some point, it disappeared from my purse and from this world. That's what's been happening. As Atsuki said, in this world, there's no remaining proof that she's dead.
entries.literal: "At some point, it disappeared from my purse and from this world. That's what's been happening. As Atsuki said, in this world, there's no remaining proof that she's dead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nothing else to care about. Knowing that, calmly waiting felt much more doable than before.
entries.literal: "There was nothing else to care about. Knowing that, calmly waiting felt much more doable than before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remained sitting on that chair, unable to hear anything beyond Atsuki's breathing.
entries.literal: "I remained sitting on that chair, unable to hear anything beyond Atsuki's breathing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was many minutes later when we heard the elevator for the third time.
entries.literal: "It was many minutes later when we heard the elevator for the third time."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There it is...!
entries.literal: "There it is...!"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Let's see if we hear it again immediately.
entries.literal: "Let's see if we hear it again immediately."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We did. Just a minute later, the fourth came.
entries.literal: "We did. Just a minute later, the fourth came."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: All right, let's go... Hopefully, nobody sees us.
entries.literal: "All right, let's go... Hopefully, nobody sees us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door, and Atsuki crouched to grab the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I opened the door, and Atsuki crouched to grab the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: How the fuck can it be this hot...!? It hurts to even get my fingers close to it.
entries.literal: "How the fuck can it be this hot...!? It hurts to even get my fingers close to it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We heard an unexpected sound.
entries.literal: "We heard an unexpected sound."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, what...?
entries.literal: "Oh, what...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We both listened more intently, and I could tell that we were hearing footsteps coming from the staircase leading down.
entries.literal: "We both listened more intently, and I could tell that we were hearing footsteps coming from the staircase leading down."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: W-Wait, it should be fine, right...?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, it should be fine, right...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck...!? What are you doing here!?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...!? What are you doing here!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai saw me through the glass. Next to him was Akaro, even though his running hadn't been heard from inside.
entries.literal: "Sai saw me through the glass. Next to him was Akaro, even though his running hadn't been heard from inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki! Come here! I fucking see the Sekimeiya!
entries.literal: "Atsuki! Come here! I fucking see the Sekimeiya!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What did you do...? You didn't stop on this floor, right?
entries.literal: "What did you do...? You didn't stop on this floor, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't be stupid. He has the Sekimeiya. He probably used it.
entries.literal: "Don't be stupid. He has the Sekimeiya. He probably used it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you mean that I just took the elevator?
entries.literal: "Do you mean that I just took the elevator?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Holy shit, man. Will this attitude stop?{w} Why were you waiting here? You knew we'd go up, right? Was your idea to make us chase you to then touch the Sekimeiya and wait here to sneak back down?
entries.literal: "Holy shit, man. Will this attitude stop?{w} Why were you waiting here? You knew we'd go up, right? Was your idea to make us chase you to then touch the Sekimeiya and wait here to sneak back down?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I didn't do any of that.
entries.literal: "...I didn't do any of that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He probably understood it. Another version of Atsuki had just used the elevator. That was why Sai was accusing him of touching the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "He probably understood it. Another version of Atsuki had just used the elevator. That was why Sai was accusing him of touching the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, while he probably thought it was the version he'd spoken with, he was unaware of the other one who'd been on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "However, while he probably thought it was the version he'd spoken with, he was unaware of the other one who'd been on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What now, then? What were you planning to do with that Sekimeiya? As I thought, you're also in on this plan, right?
entries.literal: "What now, then? What were you planning to do with that Sekimeiya? As I thought, you're also in on this plan, right?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Me...?{w} I don't even know what you're talking about.
entries.literal: "Me...?{w} I don't even know what you're talking about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though fainter, we perceived the same sound. The elevator had just been used.
entries.literal: "Even though fainter, we perceived the same sound. The elevator had just been used."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That was the elevator, and I bet I know who that is.
entries.literal: "That was the elevator, and I bet I know who that is."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Who...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki looked a little uncertain. There had been no mention of a fifth elevator sound.
entries.literal: "Atsuki looked a little uncertain. There had been no mention of a fifth elevator sound."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who? The girl who I bet was supposed to meet with you two right now, after you'd made it down from here with the Sekimeiya. It's unfortunate you were too incompetent to handle such a simple plan.
entries.literal: "Who? The girl who I bet was supposed to meet with you two right now, after you'd made it down from here with the Sekimeiya. It's unfortunate you were too incompetent to handle such a simple plan."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...What?{w} I'm being serious. I have absolutely no idea what you're talking about. What girl?
entries.literal: "...What?{w} I'm being serious. I have absolutely no idea what you're talking about. What girl?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not sure what the idea behind this is, really. Were you actually able to open the storeroom door?
entries.literal: "I'm not sure what the idea behind this is, really. Were you actually able to open the storeroom door?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}Answer me. What girl?
entries.literal: "...{w}Answer me. What girl?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What even was her name, Akaro?
entries.literal: "What even was her name, Akaro?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Hm.{w} ...Shiroya, right?
entries.literal: "...Hm.{w} ...Shiroya, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sixth time came. The elevator passed through our floor as Atsuki's eyes widened. He understood it immediately: she was already present.
entries.literal: "The sixth time came. The elevator passed through our floor as Atsuki's eyes widened. He understood it immediately: she was already present."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, fuck... She realized you hadn't come and went back up.
entries.literal: "Oh, fuck... She realized you hadn't come and went back up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai sprinted toward the third floor.
entries.literal: "Sai sprinted toward the third floor."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait! Stop!
entries.literal: "Wait! Stop!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Akaro! Go down and wait in front of the storeroom! It could've been sent empty!
entries.literal: "Akaro! Go down and wait in front of the storeroom! It could've been sent empty!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro looked hesitant for a moment, but he followed Sai's order. In an instant, Atsuki and I were alone.
entries.literal: "Akaro looked hesitant for a moment, but he followed Sai's order. In an instant, Atsuki and I were alone."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: What the hell? What do we do?
entries.literal: "What the hell? What do we do?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}We should put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet and stay on the crystal floor. That's what we were told.
entries.literal: "...{w}We should put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet and stay on the crystal floor. That's what we were told."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: All right.
entries.literal: "All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We ran behind Akaro.{w} I looked down and saw that there was still no blood on the floor or the staircase.
entries.literal: "We ran behind Akaro.{w} I looked down and saw that there was still no blood on the floor or the staircase."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What...!?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the floor, below the elevator panel, there was a folded piece of paper. Atsuki and Akaro were ahead of me, so they didn't see me grabbing it and putting it in my purse.
entries.literal: "On the floor, below the elevator panel, there was a folded piece of paper. Atsuki and Akaro were ahead of me, so they didn't see me grabbing it and putting it in my purse."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did it... not disappear after all?
entries.literal: "Did it... not disappear after all?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro was in the storeroom, but I just followed behind Atsuki, completely lost for words. How the hell had that made it there?
entries.literal: "Akaro was in the storeroom, but I just followed behind Atsuki, completely lost for words. How the hell had that made it there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The event room was empty.
entries.literal: "The event room was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the unlocked empty cabinet, and Atsuki left the Sekimeiya inside. That time, he didn't forget to lock it.
entries.literal: "I opened the unlocked empty cabinet, and Atsuki left the Sekimeiya inside. That time, he didn't forget to lock it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "We left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...We promise we don't know what you were talking about. Why did Sai say that it was Shiroya who'd taken the elevator? That's the... girl who died.
entries.literal: "...We promise we don't know what you were talking about. Why did Sai say that it was Shiroya who'd taken the elevator? That's the... girl who died."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: So you remember now?
entries.literal: "So you remember now?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did I not...? Of course I do. She was in the elevator and then disappeared from the lobby.
entries.literal: "Did I not...? Of course I do. She was in the elevator and then disappeared from the lobby."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's right, but she was here just minutes ago and said she was going to the attic. That's why Sai believes you're responsible.
entries.literal: "That's right, but she was here just minutes ago and said she was going to the attic. That's why Sai believes you're responsible."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: How many minutes ago?
entries.literal: "How many minutes ago?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't know, quite a few, and you were here too with the Erina who disappeared.
entries.literal: "I don't know, quite a few, and you were here too with the Erina who disappeared."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: The Erina who died...?
entries.literal: "The Erina who died...?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes. She had her clothes caked with dried blood. You two took the elevator up just now.
entries.literal: "Yes. She had her clothes caked with dried blood. You two took the elevator up just now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So the person who used the elevator the first time was her, and the second time it was Atsuki and Erina.
entries.literal: "So the person who used the elevator the first time was her, and the second time it was Atsuki and Erina."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had met that version of Erina as well, and neither she nor Atsuki were the people we'd been with since that morning.
entries.literal: "I had met that version of Erina as well, and neither she nor Atsuki were the people we'd been with since that morning."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That wasn't me. I'm being serious.
entries.literal: "That wasn't me. I'm being serious."

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: He's right. We've been in the attic all this time and haven't seen anyone.
entries.literal: "He's right. We've been in the attic all this time and haven't seen anyone."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's not easy to believe. You were hiding in the offices with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "That's not easy to believe. You were hiding in the offices with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It wasn't us who brought the Sekimeiya up. We found it in the attic. We also weren't hiding in the offices, we were searching them before coming back down.
entries.literal: "It wasn't us who brought the Sekimeiya up. We found it in the attic. We also weren't hiding in the offices, we were searching them before coming back down."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I don't know.{w} I can't just assume you're lying after all that's happened.
entries.literal: "...I don't know.{w} I can't just assume you're lying after all that's happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Where are the others?
entries.literal: "...Where are the others?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well, Katei should be in the security room, and I saw Erina and Isla hadn't left the crystal room they were in.
entries.literal: "Well, Katei should be in the security room, and I saw Erina and Isla hadn't left the crystal room they were in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While Atsuki opened the door to the security room, I looked at the lobby.
entries.literal: "While Atsuki opened the door to the security room, I looked at the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi's corpse had returned there, and along with the policeman, they were lying on the floor in solitude. The wound on Naomi's head had stopped bleeding, so the pool below it had reached its limit.
entries.literal: "Naomi's corpse had returned there, and along with the policeman, they were lying on the floor in solitude. The wound on Naomi's head had stopped bleeding, so the pool below it had reached its limit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The status of the room had gone back to normal after changing continuously. Was that the version the outside world would see?
entries.literal: "The status of the room had gone back to normal after changing continuously. Was that the version the outside world would see?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked to my right and saw Katei lying back on his chair in front of all the powered-off screens.
entries.literal: "I looked to my right and saw Katei lying back on his chair in front of all the powered-off screens."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, it's you two. It's been a while.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's you two. It's been a while."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Yes, we just came back from the attic.
entries.literal: "...Yes, we just came back from the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He wasn't dead below his desk, and it was clear he'd failed to fix the computer.
entries.literal: "He wasn't dead below his desk, and it was clear he'd failed to fix the computer."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...How's this going?
entries.literal: "...How's this going?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I stopped a while ago. I have no idea what the issue is, so I'll need other people to look into it.
entries.literal: "I stopped a while ago. I have no idea what the issue is, so I'll need other people to look into it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we opened the door in front, we saw the last two people. Isla was not lying face-up inside a dark cabinet, but instead ogling one of the uncovered glass displays.
entries.literal: "When we opened the door in front, we saw the last two people. Isla was not lying face-up inside a dark cabinet, but instead ogling one of the uncovered glass displays."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...Hello.
entries.literal: "...Hello."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina stood up after seeing the two of us. There was no blood on her clothes, and she seemed pretty tired.
entries.literal: "Erina stood up after seeing the two of us. There was no blood on her clothes, and she seemed pretty tired."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did something happen?
entries.literal: "Did something happen?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, no. We weren't sure if you were still here.
entries.literal: "Oh, no. We weren't sure if you were still here."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: We've been here the whole time.
entries.literal: "We've been here the whole time."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's good. The time is getting closer.
entries.literal: "That's good. The time is getting closer."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You said the Erina covered in blood was here too?
entries.literal: "You said the Erina covered in blood was here too?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes. She and the girl—the two dead bodies that disappeared. For a second, I thought they'd been alive the whole time, but that couldn't be it.
entries.literal: "Yes. She and the girl—the two dead bodies that disappeared. For a second, I thought they'd been alive the whole time, but that couldn't be it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait, is that it...? Could it be that they were genuinely brought back to life?{w} But, no... If another version of me existed, it must be something completely different.
entries.literal: "Wait, is that it...? Could it be that they were genuinely brought back to life?{w} But, no... If another version of me existed, it must be something completely different."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: If that really wasn't you, then I'm really confused. According to him, that girl had been with us the entire day. Since this morning.
entries.literal: "If that really wasn't you, then I'm really confused. According to him, that girl had been with us the entire day. Since this morning."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There was absolutely fucking nobody in the attic or anywhere.
entries.literal: "There was absolutely fucking nobody in the attic or anywhere."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Really?
entries.literal: "Really?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai came from the stairs and entered the storeroom, all while I considered how strange that assertion was. Had he simply failed to find the others?
entries.literal: "Sai came from the stairs and entered the storeroom, all while I considered how strange that assertion was. Had he simply failed to find the others?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two different versions of Atsuki, the other Erina, and her too. They all should've been there. Something else still didn't make sense either.
entries.literal: "Two different versions of Atsuki, the other Erina, and her too. They all should've been there. Something else still didn't make sense either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator had been used two more times after the fourth. We knew who had used it the first four times and that everyone who should've been on the crystal floor was present. So, who had taken the final two trips and gone above us?
entries.literal: "The elevator had been used two more times after the fourth. We knew who had used it the first four times and that everyone who should've been on the crystal floor was present. So, who had taken the final two trips and gone above us?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The door hasn't been opened again. ...Where's the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "The door hasn't been opened again. ...Where's the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: In the cabinet.
entries.literal: "In the cabinet."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: In the cabinet? Akaro, don't you understand that their friend could be here? She could've taken it already!
entries.literal: "In the cabinet? Akaro, don't you understand that their friend could be here? She could've taken it already!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hey, I did what you said.
entries.literal: "Hey, I did what you said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Offended, Sai hurried to the event room.
entries.literal: "Offended, Sai hurried to the event room."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Akaro explained to us what happened. That wasn't me, and we don't want to take it out of here again.
entries.literal: "Akaro explained to us what happened. That wasn't me, and we don't want to take it out of here again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What did he say?
entries.literal: "What did he say?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That both of them were sleeping in the attic and found the Sekimeiya there. Then, they came down, searching through every floor until we saw them.
entries.literal: "That both of them were sleeping in the attic and found the Sekimeiya there. Then, they came down, searching through every floor until we saw them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Is that what we're supposed to believe? That the people who have the key to the cabinet conveniently found it where they were, and that instead of hurrying to bring it back, they looked through the entire building with it?
entries.literal: "Is that what we're supposed to believe? That the people who have the key to the cabinet conveniently found it where they were, and that instead of hurrying to bring it back, they looked through the entire building with it?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...That's what happened.{w} Did you really not find anyone? Aren't you the one who says that I took the elevator up?
entries.literal: "...That's what happened.{w} Did you really not find anyone? Aren't you the one who says that I took the elevator up?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. I'm only one person, though, so I couldn't really search optimally.{w} But it is possible there was nobody to find if the three people who should've been there merely traveled with the Sekimeiya, which, again, you happened to have.
entries.literal: "Yes. I'm only one person, though, so I couldn't really search optimally.{w} But it is possible there was nobody to find if the three people who should've been there merely traveled with the Sekimeiya, which, again, you happened to have."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't exactly know what happened, so what is it that you're accusing me of?
entries.literal: "I don't exactly know what happened, so what is it that you're accusing me of?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}I'm accusing you of trying to execute a plan that might involve getting the Sekimeiya out of the tower. Of lying openly, and of working with that girl you know who didn't get trapped with us.
entries.literal: "...{w}I'm accusing you of trying to execute a plan that might involve getting the Sekimeiya out of the tower. Of lying openly, and of working with that girl you know who didn't get trapped with us."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I'm sorry, but I can't really take you seriously. I woke up a few minutes ago and have no idea what any of this is about. Since Akaro is backing you up, I guess it's true that the two missing bodies reappeared, but it seems they're gone again, right? Erina is with Isla two rooms over, and she looks totally okay.{w} Also, I already said that I don't want to take the Sekimeiya out of here again.
entries.literal: "...I'm sorry, but I can't really take you seriously. I woke up a few minutes ago and have no idea what any of this is about. Since Akaro is backing you up, I guess it's true that the two missing bodies reappeared, but it seems they're gone again, right? Erina is with Isla two rooms over, and she looks totally okay.{w} Also, I already said that I don't want to take the Sekimeiya out of here again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai approached Atsuki and touched his sleeves.
entries.literal: "Sai approached Atsuki and touched his sleeves."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was working again, huh? Your shirt is burning.
entries.literal: "It was working again, huh? Your shirt is burning."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: But we didn't activate it, and we never will.
entries.literal: "But we didn't activate it, and we never will."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: However, if it's true that I was here and said things that didn't make sense...{w} You're right, I know that girl, Shiroya. She's an old friend of mine who... died two weeks ago. I don't have any idea why she was here today or how that's possible.
entries.literal: "However, if it's true that I was here and said things that didn't make sense...{w} You're right, I know that girl, Shiroya. She's an old friend of mine who... died two weeks ago. I don't have any idea why she was here today or how that's possible."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You just said that the storeroom door hasn't opened again. And the elevator was used two times, right? If it's true that they were here... they must still be. And I can guarantee it because we had the Sekimeiya and didn't use it.
entries.literal: "You just said that the storeroom door hasn't opened again. And the elevator was used two times, right? If it's true that they were here... they must still be. And I can guarantee it because we had the Sekimeiya and didn't use it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: So we have to go find them. You were just one person looking around, so they could have dodged you. All of us together can find them. Then, we'll work out exactly what happened.
entries.literal: "So we have to go find them. You were just one person looking around, so they could have dodged you. All of us together can find them. Then, we'll work out exactly what happened."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Let's go.
entries.literal: "Let's go."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Are you fucking serious?
entries.literal: "...Are you fucking serious?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now I'm sure. You're spewing an immense amount of bullshit out of that idiotic mouth of yours.
entries.literal: "Now I'm sure. You're spewing an immense amount of bullshit out of that idiotic mouth of yours."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't care how you did it, but you're right: they have to be here because the elevator was used again. I don't care if they traveled to the past or if they just avoided me.
entries.literal: "I don't care how you did it, but you're right: they have to be here because the elevator was used again. I don't care if they traveled to the past or if they just avoided me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I had a theory ready that entailed Shiroya waiting for the elevator sound on the second floor and activating the Sekimeiya so that you'd all travel. After all, what's most strange is that the Sekimeiya was on the second floor right after you took the elevator up.
entries.literal: "I had a theory ready that entailed Shiroya waiting for the elevator sound on the second floor and activating the Sekimeiya so that you'd all travel. After all, what's most strange is that the Sekimeiya was on the second floor right after you took the elevator up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: With all the waiting, you probably had a somewhat thought-out plan ready. However, that hardly matters. What matters is that you're not getting the chance to take the Sekimeiya out again.
entries.literal: "With all the waiting, you probably had a somewhat thought-out plan ready. However, that hardly matters. What matters is that you're not getting the chance to take the Sekimeiya out again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did you think we'd all just go looking now? You're not moving from here.
entries.literal: "Did you think we'd all just go looking now? You're not moving from here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: And how will you enforce that?
entries.literal: "And how will you enforce that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't you think Akaro easily could?
entries.literal: "Don't you think Akaro easily could?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Neither of you are leaving this room. Give me the keys too.
entries.literal: "Neither of you are leaving this room. Give me the keys too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I handed him the keyring, feigning a defeated face.
entries.literal: "I handed him the keyring, feigning a defeated face."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whatever the fuck you had planned with that girl won't happen as long as we stay here.
entries.literal: "Whatever the fuck you had planned with that girl won't happen as long as we stay here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai moved to hallway A and went to the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Sai moved to hallway A and went to the storeroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It seems she didn't take the sole chance she had to escape. I'm not letting the storeroom out of my sight again, so the police will definitely catch this person who's supposedly dead.
entries.literal: "It seems she didn't take the sole chance she had to escape. I'm not letting the storeroom out of my sight again, so the police will definitely catch this person who's supposedly dead."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: At least one of them must be here, between Shiroya and Erina. However, it's probably both, and they're not going to show themselves.
entries.literal: "At least one of them must be here, between Shiroya and Erina. However, it's probably both, and they're not going to show themselves."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The best thing is that there's no need to search for them. The Sekimeiya is shut in here, so they can't activate it to escape. The storeroom is out of the question too. They're basically trapped.
entries.literal: "The best thing is that there's no need to search for them. The Sekimeiya is shut in here, so they can't activate it to escape. The storeroom is out of the question too. They're basically trapped."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's currently {time=19:32.} There's no need to search for them, but don't worry—they'll be found as soon as the police enter the building. If you really do want that, you're not opposed, right?
entries.literal: "It's currently {time=19:32.} There's no need to search for them, but don't worry—they'll be found as soon as the police enter the building. If you really do want that, you're not opposed, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...!{w} I still think we should find them because I want to understand what happened. If we find them, you'll believe all that I'm saying.
entries.literal: "...!{w} I still think we should find them because I want to understand what happened. If we find them, you'll believe all that I'm saying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see. Then we'll go ahead and believe it after {time=21}, when two versions of you are found.
entries.literal: "I see. Then we'll go ahead and believe it after {time=21}, when two versions of you are found."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...If that's what you want, I'm fine with that too. I-I suppose we can wait here. There's not that much time left.
entries.literal: "...If that's what you want, I'm fine with that too. I-I suppose we can wait here. There's not that much time left."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Precisely.
entries.literal: "Precisely."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I think that's for the best too.
entries.literal: "I think that's for the best too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It appeared it had been settled. After a few minutes, I was the first to sit on the floor, leaning on the dirty wall.
entries.literal: "It appeared it had been settled. After a few minutes, I was the first to sit on the floor, leaning on the dirty wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone in the room was silently on alert. Eventually, Sai's taunting attitude receded, and he started to look doubtful.
entries.literal: "Everyone in the room was silently on alert. Eventually, Sai's taunting attitude receded, and he started to look doubtful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, {time=21} kept approaching at a steady pace, and nobody seemed against that. I wanted to get rid of the note in my purse, but I couldn't go to the bathroom to flush it away. When no one was looking at me, I stuffed it inside one of my shoes. The police would probably search us after we left, so my purse wasn't a good place to hide it.
entries.literal: "However, {time=21} kept approaching at a steady pace, and nobody seemed against that. I wanted to get rid of the note in my purse, but I couldn't go to the bathroom to flush it away. When no one was looking at me, I stuffed it inside one of my shoes. The police would probably search us after we left, so my purse wasn't a good place to hide it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei left the security room and was told we were waiting together. For the last stretch of the day, he entered the dim room with us to maintain our protection of the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Katei left the security room and was told we were waiting together. For the last stretch of the day, he entered the dim room with us to maintain our protection of the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter what the truth was, our shared distrust was palpable. Anyone could've been lying the entire day. Perhaps, after the police entered, we'd eventually learn all about what the people we'd gotten trapped with had done.
entries.literal: "No matter what the truth was, our shared distrust was palpable. Anyone could've been lying the entire day. Perhaps, after the police entered, we'd eventually learn all about what the people we'd gotten trapped with had done."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't think anything good could come of it. After all, there was a killer in the room.
entries.literal: "I didn't think anything good could come of it. After all, there was a killer in the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya and Atsuki had been told by another Atsuki that as long as they stayed on the crystal floor, everything should turn out fine.
entries.literal: "Miiya and Atsuki had been told by another Atsuki that as long as they stayed on the crystal floor, everything should turn out fine."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The mystery behind the people who had gone to the attic... Nobody could be certain what had happened to them.
entries.literal: "The mystery behind the people who had gone to the attic... Nobody could be certain what had happened to them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Were they still in the tower? Or had Sai failed to find them because they had vanished?
entries.literal: "Were they still in the tower? Or had Sai failed to find them because they had vanished?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was possible that they were waiting near the event room. If that was the case, they would be found by the police.
entries.literal: "It was possible that they were waiting near the event room. If that was the case, they would be found by the police."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A few of the people in the room had similar thoughts.
entries.literal: "A few of the people in the room had similar thoughts."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Should the less suspicious among them look for the others while everyone else waited in the event room? Given the amount of time left, it sounded risky and unnecessary.
entries.literal: "Should the less suspicious among them look for the others while everyone else waited in the event room? Given the amount of time left, it sounded risky and unnecessary."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But Miiya kept thinking about one thing.
entries.literal: "But Miiya kept thinking about one thing."

entries.text: "I want to search the building again."
entries.literal: "\"I want to search the building again.\""

entries.text: "I want to stay in the event room."
entries.literal: "\"I want to stay in the event room.\""

entries.text: Finding Self
entries.literal: "Finding Self"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As the time kept passing, Miiya's conflict grew.
entries.literal: "As the time kept passing, Miiya's conflict grew."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The Atsuki they'd spoken with had said that if they stayed together on the crystal floor, everything would turn out to be fine.
entries.literal: "The Atsuki they'd spoken with had said that if they stayed together on the crystal floor, everything would turn out to be fine."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, did that imply that if they were to scatter through the building, that guarantee would be voided?
entries.literal: "However, did that imply that if they were to scatter through the building, that guarantee would be voided?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Who had taken the last elevator trip? How did that Atsuki plan to accomplish what he'd said? ...Would anyone be found if they were to inspect every floor?
entries.literal: "Who had taken the last elevator trip? How did that Atsuki plan to accomplish what he'd said? ...Would anyone be found if they were to inspect every floor?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Can't you see already that we weren't lying?" Miiya spoke.
entries.literal: "\"Can't you see already that we weren't lying?\" Miiya spoke."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Someone must definitely be here; that's not a question. If you think we want to leave this room empty as we search, someone can just stay here.
entries.literal: "Someone must definitely be here; that's not a question. If you think we want to leave this room empty as we search, someone can just stay here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki threw her a frown. They had managed to keep everyone together, so what was with that sudden input?
entries.literal: "Atsuki threw her a frown. They had managed to keep everyone together, so what was with that sudden input?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You didn't listen to me, did you? Neither of you will leave this room until the shutter opens. I'm sure there's a reason why you want us to look for whoever's here, and given what you just said, it might not be related to this room.
entries.literal: "You didn't listen to me, did you? Neither of you will leave this room until the shutter opens. I'm sure there's a reason why you want us to look for whoever's here, and given what you just said, it might not be related to this room."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: What would that be? There's no harm in searching as long as someone stays behind. It can be you, if you want.
entries.literal: "What would that be? There's no harm in searching as long as someone stays behind. It can be you, if you want."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki joined in, baiting the same reaction as before.
entries.literal: "Atsuki joined in, baiting the same reaction as before."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Stop it. We're not leaving. It's very late already, so there's no reason to at all.
entries.literal: "Stop it. We're not leaving. It's very late already, so there's no reason to at all."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Then I'm going alone.
entries.literal: "Then I'm going alone."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: What? No, you—
entries.literal: "What? No, you—"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya didn't give anyone a chance to object. She sprinted toward the hallway A door, and before Akaro had time to react, she ran to the stairs.
entries.literal: "Miiya didn't give anyone a chance to object. She sprinted toward the hallway A door, and before Akaro had time to react, she ran to the stairs."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: What the fuck!? Stop! What the fuck are you doing!?
entries.literal: "What the fuck!? Stop! What the fuck are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai's voice didn't reach Miiya, who had disappeared to the second floor. Everyone ran behind her, hesitant to go up, as her goal could've been to lure them away.{w} Meanwhile, Atsuki was lost and began to feel a despicable anxiety building up. Why was Miiya objecting to the only thing they had to do?
entries.literal: "Sai's voice didn't reach Miiya, who had disappeared to the second floor. Everyone ran behind her, hesitant to go up, as her goal could've been to lure them away.{w} Meanwhile, Atsuki was lost and began to feel a despicable anxiety building up. Why was Miiya objecting to the only thing they had to do?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "What's happening...?" Erina peeked out of the crystal room after Sai had called the elevator.
entries.literal: "\"What's happening...?\" Erina peeked out of the crystal room after Sai had called the elevator."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Erina! Please, you and Isla stay in the event room! It's very important!
entries.literal: "Erina! Please, you and Isla stay in the event room! It's very important!"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Atsuki, you stop right here. I have no fucking idea what you're doing, but don't follow her!
entries.literal: "Atsuki, you stop right here. I have no fucking idea what you're doing, but don't follow her!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Knowing he was going to be physically stopped, Atsuki ignored Sai and dashed up the stairs. In his mind, he only wanted to stop Miiya and ensure that whatever she was doing didn't prove fatal.
entries.literal: "Knowing he was going to be physically stopped, Atsuki ignored Sai and dashed up the stairs. In his mind, he only wanted to stop Miiya and ensure that whatever she was doing didn't prove fatal."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: What the fuck...!? You two, follow him! Someone has to take the elevator. I'm doing it since I have the key to the attic.
entries.literal: "What the fuck...!? You two, follow him! Someone has to take the elevator. I'm doing it since I have the key to the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the second floor, Akaro and Katei found Atsuki inside the partitions. Miiya had made it sound as if she'd wanted to search the whole building, so she could've been anywhere.
entries.literal: "On the second floor, Akaro and Katei found Atsuki inside the partitions. Miiya had made it sound as if she'd wanted to search the whole building, so she could've been anywhere."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Atsuki, wait!
entries.literal: "Atsuki, wait!"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: I won't wait...! We have to find her; it's dangerous to be alone. Sai passed us by, so this is going to go quickly.
entries.literal: "I won't wait...! We have to find her; it's dangerous to be alone. Sai passed us by, so this is going to go quickly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It didn't seem like Atsuki was lying. Both Akaro and Katei thought that he genuinely wanted to find Miiya as soon as possible.
entries.literal: "It didn't seem like Atsuki was lying. Both Akaro and Katei thought that he genuinely wanted to find Miiya as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If they were to fight over it, and Miiya and Atsuki had something planned, it was possible that fighting itself was what would allow it to succeed.
entries.literal: "If they were to fight over it, and Miiya and Atsuki had something planned, it was possible that fighting itself was what would allow it to succeed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The three of them moved one floor higher with the condition that Atsuki wouldn't be left alone.
entries.literal: "The three of them moved one floor higher with the condition that Atsuki wouldn't be left alone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As long as the elevator wasn't used again, they were fairly certain that Miiya wouldn't be the only person found. They knew that it was very likely someone else was present on one of the floors.
entries.literal: "As long as the elevator wasn't used again, they were fairly certain that Miiya wouldn't be the only person found. They knew that it was very likely someone else was present on one of the floors."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Akaro entered the three partitions of the third floor, but they were empty.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Akaro entered the three partitions of the third floor, but they were empty."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The same occurred one floor above.
entries.literal: "The same occurred one floor above."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The fifth and the sixth were desolate as well. It should've been settled, then: there were at least five people in the attic.
entries.literal: "The fifth and the sixth were desolate as well. It should've been settled, then: there were at least five people in the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya, Sai, Shiroya, another Atsuki, and a mysterious fifth person.
entries.literal: "Miiya, Sai, Shiroya, another Atsuki, and a mysterious fifth person."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They approached the door to the attic, but someone came out of it first.
entries.literal: "They approached the door to the attic, but someone came out of it first."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Miiya.
entries.literal: "It was Miiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When she saw the group, she stopped moving. As the three got closer, they saw there was blood on her forehead.
entries.literal: "When she saw the group, she stopped moving. As the three got closer, they saw there was blood on her forehead."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Wh-What happened...!? Are you okay?
entries.literal: "Wh-What happened...!? Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Uh, I don't know.
entries.literal: "Uh, I don't know."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: You don't know?
entries.literal: "You don't know?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Yes. ...I think I might've lost my memory.
entries.literal: "Yes. ...I think I might've lost my memory."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody responded. Instead, they waited, wanting to hear that it had been a joke.
entries.literal: "Nobody responded. Instead, they waited, wanting to hear that it had been a joke."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But that didn't happen. After a few silent seconds, Miiya lowered her eyebrows.
entries.literal: "But that didn't happen. After a few silent seconds, Miiya lowered her eyebrows."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I'm serious. I must've hit my head on these stairs.
entries.literal: "I'm serious. I must've hit my head on these stairs."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She showed them what she was talking about. Just like they'd seen hours earlier on the crystal floor, the edge of one of the steps was covered in blood.
entries.literal: "She showed them what she was talking about. Just like they'd seen hours earlier on the crystal floor, the edge of one of the steps was covered in blood."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...Did you trip while running up, then?
entries.literal: "...Did you trip while running up, then?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I said that I don't know. It must be my blood, because it's fresh and I'm bleeding.
entries.literal: "I said that I don't know. It must be my blood, because it's fresh and I'm bleeding."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: W-Wait. Are you really saying that you lost your memory?
entries.literal: "W-Wait. Are you really saying that you lost your memory?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Yes. Do you think I'm joking?
entries.literal: "Yes. Do you think I'm joking?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Atsuki, what the hell is this?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, what the hell is this?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: What? I have no idea. ...What exactly do you not remember?
entries.literal: "What? I have no idea. ...What exactly do you not remember?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I said that I don't remember anything.
entries.literal: "I said that I don't remember anything."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Nothing at all?
entries.literal: "Nothing at all?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I think so.
entries.literal: "I think so."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: You're joking. You hit your head and lost your memories, like in a damn movie?
entries.literal: "You're joking. You hit your head and lost your memories, like in a damn movie?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Yeah. Memory loss is a real thing, and why are you all so defensive? Shouldn't you be worried?
entries.literal: "Yeah. Memory loss is a real thing, and why are you all so defensive? Shouldn't you be worried?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone was very hesitant. Could she really have been telling the truth? The fresh blood on the stairs was unquestionable.
entries.literal: "Everyone was very hesitant. Could she really have been telling the truth? The fresh blood on the stairs was unquestionable."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: So you don't remember anything in general? What about the date or who we are?
entries.literal: "So you don't remember anything in general? What about the date or who we are?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Again, no. Where are we?
entries.literal: "Again, no. Where are we?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Answering that was too ridiculous. However, if she was lying, what was the purpose?
entries.literal: "Answering that was too ridiculous. However, if she was lying, what was the purpose?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They felt conflicted, but they had already noticed that Miiya seemed different. She had never looked at them like that, and her words felt colder than before.
entries.literal: "They felt conflicted, but they had already noticed that Miiya seemed different. She had never looked at them like that, and her words felt colder than before."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "You're Miiya. Do you not know that either?" Atsuki spoke.
entries.literal: "\"You're Miiya. Do you not know that either?\" Atsuki spoke."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: No. It's pretty strange. I don't know anything about myself, but I know how to speak. I suppose this is how this kind of memory loss works.
entries.literal: "No. It's pretty strange. I don't know anything about myself, but I know how to speak. I suppose this is how this kind of memory loss works."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: You really can't be telling the truth.
entries.literal: "You really can't be telling the truth."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Why not? Would I lie about this? My head does hurt a lot.
entries.literal: "Why not? Would I lie about this? My head does hurt a lot."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: If you hit your head and you're not lying, it should be short-term memory loss, right? Everything should slowly come back to you soon.
entries.literal: "If you hit your head and you're not lying, it should be short-term memory loss, right? Everything should slowly come back to you soon."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I don't know.
entries.literal: "I don't know."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Where are we, though? Why is there a camera there?
entries.literal: "Where are we, though? Why is there a camera there?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...I doubt that's recording. Do you know what Ashiya Tower is? That's where we are.
entries.literal: "...I doubt that's recording. Do you know what Ashiya Tower is? That's where we are."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Hm... Not really, no.
entries.literal: "Hm... Not really, no."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: It's a big building where we got trapped this morning. Do you not know any of that? There was an attack, and the exit closed.
entries.literal: "It's a big building where we got trapped this morning. Do you not know any of that? There was an attack, and the exit closed."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Oh, really? So we can't leave?
entries.literal: "Oh, really? So we can't leave?"

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Atsuki, do you actually believe she's telling the truth?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, do you actually believe she's telling the truth?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I am telling the truth. Is memory loss that rare? I don't think so, right?
entries.literal: "I am telling the truth. Is memory loss that rare? I don't think so, right?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I wonder what Sai will have to say about this. He should be in the attic.
entries.literal: "I wonder what Sai will have to say about this. He should be in the attic."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Who's that?
entries.literal: "Who's that?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...Someone else we got trapped with. Erina and Isla too, who are on the lowest floor. It's almost time for the exit to open, so you'll have to go straight to the hospital.
entries.literal: "...Someone else we got trapped with. Erina and Isla too, who are on the lowest floor. It's almost time for the exit to open, so you'll have to go straight to the hospital."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody could believe that what they were hearing was real. The timing felt too coincidental, and they knew that Miiya had run to the attic for a reason, intentionally going against what everyone else wanted.
entries.literal: "Nobody could believe that what they were hearing was real. The timing felt too coincidental, and they knew that Miiya had run to the attic for a reason, intentionally going against what everyone else wanted."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Do you think this might have anything to do with the Sekimeiya? A side effect, or something?
entries.literal: "Do you think this might have anything to do with the Sekimeiya? A side effect, or something?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: The what?
entries.literal: "The what?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: You really don't remember that either. What about the murders? You shouldn't be alone. Do you not remember Shiroya either?
entries.literal: "You really don't remember that either. What about the murders? You shouldn't be alone. Do you not remember Shiroya either?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: ...Murders? Did someone die?
entries.literal: "...Murders? Did someone die?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Yes. A killer is with us.
entries.literal: "Yes. A killer is with us."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Really? And it could be anyone?
entries.literal: "Really? And it could be anyone?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: It's not so simple, but yes.
entries.literal: "It's not so simple, but yes."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Sai didn't take the elevator again, so he should still be in the attic. Maybe he found someone.
entries.literal: "Sai didn't take the elevator again, so he should still be in the attic. Maybe he found someone."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: It's very possible.
entries.literal: "It's very possible."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Someone? Do you mean the killer?
entries.literal: "Someone? Do you mean the killer?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...I don't know.
entries.literal: "...I don't know."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They stepped into the living room, but nothing could be heard.
entries.literal: "They stepped into the living room, but nothing could be heard."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Since the elevator was there, they didn't want to make noise.
entries.literal: "Since the elevator was there, they didn't want to make noise."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door to the hallway was open, so they peeked through it. Immediately, they saw something.
entries.literal: "The door to the hallway was open, so they peeked through it. Immediately, they saw something."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One of the bedrooms was conspicuously open.
entries.literal: "One of the bedrooms was conspicuously open."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as they looked inside, there were gasps.
entries.literal: "As soon as they looked inside, there were gasps."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai's body lay facing down on the floor. His back had been pierced, apparent by the narrow hole in his shirt, which was soaked in blood.
entries.literal: "Sai's body lay facing down on the floor. His back had been pierced, apparent by the narrow hole in his shirt, which was soaked in blood."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Oh my God, no...
entries.literal: "Oh my God, no..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The four people stared at the scene with wide eyes. ...Sai had been killed.
entries.literal: "The four people stared at the scene with wide eyes. ...Sai had been killed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei slowly crouched to grab the keyring, which had fallen from Sai's pocket. Having it on his person was what had allowed his death.
entries.literal: "Katei slowly crouched to grab the keyring, which had fallen from Sai's pocket. Having it on his person was what had allowed his death."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, they ran to the living room. His killer must've been there, hidden in one of the rooms. ...They couldn't let them escape.
entries.literal: "Then, they ran to the living room. His killer must've been there, hidden in one of the rooms. ...They couldn't let them escape."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: You two wait here.
entries.literal: "You two wait here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The young pair was left behind in the living room while Akaro and Katei looked through the rooms, their heartbeats hammering in their chests.
entries.literal: "The young pair was left behind in the living room while Akaro and Katei looked through the rooms, their heartbeats hammering in their chests."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki's heart did the same as he slowly opened his mouth.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's heart did the same as he slowly opened his mouth."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Are you telling the truth? Why did you want to go to the attic?
entries.literal: "Are you telling the truth? Why did you want to go to the attic?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had noticed something.
entries.literal: "He had noticed something."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When they'd all stepped into the living room, he had looked at the floor. There, he'd seen recent footprints going from the stairs to the hallway... and then back.
entries.literal: "When they'd all stepped into the living room, he had looked at the floor. There, he'd seen recent footprints going from the stairs to the hallway... and then back."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He only wanted an explanation he could accept, but his question hardly garnered a reaction.
entries.literal: "He only wanted an explanation he could accept, but his question hardly garnered a reaction."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro and Katei confirmed that the elevator was present—and empty. Very carefully, they looked at the storeroom and then walked to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "Akaro and Katei confirmed that the elevator was present—and empty. Very carefully, they looked at the storeroom and then walked to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lastly, only the two bedrooms remained. In the right one was Sai's lifeless body, but they couldn't find anyone else.
entries.literal: "Lastly, only the two bedrooms remained. In the right one was Sai's lifeless body, but they couldn't find anyone else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The last place was the mirrored, opposite bedroom. Aside from its lack of a corpse, it was identical.
entries.literal: "The last place was the mirrored, opposite bedroom. Aside from its lack of a corpse, it was identical."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Baffled, they walked back to the living room. There, they saw Atsuki's dead body.
entries.literal: "Baffled, they walked back to the living room. There, they saw Atsuki's dead body."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unlike Sai's, his body was facing the ceiling, but the same type of wound was present in his chest, blood rapidly flowing out of it. Neither of the men could believe what they were seeing.
entries.literal: "Unlike Sai's, his body was facing the ceiling, but the same type of wound was present in his chest, blood rapidly flowing out of it. Neither of the men could believe what they were seeing."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: W-Was it her?
entries.literal: "W-Was it her?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya was nowhere to be found. Only after he had died did Atsuki's words begin to carry weight. In the end, they thought, he really hadn't been working with her.
entries.literal: "Miiya was nowhere to be found. Only after he had died did Atsuki's words begin to carry weight. In the end, they thought, he really hadn't been working with her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro and Katei couldn't move. A killer was near them, but where? Could it be that one of them had done it while they'd each looked at a different bedroom?
entries.literal: "Akaro and Katei couldn't move. A killer was near them, but where? Could it be that one of them had done it while they'd each looked at a different bedroom?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...No. Miiya was the killer; they couldn't think anything else. If another person had done it, she would've yelled. If she had run away, she probably would've been heard. Therefore, the only possible conclusion was that she had killed Atsuki and walked away.
entries.literal: "...No. Miiya was the killer; they couldn't think anything else. If another person had done it, she would've yelled. If she had run away, she probably would've been heard. Therefore, the only possible conclusion was that she had killed Atsuki and walked away."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why? Such a question was irrelevant. If she had shown her true colors openly, everyone was in immense danger.
entries.literal: "Why? Such a question was irrelevant. If she had shown her true colors openly, everyone was in immense danger."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro approached the elevator, but he couldn't open its door.
entries.literal: "Akaro approached the elevator, but he couldn't open its door."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: It was brought down.
entries.literal: "It was brought down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They knew they had to hurry, but it wasn't so simple. As they ran down the stairs, the fear continually caused them to stagger.
entries.literal: "They knew they had to hurry, but it wasn't so simple. As they ran down the stairs, the fear continually caused them to stagger."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At any moment, their lives could be extinguished. They were trapped with a killer who had a weapon and had gone almost twelve hours without being caught. Would they be able to get through the last stretch?
entries.literal: "At any moment, their lives could be extinguished. They were trapped with a killer who had a weapon and had gone almost twelve hours without being caught. Would they be able to get through the last stretch?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: An attack could've been waiting around any corner, but the thought of Erina and Isla pushed them onward.
entries.literal: "An attack could've been waiting around any corner, but the thought of Erina and Isla pushed them onward."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, as they sped down the stairs, they were oblivious to the nightmarish yells that resounded at the bottom of the tower.
entries.literal: "However, as they sped down the stairs, they were oblivious to the nightmarish yells that resounded at the bottom of the tower."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Erina! Isla! Are you there!?
entries.literal: "Erina! Isla! Are you there!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They ran to the open door. Through it, they saw exactly the image they had tried to forbid from entering their minds.
entries.literal: "They ran to the open door. Through it, they saw exactly the image they had tried to forbid from entering their minds."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A mother and her daughter lay on the floor, their bodies no different from the two in the attic. Their torsos had been pierced, and blood was slowly spreading across the floor.
entries.literal: "A mother and her daughter lay on the floor, their bodies no different from the two in the attic. Their torsos had been pierced, and blood was slowly spreading across the floor."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: There's no way...
entries.literal: "There's no way..."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: ...Katei, you have the keys, right?
entries.literal: "...Katei, you have the keys, right?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.literal: "Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: She must want everyone dead. We need to lock ourselves up somewhere, but get the Sekimeiya out! If we're attacked, we'll be able to escape by touching it.
entries.literal: "She must want everyone dead. We need to lock ourselves up somewhere, but get the Sekimeiya out! If we're attacked, we'll be able to escape by touching it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Agreeing that it was the best course of action, Katei ran to the cabinet and unlocked it.
entries.literal: "Agreeing that it was the best course of action, Katei ran to the cabinet and unlocked it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Moments later, the hallway B door opened.
entries.literal: "Moments later, the hallway B door opened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a minute had gone by, a third body lay between Erina and Isla.
entries.literal: "After a minute had gone by, a third body lay between Erina and Isla."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Akaro's. It had been pierced multiple times in the stomach, and no trace of life dwelled in it.
entries.literal: "It was Akaro's. It had been pierced multiple times in the stomach, and no trace of life dwelled in it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Next to the cabinet was the gray Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Next to the cabinet was the gray Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the time came, the shutter opened and the police rushed into Ashiya Tower.
entries.literal: "When the time came, the shutter opened and the police rushed into Ashiya Tower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the lobby was the first indication of the bloodbath that had transpired. Dead eyes watched the officers from the floor, inviting them to a hell of corridors and blood.
entries.literal: "In the lobby was the first indication of the bloodbath that had transpired. Dead eyes watched the officers from the floor, inviting them to a hell of corridors and blood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Afterward, many more bodies were found.
entries.literal: "Afterward, many more bodies were found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the event room, Erina's, Isla's, and Akaro's.
entries.literal: "In the event room, Erina's, Isla's, and Akaro's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In hallway C, Miiya's.{w} On the first staircase, Katei's.{w} Close to them, thrown on the floor, was a screwdriver covered in more than one person's blood.
entries.literal: "In hallway C, Miiya's.{w} On the first staircase, Katei's.{w} Close to them, thrown on the floor, was a screwdriver covered in more than one person's blood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the attic, Atsuki and Sai rested.
entries.literal: "In the attic, Atsuki and Sai rested."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: All of them were dead. In addition, it was confirmed that all of them had died instantly. That meant that they couldn't have killed each other.{w} However, the police raided the whole building and didn't find anyone else.
entries.literal: "All of them were dead. In addition, it was confirmed that all of them had died instantly. That meant that they couldn't have killed each other.{w} However, the police raided the whole building and didn't find anyone else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Because before they had stepped into Ashiya Tower, not a speck of life had existed within it.
entries.literal: "Because before they had stepped into Ashiya Tower, not a speck of life had existed within it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The gray Sekimeiya was found next to the cabinet and placed inside it.
entries.literal: "The gray Sekimeiya was found next to the cabinet and placed inside it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the attic, hidden in a drawer in the kitchen, a playback device was found. Curiously, one of the officers pressed the play button, but nothing seemed to happen. After fiddling with it, he determined that it was broken.
entries.literal: "In the attic, hidden in a drawer in the kitchen, a playback device was found. Curiously, one of the officers pressed the play button, but nothing seemed to happen. After fiddling with it, he determined that it was broken."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the storeroom, the movable wall was discovered. When the police managed to open the door behind it, Sai's mark was removed.
entries.literal: "In the storeroom, the movable wall was discovered. When the police managed to open the door behind it, Sai's mark was removed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, then, what had happened? Who had killed everyone? Every single person who had gotten trapped in the tower had been attacked by someone else.
entries.literal: "So, then, what had happened? Who had killed everyone? Every single person who had gotten trapped in the tower had been attacked by someone else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: An investigation went on for a very long time, but nobody had access to the swathes of information that they were missing.
entries.literal: "An investigation went on for a very long time, but nobody had access to the swathes of information that they were missing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So when a conclusion was reached, it was impossible to feel that the truth had really been found.
entries.literal: "So when a conclusion was reached, it was impossible to feel that the truth had really been found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The sudden, bloody spree was the final mystery of December 15th, 2011, which eluded the grasp of everyone who tried to solve it.
entries.literal: "The sudden, bloody spree was the final mystery of December 15th, 2011, which eluded the grasp of everyone who tried to solve it."

entries.text: Ending: Reward
entries.literal: "Ending: Reward"

entries.text: Delayed Reflection
entries.literal: "Delayed Reflection"

entries.text: Permafrost
entries.literal: "Permafrost"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't move from where I was. I only wanted to finally get out.
entries.literal: "I didn't move from where I was. I only wanted to finally get out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, when Sai had revealed the time, uncertainty had begun to creep in.
entries.literal: "However, when Sai had revealed the time, uncertainty had begun to creep in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was {time=20.} The unbelievable day was coming to an end, but there was still something we were missing.
entries.literal: "It was {time=20.} The unbelievable day was coming to an end, but there was still something we were missing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The truth. We knew nothing about what had happened.
entries.literal: "The truth. We knew nothing about what had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though many of the strange things that had occurred felt at least theoretically possible to understand, when I tried to think about them, I couldn't.
entries.literal: "Even though many of the strange things that had occurred felt at least theoretically possible to understand, when I tried to think about them, I couldn't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Maybe the problem was that I couldn't be sure if I was right about anything, but technically, there was proof that untangling the day's events was possible.
entries.literal: "Maybe the problem was that I couldn't be sure if I was right about anything, but technically, there was proof that untangling the day's events was possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The existence of the Atsuki we'd talked to was inexplicable, but the fact that he'd known what would happen and told us of a certain outcome proved that the truth was attainable.
entries.literal: "The existence of the Atsuki we'd talked to was inexplicable, but the fact that he'd known what would happen and told us of a certain outcome proved that the truth was attainable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite that, as the seconds ticked along, the answers I tried to reach changed more and more.
entries.literal: "Despite that, as the seconds ticked along, the answers I tried to reach changed more and more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What would happen to me? ...I looked up to try to believe that nothing would, but I had no way to know.
entries.literal: "What would happen to me? ...I looked up to try to believe that nothing would, but I had no way to know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At that moment, many people had to be on the other side of the shutter, and my parents were surely present among them. It was a given that we would be thoroughly questioned by the police and that an extensive investigation was to come.
