entries.literal: "At that moment, many people had to be on the other side of the shutter, and my parents were surely present among them. It was a given that we would be thoroughly questioned by the police and that an extensive investigation was to come."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And lastly, by an enigmatic version of Atsuki, we'd been assured that she would somehow come back.
entries.literal: "And lastly, by an enigmatic version of Atsuki, we'd been assured that she would somehow come back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't make any sense, but I had started to care less and less about that. She was alive, and it didn't seem like the fact that she had died twice mattered much. She would come back and maybe bring an explanation with her.
entries.literal: "It didn't make any sense, but I had started to care less and less about that. She was alive, and it didn't seem like the fact that she had died twice mattered much. She would come back and maybe bring an explanation with her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd never wished her any harm, but after her death, I'd realized that her absence was simply better. I didn't want her back.
entries.literal: "I'd never wished her any harm, but after her death, I'd realized that her absence was simply better. I didn't want her back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just as I'd been fond of Atsuki since years in the past, I'd never liked her constant presence. The me from two weeks earlier had shrugged off her disappearance, and the me stuck in the tower couldn't even care about her imminent return. It was all tiresome.
entries.literal: "Just as I'd been fond of Atsuki since years in the past, I'd never liked her constant presence. The me from two weeks earlier had shrugged off her disappearance, and the me stuck in the tower couldn't even care about her imminent return. It was all tiresome."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Coming to the exhibit had ironically worked to bring her back, and it might've been for the better. Even though Atsuki had offered for me to stay with him temporarily, I'd never been sure he would have recovered without going to live with his parents.
entries.literal: "Coming to the exhibit had ironically worked to bring her back, and it might've been for the better. Even though Atsuki had offered for me to stay with him temporarily, I'd never been sure he would have recovered without going to live with his parents."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had to accept we were leaving many questions behind, but there were plenty more in the outside world. Perhaps it wasn't a bad idea to consider finding a job somewhere else if I had the chance. I'd recently learned how much I despised acting differently than I felt, which was bound to persist if I didn't.
entries.literal: "We had to accept we were leaving many questions behind, but there were plenty more in the outside world. Perhaps it wasn't a bad idea to consider finding a job somewhere else if I had the chance. I'd recently learned how much I despised acting differently than I felt, which was bound to persist if I didn't."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What's the time?
entries.literal: "What's the time?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, you wouldn't by chance have been telling the truth, would you?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, you wouldn't by chance have been telling the truth, would you?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I was.
entries.literal: "...I was."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}Akaro, do you remember Erina? Do you think she had all her buttons?
entries.literal: "...{w}Akaro, do you remember Erina? Do you think she had all her buttons?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: O-Oh... I didn't notice.
entries.literal: "O-Oh... I didn't notice."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me neither; I didn't consider it. I think she might've had all of them, though.
entries.literal: "Me neither; I didn't consider it. I think she might've had all of them, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}I didn't lie about anything.
entries.literal: "...{w}I didn't lie about anything."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: If that's true, maybe we really should do what you proposed and go search again.
entries.literal: "If that's true, maybe we really should do what you proposed and go search again."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You think so?
entries.literal: "You think so?"

entries.speaker: m
entries.text: Isn't it too late for that? It's unlikely anything else will happen if we just stay here.
entries.literal: "Isn't it too late for that? It's unlikely anything else will happen if we just stay here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}I suppose.
entries.literal: "...{w}I suppose."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I looked at the rest, I noticed that I wasn't the only person feeling nervous. All of them had their own worries and doubts about what was coming.
entries.literal: "When I looked at the rest, I noticed that I wasn't the only person feeling nervous. All of them had their own worries and doubts about what was coming."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was it freedom that awaited? What would the world do when it found out about the Sekimeiya's powers? The answers were approaching.
entries.literal: "Was it freedom that awaited? What would the world do when it found out about the Sekimeiya's powers? The answers were approaching."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those last twenty minutes were holding the shutter in place. I was good at calming myself down, and that was all I could do.
entries.literal: "Those last twenty minutes were holding the shutter in place. I was good at calming myself down, and that was all I could do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The only movement in the room came from Atsuki bouncing his leg. I closed my eyes, wanting to leave the smoke-stained walls behind as soon as possible.
entries.literal: "The only movement in the room came from Atsuki bouncing his leg. I closed my eyes, wanting to leave the smoke-stained walls behind as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What was that?
entries.literal: "What was that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's coming from the lobby.
entries.literal: "It's coming from the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Five minutes later, we heard a rough sound. Upon stepping into hallway A, it became clear the lobby was the source.
entries.literal: "Five minutes later, we heard a rough sound. Upon stepping into hallway A, it became clear the lobby was the source."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wait, isn't that...?
entries.literal: "Wait, isn't that...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked to the door and opened it.
entries.literal: "We walked to the door and opened it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What...!? It hasn't been twelve hours yet...
entries.literal: "What...!? It hasn't been twelve hours yet..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The shutter was withdrawing, the friction producing the sound we'd heard. Nothing mattered anymore: the faint light of the night had begun to cross the smooth glass of the exit door.
entries.literal: "The shutter was withdrawing, the friction producing the sound we'd heard. Nothing mattered anymore: the faint light of the night had begun to cross the smooth glass of the exit door."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Wh-Wha...
entries.literal: "Wh-Wha..."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: N-Naomi...!
entries.literal: "N-Naomi...!"

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: What's ha...ppening?
entries.literal: "What's ha...ppening?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's already time! Come on, Isla.
entries.literal: "It's already time! Come on, Isla."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh—
entries.literal: "Wh—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perplexed, we stared at Naomi, who slowly raised herself off the floor. She seemed to be in pain, with a strong headache. As soon as she saw the blood below her, she understood it was hers and gasped.
entries.literal: "Perplexed, we stared at Naomi, who slowly raised herself off the floor. She seemed to be in pain, with a strong headache. As soon as she saw the blood below her, she understood it was hers and gasped."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh...? Y-You're okay?
entries.literal: "Oh...? Y-You're okay?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The shutter retracted all the way. Behind the door, one of multiple dark silhouettes placed its hand on the handle.
entries.literal: "The shutter retracted all the way. Behind the door, one of multiple dark silhouettes placed its hand on the handle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But before it opened, Naomi looked at all of us, her eyes driving stakes into our bodies.
entries.literal: "But before it opened, Naomi looked at all of us, her eyes driving stakes into our bodies."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She opened her mouth, and her words were mixed with the sound of our freedom.
entries.literal: "She opened her mouth, and her words were mixed with the sound of our freedom."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: Y-You...! You're a murderer!{w} And you! ...You're behind this attack!
entries.literal: "Y-You...! You're a murderer!{w} And you! ...You're behind this attack!"

entries.text: Chapter 2 Credits
entries.literal: "Chapter 2 Credits"

entries.text: The moonlight glanced off the floor of the lobby.
entries.literal: "The moonlight glanced off the floor of the lobby."

entries.text: Eight pairs of eyes saw the outside world unveiled to them again as the door they'd entered through reopened.
entries.literal: "Eight pairs of eyes saw the outside world unveiled to them again as the door they'd entered through reopened."

entries.text: At that instant, nothing else mattered.
entries.literal: "At that instant, nothing else mattered."

entries.text: The icy air they'd longed for was in reach. It was time for Ashiya Tower to be exposed.
entries.literal: "The icy air they'd longed for was in reach. It was time for Ashiya Tower to be exposed."

entries.text: After that long day, the final result—the world's truth—had been decided.
entries.literal: "After that long day, the final result—the world's truth—had been decided."

entries.text: Many policemen rushed inside the vast lobby.
entries.literal: "Many policemen rushed inside the vast lobby."

entries.text: They saw a group of people next to a door, but there was a more pressing matter.
entries.literal: "They saw a group of people next to a door, but there was a more pressing matter."

entries.text: Lying on the floor was a man wearing their own uniform.
entries.literal: "Lying on the floor was a man wearing their own uniform."

entries.text: That juxtaposition of life and death signified the end of the Sekimeiya's play.
entries.literal: "That juxtaposition of life and death signified the end of the Sekimeiya's play."

entries.text: For one side, it was time to gather questions. For the other, it was time to let them go.
entries.literal: "For one side, it was time to gather questions. For the other, it was time to let them go."

entries.text: Everyone was taken outside, where they saw the stars had always been above them.
entries.literal: "Everyone was taken outside, where they saw the stars had always been above them."

entries.text: But it was soon understood that the events of that day held uncountable mysteries.
entries.literal: "But it was soon understood that the events of that day held uncountable mysteries."

entries.text: The entire building was raided, and nobody else was found.
entries.literal: "The entire building was raided, and nobody else was found."

entries.text: The Sekimeiya, believed to be the target of the attack, hadn't been taken.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya, believed to be the target of the attack, hadn't been taken."

entries.text: A secret door existed in the storeroom, which they were sure the deceased policeman had gone through.
entries.literal: "A secret door existed in the storeroom, which they were sure the deceased policeman had gone through."

entries.text: However, it was locked.
entries.literal: "However, it was locked."

entries.text: To most of the eight witnesses, that was of no consequence.
entries.literal: "To most of the eight witnesses, that was of no consequence."

entries.text: They had no choice but to value their freedom, and they didn't hold the keys to enough questions.
entries.literal: "They had no choice but to value their freedom, and they didn't hold the keys to enough questions."

entries.text: Safely escaping a killer's reach had to be enough for them.
entries.literal: "Safely escaping a killer's reach had to be enough for them."

entries.text: Monetary compensation was given to some due to Ashiya's reckless security measures.
entries.literal: "Monetary compensation was given to some due to Ashiya's reckless security measures."

entries.text: Others were held accountable for potential crimes such as murder and theft.
entries.literal: "Others were held accountable for potential crimes such as murder and theft."

entries.text: None of those eight would ever have the chance to fully learn what had happened that day in the tower.
entries.literal: "None of those eight would ever have the chance to fully learn what had happened that day in the tower."

entries.text: But they were aware of the Sekimeiya's powers.
entries.literal: "But they were aware of the Sekimeiya's powers."

entries.text: However, only two people spoke of them.
entries.literal: "However, only two people spoke of them."

entries.text: Naturally, their statements were ridiculed and interpreted as a laughable, coordinated attempt at cover.
entries.literal: "Naturally, their statements were ridiculed and interpreted as a laughable, coordinated attempt at cover."

entries.text: In the distant future, the Sekimeiya would return to the tower.
entries.literal: "In the distant future, the Sekimeiya would return to the tower."

entries.text: Against the unbelievable claims of the guilty parties, no visitor's touch would allow a travel through time.
entries.literal: "Against the unbelievable claims of the guilty parties, no visitor's touch would allow a travel through time."

entries.text: From then onward, the Sekimeiya would stay in the special cabinet, symbolizing Xyn's failure.
entries.literal: "From then onward, the Sekimeiya would stay in the special cabinet, symbolizing Xyn's failure."

entries.text: There was a lingering question within two of the survivors.
entries.literal: "There was a lingering question within two of the survivors."

entries.text: One isolated from the simple curiosity of the outside world.
entries.literal: "One isolated from the simple curiosity of the outside world."

entries.text: It entailed the veracity of some words they'd heard.
entries.literal: "It entailed the veracity of some words they'd heard."

entries.text: "Everything should turn out fine."
entries.literal: "\"Everything should turn out fine.\""

entries.text: Almost four days had passed.
entries.literal: "Almost four days had passed."

entries.text: But it didn't feel that long. It felt, to them, as if that promise had been made mere hours ago.
entries.literal: "But it didn't feel that long. It felt, to them, as if that promise had been made mere hours ago."

entries.text: Had it already turned out to be false?
entries.literal: "Had it already turned out to be false?"

entries.text: It was impossible to know.
entries.literal: "It was impossible to know."

entries.text: Had those words truly been said?
entries.literal: "Had those words truly been said?"

entries.text: That, too, was impossible to know.
entries.literal: "That, too, was impossible to know."

entries.text: Then, they learned.
entries.literal: "Then, they learned."

entries.text: They understood that they had been aided.
entries.literal: "They understood that they had been aided."

entries.text: Who had it been? A divine presence?
entries.literal: "Who had it been? A divine presence?"

entries.text: There was nobody to thank, so their gratefulness didn't reach anyone.
entries.literal: "There was nobody to thank, so their gratefulness didn't reach anyone."

entries.text: But they knew that entity existed and that it had made possible the bright future ahead.
entries.literal: "But they knew that entity existed and that it had made possible the bright future ahead."

entries.text: Atsuki's phone rang.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's phone rang."

entries.text: On the screen, he saw a name he thought he'd never read again.
entries.literal: "On the screen, he saw a name he thought he'd never read again."

entries.text: He picked up as quickly as possible, and he heard a voice he thought he'd never hear again.
entries.literal: "He picked up as quickly as possible, and he heard a voice he thought he'd never hear again."

entries.text: "A-Atsuki...? What the hell... happened to me?"
entries.literal: "\"A-Atsuki...? What the hell... happened to me?\""

entries.text: Sunrise
entries.literal: "Sunrise"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A handful of police cars had gathered at the entrance of Ashiya Tower, ensuring complete isolation of the inside.
entries.literal: "A handful of police cars had gathered at the entrance of Ashiya Tower, ensuring complete isolation of the inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That had gone on for hours, and Yushibana's citizens had continually extended the crowd behind the authorities. Thirteen police officers stood in front of them like sentinels.
entries.literal: "That had gone on for hours, and Yushibana's citizens had continually extended the crowd behind the authorities. Thirteen police officers stood in front of them like sentinels."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A thick layer of metal had been covering the door of the building all day, and it had been many hours since communication with the inside had suddenly cut off.
entries.literal: "A thick layer of metal had been covering the door of the building all day, and it had been many hours since communication with the inside had suddenly cut off."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Next to the blocked entrance stood the people in charge of the operation. Suripo was told the time: in less than twenty minutes, the blockade would open. They had prepared for all possible outcomes.
entries.literal: "Next to the blocked entrance stood the people in charge of the operation. Suripo was told the time: in less than twenty minutes, the blockade would open. They had prepared for all possible outcomes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo had been there since the previous night, withstanding the constant noise of the curious and alarmed citizens and trying to converse with the stubborn Ashiya representative who had shown up in the morning. After breathing deeply, he approached one of the police cars.
entries.literal: "Suripo had been there since the previous night, withstanding the constant noise of the curious and alarmed citizens and trying to converse with the stubborn Ashiya representative who had shown up in the morning. After breathing deeply, he approached one of the police cars."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Kano, have you seen Vaisude recently?
entries.literal: "Kano, have you seen Vaisude recently?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The policeman under Suripo's orders frowned, realizing that he actually hadn't seen Vaisude in hours.
entries.literal: "The policeman under Suripo's orders frowned, realizing that he actually hadn't seen Vaisude in hours."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: I haven't. Did something happen to him?
entries.literal: "I haven't. Did something happen to him?"

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: He was in his car earlier, but I haven't managed to get in touch with him since. I saw he wasn't waiting in the car, and he didn't pick up when I tried to call him.
entries.literal: "He was in his car earlier, but I haven't managed to get in touch with him since. I saw he wasn't waiting in the car, and he didn't pick up when I tried to call him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kano looked through his left window toward the car Vaisude had been in. It was next to the tower's entrance, and as he'd been told, nobody could be seen through its open windows.
entries.literal: "Kano looked through his left window toward the car Vaisude had been in. It was next to the tower's entrance, and as he'd been told, nobody could be seen through its open windows."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: I apologize, but I don't know what he went to do. I haven't spoken to him all day.
entries.literal: "I apologize, but I don't know what he went to do. I haven't spoken to him all day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo walked away slowly, a little concerned. Days prior, Vaisude had been insistent in saying that an attack would occur on the morning of the 15th. However, he'd also kept saying that it was a hunch and that he didn't have proof of it.
entries.literal: "Suripo walked away slowly, a little concerned. Days prior, Vaisude had been insistent in saying that an attack would occur on the morning of the 15th. However, he'd also kept saying that it was a hunch and that he didn't have proof of it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Furthermore, after their talk, Vaisude had told Suripo that he wouldn't come to work again. He wasn't directly under Suripo's command, but he knew Suripo had been in charge of Ashiya and Xyn's confrontation and that he knew about its details more than his actual boss.
entries.literal: "Furthermore, after their talk, Vaisude had told Suripo that he wouldn't come to work again. He wasn't directly under Suripo's command, but he knew Suripo had been in charge of Ashiya and Xyn's confrontation and that he knew about its details more than his actual boss."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the morning of the 15th, two more police teams had been sent to Ashiya Tower to take control of the situation after the attack. At that time, Suripo had seen Vaisude in the team he'd always been part of.
entries.literal: "On the morning of the 15th, two more police teams had been sent to Ashiya Tower to take control of the situation after the attack. At that time, Suripo had seen Vaisude in the team he'd always been part of."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo knew he might've had valuable information, having correctly foreseen the attack. However, in the past, he hadn't provided any, so Suripo hadn't prioritized going to question him. Later on, when he'd looked, he had been unable to find Vaisude.
entries.literal: "Suripo knew he might've had valuable information, having correctly foreseen the attack. However, in the past, he hadn't provided any, so Suripo hadn't prioritized going to question him. Later on, when he'd looked, he had been unable to find Vaisude."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After talking to his colleagues, they'd all claimed not to know his whereabouts either.
entries.literal: "After talking to his colleagues, they'd all claimed not to know his whereabouts either."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo was indecisive. If Vaisude had known about Xyn's attack, why had he only warned them that it would occur? He hadn't accomplished anything, as it had already been a well-known possibility.{w} And even if he'd been involved with Xyn in some way, the same question had to be asked.
entries.literal: "Suripo was indecisive. If Vaisude had known about Xyn's attack, why had he only warned them that it would occur? He hadn't accomplished anything, as it had already been a well-known possibility.{w} And even if he'd been involved with Xyn in some way, the same question had to be asked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His disappearance was suspicious. Had he gone off to act as a part of their plan, or had something happened to him? At no point had he told anyone about it, and nobody had seen him leaving.
entries.literal: "His disappearance was suspicious. Had he gone off to act as a part of their plan, or had something happened to him? At no point had he told anyone about it, and nobody had seen him leaving."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Confident that those questions would be answered in the future, Suripo walked back to the shutter to continue waiting for {time=21:04}, when the entrance would open.
entries.literal: "Confident that those questions would be answered in the future, Suripo walked back to the shutter to continue waiting for {time=21:04}, when the entrance would open."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Near the back of the crowd, standing off by herself, was a lone blonde woman in a heavy coat. She repeatedly twisted a lock of her hair in one hand, murmuring quietly to herself as the people nearby continued their own louder musings.
entries.literal: "Near the back of the crowd, standing off by herself, was a lone blonde woman in a heavy coat. She repeatedly twisted a lock of her hair in one hand, murmuring quietly to herself as the people nearby continued their own louder musings."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: The smell around here... I wonder what's causing it. You can barely tell it's there, but it's persistent... Is it related?
entries.literal: "The smell around here... I wonder what's causing it. You can barely tell it's there, but it's persistent... Is it related?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The conversation nearby turned to the topic of Xyn and their potential involvement. She went quiet, listening intently for any clues, but it was all information she'd heard within the past few minutes regurgitated once again. Her left foot tapped an unconscious rhythm on the ground.
entries.literal: "The conversation nearby turned to the topic of Xyn and their potential involvement. She went quiet, listening intently for any clues, but it was all information she'd heard within the past few minutes regurgitated once again. Her left foot tapped an unconscious rhythm on the ground."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She wasn't sure how she'd gotten involved in the events around the tower, but once she realized something unnatural was occurring, she couldn't ignore it. Curiosity drove her to appear outside, in spite of the persistent crowd of bored townspeople.
entries.literal: "She wasn't sure how she'd gotten involved in the events around the tower, but once she realized something unnatural was occurring, she couldn't ignore it. Curiosity drove her to appear outside, in spite of the persistent crowd of bored townspeople."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo turned back, surveying the crowd once more. In the darkness, her blonde hair and slight fidgeting stood out. His caution getting the better of him, he decided to approach, as she wasn't a resident of the town he'd ever seen before.
entries.literal: "Suripo turned back, surveying the crowd once more. In the darkness, her blonde hair and slight fidgeting stood out. His caution getting the better of him, he decided to approach, as she wasn't a resident of the town he'd ever seen before."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Excuse me. Would you be able to answer a couple of questions for me?
entries.literal: "Excuse me. Would you be able to answer a couple of questions for me?"

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Hello?
entries.literal: "Hello?"

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: H-Hmm? Do you... mean me, maybe...?
entries.literal: "H-Hmm? Do you... mean me, maybe...?"

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Yes. How long have you been here?
entries.literal: "Yes. How long have you been here?"

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: Oh, ah... Only a little while, maybe an hour. I was... curious about the tower. What's happening inside. Like everyone else here is, of course.
entries.literal: "Oh, ah... Only a little while, maybe an hour. I was... curious about the tower. What's happening inside. Like everyone else here is, of course."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A thin film of sweat formed on her forehead. It wasn't the first time she'd been questioned by a police officer, but being singled out still made her nervous. Within her coat, she rubbed her arms.
entries.literal: "A thin film of sweat formed on her forehead. It wasn't the first time she'd been questioned by a police officer, but being singled out still made her nervous. Within her coat, she rubbed her arms."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: And your name?
entries.literal: "And your name?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: It's {tip=larles}Larles{/tip}. Just Larles is fine. I know it sounds odd, but it's normal where I'm from, I promise.
entries.literal: "It's {tip=larles}Larles{/tip}. Just Larles is fine. I know it sounds odd, but it's normal where I'm from, I promise."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo couldn't place her accent. It had a particular sound to it that he'd never heard before, not even from any kind of shows or songs.
entries.literal: "Suripo couldn't place her accent. It had a particular sound to it that he'd never heard before, not even from any kind of shows or songs."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Would you happen to have any form of identification on you?
entries.literal: "Would you happen to have any form of identification on you?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Trembling like a leaf in the chilly winter breeze, Larles withdrew an object from her interior coat pocket and tapped it a few times. She opened and presented it to Suripo, but her hand shook so thoroughly that he couldn't read it.
entries.literal: "Trembling like a leaf in the chilly winter breeze, Larles withdrew an object from her interior coat pocket and tapped it a few times. She opened and presented it to Suripo, but her hand shook so thoroughly that he couldn't read it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Gently removing it from her grip, he took a closer look and flipped through it. A passport. Completely valid, as far as he could tell, with nothing remotely questionable about it. Her name matched what she claimed.
entries.literal: "Gently removing it from her grip, he took a closer look and flipped through it. A passport. Completely valid, as far as he could tell, with nothing remotely questionable about it. Her name matched what she claimed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nodding slightly, Suripo handed it back to her. Instead of stowing it back in her pocket, Larles began to tap a consistent beat on it, trying to calm her nerves.
entries.literal: "Nodding slightly, Suripo handed it back to her. Instead of stowing it back in her pocket, Larles began to tap a consistent beat on it, trying to calm her nerves."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Did you just move here?
entries.literal: "Did you just move here?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: I'm here on... business. Official business. I just, well, the tower was big news and it reminded me of one back where I'm from. That, and it seemed strange...
entries.literal: "I'm here on... business. Official business. I just, well, the tower was big news and it reminded me of one back where I'm from. That, and it seemed strange..."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Strange how?
entries.literal: "Strange how?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Well, um, everyone's talking about it, right? How strange it is for people to be trapped inside... I-I'm only in town for a little while. I can leave if you think I'm suspicious...
entries.literal: "Well, um, everyone's talking about it, right? How strange it is for people to be trapped inside... I-I'm only in town for a little while. I can leave if you think I'm suspicious..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo arched an eyebrow. She was certainly suspicious, but not in the way that a Xyn plant would be. She was too obvious, and clearly harmless in his eyes.
entries.literal: "Suripo arched an eyebrow. She was certainly suspicious, but not in the way that a Xyn plant would be. She was too obvious, and clearly harmless in his eyes."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: It's the most confusing thing I've ever seen... Why can't it be opened? I've been here a few times now, and nothing seemed out of place, but today there's a big event and no explaining it. Do the police know anything? Everyone around here is clueless like me...
entries.literal: "It's the most confusing thing I've ever seen... Why can't it be opened? I've been here a few times now, and nothing seemed out of place, but today there's a big event and no explaining it. Do the police know anything? Everyone around here is clueless like me..."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: I can't get into what we know and don't know in detail. I'm sure you understand.
entries.literal: "I can't get into what we know and don't know in detail. I'm sure you understand."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Of course, yes. But don't you think there has to be some kind of supernatural component? Like maybe everyone inside time traveled and now they're in the past, at a time when nobody else is inside. Do we even know they're still in there? There's no way to see inside, right?
entries.literal: "Of course, yes. But don't you think there has to be some kind of supernatural component? Like maybe everyone inside time traveled and now they're in the past, at a time when nobody else is inside. Do we even know they're still in there? There's no way to see inside, right?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo blinked in disbelief. She claimed to be in Yushibana on some kind of business, but he didn't believe that. Her bringing up an outlandish topic like time travel most likely meant that she was with some kind of magazine or news company and trying to bait readers.
entries.literal: "Suripo blinked in disbelief. She claimed to be in Yushibana on some kind of business, but he didn't believe that. Her bringing up an outlandish topic like time travel most likely meant that she was with some kind of magazine or news company and trying to bait readers."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Where did you get this idea from?
entries.literal: "Where did you get this idea from?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Um, it was someone in the crowd who mentioned it, and I thought it made a lot of sense...
entries.literal: "Um, it was someone in the crowd who mentioned it, and I thought it made a lot of sense..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Still wary, she gestured indiscriminately at the people around the building. They had formed small, isolated bubbles in places, continuing to increase in volume as the time approached.
entries.literal: "Still wary, she gestured indiscriminately at the people around the building. They had formed small, isolated bubbles in places, continuing to increase in volume as the time approached."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: I see. Have you noticed anyone around here doing anything questionable? Or what about them disappearing?
entries.literal: "I see. Have you noticed anyone around here doing anything questionable? Or what about them disappearing?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Suripo's subtle way of discerning if she'd seen Vaisude recently. He was still concerned about his location.
entries.literal: "It was Suripo's subtle way of discerning if she'd seen Vaisude recently. He was still concerned about his location."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: No, sir, sorry to say. If I had seen anything out of place, I would have told all of you immediately. Promise! I don't want to get in your way at all, only find out the truth.
entries.literal: "No, sir, sorry to say. If I had seen anything out of place, I would have told all of you immediately. Promise! I don't want to get in your way at all, only find out the truth."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At that moment, Larles received a summons she could not ignore. She had known her time was short, but not that she wouldn't even be able to see the conclusion of the tower's mystery.
entries.literal: "At that moment, Larles received a summons she could not ignore. She had known her time was short, but not that she wouldn't even be able to see the conclusion of the tower's mystery."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Actually, I just got a call. I have to be going. Sorry, but would you mind if I took my leave?
entries.literal: "Actually, I just got a call. I have to be going. Sorry, but would you mind if I took my leave?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo sighed. She hadn't even pulled out a phone to check a call. He was no closer to an answer than he had been a few minutes ago, and he didn't expect such sudden excuses. Mentally, he made a note to check into her identity later, just in case his intuition was wrong, but she seemed unreliable at best.
entries.literal: "Suripo sighed. She hadn't even pulled out a phone to check a call. He was no closer to an answer than he had been a few minutes ago, and he didn't expect such sudden excuses. Mentally, he made a note to check into her identity later, just in case his intuition was wrong, but she seemed unreliable at best."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Well, thank you for your time. If you notice anything later on, please feel free to let us know.
entries.literal: "Well, thank you for your time. If you notice anything later on, please feel free to let us know."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo returned to his position. Larles fidgeted slightly, unsure that he had believed her. She didn't have any desire to confuse the locals and desperately wanted to see the shutter open. It was too unique for her to ignore.
entries.literal: "Suripo returned to his position. Larles fidgeted slightly, unsure that he had believed her. She didn't have any desire to confuse the locals and desperately wanted to see the shutter open. It was too unique for her to ignore."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But she was out of time. She couldn't afford to stay any longer. Sighing in resignation, she turned away from the building and began to walk. She had hoped that there was enough time to satisfy her curiosity, but it was inevitable.
entries.literal: "But she was out of time. She couldn't afford to stay any longer. Sighing in resignation, she turned away from the building and began to walk. She had hoped that there was enough time to satisfy her curiosity, but it was inevitable."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Larles made a promise to herself. Whenever she got the opportunity, she would return and determine the truth of that day with her own eyes. She couldn't get into the tower normally, but with enough preparation, it could be done.
entries.literal: "Larles made a promise to herself. Whenever she got the opportunity, she would return and determine the truth of that day with her own eyes. She couldn't get into the tower normally, but with enough preparation, it could be done."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Resolving herself, she vanished into the night.
entries.literal: "Resolving herself, she vanished into the night."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Remember what I said. One of the people inside is a terrorist who will try something to steal the Sekimeiya. Any of the people here could be their comrade, and you must prioritize keeping their plan from succeeding.
entries.literal: "Remember what I said. One of the people inside is a terrorist who will try something to steal the Sekimeiya. Any of the people here could be their comrade, and you must prioritize keeping their plan from succeeding."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: You can stop saying that. I'm well aware of what could be going on.
entries.literal: "You can stop saying that. I'm well aware of what could be going on."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lei wasn't a blood relative of Ashiya, but she'd been sent as their representative, speaking on their behalf, and had been giving the police any essential information.{w} From the get-go, she had stated that the process of stealing the Sekimeiya was underway despite Ashiya's public declarations, which were that Xyn's plan had immediately failed.
entries.literal: "Lei wasn't a blood relative of Ashiya, but she'd been sent as their representative, speaking on their behalf, and had been giving the police any essential information.{w} From the get-go, she had stated that the process of stealing the Sekimeiya was underway despite Ashiya's public declarations, which were that Xyn's plan had immediately failed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was almost {time=21}, and the winter sky had long ago darkened, bringing a sheer cold to everyone who'd kept waiting to witness the resolution of a long day.
entries.literal: "It was almost {time=21}, and the winter sky had long ago darkened, bringing a sheer cold to everyone who'd kept waiting to witness the resolution of a long day."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: This smell again... What the hell is it?
entries.literal: "This smell again... What the hell is it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo wasn't sure either. Throughout the whole day, they'd sporadically noticed a strange smell next to the tower. However, they hadn't been able to identify its source, nor the smell itself.
entries.literal: "Suripo wasn't sure either. Throughout the whole day, they'd sporadically noticed a strange smell next to the tower. However, they hadn't been able to identify its source, nor the smell itself."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: {time=21} came. The crowd was kept back by the group of policemen in front of the tower, but even the officials were partially curious how the shutter would withdraw.
entries.literal: "{time=21} came. The crowd was kept back by the group of policemen in front of the tower, but even the officials were partially curious how the shutter would withdraw."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Speculation hadn't stopped. The widespread belief was that everything had been part of Xyn's plan and Ashiya had no way of stopping it. However, nobody could agree on how Xyn would actually do it.
entries.literal: "Speculation hadn't stopped. The widespread belief was that everything had been part of Xyn's plan and Ashiya had no way of stopping it. However, nobody could agree on how Xyn would actually do it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Multiple groups of those with similar views formed the crowd outside the tower. On one side was the simply curious portion. On the other, the older citizens were eagerly awaiting Ashiya's defeat, voicing their harsh thoughts on the family.
entries.literal: "Multiple groups of those with similar views formed the crowd outside the tower. On one side was the simply curious portion. On the other, the older citizens were eagerly awaiting Ashiya's defeat, voicing their harsh thoughts on the family."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It had become known that the exit was going to remain closed for twelve hours, and although the police had kept quiet, something had seemingly caused disorder among them less than an hour after the attack.
entries.literal: "It had become known that the exit was going to remain closed for twelve hours, and although the police had kept quiet, something had seemingly caused disorder among them less than an hour after the attack."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Additionally, the names of the trapped people had been released, but nobody had seen or heard of any of their relatives waiting outside for them.
entries.literal: "Additionally, the names of the trapped people had been released, but nobody had seen or heard of any of their relatives waiting outside for them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the police stood up, everyone knew the time had come, and the flash of some cameras started to illuminate the dark exterior of the tower.
entries.literal: "When the police stood up, everyone knew the time had come, and the flash of some cameras started to illuminate the dark exterior of the tower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The last minutes were quiet. The police had been exchanging words, but they were too far from the crowd to be heard.
entries.literal: "The last minutes were quiet. The police had been exchanging words, but they were too far from the crowd to be heard."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Will this be enough people to apprehend everyone? We don't want something funny occurring.
entries.literal: "Will this be enough people to apprehend everyone? We don't want something funny occurring."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: That's not a concern. Nobody will have a way to sneak anything out.
entries.literal: "That's not a concern. Nobody will have a way to sneak anything out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There were only a few seconds left. Nobody knew the exact time the shutter had closed, but they had determined it had been right about {time=9:04.}
entries.literal: "There were only a few seconds left. Nobody knew the exact time the shutter had closed, but they had determined it had been right about {time=9:04.}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Finally, letting out a loud and hoarse noise, the heavy shutter began to rise until it fully disappeared from view. At the same time, some people in the crowd began to point up, where the same thing was happening to the covered windows.
entries.literal: "Finally, letting out a loud and hoarse noise, the heavy shutter began to rise until it fully disappeared from view. At the same time, some people in the crowd began to point up, where the same thing was happening to the covered windows."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door wasn't blocked anymore, and the bright lobby could be seen through it. Immediately, the policemen rushed in while Suripo's expectations remained unmet.
entries.literal: "The door wasn't blocked anymore, and the bright lobby could be seen through it. Immediately, the policemen rushed in while Suripo's expectations remained unmet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd been continuously told that someone would try to exit immediately with the Sekimeiya, and that they would need to be hastily detained. However, nobody could be seen inside.
entries.literal: "He'd been continuously told that someone would try to exit immediately with the Sekimeiya, and that they would need to be hastily detained. However, nobody could be seen inside."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Wh-What the fuck is this!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What the fuck is this!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before they could step into the tower, the team who'd rushed in was instantly taken aback, making brief eye contact with the confused multitude outside while covering their noses and grimacing.
entries.literal: "Before they could step into the tower, the team who'd rushed in was instantly taken aback, making brief eye contact with the confused multitude outside while covering their noses and grimacing."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: ...What's wrong!?
entries.literal: "...What's wrong!?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: There's something inside! It could be dangerous!
entries.literal: "There's something inside! It could be dangerous!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone who'd stayed next to the door understood immediately. After it had opened, it hadn't taken much time for the smell they'd been noticing to drastically intensify. That confirmed it had been coming from within the tower, something they had previously discounted.
entries.literal: "Everyone who'd stayed next to the door understood immediately. After it had opened, it hadn't taken much time for the smell they'd been noticing to drastically intensify. That confirmed it had been coming from within the tower, something they had previously discounted."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Twelve hours earlier, unidentified smoke had been released on the first floor of the tower. Right away, the possibility of it being poisonous had been presented.{w} However, they'd abandoned it as soon as the safety of the trapped individuals had been confirmed less than an hour later. Nonetheless, they'd prepared equipment such as masks just to be careful.
entries.literal: "Twelve hours earlier, unidentified smoke had been released on the first floor of the tower. Right away, the possibility of it being poisonous had been presented.{w} However, they'd abandoned it as soon as the safety of the trapped individuals had been confirmed less than an hour later. Nonetheless, they'd prepared equipment such as masks just to be careful."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When they rushed to grab their equipment, the crowd began to show concern for the eight people trapped, whose figures hadn't yet appeared.
entries.literal: "When they rushed to grab their equipment, the crowd began to show concern for the eight people trapped, whose figures hadn't yet appeared."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: I knew it! Didn't I tell you they were planning something!? You all better not let them get away with whatever they're trying to do!
entries.literal: "I knew it! Didn't I tell you they were planning something!? You all better not let them get away with whatever they're trying to do!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone had retreated from the entrance as soon as it had been perceived as dangerous. That could well have been an opening for someone inside to escape, but no such thing occurred.
entries.literal: "Everyone had retreated from the entrance as soon as it had been perceived as dangerous. That could well have been an opening for someone inside to escape, but no such thing occurred."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From a truck, the police took out protective suits alongside an optical gas imaging camera, as whatever had hit their noses had been invisible. The team ran back to the lobby and scanned the area with it.
entries.literal: "From a truck, the police took out protective suits alongside an optical gas imaging camera, as whatever had hit their noses had been invisible. The team ran back to the lobby and scanned the area with it."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Look... There's definitely something inside.
entries.literal: "Look... There's definitely something inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone who looked at the image saw what appeared to be very dense gas occupying the entire hall. It looked white in the image, and it seemed to completely lack a source.
entries.literal: "Everyone who looked at the image saw what appeared to be very dense gas occupying the entire hall. It looked white in the image, and it seemed to completely lack a source."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The people in the back could see every movement, and they understood that the situation was being communicated through wireless devices.
entries.literal: "The people in the back could see every movement, and they understood that the situation was being communicated through wireless devices."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The gas was unidentified, but they'd all inhaled some of it. However, even if it was toxic, the masks and suits would work as protection. Knowing that, the same team who'd tried to enter did so once again, hiding their faces behind the protective filters.
entries.literal: "The gas was unidentified, but they'd all inhaled some of it. However, even if it was toxic, the masks and suits would work as protection. Knowing that, the same team who'd tried to enter did so once again, hiding their faces behind the protective filters."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Look for the Sekimeiya in the cabinet! If it's empty, finding the Sekimeiya is the priority!
entries.literal: "Look for the Sekimeiya in the cabinet! If it's empty, finding the Sekimeiya is the priority!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lei had informed them of how the Sekimeiya looked and the necessity for cold temperature. Everyone who'd entered knew the Sekimeiya had to be immediately placed inside the cabinet, but after the precarious situation had been revealed, their focus was to secure everyone inside.
entries.literal: "Lei had informed them of how the Sekimeiya looked and the necessity for cold temperature. Everyone who'd entered knew the Sekimeiya had to be immediately placed inside the cabinet, but after the precarious situation had been revealed, their focus was to secure everyone inside."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Hey, look!
entries.literal: "Hey, look!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Five people had entered. Before they could disperse through the building, one alerted the others and pointed at the floor.
entries.literal: "Five people had entered. Before they could disperse through the building, one alerted the others and pointed at the floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There, they saw dried blood. Not a single soul was in the lobby awaiting their escape—there was only blood. A foreboding emotion ate at the edges of the men who'd gone in first.
entries.literal: "There, they saw dried blood. Not a single soul was in the lobby awaiting their escape—there was only blood. A foreboding emotion ate at the edges of the men who'd gone in first."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While everyone else waited impatiently, those five officers began to scatter, opening every room and trying to uncover every unseen spot. They knew the layout of the building and had been given a way to enter every place that could be locked.
entries.literal: "While everyone else waited impatiently, those five officers began to scatter, opening every room and trying to uncover every unseen spot. They knew the layout of the building and had been given a way to enter every place that could be locked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One man confirmed that the mechanical room was barren and rushed back up to enter hallway B, its walls nearly as dark.{w} There, an old friend of his frantically tried to find the people who should've been trapped inside. A great deal of blood was on the floor toward the end of the hallway, which only compounded the officers' uneasiness.
entries.literal: "One man confirmed that the mechanical room was barren and rushed back up to enter hallway B, its walls nearly as dark.{w} There, an old friend of his frantically tried to find the people who should've been trapped inside. A great deal of blood was on the floor toward the end of the hallway, which only compounded the officers' uneasiness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he entered one of the crystal rooms on the right side, he saw the first person and stopped in place, turning around to confirm with the man behind him that what he was seeing was real.
entries.literal: "When he entered one of the crystal rooms on the right side, he saw the first person and stopped in place, turning around to confirm with the man behind him that what he was seeing was real."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the opposite hallway was a longer trail of blood. The security room was the first place to be opened, so they didn't have to wait long to have their fears confirmed.{w} Then, in a deeper room, they saw an even more wretched nightmare.
entries.literal: "In the opposite hallway was a longer trail of blood. The security room was the first place to be opened, so they didn't have to wait long to have their fears confirmed.{w} Then, in a deeper room, they saw an even more wretched nightmare."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, when one of the bathrooms was opened, any comprehension they had instantly shattered.
entries.literal: "However, when one of the bathrooms was opened, any comprehension they had instantly shattered."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They walked up the first staircase and saw a person standing there.{w} It was a girl with blue hair who looked a little disoriented.
entries.literal: "They walked up the first staircase and saw a person standing there.{w} It was a girl with blue hair who looked a little disoriented."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone rushed to her and confirmed her safety. Instead of hammering her with questions, being under the impression that the gas could've been toxic, one of the men escorted her to the lobby, where she was hit by the air she'd been longing for.
entries.literal: "Everyone rushed to her and confirmed her safety. Instead of hammering her with questions, being under the impression that the gas could've been toxic, one of the men escorted her to the lobby, where she was hit by the air she'd been longing for."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The search continued, as more people were yet to be found. However, when the police reached the attic's door, there had been no new discovery.
entries.literal: "The search continued, as more people were yet to be found. However, when the police reached the attic's door, there had been no new discovery."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One of them had been given that key after pressuring Ashiya. Once the highest level of the tower was unlocked, they rushed inside.
entries.literal: "One of them had been given that key after pressuring Ashiya. Once the highest level of the tower was unlocked, they rushed inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Less than half a minute was needed to understand that three people were missing. However, even though they hadn't found anyone in the attic, they had spotted something else they'd been searching for.
entries.literal: "Less than half a minute was needed to understand that three people were missing. However, even though they hadn't found anyone in the attic, they had spotted something else they'd been searching for."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The entrance had been closed again to prevent the gas from escaping, and every bystander had shifted farther back after being informed of the possible danger.
entries.literal: "The entrance had been closed again to prevent the gas from escaping, and every bystander had shifted farther back after being informed of the possible danger."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo continued to wait for the arrival of his team, the only sound being the confused muttering of the crowd. At his side, Lei was visibly tense.
entries.literal: "Suripo continued to wait for the arrival of his team, the only sound being the confused muttering of the crowd. At his side, Lei was visibly tense."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One of their men appeared from hallway A with a girl who seemed to be in pain.
entries.literal: "One of their men appeared from hallway A with a girl who seemed to be in pain."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "...Are you okay?" Suripo asked.{w} The girl nodded faintly and looked away from him.
entries.literal: "\"...Are you okay?\" Suripo asked.{w} The girl nodded faintly and looked away from him."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: What's your name?
entries.literal: "What's your name?"

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Shiroya."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: I see. I'm really sorry you had to go through this.
entries.literal: "I see. I'm really sorry you had to go through this."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But the other policeman glared at Suripo, who didn't know what else was inside.
entries.literal: "But the other policeman glared at Suripo, who didn't know what else was inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he walked to a car with Shiroya, where the eight people trapped inside were planned to be held.
entries.literal: "Then, he walked to a car with Shiroya, where the eight people trapped inside were planned to be held."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After five minutes of no development, a second policeman came back. Outside, he took his mask off, and the look in his eyes was enough to convey what he'd seen.
entries.literal: "After five minutes of no development, a second policeman came back. Outside, he took his mask off, and the look in his eyes was enough to convey what he'd seen."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Four of them are... dead. Counting everyone, there should be {tip=three}three left{/tip}.
entries.literal: "Four of them are... dead. Counting everyone, there should be {tip=three}three left{/tip}."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Wh-What...!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...!?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: They were killed... But the others aren't anywhere inside. We haven't found the other three people who should be here.
entries.literal: "They were killed... But the others aren't anywhere inside. We haven't found the other three people who should be here."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Are you fucking serious? What about the Sekimeiya!?
entries.literal: "Are you fucking serious? What about the Sekimeiya!?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Don't worry about that.
entries.literal: "Don't worry about that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He explained that, in the attic, they'd found an egg-shaped white object that matched the Sekimeiya's description. Then, it had been brought to the cabinet downstairs as instructed.
entries.literal: "He explained that, in the attic, they'd found an egg-shaped white object that matched the Sekimeiya's description. Then, it had been brought to the cabinet downstairs as instructed."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Then...! Someone got into the cabinet. This plan definitely revolved around the Sekimeiya, but it failed. That has to be it.
entries.literal: "Then...! Someone got into the cabinet. This plan definitely revolved around the Sekimeiya, but it failed. That has to be it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lei looked relieved despite having been told about four casualties. However, Suripo still hadn't understood his subordinate.
entries.literal: "Lei looked relieved despite having been told about four casualties. However, Suripo still hadn't understood his subordinate."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: H-How is it possible the other three haven't been found? Are you sure you searched everywhere?
entries.literal: "H-How is it possible the other three haven't been found? Are you sure you searched everywhere?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Yes. Did you personally speak with all of them?
entries.literal: "Yes. Did you personally speak with all of them?"

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: I did. They all told me their names. They have to be inside.
entries.literal: "I did. They all told me their names. They have to be inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two more policemen came from the hallways and reported the same result. However, one of them inquired about something different.
entries.literal: "Two more policemen came from the hallways and reported the same result. However, one of them inquired about something different."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Is it possible they could have escaped? I saw a door in the storeroom I wasn't aware of.
entries.literal: "Is it possible they could have escaped? I saw a door in the storeroom I wasn't aware of."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: What the hell are you talking about?
entries.literal: "What the hell are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The man told them about the movable wall and about the door with a missing handle. Instead of entering to witness it by themselves, they walked to the left side of the building and estimated where the storeroom might've been.
entries.literal: "The man told them about the movable wall and about the door with a missing handle. Instead of entering to witness it by themselves, they walked to the left side of the building and estimated where the storeroom might've been."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: What the fuck is this...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck is this...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After just a minute of searching, a faint outline had been found resembling a door. Furthermore, although it was exceptionally well-hidden, they saw a keyhole that meshed perfectly with the surface of the wall.
entries.literal: "After just a minute of searching, a faint outline had been found resembling a door. Furthermore, although it was exceptionally well-hidden, they saw a keyhole that meshed perfectly with the surface of the wall."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: There's no way this is a door! No such thing exists in the storeroom!
entries.literal: "There's no way this is a door! No such thing exists in the storeroom!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo ignored her; there was obviously a door. However, it didn't explain anything.
entries.literal: "Suripo ignored her; there was obviously a door. However, it didn't explain anything."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Nobody could've escaped through here. Very soon after the attack occurred, people started watching from both sides. And not just the civilians gathered out here, but also the police.
entries.literal: "Nobody could've escaped through here. Very soon after the attack occurred, people started watching from both sides. And not just the civilians gathered out here, but also the police."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lei was astonished, as no such door should've existed. However, even though she couldn't trust that nobody could've escaped, she wasn't that concerned. After all, the well-being of the Sekimeiya had been confirmed. In the worst-case scenario, the Xyn members had fled.
entries.literal: "Lei was astonished, as no such door should've existed. However, even though she couldn't trust that nobody could've escaped, she wasn't that concerned. After all, the well-being of the Sekimeiya had been confirmed. In the worst-case scenario, the Xyn members had fled."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: And given what I saw, nobody could've opened it from the inside. The handle had been removed, and there was no lock to pick.
entries.literal: "And given what I saw, nobody could've opened it from the inside. The handle had been removed, and there was no lock to pick."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: No... There's no way this leads inside the tower. It's impossible I wouldn't know about it.
entries.literal: "No... There's no way this leads inside the tower. It's impossible I wouldn't know about it."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: We can determine that easily.
entries.literal: "We can determine that easily."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The keyhole looked old, and Suripo believed that opening it without the key would be doable. If it was rusty or had been frozen, it could've been impossible, but if it was in a decent state, it shouldn't have taken him very long.
entries.literal: "The keyhole looked old, and Suripo believed that opening it without the key would be doable. If it was rusty or had been frozen, it could've been impossible, but if it was in a decent state, it shouldn't have taken him very long."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He instructed his subordinate to run to his car, where he had a standard lock picking set. Once he received it, Suripo began to fiddle with the lock and quickly found that picking it was possible.
entries.literal: "He instructed his subordinate to run to his car, where he had a standard lock picking set. Once he received it, Suripo began to fiddle with the lock and quickly found that picking it was possible."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: This door is locked. We'd have to do this even if we had a handle.
entries.literal: "This door is locked. We'd have to do this even if we had a handle."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The other two looked at him, trying to suppress their own shivering. It wasn't from the cold alone—they'd learned that people had died, but also that some were missing. If the door led to a hidden room, the rest could've been inside.
entries.literal: "The other two looked at him, trying to suppress their own shivering. It wasn't from the cold alone—they'd learned that people had died, but also that some were missing. If the door led to a hidden room, the rest could've been inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The major part of the crowd was occupied with looking at the entrance, so they didn't pay much attention to the people who'd gone to the left side of the building. After a few short minutes, the lock clicked, and the door swung in.
entries.literal: "The major part of the crowd was occupied with looking at the entrance, so they didn't pay much attention to the people who'd gone to the left side of the building. After a few short minutes, the lock clicked, and the door swung in."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: There's no fucking way... How did I not know about this!? And how could Xyn!?
entries.literal: "There's no fucking way... How did I not know about this!? And how could Xyn!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The three of them saw the dark storeroom, with the wall that the other policeman had closed hiding the hallway door from view.
entries.literal: "The three of them saw the dark storeroom, with the wall that the other policeman had closed hiding the hallway door from view."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was truly the storeroom. The peculiar smell started to become prominent once again, so they rushed back out and walked to the main entrance, wondering if that door had truly been used as a method of escape. It seemed it hadn't been possible to open from the inside, but the handle could've been removed by the people who hadn't escaped or while the door had been open.
entries.literal: "It was truly the storeroom. The peculiar smell started to become prominent once again, so they rushed back out and walked to the main entrance, wondering if that door had truly been used as a method of escape. It seemed it hadn't been possible to open from the inside, but the handle could've been removed by the people who hadn't escaped or while the door had been open."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Outside the front door, they saw the final man who'd entered the building. All of them confirmed the same story: four people had died, and there was nobody else alive.
entries.literal: "Outside the front door, they saw the final man who'd entered the building. All of them confirmed the same story: four people had died, and there was nobody else alive."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: One of the victims is Naomi Cabca, who worked in the tower. However, two bodies that look exactly like her are inside. None of the people who got trapped shared her last name, correct?
entries.literal: "One of the victims is Naomi Cabca, who worked in the tower. However, two bodies that look exactly like her are inside. None of the people who got trapped shared her last name, correct?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo kept growing more confused and shook his head. Four of the people he'd talked to in the morning had died, which he still had trouble accepting. What the hell had happened in the tower?
entries.literal: "Suripo kept growing more confused and shook his head. Four of the people he'd talked to in the morning had died, which he still had trouble accepting. What the hell had happened in the tower?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: I took images of the inside. The gas is present practically around the entire building in different quantities, but I wasn't able to find a source for it.
entries.literal: "I took images of the inside. The gas is present practically around the entire building in different quantities, but I wasn't able to find a source for it."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: What...? How's that possible?
entries.literal: "What...? How's that possible?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: I also took pictures of the bodies.
entries.literal: "I also took pictures of the bodies."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo remembered the voice of the child he'd heard at the start of that long day after looking at her face. The pictures also encompassed all the blood found in the hallways and elevator.{w} Two of the bodies had the same face and clothing, which was incredibly odd, as nothing like that had been mentioned during the brief period of communication with those inside.
entries.literal: "Suripo remembered the voice of the child he'd heard at the start of that long day after looking at her face. The pictures also encompassed all the blood found in the hallways and elevator.{w} Two of the bodies had the same face and clothing, which was incredibly odd, as nothing like that had been mentioned during the brief period of communication with those inside."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: These bodies must be taken out. We don't know what happened or what this gas is, but it's in the entire building. A proper investigation might not be able to occur for a while with these circumstances.{w} However, the security cameras have been recording since this all started. Save all the footage to a drive.
entries.literal: "These bodies must be taken out. We don't know what happened or what this gas is, but it's in the entire building. A proper investigation might not be able to occur for a while with these circumstances.{w} However, the security cameras have been recording since this all started. Save all the footage to a drive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door had been closed again, but even then, they felt the smell was still present. They kept taking more steps back while the orders to analyze the gas were being sent.
entries.literal: "The door had been closed again, but even then, they felt the smell was still present. They kept taking more steps back while the orders to analyze the gas were being sent."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo saw that one of his men was holding something.
entries.literal: "Suripo saw that one of his men was holding something."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: What's that?
entries.literal: "What's that?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Oh, it's something I found on the first floor. Take a look at it.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's something I found on the first floor. Take a look at it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo reached out and grabbed a tiny piece of paper. He began to read the words written on it out loud.
entries.literal: "Suripo reached out and grabbed a tiny piece of paper. He began to read the words written on it out loud."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: Hello... I'm sorry that I have to write this.
entries.literal: "Hello... I'm sorry that I have to write this."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: I still can't believe what happened. I haven't been able to stop crying, but I've always tried to tell myself that these things just occur.
entries.literal: "I still can't believe what happened. I haven't been able to stop crying, but I've always tried to tell myself that these things just occur."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: I know how selfish it is that I'm writing this, but I won't be able to live with myself if I don't.
entries.literal: "I know how selfish it is that I'm writing this, but I won't be able to live with myself if I don't."

entries.speaker: sunn
entries.text: I need to say it.{w} I've always wanted to, and I can't believe I never will.{w} I love you.
entries.literal: "I need to say it.{w} I've always wanted to, and I can't believe I never will.{w} I love you."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone who heard Suripo was bewildered.
entries.literal: "Everyone who heard Suripo was bewildered."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And then, when they understood that the events of that day contained innumerably more mysteries than they'd expected, as their only wish, they hoped that all the truth could be exposed.
entries.literal: "And then, when they understood that the events of that day contained innumerably more mysteries than they'd expected, as their only wish, they hoped that all the truth could be exposed."

entries.text: Self-Fulfillment
entries.literal: "Self-Fulfillment"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The sun had long ago set, letting the sheer cold prevail in the streets of Yushibana.
entries.literal: "The sun had long ago set, letting the sheer cold prevail in the streets of Yushibana."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Near the outskirts, the moon and a few light posts provided the only illumination. It was late, and everyone around was preparing to end their day.
entries.literal: "Near the outskirts, the moon and a few light posts provided the only illumination. It was late, and everyone around was preparing to end their day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Not one of them saw the figure of a young girl appearing by the entrance of a house, below a stone roof.
entries.literal: "Not one of them saw the figure of a young girl appearing by the entrance of a house, below a stone roof."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She found herself leaning against the cold wall and quickly looked down.
entries.literal: "She found herself leaning against the cold wall and quickly looked down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Light snow was falling, but she was still able to discern some of the footprints she'd once left.
entries.literal: "Light snow was falling, but she was still able to discern some of the footprints she'd once left."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Next to the wheel marks, she knew that what she was seeing were the imprints of three different pairs of shoes. One trail was hers, and the other two belonged to two of her friends.
entries.literal: "Next to the wheel marks, she knew that what she was seeing were the imprints of three different pairs of shoes. One trail was hers, and the other two belonged to two of her friends."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She traced them with her eyes and followed them to a door in the middle of the street. Next to it was a modest window with a curtain concealing the interior.
entries.literal: "She traced them with her eyes and followed them to a door in the middle of the street. Next to it was a modest window with a curtain concealing the interior."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Light was coming from the other side, but it was very faint. Without wasting time, she dashed to the door and opened it.
entries.literal: "Light was coming from the other side, but it was very faint. Without wasting time, she dashed to the door and opened it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had appeared from the future. Instants earlier, she had been inside Ashiya Tower, on December 15th.
entries.literal: "She had appeared from the future. Instants earlier, she had been inside Ashiya Tower, on December 15th."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was fifteen days before that time, so she knew what was soon to happen in the tiny store she'd hastily run to.
entries.literal: "It was fifteen days before that time, so she knew what was soon to happen in the tiny store she'd hastily run to."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At one point, her friend Atsuki had told her that it was possible to change the past. She firmly believed that she could make it happen herself.
entries.literal: "At one point, her friend Atsuki had told her that it was possible to change the past. She firmly believed that she could make it happen herself."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She pulled open the door, planning to diverge the world from the one she knew.
entries.literal: "She pulled open the door, planning to diverge the world from the one she knew."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Her field of vision was filled by lingering smoke. Knowing not to breathe in, she glanced down as the door closed behind her.
entries.literal: "Her field of vision was filled by lingering smoke. Knowing not to breathe in, she glanced down as the door closed behind her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There, she saw the first two people who'd fallen unconscious. They had already escaped danger.
entries.literal: "There, she saw the first two people who'd fallen unconscious. They had already escaped danger."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She ran through the oppressive cloud and looked behind the stand of shelves.
entries.literal: "She ran through the oppressive cloud and looked behind the stand of shelves."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the floor was her own body. She recalled the time she'd seen the smoke appearing and been unable to resist the loss of consciousness.
