entries.literal: "On the floor was her own body. She recalled the time she'd seen the smoke appearing and been unable to resist the loss of consciousness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She would be fine as well, so she stepped to the far side of the room.
entries.literal: "She would be fine as well, so she stepped to the far side of the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As she did so, she couldn't help but briefly breathe the polluted air. She was afraid it would knock her out, but instead, she noticed something.
entries.literal: "As she did so, she couldn't help but briefly breathe the polluted air. She was afraid it would knock her out, but instead, she noticed something."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the smell from that day... And she knew what it was.
entries.literal: "It was the smell from that day... And she knew what it was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Behind the prominent stenches of the smoke and artificial gas, there was a third, hidden smell, present all around the shop. It was a possibility she'd already explored, so it didn't come as a surprise to her, but there was no time to think as she looked behind the last set of shelves.
entries.literal: "Behind the prominent stenches of the smoke and artificial gas, there was a third, hidden smell, present all around the shop. It was a possibility she'd already explored, so it didn't come as a surprise to her, but there was no time to think as she looked behind the last set of shelves."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She saw the last person. Her friend, Miiya, was unconscious on the floor, facing the ceiling. Just behind her was a powered-off heater, silently emitting the deadly gas that had once ended her life.
entries.literal: "She saw the last person. Her friend, Miiya, was unconscious on the floor, facing the ceiling. Just behind her was a powered-off heater, silently emitting the deadly gas that had once ended her life."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The range of the explosion would not be large, so saving her friend was doable, and she was confident she'd succeed.
entries.literal: "The range of the explosion would not be large, so saving her friend was doable, and she was confident she'd succeed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She kneeled and grabbed the shoulders of the unconscious girl. Then, she stepped back to drop her behind the shelves that would protect her.
entries.literal: "She kneeled and grabbed the shoulders of the unconscious girl. Then, she stepped back to drop her behind the shelves that would protect her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At that point, she was saved, but she kept moving back, so that the soon-to-break floor wouldn't swallow her. Once she was absent from all danger, the girl stood up and looked at her past self.
entries.literal: "At that point, she was saved, but she kept moving back, so that the soon-to-break floor wouldn't swallow her. Once she was absent from all danger, the girl stood up and looked at her past self."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She didn't know the exact time, but her job hadn't ended yet.{w} She stepped up to her own shoulders and grabbed them. After lifting herself, she began to back up.
entries.literal: "She didn't know the exact time, but her job hadn't ended yet.{w} She stepped up to her own shoulders and grabbed them. After lifting herself, she began to back up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, her heart suddenly skipped a beat.
entries.literal: "Then, her heart suddenly skipped a beat."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She turned around. She didn't see the door opening because a wooden shelf was blocking her sight, but soon after she heard its sound, the lights turned off.
entries.literal: "She turned around. She didn't see the door opening because a wooden shelf was blocking her sight, but soon after she heard its sound, the lights turned off."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was no time to react.{w} During the instants before the light came back on, the girl closed her eyes and attempted to cover her face with her arms.
entries.literal: "There was no time to react.{w} During the instants before the light came back on, the girl closed her eyes and attempted to cover her face with her arms."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The floor had shattered, and she found herself falling with the rubble, the deadly light shrinking within the familiar darkness.
entries.literal: "The floor had shattered, and she found herself falling with the rubble, the deadly light shrinking within the familiar darkness."

entries.text: Hex Ladder
entries.literal: "Hex Ladder"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd been in front of the queue for a long time, looking at the dull, wooden door that would soon open.
entries.literal: "We'd been in front of the queue for a long time, looking at the dull, wooden door that would soon open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked behind me and noticed that a lot of people were waiting. The entrance kept opening, sending icy breezes toward my neck.
entries.literal: "I looked behind me and noticed that a lot of people were waiting. The entrance kept opening, sending icy breezes toward my neck."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd never seen the interior of Ashiya Tower before, and I'd never believed I'd ever enter it. The lobby felt empty despite all the people that had come due to the vast and dreary amount of space.
entries.literal: "I'd never seen the interior of Ashiya Tower before, and I'd never believed I'd ever enter it. The lobby felt empty despite all the people that had come due to the vast and dreary amount of space."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I think it'll be time soon.
entries.literal: "...I think it'll be time soon."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yeah, probably less than twenty minutes.
entries.literal: "Yeah, probably less than twenty minutes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd had my mind empty all day, with no capacity to hold a conversation. Atsuki knew that and kept restlessly glancing around.
entries.literal: "I'd had my mind empty all day, with no capacity to hold a conversation. Atsuki knew that and kept restlessly glancing around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hated the way I'd become and silently apologized for putting him through even more pain. It was early in the morning, and we hadn't slept. Almost exhausted, I let my head drop and thoughtlessly stared at the floor.
entries.literal: "I hated the way I'd become and silently apologized for putting him through even more pain. It was early in the morning, and we hadn't slept. Almost exhausted, I let my head drop and thoughtlessly stared at the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: During the previous week, I could hardly even claim to have been alive. The death of our friend had shaken me in a way I'd never expected.
entries.literal: "During the previous week, I could hardly even claim to have been alive. The death of our friend had shaken me in a way I'd never expected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After lonesome months going over the most important decisions of my life, I'd considered Atsuki's call a breath of fresh air. What was the point in going to study abroad if it wasn't what I wanted the most? When I'd been at Atsuki's house, I'd felt embarrassed for not realizing before how straightforward the decision had always been.
entries.literal: "After lonesome months going over the most important decisions of my life, I'd considered Atsuki's call a breath of fresh air. What was the point in going to study abroad if it wasn't what I wanted the most? When I'd been at Atsuki's house, I'd felt embarrassed for not realizing before how straightforward the decision had always been."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But reality had hit me way harder just the next day. I'd finally decided on something, and it was rejected.{w} Why had Miiya died? It wasn't fair. The three of us were so happy that day, so why had it been Miiya's last?
entries.literal: "But reality had hit me way harder just the next day. I'd finally decided on something, and it was rejected.{w} Why had Miiya died? It wasn't fair. The three of us were so happy that day, so why had it been Miiya's last?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, anyone could die at any point. I'd heard those words many times, but I had never really understood them.
entries.literal: "Of course, anyone could die at any point. I'd heard those words many times, but I had never really understood them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What if I'd died instead? What if Atsuki had? Why was I so selfishly sad that my future wouldn't be as I'd believed during that day? At the very least, she had been unconscious...
entries.literal: "What if I'd died instead? What if Atsuki had? Why was I so selfishly sad that my future wouldn't be as I'd believed during that day? At the very least, she had been unconscious..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My thoughts were a mess, so I'd put what little willpower I had into keeping them blank. Otherwise, I'd keep replaying the span of time in which I'd awakened next to Atsuki and heard everything.
entries.literal: "My thoughts were a mess, so I'd put what little willpower I had into keeping them blank. Otherwise, I'd keep replaying the span of time in which I'd awakened next to Atsuki and heard everything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't easy to accept that the previous two weeks had actually happened, but I already considered them the two worst of my life. I'd known Atsuki for many years, and the person next to me was just a cast-off shell of his. I'd never seen him look so depressed.
entries.literal: "It wasn't easy to accept that the previous two weeks had actually happened, but I already considered them the two worst of my life. I'd known Atsuki for many years, and the person next to me was just a cast-off shell of his. I'd never seen him look so depressed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, despite the impact everything had on me, I'd also been able to think positively. That was why we were in Ashiya Tower.
entries.literal: "However, despite the impact everything had on me, I'd also been able to think positively. That was why we were in Ashiya Tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We couldn't let Miiya's death take us down too. The three of us had spoken about missing the old days and about how hard the summer months had been. Even though it was just the two of us, Atsuki and I had wanted to come to Ashiya's event. We wanted to overcome everything together.
entries.literal: "We couldn't let Miiya's death take us down too. The three of us had spoken about missing the old days and about how hard the summer months had been. Even though it was just the two of us, Atsuki and I had wanted to come to Ashiya's event. We wanted to overcome everything together."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But that wasn't fair. She didn't deserve that either... The mere thought of imagining a cheerful future without Miiya was heartbreaking.
entries.literal: "But that wasn't fair. She didn't deserve that either... The mere thought of imagining a cheerful future without Miiya was heartbreaking."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She typically hadn't shown much emotion, but I knew she'd had a good heart. I hated that after her death, I regretted not speaking to her enough... I hated how little I'd known about her despite how often the three of us had been together.
entries.literal: "She typically hadn't shown much emotion, but I knew she'd had a good heart. I hated that after her death, I regretted not speaking to her enough... I hated how little I'd known about her despite how often the three of us had been together."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It couldn't have been fair that I regretted that only because she had died. And that, despite how broken I felt, the sadness her parents were experiencing didn't mean as much to me because I'd never talked to them.
entries.literal: "...It couldn't have been fair that I regretted that only because she had died. And that, despite how broken I felt, the sadness her parents were experiencing didn't mean as much to me because I'd never talked to them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew how shallow and unreasonable some of my thoughts were, but that wasn't enough to put an end to them. Was I just selfish? ...I kept wondering if that was all.
entries.literal: "I knew how shallow and unreasonable some of my thoughts were, but that wasn't enough to put an end to them. Was I just selfish? ...I kept wondering if that was all."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: You three are the first group, correct?
entries.literal: "You three are the first group, correct?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A woman had been talking about what we would do, and she was addressing us.
entries.literal: "A woman had been talking about what we would do, and she was addressing us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Yes." After a long wait, Atsuki answered with a plain and quiet voice.
entries.literal: "\"Yes.\" After a long wait, Atsuki answered with a plain and quiet voice."

entries.speaker: sa
entries.text: ...All right, then. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...All right, then. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Right. That day, Ashiya were showcasing a new discovery. I couldn't feel the intrigue I'd once faintly had, so after the two people at my side went through the door, I followed behind them with slow steps.
entries.literal: "Right. That day, Ashiya were showcasing a new discovery. I couldn't feel the intrigue I'd once faintly had, so after the two people at my side went through the door, I followed behind them with slow steps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the opposite side was a long corridor, vast and completely lacking in comfort. I didn't see where the others had gone, but a few of the doors were open.
entries.literal: "On the opposite side was a long corridor, vast and completely lacking in comfort. I didn't see where the others had gone, but a few of the doors were open."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Are you feeling better?
entries.literal: "Are you feeling better?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh... Yeah, I'm fine. Don't worry about it.
entries.literal: "Oh... Yeah, I'm fine. Don't worry about it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked toward one of the doors, but it didn't seem like anyone was behind it.
entries.literal: "I walked toward one of the doors, but it didn't seem like anyone was behind it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Do you regret coming?
entries.literal: "...Do you regret coming?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around, saddened to hear that question.
entries.literal: "I turned around, saddened to hear that question."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...No, of course not.{w} I'm seriously glad we're here. I mean it.
entries.literal: "...No, of course not.{w} I'm seriously glad we're here. I mean it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't regret having come at all. The part of me that could feel it was really glad Atsuki was still at my side.
entries.literal: "I didn't regret having come at all. The part of me that could feel it was really glad Atsuki was still at my side."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I know how you feel, okay? It's... the same for me. It doesn't help a lot to say it, but I don't want to see you sad.
entries.literal: "I know how you feel, okay? It's... the same for me. It doesn't help a lot to say it, but I don't want to see you sad."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm here because I want to be, Atsuki. I'm okay. This is where I need to be right now. Sorry, I must look terrible.
entries.literal: "I'm here because I want to be, Atsuki. I'm okay. This is where I need to be right now. Sorry, I must look terrible."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...You know this isn't something you need to apologize for. Nothing about this is your fault.
entries.literal: "...You know this isn't something you need to apologize for. Nothing about this is your fault."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm... not so sure. I wish I didn't have to be a drag for you now.
entries.literal: "I'm... not so sure. I wish I didn't have to be a drag for you now."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: H-Hey, come on. If you want to leave, we still can. Don't feel like you have to push yourself for my sake.
entries.literal: "H-Hey, come on. If you want to leave, we still can. Don't feel like you have to push yourself for my sake."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's all right. Thank you.{w} Let's continue, though. I was the one who wanted to come.
entries.literal: "It's all right. Thank you.{w} Let's continue, though. I was the one who wanted to come."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The woman called us from one of the rooms, and we shut ourselves inside it.
entries.literal: "The woman called us from one of the rooms, and we shut ourselves inside it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind a velvet curtain was the gemstone we would be shown. After we introduced ourselves, we were told the basics behind its discovery and rarity, leading up to the cabinet containing it being unlocked.
entries.literal: "Behind a velvet curtain was the gemstone we would be shown. After we introduced ourselves, we were told the basics behind its discovery and rarity, leading up to the cabinet containing it being unlocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But as the curtain rose, something else did. A dense and dark smoke filled my vision, and before I could realize that I should have held my breath, I fell to the floor.
entries.literal: "But as the curtain rose, something else did. A dense and dark smoke filled my vision, and before I could realize that I should have held my breath, I fell to the floor."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Atsuki... Wha...
entries.literal: "Atsuki... Wha..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart went wild, but I couldn't move any other part of my body. My mind flashed to the last time smoke had put me to sleep, and remembering what the outcome had been, I desperately tried to resist the urge to close my eyes.
entries.literal: "My heart went wild, but I couldn't move any other part of my body. My mind flashed to the last time smoke had put me to sleep, and remembering what the outcome had been, I desperately tried to resist the urge to close my eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That time, I didn't wake up in the hospital. I was in the same room as before. Immobile, I stared at the floor, my awareness gradually returning.
entries.literal: "That time, I didn't wake up in the hospital. I was in the same room as before. Immobile, I stared at the floor, my awareness gradually returning."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Are y—*cough* *cough*
entries.literal: "Are y—*cough* *cough*"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yes... I think so. *cough*
entries.literal: "Yes... I think so. *cough*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was relieved to see that both of us were okay. Akaro, the other man, was safe too, but we quickly saw that Naomi was gone.
entries.literal: "I was relieved to see that both of us were okay. Akaro, the other man, was safe too, but we quickly saw that Naomi was gone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was the beginning of a very long day. There had been an attack in the tower, and plenty of questions came with it. The first one was the origin of the smoke that had knocked us out.
entries.literal: "That was the beginning of a very long day. There had been an attack in the tower, and plenty of questions came with it. The first one was the origin of the smoke that had knocked us out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There took place the first real conversation I'd had with Atsuki in days. We were forced to discuss what we'd been caught up in.
entries.literal: "There took place the first real conversation I'd had with Atsuki in days. We were forced to discuss what we'd been caught up in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And that was what we'd most needed. We hadn't talked about anything because we didn't have the strength to say what we wanted. The situation we ended up in forced us to talk to each other again.{w} When I noticed that we were speaking normally, I was grateful that coming to the tower had given us what we'd been looking for.
entries.literal: "And that was what we'd most needed. We hadn't talked about anything because we didn't have the strength to say what we wanted. The situation we ended up in forced us to talk to each other again.{w} When I noticed that we were speaking normally, I was grateful that coming to the tower had given us what we'd been looking for."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the future that should've been waiting for us was challenged by the same thing that had made it attainable: the events that unfolded in Ashiya Tower.
entries.literal: "However, the future that should've been waiting for us was challenged by the same thing that had made it attainable: the events that unfolded in Ashiya Tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the hallway, we met Erina, Isla, Katei, and Sai. There, we learned that we would spend twelve hours in the building due to an alarm that had been recently installed.
entries.literal: "In the hallway, we met Erina, Isla, Katei, and Sai. There, we learned that we would spend twelve hours in the building due to an alarm that had been recently installed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It should've gone off whenever the Sekimeiya was stolen, but when we looked in its cabinet, that was immediately thrown into question.
entries.literal: "It should've gone off whenever the Sekimeiya was stolen, but when we looked in its cabinet, that was immediately thrown into question."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the security room, we contacted the outside, which clarified the outline of what had happened. After that, we were assaulted by question after question.
entries.literal: "From the security room, we contacted the outside, which clarified the outline of what had happened. After that, we were assaulted by question after question."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The computer turned off out of the blue, leaving us unable to look at the recorded footage. Then, we looked for Naomi, who should've been somewhere in the building.
entries.literal: "The computer turned off out of the blue, leaving us unable to look at the recorded footage. Then, we looked for Naomi, who should've been somewhere in the building."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We separated into two groups and looked through the upper floors. There, we learned about the predictions Isla's friend had made.
entries.literal: "We separated into two groups and looked through the upper floors. There, we learned about the predictions Isla's friend had made."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And that Naomi had come from the floors below, demanding to talk to Katei privately.
entries.literal: "And that Naomi had come from the floors below, demanding to talk to Katei privately."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was when Atsuki and I noticed the first signs of the underlying factor of our imprisonment. The elevator was brought up, but we couldn't find who'd boarded it.
entries.literal: "That was when Atsuki and I noticed the first signs of the underlying factor of our imprisonment. The elevator was brought up, but we couldn't find who'd boarded it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The reason... was time travel. The Sekimeiya, which we had come to see, possessed the power to send people through time. As ridiculous as it sounded, we had no choice but to accept it.
entries.literal: "The reason... was time travel. The Sekimeiya, which we had come to see, possessed the power to send people through time. As ridiculous as it sounded, we had no choice but to accept it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was it true that everything happened for a reason? Had we been given the ability to undo the past after wishing for it? If so, there were two different, bright futures on the horizon.
entries.literal: "Was it true that everything happened for a reason? Had we been given the ability to undo the past after wishing for it? If so, there were two different, bright futures on the horizon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We could leave the tower after moving past Miiya's death... or we could go to the past and save her. Just when it seemed the wound was beginning to heal, we were captivated by a slim hope.
entries.literal: "We could leave the tower after moving past Miiya's death... or we could go to the past and save her. Just when it seemed the wound was beginning to heal, we were captivated by a slim hope."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it looked like the world might have been mocking us instead. We drew the conclusion that changing the past was likely not doable.
entries.literal: "But it looked like the world might have been mocking us instead. We drew the conclusion that changing the past was likely not doable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to our two possible futures, there was something darker. It first appeared when we saw Naomi's body on the floor, devoid of life and soaked in blood.
entries.literal: "Next to our two possible futures, there was something darker. It first appeared when we saw Naomi's body on the floor, devoid of life and soaked in blood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trapped with us was a killer—a person who'd produced the same pain we'd felt before.{w} There had to be justice for Naomi, but we were unable to figure out the truth behind her death.
entries.literal: "Trapped with us was a killer—a person who'd produced the same pain we'd felt before.{w} There had to be justice for Naomi, but we were unable to figure out the truth behind her death."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something became clear very early on: when we could leave the building, everything would be much different from when we'd entered it.
entries.literal: "Something became clear very early on: when we could leave the building, everything would be much different from when we'd entered it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was one of the people who'd discovered Naomi's corpse responsible for her death? I despised that thought, but more than that, I despised whoever that person was.
entries.literal: "Was one of the people who'd discovered Naomi's corpse responsible for her death? I despised that thought, but more than that, I despised whoever that person was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We heard a sound that indicated someone else was around us, but we couldn't find anyone. It seemed that during the time we'd looked for the culprit, the elevator had moved in a strange way. Whatever they were doing kept happening right under our noses.
entries.literal: "We heard a sound that indicated someone else was around us, but we couldn't find anyone. It seemed that during the time we'd looked for the culprit, the elevator had moved in a strange way. Whatever they were doing kept happening right under our noses."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And soon, we came across the bathrooms on the lowest floor. Inside the men's was Naomi's body.{w} Not the one we'd already found, but a different one. That confirmed what we'd all already imagined: in the tower with us, while the world couldn't see it, something beyond the bounds of possibility was taking place.
entries.literal: "And soon, we came across the bathrooms on the lowest floor. Inside the men's was Naomi's body.{w} Not the one we'd already found, but a different one. That confirmed what we'd all already imagined: in the tower with us, while the world couldn't see it, something beyond the bounds of possibility was taking place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We managed to enter the attic thanks to one of the keys Naomi had. Up there, the footprints on the carpet informed us that such impossibilities extended to every place in the building.
entries.literal: "We managed to enter the attic thanks to one of the keys Naomi had. Up there, the footprints on the carpet informed us that such impossibilities extended to every place in the building."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And lastly, inside Isla's purse, we found a greater harbinger of hopelessness than anything before it.
entries.literal: "And lastly, inside Isla's purse, we found a greater harbinger of hopelessness than anything before it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would we spend more than a month in that building? As impossible as it sounded, that word didn't mean much anymore.
entries.literal: "Would we spend more than a month in that building? As impossible as it sounded, that word didn't mean much anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Attempting to solve the smaller questions, Atsuki and I walked all the way down from the attic. There, I traveled through time for the first time, but it wasn't me who touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Attempting to solve the smaller questions, Atsuki and I walked all the way down from the attic. There, I traveled through time for the first time, but it wasn't me who touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We began to learn more and more about how the time travel functioned, but the biggest blockade stood resolutely in place: the past wasn't changing.
entries.literal: "We began to learn more and more about how the time travel functioned, but the biggest blockade stood resolutely in place: the past wasn't changing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Some time later, we traveled again. We appeared in the attic, but we had to stay put in one of the bedrooms. We were very tired, so we both lay in the beds.
entries.literal: "Some time later, we traveled again. We appeared in the attic, but we had to stay put in one of the bedrooms. We were very tired, so we both lay in the beds."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite how disheartening it was, we were able to calmly talk about the Sekimeiya. I no longer believed that we had much hope of understanding it or using it to our advantage, but we could at least try.
entries.literal: "Despite how disheartening it was, we were able to calmly talk about the Sekimeiya. I no longer believed that we had much hope of understanding it or using it to our advantage, but we could at least try."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And even that faint belief was thrown back in our faces. When we woke up, we found out that the Sekimeiya had taken Isla's life—that reality was truly as ruthless as we'd feared.
entries.literal: "And even that faint belief was thrown back in our faces. When we woke up, we found out that the Sekimeiya had taken Isla's life—that reality was truly as ruthless as we'd feared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What had happened to her was shrouded in mystery, but the Sekimeiya had been the catalyst. At my side, I saw Erina's devastation and wondered if my own even came close.
entries.literal: "What had happened to her was shrouded in mystery, but the Sekimeiya had been the catalyst. At my side, I saw Erina's devastation and wondered if my own even came close."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a long wait in the lobby, I found a hidden mechanism in the storeroom. Past a movable wall, there was a door without a handle that appeared to lead outside.
entries.literal: "After a long wait in the lobby, I found a hidden mechanism in the storeroom. Past a movable wall, there was a door without a handle that appeared to lead outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But after what some of us had heard from the recorder, it wasn't possible to think that freedom was so close. Was it truly a single door away?
entries.literal: "But after what some of us had heard from the recorder, it wasn't possible to think that freedom was so close. Was it truly a single door away?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina suggested locking ourselves up in a room. That was the best and safest way to reach the time limit. We chose one of the bedrooms in the attic and decided to stay there for the remaining hours.
entries.literal: "Erina suggested locking ourselves up in a room. That was the best and safest way to reach the time limit. We chose one of the bedrooms in the attic and decided to stay there for the remaining hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, we didn't even last two hours before a wave of questions forced the lock open.
entries.literal: "However, we didn't even last two hours before a wave of questions forced the lock open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I did my best to keep my mood positive, but every time I looked around me, I hated seeing where I was. I'd spent days avoiding the sun, and it had become what I wanted to see the most. On top of that, due to how little I'd slept, my head was constantly cloudy, and my body felt physically drained.
entries.literal: "I did my best to keep my mood positive, but every time I looked around me, I hated seeing where I was. I'd spent days avoiding the sun, and it had become what I wanted to see the most. On top of that, due to how little I'd slept, my head was constantly cloudy, and my body felt physically drained."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had already accepted that the Sekimeiya wouldn't bring anything beneficial. It wouldn't let us change the past, and touching it would make us stay locked in the tower for longer. So I told Atsuki that we shouldn't do it again—the most important thing was making it out safely.
entries.literal: "We had already accepted that the Sekimeiya wouldn't bring anything beneficial. It wouldn't let us change the past, and touching it would make us stay locked in the tower for longer. So I told Atsuki that we shouldn't do it again—the most important thing was making it out safely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But all over the lowest floor was proof that the torment had continued, and when we opened the door to the security room, we saw that Katei, who'd been heavily suspected, had been killed as well.
entries.literal: "But all over the lowest floor was proof that the torment had continued, and when we opened the door to the security room, we saw that Katei, who'd been heavily suspected, had been killed as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the opposite hallway was Erina's body, collapsed on the floor. Crushed from the sight, we walked to the center of the floor, wishing to be isolated so that we wouldn't become the next targets.
entries.literal: "In the opposite hallway was Erina's body, collapsed on the floor. Crushed from the sight, we walked to the center of the floor, wishing to be isolated so that we wouldn't become the next targets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What made us leave was who Atsuki saw. According to him, he'd seen another version of me in the hallway.
entries.literal: "What made us leave was who Atsuki saw. According to him, he'd seen another version of me in the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't make sense. Who had he seen, and why? I didn't want to prolong our stay, but it seemed I had...
entries.literal: "It didn't make sense. Who had he seen, and why? I didn't want to prolong our stay, but it seemed I had..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we took the elevator all the way down from the attic, we were intercepted. On the third floor, a sudden knife threatened to cut our lives short. Were we about to die too? There was no way we'd let that happen, so we ran as fast as we could.
entries.literal: "When we took the elevator all the way down from the attic, we were intercepted. On the third floor, a sudden knife threatened to cut our lives short. Were we about to die too? There was no way we'd let that happen, so we ran as fast as we could."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through an exhausting chase, we heard the voice of our attacker. It was Sai, one of the people who'd been with us since that morning.{w} What had we done to be chased with a knife? His voice conveyed that attempting to ask that would be fatal.
entries.literal: "Through an exhausting chase, we heard the voice of our attacker. It was Sai, one of the people who'd been with us since that morning.{w} What had we done to be chased with a knife? His voice conveyed that attempting to ask that would be fatal."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, when the three of us ended up in the event room, his deadly gaze ceased.
entries.literal: "However, when the three of us ended up in the event room, his deadly gaze ceased."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The moment he left the knife on the floor, our heart rates finally began to slow down. He revealed that he had to do something that required the use of the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "The moment he left the knife on the floor, our heart rates finally began to slow down. He revealed that he had to do something that required the use of the Sekimeiya in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After we failed to find him in any of the rooms where he could've been, he managed to obtain the Sekimeiya and threatened to use it at any time. He made no effort at hiding that there was something he wanted to do upon activating it, so given what he'd done to us and that he had probably been behind some of the murders, we couldn't let him succeed.
entries.literal: "After we failed to find him in any of the rooms where he could've been, he managed to obtain the Sekimeiya and threatened to use it at any time. He made no effort at hiding that there was something he wanted to do upon activating it, so given what he'd done to us and that he had probably been behind some of the murders, we couldn't let him succeed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While he continued taunting us, the range of the Sekimeiya increased. Minutes later, when he was about to touch it, Atsuki and I ran toward him to be encompassed in his travel.
entries.literal: "While he continued taunting us, the range of the Sekimeiya increased. Minutes later, when he was about to touch it, Atsuki and I ran toward him to be encompassed in his travel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai made contact with the Sekimeiya, but he didn't disappear. Only my surroundings did.
entries.literal: "Sai made contact with the Sekimeiya, but he didn't disappear. Only my surroundings did."

entries.text: Karma
entries.literal: "Karma"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In front of me was Sai. Both of us had appeared in the right-hand bedroom of the attic.{w} When Sai's eyes met mine, he raised his eyebrows, hesitant to move.
entries.literal: "In front of me was Sai. Both of us had appeared in the right-hand bedroom of the attic.{w} When Sai's eyes met mine, he raised his eyebrows, hesitant to move."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The knife almost fell from my grip, but I still held it in my right hand. I had picked it up in the event room when Sai purposely left it behind, and it didn't disappear after traveling.
entries.literal: "The knife almost fell from my grip, but I still held it in my right hand. I had picked it up in the event room when Sai purposely left it behind, and it didn't disappear after traveling."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What was it that you wanted to do?
entries.literal: "What was it that you wanted to do?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nothing.
entries.literal: "Nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had reiterated many times that he had to go to the past to do something, but he didn't expect me to appear with him. I was in front of the door while he stared at the knife in my hand. If I didn't move, I could make sure to prevent whatever he wanted to do.
entries.literal: "He had reiterated many times that he had to go to the past to do something, but he didn't expect me to appear with him. I was in front of the door while he stared at the knife in my hand. If I didn't move, I could make sure to prevent whatever he wanted to do."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Then it's fine if we stay here, right? You only needed to travel to the past, so that shouldn't be a problem.
entries.literal: "Then it's fine if we stay here, right? You only needed to travel to the past, so that shouldn't be a problem."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you threatening me with that knife? You know these cameras are recording, don't you?
entries.literal: "Are you threatening me with that knife? You know these cameras are recording, don't you?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...We definitely only went some minutes into the past. We're going to spend them here until we get to the point we were at. Atsuki's not here, so he appeared somewhere else.
entries.literal: "...We definitely only went some minutes into the past. We're going to spend them here until we get to the point we were at. Atsuki's not here, so he appeared somewhere else."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You really are threatening me with a knife? How bizarre. I suppose we can stay here for a bit since that dumbass will probably search for us. I'm confused, though. Didn't really foresee this one.
entries.literal: "You really are threatening me with a knife? How bizarre. I suppose we can stay here for a bit since that dumbass will probably search for us. I'm confused, though. Didn't really foresee this one."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What did you expect to happen?
entries.literal: "What did you expect to happen?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You can't really think I'll tell you anything while you have that pointed at me, right?
entries.literal: "You can't really think I'll tell you anything while you have that pointed at me, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the knife. Was I really threatening him...? He had chased us with it, and while it was fair, the thought of threatening someone with their own death was sickening.
entries.literal: "I looked at the knife. Was I really threatening him...? He had chased us with it, and while it was fair, the thought of threatening someone with their own death was sickening."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'm confused. Why did we appear here? How is it possible that I appeared with the knife in the attic when I only had it in the event room?
entries.literal: "...I'm confused. Why did we appear here? How is it possible that I appeared with the knife in the attic when I only had it in the event room?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I recall telling you and Atsuki that you were wrong about what you said. You mean that you've never been in this bedroom with the knife, right?
entries.literal: "I recall telling you and Atsuki that you were wrong about what you said. You mean that you've never been in this bedroom with the knife, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Maybe I was right and you were wrong, then.
entries.literal: "Maybe I was right and you were wrong, then."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wait, what time is it?
entries.literal: "Wait, what time is it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked at his wristwatch and sighed.
entries.literal: "He looked at his wristwatch and sighed."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's no current time.
entries.literal: "There's no current time."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He showed me the tiny display from afar. It was blank.
entries.literal: "He showed me the tiny display from afar. It was blank."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It stopped working? That's what Katei said happened earlier, right?
entries.literal: "It stopped working? That's what Katei said happened earlier, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes. It seems it wasn't the battery's problem, but the watch's. Even if it was working, it's unlikely it would display the real time anyway.
entries.literal: "Yes. It seems it wasn't the battery's problem, but the watch's. Even if it was working, it's unlikely it would display the real time anyway."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Take a few steps back.
entries.literal: "Take a few steps back."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why?
entries.literal: "Why?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Just do it.
entries.literal: "...Just do it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He backed farther into the room without turning around. He could've run at me at any point, so I wanted to feel a little more secure.
entries.literal: "He backed farther into the room without turning around. He could've run at me at any point, so I wanted to feel a little more secure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the drawer stand and opened the highest one while making sure Sai couldn't dash to the door.
entries.literal: "I walked to the drawer stand and opened the highest one while making sure Sai couldn't dash to the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Inside was the key to the bedroom. When we'd been running from Sai, we'd considered that he grabbed it to prevent us from locking ourselves inside, but it was still there.
entries.literal: "...Inside was the key to the bedroom. When we'd been running from Sai, we'd considered that he grabbed it to prevent us from locking ourselves inside, but it was still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He saw me taking it out and frowned. Then, he began to slowly approach me.
entries.literal: "He saw me taking it out and frowned. Then, he began to slowly approach me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Stop.
entries.literal: "Stop."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You wouldn't be thinking about locking me in here, right? That would be very mean.
entries.literal: "You wouldn't be thinking about locking me in here, right? That would be very mean."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That wasn't my intention. By attempting to trap him from outside, I would've given him a chance to push the door open and overpower me. That was why I wanted to lock the door from the inside, so that he couldn't simply rush to it and leave at any moment.
entries.literal: "That wasn't my intention. By attempting to trap him from outside, I would've given him a chance to push the door open and overpower me. That was why I wanted to lock the door from the inside, so that he couldn't simply rush to it and leave at any moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I inserted the key into the inner keyhole and turned it.
entries.literal: "I inserted the key into the inner keyhole and turned it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...You locked both of us in? Very courageous.
entries.literal: "...You locked both of us in? Very courageous."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dropped the key in my purse and zipped it. If Sai had been thinking about forcing his way out, that would make him less likely to attempt it.
entries.literal: "I dropped the key in my purse and zipped it. If Sai had been thinking about forcing his way out, that would make him less likely to attempt it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued standing in front of the door, a little calmer than before.
entries.literal: "I continued standing in front of the door, a little calmer than before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For a while, Sai looked pensive and maybe even uncertain. Trying to decipher his thoughts had rarely proven useful.
entries.literal: "For a while, Sai looked pensive and maybe even uncertain. Trying to decipher his thoughts had rarely proven useful."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Are you going to tell me why you wanted to go to the past?
entries.literal: "Are you going to tell me why you wanted to go to the past?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nope.
entries.literal: "Nope."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Then are you fine staying here?
entries.literal: "Then are you fine staying here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I suppose. This is all a little annoying.
entries.literal: "...I suppose. This is all a little annoying."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What are you thinking about? You seem pretty preoccupied.
entries.literal: "...What are you thinking about? You seem pretty preoccupied."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You want me to be honest? I'm thinking about whether I should kill you.
entries.literal: "You want me to be honest? I'm thinking about whether I should kill you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That sent a chill through my body. He really had tried to kill Atsuki, and he was willing to kill me.{w} What we wanted was to leave the building safely, and by keeping Sai locked away, I'd intended to prevent more things from happening. ...I began to worry about my decision.
entries.literal: "That sent a chill through my body. He really had tried to kill Atsuki, and he was willing to kill me.{w} What we wanted was to leave the building safely, and by keeping Sai locked away, I'd intended to prevent more things from happening. ...I began to worry about my decision."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why do you look scared? You're the one with a knife.
entries.literal: "Why do you look scared? You're the one with a knife."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I suppose that was a little misleading. I'm not trying to kill you. As I said, I'm debating whether I should.
entries.literal: "I suppose that was a little misleading. I'm not trying to kill you. As I said, I'm debating whether I should."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You remember what I said, right? You will die—that's a guarantee. Because I pretty much know it for a fact, I'm wondering whether I should make it happen myself.{w} Since I have confirmation of your death, it's very likely that if I try to push you into a wall, I'll kill you. I have no reason to think I'll end up safe, though. That knife you have is pretty scary, and I wouldn't want to be recorded.
entries.literal: "You remember what I said, right? You will die—that's a guarantee. Because I pretty much know it for a fact, I'm wondering whether I should make it happen myself.{w} Since I have confirmation of your death, it's very likely that if I try to push you into a wall, I'll kill you. I have no reason to think I'll end up safe, though. That knife you have is pretty scary, and I wouldn't want to be recorded."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Y-You're still saying that I'm going to die? Why...?
entries.literal: "...Y-You're still saying that I'm going to die? Why...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Because I've seen it. Are you really unaware that the blood in the lobby is yours?
entries.literal: "Because I've seen it. Are you really unaware that the blood in the lobby is yours?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's not...! That wasn't my blood.
entries.literal: "It's not...! That wasn't my blood."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then we go back to what I already said. I know what I'm saying for certain, but the details of it are a mystery to me.{w} I do feel bad for you. You were in a coma for a while, right? If I remember correctly, the name that was put out was yours. It's unfortunate that you'll die here after surviving that.
entries.literal: "Then we go back to what I already said. I know what I'm saying for certain, but the details of it are a mystery to me.{w} I do feel bad for you. You were in a coma for a while, right? If I remember correctly, the name that was put out was yours. It's unfortunate that you'll die here after surviving that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I raised the knife to protect myself. The likelihood that he was telling the truth kept growing as he talked. Did that really mean that I was close to dying? Would it just be him who would do it? ...Or was he making it up to scare me?
entries.literal: "I raised the knife to protect myself. The likelihood that he was telling the truth kept growing as he talked. Did that really mean that I was close to dying? Would it just be him who would do it? ...Or was he making it up to scare me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd seen Atsuki's face when he'd been told about that supposed fate of mine. The way he'd looked, and nothing more, was enough motivation to fight for my life.
entries.literal: "I'd seen Atsuki's face when he'd been told about that supposed fate of mine. The way he'd looked, and nothing more, was enough motivation to fight for my life."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm trying to sympathize with you, but it's not easy when you're pointing that knife at me.
entries.literal: "I'm trying to sympathize with you, but it's not easy when you're pointing that knife at me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Where did you even find this?
entries.literal: "...Where did you even find this?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Haven't I told you already? If you want to keep asking questions, don't repeat them.
entries.literal: "Haven't I told you already? If you want to keep asking questions, don't repeat them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His prediction that I would die had allowed him to assert control again, which was probably intentional. I tried to erase the worry from my face.
entries.literal: "His prediction that I would die had allowed him to assert control again, which was probably intentional. I tried to erase the worry from my face."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I didn't say anything else, he went back to thinking. With a few steps of separation, we both stood, silently on alert.
entries.literal: "When I didn't say anything else, he went back to thinking. With a few steps of separation, we both stood, silently on alert."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Minutes later, nothing else had happened, but I'd realized one thing.
entries.literal: "Minutes later, nothing else had happened, but I'd realized one thing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had gone some minutes to the past. Given that we hadn't heard anything around us, it was very likely we'd arrived at a time after Atsuki and I left the attic due to being chased.
entries.literal: "We had gone some minutes to the past. Given that we hadn't heard anything around us, it was very likely we'd arrived at a time after Atsuki and I left the attic due to being chased."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That meant that the entrance to the attic was locked, so if Atsuki hadn't also appeared inside, he had no way to reach us. I had no reason to think he would have appeared with the key.
entries.literal: "That meant that the entrance to the attic was locked, so if Atsuki hadn't also appeared inside, he had no way to reach us. I had no reason to think he would have appeared with the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked inside my purse and saw that the key to the attic was still inside. Just like the knife, it had appeared with me in the bedroom despite there being no possible location to be replicated that met those conditions...
entries.literal: "I looked inside my purse and saw that the key to the attic was still inside. Just like the knife, it had appeared with me in the bedroom despite there being no possible location to be replicated that met those conditions..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey, Shiroya, how much time do you think we traveled? It's not like we went an hour back, right? Twenty or thirty minutes, I'd say.
entries.literal: "Hey, Shiroya, how much time do you think we traveled? It's not like we went an hour back, right? Twenty or thirty minutes, I'd say."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had taken a few steps closer without alerting me.
entries.literal: "He had taken a few steps closer without alerting me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I-I don't know.
entries.literal: "I-I don't know."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, don't you think we've passed that threshold already? Shouldn't we get going?
entries.literal: "Well, don't you think we've passed that threshold already? Shouldn't we get going?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He wants to leave. Does that mean that he can still do what he wanted? It's not possible we went much farther back, is it...?
entries.literal: "He wants to leave. Does that mean that he can still do what he wanted? It's not possible we went much farther back, is it...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not going to say anything?
entries.literal: "Not going to say anything?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought a bit more.
entries.literal: "I thought a bit more."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I shouldn't believe anything that he says just because he sounds convincing. He's sounded convincing before at times when I knew for a fact he was lying.
entries.literal: "I shouldn't believe anything that he says just because he sounds convincing. He's sounded convincing before at times when I knew for a fact he was lying."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He knows more about how the Sekimeiya works but is refusing to say anything, so he has a reason to keep that to himself.
entries.literal: "He knows more about how the Sekimeiya works but is refusing to say anything, so he has a reason to keep that to himself."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He definitely has something in mind, and maybe if he reveals it, whatever he's planning won't work. ...But I can make sure that it won't work as long as we stay here.
entries.literal: "He definitely has something in mind, and maybe if he reveals it, whatever he's planning won't work. ...But I can make sure that it won't work as long as we stay here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The problem is Atsuki. If he could enter the attic, I could tell him what's happening without unlocking the door.
entries.literal: "The problem is Atsuki. If he could enter the attic, I could tell him what's happening without unlocking the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If he didn't travel, around now is when he should start to search for us.
entries.literal: "If he didn't travel, around now is when he should start to search for us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't decide. It was very possible that the force behind most of what had happened throughout the day was Sai. There wasn't a lot of time left until {time=21}, and if I could seclude him during that last stretch, we had the chance to leave safely.
entries.literal: "I couldn't decide. It was very possible that the force behind most of what had happened throughout the day was Sai. There wasn't a lot of time left until {time=21}, and if I could seclude him during that last stretch, we had the chance to leave safely."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Naomi, Isla, Katei, and Erina have died. The people behind that had to be either Sai or Akaro.
entries.literal: "Naomi, Isla, Katei, and Erina have died. The people behind that had to be either Sai or Akaro."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And the recorder, which has contents that are practically impossible, could've been arranged with Sai, Akaro, and Isla. Not only that, but Sai had a knife, and he already proved to be a deadly threat to Atsuki and probably me. If we just stay here, he won't be able to harm him or use the Sekimeiya again.
entries.literal: "And the recorder, which has contents that are practically impossible, could've been arranged with Sai, Akaro, and Isla. Not only that, but Sai had a knife, and he already proved to be a deadly threat to Atsuki and probably me. If we just stay here, he won't be able to harm him or use the Sekimeiya again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Of course, the recording itself was fabricated using the Sekimeiya. Sai knows the most about it, so he's the perfect person to be responsible for it. ...Why would he create that? Why would Isla have it?
entries.literal: "Of course, the recording itself was fabricated using the Sekimeiya. Sai knows the most about it, so he's the perfect person to be responsible for it. ...Why would he create that? Why would Isla have it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If he's been lying recently... Why would he say that I'll die or that the blood in the lobby is mine? That's impossible. That blood can't be mine, so why would he say it?{w} It matches with the recording because I wasn't mentioned once in it. Could it be that he's consistently trying follow a story that he's set up?
entries.literal: "If he's been lying recently... Why would he say that I'll die or that the blood in the lobby is mine? That's impossible. That blood can't be mine, so why would he say it?{w} It matches with the recording because I wasn't mentioned once in it. Could it be that he's consistently trying follow a story that he's set up?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And either way, I can't die as long as we stay here and I protect myself. Does that mean that if I decide to leave, Sai's claims become the truth?
entries.literal: "And either way, I can't die as long as we stay here and I protect myself. Does that mean that if I decide to leave, Sai's claims become the truth?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can't decide. ...Because if Sai isn't the culprit, then it's Akaro, who could be anywhere, and then Atsuki would be up against him alone.{w} Both Akaro and Sai have acted suspicious in their own ways, and Sai sounded hostile toward him earlier. ...But that could easily be a trick since they escaped the bedroom together.
entries.literal: "I can't decide. ...Because if Sai isn't the culprit, then it's Akaro, who could be anywhere, and then Atsuki would be up against him alone.{w} Both Akaro and Sai have acted suspicious in their own ways, and Sai sounded hostile toward him earlier. ...But that could easily be a trick since they escaped the bedroom together."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On the other hand, if Akaro's the one we need to worry about, it's hard to imagine we'll be able to do anything to stop him even after leaving the bedroom.
entries.literal: "On the other hand, if Akaro's the one we need to worry about, it's hard to imagine we'll be able to do anything to stop him even after leaving the bedroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...So keeping Sai shut in here is the safest move. The only real problem is that I can't tell Atsuki what's happening unless he gets into the attic.
entries.literal: "...So keeping Sai shut in here is the safest move. The only real problem is that I can't tell Atsuki what's happening unless he gets into the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Hello?
entries.literal: "...Hello?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}I won't move.
entries.literal: "...{w}I won't move."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What? ...Why? That's not what you said earlier.
entries.literal: "What? ...Why? That's not what you said earlier."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You tried to kill Atsuki and threatened me. There's no way I'll just let you go.
entries.literal: "You tried to kill Atsuki and threatened me. There's no way I'll just let you go."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey, aren't you the one currently threatening me?
entries.literal: "Hey, aren't you the one currently threatening me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure you can do this? Will you kill me if I try to unlock the door and leave? Remember that you're being recorded.
entries.literal: "Are you sure you can do this? Will you kill me if I try to unlock the door and leave? Remember that you're being recorded."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You shouldn't try it.{w} Also, I don't think the cameras are recording.
entries.literal: "You shouldn't try it.{w} Also, I don't think the cameras are recording."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I shouldn't? There's a time travel device downstairs, so I'm having trouble understanding why I shouldn't try to resist abandoning it.
entries.literal: "I shouldn't? There's a time travel device downstairs, so I'm having trouble understanding why I shouldn't try to resist abandoning it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Is that what you want? The Sekimeiya for yourself?
entries.literal: "Is that what you want? The Sekimeiya for yourself?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It would be pretty stupid to deny that. I'm sure you wouldn't turn it away either.
entries.literal: "It would be pretty stupid to deny that. I'm sure you wouldn't turn it away either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to humor him anymore.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to humor him anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He didn't say anything else, so the quiet returned.
entries.literal: "He didn't say anything else, so the quiet returned."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that it? Have we decided that we'll spend the rest of our time in here? It should only be a bit more than two hours unless we went really far back, which wouldn't make sense.
entries.literal: "Is that it? Have we decided that we'll spend the rest of our time in here? It should only be a bit more than two hours unless we went really far back, which wouldn't make sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd spent a large amount of time standing up, so I sat on the bed. I took the strap of my purse from around my neck so that Sai wouldn't knock me down if he pulled on it and left it at my side.
entries.literal: "I'd spent a large amount of time standing up, so I sat on the bed. I took the strap of my purse from around my neck so that Sai wouldn't knock me down if he pulled on it and left it at my side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He paid no mind to it and kept looking at the floor.
entries.literal: "He paid no mind to it and kept looking at the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still felt severely conflicted and worried about Atsuki's situation. Although the more I thought, the more I felt I couldn't let Sai free, and it was highly unlikely I could successfully lock him in from outside.
entries.literal: "I still felt severely conflicted and worried about Atsuki's situation. Although the more I thought, the more I felt I couldn't let Sai free, and it was highly unlikely I could successfully lock him in from outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Time kept moving in the silent attic. We must have been alone, as the lack of sound was overwhelming.
entries.literal: "Time kept moving in the silent attic. We must have been alone, as the lack of sound was overwhelming."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, Sai stood up without opening his mouth. That was the first noise I'd heard in minutes, and I stared at him curiously.
entries.literal: "Eventually, Sai stood up without opening his mouth. That was the first noise I'd heard in minutes, and I stared at him curiously."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He slowly stepped to the door with his empty hands raised.
entries.literal: "He slowly stepped to the door with his empty hands raised."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What are you doing...?
entries.literal: "What are you doing...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw him gripping the handle, and my heart sped up with uncertainty. However, when he tried to open the door, the lock prevented it.
entries.literal: "I saw him gripping the handle, and my heart sped up with uncertainty. However, when he tried to open the door, the lock prevented it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Oh, it's locked. Right.
entries.literal: "...Oh, it's locked. Right."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: By the way, you never reattached the chain, right?
entries.literal: "By the way, you never reattached the chain, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: The chain? What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "The chain? What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nothing.
entries.literal: "Nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He shook his head and retreaded his steps.
entries.literal: "He shook his head and retreaded his steps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw his nonchalant look while I was still frowning.
entries.literal: "I saw his nonchalant look while I was still frowning."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Did you just try to leave?
entries.literal: "Did you just try to leave?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Absolutely not.
entries.literal: "Absolutely not."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}Is this how you and Akaro escaped the bedroom the last time? That was what Atsuki suspected.
entries.literal: "...{w}Is this how you and Akaro escaped the bedroom the last time? That was what Atsuki suspected."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: By trying to open a locked door?
entries.literal: "By trying to open a locked door?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: By opening it and then going back in time to unlock it. Did you wait until now to try it because it was unlikely it would've worked earlier?
entries.literal: "By opening it and then going back in time to unlock it. Did you wait until now to try it because it was unlikely it would've worked earlier?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're incorrect.
entries.literal: "You're incorrect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He approached the drawer stand and took the screwdriver out of it.
entries.literal: "He approached the drawer stand and took the screwdriver out of it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What's that for?
entries.literal: "...What's that for?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't worry, I don't want to use it as a weapon. Who reattached the handles?
entries.literal: "Don't worry, I don't want to use it as a weapon. Who reattached the handles?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...It was me and Atsuki, after everyone left.
entries.literal: "...It was me and Atsuki, after everyone left."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You didn't do it right, then. From here, I noticed it was a little loose, and I just turned it to see if I was right. You didn't attach it properly.
entries.literal: "You didn't do it right, then. From here, I noticed it was a little loose, and I just turned it to see if I was right. You didn't attach it properly."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the handle and didn't see anything wrong with it.
entries.literal: "I looked at the handle and didn't see anything wrong with it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Holding the screwdriver, Sai stepped to the door again. I moved back a little, afraid of the sharply pointed tool.
entries.literal: "Holding the screwdriver, Sai stepped to the door again. I moved back a little, afraid of the sharply pointed tool."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He inserted it into one of the screws and removed it. Then, he unscrewed the one in the opposite corner while I stared, dumbfounded. I didn't know what he was doing, but messing with the handle wouldn't let him open the door.
entries.literal: "He inserted it into one of the screws and removed it. Then, he unscrewed the one in the opposite corner while I stared, dumbfounded. I didn't know what he was doing, but messing with the handle wouldn't let him open the door."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: See? These two go in the bottom. You swapped them.
entries.literal: "See? These two go in the bottom. You swapped them."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What are you talking about? They're the same.
entries.literal: "...What are you talking about? They're the same."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He ignored me and unscrewed the last two, which dropped the handle to the floor.
entries.literal: "He ignored me and unscrewed the last two, which dropped the handle to the floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No, they aren't. You don't understand much about screws, do you?
entries.literal: "No, they aren't. You don't understand much about screws, do you?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up.
entries.literal: "I stood up."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Move away. I don't know what you're trying to do, but stop.
entries.literal: "Move away. I don't know what you're trying to do, but stop."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I'm not trying to do anything, though. Do you not want me to attach it properly?
entries.literal: "...I'm not trying to do anything, though. Do you not want me to attach it properly?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: No. Step back.
entries.literal: "No. Step back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He sighed and backed off.
entries.literal: "He sighed and backed off."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I guess I locked myself in even further.
entries.literal: "...I guess I locked myself in even further."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He left the screwdriver in the drawer and looked at his feet, biting his lower lip.
entries.literal: "He left the screwdriver in the drawer and looked at his feet, biting his lower lip."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I sat back on the bed.
entries.literal: "...I sat back on the bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon after, out of nowhere, he sat on the other side of it.
entries.literal: "Soon after, out of nowhere, he sat on the other side of it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Don't sit here.
entries.literal: "Don't sit here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What? That's just rude. I'm tired.
entries.literal: "What? That's just rude. I'm tired."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Stand up.
entries.literal: "Stand up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh* Fine.
entries.literal: "*sigh* Fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But instead of standing up, with a very quick motion, he extended his arm toward me. Startled, I looked down and saw he'd unzipped my purse.
entries.literal: "But instead of standing up, with a very quick motion, he extended his arm toward me. Startled, I looked down and saw he'd unzipped my purse."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh—!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up fast enough, tightly gripping my purse and the knife.
entries.literal: "I stood up fast enough, tightly gripping my purse and the knife."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, damn it.
entries.literal: "Well, damn it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart quickly calmed down as I stared at his childish expression.
entries.literal: "My heart quickly calmed down as I stared at his childish expression."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What the fuck are you doing...!?
entries.literal: "What the fuck are you doing...!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It was just a joke. I couldn't have left anyway since you have that knife with you.
entries.literal: "It was just a joke. I couldn't have left anyway since you have that knife with you."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}You remember what you asked earlier, right? Yes, if you get close to me again, I will use the knife. Don't move again.
entries.literal: "...{w}You remember what you asked earlier, right? Yes, if you get close to me again, I will use the knife. Don't move again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right. You can't even take a simple joke.
entries.literal: "All right. You can't even take a simple joke."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He let his body fall and lay on the bed, yawning while face-down.
entries.literal: "He let his body fall and lay on the bed, yawning while face-down."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Stand up.
entries.literal: "...Stand up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't think so. Sorry, I just wanted the bed for myself. You told me not to get close to you, so I won't. I'm tired—I said so earlier.
entries.literal: "I don't think so. Sorry, I just wanted the bed for myself. You told me not to get close to you, so I won't. I'm tired—I said so earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't care anymore. I approached the desk and sat on it, resting my back on my purse and protecting it against the wall.
entries.literal: "I didn't care anymore. I approached the desk and sat on it, resting my back on my purse and protecting it against the wall."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There you go. That's much better.
entries.literal: "There you go. That's much better."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He repositioned his face on the pillow and closed his eyes.{w} ...A couple of minutes later, he hadn't moved at all.
entries.literal: "He repositioned his face on the pillow and closed his eyes.{w} ...A couple of minutes later, he hadn't moved at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd buried my face in my knees. What was happening outside the attic? A piercing pain had arisen in my chest, and there was no getting rid of it.
entries.literal: "I'd buried my face in my knees. What was happening outside the attic? A piercing pain had arisen in my chest, and there was no getting rid of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I began to heavily regret my decision when I considered the possibility that I wouldn't see Atsuki again. ...What if he had already been attacked?
entries.literal: "I began to heavily regret my decision when I considered the possibility that I wouldn't see Atsuki again. ...What if he had already been attacked?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I raised my eyes and saw Sai still lying down.
entries.literal: "I raised my eyes and saw Sai still lying down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no way he won't hear me if I try to leave, right...?
entries.literal: "There's no way he won't hear me if I try to leave, right...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I jumped back a little when he moved. After a long yawn, he sat up and stretched his arms.
entries.literal: "I jumped back a little when he moved. After a long yawn, he sat up and stretched his arms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He saw me staring at him but didn't react. Instead, he crouched to grab the handle from the floor, stood up, and turned around.
entries.literal: "He saw me staring at him but didn't react. Instead, he crouched to grab the handle from the floor, stood up, and turned around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard a sound, but I didn't believe it. Regardless, the door opened, and Sai removed the key he'd inserted into the keyhole.
entries.literal: "I heard a sound, but I didn't believe it. Regardless, the door opened, and Sai removed the key he'd inserted into the keyhole."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't run to the door because I knew I was doomed. The handle was detached, so as soon as I stood up, Sai would close the door, locking me in behind him. Frozen, all I could do was ask what had happened.
entries.literal: "I didn't run to the door because I knew I was doomed. The handle was detached, so as soon as I stood up, Sai would close the door, locking me in behind him. Frozen, all I could do was ask what had happened."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You really didn't see that I took the key from your purse? You thought I'd only unzipped it? I have it right here.
entries.literal: "You really didn't see that I took the key from your purse? You thought I'd only unzipped it? I have it right here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe it, but he had the key in his left hand. While I processed what he'd said, his smile widened.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it, but he had the key in his left hand. While I processed what he'd said, his smile widened."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: W-Wait... Is this why you removed the handle?
entries.literal: "W-Wait... Is this why you removed the handle?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course. Otherwise, it's unlikely I could've repaid the favor and locked you in. I figured it was only fair. I can't believe you didn't realize I wanted the bed for myself just to be closer to the door than you. You're not very smart, are you?
