entries.literal: "Of course. Otherwise, it's unlikely I could've repaid the favor and locked you in. I figured it was only fair. I can't believe you didn't realize I wanted the bed for myself just to be closer to the door than you. You're not very smart, are you?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Sai, what are you—
entries.literal: "Sai, what are you—"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Now, goodbye. I have things to do.
entries.literal: "Now, goodbye. I have things to do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the hallway, I heard Sai locking the door. That didn't matter, because even if he left it unlocked, I had no way to leave.
entries.literal: "From the hallway, I heard Sai locking the door. That didn't matter, because even if he left it unlocked, I had no way to leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still trying to wrap my head around what had happened, I stood up slowly and approached the door.
entries.literal: "Still trying to wrap my head around what had happened, I stood up slowly and approached the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't open it. It was exactly the same way all of us had previously locked ourselves in that very bedroom. Sai had left with the handle and the key, so I knew I had no way to get out.
entries.literal: "I couldn't open it. It was exactly the same way all of us had previously locked ourselves in that very bedroom. Sai had left with the handle and the key, so I knew I had no way to get out."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No... Now Atsuki's definitely in danger.
entries.literal: "No... Now Atsuki's definitely in danger."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Sai...! Come back! Just for a second...!
entries.literal: "Sai...! Come back! Just for a second...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no response. The attic felt just as desolate as when Sai had been there.{w} I noticed that I still had the knife in my hand. I slid it through the gap of the door, trying to push open the latch.
entries.literal: "There was no response. The attic felt just as desolate as when Sai had been there.{w} I noticed that I still had the knife in my hand. I slid it through the gap of the door, trying to push open the latch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frantically moved my arm up and down, but it simply got stuck in the middle.
entries.literal: "I frantically moved my arm up and down, but it simply got stuck in the middle."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Sai...!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew he wouldn't come back. Trying to calm my nerves, I sat on the bed.
entries.literal: "I knew he wouldn't come back. Trying to calm my nerves, I sat on the bed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm sure he used the elevator because he shouldn't be able to leave through the main door. That means the attic is still locked. Not even he should be able to enter again once he leaves.
entries.literal: "I'm sure he used the elevator because he shouldn't be able to leave through the main door. That means the attic is still locked. Not even he should be able to enter again once he leaves."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Or maybe that's not right. ...When Atsuki and I locked ourselves in the attic, Sai was able to come in anyway.
entries.literal: "Or maybe that's not right. ...When Atsuki and I locked ourselves in the attic, Sai was able to come in anyway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is there nothing I can do...? I can't take this door down.
entries.literal: "Is there nothing I can do...? I can't take this door down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to go over ways to leave, but I couldn't think of anything. All at once, the overwhelming stress came back.
entries.literal: "I tried to go over ways to leave, but I couldn't think of anything. All at once, the overwhelming stress came back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My hand began to hurt, so I stopped pounding on the door. There was no way for me to reach anyone or for anyone to reach me. Inside a locked building, on a locked floor, I was trapped in that locked room.
entries.literal: "My hand began to hurt, so I stopped pounding on the door. There was no way for me to reach anyone or for anyone to reach me. Inside a locked building, on a locked floor, I was trapped in that locked room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized I hadn't gone to the higher level of the bedroom. I climbed up the ladder, but I couldn't find anything. The only traces of life were the messy sheets from the time we'd been waiting there.
entries.literal: "I realized I hadn't gone to the higher level of the bedroom. I climbed up the ladder, but I couldn't find anything. The only traces of life were the messy sheets from the time we'd been waiting there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would I have to spend two hours there? I could only feel the piercing pain strengthening, threatening to eventually leave me breathless.
entries.literal: "Would I have to spend two hours there? I could only feel the piercing pain strengthening, threatening to eventually leave me breathless."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I have the only key to the attic Katei mentioned. ...There's no way the police won't have another one, right...?
entries.literal: "I have the only key to the attic Katei mentioned. ...There's no way the police won't have another one, right...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...At least I have the knife, so Sai won't be able to use it, and he said he didn't want to harm Atsuki anymore.
entries.literal: "...At least I have the knife, so Sai won't be able to use it, and he said he didn't want to harm Atsuki anymore."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why did we have to come here...? We should've just stayed home...
entries.literal: "Why did we have to come here...? We should've just stayed home..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hated it, but I couldn't avoid thinking about the worst possibilities. The thought of losing my two friends in as many weeks was unbearable.
entries.literal: "I hated it, but I couldn't avoid thinking about the worst possibilities. The thought of losing my two friends in as many weeks was unbearable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every time I managed to calm my thoughts, they returned, more and more terrifying. It was impossible for me to fall asleep, and the pain in my chest increased if I tried to lie down.
entries.literal: "Every time I managed to calm my thoughts, they returned, more and more terrifying. It was impossible for me to fall asleep, and the pain in my chest increased if I tried to lie down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spent the time thinking miserably in front of the door, the persistent fear that I might've let the killer run free with Atsuki unprotected eating away at me.
entries.literal: "I spent the time thinking miserably in front of the door, the persistent fear that I might've let the killer run free with Atsuki unprotected eating away at me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even after what I'd already experienced, the way I felt then was far beyond anything I'd ever known. If I could describe Miiya's death as an earthquake, I was experiencing one an order of magnitude higher.
entries.literal: "Even after what I'd already experienced, the way I felt then was far beyond anything I'd ever known. If I could describe Miiya's death as an earthquake, I was experiencing one an order of magnitude higher."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It hadn't been easy to accept her death, and I, of course, still hadn't moved past it. But it was incomparable. Knowing for a fact that a friend had died was far less of a strain than fearing that a friend could be about to die.
entries.literal: "It hadn't been easy to accept her death, and I, of course, still hadn't moved past it. But it was incomparable. Knowing for a fact that a friend had died was far less of a strain than fearing that a friend could be about to die."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Both were horrific, but only one of them involved fear, and Atsuki being in danger potentially due to my own failure only made it worse. I imagined that if any kind of hell existed, the way I felt while alone in that room must have come close.
entries.literal: "Both were horrific, but only one of them involved fear, and Atsuki being in danger potentially due to my own failure only made it worse. I imagined that if any kind of hell existed, the way I felt while alone in that room must have come close."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...o that? ...uki?
entries.literal: "...o that? ...uki?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked back abruptly the moment a voice reached my ears. More than ten minutes had passed when I perceived that sound coming from directly behind the door.
entries.literal: "I looked back abruptly the moment a voice reached my ears. More than ten minutes had passed when I perceived that sound coming from directly behind the door."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Hey! Are you there!?
entries.literal: "Hey! Are you there!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was that Sai...? Nobody else could've entered the attic.
entries.literal: "Was that Sai...? Nobody else could've entered the attic."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Open the door! Who are you!?
entries.literal: "Open the door! Who are you!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no response.
entries.literal: "There was no response."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I didn't imagine it, right?
entries.literal: "I didn't imagine it, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't—there was another sound. The other bedroom opened.
entries.literal: "I hadn't—there was another sound. The other bedroom opened."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I just heard you! Please, open the door!
entries.literal: "I just heard you! Please, open the door!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, there was no response.
entries.literal: "Once again, there was no response."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is Sai ignoring me? Either that, or someone traveled to the attic.
entries.literal: "Is Sai ignoring me? Either that, or someone traveled to the attic."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...You're still here, right? What are you planning?
entries.literal: "...You're still here, right? What are you planning?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I breathed hoarsely before letting out more exhausted yells.
entries.literal: "I breathed hoarsely before letting out more exhausted yells."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I know you're here! At least answer!
entries.literal: "I know you're here! At least answer!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He just walked away...!
entries.literal: "He just walked away...!"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Please! At least say something!
entries.literal: "Please! At least say something!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Rather than exert myself any further, I simply focused my hearing. It made no difference.
entries.literal: "Rather than exert myself any further, I simply focused my hearing. It made no difference."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What are you doing!? Please, come back!
entries.literal: "What are you doing!? Please, come back!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing.
entries.literal: "Nothing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What is he doing...?
entries.literal: "What is he doing...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Hey...!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All I could hear were my desperate breaths.
entries.literal: "All I could hear were my desperate breaths."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did he only now leave the attic, then?
entries.literal: "Did he only now leave the attic, then?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I defeatedly fell on the bed.
entries.literal: "I defeatedly fell on the bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, my vision began to fade. I'd drained some of the scarce energy I had.
entries.literal: "Soon, my vision began to fade. I'd drained some of the scarce energy I had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thankfully, the inside of my head had gone numb, so I could finally stop thinking. The lancing pain in my chest intensified, but I was able to withstand it.
entries.literal: "Thankfully, the inside of my head had gone numb, so I could finally stop thinking. The lancing pain in my chest intensified, but I was able to withstand it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Minutes were passing by, but it didn't feel like it. I didn't close my eyes or try to relax. The only thing I could feel was despair.
entries.literal: "Minutes were passing by, but it didn't feel like it. I didn't close my eyes or try to relax. The only thing I could feel was despair."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Uh... What the fuck?
entries.literal: "Uh... What the fuck?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wh—
entries.literal: "Wh—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A new voice. That time, it came from the room I was in, and I recognized it.
entries.literal: "A new voice. That time, it came from the room I was in, and I recognized it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lifted my head without thinking and saw Sai standing in the middle of the bedroom. As soon as he saw me, he dashed toward the door, but I rapidly stood up as I grabbed the knife next to me.
entries.literal: "I lifted my head without thinking and saw Sai standing in the middle of the bedroom. As soon as he saw me, he dashed toward the door, but I rapidly stood up as I grabbed the knife next to me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: H-Hey, chill with that.
entries.literal: "H-Hey, chill with that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He stepped back while I tried to understand what was happening.
entries.literal: "He stepped back while I tried to understand what was happening."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did I really travel to this goddamn bedroom? That's just unfortunate.{w} What's with that look? You're still here? How long has it been? ...I guess I just trapped myself.
entries.literal: "Did I really travel to this goddamn bedroom? That's just unfortunate.{w} What's with that look? You're still here? How long has it been? ...I guess I just trapped myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I cleared my throat, feeling unable to speak.
entries.literal: "I cleared my throat, feeling unable to speak."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...D-Did you just travel from the future?
entries.literal: "...D-Did you just travel from the future?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, maybe. How long have you been here?
entries.literal: "Yeah, maybe. How long have you been here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at his wristwatch, but the display was still blank.
entries.literal: "I looked at his wristwatch, but the display was still blank."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Do you have the key?
entries.literal: "Do you have the key?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...The key? No.{w} Answer my question. How long has it been since I left?
entries.literal: "...The key? No.{w} Answer my question. How long has it been since I left?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I don't know, maybe half an hour! Show me what you have!
entries.literal: "I don't know, maybe half an hour! Show me what you have!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached him slowly, staying at a distance that prevented him from grabbing the knife. If he still had the key he'd snatched from my purse, I had to leave immediately.
entries.literal: "I approached him slowly, staying at a distance that prevented him from grabbing the knife. If he still had the key he'd snatched from my purse, I had to leave immediately."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't you get that it's impossible I still have the key? It's like you said a while ago.{w} I just appeared in the middle of this bedroom, looking at the door. Obviously, that coordinate is from the time you were in front of the door, pointing the knife at me. At that point, I didn't have the key yet.
entries.literal: "Don't you get that it's impossible I still have the key? It's like you said a while ago.{w} I just appeared in the middle of this bedroom, looking at the door. Obviously, that coordinate is from the time you were in front of the door, pointing the knife at me. At that point, I didn't have the key yet."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Just show me your pockets.
entries.literal: "...Just show me your pockets."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Sure. I can do that.
entries.literal: "Sure. I can do that."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Start with your hip pack.
entries.literal: "...Start with your hip pack."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: My hip pack? Of course.
entries.literal: "My hip pack? Of course."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He unzipped it. Inside, I noticed a key that he hadn't had in the past.
entries.literal: "He unzipped it. Inside, I noticed a key that he hadn't had in the past."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hey, it's not for this bedroom.
entries.literal: "Hey, it's not for this bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He handed it to me.
entries.literal: "He handed it to me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: This is for the bathrooms, right? Did you kill Katei?
entries.literal: "This is for the bathrooms, right? Did you kill Katei?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I wouldn't do that to him. It would be like punching a kid for getting into the cookies, they don't know better. Anyway, let's continue.
entries.literal: "I wouldn't do that to him. It would be like punching a kid for getting into the cookies, they don't know better. Anyway, let's continue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the bathroom key on the drawer stand. Then, Sai placed a hand on the right pocket of his pants and highlighted the outline of a key. Following that, he took it out.
entries.literal: "I left the bathroom key on the drawer stand. Then, Sai placed a hand on the right pocket of his pants and highlighted the outline of a key. Following that, he took it out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the key to the Sekimeiya cabinet.
entries.literal: "It was the key to the Sekimeiya cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He kept it and continued by putting his hand in his left pocket.
entries.literal: "He kept it and continued by putting his hand in his left pocket."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: No. ...Stop.
entries.literal: "No. ...Stop."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Show me everything you have in the other pocket.
entries.literal: "Show me everything you have in the other pocket."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What? I just showed what I had.
entries.literal: "What? I just showed what I had."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Do it.
entries.literal: "...Do it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He put his hand inside the right pocket and brought out another key.
entries.literal: "He put his hand inside the right pocket and brought out another key."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, shit. Isn't this the key to this very bedroom?
entries.literal: "Oh, shit. Isn't this the key to this very bedroom?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Give it to me.
entries.literal: "Give it to me."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Fucking Atsuki. How did he get me with this?
entries.literal: "...Fucking Atsuki. How did he get me with this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the key on the drawer stand and looked at Sai sternly.
entries.literal: "I left the key on the drawer stand and looked at Sai sternly."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: That's the key to the other bedroom.{w} Take your hand out of the pocket.
entries.literal: "That's the key to the other bedroom.{w} Take your hand out of the pocket."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Turn it inside out.
entries.literal: "Turn it inside out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hesitantly, he did so.{w} One last key remained inside.
entries.literal: "Hesitantly, he did so.{w} One last key remained inside."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck? What were these doing in my pocket?
entries.literal: "What the fuck? What were these doing in my pocket?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So he had the key because he touched the Sekimeiya with it, just like how I appeared here with the knife because I had it when I traveled. ...Atsuki and I were definitely wrong.
entries.literal: "So he had the key because he touched the Sekimeiya with it, just like how I appeared here with the knife because I had it when I traveled. ...Atsuki and I were definitely wrong."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Give me the key.
entries.literal: "...Give me the key."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm... You can't expect me to give you anything when you're pointing at me with that scary knife.
entries.literal: "Hm... You can't expect me to give you anything when you're pointing at me with that scary knife."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm not approaching you to give you anything.
entries.literal: "I'm not approaching you to give you anything."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Then just throw it!
entries.literal: "Then just throw it!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I've had too many awkward moments trying to do that.
entries.literal: "I've had too many awkward moments trying to do that."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Sai, throw me the key.
entries.literal: "Sai, throw me the key."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: All right, we'll do the following.
entries.literal: "All right, we'll do the following."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He turned around and began to quickly climb up the ladder.
entries.literal: "He turned around and began to quickly climb up the ladder."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What are you doing!? Come down!
entries.literal: "What are you doing!? Come down!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't even have time to consider following him. Seconds after he had disappeared from view, he jumped back down to where I was.
entries.literal: "I didn't even have time to consider following him. Seconds after he had disappeared from view, he jumped back down to where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He extended both of his hands. They were empty.
entries.literal: "He extended both of his hands. They were empty."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is how I'm giving you the key. I left it up there so that you can obtain it without me getting close to that pointy knife.
entries.literal: "This is how I'm giving you the key. I left it up there so that you can obtain it without me getting close to that pointy knife."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What? No. Go get it.
entries.literal: "...What? No. Go get it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, that's not happening.
entries.literal: "Well, that's not happening."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What are you trying to do? Do you still have it and want me to go up so you can leave?
entries.literal: "...What are you trying to do? Do you still have it and want me to go up so you can leave?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, not at all. I'm not like that.
entries.literal: "Oh, not at all. I'm not like that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I can show you my pockets if you want.
entries.literal: "I can show you my pockets if you want."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He showed the contents of all his pockets, and except for a single key, they were identical to the time we'd all showed our possessions.
entries.literal: "He showed the contents of all his pockets, and except for a single key, they were identical to the time we'd all showed our possessions."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, I also have the attic key, but I guess that doesn't matter much to you.{w} Are you happy now? Do you think I might have it in my hair? It's pretty messy today. Maybe in one of my shoes?{w} Don't worry, I left it up top.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I also have the attic key, but I guess that doesn't matter much to you.{w} Are you happy now? Do you think I might have it in my hair? It's pretty messy today. Maybe in one of my shoes?{w} Don't worry, I left it up top."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He kept clearing places where he might've hidden the key on himself until I was forced to accept that he didn't have it anymore.
entries.literal: "He kept clearing places where he might've hidden the key on himself until I was forced to accept that he didn't have it anymore."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Anywhere else?
entries.literal: "Anywhere else?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What is he doing...!? Could he have hidden it somewhere in this section of the bedroom and I didn't realize?
entries.literal: "What is he doing...!? Could he have hidden it somewhere in this section of the bedroom and I didn't realize?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wait in that corner.
entries.literal: "Wait in that corner."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: No problem.
entries.literal: "No problem."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He approached the empty corner of the room and leaned back with a carefree face. I glanced all around, thinking about whether he could've left the key anywhere before climbing up the ladder. I knew I hadn't seen anything, but I couldn't trust it.
entries.literal: "He approached the empty corner of the room and leaned back with a carefree face. I glanced all around, thinking about whether he could've left the key anywhere before climbing up the ladder. I knew I hadn't seen anything, but I couldn't trust it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Indecisive, I looked through the few places I could think of where a key could've been hidden. The bed, the wardrobe, the drawers... I didn't find it anywhere, as it was impossible he had hidden it to begin with.
entries.literal: "Indecisive, I looked through the few places I could think of where a key could've been hidden. The bed, the wardrobe, the drawers... I didn't find it anywhere, as it was impossible he had hidden it to begin with."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...What are you even searching for? I just left it there, below the bed.
entries.literal: "...What are you even searching for? I just left it there, below the bed."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Then go get it!
entries.literal: "Then go get it!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't want to.
entries.literal: "I don't want to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up to him slowly, running out of breath.
entries.literal: "I walked up to him slowly, running out of breath."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Whoa, what's with that face? You wouldn't be thinking of killing me in front of those cameras when I'm just trying to give you a key, would you?
entries.literal: "Whoa, what's with that face? You wouldn't be thinking of killing me in front of those cameras when I'm just trying to give you a key, would you?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Why don't you go up first and then I follow you?
entries.literal: "Why don't you go up first and then I follow you?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm way too tired to climb this ladder again.
entries.literal: "I'm way too tired to climb this ladder again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He wants me to go up so that he can leave me behind again. How, though...!?
entries.literal: "He wants me to go up so that he can leave me behind again. How, though...!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You should believe me. If you hurry up, you might be fast enough to save him.
entries.literal: "You should believe me. If you hurry up, you might be fast enough to save him."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I came from the future, remember? I'm not exactly sure how far back I went, but it's possible Atsuki hasn't died yet.
entries.literal: "I came from the future, remember? I'm not exactly sure how far back I went, but it's possible Atsuki hasn't died yet."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}You're lying.
entries.literal: "...{w}You're lying."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me? I haven't lied all day.
entries.literal: "Me? I haven't lied all day."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: No, you are...
entries.literal: "No, you are..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Am I? Are you sure...? I just found him dead, but I don't even know what happened to him. I guess it was Akaro.
entries.literal: "Am I? Are you sure...? I just found him dead, but I don't even know what happened to him. I guess it was Akaro."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No, it didn't matter that he could've been lying or that it was unlikely the past could be changed. Before I could keep thinking, I was hastily climbing the ladder.
entries.literal: "No, it didn't matter that he could've been lying or that it was unlikely the past could be changed. Before I could keep thinking, I was hastily climbing the ladder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I crouched next to the bed and looked under it. It was dark, so I had to wait for my vision to adjust.
entries.literal: "I crouched next to the bed and looked under it. It was dark, so I had to wait for my vision to adjust."

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: Bye!
entries.literal: "Bye!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no way.
entries.literal: "There's no way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't react. I just kept looking at the floor, where there was nothing.
entries.literal: "I didn't react. I just kept looking at the floor, where there was nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I crawled back out and stood up, unable to raise my head. I glanced down through the hatch and saw the empty bedroom with the door closed.
entries.literal: "I crawled back out and stood up, unable to raise my head. I glanced down through the hatch and saw the empty bedroom with the door closed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He was... lying. He had to have been.
entries.literal: "He was... lying. He had to have been."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't move. I didn't know what had happened, but all my energy was directed at denying what Sai had said.
entries.literal: "I couldn't move. I didn't know what had happened, but all my energy was directed at denying what Sai had said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I got back down, I examined the door and saw that nothing about it had changed. There was still no way to open it.
entries.literal: "Once I got back down, I examined the door and saw that nothing about it had changed. There was still no way to open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't knock on the door or yell. I just sat down, staring at my lap.
entries.literal: "I didn't knock on the door or yell. I just sat down, staring at my lap."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It kept happening. Every time I thought I couldn't feel more miserable, I did.
entries.literal: "It kept happening. Every time I thought I couldn't feel more miserable, I did."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: During the minutes I sat paralyzed on the floor, I didn't perceive any sound. Once again, I was alone in the attic.
entries.literal: "During the minutes I sat paralyzed on the floor, I didn't perceive any sound. Once again, I was alone in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And so I began to think that perhaps I didn't want to leave. If what waited for me outside was what I'd been told, it was better to stay inside.
entries.literal: "And so I began to think that perhaps I didn't want to leave. If what waited for me outside was what I'd been told, it was better to stay inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Fortunately, that thought was what let me snap out of it.
entries.literal: "Fortunately, that thought was what let me snap out of it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No, I need to leave. Was Sai able to leave without the key? There's no way, right? He was just able to hide that he had it.
entries.literal: "No, I need to leave. Was Sai able to leave without the key? There's no way, right? He was just able to hide that he had it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up and tried to think rationally. There was nothing around that indicated what he'd done.
entries.literal: "I stood up and tried to think rationally. There was nothing around that indicated what he'd done."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There was nothing under the bed, so he was just lying about leaving the key there. He only wanted me to go up so he could lock me in again.
entries.literal: "There was nothing under the bed, so he was just lying about leaving the key there. He only wanted me to go up so he could lock me in again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The key I'd left on the stand was still there. I knew it wasn't the right one, but I tried to use it anyway.
entries.literal: "The key I'd left on the stand was still there. I knew it wasn't the right one, but I tried to use it anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The door didn't unlock.
entries.literal: "...The door didn't unlock."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I did all I could to dispel the fog in my mind and think about what had happened. I had to leave urgently, and if there was a way out, I needed to find it.
entries.literal: "I did all I could to dispel the fog in my mind and think about what had happened. I had to leave urgently, and if there was a way out, I needed to find it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went up to the second level and looked below the bed again. Without a doubt, there was nothing there.
entries.literal: "I went up to the second level and looked below the bed again. Without a doubt, there was nothing there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He closed the door when he left, so he definitely opened and left through it...!
entries.literal: "He closed the door when he left, so he definitely opened and left through it...!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it possible he opened it without the key? That shouldn't be it.
entries.literal: "Is it possible he opened it without the key? That shouldn't be it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The way he could've left the bedroom the very first time... by opening the door, going to the past, and unlocking it... That shouldn't have been possible either because there was no handle to open it from the inside even if it had been unlocked from the outside.
entries.literal: "The way he could've left the bedroom the very first time... by opening the door, going to the past, and unlocking it... That shouldn't have been possible either because there was no handle to open it from the inside even if it had been unlocked from the outside."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it possible that he approached the door, saw it open, traveled to the past, and opened it from the outside to let himself leave? Could he have known enough about the Sekimeiya to pull that off?
entries.literal: "Is it possible that he approached the door, saw it open, traveled to the past, and opened it from the outside to let himself leave? Could he have known enough about the Sekimeiya to pull that off?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If so, I might have been able to do it myself. I climbed down and stared at the door.
entries.literal: "If so, I might have been able to do it myself. I climbed down and stared at the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't opening. ...Was that not possible?
entries.literal: "It wasn't opening. ...Was that not possible?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It hadn't worked for Atsuki when he tried it. Maybe it really wouldn't ever occur.
entries.literal: "It hadn't worked for Atsuki when he tried it. Maybe it really wouldn't ever occur."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to think more about it. How could I open the door?
entries.literal: "I tried to think more about it. How could I open the door?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For even longer, I stood still, mustering all my remaining mental strength to figure out how to escape.
entries.literal: "For even longer, I stood still, mustering all my remaining mental strength to figure out how to escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...How had Sai done it? Had he used the key? If so, how?
entries.literal: "...How had Sai done it? Had he used the key? If so, how?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Wait.
entries.literal: "...Wait."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did I let him do this?
entries.literal: "Did I let him do this?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is it. There's no way it's not.
entries.literal: "This is it. There's no way it's not."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I thought back on one thing, the way Sai had escaped appeared in my head.
entries.literal: "As soon as I thought back on one thing, the way Sai had escaped appeared in my head."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When he appeared in the middle of the bedroom... Of course, he even said it.{w} That location belonged to the time I'd been blocking his path to the door.{w} That's how he escaped the first time. At that point, the key to the bedroom was already in his pocket, which is why he had it when he appeared from the future. Atsuki said it too, that he grabbed it when he was chasing us.{w} But, for some reason, there was another key in the drawer. At some point, the key got duplicated.
entries.literal: "When he appeared in the middle of the bedroom... Of course, he even said it.{w} That location belonged to the time I'd been blocking his path to the door.{w} That's how he escaped the first time. At that point, the key to the bedroom was already in his pocket, which is why he had it when he appeared from the future. Atsuki said it too, that he grabbed it when he was chasing us.{w} But, for some reason, there was another key in the drawer. At some point, the key got duplicated."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The time he snatched the key from my purse... it only felt like he unzipped it. That's all he did. He tricked me into thinking that he'd grabbed the key, when in reality he left with one he had from the beginning. ...Did he just make me think I was trapped?
entries.literal: "The time he snatched the key from my purse... it only felt like he unzipped it. That's all he did. He tricked me into thinking that he'd grabbed the key, when in reality he left with one he had from the beginning. ...Did he just make me think I was trapped?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the desk. That was where I'd left my purse a while ago.
entries.literal: "I looked at the desk. That was where I'd left my purse a while ago."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And the only place in this bedroom I didn't search... was in my own purse, where he knew the other key still was.
entries.literal: "And the only place in this bedroom I didn't search... was in my own purse, where he knew the other key still was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached it and looked inside. Of course, the key was missing.
entries.literal: "I approached it and looked inside. Of course, the key was missing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...He just wanted me to go up so he could grab the key from my purse. It's still unzipped.
entries.literal: "...He just wanted me to go up so he could grab the key from my purse. It's still unzipped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I set my eyes on the hatch and rapidly made my way up the ladder.
entries.literal: "I set my eyes on the hatch and rapidly made my way up the ladder."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I'm right, the other key must be somewhere here in the second level. He just hid it better to trick me.
entries.literal: "If I'm right, the other key must be somewhere here in the second level. He just hid it better to trick me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There weren't many places to look through. I frantically went through all of them in search of a very small key.
entries.literal: "There weren't many places to look through. I frantically went through all of them in search of a very small key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I started unzipping the leftmost mattress, a metal key fell to the floor.
entries.literal: "As soon as I started unzipping the leftmost mattress, a metal key fell to the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I breathed deeply before picking it up and clambering down.
entries.literal: "I breathed deeply before picking it up and clambering down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed my purse, ran to the door, and inserted the key. It finally opened, and I saw the walls of the hallway.
entries.literal: "I grabbed my purse, ran to the door, and inserted the key. It finally opened, and I saw the walls of the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sped toward the living room while I stored the knife in my purse and took the attic key out.
entries.literal: "I sped toward the living room while I stored the knife in my purse and took the attic key out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The most recent footprints there were definitely Sai's, which went to the staircase. I rapidly followed them down.
entries.literal: "The most recent footprints there were definitely Sai's, which went to the staircase. I rapidly followed them down."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...!{w} You're all right!
entries.literal: "...!{w} You're all right!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He's okay. Sai was just lying. Thank God.
entries.literal: "He's okay. Sai was just lying. Thank God."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I panted, suddenly realizing that I was out of breath.
entries.literal: "I panted, suddenly realizing that I was out of breath."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Oh, she was actually inside. I'm glad we found you.
entries.literal: "...Oh, she was actually inside. I'm glad we found you."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh-What!? He locked me in here!
entries.literal: "Wh-What!? He locked me in here!"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Me? That's funny. I locked you in, but the key's in the keyhole, right?
entries.literal: "Me? That's funny. I locked you in, but the key's in the keyhole, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Was he acting like he wanted to find me? He locked me in the bedroom!
entries.literal: "Was he acting like he wanted to find me? He locked me in the bedroom!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sorry?
entries.literal: "I'm sorry?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I've been here for almost two hours! He shut me in!
entries.literal: "I've been here for almost two hours! He shut me in!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So you chose to hole up in the attic and want to blame me for it... why, exactly?
entries.literal: "So you chose to hole up in the attic and want to blame me for it... why, exactly?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't look at Sai anymore. No matter whether he was the person behind everything, I hated him and the unquestionable malice behind his actions. However, {time=21} was very close, and creating more conflicts would only be a problem.
entries.literal: "I couldn't look at Sai anymore. No matter whether he was the person behind everything, I hated him and the unquestionable malice behind his actions. However, {time=21} was very close, and creating more conflicts would only be a problem."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.literal: "Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yes... I just ran from the bedroom. I'm fine.
entries.literal: "Yes... I just ran from the bedroom. I'm fine."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Let's pretend I locked you in a bedroom. I'm not sure why I'd even do that, but how did you leave?
entries.literal: "Let's pretend I locked you in a bedroom. I'm not sure why I'd even do that, but how did you leave?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...With the key.
entries.literal: "...With the key."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: But I thought I trapped you there?
entries.literal: "But I thought I trapped you there?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yes, but not with the key! I know what you did!
entries.literal: "Yes, but not with the key! I know what you did!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I became a witch and learned magic, huh? We can go with that if you don't want to tell the truth.
entries.literal: "I became a witch and learned magic, huh? We can go with that if you don't want to tell the truth."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...W-Wait! Erina!
entries.literal: "...W-Wait! Erina!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suddenly processed what I was seeing without tunnel vision and saw Erina next to them, her clothing coated in dried blood.
entries.literal: "I suddenly processed what I was seeing without tunnel vision and saw Erina next to them, her clothing coated in dried blood."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You're alive?
entries.literal: "You're alive?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Y-Yes...
entries.literal: "Y-Yes..."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm sorry if this sounds strange, but are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?
entries.literal: "I'm sorry if this sounds strange, but are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Hm? Yes, I've been here since then.
entries.literal: "Hm? Yes, I've been here since then."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I... see.{w} We didn't check Erina's pulse, remember...?
entries.literal: "I... see.{w} We didn't check Erina's pulse, remember...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: O-Oh! Thank God, and sorry...
entries.literal: "O-Oh! Thank God, and sorry..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After thinking incorrectly for so long, I felt immensely relieved. Despite all that had happened, those of us who were still alive, including Erina, had to make it out.
entries.literal: "After thinking incorrectly for so long, I felt immensely relieved. Despite all that had happened, those of us who were still alive, including Erina, had to make it out."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What's with the blood, though?
entries.literal: "What's with the blood, though?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't know. I got hit in the head, so my memories are a little fuzzy.
entries.literal: "I don't know. I got hit in the head, so my memories are a little fuzzy."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh. ...What time is it?
entries.literal: "Oh. ...What time is it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm... It's {time=19:40.}

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's so late... What happened while I was here? And your watch is working again?
entries.literal: "It's so late... What happened while I was here? And your watch is working again?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh? Yes, of course.
entries.literal: "Huh? Yes, of course."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wait, what's with your clothes? You were wearing different ones.
entries.literal: "Wait, what's with your clothes? You were wearing different ones."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Right. When we went to the past, we lost track of that Shiroya, but she still has to be around. I'm confused, though. Where did she come from?
entries.literal: "Right. When we went to the past, we lost track of that Shiroya, but she still has to be around. I'm confused, though. Where did she come from?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited for a response, but nobody gave one. Had the version of me that Atsuki saw reappeared...?
entries.literal: "I waited for a response, but nobody gave one. Had the version of me that Atsuki saw reappeared...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Can you come with me for a second?
entries.literal: "Can you come with me for a second?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Y-Yeah.
entries.literal: "Y-Yeah."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Can't you just talk openly here?
entries.literal: "Can't you just talk openly here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki ignored him and brought me to the fifth floor.
entries.literal: "Atsuki ignored him and brought me to the fifth floor."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You know Sai's lying, right? He really locked me in a bedroom and told me you died...! I was so worried.
entries.literal: "You know Sai's lying, right? He really locked me in a bedroom and told me you died...! I was so worried."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What...? Don't worry, I believe you, even though I still don't understand Sai very much. I wanted to tell you about what just happened.
entries.literal: "What...? Don't worry, I believe you, even though I still don't understand Sai very much. I wanted to tell you about what just happened."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Hm?
entries.literal: "Hm?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I think... the past can be changed somehow.
entries.literal: "I think... the past can be changed somehow."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It can...? Did you try it?
entries.literal: "It can...? Did you try it?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I did, but I'm not sure what to make of the results.
entries.literal: "I did, but I'm not sure what to make of the results."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those few words made me drop everything I had assumed. After what we'd experienced, was it actually possible for us to undo what had already happened?
entries.literal: "Those few words made me drop everything I had assumed. After what we'd experienced, was it actually possible for us to undo what had already happened?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's possible what I changed only affected some people. I definitely went back in time and altered the events I'd experienced. Sai recognizes the change, but I'm not sure Erina does.{w} It felt like both realities met, leading into differing memories. That could be what happened to Akaro, when his version of events contradicted ours. Maybe someone made some change that didn't affect us, or maybe it didn't affect Akaro.
entries.literal: "It's possible what I changed only affected some people. I definitely went back in time and altered the events I'd experienced. Sai recognizes the change, but I'm not sure Erina does.{w} It felt like both realities met, leading into differing memories. That could be what happened to Akaro, when his version of events contradicted ours. Maybe someone made some change that didn't affect us, or maybe it didn't affect Akaro."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: That sounds way too complicated... I'm not sure I follow, but you mean...
entries.literal: "That sounds way too complicated... I'm not sure I follow, but you mean..."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: If we go to the past, I'm pretty sure we could drastically change the way things played out. It's possible some people would still remember this reality, but the change should persist.{w} It's possible two realities just converged, but the real one comes from my change. It overlapped the last one despite some people potentially still remembering it.
entries.literal: "If we go to the past, I'm pretty sure we could drastically change the way things played out. It's possible some people would still remember this reality, but the change should persist.{w} It's possible two realities just converged, but the real one comes from my change. It overlapped the last one despite some people potentially still remembering it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So then... We just have to want to change the past? Is that the only requirement?
entries.literal: "So then... We just have to want to change the past? Is that the only requirement?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If we travel to the point Isla died, we can overwrite her death...?
entries.literal: "If we travel to the point Isla died, we can overwrite her death...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd long ago decided I wouldn't touch the Sekimeiya again, but the most fundamental reason was that we'd concluded it wasn't possible to alter the past.
entries.literal: "I'd long ago decided I wouldn't touch the Sekimeiya again, but the most fundamental reason was that we'd concluded it wasn't possible to alter the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled my own selfishness and how much I despised it. If we were able to undo what had happened but chose not to, that was infinitely worse.
entries.literal: "I recalled my own selfishness and how much I despised it. If we were able to undo what had happened but chose not to, that was infinitely worse."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Let's keep going.{w} I last traveled from the staff room. Let's go there.
entries.literal: "Let's keep going.{w} I last traveled from the staff room. Let's go there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We walked all the way down. In the reality where we were, many people had died. Even if changing the past was doable, how much could we really deviate from it?
entries.literal: "We walked all the way down. In the reality where we were, many people had died. Even if changing the past was doable, how much could we really deviate from it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That didn't matter. As long as we could prevent the suffering I'd felt for at least one person, we had to do it.
entries.literal: "That didn't matter. As long as we could prevent the suffering I'd felt for at least one person, we had to do it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We slowly reached the crystal floor. On the way down, I noticed that the smell hanging around us all day was getting stronger.
entries.literal: "We slowly reached the crystal floor. On the way down, I noticed that the smell hanging around us all day was getting stronger."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What's all this blood...?
entries.literal: "What's all this blood...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's mine. As you can see, I hurt my hand in the elevator. I don't even know why it stopped bleeding.
entries.literal: "It's mine. As you can see, I hurt my hand in the elevator. I don't even know why it stopped bleeding."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Does it hurt? That's kind of a lot.
entries.literal: "Does it hurt? That's kind of a lot."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Don't worry, it's fine...
entries.literal: "Don't worry, it's fine..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the staff room, and I saw that a new locker was open.
entries.literal: "We entered the staff room, and I saw that a new locker was open."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...!{w} It's gone.
entries.literal: "...!{w} It's gone."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Did you leave it in this locker? How?
entries.literal: "Did you leave it in this locker? How?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I found the key in the cleaning room. I know how that sounds, but I guess no one needed a key to get it. I touched it with the locker open.
entries.literal: "I found the key in the cleaning room. I know how that sounds, but I guess no one needed a key to get it. I touched it with the locker open."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh... Could anyone have taken it, then?
entries.literal: "Oh... Could anyone have taken it, then?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It would've been easy, but I'm not completely sure. The door doesn't look like it moved, so it also could've teleported.{w} While you were in the attic, we saw that happen. I definitely witnessed the Sekimeiya teleport to its cabinet.{w} But Sai could've easily grabbed it. Akaro as well. I saw him, and he should still be here somewhere. It was before I changed the past, but all I did was draw attention to hallway A. There's no way that was enough to overwrite Akaro's existence.
entries.literal: "It would've been easy, but I'm not completely sure. The door doesn't look like it moved, so it also could've teleported.{w} While you were in the attic, we saw that happen. I definitely witnessed the Sekimeiya teleport to its cabinet.{w} But Sai could've easily grabbed it. Akaro as well. I saw him, and he should still be here somewhere. It was before I changed the past, but all I did was draw attention to hallway A. There's no way that was enough to overwrite Akaro's existence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went to the event room and saw the empty cabinet. Once more, we wanted to find the Sekimeiya that someone might have hidden.
entries.literal: "We went to the event room and saw the empty cabinet. Once more, we wanted to find the Sekimeiya that someone might have hidden."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since that morning, a recurring question had been why anyone would hide the Sekimeiya when it could easily be found. I'd thought of many possible answers, but if the past could be changed, it had always been a flawed question.
entries.literal: "Since that morning, a recurring question had been why anyone would hide the Sekimeiya when it could easily be found. I'd thought of many possible answers, but if the past could be changed, it had always been a flawed question."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, if anyone was directing things toward a future they wanted, they wouldn't want anyone to deviate things on their own with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Of course, if anyone was directing things toward a future they wanted, they wouldn't want anyone to deviate things on their own with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Like always, whether it teleported or someone hid it, it has to be nearby and in a place we can access. We can find it.
entries.literal: "Like always, whether it teleported or someone hid it, it has to be nearby and in a place we can access. We can find it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was that person Sai, who knew the most about the Sekimeiya? Had an unknown person really orchestrated everything behind the scenes? I couldn't believe how fast I'd changed my mind and how much I wanted to find the Sekimeiya. Was it possible we could leave the tower in a world where I hadn't spent those two hours in that bedroom?
entries.literal: "Was that person Sai, who knew the most about the Sekimeiya? Had an unknown person really orchestrated everything behind the scenes? I couldn't believe how fast I'd changed my mind and how much I wanted to find the Sekimeiya. Was it possible we could leave the tower in a world where I hadn't spent those two hours in that bedroom?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was taking Atsuki's word, but if we found the Sekimeiya, determining whether the past could be changed should've been simple. However, we had concluded before that it wasn't possible because it had already been attempted. A ton of things implied that.
entries.literal: "I was taking Atsuki's word, but if we found the Sekimeiya, determining whether the past could be changed should've been simple. However, we had concluded before that it wasn't possible because it had already been attempted. A ton of things implied that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to erase the painful hours we'd all spent in the tower. But if that was possible, what if we could stay there for a whole month? There would be much more we could undo.
entries.literal: "I wanted to erase the painful hours we'd all spent in the tower. But if that was possible, what if we could stay there for a whole month? There would be much more we could undo."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The exit was near. In two hours, we were bound to learn about the future we'd be stuck with.
entries.literal: "The exit was near. In two hours, we were bound to learn about the future we'd be stuck with."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, yeah, the Sekimeiya's gone. I was searching for it before we went up.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah, the Sekimeiya's gone. I was searching for it before we went up."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'm sure you were.
entries.literal: "...I'm sure you were."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's not much time left... Let's wait for the shutter to open.
entries.literal: "There's not much time left... Let's wait for the shutter to open."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What about the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "What about the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who knows? I couldn't find it, but why do you care?
entries.literal: "Who knows? I couldn't find it, but why do you care?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Akaro might be responsible, and he could have taken it outside. If that happened, there's nothing we can do.
entries.literal: "Akaro might be responsible, and he could have taken it outside. If that happened, there's nothing we can do."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: However, if it's still inside, the police will find it immediately, right? It can be hidden from us, but not from them.
entries.literal: "However, if it's still inside, the police will find it immediately, right? It can be hidden from us, but not from them."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Erina, do you know where the Sekimeiya might be?
entries.literal: "Erina, do you know where the Sekimeiya might be?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...? No, I don't.
entries.literal: "What...? No, I don't."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then none of us do. If it was deliberately hidden, I don't see the point in searching for it anymore.
entries.literal: "Then none of us do. If it was deliberately hidden, I don't see the point in searching for it anymore."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You know where it is, right?
entries.literal: "You know where it is, right?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He must be the one who's been taking it all this time, and he's definitely had a reason. He doesn't want us to search for it so that he can keep it where he has it.
entries.literal: "He must be the one who's been taking it all this time, and he's definitely had a reason. He doesn't want us to search for it so that he can keep it where he has it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're free to enlighten me. If I knew where it was, what would my endgame be? Hoping the police don't find it? There's no way that would happen.{w} Someone took it when we weren't around. That must mean they have the means to keep it out of ours and the police's sights. Otherwise, hiding it is pointless.
entries.literal: "You're free to enlighten me. If I knew where it was, what would my endgame be? Hoping the police don't find it? There's no way that would happen.{w} Someone took it when we weren't around. That must mean they have the means to keep it out of ours and the police's sights. Otherwise, hiding it is pointless."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Of course, that's only assuming the past can't be changed. With how much Sai's proven to know about the Sekimeiya, there's no way he's not aware of whether it can do that or not.
entries.literal: "Of course, that's only assuming the past can't be changed. With how much Sai's proven to know about the Sekimeiya, there's no way he's not aware of whether it can do that or not."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You say that, but it's been happening since this morning, and it was never hidden in a place the police wouldn't have inspected.
entries.literal: "You say that, but it's been happening since this morning, and it was never hidden in a place the police wouldn't have inspected."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You could have a plan, too. When the police enter, as soon as they find the Sekimeiya, they'll activate it. That'll make everyone around it disappear, leaving a free path for you to retrieve it.
entries.literal: "You could have a plan, too. When the police enter, as soon as they find the Sekimeiya, they'll activate it. That'll make everyone around it disappear, leaving a free path for you to retrieve it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you even listening to yourself? You think I want to steal the Sekimeiya? Sure, I wouldn't say no to having it, but that's not gonna work out.{w} First of all, they'd simply appear in the past. If a bunch of people time travel, the panic would ruin any kind of plan like that. At least a few people have to know what the Sekimeiya is capable of too, right? Why would they send the police to grab it if they know what touching it would do?
entries.literal: "Are you even listening to yourself? You think I want to steal the Sekimeiya? Sure, I wouldn't say no to having it, but that's not gonna work out.{w} First of all, they'd simply appear in the past. If a bunch of people time travel, the panic would ruin any kind of plan like that. At least a few people have to know what the Sekimeiya is capable of too, right? Why would they send the police to grab it if they know what touching it would do?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I think I agree with him... That wouldn't work.
entries.literal: "I think I agree with him... That wouldn't work."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hiding the Sekimeiya is pointless, that's a fact. Incidentally, there's no place the police would ignore. What that means is that if the Sekimeiya's here, there's no reason to search for it. What I find most likely is that it's already outside, though.
entries.literal: "Hiding the Sekimeiya is pointless, that's a fact. Incidentally, there's no place the police would ignore. What that means is that if the Sekimeiya's here, there's no reason to search for it. What I find most likely is that it's already outside, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: All right. I agree, so let's just wait.
entries.literal: "All right. I agree, so let's just wait."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned as I looked at him, but he avoided meeting my eyes and glanced back at Sai instead.
entries.literal: "I frowned as I looked at him, but he avoided meeting my eyes and glanced back at Sai instead."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Perfect. We've had enough headaches, so let's go to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Perfect. We've had enough headaches, so let's go to the lobby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is this a bluff to waste time...?
entries.literal: "Is this a bluff to waste time...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If we want to go to the past, we want the Sekimeiya to spend a while out of the cabinet, which we accomplish by doing what Sai wants for a while. Eventually, we can find it, just like we have every time we've extensively looked for it.
entries.literal: "If we want to go to the past, we want the Sekimeiya to spend a while out of the cabinet, which we accomplish by doing what Sai wants for a while. Eventually, we can find it, just like we have every time we've extensively looked for it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki whispered to me.
entries.literal: "Atsuki whispered to me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Did you lose the knife?
entries.literal: "...Did you lose the knife?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shook my head and showed him my purse, still unzipped.
entries.literal: "I shook my head and showed him my purse, still unzipped."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did you get it from Sai after you two appeared somewhere?
entries.literal: "Did you get it from Sai after you two appeared somewhere?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: No... I still don't understand it either. Both of us appeared in the attic, and I already had it. I'd forgotten to mention it, but yeah, that doesn't make sense with how we thought the Sekimeiya worked.
entries.literal: "No... I still don't understand it either. Both of us appeared in the attic, and I already had it. I'd forgotten to mention it, but yeah, that doesn't make sense with how we thought the Sekimeiya worked."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Okay, let's sit around and wait. I'm exhausted and just want to get out, so I hope nothing else happens. Whatever Xyn or the culprit are up to is no concern of ours anymore...{w} I have no idea what happened to Akaro, but I don't care. If he's behind this whole mess, he'll face the consequences.
entries.literal: "Okay, let's sit around and wait. I'm exhausted and just want to get out, so I hope nothing else happens. Whatever Xyn or the culprit are up to is no concern of ours anymore...{w} I have no idea what happened to Akaro, but I don't care. If he's behind this whole mess, he'll face the consequences."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Exactly one hour and ten minutes. That's all we have to get through to reclaim our freedom.
entries.literal: "Exactly one hour and ten minutes. That's all we have to get through to reclaim our freedom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no reason to humor Sai anymore. I didn't believe for a second he wasn't lying. We sat on the left of the shutter without saying a word.
entries.literal: "There was no reason to humor Sai anymore. I didn't believe for a second he wasn't lying. We sat on the left of the shutter without saying a word."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had needed to leave the bedroom to finish up a part of his plan. He admitted that himself, so there was no way he simply wanted to get out of the tower while unaware of the Sekimeiya's whereabouts.
entries.literal: "He had needed to leave the bedroom to finish up a part of his plan. He admitted that himself, so there was no way he simply wanted to get out of the tower while unaware of the Sekimeiya's whereabouts."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It can't be that he's not the same Sai, right...? No... Even though his watch is working, he definitely knows what happened in the bedroom.
entries.literal: "It can't be that he's not the same Sai, right...? No... Even though his watch is working, he definitely knows what happened in the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We waited for a long time.
entries.literal: "We waited for a long time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the ideal thing to do. If we were able to find the Sekimeiya, we would do it after it had gathered enough energy. If finding it wasn't possible, we were calmly going through the final stretch.
entries.literal: "It was the ideal thing to do. If we were able to find the Sekimeiya, we would do it after it had gathered enough energy. If finding it wasn't possible, we were calmly going through the final stretch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If the recording was real, then we would either not find the Sekimeiya or changing the past would turn out to be impossible. However, I was convinced it was fake. No matter why it existed, it couldn't have been legitimate.
entries.literal: "If the recording was real, then we would either not find the Sekimeiya or changing the past would turn out to be impossible. However, I was convinced it was fake. No matter why it existed, it couldn't have been legitimate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spent some time going over all the possible outcomes. What if the Sekimeiya was in one of the temperature regulation cabinets, not gathering any heat?
entries.literal: "I spent some time going over all the possible outcomes. What if the Sekimeiya was in one of the temperature regulation cabinets, not gathering any heat?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If changing the past was possible, that was still fine. We could go a short time back, get it out of the cabinet, and progressively extend the distance traveled.
entries.literal: "If changing the past was possible, that was still fine. We could go a short time back, get it out of the cabinet, and progressively extend the distance traveled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai continued to update us with the time. We'd spent 25 minutes sitting down.
entries.literal: "Sai continued to update us with the time. We'd spent 25 minutes sitting down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it possible Sai's trying to trick us again?
entries.literal: "Is it possible Sai's trying to trick us again?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if he knows what we want to do? If he does, he could have set his wristwatch back a while to make it seem like we have more time. Did he anticipate things enough to have also edited the computer's time?
entries.literal: "What if he knows what we want to do? If he does, he could have set his wristwatch back a while to make it seem like we have more time. Did he anticipate things enough to have also edited the computer's time?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The shutter could open at any moment.
entries.literal: "...The shutter could open at any moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up.
entries.literal: "I stood up."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Wait here. I'm going to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "...Wait here. I'm going to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been needing to go for a while, and I had to before walking through the whole building. According to Sai, there were forty minutes left, but we couldn't trust that. Once I came back, we had to find the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I'd been needing to go for a while, and I had to before walking through the whole building. According to Sai, there were forty minutes left, but we couldn't trust that. Once I came back, we had to find the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, all right.
entries.literal: "Oh, all right."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Can't you wait?
entries.literal: "Can't you wait?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: No. Don't worry, though, I won't go anywhere else.
entries.literal: "No. Don't worry, though, I won't go anywhere else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew he'd insist on stopping me, so I went over to the hallway B door.
entries.literal: "I knew he'd insist on stopping me, so I went over to the hallway B door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the left bathroom.
entries.literal: "I entered the left bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I jumped instantly, feeling my back burn.
entries.literal: "I jumped instantly, feeling my back burn."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The tank... was burning.
entries.literal: "The tank... was burning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew what that had to mean. I grabbed the top with both hands and lifted it up.
entries.literal: "I knew what that had to mean. I grabbed the top with both hands and lifted it up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was on top of a pipe, touching the side I'd leaned on. It was well-balanced, positioned so that it didn't fall into the water.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was on top of a pipe, touching the side I'd leaned on. It was well-balanced, positioned so that it didn't fall into the water."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How hot does it have to be for the heat to reach the other side...? And I still feel the burn.
entries.literal: "How hot does it have to be for the heat to reach the other side...? And I still feel the burn."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But here it is... And it's working for sure.
entries.literal: "But here it is... And it's working for sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The past could be changed. Were those words true?
entries.literal: "The past could be changed. Were those words true?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If so, I knew I could go really far back.
entries.literal: "If so, I knew I could go really far back."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I tell them? ...Was it even Sai who left it here? He knew where I was going.
entries.literal: "Should I tell them? ...Was it even Sai who left it here? He knew where I was going."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Atsuki wanted to find the Sekimeiya and change the past. If I told him, I knew he would activate it. However, I wasn't sure I wanted that.
entries.literal: "...{w}Atsuki wanted to find the Sekimeiya and change the past. If I told him, I knew he would activate it. However, I wasn't sure I wanted that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His desire was to erase the deaths we'd experienced, but that wouldn't occur if he changed the past. He would still remember them, and how would it even work? Would he be stuck in a world with another self of his?
entries.literal: "His desire was to erase the deaths we'd experienced, but that wouldn't occur if he changed the past. He would still remember them, and how would it even work? Would he be stuck in a world with another self of his?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If he went to the past and changed things, he would end up personally suffering for it and would remember everything. If I did that instead... he wouldn't.
entries.literal: "If he went to the past and changed things, he would end up personally suffering for it and would remember everything. If I did that instead... he wouldn't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We didn't know where Akaro was, but he or Sai had the best chance of being behind everything. If I went to tell the others that I'd found the Sekimeiya, it was very possible Sai would purposely always stay in range. He could then prevent the changes we wanted.
entries.literal: "We didn't know where Akaro was, but he or Sai had the best chance of being behind everything. If I went to tell the others that I'd found the Sekimeiya, it was very possible Sai would purposely always stay in range. He could then prevent the changes we wanted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And ultimately, it was a fact that they'd all said they talked to a self of mine I wasn't aware of. Would that end up being myself despite me being sure that it couldn't be the case?
entries.literal: "And ultimately, it was a fact that they'd all said they talked to a self of mine I wasn't aware of. Would that end up being myself despite me being sure that it couldn't be the case?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If so, then I wouldn't be able to change the past. I was in the reality where that other self of mine appeared.
entries.literal: "If so, then I wouldn't be able to change the past. I was in the reality where that other self of mine appeared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hovered my hand over the gem and felt the imposing heat around it, repelling me. I realized I couldn't breathe properly due to the strange smell from all day. It was at its greatest intensity yet, reaching oppressive levels.
entries.literal: "I hovered my hand over the gem and felt the imposing heat around it, repelling me. I realized I couldn't breathe properly due to the strange smell from all day. It was at its greatest intensity yet, reaching oppressive levels."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With my left hand under my coat, I lifted the Sekimeiya out of the tank. Its heat was burning me through the cloth, but I resisted the intense pain.
entries.literal: "With my left hand under my coat, I lifted the Sekimeiya out of the tank. Its heat was burning me through the cloth, but I resisted the intense pain."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is the last chance we have to save anyone. Maybe saving Miiya is impossible, but I'm holding the possibility to erase Erina's suffering, Isla's, Naomi's, or even Katei's. If that works, nothing should be undoable, and then I could tell Atsuki what I've done and work together with him to save Miiya.
entries.literal: "This is the last chance we have to save anyone. Maybe saving Miiya is impossible, but I'm holding the possibility to erase Erina's suffering, Isla's, Naomi's, or even Katei's. If that works, nothing should be undoable, and then I could tell Atsuki what I've done and work together with him to save Miiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still knew he wanted to change the past, and maybe he didn't want to get rid of the memories he had. Who was I to decide that by myself and effectively erase the Atsuki I knew in that moment...?
