entries.literal: "I still knew he wanted to change the past, and maybe he didn't want to get rid of the memories he had. Who was I to decide that by myself and effectively erase the Atsuki I knew in that moment...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I couldn't hesitate. If I chose not to activate the Sekimeiya, I might not have been able to live with myself. I couldn't accept acting only in my own self-interest.
entries.literal: "But I couldn't hesitate. If I chose not to activate the Sekimeiya, I might not have been able to live with myself. I couldn't accept acting only in my own self-interest."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lowered my right hand slowly, toward the harmless-looking gem. I shut my eyes and gritted my teeth in pain, pushing through the burning aura until I made contact with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I lowered my right hand slowly, toward the harmless-looking gem. I shut my eyes and gritted my teeth in pain, pushing through the burning aura until I made contact with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At that point, Shiroya disappeared from the bathroom.
entries.literal: "At that point, Shiroya disappeared from the bathroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She also disappeared from the crystal floor and from Ashiya Tower. She went much farther through time than she had expected.
entries.literal: "She also disappeared from the crystal floor and from Ashiya Tower. She went much farther through time than she had expected."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The oblivious people who remained in the lobby would soon realize that something had happened and would search for the missing Shiroya through all seven floors...
entries.literal: "The oblivious people who remained in the lobby would soon realize that something had happened and would search for the missing Shiroya through all seven floors..."

entries.text: Liquid Canvas
entries.literal: "Liquid Canvas"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: —Wha—{w=1} ...Ow.{w=0.8} Where... is this?
entries.literal: "—Wha—{w=1} ...Ow.{w=0.8} Where... is this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt my body lying on cold stone. I opened my eyes, but I couldn't see a thing.
entries.literal: "I felt my body lying on cold stone. I opened my eyes, but I couldn't see a thing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is this still the tower...?
entries.literal: "Is this still the tower...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to stand up, but my whole body hurt. When I moved, I realized I was wearing different clothes under my coat and that the air was much colder.
entries.literal: "I tried to stand up, but my whole body hurt. When I moved, I realized I was wearing different clothes under my coat and that the air was much colder."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Ah...! What...!?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suddenly felt a throbbing pain in my head that stopped all my movements. It wasn't only my head—there wasn't a single part of my body that didn't hurt.
entries.literal: "I suddenly felt a throbbing pain in my head that stopped all my movements. It wasn't only my head—there wasn't a single part of my body that didn't hurt."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stayed still, hoping the unbearable headache would fade away. In the meantime, my vision began to adjust a little.
entries.literal: "I stayed still, hoping the unbearable headache would fade away. In the meantime, my vision began to adjust a little."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see light anywhere, but I was still able to make out the space around me.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see light anywhere, but I was still able to make out the space around me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is this underground...?
entries.literal: "Is this underground...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was all I could really tell, but when I looked up, I understood where I was.
entries.literal: "That was all I could really tell, but when I looked up, I understood where I was."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The ceiling is broken, and there's a bit of light... That's where I fell from.
entries.literal: "The ceiling is broken, and there's a bit of light... That's where I fell from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was in some kind of channel, directly below the gem shop we'd gone to that day.
entries.literal: "I was in some kind of channel, directly below the gem shop we'd gone to that day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Bewildered, I tried to think. However, an immense headache was still numbing my mind.
entries.literal: "Bewildered, I tried to think. However, an immense headache was still numbing my mind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did I appear here? From the tower?
entries.literal: "...Did I appear here? From the tower?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't think that was it. I remembered traveling from the bathroom on the crystal floor, but something was amiss.
entries.literal: "I didn't think that was it. I remembered traveling from the bathroom on the crystal floor, but something was amiss."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every time I'd gone through time, I'd instantly appeared somewhere. That time, I'd woken up on the ground, and my whole body hurt. ...Had there been something in between, then? It felt like there had to have been, but my mind was too foggy to know.
entries.literal: "Every time I'd gone through time, I'd instantly appeared somewhere. That time, I'd woken up on the ground, and my whole body hurt. ...Had there been something in between, then? It felt like there had to have been, but my mind was too foggy to know."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where am I? How far back did I go?
entries.literal: "Where am I? How far back did I go?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Under the thick, brown coat I usually wore, I identified the clothes I was in. They were the ones I'd woken up with in the hospital—the ones I'd worn the day Miiya died.
entries.literal: "Under the thick, brown coat I usually wore, I identified the clothes I was in. They were the ones I'd woken up with in the hospital—the ones I'd worn the day Miiya died."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept trying to push my mind for an answer, but I had no idea what had happened. When I finally collected myself somewhat, I noticed that I had my purse around my shoulder. I unzipped it and felt the interior with my hand.
entries.literal: "I kept trying to push my mind for an answer, but I had no idea what had happened. When I finally collected myself somewhat, I noticed that I had my purse around my shoulder. I unzipped it and felt the interior with my hand."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The knife isn't here. Why did I not travel with it this time?
entries.literal: "...The knife isn't here. Why did I not travel with it this time?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, this...!
entries.literal: "Wait, this...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I retracted my hand, gripping a familiar object. After fiddling with it, a rectangular light appeared in front of me.
entries.literal: "I retracted my hand, gripping a familiar object. After fiddling with it, a rectangular light appeared in front of me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was my phone. The time displayed was {time=21:10}, but I only wanted to look at the date. I navigated deeper into the settings menu to access the current date. Then, I stared at the screen, reading it over and over.
entries.literal: "It was my phone. The time displayed was {time=21:10}, but I only wanted to look at the date. I navigated deeper into the settings menu to access the current date. Then, I stared at the screen, reading it over and over."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: November 30th.
entries.literal: "November 30th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait... that... doesn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "Wait... that... doesn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: November 30th? Did I go fifteen days to the past?
entries.literal: "November 30th? Did I go fifteen days to the past?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That day, at that time, I was already in a coma. I'd fallen from that ceiling up there, and I woke up in a hospital room days later.
entries.literal: "That day, at that time, I was already in a coma. I'd fallen from that ceiling up there, and I woke up in a hospital room days later."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around me, but I didn't see anyone else.
entries.literal: "I looked around me, but I didn't see anyone else."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If that's where I am... has my old body already been taken to the hospital? But why does my whole body hurt? This has never happened before...
entries.literal: "If that's where I am... has my old body already been taken to the hospital? But why does my whole body hurt? This has never happened before..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind felt really clouded. After touching the Sekimeiya, I'd woken up in that sewer. I hadn't instantly appeared there, so I didn't fully understand what had happened.
entries.literal: "My mind felt really clouded. After touching the Sekimeiya, I'd woken up in that sewer. I hadn't instantly appeared there, so I didn't fully understand what had happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could I have overwritten my past self since I touched the Sekimeiya while willing to change the past?
entries.literal: "Could I have overwritten my past self since I touched the Sekimeiya while willing to change the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to stand up, but a sudden, piercing headache made me collapse to the ground. My cheek hit cold stone again, and the faint light slowly vanished.
entries.literal: "I tried to stand up, but a sudden, piercing headache made me collapse to the ground. My cheek hit cold stone again, and the faint light slowly vanished."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to move, but none of my muscles responded. My entire body was sore, like I'd received countless punches. Even the scarce willpower to reopen my eyes left me, as if I'd exhausted all my energy in an instant.
entries.literal: "I wanted to move, but none of my muscles responded. My entire body was sore, like I'd received countless punches. Even the scarce willpower to reopen my eyes left me, as if I'd exhausted all my energy in an instant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My senses dulled—the world darkened—my coat tightly enveloped me—{w} And then it was gone.{w} The cold and pain disappeared too, leaving me floating in the middle of nowhere.
entries.literal: "My senses dulled—the world darkened—my coat tightly enveloped me—{w} And then it was gone.{w} The cold and pain disappeared too, leaving me floating in the middle of nowhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no sound. I was conscious, but I didn't know where I was or why I was there. My awareness became a single, thin stream devoid of thought.
entries.literal: "There was no sound. I was conscious, but I didn't know where I was or why I was there. My awareness became a single, thin stream devoid of thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The stressful events of the tower disappeared, and the tension I'd been holding in for the previous weeks vanished. A great sense of relief washed over me.
entries.literal: "The stressful events of the tower disappeared, and the tension I'd been holding in for the previous weeks vanished. A great sense of relief washed over me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No, I was on the ground in an underground tunnel. That fleeting notion sparked into my brain multiple times, but it was never enough to disrupt the silence.
entries.literal: "No, I was on the ground in an underground tunnel. That fleeting notion sparked into my brain multiple times, but it was never enough to disrupt the silence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The world was consumed by my growing existence until eventually I was the only thing in it. Perhaps it had always been like that. For longer than time itself, I drifted aimlessly.
entries.literal: "The world was consumed by my growing existence until eventually I was the only thing in it. Perhaps it had always been like that. For longer than time itself, I drifted aimlessly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who was I? I was surprised to feel curious about that question. The nothingness had become the only thing I knew, so the tiniest vestige of uncertainty was enough to bring me into disarray.
entries.literal: "Who was I? I was surprised to feel curious about that question. The nothingness had become the only thing I knew, so the tiniest vestige of uncertainty was enough to bring me into disarray."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A distant figure began to take shape in the darkness, and it grew until I became one with it.
entries.literal: "A distant figure began to take shape in the darkness, and it grew until I became one with it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's... me.{w} ...And there's Atsuki.{w} Not from now, but when we were still children. Laughing. Playing. Having fun.
entries.literal: "That's... me.{w} ...And there's Atsuki.{w} Not from now, but when we were still children. Laughing. Playing. Having fun."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hey, Shiroya! Check this out!
entries.literal: "Hey, Shiroya! Check this out!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He handed me a small flower with dark purple petals, contrasting with the white world surrounding us.
entries.literal: "He handed me a small flower with dark purple petals, contrasting with the white world surrounding us."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: So pretty! I'm sure Danny would love it!
entries.literal: "So pretty! I'm sure Danny would love it!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gingerly placed the flower on the stuffed tiger's head, then held it up to my face.
entries.literal: "I gingerly placed the flower on the stuffed tiger's head, then held it up to my face."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wow! It looks so good on you, doesn't it?
entries.literal: "Wow! It looks so good on you, doesn't it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without missing a beat, the boy in front of me spoke up.
entries.literal: "Without missing a beat, the boy in front of me spoke up."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm sure it would look nicer on you.
entries.literal: "I'm sure it would look nicer on you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He took the flower off the toy and began fidgeting with my shirt.{w} When he was done, I couldn't help but smile.
entries.literal: "He took the flower off the toy and began fidgeting with my shirt.{w} When he was done, I couldn't help but smile."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seamlessly, the world changed. We were riding on our bikes down the streets of Yushibana.{w} ...And then we were drinking hot chocolate after playing in the snow. One after another, fond memories played in my vision, and I once again became a child.
entries.literal: "Seamlessly, the world changed. We were riding on our bikes down the streets of Yushibana.{w} ...And then we were drinking hot chocolate after playing in the snow. One after another, fond memories played in my vision, and I once again became a child."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't just experiencing memories, I also created new scenarios. We'd always wanted to hang out in the big cities, and that had become possible.
entries.literal: "I wasn't just experiencing memories, I also created new scenarios. We'd always wanted to hang out in the big cities, and that had become possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The innocent pleasure dimmed softly as the world faded back to nothing. I couldn't object or resist, as if I was a baby on the verge of awareness.
entries.literal: "The innocent pleasure dimmed softly as the world faded back to nothing. I couldn't object or resist, as if I was a baby on the verge of awareness."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After an eternity, my mind reawakened. Another figure appeared far in the distance.
entries.literal: "After an eternity, my mind reawakened. Another figure appeared far in the distance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Miiya.{w} I liked her as a friend, but...{w} When did it get so complicated?{w} She was gone. But even when she was alive, things didn't feel completely right. Myriad moments of before her death flowed into my mind. We were smiling and laughing in all of them, but as I watched us from above, I just wondered if she'd ever actually considered me a friend. We had spent time together, but I wasn't sure what it had meant.
entries.literal: "...Miiya.{w} I liked her as a friend, but...{w} When did it get so complicated?{w} She was gone. But even when she was alive, things didn't feel completely right. Myriad moments of before her death flowed into my mind. We were smiling and laughing in all of them, but as I watched us from above, I just wondered if she'd ever actually considered me a friend. We had spent time together, but I wasn't sure what it had meant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She joined our little world and warped it into something different. Not better, not worse, just different. And her departure made it very different once again.
entries.literal: "She joined our little world and warped it into something different. Not better, not worse, just different. And her departure made it very different once again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had access to a time travel device. We had no idea how it worked, but could we use it to rescue her?{w} Did I... even want to rescue her?
entries.literal: "We had access to a time travel device. We had no idea how it worked, but could we use it to rescue her?{w} Did I... even want to rescue her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course I did. Anything to bring us back to a sense of "normal". Anything to bring back the happier days.
entries.literal: "Of course I did. Anything to bring us back to a sense of \"normal\". Anything to bring back the happier days."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were the days with Miiya better than the days without her? Yes, but... why? Why was it all so messy?
entries.literal: "Were the days with Miiya better than the days without her? Yes, but... why? Why was it all so messy?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My existence folded in on itself. A momentary jolt, a sense of disorientation, running around in the darkness.
entries.literal: "My existence folded in on itself. A momentary jolt, a sense of disorientation, running around in the darkness."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was the Sekimeiya a blessing or a curse? An object that reworked the flow of time. An object that kept us confined in the past...
entries.literal: "Was the Sekimeiya a blessing or a curse? An object that reworked the flow of time. An object that kept us confined in the past..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My senses dulled again. I kept drifting in the dark and gentle abyss. Or maybe I wasn't drifting at all. I realized I didn't know anything.
entries.literal: "My senses dulled again. I kept drifting in the dark and gentle abyss. Or maybe I wasn't drifting at all. I realized I didn't know anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a cold breeze as the darkness began to lift. Part of me wanted to stay there forever, wrapped in black.
entries.literal: "I felt a cold breeze as the darkness began to lift. Part of me wanted to stay there forever, wrapped in black."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sensation of possessing a body gradually came back to me. My limbs existed again.{w} In an instant, I became acutely aware of a pain in my cheek. I was resting on a pebble.
entries.literal: "The sensation of possessing a body gradually came back to me. My limbs existed again.{w} In an instant, I became acutely aware of a pain in my cheek. I was resting on a pebble."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around me, the faint light illuminating the sewer. My eyes were wet, almost as if I'd been crying.
entries.literal: "I looked around me, the faint light illuminating the sewer. My eyes were wet, almost as if I'd been crying."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm... still underground. What just happened?
entries.literal: "I'm... still underground. What just happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My head throbbed relentlessly while I came to terms with the realization that I'd fallen unconscious. After so long, I tried to move my arm and received a faint response.
entries.literal: "My head throbbed relentlessly while I came to terms with the realization that I'd fallen unconscious. After so long, I tried to move my arm and received a faint response."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right... I just traveled from the tower. It's November 30th... Again.
entries.literal: "Right... I just traveled from the tower. It's November 30th... Again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I exhaled deeply, pulling myself together. That dream, if it could be called that, was almost like the coma I'd been in once already, a haze of half-concepts. It was almost frightening how lost I'd gotten in it.{w} I remembered fragments of it, but the question of whether I wanted to save Miiya was still vividly present in my mind.
entries.literal: "I exhaled deeply, pulling myself together. That dream, if it could be called that, was almost like the coma I'd been in once already, a haze of half-concepts. It was almost frightening how lost I'd gotten in it.{w} I remembered fragments of it, but the question of whether I wanted to save Miiya was still vividly present in my mind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Of course I want Miiya to live. What kind of question is that? And what would Atsuki do without her?
entries.literal: "...Of course I want Miiya to live. What kind of question is that? And what would Atsuki do without her?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I rested for a bit longer, trying to drive off those intrusive thoughts, until I was eventually able to sit up. I was still lost in the dark, so I pulled out my phone and looked at the time. It was {time=21:34.}
entries.literal: "I rested for a bit longer, trying to drive off those intrusive thoughts, until I was eventually able to sit up. I was still lost in the dark, so I pulled out my phone and looked at the time. It was {time=21:34.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's only been about thirty minutes...
entries.literal: "It's only been about thirty minutes..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I laboriously stood up and took some mindless steps. I couldn't feel anything around me except the hard concrete. I supposed it wasn't a sewer that I was in since it didn't really smell at all, but I had no idea what it was.
entries.literal: "I laboriously stood up and took some mindless steps. I couldn't feel anything around me except the hard concrete. I supposed it wasn't a sewer that I was in since it didn't really smell at all, but I had no idea what it was."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait... What am I supposed to do now? Can I really change the past? What the hell is this? Did I appear two weeks into the past, but mere minutes too late to save Miiya? It can't be, right...? Why would I have gone so far back?
entries.literal: "Wait... What am I supposed to do now? Can I really change the past? What the hell is this? Did I appear two weeks into the past, but mere minutes too late to save Miiya? It can't be, right...? Why would I have gone so far back?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Completely perplexed, I walked forward, toward the darkness. It wasn't possible to reach the hole above me, so I had to hope I could walk out of there.
entries.literal: "Completely perplexed, I walked forward, toward the darkness. It wasn't possible to reach the hole above me, so I had to hope I could walk out of there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a few steps, I ran into a wall. The darkness should've been terrifying, but I wasn't scared. I needed to get out of there and hope I could find out where I was.
entries.literal: "After a few steps, I ran into a wall. The darkness should've been terrifying, but I wasn't scared. I needed to get out of there and hope I could find out where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I flipped open my phone, but the light from the screen wasn't enough to illuminate the path ahead. After feeling the space, I knew there were two tunnels in front of me, one much larger than the other.
entries.literal: "I flipped open my phone, but the light from the screen wasn't enough to illuminate the path ahead. After feeling the space, I knew there were two tunnels in front of me, one much larger than the other."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could only go through one, so I kept walking toward the one that seemed wide and dry.
entries.literal: "I could only go through one, so I kept walking toward the one that seemed wide and dry."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I can change the past... can I prevent the attack in the tower from happening? I can at least prevent Atsuki and myself from going there, but would this really work?
entries.literal: "If I can change the past... can I prevent the attack in the tower from happening? I can at least prevent Atsuki and myself from going there, but would this really work?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What would happen to me? I've already thought of this, but if I change the past, would I remain in a world with another version of myself?
entries.literal: "What would happen to me? I've already thought of this, but if I change the past, would I remain in a world with another version of myself?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And if I can do that, should I? Instead of trying to travel back one more time and save Miiya in the first place?
entries.literal: "And if I can do that, should I? Instead of trying to travel back one more time and save Miiya in the first place?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}The darkness had become absolute. On that day, the Sekimeiya must've been somewhere. As Ashiya's announcement had already been made public, they were probably keeping it somewhere in the tower.
entries.literal: "...{w}The darkness had become absolute. On that day, the Sekimeiya must've been somewhere. As Ashiya's announcement had already been made public, they were probably keeping it somewhere in the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked for minutes, every individual step feeling surreal, and the bright image of the screen frozen in my mind. November 30th...
entries.literal: "I walked for minutes, every individual step feeling surreal, and the bright image of the screen frozen in my mind. November 30th..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept going, hugging the wall next to me. At one point, the path began to slant up, making every step tougher.
entries.literal: "I kept going, hugging the wall next to me. At one point, the path began to slant up, making every step tougher."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...How do I get out of here? Should there be a ladder somewhere?
entries.literal: "...How do I get out of here? Should there be a ladder somewhere?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For an entire day, I'd grown used to hearing the echo of my own footsteps with no other sound. I wasn't in that tower anymore, but the sensation was identical.
entries.literal: "For an entire day, I'd grown used to hearing the echo of my own footsteps with no other sound. I wasn't in that tower anymore, but the sensation was identical."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slowly increased my pace. I was so close to finally being outside again.
entries.literal: "I slowly increased my pace. I was so close to finally being outside again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The tunnel was a straight path, seemingly unending. After walking for a while, I started to feel a little desperate.
entries.literal: "The tunnel was a straight path, seemingly unending. After walking for a while, I started to feel a little desperate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was I going toward an exit, or was I completely lost? I couldn't see anything that distinguished where I was.
entries.literal: "Was I going toward an exit, or was I completely lost? I couldn't see anything that distinguished where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was too dedicated to my path to turn around and go the other way. It almost felt like there would be a monster waiting behind me if I did. I could only keep moving, almost like I was in a dream of an ever-lengthening corridor.
entries.literal: "I was too dedicated to my path to turn around and go the other way. It almost felt like there would be a monster waiting behind me if I did. I could only keep moving, almost like I was in a dream of an ever-lengthening corridor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, that sensation ended. I located a ladder and climbed out of the channel's end. Around me was a grassy field covered in snow, the sky firmly situated above me. It was real.
entries.literal: "Finally, that sensation ended. I located a ladder and climbed out of the channel's end. Around me was a grassy field covered in snow, the sky firmly situated above me. It was real."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't fathom the image. In front of me, I saw Yushibana, entirely still. A chilly breeze forced me to shrug my coat higher and cover my neck.
entries.literal: "I couldn't fathom the image. In front of me, I saw Yushibana, entirely still. A chilly breeze forced me to shrug my coat higher and cover my neck."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been trapped for hours in a building I could see the faintest outline of on the horizon, but that wasn't all. Seeing Yushibana below me brought a relief I hadn't known was possible. Seeing that I'd been released, all my questions fell away.
entries.literal: "I'd been trapped for hours in a building I could see the faintest outline of on the horizon, but that wasn't all. Seeing Yushibana below me brought a relief I hadn't known was possible. Seeing that I'd been released, all my questions fell away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know why I was atop that hill or what had happened to me. All I knew in that moment was a soaring sense of liberty. I was actually free.
entries.literal: "I didn't know why I was atop that hill or what had happened to me. All I knew in that moment was a soaring sense of liberty. I was actually free."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked inside my purse again and saw keys.
entries.literal: "I looked inside my purse again and saw keys."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: These belong to my apartment. They're not Atsuki's.{w} ...The tickets aren't here either.
entries.literal: "These belong to my apartment. They're not Atsuki's.{w} ...The tickets aren't here either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pushed off the snow on the stone that formed the tunnel and sat on it. Every part of my body still hurt, especially my back.
entries.literal: "I pushed off the snow on the stone that formed the tunnel and sat on it. Every part of my body still hurt, especially my back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was breathing calmly, observing the silent town. From there, I could see the entirety of Yushibana. Close to me was the school I'd gone to and a familiar park next to it.
entries.literal: "I was breathing calmly, observing the silent town. From there, I could see the entirety of Yushibana. Close to me was the school I'd gone to and a familiar park next to it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way to really be sure, but I assumed that the tunnel I'd gone through was part of some kind of drainage system. It sloped down the hill into the center of town, and I couldn't think of any other function for it than collecting water that would otherwise flood.
entries.literal: "There was no way to really be sure, but I assumed that the tunnel I'd gone through was part of some kind of drainage system. It sloped down the hill into the center of town, and I couldn't think of any other function for it than collecting water that would otherwise flood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It didn't really matter. I was out. The drainage channel, or whatever it was, hadn't swept me away or drowned me. That long tunnel was a path to salvation. I didn't know the true state of the world I was looking down on, but all by myself, I was finally able to experience peace.
entries.literal: "...It didn't really matter. I was out. The drainage channel, or whatever it was, hadn't swept me away or drowned me. That long tunnel was a path to salvation. I didn't know the true state of the world I was looking down on, but all by myself, I was finally able to experience peace."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Forcing myself to move, I stood up and began to descend a thin path that started from the tunnel.
entries.literal: "Forcing myself to move, I stood up and began to descend a thin path that started from the tunnel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sensed my boots pressing on the snow until I was down the hill. Upon turning around, I saw the trail of footprints that I'd left. ...As bizarre as it was, I looked at them as proof that I was really there.
entries.literal: "I sensed my boots pressing on the snow until I was down the hill. Upon turning around, I saw the trail of footprints that I'd left. ...As bizarre as it was, I looked at them as proof that I was really there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My phone showed {time=21:48}, and I was behind my school, where I'd rarely ever been at such a time.
entries.literal: "My phone showed {time=21:48}, and I was behind my school, where I'd rarely ever been at such a time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Much farther in the distance, I could see the top of the only structure that rivaled Ashiya Tower's height.
entries.literal: "Much farther in the distance, I could see the top of the only structure that rivaled Ashiya Tower's height."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The hospital... Is that where I am right now? Or am I being brought there?
entries.literal: "The hospital... Is that where I am right now? Or am I being brought there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't comprehend yet how the travel had worked, but I walked around the school and found myself in the park we'd been at that very day.
entries.literal: "I couldn't comprehend yet how the travel had worked, but I walked around the school and found myself in the park we'd been at that very day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started to hear faint voices around me and saw dark silhouettes next to one of the benches. Of course, I wasn't alone in the town.
entries.literal: "I started to hear faint voices around me and saw dark silhouettes next to one of the benches. Of course, I wasn't alone in the town."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unaware of where I was headed, I followed the steps we'd taken at a time that felt like a distant past.
entries.literal: "Unaware of where I was headed, I followed the steps we'd taken at a time that felt like a distant past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Tall, round lights illuminated the rustic part of Yushibana. That day, we'd just happened to end up at a modest shop, but the present me deliberately walked to it.
entries.literal: "Tall, round lights illuminated the rustic part of Yushibana. That day, we'd just happened to end up at a modest shop, but the present me deliberately walked to it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What will happen if they see me? There's gotta be someone there. ...That's bound to change the past, right?
entries.literal: "What will happen if they see me? There's gotta be someone there. ...That's bound to change the past, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remembered all the narrow streets. No light could be seen through almost any window, and most of the footprints still on the ground ended at various doors.
entries.literal: "I remembered all the narrow streets. No light could be seen through almost any window, and most of the footprints still on the ground ended at various doors."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked from the final turn and stared at where the shop had been.
entries.literal: "I looked from the final turn and stared at where the shop had been."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In front of the door were two people talking to each other. One of them wore a suit, and the other wore casual clothes for the cold.
entries.literal: "In front of the door were two people talking to each other. One of them wore a suit, and the other wore casual clothes for the cold."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't recognize either of them.
entries.literal: "I don't recognize either of them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I step forward? What would they ask me, and how would I answer anything?
entries.literal: "Should I step forward? What would they ask me, and how would I answer anything?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I chose to stay still. If the past could be changed, that wasn't the way to do it.
entries.literal: "I chose to stay still. If the past could be changed, that wasn't the way to do it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to them was the window that had once grabbed our attention. I couldn't hear anything they were saying, but they hadn't sensed me either.
entries.literal: "Next to them was the window that had once grabbed our attention. I couldn't hear anything they were saying, but they hadn't sensed me either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Not long after, the man in a suit walked away. The other person saw him off and stayed where he'd been. That gave me the chance to look at his face.
entries.literal: "Not long after, the man in a suit walked away. The other person saw him off and stayed where he'd been. That gave me the chance to look at his face."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh... It's the owner of the shop.
entries.literal: "Oh... It's the owner of the shop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other man was walking toward me, so I backed off toward another path to avoid being seen.
entries.literal: "The other man was walking toward me, so I backed off toward another path to avoid being seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suddenly bumped into a car camouflaged by the dark. In the sky, the moon was hardly visible, not helping things. Fortunately, the snow on the ground told me where I was every step.
entries.literal: "I suddenly bumped into a car camouflaged by the dark. In the sky, the moon was hardly visible, not helping things. Fortunately, the snow on the ground told me where I was every step."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I seemed to be the only person there, so I kept going until I arrived at a road full of wheel marks.
entries.literal: "I seemed to be the only person there, so I kept going until I arrived at a road full of wheel marks."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The streets were wider, and a couple walked by me. After so long, there was life around me, and the strain on my shoulders slowly faded away.
entries.literal: "The streets were wider, and a couple walked by me. After so long, there was life around me, and the strain on my shoulders slowly faded away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Should I just go home?
entries.literal: "...Should I just go home?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Atsuki was also brought to the hospital, and I was there for a week. I have the keys, so I really can just do that.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was also brought to the hospital, and I was there for a week. I have the keys, so I really can just do that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For what purpose was I in the past, standing next to a lonesome streetlight? I knew I had to do something. I could change history... But sleep was the only thing on my mind. My body still felt battered and weakened.
entries.literal: "For what purpose was I in the past, standing next to a lonesome streetlight? I knew I had to do something. I could change history... But sleep was the only thing on my mind. My body still felt battered and weakened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Getting to my bed was my priority. Everything else had become a background concern, as there was nothing I could do right then.
entries.literal: "Getting to my bed was my priority. Everything else had become a background concern, as there was nothing I could do right then."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why am I so tired? I feel different from when I was in the tower. ...Is it because this is how I was at this time on November 30th?
entries.literal: "Why am I so tired? I feel different from when I was in the tower. ...Is it because this is how I was at this time on November 30th?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My apartment was close by, and I needed to rest. At that time of night, nobody should've been there.
entries.literal: "My apartment was close by, and I needed to rest. At that time of night, nobody should've been there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cold was starting to get to me, so I tightened my coat around my shoulders as I walked. Taking my time, I observed my surroundings as I walked, all of them covered in the same white layer of snow.
entries.literal: "The cold was starting to get to me, so I tightened my coat around my shoulders as I walked. Taking my time, I observed my surroundings as I walked, all of them covered in the same white layer of snow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What will I do...? I can only hope that I'll understand everything better tomorrow, but I should have enough time to think about it. If I'm right... my parents aren't even in Japan, I'm about to spend a week in the hospital, and then I'll go to live with Atsuki. I can just be at my apartment until the 15th comes again.
entries.literal: "What will I do...? I can only hope that I'll understand everything better tomorrow, but I should have enough time to think about it. If I'm right... my parents aren't even in Japan, I'm about to spend a week in the hospital, and then I'll go to live with Atsuki. I can just be at my apartment until the 15th comes again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But then what? Should I try to make us not go to the tower? How would I attempt to prevent the attack from happening? Even if Atsuki and I don't go, there are people who will die.{w} And in both cases, I'm giving up on going to the past again to save Miiya. If the past can be changed, I can't just leave her to die.
entries.literal: "But then what? Should I try to make us not go to the tower? How would I attempt to prevent the attack from happening? Even if Atsuki and I don't go, there are people who will die.{w} And in both cases, I'm giving up on going to the past again to save Miiya. If the past can be changed, I can't just leave her to die."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But this is still really scary. At the time I change the past, I'll be stuck in a world with another self of mine, and I won't be the original.{w} The me that Atsuki saw in the event room... will it really be me? Will I decide that I don't want to change the past just so that I keep living in a world where I'm the only version of myself? I wouldn't do that, would I?
entries.literal: "But this is still really scary. At the time I change the past, I'll be stuck in a world with another self of mine, and I won't be the original.{w} The me that Atsuki saw in the event room... will it really be me? Will I decide that I don't want to change the past just so that I keep living in a world where I'm the only version of myself? I wouldn't do that, would I?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Arriving home, I saw a few people talking to each other. They had no idea I was from the future. Of course, nobody knew about the Sekimeiya's powers yet.
entries.literal: "Arriving home, I saw a few people talking to each other. They had no idea I was from the future. Of course, nobody knew about the Sekimeiya's powers yet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...How is that actually possible? The Sekimeiya has already been announced as a discovery, so why will they let the public touch it with what it can do? Did Ashiya not know about that? I have no idea where it even came from.
entries.literal: "...How is that actually possible? The Sekimeiya has already been announced as a discovery, so why will they let the public touch it with what it can do? Did Ashiya not know about that? I have no idea where it even came from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the past, all those questions still had no answers. I turned toward a narrower street full of apartment blocks and looked far ahead.
entries.literal: "In the past, all those questions still had no answers. I turned toward a narrower street full of apartment blocks and looked far ahead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped in the middle of it and went up a white, metallic staircase. On the way, I took my keys out and walked to a door below a "C" plate.
entries.literal: "I stopped in the middle of it and went up a white, metallic staircase. On the way, I took my keys out and walked to a door below a \"C\" plate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood in front of it and tried to sharpen my hearing.
entries.literal: "I stood in front of it and tried to sharpen my hearing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can't hear anything...
entries.literal: "I can't hear anything..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A little nervous, I inserted the key into the keyhole and kept it there for a while. Finally, I decided to turn it, making little noise.
entries.literal: "A little nervous, I inserted the key into the keyhole and kept it there for a while. Finally, I decided to turn it, making little noise."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I try to be silent? If I'm somehow in here, do I want to not be heard? What would I even do if I see myself? I can't go anywhere else.
entries.literal: "Should I try to be silent? If I'm somehow in here, do I want to not be heard? What would I even do if I see myself? I can't go anywhere else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door slowly.
entries.literal: "I opened the door slowly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The faint light of the night illuminated the way in, and I took a hesitant step forward.
entries.literal: "The faint light of the night illuminated the way in, and I took a hesitant step forward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naturally, I knew where the light switch was, so I reached out to it while I glanced around. When the ceiling lit up, I saw the same entrance I'd seen countless times before.
entries.literal: "Naturally, I knew where the light switch was, so I reached out to it while I glanced around. When the ceiling lit up, I saw the same entrance I'd seen countless times before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to the door, I saw my reflection in the mirror. I looked a lot better than I'd imagined, probably because the body I was in hadn't made it to December yet.
entries.literal: "Next to the door, I saw my reflection in the mirror. I looked a lot better than I'd imagined, probably because the body I was in hadn't made it to December yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed the door and stood in the middle of the room, not much warmer. I still felt uneasy, so instead of taking off my shoes, I opened the door to the living room.
entries.literal: "I closed the door and stood in the middle of the room, not much warmer. I still felt uneasy, so instead of taking off my shoes, I opened the door to the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a large window with its blinds closed, and in the center of the room, a wooden table on top of a green carpet. Everything looked like it had when I'd left on the 30th.
entries.literal: "There was a large window with its blinds closed, and in the center of the room, a wooden table on top of a green carpet. Everything looked like it had when I'd left on the 30th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really was at home. There was an old TV on top of a low stand that I rarely used due to the poor signal, and colored cushions were scattered all over the floor.
entries.literal: "I really was at home. There was an old TV on top of a low stand that I rarely used due to the poor signal, and colored cushions were scattered all over the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to me was the door to the kitchen. In the sink were the few dishes I hadn't washed, and in a corner was the laundry I hadn't finished. That day, I'd been really looking forward to meeting Atsuki and Miiya, and although we hadn't ended up doing much, I'd been excited to go.
entries.literal: "Next to me was the door to the kitchen. In the sink were the few dishes I hadn't washed, and in a corner was the laundry I hadn't finished. That day, I'd been really looking forward to meeting Atsuki and Miiya, and although we hadn't ended up doing much, I'd been excited to go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I walked back and opened the other door in the entryway.
entries.literal: "...I walked back and opened the other door in the entryway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After lighting up the short hallway, I stepped to the first door. My bedroom was behind it.
entries.literal: "After lighting up the short hallway, I stepped to the first door. My bedroom was behind it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Farther back were the last three doors. One led to my parents' bedroom, the other to the bathroom, and the last was a guest room with a small bed.
entries.literal: "Farther back were the last three doors. One led to my parents' bedroom, the other to the bathroom, and the last was a guest room with a small bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been storing things in the guest room since it'd been unused for so long, cramming a bookcase full. Recently, my drive to read had dropped off, but I still kept my favorites front and center.
entries.literal: "I'd been storing things in the guest room since it'd been unused for so long, cramming a bookcase full. Recently, my drive to read had dropped off, but I still kept my favorites front and center."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing was out of place. Everything I'd put in there hadn't moved even slightly.
entries.literal: "Nothing was out of place. Everything I'd put in there hadn't moved even slightly."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There really is nobody here.
entries.literal: "There really is nobody here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the same modest apartment I'd always lived in, but it seemed like I'd last been there a very long time in the past.{w} I'd left a trail of slick, snowy footprints, so I went to the entrance and dropped my boots beside the door.
entries.literal: "It was the same modest apartment I'd always lived in, but it seemed like I'd last been there a very long time in the past.{w} I'd left a trail of slick, snowy footprints, so I went to the entrance and dropped my boots beside the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered my bedroom and draped my wet coat on a chair. My headache had been weakening, but many of my muscles were still sore.
entries.literal: "I entered my bedroom and draped my wet coat on a chair. My headache had been weakening, but many of my muscles were still sore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't even tell if I was hungry, and my thirst was dwarfed by how tired I was. I left my purse next to the bed and fell on it with the clothes I'd been wearing.
entries.literal: "I couldn't even tell if I was hungry, and my thirst was dwarfed by how tired I was. I left my purse next to the bed and fell on it with the clothes I'd been wearing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed my eyes on top of the large pillow and gradually wormed my way under the blankets.
entries.literal: "I closed my eyes on top of the large pillow and gradually wormed my way under the blankets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was exhausted, but I didn't fall asleep immediately. There were too many things I had to think about.
entries.literal: "I was exhausted, but I didn't fall asleep immediately. There were too many things I had to think about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd just spent more than twelve hours sealed inside Ashiya Tower, so the sensation of my bed was far beyond welcome. However, it seemed I had suddenly arrived on the day where everything started.
entries.literal: "I'd just spent more than twelve hours sealed inside Ashiya Tower, so the sensation of my bed was far beyond welcome. However, it seemed I had suddenly arrived on the day where everything started."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the distance of the town must've been Atsuki, crying about the possibility of losing his two closest friends. Somewhere else, other people were surely thinking about the attack they'd orchestrate on December 15th.
entries.literal: "In the distance of the town must've been Atsuki, crying about the possibility of losing his two closest friends. Somewhere else, other people were surely thinking about the attack they'd orchestrate on December 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I soon felt like I should've turned on the heater, but I couldn't get out of bed. My mind went through most of the events I'd been caught up in, and I still didn't reach a single conclusion. I had wanted to change the past, but comfortable as I was beneath two blankets, that was comparable to moving a mountain by hand.
entries.literal: "I soon felt like I should've turned on the heater, but I couldn't get out of bed. My mind went through most of the events I'd been caught up in, and I still didn't reach a single conclusion. I had wanted to change the past, but comfortable as I was beneath two blankets, that was comparable to moving a mountain by hand."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh—
entries.literal: "Huh—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A sound reached my covered ears and woke me up. I was frightened at first, but I quickly realized it had come from outside.
entries.literal: "A sound reached my covered ears and woke me up. I was frightened at first, but I quickly realized it had come from outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And it didn't stop.
entries.literal: "And it didn't stop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Fireworks?
entries.literal: "...Fireworks?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hearing fireworks in Yushibana was rare, but it was the start of the holiday season.
entries.literal: "Hearing fireworks in Yushibana was rare, but it was the start of the holiday season."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I removed my head from under the blankets and paid attention to the sound. While it wasn't close to where I was, brief sparks of light could be seen through the window.
entries.literal: "I removed my head from under the blankets and paid attention to the sound. While it wasn't close to where I was, brief sparks of light could be seen through the window."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew the air was still chilly, but I braced myself and pushed the blankets aside.
entries.literal: "I knew the air was still chilly, but I braced myself and pushed the blankets aside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat up and looked at my phone. It was {time=1:06.}{w} When I looked behind me, I saw the large screen of glass turning orange momentarily, reflecting the distant light.
entries.literal: "I sat up and looked at my phone. It was {time=1:06.}{w} When I looked behind me, I saw the large screen of glass turning orange momentarily, reflecting the distant light."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...They really are fireworks. I never hear them here because the police always shut them down, but I bet someone sneaked some into town and wanted to celebrate the holidays.
entries.literal: "...They really are fireworks. I never hear them here because the police always shut them down, but I bet someone sneaked some into town and wanted to celebrate the holidays."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see...
entries.literal: "I see..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't help but feel as if they were welcoming me, although I knew the truth was far from that.
entries.literal: "I couldn't help but feel as if they were welcoming me, although I knew the truth was far from that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was in a coma, so I'd never truly heard or seen those fireworks. There was nothing I wanted more than to view them with Atsuki and Miiya, but that couldn't happen.
entries.literal: "I was in a coma, so I'd never truly heard or seen those fireworks. There was nothing I wanted more than to view them with Atsuki and Miiya, but that couldn't happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would it be possible to change the past so that it could?
entries.literal: "Would it be possible to change the past so that it could?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The past is really changing, though.
entries.literal: "The past is really changing, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had already been changed. That I was seeing those fireworks was the proof.
entries.literal: "It had already been changed. That I was seeing those fireworks was the proof."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was allowed to live through what I'd missed out on—the two weeks where I hadn't lived.
entries.literal: "I was allowed to live through what I'd missed out on—the two weeks where I hadn't lived."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I simply stared at the distant lights. My eyelids were drooping, but I didn't want to stop watching.
entries.literal: "I simply stared at the distant lights. My eyelids were drooping, but I didn't want to stop watching."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The fireworks didn't last much longer. After a few minutes, the stronger ones went off, and they all calmly ceased.
entries.literal: "The fireworks didn't last much longer. After a few minutes, the stronger ones went off, and they all calmly ceased."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dropped back onto the bed, still with no energy to turn on the heater or put on warmer clothes. That time, I fell asleep almost instantly.
entries.literal: "I dropped back onto the bed, still with no energy to turn on the heater or put on warmer clothes. That time, I fell asleep almost instantly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened my eyes.
entries.literal: "I opened my eyes."

entries.text: Fresh Start
entries.literal: "Fresh Start"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't in the attic. I was in my own bedroom, facing the pillow I'd evidently rolled off of.
entries.literal: "I wasn't in the attic. I was in my own bedroom, facing the pillow I'd evidently rolled off of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The whole room was lit, sunlight streaming through the window. With my face still under the blankets, I closed my eyes again, not yet wanting to face the cold.
entries.literal: "The whole room was lit, sunlight streaming through the window. With my face still under the blankets, I closed my eyes again, not yet wanting to face the cold."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The first day of December...{w} Miiya's not here anymore, I'm in the hospital, and Atsuki's probably at his house.{w} Or, I guess I'm actually in my bed.
entries.literal: "The first day of December...{w} Miiya's not here anymore, I'm in the hospital, and Atsuki's probably at his house.{w} Or, I guess I'm actually in my bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I vividly remembered parts of a dream I'd just had. We'd all still been in the tower, and while the details escaped my grasp, it had entailed a messy conflict with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I vividly remembered parts of a dream I'd just had. We'd all still been in the tower, and while the details escaped my grasp, it had entailed a messy conflict with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, I realized I'd been lying in bed for a while without doing anything.{w} ...It had happened so quickly. It felt like just minutes ago I'd been waiting with everyone in the lobby.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, I realized I'd been lying in bed for a while without doing anything.{w} ...It had happened so quickly. It felt like just minutes ago I'd been waiting with everyone in the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been distressed in the tower, so why was I acting like nothing had happened? Was it just because I'd traveled to the past? Because there were two blank weeks ahead of me, and there was no reason to go over things I'd worried about once already? That logic didn't make a lot of sense.
entries.literal: "I'd been distressed in the tower, so why was I acting like nothing had happened? Was it just because I'd traveled to the past? Because there were two blank weeks ahead of me, and there was no reason to go over things I'd worried about once already? That logic didn't make a lot of sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd gone to the past to change it, and I hadn't known how far I'd go. Since I was in the hospital at the time, as long as I went to Atsuki's house, I'd be changing the past. If he saw two versions of myself, he would have to believe anything I said.
entries.literal: "I'd gone to the past to change it, and I hadn't known how far I'd go. Since I was in the hospital at the time, as long as I went to Atsuki's house, I'd be changing the past. If he saw two versions of myself, he would have to believe anything I said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I didn't rush out of bed, and I probably knew the real reason why. It was sheer burnout.
entries.literal: "But I didn't rush out of bed, and I probably knew the real reason why. It was sheer burnout."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In a way, it was similar to how I'd felt before meeting up with Atsuki and Miiya, the period when I had absolutely no idea what to do with myself. I'd gone nowhere and done nothing for an amount of time I couldn't measure. I had lost track of days, existing solely in my apartment.
entries.literal: "In a way, it was similar to how I'd felt before meeting up with Atsuki and Miiya, the period when I had absolutely no idea what to do with myself. I'd gone nowhere and done nothing for an amount of time I couldn't measure. I had lost track of days, existing solely in my apartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had been a major depressive episode at the very least, but getting back together with not only one friend, but two, was the remedy for that. That was what I'd thought, anyway.
entries.literal: "It had been a major depressive episode at the very least, but getting back together with not only one friend, but two, was the remedy for that. That was what I'd thought, anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Miiya had died, and I'd entered a coma. If I'd been living in a haze before, it evolved into a thick fog at that point. I was a shell of a person for a while, thinking almost exclusively about dangerously dark things. I was grateful that Atsuki hadn't given up on me entirely for everything I'd put him through.
entries.literal: "...Miiya had died, and I'd entered a coma. If I'd been living in a haze before, it evolved into a thick fog at that point. I was a shell of a person for a while, thinking almost exclusively about dangerously dark things. I was grateful that Atsuki hadn't given up on me entirely for everything I'd put him through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it was a distinctly different situation. Rather than falling deeper into dysfunction, I had obtained a goal after going so far into the past. An abstract one, but a goal nonetheless.
entries.literal: "But it was a distinctly different situation. Rather than falling deeper into dysfunction, I had obtained a goal after going so far into the past. An abstract one, but a goal nonetheless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept lying there until my remaining tiredness dissipated. I knew I had to do something, but I didn't know what.
entries.literal: "I kept lying there until my remaining tiredness dissipated. I knew I had to do something, but I didn't know what."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gathered the strength to sit up and looked at the window. Going off the strong light, I had slept for quite a few hours.
entries.literal: "I gathered the strength to sit up and looked at the window. Going off the strong light, I had slept for quite a few hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My purse was next to the bed, so I grabbed my phone.
entries.literal: "My purse was next to the bed, so I grabbed my phone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: {time=12:43.}..{w} It's late.
entries.literal: "{time=12:43.}..{w} It's late."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As the buildings in Yushibana weren't very tall, I was able to see a good deal of the snow-covered town from my room. It wasn't snowing, and the sky was pretty clear. From behind the window, I felt as if I was aware of the fate of the entire town, even though what I knew was only related to a modest fraction of all those buildings.
entries.literal: "As the buildings in Yushibana weren't very tall, I was able to see a good deal of the snow-covered town from my room. It wasn't snowing, and the sky was pretty clear. From behind the window, I felt as if I was aware of the fate of the entire town, even though what I knew was only related to a modest fraction of all those buildings."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The icy air quickly got to me, so I went to the hallway, carefully walking on the wooden floor so that I wouldn't stagger.
entries.literal: "The icy air quickly got to me, so I went to the hallway, carefully walking on the wooden floor so that I wouldn't stagger."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached the heater, which I'd normally only turn on during the nights since my parents were the ones who paid for my expenses and I didn't want to risk upsetting them.
entries.literal: "I reached the heater, which I'd normally only turn on during the nights since my parents were the ones who paid for my expenses and I didn't want to risk upsetting them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This will be fine, right? Nobody's supposed to be living here, but I doubt it'll be noticed that gas and water were used.
entries.literal: "This will be fine, right? Nobody's supposed to be living here, but I doubt it'll be noticed that gas and water were used."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hesitated a little, but I needed to get rid of the oppressive cold. Seconds after I turned the heater on, it let out a buzzing sound from the pipes running behind the wall.
entries.literal: "I hesitated a little, but I needed to get rid of the oppressive cold. Seconds after I turned the heater on, it let out a buzzing sound from the pipes running behind the wall."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess even if someone does notice, it'll be at the end of this month or maybe after that. It should be okay.
entries.literal: "I guess even if someone does notice, it'll be at the end of this month or maybe after that. It should be okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had a water bottle on the table. I never liked drinking tap water, so I always spent a bit of my monthly money on bottled water. Filters just weren't enough.
entries.literal: "I had a water bottle on the table. I never liked drinking tap water, so I always spent a bit of my monthly money on bottled water. Filters just weren't enough."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't bother pouring it in a glass. The hours I'd spent in Ashiya Tower no longer applied to my body, but I was extremely thirsty.
entries.literal: "I didn't bother pouring it in a glass. The hours I'd spent in Ashiya Tower no longer applied to my body, but I was extremely thirsty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To avoid grocery shopping too often, I usually had a cabinet packed with supplies. I would refill it at the beginning of every month, which was why it was almost empty. I looked inside and grabbed a bag of mixed nuts. As expected, they weren't very good, as they had sat in the cabinet all month, but I ate all of them almost instantly due to how hungry I was.
entries.literal: "To avoid grocery shopping too often, I usually had a cabinet packed with supplies. I would refill it at the beginning of every month, which was why it was almost empty. I looked inside and grabbed a bag of mixed nuts. As expected, they weren't very good, as they had sat in the cabinet all month, but I ate all of them almost instantly due to how hungry I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the living room, almost like it was routine. The blinds were keeping the space dim, but I rarely bothered raising them.
entries.literal: "I walked to the living room, almost like it was routine. The blinds were keeping the space dim, but I rarely bothered raising them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After going to the bathroom, I stood in front of my wardrobe, wondering which clothes to change into. I'd lived alone for many months already, so I started the day as if it were a normal one.
entries.literal: "After going to the bathroom, I stood in front of my wardrobe, wondering which clothes to change into. I'd lived alone for many months already, so I started the day as if it were a normal one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it worth trying to make it seem like nobody's been here?
entries.literal: "Is it worth trying to make it seem like nobody's been here?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't know how, but if the past can be changed, I'm planning on doing it. There shouldn't be a huge need to hide my stay.
entries.literal: "I don't know how, but if the past can be changed, I'm planning on doing it. There shouldn't be a huge need to hide my stay."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Or is that right? Could it be that while I was in the hospital and at Atsuki's house, another version of me was already living here? There's no way, is there? That would mean that everything will happen as I remember it.
entries.literal: "...Or is that right? Could it be that while I was in the hospital and at Atsuki's house, another version of me was already living here? There's no way, is there? That would mean that everything will happen as I remember it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If the past will only change if I consciously make it, it shouldn't matter whether I was already living here in the reality I know. After all, I didn't come home for the purpose of changing the past.
entries.literal: "If the past will only change if I consciously make it, it shouldn't matter whether I was already living here in the reality I know. After all, I didn't come home for the purpose of changing the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If it's like this, and I intend to say that up until I decide to change history, everything could play out exactly as it once did, it should be confirmation that I'll be able to safely stay here until the 15th.
entries.literal: "If it's like this, and I intend to say that up until I decide to change history, everything could play out exactly as it once did, it should be confirmation that I'll be able to safely stay here until the 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's nothing that makes it an impossibility, so it could be that I always lived here and that I'm not changing the past yet. My parents never called me to say that someone was living at my place, and I never learned about it otherwise before the 15th, so I can secretly stay here, right? No contradictions.
entries.literal: "There's nothing that makes it an impossibility, so it could be that I always lived here and that I'm not changing the past yet. My parents never called me to say that someone was living at my place, and I never learned about it otherwise before the 15th, so I can secretly stay here, right? No contradictions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no clue if it would work like that, but worrying about it felt pointless. I chose some casual clothes to put on and stepped back to the living room.
entries.literal: "I had no clue if it would work like that, but worrying about it felt pointless. I chose some casual clothes to put on and stepped back to the living room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}And now what?
entries.literal: "...{w}And now what?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though I had spent a long while living alone in that apartment, I'd always had plenty of things to think about, all of which I'd ended up pushing aside.
entries.literal: "Even though I had spent a long while living alone in that apartment, I'd always had plenty of things to think about, all of which I'd ended up pushing aside."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wouldn't, by chance, remember a lottery winning combination, would I...?
entries.literal: "I wouldn't, by chance, remember a lottery winning combination, would I...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The only reason why I hadn't thought that seriously was because I knew I didn't. Sai had mentioned using the Sekimeiya to win the lottery, but it wasn't actually that crazy of an idea.
entries.literal: "...The only reason why I hadn't thought that seriously was because I knew I didn't. Sai had mentioned using the Sekimeiya to win the lottery, but it wasn't actually that crazy of an idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't think it was greedy, either. In fact, what felt selfish was not taking the chance when it was provided.
entries.literal: "I didn't think it was greedy, either. In fact, what felt selfish was not taking the chance when it was provided."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I could change the past, I would go back in time again, because that would allow Miiya to be saved. That meant I simply had to remember a winning number before that point. That would create the possibility of a perfect future.
entries.literal: "If I could change the past, I would go back in time again, because that would allow Miiya to be saved. That meant I simply had to remember a winning number before that point. That would create the possibility of a perfect future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was I simply daydreaming in a hellish world? As long as the past could be changed, it didn't seem so. That future certainly felt attainable.
entries.literal: "Was I simply daydreaming in a hellish world? As long as the past could be changed, it didn't seem so. That future certainly felt attainable."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where is the Sekimeiya right now? Ashiya should have it somewhere, but they must be protecting it from Xyn, so there's no way I could touch it.
entries.literal: "Where is the Sekimeiya right now? Ashiya should have it somewhere, but they must be protecting it from Xyn, so there's no way I could touch it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Wait, no. That might not be the case.
entries.literal: "...Wait, no. That might not be the case."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Katei and Suripo explained it to us. The Sekimeiya is merely bait for Xyn to get trapped in the tower. So it's definitely there right now.
entries.literal: "Katei and Suripo explained it to us. The Sekimeiya is merely bait for Xyn to get trapped in the tower. So it's definitely there right now."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They also said that the mechanism to trigger the alarm is based on the cabinet being forced open. Also, Xyn never attacked before the 15th.
entries.literal: "They also said that the mechanism to trigger the alarm is based on the cabinet being forced open. Also, Xyn never attacked before the 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Doesn't that mean that I can change the past by going there during the night and forcing the cabinet open? It's probably not in the event room yet, but it must be somewhere unavailable to the public.
entries.literal: "Doesn't that mean that I can change the past by going there during the night and forcing the cabinet open? It's probably not in the event room yet, but it must be somewhere unavailable to the public."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I break it open, the alarm will lock me inside, and someone else will be locked in the security room. According to Katei, he hadn't been taking the night shifts recently, so it'll probably be someone else. Will they buy that I'm a Xyn member?
entries.literal: "If I break it open, the alarm will lock me inside, and someone else will be locked in the security room. According to Katei, he hadn't been taking the night shifts recently, so it'll probably be someone else. Will they buy that I'm a Xyn member?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It sounded pretty dangerous. That could've been a way to travel to the past again, but if it didn't work, I would be caught by the police, ruining everything.
entries.literal: "It sounded pretty dangerous. That could've been a way to travel to the past again, but if it didn't work, I would be caught by the police, ruining everything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why were there times where touching the Sekimeiya didn't do anything? What if it just won't work before the 15th, which is why nobody noticed its powers?
entries.literal: "Why were there times where touching the Sekimeiya didn't do anything? What if it just won't work before the 15th, which is why nobody noticed its powers?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even if the main entrance of the building is locked, assuming the storeroom door did lead to the outside, I could maybe enter through it.{w} ...There's no way I could take the entire cabinet out without triggering the alarm. Someone would be looking at the cameras, and I don't even know where the cabinet is.
entries.literal: "Even if the main entrance of the building is locked, assuming the storeroom door did lead to the outside, I could maybe enter through it.{w} ...There's no way I could take the entire cabinet out without triggering the alarm. Someone would be looking at the cameras, and I don't even know where the cabinet is."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...But to begin with, why did I go so far into the past? I still don't get that.
entries.literal: "...But to begin with, why did I go so far into the past? I still don't get that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was in the water tank, but it couldn't have been there for very long. According to Atsuki, he hid it in one of the lockers a while before that. ...Is it possible it gathered a lot of energy for another reason?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was in the water tank, but it couldn't have been there for very long. According to Atsuki, he hid it in one of the lockers a while before that. ...Is it possible it gathered a lot of energy for another reason?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even thinking about it in my living room, there were many things I didn't know about the Sekimeiya. If I could be sure such a plan could work, and I knew how to go days into the past, saving Miiya should've been fairly simple.
entries.literal: "Even thinking about it in my living room, there were many things I didn't know about the Sekimeiya. If I could be sure such a plan could work, and I knew how to go days into the past, saving Miiya should've been fairly simple."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no way that I'll let everything happen exactly as it did already just so that I have a guarantee that the Sekimeiya will work, right...?
entries.literal: "There's no way that I'll let everything happen exactly as it did already just so that I have a guarantee that the Sekimeiya will work, right...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The unknown version of me that had been seen in the tower still haunted me, but that couldn't be it.
entries.literal: "The unknown version of me that had been seen in the tower still haunted me, but that couldn't be it."

entries.speaker: nm
