entries.text: No. If I were to do that, I would also prevent Atsuki and myself from going. That's completely out of the question.
entries.literal: "No. If I were to do that, I would also prevent Atsuki and myself from going. That's completely out of the question."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I wasn't even sure about my situation. My appearance in that dark tunnel was different from all the other times. Instead of teleporting instantly, I had awakened, so I still felt like there was something I was missing.
entries.literal: "...I wasn't even sure about my situation. My appearance in that dark tunnel was different from all the other times. Instead of teleporting instantly, I had awakened, so I still felt like there was something I was missing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We thought about this once, didn't we? That maybe traveling very far through time would make your memories foggy. Could that be why I feel this way? Is there something that I can't remember...?
entries.literal: "We thought about this once, didn't we? That maybe traveling very far through time would make your memories foggy. Could that be why I feel this way? Is there something that I can't remember...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure. If there were some memories missing, I had no idea how to get them back.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure. If there were some memories missing, I had no idea how to get them back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up from the carpet and went to my room.
entries.literal: "I stood up from the carpet and went to my room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My purse was still next to my bed. I picked it up and put on my coat. Then, I walked to the doorway, where I'd left the keys I'd appeared with.
entries.literal: "My purse was still next to my bed. I picked it up and put on my coat. Then, I walked to the doorway, where I'd left the keys I'd appeared with."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to go outside. If it really was the first day of December, and what I'd thought of applied, there should've been no issue with that. Nobody would be aware that I couldn't be walking in the streets.
entries.literal: "I wanted to go outside. If it really was the first day of December, and what I'd thought of applied, there should've been no issue with that. Nobody would be aware that I couldn't be walking in the streets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put on my boots and opened the door. As expected, the air enclosed by all the mountains was overwhelmingly cold, but I really wanted to go out. On the snow were my footprints from the previous day, and some others ending at the nearby apartments.
entries.literal: "I put on my boots and opened the door. As expected, the air enclosed by all the mountains was overwhelmingly cold, but I really wanted to go out. On the snow were my footprints from the previous day, and some others ending at the nearby apartments."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was very rare for me to want to leave the house without knowing why. I usually only went outside with some purpose in mind.
entries.literal: "It was very rare for me to want to leave the house without knowing why. I usually only went outside with some purpose in mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was true that a lot of responsibility was weighing on me, but I didn't feel pressured. The freedom to make choices allowed me to remain relaxed to some degree.
entries.literal: "It was true that a lot of responsibility was weighing on me, but I didn't feel pressured. The freedom to make choices allowed me to remain relaxed to some degree."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at my purse. My wallet was inside it, containing the same amount of money I'd counted before leaving to meet Atsuki and Miiya—not that much.
entries.literal: "I looked at my purse. My wallet was inside it, containing the same amount of money I'd counted before leaving to meet Atsuki and Miiya—not that much."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed the door and walked down the stairs. I lived close to the outskirts, and there usually weren't many people around. That wasn't too different that day, as only a handful of people were slowly walking on the sidewalk, wearing overcoats and exhaling misty breaths.
entries.literal: "I closed the door and walked down the stairs. I lived close to the outskirts, and there usually weren't many people around. That wasn't too different that day, as only a handful of people were slowly walking on the sidewalk, wearing overcoats and exhaling misty breaths."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe I really should've thought about where to go before leaving.
entries.literal: "Maybe I really should've thought about where to go before leaving."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked toward the center of Yushibana, every street looking identical due to the coating of snow. There were a few parked cars and a bunch of footprints on the ground, but the environment felt pretty desolate. Everyone was inside.
entries.literal: "I walked toward the center of Yushibana, every street looking identical due to the coating of snow. There were a few parked cars and a bunch of footprints on the ground, but the environment felt pretty desolate. Everyone was inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything in the immediate vicinity was residential, so I kept thinking about where to go.
entries.literal: "Everything in the immediate vicinity was residential, so I kept thinking about where to go."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess I don't have to go anywhere. I could just come back when I get tired.{w} This is only for today, though. I seriously need to decide on what to do.
entries.literal: "I guess I don't have to go anywhere. I could just come back when I get tired.{w} This is only for today, though. I seriously need to decide on what to do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were enough citizens in Yushibana that it wasn't very common to know people on the street. That was what allowed me to be unafraid of being recognized and questioned about being in the hospital.
entries.literal: "There were enough citizens in Yushibana that it wasn't very common to know people on the street. That was what allowed me to be unafraid of being recognized and questioned about being in the hospital."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Should I go to the tower? What would I even do?{w} And what else is there in town? The library? How long has it been since I went there? Too long, honestly...
entries.literal: "...Should I go to the tower? What would I even do?{w} And what else is there in town? The library? How long has it been since I went there? Too long, honestly..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could try to eat something.
entries.literal: "I could try to eat something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had also been a while since I'd eaten anything outside. I always had to use my money well and cook at home.
entries.literal: "It had also been a while since I'd eaten anything outside. I always had to use my money well and cook at home."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess I can do whatever I want with the money that I have. It's been duplicated.
entries.literal: "I guess I can do whatever I want with the money that I have. It's been duplicated."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I had my purse next to me when I woke up in the hospital, so the original money is there. ...And I'm thinking about winning the lottery.
entries.literal: "I had my purse next to me when I woke up in the hospital, so the original money is there. ...And I'm thinking about winning the lottery."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I arrived at the busier section of Yushibana, where I immediately saw a lot more people. Looking all around, I saw that not many stores were open.
entries.literal: "I arrived at the busier section of Yushibana, where I immediately saw a lot more people. Looking all around, I saw that not many stores were open."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This might not be a good idea. I've been to all these places at some point.
entries.literal: "This might not be a good idea. I've been to all these places at some point."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it possible that being recognized could be problematic? Would I be changing the past if I accidentally see someone who knows I should be in the hospital?
entries.literal: "Is it possible that being recognized could be problematic? Would I be changing the past if I accidentally see someone who knows I should be in the hospital?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no way what happened wasn't on the news. Even people who don't know me could recognize me.
entries.literal: "There's no way what happened wasn't on the news. Even people who don't know me could recognize me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Nothing should happen. If someone sees it as a big issue, then the past has been changed, but that seems very unlikely. And there's no way anything would happen to me. ...Even if I'm found out, it won't make getting to the Sekimeiya any harder.
entries.literal: "Nothing should happen. If someone sees it as a big issue, then the past has been changed, but that seems very unlikely. And there's no way anything would happen to me. ...Even if I'm found out, it won't make getting to the Sekimeiya any harder."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What would I do, though? I wouldn't want to let Atsuki know. I already traveled to the past alone, going against what the Atsuki in the tower said.
entries.literal: "What would I do, though? I wouldn't want to let Atsuki know. I already traveled to the past alone, going against what the Atsuki in the tower said."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was I being selfish again? ...Potentially hindering any attempt to save Miiya?
entries.literal: "Was I being selfish again? ...Potentially hindering any attempt to save Miiya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't personally seen the past change yet. Only Atsuki had said that it was possible, and even he hadn't known the full specifics behind it. The worst scenario simply seemed to be me having to use the Sekimeiya on the 15th, taking advantage of the attack.
entries.literal: "I hadn't personally seen the past change yet. Only Atsuki had said that it was possible, and even he hadn't known the full specifics behind it. The worst scenario simply seemed to be me having to use the Sekimeiya on the 15th, taking advantage of the attack."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned toward a narrower street. As expected, Ina Café was open. It was pretty rare for it to be closed.
entries.literal: "I turned toward a narrower street. As expected, Ina Café was open. It was pretty rare for it to be closed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The barista there definitely knows me, and I need to understand better where I am. ...How will someone who knows me react if they see me on this day?
entries.literal: "The barista there definitely knows me, and I need to understand better where I am. ...How will someone who knows me react if they see me on this day?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the entrance, finally making up my mind. Through the glass, I saw that the interior was empty and Darfee was wiping down one of the tables. It had been a long time since I'd been there, but there was a time in my life where I frequented the place, enjoying the calm atmosphere.
entries.literal: "I walked to the entrance, finally making up my mind. Through the glass, I saw that the interior was empty and Darfee was wiping down one of the tables. It had been a long time since I'd been there, but there was a time in my life where I frequented the place, enjoying the calm atmosphere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the ground was a square carpet to clean the snow off my shoes. I used it before opening the door and hesitantly walking in, immediately feeling the warm temperature.
entries.literal: "On the ground was a square carpet to clean the snow off my shoes. I used it before opening the door and hesitantly walking in, immediately feeling the warm temperature."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee didn't turn around yet, so I looked at what was on the menu. Like in the past, there were light drinks and meals, as well as alcoholic beverages closer to the night.
entries.literal: "Darfee didn't turn around yet, so I looked at what was on the menu. Like in the past, there were light drinks and meals, as well as alcoholic beverages closer to the night."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Hello.
entries.literal: "...Hello."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Hello.
entries.literal: "Hello."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He suddenly turned around.
entries.literal: "He suddenly turned around."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: {tip=ha}Ha—{/tip}
entries.literal: "{tip=ha}Ha—{/tip}"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Shiroya...!
entries.literal: "Shiroya...!"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah. It's been a while.
entries.literal: "Yeah. It's been a while."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Oh my God! Y-You're all right!
entries.literal: "Oh my God! Y-You're all right!"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...So you know what happened. I am, yes.
entries.literal: "...So you know what happened. I am, yes."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Of course! You were on the news!
entries.literal: "Of course! You were on the news!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I managed a bitter smile in response to his relieved expression.
entries.literal: "I managed a bitter smile in response to his relieved expression."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I'm so glad you were released so quickly! How are you?
entries.literal: "I'm so glad you were released so quickly! How are you?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Makes sense. I'm supposed to be in a coma.
entries.literal: "Makes sense. I'm supposed to be in a coma."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm okay. I was released yesterday. Fortunately, nothing major happened to me.
entries.literal: "I'm okay. I was released yesterday. Fortunately, nothing major happened to me."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: That's really good to hear. If you came to relax and try to forget things, we don't have to talk about it.
entries.literal: "That's really good to hear. If you came to relax and try to forget things, we don't have to talk about it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...It's fine. You don't have to worry.
entries.literal: "...It's fine. You don't have to worry."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Are you sure? I can't imagine what it must be like to lose someone close to you at your age. I'm so sorry.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? I can't imagine what it must be like to lose someone close to you at your age. I'm so sorry."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}Thank you.
entries.literal: "...{w}Thank you."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Do you have any idea what happened? A lot of details weren't published.
entries.literal: "Do you have any idea what happened? A lot of details weren't published."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Unfortunately, no. It all happened suddenly, and we were just caught up in it.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, no. It all happened suddenly, and we were just caught up in it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked down, very clearly pitying me.
entries.literal: "He looked down, very clearly pitying me."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Do you want coffee? I'm sorry, I don't have much else right now.
entries.literal: "Do you want coffee? I'm sorry, I don't have much else right now."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: N-No, I don't think I need any right now.
entries.literal: "N-No, I don't think I need any right now."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Are you sure? I can make you the Kalitsu Special.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? I can make you the Kalitsu Special."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What is that?
entries.literal: "...What is that?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: It's nothing. That's the special.
entries.literal: "It's nothing. That's the special."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He cracked a halfhearted smile, obviously trying to cheer me up. I tried to return the look, but I wasn't sure if my own smile was visible or not.
entries.literal: "He cracked a halfhearted smile, obviously trying to cheer me up. I tried to return the look, but I wasn't sure if my own smile was visible or not."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked behind the glass cover, where a few pastries remained.
entries.literal: "I looked behind the glass cover, where a few pastries remained."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'm a bit hungry. I could go for this.
entries.literal: "...I'm a bit hungry. I could go for this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pointed at one covered with dried chocolate.
entries.literal: "I pointed at one covered with dried chocolate."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Of course. Give me a second.
entries.literal: "Of course. Give me a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...He moved behind the bar, removed it with metallic tongs, and put it on a small plate, which he placed in front of me.
entries.literal: "...He moved behind the bar, removed it with metallic tongs, and put it on a small plate, which he placed in front of me."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Here. Don't worry about asking for anything else.
entries.literal: "Here. Don't worry about asking for anything else."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Thank you.
entries.literal: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I bit into it—I was hungrier than I'd thought.
entries.literal: "I bit into it—I was hungrier than I'd thought."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What will happen when he realizes that I'm still in the hospital? I haven't heard anything about Darfee in a while, so if everything were to happen as I remember, he shouldn't do anything. I really don't like having to lie to him, though.
entries.literal: "What will happen when he realizes that I'm still in the hospital? I haven't heard anything about Darfee in a while, so if everything were to happen as I remember, he shouldn't do anything. I really don't like having to lie to him, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept eating while he washed the few dishes left.
entries.literal: "I kept eating while he washed the few dishes left."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: You're done? Do you want another one?
entries.literal: "You're done? Do you want another one?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm okay, but thank you.
entries.literal: "I'm okay, but thank you."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: All right. I'm seriously happy to see you, though. I couldn't believe it when I saw your face on the news.
entries.literal: "All right. I'm seriously happy to see you, though. I couldn't believe it when I saw your face on the news."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Me too. Sorry for not coming around in a while.
entries.literal: "...Me too. Sorry for not coming around in a while."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Don't worry about that. Are your parents here?
entries.literal: "Don't worry about that. Are your parents here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee had to be in his late thirties, but he was a good friend of my parents, who'd actually brought me there for the first time. I hadn't spoken to him that many times, but I figured he was familiar enough with me, as he'd known me since I was a kid.
entries.literal: "Darfee had to be in his late thirties, but he was a good friend of my parents, who'd actually brought me there for the first time. I hadn't spoken to him that many times, but I figured he was familiar enough with me, as he'd known me since I was a kid."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: They aren't.
entries.literal: "They aren't."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: No? Will they come soon? They will, right?
entries.literal: "No? Will they come soon? They will, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I don't know. As of now, they'll stay overseas.
entries.literal: "...I don't know. As of now, they'll stay overseas."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked puzzled and disappointed. In fact, I did know that they wouldn't come. Even after waking from my coma, they would only talk to me through phone calls. ...Too busy with administrative work, of course.
entries.literal: "He looked puzzled and disappointed. In fact, I did know that they wouldn't come. Even after waking from my coma, they would only talk to me through phone calls. ...Too busy with administrative work, of course."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's right. What will even happen now? Two identical copies of my phone exist. How will calls work?
entries.literal: "That's right. What will even happen now? Two identical copies of my phone exist. How will calls work?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I suppose it doesn't matter. If both phones react when they call me, I'll just have to not pick up. If only mine rings, the past would be changing.
entries.literal: "I suppose it doesn't matter. If both phones react when they call me, I'll just have to not pick up. If only mine rings, the past would be changing."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Do come here any time you want. You're more than welcome.
entries.literal: "Do come here any time you want. You're more than welcome."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I will. I just wanted to leave my home today.
entries.literal: "...I will. I just wanted to leave my home today."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I completely understand. That's good for you to do.
entries.literal: "I completely understand. That's good for you to do."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah...
entries.literal: "Yeah..."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I think I will have coffee.
entries.literal: "I think I will have coffee."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Absolutely. How do you want it?
entries.literal: "Absolutely. How do you want it?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...It's pretty late for coffee, actually. I'm not sure, anything that's not too strong, and without milk or sugar.
entries.literal: "...It's pretty late for coffee, actually. I'm not sure, anything that's not too strong, and without milk or sugar."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: As always. Give me a second.
entries.literal: "As always. Give me a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He grabbed a short, transparent glass and filled it halfway.
entries.literal: "He grabbed a short, transparent glass and filled it halfway."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Do you want it alongside anything?
entries.literal: "Do you want it alongside anything?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He pointed at some bottles higher up.
entries.literal: "He pointed at some bottles higher up."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Those have alcohol, right?
entries.literal: "Those have alcohol, right?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Then no. I've never had any of that.
entries.literal: "...Then no. I've never had any of that."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I understand, but maybe you should. Last thing I wanna do is make an alcoholic out of you, but it doesn't hurt in small quantities.
entries.literal: "I understand, but maybe you should. Last thing I wanna do is make an alcoholic out of you, but it doesn't hurt in small quantities."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's okay. I'd prefer not to.
entries.literal: "It's okay. I'd prefer not to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He nodded and filled it all the way up. I was kind of surprised he offered—I wasn't old enough to drink, and I could have gotten away with technically barely breaking the law, but I wasn't in the mood anyway.
entries.literal: "He nodded and filled it all the way up. I was kind of surprised he offered—I wasn't old enough to drink, and I could have gotten away with technically barely breaking the law, but I wasn't in the mood anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He left the glass next to the empty plate. As usual, it was overly hot.
entries.literal: "He left the glass next to the empty plate. As usual, it was overly hot."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stretched my hands behind my back and looked around me. I was the only person there.
entries.literal: "I stretched my hands behind my back and looked around me. I was the only person there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: A newspaper...
entries.literal: "A newspaper..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few seats away, there was an open newspaper that someone had probably started reading and left behind. I pinched it and pulled it toward me.
entries.literal: "A few seats away, there was an open newspaper that someone had probably started reading and left behind. I pinched it and pulled it toward me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It should say today's date.
entries.literal: "It should say today's date."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the top right corner, and, as expected, there was the date.
entries.literal: "I looked at the top right corner, and, as expected, there was the date."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It really is December 1st.
entries.literal: "...It really is December 1st."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Is this new?
entries.literal: "Is this new?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: The newspaper? Yes.
entries.literal: "The newspaper? Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I brought it closer and looked at the pages for current news. It was Yushinews, so events from Yushibana were highlighted.
entries.literal: "I brought it closer and looked at the pages for current news. It was Yushinews, so events from Yushibana were highlighted."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Miiya and I must appear somewhere in here.
entries.literal: "Miiya and I must appear somewhere in here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I flipped the pages toward the start, as I felt it should've been important enough to put it at the beginning. When I got to the initial two, I stopped myself.
entries.literal: "I flipped the pages toward the start, as I felt it should've been important enough to put it at the beginning. When I got to the initial two, I stopped myself."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Here it is.
entries.literal: "Here it is."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The category was "November", and there were many brief articles. The last one was titled "Gas Explosion Late at Night".
entries.literal: "The category was \"November\", and there were many brief articles. The last one was titled \"Gas Explosion Late at Night\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I read the tiny letters next to a black and white picture of the shop.
entries.literal: "I read the tiny letters next to a black and white picture of the shop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Miiya Moiromo, a twenty-year-old girl, is the only casualty of a local gas explosion that occurred in the evening of November 30th. Shiroya Mirana, another young girl nineteen years of age, was gravely injured and immediately sent to the hospital. Her condition is critical, although she wasn't directly hit by the explosion."
entries.literal: "\"Miiya Moiromo, a twenty-year-old girl, is the only casualty of a local gas explosion that occurred in the evening of November 30th. Shiroya Mirana, another young girl nineteen years of age, was gravely injured and immediately sent to the hospital. Her condition is critical, although she wasn't directly hit by the explosion.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "The incident occurred when an unknown individual released smoke that caused four people inside to lose consciousness. The other two were too far from the range to receive any serious injuries. While everyone was unconscious, a heater depleted its surrounding oxygen after its flame went out, and when a visitor turned on the lights, an immediate explosion of short radius but intense force occurred.{w} It killed the first victim instantly and broke the floor of the shop. The second girl, Mirana, was protected by the furniture next to her but fell through the broken floor."
entries.literal: "\"The incident occurred when an unknown individual released smoke that caused four people inside to lose consciousness. The other two were too far from the range to receive any serious injuries. While everyone was unconscious, a heater depleted its surrounding oxygen after its flame went out, and when a visitor turned on the lights, an immediate explosion of short radius but intense force occurred.{w} It killed the first victim instantly and broke the floor of the shop. The second girl, Mirana, was protected by the furniture next to her but fell through the broken floor.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It happened just like I remember.
entries.literal: "It happened just like I remember."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And it doesn't even say why the incident happened.{w} ...Right, on the 15th, when smoke knocked us out for the second time, I thought that both incidents must have been caused by the same people. That would be Xyn.
entries.literal: "And it doesn't even say why the incident happened.{w} ...Right, on the 15th, when smoke knocked us out for the second time, I thought that both incidents must have been caused by the same people. That would be Xyn."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Wait, it actually is this. I'm not wrong.{w} It was caused by Xyn. That's why no further details got published.{w} That's what Katei told us. Xyn had already tried to steal the Sekimeiya once, but they failed. They almost caught the person behind it, but since they ended up escaping, it wasn't published that they'd been from Xyn.
entries.literal: "...{w}Wait, it actually is this. I'm not wrong.{w} It was caused by Xyn. That's why no further details got published.{w} That's what Katei told us. Xyn had already tried to steal the Sekimeiya once, but they failed. They almost caught the person behind it, but since they ended up escaping, it wasn't published that they'd been from Xyn."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, of course... In the attic, I knew I recognized that smell. I smelled it in that shop. ...That's what happened there. Xyn tried to steal the Sekimeiya before it was brought to Ashiya Tower.{w} The Sekimeiya was in the shop, and for some reason, Xyn didn't succeed.
entries.literal: "Oh, of course... In the attic, I knew I recognized that smell. I smelled it in that shop. ...That's what happened there. Xyn tried to steal the Sekimeiya before it was brought to Ashiya Tower.{w} The Sekimeiya was in the shop, and for some reason, Xyn didn't succeed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That made sense as the outline of what had occurred, but it didn't mean anything to me aside from the fact that Miiya's life had been taken during an attempt to steal a gemstone.
entries.literal: "That made sense as the outline of what had occurred, but it didn't mean anything to me aside from the fact that Miiya's life had been taken during an attempt to steal a gemstone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At that point, did Xyn know what the Sekimeiya would do, or did they attempt to steal just another simple gem that Ashiya had? The advertising had just started.
entries.literal: "At that point, did Xyn know what the Sekimeiya would do, or did they attempt to steal just another simple gem that Ashiya had? The advertising had just started."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I huffed, deeply frustrated.{w} I began to drink the coffee, and as I scanned the pages, more concise articles came into view.
entries.literal: "I huffed, deeply frustrated.{w} I began to drink the coffee, and as I scanned the pages, more concise articles came into view."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I read the title of one higher up on the page.
entries.literal: "I read the title of one higher up on the page."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Unknown Man Escapes from Prison Cell".{w} Intrigued by the premise, I read the body of the article.
entries.literal: "\"Unknown Man Escapes from Prison Cell\".{w} Intrigued by the premise, I read the body of the article."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "In the afternoon of November 24th, the camera of a prison cell recorded a prisoner escaping from it."
entries.literal: "\"In the afternoon of November 24th, the camera of a prison cell recorded a prisoner escaping from it.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...? Is it talking about a prison here?{w} I don't think there's a proper one in Yushibana, so maybe it's just talking about holding cells in the police department.
entries.literal: "What...? Is it talking about a prison here?{w} I don't think there's a proper one in Yushibana, so maybe it's just talking about holding cells in the police department."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "The identity of that person remains unknown. They were dressed as a prisoner, but no footage shows who they were or how they ended up in that cell. The corridor they were in was unprotected, as nobody should've been inside the cell. By the time the footage recording them was noticed, they'd already disappeared.{w} The cell itself was unlocked, supposedly due to being vacant. There was no security in that area, so it is possible the individual left the entire building. Their identity and the way they got to that cell are under investigation, but no method to reach it such as a hidden passage between cells was found to exist."
entries.literal: "\"The identity of that person remains unknown. They were dressed as a prisoner, but no footage shows who they were or how they ended up in that cell. The corridor they were in was unprotected, as nobody should've been inside the cell. By the time the footage recording them was noticed, they'd already disappeared.{w} The cell itself was unlocked, supposedly due to being vacant. There was no security in that area, so it is possible the individual left the entire building. Their identity and the way they got to that cell are under investigation, but no method to reach it such as a hidden passage between cells was found to exist.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell?{w} I never heard about this. I guess I don't really watch or read the news.
entries.literal: "What the hell?{w} I never heard about this. I guess I don't really watch or read the news."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to the paragraph was a picture. It showed a still black and white image of the footage, which displayed the bars protecting the cell. The door was open, and the man could be seen leaving it. However, due to the high angle, his face couldn't be seen, and the single detail to go off of was his short, dark-looking hair.
entries.literal: "Next to the paragraph was a picture. It showed a still black and white image of the footage, which displayed the bars protecting the cell. The door was open, and the man could be seen leaving it. However, due to the high angle, his face couldn't be seen, and the single detail to go off of was his short, dark-looking hair."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This person supposedly appeared in a cell, huh? I guess there are many unsolved mysteries I could solve by factoring in the Sekimeiya. Who's to say it hasn't been used in crimes before it made its way to Ashiya...?
entries.literal: "This person supposedly appeared in a cell, huh? I guess there are many unsolved mysteries I could solve by factoring in the Sekimeiya. Who's to say it hasn't been used in crimes before it made its way to Ashiya...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I downed the rest of my coffee. It wasn't supposed to be strong, and I didn't feel any reaction from it. At one point, coffee had stopped always having a positive effect on me, and sometimes it would do more harm than good, so I'd stopped drinking it frequently.
entries.literal: "I downed the rest of my coffee. It wasn't supposed to be strong, and I didn't feel any reaction from it. At one point, coffee had stopped always having a positive effect on me, and sometimes it would do more harm than good, so I'd stopped drinking it frequently."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: You're done? Do you want anything else?
entries.literal: "You're done? Do you want anything else?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm fine.
entries.literal: "I'm fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up from the stool and looked at my purse.
entries.literal: "I stood up from the stool and looked at my purse."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: You're not going to try to pay me, are you? Don't even think about it.
entries.literal: "You're not going to try to pay me, are you? Don't even think about it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh... Are you sure?
entries.literal: "Oh... Are you sure?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Of course, and come back any time you feel like it. I'm serious when I say that I was really glad to see you, and I'm relieved to see that you're all right.
entries.literal: "Of course, and come back any time you feel like it. I'm serious when I say that I was really glad to see you, and I'm relieved to see that you're all right."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Okay. I really appreciate it.
entries.literal: "Okay. I really appreciate it."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I don't want to stick my nose in your business, but I think you should talk to your parents. I can do it if you prefer. I can't believe they haven't come.
entries.literal: "I don't want to stick my nose in your business, but I think you should talk to your parents. I can do it if you prefer. I can't believe they haven't come."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Don't worry, I have been talking to them. I think I prefer to be alone, though.
entries.literal: "...Don't worry, I have been talking to them. I think I prefer to be alone, though."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Is that so...? I see.
entries.literal: "Is that so...? I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I smiled and walked to the entrance. Seeing the desolate street from such a warm place made for a very pleasant contrast.
entries.literal: "I smiled and walked to the entrance. Seeing the desolate street from such a warm place made for a very pleasant contrast."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Bye.

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I'll see you. There are a lot of things I want to talk to you about, so come back when you want. As you can see, we're not even closed on Sundays, so it can be any day. I wish you the best to get through this.
entries.literal: "I'll see you. There are a lot of things I want to talk to you about, so come back when you want. As you can see, we're not even closed on Sundays, so it can be any day. I wish you the best to get through this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded and left the shop.{w} Did I look like a person burying a lot of pain? To be talking casually and smiling only one day after Miiya's death, I assumed that was the only explanation to Darfee.
entries.literal: "I nodded and left the shop.{w} Did I look like a person burying a lot of pain? To be talking casually and smiling only one day after Miiya's death, I assumed that was the only explanation to Darfee."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I unconsciously picked a side and walked away.
entries.literal: "I unconsciously picked a side and walked away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything around me, existence itself, felt calm. I still wondered how that was possible. Only days previously, I'd questioned whether I would even speak again. Just what had happened to me?
entries.literal: "Everything around me, existence itself, felt calm. I still wondered how that was possible. Only days previously, I'd questioned whether I would even speak again. Just what had happened to me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't that I didn't feel that pain as my own anymore or that I simply expected Miiya's death to be overwritten. After all, even if I did erase it, my memories wouldn't go away. Had all the terrible events afterward outweighed it, made it insignificant? How did that make sense?
entries.literal: "It wasn't that I didn't feel that pain as my own anymore or that I simply expected Miiya's death to be overwritten. After all, even if I did erase it, my memories wouldn't go away. Had all the terrible events afterward outweighed it, made it insignificant? How did that make sense?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter the reason why I felt so tranquil, I liked it. Being able to feel any kind of comfort was a welcome change, even if the future was uncertain, and even if it all still revolved around the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "No matter the reason why I felt so tranquil, I liked it. Being able to feel any kind of comfort was a welcome change, even if the future was uncertain, and even if it all still revolved around the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went back to Ramon street. In the center of Yushibana, it was the largest one, ending at the town hall. No cars could go through it, and it was where you could usually see the most people.
entries.literal: "I went back to Ramon street. In the center of Yushibana, it was the largest one, ending at the town hall. No cars could go through it, and it was where you could usually see the most people."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Sunday, so it made sense that most places were closed. I'd thought of going to the tower earlier, but that wasn't even possible, as it closed on Sundays.{w} While I thought about what to do next, my legs automatically turned me toward a branching street.
entries.literal: "It was Sunday, so it made sense that most places were closed. I'd thought of going to the tower earlier, but that wasn't even possible, as it closed on Sundays.{w} While I thought about what to do next, my legs automatically turned me toward a branching street."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know whether to stop myself, so I continued. I hadn't really intended to go any direction in particular, but it was a path I'd taken before.
entries.literal: "I didn't know whether to stop myself, so I continued. I hadn't really intended to go any direction in particular, but it was a path I'd taken before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As opposed to the wider street, that one was only lined by residences, and it led to a one-way road, just as I remembered it.
entries.literal: "As opposed to the wider street, that one was only lined by residences, and it led to a one-way road, just as I remembered it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After ignoring two branching paths, I turned toward Enric avenue. From both sidewalks grew tall, skinny trees covered by the snow, elegantly draping over the path. It was a pretty place to live in, situated on the opposite side of Yushibana from my apartment.
entries.literal: "After ignoring two branching paths, I turned toward Enric avenue. From both sidewalks grew tall, skinny trees covered by the snow, elegantly draping over the path. It was a pretty place to live in, situated on the opposite side of Yushibana from my apartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't bring myself to walk any farther, and I only stared into the distance from the corner. I was looking at Atsuki's house.
entries.literal: "I couldn't bring myself to walk any farther, and I only stared into the distance from the corner. I was looking at Atsuki's house."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Near it, I could discern some people outside of their own houses, but Atsuki's was still.
entries.literal: "Near it, I could discern some people outside of their own houses, but Atsuki's was still."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think I should let myself be seen...
entries.literal: "I don't think I should let myself be seen..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't had any reason to go there, but I knew that if Atsuki saw me, I'd end up explaining everything that had happened. While a part of me wanted to do that, it wasn't strong enough to force me.
entries.literal: "I hadn't had any reason to go there, but I knew that if Atsuki saw me, I'd end up explaining everything that had happened. While a part of me wanted to do that, it wasn't strong enough to force me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is there light...?
entries.literal: "Is there light...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The road had very few wheel marks, and no cars were allowed to park. I crossed it to get a little closer.
entries.literal: "The road had very few wheel marks, and no cars were allowed to park. I crossed it to get a little closer."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Yeah. He's in the living room.
entries.literal: "Yeah. He's in the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through his window, it was possible to see the light on the opposite side.
entries.literal: "Through his window, it was possible to see the light on the opposite side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After waking up from my coma, he'd told me that he'd only left his house to go to the hospital, and that he'd otherwise spent all his time miserable.
entries.literal: "After waking up from my coma, he'd told me that he'd only left his house to go to the hospital, and that he'd otherwise spent all his time miserable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew how he was feeling on the other side of the glass, and if I simply showed myself, I could help him. So then, why did that not feel like the best idea?
entries.literal: "I knew how he was feeling on the other side of the glass, and if I simply showed myself, I could help him. So then, why did that not feel like the best idea?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I surreptitiously approached the door, wondering if it was simply because I would ideally overwrite time anyway. Since I planned to change the past, was there no need to make the reality I was in better?
entries.literal: "I surreptitiously approached the door, wondering if it was simply because I would ideally overwrite time anyway. Since I planned to change the past, was there no need to make the reality I was in better?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It also meant that if everything were to somehow play out as I remembered, the Atsuki I'd been with had always known that I'd traveled to the past and hadn't mentioned it so that it could happen. How likely was that, honestly?
entries.literal: "It also meant that if everything were to somehow play out as I remembered, the Atsuki I'd been with had always known that I'd traveled to the past and hadn't mentioned it so that it could happen. How likely was that, honestly?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got startled as soon as I peeked through the bars of his front gate. I hadn't seen Maxi sitting in front of the wooden door, where there was no snow.
entries.literal: "I got startled as soon as I peeked through the bars of his front gate. I hadn't seen Maxi sitting in front of the wooden door, where there was no snow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He seemed afraid for an instant when he saw me, but then he ran to me, squeezing his head through the bars.
entries.literal: "He seemed afraid for an instant when he saw me, but then he ran to me, squeezing his head through the bars."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's just me. Do you know that I should be in the hospital? What are you doing here? It's very cold.
entries.literal: "It's just me. Do you know that I should be in the hospital? What are you doing here? It's very cold."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked up as I petted him. I knew Atsuki wouldn't look through the window since Maxi tended to bark whenever other dogs passed by anyway.
entries.literal: "I looked up as I petted him. I knew Atsuki wouldn't look through the window since Maxi tended to bark whenever other dogs passed by anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I figured Umi was inside the house. Both of them had a hole in the door to enter and exit through.
entries.literal: "I figured Umi was inside the house. Both of them had a hole in the door to enter and exit through."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If nothing changes, what will happen on the 15th? I still don't understand what was up with the recording.{w} Could it really be that the exit will be locked for a month? If so, the police should take care of these two, right...?
entries.literal: "If nothing changes, what will happen on the 15th? I still don't understand what was up with the recording.{w} Could it really be that the exit will be locked for a month? If so, the police should take care of these two, right...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at Maxi's face as he happily stared back at me. If I remembered well, he was eight and had been born on May 26th.
entries.literal: "I looked at Maxi's face as he happily stared back at me. If I remembered well, he was eight and had been born on May 26th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if Atsuki was wrong and the past can't be changed? I could change it by ringing the doorbell right now, but that's not something I want to do.
entries.literal: "What if Atsuki was wrong and the past can't be changed? I could change it by ringing the doorbell right now, but that's not something I want to do."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Doesn't me constantly not wanting to do things that change the past indicate that it can't change?
entries.literal: "...Doesn't me constantly not wanting to do things that change the past indicate that it can't change?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if I leave a note saying that I'm fine?
entries.literal: "What if I leave a note saying that I'm fine?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That didn't sound like a good idea either. There was no way Atsuki would read it and assume that I'd traveled to the past. Although he would then tell me after I woke up, so it would guarantee a change.
entries.literal: "That didn't sound like a good idea either. There was no way Atsuki would read it and assume that I'd traveled to the past. Although he would then tell me after I woke up, so it would guarantee a change."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When will I be able to tell whether things can change or not? There should be something I could do to confirm it.
entries.literal: "When will I be able to tell whether things can change or not? There should be something I could do to confirm it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And I suppose that if it can't happen in the end, it's a given that the version of me they saw on the 15th will end up being me.
entries.literal: "And I suppose that if it can't happen in the end, it's a given that the version of me they saw on the 15th will end up being me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could it be that I'll have failed to conclude whether I can change the past even by the 15th? If I haven't been able to touch the Sekimeiya by then, I'll go to the tower. It just doesn't make sense that I would let everything repeat...
entries.literal: "Could it be that I'll have failed to conclude whether I can change the past even by the 15th? If I haven't been able to touch the Sekimeiya by then, I'll go to the tower. It just doesn't make sense that I would let everything repeat..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could prevent the recording from occurring so that Maxi and Umi aren't in danger. What if I decide to be the one who removed the handle in the storeroom and keep it so that I can leave at any time? Would that make any sense...?
entries.literal: "I could prevent the recording from occurring so that Maxi and Umi aren't in danger. What if I decide to be the one who removed the handle in the storeroom and keep it so that I can leave at any time? Would that make any sense...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped away from the door.
entries.literal: "I stepped away from the door."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Don't worry. I'll be back soon.
entries.literal: "Don't worry. I'll be back soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept walking back, but Maxi didn't take his eyes off me until I'd disappeared from his view.
entries.literal: "I kept walking back, but Maxi didn't take his eyes off me until I'd disappeared from his view."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One of Atsuki's neighbors was looking at me too, and she waved at me from a distance. I knew I'd seen her before, so I awkwardly returned the gesture. She opened her mouth to say something brief, but I couldn't hear her.
entries.literal: "One of Atsuki's neighbors was looking at me too, and she waved at me from a distance. I knew I'd seen her before, so I awkwardly returned the gesture. She opened her mouth to say something brief, but I couldn't hear her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited to see if she'd repeat herself, but it didn't seem like she'd realized I hadn't heard her.
entries.literal: "I waited to see if she'd repeat herself, but it didn't seem like she'd realized I hadn't heard her."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}I don't know enough about what happened these days to do something and actually be sure I've changed the past. At least not in a non-drastic way, like by speaking to Atsuki. I could go to my hospital room and draw something on my face that I didn't wake up with...
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't know enough about what happened these days to do something and actually be sure I've changed the past. At least not in a non-drastic way, like by speaking to Atsuki. I could go to my hospital room and draw something on my face that I didn't wake up with..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked all the way down the street until I was back at the wider Ramon.
entries.literal: "I walked all the way down the street until I was back at the wider Ramon."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I seriously need to know if I'm going to be able to change what happened, and pretty urgently too. If it's not possible, then every attempt I make at getting to the Sekimeiya before the 15th is automatically bound to fail.
entries.literal: "I seriously need to know if I'm going to be able to change what happened, and pretty urgently too. If it's not possible, then every attempt I make at getting to the Sekimeiya before the 15th is automatically bound to fail."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The time Katei said that someone from Xyn had tried to steal the Sekimeiya... There's no way I'll be the person behind that, right? Would he have said so if he'd known about it? I guess if the past can't be changed and someone did attempt to steal the Sekimeiya on the 30th, I have a guarantee that I won't be caught because he didn't mention that.
entries.literal: "The time Katei said that someone from Xyn had tried to steal the Sekimeiya... There's no way I'll be the person behind that, right? Would he have said so if he'd known about it? I guess if the past can't be changed and someone did attempt to steal the Sekimeiya on the 30th, I have a guarantee that I won't be caught because he didn't mention that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A lot more people than I remembered were walking up and down the stone path. As usual, most of the snow had been removed so it didn't hinder anyone.
entries.literal: "A lot more people than I remembered were walking up and down the stone path. As usual, most of the snow had been removed so it didn't hinder anyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tended not to like being in that busy street, but I wanted to appreciate people simply existing around me. Most of them were slightly hunched over to feel warmer, wearing scarves around their necks.
entries.literal: "I tended not to like being in that busy street, but I wanted to appreciate people simply existing around me. Most of them were slightly hunched over to feel warmer, wearing scarves around their necks."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was still a little hesitant. At any point, someone could've asked me about the hospital. I could recognize a few people I'd seen before, and I wasn't sure if I was imagining the stares I felt.
entries.literal: "I was still a little hesitant. At any point, someone could've asked me about the hospital. I could recognize a few people I'd seen before, and I wasn't sure if I was imagining the stares I felt."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Are they actually looking at me? There's no way it's because I'm supposed to be at the hospital, right...?
entries.literal: "Are they actually looking at me? There's no way it's because I'm supposed to be at the hospital, right...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked back, but the feeling had disappeared. I thought to myself that I was probably just pointlessly worried about that.
entries.literal: "I looked back, but the feeling had disappeared. I thought to myself that I was probably just pointlessly worried about that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was directing myself back home. The cold would soon become hard to bear, and I was a little tired. Nonetheless, going outside had been as pleasant as I'd thought it would be.
entries.literal: "I was directing myself back home. The cold would soon become hard to bear, and I was a little tired. Nonetheless, going outside had been as pleasant as I'd thought it would be."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On my way to the drier roadway, I'd passed plenty of people living their own lives. Evidently, the time had only stopped for me and Atsuki.
entries.literal: "On my way to the drier roadway, I'd passed plenty of people living their own lives. Evidently, the time had only stopped for me and Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd left the center of Yushibana, so my surroundings felt a lot less lively. Due to the temperature, the sky was devoid of birds, and seeing other animals wasn't common. Walking on the snow became a lot harder, but I'd grown used to it more every year.
entries.literal: "I'd left the center of Yushibana, so my surroundings felt a lot less lively. Due to the temperature, the sky was devoid of birds, and seeing other animals wasn't common. Walking on the snow became a lot harder, but I'd grown used to it more every year."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw something wrapped around a streetlight and approached it warily.
entries.literal: "I saw something wrapped around a streetlight and approached it warily."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "The Sekimeiya".{w} It was a flyer marked by the touch of many snowflakes. I'd seen it before, but I didn't want to look at it.
entries.literal: "\"The Sekimeiya\".{w} It was a flyer marked by the touch of many snowflakes. I'd seen it before, but I didn't want to look at it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I walked away, my eyes locked on my feet.
entries.literal: "...I walked away, my eyes locked on my feet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What if I draw something on the door of my apartment? I know that when I went home after waking up in the hospital, I didn't see anything. I think that was on the 8th, when I came home and just slept before calling Atsuki.
entries.literal: "...What if I draw something on the door of my apartment? I know that when I went home after waking up in the hospital, I didn't see anything. I think that was on the 8th, when I came home and just slept before calling Atsuki."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's very possible that the past will only change if I intend my actions to cause a change. This means that everything I've done up until now could've always happened. If I put something on my door with the intent to change the past, that could prove it can happen.
entries.literal: "It's very possible that the past will only change if I intend my actions to cause a change. This means that everything I've done up until now could've always happened. If I put something on my door with the intent to change the past, that could prove it can happen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess it wouldn't be absolute, though. I could only be sure if it's still there on the 8th. It wouldn't be an instant confirmation.
entries.literal: "I guess it wouldn't be absolute, though. I could only be sure if it's still there on the 8th. It wouldn't be an instant confirmation."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: One of the purposes of changing the past is to prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. What if I send a warning to him saying not to go? If that ends up being all I'll be able to do, I shouldn't let Erina and Isla go either, but I don't know where they live.
entries.literal: "One of the purposes of changing the past is to prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. What if I send a warning to him saying not to go? If that ends up being all I'll be able to do, I shouldn't let Erina and Isla go either, but I don't know where they live."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got my keys ready and put aside my musings until I got to the staircase of my apartment.
entries.literal: "I got my keys ready and put aside my musings until I got to the staircase of my apartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went up and unlocked the door. As soon as I opened it, the inner temperature hit me, and I remembered I'd left the heater going.
entries.literal: "I went up and unlocked the door. As soon as I opened it, the inner temperature hit me, and I remembered I'd left the heater going."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Just in case, I shouldn't have it on very often.
entries.literal: "Just in case, I shouldn't have it on very often."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After closing the door, I left my boots on the floor, my coat on a wooden hanger, and went to turn the heater off.
entries.literal: "After closing the door, I left my boots on the floor, my coat on a wooden hanger, and went to turn the heater off."

entries.text: Sky Signals
entries.literal: "Sky Signals"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was beginning to feel a little dubious and nervous about Atsuki's assertion. Did the Sekimeiya really have the power to let someone alter the past?
entries.literal: "I was beginning to feel a little dubious and nervous about Atsuki's assertion. Did the Sekimeiya really have the power to let someone alter the past?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I'll find out right now. I just need to decide that my next action will change history.
entries.literal: "...I'll find out right now. I just need to decide that my next action will change history."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait... that would be very thoughtless.
entries.literal: "Wait... that would be very thoughtless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd thought of calling Atsuki's phone for a second and then hanging up. As long as I did that, the past would change. He'd never told me about a call like that.
entries.literal: "I'd thought of calling Atsuki's phone for a second and then hanging up. As long as I did that, the past would change. He'd never told me about a call like that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I couldn't do it. It would tell him that I'd woken up, and then he'd find out otherwise. I hadn't thought it through.
entries.literal: "But I couldn't do it. It would tell him that I'd woken up, and then he'd find out otherwise. I hadn't thought it through."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is there anything else I could do to get the same result...?
entries.literal: "Is there anything else I could do to get the same result...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, I can call my parents. When I talked to them on the phone, they definitely would have told me about receiving a call from my phone on December 1st.
entries.literal: "Oh, I can call my parents. When I talked to them on the phone, they definitely would have told me about receiving a call from my phone on December 1st."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: All right, so should I just consciously aim to change the past?
entries.literal: "All right, so should I just consciously aim to change the past?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This won't get me into trouble, right...? They'll simply call the hospital, and nobody will understand what happened.
entries.literal: "This won't get me into trouble, right...? They'll simply call the hospital, and nobody will understand what happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the phone from my purse and looked at the screen. It was almost {time=15.}
entries.literal: "I took the phone from my purse and looked at the screen. It was almost {time=15.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the contacts list, selected my mom, and pressed the call button.
entries.literal: "I went to the contacts list, selected my mom, and pressed the call button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The signal usually wasn't great, so I got closer to the window. Immediately after the first beep, I heard a voice.
entries.literal: "The signal usually wasn't great, so I got closer to the window. Immediately after the first beep, I heard a voice."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Shiroya...! How are you!?{w} I'm so glad you called! We were so worried!
entries.literal: "Shiroya...! How are you!?{w} I'm so glad you called! We were so worried!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mom's voice came through the speaker, her disturbance making her sound a little distorted.
entries.literal: "My mom's voice came through the speaker, her disturbance making her sound a little distorted."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Hello...! Are you there? What happened? You're okay, right?
entries.literal: "Hello...! Are you there? What happened? You're okay, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to speak, so I pressed the red button and cut the call, surprised to feel a sharp heartache as I did so.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to speak, so I pressed the red button and cut the call, surprised to feel a sharp heartache as I did so."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. The past can be changed. Atsuki was right.
entries.literal: "I see. The past can be changed. Atsuki was right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A call request appeared, "Mom" listed as the name.
entries.literal: "A call request appeared, \"Mom\" listed as the name."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't pick it up and simply waited it out.
entries.literal: "I didn't pick it up and simply waited it out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No other call came afterward.
entries.literal: "No other call came afterward."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They must've called the hospital.
entries.literal: "They must've called the hospital."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I let out a nervous breath and closed my phone.
entries.literal: "I let out a nervous breath and closed my phone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Why did I travel so many days back? That doesn't make sense. Were we wrong, and the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet wasn't what influenced the time traveled?
entries.literal: "...{w}Why did I travel so many days back? That doesn't make sense. Were we wrong, and the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet wasn't what influenced the time traveled?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's not possible that it spent enough time in the water tank to send me here. Either way, what's important is that I can replicate it.
entries.literal: "It's not possible that it spent enough time in the water tank to send me here. Either way, what's important is that I can replicate it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Before the 15th, if I'm not able to get the Sekimeiya, I can change the past and prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. The 15th is the only time where I'm guaranteed to be able to touch the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Before the 15th, if I'm not able to get the Sekimeiya, I can change the past and prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. The 15th is the only time where I'm guaranteed to be able to touch the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There'll be the attack, and people will fall unconscious, probably except the attacker. If that period of time isn't enough, I'll have twelve hours to use it, during which people will get trapped again.{w} If it comes down to it, I might have to think of how to take advantage of what happened. When the smoke went off, there were many places that weren't hit...
entries.literal: "There'll be the attack, and people will fall unconscious, probably except the attacker. If that period of time isn't enough, I'll have twelve hours to use it, during which people will get trapped again.{w} If it comes down to it, I might have to think of how to take advantage of what happened. When the smoke went off, there were many places that weren't hit..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Since the past can be changed... Even though the Sekimeiya must currently be in the tower to bait an attack from Xyn, it's possible that I'll be caught by the police if I try to go and touch it before the 15th. ...Just which option is better?
entries.literal: "Since the past can be changed... Even though the Sekimeiya must currently be in the tower to bait an attack from Xyn, it's possible that I'll be caught by the police if I try to go and touch it before the 15th. ...Just which option is better?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At least if I get trapped by myself on a night before the 15th, the only person trapped with me will be the person in the security room. I only need to learn how to jump days into the past, which should be a lot more feasible if there aren't seven other people there.
entries.literal: "At least if I get trapped by myself on a night before the 15th, the only person trapped with me will be the person in the security room. I only need to learn how to jump days into the past, which should be a lot more feasible if there aren't seven other people there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I really appeared just minutes too late to save Miiya. That's ridiculous.
entries.literal: "...I really appeared just minutes too late to save Miiya. That's ridiculous."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And instead of appearing instantly, I felt like I woke up. ...When I touched the Sekimeiya in the water tank, the heat around it was clearly a lot stronger than every other time. So the heat it releases is related to the distance traveled, but the way it increases might be different from what we thought.
entries.literal: "And instead of appearing instantly, I felt like I woke up. ...When I touched the Sekimeiya in the water tank, the heat around it was clearly a lot stronger than every other time. So the heat it releases is related to the distance traveled, but the way it increases might be different from what we thought."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I should probably try to eat something.
entries.literal: "...I should probably try to eat something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the kitchen. I didn't like cooking and I wasn't great at it, but I'd lately gotten used to making my own food, as I didn't have many alternatives.
entries.literal: "I went to the kitchen. I didn't like cooking and I wasn't great at it, but I'd lately gotten used to making my own food, as I didn't have many alternatives."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I'd been living at Atsuki's house, I'd only eaten by heating up prepared food that I couldn't afford. I opened the fridge, and as expected, there wasn't much to choose from. I was hungry due to walking around in the cold, so I wasn't picky.
entries.literal: "When I'd been living at Atsuki's house, I'd only eaten by heating up prepared food that I couldn't afford. I opened the fridge, and as expected, there wasn't much to choose from. I was hungry due to walking around in the cold, so I wasn't picky."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A bit of meat remained in a plastic tray. I really only kept buying it because my parents used to.{w} I grabbed it and looked at my side. Thankfully, the frying pan was clean.
entries.literal: "A bit of meat remained in a plastic tray. I really only kept buying it because my parents used to.{w} I grabbed it and looked at my side. Thankfully, the frying pan was clean."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I usually avoided using oil because the sizzling always startled me, and as a result, I'd basically stopped caring about eating things that were plain. I ignored the full bottle and heated up the empty pan for a few seconds. Then, I carefully placed the last pieces of meat on it and took a step back as they cooked.
entries.literal: "I usually avoided using oil because the sizzling always startled me, and as a result, I'd basically stopped caring about eating things that were plain. I ignored the full bottle and heated up the empty pan for a few seconds. Then, I carefully placed the last pieces of meat on it and took a step back as they cooked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After staring from a few steps back for a while, I used chopsticks to flip the chunks of meat around, forcefully ungluing them from the surface. I added salt and spice powder, garnished them the best I could, and cut it all up. The meal looked exactly like every other time I'd prepared it, and I brought it to the living room.
entries.literal: "After staring from a few steps back for a while, I used chopsticks to flip the chunks of meat around, forcefully ungluing them from the surface. I added salt and spice powder, garnished them the best I could, and cut it all up. The meal looked exactly like every other time I'd prepared it, and I brought it to the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the plate on the table and sat on a cushion.
entries.literal: "I left the plate on the table and sat on a cushion."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This doesn't even make sense. Where are the others?
entries.literal: "This doesn't even make sense. Where are the others?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought of something that should've come to mind much sooner.
entries.literal: "I thought of something that should've come to mind much sooner."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Atsuki, Erina, Sai, and maybe Akaro. A bunch of people who must have been outside the tower too. Where are they?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, Erina, Sai, and maybe Akaro. A bunch of people who must have been outside the tower too. Where are they?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I've been assuming I traveled alone, but that doesn't make any sense if we were at least right about one thing. If the range of the Sekimeiya was related to how far you went, there's no way the lobby wasn't included given that I traveled more than two weeks to the past.
entries.literal: "I've been assuming I traveled alone, but that doesn't make any sense if we were at least right about one thing. If the range of the Sekimeiya was related to how far you went, there's no way the lobby wasn't included given that I traveled more than two weeks to the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Where are they? I had to have made someone else travel with me, and everyone should've appeared at the same time that I did... but I'm also not sure I was immediately aware right after touching the Sekimeiya and passed out for a little while, so who knows when that would be?
entries.literal: "...Where are they? I had to have made someone else travel with me, and everyone should've appeared at the same time that I did... but I'm also not sure I was immediately aware right after touching the Sekimeiya and passed out for a little while, so who knows when that would be?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was our understanding of the range incorrect too? If the range equaled the size of a crystal room when we traveled less than an hour... traveling fifteen days must have meant it extended far outside the tower.
entries.literal: "Was our understanding of the range incorrect too? If the range equaled the size of a crystal room when we traveled less than an hour... traveling fifteen days must have meant it extended far outside the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed a slice of meat and brought it to my mouth.
entries.literal: "I grabbed a slice of meat and brought it to my mouth."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's not good at all.
entries.literal: "It's not good at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The taste was weird, but the spice did its job at obfuscating it.
entries.literal: "The taste was weird, but the spice did its job at obfuscating it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Ashiya and the police were right outside the tower. If they traveled to the past, I'm sure information about that would be widespread. There's no way a bunch of people traveling through time wouldn't create an uproar.
entries.literal: "...Ashiya and the police were right outside the tower. If they traveled to the past, I'm sure information about that would be widespread. There's no way a bunch of people traveling through time wouldn't create an uproar."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I appeared late on November 30th, where I'd been on that day. When we were in the tower, we thought about going ten minutes back but appearing where we'd been five minutes before traveling.{w} Did something like that happen again? Maybe I appeared at {time=21:10} where I'd been at {time=21:00}, so my old self wasn't there anymore. If I showed up exactly where I was at the time, I would've replaced my old self, and now I know that didn't happen.
entries.literal: "I appeared late on November 30th, where I'd been on that day. When we were in the tower, we thought about going ten minutes back but appearing where we'd been five minutes before traveling.{w} Did something like that happen again? Maybe I appeared at {time=21:10} where I'd been at {time=21:00}, so my old self wasn't there anymore. If I showed up exactly where I was at the time, I would've replaced my old self, and now I know that didn't happen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We definitely know that the location you appear is based on a past one. If multiple people from Ashiya or the police were sent to the past, they might have all appeared in the same area, like their workplace.
entries.literal: "We definitely know that the location you appear is based on a past one. If multiple people from Ashiya or the police were sent to the past, they might have all appeared in the same area, like their workplace."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even if I tried to explain it like that, it didn't make a ton of sense. The range had to be immense, not just big enough to encompass the policemen right outside.
entries.literal: "Even if I tried to explain it like that, it didn't make a ton of sense. The range had to be immense, not just big enough to encompass the policemen right outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I ate more, trying not to chew much. I wasn't sure if the meat was bland or just plain tasted bad, so I could avoid finding out by not biting into it.
entries.literal: "...I ate more, trying not to chew much. I wasn't sure if the meat was bland or just plain tasted bad, so I could avoid finding out by not biting into it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I bet we just were mistaken about the range as well. Or maybe it wasn't necessarily that. Maybe the range and the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet were related... that'd still make some sort of sense.
entries.literal: "I bet we just were mistaken about the range as well. Or maybe it wasn't necessarily that. Maybe the range and the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet were related... that'd still make some sort of sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Because again, when I touched it, it couldn't have been there for too long. And the range couldn't have been that large either, so the question should only be why I went so many days into the past.
