entries.literal: "Because again, when I touched it, it couldn't have been there for too long. And the range couldn't have been that large either, so the question should only be why I went so many days into the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if it's just random? We kinda let go of that thought because we didn't want it to be true, but it would make enough sense.
entries.literal: "What if it's just random? We kinda let go of that thought because we didn't want it to be true, but it would make enough sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped eating. The aftertaste was getting worse, and the hunger had somewhat faded.
entries.literal: "I stopped eating. The aftertaste was getting worse, and the hunger had somewhat faded."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This could be really bad.
entries.literal: "This could be really bad."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I was the only person who traveled, then everything I've thought should still apply. On the other hand, if a bunch of other people went with me and there's no news about it, I have no idea what will happen.
entries.literal: "If I was the only person who traveled, then everything I've thought should still apply. On the other hand, if a bunch of other people went with me and there's no news about it, I have no idea what will happen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Xyn members from the future could be here. They would know about the incident and about the secret alarm. And if they do, they know what to expect and would alter their plans on the 15th.
entries.literal: "Xyn members from the future could be here. They would know about the incident and about the secret alarm. And if they do, they know what to expect and would alter their plans on the 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even if Ashiya members or the police are here from the future, as long as they somewhat understand what happened, there's no guarantee the events of that day will happen again.
entries.literal: "Even if Ashiya members or the police are here from the future, as long as they somewhat understand what happened, there's no guarantee the events of that day will happen again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}If Sai also traveled, there's no way he won't try to steal the Sekimeiya before then, when nobody else seemed aware of its powers. I didn't consider that more people could be here with the same intentions that I have, aside from the original Xyn plan.
entries.literal: "...{w}If Sai also traveled, there's no way he won't try to steal the Sekimeiya before then, when nobody else seemed aware of its powers. I didn't consider that more people could be here with the same intentions that I have, aside from the original Xyn plan."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I bit my lip. If more people had traveled from the future, anyone could change the past, significantly obstructing me.
entries.literal: "I bit my lip. If more people had traveled from the future, anyone could change the past, significantly obstructing me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My phone insistently vibrated against the table. It was another incoming call.
entries.literal: "My phone insistently vibrated against the table. It was another incoming call."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I leaned in to look at the tiny screen on its back.
entries.literal: "I leaned in to look at the tiny screen on its back."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: My mother again... I imagine she was told I still haven't woken up.
entries.literal: "My mother again... I imagine she was told I still haven't woken up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I let the ringing continue, but it stopped very quickly.
entries.literal: "I let the ringing continue, but it stopped very quickly."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh...

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did she just hang up?
entries.literal: "Did she just hang up?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe not. Right now, my original phone should be next to me in the hospital. If the call showed up on both devices, it's possible someone picked it up from there and it stopped ringing here.
entries.literal: "Maybe not. Right now, my original phone should be next to me in the hospital. If the call showed up on both devices, it's possible someone picked it up from there and it stopped ringing here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I let myself fall back on the floor and waited to see if she'd call again.
entries.literal: "I let myself fall back on the floor and waited to see if she'd call again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There had been no new calls, and I hadn't sat back up. I'd been lying there for quite a while, so hunger started to claw at me again.
entries.literal: "There had been no new calls, and I hadn't sat back up. I'd been lying there for quite a while, so hunger started to claw at me again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd looked through my food supplies that morning, so I knew no instant noodles were left. I lay there for a while, with no strength to stand.
entries.literal: "I'd looked through my food supplies that morning, so I knew no instant noodles were left. I lay there for a while, with no strength to stand."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I go buy something? I don't mind spending the money that I have.
entries.literal: "Should I go buy something? I don't mind spending the money that I have."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Wait, I can't. It's Sunday.
entries.literal: "...Wait, I can't. It's Sunday."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed, both frustrated and relieved.
entries.literal: "I sighed, both frustrated and relieved."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept staring at the ceiling, noticing the sky turning dark through the gaps of the blinds. Thankfully, even though people lived on the other side of the walls, they tended to be very silent.
entries.literal: "I kept staring at the ceiling, noticing the sky turning dark through the gaps of the blinds. Thankfully, even though people lived on the other side of the walls, they tended to be very silent."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My phone vibrated again, even more briefly than before.
entries.literal: "My phone vibrated again, even more briefly than before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I finally got up, supporting my body with one arm. As I did so, I realized what that had been.
entries.literal: "...{w}I finally got up, supporting my body with one arm. As I did so, I realized what that had been."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, it's just gonna be that message.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's just gonna be that message."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I picked up my phone and flipped it open. As I'd thought, the expected message was on the screen, so I dismissed it with a button.
entries.literal: "I picked up my phone and flipped it open. As I'd thought, the expected message was on the screen, so I dismissed it with a button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Today at {time=9:51}, a deposit of ¥20,000 was transferred into your bank account. This will be reflected in 3 to 4 business days."{w} The time showed {time=17:57.}
entries.literal: "\"Today at {time=9:51}, a deposit of ¥20,000 was transferred into your bank account. This will be reflected in 3 to 4 business days.\"{w} The time showed {time=17:57.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I received that message on the first day of every month, with the monthly money my parents and I had agreed on. It said the payment had been confirmed in the morning, but it was normal for me to receive the message many hours later.
entries.literal: "I received that message on the first day of every month, with the monthly money my parents and I had agreed on. It said the payment had been confirmed in the morning, but it was normal for me to receive the message many hours later."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I remember seeing that message days after I woke up, so it just appeared on both phones. Either that, or back then I hadn't been living here and now it only appeared on this one...
entries.literal: "I remember seeing that message days after I woke up, so it just appeared on both phones. Either that, or back then I hadn't been living here and now it only appeared on this one..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could use this money if I need to. I didn't buy anything when I was staying at Atsuki's house, and I definitely didn't check my recent transactions, so it shouldn't be noticed if I take it.
entries.literal: "I could use this money if I need to. I didn't buy anything when I was staying at Atsuki's house, and I definitely didn't check my recent transactions, so it shouldn't be noticed if I take it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I yawned. Despite lying down for a while, I felt lethargic.
entries.literal: "I yawned. Despite lying down for a while, I felt lethargic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was still somewhat early, and the hunger had fully returned. However, I didn't feel like eating anything I had, and even less so like making it myself.
entries.literal: "It was still somewhat early, and the hunger had fully returned. However, I didn't feel like eating anything I had, and even less so like making it myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to drink some water and left the plate in the sink. The lingering warmth of the heater had almost disappeared, so I turned it back on.
entries.literal: "I went to drink some water and left the plate in the sink. The lingering warmth of the heater had almost disappeared, so I turned it back on."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess I'll buy more food tomorrow. If it's possible that more people traveled to the past with me, and I intend to try to find the Sekimeiya before the 15th, I should do it as soon as possible, before anyone else who's possibly here can beat me to it.
entries.literal: "I guess I'll buy more food tomorrow. If it's possible that more people traveled to the past with me, and I intend to try to find the Sekimeiya before the 15th, I should do it as soon as possible, before anyone else who's possibly here can beat me to it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even with the heater on, I had to sleep with nightwear during the winter. I was tired enough to go to bed, so I put it on.
entries.literal: "Even with the heater on, I had to sleep with nightwear during the winter. I was tired enough to go to bed, so I put it on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No light was coming from the window. The sun had set very early, giving me the impression that it was already time to sleep.
entries.literal: "No light was coming from the window. The sun had set very early, giving me the impression that it was already time to sleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lowered the blinds, which I'd forgotten to do the previous night.
entries.literal: "I lowered the blinds, which I'd forgotten to do the previous night."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I turned off the light and made my way under the blankets in the dark.
entries.literal: "Then, I turned off the light and made my way under the blankets in the dark."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As always, I left my phone on the bedside table next to me so that I could check the time after waking up or to set an alarm.{w} I hugged the pillow and closed my eyes.
entries.literal: "As always, I left my phone on the bedside table next to me so that I could check the time after waking up or to set an alarm.{w} I hugged the pillow and closed my eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had been a pretty messy day. Aside from the arriving from the future aspect, I'd had many similar days that year.
entries.literal: "It had been a pretty messy day. Aside from the arriving from the future aspect, I'd had many similar days that year."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The reason why I'd been able to relax and enjoy the tranquility was probably simple. My preoccupations were much different from the usual.
entries.literal: "The reason why I'd been able to relax and enjoy the tranquility was probably simple. My preoccupations were much different from the usual."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those days were bound to end. I'd eventually have to find a job or study far from home. The weeks without obligations were ideal, but the feeling of wasting them was what made them stressful. I'd rarely been able to feel so calm, even though I still had very serious concerns on my mind.{w} I hated thinking about it, but what would I do in the future? My parents wouldn't keep sending me money for many more months, so what job could I find? I was only a little interested in studying medicine, but I didn't want to move, and I'd have to spend years and years pursuing it. Of course, it was expensive too, so I felt I had to completely discard the idea.
entries.literal: "Those days were bound to end. I'd eventually have to find a job or study far from home. The weeks without obligations were ideal, but the feeling of wasting them was what made them stressful. I'd rarely been able to feel so calm, even though I still had very serious concerns on my mind.{w} I hated thinking about it, but what would I do in the future? My parents wouldn't keep sending me money for many more months, so what job could I find? I was only a little interested in studying medicine, but I didn't want to move, and I'd have to spend years and years pursuing it. Of course, it was expensive too, so I felt I had to completely discard the idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What I had to do was very important. I had to erase Miiya's death and make sure Atsuki wouldn't go to the tower. If I could travel to the past and win the lottery, I would do it. It wasn't an answer I'd ever imagined, but it was perfect.
entries.literal: "What I had to do was very important. I had to erase Miiya's death and make sure Atsuki wouldn't go to the tower. If I could travel to the past and win the lottery, I would do it. It wasn't an answer I'd ever imagined, but it was perfect."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It's almost perfect. There's this huge problem.
entries.literal: "...It's almost perfect. There's this huge problem."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The past can be changed, but the way it happens... even if I am able to save Miiya, two versions of myself will remain.
entries.literal: "The past can be changed, but the way it happens... even if I am able to save Miiya, two versions of myself will remain."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}I have to assume that's how it'd work. It's the most logical answer, isn't it? Neither of us would blink out of existence.
entries.literal: "...{w}I have to assume that's how it'd work. It's the most logical answer, isn't it? Neither of us would blink out of existence."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What would I do? Claim my lottery prize and go live on the other side of the world while the other version of me stays with Atsuki and Miiya?
entries.literal: "What would I do? Claim my lottery prize and go live on the other side of the world while the other version of me stays with Atsuki and Miiya?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't want that. It sounds ridiculous too.
entries.literal: "I don't want that. It sounds ridiculous too."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is there even a solution here?
entries.literal: "Is there even a solution here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suddenly felt the same way I did every time I thought about my future. Neither answer was any good at all.
entries.literal: "I suddenly felt the same way I did every time I thought about my future. Neither answer was any good at all."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no way around it, right? I couldn't just show up in front of the three of them and explain everything, could I...?
entries.literal: "There's no way around it, right? I couldn't just show up in front of the three of them and explain everything, could I...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In a reality after saving Miiya, the Sekimeiya would still exist, and it's not like its existence could stay a secret. I have no idea what would happen.
entries.literal: "In a reality after saving Miiya, the Sekimeiya would still exist, and it's not like its existence could stay a secret. I have no idea what would happen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess that if I can get to the Sekimeiya before the 15th, I could get it again after Miiya is safe. At the very least, if I had it, that'd prove that I'm right, and nobody else could steal it from Ashiya later on. ...I doubt I'd be questioned if I appear in front of another version of myself, though.
entries.literal: "I guess that if I can get to the Sekimeiya before the 15th, I could get it again after Miiya is safe. At the very least, if I had it, that'd prove that I'm right, and nobody else could steal it from Ashiya later on. ...I doubt I'd be questioned if I appear in front of another version of myself, though."

entries.text: Excavation
entries.literal: "Excavation"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it morning?
entries.literal: "Is it morning?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the window behind me. Through the upper gaps of the blinds, faint light was entering the bedroom.
entries.literal: "I looked at the window behind me. Through the upper gaps of the blinds, faint light was entering the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd slept well, and likely for a long time.
entries.literal: "I'd slept well, and likely for a long time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: One day closer to the 15th. I'm just in a countdown.
entries.literal: "One day closer to the 15th. I'm just in a countdown."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wonder where the Sekimeiya is now. If Xyn has already failed to steal it once, are they already planning their daylight attack?
entries.literal: "I wonder where the Sekimeiya is now. If Xyn has already failed to steal it once, are they already planning their daylight attack?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat up and leaned against the pillow. The room was still pleasantly warm, a luxury I appreciated.
entries.literal: "I sat up and leaned against the pillow. The room was still pleasantly warm, a luxury I appreciated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached for my phone to look at the time.{w} It showed {time=9:07}, confirming how long I'd slept.
entries.literal: "I reached for my phone to look at the time.{w} It showed {time=9:07}, confirming how long I'd slept."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Katei said that the Sekimeiya had been found recently on a nearby mountain. Could that be true, though? Was a stone with time traveling powers on a mountain next to Yushibana?
entries.literal: "...Katei said that the Sekimeiya had been found recently on a nearby mountain. Could that be true, though? Was a stone with time traveling powers on a mountain next to Yushibana?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It doesn't even make sense. The place he described would have been close to where Atsuki and I used to go as kids. That place is mostly ignored nowadays because it lacks caves. If the Sekimeiya was found there, it shouldn't have been inside the mountain.
entries.literal: "It doesn't even make sense. The place he described would have been close to where Atsuki and I used to go as kids. That place is mostly ignored nowadays because it lacks caves. If the Sekimeiya was found there, it shouldn't have been inside the mountain."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's really strange, though. It's been snowing a lot recently... If the Sekimeiya was simply sitting around, it would've been deep under the snow.
entries.literal: "That's really strange, though. It's been snowing a lot recently... If the Sekimeiya was simply sitting around, it would've been deep under the snow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...So either Katei's story was false, or the Sekimeiya had been recently left there and wasn't completely buried by the falling snow when someone found it.
entries.literal: "...So either Katei's story was false, or the Sekimeiya had been recently left there and wasn't completely buried by the falling snow when someone found it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Neither option makes much sense. Why would it be put there? It's rare for anyone to go up there, so maybe they expected it to not be found. But that's insanely coincidental.
entries.literal: "Neither option makes much sense. Why would it be put there? It's rare for anyone to go up there, so maybe they expected it to not be found. But that's insanely coincidental."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Just a few days ago, where was the Sekimeiya? I can't seriously think that it was on that mountain for all the years I've lived here.
entries.literal: "Just a few days ago, where was the Sekimeiya? I can't seriously think that it was on that mountain for all the years I've lived here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What exactly is the likelihood that it was left there recently? Maybe there actually could be a reason behind that.
entries.literal: "What exactly is the likelihood that it was left there recently? Maybe there actually could be a reason behind that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I languidly reached for my phone again and opened it. On the screen was an icon that I hadn't clicked on for a very long time. It said "browser".
entries.literal: "I languidly reached for my phone again and opened it. On the screen was an icon that I hadn't clicked on for a very long time. It said \"browser\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My phone could connect to the internet at all times. It was extremely slow, and I never used it. Before my parents had left, we had local internet access, but they shut it down once they took their laptop away.
entries.literal: "My phone could connect to the internet at all times. It was extremely slow, and I never used it. Before my parents had left, we had local internet access, but they shut it down once they took their laptop away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pressed the button and waited for a white screen to load. I had to look away from the glaring brightness, falling back onto the pillow.
entries.literal: "I pressed the button and waited for a white screen to load. I had to look away from the glaring brightness, falling back onto the pillow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Weeks ago, who had the Sekimeiya? If someone had it, is it possible it was already given that name? I don't think Katei mentioned who named it. ...If I recall correctly, he said that it was found on the 27th, and Ashiya announced the event on the 29th, three days ago.
entries.literal: "Weeks ago, who had the Sekimeiya? If someone had it, is it possible it was already given that name? I don't think Katei mentioned who named it. ...If I recall correctly, he said that it was found on the 27th, and Ashiya announced the event on the 29th, three days ago."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I search for the word "Sekimeiya", I'll probably just find mentions of Ashiya's announcement. I wonder if I could find an instance of that word from before the 29th.
entries.literal: "If I search for the word \"Sekimeiya\", I'll probably just find mentions of Ashiya's announcement. I wonder if I could find an instance of that word from before the 29th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The search engine loaded, and I considered what to type into it.
entries.literal: "The search engine loaded, and I considered what to type into it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it possible I'll find traces of the people who want to steal it? I wonder... if what happened on the 30th was an attempt to steal the Sekimeiya, even though it wasn't publicly stated, could there be any mention of this somewhere online?
entries.literal: "Is it possible I'll find traces of the people who want to steal it? I wonder... if what happened on the 30th was an attempt to steal the Sekimeiya, even though it wasn't publicly stated, could there be any mention of this somewhere online?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew Ashiya's announcements would cover up what I wanted to find, so I set the results of the search to be ordered by oldest first, to truly find the first recorded instance of the word. I typed "Sekimeiya" and pressed the search button.
entries.literal: "I knew Ashiya's announcements would cover up what I wanted to find, so I set the results of the search to be ordered by oldest first, to truly find the first recorded instance of the word. I typed \"Sekimeiya\" and pressed the search button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The white screen returned with a slowly-filling blue bar on top, which I patiently watched finish.
entries.literal: "The white screen returned with a slowly-filling blue bar on top, which I patiently watched finish."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lost myself in anticipation, forgetting to even blink. Just when had the word "Sekimeiya" been recorded for the first time? I doubted I would find valuable information about Xyn, but that shouldn't have been out of the question either.
entries.literal: "I lost myself in anticipation, forgetting to even blink. Just when had the word \"Sekimeiya\" been recorded for the first time? I doubted I would find valuable information about Xyn, but that shouldn't have been out of the question either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The results all appeared at once. I glanced at all of them hastily, reading common page titles in blue reporting Ashiya's announcement on the 29th.
entries.literal: "The results all appeared at once. I glanced at all of them hastily, reading common page titles in blue reporting Ashiya's announcement on the 29th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Wait, what's this?{w} ...The Sekimeiya incident might happen soon...?
entries.literal: "...Wait, what's this?{w} ...The Sekimeiya incident might happen soon...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the very first entry. Below it, in gray, I read the creation date.
entries.literal: "It was the very first entry. Below it, in gray, I read the creation date."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Written on the 24th of November... Did I find it?
entries.literal: "Written on the 24th of November... Did I find it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pressed down once to highlight the text and then clicked on "OK". Once again, the screen turned white and began to slowly load the page.
entries.literal: "I pressed down once to highlight the text and then clicked on \"OK\". Once again, the screen turned white and began to slowly load the page."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There'd been a brief preview below the title, but I'd advanced before reading it fully. However, it seemed that whoever wrote it was pretty disconcerted.
entries.literal: "There'd been a brief preview below the title, but I'd advanced before reading it fully. However, it seemed that whoever wrote it was pretty disconcerted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited for the screen to transition, blocking out anything else in my field of view. Meanwhile, I looked at the URL of the website and recognized it as a well-known forum used worldwide.
entries.literal: "I waited for the screen to transition, blocking out anything else in my field of view. Meanwhile, I looked at the URL of the website and recognized it as a well-known forum used worldwide."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The loading speed seemed much slower that time, and I worried it would just hang. I held my breath every time the progress bar froze.
entries.literal: "The loading speed seemed much slower that time, and I worried it would just hang. I held my breath every time the progress bar froze."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The screen turned gray, and the header of the website appeared. Instants later, the rest of its contents popped up in a flash.
entries.literal: "The screen turned gray, and the header of the website appeared. Instants later, the rest of its contents popped up in a flash."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I relaxed my eyes, the darker screen reducing the strain. Then, I attempted to read the two blocks of text below the title, displayed in minuscule letters.
entries.literal: "I relaxed my eyes, the darker screen reducing the strain. Then, I attempted to read the two blocks of text below the title, displayed in minuscule letters."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I swear this is all the truth, I'm not messing around. I'm a bit scared, though, and I'm not sure what to do. I think I just woke up from a really strange dream. It felt hyperrealistic, and I'm still shaking..."
entries.literal: "\"I swear this is all the truth, I'm not messing around. I'm a bit scared, though, and I'm not sure what to do. I think I just woke up from a really strange dream. It felt hyperrealistic, and I'm still shaking...\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I don't know if it means anything. Maybe it was a premonition, I'm not sure. However, I'd be careful on the 15th of next month. If I don't say this anonymously, I'll be laughed at, or even fired... On the 15th, Ashiya will hold a big event in the tower, and there'll be a terrorist attack."
entries.literal: "\"I don't know if it means anything. Maybe it was a premonition, I'm not sure. However, I'd be careful on the 15th of next month. If I don't say this anonymously, I'll be laughed at, or even fired... On the 15th, Ashiya will hold a big event in the tower, and there'll be a terrorist attack.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "It will be called... the Sekimeiya."
entries.literal: "\"It will be called... the Sekimeiya.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Soon, maybe they will announce it. I don't think I'm a prophet or anything, but I'm still trying to calm down. This time, it felt too real to let it pass."
entries.literal: "\"Soon, maybe they will announce it. I don't think I'm a prophet or anything, but I'm still trying to calm down. This time, it felt too real to let it pass.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Speechless, I scrolled the page down so that I could read the entirety of the following paragraph.
entries.literal: "Speechless, I scrolled the page down so that I could read the entirety of the following paragraph."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "That's what I dreamed. It's so bizarre I still think it might've really happened. That's why I feel the need to post it, in case it actually means something. Do not go to that event if it happens. Some people even got trapped inside, but I don't know what happened to them."
entries.literal: "\"That's what I dreamed. It's so bizarre I still think it might've really happened. That's why I feel the need to post it, in case it actually means something. Do not go to that event if it happens. Some people even got trapped inside, but I don't know what happened to them.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I think something might be wrong with me... I don't know why, but I'm not home. I can hardly believe it's still the 24th, and I don't know what I'm doing at my parents' house."
entries.literal: "\"I think something might be wrong with me... I don't know why, but I'm not home. I can hardly believe it's still the 24th, and I don't know what I'm doing at my parents' house.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Sorry to rant about this, but I need to let it out somewhere. I've been suffering from a few mental issues, but nothing has been as bad as this. I've been living alone for two years while my condition has gotten worse and worse. I feel I can't continue on my own, and letting people around me know it might be a horrible idea."
entries.literal: "\"Sorry to rant about this, but I need to let it out somewhere. I've been suffering from a few mental issues, but nothing has been as bad as this. I've been living alone for two years while my condition has gotten worse and worse. I feel I can't continue on my own, and letting people around me know it might be a horrible idea.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Anyway, maybe some of you will have some advice. I know posting here isn't the most effective thing, but it's very hard for me to talk about this out loud. Thank you for reading."
entries.literal: "\"Anyway, maybe some of you will have some advice. I know posting here isn't the most effective thing, but it's very hard for me to talk about this out loud. Thank you for reading.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was where it ended. I looked at the username on the post and read "7md_ag".
entries.literal: "That was where it ended. I looked at the username on the post and read \"7md_ag\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Astonished, I read through it all again.
entries.literal: "Astonished, I read through it all again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Who is this?{w} There's no way it's from the people who organized the attack. The Sekimeiya hadn't been given to Ashiya yet, and they wouldn't know people will get trapped since the alarm's existence was supposed to be a secret.
entries.literal: "...{w}Who is this?{w} There's no way it's from the people who organized the attack. The Sekimeiya hadn't been given to Ashiya yet, and they wouldn't know people will get trapped since the alarm's existence was supposed to be a secret."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could it be that someone from Ashiya posted this? If not, they must not have seen it, because it reveals that someone knew about the alarm. ...Even though Ashiya didn't have the Sekimeiya on the 24th, is it possible this person knew they'd obtain a gem to use as bait and what they'd name it?
entries.literal: "Could it be that someone from Ashiya posted this? If not, they must not have seen it, because it reveals that someone knew about the alarm. ...Even though Ashiya didn't have the Sekimeiya on the 24th, is it possible this person knew they'd obtain a gem to use as bait and what they'd name it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...There's no way. This can only be one thing.{w} ...Someone who traveled from the future—from the 15th. If it's not that, whoever posted this knew about the Sekimeiya's powers.
entries.literal: "...There's no way. This can only be one thing.{w} ...Someone who traveled from the future—from the 15th. If it's not that, whoever posted this knew about the Sekimeiya's powers."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: "I can hardly believe it's still the 24th, and I don't know what I'm doing at my parents' house." Did they appear there from the future...?
entries.literal: "\"I can hardly believe it's still the 24th, and I don't know what I'm doing at my parents' house.\" Did they appear there from the future...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: "Some people even got trapped inside, but I don't know what happened to them."{w} ...If I'm right, this person must have been outside of the tower. They knew some of us had gotten trapped, but not what was happening inside. Then, before {time=21}, they traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "\"Some people even got trapped inside, but I don't know what happened to them.\"{w} ...If I'm right, this person must have been outside of the tower. They knew some of us had gotten trapped, but not what was happening inside. Then, before {time=21}, they traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about that for a while. Was it possible such a thing had happened?
entries.literal: "I thought about that for a while. Was it possible such a thing had happened?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If they were outside the tower and suddenly traveled, did people see that? Did someone from inside the building travel to the 24th and bring this person with them?{w} That can't be, right? It's the same thing I thought about regarding my own travel. It would've had an immense range, and it would've picked up so many more people, including me.
entries.literal: "If they were outside the tower and suddenly traveled, did people see that? Did someone from inside the building travel to the 24th and bring this person with them?{w} That can't be, right? It's the same thing I thought about regarding my own travel. It would've had an immense range, and it would've picked up so many more people, including me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe I have this wrong. If the recording was genuine, the exit wouldn't have unlocked after {time=21.} That could be why this person doesn't know what happened to us, and they could've traveled after the 15th. Maybe when they did, nobody else was outside the tower, and that's why only one person traveled.
entries.literal: "Maybe I have this wrong. If the recording was genuine, the exit wouldn't have unlocked after {time=21.} That could be why this person doesn't know what happened to us, and they could've traveled after the 15th. Maybe when they did, nobody else was outside the tower, and that's why only one person traveled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got really confused. None of my ideas seemed very reasonable.
entries.literal: "I got really confused. None of my ideas seemed very reasonable."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Does this confirm that what we thought about the range was completely wrong? Now it's not only my travel that doesn't make sense.
entries.literal: "Does this confirm that what we thought about the range was completely wrong? Now it's not only my travel that doesn't make sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no way this person knew all this without being present on the 15th. Even if they somehow knew what would happen, what's the reason to post it online? The only people who would know about the alarm ahead of time would be Xyn members or Ashiya, two groups that would never publicly post this. Traveling from the future and posting it makes far more sense.
entries.literal: "There's no way this person knew all this without being present on the 15th. Even if they somehow knew what would happen, what's the reason to post it online? The only people who would know about the alarm ahead of time would be Xyn members or Ashiya, two groups that would never publicly post this. Traveling from the future and posting it makes far more sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I read it one more time, and what they described sounded exactly like they had been sent fairly far back in time.
entries.literal: "I read it one more time, and what they described sounded exactly like they had been sent fairly far back in time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But if that's it, who made that travel happen? Whoever did would've disappeared from the tower.{w} ...Was it Akaro?{w} When we left the attic's bedroom, we found the Sekimeiya powered off in a hallway B room. After that time, I didn't see Akaro again, and he could've touched it. ...Also, the rest of us but Sai were in the attic, so maybe that's why we didn't travel alongside Akaro.
entries.literal: "But if that's it, who made that travel happen? Whoever did would've disappeared from the tower.{w} ...Was it Akaro?{w} When we left the attic's bedroom, we found the Sekimeiya powered off in a hallway B room. After that time, I didn't see Akaro again, and he could've touched it. ...Also, the rest of us but Sai were in the attic, so maybe that's why we didn't travel alongside Akaro."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But... much later, Atsuki said that he'd seen him.{w} ...Maybe I'm wrong. If the range isn't an obstacle, anyone could've gone so far back. Then, they either could've reentered through the storeroom or been inside since that morning.
entries.literal: "But... much later, Atsuki said that he'd seen him.{w} ...Maybe I'm wrong. If the range isn't an obstacle, anyone could've gone so far back. Then, they either could've reentered through the storeroom or been inside since that morning."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's also possible the Sekimeiya was taken out through the storeroom at some point, and that's how this person traveled without affecting anyone nearby.
entries.literal: "It's also possible the Sekimeiya was taken out through the storeroom at some point, and that's how this person traveled without affecting anyone nearby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}If this person was outside the tower and went to the past alongside someone who activated the Sekimeiya, would they have thought that they'd experienced a hyperrealistic dream? That sounds pretty strange, but I suppose there aren't many more interpretations. They don't exactly seem to have a record of being mentally stable...
entries.literal: "...{w}If this person was outside the tower and went to the past alongside someone who activated the Sekimeiya, would they have thought that they'd experienced a hyperrealistic dream? That sounds pretty strange, but I suppose there aren't many more interpretations. They don't exactly seem to have a record of being mentally stable..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So did this thread always exist? Did the event still occur when the Sekimeiya's existence had been foreseen days before its announcement because nobody saw this? Did this person not try to make waves once it was announced...?
entries.literal: "So did this thread always exist? Did the event still occur when the Sekimeiya's existence had been foreseen days before its announcement because nobody saw this? Did this person not try to make waves once it was announced...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to keep scrolling down and realized that the page was larger than I'd thought.
entries.literal: "I tried to keep scrolling down and realized that the page was larger than I'd thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Below the initial post was a short reply.{w} "Yeah, right? If you can see the future, do me a favor and PM me tomorrow's lottery numbers. That'd be sick. I'd make a nice long reservation at that comfy Damski resort place, always wanted to go."
entries.literal: "Below the initial post was a short reply.{w} \"Yeah, right? If you can see the future, do me a favor and PM me tomorrow's lottery numbers. That'd be sick. I'd make a nice long reservation at that comfy Damski resort place, always wanted to go.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The poster was "IloveAgathodaemon". I went down farther and saw another reply by the original poster.
entries.literal: "...The poster was \"IloveAgathodaemon\". I went down farther and saw another reply by the original poster."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I'm telling the truth. I've cooled off, but I still feel like I shouldn't be here. I am not the crazy one. I just spoke to my parents, and they also said I shouldn't be here. There is no way it's the 24th. I can't believe any of this."
entries.literal: "\"I'm telling the truth. I've cooled off, but I still feel like I shouldn't be here. I am not the crazy one. I just spoke to my parents, and they also said I shouldn't be here. There is no way it's the 24th. I can't believe any of this.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next reply had been posted one day later. Below it, the dated entry showed it had been sent on the 25th of November, at {time=20.}
entries.literal: "The next reply had been posted one day later. Below it, the dated entry showed it had been sent on the 25th of November, at {time=20.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "But where's my lottery number? I was excited to go buy my ticket. I don't know if you're just bored, but there's not much time until the 15th. Don't worry. I promise you I won't go if what you're saying happens."
entries.literal: "\"But where's my lottery number? I was excited to go buy my ticket. I don't know if you're just bored, but there's not much time until the 15th. Don't worry. I promise you I won't go if what you're saying happens.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, a third person had left a comment. Their name was "RentALiver".
entries.literal: "Next, a third person had left a comment. Their name was \"RentALiver\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Are you someone from Sasameyuki? Is this what you all do now? If this event at the skyscraper is actually announced, it'll confirm I'm right. Are you trying to scare people off from going? I bet you're not even from Yushibana."
entries.literal: "\"Are you someone from Sasameyuki? Is this what you all do now? If this event at the skyscraper is actually announced, it'll confirm I'm right. Are you trying to scare people off from going? I bet you're not even from Yushibana.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned and tried to remember what I knew about that name.
entries.literal: "I frowned and tried to remember what I knew about that name."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that a company Ashiya had a conflict with? ...That has to be it. They're not from Yushibana, which must be why this person's saying that.
entries.literal: "Is that a company Ashiya had a conflict with? ...That has to be it. They're not from Yushibana, which must be why this person's saying that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was another reply posted early on the 26th by the original poster.
entries.literal: "There was another reply posted early on the 26th by the original poster."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I am from Yushibana. It's where I am right now. I just came back from my parents', but my memories of the days leading up to the 15th only intensified. It's impossible I dreamed all that. I really have no idea what happened to me."
entries.literal: "\"I am from Yushibana. It's where I am right now. I just came back from my parents', but my memories of the days leading up to the 15th only intensified. It's impossible I dreamed all that. I really have no idea what happened to me.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...A picture?
entries.literal: "...A picture?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Below that comment, there was an attached picture that just finished loading. It was from high up, and you could see the tower in the distance, its surroundings all lightly covered by snow.
entries.literal: "Below that comment, there was an attached picture that just finished loading. It was from high up, and you could see the tower in the distance, its surroundings all lightly covered by snow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This was taken in Yushibana. I see, they posted this to show that they live here.
entries.literal: "This was taken in Yushibana. I see, they posted this to show that they live here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I scrolled down more and came to a yellow line of text saying "This topic has been locked. You cannot post a new reply."
entries.literal: "I scrolled down more and came to a yellow line of text saying \"This topic has been locked. You cannot post a new reply.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is all there is...
entries.literal: "This is all there is..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This person definitely traveled from the 15th. They even said their memories end there, so that's the day they went to the past.
entries.literal: "This person definitely traveled from the 15th. They even said their memories end there, so that's the day they went to the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It doesn't make sense, though. How did that happen...?
entries.literal: "It doesn't make sense, though. How did that happen...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And did this thread change the past, or did it always exist and the incident occurred anyway?
entries.literal: "And did this thread change the past, or did it always exist and the incident occurred anyway?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It seems so strange... What if Xyn gets in touch with this person after Ashiya announces the Sekimeiya event, and that's how they'll learn about the alarm? That'd be a paradox, but maybe it's possible.
entries.literal: "It seems so strange... What if Xyn gets in touch with this person after Ashiya announces the Sekimeiya event, and that's how they'll learn about the alarm? That'd be a paradox, but maybe it's possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I selected the username "7md_ag" and pulled up the profile.
entries.literal: "I selected the username \"7md_ag\" and pulled up the profile."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The page loaded much more quickly. A history of the account activity appeared before me, but unfortunately, they hadn't posted anything after their last reply.
entries.literal: "The page loaded much more quickly. A history of the account activity appeared before me, but unfortunately, they hadn't posted anything after their last reply."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a little dizzy after reading all of that, probably thanks to not having eaten much the previous day. Sapped of energy, I got out of bed and steadied myself.
entries.literal: "I felt a little dizzy after reading all of that, probably thanks to not having eaten much the previous day. Sapped of energy, I got out of bed and steadied myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I picked out some fresh clothing and stepped to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "I picked out some fresh clothing and stepped to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I still don't have anything to eat.
entries.literal: "...I still don't have anything to eat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could feel the demands of my stomach. Given the unpleasant meat I'd cooked, it wanted something actually edible.
entries.literal: "I could feel the demands of my stomach. Given the unpleasant meat I'd cooked, it wanted something actually edible."

entries.text: It's really early... I should just go to the grocery store. Better watch out for no low-quality cuts of meat before I buy them, though...
entries.literal: "It's really early... I should just go to the grocery store. Better watch out for no low-quality cuts of meat before I buy them, though..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sidnoc was a grocery close to my apartment that I visited often, and that was my target for the time being. I knew I wouldn't be able to think properly before eating something filling.
entries.literal: "Sidnoc was a grocery close to my apartment that I visited often, and that was my target for the time being. I knew I wouldn't be able to think properly before eating something filling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I drank some chilly bottled water and approached the heater.
entries.literal: "I drank some chilly bottled water and approached the heater."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess I can leave it on. I'll be really cold once I come back.
entries.literal: "I guess I can leave it on. I'll be really cold once I come back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed my purse in the living room. In the entrance, I made sure I wasn't forgetting anything and picked up my keys. I had my wallet too, so I put on the boots and coat I'd left next to the door.
entries.literal: "I grabbed my purse in the living room. In the entrance, I made sure I wasn't forgetting anything and picked up my keys. I had my wallet too, so I put on the boots and coat I'd left next to the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't snowing that day either, and my street seemed empty.{w} I went down the stairs and walked ahead. The direction was the same I'd taken the previous day, but Sidnoc was located before the center of Yushibana.
entries.literal: "It wasn't snowing that day either, and my street seemed empty.{w} I went down the stairs and walked ahead. The direction was the same I'd taken the previous day, but Sidnoc was located before the center of Yushibana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recognized the wide tire marks on the snow. Once a week, a garbage truck would pass through my street to collect the grouped-up cans farther ahead.
entries.literal: "I recognized the wide tire marks on the snow. Once a week, a garbage truck would pass through my street to collect the grouped-up cans farther ahead."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess the lady at the store also knows me.
entries.literal: "I guess the lady at the store also knows me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know her name, or if she was the owner of the place or just a cashier, but she was usually there when I went. I wondered if she'd say anything, as I'd never really spoken to her.
entries.literal: "I didn't know her name, or if she was the owner of the place or just a cashier, but she was usually there when I went. I wondered if she'd say anything, as I'd never really spoken to her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Normally, after leaving my house with the heater on, the outside would feel very cold. It was a little bit warmer than I expected, so I kept a steady pace.
entries.literal: "Normally, after leaving my house with the heater on, the outside would feel very cold. It was a little bit warmer than I expected, so I kept a steady pace."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw more clouds above me, as white as the ground. ...After walking for a bit, I still hadn't seen anyone on the street.
entries.literal: "I saw more clouds above me, as white as the ground. ...After walking for a bit, I still hadn't seen anyone on the street."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...After firmly pressing down on the snow with a step, I brought myself to a halt.
entries.literal: "...After firmly pressing down on the snow with a step, I brought myself to a halt."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still looking upward, I was staring at the structure that reached higher than the others. I'd seen it throughout my entire life, but I'd only recently entered it for the first time.
entries.literal: "Still looking upward, I was staring at the structure that reached higher than the others. I'd seen it throughout my entire life, but I'd only recently entered it for the first time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remembered having been told before that it was visible from any place in Yushibana, and I'd just seen it was the truth.
entries.literal: "I remembered having been told before that it was visible from any place in Yushibana, and I'd just seen it was the truth."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess when we were inside of it, all of Yushibana could see us.
entries.literal: "I guess when we were inside of it, all of Yushibana could see us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From where I was, I could only see a few of the higher windows, but it was enough to notice that there were no shutters covering them.
entries.literal: "From where I was, I could only see a few of the higher windows, but it was enough to notice that there were no shutters covering them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at it for a while, my mind blank. It seemed there was no light on the other side of the windows. As Katei had said, nobody had been recently working on those floors.
entries.literal: "I looked at it for a while, my mind blank. It seemed there was no light on the other side of the windows. As Katei had said, nobody had been recently working on those floors."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shook it off and kept going. I was already pretty close.
entries.literal: "I shook it off and kept going. I was already pretty close."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I got closer to the busier center of town, more and more tire marks crisscrossed the snow. I could see the shop ahead of me, and I shortly arrived in front of it.
entries.literal: "As I got closer to the busier center of town, more and more tire marks crisscrossed the snow. I could see the shop ahead of me, and I shortly arrived in front of it."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Hello.
entries.literal: "Hello."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Good morning.
entries.literal: "...Good morning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked past her. The streets had been desolate, but I saw someone I didn't recognize picking up cereal in an aisle.
entries.literal: "I walked past her. The streets had been desolate, but I saw someone I didn't recognize picking up cereal in an aisle."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...She didn't say anything.
entries.literal: "...She didn't say anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I figured not everyone had seen the news, and even if she had, she didn't have to mention it. I knew where everything was, so I kept walking as I wondered what to get.
entries.literal: "I figured not everyone had seen the news, and even if she had, she didn't have to mention it. I knew where everything was, so I kept walking as I wondered what to get."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really wanted to use my time well, and I never felt like cooking. I stopped in front of the stand full of instant food.
entries.literal: "I really wanted to use my time well, and I never felt like cooking. I stopped in front of the stand full of instant food."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'll get tired of these if it's the only thing I buy. ...They're all instant noodles.
entries.literal: "I'll get tired of these if it's the only thing I buy. ...They're all instant noodles."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned a little, but there was nothing to worry about. On the 8th, I'd gone home from the hospital, but it had been late, and I'd eaten a little before leaving. I didn't think I'd checked the kitchen where I could've seen my food supply.
entries.literal: "I frowned a little, but there was nothing to worry about. On the 8th, I'd gone home from the hospital, but it had been late, and I'd eaten a little before leaving. I didn't think I'd checked the kitchen where I could've seen my food supply."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And even if I did, I could simply be changing the past now.
entries.literal: "And even if I did, I could simply be changing the past now."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It keeps occurring, though. I went to buy food without the intention to change the past, and it happened to match what I already lived through once. Maybe it really is correct that everything will happen as it did if I don't purposely think about changing anything.
entries.literal: "It keeps occurring, though. I went to buy food without the intention to change the past, and it happened to match what I already lived through once. Maybe it really is correct that everything will happen as it did if I don't purposely think about changing anything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But that also doesn't make complete sense. I've already made one change by calling my mom, so now "everything" can't really happen as it did as long as I don't intend otherwise. Down the line, more things are bound to differ...
entries.literal: "But that also doesn't make complete sense. I've already made one change by calling my mom, so now \"everything\" can't really happen as it did as long as I don't intend otherwise. Down the line, more things are bound to differ..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed, picked up a few packs of instant noodles without any special flavoring, and wandered around the shop.
entries.literal: "I sighed, picked up a few packs of instant noodles without any special flavoring, and wandered around the shop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't grabbed a cart, so I soon found myself carrying noodles, cookies, milk, chips, almonds, and my favorite cereal bars.
entries.literal: "I hadn't grabbed a cart, so I soon found myself carrying noodles, cookies, milk, chips, almonds, and my favorite cereal bars."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I should get meat too.
entries.literal: "...I should get meat too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a little reluctant to buy more after the two nasty pieces I'd eaten.
entries.literal: "I felt a little reluctant to buy more after the two nasty pieces I'd eaten."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared through the transparent door of the fridge. I didn't feel like looking at the eggs, so I scanned the scarce meat that was there.
entries.literal: "I stared through the transparent door of the fridge. I didn't feel like looking at the eggs, so I scanned the scarce meat that was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess I just have to heat these up.
entries.literal: "I guess I just have to heat these up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lifted up the top and grabbed some prepared meat. I knew I'd seen the same brand at Atsuki's house.
entries.literal: "I lifted up the top and grabbed some prepared meat. I knew I'd seen the same brand at Atsuki's house."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Careful not to let anything fall, I stepped up to the cashier and dropped everything on the conveyor belt. It would all last me a few days, but not until the 15th.
entries.literal: "Careful not to let anything fall, I stepped up to the cashier and dropped everything on the conveyor belt. It would all last me a few days, but not until the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She quietly scanned all the items.
entries.literal: "She quietly scanned all the items."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: It'll be ¥2,739 total.
entries.literal: "It'll be ¥2,739 total."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Ah, give me a plastic bag too, please.
entries.literal: "Ah, give me a plastic bag too, please."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: ...Here.
entries.literal: "...Here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed my wallet, but I knew I barely didn't have enough cash to pay for everything.{w} I took out my credit card instead and handed it to her.
entries.literal: "I grabbed my wallet, but I knew I barely didn't have enough cash to pay for everything.{w} I took out my credit card instead and handed it to her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She inserted it into a tiny device and asked me to put in my PIN.
entries.literal: "She inserted it into a tiny device and asked me to put in my PIN."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: 1{w=0.4}9{w=0.2}9{w=0.3}1.{w=0.3} I pressed "okay" and waited a few seconds.
entries.literal: "1{w=0.4}9{w=0.2}9{w=0.3}1.{w=0.3} I pressed \"okay\" and waited a few seconds."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: All right, thank you.
entries.literal: "All right, thank you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After she handed me the receipt, I put everything in the bag and walked out.
entries.literal: "After she handed me the receipt, I put everything in the bag and walked out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other shopper had left at some point, but the outside was as devoid of life as before.
entries.literal: "The other shopper had left at some point, but the outside was as devoid of life as before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I retreaded my footprints to make it home. I'd already done what I wanted, so I moved slower, trying not to exhaust the minimal energy I still had.
entries.literal: "I retreaded my footprints to make it home. I'd already done what I wanted, so I moved slower, trying not to exhaust the minimal energy I still had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the keys out while I went up the stairs. Opening the door caused the heat stored inside to leak out, so I moved in quickly.
entries.literal: "I took the keys out while I went up the stairs. Opening the door caused the heat stored inside to leak out, so I moved in quickly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the bag on the floor to take off my coat and shoes and brought it to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "I left the bag on the floor to take off my coat and shoes and brought it to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Except for a portion of noodles, I stored everything in a low cabinet and the fridge. I didn't have any way to obtain hot water, so I put some in a pot and placed it on the gas stove. I tended to cook with bottled water because I didn't particularly trust tap water. Fortunately, I still had plenty of bottles left.
entries.literal: "Except for a portion of noodles, I stored everything in a low cabinet and the fridge. I didn't have any way to obtain hot water, so I put some in a pot and placed it on the gas stove. I tended to cook with bottled water because I didn't particularly trust tap water. Fortunately, I still had plenty of bottles left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After grabbing the chopsticks, I waited for the water to boil. It didn't need to get overly hot, so as soon as tiny bubbles began to form on the surface of the pot, I turned off the stove and poured the water in a bowl with the noodles and other ingredients.
entries.literal: "After grabbing the chopsticks, I waited for the water to boil. It didn't need to get overly hot, so as soon as tiny bubbles began to form on the surface of the pot, I turned off the stove and poured the water in a bowl with the noodles and other ingredients."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Within five minutes, they would be cooked. As usual, I brought the bowl to the living room and left it on the table.
entries.literal: "Within five minutes, they would be cooked. As usual, I brought the bowl to the living room and left it on the table."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't turned on the light, so the only illumination came from outside. I felt much more comfortable not having my window exposed to anyone outside of it, and the lighting was preferable anyway.
entries.literal: "I hadn't turned on the light, so the only illumination came from outside. I felt much more comfortable not having my window exposed to anyone outside of it, and the lighting was preferable anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, I still turned on the ceiling light to force myself to be more awake.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, I still turned on the ceiling light to force myself to be more awake."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to simply wait for the noodles to cook, but it was hard not to remember what I'd read.
entries.literal: "I tried to simply wait for the noodles to cook, but it was hard not to remember what I'd read."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Who had written those posts, and where had they been on the 15th? Since they'd traveled back, on that day, two versions of them should have existed simultaneously.
entries.literal: "...Who had written those posts, and where had they been on the 15th? Since they'd traveled back, on that day, two versions of them should have existed simultaneously."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind clouded as soon as I tried to think about it, so I knew it was a bad idea trying to get anywhere before eating.
entries.literal: "My mind clouded as soon as I tried to think about it, so I knew it was a bad idea trying to get anywhere before eating."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I poked the noodles with the chopsticks, but I had to wait a little more.
entries.literal: "I poked the noodles with the chopsticks, but I had to wait a little more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Enough time had probably passed, so I brought some to my mouth.
entries.literal: "Enough time had probably passed, so I brought some to my mouth."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...They were good, and not too hot either, so I continued.
entries.literal: "...They were good, and not too hot either, so I continued."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The issue with those packets of ramen was that there wasn't much in them. It only took me about a minute to finish.
entries.literal: "The issue with those packets of ramen was that there wasn't much in them. It only took me about a minute to finish."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried not to wolf it down so fast, but it had at least been what I'd needed, because my mind started regaining some focus soon after beginning to eat.
entries.literal: "I tried not to wolf it down so fast, but it had at least been what I'd needed, because my mind started regaining some focus soon after beginning to eat."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe I could try to figure out who posted that thread.
entries.literal: "Maybe I could try to figure out who posted that thread."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I got that idea, I put the noodles on hold and walked to my bedroom.
entries.literal: "When I got that idea, I put the noodles on hold and walked to my bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My phone was still next to the pillow, so I grabbed it and flipped it open.
entries.literal: "My phone was still next to the pillow, so I grabbed it and flipped it open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: 7md_ag's profile was still there. As I walked back to the living room, I pressed the "return" button.
entries.literal: "7md_ag's profile was still there. As I walked back to the living room, I pressed the \"return\" button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the phone on the table and continued eating. As soon as the page loaded, I navigated to the bottom of it.
entries.literal: "I left the phone on the table and continued eating. As soon as the page loaded, I navigated to the bottom of it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Yeah, this picture... I could try to pinpoint where it was taken from.
entries.literal: "Yeah, this picture... I could try to pinpoint where it was taken from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The angle was from a little high up, so it was likely taken through an apartment window.{w} In Yushibana, most apartments didn't have different floors, so it was likely that if I simply found the place it'd been taken from, I could also find out who lived there.
entries.literal: "The angle was from a little high up, so it was likely taken through an apartment window.{w} In Yushibana, most apartments didn't have different floors, so it was likely that if I simply found the place it'd been taken from, I could also find out who lived there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Actually, no... I know this street. That's where there are a few slightly higher buildings, so they should have more than one floor. ...This is close to Atsuki's house.
entries.literal: "Actually, no... I know this street. That's where there are a few slightly higher buildings, so they should have more than one floor. ...This is close to Atsuki's house."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ate the remaining noodles, scratching the bottom of the bowl so that none were left behind.
entries.literal: "I ate the remaining noodles, scratching the bottom of the bowl so that none were left behind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Would knowing who this person is be useful? ...It might be.
entries.literal: "...Would knowing who this person is be useful? ...It might be."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not sure how much I can do. I really doubt I could stop the incident from happening myself, but I should try to learn as much as I can about it. ...What really happened on the 15th? There were a lot of strange things about the attack.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure how much I can do. I really doubt I could stop the incident from happening myself, but I should try to learn as much as I can about it. ...What really happened on the 15th? There were a lot of strange things about the attack."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's also the chance the person who posted the thread is someone I know. Assuming I manage to travel back in time again, it's definitely possible that they'll still go all the way back as long as the incident occurs. It shouldn't even matter if Atsuki and I don't go.{w} I'll definitely have to go to the tower before the 15th. I guess the best I can hope for is that I'll be able to touch the Sekimeiya and go far enough back to save Miiya. Most likely, the biggest issue right now is not knowing how to make myself go so far back again.
entries.literal: "There's also the chance the person who posted the thread is someone I know. Assuming I manage to travel back in time again, it's definitely possible that they'll still go all the way back as long as the incident occurs. It shouldn't even matter if Atsuki and I don't go.{w} I'll definitely have to go to the tower before the 15th. I guess the best I can hope for is that I'll be able to touch the Sekimeiya and go far enough back to save Miiya. Most likely, the biggest issue right now is not knowing how to make myself go so far back again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But if I can pull that off, alongside saving Miiya, the ideal scenario would be to obtain the Sekimeiya myself. What if I go many days into the past, before the 27th? I could find the Sekimeiya on the mountain, which would save Miiya and prevent the incident from happening.
entries.literal: "But if I can pull that off, alongside saving Miiya, the ideal scenario would be to obtain the Sekimeiya myself. What if I go many days into the past, before the 27th? I could find the Sekimeiya on the mountain, which would save Miiya and prevent the incident from happening."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I suppose Ashiya would find a replacement for the Sekimeiya to bait Xyn, but that doesn't really matter as long as people don't get trapped with something that causes time travel. That could outright stop any deaths from happening just by itself.
entries.literal: "...I suppose Ashiya would find a replacement for the Sekimeiya to bait Xyn, but that doesn't really matter as long as people don't get trapped with something that causes time travel. That could outright stop any deaths from happening just by itself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the kitchen and left the bowl in the sink. I still felt hungry, so I took the chocolate cookies I'd bought out of the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I walked to the kitchen and left the bowl in the sink. I still felt hungry, so I took the chocolate cookies I'd bought out of the cabinet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I find the person behind the thread, maybe I could speak to them. They could still have important information if they merely traveled from outside the tower. It's also possible other people will try to get in touch with them now that the Sekimeiya has been announced officially.
entries.literal: "If I find the person behind the thread, maybe I could speak to them. They could still have important information if they merely traveled from outside the tower. It's also possible other people will try to get in touch with them now that the Sekimeiya has been announced officially."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were a number of reasons why discovering their identity would potentially be useful. If even one of them was correct, that was enough.
entries.literal: "There were a number of reasons why discovering their identity would potentially be useful. If even one of them was correct, that was enough."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I go there and knock on the door, hoping it's the right one...?
entries.literal: "Should I go there and knock on the door, hoping it's the right one...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We gave our names to Suripo when we talked to him, so this person could potentially recognize mine. Would it be a good idea to say that I've experienced the same thing as them...?
entries.literal: "We gave our names to Suripo when we talked to him, so this person could potentially recognize mine. Would it be a good idea to say that I've experienced the same thing as them...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lay back on the carpet, a bit indecisive.
entries.literal: "I lay back on the carpet, a bit indecisive."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I also keep thinking that before the 15th, if I haven't been able to use the Sekimeiya, I'll prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. How exactly do I plan to do that...?
entries.literal: "I also keep thinking that before the 15th, if I haven't been able to use the Sekimeiya, I'll prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower. How exactly do I plan to do that...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...There's no way writing an anonymous note would be enough.
entries.literal: "...There's no way writing an anonymous note would be enough."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, actually, it should be simple.{w} When I woke up in the hospital, it was the afternoon of the 8th, and Atsuki was there. So I know for a fact that he'll be out at that time.
entries.literal: "Oh, actually, it should be simple.{w} When I woke up in the hospital, it was the afternoon of the 8th, and Atsuki was there. So I know for a fact that he'll be out at that time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could go to his house then and take the tickets we bought. The three of them should be in the purse Miiya used, and the pamphlet advised people to hurry before they ran out. There were so many people at the tower when the shutter closed that I bet they sold out, too. We didn't look at those tickets again until the 14th, so that'll definitely be too late to buy new ones.
entries.literal: "I could go to his house then and take the tickets we bought. The three of them should be in the purse Miiya used, and the pamphlet advised people to hurry before they ran out. There were so many people at the tower when the shutter closed that I bet they sold out, too. We didn't look at those tickets again until the 14th, so that'll definitely be too late to buy new ones."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I should be able to enter his house when he's out. I know where he keeps a hidden key close to his door just in case he ever forgets his inside. If it's not there anymore, I might be able to open the window of his bedroom as long as the shutter isn't down. He doesn't usually lock it.
entries.literal: "I should be able to enter his house when he's out. I know where he keeps a hidden key close to his door just in case he ever forgets his inside. If it's not there anymore, I might be able to open the window of his bedroom as long as the shutter isn't down. He doesn't usually lock it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spent a while lying down, but I began to feel really curious about the mysterious forum poster, wondering if there'd been an ulterior reason behind their text.
entries.literal: "I spent a while lying down, but I began to feel really curious about the mysterious forum poster, wondering if there'd been an ulterior reason behind their text."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put my phone in my purse and prepared to leave.
entries.literal: "I put my phone in my purse and prepared to leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My boots and coat were where I'd just left them, so I put them on and stepped out, then headed down the stairs.
entries.literal: "My boots and coat were where I'd just left them, so I put them on and stepped out, then headed down the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew approximately where to go. Once I was at the street where the picture had been taken, I expected to be able to look at it and determine the exact building I was searching for.
entries.literal: "I knew approximately where to go. Once I was at the street where the picture had been taken, I expected to be able to look at it and determine the exact building I was searching for."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could take different paths to make it to the opposite side of the town, but I simply walked as if I was going to Atsuki's house.
entries.literal: "I could take different paths to make it to the opposite side of the town, but I simply walked as if I was going to Atsuki's house."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His house and Ashiya Tower were both in the distance, but they were also on opposite sides. The tower was right in front of the mountains, whereas Atsuki's house was near the road to leave Yushibana.
entries.literal: "His house and Ashiya Tower were both in the distance, but they were also on opposite sides. The tower was right in front of the mountains, whereas Atsuki's house was near the road to leave Yushibana."

entries.speaker: i
