entries.text: As always, the center of the town felt much more lively. At a crosswalk hidden by the snow, a car waited for people to cross. That time, instead of going with them to Ramon street, I went directly to Enric avenue.
entries.literal: "As always, the center of the town felt much more lively. At a crosswalk hidden by the snow, a car waited for people to cross. That time, instead of going with them to Ramon street, I went directly to Enric avenue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I chose not to walk past Atsuki's house and kept moving ahead. If I wasn't mistaken, the street I was going to was called Ampla, and it was parallel to Enric.
entries.literal: "I chose not to walk past Atsuki's house and kept moving ahead. If I wasn't mistaken, the street I was going to was called Ampla, and it was parallel to Enric."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait a second.
entries.literal: "Wait a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thinking about the movements I'd made the previous day, an important connection arose in my mind.
entries.literal: "Thinking about the movements I'd made the previous day, an important connection arose in my mind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The forum thread had been posted on November 24th. I'd read about that date in the newspaper.
entries.literal: "The forum thread had been posted on November 24th. I'd read about that date in the newspaper."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Also in the afternoon of November 24th, a camera had recorded a prisoner escaping from a cell. No one had any idea how they'd even gotten in there.
entries.literal: "Also in the afternoon of November 24th, a camera had recorded a prisoner escaping from a cell. No one had any idea how they'd even gotten in there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Was I actually right? Was it the Sekimeiya's teleportation?
entries.literal: "...Was I actually right? Was it the Sekimeiya's teleportation?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If the person who posted the forum thread was outside the tower on the 15th, like I thought, someone touched the Sekimeiya from inside. So both of them appeared at the very same time on November 24th.
entries.literal: "If the person who posted the forum thread was outside the tower on the 15th, like I thought, someone touched the Sekimeiya from inside. So both of them appeared at the very same time on November 24th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It fit perfectly. Someone else who'd been caught up in that travel had appeared inside a vacant prison cell.
entries.literal: "It fit perfectly. Someone else who'd been caught up in that travel had appeared inside a vacant prison cell."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Was it the person who touched the Sekimeiya or someone else who was waiting outside?
entries.literal: "...Was it the person who touched the Sekimeiya or someone else who was waiting outside?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The article said they were dressed as a prisoner. This must mean that the position they appeared in was based on a time they were jailed, right? ...Had one of us in the tower been in prison in the past?
entries.literal: "The article said they were dressed as a prisoner. This must mean that the position they appeared in was based on a time they were jailed, right? ...Had one of us in the tower been in prison in the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I attempted to visualize the picture next to the article.
entries.literal: "I attempted to visualize the picture next to the article."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had been taken from the ceiling, so measuring the person's height with it was very hard. Since it had been in black and white, I couldn't discern the color of their hair either, so all I knew was that they were a man with short and dark hair.
entries.literal: "It had been taken from the ceiling, so measuring the person's height with it was very hard. Since it had been in black and white, I couldn't discern the color of their hair either, so all I knew was that they were a man with short and dark hair."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's not possible it was a police officer waiting outside. If that was the case, they wouldn't have appeared dressed up as a prisoner. Just going off that fact, it's incredibly likely it was one of us who were inside the building.
entries.literal: "It's not possible it was a police officer waiting outside. If that was the case, they wouldn't have appeared dressed up as a prisoner. Just going off that fact, it's incredibly likely it was one of us who were inside the building."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So... someone else who got trapped and knows about the Sekimeiya's powers is here, in the past with me. This is what I was afraid of.
entries.literal: "So... someone else who got trapped and knows about the Sekimeiya's powers is here, in the past with me. This is what I was afraid of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I bit my lip and tried to keep walking.{w} I'd already thought of the negative implications of that, but I had to start seriously worrying about them.
entries.literal: "I bit my lip and tried to keep walking.{w} I'd already thought of the negative implications of that, but I had to start seriously worrying about them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If they'd been in prison before, their reason to be in the tower had to be stealing the Sekimeiya. Everyone there with me understood at least the basics of what it could do, so now that person must be entirely aware of the fact that they're in the past...
entries.literal: "If they'd been in prison before, their reason to be in the tower had to be stealing the Sekimeiya. Everyone there with me understood at least the basics of what it could do, so now that person must be entirely aware of the fact that they're in the past..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...They have the ability to change the past and know about Ashiya's alarm. At any point, I could hear the news that the Sekimeiya has been stolen before the 15th.
entries.literal: "...They have the ability to change the past and know about Ashiya's alarm. At any point, I could hear the news that the Sekimeiya has been stolen before the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to calm myself down, but it wasn't easy. If Xyn, or anyone, stole the Sekimeiya, the incident on the 15th wouldn't happen. The deaths of that day would be erased, but an alternate outcome like that came with its own problems.
entries.literal: "I tried to calm myself down, but it wasn't easy. If Xyn, or anyone, stole the Sekimeiya, the incident on the 15th wouldn't happen. The deaths of that day would be erased, but an alternate outcome like that came with its own problems."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wouldn't be able to save Miiya, and I would remain in a world with two versions of myself. The only way to make the latter work would become impossible as well, as I wouldn't be able to go back in time with any winning lottery number.
entries.literal: "I wouldn't be able to save Miiya, and I would remain in a world with two versions of myself. The only way to make the latter work would become impossible as well, as I wouldn't be able to go back in time with any winning lottery number."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Does this pretty much mean that I have to go to the tower as soon as possible, find the Sekimeiya, and somehow activate it to go days back?{w} That could easily go wrong in so many ways...!{w} What if I stay in front of the tower permanently to see what Xyn do with the Sekimeiya once they steal it?{w} This could also very easily end up being a mistake, and there's no way I could do it.
entries.literal: "Does this pretty much mean that I have to go to the tower as soon as possible, find the Sekimeiya, and somehow activate it to go days back?{w} That could easily go wrong in so many ways...!{w} What if I stay in front of the tower permanently to see what Xyn do with the Sekimeiya once they steal it?{w} This could also very easily end up being a mistake, and there's no way I could do it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is it likely that whoever traveled to the 24th thinks the past can't be changed? If so, they'll be afraid to attempt to steal it before the 15th, and they'll try to do it on that day with the information they have, just like I was thinking of doing.
entries.literal: "...Is it likely that whoever traveled to the 24th thinks the past can't be changed? If so, they'll be afraid to attempt to steal it before the 15th, and they'll try to do it on that day with the information they have, just like I was thinking of doing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess I can hope that's the case.
entries.literal: "I guess I can hope that's the case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd left my apartment to figure out who 7md_ag was, so I did my best to let go of those worries for the moment and reach my target street.
entries.literal: "I'd left my apartment to figure out who 7md_ag was, so I did my best to let go of those worries for the moment and reach my target street."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Well, it should be this one.
entries.literal: "...Well, it should be this one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took my phone out and looked at its screen.{w} Then, I peered into the distance, toward the tower.
entries.literal: "I took my phone out and looked at its screen.{w} Then, I peered into the distance, toward the tower."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Yeah, it has to be this street.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it has to be this street."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The structures around me were slightly taller than in most of Yushibana, and the number of windows showed that they had several floors.
entries.literal: "The structures around me were slightly taller than in most of Yushibana, and the number of windows showed that they had several floors."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept walking to get closer to where I thought the picture had been taken from.
entries.literal: "I kept walking to get closer to where I thought the picture had been taken from."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...{w} Around here?
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} Around here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the building behind me. The picture could've been taken from any of those windows.
entries.literal: "I looked at the building behind me. The picture could've been taken from any of those windows."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh... Is it actually this building?
entries.literal: "Oh... Is it actually this building?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was something that made it stand out. Next to the door, there was a sign with three words on it.
entries.literal: "There was something that made it stand out. Next to the door, there was a sign with three words on it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Apartment for sale".
entries.literal: "\"Apartment for sale\"."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess that doesn't have to mean anything.
entries.literal: "I guess that doesn't have to mean anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I frowned a little. While I didn't know which apartment was the one for sale, light could be seen on the other side of the four windows above the door.
entries.literal: "But I frowned a little. While I didn't know which apartment was the one for sale, light could be seen on the other side of the four windows above the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The entrance was locked, and I couldn't see anyone nearby. Next to the door, below the sign, was a panel with four numbers and four buttons to press.
entries.literal: "The entrance was locked, and I couldn't see anyone nearby. Next to the door, below the sign, was a panel with four numbers and four buttons to press."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I try to ring the bell...? It could be any of the four.{w} If the person from the forum is someone I know, maybe I could recognize their voice.
entries.literal: "Should I try to ring the bell...? It could be any of the four.{w} If the person from the forum is someone I know, maybe I could recognize their voice."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt pretty hesitant, wondering what to say after ringing.
entries.literal: "I felt pretty hesitant, wondering what to say after ringing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Do I ask for a name and just say that I made a mistake if I don't recognize them? ...What if they live with someone else who answers instead?
entries.literal: "Do I ask for a name and just say that I made a mistake if I don't recognize them? ...What if they live with someone else who answers instead?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the sign again.
entries.literal: "I looked at the sign again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...There's a phone number. Maybe I should call it instead.
entries.literal: "...There's a phone number. Maybe I should call it instead."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Would I be told information about the previous resident...? Could it be that the person I'm looking for decided to move out immediately, afraid of what they thought was a grave mental issue?
entries.literal: "Would I be told information about the previous resident...? Could it be that the person I'm looking for decided to move out immediately, afraid of what they thought was a grave mental issue?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Given the way their posts had been written, that wasn't unthinkable. Maybe they'd just decided to move somewhere else, and that was why someone still seemed to be living behind every window at that moment.
entries.literal: "Given the way their posts had been written, that wasn't unthinkable. Maybe they'd just decided to move somewhere else, and that was why someone still seemed to be living behind every window at that moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still holding the phone, I pressed the call button and dialed the numbers on the wall.{w} 1989-1815-251...{w=0.6} I started to hear the high-pitched beeps.
entries.literal: "Still holding the phone, I pressed the call button and dialed the numbers on the wall.{w} 1989-1815-251...{w=0.6} I started to hear the high-pitched beeps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A little half-hearted, I waited with the phone on my ear.
entries.literal: "A little half-hearted, I waited with the phone on my ear."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: ...Hello?
entries.literal: "...Hello?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh, hey.{w} ...I'm calling for an apartment I see for sale at Ampla.
entries.literal: "Oh, hey.{w} ...I'm calling for an apartment I see for sale at Ampla."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Ah, great! You're the first person to be interested, but the interior there is well-maintained, and it's in a very good area. Are you from here?
entries.literal: "Ah, great! You're the first person to be interested, but the interior there is well-maintained, and it's in a very good area. Are you from here?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I am, yes.
entries.literal: "...I am, yes."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: That's great.{w} ...Are you perhaps at the address right now?
entries.literal: "That's great.{w} ...Are you perhaps at the address right now?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yes. I'm looking at it.
entries.literal: "Yes. I'm looking at it."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I can see you from my window. Wait a second, I'll come out.
entries.literal: "I can see you from my window. Wait a second, I'll come out."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: O-Oh, all right.
entries.literal: "O-Oh, all right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He hung up, so I stood still nervously, failing to see anyone behind a window.
entries.literal: "He hung up, so I stood still nervously, failing to see anyone behind a window."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have to wait long for a door farther back to open.{w} A middle-aged man came out and shuffled up to me.
entries.literal: "I didn't have to wait long for a door farther back to open.{w} A middle-aged man came out and shuffled up to me."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Hello! What's your name?
entries.literal: "Hello! What's your name?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Shiroya."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I see. Glad to meet you. I'm Cecal Fray.
entries.literal: "I see. Glad to meet you. I'm Cecal Fray."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He bowed enthusiastically and turned to the sign.
entries.literal: "He bowed enthusiastically and turned to the sign."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: It hasn't been up for sale very long, but I'm sure it'll be purchased quickly. Would you like to see the inside? Since you're here, I'm assuming you've not seen the pictures on the website.
entries.literal: "It hasn't been up for sale very long, but I'm sure it'll be purchased quickly. Would you like to see the inside? Since you're here, I'm assuming you've not seen the pictures on the website."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I haven't, and yeah, I'd like to. Isn't someone currently inside, though? There's light coming from all the windows.
entries.literal: "I haven't, and yeah, I'd like to. Isn't someone currently inside, though? There's light coming from all the windows."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Ah! Yes, you're perceptive. The previous resident is currently preparing to move out. We agreed he could receive visits while he's still here. Don't worry, it'll be vacant quite soon.
entries.literal: "Ah! Yes, you're perceptive. The previous resident is currently preparing to move out. We agreed he could receive visits while he's still here. Don't worry, it'll be vacant quite soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to say, but I couldn't back off.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to say, but I couldn't back off."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'm sorry to ask this, but why is he leaving? Did he have an issue with the apartment?
entries.literal: "...I'm sorry to ask this, but why is he leaving? Did he have an issue with the apartment?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Oh, not at all. Evidently, he wanted to go live with his parents. I've spoken to him personally. He's well-mannered and intelligent, no problems on my end, but it seems he's not well, so he couldn't keep living by himself.
entries.literal: "Oh, not at all. Evidently, he wanted to go live with his parents. I've spoken to him personally. He's well-mannered and intelligent, no problems on my end, but it seems he's not well, so he couldn't keep living by himself."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It is him.
entries.literal: "...It is him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked up, but I still couldn't see anyone through the glass.
entries.literal: "I looked up, but I still couldn't see anyone through the glass."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...He's not well? I'm sorry for asking. ...Is he gonna be okay?
entries.literal: "...He's not well? I'm sorry for asking. ...Is he gonna be okay?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Yes, you shouldn't worry. I'm not sure exactly what the issue is, but he was very recently at his parents' house, preparing to move. He seemed fine to me when we spoke briefly. I didn't want to pry, though.
entries.literal: "Yes, you shouldn't worry. I'm not sure exactly what the issue is, but he was very recently at his parents' house, preparing to move. He seemed fine to me when we spoke briefly. I didn't want to pry, though."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Ah, I'm glad.
entries.literal: "Ah, I'm glad."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had two keys on his palm and used one to unlock the entrance.{w} I saw a gray hall with stairs leading up.
entries.literal: "He had two keys on his palm and used one to unlock the entrance.{w} I saw a gray hall with stairs leading up."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I think he implied he had some kind of mental disorder, but I'm not really well-informed. He called me in late November saying that someone had broken into his house.
entries.literal: "I think he implied he had some kind of mental disorder, but I'm not really well-informed. He called me in late November saying that someone had broken into his house."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Wait, really? Did they take anything?
entries.literal: "...Wait, really? Did they take anything?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: No, that's what I'm saying. Soon after, he called again, assuring me that he'd imagined it and not to worry, but that he'd still move out.
entries.literal: "No, that's what I'm saying. Soon after, he called again, assuring me that he'd imagined it and not to worry, but that he'd still move out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I followed him up the stairs with a pensive frown.
entries.literal: "I followed him up the stairs with a pensive frown."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He stopped in front of the first door, which had an "A" above it.{w} Instead of unlocking it himself, he rang the bell.
entries.literal: "He stopped in front of the first door, which had an \"A\" above it.{w} Instead of unlocking it himself, he rang the bell."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started to feel nervous. Would the person about to open the door recognize me? ...Would I recognize him?
entries.literal: "I started to feel nervous. Would the person about to open the door recognize me? ...Would I recognize him?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard footsteps approaching, and the door jittered. In one motion, I saw the face of the person I'd been searching for.
entries.literal: "I heard footsteps approaching, and the door jittered. In one motion, I saw the face of the person I'd been searching for."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...No, I don't think I know him.
entries.literal: "...No, I don't think I know him."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Ah, good morning.{w} ...Well, I guess it's close to noon already.{w} Are you coming to see my apartment?
entries.literal: "Ah, good morning.{w} ...Well, I guess it's close to noon already.{w} Are you coming to see my apartment?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.literal: "...Yeah."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Come in, then. It's a very nice place. I've really enjoyed living here.
entries.literal: "Come in, then. It's a very nice place. I've really enjoyed living here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't take my eyes off his face, but all I could conclude was that I'd never seen him before. He wore a sympathetic smile, and his voice sounded kind.
entries.literal: "I didn't take my eyes off his face, but all I could conclude was that I'd never seen him before. He wore a sympathetic smile, and his voice sounded kind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped in timidly, unaware of where to set my eyes. Following the agent, or landlord, whoever he was, I entered the living room.
entries.literal: "I stepped in timidly, unaware of where to set my eyes. Following the agent, or landlord, whoever he was, I entered the living room."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: The furniture won't be taken away. You'll notice the heating is working just fine, but sunlight makes it inside all day too.{w} You might've noticed that there's no elevator below, but fortunately, you only have to go up a single set of stairs.
entries.literal: "The furniture won't be taken away. You'll notice the heating is working just fine, but sunlight makes it inside all day too.{w} You might've noticed that there's no elevator below, but fortunately, you only have to go up a single set of stairs."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yeah. I like it.
entries.literal: "...Yeah. I like it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't necessarily lying. Everything looked clean and neatly arranged.
entries.literal: "I wasn't necessarily lying. Everything looked clean and neatly arranged."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Great! ...You'll see how spacious the rooms are. There are two of them.
entries.literal: "Great! ...You'll see how spacious the rooms are. There are two of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept following behind, still thinking about what he'd said in the staircase.
entries.literal: "I kept following behind, still thinking about what he'd said in the staircase."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He called saying that someone had broken in, but later retracted that.
entries.literal: "He called saying that someone had broken in, but later retracted that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked back at the man, who was just tagging along in silence.
entries.literal: "I looked back at the man, who was just tagging along in silence."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...He must know what will happen.
entries.literal: "...He must know what will happen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Someone broke into this place a few days ago... He appeared at his parents' house on the 24th, and later on, he replied again from this apartment, when he took that picture.
entries.literal: "Someone broke into this place a few days ago... He appeared at his parents' house on the 24th, and later on, he replied again from this apartment, when he took that picture."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did he break into his own house...? If he appeared at his parents' without the keys, that could have happened. Maybe he did have them and his original self noticed someone had entered.
entries.literal: "Did he break into his own house...? If he appeared at his parents' without the keys, that could have happened. Maybe he did have them and his original self noticed someone had entered."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...There are more possible explanations. What if it was the version from the future who noticed his original self when he made it back home and thought he was a thief? ...Then, he figured out what had happened and called to say he'd just imagined it.
entries.literal: "...There are more possible explanations. What if it was the version from the future who noticed his original self when he made it back home and thought he was a thief? ...Then, he figured out what had happened and called to say he'd just imagined it."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Do you like it?
entries.literal: "Do you like it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He opened the door to a bedroom.
entries.literal: "He opened the door to a bedroom."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yeah. That's a big bed.
entries.literal: "...Yeah. That's a big bed."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: As I said, everything you see is a fixture. It's part of the package.
entries.literal: "As I said, everything you see is a fixture. It's part of the package."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: That's good.
entries.literal: "That's good."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, if I'm right at all, two versions of him must currently exist. ...Is the one right here the one who traveled from the future? Is it possible they've seen each other? Surely that would be changing the past.
entries.literal: "So, if I'm right at all, two versions of him must currently exist. ...Is the one right here the one who traveled from the future? Is it possible they've seen each other? Surely that would be changing the past."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: ...Here's the other room. It's a little smaller, but it can also work as a bedroom if anyone stays over.
entries.literal: "...Here's the other room. It's a little smaller, but it can also work as a bedroom if anyone stays over."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room was pretty messy, and it stored different kinds of objects and old devices.{w} My attention was quickly directed to a framed picture.
entries.literal: "The room was pretty messy, and it stored different kinds of objects and old devices.{w} My attention was quickly directed to a framed picture."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I leaned forward to take a better look at it. I could see the man who lived in the apartment in front of someone a little older than him.
entries.literal: "I leaned forward to take a better look at it. I could see the man who lived in the apartment in front of someone a little older than him."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...A police uniform.
entries.literal: "...A police uniform."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were both dressed as police officers, and the background was a simple white wall.
entries.literal: "They were both dressed as police officers, and the background was a simple white wall."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: You have the bathroom right here.
entries.literal: "You have the bathroom right here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked through the door and saw a bathroom similar to mine. The structure of the apartment was similar to my own, but everything felt more taken care of, and the rooms were slightly larger.
entries.literal: "I looked through the door and saw a bathroom similar to mine. The structure of the apartment was similar to my own, but everything felt more taken care of, and the rooms were slightly larger."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we'd seen all of them, we ended up at the front door.
entries.literal: "When we'd seen all of them, we ended up at the front door."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I know we haven't spoken about price—I can be a bit flexible. Right now, the set price is ¥42,000 a month, but you'll need to make an initial deposit of ¥126,000.{w} How does that sound?
entries.literal: "I know we haven't spoken about price—I can be a bit flexible. Right now, the set price is ¥42,000 a month, but you'll need to make an initial deposit of ¥126,000.{w} How does that sound?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If only. ...Maybe after I win the lottery.
entries.literal: "If only. ...Maybe after I win the lottery."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Hm... I certainly liked this place. It's a big decision, though...{w} I'll have to think about it.
entries.literal: "Hm... I certainly liked this place. It's a big decision, though...{w} I'll have to think about it."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: ...Of course. Keep in mind more people are likely to be interested.
entries.literal: "...Of course. Keep in mind more people are likely to be interested."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I know. I'll try to make up my mind quickly and call you. I've got your number saved now.
entries.literal: "I know. I'll try to make up my mind quickly and call you. I've got your number saved now."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: All right. I'll await your call, Shiroya. It was a pleasure.
entries.literal: "All right. I'll await your call, Shiroya. It was a pleasure."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Likewise.
entries.literal: "...Likewise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to bow, but the wide eyes of the man holding the door froze me before I could.
entries.literal: "I was about to bow, but the wide eyes of the man holding the door froze me before I could."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Also frozen, the man's eyes pierced mine until I forcibly ripped my gaze away and completed the bow.
entries.literal: "Also frozen, the man's eyes pierced mine until I forcibly ripped my gaze away and completed the bow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did he react to my name?
entries.literal: "...Did he react to my name?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: G-Goodbye.
entries.literal: "G-Goodbye."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Goodbye. I hope to see you again.
entries.literal: "Goodbye. I hope to see you again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other man wasn't saying anything, so I slowly stepped away, unsure whether that look had been a reaction to my name or if he'd had it from the beginning. It seemed both of them would stay there, so I left by myself.
entries.literal: "The other man wasn't saying anything, so I slowly stepped away, unsure whether that look had been a reaction to my name or if he'd had it from the beginning. It seemed both of them would stay there, so I left by myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I turned around, I was met with the same sensation.{w} The door to the outside closed, and I saw a man walking up the stairs. The look he gave muddled my mind, instantly making me doubt everything I'd just determined.
entries.literal: "As soon as I turned around, I was met with the same sensation.{w} The door to the outside closed, and I saw a man walking up the stairs. The look he gave muddled my mind, instantly making me doubt everything I'd just determined."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the very same look as the other man's, down to the piercing pause.{w} When time continued, he stepped up and unlocked the opposite door, quietly shutting it behind him without saying a word.
entries.literal: "It was the very same look as the other man's, down to the piercing pause.{w} When time continued, he stepped up and unlocked the opposite door, quietly shutting it behind him without saying a word."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What the hell? What was that?
entries.literal: "...What the hell? What was that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He'd been skinny and a little older, but I hadn't recognized him either, so I simply stood still, wondering which of those two stares had been given by 7md_ag.
entries.literal: "He'd been skinny and a little older, but I hadn't recognized him either, so I simply stood still, wondering which of those two stares had been given by 7md_ag."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Was it just that he was surprised to see someone he'd never seen in this building?
entries.literal: "...Was it just that he was surprised to see someone he'd never seen in this building?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had I only overreacted internally? It had seemed bizarre to me, but maybe I'd just misinterpreted the second look due to seeing it immediately after the first.
entries.literal: "Had I only overreacted internally? It had seemed bizarre to me, but maybe I'd just misinterpreted the second look due to seeing it immediately after the first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I went down the stairs and opened the door in a haze of confusion.
entries.literal: "...I went down the stairs and opened the door in a haze of confusion."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Outside, I merely stood still, trying to sort out my thoughts.
entries.literal: "Outside, I merely stood still, trying to sort out my thoughts."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The first man must be the forum poster. What I was told about him fits perfectly.
entries.literal: "The first man must be the forum poster. What I was told about him fits perfectly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked away, intending to take the second stare out of my mind and telling myself that I'd really overreacted to it.
entries.literal: "I walked away, intending to take the second stare out of my mind and telling myself that I'd really overreacted to it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I guess it doesn't really matter. It was one of them for sure, and I didn't recognize either of them.
entries.literal: "...I guess it doesn't really matter. It was one of them for sure, and I didn't recognize either of them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's much more likely it was the first guy because of that framed picture. He was one of the police officers outside the tower, so I was right. He was suddenly picked up by a travel that was activated within the building.
entries.literal: "It's much more likely it was the first guy because of that framed picture. He was one of the police officers outside the tower, so I was right. He was suddenly picked up by a travel that was activated within the building."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...But he is a policeman. Is he not going to try to prevent the attack from happening somehow? If he made that call saying there was no actual burglar, he must understand enough of what happened to him. He has to know he's in the past.
entries.literal: "...But he is a policeman. Is he not going to try to prevent the attack from happening somehow? If he made that call saying there was no actual burglar, he must understand enough of what happened to him. He has to know he's in the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Lost in thought, I arrived at Ramon.{w} In contrast to the early morning, the street was fairly busy, partially thanks to the good weather. I recognized a group of kids years younger than me, so I avoided even looking at them.
entries.literal: "Lost in thought, I arrived at Ramon.{w} In contrast to the early morning, the street was fairly busy, partially thanks to the good weather. I recognized a group of kids years younger than me, so I avoided even looking at them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And like I thought, two versions of him must currently exist. I can't be sure I just talked to the one aware of the incident.
entries.literal: "And like I thought, two versions of him must currently exist. I can't be sure I just talked to the one aware of the incident."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But the stare stuck in my mind strongly implied he was.
entries.literal: "But the stare stuck in my mind strongly implied he was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wondered whether to go home. I'd accomplished my goal, even though I couldn't draw much from it. I hadn't recognized the person known as 7md_ag, but I felt confident that the solution to the forum thread was a police officer who'd traveled through time.
entries.literal: "I wondered whether to go home. I'd accomplished my goal, even though I couldn't draw much from it. I hadn't recognized the person known as 7md_ag, but I felt confident that the solution to the forum thread was a police officer who'd traveled through time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe I should've tried to talk to him. ...But I doubt he would tell me anything new, and I'd very much rather not say what I'm doing here.
entries.literal: "Maybe I should've tried to talk to him. ...But I doubt he would tell me anything new, and I'd very much rather not say what I'm doing here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With that out of the way, I was forced to go back to my previous thoughts. What could I do about the person who'd probably traveled with him to the prison cell?
entries.literal: "With that out of the way, I was forced to go back to my previous thoughts. What could I do about the person who'd probably traveled with him to the prison cell?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wandered around slowly, hoping something would come to mind.{w} ...Knowing that the future I was envisioning could have been destroyed at any moment caused a hollow anxiety to form in my chest. It was the same one I'd felt after Miiya died.
entries.literal: "I wandered around slowly, hoping something would come to mind.{w} ...Knowing that the future I was envisioning could have been destroyed at any moment caused a hollow anxiety to form in my chest. It was the same one I'd felt after Miiya died."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At least I was pretty sure that I was in the best place to sort it all out. Not inside an oppressive, enclosed building, but free in Yushibana.
entries.literal: "At least I was pretty sure that I was in the best place to sort it all out. Not inside an oppressive, enclosed building, but free in Yushibana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I thought about it more, it was almost worse, in a way. Miiya had died instantly, and I'd been forced to confront that reality instantly. Similarly, in Ashiya Tower, the attack had been instant and all the consequences of it had been fairly quick to follow.
entries.literal: "When I thought about it more, it was almost worse, in a way. Miiya had died instantly, and I'd been forced to confront that reality instantly. Similarly, in Ashiya Tower, the attack had been instant and all the consequences of it had been fairly quick to follow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But what I was doing then, walking around town and slowly gathering information... was not the same. If I didn't save Miiya through my actions, all I was really doing was letting things slowly play out, gradually getting worse.
entries.literal: "But what I was doing then, walking around town and slowly gathering information... was not the same. If I didn't save Miiya through my actions, all I was really doing was letting things slowly play out, gradually getting worse."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Distracting myself from that was the best I could do in the meantime, while I decided whether taking action was really the wisest thing to do. I buried that creeping dread as deep as I could and returned to thinking about the man in the apartment.
entries.literal: "Distracting myself from that was the best I could do in the meantime, while I decided whether taking action was really the wisest thing to do. I buried that creeping dread as deep as I could and returned to thinking about the man in the apartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The thread had said that he'd appeared at his parents' house on the 24th. I found myself going back to that.
entries.literal: "The thread had said that he'd appeared at his parents' house on the 24th. I found myself going back to that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And his parents said that he shouldn't have been there. That contradicts what I thought yesterday regarding my own travel.
entries.literal: "And his parents said that he shouldn't have been there. That contradicts what I thought yesterday regarding my own travel."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I thought that on the 30th, I appeared underground at {time=21:10} where I'd been only minutes prior. Plenty of travels that happened in the tower can fit that idea, but there were already some that didn't, and neither does this one.
entries.literal: "I thought that on the 30th, I appeared underground at {time=21:10} where I'd been only minutes prior. Plenty of travels that happened in the tower can fit that idea, but there were already some that didn't, and neither does this one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If his parents said that he shouldn't have been there on the 24th, it can't be that it was a coordinate mere minutes away from the point he appeared.{w} But of course, his parents' house isn't a random position. It definitely had to have been based on one from his past.
entries.literal: "If his parents said that he shouldn't have been there on the 24th, it can't be that it was a coordinate mere minutes away from the point he appeared.{w} But of course, his parents' house isn't a random position. It definitely had to have been based on one from his past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Admittedly, thinking about that was frustrating. I'd gone over similar thoughts so many times, but it didn't seem like reaching a conclusion was feasible, and especially not when I couldn't know if the Sekimeiya was consistent.
entries.literal: "Admittedly, thinking about that was frustrating. I'd gone over similar thoughts so many times, but it didn't seem like reaching a conclusion was feasible, and especially not when I couldn't know if the Sekimeiya was consistent."

entries.text: Orbit Crash
entries.literal: "Orbit Crash"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped myself in the middle of the street.
entries.literal: "I stopped myself in the middle of the street."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ahead of me, I saw something I recognized.{w} The very same stare I'd just been given.
entries.literal: "Ahead of me, I saw something I recognized.{w} The very same stare I'd just been given."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Someone else who I didn't recognize had suddenly looked at me like that, but when I noticed it, they were looking somewhere else.
entries.literal: "...Someone else who I didn't recognize had suddenly looked at me like that, but when I noticed it, they were looking somewhere else."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Am I just imagining it? Am I just paranoid after the first time?
entries.literal: "...Am I just imagining it? Am I just paranoid after the first time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spun around me, and after a full circle, my heart hammered once.{w} All around, I'd seen people fixing their eyes on me.
entries.literal: "I spun around me, and after a full circle, my heart hammered once.{w} All around, I'd seen people fixing their eyes on me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spun once again, more slowly.
entries.literal: "I spun once again, more slowly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Afterward, I closed my eyes. I hadn't seen a single person looking at me the second time.
entries.literal: "Afterward, I closed my eyes. I hadn't seen a single person looking at me the second time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I have to be making it up.
entries.literal: "I have to be making it up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The thin white trees came back to me, but I was slightly dizzy. I surveyed my surroundings again, and everyone was only looking straight ahead as they walked across the ground.
entries.literal: "The thin white trees came back to me, but I was slightly dizzy. I surveyed my surroundings again, and everyone was only looking straight ahead as they walked across the ground."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It couldn't be that they know I should be in the hospital, right?
entries.literal: "It couldn't be that they know I should be in the hospital, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That thought made me feel a little uncomfortable, so I stepped away.
entries.literal: "That thought made me feel a little uncomfortable, so I stepped away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's gotta be just me. Nobody's looking now. ...Even if that was the case, it shouldn't matter.
entries.literal: "It's gotta be just me. Nobody's looking now. ...Even if that was the case, it shouldn't matter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it still made me uneasy, so I walked toward a narrower branching street which was much less crowded.
entries.literal: "But it still made me uneasy, so I walked toward a narrower branching street which was much less crowded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I advanced without thinking about where I was going. Eventually, I turned around and still saw no one looking back at me.
entries.literal: "I advanced without thinking about where I was going. Eventually, I turned around and still saw no one looking back at me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm going the wrong way if I want to go home, though.
entries.literal: "I'm going the wrong way if I want to go home, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to the end of the street. There, the atmosphere was completely calm, similar to how things had been that morning.{w} Slightly ahead of me was the school I'd always gone to, in front of the end of the mountain range.
entries.literal: "I moved to the end of the street. There, the atmosphere was completely calm, similar to how things had been that morning.{w} Slightly ahead of me was the school I'd always gone to, in front of the end of the mountain range."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept moving forward, accepting my own improvised detour.
entries.literal: "I kept moving forward, accepting my own improvised detour."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Past the corner, I saw a green bus I hadn't noticed beforehand. Making no noise, it crossed my view and disappeared as it curved away.
entries.literal: "Past the corner, I saw a green bus I hadn't noticed beforehand. Making no noise, it crossed my view and disappeared as it curved away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't common to see a bus like that in Yushibana. Since it had been green, I knew it had come from outside the town. There were local buses as well, but they were blue and took very few paths.
entries.literal: "It wasn't common to see a bus like that in Yushibana. Since it had been green, I knew it had come from outside the town. There were local buses as well, but they were blue and took very few paths."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I crossed the road, stepping on the recent wet tracks.
entries.literal: "I crossed the road, stepping on the recent wet tracks."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shortly arrived at the entrance to my school. The tunnel I'd come out of two days earlier was very close by.
entries.literal: "I shortly arrived at the entrance to my school. The tunnel I'd come out of two days earlier was very close by."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And of course, Seeuta D'ella Park too. Like every year, it would spend a few months covered by snow.
entries.literal: "And of course, Seeuta D'ella Park too. Like every year, it would spend a few months covered by snow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without a clear purpose in mind, I strolled over to it, surrounded by pure silence.
entries.literal: "Without a clear purpose in mind, I strolled over to it, surrounded by pure silence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see people in the distance, too tiny to recognize.{w} I'd pretty much circled around Yushibana, and it was fairly smaller than the perception of it I'd always had.
entries.literal: "I could see people in the distance, too tiny to recognize.{w} I'd pretty much circled around Yushibana, and it was fairly smaller than the perception of it I'd always had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could make it home without crossing the center again, so I headed toward the path I'd often taken after classes.{w} However, I abruptly forced my legs to stop.
entries.literal: "I could make it home without crossing the center again, so I headed toward the path I'd often taken after classes.{w} However, I abruptly forced my legs to stop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Am I just stressed out?
entries.literal: "...Am I just stressed out?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept walking, shrugging off whatever was up with me.{w} But I soon had to stop again.
entries.literal: "I kept walking, shrugging off whatever was up with me.{w} But I soon had to stop again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Perhaps I'd sharpened my senses during the hours I'd spent on edge in the tower.
entries.literal: "...Perhaps I'd sharpened my senses during the hours I'd spent on edge in the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody seemed to be behind me, but something inside me told me otherwise.{w} The first time, I'd turned around after stopping and hadn't seen anyone. The second, I hadn't sensed anything, but I wanted to make sure.
entries.literal: "Nobody seemed to be behind me, but something inside me told me otherwise.{w} The first time, I'd turned around after stopping and hadn't seen anyone. The second, I hadn't sensed anything, but I wanted to make sure."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Have I hit the point of thinking that I'm being followed? ...I should just make it home.
entries.literal: "Have I hit the point of thinking that I'm being followed? ...I should just make it home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued walking around the rim of Yushibana, slightly on alert.
entries.literal: "I continued walking around the rim of Yushibana, slightly on alert."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound of my footsteps was all I picked up. I looked at the sky and noticed the dense white clouds.
entries.literal: "The sound of my footsteps was all I picked up. I looked at the sky and noticed the dense white clouds."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...In the park, I'd felt like there was movement behind me as soon as I'd started to walk. With how likely it was that I'd been mistaken, I was sure I was more nervous than I thought.
entries.literal: "...In the park, I'd felt like there was movement behind me as soon as I'd started to walk. With how likely it was that I'd been mistaken, I was sure I was more nervous than I thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The third time I stopped myself, I didn't just look back.
entries.literal: "The third time I stopped myself, I didn't just look back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around and ran toward the way I'd come.
entries.literal: "I turned around and ran toward the way I'd come."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't immediately see anyone. Seconds later, I'd covered quite a bit of distance, and nobody had come into view yet.
entries.literal: "I didn't immediately see anyone. Seconds later, I'd covered quite a bit of distance, and nobody had come into view yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But when I looked down, my heart sank like a stone.
entries.literal: "But when I looked down, my heart sank like a stone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Footprints.{w} They weren't mine, and I hadn't seen them seconds earlier. They came from the park hugging the edge and then disappeared toward faraway trees.
entries.literal: "Footprints.{w} They weren't mine, and I hadn't seen them seconds earlier. They came from the park hugging the edge and then disappeared toward faraway trees."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Was I not imagining anything? Am I actually being followed...?
entries.literal: "...Was I not imagining anything? Am I actually being followed...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The footprints were too big to be my own, and I noticed a detail that reinforced my fear.
entries.literal: "The footprints were too big to be my own, and I noticed a detail that reinforced my fear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as they turned toward the trees, the distance between each step increased.
entries.literal: "As soon as they turned toward the trees, the distance between each step increased."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did they run away the moment I looked back?
entries.literal: "...Did they run away the moment I looked back?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had become more than just paranoia. I turned around to my previous path and sped up considerably.
entries.literal: "It had become more than just paranoia. I turned around to my previous path and sped up considerably."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Who would follow me, though? Is it someone else who traveled to the past?
entries.literal: "...Who would follow me, though? Is it someone else who traveled to the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't think of many possibilities. I knew the past wasn't guaranteed to repeat, but even if someone who knew me had seen me, they wouldn't have run away as soon as I'd noticed them.
entries.literal: "I couldn't think of many possibilities. I knew the past wasn't guaranteed to repeat, but even if someone who knew me had seen me, they wouldn't have run away as soon as I'd noticed them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The path was mostly straight until my apartment. It wasn't too cold, so I didn't slow down.{w} On the way, I crossed paths with a neighbor of mine. Naturally, her footprints didn't match the ones I'd seen...
entries.literal: "The path was mostly straight until my apartment. It wasn't too cold, so I didn't slow down.{w} On the way, I crossed paths with a neighbor of mine. Naturally, her footprints didn't match the ones I'd seen..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slowed down when I got to the metallic staircase and unlocked my door. I glanced all around me before opening it, and I didn't see anyone.
entries.literal: "I slowed down when I got to the metallic staircase and unlocked my door. I glanced all around me before opening it, and I didn't see anyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I panted for a bit, the comforting warmth helping me to calm down. After some time, I shrugged off my coat and boots.
entries.literal: "I panted for a bit, the comforting warmth helping me to calm down. After some time, I shrugged off my coat and boots."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really didn't like having to feel wary even in my apartment, but I couldn't shake it.
entries.literal: "I really didn't like having to feel wary even in my apartment, but I couldn't shake it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was it possible I was mistaken? I couldn't really put into words why I'd felt someone had been behind me, so I tried to believe that I'd made it all up.
entries.literal: "Was it possible I was mistaken? I couldn't really put into words why I'd felt someone had been behind me, so I tried to believe that I'd made it all up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The ground had been covered in footprints. Even if the ones I'd seen had looked more recent than the others, that didn't prove anything.
entries.literal: "The ground had been covered in footprints. Even if the ones I'd seen had looked more recent than the others, that didn't prove anything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Why would anyone follow me?{w} To confirm that it was me because I should be in the hospital? ...It wouldn't be to hurt me, right?{w} ...If it was someone from Xyn who traveled to the past, would I actually be seen as a threat to them? If they know I should be in the hospital, they could figure out that there are two of me and I came from the future.
entries.literal: "...Why would anyone follow me?{w} To confirm that it was me because I should be in the hospital? ...It wouldn't be to hurt me, right?{w} ...If it was someone from Xyn who traveled to the past, would I actually be seen as a threat to them? If they know I should be in the hospital, they could figure out that there are two of me and I came from the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had a building headache, and I'd been sweating profusely for a while. I thought about turning off the heater, but I chose to try loosening up instead.
entries.literal: "I had a building headache, and I'd been sweating profusely for a while. I thought about turning off the heater, but I chose to try loosening up instead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the kitchen. If I could eat something, that'd give me something to do and allow me to trust my own judgment a bit more.
entries.literal: "I went to the kitchen. If I could eat something, that'd give me something to do and allow me to trust my own judgment a bit more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the prepped meat from the fridge. I didn't have a microwave, so I still had to use the stove. The frying pan was dirty from the last time, so I listlessly poured dish soap on a sponge and scrubbed the pan before rinsing it.
entries.literal: "I took the prepped meat from the fridge. I didn't have a microwave, so I still had to use the stove. The frying pan was dirty from the last time, so I listlessly poured dish soap on a sponge and scrubbed the pan before rinsing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I dried it with a hanging towel and put it on the burner with the food.{w} I knew not to turn the intensity all the way up or it would burn easily. I stood in front of the pan, focusing only on evenly heating the meat.
entries.literal: "...I dried it with a hanging towel and put it on the burner with the food.{w} I knew not to turn the intensity all the way up or it would burn easily. I stood in front of the pan, focusing only on evenly heating the meat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seconds later, I turned it around with a knife and waited a bit longer for it to be done.
entries.literal: "Seconds later, I turned it around with a knife and waited a bit longer for it to be done."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only one bowl was still clean, so I used it to bring the food to the living room.
entries.literal: "Only one bowl was still clean, so I used it to bring the food to the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The pieces were small, so I didn't have to cut them. I quickly brought one into my mouth.
entries.literal: "The pieces were small, so I didn't have to cut them. I quickly brought one into my mouth."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The inside's still a little cold, but the taste isn't bad. Unfortunately, I probably have no future as a fry cook.
entries.literal: "...The inside's still a little cold, but the taste isn't bad. Unfortunately, I probably have no future as a fry cook."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Well, actually, maybe that's fortunate...?
entries.literal: "Well, actually, maybe that's fortunate...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}I should just try not to think about it too much. Even if I was being followed, what's most important is still that the Sekimeiya could be taken before the 15th.
entries.literal: "...{w}I should just try not to think about it too much. Even if I was being followed, what's most important is still that the Sekimeiya could be taken before the 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And if I try to enter the tower during the night and I'm caught before I can trigger the alarm, it could all fail.{w} My main two worries are not knowing where the Sekimeiya is and not knowing how to travel a lot of days back in time.
entries.literal: "...And if I try to enter the tower during the night and I'm caught before I can trigger the alarm, it could all fail.{w} My main two worries are not knowing where the Sekimeiya is and not knowing how to travel a lot of days back in time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could go to the tower during the day and try to find the cabinet. If it's there, I know the mechanism behind the alarm will already be working, so I could try to consciously change the past the following night by entering the tower and forcing the cabinet open. I suppose it's possible it already is in the event room if nobody's allowed in for now.{w} There wasn't a camera in the storeroom, so maybe I could see if the handle of the hidden door is still there and if it really leads outside.{w} Using that hidden section is my best bet to make it to the tower during the night. I could either try to enter it from the outside or wait behind the movable wall during the day, where I won't be found before the tower closes.
entries.literal: "I could go to the tower during the day and try to find the cabinet. If it's there, I know the mechanism behind the alarm will already be working, so I could try to consciously change the past the following night by entering the tower and forcing the cabinet open. I suppose it's possible it already is in the event room if nobody's allowed in for now.{w} There wasn't a camera in the storeroom, so maybe I could see if the handle of the hidden door is still there and if it really leads outside.{w} Using that hidden section is my best bet to make it to the tower during the night. I could either try to enter it from the outside or wait behind the movable wall during the day, where I won't be found before the tower closes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, the other issue is the truly concerning one.
entries.literal: "So, the other issue is the truly concerning one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I would break open the cabinet and activate the alarm. That would lock me in the tower with the person in the security room.
entries.literal: "I would break open the cabinet and activate the alarm. That would lock me in the tower with the person in the security room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, even though we had to spend twelve hours inside, that wouldn't necessarily repeat. They explained to us that there was a way to open the exit before the maximum time. Both the security member and Ashiya can work together to remove the shutter.
entries.literal: "However, even though we had to spend twelve hours inside, that wouldn't necessarily repeat. They explained to us that there was a way to open the exit before the maximum time. Both the security member and Ashiya can work together to remove the shutter."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On the 15th, this system didn't appear to be working for either of them... I can't be sure the same will happen before that day, though. What if interfering with the mechanism was part of the attack? If so, it's very possible it'll still work properly before the 15th.
entries.literal: "On the 15th, this system didn't appear to be working for either of them... I can't be sure the same will happen before that day, though. What if interfering with the mechanism was part of the attack? If so, it's very possible it'll still work properly before the 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can't assume I'll have half a day to experiment with the Sekimeiya. To avoid being seen through the cameras, I could go to a place without them. The attic would be locked, so there wouldn't be many options.
entries.literal: "I can't assume I'll have half a day to experiment with the Sekimeiya. To avoid being seen through the cameras, I could go to a place without them. The attic would be locked, so there wouldn't be many options."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There, assuming the person in the security room doesn't leave, I could try to mess with the Sekimeiya. Maybe I'll touch it and appear somewhere that's being recorded, though.{w} If that's seen from the security room and I don't reply to whatever I'm told by the guard, it's incredibly likely they'll go ahead and unlock the exit.
entries.literal: "There, assuming the person in the security room doesn't leave, I could try to mess with the Sekimeiya. Maybe I'll touch it and appear somewhere that's being recorded, though.{w} If that's seen from the security room and I don't reply to whatever I'm told by the guard, it's incredibly likely they'll go ahead and unlock the exit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept eating the last slices.
entries.literal: "I kept eating the last slices."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Even though the handle of the hidden door was removed, since the door had two holes, we were able to deduce that the handle used to have a keyhole. So even if the handle is still there, I'll probably need the key in order to open it.
entries.literal: "...Even though the handle of the hidden door was removed, since the door had two holes, we were able to deduce that the handle used to have a keyhole. So even if the handle is still there, I'll probably need the key in order to open it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But if I see that I can open the door, it's possible I'll have a good way out.{w} During the night, I could enter the tower through that door and quickly go to the Sekimeiya cabinet to trigger the alarm. Then, as soon as possible, I could leave with the Sekimeiya through the storeroom.
entries.literal: "But if I see that I can open the door, it's possible I'll have a good way out.{w} During the night, I could enter the tower through that door and quickly go to the Sekimeiya cabinet to trigger the alarm. Then, as soon as possible, I could leave with the Sekimeiya through the storeroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If nobody's watching that side of the building and I hide my face from the cameras, I could bring it home and experiment with it here...
entries.literal: "If nobody's watching that side of the building and I hide my face from the cameras, I could bring it home and experiment with it here..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This doesn't sound like it has drawbacks, and it only requires that the storeroom door actually leads outside and that I can open it.
entries.literal: "This doesn't sound like it has drawbacks, and it only requires that the storeroom door actually leads outside and that I can open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}But did that bring serious risks? Even if I was later found outside, I could touch the Sekimeiya and go to the past before my identity was given away. Although I would lose the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...{w}But did that bring serious risks? Even if I was later found outside, I could touch the Sekimeiya and go to the past before my identity was given away. Although I would lose the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why does the hidden area in the storeroom even exist? It's possible Katei lied when he said he didn't know about it. If Ashiya were completely aware of it, there's no way they'll allow it to be opened.
entries.literal: "Why does the hidden area in the storeroom even exist? It's possible Katei lied when he said he didn't know about it. If Ashiya were completely aware of it, there's no way they'll allow it to be opened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait...{w} there might be a way to solve the problem of not being able to figure out why I went so many days to the past.
entries.literal: "Wait...{w} there might be a way to solve the problem of not being able to figure out why I went so many days to the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It makes sense that the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet was a factor to determine the time traveled, even if there's more to it. After all the time I spent in the tower, what I can be almost certain of is that one minute stored comes out to more than one minute traveled.
entries.literal: "It makes sense that the time the Sekimeiya spent out of the cabinet was a factor to determine the time traveled, even if there's more to it. After all the time I spent in the tower, what I can be almost certain of is that one minute stored comes out to more than one minute traveled."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I can't open the storeroom door, I could still make it inside the tower during the night if I wait in the section past the movable wall, assuming someone else who knows about it doesn't check it.{w} After that, I could activate the alarm and leave the Sekimeiya out of its cabinet for a really long time.
entries.literal: "If I can't open the storeroom door, I could still make it inside the tower during the night if I wait in the section past the movable wall, assuming someone else who knows about it doesn't check it.{w} After that, I could activate the alarm and leave the Sekimeiya out of its cabinet for a really long time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How would I prevent the exit from opening early? I'd be talked to from the security room, so maybe I could reply and act as if I really am from Xyn.{w} Could I try to negotiate for hours or somehow convince them not to open the exit prematurely?
entries.literal: "How would I prevent the exit from opening early? I'd be talked to from the security room, so maybe I could reply and act as if I really am from Xyn.{w} Could I try to negotiate for hours or somehow convince them not to open the exit prematurely?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I could think of something to say so that they keep me there, I could be in hallway A all the time.{w} Assuming twelve hours pass, I could run to touch the Sekimeiya just before the deadline. And if at least one stored minute means two minutes traveled, I would go 24 hours into the past. As long as I can make it to the previous night, to a time before the tower is open to the public, I could change the past and repeat the process.{w} I could progressively go days back without understanding how to travel such a long distance at once.
entries.literal: "If I could think of something to say so that they keep me there, I could be in hallway A all the time.{w} Assuming twelve hours pass, I could run to touch the Sekimeiya just before the deadline. And if at least one stored minute means two minutes traveled, I would go 24 hours into the past. As long as I can make it to the previous night, to a time before the tower is open to the public, I could change the past and repeat the process.{w} I could progressively go days back without understanding how to travel such a long distance at once."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I considered my options further, I went to the kitchen and left the bowl in the sink.
entries.literal: "While I considered my options further, I went to the kitchen and left the bowl in the sink."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is this a good idea? I'm not sure I could pull it off.
entries.literal: "...Is this a good idea? I'm not sure I could pull it off."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There are issues too. The person in the security room could see that the Sekimeiya's outside the cabinet and demand that I put it back, knowing that the refrigeration is essential to keep it safe.{w} And if one minute stored doesn't come out to two or more minutes traveled, I could appear during daytime, so I couldn't repeat the process until the same night I started from in the first place.
entries.literal: "There are issues too. The person in the security room could see that the Sekimeiya's outside the cabinet and demand that I put it back, knowing that the refrigeration is essential to keep it safe.{w} And if one minute stored doesn't come out to two or more minutes traveled, I could appear during daytime, so I couldn't repeat the process until the same night I started from in the first place."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}What would even happen if I went back to the 30th and could save Miiya? Where would I stay?
entries.literal: "...{w}What would even happen if I went back to the 30th and could save Miiya? Where would I stay?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Since the past would greatly change, the current version of me who traveled from the 15th would very likely be overwritten.{w} Even if my original self still goes to the hospital on the 30th, that me wouldn't go to live with Atsuki, so I'd instantly have to figure out what to do in a world with two versions of myself.
entries.literal: "Since the past would greatly change, the current version of me who traveled from the 15th would very likely be overwritten.{w} Even if my original self still goes to the hospital on the 30th, that me wouldn't go to live with Atsuki, so I'd instantly have to figure out what to do in a world with two versions of myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That aspect of the loose plan I had still brought me nothing but regret. As much as it was undeniable that saving Miiya would be the ideal outcome, it really wouldn't mean that to me. I was the one whose entire existence would be like a foreign body.
entries.literal: "That aspect of the loose plan I had still brought me nothing but regret. As much as it was undeniable that saving Miiya would be the ideal outcome, it really wouldn't mean that to me. I was the one whose entire existence would be like a foreign body."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Oh, I don't actually think this can work.{w} If the Sekimeiya really was in that shop on the 30th, as long as it wasn't immediately brought to the tower, there could be a point where I couldn't keep progressively going one day back at a time. There'd eventually be no Sekimeiya in the tower to travel with.
entries.literal: "...Oh, I don't actually think this can work.{w} If the Sekimeiya really was in that shop on the 30th, as long as it wasn't immediately brought to the tower, there could be a point where I couldn't keep progressively going one day back at a time. There'd eventually be no Sekimeiya in the tower to travel with."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And there's something else... I only thought of this idea assuming I can't open the storeroom door or that it doesn't lead outside. If I wanted to trap myself during the night, I would need to enter the tower before it closes and wait in the hidden segment of the storeroom.
entries.literal: "And there's something else... I only thought of this idea assuming I can't open the storeroom door or that it doesn't lead outside. If I wanted to trap myself during the night, I would need to enter the tower before it closes and wait in the hidden segment of the storeroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I can only go one day back at a time, I'll eventually reach Sunday, when the tower is closed and I can't get in. The last possible night where I could do this would be Monday—tonight.{w} ...So Miiya died on a Saturday, and I can't save her if I don't figure out why I went so far back.
entries.literal: "If I can only go one day back at a time, I'll eventually reach Sunday, when the tower is closed and I can't get in. The last possible night where I could do this would be Monday—tonight.{w} ...So Miiya died on a Saturday, and I can't save her if I don't figure out why I went so far back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the end, no matter how much I thought in the living room of my house, I had to go to the tower.{w} During the day, I had to try to find the Sekimeiya and check the status of the storeroom door so that I could determine the best course of action.
entries.literal: "In the end, no matter how much I thought in the living room of my house, I had to go to the tower.{w} During the day, I had to try to find the Sekimeiya and check the status of the storeroom door so that I could determine the best course of action."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I rested my head on one of the pillows. After recalling the footprints in the snow, I felt reluctant to leave my apartment again.
entries.literal: "I rested my head on one of the pillows. After recalling the footprints in the snow, I felt reluctant to leave my apartment again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I would leave, just not immediately... I closed my eyes, overwhelmed by all the doubts I had.
entries.literal: "I would leave, just not immediately... I closed my eyes, overwhelmed by all the doubts I had."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: *sigh*
entries.literal: "*sigh*"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up and turned off the lights.
entries.literal: "I stood up and turned off the lights."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard a faint sound.{w} After suddenly raising my head, I noticed it was coming from next to me.
entries.literal: "I heard a faint sound.{w} After suddenly raising my head, I noticed it was coming from next to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached for my purse and took my phone out.
entries.literal: "I reached for my purse and took my phone out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The number calling me was displayed on the back screen. I read it a couple times, wondering if I recognized it.
entries.literal: "The number calling me was displayed on the back screen. I read it a couple times, wondering if I recognized it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think I've ever been called by this number.
entries.literal: "I don't think I've ever been called by this number."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since there was no name below it, it wasn't on my contacts list.
entries.literal: "Since there was no name below it, it wasn't on my contacts list."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's also not the number I just called earlier.
entries.literal: "It's also not the number I just called earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They hadn't hung up yet, so I debated what to do.
entries.literal: "They hadn't hung up yet, so I debated what to do."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Should I pick up? It doesn't seem like anyone has in the hospital.
entries.literal: "...Should I pick up? It doesn't seem like anyone has in the hospital."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was rare for me to receive a strange call. Given my situation, I hesitantly pressed the "accept" button.
entries.literal: "It was rare for me to receive a strange call. Given my situation, I hesitantly pressed the \"accept\" button."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Hello?
entries.literal: "...Hello?"

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: O-Oh, you picked up. Good.{w} Hey there.
entries.literal: "O-Oh, you picked up. Good.{w} Hey there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned, unable to recognize the relieved-sounding voice.
