entries.literal: "I frowned, unable to recognize the relieved-sounding voice."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: Are you Shiroya...?
entries.literal: "Are you Shiroya...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Huh? Yes. ...Who are you?
entries.literal: "Huh? Yes. ...Who are you?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: You were at my place earlier, remember? My name's Vaisude.
entries.literal: "You were at my place earlier, remember? My name's Vaisude."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Ah... from the apartment? Are you the one who's currently living there?
entries.literal: "Ah... from the apartment? Are you the one who's currently living there?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Yes. I'm sorry to suddenly call you like this. I got your number from Cecal's phone.
entries.literal: "Yes. I'm sorry to suddenly call you like this. I got your number from Cecal's phone."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What...? Why?
entries.literal: "What...? Why?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I asked that, but I figured I already knew the answer. He had recognized me.
entries.literal: "I asked that, but I figured I already knew the answer. He had recognized me."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: I just need to ask this first. You were in Ashiya Tower during the terrorist attack on December 15th, right?
entries.literal: "I just need to ask this first. You were in Ashiya Tower during the terrorist attack on December 15th, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}December 15th? What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "...{w}December 15th? What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Wh-What? You know all about it, right? That's why you came to my place.
entries.literal: "Wh-What? You know all about it, right? That's why you came to my place."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}I do, yeah. I was there.
entries.literal: "...{w}I do, yeah. I was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no reason to keep hiding it.
entries.literal: "There was no reason to keep hiding it."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: I see. I knew I wasn't wrong.
entries.literal: "I see. I knew I wasn't wrong."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: There's a reason why I'm calling you. ...I don't know how this will sound, though.
entries.literal: "There's a reason why I'm calling you. ...I don't know how this will sound, though."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What is it?
entries.literal: "...What is it?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: ...Do you know... what I experienced? You read my thread from November, didn't you? That's how you found my apartment.
entries.literal: "...Do you know... what I experienced? You read my thread from November, didn't you? That's how you found my apartment."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What did you experience?
entries.literal: "What did you experience?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Exactly what I wrote about...! From the 15th of December, I suddenly appeared on the 24th of November!
entries.literal: "Exactly what I wrote about...! From the 15th of December, I suddenly appeared on the 24th of November!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, there was no reason to deny it. Since I'd shown up at his place days before the 15th and been one of the people to get trapped, from his perspective, it was fair to conclude that I'd also traveled through time.
entries.literal: "Once again, there was no reason to deny it. Since I'd shown up at his place days before the 15th and been one of the people to get trapped, from his perspective, it was fair to conclude that I'd also traveled through time."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I see. You're right. I also traveled back in time.
entries.literal: "...I see. You're right. I also traveled back in time."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Wh— R-Really...!?{w} So that is what happened! How, though!?
entries.literal: "Wh— R-Really...!?{w} So that is what happened! How, though!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I breathed steadily, wondering what to say.
entries.literal: "I breathed steadily, wondering what to say."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I don't know. I'm confused as well.
entries.literal: "...I don't know. I'm confused as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to reveal the Sekimeiya's powers, as I'd been fearing someone could get to it before me.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to reveal the Sekimeiya's powers, as I'd been fearing someone could get to it before me."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: You don't know...? Something happened inside the tower, right? How is it possible that I appeared in November like that!?
entries.literal: "You don't know...? Something happened inside the tower, right? How is it possible that I appeared in November like that!?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm telling the truth. I don't know. I also suddenly traveled through time when I was in the tower, but I don't know why. I'm kinda glad to know I wasn't the only one, though.
entries.literal: "I'm telling the truth. I don't know. I also suddenly traveled through time when I was in the tower, but I don't know why. I'm kinda glad to know I wasn't the only one, though."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: S-So, time traveling really is possible...! I was so scared I'd lost it completely!{w} Do you really not know anything about what happened?
entries.literal: "S-So, time traveling really is possible...! I was so scared I'd lost it completely!{w} Do you really not know anything about what happened?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I don't. I went to the event with a friend, and we all got knocked out by smoke that came out of nowhere. I know I traveled to the past, but not anything about what happened in that place.
entries.literal: "...I don't. I went to the event with a friend, and we all got knocked out by smoke that came out of nowhere. I know I traveled to the past, but not anything about what happened in that place."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: What the hell...? I don't get it. ...How's that possible? A lot more people had to have come with me, right?
entries.literal: "What the hell...? I don't get it. ...How's that possible? A lot more people had to have come with me, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's possible, but I don't know. You're the first one I've come across.
entries.literal: "It's possible, but I don't know. You're the first one I've come across."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Whoa... This is unreal.
entries.literal: "Whoa... This is unreal."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I know. I can still hardly believe it.
entries.literal: "...I know. I can still hardly believe it."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Why didn't you say anything to me? Isn't that why you came to my place?
entries.literal: "Why didn't you say anything to me? Isn't that why you came to my place?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah, I'm sorry... I didn't know what to say.{w} It was hard to ask out of nowhere if you'd traveled through time.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I'm sorry... I didn't know what to say.{w} It was hard to ask out of nowhere if you'd traveled through time."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Ah, I understand. The same thing happened to me.
entries.literal: "Ah, I understand. The same thing happened to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He kept going after a pause.
entries.literal: "He kept going after a pause."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Then what will happen in two weeks? Do you think it will repeat?
entries.literal: "Then what will happen in two weeks? Do you think it will repeat?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's very possible, but I'm not sure everything will be identical.
entries.literal: "It's very possible, but I'm not sure everything will be identical."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Yeah, that wouldn't make sense. I have no idea how it'll come to occur, but it'll happen again. People will travel to the past. I can't believe it.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that wouldn't make sense. I have no idea how it'll come to occur, but it'll happen again. People will travel to the past. I can't believe it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'm as confused as you are.
entries.literal: "...I'm as confused as you are."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: ...{w}So, are you okay now? I figure getting caught in that attack and suddenly traveling through time was hard on you. I know I didn't take it well.
entries.literal: "...{w}So, are you okay now? I figure getting caught in that attack and suddenly traveling through time was hard on you. I know I didn't take it well."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I am. Don't worry about me.{w} But I do have a question. Did you let your past self see you?
entries.literal: "I am. Don't worry about me.{w} But I do have a question. Did you let your past self see you?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: My past self? No... I didn't, but I-I did see him.{w} I came back to my place on the 25th of November, and in the afternoon, I saw myself coming back from work. I got scared when I heard the sound, so I escaped without being seen.{w} When I started to understand what had happened to me, I managed to avoid problems pretty easily by staying at home before the evening or at my parents'.
entries.literal: "My past self? No... I didn't, but I-I did see him.{w} I came back to my place on the 25th of November, and in the afternoon, I saw myself coming back from work. I got scared when I heard the sound, so I escaped without being seen.{w} When I started to understand what had happened to me, I managed to avoid problems pretty easily by staying at home before the evening or at my parents'."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...So, since it wasn't his intention to change the past, he didn't.
entries.literal: "...So, since it wasn't his intention to change the past, he didn't."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: I'm incredibly relieved I was right, you really can't imagine it. I'm still going to move, but I'm so glad I can stop doubting what I felt sure of.
entries.literal: "I'm incredibly relieved I was right, you really can't imagine it. I'm still going to move, but I'm so glad I can stop doubting what I felt sure of."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...That's good to hear. I'm sure everything will be all right.
entries.literal: "...That's good to hear. I'm sure everything will be all right."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Yeah, I think so too.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I think so too."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You're with the police, right? I saw a picture in your apartment.
entries.literal: "You're with the police, right? I saw a picture in your apartment."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Yes, but I'm afraid I won't work there much longer.{w} ...Honestly, I have been told in the past I'm not always mentally stable. I'm relieved that it's not at the point I'd feared, but staying at my job would be very irresponsible... and dangerous. ...I didn't share it at first, but I think that just made it worse, so I've already accepted my condition.
entries.literal: "Yes, but I'm afraid I won't work there much longer.{w} ...Honestly, I have been told in the past I'm not always mentally stable. I'm relieved that it's not at the point I'd feared, but staying at my job would be very irresponsible... and dangerous. ...I didn't share it at first, but I think that just made it worse, so I've already accepted my condition."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I winced sympathetically at what he was saying. His voice still sounded very calm, but there was a definite trace of sadness in it. It didn't seem like he wanted to specify any details, so I didn't ask for them.
entries.literal: "I winced sympathetically at what he was saying. His voice still sounded very calm, but there was a definite trace of sadness in it. It didn't seem like he wanted to specify any details, so I didn't ask for them."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'm sorry. I hope it gets better once you move out.
entries.literal: "...I'm sorry. I hope it gets better once you move out."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Thank you. I do as well.
entries.literal: "Thank you. I do as well."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You were still working with the police up until the 15th, right?
entries.literal: "You were still working with the police up until the 15th, right?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: I was, yes.
entries.literal: "I was, yes."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: In that case, is there something you know about the attack? ...Do you know what could've happened?
entries.literal: "In that case, is there something you know about the attack? ...Do you know what could've happened?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I don't know anything.{w} It was a highly entertained possibility that Xyn could've been planning something, but I don't know anything beyond that.
entries.literal: "Oh, I'm sorry. I don't know anything.{w} It was a highly entertained possibility that Xyn could've been planning something, but I don't know anything beyond that."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I see. That's fine.
entries.literal: "I see. That's fine."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: ...Sorry, I'd love to give you more information. Ashiya quickly put out a statement about their version of what had happened, but nobody really believed it. We thought that something in the security system went wrong because Ashiya were having problems unlocking the way in and the communication with the interior suddenly cut.
entries.literal: "...Sorry, I'd love to give you more information. Ashiya quickly put out a statement about their version of what had happened, but nobody really believed it. We thought that something in the security system went wrong because Ashiya were having problems unlocking the way in and the communication with the interior suddenly cut."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah, that's what happened inside as well, but we couldn't figure out what caused it.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that's what happened inside as well, but we couldn't figure out what caused it."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: I see... I apologize for not being more helpful.
entries.literal: "I see... I apologize for not being more helpful."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Don't worry, I wanted to ask just in case.
entries.literal: "Don't worry, I wanted to ask just in case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure whether asking my next question was the right call, but I had to know.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure whether asking my next question was the right call, but I had to know."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh, something else. I don't mean to be rude or anything, but were you in Seeuta D'ella earlier?
entries.literal: "Oh, something else. I don't mean to be rude or anything, but were you in Seeuta D'ella earlier?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: ...The park? No. Why...?
entries.literal: "...The park? No. Why...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I thought I might've seen you there. Was I wrong?
entries.literal: "I thought I might've seen you there. Was I wrong?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: ...Yes. I'm still at my apartment.
entries.literal: "...Yes. I'm still at my apartment."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I was mistaken, then.
entries.literal: "I was mistaken, then."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Yeah, it wasn't me.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it wasn't me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I see, sorry.
entries.literal: "...I see, sorry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to push it, but I still halfway doubted him.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to push it, but I still halfway doubted him."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: It's fine. I guess this was all I called you for, but thank you for telling me the truth. Hearing that really was a relief.
entries.literal: "It's fine. I guess this was all I called you for, but thank you for telling me the truth. Hearing that really was a relief."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm glad. ...Do you think you'll be okay?
entries.literal: "I'm glad. ...Do you think you'll be okay?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: I will. I'm not sure what I'll do now, knowing what happened, but I'll manage. I hope you will too. Is there anything else you want to know?
entries.literal: "I will. I'm not sure what I'll do now, knowing what happened, but I'll manage. I hope you will too. Is there anything else you want to know?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Uh...{w} yes.{w} Do you know exactly when you traveled through time on the 15th?
entries.literal: "Uh...{w} yes.{w} Do you know exactly when you traveled through time on the 15th?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: The time? ...It might've been close to {time=16}, I think.
entries.literal: "The time? ...It might've been close to {time=16}, I think."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Hm...{w} I don't know, then. I traveled hours later, so I don't know what to think.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} I don't know, then. I traveled hours later, so I don't know what to think."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: ...That's unbelievable. I just can't wrap my head around it.
entries.literal: "...That's unbelievable. I just can't wrap my head around it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I know...
entries.literal: "I know..."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Can you think of anything else that could be of use? I'd really like to help understand what happened. This is way too crazy.
entries.literal: "Can you think of anything else that could be of use? I'd really like to help understand what happened. This is way too crazy."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}I don't think so, no.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't think so, no."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: I see... Do call me if you think of anything, then. Even though we still can't understand anything, at least now I can be somewhat at ease.
entries.literal: "I see... Do call me if you think of anything, then. Even though we still can't understand anything, at least now I can be somewhat at ease."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Okay. I will.
entries.literal: "...Okay. I will."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: And if you realize something or can think of what happened, please tell me. I would really appreciate that.
entries.literal: "And if you realize something or can think of what happened, please tell me. I would really appreciate that."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: All right.
entries.literal: "All right."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Thank you.
entries.literal: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a few seconds, he said goodbye, and the call ended.
entries.literal: "After a few seconds, he said goodbye, and the call ended."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...So that's that.
entries.literal: "...So that's that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left my phone on the floor and rested my head back on the pillow. I'd briefly looked at the time, which had shown {time=16:58.}
entries.literal: "I left my phone on the floor and rested my head back on the pillow. I'd briefly looked at the time, which had shown {time=16:58.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm glad all that makes more sense now. ...It's probably fine that I revealed I traveled through time.{w} At {time=16} we were in the attic, and I think Sai and Akaro had already escaped from the bedroom... I might've been right with what I thought before.
entries.literal: "I'm glad all that makes more sense now. ...It's probably fine that I revealed I traveled through time.{w} At {time=16} we were in the attic, and I think Sai and Akaro had already escaped from the bedroom... I might've been right with what I thought before."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I forgot to ask, but Xyn definitely didn't approach him. It seems that all the information he could give them would be the very basic details behind the alarm, although I really doubt he would. He knows he's in the past, so if someone approaches him asking questions without knowledge of what happened on the 15th, it'll be easy to conclude they're not good people.
entries.literal: "I forgot to ask, but Xyn definitely didn't approach him. It seems that all the information he could give them would be the very basic details behind the alarm, although I really doubt he would. He knows he's in the past, so if someone approaches him asking questions without knowledge of what happened on the 15th, it'll be easy to conclude they're not good people."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It didn't sound like he was taking it that badly, though. I guess he'll be at his parents' house from now on. If everything were to repeat, his original self would still live in his apartment until the 15th, when he'd travel to the past.
entries.literal: "It didn't sound like he was taking it that badly, though. I guess he'll be at his parents' house from now on. If everything were to repeat, his original self would still live in his apartment until the 15th, when he'd travel to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I figured I didn't have to think too hard about it, so after wondering if there was anything else important I could ask him, I shut my eyes and buried my face in my pillow.
entries.literal: "I figured I didn't have to think too hard about it, so after wondering if there was anything else important I could ask him, I shut my eyes and buried my face in my pillow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A while later, I went to the hallway. I tended not to enjoy taking showers during the winter, but as the heater had been working all day, it felt like a good idea. ...And I just wanted to do something.
entries.literal: "A while later, I went to the hallway. I tended not to enjoy taking showers during the winter, but as the heater had been working all day, it felt like a good idea. ...And I just wanted to do something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Technically, I'd showered two days earlier, on the 30th. I went to my bedroom and selected the clothes I usually slept in.
entries.literal: "Technically, I'd showered two days earlier, on the 30th. I went to my bedroom and selected the clothes I usually slept in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had a bathtub in the bathroom, as my apartment wasn't big enough to have a dedicated room for it. I wasn't good at taking short showers, so I generally opted to take baths and avoid using up all the hot water.
entries.literal: "I had a bathtub in the bathroom, as my apartment wasn't big enough to have a dedicated room for it. I wasn't good at taking short showers, so I generally opted to take baths and avoid using up all the hot water."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned on the water and waited for it to heat up as I left my nightwear ready.
entries.literal: "I turned on the water and waited for it to heat up as I left my nightwear ready."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door and stepped out. Thanks to the heater, the hallway felt cold in a pleasant way.
entries.literal: "I opened the door and stepped out. Thanks to the heater, the hallway felt cold in a pleasant way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How much time had I spent there? I'd tried to keep my mind empty, but it wasn't easy, especially after Vaisude's call.{w} As usual, the bath had been relaxing, but it also made me more tired.
entries.literal: "How much time had I spent there? I'd tried to keep my mind empty, but it wasn't easy, especially after Vaisude's call.{w} As usual, the bath had been relaxing, but it also made me more tired."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't usually like how my hair looked after using the hair dryer, so I only used a towel, leaving it slightly wet. I'd tried not to soak it too much since I had to sleep soon, but that hadn't worked out, and I wasn't sure where the dryer even was.
entries.literal: "I didn't usually like how my hair looked after using the hair dryer, so I only used a towel, leaving it slightly wet. I'd tried not to soak it too much since I had to sleep soon, but that hadn't worked out, and I wasn't sure where the dryer even was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No sunlight was left. I approached my phone and glanced at the time.{w} {time=19:19.} The previous day, I'd gone to sleep very early, so my body was demanding that I repeat the schedule.
entries.literal: "No sunlight was left. I approached my phone and glanced at the time.{w} {time=19:19.} The previous day, I'd gone to sleep very early, so my body was demanding that I repeat the schedule."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I'm not sure this is gonna go well if I'm going to spend the entire night in the tower soon.
entries.literal: "...I'm not sure this is gonna go well if I'm going to spend the entire night in the tower soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd had a pretty sad thought in the bathtub. My birthday was on the 19th of December, and Atsuki's was on the 21st. Earlier that year, the three of us had celebrated Miiya's, but it could end up being the first year I could remember where Atsuki and I wouldn't be together those two days.
entries.literal: "I'd had a pretty sad thought in the bathtub. My birthday was on the 19th of December, and Atsuki's was on the 21st. Earlier that year, the three of us had celebrated Miiya's, but it could end up being the first year I could remember where Atsuki and I wouldn't be together those two days."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If we'd continued in the tower and the exit hadn't opened, we would've spent them locked inside. I was already moving the world away from that reality... The thought of having to miss those days was pretty disheartening, even if they would technically happen with another version of me present.
entries.literal: "If we'd continued in the tower and the exit hadn't opened, we would've spent them locked inside. I was already moving the world away from that reality... The thought of having to miss those days was pretty disheartening, even if they would technically happen with another version of me present."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I knew I wouldn't let myself be tricked. I wouldn't abandon the wish to save Miiya because of that. If I did, spending our birthdays together wouldn't mean anything anymore.
entries.literal: "But I knew I wouldn't let myself be tricked. I wouldn't abandon the wish to save Miiya because of that. If I did, spending our birthdays together wouldn't mean anything anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Yawning, I brought my phone to my bedroom. Sometimes, I got pretty hungry after bathing, but I really just wanted to lie down. ...The time had been passing so fast since I'd made it home.
entries.literal: "Yawning, I brought my phone to my bedroom. Sometimes, I got pretty hungry after bathing, but I really just wanted to lie down. ...The time had been passing so fast since I'd made it home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned off the hallway light and walked to my bed. The blinds were still down, so I turned off the light there too and covered myself with the blankets, their soft touch highlighted after the bath.
entries.literal: "I turned off the hallway light and walked to my bed. The blinds were still down, so I turned off the light there too and covered myself with the blankets, their soft touch highlighted after the bath."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm gonna wake up on December 3rd...
entries.literal: "I'm gonna wake up on December 3rd..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Atsuki's probably suffering by himself in his house. ...Or maybe he's in the hospital. This is about the time I woke up on the 8th, and he was there.
entries.literal: "...Atsuki's probably suffering by himself in his house. ...Or maybe he's in the hospital. This is about the time I woke up on the 8th, and he was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No matter what I do, things won't ever be the same, will they?
entries.literal: "No matter what I do, things won't ever be the same, will they?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I have to go to the tower tomorrow, don't I...? That'll tell me which options I have.{w} Assuming I'm able to find the cabinet, what would I choose? If I can't decide now, how will I be able to decide tomorrow?
entries.literal: "I have to go to the tower tomorrow, don't I...? That'll tell me which options I have.{w} Assuming I'm able to find the cabinet, what would I choose? If I can't decide now, how will I be able to decide tomorrow?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was so comfortable in my bed that it was almost impossible to believe that, within a few hours, I might have been living in a world where I wouldn't really be myself.{w} Instead, I could end up in a prison cell. The choices I had weren't just freeing, they were daunting.
entries.literal: "I was so comfortable in my bed that it was almost impossible to believe that, within a few hours, I might have been living in a world where I wouldn't really be myself.{w} Instead, I could end up in a prison cell. The choices I had weren't just freeing, they were daunting."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}If I changed the past, I would pretty much be sacrificing myself. It's already changed in a very minor way, but that might not matter.{w} Even if I can't ever use the Sekimeiya again, if I simply prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower on the 15th, the other version of me will never travel through time, so both of us will persist.{w} ...That is assuming I don't get dematerialized by a paradox. Since the past can be changed, I should probably not be worried about that. Hopefully.
entries.literal: "...{w}If I changed the past, I would pretty much be sacrificing myself. It's already changed in a very minor way, but that might not matter.{w} Even if I can't ever use the Sekimeiya again, if I simply prevent Atsuki and myself from going to the tower on the 15th, the other version of me will never travel through time, so both of us will persist.{w} ...That is assuming I don't get dematerialized by a paradox. Since the past can be changed, I should probably not be worried about that. Hopefully."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was just so frustrating to think about. Like in the bathroom, I forced the thoughts away and tried to breathe calmly.
entries.literal: "It was just so frustrating to think about. Like in the bathroom, I forced the thoughts away and tried to breathe calmly."

entries.text: Mutual Reject
entries.literal: "Mutual Reject"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at my window. It was still pretty early, as I couldn't see light through the gaps.
entries.literal: "I looked at my window. It was still pretty early, as I couldn't see light through the gaps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed I'd woken up as early as I'd gone to sleep. I felt well-rested, so I sat up instead of lounging around.
entries.literal: "It seemed I'd woken up as early as I'd gone to sleep. I felt well-rested, so I sat up instead of lounging around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd realized that the time I had left was potentially scarce, and it felt like a long, long time since I'd appreciated ordinary days so much. ...I didn't want them to end any time soon, so I got out of bed right away.
entries.literal: "I'd realized that the time I had left was potentially scarce, and it felt like a long, long time since I'd appreciated ordinary days so much. ...I didn't want them to end any time soon, so I got out of bed right away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The time was {time=7:45.}{w} I set the phone back on the table while a glimpse of the dream I'd just had returned to me.
entries.literal: "The time was {time=7:45.}{w} I set the phone back on the table while a glimpse of the dream I'd just had returned to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't able to piece it together properly, but I knew it had been very similar to the one from two nights prior. I had been in the tower, working through an infinite cascade of headaches caused by the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I wasn't able to piece it together properly, but I knew it had been very similar to the one from two nights prior. I had been in the tower, working through an infinite cascade of headaches caused by the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm... maybe it's a little interesting that I'm dreaming about this.
entries.literal: "Hm... maybe it's a little interesting that I'm dreaming about this."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The body I'm currently in was never in the tower. The part of me that's causing these dreams traveled alongside my consciousness from the 15th.
entries.literal: "The body I'm currently in was never in the tower. The part of me that's causing these dreams traveled alongside my consciousness from the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was no expert on how dreams worked, and there wasn't much I could really glean from that anyway.
entries.literal: "I was no expert on how dreams worked, and there wasn't much I could really glean from that anyway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Actually, wait a second. I went fifteen days back in time, but mentally, I still aged those fifteen days. I'm not sure exactly how old my body actually is after doing that, but wouldn't that mean that my birthday is technically on December 4th from now on instead? So, tomorrow.
entries.literal: "Actually, wait a second. I went fifteen days back in time, but mentally, I still aged those fifteen days. I'm not sure exactly how old my body actually is after doing that, but wouldn't that mean that my birthday is technically on December 4th from now on instead? So, tomorrow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh. I'm just going to ignore that. It seems easier.
entries.literal: "Huh. I'm just going to ignore that. It seems easier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up as I stretched my limbs and walked to the wardrobe while rubbing my eyes. Sleeping so long would actually tire me out sometimes, but I felt completely rested.
entries.literal: "I stood up as I stretched my limbs and walked to the wardrobe while rubbing my eyes. Sleeping so long would actually tire me out sometimes, but I felt completely rested."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The radiators had been emitting heat for a long time, so the temperature was very pleasing.
entries.literal: "The radiators had been emitting heat for a long time, so the temperature was very pleasing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took some time to drink water and eat a few almonds. For some reason, I felt the impulse to go out, just like the first day.
entries.literal: "I took some time to drink water and eat a few almonds. For some reason, I felt the impulse to go out, just like the first day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to open the door and check the temperature, but it didn't open smoothly. When I peeked out, I understood why.
entries.literal: "I tried to open the door and check the temperature, but it didn't open smoothly. When I peeked out, I understood why."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It's snowing. The sun is rising from behind the mountains, too.
entries.literal: "...It's snowing. The sun is rising from behind the mountains, too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't very dense snow, and only a bit of it had piled in front of the door. It didn't feel unbearably cold, so I stepped back in to go grab my phone and put on my coat.
entries.literal: "It wasn't very dense snow, and only a bit of it had piled in front of the door. It didn't feel unbearably cold, so I stepped back in to go grab my phone and put on my coat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remembered the footprints from the previous day again. I didn't want to let them intimidate me, so I discarded the thought. Despite that, I knew that finding out who was responsible for them, if I could, was a fairly good idea.
entries.literal: "I remembered the footprints from the previous day again. I didn't want to let them intimidate me, so I discarded the thought. Despite that, I knew that finding out who was responsible for them, if I could, was a fairly good idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped out but stopped myself as I was walking down the stairs.
entries.literal: "I stepped out but stopped myself as I was walking down the stairs."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe it's too early. ...It's also colder than I thought.
entries.literal: "Maybe it's too early. ...It's also colder than I thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to turn around so soon, so I kept going down, taking a few uncertain steps.{w} There was nobody outside. I was the only person I could see being hit by the falling snow.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to turn around so soon, so I kept going down, taking a few uncertain steps.{w} There was nobody outside. I was the only person I could see being hit by the falling snow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put on the heavy hood and began to make distance from my apartment.
entries.literal: "I put on the heavy hood and began to make distance from my apartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd previously wandered around Yushibana without a purpose, but the weather no longer made that a good idea. If I decided not to turn back, I had to actually go somewhere.
entries.literal: "I'd previously wandered around Yushibana without a purpose, but the weather no longer made that a good idea. If I decided not to turn back, I had to actually go somewhere."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's so early, though. ...Should I just go to the tower?
entries.literal: "It's so early, though. ...Should I just go to the tower?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't change direction, well aware that a part of me didn't want to go back there.
entries.literal: "I didn't change direction, well aware that a part of me didn't want to go back there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would I only go when I'd made up my mind? If so, that would never happen.{w} My whole life, I'd always avoided getting near that building. After the hellish day I'd spent there, that resistant part of me had only gotten stronger.
entries.literal: "Would I only go when I'd made up my mind? If so, that would never happen.{w} My whole life, I'd always avoided getting near that building. After the hellish day I'd spent there, that resistant part of me had only gotten stronger."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Last night, I decided I'd go today, though. I really should...{w} I should, because if I don't, Miiya's fate could be set in stone at any time.
entries.literal: "Last night, I decided I'd go today, though. I really should...{w} I should, because if I don't, Miiya's fate could be set in stone at any time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd once thought that it already had been set in stone, even after learning about the Sekimeiya. Even with all the dilemmas I had, the impulse to go outside took priority over them. It was a strange, new sensation, and I hoped it would persist. Going to the tower would remove the faint traces of freedom I was feeling.
entries.literal: "I'd once thought that it already had been set in stone, even after learning about the Sekimeiya. Even with all the dilemmas I had, the impulse to go outside took priority over them. It was a strange, new sensation, and I hoped it would persist. Going to the tower would remove the faint traces of freedom I was feeling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The streets were completely desolate. I'd gotten pretty far without noticing it, absorbed by the same persistent quandary.
entries.literal: "...The streets were completely desolate. I'd gotten pretty far without noticing it, absorbed by the same persistent quandary."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Am I just afraid of being alone in a world where Miiya's alive? I don't even think I'm that concerned about getting caught by the police.{w} Right now, I'm all by myself, and I don't dislike it like I have in the past. ...It's probably because I know it's not indefinite, though.
entries.literal: "Am I just afraid of being alone in a world where Miiya's alive? I don't even think I'm that concerned about getting caught by the police.{w} Right now, I'm all by myself, and I don't dislike it like I have in the past. ...It's probably because I know it's not indefinite, though."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If that's all it is, couldn't I just go talk to Atsuki? If I explain everything to him, both of us could travel to the past and save Miiya. Another version of both of us would remain, but I wouldn't have to be by myself.
entries.literal: "If that's all it is, couldn't I just go talk to Atsuki? If I explain everything to him, both of us could travel to the past and save Miiya. Another version of both of us would remain, but I wouldn't have to be by myself."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He would probably agree to it...
entries.literal: "He would probably agree to it..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But by traveling from the tower alone, I'd willingly avoided that already. ...Hadn't I traveled to the past precisely to also erase Atsuki's pain, so that he wouldn't have to remember everything?
entries.literal: "But by traveling from the tower alone, I'd willingly avoided that already. ...Hadn't I traveled to the past precisely to also erase Atsuki's pain, so that he wouldn't have to remember everything?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At once, I realized that the sight in front of me was not one I'd seen before.
entries.literal: "At once, I realized that the sight in front of me was not one I'd seen before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A foggy Ramon street extended far ahead of me, but only a handful of people were walking, covering their heads due to the snow. I had never seen it so devoid of life.{w} The entire area had begun to be coated by a thin layer of whiteness. I'd gotten there early enough to witness it before it was manually removed.
entries.literal: "A foggy Ramon street extended far ahead of me, but only a handful of people were walking, covering their heads due to the snow. I had never seen it so devoid of life.{w} The entire area had begun to be coated by a thin layer of whiteness. I'd gotten there early enough to witness it before it was manually removed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I crossed the empty road. On the other side, I looked around me and saw that every shop was closed.
entries.literal: "I crossed the empty road. On the other side, I looked around me and saw that every shop was closed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For a while, I didn't move. It was such an unusual sight that I had to wonder if it made any sense.
entries.literal: "For a while, I didn't move. It was such an unusual sight that I had to wonder if it made any sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's... never been like this, has it?
entries.literal: "It's... never been like this, has it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything was closed, and there were so few people... It was hard to think I was at the same place as always.
entries.literal: "Everything was closed, and there were so few people... It was hard to think I was at the same place as always."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even the times I went to school through Ramon, there were a lot more people, right? It was also around this time of day.
entries.literal: "Even the times I went to school through Ramon, there were a lot more people, right? It was also around this time of day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was heading to Ina Café, but I started to doubt it'd be open, as nothing else was.
entries.literal: "I was heading to Ina Café, but I started to doubt it'd be open, as nothing else was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That didn't feel right. I didn't think I'd ever seen it closed, not even on any special holiday.
entries.literal: "That didn't feel right. I didn't think I'd ever seen it closed, not even on any special holiday."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was at a branching street farther up, so I kept going, assuring myself that it would be up and running.
entries.literal: "It was at a branching street farther up, so I kept going, assuring myself that it would be up and running."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sometimes, I'd seen people out walking their dogs so early in the morning, but the snow made that impossible. When someone finally passed me by, I glanced at their face, and it didn't seem like they found the state of their surroundings strange.
entries.literal: "Sometimes, I'd seen people out walking their dogs so early in the morning, but the snow made that impossible. When someone finally passed me by, I glanced at their face, and it didn't seem like they found the state of their surroundings strange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got more and more confused. ...Was the lack of people normal? Perhaps the few memories I had of my morning trips to school were mistaken.{w} I was sure of one thing, though. When I'd taken Ramon street to go to classes, it had been to stop by Ina and eat something. While I couldn't be sure about the other places, I knew that not once had Ina been closed.
entries.literal: "I got more and more confused. ...Was the lack of people normal? Perhaps the few memories I had of my morning trips to school were mistaken.{w} I was sure of one thing, though. When I'd taken Ramon street to go to classes, it had been to stop by Ina and eat something. While I couldn't be sure about the other places, I knew that not once had Ina been closed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Starting to get impatient, I accelerated toward Costa, the small street I'd always turned to.
entries.literal: "Starting to get impatient, I accelerated toward Costa, the small street I'd always turned to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When it finally came into view, I raised my head, letting the falling snow collide with my face. Soon, Ina came up, and I slowed down.
entries.literal: "When it finally came into view, I raised my head, letting the falling snow collide with my face. Soon, Ina came up, and I slowed down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It really is closed.
entries.literal: "...It really is closed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at it from a distance. It shouldn't have been that strange, but a surrealness similar to the one I'd felt in the tower started to creep into the edges of my mind.
entries.literal: "I stared at it from a distance. It shouldn't have been that strange, but a surrealness similar to the one I'd felt in the tower started to creep into the edges of my mind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wasn't wrong, though. I've never seen it closed before.
entries.literal: "I wasn't wrong, though. I've never seen it closed before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could be sure of that since there was an emblem of a coffee mug on the shutter that I was certainly seeing for the first time.
entries.literal: "I could be sure of that since there was an emblem of a coffee mug on the shutter that I was certainly seeing for the first time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued getting closer without looking away. As I did, I thought of a time Darfee had said they didn't close a single day of the year.
entries.literal: "I continued getting closer without looking away. As I did, I thought of a time Darfee had said they didn't close a single day of the year."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Could he be sick?
entries.literal: "...Could he be sick?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No, that's not it. ...Everything else is closed too.
entries.literal: "No, that's not it. ...Everything else is closed too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to think of a reason, but I couldn't. The lack of people and open stores... Something about Yushibana was off.
entries.literal: "I tried to think of a reason, but I couldn't. The lack of people and open stores... Something about Yushibana was off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got to the shutter and tried to find a note explaining why it was closed. But there was nothing.
entries.literal: "I got to the shutter and tried to find a note explaining why it was closed. But there was nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I took my phone out and looked at the time. It was {time=7:59.}
entries.literal: "...I took my phone out and looked at the time. It was {time=7:59.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's possible he recently started to open later. That'd be weird, because students usually buy pastries here on the way to school.
entries.literal: "It's possible he recently started to open later. That'd be weird, because students usually buy pastries here on the way to school."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The classes started at {time=8:00}, and I'd always been under the impression that Ina opened half an hour earlier.{w} I stepped under a thin stone roof to shield myself from the snow.
entries.literal: "The classes started at {time=8:00}, and I'd always been under the impression that Ina opened half an hour earlier.{w} I stepped under a thin stone roof to shield myself from the snow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was lost, not knowing what to think. ...Surely Yushibana would soon look as it always had.
entries.literal: "I was lost, not knowing what to think. ...Surely Yushibana would soon look as it always had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd spent a couple of minutes crouching down under the roof, almost afraid of the silent street.
entries.literal: "I'd spent a couple of minutes crouching down under the roof, almost afraid of the silent street."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Wait. There's nobody here.{w} Why did I not see anyone going to school?
entries.literal: "...Wait. There's nobody here.{w} Why did I not see anyone going to school?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't understand. That didn't make sense.
entries.literal: "I didn't understand. That didn't make sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Classes had to be starting, but everything around me was deserted.
entries.literal: "Classes had to be starting, but everything around me was deserted."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I used to see a few people going to school when I went through the center. Why have I not seen anyone?
entries.literal: "I used to see a few people going to school when I went through the center. Why have I not seen anyone?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't gone to school in months. Had something changed? The schedule, maybe? Some emergency? Was December 3rd a holiday I wasn't aware of? ...I couldn't be sure of anything, as I'd spent the entire time in a coma.
entries.literal: "I hadn't gone to school in months. Had something changed? The schedule, maybe? Some emergency? Was December 3rd a holiday I wasn't aware of? ...I couldn't be sure of anything, as I'd spent the entire time in a coma."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was wrong...!? No matter how much I looked around me, the absence of people wasn't normal, and even if there were no classes for some reason, Ina should have been open.
entries.literal: "What was wrong...!? No matter how much I looked around me, the absence of people wasn't normal, and even if there were no classes for some reason, Ina should have been open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the snow piling on the ground. Beyond my safe place, the white curtain extended ahead, almost like a cloud.
entries.literal: "I stared at the snow piling on the ground. Beyond my safe place, the white curtain extended ahead, almost like a cloud."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have gloves, so I tended to keep my hands warm in the pockets of my coat. Snow had slipped its way inside, and the cold ate at my fingers.
entries.literal: "I didn't have gloves, so I tended to keep my hands warm in the pockets of my coat. Snow had slipped its way inside, and the cold ate at my fingers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to do. There was nowhere I could go, and the temperature was imposing, rapidly becoming oppressive as soon as I'd stopped moving.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to do. There was nowhere I could go, and the temperature was imposing, rapidly becoming oppressive as soon as I'd stopped moving."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I should just go home.
entries.literal: "...I should just go home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hung my head. I'd been feeling fine when I left my apartment, but the atmosphere outside was completely unwelcoming, repelling me.
entries.literal: "I hung my head. I'd been feeling fine when I left my apartment, but the atmosphere outside was completely unwelcoming, repelling me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So I stubbornly stayed there. Perhaps the mornings in Yushibana had become a lot more empty than before, but I knew it wouldn't be like that all day. Shortly, Ramon would fill up as always, practically bustling by comparison.
entries.literal: "So I stubbornly stayed there. Perhaps the mornings in Yushibana had become a lot more empty than before, but I knew it wouldn't be like that all day. Shortly, Ramon would fill up as always, practically bustling by comparison."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I clenched my hands and shuffled my feet repeatedly. The cold was sapping my energy bit by bit, so I had to keep confirming that I was capable of movement.
entries.literal: "I clenched my hands and shuffled my feet repeatedly. The cold was sapping my energy bit by bit, so I had to keep confirming that I was capable of movement."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew I wasn't wrong. Ahead of Ina was a clothing store that had always been open at that time, but I could see it was closed as well. The Yushibana I was in didn't make sense. It was abnormal.
entries.literal: "I knew I wasn't wrong. Ahead of Ina was a clothing store that had always been open at that time, but I could see it was closed as well. The Yushibana I was in didn't make sense. It was abnormal."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How long had I been there? I was too cold to curl my fingers around my phone.
entries.literal: "How long had I been there? I was too cold to curl my fingers around my phone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What am I doing...? I need to go home.
entries.literal: "What am I doing...? I need to go home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Remembering the heater, I almost stood up. However, looking at my right, I noticed that some people had arrived at Ramon. It didn't feel normal yet, but it was getting there.
entries.literal: "Remembering the heater, I almost stood up. However, looking at my right, I noticed that some people had arrived at Ramon. It didn't feel normal yet, but it was getting there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I just had to wait a little more. At any point, one of the shops had to open, and I could enter it to eat something.
entries.literal: "I just had to wait a little more. At any point, one of the shops had to open, and I could enter it to eat something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would that really happen? Everyone I could see walked ahead individually, either hidden behind an umbrella or disappearing into the distance without looking anywhere else.
entries.literal: "Would that really happen? Everyone I could see walked ahead individually, either hidden behind an umbrella or disappearing into the distance without looking anywhere else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned abruptly to a nearby sound.{w} An old man was walking toward me from the wider street.
entries.literal: "I turned abruptly to a nearby sound.{w} An old man was walking toward me from the wider street."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He hadn't seen me, and his tired eyes stared ahead as he walked through his own breath. I forced my body to stand up and stepped out from under the roof.
entries.literal: "He hadn't seen me, and his tired eyes stared ahead as he walked through his own breath. I forced my body to stand up and stepped out from under the roof."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...A-Ah, I'm sorry...
entries.literal: "...A-Ah, I'm sorry..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Oh?"{w} He suddenly noticed I'd addressed him and focused his expression, trying to hear my voice.
entries.literal: "\"Oh?\"{w} He suddenly noticed I'd addressed him and focused his expression, trying to hear my voice."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Um... is it normal that everything is closed? Shouldn't Ina be open already?
entries.literal: "Um... is it normal that everything is closed? Shouldn't Ina be open already?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: ...Huh? I-Ina...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He frowned and looked at the shutter.
entries.literal: "He frowned and looked at the shutter."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I've never been there, but it's true that it's usually open.{w} You think it should be?
entries.literal: "I've never been there, but it's true that it's usually open.{w} You think it should be?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yes. I think so.{w} It's not only Ina, though. Everything's closed.
entries.literal: "Yes. I think so.{w} It's not only Ina, though. Everything's closed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...He looked all around him.
entries.literal: "...He looked all around him."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Hm, that's true. I don't think they should be closed today, so you probably only have to wait a little more. It's still pretty early.
entries.literal: "Hm, that's true. I don't think they should be closed today, so you probably only have to wait a little more. It's still pretty early."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I see.
entries.literal: "...I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was about to drop it, but I insisted before he kept walking.
entries.literal: "He was about to drop it, but I insisted before he kept walking."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: But... aren't there far fewer people around than usual? It's Tuesday, right? There's no reason why that'd be the case.
entries.literal: "But... aren't there far fewer people around than usual? It's Tuesday, right? There's no reason why that'd be the case."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Fewer people...? You think so?
entries.literal: "Fewer people...? You think so?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a bit, he shook his head.
entries.literal: "After a bit, he shook his head."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Like I said, it's very early in the morning.
entries.literal: "Like I said, it's very early in the morning."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}Maybe I'm wrong. ...It's just the impression I got.
entries.literal: "...{w}Maybe I'm wrong. ...It's just the impression I got."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He shrugged and gave a short, dry laugh before nodding his head and parting.
entries.literal: "He shrugged and gave a short, dry laugh before nodding his head and parting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd felt before that I was being a little paranoid. Was that all it was...?
entries.literal: "I'd felt before that I was being a little paranoid. Was that all it was...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped back, shaking a bit of snow off my head. Maybe I'd internally exaggerated things, but I didn't think my memories were off.
entries.literal: "I stepped back, shaking a bit of snow off my head. Maybe I'd internally exaggerated things, but I didn't think my memories were off."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I should just wait, then—that's all. At some point, nobody will be able to say it's too early for the stores to be closed.
entries.literal: "...I should just wait, then—that's all. At some point, nobody will be able to say it's too early for the stores to be closed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been below that short roof for some minutes, and while I couldn't stay there for much longer, there was nowhere else to take shelter. However, the thought of going all the way home before eating anything was intimidating.
entries.literal: "I'd been below that short roof for some minutes, and while I couldn't stay there for much longer, there was nowhere else to take shelter. However, the thought of going all the way home before eating anything was intimidating."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's definitely more people than before. ...It's all fine.
entries.literal: "There's definitely more people than before. ...It's all fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Minutes earlier, I'd been considerably anxious due to the state of Yushibana. ...And I'd just made it up. That was all I could think it was.
entries.literal: "Minutes earlier, I'd been considerably anxious due to the state of Yushibana. ...And I'd just made it up. That was all I could think it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't be relieved yet, because all around me, I could only see shutters. Only after one of them moved would any remaining doubt dissipate.
entries.literal: "I couldn't be relieved yet, because all around me, I could only see shutters. Only after one of them moved would any remaining doubt dissipate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I leaned against the cold wall, questioning myself. ...It was such a horrible feeling.
entries.literal: "I leaned against the cold wall, questioning myself. ...It was such a horrible feeling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Very soon, I heard a loud grinding sound.
entries.literal: "Very soon, I heard a loud grinding sound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned to the mug symbol and saw it rising, uncovering the dim interior through the glass.
entries.literal: "I turned to the mug symbol and saw it rising, uncovering the dim interior through the glass."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee was inside with a ring of keys in his hand. He unlocked the door and pushed the shutter all the way up.{w} I approached nervously before he noticed me.
entries.literal: "Darfee was inside with a ring of keys in his hand. He unlocked the door and pushed the shutter all the way up.{w} I approached nervously before he noticed me."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: ...!{w} Shiroya! What are you doing here so early?
entries.literal: "...!{w} Shiroya! What are you doing here so early?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I was waiting for you to open. I really wanted to go somewhere, for some reason.{w} I thought you opened at {time=7:30}, though.
entries.literal: "...I was waiting for you to open. I really wanted to go somewhere, for some reason.{w} I thought you opened at {time=7:30}, though."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: ...You're right, I'm sorry if I'm late. Have you been waiting for a while?
entries.literal: "...You're right, I'm sorry if I'm late. Have you been waiting for a while?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I've been here a bit, but don't worry.
entries.literal: "I've been here a bit, but don't worry."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: ...Well, now I feel bad. Come in... You must be really cold.
entries.literal: "...Well, now I feel bad. Come in... You must be really cold."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went through the transparent door, lightly tapping the snow off my shoes. I was glad that everything was all right. I couldn't understand if something strange had really just happened, but the warmth alleviated my worries.
entries.literal: "I went through the transparent door, lightly tapping the snow off my shoes. I was glad that everything was all right. I couldn't understand if something strange had really just happened, but the warmth alleviated my worries."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Sorry, it'll take a bit for the heat to get going.
entries.literal: "Sorry, it'll take a bit for the heat to get going."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: That's fine. ...It's much better than outside.
entries.literal: "That's fine. ...It's much better than outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped farther in and looked at the multitude of pastries behind the glass as I removed my hood. Meanwhile, Darfee grabbed a few chairs from a pile in the corner and put them beside the tables.
entries.literal: "I stepped farther in and looked at the multitude of pastries behind the glass as I removed my hood. Meanwhile, Darfee grabbed a few chairs from a pile in the corner and put them beside the tables."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: What do you want? These are all recently baked.
entries.literal: "What do you want? These are all recently baked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pointed at the same chocolate-covered one I'd had before, unaware of its name. I'd heard before that eating warm pastries wasn't healthy and to always wait for them to cool off, but I was too hungry to care.
entries.literal: "I pointed at the same chocolate-covered one I'd had before, unaware of its name. I'd heard before that eating warm pastries wasn't healthy and to always wait for them to cool off, but I was too hungry to care."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I eagerly waited while Darfee went behind the counter, biting in immediately after the tiny plate was placed in front of me.
entries.literal: "I eagerly waited while Darfee went behind the counter, biting in immediately after the tiny plate was placed in front of me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee looked pretty busy preparing everything. He got two batches of bread out of the oven and placed them in the usual spot.
entries.literal: "Darfee looked pretty busy preparing everything. He got two batches of bread out of the oven and placed them in the usual spot."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'll need a coffee too.
entries.literal: "...I'll need a coffee too."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: The same way?
entries.literal: "The same way?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: All right. Give me a moment.
entries.literal: "All right. Give me a moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd felt completely rested after waking up, but that had drastically changed.{w} Staring at the wood, I kept biting the pastry, its warmth permeating my body.
entries.literal: "I'd felt completely rested after waking up, but that had drastically changed.{w} Staring at the wood, I kept biting the pastry, its warmth permeating my body."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee put an empty cup below the coffee machine and filled it up.
entries.literal: "Darfee put an empty cup below the coffee machine and filled it up."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Do you want to sit at a table?
entries.literal: "Do you want to sit at a table?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked behind me. Next to the low tables was the wide window, intercepting soft flakes of snow.
entries.literal: "I looked behind me. Next to the low tables was the wide window, intercepting soft flakes of snow."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah. I'll sit there.
entries.literal: "Yeah. I'll sit there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd already finished up the pastry, so I grabbed the cup by its rim and carefully brought it to the closest table.
entries.literal: "I'd already finished up the pastry, so I grabbed the cup by its rim and carefully brought it to the closest table."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat on one of the two chairs, its angle allowing Ramon to be seen.{w} ...What had I been going on about? There were a number of pedestrians walking with an umbrella above them.
entries.literal: "I sat on one of the two chairs, its angle allowing Ramon to be seen.{w} ...What had I been going on about? There were a number of pedestrians walking with an umbrella above them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I touched the glass with a finger, feeling again how cold it was outside. With the other hand, I gripped the hot coffee tightly, a stark contrast. Then, I slowly brought it to my lips.
entries.literal: "I touched the glass with a finger, feeling again how cold it was outside. With the other hand, I gripped the hot coffee tightly, a stark contrast. Then, I slowly brought it to my lips."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...!{w=0.5} It's burning.{w} It's a lot less hot when I make it at home.
entries.literal: "...!{w=0.5} It's burning.{w} It's a lot less hot when I make it at home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I placed it back down, Darfee still arranging everything properly behind the counter.
entries.literal: "I placed it back down, Darfee still arranging everything properly behind the counter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited a bit for the coffee to cool off and started to drink it.
entries.literal: "I waited a bit for the coffee to cool off and started to drink it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I finished it in a few sips.{w} Seconds later, I began to notice a faint headache, a frequent side effect coffee had on me.
entries.literal: "I finished it in a few sips.{w} Seconds later, I began to notice a faint headache, a frequent side effect coffee had on me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Do you have any water?
entries.literal: "...Do you have any water?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Water? Yeah, of course.
entries.literal: "Water? Yeah, of course."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee's head peeked out from under the counter, and he filled up a glass with a bottle of water. I stood to grab it from the other side and drank it in hopes of alleviating the pain.
entries.literal: "Darfee's head peeked out from under the counter, and he filled up a glass with a bottle of water. I stood to grab it from the other side and drank it in hopes of alleviating the pain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The effect was almost immediate, and the pleasant change of temperature refreshed my mouth.
entries.literal: "...The effect was almost immediate, and the pleasant change of temperature refreshed my mouth."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reclined in the chair, still a little rattled.
entries.literal: "I reclined in the chair, still a little rattled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned my head to the door after hearing it open. A man I hadn't seen outside entered the café and stepped up to the bar with moist footsteps.
entries.literal: "I turned my head to the door after hearing it open. A man I hadn't seen outside entered the café and stepped up to the bar with moist footsteps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "What'll it be?" Still looking a little busy, Darfee addressed him while he scanned the wooden trays behind the counter.
entries.literal: "\"What'll it be?\" Still looking a little busy, Darfee addressed him while he scanned the wooden trays behind the counter."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I'll have two loaves of spelt bread.
entries.literal: "I'll have two loaves of spelt bread."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: This one?
entries.literal: "This one?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The man nodded, and Darfee packed both loaves into a thin bag that he handed over.{w} "What else?"
entries.literal: "The man nodded, and Darfee packed both loaves into a thin bag that he handed over.{w} \"What else?\""

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: That's all.
entries.literal: "That's all."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: It'll be ¥280, then.
entries.literal: "It'll be ¥280, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Thank you." After being handed a few coins, Darfee bowed, and the man quietly walked out.
entries.literal: "\"Thank you.\" After being handed a few coins, Darfee bowed, and the man quietly walked out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Following that, more people began to enter.
entries.literal: "Following that, more people began to enter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw everyone come in and out from my chair. Most of them had come to buy bread, which had almost run out already.
entries.literal: "I saw everyone come in and out from my chair. Most of them had come to buy bread, which had almost run out already."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was hard to believe the place would evolve throughout the day, becoming a bar in the evening. Everyone had instantly left without sitting anywhere, as the chairs and stools were primarily used later in the day.{w} The café was open the entire day on every day of the week. However, even though Darfee was the main person behind it, I'd frequently seen members of his family behind the counter. He couldn't do it all himself.
entries.literal: "It was hard to believe the place would evolve throughout the day, becoming a bar in the evening. Everyone had instantly left without sitting anywhere, as the chairs and stools were primarily used later in the day.{w} The café was open the entire day on every day of the week. However, even though Darfee was the main person behind it, I'd frequently seen members of his family behind the counter. He couldn't do it all himself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once a few minutes had gone by without any new customers, Darfee addressed me.
entries.literal: "Once a few minutes had gone by without any new customers, Darfee addressed me."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: You've been here a while. Do you want anything else?
entries.literal: "You've been here a while. Do you want anything else?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Hm.{w} I don't think so.{w} I'm still hungry, but I don't really want another pastry.
entries.literal: "...Hm.{w} I don't think so.{w} I'm still hungry, but I don't really want another pastry."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: That's fine.{w} ...Have you talked to your parents?
entries.literal: "That's fine.{w} ...Have you talked to your parents?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yeah, I called my mom the other day.{w} ...We talked a bit, but they're gonna stay where they are. I already mentioned that's also what I prefer.
entries.literal: "...Yeah, I called my mom the other day.{w} ...We talked a bit, but they're gonna stay where they are. I already mentioned that's also what I prefer."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: ...Are you sure about that? Is it that you want to be alone or that you don't want your parents to come?
entries.literal: "...Are you sure about that? Is it that you want to be alone or that you don't want your parents to come?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}I think I prefer being alone, at least at home.
entries.literal: "...{w}I think I prefer being alone, at least at home."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I can understand that. I'm glad you're okay, but I suppose I can't really accept they won't come back. I was really shocked when I learned they'd moved away without you.
entries.literal: "I can understand that. I'm glad you're okay, but I suppose I can't really accept they won't come back. I was really shocked when I learned they'd moved away without you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what else to say. He realized I was looking a little down and changed the subject.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what else to say. He realized I was looking a little down and changed the subject."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Well, I'm happy you came back already. You were there very early, though.
entries.literal: "Well, I'm happy you came back already. You were there very early, though."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I went to sleep pretty early too, and for some reason, I felt like going out somewhere again.
entries.literal: "I went to sleep pretty early too, and for some reason, I felt like going out somewhere again."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: You should've at least grabbed an umbrella. But it's impressive how strong you are.
entries.literal: "You should've at least grabbed an umbrella. But it's impressive how strong you are."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He smiled gently at me.
entries.literal: "He smiled gently at me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, right, I guess he isn't aware that I'm still in the hospital. There's no reason he would know that without calling my parents.{w} Will he find out on the 8th...? I don't know what I'll say if he does.
entries.literal: "Oh, right, I guess he isn't aware that I'm still in the hospital. There's no reason he would know that without calling my parents.{w} Will he find out on the 8th...? I don't know what I'll say if he does."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: So what have you been doing these last couple of days?
entries.literal: "So what have you been doing these last couple of days?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}Not much. I went to Atsuki's house yesterday, and I was there for a while.
entries.literal: "...{w}Not much. I went to Atsuki's house yesterday, and I was there for a while."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Atsuki's house? You think being there helps you?
entries.literal: "Atsuki's house? You think being there helps you?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I think so, yeah.
entries.literal: "...I think so, yeah."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked saddened too, but I hadn't lied. I wasn't entirely certain how I was able to feel so tranquil at home by myself, but I suspected that if Atsuki hadn't invited me to his house from the hospital in the first place, I wouldn't have been able to bear it. The pain we'd felt from Miiya's death had practically hung in the air at his house, but we'd been able to withstand it together.
entries.literal: "He looked saddened too, but I hadn't lied. I wasn't entirely certain how I was able to feel so tranquil at home by myself, but I suspected that if Atsuki hadn't invited me to his house from the hospital in the first place, I wouldn't have been able to bear it. The pain we'd felt from Miiya's death had practically hung in the air at his house, but we'd been able to withstand it together."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I don't want to put any pressure on you, but I'm curious if you have an idea about what you'll do. Last I heard, you were considering studying medicine, right?{w} ...Sorry, maybe this isn't a good time to ask these questions.
entries.literal: "I don't want to put any pressure on you, but I'm curious if you have an idea about what you'll do. Last I heard, you were considering studying medicine, right?{w} ...Sorry, maybe this isn't a good time to ask these questions."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Don't worry... I don't know, though.{w} I don't even know anything about medicine. It's just one of the few areas I think I could find interesting, but I'm not sure I want to keep studying. I think it's a lot more likely I'll try to find a job.
entries.literal: "Don't worry... I don't know, though.{w} I don't even know anything about medicine. It's just one of the few areas I think I could find interesting, but I'm not sure I want to keep studying. I think it's a lot more likely I'll try to find a job."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Is that so? I was thinking that I wouldn't at all mind letting you work here a few hours a week. Would you be interested? It'd give you something to do, and you wouldn't have to depend exclusively on your parents.
entries.literal: "Is that so? I was thinking that I wouldn't at all mind letting you work here a few hours a week. Would you be interested? It'd give you something to do, and you wouldn't have to depend exclusively on your parents."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That offer came out of nowhere, and I was left a little shocked.
entries.literal: "That offer came out of nowhere, and I was left a little shocked."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Um... I don't know.{w} Maybe.{w} I'll think about it. Can I? I really appreciate it, though.
entries.literal: "Um... I don't know.{w} Maybe.{w} I'll think about it. Can I? I really appreciate it, though."

entries.speaker: d
