entries.text: Of course, this isn't a decision you have to rush, and it's an offer that isn't going anywhere, so tell me if you think it'd be good for you.
entries.literal: "Of course, this isn't a decision you have to rush, and it's an offer that isn't going anywhere, so tell me if you think it'd be good for you."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Admittedly, if that had been proposed to me before December, I might've accepted immediately, as I'd been desperately lacking an actual path to take.{w} But part of me just wanted the days to continue. It was a selfish and impossible wish, but the two days of December I'd redone had possessed a calmness I'd rarely known despite my own paranoia.
entries.literal: "Admittedly, if that had been proposed to me before December, I might've accepted immediately, as I'd been desperately lacking an actual path to take.{w} But part of me just wanted the days to continue. It was a selfish and impossible wish, but the two days of December I'd redone had possessed a calmness I'd rarely known despite my own paranoia."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone opened the door, so Darfee had to attend them.
entries.literal: "Someone opened the door, so Darfee had to attend them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked through the glass. At Ramon, I could see a person dressed in a green uniform removing the snow on the ground. Some was still falling, but it had become too light to build up.
entries.literal: "I looked through the glass. At Ramon, I could see a person dressed in a green uniform removing the snow on the ground. Some was still falling, but it had become too light to build up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After my brief talk with Darfee, I'd taken notice of something. Everything that I'd been worrying about for months had become meaningless.
entries.literal: "After my brief talk with Darfee, I'd taken notice of something. Everything that I'd been worrying about for months had become meaningless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Technically, at the moment, none of that mattered anymore. Studying medicine, moving away, getting a job... All of that would be irrelevant if I traveled to the past again or if I modified history.{w} It would all have been for nothing. I would strive to prevent the death of a friend, isolating myself in a world where not a single thing of what I'd constantly worried about would occur.
entries.literal: "Technically, at the moment, none of that mattered anymore. Studying medicine, moving away, getting a job... All of that would be irrelevant if I traveled to the past again or if I modified history.{w} It would all have been for nothing. I would strive to prevent the death of a friend, isolating myself in a world where not a single thing of what I'd constantly worried about would occur."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And I would really try to do it. Sitting on that chair, I'd sporadically feel a sharp pain in my chest. A pain warning me that it could've been my last visit to Ina and my last real day in Yushibana. Any day could have been my last one before needing to take action.
entries.literal: "...And I would really try to do it. Sitting on that chair, I'd sporadically feel a sharp pain in my chest. A pain warning me that it could've been my last visit to Ina and my last real day in Yushibana. Any day could have been my last one before needing to take action."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd come to massively appreciate the odd serenity I could feel. For that reason, if the end of the countdown was that close, I'd try to prolong it a little bit more.
entries.literal: "I'd come to massively appreciate the odd serenity I could feel. For that reason, if the end of the countdown was that close, I'd try to prolong it a little bit more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And since all I wished for was the calmness I felt, I remained on that chair where it existed, witnessing the outside world move through the glass.
entries.literal: "And since all I wished for was the calmness I felt, I remained on that chair where it existed, witnessing the outside world move through the glass."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Letting the time pass was what I most and least wanted. I stayed there, glancing out and believing it was the best way to use the time I still had.
entries.literal: "Letting the time pass was what I most and least wanted. I stayed there, glancing out and believing it was the best way to use the time I still had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee noticed that, as he didn't resume the conversation once the silence had returned.
entries.literal: "Darfee noticed that, as he didn't resume the conversation once the silence had returned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nothing else I thought I could do on December 3rd. The only thing that remained was going to the tower and learning what would come next.
entries.literal: "There was nothing else I thought I could do on December 3rd. The only thing that remained was going to the tower and learning what would come next."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before that, there was only an optional step. It was deciding.{w} I still had the ability to choose. It wasn't true that going to the tower was essential for that.
entries.literal: "Before that, there was only an optional step. It was deciding.{w} I still had the ability to choose. It wasn't true that going to the tower was essential for that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter what I'd find there, deciding whether to change the past or not was possible, even though I'd done my best to believe that I'd never choose the latter.{w} After all, I'd touched the Sekimeiya to change the past, and it would've been for nothing if I later decided not to.
entries.literal: "No matter what I'd find there, deciding whether to change the past or not was possible, even though I'd done my best to believe that I'd never choose the latter.{w} After all, I'd touched the Sekimeiya to change the past, and it would've been for nothing if I later decided not to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But perhaps that was wrong. I couldn't think anymore that touching the Sekimeiya would've been for nothing even if I decided not to alter history. The days I was living through did mean something to me.
entries.literal: "But perhaps that was wrong. I couldn't think anymore that touching the Sekimeiya would've been for nothing even if I decided not to alter history. The days I was living through did mean something to me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What would actually happen if I step aside and choose not to go to the tower again? I don't think that'd actually be so simple either.{w} Late on the 15th, I disappeared from the tower, leaving the others behind. If everything happens as it did, Atsuki will try to travel to the past himself, and the problem of the recording will come back in full force.
entries.literal: "...What would actually happen if I step aside and choose not to go to the tower again? I don't think that'd actually be so simple either.{w} Late on the 15th, I disappeared from the tower, leaving the others behind. If everything happens as it did, Atsuki will try to travel to the past himself, and the problem of the recording will come back in full force."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There really wasn't a single good option, so maybe deciding simply wasn't possible.
entries.literal: "There really wasn't a single good option, so maybe deciding simply wasn't possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of trying to determine which of the choices I had was better, would attempting to find a new one serve any purpose?
entries.literal: "Instead of trying to determine which of the choices I had was better, would attempting to find a new one serve any purpose?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's just... nothing else, is there?
entries.literal: "There's just... nothing else, is there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There'd always been a concealed alternative that I'd been aware of, but it was so unthinkable that I'd chosen to immediately dismiss it.
entries.literal: "There'd always been a concealed alternative that I'd been aware of, but it was so unthinkable that I'd chosen to immediately dismiss it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I didn't change the past, Miiya would stay dead, and so would the people who'd died in the tower. It was even possible Atsuki would too if the exit didn't open after twelve hours. At that point, I could try to enter the building through the storeroom or make the police do so, but if that door didn't actually lead outside, the recording had a chance to occur a month later.
entries.literal: "If I didn't change the past, Miiya would stay dead, and so would the people who'd died in the tower. It was even possible Atsuki would too if the exit didn't open after twelve hours. At that point, I could try to enter the building through the storeroom or make the police do so, but if that door didn't actually lead outside, the recording had a chance to occur a month later."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though I'd changed the past by calling my mother, that wouldn't necessarily prevent the events of the 15th from occurring—the version of me in the hospital at that moment could still travel back in time the same way I had.{w} I knew that could be wrong. If I still went back in time after my mom told me about the call she got when I was in the hospital, I wouldn't ever try to change the past by calling her. The distinction between that Shiroya and me already somewhat existed.
entries.literal: "Even though I'd changed the past by calling my mother, that wouldn't necessarily prevent the events of the 15th from occurring—the version of me in the hospital at that moment could still travel back in time the same way I had.{w} I knew that could be wrong. If I still went back in time after my mom told me about the call she got when I was in the hospital, I wouldn't ever try to change the past by calling her. The distinction between that Shiroya and me already somewhat existed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So if that's not the case, and I further change the past, the only negative is that the self of mine currently in the hospital will stop being me, and I'll have to abandon my current life. I'm... not really sure I could do that.
entries.literal: "So if that's not the case, and I further change the past, the only negative is that the self of mine currently in the hospital will stop being me, and I'll have to abandon my current life. I'm... not really sure I could do that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then yes, of course, there was a way to prevent that from happening.{w} Upon changing the past, the problematic variable was solely the other version of myself. Therefore, by removing that variable, I'd have everything I wanted.{w} ...But that wasn't something I could seriously consider.{w} That possibility simply didn't exist.{w=0.8}{nw}
entries.literal: "Then yes, of course, there was a way to prevent that from happening.{w} Upon changing the past, the problematic variable was solely the other version of myself. Therefore, by removing that variable, I'd have everything I wanted.{w} ...But that wasn't something I could seriously consider.{w} That possibility simply didn't exist.{w=0.8}{nw}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd spent a very long time beside that glass as it was marked by unending snow. I was getting alarmingly hungry, but for as long as I stayed there, I would be fine.
entries.literal: "I'd spent a very long time beside that glass as it was marked by unending snow. I was getting alarmingly hungry, but for as long as I stayed there, I would be fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through the glass and the whirls of white, I was able to see the sun. It had reached the center of the sky.
entries.literal: "Through the glass and the whirls of white, I was able to see the sun. It had reached the center of the sky."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued staring through it, watching the part of Yushibana that had become as lively as always.
entries.literal: "I continued staring through it, watching the part of Yushibana that had become as lively as always."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was until I recognized something in the distance.
entries.literal: "That was until I recognized something in the distance."

entries.text: Axis Ropeway
entries.literal: "Axis Ropeway"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up from the chair, realizing that I had forgotten something.
entries.literal: "I stood up from the chair, realizing that I had forgotten something."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'll be leaving. How much is it?
entries.literal: "...I'll be leaving. How much is it?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: What? You still think that you have to pay?
entries.literal: "What? You still think that you have to pay?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Just tell me. I'll feel bad about coming so often if I don't pay.
entries.literal: "Just tell me. I'll feel bad about coming so often if I don't pay."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: That's mean...{w} It's ¥300.
entries.literal: "That's mean...{w} It's ¥300."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took my wallet out and paid with the exact amount.
entries.literal: "I took my wallet out and paid with the exact amount."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Thank you. Sorry for leaving so suddenly, but I need to be somewhere.
entries.literal: "Thank you. Sorry for leaving so suddenly, but I need to be somewhere."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Don't worry. You know you can come back any time.
entries.literal: "Don't worry. You know you can come back any time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded and left, flipping up my hood.
entries.literal: "I nodded and left, flipping up my hood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked directly to Ramon street. In the distance, I had recognized a purse.{w} ...After staring at it for a few seconds, I knew exactly where I'd seen it.
entries.literal: "I walked directly to Ramon street. In the distance, I had recognized a purse.{w} ...After staring at it for a few seconds, I knew exactly where I'd seen it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dashed toward the direction it had been. Right above the purse, an umbrella was covering the face of its owner.
entries.literal: "I dashed toward the direction it had been. Right above the purse, an umbrella was covering the face of its owner."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But that didn't matter. I knew that purse. While identical ones could exist, I'd recognized it as... Isla's.
entries.literal: "But that didn't matter. I knew that purse. While identical ones could exist, I'd recognized it as... Isla's."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran to the street the umbrella had turned to. Even though I hadn't seen the face of the person holding it, that umbrella was lower to the ground than all the others...
entries.literal: "I ran to the street the umbrella had turned to. Even though I hadn't seen the face of the person holding it, that umbrella was lower to the ground than all the others..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started moving faster as I reached an area with less snow stuck to the pavement. Ramon was pretty crowded, so I wasn't sure if anyone had been walking beside that umbrella, but I'd recalled something else I'd entirely forgotten about.
entries.literal: "I started moving faster as I reached an area with less snow stuck to the pavement. Ramon was pretty crowded, so I wasn't sure if anyone had been walking beside that umbrella, but I'd recalled something else I'd entirely forgotten about."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isla's friend... That's right. They must be here.
entries.literal: "Isla's friend... That's right. They must be here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A sudden wave of bleariness crashed through my head, demanding me to slow down, but I didn't stop until I'd arrived at the dimmer street I'd seen the umbrella at.
entries.literal: "A sudden wave of bleariness crashed through my head, demanding me to slow down, but I didn't stop until I'd arrived at the dimmer street I'd seen the umbrella at."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see anyone.{w} There were multiple doors on both sides and more branching paths farther ahead.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see anyone.{w} There were multiple doors on both sides and more branching paths farther ahead."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't know what happened to me this morning, but today's definitely a school day. ...If that was really Isla, it could've actually been her "friend", right?{w} Was I correct, and her identity was Isla herself?
entries.literal: "I don't know what happened to me this morning, but today's definitely a school day. ...If that was really Isla, it could've actually been her \"friend\", right?{w} Was I correct, and her identity was Isla herself?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That thought had seemed a little strange in the tower for a number of reasons.{w} She couldn't have gone back in time to repeat exactly what she'd lived through, but I had since learned that a long travel like that could've happened without needing to store energy for a month.
entries.literal: "That thought had seemed a little strange in the tower for a number of reasons.{w} She couldn't have gone back in time to repeat exactly what she'd lived through, but I had since learned that a long travel like that could've happened without needing to store energy for a month."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked down. From there onward, snow still covered the ground. As a result, I was able to see a pair of footprints, smaller and less faded than the rest, disappearing ahead.
entries.literal: "I looked down. From there onward, snow still covered the ground. As a result, I was able to see a pair of footprints, smaller and less faded than the rest, disappearing ahead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped forward, careful not to lose track of them. The buildings weren't casting dark shadows on the ground, so I was able to follow them without mixing them up.
entries.literal: "I stepped forward, careful not to lose track of them. The buildings weren't casting dark shadows on the ground, so I was able to follow them without mixing them up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went all the way down the street, where the footprints turned to the right.{w} Once again, I was close to Atsuki's house, but the marks on the ground deviated from it. There was still no indication of them ending, and I wasn't able to see anyone farther ahead.
entries.literal: "I went all the way down the street, where the footprints turned to the right.{w} Once again, I was close to Atsuki's house, but the marks on the ground deviated from it. There was still no indication of them ending, and I wasn't able to see anyone farther ahead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been trying to go fast, but once again, the footprints turned to the right and I couldn't spot the umbrella.
entries.literal: "I'd been trying to go fast, but once again, the footprints turned to the right and I couldn't spot the umbrella."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isn't this a dead end?
entries.literal: "Isn't this a dead end?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like I thought, that turn brought me to a short street filled with houses. That meant the footprints had to end at a door.
entries.literal: "Like I thought, that turn brought me to a short street filled with houses. That meant the footprints had to end at a door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And they did. When I lifted my head, I saw a house, the trail ending at its entrance.
entries.literal: "And they did. When I lifted my head, I saw a house, the trail ending at its entrance."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Does Isla live here?{w} ...Should I ring the bell?
entries.literal: "Does Isla live here?{w} ...Should I ring the bell?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead, I warily stepped back, as letting myself be seen had some worrying implications.
entries.literal: "Instead, I warily stepped back, as letting myself be seen had some worrying implications."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even if I'd just seen an Isla who'd traveled from the future, while the original one was likely to not be home, it was very possible Erina was. She'd told us that she once found out Isla hadn't gone to school, so there was nothing stopping her from being inside right then.
entries.literal: "Even if I'd just seen an Isla who'd traveled from the future, while the original one was likely to not be home, it was very possible Erina was. She'd told us that she once found out Isla hadn't gone to school, so there was nothing stopping her from being inside right then."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Whether I ring the bell or not... that's the same as finally deciding whether to change the past or not.
entries.literal: "Whether I ring the bell or not... that's the same as finally deciding whether to change the past or not."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'd like to know who Isla's friend is, and if it really is herself, I might learn something very important from her. However, it's also possible Erina will see me, which will change things pretty drastically...
entries.literal: "I'd like to know who Isla's friend is, and if it really is herself, I might learn something very important from her. However, it's also possible Erina will see me, which will change things pretty drastically..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the building from behind a car. I couldn't see light through any of the windows, and nobody else was close by.
entries.literal: "I looked at the building from behind a car. I couldn't see light through any of the windows, and nobody else was close by."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I needed to make up my mind, but it was impossible...! If I pressed the button next to the door, the rest of my life might have gone up in smoke.
entries.literal: "I needed to make up my mind, but it was impossible...! If I pressed the button next to the door, the rest of my life might have gone up in smoke."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it true that the past will only change if I want it to? If so, I could try to ring without that being my intention, but that's so risky. I don't know how it works...!
entries.literal: "Is it true that the past will only change if I want it to? If so, I could try to ring without that being my intention, but that's so risky. I don't know how it works...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt my heart racing as I worried about making any rushed action.
entries.literal: "I felt my heart racing as I worried about making any rushed action."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I just watch from here and try to observe who the friend is?{w} Maybe I should just leave. I know where Isla lives now, so I can try to prevent them from going to the tower on the 15th.{w} That might be best.
entries.literal: "Should I just watch from here and try to observe who the friend is?{w} Maybe I should just leave. I know where Isla lives now, so I can try to prevent them from going to the tower on the 15th.{w} That might be best."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I were to do that, and Isla's friend is really herself, she'd end up in the same situation as me, stuck in a world with two versions of her.{w} What will happen after that? How would the world even take it? If they don't go to the tower, Isla won't be able to travel to the past. Will that simply not matter, and both of them will continue to live?{w} If her existence gets overwritten, mine will be too, right?
entries.literal: "If I were to do that, and Isla's friend is really herself, she'd end up in the same situation as me, stuck in a world with two versions of her.{w} What will happen after that? How would the world even take it? If they don't go to the tower, Isla won't be able to travel to the past. Will that simply not matter, and both of them will continue to live?{w} If her existence gets overwritten, mine will be too, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How was I supposed to reason any of that out when I knew nothing about what would happen?
entries.literal: "How was I supposed to reason any of that out when I knew nothing about what would happen?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Time was passing with no progress being made. Every time I questioned what to do, the same fundamental bifurcation emerged; I needed to know what I wanted.
entries.literal: "Time was passing with no progress being made. Every time I questioned what to do, the same fundamental bifurcation emerged; I needed to know what I wanted."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Can I not do it? Is it actually impossible to decide?
entries.literal: "Can I not do it? Is it actually impossible to decide?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It shouldn't be, right? Even if I don't like any of the choices, there has to be one I prefer.{w} If they're all equally bad, then I can just choose one to stick to, can't I? I can just decide my entire life like that.
entries.literal: "It shouldn't be, right? Even if I don't like any of the choices, there has to be one I prefer.{w} If they're all equally bad, then I can just choose one to stick to, can't I? I can just decide my entire life like that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I need to do it, and this is when. I'm stretching out the time I have too much, and I could end up immensely regretting it at any point.
entries.literal: "I need to do it, and this is when. I'm stretching out the time I have too much, and I could end up immensely regretting it at any point."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I just have to decide now. Even if I wish I'd made another choice later, I can't know that now. So I just need to make the decision based on what I feel at this moment.
entries.literal: "I just have to decide now. Even if I wish I'd made another choice later, I can't know that now. So I just need to make the decision based on what I feel at this moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But even after thinking all that, I didn't move from behind the car. My thoughts were in complete disarray.
entries.literal: "But even after thinking all that, I didn't move from behind the car. My thoughts were in complete disarray."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I finally stepped out and inspected the dark windows. If I didn't care about changing the past again, trying to reach Isla's friend was the right call.
entries.literal: "I finally stepped out and inspected the dark windows. If I didn't care about changing the past again, trying to reach Isla's friend was the right call."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But of course I cared. I couldn't suddenly press a button that would influence my whole life.
entries.literal: "But of course I cared. I couldn't suddenly press a button that would influence my whole life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the way I'd come from.{w} Nobody was there.
entries.literal: "I looked at the way I'd come from.{w} Nobody was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see my footprints coming toward me, so I quietly traced them, peeking at the previous street.
entries.literal: "I could see my footprints coming toward me, so I quietly traced them, peeking at the previous street."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Again, nobody was in sight.
entries.literal: "Again, nobody was in sight."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had felt the same sensation as the day before. I didn't know if I'd noticed a sound or a movement, but my head had suddenly turned to that corner.{w} I looked at the ground, but many footprints were there, and due to the falling snow, it was hard to tell which were recent.
entries.literal: "I had felt the same sensation as the day before. I didn't know if I'd noticed a sound or a movement, but my head had suddenly turned to that corner.{w} I looked at the ground, but many footprints were there, and due to the falling snow, it was hard to tell which were recent."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it just me? ...It's not, right?{w} Yesterday, someone was definitely following me. Did I only imagine it this time?
entries.literal: "Is it just me? ...It's not, right?{w} Yesterday, someone was definitely following me. Did I only imagine it this time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked left and right, confirming I was alone.
entries.literal: "I looked left and right, confirming I was alone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I still felt that Vaisude might have followed me, but he wouldn't do it again...
entries.literal: "I still felt that Vaisude might have followed me, but he wouldn't do it again..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could it be Isla...?{w} No, the footprints I saw yesterday belonged to an adult.
entries.literal: "Could it be Isla...?{w} No, the footprints I saw yesterday belonged to an adult."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to compose myself and walked farther into the street.
entries.literal: "I tried to compose myself and walked farther into the street."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I should just leave. I'm not gonna be able to ring the bell.
entries.literal: "I should just leave. I'm not gonna be able to ring the bell."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a deep unease at the concept of someone watching me from a distance. I couldn't understand why they would, and it put even more pressure on me.
entries.literal: "I felt a deep unease at the concept of someone watching me from a distance. I couldn't understand why they would, and it put even more pressure on me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was still fairly hungry and far from my apartment, but if I went home in a straight line, I'd have to go through all the deserted streets before getting back to the center.{w} I didn't want to do that if someone was observing me in secret.
entries.literal: "I was still fairly hungry and far from my apartment, but if I went home in a straight line, I'd have to go through all the deserted streets before getting back to the center.{w} I didn't want to do that if someone was observing me in secret."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was close to the outskirts, so instead of going back, I kept on ahead.
entries.literal: "I was close to the outskirts, so instead of going back, I kept on ahead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When the curved street came to an end and the short houses stopped, the sight to the tall mountains was wide open. I was at the start of the mountain range, close to the valley that led out of Yushibana.
entries.literal: "When the curved street came to an end and the short houses stopped, the sight to the tall mountains was wide open. I was at the start of the mountain range, close to the valley that led out of Yushibana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't seen anyone yet, and there were barely any footprints around. If I'd been followed again, I had surely gone the opposite way.
entries.literal: "I hadn't seen anyone yet, and there were barely any footprints around. If I'd been followed again, I had surely gone the opposite way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spun in place, confirming again that nobody was there. I doubted anyone was watching me based on where I was. The only place they could be hiding was within some covered windows fairly far away.
entries.literal: "I spun in place, confirming again that nobody was there. I doubted anyone was watching me based on where I was. The only place they could be hiding was within some covered windows fairly far away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Noticing the slight weight on my head, I shook off the snow piled on it. Then, I kept walking, my boots sinking deeply into the snow.
entries.literal: "Noticing the slight weight on my head, I shook off the snow piled on it. Then, I kept walking, my boots sinking deeply into the snow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The path outlining Yushibana was not well-maintained. Tall weeds dominated it, unfazed by the snow. I'd learned to avoid coming back from Atsuki's house through that route, as it tended to be hard to traverse.
entries.literal: "The path outlining Yushibana was not well-maintained. Tall weeds dominated it, unfazed by the snow. I'd learned to avoid coming back from Atsuki's house through that route, as it tended to be hard to traverse."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ahead of me, I saw a thin path going up the mountain. Like the entire hill, it was coated in snow, but the lack of grass peeking up highlighted the way.
entries.literal: "Ahead of me, I saw a thin path going up the mountain. Like the entire hill, it was coated in snow, but the lack of grass peeking up highlighted the way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached the split and instinctively took the path up the large mountain.
entries.literal: "I reached the split and instinctively took the path up the large mountain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Due to another impulse, I found myself climbing the steep path, leaving behind the straight and plain one. I knew it would level out soon and lead home despite taking longer.
entries.literal: "Due to another impulse, I found myself climbing the steep path, leaving behind the straight and plain one. I knew it would level out soon and lead home despite taking longer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All around me, I could only see dried bushes covered in white and tall trees scattered around. I knew the mountains were frequently visited, but I couldn't make out any indications of people having been there.
entries.literal: "All around me, I could only see dried bushes covered in white and tall trees scattered around. I knew the mountains were frequently visited, but I couldn't make out any indications of people having been there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd turned to that path due to the conversation I'd had with Atsuki in one of the hallway A crystal rooms. It had been so long since both of us had taken that path, but walking up all by myself was still somehow familiar.
entries.literal: "I'd turned to that path due to the conversation I'd had with Atsuki in one of the hallway A crystal rooms. It had been so long since both of us had taken that path, but walking up all by myself was still somehow familiar."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would we ever go up together again? That was also something I had to choose.
entries.literal: "Would we ever go up together again? That was also something I had to choose."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The wind was noticeably stronger higher up. The terrain there was plain, and the way branched out.{w} Higher still was the entrance to the caves, whereas the path to the right would take me close to home.
entries.literal: "The wind was noticeably stronger higher up. The terrain there was plain, and the way branched out.{w} Higher still was the entrance to the caves, whereas the path to the right would take me close to home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around to witness the sight I'd earned.
entries.literal: "I turned around to witness the sight I'd earned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The entirety of Yushibana covered by snow... The sight was as pleasant as it had always been, intensified by the moving curtain of falling flakes, which appeared much denser from above.
entries.literal: "The entirety of Yushibana covered by snow... The sight was as pleasant as it had always been, intensified by the moving curtain of falling flakes, which appeared much denser from above."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the way I'd come from, but even from that position, I wasn't able to see anyone. Only when I peered at the center of town was I able to notice the tiny movements of people on the streets.
entries.literal: "I looked at the way I'd come from, but even from that position, I wasn't able to see anyone. Only when I peered at the center of town was I able to notice the tiny movements of people on the streets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There wasn't a place I couldn't see. The hospital was close to where I was, most of its windows covered from within. In the distance, the Zubesout Trash Disposal looked like a perfect circle, appearing as elegant as every other place thanks to the snow.
entries.literal: "There wasn't a place I couldn't see. The hospital was close to where I was, most of its windows covered from within. In the distance, the Zubesout Trash Disposal looked like a perfect circle, appearing as elegant as every other place thanks to the snow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And of course, close to it, Ashiya Tower. It was rare to see the top of it, but the snow almost made it blend in completely.
entries.literal: "And of course, close to it, Ashiya Tower. It was rare to see the top of it, but the snow almost made it blend in completely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked down to its entrance. I could just barely make it out despite the distance and whirls of snow, but there was no shutter in place.
entries.literal: "I looked down to its entrance. I could just barely make it out despite the distance and whirls of snow, but there was no shutter in place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite the harsh wind hitting my face, I kept watching with both hands in my pockets, trying not to let the snow fall inside.
entries.literal: "Despite the harsh wind hitting my face, I kept watching with both hands in my pockets, trying not to let the snow fall inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A very important decision still needed to be made, and even ignoring that decision was its own decision. Was there going to be a better time? As soon as I asked myself that, I knew the answer.
entries.literal: "A very important decision still needed to be made, and even ignoring that decision was its own decision. Was there going to be a better time? As soon as I asked myself that, I knew the answer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would I try to alter the fate of the town, trapped in a shrouded sequence of events revolving around a magical gemstone?
entries.literal: "Would I try to alter the fate of the town, trapped in a shrouded sequence of events revolving around a magical gemstone?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would I try to save Miiya and the people I'd met that day at the cost of my own normal life? Even if I succeeded, I would have to keep on living in circumstances I couldn't even fathom.
entries.literal: "Would I try to save Miiya and the people I'd met that day at the cost of my own normal life? Even if I succeeded, I would have to keep on living in circumstances I couldn't even fathom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had felt like I'd been living in a mire, and when I was finally pulled out of it, I lost everything. The incident in the tower had only made things worse, and I'd finally been saved from it only to be subsequently forced into destroying my own life as the "right" answer.
entries.literal: "I had felt like I'd been living in a mire, and when I was finally pulled out of it, I lost everything. The incident in the tower had only made things worse, and I'd finally been saved from it only to be subsequently forced into destroying my own life as the \"right\" answer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know if I could accomplish it, but the choice was about whether to try it. I could be caught by the police or be beaten to the punch by someone else from the future. If the latter happened, I was letting it happen by not acting. It was my own fault.{w} It was all a mess, and there was no way not to make it one. I wanted to talk to Miiya again, but even if I saved her, that wouldn't happen.{w} She hadn't deserved to die, so I could trade positions with her. I wouldn't even be doing it for some twisted form of recognition, as nobody would know what had happened—my other self would exist in my place, and I'd step aside.
entries.literal: "I didn't know if I could accomplish it, but the choice was about whether to try it. I could be caught by the police or be beaten to the punch by someone else from the future. If the latter happened, I was letting it happen by not acting. It was my own fault.{w} It was all a mess, and there was no way not to make it one. I wanted to talk to Miiya again, but even if I saved her, that wouldn't happen.{w} She hadn't deserved to die, so I could trade positions with her. I wouldn't even be doing it for some twisted form of recognition, as nobody would know what had happened—my other self would exist in my place, and I'd step aside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the tower, knowing the Sekimeiya was inside.{w} Who else in that town knew about what had happened on the 15th? I wished I could know that.
entries.literal: "I looked at the tower, knowing the Sekimeiya was inside.{w} Who else in that town knew about what had happened on the 15th? I wished I could know that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I just have to go in, find where the Sekimeiya is, and check if I can open the door in the storeroom. I just have to do that, determine what I can do, and enter again during the night.
entries.literal: "I just have to go in, find where the Sekimeiya is, and check if I can open the door in the storeroom. I just have to do that, determine what I can do, and enter again during the night."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But that wasn't the problem. I would only go back to the tower after knowing whether I truly wanted the past to change.
entries.literal: "But that wasn't the problem. I would only go back to the tower after knowing whether I truly wanted the past to change."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So, would I attempt to alter the hellish world I'd experienced at the cost of the life I'd always had, or would I give up on using the Sekimeiya again, accepting the cards we'd been dealt to create the best future we had at hand?
entries.literal: "So, would I attempt to alter the hellish world I'd experienced at the cost of the life I'd always had, or would I give up on using the Sekimeiya again, accepting the cards we'd been dealt to create the best future we had at hand?"

entries.text: Step aside and wait out the days.
entries.literal: "Step aside and wait out the days."

entries.text: Try to change the past.
entries.literal: "Try to change the past."

entries.text: Mirage
entries.literal: "Mirage"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was the answer. She wasn't disappointed in herself or sad about what would come. ...Shiroya was relieved to know that she'd made a decision.
entries.literal: "That was the answer. She wasn't disappointed in herself or sad about what would come. ...Shiroya was relieved to know that she'd made a decision."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She didn't know what would happen from there. Would Ashiya Tower be locked up for an entire month? If so, then it seemed hard to believe the storeroom door would work to free the remaining people.
entries.literal: "She didn't know what would happen from there. Would Ashiya Tower be locked up for an entire month? If so, then it seemed hard to believe the storeroom door would work to free the remaining people."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What that meant was that she had a few days for herself. Immediately after that, Shiroya didn't know what shape the future would take, but she believed that she and Atsuki would get through it. Her goal was solely to enjoy the remaining time she had.{w} Despite that, seeing a bustling street while she walked down the mountain, she only felt empty.
entries.literal: "What that meant was that she had a few days for herself. Immediately after that, Shiroya didn't know what shape the future would take, but she believed that she and Atsuki would get through it. Her goal was solely to enjoy the remaining time she had.{w} Despite that, seeing a bustling street while she walked down the mountain, she only felt empty."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At least, that was hypothetically what would have happened. However, it simply wasn't to be.
entries.literal: "At least, that was hypothetically what would have happened. However, it simply wasn't to be."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: More precisely, her surroundings at that moment didn't remotely resemble a mountain.
entries.literal: "More precisely, her surroundings at that moment didn't remotely resemble a mountain."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They were dark and eerie. The person closest to her was someone she'd never spoken with.
entries.literal: "They were dark and eerie. The person closest to her was someone she'd never spoken with."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why...?

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This world has not been frozen, but modified for convenience and familiarity. Ordinarily, this shape would be unlikely to be constructed, but it is needed to emphasize certain aspects.
entries.literal: "This world has not been frozen, but modified for convenience and familiarity. Ordinarily, this shape would be unlikely to be constructed, but it is needed to emphasize certain aspects."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Where is Shiroya now, and how did she get there?
entries.literal: "...Where is Shiroya now, and how did she get there?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya had traveled fifteen days through time and found herself underground.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had traveled fifteen days through time and found herself underground."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Her decision would end up being not to attempt to change history, never entering Ashiya Tower again. Naturally, at this point, she didn't know that.
entries.literal: "Her decision would end up being not to attempt to change history, never entering Ashiya Tower again. Naturally, at this point, she didn't know that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After exiting the inclined tunnel, she saw the entirety of Yushibana, the sun long since fallen behind the horizon.
entries.literal: "After exiting the inclined tunnel, she saw the entirety of Yushibana, the sun long since fallen behind the horizon."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She wandered through the dim streets, arriving at the shop where the explosion had occurred. Feeling extremely beaten down and ultimately unaware of what had happened, she walked to her apartment.
entries.literal: "She wandered through the dim streets, arriving at the shop where the explosion had occurred. Feeling extremely beaten down and ultimately unaware of what had happened, she walked to her apartment."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had been in the tower only minutes ago, where she'd discussed using the Sekimeiya one more time with the hope that the past could really be changed. At home, however, she hurried to her bed, where she lay with the clothes that had been dampened so long ago.
entries.literal: "She had been in the tower only minutes ago, where she'd discussed using the Sekimeiya one more time with the hope that the past could really be changed. At home, however, she hurried to her bed, where she lay with the clothes that had been dampened so long ago."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next day, she felt the urge to leave her apartment. It was noon, as she'd slept for a very long time. Outside, though, what would happen? Would anyone call her out for having come from the future?
entries.literal: "The next day, she felt the urge to leave her apartment. It was noon, as she'd slept for a very long time. Outside, though, what would happen? Would anyone call her out for having come from the future?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She wandered mindlessly, witnessing the life that had once disappeared around her.
entries.literal: "She wandered mindlessly, witnessing the life that had once disappeared around her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And she ended up at the entrance to Ina Café, where she would surely be recognized. However, she suddenly stopped when a note stuck to the shutter caught her notice.
entries.literal: "And she ended up at the entrance to Ina Café, where she would surely be recognized. However, she suddenly stopped when a note stuck to the shutter caught her notice."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was on top of the drawing of a coffee mug she'd never seen. She got closer and read what it said.
entries.literal: "It was on top of the drawing of a coffee mug she'd never seen. She got closer and read what it said."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "We apologize, but due to personal matters, we will be closed most days of the week. We hope this will only last for a short time."
entries.literal: "\"We apologize, but due to personal matters, we will be closed most days of the week. We hope this will only last for a short time.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya could hardly believe what she'd read. In many years, she'd never seen Ina closed, and even though the note was written in plural, she knew the person who'd written it had to be the one who worked there almost every day.
entries.literal: "Shiroya could hardly believe what she'd read. In many years, she'd never seen Ina closed, and even though the note was written in plural, she knew the person who'd written it had to be the one who worked there almost every day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Was it the universe's warning, telling her that she wasn't allowed to be seen? Perhaps Darfee seeing her would have created an impossibility that the universe had prevented.
entries.literal: "Was it the universe's warning, telling her that she wasn't allowed to be seen? Perhaps Darfee seeing her would have created an impossibility that the universe had prevented."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After staring at the note for a long time, she walked away. Hesitant to step into the busy crowd, she went the opposite way, wondering about the cause of Darfee's absence.
entries.literal: "After staring at the note for a long time, she walked away. Hesitant to step into the busy crowd, she went the opposite way, wondering about the cause of Darfee's absence."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She hadn't visited the café in a long time, so she didn't know how long that note had been there. No matter the reason, she felt a little worried for Darfee, who'd always been kind to her.
entries.literal: "She hadn't visited the café in a long time, so she didn't know how long that note had been there. No matter the reason, she felt a little worried for Darfee, who'd always been kind to her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Just what should she do...? She hadn't eaten much, so her head started to feel a little cloudy.
entries.literal: "Just what should she do...? She hadn't eaten much, so her head started to feel a little cloudy."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Distracted, she jumped when a sudden noise came from behind her.
entries.literal: "Distracted, she jumped when a sudden noise came from behind her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She turned around and saw a still car in the middle of the road. Its driver burst out and dashed to the front.{w} "Oh my God! Are you okay!? Hey...!"
entries.literal: "She turned around and saw a still car in the middle of the road. Its driver burst out and dashed to the front.{w} \"Oh my God! Are you okay!? Hey...!\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From farther ahead, Shiroya stared, terrified. However, a parked car prevented her from seeing what was on the snowy asphalt.
entries.literal: "From farther ahead, Shiroya stared, terrified. However, a parked car prevented her from seeing what was on the snowy asphalt."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "What the fuck!? I barely tapped him! Don't fucking tell me...!"{w} What had happened wasn't a mystery; Shiroya was stunned into immobility. As a handful of bystanders ran to the car, she desperately wished that no one's life had been lost.
entries.literal: "\"What the fuck!? I barely tapped him! Don't fucking tell me...!\"{w} What had happened wasn't a mystery; Shiroya was stunned into immobility. As a handful of bystanders ran to the car, she desperately wished that no one's life had been lost."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: Hey! ...Say something!{w} Come on! Say something!
entries.literal: "Hey! ...Say something!{w} Come on! Say something!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Those anguished cries continued ceaselessly and kept drawing nearby people in, forming a circle.
entries.literal: "Those anguished cries continued ceaselessly and kept drawing nearby people in, forming a circle."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A few of them had phones by their ears, detailing the emergency to the proper officials with the hopeless voice of the driver in the background. Given the way everyone was acting, there was only one conclusion to draw.
entries.literal: "A few of them had phones by their ears, detailing the emergency to the proper officials with the hopeless voice of the driver in the background. Given the way everyone was acting, there was only one conclusion to draw."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: You've gotta be fucking kidding! ...Hey! Wake up!{w} Man! He just ran out in front of me! There was no way I could've stopped in time!{w} Come on, say something! Please!
entries.literal: "You've gotta be fucking kidding! ...Hey! Wake up!{w} Man! He just ran out in front of me! There was no way I could've stopped in time!{w} Come on, say something! Please!"

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: H-He's right, I saw it too. He suddenly crossed the road.{w} It looked like he started running when he saw her.
entries.literal: "H-He's right, I saw it too. He suddenly crossed the road.{w} It looked like he started running when he saw her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Out of nowhere, everyone turned to face the petrified Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, everyone turned to face the petrified Shiroya."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: Wh...

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She stared back at the onlookers for long seconds, none of them moving.
entries.literal: "She stared back at the onlookers for long seconds, none of them moving."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Finally, after she processed what she'd heard, she stepped forward and looked beyond the parked car.
entries.literal: "Finally, after she processed what she'd heard, she stepped forward and looked beyond the parked car."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sure enough, she knew the person lying on the snow who was being forcefully shaken by his shoulders.
entries.literal: "Sure enough, she knew the person lying on the snow who was being forcefully shaken by his shoulders."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Of course she did. On top of all the bright blood soaking into the snow was the person she knew most well. The person she'd gone to the tower with, and her last friend.
entries.literal: "Of course she did. On top of all the bright blood soaking into the snow was the person she knew most well. The person she'd gone to the tower with, and her last friend."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So when she saw his empty eyes, the sound of her heart thudding echoed inside her own body. Red and white blended into one, the entire world appearing drenched in his blood.
entries.literal: "So when she saw his empty eyes, the sound of her heart thudding echoed inside her own body. Red and white blended into one, the entire world appearing drenched in his blood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was absurd to think that scene made any sense. That thought barely managed to cross her mind.
entries.literal: "It was absurd to think that scene made any sense. That thought barely managed to cross her mind."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She hadn't wished the past to change at all, so why had it changed in the worst way possible?
entries.literal: "She hadn't wished the past to change at all, so why had it changed in the worst way possible?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Soon, an ambulance came, but everyone was already aware it was futile.{w} The body was quickly placed on a stretcher and injected with a substance. Losing no time, he was brought in through the rear door of the vehicle, and it sped away.
entries.literal: "Soon, an ambulance came, but everyone was already aware it was futile.{w} The body was quickly placed on a stretcher and injected with a substance. Losing no time, he was brought in through the rear door of the vehicle, and it sped away."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A swarm of people surrounded the bloodstain left behind, and they started to talk loudly as soon as the ambulance left.
entries.literal: "A swarm of people surrounded the bloodstain left behind, and they started to talk loudly as soon as the ambulance left."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the ground, the broken driver stared downward. A few steps back, Shiroya did the same thing, rejecting what she'd witnessed.
entries.literal: "On the ground, the broken driver stared downward. A few steps back, Shiroya did the same thing, rejecting what she'd witnessed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had recently been forced to accept the cruelty of reality, but she hadn't been prepared for the same thing to happen again.{w} She denied it. She told herself that she'd mistaken his face or that everyone had failed to notice he'd still been alive. ...If everything was a dream, it would resolve all of her problems at once.
entries.literal: "She had recently been forced to accept the cruelty of reality, but she hadn't been prepared for the same thing to happen again.{w} She denied it. She told herself that she'd mistaken his face or that everyone had failed to notice he'd still been alive. ...If everything was a dream, it would resolve all of her problems at once."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: What's your name?
entries.literal: "What's your name?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya heard someone addressing her. It had happened before when they'd noticed she knew the victim, but she hadn't replied. For that reason, she'd been left alone for a while.
entries.literal: "Shiroya heard someone addressing her. It had happened before when they'd noticed she knew the victim, but she hadn't replied. For that reason, she'd been left alone for a while."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: Answer me. What's your name?
entries.literal: "Answer me. What's your name?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But that voice persisted. When Shiroya moved her head, she saw a police officer staring at her with a serious expression.
entries.literal: "But that voice persisted. When Shiroya moved her head, she saw a police officer staring at her with a serious expression."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: ...Sh-Shiroya.{w} Mirana.
entries.literal: "...Sh-Shiroya.{w} Mirana."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: You'll have to come with us.
entries.literal: "You'll have to come with us."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: ...Wh-Wha—
entries.literal: "...Wh-Wha—"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Grabbed by the wrist, she was dragged to a police car with its door open.
entries.literal: "Grabbed by the wrist, she was dragged to a police car with its door open."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: Sit here.
entries.literal: "Sit here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The officer closed the door from the outside. Immediately, another officer opened the front door and sat in the driver seat.
entries.literal: "The officer closed the door from the outside. Immediately, another officer opened the front door and sat in the driver seat."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya had no strength to question anything, so when the engine started up and they began to drive away, she could only gaze at the fading group of people who'd seen the same thing she had.
entries.literal: "Shiroya had no strength to question anything, so when the engine started up and they began to drive away, she could only gaze at the fading group of people who'd seen the same thing she had."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Days passed, and still confined, she remained unable to comprehend a single piece of what had happened.
entries.literal: "Days passed, and still confined, she remained unable to comprehend a single piece of what had happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was many days later when Shiroya stepped on the snow again.
entries.literal: "It was many days later when Shiroya stepped on the snow again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had learned it with certainty: Atsuki had died on that day, instantly.
entries.literal: "She had learned it with certainty: Atsuki had died on that day, instantly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The incident of the 15th had already occurred, and in the distance, she could see Ashiya Tower.{w} It had been a while ago when she'd touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom, but she hadn't set foot in that building again.
entries.literal: "The incident of the 15th had already occurred, and in the distance, she could see Ashiya Tower.{w} It had been a while ago when she'd touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom, but she hadn't set foot in that building again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And she wouldn't. It didn't matter anymore.
entries.literal: "And she wouldn't. It didn't matter anymore."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She didn't know where to find the Sekimeiya or what had happened to her life. The day she opened the door to her apartment again... was January 11th of 2012.
entries.literal: "She didn't know where to find the Sekimeiya or what had happened to her life. The day she opened the door to her apartment again... was January 11th of 2012."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What had happened on the 15th of December? She had heard about it.
entries.literal: "What had happened on the 15th of December? She had heard about it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At {time=21}, the main shutter had unlocked. However, nobody had been found alive inside.
entries.literal: "At {time=21}, the main shutter had unlocked. However, nobody had been found alive inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two people had been found dead. Their names were Naomi Cabca and Isla Majutsu.{w} Drops of blood that hadn't belonged to them had been found on the floor, but the whereabouts of the remaining people were a mystery. After raiding the building, the police had failed to find them.
entries.literal: "Two people had been found dead. Their names were Naomi Cabca and Isla Majutsu.{w} Drops of blood that hadn't belonged to them had been found on the floor, but the whereabouts of the remaining people were a mystery. After raiding the building, the police had failed to find them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It had been soon confirmed that more people should've been there. Counting everyone who'd scanned their tickets in the entrance, the names of the people who hadn't evacuated were Atsuki Hakutoki, Shiroya Mirana, Sai Yomiya, Akaro Esata, and Erina Majutsu.{w} What had happened to them? It was impossible they had left the building during their twelve hours of imprisonment, as the whole structure had been observed from the outside since that morning.
entries.literal: "It had been soon confirmed that more people should've been there. Counting everyone who'd scanned their tickets in the entrance, the names of the people who hadn't evacuated were Atsuki Hakutoki, Shiroya Mirana, Sai Yomiya, Akaro Esata, and Erina Majutsu.{w} What had happened to them? It was impossible they had left the building during their twelve hours of imprisonment, as the whole structure had been observed from the outside since that morning."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The police concluded that Isla Majutsu, the second victim, had died many hours after {time=9.}{w} Yet, they had very few clues as to what had occurred. Almost all the recorded footage had been erased, and what remained was useless. The belongings of the two victims contained nothing of importance, and neither did any place in the building.{w} That only made things more confusing, because despite the belief of many citizens, nothing else had been stolen beyond the gemstones that had been found in the morning.
entries.literal: "The police concluded that Isla Majutsu, the second victim, had died many hours after {time=9.}{w} Yet, they had very few clues as to what had occurred. Almost all the recorded footage had been erased, and what remained was useless. The belongings of the two victims contained nothing of importance, and neither did any place in the building.{w} That only made things more confusing, because despite the belief of many citizens, nothing else had been stolen beyond the gemstones that had been found in the morning."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But there was another reason why the investigation was majorly hindered.
entries.literal: "But there was another reason why the investigation was majorly hindered."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the entrance opened, the authorities detected a gas present in the interior, especially prominent on the lowest floor. As a safety measure, they quickly locked the main access to the building to analyze what the substance was.
entries.literal: "When the entrance opened, the authorities detected a gas present in the interior, especially prominent on the lowest floor. As a safety measure, they quickly locked the main access to the building to analyze what the substance was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After analysis, identifying the substance hadn't been possible. Once that information propagated, the handling of the situation became much more delicate, as neither the gas nor its source had been recognized.
entries.literal: "After analysis, identifying the substance hadn't been possible. Once that information propagated, the handling of the situation became much more delicate, as neither the gas nor its source had been recognized."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This was the first public statement:{w} "Five people who were trapped in Ashiya Tower on the 15th are still to be found. The deaths of Naomi Cabca and Isla Majutsu are being investigated. However, access to Ashiya Tower is strictly prohibited, as a potentially dangerous gas was found within it in high quantities.{w} While investigating the motive behind the attack is not the highest priority, aside from the gemstones found immediately after the authorities secured the situation, no other valuable items were found to be missing, indicating that theft may not have been the goal."
entries.literal: "This was the first public statement:{w} \"Five people who were trapped in Ashiya Tower on the 15th are still to be found. The deaths of Naomi Cabca and Isla Majutsu are being investigated. However, access to Ashiya Tower is strictly prohibited, as a potentially dangerous gas was found within it in high quantities.{w} While investigating the motive behind the attack is not the highest priority, aside from the gemstones found immediately after the authorities secured the situation, no other valuable items were found to be missing, indicating that theft may not have been the goal.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya couldn't see the walls of her apartment without feeling her heart shrinking. When she finally went back, she wondered what she was supposed to do.
entries.literal: "Shiroya couldn't see the walls of her apartment without feeling her heart shrinking. When she finally went back, she wondered what she was supposed to do."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had spoken to her parents over the phone, and she'd been forced to speak about Atsuki's death and everything the police had asked her. Even though she'd been released without being considered guilty of anything, she hadn't been able to answer any questions about the attack on the 15th.
entries.literal: "She had spoken to her parents over the phone, and she'd been forced to speak about Atsuki's death and everything the police had asked her. Even though she'd been released without being considered guilty of anything, she hadn't been able to answer any questions about the attack on the 15th."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lately, she'd had to talk a lot, but when she found herself at home, she didn't think she had the ability to produce a single sound.
entries.literal: "Lately, she'd had to talk a lot, but when she found herself at home, she didn't think she had the ability to produce a single sound."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The pillows were still scattered in her living room. The last time she'd been there, she'd managed to feel hopeful, but that felt so distant that it was hard to believe decades hadn't passed.
entries.literal: "The pillows were still scattered in her living room. The last time she'd been there, she'd managed to feel hopeful, but that felt so distant that it was hard to believe decades hadn't passed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya didn't know what the point of returning was. She had lost everything.
entries.literal: "Shiroya didn't know what the point of returning was. She had lost everything."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the next day. She had slept and eaten, but it couldn't be said she'd done so for any particular reason.{w} The miserable way she felt... it was all too familiar to her, but the difference in potency was immense.
entries.literal: "It was the next day. She had slept and eaten, but it couldn't be said she'd done so for any particular reason.{w} The miserable way she felt... it was all too familiar to her, but the difference in potency was immense."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That day, she became aware of something she hadn't been told yet.
entries.literal: "That day, she became aware of something she hadn't been told yet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After turning on the television, she learned about the current situation in Yushibana.
entries.literal: "After turning on the television, she learned about the current situation in Yushibana."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It wasn't a secret that a large portion of the citizens was opposed to the presence Ashiya had built. Due to Ashiya Tower, Yushibana had undergone a drastic change throughout the recent years.
entries.literal: "It wasn't a secret that a large portion of the citizens was opposed to the presence Ashiya had built. Due to Ashiya Tower, Yushibana had undergone a drastic change throughout the recent years."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Perhaps the old activities of what had once been called the Ashiya family weren't as widely known, but what was a commonly shared fact was that when the tower had shifted into a personal exposition center, a new wave of people had taken over the town.
entries.literal: "Perhaps the old activities of what had once been called the Ashiya family weren't as widely known, but what was a commonly shared fact was that when the tower had shifted into a personal exposition center, a new wave of people had taken over the town."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was the fundamental dispute in Yushibana. The older citizens, aware of the way Ashiya had once been, were becoming outnumbered by the recent influx of people Ashiya had brought, who supported the now-corporation due to financial reasons and were ignorant of its roots.{w} After the 15th of December, the backlash Ashiya had received had been enormous. Through their poor security measures, they'd let two people be killed, and they hadn't publicly responded well to the ordeal, blinded by their battle against Xyn.
entries.literal: "That was the fundamental dispute in Yushibana. The older citizens, aware of the way Ashiya had once been, were becoming outnumbered by the recent influx of people Ashiya had brought, who supported the now-corporation due to financial reasons and were ignorant of its roots.{w} After the 15th of December, the backlash Ashiya had received had been enormous. Through their poor security measures, they'd let two people be killed, and they hadn't publicly responded well to the ordeal, blinded by their battle against Xyn."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unlike previously, the protests were so strong and visible that the supportive part of Yushibana joined in as well. Everything Ashiya had done to combat Xyn was being revealed, so the older citizens took the chance to expose all they knew about Ashiya's past, and rumors about the missing people and the unknown gas continued to circulate.
entries.literal: "Unlike previously, the protests were so strong and visible that the supportive part of Yushibana joined in as well. Everything Ashiya had done to combat Xyn was being revealed, so the older citizens took the chance to expose all they knew about Ashiya's past, and rumors about the missing people and the unknown gas continued to circulate."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: All Ashiya kept saying was that they were still investigating what had happened—that they would find the missing people and expose those working as part of Xyn. Then, the tower would quickly open again.{w} However, everyone knew that nobody had entered that building since the 15th due to the unknown gas, so those statements were seen as a haphazard, lacking defense.
entries.literal: "All Ashiya kept saying was that they were still investigating what had happened—that they would find the missing people and expose those working as part of Xyn. Then, the tower would quickly open again.{w} However, everyone knew that nobody had entered that building since the 15th due to the unknown gas, so those statements were seen as a haphazard, lacking defense."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Where were the remaining people? Why had they not been in the tower?{w} One of them had died in a car accident, and another one had been unable to explain anything to the police. It didn't make sense; they should've been in the tower, late on the 15th. ...And what about the other three? They hadn't been found anywhere.
entries.literal: "Where were the remaining people? Why had they not been in the tower?{w} One of them had died in a car accident, and another one had been unable to explain anything to the police. It didn't make sense; they should've been in the tower, late on the 15th. ...And what about the other three? They hadn't been found anywhere."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Soon, Ashiya went quiet. After days spent repeating themselves, it seemed they'd chosen to drop the subject entirely.
entries.literal: "Soon, Ashiya went quiet. After days spent repeating themselves, it seemed they'd chosen to drop the subject entirely."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The news had been covered all over the nation and had even reached overseas. When it was noticed that Ashiya had stopped defending themselves from harsh criticism, it was assumed they'd concluded they were done for.
entries.literal: "The news had been covered all over the nation and had even reached overseas. When it was noticed that Ashiya had stopped defending themselves from harsh criticism, it was assumed they'd concluded they were done for."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And that was correct. The next time an executive of Ashiya was seen, they were recorded exiting the tower, loading covered boxes onto a truck.
entries.literal: "And that was correct. The next time an executive of Ashiya was seen, they were recorded exiting the tower, loading covered boxes onto a truck."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later that day, from her apartment, Shiroya saw that scene being broadcast.
entries.literal: "Later that day, from her apartment, Shiroya saw that scene being broadcast."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: So, is it true that you're abandoning the tower? It's been speculated you're selling it. Is that correct? What do you have to say about all the employees you left without a job?
entries.literal: "So, is it true that you're abandoning the tower? It's been speculated you're selling it. Is that correct? What do you have to say about all the employees you left without a job?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was no reply from the Ashiya member.
entries.literal: "There was no reply from the Ashiya member."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: The police haven't said anything else about the supposed gas that's inside. Is that not a concern anymore?
entries.literal: "The police haven't said anything else about the supposed gas that's inside. Is that not a concern anymore?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the video, the snow was starting to melt in the background. The reporter tried to get the man to answer again, but she couldn't get him to speak.
entries.literal: "On the video, the snow was starting to melt in the background. The reporter tried to get the man to answer again, but she couldn't get him to speak."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya reached out to pet Maxi. In the corner, Umi's eyes seemed to be fixed on the screen, her dark fur camouflaged in the dim room.
entries.literal: "Shiroya reached out to pet Maxi. In the corner, Umi's eyes seemed to be fixed on the screen, her dark fur camouflaged in the dim room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The screen morphed into static, the audio going with it. As the signal was very poor, it was frequently interrupted.
entries.literal: "The screen morphed into static, the audio going with it. As the signal was very poor, it was frequently interrupted."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Staring at the television, Shiroya felt traces of motion sickness. Was it due to the rapidly flashing screen? It almost didn't seem that way.
entries.literal: "Staring at the television, Shiroya felt traces of motion sickness. Was it due to the rapidly flashing screen? It almost didn't seem that way."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Long ago, evolution had developed motion sickness. When one's sight blurred, as they could've been poisoned, they would react by vomiting to expel the poison. Shiroya was unsure if the static just made her feel that way or if her entire life had been poisoned.
entries.literal: "Long ago, evolution had developed motion sickness. When one's sight blurred, as they could've been poisoned, they would react by vomiting to expel the poison. Shiroya was unsure if the static just made her feel that way or if her entire life had been poisoned."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Alone in her apartment, she didn't look away until the signal resolved.{w} When it did, someone else was speaking about the same topic, but very far from the tower.
entries.literal: "Alone in her apartment, she didn't look away until the signal resolved.{w} When it did, someone else was speaking about the same topic, but very far from the tower."

entries.speaker: c5
entries.text: ...ya tower was bought. We don't have the details yet, but it appears the building is not theirs anymore. They just finished taking out anything of worth inside, so Ashiya's quietly leaving their old property behind.
entries.literal: "...ya tower was bought. We don't have the details yet, but it appears the building is not theirs anymore. They just finished taking out anything of worth inside, so Ashiya's quietly leaving their old property behind."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It became known that someone had offered to buy the tower from Ashiya, and they had accepted due to their awful position. In the blink of an eye, Ashiya, which had been seen as a source of power and wealth within Yushibana, had entirely vanished.{w} Who had been the buyer, however? It didn't seem that information was widely available.
entries.literal: "It became known that someone had offered to buy the tower from Ashiya, and they had accepted due to their awful position.
