In the blink of an eye, Ashiya, which had been seen as a source of power and wealth within Yushibana, had entirely vanished.{w} Who had been the buyer, however? It didn't seem that information was widely available."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Despite what many people felt in regards to Ashiya, a large portion of the citizens in Yushibana engaged in business with them, so the group falling to pieces brought hardship. Would the tower's new owner put the building to a similar use?
entries.literal: "Despite what many people felt in regards to Ashiya, a large portion of the citizens in Yushibana engaged in business with them, so the group falling to pieces brought hardship. Would the tower's new owner put the building to a similar use?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If not, it was very likely someone else from Yushibana would, as there were a variety of shops and attractions related to the gemstones in the surrounding mountains. As long as those shops could still sell gems, at least a few of them would avoid disaster.
entries.literal: "If not, it was very likely someone else from Yushibana would, as there were a variety of shops and attractions related to the gemstones in the surrounding mountains. As long as those shops could still sell gems, at least a few of them would avoid disaster."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But what would happen was soon revealed.
entries.literal: "But what would happen was soon revealed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The news finally came out: the building that had been Ashiya's for so many years would disappear.
entries.literal: "The news finally came out: the building that had been Ashiya's for so many years would disappear."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That began to shine a bit of light on the situation. The demolition of the tower was something one part of Yushibana had always wished for. The structure that clearly didn't belong with the others—the one they'd all seen rapidly increasing in height throughout the years...
entries.literal: "That began to shine a bit of light on the situation. The demolition of the tower was something one part of Yushibana had always wished for. The structure that clearly didn't belong with the others—the one they'd all seen rapidly increasing in height throughout the years..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why had it been purchased just to be demolished? Had it been to follow that old, unattainable demand that Ashiya disappear? Did they hope the rumors still tied with that building would vanish so that something entirely new could be built? There was only speculation on those topics throughout Yushibana, and nothing more.
entries.literal: "Why had it been purchased just to be demolished? Had it been to follow that old, unattainable demand that Ashiya disappear? Did they hope the rumors still tied with that building would vanish so that something entirely new could be built? There was only speculation on those topics throughout Yushibana, and nothing more."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Weeks had passed, but any answers remained staunchly concealed. However, a date had already been appointed: on October 4th, the building would be destroyed.
entries.literal: "Weeks had passed, but any answers remained staunchly concealed. However, a date had already been appointed: on October 4th, the building would be destroyed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was a tall and wide structure, so demolishing it wasn't simple. As no buildings were directly next to it, though, there was little danger to any of the surroundings.
entries.literal: "It was a tall and wide structure, so demolishing it wasn't simple. As no buildings were directly next to it, though, there was little danger to any of the surroundings."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At some point, the unanswered questions had almost faded. Who had caused the incident on the 15th of December? Who had killed the two victims? Where were the remaining people? Given the blood that had been found, the worst had been assumed by all.
entries.literal: "At some point, the unanswered questions had almost faded. Who had caused the incident on the 15th of December? Who had killed the two victims? Where were the remaining people? Given the blood that had been found, the worst had been assumed by all."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After so long, there was a reason why Shiroya and her cat had their heads out their window.{w} It was October 4th, and the sight they were beholding would no longer exist the following day.
entries.literal: "After so long, there was a reason why Shiroya and her cat had their heads out their window.{w} It was October 4th, and the sight they were beholding would no longer exist the following day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the distance, the building stretching past the others was soon to fall. It could've been dangerous to get close to it, so many people were also watching from within their houses. Some of them were about to have a familiar view returned to them. Others, like Shiroya, could hardly imagine what a Yushibana without Ashiya Tower would be like.
entries.literal: "In the distance, the building stretching past the others was soon to fall. It could've been dangerous to get close to it, so many people were also watching from within their houses. Some of them were about to have a familiar view returned to them. Others, like Shiroya, could hardly imagine what a Yushibana without Ashiya Tower would be like."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At {time=12}, the demolition would begin. There'd been no correspondence from Ashiya in months. The facts behind the unknown gas and the deaths within the tower were still shrouded in darkness.{w} The interior of the building had been investigated a few times after the 15th, but nothing useful had been figured out. Ashiya had removed everything of value, so after it was verified by the new owner, the demolition seemed to pose no risk aside from the dust it would scatter across the hill behind the tower.
entries.literal: "At {time=12}, the demolition would begin. There'd been no correspondence from Ashiya in months. The facts behind the unknown gas and the deaths within the tower were still shrouded in darkness.{w} The interior of the building had been investigated a few times after the 15th, but nothing useful had been figured out. Ashiya had removed everything of value, so after it was verified by the new owner, the demolition seemed to pose no risk aside from the dust it would scatter across the hill behind the tower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A minute before the appointed time, many pairs of eyes looked on from behind windows all over town.
entries.literal: "A minute before the appointed time, many pairs of eyes looked on from behind windows all over town."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With a faint, deep sound, the building had abruptly fallen. In a second, a huge, brown cloud of dust was all that Shiroya could see on the other side of Yushibana.
entries.literal: "With a faint, deep sound, the building had abruptly fallen. In a second, a huge, brown cloud of dust was all that Shiroya could see on the other side of Yushibana."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It didn't seem like it had reached any of the nearest houses. Instead of waiting for it to dissipate, Shiroya shut the window and walked out of her bedroom.
entries.literal: "It didn't seem like it had reached any of the nearest houses. Instead of waiting for it to dissipate, Shiroya shut the window and walked out of her bedroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Cleaning up the debris would be a long process, and while there was no news about what would happen afterward, the procedure would start a week from that day.
entries.literal: "Cleaning up the debris would be a long process, and while there was no news about what would happen afterward, the procedure would start a week from that day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya returned in the afternoon. She'd gotten used to having the television on while she was at home. She'd never done that prior to everything that had happened to her, but it brought her some small form of solace to have any noise at all in her barren set of rooms.
entries.literal: "Shiroya returned in the afternoon. She'd gotten used to having the television on while she was at home. She'd never done that prior to everything that had happened to her, but it brought her some small form of solace to have any noise at all in her barren set of rooms."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She'd set the volume low because the sporadic static would be hard on her ears otherwise.
entries.literal: "She'd set the volume low because the sporadic static would be hard on her ears otherwise."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The bright screen projected light onto the ceiling. When the color drastically changed, Shiroya lifted her head.
entries.literal: "The bright screen projected light onto the ceiling. When the color drastically changed, Shiroya lifted her head."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She raised her entire body next. On the screen was a man speaking into a microphone.{w} She grabbed the remote and increased the volume, staring at the text beneath him.
entries.literal: "She raised her entire body next. On the screen was a man speaking into a microphone.{w} She grabbed the remote and increased the volume, staring at the text beneath him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had to read it a few times to comprehend it.
entries.literal: "She had to read it a few times to comprehend it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "The last three people who were trapped in Ashiya Tower found dead".
entries.literal: "\"The last three people who were trapped in Ashiya Tower found dead\"."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the corner of the screen was an image of the piled debris. Shiroya focused her hearing and began to process the deep voice of the reporter.
entries.literal: "In the corner of the screen was an image of the piled debris. Shiroya focused her hearing and began to process the deep voice of the reporter."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...en they started to be removed, the first body was found. It was that of Akaro Esata.
entries.literal: "...en they started to be removed, the first body was found. It was that of Akaro Esata."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A video began to play in the background. It showed people removing the debris and a pixelated red blob in the middle.
entries.literal: "A video began to play in the background. It showed people removing the debris and a pixelated red blob in the middle."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Another one was quickly found afterward, belonging to Sai Yomiya. Finally, when almost all the debris had been removed, Erina Majutsu's body was found.{w} The three bodies were heavily crushed, and it's believed some parts of them weren't found.
entries.literal: "Another one was quickly found afterward, belonging to Sai Yomiya. Finally, when almost all the debris had been removed, Erina Majutsu's body was found.{w} The three bodies were heavily crushed, and it's believed some parts of them weren't found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya listened in disbelief. She'd always known that when she'd touched the Sekimeiya, Atsuki, Erina, Sai, and Akaro had been in the lobby. Atsuki had died in a car accident, but the others had all disappeared. A long time ago, Shiroya had concluded that Atsuki must've traveled through time after her.
entries.literal: "Shiroya listened in disbelief. She'd always known that when she'd touched the Sekimeiya, Atsuki, Erina, Sai, and Akaro had been in the lobby. Atsuki had died in a car accident, but the others had all disappeared. A long time ago, Shiroya had concluded that Atsuki must've traveled through time after her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But this... What kind of sense did it make? The censoring prevented her from confirming the bodies' faces, but given their descriptions, it didn't seem like that would've been possible regardless.
entries.literal: "But this... What kind of sense did it make? The censoring prevented her from confirming the bodies' faces, but given their descriptions, it didn't seem like that would've been possible regardless."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: As of now, what happened is unknown. While the bodies were severely smashed, they were not fully decomposed. It has been determined that they died the day of the demolition.{w} However, the possibility of the demolition itself causing their deaths has been thoroughly refuted. It was properly verified that nobody was in the building before the impact, and that's not the only reason.{w} The three bodies were below all the rubble. If the building had really fallen on them, their condition would be even worse. Strangely, some of the body parts that were recovered are practically intact, despite the state of most others.{w} There was no dust discovered on the bodies—neither inside their clothes nor in their mouths. For this reason, the situation is being handled very carefully, as the truth behind it might be appalling.{w} It has been considered that the bodies were disposed of within the rubble following the demolition since they couldn't have been directly hit by it. However, given how deep they were and the absence of blood around them, that was immediately discarded as well.{w} Even though the abundance of the unidentified old gas has disappeared, around the three bodies was where the last remaining traces were found.{w} This is an extremely delicate case that has carried unsolved questions with it all year. Now that everyone who was trapped in the building has been found, the authorities will do all they can to figure out what happened on that day.
entries.literal: "As of now, what happened is unknown. While the bodies were severely smashed, they were not fully decomposed. It has been determined that they died the day of the demolition.{w} However, the possibility of the demolition itself causing their deaths has been thoroughly refuted. It was properly verified that nobody was in the building before the impact, and that's not the only reason.{w} The three bodies were below all the rubble. If the building had really fallen on them, their condition would be even worse. Strangely, some of the body parts that were recovered are practically intact, despite the state of most others.{w} There was no dust discovered on the bodies—neither inside their clothes nor in their mouths. For this reason, the situation is being handled very carefully, as the truth behind it might be appalling.{w} It has been considered that the bodies were disposed of within the rubble following the demolition since they couldn't have been directly hit by it. However, given how deep they were and the absence of blood around them, that was immediately discarded as well.{w} Even though the abundance of the unidentified old gas has disappeared, around the three bodies was where the last remaining traces were found.{w} This is an extremely delicate case that has carried unsolved questions with it all year. Now that everyone who was trapped in the building has been found, the authorities will do all they can to figure out what happened on that day."

entries.text: Chapter 3 Credits (Forsaken Relay)
entries.literal: "Chapter 3 Credits (Forsaken Relay)"

entries.text: Shiroya turned off the television.
entries.literal: "Shiroya turned off the television."

entries.text: After months of dwelling on the incident, the reporter's words released her.
entries.literal: "After months of dwelling on the incident, the reporter's words released her."

entries.text: It was over.
entries.literal: "It was over."

entries.text: The remaining hope she'd been carrying was gone.
entries.literal: "The remaining hope she'd been carrying was gone."

entries.text: She wouldn't see the people she'd been with that day again, and she wouldn't learn what had happened to them.
entries.literal: "She wouldn't see the people she'd been with that day again, and she wouldn't learn what had happened to them."

entries.text: Over time, she'd come to accept that the time when the three had reunited had been but a second farewell.
entries.literal: "Over time, she'd come to accept that the time when the three had reunited had been but a second farewell."

entries.text: Shiroya stepped out of her apartment one more time to visit the snowless world.
entries.literal: "Shiroya stepped out of her apartment one more time to visit the snowless world."

entries.text: The sky above her didn't feel the same as it once had, but it was still there.
entries.literal: "The sky above her didn't feel the same as it once had, but it was still there."

entries.text: She had somewhere to go.
entries.literal: "She had somewhere to go."

entries.text: Earlier that day, she'd tried to walk there and stopped halfway.
entries.literal: "Earlier that day, she'd tried to walk there and stopped halfway."

entries.text: Surrounded by green, she inhaled a familiar aroma.
entries.literal: "Surrounded by green, she inhaled a familiar aroma."

entries.text: She wanted to know if an offer she'd received long ago was still valid.
entries.literal: "She wanted to know if an offer she'd received long ago was still valid."

entries.text: Finally hoping for something, she wished it wasn't too late.
entries.literal: "Finally hoping for something, she wished it wasn't too late."

entries.text: And as she saw the last person who remained from her old life, she learned that she hadn't waited too long.
entries.literal: "And as she saw the last person who remained from her old life, she learned that she hadn't waited too long."

entries.text: It wouldn't make her happy.
entries.literal: "It wouldn't make her happy."

entries.text: And it would probably not make her less lonely.
entries.literal: "And it would probably not make her less lonely."

entries.text: But the fact that she wanted it regardless was enough to know that she had to do it.
entries.literal: "But the fact that she wanted it regardless was enough to know that she had to do it."

entries.text: The next day, she had a reason to get up and fondly remembered the last time she'd awoken in high spirits.
entries.literal: "The next day, she had a reason to get up and fondly remembered the last time she'd awoken in high spirits."

entries.text: The three gruesome bodies beneath the rubble...
entries.literal: "The three gruesome bodies beneath the rubble..."

entries.text: That mystery was nowhere close to being solved.
entries.literal: "That mystery was nowhere close to being solved."

entries.text: There had been no new information from Ashiya.
entries.literal: "There had been no new information from Ashiya."

entries.text: They had vanished completely, and with them the route to any remaining answers.
entries.literal: "They had vanished completely, and with them the route to any remaining answers."

entries.text: The plain terrain where the tower had once been...
entries.literal: "The plain terrain where the tower had once been..."

entries.text: After years of the building's increasing height, nothing else would rise there.
entries.literal: "After years of the building's increasing height, nothing else would rise there."

entries.text: It didn't take long for that place to become a thing of the past.
entries.literal: "It didn't take long for that place to become a thing of the past."

entries.text: And for that inexplicable day to be merely a memory.
entries.literal: "And for that inexplicable day to be merely a memory."

entries.text: Once years had gone by, Shiroya's surroundings were different.
entries.literal: "Once years had gone by, Shiroya's surroundings were different."

entries.text: She wasn't far from Yushibana, but she didn't live there anymore.
entries.literal: "She wasn't far from Yushibana, but she didn't live there anymore."

entries.text: Every time she looked at both animals still at her side, she remembered the person who'd always been with her.
entries.literal: "Every time she looked at both animals still at her side, she remembered the person who'd always been with her."

entries.text: He was someone she'd never forget and someone who didn't exist anymore.
entries.literal: "He was someone she'd never forget and someone who didn't exist anymore."

entries.text: Holding a packed, green folder, she laughed along with someone who'd never stepped into her hometown.
entries.literal: "Holding a packed, green folder, she laughed along with someone who'd never stepped into her hometown."

entries.text: She explained the events of one particular December 15th as if they had happened long, long ago.
entries.literal: "She explained the events of one particular December 15th as if they had happened long, long ago."

entries.text: Leaving out crucial details, she maintained a natural voice as she thought back on that egg-shaped stone.
entries.literal: "Leaving out crucial details, she maintained a natural voice as she thought back on that egg-shaped stone."

entries.text: Was she the last person who remembered its powers?
entries.literal: "Was she the last person who remembered its powers?"

entries.text: ...She really was the same person who'd once stepped into that tower, and the only survivor of that day.
entries.literal: "...She really was the same person who'd once stepped into that tower, and the only survivor of that day."

entries.text: Ending: Forsaken Relay
entries.literal: "Ending: Forsaken Relay"

entries.text: Axis Ropeway
entries.literal: "Axis Ropeway"

entries.text: Tethered
entries.literal: "Tethered"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I would... change the past. I had a way to save Miiya, Atsuki, Isla, Katei, Naomi, Erina...
entries.literal: "I would... change the past. I had a way to save Miiya, Atsuki, Isla, Katei, Naomi, Erina..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had traveled from the 15th to change the past alone, and even though I hadn't been aware of what would happen, I had considered the outcome with my other self.
entries.literal: "I had traveled from the 15th to change the past alone, and even though I hadn't been aware of what would happen, I had considered the outcome with my other self."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Looking at the small town had finally brought me to lean toward an option. I'd decided to do my best to change the past, as the possible consequences didn't outweigh what good could be achieved.
entries.literal: "Looking at the small town had finally brought me to lean toward an option. I'd decided to do my best to change the past, as the possible consequences didn't outweigh what good could be achieved."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But the tower I could see far in the distance... I still couldn't go there.
entries.literal: "But the tower I could see far in the distance... I still couldn't go there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The day I'd enter that building again would likely be the last day of my normal life, and even though I'd decided, the thought could still freeze me in place.
entries.literal: "The day I'd enter that building again would likely be the last day of my normal life, and even though I'd decided, the thought could still freeze me in place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted the days I had to persist, but that couldn't happen. My life in Yushibana was likely soon to end, and I could choose the length of the last stretch.
entries.literal: "I wanted the days I had to persist, but that couldn't happen. My life in Yushibana was likely soon to end, and I could choose the length of the last stretch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I saved Miiya, I wouldn't show myself to her, Atsuki, and the other me, even though I didn't know yet what I would do.
entries.literal: "If I saved Miiya, I wouldn't show myself to her, Atsuki, and the other me, even though I didn't know yet what I would do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So the issue to solve was the possibility of a knowledgeable enemy who could change the past on their own and steal the Sekimeiya before the 15th.
entries.literal: "So the issue to solve was the possibility of a knowledgeable enemy who could change the past on their own and steal the Sekimeiya before the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't do much to combat that aside from rushing in, which I found far too risky. So I settled on another course of action and accepted that I would take it.
entries.literal: "I couldn't do much to combat that aside from rushing in, which I found far too risky. So I settled on another course of action and accepted that I would take it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thursday was two days away.{w} Every Thursday morning, an event would be held in the tower. That was the day I chose to step into the building for the second time and find the Sekimeiya that was surely confined inside.
entries.literal: "Thursday was two days away.{w} Every Thursday morning, an event would be held in the tower. That was the day I chose to step into the building for the second time and find the Sekimeiya that was surely confined inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to breathe properly. If I wasn't beaten to it, I only had one more day that I'd chosen to give myself, hopelessly refusing to let them end so soon.{w} And the very next one, I'd go to the tower in the morning and think about the best way to act. Then, I'd put that into effect that very night.
entries.literal: "I tried to breathe properly. If I wasn't beaten to it, I only had one more day that I'd chosen to give myself, hopelessly refusing to let them end so soon.{w} And the very next one, I'd go to the tower in the morning and think about the best way to act. Then, I'd put that into effect that very night."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What would the event be? I knew Atsuki had read the upcoming ones and said that only one seemed interesting in late January.
entries.literal: "What would the event be? I knew Atsuki had read the upcoming ones and said that only one seemed interesting in late January."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There, people will probably ask about the Sekimeiya. It might even be held in the event room.
entries.literal: "There, people will probably ask about the Sekimeiya. It might even be held in the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had bought entrance tickets for the 15th many days prior, but when we'd waited in the lobby, I'd heard people trying to buy them at the reception desk. They'd all been sold out, but if you could buy the tickets directly there, it was probably common to do so on the day of less important events.
entries.literal: "We had bought entrance tickets for the 15th many days prior, but when we'd waited in the lobby, I'd heard people trying to buy them at the reception desk. They'd all been sold out, but if you could buy the tickets directly there, it was probably common to do so on the day of less important events."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And if there are none left, I'll just pay for a normal visit. Joining whatever special event will happen isn't essential.
entries.literal: "And if there are none left, I'll just pay for a normal visit. Joining whatever special event will happen isn't essential."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to stop staring ahead. The strong wind kept whipping snow into my face, and prickling pains chipped at the corners of my eyes.
entries.literal: "I had to stop staring ahead. The strong wind kept whipping snow into my face, and prickling pains chipped at the corners of my eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Scanning the ground, I took the path that circled Yushibana.
entries.literal: "Scanning the ground, I took the path that circled Yushibana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The way wasn't perfectly even, and traversing the dense snow was difficult. I had to take the next path leading down, but I couldn't easily see it in the distance due to its identical color.
entries.literal: "The way wasn't perfectly even, and traversing the dense snow was difficult. I had to take the next path leading down, but I couldn't easily see it in the distance due to its identical color."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My stomach was demanding food, and the cold was becoming too prominent to bear. Protecting my head with my hood, I advanced steadily, knowing where I was headed for once.
entries.literal: "My stomach was demanding food, and the cold was becoming too prominent to bear. Protecting my head with my hood, I advanced steadily, knowing where I was headed for once."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was close to home. Even though I was going slow, I knew there wasn't much distance between both trails down.
entries.literal: "I was close to home. Even though I was going slow, I knew there wasn't much distance between both trails down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been glancing up here and there, but it was hard to recognize the narrow entrance to Yushibana I was going toward.
entries.literal: "I'd been glancing up here and there, but it was hard to recognize the narrow entrance to Yushibana I was going toward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At last, I saw the absence of brown at my right.{w} As I thought, it extended all the way down, leading to a dirt road close to my home.
entries.literal: "At last, I saw the absence of brown at my right.{w} As I thought, it extended all the way down, leading to a dirt road close to my home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped down the steep path, careful not to trip. Slowly, I descended until there was concrete below the snow and composed myself. The wind was noticeably weaker closer to the ground, so I raised my head again.
entries.literal: "I stepped down the steep path, careful not to trip. Slowly, I descended until there was concrete below the snow and composed myself. The wind was noticeably weaker closer to the ground, so I raised my head again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The narrow path soon became a sidewalk where a couple of cars were parked. Like I'd seen from above, nobody seemed to be on the outskirts.
entries.literal: "The narrow path soon became a sidewalk where a couple of cars were parked. Like I'd seen from above, nobody seemed to be on the outskirts."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was less than two minutes away from home. My apartment was one block farther, but I had to walk a bit.
entries.literal: "I was less than two minutes away from home. My apartment was one block farther, but I had to walk a bit."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is someone behind me again?
entries.literal: "Is someone behind me again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see the metallic staircase far ahead, but I debated whether to stop.
entries.literal: "I could see the metallic staircase far ahead, but I debated whether to stop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No, yesterday that didn't work. They'll just run away.
entries.literal: "No, yesterday that didn't work. They'll just run away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I pass by my apartment? What if they want to know where I live?
entries.literal: "Should I pass by my apartment? What if they want to know where I live?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started to feel a little nervous. Had I actually felt someone behind me once more, or was it paranoia...? I just needed to go home.{w} I looked by my feet.
entries.literal: "I started to feel a little nervous. Had I actually felt someone behind me once more, or was it paranoia...? I just needed to go home.{w} I looked by my feet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could circle this block, and if new footsteps are here when I'm back, I'll know I'm not making anything up.
entries.literal: "I could circle this block, and if new footsteps are here when I'm back, I'll know I'm not making anything up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't change my pace, but I avoided even looking at my apartment. I'd just made a very important decision, but I felt indecisive again.
entries.literal: "I didn't change my pace, but I avoided even looking at my apartment. I'd just made a very important decision, but I felt indecisive again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even if I confirm that I'm right, what would I do? ...Ignore it?
entries.literal: "Even if I confirm that I'm right, what would I do? ...Ignore it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'd have to go home anyway.
entries.literal: "I'd have to go home anyway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Up ahead, the only way to see my back would be from directly behind me. If I suddenly turn around at the end and someone is watching me, I should see them as well.
entries.literal: "Up ahead, the only way to see my back would be from directly behind me. If I suddenly turn around at the end and someone is watching me, I should see them as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I bit my lip and kept walking. I couldn't make any motions that indicated I thought someone was behind me or they'd be able to escape again. If someone was there, I just needed to know who it was.
entries.literal: "I bit my lip and kept walking. I couldn't make any motions that indicated I thought someone was behind me or they'd be able to escape again. If someone was there, I just needed to know who it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I managed to feel a bit of sweat forming on my palms despite the overwhelming cold. Depending on who it was, I might have had to act sooner than I expected.
entries.literal: "I managed to feel a bit of sweat forming on my palms despite the overwhelming cold. Depending on who it was, I might have had to act sooner than I expected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had passed my apartment. If someone was really looking at me, would the curtain of snow conceal them? If they turned fast enough, identifying them would likely be impossible.
entries.literal: "I had passed my apartment. If someone was really looking at me, would the curtain of snow conceal them? If they turned fast enough, identifying them would likely be impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I was close to the end of the street, where it curved into another one. If someone was watching me from behind at that moment, they had to be in eyeshot.
entries.literal: "...{w}I was close to the end of the street, where it curved into another one. If someone was watching me from behind at that moment, they had to be in eyeshot."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I instinctively turned around before I'd planned.
entries.literal: "But I instinctively turned around before I'd planned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A sudden sound had broken the silence far behind me. And as I'd feared, the falling snow was blurring the image.
entries.literal: "A sudden sound had broken the silence far behind me. And as I'd feared, the falling snow was blurring the image."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Frowning, I sprinted back the way I'd come, toward a blue smudge way ahead.
entries.literal: "Frowning, I sprinted back the way I'd come, toward a blue smudge way ahead."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that...?
entries.literal: "Is that...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It immediately became visible. It was a police officer.{w} ...But that wasn't all, so I didn't stop.
entries.literal: "It immediately became visible. It was a police officer.{w} ...But that wasn't all, so I didn't stop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before getting there, I understood what had happened. Next to the officer was a police car, and they'd just closed the back door after making someone else get in.
entries.literal: "Before getting there, I understood what had happened. Next to the officer was a police car, and they'd just closed the back door after making someone else get in."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Oh...! ...What's wrong?
entries.literal: "Oh...! ...What's wrong?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I panted breathlessly, my hands on my knees. A sudden dizziness invaded me, almost causing me to fall.
entries.literal: "I panted breathlessly, my hands on my knees. A sudden dizziness invaded me, almost causing me to fall."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Are you okay...?
entries.literal: "Are you okay...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded and slowly looked up. Instead of responding, I stared at the window of the car. The glass was tinted, so I couldn't see the interior of the vehicle.
entries.literal: "I nodded and slowly looked up. Instead of responding, I stared at the window of the car. The glass was tinted, so I couldn't see the interior of the vehicle."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: S-Sorry, did you just arrest someone?
entries.literal: "S-Sorry, did you just arrest someone?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Hm? Yes. What's the matter?
entries.literal: "Hm? Yes. What's the matter?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}I... was feeling like someone was following me just now. Could it have been this person?
entries.literal: "...{w}I... was feeling like someone was following me just now. Could it have been this person?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The man frowned and took out a tiny scrapbook.
entries.literal: "The man frowned and took out a tiny scrapbook."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: What's your name?
entries.literal: "What's your name?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Mine...?{w} ...It's Shiroya Mirana.
entries.literal: "Mine...?{w} ...It's Shiroya Mirana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked at me and silently wrote on the paper.{w} Then, he suddenly smiled, completely shifting his expression.
entries.literal: "He looked at me and silently wrote on the paper.{w} Then, he suddenly smiled, completely shifting his expression."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I see. You can stop worrying, then. If you think you were being followed, there's nothing to be afraid of.
entries.literal: "I see. You can stop worrying, then. If you think you were being followed, there's nothing to be afraid of."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh-What...? Can you let me see their face?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? Can you let me see their face?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked at the black window.
entries.literal: "He looked at the black window."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: No. I'm not allowed to do that.
entries.literal: "No. I'm not allowed to do that."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What about their name or the reason for arresting them?
entries.literal: "...What about their name or the reason for arresting them?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: You can stop worrying—believe me. Right now, I'm not allowed to tell you any of that, but just wait for when it's made public.
entries.literal: "You can stop worrying—believe me. Right now, I'm not allowed to tell you any of that, but just wait for when it's made public."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to produce some way of coercing him into telling me more, but I couldn't come up with anything.
entries.literal: "I tried to produce some way of coercing him into telling me more, but I couldn't come up with anything."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I have to hurry. Don't hesitate to contact us if you feel you're being followed again, but I don't think you'll be having any more problems.
entries.literal: "I have to hurry. Don't hesitate to contact us if you feel you're being followed again, but I don't think you'll be having any more problems."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.literal: "...Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The man nodded with a sympathetic smile and opened the door to the driver side, quickly shutting it again. Then, the car began to move and soon disappeared toward the direction I'd just run from.
entries.literal: "The man nodded with a sympathetic smile and opened the door to the driver side, quickly shutting it again. Then, the car began to move and soon disappeared toward the direction I'd just run from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked by my feet. The tire marks came from far away, and next to them was a group of footprints.
entries.literal: "I looked by my feet. The tire marks came from far away, and next to them was a group of footprints."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: These are mine. I looked at the ground earlier specifically for this.{w} ...And these were definitely not here before.
entries.literal: "These are mine. I looked at the ground earlier specifically for this.{w} ...And these were definitely not here before."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They're the policeman's, though.
entries.literal: "They're the policeman's, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept looking down, trying to find a third pair of footprints.
entries.literal: "I kept looking down, trying to find a third pair of footprints."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There had to be a third pair right there, but I suddenly remembered the strange smile the officer had. Something felt odd about him.
entries.literal: "There had to be a third pair right there, but I suddenly remembered the strange smile the officer had. Something felt odd about him."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, these.
entries.literal: "Wait, these."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After taking a few steps forward, I noticed the trail of footprints coming from the same direction as the tire tracks.
entries.literal: "After taking a few steps forward, I noticed the trail of footprints coming from the same direction as the tire tracks."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It must be these since they end where the car was.{w} They also resemble the ones I saw yesterday.
entries.literal: "It must be these since they end where the car was.{w} They also resemble the ones I saw yesterday."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept following them in reverse, hoping they would lead somewhere. However, I immediately realized that wouldn't work.{w} The more I walked, the more the footprints faded due to the falling snow. Soon, I could hardly even make out their shape.
entries.literal: "I kept following them in reverse, hoping they would lead somewhere. However, I immediately realized that wouldn't work.{w} The more I walked, the more the footprints faded due to the falling snow. Soon, I could hardly even make out their shape."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I was right.
entries.literal: "...I was right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped myself, stress and relief pulling me from both sides.
entries.literal: "I stopped myself, stress and relief pulling me from both sides."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The person who was following me was arrested... Maybe I was right that they were someone else who traveled from the 15th. Depending on what happened, just that alone could've led to their arrest.
entries.literal: "The person who was following me was arrested... Maybe I was right that they were someone else who traveled from the 15th. Depending on what happened, just that alone could've led to their arrest."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What mattered was that someone who potentially wanted to steal the Sekimeiya was out of the picture. Being able to feel a little calmer in that regard was immensely beneficial.
entries.literal: "What mattered was that someone who potentially wanted to steal the Sekimeiya was out of the picture. Being able to feel a little calmer in that regard was immensely beneficial."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And he said that their identity would be made public. When's that gonna be, though? Assuming everything up until the 15th repeats itself, it won't be before that day, right? Otherwise, someone who went to the tower would've known a future self of theirs had been arrested.
entries.literal: "...And he said that their identity would be made public. When's that gonna be, though? Assuming everything up until the 15th repeats itself, it won't be before that day, right? Otherwise, someone who went to the tower would've known a future self of theirs had been arrested."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to think, but it seemed someone had really identified me and been following me. Added to their arrest, assuming that they'd traveled from the future seemed the most likely scenario.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to think, but it seemed someone had really identified me and been following me. Added to their arrest, assuming that they'd traveled from the future seemed the most likely scenario."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around. My apartment was right there.
entries.literal: "I turned around. My apartment was right there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could barely keep myself standing anymore. I approached the staircase while I grabbed the keys and staggered my way to the front door.
entries.literal: "I could barely keep myself standing anymore. I approached the staircase while I grabbed the keys and staggered my way to the front door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lightly shook off the snow on me and turned the key clockwise.
entries.literal: "I lightly shook off the snow on me and turned the key clockwise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...How long had the heater been on? The change in temperature was more drastic than it had ever been.
entries.literal: "...How long had the heater been on? The change in temperature was more drastic than it had ever been."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hurriedly closed the door and left my coat and boots behind. I wanted to drop to the floor, but I managed to make it to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "I hurriedly closed the door and left my coat and boots behind. I wanted to drop to the floor, but I managed to make it to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew I still had the instant noodles I'd bought, so I grabbed the bowl I'd used last time, then washed and filled a pot.
entries.literal: "I knew I still had the instant noodles I'd bought, so I grabbed the bowl I'd used last time, then washed and filled a pot."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once the water began to boil, I dropped the noodles in and watched them slowly spread out.
entries.literal: "Once the water began to boil, I dropped the noodles in and watched them slowly spread out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It would take three minutes to cook. Meanwhile, I sipped water and tried to compose myself.
entries.literal: "It would take three minutes to cook. Meanwhile, I sipped water and tried to compose myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't been able to eat in the tower, and I'd kept going for hours and hours there, but the cold outside in wintertime Yushibana was a real problem for me. I kept underestimating the importance of a reasonable surrounding temperature.
entries.literal: "I hadn't been able to eat in the tower, and I'd kept going for hours and hours there, but the cold outside in wintertime Yushibana was a real problem for me. I kept underestimating the importance of a reasonable surrounding temperature."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone following me had only thrown me further into disarray. I couldn't put into words why I'd felt again that they'd been watching me, but it was possible their goal had really been to learn where I lived. I was far beyond the point of assuming they only wanted to confirm who I was.
entries.literal: "Someone following me had only thrown me further into disarray. I couldn't put into words why I'd felt again that they'd been watching me, but it was possible their goal had really been to learn where I lived. I was far beyond the point of assuming they only wanted to confirm who I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I removed most of the water from the pot and dropped the noodles in the bowl, garnishing it as I had before. The meal looked pretty ordinary, but I eagerly brought it to the living room.
entries.literal: "I removed most of the water from the pot and dropped the noodles in the bowl, garnishing it as I had before. The meal looked pretty ordinary, but I eagerly brought it to the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ate some. They were hot and a bit stiff, but I kept going.
entries.literal: "I ate some. They were hot and a bit stiff, but I kept going."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I eventually slowed down. Curiously, I took out the phone from my purse and looked at the time.
entries.literal: "I eventually slowed down. Curiously, I took out the phone from my purse and looked at the time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: {time=16} already... I was outside for so many hours.
entries.literal: "{time=16} already... I was outside for so many hours."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The person who was just arrested... Could they have been from Xyn?{w} If so, that's a new occurrence, because we were told that no members had been caught yet.
entries.literal: "The person who was just arrested... Could they have been from Xyn?{w} If so, that's a new occurrence, because we were told that no members had been caught yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were they someone I'd been with in the tower? ...It was frustrating that I hadn't been able to see their face.
entries.literal: "Were they someone I'd been with in the tower? ...It was frustrating that I hadn't been able to see their face."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I figured there was no point in getting hung up on it, so I kept eating as I thought back on what was most important.
entries.literal: "I figured there was no point in getting hung up on it, so I kept eating as I thought back on what was most important."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It'll be Thursday in just two days... I'm giving myself tomorrow to enjoy, but I'm not sure that's what I want anymore. I'll probably just be nervous all day.
entries.literal: "It'll be Thursday in just two days... I'm giving myself tomorrow to enjoy, but I'm not sure that's what I want anymore. I'll probably just be nervous all day."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On Thursday morning... finding the Sekimeiya and checking the door in the storeroom shouldn't take too long. After that, there are more important matters.
entries.literal: "On Thursday morning... finding the Sekimeiya and checking the door in the storeroom shouldn't take too long. After that, there are more important matters."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'll change the past drastically for the first time by going to Atsuki's house and taking the tickets we bought.{w} Later, I can go to Isla's house and either attempt to talk with whoever her friend really is or try to prevent them from going on the 15th in the same way.
entries.literal: "I'll change the past drastically for the first time by going to Atsuki's house and taking the tickets we bought.{w} Later, I can go to Isla's house and either attempt to talk with whoever her friend really is or try to prevent them from going on the 15th in the same way."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That could be really important, because if I get caught by the police or I'm not able to find the Sekimeiya, at least I'll guarantee that the four of us don't go to the event.
entries.literal: "That could be really important, because if I get caught by the police or I'm not able to find the Sekimeiya, at least I'll guarantee that the four of us don't go to the event."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not too sure what would happen then. It's pretty likely the two initial groups to get trapped would merely consist of different people, but I can't do anything about that.
entries.literal: "I'm not too sure what would happen then. It's pretty likely the two initial groups to get trapped would merely consist of different people, but I can't do anything about that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd entirely cleaned out the bowl, so I brought it to the kitchen and picked up a pair of cereal bars.
entries.literal: "I'd entirely cleaned out the bowl, so I brought it to the kitchen and picked up a pair of cereal bars."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I had a thought I hadn't fully considered before.
entries.literal: "Then, I had a thought I hadn't fully considered before."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could this be a bad idea...?
entries.literal: "Could this be a bad idea...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Assuming I'm not able to find the Sekimeiya in the tower, should I really try to prevent any of us from going there? That might screw it all up.
entries.literal: "Assuming I'm not able to find the Sekimeiya in the tower, should I really try to prevent any of us from going there? That might screw it all up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right now, the 15th is the failsafe in case I can't find the Sekimeiya beforehand. If I let everything repeat, I'll be able to touch it again on that day.{w} Hell, I could see where the recorder even came from, or even stay there for a month, depending on whether it's real or not.
entries.literal: "Right now, the 15th is the failsafe in case I can't find the Sekimeiya beforehand. If I let everything repeat, I'll be able to touch it again on that day.{w} Hell, I could see where the recorder even came from, or even stay there for a month, depending on whether it's real or not."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But if Atsuki, Isla, Erina, and I don't go to the event, it will all be considerably different.{w} What if something causes the attack to fail?{w} What if Katei and Ashiya are able to unlock the exit this time?
entries.literal: "But if Atsuki, Isla, Erina, and I don't go to the event, it will all be considerably different.{w} What if something causes the attack to fail?{w} What if Katei and Ashiya are able to unlock the exit this time?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That would get rid of the only guaranteed time where getting the Sekimeiya again will be possible.{w} So, if I don't find it anywhere on Thursday, maybe waiting until the 15th is the best call.
entries.literal: "That would get rid of the only guaranteed time where getting the Sekimeiya again will be possible.{w} So, if I don't find it anywhere on Thursday, maybe waiting until the 15th is the best call."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I discarded that idea at the start of all this for a reason. If I let the incident happen like it once did, where really is the proof that the past can change? It would mean that the version of myself Atsuki saw really was just me in the future.
entries.literal: "I discarded that idea at the start of all this for a reason. If I let the incident happen like it once did, where really is the proof that the past can change? It would mean that the version of myself Atsuki saw really was just me in the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But that's not the case anymore. This is what I hadn't considered yet.
entries.literal: "But that's not the case anymore. This is what I hadn't considered yet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I don't change anything else until the 15th and everything actually repeats, I won't have to enter the tower again.
entries.literal: "If I don't change anything else until the 15th and everything actually repeats, I won't have to enter the tower again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now I know something very important. At close to {time=16}, a very long travel took place, and it reached through the walls of the tower...{w} Could I place myself in that range, or would I be arrested?
entries.literal: "Now I know something very important. At close to {time=16}, a very long travel took place, and it reached through the walls of the tower...{w} Could I place myself in that range, or would I be arrested?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even though everyone close to the building will know that someone with my name is inside, would they recognize my face? All I'd have to do would be spot Vaisude and get very close to him at {time=16.}
entries.literal: "Even though everyone close to the building will know that someone with my name is inside, would they recognize my face? All I'd have to do would be spot Vaisude and get very close to him at {time=16.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That would make me travel to the 24th of November. This would be the best possible outcome.{w} I'd make it far enough to be the first person to find the Sekimeiya in the mountains, stop all of this at the source, and save everyone.
entries.literal: "That would make me travel to the 24th of November. This would be the best possible outcome.{w} I'd make it far enough to be the first person to find the Sekimeiya in the mountains, stop all of this at the source, and save everyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Exploring what to do those days seemed like a foolish dream, but I thought about it for a bit. I'd been living in my apartment on the 24th, so if I actually wanted to go that far back, I'd have to seriously plan it out.
entries.literal: "Exploring what to do those days seemed like a foolish dream, but I thought about it for a bit. I'd been living in my apartment on the 24th, so if I actually wanted to go that far back, I'd have to seriously plan it out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It sounded great in concept, but I couldn't help but think it was an impossible avenue.
entries.literal: "It sounded great in concept, but I couldn't help but think it was an impossible avenue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How would I get close to Vaisude without getting arrested? I could call him again to more accurately determine the time he'd traveled, but it was unlikely it would be that precise.
entries.literal: "How would I get close to Vaisude without getting arrested? I could call him again to more accurately determine the time he'd traveled, but it was unlikely it would be that precise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still had no idea why we'd found two Naomis, but I hated the idea of letting that repeat even if I'd be letting it happen again so that I could stop it later. In addition, even though it seemed like a given, I couldn't assume that large travel would still happen.
entries.literal: "I still had no idea why we'd found two Naomis, but I hated the idea of letting that repeat even if I'd be letting it happen again so that I could stop it later. In addition, even though it seemed like a given, I couldn't assume that large travel would still happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't think Vaisude had lied, but I'd somewhat changed history when I'd called my mom, and I didn't know what extra changes that implied. Furthermore, I had no idea if someone else would change the past differently; the butterfly effect could've easily prevented the {time=16} travel from happening.
entries.literal: "I didn't think Vaisude had lied, but I'd somewhat changed history when I'd called my mom, and I didn't know what extra changes that implied. Furthermore, I had no idea if someone else would change the past differently; the butterfly effect could've easily prevented the {time=16} travel from happening."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If that was the case, would the Vaisude I'd spoken to exist in the world I was in? While I couldn't answer that, I was inclined to think that he would, and that his travel would merely not repeat due to the change.
entries.literal: "If that was the case, would the Vaisude I'd spoken to exist in the world I was in? While I couldn't answer that, I was inclined to think that he would, and that his travel would merely not repeat due to the change."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened my eyes after a while. I saw the familiar ceiling I'd been staring at before, but the illumination had slightly changed.
entries.literal: "I opened my eyes after a while. I saw the familiar ceiling I'd been staring at before, but the illumination had slightly changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Turning to the window, I noticed the sun was setting.
entries.literal: "Turning to the window, I noticed the sun was setting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had been going to sleep very early, so I was pretty tired. However, there was something I had to do that I didn't want to leave for the next day.{w} I'd been yawning and stretching on the floor, but I felt I had a bit of time before going to bed.
entries.literal: "I had been going to sleep very early, so I was pretty tired. However, there was something I had to do that I didn't want to leave for the next day.{w} I'd been yawning and stretching on the floor, but I felt I had a bit of time before going to bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since doing it on Thursday might have been a bad idea, I stood up and went to the entrance.
entries.literal: "Since doing it on Thursday might have been a bad idea, I stood up and went to the entrance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sky had gotten a lot darker, and the icy air almost changed my mind.{w} I quickly put my coat and boots back on, checked that everything was in my purse, and stepped out after turning off the lights.
entries.literal: "The sky had gotten a lot darker, and the icy air almost changed my mind.{w} I quickly put my coat and boots back on, checked that everything was in my purse, and stepped out after turning off the lights."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Snow was still falling, but it was much lighter, like in the morning. I wondered whether to turn back to grab an umbrella, but I didn't intend to be out for too long, and it didn't seem like the snow was picking up at all.
entries.literal: "Snow was still falling, but it was much lighter, like in the morning. I wondered whether to turn back to grab an umbrella, but I didn't intend to be out for too long, and it didn't seem like the snow was picking up at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went down the stairs and began to walk. ...I looked at the ground, where neither the tire tracks nor the footprints were visible anymore.
entries.literal: "I went down the stairs and began to walk. ...I looked at the ground, where neither the tire tracks nor the footprints were visible anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was remarkable how different the periphery was compared to the center of the town. After some minutes, I'd only seen a handful of people quietly wandering with an umbrella, but the many lit windows all around gave away the presence of life.
entries.literal: "It was remarkable how different the periphery was compared to the center of the town. After some minutes, I'd only seen a handful of people quietly wandering with an umbrella, but the many lit windows all around gave away the presence of life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached the lonely crosswalk leading to Ramon and saw the wide street ahead, illuminated by many faint streetlights. Home to many stores, it looked like an entrance to a different town, its wet stone occupied with passersby.
entries.literal: "I reached the lonely crosswalk leading to Ramon and saw the wide street ahead, illuminated by many faint streetlights. Home to many stores, it looked like an entrance to a different town, its wet stone occupied with passersby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's late, but I think it should be open...
entries.literal: "It's late, but I think it should be open..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued up the path, waiting for my destination to come into sight. While I'd never entered it, I recalled seeing it open at that hour.
entries.literal: "I continued up the path, waiting for my destination to come into sight. While I'd never entered it, I recalled seeing it open at that hour."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It should be that.
entries.literal: "...It should be that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ahead and still in Ramon was what looked like a blue storefront with white letters above it. It read "Ishimaru".
entries.literal: "Ahead and still in Ramon was what looked like a blue storefront with white letters above it. It read \"Ishimaru\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood in front of its door. The interior was lit, and a woman was sitting behind a transparent wall. Nonetheless, I felt a bit reluctant to step in.
entries.literal: "I stood in front of its door. The interior was lit, and a woman was sitting behind a transparent wall. Nonetheless, I felt a bit reluctant to step in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was something about the situation that felt too surreal. I couldn't feel bad about myself, though, because what I was doing was a necessary step.
entries.literal: "There was something about the situation that felt too surreal. I couldn't feel bad about myself, though, because what I was doing was a necessary step."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pulled the door open and entered the small space, protected from the cold once more. The woman smiled warmly at me as I approached.
entries.literal: "I pulled the door open and entered the small space, protected from the cold once more. The woman smiled warmly at me as I approached."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Good afternoon. You'd like to try your luck?
entries.literal: "Good afternoon. You'd like to try your luck?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.literal: "...Yeah."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Perfect. Have you come here before? I don't think you have.
entries.literal: "Perfect. Have you come here before? I don't think you have."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...No, I have. I came a while ago, but I'd forgotten to check if I'd won anything until now.
entries.literal: "...No, I have. I came a while ago, but I'd forgotten to check if I'd won anything until now."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Ah, I see. What would you like, then?
entries.literal: "Ah, I see. What would you like, then?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about how to phrase the few questions I had.
entries.literal: "I thought about how to phrase the few questions I had."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: The number I had was for December 1st, I believe. I wonder, by the way, how long would it be valid for?
entries.literal: "The number I had was for December 1st, I believe. I wonder, by the way, how long would it be valid for?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Oh, it's still valid, don't worry. They last a whole year.{w} Anyway, December 1st? Let me see.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's still valid, don't worry. They last a whole year.{w} Anyway, December 1st? Let me see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't been sure what day to say, but I hadn't wanted to ask for the previous day's. If I went back to November, I'd change the past in a considerable way. Then, the butterfly effect could affect what I was doing.{w} I knew each digit of a winning lottery number was manually drawn every time, so if I changed the past and made it back to the same day, it was entirely possible the latest winning number would differ. A mere millisecond of difference could result in a different draw. I'd chosen December 1st because it was the next day after Miiya's death, and I didn't know how far back I'd end up being able to go.
entries.literal: "I hadn't been sure what day to say, but I hadn't wanted to ask for the previous day's. If I went back to November, I'd change the past in a considerable way. Then, the butterfly effect could affect what I was doing.{w} I knew each digit of a winning lottery number was manually drawn every time, so if I changed the past and made it back to the same day, it was entirely possible the latest winning number would differ. A mere millisecond of difference could result in a different draw. I'd chosen December 1st because it was the next day after Miiya's death, and I didn't know how far back I'd end up being able to go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After looking at a computer screen for a few seconds, the woman voiced a number.
entries.literal: "After looking at a computer screen for a few seconds, the woman voiced a number."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: December 1st... I'm assuming you bought a standard Lotus-6 combination, correct?
entries.literal: "December 1st... I'm assuming you bought a standard Lotus-6 combination, correct?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: On December 1st, the number drawn was 30-05-12-31-15-26, and the bonus number was 24.
entries.literal: "On December 1st, the number drawn was 30-05-12-31-15-26, and the bonus number was 24."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Ah, I don't think that was it. It would've been great to win on the first attempt.
entries.literal: "...Ah, I don't think that was it. It would've been great to win on the first attempt."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Do you have the ticket? You might've won one of the secondary prizes if any of the last numbers coincide.
entries.literal: "Do you have the ticket? You might've won one of the secondary prizes if any of the last numbers coincide."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I didn't bring it, no. I'm sure none match, though.
entries.literal: "...I didn't bring it, no. I'm sure none match, though."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I see. That's unfortunate.{w} Do you want to try again?
entries.literal: "I see. That's unfortunate.{w} Do you want to try again?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Maybe. I have a couple questions, though. I've always been curious about this.
entries.literal: "Maybe. I have a couple questions, though. I've always been curious about this."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Would I be able to ask for a specific number that I want?
entries.literal: "Would I be able to ask for a specific number that I want?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Yes, that's possible. We tend to sell packs of five different combinations, but you can also choose the numbers you want if it's what you prefer.
entries.literal: "Yes, that's possible. We tend to sell packs of five different combinations, but you can also choose the numbers you want if it's what you prefer."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: All right.{w} How much would I have won if all the digits matched?
entries.literal: "All right.{w} How much would I have won if all the digits matched?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Let me see...{w} The main prize money of December 1st was ¥917,999,011.{w} It's even higher now. Nobody's won the jackpot in a while.
entries.literal: "Let me see...{w} The main prize money of December 1st was ¥917,999,011.{w} It's even higher now. Nobody's won the jackpot in a while."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh, wow. I'm not sure what I'd do with so much money.
entries.literal: "Oh, wow. I'm not sure what I'd do with so much money."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Some people say it's unlucky to win that much. It has ruined people's lives.
entries.literal: "Some people say it's unlucky to win that much. It has ruined people's lives."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah, I would be very overwhelmed.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I would be very overwhelmed."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I don't remember: how much does buying a number cost?
entries.literal: "I don't remember: how much does buying a number cost?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: It's just ¥200.
entries.literal: "It's just ¥200."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I see. ...Is it possible to buy a number that will be played the same day you buy it?
entries.literal: "I see. ...Is it possible to buy a number that will be played the same day you buy it?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Yes, but only before {time=17.} You don't have to worry about this today since the next Lotus-6 will be held on the 5th, this Thursday.
entries.literal: "Yes, but only before {time=17.} You don't have to worry about this today since the next Lotus-6 will be held on the 5th, this Thursday."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Ah, I understand. I think I'll come back, then. I'd like to think about the number I want.
entries.literal: "Ah, I understand. I think I'll come back, then. I'd like to think about the number I want."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: That's perfectly fine. I hope you're right on the mark.
entries.literal: "That's perfectly fine. I hope you're right on the mark."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Me too.{w} I'm sorry for having so many questions, but if I won, would my identity have to be revealed?
entries.literal: "Me too.{w} I'm sorry for having so many questions, but if I won, would my identity have to be revealed?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Oh, no, Japanese law doesn't enforce that.
entries.literal: "Oh, no, Japanese law doesn't enforce that."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...And how long would I have to wait to receive the money?
entries.literal: "...And how long would I have to wait to receive the money?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: No more than two weeks. You'd be able to choose whether to receive the full amount at once or monthly. You wouldn't have to worry about taxes, either.
entries.literal: "No more than two weeks. You'd be able to choose whether to receive the full amount at once or monthly. You wouldn't have to worry about taxes, either."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Thank you! I was always curious about this.
entries.literal: "Thank you! I was always curious about this."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I'm glad I could help. I'll see you next time.
entries.literal: "I'm glad I could help. I'll see you next time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I bowed and walked out.
entries.literal: "I bowed and walked out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I began to walk down the street, repeating the numbers mentally. While writing them down was a good idea, I had to ensure I could memorize them, because it was likely any written note would disappear if I traveled far to the past again, just like the knife had.
entries.literal: "I began to walk down the street, repeating the numbers mentally. While writing them down was a good idea, I had to ensure I could memorize them, because it was likely any written note would disappear if I traveled far to the past again, just like the knife had."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'll probably just get in big trouble. Within two weeks, I'd receive the money in my bank account, so I'd probably have to take out the money before the other me notices what happened...
entries.literal: "I'll probably just get in big trouble. Within two weeks, I'd receive the money in my bank account, so I'd probably have to take out the money before the other me notices what happened..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: For that, I'd have to duplicate my bank card or try to take it out of the other me's purse.{w} What would I do if I saw that so much money was added and immediately taken from my account? If it was investigated, security cameras would probably see me in the bank.
entries.literal: "For that, I'd have to duplicate my bank card or try to take it out of the other me's purse.{w} What would I do if I saw that so much money was added and immediately taken from my account? If it was investigated, security cameras would probably see me in the bank."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe not taking everything would be a good idea. If I leave a part for the other me, would she keep quiet...? I'm not sure what I would do myself in that situation, honestly.
entries.literal: "Maybe not taking everything would be a good idea. If I leave a part for the other me, would she keep quiet...? I'm not sure what I would do myself in that situation, honestly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could hardly take those thoughts seriously. ...Had I really assumed that I'd try to go live far away all by myself?
entries.literal: "I could hardly take those thoughts seriously. ...Had I really assumed that I'd try to go live far away all by myself?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She also said that she'd never seen me there before. I suppose that means that there currently is no me who bought that number after going to the past. Of course, that will only happen when history is greatly altered, so it isn't the case yet.
entries.literal: "She also said that she'd never seen me there before. I suppose that means that there currently is no me who bought that number after going to the past. Of course, that will only happen when history is greatly altered, so it isn't the case yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still felt a little unsure. Would the number stay the same if I changed the past even a little bit...?
entries.literal: "I still felt a little unsure. Would the number stay the same if I changed the past even a little bit...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On December 1st, I will already have changed the past. However, I guess that if I travel to days before the 30th, I'll be able to obtain the Sekimeiya myself and redo this in a way so that the past only changes when I buy the number. I guess the past wouldn't even have to change in that instance. Buying the ticket wouldn't contradict any previous experiences.
entries.literal: "On December 1st, I will already have changed the past. However, I guess that if I travel to days before the 30th, I'll be able to obtain the Sekimeiya myself and redo this in a way so that the past only changes when I buy the number. I guess the past wouldn't even have to change in that instance. Buying the ticket wouldn't contradict any previous experiences."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A bit of snow was still falling, but it was hard to see it without looking at the streetlights. Yawning as I went, I walked back over my own steps until I arrived at my apartment.
entries.literal: "A bit of snow was still falling, but it was hard to see it without looking at the streetlights. Yawning as I went, I walked back over my own steps until I arrived at my apartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped in, leaving my coat and boots behind as usual. I thought of trying to eat something else, but I was too tired to bother, and nothing I had was appetizing anyway.
entries.literal: "I stepped in, leaving my coat and boots behind as usual. I thought of trying to eat something else, but I was too tired to bother, and nothing I had was appetizing anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I changed into the same nightwear and turned off the light in the entrance.
entries.literal: "I changed into the same nightwear and turned off the light in the entrance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a piece of paper and a pen out of a drawer. Just in case, I wrote down the winning combination.
entries.literal: "I took a piece of paper and a pen out of a drawer. Just in case, I wrote down the winning combination."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After that, I straightened up my blankets and buried myself underneath them, leaving my phone by the side of my bed.
entries.literal: "After that, I straightened up my blankets and buried myself underneath them, leaving my phone by the side of my bed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Mom hasn't tried to call me again. I wonder what happened with that.
entries.literal: "...Mom hasn't tried to call me again. I wonder what happened with that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I found myself comfortably lying on my soft mattress while another version of myself was suffering in the hospital.
entries.literal: "Once again, I found myself comfortably lying on my soft mattress while another version of myself was suffering in the hospital."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moreso felt bad for the me I was, who only had two last opportunities to appreciate the touch of that old bed.
entries.literal: "I moreso felt bad for the me I was, who only had two last opportunities to appreciate the touch of that old bed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What was it?
entries.literal: "...What was it?"

entries.speaker: i
