entries.text: I felt my head hurt a bit, but I tried to recall the winning combination before looking at the bedside table.
entries.literal: "I felt my head hurt a bit, but I tried to recall the winning combination before looking at the bedside table."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt like I'd only slept for the blink of an eye, as I vividly remembered the thoughts I'd had in the evening. I looked up, still covering my eyes with the bed sheets.
entries.literal: "I felt like I'd only slept for the blink of an eye, as I vividly remembered the thoughts I'd had in the evening. I looked up, still covering my eyes with the bed sheets."

entries.text: Saving Reverie
entries.literal: "Saving Reverie"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I shuffled the blankets aside. I'd gotten too used to the feeling of waking up to a warm room. It was almost more pleasant than being covered in softness.
entries.literal: "...I shuffled the blankets aside. I'd gotten too used to the feeling of waking up to a warm room. It was almost more pleasant than being covered in softness."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to spend a long time in bed, so I pushed myself to get up.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to spend a long time in bed, so I pushed myself to get up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I raised the blinds, filling the bedroom with light. Behind the glass was the still image of a white Yushibana with the sun already up.
entries.literal: "I raised the blinds, filling the bedroom with light. Behind the glass was the still image of a white Yushibana with the sun already up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The snow had ceased during the night, and a bit of fog was all that remained, especially prominent in the distant mountains. It was a beautiful and peaceful thing to see, but I felt some deep strain as well.
entries.literal: "The snow had ceased during the night, and a bit of fog was all that remained, especially prominent in the distant mountains. It was a beautiful and peaceful thing to see, but I felt some deep strain as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My phone showed {time=9:57.} I had no plans for the day, but it was a very special one. Like usual, I stepped to the bathroom and rubbed my eyes.
entries.literal: "My phone showed {time=9:57.} I had no plans for the day, but it was a very special one. Like usual, I stepped to the bathroom and rubbed my eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still had two cereal bars left. I tossed the wrappers in the trash and started to eat them as I tiredly stretched my arms.
entries.literal: "I still had two cereal bars left. I tossed the wrappers in the trash and started to eat them as I tiredly stretched my arms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been nervously pacing as I ate them and stopped myself as soon as I realized it.{w} I didn't have anything to do, and repeatedly going over the same thoughts was only stressful. I'd decided to spend my final free day in as relaxing of a manner as I could manage, but I couldn't let myself keep worrying about losing precious time.
entries.literal: "I'd been nervously pacing as I ate them and stopped myself as soon as I realized it.{w} I didn't have anything to do, and repeatedly going over the same thoughts was only stressful. I'd decided to spend my final free day in as relaxing of a manner as I could manage, but I couldn't let myself keep worrying about losing precious time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went back to my bedroom and looked at the wardrobe to pick something to change into.
entries.literal: "I went back to my bedroom and looked at the wardrobe to pick something to change into."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at what I had. I'd been selecting random clothes for the past few days, but I found myself thinking a little harder about it.{w} I had a blue hoodie that I really liked in mind, but I couldn't find it, so I ended up grabbing a long-sleeved orange shirt instead.
entries.literal: "I stared at what I had. I'd been selecting random clothes for the past few days, but I found myself thinking a little harder about it.{w} I had a blue hoodie that I really liked in mind, but I couldn't find it, so I ended up grabbing a long-sleeved orange shirt instead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My laundry basket was nearly full. The previous day's clothes were there, and it had been a while since I'd washed them.
entries.literal: "My laundry basket was nearly full. The previous day's clothes were there, and it had been a while since I'd washed them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Doing the laundry most certainly didn't matter anymore, but I dragged the basket to the kitchen nonetheless. The washing machine was there, next to another basket which was close to full.
entries.literal: "Doing the laundry most certainly didn't matter anymore, but I dragged the basket to the kitchen nonetheless. The washing machine was there, next to another basket which was close to full."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tended to prioritize washing what I left in my bedroom, but I still had the blue hoodie in mind, so I rifled through both piles.
entries.literal: "I tended to prioritize washing what I left in my bedroom, but I still had the blue hoodie in mind, so I rifled through both piles."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't able to find it with a cursory inspection, but I didn't want to empty both baskets just for that, so I began to fill the washer.
entries.literal: "I wasn't able to find it with a cursory inspection, but I didn't want to empty both baskets just for that, so I began to fill the washer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The machine wasn't too spacious, so I could only pick out part of the basket. Once I'd filled it with the top half, I pushed the round door shut and poured in a bit of laundry detergent.
entries.literal: "The machine wasn't too spacious, so I could only pick out part of the basket. Once I'd filled it with the top half, I pushed the round door shut and poured in a bit of laundry detergent."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had a number of clothes at home that I'd accumulated throughout the years, but since they were all on the cheap side, I didn't trust using hot water. When I pressed the big blue button, "30:00" appeared in red digits on the screen and began to count down.
entries.literal: "I had a number of clothes at home that I'd accumulated throughout the years, but since they were all on the cheap side, I didn't trust using hot water. When I pressed the big blue button, \"30:00\" appeared in red digits on the screen and began to count down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the lighter bucket and brought it back to my bedroom, where it was more convenient.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the lighter bucket and brought it back to my bedroom, where it was more convenient."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ended up sitting on the carpet. I was trying to calm my nerves, but as soon as I made any attempt to stop thinking, it became incredibly difficult.
entries.literal: "I ended up sitting on the carpet. I was trying to calm my nerves, but as soon as I made any attempt to stop thinking, it became incredibly difficult."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to go out again, somewhere. Staying still, the mess of emotions inside me was uncontrollable.
entries.literal: "I wanted to go out again, somewhere. Staying still, the mess of emotions inside me was uncontrollable."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Does it even matter, though? I can go to Ina, but it's not fair to say goodbye to someone without them knowing it, and I'd just be so sad without being able to say why...
entries.literal: "Does it even matter, though? I can go to Ina, but it's not fair to say goodbye to someone without them knowing it, and I'd just be so sad without being able to say why..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, the past would change, and that'd be overwritten anyway.
entries.literal: "Then, the past would change, and that'd be overwritten anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I really tried to keep my mood pleasant. It was possible I wouldn't find the Sekimeiya the next day, and even after traveling, I could go to Ina Café before the 30th to reach a time that wouldn't be deleted.
entries.literal: "...I really tried to keep my mood pleasant. It was possible I wouldn't find the Sekimeiya the next day, and even after traveling, I could go to Ina Café before the 30th to reach a time that wouldn't be deleted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The time had been passing far too fast, so I rested my head on a pillow, knowing that would slow it down. I stayed there for a few minutes and listened to the washer work. Even if doing the laundry didn't matter, my clothes could get moldy if they stayed inside for too long...
entries.literal: "The time had been passing far too fast, so I rested my head on a pillow, knowing that would slow it down. I stayed there for a few minutes and listened to the washer work. Even if doing the laundry didn't matter, my clothes could get moldy if they stayed inside for too long..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard it running from the living room. When the intensity increased, I knew the spin-dry had begun and that only a few minutes were left. I went to check.
entries.literal: "I heard it running from the living room. When the intensity increased, I knew the spin-dry had begun and that only a few minutes were left. I went to check."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see the meshed clothes rapidly spinning behind the glass, and the countdown approaching the last three minutes.
entries.literal: "I could see the meshed clothes rapidly spinning behind the glass, and the countdown approaching the last three minutes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I watched the seconds tick until four zeros filled the screen. Then, I grabbed the plastic handle and opened the door. I placed a blue bucket below it and dropped the compact, wet mess of clothes in it.
entries.literal: "I watched the seconds tick until four zeros filled the screen. Then, I grabbed the plastic handle and opened the door. I placed a blue bucket below it and dropped the compact, wet mess of clothes in it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dragged it to the wardrobe as well. I didn't have a dryer, so since the outside was freezing, I had to use a foldable washing line with the help of the heater.
entries.literal: "I dragged it to the wardrobe as well. I didn't have a dryer, so since the outside was freezing, I had to use a foldable washing line with the help of the heater."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made room on the floor and opened it up, proceeding to grab the pieces and hang them individually.
entries.literal: "I made room on the floor and opened it up, proceeding to grab the pieces and hang them individually."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They weren't too wet, so I kept crouching and using as few of my scarce clothespins as possible.{w} I took out a pretty blue and white shirt. I figured that I was still pretty tired since I thought I'd left it out of the washer due to the bad memories it brought, but I still hung it properly and kept going.
entries.literal: "They weren't too wet, so I kept crouching and using as few of my scarce clothespins as possible.{w} I took out a pretty blue and white shirt. I figured that I was still pretty tired since I thought I'd left it out of the washer due to the bad memories it brought, but I still hung it properly and kept going."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was done fairly quickly and looked at the neatly-hung laundry that would likely never be used. I turned around, looking down at my feet until I got to the front door.
entries.literal: "I was done fairly quickly and looked at the neatly-hung laundry that would likely never be used. I turned around, looking down at my feet until I got to the front door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been going outside without a defined reason, and I felt obligated to do it again. Spending the entire day inside would have been too difficult.
entries.literal: "I'd been going outside without a defined reason, and I felt obligated to do it again. Spending the entire day inside would have been too difficult."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got ready to leave and recalled I'd left my purse in my bedroom, so I went to grab it along with my phone.
entries.literal: "I got ready to leave and recalled I'd left my purse in my bedroom, so I went to grab it along with my phone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to reach for the front door, but I walked to the kitchen instead, remembering the garbage bag where I'd thrown the cereal bar wrappers. It was almost full, so I made a knot with the bands and returned.
entries.literal: "I was about to reach for the front door, but I walked to the kitchen instead, remembering the garbage bag where I'd thrown the cereal bar wrappers. It was almost full, so I made a knot with the bands and returned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pushed away a bit of snow that had accumulated on the ground, just like most of the neighboring apartments had.
entries.literal: "I pushed away a bit of snow that had accumulated on the ground, just like most of the neighboring apartments had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cold was still biting, but I'd come to expect it by that point. Stepping with satisfying crunches, I went down the stairs. The sky had cleared completely, and the street seemed especially bright. I walked the opposite way as usual, toward the garbage bins.
entries.literal: "The cold was still biting, but I'd come to expect it by that point. Stepping with satisfying crunches, I went down the stairs. The sky had cleared completely, and the street seemed especially bright. I walked the opposite way as usual, toward the garbage bins."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were at the very end of the street, past the curve that could be seen in the distance.
entries.literal: "They were at the very end of the street, past the curve that could be seen in the distance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I threw the bag in the bin for combustibles and started to walk toward the center of Yushibana.
entries.literal: "I threw the bag in the bin for combustibles and started to walk toward the center of Yushibana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As opposed to the previous day, my first view of Ramon was the crowded street it had always been. After crossing the road, I walked near the left buildings until I was on the thinner path.
entries.literal: "As opposed to the previous day, my first view of Ramon was the crowded street it had always been. After crossing the road, I walked near the left buildings until I was on the thinner path."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, Ina was open. I saw the large screen of glass and Darfee behind the counter, seemingly texting with his phone.
entries.literal: "Of course, Ina was open. I saw the large screen of glass and Darfee behind the counter, seemingly texting with his phone."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: ...Oh, hey! I'm glad to see you've taken a liking to this place again.
entries.literal: "...Oh, hey! I'm glad to see you've taken a liking to this place again."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.literal: "...Yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped up to the bar. Like the previous day, there was no one inside at that time.
entries.literal: "I stepped up to the bar. Like the previous day, there was no one inside at that time."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: How are you?
entries.literal: "How are you?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm okay.
entries.literal: "I'm okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I must have looked a little worse than before. I figured he thought it was just due to Miiya's death, but there was much more affecting me than solely that.
entries.literal: "I must have looked a little worse than before. I figured he thought it was just due to Miiya's death, but there was much more affecting me than solely that."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Do you want one of these?
entries.literal: "Do you want one of these?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He pointed at the pastries I'd been eating across the past couple of days.
entries.literal: "He pointed at the pastries I'd been eating across the past couple of days."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Yeah, I'm hungry.
entries.literal: "...Yeah, I'm hungry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He grabbed a small plate from below the counter and placed it in front of me with the pastry. I bit into it, a little bit tired of eating the same thing repeatedly, but glad that I at least had the option.
entries.literal: "He grabbed a small plate from below the counter and placed it in front of me with the pastry. I bit into it, a little bit tired of eating the same thing repeatedly, but glad that I at least had the option."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Going to sit at the same place again?
entries.literal: "Going to sit at the same place again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned to the table he was pointing to.{w} As I spun, something caught my eye.
entries.literal: "I turned to the table he was pointing to.{w} As I spun, something caught my eye."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a TV close to the entrance. It was muted, but I could see a reporter speaking into a microphone.{w} I recalled the words of the police officer.
entries.literal: "There was a TV close to the entrance. It was muted, but I could see a reporter speaking into a microphone.{w} I recalled the words of the police officer."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I will, yeah.
entries.literal: "I will, yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the plate and stepped back, but I sat on the opposite chair from last time so that I could see the screen.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the plate and stepped back, but I sat on the opposite chair from last time so that I could see the screen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Would it be announced today...? That seems unlikely.
entries.literal: "Would it be announced today...? That seems unlikely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But as soon as I sat on the chair, I read the white text at the bottom of the screen, which had just changed from a different headline.
entries.literal: "But as soon as I sat on the chair, I read the white text at the bottom of the screen, which had just changed from a different headline."

entries.text: Stopping Power
entries.literal: "Stopping Power"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Xyn member caught for the first time yesterday in Yushibana".
entries.literal: "\"Xyn member caught for the first time yesterday in Yushibana\"."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to read it two more times. That didn't make sense.
entries.literal: "I had to read it two more times. That didn't make sense."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Can you turn the volume up, please?
entries.literal: "...Can you turn the volume up, please?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee looked at the TV, and when he read what it said, he did as I asked despite his own surprise.
entries.literal: "Darfee looked at the TV, and when he read what it said, he did as I asked despite his own surprise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before he did, the image changed. That time, I immediately recognized what I saw, but once again, it didn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "Before he did, the image changed. That time, I immediately recognized what I saw, but once again, it didn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell...? ...Wasn't that in the newspaper?
entries.literal: "What the hell...? ...Wasn't that in the newspaper?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The voice of the reporter began to reach us, and when it did, the image had transitioned once again.{w} For a second, it had been a short video recorded from a security camera. It showed a prison cell and a person in prison clothing hard to recognize due to the high angle.
entries.literal: "The voice of the reporter began to reach us, and when it did, the image had transitioned once again.{w} For a second, it had been a short video recorded from a security camera. It showed a prison cell and a person in prison clothing hard to recognize due to the high angle."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: ...ested yesterday in a lonely street of Yushibana. He is believed to be a member of the criminal group Xyn, but his identity is unknown.
entries.literal: "...ested yesterday in a lonely street of Yushibana. He is believed to be a member of the criminal group Xyn, but his identity is unknown."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to give meaning to those words, but I couldn't. The brief footage had been almost identical to the picture from the newspaper, and they were saying that the man's identity was unknown, just like in that article.
entries.literal: "I tried to give meaning to those words, but I couldn't. The brief footage had been almost identical to the picture from the newspaper, and they were saying that the man's identity was unknown, just like in that article."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: An interrogation is taking place, and the police are actively attempting to identify the suspect. This is likely to be the first member of the group to be caught, so the situation is being properly taken care of.
entries.literal: "An interrogation is taking place, and the police are actively attempting to identify the suspect. This is likely to be the first member of the group to be caught, so the situation is being properly taken care of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After those words, the reporter bowed, and an ad began to play.
entries.literal: "After those words, the reporter bowed, and an ad began to play."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at Darfee, who appeared confused as well. Before he could say anything, I stood up and approached a table next to the counter.
entries.literal: "I looked at Darfee, who appeared confused as well. Before he could say anything, I stood up and approached a table next to the counter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd seen a pile of newspapers there before, and it hadn't moved. Immediately, I saw that the one I'd read was still there, facing down. I opened it and rushed to the first two pages.
entries.literal: "I'd seen a pile of newspapers there before, and it hadn't moved. Immediately, I saw that the one I'd read was still there, facing down. I opened it and rushed to the first two pages."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's here—what was just shown looked exactly like this picture.
entries.literal: "It's here—what was just shown looked exactly like this picture."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee was looking at me with a serious face, and I brought the newspaper to him.
entries.literal: "Darfee was looking at me with a serious face, and I brought the newspaper to him."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Sorry, I might be going insane, but I could've sworn I'd seen that before. Wasn't it exactly like this?
entries.literal: "Sorry, I might be going insane, but I could've sworn I'd seen that before. Wasn't it exactly like this?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: U-Uh...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked at the article I was pointing to and narrowed his eyebrows further.
entries.literal: "He looked at the article I was pointing to and narrowed his eyebrows further."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Y-You're right... It's the same cell, but this says it's from November 24th.
entries.literal: "Y-You're right... It's the same cell, but this says it's from November 24th."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Didn't the person also look the same?
entries.literal: "Didn't the person also look the same?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Did he...? I couldn't get a good look at him, but I can't in this picture either.
entries.literal: "Did he...? I couldn't get a good look at him, but I can't in this picture either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He began to read the text.
entries.literal: "He began to read the text."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I never learned about this... On November 24th, a prisoner escaped from a cell.{w} But Xyn isn't mentioned here even though they also said the identity of the person wasn't known.{w} ...How's that possible? They don't know the identity of someone they arrested?
entries.literal: "I never learned about this... On November 24th, a prisoner escaped from a cell.{w} But Xyn isn't mentioned here even though they also said the identity of the person wasn't known.{w} ...How's that possible? They don't know the identity of someone they arrested?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked back at the TV, but it was still only ads.
entries.literal: "I looked back at the TV, but it was still only ads."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah, it's strange. My mind immediately went to this article, but there's probably no correlation. Every cell must be recorded from this angle, so to me it seemed like they were the same.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it's strange. My mind immediately went to this article, but there's probably no correlation. Every cell must be recorded from this angle, so to me it seemed like they were the same."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Ah, it could be that.
entries.literal: "Ah, it could be that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat on the chair again. Of course, it was no coincidence.
entries.literal: "I sat on the chair again. Of course, it was no coincidence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The person who'd been arrested had been following me, meaning that it was very likely they had come from the future. Then, the person from the article had appeared in the cell on the 24th, a day I knew for a fact people had arrived at from the 15th.
entries.literal: "The person who'd been arrested had been following me, meaning that it was very likely they had come from the future. Then, the person from the article had appeared in the cell on the 24th, a day I knew for a fact people had arrived at from the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What the hell was going on, then? Could they have been the same person? A few days earlier, they'd appeared in that cell. The previous day, they'd been arrested.{w} What kind of coincidence was that? Had he been sent to the same cell? Had the police not realized that he was the person who'd escaped on the 24th? And why was his identity unknown if they thought he was a Xyn member?
entries.literal: "What the hell was going on, then? Could they have been the same person? A few days earlier, they'd appeared in that cell. The previous day, they'd been arrested.{w} What kind of coincidence was that? Had he been sent to the same cell? Had the police not realized that he was the person who'd escaped on the 24th? And why was his identity unknown if they thought he was a Xyn member?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was baffled, but an important piece of the puzzle came back to me. Once again, it was what Katei told us.
entries.literal: "I was baffled, but an important piece of the puzzle came back to me. Once again, it was what Katei told us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Xyn had attempted to steal the Sekimeiya once before the 15th. They failed, and while the police had the chance to catch a Xyn member, they escaped.{w} I couldn't remember the exact way it was phrased, but that had happened once before the 15th...
entries.literal: "Xyn had attempted to steal the Sekimeiya once before the 15th. They failed, and while the police had the chance to catch a Xyn member, they escaped.{w} I couldn't remember the exact way it was phrased, but that had happened once before the 15th..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What is the connection between the article and this arrest...?
entries.literal: "What is the connection between the article and this arrest...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't help but feel that something was incredibly backward. The resemblance between both events was undeniable. Even Darfee immediately noticed it, unaware of the extra links I knew regarding the person and the Sekimeiya's travel.
entries.literal: "I couldn't help but feel that something was incredibly backward. The resemblance between both events was undeniable. Even Darfee immediately noticed it, unaware of the extra links I knew regarding the person and the Sekimeiya's travel."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They caught a Xyn member for the first time.{w} ...But they'll escape before the 15th. Katei and the article prove that.
entries.literal: "They caught a Xyn member for the first time.{w} ...But they'll escape before the 15th. Katei and the article prove that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It couldn't be so straightforward because the article discussed an event from November 24th. While both events couldn't be the very same, they couldn't be separate either.
entries.literal: "It couldn't be so straightforward because the article discussed an event from November 24th. While both events couldn't be the very same, they couldn't be separate either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ate what remained of the pastry, trying to clear the cloudy confusion that had arisen in my mind. Behind both of those events was the Sekimeiya—that by itself already gave away that something unnatural was at work.
entries.literal: "I ate what remained of the pastry, trying to clear the cloudy confusion that had arisen in my mind. Behind both of those events was the Sekimeiya—that by itself already gave away that something unnatural was at work."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's something crucial that I can't ignore.{w} In both cases, someone ended up in a prison cell. I don't know if the same person was caught both times, but it's very likely they came from the future. So, anything regarding them could differ from the reality I know.
entries.literal: "There's something crucial that I can't ignore.{w} In both cases, someone ended up in a prison cell. I don't know if the same person was caught both times, but it's very likely they came from the future. So, anything regarding them could differ from the reality I know."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Xyn member who traveled from the 15th could've already changed this. If he got arrested after traveling in this reality, there would be a second Xyn member caught after the first time—the person from the future who was following me.
entries.literal: "The Xyn member who traveled from the 15th could've already changed this. If he got arrested after traveling in this reality, there would be a second Xyn member caught after the first time—the person from the future who was following me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Trying to work it all out, I'd locked up.
entries.literal: "...{w}Trying to work it all out, I'd locked up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wasn't there something else Katei said? ...That Ashiya or the police chose not to reveal that they'd almost caught a Xyn member before they'd escaped.
entries.literal: "Wasn't there something else Katei said? ...That Ashiya or the police chose not to reveal that they'd almost caught a Xyn member before they'd escaped."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Doesn't this fit all too well with the article? If both events are connected, the fact that the person in the cell was a Xyn member must match as well. However, in the article, that wasn't revealed. ...Could that be the original event that Katei told us about?{w} That person escaped and managed to get to the tower. After that, they traveled to the past and got caught again when they were following me. Somehow, the police still didn't know their identity, but this time it was revealed that they were a Xyn member.
entries.literal: "Doesn't this fit all too well with the article? If both events are connected, the fact that the person in the cell was a Xyn member must match as well. However, in the article, that wasn't revealed. ...Could that be the original event that Katei told us about?{w} That person escaped and managed to get to the tower. After that, they traveled to the past and got caught again when they were following me. Somehow, the police still didn't know their identity, but this time it was revealed that they were a Xyn member."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's right. This must be a change made by a person who traveled from the 15th. After all, someone from Xyn was just revealed to have been caught, which never happened in our reality.
entries.literal: "That's right. This must be a change made by a person who traveled from the 15th. After all, someone from Xyn was just revealed to have been caught, which never happened in our reality."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...But what I just came up with doesn't make sense either.
entries.literal: "...But what I just came up with doesn't make sense either."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It doesn't make sense if the person from the 24th really teleported to the cell. Which must have happened, given what I know happened to Vaisude...
entries.literal: "It doesn't make sense if the person from the 24th really teleported to the cell. Which must have happened, given what I know happened to Vaisude..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If whoever that person was traveled to the cell from the 15th, they couldn't have been the same person to be caught yesterday, because the second arrest must be a new event.{w} Could it be that history was changed, but I still remember the one that both I and that man came from because I also traveled from it?
entries.literal: "If whoever that person was traveled to the cell from the 15th, they couldn't have been the same person to be caught yesterday, because the second arrest must be a new event.{w} Could it be that history was changed, but I still remember the one that both I and that man came from because I also traveled from it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I noticed a mistake I'd made.
entries.literal: "I noticed a mistake I'd made."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On the 24th, it's very likely a Xyn member appeared in a cell from the future. Now that I think of it, though, it can't be that he was actually caught and then escaped while Ashiya decided not to reveal he was from Xyn.
entries.literal: "On the 24th, it's very likely a Xyn member appeared in a cell from the future. Now that I think of it, though, it can't be that he was actually caught and then escaped while Ashiya decided not to reveal he was from Xyn."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That doesn't match because Katei said they were caught after trying to steal the Sekimeiya before the 15th. It hadn't even been found on the 24th.
entries.literal: "That doesn't match because Katei said they were caught after trying to steal the Sekimeiya before the 15th. It hadn't even been found on the 24th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell, then?
entries.literal: "What the hell, then?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had very little information, so I looked at the screen when I heard the news had come back. Unfortunately, they began to talk about a different topic, and Darfee quickly turned down the volume and looked at me.
entries.literal: "I had very little information, so I looked at the screen when I heard the news had come back. Unfortunately, they began to talk about a different topic, and Darfee quickly turned down the volume and looked at me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, it was probably a good thing. A member from Xyn who'd traveled from the 15th had been caught, and since that had been revealed, there was no reason to think he would escape. It was an event that hadn't occurred when we'd originally stepped into the tower.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, it was probably a good thing. A member from Xyn who'd traveled from the 15th had been caught, and since that had been revealed, there was no reason to think he would escape. It was an event that hadn't occurred when we'd originally stepped into the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Piecing all the details together with what I knew seemed almost impossible, as no possibility made total sense.
entries.literal: "Piecing all the details together with what I knew seemed almost impossible, as no possibility made total sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm... I did wonder before why he appeared in a jail cell on the 24th.{w} From the 15th, it's very likely he'd appear somewhere he'd been before in the past.
entries.literal: "Hm... I did wonder before why he appeared in a jail cell on the 24th.{w} From the 15th, it's very likely he'd appear somewhere he'd been before in the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And now this could fit. If the arrest from yesterday always occurred, the position on the 24th could be based on today.
entries.literal: "And now this could fit. If the arrest from yesterday always occurred, the position on the 24th could be based on today."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But then questions like how he was in the tower on the 15th or why he was following me start to crop up.
entries.literal: "But then questions like how he was in the tower on the 15th or why he was following me start to crop up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slowed down, sensing a headache. No matter what the truth was, it was messy.
entries.literal: "I slowed down, sensing a headache. No matter what the truth was, it was messy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was the link between both events? Which one was new, and which one had always happened? Regardless of the arrangement I tried, something always seemed to get in the way.
entries.literal: "What was the link between both events? Which one was new, and which one had always happened? Regardless of the arrangement I tried, something always seemed to get in the way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And when I'd calmed down internally, one option seemed more plausible than the others.
entries.literal: "And when I'd calmed down internally, one option seemed more plausible than the others."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I believed that the 30th of November was the day somebody attempted to steal the Sekimeiya. That was probably correct since nobody was caught and no connection to Xyn was made. Katei would've been talking about this.
entries.literal: "I believed that the 30th of November was the day somebody attempted to steal the Sekimeiya. That was probably correct since nobody was caught and no connection to Xyn was made. Katei would've been talking about this."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On the 15th, a Xyn member traveled to the 24th and appeared in an unlocked cell. Due to that, he was able to escape.
entries.literal: "On the 15th, a Xyn member traveled to the 24th and appeared in an unlocked cell. Due to that, he was able to escape."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After following me, he was caught yesterday. That changed the past because no Xyn member had been caught yet on the 15th.
entries.literal: "After following me, he was caught yesterday. That changed the past because no Xyn member had been caught yet on the 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What's iffy about this? That their identity was unknown, that the cell could've been the same one...?{w} The fact that they appeared in a cell on the 24th might also be a contradiction—they wouldn't have been there before traveling. I feel like there are more problems, but I don't know how to identify them.
entries.literal: "What's iffy about this? That their identity was unknown, that the cell could've been the same one...?{w} The fact that they appeared in a cell on the 24th might also be a contradiction—they wouldn't have been there before traveling. I feel like there are more problems, but I don't know how to identify them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...But if this is what happened, Xyn must be in disarray. Someone from their group was arrested when they're all still free. Could this make them rethink their attack? That could be bad.{w} Maybe Ashiya won't care about using the Sekimeiya as bait now that a Xyn member's been caught, but the event should still happen...
entries.literal: "...But if this is what happened, Xyn must be in disarray. Someone from their group was arrested when they're all still free. Could this make them rethink their attack? That could be bad.{w} Maybe Ashiya won't care about using the Sekimeiya as bait now that a Xyn member's been caught, but the event should still happen..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, one thing definitely is strange, though.{w} On the 24th, the police weren't able to identify the person who appeared in the cell. But he was arrested in the street yesterday, and that policeman almost seemed like he knew that it was a good arrest to make.{w} That doesn't make any sense. That man was in the tower on the 15th, so if the police were fine with arresting him yesterday, it follows they would've also arrested him immediately on the morning of the 15th.
entries.literal: "Oh, one thing definitely is strange, though.{w} On the 24th, the police weren't able to identify the person who appeared in the cell. But he was arrested in the street yesterday, and that policeman almost seemed like he knew that it was a good arrest to make.{w} That doesn't make any sense. That man was in the tower on the 15th, so if the police were fine with arresting him yesterday, it follows they would've also arrested him immediately on the morning of the 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Could it be that didn't happen because he entered the tower through the storeroom? And, if what happened on the 24th somehow made the police arrest him yesterday, wouldn't they have said that he'd been the one who had appeared in the cell on the 24th?
entries.literal: "...Could it be that didn't happen because he entered the tower through the storeroom? And, if what happened on the 24th somehow made the police arrest him yesterday, wouldn't they have said that he'd been the one who had appeared in the cell on the 24th?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whatever the case, it seemed like an enigma that I probably had to put aside. It was at least good that the person following me had been caught. It could only have been beneficial to my plan.
entries.literal: "Whatever the case, it seemed like an enigma that I probably had to put aside. It was at least good that the person following me had been caught. It could only have been beneficial to my plan."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Are you thinking about the news?
entries.literal: "Are you thinking about the news?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Darfee addressed me after I'd been in thought for a few minutes.
entries.literal: "Darfee addressed me after I'd been in thought for a few minutes."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: A bit. It just threw me off.
entries.literal: "A bit. It just threw me off."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I see. Well, it's good that someone from that group finally got caught.
entries.literal: "I see. Well, it's good that someone from that group finally got caught."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah, I agree.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I agree."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The past had certainly changed in front of me. I wasn't in the same reality I knew, so letting everything repeat to remain as the only me was not an option anymore.
entries.literal: "The past had certainly changed in front of me. I wasn't in the same reality I knew, so letting everything repeat to remain as the only me was not an option anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was still the major worry that the Sekimeiya could be stolen at any moment. Even if someone from the future had been removed from the equation, that didn't completely rule out the possibility.
entries.literal: "There was still the major worry that the Sekimeiya could be stolen at any moment. Even if someone from the future had been removed from the equation, that didn't completely rule out the possibility."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As a matter of fact, the Sekimeiya could have already been stolen. How did the police know that the person they'd caught was with Xyn? Was it because he'd already taken it? The thought of that sent a chill down my spine.
entries.literal: "As a matter of fact, the Sekimeiya could have already been stolen. How did the police know that the person they'd caught was with Xyn? Was it because he'd already taken it? The thought of that sent a chill down my spine."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Do you know about the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...Do you know about the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Huh? ...What do you mean?
entries.literal: "Huh? ...What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Ashiya's event.
entries.literal: "Ashiya's event."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Hm? Yeah, of course.
entries.literal: "Hm? Yeah, of course."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Well, nobody stole the Sekimeiya, right...?
entries.literal: "Well, nobody stole the Sekimeiya, right...?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: The Sekimeiya...? N-No. ...As far as I know, at least.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya...? N-No. ...As far as I know, at least."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: All right, I just wanted to make sure since I haven't been paying attention to the news.
entries.literal: "All right, I just wanted to make sure since I haven't been paying attention to the news."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked a little concerned, so I turned to the window. Did he think it was bad I had my thoughts elsewhere after a friend of mine had died? I doubted it, but that was the impression his look gave me.
entries.literal: "He looked a little concerned, so I turned to the window. Did he think it was bad I had my thoughts elsewhere after a friend of mine had died? I doubted it, but that was the impression his look gave me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared out the window. I could only see the narrow street, as opposed to the moving Ramon. ...Just what had happened to the world I knew?
entries.literal: "I stared out the window. I could only see the narrow street, as opposed to the moving Ramon. ...Just what had happened to the world I knew?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At that point, it was best to focus on what still mattered.
entries.literal: "At that point, it was best to focus on what still mattered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With no snow falling, there'd been hardly any movement outside. A few people had come to buy the remaining bread, but time seemed to have stilled for a while.
entries.literal: "With no snow falling, there'd been hardly any movement outside. A few people had come to buy the remaining bread, but time seemed to have stilled for a while."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up from the chair and informed Darfee that I'd be heading out.
entries.literal: "I stood up from the chair and informed Darfee that I'd be heading out."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: All right, Shiroya. Have a good day. It'll be ¥150.
entries.literal: "All right, Shiroya. Have a good day. It'll be ¥150."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took out three coins from my wallet and handed them to him. He mirrored my smile but not the underlying sadness behind it.
entries.literal: "I took out three coins from my wallet and handed them to him. He mirrored my smile but not the underlying sadness behind it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Goodbye.
entries.literal: "Goodbye."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I'll see you.
entries.literal: "I'll see you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I walked out of the door and stepped onto the snow again.
entries.literal: "...I walked out of the door and stepped onto the snow again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made some distance from Ina, brooding all the while. I had a hard time accepting that it might have been my last visit.
entries.literal: "I made some distance from Ina, brooding all the while. I had a hard time accepting that it might have been my last visit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been slowly walking down Ramon when I stopped myself to stare at a street branching off on the other side.
entries.literal: "I'd been slowly walking down Ramon when I stopped myself to stare at a street branching off on the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd taken that path many times to get to Atsuki's house, so I soon realized I was nervously biting my lip again.
entries.literal: "I'd taken that path many times to get to Atsuki's house, so I soon realized I was nervously biting my lip again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have anywhere to go in more ways than one. A huge change in history had occurred—I'd never go back to the world I knew.
entries.literal: "I didn't have anywhere to go in more ways than one. A huge change in history had occurred—I'd never go back to the world I knew."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That meant that making sure Atsuki and I couldn't go to the event had become an even higher priority. It no longer had a downside.
entries.literal: "That meant that making sure Atsuki and I couldn't go to the event had become an even higher priority. It no longer had a downside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I'd decided the previous day that I'd do it on Thursday, but that was potentially a bad idea. I didn't know when Atsuki would leave his house, and waiting in front of it all day wasn't something I wanted to do.
entries.literal: "...I'd decided the previous day that I'd do it on Thursday, but that was potentially a bad idea. I didn't know when Atsuki would leave his house, and waiting in front of it all day wasn't something I wanted to do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After all, if it got too late, I'd have to ring the bell and face him.{w} ...I didn't think I could do that.
entries.literal: "After all, if it got too late, I'd have to ring the bell and face him.{w} ...I didn't think I could do that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I only had one job: setting up a future that was perfect for everyone but me, then walking away from it. I couldn't fight that anymore.
entries.literal: "I only had one job: setting up a future that was perfect for everyone but me, then walking away from it. I couldn't fight that anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I crossed the street and walked through the narrower one, arriving at a part of Yushibana I'd always found pretty.
entries.literal: "I crossed the street and walked through the narrower one, arriving at a part of Yushibana I'd always found pretty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At other times of the year, you could see the green leaves beneath the snow of the tall trees. The road was still white, but it was almost immaculate. I slowly crossed to the opposite sidewalk.
entries.literal: "At other times of the year, you could see the green leaves beneath the snow of the tall trees. The road was still white, but it was almost immaculate. I slowly crossed to the opposite sidewalk."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki's house was there. Before I got too close, a sharp pain in my chest stopped me.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's house was there. Before I got too close, a sharp pain in my chest stopped me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Would I really never enter it again?{w} Could I really have been mere minutes away from going in and out of that door for the last time?
entries.literal: "...Would I really never enter it again?{w} Could I really have been mere minutes away from going in and out of that door for the last time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had a hard time believing it.
entries.literal: "I had a hard time believing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran up to the gate before that hesitation could take hold of me completely.
entries.literal: "I ran up to the gate before that hesitation could take hold of me completely."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I looked through the bars. Maxi wasn't in front of the door anymore, but his small paws had left imprints in the snow around it.
entries.literal: "...I looked through the bars. Maxi wasn't in front of the door anymore, but his small paws had left imprints in the snow around it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He is here.
entries.literal: "He is here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was light behind a curtain. With no guarantee that Atsuki wouldn't see me, I stepped behind a tree.
entries.literal: "There was light behind a curtain. With no guarantee that Atsuki wouldn't see me, I stepped behind a tree."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really didn't want to be seen. If I talked to Atsuki, I was afraid that I would lose any resolve I had.
entries.literal: "I really didn't want to be seen. If I talked to Atsuki, I was afraid that I would lose any resolve I had."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can't just stay here all day, waiting for him to leave. I don't even know if he will.
entries.literal: "I can't just stay here all day, waiting for him to leave. I don't even know if he will."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a last resort available. Since I knew where he kept an extra house key, just behind the gate, I could try to enter the house and silently grab Miiya's purse, which had been left in the living room.
entries.literal: "There was a last resort available. Since I knew where he kept an extra house key, just behind the gate, I could try to enter the house and silently grab Miiya's purse, which had been left in the living room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Not now, though. If it wasn't a coincidence that he was in the hospital when I woke up, he should leave at some point.
entries.literal: "Not now, though. If it wasn't a coincidence that he was in the hospital when I woke up, he should leave at some point."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Would he leave if I called him from my phone and quickly hung up?
entries.literal: "...Would he leave if I called him from my phone and quickly hung up?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I decided against that again.
entries.literal: "...{w}I decided against that again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Should I just wait here...?
entries.literal: "...{w}Should I just wait here...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I crossed back to the other side of the road and surveyed the door from afar. I looked around; it appeared I was the only person there.
entries.literal: "I crossed back to the other side of the road and surveyed the door from afar. I looked around; it appeared I was the only person there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Most of the trees there were too thin to cover me, so there was nowhere I could safely watch from.
entries.literal: "Most of the trees there were too thin to cover me, so there was nowhere I could safely watch from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at a corner far ahead. I'd be able to see the window from there.
entries.literal: "I glanced at a corner far ahead. I'd be able to see the window from there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Slightly hesitant, I walked to it and peered at his house. As I'd thought, I'd be able to see him leaving while still being out of sight.
entries.literal: "Slightly hesitant, I walked to it and peered at his house. As I'd thought, I'd be able to see him leaving while still being out of sight."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was something a bit worrying that I also noticed, however. It was the trail of footprints I'd left.
entries.literal: "There was something a bit worrying that I also noticed, however. It was the trail of footprints I'd left."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Will he notice the trail going behind the tree?
entries.literal: "...Will he notice the trail going behind the tree?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed unlikely that he'd think it was suspicious, but he could find me by following them with his eyes.
entries.literal: "It seemed unlikely that he'd think it was suspicious, but he could find me by following them with his eyes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'll just have to be careful.
entries.literal: "I'll just have to be careful."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But no matter what I thought, I was uncomfortable. I couldn't take my eyes off his house, and I didn't particularly enjoy the thought of spending my last real day in Yushibana spying on Atsuki.
entries.literal: "...But no matter what I thought, I was uncomfortable. I couldn't take my eyes off his house, and I didn't particularly enjoy the thought of spending my last real day in Yushibana spying on Atsuki."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I need to do it, though.
entries.literal: "I need to do it, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hid myself and leaned against the dark, cold wall.{w} Suddenly, I recognized what I was looking at.
entries.literal: "I hid myself and leaned against the dark, cold wall.{w} Suddenly, I recognized what I was looking at."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd seen that very street the previous day, when I'd been following Isla.
entries.literal: "I'd seen that very street the previous day, when I'd been following Isla."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's right... There's no reason not to do the same with Isla since I might know where she lives as well.
entries.literal: "That's right... There's no reason not to do the same with Isla since I might know where she lives as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Leaving Enric behind, I walked until a crossing street turned to the right. There was the entrance to the dead end I'd been at.
entries.literal: "Leaving Enric behind, I walked until a crossing street turned to the right. There was the entrance to the dead end I'd been at."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the short house where the small footprints had ended the previous day. I couldn't see any light coming from inside, and nobody was around me.
entries.literal: "I stared at the short house where the small footprints had ended the previous day. I couldn't see any light coming from inside, and nobody was around me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Faded footprints were scattered all over the ground, and some ended at that front door. I placed myself behind the same black car as before to avoid being right in the middle of the path.
entries.literal: "Faded footprints were scattered all over the ground, and some ended at that front door. I placed myself behind the same black car as before to avoid being right in the middle of the path."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wondered what to do. Changing the past no longer felt like an obstacle, so I was free to decide on anything.
entries.literal: "I wondered what to do. Changing the past no longer felt like an obstacle, so I was free to decide on anything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isla should be at school, but I don't know about Erina, and I don't know if anyone else lives here. ...How the hell can I take their tickets for the event when I don't even know where they're keeping them?
entries.literal: "Isla should be at school, but I don't know about Erina, and I don't know if anyone else lives here. ...How the hell can I take their tickets for the event when I don't even know where they're keeping them?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I considered two important facts: in the attic, Erina had implied they'd bought the tickets pretty early. That meant they were likely to already have them.
entries.literal: "...{w}I considered two important facts: in the attic, Erina had implied they'd bought the tickets pretty early. That meant they were likely to already have them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Secondly, before locking ourselves in the bedroom, everyone's possessions had been looked at. While tickets for the event had been found on almost everyone who'd been a visitor, none had been in Erina's purse.
entries.literal: "Secondly, before locking ourselves in the bedroom, everyone's possessions had been looked at. While tickets for the event had been found on almost everyone who'd been a visitor, none had been in Erina's purse."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They were probably inside Isla's, then. Could they already be there...?
entries.literal: "They were probably inside Isla's, then. Could they already be there...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The pressure of being in a crucial moment was getting to me. I stepped out and slowly approached the door.
entries.literal: "The pressure of being in a crucial moment was getting to me. I stepped out and slowly approached the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If Erina and Isla didn't go to the tower, different people would in their place. It was overwhelmingly likely that as long as Ashiya had the Sekimeiya, people would get trapped in that building. However, Isla's fate could be averted.
entries.literal: "If Erina and Isla didn't go to the tower, different people would in their place. It was overwhelmingly likely that as long as Ashiya had the Sekimeiya, people would get trapped in that building. However, Isla's fate could be averted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And I could change the past. When I was in front of the door, I stared at the tiny white bell at its side.
entries.literal: "...And I could change the past. When I was in front of the door, I stared at the tiny white bell at its side."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Erina and Isla don't know me. I can just press it.
entries.literal: "Erina and Isla don't know me. I can just press it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But what about Isla's friend? What was the truth behind that...? Is someone else really living here with them?
entries.literal: "But what about Isla's friend? What was the truth behind that...? Is someone else really living here with them?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My arm reached out and touched the cold doorbell almost unconsciously, like it was another organism.
entries.literal: "My arm reached out and touched the cold doorbell almost unconsciously, like it was another organism."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But really, what should I say...? I suppose that'll vary depending on who opens the door.
entries.literal: "But really, what should I say...? I suppose that'll vary depending on who opens the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd seen no light inside, so maybe nobody would. I firmly rang the doorbell.
entries.literal: "I'd seen no light inside, so maybe nobody would. I firmly rang the doorbell."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is there actually nobody here?
entries.literal: "...Is there actually nobody here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A day earlier, the small footprints had ended at the door, and it was close to the same time of the day that it had been.
entries.literal: "A day earlier, the small footprints had ended at the door, and it was close to the same time of the day that it had been."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suspected I knew what the reason was.
entries.literal: "I suspected I knew what the reason was."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Isla! Are you here...!?{w} It's me, Shiroya!
entries.literal: "Isla! Are you here...!?{w} It's me, Shiroya!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no reply.
entries.literal: "There was no reply."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is she out again?
entries.literal: "Is she out again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd wondered about it already, but my intention was to take the tickets from Erina and Isla. If I did that, Isla couldn't travel to the past... so her "friend" might no longer have existed.
entries.literal: "I'd wondered about it already, but my intention was to take the tickets from Erina and Isla. If I did that, Isla couldn't travel to the past... so her \"friend\" might no longer have existed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I'd seen her from the café during school hours. That had to be an Isla who'd traveled from the future.{w} Why had she been out of her house? I figured she wouldn't have wanted to show herself anywhere, which was why she wasn't opening the door.
entries.literal: "But I'd seen her from the café during school hours. That had to be an Isla who'd traveled from the future.{w} Why had she been out of her house? I figured she wouldn't have wanted to show herself anywhere, which was why she wasn't opening the door."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Isla, are you here?
entries.literal: "Isla, are you here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knocked on the door lightly, but it didn't seem like I'd be answered.
entries.literal: "I knocked on the door lightly, but it didn't seem like I'd be answered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The mystery behind Isla's friend was nowhere near solved. If their real identity was an Isla who'd come from the future, why hadn't she prevented herself from going to the event? My intention was to do just that, so my unease grew. Plenty of things about Isla had been questionable when looking back at it, but the voice recorder and her friend's existence were the biggest ones.
entries.literal: "The mystery behind Isla's friend was nowhere near solved. If their real identity was an Isla who'd come from the future, why hadn't she prevented herself from going to the event? My intention was to do just that, so my unease grew. Plenty of things about Isla had been questionable when looking back at it, but the voice recorder and her friend's existence were the biggest ones."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been standing there for a while, and nothing had changed. Part of me wanted to give up, but the idea of her friend purposely not opening the door was one I didn't like at all.
entries.literal: "I'd been standing there for a while, and nothing had changed. Part of me wanted to give up, but the idea of her friend purposely not opening the door was one I didn't like at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, the door opened wide and I saw the dark interior.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, the door opened wide and I saw the dark interior."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nobody there. I'd simply tried to open the door and succeeded.
entries.literal: "There was nobody there. I'd simply tried to open the door and succeeded."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It was unlocked?
entries.literal: "...It was unlocked?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd grabbed the handle to make some noise, and I'd accidentally pushed forward.{w} I didn't move. I kept staring inside until I was sure it was vacant. Then, I lightly pushed the door a bit more and took a careful step in.
entries.literal: "I'd grabbed the handle to make some noise, and I'd accidentally pushed forward.{w} I didn't move. I kept staring inside until I was sure it was vacant. Then, I lightly pushed the door a bit more and took a careful step in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I scanned the area and immediately noticed a wide assortment of items on the ground. Toys, dolls, coloring books, and markers. In the corner was a pile of laundry, and the walls had a few faded scribbles on them, as if someone had tried to wash them away. There were also pictures of a child at various stages of growth, and her mother was occasionally in the shot with her.
entries.literal: "I scanned the area and immediately noticed a wide assortment of items on the ground. Toys, dolls, coloring books, and markers. In the corner was a pile of laundry, and the walls had a few faded scribbles on them, as if someone had tried to wash them away. There were also pictures of a child at various stages of growth, and her mother was occasionally in the shot with her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the entryway closet in search of the purse and was faced with a few women's and girls' jackets. Scattered in the closet were clothes you wouldn't typically see when visiting someone's house.{w} An apron with the name of a local restaurant, a uniform for a factory worker, and a cap branded with the logo of a convenience store.
entries.literal: "I opened the entryway closet in search of the purse and was faced with a few women's and girls' jackets. Scattered in the closet were clothes you wouldn't typically see when visiting someone's house.{w} An apron with the name of a local restaurant, a uniform for a factory worker, and a cap branded with the logo of a convenience store."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have to search for long. Right inside was the purse Isla had been wearing.
entries.literal: "I didn't have to search for long. Right inside was the purse Isla had been wearing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without hesitation, I looked inside.
entries.literal: "Without hesitation, I looked inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The most important issue was resolved immediately—the recorder wasn't there. I saw a pack of tissues and small sunglasses, but no tickets either.
entries.literal: "The most important issue was resolved immediately—the recorder wasn't there. I saw a pack of tissues and small sunglasses, but no tickets either."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, this is strange. When we found the recorder, I looked at this purse, and the tickets weren't there either. ...Were they in Isla's pockets?
entries.literal: "Wait, this is strange. When we found the recorder, I looked at this purse, and the tickets weren't there either. ...Were they in Isla's pockets?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a sudden chill and looked at my sides. Nobody was there, but that in itself was very strange...
entries.literal: "I felt a sudden chill and looked at my sides. Nobody was there, but that in itself was very strange..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why... is this purse here? Yesterday, the reason why I recognized Isla was precisely because she was wearing the purse outside. If she's outside right now, why is her purse here?
entries.literal: "Why... is this purse here? Yesterday, the reason why I recognized Isla was precisely because she was wearing the purse outside. If she's outside right now, why is her purse here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was some kind of creeping, unknown dread at my back, but I immediately rationalized it away.
entries.literal: "There was some kind of creeping, unknown dread at my back, but I immediately rationalized it away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The person I saw yesterday was likely Isla's "friend". She was wearing her purse, and she isn't here right now.
entries.literal: "...The person I saw yesterday was likely Isla's \"friend\". She was wearing her purse, and she isn't here right now."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This purse belongs to the original Isla who's at school. If that's it, this makes a lot of sense.
entries.literal: "This purse belongs to the original Isla who's at school. If that's it, this makes a lot of sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But why was the door unlocked? Was it a normal thing for them? ...And why would the other Isla be going anywhere during the day?
entries.literal: "But why was the door unlocked? Was it a normal thing for them? ...And why would the other Isla be going anywhere during the day?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The chance to take their tickets was there. Instead of focusing on specifics, I just had to take that simple action.
entries.literal: "The chance to take their tickets was there. Instead of focusing on specifics, I just had to take that simple action."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And when I let go of the purse, I noticed I'd missed a lower pocket.
entries.literal: "And when I let go of the purse, I noticed I'd missed a lower pocket."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I unzipped it and narrowed my eyes. All I saw were two folded pieces of paper that I easily recognized.
entries.literal: "I unzipped it and narrowed my eyes. All I saw were two folded pieces of paper that I easily recognized."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed them with two fingers and unfolded them, confirming they were the event tickets.
entries.literal: "I grabbed them with two fingers and unfolded them, confirming they were the event tickets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't give it another thought before dashing out and closing the door.
entries.literal: "I didn't give it another thought before dashing out and closing the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I froze up, realizing how suspicious I looked. I instinctively crumpled the tickets in my fist, but nobody was around to see me.
entries.literal: "I froze up, realizing how suspicious I looked. I instinctively crumpled the tickets in my fist, but nobody was around to see me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I breathed deeply and began to walk away, calm and nonchalant. I had prevented it; I wasn't in my world anymore, but Isla wouldn't die.
entries.literal: "I breathed deeply and began to walk away, calm and nonchalant. I had prevented it; I wasn't in my world anymore, but Isla wouldn't die."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What would happen with Isla? If two versions of her really existed, then it seemed they'd both permanently persist in a single reality. However, I'd already decided once that was the better option, so I'd just put her in the same situation as me.
entries.literal: "What would happen with Isla? If two versions of her really existed, then it seemed they'd both permanently persist in a single reality. However, I'd already decided once that was the better option, so I'd just put her in the same situation as me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I soon made it back to Enric avenue. From the same corner, I saw light behind Atsuki's window.
entries.literal: "I soon made it back to Enric avenue. From the same corner, I saw light behind Atsuki's window."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at it for a bit, but I gave up after a short while. I just wanted to go home and wait for tomorrow to come.
entries.literal: "I stared at it for a bit, but I gave up after a short while. I just wanted to go home and wait for tomorrow to come."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd always liked walking through that street, but I turned around and moved to Ramon as I stepped through the thin, parallel path.
entries.literal: "I'd always liked walking through that street, but I turned around and moved to Ramon as I stepped through the thin, parallel path."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Tomorrow, I'll definitely have to take our tickets, no matter how. It might not be as much of a priority as I thought, though.{w} If I find the Sekimeiya in the tower and enter it during the night, I'll either travel through time or be caught by the police. If I travel through time, taking our tickets won't matter since I'll change the past. ...And if I get caught by the police, there's no way Atsuki won't learn about it. I'm not sure what would happen to my other self, but I doubt she and Atsuki would just go to the tower on the 15th.
entries.literal: "...Tomorrow, I'll definitely have to take our tickets, no matter how. It might not be as much of a priority as I thought, though.{w} If I find the Sekimeiya in the tower and enter it during the night, I'll either travel through time or be caught by the police. If I travel through time, taking our tickets won't matter since I'll change the past. ...And if I get caught by the police, there's no way Atsuki won't learn about it. I'm not sure what would happen to my other self, but I doubt she and Atsuki would just go to the tower on the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I would still do it, just in case. For the time being, I simply kept going over the lottery numbers in my head, slowly approaching my apartment. When I was getting close, I saw the footprints I'd left earlier, but again, it seemed that the previous day's weren't there. ...However much my steps left impressions, it was clear that they were all bound to eventually fade.
entries.literal: "I would still do it, just in case. For the time being, I simply kept going over the lottery numbers in my head, slowly approaching my apartment. When I was getting close, I saw the footprints I'd left earlier, but again, it seemed that the previous day's weren't there. ...However much my steps left impressions, it was clear that they were all bound to eventually fade."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, it was warm inside my apartment again. I shrugged off my coat almost immediately.
entries.literal: "Of course, it was warm inside my apartment again. I shrugged off my coat almost immediately."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at my phone. It was {time=14:04.}{w} There was nothing else I wanted to do for the day, so I went to the kitchen after a long pause.
entries.literal: "I looked at my phone. It was {time=14:04.}{w} There was nothing else I wanted to do for the day, so I went to the kitchen after a long pause."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As much as I disliked the idea of eating noodles again, I had nothing else. I didn't want to go buy food again because I'd just feel like I was doing something else in Yushibana for the last time. Like the day before, I washed the only pot I had and boiled a bit of water before dropping a stiff block of noodles in it.
entries.literal: "As much as I disliked the idea of eating noodles again, I had nothing else. I didn't want to go buy food again because I'd just feel like I was doing something else in Yushibana for the last time. Like the day before, I washed the only pot I had and boiled a bit of water before dropping a stiff block of noodles in it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited for them to be cooked, sparingly moving them with two new chopsticks. When four minutes had passed, I poured most of the liquid out and let the noodles fall into a bowl.
entries.literal: "I waited for them to be cooked, sparingly moving them with two new chopsticks. When four minutes had passed, I poured most of the liquid out and let the noodles fall into a bowl."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew exactly what their taste would be before I began to eat. It was really getting old, but I powered through.
entries.literal: "I knew exactly what their taste would be before I began to eat. It was really getting old, but I powered through."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The bowl was empty, and I could hardly tell I'd just eaten. I tried to lie on the floor, but it was a bit uncomfortable for my stomach. Instead, I grabbed the bowl and brought it back to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "The bowl was empty, and I could hardly tell I'd just eaten. I tried to lie on the floor, but it was a bit uncomfortable for my stomach. Instead, I grabbed the bowl and brought it back to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I placed it in the sink and opened the cabinet with the food I'd bought. After inspecting it briefly, I indifferently closed the wooden door.
entries.literal: "I placed it in the sink and opened the cabinet with the food I'd bought. After inspecting it briefly, I indifferently closed the wooden door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to drop the packaging of the noodles into the trash, but I remembered I'd thrown out the bag earlier. I took the roll out of a drawer and placed a new, empty bag in the corner. I thought back on the tickets and looked inside my purse. I'd left both of them there, so I threw them in the garbage as well.
entries.literal: "I was about to drop the packaging of the noodles into the trash, but I remembered I'd thrown out the bag earlier.
