I took the roll out of a drawer and placed a new, empty bag in the corner. I thought back on the tickets and looked inside my purse. I'd left both of them there, so I threw them in the garbage as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went back to sit on one of the scattered cushions. As much as I felt incredibly overwhelmed, I was out of things to think about. Eventually, I dropped on the floor and emptily let time pass.
entries.literal: "I went back to sit on one of the scattered cushions. As much as I felt incredibly overwhelmed, I was out of things to think about. Eventually, I dropped on the floor and emptily let time pass."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was surreal to think the walls around me, which I'd seen for so many years, could soon disappear forever. There was so much uncertainty.
entries.literal: "It was surreal to think the walls around me, which I'd seen for so many years, could soon disappear forever. There was so much uncertainty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter what awaited... my future was going to be miserable. Every scenario led to roughly the same thing.
entries.literal: "No matter what awaited... my future was going to be miserable. Every scenario led to roughly the same thing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...How was it going to be anything better than terrible? I would either get caught by the police or have to keep on living with sketchy money I wasn't even sure I knew how to obtain.
entries.literal: "...How was it going to be anything better than terrible? I would either get caught by the police or have to keep on living with sketchy money I wasn't even sure I knew how to obtain."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'd have no proper identity and no idea how to get a new one or do anything else... There's no way this will work, and the other version of me will live her life completely clueless, maybe until she finds out she was arrested somewhere.
entries.literal: "I'd have no proper identity and no idea how to get a new one or do anything else... There's no way this will work, and the other version of me will live her life completely clueless, maybe until she finds out she was arrested somewhere."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even if none of those options occur... if I can't go back in time again, but I also don't get caught... What the hell happens then? I'd just have to explain everything to Atsuki and myself. ...What would my thoughts have been if another version of myself appeared like that during the impact of Miiya's death?
entries.literal: "Even if none of those options occur... if I can't go back in time again, but I also don't get caught... What the hell happens then? I'd just have to explain everything to Atsuki and myself. ...What would my thoughts have been if another version of myself appeared like that during the impact of Miiya's death?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There really wasn't a good possible way it could all end. Even though I'd chosen the sole path that could save Miiya, achieving it was actually no guarantee.
entries.literal: "There really wasn't a good possible way it could all end. Even though I'd chosen the sole path that could save Miiya, achieving it was actually no guarantee."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At this time tomorrow, I'll already have been in the tower, and I'll be thinking about the best way to act. If I can't pull things off in the night, what the hell will I say to the police? They'll immediately realize another me is in the hospital.
entries.literal: "At this time tomorrow, I'll already have been in the tower, and I'll be thinking about the best way to act. If I can't pull things off in the night, what the hell will I say to the police? They'll immediately realize another me is in the hospital."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wonder what would happen if I revealed what the Sekimeiya can do. They'd have to believe me due to my existence.{w} And then what? Would they let me go with no real identity of my own? Would the Sekimeiya be kept a secret? If so, there's no chance I'd be able to live anything akin to a normal life.{w} Honestly, maybe getting caught by the police would be better... Or, if I'm able to save Miiya, I could reveal myself, and they'd decide what to do.
entries.literal: "I wonder what would happen if I revealed what the Sekimeiya can do. They'd have to believe me due to my existence.{w} And then what? Would they let me go with no real identity of my own? Would the Sekimeiya be kept a secret? If so, there's no chance I'd be able to live anything akin to a normal life.{w} Honestly, maybe getting caught by the police would be better... Or, if I'm able to save Miiya, I could reveal myself, and they'd decide what to do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I realized I'd just thought that and pitied myself. I'd been feeling sporadic senses of liberty the past few days after being shut away for so long, so the fact that I'd seen an outcome deprived of any freedom as acceptable was just disheartening.
entries.literal: "...{w}I realized I'd just thought that and pitied myself. I'd been feeling sporadic senses of liberty the past few days after being shut away for so long, so the fact that I'd seen an outcome deprived of any freedom as acceptable was just disheartening."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was undoubtedly absurd that I'd held off from going to the tower for so long. My hesitation could have doomed me at any point. I was just selfish. I wanted those tranquil days to continue despite knowing they couldn't—being in my living room was proof enough of that...
entries.literal: "It was undoubtedly absurd that I'd held off from going to the tower for so long. My hesitation could have doomed me at any point. I was just selfish. I wanted those tranquil days to continue despite knowing they couldn't—being in my living room was proof enough of that..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It appeared to just be misfortune that what I wanted was the single thing that definitely couldn't happen. Ironically, there was no going back. The important decision had already been made, and I was only stalling out the clock.
entries.literal: "It appeared to just be misfortune that what I wanted was the single thing that definitely couldn't happen. Ironically, there was no going back. The important decision had already been made, and I was only stalling out the clock."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind hadn't changed, and if I went back to the time I'd decided, the result wouldn't differ. It had been clear from the beginning that there was no win-win situation.
entries.literal: "My mind hadn't changed, and if I went back to the time I'd decided, the result wouldn't differ. It had been clear from the beginning that there was no win-win situation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't possible to go back to my old world, not even with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It wasn't possible to go back to my old world, not even with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I traveled days through time, I wouldn't be able to let everything play out as it once had anymore. There were people who'd traveled from the 15th and changed history... In the blink of an eye, the world I'd always lived in had distanced from me so much that it was no longer reachable.
entries.literal: "If I traveled days through time, I wouldn't be able to let everything play out as it once had anymore. There were people who'd traveled from the 15th and changed history... In the blink of an eye, the world I'd always lived in had distanced from me so much that it was no longer reachable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So, with no room for doubt, attempting to save Miiya was what I had to do. I needed to figure out a way to travel days through time once more and save her. If I took the Sekimeiya before November 27th, that'd be the best I could do. ...And then, after that would come a new decision, almost as important as the last.
entries.literal: "So, with no room for doubt, attempting to save Miiya was what I had to do. I needed to figure out a way to travel days through time once more and save her. If I took the Sekimeiya before November 27th, that'd be the best I could do. ...And then, after that would come a new decision, almost as important as the last."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After lying on the floor for so long, my nervousness gradually dissipated. There was no way I'd be able to calm myself the next day, but the beige walls of my living room were oddly relaxing.
entries.literal: "After lying on the floor for so long, my nervousness gradually dissipated. There was no way I'd be able to calm myself the next day, but the beige walls of my living room were oddly relaxing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Maybe I really was spending my last hours there, as unbelievable as it felt. I was in a situation I didn't think anyone else had ever been in, and I was the one who had chosen to go through it alone. But I was at a point where I really had to believe in my decisions, and I was confident in thinking that giving myself that last day had been the right thing.
entries.literal: "Maybe I really was spending my last hours there, as unbelievable as it felt. I was in a situation I didn't think anyone else had ever been in, and I was the one who had chosen to go through it alone. But I was at a point where I really had to believe in my decisions, and I was confident in thinking that giving myself that last day had been the right thing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't keep the myriad of thoughts from circling through my mind, but they eventually faded into the background. Time advanced, the light slowly abandoning the room.
entries.literal: "I couldn't keep the myriad of thoughts from circling through my mind, but they eventually faded into the background. Time advanced, the light slowly abandoning the room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}What the hell was I thinking?
entries.literal: "...{w}What the hell was I thinking?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd had to keep so many things in mind that I couldn't really be surprised I'd made such a large oversight.
entries.literal: "I'd had to keep so many things in mind that I couldn't really be surprised I'd made such a large oversight."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I took Isla's and Erina's tickets to prevent them from going to the tower on the 15th. It sounded like a good idea because they could've sold out quickly...{w} I completely ignored that they could simply print them out again. ...I don't think they'd have to buy new ones.
entries.literal: "I took Isla's and Erina's tickets to prevent them from going to the tower on the 15th. It sounded like a good idea because they could've sold out quickly...{w} I completely ignored that they could simply print them out again. ...I don't think they'd have to buy new ones."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed, exasperated. I'd never had a printer, so I hadn't thought it through. I knew Atsuki and I hadn't checked our tickets until the 14th, but we would've been able to print new ones if they hadn't been there.
entries.literal: "I sighed, exasperated. I'd never had a printer, so I hadn't thought it through. I knew Atsuki and I hadn't checked our tickets until the 14th, but we would've been able to print new ones if they hadn't been there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How the hell do I do this, then? Unless Erina and Isla don't notice that their tickets are gone until they're in the tower, they can just go anyway.{w} At least in the case of Atsuki and myself, it was seeing our tickets that made us decide to go through with attending the event, so we might actually not go if I do take them.
entries.literal: "How the hell do I do this, then? Unless Erina and Isla don't notice that their tickets are gone until they're in the tower, they can just go anyway.{w} At least in the case of Atsuki and myself, it was seeing our tickets that made us decide to go through with attending the event, so we might actually not go if I do take them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really didn't want to think very hard about it, but I wasn't too worried. If I got caught by the police, Atsuki and I probably wouldn't go to the event, but if I wasn't able to find the Sekimeiya, I'd have to think of something else. Maybe a note wasn't a horrible idea, or I could break his printer. There had to be at least one way to stop Atsuki and me from going.
entries.literal: "I really didn't want to think very hard about it, but I wasn't too worried. If I got caught by the police, Atsuki and I probably wouldn't go to the event, but if I wasn't able to find the Sekimeiya, I'd have to think of something else. Maybe a note wasn't a horrible idea, or I could break his printer. There had to be at least one way to stop Atsuki and me from going."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And Erina and Isla... If I'm not able to travel, I could just try to talk to them again, but I'm not sure what I'd say. I wonder if they'd accuse me of stealing their tickets if I suddenly show up warning them not to go.
entries.literal: "And Erina and Isla... If I'm not able to travel, I could just try to talk to them again, but I'm not sure what I'd say. I wonder if they'd accuse me of stealing their tickets if I suddenly show up warning them not to go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd think about that tomorrow, after getting inside the tower.
entries.literal: "I'd think about that tomorrow, after getting inside the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't moved in too long, and I'd begun to feel tired. The sun was setting, so my body was requesting that I sleep at the same time it had gotten accustomed to.
entries.literal: "I hadn't moved in too long, and I'd begun to feel tired. The sun was setting, so my body was requesting that I sleep at the same time it had gotten accustomed to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed laughable to think I'd be able to fall asleep. I could try to quell the onslaught of my thoughts, but there was no getting rid of them.
entries.literal: "It seemed laughable to think I'd be able to fall asleep. I could try to quell the onslaught of my thoughts, but there was no getting rid of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, the same sharp pain hit me when I thought that it could have been my last night in that apartment. If I managed to go back in time the next day, it really was possible I'd never rest in my bed again.
entries.literal: "Once again, the same sharp pain hit me when I thought that it could have been my last night in that apartment. If I managed to go back in time the next day, it really was possible I'd never rest in my bed again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I already thought of this, but I shouldn't take it lightly. How exactly am I going to get in the tower tomorrow night if I'm getting tired at this time?
entries.literal: "I already thought of this, but I shouldn't take it lightly. How exactly am I going to get in the tower tomorrow night if I'm getting tired at this time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd enter the tower with a plan in mind. It could entail staying there for the entire duration or rushing out of the building with the Sekimeiya. While I wasn't sure yet, I didn't want to blow it due to a lack of sleep, and simply drinking coffee to stay awake had backfired numerous times.
entries.literal: "I'd enter the tower with a plan in mind. It could entail staying there for the entire duration or rushing out of the building with the Sekimeiya. While I wasn't sure yet, I didn't want to blow it due to a lack of sleep, and simply drinking coffee to stay awake had backfired numerous times."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought of placing the clothes I'd washed into the wardrobe, but I just couldn't bring myself to do it. There was nothing I could do but keep lying down, awaiting the time where I'd force myself into bed.
entries.literal: "I thought of placing the clothes I'd washed into the wardrobe, but I just couldn't bring myself to do it. There was nothing I could do but keep lying down, awaiting the time where I'd force myself into bed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But a while later, that time hadn't come. While I was tired, I couldn't manage to stand up, as that would mean finally abandoning the life I had.
entries.literal: "But a while later, that time hadn't come. While I was tired, I couldn't manage to stand up, as that would mean finally abandoning the life I had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...If I stayed on the floor, it would mean the last night in my bed had already happened, and for some reason, I preferred that.
entries.literal: "...If I stayed on the floor, it would mean the last night in my bed had already happened, and for some reason, I preferred that."

entries.text: Sleep Paralysis
entries.literal: "Sleep Paralysis"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I managed to stand up, but only to turn off the light.
entries.literal: "I managed to stand up, but only to turn off the light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room had become fully dark. I couldn't tell how much time had passed since I had looked away from the small, red light on the TV.
entries.literal: "The room had become fully dark. I couldn't tell how much time had passed since I had looked away from the small, red light on the TV."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I knew it had been a while. My head rested on a cushion, and the feel of the carpet was comforting. Even though I had no blanket, the heater allowed me to remain in the middle of the floor, contacting the table with my back.
entries.literal: "However, I knew it had been a while. My head rested on a cushion, and the feel of the carpet was comforting. Even though I had no blanket, the heater allowed me to remain in the middle of the floor, contacting the table with my back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I hadn't fallen asleep. I had only sensed time passing, my vivid trains of thought infinitely spiraling into chaotic repetition.
entries.literal: "But I hadn't fallen asleep. I had only sensed time passing, my vivid trains of thought infinitely spiraling into chaotic repetition."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That became mentally exhausting. I just wanted to fall asleep, but it didn't seem like it would ever happen.
entries.literal: "That became mentally exhausting. I just wanted to fall asleep, but it didn't seem like it would ever happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The absolute silence had persisted for what felt like hours. At one point, I realized that I'd fallen asleep just for my awareness to instantly return.
entries.literal: "The absolute silence had persisted for what felt like hours. At one point, I realized that I'd fallen asleep just for my awareness to instantly return."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That might've happened a few more times. However, I still felt as if I'd been awake the whole time, desperately trying to lose consciousness.
entries.literal: "That might've happened a few more times. However, I still felt as if I'd been awake the whole time, desperately trying to lose consciousness."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was the sun going to rise at any point? I had to go to the tower in the morning so that I had enough time until the next night.
entries.literal: "Was the sun going to rise at any point? I had to go to the tower in the morning so that I had enough time until the next night."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I thought of setting an alarm, but I couldn't briefly sleep and be drowsy on such an important day.
entries.literal: "...I thought of setting an alarm, but I couldn't briefly sleep and be drowsy on such an important day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been thinking about grabbing my phone for a while until I finally extended my arm and felt around the surface of the table. I dragged my phone toward me and shut my eyes tightly as I flipped it open.
entries.literal: "I'd been thinking about grabbing my phone for a while until I finally extended my arm and felt around the surface of the table. I dragged my phone toward me and shut my eyes tightly as I flipped it open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soft, blue light soaked through my eyelids, prompting me to raise them. Then, I stared at the upper corner and waited for my blurry vision to fade.
entries.literal: "Soft, blue light soaked through my eyelids, prompting me to raise them. Then, I stared at the upper corner and waited for my blurry vision to fade."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's so late...
entries.literal: "It's so late..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Next to the numbers, I saw the words "No service".
entries.literal: "...Next to the numbers, I saw the words \"No service\"."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't think I'd seen them before, but I closed my phone to combat an abrupt headache.
entries.literal: "I didn't think I'd seen them before, but I closed my phone to combat an abrupt headache."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After that, I dropped my head back on the pillow, starting to seriously worry.
entries.literal: "After that, I dropped my head back on the pillow, starting to seriously worry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way I'd be in time for the event that would start in four hours. ...At least that wasn't too important.
entries.literal: "There was no way I'd be in time for the event that would start in four hours. ...At least that wasn't too important."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it didn't feel like I'd ever fall asleep. When I had, I'd immediately reawakened, and once I'd seen the light of my phone, I couldn't get it out of my mind.
entries.literal: "But it didn't feel like I'd ever fall asleep. When I had, I'd immediately reawakened, and once I'd seen the light of my phone, I couldn't get it out of my mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The entrance fee on the 15th had been pretty expensive... I believed I had enough money in my wallet, but if not, I still had the option of buying a normal visit.
entries.literal: "The entrance fee on the 15th had been pretty expensive... I believed I had enough money in my wallet, but if not, I still had the option of buying a normal visit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I rolled onto my back. Being there was getting unbearable.
entries.literal: "I rolled onto my back. Being there was getting unbearable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Most of my stress had faded a long while ago, but that still hadn't been enough to fall asleep. The impression that I was wasting any of my time was intrusive.
entries.literal: "Most of my stress had faded a long while ago, but that still hadn't been enough to fall asleep. The impression that I was wasting any of my time was intrusive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I finally sat up and noticed that I really wasn't tired. After a short time, my constricting headache started to fade.
entries.literal: "I finally sat up and noticed that I really wasn't tired. After a short time, my constricting headache started to fade."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed my phone again. It was {time=5:30.}
entries.literal: "I grabbed my phone again. It was {time=5:30.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the 15th, we'd gone to the tower during the night because we hadn't been able to fall asleep. ...It was still very early, though.
entries.literal: "On the 15th, we'd gone to the tower during the night because we hadn't been able to fall asleep. ...It was still very early, though."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I go before sleeping, I could come back later and rest until the afternoon. If I'll have to spend a long time in the tower the next night, that'll help me not be exhausted.
entries.literal: "If I go before sleeping, I could come back later and rest until the afternoon. If I'll have to spend a long time in the tower the next night, that'll help me not be exhausted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was doubtful I'd be able to sleep after coming back, when I'd finally be aware of the crucial details I needed.{w} But since it was likely Atsuki wouldn't be at home late in the day, I didn't think it was a terrible idea.
entries.literal: "It was doubtful I'd be able to sleep after coming back, when I'd finally be aware of the crucial details I needed.{w} But since it was likely Atsuki wouldn't be at home late in the day, I didn't think it was a terrible idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way I'd be able to lie back down again after sitting up, let alone sleep. I'd been on that carpet for so many hours.
entries.literal: "There was no way I'd be able to lie back down again after sitting up, let alone sleep. I'd been on that carpet for so many hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was still a bit dizzy, but I managed to carefully stand in the darkness and step out of the room.
entries.literal: "I was still a bit dizzy, but I managed to carefully stand in the darkness and step out of the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: More than three hours remained until {time=9}, when the tower's halls would open to the public. On the 15th, though, Atsuki and I had been in the lobby since much earlier.
entries.literal: "More than three hours remained until {time=9}, when the tower's halls would open to the public. On the 15th, though, Atsuki and I had been in the lobby since much earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know if it was a bad idea, but I grabbed my coat and stepped into the pair of boots on the floor. I gripped the door and slowly pushed it open.
entries.literal: "I didn't know if it was a bad idea, but I grabbed my coat and stepped into the pair of boots on the floor. I gripped the door and slowly pushed it open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The air was frigid as usual, but I couldn't feel any wind. A multitude of stars filled the dark sky, unmatched by the row of streetlights across the closest walkway. Not a soul could be seen, and the imposing atmosphere made me reconsider going out so early.
entries.literal: "The air was frigid as usual, but I couldn't feel any wind. A multitude of stars filled the dark sky, unmatched by the row of streetlights across the closest walkway. Not a soul could be seen, and the imposing atmosphere made me reconsider going out so early."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped forward, the snow stiff beneath my feet. I couldn't make out that layer of white anywhere but directly underneath the lights.
entries.literal: "I stepped forward, the snow stiff beneath my feet. I couldn't make out that layer of white anywhere but directly underneath the lights."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had my purse with me, so I closed the door and descended the stairs, purposely avoiding the frozen handrail.
entries.literal: "I had my purse with me, so I closed the door and descended the stairs, purposely avoiding the frozen handrail."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked in the direction of the tower. However, for once, I couldn't see it.
entries.literal: "I looked in the direction of the tower. However, for once, I couldn't see it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no chance I'd get lost, so I started to walk toward its location. As the tower was on the outskirts, the streetlights soon ceased, making me hug walls to know where I was.
entries.literal: "There was no chance I'd get lost, so I started to walk toward its location. As the tower was on the outskirts, the streetlights soon ceased, making me hug walls to know where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't very far, and despite the eerie scenery, I was glad I'd left my apartment. I had to be in the tower in the morning, and I knew its entrance opened far before {time=9.} A receptionist had been there when we'd arrived, so I could try to buy tickets for the event and think about questions I wanted to ask.
entries.literal: "It wasn't very far, and despite the eerie scenery, I was glad I'd left my apartment. I had to be in the tower in the morning, and I knew its entrance opened far before {time=9.} A receptionist had been there when we'd arrived, so I could try to buy tickets for the event and think about questions I wanted to ask."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept walking, hoping I was getting closer. I could hardly see anything a few steps ahead, and as all lights had disappeared, I had to confirm the sensation of movement by looking at the ground.
entries.literal: "I kept walking, hoping I was getting closer. I could hardly see anything a few steps ahead, and as all lights had disappeared, I had to confirm the sensation of movement by looking at the ground."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started to see more of the round light bulbs in the distance. I knew what it meant. That was the plaza in front of Ashiya Tower.
entries.literal: "I started to see more of the round light bulbs in the distance. I knew what it meant. That was the plaza in front of Ashiya Tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got closer and closer until I started to perceive the lights' quiet buzz. Then, I followed the path with my eyes, ending where the tower stood.
entries.literal: "I got closer and closer until I started to perceive the lights' quiet buzz. Then, I followed the path with my eyes, ending where the tower stood."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There it was. The immense building in the form of a huge shadow that covered the many stars behind it. I slowly got closer to it, interspersing the hum of the lights with sharp steps.
entries.literal: "There it was. The immense building in the form of a huge shadow that covered the many stars behind it. I slowly got closer to it, interspersing the hum of the lights with sharp steps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, before I expected to, I hit a wall.
entries.literal: "However, before I expected to, I hit a wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was the wall of the tower, which I suddenly hit with my foot. Startled, I felt it with my hand, expecting a cold stone.
entries.literal: "...It was the wall of the tower, which I suddenly hit with my foot. Startled, I felt it with my hand, expecting a cold stone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I touched something else entirely. My fingers felt a smooth, glassy surface, and as I stared at it with confusion, my vision adjusted just enough to understand where I was.
entries.literal: "But I touched something else entirely. My fingers felt a smooth, glassy surface, and as I stared at it with confusion, my vision adjusted just enough to understand where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was the door. No thick shutter was there either, as I could recognize the floor of the lobby a step beyond the glass.
entries.literal: "...It was the door. No thick shutter was there either, as I could recognize the floor of the lobby a step beyond the glass."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wondered to myself why I'd been surprised and immediately concluded that it was because there was no light. I'd suddenly hit the glass with no warning since the lights behind it weren't turned on.
entries.literal: "I wondered to myself why I'd been surprised and immediately concluded that it was because there was no light. I'd suddenly hit the glass with no warning since the lights behind it weren't turned on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of putting my hand back in my pocket, I grabbed my phone. The screen displayed {time=5:48.} Then, I hesitantly gripped the handle of the door and tried to open it.{w} Like it seemed, it was locked.
entries.literal: "Instead of putting my hand back in my pocket, I grabbed my phone. The screen displayed {time=5:48.} Then, I hesitantly gripped the handle of the door and tried to open it.{w} Like it seemed, it was locked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped back carefully, trying to get a feel for my surroundings.{w} ...And all I determined was that I was completely alone.
entries.literal: "I stepped back carefully, trying to get a feel for my surroundings.{w} ...And all I determined was that I was completely alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the 15th, that door had been highlighted by the warm light behind it, and we'd entered it at {time=6.}
entries.literal: "On the 15th, that door had been highlighted by the warm light behind it, and we'd entered it at {time=6.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That time was very close, but I began to wonder whether that had been a special occasion. Maybe they'd anticipated people would come very early and that was why the tower had been open at {time=6.}
entries.literal: "That time was very close, but I began to wonder whether that had been a special occasion. Maybe they'd anticipated people would come very early and that was why the tower had been open at {time=6.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Over three hours were left until {time=9.} When would the entrance open? I had no way to know how long I'd have to wait.
entries.literal: "...Over three hours were left until {time=9.} When would the entrance open? I had no way to know how long I'd have to wait."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I leaned on the icy metal of a nearby streetlight, the cold penetrating to my back. The light made my misty breath visible, emphasizing the harsh cold even further. Without a doubt, I wouldn't be able to stay there for long.
entries.literal: "I leaned on the icy metal of a nearby streetlight, the cold penetrating to my back. The light made my misty breath visible, emphasizing the harsh cold even further. Without a doubt, I wouldn't be able to stay there for long."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't take my eyes off the entrance, but I could hardly see it from where I'd moved to. As I waited outside, I knew people were behind the wall. At the very least, I knew someone was in the security room, waiting for a sudden attack that could come at any moment.
entries.literal: "I didn't take my eyes off the entrance, but I could hardly see it from where I'd moved to. As I waited outside, I knew people were behind the wall. At the very least, I knew someone was in the security room, waiting for a sudden attack that could come at any moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood, covering my neck as much as I could. The ring of lights let me see slightly ahead in every direction, but past them, there was only darkness.
entries.literal: "I stood, covering my neck as much as I could. The ring of lights let me see slightly ahead in every direction, but past them, there was only darkness."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I figured something had to happen soon, but even if I wanted to, I didn't feel capable of turning back. If I moved again, I wouldn't be able to withstand the temperature, and physical fatigue was beginning to set back in.
entries.literal: "I figured something had to happen soon, but even if I wanted to, I didn't feel capable of turning back. If I moved again, I wouldn't be able to withstand the temperature, and physical fatigue was beginning to set back in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I felt like I'd been there for some time, I slowly took my hand out of my fuzzy coat, and with my thumb, I flipped open my phone to look at the time again.
entries.literal: "When I felt like I'd been there for some time, I slowly took my hand out of my fuzzy coat, and with my thumb, I flipped open my phone to look at the time again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {time=6:03.}..{w} It had only been a few minutes, and the words "No service" were still there.
entries.literal: "{time=6:03.}..{w} It had only been a few minutes, and the words \"No service\" were still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd also looked at my phone on the 15th, before we'd been asked to leave them behind with the guards. By {time=6:03}, we'd already been allowed to step in.
entries.literal: "I'd also looked at my phone on the 15th, before we'd been asked to leave them behind with the guards. By {time=6:03}, we'd already been allowed to step in."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How much longer do I have to be here...? Is the tower not going to open until {time=9}?
entries.literal: "How much longer do I have to be here...? Is the tower not going to open until {time=9}?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was still staring at the building. Any moment, the light behind the glass could turn on. Maybe someone would come and unlock it from the outside. ...There was no way it would remain closed for three more hours.
entries.literal: "I was still staring at the building. Any moment, the light behind the glass could turn on. Maybe someone would come and unlock it from the outside. ...There was no way it would remain closed for three more hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without needing to look at my phone, I knew the time was passing glacially. The few minutes I'd been there had already felt much longer.
entries.literal: "Without needing to look at my phone, I knew the time was passing glacially. The few minutes I'd been there had already felt much longer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Somehow, they had also passed very quickly. Had I really been there for more than twenty minutes? I felt as if even my mind had frozen through, a complete opposite from the spiraling mess it'd been at home.
entries.literal: "...Somehow, they had also passed very quickly. Had I really been there for more than twenty minutes? I felt as if even my mind had frozen through, a complete opposite from the spiraling mess it'd been at home."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to close my eyes and slowly sit on the ground. Everything around me was dark enough that it wouldn't have made much difference, and it almost felt like my body was gradually sliding down the streetlight anyway.
entries.literal: "I wanted to close my eyes and slowly sit on the ground. Everything around me was dark enough that it wouldn't have made much difference, and it almost felt like my body was gradually sliding down the streetlight anyway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hoped I was retaining enough of my scarce strength to be able to walk into the building when the time came. I still believed that the lights would suddenly turn on, but I hadn't sensed a thing since I'd stopped moving.
entries.literal: "I hoped I was retaining enough of my scarce strength to be able to walk into the building when the time came. I still believed that the lights would suddenly turn on, but I hadn't sensed a thing since I'd stopped moving."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I looked at the time again, it was {time=6:28.} Once more, it seemed as if the last half hour had happened in an instant, while the next one would last an eternity.
entries.literal: "When I looked at the time again, it was {time=6:28.} Once more, it seemed as if the last half hour had happened in an instant, while the next one would last an eternity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why was nothing happening? Even though it was so early, why was I alone? On the 15th, the group of people waiting for the event had begun hours before it started. Had that never been the case before?
entries.literal: "Why was nothing happening? Even though it was so early, why was I alone? On the 15th, the group of people waiting for the event had begun hours before it started. Had that never been the case before?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even so, when would the door open? It was horrible not knowing how long I'd have to be there for.
entries.literal: "Even so, when would the door open? It was horrible not knowing how long I'd have to be there for."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The woman who was at the reception desk should come at any time. She was here so early, and so were the guards.
entries.literal: "...The woman who was at the reception desk should come at any time. She was here so early, and so were the guards."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, Katei too. ...He said he'd been taking the daily shifts recently.{w} Uh... did he say when he started? ...It should also be well before {time=9.}
entries.literal: "Oh, Katei too. ...He said he'd been taking the daily shifts recently.{w} Uh... did he say when he started? ...It should also be well before {time=9.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't do anything but keep waiting. I desperately needed that door to open, and I had only managed to stay out in the cold for so long because I believed it would.
entries.literal: "I couldn't do anything but keep waiting. I desperately needed that door to open, and I had only managed to stay out in the cold for so long because I believed it would."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to move my right hand, but I couldn't feel the soft touch of my pocket anymore. ...Was something really going to happen?
entries.literal: "I tried to move my right hand, but I couldn't feel the soft touch of my pocket anymore. ...Was something really going to happen?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was hard to breathe properly, and the sporadic, soft wind began to feel painful. The harsh electric sound, which I'd thought to be minor upon arriving, was practically blaring.
entries.literal: "It was hard to breathe properly, and the sporadic, soft wind began to feel painful. The harsh electric sound, which I'd thought to be minor upon arriving, was practically blaring."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had been there for an hour, and not a thing had changed. I blanched at the thought of waiting for two more hours, but the longer it went on, the sooner I thought it had to end.
entries.literal: "I had been there for an hour, and not a thing had changed. I blanched at the thought of waiting for two more hours, but the longer it went on, the sooner I thought it had to end."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The night had stretched out for so long that my eyes were beginning to close on their own. I just wanted to lie in my bed...
entries.literal: "The night had stretched out for so long that my eyes were beginning to close on their own. I just wanted to lie in my bed..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The last stretch would not be any easier on me. Soon, Ina would open, but there was no way I could walk there. The temperature inside the tower was regulated, and that was where I needed to be.
entries.literal: "The last stretch would not be any easier on me. Soon, Ina would open, but there was no way I could walk there. The temperature inside the tower was regulated, and that was where I needed to be."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The same wait continued until {time=7} came. The time I'd spent could've been summarized in a blink, as each second had been identical.
entries.literal: "The same wait continued until {time=7} came. The time I'd spent could've been summarized in a blink, as each second had been identical."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When would something happen...!? I wanted to sleep and know where the Sekimeiya was. I just needed to step into the tower, but why was it not open already? I had hit the point of real, pressing fear.
entries.literal: "When would something happen...!? I wanted to sleep and know where the Sekimeiya was. I just needed to step into the tower, but why was it not open already? I had hit the point of real, pressing fear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't think straight. That small plaza was the only illuminated place I could see, and I had to be as close to the entrance as I could.
entries.literal: "I couldn't think straight. That small plaza was the only illuminated place I could see, and I had to be as close to the entrance as I could."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I looked up, but I couldn't see anything past the dark, monolithic slab of the building.{w} I hadn't moved in so long that turning my head was painful. I had to do it slowly, but I managed to see the stars.
entries.literal: "...{w}I looked up, but I couldn't see anything past the dark, monolithic slab of the building.{w} I hadn't moved in so long that turning my head was painful. I had to do it slowly, but I managed to see the stars."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Wait...{w} Am I crazy...?
entries.literal: "...Wait...{w} Am I crazy...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the same starry sky. Just like everything below it, nothing had changed above.
entries.literal: "It was the same starry sky. Just like everything below it, nothing had changed above."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...? This doesn't make any sense.{w} Where's...{w} the sun?
entries.literal: "What...? This doesn't make any sense.{w} Where's...{w} the sun?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared up with wide eyes. The dark sky looked just as it had when I'd left my apartment.
entries.literal: "I stared up with wide eyes. The dark sky looked just as it had when I'd left my apartment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, speechless, I looked back at my phone.{w} {time=7:04.}
entries.literal: "Then, speechless, I looked back at my phone.{w} {time=7:04.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't understand... It's like the world has stopped moving.{w} No service... Why? Why does my phone have no service!?
entries.literal: "I don't understand... It's like the world has stopped moving.{w} No service... Why? Why does my phone have no service!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd witnessed the sun rising from behind the mountains countless times. But at that moment, no hint of light peeked out from over them. It was {time=7} already, so why was Yushibana still covered in darkness?
entries.literal: "I'd witnessed the sun rising from behind the mountains countless times. But at that moment, no hint of light peeked out from over them. It was {time=7} already, so why was Yushibana still covered in darkness?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd felt that time might not have been passing since I'd leaned on that streetlight. Astonished, I forced myself to step forward and spun.{w} Nothing at all had changed.
entries.literal: "I'd felt that time might not have been passing since I'd leaned on that streetlight. Astonished, I forced myself to step forward and spun.{w} Nothing at all had changed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no meaning I could think of. After all, no matter how certain I felt, it was impossible that everything had just stopped. Inevitably, the sun would rise, obliterating the night.
entries.literal: "There was no meaning I could think of. After all, no matter how certain I felt, it was impossible that everything had just stopped. Inevitably, the sun would rise, obliterating the night."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But with each second that seemingly passed, the more I doubted any had. I'd spent what seemed like eons convinced the lights in the lobby would turn on at any moment, and they still hadn't.
entries.literal: "But with each second that seemingly passed, the more I doubted any had. I'd spent what seemed like eons convinced the lights in the lobby would turn on at any moment, and they still hadn't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was I waiting for? The tower should've opened already. Without a doubt, the sun should've begun to rise already.{w} ...Waiting had become my only protest, but time staunchly refused to advance to the next day.
entries.literal: "What was I waiting for? The tower should've opened already. Without a doubt, the sun should've begun to rise already.{w} ...Waiting had become my only protest, but time staunchly refused to advance to the next day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nothing else I could do. I wanted to fall back into my bed and feel the warmth of my apartment, but my legs wouldn't be able to carry me far from that undefined plaza.
entries.literal: "There was nothing else I could do. I wanted to fall back into my bed and feel the warmth of my apartment, but my legs wouldn't be able to carry me far from that undefined plaza."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two days before then, I'd also felt like the world had something wrong with it, but everything had solved itself in the end. Was the same thing happening again? How long had I waited then for normalcy to return?
entries.literal: "Two days before then, I'd also felt like the world had something wrong with it, but everything had solved itself in the end. Was the same thing happening again? How long had I waited then for normalcy to return?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way I was in the wrong, like I'd thought the other day. Nobody was there; everything felt still, and it had even since I'd arrived. I was alone among nothingness. The light above me was a star, and everything for light years around was the void.
entries.literal: "There was no way I was in the wrong, like I'd thought the other day. Nobody was there; everything felt still, and it had even since I'd arrived. I was alone among nothingness. The light above me was a star, and everything for light years around was the void."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hugged my body even tighter. I'd been convinced the cold would end at some point, but it continued without end, eroding me. Would {time=9} be no different? I could no longer tell myself it was impossible.
entries.literal: "I hugged my body even tighter. I'd been convinced the cold would end at some point, but it continued without end, eroding me. Would {time=9} be no different? I could no longer tell myself it was impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My eyes remained locked to the sky. I was terrified, desperately wishing that I was back in my room, but simultaneously overcome with curiosity. Both of those conflicting feelings locked me in place.
entries.literal: "My eyes remained locked to the sky. I was terrified, desperately wishing that I was back in my room, but simultaneously overcome with curiosity. Both of those conflicting feelings locked me in place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't make any sense. Where was the light, the people, or the real world? Traveling through time with the Sekimeiya, as insane as it had been, was at least clearly traveling through time. I had no idea what I was experiencing in front of the tower. It had no name, no concept.
entries.literal: "It didn't make any sense. Where was the light, the people, or the real world? Traveling through time with the Sekimeiya, as insane as it had been, was at least clearly traveling through time. I had no idea what I was experiencing in front of the tower. It had no name, no concept."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to go back home. Even though I felt almost unable to walk, I was only a few minutes away, and every second I waited slightly reduced the energy I had to go back.
entries.literal: "I had to go back home. Even though I felt almost unable to walk, I was only a few minutes away, and every second I waited slightly reduced the energy I had to go back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even so, I was hypnotized by that unchanging sky. Was there an explanation behind the state of the world, or was it another question without an answer?
entries.literal: "Even so, I was hypnotized by that unchanging sky. Was there an explanation behind the state of the world, or was it another question without an answer?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Time was certainly advancing, but I couldn't make out even a hint of a white outline. The sun was nowhere to be seen—not the faintest trace of it.
entries.literal: "Time was certainly advancing, but I couldn't make out even a hint of a white outline. The sun was nowhere to be seen—not the faintest trace of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If the world had frozen, would it ever unfreeze? If so, then the next question was whether I'd get to see that happen.
entries.literal: "If the world had frozen, would it ever unfreeze? If so, then the next question was whether I'd get to see that happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe my legs were still supporting my weight. There was nowhere to sit except the slick ground itself. Wanting to confirm how much time had passed, I painfully lowered my neck to look at my phone.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe my legs were still supporting my weight. There was nowhere to sit except the slick ground itself. Wanting to confirm how much time had passed, I painfully lowered my neck to look at my phone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {time=7:30.}..{w} "{tip=phone}No service{/tip}".{w} That time, I slowly moved my finger up to the call button.{w} It was freezing, but it still registered my touch. The moment I pressed it, I called my mother's number.
entries.literal: "{time=7:30.}..{w} \"{tip=phone}No service{/tip}\".{w} That time, I slowly moved my finger up to the call button.{w} It was freezing, but it still registered my touch. The moment I pressed it, I called my mother's number."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}A quiet, robotic voice came out of the speaker.
entries.literal: "...{w}A quiet, robotic voice came out of the speaker."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: We couldn't connect to the line.
entries.literal: "We couldn't connect to the line."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immediately, a beep played, indicating that the call had been cut.
entries.literal: "Immediately, a beep played, indicating that the call had been cut."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered something like a state of shock, unable to move the phone away from my ear. Something was very wrong—I could no longer believe anything else. The place I was at that moment was not the real world.
entries.literal: "I entered something like a state of shock, unable to move the phone away from my ear. Something was very wrong—I could no longer believe anything else. The place I was at that moment was not the real world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd gone back to looking at the sky. Where could I be if not in the real world? Was I in a dream after I'd finally fallen asleep on that soft carpet?
entries.literal: "I'd gone back to looking at the sky. Where could I be if not in the real world? Was I in a dream after I'd finally fallen asleep on that soft carpet?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Usually, verifying that would've been very simple. However, as I could hardly feel my skin anymore, even after pinching my hand, I wasn't able to conclude it was reality.
entries.literal: "Usually, verifying that would've been very simple. However, as I could hardly feel my skin anymore, even after pinching my hand, I wasn't able to conclude it was reality."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No, it was reality. The minimal sensation had been enough to confirm that. When we'd been in the tower, I'd felt almost the same way regarding how dreamlike everything was. Was there, then, an explanation behind an unmoving world?
entries.literal: "No, it was reality. The minimal sensation had been enough to confirm that. When we'd been in the tower, I'd felt almost the same way regarding how dreamlike everything was. Was there, then, an explanation behind an unmoving world?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who could possibly interpret anything about that explanation if it existed in the first place? Hadn't I been the only person to notice it two days earlier? After all, it felt as if I was the root cause. The world wasn't permitting me to enter the next day even though it already should have started.
entries.literal: "Who could possibly interpret anything about that explanation if it existed in the first place? Hadn't I been the only person to notice it two days earlier? After all, it felt as if I was the root cause. The world wasn't permitting me to enter the next day even though it already should have started."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If that was it, was there anything I could do? There were precisely zero ideas that came to mind about what was happening to me or how I could resolve it.
entries.literal: "If that was it, was there anything I could do? There were precisely zero ideas that came to mind about what was happening to me or how I could resolve it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And there was no fleeing either. If abandoning the idea of going to the tower would advance everything to the next day, there was no solution.
entries.literal: "And there was no fleeing either. If abandoning the idea of going to the tower would advance everything to the next day, there was no solution."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I could still somewhat feel my hand. What was clear was that staying still was getting me nowhere.
entries.literal: "...I could still somewhat feel my hand. What was clear was that staying still was getting me nowhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still gripping my phone, I took it out again. According to it, time had definitely been passing, as it showed {time=7:35.}
entries.literal: "Still gripping my phone, I took it out again. According to it, time had definitely been passing, as it showed {time=7:35.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Making sure I could still move my legs, I stepped closer to the building. Immediately, the bricks that formed the front wall became visible.
entries.literal: "Making sure I could still move my legs, I stepped closer to the building. Immediately, the bricks that formed the front wall became visible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The lobby looked as it had earlier, the tower just as unchanging as its surroundings. I stepped to the left, trying to make out the reception desk. Even though it was very dark, I was sure nobody was there.
entries.literal: "The lobby looked as it had earlier, the tower just as unchanging as its surroundings. I stepped to the left, trying to make out the reception desk. Even though it was very dark, I was sure nobody was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had little to no force left in the motion, but I grabbed the handle again and tried to push.
entries.literal: "I had little to no force left in the motion, but I grabbed the handle again and tried to push."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't budge at all.
entries.literal: "It didn't budge at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was close to me, somewhere behind that door. If the world had frozen in place, wasn't it the perfect opportunity to obtain it?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was close to me, somewhere behind that door. If the world had frozen in place, wasn't it the perfect opportunity to obtain it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't sense a single living thing anywhere, so there was no need to devise a plan. I just had to find the Sekimeiya and hope that after using it, things would fix themselves.
entries.literal: "I couldn't sense a single living thing anywhere, so there was no need to devise a plan. I just had to find the Sekimeiya and hope that after using it, things would fix themselves."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So I continued stepping away from the door until no light remained in front of me.
entries.literal: "So I continued stepping away from the door until no light remained in front of me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked forward, following the rough wall with my arm. It continued for a short while, but I soon lost it. When that happened, I turned to the right, and something cold hit my shins.
entries.literal: "I walked forward, following the rough wall with my arm. It continued for a short while, but I soon lost it. When that happened, I turned to the right, and something cold hit my shins."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was grass, covered with snow that I shook off before it could stick to me.
entries.literal: "It was grass, covered with snow that I shook off before it could stick to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I put out my right hand and walked ahead, tracing the wall with my bare fingers.
entries.literal: "Then, I put out my right hand and walked ahead, tracing the wall with my bare fingers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd gone around to the left side of the building, having considered the possibility of another way in.
entries.literal: "I'd gone around to the left side of the building, having considered the possibility of another way in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Going to the storeroom wasn't the only way to determine if that door really connected to the outside. ...It was completely dark, and the surface of the building was like a block of ice. However, if there was a door somewhere in it, I believed I could find it.
entries.literal: "Going to the storeroom wasn't the only way to determine if that door really connected to the outside. ...It was completely dark, and the surface of the building was like a block of ice. However, if there was a door somewhere in it, I believed I could find it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would I be able to open it if I did? It didn't sound likely, but there was a chance I could enter, and I no longer feared the possibility of someone seeing me through the cameras. Staying outside was far more intimidating.
entries.literal: "Would I be able to open it if I did? It didn't sound likely, but there was a chance I could enter, and I no longer feared the possibility of someone seeing me through the cameras. Staying outside was far more intimidating."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really was exhausted, and the tall grass made the path harder to get through. However, as it was fully dark, I had to be very attentive.
entries.literal: "I really was exhausted, and the tall grass made the path harder to get through. However, as it was fully dark, I had to be very attentive."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With my forefinger, I slowly traced a line through the wall, attempting to discern the thinnest gap that could've outlined a door.
entries.literal: "With my forefinger, I slowly traced a line through the wall, attempting to discern the thinnest gap that could've outlined a door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cold surface was uneven and bumpy, so I rapidly lost all hope. If there was a door somewhere, I wouldn't find it so easily even if I could roughly tell where the storeroom was. As I walked, the fear of passing out began to grow inside me.
entries.literal: "The cold surface was uneven and bumpy, so I rapidly lost all hope. If there was a door somewhere, I wouldn't find it so easily even if I could roughly tell where the storeroom was. As I walked, the fear of passing out began to grow inside me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, the wall ended, and I found myself at the back of the tower. In front of me, I could no longer see the stars, as an invisibly dark mountain extended just ahead.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, the wall ended, and I found myself at the back of the tower. In front of me, I could no longer see the stars, as an invisibly dark mountain extended just ahead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around and felt the wall again with my left hand. Eyes closed, I started to retrace my steps, feeling an awful mix of negative emotions.
entries.literal: "I turned around and felt the wall again with my left hand. Eyes closed, I started to retrace my steps, feeling an awful mix of negative emotions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I suddenly stopped when I remembered something from the day we'd been inside that immense building.{w} If that door had really led to the wall I was at, there was a way I could find it.
entries.literal: "But I suddenly stopped when I remembered something from the day we'd been inside that immense building.{w} If that door had really led to the wall I was at, there was a way I could find it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to forcefully press my hand against the wall. Naturally, nothing happened.
entries.literal: "I tried to forcefully press my hand against the wall. Naturally, nothing happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If a door was there, it must've been made or covered with the same bricks as everywhere else. However, when we'd been in the storeroom, we had shaken the door from the inside, and it had made a rattling sound.{w} ...If the other side was the wall, then shaking it from the outside would produce the same sound.
entries.literal: "If a door was there, it must've been made or covered with the same bricks as everywhere else. However, when we'd been in the storeroom, we had shaken the door from the inside, and it had made a rattling sound.{w} ...If the other side was the wall, then shaking it from the outside would produce the same sound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With no light bulbs around, all sound had disappeared, and during the winter, it was rare to hear insects at night. But the silence felt far too unnatural to be justified.
entries.literal: "With no light bulbs around, all sound had disappeared, and during the winter, it was rare to hear insects at night. But the silence felt far too unnatural to be justified."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took one step forward and softly hit the wall with a fist. All it produced was an instant, dry noise, and no part of the wall moved in the slightest.
entries.literal: "I took one step forward and softly hit the wall with a fist. All it produced was an instant, dry noise, and no part of the wall moved in the slightest."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled the width of the door and that I was definitely close to the storeroom. After the next step, I repeated the same tired motion, and the result was identical.
entries.literal: "I recalled the width of the door and that I was definitely close to the storeroom. After the next step, I repeated the same tired motion, and the result was identical."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I stepped again and hit the wall.
entries.literal: "Then, I stepped again and hit the wall."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was that it...?
entries.literal: "Was that it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound had been different. To confirm it, I hit the same spot, trying to apply a bit more strength I wasn't sure I had.
entries.literal: "The sound had been different. To confirm it, I hit the same spot, trying to apply a bit more strength I wasn't sure I had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound I heard was different.{w} Speechless, I extended my arm to the wall and pushed. When I did, I felt it move.
entries.literal: "The sound I heard was different.{w} Speechless, I extended my arm to the wall and pushed. When I did, I felt it move."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...? Did I open it?
entries.literal: "What...? Did I open it?"

entries.text: Bridge
entries.literal: "Bridge"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After so long, that was what made my heart speed up. I felt the edges and confirmed the outline of a door.{w} Akaro had been right after all. That door in the storeroom was the only thing blocking our way out.
entries.literal: "After so long, that was what made my heart speed up. I felt the edges and confirmed the outline of a door.{w} Akaro had been right after all. That door in the storeroom was the only thing blocking our way out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I'd gotten it to open easily just by pushing it. However, it had opened inwardly, which was why we hadn't been able to do it in the storeroom.
entries.literal: "...{w}I'd gotten it to open easily just by pushing it. However, it had opened inwardly, which was why we hadn't been able to do it in the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped toward the door. I couldn't see a thing, but when I felt the inner walls, I immediately identified them: I was back in the storeroom on the tower's crystal floor.
entries.literal: "I stepped toward the door. I couldn't see a thing, but when I felt the inner walls, I immediately identified them: I was back in the storeroom on the tower's crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I couldn't move. The fear of someone being in the security room resurfaced. If I walked forward and got caught, that was the end of everything.
entries.literal: "But I couldn't move. The fear of someone being in the security room resurfaced. If I walked forward and got caught, that was the end of everything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door was covered by bricks, and its gaps were incredibly thin. When I felt it from the inside, I noticed something very important.
entries.literal: "The door was covered by bricks, and its gaps were incredibly thin. When I felt it from the inside, I noticed something very important."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh... There's no handle. It was already gone that morning.
entries.literal: "Oh... There's no handle. It was already gone that morning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: More importantly, that meant that if I closed the door, I wouldn't be able to open it from the inside.
entries.literal: "More importantly, that meant that if I closed the door, I wouldn't be able to open it from the inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked deeper into the narrow entrance, leaving it open. There hadn't been much wind outside, so I didn't think it would close on its own.{w} Immediately, I hit another wall. It was what concealed the area I was in.
entries.literal: "I walked deeper into the narrow entrance, leaving it open. There hadn't been much wind outside, so I didn't think it would close on its own.{w} Immediately, I hit another wall. It was what concealed the area I was in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was in its regular position, separating both sides of the storeroom. I put my hand on it and felt it around the right edge, where the opening mechanism was.
entries.literal: "It was in its regular position, separating both sides of the storeroom. I put my hand on it and felt it around the right edge, where the opening mechanism was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From that side, the little aperture was noticeable to the touch. When I dragged the wall open, however, I couldn't see any difference, as there was no light beyond it.
entries.literal: "From that side, the little aperture was noticeable to the touch. When I dragged the wall open, however, I couldn't see any difference, as there was no light beyond it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took another cautious step and felt a soft texture. I really was in the storeroom. What I was making contact with was the damaged couch we'd seen next to the wall.
entries.literal: "I took another cautious step and felt a soft texture. I really was in the storeroom. What I was making contact with was the damaged couch we'd seen next to the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see anything, but I knew the door to hallway A was in front of me. ...Was it open or closed? While I couldn't know that, what I did know was that the lights were off on the other side.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see anything, but I knew the door to hallway A was in front of me. ...Was it open or closed? While I couldn't know that, what I did know was that the lights were off on the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no camera in the storeroom, but as soon as I opened the next door, I would be recorded. ...The question was whether the security room was vacant or not.
entries.literal: "There was no camera in the storeroom, but as soon as I opened the next door, I would be recorded. ...The question was whether the security room was vacant or not."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I didn't know what to do. Of course, there had to be someone in the security room, but there simultaneously couldn't be—the world had frozen.{w} What would happen if I was seen? I couldn't claim to have randomly found the hidden door.
entries.literal: "...{w}I didn't know what to do. Of course, there had to be someone in the security room, but there simultaneously couldn't be—the world had frozen.{w} What would happen if I was seen? I couldn't claim to have randomly found the hidden door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But the chance I had was perfect. The tower seemed lifeless, so I could find the Sekimeiya and leave. ...If it was true that nobody was there, I could even set off the alarm and let the Sekimeiya store time for twelve hours, as there wouldn't be anyone in the security room to complete the deactivation process.
entries.literal: "But the chance I had was perfect. The tower seemed lifeless, so I could find the Sekimeiya and leave. ...If it was true that nobody was there, I could even set off the alarm and let the Sekimeiya store time for twelve hours, as there wouldn't be anyone in the security room to complete the deactivation process."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ultimately, I reached my arm toward the door. The day would evidently never begin, so between attempting to walk back home and trying to obtain the Sekimeiya, the decision had already been made.
entries.literal: "Ultimately, I reached my arm toward the door. The day would evidently never begin, so between attempting to walk back home and trying to obtain the Sekimeiya, the decision had already been made."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a metallic knob and turned it. Once more, after opening a door, the darkness persisted.
entries.literal: "I felt a metallic knob and turned it. Once more, after opening a door, the darkness persisted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see hallway A, but I knew I was there. I was immediately certain that I wasn't in a dream due to my senses.{w} It was the smell. The same strange smell that had characterized the building on that long day tinged the air again.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see hallway A, but I knew I was there. I was immediately certain that I wasn't in a dream due to my senses.{w} It was the smell. The same strange smell that had characterized the building on that long day tinged the air again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I knew it wasn't the scent of the building itself. On the evening of the 15th, I'd identified the real source.{w} The Sekimeiya. When we'd been close to it, the smell had strengthened, and when we'd been farther from it, it had always been weaker.
entries.literal: "But I knew it wasn't the scent of the building itself. On the evening of the 15th, I'd identified the real source.{w} The Sekimeiya. When we'd been close to it, the smell had strengthened, and when we'd been farther from it, it had always been weaker."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I'd thought, the Sekimeiya had to be there, somewhere in the building. ...And going off the intensity, it was close.
entries.literal: "As I'd thought, the Sekimeiya had to be there, somewhere in the building. ...And going off the intensity, it was close."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't taken another step into the hallway, but I'd been there for some seconds and nothing had occurred. Then, I realized that my impression had been incorrect. After opening the door, there had been a subtle change I'd taken a bit to notice.
entries.literal: "I hadn't taken another step into the hallway, but I'd been there for some seconds and nothing had occurred. Then, I realized that my impression had been incorrect. After opening the door, there had been a subtle change I'd taken a bit to notice."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A tiny green light could be seen high up, slowly flickering. It belonged to a security camera.
entries.literal: "A tiny green light could be seen high up, slowly flickering. It belonged to a security camera."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We'd never learned the true meaning behind those lights. Did they indicate that I was being recorded or something else? Was my figure being displayed in the security room?
entries.literal: "We'd never learned the true meaning behind those lights. Did they indicate that I was being recorded or something else? Was my figure being displayed in the security room?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything was cold and still. The only remaining movement was from that inanimate light.
entries.literal: "Everything was cold and still. The only remaining movement was from that inanimate light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The security room had to be soulless, but I couldn't believe it. Even though that belief was close to proven, I couldn't accept it. Slowly, I began to take silent steps toward the metallic door.
entries.literal: "The security room had to be soulless, but I couldn't believe it. Even though that belief was close to proven, I couldn't accept it. Slowly, I began to take silent steps toward the metallic door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: An occurrence from the 15th was repeating. In just the short time I'd been there, the smell had blended in, becoming harder and harder to notice despite its prior strength.
entries.literal: "An occurrence from the 15th was repeating. In just the short time I'd been there, the smell had blended in, becoming harder and harder to notice despite its prior strength."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The first time we noticed this smell, wasn't Katei confused about it too? ...But if it came from the Sekimeiya, he should've smelled it during the previous two weeks...
entries.literal: "...The first time we noticed this smell, wasn't Katei confused about it too? ...But if it came from the Sekimeiya, he should've smelled it during the previous two weeks..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hit the wall at my side, failing to walk in a straight line. Carefully, I continued to move until I felt a doorknob.{w} It was the security room's, so I gently gripped it.
entries.literal: "I hit the wall at my side, failing to walk in a straight line. Carefully, I continued to move until I felt a doorknob.{w} It was the security room's, so I gently gripped it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to see it with my own eyes. Was nobody on the other side? It couldn't be. Ashiya had been anticipating Xyn's attack, so why would nobody be stationed at the cameras?
entries.literal: "I had to see it with my own eyes. Was nobody on the other side? It couldn't be. Ashiya had been anticipating Xyn's attack, so why would nobody be stationed at the cameras?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I knew the room would be empty because I hadn't been seen. When I slowly opened the door, nothing but darkness waited for me.
entries.literal: "But I knew the room would be empty because I hadn't been seen. When I slowly opened the door, nothing but darkness waited for me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nobody inside. I knew there were many monitors in front of me, but none of them were on.
entries.literal: "There was nobody inside. I knew there were many monitors in front of me, but none of them were on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was unbelievable. Why had all life vanished from the world? Why had all the surrounding lights gone dark when electricity still flowed?
entries.literal: "It was unbelievable. Why had all life vanished from the world? Why had all the surrounding lights gone dark when electricity still flowed?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked into the room as I recognized a red light near the floor, doubting whether the button it belonged to still functioned.
entries.literal: "I walked into the room as I recognized a red light near the floor, doubting whether the button it belonged to still functioned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached out and felt around in front of me. When I touched the chair, I moved it aside and crouched next to the light.
entries.literal: "I reached out and felt around in front of me. When I touched the chair, I moved it aside and crouched next to the light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pressed the button softly.
