entries.literal: "I pressed the button softly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A whirring sound came from my side. Following it, one of the screens turned on.
entries.literal: "A whirring sound came from my side. Following it, one of the screens turned on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The computer had powered on, and a single monitor displayed a loading bar. At last, I could see the dim walls around me, the blue light projecting onto them. Without a doubt, I was the only person there.
entries.literal: "The computer had powered on, and a single monitor displayed a loading bar. At last, I could see the dim walls around me, the blue light projecting onto them. Without a doubt, I was the only person there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, the bar filled and was replaced by an authentication screen. I remembered that Katei had entered a long ID and password, so there was no chance I could access it.
entries.literal: "Soon, the bar filled and was replaced by an authentication screen. I remembered that Katei had entered a long ID and password, so there was no chance I could access it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd confirmed I was alone, as ridiculous as it seemed. I was about to walk out when the messiness of the room caught my attention.
entries.literal: "I'd confirmed I was alone, as ridiculous as it seemed. I was about to walk out when the messiness of the room caught my attention."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The objects on the desk were scattered around, and almost all the drawers were partially open.
entries.literal: "The objects on the desk were scattered around, and almost all the drawers were partially open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...What had happened? On the 15th, when we'd stepped inside for the first time, the room had looked considerably different.
entries.literal: "...What had happened? On the 15th, when we'd stepped inside for the first time, the room had looked considerably different."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had someone tried to find something? ...I began to feel uneasy.
entries.literal: "Had someone tried to find something? ...I began to feel uneasy."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh... {w}This is...!
entries.literal: "Oh... {w}This is...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Glancing at the many open drawers, I saw something next to a pile of files.{w} I pulled the heavy compartment open and tried to reach the bottom with a finger.
entries.literal: "Glancing at the many open drawers, I saw something next to a pile of files.{w} I pulled the heavy compartment open and tried to reach the bottom with a finger."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...A brown key, large and rusty. After putting it in front of the light, I confirmed it was the one I suspected.
entries.literal: "...A brown key, large and rusty. After putting it in front of the light, I confirmed it was the one I suspected."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's the key we found on the floor of hallway A... We later thought it could've been for the storeroom door.
entries.literal: "It's the key we found on the floor of hallway A... We later thought it could've been for the storeroom door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And... it was in the security room.
entries.literal: "And... it was in the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There'd been a few reasons to think that the person who dropped the key was one of the culprits behind the attack.
entries.literal: "There'd been a few reasons to think that the person who dropped the key was one of the culprits behind the attack."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And at that moment, when it was essential for the cameras to be monitored, nobody was in the security room.
entries.literal: "And at that moment, when it was essential for the cameras to be monitored, nobody was in the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was there a reason after all? ...Could the frozen world have merely been an illusion?
entries.literal: "Was there a reason after all? ...Could the frozen world have merely been an illusion?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were many things that made me uneasy, so I walked to the door. My breathing had begun to accelerate.
entries.literal: "There were many things that made me uneasy, so I walked to the door. My breathing had begun to accelerate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The key was still in my hand. It was potentially an essential part of the culprit's plan, so I took it with me, accepting that the past could change. If there was no copy of it, it wouldn't be found in hallway A anymore, and the entire attack could fail depending on its importance.
entries.literal: "The key was still in my hand. It was potentially an essential part of the culprit's plan, so I took it with me, accepting that the past could change. If there was no copy of it, it wouldn't be found in hallway A anymore, and the entire attack could fail depending on its importance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt around the lobby door until I found its knob.
entries.literal: "I felt around the lobby door until I found its knob."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see a red light by the reception desk, but it wasn't enough to illuminate the lobby, even with the streetlights shining faintly from beyond the glass.{w} I questioned it again. Why was the entire floor dark when I'd been able to turn on the computer?
entries.literal: "I could see a red light by the reception desk, but it wasn't enough to illuminate the lobby, even with the streetlights shining faintly from beyond the glass.{w} I questioned it again. Why was the entire floor dark when I'd been able to turn on the computer?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the inside, the exterior door wasn't fully transparent, but it was enough to see that the sun hadn't risen yet. It seemed entirely futile to think about that.
entries.literal: "From the inside, the exterior door wasn't fully transparent, but it was enough to see that the sun hadn't risen yet. It seemed entirely futile to think about that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But if there really was a reason behind it, the mirrored stillness of the tower had the same cause. I could attempt to grasp it from that angle.
entries.literal: "But if there really was a reason behind it, the mirrored stillness of the tower had the same cause. I could attempt to grasp it from that angle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Disoriented, I walked across the smooth floor with my arm out. Where was the Sekimeiya? If Ashiya's intent was to make Xyn break open the cabinet, it couldn't be well-hidden.
entries.literal: "Disoriented, I walked across the smooth floor with my arm out. Where was the Sekimeiya? If Ashiya's intent was to make Xyn break open the cabinet, it couldn't be well-hidden."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a room below me. There'd been nothing in the storeroom, so the mechanical room was a rational place to store the cabinet.{w} But more importantly, I knew that the light breakers were there. There were no switches on the walls, so if the breakers were on, I would have no idea why the tower was still dark.
entries.literal: "There was a room below me. There'd been nothing in the storeroom, so the mechanical room was a rational place to store the cabinet.{w} But more importantly, I knew that the light breakers were there. There were no switches on the walls, so if the breakers were on, I would have no idea why the tower was still dark."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I followed the surface of the desk around. There, I searched across the wall until I'd taken hold of a door.
entries.literal: "I followed the surface of the desk around. There, I searched across the wall until I'd taken hold of a door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A tenebrous staircase led down from the other side of that door. I descended it, carefully placing each of my steps.
entries.literal: "A tenebrous staircase led down from the other side of that door. I descended it, carefully placing each of my steps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't as narrow as I recalled. The cabinet would have fit if brought down. After I made the sharp turn below, I felt the following door, which I accidentally opened with my knee.
entries.literal: "It wasn't as narrow as I recalled. The cabinet would have fit if brought down. After I made the sharp turn below, I felt the following door, which I accidentally opened with my knee."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The bulb was no longer emitting any light, but the difference was minimal. I knew the space was filled with furniture, so I gingerly stepped to the wall with the circuit breakers.
entries.literal: "...The bulb was no longer emitting any light, but the difference was minimal. I knew the space was filled with furniture, so I gingerly stepped to the wall with the circuit breakers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hit the plastic panel with my arm. Naturally, I couldn't see the state of the switches, so I hoped what I had at hand would be enough.
entries.literal: "I hit the plastic panel with my arm. Naturally, I couldn't see the state of the switches, so I hoped what I had at hand would be enough."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took out my phone and placed its screen in front of the panel.
entries.literal: "I took out my phone and placed its screen in front of the panel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The breakers were right behind it, so the faint light was enough to let me see the direction they were pointing to. I slowly panned the phone across the plastic surface, taking a look at all of them.
entries.literal: "The breakers were right behind it, so the faint light was enough to let me see the direction they were pointing to. I slowly panned the phone across the plastic surface, taking a look at all of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were all pointing up.
entries.literal: "They were all pointing up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...So, like with the sun, there was no reason behind the lack of light within the tower. It didn't make any sense, but I put my phone away and reached my arm back up.
entries.literal: "...So, like with the sun, there was no reason behind the lack of light within the tower. It didn't make any sense, but I put my phone away and reached my arm back up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When my phone had hit the plastic, I'd heard a metallic sound. As the ceiling was very low, I had no problem reaching the top of the panel.
entries.literal: "When my phone had hit the plastic, I'd heard a metallic sound. As the ceiling was very low, I had no problem reaching the top of the panel."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Uh...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two cold objects were there.
entries.literal: "Two cold objects were there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed them with two fingers and opened my palm. Even though I couldn't see anything, I could identify their shape.
entries.literal: "I grabbed them with two fingers and opened my palm. Even though I couldn't see anything, I could identify their shape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took my phone back out and directed its light at what I was holding.
entries.literal: "I took my phone back out and directed its light at what I was holding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {tip=keys}Two more keys{/tip}.{w} Once they were illuminated, I recognized them as well.
entries.literal: "{tip=keys}Two more keys{/tip}.{w} Once they were illuminated, I recognized them as well."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait... This is the attic's.
entries.literal: "Wait... This is the attic's."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But that wasn't all, because the other one was unmistakably the Sekimeiya cabinet's.
entries.literal: "But that wasn't all, because the other one was unmistakably the Sekimeiya cabinet's."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I... just have to find the cabinet, then...! I can just unlock it. I don't have to break it open.
entries.literal: "I... just have to find the cabinet, then...! I can just unlock it. I don't have to break it open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why the hell had those keys been there? Both of them were supposed to have few or no replicas and be carefully protected.
entries.literal: "Why the hell had those keys been there? Both of them were supposed to have few or no replicas and be carefully protected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing made any sense. How many mysteries layered around the Sekimeiya? ...I began to question what to do.
entries.literal: "Nothing made any sense. How many mysteries layered around the Sekimeiya? ...I began to question what to do."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I have to hurry and find the cabinet, but then what? Should I try to trigger the alarm or just silently unlock it and take the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...I have to hurry and find the cabinet, but then what? Should I try to trigger the alarm or just silently unlock it and take the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been recorded by cameras, so even though I had the cabinet key, shutting down the tower sounded like a fine idea. However, anyone who knew about the secret door could enter at any point.
entries.literal: "I'd been recorded by cameras, so even though I had the cabinet key, shutting down the tower sounded like a fine idea. However, anyone who knew about the secret door could enter at any point."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If the rusty key is really for that door, I could try to lock it from the inside...
entries.literal: "If the rusty key is really for that door, I could try to lock it from the inside..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to move, but the obstacles in the room didn't make it easy. Could the cabinet have been there? While it seemed like a good place, neither the lobby nor the mechanical room had cameras.
entries.literal: "I tried to move, but the obstacles in the room didn't make it easy. Could the cabinet have been there? While it seemed like a good place, neither the lobby nor the mechanical room had cameras."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were chairs and tables on the floor, so I had to move some aside to get to every part of the room. Even though it was impossible for anyone to be there, I kept trying to be silent and failing as I scattered things that I couldn't see.
entries.literal: "There were chairs and tables on the floor, so I had to move some aside to get to every part of the room. Even though it was impossible for anyone to be there, I kept trying to be silent and failing as I scattered things that I couldn't see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a while, I knew the cabinet wasn't there.
entries.literal: "After a while, I knew the cabinet wasn't there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea if I needed to hurry or not, so I went up the staircase without wasting any more time.
entries.literal: "I had no idea if I needed to hurry or not, so I went up the staircase without wasting any more time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped back into the lobby. ...Where would the Sekimeiya have been? There were a couple of places I knew to prioritize over the others.
entries.literal: "I stepped back into the lobby. ...Where would the Sekimeiya have been? There were a couple of places I knew to prioritize over the others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to hallway B, hitting the hard column with my shoulder.
entries.literal: "I walked to hallway B, hitting the hard column with my shoulder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The green lights on the cameras were still there, but my legs moved automatically, recalling the steps needed to reach the place called the event room.
entries.literal: "The green lights on the cameras were still there, but my legs moved automatically, recalling the steps needed to reach the place called the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was it set up as it had been the 15th? Finding out would be simple, and if the cabinet wasn't there, my last idea was the room in front of it, B4, where the cabinets with temperature regulation were.
entries.literal: "Was it set up as it had been the 15th? Finding out would be simple, and if the cabinet wasn't there, my last idea was the room in front of it, B4, where the cabinets with temperature regulation were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After I'd taken a few steps, I turned around.{w} Through the door, I was peering back into the lobby.
entries.literal: "After I'd taken a few steps, I turned around.{w} Through the door, I was peering back into the lobby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart sped up all by itself while I scrambled to understand why my line of sight was completely black.
entries.literal: "My heart sped up all by itself while I scrambled to understand why my line of sight was completely black."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see nothing but darkness, and that didn't make any sense...{w} Because from there, I should've been able to see the lights of the reception desk.
entries.literal: "I could see nothing but darkness, and that didn't make any sense...{w} Because from there, I should've been able to see the lights of the reception desk."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What... happened?
entries.literal: "What... happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed and opened my eyes a few times, wondering if I was the problem.
entries.literal: "I closed and opened my eyes a few times, wondering if I was the problem."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There it was.
entries.literal: "There it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Stunned, I stared at it. I hadn't moved at all, so I didn't understand. I really wanted to doubt my eyes, but the light had suddenly come back.
entries.literal: "Stunned, I stared at it. I hadn't moved at all, so I didn't understand. I really wanted to doubt my eyes, but the light had suddenly come back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And even though I could see it beyond the door, my heart hadn't slowed down. It was the same sensation as when I'd turned around while being tailed in the snow.
entries.literal: "And even though I could see it beyond the door, my heart hadn't slowed down. It was the same sensation as when I'd turned around while being tailed in the snow."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was only silence.
entries.literal: "There was only silence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I backed away slowly without taking my eyes off the light.
entries.literal: "I backed away slowly without taking my eyes off the light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And eventually, the wall covered it as I kept approaching the door at my right.
entries.literal: "And eventually, the wall covered it as I kept approaching the door at my right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I found the doorknob and opened the way to the bridge between the hallways.
entries.literal: "I found the doorknob and opened the way to the bridge between the hallways."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was... cold.{w} As soon as I took a step in, I perceived a decrease in temperature.
entries.literal: "It was... cold.{w} As soon as I took a step in, I perceived a decrease in temperature."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What is this...?
entries.literal: "What is this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe I was able to feel any colder. However, after opening that door, the change had been instant.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe I was able to feel any colder. However, after opening that door, the change had been instant."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I approached the place where the cabinet had been, the temperature continued to decrease.
entries.literal: "As I approached the place where the cabinet had been, the temperature continued to decrease."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It is here.
entries.literal: "...It is here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the middle of the wall, I felt the cold touch of a curtain. I raised it as fast as I could, forcing my hand into a claw grip.
entries.literal: "In the middle of the wall, I felt the cold touch of a curtain. I raised it as fast as I could, forcing my hand into a claw grip."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And when it was out of the way, I didn't have to wonder what was behind it. There was a faint glow, making the crimson texture beneath it visible.
entries.literal: "And when it was out of the way, I didn't have to wonder what was behind it. There was a faint glow, making the crimson texture beneath it visible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe it. The Sekimeiya was there, but what had happened in that place? With my free hand, I reached in to verify if the cabinet was open.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it. The Sekimeiya was there, but what had happened in that place? With my free hand, I reached in to verify if the cabinet was open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I'd thought, the glass wasn't properly closed. That was why the entire room felt chilly.
entries.literal: "As I'd thought, the glass wasn't properly closed. That was why the entire room felt chilly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to decide what to do, but I couldn't think straight. ...I had the Sekimeiya at hand—I didn't even need the key that I'd found.
entries.literal: "I had to decide what to do, but I couldn't think straight. ...I had the Sekimeiya at hand—I didn't even need the key that I'd found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt the glass with my hand. The gap wasn't big enough to get it through, so I tried to scroll it farther down.
entries.literal: "I felt the glass with my hand. The gap wasn't big enough to get it through, so I tried to scroll it farther down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I couldn't move it. It seemed to be stuck in place.
entries.literal: "...I couldn't move it. It seemed to be stuck in place."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why is it not opening...? It can't be locked.
entries.literal: "Why is it not opening...? It can't be locked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept applying force and noticed that it was moving a little. Before I could reach the Sekimeiya, though, I let go of the glass.
entries.literal: "I kept applying force and noticed that it was moving a little. Before I could reach the Sekimeiya, though, I let go of the glass."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What's that...?
entries.literal: "What's that...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the cushion around the Sekimeiya. My first impression had been mistaken, as it wasn't just crimson.
entries.literal: "I stared at the cushion around the Sekimeiya. My first impression had been mistaken, as it wasn't just crimson."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that... white?
entries.literal: "Is that... white?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It appeared to be stained by a substance, but I couldn't tell what it was.
entries.literal: "It appeared to be stained by a substance, but I couldn't tell what it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Frowning, I kept trying to push open the glass.
entries.literal: "Frowning, I kept trying to push open the glass."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is it cracked?
entries.literal: "...Is it cracked?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The surface felt rough, as if it had been damaged.
entries.literal: "The surface felt rough, as if it had been damaged."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A loud noise invaded my ears right as I got the glass unstuck.
entries.literal: "A loud noise invaded my ears right as I got the glass unstuck."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that the alarm...!? Why!?{w} Did I just break it!?
entries.literal: "Is that the alarm...!? Why!?{w} Did I just break it!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd never heard that sound, but it had to be the same one that played when we were trapped.{w} I started to lose control of my nerves. What was happening? I'd triggered it after doing something to the cabinet, and I couldn't see what.
entries.literal: "I'd never heard that sound, but it had to be the same one that played when we were trapped.{w} I started to lose control of my nerves. What was happening? I'd triggered it after doing something to the cabinet, and I couldn't see what."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood still, praying for the sound to disappear. I was being locked in, but nobody was in the security room, and I'd left the storeroom door open.{w} As I stood, I perceived a fainter and rougher sound coming from the lobby. It was the shutter, closing automatically.
entries.literal: "I stood still, praying for the sound to disappear. I was being locked in, but nobody was in the security room, and I'd left the storeroom door open.{w} As I stood, I perceived a fainter and rougher sound coming from the lobby. It was the shutter, closing automatically."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The silence came back, but I still couldn't get it together.
entries.literal: "The silence came back, but I still couldn't get it together."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, the past had changed—the alarm had been activated before the 15th. ...But why?
entries.literal: "Of course, the past had changed—the alarm had been activated before the 15th. ...But why?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I looked at the Sekimeiya, still faintly glowing. I should've had enough time to escape with it, and I didn't know if the world would return to normal on its own.
entries.literal: "...I looked at the Sekimeiya, still faintly glowing. I should've had enough time to escape with it, and I didn't know if the world would return to normal on its own."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put my hand through the opening and immediately stopped.
entries.literal: "I put my hand through the opening and immediately stopped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't make any sense, but I was too exhausted to react. The inside of the cabinet, which I expected to be the coldest part of the room, was hot. In fact, as I got closer to the Sekimeiya, I felt a hot aura reminiscent of the one in the water tank.
entries.literal: "It didn't make any sense, but I was too exhausted to react. The inside of the cabinet, which I expected to be the coldest part of the room, was hot. In fact, as I got closer to the Sekimeiya, I felt a hot aura reminiscent of the one in the water tank."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait...!{w} Does this mean that I can travel really far back again?{w} Why, though...!? The cabinet shouldn't allow it.
entries.literal: "Wait...!{w} Does this mean that I can travel really far back again?{w} Why, though...!? The cabinet shouldn't allow it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I raised my hand and felt the freezing air that the cabinet was releasing.
entries.literal: "I raised my hand and felt the freezing air that the cabinet was releasing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I touched the white stain on the cushion and knew I hadn't been mistaken; something was there.
entries.literal: "...{w}I touched the white stain on the cushion and knew I hadn't been mistaken; something was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was considerably hot, and it felt as if something had dried on the cloth. As I moved my hand around it, I noticed it was in abundance, whatever it was.
entries.literal: "It was considerably hot, and it felt as if something had dried on the cloth. As I moved my hand around it, I noticed it was in abundance, whatever it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was it...? I couldn't tell, but there were also tiny pieces with a rocky texture scattered across the cushion.
entries.literal: "What was it...? I couldn't tell, but there were also tiny pieces with a rocky texture scattered across the cushion."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My fingers felt something different and tried to grab it. It was larger than the strange substance above it.
entries.literal: "My fingers felt something different and tried to grab it. It was larger than the strange substance above it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell is this...?{w} A card?
entries.literal: "What the hell is this...?{w} A card?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Its texture and form resembled one, but it was pretty small. I took it out of the cabinet and felt its hot touch, painfully confused.
entries.literal: "Its texture and form resembled one, but it was pretty small. I took it out of the cabinet and felt its hot touch, painfully confused."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was stained like the cushion, but I couldn't tell what it was. ...I grabbed my phone and shined its faint light on the object.
entries.literal: "It was stained like the cushion, but I couldn't tell what it was. ...I grabbed my phone and shined its faint light on the object."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just like I'd thought, it was a very tiny card. On it, a single word was written.
entries.literal: "Just like I'd thought, it was a very tiny card. On it, a single word was written."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {tip=card}XYN{/tip}.
entries.literal: "{tip=card}XYN{/tip}."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A chill ran down my spine. They had been there.
entries.literal: "A chill ran down my spine. They had been there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But why...? They shouldn't have attacked until the 15th. Was it as I'd feared? Had one of the members traveled from the 15th, changing history with an early attack?
entries.literal: "But why...? They shouldn't have attacked until the 15th. Was it as I'd feared? Had one of the members traveled from the 15th, changing history with an early attack?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the Sekimeiya... Most importantly, why was it still there if Xyn had already attacked?
entries.literal: "I stared at the Sekimeiya... Most importantly, why was it still there if Xyn had already attacked?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had so many questions and no faith that any would be answered. I began to move my hand toward the glow inside the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I had so many questions and no faith that any would be answered. I began to move my hand toward the glow inside the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The searing air around it was all I could be sure of. It was ridiculously hot, completely overpowering the cabinet's icy interior. My frozen hand penetrated the barrier of hot air—the temperature was all I needed to know the Sekimeiya's energy was comparable to when it had been in the water tank.
entries.literal: "The searing air around it was all I could be sure of. It was ridiculously hot, completely overpowering the cabinet's icy interior. My frozen hand penetrated the barrier of hot air—the temperature was all I needed to know the Sekimeiya's energy was comparable to when it had been in the water tank."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would touching it bring back life to the world? From the 15th, I'd gone fifteen days back. It didn't matter that I'd have nowhere to stay; I would have time to work all those matters out. I just had to go back in time and root out the problem by obtaining the Sekimeiya before anyone else did.
entries.literal: "Would touching it bring back life to the world? From the 15th, I'd gone fifteen days back. It didn't matter that I'd have nowhere to stay; I would have time to work all those matters out. I just had to go back in time and root out the problem by obtaining the Sekimeiya before anyone else did."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My hand, cold as it was, began to burn painfully. I was so close to the Sekimeiya and to leaving behind yet another reality.{w} I shut my eyes, mustering up the will to move my hand farther. I expected that by the next time I opened them, my surroundings would have morphed entirely.
entries.literal: "My hand, cold as it was, began to burn painfully. I was so close to the Sekimeiya and to leaving behind yet another reality.{w} I shut my eyes, mustering up the will to move my hand farther. I expected that by the next time I opened them, my surroundings would have morphed entirely."

entries.text: River
entries.literal: "River"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The light... had come back. But I was in the lobby.
entries.literal: "The light... had come back. But I was in the lobby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where is this...?
entries.literal: "Where is this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around slowly.
entries.literal: "I turned around slowly."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: A-Atsuki...?
entries.literal: "A-Atsuki...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: H—{w} You...!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We both looked shocked to see each other. At that time, I saw the shutter and the powered-off lights. Those were the effects of the alarm.
entries.literal: "We both looked shocked to see each other. At that time, I saw the shutter and the powered-off lights. Those were the effects of the alarm."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: A-Are you Shiroya...?
entries.literal: "A-Are you Shiroya...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What? Y-Yes. Where are we? I just appeared here.
entries.literal: "What? Y-Yes. Where are we? I just appeared here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe it was him. I'd thought seeing him again wasn't possible. However, the look he gave me seemed full of suspicion. His eyes were piercing mine, and he appeared wary.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it was him. I'd thought seeing him again wasn't possible. However, the look he gave me seemed full of suspicion. His eyes were piercing mine, and he appeared wary."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt my body and noticed my heart skip a beat. I was wearing different clothes, ones I'd washed the day before.{w} As soon as the world had unfrozen, so had I. I could move my hand without it cramping, as if the time I'd spent outside had been erased. ...And when I did, I realized I wasn't tired anymore.
entries.literal: "I felt my body and noticed my heart skip a beat. I was wearing different clothes, ones I'd washed the day before.{w} As soon as the world had unfrozen, so had I. I could move my hand without it cramping, as if the time I'd spent outside had been erased. ...And when I did, I realized I wasn't tired anymore."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: W-Wait, that...
entries.literal: "W-Wait, that..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I followed his eyes toward the hallway B door. When I gave it a closer look, I saw the crucial detail I'd missed.{w} Its edges were dark. I'd seen it before, so I didn't have to wonder what it meant.
entries.literal: "I followed his eyes toward the hallway B door. When I gave it a closer look, I saw the crucial detail I'd missed.{w} Its edges were dark. I'd seen it before, so I didn't have to wonder what it meant."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...It's the smoke, right?
entries.literal: "...It's the smoke, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Y-Yes, but doesn't it look different?
entries.literal: "Y-Yes, but doesn't it look different?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm not sure where we are. I just appeared here too.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure where we are. I just appeared here too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As he said that, he approached the door. Unlike mine, his clothes were the ones he'd worn on the 15th, but they were clean.
entries.literal: "As he said that, he approached the door. Unlike mine, his clothes were the ones he'd worn on the 15th, but they were clean."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A sound that came from hallway B made Atsuki stop.
entries.literal: "A sound that came from hallway B made Atsuki stop."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A door had closed. He went still, trying to stay silent, and I did the same.
entries.literal: "A door had closed. He went still, trying to stay silent, and I did the same."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few seconds later, he kept going and grabbed the knob. When he opened the door, I couldn't believe what I saw.
entries.literal: "A few seconds later, he kept going and grabbed the knob. When he opened the door, I couldn't believe what I saw."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, fuck. Don't breathe.
entries.literal: "Oh, fuck. Don't breathe."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No light filled the hallway; only a dark fog did. Without a doubt, it was the same smoke that had knocked us out, although its density seemed much lower.
entries.literal: "No light filled the hallway; only a dark fog did. Without a doubt, it was the same smoke that had knocked us out, although its density seemed much lower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Right next to us were three people on the floor: Erina, Isla, and Sai, who had all just lost consciousness.
entries.literal: "Right next to us were three people on the floor: Erina, Isla, and Sai, who had all just lost consciousness."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: A-Are we on the morning of the 15th?
entries.literal: "A-Are we on the morning of the 15th?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After staring at the scene with perplexity, Atsuki's face slowly turned to me, and he spoke in a quiet voice.
entries.literal: "After staring at the scene with perplexity, Atsuki's face slowly turned to me, and he spoke in a quiet voice."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Are you really Shiroya? The real one?
entries.literal: "...Are you really Shiroya? The real one?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What does that mean...!? Who else would I be?
entries.literal: "What does that mean...!? Who else would I be?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...What do you remember? Please, tell me everything.
entries.literal: "...What do you remember? Please, tell me everything."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What!? I-I don't know what you mean! We got trapped here, and a bunch of things happened!
entries.literal: "What!? I-I don't know what you mean! We got trapped here, and a bunch of things happened!"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What happened? How did you end up here?
entries.literal: "What happened? How did you end up here?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: H-Huh? A lot of things! Do you remember everything? Late into the day, we were in the lobby, and I went to the bathroom. There, I activated the Sekimeiya and appeared on the 30th of November, below that gem shop.{w} Then... a few days later, I entered the tower and touched the Sekimeiya. That's how I just appeared here.
entries.literal: "H-Huh? A lot of things! Do you remember everything? Late into the day, we were in the lobby, and I went to the bathroom. There, I activated the Sekimeiya and appeared on the 30th of November, below that gem shop.{w} Then... a few days later, I entered the tower and touched the Sekimeiya. That's how I just appeared here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was why... the image my brain was receiving didn't make any sense. How could it be real? How could that have been the start of December 15th?
entries.literal: "That was why... the image my brain was receiving didn't make any sense. How could it be real? How could that have been the start of December 15th?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: W-Wait, that's all...? What about appearing after you'd gone to the bathroom? Do you remember that?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, that's all...? What about appearing after you'd gone to the bathroom? Do you remember that?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What? N-No...? I found the Sekimeiya in the toilet's water tank and went a long way into the past.
entries.literal: "What? N-No...? I found the Sekimeiya in the toilet's water tank and went a long way into the past."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}Are you really... the real Shiroya? I don't really understand what you're telling me.
entries.literal: "...{w}Are you really... the real Shiroya? I don't really understand what you're telling me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't either. Had he just appeared there at the same time as me? Didn't that mean that he'd been encompassed by the range of my travel?
entries.literal: "I didn't either. Had he just appeared there at the same time as me? Didn't that mean that he'd been encompassed by the range of my travel?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait a second. That sound from before was a door, right? It sounded like it came from the right wall.
entries.literal: "Wait a second. That sound from before was a door, right? It sounded like it came from the right wall."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I think so.
entries.literal: "...I think so."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It had to be that one, then.
entries.literal: "It had to be that one, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He pointed at one of the doors, and I understood why he'd said that.
entries.literal: "He pointed at one of the doors, and I understood why he'd said that."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's where Naomi died and where I traveled for the first time. If the smoke was just released, someone might have just been there because it's where the temperature regulation cabinets are.
entries.literal: "That's where Naomi died and where I traveled for the first time. If the smoke was just released, someone might have just been there because it's where the temperature regulation cabinets are."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I didn't know what to say, but he was the Atsuki I'd been with that day. How was I talking to him? Hadn't his existence been overwritten...?
entries.literal: "...{w}I didn't know what to say, but he was the Atsuki I'd been with that day. How was I talking to him? Hadn't his existence been overwritten...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I think we just heard the culprit. I have no idea why we're here, but only a few people should be conscious at this time.
entries.literal: "I think we just heard the culprit. I have no idea why we're here, but only a few people should be conscious at this time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He gestured at me to follow him and not breathe. Before I could react, he was dashing toward that door, so I did the same, covering my face with an arm.
entries.literal: "He gestured at me to follow him and not breathe. Before I could react, he was dashing toward that door, so I did the same, covering my face with an arm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I still trailed behind, he looked at me and seemed to frown. However, he ended up going through the door.
entries.literal: "While I still trailed behind, he looked at me and seemed to frown. However, he ended up going through the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The crystal room was empty, and every cabinet had its curtain neatly in place. If the sound had come from there, someone had just left.
entries.literal: "The crystal room was empty, and every cabinet had its curtain neatly in place. If the sound had come from there, someone had just left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki closed the door carefully so that his voice wouldn't be heard.
entries.literal: "Atsuki closed the door carefully so that his voice wouldn't be heard."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did you see the door to the lobby?
entries.literal: "Did you see the door to the lobby?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What about it?
entries.literal: "...What about it?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We just left it open.
entries.literal: "We just left it open."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh. Does that matter?
entries.literal: "Oh. Does that matter?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You remember, right? When we met everyone else, Sai pointed out that it was open, and Katei said he did that. I'm pretty sure it looked exactly the way we just left it.
entries.literal: "You remember, right? When we met everyone else, Sai pointed out that it was open, and Katei said he did that. I'm pretty sure it looked exactly the way we just left it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I see what you mean, but please answer one thing for me. Why are we here? Did something happen after I traveled to the past?
entries.literal: "I see what you mean, but please answer one thing for me. Why are we here? Did something happen after I traveled to the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked down.
entries.literal: "He looked down."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Are you telling me the truth? Do you not know what happened after?
entries.literal: "Are you telling me the truth? Do you not know what happened after?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I don't...! I just told you. I appeared on the 30th of November.{w} I stayed at my apartment while my past self was in the hospital, and a few days later, I entered the tower.{w} I have no idea what happened there, though. The Sekimeiya was already in the cabinet, and I touched it since nobody was in the security room. After that, I appeared in the lobby with you. Now we're here.
entries.literal: "I don't...! I just told you. I appeared on the 30th of November.{w} I stayed at my apartment while my past self was in the hospital, and a few days later, I entered the tower.{w} I have no idea what happened there, though. The Sekimeiya was already in the cabinet, and I touched it since nobody was in the security room. After that, I appeared in the lobby with you. Now we're here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as he took what I was saying as sincere, his way of looking at me changed entirely. I finally felt like the person in front of me was the Atsuki I'd wanted to be back with.
entries.literal: "As soon as he took what I was saying as sincere, his way of looking at me changed entirely. I finally felt like the person in front of me was the Atsuki I'd wanted to be back with."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wait, you said you traveled to the 30th? Did you try to save Miiya?
entries.literal: "Wait, you said you traveled to the 30th? Did you try to save Miiya?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I couldn't... I appeared too late for that, but I did change the past—
entries.literal: "I couldn't... I appeared too late for that, but I did change the past—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to cut that sentence short. The past had changed, hadn't it? If that was the case, how could the same incident have been starting again? How was it possible we'd left the lobby door open exactly like we'd seen it in that morning, and how could Atsuki have possessed the memories of that long day? How the hell was I back there...!?
entries.literal: "I had to cut that sentence short. The past had changed, hadn't it? If that was the case, how could the same incident have been starting again? How was it possible we'd left the lobby door open exactly like we'd seen it in that morning, and how could Atsuki have possessed the memories of that long day? How the hell was I back there...!?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I'm trying to understand what you've said...
entries.literal: "I'm trying to understand what you've said..."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Don't worry, even I don't understand anything of what I lived through. I'm not lying, though.
entries.literal: "Don't worry, even I don't understand anything of what I lived through. I'm not lying, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Then I'm not sure it would help if I told you what happened after you left.{w} Another version of you was there, but it wasn't you, right?
entries.literal: "...Then I'm not sure it would help if I told you what happened after you left.{w} Another version of you was there, but it wasn't you, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: N-No. I have no idea who that was.
entries.literal: "N-No. I have no idea who that was."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Well, we weren't able to leave when the time came. I'm not sure what happened, why, or how, but the lights went off, and we couldn't get out.{w} ...You remember the recording, right?{w} It was real.
entries.literal: "Well, we weren't able to leave when the time came. I'm not sure what happened, why, or how, but the lights went off, and we couldn't get out.{w} ...You remember the recording, right?{w} It was real."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wait, what...?
entries.literal: "Wait, what...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes, it did happen. It wasn't a trick.{w} It still doesn't make any sense, though. I can't wrap my head around what happened.{w} You said that you touched the Sekimeiya in the event room days before the 15th, right?
entries.literal: "Yes, it did happen. It wasn't a trick.{w} It still doesn't make any sense, though. I can't wrap my head around what happened.{w} You said that you touched the Sekimeiya in the event room days before the 15th, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Y-Yes.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I see. What the fuck, then...? I don't get anything.{w} I thought I got caught up in your travel and both of us appeared in front of the hallway B door, the location where we were on the morning of the 15th.
entries.literal: "I see. What the fuck, then...? I don't get anything.{w} I thought I got caught up in your travel and both of us appeared in front of the hallway B door, the location where we were on the morning of the 15th."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: But that makes no sense...! And look at my clothes, I wasn't wearing these on the 15th!
entries.literal: "But that makes no sense...! And look at my clothes, I wasn't wearing these on the 15th!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only my purse and coat matched what I'd worn on that day.
entries.literal: "Only my purse and coat matched what I'd worn on that day."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You're right, actually. Were you wearing them when you touched the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "You're right, actually. Were you wearing them when you touched the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shook my head and followed Atsuki's line of sight as soon as I saw he'd noticed something. We approached one of the cabinets.
entries.literal: "I shook my head and followed Atsuki's line of sight as soon as I saw he'd noticed something. We approached one of the cabinets."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...That's where the Sekimeiya was, right?
entries.literal: "...That's where the Sekimeiya was, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes, and look at the wheel.
entries.literal: "Yes, and look at the wheel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It said 0 °C.
entries.literal: "It said 0 °C."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's set to be cold... Oh, and it's not damaged yet. Wasn't this the one with a crack?
entries.literal: "It's set to be cold... Oh, and it's not damaged yet. Wasn't this the one with a crack?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes... it was.
entries.literal: "Yes... it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared while Atsuki peeked behind the cabinet to unlock it. He raised it alongside the curtain, and I stepped beside him to look inside.
entries.literal: "I stared while Atsuki peeked behind the cabinet to unlock it. He raised it alongside the curtain, and I stepped beside him to look inside."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What?{w} I...{w=0.4} don't get it.
entries.literal: "Wh-What?{w} I...{w=0.4} don't get it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya. It was there, emitting a bright white in the middle of the empty cabinet.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya. It was there, emitting a bright white in the middle of the empty cabinet."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Someone left it in here.
entries.literal: "Someone left it in here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes, which is what I don't get. When we woke up, it was in the event room, still in its cabinet.
entries.literal: "Yes, which is what I don't get. When we woke up, it was in the event room, still in its cabinet."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You're... right.
entries.literal: "You're... right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seemingly overwhelmed, Atsuki covered his hand with his sleeve and brought the Sekimeiya out.
entries.literal: "Seemingly overwhelmed, Atsuki covered his hand with his sleeve and brought the Sekimeiya out."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's set to 0 °C, but the cabinet isn't cold at all.
entries.literal: "It's set to 0 °C, but the cabinet isn't cold at all."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It could've been set just now, so it didn't have enough time to cool off.
entries.literal: "It could've been set just now, so it didn't have enough time to cool off."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: God, the Sekimeiya is burning, though...!
entries.literal: "God, the Sekimeiya is burning, though...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I heard that, I extended my arm, startling Atsuki. I shook my head—I didn't want to make contact. I only wanted to feel the air around it.
entries.literal: "As soon as I heard that, I extended my arm, startling Atsuki. I shook my head—I didn't want to make contact. I only wanted to feel the air around it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Sorry, when I touched it in the bathroom, its surroundings were incredibly hot. ...I can feel the heat, but it's nothing like then.{w} Do you know more about how the Sekimeiya works?
entries.literal: "Sorry, when I touched it in the bathroom, its surroundings were incredibly hot. ...I can feel the heat, but it's nothing like then.{w} Do you know more about how the Sekimeiya works?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I know nothing, and even less with what you've told me.
entries.literal: "I know nothing, and even less with what you've told me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's working, so if we're really at the start of the incident, wouldn't touching it put us outside?
entries.literal: "It's working, so if we're really at the start of the incident, wouldn't touching it put us outside?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: M-Maybe. That's what I was thinking. It should be hot enough for that.
entries.literal: "M-Maybe. That's what I was thinking. It should be hot enough for that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The real state of the world was unknown. I had no idea where we were or what was beyond the walls of the tower. However, if touching the Sekimeiya would send us far enough to escape it, it would guarantee the real Atsuki would still exist even if I couldn't comprehend his return.
entries.literal: "The real state of the world was unknown. I had no idea where we were or what was beyond the walls of the tower. However, if touching the Sekimeiya would send us far enough to escape it, it would guarantee the real Atsuki would still exist even if I couldn't comprehend his return."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Let's touch it.
entries.literal: "Let's touch it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki nodded and moved closer while I stared at the Sekimeiya, wishing I was moments away from never seeing it again.
entries.literal: "Atsuki nodded and moved closer while I stared at the Sekimeiya, wishing I was moments away from never seeing it again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When his hand touched it, the Sekimeiya disappeared.{w} That was all I'd wanted. However, nothing else did.
entries.literal: "When his hand touched it, the Sekimeiya disappeared.{w} That was all I'd wanted. However, nothing else did."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were in the same crystal room. We hadn't even moved. Speechless, I stared at his hands and the floor in search of the stone that had vanished.
entries.literal: "We were in the same crystal room. We hadn't even moved. Speechless, I stared at his hands and the floor in search of the stone that had vanished."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Th-This is what happened before. It teleported, and we didn't travel.
entries.literal: "Th-This is what happened before. It teleported, and we didn't travel."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Oh.
entries.literal: "Oh."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That had escaped my mind a long time ago. ...The Sekimeiya's teleportation.{w} What caused it...!? Would it sometimes reject a travel? If so, why had it happened then...!?
entries.literal: "That had escaped my mind a long time ago. ...The Sekimeiya's teleportation.{w} What caused it...!? Would it sometimes reject a travel? If so, why had it happened then...!?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wait, n-no... I-It can't be that.
entries.literal: "Wait, n-no... I-It can't be that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That time, it was Atsuki who followed my petrified eyes. As soon as he took a glance at the cabinet, he almost fell from the shock.
entries.literal: "That time, it was Atsuki who followed my petrified eyes. As soon as he took a glance at the cabinet, he almost fell from the shock."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What the fuck...? It didn't fall, right?
entries.literal: "Wh-What the fuck...? It didn't fall, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shook my head.{w} The lid that Atsuki had just opened... The instant the Sekimeiya disappeared, it had closed without producing a sound. And that wasn't all. Over it, the velvet curtain covered it perfectly, making the cabinet look like every other one in the room.
entries.literal: "I shook my head.{w} The lid that Atsuki had just opened... The instant the Sekimeiya disappeared, it had closed without producing a sound. And that wasn't all. Over it, the velvet curtain covered it perfectly, making the cabinet look like every other one in the room."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Did we actually travel through time? ...Are we at a point before I opened it?
entries.literal: "Did we actually travel through time? ...Are we at a point before I opened it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A distinct sound entered our ears, and we turned to the door. ...Someone was running through the hallway.
entries.literal: "A distinct sound entered our ears, and we turned to the door. ...Someone was running through the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could he have been right? As we ran to the door, I wondered. ...Were the walls of the hallway bright and elegant or dark and dirty? At the same time, we gripped the knob and burst through the door.
entries.literal: "Could he have been right? As we ran to the door, I wondered. ...Were the walls of the hallway bright and elegant or dark and dirty? At the same time, we gripped the knob and burst through the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immediately, we were forced to cover our faces. It didn't make any sense, but the smoke was still there. The sound of footsteps at least couldn't have been a mistake, so after our initial surprise, we looked both ways.
entries.literal: "Immediately, we were forced to cover our faces. It didn't make any sense, but the smoke was still there. The sound of footsteps at least couldn't have been a mistake, so after our initial surprise, we looked both ways."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...We couldn't see anyone, but the sound hadn't faded away. It seemed they'd run to hallway C.
entries.literal: "...We couldn't see anyone, but the sound hadn't faded away. It seemed they'd run to hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki tugged my sleeve, telling me to follow. It was likely the culprit was there—the one who'd just left the Sekimeiya behind. But I hesitated a bit, frowning as I kept staring at the lobby side. Were my eyes playing tricks on me?
entries.literal: "Atsuki tugged my sleeve, telling me to follow. It was likely the culprit was there—the one who'd just left the Sekimeiya behind. But I hesitated a bit, frowning as I kept staring at the lobby side. Were my eyes playing tricks on me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Covering our faces, we chased behind the sound. Very little smoke remained, so it was easy to avoid breathing it until we got to the clean hallway.
entries.literal: "...Covering our faces, we chased behind the sound. Very little smoke remained, so it was easy to avoid breathing it until we got to the clean hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The footsteps were quickly dissipating in the distance. We looked at each other to verify that we'd both heard them going up the stairs.
entries.literal: "The footsteps were quickly dissipating in the distance. We looked at each other to verify that we'd both heard them going up the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We bolted to them and were met with the gray door, fully open. Early on the 15th, Katei had acted surprised to see it unlocked, but where was he at that moment if not running up the floors?
entries.literal: "We bolted to them and were met with the gray door, fully open. Early on the 15th, Katei had acted surprised to see it unlocked, but where was he at that moment if not running up the floors?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stepped onto the second floor. It was a scene I'd thought I wouldn't see again, causing my face to unconsciously screw up in disgust.
entries.literal: "We stepped onto the second floor. It was a scene I'd thought I wouldn't see again, causing my face to unconsciously screw up in disgust."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe I was circling those floors once more, but as I did, my mind went back to the door to the lobby. After leaving the crystal room, it had looked more open than before.{w} That was strange, because as Atsuki said, the way we'd left it was just like how it was that morning, before Sai opened it all the way.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe I was circling those floors once more, but as I did, my mind went back to the door to the lobby. After leaving the crystal room, it had looked more open than before.{w} That was strange, because as Atsuki said, the way we'd left it was just like how it was that morning, before Sai opened it all the way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the most important detail was higher up, above the three sleeping bodies. I hadn't been able to give it a good look, but the camera's lens had seemed to reflect the light of the crystal room.{w} Then, I'd looked at the other lenses and thought that they more clearly had smoke on them.
entries.literal: "However, the most important detail was higher up, above the three sleeping bodies. I hadn't been able to give it a good look, but the camera's lens had seemed to reflect the light of the crystal room.{w} Then, I'd looked at the other lenses and thought that they more clearly had smoke on them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As we sprinted as fast as we could, I was amazed by the energy I had. Before touching the Sekimeiya, I'd had difficulty even staying steady.
entries.literal: "As we sprinted as fast as we could, I was amazed by the energy I had. Before touching the Sekimeiya, I'd had difficulty even staying steady."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea who we were following, but Naomi and Katei were the likely choices. Why were they running up? It had all happened at once after we'd touched the disappearing Sekimeiya. What the hell was that about?
entries.literal: "I had no idea who we were following, but Naomi and Katei were the likely choices. Why were they running up? It had all happened at once after we'd touched the disappearing Sekimeiya. What the hell was that about?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki once told me he'd seen it teleport to its cabinet. That seemed to resolve the doubt from earlier—it had just teleported to the event room, which was why it was there when we woke up.{w} The important question was what else the disappearance implied. The cabinet's reversion to its previous state revealed a secondary effect.
entries.literal: "Atsuki once told me he'd seen it teleport to its cabinet. That seemed to resolve the doubt from earlier—it had just teleported to the event room, which was why it was there when we woke up.{w} The important question was what else the disappearance implied. The cabinet's reversion to its previous state revealed a secondary effect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a while, the mesh of footsteps began to sound distorted. We were on the third floor, and I tried to sharpen my hearing.
entries.literal: "After a while, the mesh of footsteps began to sound distorted. We were on the third floor, and I tried to sharpen my hearing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...What exactly was I hearing? The footsteps ahead, mine, and Atsuki's.{w} Why did it sound as if there were more?{w} The echo could've been messing with me, but it seemed as if another pair of footsteps was running just behind us.
entries.literal: "...What exactly was I hearing? The footsteps ahead, mine, and Atsuki's.{w} Why did it sound as if there were more?{w} The echo could've been messing with me, but it seemed as if another pair of footsteps was running just behind us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We hadn't let out a single word since leaving the crystal floor. When we stepped on the sixth, a sound dominated the air.
entries.literal: "We hadn't let out a single word since leaving the crystal floor. When we stepped on the sixth, a sound dominated the air."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As we'd feared, only one door could've closed, found on the other side of the floor.
entries.literal: "As we'd feared, only one door could've closed, found on the other side of the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We didn't slow down until the attic's entrance was in front of us. Panting, Atsuki grabbed the doorknob, but he couldn't get it to open.
entries.literal: "We didn't slow down until the attic's entrance was in front of us. Panting, Atsuki grabbed the doorknob, but he couldn't get it to open."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Damn it...!
entries.literal: "Damn it...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was locked. As we stared in defeat, I realized nobody was trying to catch up to us, so I took the time to sort out my thoughts.
entries.literal: "It was locked. As we stared in defeat, I realized nobody was trying to catch up to us, so I took the time to sort out my thoughts."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suddenly remembered something and looked at my waist. My purse was still there, so I unzipped it and looked inside. Immediately, I took something out and showed it to Atsuki.
entries.literal: "I suddenly remembered something and looked at my waist. My purse was still there, so I unzipped it and looked inside. Immediately, I took something out and showed it to Atsuki."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What...!? Why do you have it!?
entries.literal: "What...!? Why do you have it!?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I... don't know... I found it when I entered the tower, in the mechanical room. I found the rusty key in a drawer in the security room as well, but... how is it possible I still have them when my clothes completely changed?
entries.literal: "I... don't know... I found it when I entered the tower, in the mechanical room. I found the rusty key in a drawer in the security room as well, but... how is it possible I still have them when my clothes completely changed?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't make any sense, but I could open the attic. I inserted the key into the keyhole without wasting any more time.{w} When it unlocked, I slowly pushed the door open.
entries.literal: "It didn't make any sense, but I could open the attic. I inserted the key into the keyhole without wasting any more time.{w} When it unlocked, I slowly pushed the door open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The dim staircase extended beyond us. Instead of rushing up, we stepped forward silently, as the person we'd been chasing couldn't know that we had a key, and the elevator had been disabled by the alarm.
entries.literal: "The dim staircase extended beyond us. Instead of rushing up, we stepped forward silently, as the person we'd been chasing couldn't know that we had a key, and the elevator had been disabled by the alarm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the front, I began to ascend the stairs, the light of the living room slowly creeping in.
entries.literal: "At the front, I began to ascend the stairs, the light of the living room slowly creeping in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next door was open. As I reached the top, I extended my neck past it.
entries.literal: "The next door was open. As I reached the top, I extended my neck past it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I saw who was there.{w} Naomi.
entries.literal: "Then, I saw who was there.{w} Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her back was facing me, as she was staring at an open black suitcase on the sofa.
entries.literal: "Her back was facing me, as she was staring at an open black suitcase on the sofa."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around to let Atsuki know.
entries.literal: "I turned around to let Atsuki know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was confused. It was considerably dark, but I couldn't even make out his figure.
entries.literal: "I was confused. It was considerably dark, but I couldn't even make out his figure."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Are you here?
entries.literal: "...Are you here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I whispered in the quietest voice I could muster, but I received no response.
entries.literal: "I whispered in the quietest voice I could muster, but I received no response."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Puzzled, I slowly went down the steps, careful not to hit him. However, by the time I reached the door, I hadn't sensed him yet.
entries.literal: "Puzzled, I slowly went down the steps, careful not to hit him. However, by the time I reached the door, I hadn't sensed him yet."

entries.text: Sunken Vessel
entries.literal: "Sunken Vessel"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...? Did he leave!?
entries.literal: "What...? Did he leave!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gripped the doorknob and pushed on the door.
entries.literal: "I gripped the doorknob and pushed on the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}It didn't make any sense. It was ridiculous to think that it could. However, the door was locked.
entries.literal: "...{w}It didn't make any sense. It was ridiculous to think that it could. However, the door was locked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't even try to think it over. With the key in my hand, I unlocked the door and opened it all the way.
entries.literal: "I didn't even try to think it over. With the key in my hand, I unlocked the door and opened it all the way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The vast corridor was vacant.
entries.literal: "The vast corridor was vacant."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: A-Atsuki...?
entries.literal: "A-Atsuki...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My whisper didn't reach anyone.
entries.literal: "My whisper didn't reach anyone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did he leave...? There's no way. He couldn't have locked the door.
entries.literal: "Did he leave...? There's no way. He couldn't have locked the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't hear anything above the stairs, but Naomi was there. I knew Atsuki hadn't stepped ahead of me, though.
entries.literal: "I couldn't hear anything above the stairs, but Naomi was there. I knew Atsuki hadn't stepped ahead of me, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What had just happened...? I hadn't heard anything, but someone locked the door. ...With my guard up, I walked to the corridor with the offices.
entries.literal: "What had just happened...? I hadn't heard anything, but someone locked the door. ...With my guard up, I walked to the corridor with the offices."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't feel like anyone was there.
entries.literal: "It didn't feel like anyone was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't have missed the sound of the door locking. I would've also heard Atsuki's movements, and he wouldn't have suddenly left me...!
entries.literal: "I couldn't have missed the sound of the door locking. I would've also heard Atsuki's movements, and he wouldn't have suddenly left me...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was unbelievable. That was an Atsuki who couldn't exist anymore, but he'd been there!
entries.literal: "It was unbelievable. That was an Atsuki who couldn't exist anymore, but he'd been there!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept circling the floor, carefully scanning it.{w} He couldn't have faded out of existence just like that—the door proved something else had happened.
entries.literal: "I kept circling the floor, carefully scanning it.{w} He couldn't have faded out of existence just like that—the door proved something else had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi was in the attic. I'd seen a black suitcase in front of her, which had to be the one we found the first time we entered that place...
entries.literal: "Naomi was in the attic. I'd seen a black suitcase in front of her, which had to be the one we found the first time we entered that place..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went down the stairs, wanting to believe Atsuki was still somewhere.
entries.literal: "I went down the stairs, wanting to believe Atsuki was still somewhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Could it have been due to the Sekimeiya, which had disappeared from our sight? If he had somehow traveled through time, I wanted to believe he was nearby.
entries.literal: "...Could it have been due to the Sekimeiya, which had disappeared from our sight? If he had somehow traveled through time, I wanted to believe he was nearby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the morning of the 15th. ...Why? How had I ended up back on that day?
entries.literal: "It was the morning of the 15th. ...Why? How had I ended up back on that day?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those events should've been erased completely, so why were they repeating?{w} ...Maybe it didn't matter if I really had returned to my world. I would soon learn if everything I'd experienced would happen again.
entries.literal: "Those events should've been erased completely, so why were they repeating?{w} ...Maybe it didn't matter if I really had returned to my world. I would soon learn if everything I'd experienced would happen again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It really wouldn't make any sense if it did. The smoke had just been released. It appeared Naomi hadn't suffered from the effects of the smoke and escaped to the attic with a suitcase.
entries.literal: "...It really wouldn't make any sense if it did. The smoke had just been released. It appeared Naomi hadn't suffered from the effects of the smoke and escaped to the attic with a suitcase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could that long day actually happen again? Not only was I there, but so was an Atsuki who'd experienced it too. ...How many times had we searched the whole building? It was impossible I could avoid being spotted by all those searches.
entries.literal: "Could that long day actually happen again? Not only was I there, but so was an Atsuki who'd experienced it too. ...How many times had we searched the whole building? It was impossible I could avoid being spotted by all those searches."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The events that followed would soon diverge from what I knew. The past would be changed, which was something that should have already happened.
entries.literal: "...The events that followed would soon diverge from what I knew. The past would be changed, which was something that should have already happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Who had returned the world to that state? What had the Sekimeiya really been doing to us? As I proceeded down the floors, I simply wished to reunite with the Atsuki I'd been separated from twice.
entries.literal: "...Who had returned the world to that state? What had the Sekimeiya really been doing to us? As I proceeded down the floors, I simply wished to reunite with the Atsuki I'd been separated from twice."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Wait!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I quickly rifled through my pockets, but they were empty. Then, I stared at my purse in disbelief.
entries.literal: "I quickly rifled through my pockets, but they were empty. Then, I stared at my purse in disbelief."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Why isn't my phone here?{w} Why...? I had it when I touched the Sekimeiya, and the keys that I found in the mechanical room are still here with the one for my apartment. Why the hell is only my phone gone!?
entries.literal: "...Why isn't my phone here?{w} Why...? I had it when I touched the Sekimeiya, and the keys that I found in the mechanical room are still here with the one for my apartment. Why the hell is only my phone gone!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was laughable, as if we were being toyed with. My phone, which I needed the most, was the sole item in my purse that hadn't appeared with me.
entries.literal: "It was laughable, as if we were being toyed with. My phone, which I needed the most, was the sole item in my purse that hadn't appeared with me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But of course, there was another major difference: my clothes. Aside from my coat, they weren't the ones I'd been wearing when I touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "But of course, there was another major difference: my clothes. Aside from my coat, they weren't the ones I'd been wearing when I touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, that's not right. Not all the keys are here.{w} I have the attic's and the rusty key, but not the cabinet's. Why? Why didn't that one travel with me!?
entries.literal: "Wait, that's not right. Not all the keys are here.{w} I have the attic's and the rusty key, but not the cabinet's. Why? Why didn't that one travel with me!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the only one missing, but why? What the hell was different about it!?
entries.literal: "It was the only one missing, but why? What the hell was different about it!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I returned to the crystal floor, searching for the Atsuki I'd just been talking to. Both of us had been disconcerted to be back there, and I couldn't stomach the thought of reliving the same twelve hours.
entries.literal: "I returned to the crystal floor, searching for the Atsuki I'd just been talking to. Both of us had been disconcerted to be back there, and I couldn't stomach the thought of reliving the same twelve hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was the Sekimeiya a sentient being deciding our fate? It almost seemed malicious, but I had to use it to finally break free. I knew plenty of days could be traveled at a time, so we just had to touch it. But when we'd tried that, our travel had failed.
entries.literal: "Was the Sekimeiya a sentient being deciding our fate? It almost seemed malicious, but I had to use it to finally break free. I knew plenty of days could be traveled at a time, so we just had to touch it. But when we'd tried that, our travel had failed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was the reason, then? Why were we forced to stay? Part of me wanted to know the answers to such heavy questions, and part of me wanted to have never even known they existed.
