entries.literal: "What was the reason, then? Why were we forced to stay? Part of me wanted to know the answers to such heavy questions, and part of me wanted to have never even known they existed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped down. The walls ahead looked different than they had minutes prior, as the smoke had rapidly dried up on them.
entries.literal: "I stepped down. The walls ahead looked different than they had minutes prior, as the smoke had rapidly dried up on them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, the suitcase isn't here...
entries.literal: "Oh, the suitcase isn't here..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't noticed that when we'd run up.
entries.literal: "I hadn't noticed that when we'd run up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the beginning of the incident. There were probably next to no people who were conscious, but it was possible someone had faked being knocked out. As I silently walked to hallway B, I couldn't help but wonder what I'd witness.
entries.literal: "It was the beginning of the incident. There were probably next to no people who were conscious, but it was possible someone had faked being knocked out. As I silently walked to hallway B, I couldn't help but wonder what I'd witness."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They're already up.
entries.literal: "They're already up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hid myself as well as I could, staring at the dark end of the hallway. I could see Erina and Sai checking up on Isla, who was still unconscious.
entries.literal: "I hid myself as well as I could, staring at the dark end of the hallway. I could see Erina and Sai checking up on Isla, who was still unconscious."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The three of us should definitely be in the event room, then.
entries.literal: "The three of us should definitely be in the event room, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But there was no trace of the Atsuki I'd just been with, and I had no idea what could've happened to him.
entries.literal: "But there was no trace of the Atsuki I'd just been with, and I had no idea what could've happened to him."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The camera...
entries.literal: "The camera..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was very hard to see from so far away, but it wasn't reflecting anything.
entries.literal: "It was very hard to see from so far away, but it wasn't reflecting anything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did I imagine the lens being clean?
entries.literal: "Did I imagine the lens being clean?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And strangely, behind the three of them, the door to the lobby looked just like it had right before we'd run up. Had it actually moved since Atsuki and I had gone through it? I hadn't the faintest idea. Questioning reality and myself had become roughly equivalent concepts.
entries.literal: "And strangely, behind the three of them, the door to the lobby looked just like it had right before we'd run up. Had it actually moved since Atsuki and I had gone through it? I hadn't the faintest idea. Questioning reality and myself had become roughly equivalent concepts."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...If Atsuki's still here, both of us will try to stay away from the group, so we should find each other quickly.
entries.literal: "...If Atsuki's still here, both of us will try to stay away from the group, so we should find each other quickly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was he there, though? ...Or had he disappeared entirely? I couldn't tell which option the locked attic door pointed to.
entries.literal: "Was he there, though? ...Or had he disappeared entirely? I couldn't tell which option the locked attic door pointed to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nothing I could do. I had no idea if the Sekimeiya had teleported to its cabinet, and I couldn't leave through the storeroom. Still unable to believe the sight of those dark walls, I stared from a distance, waiting for the imminent, unending day to begin.
entries.literal: "There was nothing I could do. I had no idea if the Sekimeiya had teleported to its cabinet, and I couldn't leave through the storeroom. Still unable to believe the sight of those dark walls, I stared from a distance, waiting for the imminent, unending day to begin."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard a door opening and saw three people slowly emerging from the event room. They were Atsuki, Akaro, and myself, stained by the dry substance.
entries.literal: "I heard a door opening and saw three people slowly emerging from the event room. They were Atsuki, Akaro, and myself, stained by the dry substance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Speechless, I saw my old self slowly walking to the others, facing the dark floor. Once they all saw each other, they began to speak.
entries.literal: "Speechless, I saw my old self slowly walking to the others, facing the dark floor. Once they all saw each other, they began to speak."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Their voices were too quiet to understand, but I knew what they were saying. I really was at the start of that day.
entries.literal: "Their voices were too quiet to understand, but I knew what they were saying. I really was at the start of that day."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But wait.{w} Where's Katei...?
entries.literal: "But wait.{w} Where's Katei...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no tall figure in a uniform next to them. ...When we'd left the event room for the first time, he'd already been there with the other group.
entries.literal: "There was no tall figure in a uniform next to them. ...When we'd left the event room for the first time, he'd already been there with the other group."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I verified that I wasn't mistaken. Katei was nowhere to be seen.
entries.literal: "I verified that I wasn't mistaken. Katei was nowhere to be seen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then... this isn't the start of the day we know. Everything is bound to differ.{w} ...Could Katei have seen me here, which made him hesitant to show himself?
entries.literal: "Then... this isn't the start of the day we know. Everything is bound to differ.{w} ...Could Katei have seen me here, which made him hesitant to show himself?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just what had happened to the world...!? Where exactly was I, and how had I ended up there!? Failing to know such fundamentals made my head spin.
entries.literal: "Just what had happened to the world...!? Where exactly was I, and how had I ended up there!? Failing to know such fundamentals made my head spin."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, everything will be different. It's gotta be because I'm here, and the first time I wasn't. None of what happened is guaranteed to repeat.
entries.literal: "So, everything will be different. It's gotta be because I'm here, and the first time I wasn't. None of what happened is guaranteed to repeat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Atsuki I'd just been with couldn't exist anymore, but he couldn't have disappeared because of something I'd done! After all, I would've vanished with him.
entries.literal: "The Atsuki I'd just been with couldn't exist anymore, but he couldn't have disappeared because of something I'd done! After all, I would've vanished with him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really wanted to find him again and get out. I'd tried to internalize that I'd never talk to him again, but I'd evidently failed, as I could feel relief while the people near the entrance met each other for the first time.
entries.literal: "I really wanted to find him again and get out. I'd tried to internalize that I'd never talk to him again, but I'd evidently failed, as I could feel relief while the people near the entrance met each other for the first time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For some reason, I had seen him again, and he had to still be somewhere. It was possible to break free with him, something that seemed impossible for the longest time. We were not in our original world, so even though we'd be stuck with different versions of ourselves, that really didn't matter.
entries.literal: "For some reason, I had seen him again, and he had to still be somewhere. It was possible to break free with him, something that seemed impossible for the longest time. We were not in our original world, so even though we'd be stuck with different versions of ourselves, that really didn't matter."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't tell what they were talking about, but they would soon search the whole building. That meant I would eventually be discovered.
entries.literal: "I couldn't tell what they were talking about, but they would soon search the whole building. That meant I would eventually be discovered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at my clothes. What the hell would I say if I was found? They'd immediately notice I wasn't the same person—I had less smoke on me, and my clothes were different.
entries.literal: "I looked at my clothes. What the hell would I say if I was found? They'd immediately notice I wasn't the same person—I had less smoke on me, and my clothes were different."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm.
entries.literal: "Hm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd had a fairly absurd thought.{w} "I can enter the attic, so what if I put on the clothes from up there and make up an excuse like being too cold or that my clothes were itchy due to the smoke?"
entries.literal: "I'd had a fairly absurd thought.{w} \"I can enter the attic, so what if I put on the clothes from up there and make up an excuse like being too cold or that my clothes were itchy due to the smoke?\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, that brought my mind to the self of mine Atsuki had once seen. According to him, she had been wearing clothes from the attic.
entries.literal: "Of course, that brought my mind to the self of mine Atsuki had once seen. According to him, she had been wearing clothes from the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...This wouldn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "...This wouldn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not in that reality anymore. The person Atsuki saw can't be me. ...It's impossible.
entries.literal: "I'm not in that reality anymore. The person Atsuki saw can't be me. ...It's impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea how the universe worked. Was it remotely possible for me to go back to that world? It shouldn't have been, but if I could, I wanted to finish that circle.
entries.literal: "I had no idea how the universe worked. Was it remotely possible for me to go back to that world? It shouldn't have been, but if I could, I wanted to finish that circle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once, I'd willingly abandoned that reality, but I had slowly learned that it was a mistake. What I still had there was not something I could leave behind.
entries.literal: "Once, I'd willingly abandoned that reality, but I had slowly learned that it was a mistake. What I still had there was not something I could leave behind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Didn't it work like this a few times on the 15th...?
entries.literal: "Didn't it work like this a few times on the 15th...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I go to the attic and put on clothes from the wardrobe, what would the reason be? To hope I'll end up in that reality again, where a version of me with those clothes existed? ...Doesn't that not make sense? Like Atsuki and I talked about, it's an event with no origin, a paradox.
entries.literal: "If I go to the attic and put on clothes from the wardrobe, what would the reason be? To hope I'll end up in that reality again, where a version of me with those clothes existed? ...Doesn't that not make sense? Like Atsuki and I talked about, it's an event with no origin, a paradox."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But the reason I just thought about changing my clothes was to conceal myself as part of this reality, not just to complete a loop where it already happened. Would I have thought of this even if I didn't know about the version of me Atsuki saw?
entries.literal: "But the reason I just thought about changing my clothes was to conceal myself as part of this reality, not just to complete a loop where it already happened. Would I have thought of this even if I didn't know about the version of me Atsuki saw?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Naomi was just in the attic. On the 15th, we found two dead versions of her, but that doesn't have to repeat. My original world should be long gone...
entries.literal: "Naomi was just in the attic. On the 15th, we found two dead versions of her, but that doesn't have to repeat. My original world should be long gone..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But right now, I'm not there, and I can get the clothes that me was wearing. ...If they lead me back to that reality, it would explain why we still found them in the attic when we ran up. They had never been taken out.
entries.literal: "But right now, I'm not there, and I can get the clothes that me was wearing. ...If they lead me back to that reality, it would explain why we still found them in the attic when we ran up. They had never been taken out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator was supposedly disabled, so I started going up on foot.
entries.literal: "The elevator was supposedly disabled, so I started going up on foot."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The attic door was still unlocked.
entries.literal: "The attic door was still unlocked."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was me who unlocked it. On the 15th, we couldn't get it to open when we came across it because Naomi had shut herself inside.{w} ...Since it hasn't been locked again, she must not have left yet.
entries.literal: "It was me who unlocked it. On the 15th, we couldn't get it to open when we came across it because Naomi had shut herself inside.{w} ...Since it hasn't been locked again, she must not have left yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slowly ascended the steps, unsure what to think of Naomi.
entries.literal: "I slowly ascended the steps, unsure what to think of Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was she behind the attack? ...Someone would soon try to kill her, but what was their motive?
entries.literal: "Was she behind the attack? ...Someone would soon try to kill her, but what was their motive?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see the light of the living room through the slightly open door. When I went still, the attic felt completely soulless.
entries.literal: "I could see the light of the living room through the slightly open door. When I went still, the attic felt completely soulless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I finally took a glance at the room.
entries.literal: "I finally took a glance at the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I couldn't see anyone, so I had to step a little closer. When I did, it made no difference.
entries.literal: "...I couldn't see anyone, so I had to step a little closer. When I did, it made no difference."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi wasn't there anymore. Just a few minutes ago, she had been standing on the carpet, looking at the suitcase, which had remained open on the soft cushion.
entries.literal: "Naomi wasn't there anymore. Just a few minutes ago, she had been standing on the carpet, looking at the suitcase, which had remained open on the soft cushion."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were my eyes deceiving me? ...Perplexed, I stepped onto the carpet.
entries.literal: "Were my eyes deceiving me? ...Perplexed, I stepped onto the carpet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled the first time I'd set foot inside. Back then, an identical suitcase had been on that couch, but it was empty. That wasn't the case at the moment.
entries.literal: "I recalled the first time I'd set foot inside. Back then, an identical suitcase had been on that couch, but it was empty. That wasn't the case at the moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was not only one Sekimeiya in it, but a second. One of them was gray, and the other shined faintly.
entries.literal: "There was not only one Sekimeiya in it, but a second. One of them was gray, and the other shined faintly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I was staring at them, the disabled one became white.
entries.literal: "As I was staring at them, the disabled one became white."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why...? Why are there two?
entries.literal: "Why...? Why are there two?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hovered my hand over the one on the right. It was hard to notice, but I definitely felt a warm aura. I could touch it and travel right there.
entries.literal: "I hovered my hand over the one on the right. It was hard to notice, but I definitely felt a warm aura. I could touch it and travel right there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't fathom the sight. Why was there another Sekimeiya next to it?{w} I knew from what Atsuki told me that two had existed at one point...
entries.literal: "I couldn't fathom the sight. Why was there another Sekimeiya next to it?{w} I knew from what Atsuki told me that two had existed at one point..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And it appeared they had since the very start. How had a second one come to exist? I only knew that just before I'd entered the room, one of them had been activated.
entries.literal: "...And it appeared they had since the very start. How had a second one come to exist? I only knew that just before I'd entered the room, one of them had been activated."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Naomi must've touched it, and she appeared somewhere else.
entries.literal: "Naomi must've touched it, and she appeared somewhere else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked down at the carpeted floor. Naomi's footprints ended exactly where I was. However, I couldn't help but feel something was wrong.
entries.literal: "I looked down at the carpeted floor. Naomi's footprints ended exactly where I was. However, I couldn't help but feel something was wrong."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isn't this... the opposite of what we saw?
entries.literal: "Isn't this... the opposite of what we saw?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we all entered the attic, her footprints began at the suitcase.{w} Now, they end at it, and I already mixed mine with hers.
entries.literal: "When we all entered the attic, her footprints began at the suitcase.{w} Now, they end at it, and I already mixed mine with hers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I forced myself to drop it. No matter why, two Sekimeiya were in front of me. I nervously stared at them, knowing Naomi could be anywhere.
entries.literal: "I forced myself to drop it. No matter why, two Sekimeiya were in front of me. I nervously stared at them, knowing Naomi could be anywhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: One of them was supposed to be on the crystal floor, and duplicating it had never sounded possible. However, it was very evident its powers went far beyond the mere time travel we'd once learned about.
entries.literal: "One of them was supposed to be on the crystal floor, and duplicating it had never sounded possible. However, it was very evident its powers went far beyond the mere time travel we'd once learned about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would they let me travel, or would that be denied again? I faltered, desperately trying to make up my mind.
entries.literal: "Would they let me travel, or would that be denied again? I faltered, desperately trying to make up my mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why had Atsuki suddenly disappeared...!? He had to still exist...
entries.literal: "Why had Atsuki suddenly disappeared...!? He had to still exist..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't in our reality, but was it really possible to return to it...? If I traveled to the past right then, even outside of the tower, that Atsuki would likely not be there.
entries.literal: "I wasn't in our reality, but was it really possible to return to it...? If I traveled to the past right then, even outside of the tower, that Atsuki would likely not be there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The world is being constantly changed, and not only by me. To be back together outside, we'd need to travel to the past at the same time.
entries.literal: "...The world is being constantly changed, and not only by me. To be back together outside, we'd need to travel to the past at the same time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It made me want to tear my hair out. Was there really a reason why I was at the beginning of the incident? ...Would I be sent back to my reality if I merely followed some sort of destiny?
entries.literal: "It made me want to tear my hair out. Was there really a reason why I was at the beginning of the incident? ...Would I be sent back to my reality if I merely followed some sort of destiny?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: These two Sekimeiya... This could be good.
entries.literal: "These two Sekimeiya... This could be good."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The existence of an extra one isn't known, and Naomi just traveled somewhere thinking she left the attic locked. I can hide one of them, and the group won't be aware of the one I have even if they enter the attic.
entries.literal: "The existence of an extra one isn't known, and Naomi just traveled somewhere thinking she left the attic locked. I can hide one of them, and the group won't be aware of the one I have even if they enter the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After that, I just have to find Atsuki and bring him to the Sekimeiya that'll a lot of energy. That's how we'll be able to leave.
entries.literal: "After that, I just have to find Atsuki and bring him to the Sekimeiya that'll a lot of energy. That's how we'll be able to leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who knew about that second Sekimeiya? Was it only Naomi? On the 15th, she had appeared from the lower floors, asking to talk to Katei privately. Maybe that was where she ended up after she vanished from the attic.
entries.literal: "Who knew about that second Sekimeiya? Was it only Naomi? On the 15th, she had appeared from the lower floors, asking to talk to Katei privately. Maybe that was where she ended up after she vanished from the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could be sure the previously gray one worked, so I grabbed it, avoiding direct contact. I knew very well about the lack of good hiding spots, so I considered where to leave it.
entries.literal: "I could be sure the previously gray one worked, so I grabbed it, avoiding direct contact. I knew very well about the lack of good hiding spots, so I considered where to leave it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had personally found the hidden area in the storeroom, and it was possible Katei knew about it. Because of that, somewhere in the attic immediately seemed like the best option.
entries.literal: "I had personally found the hidden area in the storeroom, and it was possible Katei knew about it. Because of that, somewhere in the attic immediately seemed like the best option."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I entered the rightmost bedroom.
entries.literal: "...I entered the rightmost bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Keeping my hands off the gem, I opened the wardrobe. Once I looked inside, I remembered the two pieces of clothing Atsuki had pointed at.{w} They were a white shirt and a dark gray pair of pants, larger than what I usually wore. There was nothing else to put on.
entries.literal: "Keeping my hands off the gem, I opened the wardrobe. Once I looked inside, I remembered the two pieces of clothing Atsuki had pointed at.{w} They were a white shirt and a dark gray pair of pants, larger than what I usually wore. There was nothing else to put on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around me, wondering where to leave the Sekimeiya. Since I had to find Atsuki, I couldn't stay with it, but there weren't many places in the attic that could conceal things for long. The best I could think to do was crouch next to the bed and let the Sekimeiya roll up to the wall underneath it.
entries.literal: "I looked around me, wondering where to leave the Sekimeiya. Since I had to find Atsuki, I couldn't stay with it, but there weren't many places in the attic that could conceal things for long. The best I could think to do was crouch next to the bed and let the Sekimeiya roll up to the wall underneath it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door to the attic was still unlocked, so I had to hurry. I took off my coat and grabbed both pieces of clothing, sensing a bizarre surrealness as I put them on. Would that mere action guarantee my return to that world? There was nothing else I could do to aim for that.{w} ...Had the me that Atsuki had seen really been me after all?
entries.literal: "The door to the attic was still unlocked, so I had to hurry. I took off my coat and grabbed both pieces of clothing, sensing a bizarre surrealness as I put them on. Would that mere action guarantee my return to that world? There was nothing else I could do to aim for that.{w} ...Had the me that Atsuki had seen really been me after all?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tied my coat and old clothing around my waist together and exited the room.
entries.literal: "I tied my coat and old clothing around my waist together and exited the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other Sekimeiya still sat on the sofa. What would happen to it? Would anyone find it before the rest entered the attic?{w} We had only been able to come in thanks to the keys on Naomi's dead body. Someone in the tower had to be plotting her death right then, so I needed to find her and see if I could prevent that.
entries.literal: "The other Sekimeiya still sat on the sofa. What would happen to it? Would anyone find it before the rest entered the attic?{w} We had only been able to come in thanks to the keys on Naomi's dead body. Someone in the tower had to be plotting her death right then, so I needed to find her and see if I could prevent that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I locked the door with my key. Then, going down the floors, I thought about something Atsuki had said after we'd met again.
entries.literal: "I locked the door with my key. Then, going down the floors, I thought about something Atsuki had said after we'd met again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He claimed the recording was real.{w} What the hell did that even mean? Did they really spend an entire month here? There's no way.
entries.literal: "He claimed the recording was real.{w} What the hell did that even mean? Did they really spend an entire month here? There's no way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What had happened after my travel? The eyes he'd looked at me with had first been filled with suspicion, but why...? Who could I have been if not the "real Shiroya"?
entries.literal: "What had happened after my travel? The eyes he'd looked at me with had first been filled with suspicion, but why...? Who could I have been if not the \"real Shiroya\"?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's going to be quite a few hours until the time he saw me with these clothes in hallway B. Will I be there by that time somehow?
entries.literal: "It's going to be quite a few hours until the time he saw me with these clothes in hallway B. Will I be there by that time somehow?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew my goals were slightly contradictory. After all, that reality wasn't where the Atsuki I was searching for was. However, if I really got there, I could show myself to the others as soon as I traveled to the past from the bathroom. Then, I would suddenly be the original me again.
entries.literal: "I knew my goals were slightly contradictory. After all, that reality wasn't where the Atsuki I was searching for was. However, if I really got there, I could show myself to the others as soon as I traveled to the past from the bathroom. Then, I would suddenly be the original me again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went down the multiple staircases, feeling the odd touch of my new clothes. When I got to the last one, I noticed voices coming from hallway C.
entries.literal: "I went down the multiple staircases, feeling the odd touch of my new clothes. When I got to the last one, I noticed voices coming from hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They quickly faded, and I realized the group was moving to hallway B. I silently looked past the gray door.
entries.literal: "They quickly faded, and I realized the group was moving to hallway B. I silently looked past the gray door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Katei's still not with them.{w} There's no way they talked to the outside.{w} Why is Katei not showing himself? He still has to be here, doesn't he...?
entries.literal: "Katei's still not with them.{w} There's no way they talked to the outside.{w} Why is Katei not showing himself? He still has to be here, doesn't he...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could hear doors opening, the sound of them searching through hallway B. I knew they'd soon go up the floors, so if I wasn't careful, I could easily be found. The storeroom and the attic were the only somewhat unreachable places.
entries.literal: "I could hear doors opening, the sound of them searching through hallway B. I knew they'd soon go up the floors, so if I wasn't careful, I could easily be found. The storeroom and the attic were the only somewhat unreachable places."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where could Atsuki be!? Is it possible he went to the past and was teleported outside the tower?{w} ...Even if that happened, would he not have entered it again? I suppose not if the incident had already started.
entries.literal: "Where could Atsuki be!? Is it possible he went to the past and was teleported outside the tower?{w} ...Even if that happened, would he not have entered it again? I suppose not if the incident had already started."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I was sure hallway C was empty, I stepped down and silently walked to A.
entries.literal: "When I was sure hallway C was empty, I stepped down and silently walked to A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, as I'd expected, the group came closer again.
entries.literal: "Eventually, as I'd expected, the group came closer again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To avoid being seen, I hid myself in one of the crystal rooms which had just been investigated, A5. It was the one that had been hit by the smoke, and I could see the gems were still missing.
entries.literal: "To avoid being seen, I hid myself in one of the crystal rooms which had just been investigated, A5. It was the one that had been hit by the smoke, and I could see the gems were still missing."

entries.speaker: il4
entries.text: ..ake— ...evator?
entries.literal: "..ake— ...evator?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recognized all their voices, and the conversation they were having was fairly familiar to me.
entries.literal: "I recognized all their voices, and the conversation they were having was fairly familiar to me."

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: ...em to be worki—
entries.literal: "...em to be worki—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After noticing the elevator wasn't functioning, they loudly went up the stairs. As Katei wasn't with them, their pace was much quicker, and they didn't consider the unlocked door to floor 2 odd.
entries.literal: "After noticing the elevator wasn't functioning, they loudly went up the stairs. As Katei wasn't with them, their pace was much quicker, and they didn't consider the unlocked door to floor 2 odd."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And they didn't find the suitcase in hallway C.
entries.literal: "...And they didn't find the suitcase in hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On that day, we'd been beset with questions from the word go. Who discarded that suitcase? ...What caused the computer's shutdown?
entries.literal: "On that day, we'd been beset with questions from the word go. Who discarded that suitcase? ...What caused the computer's shutdown?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After some time had passed, I exited the room. Was Atsuki there as well, hiding like I was?
entries.literal: "After some time had passed, I exited the room. Was Atsuki there as well, hiding like I was?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still puzzled by Katei's absence, I went to check the live camera feed. I assumed the monitors were working.
entries.literal: "Still puzzled by Katei's absence, I went to check the live camera feed. I assumed the monitors were working."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door wasn't opening.
entries.literal: "The door wasn't opening."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's locked...? Why?
entries.literal: "It's locked...? Why?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I asked myself that, I knew the answer: the alarm had locked it.
entries.literal: "As soon as I asked myself that, I knew the answer: the alarm had locked it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And Katei hasn't unlocked it yet. I guess this proves he wasn't in the security room during the attack.
entries.literal: "...And Katei hasn't unlocked it yet. I guess this proves he wasn't in the security room during the attack."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Or... could it be he's currently still inside?
entries.literal: "Or... could it be he's currently still inside?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only the shutter was in the lobby. At that time, no blood had been spilled yet, and the shining floor remained spotless.
entries.literal: "Only the shutter was in the lobby. At that time, no blood had been spilled yet, and the shining floor remained spotless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Aside from the darker tone, the case was identical in hallway B. I looked up at the closest camera and confirmed every part of it had been covered by the smoke.
entries.literal: "Aside from the darker tone, the case was identical in hallway B. I looked up at the closest camera and confirmed every part of it had been covered by the smoke."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At first glance, nobody else was on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "At first glance, nobody else was on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Atsuki?{w} Are you here...?{w} Atsuki!
entries.literal: "...Atsuki?{w} Are you here...?{w} Atsuki!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt like my voice was audible across the entire crystal floor, but nobody was drawn to it.
entries.literal: "I felt like my voice was audible across the entire crystal floor, but nobody was drawn to it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi had to be somewhere too, but I wasn't sure she'd show herself to me. As I didn't want to be in the middle of the hallway, I walked toward a place I had to check.
entries.literal: "Naomi had to be somewhere too, but I wasn't sure she'd show herself to me. As I didn't want to be in the middle of the hallway, I walked toward a place I had to check."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the storeroom and rapidly closed the door behind me. The fake wall was keeping the larger corridor hidden, so I carefully felt it for the opening mechanism.
entries.literal: "I entered the storeroom and rapidly closed the door behind me. The fake wall was keeping the larger corridor hidden, so I carefully felt it for the opening mechanism."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After finding it, I slid it to the back and opened it with ease.
entries.literal: "After finding it, I slid it to the back and opened it with ease."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shut myself in. I couldn't believe that secret passage hadn't had any relevance during the day. It served some kind of purpose, and it was likely someone else still in the tower knew about it. I couldn't feel completely safe there.
entries.literal: "I shut myself in. I couldn't believe that secret passage hadn't had any relevance during the day. It served some kind of purpose, and it was likely someone else still in the tower knew about it. I couldn't feel completely safe there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After shutting myself in, the complete darkness returned.
entries.literal: "After shutting myself in, the complete darkness returned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped up to the final door, aware of where it led.
entries.literal: "I stepped up to the final door, aware of where it led."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see anything, so I'd blindly felt its surface with one hand. ...Something else was there.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see anything, so I'd blindly felt its surface with one hand. ...Something else was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is the handle...! It hasn't been taken off!
entries.literal: "This is the handle...! It hasn't been taken off!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gripped the freezing metal and turned it downward.
entries.literal: "I gripped the freezing metal and turned it downward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immediately, the door smoothly moved toward me, allowing bright light to illuminate the gloomy walls.
entries.literal: "Immediately, the door smoothly moved toward me, allowing bright light to illuminate the gloomy walls."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before the gap widened, I hastily closed it again. I'd seen white grass at my feet and the surrounding mountains above. The door... was not locked.
entries.literal: "Before the gap widened, I hastily closed it again. I'd seen white grass at my feet and the surrounding mountains above. The door... was not locked."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Has the handle not been removed yet...? ...Or did it never happen this time?
entries.literal: "Has the handle not been removed yet...? ...Or did it never happen this time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Puzzled, I tried to understand why stepping out of the building was possible.{w} ...On the 15th, the handle had been taken off. When I'd entered the tower during the night, it had already been gone. So how could it possibly have been attached right then?
entries.literal: "Puzzled, I tried to understand why stepping out of the building was possible.{w} ...On the 15th, the handle had been taken off. When I'd entered the tower during the night, it had already been gone. So how could it possibly have been attached right then?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a line of reasoning that made a bit of sense.{w} In the morning of that day, we had found a rusty key on the floor of hallway A. ...It was a key I had in my purse at that very moment.
entries.literal: "There was a line of reasoning that made a bit of sense.{w} In the morning of that day, we had found a rusty key on the floor of hallway A. ...It was a key I had in my purse at that very moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After feeling its rough surface, I took it out and inserted it into the keyhole. Upon turning it, I successfully locked the door.
entries.literal: "After feeling its rough surface, I took it out and inserted it into the keyhole. Upon turning it, I successfully locked the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It really was for this door, then...
entries.literal: "It really was for this door, then..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And we had found it very early on. It was likely that the handle had been gone since the start.
entries.literal: "And we had found it very early on. It was likely that the handle had been gone since the start."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why would it have been removed so early? Of course, to prevent us from leaving.{w} ...But how would anyone have done that? After all, the alarm was supposed to be a secret. We didn't even learn what really triggered it.
entries.literal: "Why would it have been removed so early? Of course, to prevent us from leaving.{w} ...But how would anyone have done that? After all, the alarm was supposed to be a secret. We didn't even learn what really triggered it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Whoever took it off knew about the alarm in addition to the secret door's existence. Normally, I would assume that the door was always taken into consideration for whatever the attack entailed...
entries.literal: "Whoever took it off knew about the alarm in addition to the secret door's existence. Normally, I would assume that the door was always taken into consideration for whatever the attack entailed..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But the fact that it was open just now contradicts that, especially because when I entered the tower through it, the handle was already gone.
entries.literal: "But the fact that it was open just now contradicts that, especially because when I entered the tower through it, the handle was already gone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. ...The handle was removed days before the 15th, but this didn't repeat this time, so the door is unlocked. Someone who traveled far to the past must have removed the handle, aware of the alarm and secret door thanks to their future knowledge.{w} But... did they see the handle removed before they traveled and then remove it in the past, making it a loop with no start...?
entries.literal: "I see. ...The handle was removed days before the 15th, but this didn't repeat this time, so the door is unlocked. Someone who traveled far to the past must have removed the handle, aware of the alarm and secret door thanks to their future knowledge.{w} But... did they see the handle removed before they traveled and then remove it in the past, making it a loop with no start...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In any case, this isn't that same world. In this one, the handle wasn't taken off days in advance by anyone. I'm not sure what the cause of these differences is, but there is another major one that must be related.
entries.literal: "In any case, this isn't that same world. In this one, the handle wasn't taken off days in advance by anyone. I'm not sure what the cause of these differences is, but there is another major one that must be related."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Katei's absence. I don't think he's in the building right now.{w} In the past, I found the key for this door in his security room. On the 15th, we found it in hallway A, where I bet he dropped it. ...I wonder why he didn't go back for it.{w} Was Katei responsible for all this? That doesn't make a ton of sense, but he had this key. He was ready to leave through this door because he knew the alarm would go off and block every other method of escape. If someone hadn't removed the handle in the past, we might never have even seen him.
entries.literal: "...Katei's absence. I don't think he's in the building right now.{w} In the past, I found the key for this door in his security room. On the 15th, we found it in hallway A, where I bet he dropped it. ...I wonder why he didn't go back for it.{w} Was Katei responsible for all this? That doesn't make a ton of sense, but he had this key. He was ready to leave through this door because he knew the alarm would go off and block every other method of escape. If someone hadn't removed the handle in the past, we might never have even seen him."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So what happened here?
entries.literal: "So what happened here?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did he leave right after the smoke was released? I wonder what this plan was really about, then, because Naomi ran up with the Sekimeiya. ...Well, with two of them.
entries.literal: "Did he leave right after the smoke was released? I wonder what this plan was really about, then, because Naomi ran up with the Sekimeiya. ...Well, with two of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still had no clue what the attack actually was. I didn't know who was innocent and who wasn't. However, that wasn't the most important thing.
entries.literal: "I still had no clue what the attack actually was. I didn't know who was innocent and who wasn't. However, that wasn't the most important thing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What should I do now?
entries.literal: "...What should I do now?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Everyone can leave. Katei's not here, so they must not know what happened or how long they'll have to be here for.
entries.literal: "Everyone can leave. Katei's not here, so they must not know what happened or how long they'll have to be here for."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Was Katei behind all the deaths? Did he kill Naomi? ...If he did, they should all be safe. But I don't know what Naomi's intentions are, and Katei also ended up dying in our world.
entries.literal: "...Was Katei behind all the deaths? Did he kill Naomi? ...If he did, they should all be safe. But I don't know what Naomi's intentions are, and Katei also ended up dying in our world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it wasn't so simple. If everyone left just like that, I wouldn't return to that world. The only way that could happen was by still being in the tower in the afternoon.
entries.literal: "But it wasn't so simple. If everyone left just like that, I wouldn't return to that world. The only way that could happen was by still being in the tower in the afternoon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...What if Atsuki wasn't with me anymore? If everyone left, I'd finally cement a world with an extra version of myself.
entries.literal: "...What if Atsuki wasn't with me anymore? If everyone left, I'd finally cement a world with an extra version of myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How would it happen? How would I ever return to that world? Just as I didn't know that, I had no clue how I'd ended up where I was.
entries.literal: "How would it happen? How would I ever return to that world? Just as I didn't know that, I had no clue how I'd ended up where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was possible the world would morph as the hours went on. People would learn about time travel and eventually go back in time. Upon altering the past, the world's status would shift.{w} It was a mystery how the changes were applied, but I didn't think it was impossible that I could get to where I wanted merely by letting the hours pass.
entries.literal: "It was possible the world would morph as the hours went on. People would learn about time travel and eventually go back in time. Upon altering the past, the world's status would shift.{w} It was a mystery how the changes were applied, but I didn't think it was impossible that I could get to where I wanted merely by letting the hours pass."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I knew where two Sekimeiya were, and while it was possible I could leave with them, it was incredibly risky—I had no way to know whether traveling to the past was still a good idea.
entries.literal: "...I knew where two Sekimeiya were, and while it was possible I could leave with them, it was incredibly risky—I had no way to know whether traveling to the past was still a good idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around and walked toward the wall.{w} ...I thought I'd heard a sound coming from the hallway.
entries.literal: "I turned around and walked toward the wall.{w} ...I thought I'd heard a sound coming from the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I held my breath, staying as close to the wall as possible. The storeroom was uncomfortably cold, so I didn't directly touch the tile.
entries.literal: "...I held my breath, staying as close to the wall as possible. The storeroom was uncomfortably cold, so I didn't directly touch the tile."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had I been mistaken, or had someone crossed the hallway? After focusing my hearing, I hadn't heard anything else.
entries.literal: "Had I been mistaken, or had someone crossed the hallway? After focusing my hearing, I hadn't heard anything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...If it was the group, I figured they would be talking and have audible footsteps. Unless I'd imagined it, it was either one or two people.
entries.literal: "...If it was the group, I figured they would be talking and have audible footsteps. Unless I'd imagined it, it was either one or two people."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Could it have been Atsuki? I began to debate what to do.
entries.literal: "...Could it have been Atsuki? I began to debate what to do."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He knows about this place. If it's him, he should come here eventually.
entries.literal: "He knows about this place. If it's him, he should come here eventually."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been rigidly on alert for a couple of minutes. If someone was close to me, I wasn't perceiving them.
entries.literal: "I'd been rigidly on alert for a couple of minutes. If someone was close to me, I wasn't perceiving them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That was until an abrupt yell came. A faint but shrill yell that instantly pierced my chest.
entries.literal: "...That was until an abrupt yell came. A faint but shrill yell that instantly pierced my chest."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seconds later, a door was shut.
entries.literal: "Seconds later, a door was shut."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had paralyzed me on the spot. Staring at the darkness, I kept replaying the brusque, feminine yell that had immediately lapsed into silence.
entries.literal: "It had paralyzed me on the spot. Staring at the darkness, I kept replaying the brusque, feminine yell that had immediately lapsed into silence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to rush out of the storeroom. That yell was full of nothing but despair, and someone was still there.{w} I wanted to deny I'd even heard it, but I forced myself to move.
entries.literal: "I had to rush out of the storeroom. That yell was full of nothing but despair, and someone was still there.{w} I wanted to deny I'd even heard it, but I forced myself to move."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the wall and very slowly stepped forward. Then, I placed my hand on the hallway doorknob. It was dangerous, but I desperately wanted to see that I'd been wrong.
entries.literal: "I opened the wall and very slowly stepped forward. Then, I placed my hand on the hallway doorknob. It was dangerous, but I desperately wanted to see that I'd been wrong."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hallway seemed completely empty. I distinctly felt the sensation that nobody else was there, but I knew that couldn't be the case.
entries.literal: "The hallway seemed completely empty. I distinctly felt the sensation that nobody else was there, but I knew that couldn't be the case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door that had closed... All of them were, but my legs began to walk toward one in particular.
entries.literal: "The door that had closed... All of them were, but my legs began to walk toward one in particular."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized how fast my heart had gotten when I gripped the door, and once I opened it, that only intensified.
entries.literal: "I realized how fast my heart had gotten when I gripped the door, and once I opened it, that only intensified."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't been wrong, but the sight I saw wasn't what I expected.
entries.literal: "I hadn't been wrong, but the sight I saw wasn't what I expected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were two bodies lying on the floor. The room was dim, but I instantly identified them.
entries.literal: "There were two bodies lying on the floor. The room was dim, but I instantly identified them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There couldn't be a more terrifying sight. While my hands trembled and I began to step back, a fate that had been once stated replayed like a record.
entries.literal: "There couldn't be a more terrifying sight. While my hands trembled and I began to step back, a fate that had been once stated replayed like a record."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...On the floor was my own body, facing me with blank eyes. It had been my own anguished yell that I'd heard.{w} Next to it was Naomi, her head dripping blood beneath one of my arms.
entries.literal: "...On the floor was my own body, facing me with blank eyes. It had been my own anguished yell that I'd heard.{w} Next to it was Naomi, her head dripping blood beneath one of my arms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without making noise, I closed the door. Someone was still present—someone who had killed me.
entries.literal: "Without making noise, I closed the door. Someone was still present—someone who had killed me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't let myself be seen. A sudden dizziness invaded me as I glanced back and forth between both sides of the corridor. Trying not to lurch, I reached the storeroom again.
entries.literal: "I couldn't let myself be seen. A sudden dizziness invaded me as I glanced back and forth between both sides of the corridor. Trying not to lurch, I reached the storeroom again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind the wall, I let out a long breath, that merciless image still burned into my retinas.
entries.literal: "Behind the wall, I let out a long breath, that merciless image still burned into my retinas."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I... had been killed.
entries.literal: "I... had been killed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How had that happened...? Even though the body I'd seen wasn't mine, my own could barely support itself either.
entries.literal: "How had that happened...? Even though the body I'd seen wasn't mine, my own could barely support itself either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who... had done it? If Katei wasn't in the tower, very few options remained. ...I'd even been wrong about Naomi's safety, as she'd fallen victim next to me.
entries.literal: "Who... had done it? If Katei wasn't in the tower, very few options remained. ...I'd even been wrong about Naomi's safety, as she'd fallen victim next to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to think straight—it was crucial not to lose myself. The person who had killed Naomi the first time must've targeted me as well... but why...!? And who had it been...!?
entries.literal: "I had to think straight—it was crucial not to lose myself. The person who had killed Naomi the first time must've targeted me as well... but why...!? And who had it been...!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no sound I could pick up. The closing door had been the last time I'd perceived someone's presence.
entries.literal: "There was no sound I could pick up. The closing door had been the last time I'd perceived someone's presence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to calm myself down. The world I was in wouldn't remain.{w} It would be entirely modified until it warped into the day I'd lived through. That would erase my death.
entries.literal: "I had to calm myself down. The world I was in wouldn't remain.{w} It would be entirely modified until it warped into the day I'd lived through. That would erase my death."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That... had to happen. I didn't know how, or why, but it had to.
entries.literal: "That... had to happen. I didn't know how, or why, but it had to."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Atsuki... The new one. Where is he?
entries.literal: "Atsuki... The new one. Where is he?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart wouldn't slow down. Atsuki was going to see my body soon. ...Just thinking about that made it hard to breathe.
entries.literal: "My heart wouldn't slow down. Atsuki was going to see my body soon. ...Just thinking about that made it hard to breathe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Miiya had just died. I couldn't let him see me dead too, or he might have given up entirely instead of fighting. I didn't want to imagine the brief thoughts going through my own head before dying either, but I couldn't stop imagining them.
entries.literal: "Miiya had just died. I couldn't let him see me dead too, or he might have given up entirely instead of fighting. I didn't want to imagine the brief thoughts going through my own head before dying either, but I couldn't stop imagining them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two Sekimeiya were in the attic. Trying to undo what had happened was possible.
entries.literal: "Two Sekimeiya were in the attic. Trying to undo what had happened was possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone was above me, and as the elevator didn't work, I couldn't rush up. I hadn't wanted to travel through time, but Atsuki couldn't see that I'd died, no matter if it could be reversed later.
entries.literal: "Everyone was above me, and as the elevator didn't work, I couldn't rush up. I hadn't wanted to travel through time, but Atsuki couldn't see that I'd died, no matter if it could be reversed later."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was the killer close to me? If I was found, I would become a target. They would have no issue killing me twice. Even though I hadn't heard anything again, they could've been quietly staying somewhere.
entries.literal: "Was the killer close to me? If I was found, I would become a target. They would have no issue killing me twice. Even though I hadn't heard anything again, they could've been quietly staying somewhere."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was someone who wanted to kill me since this morning. I have to figure out who it was so that I can be careful later or in case I travel to the past again.
entries.literal: "It was someone who wanted to kill me since this morning. I have to figure out who it was so that I can be careful later or in case I travel to the past again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why had I separated myself from the others? In the morning, I had been careful not to remain alone or with people I didn't trust.
entries.literal: "Why had I separated myself from the others? In the morning, I had been careful not to remain alone or with people I didn't trust."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was unbearably terrified, so I froze behind the wall. Paralyzed by fear, I was unable to leave that place.{w} I had to go to the event room and move the bodies to where I was so that they wouldn't be found. If the killer noticed me, however, everything would be over.
entries.literal: "I was unbearably terrified, so I froze behind the wall. Paralyzed by fear, I was unable to leave that place.{w} I had to go to the event room and move the bodies to where I was so that they wouldn't be found. If the killer noticed me, however, everything would be over."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So I stayed there, hopelessly regretting all that had happened. The temperature in that part of the building wasn't regulated at all, so the cold seeped into me, but even that had stopped being perceived by my body. ...Nothing was until footsteps finally broke the silence again.
entries.literal: "So I stayed there, hopelessly regretting all that had happened. The temperature in that part of the building wasn't regulated at all, so the cold seeped into me, but even that had stopped being perceived by my body. ...Nothing was until footsteps finally broke the silence again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had been a few minutes. Suddenly, faint voices came from the hallway. I immediately knew the group had returned.{w} I couldn't even hesitate. Without wasting time, someone ran past, toward the event room. Then, a voice came from there.
entries.literal: "It had been a few minutes. Suddenly, faint voices came from the hallway. I immediately knew the group had returned.{w} I couldn't even hesitate. Without wasting time, someone ran past, toward the event room. Then, a voice came from there."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...s not here!
entries.literal: "...s not here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Sai. It appeared the storeroom door, being lower quality than the rest, let sound pass easily. But Sai's words weren't the ones I'd expected.{w} Upon hearing that, everyone else ran to the room.
entries.literal: "It was Sai. It appeared the storeroom door, being lower quality than the rest, let sound pass easily. But Sai's words weren't the ones I'd expected.{w} Upon hearing that, everyone else ran to the room."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...ou serious? The three of them must've taken it!
entries.literal: "...ou serious? The three of them must've taken it!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What? Have they not seen the bodies?{w} "The three of them". Naomi, myself, and someone else went down at some point. This third person must be the killer...
entries.literal: "...What? Have they not seen the bodies?{w} \"The three of them\". Naomi, myself, and someone else went down at some point. This third person must be the killer..."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...hy! We need to find them!
entries.literal: "...hy! We need to find them!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That voice was Isla's. Puzzled, I still managed to comprehend what had happened. The bodies had been removed, but the Sekimeiya had been taken. They didn't seem to have noticed any blood on the floor, so it had been quickly cleaned as well.{w} However, something didn't make sense.{w} "The three of them must've taken it!" Erina said that. If only those three were possible suspects, the whole group saw the Sekimeiya in the cabinet before going up.{w} ...How was that possible? I had just seen two in the attic...
entries.literal: "...That voice was Isla's. Puzzled, I still managed to comprehend what had happened. The bodies had been removed, but the Sekimeiya had been taken. They didn't seem to have noticed any blood on the floor, so it had been quickly cleaned as well.{w} However, something didn't make sense.{w} \"The three of them must've taken it!\" Erina said that. If only those three were possible suspects, the whole group saw the Sekimeiya in the cabinet before going up.{w} ...How was that possible? I had just seen two in the attic..."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Shiroya! ...Are you here!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! ...Are you here!?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Shiroya...!
entries.literal: "Shiroya...!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...e has to be here.
entries.literal: "...e has to be here."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Hey! Shiroya...!
entries.literal: "Hey! Shiroya...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki's voice increased in volume; he was getting closer.
entries.literal: "Atsuki's voice increased in volume; he was getting closer."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Who have I heard? ...Atsuki, Erina, Isla, Sai. ...Is only Akaro left?
entries.literal: "Who have I heard? ...Atsuki, Erina, Isla, Sai. ...Is only Akaro left?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I thought that, a fifth voice came from the hallway.
entries.literal: "As soon as I thought that, a fifth voice came from the hallway."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Here you are! You need to come up!
entries.literal: "Here you are! You need to come up!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's Akaro...
entries.literal: "That's Akaro..."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What happened!?
entries.literal: "What happened!?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Just come with me! You'll see!
entries.literal: "Just come with me! You'll see!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could tell he was near the staircase. When everyone heard that, they followed his sudden order and ran up, demanding an explanation. In the blink of an eye, empty silence returned to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "I could tell he was near the staircase. When everyone heard that, they followed his sudden order and ran up, demanding an explanation. In the blink of an eye, empty silence returned to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Was he the one who'd killed me? Unless someone had traveled from the future, I saw no other conclusion.
entries.literal: "...Was he the one who'd killed me? Unless someone had traveled from the future, I saw no other conclusion."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew next to nothing about Akaro. He had been shrouded in uncertainty the entire day. At some point, he even disappeared for hours, and Atsuki only saw him once after that.
entries.literal: "I knew next to nothing about Akaro. He had been shrouded in uncertainty the entire day. At some point, he even disappeared for hours, and Atsuki only saw him once after that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had he always been Naomi's killer? ...Why had he never killed me, though? What had led to my own death?
entries.literal: "Had he always been Naomi's killer? ...Why had he never killed me, though? What had led to my own death?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Reality had to change. No matter how, the other world had to be brought back. ...Was that truly possible? Would it occur out of nowhere?
entries.literal: "Reality had to change. No matter how, the other world had to be brought back. ...Was that truly possible? Would it occur out of nowhere?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I continued to wait in that secret corridor. If the bodies had been moved but not brought to my hiding spot, it was very likely the culprit wasn't aware of it.
entries.literal: "I continued to wait in that secret corridor. If the bodies had been moved but not brought to my hiding spot, it was very likely the culprit wasn't aware of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I began to worry. If Akaro was the killer, why get everyone to rush upstairs? It had always been so hard to figure out the culprit's intentions, but I at least knew it was odd that he'd been above the group when he was supposed to be on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "...I began to worry. If Akaro was the killer, why get everyone to rush upstairs? It had always been so hard to figure out the culprit's intentions, but I at least knew it was odd that he'd been above the group when he was supposed to be on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once a few silent minutes had passed, a sudden sound met my ears.
entries.literal: "Once a few silent minutes had passed, a sudden sound met my ears."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What was that...?
entries.literal: "What was that...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a single metallic sound, one which I couldn't identify.
entries.literal: "It was a single metallic sound, one which I couldn't identify."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I heard nothing for a few brief moments, but then there was a follow-up.
entries.literal: "...I heard nothing for a few brief moments, but then there was a follow-up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, did the elevator just open? Then what was that first sound?
entries.literal: "Wait, did the elevator just open? Then what was that first sound?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I focused my hearing as much as I could. I couldn't be sure, but both sounds had come from where the elevator was.
entries.literal: "I focused my hearing as much as I could. I couldn't be sure, but both sounds had come from where the elevator was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I let more time pass, but nothing else came.
entries.literal: "I let more time pass, but nothing else came."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was sure I hadn't been mistaken. Someone had just been there.
entries.literal: "I was sure I hadn't been mistaken. Someone had just been there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to stay where I was. Something was happening, but the person I'd heard had made very little noise on purpose. I couldn't let myself be noticed by them.
entries.literal: "I had to stay where I was. Something was happening, but the person I'd heard had made very little noise on purpose. I couldn't let myself be noticed by them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was another long while where nothing was heard from the storeroom, but once again, the silence was eventually broken when sound came from the staircase.
entries.literal: "There was another long while where nothing was heard from the storeroom, but once again, the silence was eventually broken when sound came from the staircase."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Here too! What the fuck!?
entries.literal: "Here too! What the fuck!?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: They have to be somewhere.
entries.literal: "They have to be somewhere."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Shiroya! Where are you...!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Where are you...!?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I told you! I don't know what the fuck they're doing, but they're hiding from us!
entries.literal: "I told you! I don't know what the fuck they're doing, but they're hiding from us!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Shiroya isn't doing anything! It has to be Naomi!{w} Shiroya! If you're here, please come out!
entries.literal: "Shiroya isn't doing anything! It has to be Naomi!{w} Shiroya! If you're here, please come out!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was I hearing? It was clear something had happened, but I couldn't discern what.
entries.literal: "What was I hearing? It was clear something had happened, but I couldn't discern what."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: There's no way we won't find them if we split up. Atsuki, if you don't want to believe it, I invite you to find her.
entries.literal: "There's no way we won't find them if we split up. Atsuki, if you don't want to believe it, I invite you to find her."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I don't care if you're lying or not! She wouldn't do this!
entries.literal: "I don't care if you're lying or not! She wouldn't do this!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Listen to me! Not only is she hiding with Naomi, but you're incredibly suspicious! They're obviously doing this shit for a reason, but we won't find them if we don't split up.
entries.literal: "Listen to me! Not only is she hiding with Naomi, but you're incredibly suspicious! They're obviously doing this shit for a reason, but we won't find them if we don't split up."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: He's right. They must have the Sekimeiya, so this has to be part of their plan.
entries.literal: "He's right. They must have the Sekimeiya, so this has to be part of their plan."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What plan!? She has no plan!
entries.literal: "What plan!? She has no plan!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Then where is she? If she's not involved, why would Naomi do that?
entries.literal: "Then where is she? If she's not involved, why would Naomi do that?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...I don't know!
entries.literal: "...I don't know!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could tell it was Atsuki who began to open the hallway doors. After loudly opening the storeroom's, he rapidly moved on.
entries.literal: "I could tell it was Atsuki who began to open the hallway doors. After loudly opening the storeroom's, he rapidly moved on."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Shiroya! Holy shit, please!
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Holy shit, please!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It sounded like everyone was dispersing. Some of them went back up while others joined Atsuki. ...They were searching for two dead people.
entries.literal: "It sounded like everyone was dispersing. Some of them went back up while others joined Atsuki. ...They were searching for two dead people."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The noise moved to the other hallway and eventually quieted. I couldn't understand what they were saying anymore, but I didn't think anything had been found.
entries.literal: "The noise moved to the other hallway and eventually quieted. I couldn't understand what they were saying anymore, but I didn't think anything had been found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone was scattered around, and as people went up the stairs, the silence returned again.
entries.literal: "Everyone was scattered around, and as people went up the stairs, the silence returned again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Where could the bodies have been hidden? Is it possible the security room was opened?
entries.literal: "...Where could the bodies have been hidden? Is it possible the security room was opened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi had possessed the key to the attic, so her killer could've obtained it. But how would both bodies have been brought up when the elevator didn't work?
entries.literal: "Naomi had possessed the key to the attic, so her killer could've obtained it. But how would both bodies have been brought up when the elevator didn't work?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could notice a couple people still wandering nearby. Katei wasn't there, so their knowledge of the attic was limited.
entries.literal: "I could notice a couple people still wandering nearby. Katei wasn't there, so their knowledge of the attic was limited."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once some time had passed, most of them ended up back on the crystal floor. In hallway C, they were discussing what could've happened after not finding anything.
entries.literal: "Once some time had passed, most of them ended up back on the crystal floor. In hallway C, they were discussing what could've happened after not finding anything."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...es, they have to be on the Ashiya floor. That's why this was done.{w} The elevator wasn't working earlier, so they prevented us from using it as soon as it was up and running again.
entries.literal: "...es, they have to be on the Ashiya floor. That's why this was done.{w} The elevator wasn't working earlier, so they prevented us from using it as soon as it was up and running again."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...roya is not doing this...! She must have been locked in there.
entries.literal: "...roya is not doing this...! She must have been locked in there."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...ound it!
entries.literal: "...ound it!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro shouted from a distance, shutting down the conversation. When he spoke again, he had run down the stairs.
entries.literal: "Akaro shouted from a distance, shutting down the conversation. When he spoke again, he had run down the stairs."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Look! It was on the fourth floor!
entries.literal: "Look! It was on the fourth floor!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Huh. Where?
entries.literal: "Huh. Where?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: In one of the drawers! I looked through all of them. That's where they hid it.
entries.literal: "In one of the drawers! I looked through all of them. That's where they hid it."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: That's weird. They must be on the Ashiya floor, right? Why would they hide the Sekimeiya outside of it?
entries.literal: "That's weird. They must be on the Ashiya floor, right? Why would they hide the Sekimeiya outside of it?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Hell if I know, but you were right. Their plan was to take the Sekimeiya. Now that we found it, we have to hold on to it until this situation is resolved.
entries.literal: "Hell if I know, but you were right. Their plan was to take the Sekimeiya. Now that we found it, we have to hold on to it until this situation is resolved."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: So what are you saying we should do?
entries.literal: "So what are you saying we should do?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: If we stay in a room, whatever they're trying won't work. They won't be able to get the Sekimeiya again, and none of us will leave it alone. Don't think you're in the clear, either.
entries.literal: "If we stay in a room, whatever they're trying won't work. They won't be able to get the Sekimeiya again, and none of us will leave it alone. Don't think you're in the clear, either."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I'm telling you that Shiroya isn't part of this...! I have no idea what Naomi wanted, but she brought her to the attic! There's no way I'm staying anywhere without finding her!
entries.literal: "I'm telling you that Shiroya isn't part of this...! I have no idea what Naomi wanted, but she brought her to the attic! There's no way I'm staying anywhere without finding her!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I think we should do what Akaro says, Atsuki. If you're right, there's nothing we can do. No matter what their intent is, they're screwed if we stay with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I think we should do what Akaro says, Atsuki. If you're right, there's nothing we can do. No matter what their intent is, they're screwed if we stay with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I'm not going to just sit around! We need to find her!
entries.literal: "I'm not going to just sit around! We need to find her!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Was Akaro the killer? When he proposed staying somewhere, an idea came to mind.
entries.literal: "...{w}Was Akaro the killer? When he proposed staying somewhere, an idea came to mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody had been found, so the Atsuki I'd briefly reunited with was likely nowhere. I knew he didn't have the key to the attic, so if he was elsewhere, they would've seen him.
entries.literal: "Nobody had been found, so the Atsuki I'd briefly reunited with was likely nowhere. I knew he didn't have the key to the attic, so if he was elsewhere, they would've seen him."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Atsuki, you need to listen to us. If what you're saying is true, we're out of options. However, the Sekimeiya has already been taken once, and they're the only people who could've done this. Even if someone else got trapped, the reality is the same. Whatever plan they have won't work now, so cooperate with us.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, you need to listen to us. If what you're saying is true, we're out of options. However, the Sekimeiya has already been taken once, and they're the only people who could've done this. Even if someone else got trapped, the reality is the same. Whatever plan they have won't work now, so cooperate with us."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I mean, you're free not to. You can keep searching around, but it's evident they're hidden someplace we can't access. Until we can leave, we have to stay somewhere. Splitting ourselves up might just be what they need.
entries.literal: "I mean, you're free not to. You can keep searching around, but it's evident they're hidden someplace we can't access. Until we can leave, we have to stay somewhere. Splitting ourselves up might just be what they need."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: You're all insane! We don't know how long that'll take! Naomi's the one who did this, so we have to find Shiroya right now!
entries.literal: "You're all insane! We don't know how long that'll take! Naomi's the one who did this, so we have to find Shiroya right now!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro had found the Sekimeiya. Was it the one he hid? If he hadn't lied about its whereabouts, it wasn't either of the two I'd seen.
entries.literal: "Akaro had found the Sekimeiya. Was it the one he hid? If he hadn't lied about its whereabouts, it wasn't either of the two I'd seen."

entries.speaker: i
