entries.text: They were sure someone else had to be in the building, and that definitely had something to do with the metallic sound I'd heard after everyone went upstairs. Something had happened while they'd been together, so from their point of view, someone else was there and took the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "They were sure someone else had to be in the building, and that definitely had something to do with the metallic sound I'd heard after everyone went upstairs. Something had happened while they'd been together, so from their point of view, someone else was there and took the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it wasn't me or Naomi. Could it have been Katei, or was he long gone? ...There was one last explanation.
entries.literal: "But it wasn't me or Naomi. Could it have been Katei, or was he long gone? ...There was one last explanation."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The time travel nobody was yet aware of. If someone had traveled to the past, it would've created the illusion of another person. On top of that, Akaro was holding the very thing that allowed that time travel.
entries.literal: "The time travel nobody was yet aware of. If someone had traveled to the past, it would've created the illusion of another person. On top of that, Akaro was holding the very thing that allowed that time travel."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: We shouldn't leave it in the event room again. We have to hide it from them, just in case.
entries.literal: "We shouldn't leave it in the event room again. We have to hide it from them, just in case."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro's voice distanced as he spoke, and everyone followed him to hallway B. From the other side, I could still hear Atsuki's muddled refusal.
entries.literal: "Akaro's voice distanced as he spoke, and everyone followed him to hallway B. From the other side, I could still hear Atsuki's muddled refusal."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...On my end, I had made up my mind. I slowly opened both doors in front of me and stepped out of the storeroom.
entries.literal: "...On my end, I had made up my mind. I slowly opened both doors in front of me and stepped out of the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro and Sai were insistent about staying in a crystal room. Their actions in the other world had been vastly different, especially Sai's.
entries.literal: "Akaro and Sai were insistent about staying in a crystal room. Their actions in the other world had been vastly different, especially Sai's."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't seem like the bodies could've been in the attic, so it was possible Atsuki would find them if he searched hard enough. He was against staying in a room with everyone before finding me. That was one of the reasons I abandoned my hiding spot.{w} I couldn't leave him alone, even if I wished the world would change. If he couldn't find me, he would suffer alone for hours. ...Even so, as I saw the hallway, I kept trembling. I really wanted to talk to him as if nothing had happened.
entries.literal: "It didn't seem like the bodies could've been in the attic, so it was possible Atsuki would find them if he searched hard enough. He was against staying in a room with everyone before finding me. That was one of the reasons I abandoned my hiding spot.{w} I couldn't leave him alone, even if I wished the world would change. If he couldn't find me, he would suffer alone for hours. ...Even so, as I saw the hallway, I kept trembling. I really wanted to talk to him as if nothing had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody heard the sound of my steps. Who had killed me and Naomi? That question also brought me to leave the storeroom.{w} If it wasn't anyone in hallway B, I wouldn't be safe staying by myself. If it was one of them, I would be safe as long as we were all together, and it was possible I could determine who was responsible.{w} As long as nothing tricky happened, we would remain in one place. If I made sure that continued, it was a good way to let the time advance until the afternoon. It would almost guarantee that the interior of the tower remained calm.
entries.literal: "Nobody heard the sound of my steps. Who had killed me and Naomi? That question also brought me to leave the storeroom.{w} If it wasn't anyone in hallway B, I wouldn't be safe staying by myself. If it was one of them, I would be safe as long as we were all together, and it was possible I could determine who was responsible.{w} As long as nothing tricky happened, we would remain in one place. If I made sure that continued, it was a good way to let the time advance until the afternoon. It would almost guarantee that the interior of the tower remained calm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was also curious to know what had been happening. When I turned to hallway C, I instantly understood what the sound I'd heard really was.
entries.literal: "I was also curious to know what had been happening. When I turned to hallway C, I instantly understood what the sound I'd heard really was."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh... The panel was taken off...
entries.literal: "Oh... The panel was taken off..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator button wasn't there. Only wires coming out of the wall remained where the metallic panel had been.
entries.literal: "The elevator button wasn't there. Only wires coming out of the wall remained where the metallic panel had been."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Sh-Shiroya!
entries.literal: "Sh-Shiroya!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suddenly turned to face Atsuki and ran to him, my heart rate increasing as I approached.
entries.literal: "I suddenly turned to face Atsuki and ran to him, my heart rate increasing as I approached."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-Where were you!? I've searched everywhere!
entries.literal: "Wh-Where were you!? I've searched everywhere!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When the others saw me, they dashed over. In the meantime, I thought of what to say, hating the need to lie.
entries.literal: "When the others saw me, they dashed over. In the meantime, I thought of what to say, hating the need to lie."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck are those clothes?
entries.literal: "What the fuck are those clothes?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: N-Naomi gave them to me. ...I told her I was cold and that my old clothes were a bit itchy.
entries.literal: "N-Naomi gave them to me. ...I told her I was cold and that my old clothes were a bit itchy."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck? Where is she!?
entries.literal: "What the fuck? Where is she!?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I-I don't know... We went to the highest floor, but she suddenly disappeared. I think she locked herself in there.
entries.literal: "I-I don't know... We went to the highest floor, but she suddenly disappeared. I think she locked herself in there."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you serious? What did she want?
entries.literal: "Are you serious? What did she want?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Huh...? What do you mean?
entries.literal: "Huh...? What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been looking at the floor, stuttering as I made everything up. ...When I finally looked at the rest, I noticed what greatly stood out from them.
entries.literal: "I'd been looking at the floor, stuttering as I made everything up. ...When I finally looked at the rest, I noticed what greatly stood out from them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Akaro's eyes. They couldn't believe what they were seeing, and his body was solid as a rock. I needed nothing else to know who my killer was.
entries.literal: "...Akaro's eyes. They couldn't believe what they were seeing, and his body was solid as a rock. I needed nothing else to know who my killer was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In his hands was a glowing Sekimeiya. However, I immediately saw something I assumed nobody had realized.{w} His sleeve was between it and his skin. He was purposely avoiding contact with it.
entries.literal: "In his hands was a glowing Sekimeiya. However, I immediately saw something I assumed nobody had realized.{w} His sleeve was between it and his skin. He was purposely avoiding contact with it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...What did Naomi have to tell you, I mean.
entries.literal: "...What did Naomi have to tell you, I mean."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I... don't know. She didn't tell me anything. Can you explain what happened there? Why is the elevator button gone?
entries.literal: "I... don't know. She didn't tell me anything. Can you explain what happened there? Why is the elevator button gone?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Slow down. What do you mean she didn't tell you anything? She asked to talk to you and Akaro privately. Did she never follow up on that?
entries.literal: "...Slow down. What do you mean she didn't tell you anything? She asked to talk to you and Akaro privately. Did she never follow up on that?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: N-No. ...I told her I was cold, and she gave me this.
entries.literal: "N-No. ...I told her I was cold, and she gave me this."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I see. That's also what Akaro said. That you two suddenly disappeared.
entries.literal: "I see. That's also what Akaro said. That you two suddenly disappeared."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Y-Yes, sorry.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes, sorry."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's when we heard the elevator, then. Did Naomi activate it?
entries.literal: "That's when we heard the elevator, then. Did Naomi activate it?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...You heard it?
entries.literal: "...You heard it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes, it passed through the fourth floor twice. We thought it couldn't have been the elevator since it wasn't working, but it had to be.
entries.literal: "Yes, it passed through the fourth floor twice. We thought it couldn't have been the elevator since it wasn't working, but it had to be."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I see. I don't know why, but it worked when Naomi called it.
entries.literal: "I see. I don't know why, but it worked when Naomi called it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...It did? After that, we all came here and saw that the Sekimeiya had been stolen. Did neither of you do that?
entries.literal: "...It did? After that, we all came here and saw that the Sekimeiya had been stolen. Did neither of you do that?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wait, wh-what? No. We never went there.{w} In the attic, she gave me these, and when we left, she suddenly ran back and locked herself inside.
entries.literal: "Wait, wh-what? No. We never went there.{w} In the attic, she gave me these, and when we left, she suddenly ran back and locked herself inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I really hated lying like that. Naomi had been killed, and I was setting her up as the culprit. Meanwhile, Akaro's body hadn't moved in the slightest.
entries.literal: "I really hated lying like that. Naomi had been killed, and I was setting her up as the culprit. Meanwhile, Akaro's body hadn't moved in the slightest."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed they had accepted my claims. They were absurd, especially the clothing part since I was colder than before, but Naomi was already suspicious to them, so they seemed to believe what I was saying.
entries.literal: "It seemed they had accepted my claims. They were absurd, especially the clothing part since I was colder than before, but Naomi was already suspicious to them, so they seemed to believe what I was saying."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Really, though, what happened to the button...?
entries.literal: "...Really, though, what happened to the button...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...When we saw that the Sekimeiya was gone, Akaro told us to run upstairs. He'd been searching for you two, and we missed him when he was in the offices.{w} On the fourth floor, the panel had been ripped off. We went up and saw that they were gone on the fifth and sixth as well. Sai tried to open the doors, but the elevator wasn't there.{w} By the time we ran all the way down, it had happened on the first three floors too, and the elevator wasn't there either.
entries.literal: "...When we saw that the Sekimeiya was gone, Akaro told us to run upstairs. He'd been searching for you two, and we missed him when he was in the offices.{w} On the fourth floor, the panel had been ripped off. We went up and saw that they were gone on the fifth and sixth as well. Sai tried to open the doors, but the elevator wasn't there.{w} By the time we ran all the way down, it had happened on the first three floors too, and the elevator wasn't there either."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah. We heard it moving two more times when we were going down. If you're telling the truth, I guess that was Naomi.
entries.literal: "Yeah. We heard it moving two more times when we were going down. If you're telling the truth, I guess that was Naomi."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I am... I don't know what she did after she locked herself up, but I've been looking for you until now...
entries.literal: "I am... I don't know what she did after she locked herself up, but I've been looking for you until now..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: In any case, it doesn't matter. We found the Sekimeiya, and we'll stay with it in a room until we can leave so that it isn't stolen again.
entries.literal: "In any case, it doesn't matter. We found the Sekimeiya, and we'll stay with it in a room until we can leave so that it isn't stolen again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only one door was open in hallway B.
entries.literal: "Only one door was open in hallway B."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Was that where you were going?
entries.literal: "...Was that where you were going?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, Akaro spoke. From the storeroom, I'd noticed his voice sounded rougher and sharper than I remembered, but that seemed to have disappeared.{w} When I looked at him, he turned around and walked to that room.
entries.literal: "Finally, Akaro spoke. From the storeroom, I'd noticed his voice sounded rougher and sharper than I remembered, but that seemed to have disappeared.{w} When I looked at him, he turned around and walked to that room."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I thought we should leave the Sekimeiya here. ...Naomi can open the other cabinet, and just like it, I noticed these can get cold too.
entries.literal: "I thought we should leave the Sekimeiya here. ...Naomi can open the other cabinet, and just like it, I noticed these can get cold too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was why the room had caught my attention. It was room B4, where we'd found the first Naomi and where the Sekimeiya had been hidden.
entries.literal: "That was why the room had caught my attention. It was room B4, where we'd found the first Naomi and where the Sekimeiya had been hidden."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's bigger too, so I think it's a good idea.
entries.literal: "It's bigger too, so I think it's a good idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, without looking at us, Akaro walked into the room and raised the lid of a cabinet, undoing the back lock. After placing the Sekimeiya inside, he rotated the two temperature wheels.
entries.literal: "Once again, without looking at us, Akaro walked into the room and raised the lid of a cabinet, undoing the back lock. After placing the Sekimeiya inside, he rotated the two temperature wheels."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I set it to 5 °C. Let's just leave it in here.
entries.literal: "...I set it to 5 °C. Let's just leave it in here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone entered while I narrowed my eyes. Katei wasn't there, so he hadn't repeatedly warned them not to get the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet. Despite that, Akaro had gone out of his way to keep it in a cold space.
entries.literal: "Everyone entered while I narrowed my eyes. Katei wasn't there, so he hadn't repeatedly warned them not to get the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet. Despite that, Akaro had gone out of his way to keep it in a cold space."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had knowledge of the Sekimeiya—the way he held it was the giveaway. He had to be the one who had stolen it, not just the killer. Atsuki and I had seen the temperature set to 0 °C more than once, and Akaro specifically set it to 5 °C, so there was no way he didn't know about that requirement.{w} ...The temperature of the Sekimeiya's display cabinet wasn't visible, so I wondered what it was.
entries.literal: "He had knowledge of the Sekimeiya—the way he held it was the giveaway. He had to be the one who had stolen it, not just the killer. Atsuki and I had seen the temperature set to 0 °C more than once, and Akaro specifically set it to 5 °C, so there was no way he didn't know about that requirement.{w} ...The temperature of the Sekimeiya's display cabinet wasn't visible, so I wondered what it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody was questioning Akaro's bizarre actions. Perhaps it was normal only I was seeing them as such. Similarly, as nobody was questioning what I'd said, I made my way in and sat on the floor, leaning against a cabinet.
entries.literal: "Nobody was questioning Akaro's bizarre actions. Perhaps it was normal only I was seeing them as such. Similarly, as nobody was questioning what I'd said, I made my way in and sat on the floor, leaning against a cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki sat to my left. Most strain had disappeared from his face, but I could only feel like I was lying to him. The person he'd entered the building with had been killed, something I could hardly believe.
entries.literal: "Atsuki sat to my left. Most strain had disappeared from his face, but I could only feel like I was lying to him. The person he'd entered the building with had been killed, something I could hardly believe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How had everything taken that turn...? I didn't want to be there. I wanted to be back home or in the lobby, about to leave with Atsuki. I was foolish to hope anything would get better by simply waiting.
entries.literal: "How had everything taken that turn...? I didn't want to be there. I wanted to be back home or in the lobby, about to leave with Atsuki. I was foolish to hope anything would get better by simply waiting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door closed. Sai sat in front of it, blocking the exit. He was insistent about not leaving, and as he looked at me from the opposite end of the room, I could still sense his suspicion.
entries.literal: "The door closed. Sai sat in front of it, blocking the exit. He was insistent about not leaving, and as he looked at me from the opposite end of the room, I could still sense his suspicion."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Lastly, when I least expected it, Akaro approached us. ...I glanced at him, but his eyes didn't meet mine.{w} Then, he sat to my right, between me and the cabinet containing the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Lastly, when I least expected it, Akaro approached us. ...I glanced at him, but his eyes didn't meet mine.{w} Then, he sat to my right, between me and the cabinet containing the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For long seconds, I nervously waited for him to say something while he stared at his lap. In the end, when he raised his head, all he did was exhale a long-held breath before staring back down.
entries.literal: "For long seconds, I nervously waited for him to say something while he stared at his lap. In the end, when he raised his head, all he did was exhale a long-held breath before staring back down."

entries.text: Simulation Therapy
entries.literal: "Simulation Therapy"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A while later, the single sound within the room had been that of Isla's steps. She continually walked from cabinet to cabinet.
entries.literal: "A while later, the single sound within the room had been that of Isla's steps. She continually walked from cabinet to cabinet."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh...! Look at this one!
entries.literal: "Oh...! Look at this one!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina followed her daughter around the room and mimicked her sounds of amazement.
entries.literal: "Erina followed her daughter around the room and mimicked her sounds of amazement."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wow, the swirls on it are so pretty!
entries.literal: "Wow, the swirls on it are so pretty!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Gleefully, they circled the room until they'd observed all the gems.
entries.literal: "Gleefully, they circled the room until they'd observed all the gems."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The last time, all of us had looked at the gems, so the situation clearly differed.{w} Atsuki hadn't so much as shifted one of his legs since we'd come in. I'd wanted to talk to him, but I hadn't expected he would act that way. Before entering the tower, he and I had spoken very little. That gradually changed during the day, but the Atsuki next to me looked just like he had at his house.
entries.literal: "The last time, all of us had looked at the gems, so the situation clearly differed.{w} Atsuki hadn't so much as shifted one of his legs since we'd come in. I'd wanted to talk to him, but I hadn't expected he would act that way. Before entering the tower, he and I had spoken very little. That gradually changed during the day, but the Atsuki next to me looked just like he had at his house."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Oh, let me see that, Isla.
entries.literal: "...Oh, let me see that, Isla."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone looked at her purse, where I was staring. I'd just realized there was something very important to check.
entries.literal: "Everyone looked at her purse, where I was staring. I'd just realized there was something very important to check."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: These? They're sunglasses!
entries.literal: "These? They're sunglasses!"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Sunglasses in the winter? Isn't that a little strange?
entries.literal: "Sunglasses in the winter? Isn't that a little strange?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Nope! They block the sun reflecting off the snow. Here, try them on.
entries.literal: "Nope! They block the sun reflecting off the snow. Here, try them on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She came closer and handed them to me.
entries.literal: "She came closer and handed them to me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Hm... They're too small for me, but I'm sure they fit you perfectly.
entries.literal: "Hm... They're too small for me, but I'm sure they fit you perfectly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She put them on with a big grin.
entries.literal: "She put them on with a big grin."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: It's okay! You can try again when I'm bigger.
entries.literal: "It's okay! You can try again when I'm bigger."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The recorder isn't there. I don't get it.
entries.literal: "...The recorder isn't there. I don't get it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From farther away, Erina smiled at us. I couldn't help but feel that I'd never seen her look that way in the other world.
entries.literal: "From farther away, Erina smiled at us. I couldn't help but feel that I'd never seen her look that way in the other world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla took off her glasses and ran across the room. I had no idea what to think of her, the recording, or her friend. I knew she had died once, though. If we stayed put, that was much less likely to repeat.
entries.literal: "Isla took off her glasses and ran across the room. I had no idea what to think of her, the recording, or her friend. I knew she had died once, though. If we stayed put, that was much less likely to repeat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For a while, Isla's quiet footsteps punctuated the silence as she moved to each cabinet. She'd already looked through all of them, but staying still seemed to be difficult for her. Erina simply followed her daughter's movements with her eyes.
entries.literal: "For a while, Isla's quiet footsteps punctuated the silence as she moved to each cabinet. She'd already looked through all of them, but staying still seemed to be difficult for her. Erina simply followed her daughter's movements with her eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I noticed that the silence had gone on for longer than usual, I glanced back up. It took me a bit to spot Isla in front of the cabinet with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "When I noticed that the silence had gone on for longer than usual, I glanced back up. It took me a bit to spot Isla in front of the cabinet with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was staring at it with a piercing gaze, her figure completely rigid. Out of nowhere, her right hand began to reach for the lid, moving almost imperceptibly.
entries.literal: "She was staring at it with a piercing gaze, her figure completely rigid. Out of nowhere, her right hand began to reach for the lid, moving almost imperceptibly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But before she made contact with it, Akaro noticed what I was looking at.
entries.literal: "But before she made contact with it, Akaro noticed what I was looking at."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hey, Isla, what are you doing? The Sekimeiya shouldn't be taken out of there.
entries.literal: "Hey, Isla, what are you doing? The Sekimeiya shouldn't be taken out of there."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...Why not?
entries.literal: "...Why not?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I already explained. I put it somewhere cold, like it was in the event room. Naomi told us not to take it out of the cabinet, so it's better to keep it shut.
entries.literal: "I already explained. I put it somewhere cold, like it was in the event room. Naomi told us not to take it out of the cabinet, so it's better to keep it shut."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I won't take it away. I just want to look at it again.
entries.literal: "I won't take it away. I just want to look at it again."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You have plenty of other gems to look at. I know you came to the tower for the Sekimeiya, but it's a lot more boring than all the other stones in this room.
entries.literal: "You have plenty of other gems to look at. I know you came to the tower for the Sekimeiya, but it's a lot more boring than all the other stones in this room."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hmph.
entries.literal: "Hmph."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Disappointed, Isla turned around. She continued going from cabinet to cabinet, and every once in a while, she'd glare at Akaro from a distance.
entries.literal: "Disappointed, Isla turned around. She continued going from cabinet to cabinet, and every once in a while, she'd glare at Akaro from a distance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once she had circled around the room, she was once again in front of the cabinet with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Once she had circled around the room, she was once again in front of the cabinet with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: But it was glowing, right? Ash, um... Ashiya said that it was the rarest discovery of the century! What if it has super... um, supernatural powers?
entries.literal: "But it was glowing, right? Ash, um... Ashiya said that it was the rarest discovery of the century! What if it has super... um, supernatural powers?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Don't be silly. You don't know much about Ashiya, do you?
entries.literal: "Don't be silly. You don't know much about Ashiya, do you?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I do! I hear about them all the time!
entries.literal: "I do! I hear about them all the time!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Heh, yeah, but I'll give you some advice. Don't trust anything Ashiya say. You wouldn't like to know how they obtained some of the gemstones you were looking at.
entries.literal: "Heh, yeah, but I'll give you some advice. Don't trust anything Ashiya say. You wouldn't like to know how they obtained some of the gemstones you were looking at."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hmm?
entries.literal: "Hmm?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unprompted, Isla sat next to Akaro, demanding a detailed explanation.
entries.literal: "Unprompted, Isla sat next to Akaro, demanding a detailed explanation."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...They've never been known for their decent practices. That's the best way I can put it. I guess kids nowadays aren't very in touch with their history.
entries.literal: "...They've never been known for their decent practices. That's the best way I can put it. I guess kids nowadays aren't very in touch with their history."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Upon seeing that Isla had sat with us, Erina came over too.
entries.literal: "Upon seeing that Isla had sat with us, Erina came over too."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: You mean they're not good people?
entries.literal: "You mean they're not good people?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Ah, I've told her about this before. It's why I had reservations about bringing her here.
entries.literal: "Ah, I've told her about this before. It's why I had reservations about bringing her here."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Huh? I don't remember that.
entries.literal: "Huh? I don't remember that."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well, at least in the past they weren't. Right now, it's a bit harder to say, but God only knows what the reason behind today's event was.
entries.literal: "Well, at least in the past they weren't. Right now, it's a bit harder to say, but God only knows what the reason behind today's event was."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What did you mean before? How have they gotten all these gems?
entries.literal: "What did you mean before? How have they gotten all these gems?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Do you know anything about gemstones? There are many types. Geodes, for example, look like normal rocks on the outside but are fractal-like on the inside. Ashiya push themselves to have an event every week and change the displayed gemstones often, so in the past they've displayed fake geodes.
entries.literal: "Do you know anything about gemstones? There are many types. Geodes, for example, look like normal rocks on the outside but are fractal-like on the inside. Ashiya push themselves to have an event every week and change the displayed gemstones often, so in the past they've displayed fake geodes."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: People love looking for extraterrestrial gems—materials that came from space. I bet you that if any of the ones here are supposedly one of those, they were found in one of the mountains you see every day.
entries.literal: "People love looking for extraterrestrial gems—materials that came from space. I bet you that if any of the ones here are supposedly one of those, they were found in one of the mountains you see every day."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I can't give you proof of this, but some of them are lab-created too. Ashiya can't trick everyone, but it clearly works favorably for them. For a while, they displayed a Verdelite Tourmaline labeled as a Chrome Tourmaline, which is much rarer. They're easily distinguished if you have a magnet, but they look very similar if you only have your eyes.
entries.literal: "I can't give you proof of this, but some of them are lab-created too. Ashiya can't trick everyone, but it clearly works favorably for them. For a while, they displayed a Verdelite Tourmaline labeled as a Chrome Tourmaline, which is much rarer. They're easily distinguished if you have a magnet, but they look very similar if you only have your eyes."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Oh...! You know a lot about this!
entries.literal: "Oh...! You know a lot about this!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Not as much as you would imagine. It's hard not to hear about these things, really. Of course, I'm not surprised the Sekimeiya doesn't seem to be anything special.
entries.literal: "Not as much as you would imagine. It's hard not to hear about these things, really. Of course, I'm not surprised the Sekimeiya doesn't seem to be anything special."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Even if it's not, we would have to pay a fortune if we broke it. Akaro's right, it's better to leave it be.
entries.literal: "Even if it's not, we would have to pay a fortune if we broke it. Akaro's right, it's better to leave it be."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Exactly.
entries.literal: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want Isla to object, so I attempted to change the topic, and the appearance of her house was the first thing that came to my mind.
entries.literal: "I didn't want Isla to object, so I attempted to change the topic, and the appearance of her house was the first thing that came to my mind."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: She must be a handful. I bet she leaves a mess at home.
entries.literal: "She must be a handful. I bet she leaves a mess at home."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She's got her moments, but we manage. She's all I've got, after all.
entries.literal: "She's got her moments, but we manage. She's all I've got, after all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro's expression softened. I knew he had to be hiding a lot, but it was hard to think even his appearance was insincere.
entries.literal: "Akaro's expression softened. I knew he had to be hiding a lot, but it was hard to think even his appearance was insincere."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I see. That must be difficult. Say, Isla, how's school going? Shouldn't you be there right now?
entries.literal: "I see. That must be difficult. Say, Isla, how's school going? Shouldn't you be there right now?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Yes, but Mom let me skip classes! I like having a day off because not everyone there is nice.
entries.literal: "Yes, but Mom let me skip classes! I like having a day off because not everyone there is nice."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Some kids are mean to you?
entries.literal: "Some kids are mean to you?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Well, Amelie never lets me play with them, and everyone does what she says.
entries.literal: "Well, Amelie never lets me play with them, and everyone does what she says."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Ah, is that so? Well, I'll come talk with Amelie once we're out. I had to deal with people like her when I was your age too.
entries.literal: "Ah, is that so? Well, I'll come talk with Amelie once we're out. I had to deal with people like her when I was your age too."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Really? My teacher already tried, but Amelie didn't change at all.
entries.literal: "Really? My teacher already tried, but Amelie didn't change at all."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Don't worry. If she continues, we'll have another talk.
entries.literal: "Don't worry. If she continues, we'll have another talk."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla grinned at the thought of a big, scary man like Akaro intimidating her school enemy. Meanwhile, Erina watched over them from above with melancholic eyes.
entries.literal: "Isla grinned at the thought of a big, scary man like Akaro intimidating her school enemy. Meanwhile, Erina watched over them from above with melancholic eyes."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Mom, Mister Akaro is a nice man. Can he be my new daddy?
entries.literal: "Mom, Mister Akaro is a nice man. Can he be my new daddy?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...You want him to be your dad? What do you think he'll say when he sees your bedroom?
entries.literal: "...You want him to be your dad? What do you think he'll say when he sees your bedroom?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Huh? I'll clean it! I promise!
entries.literal: "Huh? I'll clean it! I promise!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You always say that. It stays clean for three days, and then you forget about your promise.
entries.literal: "You always say that. It stays clean for three days, and then you forget about your promise."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Not this time! You'll never remind me again!
entries.literal: "Not this time! You'll never remind me again!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Sweetie, you know how much work being in charge of you is, right? Do you really want to put that on him?
entries.literal: "Sweetie, you know how much work being in charge of you is, right? Do you really want to put that on him?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I-I'm not that bad!
entries.literal: "I-I'm not that bad!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It sounded like it was Akaro's time to chime in, but he kept quiet, looking somewhere else.
entries.literal: "...It sounded like it was Akaro's time to chime in, but he kept quiet, looking somewhere else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His lack of input abruptly ended that topic, so Isla stood up. Instead of returning to the cabinet with the Sekimeiya, she continued romping around the room.
entries.literal: "His lack of input abruptly ended that topic, so Isla stood up. Instead of returning to the cabinet with the Sekimeiya, she continued romping around the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took a while, but eventually, she calmed down and sat a bit away.
entries.literal: "It took a while, but eventually, she calmed down and sat a bit away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Time passed, and everyone kept to themselves. Sai still leaned against the door, looking nowhere but the floor. It probably hadn't been long enough for the others to get to know his personality and why the way he was acting was unusual.
entries.literal: "...Time passed, and everyone kept to themselves. Sai still leaned against the door, looking nowhere but the floor. It probably hadn't been long enough for the others to get to know his personality and why the way he was acting was unusual."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized I no longer had the pendant I'd worn on the 15th. It didn't seem like anyone had noticed, but I would have no excuse if someone did.
entries.literal: "I realized I no longer had the pendant I'd worn on the 15th. It didn't seem like anyone had noticed, but I would have no excuse if someone did."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...So Naomi hasn't shown up.{w} Did she not say anything when she locked herself inside the top floor?
entries.literal: "...So Naomi hasn't shown up.{w} Did she not say anything when she locked herself inside the top floor?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, Akaro spoke again. His voice was quiet, and the steely look in his eyes from before we'd entered the room was completely gone.
entries.literal: "Finally, Akaro spoke again. His voice was quiet, and the steely look in his eyes from before we'd entered the room was completely gone."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: No, she didn't... I don't know what got into her, but I assume she wanted to do whatever she did to the elevator.{w} I guess while we're here, there's nothing she can do anymore.
entries.literal: "No, she didn't... I don't know what got into her, but I assume she wanted to do whatever she did to the elevator.{w} I guess while we're here, there's nothing she can do anymore."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I understand.
entries.literal: "I understand."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Out of curiosity, are you the girl who fell into a coma two weeks ago? I think I saw your name on the news.
entries.literal: "Out of curiosity, are you the girl who fell into a coma two weeks ago? I think I saw your name on the news."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Uh, y-yes. ...That was me.
entries.literal: "Uh, y-yes. ...That was me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although he was speaking quietly, Atsuki heard that too and looked at Akaro curiously.
entries.literal: "Although he was speaking quietly, Atsuki heard that too and looked at Akaro curiously."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Damn, that must've been a scare. It's good to see you're all right now.
entries.literal: "Damn, that must've been a scare. It's good to see you're all right now."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah...
entries.literal: "Yeah..."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: There was an explosion close to here, right? Didn't someone die, and {tip=gan}a person{/tip} was sent to the hospital?
entries.literal: "There was an explosion close to here, right? Didn't someone die, and {tip=gan}a person{/tip} was sent to the hospital?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Y-Yes... A friend of ours died. Two people were hospitalized.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes... A friend of ours died. Two people were hospitalized."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Oh.{w} I'm very sorry.{w} I can't imagine what that would be like at your age. I thought earlier that something about you two looked off. I'm really sorry for bringing it up.
entries.literal: "...Oh.{w} I'm very sorry.{w} I can't imagine what that would be like at your age. I thought earlier that something about you two looked off. I'm really sorry for bringing it up."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's all right. Don't worry about it.
entries.literal: "It's all right. Don't worry about it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki said what I'd been about to.{w} Then, Akaro gave us a look of pity. I could only wonder why he'd said any of that.
entries.literal: "Atsuki said what I'd been about to.{w} Then, Akaro gave us a look of pity. I could only wonder why he'd said any of that."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I did lose someone very close to me a long time ago too. I don't imagine this is something you want to hear from a person you don't know, but all I wish now is that I hadn't thought that much about it.{w} At the time, I thought I'd be disrespecting the dead if I tried to get over it, but that nearly ate me alive.{w} I guess you're already doing much better than me if you're here. Thinking too hard about these things when they just happened can be pure torture.
entries.literal: "I did lose someone very close to me a long time ago too. I don't imagine this is something you want to hear from a person you don't know, but all I wish now is that I hadn't thought that much about it.{w} At the time, I thought I'd be disrespecting the dead if I tried to get over it, but that nearly ate me alive.{w} I guess you're already doing much better than me if you're here. Thinking too hard about these things when they just happened can be pure torture."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: The worst part is trying to convince yourself that there's some meaning in it. Sometimes, bad things just happen because they happen, and that's all there is to it. I wanted to believe there was a greater plan, but...
entries.literal: "The worst part is trying to convince yourself that there's some meaning in it. Sometimes, bad things just happen because they happen, and that's all there is to it. I wanted to believe there was a greater plan, but..."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Anyway, the important thing is that you're both still alive. Finding any meaning in that is up to you. Just living and moving past it is enough.
entries.literal: "Anyway, the important thing is that you're both still alive. Finding any meaning in that is up to you. Just living and moving past it is enough."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I agree. That's why we came here.
entries.literal: "...I agree. That's why we came here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki spoke where I couldn't. Akaro being supportive was something I hadn't expected in the slightest, especially given that I was sure he'd killed me.
entries.literal: "Atsuki spoke where I couldn't. Akaro being supportive was something I hadn't expected in the slightest, especially given that I was sure he'd killed me."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I know people can't choose a way to react, and I shouldn't be giving any advice. ...It's much easier said than done, but if you can, don't regret anything that you did.
entries.literal: "I know people can't choose a way to react, and I shouldn't be giving any advice. ...It's much easier said than done, but if you can, don't regret anything that you did."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Are you okay?
entries.literal: "...Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki looked at me with sorrowful eyes. When I nodded, he went back to staring at his lap.
entries.literal: "Atsuki looked at me with sorrowful eyes. When I nodded, he went back to staring at his lap."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...And you? I'm sorry, we shouldn't have come.
entries.literal: "...And you? I'm sorry, we shouldn't have come."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Don't be. I'm still glad we're here, and don't worry about me. I'm fine.
entries.literal: "Don't be. I'm still glad we're here, and don't worry about me. I'm fine."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: All right.
entries.literal: "All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I smiled, but he didn't look up again.
entries.literal: "I smiled, but he didn't look up again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla had finished her most recent survey of the cabinets and was sitting in the middle of the room. I looked at the ceiling, where the camera was, and noticed that no green light flickered below the lens.
entries.literal: "Isla had finished her most recent survey of the cabinets and was sitting in the middle of the room. I looked at the ceiling, where the camera was, and noticed that no green light flickered below the lens."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw Sai looking at his wristwatch.
entries.literal: "I saw Sai looking at his wristwatch."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: How long have we been trapped for?
entries.literal: "How long have we been trapped for?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Uh... almost two hours. It's {time=11.}
entries.literal: "Uh... almost two hours. It's {time=11.}"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Two hours...? How much longer do we have to be here? This is getting ridiculous.
entries.literal: "Two hours...? How much longer do we have to be here? This is getting ridiculous."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's really strange. I wonder if they're having issues opening the shutter.
entries.literal: "It's really strange. I wonder if they're having issues opening the shutter."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: In any case, it has to unlock at any moment.
entries.literal: "In any case, it has to unlock at any moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...If only we had waited like that the first time. Nobody knew about the Sekimeiya's powers. That was likely why the time had been passing so smoothly.
entries.literal: "...If only we had waited like that the first time. Nobody knew about the Sekimeiya's powers. That was likely why the time had been passing so smoothly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, nobody but Akaro. The way he had held it hadn't been a coincidence. ...I didn't know why, but aware of its powers, his intention was to keep us shut in a room while the Sekimeiya was with us.{w} Did he know about the twelve hour limit? ...Or was the reason tied to the other Sekimeiya that I'd seen? I still potentially had one hidden in the attic.
entries.literal: "Of course, nobody but Akaro. The way he had held it hadn't been a coincidence. ...I didn't know why, but aware of its powers, his intention was to keep us shut in a room while the Sekimeiya was with us.{w} Did he know about the twelve hour limit? ...Or was the reason tied to the other Sekimeiya that I'd seen? I still potentially had one hidden in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was the killer who'd hidden his victims' bodies. He had conjured the illusion that Naomi was still alive thanks to the Sekimeiya.{w} ...Next to me, he hadn't opened his mouth again. He knew that I was lying and must've seen me as a threat, but his brief conversation with us had left me dazed.
entries.literal: "He was the killer who'd hidden his victims' bodies. He had conjured the illusion that Naomi was still alive thanks to the Sekimeiya.{w} ...Next to me, he hadn't opened his mouth again. He knew that I was lying and must've seen me as a threat, but his brief conversation with us had left me dazed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone was quiet. For a long time, all we heard was Isla fidgeting with her sunglasses and sporadic sighs.
entries.literal: "Everyone was quiet. For a long time, all we heard was Isla fidgeting with her sunglasses and sporadic sighs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to keep excess thoughts to a minimum. I couldn't understand the strange world I'd suddenly been sent to, so to stave off exhaustion, my mind had remained empty for a while.
entries.literal: "I tried to keep excess thoughts to a minimum. I couldn't understand the strange world I'd suddenly been sent to, so to stave off exhaustion, my mind had remained empty for a while."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...It's {time=13.}

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai read the time out loud every half hour. Rather than comforting us, it made things drag on. I'd gotten pretty tired again just by sitting down for so long.
entries.literal: "Sai read the time out loud every half hour. Rather than comforting us, it made things drag on. I'd gotten pretty tired again just by sitting down for so long."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a while, Sai spoke again.
entries.literal: "After a while, Sai spoke again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: *sigh*{w}{w=0.7} ...I'm going to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "*sigh*{w}{w=0.7} ...I'm going to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone watched him stand up, but the silence remained as he left the room. We'd been sitting for a long time, so it wasn't reasonable to stop him.
entries.literal: "Everyone watched him stand up, but the silence remained as he left the room. We'd been sitting for a long time, so it wasn't reasonable to stop him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had been practically parked in front of the door, but the atmosphere hadn't changed with him gone. The concern began when a few minutes passed without him returning.
entries.literal: "Sai had been practically parked in front of the door, but the atmosphere hadn't changed with him gone. The concern began when a few minutes passed without him returning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd immediately considered the possibility that he had an ulterior motive, but everyone else took longer to reach that conclusion.
entries.literal: "I'd immediately considered the possibility that he had an ulterior motive, but everyone else took longer to reach that conclusion."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Where exactly did Sai go?
entries.literal: "...Where exactly did Sai go?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you think he was lying? It's been a long time since he left.
entries.literal: "Do you think he was lying? It's been a long time since he left."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Don't think about him. If he doesn't want to come back, it's not our problem.
entries.literal: "Don't think about him. If he doesn't want to come back, it's not our problem."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could Akaro and Sai have been working together? What the hell were they doing, then...?
entries.literal: "Could Akaro and Sai have been working together? What the hell were they doing, then...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What if something happened to him?
entries.literal: "What if something happened to him?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Don't be ridiculous. Do you think Naomi attacked him? We would've heard that.
entries.literal: "Don't be ridiculous. Do you think Naomi attacked him? We would've heard that."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't trust him. I think he might be trying to make us search for him so that we leave the room.
entries.literal: "I don't trust him. I think he might be trying to make us search for him so that we leave the room."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Really? I don't think that makes much sense.
entries.literal: "...Really? I don't think that makes much sense."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Forget about him. No matter why he left, staying here is the right call.
entries.literal: "Forget about him. No matter why he left, staying here is the right call."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It eventually became clear Sai wasn't coming back. He'd left with our only method to measure the time, but it felt like almost half an hour had passed.
entries.literal: "It eventually became clear Sai wasn't coming back. He'd left with our only method to measure the time, but it felt like almost half an hour had passed."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Seriously, what the fuck is happening? It's been hours.
entries.literal: "Seriously, what the fuck is happening? It's been hours."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody responded.
entries.literal: "Nobody responded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still next to me, Atsuki and Akaro patiently waited. On the floor lay a tired Isla, while Erina's face showed the most worry.
entries.literal: "Still next to me, Atsuki and Akaro patiently waited. On the floor lay a tired Isla, while Erina's face showed the most worry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Simultaneously, Atsuki and I looked at the ceiling.
entries.literal: "Simultaneously, Atsuki and I looked at the ceiling."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Did you hear something?
entries.literal: "...Did you hear something?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I think so.
entries.literal: "I think so."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "...What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It sounded like someone just walked above us. And did you not hear sounds coming from the crystal floor a few minutes ago?
entries.literal: "It sounded like someone just walked above us. And did you not hear sounds coming from the crystal floor a few minutes ago?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What? I didn't hear that.
entries.literal: "What? I didn't hear that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina hadn't noticed anything either.
entries.literal: "Erina hadn't noticed anything either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone was on alert, but the sound had been very brief, immediately engulfed by the silence again.
entries.literal: "Everyone was on alert, but the sound had been very brief, immediately engulfed by the silence again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, just a few minutes later, it repeated.
entries.literal: "However, just a few minutes later, it repeated."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Th-There! Did you hear it?
entries.literal: "Th-There! Did you hear it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We all nodded that time.
entries.literal: "We all nodded that time."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Someone's on the second floor.
entries.literal: "Someone's on the second floor."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Didn't it sound like more than one person?
entries.literal: "Didn't it sound like more than one person?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...More than one?
entries.literal: "...More than one?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind jumped to the other Atsuki. ...Was he still there?{w} We listened with rapt attention, but there was nothing else to hear.
entries.literal: "My mind jumped to the other Atsuki. ...Was he still there?{w} We listened with rapt attention, but there was nothing else to hear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took less time to repeat than before, and when it did, we were sure more than one person was outside our room.
entries.literal: "It took less time to repeat than before, and when it did, we were sure more than one person was outside our room."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It's Sai and Naomi. ...What the fuck are they doing?
entries.literal: "It's Sai and Naomi. ...What the fuck are they doing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina grimaced at his language but opted not to reprimand him.
entries.literal: "Erina grimaced at his language but opted not to reprimand him."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It has to be them. There's no way we missed anyone.
entries.literal: "It has to be them. There's no way we missed anyone."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Don't think about leaving. Whatever they're doing won't matter as long as we're here.{w} It's not our business either. They're the ones who could be committing a crime.
entries.literal: "Don't think about leaving. Whatever they're doing won't matter as long as we're here.{w} It's not our business either. They're the ones who could be committing a crime."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We didn't move, but during the following minutes, the same faint sound of footsteps was heard two more times.
entries.literal: "We didn't move, but during the following minutes, the same faint sound of footsteps was heard two more times."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whoever they were, they'd been moving through the building. At one point, it seemed as if a sound came from the crystal floor itself, but I didn't mention that.
entries.literal: "Whoever they were, they'd been moving through the building. At one point, it seemed as if a sound came from the crystal floor itself, but I didn't mention that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Who was there? Akaro had reiterated that Naomi and Sai were trying to lure us out, but my curiosity went beyond that.
entries.literal: "...Who was there? Akaro had reiterated that Naomi and Sai were trying to lure us out, but my curiosity went beyond that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unmistakably, more than one person was moving around. However, Naomi couldn't have been included. I knew she was dead.
entries.literal: "Unmistakably, more than one person was moving around. However, Naomi couldn't have been included. I knew she was dead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then who was the other person? With everything seemingly unchanging, my need to know had only grown larger. Could it have been Atsuki? I didn't think so. Had Katei been there the whole time? I didn't think so either.{w} ...Was it someone who'd traveled through time?
entries.literal: "Then who was the other person? With everything seemingly unchanging, my need to know had only grown larger. Could it have been Atsuki? I didn't think so. Had Katei been there the whole time? I didn't think so either.{w} ...Was it someone who'd traveled through time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whoever it was, they hadn't been heard in a while.
entries.literal: "Whoever it was, they hadn't been heard in a while."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...What time is it now? Are we going to be here all day?
entries.literal: "...What time is it now? Are we going to be here all day?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was getting unbearable even for me, who knew when the supposed end was.
entries.literal: "It was getting unbearable even for me, who knew when the supposed end was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina walked a few steps. I thought she only wanted to stretch her body again, but that wasn't it.
entries.literal: "Erina walked a few steps. I thought she only wanted to stretch her body again, but that wasn't it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I have to go to the bathroom.{w} Do you need to go too, Isla?
entries.literal: "...I have to go to the bathroom.{w} Do you need to go too, Isla?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She shook her head.{w} At the same time, the rest of us looked on with skepticism after what had happened with Sai.
entries.literal: "She shook her head.{w} At the same time, the rest of us looked on with skepticism after what had happened with Sai."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Don't worry, it shouldn't matter if only one of us leaves. I doubt I'll come across Sai or Naomi, but I'll be right back.
entries.literal: "Don't worry, it shouldn't matter if only one of us leaves. I doubt I'll come across Sai or Naomi, but I'll be right back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But she wasn't.{w} After a little while, we realized the same thing had occurred.
entries.literal: "...But she wasn't.{w} After a little while, we realized the same thing had occurred."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And since she'd left, the sporadic sounds had returned. Someone had walked above us and on the crystal floor, but all of those noises were faint.
entries.literal: "And since she'd left, the sporadic sounds had returned. Someone had walked above us and on the crystal floor, but all of those noises were faint."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, even Isla began to look concerned, quietly staring at the empty door.
entries.literal: "Eventually, even Isla began to look concerned, quietly staring at the empty door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Sai didn't come back, it was natural to assume it was his choice. The case wasn't the same with Erina.
entries.literal: "When Sai didn't come back, it was natural to assume it was his choice. The case wasn't the same with Erina."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone was there—someone who shouldn't have been there. Had they prevented both people from coming back to us...?
entries.literal: "Someone was there—someone who shouldn't have been there. Had they prevented both people from coming back to us...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't take it anymore. Once again, the sounds had momentarily stopped, but I had to know who else was in the building. As I was convinced Akaro had been my killer, I didn't fear leaving the room anymore.
entries.literal: "I couldn't take it anymore. Once again, the sounds had momentarily stopped, but I had to know who else was in the building. As I was convinced Akaro had been my killer, I didn't fear leaving the room anymore."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'll go too.
entries.literal: "I'll go too."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: H-Huh?
entries.literal: "H-Huh?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'll come back, though. Sorry, we've been here for too long.
entries.literal: "I'll come back, though. Sorry, we've been here for too long."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before he could object, I walked to the door. I didn't exactly want to leave Atsuki behind, but I had no choice.{w} I hadn't missed Akaro's sudden frown, but he kept his mouth shut as I passed by Isla.
entries.literal: "Before he could object, I walked to the door. I didn't exactly want to leave Atsuki behind, but I had no choice.{w} I hadn't missed Akaro's sudden frown, but he kept his mouth shut as I passed by Isla."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked both ways. Nothing about the hallway appeared immediately odd, but the darkness was imposing.
entries.literal: "I looked both ways. Nothing about the hallway appeared immediately odd, but the darkness was imposing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The lobby door was open. Drawn to it, I tried not to make a sound.
entries.literal: "The lobby door was open. Drawn to it, I tried not to make a sound."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell!?
entries.literal: "What the hell!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Both bodies were there, near the hallway A door. Like before, my own looked at the ceiling with empty eyes, while drops of blood had stained the floor beneath Naomi's head.{w} In addition, all the ceiling lights were on, even the ones that the alarm had disabled and weren't working in the morning.
entries.literal: "Both bodies were there, near the hallway A door. Like before, my own looked at the ceiling with empty eyes, while drops of blood had stained the floor beneath Naomi's head.{w} In addition, all the ceiling lights were on, even the ones that the alarm had disabled and weren't working in the morning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew Sai had once tried to kill us, but those bodies couldn't have been his doing alone. Recalling the faint sounds I'd heard from inside the room, I slowly stepped to the other door.
entries.literal: "I knew Sai had once tried to kill us, but those bodies couldn't have been his doing alone. Recalling the faint sounds I'd heard from inside the room, I slowly stepped to the other door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The bodies had been moved to the lobby, and there was no way the other Atsuki would've done that. Unable to look at them up close, I hurried out.
entries.literal: "The bodies had been moved to the lobby, and there was no way the other Atsuki would've done that. Unable to look at them up close, I hurried out."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No way.
entries.literal: "No way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone was far ahead, next to the staircase.{w} A pool of blood extended around a third fallen body, lying in the illuminated zone.
entries.literal: "Someone was far ahead, next to the staircase.{w} A pool of blood extended around a third fallen body, lying in the illuminated zone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Erina. What's happening...!?
entries.literal: "Erina. What's happening...!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart dropped like a stone. I looked away from her body, but I had to fight back tears.
entries.literal: "My heart dropped like a stone. I looked away from her body, but I had to fight back tears."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had the killer been outside all along?{w} It was too overwhelming—I couldn't bear it anymore. But the next thing I heard was footsteps from hallway B, causing my heart to drop even further.
entries.literal: "Had the killer been outside all along?{w} It was too overwhelming—I couldn't bear it anymore. But the next thing I heard was footsteps from hallway B, causing my heart to drop even further."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran as fast as I could, but I was too late. All I saw was Atsuki's figure disappearing into the lobby.
entries.literal: "I ran as fast as I could, but I was too late. All I saw was Atsuki's figure disappearing into the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I clenched my fists, desperately thinking about what to do. He had already seen both bodies, but there'd been no audible reaction.
entries.literal: "I clenched my fists, desperately thinking about what to do. He had already seen both bodies, but there'd been no audible reaction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, someone else came out of the crystal room. Before I hid myself behind the wall, I was able to see Akaro.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, someone else came out of the crystal room. Before I hid myself behind the wall, I was able to see Akaro."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What now...!? Do I have to hide again?
entries.literal: "What now...!? Do I have to hide again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything had gone down the drain so fast. I felt unable to move, as if my racing heart was using all my energy.
entries.literal: "Everything had gone down the drain so fast. I felt unable to move, as if my racing heart was using all my energy."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...Hey! Where the fuck are all of you!?
entries.literal: "...Hey! Where the fuck are all of you!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the hallway again.
entries.literal: "I looked at the hallway again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I did, I saw Akaro coming out of the event room.
entries.literal: "As soon as I did, I saw Akaro coming out of the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, he began to get closer.
entries.literal: "Then, he began to get closer."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He might notice me if I try to leave.
entries.literal: "He might notice me if I try to leave."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did he enter... the staff room?
entries.literal: "Did he enter... the staff room?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd heard Akaro's short steps and then a door closing.
entries.literal: "I'd heard Akaro's short steps and then a door closing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But before I could think about it, I realized Atsuki was in hallway A, slowly approaching Erina.
entries.literal: "...But before I could think about it, I realized Atsuki was in hallway A, slowly approaching Erina."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had nowhere to hide. As a last-ditch effort, I darted to the bathrooms, which I could see were empty.
entries.literal: "I had nowhere to hide. As a last-ditch effort, I darted to the bathrooms, which I could see were empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slowly closed the door of the women's and locked it with the inner latch.
entries.literal: "I slowly closed the door of the women's and locked it with the inner latch."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can stay here. Katei was the one who had the key.
entries.literal: "I can stay here. Katei was the one who had the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon after I heard Atsuki's steps reach Erina's body, they ran up the stairs.
entries.literal: "Soon after I heard Atsuki's steps reach Erina's body, they ran up the stairs."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What is he doing? Does he want to find whoever else is in the building?
entries.literal: "What is he doing? Does he want to find whoever else is in the building?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From Atsuki's point of view, only Sai or an extra person could've killed the three of them. My body wore different clothes, but there was no way he'd care about that while unaware of what the Sekimeiya could do.
entries.literal: "From Atsuki's point of view, only Sai or an extra person could've killed the three of them. My body wore different clothes, but there was no way he'd care about that while unaware of what the Sekimeiya could do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hated thinking about it. He'd found me dead, and I couldn't even imagine what I would've felt in his place.
entries.literal: "I hated thinking about it. He'd found me dead, and I couldn't even imagine what I would've felt in his place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once his steps had disappeared, I continued to pay attention so that I could hear what was happening in hallway B.
entries.literal: "Once his steps had disappeared, I continued to pay attention so that I could hear what was happening in hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But nothing did. Since Akaro had shut himself in a room, I'd heard no new movement.
entries.literal: "But nothing did. Since Akaro had shut himself in a room, I'd heard no new movement."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is he still there? ...What about Isla?
entries.literal: "Is he still there? ...What about Isla?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could the door have been preventing the sound from reaching me?{w} No. I'd heard Atsuki going up the stairs.
entries.literal: "Could the door have been preventing the sound from reaching me?{w} No. I'd heard Atsuki going up the stairs."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And why did he only call for us once? He immediately went quiet.
entries.literal: "...And why did he only call for us once? He immediately went quiet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know where Akaro was, but the time when Atsuki had seen the me in different clothing was slowly approaching. I just had to wait a bit more to see whether my hopes had been in vain.
entries.literal: "I didn't know where Akaro was, but the time when Atsuki had seen the me in different clothing was slowly approaching. I just had to wait a bit more to see whether my hopes had been in vain."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How's this possible? Where did everyone go?
entries.literal: "How's this possible? Where did everyone go?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been in the bathroom for several minutes, but the impossible silence hadn't ceased. We'd heard sounds from the crystal room. Someone had to be there. ...Why was everything so quiet, then?
entries.literal: "I'd been in the bathroom for several minutes, but the impossible silence hadn't ceased. We'd heard sounds from the crystal room. Someone had to be there. ...Why was everything so quiet, then?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Should I go to the storeroom?
entries.literal: "...Should I go to the storeroom?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I unlocked the door. I had the chance to go back there, so I slowly opened the way out.
entries.literal: "I unlocked the door. I had the chance to go back there, so I slowly opened the way out."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is there really nobody here?
entries.literal: "Is there really nobody here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The silence persisted once I stepped out. I'd wanted to run straight to the storeroom, but I noticed that all the doors in hallway B were closed.
entries.literal: "The silence persisted once I stepped out. I'd wanted to run straight to the storeroom, but I noticed that all the doors in hallway B were closed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What about Isla? She can't see Erina's body.
entries.literal: "What about Isla? She can't see Erina's body."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait.
entries.literal: "Wait."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached room B4 as soon as a thought came to mind.
entries.literal: "I approached room B4 as soon as a thought came to mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a deep breath, I twisted the doorknob.
entries.literal: "After a deep breath, I twisted the doorknob."

entries.text: Undertow
entries.literal: "Undertow"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She's not here.{w} Oh... I was right.
entries.literal: "She's not here.{w} Oh... I was right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The cabinet where the Sekimeiya had been was open. I stepped up to it and glanced inside.
entries.literal: "The cabinet where the Sekimeiya had been was open. I stepped up to it and glanced inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still there, and its color was white. After staring at it for a while, I reached inside and took it out, protected by my long sleeves.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was still there, and its color was white. After staring at it for a while, I reached inside and took it out, protected by my long sleeves."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's cold.{w} ...They must've traveled, though. That's why the sounds stopped.
entries.literal: "It's cold.{w} ...They must've traveled, though. That's why the sounds stopped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But where were they? I was clueless.{w} Why had the Sekimeiya been touched, and why had it allowed someone to travel? The temperature in the cabinet was frigid.
entries.literal: "...But where were they? I was clueless.{w} Why had the Sekimeiya been touched, and why had it allowed someone to travel? The temperature in the cabinet was frigid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the hallway and then to the staff room.
entries.literal: "I walked to the hallway and then to the staff room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Holding the Sekimeiya with one hand, I opened the door.
entries.literal: "Holding the Sekimeiya with one hand, I opened the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He's not here. I'm pretty sure this is where he went.
entries.literal: "He's not here. I'm pretty sure this is where he went."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I... should bring the Sekimeiya to the storeroom.
entries.literal: "I... should bring the Sekimeiya to the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Without thinking twice, I ran to hallway A.
entries.literal: "Without thinking twice, I ran to hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked both ways to confirm that nobody was there and gripped the doorknob.
entries.literal: "I looked both ways to confirm that nobody was there and gripped the doorknob."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My jaw dropped, and I stared at the lobby. Its door had been left open.
entries.literal: "My jaw dropped, and I stared at the lobby. Its door had been left open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were my eyes betraying me? As I got closer, I knew that I hadn't imagined it.
entries.literal: "Were my eyes betraying me? As I got closer, I knew that I hadn't imagined it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where's Naomi...?
entries.literal: "Where's Naomi...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Only my own corpse remained on the floor. Although the red pool of Naomi's blood was still next to it, the body it belonged to wasn't there.
entries.literal: "Only my own corpse remained on the floor. Although the red pool of Naomi's blood was still next to it, the body it belonged to wasn't there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sensation that had once faded came back, reminding me of where I was. Inexplicable mysteries were bound to occur on December 15th.
entries.literal: "The sensation that had once faded came back, reminding me of where I was. Inexplicable mysteries were bound to occur on December 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around; trying to think it through was useless. Even though I didn't know what I was waiting for, it was clear anything could happen, so going back to my own world wasn't far-fetched.
entries.literal: "I turned around; trying to think it through was useless. Even though I didn't know what I was waiting for, it was clear anything could happen, so going back to my own world wasn't far-fetched."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the hidden part of the storeroom and dropped the Sekimeiya on the floor. Glowing in the darkness, its temperature was noticeably higher than after I'd taken it out of the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I entered the hidden part of the storeroom and dropped the Sekimeiya on the floor. Glowing in the darkness, its temperature was noticeably higher than after I'd taken it out of the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I least expected it, a crucial piece of the puzzle fell into place.
entries.literal: "When I least expected it, a crucial piece of the puzzle fell into place."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, of course...! How did I not realize this earlier?
entries.literal: "Wait, of course...! How did I not realize this earlier?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the storeroom. If what had been in the lobby was a pool, near the staircase, Erina's body lay on a sea of blood.{w} ...That Erina, below the broken elevator... We had never spoken to her. That was because she had died.
entries.literal: "I left the storeroom. If what had been in the lobby was a pool, near the staircase, Erina's body lay on a sea of blood.{w} ...That Erina, below the broken elevator... We had never spoken to her. That was because she had died."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Did it make any sense? My idea was muddled, but I was sure it was on the right track.
entries.literal: "...Did it make any sense? My idea was muddled, but I was sure it was on the right track."

entries.speaker: i
