entries.text: I had to make sure of something. ...I had to make sure Akaro and Isla weren't anywhere.
entries.literal: "I had to make sure of something. ...I had to make sure Akaro and Isla weren't anywhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even though an immense amount of things didn't add up, I thought I'd found one of the keys. As I bolted up the stairs, details reinforced that thought.
entries.literal: "Even though an immense amount of things didn't add up, I thought I'd found one of the keys. As I bolted up the stairs, details reinforced that thought."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's gotta be later than {time=15.} That fits perfectly.{w} And... the drop of blood that Atsuki and I saw in the lobby... It was exactly where Naomi's body left it before vanishing.
entries.literal: "It's gotta be later than {time=15.} That fits perfectly.{w} And... the drop of blood that Atsuki and I saw in the lobby... It was exactly where Naomi's body left it before vanishing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I reached the offices, I stopped myself abruptly. There was something on the floor.
entries.literal: "When I reached the offices, I stopped myself abruptly. There was something on the floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Another Sekimeiya...?{w} Could this be the one I hid?
entries.literal: "Another Sekimeiya...?{w} Could this be the one I hid?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hovered my hand over it. An aura of heat surrounded it, so it was functional as well.
entries.literal: "I hovered my hand over it. An aura of heat surrounded it, so it was functional as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I picked it up, I felt that it was even hotter than I'd thought. Thanks to the thick clothes from the attic, I was able to bring it with me.
entries.literal: "When I picked it up, I felt that it was even hotter than I'd thought. Thanks to the thick clothes from the attic, I was able to bring it with me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did Atsuki see it? This had to be here for a while.
entries.literal: "...Did Atsuki see it? This had to be here for a while."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Running up the floors, I saw that every elevator panel had been taken off. Had Akaro been responsible for that? I had no clue anymore.
entries.literal: "Running up the floors, I saw that every elevator panel had been taken off. Had Akaro been responsible for that? I had no clue anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, I reached the attic's door. Every floor had been vacant, but the attic couldn't be.
entries.literal: "Eventually, I reached the attic's door. Every floor had been vacant, but the attic couldn't be."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was open, so I could see the narrow staircase ahead.{w} Why? Why wasn't the door locked anymore? Furthermore, the key was inserted in the outer keyhole.
entries.literal: "It was open, so I could see the narrow staircase ahead.{w} Why? Why wasn't the door locked anymore? Furthermore, the key was inserted in the outer keyhole."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Many footprints were pressed into the carpet. It didn't make any sense, but I didn't care. I also saw that the suitcase was no longer on the sofa.{w} As soon as I stepped into the living room, I heard a noise coming from one of the bedrooms.
entries.literal: "Many footprints were pressed into the carpet. It didn't make any sense, but I didn't care. I also saw that the suitcase was no longer on the sofa.{w} As soon as I stepped into the living room, I heard a noise coming from one of the bedrooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd hidden the Sekimeiya there hours earlier. When I got closer, I could make out the sound better, and I locked up.
entries.literal: "I'd hidden the Sekimeiya there hours earlier. When I got closer, I could make out the sound better, and I locked up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki was crying. I could see his torso on top of the bed, twitching rhythmically.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was crying. I could see his torso on top of the bed, twitching rhythmically."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had seen the dead bodies—my own death.{w} I was still alive, though.
entries.literal: "He had seen the dead bodies—my own death.{w} I was still alive, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled what Sai had told us a long time in the past. According to him, the drop of blood in the lobby was mine.{w} He'd been wrong, hadn't he? It was Naomi's.{w} In that case, why had he said that? And why had he been both right and wrong about my fate?
entries.literal: "I recalled what Sai had told us a long time in the past. According to him, the drop of blood in the lobby was mine.{w} He'd been wrong, hadn't he? It was Naomi's.{w} In that case, why had he said that? And why had he been both right and wrong about my fate?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped back, careful not to make a sound. Perhaps I was a monster for that, but it was the only thing I could do.
entries.literal: "I stepped back, careful not to make a sound. Perhaps I was a monster for that, but it was the only thing I could do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki had learned that the me of his world had died. I wanted to go back to mine, so I couldn't show myself and disappear on him again.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had learned that the me of his world had died. I wanted to go back to mine, so I couldn't show myself and disappear on him again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Aside from Atsuki and me, the whole tower was empty. How could that be, though? Where were Akaro and Isla?
entries.literal: "Aside from Atsuki and me, the whole tower was empty. How could that be, though? Where were Akaro and Isla?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The answer to that question was one I already knew.{w} They were in my world. They were the proof that going back was possible.
entries.literal: "The answer to that question was one I already knew.{w} They were in my world. They were the proof that going back was possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the point I was, an Akaro had appeared in the attic. His memories had differed from ours, and there had been a major distinction between us—he didn't know Katei.
entries.literal: "At the point I was, an Akaro had appeared in the attic. His memories had differed from ours, and there had been a major distinction between us—he didn't know Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had taken me a while to process it, but everything he said had started to make sense. The events he described were the ones I'd just lived through.{w} He'd sympathized with us, and he'd been surprised to hear we'd found Naomi's body but not that she'd died. After all, he had killed her in the world I was in, hadn't he?
entries.literal: "It had taken me a while to process it, but everything he said had started to make sense. The events he described were the ones I'd just lived through.{w} He'd sympathized with us, and he'd been surprised to hear we'd found Naomi's body but not that she'd died. After all, he had killed her in the world I was in, hadn't he?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Sai? I have no idea. He left the room earlier and didn't come back. What are you all even doing here?
entries.literal: "Sai? I have no idea. He left the room earlier and didn't come back. What are you all even doing here?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I mean... what I said. Why are you all here?
entries.literal: "I mean... what I said. Why are you all here?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: We tried to stay put in one place together. Do you not remember that?
entries.literal: "We tried to stay put in one place together. Do you not remember that?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No, I do. That doesn't answer my question, though.
entries.literal: "No, I do. That doesn't answer my question, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: How does it not answer your question? You and Sai escaped, and now you came back.
entries.literal: "How does it not answer your question? You and Sai escaped, and now you came back."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What!? That's not true! I didn't escape.
entries.literal: "What!? That's not true! I didn't escape."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And Isla... What the hell happened to her?{w} At the same time that Akaro appeared, Erina swore she heard Isla just outside the bedroom.
entries.literal: "And Isla... What the hell happened to her?{w} At the same time that Akaro appeared, Erina swore she heard Isla just outside the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, the last person, Sai... Where was he?
entries.literal: "Then, the last person, Sai... Where was he?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sai who chased us with a knife... Who was he?{w} ...The one who left the crystal room a while ago is the one who had the chance to see my body in the lobby. Is that where he made a mistake?
entries.literal: "The Sai who chased us with a knife... Who was he?{w} ...The one who left the crystal room a while ago is the one who had the chance to see my body in the lobby. Is that where he made a mistake?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went back to the storeroom and moved behind the wall.
entries.literal: "I went back to the storeroom and moved behind the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After dropping the Sekimeiya, I shifted my focus to the one I'd left there earlier.
entries.literal: "After dropping the Sekimeiya, I shifted my focus to the one I'd left there earlier."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How did they reach that world? There can only be one answer: with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "How did they reach that world? There can only be one answer: with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The cabinet was open, so they touched the Sekimeiya. Even Sai could've touched the other one after leaving the room.
entries.literal: "The cabinet was open, so they touched the Sekimeiya. Even Sai could've touched the other one after leaving the room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's what brought them there. It has to be.{w} How did I even get here in the first place? It was by touching the Sekimeiya. ...And why did Atsuki disappear from this world? I'd bet it happened when Naomi touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "That's what brought them there. It has to be.{w} How did I even get here in the first place? It was by touching the Sekimeiya. ...And why did Atsuki disappear from this world? I'd bet it happened when Naomi touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So then, why would it send me to another world as opposed to making me travel through time?
entries.literal: "So then, why would it send me to another world as opposed to making me travel through time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know that. It didn't make any sense. However, I could be confident it would work. It had already been proven.
entries.literal: "I didn't know that. It didn't make any sense. However, I could be confident it would work. It had already been proven."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After all, Atsuki had seen me on the crystal floor wearing the clothes I was wearing that very second. If I touched the Sekimeiya, I was guaranteed to go back.
entries.literal: "After all, Atsuki had seen me on the crystal floor wearing the clothes I was wearing that very second. If I touched the Sekimeiya, I was guaranteed to go back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't waste any more time. The darkness highlighted two glows, but my hand only approached one. It was the one I believed Akaro and Isla used.
entries.literal: "I didn't waste any more time. The darkness highlighted two glows, but my hand only approached one. It was the one I believed Akaro and Isla used."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I realized it, the glow disappeared in an instant of brief heat.
entries.literal: "Before I realized it, the glow disappeared in an instant of brief heat."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did it power off...?
entries.literal: "Did it power off...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I extended my hand more and understood that wasn't the case. ...It hadn't just powered off. The Sekimeiya wasn't there anymore.
entries.literal: "I extended my hand more and understood that wasn't the case. ...It hadn't just powered off. The Sekimeiya wasn't there anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to find the other one, but I couldn't. The darkness had become absolute yet again, and as I smelled the air, I felt I noticed a difference.
entries.literal: "I tried to find the other one, but I couldn't. The darkness had become absolute yet again, and as I smelled the air, I felt I noticed a difference."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did it work? I didn't teleport.
entries.literal: "Did it work? I didn't teleport."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I touched the walls around me. I was still in the storeroom.
entries.literal: "I touched the walls around me. I was still in the storeroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh!
entries.literal: "Oh!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up and took off to the door at the end of the corridor. When I hit it, I frantically felt its surface with my hand.
entries.literal: "I stood up and took off to the door at the end of the corridor. When I hit it, I frantically felt its surface with my hand."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's not here! The handle's gone!
entries.literal: "It's not here! The handle's gone!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had... made it back. I really had.
entries.literal: "I had... made it back. I really had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I dropped to the floor, exhausted and overwhelmed. There were so many things that I didn't understand, but I'd been right about the most important one. I closed my eyes, letting out short breaths until they slowed down.
entries.literal: "I dropped to the floor, exhausted and overwhelmed. There were so many things that I didn't understand, but I'd been right about the most important one. I closed my eyes, letting out short breaths until they slowed down."

entries.text: Transformative Interference
entries.literal: "Transformative Interference"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What do I want to do now...?
entries.literal: "What do I want to do now...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't safe in the storeroom anymore. The handle was gone, so everyone should have known about the hidden section. It appeared I had two options to choose from.
entries.literal: "I wasn't safe in the storeroom anymore. The handle was gone, so everyone should have known about the hidden section. It appeared I had two options to choose from."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How did the world function? Even though I'd changed the past, I'd gone back to a reality that I'd long thought erased. Just that fact made me doubt it was possible to alter history.
entries.literal: "How did the world function? Even though I'd changed the past, I'd gone back to a reality that I'd long thought erased. Just that fact made me doubt it was possible to alter history."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I had to think it was possible. I could do it right that moment. If I showed myself, I would change the events I'd experienced. And that was what I had to choose.
entries.literal: "However, I had to think it was possible. I could do it right that moment. If I showed myself, I would change the events I'd experienced. And that was what I had to choose."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whether to change the past or not. ...Did both options make sense?
entries.literal: "Whether to change the past or not. ...Did both options make sense?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I let everything repeat, the current version of myself will travel from the bathroom. That will let me take her place once again. ...I'd have to let Katei die for that.
entries.literal: "If I let everything repeat, the current version of myself will travel from the bathroom. That will let me take her place once again. ...I'd have to let Katei die for that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And still, to do it, I couldn't merely stay put. I had to purposely let Atsuki see me to seal the start and end of the loop.
entries.literal: "And still, to do it, I couldn't merely stay put. I had to purposely let Atsuki see me to seal the start and end of the loop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Will that be how it'll work in the end?
entries.literal: "...Will that be how it'll work in the end?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I divert the events from the ones I remember, two versions of me will persist. It might also erase the Atsuki I met this morning, or myself, depending on what the consequences will be...
entries.literal: "If I divert the events from the ones I remember, two versions of me will persist. It might also erase the Atsuki I met this morning, or myself, depending on what the consequences will be..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like I'd wanted, I had eventually returned to my target world by just waiting. The proper circumstances had aligned to fulfill what had to happen. If I just waited a while longer, I would arrive at the truth of Atsuki seeing me.
entries.literal: "Like I'd wanted, I had eventually returned to my target world by just waiting. The proper circumstances had aligned to fulfill what had to happen. If I just waited a while longer, I would arrive at the truth of Atsuki seeing me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know the exact time, so I got as close to the hallway as possible.
entries.literal: "I didn't know the exact time, so I got as close to the hallway as possible."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I can't really hear anything.
entries.literal: "...I can't really hear anything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...{w} I'm pretty sure someone should be here, no matter what time it is.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} I'm pretty sure someone should be here, no matter what time it is."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We didn't look at the storeroom again when we left the attic, did we...? I might really be able to stay here undiscovered.
entries.literal: "We didn't look at the storeroom again when we left the attic, did we...? I might really be able to stay here undiscovered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had I always been there all along? I had a lot of trouble visualizing exactly what had happened.
entries.literal: "Had I always been there all along? I had a lot of trouble visualizing exactly what had happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trying to perceive any sound, I continued pressing my ear against the wall.
entries.literal: "Trying to perceive any sound, I continued pressing my ear against the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Once again, that led into minutes of silence, and as they kept passing, my concern only strengthened.
entries.literal: "...Once again, that led into minutes of silence, and as they kept passing, my concern only strengthened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was I really in the same place? Maybe the handleless door hadn't been the proof I thought.
entries.literal: "Was I really in the same place? Maybe the handleless door hadn't been the proof I thought."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is probably the time we were locked in the attic, but we know things happened down here while we were above. ...What's with the complete silence, then?
entries.literal: "This is probably the time we were locked in the attic, but we know things happened down here while we were above. ...What's with the complete silence, then?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Akaro who appeared in the bedroom... He has to be the one I was with just now. If that's correct, Isla was actually in the attic as well when Erina heard her.
entries.literal: "The Akaro who appeared in the bedroom... He has to be the one I was with just now. If that's correct, Isla was actually in the attic as well when Erina heard her."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So then, what happened to them? Why did we never find Isla, and why did Akaro disappear?
entries.literal: "So then, what happened to them? Why did we never find Isla, and why did Akaro disappear?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We had left Akaro in the lower level of the bedroom. A while later, he disappeared. Furthermore, the chain hadn't been removed.
entries.literal: "We had left Akaro in the lower level of the bedroom. A while later, he disappeared. Furthermore, the chain hadn't been removed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a simple explanation—disappearing with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "There was a simple explanation—disappearing with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When the ominous silence had gone on for a while, I decided to open the door in front of the wall.
entries.literal: "When the ominous silence had gone on for a while, I decided to open the door in front of the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Hallway A.{w} Immediately, I noticed something that differed.
entries.literal: "...Hallway A.{w} Immediately, I noticed something that differed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The elevator button is in place.
entries.literal: "The elevator button is in place."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it correct that if I don't intend to change the past, it won't? If so, that'll be very convenient.
entries.literal: "Is it correct that if I don't intend to change the past, it won't? If so, that'll be very convenient."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I mean, I have proof that I'll still be here hours later, so I can do whatever I want as long as I don't purposely change the past.
entries.literal: "I mean, I have proof that I'll still be here hours later, so I can do whatever I want as long as I don't purposely change the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went up the staircase. ...Could Isla have been in the attic?
entries.literal: "I went up the staircase. ...Could Isla have been in the attic?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to see it with my own eyes. I had to confirm I was back there.
entries.literal: "I had to see it with my own eyes. I had to confirm I was back there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached the attic's door. Next to every elevator on the way up, the metallic panels had been properly attached.
entries.literal: "I reached the attic's door. Next to every elevator on the way up, the metallic panels had been properly attached."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the floor of the living room. Even though it had changed considerably, there were still recent footprints, and the empty suitcase was back on the sofa.
entries.literal: "I looked at the floor of the living room. Even though it had changed considerably, there were still recent footprints, and the empty suitcase was back on the sofa."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait a second.
entries.literal: "Wait a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared by my feet after stepping in and remembered something Atsuki had once said.
entries.literal: "I stared by my feet after stepping in and remembered something Atsuki had once said."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: A-Are these Isla's? They can't be, right? And I think they're a bit too big.
entries.literal: "A-Are these Isla's? They can't be, right? And I think they're a bit too big."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't make any sound. Slowly, I stepped to the hallway and saw all that I needed to see.
entries.literal: "I couldn't make any sound. Slowly, I stepped to the hallway and saw all that I needed to see."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no handle here either...
entries.literal: "There's no handle here either..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That could've only meant one thing. As I stood there, we were all behind that door.
entries.literal: "That could've only meant one thing. As I stood there, we were all behind that door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, is Isla here?
entries.literal: "So, is Isla here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like we'd once done, I took off my boots to reach the other bedroom while making the least amount of noise.
entries.literal: "Like we'd once done, I took off my boots to reach the other bedroom while making the least amount of noise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was empty.
entries.literal: "It was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So was the kitchen.
entries.literal: "So was the kitchen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And the storeroom.
entries.literal: "And the storeroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...She's not here.
entries.literal: "...She's not here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I put on my boots and closed the door.
entries.literal: "...{w}I put on my boots and closed the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then what the hell happened to her? Did she—
entries.literal: "Then what the hell happened to her? Did she—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hold on.{w} That's it. ...That's what happened!
entries.literal: "Hold on.{w} That's it. ...That's what happened!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The identity of Isla's friend...{w} I had finally figured it out.
entries.literal: "The identity of Isla's friend...{w} I had finally figured it out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla had died, so how could she have been alive within a month? Atsuki had already stated that the recording was no trap.
entries.literal: "Isla had died, so how could she have been alive within a month? Atsuki had already stated that the recording was no trap."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were many things I had learned. Vaisude revealed that there was a large travel at around {time=16.} That was how he had appeared on the 24th of November, and it happened to fit with the approximate date Isla's friend had appeared.
entries.literal: "There were many things I had learned. Vaisude revealed that there was a large travel at around {time=16.} That was how he had appeared on the 24th of November, and it happened to fit with the approximate date Isla's friend had appeared."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And that's not all. This also explains another mystery: Akaro's disappearance.
entries.literal: "And that's not all. This also explains another mystery: Akaro's disappearance."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's someone else who appeared on the 24th of November. The person who escaped from a prison cell, who I really have to assume was Akaro.
entries.literal: "There's someone else who appeared on the 24th of November. The person who escaped from a prison cell, who I really have to assume was Akaro."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At {time=16}, there was a very large travel, and everyone who got caught up in it appeared on the 24th of November. Three people who traveled were Vaisude, Isla, and Akaro.
entries.literal: "At {time=16}, there was a very large travel, and everyone who got caught up in it appeared on the 24th of November. Three people who traveled were Vaisude, Isla, and Akaro."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Akaro who appeared in the cell wasn't the same Akaro we originally met in the morning. In a way, that explains some of the questions I had.{w} Didn't Atsuki say that he'd seen Akaro once again? That was the version of him who escaped the bedroom with Sai.{w} Why did he appear in prison, and what did he do later? I don't know, but at this point I have no doubt Akaro was the Xyn member trapped with us.
entries.literal: "The Akaro who appeared in the cell wasn't the same Akaro we originally met in the morning. In a way, that explains some of the questions I had.{w} Didn't Atsuki say that he'd seen Akaro once again? That was the version of him who escaped the bedroom with Sai.{w} Why did he appear in prison, and what did he do later? I don't know, but at this point I have no doubt Akaro was the Xyn member trapped with us."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And that's how both Islas met. ...Earlier, when we were in the bedroom, Erina's and Isla's behavior seemed different. That's because in that world, her "friend" never appeared.{w} This is the solution to Atsuki's problem. After going to the past, she didn't recreate what she had lived through. For her, that was happening for the first time.
entries.literal: "And that's how both Islas met. ...Earlier, when we were in the bedroom, Erina's and Isla's behavior seemed different. That's because in that world, her \"friend\" never appeared.{w} This is the solution to Atsuki's problem. After going to the past, she didn't recreate what she had lived through. For her, that was happening for the first time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I thought about it, all the things we'd heard about her friend made sense.
entries.literal: "When I thought about it, all the things we'd heard about her friend made sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: "She said that if we stayed calm in one place, nobody would be hurt."{w} That's exactly what we did. We stayed in a crystal room, and Isla never saw any of the dead bodies.
entries.literal: "\"She said that if we stayed calm in one place, nobody would be hurt.\"{w} That's exactly what we did. We stayed in a crystal room, and Isla never saw any of the dead bodies."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: "She said that even though she didn't know how it would end or how long we'd stay here for, she'd wait for me at home."{w} I see. The reason she didn't know how it would end was because she traveled to the past in the middle of the day, and she didn't know how long we'd stay because Katei hadn't been there to explain the alarm.
entries.literal: "\"She said that even though she didn't know how it would end or how long we'd stay here for, she'd wait for me at home.\"{w} I see. The reason she didn't know how it would end was because she traveled to the past in the middle of the day, and she didn't know how long we'd stay because Katei hadn't been there to explain the alarm."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It makes sense. Isla was told that seven people would get trapped and that it'd be three men and four women. That's just because the other Isla wasn't counting Katei.
entries.literal: "It makes sense. Isla was told that seven people would get trapped and that it'd be three men and four women. That's just because the other Isla wasn't counting Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was one last thing Isla had told us. Her friend assured her that she would get to touch the Sekimeiya.{w} The Isla I'd just been with had touched it. In the crystal room, she asked about it, but Akaro told her not to. When he left Isla alone, I'm sure she took advantage of it. That was why the cabinet was open and why both of them appeared in the world I was in.
entries.literal: "There was one last thing Isla had told us. Her friend assured her that she would get to touch the Sekimeiya.{w} The Isla I'd just been with had touched it. In the crystal room, she asked about it, but Akaro told her not to. When he left Isla alone, I'm sure she took advantage of it. That was why the cabinet was open and why both of them appeared in the world I was in."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's only one thing I find strange... If she appeared in this world in that room, she would've noticed that a curtain had appeared on the floor with Naomi's corpse under it. ...Did she see it?
entries.literal: "There's only one thing I find strange... If she appeared in this world in that room, she would've noticed that a curtain had appeared on the floor with Naomi's corpse under it. ...Did she see it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm... the Sekimeiya was inside the cabinet, so she had to climb inside to touch it. If she changed worlds inside the cabinet, she would have shut herself in there, because it's locked in this world. I wonder what exactly happened.
entries.literal: "Hm... the Sekimeiya was inside the cabinet, so she had to climb inside to touch it. If she changed worlds inside the cabinet, she would have shut herself in there, because it's locked in this world. I wonder what exactly happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And when did the recording come into play in all of this...?
entries.literal: "And when did the recording come into play in all of this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A sound came from the hallway.
entries.literal: "A sound came from the hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did they open the door...?
entries.literal: "Did they open the door...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone was there, but I could only hear footsteps.
entries.literal: "Someone was there, but I could only hear footsteps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made sure not to move, but I couldn't discern who it was.
entries.literal: "I made sure not to move, but I couldn't discern who it was."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It has to be us. ...We just left the bedroom.
entries.literal: "It has to be us. ...We just left the bedroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They're still there.
entries.literal: "They're still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound wasn't reaching well where I was. There had been brief periods of silence, but I could tell the hallway was not empty.
entries.literal: "The sound wasn't reaching well where I was. There had been brief periods of silence, but I could tell the hallway was not empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, the dry footsteps faded away.
entries.literal: "Soon, the dry footsteps faded away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did they leave? That wasn't only one person.
entries.literal: "...Did they leave? That wasn't only one person."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I should go back to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "I should go back to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't like the idea of staying in the attic, but I could've been seen if I went all the way down.
entries.literal: "I didn't like the idea of staying in the attic, but I could've been seen if I went all the way down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No matter who that was, I can probably make it down before them.
entries.literal: "No matter who that was, I can probably make it down before them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to open the elevator, but it didn't budge. Then, as soon as I pressed the button, I felt a spark in my mind.
entries.literal: "I tried to open the elevator, but it didn't budge. Then, as soon as I pressed the button, I felt a spark in my mind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Whoa, what the hell...?{w} Did this happen again?
entries.literal: "Whoa, what the hell...?{w} Did this happen again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Dumbfounded, I stared at the button until it lit up orange.
entries.literal: "Dumbfounded, I stared at the button until it lit up orange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Inside the elevator, I pressed the lowest button.
entries.literal: "Inside the elevator, I pressed the lowest button."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I descended the building, I reeled from confusion. ...What had just happened?
entries.literal: "While I descended the building, I reeled from confusion. ...What had just happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I opened the door on the crystal floor and made a quick dash to the storeroom.
entries.literal: "...I opened the door on the crystal floor and made a quick dash to the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I paid my utmost attention behind the door. What was about to happen was very important.
entries.literal: "I paid my utmost attention behind the door. What was about to happen was very important."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There it is!
entries.literal: "There it is!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone appeared from the staircase.
entries.literal: "Someone appeared from the staircase."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It's more than one person. It has to be the same people who just left the attic.
entries.literal: "...It's more than one person. It has to be the same people who just left the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That meant it had to be us. It had to be us... Atsuki and me.
entries.literal: "That meant it had to be us. It had to be us... Atsuki and me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was that me? I just heard a voice.
entries.literal: "Was that me? I just heard a voice."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't sure, but they didn't speak again. Instead, they got closer to where I was.
entries.literal: "I wasn't sure, but they didn't speak again. Instead, they got closer to where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And as the sound of their footsteps increased, they quickly decreased. Then, they opened a door. ...I had to think it was the event room's.
entries.literal: "And as the sound of their footsteps increased, they quickly decreased. Then, they opened a door. ...I had to think it was the event room's."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell...? It has to be us, but it doesn't make sense.
entries.literal: "What the hell...? It has to be us, but it doesn't make sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something else had to happen, so I waited for it.
entries.literal: "Something else had to happen, so I waited for it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited... for something that didn't happen.
entries.literal: "I waited... for something that didn't happen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody else came from the staircase side. In fact, ever since the footsteps had crossed the hallway, I hadn't heard anything.
entries.literal: "Nobody else came from the staircase side. In fact, ever since the footsteps had crossed the hallway, I hadn't heard anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In just a few minutes, I began to doubt what had been confirmed. I doubted I really was back in that world.
entries.literal: "In just a few minutes, I began to doubt what had been confirmed. I doubted I really was back in that world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at hallway A. Nobody was there, but I believed it was easy to confirm where I was.
entries.literal: "I glanced at hallway A. Nobody was there, but I believed it was easy to confirm where I was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Cautiously, I walked to the lobby door. I opened it slowly, creating the tiniest gap.
entries.literal: "Cautiously, I walked to the lobby door. I opened it slowly, creating the tiniest gap."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I'd thought, something was wrong.
entries.literal: "As I'd thought, something was wrong."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was completely empty. My own body had disappeared even though a single drop of blood remained near the door.
entries.literal: "It was completely empty. My own body had disappeared even though a single drop of blood remained near the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why... Why is nobody here?
entries.literal: "Why... Why is nobody here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the event room, where the door had been left open. ...The display cabinet was empty.
entries.literal: "I went to the event room, where the door had been left open. ...The display cabinet was empty."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no chance I'm not back, is there?
entries.literal: "There's no chance I'm not back, is there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to be, and a way to be sure was in hallway B. But something else grabbed my attention as soon as I stepped in.
entries.literal: "I had to be, and a way to be sure was in hallway B. But something else grabbed my attention as soon as I stepped in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A door was open. It belonged to the farthest crystal room, B6.
entries.literal: "A door was open. It belonged to the farthest crystal room, B6."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached it slowly and soon saw what was behind it.
entries.literal: "I approached it slowly and soon saw what was behind it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was just inside the room. Its color was white, and nobody was there.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was just inside the room. Its color was white, and nobody was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could only frown as I walked up to it. That was the place we had traveled from after leaving the attic. Many things indicated I was in that world.
entries.literal: "I could only frown as I walked up to it. That was the place we had traveled from after leaving the attic. Many things indicated I was in that world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But not all. There was something that wasn't right, and it was baffling.
entries.literal: "But not all. There was something that wasn't right, and it was baffling."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So there are two Sekimeiya here as well...?
entries.literal: "So there are two Sekimeiya here as well...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That had to be right, and no matter what was happening, keeping one was a good idea. Still rattled, I picked it up.
entries.literal: "That had to be right, and no matter what was happening, keeping one was a good idea. Still rattled, I picked it up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The headache was coming back, so I left quickly and directed myself to the room I'd wanted to inspect.
entries.literal: "The headache was coming back, so I left quickly and directed myself to the room I'd wanted to inspect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: B4, where I'd been for hours. When I opened the door, I found what I expected on the other side.
entries.literal: "B4, where I'd been for hours. When I opened the door, I found what I expected on the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Naomi was on the floor, under a curtain. There were bloodstains near her and on the wall, too.
entries.literal: "Naomi was on the floor, under a curtain. There were bloodstains near her and on the wall, too."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Just what the hell is happening?{w} The Sekimeiya I have right now is the one we touched in that crystal room, right...?
entries.literal: "Just what the hell is happening?{w} The Sekimeiya I have right now is the one we touched in that crystal room, right...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I just took it, so that's why we didn't find it later. ...Instead, we found it in a drawer.{w} That must not have been the same one. ...Is that it?
entries.literal: "I just took it, so that's why we didn't find it later. ...Instead, we found it in a drawer.{w} That must not have been the same one. ...Is that it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The structure of those events didn't make sense. There was a major contradiction.
entries.literal: "The structure of those events didn't make sense. There was a major contradiction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I approached one of the cabinets. Its side wheel was damaged.
entries.literal: "...I approached one of the cabinets. Its side wheel was damaged."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's the same cabinet we saw that day.{w} ...Actually, I should keep the Sekimeiya here. I was thinking of bringing it to the storeroom, but that could be risky depending on what happened.
entries.literal: "It's the same cabinet we saw that day.{w} ...Actually, I should keep the Sekimeiya here. I was thinking of bringing it to the storeroom, but that could be risky depending on what happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After all, why had I traveled back to that world? Due to an idea I'd had, I didn't want to stay near the Sekimeiya. For the same reason, I had to turn the wheel.
entries.literal: "After all, why had I traveled back to that world? Due to an idea I'd had, I didn't want to stay near the Sekimeiya. For the same reason, I had to turn the wheel."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Akaro set it to 5 °C, but that must not have been enough, because the Sekimeiya still worked when Isla touched it. ...We found it set to 0 °C, so that might be better.
entries.literal: "Akaro set it to 5 °C, but that must not have been enough, because the Sekimeiya still worked when Isla touched it. ...We found it set to 0 °C, so that might be better."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still couldn't easily believe what I was thinking. ...Had everything really happened as I thought?
entries.literal: "I still couldn't easily believe what I was thinking. ...Had everything really happened as I thought?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew I had to be wrong about something, so what made the most sense... was that I was mistaken about what time it was.
entries.literal: "I knew I had to be wrong about something, so what made the most sense... was that I was mistaken about what time it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...After all, I had used the elevator.
entries.literal: "...After all, I had used the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the attic, I'd been so distracted that I hardly considered the elevator would be audible. In fact, while I'd thought about it, I'd been blinded by the assumption that if I didn't mean to change the past, everything would repeat, and I was at no risk of being seen.
entries.literal: "In the attic, I'd been so distracted that I hardly considered the elevator would be audible. In fact, while I'd thought about it, I'd been blinded by the assumption that if I didn't mean to change the past, everything would repeat, and I was at no risk of being seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If everything did happen the same way, it was guaranteed that I wouldn't be found. Therefore, using the elevator to go to the crystal floor was safe. That had been my unconscious thought process.
entries.literal: "If everything did happen the same way, it was guaranteed that I wouldn't be found. Therefore, using the elevator to go to the crystal floor was safe. That had been my unconscious thought process."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it had generated a logical issue in my mind.
entries.literal: "But it had generated a logical issue in my mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who had caused the noises I'd heard in the attic? I'd assumed that was the time we'd left the bedroom.
entries.literal: "Who had caused the noises I'd heard in the attic? I'd assumed that was the time we'd left the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But what had happened after that?
entries.literal: "But what had happened after that?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Atsuki and I went down to the crystal floor and then to the event room. That's what I heard from the storeroom just now.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and I went down to the crystal floor and then to the event room. That's what I heard from the storeroom just now."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, we found the Sekimeiya in room B6. We touched it and traveled through time.
entries.literal: "Then, we found the Sekimeiya in room B6. We touched it and traveled through time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We appeared back in the bedroom, and then we went to the lobby before our original versions arrived on the crystal floor. We determined that we'd gone five minutes to the past.
entries.literal: "We appeared back in the bedroom, and then we went to the lobby before our original versions arrived on the crystal floor. We determined that we'd gone five minutes to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, that didn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "However, that didn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The elevator was another key detail to those events.{w} After leaving the attic's bedroom for the first time, we had heard the elevator twice on the office floors.
entries.literal: "The elevator was another key detail to those events.{w} After leaving the attic's bedroom for the first time, we had heard the elevator twice on the office floors."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, when we traveled five minutes to the past, I pressed the button in the attic. That's why we thought it was us who called it from the attic and took it down.
entries.literal: "Then, when we traveled five minutes to the past, I pressed the button in the attic. That's why we thought it was us who called it from the attic and took it down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And just now, when I called the elevator, I thought "Did this happen again? Did I once again call the elevator without realizing that I was going to produce the sound I'd already heard?"
entries.literal: "And just now, when I called the elevator, I thought \"Did this happen again? Did I once again call the elevator without realizing that I was going to produce the sound I'd already heard?\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That was wrong, though. It couldn't have happened "again" because both elevator trips were the very same.
entries.literal: "That was wrong, though. It couldn't have happened \"again\" because both elevator trips were the very same."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After Atsuki and I touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in the bedroom, I called the elevator, producing the sound we heard before traveling. Now, right after the old versions of us went down, I called the elevator, producing the sound we heard.
entries.literal: "After Atsuki and I touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in the bedroom, I called the elevator, producing the sound we heard before traveling. Now, right after the old versions of us went down, I called the elevator, producing the sound we heard."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Which one was right, and which one was wrong? Only one was the truth.
entries.literal: "Which one was right, and which one was wrong? Only one was the truth."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was the reason why I was skeptical about my surroundings. I was in that world, but there had to be something I was mistaken about.{w} If it was the time of day, everything made sense. If the sounds I'd heard in the attic hadn't belonged to our past selves, there was no contradiction.
entries.literal: "That was the reason why I was skeptical about my surroundings. I was in that world, but there had to be something I was mistaken about.{w} If it was the time of day, everything made sense. If the sounds I'd heard in the attic hadn't belonged to our past selves, there was no contradiction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But was that it...? It didn't seem likely. From the storeroom, I was pretty sure I'd heard my own voice. That would've been when we'd checked the elevator to confirm that it arrived on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "But was that it...? It didn't seem likely. From the storeroom, I was pretty sure I'd heard my own voice. That would've been when we'd checked the elevator to confirm that it arrived on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I just caused the sound we heard that day, then what the hell happened after we appeared in the bedroom?
entries.literal: "If I just caused the sound we heard that day, then what the hell happened after we appeared in the bedroom?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just a few minutes prior, I'd confirmed nobody was in the lobby. ...But the versions of us who had touched the Sekimeiya in B6 were supposed to be there.
entries.literal: "Just a few minutes prior, I'd confirmed nobody was in the lobby. ...But the versions of us who had touched the Sekimeiya in B6 were supposed to be there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who had caused the elevator noises? No matter which one was correct, the other interpretation was completely wrong.
entries.literal: "Who had caused the elevator noises? No matter which one was correct, the other interpretation was completely wrong."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been trying to combat my headache to understand what had happened. Even though both versions of things made perfect sense separately, it was impossible to reconcile them.
entries.literal: "I'd been trying to combat my headache to understand what had happened. Even though both versions of things made perfect sense separately, it was impossible to reconcile them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...In the storeroom, I touched the Sekimeiya and the world around me changed. Could something like that have happened when we touched it in room B6?
entries.literal: "...In the storeroom, I touched the Sekimeiya and the world around me changed. Could something like that have happened when we touched it in room B6?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That seemed like it could make sense, but there was another problem. Atsuki had seen me after that point. That implied he was still in the same world.
entries.literal: "That seemed like it could make sense, but there was another problem. Atsuki had seen me after that point. That implied he was still in the same world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been caught up sorting everything out in my head when I heard someone just outside the door.
entries.literal: "I'd been caught up sorting everything out in my head when I heard someone just outside the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Who's that?
entries.literal: "...Who's that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound only intensified, and soon, the door opened. When I saw who was there, I rushed over.
entries.literal: "The sound only intensified, and soon, the door opened. When I saw who was there, I rushed over."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Erina...! A-Are you—
entries.literal: "Erina...! A-Are you—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could finish, she fell to the floor.{w} Her clothes were soaked in blood, and her expression was vacant. I moved to shake her shoulder, but she didn't respond.
entries.literal: "Before I could finish, she fell to the floor.{w} Her clothes were soaked in blood, and her expression was vacant. I moved to shake her shoulder, but she didn't respond."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh-What happened...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What happened...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Disconcerted, I closed the door. I didn't want to be heard, and I wasn't sure who else was there. However, I calmed myself down when I recalled what had happened.
entries.literal: "Disconcerted, I closed the door. I didn't want to be heard, and I wasn't sure who else was there. However, I calmed myself down when I recalled what had happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right... Okay. She's not dead.
entries.literal: "Right... Okay. She's not dead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was the room where we'd found her, and she had fallen in the same position. I placed a finger on her neck and felt the pulse we'd missed.
entries.literal: "That was the room where we'd found her, and she had fallen in the same position. I placed a finger on her neck and felt the pulse we'd missed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She said she got hit in the head, but who did it...? All this blood can't be hers.
entries.literal: "She said she got hit in the head, but who did it...? All this blood can't be hers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who could've hit Erina? ...Akaro, Sai, and Katei. However, no one else but Katei had lost that much blood.
entries.literal: "Who could've hit Erina? ...Akaro, Sai, and Katei. However, no one else but Katei had lost that much blood."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The blood is fresh. ...Katei's already dead, then.
entries.literal: "...The blood is fresh. ...Katei's already dead, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was once again lost. Everything was repeating, which meant that I hadn't been mistaken. What I'd heard in the attic was really us leaving the bedroom.
entries.literal: "I was once again lost. Everything was repeating, which meant that I hadn't been mistaken. What I'd heard in the attic was really us leaving the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I doubted what to do. Sai and Akaro could've been very close by.{w} In the other world, Akaro had killed me, and in the one I was in, Sai would soon chase us with a knife. No matter what, I couldn't let myself be seen, so going to the storeroom was dangerous.
entries.literal: "I doubted what to do. Sai and Akaro could've been very close by.{w} In the other world, Akaro had killed me, and in the one I was in, Sai would soon chase us with a knife. No matter what, I couldn't let myself be seen, so going to the storeroom was dangerous."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Katei and Erina left the attic together. They might've been attacked at the same time by Akaro or Sai.
entries.literal: "Katei and Erina left the attic together. They might've been attacked at the same time by Akaro or Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So, what about us? Where were our past selves?
entries.literal: "So, what about us? Where were our past selves?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: According to my memories, we should have been in the lobby when I'd peeked into it, so I couldn't blindly trust what I remembered in that regard.
entries.literal: "According to my memories, we should have been in the lobby when I'd peeked into it, so I couldn't blindly trust what I remembered in that regard."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe I should go to the storeroom anyway. If everything will play out the same, I can be sure I won't be seen.
entries.literal: "Maybe I should go to the storeroom anyway. If everything will play out the same, I can be sure I won't be seen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, no.{w} I don't have to.
entries.literal: "Wait, no.{w} I don't have to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought a little ahead. When we'd found Erina, we failed to realize that she was alive. Due to the shock, we'd barely stepped into the room.
entries.literal: "I thought a little ahead. When we'd found Erina, we failed to realize that she was alive. Due to the shock, we'd barely stepped into the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could leave, but given what I knew, I didn't have to. If I stayed next to the door when it opened, our past selves wouldn't see me. It was better not to move.
entries.literal: "I could leave, but given what I knew, I didn't have to. If I stayed next to the door when it opened, our past selves wouldn't see me. It was better not to move."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited next to the door. From there, the whole floor seemed silent.
entries.literal: "I waited next to the door. From there, the whole floor seemed silent."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina had completely passed out. She hadn't moved an inch, and as the seconds passed, I kept wondering where Atsuki and the other me were.
entries.literal: "Erina had completely passed out. She hadn't moved an inch, and as the seconds passed, I kept wondering where Atsuki and the other me were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't get it. Was I not properly remembering what had happened...?{w} I looked up at the camera. Was I being recorded in two different places simultaneously?
entries.literal: "I didn't get it. Was I not properly remembering what had happened...?{w} I looked up at the camera. Was I being recorded in two different places simultaneously?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...?{w} The green light still isn't there. That's odd...
entries.literal: "What...?{w} The green light still isn't there. That's odd..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was in my hands. I'd gotten distracted, so I hadn't left it in the cabinet. However, I'd also noticed something else that was strange, which had made me very reluctant to follow through with that.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was in my hands. I'd gotten distracted, so I hadn't left it in the cabinet. However, I'd also noticed something else that was strange, which had made me very reluctant to follow through with that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have to wait long before I heard a door opening. It sounded like someone had come from the lobby.
entries.literal: "I didn't have to wait long before I heard a door opening. It sounded like someone had come from the lobby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Again, it's more than one person. ...Are they gonna go to the bathrooms?
entries.literal: "Again, it's more than one person. ...Are they gonna go to the bathrooms?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They did.{w} Then, another door was opened. ...I knew it was the staff room's.
entries.literal: "They did.{w} Then, another door was opened. ...I knew it was the staff room's."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It really is us. What the hell, then?
entries.literal: "It really is us. What the hell, then?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...et the Se—{w} ...has to be—
entries.literal: "...et the Se—{w} ...has to be—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It is. That was Atsuki.
entries.literal: "It is. That was Atsuki."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I remember what we did... After checking that Naomi's locker was still open, we found the Sekimeiya in a drawer in room B6. We brought it to the event room, and then we found Katei and Erina.
entries.literal: "I remember what we did... After checking that Naomi's locker was still open, we found the Sekimeiya in a drawer in room B6. We brought it to the event room, and then we found Katei and Erina."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As predicted, the steps eventually moved to the event room.
entries.literal: "As predicted, the steps eventually moved to the event room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I'm not mistaken, they'll come here soon.
entries.literal: "If I'm not mistaken, they'll come here soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My tension grew, but I had to be fine as long as I didn't make noise. Meanwhile, I kept wondering what to do with the Sekimeiya that I had. ...I could be sure there had always been two of them, as we had just locked one in its cabinet.
entries.literal: "My tension grew, but I had to be fine as long as I didn't make noise. Meanwhile, I kept wondering what to do with the Sekimeiya that I had. ...I could be sure there had always been two of them, as we had just locked one in its cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no remaining doubt in my mind that I was right, so I waited. After finding Katei, it hadn't taken us very long to come across Erina.
entries.literal: "There was no remaining doubt in my mind that I was right, so I waited. After finding Katei, it hadn't taken us very long to come across Erina."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And that was reflected by the sound behind the door. Mere minutes after it faded, the lobby door opened again.
entries.literal: "And that was reflected by the sound behind the door. Mere minutes after it faded, the lobby door opened again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew full well the desolate atmosphere we'd experienced as we'd looked in every room. After that repeated, they opened the door next to me, and I was forced to relive the shock of seeing Erina's bloodied body through their sharp gasps.
entries.literal: "I knew full well the desolate atmosphere we'd experienced as we'd looked in every room. After that repeated, they opened the door next to me, and I was forced to relive the shock of seeing Erina's bloodied body through their sharp gasps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki took two steps forward, and I heard my past self crumple down. Hidden behind the door, I held my breath.
entries.literal: "Atsuki took two steps forward, and I heard my past self crumple down. Hidden behind the door, I held my breath."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's it... I can't look at her. Let's go...
entries.literal: "That's it... I can't look at her. Let's go..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Slowly, Atsuki turned around. I couldn't see it, but I felt the despair that came from him.
entries.literal: "Slowly, Atsuki turned around. I couldn't see it, but I felt the despair that came from him."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Give me a second.
entries.literal: "Give me a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before they left, Atsuki detached the curtain from the cabinet closest to him and covered Erina with it.
entries.literal: "Before they left, Atsuki detached the curtain from the cabinet closest to him and covered Erina with it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I exhaled. I may have been in the same world I'd come from originally, but there were loads of things I didn't understand.
entries.literal: "I exhaled. I may have been in the same world I'd come from originally, but there were loads of things I didn't understand."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So now what?
entries.literal: "So now what?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya entailed a dilemma. I wanted to leave it behind, but that potentially created its own problem.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya entailed a dilemma. I wanted to leave it behind, but that potentially created its own problem."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh...! This is what happened!
entries.literal: "Oh...! This is what happened!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I thought ahead, the answer to a persistent question was finally answered.
entries.literal: "When I thought ahead, the answer to a persistent question was finally answered."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I... I just trapped myself.
entries.literal: "I... I just trapped myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been going one step at a time, so I hadn't realized a direct result of what I'd done.
entries.literal: "I'd been going one step at a time, so I hadn't realized a direct result of what I'd done."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After finding Erina, we went to the event room, and Atsuki sat next to the hallway A door.
entries.literal: "After finding Erina, we went to the event room, and Atsuki sat next to the hallway A door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I finally understood... The reason why he'd seen me, and why that would repeat.
entries.literal: "I finally understood... The reason why he'd seen me, and why that would repeat."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm trapped. As soon as I leave this room, Atsuki will hear and see me. ...That's what woke him up.
entries.literal: "I'm trapped. As soon as I leave this room, Atsuki will hear and see me. ...That's what woke him up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And I had to leave. If I stayed there for much longer, a search would eventually find me. That wasn't all—I knew Erina would soon regain consciousness herself, and I had a reason to think Sai would search the room I was in fairly soon. ...I had to leave, and as soon as I did, I would force our past selves out of the event room.
entries.literal: "...And I had to leave. If I stayed there for much longer, a search would eventually find me. That wasn't all—I knew Erina would soon regain consciousness herself, and I had a reason to think Sai would search the room I was in fairly soon. ...I had to leave, and as soon as I did, I would force our past selves out of the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had a Sekimeiya with me, so teleporting out was an option. But it was one I couldn't risk, because I refused to leave the world I was in again.
entries.literal: "I had a Sekimeiya with me, so teleporting out was an option. But it was one I couldn't risk, because I refused to leave the world I was in again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the event room, I had fallen asleep very quickly. I'd been dead tired that day.{w} I felt a similar exhaustion at that moment. I'd been in the tower for many hours already, but they'd fortunately been much less dense.
entries.literal: "In the event room, I had fallen asleep very quickly. I'd been dead tired that day.{w} I felt a similar exhaustion at that moment. I'd been in the tower for many hours already, but they'd fortunately been much less dense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After I leave, Atsuki will call for me, and I won't appear.
entries.literal: "After I leave, Atsuki will call for me, and I won't appear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unbelievable as it seemed, that aligned with what I wanted, so it made sense for it to occur. I could watch what had happened from a distance, and there was something I was curious about.
entries.literal: "Unbelievable as it seemed, that aligned with what I wanted, so it made sense for it to occur. I could watch what had happened from a distance, and there was something I was curious about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was yet another reason—it would've caused a problem that I was finally sure existed.{w} I couldn't interact with my old self. It was the same thing we'd considered with Isla. If my past self met the future me and tried to keep everything exactly the same, she'd have to replicate precisely what she'd seen me do. Every word, every movement. No human was capable of that.{w} It was crucial not to be seen by both her and Atsuki.
entries.literal: "There was yet another reason—it would've caused a problem that I was finally sure existed.{w} I couldn't interact with my old self. It was the same thing we'd considered with Isla. If my past self met the future me and tried to keep everything exactly the same, she'd have to replicate precisely what she'd seen me do. Every word, every movement. No human was capable of that.{w} It was crucial not to be seen by both her and Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A certain time was approaching. There was something I'd been avoiding thinking about.
entries.literal: "A certain time was approaching. There was something I'd been avoiding thinking about."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On that mountain, I made a decision...{w} To change the past and save everyone. Miiya, Isla, Erina, Katei, Naomi...
entries.literal: "On that mountain, I made a decision...{w} To change the past and save everyone. Miiya, Isla, Erina, Katei, Naomi..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While that reality seemed distant, it was as close as ever. The time I'd found the Sekimeiya in the water tank would soon come. At that point, the Sekimeiya had shot me quite far through time, even though I didn't know why.
entries.literal: "While that reality seemed distant, it was as close as ever. The time I'd found the Sekimeiya in the water tank would soon come. At that point, the Sekimeiya had shot me quite far through time, even though I didn't know why."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...When I go to the bathroom, I just have to stop my old self. ...That should let the Sekimeiya store even more energy, so if I touch it later, I'll go to November again. To a time before Miiya died.
entries.literal: "...When I go to the bathroom, I just have to stop my old self. ...That should let the Sekimeiya store even more energy, so if I touch it later, I'll go to November again. To a time before Miiya died."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was all I had to do. If I changed the past in just the right way, accomplishing what I'd decided was well within reach.
entries.literal: "That was all I had to do. If I changed the past in just the right way, accomplishing what I'd decided was well within reach."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And yet... I didn't know what to do.{w} Hadn't I also decided that going to the past was a mistake?
entries.literal: "And yet... I didn't know what to do.{w} Hadn't I also decided that going to the past was a mistake?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I didn't interfere, my past self would travel, and I would become myself again. I could just leave with Atsuki...
entries.literal: "If I didn't interfere, my past self would travel, and I would become myself again. I could just leave with Atsuki..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But is that even the case...? Would that really be possible?
entries.literal: "But is that even the case...? Would that really be possible?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Atsuki from this morning said that the recording was real. We won't simply leave at {time=21.}
entries.literal: "The Atsuki from this morning said that the recording was real. We won't simply leave at {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And that wasn't all. He was suspicious of me and asked if I was the real Shiroya.{w} ...Why? What happened after I went back in time?
entries.literal: "And that wasn't all. He was suspicious of me and asked if I was the real Shiroya.{w} ...Why? What happened after I went back in time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Up until then, my safety had been guaranteed because Atsuki had seen me late into the day. Beyond that point, I couldn't be confident about anything. On top of that, it was a fact that I'd never been mentioned in the recording.
entries.literal: "Up until then, my safety had been guaranteed because Atsuki had seen me late into the day. Beyond that point, I couldn't be confident about anything. On top of that, it was a fact that I'd never been mentioned in the recording."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I also recalled that I'd been seen again later, wearing the clothes from the attic. That had only been briefly mentioned, so I didn't know what it was about.
entries.literal: "I also recalled that I'd been seen again later, wearing the clothes from the attic. That had only been briefly mentioned, so I didn't know what it was about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked down. When the Sekimeiya had begun to get too hot, I'd left it on the floor.{w} It was a bit difficult to decide what to do with it.
entries.literal: "I looked down. When the Sekimeiya had begun to get too hot, I'd left it on the floor.{w} It was a bit difficult to decide what to do with it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: My intention was to leave it in that cold cabinet, but I think something's odd about that.
entries.literal: "My intention was to leave it in that cold cabinet, but I think something's odd about that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Once I leave, our past selves will go to the attic. While they're returning, the elevator will be intercepted and Sai will chase them.
entries.literal: "...Once I leave, our past selves will go to the attic. While they're returning, the elevator will be intercepted and Sai will chase them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They'll all end up in the event room, where Sai's attitude will flip. Something we didn't figure out was how he managed to not be found in hallway B when Atsuki searched through every room.
entries.literal: "They'll all end up in the event room, where Sai's attitude will flip. Something we didn't figure out was how he managed to not be found in hallway B when Atsuki searched through every room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I left the Sekimeiya in that cabinet, that would've given him a way out. He could've disappeared by touching it. That was why I'd thought that he might've been about to investigate the room and find out that a Sekimeiya was there.
entries.literal: "If I left the Sekimeiya in that cabinet, that would've given him a way out. He could've disappeared by touching it. That was why I'd thought that he might've been about to investigate the room and find out that a Sekimeiya was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At that point, another Sekimeiya was in the event room. If there are only two, the only way Sai could've disappeared from one of these rooms is with the Sekimeiya that I have now.
entries.literal: "At that point, another Sekimeiya was in the event room. If there are only two, the only way Sai could've disappeared from one of these rooms is with the Sekimeiya that I have now."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I would keep it cold, so he'd have to take it out, wait for Atsuki to investigate the other rooms, and touch it as soon as this one was about to be searched in order to get away.
entries.literal: "I would keep it cold, so he'd have to take it out, wait for Atsuki to investigate the other rooms, and touch it as soon as this one was about to be searched in order to get away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But it's not so straightforward, because according to Atsuki, he looked in every cabinet. If that's what happened, he should've seen the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "But it's not so straightforward, because according to Atsuki, he looked in every cabinet. If that's what happened, he should've seen the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it possible it teleported after Sai used it...? I'm not sure about that anymore.
entries.literal: "Is it possible it teleported after Sai used it...? I'm not sure about that anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}That was what seemed odd. Up until that point, everything I'd done that had matched with what I'd already lived through contained a purpose. The clothes, showing myself, the elevator... I hadn't repeated anything without a reason.{w} So then, what was going on? Would I leave the Sekimeiya there to give Sai a way to escape? ...Simply to avoid changing the past?
entries.literal: "...{w}That was what seemed odd. Up until that point, everything I'd done that had matched with what I'd already lived through contained a purpose. The clothes, showing myself, the elevator... I hadn't repeated anything without a reason.{w} So then, what was going on? Would I leave the Sekimeiya there to give Sai a way to escape? ...Simply to avoid changing the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was weird. Because I had realized it, I had no reason to leave the Sekimeiya in that cabinet. Even though I wanted to hide it far from me, it didn't have to be in hallway B.{w} I didn't want to leave the Sekimeiya there. Aside from the fact that it would be consistent with my experiences, it would only bring negative consequences.
entries.literal: "It was weird. Because I had realized it, I had no reason to leave the Sekimeiya in that cabinet. Even though I wanted to hide it far from me, it didn't have to be in hallway B.{w} I didn't want to leave the Sekimeiya there. Aside from the fact that it would be consistent with my experiences, it would only bring negative consequences."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But didn't that mean Sai would still manage to hide anyway? After all, I wouldn't {i}not{/i} be doing it to change the past; disregarding my own interests purely to be consistent with what I'd already experienced wasn't how everything had worked so far.{w} That was what I was curious about and what I wanted to observe from a distance. How was Sai going to escape detection?
entries.literal: "But didn't that mean Sai would still manage to hide anyway? After all, I wouldn't {i}not{/i} be doing it to change the past; disregarding my own interests purely to be consistent with what I'd already experienced wasn't how everything had worked so far.{w} That was what I was curious about and what I wanted to observe from a distance. How was Sai going to escape detection?"

entries.text: Helix
entries.literal: "Helix"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The more I thought about it, the more I believed that leaving the Sekimeiya in the cabinet wasn't the call.
entries.literal: "The more I thought about it, the more I believed that leaving the Sekimeiya in the cabinet wasn't the call."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I was sure, I looked at the door. It hadn't been properly closed, so I widened the gap without making a noise.
entries.literal: "When I was sure, I looked at the door. It hadn't been properly closed, so I widened the gap without making a noise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was as I'd thought. I could see Atsuki sleeping next to the hallway A door.
entries.literal: "...It was as I'd thought. I could see Atsuki sleeping next to the hallway A door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took one step forward.
entries.literal: "I took one step forward."

entries.speaker: i
