entries.text: Immediately, Atsuki's eyes opened. Raising his head, he stared right at me.
entries.literal: "Immediately, Atsuki's eyes opened. Raising his head, he stared right at me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned and walked down the hallway to reach the storeroom.
entries.literal: "I turned and walked down the hallway to reach the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It really had been me. At that time, I had denied it completely, but the person Atsuki saw was the same me, in a sense.
entries.literal: "It really had been me. At that time, I had denied it completely, but the person Atsuki saw was the same me, in a sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From inside the storeroom, I heard Atsuki slowly walking. He circled the floor until he was back at the event room.
entries.literal: "From inside the storeroom, I heard Atsuki slowly walking. He circled the floor until he was back at the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next, they would go to the security room to check the time before going to the attic.
entries.literal: "Next, they would go to the security room to check the time before going to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Something had just caught my eye.
entries.literal: "...Something had just caught my eye."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The green light was on the hallway's camera...
entries.literal: "The green light was on the hallway's camera..."

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: Shiroya! Are you there!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Are you there!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was ridiculous. ...I was, in fact, but I didn't want to be seen. Such a nonsensical prediction had turned out true.
entries.literal: "It was ridiculous. ...I was, in fact, but I didn't want to be seen. Such a nonsensical prediction had turned out true."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our old selves walked to the stairs to reach the attic. As soon as they were gone, I left as well.
entries.literal: "Our old selves walked to the stairs to reach the attic. As soon as they were gone, I left as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd left the Sekimeiya on the crystal room floor, as I hadn't wanted to be seen with it.
entries.literal: "I'd left the Sekimeiya on the crystal room floor, as I hadn't wanted to be seen with it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh. Don't tell me it's already gonna be gone.{w} ...Is this how Sai managed to disappear?
entries.literal: "Oh. Don't tell me it's already gonna be gone.{w} ...Is this how Sai managed to disappear?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That made a lot of sense, so I sped up. Could he have grabbed it so fast?
entries.literal: "That made a lot of sense, so I sped up. Could he have grabbed it so fast?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No. ...It's still here.
entries.literal: "No. ...It's still here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was behind the door, where I'd left it. Carefully, I picked it up.
entries.literal: "It was behind the door, where I'd left it. Carefully, I picked it up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where should I put it...?
entries.literal: "Where should I put it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thinking about it, I walked to hallway C, where a sudden sound startled me.
entries.literal: "Thinking about it, I walked to hallway C, where a sudden sound startled me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wh—
entries.literal: "Wh—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I retreated immediately.{w} ...In hallway A, I'd just seen Sai. He hadn't seen me in return, but something was very odd.{w} He'd been exiting the storeroom with a knife in his hand and was visibly shocked after looking at the stairs, where there was nothing.
entries.literal: "I retreated immediately.{w} ...In hallway A, I'd just seen Sai. He hadn't seen me in return, but something was very odd.{w} He'd been exiting the storeroom with a knife in his hand and was visibly shocked after looking at the stairs, where there was nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Slowly, I kept stepping back until I reached the lobby.
entries.literal: "Slowly, I kept stepping back until I reached the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound of his footsteps came from hallway B. Then, he started to open doors.
entries.literal: "The sound of his footsteps came from hallway B. Then, he started to open doors."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did he notice me?
entries.literal: "Did he notice me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With his free hand, he'd been touching his mouth. He was the Sai who had chased us, and he was about to intercept the elevator with us inside.
entries.literal: "With his free hand, he'd been touching his mouth. He was the Sai who had chased us, and he was about to intercept the elevator with us inside."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He's the one who said I would die. ...It's the Sai who locked me in the attic.
entries.literal: "He's the one who said I would die. ...It's the Sai who locked me in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he started getting closer, I approached hallway A.
entries.literal: "When he started getting closer, I approached hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That way, I avoided being seen as I returned to hallway C.
entries.literal: "That way, I avoided being seen as I returned to hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai appeared from the lobby and started to open doors in hallway A as well.
entries.literal: "Sai appeared from the lobby and started to open doors in hallway A as well."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell is he doing...? It seems like he's being silent on purpose.
entries.literal: "What the hell is he doing...? It seems like he's being silent on purpose."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew he'd soon go up the floors, so I circled back to hallway B.
entries.literal: "I knew he'd soon go up the floors, so I circled back to hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My heart rate was increasing. I couldn't feel safe anymore. ...Why had Sai said that I would die, and why had he chased us with a knife?
entries.literal: "My heart rate was increasing. I couldn't feel safe anymore. ...Why had Sai said that I would die, and why had he chased us with a knife?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His intentions were unfathomably enigmatic. However, I didn't think he'd declared my death because he'd already killed me. At one point, he'd stated that he'd be the one to kill me if he had to.
entries.literal: "His intentions were unfathomably enigmatic. However, I didn't think he'd declared my death because he'd already killed me. At one point, he'd stated that he'd be the one to kill me if he had to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And the knife he was holding... Where had he gotten it from? There was something to consider.
entries.literal: "And the knife he was holding... Where had he gotten it from? There was something to consider."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd seen him exiting the storeroom, but he was searching through hallway A. ...So, he'd been in the storeroom before inspecting its hallway.
entries.literal: "I'd seen him exiting the storeroom, but he was searching through hallway A. ...So, he'd been in the storeroom before inspecting its hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Could he have come from the outside door? It can't be, can it? But it would explain the knife and how he was in the storeroom right after I left it.
entries.literal: "...Could he have come from the outside door? It can't be, can it? But it would explain the knife and how he was in the storeroom right after I left it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard something behind me and quickly hid myself in the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "I heard something behind me and quickly hid myself in the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Who was that?
entries.literal: "Who was that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone had been in hallway B. When I considered it, I concluded it had to be Erina.
entries.literal: "Someone had been in hallway B. When I considered it, I concluded it had to be Erina."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I froze, wondering if she could've seen me. I still had the Sekimeiya, but I really didn't want to activate it.
entries.literal: "I froze, wondering if she could've seen me. I still had the Sekimeiya, but I really didn't want to activate it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed I hadn't been seen. I couldn't hear her, but she wasn't coming.
entries.literal: "It seemed I hadn't been seen. I couldn't hear her, but she wasn't coming."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what was happening, so I had to stay there. For a while, nothing happened at all.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what was happening, so I had to stay there. For a while, nothing happened at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That changed when someone started to get closer. The steps came from hallway C.
entries.literal: "That changed when someone started to get closer. The steps came from hallway C."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Are they coming over here? That's someone else, right?
entries.literal: "Are they coming over here? That's someone else, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound got louder until it was coming from right behind the door.{w} However, the steps kept going.
entries.literal: "The sound got louder until it was coming from right behind the door.{w} However, the steps kept going."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This way of walking... It's got to be Sai.
entries.literal: "This way of walking... It's got to be Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was he circling the floor again? He'd come from hallway C and disappeared toward the lobby side.
entries.literal: "Was he circling the floor again? He'd come from hallway C and disappeared toward the lobby side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}It didn't sound like he'd looked into all the rooms again, so I didn't understand.
entries.literal: "...{w}It didn't sound like he'd looked into all the rooms again, so I didn't understand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When the silence returned, it stayed for even longer.
entries.literal: "When the silence returned, it stayed for even longer."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did he go upstairs already?
entries.literal: "Did he go upstairs already?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What about Erina? That must've been her, but where is she now...?
entries.literal: "What about Erina? That must've been her, but where is she now...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about what would happen next in detail.
entries.literal: "I thought about what would happen next in detail."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Our past selves are in the attic, and they'll try to come back here soon. ...I guess I get how the chase started.{w} I think Sai was searching for someone while holding that knife. I don't know why, but it's very possible he wanted to find Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Our past selves are in the attic, and they'll try to come back here soon. ...I guess I get how the chase started.{w} I think Sai was searching for someone while holding that knife. I don't know why, but it's very possible he wanted to find Atsuki."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The elevator's on this floor, and Sai went up to search for Atsuki. When we called the elevator from the attic, he was on the third floor and heard it.{w} He probably figured it was empty, especially if he knew it was on the crystal floor. From his perspective, someone called it from the attic and was about to go back down.
entries.literal: "The elevator's on this floor, and Sai went up to search for Atsuki. When we called the elevator from the attic, he was on the third floor and heard it.{w} He probably figured it was empty, especially if he knew it was on the crystal floor. From his perspective, someone called it from the attic and was about to go back down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's how he intercepted us. Seconds after he heard it, he called it from the third floor, knowing someone would be inside. ...If he was looking for someone in particular, that might be why he wasn't right outside when we opened the door.
entries.literal: "That's how he intercepted us. Seconds after he heard it, he called it from the third floor, knowing someone would be inside. ...If he was looking for someone in particular, that might be why he wasn't right outside when we opened the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...How did the chase go down, though? We locked ourselves in the attic, but somehow he had another key to open it.{w} We thought we couldn't try to lock ourselves in a bedroom because he took the key, but it was still in the drawer when he and I teleported in there later.{w} But that's not all. I found out Sai had the keys to both bedrooms in his pocket, and he even frowned when he saw one was in the drawer. That must be why he didn't take it to trap us... Did he think it wouldn't be there because he'd already taken it?
entries.literal: "...How did the chase go down, though? We locked ourselves in the attic, but somehow he had another key to open it.{w} We thought we couldn't try to lock ourselves in a bedroom because he took the key, but it was still in the drawer when he and I teleported in there later.{w} But that's not all. I found out Sai had the keys to both bedrooms in his pocket, and he even frowned when he saw one was in the drawer. That must be why he didn't take it to trap us... Did he think it wouldn't be there because he'd already taken it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After trying to escape, we'll all end up in the event room.
entries.literal: "After trying to escape, we'll all end up in the event room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I should be able to stay here and leave when that happens.
entries.literal: "I should be able to stay here and leave when that happens."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to loosen up. The cleaning cart was gone, so there was room on the floor to nervously walk in circles.
entries.literal: "I tried to loosen up. The cleaning cart was gone, so there was room on the floor to nervously walk in circles."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...They should be here soon. The chase didn't go on for that long.
entries.literal: "...They should be here soon. The chase didn't go on for that long."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to attentively listen for our arrival, but my heartbeat wouldn't let me focus.
entries.literal: "I had to attentively listen for our arrival, but my heartbeat wouldn't let me focus."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was late into the day. {time=21} was close to two hours away, and I'd touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom a while before that.
entries.literal: "It was late into the day. {time=21} was close to two hours away, and I'd touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom a while before that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The most important time was approaching, and I had no idea what to do.
entries.literal: "The most important time was approaching, and I had no idea what to do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I perceived the faint, running steps I'd known would come. We were going to the event room.
entries.literal: "I perceived the faint, running steps I'd known would come. We were going to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shortly after they faded, the same sound repeated, and it quickly approached me.{w} It was Sai. He had appeared from hallway B, running into Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Shortly after they faded, the same sound repeated, and it quickly approached me.{w} It was Sai. He had appeared from hallway B, running into Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: To avoid being heard, he slowed down momentarily until he bumped against Atsuki.
entries.literal: "To avoid being heard, he slowed down momentarily until he bumped against Atsuki."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They'll... be in the event room for a while. I should be able to leave now.
entries.literal: "They'll... be in the event room for a while. I should be able to leave now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't stay there, or else Atsuki would see me. Nervously, I turned the doorknob and slowly opened the door.
entries.literal: "I couldn't stay there, or else Atsuki would see me. Nervously, I turned the doorknob and slowly opened the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The event room was open, and I could faintly hear our voices. I carefully slipped to hallway C.
entries.literal: "The event room was open, and I could faintly hear our voices. I carefully slipped to hallway C."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'll be fine here.
entries.literal: "I'll be fine here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It won't take much for Sai to run out. Is it a good idea to try to see where he went?
entries.literal: "...It won't take much for Sai to run out. Is it a good idea to try to see where he went?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "If I don't intend to change the past, it won't change." As long as that notion was correct, I could peek out from where I was, knowing I wouldn't be seen.
entries.literal: "\"If I don't intend to change the past, it won't change.\" As long as that notion was correct, I could peek out from where I was, knowing I wouldn't be seen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...He didn't have enough time to go to hallway C, did he...?
entries.literal: "...He didn't have enough time to go to hallway C, did he...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't think so, and even if he had, his reappearance still wouldn't make sense.
entries.literal: "I didn't think so, and even if he had, his reappearance still wouldn't make sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was getting too hot, urging me to drop it, but I resisted. So close to it, it was undeniable that it had been the emitter of the strange smell.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was getting too hot, urging me to drop it, but I resisted. So close to it, it was undeniable that it had been the emitter of the strange smell."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I awaited Sai's next move, I looked around me, wondering where Erina and Akaro were.
entries.literal: "While I awaited Sai's next move, I looked around me, wondering where Erina and Akaro were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Prepared to react, I stood in place. I couldn't hear us from there, but I knew I'd notice Sai's escape.
entries.literal: "Prepared to react, I stood in place. I couldn't hear us from there, but I knew I'd notice Sai's escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Then it happened. He dashed out of the event room, his swift steps reaching me.
entries.literal: "...Then it happened. He dashed out of the event room, his swift steps reaching me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As fast as I could, I looked at the hallway.
entries.literal: "As fast as I could, I looked at the hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Confused, I hid myself before Atsuki saw me. Then, I glanced at the Sekimeiya.{w} ...I still had it.
entries.literal: "Confused, I hid myself before Atsuki saw me. Then, I glanced at the Sekimeiya.{w} ...I still had it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't get it. Why was he not found?
entries.literal: "I don't get it. Why was he not found?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had sprinted straight ahead, shutting himself inside room B4, where I'd just been.{w} Could there have been a third Sekimeiya? If not, his disappearance couldn't be explained.
entries.literal: "Sai had sprinted straight ahead, shutting himself inside room B4, where I'd just been.{w} Could there have been a third Sekimeiya? If not, his disappearance couldn't be explained."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Ah, no.{w} I think I know what he did.
entries.literal: "...Ah, no.{w} I think I know what he did."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At once, I understood what had happened. Sai had merely been playing with us. He hadn't lied about that.
entries.literal: "At once, I understood what had happened. Sai had merely been playing with us. He hadn't lied about that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}It was absurd, but given his grin, I was sure it was the right answer. Something we'd told him had allowed him to pull it off.
entries.literal: "...{w}It was absurd, but given his grin, I was sure it was the right answer. Something we'd told him had allowed him to pull it off."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Where did you even get that knife!? Did you kill Katei and Erina?
entries.literal: "Where did you even get that knife!? Did you kill Katei and Erina?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...No. I haven't killed anyone.
entries.literal: "...No. I haven't killed anyone."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Listen, here's a good question for you. I've seen Katei's and Erina's corpses. If I killed them, how come there's no blood on my clothes?
entries.literal: "Listen, here's a good question for you. I've seen Katei's and Erina's corpses. If I killed them, how come there's no blood on my clothes?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We told him Erina died, but he knew the truth.{w} Before, when he was looking through the floor, he came across Erina. After that, she woke up and left the room. When I was in the cleaning room, Sai walked through the hallway again. Maybe he was drawn to the sound and saw Erina was gone.{w} In short, he knew she hadn't died and that she wasn't in that room anymore.
entries.literal: "We told him Erina died, but he knew the truth.{w} Before, when he was looking through the floor, he came across Erina. After that, she woke up and left the room. When I was in the cleaning room, Sai walked through the hallway again. Maybe he was drawn to the sound and saw Erina was gone.{w} In short, he knew she hadn't died and that she wasn't in that room anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was how he'd thought of a way to outsmart us, just like he said. He ran to that crystal room and covered himself with the curtain to make Atsuki think Erina was still beneath it. ...That was his trick.
entries.literal: "That was how he'd thought of a way to outsmart us, just like he said. He ran to that crystal room and covered himself with the curtain to make Atsuki think Erina was still beneath it. ...That was his trick."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited for Atsuki to enter the cleaning room and slowly stepped away.
entries.literal: "I waited for Atsuki to enter the cleaning room and slowly stepped away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We didn't have time to search this hallway, so I won't be found here.
entries.literal: "We didn't have time to search this hallway, so I won't be found here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I returned to the secret section of the cold storeroom. It was around the time Sai and I had traveled to the attic, so I'd soon have no understanding of what would happen below.
entries.literal: "I returned to the secret section of the cold storeroom. It was around the time Sai and I had traveled to the attic, so I'd soon have no understanding of what would happen below."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a few seconds, I looked down at the glowing gem. The strong heat around the Sekimeiya seemed to have lessened.
entries.literal: "After a few seconds, I looked down at the glowing gem. The strong heat around the Sekimeiya seemed to have lessened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did it cool down a little?{w} It's still pretty hot, so it's not like I put it in the cold cabinets. That's weird.
entries.literal: "...Did it cool down a little?{w} It's still pretty hot, so it's not like I put it in the cold cabinets. That's weird."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't matter. I knew I had to think. I had to come to a final conclusion...
entries.literal: "It didn't matter. I knew I had to think. I had to come to a final conclusion..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it was impossible. The time was rapidly approaching, and it didn't seem like I'd make a decision I wouldn't regret forever.
entries.literal: "But it was impossible. The time was rapidly approaching, and it didn't seem like I'd make a decision I wouldn't regret forever."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While the minutes kept passing, it didn't feel like they were to me. I was firmly trapped, with very little time left.
entries.literal: "While the minutes kept passing, it didn't feel like they were to me. I was firmly trapped, with very little time left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't heard our past selves in some time, so it was likely we'd already traveled.
entries.literal: "I hadn't heard our past selves in some time, so it was likely we'd already traveled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone was walking in hallway A. Since I didn't know who it was, that meant my past self wasn't there anymore.
entries.literal: "Someone was walking in hallway A. Since I didn't know who it was, that meant my past self wasn't there anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who was it? It could've been Atsuki, Erina, or Akaro. Even though Sai had escaped from the attic, I didn't think it could've been him yet unless he traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "Who was it? It could've been Atsuki, Erina, or Akaro. Even though Sai had escaped from the attic, I didn't think it could've been him yet unless he traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, identical-sounding steps passed by. They headed up the stairs.
entries.literal: "Soon, identical-sounding steps passed by. They headed up the stairs."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They just left the floor. ...I wonder if it was Atsuki.
entries.literal: "They just left the floor. ...I wonder if it was Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to leave, and that was a good time. I hadn't been able to get rid of the Sekimeiya, and I had the opportunity to leave it in the cold.
entries.literal: "I wanted to leave, and that was a good time. I hadn't been able to get rid of the Sekimeiya, and I had the opportunity to leave it in the cold."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see or hear anyone, so I stepped to the event room and slowly looked through the door.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see or hear anyone, so I stepped to the event room and slowly looked through the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was empty. Most importantly, the Sekimeiya wasn't on the floor, which meant someone had been there after our travel.
entries.literal: "It was empty. Most importantly, the Sekimeiya wasn't on the floor, which meant someone had been there after our travel."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It was probably Atsuki.
entries.literal: "...It was probably Atsuki."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to hallway B and walked to the crystal room in front.
entries.literal: "I moved to hallway B and walked to the crystal room in front."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Next to Naomi's body, the red curtain lay by itself. Without wasting time, I did what I'd planned earlier and left the Sekimeiya sealed away in the very first cabinet where we'd found it. When I closed it, a sound indicated it had locked automatically.{w} The wheel appeared damaged, but it still worked, so I was able to set the temperature to 0 °C.
entries.literal: "Next to Naomi's body, the red curtain lay by itself. Without wasting time, I did what I'd planned earlier and left the Sekimeiya sealed away in the very first cabinet where we'd found it. When I closed it, a sound indicated it had locked automatically.{w} The wheel appeared damaged, but it still worked, so I was able to set the temperature to 0 °C."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm, it might not be a good idea to go back.
entries.literal: "Hm, it might not be a good idea to go back."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Atsuki told me that he searched for me. If he comes from the stairs while I'm in the storeroom, I won't be able to leave before I'm found. ...If I'm here, I can avoid being seen by circling the hallways, like I did earlier with Sai.
entries.literal: "Atsuki told me that he searched for me. If he comes from the stairs while I'm in the storeroom, I won't be able to leave before I'm found. ...If I'm here, I can avoid being seen by circling the hallways, like I did earlier with Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized something. Up until then, there'd been reasons to avoid being seen. At the point I had reached, however, it wouldn't mean that much.
entries.literal: "I realized something. Up until then, there'd been reasons to avoid being seen. At the point I had reached, however, it wouldn't mean that much."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: My past self is in the attic, so as long as she can't see me, it shouldn't matter. ...I can be a bit calmer about that, then.
entries.literal: "My past self is in the attic, so as long as she can't see me, it shouldn't matter. ...I can be a bit calmer about that, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Technically, I was guaranteed to be seen again—it was what I'd been told.{w} Not knowing what would happen was a little nerve-wracking, but Sai had been one person to see me. There was a bit of time left until that could happen, as he'd been in the attic for a while.
entries.literal: "Technically, I was guaranteed to be seen again—it was what I'd been told.{w} Not knowing what would happen was a little nerve-wracking, but Sai had been one person to see me. There was a bit of time left until that could happen, as he'd been in the attic for a while."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Where the hell are Erina and Akaro?{w} It's been so long since anyone saw Akaro. The one who came to the bedroom wasn't the same one who left with Sai. ...I know he's here, though.
entries.literal: "...Where the hell are Erina and Akaro?{w} It's been so long since anyone saw Akaro. The one who came to the bedroom wasn't the same one who left with Sai. ...I know he's here, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited, expecting to hear someone at any point. Until then, the floor seemed deserted.
entries.literal: "I waited, expecting to hear someone at any point. Until then, the floor seemed deserted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was minutes later when I turned to the lobby. I felt like I'd heard someone there.
entries.literal: "It was minutes later when I turned to the lobby. I felt like I'd heard someone there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is there anyone there? I expected them to come from the stairs.
entries.literal: "Is there anyone there? I expected them to come from the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seconds passed, and I hadn't heard anything else.
entries.literal: "Seconds passed, and I hadn't heard anything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I could've been mistaken, so I slowly stepped to the door.
entries.literal: "...I could've been mistaken, so I slowly stepped to the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...No one.
entries.literal: "...No one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had I imagined it...? I entered, drawn once again by the blood ahead. Without a doubt, it was where the bigger pool had been earlier.
entries.literal: "Had I imagined it...? I entered, drawn once again by the blood ahead. Without a doubt, it was where the bigger pool had been earlier."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...!{w} I didn't imagine it this time. There's someone in hallway A.
entries.literal: "...!{w} I didn't imagine it this time. There's someone in hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I retreated slowly.
entries.literal: "I retreated slowly."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait. There's someone in hallway B as well...!
entries.literal: "Wait. There's someone in hallway B as well...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I doubted what to do as I approached the mechanical room.
entries.literal: "I doubted what to do as I approached the mechanical room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I see. This is why I'll be seen. I can't enter either hallway, so as soon as someone comes here, they'll find me. It'll probably happen even if I go down.
entries.literal: "...I see. This is why I'll be seen. I can't enter either hallway, so as soon as someone comes here, they'll find me. It'll probably happen even if I go down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}My only move was to wait. When I thought about it, I realized that being found wasn't so bad.
entries.literal: "...{w}My only move was to wait. When I thought about it, I realized that being found wasn't so bad."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As long as Atsuki was one of the people I'd heard, I could stop worrying about my well-being. If I was with him until my past self left the attic, I knew Sai and Akaro wouldn't be a threat because Atsuki hadn't said that something had happened to me.
entries.literal: "As long as Atsuki was one of the people I'd heard, I could stop worrying about my well-being. If I was with him until my past self left the attic, I knew Sai and Akaro wouldn't be a threat because Atsuki hadn't said that something had happened to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But what would I tell him...? No matter how much I wanted to talk to him, what could I possibly say...?
entries.literal: "But what would I tell him...? No matter how much I wanted to talk to him, what could I possibly say...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Atsuki from this morning... where is he?{w} Will I ever find him again? ...He was a future version of the Atsuki here, but how will everything lead into what happened? How will he end up at the beginning of this day?
entries.literal: "The Atsuki from this morning... where is he?{w} Will I ever find him again? ...He was a future version of the Atsuki here, but how will everything lead into what happened? How will he end up at the beginning of this day?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After my past self traveled to November, could I stay with Atsuki? Even though it was possible the exit wouldn't open, could I just stay with him? According to him, a Shiroya who wasn't the "real Shiroya" would appear. ...Was it possible for me to change reality in a way so that wouldn't occur...?
entries.literal: "After my past self traveled to November, could I stay with Atsuki? Even though it was possible the exit wouldn't open, could I just stay with him? According to him, a Shiroya who wasn't the \"real Shiroya\" would appear. ...Was it possible for me to change reality in a way so that wouldn't occur...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...The end was very uncertain, even more than the first time I'd gone through it. I didn't know what would happen, what I would do, or what I could do.
entries.literal: "...The end was very uncertain, even more than the first time I'd gone through it. I didn't know what would happen, what I would do, or what I could do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}It didn't seem like anything was happening. I'd been expecting either door to open, but a few still minutes had already passed.
entries.literal: "...{w}It didn't seem like anything was happening. I'd been expecting either door to open, but a few still minutes had already passed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I know I didn't imagine it. There was someone in both hallways. I guess it's just a matter of time since I know for a fact I'll be seen.
entries.literal: "I know I didn't imagine it. There was someone in both hallways. I guess it's just a matter of time since I know for a fact I'll be seen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...{w} could it be that I have already been seen? What if I didn't know about it, but it already happened?
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} could it be that I have already been seen? What if I didn't know about it, but it already happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't seem likely that I'd just be ignored, but I had no way to know. No matter what, there was nothing else I could do but stay in place.
entries.literal: "It didn't seem likely that I'd just be ignored, but I had no way to know. No matter what, there was nothing else I could do but stay in place."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...roya!{w=0.7} Hey!{w=0.5} Wher— ...you!?

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wh—{w} Atsuki?
entries.literal: "Wh—{w} Atsuki?"

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: Shiroya! Can you hear me!?
entries.literal: "Shiroya! Can you hear me!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What's happening...?
entries.literal: "What's happening...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Like a sharp needle, Atsuki's voice pierced into my chest. The pain in those words wasn't one I'd heard before.
entries.literal: "Like a sharp needle, Atsuki's voice pierced into my chest. The pain in those words wasn't one I'd heard before."

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: You're okay, right!? If you can hear me, please come out! Say something!
entries.literal: "You're okay, right!? If you can hear me, please come out! Say something!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the sudden manner they'd started, the shouts faded with a wail. Then, in their place came a shrill cry.
entries.literal: "In the sudden manner they'd started, the shouts faded with a wail. Then, in their place came a shrill cry."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki was sobbing like a broken person.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was sobbing like a broken person."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With a trembling hand, I grabbed the knob.
entries.literal: "With a trembling hand, I grabbed the knob."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I pulled the door open, I saw Atsuki on the floor. He wasn't just crying—he was shaking. He was a wreck.
entries.literal: "As I pulled the door open, I saw Atsuki on the floor. He wasn't just crying—he was shaking. He was a wreck."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: H-Hey...
entries.literal: "H-Hey..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...My hoarse voice didn't reach him.{w} Gently, and trying not to stagger, I took a step forward.
entries.literal: "...My hoarse voice didn't reach him.{w} Gently, and trying not to stagger, I took a step forward."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he saw me, he gathered himself enough to stop shaking and warily stood up.
entries.literal: "When he saw me, he gathered himself enough to stop shaking and warily stood up."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Are you actually Shiroya?
entries.literal: "...Are you actually Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I didn't know what to say. When his eyes pierced into mine, any words I could have prepared flew out of my mind.
entries.literal: "...{w}I didn't know what to say. When his eyes pierced into mine, any words I could have prepared flew out of my mind."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-Where were you? What's with those clothes?{w} Are you the same person who disappeared with Sai?
entries.literal: "Wh-Where were you? What's with those clothes?{w} Are you the same person who disappeared with Sai?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The same person...? I'm not. Not in the sense he means.
entries.literal: "The same person...? I'm not. Not in the sense he means."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It felt like my voice was stuck in my throat, and my thoughts were all over the place. ...Had that exact conversation always happened while I'd been in the attic?
entries.literal: "It felt like my voice was stuck in my throat, and my thoughts were all over the place. ...Had that exact conversation always happened while I'd been in the attic?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I-I'm sorry... I'm very confused too. ...I-I guess so, though.
entries.literal: "I-I'm sorry... I'm very confused too. ...I-I guess so, though."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You guess so?{w} What do you mean? You remember everything, right?
entries.literal: "You guess so?{w} What do you mean? You remember everything, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Right now...
entries.literal: "Right now..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped myself. From hallway C, a figure approached.
entries.literal: "I stopped myself. From hallway C, a figure approached."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes?
entries.literal: "Yes?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was Erina. The look in her eyes and her way of walking had cut me off.{w} When Atsuki turned around, he hardly reacted, so I was unsure if he already knew what had happened to her.
entries.literal: "...It was Erina. The look in her eyes and her way of walking had cut me off.{w} When Atsuki turned around, he hardly reacted, so I was unsure if he already knew what had happened to her."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm glad to see you two are safe. I was a bit worried...{w} Wh-What's with those clothes? You weren't wearing them earlier, were you...?
entries.literal: "I'm glad to see you two are safe. I was a bit worried...{w} Wh-What's with those clothes? You weren't wearing them earlier, were you...?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Who the hell are you? Or even you... How can you two exist!?
entries.literal: "Who the hell are you? Or even you... How can you two exist!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the Erina we'd assumed was dead. Her clothes were stained with blood, and she appeared to be groggy.
entries.literal: "It was the Erina we'd assumed was dead. Her clothes were stained with blood, and she appeared to be groggy."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Where were you? How did you just appear out of nowhere!?
entries.literal: "Where were you? How did you just appear out of nowhere!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In response to that, Erina slowly knitted her brow.
entries.literal: "In response to that, Erina slowly knitted her brow."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What do you not understand? Did you just pop into existence at some point?
entries.literal: "What do you not understand? Did you just pop into existence at some point?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No... Why do you think that?
entries.literal: "No... Why do you think that?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Have you looked at that room? Your body is there.
entries.literal: "Have you looked at that room? Your body is there."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...? That one? It... can't be.
entries.literal: "What...? That one? It... can't be."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I knew you were lying. I-I can't be here, of course not...
entries.literal: "I knew you were lying. I-I can't be here, of course not..."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Shiroya, what the hell is happening? Answer my other questions. How can you exist when it shouldn't be possible? Did the same thing happen to Erina?
entries.literal: "...Shiroya, what the hell is happening? Answer my other questions. How can you exist when it shouldn't be possible? Did the same thing happen to Erina?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: To Erina? She should be dead, right?
entries.literal: "To Erina? She should be dead, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped to the door. Of course, Erina's body was no longer there.
entries.literal: "I stepped to the door. Of course, Erina's body was no longer there."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: About Erina, I think what happened isn't what you think.
entries.literal: "About Erina, I think what happened isn't what you think."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's probably right. I can't think of anything anymore.
entries.literal: "That's probably right. I can't think of anything anymore."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Under those stained clothes, there's no wound, right?
entries.literal: "...Under those stained clothes, there's no wound, right?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: There never was one. The body you think disappeared is her.
entries.literal: "There never was one. The body you think disappeared is her."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you mean that she never died?
entries.literal: "Do you mean that she never died?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded. When we found Erina, the shock of Katei's death was still affecting us. We hadn't checked to confirm her death because we hadn't even doubted it.
entries.literal: "I nodded. When we found Erina, the shock of Katei's death was still affecting us. We hadn't checked to confirm her death because we hadn't even doubted it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: A-Are you serious...?{w} Were you playing dead, then? Or just unconscious? It doesn't look like you feel very well.
entries.literal: "A-Are you serious...?{w} Were you playing dead, then? Or just unconscious? It doesn't look like you feel very well."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I'm not sure... I remember I was drawn to this room, and then I think I blacked out.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure... I remember I was drawn to this room, and then I think I blacked out."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Drawn? By a noise?
entries.literal: "Drawn? By a noise?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: N-No... Something stronger, but I'm not sure what, exactly. I don't know whose blood this is, but since I woke up, I've felt... groggy and numb.
entries.literal: "N-No... Something stronger, but I'm not sure what, exactly. I don't know whose blood this is, but since I woke up, I've felt... groggy and numb."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I... see.
entries.literal: "I... see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea what that was about. I'd been in the room when she had appeared, but I hadn't sensed anything like that.
entries.literal: "I had no idea what that was about. I'd been in the room when she had appeared, but I hadn't sensed anything like that."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Shiroya, do you remember finding her body as well? And you realized what really happened? ...You still haven't explained what you're doing here. Are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?
entries.literal: "Shiroya, do you remember finding her body as well? And you realized what really happened? ...You still haven't explained what you're doing here. Are you the same Shiroya who disappeared from the event room with Sai?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I wish I could explain everything to you, but I still don't really know what happened.{w} But, yes. I'm really glad to see you again.
entries.literal: "...I wish I could explain everything to you, but I still don't really know what happened.{w} But, yes. I'm really glad to see you again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I smiled and felt a wave of relief. It didn't matter that I didn't know why I was there again—those words had been the most sincere of my life.
entries.literal: "I smiled and felt a wave of relief. It didn't matter that I didn't know why I was there again—those words had been the most sincere of my life."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What's with those clothes, then? Why is the cross not on them? Why did you ignore me when we saw each other in the event room and when I kept shouting your name?
entries.literal: "Wh-What's with those clothes, then? Why is the cross not on them? Why did you ignore me when we saw each other in the event room and when I kept shouting your name?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Well, I—
entries.literal: "...Well, I—"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Hey... I'm still confused, but I have a question.
entries.literal: "Hey... I'm still confused, but I have a question."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The Sekimeiya... does it really make you travel through time?{w} How does it work?
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya... does it really make you travel through time?{w} How does it work?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: If I understand it... touching it with your skin activates it, right? And you can go far into the past if it's out of the cabinet for a while.
entries.literal: "If I understand it... touching it with your skin activates it, right? And you can go far into the past if it's out of the cabinet for a while."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's... what I've been working under, yes.
entries.literal: "That's... what I've been working under, yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He looked at me in case I had an objection. Even after everything that had happened, that still should've been correct, so I nodded uncertainly.
entries.literal: "He looked at me in case I had an objection. Even after everything that had happened, that still should've been correct, so I nodded uncertainly."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I was thinking. Why don't I just go back in time to save Isla?
entries.literal: "I was thinking. Why don't I just go back in time to save Isla?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki and I looked at each other, and I wondered about her proposition. What would happen if Erina changed the past? What would happen to the world and to us?
entries.literal: "Atsuki and I looked at each other, and I wondered about her proposition. What would happen if Erina changed the past? What would happen to the world and to us?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I don't know why I didn't think of it earlier. Someone killed her a few hours ago, so I just have to go to that time and prevent it.
entries.literal: "I don't know why I didn't think of it earlier. Someone killed her a few hours ago, so I just have to go to that time and prevent it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Saving Isla was something I could do. It should've been possible, given what I knew.
entries.literal: "Saving Isla was something I could do. It should've been possible, given what I knew."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: But I couldn't find the Sekimeiya. I kept looking at Isla's face for a very long time, and she told me that she could be saved. Then, I saw a girl, and after that I heard you shouting.
entries.literal: "But I couldn't find the Sekimeiya. I kept looking at Isla's face for a very long time, and she told me that she could be saved. Then, I saw a girl, and after that I heard you shouting."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...A girl? You saw Shiroya?
entries.literal: "...A girl? You saw Shiroya?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Um...{w} I guess it couldn't have been anyone else.{w} ...It must have been Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Um...{w} I guess it couldn't have been anyone else.{w} ...It must have been Shiroya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, she did? I wonder if she's talking about the time before she fell unconscious, when I was in the crystal room with her.
entries.literal: "Oh, she did? I wonder if she's talking about the time before she fell unconscious, when I was in the crystal room with her."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I also saw what happened to Katei... It looked horrible. Did someone do that?
entries.literal: "I also saw what happened to Katei... It looked horrible. Did someone do that?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...It couldn't have been an accident.{w} But anyway, the Sekimeiya's not in the event room.
entries.literal: "...It couldn't have been an accident.{w} But anyway, the Sekimeiya's not in the event room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Are you sure...?{w} Do you know where it could be? I really need to find it.
entries.literal: "Are you sure...?{w} Do you know where it could be? I really need to find it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No. I suspect Sai or Akaro must've taken it.
entries.literal: "No. I suspect Sai or Akaro must've taken it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew where one was, but I couldn't bring myself to say it. Once again, the decision of whether to change the past had to be made, and I couldn't do it.
entries.literal: "I knew where one was, but I couldn't bring myself to say it. Once again, the decision of whether to change the past had to be made, and I couldn't do it."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...{w}Are you lying?
entries.literal: "...{w}Are you lying?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What? No, I'm not.
entries.literal: "What? No, I'm not."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Is he not? Who has the Sekimeiya Sai and I traveled with?{w} ...If he does, I understand why he'd lie. Right now, he believes the past can't be changed.
entries.literal: "...{w}Is he not? Who has the Sekimeiya Sai and I traveled with?{w} ...If he does, I understand why he'd lie. Right now, he believes the past can't be changed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Actually, that's right. He changed his mind on that before I got out of the attic. He said he'd changed the past.
entries.literal: "Actually, that's right. He changed his mind on that before I got out of the attic. He said he'd changed the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned. ...What exactly was going to happen?
entries.literal: "I frowned. ...What exactly was going to happen?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: The way you two reacted. You don't want me to save Isla, do you?
entries.literal: "The way you two reacted. You don't want me to save Isla, do you?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: That's not it at all... Remember that Sai and Akaro took the cabinet key. They probably have the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "That's not it at all... Remember that Sai and Akaro took the cabinet key. They probably have the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed Erina was seeing through us. Discontent, she walked to the event room.
entries.literal: "It seemed Erina was seeing through us. Discontent, she walked to the event room."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I-I knew it! You were lying...
entries.literal: "I-I knew it! You were lying..."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You didn't want me to look at the cabinet!
entries.literal: "You didn't want me to look at the cabinet!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya's here... Did Atsuki leave it in the cabinet? I don't think he would have.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya's here... Did Atsuki leave it in the cabinet? I don't think he would have."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at him. As I'd thought, he was visibly confused—the Sekimeiya shouldn't have been there.
entries.literal: "I looked at him. As I'd thought, he was visibly confused—the Sekimeiya shouldn't have been there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, not wanting to touch it for the time being. Following that, she immediately let the curtain fall back down.
entries.literal: "Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, not wanting to touch it for the time being. Following that, she immediately let the curtain fall back down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a long silence, the hallway A door opened. When we looked over, someone was stepping into the room.
entries.literal: "After a long silence, the hallway A door opened. When we looked over, someone was stepping into the room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Uh...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Sai. He had already escaped from the attic.
entries.literal: "It was Sai. He had already escaped from the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's up?
entries.literal: "What's up?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...What the fuck are you even doing here? Did you succeed with that plan of yours?
entries.literal: "...What the fuck are you even doing here? Did you succeed with that plan of yours?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh, not quite, unfortunately. I thought Erina was dead. What's she doing with the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Oh, not quite, unfortunately. I thought Erina was dead. What's she doing with the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You thought that too? No. I'm going to go to the past to save Isla.
entries.literal: "You thought that too? No. I'm going to go to the past to save Isla."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh. I doubt that. The past can't be changed.
entries.literal: "Huh. I doubt that. The past can't be changed."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: That's nonsense! I'm going to the past, so I'll prevent Isla from dying. You've used the Sekimeiya before, right? How long do I need to wait to go enough hours back?
entries.literal: "That's nonsense! I'm going to the past, so I'll prevent Isla from dying. You've used the Sekimeiya before, right? How long do I need to wait to go enough hours back?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Um... It should be about fifteen minutes, but I still find it unlikely you'll change anything.
entries.literal: "Um... It should be about fifteen minutes, but I still find it unlikely you'll change anything."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Sai... where the fuck did you go? Were you in the attic?{w} Do you know where Shiroya went? I saw her disappear with you.
entries.literal: "Sai... where the fuck did you go? Were you in the attic?{w} Do you know where Shiroya went? I saw her disappear with you."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isn't she next to you? What's with those clothes, anyway? Aren't they from there?
entries.literal: "Isn't she next to you? What's with those clothes, anyway? Aren't they from there?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...They are.
entries.literal: "...They are."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I see, they're definitely an improvement for you.{w} And just ignore me, Atsuki. I was busy sorting something out.
entries.literal: "I see, they're definitely an improvement for you.{w} And just ignore me, Atsuki. I was busy sorting something out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Sorting something out". I couldn't help but react, as I knew he had just locked my past self in the attic.
entries.literal: "\"Sorting something out\". I couldn't help but react, as I knew he had just locked my past self in the attic."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh, right, I'd forgotten about this too.
entries.literal: "Oh, right, I'd forgotten about this too."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I found this just now. I tried to read it, but my head hurt a lot. Do you know what it is?
entries.literal: "I found this just now. I tried to read it, but my head hurt a lot. Do you know what it is?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, Erina took out a piece of paper from her purse and handed it to Atsuki. I saw some black letters on it, but I didn't recognize what it was.{w} Immediately, he stashed it in his pocket.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, Erina took out a piece of paper from her purse and handed it to Atsuki. I saw some black letters on it, but I didn't recognize what it was.{w} Immediately, he stashed it in his pocket."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: H-Hey... What was that?
entries.literal: "H-Hey... What was that?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Don't mind me, like you said.
entries.literal: "Don't mind me, like you said."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You look pretty nervous. I saw something written there.{w} You were pretty in control of things when you pulled off that trick with the key earlier, so why is this getting you all worked up? Do you wanna hide it that badly?
entries.literal: "You look pretty nervous. I saw something written there.{w} You were pretty in control of things when you pulled off that trick with the key earlier, so why is this getting you all worked up? Do you wanna hide it that badly?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}It's just a personal paper. It has nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...{w}It's just a personal paper. It has nothing to do with you or the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Very intriguing, then.
entries.literal: "Very intriguing, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...A personal paper? I didn't think I'd seen it before.{w} When I glanced at him, he immediately looked away, leaving me a little surprised.
entries.literal: "...A personal paper? I didn't think I'd seen it before.{w} When I glanced at him, he immediately looked away, leaving me a little surprised."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: So, did any of you see Miiya...?
entries.literal: "So, did any of you see Miiya...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wh...

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Who?
entries.literal: "Who?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: You don't know her, right? I... I knew I wasn't going insane.
entries.literal: "You don't know her, right? I... I knew I wasn't going insane."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: H-How do you know that name?
entries.literal: "H-How do you know that name?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She's the person I was with earlier, before I saw you two... It just came back to me. I don't know where she went, though.
entries.literal: "She's the person I was with earlier, before I saw you two... It just came back to me. I don't know where she went, though."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...? What just happened?
entries.literal: "What...? What just happened?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's not possible. How could she have seen Miiya!?
entries.literal: "That's not possible. How could she have seen Miiya!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What's with that reaction? Don't you see she's just delirious?{w} She didn't die, but I have a pretty good idea of what happened to her. Say, did you hallucinate someone?
entries.literal: "What's with that reaction? Don't you see she's just delirious?{w} She didn't die, but I have a pretty good idea of what happened to her. Say, did you hallucinate someone?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's not it. That's not just some name she made up.
entries.literal: "That's not it. That's not just some name she made up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you know this person, then?
entries.literal: "Do you know this person, then?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...We do, but Erina couldn't have seen her. She couldn't be here.
entries.literal: "...We do, but Erina couldn't have seen her. She couldn't be here."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you sure? She could've entered through the storeroom. She could've even traveled from the future since the Sekimeiya's bound to be exposed to the outside world.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? She could've entered through the storeroom. She could've even traveled from the future since the Sekimeiya's bound to be exposed to the outside world."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: That's not what she means... She's not anywhere right now.
entries.literal: "That's not what she means... She's not anywhere right now."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Oh? Is she dead?{w} ...Wait, Miiya, you said...?
entries.literal: "Oh? Is she dead?{w} ...Wait, Miiya, you said...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was the biggest blow I'd been dealt in a long time. I'd grown to think I partially understood what had happened, but a few words were enough to shatter everything.{w} What did it mean? Could it have been another prediction from the world? Had my own decision been handed to me, confirming that I would save Miiya?{w} There was no way—that didn't make sense. If I'd changed the past, many more things would've differed as well.
entries.literal: "That was the biggest blow I'd been dealt in a long time. I'd grown to think I partially understood what had happened, but a few words were enough to shatter everything.{w} What did it mean? Could it have been another prediction from the world? Had my own decision been handed to me, confirming that I would save Miiya?{w} There was no way—that didn't make sense. If I'd changed the past, many more things would've differed as well."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...No. She's with us. She has red hair, right?
entries.literal: "...No. She's with us. She has red hair, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Did you actually see her? What did she say?
entries.literal: "...Did you actually see her? What did she say?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: She told me her name, but she didn't look lost or anything. She knew me, too...{w} She just suddenly ran away, and I haven't seen her again. I definitely thought I hadn't seen her before, but I honestly wasn't sure.
entries.literal: "She told me her name, but she didn't look lost or anything. She knew me, too...{w} She just suddenly ran away, and I haven't seen her again. I definitely thought I hadn't seen her before, but I honestly wasn't sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}There was no way to make sense of what she was saying. It seemed the structure of the world had been warped beyond comprehension.
entries.literal: "...{w}There was no way to make sense of what she was saying. It seemed the structure of the world had been warped beyond comprehension."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't know how to interpret this. Did you all agree to make up this story for when I appeared?
entries.literal: "I don't know how to interpret this. Did you all agree to make up this story for when I appeared?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Shut up.
entries.literal: "Shut up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, I'm trying to figure things out myself and I thought I was close to understanding quite a bit, but now there's a bunch of shit I don't get, and it doesn't feel great.
entries.literal: "Well, I'm trying to figure things out myself and I thought I was close to understanding quite a bit, but now there's a bunch of shit I don't get, and it doesn't feel great."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You did mean she died, right? Is saving her with the Sekimeiya not an option?
entries.literal: "You did mean she died, right? Is saving her with the Sekimeiya not an option?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Sai, shut the fuck up. If it was, I promise you that we would've done it.
entries.literal: "Sai, shut the fuck up. If it was, I promise you that we would've done it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was Atsuki right? I didn't know anymore—I'd never known. Saving Miiya alongside everyone else was supposed to be possible, because traveling days to the past could soon occur. How did that tie into what Erina said, though? There was no longer anything that made sense.
entries.literal: "Was Atsuki right? I didn't know anymore—I'd never known. Saving Miiya alongside everyone else was supposed to be possible, because traveling days to the past could soon occur. How did that tie into what Erina said, though? There was no longer anything that made sense."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: It's probably been close to fifteen minutes already, right?
entries.literal: "It's probably been close to fifteen minutes already, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'd say so. Yes, it's been almost fifteen minutes since I arrived.
entries.literal: "I'd say so. Yes, it's been almost fifteen minutes since I arrived."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Are you sure I'll go far enough back?
entries.literal: "Are you sure I'll go far enough back?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: She died at around {time=14}, right? It should be enough, yes.
entries.literal: "She died at around {time=14}, right? It should be enough, yes."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Okay. I'm going, then. Are all of you coming with me?
entries.literal: "...Okay. I'm going, then. Are all of you coming with me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Don't worry, we're far enough from you.
entries.literal: "Don't worry, we're far enough from you."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I understand. Well... goodbye for now.
entries.literal: "I understand. Well... goodbye for now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai had kept lying to Erina, claiming fifteen minutes was long enough to go hours back. However, I couldn't be entirely sure that was impossible.{w} As she got her hand closer to her purse, the three of us stepped back. Given what we knew about the range, we were outside of it.
entries.literal: "Sai had kept lying to Erina, claiming fifteen minutes was long enough to go hours back. However, I couldn't be entirely sure that was impossible.{w} As she got her hand closer to her purse, the three of us stepped back. Given what we knew about the range, we were outside of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I was concerned. Were we highly mistaken about how the range worked? I didn't stop retreating until Erina's hand contacted the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "But I was concerned. Were we highly mistaken about how the range worked? I didn't stop retreating until Erina's hand contacted the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And when it did, something I hadn't even imagined occurred.
entries.literal: "And when it did, something I hadn't even imagined occurred."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was the only person to disappear.
entries.literal: "Sai was the only person to disappear."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Wait... what?
entries.literal: "Wait... what?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was speechless. Erina had touched the Sekimeiya, and we'd been farther away than Sai. It didn't make any sense why he was the only one to vanish.
entries.literal: "I was speechless. Erina had touched the Sekimeiya, and we'd been farther away than Sai. It didn't make any sense why he was the only one to vanish."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Why didn't it work!? Did Sai disappear?{w} Was everything that he said a lie...?
entries.literal: "Why didn't it work!? Did Sai disappear?{w} Was everything that he said a lie...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was almost laughable. We'd always been so far from the truth.
entries.literal: "It was almost laughable. We'd always been so far from the truth."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Admit it... Did you ever want me to save Isla? Were you... Were you involved in the first place!?
entries.literal: "Admit it... Did you ever want me to save Isla? Were you... Were you involved in the first place!?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You're wrong. We don't know how the Sekimeiya works, but this shouldn't have happened...
entries.literal: "You're wrong. We don't know how the Sekimeiya works, but this shouldn't have happened..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No matter what I thought, it didn't make sense. I couldn't even come up with a baseless explanation.
entries.literal: "No matter what I thought, it didn't make sense. I couldn't even come up with a baseless explanation."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Wait! Where did it go!?{w} It's not here!
entries.literal: "...Wait! Where did it go!?{w} It's not here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina's wide eyes were fixed on her purse. ...It was empty.
entries.literal: "Erina's wide eyes were fixed on her purse. ...It was empty."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, what...?{w} The Sekimeiya disappeared?
entries.literal: "Wait, what...?{w} The Sekimeiya disappeared?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: It... teleported.
entries.literal: "It... teleported."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perplexed, Atsuki walked to the cabinet. When he raised the curtain, we saw the Sekimeiya sitting comfortably behind the glass.
entries.literal: "Perplexed, Atsuki walked to the cabinet. When he raised the curtain, we saw the Sekimeiya sitting comfortably behind the glass."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did it... teleport to the cabinet? This has to be what Atsuki talked about.
entries.literal: "Did it... teleport to the cabinet? This has to be what Atsuki talked about."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Atsuki, tell me... What do I need to do to travel through time?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, tell me... What do I need to do to travel through time?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Exactly what Sai and I told you. I don't know why it didn't work just now.
entries.literal: "Exactly what Sai and I told you. I don't know why it didn't work just now."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No... That's not it.
entries.literal: "No... That's not it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya didn't teleport. ...That's wrong.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya didn't teleport. ...That's wrong."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought back on what had just happened.
entries.literal: "I thought back on what had just happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, not wanting to touch it for the time being. Following that, she immediately let the curtain fall back down."
entries.literal: "\"Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, not wanting to touch it for the time being. Following that, she immediately let the curtain fall back down.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Perplexed, Atsuki walked to the cabinet. When he raised the curtain, we saw the Sekimeiya sitting comfortably behind the glass."
entries.literal: "\"Perplexed, Atsuki walked to the cabinet. When he raised the curtain, we saw the Sekimeiya sitting comfortably behind the glass.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She didn't close the glass before lowering the curtain, but it's closed right now anyway. ...The Sekimeiya didn't teleport.
entries.literal: "She didn't close the glass before lowering the curtain, but it's closed right now anyway. ...The Sekimeiya didn't teleport."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the floor, and my heart skipped a beat. There was no drop of blood.
entries.literal: "I looked at the floor, and my heart skipped a beat. There was no drop of blood."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, the reason why only Sai disappeared...
entries.literal: "Then, the reason why only Sai disappeared..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Can I... not save Isla? Why did it not work...?{w} Oh, of course.{w} What was I even thinking? Traveling to the past isn't possible.{w} You lied about it since the beginning, right? That's why it didn't work: it can't happen. I actually fell for it.
entries.literal: "Can I... not save Isla? Why did it not work...?{w} Oh, of course.{w} What was I even thinking? Traveling to the past isn't possible.{w} You lied about it since the beginning, right? That's why it didn't work: it can't happen. I actually fell for it."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Just wait here. I'll be back in a second.
entries.literal: "Just wait here. I'll be back in a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before we could react, Atsuki went to hallway B. I left Erina behind and saw him entering the staff room.
entries.literal: "Before we could react, Atsuki went to hallway B. I left Erina behind and saw him entering the staff room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, was I right? ...But I don't get it. The Sekimeiya shouldn't have been in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Oh, was I right? ...But I don't get it. The Sekimeiya shouldn't have been in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He promptly came back out.
entries.literal: "He promptly came back out."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Did it disappear?
entries.literal: "...Did it disappear?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. So it is as I thought.
entries.literal: "I see. So it is as I thought."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh-What did you want to do?
entries.literal: "Wh-What did you want to do?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Oh, I'm just wondering about Sai's whereabouts because an extra version of him has existed somewhere in the past.
entries.literal: "Oh, I'm just wondering about Sai's whereabouts because an extra version of him has existed somewhere in the past."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did we never see him in so many hours?
entries.literal: "Did we never see him in so many hours?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...I'm not sure, but he has to be somewhere.
entries.literal: "...I'm not sure, but he has to be somewhere."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There you are. What were you doing?
entries.literal: "There you are. What were you doing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai appeared from the lobby.
entries.literal: "Sai appeared from the lobby."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh...? What the fuck?
entries.literal: "Wh...? What the fuck?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On his face, there was only shock. I saw it very well, as his eyes were boring a hole through me.
entries.literal: "On his face, there was only shock. I saw it very well, as his eyes were boring a hole through me."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...!{w} Wh-Who the fuck are you? How are you here?
entries.literal: "...!{w} Wh-Who the fuck are you? How are you here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I recovered from hearing that, someone came from the event room.
entries.literal: "Before I recovered from hearing that, someone came from the event room."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Whoa! What's this girl doing here!?
entries.literal: "Whoa! What's this girl doing here!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Akaro, and I understood. It was the time when Atsuki had seen him again; it wasn't happening for the first time.
entries.literal: "It was Akaro, and I understood. It was the time when Atsuki had seen him again; it wasn't happening for the first time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki! Now you have to answer! Who is she?
entries.literal: "Atsuki! Now you have to answer! Who is she?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Are you actually acting as if you don't recognize me?
entries.literal: "...Are you actually acting as if you don't recognize me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course we don't!
entries.literal: "Of course we don't!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well... No.{w} Of course we do.{w} Aren't you... dead?
entries.literal: "Well... No.{w} Of course we do.{w} Aren't you... dead?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Dead? ...When did I die? Did it happen again?
entries.literal: "Dead? ...When did I die? Did it happen again?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: M-Me...? Why would I be dead?
entries.literal: "M-Me...? Why would I be dead?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And you too, Erina! I thought you'd died!
entries.literal: "And you too, Erina! I thought you'd died!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh...? Isn't that what you said earlier?
entries.literal: "Wh...? Isn't that what you said earlier?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Earlier? What the hell are you talking about?
entries.literal: "Earlier? What the hell are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...There was no question. That Sai wasn't the same person we'd just been with.
entries.literal: "...There was no question. That Sai wasn't the same person we'd just been with."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Sai, what time is it?
entries.literal: "Sai, what time is it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Uh...{w} it's {time=18:43.}

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Why? Did you time travel?
entries.literal: "Why? Did you time travel?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: N-No. I didn't.
entries.literal: "N-No. I didn't."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: He's right, though. Are you a future version of Erina or something?
entries.literal: "He's right, though. Are you a future version of Erina or something?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: ak
