entries.text: Well, you're not dead after all, but we felt your pulse... In any case, I figured you would've come from the future. What even happened to you?
entries.literal: "Well, you're not dead after all, but we felt your pulse... In any case, I figured you would've come from the future. What even happened to you?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Um... I can't remember much. I think someone hit my head, and I fell unconscious. I don't know what happened before that.
entries.literal: "Um... I can't remember much. I think someone hit my head, and I fell unconscious. I don't know what happened before that."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yeah, that's about what we knew too. Sorry that we can't be of more use.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that's about what we knew too. Sorry that we can't be of more use."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I don't get it either, but I'm glad you're safe. This means you're not guaranteed to end up dead, but you... What even is your name? How did you get here?
entries.literal: "I don't get it either, but I'm glad you're safe. This means you're not guaranteed to end up dead, but you... What even is your name? How did you get here?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I've been here since the start.
entries.literal: "...I've been here since the start."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's not true.
entries.literal: "That's not true."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What? How could that possibly not be true?
entries.literal: "...What? How could that possibly not be true?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hold on, though... Your name... I think I might actually remember that.{w} Shi... roya, was it? My memories are a little foggy.
entries.literal: "Hold on, though... Your name... I think I might actually remember that.{w} Shi... roya, was it? My memories are a little foggy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded, puzzled.
entries.literal: "I nodded, puzzled."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I thought so. Like I said... I thought you'd died.
entries.literal: "I thought so. Like I said... I thought you'd died."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: As you can see, I'm alive.
entries.literal: "As you can see, I'm alive."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Do you have a twin, by any chance?
entries.literal: "Do you have a twin, by any chance?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What? No.
entries.literal: "What? No."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: But, then... It doesn't make any sense. I'm still really confused...
entries.literal: "But, then... It doesn't make any sense. I'm still really confused..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck do you mean you're "confused"!? She just showed up like that! Did you enter through the storeroom?
entries.literal: "What the fuck do you mean you're \"confused\"!? She just showed up like that! Did you enter through the storeroom?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I've been with you since {time=9}, Sai.
entries.literal: "I've been with you since {time=9}, Sai."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's a load of crap. Regardless, you'll definitely die. I'm sorry to tell you like that, but you're not making it easy for us. Atsuki, I know you know her.
entries.literal: "That's a load of crap. Regardless, you'll definitely die. I'm sorry to tell you like that, but you're not making it easy for us. Atsuki, I know you know her."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I'm going to die? That's not true. It has to be another false fate, spawned the same way as the other.
entries.literal: "...I'm going to die? That's not true. It has to be another false fate, spawned the same way as the other."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}I do, and she's telling the truth.
entries.literal: "...{w}I do, and she's telling the truth."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you just fucking with me? What's the point of lying so blatantly?
entries.literal: "Are you just fucking with me? What's the point of lying so blatantly?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: He's... He's telling the truth. Shiroya's been with us the entire time.
entries.literal: "He's... He's telling the truth. Shiroya's been with us the entire time."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The entire time? Not even you have been here since {time=9}!
entries.literal: "The entire time? Not even you have been here since {time=9}!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: E-Excuse me?
entries.literal: "E-Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, you get what I mean. You don't remember when you got attacked or where you came from very well, right?{w} Of course, Erina and Isla have been here the whole time, but not you.
entries.literal: "Well, you get what I mean. You don't remember when you got attacked or where you came from very well, right?{w} Of course, Erina and Isla have been here the whole time, but not you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya had disappeared as soon as Erina touched it. In the storeroom, the same thing had happened to me.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya had disappeared as soon as Erina touched it. In the storeroom, the same thing had happened to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around, wondering where I was.
entries.literal: "I looked around, wondering where I was."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The camera...
entries.literal: "The camera..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Above the door to the lobby, a camera focused its lens on us. Unlike all the others, no smoke was on its smooth surface.
entries.literal: "Above the door to the lobby, a camera focused its lens on us. Unlike all the others, no smoke was on its smooth surface."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And the green light isn't there.{w} It's... that world. The one from this morning.
entries.literal: "And the green light isn't there.{w} It's... that world. The one from this morning."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Did you notice something?
entries.literal: "...Did you notice something?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, that Atsuki... Is he here? When Naomi touched the Sekimeiya, I'm sure he stayed behind.
entries.literal: "Then, that Atsuki... Is he here? When Naomi touched the Sekimeiya, I'm sure he stayed behind."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}I... need to go somewhere.
entries.literal: "...{w}I... need to go somewhere."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm sorry, I need to go to the attic.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry, I need to go to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before he could say anything, I took off for hallway C.
entries.literal: "Before he could say anything, I took off for hallway C."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Please, don't follow me.
entries.literal: "Please, don't follow me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a reason I had to do that.
entries.literal: "There was a reason I had to do that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Atsuki from that morning... It was very possible he was somewhere, and I really wanted to find him again.
entries.literal: "The Atsuki from that morning... It was very possible he was somewhere, and I really wanted to find him again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The attic had been where we'd parted, but I had to go alone. He was a future version of the Atsuki I'd just been with.
entries.literal: "The attic had been where we'd parted, but I had to go alone. He was a future version of the Atsuki I'd just been with."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd concluded that two versions of the same person could never interact with each other because it was a real paradox devoid of origin. ...And paradoxes were impossibilities. If Atsuki came with me, it would guarantee I'd never find his future self. In the world we were in, it was very possible the door to the attic had been open, how we'd left it.
entries.literal: "I'd concluded that two versions of the same person could never interact with each other because it was a real paradox devoid of origin. ...And paradoxes were impossibilities. If Atsuki came with me, it would guarantee I'd never find his future self. In the world we were in, it was very possible the door to the attic had been open, how we'd left it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Going by myself, I could find him. He was the future version of the Atsuki I'd just been with.{w} I'd just told him I was going there, so if his future self was in that world, I knew he would be waiting.
entries.literal: "Going by myself, I could find him. He was the future version of the Atsuki I'd just been with.{w} I'd just told him I was going there, so if his future self was in that world, I knew he would be waiting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And it would let me verify my conclusion—that there was no past self of mine locked in a bedroom.
entries.literal: "And it would let me verify my conclusion—that there was no past self of mine locked in a bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I confirmed I wasn't being followed, I exhaled in relief. I tried to open the elevator, but it wasn't there.
entries.literal: "When I confirmed I wasn't being followed, I exhaled in relief. I tried to open the elevator, but it wasn't there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I should use it. If he's on another floor, he'll at least hear me.
entries.literal: "...I should use it. If he's on another floor, he'll at least hear me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pressed the button and waited for the elevator.
entries.literal: "I pressed the button and waited for the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once it had come, I stepped inside. The "7" button wasn't available, but I still had the key to the attic.{w} After getting it out of my purse, I enabled the button and pressed it to start ascending.
entries.literal: "Once it had come, I stepped inside. The \"7\" button wasn't available, but I still had the key to the attic.{w} After getting it out of my purse, I enabled the button and pressed it to start ascending."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the way, my anticipation compounded, my heartbeat meshed with the slight friction of the ropes above.
entries.literal: "On the way, my anticipation compounded, my heartbeat meshed with the slight friction of the ropes above."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Upon arriving, I slowly opened the door, revealing an empty hallway.
entries.literal: "Upon arriving, I slowly opened the door, revealing an empty hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped out and walked to the turn. As soon as I looked ahead, it was settled: my past self wasn't there, and both bedrooms were open.
entries.literal: "I stepped out and walked to the turn. As soon as I looked ahead, it was settled: my past self wasn't there, and both bedrooms were open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But where was Atsuki? It didn't seem like anyone was there.
entries.literal: "...But where was Atsuki? It didn't seem like anyone was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I headed to the living room and looked at the floor.
entries.literal: "I headed to the living room and looked at the floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: These footprints... They're very recent.
entries.literal: "These footprints... They're very recent."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, a sound came from the stairs. Fixing my eyes on the door, I noticed it was approaching.
entries.literal: "Then, a sound came from the stairs. Fixing my eyes on the door, I noticed it was approaching."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And finally, it opened.{w} The person behind it... Were they the one I wanted to see?
entries.literal: "And finally, it opened.{w} The person behind it... Were they the one I wanted to see?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: There you are... You did come.{w} I'd forgotten you had the key to the attic.
entries.literal: "There you are... You did come.{w} I'd forgotten you had the key to the attic."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Are you... the Atsuki from this morning?
entries.literal: "Are you... the Atsuki from this morning?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Yeah. I'm glad I wasn't wrong.
entries.literal: "Yeah. I'm glad I wasn't wrong."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Y-You knew I would be here, right? You remembered what happened.
entries.literal: "Y-You knew I would be here, right? You remembered what happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He nodded.{w} That was it. I'd finally found him. We just had to stay together from that point on.
entries.literal: "He nodded.{w} That was it. I'd finally found him. We just had to stay together from that point on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What had happened after I'd traveled didn't matter anymore. As long as I stayed with Atsuki, we would be together at {time=21}, which he had lived through once already.
entries.literal: "What had happened after I'd traveled didn't matter anymore. As long as I stayed with Atsuki, we would be together at {time=21}, which he had lived through once already."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was so relieved, and he looked the same. However, there was something else on his face. ...I felt it was exhaustion.
entries.literal: "I was so relieved, and he looked the same. However, there was something else on his face. ...I felt it was exhaustion."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Have you been here all this time? When you disappeared this morning, I tried to find you, but I was in another world, right?
entries.literal: "Have you been here all this time? When you disappeared this morning, I tried to find you, but I was in another world, right?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I... think so. I learned a lot of things. It's been longer than you think since I saw you.
entries.literal: "I... think so. I learned a lot of things. It's been longer than you think since I saw you."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What do you mean? You said the recording was real, right? What happened at {time=21}? And why did both of us appear at the start of today?
entries.literal: "What do you mean? You said the recording was real, right? What happened at {time=21}? And why did both of us appear at the start of today?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...Why did we travel to this morning?{w} I know the answer now.
entries.literal: "...Why did we travel to this morning?{w} I know the answer now."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I remember what you told me. You said you traveled to the 30th of November, and that a few days later, you touched the Sekimeiya in the tower. Is that right?
entries.literal: "I remember what you told me. You said you traveled to the 30th of November, and that a few days later, you touched the Sekimeiya in the tower. Is that right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Y-Yes. That's when I appeared with you in the lobby.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes. That's when I appeared with you in the lobby."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: No, that's wrong. I know what happened to you.
entries.literal: "No, that's wrong. I know what happened to you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For a moment, I was lost. What did that mean? ...What had happened to me?
entries.literal: "For a moment, I was lost. What did that mean? ...What had happened to me?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: You didn't go to November... You went to the future.
entries.literal: "You didn't go to November... You went to the future."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Wh-What? No I didn't. I went two weeks to the past.
entries.literal: "...Wh-What? No I didn't. I went two weeks to the past."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I don't know why you think that, but I believe you went to the future.{w} You said that you entered the tower in early December. I believe that was the 5th of January instead.
entries.literal: "I don't know why you think that, but I believe you went to the future.{w} You said that you entered the tower in early December. I believe that was the 5th of January instead."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: The 5th of January? That doesn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "The 5th of January? That doesn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't... make any sense. ...Did it?{w} The days I'd spent in my apartment. That had been in December, hadn't it?
entries.literal: "It didn't... make any sense. ...Did it?{w} The days I'd spent in my apartment. That had been in December, hadn't it?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Like I said, the recording was real. On the 5th of January, we were in the tower. That's why I appeared with you in the lobby when you touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Like I said, the recording was real. On the 5th of January, we were in the tower. That's why I appeared with you in the lobby when you touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: N-No. No. How would I have gone to the future? There's no way.
entries.literal: "N-No. No. How would I have gone to the future? There's no way."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: With the Sekimeiya. There were two of them.
entries.literal: "With the Sekimeiya. There were two of them."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I... know. I saw that too. What do you mean, though?
entries.literal: "I... know. I saw that too. What do you mean, though?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I've thought about everything that happened. There always were two Sekimeiya, but only one of them made us go to the past. The other one made us go to the future instead.
entries.literal: "I've thought about everything that happened. There always were two Sekimeiya, but only one of them made us go to the past. The other one made us go to the future instead."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: The one in the water tank sent you to the future, but that wasn't the first time. ...It wasn't the first time you'd traveled forward in time. There were others.
entries.literal: "The one in the water tank sent you to the future, but that wasn't the first time. ...It wasn't the first time you'd traveled forward in time. There were others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was at a loss for words. That couldn't be the truth; it didn't make sense.{w} But... if it had happened before...{w} Earlier, when our past selves had traveled to the attic... I'd pressed the elevator button two times, and only one of them could've caused the sound we'd heard. If we'd appeared in the future instead, that solved it.{w} We'd immediately thought we'd traveled just a few minutes to the past because the handle in the bedroom had been reattached and our footprints were still visible in the living room, but that would've been the case a few minutes into the future too. Was that really possible, though? Wouldn't we have noticed a ton of contradictions?
entries.literal: "I was at a loss for words. That couldn't be the truth; it didn't make sense.{w} But... if it had happened before...{w} Earlier, when our past selves had traveled to the attic... I'd pressed the elevator button two times, and only one of them could've caused the sound we'd heard. If we'd appeared in the future instead, that solved it.{w} We'd immediately thought we'd traveled just a few minutes to the past because the handle in the bedroom had been reattached and our footprints were still visible in the living room, but that would've been the case a few minutes into the future too. Was that really possible, though? Wouldn't we have noticed a ton of contradictions?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This will have no impact whatsoever, so answer as you see fit. Where did Shiroya travel?
entries.literal: "This will have no impact whatsoever, so answer as you see fit. Where did Shiroya travel?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So you read a story where Shiroya had traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "So you read a story where Shiroya had traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In reality, she did travel to the future, and just like you, she never realized it.
entries.literal: "In reality, she did travel to the future, and just like you, she never realized it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, everything around her pointed at the truth that she failed to notice. She felt free after so long, which prevented her from realizing that she was still trapped.
entries.literal: "However, everything around her pointed at the truth that she failed to notice. She felt free after so long, which prevented her from realizing that she was still trapped."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was due to her narrow field of view. Just like her, depending on the way things were looked at, you would've been told an entirely different story.
entries.literal: "That was due to her narrow field of view. Just like her, depending on the way things were looked at, you would've been told an entirely different story."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But there's no shame in that. Both of them are just as valid.
entries.literal: "But there's no shame in that. Both of them are just as valid."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Every mystery has been accompanied by the key to unlock it. Shiroya went to the future. That's why the days of the week didn't match December, when the 15th was a Thursday.{w} That's why it wasn't snowing when she stepped out of the drainage channel. That's why, as soon as she got home, she heard fireworks celebrating the new year.
entries.literal: "Every mystery has been accompanied by the key to unlock it. Shiroya went to the future. That's why the days of the week didn't match December, when the 15th was a Thursday.{w} That's why it wasn't snowing when she stepped out of the drainage channel. That's why, as soon as she got home, she heard fireworks celebrating the new year."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But one time, Darfee told her she could drink alcohol. Given her birthday, that meant she was already twenty years old and legally allowed to drink.
entries.literal: "But one time, Darfee told her she could drink alcohol. Given her birthday, that meant she was already twenty years old and legally allowed to drink."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There have been countless keys, but some of them have been much smaller than you might think. However, know they're there and hunt for them. The time where your success will be measured will come, and now it is very close.
entries.literal: "There have been countless keys, but some of them have been much smaller than you might think. However, know they're there and hunt for them. The time where your success will be measured will come, and now it is very close."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So you read a story where Shiroya had traveled to the future.
entries.literal: "So you read a story where Shiroya had traveled to the future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was the truth. Everything around her pointed to it, yet she failed to notice it. She felt free after so long, which prevented her from realizing that she was still trapped.

entries.text: {cps=80}In the living room,{w=0.4} Shiroya thought to herself.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}In the living room,{w=0.4} Shiroya thought to herself.{nw}"

entries.text: {cps=80}Everything she'd experienced...{w=0.4} How could it have happened in January?{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}Everything she'd experienced...{w=0.4} How could it have happened in January?{nw}"

entries.text: {cps=80}It seemed impossible at first,{w=0.3} but she soon realized it wasn't.{w=0.7} Even if that was the case, {w=0.2}though,{w=0.2} there were many questions to answer.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}It seemed impossible at first,{w=0.3} but she soon realized it wasn't.{w=0.7} Even if that was the case, {w=0.2}though,{w=0.2} there were many questions to answer.{nw}"

entries.text: {cps=80}...So...{w=0.4} what now?{w=0.7} What will happen at {time=21}?{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}...So...{w=0.4} what now?{w=0.7} What will happen at {time=21}?{nw}"

entries.text: {cps=80}It'll be fine.{w=0.4} We'll be able to leave.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}It'll be fine.{w=0.4} We'll be able to leave.{nw}"

entries.text: {cps=80}Finally,{w=0.3} Shiroya breathed a sigh of relief,{w=0.4} but it was cut short by words she didn't expect.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}Finally,{w=0.3} Shiroya breathed a sigh of relief,{w=0.4} but it was cut short by words she didn't expect.{nw}"

entries.text: {cps=80}This isn't over yet,{w=0.2} though.{w=0.5} We have to do one more thing.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}This isn't over yet,{w=0.2} though.{w=0.5} We have to do one more thing.{nw}"

entries.text: {cps=80}Shiroya peered at him,{w=0.4} wondering just what he meant.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}Shiroya peered at him,{w=0.4} wondering just what he meant.{nw}"

entries.text: {cps=80}...{w=0.1}W{w=0.1}e{w=0.8} are going to save Miiya.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}...{w=0.1}W{w=0.1}e{w=0.8} are going to save Miiya.{nw}"

entries.text: That wasn't the end for them.
entries.literal: "That wasn't the end for them."

entries.text: But only the final step was left.
entries.literal: "But only the final step was left."

entries.text: How could that goal be achieved?
entries.literal: "How could that goal be achieved?"

entries.text: Shiroya wondered that as she awaited Atsuki's next words.
entries.literal: "Shiroya wondered that as she awaited Atsuki's next words."

entries.text: Miiya, who had been seen in the tower... How would she be saved?

entries.text: But a way to save Miiya had always meant her own death.
entries.literal: "But a way to save Miiya had always meant her own death."

entries.speaker: c3s

entries.text: {cps=80}It'll be fine.{w=0.4} We'll be able to leave.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}It'll be fine.{w=0.4} We'll be able to leave.{nw}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: {cps=80}Finally,{w=0.3} Shiroya breathed a sigh of relief,{w=0.4} but it was cut short by words she didn't expect.{nw}
entries.literal: "{cps=80}Finally,{w=0.3} Shiroya breathed a sigh of relief,{w=0.4} but it was cut short by words she didn't expect.{nw}"

entries.speaker: c2a

entries.literal: "{cps=80}This isn't over yet,{w=0.2} though.{w=0.5} We have to do one more thing.{nw}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: {cps=80}Shiroya peered at him,{w=0.4} wondering just what he meant.{nw}

entries.text: Failure
entries.literal: "Failure"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the attic, Atsuki sobbed on top of a bed. He'd seen Shiroya's dead body. She had been killed, next to Naomi.
entries.literal: "In the attic, Atsuki sobbed on top of a bed. He'd seen Shiroya's dead body. She had been killed, next to Naomi."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki couldn't believe the world had suddenly taken such a turn. Shiroya couldn't have possibly died mere days after Miiya. He had been hopeful the previous night—it was absurd for him to think that he was in reality.
entries.literal: "Atsuki couldn't believe the world had suddenly taken such a turn. Shiroya couldn't have possibly died mere days after Miiya. He had been hopeful the previous night—it was absurd for him to think that he was in reality."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But his tears conveyed what he already knew. He would never speak to Shiroya again.
entries.literal: "But his tears conveyed what he already knew. He would never speak to Shiroya again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had run up the floors after seeing the body. The attic should've been locked, but that hadn't been the case. After failing to find who he'd been searching for, Atsuki had collapsed onto the bed.
entries.literal: "He had run up the floors after seeing the body. The attic should've been locked, but that hadn't been the case. After failing to find who he'd been searching for, Atsuki had collapsed onto the bed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Meanwhile, the tower... was almost empty. Only one other person was in the building with Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, the tower... was almost empty. Only one other person was in the building with Atsuki."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That person was Sai.
entries.literal: "That person was Sai."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Puzzled, he stepped into hallway B. ...What had just happened?{w} Out of nowhere, the Sekimeiya had disappeared.
entries.literal: "Puzzled, he stepped into hallway B. ...What had just happened?{w} Out of nowhere, the Sekimeiya had disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He wondered if he'd traveled through time. Even though he hadn't touched the Sekimeiya, something peculiar had occurred.
entries.literal: "He wondered if he'd traveled through time. Even though he hadn't touched the Sekimeiya, something peculiar had occurred."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he looked around him, his confusion intensified. Naomi wasn't in the bathroom.
entries.literal: "When he looked around him, his confusion intensified. Naomi wasn't in the bathroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he saw the bloody corpse next to the stairs. Erina had died. Going off of the blood, it seemed she'd hit her head on the stairs and tumbled down.
entries.literal: "Then, he saw the bloody corpse next to the stairs. Erina had died. Going off of the blood, it seemed she'd hit her head on the stairs and tumbled down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai saw something else. There was no longer a green light on the security cameras. Did that mean they weren't recording?{w} Without a doubt, he wasn't where he'd been a minute ago.
entries.literal: "Sai saw something else. There was no longer a green light on the security cameras. Did that mean they weren't recording?{w} Without a doubt, he wasn't where he'd been a minute ago."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai had recently learned valuable information regarding the Sekimeiya; he was confident he knew more than everyone else. However, he had no clue what had just happened.
entries.literal: "Sai had recently learned valuable information regarding the Sekimeiya; he was confident he knew more than everyone else. However, he had no clue what had just happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He took his time looking through the crystal floor. Someone might've been there, and perhaps the Sekimeiya as well.
entries.literal: "He took his time looking through the crystal floor. Someone might've been there, and perhaps the Sekimeiya as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stared into a crystal room. It was where they'd found Naomi's first corpse, but she had also vanished from there, and the velvet curtain, which had been laid on top of her, was attached to its original cabinet.
entries.literal: "He stared into a crystal room. It was where they'd found Naomi's first corpse, but she had also vanished from there, and the velvet curtain, which had been laid on top of her, was attached to its original cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Deep in thought, Sai walked to room A5, where Isla had died. Lifting up the cabinet's lid, he verified her body was gone as well.
entries.literal: "Deep in thought, Sai walked to room A5, where Isla had died. Lifting up the cabinet's lid, he verified her body was gone as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he looked at the lobby, he was met with Shiroya's immobile body. Next to her was a puddle of blood, and her eyes showed that no life remained within them.{w} Shiroya had been killed... By who, though? ...Sai didn't find anything important among her belongings.
entries.literal: "When he looked at the lobby, he was met with Shiroya's immobile body. Next to her was a puddle of blood, and her eyes showed that no life remained within them.{w} Shiroya had been killed... By who, though? ...Sai didn't find anything important among her belongings."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Again, he wondered. Where was he...? The corpses he knew of had vanished, while Shiroya and Erina, who should've been in the attic, had been killed.{w} What did the silence mean? Where was Atsuki and everyone else...? His wristwatch wouldn't help him figure any of that out, so he headed to the security room.
entries.literal: "Again, he wondered. Where was he...? The corpses he knew of had vanished, while Shiroya and Erina, who should've been in the attic, had been killed.{w} What did the silence mean? Where was Atsuki and everyone else...? His wristwatch wouldn't help him figure any of that out, so he headed to the security room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But the door was locked.
entries.literal: "But the door was locked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Had Katei locked it? That seemed strange.{w} Sai wanted to know the time. The bodies vanishing indicated that he was in the past, but the truth couldn't have been so simple.{w} The future, perhaps? Had the earlier crimes been covered up? ...Sai wasn't sure what to think.
entries.literal: "Had Katei locked it? That seemed strange.{w} Sai wanted to know the time. The bodies vanishing indicated that he was in the past, but the truth couldn't have been so simple.{w} The future, perhaps? Had the earlier crimes been covered up? ...Sai wasn't sure what to think."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he looked at the elevator, frowning in consternation. The button was gone...{w} Nonetheless, when he tried to open the door, it budged.
entries.literal: "Then, he looked at the elevator, frowning in consternation. The button was gone...{w} Nonetheless, when he tried to open the door, it budged."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Inside it was blood and a pile of metallic panels.
entries.literal: "Inside it was blood and a pile of metallic panels."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was a long time later when Sai stepped into the attic. He hadn't found anyone else, and only the last floor remained. He immediately noticed that the suitcase was gone from the sofa.
entries.literal: "It was a long time later when Sai stepped into the attic. He hadn't found anyone else, and only the last floor remained. He immediately noticed that the suitcase was gone from the sofa."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But Atsuki's sobs began to reach his ears. His cries came in broken bursts, muffled by the pillow.
entries.literal: "But Atsuki's sobs began to reach his ears. His cries came in broken bursts, muffled by the pillow."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...What are you doing?
entries.literal: "...What are you doing?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai noticed that one of the bed sheets was gone. When Atsuki heard him, his head immediately turned and he saw him approaching through his bleary vision.{w} Then, Atsuki's fist flew. If Sai hadn't reacted fast enough, the blow would've broken his jaw.
entries.literal: "Sai noticed that one of the bed sheets was gone. When Atsuki heard him, his head immediately turned and he saw him approaching through his bleary vision.{w} Then, Atsuki's fist flew. If Sai hadn't reacted fast enough, the blow would've broken his jaw."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Wh-What the fuck!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What the fuck!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai felt his tongue. It was bleeding.
entries.literal: "Sai felt his tongue. It was bleeding."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before he could process it, Atsuki struck again. When Sai saw Atsuki's fist had barely missed its full impact, he realized it could've easily just killed him.{w} ...After all, from Atsuki's perspective, Sai had to be the murderer.
entries.literal: "Before he could process it, Atsuki struck again. When Sai saw Atsuki's fist had barely missed its full impact, he realized it could've easily just killed him.{w} ...After all, from Atsuki's perspective, Sai had to be the murderer."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone had stayed in a crystal room, and Sai had been the first to leave. Only Naomi should've been outside, but she had been one of the victims.{w} Then, Erina had left, and she had been killed as well. Lastly, after Shiroya's departure, she'd instantly been met with the same fate.{w} It was only Sai who could've done that; the one still alive, who had willingly not returned.
entries.literal: "Everyone had stayed in a crystal room, and Sai had been the first to leave. Only Naomi should've been outside, but she had been one of the victims.{w} Then, Erina had left, and she had been killed as well. Lastly, after Shiroya's departure, she'd instantly been met with the same fate.{w} It was only Sai who could've done that; the one still alive, who had willingly not returned."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, Atsuki wasn't aware of where he was. He wasn't aware of what the Sekimeiya truly were, as he had never witnessed their powers.
entries.literal: "However, Atsuki wasn't aware of where he was. He wasn't aware of what the Sekimeiya truly were, as he had never witnessed their powers."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Atsuki's third strike came, it was immediately returned. In Sai's hand was a knife that slashed Atsuki's shirt.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki's third strike came, it was immediately returned. In Sai's hand was a knife that slashed Atsuki's shirt."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That confirmed it to him: Sai was the killer. He had just tried to make Atsuki his fourth victim.
entries.literal: "That confirmed it to him: Sai was the killer. He had just tried to make Atsuki his fourth victim."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He felt a chill up his spine. He couldn't die there, not after Shiroya's death, but he wasn't a match against Sai's knife.{w} Before he could swing again, Atsuki ran out of the room.
entries.literal: "He felt a chill up his spine. He couldn't die there, not after Shiroya's death, but he wasn't a match against Sai's knife.{w} Before he could swing again, Atsuki ran out of the room."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: You're not gonna fucking run away!
entries.literal: "You're not gonna fucking run away!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai wouldn't let him go—not after he'd tried to kill him out of nowhere. On top of that, he was aware of a few things.{w} Nobody else was in the tower. Murders had occurred. The cameras didn't seem to be working. He had a knife.{w} ...He had been handed the perfect circumstances to finally know what killing a person was like.
entries.literal: "Sai wouldn't let him go—not after he'd tried to kill him out of nowhere. On top of that, he was aware of a few things.{w} Nobody else was in the tower. Murders had occurred. The cameras didn't seem to be working. He had a knife.{w} ...He had been handed the perfect circumstances to finally know what killing a person was like."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he'd cut his shirt, Sai had discerned fear within Atsuki's eyes. He had run away, but there weren't many places where he could hide.{w} Sai had enjoyed Atsuki's presence in the tower, and he was poised to enjoy it even more. Thanks to the knife he had, he could hunt him down.
entries.literal: "When he'd cut his shirt, Sai had discerned fear within Atsuki's eyes. He had run away, but there weren't many places where he could hide.{w} Sai had enjoyed Atsuki's presence in the tower, and he was poised to enjoy it even more. Thanks to the knife he had, he could hunt him down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And at the same time, he felt enraged. Atsuki had almost killed him; he'd almost suffered a sudden, clueless, and pathetic death.{w} His confusion toward the world was gone. In the blink of an eye, Sai's thoughts had shifted drastically.
entries.literal: "And at the same time, he felt enraged. Atsuki had almost killed him; he'd almost suffered a sudden, clueless, and pathetic death.{w} His confusion toward the world was gone. In the blink of an eye, Sai's thoughts had shifted drastically."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He grabbed the key to the bedroom. Strangely, it wasn't where he'd left it, but in its original drawer.
entries.literal: "He grabbed the key to the bedroom. Strangely, it wasn't where he'd left it, but in its original drawer."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he grabbed the one in the other bedroom and removed its chain with a screwdriver. With that, Atsuki had very few places to hide.
entries.literal: "Then, he grabbed the one in the other bedroom and removed its chain with a screwdriver. With that, Atsuki had very few places to hide."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The key to the attic had been in the door, and Sai had grabbed it. That meant Atsuki couldn't lock himself inside. The two remaining options Sai could think of were the security room and a bathroom, which could both be bypassed with Katei's keys.
entries.literal: "The key to the attic had been in the door, and Sai had grabbed it. That meant Atsuki couldn't lock himself inside. The two remaining options Sai could think of were the security room and a bathroom, which could both be bypassed with Katei's keys."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He began to search for him, aware that Atsuki could attack first.{w} In the living room, he saw footprints running out, yet he cautiously looked through the whole floor to confirm Atsuki wasn't still there.
entries.literal: "He began to search for him, aware that Atsuki could attack first.{w} In the living room, he saw footprints running out, yet he cautiously looked through the whole floor to confirm Atsuki wasn't still there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Coming out of the partitions, Sai stared at both bathrooms. He noticed only one of them was closed.
entries.literal: "Coming out of the partitions, Sai stared at both bathrooms. He noticed only one of them was closed."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I see, so you're here.
entries.literal: "I see, so you're here."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Atsuki, open the door.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, open the door."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Atsuki!{w} I bet you want to know what happened to Shiroya. Open, you stupid moron!
entries.literal: "Atsuki!{w} I bet you want to know what happened to Shiroya. Open, you stupid moron!"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...Oh, I see.{w} You're not answering...{w} because you're already dead.
entries.literal: "...Oh, I see.{w} You're not answering...{w} because you're already dead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai grinned. In the storeroom on the crystal floor, he had found both Sekimeiya.{w} He'd had a reason to hide one while leaving the other there, but what mattered was that he had access to both.{w} That bathroom was where Atsuki had hidden. If Sai went to the past, he could wait for him inside. Hence, on the other side of the door, Atsuki must've already been dead, and a future version of Sai must've been waiting for his past self to leave.
entries.literal: "Sai grinned. In the storeroom on the crystal floor, he had found both Sekimeiya.{w} He'd had a reason to hide one while leaving the other there, but what mattered was that he had access to both.{w} That bathroom was where Atsuki had hidden. If Sai went to the past, he could wait for him inside. Hence, on the other side of the door, Atsuki must've already been dead, and a future version of Sai must've been waiting for his past self to leave."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Briskly, Sai ran all the way down. He didn't know which of the two Sekimeiya to activate, but it didn't matter.
entries.literal: "Briskly, Sai ran all the way down. He didn't know which of the two Sekimeiya to activate, but it didn't matter."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Behind the storeroom's wall, Sai hurried to the glowing gemstone, knowing it had been there a long time.
entries.literal: "Behind the storeroom's wall, Sai hurried to the glowing gemstone, knowing it had been there a long time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had been in the bathroom on floor 6 since Sai had gone down. He had no idea how much time had passed, but the silence hadn't wavered once.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had been in the bathroom on floor 6 since Sai had gone down. He had no idea how much time had passed, but the silence hadn't wavered once."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How long had it been...? Perhaps two hours.{w} No matter the time, for Atsuki, it had felt like a still instant; Atsuki's mind had been consumed by the persistent image of Shiroya's corpse.
entries.literal: "How long had it been...? Perhaps two hours.{w} No matter the time, for Atsuki, it had felt like a still instant; Atsuki's mind had been consumed by the persistent image of Shiroya's corpse."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Why had Sai not come back? Had he killed everyone else...?{w} Atsuki was incapable of shedding more tears. He'd been in the tower almost the entire day, and he didn't know if the exit would ever unlock.
entries.literal: "...Why had Sai not come back? Had he killed everyone else...?{w} Atsuki was incapable of shedding more tears. He'd been in the tower almost the entire day, and he didn't know if the exit would ever unlock."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He wanted to leave the bathroom. Putting a firm end to Sai—that desire spurred him onward.
entries.literal: "He wanted to leave the bathroom. Putting a firm end to Sai—that desire spurred him onward."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What if the police couldn't prove what he'd done? Exploring that thought for a second almost broke Atsuki.
entries.literal: "What if the police couldn't prove what he'd done? Exploring that thought for a second almost broke Atsuki."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had to find Sai before the police... but he was wielding a knife, and Atsuki didn't know where he was.
entries.literal: "He had to find Sai before the police... but he was wielding a knife, and Atsuki didn't know where he was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Finally, Atsuki was able to reach the doorknob. He didn't think he had decided, but he couldn't stay there anymore.
entries.literal: "...Finally, Atsuki was able to reach the doorknob. He didn't think he had decided, but he couldn't stay there anymore."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai hadn't been waiting for him outside. The floor was as desolate as it had sounded.
entries.literal: "Sai hadn't been waiting for him outside. The floor was as desolate as it had sounded."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had heard him going down the stairs hours before. The red around his eyes had mostly faded, and they were otherwise empty. Slowly, he descended to the fifth floor.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had heard him going down the stairs hours before. The red around his eyes had mostly faded, and they were otherwise empty. Slowly, he descended to the fifth floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But the Sai he was searching for wasn't there. He wasn't anywhere in that building.
entries.literal: "But the Sai he was searching for wasn't there. He wasn't anywhere in that building."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he arrived at the lowest floor, he was drawn to the open storeroom beyond Erina's lifeless body. There, he learned of its secret.
entries.literal: "When he arrived at the lowest floor, he was drawn to the open storeroom beyond Erina's lifeless body. There, he learned of its secret."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The movable wall was open, showing the way to the hidden corridor. Behind it, a strange light came from the floor.
entries.literal: "The movable wall was open, showing the way to the hidden corridor. Behind it, a strange light came from the floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki didn't react, but he crouched beside it.
entries.literal: "Atsuki didn't react, but he crouched beside it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he placed his finger on it, he retracted it immediately. He'd been burned, and before he could be surprised, the lights went out. Both the faint glow and the room's; the movable wall had closed.
entries.literal: "When he placed his finger on it, he retracted it immediately. He'd been burned, and before he could be surprised, the lights went out. Both the faint glow and the room's; the movable wall had closed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Astonished, Atsuki looked back. The wall was in place, and where there'd been a soft glow before, there was nothing.
entries.literal: "Astonished, Atsuki looked back. The wall was in place, and where there'd been a soft glow before, there was nothing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stood up and walked into the darkness. Immediately, he encountered a door that he couldn't open: its handle was missing.
entries.literal: "He stood up and walked into the darkness. Immediately, he encountered a door that he couldn't open: its handle was missing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stepped back to the wall that had closed. It didn't seem to have a handle either, and he couldn't get it to open.{w} For an instant, Atsuki thought he'd been trapped, but he soon felt the area that allowed him to open the hidden wall.
entries.literal: "He stepped back to the wall that had closed. It didn't seem to have a handle either, and he couldn't get it to open.{w} For an instant, Atsuki thought he'd been trapped, but he soon felt the area that allowed him to open the hidden wall."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the hallway, Atsuki stared at the stairs in fright.{w} What was happening to him? Erina had just been there, hadn't she? Yet she no longer was, and the sea of blood there had been reduced to a single droplet.
entries.literal: "In the hallway, Atsuki stared at the stairs in fright.{w} What was happening to him? Erina had just been there, hadn't she? Yet she no longer was, and the sea of blood there had been reduced to a single droplet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he looked at the other side, the sensation persisted. The event room had been open before he'd entered the storeroom, but it wasn't anymore.
entries.literal: "When he looked at the other side, the sensation persisted. The event room had been open before he'd entered the storeroom, but it wasn't anymore."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody was in it, but the same glow lay on the floor near the cabinet. That was when Atsuki understood what it had been: the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Nobody was in it, but the same glow lay on the floor near the cabinet. That was when Atsuki understood what it had been: the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As he crouched next to it, he shivered slightly at both the temperature of the room and how odd everything was. Could the Sekimeiya really have disappeared when he'd touched it? And why had he been burned? He still felt it on his finger.
entries.literal: "As he crouched next to it, he shivered slightly at both the temperature of the room and how odd everything was. Could the Sekimeiya really have disappeared when he'd touched it? And why had he been burned? He still felt it on his finger."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Carefully, he reached out to it with his left hand.{w} Again, as soon as he contacted it, the gemstone disappeared and he felt a painful burn.
entries.literal: "Carefully, he reached out to it with his left hand.{w} Again, as soon as he contacted it, the gemstone disappeared and he felt a painful burn."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki was lost. Was he delusional? ...He couldn't convince himself that was impossible, but he'd seen it clearly: the gemstone had vanished.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was lost. Was he delusional? ...He couldn't convince himself that was impossible, but he'd seen it clearly: the gemstone had vanished."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He looked around, almost beginning to cry again in desperation. Hopefully, Shiroya's corpse had also been a hallucination, but he couldn't bring himself to verify it.
entries.literal: "He looked around, almost beginning to cry again in desperation. Hopefully, Shiroya's corpse had also been a hallucination, but he couldn't bring himself to verify it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He staggered to hallway B. Perhaps Akaro and Isla were still in that room.
entries.literal: "He staggered to hallway B. Perhaps Akaro and Isla were still in that room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They weren't. The room was empty.
entries.literal: "They weren't. The room was empty."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The lobby door wasn't closed, but Atsuki quickly looked away. Instead, he went to hallway C, wondering if Erina had truly disappeared.
entries.literal: "The lobby door wasn't closed, but Atsuki quickly looked away. Instead, he went to hallway C, wondering if Erina had truly disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...She had. She really wasn't there.
entries.literal: "...She had. She really wasn't there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had failed to notice another change earlier: the elevator button. ...It was attached where it should have been on the wall.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had failed to notice another change earlier: the elevator button. ...It was attached where it should have been on the wall."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He pressed it softly, causing the burn on his fingertip to prickle painfully.{w} Long seconds later, the button's outline flashed orange.
entries.literal: "He pressed it softly, causing the burn on his fingertip to prickle painfully.{w} Long seconds later, the button's outline flashed orange."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hesitantly, Atsuki tried to open the door.
entries.literal: "Hesitantly, Atsuki tried to open the door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At {time=21:04}, the shutter opened.{w} A group of policemen had been in front of it, awaiting that time. As soon as the glass came into view, they saw the figure of a young girl lying next to a puddle of blood.
entries.literal: "At {time=21:04}, the shutter opened.{w} A group of policemen had been in front of it, awaiting that time. As soon as the glass came into view, they saw the figure of a young girl lying next to a puddle of blood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, they couldn't rush in. An unknown gas was quickly detected inside the building.
entries.literal: "However, they couldn't rush in. An unknown gas was quickly detected inside the building."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When they were prepared, the team raided Ashiya Tower.{w} The girl in the lobby was young and had blue hair. She didn't have an open wound, so the blood next to her was strange.
entries.literal: "When they were prepared, the team raided Ashiya Tower.{w} The girl in the lobby was young and had blue hair. She didn't have an open wound, so the blood next to her was strange."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the other side of the door was another body. Along with a much larger pool of blood, an older woman was found. She had hit her head on a step, dying instantly.
entries.literal: "On the other side of the door was another body. Along with a much larger pool of blood, an older woman was found. She had hit her head on a step, dying instantly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What exactly had happened during the twelve hours when the tower had been sealed off? The officers were speechless as they stared at the corpses.{w} However, that was nothing compared to what awaited in hallway B.
entries.literal: "What exactly had happened during the twelve hours when the tower had been sealed off? The officers were speechless as they stared at the corpses.{w} However, that was nothing compared to what awaited in hallway B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Dimly lit, its entire floor was red. It took a moment for the first officer to realize that it was blood, not lighting.{w} Then, when he saw its source, the wind was knocked out of him.{w} He froze, knowing that would be the most gruesome image he'd ever see—the sad remains of what had once been a human being.
entries.literal: "Dimly lit, its entire floor was red. It took a moment for the first officer to realize that it was blood, not lighting.{w} Then, when he saw its source, the wind was knocked out of him.{w} He froze, knowing that would be the most gruesome image he'd ever see—the sad remains of what had once been a human being."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the middle of the hallway, by the door of a crystal room in the right wall, was the origin of the blood.{w} It wasn't a body. It was only half of one.
entries.literal: "In the middle of the hallway, by the door of a crystal room in the right wall, was the origin of the blood.{w} It wasn't a body. It was only half of one."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The other half was beyond the door, as it had split it in two.
entries.literal: "The other half was beyond the door, as it had split it in two."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The officer stared at it while his heart hammered. It looked like a young man.
entries.literal: "The officer stared at it while his heart hammered. It looked like a young man."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They raised the curtain to the Sekimeiya cabinet. As Ashiya had feared, it was empty.
entries.literal: "They raised the curtain to the Sekimeiya cabinet. As Ashiya had feared, it was empty."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lei had let them know about the Sekimeiya's appearance and about the necessity for cold. They knew the Sekimeiya were two identical egg-shaped stones.
entries.literal: "Lei had let them know about the Sekimeiya's appearance and about the necessity for cold. They knew the Sekimeiya were two identical egg-shaped stones."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It didn't take long for them to be found. One was in the storeroom, behind a secret wall. The other had been hidden inside a crystal room in hallway B. As instructed, an officer brought them to their cabinet, but he felt something strange. Through his protective suit, he noticed one of the stones was hot. The other, however, was not.
entries.literal: "It didn't take long for them to be found. One was in the storeroom, behind a secret wall. The other had been hidden inside a crystal room in hallway B. As instructed, an officer brought them to their cabinet, but he felt something strange. Through his protective suit, he noticed one of the stones was hot. The other, however, was not."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Even when the police climbed to the highest floor, no one else had been found.
entries.literal: "Even when the police climbed to the highest floor, no one else had been found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The team exited and reported their findings. Three people had been found dead, zero alive.
entries.literal: "The team exited and reported their findings. Three people had been found dead, zero alive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It didn't make sense; at least five were missing. Thanks to the entrance tickets, they knew the names of the people who hadn't been found outside.
entries.literal: "It didn't make sense; at least five were missing. Thanks to the entrance tickets, they knew the names of the people who hadn't been found outside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While the citizens learned the tragic events that had transpired, the bodies were identified.{w} The girl in the lobby was Shiroya Mirana.{w} The woman beside the stairs was Erina Majutsu.{w} And the body split in two was Sai Yomiya's.
entries.literal: "While the citizens learned the tragic events that had transpired, the bodies were identified.{w} The girl in the lobby was Shiroya Mirana.{w} The woman beside the stairs was Erina Majutsu.{w} And the body split in two was Sai Yomiya's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was a secret corridor in the storeroom that Ashiya didn't know about. When the police learned it led outside, a single conclusion was drawn: the missing people had left through it minutes after the attack. Since then, all sides of the tower had been observed.
entries.literal: "There was a secret corridor in the storeroom that Ashiya didn't know about. When the police learned it led outside, a single conclusion was drawn: the missing people had left through it minutes after the attack. Since then, all sides of the tower had been observed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So... what had happened inside? Who had killed those three people?
entries.literal: "So... what had happened inside? Who had killed those three people?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The building was raided a second time. If someone was still there, they had to be found immediately. Every possible spot was inspected.
entries.literal: "The building was raided a second time. If someone was still there, they had to be found immediately. Every possible spot was inspected."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the crystal floor, a member of the team entered the elevator. Blood and metallic panels were on the floor, but his attention went higher.
entries.literal: "On the crystal floor, a member of the team entered the elevator. Blood and metallic panels were on the floor, but his attention went higher."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the only remaining place in the tower. With the tools he'd been given, he unlocked the hatch on the ceiling to look into the narrow elevator shaft.
entries.literal: "It was the only remaining place in the tower. With the tools he'd been given, he unlocked the hatch on the ceiling to look into the narrow elevator shaft."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he pulled his head up through it, he saw a face before his eyes.{w} It was that of a young, unconscious boy. Blood issued from his mouth in a thin stream.
entries.literal: "When he pulled his head up through it, he saw a face before his eyes.{w} It was that of a young, unconscious boy. Blood issued from his mouth in a thin stream."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The officer placed his hand under the boy's nose; he was still breathing. He gently shook his shoulder, but there was no response.
entries.literal: "The officer placed his hand under the boy's nose; he was still breathing. He gently shook his shoulder, but there was no response."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He was unsure how to safely remove the boy from where he was or how he'd even gotten there in the first place. The full extent of his injuries was also an unknown factor.
entries.literal: "He was unsure how to safely remove the boy from where he was or how he'd even gotten there in the first place. The full extent of his injuries was also an unknown factor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He called for help, and a team of men slowly and gingerly extricated the boy shortly afterward.
entries.literal: "He called for help, and a team of men slowly and gingerly extricated the boy shortly afterward."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki Hakutoki. That was the name of the person who'd been found above the elevator.{w} Hours after his rescue, he regained consciousness. At first, he sounded devastated due to the death of his close friend. However, as he continued to be questioned, his answers only grew stranger.
entries.literal: "Atsuki Hakutoki. That was the name of the person who'd been found above the elevator.{w} Hours after his rescue, he regained consciousness. At first, he sounded devastated due to the death of his close friend. However, as he continued to be questioned, his answers only grew stranger."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't know how he'd ended up in the elevator shaft, and the events he described didn't make sense. According to him, the missing people had been in the building for hours, which the police rejected immediately, as there was no way they would have been able to escape through the secret door.
entries.literal: "He didn't know how he'd ended up in the elevator shaft, and the events he described didn't make sense. According to him, the missing people had been in the building for hours, which the police rejected immediately, as there was no way they would have been able to escape through the secret door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't have a valid explanation for any of the deaths. No clues at the crime scenes pointed to their truth, and no video footage had been recorded. Quickly, the possibility that Atsuki was lying was presented—only he could've committed those murders.{w} He must've been lying: none of what he'd said could be the truth. However, nobody could be completely sure. Sai's death... It hadn't been natural.{w} How would Atsuki have killed him? How would anyone have killed him like that? And how would Atsuki have ended up unconscious above the elevator?
entries.literal: "He didn't have a valid explanation for any of the deaths. No clues at the crime scenes pointed to their truth, and no video footage had been recorded. Quickly, the possibility that Atsuki was lying was presented—only he could've committed those murders.{w} He must've been lying: none of what he'd said could be the truth. However, nobody could be completely sure. Sai's death... It hadn't been natural.{w} How would Atsuki have killed him? How would anyone have killed him like that? And how would Atsuki have ended up unconscious above the elevator?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And, admittedly, there was a point of truth to Atsuki's words: the blood in the lobby.{w} Next to Shiroya's body, there'd been a puddle of blood, which was confirmed not to match with any of the bodies present.{w} Could it really have been... Naomi's? The corpse Atsuki swore had disappeared...?
entries.literal: "And, admittedly, there was a point of truth to Atsuki's words: the blood in the lobby.{w} Next to Shiroya's body, there'd been a puddle of blood, which was confirmed not to match with any of the bodies present.{w} Could it really have been... Naomi's? The corpse Atsuki swore had disappeared...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The backlash Ashiya received was immense. They had allowed a tragedy to unfold on their own property.
entries.literal: "The backlash Ashiya received was immense. They had allowed a tragedy to unfold on their own property."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After the attack, the tower didn't open again. Containing countless mysteries and an unknown gas, it was closed indefinitely.
entries.literal: "After the attack, the tower didn't open again. Containing countless mysteries and an unknown gas, it was closed indefinitely."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And eventually, Ashiya's voice faded. There was nothing they could do anymore.
entries.literal: "And eventually, Ashiya's voice faded. There was nothing they could do anymore."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Many weeks had passed since December 15th. Lonely, Atsuki looked at the sky through the glass of a window.
entries.literal: "Many weeks had passed since December 15th. Lonely, Atsuki looked at the sky through the glass of a window."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He could not yet believe what his life had become, and imagining the worst years ahead of him, he could only cry.
entries.literal: "He could not yet believe what his life had become, and imagining the worst years ahead of him, he could only cry."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The sky he saw... He wasn't happy he could still see it. He wanted it to disappear.
entries.literal: "The sky he saw... He wasn't happy he could still see it. He wanted it to disappear."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And it did.
entries.literal: "And it did."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Through the glass of a window, the cloudy sky could be seen.{w} However, no one was there to see it.
entries.literal: "Through the glass of a window, the cloudy sky could be seen.{w} However, no one was there to see it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Around the country, some people had the opportunity to witness the disappearance of countless citizens.{w} Speechless, they walked to where everyone had been... In the blink of an eye, the streets had become desolate, and even some cars had disappeared.
entries.literal: "Around the country, some people had the opportunity to witness the disappearance of countless citizens.{w} Speechless, they walked to where everyone had been... In the blink of an eye, the streets had become desolate, and even some cars had disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The news was heard across the world: every being within an immense radius had vanished—almost a third of Japan was gone.
entries.literal: "The news was heard across the world: every being within an immense radius had vanished—almost a third of Japan was gone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was humanity's most shocking event ever recorded. In a mere instant, millions of people disappeared without a trace. What had occurred was far beyond anyone's understanding.
entries.literal: "It was humanity's most shocking event ever recorded. In a mere instant, millions of people disappeared without a trace. What had occurred was far beyond anyone's understanding."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You might know what was in the center of that radius.
entries.literal: "You might know what was in the center of that radius."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A little town on the foot of a mountain range, called Yushibana.
entries.literal: "A little town on the foot of a mountain range, called Yushibana."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Then, everyone traveled through time. That must be what you're thinking.
entries.literal: "...Then, everyone traveled through time. That must be what you're thinking."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, not one of the people who disappeared reappeared anywhere. The instant they vanished, their existence was {tip=disappearance}erased forever{/tip}.
entries.literal: "However, not one of the people who disappeared reappeared anywhere. The instant they vanished, their existence was {tip=disappearance}erased forever{/tip}."

entries.text: First Cause Dilemma
entries.literal: "First Cause Dilemma"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Airun was covered by a vast cape of snow. During the winter, Calliant were the only flowers that had survived the climate, and they encompassed its entire spectrum of flora.
entries.literal: "Airun was covered by a vast cape of snow. During the winter, Calliant were the only flowers that had survived the climate, and they encompassed its entire spectrum of flora."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A member of a large range, the mountain extended behind Yushibana, its perpetual snowy top reaching higher than the others.
entries.literal: "A member of a large range, the mountain extended behind Yushibana, its perpetual snowy top reaching higher than the others."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Years had passed since it had last been visited. It had long ago been said that only its neighbors were holders of innumerable gemstones.
entries.literal: "Years had passed since it had last been visited. It had long ago been said that only its neighbors were holders of innumerable gemstones."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On its base, different species of Calliant peeked through the snow. After so long, however, they were accompanied by something else.
entries.literal: "On its base, different species of Calliant peeked through the snow. After so long, however, they were accompanied by something else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Human footprints. Marked on the ground, they wandered about.
entries.literal: "Human footprints. Marked on the ground, they wandered about."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Far from them, a man walked on the snow. His name was Gan, and in the distance, he could see the mountains he'd often traveled through.
entries.literal: "Far from them, a man walked on the snow. His name was Gan, and in the distance, he could see the mountains he'd often traveled through."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the first time he'd brought his equipment to Airun. He'd always been curious to know whether the common belief about it being devoid of value was true.
entries.literal: "It was the first time he'd brought his equipment to Airun. He'd always been curious to know whether the common belief about it being devoid of value was true."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And, after hours, he had verified it. He hadn't found any caves, and the surface had been harder to traverse than Airun's neighbors.
entries.literal: "And, after hours, he had verified it. He hadn't found any caves, and the surface had been harder to traverse than Airun's neighbors."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Disappointed, he walked back before the sun set. He'd been out all day, and he was exhausted.
entries.literal: "Disappointed, he walked back before the sun set. He'd been out all day, and he was exhausted."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He was walking down a narrow path when something caught his eye.
entries.literal: "He was walking down a narrow path when something caught his eye."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd already crossed the treeline, so tall trees were surrounding him. He stopped himself when he noticed an opening between two of them.
entries.literal: "He'd already crossed the treeline, so tall trees were surrounding him. He stopped himself when he noticed an opening between two of them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Intrigued, he walked over to it, and as he got closer, he realized what it was.
entries.literal: "Intrigued, he walked over to it, and as he got closer, he realized what it was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: An entrance to a vast field of grass, enclosed by the trees that hid it from view.{w} However, what truly stood out was farther ahead.
entries.literal: "An entrance to a vast field of grass, enclosed by the trees that hid it from view.{w} However, what truly stood out was farther ahead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was a wooden cabin. In the corner of the field, it lay covered in white.
entries.literal: "There was a wooden cabin. In the corner of the field, it lay covered in white."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Speechless, he was drawn to it.{w} The grass was tall, and it had almost been concealed by the snow. Slowly making his way inward, Gan didn't take his eyes off the cabin.
entries.literal: "Speechless, he was drawn to it.{w} The grass was tall, and it had almost been concealed by the snow. Slowly making his way inward, Gan didn't take his eyes off the cabin."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd never heard about it, and it looked abandoned. Many questions came to him, but they all suddenly vanished.
entries.literal: "He'd never heard about it, and it looked abandoned. Many questions came to him, but they all suddenly vanished."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He looked at the ground. On top of the snow, he'd almost missed something that easily blended in.
entries.literal: "He looked at the ground. On top of the snow, he'd almost missed something that easily blended in."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Was it... an egg? He crouched by its side and felt its surface. Strangely, no snow was on it.
entries.literal: "Was it... an egg? He crouched by its side and felt its surface. Strangely, no snow was on it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he touched it, his face was one of amazement. It was incredibly smooth, but it was heavier than it looked. He'd never seen anything like it in his life.
entries.literal: "When he touched it, his face was one of amazement. It was incredibly smooth, but it was heavier than it looked. He'd never seen anything like it in his life."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What was it, and why was it there? Gan didn't care and was eager to bring it home.
entries.literal: "What was it, and why was it there? Gan didn't care and was eager to bring it home."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It looked like a gemstone, but it hadn't been underground. Content to have found something, he kept walking toward the cabin.
entries.literal: "It looked like a gemstone, but it hadn't been underground. Content to have found something, he kept walking toward the cabin."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door was open, so he took a look inside.{w} A few spiders had set up shop there. Most of them had died out during the winter, but their webs still decorated the room.
entries.literal: "The door was open, so he took a look inside.{w} A few spiders had set up shop there. Most of them had died out during the winter, but their webs still decorated the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Gan didn't dare look down into the storeroom. The last thing he wanted was for some large spider still living down there to be disturbed by him.
entries.literal: "Gan didn't dare look down into the storeroom. The last thing he wanted was for some large spider still living down there to be disturbed by him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As he'd expected, it didn't seem like anyone had been there in a long time.
entries.literal: "As he'd expected, it didn't seem like anyone had been there in a long time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The 27th of November was a Sunday. That was why Gan had chosen it to go to Airun.
entries.literal: "The 27th of November was a Sunday. That was why Gan had chosen it to go to Airun."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Late into the day, he arrived at home. With one hand, he unlocked his front door.
entries.literal: "Late into the day, he arrived at home. With one hand, he unlocked his front door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stepped into his shop, Musashi Gemstones.{w} He left his discovery on a stand and hurried to turn on the heater. Then, he grabbed the phone and dialed a number he had memorized.
entries.literal: "He stepped into his shop, Musashi Gemstones.{w} He left his discovery on a stand and hurried to turn on the heater. Then, he grabbed the phone and dialed a number he had memorized."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Lei! I'm sorry to call you so late. Is this a good time?
entries.literal: "Lei! I'm sorry to call you so late. Is this a good time?"

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: What do you want?
entries.literal: "What do you want?"

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: I just found something that will interest you. You have to see it.
entries.literal: "I just found something that will interest you. You have to see it."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Is it about a gemstone?
entries.literal: "Is it about a gemstone?"

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Y-Yes, but it's not a normal one. I found it on Airun, and it's unlike any I've seen.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes, but it's not a normal one. I found it on Airun, and it's unlike any I've seen."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: ...Is that so?{w} If you're not exaggerating, you might be in luck.
entries.literal: "...Is that so?{w} If you're not exaggerating, you might be in luck."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: I'm not. I'm certain this would fit perfectly in the tower.
entries.literal: "I'm not. I'm certain this would fit perfectly in the tower."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Is it all right if I come tomorrow? I want to speak to you about something.
entries.literal: "Is it all right if I come tomorrow? I want to speak to you about something."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Yes, that's perfectly fine.
entries.literal: "Yes, that's perfectly fine."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: I'll be there in the afternoon, then.
entries.literal: "I'll be there in the afternoon, then."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Thank you! I'll be waiting.{w} Good night.
entries.literal: "Thank you! I'll be waiting.{w} Good night."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The call cut off.{w} Gan pumped his fist in relief. It had been a while since he'd struck a deal with Ashiya.
entries.literal: "The call cut off.{w} Gan pumped his fist in relief. It had been a while since he'd struck a deal with Ashiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He sat on his chair. He was tired, and he had to think about what he'd say the next day.
