entries.literal: "He sat on his chair. He was tired, and he had to think about what he'd say the next day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A while later, he raised his head. He had noticed something.{w} A smell he hadn't perceived before was in his shop.
entries.literal: "A while later, he raised his head. He had noticed something.{w} A smell he hadn't perceived before was in his shop."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He couldn't discern what it was, but he slowly walked over to the gem he'd brought.
entries.literal: "He couldn't discern what it was, but he slowly walked over to the gem he'd brought."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Was it the source? He got close to it, but he suddenly retreated.
entries.literal: "Was it the source? He got close to it, but he suddenly retreated."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, carefully, he placed his hand on it.
entries.literal: "Then, carefully, he placed his hand on it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...{w}It was hot. Very hot.{w} Why? It had been cold before. Why had its temperature changed?
entries.literal: "...{w}It was hot. Very hot.{w} Why? It had been cold before. Why had its temperature changed?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Concerned, he grabbed it.{w} He examined it closely, but there was no explanation for the temperature change. What could've caused that? And most importantly, would it ward Ashiya off from buying it?
entries.literal: "Concerned, he grabbed it.{w} He examined it closely, but there was no explanation for the temperature change. What could've caused that? And most importantly, would it ward Ashiya off from buying it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stepped out of his shop. Outside, it had remained cold.
entries.literal: "He stepped out of his shop. Outside, it had remained cold."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And soon after he did, the gem cooled down. In the blink of an eye, the warmth around it had faded.
entries.literal: "And soon after he did, the gem cooled down. In the blink of an eye, the warmth around it had faded."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Was it the surrounding temperature? No matter what, it hadn't seemed normal.
entries.literal: "Was it the surrounding temperature? No matter what, it hadn't seemed normal."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In awe, Gan stepped back in, letting the heat make contact with the gem.
entries.literal: "In awe, Gan stepped back in, letting the heat make contact with the gem."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Immediately, he noticed the change. The smooth surface began to heat up exponentially.
entries.literal: "Immediately, he noticed the change. The smooth surface began to heat up exponentially."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What did he have in his hands, exactly? How was such a rapid change in temperature occurring?
entries.literal: "What did he have in his hands, exactly? How was such a rapid change in temperature occurring?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And would Ashiya be against taking such a thing? Gan began to worry.
entries.literal: "And would Ashiya be against taking such a thing? Gan began to worry."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He remembered that a long time ago, Ashiya had sold him storage cabinets, and one of them had been equipped with temperature regulation. Biting his lip, he went to his storage room.
entries.literal: "He remembered that a long time ago, Ashiya had sold him storage cabinets, and one of them had been equipped with temperature regulation. Biting his lip, he went to his storage room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One of the dusty cabinets had a wheel on its side. He dragged it close to an outlet and plugged it in.
entries.literal: "One of the dusty cabinets had a wheel on its side. He dragged it close to an outlet and plugged it in."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The temperature in Yushibana was around 0 °C. Matching it, he rotated the wheel and brought the gemstone there.
entries.literal: "The temperature in Yushibana was around 0 °C. Matching it, he rotated the wheel and brought the gemstone there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After leaving it inside, he waited for the temperature to stabilize.
entries.literal: "After leaving it inside, he waited for the temperature to stabilize."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And when it had, he touched the gemstone one more time.{w} All warmth was long gone, and the smell had also faded.
entries.literal: "And when it had, he touched the gemstone one more time.{w} All warmth was long gone, and the smell had also faded."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was bizarre, but Gan's mind went again to Ashiya. What would they say about something so peculiar...?
entries.literal: "It was bizarre, but Gan's mind went again to Ashiya. What would they say about something so peculiar...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Tired, he went to his bedroom. He knew he would fall asleep instantly.
entries.literal: "Tired, he went to his bedroom. He knew he would fall asleep instantly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He was still in his mountain equipment—jacket, hat, and gloves—so he hurried to take them off.
entries.literal: "He was still in his mountain equipment—jacket, hat, and gloves—so he hurried to take them off."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next day, Lei came to visit Gan, who had been preparing what to say.
entries.literal: "The next day, Lei came to visit Gan, who had been preparing what to say."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a warm welcome, she was brought to the Sekimeiya—that was the name Gan had chosen for the gemstone.
entries.literal: "After a warm welcome, she was brought to the Sekimeiya—that was the name Gan had chosen for the gemstone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as Lei saw it, she let him know Ashiya were interested in buying it. It had taken a lot less convincing than Gan had expected.
entries.literal: "As soon as Lei saw it, she let him know Ashiya were interested in buying it. It had taken a lot less convincing than Gan had expected."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lei let him know the reason. Ashiya had been searching for a unique gemstone, and the one he'd found would serve that purpose well.
entries.literal: "Lei let him know the reason. Ashiya had been searching for a unique gemstone, and the one he'd found would serve that purpose well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Gan and Lei had long ago agreed on a standard starting sum per gemstone, which Gan couldn't pass on. However, he hadn't yet mentioned what he'd found out about the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Gan and Lei had long ago agreed on a standard starting sum per gemstone, which Gan couldn't pass on. However, he hadn't yet mentioned what he'd found out about the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Yesterday, I noticed the heater's temperature might've damaged it. That's why I've got it cold right now.
entries.literal: "Yesterday, I noticed the heater's temperature might've damaged it. That's why I've got it cold right now."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Oh, it's cold in there?
entries.literal: "Oh, it's cold in there?"

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: ...Yes. I advise you to do the same. The lower temperature seemed to immediately alleviate the problem. It's currently set to 0 °C.
entries.literal: "...Yes. I advise you to do the same. The lower temperature seemed to immediately alleviate the problem. It's currently set to 0 °C."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: That's fine. We can do that.
entries.literal: "That's fine. We can do that."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Good. Just in case, I would suggest you not touch it while it's not refrigerated. It's delicate, so I wouldn't risk it.
entries.literal: "Good. Just in case, I would suggest you not touch it while it's not refrigerated. It's delicate, so I wouldn't risk it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lei silently nodded.{w} Gan took a deep breath. If Ashiya did what he had instructed, there would be no problem.
entries.literal: "Lei silently nodded.{w} Gan took a deep breath. If Ashiya did what he had instructed, there would be no problem."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: We'll deal with the paperwork, then. You know the usual.{w} We'll be here this Wednesday. Is {time=21} a good time? Sorry if it's too late, we're pretty overloaded.
entries.literal: "We'll deal with the paperwork, then. You know the usual.{w} We'll be here this Wednesday. Is {time=21} a good time? Sorry if it's too late, we're pretty overloaded."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Yes, any time is fine. I'm still open at that hour, so I'll have everything prepared.
entries.literal: "Yes, any time is fine. I'm still open at that hour, so I'll have everything prepared."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Perfect.
entries.literal: "Perfect."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both of them bowed, and Lei calmly exited his shop.
entries.literal: "Both of them bowed, and Lei calmly exited his shop."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Gan woke up, he didn't open the shop. He'd been thinking that something else could've been on that mountain.
entries.literal: "When Gan woke up, he didn't open the shop. He'd been thinking that something else could've been on that mountain."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The gemstone he'd found... Why had it been there? Snow had fallen days prior, so why had none been on it?{w} Had someone dropped it there? Someone who knew about that place?
entries.literal: "The gemstone he'd found... Why had it been there? Snow had fallen days prior, so why had none been on it?{w} Had someone dropped it there? Someone who knew about that place?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Ashiya paid well, so Gan hadn't stopped thinking about going back to that grassy field... Was it possible he had missed something?
entries.literal: "Ashiya paid well, so Gan hadn't stopped thinking about going back to that grassy field... Was it possible he had missed something?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he spotted the familiar opening between the trees, Gan deviated from the narrow path.
entries.literal: "When he spotted the familiar opening between the trees, Gan deviated from the narrow path."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once more, he saw the short cabin. It was two days later, so his footprints had almost fully disappeared.
entries.literal: "Once more, he saw the short cabin. It was two days later, so his footprints had almost fully disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He scanned the terrain, slowly stepping forward. He noticed something and hurried over to it.
entries.literal: "He scanned the terrain, slowly stepping forward. He noticed something and hurried over to it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A section of white stood out, but it wasn't snow. He approached and slowly reached down.
entries.literal: "A section of white stood out, but it wasn't snow. He approached and slowly reached down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was another gemstone, identical to the one he'd found.
entries.literal: "It was another gemstone, identical to the one he'd found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Gan searched through the entire field, but he found nothing else.
entries.literal: "Gan searched through the entire field, but he found nothing else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At home, he called Lei and told her about his latest discovery. When she heard it looked the same, she sounded interested.
entries.literal: "At home, he called Lei and told her about his latest discovery. When she heard it looked the same, she sounded interested."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, there was an issue: Ashiya had already revealed the Sekimeiya's existence. On that day, the primary announcements had been made.
entries.literal: "However, there was an issue: Ashiya had already revealed the Sekimeiya's existence. On that day, the primary announcements had been made."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: You know what? This might be great.{w} You remember what I told you, don't you?{w} We're keeping the details of the Sekimeiya a secret, and this could be something perfect to reveal on the day of the event. We'll buy both of them.
entries.literal: "You know what? This might be great.{w} You remember what I told you, don't you?{w} We're keeping the details of the Sekimeiya a secret, and this could be something perfect to reveal on the day of the event. We'll buy both of them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There were many things Lei hadn't told Gan, but that was the truth. If Xyn didn't make their move before the 15th, Ashiya could justify part of the build-up on the existence of two identical, paired gemstones.
entries.literal: "There were many things Lei hadn't told Gan, but that was the truth. If Xyn didn't make their move before the 15th, Ashiya could justify part of the build-up on the existence of two identical, paired gemstones."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That is why, until that day, most people who uttered the words "the Sekimeiya" weren't aware they were referring to two gemstones at once.
entries.literal: "That is why, until that day, most people who uttered the words \"the Sekimeiya\" weren't aware they were referring to two gemstones at once."

entries.text: Corrosion Fatigue
entries.literal: "Corrosion Fatigue"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In a small town encircled by mountains, a house stood out from the others. It was surrounded by an empty field, and it was often referred to as a mansion.
entries.literal: "In a small town encircled by mountains, a house stood out from the others. It was surrounded by an empty field, and it was often referred to as a mansion."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody truly knew the family who lived in it, but the numerous nasty rumors about them were known by all.{w} For a long time, they were believed to be secretly authoritarian. However, crimes had recently started to be linked back to them.
entries.literal: "Nobody truly knew the family who lived in it, but the numerous nasty rumors about them were known by all.{w} For a long time, they were believed to be secretly authoritarian. However, crimes had recently started to be linked back to them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the afternoon came, a swarm of students exited the single school in town. It was starting to get cold, so most of them walked home.
entries.literal: "When the afternoon came, a swarm of students exited the single school in town. It was starting to get cold, so most of them walked home."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the mansion's living room, a thirteen-year-old boy named Kyuuka sat on a large sofa. It was his favorite spot, the most comfortable place in his own world. Idly, just passing the time, he watched whatever was on television by himself.
entries.literal: "In the mansion's living room, a thirteen-year-old boy named Kyuuka sat on a large sofa. It was his favorite spot, the most comfortable place in his own world. Idly, just passing the time, he watched whatever was on television by himself."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Most days, he would come home from school and do that. In the past, he had sometimes played with friends, but he had distanced himself from them as time went on.
entries.literal: "Most days, he would come home from school and do that. In the past, he had sometimes played with friends, but he had distanced himself from them as time went on."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Solitude was his preference. The lesson he had taught himself from years of exposure to others was that they weren't worth his time, and so once in a while, he wouldn't go to school for the simple reason that it was too much of a bother.
entries.literal: "Solitude was his preference. The lesson he had taught himself from years of exposure to others was that they weren't worth his time, and so once in a while, he wouldn't go to school for the simple reason that it was too much of a bother."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His parents were upstairs. He had, over time, picked up on what their "business" entailed, but the details were neither accessible nor relevant to him.
entries.literal: "His parents were upstairs. He had, over time, picked up on what their \"business\" entailed, but the details were neither accessible nor relevant to him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kyuuka heard the door open. When he glanced over, he saw his older brother stepping in with a girl he'd never seen before.
entries.literal: "Kyuuka heard the door open. When he glanced over, he saw his older brother stepping in with a girl he'd never seen before."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Who's that?
entries.literal: "Who's that?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: She's a friend of mine. I'm just going to show her the house.
entries.literal: "She's a friend of mine. I'm just going to show her the house."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Without saying a word, she was brought upstairs. Kyuuka saw it as none of his concern at all. In his eyes, she was either somebody related to his parents' business or just another source of entertainment for his brother.
entries.literal: "Without saying a word, she was brought upstairs. Kyuuka saw it as none of his concern at all. In his eyes, she was either somebody related to his parents' business or just another source of entertainment for his brother."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When night had come, he hadn't seen anyone else.
entries.literal: "When night had come, he hadn't seen anyone else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After making his own food, Kyuuka walked to his bedroom. He couldn't easily fall asleep with things being so noisy, so he covered himself with the sheets.
entries.literal: "After making his own food, Kyuuka walked to his bedroom. He couldn't easily fall asleep with things being so noisy, so he covered himself with the sheets."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next evening, watching television as usual, he saw a familiar face. A girl had disappeared in the town where he lived.
entries.literal: "The next evening, watching television as usual, he saw a familiar face. A girl had disappeared in the town where he lived."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kyuuka wasn't remotely surprised. They didn't operate in shadows; there was no need to do so.
entries.literal: "Kyuuka wasn't remotely surprised. They didn't operate in shadows; there was no need to do so."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...She was the daughter of someone with strong ties to the town's leadership. That made sense. His brother was just carrying out something that was both productive and fun for him.
entries.literal: "...She was the daughter of someone with strong ties to the town's leadership. That made sense. His brother was just carrying out something that was both productive and fun for him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hours later, his older brother came down from upstairs. He looked cheerful and left after silently waving to Kyuuka.
entries.literal: "Hours later, his older brother came down from upstairs. He looked cheerful and left after silently waving to Kyuuka."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd learned the girl's name: Anora. It made no difference. Regardless of her name, she was locked in the same room as always.{w} Soon, he heard plaintive cries coming from above.
entries.literal: "He'd learned the girl's name: Anora. It made no difference. Regardless of her name, she was locked in the same room as always.{w} Soon, he heard plaintive cries coming from above."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kyuuka responded by turning up the volume.
entries.literal: "Kyuuka responded by turning up the volume."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Eventually, his brother came back with some bags he hadn't left with.
entries.literal: "Eventually, his brother came back with some bags he hadn't left with."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A day had passed with no minute full of silence. In the living room, Kyuuka tried to ignore the muffled noise. Whenever those situations occurred, he went to school just to get away from it for a while, but he had to come home eventually.
entries.literal: "A day had passed with no minute full of silence. In the living room, Kyuuka tried to ignore the muffled noise. Whenever those situations occurred, he went to school just to get away from it for a while, but he had to come home eventually."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't like it. He knew that girl was suffering, and he didn't want that.{w} However, he wouldn't talk his brother out of it, and he didn't want to annoy him. Furthermore, the room upstairs was always locked, and he couldn't bring himself to let anybody know.
entries.literal: "He didn't like it. He knew that girl was suffering, and he didn't want that.{w} However, he wouldn't talk his brother out of it, and he didn't want to annoy him. Furthermore, the room upstairs was always locked, and he couldn't bring himself to let anybody know."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She hadn't done anything to deserve it, presumably. Few of the people his brother brought home gave him that impression. He didn't think of himself as a bad person, and would have helped her if he could, but that was a mere notion. It wasn't realistic enough for him to act on.
entries.literal: "She hadn't done anything to deserve it, presumably. Few of the people his brother brought home gave him that impression. He didn't think of himself as a bad person, and would have helped her if he could, but that was a mere notion. It wasn't realistic enough for him to act on."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was why he'd always stayed aside, quietly sitting on that sofa.
entries.literal: "That was why he'd always stayed aside, quietly sitting on that sofa."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But his mind suddenly changed when he saw something he hadn't seen in a long time.
entries.literal: "But his mind suddenly changed when he saw something he hadn't seen in a long time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was a key.{w} When his brother had gone up loaded with what he'd bought, he'd left his keys in the keyhole.
entries.literal: "It was a key.{w} When his brother had gone up loaded with what he'd bought, he'd left his keys in the keyhole."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kyuuka silently stood up and walked over. He looked back, confirming his brother wasn't coming.
entries.literal: "Kyuuka silently stood up and walked over. He looked back, confirming his brother wasn't coming."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he detached one of the keys from the ring and stored it in his pocket.
entries.literal: "Then, he detached one of the keys from the ring and stored it in his pocket."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Beyond the wooden ceiling, she continued to yell. On some level, such barbarism disgusted Kyuuka. He was getting tired of it.
entries.literal: "Beyond the wooden ceiling, she continued to yell. On some level, such barbarism disgusted Kyuuka. He was getting tired of it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sighing, he lay on his side to muffle the sound entering at least one of his ears. He'd endured louder, and for longer.
entries.literal: "Sighing, he lay on his side to muffle the sound entering at least one of his ears. He'd endured louder, and for longer."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Part of him really did wish to take action for once, whether it was from the presence of the key or not. It had been ages since he'd had a conversation with his brother, but at some point, a part of him had come to revile his sibling.
entries.literal: "Part of him really did wish to take action for once, whether it was from the presence of the key or not. It had been ages since he'd had a conversation with his brother, but at some point, a part of him had come to revile his sibling."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He asked himself a question. Was it worth doing something?
entries.literal: "He asked himself a question. Was it worth doing something?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Answering that was difficult for Kyuuka. He didn't like people. They were rude, selfish, and just too much effort to deal with. If any of them had cared about him, he might have thought differently.
entries.literal: "Answering that was difficult for Kyuuka. He didn't like people. They were rude, selfish, and just too much effort to deal with. If any of them had cared about him, he might have thought differently."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the other hand, he knew that he'd barely tried to speak to anyone in a long time, and his brother wasn't exactly deserving of anyone's attention, let alone approval.
entries.literal: "On the other hand, he knew that he'd barely tried to speak to anyone in a long time, and his brother wasn't exactly deserving of anyone's attention, let alone approval."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His parents and his brother—his whole family—was composed of deplorable individuals. He saw himself as different. It wasn't his choice to hurt people, and he would have actively stopped it if he could.
entries.literal: "His parents and his brother—his whole family—was composed of deplorable individuals. He saw himself as different. It wasn't his choice to hurt people, and he would have actively stopped it if he could."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, given the fact that he could, it only made sense to do so. When he thought about it like that, he came to a decision.
entries.literal: "So, given the fact that he could, it only made sense to do so. When he thought about it like that, he came to a decision."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next day, Kyuuka stayed home. As soon as his parents left the house, he went up the stairs.
entries.literal: "The next day, Kyuuka stayed home. As soon as his parents left the house, he went up the stairs."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The phone was there. Quietly, he dialed the police's number.{w} When they picked up, he anonymously revealed Anora's whereabouts, claiming to have heard yells coming from the house. Then, before his brother could hear him, he slipped back to his sofa.
entries.literal: "The phone was there. Quietly, he dialed the police's number.{w} When they picked up, he anonymously revealed Anora's whereabouts, claiming to have heard yells coming from the house. Then, before his brother could hear him, he slipped back to his sofa."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was no way out for his brother. He hadn't asked about the missing key, so thanks to that, he knew Anora would be found.
entries.literal: "There was no way out for his brother. He hadn't asked about the missing key, so thanks to that, he knew Anora would be found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Many years earlier, Kyuuka's parents had added a secret to their house. An entrance, or exit, nobody would notice. Kyuuka had seen it being used a handful of times.
entries.literal: "Many years earlier, Kyuuka's parents had added a secret to their house. An entrance, or exit, nobody would notice. Kyuuka had seen it being used a handful of times."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The rumors about the mansion were known by the whole town. The first time that someone had disappeared, the police had quickly shown up.{w} Yet, thanks to that well-hidden exit, Kyuuka's brother had avoided being caught.
entries.literal: "The rumors about the mansion were known by the whole town. The first time that someone had disappeared, the police had quickly shown up.{w} Yet, thanks to that well-hidden exit, Kyuuka's brother had avoided being caught."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kyuuka knew that when the police appeared, his brother would try to escape with the girl. However, with the key that he had taken, that would be impossible.
entries.literal: "Kyuuka knew that when the police appeared, his brother would try to escape with the girl. However, with the key that he had taken, that would be impossible."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Hey, Kyuuka. What was that?
entries.literal: "Hey, Kyuuka. What was that?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His brother had appeared from upstairs. Internally panicking, Kyuuka responded.
entries.literal: "His brother had appeared from upstairs. Internally panicking, Kyuuka responded."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: What was what?
entries.literal: "What was what?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: I heard a noise. Did you want to come see or something?
entries.literal: "I heard a noise. Did you want to come see or something?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...No. It was the TV.
entries.literal: "...No. It was the TV."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Ah, ah, okay. You have some free time though, right? Want to learn the works? Job training.
entries.literal: "Ah, ah, okay. You have some free time though, right? Want to learn the works? Job training."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: No. I'm tired, so maybe later.
entries.literal: "No. I'm tired, so maybe later."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: You say that every time. Oh well. I'll get back to it. If you don't want to learn the family business, you'd better go to school more. Keep your grades up. Hehe.
entries.literal: "You say that every time. Oh well. I'll get back to it. If you don't want to learn the family business, you'd better go to school more. Keep your grades up. Hehe."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He went back upstairs. A few minutes had passed since Kyuuka had gotten off the phone. He'd accidentally alerted his brother, but that danger was gone. All he had to worry about from that point on was looking like an accomplice.
entries.literal: "He went back upstairs. A few minutes had passed since Kyuuka had gotten off the phone. He'd accidentally alerted his brother, but that danger was gone. All he had to worry about from that point on was looking like an accomplice."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Barely seconds after his brother had gone back to the room, a sharp sound came from it.
entries.literal: "Barely seconds after his brother had gone back to the room, a sharp sound came from it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: No more yelling. No more anything. It was silent. A horrible feeling like being submerged in icy water overtook Kyuuka.
entries.literal: "No more yelling. No more anything. It was silent. A horrible feeling like being submerged in icy water overtook Kyuuka."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His brother had a gun. He knew that. What he didn't know was why he would just shoot the girl.
entries.literal: "His brother had a gun. He knew that. What he didn't know was why he would just shoot the girl."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The police were coming, and there was absolutely no chance his brother escaped with anything less than a murder charge. He deserved no less, but for him to kill her so suddenly was unthinkable. He hadn't given that impression at all a few seconds earlier.
entries.literal: "The police were coming, and there was absolutely no chance his brother escaped with anything less than a murder charge. He deserved no less, but for him to kill her so suddenly was unthinkable. He hadn't given that impression at all a few seconds earlier."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kyuuka stood up and stepped up the stairs, eyeing the door warily. Each of his footsteps was carefully placed to prevent a repeat of being detected.
entries.literal: "Kyuuka stood up and stepped up the stairs, eyeing the door warily. Each of his footsteps was carefully placed to prevent a repeat of being detected."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door wasn't locked. He gingerly nudged it open, not afraid that he'd see something worse than what he had before, but afraid that he might be shot by reflex.
entries.literal: "The door wasn't locked. He gingerly nudged it open, not afraid that he'd see something worse than what he had before, but afraid that he might be shot by reflex."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The body of Kyuuka's brother was on the floor, completely immobile. There was no doubt in his mind that he was dead.
entries.literal: "The body of Kyuuka's brother was on the floor, completely immobile. There was no doubt in his mind that he was dead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something connected in his mind. His brother hadn't gone up just to shoot her right away. She had shot him. His noise had been the distraction that allowed her to escape confinement and get a weapon.
entries.literal: "Something connected in his mind. His brother hadn't gone up just to shoot her right away. She had shot him. His noise had been the distraction that allowed her to escape confinement and get a weapon."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The girl wasn't in the usual chair he used. Around it was an untied rope, and bloodstains much older than the ones surrounding Kyuuka's brother.
entries.literal: "The girl wasn't in the usual chair he used. Around it was an untied rope, and bloodstains much older than the ones surrounding Kyuuka's brother."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But Kyuuka didn't see her anywhere. The girl had vanished. Bewildered, he stepped into the room.
entries.literal: "But Kyuuka didn't see her anywhere. The girl had vanished. Bewildered, he stepped into the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In an instant, she emerged from behind the door and shoved a gun up to his face. The barrel took up almost his entire field of vision.
entries.literal: "In an instant, she emerged from behind the door and shoved a gun up to his face. The barrel took up almost his entire field of vision."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He couldn't think of a thing to say. No longer feeling like he was sinking, he felt nothing.
entries.literal: "He couldn't think of a thing to say. No longer feeling like he was sinking, he felt nothing."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Give m-me one reason... not to... shoot you too.
entries.literal: "Give m-me one reason... not to... shoot you too."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...{w}I called the police. They're on their way right now.
entries.literal: "...{w}I called the police. They're on their way right now."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Wh-What...? When?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? When?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: A few minutes ago.
entries.literal: "A few minutes ago."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Her hand was shaking violently, and beyond the metal barrel, Kyuuka could see her face.
entries.literal: "Her hand was shaking violently, and beyond the metal barrel, Kyuuka could see her face."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One of her eyes was missing, and the pain, dulled as it must have been, was getting to her. Adrenaline couldn't keep her going against exhaustion forever.
entries.literal: "One of her eyes was missing, and the pain, dulled as it must have been, was getting to her. Adrenaline couldn't keep her going against exhaustion forever."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Why... Why wouldn't you c-call them earlier!? You were h-here... when I got here!
entries.literal: "Why... Why wouldn't you c-call them earlier!? You were h-here... when I got here!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't say anything for a few seconds. The wrong response could've killed him.
entries.literal: "He didn't say anything for a few seconds. The wrong response could've killed him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was clear that she was completely unstable. She had lost so much blood that her actions were slightly sluggish as well.
entries.literal: "It was clear that she was completely unstable. She had lost so much blood that her actions were slightly sluggish as well."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Do you know what he would have done if I'd called the police earlier? What he did to you, but worse.
entries.literal: "Do you know what he would have done if I'd called the police earlier? What he did to you, but worse."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Y-You didn't do anything! You let him... You let him do this!
entries.literal: "Y-You didn't do anything! You let him... You let him do this!"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...The police will be here in a few minutes. You're safe.
entries.literal: "...The police will be here in a few minutes. You're safe."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: I don't believe you!
entries.literal: "I don't believe you!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kyuuka considered for a moment. He didn't have a good way to escape. Entering the room blindly had been a mistake for him.
entries.literal: "Kyuuka considered for a moment. He didn't have a good way to escape. Entering the room blindly had been a mistake for him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had believed that even if she was just like everyone else, not worth caring about, it would be a good thing to put a stop to what his brother was doing to people. And it could have ended up costing him.{w} All Kyuuka had accomplished was getting him killed and putting himself in a dangerous position.
entries.literal: "He had believed that even if she was just like everyone else, not worth caring about, it would be a good thing to put a stop to what his brother was doing to people. And it could have ended up costing him.{w} All Kyuuka had accomplished was getting him killed and putting himself in a dangerous position."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was only one course of action he could take at that moment, and it happened almost automatically.
entries.literal: "There was only one course of action he could take at that moment, and it happened almost automatically."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After repeatedly knocking, the police forced the door open.
entries.literal: "After repeatedly knocking, the police forced the door open."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Drawn by the smell of blood and gunpowder, they immediately located the room where two corpses lay. A man and the kidnapped girl were on the floor.
entries.literal: "Drawn by the smell of blood and gunpowder, they immediately located the room where two corpses lay. A man and the kidnapped girl were on the floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Immediately, the entire mansion was secured, but nobody else was found.
entries.literal: "Immediately, the entire mansion was secured, but nobody else was found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next day, the news was published: Anora, the girl who'd disappeared, had been found dead high on a mountain. One of her eyes had been gouged out, and the other had a bullet through it. A bewildered Kyuuka read that article.
entries.literal: "The next day, the news was published: Anora, the girl who'd disappeared, had been found dead high on a mountain. One of her eyes had been gouged out, and the other had a bullet through it. A bewildered Kyuuka read that article."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That day, he came back home and realized that his parents were there.{w} As usual, he had no idea what they would say.
entries.literal: "That day, he came back home and realized that his parents were there.{w} As usual, he had no idea what they would say."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before they saw him, his parents looked terribly sad. However, when he appeared, relief spread through them.
entries.literal: "Before they saw him, his parents looked terribly sad. However, when he appeared, relief spread through them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His parents didn't talk about what had happened. While he found it strange, Kyuuka couldn't bring himself to utter a word about it either.
entries.literal: "His parents didn't talk about what had happened. While he found it strange, Kyuuka couldn't bring himself to utter a word about it either."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Kyuuka would be the family's final generation. That was something he was sure of.
entries.literal: "Kyuuka would be the family's final generation. That was something he was sure of."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, even that was stripped away. On paper, at least. After what had happened with his brother, his last name carried a heavy stigma, and so his parents took action.
entries.literal: "However, even that was stripped away. On paper, at least. After what had happened with his brother, his last name carried a heavy stigma, and so his parents took action."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He was released from that family. Then, he kept secretly living in that mansion until he was given a new place in the center of the town.
entries.literal: "He was released from that family. Then, he kept secretly living in that mansion until he was given a new place in the center of the town."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If nothing else, he appreciated that his job wasn't nearly as dirty as it could have been—and that he had some peace and quiet.
entries.literal: "If nothing else, he appreciated that his job wasn't nearly as dirty as it could have been—and that he had some peace and quiet."

entries.text: Molehill
entries.literal: "Molehill"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The lights turned on in the tower.{w} The lobby door opened, and a man stepped into the hallway.
entries.literal: "The lights turned on in the tower.{w} The lobby door opened, and a man stepped into the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Katei, who had recently changed into his working uniform. Ready to begin his morning shift, he entered the security room.
entries.literal: "It was Katei, who had recently changed into his working uniform. Ready to begin his morning shift, he entered the security room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His colleague Cou was ready to leave. After greeting each other, Katei sat on his chair.
entries.literal: "His colleague Cou was ready to leave. After greeting each other, Katei sat on his chair."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Over the phone, he'd learned Xyn had attacked again. It had happened on the 24th, and it had started during his own shift.{w} On that Thursday, there had been an event in the tower where many gemstones had been replaced. The next night, they had all been taken.
entries.literal: "Over the phone, he'd learned Xyn had attacked again. It had happened on the 24th, and it had started during his own shift.{w} On that Thursday, there had been an event in the tower where many gemstones had been replaced. The next night, they had all been taken."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Long ago, his job had started to exclusively revolve around Xyn. Ashiya had been outsmarted repeatedly, and every countermeasure they designed was continually bypassed.{w} It was Katei's job to put an end to those incidents. However, his thoughts on Ashiya were far from positive. He'd worked in the tower for years, and he knew information that eluded public knowledge.
entries.literal: "Long ago, his job had started to exclusively revolve around Xyn. Ashiya had been outsmarted repeatedly, and every countermeasure they designed was continually bypassed.{w} It was Katei's job to put an end to those incidents. However, his thoughts on Ashiya were far from positive. He'd worked in the tower for years, and he knew information that eluded public knowledge."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He was fully aware that none of his superiors belonged to the Ashiya family anymore. It had been long ago when the corporation had lost all ties to their actual bloodline.
entries.literal: "He was fully aware that none of his superiors belonged to the Ashiya family anymore. It had been long ago when the corporation had lost all ties to their actual bloodline."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei stared at the three monitors in front of him, and as he moved the cursor toward a folder, his heart began to race.
entries.literal: "Katei stared at the three monitors in front of him, and as he moved the cursor toward a folder, his heart began to race."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Xyn had circumvented their measures multiple times, but that hadn't been all. Camera footage had been erased, and they'd taken advantage of the rare times when the security room had been empty.
entries.literal: "Xyn had circumvented their measures multiple times, but that hadn't been all. Camera footage had been erased, and they'd taken advantage of the rare times when the security room had been empty."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei knew someone close to them worked for Xyn. There was no other explanation anymore.
entries.literal: "Katei knew someone close to them worked for Xyn. There was no other explanation anymore."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There were many candidates he had considered, but they'd all looked clean. As he approached a hidden folder, he wondered again who it was. A few places in the tower weren't fitted with cameras, but trying to catch Xyn on video had long ago started to feel like a futile effort.
entries.literal: "There were many candidates he had considered, but they'd all looked clean. As he approached a hidden folder, he wondered again who it was. A few places in the tower weren't fitted with cameras, but trying to catch Xyn on video had long ago started to feel like a futile effort."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei had ruminated on something for quite a while. He wanted to use the places without cameras to catch the infiltrator.
entries.literal: "Katei had ruminated on something for quite a while. He wanted to use the places without cameras to catch the infiltrator."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before arriving at the tower, he'd been told that footage of hallway A had been erased. That was why he'd been nervous all morning.
entries.literal: "Before arriving at the tower, he'd been told that footage of hallway A had been erased. That was why he'd been nervous all morning."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But he had to be careful. Opening that folder might've been a bad idea.
entries.literal: "But he had to be careful. Opening that folder might've been a bad idea."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How had Xyn erased the footage? It had always happened during times when the security room was vacant, but Katei thought that was off. Most recently, it had happened when he'd been out, but he didn't think anyone would've had enough time to remove the footage.
entries.literal: "How had Xyn erased the footage? It had always happened during times when the security room was vacant, but Katei thought that was off. Most recently, it had happened when he'd been out, but he didn't think anyone would've had enough time to remove the footage."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Could that computer have been infected? Like he'd done in the past, he spent the entire morning cleaning it up as much as he could.
entries.literal: "Could that computer have been infected? Like he'd done in the past, he spent the entire morning cleaning it up as much as he could."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And when he was done, he sent the folder to an e-mail address that he had created at home.
entries.literal: "And when he was done, he sent the folder to an e-mail address that he had created at home."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That evening, he hurried to his personal computer. He'd been wondering all day if his plan had worked.
entries.literal: "That evening, he hurried to his personal computer. He'd been wondering all day if his plan had worked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He hadn't spoken to anyone about it. There was no way Xyn had known about it.
entries.literal: "He hadn't spoken to anyone about it. There was no way Xyn had known about it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Finally, he logged into his account and downloaded the folder.
entries.literal: "Finally, he logged into his account and downloaded the folder."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Inside it, there was a long video.
entries.literal: "Inside it, there was a long video."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The day before Xyn's attack, he'd been forced to momentarily rush out of the security room. During that time, part of the footage had been erased.
entries.literal: "The day before Xyn's attack, he'd been forced to momentarily rush out of the security room. During that time, part of the footage had been erased."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei had been waiting for that to happen. That was why, when he'd dashed out of the security room, he hadn't closed its door.
entries.literal: "Katei had been waiting for that to happen. That was why, when he'd dashed out of the security room, he hadn't closed its door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The footage from hallway A had been erased, but had Xyn accounted for Katei's idea? During that time, another camera had been recording part of the hallway.
entries.literal: "The footage from hallway A had been erased, but had Xyn accounted for Katei's idea? During that time, another camera had been recording part of the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The computer's webcam, tucked behind one of the monitors. It spent most of the time turned off, but that time, it had been recording the hallway through the open door.{w} Katei had pressed a button behind the camera to begin the recording, and it wasn't a new device in the tower. There was no way Xyn had learned of his plan.
entries.literal: "The computer's webcam, tucked behind one of the monitors. It spent most of the time turned off, but that time, it had been recording the hallway through the open door.{w} Katei had pressed a button behind the camera to begin the recording, and it wasn't a new device in the tower. There was no way Xyn had learned of his plan."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei played the video, his trembling hand advancing it to the time he'd left the room. That had been the only time of the day when he hadn't monitored hallway A, so Xyn must've wanted to hide those few seconds.
entries.literal: "Katei played the video, his trembling hand advancing it to the time he'd left the room. That had been the only time of the day when he hadn't monitored hallway A, so Xyn must've wanted to hide those few seconds."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The time was before {time=9.} When Katei saw his face disappearing from the video, he let go of the mouse.{w} Then, he saw all he needed to see.{w} Through hallway A, someone he knew passed by. They were pushing a cleaning cart.
entries.literal: "The time was before {time=9.} When Katei saw his face disappearing from the video, he let go of the mouse.{w} Then, he saw all he needed to see.{w} Through hallway A, someone he knew passed by. They were pushing a cleaning cart."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was what Xyn had wanted to hide. Finally, he knew the identity of the infiltrator.{w} Ido, the janitor.
entries.literal: "That was what Xyn had wanted to hide. Finally, he knew the identity of the infiltrator.{w} Ido, the janitor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...But he still didn't know what had happened. Gemstones had been stolen from one of the rooms, but that hadn't happened until the following night. Yet, when they'd gone through the available footage, nobody had entered that room at the time of the attack.
entries.literal: "...But he still didn't know what had happened. Gemstones had been stolen from one of the rooms, but that hadn't happened until the following night. Yet, when they'd gone through the available footage, nobody had entered that room at the time of the attack."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Had they been moved? Katei stared at the cleaning cart, wondering if they'd been inside it. If that was the case, they could've immediately been taken out. However, during the time of the attack, Ido hadn't been in the building.
entries.literal: "Had they been moved? Katei stared at the cleaning cart, wondering if they'd been inside it. If that was the case, they could've immediately been taken out. However, during the time of the attack, Ido hadn't been in the building."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was something else of value Katei learned. The footage of some cameras had been erased while he was out of the security room. However, as he'd suspected, nobody had entered it before his return.
entries.literal: "There was something else of value Katei learned. The footage of some cameras had been erased while he was out of the security room. However, as he'd suspected, nobody had entered it before his return."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei had started working in the tower decades ago, and many years were still ahead of him. He had worked on the building's security before the security room had been constructed, but that hadn't always been his job.
entries.literal: "Katei had started working in the tower decades ago, and many years were still ahead of him. He had worked on the building's security before the security room had been constructed, but that hadn't always been his job."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he looked at the future, he hated it. He loathed the thought of working there for even another year.
entries.literal: "When he looked at the future, he hated it. He loathed the thought of working there for even another year."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had no respect for Ashiya, and there was nothing about what the company had become that he identified with. He had seen the building change over the years to the point where it simply didn't feel the same.
entries.literal: "He had no respect for Ashiya, and there was nothing about what the company had become that he identified with. He had seen the building change over the years to the point where it simply didn't feel the same."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Since Xyn had reared their head in pursuit of Ashiya, some concepts had become tempting to Katei.
entries.literal: "Since Xyn had reared their head in pursuit of Ashiya, some concepts had become tempting to Katei."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: During his night shifts, he was sometimes the only person in the building. He had given plenty of thought to taking out Ashiya's collection of gemstones.
entries.literal: "During his night shifts, he was sometimes the only person in the building. He had given plenty of thought to taking out Ashiya's collection of gemstones."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It should've been simple. It had happened before, so he could claim that the security footage had suddenly been erased and that he hadn't seen anything through the monitors.
entries.literal: "It should've been simple. It had happened before, so he could claim that the security footage had suddenly been erased and that he hadn't seen anything through the monitors."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But that was too dangerous. Xyn seemed to know everything that happened in that place. What if they exposed Katei as being responsible? Would they dislike being impersonated? He was worried they would threaten him too.{w} And even if none of that happened, Katei didn't know what he'd do with those gems.
entries.literal: "But that was too dangerous. Xyn seemed to know everything that happened in that place. What if they exposed Katei as being responsible? Would they dislike being impersonated? He was worried they would threaten him too.{w} And even if none of that happened, Katei didn't know what he'd do with those gems."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After everything, Katei didn't think it was fair that he had to keep working there; he couldn't bear the thought of staying in that place for much longer. His parents had died, and he wouldn't be able to support himself for too long if he left his job. ...It wasn't fair.{w} After Xyn's first attack, his mind had produced various scenarios that gave him what he wanted.
entries.literal: "After everything, Katei didn't think it was fair that he had to keep working there; he couldn't bear the thought of staying in that place for much longer. His parents had died, and he wouldn't be able to support himself for too long if he left his job. ...It wasn't fair.{w} After Xyn's first attack, his mind had produced various scenarios that gave him what he wanted."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the morning came, Katei had slept very little. He'd wanted to find a Xyn member for so long, and he was confident he finally had.{w} Months ago, he'd come up with a tempting plan. However, it was fairly large scale, so he'd been very hesitant to set it into motion.
entries.literal: "When the morning came, Katei had slept very little. He'd wanted to find a Xyn member for so long, and he was confident he finally had.{w} Months ago, he'd come up with a tempting plan. However, it was fairly large scale, so he'd been very hesitant to set it into motion."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He left his house earlier than usual. On the way, he called Lei. She was the only person he'd always been confident wasn't part of Xyn, as she wanted to catch them more than anyone else.
entries.literal: "He left his house earlier than usual. On the way, he called Lei. She was the only person he'd always been confident wasn't part of Xyn, as she wanted to catch them more than anyone else."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Katei? What do you want?
entries.literal: "Katei? What do you want?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I would like to talk to you later. It might not be a good idea to do it in the tower, so if I can meet you outside before my shift starts, that'd be great.
entries.literal: "I would like to talk to you later. It might not be a good idea to do it in the tower, so if I can meet you outside before my shift starts, that'd be great."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Is it important?
entries.literal: "Is it important?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: I understand. I will be there as soon as I can.
entries.literal: "I understand. I will be there as soon as I can."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Thank you.
entries.literal: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Outside the tower's entrance, Katei and Lei met. Furtively, they stepped aside.
entries.literal: "Outside the tower's entrance, Katei and Lei met. Furtively, they stepped aside."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: What is it?
entries.literal: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I've had this idea for some time. If we're ever going to do something like this, it's right now.
entries.literal: "I've had this idea for some time. If we're ever going to do something like this, it's right now."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After hearing that, Lei frowned. Meanwhile, Katei thought of the best way to phrase what he'd wanted to say for months.
entries.literal: "After hearing that, Lei frowned. Meanwhile, Katei thought of the best way to phrase what he'd wanted to say for months."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: It's evident Xyn has a way to be in the tower without being seen, even when we're prepared. I believe we have to stop trying to see them while they're attacking.
entries.literal: "It's evident Xyn has a way to be in the tower without being seen, even when we're prepared. I believe we have to stop trying to see them while they're attacking."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: When we added locks to the cabinets, they were able to unlock them and even broke some of them. It was a while ago, but remember what we thought? We removed those locks to prevent future damage and because that would incite Xyn to easily come back, so we'd be able to catch them.
entries.literal: "When we added locks to the cabinets, they were able to unlock them and even broke some of them. It was a while ago, but remember what we thought? We removed those locks to prevent future damage and because that would incite Xyn to easily come back, so we'd be able to catch them."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: We added an alarm to be alerted that cabinets were opened, but it didn't go off when they attacked. At this point, I find it impossible to believe they can't externally access the computer. I've looked into it many times, but that has to be true.
entries.literal: "We added an alarm to be alerted that cabinets were opened, but it didn't go off when they attacked. At this point, I find it impossible to believe they can't externally access the computer. I've looked into it many times, but that has to be true."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Do you think we should change out the computer entirely?
entries.literal: "Do you think we should change out the computer entirely?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: No. Access to our computer can't be all they have. If we change it, they'll immediately know they lost that information, which could be bad. I would also not be able to protect the new computer at all times.{w} I have an idea. If I develop the mechanism behind a new alarm at home, it's possible they won't be able to bypass it.{w} I think this is what we should do so that they don't think we're suspicious of anything involving our computer setup.{w} Once I set up the software for this at home, I'll bring it to the tower's computer. If I do it well, it's unlikely they'll notice it.
entries.literal: "No. Access to our computer can't be all they have. If we change it, they'll immediately know they lost that information, which could be bad. I would also not be able to protect the new computer at all times.{w} I have an idea. If I develop the mechanism behind a new alarm at home, it's possible they won't be able to bypass it.{w} I think this is what we should do so that they don't think we're suspicious of anything involving our computer setup.{w} Once I set up the software for this at home, I'll bring it to the tower's computer. If I do it well, it's unlikely they'll notice it."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: ...I see. I think that's worth doing.
entries.literal: "...I see. I think that's worth doing."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Me too, but we have to be smart. If this works, we have to catch them.{w} We can't screw this up. If they really activate the alarm, they might still have a method of escape. We have to make sure that won't be possible.
entries.literal: "Me too, but we have to be smart. If this works, we have to catch them.{w} We can't screw this up. If they really activate the alarm, they might still have a method of escape. We have to make sure that won't be possible."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: How?
entries.literal: "How?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I can build it so that when the alarm is activated, any exits will close. As soon as they open a cabinet, they will be stuck in the tower.{w} I have thought a lot about this. They have attacked during times I was in the security room, so we'll make sure one of us is always there. If the mechanism also locks that door, we will trap the attacker.
entries.literal: "I can build it so that when the alarm is activated, any exits will close. As soon as they open a cabinet, they will be stuck in the tower.{w} I have thought a lot about this. They have attacked during times I was in the security room, so we'll make sure one of us is always there. If the mechanism also locks that door, we will trap the attacker."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: ...Do you think this could work?
entries.literal: "...Do you think this could work?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: It must. They have always attacked during the night, so I'm confident it will go smoothly.
entries.literal: "It must. They have always attacked during the night, so I'm confident it will go smoothly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For the first time in what seemed like forever, Lei thought that one of Katei's ideas had real promise.
entries.literal: "For the first time in what seemed like forever, Lei thought that one of Katei's ideas had real promise."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: How would the exits be locked, though?
entries.literal: "How would the exits be locked, though?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: That's what I can't handle. If I use the old system, I can have the mechanism ready for tomorrow. The installation would have to be done during the night, though, when no one else is here.{w} It will be independent of the computer, so Xyn shouldn't learn about it. I believe it's possible they're receiving the camera's feed, but the lobby isn't recorded, so they won't see it.
entries.literal: "That's what I can't handle. If I use the old system, I can have the mechanism ready for tomorrow. The installation would have to be done during the night, though, when no one else is here.{w} It will be independent of the computer, so Xyn shouldn't learn about it. I believe it's possible they're receiving the camera's feed, but the lobby isn't recorded, so they won't see it."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: But what about the windows? Shouldn't they be shut as well?
entries.literal: "But what about the windows? Shouldn't they be shut as well?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: ...You're right—that would be seen. I wouldn't like to disable the camera system because they could learn something is being done under their noses.{w} Nothing happens on the higher floors during the night. I can modify the system from home as well to disable those cameras and loop a still image of the floors, then quickly install the modification on the tower's computer. I doubt Xyn will look at that footage, but if they do, they shouldn't notice the cameras were stopped.
entries.literal: "...You're right—that would be seen. I wouldn't like to disable the camera system because they could learn something is being done under their noses.{w} Nothing happens on the higher floors during the night. I can modify the system from home as well to disable those cameras and loop a still image of the floors, then quickly install the modification on the tower's computer. I doubt Xyn will look at that footage, but if they do, they shouldn't notice the cameras were stopped."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: However, we can't do it like the last time. Altering every cabinet to trigger the alarm is something that could easily be noticed, and it would take a long time.
entries.literal: "However, we can't do it like the last time. Altering every cabinet to trigger the alarm is something that could easily be noticed, and it would take a long time."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: That's true, but it's what we would have to do.
entries.literal: "That's true, but it's what we would have to do."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: We can draw them to a specific cabinet. Do you remember when we obtained the Nomdaid? It was targeted by Xyn immediately.{w} If we procure something of that caliber, Xyn won't be able to resist a repeat. That will be the cabinet we'll need to alter, and since it won't be one currently displayed, we can modify it before they know it exists.
entries.literal: "We can draw them to a specific cabinet. Do you remember when we obtained the Nomdaid? It was targeted by Xyn immediately.{w} If we procure something of that caliber, Xyn won't be able to resist a repeat. That will be the cabinet we'll need to alter, and since it won't be one currently displayed, we can modify it before they know it exists."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lei nodded thoughtfully. Katei's plan could definitely work.
entries.literal: "Lei nodded thoughtfully. Katei's plan could definitely work."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: I see. I will try to find a good fit for that.
entries.literal: "I see. I will try to find a good fit for that."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Perfect. We should hurry up before they attack again.{w} If I'm not mistaken, the event for the 15th of next month was hindered. It was going to be a guided tour to cover the last wave of gems, but that can't be done anymore.
entries.literal: "Perfect. We should hurry up before they attack again.{w} If I'm not mistaken, the event for the 15th of next month was hindered. It was going to be a guided tour to cover the last wave of gems, but that can't be done anymore."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: That's right. It's canceled as of now.
entries.literal: "That's right. It's canceled as of now."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: When you find a suitable gemstone, announce it'll be shown on that Thursday. This way, if Xyn doesn't attack beforehand, we'll still solve that problem.
entries.literal: "When you find a suitable gemstone, announce it'll be shown on that Thursday. This way, if Xyn doesn't attack beforehand, we'll still solve that problem."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: That's a very good idea. I'll do that.
entries.literal: "That's a very good idea. I'll do that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei nodded slowly. That was what he'd needed the most.{w} The 15th was a Thursday, and also the middle point of the month. That meant that it was the day his work shift would change. In the first half of the month, Katei worked during the night, and in the second half, he worked during the morning.{w} Up until the 15th, he'd be in the tower all night, ready for Xyn's attack. However, he'd also learned Xyn made daylight moves. So, if the attack didn't happen before the 15th, Katei would be present during the event.
entries.literal: "Katei nodded slowly. That was what he'd needed the most.{w} The 15th was a Thursday, and also the middle point of the month. That meant that it was the day his work shift would change. In the first half of the month, Katei worked during the night, and in the second half, he worked during the morning.{w} Up until the 15th, he'd be in the tower all night, ready for Xyn's attack. However, he'd also learned Xyn made daylight moves. So, if the attack didn't happen before the 15th, Katei would be present during the event."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: I will do my best to find something appropriate. When it's ready, we'll put it in a prepared cabinet, and you will enable the system on the tower's computer.
entries.literal: "I will do my best to find something appropriate. When it's ready, we'll put it in a prepared cabinet, and you will enable the system on the tower's computer."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Why don't we do it differently? Why not make it so that opening the cabinet locks the room it's in, as opposed to the entire building?
entries.literal: "Why don't we do it differently? Why not make it so that opening the cabinet locks the room it's in, as opposed to the entire building?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: No. That could go wrong. Altering those doors is much more likely to be noticed, and if someone inside the room was quick, they could get out before being trapped.
entries.literal: "No. That could go wrong. Altering those doors is much more likely to be noticed, and if someone inside the room was quick, they could get out before being trapped."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei's voice was stern. He couldn't waver in initiating the plan.
entries.literal: "Katei's voice was stern. He couldn't waver in initiating the plan."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: You think so? I was thinking about a mechanical lock, not a shutter.
entries.literal: "You think so? I was thinking about a mechanical lock, not a shutter."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: That wouldn't work. They could keep the door open and put a hard object between it and the wall to prevent it from locking. I'm aware my idea is more complex, but we can't risk this.
entries.literal: "That wouldn't work. They could keep the door open and put a hard object between it and the wall to prevent it from locking. I'm aware my idea is more complex, but we can't risk this."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: All right, we'll talk about it further.{w} I will let Cou know about this when he leaves, and I'll speak to Wis. Is that fine?
entries.literal: "All right, we'll talk about it further.{w} I will let Cou know about this when he leaves, and I'll speak to Wis. Is that fine?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei nodded after a pause. Cou and Wis were the first people he'd personally investigated, as they shared his job. He couldn't be completely certain, but he really didn't think they were part of Xyn.{w} Katei's shift was about to start, so he bowed and stepped into the tower. As he walked to the security room, he sighed, relieved Lei hadn't put more pressure on him.{w} That would've prevented what he had in mind. It was something only he could do, and it was thanks to a key that had once saved him.
entries.literal: "Katei nodded after a pause. Cou and Wis were the first people he'd personally investigated, as they shared his job. He couldn't be completely certain, but he really didn't think they were part of Xyn.{w} Katei's shift was about to start, so he bowed and stepped into the tower. As he walked to the security room, he sighed, relieved Lei hadn't put more pressure on him.{w} That would've prevented what he had in mind. It was something only he could do, and it was thanks to a key that had once saved him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the 6th of December. Katei had been shut in the security room for a few hours.
entries.literal: "It was the 6th of December. Katei had been shut in the security room for a few hours."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He was staring at the screens, knowing Xyn's attack could come at any time.
entries.literal: "He was staring at the screens, knowing Xyn's attack could come at any time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suddenly, an alarm blared. Immediately, he knew they were in the building.{w} But he didn't understand how that could be. Through the monitors, he couldn't see anyone anywhere.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, an alarm blared. Immediately, he knew they were in the building.{w} But he didn't understand how that could be. Through the monitors, he couldn't see anyone anywhere."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Ah, I see. The security system was hacked. It almost worked.
entries.literal: "Ah, I see. The security system was hacked. It almost worked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei smirked. Before the alarm ceased, he found the anomaly in the system. Xyn had sabotaged it without being noticed.
entries.literal: "Katei smirked. Before the alarm ceased, he found the anomaly in the system. Xyn had sabotaged it without being noticed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei fixed the problem, all the screens updated, and through one, he saw a man in the event room. He looked disconcerted, desperately glancing around him.
entries.literal: "When Katei fixed the problem, all the screens updated, and through one, he saw a man in the event room. He looked disconcerted, desperately glancing around him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei moved the microphone close to his mouth and turned it on. When he spoke, his voice played everywhere in the building.
entries.literal: "Katei moved the microphone close to his mouth and turned it on. When he spoke, his voice played everywhere in the building."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: We knew you would come. The gemstone in front of you was all we needed to draw you here.
entries.literal: "We knew you would come. The gemstone in front of you was all we needed to draw you here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The man looked up, trying to find the source of the audio. Because his face was covered, Katei couldn't tell who he was.
entries.literal: "The man looked up, trying to find the source of the audio. Because his face was covered, Katei couldn't tell who he was."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Unfortunately, you have been trapped. You won't be able to leave this building.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, you have been trapped. You won't be able to leave this building."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he heard that, the man ran to the lobby. He disappeared from Katei's sight, but he soon reappeared, dashing toward the staircase.
entries.literal: "When he heard that, the man ran to the lobby. He disappeared from Katei's sight, but he soon reappeared, dashing toward the staircase."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: It's futile. The way to the second floor is locked, and the elevator has been disabled.
entries.literal: "It's futile. The way to the second floor is locked, and the elevator has been disabled."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The man ignored Katei's voice and took out a key.
entries.literal: "The man ignored Katei's voice and took out a key."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Oh, Xyn even has that key? I'm impressed.
entries.literal: "Oh, Xyn even has that key? I'm impressed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With it, he unlocked the door protecting the next floor. However, when he saw the windows, he slowed down, unable to accept it.
entries.literal: "With it, he unlocked the door protecting the next floor. However, when he saw the windows, he slowed down, unable to accept it."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Haha, it's useless! All the windows have been sealed. You cannot escape.
entries.literal: "Haha, it's useless! All the windows have been sealed. You cannot escape."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The man didn't give up. Instead, he turned around and ran to where Katei was.
entries.literal: "The man didn't give up. Instead, he turned around and ran to where Katei was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He arrived at the security room, slamming into the door behind Katei.
entries.literal: "He arrived at the security room, slamming into the door behind Katei."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: This door is perfectly shut. You will not open it.
entries.literal: "This door is perfectly shut. You will not open it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Finally, the man seemed to give up. After a few seconds of silence, he stepped back and fell defeatedly to the floor.
entries.literal: "Finally, the man seemed to give up. After a few seconds of silence, he stepped back and fell defeatedly to the floor."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Now you understand your position.{w} When the alarm played, Ashiya were notified. They will be here in less than ten minutes.{w} Before that, there's something I want to tell you.
entries.literal: "Now you understand your position.{w} When the alarm played, Ashiya were notified. They will be here in less than ten minutes.{w} Before that, there's something I want to tell you."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Slowly, the man looked up, once again trying to determine where Katei's voice was coming from.
entries.literal: "Slowly, the man looked up, once again trying to determine where Katei's voice was coming from."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: It is not possible for me to unlock the exit. For that, Ashiya's input is needed.{w} However, I know of a secret way out.
entries.literal: "It is not possible for me to unlock the exit. For that, Ashiya's input is needed.{w} However, I know of a secret way out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei said that, the man stood back up. Had his hearing failed him?
entries.literal: "When Katei said that, the man stood back up. Had his hearing failed him?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: In this building, there's a hidden door. I have also hidden the key you'll need to unlock it somewhere here.{w} If you don't waste time, you can leave before Ashiya comes.{w} This alarm has never been activated before. I will tell them that a malfunction set it off. If nobody's found when the building is unlocked, they will believe my word.{w} If you want that, there are two conditions you must agree on.{w} You have stolen from us countless times—it is undeniable that Xyn must be a wealthy group. For your liberty, you will provide me with 50 million yen. I believe that is a fair sum.{w} Secondly, you must reveal your identity in front of the cameras.{w} I know you, Xyn.
