I know a lot more than you think.{w} Ido is the mole; I know where you gather, and I've investigated many of you.{w} Just like I know you, you know me. For that reason, if anything were to happen to me, this recording and all the information I have will be immediately exposed.{w} Do you agree to these conditions?
entries.literal: "In this building, there's a hidden door. I have also hidden the key you'll need to unlock it somewhere here.{w} If you don't waste time, you can leave before Ashiya comes.{w} This alarm has never been activated before. I will tell them that a malfunction set it off. If nobody's found when the building is unlocked, they will believe my word.{w} If you want that, there are two conditions you must agree on.{w} You have stolen from us countless times—it is undeniable that Xyn must be a wealthy group. For your liberty, you will provide me with 50 million yen. I believe that is a fair sum.{w} Secondly, you must reveal your identity in front of the cameras.{w} I know you, Xyn. I know a lot more than you think.{w} Ido is the mole; I know where you gather, and I've investigated many of you.{w} Just like I know you, you know me. For that reason, if anything were to happen to me, this recording and all the information I have will be immediately exposed.{w} Do you agree to these conditions?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The loud voice faded with static. Before the silence could grow uncomfortable, the man nodded.{w} Then, he slowly took off his mask.
entries.literal: "The loud voice faded with static. Before the silence could grow uncomfortable, the man nodded.{w} Then, he slowly took off his mask."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: B-{w=0.2}Brother?
entries.literal: "B-{w=0.2}Brother?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei saw his brother's face, he snapped out of his daydream.
entries.literal: "When Katei saw his brother's face, he snapped out of his daydream."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was going to work; Lei hadn't suspected him at all. After going over his plan and stepping into the security room, he reassured himself.
entries.literal: "It was going to work; Lei hadn't suspected him at all. After going over his plan and stepping into the security room, he reassured himself."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei got home and took something out of a drawer. He finally had a use for it.
entries.literal: "Katei got home and took something out of a drawer. He finally had a use for it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: All staff members were often checked despite their positions, and they had to leave their phones behind before beginning their work.{w} That was the reason Katei had set an alarm so early.
entries.literal: "All staff members were often checked despite their positions, and they had to leave their phones behind before beginning their work.{w} That was the reason Katei had set an alarm so early."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before the sun had risen, he was outside the tower.
entries.literal: "Before the sun had risen, he was outside the tower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A while later, he showed himself in the lobby to begin his shift.
entries.literal: "A while later, he showed himself in the lobby to begin his shift."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once hours had passed, he left the security room and walked down the hallway.{w} He entered the storeroom, leaving it shortly after.
entries.literal: "Once hours had passed, he left the security room and walked down the hallway.{w} He entered the storeroom, leaving it shortly after."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had seen Ido cleaning those hallways countless times. He knew Ido was given multiple keys, which he often had at the front of the cleaning cart.{w} Katei waited for Ido to exit the building. Snow had just stopped falling, and Ashiya always wanted to keep the plaza outside the tower free of any buildup.
entries.literal: "He had seen Ido cleaning those hallways countless times. He knew Ido was given multiple keys, which he often had at the front of the cleaning cart.{w} Katei waited for Ido to exit the building. Snow had just stopped falling, and Ashiya always wanted to keep the plaza outside the tower free of any buildup."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was when Katei walked to the cleaning room. The cart was there—Ido didn't always bring it with him, so he examined it carefully. However, he was surprised to find what he wanted on one of the shelves instead. It was the key he needed.
entries.literal: "That was when Katei walked to the cleaning room. The cart was there—Ido didn't always bring it with him, so he examined it carefully. However, he was surprised to find what he wanted on one of the shelves instead. It was the key he needed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He brought it to the staff room. There, he unlocked Ido's locker. Every day, Ido would change into a white uniform, leaving his normal clothes behind.
entries.literal: "He brought it to the staff room. There, he unlocked Ido's locker. Every day, Ido would change into a white uniform, leaving his normal clothes behind."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His coat, which he always wore, was hanging inside. As fast as he could, Katei took the tiny device he'd retrieved in the storeroom and attached it to the coat's neck, where it'd be close to Ido's mouth.
entries.literal: "His coat, which he always wore, was hanging inside. As fast as he could, Katei took the tiny device he'd retrieved in the storeroom and attached it to the coat's neck, where it'd be close to Ido's mouth."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he got back to the security room, he tested it to see if it was working.
entries.literal: "When he got back to the security room, he tested it to see if it was working."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What he had attached to Ido's clothes was linked to a tiny playback device. He took it out, and when he pressed the record button, a flat line appeared on the screen, indicating it was receiving audio feed.
entries.literal: "What he had attached to Ido's clothes was linked to a tiny playback device. He took it out, and when he pressed the record button, a flat line appeared on the screen, indicating it was receiving audio feed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The internal storage of the device would quickly run out, so he had inserted a large SD card in the back. Katei pressed the play button, and soft static began to come out of the speaker. Nothing else played, but he knew that nothing was making any sound in the staff room.
entries.literal: "The internal storage of the device would quickly run out, so he had inserted a large SD card in the back. Katei pressed the play button, and soft static began to come out of the speaker. Nothing else played, but he knew that nothing was making any sound in the staff room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He couldn't risk leaving the tower with the device, and he had to go to the storeroom only when it was absolutely necessary. When the hallways were empty, he went back to the staff room and left the device in his locker.
entries.literal: "He couldn't risk leaving the tower with the device, and he had to go to the storeroom only when it was absolutely necessary. When the hallways were empty, he went back to the staff room and left the device in his locker."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next day, he listened to what had been recorded. The waveform highlighted the noisy moments, but after minutes of perusing, he realized nothing of importance was there.{w} After Ido's job had ended, he'd walked home and hadn't left again until the next morning.
entries.literal: "The next day, he listened to what had been recorded. The waveform highlighted the noisy moments, but after minutes of perusing, he realized nothing of importance was there.{w} After Ido's job had ended, he'd walked home and hadn't left again until the next morning."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From there, all Katei had to do was wait for Lei to do her job.
entries.literal: "From there, all Katei had to do was wait for Lei to do her job."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The following day was a Sunday. Even though the tower was closed, Katei still had to work in it.
entries.literal: "The following day was a Sunday. Even though the tower was closed, Katei still had to work in it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Alone on the crystal floor, Katei skimmed through the newest audio. Once again, it seemed nothing substantial had been recorded.
entries.literal: "Alone on the crystal floor, Katei skimmed through the newest audio. Once again, it seemed nothing substantial had been recorded."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On Monday the 28th, he stepped into the building. Very few days of his morning shift remained.{w} He listened to what the bug had recorded, and yet again, he hadn't obtained anything valuable. It appeared Ido was always at home.
entries.literal: "On Monday the 28th, he stepped into the building. Very few days of his morning shift remained.{w} He listened to what the bug had recorded, and yet again, he hadn't obtained anything valuable. It appeared Ido was always at home."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Could he have been mistaken? What if Ido wasn't with Xyn?{w} Perhaps that wasn't it. Maybe they were too careful, and spying on them like that was never going to work.
entries.literal: "Could he have been mistaken? What if Ido wasn't with Xyn?{w} Perhaps that wasn't it. Maybe they were too careful, and spying on them like that was never going to work."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei was hesitant. He didn't have a lot of time, and his will was wavering.
entries.literal: "Katei was hesitant. He didn't have a lot of time, and his will was wavering."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That afternoon, he received Lei's call.
entries.literal: "That afternoon, he received Lei's call."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Hello. I believe I found what we needed.
entries.literal: "Hello. I believe I found what we needed."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: ...You found a special gemstone?
entries.literal: "...You found a special gemstone?"

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: Yes. I just went to see it, and I think it'll fit what we need.{w} Apparently, Gan found it yesterday on Airun. It's a white, egg-shaped stone, bright and smooth, that he called the "Sekimeiya".
entries.literal: "Yes. I just went to see it, and I think it'll fit what we need.{w} Apparently, Gan found it yesterday on Airun. It's a white, egg-shaped stone, bright and smooth, that he called the \"Sekimeiya\"."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Good. Anything should work as long as we advertise it like the last time.{w} I have finished doing my part, by the way.
entries.literal: "Good. Anything should work as long as we advertise it like the last time.{w} I have finished doing my part, by the way."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: The alarm system's done? Perfect. We'll have the Sekimeiya on the 30th, so we might want to install the alarm the night before.
entries.literal: "The alarm system's done? Perfect. We'll have the Sekimeiya on the 30th, so we might want to install the alarm the night before."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei began to get very worried. If Ido wasn't part of the group, he had to know. He wondered if he could do something with the information Lei had just given him.
entries.literal: "Katei began to get very worried. If Ido wasn't part of the group, he had to know. He wondered if he could do something with the information Lei had just given him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei's lone hunt had begun far in the past. He had looked into most employees and had conversed with all of them. Although he hadn't determined anything at the time, that might've ended up being useful, as Ido wouldn't find it strange if Katei suddenly talked to him.
entries.literal: "Katei's lone hunt had begun far in the past. He had looked into most employees and had conversed with all of them. Although he hadn't determined anything at the time, that might've ended up being useful, as Ido wouldn't find it strange if Katei suddenly talked to him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had to make sure he wasn't mistaken, so he briefly exited the security room and walked to the lobby.
entries.literal: "He had to make sure he wasn't mistaken, so he briefly exited the security room and walked to the lobby."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Hey. How's it going?
entries.literal: "Hey. How's it going?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Ido turned to Katei and bowed with a jolly expression.
entries.literal: "Ido turned to Katei and bowed with a jolly expression."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: Everything has been going good, thank you for asking. How about you?
entries.literal: "Everything has been going good, thank you for asking. How about you?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: ...I don't think I can say the same, unfortunately. You know what happened on the 24th. We're doing our best to catch Xyn, but we're as lost as ever.
entries.literal: "...I don't think I can say the same, unfortunately. You know what happened on the 24th. We're doing our best to catch Xyn, but we're as lost as ever."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: Is that so...? I hope you can figure them out soon.
entries.literal: "Is that so...? I hope you can figure them out soon."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Me too, but we're in a bit of a hurry. The event for the 15th was changed. We're going to pick up a valuable gemstone this Wednesday, and you probably remember what happened the last time an event of this caliber was about to be held. ...We have to catch them before that day.
entries.literal: "Me too, but we're in a bit of a hurry. The event for the 15th was changed. We're going to pick up a valuable gemstone this Wednesday, and you probably remember what happened the last time an event of this caliber was about to be held. ...We have to catch them before that day."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: Oh, really? I hadn't heard about that.
entries.literal: "Oh, really? I hadn't heard about that."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Yeah, it's called the Sekimeiya, apparently, and it was found yesterday. We're handling everything with utmost care, but we're worried Xyn might attack at any moment. Keep an eye out for me, and mention anything you think is suspicious.
entries.literal: "Yeah, it's called the Sekimeiya, apparently, and it was found yesterday. We're handling everything with utmost care, but we're worried Xyn might attack at any moment. Keep an eye out for me, and mention anything you think is suspicious."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: Oh, absolutely. I'm sorry to hear the situation is this bad, but I trust you'll catch them soon.
entries.literal: "Oh, absolutely. I'm sorry to hear the situation is this bad, but I trust you'll catch them soon."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: ...Thank you.{w} I have to go now. *sigh*
entries.literal: "...Thank you.{w} I have to go now. *sigh*"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Ido bowed again as Katei walked to the reception desk.
entries.literal: "Ido bowed again as Katei walked to the reception desk."

entries.text: The Copse
entries.literal: "The Copse"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: You did a good job, Atase.
entries.literal: "You did a good job, Atase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Behind a short chair, Atase's boss congratulated him. As he did, however, Atase knew he must've been called there for a different reason.
entries.literal: "Behind a short chair, Atase's boss congratulated him. As he did, however, Atase knew he must've been called there for a different reason."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Thank you. I'm glad everything went well.
entries.literal: "Thank you. I'm glad everything went well."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Yes, me too.{w} How was it?
entries.literal: "Yes, me too.{w} How was it?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: How? It was simple, of course.{w} I had to spend a long time in the tower, but it went as we'd expected.
entries.literal: "How? It was simple, of course.{w} I had to spend a long time in the tower, but it went as we'd expected."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Good. I verified that we received everything. It seems nothing went wrong.
entries.literal: "Good. I verified that we received everything. It seems nothing went wrong."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...Yes. It went smoothly.
entries.literal: "...Yes. It went smoothly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase's boss stared into his eyes.{w} Why? Why was he being tested like that?
entries.literal: "Atase's boss stared into his eyes.{w} Why? Why was he being tested like that?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Is that all you have to say?
entries.literal: "Is that all you have to say?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Y-Yes. Am I missing something?
entries.literal: "Y-Yes. Am I missing something?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: If it's as you said, no.
entries.literal: "If it's as you said, no."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...{w}Is this why you called me?
entries.literal: "...{w}Is this why you called me?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Yes. You can go now.
entries.literal: "Yes. You can go now."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase was confused. He'd been surprised to have been called four days after the assignment, but his boss's attitude had left him even more fazed.
entries.literal: "Atase was confused. He'd been surprised to have been called four days after the assignment, but his boss's attitude had left him even more fazed."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...I'll go, then.
entries.literal: "...I'll go, then."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His boss didn't show the slightest sign of movement. After a long pause, Atase stood up.
entries.literal: "His boss didn't show the slightest sign of movement. After a long pause, Atase stood up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suddenly, five knocks reverberated through the small space.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, five knocks reverberated through the small space."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Go ahead.
entries.literal: "Go ahead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door opened, and the outline of a thin man appeared. Hesitantly, he looked into the room, worried he was a disturbance.
entries.literal: "The door opened, and the outline of a thin man appeared. Hesitantly, he looked into the room, worried he was a disturbance."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: What do you want, Ido?
entries.literal: "What do you want, Ido?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: ...There's something I have to tell you.
entries.literal: "...There's something I have to tell you."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Speak, then.
entries.literal: "Speak, then."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: I have been told Ashiya will pick up a... notable gem this Wednesday.
entries.literal: "I have been told Ashiya will pick up a... notable gem this Wednesday."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Who told you that?
entries.literal: "Who told you that?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: Katei Kuiji, from security. He compared it to the situation with the Nomdaid.
entries.literal: "Katei Kuiji, from security. He compared it to the situation with the Nomdaid."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Hm.
entries.literal: "Hm."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: He said they'll show it on the 15th; the event is going to be changed.
entries.literal: "He said they'll show it on the 15th; the event is going to be changed."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: What else did he say?
entries.literal: "What else did he say?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: ...That they're working very hard to catch us before that day, handling the situation with utmost care and having a lot of trouble with it.{w} The gemstone was found yesterday on Airun, and it's called the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...That they're working very hard to catch us before that day, handling the situation with utmost care and having a lot of trouble with it.{w} The gemstone was found yesterday on Airun, and it's called the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Anything else?
entries.literal: "Anything else?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Why were you told this?
entries.literal: "Why were you told this?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: I don't know. I think he was venting, honestly. I've worked there since years before the first attack, so I believe I'm considered trustworthy. We had a brief conversation this morning.
entries.literal: "I don't know. I think he was venting, honestly. I've worked there since years before the first attack, so I believe I'm considered trustworthy. We had a brief conversation this morning."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Thank you for letting us know immediately, and do so again in the future.{w} You may go now.
entries.literal: "Thank you for letting us know immediately, and do so again in the future.{w} You may go now."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After Ido left the room, Atase's boss looked pensive for some time before inquiring what Atase's thoughts were.{w} Atase had been the most involved in Ashiya-related manners; as such, his superior was curious to know his thoughts on what they'd heard.
entries.literal: "After Ido left the room, Atase's boss looked pensive for some time before inquiring what Atase's thoughts were.{w} Atase had been the most involved in Ashiya-related manners; as such, his superior was curious to know his thoughts on what they'd heard."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: They must expect an attack is imminent, so I'm sure they have something prepared.
entries.literal: "They must expect an attack is imminent, so I'm sure they have something prepared."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Of course.{w} Three days ago, our access to the tower's computer was terminated. It's unlikely we were detected, though, so they're repeating the same preemptive actions.{w} Infecting the computer again is not a priority. They must be paying close attention to it, and if they found out a way to identify us, we can't risk notifying them of the moment we regained access.
entries.literal: "Of course.{w} Three days ago, our access to the tower's computer was terminated. It's unlikely we were detected, though, so they're repeating the same preemptive actions.{w} Infecting the computer again is not a priority. They must be paying close attention to it, and if they found out a way to identify us, we can't risk notifying them of the moment we regained access."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...{w}I have a thought.{w} The computer was cleaned, so they're evidently preparing something in the tower. However, we have very early information about the event they're preparing. If we want to make a move, it might be a good call to do it before they actually retrieve the gem on the 30th.
entries.literal: "...{w}I have a thought.{w} The computer was cleaned, so they're evidently preparing something in the tower. However, we have very early information about the event they're preparing. If we want to make a move, it might be a good call to do it before they actually retrieve the gem on the 30th."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: What? That would be disastrous.{w} Did you not listen to Ido? He was told they're handling the situation extremely carefully. And he was told about a few key details.{w} Ashiya are hunting for a spy. If we take advantage of the information Ido was given, we're handing them his identity.
entries.literal: "What? That would be disastrous.{w} Did you not listen to Ido? He was told they're handling the situation extremely carefully. And he was told about a few key details.{w} Ashiya are hunting for a spy. If we take advantage of the information Ido was given, we're handing them his identity."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...{w}You're right. That's a bad idea.
entries.literal: "...{w}You're right. That's a bad idea."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: ...{w}You can leave now. I'll think about this.
entries.literal: "...{w}You can leave now. I'll think about this."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase gave his boss a slow nod and walked out of the room.
entries.literal: "Atase gave his boss a slow nod and walked out of the room."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Why were you told this?
entries.literal: "Why were you told this?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: I don't know. I think he was venting, honestly. I've worked there since years before the first attack, so I believe I'm considered trustworthy. We had a brief conversation this morning.
entries.literal: "I don't know. I think he was venting, honestly. I've worked there since years before the first attack, so I believe I'm considered trustworthy. We had a brief conversation this morning."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Thank you for letting us know immediately, and do so again in the future.{w} You may go now.
entries.literal: "Thank you for letting us know immediately, and do so again in the future.{w} You may go now."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei's heart rapidly pounded his chest. He had landed his first hit.
entries.literal: "Katei's heart rapidly pounded his chest. He had landed his first hit."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Ido was part of Xyn, and Ashiya's bait had sunk into their pond. Shaking, Katei combed through the rest of the recording, but it didn't contain anything else of relevance.
entries.literal: "Ido was part of Xyn, and Ashiya's bait had sunk into their pond. Shaking, Katei combed through the rest of the recording, but it didn't contain anything else of relevance."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The door to the security room opened.
entries.literal: "The door to the security room opened."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: We have made the primary announcement of the Sekimeiya. We won't have it until tomorrow, but there's no way an issue will come up with Gan.
entries.literal: "We have made the primary announcement of the Sekimeiya. We won't have it until tomorrow, but there's no way an issue will come up with Gan."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: That's good. We have to build it up as early as possible, and we always announce the events well in advance.
entries.literal: "That's good. We have to build it up as early as possible, and we always announce the events well in advance."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Jiro had called Atase again. When he stepped into the room, he was gestured to sit in front of the table.
entries.literal: "Jiro had called Atase again. When he stepped into the room, he was gestured to sit in front of the table."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Have you heard about it?
entries.literal: "Have you heard about it?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Ashiya's announcement?
entries.literal: "Ashiya's announcement?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Yes. They have revealed the existence of the Sekimeiya, and the details match what Ido was told.{w} I think your idea is now worth considering.
entries.literal: "Yes. They have revealed the existence of the Sekimeiya, and the details match what Ido was told.{w} I think your idea is now worth considering."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Right. Now that the information is out, we won't be linked to Ido.
entries.literal: "Right. Now that the information is out, we won't be linked to Ido."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: They think we'll attack the tower as usual. As you said, they cleaned up their computer, so what they're preparing has to entail the building.{w} We know Ashiya will obtain the Sekimeiya tomorrow, but we could've investigated for this information after the announcement.
entries.literal: "They think we'll attack the tower as usual. As you said, they cleaned up their computer, so what they're preparing has to entail the building.{w} We know Ashiya will obtain the Sekimeiya tomorrow, but we could've investigated for this information after the announcement."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: And we still need to do that. We don't know where the Sekimeiya currently is or what it looks like.
entries.literal: "And we still need to do that. We don't know where the Sekimeiya currently is or what it looks like."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: No. We know enough.
entries.literal: "No. We know enough."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Ashiya said they will pick it up tomorrow as opposed to having it brought. We know that means the source is established and from Yushibana. It was found on the 27th, so that Ashiya will already have it tomorrow confirms it's currently here.{w} There are a few established points in contact with Ashiya, but not many. There are a couple of amateur collectors that try to sell all their findings to them. If it was found on the 27th and Ashiya already knew they would obtain it yesterday, it's likely they were immediately called about it in hopes they'd buy it.{w} The 27th is a Sunday, the day Gan closes his shop to go to the caves. It's highly possible it was him who found it. It was also given a name before Ashiya obtained it, which is something he has done in the past.
entries.literal: "Ashiya said they will pick it up tomorrow as opposed to having it brought. We know that means the source is established and from Yushibana. It was found on the 27th, so that Ashiya will already have it tomorrow confirms it's currently here.{w} There are a few established points in contact with Ashiya, but not many. There are a couple of amateur collectors that try to sell all their findings to them. If it was found on the 27th and Ashiya already knew they would obtain it yesterday, it's likely they were immediately called about it in hopes they'd buy it.{w} The 27th is a Sunday, the day Gan closes his shop to go to the caves. It's highly possible it was him who found it. It was also given a name before Ashiya obtained it, which is something he has done in the past."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...I understand. We don't know how it looks, though.{w} Should Ido try to obtain that information?
entries.literal: "...I understand. We don't know how it looks, though.{w} Should Ido try to obtain that information?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: I don't think so.
entries.literal: "I don't think so."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Jiro took a cellphone out of a drawer.
entries.literal: "Jiro took a cellphone out of a drawer."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Let's try this.
entries.literal: "Let's try this."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With a serious expression, Jiro dialed a number and put the cellphone close to his ear.
entries.literal: "With a serious expression, Jiro dialed a number and put the cellphone close to his ear."

entries.speaker: gan2
entries.text: Yes?
entries.literal: "Yes?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Am I calling Musashi Gemstones?
entries.literal: "Am I calling Musashi Gemstones?"

entries.speaker: gan2
entries.text: You are.
entries.literal: "You are."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Glad to speak with you. I'm Zane, from Ashiya.{w} I'm calling you to confirm that I'll come tomorrow at {time=14.}
entries.literal: "Glad to speak with you. I'm Zane, from Ashiya.{w} I'm calling you to confirm that I'll come tomorrow at {time=14.}"

entries.speaker: gan2
entries.text: ...{time=14}? I was told it'd be at {time=21.}
entries.literal: "...{time=14}? I was told it'd be at {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: ...Oh,{w} really?{w} My mistake, I was looking at the wrong page.{w} You're right, it'll be at {time=21.} Is that still all right?
entries.literal: "...Oh,{w} really?{w} My mistake, I was looking at the wrong page.{w} You're right, it'll be at {time=21.} Is that still all right?"

entries.speaker: gan2
entries.text: Yes, I'll be here.
entries.literal: "Yes, I'll be here."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Perfect. That was all, then.
entries.literal: "Perfect. That was all, then."

entries.speaker: gan2
entries.text: I'll see you.
entries.literal: "I'll see you."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Goodbye.
entries.literal: "Goodbye."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: It appears you have a new job tomorrow.
entries.literal: "It appears you have a new job tomorrow."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The plan was simple.{w} Atase had to pass himself off as an Ashiya member. In order to not be easily recognizable in the future, his figure had to be slightly disguised, and he knew how to change his voice.
entries.literal: "The plan was simple.{w} Atase had to pass himself off as an Ashiya member. In order to not be easily recognizable in the future, his figure had to be slightly disguised, and he knew how to change his voice."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On November 30th, snow began to fall. Xyn had been preparing their move, and Ashiya did the same.
entries.literal: "On November 30th, snow began to fall. Xyn had been preparing their move, and Ashiya did the same."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Minutes before {time=21}, a car parked outside Musashi Gemstones. Atase emerged from inside it, wearing a long coat.{w} Stepping into the snow, he approached the bright window, leaving the prints of a new pair of shoes behind.
entries.literal: "Minutes before {time=21}, a car parked outside Musashi Gemstones. Atase emerged from inside it, wearing a long coat.{w} Stepping into the snow, he approached the bright window, leaving the prints of a new pair of shoes behind."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He wasn't even close to calm. If Gan had told Ashiya about the call he'd received, they might've been waiting for Xyn's arrival.
entries.literal: "He wasn't even close to calm. If Gan had told Ashiya about the call he'd received, they might've been waiting for Xyn's arrival."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Slowly, he pushed open the door, a wave of warm air hitting his guarded face.
entries.literal: "Slowly, he pushed open the door, a wave of warm air hitting his guarded face."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Inside the shop, he saw a young man near the entrance, who only glanced at him emptily. Avoiding eye contact, Atase stared behind his shoulders.{w} Gan rushed over to the door after hearing the sound.
entries.literal: "Inside the shop, he saw a young man near the entrance, who only glanced at him emptily. Avoiding eye contact, Atase stared behind his shoulders.{w} Gan rushed over to the door after hearing the sound."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Hello. I'm sorry for coming earlier than arranged.
entries.literal: "Hello. I'm sorry for coming earlier than arranged."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: No, don't worry! I'm happy to see you.
entries.literal: "No, don't worry! I'm happy to see you."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Gan's face shaped into a big smile. Then, he brought Atase to the reception desk.
entries.literal: "Gan's face shaped into a big smile. Then, he brought Atase to the reception desk."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: I'd like to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I'd like to see the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Yes. I have prepared everything. Wait here.
entries.literal: "Yes. I have prepared everything. Wait here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Gan walked away and shortly came back. He held a small, brown box between his hands and handed it over to Atase. During the time it couldn't be in the cold, he had made sure the Sekimeiya's temperature wouldn't go through the box.
entries.literal: "Gan walked away and shortly came back. He held a small, brown box between his hands and handed it over to Atase. During the time it couldn't be in the cold, he had made sure the Sekimeiya's temperature wouldn't go through the box."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: I'm not done, give me a moment. Oh, and you're aware of what I discussed with Lei, right? The price will be double the usual.
entries.literal: "I'm not done, give me a moment. Oh, and you're aware of what I discussed with Lei, right? The price will be double the usual."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Surprisingly, Gan walked away again. As he did, Atase peeked into the box and saw an egg-shaped stone, glowing faintly. That must have been the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Surprisingly, Gan walked away again. As he did, Atase peeked into the box and saw an egg-shaped stone, glowing faintly. That must have been the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was his time—he had it.{w} As he'd discussed with his boss, Gan had to be paid before leaving, so Atase couldn't simply step out of the shop. If he ran away, Gan would try to chase him and would immediately call Ashiya and the police, and it was possible he'd see their car. Atase slowly took something out of his large pocket.
entries.literal: "That was his time—he had it.{w} As he'd discussed with his boss, Gan had to be paid before leaving, so Atase couldn't simply step out of the shop. If he ran away, Gan would try to chase him and would immediately call Ashiya and the police, and it was possible he'd see their car. Atase slowly took something out of his large pocket."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A grenade that would rapidly disperse smoke through the shop, knocking out everyone who inhaled it.
entries.literal: "A grenade that would rapidly disperse smoke through the shop, knocking out everyone who inhaled it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as he activated it, he dashed to the door, colliding with the light falling snow. A curtain blocked the view through the window, so no one could see what had happened from outside.
entries.literal: "As soon as he activated it, he dashed to the door, colliding with the light falling snow. A curtain blocked the view through the window, so no one could see what had happened from outside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Without slowing down, Atase ran to the car. He had seen the immense cloud of smoke appearing before his eyes, and Gan had been farther into the room. There was no way he'd avoided being knocked unconscious.
entries.literal: "Without slowing down, Atase ran to the car. He had seen the immense cloud of smoke appearing before his eyes, and Gan had been farther into the room. There was no way he'd avoided being knocked unconscious."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Faiten, another member of Xyn, had opened the car door. Atase rapidly stepped in and hurried to close it.
entries.literal: "Faiten, another member of Xyn, had opened the car door. Atase rapidly stepped in and hurried to close it."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Go! I'm pretty sure he was hit, but Ashiya could come at any time!
entries.literal: "Go! I'm pretty sure he was hit, but Ashiya could come at any time!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Faiten accelerated as fast as he could. The vehicle took off at a speed far beyond the legal limit, almost running over an old man past the first turn.
entries.literal: "Faiten accelerated as fast as he could. The vehicle took off at a speed far beyond the legal limit, almost running over an old man past the first turn."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At the appointed time, Lei gripped the handle of the door, ahead of a notary from Ashiya.
entries.literal: "At the appointed time, Lei gripped the handle of the door, ahead of a notary from Ashiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When she laid eyes inside the shop, a thin darkness hindered her sight.{w} Confused, she placed a finger on the light switch next to the door, but that turned off all remaining light.{w} Immediately, she flipped it back.
entries.literal: "When she laid eyes inside the shop, a thin darkness hindered her sight.{w} Confused, she placed a finger on the light switch next to the door, but that turned off all remaining light.{w} Immediately, she flipped it back."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both she and the notary were taken aback by the loud noise.
entries.literal: "Both she and the notary were taken aback by the loud noise."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Astonished, they looked through the door and saw that the opposite part of the shop had disappeared. Their hearts almost stopped when they saw blood and human flesh on the edges of the hole.
entries.literal: "Astonished, they looked through the door and saw that the opposite part of the shop had disappeared. Their hearts almost stopped when they saw blood and human flesh on the edges of the hole."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It had been Xyn. As Lei stared at the scene, she found no other option.{w} They had never taken their attacks to such an extent before, but she knew they were responsible.{w} How? How had they learned about the time and place of the Sekimeiya's tradeoff? Had her phone been hijacked?
entries.literal: "It had been Xyn. As Lei stared at the scene, she found no other option.{w} They had never taken their attacks to such an extent before, but she knew they were responsible.{w} How? How had they learned about the time and place of the Sekimeiya's tradeoff? Had her phone been hijacked?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the floor were Gan and a boy she didn't know. However, someone else had been farther ahead. ...Someone had just died, and she couldn't fathom it.
entries.literal: "On the floor were Gan and a boy she didn't know. However, someone else had been farther ahead. ...Someone had just died, and she couldn't fathom it."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...Are you two okay?
entries.literal: "...Are you two okay?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The man beside Lei began to shake both bodies.{w} Soon, Gan, who had inhaled a lesser amount of the smoke thanks to the shelves, opened his eyes, obstructing the blood from flowing down.{w} In disbelief, he told Lei about what had happened, stuttering as he stared at the broken floor.
entries.literal: "The man beside Lei began to shake both bodies.{w} Soon, Gan, who had inhaled a lesser amount of the smoke thanks to the shelves, opened his eyes, obstructing the blood from flowing down.{w} In disbelief, he told Lei about what had happened, stuttering as he stared at the broken floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While an ambulance was being called, Lei's phone was also by her ear, linked to the police.
entries.literal: "While an ambulance was being called, Lei's phone was also by her ear, linked to the police."

entries.speaker: lei
entries.text: I'm telling you they just escaped! They're in a vehicle—I see their tire marks outside the shop!{w} They must be found immediately! They just stole an incredibly valuable gemstone!
entries.literal: "I'm telling you they just escaped! They're in a vehicle—I see their tire marks outside the shop!{w} They must be found immediately! They just stole an incredibly valuable gemstone!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the boy woke up, he stood in a daze. Then, staggering forward, he stared at the back of the shop with desperate eyes.
entries.literal: "When the boy woke up, he stood in a daze. Then, staggering forward, he stared at the back of the shop with desperate eyes."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Wh-Where are the two girls that were here?
entries.literal: "Wh-Where are the two girls that were here?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was silence. Nobody knew the answer, but they didn't think they could have spoken even if they had.
entries.literal: "There was silence. Nobody knew the answer, but they didn't think they could have spoken even if they had."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: It went well. We're on the way.
entries.literal: "It went well. We're on the way."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Faiten and Atase were driving away. Just in case, they couldn't go straight to their boss.
entries.literal: "Faiten and Atase were driving away. Just in case, they couldn't go straight to their boss."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The dim streets of Yushibana were empty, but the snow prevented them from going as fast as they wanted to. They had to be careful not to let the wheel marks show their destination.{w} When he had calmed down, Atase lifted the box's lid.
entries.literal: "The dim streets of Yushibana were empty, but the snow prevented them from going as fast as they wanted to. They had to be careful not to let the wheel marks show their destination.{w} When he had calmed down, Atase lifted the box's lid."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He saw one of the Sekimeiya. It had to be what Ashiya had announced, as Atase had never seen a gemstone like it.
entries.literal: "He saw one of the Sekimeiya. It had to be what Ashiya had announced, as Atase had never seen a gemstone like it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Out of the blue, they heard a siren behind them.{w} Through the rearview mirror, they could see a police car approaching.
entries.literal: "Out of the blue, they heard a siren behind them.{w} Through the rearview mirror, they could see a police car approaching."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Wh-What!?{w} Stop! Don't keep going!
entries.literal: "Wh-What!?{w} Stop! Don't keep going!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Pale, Faiten pulled over to the right. He couldn't muster a word—he slowly looked at the box on Atase's lap.{w} Had Ashiya set a trap for them?
entries.literal: "Pale, Faiten pulled over to the right. He couldn't muster a word—he slowly looked at the box on Atase's lap.{w} Had Ashiya set a trap for them?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...Don't tell me there's a tracker in that box.
entries.literal: "...Don't tell me there's a tracker in that box."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: What? No, I didn't see anything.
entries.literal: "What? No, I didn't see anything."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A police officer knocked on their door, demanding they open it.
entries.literal: "A police officer knocked on their door, demanding they open it."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: What's the problem?
entries.literal: "What's the problem?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: We were notified your vehicle almost ran over someone at Maura. Two people saw you going at a much faster speed than the limit allowed.
entries.literal: "We were notified your vehicle almost ran over someone at Maura. Two people saw you going at a much faster speed than the limit allowed."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...Oh, is that so? Sorry, I don't remember how fast I was going.
entries.literal: "...Oh, is that so? Sorry, I don't remember how fast I was going."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The officer paused as he smelled the air.{w} ...Inside the vehicle, both men frowned. What was he doing?
entries.literal: "The officer paused as he smelled the air.{w} ...Inside the vehicle, both men frowned. What was he doing?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Hand me your license, please.
entries.literal: "Hand me your license, please."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Faiten took out a few documents from the glove compartment and handed them to the officer.
entries.literal: "Faiten took out a few documents from the glove compartment and handed them to the officer."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Step out of the vehicle.
entries.literal: "Step out of the vehicle."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: S-Sure.
entries.literal: "S-Sure."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...This is a screening device. Please take a breath test.
entries.literal: "...This is a screening device. Please take a breath test."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a minute, the officer looked at the result.{w} It said "zero".
entries.literal: "After a minute, the officer looked at the result.{w} It said \"zero\"."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: There are no traces of alcohol on you.
entries.literal: "There are no traces of alcohol on you."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Of course. I would never drink before driving.
entries.literal: "Of course. I would never drink before driving."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: ...{w}You can get back in the vehicle.{w} Please, make sure you don't drive over the speed limit.
entries.literal: "...{w}You can get back in the vehicle.{w} Please, make sure you don't drive over the speed limit."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Yes, I'm sorry. If I went over it, I promise that I didn't notice.
entries.literal: "Yes, I'm sorry. If I went over it, I promise that I didn't notice."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Faiten stepped into the car. As he did so, the officer received a radio call.{w} Trying to hide his haste, Faiten asked if he could get going.
entries.literal: "Faiten stepped into the car. As he did so, the officer received a radio call.{w} Trying to hide his haste, Faiten asked if he could get going."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With his hand, the officer indicated to hold off.
entries.literal: "With his hand, the officer indicated to hold off."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suddenly, the officer's look changed.{w} Both men noticed he was staring at the brown box.{w} Then, the officer saw something else. On Atase's attire, there was an Ashiya logo.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, the officer's look changed.{w} Both men noticed he was staring at the brown box.{w} Then, the officer saw something else. On Atase's attire, there was an Ashiya logo."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: What's in that box?
entries.literal: "What's in that box?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: In this one? A present for my girl.
entries.literal: "In this one? A present for my girl."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Give it to me.
entries.literal: "Give it to me."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...Should I? It's snowing, and I wouldn't like it to get dirty.
entries.literal: "...Should I? It's snowing, and I wouldn't like it to get dirty."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Please give me that box.
entries.literal: "Please give me that box."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Slowly, Faiten took it and handed it to the officer.{w} He lifted the lid, and his eyes didn't waver.
entries.literal: "Slowly, Faiten took it and handed it to the officer.{w} He lifted the lid, and his eyes didn't waver."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Both of you step out of the vehicle.
entries.literal: "Both of you step out of the vehicle."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Faiten and Atase looked at each other. Then, after a pause, Faiten extricated his lower body from below the dashboard.{w} The officer never expected the car to accelerate as he did.{w} It was Atase's foot that pressed down the accelerator. Immediately, the officer ran to his car as he yelled for them to stop.
entries.literal: "Faiten and Atase looked at each other. Then, after a pause, Faiten extricated his lower body from below the dashboard.{w} The officer never expected the car to accelerate as he did.{w} It was Atase's foot that pressed down the accelerator. Immediately, the officer ran to his car as he yelled for them to stop."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later into the night, a handful of men were in Musashi Gemstones.{w} Everyone had been ordered to leave, and the scene had been preserved as well as possible.
entries.literal: "Later into the night, a handful of men were in Musashi Gemstones.{w} Everyone had been ordered to leave, and the scene had been preserved as well as possible."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki Hakutoki and Gan had been sent to the hospital. Their physical condition was fine, but they'd have to spend the night there.
entries.literal: "Atsuki Hakutoki and Gan had been sent to the hospital. Their physical condition was fine, but they'd have to spend the night there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Under the shop was a channel sheltered from the icy air. There had been two more people inside at the time of the explosion. One of them had fallen through the floor, whereas the other had died on the spot.
entries.literal: "Under the shop was a channel sheltered from the icy air. There had been two more people inside at the time of the explosion. One of them had fallen through the floor, whereas the other had died on the spot."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya Mirana had hit her head after falling from high up and entered a coma. As soon as the paramedics had reached that place, she had been taken to the hospital too.{w} A few people were scattered around where her body had fallen.
entries.literal: "Shiroya Mirana had hit her head after falling from high up and entered a coma. As soon as the paramedics had reached that place, she had been taken to the hospital too.{w} A few people were scattered around where her body had fallen."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The forensic team. They were investigating the scene and had confirmed that the missing girl, Miiya Moiromo, had died.
entries.literal: "The forensic team. They were investigating the scene and had confirmed that the missing girl, Miiya Moiromo, had died."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something else had fallen with the rubble. An open box, identical to the one Atase had received.{w} Its lid had burst open on impact, and its contents had rolled away. A handful of people had seen the shining, egg-shaped stone within the darkness, but nobody had been allowed to touch anything. Its faint shine highlighted the drop of blood that had arced across its surface.
entries.literal: "Something else had fallen with the rubble. An open box, identical to the one Atase had received.{w} Its lid had burst open on impact, and its contents had rolled away. A handful of people had seen the shining, egg-shaped stone within the darkness, but nobody had been allowed to touch anything. Its faint shine highlighted the drop of blood that had arced across its surface."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When a woman from the forensic team felt the gem for the first time, she was taken aback. ...It was very hot.{w} Ashiya had quickly learned that only one of the Sekimeiya had been taken and asked the investigation team to return the fallen one. However, as it was related to the incident, it had to be inspected by them first.
entries.literal: "When a woman from the forensic team felt the gem for the first time, she was taken aback. ...It was very hot.{w} Ashiya had quickly learned that only one of the Sekimeiya had been taken and asked the investigation team to return the fallen one. However, as it was related to the incident, it had to be inspected by them first."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The woman grabbed the box and shut it inside. Then, gripping a flashlight with her tight latex gloves, she kept searching around the place.
entries.literal: "The woman grabbed the box and shut it inside. Then, gripping a flashlight with her tight latex gloves, she kept searching around the place."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When midnight hit, it was December.
entries.literal: "When midnight hit, it was December."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei's night shift had begun. Before entering the security room, he had spoken to Lei.
entries.literal: "Katei's night shift had begun. Before entering the security room, he had spoken to Lei."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Xyn had attacked the gem shop. However, for the first time, their plan had failed due to external factors; the Sekimeiya would be returned to Ashiya.
entries.literal: "Xyn had attacked the gem shop. However, for the first time, their plan had failed due to external factors; the Sekimeiya would be returned to Ashiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How had Xyn learned about the location? Katei didn't know, but it didn't matter.{w} The preparations for his plan had been completed, so he needed Xyn to attack again. It wasn't in Ashiya's interests to pursue the attack of the 30th any further. As if nothing had happened, the Sekimeiya plan needed to continue as devised.
entries.literal: "How had Xyn learned about the location? Katei didn't know, but it didn't matter.{w} The preparations for his plan had been completed, so he needed Xyn to attack again. It wasn't in Ashiya's interests to pursue the attack of the 30th any further. As if nothing had happened, the Sekimeiya plan needed to continue as devised."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the stillness had gone on for a while, Katei listened to the latest recording.{w} Nothing related to Xyn was there. Since Ido had told them about the Sekimeiya, the recordings had been nothing but uneventful.
entries.literal: "When the stillness had gone on for a while, Katei listened to the latest recording.{w} Nothing related to Xyn was there. Since Ido had told them about the Sekimeiya, the recordings had been nothing but uneventful."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The SD card behind the device had been swapped out. If the device was ever found in the tower, Katei didn't want the information he had to be revealed; he needed it for himself.{w} It was a small card that wouldn't be questioned, so he could easily leave the building with it. After listening to Xyn's brief meeting, he had saved the recording on his own computer, inserting a new, empty card in the recording device.
entries.literal: "The SD card behind the device had been swapped out. If the device was ever found in the tower, Katei didn't want the information he had to be revealed; he needed it for himself.{w} It was a small card that wouldn't be questioned, so he could easily leave the building with it. After listening to Xyn's brief meeting, he had saved the recording on his own computer, inserting a new, empty card in the recording device."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At home, Lei hadn't calmed down yet. A young girl had died in Musashi Gemstones, and she'd learned the initial details.
entries.literal: "At home, Lei hadn't calmed down yet. A young girl had died in Musashi Gemstones, and she'd learned the initial details."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Xyn had impersonated Ashiya. Yet again, they had possessed confidential information to carry out their plan.
entries.literal: "Xyn had impersonated Ashiya. Yet again, they had possessed confidential information to carry out their plan."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, they hadn't known about the second Sekimeiya. After being given one, they had released a potent gas in the small shop which had put everyone to sleep.
entries.literal: "However, they hadn't known about the second Sekimeiya. After being given one, they had released a potent gas in the small shop which had put everyone to sleep."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The girl's death hadn't been part of Xyn's plan. It had been the result of a common domestic accident, but Xyn had made it possible.
entries.literal: "The girl's death hadn't been part of Xyn's plan. It had been the result of a common domestic accident, but Xyn had made it possible."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The Sekimeiya Xyn had stolen was being brought back to Ashiya, but the other one, which had fallen through the shop's floor, had been taken by the forensics. Lei had insisted that it be returned and kept cold; Gan had warned her about the temperature, but she had been told she would have to wait 36 hours.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya Xyn had stolen was being brought back to Ashiya, but the other one, which had fallen through the shop's floor, had been taken by the forensics. Lei had insisted that it be returned and kept cold; Gan had warned her about the temperature, but she had been told she would have to wait 36 hours."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: You fucked up badly.
entries.literal: "You fucked up badly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase and Faiten had explained the events to his boss. They'd managed to slip away and safely arrived at the meeting place.
entries.literal: "Atase and Faiten had explained the events to his boss. They'd managed to slip away and safely arrived at the meeting place."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Jiro looked stern. He wasn't a man to grow uncontrollably angry, but his eyes showed how displeased he was.
entries.literal: "Jiro looked stern. He wasn't a man to grow uncontrollably angry, but his eyes showed how displeased he was."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Are you convinced you won't be tracked here?
entries.literal: "Are you convinced you won't be tracked here?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Absolutely.{w} The car is parked quite a ways away, but the police will find it soon. We have to give it up.
entries.literal: "Absolutely.{w} The car is parked quite a ways away, but the police will find it soon. We have to give it up."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: ...{w}Have you learned what happened?
entries.literal: "...{w}Have you learned what happened?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Wh-What do you mean?
entries.literal: "Wh-What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Someone died in Musashi. There was a gas explosion after you left.
entries.literal: "Someone died in Musashi. There was a gas explosion after you left."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both lackeys looked at each other, lost for words.
entries.literal: "Both lackeys looked at each other, lost for words."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: I-It can't be. We didn't do anything.
entries.literal: "I-It can't be. We didn't do anything."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Watch the news tomorrow. You knocked everyone out, so no one noticed the heater was busted and leaking gas. When Ashiya entered, there was an explosion. You killed a civilian. Someone else was sent to the hospital in a coma.
entries.literal: "Watch the news tomorrow. You knocked everyone out, so no one noticed the heater was busted and leaking gas. When Ashiya entered, there was an explosion. You killed a civilian. Someone else was sent to the hospital in a coma."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Do you understand? This is a major fuck up. Xyn does {i}not{/} get involved in murder cases.
entries.literal: "Do you understand? This is a major fuck up. Xyn does {i}not{/} get involved in murder cases."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...That wasn't our fault, though. We did as planned.
entries.literal: "...That wasn't our fault, though. We did as planned."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: You're right. All you did was draw the police to you and lose the Sekimeiya. You both should've been arrested, but now you're going to land us all in hot water.
entries.literal: "You're right. All you did was draw the police to you and lose the Sekimeiya. You both should've been arrested, but now you're going to land us all in hot water."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...{w}I don't think I'll be recognized.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't think I'll be recognized."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Atase, shut up. You might be done for already.
entries.literal: "Atase, shut up. You might be done for already."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: I'm going to ask you the same thing I did once already. Did everything truly go as planned on the 24th?
entries.literal: "I'm going to ask you the same thing I did once already. Did everything truly go as planned on the 24th?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Y-Yes. Why are you asking this again?
entries.literal: "Y-Yes. Why are you asking this again?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: That afternoon, an unidentified person escaped from a prison cell. I was later called and told that you were seen near that place, wearing the same clothes as them.
entries.literal: "That afternoon, an unidentified person escaped from a prison cell. I was later called and told that you were seen near that place, wearing the same clothes as them."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Wait, what!? That wasn't me! I was in the tower at that time!
entries.literal: "Wait, what!? That wasn't me! I was in the tower at that time!"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: You say that, but we erased those records.{w} I don't know what the fuck is going on with you, but what just happened isn't acceptable. Now you're being hunted for causing a death, and the police pulled you over. Both of you are basically sacrificial lambs at this point.
entries.literal: "You say that, but we erased those records.{w} I don't know what the fuck is going on with you, but what just happened isn't acceptable. Now you're being hunted for causing a death, and the police pulled you over. Both of you are basically sacrificial lambs at this point."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase couldn't believe what he was hearing. He'd been part of Xyn for many years, and he'd never been told something like that.
entries.literal: "Atase couldn't believe what he was hearing. He'd been part of Xyn for many years, and he'd never been told something like that."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...Then what should we do?
entries.literal: "...Then what should we do?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: You have to be quiet. Wait, and when you're arrested, you stay quiet.
entries.literal: "You have to be quiet. Wait, and when you're arrested, you stay quiet."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Come on, we won't say anything, but isn't there something you can do?
entries.literal: "Come on, we won't say anything, but isn't there something you can do?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Something I can do? What do you want, to go live in a different country?
entries.literal: "Something I can do? What do you want, to go live in a different country?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Why would I help you two? You allowed our first failure against Ashiya. I'm not sticking my neck out here. Anything involving you from now on will be exceptionally problematic.
entries.literal: "Why would I help you two? You allowed our first failure against Ashiya. I'm not sticking my neck out here. Anything involving you from now on will be exceptionally problematic."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...What about the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...What about the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: What about it?
entries.literal: "What about it?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Are we... gonna do anything else about it?
entries.literal: "Are we... gonna do anything else about it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Jiro didn't have an immediate answer for that question.
entries.literal: "Jiro didn't have an immediate answer for that question."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Did you see it?
entries.literal: "Did you see it?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: I did. I was surprised by how it looked.{w} It honestly looks like an egg made of marble, and I think it was shining a little.
entries.literal: "I did. I was surprised by how it looked.{w} It honestly looks like an egg made of marble, and I think it was shining a little."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: ...An egg? How big was it?
entries.literal: "...An egg? How big was it?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: A bit more than the length of this finger, I'd say.
entries.literal: "A bit more than the length of this finger, I'd say."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Jiro was pensive for a while. His plan had been so close to working, but he couldn't blindly throw out a new move.
entries.literal: "Jiro was pensive for a while. His plan had been so close to working, but he couldn't blindly throw out a new move."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Go home for now.{w} Atase, I want you here tomorrow at {time=14.}
entries.literal: "Go home for now.{w} Atase, I want you here tomorrow at {time=14.}"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...Okay. I'll be here.
entries.literal: "...Okay. I'll be here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both men knew not to push the issue, so they slowly stepped out of the room.
entries.literal: "Both men knew not to push the issue, so they slowly stepped out of the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase got home late into the night. He'd lived alone for years, so he had nobody to wake up.{w} The first thing he did was look up the recent news.
entries.literal: "Atase got home late into the night. He'd lived alone for years, so he had nobody to wake up.{w} The first thing he did was look up the recent news."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As he'd been told, he came across an article from the 24th of November. Someone had escaped from a prison cell, but the story was enigmatic.{w} It hadn't been him; as he'd said, he had been in Ashiya Tower at the time. However, he couldn't help but feel that the man in the attached picture did strangely resemble him.
entries.literal: "As he'd been told, he came across an article from the 24th of November. Someone had escaped from a prison cell, but the story was enigmatic.{w} It hadn't been him; as he'd said, he had been in Ashiya Tower at the time. However, he couldn't help but feel that the man in the attached picture did strangely resemble him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the sun rose, Atase still hadn't managed to fall asleep.
entries.literal: "When the sun rose, Atase still hadn't managed to fall asleep."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The latest news was posted online, and he didn't have to search for what he wanted. The highlighted article said: "Twenty-year-old girl dies by gas explosion in Yushibana".
entries.literal: "The latest news was posted online, and he didn't have to search for what he wanted. The highlighted article said: \"Twenty-year-old girl dies by gas explosion in Yushibana\"."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His eyes locked onto the headline painfully, and he was unable to clear his suddenly clogged throat. It was the first time his actions had killed someone.{w} When he read that two friends of the girl had been there, a cold hollow expanded within his chest. He vividly remembered how he'd received the death of a close friend of his years ago. It hadn't been his intention, but he had created that pain for someone else, and a friend of the girl he'd killed was in grave danger as well.{w} It was the last thing he'd ever wanted to happen. However, his mind kept going to what his boss had said. It was true—his situation was volatile.
entries.literal: "His eyes locked onto the headline painfully, and he was unable to clear his suddenly clogged throat. It was the first time his actions had killed someone.{w} When he read that two friends of the girl had been there, a cold hollow expanded within his chest. He vividly remembered how he'd received the death of a close friend of his years ago. It hadn't been his intention, but he had created that pain for someone else, and a friend of the girl he'd killed was in grave danger as well.{w} It was the last thing he'd ever wanted to happen. However, his mind kept going to what his boss had said. It was true—his situation was volatile."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He frowned as he finished reading the article.{w} He went over it again to confirm he hadn't been mistaken, but there was no mention of Xyn or their plan.
entries.literal: "He frowned as he finished reading the article.{w} He went over it again to confirm he hadn't been mistaken, but there was no mention of Xyn or their plan."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why...? There was no way Ashiya didn't think Xyn had been behind it. However, they hadn't been mentioned, nor had the Sekimeiya...
entries.literal: "Why...? There was no way Ashiya didn't think Xyn had been behind it. However, they hadn't been mentioned, nor had the Sekimeiya..."

entries.text: Initial Singularity
entries.literal: "Initial Singularity"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The appointed time came. Atase had been able to get a bit of sleep, and he sat in front of his boss after a silent nod.
entries.literal: "The appointed time came. Atase had been able to get a bit of sleep, and he sat in front of his boss after a silent nod."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: We're going to wait for Ido to come. He'll be here soon.
entries.literal: "We're going to wait for Ido to come. He'll be here soon."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: All right.
entries.literal: "All right."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Ashiya haven't stopped talking about this Sekimeiya, and it was found two days before its announcement. Like you said, they're doing something in the tower, I have no doubt—that's why our name wasn't on the news.
entries.literal: "Ashiya haven't stopped talking about this Sekimeiya, and it was found two days before its announcement. Like you said, they're doing something in the tower, I have no doubt—that's why our name wasn't on the news."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...Yes, that's very likely. I also noticed that.
entries.literal: "...Yes, that's very likely. I also noticed that."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: A surprising amount of people have echoed Ashiya. It appears the Sekimeiya event is gaining a lot of traction. There's been a great deal of interest in it.
entries.literal: "A surprising amount of people have echoed Ashiya. It appears the Sekimeiya event is gaining a lot of traction. There's been a great deal of interest in it."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Do you remember what Ido was told? Katei Kuiji's information was real, and he said they're doing their best to catch us before the 15th. They were sending the Sekimeiya to the tower, expecting our attack before the event.
entries.literal: "Do you remember what Ido was told? Katei Kuiji's information was real, and he said they're doing their best to catch us before the 15th. They were sending the Sekimeiya to the tower, expecting our attack before the event."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Right.
entries.literal: "Right."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was a knock at the door.
entries.literal: "There was a knock at the door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Enter."{w} Ido stepped in, sensing the tense atmosphere. Then, he sat beside Atase.
entries.literal: "\"Enter.\"{w} Ido stepped in, sensing the tense atmosphere. Then, he sat beside Atase."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Did you get it?
entries.literal: "Did you get it?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: ...Yes. I didn't think I would, but I have what you asked for.
entries.literal: "...Yes. I didn't think I would, but I have what you asked for."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The tower's janitor put his hand in his pocket and slowly took out a rectangular piece of paper.{w} It was a photograph. He handed it to his boss, who stared at it intensely.
entries.literal: "The tower's janitor put his hand in his pocket and slowly took out a rectangular piece of paper.{w} It was a photograph. He handed it to his boss, who stared at it intensely."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: You were right. It looks like an egg made of marble.
entries.literal: "You were right. It looks like an egg made of marble."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he showed it to Atase, he saw the same gemstone that had been inside the box. It was shut behind glass, and the wall in the background was from inside the tower.
entries.literal: "When he showed it to Atase, he saw the same gemstone that had been inside the box. It was shut behind glass, and the wall in the background was from inside the tower."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Y-You took a picture of it? Isn't that risky as hell?
entries.literal: "Y-You took a picture of it? Isn't that risky as hell?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: That's what I thought too, but it went well.
entries.literal: "That's what I thought too, but it went well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Xyn had figured out a way to sneak tiny devices into the tower. That was the reason they'd chosen Ido as their associate.{w} Staff members were frequently inspected upon arrival, especially after Xyn's first attacks. However, the janitor's job entailed the maintenance of the tower's plaza. By bringing the cleaning cart outside of the building and using a different Xyn member to drop the desired device in it, they had managed to slip a small camera into the tower.
entries.literal: "Xyn had figured out a way to sneak tiny devices into the tower. That was the reason they'd chosen Ido as their associate.{w} Staff members were frequently inspected upon arrival, especially after Xyn's first attacks. However, the janitor's job entailed the maintenance of the tower's plaza. By bringing the cleaning cart outside of the building and using a different Xyn member to drop the desired device in it, they had managed to slip a small camera into the tower."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: How did you do it, though?
entries.literal: "How did you do it, though?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was brought to the event room, and it was inside a cabinet. I hoped it would be out of all the security cameras' sight at some point, but that wasn't the case.{w} I wanted to use the cart to cover my hands so that I wouldn't be seen taking the picture, but it was easier than that.{w} Entering the event room was forbidden to the public, but I stepped in to clean it. As soon as I did, Katei Kuiji entered too—his night shift was about to end. It was very fortunate because a long curtain covered the Sekimeiya. He asked if I was curious about it and offered to let me see it.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was brought to the event room, and it was inside a cabinet. I hoped it would be out of all the security cameras' sight at some point, but that wasn't the case.{w} I wanted to use the cart to cover my hands so that I wouldn't be seen taking the picture, but it was easier than that.{w} Entering the event room was forbidden to the public, but I stepped in to clean it. As soon as I did, Katei Kuiji entered too—his night shift was about to end. It was very fortunate because a long curtain covered the Sekimeiya. He asked if I was curious about it and offered to let me see it."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: ...{w}Is that so?{w} What did he say this time?
entries.literal: "...{w}Is that so?{w} What did he say this time?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: He seemed to want to make small talk. I believe he doesn't suspect me.{w} He had a key for the cabinet, and he said they'd only made one for the event so that Xyn wouldn't be able to unlock it.{w} He even used it to open the cabinet and let me touch the Sekimeiya. It was pretty smooth and felt like cold marble.{w} It was kept refrigerated because it can apparently get damaged otherwise. He didn't say much else of importance, but he kept reiterating that they're hard at work upgrading their security measures to catch us.
entries.literal: "He seemed to want to make small talk. I believe he doesn't suspect me.{w} He had a key for the cabinet, and he said they'd only made one for the event so that Xyn wouldn't be able to unlock it.{w} He even used it to open the cabinet and let me touch the Sekimeiya. It was pretty smooth and felt like cold marble.{w} It was kept refrigerated because it can apparently get damaged otherwise. He didn't say much else of importance, but he kept reiterating that they're hard at work upgrading their security measures to catch us."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: ...What the hell is that man doing?
entries.literal: "...What the hell is that man doing?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: I don't know, but when he left, I knew nobody was going to be in the security room for a very short time. That's when I took the picture. ...Just in case the footage is ever reviewed, I still did it covered by the cart, so I'll only be seen uncovering the curtain again.
