entries.literal: "I don't know, but when he left, I knew nobody was going to be in the security room for a very short time. That's when I took the picture. ...Just in case the footage is ever reviewed, I still did it covered by the cart, so I'll only be seen uncovering the curtain again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Jiro's eyes had a glint to them. He knew they couldn't take things lightly.
entries.literal: "Jiro's eyes had a glint to them. He knew they couldn't take things lightly."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Do you know what the upgraded security measures he talked about could be?
entries.literal: "Do you know what the upgraded security measures he talked about could be?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: No. He didn't elaborate, and I haven't noticed any difference.
entries.literal: "No. He didn't elaborate, and I haven't noticed any difference."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: It's strange. You said the cabinet where the Sekimeiya is can be locked and unlocked with a single key. When they did that in the past, we broke them open, so they must've accounted for that.{w} When they linked an alarm to the cabinets, we disabled it remotely thanks to our access to their computer. Given what you've said, it's likely they're doing something similar, and that's why they cleaned their entire system. However, infecting it again to intercept what they're doing might be what they're waiting for.
entries.literal: "It's strange. You said the cabinet where the Sekimeiya is can be locked and unlocked with a single key. When they did that in the past, we broke them open, so they must've accounted for that.{w} When they linked an alarm to the cabinets, we disabled it remotely thanks to our access to their computer. Given what you've said, it's likely they're doing something similar, and that's why they cleaned their entire system. However, infecting it again to intercept what they're doing might be what they're waiting for."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A long time ago, Xyn had the chance to manually install a piece of software they'd created on Ashiya's computer. Thanks to the cleaning cart, they'd brought a storage device inside, and by keeping it in Ido's locker, they'd waited for the chance they'd needed. When the security staff was drawn out of their room, Ido had the chance to boot it up in their system.
entries.literal: "A long time ago, Xyn had the chance to manually install a piece of software they'd created on Ashiya's computer. Thanks to the cleaning cart, they'd brought a storage device inside, and by keeping it in Ido's locker, they'd waited for the chance they'd needed. When the security staff was drawn out of their room, Ido had the chance to boot it up in their system."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Despite Xyn's knowledge in the field, creating an undetectable malicious program wasn't simple. Because of that, the application they placed on the computer was a harmless one. That allowed it to stay hidden, only booting up for instants at a time.{w} Its purpose was to check a path on the cloud owned by Xyn. If it contained a file, it would be downloaded and executed. However, if the file had already been downloaded once, the process wouldn't be repeated.{w} That remote method allowed Xyn to gain access to Ashiya's computer. They knew about their security system, but a malicious file couldn't remain undetectable for long. By shuffling it every few days, however, they had kept their connection to the computer for months.
entries.literal: "Despite Xyn's knowledge in the field, creating an undetectable malicious program wasn't simple. Because of that, the application they placed on the computer was a harmless one. That allowed it to stay hidden, only booting up for instants at a time.{w} Its purpose was to check a path on the cloud owned by Xyn. If it contained a file, it would be downloaded and executed. However, if the file had already been downloaded once, the process wouldn't be repeated.{w} That remote method allowed Xyn to gain access to Ashiya's computer. They knew about their security system, but a malicious file couldn't remain undetectable for long. By shuffling it every few days, however, they had kept their connection to the computer for months."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It entailed a risk. If the server file was found at any given time, reverse tracking Xyn could've been feasible. To prevent that, they had made sure their file wouldn't ever be automatically detected, but their connection to Ashiya had been cut a few days previously. They knew the computer had undergone a thorough cleanup that had managed to erase Xyn's file in the process.{w} However, what about the application that had been manually installed months ago? Had it been erased too?
entries.literal: "It entailed a risk. If the server file was found at any given time, reverse tracking Xyn could've been feasible. To prevent that, they had made sure their file wouldn't ever be automatically detected, but their connection to Ashiya had been cut a few days previously. They knew the computer had undergone a thorough cleanup that had managed to erase Xyn's file in the process.{w} However, what about the application that had been manually installed months ago? Had it been erased too?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Jiro feared the reason behind the computer's cleanup. If their original application was still present within the computer, they could infect it again by putting up a new file on the path. What Jiro didn't like was the thought that Ashiya were monitoring every change.{w} While the file itself couldn't be detected as malicious, they might've committed a manual cleanup to assure it or anything similar would be deleted. Then, if Xyn remotely downloaded a new one, its appearance would be noticed, and although it wouldn't be detected as malicious, Ashiya could be sure Xyn had sent it.
entries.literal: "Jiro feared the reason behind the computer's cleanup. If their original application was still present within the computer, they could infect it again by putting up a new file on the path. What Jiro didn't like was the thought that Ashiya were monitoring every change.{w} While the file itself couldn't be detected as malicious, they might've committed a manual cleanup to assure it or anything similar would be deleted. Then, if Xyn remotely downloaded a new one, its appearance would be noticed, and although it wouldn't be detected as malicious, Ashiya could be sure Xyn had sent it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had come up with a test. To know if their original application was still there, he put up a different file on the path. Upon execution, it would send a request to a web server before deleting itself.{w} The request had been received, so Jiro knew infecting Ashiya's computer again was possible. However, he was considerably hesitant about doing it.
entries.literal: "He had come up with a test. To know if their original application was still there, he put up a different file on the path. Upon execution, it would send a request to a web server before deleting itself.{w} The request had been received, so Jiro knew infecting Ashiya's computer again was possible. However, he was considerably hesitant about doing it."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: The event will be on the 15th, but until then, it seems the Sekimeiya will be in the event room, merely locked inside a cabinet. Nothing we can do should involve breaking it open.{w} It'll be there for two weeks; they definitely expect our attack, and they think it'll happen during any night.{w} You said the cabinet looks different than all the others, right? It was prepared specifically for this, and the computer was cleaned up. I'll repeat that Katei Kuiji said their intent is to catch us before the 15th.{w} There's one more thing that caught my attention. You were told that they'd only made one key for the day of the event. This means the key will be used on the 15th.
entries.literal: "The event will be on the 15th, but until then, it seems the Sekimeiya will be in the event room, merely locked inside a cabinet. Nothing we can do should involve breaking it open.{w} It'll be there for two weeks; they definitely expect our attack, and they think it'll happen during any night.{w} You said the cabinet looks different than all the others, right? It was prepared specifically for this, and the computer was cleaned up. I'll repeat that Katei Kuiji said their intent is to catch us before the 15th.{w} There's one more thing that caught my attention. You were told that they'd only made one key for the day of the event. This means the key will be used on the 15th."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: Oh, yes. He said he'd let me be the first to touch it and warned me to be very gentle.
entries.literal: "Oh, yes. He said he'd let me be the first to touch it and warned me to be very gentle."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: The first to touch it. So they'll let visitors feel it during the event. That confirms that they'll unlock the cabinet, which we can't and shouldn't try to do.
entries.literal: "The first to touch it. So they'll let visitors feel it during the event. That confirms that they'll unlock the cabinet, which we can't and shouldn't try to do."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both subordinates were paying close attention and slowly understood what Jiro was getting at.
entries.literal: "Both subordinates were paying close attention and slowly understood what Jiro was getting at."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: If we're going to attack, there are many reasons why it should be on the very day of the event. Now that Ashiya are putting so much effort into this, we can't follow along with their expectations.{w} ...And there's another important reason why we shouldn't try to steal the Sekimeiya any day before the 15th.{w} Since the announcement, Ashiya haven't stopped building excitement for this mysterious gemstone; they're likely being excessive on purpose. Today, the Sekimeiya's value is already greater than yesterday's. Every day it's kept as a mystery, Ashiya are artificially inflating its value.{w} On the 15th, the Sekimeiya's value will be the highest it can be. That is when we want it.
entries.literal: "If we're going to attack, there are many reasons why it should be on the very day of the event. Now that Ashiya are putting so much effort into this, we can't follow along with their expectations.{w} ...And there's another important reason why we shouldn't try to steal the Sekimeiya any day before the 15th.{w} Since the announcement, Ashiya haven't stopped building excitement for this mysterious gemstone; they're likely being excessive on purpose. Today, the Sekimeiya's value is already greater than yesterday's. Every day it's kept as a mystery, Ashiya are artificially inflating its value.{w} On the 15th, the Sekimeiya's value will be the highest it can be. That is when we want it."

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: ...How would we actually get it, though? It will always be guarded when the cabinet's open, and there's a security camera in the room.
entries.literal: "...How would we actually get it, though? It will always be guarded when the cabinet's open, and there's a security camera in the room."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Ashiya are supposedly raising the scale of their measures. So should we.{w} You're right. When the cabinet is unlocked, we won't easily be able to access the Sekimeiya. But when it's locked, there's no way we will.{w} It is possible we could acquire the single key they have, but that's not exactly likely, and it would pretty much reveal Ido. This is why I'm willing to prioritize my first idea.{w} I asked you to bring a picture of the Sekimeiya because I found Atase's description of it interesting. It was supposedly found on Airun, that derelict mountain. I find that very hard to believe.{w} Where did Gan find it? There are no caves there, and like Ashiya are saying, this is far from a typical gemstone.{w} Doesn't it look too good to you? Its shape isn't natural if it's supposed to be a stone formed over the years. There's something about this story that is off.
entries.literal: "Ashiya are supposedly raising the scale of their measures. So should we.{w} You're right. When the cabinet is unlocked, we won't easily be able to access the Sekimeiya. But when it's locked, there's no way we will.{w} It is possible we could acquire the single key they have, but that's not exactly likely, and it would pretty much reveal Ido. This is why I'm willing to prioritize my first idea.{w} I asked you to bring a picture of the Sekimeiya because I found Atase's description of it interesting. It was supposedly found on Airun, that derelict mountain. I find that very hard to believe.{w} Where did Gan find it? There are no caves there, and like Ashiya are saying, this is far from a typical gemstone.{w} Doesn't it look too good to you? Its shape isn't natural if it's supposed to be a stone formed over the years. There's something about this story that is off."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: It was found right after our latest attack, and right as the computer was cleaned up. What I believe is that the emergence of this gemstone is directly related to us.{w} Both of you compared it to marble, and it glows faintly. Added to its shape, vague origin, and the lack of details Ashiya are providing, I can't help but feel this was deliberately organized... As if the Sekimeiya was handcrafted to draw us to the focus of their upgraded security.
entries.literal: "It was found right after our latest attack, and right as the computer was cleaned up. What I believe is that the emergence of this gemstone is directly related to us.{w} Both of you compared it to marble, and it glows faintly. Added to its shape, vague origin, and the lack of details Ashiya are providing, I can't help but feel this was deliberately organized... As if the Sekimeiya was handcrafted to draw us to the focus of their upgraded security."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Do you mean that they made the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Do you mean that they made the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: That is irrelevant. However, if they did, it would've been simple. They crafted a material of a single color into a simple shape. There are some that glow like this, and luminous paint would achieve the same effect.{w} It doesn't matter if the gemstone in this picture was fabricated. Ashiya are giving it real value. However, what I've said could be of immense use to us.{w} Ido, it felt like marble, right? We can have its dimensions, and the color and form aren't an issue. Do you know that molding marble is fairly simple?
entries.literal: "That is irrelevant. However, if they did, it would've been simple. They crafted a material of a single color into a simple shape. There are some that glow like this, and luminous paint would achieve the same effect.{w} It doesn't matter if the gemstone in this picture was fabricated. Ashiya are giving it real value. However, what I've said could be of immense use to us.{w} Ido, it felt like marble, right? We can have its dimensions, and the color and form aren't an issue. Do you know that molding marble is fairly simple?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...What are you saying? That we could replicate the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...What are you saying? That we could replicate the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: We easily could.
entries.literal: "We easily could."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...I see. So we could sell it as the real Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...I see. So we could sell it as the real Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Of course not. That would eliminate all our credibility.{w} I said this as a solution to Ido's question—how to obtain the real Sekimeiya.{w} On the 15th, if we take it while the cabinet's unlocked, it will be noticed immediately. The real problem is taking it out of the building.{w} We replace it with ours, and Ido takes it out with the cleaning cart.
entries.literal: "Of course not. That would eliminate all our credibility.{w} I said this as a solution to Ido's question—how to obtain the real Sekimeiya.{w} On the 15th, if we take it while the cabinet's unlocked, it will be noticed immediately. The real problem is taking it out of the building.{w} We replace it with ours, and Ido takes it out with the cleaning cart."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Do you really think we could swap them? How would that not be noticed?{w} Also, doesn't this create the same problem? If we managed to replace it with a similar-looking stone, how would we demonstrate we have the real one? If we sold it, Ashiya would claim to still have it.
entries.literal: "Do you really think we could swap them? How would that not be noticed?{w} Also, doesn't this create the same problem? If we managed to replace it with a similar-looking stone, how would we demonstrate we have the real one? If we sold it, Ashiya would claim to still have it."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: We could easily demonstrate it. And not only to assert our credibility, but also to let Ashiya know their measures have failed again.{w} I know who could do this for us: my good friend Cevin Neneco. I have an idea of how to account for this, but I'll need to think more about it.{w} Your other question, how the swap wouldn't be noticed... That has an easier answer.
entries.literal: "We could easily demonstrate it. And not only to assert our credibility, but also to let Ashiya know their measures have failed again.{w} I know who could do this for us: my good friend Cevin Neneco. I have an idea of how to account for this, but I'll need to think more about it.{w} Your other question, how the swap wouldn't be noticed... That has an easier answer."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: We'd have to do it when the cabinet is open. However, we can't be seen either in person or from the security room.{w} There is a way. The same thing we used last time, a smoke grenade.
entries.literal: "We'd have to do it when the cabinet is open. However, we can't be seen either in person or from the security room.{w} There is a way. The same thing we used last time, a smoke grenade."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...D-Do you want to release that in the tower?
entries.literal: "...D-Do you want to release that in the tower?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: The event will consist of guided visits for three people at once, and it will start at {time=9.}{w} Like always, at that time, the floor will be almost empty. That's when we make our move—before anyone knows what the Sekimeiya is. We know the people who show up earliest get in earliest. Atase, you will be there first.
entries.literal: "The event will consist of guided visits for three people at once, and it will start at {time=9.}{w} Like always, at that time, the floor will be almost empty. That's when we make our move—before anyone knows what the Sekimeiya is. We know the people who show up earliest get in earliest. Atase, you will be there first."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Intimidated by his boss's words, Atase stared hesitantly. He hadn't heard the entire plan yet, but it already sounded dangerous.
entries.literal: "Intimidated by his boss's words, Atase stared hesitantly. He hadn't heard the entire plan yet, but it already sounded dangerous."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Ido will be there too. Once you're inside, he will secretly give you a small grenade that he'll bring in the previous day with the cleaning cart. When the event begins, it'll go off in front of the Sekimeiya, and it'll knock everyone out. The smoke will rapidly rise up, so to avoid inhaling any, you'll immediately throw yourself to the floor.{w} The cabinet will be unlocked, which will give you the chance to swap the Sekimeiya. Ours will be in the cleaning cart, and so that you don't have to go back to the lobby, Ido will leave it in the cleaning room. After that, you'll keep acting as if you fell unconscious.{w} In the end, despite the attack, Ashiya will think they still have the Sekimeiya, so, the following day, Ido will be able to take the real one out.
entries.literal: "Ido will be there too. Once you're inside, he will secretly give you a small grenade that he'll bring in the previous day with the cleaning cart. When the event begins, it'll go off in front of the Sekimeiya, and it'll knock everyone out. The smoke will rapidly rise up, so to avoid inhaling any, you'll immediately throw yourself to the floor.{w} The cabinet will be unlocked, which will give you the chance to swap the Sekimeiya. Ours will be in the cleaning cart, and so that you don't have to go back to the lobby, Ido will leave it in the cleaning room. After that, you'll keep acting as if you fell unconscious.{w} In the end, despite the attack, Ashiya will think they still have the Sekimeiya, so, the following day, Ido will be able to take the real one out."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Wait a second... Wh-Why do I have to do this? Shouldn't Ido be the one? This could go horribly wrong!
entries.literal: "Wait a second... Wh-Why do I have to do this? Shouldn't Ido be the one? This could go horribly wrong!"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: No. At the time of the event, Ido has no reason to be in the event room. Furthermore, it's likely the people present will be investigated, which could lead Ashiya to find the real Sekimeiya in the cart before we can obtain it.{w} This could go wrong, sure, but it can work. However, see it as a chance I'm giving you.{w} You screwed up badly. Not only should you redeem yourself to us, but to yourself. If you're found, you will be seen as a killer. Make sure this plan works before you think of asking for our help again.
entries.literal: "No. At the time of the event, Ido has no reason to be in the event room. Furthermore, it's likely the people present will be investigated, which could lead Ashiya to find the real Sekimeiya in the cart before we can obtain it.{w} This could go wrong, sure, but it can work. However, see it as a chance I'm giving you.{w} You screwed up badly. Not only should you redeem yourself to us, but to yourself. If you're found, you will be seen as a killer. Make sure this plan works before you think of asking for our help again."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: W-Will you offer help if this goes well?
entries.literal: "W-Will you offer help if this goes well?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: That's something you will have to ask again after the 15th. Until then, you're still nothing but trouble for us—disposing of you is what we should do. ...Do you understand why it is essential that this is not a failure?
entries.literal: "That's something you will have to ask again after the 15th. Until then, you're still nothing but trouble for us—disposing of you is what we should do. ...Do you understand why it is essential that this is not a failure?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...{w}I don't even get what you said, though. I'll still be recorded if I do this.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't even get what you said, though. I'll still be recorded if I do this."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: No. The smokescreen will cover you. We'll make sure it works as a barrier for the camera.
entries.literal: "No. The smokescreen will cover you. We'll make sure it works as a barrier for the camera."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: But what about the hallway!? I'll be seen going to the cleaning room!
entries.literal: "But what about the hallway!? I'll be seen going to the cleaning room!"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: That is one reason why smoke should also be released there.{w} Like in every guided visit, everyone else will be in the lobby. If smoke appears in both hallways, everyone will quickly evacuate, as they'll be worried about it being poisonous or there being a fire. Then, the exit will be guarded to make sure nobody runs out with stolen gems.{w} Katei Kuiji will be in the security room, so due to the smoke, he won't be able to leave it without falling unconscious, and he won't see what's happening in the building.{w} When everyone is knocked out, you will go to the cleaning room and obtain our fake. It is essential that you do this first to make sure no one sees you. You will leave your smoke grenade in the cart and subsequently go back to swap the gemstones.
entries.literal: "That is one reason why smoke should also be released there.{w} Like in every guided visit, everyone else will be in the lobby. If smoke appears in both hallways, everyone will quickly evacuate, as they'll be worried about it being poisonous or there being a fire. Then, the exit will be guarded to make sure nobody runs out with stolen gems.{w} Katei Kuiji will be in the security room, so due to the smoke, he won't be able to leave it without falling unconscious, and he won't see what's happening in the building.{w} When everyone is knocked out, you will go to the cleaning room and obtain our fake. It is essential that you do this first to make sure no one sees you. You will leave your smoke grenade in the cart and subsequently go back to swap the gemstones."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...Who will set off the smoke outside the event room, though?
entries.literal: "...Who will set off the smoke outside the event room, though?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Nobody will. Setting up a timer is the easiest thing in the world. We know when they have to go off: at {time=9:04.}
entries.literal: "Nobody will. Setting up a timer is the easiest thing in the world. We know when they have to go off: at {time=9:04.}"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: No, we don't...! The event will begin at {time=9}, but we don't know when the cabinet will be unlocked!
entries.literal: "No, we don't...! The event will begin at {time=9}, but we don't know when the cabinet will be unlocked!"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: That doesn't matter. Ido has seen the key and how to use it. If the smoke goes off before the cabinet is unlocked, the guide will be knocked out, and they will have the key on their person.
entries.literal: "That doesn't matter. Ido has seen the key and how to use it. If the smoke goes off before the cabinet is unlocked, the guide will be knocked out, and they will have the key on their person."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: And where exactly will the smoke bombs be in the hallways?
entries.literal: "And where exactly will the smoke bombs be in the hallways?"

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Don't you remember? We can use the handrails.{w} Behind them, the small grenades will be hidden, and it works perfectly for us. The cameras in the hallways are placed to focus on the doors, so there are parts of the handrails that aren't visible.{w} When Ido is cleaning, he can secretly place a grenade and slide it toward a point of the handrail that's being recorded. We will need two per hallway, and it'll seem like anyone could've placed them the previous day.
entries.literal: "Don't you remember? We can use the handrails.{w} Behind them, the small grenades will be hidden, and it works perfectly for us. The cameras in the hallways are placed to focus on the doors, so there are parts of the handrails that aren't visible.{w} When Ido is cleaning, he can secretly place a grenade and slide it toward a point of the handrail that's being recorded. We will need two per hallway, and it'll seem like anyone could've placed them the previous day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Finally, both subordinates understood how serious their boss was and broke into a sweat. As they took off and draped their heavy attire on the back of their chairs, they began to process each step of what they would be performing.
entries.literal: "Finally, both subordinates understood how serious their boss was and broke into a sweat. As they took off and draped their heavy attire on the back of their chairs, they began to process each step of what they would be performing."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: ...And that's not all. There's something else we'll do that will divert suspicion from Ido.{w} After all, if this works, we still wouldn't be in the clear. After suffering such a major attack, will Ashiya really believe nothing was stolen? If they're careful, they might not believe it and end up finding the real Sekimeiya.{w} So, we will give them a reason to believe it.{w} Their focus will be on the Sekimeiya; that's what they expect to be targeted, and the measures they're taking clearly involve it, as proven by the new cabinet and it only having one key. Targeting a different room will be much less problematic.{w} In the morning, before the event, the cameras will be monitored. However, there are more cameras than monitors, and only the hallways and a few crystal rooms are displayed at once, correct, Ido?
entries.literal: "...And that's not all. There's something else we'll do that will divert suspicion from Ido.{w} After all, if this works, we still wouldn't be in the clear. After suffering such a major attack, will Ashiya really believe nothing was stolen? If they're careful, they might not believe it and end up finding the real Sekimeiya.{w} So, we will give them a reason to believe it.{w} Their focus will be on the Sekimeiya; that's what they expect to be targeted, and the measures they're taking clearly involve it, as proven by the new cabinet and it only having one key. Targeting a different room will be much less problematic.{w} In the morning, before the event, the cameras will be monitored. However, there are more cameras than monitors, and only the hallways and a few crystal rooms are displayed at once, correct, Ido?"

entries.speaker: ido
entries.text: ...Yes. I've never seen the smaller one in hallway A being displayed. It's normally just the hallway.
entries.literal: "...Yes. I've never seen the smaller one in hallway A being displayed. It's normally just the hallway."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Exactly. This means that if you put all the gems there into a case, you won't be seen. We would usually never do this, as it makes you the only suspect, but this isn't an issue this time.{w} The curtains aren't raised until {time=9:10}, so you'll leave all of them down. You'll also leave the case in the room, in the corner beneath the camera, so that we can have a visitor be there when the smoke is released, crouching right as it happens. If they keep their head near the floor as they exit the tower with the case, they won't fall unconscious.{w} Two minutes after the smoke has been released, he will attempt to flee. This will make Ashiya think their expectations were subverted and that the failed attack had that room as its final target.{w} ...I doubt Faiten will be willing to take this job under any circumstances, but I'll find the right person without telling them the full extent of the plan.
entries.literal: "Exactly. This means that if you put all the gems there into a case, you won't be seen. We would usually never do this, as it makes you the only suspect, but this isn't an issue this time.{w} The curtains aren't raised until {time=9:10}, so you'll leave all of them down. You'll also leave the case in the room, in the corner beneath the camera, so that we can have a visitor be there when the smoke is released, crouching right as it happens. If they keep their head near the floor as they exit the tower with the case, they won't fall unconscious.{w} Two minutes after the smoke has been released, he will attempt to flee. This will make Ashiya think their expectations were subverted and that the failed attack had that room as its final target.{w} ...I doubt Faiten will be willing to take this job under any circumstances, but I'll find the right person without telling them the full extent of the plan."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Since the reason behind doing this is passing off that room as the target, the smoke will need to be released there as well, so that's where Ido will leave the last grenade.
entries.literal: "Since the reason behind doing this is passing off that room as the target, the smoke will need to be released there as well, so that's where Ido will leave the last grenade."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...But, what...? I'm very confused. All of this will be recorded.
entries.literal: "...But, what...? I'm very confused. All of this will be recorded."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Yes.{w} Before, I said that infecting the computer again could be risky. While that is true, it won't be an issue if we take the proper measures.{w} When the smoke is released, I will infect the computer remotely. While Katei is overwhelmed by the attack, it'll take me a few seconds to erase the saved footage of the previous 24 hours. Then, I will immediately disconnect our access so that we can't be tracked.{w} This will work in four different ways.{w} It will remove the footage that incriminates Ido.{w} It will remove the footage showing the source of the smoke in the event room.{w} It will make them think we had to remove the hallways' footage to hide who placed the grenades there, when that's not actually needed.{w} And lastly, it will hide that we can access the computer at any time, because they might think we were able to erase the footage thanks to the commotion of the attack.{w} ...This is it. This is what we'll do, and how we'll nab the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Yes.{w} Before, I said that infecting the computer again could be risky. While that is true, it won't be an issue if we take the proper measures.{w} When the smoke is released, I will infect the computer remotely. While Katei is overwhelmed by the attack, it'll take me a few seconds to erase the saved footage of the previous 24 hours. Then, I will immediately disconnect our access so that we can't be tracked.{w} This will work in four different ways.{w} It will remove the footage that incriminates Ido.{w} It will remove the footage showing the source of the smoke in the event room.{w} It will make them think we had to remove the hallways' footage to hide who placed the grenades there, when that's not actually needed.{w} And lastly, it will hide that we can access the computer at any time, because they might think we were able to erase the footage thanks to the commotion of the attack.{w} ...This is it. This is what we'll do, and how we'll nab the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: kr
entries.text: Once the plan is a success, we'll get it out of the building with the cart. However, how do we let Ashiya know their Sekimeiya is fake? Whatever the best answer is, it relies on the crafting process.{w} You said the Sekimeiya's kept pretty cold. There aren't many chemical reactions that occur at low temperatures, but perhaps we could make use of one to damage the Sekimeiya after a couple of days of exposure.{w} If not, then a mere timed reaction would suffice, one that would break our Sekimeiya and leave behind a card with our name.
entries.literal: "Once the plan is a success, we'll get it out of the building with the cart. However, how do we let Ashiya know their Sekimeiya is fake? Whatever the best answer is, it relies on the crafting process.{w} You said the Sekimeiya's kept pretty cold. There aren't many chemical reactions that occur at low temperatures, but perhaps we could make use of one to damage the Sekimeiya after a couple of days of exposure.{w} If not, then a mere timed reaction would suffice, one that would break our Sekimeiya and leave behind a card with our name."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei saw the busy waveform, he knew his bait had been effective.{w} Since Xyn had attacked the gem shop, Ido hadn't spoken to his boss. Katei had wanted to know Xyn's position after their failure, so he had given Ido information about the Sekimeiya to report to his group.
entries.literal: "When Katei saw the busy waveform, he knew his bait had been effective.{w} Since Xyn had attacked the gem shop, Ido hadn't spoken to his boss. Katei had wanted to know Xyn's position after their failure, so he had given Ido information about the Sekimeiya to report to his group."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At a low volume, he listened to the audio in his dim office. The second time, the conversation was a lot more substantial.{w} Katei thrilled internally; an overwhelming amount of details were being revealed to him. He finally knew many of Xyn's secrets that had tormented him for so long.{w} He heard Xyn design their plan, even though the end sounded muffled. Ashiya's lure wouldn't work; there would be no attack before the 15th, and most importantly, Katei could no longer follow through with his scheme.{w} Xyn would attack during the daytime. The alarm wouldn't be activated, and Katei's voice could be heard by other people. In addition, even if the alarm was activated, Katei wouldn't be able to offer a Xyn member a quick escape, as the outside of the building wouldn't be deserted.
entries.literal: "At a low volume, he listened to the audio in his dim office. The second time, the conversation was a lot more substantial.{w} Katei thrilled internally; an overwhelming amount of details were being revealed to him. He finally knew many of Xyn's secrets that had tormented him for so long.{w} He heard Xyn design their plan, even though the end sounded muffled. Ashiya's lure wouldn't work; there would be no attack before the 15th, and most importantly, Katei could no longer follow through with his scheme.{w} Xyn would attack during the daytime. The alarm wouldn't be activated, and Katei's voice could be heard by other people. In addition, even if the alarm was activated, Katei wouldn't be able to offer a Xyn member a quick escape, as the outside of the building wouldn't be deserted."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, there was something else Katei realized: Xyn were right. The Sekimeiya's value was already much higher than what Ashiya had expected.{w} To incentivize Xyn's attack, Ashiya had been building an air of mystery around the gemstone, which had rapidly expanded. Until the 15th, the Sekimeiya's worth would be far higher than everything else Ashiya had ever possessed.{w} Katei didn't feel pressured. He had very valuable information, and he had learned that the concept of his plan could still be executed, albeit differently. He could anonymously threaten Ido with the audio, but that would give away Katei's source of information, and unlike after his previous plan, Xyn wouldn't be indebted to him. As such, he decided to change his way of thinking for the time being.
entries.literal: "However, there was something else Katei realized: Xyn were right. The Sekimeiya's value was already much higher than what Ashiya had expected.{w} To incentivize Xyn's attack, Ashiya had been building an air of mystery around the gemstone, which had rapidly expanded. Until the 15th, the Sekimeiya's worth would be far higher than everything else Ashiya had ever possessed.{w} Katei didn't feel pressured. He had very valuable information, and he had learned that the concept of his plan could still be executed, albeit differently. He could anonymously threaten Ido with the audio, but that would give away Katei's source of information, and unlike after his previous plan, Xyn wouldn't be indebted to him. As such, he decided to change his way of thinking for the time being."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The Sekimeiya... he could obtain it himself and postpone the idea of blackmailing Xyn. He had the key to the cabinet and a trump card he'd saved for years—the storeroom's secret.{w} Before Katei's parents had died, the building had undergone severe expansions. The secret corridor had always remained a hidden part of the lowest floor, but nobody who knew about it remained.{w} Naturally, Katei had tested it already to deduce whether Xyn were aware of its existence. He had easily been able to confirm it had never opened during their attacks.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya... he could obtain it himself and postpone the idea of blackmailing Xyn. He had the key to the cabinet and a trump card he'd saved for years—the storeroom's secret.{w} Before Katei's parents had died, the building had undergone severe expansions. The secret corridor had always remained a hidden part of the lowest floor, but nobody who knew about it remained.{w} Naturally, Katei had tested it already to deduce whether Xyn were aware of its existence. He had easily been able to confirm it had never opened during their attacks."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How could Katei take the Sekimeiya out of the tower? Despite all he knew, it wasn't a simple task.{w} He couldn't act out a fake Xyn attack when he didn't have the night shift: if he entered through the storeroom, he would be seen from the security room.{w} He could take action when he had the night shift. He could bring the Sekimeiya to the storeroom and claim Xyn had erased the security footage. But would such a thing be believable?{w} He wasn't worried that Xyn could threaten him anymore—he had the upper hand in that battle, as he could expose a good deal about them. Yet, Katei's story would be too convenient. His alarm would have to be somehow bypassed, and Katei would have to let them escape.
entries.literal: "How could Katei take the Sekimeiya out of the tower? Despite all he knew, it wasn't a simple task.{w} He couldn't act out a fake Xyn attack when he didn't have the night shift: if he entered through the storeroom, he would be seen from the security room.{w} He could take action when he had the night shift. He could bring the Sekimeiya to the storeroom and claim Xyn had erased the security footage. But would such a thing be believable?{w} He wasn't worried that Xyn could threaten him anymore—he had the upper hand in that battle, as he could expose a good deal about them. Yet, Katei's story would be too convenient. His alarm would have to be somehow bypassed, and Katei would have to let them escape."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What if he activated the alarm by forcing open the cabinet? Then, when the exit unlocked, no Xyn member would be found in the building, and the Sekimeiya would've magically disappeared.{w} There was only one way Katei could make that work: by saying he had seen someone escaping toward the storeroom. However, he didn't want to reveal the existence of the hidden door yet.{w} There was no smooth story that let Katei weasel out. He didn't want to be investigated by Ashiya or Xyn, but every scenario sounded iffy and had him as an easy suspect.{w} That was until he realized that the perfect moment existed.{w} A moment where he wouldn't be the only suspect, and where his story would be believed without doubt: the day of the event.
entries.literal: "What if he activated the alarm by forcing open the cabinet? Then, when the exit unlocked, no Xyn member would be found in the building, and the Sekimeiya would've magically disappeared.{w} There was only one way Katei could make that work: by saying he had seen someone escaping toward the storeroom. However, he didn't want to reveal the existence of the hidden door yet.{w} There was no smooth story that let Katei weasel out. He didn't want to be investigated by Ashiya or Xyn, but every scenario sounded iffy and had him as an easy suspect.{w} That was until he realized that the perfect moment existed.{w} A moment where he wouldn't be the only suspect, and where his story would be believed without doubt: the day of the event."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The day when Xyn would be in the tower, and when Katei would be in the security room. He could use their own attack against them to obfuscate his involvement.
entries.literal: "The day when Xyn would be in the tower, and when Katei would be in the security room. He could use their own attack against them to obfuscate his involvement."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He knew what would happen and what Xyn's actions would be. He immediately thought of a way to take advantage of them.
entries.literal: "He knew what would happen and what Xyn's actions would be. He immediately thought of a way to take advantage of them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The Sekimeiya cabinet had been designed to trigger the alarm upon being minimally damaged. At {time=9:04}, a vast cloud of smoke was going to be released in the event room. Even though the cabinet could be unlocked, the mere damage of the smoke could set off the alarm.{w} In any case, if the alarm went off at that time, it wouldn't be questioned: a real attack would've triggered it, so it would've served its function.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya cabinet had been designed to trigger the alarm upon being minimally damaged. At {time=9:04}, a vast cloud of smoke was going to be released in the event room. Even though the cabinet could be unlocked, the mere damage of the smoke could set off the alarm.{w} In any case, if the alarm went off at that time, it wouldn't be questioned: a real attack would've triggered it, so it would've served its function."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei had designed the system, and he knew Xyn didn't have access to the tower's computer. If he altered the system to automatically activate the alarm at that time, no one would know.{w} He could trap Xyn in the tower and commandeer the rest of their plan himself. In addition, Katei had another reason to trigger the alarm: to aid Xyn before his intervention. The only way their plan could fail was if people from the outside quickly raided the building despite the smoke. That was something the alarm could prevent.
entries.literal: "Katei had designed the system, and he knew Xyn didn't have access to the tower's computer. If he altered the system to automatically activate the alarm at that time, no one would know.{w} He could trap Xyn in the tower and commandeer the rest of their plan himself. In addition, Katei had another reason to trigger the alarm: to aid Xyn before his intervention. The only way their plan could fail was if people from the outside quickly raided the building despite the smoke. That was something the alarm could prevent."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei's initial idea was promising, and he could develop it further.{w} Xyn would disable the hallway A cameras, where the security room and the storeroom were. That meant that before the attack, Katei could quickly go to the lobby to discuss what to do during the event with the police. That would be the last recording of hallway A.{w} Upon seeing the smoke, everyone would rapidly evacuate, unaware that the alarm was soon to be activated. Then, during the chaos, Katei would reenter the hallway.
entries.literal: "Katei's initial idea was promising, and he could develop it further.{w} Xyn would disable the hallway A cameras, where the security room and the storeroom were. That meant that before the attack, Katei could quickly go to the lobby to discuss what to do during the event with the police. That would be the last recording of hallway A.{w} Upon seeing the smoke, everyone would rapidly evacuate, unaware that the alarm was soon to be activated. Then, during the chaos, Katei would reenter the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That would no longer be caught by the cameras. As he'd heard Xyn's discussion, he knew that by crawling, he would avoid falling unconscious.{w} He knew what Atase's movements would be—the alarm wouldn't influence them. He would go to the cleaning room, so Katei had the opportunity to take the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet if it was unlocked. If it wasn't, he'd go take it from the cleaning cart after Atase finished his job.
entries.literal: "That would no longer be caught by the cameras. As he'd heard Xyn's discussion, he knew that by crawling, he would avoid falling unconscious.{w} He knew what Atase's movements would be—the alarm wouldn't influence them. He would go to the cleaning room, so Katei had the opportunity to take the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet if it was unlocked. If it wasn't, he'd go take it from the cleaning cart after Atase finished his job."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he could rapidly go to the storeroom and leave the Sekimeiya behind the movable wall. Lei had told him it couldn't be kept at a warm temperature, but the storeroom's corridor was colder than the rest of the tower due to its lack of insulation and air conditioning.{w} Lastly, he would leave using his unique key. Everyone would be in front of the entrance, so he wouldn't be seen stepping out of the building. Then, he would appear from behind them, as if he had evacuated, which hallway A's camera would corroborate.
entries.literal: "Then, he could rapidly go to the storeroom and leave the Sekimeiya behind the movable wall. Lei had told him it couldn't be kept at a warm temperature, but the storeroom's corridor was colder than the rest of the tower due to its lack of insulation and air conditioning.{w} Lastly, he would leave using his unique key. Everyone would be in front of the entrance, so he wouldn't be seen stepping out of the building. Then, he would appear from behind them, as if he had evacuated, which hallway A's camera would corroborate."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody would be in the security room, so after twelve hours, the shutter would open. Then, someone inside the building would be guaranteed to be a member of Xyn and responsible for triggering the alarm.
entries.literal: "Nobody would be in the security room, so after twelve hours, the shutter would open. Then, someone inside the building would be guaranteed to be a member of Xyn and responsible for triggering the alarm."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, nobody would know the Sekimeiya had been stolen because Xyn's fake would remain inside, and nobody would suspect Katei of having any involvement, as he couldn't have. Not even Xyn would suspect him.
entries.literal: "However, nobody would know the Sekimeiya had been stolen because Xyn's fake would remain inside, and nobody would suspect Katei of having any involvement, as he couldn't have. Not even Xyn would suspect him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And in the future, he could retrieve the real Sekimeiya from the storeroom without an issue.
entries.literal: "And in the future, he could retrieve the real Sekimeiya from the storeroom without an issue."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everything was finally in motion, and the long wait for the day of the event began.{w} Ashiya, Xyn, and Katei. Each of those three parties had their own unique agenda.
entries.literal: "Everything was finally in motion, and the long wait for the day of the event began.{w} Ashiya, Xyn, and Katei. Each of those three parties had their own unique agenda."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Every night, Ashiya expected Xyn's attack. However, Katei knew it wouldn't happen yet and kept mentally rehearsing his plan.
entries.literal: "Every night, Ashiya expected Xyn's attack. However, Katei knew it wouldn't happen yet and kept mentally rehearsing his plan."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Meanwhile, Xyn received their replica of the Sekimeiya.{w} Ido, who had seen, touched, and measured the original, confirmed there was no glaring difference between the two, and that unless Ashiya had foreseen a replica being created, it would work.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, Xyn received their replica of the Sekimeiya.{w} Ido, who had seen, touched, and measured the original, confirmed there was no glaring difference between the two, and that unless Ashiya had foreseen a replica being created, it would work."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As the days approached, Ashiya realized Xyn were likely to not fall for their trap, and as Xyn had predicted, the Sekimeiya continued to grow more valuable in the eyes of the world.{w} Ashiya hadn't fully prepared the event yet, so a trusted employee of theirs was chosen to plan out the guided visits.
entries.literal: "As the days approached, Ashiya realized Xyn were likely to not fall for their trap, and as Xyn had predicted, the Sekimeiya continued to grow more valuable in the eyes of the world.{w} Ashiya hadn't fully prepared the event yet, so a trusted employee of theirs was chosen to plan out the guided visits."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase was under a lot of pressure. He had to make sure the plan was a success, and if he executed what had been laid out perfectly, the odds would be in his favor.
entries.literal: "Atase was under a lot of pressure. He had to make sure the plan was a success, and if he executed what had been laid out perfectly, the odds would be in his favor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: All the preparations had been made. Slowly, the days of December ticked up to the 15th.
entries.literal: "All the preparations had been made. Slowly, the days of December ticked up to the 15th."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, nobody expected what would happen on that day.
entries.literal: "However, nobody expected what would happen on that day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Eight people were trapped in Ashiya Tower, but they weren't alone. That was the catalyst of the construction of a mountainous maze.{w} Who reached its peak? It wasn't everyone who began the climb.
entries.literal: "Eight people were trapped in Ashiya Tower, but they weren't alone. That was the catalyst of the construction of a mountainous maze.{w} Who reached its peak? It wasn't everyone who began the climb."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You are lucky enough to have access to all its sides, but what about the peak?{w} Three parties formed the mountain's base, unaware of how high it would go.
entries.literal: "You are lucky enough to have access to all its sides, but what about the peak?{w} Three parties formed the mountain's base, unaware of how high it would go."

entries.text: Xyn
entries.literal: "Xyn"

entries.text: Katei
entries.literal: "Katei"

entries.text: Ashiya
entries.literal: "Ashiya"

entries.text: Continue
entries.literal: "Continue"

entries.text: Contrition
entries.literal: "Contrition"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the tower opened, Atase was the only person waiting outside. He wore light attire despite the cold.
entries.literal: "When the tower opened, Atase was the only person waiting outside. He wore light attire despite the cold."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He bowed at the receptionist and stepped in slowly. A man walked up to him, asking for his ticket. After showing it and confirming that he didn't have a phone, he stepped to the hallway B door.
entries.literal: "He bowed at the receptionist and stepped in slowly. A man walked up to him, asking for his ticket. After showing it and confirming that he didn't have a phone, he stepped to the hallway B door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was very early in the morning. For a while, all he heard was the receptionist shuffling a bunch of papers behind the desk.
entries.literal: "It was very early in the morning. For a while, all he heard was the receptionist shuffling a bunch of papers behind the desk."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next person he saw was Ido. Without looking over, he casually made his way to the hallway.{w} It took him a while to come back. When he did, his clothes were different, and he was carrying a cleaning bucket.
entries.literal: "The next person he saw was Ido. Without looking over, he casually made his way to the hallway.{w} It took him a while to come back. When he did, his clothes were different, and he was carrying a cleaning bucket."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase was relieved. Nothing had happened, so Ido's part of the plan had gone well. He didn't have the cleaning cart, as it was waiting for Atase with the fake Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Atase was relieved. Nothing had happened, so Ido's part of the plan had gone well. He didn't have the cleaning cart, as it was waiting for Atase with the fake Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Idly mopping the floor, Ido got close to Atase. That was when he dropped a tiny grenade in his pocket. At that point, everything was ready—the action was poised to begin.
entries.literal: "Idly mopping the floor, Ido got close to Atase. That was when he dropped a tiny grenade in his pocket. At that point, everything was ready—the action was poised to begin."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase turned around when he heard something at his back. Two more people were by the entrance: a boy and a girl.
entries.literal: "Atase turned around when he heard something at his back. Two more people were by the entrance: a boy and a girl."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Out of nowhere, Atase felt a sudden wave of heat. ...He had seen the boy before.{w} In Musashi Gemstones, he had been the first to be hit by the smoke. Atsuki Hakutoki was his name, and he'd been safely discharged from the hospital.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, Atase felt a sudden wave of heat. ...He had seen the boy before.{w} In Musashi Gemstones, he had been the first to be hit by the smoke. Atsuki Hakutoki was his name, and he'd been safely discharged from the hospital."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase swiftly looked away. On that day, his face had been disguised, but what if he was recognized? He stared at the floor as they walked closer to him, clenching his fists tightly.
entries.literal: "Atase swiftly looked away. On that day, his face had been disguised, but what if he was recognized? He stared at the floor as they walked closer to him, clenching his fists tightly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...{w}He had to avoid eye contact; the boy next to him had lost someone, and it had been his fault.{w} He had taken a glance at the girl as well. Although he hadn't seen her before, the eyes below her red hair looked identical to the boy's.
entries.literal: "...{w}He had to avoid eye contact; the boy next to him had lost someone, and it had been his fault.{w} He had taken a glance at the girl as well. Although he hadn't seen her before, the eyes below her red hair looked identical to the boy's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: {time=9:00} was distant. Long before it, police officers arrived outside the tower.{w} Atase's rough facial description must've been known. He didn't think he'd be recognized, but he couldn't bring himself to look back.
entries.literal: "{time=9:00} was distant. Long before it, police officers arrived outside the tower.{w} Atase's rough facial description must've been known. He didn't think he'd be recognized, but he couldn't bring himself to look back."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: All at once, a wave of people flooded in. Faint chatter took over the silence, but none of it reached Atase. He had to look calm and know exactly what to do.{w} He saw someone he knew outside the lobby. However, that person didn't know who Atase was. His job was to take out a suitcase at {time=9:06.}
entries.literal: "All at once, a wave of people flooded in. Faint chatter took over the silence, but none of it reached Atase. He had to look calm and know exactly what to do.{w} He saw someone he knew outside the lobby. However, that person didn't know who Atase was. His job was to take out a suitcase at {time=9:06.}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Ido had left through the opposite hallway a while ago. When he came back, he started to mop the floor a second time.
entries.literal: "Ido had left through the opposite hallway a while ago. When he came back, he started to mop the floor a second time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Slowly, the time kept passing.{w} After Ido was done with the little plaza, he entered again, mopping the new snowy footprints and the already shining floor.
entries.literal: "Slowly, the time kept passing.{w} After Ido was done with the little plaza, he entered again, mopping the new snowy footprints and the already shining floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For a while, he kept doing that. He had to stay there, as he knew what was soon to happen in the hallways.
entries.literal: "For a while, he kept doing that. He had to stay there, as he knew what was soon to happen in the hallways."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Shiroya...?
entries.literal: "Shiroya...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase's heart skipped a beat. Behind him, he'd heard the voice of Katei Kuiji. However, that name...
entries.literal: "Atase's heart skipped a beat. Behind him, he'd heard the voice of Katei Kuiji. However, that name..."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Is this yours? I think you dropped it.
entries.literal: "Is this yours? I think you dropped it."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: ...Thank you.
entries.literal: "...Thank you."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase's head slowly turned to the girl.{w} She wasn't Shiroya. That was the name of the girl whose memory pressed down on his shoulders.
entries.literal: "Atase's head slowly turned to the girl.{w} She wasn't Shiroya. That was the name of the girl whose memory pressed down on his shoulders."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Who was that, then?{w} Atase would soon learn.
entries.literal: "Who was that, then?{w} Atase would soon learn."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At {time=9}, the door to hallway B opened. Through it came Naomi Cabca, who gave a brief explanation of the event.{w} It was time. Only four minutes were left.
entries.literal: "At {time=9}, the door to hallway B opened. Through it came Naomi Cabca, who gave a brief explanation of the event.{w} It was time. Only four minutes were left."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Are you three the first group?
entries.literal: "Are you three the first group?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: Yeah, we've been here for a while.
entries.literal: "Yeah, we've been here for a while."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Perfect. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Perfect. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Quietly, the three people at the front of the line stepped into the hallway and were drawn to the room in the middle.
entries.literal: "Quietly, the three people at the front of the line stepped into the hallway and were drawn to the room in the middle."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A single cabinet was there, covered by a velvet curtain. It was a sight Atase had seen before through a picture.
entries.literal: "A single cabinet was there, covered by a velvet curtain. It was a sight Atase had seen before through a picture."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: All right. It would be helpful if you could tell me your names so that I know how to address you.
entries.literal: "All right. It would be helpful if you could tell me your names so that I know how to address you."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I'm Miiya Moiromo.
entries.literal: "I'm Miiya Moiromo."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was her name. It was one Atase remembered. Miiya Moiromo had been in the shop as well, but she hadn't been hit by the impact of the explosion.
entries.literal: "That was her name. It was one Atase remembered. Miiya Moiromo had been in the shop as well, but she hadn't been hit by the impact of the explosion."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Akaro Esata". For the first time in hours, Atase opened his mouth, voicing the name that had been on his ticket.
entries.literal: "\"Akaro Esata\". For the first time in hours, Atase opened his mouth, voicing the name that had been on his ticket."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...Atsuki Hakutoki.
entries.literal: "...Atsuki Hakutoki."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi began to explain the story behind the Sekimeiya. As she did, Atase wondered if any bit of truth was coming out of her mouth.
entries.literal: "Naomi began to explain the story behind the Sekimeiya. As she did, Atase wondered if any bit of truth was coming out of her mouth."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Part of the experience is the touch, so I will open the glass and let you experience it yourselves. However, I must insist that you be gentle and keep your hands inside the cabinet at all times.
entries.literal: "Part of the experience is the touch, so I will open the glass and let you experience it yourselves. However, I must insist that you be gentle and keep your hands inside the cabinet at all times."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She took out a keyring. After inserting a small one into the cabinet, she unlocked it.
entries.literal: "She took out a keyring. After inserting a small one into the cabinet, she unlocked it."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: I have a question.
entries.literal: "I have a question."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Hm? What is it?
entries.literal: "Hm? What is it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase suppressed his nervousness as best he could. The cabinet had been unlocked, so the plan was very close to succeeding. However, a few seconds still remained until {time=9:04.}
entries.literal: "Atase suppressed his nervousness as best he could. The cabinet had been unlocked, so the plan was very close to succeeding. However, a few seconds still remained until {time=9:04.}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He attempted to slow Naomi down. She had been about to raise the curtain and let them touch the gemstone. If that happened before the smoke was released, the Sekimeiya could be hit by it, which could later reveal that the clean one was Xyn's fake.
entries.literal: "He attempted to slow Naomi down. She had been about to raise the curtain and let them touch the gemstone. If that happened before the smoke was released, the Sekimeiya could be hit by it, which could later reveal that the clean one was Xyn's fake."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: You keep mentioning how valuable the Sekimeiya is, but is there proof of that? The way you're explaining it, you don't even say what kind of gem it is, only that it's "rare".
entries.literal: "You keep mentioning how valuable the Sekimeiya is, but is there proof of that? The way you're explaining it, you don't even say what kind of gem it is, only that it's \"rare\"."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: But the value could've been arbitrarily created by Ashiya, as it's not being officially recognized as anything more than an unusual discovery.
entries.literal: "But the value could've been arbitrarily created by Ashiya, as it's not being officially recognized as anything more than an unusual discovery."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Well, I will let you decide that for yourself. As you said, it's not categorized because nobody was able to properly appraise it. That's all you need to be assured of its value.
entries.literal: "Well, I will let you decide that for yourself. As you said, it's not categorized because nobody was able to properly appraise it. That's all you need to be assured of its value."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: I apologize for being skeptical, but you must be aware that Ashiya aren't exactly recognized for their fairness.
entries.literal: "I apologize for being skeptical, but you must be aware that Ashiya aren't exactly recognized for their fairness."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Do you have a reason to say that?
entries.literal: "Do you have a reason to say that?"

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: Yes, that everyone in the lobby sounded as skeptical as I am.
entries.literal: "Yes, that everyone in the lobby sounded as skeptical as I am."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Maybe seeing it for yourself will convince you.
entries.literal: "Maybe seeing it for yourself will convince you."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: That's what I'm hoping.
entries.literal: "That's what I'm hoping."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a pause, Naomi shook her head and crouched beside the cabinet. When she raised the curtain, a huge cloud of smoke rose with it, coming from the grenade Atase had taken out of his pocket.
entries.literal: "After a pause, Naomi shook her head and crouched beside the cabinet. When she raised the curtain, a huge cloud of smoke rose with it, coming from the grenade Atase had taken out of his pocket."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before anyone could resist, Atase had already fallen to the floor. Looking down and covering his nose, he avoided having his consciousness fade.
entries.literal: "Before anyone could resist, Atase had already fallen to the floor. Looking down and covering his nose, he avoided having his consciousness fade."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once everyone plummeted down, a sudden, unsettling silence consumed the room.{w} What was happening outside? Had everyone evacuated? Had the gems been brought out in the suitcase? For a few seconds, Atase had to wait to make sure nobody remained conscious.
entries.literal: "Once everyone plummeted down, a sudden, unsettling silence consumed the room.{w} What was happening outside? Had everyone evacuated? Had the gems been brought out in the suitcase? For a few seconds, Atase had to wait to make sure nobody remained conscious."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He heard someone running through hallway A. It must have been the man with the gemstones, but why? Two minutes hadn't passed yet.
entries.literal: "He heard someone running through hallway A. It must have been the man with the gemstones, but why? Two minutes hadn't passed yet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase's eyes widened. What the hell was that sound?
entries.literal: "Atase's eyes widened. What the hell was that sound?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He waited, wondering what was happening. ...Had the plan been a failure?
entries.literal: "He waited, wondering what was happening. ...Had the plan been a failure?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a few seconds, the loud noise faded. However, Atase could not hear anything else outside the room.
entries.literal: "After a few seconds, the loud noise faded. However, Atase could not hear anything else outside the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he looked up, he couldn't believe he was in the same place. Very little light was being cast from the ceiling, and the walls had become dark.
entries.literal: "When he looked up, he couldn't believe he was in the same place. Very little light was being cast from the ceiling, and the walls had become dark."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The three people who'd been with him were lying on the floor. Once he knew he could move, he silently stepped to hallway B.
entries.literal: "The three people who'd been with him were lying on the floor. Once he knew he could move, he silently stepped to hallway B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Again, it was hard to believe it was the same place as before. However, nobody was there.{w} Covering his face, Atase dashed to the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "Again, it was hard to believe it was the same place as before. However, nobody was there.{w} Covering his face, Atase dashed to the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was light; almost no smoke had gone through the door.{w} Occupying most of the space, the cart sat in the room. Without hesitating, he dropped the smoke grenade inside it.
entries.literal: "There was light; almost no smoke had gone through the door.{w} Occupying most of the space, the cart sat in the room. Without hesitating, he dropped the smoke grenade inside it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The fake Sekimeiya was there. However, Atase couldn't touch it with his bare hands, or he would leave smoky fingerprints on it. He took it with the clean sleeves of his shirt and brought it to the hallway, crouching so that the remaining smoke wouldn't make contact with it.
entries.literal: "The fake Sekimeiya was there. However, Atase couldn't touch it with his bare hands, or he would leave smoky fingerprints on it. He took it with the clean sleeves of his shirt and brought it to the hallway, crouching so that the remaining smoke wouldn't make contact with it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Back in the event room, he walked to the cabinet. Like Naomi had been about to do, he raised the curtain.
entries.literal: "Back in the event room, he walked to the cabinet. Like Naomi had been about to do, he raised the curtain."

entries.speaker: ta
entries.text: ...{w}H-Huh?

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stopped cold, suddenly bewildered. Two glowing stones were in front of him.
entries.literal: "He stopped cold, suddenly bewildered. Two glowing stones were in front of him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why? He couldn't comprehend what he was seeing.{w} Had there been two Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Why? He couldn't comprehend what he was seeing.{w} Had there been two Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase had to rush, but he didn't know what to do. If he took both gemstones, Xyn's plan would never work.{w} Dumbfounded, he reached for one of the two; he could only replace a single one.
entries.literal: "Atase had to rush, but he didn't know what to do. If he took both gemstones, Xyn's plan would never work.{w} Dumbfounded, he reached for one of the two; he could only replace a single one."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He felt a screen of glass that he was able to slide open. Then, without placing his fingers on it, he took a gemstone out, swapping it with his.{w} Still in awe, he closed the glass and dropped the curtain down.
entries.literal: "He felt a screen of glass that he was able to slide open. Then, without placing his fingers on it, he took a gemstone out, swapping it with his.{w} Still in awe, he closed the glass and dropped the curtain down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He ran back with the gem in his hands. After locating the door, he moved into hallway B and silently went to the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "He ran back with the gem in his hands. After locating the door, he moved into hallway B and silently went to the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He dropped the Sekimeiya next to the grenade, and once he was done, Atase rushed back to the event room.
entries.literal: "He dropped the Sekimeiya next to the grenade, and once he was done, Atase rushed back to the event room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He made sure to close the door and stepped to the spot where he'd fallen down.
entries.literal: "He made sure to close the door and stepped to the spot where he'd fallen down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, the darkness prevented him from noticing something.{w} Naomi was no longer there.
entries.literal: "However, the darkness prevented him from noticing something.{w} Naomi was no longer there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While Atase lay down, he heard sounds around him: the floor wasn't empty.
entries.literal: "While Atase lay down, he heard sounds around him: the floor wasn't empty."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Just what was happening? Everything started to become stranger when nobody entered where he was.
entries.literal: "Just what was happening? Everything started to become stranger when nobody entered where he was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His job was to stay there, and that was what he did.
entries.literal: "His job was to stay there, and that was what he did."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...{w}But he couldn't make sense of it. Why weren't they being rescued?
entries.literal: "...{w}But he couldn't make sense of it. Why weren't they being rescued?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Wh—{w=0.4} *cough*
entries.literal: "Wh—{w=0.4} *cough*"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The boy woke up.{w} That was the start of a very long day.{w} During the previous weeks, Atase had come up with countless outcomes. However, the real one was far from any he'd devised.
entries.literal: "The boy woke up.{w} That was the start of a very long day.{w} During the previous weeks, Atase had come up with countless outcomes. However, the real one was far from any he'd devised."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They were trapped. The alarm he'd heard had removed all methods of escape.{w} When he learned Naomi had left the event room before his return, he had to hide his fear. ...Could she have noticed Atase's absence upon awakening?
entries.literal: "They were trapped. The alarm he'd heard had removed all methods of escape.{w} When he learned Naomi had left the event room before his return, he had to hide his fear. ...Could she have noticed Atase's absence upon awakening?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was one of his initial questions, but they didn't stop piling up. Atase would have to spend twelve hours in that building until he could leave.
entries.literal: "That was one of his initial questions, but they didn't stop piling up. Atase would have to spend twelve hours in that building until he could leave."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't know how worried he had to be or what had triggered the alarm. Even though the building was full of cameras, he knew not to be afraid of them.{w} He was told the internet connection had been cut by the alarm. In the meantime, Xyn couldn't remotely access the computer. However, he knew his group well. According to Katei, at {time=21}, the connection would come back, and Xyn would immediately erase all the recorded footage.
entries.literal: "He didn't know how worried he had to be or what had triggered the alarm. Even though the building was full of cameras, he knew not to be afraid of them.{w} He was told the internet connection had been cut by the alarm. In the meantime, Xyn couldn't remotely access the computer. However, he knew his group well. According to Katei, at {time=21}, the connection would come back, and Xyn would immediately erase all the recorded footage."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He recalled the conversation he'd had with his boss word by word; he knew how important it was for him not to fail.{w} Therefore, despite the unforeseen alarm, Atase had only one priority: to make the plan a success.
entries.literal: "He recalled the conversation he'd had with his boss word by word; he knew how important it was for him not to fail.{w} Therefore, despite the unforeseen alarm, Atase had only one priority: to make the plan a success."

entries.text: Inside Out
entries.literal: "Inside Out"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was almost time.
entries.literal: "It was almost time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Upon arriving at the tower, Katei had listened to the latest recording. As he'd hoped, Ido and his boss had talked one last time and gone over their movements.{w} Katei took out the SD card—he couldn't allow that audio to be heard by anyone else. As he didn't want the card on his person either, he hid it in the security room.
entries.literal: "Upon arriving at the tower, Katei had listened to the latest recording. As he'd hoped, Ido and his boss had talked one last time and gone over their movements.{w} Katei took out the SD card—he couldn't allow that audio to be heard by anyone else. As he didn't want the card on his person either, he hid it in the security room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The time was rapidly approaching, and he didn't have the opportunity to go back to the staff room. While he tried to remain calm, he hid the voice recorder as well. Although the large device could've been found if Ashiya searched, he knew the SD card wouldn't be, which was all that mattered.{w} Through the monitors, Katei saw the first group approaching the event room. He had to act.
entries.literal: "The time was rapidly approaching, and he didn't have the opportunity to go back to the staff room. While he tried to remain calm, he hid the voice recorder as well.
