Although the large device could've been found if Ashiya searched, he knew the SD card wouldn't be, which was all that mattered.{w} Through the monitors, Katei saw the first group approaching the event room. He had to act."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Even though nobody was seeing him, he approached the hallway nonchalantly. During the previous days, he'd kept coming up with good excuses to get out of the security room at that time.
entries.literal: "Even though nobody was seeing him, he approached the hallway nonchalantly. During the previous days, he'd kept coming up with good excuses to get out of the security room at that time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hallway A was empty, but as soon as Katei entered it, so did someone else. From the lobby came a man with long hair who he'd never seen before.{w} Paying no attention to Katei, he walked forward.
entries.literal: "Hallway A was empty, but as soon as Katei entered it, so did someone else. From the lobby came a man with long hair who he'd never seen before.{w} Paying no attention to Katei, he walked forward."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Behind the handrails, Katei knew the grenades were concealed. However, he couldn't look at them because that footage was going to be reviewed.
entries.literal: "Behind the handrails, Katei knew the grenades were concealed. However, he couldn't look at them because that footage was going to be reviewed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei couldn't get distracted. Keeping his expression natural, he stepped into the lobby.
entries.literal: "Katei couldn't get distracted. Keeping his expression natural, he stepped into the lobby."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The room was full of people. All the visitors formed a line behind hallway B, while police officers conversed with Ashiya's guard.{w} Dote and Asfu, Katei's co-workers, greeted him with a smile. Their job was to uncover the cabinets in most of the crystal rooms, but they knew very few people there that day wanted to see those.
entries.literal: "The room was full of people. All the visitors formed a line behind hallway B, while police officers conversed with Ashiya's guard.{w} Dote and Asfu, Katei's co-workers, greeted him with a smile. Their job was to uncover the cabinets in most of the crystal rooms, but they knew very few people there that day wanted to see those."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One more person reacted to Katei's arrival: the janitor. However, only Katei noticed it, as Ido looked away immediately.
entries.literal: "One more person reacted to Katei's arrival: the janitor. However, only Katei noticed it, as Ido looked away immediately."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...{w}Nobody was looking at him, and he didn't want to walk away from the door. As if waiting for the conversation to end, he stared at the police as they talked.
entries.literal: "...{w}Nobody was looking at him, and he didn't want to walk away from the door. As if waiting for the conversation to end, he stared at the police as they talked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei's plan wasn't guaranteed to work, but he wasn't at risk. Once the smoke was released, the chance to step back into the hallway might not have existed. If someone gestured at Katei to evacuate, he couldn't turn around.{w} However, it didn't matter; he wouldn't be blamed for the attack, and Xyn's plan would still fail. Furthermore, he could attempt to sneak away outside and then reenter the building through the storeroom anyway.
entries.literal: "Katei's plan wasn't guaranteed to work, but he wasn't at risk. Once the smoke was released, the chance to step back into the hallway might not have existed. If someone gestured at Katei to evacuate, he couldn't turn around.{w} However, it didn't matter; he wouldn't be blamed for the attack, and Xyn's plan would still fail. Furthermore, he could attempt to sneak away outside and then reenter the building through the storeroom anyway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The time passed faster than Katei had imagined. All of a sudden, he noticed the light in hallway A disappear.
entries.literal: "The time passed faster than Katei had imagined. All of a sudden, he noticed the light in hallway A disappear."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Wh-What's this!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What's this!?"

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: Smoke! Something happened in the hallway!
entries.literal: "Smoke! Something happened in the hallway!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Someone opened the door in front of the crowd. In an instant, a plume of smoke invaded the lobby, and the door was forcibly shut again.
entries.literal: "Someone opened the door in front of the crowd. In an instant, a plume of smoke invaded the lobby, and the door was forcibly shut again."

entries.speaker: nn
entries.text: It's in both hallways!
entries.literal: "It's in both hallways!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei felt a shock going through his body: that was the moment. In the blink of an eye, everyone had turned around toward the exit, while both police officers were alerting their superiors.{w} As quickly as he could, Katei dashed into the hallway and dropped to his hands and knees.
entries.literal: "Katei felt a shock going through his body: that was the moment. In the blink of an eye, everyone had turned around toward the exit, while both police officers were alerting their superiors.{w} As quickly as he could, Katei dashed into the hallway and dropped to his hands and knees."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the floor, someone almost crashed onto him. A person he couldn't distinguish through the veil of smoke rapidly crawled to the lobby, slamming the door shut behind them.
entries.literal: "On the floor, someone almost crashed onto him. A person he couldn't distinguish through the veil of smoke rapidly crawled to the lobby, slamming the door shut behind them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suddenly, Katei could only hear his heartbeat. That person was undoubtedly the man he'd seen entering the hallway, but he couldn't be heard anymore. Only faint yells could.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, Katei could only hear his heartbeat. That person was undoubtedly the man he'd seen entering the hallway, but he couldn't be heard anymore. Only faint yells could."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was until a loud alarm rang through the building. Immediately afterward, a rough sound came from the lobby, along with stronger yells. The shutter was closing.
entries.literal: "That was until a loud alarm rang through the building. Immediately afterward, a rough sound came from the lobby, along with stronger yells. The shutter was closing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And just like that, Katei's plan was set in motion. He had trapped himself, but nobody had realized it.
entries.literal: "And just like that, Katei's plan was set in motion. He had trapped himself, but nobody had realized it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd seen the floor through the cameras: it was very likely only him and Atase were conscious. With utmost care, he slowly crawled toward the event room.
entries.literal: "He'd seen the floor through the cameras: it was very likely only him and Atase were conscious. With utmost care, he slowly crawled toward the event room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From outside, he heard a sound: Atase was standing up. Amidst the pure silence, Katei heard him going to the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "From outside, he heard a sound: Atase was standing up. Amidst the pure silence, Katei heard him going to the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was Katei's chance to open the door slightly. When he did, he saw the floor of the event room, but all the bodies were too far away to be distinguished.
entries.literal: "That was Katei's chance to open the door slightly. When he did, he saw the floor of the event room, but all the bodies were too far away to be distinguished."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Through the gap, he stared. He knew the darkness would prevent Atase from noticing him, and there was something he had to see.{w} Days earlier, he had uncovered the cabinet's curtain. ...He had seen two identical Sekimeiya lying atop the cushion.{w} Although he'd gotten scared at first, Xyn hadn't planted a fake yet—he knew Ashiya had two identical gemstones.
entries.literal: "Through the gap, he stared. He knew the darkness would prevent Atase from noticing him, and there was something he had to see.{w} Days earlier, he had uncovered the cabinet's curtain. ...He had seen two identical Sekimeiya lying atop the cushion.{w} Although he'd gotten scared at first, Xyn hadn't planted a fake yet—he knew Ashiya had two identical gemstones."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Xyn would only be able to replace one, but Katei had the chance to obtain both. He merely had to observe from the hallway to learn which one got replaced.
entries.literal: "Xyn would only be able to replace one, but Katei had the chance to obtain both. He merely had to observe from the hallway to learn which one got replaced."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It only took Atase a few seconds to come back. When he did, he approached the cabinet while holding a glowing stone.
entries.literal: "It only took Atase a few seconds to come back. When he did, he approached the cabinet while holding a glowing stone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Despite the darkness, once he uncovered the curtain, Katei was able to perceive Atase's shock. Two gemstones were contained in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Despite the darkness, once he uncovered the curtain, Katei was able to perceive Atase's shock. Two gemstones were contained in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He was completely still until he reached for one of them. After taking out the rightmost one, Atase placed his own inside.{w} He ran back without wasting even a second.
entries.literal: "He was completely still until he reached for one of them. After taking out the rightmost one, Atase placed his own inside.{w} He ran back without wasting even a second."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was Katei's moment. Overwhelmed by his unrelenting heartbeat, he rushed to the cabinet, covering his nose as he looked down.
entries.literal: "That was Katei's moment. Overwhelmed by his unrelenting heartbeat, he rushed to the cabinet, covering his nose as he looked down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Admittedly, there was a small difference between them, but he knew the gem on the left was the valuable one. After taking it out, he hurriedly dropped the curtain as if nothing had happened.
entries.literal: "Admittedly, there was a small difference between them, but he knew the gem on the left was the valuable one. After taking it out, he hurriedly dropped the curtain as if nothing had happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He reentered the hallway. Everything was going as planned, but his frantic breaths refused to steady.
entries.literal: "He reentered the hallway. Everything was going as planned, but his frantic breaths refused to steady."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The other Sekimeiya would be in the cleaning cart. Katei only had to be in the tower for a few more seconds.{w} Hallway C was still being recorded, so he skittered to the lobby. However, on the way, he abruptly stopped himself.
entries.literal: "The other Sekimeiya would be in the cleaning cart. Katei only had to be in the tower for a few more seconds.{w} Hallway C was still being recorded, so he skittered to the lobby. However, on the way, he abruptly stopped himself."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stared at his hands in confusion. ...What had happened? There was no glow there.{w} It didn't make any sense: he could feel the Sekimeiya's touch, but it didn't look like it was there.
entries.literal: "He stared at his hands in confusion. ...What had happened? There was no glow there.{w} It didn't make any sense: he could feel the Sekimeiya's touch, but it didn't look like it was there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Bewildered, he stepped toward the light in the lobby, and once it illuminated his hands, he saw what had happened: the Sekimeiya was no longer white.{w} Puzzled, he looked around him. A metal shutter was covering the exit, but somehow the gemstone in his hands was more bizarre.
entries.literal: "Bewildered, he stepped toward the light in the lobby, and once it illuminated his hands, he saw what had happened: the Sekimeiya was no longer white.{w} Puzzled, he looked around him. A metal shutter was covering the exit, but somehow the gemstone in his hands was more bizarre."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He looked at it with concern at the same time that he recalled Lei's words. It was essential for the Sekimeiya to remain in a cold space, and it couldn't be touched outside the cabinet.
entries.literal: "He looked at it with concern at the same time that he recalled Lei's words. It was essential for the Sekimeiya to remain in a cold space, and it couldn't be touched outside the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Had he damaged it? A nervous sweat broke out across his body. He lightly held the Sekimeiya with his suit instead so that he wouldn't directly contact it.
entries.literal: "Had he damaged it? A nervous sweat broke out across his body. He lightly held the Sekimeiya with his suit instead so that he wouldn't directly contact it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The view of hallway B was identical: not much could be seen a few steps ahead.
entries.literal: "The view of hallway B was identical: not much could be seen a few steps ahead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atase had surely left the cleaning room already. Slowly, Katei turned its doorknob.
entries.literal: "Atase had surely left the cleaning room already. Slowly, Katei turned its doorknob."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The cart was there. Inside it, Katei saw the second Sekimeiya. Unlike the one between his hands, it still glowed dimly.
entries.literal: "The cart was there. Inside it, Katei saw the second Sekimeiya. Unlike the one between his hands, it still glowed dimly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He reached his right arm inside and took out the other Sekimeiya without touching it directly.{w} Amazed, Katei stared at it. He couldn't know if the cloth of his shirt had made a difference, but its glow hadn't vanished that time.
entries.literal: "He reached his right arm inside and took out the other Sekimeiya without touching it directly.{w} Amazed, Katei stared at it. He couldn't know if the cloth of his shirt had made a difference, but its glow hadn't vanished that time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But the amazement quickly morphed into stupefaction. The Sekimeiya was hot.
entries.literal: "But the amazement quickly morphed into stupefaction. The Sekimeiya was hot."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He couldn't believe it, but there was no mistaking it: the Sekimeiya that had been in the cart was clearly warmer than everything around it. Why...? Was it also due to the absence of cold?
entries.literal: "He couldn't believe it, but there was no mistaking it: the Sekimeiya that had been in the cart was clearly warmer than everything around it. Why...? Was it also due to the absence of cold?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei had to ignore it—he was running out of time. After stepping back into the hallway, he went inside the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Katei had to ignore it—he was running out of time. After stepping back into the hallway, he went inside the storeroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He knew the secret mechanism very well. Entering the secret corridor, he placed both Sekimeiya on a suitcase lying open on the floor. He had left it there to be able to leave with the gemstones in the future.
entries.literal: "He knew the secret mechanism very well. Entering the secret corridor, he placed both Sekimeiya on a suitcase lying open on the floor. He had left it there to be able to leave with the gemstones in the future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Finally, he felt the last door, and as he did, he wondered. Would anyone see him? It couldn't be; he anticipated that everyone was in front of the main door.
entries.literal: "Finally, he felt the last door, and as he did, he wondered. Would anyone see him? It couldn't be; he anticipated that everyone was in front of the main door."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: ...{w}Wh-What?{w} Wh-Where is it!?
entries.literal: "...{w}Wh-What?{w} Wh-Where is it!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Petrified, Katei kept going through all his pockets.{w} The key wasn't there.{w} There was no way out for him without it. Desperately, he looked at all the keys he had, but none of them had the particular rust he most wanted to feel.
entries.literal: "Petrified, Katei kept going through all his pockets.{w} The key wasn't there.{w} There was no way out for him without it. Desperately, he looked at all the keys he had, but none of them had the particular rust he most wanted to feel."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He realized that he must have dropped it.{w} He didn't keep it with the others, and he'd verified that he had it in the security room. Therefore, he'd dropped it in hallway A, when he'd been crawling toward the event room. Since his pocket had been so close to the floor, he hadn't noticed the sound of it falling out.
entries.literal: "He realized that he must have dropped it.{w} He didn't keep it with the others, and he'd verified that he had it in the security room. Therefore, he'd dropped it in hallway A, when he'd been crawling toward the event room. Since his pocket had been so close to the floor, he hadn't noticed the sound of it falling out."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: F-Fuck! No!
entries.literal: "F-Fuck! No!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Tightening his fist, he went back to the hallway. It was drenched in darkness, but the key had to be somewhere.
entries.literal: "Tightening his fist, he went back to the hallway. It was drenched in darkness, but the key had to be somewhere."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He moved to the wall he'd crawled next to and repeated the action, scanning the entire surface.
entries.literal: "He moved to the wall he'd crawled next to and repeated the action, scanning the entire surface."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Yes!
entries.literal: "Yes!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Although he'd lost many precious seconds, he found it camouflaged under the smoke. He'd been trying to make very little noise, but he couldn't care about that anymore. As fast as he could, he ran back to the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Although he'd lost many precious seconds, he found it camouflaged under the smoke. He'd been trying to make very little noise, but he couldn't care about that anymore. As fast as he could, he ran back to the storeroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stopped before the secret exit. A bright, grassy field was outside it, and he was so close to seeing it.{w} He located the keyhole and inserted the chilly key into it.
entries.literal: "He stopped before the secret exit. A bright, grassy field was outside it, and he was so close to seeing it.{w} He located the keyhole and inserted the chilly key into it."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It wasn't turning. The door wasn't opening.
entries.literal: "It wasn't turning. The door wasn't opening."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: No. There's no way. Why is it...
entries.literal: "No. There's no way. Why is it..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something was preventing him from turning the key, and no matter how much he tried, it didn't budge. Such a thing had never happened to him before.
entries.literal: "Something was preventing him from turning the key, and no matter how much he tried, it didn't budge. Such a thing had never happened to him before."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: They... Did they learn about this door?
entries.literal: "They... Did they learn about this door?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Subsumed by the darkness, Katei fell to his knees in defeat. The last method of escape, which he'd held as a trump card for years, had betrayed him.{w} The situation only became worse for him when he turned around.{w} There was nothing there.
entries.literal: "Subsumed by the darkness, Katei fell to his knees in defeat. The last method of escape, which he'd held as a trump card for years, had betrayed him.{w} The situation only became worse for him when he turned around.{w} There was nothing there."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: H-Huh?{w} Where are... the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "H-Huh?{w} Where are... the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The two telltale glows weren't there. When he crawled to where the suitcase should've been, he saw that it had vanished as well.
entries.literal: "The two telltale glows weren't there. When he crawled to where the suitcase should've been, he saw that it had vanished as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the floor, Katei was consumed by a wave of cold fear. He'd been outsmarted—there was no other explanation.
entries.literal: "On the floor, Katei was consumed by a wave of cold fear. He'd been outsmarted—there was no other explanation."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two doors blocked his view into hallway A, but he was scared to leave. Xyn must've been there.
entries.literal: "Two doors blocked his view into hallway A, but he was scared to leave. Xyn must've been there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei waited. Were they going to come now that they'd defeated him?
entries.literal: "Katei waited. Were they going to come now that they'd defeated him?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What were they going to do? Would Katei's name be exposed? ...Those were the only thoughts he could formulate.
entries.literal: "What were they going to do? Would Katei's name be exposed? ...Those were the only thoughts he could formulate."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei looked up. He had heard a brief sound.
entries.literal: "Katei looked up. He had heard a brief sound."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Someone was in the hallway.{w} Slowly, he rose and stepped out of the secret corridor, then gripped the doorknob.
entries.literal: "Someone was in the hallway.{w} Slowly, he rose and stepped out of the secret corridor, then gripped the doorknob."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hallway A was still dark, but a bit more light had begun to pass through the smoke cover. That was how he saw a human figure walking to the lobby as it carried his suitcase.
entries.literal: "Hallway A was still dark, but a bit more light had begun to pass through the smoke cover. That was how he saw a human figure walking to the lobby as it carried his suitcase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Naomi, one of the people he was certain had fallen unconscious. Given the conversations he'd heard, Katei knew she wasn't working with Xyn.
entries.literal: "It was Naomi, one of the people he was certain had fallen unconscious. Given the conversations he'd heard, Katei knew she wasn't working with Xyn."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In an instant, he ran up behind her. He had to talk to her before everyone woke up.{w} However, as soon as she heard his movements, Naomi sprinted away to escape him.
entries.literal: "In an instant, he ran up behind her. He had to talk to her before everyone woke up.{w} However, as soon as she heard his movements, Naomi sprinted away to escape him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei set foot in the lobby, Naomi was nowhere to be seen. The hallway B door was slightly closed, but he couldn't rush. She could easily have been hiding behind the desk or in the room below.
entries.literal: "When Katei set foot in the lobby, Naomi was nowhere to be seen. The hallway B door was slightly closed, but he couldn't rush. She could easily have been hiding behind the desk or in the room below."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stepped forward slowly. His goal was to find Naomi as soon as possible—to learn how much she knew, what had happened, what she intended to do, and to retrieve the suitcase.
entries.literal: "He stepped forward slowly. His goal was to find Naomi as soon as possible—to learn how much she knew, what had happened, what she intended to do, and to retrieve the suitcase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But Katei didn't make it far before he turned back to the door. He heard running footsteps on the other side of the hallway.
entries.literal: "But Katei didn't make it far before he turned back to the door. He heard running footsteps on the other side of the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He peered into the hallway, but the dark cloud prevented a clear line of sight. Despite that, he was able to see that someone was there, and they began to go up the stairs.{w} He ran without thinking. He had to stop Naomi no matter how much panic assaulted him.
entries.literal: "He peered into the hallway, but the dark cloud prevented a clear line of sight. Despite that, he was able to see that someone was there, and they began to go up the stairs.{w} He ran without thinking. He had to stop Naomi no matter how much panic assaulted him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The gray door was unlocked. That was all he needed to confirm that it was Naomi who'd gone up.
entries.literal: "The gray door was unlocked. That was all he needed to confirm that it was Naomi who'd gone up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stepped onto the second floor—the echoing sound of footsteps was clearly audible. They were still running, so he had to pursue them.
entries.literal: "He stepped onto the second floor—the echoing sound of footsteps was clearly audible. They were still running, so he had to pursue them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His life depended on it. He put all his strength into his legs and ran, disregarding everything else his body demanded. Rest and oxygen could wait.
entries.literal: "His life depended on it. He put all his strength into his legs and ran, disregarding everything else his body demanded. Rest and oxygen could wait."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The stairs toward the fourth floor were before him. He maintained the highest speed possible, but he already knew everything was over. No matter what, the plan he'd crafted would never succeed.
entries.literal: "The stairs toward the fourth floor were before him. He maintained the highest speed possible, but he already knew everything was over. No matter what, the plan he'd crafted would never succeed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before reaching the top, he tripped on a step.
entries.literal: "Before reaching the top, he tripped on a step."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He intercepted the fall with his wrist, but he couldn't immediately stand back up.
entries.literal: "He intercepted the fall with his wrist, but he couldn't immediately stand back up."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: F-Fuck!
entries.literal: "F-Fuck!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he did manage to rise, he was about to keep running. However, he realized that was a bad idea.
entries.literal: "When he did manage to rise, he was about to keep running. However, he realized that was a bad idea."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Wait, shit...! She's going to the attic!
entries.literal: "Wait, shit...! She's going to the attic!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Finally, he understood how doomed he was. He couldn't open the attic, where Naomi would lock herself with the suitcase. Continuing to go up was a futile waste of time.
entries.literal: "Finally, he understood how doomed he was. He couldn't open the attic, where Naomi would lock herself with the suitcase. Continuing to go up was a futile waste of time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In total disarray, Katei turned around. ...How much did Naomi know? Had she identified Katei...?
entries.literal: "In total disarray, Katei turned around. ...How much did Naomi know? Had she identified Katei...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What was he supposed to do...? Overwhelmed, he tried to think of a course of action.
entries.literal: "What was he supposed to do...? Overwhelmed, he tried to think of a course of action."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: More people were on the crystal floor. He had to act as if he'd gotten trapped like everyone else, but there were many things he had to take care of.
entries.literal: "More people were on the crystal floor. He had to act as if he'd gotten trapped like everyone else, but there were many things he had to take care of."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His hands trembled as he walked back down. He balled them into fists and slowly released them.{w} The trembling stopped, but he was internally collapsing. Attempting a calming breath, he walked to the crystal floor, where he began to look around as if he'd been innocently imprisoned.
entries.literal: "His hands trembled as he walked back down. He balled them into fists and slowly released them.{w} The trembling stopped, but he was internally collapsing. Attempting a calming breath, he walked to the crystal floor, where he began to look around as if he'd been innocently imprisoned."

entries.text: Tachyon Rotation
entries.literal: "Tachyon Rotation"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi's eyes opened in pain. Before them was a pair of shoes.
entries.literal: "Naomi's eyes opened in pain. Before them was a pair of shoes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She recognized them, but not the scenery behind them. ...Where was she?
entries.literal: "She recognized them, but not the scenery behind them. ...Where was she?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A sharp sound refocused all of her senses.{w} She was in the event room, and there had just been an attack in the tower.{w} After getting that far, she almost gasped. Those shoes belonged to Katei, and what she'd heard was the cabinet opening.
entries.literal: "A sharp sound refocused all of her senses.{w} She was in the event room, and there had just been an attack in the tower.{w} After getting that far, she almost gasped. Those shoes belonged to Katei, and what she'd heard was the cabinet opening."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While she was still processing that information, the steps began to depart.{w} She had to stop him. At once, Naomi considered the possibility that Katei had been responsible for the smoke.{w} Her head hurt, and her limbs took a few seconds to respond. However, she was able to force her body up.
entries.literal: "While she was still processing that information, the steps began to depart.{w} She had to stop him. At once, Naomi considered the possibility that Katei had been responsible for the smoke.{w} Her head hurt, and her limbs took a few seconds to respond. However, she was able to force her body up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Speechless, she saw two people who she'd just met on the floor. Their names were Atsuki and Shiroya.{w} But what about the third person...? Another man had been with them, and Naomi couldn't find him.
entries.literal: "Speechless, she saw two people who she'd just met on the floor. Their names were Atsuki and Shiroya.{w} But what about the third person...? Another man had been with them, and Naomi couldn't find him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She grabbed her glasses from the floor. Immediately, her sight blackened, as the smoke had covered the lenses. Trying not to inhale what lingered of it in the air, she slowly staggered to hallway A, wondering how long she'd been asleep and cleaning her glasses with her sleeves.
entries.literal: "She grabbed her glasses from the floor. Immediately, her sight blackened, as the smoke had covered the lenses. Trying not to inhale what lingered of it in the air, she slowly staggered to hallway A, wondering how long she'd been asleep and cleaning her glasses with her sleeves."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Six people had fallen unconscious. When the smoke was released, Naomi had been looking at the cabinet; out of all of them, she'd been the farthest from the source, as everyone else had been next to a grenade.{w} Atase had faked his unconsciousness, meaning that in the event room, Naomi's was the only adult body to be knocked out. Added to the lesser quantity of smoke that she inhaled, she would've been the first to awaken.{w} Because of that, when Katei stepped next to her ears, she was brought back to reality minutes before everyone else.
entries.literal: "Six people had fallen unconscious. When the smoke was released, Naomi had been looking at the cabinet; out of all of them, she'd been the farthest from the source, as everyone else had been next to a grenade.{w} Atase had faked his unconsciousness, meaning that in the event room, Naomi's was the only adult body to be knocked out. Added to the lesser quantity of smoke that she inhaled, she would've been the first to awaken.{w} Because of that, when Katei stepped next to her ears, she was brought back to reality minutes before everyone else."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She couldn't believe the appearance of the hallway. Like in the event room, a dark, sticky coating was everywhere, blocking out the light. Thanks to hallway C's ceiling light, though, she was able to see the storeroom closing.
entries.literal: "She couldn't believe the appearance of the hallway. Like in the event room, a dark, sticky coating was everywhere, blocking out the light. Thanks to hallway C's ceiling light, though, she was able to see the storeroom closing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It had been Katei, hadn't it...? She'd spoken to him a few times, but she'd never gotten a specific impression of him.
entries.literal: "It had been Katei, hadn't it...? She'd spoken to him a few times, but she'd never gotten a specific impression of him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Approaching the storeroom, Naomi hoped she'd been mistaken. Katei should've been in the security room, so perhaps he was acting against the attack by protecting the target.{w} Outside the door, she heard a noise.
entries.literal: "Approaching the storeroom, Naomi hoped she'd been mistaken. Katei should've been in the security room, so perhaps he was acting against the attack by protecting the target.{w} Outside the door, she heard a noise."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What was it...? It sounded like a door was being forced open, but that didn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "What was it...? It sounded like a door was being forced open, but that didn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When it stopped, Naomi heard the person approaching and sharply burst to her side out of fear of being attacked.
entries.literal: "When it stopped, Naomi heard the person approaching and sharply burst to her side out of fear of being attacked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...It was Katei. However, he didn't see Naomi, and instead, he rushed back into the darkness.
entries.literal: "...It was Katei. However, he didn't see Naomi, and instead, he rushed back into the darkness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as Naomi peeked inside the vacant room, her mouth dropped.{w} What the hell was she seeing? The wall was open...
entries.literal: "As soon as Naomi peeked inside the vacant room, her mouth dropped.{w} What the hell was she seeing? The wall was open..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: All doubts vanished from her mind: Katei was behind the attack. A corridor extended beyond the wall—one she'd never known about. As much as she couldn't believe it, it explained a lot of things.
entries.literal: "All doubts vanished from her mind: Katei was behind the attack. A corridor extended beyond the wall—one she'd never known about. As much as she couldn't believe it, it explained a lot of things."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, she took notice of a glow on the floor. ...The Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Then, she took notice of a glow on the floor. ...The Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Concealing her footsteps, she approached the faint light. It was in a suitcase, and it appeared both gemstones were there. Slowly, she closed it and brought it out of the room.
entries.literal: "Concealing her footsteps, she approached the faint light. It was in a suitcase, and it appeared both gemstones were there. Slowly, she closed it and brought it out of the room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Although she couldn't see anyone, she was able to perceive Katei nearby. He was there, in the hallway.{w} Wishing not to be seen, she sprinted toward hallway C.
entries.literal: "Although she couldn't see anyone, she was able to perceive Katei nearby. He was there, in the hallway.{w} Wishing not to be seen, she sprinted toward hallway C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before she could breathe steadily, she heard Katei getting closer. Without moving her eyes, Naomi continued to take slow steps back.
entries.literal: "Before she could breathe steadily, she heard Katei getting closer. Without moving her eyes, Naomi continued to take slow steps back."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But Katei wasn't coming for her. He simply reentered the storeroom.
entries.literal: "But Katei wasn't coming for her. He simply reentered the storeroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was when Naomi finally thought about how strange everything was. What was that silence? What had happened after she'd lost consciousness?
entries.literal: "That was when Naomi finally thought about how strange everything was. What was that silence? What had happened after she'd lost consciousness?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From where she was, she could see that hallway B looked the same. Something of large scale had happened, so why was nobody else there?
entries.literal: "From where she was, she could see that hallway B looked the same. Something of large scale had happened, so why was nobody else there?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She felt frozen, and clueless as to what to do. ...At least, she had retrieved the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "She felt frozen, and clueless as to what to do. ...At least, she had retrieved the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had to leave. The exit was on the other side of the hallways, but she could only see a dark void.
entries.literal: "She had to leave. The exit was on the other side of the hallways, but she could only see a dark void."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Was someone else there? She hesitated, scared to surround herself with the darkness.
entries.literal: "Was someone else there? She hesitated, scared to surround herself with the darkness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Holding tightly onto the suitcase, she took a step forward. A thin fog obscured her vision, but the lobby door shortly came into view.
entries.literal: "Holding tightly onto the suitcase, she took a step forward. A thin fog obscured her vision, but the lobby door shortly came into view."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, alarm bells went off in her head. Someone was behind her, running at full speed.
entries.literal: "However, alarm bells went off in her head. Someone was behind her, running at full speed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She couldn't look back. With the scarce energy she had, she went through the door.
entries.literal: "She couldn't look back. With the scarce energy she had, she went through the door."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Wh—
entries.literal: "Wh—"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Her eyes went wider than ever before. A metal shutter was in front of the door.{w} It didn't make any sense, but she didn't have time to think. She had to keep running.
entries.literal: "Her eyes went wider than ever before. A metal shutter was in front of the door.{w} It didn't make any sense, but she didn't have time to think. She had to keep running."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Covering her face, she ran through hallway B. When she returned to where she'd been, she confirmed she wasn't being chased anymore.
entries.literal: "Covering her face, she ran through hallway B. When she returned to where she'd been, she confirmed she wasn't being chased anymore."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She couldn't leave the building. It was ridiculous, but a huge piece of metal she'd never seen was blocking the way out. If Katei was the one who'd run behind her, there was only one place where she'd be safe.
entries.literal: "She couldn't leave the building. It was ridiculous, but a huge piece of metal she'd never seen was blocking the way out. If Katei was the one who'd run behind her, there was only one place where she'd be safe."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She tried to open the elevator, but it wasn't on that floor.{w} She couldn't wait for it, so she took out her keys and dashed up the stairs.
entries.literal: "She tried to open the elevator, but it wasn't on that floor.{w} She couldn't wait for it, so she took out her keys and dashed up the stairs."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She unlocked the gray door, but she couldn't waste time locking it behind her; if her pursuer was Katei, he had that key as well.
entries.literal: "She unlocked the gray door, but she couldn't waste time locking it behind her; if her pursuer was Katei, he had that key as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She didn't slow down. Once she was on the third floor, a sound alerted her: she was being chased again.
entries.literal: "She didn't slow down. Once she was on the third floor, a sound alerted her: she was being chased again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Through the many floors of the tower, her goal was to make it to the attic. The Sekimeiya bounced inside the suitcase, and Naomi gripped the key without stopping once.
entries.literal: "Through the many floors of the tower, her goal was to make it to the attic. The Sekimeiya bounced inside the suitcase, and Naomi gripped the key without stopping once."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At last, the final floor was in sight, and nobody was behind her.
entries.literal: "At last, the final floor was in sight, and nobody was behind her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With the key, she locked the door behind her.
entries.literal: "With the key, she locked the door behind her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had made it; Katei wouldn't be able to reach that place. Panting, she went up the narrow staircase.
entries.literal: "She had made it; Katei wouldn't be able to reach that place. Panting, she went up the narrow staircase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi stepped to the sofa, where she dropped her keys and the suitcase. Exhausted, she took a moment to catch her breath. The bright living room looked nothing like the lowest floor.{w} When she opened the case, she saw both identical gemstones. Even though she'd brought them to safety, she'd been told the cabinet's temperature was essential for their well-being.
entries.literal: "Naomi stepped to the sofa, where she dropped her keys and the suitcase. Exhausted, she took a moment to catch her breath. The bright living room looked nothing like the lowest floor.{w} When she opened the case, she saw both identical gemstones. Even though she'd brought them to safety, she'd been told the cabinet's temperature was essential for their well-being."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something was strange. The interior of the suitcase was very hot. Naomi felt around in it and gripped it tightly, unable to comprehend why it had heated up so much.
entries.literal: "Something was strange. The interior of the suitcase was very hot. Naomi felt around in it and gripped it tightly, unable to comprehend why it had heated up so much."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Wh-What!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Out of nowhere, both of the Sekimeiya vanished.{w} Astonished, Naomi stared at the empty suitcase. She had felt one of their white surfaces for an instant before both had disappeared.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, both of the Sekimeiya vanished.{w} Astonished, Naomi stared at the empty suitcase. She had felt one of their white surfaces for an instant before both had disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She couldn't comprehend what had occurred; it wasn't possible. They couldn't have disappeared.{w} ...However, they weren't there anymore.
entries.literal: "She couldn't comprehend what had occurred; it wasn't possible. They couldn't have disappeared.{w} ...However, they weren't there anymore."

entries.speaker: sann
entries.text: Wha...!

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, she noticed something else was gone: her keys, which she'd left next to the suitcase.
entries.literal: "Then, she noticed something else was gone: her keys, which she'd left next to the suitcase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She questioned her own memories. She had just left the keyring there, hadn't she...?{w} Or had she left it in the keyhole?{w} Speechless, she peeked down the stairs.
entries.literal: "She questioned her own memories. She had just left the keyring there, hadn't she...?{w} Or had she left it in the keyhole?{w} Speechless, she peeked down the stairs."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It... wasn't there. But it wasn't on the sofa either.{w} She couldn't understand. How could her keys have disappeared with the Sekimeiya? It was utterly nonsensical.{w} She'd looked through the sofa, the suitcase, and all her pockets; they really weren't anywhere.
entries.literal: "It... wasn't there. But it wasn't on the sofa either.{w} She couldn't understand. How could her keys have disappeared with the Sekimeiya? It was utterly nonsensical.{w} She'd looked through the sofa, the suitcase, and all her pockets; they really weren't anywhere."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Wondering if she'd gone insane, Naomi walked to the hallway. She knew the layout of the attic well, and she was sure she was alone.
entries.literal: "Wondering if she'd gone insane, Naomi walked to the hallway. She knew the layout of the attic well, and she was sure she was alone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She'd intended to keep the Sekimeiya in a safe place, but somehow, she'd failed. Completely lost, she wondered what to do.{w} More people were on the crystal floor, and they could have already woken up.
entries.literal: "She'd intended to keep the Sekimeiya in a safe place, but somehow, she'd failed. Completely lost, she wondered what to do.{w} More people were on the crystal floor, and they could have already woken up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However... she couldn't leave. Without the key, she couldn't unlock the door she'd just locked, so she pressed the elevator button.{w} ...But nothing happened.
entries.literal: "However... she couldn't leave. Without the key, she couldn't unlock the door she'd just locked, so she pressed the elevator button.{w} ...But nothing happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi couldn't believe her situation, but no matter how much she thought about it, she didn't think she was wrong about what had happened: she'd seen the Sekimeiya disappear before her eyes, so the same must have happened with the keys.
entries.literal: "Naomi couldn't believe her situation, but no matter how much she thought about it, she didn't think she was wrong about what had happened: she'd seen the Sekimeiya disappear before her eyes, so the same must have happened with the keys."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...What had happened in the tower? Had she been hallucinating everything since she'd fallen unconscious? She simply couldn't accept that she'd trapped herself in the attic.
entries.literal: "...What had happened in the tower? Had she been hallucinating everything since she'd fallen unconscious? She simply couldn't accept that she'd trapped herself in the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But she had. Alone on the highest floor of the tower, Naomi had no method of escape.
entries.literal: "But she had. Alone on the highest floor of the tower, Naomi had no method of escape."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And so began the day.
entries.literal: "And so began the day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How did it end, however?
entries.literal: "How did it end, however?"

entries.text: Bioluminescent
entries.literal: "Bioluminescent"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=0.6}My body crumpled down; I couldn't keep going.
entries.literal: "{w=0.6}My body crumpled down; I couldn't keep going."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A month? What kind of joke was that? I couldn't bear one more second.
entries.literal: "A month? What kind of joke was that? I couldn't bear one more second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya's words played back in my head. "Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it."
entries.literal: "Shiroya's words played back in my head. \"Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I laughed, alone. I didn't know where I was, what anything had become... none of it. Nothing we'd done had any meaning. We'd made it to the end of that impossibly long day for nothing.
entries.literal: "I laughed, alone. I didn't know where I was, what anything had become... none of it. Nothing we'd done had any meaning. We'd made it to the end of that impossibly long day for nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The words Shiroya had abandoned me with... Were they supposed to be reassuring?
entries.literal: "The words Shiroya had abandoned me with... Were they supposed to be reassuring?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to continue yelling her name, but my voice broke. She'd known what would happen and hadn't warned us. She'd kept waiting at our side, bolstering our hope, until she'd run away.{w} Why...!? She would never have done that... I couldn't let a single day change my view of her.
entries.literal: "I tried to continue yelling her name, but my voice broke. She'd known what would happen and hadn't warned us. She'd kept waiting at our side, bolstering our hope, until she'd run away.{w} Why...!? She would never have done that... I couldn't let a single day change my view of her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I couldn't help but despair. I wanted to leave. I wanted to be hit by the icy air and feel released. I wanted to talk to more people, even if they were the police.
entries.literal: "But I couldn't help but despair. I wanted to leave. I wanted to be hit by the icy air and feel released. I wanted to talk to more people, even if they were the police."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And it wouldn't happen. Could we survive an entire month? Of course not...! Shiroya hadn't been mentioned in the recording, so would I not see her for weeks?
entries.literal: "And it wouldn't happen. Could we survive an entire month? Of course not...! Shiroya hadn't been mentioned in the recording, so would I not see her for weeks?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Would the nightmare persist in the Sekimeiya's domain? It was too horrible of a thought to bear. People had died, and I still didn't know who, how, why...
entries.literal: "Would the nightmare persist in the Sekimeiya's domain? It was too horrible of a thought to bear. People had died, and I still didn't know who, how, why..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The lights had gone out, so I followed their example. I closed my eyes, intensifying the darkness, before I felt once again how insignificant I was.
entries.literal: "The lights had gone out, so I followed their example. I closed my eyes, intensifying the darkness, before I felt once again how insignificant I was."

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: I—{w=0.4}Isla?{w=0.5} Where...?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina's voice came from the hallway.
entries.literal: "Erina's voice came from the hallway."

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: Sh-She's not here!
entries.literal: "Sh-She's not here!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: Where is she...!?
entries.literal: "Where is she...!?"

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai sounded confused too, near the end of hallway A.
entries.literal: "Sai sounded confused too, near the end of hallway A."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She's not here? Could she mean...?
entries.literal: "She's not here? Could she mean...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I mustered the strength to scramble back out of the lobby.
entries.literal: "I mustered the strength to scramble back out of the lobby."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Look! She isn't in the cabinet!
entries.literal: "Look! She isn't in the cabinet!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the crystal room. Although I knew its walls were stained dark, I couldn't differentiate them from the rest.{w} I stepped to the cabinet where Isla rested and reached my hand inside.{w} ...She wasn't there.
entries.literal: "I entered the crystal room. Although I knew its walls were stained dark, I couldn't differentiate them from the rest.{w} I stepped to the cabinet where Isla rested and reached my hand inside.{w} ...She wasn't there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Y-You're right...{w} She was here just minutes ago.
entries.literal: "Y-You're right...{w} She was here just minutes ago."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck? Did Shiroya take her out?
entries.literal: "What the fuck? Did Shiroya take her out?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What? Why would she do that?
entries.literal: "...What? Why would she do that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'm sure you can explain why she did everything else.
entries.literal: "I'm sure you can explain why she did everything else."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What if she was saved? That could be it, right?
entries.literal: "What if she was saved? That could be it, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, something just happened. That's for sure.
entries.literal: "Well, something just happened. That's for sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I followed Sai out.{w} Utterly lost, we went to check the bathrooms.
entries.literal: "I followed Sai out.{w} Utterly lost, we went to check the bathrooms."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Man, what the fuck is this?
entries.literal: "Man, what the fuck is this?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Naomi isn't here either...
entries.literal: "Naomi isn't here either..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We ran to the crystal room where we'd found her first body.{w} It wasn't there. The curtain wasn't on the floor either.
entries.literal: "We ran to the crystal room where we'd found her first body.{w} It wasn't there. The curtain wasn't on the floor either."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Did all the bodies disappear? In that case, Katei's must not be in the security room either, but why the hell is it locked?
entries.literal: "...Did all the bodies disappear? In that case, Katei's must not be in the security room either, but why the hell is it locked?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And it wasn't only the bodies. We had thought that if the exit didn't unlock at {time=21}, we would let the others listen to the recording. However, that could no longer happen; the recorder itself had certainly vanished alongside Isla.
entries.literal: "And it wasn't only the bodies. We had thought that if the exit didn't unlock at {time=21}, we would let the others listen to the recording. However, that could no longer happen; the recorder itself had certainly vanished alongside Isla."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, when the lights went out, did you really not see anything?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, when the lights went out, did you really not see anything?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... didn't see anything, no.
entries.literal: "I... didn't see anything, no."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then why did Erina and I see a flashing light? It lasted an instant, but I find it really strange that it didn't happen to you.
entries.literal: "Then why did Erina and I see a flashing light? It lasted an instant, but I find it really strange that it didn't happen to you."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know. I have no idea...!
entries.literal: "I don't know. I have no idea...!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why was I the only one to not see that...? Could that indicate what happened?{w} Shiroya ran to hallway B and told us to not follow her. Was she going to the Sekimeiya in the cabinet?{w} Then, out of nowhere, the lights went off, and the shutter remained unmoving.
entries.literal: "Why was I the only one to not see that...? Could that indicate what happened?{w} Shiroya ran to hallway B and told us to not follow her. Was she going to the Sekimeiya in the cabinet?{w} Then, out of nowhere, the lights went off, and the shutter remained unmoving."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What the fuck had happened? Shiroya's face had looked the opposite of malicious, so why would she have done anything harmful? She couldn't have trapped us there for an entire month...!
entries.literal: "What the fuck had happened? Shiroya's face had looked the opposite of malicious, so why would she have done anything harmful? She couldn't have trapped us there for an entire month...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina was behind us, and she sounded like she was in pain. Although we couldn't see it, it appeared her finger had started bleeding out of nowhere.
entries.literal: "Erina was behind us, and she sounded like she was in pain. Although we couldn't see it, it appeared her finger had started bleeding out of nowhere."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Erina, before the lights went off, you went to the mechanical room, right?
entries.literal: "Erina, before the lights went off, you went to the mechanical room, right?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...{w}Y-Yes.

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Why?
entries.literal: "Why?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...I thought maybe someone was there. We still have to find Akaro.
entries.literal: "...I thought maybe someone was there. We still have to find Akaro."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There's no way you believe her, right?
entries.literal: "There's no way you believe her, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}The light breakers are there. Did you turn them off? What the hell happened to your finger?
entries.literal: "...{w}The light breakers are there. Did you turn them off? What the hell happened to your finger?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What!? How would I have done that? They're locked up, and there's still electricity. The cameras are working.
entries.literal: "What!? How would I have done that? They're locked up, and there's still electricity. The cameras are working."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I glanced at the ceiling of the hallway, where the faint green lights of the cameras could be seen.
entries.literal: "I glanced at the ceiling of the hallway, where the faint green lights of the cameras could be seen."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: A-And I don't know, but it really hurts! Did you just hear that? A drop of blood fell to the floor, but I can't see what kind of injury I have!
entries.literal: "A-And I don't know, but it really hurts! Did you just hear that? A drop of blood fell to the floor, but I can't see what kind of injury I have!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You could've only turned off the breakers that control the light, right?
entries.literal: "You could've only turned off the breakers that control the light, right?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Go check them! You'll see that I didn't touch any!
entries.literal: "Go check them! You'll see that I didn't touch any!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Did the light go off in the mechanical room?
entries.literal: "Did the light go off in the mechanical room?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Yes!
entries.literal: "Yes!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Then how are we supposed to check them!? We can't see anything!
entries.literal: "Then how are we supposed to check them!? We can't see anything!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Doesn't your wristwatch give off some light?
entries.literal: "Doesn't your wristwatch give off some light?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Do you think this is gonna do anything!?
entries.literal: "Do you think this is gonna do anything!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai lit his watch's blue screen, but it didn't illuminate anything in front of it.
entries.literal: "Sai lit his watch's blue screen, but it didn't illuminate anything in front of it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is Shiroya still here? ...Is she currently listening to us?
entries.literal: "Is Shiroya still here? ...Is she currently listening to us?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: "Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it."{w} If she's not here anymore, then who did this? It can't be just a coincidence that Erina left our side minutes before the shutter was going to open.
entries.literal: "\"Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it.\"{w} If she's not here anymore, then who did this? It can't be just a coincidence that Erina left our side minutes before the shutter was going to open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A month in the tower... That was impossible. There was no way that fate awaited us, but merely thinking about it was almost enough to make me lose my grip on reality.
entries.literal: "A month in the tower... That was impossible. There was no way that fate awaited us, but merely thinking about it was almost enough to make me lose my grip on reality."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't stand it anymore. I wanted to know what was happening...! I wanted to know what had been going on since the start!
entries.literal: "I couldn't stand it anymore. I wanted to know what was happening...! I wanted to know what had been going on since the start!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Now stay here, and don't follow me."{w} Why!? Why did I have to stay there!? Leaving the tower with Shiroya was the only thing I wanted—it was the only thing both of us wanted!
entries.literal: "\"Now stay here, and don't follow me.\"{w} Why!? Why did I have to stay there!? Leaving the tower with Shiroya was the only thing I wanted—it was the only thing both of us wanted!"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Are the other floors going to be like this too?
entries.literal: "...Are the other floors going to be like this too?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're asking as if I have a clue.
entries.literal: "You're asking as if I have a clue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We trudged along, bit by bit. In hallway C, Sai tried to open the elevator.
entries.literal: "We trudged along, bit by bit. In hallway C, Sai tried to open the elevator."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's not here.
entries.literal: "It's not here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He found the button on the wall and pressed it.{w} A while later, it still hadn't lit up.
entries.literal: "He found the button on the wall and pressed it.{w} A while later, it still hadn't lit up."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Unless it's open on another floor, the elevator is disabled too.{w} I didn't want to use it, though. Let's take the stairs.
entries.literal: "Unless it's open on another floor, the elevator is disabled too.{w} I didn't want to use it, though. Let's take the stairs."

entries.speaker: q
entries.text: ...Wh-What the...?{w} What happened to the lights?
entries.literal: "...Wh-What the...?{w} What happened to the lights?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That voice...
entries.literal: "That voice..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around to where it had come from.
entries.literal: "I turned around to where it had come from."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Whose voice was it?
entries.literal: "Whose voice was it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What do you think? What are the remaining mysteries that you have solved?
entries.literal: "What do you think? What are the remaining mysteries that you have solved?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Perhaps you would like to prove yourself as well. You will have the chance to do that.{w} Show that the peak is also awaiting you—that the keys you were given were put to use.
entries.literal: "Perhaps you would like to prove yourself as well. You will have the chance to do that.{w} Show that the peak is also awaiting you—that the keys you were given were put to use."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Exactly, Akaro's return. That was what the voice signified.
entries.literal: "Exactly, Akaro's return. That was what the voice signified."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From here on out, you'll be able to submit your own answers for the mysteries of this story and show what you've solved. At the end, you'll have access to the total number of correct answers, but your performance won't influence the story. Best of luck.
entries.literal: "From here on out, you'll be able to submit your own answers for the mysteries of this story and show what you've solved. At the end, you'll have access to the total number of correct answers, but your performance won't influence the story. Best of luck."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unfortunately, that is incorrect. Don't worry, though, as this is just the beginning.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, that is incorrect. Don't worry, though, as this is just the beginning."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From here on out, you'll be able to submit your own answers for the mysteries of this story and show what you've solved. At the end, you'll have access to the total number of correct answers, but your performance won't influence the story. Best of luck.
entries.literal: "From here on out, you'll be able to submit your own answers for the mysteries of this story and show what you've solved. At the end, you'll have access to the total number of correct answers, but your performance won't influence the story. Best of luck."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: A-Akaro! Is that you?
entries.literal: "A-Akaro! Is that you?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Huh? Yes! ...Where am I!?
entries.literal: "Huh? Yes! ...Where am I!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck do you mean!? We haven't seen you in hours!
entries.literal: "What the fuck do you mean!? We haven't seen you in hours!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What? What time is it? We're still in the tower, right?
entries.literal: "What? What time is it? We're still in the tower, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course we are, and it's past {time=21}! The shutter didn't open!
entries.literal: "Of course we are, and it's past {time=21}! The shutter didn't open!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: W-Wait, what!? That can't be...!
entries.literal: "W-Wait, what!? That can't be...!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Cut it out! Where the fuck have you been!?
entries.literal: "Cut it out! Where the fuck have you been!?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What does that mean!? I just touched the Sekimeiya and appeared here!
entries.literal: "What does that mean!? I just touched the Sekimeiya and appeared here!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Where? When did you touch it?
entries.literal: "Where? When did you touch it?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: U-Uh... it was...
entries.literal: "U-Uh... it was..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Spit it out! Was it after we escaped from the attic's bedroom? I don't even give a shit anymore!
entries.literal: "Spit it out! Was it after we escaped from the attic's bedroom? I don't even give a shit anymore!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Y-Yes.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You son of a bitch! He punched me in the stomach!{w} I was knocked out, and when I woke up, I couldn't even stand up straight!
entries.literal: "You son of a bitch! He punched me in the stomach!{w} I was knocked out, and when I woke up, I couldn't even stand up straight!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I told him to tell me where he put the Sekimeiya since I knew he had it. I just touched it on the crystal floor, and the lights went off.
entries.literal: "...I told him to tell me where he put the Sekimeiya since I knew he had it. I just touched it on the crystal floor, and the lights went off."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Are you saying that you traveled forward in time? You're a fucking liar.
entries.literal: "Are you saying that you traveled forward in time? You're a fucking liar."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm not lying!
entries.literal: "I'm not lying!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind was worn out, but what Akaro was saying didn't make sense. I had seen him earlier, before Shiroya had run up to the attic.
entries.literal: "My mind was worn out, but what Akaro was saying didn't make sense. I had seen him earlier, before Shiroya had run up to the attic."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't care if you don't believe me, just tell me what the fuck happened! Why are the lights off, and where is everyone else!?
entries.literal: "I don't care if you don't believe me, just tell me what the fuck happened! Why are the lights off, and where is everyone else!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You were gone for six hours! Do you think I'm gonna believe that nonsense!? Katei died, and God knows where Shiroya is!
entries.literal: "You were gone for six hours! Do you think I'm gonna believe that nonsense!? Katei died, and God knows where Shiroya is!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Wait, what!? Katei was killed...?
entries.literal: "Wait, what!? Katei was killed...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes!
entries.literal: "Yes!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What about Isla?
entries.literal: "What about Isla?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I-Isla...? Y-You... know what happened, right...?
entries.literal: "I-Isla...? Y-You... know what happened, right...?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes, but she was here again!{w} Sai, why did you go quiet!? You saw her as well!
entries.literal: "Yes, but she was here again!{w} Sai, why did you go quiet!? You saw her as well!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}I don't know what happened.{w} She was alive when we left the attic. We talked to her, but she didn't remember anything about what had happened. After this son of a bitch knocked me out, I wasn't able to find her again.
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't know what happened.{w} She was alive when we left the attic. We talked to her, but she didn't remember anything about what had happened. After this son of a bitch knocked me out, I wasn't able to find her again."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What...!? You never said that! That means she's alive! The recording was right—she'll be here!
entries.literal: "What...!? You never said that! That means she's alive! The recording was right—she'll be here!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What recording?
entries.literal: "What recording?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...{w}Can you please answer me? Why are the lights off!? There's no way it's {time=21.}
entries.literal: "...{w}Can you please answer me? Why are the lights off!? There's no way it's {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai stabbed his wristwatch with one finger.
entries.literal: "Sai stabbed his wristwatch with one finger."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: It's {time=21:12}, dumbass! And we don't know what happened! The lights went off just minutes before the shutter was gonna open, and we have no idea why!
entries.literal: "It's {time=21:12}, dumbass! And we don't know what happened! The lights went off just minutes before the shutter was gonna open, and we have no idea why!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not all that happened. The dead bodies disappeared too. It wasn't just the light.
entries.literal: "That's not all that happened. The dead bodies disappeared too. It wasn't just the light."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was why Akaro's story was unbelievable. Had he traveled... to the future? Was that possible?{w} Even if it was, his appearance didn't make sense. Something had happened at {time=21} that went against the normal flow of time. I didn't think that Akaro could've simply traveled forward in time to appear where we were.
entries.literal: "That was why Akaro's story was unbelievable. Had he traveled... to the future? Was that possible?{w} Even if it was, his appearance didn't make sense. Something had happened at {time=21} that went against the normal flow of time. I didn't think that Akaro could've simply traveled forward in time to appear where we were."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Wait a second! What the fuck are...{w} these clothes?
entries.literal: "Wait a second! What the fuck are...{w} these clothes?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I'm not wearing the clothes I was wearing before! What the fuck!?
entries.literal: "I'm not wearing the clothes I was wearing before! What the fuck!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Speechless, we stepped over to his voice. Once I felt the texture of his shirt, I realized it wasn't the one he'd been wearing before.
entries.literal: "Speechless, we stepped over to his voice. Once I felt the texture of his shirt, I realized it wasn't the one he'd been wearing before."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Ah, the Sekimeiya changed your clothes. Is that right?
entries.literal: "Ah, the Sekimeiya changed your clothes. Is that right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Th-That's what happened! They just changed!
entries.literal: "Th-That's what happened! They just changed!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You're several galaxies out of your mind if you think we'll believe anything that you're saying. What the fuck is your goal?
entries.literal: "You're several galaxies out of your mind if you think we'll believe anything that you're saying. What the fuck is your goal?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are they yours?
entries.literal: "Are they yours?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: These clothes...?{w} I... think so. They're not the ones I had on, though!
entries.literal: "These clothes...?{w} I... think so. They're not the ones I had on, though!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea what to believe. Had the Sekimeiya made Akaro travel to the future? Had it swapped his clothing...? I couldn't rule anything out as impossible, but it wasn't easy to trust him.
entries.literal: "I had no idea what to believe. Had the Sekimeiya made Akaro travel to the future? Had it swapped his clothing...? I couldn't rule anything out as impossible, but it wasn't easy to trust him."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If he was telling the truth... who was the Akaro I'd seen? His existence had gradually gotten harder to comprehend.
entries.literal: "If he was telling the truth... who was the Akaro I'd seen? His existence had gradually gotten harder to comprehend."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're really saying the shutter is still there...?{w} We're in hallway C, right?
entries.literal: "You're really saying the shutter is still there...?{w} We're in hallway C, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hugging the wall, Akaro walked to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Hugging the wall, Akaro walked to the lobby."

entries.speaker: ak4
entries.text: It is... It really is still here.{w} Is it actually after {time=21}? What the fuck do we do, then!?
entries.literal: "It is... It really is still here.{w} Is it actually after {time=21}? What the fuck do we do, then!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What the fuck do you think we can do!? Nothing!
entries.literal: "What the fuck do you think we can do!? Nothing!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite being aware of another option for so long, there was another choice. We had the Sekimeiya.{w} We could travel through time. According to Akaro, he had traveled hours forward, so nothing said we couldn't escape the tower with it.{w} The reason I hadn't explored that option yet was what Shiroya had said. Due to her, I wasn't sure that trying to escape from the dark tower was what I had to do. However, Sai and Akaro weren't even discussing the Sekimeiya. Supposedly, Akaro had just appeared, and he hadn't even asked about its whereabouts.
entries.literal: "Despite being aware of another option for so long, there was another choice. We had the Sekimeiya.{w} We could travel through time. According to Akaro, he had traveled hours forward, so nothing said we couldn't escape the tower with it.{w} The reason I hadn't explored that option yet was what Shiroya had said. Due to her, I wasn't sure that trying to escape from the dark tower was what I had to do. However, Sai and Akaro weren't even discussing the Sekimeiya. Supposedly, Akaro had just appeared, and he hadn't even asked about its whereabouts."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: And... you said Shiroya is gone? What happened to her?
entries.literal: "And... you said Shiroya is gone? What happened to her?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: We don't know! If you're not behind whatever just happened, it must be her! She ran away before the lights went out and said not to follow her. She should be somewhere.
entries.literal: "We don't know! If you're not behind whatever just happened, it must be her! She ran away before the lights went out and said not to follow her. She should be somewhere."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, you've reiterated that you know more about the Sekimeiya than us, and you haven't fundamentally denied what Akaro said. Does that mean that traveling to the future is possible?
entries.literal: "Sai, you've reiterated that you know more about the Sekimeiya than us, and you haven't fundamentally denied what Akaro said. Does that mean that traveling to the future is possible?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...I don't know. Even if it was, would you really believe the nonsense he's spewing?
entries.literal: "...I don't know. Even if it was, would you really believe the nonsense he's spewing?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: You're the one spewing nonsense! Why would the exit not unlock!? One of you killed Katei, right? Who was it!?{w} And what, the bodies disappeared? Have you searched for them? We know the Sekimeiya doesn't make them vanish, right? Is it even in the cabinet?
entries.literal: "You're the one spewing nonsense! Why would the exit not unlock!? One of you killed Katei, right? Who was it!?{w} And what, the bodies disappeared? Have you searched for them? We know the Sekimeiya doesn't make them vanish, right? Is it even in the cabinet?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Yes.{w} And we were planning to search through the higher floors. We don't even know if the lights went off up there, but the elevator doesn't work, and the security room is locked for some reason.
entries.literal: "...Yes.{w} And we were planning to search through the higher floors. We don't even know if the lights went off up there, but the elevator doesn't work, and the security room is locked for some reason."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What...? I'm really going to lose it. I have no idea how I've gone through all of this without losing it already.
