entries.literal: "What...? I'm really going to lose it. I have no idea how I've gone through all of this without losing it already."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Shut the fuck up! If you're telling the truth, we've been here twice as long as you!{w} Let's just go up. We can hope there's still light somewhere.
entries.literal: "Shut the fuck up! If you're telling the truth, we've been here twice as long as you!{w} Let's just go up. We can hope there's still light somewhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That put the discussion on pause. I couldn't believe my legs were still obeying me, but I proceeded up the stairs.{w} Was there anything to find? ...Shiroya? Maybe Isla...? I had moved beyond taking things for granted.
entries.literal: "That put the discussion on pause. I couldn't believe my legs were still obeying me, but I proceeded up the stairs.{w} Was there anything to find? ...Shiroya? Maybe Isla...? I had moved beyond taking things for granted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once we went through the gray door, we saw that the darkness would likely persist.
entries.literal: "Once we went through the gray door, we saw that the darkness would likely persist."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Did the lights really go out everywhere?
entries.literal: "Did the lights really go out everywhere?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Seems so.
entries.literal: "Seems so."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Even if there's something to find, there's no way we can find it.
entries.literal: "Even if there's something to find, there's no way we can find it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And if someone else is here, they're staying away from us on purpose. We should go all the way up first.
entries.literal: "And if someone else is here, they're staying away from us on purpose. We should go all the way up first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went around the floor without entering the offices. Our steps echoed loudly in comparison to the more muffled corridors on the first floor.
entries.literal: "We went around the floor without entering the offices. Our steps echoed loudly in comparison to the more muffled corridors on the first floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Gripping the handrail, we went up the stairs step by step.{w} On the third floor, I wondered if we would even be able to step into the attic. Perhaps Sai had a second key, but the original one should've been in the inner keyhole, and it could've already been taken.
entries.literal: "Gripping the handrail, we went up the stairs step by step.{w} On the third floor, I wondered if we would even be able to step into the attic. Perhaps Sai had a second key, but the original one should've been in the inner keyhole, and it could've already been taken."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We were all disheartened. Silently, we arrived on the sixth floor, though we could only know because we'd counted the stairwells.
entries.literal: "We were all disheartened. Silently, we arrived on the sixth floor, though we could only know because we'd counted the stairwells."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The door's unlocked.
entries.literal: "The door's unlocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai opened the door to the attic, but we didn't see anything ahead of us.
entries.literal: "Sai opened the door to the attic, but we didn't see anything ahead of us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: The key's still inserted here. ...It doesn't seem like there's light above, though.
entries.literal: "The key's still inserted here. ...It doesn't seem like there's light above, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We stepped up the narrow staircase. At the top, we confirmed no light was on the final floor either.
entries.literal: "We stepped up the narrow staircase. At the top, we confirmed no light was on the final floor either."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Fuck, man. Do we really have to stay in the dark?
entries.literal: "Fuck, man. Do we really have to stay in the dark?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: As if having light would be that much better.
entries.literal: "As if having light would be that much better."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Hang on.
entries.literal: "...Hang on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped forward, toward the table.
entries.literal: "I stepped forward, toward the table."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After fiddling with a cable, I pressed a switch.
entries.literal: "After fiddling with a cable, I pressed a switch."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh, the lamp!
entries.literal: "Oh, the lamp!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It works, thank God. I wasn't sure if it would, but it'll do.
entries.literal: "It works, thank God. I wasn't sure if it would, but it'll do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at everyone and almost fell back. It took me a second to notice that the man behind Erina was Akaro. Not only were his clothes different, but also his hair—he was hardly recognizable.
entries.literal: "I looked at everyone and almost fell back. It took me a second to notice that the man behind Erina was Akaro. Not only were his clothes different, but also his hair—he was hardly recognizable."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh my God! Th-The tip of my finger is cut! L-Look how much blood I'm losing!
entries.literal: "Oh my God! Th-The tip of my finger is cut! L-Look how much blood I'm losing!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina looked inside her purse and brought out bandages. Grimacing from the sight of the blood, she covered her finger with them.
entries.literal: "Erina looked inside her purse and brought out bandages. Grimacing from the sight of the blood, she covered her finger with them."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: The bedrooms... had a lamp as well, right?
entries.literal: "The bedrooms... had a lamp as well, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thanks to them, we were able to light up the bedrooms, and by opening the doors, the hallway, kitchen, and bathroom were slightly illuminated as well.
entries.literal: "Thanks to them, we were able to light up the bedrooms, and by opening the doors, the hallway, kitchen, and bathroom were slightly illuminated as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two of those places contained a minor indication that shed light on their situation, but in a third one was the biggest clue.
entries.literal: "Two of those places contained a minor indication that shed light on their situation, but in a third one was the biggest clue."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Precisely. It was in the kitchen.
entries.literal: "Precisely. It was in the kitchen."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Initially, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left in the living room were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there.
entries.literal: "Initially, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left in the living room were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.
entries.literal: "Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the living room, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there.
entries.literal: "In the living room, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He frowned and moved on, unaware that another place held a much stronger clue.
entries.literal: "He frowned and moved on, unaware that another place held a much stronger clue."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out.
entries.literal: "Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was nothing in the storeroom that indicated where they were.
entries.literal: "There was nothing in the storeroom that indicated where they were."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the living room, however, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there.
entries.literal: "In the living room, however, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out.
entries.literal: "Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was nothing in the bathroom that indicated where they were.
entries.literal: "There was nothing in the bathroom that indicated where they were."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the living room, however, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there.
entries.literal: "In the living room, however, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out.
entries.literal: "Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the right bedroom, Atsuki noticed that the inner handle was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} He had seen that in the living room, the footprints they'd just left had been the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there as well.
entries.literal: "In the right bedroom, Atsuki noticed that the inner handle was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} He had seen that in the living room, the footprints they'd just left had been the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Confused, he stepped out, unaware that another place held a much stronger clue.
entries.literal: "Confused, he stepped out, unaware that another place held a much stronger clue."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That glass...
entries.literal: "That glass..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a glass next to the sink.{w} I recognized it—when I'd been with Shiroya, I had tried to drink tap water. It had tasted terrible, and I'd set it aside.
entries.literal: "There was a glass next to the sink.{w} I recognized it—when I'd been with Shiroya, I had tried to drink tap water. It had tasted terrible, and I'd set it aside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After that time, I had seen the glass again. But there was a major distinction between that glass and the one I was looking at.
entries.literal: "After that time, I had seen the glass again. But there was a major distinction between that glass and the one I was looking at."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Specifically, it had since become empty.
entries.literal: "Specifically, it had since become empty."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: H-Hey, guys! Come to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "H-Hey, guys! Come to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone entered.
entries.literal: "Everyone entered."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What do you want?
entries.literal: "What do you want?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did any of you pour out the water in this glass?
entries.literal: "Did any of you pour out the water in this glass?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I didn't.
entries.literal: "I didn't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone denied it with confusion.
entries.literal: "Everyone denied it with confusion."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I left it here a few hours ago, and it was filled with water. I don't think it moved either.
entries.literal: "I left it here a few hours ago, and it was filled with water. I don't think it moved either."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So it vanished on its own?
entries.literal: "So it vanished on its own?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai frowned.
entries.literal: "Sai frowned."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What, did it evaporate?
entries.literal: "What, did it evaporate?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Water evaporates at any temperature that doesn't freeze it, right?
entries.literal: "Water evaporates at any temperature that doesn't freeze it, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, we're indoors. The air isn't moving, and it's not hot at all. It could take a month for the water in a glass to evaporate.
entries.literal: "Atsuki, we're indoors. The air isn't moving, and it's not hot at all. It could take a month for the water in a glass to evaporate."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...A month?
entries.literal: "...A month?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I silently stared back at Sai, wondering if he was thinking what I was.
entries.literal: "I silently stared back at Sai, wondering if he was thinking what I was."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...What, do you think we traveled into the future? A month into the future?
entries.literal: "...What, do you think we traveled into the future? A month into the future?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Beside me, Erina's eyes were wide. Could that have been the truth behind the recording's prediction?
entries.literal: "Beside me, Erina's eyes were wide. Could that have been the truth behind the recording's prediction?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, is traveling to the future possible?
entries.literal: "Sai, is traveling to the future possible?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...{w}It is, I'm pretty sure.
entries.literal: "...{w}It is, I'm pretty sure."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: And you said something happened before the lights went out, right? I didn't see it, but could we have traveled forward right as Shiroya ran away?
entries.literal: "And you said something happened before the lights went out, right? I didn't see it, but could we have traveled forward right as Shiroya ran away?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: A month into the future? The Sekimeiya couldn't have had enough energy to make that happen, right?
entries.literal: "A month into the future? The Sekimeiya couldn't have had enough energy to make that happen, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}But there are no other footprints in the living room. The ones we left just a while ago should be visible.{w} And there's no way we went to the past because the handle in the right bedroom is on the floor.
entries.literal: "...{w}But there are no other footprints in the living room. The ones we left just a while ago should be visible.{w} And there's no way we went to the past because the handle in the right bedroom is on the floor."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: You think the shutter would still be in place after a month?
entries.literal: "You think the shutter would still be in place after a month?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, it is...
entries.literal: "Well, it is..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone was deep in thought, seriously entertaining the possibility I was presenting.
entries.literal: "Everyone was deep in thought, seriously entertaining the possibility I was presenting."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: There are plenty of things unaccounted for.{w} Who activated this future travel, and why? Why did we go so far into the future?{w} Why are the lights off?{w} What was the flash Erina and I saw? And why did it not feel like we traveled? We didn't change places, did we?
entries.literal: "There are plenty of things unaccounted for.{w} Who activated this future travel, and why? Why did we go so far into the future?{w} Why are the lights off?{w} What was the flash Erina and I saw? And why did it not feel like we traveled? We didn't change places, did we?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai was right. If we were in the future, all of those questions had to be answered.{w} However, others would be resolved.{w} Spending a month in the tower without any source of food was no longer necessarily a problem.
entries.literal: "Sai was right. If we were in the future, all of those questions had to be answered.{w} However, others would be resolved.{w} Spending a month in the tower without any source of food was no longer necessarily a problem."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Akaro, do you want to change up your account a little?
entries.literal: "Akaro, do you want to change up your account a little?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: No. I don't know where we are, but it's where I appeared after touching the Sekimeiya you had hidden.
entries.literal: "No. I don't know where we are, but it's where I appeared after touching the Sekimeiya you had hidden."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Ah, right.
entries.literal: "Ah, right."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Well, there's nothing else in the attic.
entries.literal: "Well, there's nothing else in the attic."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: No matter what's happening, we should just stay somewhere. We can't do anything else...
entries.literal: "No matter what's happening, we should just stay somewhere. We can't do anything else..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Yeah, let's go shack up somewhere for a few dozen more hours just in case the shutter opens some day. Who knows if Shiroya is gonna send us another month forward a minute before they unlock, though.{w} I'm starving, by the way. Think I'll pass out any time now.
entries.literal: "Yeah, let's go shack up somewhere for a few dozen more hours just in case the shutter opens some day. Who knows if Shiroya is gonna send us another month forward a minute before they unlock, though.{w} I'm starving, by the way. Think I'll pass out any time now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before anyone could reply, Sai departed to the living room.{w} He was followed by everyone but me.
entries.literal: "Before anyone could reply, Sai departed to the living room.{w} He was followed by everyone but me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If something like that is what happened, Shiroya knew about it...{w} She didn't say anything about it—only that she meant everything she'd said.
entries.literal: "If something like that is what happened, Shiroya knew about it...{w} She didn't say anything about it—only that she meant everything she'd said."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How could she have even known we'd end up in this situation? If it was her who made this happen, then why? And how...!?
entries.literal: "How could she have even known we'd end up in this situation? If it was her who made this happen, then why? And how...!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it really possible that we're in the future? There's not even a guarantee we're one month forward. We could've gone a year into the future; no point after the water evaporated can be concretely determined.
entries.literal: "Is it really possible that we're in the future? There's not even a guarantee we're one month forward. We could've gone a year into the future; no point after the water evaporated can be concretely determined."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And the security room is locked, so we can't see the date on the computer.{w} Is this what Shiroya wanted? Did she want this to happen for a reason...?{w} Everything she said in hallway C... She already knew about this.
entries.literal: "And the security room is locked, so we can't see the date on the computer.{w} Is this what Shiroya wanted? Did she want this to happen for a reason...?{w} Everything she said in hallway C... She already knew about this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran my fingers through my hair as I walked to the right bedroom. The inner handle was in the hallway, and the sheets were messy.
entries.literal: "I ran my fingers through my hair as I walked to the right bedroom. The inner handle was in the hallway, and the sheets were messy."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What happened to the real Shiroya...? To the one who went to the bathroom.{w} Did she touch the Sekimeiya in the water tank? If so, where is she now? Could she eventually have become the other Shiroya...?
entries.literal: "What happened to the real Shiroya...? To the one who went to the bathroom.{w} Did she touch the Sekimeiya in the water tank? If so, where is she now? Could she eventually have become the other Shiroya...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the most frustrating thing in the world. But although I hated the thought of them, Shiroya's final words were kindling a bit of hope within me.
entries.literal: "It was the most frustrating thing in the world. But although I hated the thought of them, Shiroya's final words were kindling a bit of hope within me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...How the hell would we even have traveled to the future!? Sai said it's possible, and I doubt he was lying.
entries.literal: "...How the hell would we even have traveled to the future!? Sai said it's possible, and I doubt he was lying."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it random, like the replicated location?{w} I suppose it can't be random if someone made us travel forward in time deliberately, but what exactly caused it?
entries.literal: "Is it random, like the replicated location?{w} I suppose it can't be random if someone made us travel forward in time deliberately, but what exactly caused it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I lay on the bed. I was exhausted, and my parched throat demanded a drink, an urge I knew wouldn't relent any time soon.
entries.literal: "I lay on the bed. I was exhausted, and my parched throat demanded a drink, an urge I knew wouldn't relent any time soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why did we have to step into the tower in the first place? I didn't have the will to push that thought away anymore.
entries.literal: "Why did we have to step into the tower in the first place? I didn't have the will to push that thought away anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door opened a few minutes later. I looked over and saw everyone coming in from the hallway. They seemed just as tired as me as they stepped in slowly. Closing the door would've trapped us, so they left it open.
entries.literal: "The door opened a few minutes later. I looked over and saw everyone coming in from the hallway. They seemed just as tired as me as they stepped in slowly. Closing the door would've trapped us, so they left it open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro sat on the bed, making a deep noise.
entries.literal: "Akaro sat on the bed, making a deep noise."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Well... What do we do now?
entries.literal: "Well... What do we do now?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: What do you want to do? We might've been here for more than a month and the exit's not open. Unless you wanna take down the shutter by hand, we can only keep waiting.
entries.literal: "What do you want to do? We might've been here for more than a month and the exit's not open. Unless you wanna take down the shutter by hand, we can only keep waiting."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This conversation...!
entries.literal: "This conversation...!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I don't get it. What the hell happened? Did Ashiya just abandon their own building with us inside...? And we thought we'd be free after twelve hours...
entries.literal: "I don't get it. What the hell happened? Did Ashiya just abandon their own building with us inside...? And we thought we'd be free after twelve hours..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A tingling dread began at the tips of my fingers and wormed its way deeper inward. I glanced at Erina, and she looked like no more than a ghost.
entries.literal: "A tingling dread began at the tips of my fingers and wormed its way deeper inward. I glanced at Erina, and she looked like no more than a ghost."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, what are you thinking about? Do you have any more ideas...? And hey, Erina, what's with that face?
entries.literal: "Atsuki, what are you thinking about? Do you have any more ideas...? And hey, Erina, what's with that face?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What, not going to answer?
entries.literal: "What, not going to answer?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before we even heard the sound, Erina and I turned to the door.{w} Then, it opened further, followed by gasps.
entries.literal: "Before we even heard the sound, Erina and I turned to the door.{w} Then, it opened further, followed by gasps."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isla...! What the hell!?
entries.literal: "Isla...! What the hell!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the door, Isla looked at all of us. She seemed to be searching for something.{w} However, she paid no mind to our perplexed faces and kept scanning the room.
entries.literal: "From the door, Isla looked at all of us. She seemed to be searching for something.{w} However, she paid no mind to our perplexed faces and kept scanning the room."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Hey, answer us...! Wh-What are you looking at!?
entries.literal: "Hey, answer us...! Wh-What are you looking at!?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: ...{w}Where am I...?
entries.literal: "...{w}Where am I...?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh-What do you mean? We're still in Ashiya Tower. Do you not remember?
entries.literal: "Wh-What do you mean? We're still in Ashiya Tower. Do you not remember?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No, I know. What I mean is... what happened to me? Where am I?
entries.literal: "No, I know. What I mean is... what happened to me? Where am I?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: No... I should be...
entries.literal: "No... I should be..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Out of nowhere, she staggered forward and began to cry painfully.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, she staggered forward and began to cry painfully."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: I-Isla, what's gotten into you? ...What are you holding?{w} And Erina, why aren't you doing anything!?
entries.literal: "I-Isla, what's gotten into you? ...What are you holding?{w} And Erina, why aren't you doing anything!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She'd pushed the door with both hands, and her left was holding a device—one that I'd seen before. She twitched as she gripped it tightly, sobbing uncontrollably.
entries.literal: "She'd pushed the door with both hands, and her left was holding a device—one that I'd seen before. She twitched as she gripped it tightly, sobbing uncontrollably."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Isla...
entries.literal: "Isla..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Almost afraid she would disappear, Erina tentatively approached her.
entries.literal: "Almost afraid she would disappear, Erina tentatively approached her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Realizing that she was corporeal, she embraced her daughter as she fell to her knees.
entries.literal: "Realizing that she was corporeal, she embraced her daughter as she fell to her knees."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the floor, both of them wept.{w} The recording... it had always been genuine. I finally understood its context, but even that understanding brought an immense number of questions along with it.
entries.literal: "On the floor, both of them wept.{w} The recording... it had always been genuine. I finally understood its context, but even that understanding brought an immense number of questions along with it."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isla... Where were you? What have you been doing?
entries.literal: "Isla... Where were you? What have you been doing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through her sobs, she managed to repeat her question.
entries.literal: "Through her sobs, she managed to repeat her question."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: What happened to me?
entries.literal: "What happened to me?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wh-What do you mean!? You should be the one answering that!
entries.literal: "Wh-What do you mean!? You should be the one answering that!"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: N-No! Not to me! To Isla!{w} Why isn't she here!?
entries.literal: "N-No! Not to me! To Isla!{w} Why isn't she here!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone was speechless. However, I knew that wasn't the Isla the others were thinking of.
entries.literal: "Everyone was speechless. However, I knew that wasn't the Isla the others were thinking of."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Do you mean to your friend?
entries.literal: "Do you mean to your friend?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She gave me an intense look and nodded.
entries.literal: "She gave me an intense look and nodded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When she saw I couldn't answer, her face broke even further, and she buried it in Erina's chest.
entries.literal: "When she saw I couldn't answer, her face broke even further, and she buried it in Erina's chest."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is the friend we were told about. She's searching for the Isla we knew.{w} I have no idea how this came to happen, but this Isla is the person that "my" Isla mentioned.
entries.literal: "This is the friend we were told about. She's searching for the Isla we knew.{w} I have no idea how this came to happen, but this Isla is the person that \"my\" Isla mentioned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Their sobs continued for a long time. Although they weren't understood, nobody could interrupt them.
entries.literal: "Their sobs continued for a long time. Although they weren't understood, nobody could interrupt them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But, as soon as they began to peter out, Sai spoke.
entries.literal: "But, as soon as they began to peter out, Sai spoke."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Isla, this is very important.{w} What day is it? Do you know that?
entries.literal: "Isla, this is very important.{w} What day is it? Do you know that?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She looked up at him and managed to muster a date.
entries.literal: "She looked up at him and managed to muster a date."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Correct. January 5th, 2012.
entries.literal: "Correct. January 5th, 2012."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: January 5th of 2012... So we did go about three weeks into the future.
entries.literal: "January 5th of 2012... So we did go about three weeks into the future."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Wh-What about Shiroya... Is she here?
entries.literal: "Wh-What about Shiroya... Is she here?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Shiroya...? We don't know where she is.{w} Do you? Should she be here?
entries.literal: "Shiroya...? We don't know where she is.{w} Do you? Should she be here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a long pause, Isla nodded faintly.
entries.literal: "After a long pause, Isla nodded faintly."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Sweetie, how did you get here? And why do you have that in your hands?
entries.literal: "Sweetie, how did you get here? And why do you have that in your hands?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With her glistening eyes, Isla looked at the device she was holding. It was the one that had played the recording. Of course, that meant the conversation in the bedroom had just been recorded.
entries.literal: "With her glistening eyes, Isla looked at the device she was holding. It was the one that had played the recording. Of course, that meant the conversation in the bedroom had just been recorded."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I... saw him hiding it in the living room.
entries.literal: "I... saw him hiding it in the living room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone looked at Sai, who smiled playfully.
entries.literal: "Everyone looked at Sai, who smiled playfully."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: So she did.{w} I actually found that in the security room a while ago. I didn't know what it was for until I found something else, a bug Atsuki hid in a coat pocket in one of the lockers.
entries.literal: "So she did.{w} I actually found that in the security room a while ago. I didn't know what it was for until I found something else, a bug Atsuki hid in a coat pocket in one of the lockers."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait, what? I didn't hide that! It was already there.
entries.literal: "Wait, what? I didn't hide that! It was already there."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: How did you even open that locker?
entries.literal: "How did you even open that locker?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The key was in the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "The key was in the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...Really? Well, unfortunately, I found the bug late into the day, but I figured the device I'd found earlier could receive its audio.{w} I thought this was a good occasion to use it, what with Akaro's story being questionable as hell. His clothes changed, and he was out of the tower for a long time. That's why I just placed the bug on him and started recording. I wanted to know if he had a way to exit the building.
entries.literal: "...Really? Well, unfortunately, I found the bug late into the day, but I figured the device I'd found earlier could receive its audio.{w} I thought this was a good occasion to use it, what with Akaro's story being questionable as hell. His clothes changed, and he was out of the tower for a long time. That's why I just placed the bug on him and started recording. I wanted to know if he had a way to exit the building."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Wh-What!? Where is it!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What!? Where is it!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Calm down. Did you really not realize it? It's behind your neck.{w} To be honest, I was also curious about something else. I've still got no explanation for a lot of things that occurred, and I've thought for a while that one of us might travel far to the past to carry out their plan. If that person happened to be Akaro, I hoped that when I pressed the play button, two recordings would show up at once. That would've immediately exposed him, but it didn't happen. I suppose that doesn't matter anymore since he's aware of the bug.
entries.literal: "Calm down. Did you really not realize it? It's behind your neck.{w} To be honest, I was also curious about something else. I've still got no explanation for a lot of things that occurred, and I've thought for a while that one of us might travel far to the past to carry out their plan. If that person happened to be Akaro, I hoped that when I pressed the play button, two recordings would show up at once. That would've immediately exposed him, but it didn't happen. I suppose that doesn't matter anymore since he's aware of the bug."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After frantically feeling his neck, Akaro was able to remove it.
entries.literal: "After frantically feeling his neck, Akaro was able to remove it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. So this is how the conversation was recorded. But... why did Isla have it on the morning of the 15th? Is it going to travel to the past?
entries.literal: "I see. So this is how the conversation was recorded. But... why did Isla have it on the morning of the 15th? Is it going to travel to the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While Erina's trembling hand stroked Isla's hair, she noticed something other than the recorder.
entries.literal: "While Erina's trembling hand stroked Isla's hair, she noticed something other than the recorder."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What are you hiding, sweetie?
entries.literal: "What are you hiding, sweetie?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina's voice sounded concerned, and I knew why. Isla's right hand was a fist; she was holding something.{w} But she shook her head in fear.
entries.literal: "Erina's voice sounded concerned, and I knew why. Isla's right hand was a fist; she was holding something.{w} But she shook her head in fear."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Come on, open it. What do you have there?
entries.literal: "Come on, open it. What do you have there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina had told us about it: during the two weeks before the event, Isla had sometimes hidden something in her fist. It appeared that had been Isla's friend, who still refused to open her hand.
entries.literal: "Erina had told us about it: during the two weeks before the event, Isla had sometimes hidden something in her fist. It appeared that had been Isla's friend, who still refused to open her hand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, Isla's remaining strength was negligible. Erina gently forced her hand open until we saw her palm.
entries.literal: "However, Isla's remaining strength was negligible. Erina gently forced her hand open until we saw her palm."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Wet from her tears, her fingertip had a {tip=burn3}burn{/tip}.
entries.literal: "Wet from her tears, her fingertip had a {tip=burn3}burn{/tip}."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh-What is this...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What is this...?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I don't know... but it doesn't hurt...
entries.literal: "I don't know... but it doesn't hurt..."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did you get burned? When?
entries.literal: "Did you get burned? When?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Isla didn't reply. It didn't seem like she was sure.
entries.literal: "Isla didn't reply. It didn't seem like she was sure."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Isla, I believe that it's January 5th, but please tell us why you're here. What happened to you?
entries.literal: "Isla, I believe that it's January 5th, but please tell us why you're here. What happened to you?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was clear nobody wanted to question why she was alive; no matter the answer, it had to be the Sekimeiya's doing.
entries.literal: "It was clear nobody wanted to question why she was alive; no matter the answer, it had to be the Sekimeiya's doing."

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: I...{w} I followed her steps.
entries.literal: "I...{w} I followed her steps."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Her steps...?
entries.literal: "Her steps...?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: Th-There was a hidden door outside. That's how I entered th-the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Th-There was a hidden door outside. That's how I entered th-the storeroom."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Wait, what!?{w} Is that door open!?
entries.literal: "Wait, what!?{w} Is that door open!?"

entries.speaker: il
entries.text: N-No. It clo—
entries.literal: "N-No. It clo—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before she could finish, Sai and Akaro ran out of the room. Then, even Erina hurried to pick Isla up and leave. They were all going straight to the door to see if they could open it.
entries.literal: "Before she could finish, Sai and Akaro ran out of the room. Then, even Erina hurried to pick Isla up and leave. They were all going straight to the door to see if they could open it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I was the only one left behind, trying to get to a final thought.
entries.literal: "Once again, I was the only one left behind, trying to get to a final thought."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isla followed "her steps"... and she thought Shiroya had to be here. Does that mean Shiroya recently entered from the storeroom?
entries.literal: "Isla followed \"her steps\"... and she thought Shiroya had to be here. Does that mean Shiroya recently entered from the storeroom?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait a second...{w} I might understand our misconception.{w} Somehow, we traveled days into the future, and the shutter was still here. That's what led us to think it never opened.
entries.literal: "Wait a second...{w} I might understand our misconception.{w} Somehow, we traveled days into the future, and the shutter was still here. That's what led us to think it never opened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's not it, though...! It actually opened minutes after we vanished from the 15th.{w} Long after that, it was closed again. That's why the security room is locked and the elevator isn't working. Those are the alarm's effects—we were trapped for a second time. That's why the corpses are gone!
entries.literal: "That's not it, though...! It actually opened minutes after we vanished from the 15th.{w} Long after that, it was closed again. That's why the security room is locked and the elevator isn't working. Those are the alarm's effects—we were trapped for a second time. That's why the corpses are gone!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This means the exit should still unlock within twelve hours... But will it be that easy...? Will we be allowed to leave this time?
entries.literal: "This means the exit should still unlock within twelve hours... But will it be that easy...? Will we be allowed to leave this time?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why are the lights off, though? Why was nobody in the security room? Why was the attic unlocked? And why was the alarm activated again?
entries.literal: "Why are the lights off, though? Why was nobody in the security room? Why was the attic unlocked? And why was the alarm activated again?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why did we travel days into the future? Why didn't it feel like we traveled? Why did Shiroya enter the tower on January 5th?
entries.literal: "Why did we travel days into the future? Why didn't it feel like we traveled? Why did Shiroya enter the tower on January 5th?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We arrived on this day when, from our point of view, the lights went off. The alarm was activated before then, so it felt as if the shutter never withdrew...
entries.literal: "We arrived on this day when, from our point of view, the lights went off. The alarm was activated before then, so it felt as if the shutter never withdrew..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When? What's the deadline this time?
entries.literal: "When? What's the deadline this time?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And was it Shiroya? Whoever it was, they were here recently.
entries.literal: "And was it Shiroya? Whoever it was, they were here recently."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Hm. Someone had to be here.
entries.literal: "...{w}Hm. Someone had to be here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh.{w} I know when it happened! I can't believe I didn't realize it, but it happened immediately before our arrival on this day!
entries.literal: "Oh.{w} I know when it happened! I can't believe I didn't realize it, but it happened immediately before our arrival on this day!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Someone had been there right as the group had appeared on January 5th.{w} Atsuki knew that thanks to the last time he'd been in...
entries.literal: "Someone had been there right as the group had appeared on January 5th.{w} Atsuki knew that thanks to the last time he'd been in..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Not the lobby.
entries.literal: "Not the lobby."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Not the hallways.
entries.literal: "Not the hallways."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You realized it, didn't you?
entries.literal: "You realized it, didn't you?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Not the attic.
entries.literal: "Not the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I was so overwhelmed that I didn't notice it. When I went to the event room...
entries.literal: "I was so overwhelmed that I didn't notice it. When I went to the event room..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "The room was cold. Had Shiroya run to get the Sekimeiya? I carefully walked to the cabinet, moved aside the curtain, and tried to open the glass."
entries.literal: "\"The room was cold. Had Shiroya run to get the Sekimeiya? I carefully walked to the cabinet, moved aside the curtain, and tried to open the glass.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "It should've been locked, but it wasn't. The glass was partially open, and I could put my hand inside."
entries.literal: "\"It should've been locked, but it wasn't. The glass was partially open, and I could put my hand inside.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I felt the Sekimeiya's surface and confirmed it was still there."
entries.literal: "\"I felt the Sekimeiya's surface and confirmed it was still there.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I only realized the Sekimeiya was in the cabinet when I felt it! That means it wasn't glowing!
entries.literal: "I only realized the Sekimeiya was in the cabinet when I felt it! That means it wasn't glowing!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Although it was kept cold, the Sekimeiya was powered off. It had been used moments prior!{w} How can it be that it was powered off within the cabinet? When the cold hit it, it always regained its glow immediately.{w} The glass was partly open, cooling down the whole room. Was it due to that single detail?{w} Or was it something else? If I'm not mistaken, the longer the travel, the longer the Sekimeiya spends powered off...
entries.literal: "Although it was kept cold, the Sekimeiya was powered off. It had been used moments prior!{w} How can it be that it was powered off within the cabinet? When the cold hit it, it always regained its glow immediately.{w} The glass was partly open, cooling down the whole room. Was it due to that single detail?{w} Or was it something else? If I'm not mistaken, the longer the travel, the longer the Sekimeiya spends powered off..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been under the impression that using the Sekimeiya would be futile; I hadn't known that the shutter wouldn't be there in the past, so I'd figured traveling through time would only make a bigger mess of things.
entries.literal: "I'd been under the impression that using the Sekimeiya would be futile; I hadn't known that the shutter wouldn't be there in the past, so I'd figured traveling through time would only make a bigger mess of things."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what I had to do in order to travel forward in time, but if I simply traveled enough time back to appear before our arrival, I could meet the person who had secretly trapped us in January.
entries.literal: "I didn't know what I had to do in order to travel forward in time, but if I simply traveled enough time back to appear before our arrival, I could meet the person who had secretly trapped us in January."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked out of the bedroom.{w} Everyone else had already gone down.
entries.literal: "I walked out of the bedroom.{w} Everyone else had already gone down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left through the staircase and went around the sixth floor by hugging the right wall.
entries.literal: "I left through the staircase and went around the sixth floor by hugging the right wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Attentively walking through the darkness, I reached the crystal floor.{w} I heard knocks and voices coming from the storeroom; it appeared Isla hadn't thought to keep the door open. Perhaps she hadn't been aware of the missing handle.{w} Without making a sound, I slowly tiptoed to the event room.
entries.literal: "Attentively walking through the darkness, I reached the crystal floor.{w} I heard knocks and voices coming from the storeroom; it appeared Isla hadn't thought to keep the door open. Perhaps she hadn't been aware of the missing handle.{w} Without making a sound, I slowly tiptoed to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The air was still cold, and when I raised the curtain, the Sekimeiya's glow appeared before me.
entries.literal: "The air was still cold, and when I raised the curtain, the Sekimeiya's glow appeared before me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's still here... I'm a little surprised.
entries.literal: "It's still here... I'm a little surprised."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The glass wasn't closed, so I could reach it easily. Without directly touching it, I took the Sekimeiya out.
entries.literal: "The glass wasn't closed, so I could reach it easily. Without directly touching it, I took the Sekimeiya out."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I just want to go a little while back. It should be simple.{w} This room is pretty cold, so it might not be a good idea to stay here if I want the Sekimeiya to gather energy.
entries.literal: "I just want to go a little while back. It should be simple.{w} This room is pretty cold, so it might not be a good idea to stay here if I want the Sekimeiya to gather energy."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the hallway and entered room B5, which wasn't in range of the lower temperature. Then, I left the gemstone on the floor.
entries.literal: "I walked to the hallway and entered room B5, which wasn't in range of the lower temperature. Then, I left the gemstone on the floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: With how dark it is, even if the others search for me, I'll be hard to find.
entries.literal: "With how dark it is, even if the others search for me, I'll be hard to find."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The lights went off when Sai's watch read {time=21:03.} I need to arrive before that point, and now his watch must say almost {time=21:20.}{w} I need to leave the Sekimeiya here...
entries.literal: "The lights went off when Sai's watch read {time=21:03.} I need to arrive before that point, and now his watch must say almost {time=21:20.}{w} I need to leave the Sekimeiya here..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I wait for 10 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 30 minutes at {time=21:30.}
entries.literal: "If I wait for 10 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 30 minutes at {time=21:30.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I wait for 15 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 35 minutes at {time=21:35.}
entries.literal: "If I wait for 15 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 35 minutes at {time=21:35.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I wait for 20 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 40 minutes at {time=21:40.}
entries.literal: "If I wait for 20 minutes, I doubt I'll be able to go back 40 minutes at {time=21:40.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: 35 minutes is probably too much.
entries.literal: "35 minutes is probably too much."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'd say for about 25 minutes, so that at {time=21:45} I can travel 45 minutes back. I think that's it, based on all the travels, and especially everything that I just learned.{w} I don't have a way to measure the time by myself, though.
entries.literal: "I'd say for about 25 minutes, so that at {time=21:45} I can travel 45 minutes back. I think that's it, based on all the travels, and especially everything that I just learned.{w} I don't have a way to measure the time by myself, though."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...{w} I can't measure the real time, but I might have a way to measure minutes.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} I can't measure the real time, but I might have a way to measure minutes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The security room is locked, so I don't think there's anything on the crystal floor that isn't Sai's watch. There are a bunch of computers on the office floors, but I need access information to look at the time.{w} I can only think of the kitchen in the attic.{w} The refrigerator was working, so the oven should be too. There's still electricity, so I should be able to count the minutes that pass with that.
entries.literal: "The security room is locked, so I don't think there's anything on the crystal floor that isn't Sai's watch. There are a bunch of computers on the office floors, but I need access information to look at the time.{w} I can only think of the kitchen in the attic.{w} The refrigerator was working, so the oven should be too. There's still electricity, so I should be able to count the minutes that pass with that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Faint voices were still coming from the storeroom. Like before, I ascended the stairs without making noise.
entries.literal: "Faint voices were still coming from the storeroom. Like before, I ascended the stairs without making noise."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I arrived at the kitchen and kneeled in front of the oven. When I pressed the "on" button, a round light lit up red.
entries.literal: "I arrived at the kitchen and kneeled in front of the oven. When I pressed the \"on\" button, a round light lit up red."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I set the lowest possible temperature and rotated the timer toward 22 minutes. Immediately, a quiet buzz indicated that it had begun to count down.
entries.literal: "I set the lowest possible temperature and rotated the timer toward 22 minutes. Immediately, a quiet buzz indicated that it had begun to count down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed the door and walked back to the bedroom, where I lay on the same bed.
entries.literal: "I closed the door and walked back to the bedroom, where I lay on the same bed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Unless the Sekimeiya's found, this should work. I'll come across whoever set this up, and most importantly, I'll appear before the alarm does anything.
entries.literal: "Unless the Sekimeiya's found, this should work. I'll come across whoever set this up, and most importantly, I'll appear before the alarm does anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was I going against Shiroya's wishes? I couldn't care anymore. If it was her, I needed to know why she'd done everything.
entries.literal: "Was I going against Shiroya's wishes? I couldn't care anymore. If it was her, I needed to know why she'd done everything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't let myself fall asleep. A number of minutes had passed, and nobody had come back up.
entries.literal: "I didn't let myself fall asleep. A number of minutes had passed, and nobody had come back up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reentered the kitchen. Less than two minutes remained on the timer.
entries.literal: "I reentered the kitchen. Less than two minutes remained on the timer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In front of the oven, I watched the indicator rotate until it finished with a beep.
entries.literal: "In front of the oven, I watched the indicator rotate until it finished with a beep."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can go now.
entries.literal: "I can go now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I pressed the "off" button and went down the stairs.
entries.literal: "I pressed the \"off\" button and went down the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two floors down, I stopped abruptly. The others were making their way up.{w} I took a step aside and hushed my breathing. Unaware that I was there, they passed me by.
entries.literal: "Two floors down, I stopped abruptly. The others were making their way up.{w} I took a step aside and hushed my breathing. Unaware that I was there, they passed me by."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once the sounds of their movement had faded, I kept going down.
entries.literal: "Once the sounds of their movement had faded, I kept going down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still behind room B5's door.{w} I felt it through my sleeve and instantly determined that it had built up considerable energy. I had to quickly withdraw my hand to avoid harm.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was still behind room B5's door.{w} I felt it through my sleeve and instantly determined that it had built up considerable energy. I had to quickly withdraw my hand to avoid harm."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This should be enough, but I wonder if it'll work as I want it to.
entries.literal: "This should be enough, but I wonder if it'll work as I want it to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was certain 25 minutes had passed since I'd taken it out of the cabinet. Without hesitation, I rapidly forced my hand through the wall of heat until I contacted the smooth stone.
entries.literal: "I was certain 25 minutes had passed since I'd taken it out of the cabinet. Without hesitation, I rapidly forced my hand through the wall of heat until I contacted the smooth stone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Did I... change places?
entries.literal: "...{w}Did I... change places?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spun; the darkness around me was identical.
entries.literal: "I spun; the darkness around me was identical."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait! The shutter isn't here!
entries.literal: "Wait! The shutter isn't here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared in awe. I could see a streetlight within the night, illuminating the snow around it. I was in the lobby of the tower; a light from the reception desk confirmed that.
entries.literal: "I stared in awe. I could see a streetlight within the night, illuminating the snow around it. I was in the lobby of the tower; a light from the reception desk confirmed that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It did work...! The alarm hasn't gone off yet!
entries.literal: "It did work...! The alarm hasn't gone off yet!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, when I tried to open the door, it was still locked. I had also been assaulted by a wave of tiredness and wished to lie down.{w} Suddenly, a sharp sound echoed in my ears. ...Had it come from hallway B?
entries.literal: "However, when I tried to open the door, it was still locked. I had also been assaulted by a wave of tiredness and wished to lie down.{w} Suddenly, a sharp sound echoed in my ears. ...Had it come from hallway B?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Someone's there.
entries.literal: "Someone's there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was it Shiroya? Slowly, I moved closer.
entries.literal: "Was it Shiroya? Slowly, I moved closer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I stopped still. No sound could be heard anymore.{w} I didn't know what to do, and I was more than a little afraid. If that was the person who'd killed everyone, I was finally in real danger—the recording had guaranteed my safety for a long time, but it had become a past event, and the promise of my well-being had expired.
entries.literal: "...{w}I stopped still. No sound could be heard anymore.{w} I didn't know what to do, and I was more than a little afraid. If that was the person who'd killed everyone, I was finally in real danger—the recording had guaranteed my safety for a long time, but it had become a past event, and the promise of my well-being had expired."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh?{w} What...?
entries.literal: "Huh?{w} What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Though I couldn't see it, I looked at my hand. It hadn't hurt for a while, but it was where I'd suffered a painful injury in the elevator.
entries.literal: "Though I couldn't see it, I looked at my hand. It hadn't hurt for a while, but it was where I'd suffered a painful injury in the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Amazed, I opened and closed it in succession. I could feel the injury was gone.
entries.literal: "Amazed, I opened and closed it in succession. I could feel the injury was gone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why...? I traveled to the past with it before, and it didn't disappear!
entries.literal: "Why...? I traveled to the past with it before, and it didn't disappear!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It must've had to do with the replicated location, but my attention was again taken by resuming footsteps.
entries.literal: "It must've had to do with the replicated location, but my attention was again taken by resuming footsteps."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Are they Shiroya's...?
entries.literal: "Are they Shiroya's...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't deny it, but I wasn't sure either.
entries.literal: "I couldn't deny it, but I wasn't sure either."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I think they just entered the event room. ...Are they planning to travel through time? The alarm will probably be activated from there.
entries.literal: "I think they just entered the event room. ...Are they planning to travel through time? The alarm will probably be activated from there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not sure what the best course of action is. Should I change the past to prevent the alarm from going off? That could be dangerous.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure what the best course of action is. Should I change the past to prevent the alarm from going off? That could be dangerous."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could hear faint sounds, but I couldn't make them out. Trying to quickly come to a conclusion, I waited helplessly from a distance.
entries.literal: "I could hear faint sounds, but I couldn't make them out. Trying to quickly come to a conclusion, I waited helplessly from a distance."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, wait...!
entries.literal: "Oh, wait...!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If this is Shiroya, she came in from the storeroom! Isla seemed like she entered the tower by following her steps.{w} If Isla was able to enter from the outside, the door was open. I might be able to leave right now...!
entries.literal: "If this is Shiroya, she came in from the storeroom! Isla seemed like she entered the tower by following her steps.{w} If Isla was able to enter from the outside, the door was open. I might be able to leave right now...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried not to panic. Freedom was potentially in reach, but I couldn't let myself be noticed.
entries.literal: "I tried not to panic. Freedom was potentially in reach, but I couldn't let myself be noticed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Fuck! That's the alarm!
entries.literal: "Fuck! That's the alarm!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A loud sound came from behind me. When I turned around, I saw the streetlight beyond the glass disappearing. The shutter was beginning to cover it, and before I knew it, it was no longer visible.
entries.literal: "A loud sound came from behind me. When I turned around, I saw the streetlight beyond the glass disappearing. The shutter was beginning to cover it, and before I knew it, it was no longer visible."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No, it doesn't matter! It's not gonna lock the other exit!
entries.literal: "No, it doesn't matter! It's not gonna lock the other exit!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped back, placing my feet on the floor as slowly as I could. Then, feeling the wall, I walked to the next door.
entries.literal: "I stepped back, placing my feet on the floor as slowly as I could. Then, feeling the wall, I walked to the next door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hallway A extended beyond me. Was the other person still there? I couldn't hear anything.
entries.literal: "Hallway A extended beyond me. Was the other person still there? I couldn't hear anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to run in case the door was closed. I stepped to the left wall and walked as I counted the rooms.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to run in case the door was closed. I stepped to the left wall and walked as I counted the rooms."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: One,{w=0.6} two,{w=0.6} three,{w=0.6} four,{w=0.6} five.
entries.literal: "One,{w=0.6} two,{w=0.6} three,{w=0.6} four,{w=0.6} five."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This one has to be the storeroom's! It's not even closed!
entries.literal: "This one has to be the storeroom's! It's not even closed!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I looked through it, I saw a light. It was very faint, but it illuminated the narrow walls slightly.
entries.literal: "When I looked through it, I saw a light. It was very faint, but it illuminated the narrow walls slightly."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Are those... the stars...?
entries.literal: "Are those... the stars...?"

entries.text: Sheer Intent
entries.literal: "Sheer Intent"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No way.
entries.literal: "No way."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: A-Atsuki...?
entries.literal: "A-Atsuki...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: H—

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From behind, I heard a voice that made me jump.
entries.literal: "From behind, I heard a voice that made me jump."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You...!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was her, wearing clothes I hadn't seen in a long time.
entries.literal: "It was her, wearing clothes I hadn't seen in a long time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: A-Are you Shiroya...?
entries.literal: "A-Are you Shiroya...?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What? Y-Yes. Where are we? I just appeared here.
entries.literal: "What? Y-Yes. Where are we? I just appeared here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Both of us just appeared here? The Sekimeiya was activated, and the range reached to the storeroom...
entries.literal: "Both of us just appeared here? The Sekimeiya was activated, and the range reached to the storeroom..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hold on, isn't that...?
entries.literal: "Hold on, isn't that...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind her was the hallway B door, and on its edges was the dark outline caused by the smoke. However, it didn't look dry yet.
entries.literal: "Behind her was the hallway B door, and on its edges was the dark outline caused by the smoke. However, it didn't look dry yet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: W-Wait, that...
entries.literal: "W-Wait, that..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She looked back and realized the same. And most of the ceiling lights were off, like they had been in the morning...
entries.literal: "She looked back and realized the same. And most of the ceiling lights were off, like they had been in the morning..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...It's the smoke, right?
entries.literal: "...It's the smoke, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Y-Yes, but doesn't it look different?
entries.literal: "Y-Yes, but doesn't it look different?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm not sure where we are. I just appeared here too.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure where we are. I just appeared here too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could we have been back at the beginning? Before asking anything else, I got closer to the hallway.{w} A sound from the other side caused me to stop; a door had closed.
entries.literal: "Could we have been back at the beginning? Before asking anything else, I got closer to the hallway.{w} A sound from the other side caused me to stop; a door had closed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed like nobody was coming, so I slowly continued until I gripped the knob. Then, when I looked through the door, a dark plume clouded my vision.
entries.literal: "It seemed like nobody was coming, so I slowly continued until I gripped the knob. Then, when I looked through the door, a dark plume clouded my vision."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, fuck. Don't breathe.
entries.literal: "Oh, fuck. Don't breathe."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wh-What...?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Erina, Isla, and Sai were on the floor. It was the start of the incident.
entries.literal: "Erina, Isla, and Sai were on the floor. It was the start of the incident."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe it. I'd been so close to escaping, but it hadn't been permitted. I had no idea what was ahead of me anymore, but the tower held me in its grip like a python.{w} I lowered my head and saw my own hand. Exposed to the light, I could see the injury was still gone.{w} Then, I noticed something else—I wasn't hungry or tired anymore. Those sensations had also disappeared.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it. I'd been so close to escaping, but it hadn't been permitted. I had no idea what was ahead of me anymore, but the tower held me in its grip like a python.{w} I lowered my head and saw my own hand. Exposed to the light, I could see the injury was still gone.{w} Then, I noticed something else—I wasn't hungry or tired anymore. Those sensations had also disappeared."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: A-Are we on the morning of the 15th?
entries.literal: "A-Are we on the morning of the 15th?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around warily. Shiroya was there, but I still felt that something about her was different. She didn't feel like the person I'd entered the tower with.
entries.literal: "I turned around warily. Shiroya was there, but I still felt that something about her was different. She didn't feel like the person I'd entered the tower with."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Are you really Shiroya? The real one?
entries.literal: "...Are you really Shiroya? The real one?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What does that mean...!? Who else would I be?
entries.literal: "What does that mean...!? Who else would I be?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...What do you remember? Please, tell me everything.
entries.literal: "...What do you remember? Please, tell me everything."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What!? I-I don't know what you mean! We got trapped here, and a bunch of things happened!
entries.literal: "What!? I-I don't know what you mean! We got trapped here, and a bunch of things happened!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What happened? How did you end up here?
entries.literal: "What happened? How did you end up here?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: H-Huh? A lot of things! Do you remember everything? Late into the day, we were in the lobby, and I went to the bathroom. There, I activated the Sekimeiya and appeared on the 30th of November, below that gem shop.{w} Then... a few days later, I entered the tower and touched the Sekimeiya. That's how I just appeared here.
entries.literal: "H-Huh? A lot of things! Do you remember everything? Late into the day, we were in the lobby, and I went to the bathroom. There, I activated the Sekimeiya and appeared on the 30th of November, below that gem shop.{w} Then... a few days later, I entered the tower and touched the Sekimeiya. That's how I just appeared here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: W-Wait, that's all...? What about appearing after you'd gone to the bathroom? Do you remember that?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, that's all...? What about appearing after you'd gone to the bathroom? Do you remember that?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What? N-No...? I found the Sekimeiya in the toilet's water tank and went a long way into the past.
entries.literal: "What? N-No...? I found the Sekimeiya in the toilet's water tank and went a long way into the past."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Are you really... the real Shiroya? I don't really understand what you're telling me.
entries.literal: "...{w}Are you really... the real Shiroya? I don't really understand what you're telling me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She gave me a disoriented stare, as if she had no idea why I was so skeptical.
entries.literal: "She gave me a disoriented stare, as if she had no idea why I was so skeptical."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait a second. That sound from before was a door, right? It sounded like it came from the right wall.
entries.literal: "Wait a second. That sound from before was a door, right? It sounded like it came from the right wall."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I think so.
entries.literal: "...I think so."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It had to be that one, then.{w} That's where Naomi died and where I traveled for the first time. If the smoke was just released, someone might have just been there because it's where the temperature regulation cabinets are.
entries.literal: "It had to be that one, then.{w} That's where Naomi died and where I traveled for the first time. If the smoke was just released, someone might have just been there because it's where the temperature regulation cabinets are."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Were we really at the beginning, just like that? It didn't make any sense; if we had always been present, we would've been found on many occasions.{w} Were we going to change the past? I really wanted Shiroya to be telling the truth. If she was, we would get through everything, but I knew she had withheld the truth from me before.
entries.literal: "Were we really at the beginning, just like that? It didn't make any sense; if we had always been present, we would've been found on many occasions.{w} Were we going to change the past? I really wanted Shiroya to be telling the truth. If she was, we would get through everything, but I knew she had withheld the truth from me before."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think we just heard the culprit. I have no idea why we're here, but only a few people should be conscious at this time.
entries.literal: "I think we just heard the culprit. I have no idea why we're here, but only a few people should be conscious at this time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't hesitate. The real culprit, the person who had removed the storeroom's handle, could have been present. Low to the ground, I scurried to the crystal room.{w} I turned to Shiroya, who was following me. At that point, I noticed something intriguing, but I couldn't stop there.
entries.literal: "I couldn't hesitate. The real culprit, the person who had removed the storeroom's handle, could have been present. Low to the ground, I scurried to the crystal room.{w} I turned to Shiroya, who was following me. At that point, I noticed something intriguing, but I couldn't stop there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We entered the room, and I closed the door behind us.
entries.literal: "We entered the room, and I closed the door behind us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you see the door to the lobby?
entries.literal: "Did you see the door to the lobby?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...What about it?
entries.literal: "...What about it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We just left it open.
entries.literal: "We just left it open."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh. Does that matter?
entries.literal: "Oh. Does that matter?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You remember, right? When we met everyone else, Sai pointed out that it was open, and Katei said he did that. I'm pretty sure it looked exactly the way we just left it.
entries.literal: "You remember, right? When we met everyone else, Sai pointed out that it was open, and Katei said he did that. I'm pretty sure it looked exactly the way we just left it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I see what you mean, but please answer one thing for me. Why are we here? Did something happen after I traveled to the past?
entries.literal: "...I see what you mean, but please answer one thing for me. Why are we here? Did something happen after I traveled to the past?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Are you telling me the truth? Do you not know what happened after?
entries.literal: "Are you telling me the truth? Do you not know what happened after?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I don't...! I just told you. I appeared on the 30th of November.{w} I stayed at my apartment while my past self was in the hospital, and a few days later, I entered the tower.{w} I have no idea what happened there, though. The Sekimeiya was already in the cabinet, and I touched it since nobody was in the security room. After that, I appeared in the lobby with you. Now we're here.
entries.literal: "I don't...! I just told you. I appeared on the 30th of November.{w} I stayed at my apartment while my past self was in the hospital, and a few days later, I entered the tower.{w} I have no idea what happened there, though. The Sekimeiya was already in the cabinet, and I touched it since nobody was in the security room. After that, I appeared in the lobby with you. Now we're here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't know what to think. While I was aware such lengthy travels were possible, what she was saying didn't sound right. Had she traveled to the future from early December? Why had we appeared at the same time, then?
entries.literal: "I didn't know what to think. While I was aware such lengthy travels were possible, what she was saying didn't sound right. Had she traveled to the future from early December? Why had we appeared at the same time, then?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it was impossible for me to think she was lying; her voice sounded as sincere as always.{w} When I'd activated the Sekimeiya from room B5... had I perhaps traveled to the first days of December?{w} I was stumped. If she was telling the truth, I couldn't explain what had happened to me.
entries.literal: "But it was impossible for me to think she was lying; her voice sounded as sincere as always.{w} When I'd activated the Sekimeiya from room B5... had I perhaps traveled to the first days of December?{w} I was stumped. If she was telling the truth, I couldn't explain what had happened to me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait, you said you traveled to the 30th? Did you try to save Miiya?
entries.literal: "Wait, you said you traveled to the 30th? Did you try to save Miiya?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I couldn't... I appeared too late for that, but I did change the past—
entries.literal: "I couldn't... I appeared too late for that, but I did change the past—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She cut herself off, as if doubting what she was saying.
entries.literal: "She cut herself off, as if doubting what she was saying."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm trying to understand what you've said...
entries.literal: "I'm trying to understand what you've said..."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Don't worry, even I don't understand anything of what I lived through. I'm not lying, though.
entries.literal: "Don't worry, even I don't understand anything of what I lived through. I'm not lying, though."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Then I'm not sure it would help if I told you what happened after you left.{w} Another version of you was there, but it wasn't you, right?
entries.literal: "...Then I'm not sure it would help if I told you what happened after you left.{w} Another version of you was there, but it wasn't you, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: N-No. I have no idea who that was.
entries.literal: "N-No. I have no idea who that was."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Well, we weren't able to leave when the time came. I'm not sure what happened, why, or how, but the lights went off, and we couldn't get out.{w} ...You remember the recording, right?{w} It was real.
entries.literal: "Well, we weren't able to leave when the time came. I'm not sure what happened, why, or how, but the lights went off, and we couldn't get out.{w} ...You remember the recording, right?{w} It was real."
