entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, what...?
entries.literal: "Wait, what...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, it did happen. It wasn't a trick.{w} It still doesn't make any sense, though. I can't wrap my head around what happened.
entries.literal: "Yes, it did happen. It wasn't a trick.{w} It still doesn't make any sense, though. I can't wrap my head around what happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You said that you touched the Sekimeiya in the event room days before the 15th, right?
entries.literal: "You said that you touched the Sekimeiya in the event room days before the 15th, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-Yes.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. What the fuck, then...? I don't get anything.{w} I thought I got caught up in your travel and both of us appeared in front of the hallway B door, the location where we were on the morning of the 15th.
entries.literal: "I see. What the fuck, then...? I don't get anything.{w} I thought I got caught up in your travel and both of us appeared in front of the hallway B door, the location where we were on the morning of the 15th."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But that makes no sense...! And look at my clothes, I wasn't wearing these on the 15th!
entries.literal: "But that makes no sense...! And look at my clothes, I wasn't wearing these on the 15th!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You're right, actually. Were you wearing them when you touched the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "You're right, actually. Were you wearing them when you touched the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As she shook her head, my attention was grabbed by a cabinet I recognized.
entries.literal: "As she shook her head, my attention was grabbed by a cabinet I recognized."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...That's where the Sekimeiya was, right?
entries.literal: "...That's where the Sekimeiya was, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, and look at the wheel.
entries.literal: "Yes, and look at the wheel."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's set to be cold... Oh, and it's not damaged yet. Wasn't this the one with a crack?
entries.literal: "It's set to be cold... Oh, and it's not damaged yet. Wasn't this the one with a crack?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes... it was.
entries.literal: "Yes... it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I unlocked its lid, and both of us looked inside.
entries.literal: "I unlocked its lid, and both of us looked inside."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-What?{w} I...{w} don't get it.
entries.literal: "Wh-What?{w} I...{w} don't get it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was there.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was there."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Someone left it in here.
entries.literal: "Someone left it in here."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, which is what I don't get. When we woke up, it was in the event room, still in its cabinet.
entries.literal: "Yes, which is what I don't get. When we woke up, it was in the event room, still in its cabinet."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You're... right.
entries.literal: "You're... right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the Sekimeiya out. Although the cabinet had been set to 0 °C, it wasn't cold, likely because it had been recently set. In contrast, the Sekimeiya was burning, forcing me to double layer the cloth of my sleeves.
entries.literal: "I took the Sekimeiya out. Although the cabinet had been set to 0 °C, it wasn't cold, likely because it had been recently set. In contrast, the Sekimeiya was burning, forcing me to double layer the cloth of my sleeves."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's set to 0 °C, but the cabinet isn't cold at all.
entries.literal: "It's set to 0 °C, but the cabinet isn't cold at all."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It could've been set just now, so it didn't have enough time to cool off.
entries.literal: "It could've been set just now, so it didn't have enough time to cool off."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: God, the Sekimeiya is burning, though...!
entries.literal: "God, the Sekimeiya is burning, though...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya reached out to me, and I reflexively jumped back a bit. She didn't do anything, however.
entries.literal: "Shiroya reached out to me, and I reflexively jumped back a bit. She didn't do anything, however."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Sorry, when I touched it in the bathroom, its surroundings were incredibly hot. ...I can feel the heat, but it's nothing like then.{w} Do you know more about how the Sekimeiya works?
entries.literal: "Sorry, when I touched it in the bathroom, its surroundings were incredibly hot. ...I can feel the heat, but it's nothing like then.{w} Do you know more about how the Sekimeiya works?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know nothing, and even less with what you've told me.
entries.literal: "I know nothing, and even less with what you've told me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's working, so if we're really at the start of the incident, wouldn't touching it put us outside?
entries.literal: "It's working, so if we're really at the start of the incident, wouldn't touching it put us outside?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: M-Maybe. That's what I was thinking. It should be hot enough for that.
entries.literal: "M-Maybe. That's what I was thinking. It should be hot enough for that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, the chance to escape had appeared right in front of me. Was it finally a genuine opportunity?
entries.literal: "Once again, the chance to escape had appeared right in front of me. Was it finally a genuine opportunity?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Let's touch it.
entries.literal: "Let's touch it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded and got close to her. Slowly, my hand reached for the Sekimeiya in defiance of the burning aura around it.{w} However, the instant I contacted the gemstone, it vanished.
entries.literal: "I nodded and got close to her. Slowly, my hand reached for the Sekimeiya in defiance of the burning aura around it.{w} However, the instant I contacted the gemstone, it vanished."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya wasn't there anymore. We hadn't appeared anywhere else either, as I could still feel the burn on my fingers.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya wasn't there anymore. We hadn't appeared anywhere else either, as I could still feel the burn on my fingers."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Th-This is what happened before. It teleported, and we didn't travel.
entries.literal: "Th-This is what happened before. It teleported, and we didn't travel."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh.
entries.literal: "Oh."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe it. All we wanted was to leave that place, but it was a hope constantly rebuilt only to be repeatedly crushed.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it. All we wanted was to leave that place, but it was a hope constantly rebuilt only to be repeatedly crushed."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, n-no... I-It can't be that.
entries.literal: "Wait, n-no... I-It can't be that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I followed Shiroya's eyes and almost fell back from the shock. The cabinet was shut, and the curtain neatly covered it again.
entries.literal: "I followed Shiroya's eyes and almost fell back from the shock. The cabinet was shut, and the curtain neatly covered it again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wh-What the fuck...? It didn't fall, right?
entries.literal: "Wh-What the fuck...? It didn't fall, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She denied it; the cabinet had closed without making a sound.{w} Could we have traveled back in time to a point before I'd unlocked it? In that case, why hadn't we teleported?
entries.literal: "She denied it; the cabinet had closed without making a sound.{w} Could we have traveled back in time to a point before I'd unlocked it? In that case, why hadn't we teleported?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, we turned to the door. Someone was running through the hallway.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, we turned to the door. Someone was running through the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As they did, we ran to grab the doorknob.
entries.literal: "As they did, we ran to grab the doorknob."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A bit of smoke remained in the air, and nobody could be seen. It didn't seem like we'd gone to the past.
entries.literal: "A bit of smoke remained in the air, and nobody could be seen. It didn't seem like we'd gone to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, those rapid footsteps were still audible in the distance. It had to be the person responsible for our imprisonment...!{w} We ran behind the sound, covering our faces.
entries.literal: "However, those rapid footsteps were still audible in the distance. It had to be the person responsible for our imprisonment...!{w} We ran behind the sound, covering our faces."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They had gone up the stairs, and the gray door was unlocked. We went up, hearing the echoing steps far ahead. If they were going to the attic, we couldn't slow down.
entries.literal: "They had gone up the stairs, and the gray door was unlocked. We went up, hearing the echoing steps far ahead. If they were going to the attic, we couldn't slow down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we got to the sixth floor, the crack of a door closing resounded through the air. We hadn't been fast enough.
entries.literal: "When we got to the sixth floor, the crack of a door closing resounded through the air. We hadn't been fast enough."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Damn it...!
entries.literal: "Damn it...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As expected, the attic door was locked.{w} Had it been Naomi? She was the one with the key.
entries.literal: "As expected, the attic door was locked.{w} Had it been Naomi? She was the one with the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Frustrated, I looked at Shiroya, who had a key in her hand.
entries.literal: "Frustrated, I looked at Shiroya, who had a key in her hand."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What...!? Why do you have it!?
entries.literal: "What...!? Why do you have it!?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I... don't know... I found it when I entered the tower, in the mechanical room. I found the rusty key in a drawer in the security room as well, but... how is it possible I still have them when my clothes completely changed?
entries.literal: "I... don't know... I found it when I entered the tower, in the mechanical room. I found the rusty key in a drawer in the security room as well, but... how is it possible I still have them when my clothes completely changed?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned along with her, as it sounded unbelievable. She hurried to unlock the door and revealed the narrow staircase.
entries.literal: "I frowned along with her, as it sounded unbelievable. She hurried to unlock the door and revealed the narrow staircase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Barely any light illuminated the steps. Following Shiroya, I began to silently ascend them.
entries.literal: "Barely any light illuminated the steps. Following Shiroya, I began to silently ascend them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When she reached the top, Shiroya peeked through the small gap between the door and wall.{w} Then, she turned to me.
entries.literal: "When she reached the top, Shiroya peeked through the small gap between the door and wall.{w} Then, she turned to me."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Your perception of what occurred is gravely mistaken. Before Atsuki, Shiroya's figure vanished.
entries.literal: "Your perception of what occurred is gravely mistaken. Before Atsuki, Shiroya's figure vanished."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But before she could face me, she disappeared.
entries.literal: "But before she could face me, she disappeared."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What!? Did she travel!?
entries.literal: "What!? Did she travel!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran up the stairs and looked through the door.
entries.literal: "I ran up the stairs and looked through the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody was there.
entries.literal: "Nobody was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But something was on the sofa that left me dazed. Two Sekimeiya were there, and one of them was powered off.{w} Next to them, I saw a set of keys. ...It was Naomi's.
entries.literal: "But something was on the sofa that left me dazed. Two Sekimeiya were there, and one of them was powered off.{w} Next to them, I saw a set of keys. ...It was Naomi's."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was Naomi here? Did she touch that Sekimeiya, teleporting Shiroya away?
entries.literal: "Was Naomi here? Did she touch that Sekimeiya, teleporting Shiroya away?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi and Shiroya had disappeared. However, Atsuki didn't know something else had too.
entries.literal: "Naomi and Shiroya had disappeared. However, Atsuki didn't know something else had too."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yes. Atsuki didn't see the suitcase Naomi had been holding; both Sekimeiya lay alone on top of the sofa's cushion.
entries.literal: "Yes. Atsuki didn't see the suitcase Naomi had been holding; both Sekimeiya lay alone on top of the sofa's cushion."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the suitcase that Naomi had been holding. Atsuki saw both Sekimeiya lying alone on top of the sofa's cushion.
entries.literal: "It was the suitcase that Naomi had been holding. Atsuki saw both Sekimeiya lying alone on top of the sofa's cushion."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why are there two Sekimeiya...? Were there two from the beginning? Is this really why Sai had one in his hip pack once...?
entries.literal: "Why are there two Sekimeiya...? Were there two from the beginning? Is this really why Sai had one in his hip pack once...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where the hell did Shiroya appear? Could she be back on the crystal floor?
entries.literal: "Where the hell did Shiroya appear? Could she be back on the crystal floor?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a step back, hesitant to walk into the living room. My footprints would stay on the floor, and we'd never seen them.
entries.literal: "I took a step back, hesitant to walk into the living room. My footprints would stay on the floor, and we'd never seen them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, no... Shiroya couldn't have gone to the past.{w} If she had, she would've shown up immediately after her disappearance, right?{w} Could she have gone to the future...? Is that really possible?
entries.literal: "Wait, no... Shiroya couldn't have gone to the past.{w} If she had, she would've shown up immediately after her disappearance, right?{w} Could she have gone to the future...? Is that really possible?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Or what if she went far enough to the past to appear outside the tower? The range picked her up, but not me. It was likely not a very lengthy travel, I'm just not sure how much I can trust the range.
entries.literal: "Or what if she went far enough to the past to appear outside the tower? The range picked her up, but not me. It was likely not a very lengthy travel, I'm just not sure how much I can trust the range."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And Naomi was definitely here. Why did she run up to the attic with the Sekimeiya, just to travel through time?{w} She didn't know we'd unlocked the way in, so she might think she locked the Sekimeiya in here.{w} ...Which is strange. After all, the attic was locked when we first came across the door.
entries.literal: "...And Naomi was definitely here. Why did she run up to the attic with the Sekimeiya, just to travel through time?{w} She didn't know we'd unlocked the way in, so she might think she locked the Sekimeiya in here.{w} ...Which is strange. After all, the attic was locked when we first came across the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't get it...! The Sekimeiya disappeared from the crystal room, and immediately, Naomi was bringing two of them up. At the same time, another one must've been in its original cabinet.{w} What the hell happened before we woke up? How many Sekimeiya are there...?
entries.literal: "I don't get it...! The Sekimeiya disappeared from the crystal room, and immediately, Naomi was bringing two of them up. At the same time, another one must've been in its original cabinet.{w} What the hell happened before we woke up? How many Sekimeiya are there...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was enigmatic. Naomi had to still be in the tower, but if Shiroya also was, why had she not come back?
entries.literal: "It was enigmatic. Naomi had to still be in the tower, but if Shiroya also was, why had she not come back?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could they both have gone to the past, but only Naomi reappeared in the tower?
entries.literal: "Could they both have gone to the past, but only Naomi reappeared in the tower?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, I realized I had to go back downstairs and found myself bolting out of the attic.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, I realized I had to go back downstairs and found myself bolting out of the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The storeroom...! Now I know it leads outside, and its handle must've been taken off at this time. If it was Naomi, I might get there before it happens!
entries.literal: "The storeroom...! Now I know it leads outside, and its handle must've been taken off at this time. If it was Naomi, I might get there before it happens!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya could no longer have been in the building, but perhaps she was outside. As another chance to escape presented itself, I found myself gathering foolish hope once more.
entries.literal: "Shiroya could no longer have been in the building, but perhaps she was outside. As another chance to escape presented itself, I found myself gathering foolish hope once more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Almost no smoke hung in the air, and I could hear people on the same floor. I was not the only person there, but my only interest was the room I ran to.
entries.literal: "Almost no smoke hung in the air, and I could hear people on the same floor. I was not the only person there, but my only interest was the room I ran to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the storeroom, I rapidly shut myself behind the secret wall and approached the door.
entries.literal: "In the storeroom, I rapidly shut myself behind the secret wall and approached the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the dark, I felt it for its handle.
entries.literal: "In the dark, I felt it for its handle."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It is here! I can leave!
entries.literal: "It is here! I can leave!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe it, but I gripped the handle and turned it with all my might.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it, but I gripped the handle and turned it with all my might."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: You've gotta be kidding me. It's locked...
entries.literal: "You've gotta be kidding me. It's locked..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, no, of course it is! That's why it was ripped off, so that we couldn't unlock it with the key that we found!
entries.literal: "Wait, no, of course it is! That's why it was ripped off, so that we couldn't unlock it with the key that we found!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran back to the hallway. We'd found the rusty key on the floor, in front of the event room.
entries.literal: "I ran back to the hallway. We'd found the rusty key on the floor, in front of the event room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I get it and unlock the door, I'll definitely be changing the past, won't I? The police might even see me and set everyone free.
entries.literal: "If I get it and unlock the door, I'll definitely be changing the past, won't I? The police might even see me and set everyone free."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of that no longer mattered. The real Shiroya had likely appeared somewhere, and I had a definite avenue of escape. I wasn't even aware of the possible consequences that would come, so I couldn't care about them. They were abstract things, and escaping was concrete.
entries.literal: "All of that no longer mattered. The real Shiroya had likely appeared somewhere, and I had a definite avenue of escape. I wasn't even aware of the possible consequences that would come, so I couldn't care about them. They were abstract things, and escaping was concrete."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where the fuck is it...!? It was right here.
entries.literal: "Where the fuck is it...!? It was right here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was very little light, but I couldn't see the key anywhere.
entries.literal: "There was very little light, but I couldn't see the key anywhere."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the fuck!? I just want to leave!
entries.literal: "What the fuck!? I just want to leave!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to accept it, but the key wasn't there.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to accept it, but the key wasn't there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was it not dropped yet?
entries.literal: "Was it not dropped yet?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although it was ridiculous, I went back to the chilly storeroom. It was a bit of a gamble, but the culprit had to arrive there relatively soon to detach the handle.
entries.literal: "Although it was ridiculous, I went back to the chilly storeroom. It was a bit of a gamble, but the culprit had to arrive there relatively soon to detach the handle."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Wait, is that right?{w} Will the culprit really come in here...?
entries.literal: "...{w}Wait, is that right?{w} Will the culprit really come in here...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we found the secret wall, a single set of fingerprints was on it, meaning that it had been opened one time in the recent past. I swear I just saw those same fingerprints right now... Does that mean that nobody will come until our past selves find the mechanism?{w} Alternatively, what if they come from outside and won't touch the other side of the wall?{w} ...This doesn't make any sense, though. How is it possible we only saw one set of fingerprints? What about the ones I left just now?
entries.literal: "When we found the secret wall, a single set of fingerprints was on it, meaning that it had been opened one time in the recent past. I swear I just saw those same fingerprints right now... Does that mean that nobody will come until our past selves find the mechanism?{w} Alternatively, what if they come from outside and won't touch the other side of the wall?{w} ...This doesn't make any sense, though. How is it possible we only saw one set of fingerprints? What about the ones I left just now?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Did it mean that the past had changed? Was everything going to happen differently?
entries.literal: "Did it mean that the past had changed? Was everything going to happen differently?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And where in the world is Shiroya? If she somehow went to the future, she'll definitely come here when she appears.{w} Is it possible she's outside and won't tell the police just so she can avoid changing the past...?
entries.literal: "...And where in the world is Shiroya? If she somehow went to the future, she'll definitely come here when she appears.{w} Is it possible she's outside and won't tell the police just so she can avoid changing the past...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The key isn't in the hallway, the handle hasn't been taken off, I left extra fingerprints, and two Sekimeiya are in the attic. This cannot be the same morning. After all, if I'd been here since the start, I would've been found.
entries.literal: "The key isn't in the hallway, the handle hasn't been taken off, I left extra fingerprints, and two Sekimeiya are in the attic. This cannot be the same morning. After all, if I'd been here since the start, I would've been found."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So what exactly is going to happen? Is everything gonna be different?{w} What about our past selves? If the past was changed somewhere, I'm no longer the other Atsuki who's currently here.
entries.literal: "So what exactly is going to happen? Is everything gonna be different?{w} What about our past selves? If the past was changed somewhere, I'm no longer the other Atsuki who's currently here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to stay in the storeroom, merely hoping Shiroya would come. I had no desire to go back to the attic either; the Sekimeiya would clearly never aid us, and I didn't want anyone to slip into the storeroom while I wasn't present.
entries.literal: "I had to stay in the storeroom, merely hoping Shiroya would come. I had no desire to go back to the attic either; the Sekimeiya would clearly never aid us, and I didn't want anyone to slip into the storeroom while I wasn't present."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell is all of this!? When I finally found Shiroya, she suddenly disappeared! There's no way I'm going to spend twelve more hours here from the start, and I have no idea what the fuck is even going to happen! How did everything turn into this so quickly!?
entries.literal: "What the hell is all of this!? When I finally found Shiroya, she suddenly disappeared! There's no way I'm going to spend twelve more hours here from the start, and I have no idea what the fuck is even going to happen! How did everything turn into this so quickly!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a moment to recenter. Panicking wasn't going to get me anywhere.
entries.literal: "I took a moment to recenter. Panicking wasn't going to get me anywhere."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Didn't Shiroya say that she found the rusty key in a security room drawer? What if it was her who changed the past?
entries.literal: "...Didn't Shiroya say that she found the rusty key in a security room drawer? What if it was her who changed the past?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If she grabbed it days ago, it wouldn't be in hallway A now.{w} And if the world changed independent of her actions, could the key currently be in the security room? I can't try to find it before everyone wakes up because the alarm locked the room...
entries.literal: "If she grabbed it days ago, it wouldn't be in hallway A now.{w} And if the world changed independent of her actions, could the key currently be in the security room? I can't try to find it before everyone wakes up because the alarm locked the room..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The key was in the security room days ago... Katei was surely who dropped it, then.
entries.literal: "The key was in the security room days ago... Katei was surely who dropped it, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was earlier than I'd anticipated when sound came from the hallway.{w} From the lobby side, a group of people approached where I was.
entries.literal: "It was earlier than I'd anticipated when sound came from the hallway.{w} From the lobby side, a group of people approached where I was."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh...? Is that everyone?{w} This isn't what we did. We went to the security room the first time we stepped into this hallway.
entries.literal: "Huh...? Is that everyone?{w} This isn't what we did. We went to the security room the first time we stepped into this hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, the steps went to the crystal room in front of me.
entries.literal: "However, the steps went to the crystal room in front of me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's the room where the gemstones were stolen. Why did they go there without entering the security room first?
entries.literal: "That's the room where the gemstones were stolen. Why did they go there without entering the security room first?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From behind the wall, I was able to pick up a voice. It was Sai's, although I couldn't make out the words.
entries.literal: "From behind the wall, I was able to pick up a voice. It was Sai's, although I couldn't make out the words."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Do they know what happened there? Why, though? That's so strange.
entries.literal: "Do they know what happened there? Why, though? That's so strange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They left the room not long after and walked closer to the stairs.
entries.literal: "They left the room not long after and walked closer to the stairs."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's Katei talking, isn't it?
entries.literal: "That's Katei talking, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I focused as much as I could to understand what he was saying.
entries.literal: "I focused as much as I could to understand what he was saying."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...elevator won't move— ...arm disabled it.
entries.literal: "...elevator won't move— ...arm disabled it."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...Sorry, Isla, but there's no—
entries.literal: "...Sorry, Isla, but there's no—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell? This is entirely different from what we experienced.
entries.literal: "What the hell? This is entirely different from what we experienced."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone went up the stairs, leaving behind the bizarre silence.
entries.literal: "Everyone went up the stairs, leaving behind the bizarre silence."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They didn't even unlock the security room, so I can't go see if the key's there!
entries.literal: "They didn't even unlock the security room, so I can't go see if the key's there!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was evident there had been a change in history, but where? I hadn't willingly changed the past, so someone else must have... Why had it had such a particular effect on me, though? Did I possess memories of the past reality because I'd traveled from it...?
entries.literal: "It was evident there had been a change in history, but where? I hadn't willingly changed the past, so someone else must have... Why had it had such a particular effect on me, though? Did I possess memories of the past reality because I'd traveled from it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That didn't quite make sense, but I knew the answer wouldn't be simple regardless.
entries.literal: "That didn't quite make sense, but I knew the answer wouldn't be simple regardless."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is that it? Did a person alter reality, or is what happened something else...?
entries.literal: "...Is that it? Did a person alter reality, or is what happened something else...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But most importantly, what was I supposed to do? I had no idea. Nothing was guaranteed.
entries.literal: "But most importantly, what was I supposed to do? I had no idea. Nothing was guaranteed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If the past has already changed, no matter what I do, I'll have no direct relation to the Atsuki who just went up. ...That means my priority should be to find Shiroya, who's in the same position as me.{w} Where could she be? If she traveled through time and another deviation occurred, she might not exist in this world anymore.
entries.literal: "If the past has already changed, no matter what I do, I'll have no direct relation to the Atsuki who just went up. ...That means my priority should be to find Shiroya, who's in the same position as me.{w} Where could she be? If she traveled through time and another deviation occurred, she might not exist in this world anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Assuming that was actually the case, was finding her conceivable in the first place? I couldn't even know that, seeing as I was already neck-deep in the nonsensical.
entries.literal: "Assuming that was actually the case, was finding her conceivable in the first place? I couldn't even know that, seeing as I was already neck-deep in the nonsensical."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I didn't have to wait very long before I heard some of the others come back.
entries.literal: "Once again, I didn't have to wait very long before I heard some of the others come back."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Who's that? It's not everyone who went up.
entries.literal: "Who's that? It's not everyone who went up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Quietly, they walked past the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Quietly, they walked past the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Following them, another person came from the stairs, crossing in front of the storeroom.{w} A few seconds later, someone else did too, but they didn't enter hallway A.
entries.literal: "Following them, another person came from the stairs, crossing in front of the storeroom.{w} A few seconds later, someone else did too, but they didn't enter hallway A."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell is happening here...!? Why is everyone silently walking around on their own!?
entries.literal: "What the hell is happening here...!? Why is everyone silently walking around on their own!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At some point, someone briefly entered the storeroom and left without saying anything. After listening for a few minutes, everything occurred in reverse. Several footsteps went up the stairs in a small group. A bit later, I heard a single person going up, followed by another shortly after that.
entries.literal: "At some point, someone briefly entered the storeroom and left without saying anything. After listening for a few minutes, everything occurred in reverse. Several footsteps went up the stairs in a small group. A bit later, I heard a single person going up, followed by another shortly after that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}What the fuck just happened!? Is everyone gone again?
entries.literal: "...{w}What the fuck just happened!? Is everyone gone again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nothing else could be heard on the crystal floor, but I had no idea what any of those people had done or who they were.
entries.literal: "Nothing else could be heard on the crystal floor, but I had no idea what any of those people had done or who they were."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The silence continued for some time, and eventually, I was tempted to step out. Multiple people had walked toward the security room, but I didn't know if they'd entered it.
entries.literal: "The silence continued for some time, and eventually, I was tempted to step out. Multiple people had walked toward the security room, but I didn't know if they'd entered it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was one of them Katei? Nobody seems to be here, so I could go check if it's unlocked.
entries.literal: "Was one of them Katei? Nobody seems to be here, so I could go check if it's unlocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slipped out of the secret corridor and opened the way out just a crack.
entries.literal: "I slipped out of the secret corridor and opened the way out just a crack."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody was in hallway C.
entries.literal: "Nobody was in hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slowly moved the other way.
entries.literal: "I slowly moved the other way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I tried to open the security room, I found it to be unlocked.
entries.literal: "When I tried to open the security room, I found it to be unlocked."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh... all the screens are off.{w} It looks like the same thing that happened to us, where they all shut down at the same time. It seems it occurred again despite all the differences.
entries.literal: "Oh... all the screens are off.{w} It looks like the same thing that happened to us, where they all shut down at the same time. It seems it occurred again despite all the differences."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't waste time, so I hurried over to the drawers.
entries.literal: "I couldn't waste time, so I hurried over to the drawers."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I doubt it's still here.{w} What's most likely is that Katei has—
entries.literal: "I doubt it's still here.{w} What's most likely is that Katei has—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I cut myself off. The key was there, deep within a drawer.
entries.literal: "I cut myself off. The key was there, deep within a drawer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although I could no longer be certain that leaving the tower was what I had to do, I couldn't help but feel a brief thrill at the prospect.
entries.literal: "Although I could no longer be certain that leaving the tower was what I had to do, I couldn't help but feel a brief thrill at the prospect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was the universe going to allow it for once? Back in the storeroom, I pressed my hand against the hidden door, nearly out of breath.
entries.literal: "Was the universe going to allow it for once? Back in the storeroom, I pressed my hand against the hidden door, nearly out of breath."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The handle was there, and so was the keyhole. I inserted the key, which confirmed it was the right one.
entries.literal: "The handle was there, and so was the keyhole. I inserted the key, which confirmed it was the right one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Really? Is leaving this place simply not possible?
entries.literal: "...Really? Is leaving this place simply not possible?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't working. Although the key was the right one, it wasn't unlocking the door.
entries.literal: "It wasn't working. Although the key was the right one, it wasn't unlocking the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is absurd. What the fuck am I supposed to do!?{w} Do I wait half a day here, hoping Shiroya will just appear and the exit will open?{w} And then what? Two versions of us remain forever? ...This is insane! There has to be something we can do.
entries.literal: "This is absurd. What the fuck am I supposed to do!?{w} Do I wait half a day here, hoping Shiroya will just appear and the exit will open?{w} And then what? Two versions of us remain forever? ...This is insane! There has to be something we can do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I had the rusty key, so an old thought came back to me.
entries.literal: "...{w}I had the rusty key, so an old thought came back to me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Unless I go back to thinking about thought-up loops, I suppose. There could be something that would work.{w} The person who killed Katei took that rusty key and walked out of the tower through the storeroom door, which was open. That created a location outside the tower where they were holding the key that could be replicated. Then, they reentered and used the Sekimeiya to go back in time. In the past, they appeared outside the tower holding the key, so they were able to unlock the door and reenter with something they'd obtained outside—like a knife. They left the door open so that their past self could exit with the key and create the replicated location."
entries.literal: "\"Unless I go back to thinking about thought-up loops, I suppose. There could be something that would work.{w} The person who killed Katei took that rusty key and walked out of the tower through the storeroom door, which was open. That created a location outside the tower where they were holding the key that could be replicated. Then, they reentered and used the Sekimeiya to go back in time. In the past, they appeared outside the tower holding the key, so they were able to unlock the door and reenter with something they'd obtained outside—like a knife. They left the door open so that their past self could exit with the key and create the replicated location.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could I pull off something like that, after all?
entries.literal: "Could I pull off something like that, after all?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I still have no idea how the replicated location works, but I could try it. I'll step out and spend a long time outside holding the key. After that, I'll come back in and travel to the past as many times as needed to appear outside holding the key so that I can unlock the door and let my past self out. I can't really construct it in a cleaner way.
entries.literal: "I still have no idea how the replicated location works, but I could try it. I'll step out and spend a long time outside holding the key. After that, I'll come back in and travel to the past as many times as needed to appear outside holding the key so that I can unlock the door and let my past self out. I can't really construct it in a cleaner way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped out of the secret area so that another self of mine could unlock the door without alerting me. My knocks from before would be their cue to do it.
entries.literal: "I stepped out of the secret area so that another self of mine could unlock the door without alerting me. My knocks from before would be their cue to do it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Great. I'm just gonna be here all my life.
entries.literal: "Great. I'm just gonna be here all my life."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew that feeling all too well. My plan had failed, but I couldn't know why. For all I knew, it was viable, but if the police or civilians were observing the surroundings of the tower, that was one of countless ways it would be blocked. It was possible I wouldn't have been able to unlock the door from outside either.
entries.literal: "I knew that feeling all too well. My plan had failed, but I couldn't know why. For all I knew, it was viable, but if the police or civilians were observing the surroundings of the tower, that was one of countless ways it would be blocked. It was possible I wouldn't have been able to unlock the door from outside either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat down, defeated.
entries.literal: "I sat down, defeated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stayed on the cold floor, waiting for the door to open. It seemed the last hope that remained entailed being able to leave at {time=21.}{w} Was that going to happen, or was I going to wait another twelve hours just to be faked out again?
entries.literal: "I stayed on the cold floor, waiting for the door to open. It seemed the last hope that remained entailed being able to leave at {time=21.}{w} Was that going to happen, or was I going to wait another twelve hours just to be faked out again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And would the secret door ever open? Would I ever see the Shiroya I'd just been with again?
entries.literal: "...And would the secret door ever open? Would I ever see the Shiroya I'd just been with again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't bother thinking; there was nothing else I felt compelled to solve, as the march of time alone would decide everything. Soon after I rested my jaw on my knees, I heard people returning to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "I didn't bother thinking; there was nothing else I felt compelled to solve, as the march of time alone would decide everything. Soon after I rested my jaw on my knees, I heard people returning to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew everyone was outside, but I didn't want to show myself. If I had to wait all day again, I would do it peacefully—alone.
entries.literal: "I knew everyone was outside, but I didn't want to show myself. If I had to wait all day again, I would do it peacefully—alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I stashed the key in my pocket, I noticed something else: another key had disappeared. ...The one that opened the locker that wasn't Naomi's.{w} When had it disappeared? I had only just realized it, but it was a result of one of my last two travels.
entries.literal: "When I stashed the key in my pocket, I noticed something else: another key had disappeared. ...The one that opened the locker that wasn't Naomi's.{w} When had it disappeared? I had only just realized it, but it was a result of one of my last two travels."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard faint voices sporadically, but I had no real idea of what was happening in the building. Once some time had passed, only occasional footsteps met my ears.
entries.literal: "I heard faint voices sporadically, but I had no real idea of what was happening in the building. Once some time had passed, only occasional footsteps met my ears."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My body began to feel noticeably chilled, so I tried to cover myself well. Shiroya wasn't coming—that was very clear. ...Was Naomi present, though? I hadn't heard anything regarding her.
entries.literal: "My body began to feel noticeably chilled, so I tried to cover myself well. Shiroya wasn't coming—that was very clear. ...Was Naomi present, though? I hadn't heard anything regarding her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}What about the Sekimeiya? During the prolonged silence, I considered trying to find it. Assuming two existed, obtaining a single one wasn't too hard. Nobody knew about the hidden section I was in, so I could conceal it there.
entries.literal: "...{w}What about the Sekimeiya? During the prolonged silence, I considered trying to find it. Assuming two existed, obtaining a single one wasn't too hard. Nobody knew about the hidden section I was in, so I could conceal it there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I knew that would only complicate things further. Escaping the building by touching the Sekimeiya couldn't be possible; when that was supposed to occur, the Sekimeiya vanished instead.{w} What the hell had happened at that time? Why had the cabinet's state reverted? Without a thorough understanding of the Sekimeiya's powers, I couldn't begin to use it.
entries.literal: "But I knew that would only complicate things further. Escaping the building by touching the Sekimeiya couldn't be possible; when that was supposed to occur, the Sekimeiya vanished instead.{w} What the hell had happened at that time? Why had the cabinet's state reverted? Without a thorough understanding of the Sekimeiya's powers, I couldn't begin to use it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: So I stayed there, ignorant to the actual time.{w} ...However, I could tell that a few hours had passed.
entries.literal: "So I stayed there, ignorant to the actual time.{w} ...However, I could tell that a few hours had passed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had been a while since I'd heard anyone's voice. Only individual steps had crossed the hallway here and there.
entries.literal: "It had been a while since I'd heard anyone's voice. Only individual steps had crossed the hallway here and there."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Hey! ...the fuck...! Where have you—
entries.literal: "Hey! ...the fuck...! Where have you—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the door. It was Sai's voice, which I hadn't heard in a long time.
entries.literal: "I looked at the door. It was Sai's voice, which I hadn't heard in a long time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no immediate response that I could hear, but I remained attentive. Had Sai seen someone who hadn't been there for a long time? My mind immediately went to Naomi.
entries.literal: "There was no immediate response that I could hear, but I remained attentive. Had Sai seen someone who hadn't been there for a long time? My mind immediately went to Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't able to properly distinguish anything else, but I could at least tell that a group was in the hallway. I'd only understood Sai due to his volume.
entries.literal: "I wasn't able to properly distinguish anything else, but I could at least tell that a group was in the hallway. I'd only understood Sai due to his volume."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few minutes later, even those faint signs of life faded out.
entries.literal: "A few minutes later, even those faint signs of life faded out."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Are they not there anymore...?
entries.literal: "Are they not there anymore...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't seem so. Leaning against the wall, I attempted to think about nothing.
entries.literal: "It didn't seem so. Leaning against the wall, I attempted to think about nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Minutes later, a couple sets of footsteps approached from the far end of the hallway. As always, my eyes instinctively turned to the door.
entries.literal: "Minutes later, a couple sets of footsteps approached from the far end of the hallway. As always, my eyes instinctively turned to the door."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: It's certainly po— ...on this floor. Don't move fro—
entries.literal: "It's certainly po— ...on this floor. Don't move fro—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Was that me?
entries.literal: "...Was that me?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...Okay.
entries.literal: "...Okay."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}What?

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That voice...
entries.literal: "That voice..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was that Miiya...? ...I must be mistaken.
entries.literal: "Was that Miiya...? ...I must be mistaken."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, the storeroom door opened, and I had to fight to contain my panic.{w} It appeared my past self was looking for something, as he quickly moved on to the next crystal room.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, the storeroom door opened, and I had to fight to contain my panic.{w} It appeared my past self was looking for something, as he quickly moved on to the next crystal room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was her, wasn't it...? It was only one word, but wasn't that her voice...?
entries.literal: "It was her, wasn't it...? It was only one word, but wasn't that her voice...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While it seemed impossible, her existence in the tower had been mentioned before. Erina, Sai, and Akaro had all claimed to have seen her.
entries.literal: "While it seemed impossible, her existence in the tower had been mentioned before. Erina, Sai, and Akaro had all claimed to have seen her."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is she there, on the other side of the door?
entries.literal: "Is she there, on the other side of the door?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Multiple people emerged from the lobby side and stopped in hallway C. Meanwhile, I could hear doors being opened.
entries.literal: "Multiple people emerged from the lobby side and stopped in hallway C. Meanwhile, I could hear doors being opened."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...you hear that?
entries.literal: "...you hear that?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: No?
entries.literal: "No?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What are they doing? Searching for the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "What are they doing? Searching for the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Stay the—{w=0.4} ...look at the mechani—
entries.literal: "Stay the—{w=0.4} ...look at the mechani—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That was my voice again.
entries.literal: "That was my voice again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I think they moved over to hallway B.
entries.literal: "I think they moved over to hallway B."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...right. Let's go.
entries.literal: "...right. Let's go."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And now they're going up.
entries.literal: "And now they're going up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I emerged from the hidden area so that I could hear a little bit better. It seemed everyone was walking up the stairs.{w} Had I actually heard Miiya? If she was there, I had to see her.
entries.literal: "I emerged from the hidden area so that I could hear a little bit better. It seemed everyone was walking up the stairs.{w} Had I actually heard Miiya? If she was there, I had to see her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed the secret wall. I assumed everyone's backs were facing me, so I peeked out from behind the door. If Miiya was with them, I didn't mind being seen, but half of me thought my mind had played a trick on me.
entries.literal: "I closed the secret wall. I assumed everyone's backs were facing me, so I peeked out from behind the door. If Miiya was with them, I didn't mind being seen, but half of me thought my mind had played a trick on me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Most of them had turned past the gray door; I could only see Sai's legs slowly disappearing.
entries.literal: "Most of them had turned past the gray door; I could only see Sai's legs slowly disappearing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached the stairs, hoping I could watch them from a distance. However, all of a sudden, Sai stopped.
entries.literal: "I approached the stairs, hoping I could watch them from a distance. However, all of a sudden, Sai stopped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had he heard me? I stepped aside reflexively.
entries.literal: "Had he heard me? I stepped aside reflexively."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...What's up?
entries.literal: "...What's up?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Akaro, why is that door open?
entries.literal: "Akaro, why is that door open?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Shit. They noticed me.
entries.literal: "Shit. They noticed me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As their suspicion grew, I stepped back several times. By the time they came back down, I was in hallway B.
entries.literal: "As their suspicion grew, I stepped back several times. By the time they came back down, I was in hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Akaro approached the storeroom and were followed by Katei, Erina, and Isla.
entries.literal: "Sai and Akaro approached the storeroom and were followed by Katei, Erina, and Isla."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What about Miiya? Is she not here?{w} My past self isn't either...
entries.literal: "...What about Miiya? Is she not here?{w} My past self isn't either..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see what was happening from where I was, but suddenly, I heard gasps.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see what was happening from where I was, but suddenly, I heard gasps."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got closer and shut my eyes in regret when I saw what they were looking at. They had found the secret corridor.
entries.literal: "I got closer and shut my eyes in regret when I saw what they were looking at. They had found the secret corridor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the fuck do I do now...? There's nowhere else to hide.
entries.literal: "What the fuck do I do now...? There's nowhere else to hide."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked around in desperation. I could never hide in a bathroom, as Katei would unlock it.{w} I saw the elevator was open; it was working, and the others had definitely been in the process of searching the whole building.
entries.literal: "I looked around in desperation. I could never hide in a bathroom, as Katei would unlock it.{w} I saw the elevator was open; it was working, and the others had definitely been in the process of searching the whole building."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did I really mishear that? Was that not Miiya...?{w} Where is my other self, then? What about the past Shiroya? She isn't here either.
entries.literal: "Did I really mishear that? Was that not Miiya...?{w} Where is my other self, then? What about the past Shiroya? She isn't here either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to the event room, an easy bridge between the hallways.
entries.literal: "I moved to the event room, an easy bridge between the hallways."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just to check, I uncovered the curtain. The Sekimeiya wasn't there.
entries.literal: "Just to check, I uncovered the curtain. The Sekimeiya wasn't there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not gonna spend hours trying to hide from everyone. If I'm discovered, I'll explain what happened to me.
entries.literal: "I'm not gonna spend hours trying to hide from everyone. If I'm discovered, I'll explain what happened to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At least a few of them were still in the storeroom, discussing what they'd found. Some minutes later, I was surprised by the sound of someone walking through hallway A.
entries.literal: "At least a few of them were still in the storeroom, discussing what they'd found. Some minutes later, I was surprised by the sound of someone walking through hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was strange was that they'd come from the lobby side. They'd come out of a crystal room to my left.
entries.literal: "What was strange was that they'd come from the lobby side. They'd come out of a crystal room to my left."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was someone in there...?
entries.literal: "Was someone in there...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whoever it was had walked to the storeroom, but all the voices I could make out were too muffled.
entries.literal: "Whoever it was had walked to the storeroom, but all the voices I could make out were too muffled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, I stopped sensing people in the hallway.
entries.literal: "Eventually, I stopped sensing people in the hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did they go anywhere?
entries.literal: "...Did they go anywhere?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just in case, I left through the other side.
entries.literal: "Just in case, I left through the other side."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Yeah, they're not there anymore.{w} Where did they go? There's no way they opened the door out, is there?
entries.literal: "Yeah, they're not there anymore.{w} Where did they go? There's no way they opened the door out, is there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They hadn't. It was still locked.
entries.literal: "They hadn't. It was still locked."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe they continued going up...?
entries.literal: "Maybe they continued going up...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the crystal rooms in hallway A. There was only one farther ahead on the same wall as the event room: A1.
entries.literal: "I stared at the crystal rooms in hallway A. There was only one farther ahead on the same wall as the event room: A1."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That person... Did they come out of here?
entries.literal: "That person... Did they come out of here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a little strange. After all, I knew the floor had just been inspected, and since the others had been about to go up, it was likely they hadn't found whatever they'd been searching for.
entries.literal: "It was a little strange. After all, I knew the floor had just been inspected, and since the others had been about to go up, it was likely they hadn't found whatever they'd been searching for."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't heard anyone entering the room, so if someone had left it, they had definitely done so after spending a while inside. That was what I found odd.
entries.literal: "I hadn't heard anyone entering the room, so if someone had left it, they had definitely done so after spending a while inside. That was what I found odd."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The curtains were raised, showing that the cabinets had recently been looked into. Curious, I went ahead and opened them.
entries.literal: "The curtains were raised, showing that the cabinets had recently been looked into. Curious, I went ahead and opened them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was surprised to find out my suspicion had been on the mark. A Sekimeiya was inside one of the cabinets.
entries.literal: "I was surprised to find out my suspicion had been on the mark. A Sekimeiya was inside one of the cabinets."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell...? So someone managed to hide it despite the search.
entries.literal: "What the hell...? So someone managed to hide it despite the search."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew an identical gemstone existed, so I went through the remaining cabinets until I was confident that it was the only Sekimeiya in the room.
entries.literal: "I knew an identical gemstone existed, so I went through the remaining cabinets until I was confident that it was the only Sekimeiya in the room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Should I take it? Now that I can't stay in the storeroom, it might be useful to keep it.
entries.literal: "...Should I take it? Now that I can't stay in the storeroom, it might be useful to keep it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unsure, I reached in to grab it, and as I took it out, I was reminded of an unexplained problem.
entries.literal: "Unsure, I reached in to grab it, and as I took it out, I was reminded of an unexplained problem."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It's not hot at all.{w} That means it's not currently working, but it should be.
entries.literal: "...It's not hot at all.{w} That means it's not currently working, but it should be."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is what happened sometimes. The Sekimeiya remained cold outside the cabinet, and touching it didn't do anything.
entries.literal: "This is what happened sometimes. The Sekimeiya remained cold outside the cabinet, and touching it didn't do anything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm... Could it be that out of the two Sekimeiya, only one works?
entries.literal: "Hm... Could it be that out of the two Sekimeiya, only one works?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That sounded like a plausible idea, but it was denied by the time a Sekimeiya had appeared inactive in Sai's hip pack.{w} It was useless, and I didn't want to give myself another headache trying to resolve it. I put it back where I'd found it.
entries.literal: "That sounded like a plausible idea, but it was denied by the time a Sekimeiya had appeared inactive in Sai's hip pack.{w} It was useless, and I didn't want to give myself another headache trying to resolve it. I put it back where I'd found it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wonder who hid it here, though.
entries.literal: "I wonder who hid it here, though."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where do I even go?
entries.literal: "Where do I even go?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The tower was being inspected, so I figured the least likely places to be revisited were the bathrooms on floor 2.
entries.literal: "The tower was being inspected, so I figured the least likely places to be revisited were the bathrooms on floor 2."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shut myself inside one.
entries.literal: "I shut myself inside one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'll definitely be found eventually no matter where I stay.
entries.literal: "I'll definitely be found eventually no matter where I stay."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was that voice really Miiya's? I need to know that.{w} It couldn't have been anyone else. If it wasn't my imagination, it was the real Miiya.
entries.literal: "Was that voice really Miiya's? I need to know that.{w} It couldn't have been anyone else. If it wasn't my imagination, it was the real Miiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea why she would be there, but if she was, that was the biggest question of them all.
entries.literal: "I had no idea why she would be there, but if she was, that was the biggest question of them all."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's likely they'll all come back down. If she's here, I'll be able to see her.{w} She wasn't with the others in the storeroom, though. My past self and Shiroya were missing too...
entries.literal: "It's likely they'll all come back down. If she's here, I'll be able to see her.{w} She wasn't with the others in the storeroom, though. My past self and Shiroya were missing too..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They haven't come back yet. I have to assume they have access to the attic.
entries.literal: "They haven't come back yet. I have to assume they have access to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I decided that if nobody came after a while, I would quietly go up to see if I could find everyone.{w} But soon after that resolution, I thought I might've heard someone just outside the bathroom, separated from the rest.
entries.literal: "I decided that if nobody came after a while, I would quietly go up to see if I could find everyone.{w} But soon after that resolution, I thought I might've heard someone just outside the bathroom, separated from the rest."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did someone go to the crystal floor?
entries.literal: "Did someone go to the crystal floor?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went out and walked halfway down the stairs.
entries.literal: "I went out and walked halfway down the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through the gray door, I saw Sai in hallway A, going from room to room.
entries.literal: "Through the gray door, I saw Sai in hallway A, going from room to room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell is he doing now?{w} And what the hell is everyone else doing, letting him roam around freely?
entries.literal: "What the hell is he doing now?{w} And what the hell is everyone else doing, letting him roam around freely?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was he the person who came out of that crystal room? If he traveled through time, he could've been there and in the storeroom at the same time.{w} But everyone had to see that person when they left A1. They would've reacted at seeing two of one person, and I guess it would've been a paradox...
entries.literal: "Was he the person who came out of that crystal room? If he traveled through time, he could've been there and in the storeroom at the same time.{w} But everyone had to see that person when they left A1. They would've reacted at seeing two of one person, and I guess it would've been a paradox..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is strange. He's likely searching for the Sekimeiya, which means he didn't hide it in that cabinet. However, a search just happened, so why is he doing this? Does he not trust the results?
entries.literal: "This is strange. He's likely searching for the Sekimeiya, which means he didn't hide it in that cabinet. However, a search just happened, so why is he doing this? Does he not trust the results?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I guess that's not all. There must be another Sekimeiya somewhere...
entries.literal: "I guess that's not all. There must be another Sekimeiya somewhere..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped away. I could still hear him moving downstairs, but the others were my concern.
entries.literal: "I stepped away. I could still hear him moving downstairs, but the others were my concern."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept waiting in the bathroom.
entries.literal: "I kept waiting in the bathroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If Sai sneaked away, they'll notice it pretty quickly. He probably came down to search for himself, and he might find the Sekimeiya I saw.
entries.literal: "If Sai sneaked away, they'll notice it pretty quickly. He probably came down to search for himself, and he might find the Sekimeiya I saw."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wonder what he'll do if he actually does. It wasn't working, so he won't be able to activate it.
entries.literal: "I wonder what he'll do if he actually does. It wasn't working, so he won't be able to activate it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound of his movements no longer reached me. Bemused by the fact that I could still be patient, I waited for something to happen.
entries.literal: "The sound of his movements no longer reached me. Bemused by the fact that I could still be patient, I waited for something to happen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't know what Sai's intentions could be. Surely he still has to learn everything about the Sekimeiya, but what is his ultimate goal? ...He was trying to achieve something all day, and I have no idea what.
entries.literal: "I don't know what Sai's intentions could be. Surely he still has to learn everything about the Sekimeiya, but what is his ultimate goal? ...He was trying to achieve something all day, and I have no idea what."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that someone above me...?
entries.literal: "Is that someone above me...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For a second, I could discern footsteps coming from the ceiling.
entries.literal: "For a second, I could discern footsteps coming from the ceiling."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it the others...?
entries.literal: "Is it the others...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound grew clearer: a group of people was coming down.{w} Once they went down the stairs, I slowly opened the door.
entries.literal: "The sound grew clearer: a group of people was coming down.{w} Once they went down the stairs, I slowly opened the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see anyone in hallway A.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see anyone in hallway A."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They're not in hallway C either?
entries.literal: "They're not in hallway C either?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...any of the—{w} Can you he—
entries.literal: "...any of the—{w} Can you he—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro's voice came from hallway B. From the stairs, I didn't have a good angle to observe.
entries.literal: "Akaro's voice came from hallway B. From the stairs, I didn't have a good angle to observe."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I chose not to step down. If I was more patient, I would see them from afar without showing myself.
entries.literal: "I chose not to step down. If I was more patient, I would see them from afar without showing myself."

entries.speaker: k4
entries.text: the hell...! ...seriously burning!
entries.literal: "the hell...! ...seriously burning!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, did Katei find a Sekimeiya in hallway B?
entries.literal: "Wait, did Katei find a Sekimeiya in hallway B?"

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: ...it there?
entries.literal: "...it there?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And that's me. My past self is with them this time.{w} ...Where the hell is Sai, though?
entries.literal: "And that's me. My past self is with them this time.{w} ...Where the hell is Sai, though?"

entries.speaker: k4
entries.text: I have no clue!
entries.literal: "I have no clue!"

entries.speaker: a4
entries.text: ...either.
entries.literal: "...either."

entries.speaker: k4
entries.text: ...eed to leave this—
entries.literal: "...eed to leave this—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They're walking away.
entries.literal: "They're walking away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sound of their footsteps was fading, when all of a sudden, a sharp sound split the air.
entries.literal: "The sound of their footsteps was fading, when all of a sudden, a sharp sound split the air."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What was that...? It came from hallway B too.
entries.literal: "What was that...? It came from hallway B too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't hear the others anymore. After waiting a bit behind the door, I stepped down cautiously.
entries.literal: "I couldn't hear the others anymore. After waiting a bit behind the door, I stepped down cautiously."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It sounded like something fell to the floor...
entries.literal: "It sounded like something fell to the floor..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It didn't seem like anyone was still there. After that sound, the crystal floor's characteristic silence had arisen.
entries.literal: "It didn't seem like anyone was still there. After that sound, the crystal floor's characteristic silence had arisen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Keeping myself hidden, I peeked into hallway B.{w} Nobody was there, but I saw what had hit the floor next to the event room.
entries.literal: "Keeping myself hidden, I peeked into hallway B.{w} Nobody was there, but I saw what had hit the floor next to the event room."

entries.text: Snowmelt
entries.literal: "Snowmelt"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It was a Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What just happened? Did they touch it, so it fell when they disappeared?
entries.literal: "...What just happened? Did they touch it, so it fell when they disappeared?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That doesn't make sense, though...
entries.literal: "That doesn't make sense, though..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...They wouldn't necessarily have come back here. Especially since they could've traveled to the future.
entries.literal: "...They wouldn't necessarily have come back here. Especially since they could've traveled to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was strange was its color. It was white, and if they'd touched it, it would've been gray.
entries.literal: "What was strange was its color. It was white, and if they'd touched it, it would've been gray."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even though the Sekimeiya didn't work for me earlier, it could've been working now. It could also be another Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Even though the Sekimeiya didn't work for me earlier, it could've been working now. It could also be another Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was strange was its color. It was white, and if they'd touched it, it would've been gray.
entries.literal: "What was strange was its color. It was white, and if they'd touched it, it would've been gray."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Its color... It's white.{w} If they had touched it, it would be gray.
entries.literal: "Its color... It's white.{w} If they had touched it, it would be gray."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Would it have teleported if they'd activated it? Not necessarily; it didn't when Sai and Shiroya traveled from the event room.
entries.literal: "...Would it have teleported if they'd activated it? Not necessarily; it didn't when Sai and Shiroya traveled from the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was strange was its color. It was white, and if they'd touched it, it would've been gray.
entries.literal: "What was strange was its color. It was white, and if they'd touched it, it would've been gray."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached it while scanning the area around me. Then, I felt it through my sleeve.
entries.literal: "I approached it while scanning the area around me. Then, I felt it through my sleeve."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Damn, it's super hot, just like Katei said. There's no way they activated it.
entries.literal: "Damn, it's super hot, just like Katei said. There's no way they activated it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They had to have been going to the event room, so I opened its door.
entries.literal: "They had to have been going to the event room, so I opened its door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I did, I hit something on the other side.
entries.literal: "When I did, I hit something on the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was another Sekimeiya. However, it was powered off.
entries.literal: "It was another Sekimeiya. However, it was powered off."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, what?
entries.literal: "Oh, what?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What happened? They touched this one instead?{w} Hang on, is this the one I found in the cabinet? If it's not working now, that means it was previously working.
entries.literal: "...What happened? They touched this one instead?{w} Hang on, is this the one I found in the cabinet? If it's not working now, that means it was previously working."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The empty cabinet was uncovered...
entries.literal: "The empty cabinet was uncovered..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to room A1.
entries.literal: "I went to room A1."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Inside the same cabinet from before, a third Sekimeiya rested.
entries.literal: "Inside the same cabinet from before, a third Sekimeiya rested."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell...? There are three of them?
entries.literal: "What the hell...? There are three of them?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt it through my sleeve as well. As I'd expected, it was cold.
entries.literal: "I felt it through my sleeve as well. As I'd expected, it was cold."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So this one doesn't work?
entries.literal: "So this one doesn't work?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Frowning, I went back to the event room. Two functional Sekimeiya were on the floor, close to each other.
entries.literal: "Frowning, I went back to the event room. Two functional Sekimeiya were on the floor, close to each other."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A vague idea had formed in my head during the hours I'd been waiting.
entries.literal: "A vague idea had formed in my head during the hours I'd been waiting."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was I... right?
entries.literal: "Was I... right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Where was everyone? If they had traveled through time, where were they?
entries.literal: "Where was everyone? If they had traveled through time, where were they?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, I have to see if I can find them. This is critical.
entries.literal: "Wait, I have to see if I can find them. This is critical."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Focused on my thoughts, I walked through the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Focused on my thoughts, I walked through the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki suspected that perhaps...
entries.literal: "Atsuki suspected that perhaps..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is nobody here? ...What about Sai? Did he disappear with everyone else?
entries.literal: "Is nobody here? ...What about Sai? Did he disappear with everyone else?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to look above too, so I grabbed both functional Sekimeiya and went up the stairs.
entries.literal: "I had to look above too, so I grabbed both functional Sekimeiya and went up the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached the attic and saw that the door was open. However, the key wasn't in the keyhole.
entries.literal: "I reached the attic and saw that the door was open. However, the key wasn't in the keyhole."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Recent footprints were in the living room, but I couldn't hear anyone moving around.
entries.literal: "Recent footprints were in the living room, but I couldn't hear anyone moving around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked in the kitchen, the bathroom, the storeroom, both bedrooms... They were all empty.
entries.literal: "I looked in the kitchen, the bathroom, the storeroom, both bedrooms... They were all empty."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I... don't think the people who were in hallway B are currently here.
entries.literal: "I... don't think the people who were in hallway B are currently here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat on the sofa. The Sekimeiya I'd seen weren't there anymore, likely because they were the same ones I was holding.
