entries.literal: "I sat on the sofa. The Sekimeiya I'd seen weren't there anymore, likely because they were the same ones I was holding."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This world... it's clearly not the one I started in. Many things are happening differently.
entries.literal: "This world... it's clearly not the one I started in. Many things are happening differently."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I thought that maybe the past changed at some point. This would've led into the countless deviations I've noticed.{w} ...But there's something about this world that I recognize.
entries.literal: "I thought that maybe the past changed at some point. This would've led into the countless deviations I've noticed.{w} ...But there's something about this world that I recognize."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And, if I'm really recognizing something from this world, there's no way it was created after the first time I visited it.
entries.literal: "And, if I'm really recognizing something from this world, there's no way it was created after the first time I visited it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What Atsuki recognized from this world was...
entries.literal: "What Atsuki recognized from this world was..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Not the storeroom handle; he never saw it before his appearance in this world.
entries.literal: "Not the storeroom handle; he never saw it before his appearance in this world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What I recognized from that world was Miiya's existence.
entries.literal: "What I recognized from that world was Miiya's existence."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even though I haven't been able to see her, what I heard was her voice. I can't doubt that.{w} When that happened, everyone was there. In other words, Miiya's existence wasn't something anyone found strange—not even my past self.
entries.literal: "Even though I haven't been able to see her, what I heard was her voice. I can't doubt that.{w} When that happened, everyone was there. In other words, Miiya's existence wasn't something anyone found strange—not even my past self."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: A while ago, Erina claimed she saw Miiya, but her reaction to that was appropriate. She said she didn't think Miiya had been in the tower before.
entries.literal: "A while ago, Erina claimed she saw Miiya, but her reaction to that was appropriate. She said she didn't think Miiya had been in the tower before."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, the same thing didn't occur shortly after that.
entries.literal: "However, the same thing didn't occur shortly after that."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course, I'm assuming Miiya's in on it as well.
entries.literal: "Of course, I'm assuming Miiya's in on it as well."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Not gonna keep trying to clear your name? I suppose it'd be futile with how obvious it is that this is your doing.
entries.literal: "Not gonna keep trying to clear your name? I suppose it'd be futile with how obvious it is that this is your doing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Okay, I'll ask. How do you know about Miiya?
entries.literal: "...Okay, I'll ask. How do you know about Miiya?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What? She's been here—
entries.literal: "What? She's been here—"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's it, ignore him from now on. He can't get out of the corner he's backed himself into.
entries.literal: "That's it, ignore him from now on. He can't get out of the corner he's backed himself into."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Sai and Akaro acted as if Miiya's existence was normal.{w} And that's not all. Akaro disappeared after that point, and when he appeared with different clothes after {time=21}, he said he hadn't been present at the last time I'd seen him.
entries.literal: "Sai and Akaro acted as if Miiya's existence was normal.{w} And that's not all. Akaro disappeared after that point, and when he appeared with different clothes after {time=21}, he said he hadn't been present at the last time I'd seen him."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In addition, Sai's attitude at that time was different from how he behaved afterward.
entries.literal: "In addition, Sai's attitude at that time was different from how he behaved afterward."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, when did that happen? When did Miiya's existence become normal for the world?
entries.literal: "So, when did that happen? When did Miiya's existence become normal for the world?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When that happened, he and Shiroya appeared in the attic. At that point, though, Miiya's existence wasn't yet normal.
entries.literal: "When that happened, he and Shiroya appeared in the attic. At that point, though, Miiya's existence wasn't yet normal."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When that happened, he appeared in the event room. At that point, though, Miiya's existence wasn't yet normal.
entries.literal: "When that happened, he appeared in the event room. At that point, though, Miiya's existence wasn't yet normal."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Erina, Sai, Shiroya, and I were in the event room. At that point, everyone was surprised to hear Erina mention Miiya.
entries.literal: "Erina, Sai, Shiroya, and I were in the event room. At that point, everyone was surprised to hear Erina mention Miiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When Erina touched the Sekimeiya, that changed. Both Sai and Akaro, who came from outside the room, found Miiya's existence to be an expected thing.
entries.literal: "When Erina touched the Sekimeiya, that changed. Both Sai and Akaro, who came from outside the room, found Miiya's existence to be an expected thing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Once again, that's not all. There was another major change.
entries.literal: "Once again, that's not all. There was another major change."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was Shiroya's existence. Sai and Akaro were shocked when they saw her, and perfectly in line with that, I haven't seen her here.
entries.literal: "It was Shiroya's existence. Sai and Akaro were shocked when they saw her, and perfectly in line with that, I haven't seen her here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...When Erina touched the Sekimeiya, something major occurred. I'm sure of that. The Sekimeiya had some hidden effect all this time.
entries.literal: "...When Erina touched the Sekimeiya, something major occurred. I'm sure of that. The Sekimeiya had some hidden effect all this time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That effect occurred when Erina touched it. That was definitely the strangest travel of them all.
entries.literal: "That effect occurred when Erina touched it. That was definitely the strangest travel of them all."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Three major questions arose: why did Erina, Shiroya, and I not travel, but Sai did?{w} Why did the Sekimeiya teleport instantly back to its cabinet?{w} Why was the range bigger than it should've been?
entries.literal: "Three major questions arose: why did Erina, Shiroya, and I not travel, but Sai did?{w} Why did the Sekimeiya teleport instantly back to its cabinet?{w} Why was the range bigger than it should've been?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now I'm aware of a factor that I didn't consider at the time, which could be the answer to what happened.
entries.literal: "Now I'm aware of a factor that I didn't consider at the time, which could be the answer to what happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't believe Miiya's existence is the answer to those questions.
entries.literal: "I don't believe Miiya's existence is the answer to those questions."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It must be the second Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It must be the second Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't believe traveling to the future is the answer to those questions.
entries.literal: "I don't believe traveling to the future is the answer to those questions."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It must be the second Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It must be the second Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The second Sekimeiya...
entries.literal: "The second Sekimeiya..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Before Erina touched the Sekimeiya, when we entered the event room, Shiroya and I were confused to see the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.{w} In my case, it was because I'd recently hidden it.{w} ...Specifically, in a locker in the staff room.
entries.literal: "Before Erina touched the Sekimeiya, when we entered the event room, Shiroya and I were confused to see the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.{w} In my case, it was because I'd recently hidden it.{w} ...Specifically, in a locker in the staff room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When I saw it in the cabinet, I thought it must've teleported to its "original place", or where the cold temperature was.{w} The reality was...
entries.literal: "When I saw it in the cabinet, I thought it must've teleported to its \"original place\", or where the cold temperature was.{w} The reality was..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That's not it.
entries.literal: "That's not it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I don't think it was the same Sekimeiya. However, the one I hid in the staff room was working, and the one in the cabinet, which Erina touched, was working as well.
entries.literal: "...I don't think it was the same Sekimeiya. However, the one I hid in the staff room was working, and the one in the cabinet, which Erina touched, was working as well."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, I think that what I believe to be the main key to most of those questions is...
entries.literal: "So, I think that what I believe to be the main key to most of those questions is..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Erina touched the Sekimeiya, but that shouldn't matter.
entries.literal: "Erina touched the Sekimeiya, but that shouldn't matter."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The answer might be the location of both Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "The answer might be the location of both Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not sure the Sekimeiya that was activated was the reason.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure the Sekimeiya that was activated was the reason."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The answer might be the location of both Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "The answer might be the location of both Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The location of the Sekimeiya... One was near the cabinet, and the other was in a locker.
entries.literal: "The location of the Sekimeiya... One was near the cabinet, and the other was in a locker."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How many people were in range? ...Actually, I don't think that has any relevance after all.
entries.literal: "How many people were in range? ...Actually, I don't think that has any relevance after all."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The answer might be the position of both Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "The answer might be the position of both Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The one in the event room spent fifteen minutes outside the cabinet. Meanwhile, as I had touched the one in the staff room at around {time=18:30}, it should've gathered power there for almost half an hour.
entries.literal: "The one in the event room spent fifteen minutes outside the cabinet. Meanwhile, as I had touched the one in the staff room at around {time=18:30}, it should've gathered power there for almost half an hour."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The range of the Sekimeiya Erina touched probably looked like this.{w} However, the hidden factor that I didn't account for...
entries.literal: "The range of the Sekimeiya Erina touched probably looked like this.{w} However, the hidden factor that I didn't account for..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Was the Sekimeiya in the staff room.{w} It was in the rightmost set of lockers, and given the time it had been there, I imagine its range extended halfway through the event room.
entries.literal: "...Was the Sekimeiya in the staff room.{w} It was in the rightmost set of lockers, and given the time it had been there, I imagine its range extended halfway through the event room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}If this is what was special about that travel, then what happened to us?{w} Sai did travel because he was only within range of Erina's Sekimeiya. However, the rest of us didn't teleport through space or time.
entries.literal: "...{w}If this is what was special about that travel, then what happened to us?{w} Sai did travel because he was only within range of Erina's Sekimeiya. However, the rest of us didn't teleport through space or time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Instead, what changed was the world around us.{w} The Sekimeiya didn't teleport back to the cabinet—that was a mere illusion.
entries.literal: "Instead, what changed was the world around us.{w} The Sekimeiya didn't teleport back to the cabinet—that was a mere illusion."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, I quickly went to check the locker and found out the Sekimeiya I'd hidden there was gone. That only contributed to the same illusion.
entries.literal: "Then, I quickly went to check the locker and found out the Sekimeiya I'd hidden there was gone. That only contributed to the same illusion."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I might be mistaken somewhere, but I don't think that was still the same world.{w} However, what happened later? We did reunite with the Sai who'd traveled in the event room, didn't we?{w} Similarly, Akaro and the other Sai weren't found again. It was as if we'd gone back to our world.
entries.literal: "I might be mistaken somewhere, but I don't think that was still the same world.{w} However, what happened later? We did reunite with the Sai who'd traveled in the event room, didn't we?{w} Similarly, Akaro and the other Sai weren't found again. It was as if we'd gone back to our world."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wonder... Does that hypothesis solve every mystery surrounding that travel?{w} What about the range? It was bigger than previous fifteen-minute travels, wasn't it?{w} ...Two functional Sekimeiya existed.{w} If their ranges overlapped, the Sekimeiya's effect wouldn't just be time travel.{w} I think that could be right. It's not an idea that can only be applied in that instance.
entries.literal: "I wonder... Does that hypothesis solve every mystery surrounding that travel?{w} What about the range? It was bigger than previous fifteen-minute travels, wasn't it?{w} ...Two functional Sekimeiya existed.{w} If their ranges overlapped, the Sekimeiya's effect wouldn't just be time travel.{w} I think that could be right. It's not an idea that can only be applied in that instance."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where is everyone? The Sekimeiya was just activated when both of them were close to each other on the crystal floor, and it doesn't seem like the others are still in this tower.{w} How did I get to this world? Could it really be the same one we briefly visited?{w} This morning, Shiroya and I witnessed the Sekimeiya teleport. But that isn't what's been going on—the Sekimeiya isn't teleporting. It only appears that way because the entire world is changing.
entries.literal: "Where is everyone? The Sekimeiya was just activated when both of them were close to each other on the crystal floor, and it doesn't seem like the others are still in this tower.{w} How did I get to this world? Could it really be the same one we briefly visited?{w} This morning, Shiroya and I witnessed the Sekimeiya teleport. But that isn't what's been going on—the Sekimeiya isn't teleporting. It only appears that way because the entire world is changing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When it happened, we found the Sekimeiya inside a cabinet in room B4. It's very possible the other one was hidden nearby.{w} That's why Naomi was running to the attic with both Sekimeiya immediately after it disappeared.{w} We chased her up, but in the attic's staircase, Shiroya disappeared.{w} When I looked at the living room, both Sekimeiya were next to each other, and one of them was gray. As a result, neither Naomi nor Shiroya are here.
entries.literal: "When it happened, we found the Sekimeiya inside a cabinet in room B4. It's very possible the other one was hidden nearby.{w} That's why Naomi was running to the attic with both Sekimeiya immediately after it disappeared.{w} We chased her up, but in the attic's staircase, Shiroya disappeared.{w} When I looked at the living room, both Sekimeiya were next to each other, and one of them was gray. As a result, neither Naomi nor Shiroya are here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Lastly, though... this would answer the question of how Naomi's corpse appeared two times.{w} If Naomi touched the Sekimeiya and the world around her changed, she would've appeared in the attic. Her keys had been left behind, so she had no way to leave.{w} That's what happened. That's what we saw on the floor of the living room. That's why we found Naomi dead twice.{w} The Naomi that Shiroya disappeared with was one of the two bodies that we found dead. ...Does this mean that version of Shiroya was there since the beginning?
entries.literal: "Lastly, though... this would answer the question of how Naomi's corpse appeared two times.{w} If Naomi touched the Sekimeiya and the world around her changed, she would've appeared in the attic. Her keys had been left behind, so she had no way to leave.{w} That's what happened. That's what we saw on the floor of the living room. That's why we found Naomi dead twice.{w} The Naomi that Shiroya disappeared with was one of the two bodies that we found dead. ...Does this mean that version of Shiroya was there since the beginning?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "The Naomi that Shiroya disappeared with was one of the two bodies that we found dead."
entries.literal: "\"The Naomi that Shiroya disappeared with was one of the two bodies that we found dead.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That is...
entries.literal: "That is..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unfortunately, it is not correct. While it's understandable for Atsuki to have made that mistake, I thought perhaps you had realized the flaw.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, it is not correct. While it's understandable for Atsuki to have made that mistake, I thought perhaps you had realized the flaw."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Indeed, it is incorrect. While it's understandable for Atsuki to have made that mistake, I figured you would've realized the flaw.
entries.literal: "Indeed, it is incorrect. While it's understandable for Atsuki to have made that mistake, I figured you would've realized the flaw."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...So, if I activate the Sekimeiya right now, will I go back to the other world?
entries.literal: "...So, if I activate the Sekimeiya right now, will I go back to the other world?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When Shiroya disappeared, she wasn't in the living room yet, meaning that she didn't leave any footprints...
entries.literal: "When Shiroya disappeared, she wasn't in the living room yet, meaning that she didn't leave any footprints..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wondered earlier how I'd be here for twelve hours without being found when the searches we executed would've found me. Of course, in this world, this doesn't apply. Everyone is gone.
entries.literal: "I wondered earlier how I'd be here for twelve hours without being found when the searches we executed would've found me. Of course, in this world, this doesn't apply. Everyone is gone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where are they, though? Am I really correct in what I'm thinking?{w} Everyone who was in hallway B is no longer in this world. If that is the case, are they in the world I came from?
entries.literal: "Where are they, though? Am I really correct in what I'm thinking?{w} Everyone who was in hallway B is no longer in this world. If that is the case, are they in the world I came from?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that possible? ...It might be, but it doesn't feel right. After all, if this is the world where I was when Erina touched the Sekimeiya, Sai and Akaro must eventually come back.
entries.literal: "Is that possible? ...It might be, but it doesn't feel right. After all, if this is the world where I was when Erina touched the Sekimeiya, Sai and Akaro must eventually come back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a speculative mess, especially because I couldn't prove anything. However, the fundamental basis that I was working with seemed correct.
entries.literal: "It was a speculative mess, especially because I couldn't prove anything. However, the fundamental basis that I was working with seemed correct."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What exactly were the body double mysteries? I can't understand Shiroya's case at all, and I'm not sure about Sai's.{w} Isla's, though... Could her "friend" have been the Isla from this world?
entries.literal: "What exactly were the body double mysteries? I can't understand Shiroya's case at all, and I'm not sure about Sai's.{w} Isla's, though... Could her \"friend\" have been the Isla from this world?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: "From this world"... I don't know what the hell to think, and that's mostly due to the most blatant example: the second Akaro.{w} The Akaro who had different memories and disappeared from the bedroom. Did he come from a different world in the way that I'm thinking?{w} If so, he couldn't have been the Akaro from this world because he didn't know who Katei was, but he did know Shiroya.
entries.literal: "\"From this world\"... I don't know what the hell to think, and that's mostly due to the most blatant example: the second Akaro.{w} The Akaro who had different memories and disappeared from the bedroom. Did he come from a different world in the way that I'm thinking?{w} If so, he couldn't have been the Akaro from this world because he didn't know who Katei was, but he did know Shiroya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Now, what have you been thinking all this time? Do you have your own answers?
entries.literal: "Now, what have you been thinking all this time? Do you have your own answers?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: First off, what is the explanation behind that Akaro?
entries.literal: "First off, what is the explanation behind that Akaro?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Correct.{w} A world beyond Atsuki's knowledge.
entries.literal: "Correct.{w} A world beyond Atsuki's knowledge."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's not it.
entries.literal: "That's not it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The explanation is a world beyond Atsuki's knowledge.
entries.literal: "The explanation is a world beyond Atsuki's knowledge."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, where did that Akaro come from?{w} Could he have come from a world without Katei?{w} If that's it, though, this is too fucking confusing! Could changing worlds bring me to any kind of world? There could be infinite worlds, and the Sekimeiya could act as random bridges between them!
entries.literal: "So, where did that Akaro come from?{w} Could he have come from a world without Katei?{w} If that's it, though, this is too fucking confusing! Could changing worlds bring me to any kind of world? There could be infinite worlds, and the Sekimeiya could act as random bridges between them!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Now, tell him. Although he can't hear you, tell him why he's wrong.
entries.literal: "Now, tell him. Although he can't hear you, tell him why he's wrong."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yes. Only three different worlds exist.
entries.literal: "Yes. Only three different worlds exist."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How did you know that, though? How could you be sure of such a powerful assertion?
entries.literal: "How did you know that, though? How could you be sure of such a powerful assertion?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: No. The answer is three.
entries.literal: "No. The answer is three."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Now that you know, perhaps you have an idea of how you could've asserted that fact.
entries.literal: "Now that you know, perhaps you have an idea of how you could've asserted that fact."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Why is it proven that there are not infinite worlds? Why can't a fourth one exist?
entries.literal: "...Why is it proven that there are not infinite worlds? Why can't a fourth one exist?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Because the three worlds loop. Congratulations.
entries.literal: "Because the three worlds loop. Congratulations."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That is the essential core of the universe you've witnessed. Through the Sekimeiya, the link between three worlds looped. The three sides of the mountain spun around, leading to a single peak.
entries.literal: "That is the essential core of the universe you've witnessed. Through the Sekimeiya, the link between three worlds looped. The three sides of the mountain spun around, leading to a single peak."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Why is it proven that there are not infinite worlds? Why can't a fourth one exist?
entries.literal: "...Why is it proven that there are not infinite worlds? Why can't a fourth one exist?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It is because the three worlds loop. That is the essential core of the universe you've witnessed.{w} Through the Sekimeiya, the link between three worlds looped. The three sides of the mountain spun around, leading to a single peak.
entries.literal: "It is because the three worlds loop. That is the essential core of the universe you've witnessed.{w} Through the Sekimeiya, the link between three worlds looped. The three sides of the mountain spun around, leading to a single peak."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But that doesn't answer all the questions, does it? Why only three worlds?
entries.literal: "But that doesn't answer all the questions, does it? Why only three worlds?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki correctly figured out the Sekimeiya's core secret.{w} In each world, two Sekimeiya existed. When one was activated, the active range sent anyone encompassed in it through time.{w} However, if both ranges overlapped, whoever found themselves present within both were not transported through time and space, but through worlds.
entries.literal: "Atsuki correctly figured out the Sekimeiya's core secret.{w} In each world, two Sekimeiya existed. When one was activated, the active range sent anyone encompassed in it through time.{w} However, if both ranges overlapped, whoever found themselves present within both were not transported through time and space, but through worlds."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This effect is called a world switch, although the full extent of the name might not make a lot of sense to you yet.{w} Like everything about the Sekimeiya, the world switch hid many secrets of its own. Of course, you may have figured some of them out with the tools you were given.
entries.literal: "This effect is called a world switch, although the full extent of the name might not make a lot of sense to you yet.{w} Like everything about the Sekimeiya, the world switch hid many secrets of its own. Of course, you may have figured some of them out with the tools you were given."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There is one world in which only Atsuki is found alive in the tower. He is suspected of having been behind multiple crimes, but his life is suddenly cut short as he looks through a window.
entries.literal: "There is one world in which only Atsuki is found alive in the tower. He is suspected of having been behind multiple crimes, but his life is suddenly cut short as he looks through a window."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That world will be called "A".
entries.literal: "That world will be called \"A\"."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If that world is "A", then the world in which everyone survived and left the tower...
entries.literal: "If that world is \"A\", then the world in which everyone survived and left the tower..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: No. That world is "C".
entries.literal: "No. That world is \"C\"."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "B" is the world in which the recorder was present. At {time=21}, Atsuki, Sai, and Erina weren't able to escape.
entries.literal: "\"B\" is the world in which the recorder was present. At {time=21}, Atsuki, Sai, and Erina weren't able to escape."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Exactly. It is "C".
entries.literal: "Exactly. It is \"C\"."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, "B" is the world in which the recorder was present. At {time=21}, Atsuki, Sai, and Erina weren't able to escape.
entries.literal: "Then, \"B\" is the world in which the recorder was present. At {time=21}, Atsuki, Sai, and Erina weren't able to escape."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: By world switching from world A, people were brought to...
entries.literal: "By world switching from world A, people were brought to..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yes. This is the way the worlds looped.
entries.literal: "Yes. This is the way the worlds looped."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Incorrect. The answer is "B".
entries.literal: "Incorrect. The answer is \"B\"."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You've seen a few instances of full loops. Miiya's group went from their own world, C, to world A. From world A they went to world B, and then from world B they went back to world C.{w} Shiroya, after traveling from January 5th to December 15th, went from world B to world C with Atsuki. In the attic, she went from world C to world A with Naomi, and she finally returned alone to world B. The order is A - B - C - A.
entries.literal: "You've seen a few instances of full loops. Miiya's group went from their own world, C, to world A. From world A they went to world B, and then from world B they went back to world C.{w} Shiroya, after traveling from January 5th to December 15th, went from world B to world C with Atsuki. In the attic, she went from world C to world A with Naomi, and she finally returned alone to world B. The order is A - B - C - A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Worlds A and C were drastically different, as the worlds followed an intrinsic progression with each other. However, as strange as it might seem, there was only a single degree of separation between C and A.
entries.literal: "Worlds A and C were drastically different, as the worlds followed an intrinsic progression with each other. However, as strange as it might seem, there was only a single degree of separation between C and A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There is, isn't there? I'm sure you can find instances that didn't follow that order—all of which had something in common.
entries.literal: "There is, isn't there? I'm sure you can find instances that didn't follow that order—all of which had something in common."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You don't think so? Can you not find any instances that didn't follow that order?{w} They do exist. If you find them, perhaps you'll notice what they had in common.
entries.literal: "You don't think so? Can you not find any instances that didn't follow that order?{w} They do exist. If you find them, perhaps you'll notice what they had in common."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The incident at the tower happened in all three worlds, but the outcome was vastly different.{w} Why?
entries.literal: "The incident at the tower happened in all three worlds, but the outcome was vastly different.{w} Why?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The major difference in world A...
entries.literal: "The major difference in world A..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world A, many people died. The major difference from the beginning was Katei's absence.
entries.literal: "In world A, many people died. The major difference from the beginning was Katei's absence."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The major difference from the beginning was Katei's absence.
entries.literal: "The major difference from the beginning was Katei's absence."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world A, only one Naomi was found. The major difference from the beginning was Katei's absence.
entries.literal: "In world A, only one Naomi was found. The major difference from the beginning was Katei's absence."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei put his plan into action: he put both real Sekimeiya in the suitcase he had prepared and moved to the secret door in the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Katei put his plan into action: he put both real Sekimeiya in the suitcase he had prepared and moved to the secret door in the storeroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He felt the handle, but he quickly realized he had dropped the key in the hallway.
entries.literal: "He felt the handle, but he quickly realized he had dropped the key in the hallway."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While he was searching for it, Naomi found the suitcase and took it.
entries.literal: "While he was searching for it, Naomi found the suitcase and took it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, when Katei found the key, he attempted to unlock the secret door.
entries.literal: "Then, when Katei found the key, he attempted to unlock the secret door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And he did. He was able to leave.
entries.literal: "And he did. He was able to leave."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But he didn't step out. He saw the Sekimeiya had been taken before hearing Naomi's movements. His plan had been very close to succeeding, so he panicked.
entries.literal: "But he didn't step out. He saw the Sekimeiya had been taken before hearing Naomi's movements. His plan had been very close to succeeding, so he panicked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He ran behind her desperately, but Naomi had a safe place: the attic.
entries.literal: "He ran behind her desperately, but Naomi had a safe place: the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He chased her up, but he recognized that going all the way was a mistake. He could never enter the final floor.
entries.literal: "He chased her up, but he recognized that going all the way was a mistake. He could never enter the final floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He tripped in the staircase leading to the fourth floor and distractedly walked back without realizing he'd dropped yet another key.
entries.literal: "He tripped in the staircase leading to the fourth floor and distractedly walked back without realizing he'd dropped yet another key."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The security room's.
entries.literal: "The security room's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That isn't right. Katei didn't have that key.{w} He dropped the security room's.
entries.literal: "That isn't right. Katei didn't have that key.{w} He dropped the security room's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That isn't right. He dropped the security room's.
entries.literal: "That isn't right. He dropped the security room's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You remember that Atsuki found it there, but that didn't happen in world A, did it? That was in world C.{w} You might know who found the key in world A. It was Akaro. Although many things were different, Atsuki only came across it in world C because Katei had been staring at the floor, and he wasn't there in world A.
entries.literal: "You remember that Atsuki found it there, but that didn't happen in world A, did it? That was in world C.{w} You might know who found the key in world A. It was Akaro. Although many things were different, Atsuki only came across it in world C because Katei had been staring at the floor, and he wasn't there in world A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His mind threatening to collapse in on itself, Katei realized his only option was to escape from the building as quickly as possible.
entries.literal: "His mind threatening to collapse in on itself, Katei realized his only option was to escape from the building as quickly as possible."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He left through the storeroom before the others woke up. Outside, he was fast enough to meet up with everyone else who'd evacuated. He knew the floor 2 cameras had recorded him, but he was confident he could take care of that at {time=21.}
entries.literal: "He left through the storeroom before the others woke up. Outside, he was fast enough to meet up with everyone else who'd evacuated. He knew the floor 2 cameras had recorded him, but he was confident he could take care of that at {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Meanwhile, in world C, everything happened similarly. However, when Katei attempted to unlock the storeroom door, he couldn't. Something prevented him from doing so.{w} Like in world A, he heard Naomi's movements and chased her up, dropping the key in the same staircase.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, in world C, everything happened similarly. However, when Katei attempted to unlock the storeroom door, he couldn't. Something prevented him from doing so.{w} Like in world A, he heard Naomi's movements and chased her up, dropping the key in the same staircase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...So, what about world B? What happened to the security room key in that world?
entries.literal: "...So, what about world B? What happened to the security room key in that world?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The truth is that Katei didn't drop it.
entries.literal: "The truth is that Katei didn't drop it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How is that possible? Why did that differ between worlds?
entries.literal: "How is that possible? Why did that differ between worlds?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The answer is tied to something else that only occurred in B.
entries.literal: "The answer is tied to something else that only occurred in B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...It was the handle's removal.{w} In world B, Katei went to the secret door, ready to leave. However, he immediately felt it with his hand: the handle wasn't there.
entries.literal: "...It was the handle's removal.{w} In world B, Katei went to the secret door, ready to leave. However, he immediately felt it with his hand: the handle wasn't there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He couldn't believe it—he had been outsmarted. Speechless, he froze in place.
entries.literal: "He couldn't believe it—he had been outsmarted. Speechless, he froze in place."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Of course, as the keyhole had been in the handle, he couldn't even attempt to unlock the door. That is why he didn't notice that he'd dropped the rusty key in hallway A, and it's why Naomi didn't have the chance to take his suitcase.
entries.literal: "Of course, as the keyhole had been in the handle, he couldn't even attempt to unlock the door. That is why he didn't notice that he'd dropped the rusty key in hallway A, and it's why Naomi didn't have the chance to take his suitcase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He understood that he would have to stay in the tower, but he didn't immediately give up. Xyn's Sekimeiya was still in the event room, and perhaps he could make use of it.{w} Katei sighed deeply, trying to figure out who could've known about the storeroom's secret.
entries.literal: "He understood that he would have to stay in the tower, but he didn't immediately give up. Xyn's Sekimeiya was still in the event room, and perhaps he could make use of it.{w} Katei sighed deeply, trying to figure out who could've known about the storeroom's secret."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before anyone could see him, he went to a crystal room in hallway B; he had been told that refrigeration was essential to keep the Sekimeiya stable.
entries.literal: "Before anyone could see him, he went to a crystal room in hallway B; he had been told that refrigeration was essential to keep the Sekimeiya stable."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had independently learned that Ashiya had two identical Sekimeiya, but it wasn't public knowledge. Hence, abusing Xyn's plan still seemed feasible: he could keep a Sekimeiya for himself as long as Ashiya found Xyn's fake in the cabinet. That was why he left each Sekimeiya inside different cabinets in room B4.
entries.literal: "He had independently learned that Ashiya had two identical Sekimeiya, but it wasn't public knowledge. Hence, abusing Xyn's plan still seemed feasible: he could keep a Sekimeiya for himself as long as Ashiya found Xyn's fake in the cabinet. That was why he left each Sekimeiya inside different cabinets in room B4."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He came to the conclusion that it was a good idea to let the suitcase be found. As he disposed of it, he heard a sound coming from the crystal room he'd just been in.
entries.literal: "He came to the conclusion that it was a good idea to let the suitcase be found. As he disposed of it, he heard a sound coming from the crystal room he'd just been in."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He ran there and saw one of the Sekimeiya on the floor: Atsuki and Shiroya had just world switched to world C.
entries.literal: "He ran there and saw one of the Sekimeiya on the floor: Atsuki and Shiroya had just world switched to world C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He couldn't comprehend it. The Sekimeiya was gray, but nobody was there. Nobody could've escaped after he'd heard the sound.
entries.literal: "He couldn't comprehend it. The Sekimeiya was gray, but nobody was there. Nobody could've escaped after he'd heard the sound."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yet, one of the cabinets was open...{w} It was impossible anyone had been there, and the cabinet's temperature hadn't even cooled off yet. He hurriedly put the Sekimeiya back in, still trying to process what could've happened.
entries.literal: "Yet, one of the cabinets was open...{w} It was impossible anyone had been there, and the cabinet's temperature hadn't even cooled off yet. He hurriedly put the Sekimeiya back in, still trying to process what could've happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he left the room, he saw Erina's group on the floor of the hallway. She was moving slightly, so Katei felt trapped. He didn't want her to wake up and see him leaving.{w} Slowly, he walked over and crouched beside the three incapacitated people.
entries.literal: "When he left the room, he saw Erina's group on the floor of the hallway. She was moving slightly, so Katei felt trapped. He didn't want her to wake up and see him leaving.{w} Slowly, he walked over and crouched beside the three incapacitated people."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, doesn't this beg the same question? Why was the handle taken off in B?
entries.literal: "So, doesn't this beg the same question? Why was the handle taken off in B?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: To begin with, who do you think was responsible for that?
entries.literal: "To begin with, who do you think was responsible for that?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yes. It was Akaro A.
entries.literal: "Yes. It was Akaro A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's not right.{w} The person who removed the secret door's handle in world B was Akaro A.
entries.literal: "That's not right.{w} The person who removed the secret door's handle in world B was Akaro A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He was the main person behind the attack. In his world, however, Xyn were outsmarted.{w} The alarm Xyn didn't know about went off, and the Sekimeiya Akaro had hidden in the cleaning cart was taken.
entries.literal: "He was the main person behind the attack. In his world, however, Xyn were outsmarted.{w} The alarm Xyn didn't know about went off, and the Sekimeiya Akaro had hidden in the cleaning cart was taken."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Who had been responsible? For a while, Akaro had no idea.
entries.literal: "Who had been responsible? For a while, Akaro had no idea."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, eventually, he world switched to B with Isla.
entries.literal: "However, eventually, he world switched to B with Isla."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In that world, he was surprised to find out the attic was unlocked, and even more so to see that everyone was taking shelter inside a bedroom.{w} There, he learned about two things: Katei's presence in the tower and the existence of the storeroom's secret.{w} Naturally, he knew who Katei Kuiji was, but he shouldn't have been there. Akaro had suspected someone from Ashiya had hindered their plan, so he was internally taken aback when he heard details about that world's events.
entries.literal: "In that world, he was surprised to find out the attic was unlocked, and even more so to see that everyone was taking shelter inside a bedroom.{w} There, he learned about two things: Katei's presence in the tower and the existence of the storeroom's secret.{w} Naturally, he knew who Katei Kuiji was, but he shouldn't have been there. Akaro had suspected someone from Ashiya had hindered their plan, so he was internally taken aback when he heard details about that world's events."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Soon, that Akaro traveled to the past and appeared on the 24th of November. You remember what Shiroya thought, don't you?
entries.literal: "Soon, that Akaro traveled to the past and appeared on the 24th of November. You remember what Shiroya thought, don't you?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Out of nowhere, he appeared in a detention cell, but he was able to leave it. Then, he realized he was in the far past.{w} He recalled the times Katei had chosen to speak to Ido: he must've been who had interfered with Xyn's plan.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, he appeared in a detention cell, but he was able to leave it. Then, he realized he was in the far past.{w} He recalled the times Katei had chosen to speak to Ido: he must've been who had interfered with Xyn's plan."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei hadn't been in the tower, yet everyone had eventually claimed he'd been there since the start. It wasn't hard to suspect the truth.{w} However, Akaro still couldn't believe what he'd done. In the tower, desperate to fulfill Xyn's plan...
entries.literal: "Katei hadn't been in the tower, yet everyone had eventually claimed he'd been there since the start. It wasn't hard to suspect the truth.{w} However, Akaro still couldn't believe what he'd done. In the tower, desperate to fulfill Xyn's plan..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How had Shiroya come back to life? ...And she had clearly been aware of what he'd done.{w} Why had she not said anything, then? Akaro had no idea why she had come back, but he had been next to her and Atsuki for hours; he'd seen how they'd turned out after he'd caused the death of their friend.
entries.literal: "How had Shiroya come back to life? ...And she had clearly been aware of what he'd done.{w} Why had she not said anything, then? Akaro had no idea why she had come back, but he had been next to her and Atsuki for hours; he'd seen how they'd turned out after he'd caused the death of their friend."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At first, when he appeared in November, Akaro thought of what to do. He could take advantage of it—he knew what would happen.{w} Yet his remorse soon overcame him. His greatest wish was to walk away, and he had the opportunity to do so. The plan was going to be a failure, but he was no longer in his world. Perhaps he could let his other self take the blame while he tried to atone for his actions...
entries.literal: "At first, when he appeared in November, Akaro thought of what to do. He could take advantage of it—he knew what would happen.{w} Yet his remorse soon overcame him. His greatest wish was to walk away, and he had the opportunity to do so. The plan was going to be a failure, but he was no longer in his world. Perhaps he could let his other self take the blame while he tried to atone for his actions..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Of course, due to a certain perspective you've viewed, you know that's not what happened.
entries.literal: "Of course, due to a certain perspective you've viewed, you know that's not what happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In any case, Akaro's actions significantly changed the start of world B's incident. Katei didn't know he'd dropped the rusty key, and Naomi didn't run to the attic with the suitcase.
entries.literal: "In any case, Akaro's actions significantly changed the start of world B's incident. Katei didn't know he'd dropped the rusty key, and Naomi didn't run to the attic with the suitcase."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In worlds A and C, however, the same thing occurred. In the attic, Naomi touched the Sekimeiya and world switched.{w} When Naomi A touched it, she appeared in world B. Her keys remained in world A, and the elevator was disabled. Until that changed, she was trapped up there.{w} From her point of view, both Sekimeiya disappeared, as she brought the suitcase along as one of her possessions.
entries.literal: "In worlds A and C, however, the same thing occurred. In the attic, Naomi touched the Sekimeiya and world switched.{w} When Naomi A touched it, she appeared in world B. Her keys remained in world A, and the elevator was disabled. Until that changed, she was trapped up there.{w} From her point of view, both Sekimeiya disappeared, as she brought the suitcase along as one of her possessions."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, Naomi C's outcome was different.{w} She world switched to world A, and the range encompassed Shiroya as well.{w} Even though the attic was locked, they weren't trapped. Not only did Shiroya have the key, but so did Naomi: although she'd changed worlds, she grabbed the keys Naomi A had left behind, unaware they were no longer hers.
entries.literal: "However, Naomi C's outcome was different.{w} She world switched to world A, and the range encompassed Shiroya as well.{w} Even though the attic was locked, they weren't trapped. Not only did Shiroya have the key, but so did Naomi: although she'd changed worlds, she grabbed the keys Naomi A had left behind, unaware they were no longer hers."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In addition, she brought the suitcase along too, but the Sekimeiya Naomi A had used were both still there. As both Naomis world switched at exactly the same time, for Naomi C, it only seemed as though the Sekimeiya she'd touched turned gray, even though it was the one Naomi A had activated.{w} Instinctively, what she did was touch the other Sekimeiya, unable to believe her finger had changed a gem's color. When she did, she traveled through time: since one of the Sekimeiya was powered off, there was no world switch.
entries.literal: "In addition, she brought the suitcase along too, but the Sekimeiya Naomi A had used were both still there. As both Naomis world switched at exactly the same time, for Naomi C, it only seemed as though the Sekimeiya she'd touched turned gray, even though it was the one Naomi A had activated.{w} Instinctively, what she did was touch the other Sekimeiya, unable to believe her finger had changed a gem's color. When she did, she traveled through time: since one of the Sekimeiya was powered off, there was no world switch."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Although these beginning sequences evolved into drastically different days, some of the differences between worlds came from before the 15th.
entries.literal: "Although these beginning sequences evolved into drastically different days, some of the differences between worlds came from before the 15th."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Isla's friend only existed in world B. In the other worlds, Isla hadn't been assured everything would go smoothly; nobody had told her she'd be able to touch the Sekimeiya. Hence, her mood was more dampened, and Erina's was lighter.
entries.literal: "Isla's friend only existed in world B. In the other worlds, Isla hadn't been assured everything would go smoothly; nobody had told her she'd be able to touch the Sekimeiya. Hence, her mood was more dampened, and Erina's was lighter."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai sniffed out that something would occur on the day of the event. However, only in world B was he certain—he had read a forum thread that foretold what would unfold in the tower. In that world, he was much more active from the start.
entries.literal: "Sai sniffed out that something would occur on the day of the event. However, only in world B was he certain—he had read a forum thread that foretold what would unfold in the tower. In that world, he was much more active from the start."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world A, Akaro couldn't see Katei as his enemy, so his attitude toward the others was rougher and sterner.{w} In addition, the article detailing his escape from prison only existed in world B.
entries.literal: "In world A, Akaro couldn't see Katei as his enemy, so his attitude toward the others was rougher and sterner.{w} In addition, the article detailing his escape from prison only existed in world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world C, Katei's Sekimeiya were taken by Naomi, so his priorities were very different. In world B, Katei had to step up to Erina's group, while in world C, he saw room A5 by himself before everyone else regained consciousness.
entries.literal: "In world C, Katei's Sekimeiya were taken by Naomi, so his priorities were very different. In world B, Katei had to step up to Erina's group, while in world C, he saw room A5 by himself before everyone else regained consciousness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Do you think there's a relation between all these changes?
entries.literal: "Do you think there's a relation between all these changes?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There certainly is one: they were all caused by someone from another world.
entries.literal: "There certainly is one: they were all caused by someone from another world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's it. They were caused by someone from another world.
entries.literal: "That's it. They were caused by someone from another world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: No, they had an origin. The actual relation is that they were all caused by someone from another world.
entries.literal: "No, they had an origin. The actual relation is that they were all caused by someone from another world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Up to the 24th of November, all the worlds were identical.{w} You might be familiar with the many-worlds interpretation. According to it, every choice splits the world, leading into infinite worlds which are infinitely different.
entries.literal: "Up to the 24th of November, all the worlds were identical.{w} You might be familiar with the many-worlds interpretation. According to it, every choice splits the world, leading into infinite worlds which are infinitely different."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In these three worlds, the initial difference came in November of 2011, and it was caused due to someone who had world switched from another world.{w} In other words, there was no change that wasn't influenced by another world—if zero world switches had occurred, each of the three worlds would've remained identical.
entries.literal: "In these three worlds, the initial difference came in November of 2011, and it was caused due to someone who had world switched from another world.{w} In other words, there was no change that wasn't influenced by another world—if zero world switches had occurred, each of the three worlds would've remained identical."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Only they caused reality to differ. It was the world switches that shaped this maze—a maze whose walls could be broken.
entries.literal: "Only they caused reality to differ. It was the world switches that shaped this maze—a maze whose walls could be broken."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There are numerous enigmas around the world switch. Perhaps you have some lingering questions.{w} When Akaro A appeared in world B, the storeroom had been sealed by his future self. However, in part, that helped him go back in time and seal it. Doesn't that seem contradictory? If he had appeared in a world without a sealed storeroom, he wouldn't have been able to go back and seal it... You might find a number of similar cases.{w} For that, you can look at the people who world switched and the way they shaped their new world. If the answer escapes you, that's where you will find it, alongside the real form of the world switch.
entries.literal: "There are numerous enigmas around the world switch. Perhaps you have some lingering questions.{w} When Akaro A appeared in world B, the storeroom had been sealed by his future self. However, in part, that helped him go back in time and seal it. Doesn't that seem contradictory? If he had appeared in a world without a sealed storeroom, he wouldn't have been able to go back and seal it... You might find a number of similar cases.{w} For that, you can look at the people who world switched and the way they shaped their new world. If the answer escapes you, that's where you will find it, alongside the real form of the world switch."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't just think that infinite worlds existed. After all, it was possible I was going back and forth between two.{w} The first time, Erina had brought us to a different world, but we had eventually returned. When we'd later traveled back to that morning, Shiroya and I had changed worlds, but I suspected that we'd appeared in the same one again. That was why thinking that infinite worlds existed was a bit of a leap.
entries.literal: "I couldn't just think that infinite worlds existed. After all, it was possible I was going back and forth between two.{w} The first time, Erina had brought us to a different world, but we had eventually returned. When we'd later traveled back to that morning, Shiroya and I had changed worlds, but I suspected that we'd appeared in the same one again. That was why thinking that infinite worlds existed was a bit of a leap."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at both Sekimeiya. If I touched one, would the world around me really change?
entries.literal: "I looked at both Sekimeiya. If I touched one, would the world around me really change?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What about the range, the replicated location, the time traveled, and all that nonsense?
entries.literal: "What about the range, the replicated location, the time traveled, and all that nonsense?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped into the kitchen.
entries.literal: "I stepped into the kitchen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Can the refrigerator act like the cold cabinet?
entries.literal: "...Can the refrigerator act like the cold cabinet?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened it and put my hand inside. While it was cold, the temperature didn't seem as low as the Sekimeiya cabinet's.
entries.literal: "I opened it and put my hand inside. While it was cold, the temperature didn't seem as low as the Sekimeiya cabinet's."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a regulation mechanism inside, so I changed it to the coldest setting.
entries.literal: "There was a regulation mechanism inside, so I changed it to the coldest setting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shut a Sekimeiya inside the refrigerator for a few seconds.{w} When I took it out, I felt it through my shirt.
entries.literal: "I shut a Sekimeiya inside the refrigerator for a few seconds.{w} When I took it out, I felt it through my shirt."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It did work. It was pretty hot before, and now it's not.
entries.literal: "It did work. It was pretty hot before, and now it's not."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, as long as I keep a Sekimeiya in here, I might not be encompassed within two ranges.
entries.literal: "So, as long as I keep a Sekimeiya in here, I might not be encompassed within two ranges."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't confident the concept of range I was working with was correct, though.
entries.literal: "I wasn't confident the concept of range I was working with was correct, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put both Sekimeiya inside to hopefully reset them. A few seconds later, I took one out and set it on the countertop.
entries.literal: "I put both Sekimeiya inside to hopefully reset them. A few seconds later, I took one out and set it on the countertop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Theoretically, it should begin to gather energy now, so I'll travel a short distance if I touch it soon.
entries.literal: "Theoretically, it should begin to gather energy now, so I'll travel a short distance if I touch it soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I counted up to a minute in my head. Then, I touched the Sekimeiya on the marble.
entries.literal: "I counted up to a minute in my head. Then, I touched the Sekimeiya on the marble."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Hm? What just happened?
entries.literal: "...{w}Hm? What just happened?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was still in the kitchen, but I had teleported less than a step backward.
entries.literal: "I was still in the kitchen, but I had teleported less than a step backward."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh? The Sekimeiya is powered off just where I touched it.
entries.literal: "Huh? The Sekimeiya is powered off just where I touched it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Does that mean I traveled to the future? I think I only went a few seconds through time, and there's no past self of mine here.
entries.literal: "Does that mean I traveled to the future? I think I only went a few seconds through time, and there's no past self of mine here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was gray, indicating that I was at a point after my travel. Surprised, I realized I really had traveled forward in time.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was gray, indicating that I was at a point after my travel. Surprised, I realized I really had traveled forward in time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What was the difference? Why didn't I travel to the past?
entries.literal: "What was the difference? Why didn't I travel to the past?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And the location where I appeared... Why was it right next to where I touched the Sekimeiya?{w} It's as if I only moved a tiny bit because I only went a few seconds to the future.
entries.literal: "And the location where I appeared... Why was it right next to where I touched the Sekimeiya?{w} It's as if I only moved a tiny bit because I only went a few seconds to the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...{w} I have an idea, but I don't think I can test it.
entries.literal: "Hm...{w} I have an idea, but I don't think I can test it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, no, maybe I can.
entries.literal: "Wait, no, maybe I can."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I put the Sekimeiya in the refrigerator, it regained its white color. However, I ignored that and ran to the staircase.
entries.literal: "As soon as I put the Sekimeiya in the refrigerator, it regained its white color. However, I ignored that and ran to the staircase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It appeared the crystal floor was still empty, but I couldn't know for certain.
entries.literal: "It appeared the crystal floor was still empty, but I couldn't know for certain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Quietly, I walked to the security room.
entries.literal: "Quietly, I walked to the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All the screens were still black, but they weren't my focus. I began to look everywhere I could.
entries.literal: "All the screens were still black, but they weren't my focus. I began to look everywhere I could."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Sai said he found the voice recorder here, but perhaps he hasn't yet. I might be able to get it in this world.
entries.literal: "Sai said he found the voice recorder here, but perhaps he hasn't yet. I might be able to get it in this world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And I did. Behind one of the monitors on the wall, I found the device that had been in Isla's purse.
entries.literal: "And I did. Behind one of the monitors on the wall, I found the device that had been in Isla's purse."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I pressed the "record" button, a line appeared on the screen. Above it, numbers began to count the recorded seconds.
entries.literal: "When I pressed the \"record\" button, a line appeared on the screen. Above it, numbers began to count the recorded seconds."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There was no saved recording this time...
entries.literal: "There was no saved recording this time..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That wasn't strange. After all, the recorder in Isla's purse had to have traveled from the future, while the one in the security room was the original one.{w} However, my intention wasn't to record anything. I wanted to use the device as a timer that I could hold.
entries.literal: "That wasn't strange. After all, the recorder in Isla's purse had to have traveled from the future, while the one in the security room was the original one.{w} However, my intention wasn't to record anything. I wanted to use the device as a timer that I could hold."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Back in the attic, I entered the kitchen again. Both Sekimeiya were still in the refrigerator, but I didn't want to take one out yet.
entries.literal: "Back in the attic, I entered the kitchen again. Both Sekimeiya were still in the refrigerator, but I didn't want to take one out yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead, I powered on the oven and set it to finish after ten minutes.
entries.literal: "Instead, I powered on the oven and set it to finish after ten minutes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, at the same time that the oven began to count down, I pressed the record button. Immediately, the seconds began to count up on the device's screen.
entries.literal: "Then, at the same time that the oven began to count down, I pressed the record button. Immediately, the seconds began to count up on the device's screen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: With this setup, I can know the amount of time I'm traveling.
entries.literal: "With this setup, I can know the amount of time I'm traveling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I held the recorder in my hand so that it would always be in my possession. When the oven's timer showed nine minutes, the device had hit one minute.
entries.literal: "I held the recorder in my hand so that it would always be in my possession. When the oven's timer showed nine minutes, the device had hit one minute."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Meanwhile, I thought back on the many travels I'd experienced, wondering if there was any idea I could apply to every single one.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, I thought back on the many travels I'd experienced, wondering if there was any idea I could apply to every single one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When three minutes had been recorded, I took the Sekimeiya I'd last used out of the refrigerator and left it on the countertop.
entries.literal: "When three minutes had been recorded, I took the Sekimeiya I'd last used out of the refrigerator and left it on the countertop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, it's started gaining energy after three minutes have gone by.
entries.literal: "So, it's started gaining energy after three minutes have gone by."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't stop staring at the ticking timer. A few seconds later, I brought my hand close to the Sekimeiya. I didn't touch it yet, though. I had to make sure I did so at the appropriate time.
entries.literal: "I didn't stop staring at the ticking timer. A few seconds later, I brought my hand close to the Sekimeiya. I didn't touch it yet, though. I had to make sure I did so at the appropriate time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Above the Sekimeiya, my hand patiently hovered. As soon as the recorder and the oven hit five minutes, I touched it.
entries.literal: "Above the Sekimeiya, my hand patiently hovered. As soon as the recorder and the oven hit five minutes, I touched it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I'd hardly moved through space: I was still in the kitchen, staring at the Sekimeiya. However, it was gray, meaning that I was in the future.
entries.literal: "Once again, I'd hardly moved through space: I was still in the kitchen, staring at the Sekimeiya. However, it was gray, meaning that I was in the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Immediately, I looked at the oven. Its timer indicated that four minutes and fifteen seconds still remained.{w} Right after that, I glanced at my own hand, eager to look at my timer.{w} The device was there.
entries.literal: "Immediately, I looked at the oven. Its timer indicated that four minutes and fifteen seconds still remained.{w} Right after that, I glanced at my own hand, eager to look at my timer.{w} The device was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: 4:15... It's the same time!
entries.literal: "4:15... It's the same time!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But while the device's screen changed to 4:16, the oven's timer went to 4:14.{w} Like before, the recorder kept counting up, whereas the oven counted down.
entries.literal: "But while the device's screen changed to 4:16, the oven's timer went to 4:14.{w} Like before, the recorder kept counting up, whereas the oven counted down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh...

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I touched the Sekimeiya at the five-minute mark and went 45 seconds into the future. That's a little odd—the Sekimeiya gathered energy for two minutes. The times it gathered energy for fifteen minutes, we went twenty minutes through time.
entries.literal: "I touched the Sekimeiya at the five-minute mark and went 45 seconds into the future. That's a little odd—the Sekimeiya gathered energy for two minutes. The times it gathered energy for fifteen minutes, we went twenty minutes through time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The most important thing, though... is that although I went 45 seconds to the future, the recorder seems to have gone 45 seconds backward in time.
entries.literal: "The most important thing, though... is that although I went 45 seconds to the future, the recorder seems to have gone 45 seconds backward in time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That must mean... that the replicated location was from 45 seconds before I touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "That must mean... that the replicated location was from 45 seconds before I touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That left me thinking, but the train of thought was interrupted by the Sekimeiya. It turned white a few seconds after my reappearance.
entries.literal: "That left me thinking, but the train of thought was interrupted by the Sekimeiya. It turned white a few seconds after my reappearance."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is strange too. It took almost two minutes to power back on, but it spent about five minutes powered off when Sai and Shiroya disappeared from the event room.
entries.literal: "This is strange too. It took almost two minutes to power back on, but it spent about five minutes powered off when Sai and Shiroya disappeared from the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to do it again.{w} I turned off the oven and erased the recording. Next, I set the oven to five minutes and pressed the device's record button at the same time.{w} I left the Sekimeiya in the refrigerator until two minutes had elapsed. Then, thirty seconds later, when the recorder displayed 2:30, I touched the gem again.
entries.literal: "I had to do it again.{w} I turned off the oven and erased the recording. Next, I set the oven to five minutes and pressed the device's record button at the same time.{w} I left the Sekimeiya in the refrigerator until two minutes had elapsed. Then, thirty seconds later, when the recorder displayed 2:30, I touched the gem again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The immediate result was the same: I appeared in the kitchen, pretty much where I'd already been standing. I looked at both timers at once.{w} The two of them showed "2:21", yet the device's timer kept ticking up while the oven's counted down.
entries.literal: "The immediate result was the same: I appeared in the kitchen, pretty much where I'd already been standing. I looked at both timers at once.{w} The two of them showed \"2:21\", yet the device's timer kept ticking up while the oven's counted down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the fuck? Again, I went nine seconds to the future, but the location I appeared in was from nine seconds before touching the Sekimeiya.{w} Is this it? Does traveling to the future X amount of time replicate the location in space you were at X amount of time in the past?{w} What about traveling back, though? I've gone to the future three times in a row!
entries.literal: "What the fuck? Again, I went nine seconds to the future, but the location I appeared in was from nine seconds before touching the Sekimeiya.{w} Is this it? Does traveling to the future X amount of time replicate the location in space you were at X amount of time in the past?{w} What about traveling back, though? I've gone to the future three times in a row!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The only idea I had was to use the other Sekimeiya, so I put the one I'd been using in the refrigerator.
entries.literal: "The only idea I had was to use the other Sekimeiya, so I put the one I'd been using in the refrigerator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I set up the same conditions with the oven's timer at five minutes as I began a new recording.
entries.literal: "I set up the same conditions with the oven's timer at five minutes as I began a new recording."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That time, when two minutes had elapsed, I took the other Sekimeiya out. Thirty seconds later, I activated it.
entries.literal: "That time, when two minutes had elapsed, I took the other Sekimeiya out. Thirty seconds later, I activated it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The result was almost identical. I appeared in the kitchen, very close to where I'd been.
entries.literal: "The result was almost identical. I appeared in the kitchen, very close to where I'd been."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, someone was in front of me. It was my past self.
entries.literal: "However, someone was in front of me. It was my past self."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remained completely still, just like a deer caught in headlights. The back of my own head was in front of my eyes.
entries.literal: "I remained completely still, just like a deer caught in headlights. The back of my own head was in front of my eyes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But it didn't remain there for long. Quickly, my figure disappeared, revealing the powered-off Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "But it didn't remain there for long. Quickly, my figure disappeared, revealing the powered-off Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see... I just traveled through time, and the Sekimeiya's range was so small that it didn't pick me up again. It does seem like I went nine seconds to the past.{w} It's probably due to the Sekimeiya I used: this one makes you travel to the past, while the other sends you to the future.
entries.literal: "I see... I just traveled through time, and the Sekimeiya's range was so small that it didn't pick me up again. It does seem like I went nine seconds to the past.{w} It's probably due to the Sekimeiya I used: this one makes you travel to the past, while the other sends you to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The oven's timer was at 2:25, so I hurried to look at the voice recorder as I thought about it.{w} I had gone nine seconds to the past, so upon appearing, the oven's timer would've been at 2:39. Then, I had waited out the nine seconds needed for my past self to disappear, and five extra seconds had elapsed since. Before the oven's timer counted down to 2:24, I looked at the device between my hands.
entries.literal: "The oven's timer was at 2:25, so I hurried to look at the voice recorder as I thought about it.{w} I had gone nine seconds to the past, so upon appearing, the oven's timer would've been at 2:39. Then, I had waited out the nine seconds needed for my past self to disappear, and five extra seconds had elapsed since. Before the oven's timer counted down to 2:24, I looked at the device between my hands."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The screen is blank! What the hell!?{w} Why? I can't know where this location is from!
entries.literal: "The screen is blank! What the hell!?{w} Why? I can't know where this location is from!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Traveling nine seconds to the future put me where I'd been nine seconds in the past!{w} Wouldn't traveling to the past put me—{w} ...{w}where I'd be nine seconds in the future.{w} And I'm still here, exactly where I appeared.
entries.literal: "Traveling nine seconds to the future put me where I'd been nine seconds in the past!{w} Wouldn't traveling to the past put me—{w} ...{w}where I'd be nine seconds in the future.{w} And I'm still here, exactly where I appeared."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But then why is the screen...
entries.literal: "But then why is the screen..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait,{w} no.{w} It might make sense.
entries.literal: "Wait,{w} no.{w} It might make sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Let's say the Sekimeiya is touched at time {b}t{/b}. In this case, {b}t{/b} is 2:30.{w} {b}X{/b} will refer to the travel time, which is nine seconds.
entries.literal: "Let's say the Sekimeiya is touched at time {b}t{/b}. In this case, {b}t{/b} is 2:30.{w} {b}X{/b} will refer to the travel time, which is nine seconds."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Let's assume that traveling {b}X{/b} seconds to the past copies your state {b}X{/b} seconds after touching the Sekimeiya. What would the time on the device be upon appearing?
entries.literal: "Let's assume that traveling {b}X{/b} seconds to the past copies your state {b}X{/b} seconds after touching the Sekimeiya. What would the time on the device be upon appearing?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: {b}t+X{/b}, or 2:39.{w} Then {b}2X{/b} seconds would pass to reach the future state.
entries.literal: "{b}t+X{/b}, or 2:39.{w} Then {b}2X{/b} seconds would pass to reach the future state."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The timer would read {b}t+3X{/b}, or 2:57, but that contradicts the past position.{w}  The timer at arrival would have to be {b}t+3X{/b}.
entries.literal: "The timer would read {b}t+3X{/b}, or 2:57, but that contradicts the past position.{w}  The timer at arrival would have to be {b}t+3X{/b}."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But nothing stops this from continuing. Another {b}2X{/b} seconds would be added...
entries.literal: "But nothing stops this from continuing. Another {b}2X{/b} seconds would be added..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The recorder's time would add up infinitely, and eventually its battery would run out.
entries.literal: "The recorder's time would add up infinitely, and eventually its battery would run out."

entries.speaker: nm
