entries.text: This can't make sense, though.{w} If the replicated location is one that occurs after touching the Sekimeiya, we would die.
entries.literal: "This can't make sense, though.{w} If the replicated location is one that occurs after touching the Sekimeiya, we would die."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Just like with the recorder's timer, my age would've increased by a few seconds repeatedly, making me die instantly upon traveling to the past.
entries.literal: "Just like with the recorder's timer, my age would've increased by a few seconds repeatedly, making me die instantly upon traveling to the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If the device aged in a loop until it ran out of batteries, its appearance would've changed too. It would've degraded, probably even disintegrated into nothing.
entries.literal: "If the device aged in a loop until it ran out of batteries, its appearance would've changed too. It would've degraded, probably even disintegrated into nothing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, isn't this what happened... to Sai's watch?{w} Not only to Sai, but to a Sai who I have to assume traveled to the past. When I saw him, he should've been in the attic, so he'd come from the future. Later, I learned his watch had stopped working again.
entries.literal: "However, isn't this what happened... to Sai's watch?{w} Not only to Sai, but to a Sai who I have to assume traveled to the past. When I saw him, he should've been in the attic, so he'd come from the future. Later, I learned his watch had stopped working again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If he appeared five minutes in the past where he would be ten minutes after his appearance... the time on his watch would've increased by ten minutes infinitely, and the battery would've eventually stopped working.{w} There's no way it would've lasted thousands of years, though, so what the hell?{w} And why would the watch's inner mechanism add up the looped time while its outer appearance wasn't affected?
entries.literal: "If he appeared five minutes in the past where he would be ten minutes after his appearance... the time on his watch would've increased by ten minutes infinitely, and the battery would've eventually stopped working.{w} There's no way it would've lasted thousands of years, though, so what the hell?{w} And why would the watch's inner mechanism add up the looped time while its outer appearance wasn't affected?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The recorder isn't working anymore, so I can't keep testing.
entries.literal: "...The recorder isn't working anymore, so I can't keep testing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, no. I can make it work again if what I've concluded is correct.{w} After all, just minutes ago, I was holding it when it worked. I just have to replicate that location, which should be easy. I only have to travel a couple minutes to the future.
entries.literal: "Wait, no. I can make it work again if what I've concluded is correct.{w} After all, just minutes ago, I was holding it when it worked. I just have to replicate that location, which should be easy. I only have to travel a couple minutes to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was what I did. I put the broken recorder in a drawer and traveled to the future. When I appeared, I was holding the device. The timer on its screen said 1:35, as it was still working.
entries.literal: "That was what I did. I put the broken recorder in a drawer and traveled to the future. When I appeared, I was holding the device. The timer on its screen said 1:35, as it was still working."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is definitely how traveling to the future works, then...
entries.literal: "This is definitely how traveling to the future works, then..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But what about traveling to the past? Did all those travels work like this as well?
entries.literal: "But what about traveling to the past? Did all those travels work like this as well?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The first time I went to the past, I appeared in the lobby, right in front of the hallway A door. I later determined I'd gone about twenty minutes to the past.
entries.literal: "The first time I went to the past, I appeared in the lobby, right in front of the hallway A door. I later determined I'd gone about twenty minutes to the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, twenty minutes after the point I touched the Sekimeiya...{w} I was in the lobby, right in front of the hallway A door. I was watching the hallway while the others looked through every room.
entries.literal: "So, twenty minutes after the point I touched the Sekimeiya...{w} I was in the lobby, right in front of the hallway A door. I was watching the hallway while the others looked through every room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Seriously...? Is this what's been happening?
entries.literal: "Seriously...? Is this what's been happening?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Later, Shiroya and I traveled about forty minutes to the past. I appeared in the security room, sitting down. However, the chair wasn't there to support me, so I fell to the floor.
entries.literal: "Later, Shiroya and I traveled about forty minutes to the past. I appeared in the security room, sitting down. However, the chair wasn't there to support me, so I fell to the floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Forty minutes after the time we touched the Sekimeiya... I really was in the security room, looking at the computer. Sai had just run away from me, and I even looked at the time. I was there from {time=12:18} to {time=12:31.}
entries.literal: "Forty minutes after the time we touched the Sekimeiya... I really was in the security room, looking at the computer. Sai had just run away from me, and I even looked at the time. I was there from {time=12:18} to {time=12:31.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even Shiroya... She said she'd appeared in the second floor offices, and when we reunited outside the security room, she'd just been searching for me through every floor starting from the top. Both of us had just been in the locations we'd appeared.
entries.literal: "Even Shiroya... She said she'd appeared in the second floor offices, and when we reunited outside the security room, she'd just been searching for me through every floor starting from the top. Both of us had just been in the locations we'd appeared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could hardly believe it, but I finally knew the logic behind what had agonizingly eluded me: the replicated location.
entries.literal: "I could hardly believe it, but I finally knew the logic behind what had agonizingly eluded me: the replicated location."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But hang on... Does this mean that every time we touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in a location we recognized, we'd gone to the future? ...It's only traveling to the future that replicates a past coordinate you've been at.
entries.literal: "But hang on... Does this mean that every time we touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in a location we recognized, we'd gone to the future? ...It's only traveling to the future that replicates a past coordinate you've been at."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is absurd, though! It doesn't even make sense!
entries.literal: "This is absurd, though! It doesn't even make sense!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why the hell did I appear in the security room in the past!? Because I was later in the security room? That's nonsense!
entries.literal: "Why the hell did I appear in the security room in the past!? Because I was later in the security room? That's nonsense!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why the security room? If I had appeared in the attic, for example, I would've been somewhere else eighty minutes later! I was only in the security room in the future because it's where I appeared in the past!
entries.literal: "Why the security room? If I had appeared in the attic, for example, I would've been somewhere else eighty minutes later! I was only in the security room in the future because it's where I appeared in the past!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why couldn't I have appeared on another continent? Then I would've been there in the future and made it come true!
entries.literal: "Why couldn't I have appeared on another continent? Then I would've been there in the future and made it come true!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's nonsense! What's actually determining where we appear?{w} Something must be. We appeared inside the tower every single time.
entries.literal: "It's nonsense! What's actually determining where we appear?{w} Something must be. We appeared inside the tower every single time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya and Atsuki had spent a long time in the elevator. Thanks to the stop button, they had managed to escape from Sai.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and Atsuki had spent a long time in the elevator. Thanks to the stop button, they had managed to escape from Sai."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But Shiroya soon noticed something was happening to Atsuki. He looked pale, and his breathing had sped up.
entries.literal: "But Shiroya soon noticed something was happening to Atsuki. He looked pale, and his breathing had sped up."

entries.speaker: snn
entries.text: ...Are you okay?
entries.literal: "...Are you okay?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Yes, don't worry.
entries.literal: "Yes, don't worry."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya stared at her lap, worried about Atsuki's thoughts. Did he, perhaps, think they wouldn't be able to leave?
entries.literal: "Shiroya stared at her lap, worried about Atsuki's thoughts. Did he, perhaps, think they wouldn't be able to leave?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The silence went on for a long time.
entries.literal: "The silence went on for a long time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Eventually, Shiroya experienced some relief. Atsuki had closed his eyes, and he didn't appear to be as stressed. Mirroring him, Shiroya closed her eyes too.
entries.literal: "Eventually, Shiroya experienced some relief. Atsuki had closed his eyes, and he didn't appear to be as stressed. Mirroring him, Shiroya closed her eyes too."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Minutes later, both pairs of eyes shot open at the same time, and Shiroya couldn't believe what she saw.
entries.literal: "Minutes later, both pairs of eyes shot open at the same time, and Shiroya couldn't believe what she saw."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A knife was buried in Atsuki's chest.{w} She looked directly into his eyes, but only silence filled the elevator—neither of them could bring themselves to utter a word.
entries.literal: "A knife was buried in Atsuki's chest.{w} She looked directly into his eyes, but only silence filled the elevator—neither of them could bring themselves to utter a word."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, Shiroya looked at the hand gripping the knife. She followed it up to an arm and then a shoulder.{w} Finally, she traced it to Sai's face.
entries.literal: "Then, Shiroya looked at the hand gripping the knife. She followed it up to an arm and then a shoulder.{w} Finally, she traced it to Sai's face."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But that sight didn't last long. Immediately after killing his first victim, Sai felt the urge to have a second. With a frantic motion, the knife sliced Shiroya's chest.
entries.literal: "But that sight didn't last long. Immediately after killing his first victim, Sai felt the urge to have a second. With a frantic motion, the knife sliced Shiroya's chest."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before she could process the scene, Shiroya's body fell beside Atsuki, their blood pooling together in the elevator.
entries.literal: "Before she could process the scene, Shiroya's body fell beside Atsuki, their blood pooling together in the elevator."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Of course, you know this never occurred.
entries.literal: "Of course, you know this never occurred."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If it had, though... how would it have come to happen?
entries.literal: "If it had, though... how would it have come to happen?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai stared at both bodies momentarily. However, he didn't immediately understand that he was trapped.
entries.literal: "Sai stared at both bodies momentarily. However, he didn't immediately understand that he was trapped."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had pressed the stop button, so Sai couldn't leave the elevator.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had pressed the stop button, so Sai couldn't leave the elevator."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He couldn't move either—two bodies were on the floor. Eventually, when the replicated location took place, Sai was exactly where he'd appeared.
entries.literal: "He couldn't move either—two bodies were on the floor. Eventually, when the replicated location took place, Sai was exactly where he'd appeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But... why? He was able to be there in the future because he had appeared there in the past. {tip=saielevator}Why had that been the location where he'd appeared?{/tip} Why not somewhere else?
entries.literal: "But... why? He was able to be there in the future because he had appeared there in the past. {tip=saielevator}Why had that been the location where he'd appeared?{/tip} Why not somewhere else?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Maybe you have a good idea.
entries.literal: "Maybe you have a good idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea. It seemed to make no sense at all.
entries.literal: "I had no idea. It seemed to make no sense at all."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But what the hell would happen now if I travel to the past?{w} Let's say I travel two minutes back and appear in the kitchen. Will it be guaranteed that I'll be in the kitchen four minutes later?
entries.literal: "But what the hell would happen now if I travel to the past?{w} Let's say I travel two minutes back and appear in the kitchen. Will it be guaranteed that I'll be in the kitchen four minutes later?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if I don't want to? What if I decide to leave?{w} Does the location where I appear force me to be somewhere in the future? That makes even less sense!
entries.literal: "What if I don't want to? What if I decide to leave?{w} Does the location where I appear force me to be somewhere in the future? That makes even less sense!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned, curious. What would actually happen? I had never traveled with knowledge of how the replicated location worked, but it seemed like having that knowledge alone would break the rule—I would no longer replicate the location in the future through some weird, unconscious fate.
entries.literal: "I frowned, curious. What would actually happen? I had never traveled with knowledge of how the replicated location worked, but it seemed like having that knowledge alone would break the rule—I would no longer replicate the location in the future through some weird, unconscious fate."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I mean, if I do appear in the kitchen, can I refuse to be there in the future? Can I risk doing that just out of curiosity?{w} What if it's the universe's rule? Would I end up not trying to go against it out of fear of what might happen, which would confirm the impossibility of being in a paradoxical location?
entries.literal: "I mean, if I do appear in the kitchen, can I refuse to be there in the future? Can I risk doing that just out of curiosity?{w} What if it's the universe's rule? Would I end up not trying to go against it out of fear of what might happen, which would confirm the impossibility of being in a paradoxical location?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's pretty similar to not attempting to change the past just in case it's not possible, but it can't be fought, can it?
entries.literal: "That's pretty similar to not attempting to change the past just in case it's not possible, but it can't be fought, can it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And yet it doesn't make sense. Why would I purposely be somewhere just because it's where I appeared in the past?
entries.literal: "...And yet it doesn't make sense. Why would I purposely be somewhere just because it's where I appeared in the past?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I wonder. Can I maybe take advantage of it?
entries.literal: "...I wonder. Can I maybe take advantage of it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It doesn't seem fair that figuring out how it works would be a detriment if I intend to travel back. Until now, the rule has been consistent through mere fate, but it wouldn't be the same if I was aware of it as it happened.
entries.literal: "It doesn't seem fair that figuring out how it works would be a detriment if I intend to travel back. Until now, the rule has been consistent through mere fate, but it wouldn't be the same if I was aware of it as it happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: A way to put the knowledge into practice... Maybe, as long as I have accurate knowledge...
entries.literal: "A way to put the knowledge into practice... Maybe, as long as I have accurate knowledge..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put the Sekimeiya that had sent me to the past in the refrigerator. After I waited a bit, I took it back out.
entries.literal: "I put the Sekimeiya that had sent me to the past in the refrigerator. After I waited a bit, I took it back out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I set the timer and waited half a minute. Then, I brought my hand toward its glow.
entries.literal: "I set the timer and waited half a minute. Then, I brought my hand toward its glow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: All right. Will you send me to the living room?
entries.literal: "All right. Will you send me to the living room?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was where I appeared: in the middle of the room.
entries.literal: "That was where I appeared: in the middle of the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And so I waited. I had traveled nine seconds to the past, so the only mandatory rule was that I had to be there after eighteen seconds.{w} ...But I didn't wait there because the universe had forced me to—I did it so that my request could be fulfilled.
entries.literal: "And so I waited. I had traveled nine seconds to the past, so the only mandatory rule was that I had to be there after eighteen seconds.{w} ...But I didn't wait there because the universe had forced me to—I did it so that my request could be fulfilled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eighteen seconds later, I was still there.
entries.literal: "Eighteen seconds later, I was still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before touching the Sekimeiya, I had thought of what would happen. I had thought that eighteen seconds after appearing in the past, I would be in the living room.{w} Of course, if that was the case, it implied I would appear in the living room, so it was what had happened. Then, to make it possible, I'd remained there, exactly where I'd imagined myself appearing.
entries.literal: "Before touching the Sekimeiya, I had thought of what would happen. I had thought that eighteen seconds after appearing in the past, I would be in the living room.{w} Of course, if that was the case, it implied I would appear in the living room, so it was what had happened. Then, to make it possible, I'd remained there, exactly where I'd imagined myself appearing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. So this is the opposite of useless.
entries.literal: "I see. So this is the opposite of useless."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's like the thought-up loops that I came up with. As long as the loop is in my head before touching the Sekimeiya, and as long as it can be executed, it will work.{w} "As long as it can be executed". Didn't I just travel from the 5th of January to the 15th of December?
entries.literal: "It's like the thought-up loops that I came up with. As long as the loop is in my head before touching the Sekimeiya, and as long as it can be executed, it will work.{w} \"As long as it can be executed\". Didn't I just travel from the 5th of January to the 15th of December?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I went 21 days into the past, and my knowledge of the replicated location came after the travel but before the location is replicated in the future. What the hell happens now?{w} I appeared in the lobby; does that confirm that I'll be alive in the future?
entries.literal: "I went 21 days into the past, and my knowledge of the replicated location came after the travel but before the location is replicated in the future. What the hell happens now?{w} I appeared in the lobby; does that confirm that I'll be alive in the future?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Doesn't this travel genuinely force me to be in the lobby on the day—
entries.literal: "Doesn't this travel genuinely force me to be in the lobby on the day—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}I went 21 days to the past.{w} 21 days after January 5th is a Thursday, January 26th...
entries.literal: "...{w}I went 21 days to the past.{w} 21 days after January 5th is a Thursday, January 26th..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was something there. That wasn't some random day.{w} Shiroya and I had talked with Miiya about it. We had said that we would go back to the tower on the 26th if we liked it the first time.
entries.literal: "There was something there. That wasn't some random day.{w} Shiroya and I had talked with Miiya about it. We had said that we would go back to the tower on the 26th if we liked it the first time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Miiya had died because of the Sekimeiya—without the Sekimeiya's existence, the explosion wouldn't have occurred, and Miiya would've kept on living. Ashiya held an event in the tower every Thursday, and on January 26th, a Thursday, an event that had grabbed our attention would take place.{w} If the Sekimeiya hadn't existed, we would've been in the tower on January 26th. Even after Miiya's death, if no travels had taken place, it was feasible that Shiroya and I would've returned to continue healing and moving forward. But from what I understood, our reason for returning would be different—to satisfy a travel that had already happened.
entries.literal: "Miiya had died because of the Sekimeiya—without the Sekimeiya's existence, the explosion wouldn't have occurred, and Miiya would've kept on living. Ashiya held an event in the tower every Thursday, and on January 26th, a Thursday, an event that had grabbed our attention would take place.{w} If the Sekimeiya hadn't existed, we would've been in the tower on January 26th. Even after Miiya's death, if no travels had taken place, it was feasible that Shiroya and I would've returned to continue healing and moving forward. But from what I understood, our reason for returning would be different—to satisfy a travel that had already happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What was the exact truth hidden behind that? I didn't know, but it confirmed again that the locations where we appeared were in no way random.
entries.literal: "What was the exact truth hidden behind that? I didn't know, but it confirmed again that the locations where we appeared were in no way random."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This means that I can pretty much teleport anywhere I want, doesn't it?{w} I just have to think about where I'll be in the future. The limit is that the location has to be possible to reach in a set time. Is that it?
entries.literal: "This means that I can pretty much teleport anywhere I want, doesn't it?{w} I just have to think about where I'll be in the future. The limit is that the location has to be possible to reach in a set time. Is that it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the kitchen and briefly put the Past Sekimeiya in the refrigerator. Once it had stored energy for thirty seconds, I touched it.
entries.literal: "I went to the kitchen and briefly put the Past Sekimeiya in the refrigerator. Once it had stored energy for thirty seconds, I touched it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once more, I appeared in the living room, where I'd wanted to appear.{w} I looked at my hands, but they were empty.
entries.literal: "Once more, I appeared in the living room, where I'd wanted to appear.{w} I looked at my hands, but they were empty."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. I guess that was too nonsensical to work.
entries.literal: "I see. I guess that was too nonsensical to work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before touching the Sekimeiya, I had thought that I'd be in the living room with a chocolate bar in my hands. By appearing there with the chocolate, I would be able to have it in the future so that it could appear in the past.{w} Presumably, that hadn't worked because I could never have obtained that chocolate in the span of those seconds, so I went back to the kitchen after I waited the proper amount of time.
entries.literal: "Before touching the Sekimeiya, I had thought that I'd be in the living room with a chocolate bar in my hands. By appearing there with the chocolate, I would be able to have it in the future so that it could appear in the past.{w} Presumably, that hadn't worked because I could never have obtained that chocolate in the span of those seconds, so I went back to the kitchen after I waited the proper amount of time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I touched the Past Sekimeiya after it had gathered energy for thirty seconds.
entries.literal: "Once again, I touched the Past Sekimeiya after it had gathered energy for thirty seconds."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After I appeared in the living room, I looked at my hands.{w} I was holding a pen.
entries.literal: "After I appeared in the living room, I looked at my hands.{w} I was holding a pen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked next to the television and saw the same pen.
entries.literal: "I looked next to the television and saw the same pen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see... This does work.
entries.literal: "I see... This does work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before touching the Sekimeiya, I'd thought that I would appear in the living room, and that during those eighteen seconds, I would go grab the pen. That was why I had appeared with it.{w} However, I already had the pen. I didn't have to go get it; I could simply stay where I'd appeared so that I could appear with it.
entries.literal: "Before touching the Sekimeiya, I'd thought that I would appear in the living room, and that during those eighteen seconds, I would go grab the pen. That was why I had appeared with it.{w} However, I already had the pen. I didn't have to go get it; I could simply stay where I'd appeared so that I could appear with it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eighteen seconds went by, and I didn't step away from where I'd appeared.
entries.literal: "Eighteen seconds went by, and I didn't step away from where I'd appeared."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, even though I never obtained the pen myself, I was able to appear with it solely because I could have obtained it. I effectively duplicated the pen, but I can't spawn objects that don't exist or I can't feasibly obtain before the future coordinate, like the chocolate. And this only happened because I thought of my actions before touching the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "So, even though I never obtained the pen myself, I was able to appear with it solely because I could have obtained it. I effectively duplicated the pen, but I can't spawn objects that don't exist or I can't feasibly obtain before the future coordinate, like the chocolate. And this only happened because I thought of my actions before touching the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a fascinating concept, and an incredibly strong one. Simply by having awareness of a single rule, the Sekimeiya had grown drastically more useful.
entries.literal: "It was a fascinating concept, and an incredibly strong one. Simply by having awareness of a single rule, the Sekimeiya had grown drastically more useful."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I touch the Past Sekimeiya while I'm holding the pen now, I'll appear with it in the past. However, that's possible only as long as I have it in the proportional future.
entries.literal: "If I touch the Past Sekimeiya while I'm holding the pen now, I'll appear with it in the past. However, that's possible only as long as I have it in the proportional future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So when I touch the Sekimeiya, if I either think that I'll let go of the pen before the time expires or otherwise wouldn't have it, I won't appear with it. I would be instantly annihilating the pen without having to actually get rid of it. Even though I should appear with it, I wouldn't.
entries.literal: "So when I touch the Sekimeiya, if I either think that I'll let go of the pen before the time expires or otherwise wouldn't have it, I won't appear with it. I would be instantly annihilating the pen without having to actually get rid of it. Even though I should appear with it, I wouldn't."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Exactly. On January 5th, Shiroya traveled to December 15th and noticed that out of the things she'd been holding, only her phone had disappeared.
entries.literal: "Exactly. On January 5th, Shiroya traveled to December 15th and noticed that out of the things she'd been holding, only her phone had disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why?{w} She appeared in the lobby of the tower, and the future coordinate was January 26th. I'm sure you haven't forgotten that phones are strictly prohibited in the tower: she couldn't have been there with it in the future, so she appeared without it in the past.
entries.literal: "Why?{w} She appeared in the lobby of the tower, and the future coordinate was January 26th. I'm sure you haven't forgotten that phones are strictly prohibited in the tower: she couldn't have been there with it in the future, so she appeared without it in the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You might have realized that the same thing happened to the "XYN" card, which she didn't think about, and her clothes. Unlike Atsuki, she didn't appear with the ones she'd been wearing. ...That's still strange, isn't it?
entries.literal: "You might have realized that the same thing happened to the \"XYN\" card, which she didn't think about, and her clothes. Unlike Atsuki, she didn't appear with the ones she'd been wearing. ...That's still strange, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The knife disappeared from Shiroya's purse when she traveled to the future because she didn't have it in the past, so it would've been impossible for her to appear with it.
entries.literal: "The knife disappeared from Shiroya's purse when she traveled to the future because she didn't have it in the past, so it would've been impossible for her to appear with it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But on January 5th, when she traveled to December 15th, she noticed that out of the things she'd been holding, only her phone had disappeared. She didn't think about it, but the "XYN" card did as well, and her clothes had changed.
entries.literal: "But on January 5th, when she traveled to December 15th, she noticed that out of the things she'd been holding, only her phone had disappeared. She didn't think about it, but the \"XYN\" card did as well, and her clothes had changed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why?{w} She appeared in the lobby of the tower, and the future coordinate was January 26th. I'm sure you haven't forgotten that phones are strictly prohibited in the tower: she couldn't have been there with it in the future, so she appeared without it in the past.
entries.literal: "Why?{w} She appeared in the lobby of the tower, and the future coordinate was January 26th. I'm sure you haven't forgotten that phones are strictly prohibited in the tower: she couldn't have been there with it in the future, so she appeared without it in the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The cleaning cart disappeared when Shiroya traveled to the future because she didn't have it in the past, so it would've been impossible for her to appear with it.
entries.literal: "The cleaning cart disappeared when Shiroya traveled to the future because she didn't have it in the past, so it would've been impossible for her to appear with it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But on January 5th, when she traveled to December 15th, she noticed that out of the things she'd been holding, only her phone had disappeared. She didn't think about it, but the "XYN" card did as well, and her clothes had changed.
entries.literal: "But on January 5th, when she traveled to December 15th, she noticed that out of the things she'd been holding, only her phone had disappeared. She didn't think about it, but the \"XYN\" card did as well, and her clothes had changed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why?{w} She appeared in the lobby of the tower, and the future coordinate was January 26th. I'm sure you haven't forgotten that phones are strictly prohibited in the tower: she couldn't have been there with it in the future, so she appeared without it in the past.
entries.literal: "Why?{w} She appeared in the lobby of the tower, and the future coordinate was January 26th. I'm sure you haven't forgotten that phones are strictly prohibited in the tower: she couldn't have been there with it in the future, so she appeared without it in the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is pretty insane. I can't believe the mechanics actually followed some rules.
entries.literal: "This is pretty insane. I can't believe the mechanics actually followed some rules."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was overwhelmed by the number of things I was learning, but I didn't want to focus on a single detail. I didn't know if anyone else would come back at some point, and there were plenty of aspects I was wondering about.
entries.literal: "I was overwhelmed by the number of things I was learning, but I didn't want to focus on a single detail. I didn't know if anyone else would come back at some point, and there were plenty of aspects I was wondering about."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How much can I figure out with what I know? Was Sai aware of all this? He had a wristwatch, so I bet it would've been a lot easier for him to learn some of it.{w} There were two Sekimeiya since this morning, but what about the third one? Does that one never work...?
entries.literal: "How much can I figure out with what I know? Was Sai aware of all this? He had a wristwatch, so I bet it would've been a lot easier for him to learn some of it.{w} There were two Sekimeiya since this morning, but what about the third one? Does that one never work...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And one made us travel back in time, while the other sent us forward.{w} If I know the time someone appeared in the future, I can know that's where they were in the past—there are many ways to apply all of this.{w} I wonder... When someone travels to the past, if I think that I'll bring them somewhere in the future, would I make them appear there in the past? Could the origin be in my mind even though I'm not the one traveling?
entries.literal: "And one made us travel back in time, while the other sent us forward.{w} If I know the time someone appeared in the future, I can know that's where they were in the past—there are many ways to apply all of this.{w} I wonder... When someone travels to the past, if I think that I'll bring them somewhere in the future, would I make them appear there in the past? Could the origin be in my mind even though I'm not the one traveling?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to calm down a bit and went to the kitchen. It was better to answer the larger questions first.
entries.literal: "I tried to calm down a bit and went to the kitchen. It was better to answer the larger questions first."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait a second. I can duplicate anything obtainable, can't I?
entries.literal: "Wait a second. I can duplicate anything obtainable, can't I?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We wondered whether duplicating the Sekimeiya was possible, but it doesn't appear to be the case. When it's activated, it doesn't count as something you possess, and it stays behind.
entries.literal: "We wondered whether duplicating the Sekimeiya was possible, but it doesn't appear to be the case. When it's activated, it doesn't count as something you possess, and it stays behind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now I'm certain that the Sai with the broken wristwatch came from the future, and he had a Sekimeiya in his hip pack. He acted as if he didn't know it was there, so perhaps that was the truth.
entries.literal: "Now I'm certain that the Sai with the broken wristwatch came from the future, and he had a Sekimeiya in his hip pack. He acted as if he didn't know it was there, so perhaps that was the truth."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe he appeared with it. An important detail is that it was inactive.{w} If he hid a powered-off Sekimeiya in his hip pack in the future, it's possible he appeared with it in the past.
entries.literal: "Maybe he appeared with it. An important detail is that it was inactive.{w} If he hid a powered-off Sekimeiya in his hip pack in the future, it's possible he appeared with it in the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trying it was simple. First, I used the Past Sekimeiya to travel nine seconds to the past.
entries.literal: "Trying it was simple. First, I used the Past Sekimeiya to travel nine seconds to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the living room, I waited eighteen seconds before I reentered the kitchen.
entries.literal: "In the living room, I waited eighteen seconds before I reentered the kitchen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya will now spend a little while powered off.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya will now spend a little while powered off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the Future Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator and grabbed the disabled Past Sekimeiya.{w} Half a minute later, I left it on the countertop and touched the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I took the Future Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator and grabbed the disabled Past Sekimeiya.{w} Half a minute later, I left it on the countertop and touched the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I appeared in the kitchen nine seconds in the future. Then, I glanced at my hands.
entries.literal: "I appeared in the kitchen nine seconds in the future. Then, I glanced at my hands."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was there. Still gray, I had it in my hands.
entries.literal: "It was there. Still gray, I had it in my hands."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did I really duplicate it...?
entries.literal: "Did I really duplicate it...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the marble, where I'd left the Past Sekimeiya before traveling.
entries.literal: "I looked at the marble, where I'd left the Past Sekimeiya before traveling."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What!? It's not there!
entries.literal: "What!? It's not there!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Future Sekimeiya was where I'd touched it, and it was gray. That proved I'd traveled to the future. However, the original Past Sekimeiya was gone: I hadn't duplicated it.
entries.literal: "The Future Sekimeiya was where I'd touched it, and it was gray. That proved I'd traveled to the future. However, the original Past Sekimeiya was gone: I hadn't duplicated it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell? Can the Sekimeiya not be duplicated?{w} It seems like the original one disappeared when I appeared with it in the future and disallowed the duplication. There's no way anyone came and took it during the nine seconds I wasn't here, right?
entries.literal: "What the hell? Can the Sekimeiya not be duplicated?{w} It seems like the original one disappeared when I appeared with it in the future and disallowed the duplication. There's no way anyone came and took it during the nine seconds I wasn't here, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was bizarre, but the fact that I'd appeared with it was notable. It had counted as one of my past possessions.
entries.literal: "It was bizarre, but the fact that I'd appeared with it was notable. It had counted as one of my past possessions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I was thinking, the Past Sekimeiya powered on.
entries.literal: "While I was thinking, the Past Sekimeiya powered on."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's still working.{w} I wonder if the fact that it was powered off mattered at all.
entries.literal: "It's still working.{w} I wonder if the fact that it was powered off mattered at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I repeated the same process but held the powered Past Sekimeiya with my sleeves for half a minute.{w} Then, I left it in the refrigerator to avoid overlapping ranges and went nine seconds to the future.
entries.literal: "I repeated the same process but held the powered Past Sekimeiya with my sleeves for half a minute.{w} Then, I left it in the refrigerator to avoid overlapping ranges and went nine seconds to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I didn't appear with the Sekimeiya. My hands looked to be holding something that wasn't there.
entries.literal: "...{w}I didn't appear with the Sekimeiya. My hands looked to be holding something that wasn't there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the refrigerator and saw the Past Sekimeiya where I'd just left it.
entries.literal: "I opened the refrigerator and saw the Past Sekimeiya where I'd just left it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So it did matter that it wasn't active. When it isn't, its powers fade temporarily, and it acts as a normal object.
entries.literal: "So it did matter that it wasn't active. When it isn't, its powers fade temporarily, and it acts as a normal object."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What would happen if I did the reverse of this? Wouldn't the past change?{w} If I go to the past holding the powered-off Future Sekimeiya, I would appear with it in the past, so the "original" one would disappear. That means that I couldn't hold it anymore when I'm traveling to the past, thereby changing it.
entries.literal: "What would happen if I did the reverse of this? Wouldn't the past change?{w} If I go to the past holding the powered-off Future Sekimeiya, I would appear with it in the past, so the \"original\" one would disappear. That means that I couldn't hold it anymore when I'm traveling to the past, thereby changing it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried it out of curiosity. Holding the Future Sekimeiya that I'd powered off, I went nine seconds to the past.
entries.literal: "I tried it out of curiosity. Holding the Future Sekimeiya that I'd powered off, I went nine seconds to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the living room, however, I didn't have the Future Sekimeiya between my hands.
entries.literal: "In the living room, however, I didn't have the Future Sekimeiya between my hands."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It didn't work? I thought that I would stay here for eighteen seconds with the Sekimeiya, so that's strange.
entries.literal: "It didn't work? I thought that I would stay here for eighteen seconds with the Sekimeiya, so that's strange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, I heard a sound coming from the kitchen. It scared me at first, but I immediately understood what it was.{w} Nine seconds later, I entered through the door.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, I heard a sound coming from the kitchen. It scared me at first, but I immediately understood what it was.{w} Nine seconds later, I entered through the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The disabled Sekimeiya was on the floor. It hadn't disappeared alongside my past self.
entries.literal: "The disabled Sekimeiya was on the floor. It hadn't disappeared alongside my past self."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why, though? I don't get it.{w} ...Wait, no, I might have an idea.
entries.literal: "Why, though? I don't get it.{w} ...Wait, no, I might have an idea."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I think it's due to the infinite loop concept I thought of.{w} If I had appeared with the powered-off Future Sekimeiya in the past, eighteen seconds later, it would've been closer to powering on. Once the infinite loop is applied, the Sekimeiya could've never appeared powered off, and when it's powered on, it doesn't count as a normal object. I believe that's why it didn't travel.
entries.literal: "I think it's due to the infinite loop concept I thought of.{w} If I had appeared with the powered-off Future Sekimeiya in the past, eighteen seconds later, it would've been closer to powering on. Once the infinite loop is applied, the Sekimeiya could've never appeared powered off, and when it's powered on, it doesn't count as a normal object. I believe that's why it didn't travel."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What exactly would happen if I wait in the middle of the living room for a few seconds, move the sofa to where I'd been standing, and then travel to the future?
entries.literal: "...What exactly would happen if I wait in the middle of the living room for a few seconds, move the sofa to where I'd been standing, and then travel to the future?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: My appearance would collide with the sofa, but what would that do? Would I overwrite part of the sofa? Would it cut off my legs and kill me?
entries.literal: "My appearance would collide with the sofa, but what would that do? Would I overwrite part of the sofa? Would it cut off my legs and kill me?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's too risky to test that, but I have no idea what the result would be. After all, I've been appearing where there is air, and it seems I'm overwriting it, or else it would also kill me.
entries.literal: "It's too risky to test that, but I have no idea what the result would be. After all, I've been appearing where there is air, and it seems I'm overwriting it, or else it would also kill me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The case might be different if I appear on top of a solid object, though.
entries.literal: "The case might be different if I appear on top of a solid object, though."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Indeed. That is the fate Sai A met.
entries.literal: "Indeed. That is the fate Sai A met."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Incorrect. That is the fate Sai A met.
entries.literal: "Incorrect. That is the fate Sai A met."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In his world, he was the first person to leave room B4, in which everyone waited.
entries.literal: "In his world, he was the first person to leave room B4, in which everyone waited."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After his departure, he never came back. He was never again seen alive.
entries.literal: "After his departure, he never came back. He was never again seen alive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unaware of what awaited him, he touched the Future Sekimeiya that had been hidden in the attic.
entries.literal: "Unaware of what awaited him, he touched the Future Sekimeiya that had been hidden in the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For a prolonged period of time, he had been sitting against a door in a crystal room. However, when he appeared there in the future, that door had been opened...
entries.literal: "For a prolonged period of time, he had been sitting against a door in a crystal room. However, when he appeared there in the future, that door had been opened..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I've been figuring all of this out, but I still don't fully understand the most important aspect: the amount of time traveled.{w} I've been repeatedly traveling nine seconds through time, so it has to be consistent as well.
entries.literal: "I've been figuring all of this out, but I still don't fully understand the most important aspect: the amount of time traveled.{w} I've been repeatedly traveling nine seconds through time, so it has to be consistent as well."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Thirty seconds stored equals nine seconds traveled. Two minutes stored equals 45 seconds traveled.{w} There's already an indication here: each stored second turns into more amount of time traveled than the previous. In the first case, each second stored added 0.3 seconds traveled. In the second case, each second stored added 0.37 seconds traveled.
entries.literal: "Thirty seconds stored equals nine seconds traveled. Two minutes stored equals 45 seconds traveled.{w} There's already an indication here: each stored second turns into more amount of time traveled than the previous. In the first case, each second stored added 0.3 seconds traveled. In the second case, each second stored added 0.37 seconds traveled."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And it's evident this keeps going—fifteen minutes stored led into twenty minutes traveled. In that case, each second stored added 1.3 seconds.{w} Earlier, keeping the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet for 25 minutes made me travel about 45 minutes to the past. That's a pretty noticeable increase. Each stored second would've counted for 1.8 seconds traveled.
entries.literal: "And it's evident this keeps going—fifteen minutes stored led into twenty minutes traveled. In that case, each second stored added 1.3 seconds.{w} Earlier, keeping the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet for 25 minutes made me travel about 45 minutes to the past. That's a pretty noticeable increase. Each stored second would've counted for 1.8 seconds traveled."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So the more time it's gathered, the larger the increase is. It's exponential.{w} The difference between five and ten minutes is very little compared to the difference between twenty and 25. For a while, the numbers will be low, but there'll be a point where they suddenly become immense.{w} Once the Sekimeiya has been out of the cabinet for 35 minutes, how much will one stored second equal to?{w} ...What about after an hour?
entries.literal: "So the more time it's gathered, the larger the increase is. It's exponential.{w} The difference between five and ten minutes is very little compared to the difference between twenty and 25. For a while, the numbers will be low, but there'll be a point where they suddenly become immense.{w} Once the Sekimeiya has been out of the cabinet for 35 minutes, how much will one stored second equal to?{w} ...What about after an hour?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's an indication that I'm correct about this: Akaro and Shiroya.{w} They traveled days through time, and so did I. Akaro said he touched the Sekimeiya while we were in the attic's bedroom, so it's very possible it stored energy for a long time.
entries.literal: "There's an indication that I'm correct about this: Akaro and Shiroya.{w} They traveled days through time, and so did I. Akaro said he touched the Sekimeiya while we were in the attic's bedroom, so it's very possible it stored energy for a long time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In any case, the increase of the time traveled is not gradual. However, I think something might be.
entries.literal: "In any case, the increase of the time traveled is not gradual. However, I think something might be."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The range. That's what all the travels indicate.
entries.literal: "The range. That's what all the travels indicate."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Although I still don't fully comprehend it, I believe it must work under a gradual increase. Otherwise, when Akaro and Shiroya traveled days through time, we would've traveled as well.
entries.literal: "Although I still don't fully comprehend it, I believe it must work under a gradual increase. Otherwise, when Akaro and Shiroya traveled days through time, we would've traveled as well."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There is something else that could follow a similar progression, which is the time it spends recovering.{w} No matter the amount of time traveled, the Sekimeiya always spends a while gray. However, the amount of time stored seems to gradually add to the guaranteed amount.
entries.literal: "There is something else that could follow a similar progression, which is the time it spends recovering.{w} No matter the amount of time traveled, the Sekimeiya always spends a while gray. However, the amount of time stored seems to gradually add to the guaranteed amount."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's gotta be a formula behind the amount of time traveled that always applies.
entries.literal: "There's gotta be a formula behind the amount of time traveled that always applies."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What could it be? A formula that increases the amount each second adds as more seconds have passed...{w} If I could figure it out, I could use the Sekimeiya to appear at any point in time.
entries.literal: "What could it be? A formula that increases the amount each second adds as more seconds have passed...{w} If I could figure it out, I could use the Sekimeiya to appear at any point in time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Thankfully, if it doesn't change over time, I could do small-scale tests to figure out what exactly would occur at a larger scale; observing the difference between 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, and 35 stored seconds might be all I need to understand what one hour of stored time would cause.
entries.literal: "Thankfully, if it doesn't change over time, I could do small-scale tests to figure out what exactly would occur at a larger scale; observing the difference between 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, and 35 stored seconds might be all I need to understand what one hour of stored time would cause."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But my way to measure time isn't precise, and I can't measure decimals. I might need a calculator too, and I don't know if there'd be one here in the attic.
entries.literal: "But my way to measure time isn't precise, and I can't measure decimals. I might need a calculator too, and I don't know if there'd be one here in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why was I so preoccupied with the idea? Was it due to mere curiosity?{w} No. That wasn't all. At some point, I had realized it.
entries.literal: "Why was I so preoccupied with the idea? Was it due to mere curiosity?{w} No. That wasn't all. At some point, I had realized it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While locked in the tower for twelve hours, I'd spent a long time trying to figure out if saving Miiya was possible. And I knew, at that moment, that it was.{w} However, those thoughts had all faded from my mind some time previously. Shiroya had caused me to abandon the idea of saving her.{w} But I'd learned that wasn't the real Shiroya, and it made a lot of sense—she would never have said that. She had wanted to save Miiya just like me and had been prepared to do it once I'd told her it was possible.
entries.literal: "While locked in the tower for twelve hours, I'd spent a long time trying to figure out if saving Miiya was possible. And I knew, at that moment, that it was.{w} However, those thoughts had all faded from my mind some time previously. Shiroya had caused me to abandon the idea of saving her.{w} But I'd learned that wasn't the real Shiroya, and it made a lot of sense—she would never have said that. She had wanted to save Miiya just like me and had been prepared to do it once I'd told her it was possible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had I truly heard Miiya earlier? ...That voice continually replayed in my head, but I couldn't understand the circumstances around it.
entries.literal: "Had I truly heard Miiya earlier? ...That voice continually replayed in my head, but I couldn't understand the circumstances around it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't know how reasonable this is. After a while of storing time, being off by even a single decimal would result in a substantial difference...
entries.literal: "I don't know how reasonable this is. After a while of storing time, being off by even a single decimal would result in a substantial difference..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even if I analyze repeated short travels to the future, it might take me a really long time to come up with an accurate equation with just these two timers.
entries.literal: "Even if I analyze repeated short travels to the future, it might take me a really long time to come up with an accurate equation with just these two timers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea how long I'd be alone in the tower, but I couldn't afford to spend hours perfecting a formula. I didn't even know if it was consistent in the first place.
entries.literal: "I had no idea how long I'd be alone in the tower, but I couldn't afford to spend hours perfecting a formula. I didn't even know if it was consistent in the first place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mind went back to a thought I'd had long in the past. When I'd originally conceived of thought-up loops, I'd also considered a particular scenario.
entries.literal: "My mind went back to a thought I'd had long in the past. When I'd originally conceived of thought-up loops, I'd also considered a particular scenario."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Depending on how it works, the possibilities could be limitless. There's even a higher step to reach."
entries.literal: "\"Depending on how it works, the possibilities could be limitless. There's even a higher step to reach.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "It's considerably different, but it follows along with a few things I thought about earlier, regarding the date displayed on Sai's watch."
entries.literal: "\"It's considerably different, but it follows along with a few things I thought about earlier, regarding the date displayed on Sai's watch.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Out of the countless examples, could you go back in time, trade information with someone, write it all down, and leave it all on a note that you'd see before traveling through time?"
entries.literal: "\"Out of the countless examples, could you go back in time, trade information with someone, write it all down, and leave it all on a note that you'd see before traveling through time?\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "You'd read the note and go back to the past. However, since you would already know the contents of it, you'd have no reason to exchange the information—all you'd have to do is leave behind the note you'd read so that you could read it before traveling."
entries.literal: "\"You'd read the note and go back to the past. However, since you would already know the contents of it, you'd have no reason to exchange the information—all you'd have to do is leave behind the note you'd read so that you could read it before traveling.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "The note itself would be a paradox that you caused, but was the past truly changed? Was a past in which you exchanged information truly overwritten? ...Or did it never exist in the first place?"
entries.literal: "\"The note itself would be a paradox that you caused, but was the past truly changed? Was a past in which you exchanged information truly overwritten? ...Or did it never exist in the first place?\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "...If Sai's watch got to "9999-12-31" by spending infinite time in a loop, did the pasts in which the time counted up to that date really exist in any capacity?"
entries.literal: "\"...If Sai's watch got to \"9999-12-31\" by spending infinite time in a loop, did the pasts in which the time counted up to that date really exist in any capacity?\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Would something like that actually be possible?
entries.literal: "...Would something like that actually be possible?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't have the time needed to find an equation that lets me calculate time values for the Sekimeiya, but as long as it's possible to find, could I use something like this to obtain it?
entries.literal: "I don't have the time needed to find an equation that lets me calculate time values for the Sekimeiya, but as long as it's possible to find, could I use something like this to obtain it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How long would it take me to find it? Maybe two hours of monitoring innumerable travels?
entries.literal: "How long would it take me to find it? Maybe two hours of monitoring innumerable travels?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I extrapolate my old scenario to this, it would look something like... going two hours back in time, spending them working to find the formula, and noting it down on a piece of paper that I would hide inside a drawer. Before traveling two hours back, I would find the note, and in the past, as I would already know the formula, I would just have to write it down and leave it in the drawer.
entries.literal: "If I extrapolate my old scenario to this, it would look something like... going two hours back in time, spending them working to find the formula, and noting it down on a piece of paper that I would hide inside a drawer. Before traveling two hours back, I would find the note, and in the past, as I would already know the formula, I would just have to write it down and leave it in the drawer."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But this isn't applicable, because if I go two hours back, I won't have access to the Sekimeiya. I've been testing with them, so if I go back and use them, I'll be changing the past, and the note will not be written in my current reality.
entries.literal: "But this isn't applicable, because if I go two hours back, I won't have access to the Sekimeiya. I've been testing with them, so if I go back and use them, I'll be changing the past, and the note will not be written in my current reality."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But what if I change it up a little?
entries.literal: "But what if I change it up a little?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Let's say I take the Past Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator. Two minutes later, I touch it and go 45 seconds back. I'm not even sure if this first travel would be needed, but it might be.
entries.literal: "Let's say I take the Past Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator. Two minutes later, I touch it and go 45 seconds back. I'm not even sure if this first travel would be needed, but it might be."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, 45 seconds later, my original self will disappear, and I'll spend two hours testing with both Sekimeiya to come up with the right formula. Once I have it, I'll go back in time to a point before I traveled the 45 seconds and write down the formula.
entries.literal: "Then, 45 seconds later, my original self will disappear, and I'll spend two hours testing with both Sekimeiya to come up with the right formula. Once I have it, I'll go back in time to a point before I traveled the 45 seconds and write down the formula."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Before traveling the 45 seconds, I'll read the note with the formula. Then, 45 seconds in the past, I'll write it down so that my original self can see it.{w} Would this allow me to spend two hours finding the formula without actually having to waste that time?
entries.literal: "Before traveling the 45 seconds, I'll read the note with the formula. Then, 45 seconds in the past, I'll write it down so that my original self can see it.{w} Would this allow me to spend two hours finding the formula without actually having to waste that time?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no point in assuming an answer because it was easy to test. I readied myself to perform the loop and started to store time with the Past Sekimeiya.{w} However, when I looked at the drawer where I wanted the note to be hidden, it was empty.
entries.literal: "There was no point in assuming an answer because it was easy to test. I readied myself to perform the loop and started to store time with the Past Sekimeiya.{w} However, when I looked at the drawer where I wanted the note to be hidden, it was empty."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh, okay. ...Why did it not work?
entries.literal: "Huh, okay. ...Why did it not work?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The success of the loop required the existence of hypothetical events. In reality, if I had seen the note, I would never have spent two hours working to find the formula—those events would only have existed in a hypothetical history. Once their result was known, their existence would've become unneeded.
entries.literal: "The success of the loop required the existence of hypothetical events. In reality, if I had seen the note, I would never have spent two hours working to find the formula—those events would only have existed in a hypothetical history. Once their result was known, their existence would've become unneeded."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Am I mistaken, then? Is this concept just unworkable?{w} That can't be. It's the same thing as the recorder powering off when I go to the past: the hypothetical realities in which it progressively loses battery need to exist in order for it to appear without power in the real one.
entries.literal: "Am I mistaken, then? Is this concept just unworkable?{w} That can't be. It's the same thing as the recorder powering off when I go to the past: the hypothetical realities in which it progressively loses battery need to exist in order for it to appear without power in the real one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although I didn't fully understand that, as the recorder not degrading physically still didn't make sense to me.
entries.literal: "Although I didn't fully understand that, as the recorder not degrading physically still didn't make sense to me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if it didn't work because two hours wouldn't have been enough to determine the formula? Or what if, during those two hours, people would've shown up and I would've been unable to continue and go to the past to leave the note behind?
entries.literal: "What if it didn't work because two hours wouldn't have been enough to determine the formula? Or what if, during those two hours, people would've shown up and I would've been unable to continue and go to the past to leave the note behind?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If two hours wouldn't have been enough, what about ten? What if it would've taken me more than twenty hours to refine the formula until it was consistent with every travel?
entries.literal: "If two hours wouldn't have been enough, what about ten? What if it would've taken me more than twenty hours to refine the formula until it was consistent with every travel?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The tower will open at {time=21}, so assuming no one else comes, even in a hypothetical world, I would only have until {time=21} to experiment... Actually, probably way less than that, because to travel to the past and appear in the tower, I'd have to be inside it hours after {time=21.}
entries.literal: "The tower will open at {time=21}, so assuming no one else comes, even in a hypothetical world, I would only have until {time=21} to experiment... Actually, probably way less than that, because to travel to the past and appear in the tower, I'd have to be inside it hours after {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But assuming I had all the time I needed, would I be able to use a hypothetical world to my advantage? Could I make use of countless hours without actually spending any?{w} ...I considered that there might've been a way to test it.
entries.literal: "...But assuming I had all the time I needed, would I be able to use a hypothetical world to my advantage? Could I make use of countless hours without actually spending any?{w} ...I considered that there might've been a way to test it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the Past Sekimeiya out and pressed "play" on the recorder. Following that, I went to the living room with the Past Sekimeiya and the recorder and closed the door to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "I took the Past Sekimeiya out and pressed \"play\" on the recorder. Following that, I went to the living room with the Past Sekimeiya and the recorder and closed the door to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to think very thoroughly about it. Instead of using a single hypothetical world, what if I used multiple at once by making it recursive?
entries.literal: "I had to think very thoroughly about it. Instead of using a single hypothetical world, what if I used multiple at once by making it recursive?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}If I touch the Sekimeiya when fifteen minutes have passed, I'll go twenty minutes to the past.{w} But before I touch it, I'll open the door to the hallway and find a notepad from the bedrooms on the floor. Depending on what it says, I'll do one of three things.
entries.literal: "...{w}If I touch the Sekimeiya when fifteen minutes have passed, I'll go twenty minutes to the past.{w} But before I touch it, I'll open the door to the hallway and find a notepad from the bedrooms on the floor. Depending on what it says, I'll do one of three things."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: 1: If it has a formula written down, I'll go twenty minutes to the past, obtain the notepad, write the formula down, and leave it in the hallway.
entries.literal: "1: If it has a formula written down, I'll go twenty minutes to the past, obtain the notepad, write the formula down, and leave it in the hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: 2: If I don't find a notepad, I'll go twenty minutes to the past, and using the Future Sekimeiya in the kitchen, I'll start to work toward finding the formula. Before twenty minutes pass, I'll obtain a notepad from the bedrooms, and in the top left corner of the first page, I'll write a "1" along with the progress I made in those twenty minutes. Then, I'll leave it in the hallway.
entries.literal: "2: If I don't find a notepad, I'll go twenty minutes to the past, and using the Future Sekimeiya in the kitchen, I'll start to work toward finding the formula. Before twenty minutes pass, I'll obtain a notepad from the bedrooms, and in the top left corner of the first page, I'll write a \"1\" along with the progress I made in those twenty minutes. Then, I'll leave it in the hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: 3: If I find a notepad that doesn't contain the formula, it will have my current progress along with a number in the top left corner of the first page, which will indicate the amount of iterations that have occurred so far.{w} I'll go back to the past, and using the information I read in the notepad, I'll start working to find the formula. Before the twenty minutes pass, I'll write down the updated progress in a notepad from the bedrooms, increase the number I saw in the top left corner by one, and then leave the notepad in the hallway.
entries.literal: "3: If I find a notepad that doesn't contain the formula, it will have my current progress along with a number in the top left corner of the first page, which will indicate the amount of iterations that have occurred so far.{w} I'll go back to the past, and using the information I read in the notepad, I'll start working to find the formula. Before the twenty minutes pass, I'll write down the updated progress in a notepad from the bedrooms, increase the number I saw in the top left corner by one, and then leave the notepad in the hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This makes use of infinite time. By repeatedly using these twenty minutes across multiple hypothetical worlds, I can carry my progress over until the formula is found. I'm able to compress years' worth of calculations into a single twenty-minute loop.
entries.literal: "This makes use of infinite time. By repeatedly using these twenty minutes across multiple hypothetical worlds, I can carry my progress over until the formula is found. I'm able to compress years' worth of calculations into a single twenty-minute loop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Since all the worlds will collapse into a final result, I'll always find the real formula behind the hallway door if this is viable; actions 2 and 3 are only for the hypothetical worlds.
entries.literal: "Since all the worlds will collapse into a final result, I'll always find the real formula behind the hallway door if this is viable; actions 2 and 3 are only for the hypothetical worlds."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: As another final point, if the number in the top left corner exceeds, say, a billion, then I can be confident no answer exists.
entries.literal: "As another final point, if the number in the top left corner exceeds, say, a billion, then I can be confident no answer exists."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I realized the plan had a small flaw.
entries.literal: "...{w}I realized the plan had a small flaw."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But if in the real world, I open the hallway door and find no notepad, I'll think that the plan hasn't worked and won't go through with the first loop. In the same way, the first hypothetical version of me, instead of assuming that he's about to start the first iteration, would assume that the plan is flawed and wouldn't start the sequence. If I want this to work, I'll have to execute the first loop in the instance that I don't find a notepad in the hallway right now.{w} This is okay, because even though the plan wouldn't work for me, I'd have to resort to trying to find the formula manually in the real world. Executing the first loop would work toward that, and it would make the plan succeed if the concept is valid.
entries.literal: "But if in the real world, I open the hallway door and find no notepad, I'll think that the plan hasn't worked and won't go through with the first loop. In the same way, the first hypothetical version of me, instead of assuming that he's about to start the first iteration, would assume that the plan is flawed and wouldn't start the sequence. If I want this to work, I'll have to execute the first loop in the instance that I don't find a notepad in the hallway right now.{w} This is okay, because even though the plan wouldn't work for me, I'd have to resort to trying to find the formula manually in the real world. Executing the first loop would work toward that, and it would make the plan succeed if the concept is valid."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Thirteen minutes had passed.
entries.literal: "Thirteen minutes had passed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't heard anything in the attic; if another version of me had been ready to pass the formula on to me, he'd been very quiet.
entries.literal: "I hadn't heard anything in the attic; if another version of me had been ready to pass the formula on to me, he'd been very quiet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Still completely clueless as to whether it would work, I approached the hallway.
entries.literal: "Still completely clueless as to whether it would work, I approached the hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wh—
entries.literal: "Wh—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My mouth dropped to the floor. Flashes of a certain bedroom popped in my mind, a normal occurrence after seeing my own messy handwriting.
entries.literal: "My mouth dropped to the floor. Flashes of a certain bedroom popped in my mind, a normal occurrence after seeing my own messy handwriting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A notepad was beside my feet, containing a large string of numbers on the first page. Upon closer inspection, it was definitely a formula—far from a clean one.
entries.literal: "A notepad was beside my feet, containing a large string of numbers on the first page. Upon closer inspection, it was definitely a formula—far from a clean one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is really it. It actually worked...!
entries.literal: "This is really it. It actually worked...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All the pages after the first one were completely empty. There was no number on the top left, so I didn't know how many iterations had been needed to reach it, but its complexity was evident.
entries.literal: "All the pages after the first one were completely empty. There was no number on the top left, so I didn't know how many iterations had been needed to reach it, but its complexity was evident."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So Shiroya and Akaro weren't lying... Touching the Sekimeiya after an hour of stored time will really send you weeks through time, and I can calculate the exact amount.
entries.literal: "So Shiroya and Akaro weren't lying... Touching the Sekimeiya after an hour of stored time will really send you weeks through time, and I can calculate the exact amount."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before that, though, I had to travel to the past. Less than twenty seconds remained until the fifteen-minute mark. When the timer hit it, I touched the Past Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Before that, though, I had to travel to the past. Less than twenty seconds remained until the fifteen-minute mark. When the timer hit it, I touched the Past Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As expected, I appeared in the hallway, right next to the kitchen, which was closed. I had gone twenty minutes back, but the Past Sekimeiya had only stored energy for fifteen. During the first five minutes, I had no access to the kitchen because my past self was there. In the hypothetical loops, that time would've been used to check the progress made until the previous iteration.
entries.literal: "As expected, I appeared in the hallway, right next to the kitchen, which was closed. I had gone twenty minutes back, but the Past Sekimeiya had only stored energy for fifteen. During the first five minutes, I had no access to the kitchen because my past self was there. In the hypothetical loops, that time would've been used to check the progress made until the previous iteration."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the right bedroom and took a notepad from a drawer. I recalled all the numbers that had comprised the formula and wrote them down.
entries.literal: "I went to the right bedroom and took a notepad from a drawer. I recalled all the numbers that had comprised the formula and wrote them down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I silently approached the hallway and left the notepad next to the living room.
entries.literal: "Then, I silently approached the hallway and left the notepad next to the living room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is crazy. I wonder how much time was spent to reach this equation. It feels like an instant result for my real self, so I could even use something like this to brute force the computer passwords downstairs.
entries.literal: "This is crazy. I wonder how much time was spent to reach this equation. It feels like an instant result for my real self, so I could even use something like this to brute force the computer passwords downstairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood in silence until I heard my past self leaving the kitchen.
entries.literal: "I stood in silence until I heard my past self leaving the kitchen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Future Sekimeiya's in the refrigerator...
