entries.literal: "The Future Sekimeiya's in the refrigerator..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had a slight doubt. I understood the formula, but a certain factor wasn't part of it.
entries.literal: "I had a slight doubt. I understood the formula, but a certain factor wasn't part of it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that really it? Is there no other influential factor?
entries.literal: "Is that really it? Is there no other influential factor?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped over to the sink and set the plug for the drain. Then, I filled it with water very slowly so that I didn't make noise. Once it reached the top, I took the Future Sekimeiya out and put it in the water.
entries.literal: "I stepped over to the sink and set the plug for the drain. Then, I filled it with water very slowly so that I didn't make noise. Once it reached the top, I took the Future Sekimeiya out and put it in the water."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I set the oven to count for ten minutes. When only five had passed, I put my hand in the water and touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I set the oven to count for ten minutes. When only five had passed, I put my hand in the water and touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I appeared in the kitchen and immediately saw the disabled Future Sekimeiya under the water. Then I looked at the oven and saw the amount of time I'd gone to the future.{w} The timer was at 4:31, immediately ticking down to 4:30.
entries.literal: "I appeared in the kitchen and immediately saw the disabled Future Sekimeiya under the water. Then I looked at the oven and saw the amount of time I'd gone to the future.{w} The timer was at 4:31, immediately ticking down to 4:30."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: 29 seconds. I have gone 29 seconds forward.{w} So I was right. There's another factor:{w} the temperature.
entries.literal: "29 seconds. I have gone 29 seconds forward.{w} So I was right. There's another factor:{w} the temperature."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The water is at room temperature, and the Sekimeiya spent five minutes in it. I should've definitely gone more than 29 seconds forward.
entries.literal: "The water is at room temperature, and the Sekimeiya spent five minutes in it. I should've definitely gone more than 29 seconds forward."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But the heat capacity of water is four times the air's, meaning that it heats up four times slower.{w} It appears a temperature higher than the cabinet lets the Sekimeiya store energy and become hot. Of course, that heats up the air around it.{w} Then, that same air makes the Sekimeiya even hotter, leading into the infinite increase of energy.
entries.literal: "But the heat capacity of water is four times the air's, meaning that it heats up four times slower.{w} It appears a temperature higher than the cabinet lets the Sekimeiya store energy and become hot. Of course, that heats up the air around it.{w} Then, that same air makes the Sekimeiya even hotter, leading into the infinite increase of energy."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is why the water's different heat capacity changes things. Because water heats up four times slower, five minutes submerged in it is the same as 75 seconds outside it. So I only traveled 29 seconds. I'm sure the hypothetical versions of me thought about this too when they were coming up with the equation, but it's not really part of it, it just modifies the result.
entries.literal: "This is why the water's different heat capacity changes things. Because water heats up four times slower, five minutes submerged in it is the same as 75 seconds outside it. So I only traveled 29 seconds. I'm sure the hypothetical versions of me thought about this too when they were coming up with the equation, but it's not really part of it, it just modifies the result."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Finally, this answers the last question regarding that time Erina touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Finally, this answers the last question regarding that time Erina touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why were we encompassed within Erina's range? The Sekimeiya had spent fifteen minutes outside the cabinet, and based on the previous identical travel, we should've been outside of it.
entries.literal: "Why were we encompassed within Erina's range? The Sekimeiya had spent fifteen minutes outside the cabinet, and based on the previous identical travel, we should've been outside of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, avoiding direct contact with it."
entries.literal: "\"Erina opened the glass and rolled the Sekimeiya into her purse, avoiding direct contact with it.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's why. For those fifteen minutes, the Sekimeiya was in her purse.{w} That led to the opposite situation as the water. The air inside the purse couldn't easily escape, so it heated up faster than outside it. That is the reason why the range was bigger.{w} And Sai, the only person who actually traveled through time, would have been sent more than twenty minutes.
entries.literal: "That's why. For those fifteen minutes, the Sekimeiya was in her purse.{w} That led to the opposite situation as the water. The air inside the purse couldn't easily escape, so it heated up faster than outside it. That is the reason why the range was bigger.{w} And Sai, the only person who actually traveled through time, would have been sent more than twenty minutes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wonder how much of an effect this had on the travels. When the Sekimeiya was in the other cabinets, for example, did it heat up faster? Their interiors are wide, but I'm sure there was an imperceptible difference.
entries.literal: "I wonder how much of an effect this had on the travels. When the Sekimeiya was in the other cabinets, for example, did it heat up faster? Their interiors are wide, but I'm sure there was an imperceptible difference."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Maybe you noticed the instances where this property was a factor in play.
entries.literal: "Maybe you noticed the instances where this property was a factor in play."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Earlier, did you wonder why Shiroya world switched alongside Naomi? She was in the staircase while the Sekimeiya were on the sofa, and they had recently been taken out of the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Earlier, did you wonder why Shiroya world switched alongside Naomi? She was in the staircase while the Sekimeiya were on the sofa, and they had recently been taken out of the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As you might guess, it was Katei's tight suitcase that let the Sekimeiya gain power faster than normal.
entries.literal: "As you might guess, it was Katei's tight suitcase that let the Sekimeiya gain power faster than normal."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That... might be everything. Although I could be wrong on details that I can't verify, I can apply the time formula as long as I touch the Sekimeiya outside the water and in this room. The temperature in the attic doesn't feel different from everywhere else, but I should stay here.
entries.literal: "That... might be everything. Although I could be wrong on details that I can't verify, I can apply the time formula as long as I touch the Sekimeiya outside the water and in this room. The temperature in the attic doesn't feel different from everywhere else, but I should stay here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I heard myself in the living room stepping to the hallway. Soon after, that me touched the Sekimeiya and went back in time.
entries.literal: "I heard myself in the living room stepping to the hallway. Soon after, that me touched the Sekimeiya and went back in time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I retrieved the Past Sekimeiya and the recorder, then stepped back into the kitchen.
entries.literal: "I retrieved the Past Sekimeiya and the recorder, then stepped back into the kitchen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put both Sekimeiya in the refrigerator and took out the Past Sekimeiya as I began a new recording.
entries.literal: "I put both Sekimeiya in the refrigerator and took out the Past Sekimeiya as I began a new recording."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I moved to the hallway; I had appeared right outside the kitchen, so I had to be there in twenty minutes. By leaving the door open, I could make sure the Future Sekimeiya was safe in the refrigerator.
entries.literal: "I moved to the hallway; I had appeared right outside the kitchen, so I had to be there in twenty minutes. By leaving the door open, I could make sure the Future Sekimeiya was safe in the refrigerator."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is there anything else? Is there any mystery that I can't explain?
entries.literal: "...Is there anything else? Is there any mystery that I can't explain?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the storeroom, I'd sporadically thought about the long series of events that had gone on during the twelve-hour span of time. A few ideas had come to me, but I had to seriously think about everything with what I'd learned.
entries.literal: "In the storeroom, I'd sporadically thought about the long series of events that had gone on during the twelve-hour span of time. A few ideas had come to me, but I had to seriously think about everything with what I'd learned."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At {time=9}, the smoke was released in the tower, beginning the attack that trapped us inside. What triggered the alarm? Was anyone aware of the Sekimeiya's powers? I'm still not sure about the details behind it, but it's a lot clearer now.
entries.literal: "At {time=9}, the smoke was released in the tower, beginning the attack that trapped us inside. What triggered the alarm? Was anyone aware of the Sekimeiya's powers? I'm still not sure about the details behind it, but it's a lot clearer now."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: While we were asleep, someone hid the Sekimeiya in room B4 and turned on the temperature regulation.{w} Was it Naomi? In this world, she ran up to the attic with them.
entries.literal: "While we were asleep, someone hid the Sekimeiya in room B4 and turned on the temperature regulation.{w} Was it Naomi? In this world, she ran up to the attic with them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's also Katei. He wasn't in the security room, and he has to be who dropped the rusty key in hallway A.{w} Beyond the truth of the attack, the third Sekimeiya, the one that doesn't work, was the only one inside the cabinet when we woke up. When Isla touched it, nothing happened to her.
entries.literal: "There's also Katei. He wasn't in the security room, and he has to be who dropped the rusty key in hallway A.{w} Beyond the truth of the attack, the third Sekimeiya, the one that doesn't work, was the only one inside the cabinet when we woke up. When Isla touched it, nothing happened to her."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We went to the security room and contacted the outside. That's when we had the call with Suripo, who told us about the story behind Ashiya and Xyn.
entries.literal: "We went to the security room and contacted the outside. That's when we had the call with Suripo, who told us about the story behind Ashiya and Xyn."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Before it ended, Sai turned off the monitor next to him. However, the whole computer immediately powered off too.
entries.literal: "Before it ended, Sai turned off the monitor next to him. However, the whole computer immediately powered off too."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Who did that, and why? At this point, I believe there's an answer far more likely than the others.
entries.literal: "Who did that, and why? At this point, I believe there's an answer far more likely than the others."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I think it was Katei. The person who was sitting in front of the computer.{w} When it happened, we were about to look at the recorded footage. That would've revealed that he hadn't been in the security room and who knows what else.
entries.literal: "I think it was Katei. The person who was sitting in front of the computer.{w} When it happened, we were about to look at the recorded footage. That would've revealed that he hadn't been in the security room and who knows what else."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He probably wanted to use Sai's trick to his advantage. We were all focused on the screen that went black, so nobody saw him pressing the power button below the desk. Due to his timing, he tried to make it seem as if both things had the same cause.
entries.literal: "He probably wanted to use Sai's trick to his advantage. We were all focused on the screen that went black, so nobody saw him pressing the power button below the desk. Due to his timing, he tried to make it seem as if both things had the same cause."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The first thing he did was crouch under the desk and check the wires. He said nothing was wrong behind the computer, but I think that what he did was disconnect a cable. Then, when he repeatedly pressed the power button, the computer didn't turn on.
entries.literal: "The first thing he did was crouch under the desk and check the wires. He said nothing was wrong behind the computer, but I think that what he did was disconnect a cable. Then, when he repeatedly pressed the power button, the computer didn't turn on."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, he couldn't leave it like that. If we explained what had happened to the police, they would immediately notice the disconnected cable, and no one would believe a word Katei said. So, after he acted like he'd been trying to figure out the issue for a long time, he reconnected the cable and the computer was able to power back on.
entries.literal: "However, he couldn't leave it like that. If we explained what had happened to the police, they would immediately notice the disconnected cable, and no one would believe a word Katei said. So, after he acted like he'd been trying to figure out the issue for a long time, he reconnected the cable and the computer was able to power back on."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think that's all he did, though. During all the time he was below the desk, he unplugged the camera system from the computer. Later into the day, I realized the drive that stored the recorded footage wasn't being detected.
entries.literal: "I don't think that's all he did, though. During all the time he was below the desk, he unplugged the camera system from the computer. Later into the day, I realized the drive that stored the recorded footage wasn't being detected."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And even that wasn't all. We tried to communicate with the outside a second time, but upon inputting his credentials, an "Access Denied" message appeared.{w} Why? I'm not completely sure why he would've done that, but he could've purposely entered an incorrect password to prompt that message. Perhaps there was a reason why he couldn't allow a second call, but he must've done that. After all, there's no way Ashiya would've been the ones to cut our single method of communication.
entries.literal: "And even that wasn't all. We tried to communicate with the outside a second time, but upon inputting his credentials, an \"Access Denied\" message appeared.{w} Why? I'm not completely sure why he would've done that, but he could've purposely entered an incorrect password to prompt that message. Perhaps there was a reason why he couldn't allow a second call, but he must've done that. After all, there's no way Ashiya would've been the ones to cut our single method of communication."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...He wasn't in the security room when the smoke went off, but one of the things he said was that he'd tried to do his part of removing the shutter and that the system hadn't let him.{w} That didn't actually happen, but Suripo told us that a similar error was affecting Ashiya. Since Katei knew or lied about it without experiencing it, it follows he was probably the cause behind it. He didn't want the exit to open before the time limit.{w} Therefore, there was something he had to do before the time expired, and deleting the saved footage was likely part of that.{w} When we were done, we left him alone in the security room. That was the time we later learned footage had been erased; he used it to briefly reconnect the system and delete what he didn't want us to see.
entries.literal: "...He wasn't in the security room when the smoke went off, but one of the things he said was that he'd tried to do his part of removing the shutter and that the system hadn't let him.{w} That didn't actually happen, but Suripo told us that a similar error was affecting Ashiya. Since Katei knew or lied about it without experiencing it, it follows he was probably the cause behind it. He didn't want the exit to open before the time limit.{w} Therefore, there was something he had to do before the time expired, and deleting the saved footage was likely part of that.{w} When we were done, we left him alone in the security room. That was the time we later learned footage had been erased; he used it to briefly reconnect the system and delete what he didn't want us to see."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We looked through the crystal floor, but we didn't find Naomi. Then, we separated into two groups to look through the other floors. Erina, Isla, Shiroya, and I took the elevator up to the sixth floor.
entries.literal: "We looked through the crystal floor, but we didn't find Naomi. Then, we separated into two groups to look through the other floors. Erina, Isla, Shiroya, and I took the elevator up to the sixth floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On the fifth floor, before Isla told us about her friend, we heard the elevator. Since we had left it on the sixth, and the other group only heard it once, it had to have been going down.
entries.literal: "On the fifth floor, before Isla told us about her friend, we heard the elevator. Since we had left it on the sixth, and the other group only heard it once, it had to have been going down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was the Naomi who'd ended up trapped in the attic. When she appeared there, the elevator wasn't working, but she must have eventually tried it again after Katei reenabled it.
entries.literal: "It was the Naomi who'd ended up trapped in the attic. When she appeared there, the elevator wasn't working, but she must have eventually tried it again after Katei reenabled it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: From the sixth floor, the elevator went to the attic. Of course, we didn't hear that.{w} Then, that Naomi used it to go all the way down.
entries.literal: "From the sixth floor, the elevator went to the attic. Of course, we didn't hear that.{w} Then, that Naomi used it to go all the way down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was soon after when we found Naomi's first corpse in the hallway B crystal room.
entries.literal: "It was soon after when we found Naomi's first corpse in the hallway B crystal room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think that was the Naomi who'd taken the elevator, though. The elevator moved after one Naomi had already appeared, and her set of keys was on the first dead body.
entries.literal: "I don't think that was the Naomi who'd taken the elevator, though. The elevator moved after one Naomi had already appeared, and her set of keys was on the first dead body."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That was likely the Naomi from our world. She appeared in front of the others and asked to talk to Katei privately. Later, the Naomi in the attic went down.
entries.literal: "That was likely the Naomi from our world. She appeared in front of the others and asked to talk to Katei privately. Later, the Naomi in the attic went down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But after we waited, Katei came back alone, saying Naomi hadn't wanted to come back.
entries.literal: "But after we waited, Katei came back alone, saying Naomi hadn't wanted to come back."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If she was still down there, we couldn't let her keep escaping. Shiroya and I waited in front of the elevator while the others went down to make sure we'd find her.{w} Suddenly, we heard the elevator going up.
entries.literal: "If she was still down there, we couldn't let her keep escaping. Shiroya and I waited in front of the elevator while the others went down to make sure we'd find her.{w} Suddenly, we heard the elevator going up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We thought that was Naomi, but we didn't find anyone where the elevator would've stopped. The reason was that my past self was the person who used it.
entries.literal: "We thought that was Naomi, but we didn't find anyone where the elevator would've stopped. The reason was that my past self was the person who used it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And while we were discussing what could've happened, Akaro came running. The Sekimeiya had vanished from the cabinet for the first time.
entries.literal: "And while we were discussing what could've happened, Akaro came running. The Sekimeiya had vanished from the cabinet for the first time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Everyone was waiting near the stairs when we arrived. Shiroya and I saw the empty cabinet in the event room, but the priority was still Naomi—she had to be there.
entries.literal: "Everyone was waiting near the stairs when we arrived. Shiroya and I saw the empty cabinet in the event room, but the priority was still Naomi—she had to be there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Making sure nobody could leave, room B4 was eventually looked into. That's where we found her corpse.
entries.literal: "Making sure nobody could leave, room B4 was eventually looked into. That's where we found her corpse."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Someone coming from the future could've killed her, but I'm inclined to think it was actually Katei.{w} It happened in the room where the Sekimeiya were hidden, and in this world, Naomi didn't bring them there. That makes me think it was Katei who did.
entries.literal: "Someone coming from the future could've killed her, but I'm inclined to think it was actually Katei.{w} It happened in the room where the Sekimeiya were hidden, and in this world, Naomi didn't bring them there. That makes me think it was Katei who did."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi appeared from the second floor. She had been watching the group from a distance just in case she could gather information such as Katei's potential accomplices. Finally, she mustered the courage to confront them.
entries.literal: "Naomi appeared from the second floor. She had been watching the group from a distance just in case she could gather information such as Katei's potential accomplices. Finally, she mustered the courage to confront them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She requested to talk to Katei privately; she represented Ashiya, so she couldn't let the others hear such a bold accusation against one of their workers if it was possible an explanation existed. However, she knew Katei had taken the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet.
entries.literal: "She requested to talk to Katei privately; she represented Ashiya, so she couldn't let the others hear such a bold accusation against one of their workers if it was possible an explanation existed. However, she knew Katei had taken the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Without speaking a word, they walked to the crystal floor. There, Naomi brought Katei to the room she'd seen him leave.
entries.literal: "Without speaking a word, they walked to the crystal floor. There, Naomi brought Katei to the room she'd seen him leave."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The Sekimeiya had to be there. Naomi asked him to unlock all the cabinets and saw two of them lying inside.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya had to be there. Naomi asked him to unlock all the cabinets and saw two of them lying inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Raising her voice, she demanded an explanation while Katei kept quiet. He knew how bad the situation was: Naomi would bring about his doom. She would ruin everything.
entries.literal: "Raising her voice, she demanded an explanation while Katei kept quiet. He knew how bad the situation was: Naomi would bring about his doom. She would ruin everything."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't bother making flimsy excuses. He explained everything he'd done, hoping she would sympathize with him. He had worked in Ashiya Tower all his life; he couldn't take it anymore. He'd only wanted to free himself from the life he'd lived.
entries.literal: "He didn't bother making flimsy excuses. He explained everything he'd done, hoping she would sympathize with him. He had worked in Ashiya Tower all his life; he couldn't take it anymore. He'd only wanted to free himself from the life he'd lived."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When she discarded Katei's justification, it was his voice that rose. There was no way he would let his life end like that.
entries.literal: "When she discarded Katei's justification, it was his voice that rose. There was no way he would let his life end like that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The truth was out, so Katei attempted a bribe. If they obtained the Sekimeiya, both of them could work together to trade it off.{w} Immediately, Naomi refused—she was Ashiya's most trusted employee.{w} The third step was a threat. With a calm voice, Katei let her pick between Ashiya or her own safety. He needed her to stay quiet, and starting immediately; she knew two real Sekimeiya existed.{w} However, as Katei's words were dismissed again, he finally wavered. He had been acting stern, but that was far from reality. Inwardly, Katei burned with rage toward Naomi.
entries.literal: "The truth was out, so Katei attempted a bribe. If they obtained the Sekimeiya, both of them could work together to trade it off.{w} Immediately, Naomi refused—she was Ashiya's most trusted employee.{w} The third step was a threat. With a calm voice, Katei let her pick between Ashiya or her own safety. He needed her to stay quiet, and starting immediately; she knew two real Sekimeiya existed.{w} However, as Katei's words were dismissed again, he finally wavered. He had been acting stern, but that was far from reality. Inwardly, Katei burned with rage toward Naomi."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a sudden step forward, Katei dashed at her.{w} She had enough time to react and defend herself, but she was no match for him. After an abrupt scuffle, Katei dragged her to the wall and knocked her out. Before her death, Naomi let out a yell that only reached a single pair of ears outside the room: her own.
entries.literal: "After a sudden step forward, Katei dashed at her.{w} She had enough time to react and defend herself, but she was no match for him. After an abrupt scuffle, Katei dragged her to the wall and knocked her out. Before her death, Naomi let out a yell that only reached a single pair of ears outside the room: her own."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From above, Katei stared at Naomi's body, unaware that a cabinet's temperature wheel had been damaged. Seconds later, he finally checked her breathing. ...There was none.{w} But all wasn't lost. Earlier, he had turned off that room's camera. He had known that he would have to take one of the Sekimeiya away eventually, so he had preemptively disabled the video.{w} But although he hadn't been recorded, he knew he was the only possible suspect.
entries.literal: "From above, Katei stared at Naomi's body, unaware that a cabinet's temperature wheel had been damaged. Seconds later, he finally checked her breathing. ...There was none.{w} But all wasn't lost. Earlier, he had turned off that room's camera. He had known that he would have to take one of the Sekimeiya away eventually, so he had preemptively disabled the video.{w} But although he hadn't been recorded, he knew he was the only possible suspect."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...That was until he heard a sudden sound that forced him out of the room. Outside, he saw Atsuki's lone figure.{w} Katei rapidly stepped aside; he couldn't afford to be seen. However, Atsuki had just been recorded by the cameras, so there was another potential culprit to build a narrative against.{w} Before he walked back up, Katei thought about what he had to say. He had killed someone else after all those years, and he could find another way out.
entries.literal: "...That was until he heard a sudden sound that forced him out of the room. Outside, he saw Atsuki's lone figure.{w} Katei rapidly stepped aside; he couldn't afford to be seen. However, Atsuki had just been recorded by the cameras, so there was another potential culprit to build a narrative against.{w} Before he walked back up, Katei thought about what he had to say. He had killed someone else after all those years, and he could find another way out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Naomi's body was found, Atsuki's eyes landed on the damaged wheel. It had stopped the temperature regulation, so the Sekimeiya made him travel to the past. However, the Sekimeiya lying in the neighboring cabinet was still kept cold, so no world switch occurred.
entries.literal: "When Naomi's body was found, Atsuki's eyes landed on the damaged wheel. It had stopped the temperature regulation, so the Sekimeiya made him travel to the past. However, the Sekimeiya lying in the neighboring cabinet was still kept cold, so no world switch occurred."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There, I traveled to the past for the first time, and twenty minutes later, I walked right back to where everyone had seen me disappear.
entries.literal: "There, I traveled to the past for the first time, and twenty minutes later, I walked right back to where everyone had seen me disappear."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya turned gray, so we brought it to its cabinet in the event room, where it became white again.{w} We heard a sound coming from outside. After all, someone else was still lurking within the tower—the Naomi who took the elevator down. The corpse had stopped our search, and we'd never looked into every room.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya turned gray, so we brought it to its cabinet in the event room, where it became white again.{w} We heard a sound coming from outside. After all, someone else was still lurking within the tower—the Naomi who took the elevator down. The corpse had stopped our search, and we'd never looked into every room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But we couldn't let her escape, so we separated into two groups to look at both hallways. Katei, Erina, Isla, and I looked at hallway A, while Shiroya, Akaro, and Sai looked at hallway B. Despite that, we didn't find her.
entries.literal: "But we couldn't let her escape, so we separated into two groups to look at both hallways. Katei, Erina, Isla, and I looked at hallway A, while Shiroya, Akaro, and Sai looked at hallway B. Despite that, we didn't find her."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we finished, Sai reiterated his distrust for Katei and refused to believe that Naomi hadn't been found in the rooms he'd investigated.
entries.literal: "When we finished, Sai reiterated his distrust for Katei and refused to believe that Naomi hadn't been found in the rooms he'd investigated."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Sai wanted to confirm it for himself, which led him to enter the storeroom. There, he found a Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Sai wanted to confirm it for himself, which led him to enter the storeroom. There, he found a Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Had it been taken already? We went to the event room, and it was in fact gone from the cabinet.{w} Who hid it in the storeroom? That question ate at me.
entries.literal: "Had it been taken already? We went to the event room, and it was in fact gone from the cabinet.{w} Who hid it in the storeroom? That question ate at me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I believe I now understand what happened.{w} To get the Sekimeiya out of the event room's cabinet, the key was necessary, and it was with Naomi's corpse in room B4. That means someone who investigated hallway B must have taken it to unlock the cabinet.{w} However, none of them had the chance to hide it in the storeroom without being seen by the people who'd investigated hallway A. That's why it didn't make sense.
entries.literal: "I believe I now understand what happened.{w} To get the Sekimeiya out of the event room's cabinet, the key was necessary, and it was with Naomi's corpse in room B4. That means someone who investigated hallway B must have taken it to unlock the cabinet.{w} However, none of them had the chance to hide it in the storeroom without being seen by the people who'd investigated hallway A. That's why it didn't make sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The answer is that...
entries.literal: "The answer is that..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't believe two people worked together. The issue was caused by a misconception.
entries.literal: "I don't believe two people worked together. The issue was caused by a misconception."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I entertained the thought that Sai had it in his hip pack, but I saw clearly when he entered the room that he didn't have the Sekimeiya yet.
entries.literal: "I entertained the thought that Sai had it in his hip pack, but I saw clearly when he entered the room that he didn't have the Sekimeiya yet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It wasn't the same Sekimeiya. The first mystery regarding its whereabouts already pointed at the truth that more than one Sekimeiya existed.{w} ...After all, when Sai left the storeroom, he made me touch it, and nothing happened.{w} It was definitely the third Sekimeiya—the one that had disappeared from the event room the first time. The Past Sekimeiya was in room B4 since we'd regained consciousness, so we never actually found the one that disappeared first.
entries.literal: "It wasn't the same Sekimeiya. The first mystery regarding its whereabouts already pointed at the truth that more than one Sekimeiya existed.{w} ...After all, when Sai left the storeroom, he made me touch it, and nothing happened.{w} It was definitely the third Sekimeiya—the one that had disappeared from the event room the first time. The Past Sekimeiya was in room B4 since we'd regained consciousness, so we never actually found the one that disappeared first."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Who hid the third Sekimeiya in the storeroom? That happened before Shiroya, Akaro, and I walked down from the sixth floor.{w} I don't believe it was Katei because he's likely the one who hid the two working Sekimeiya. If he wanted to also hide the third, which was originally in the event room, he would have done so while we were asleep.{w} I don't believe the other Naomi would have wanted to leave it there either.
entries.literal: "Who hid the third Sekimeiya in the storeroom? That happened before Shiroya, Akaro, and I walked down from the sixth floor.{w} I don't believe it was Katei because he's likely the one who hid the two working Sekimeiya. If he wanted to also hide the third, which was originally in the event room, he would have done so while we were asleep.{w} I don't believe the other Naomi would have wanted to leave it there either."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's one last likely candidate: Sai.
entries.literal: "There's one last likely candidate: Sai."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After Katei said that Naomi didn't want to return, the others investigated the crystal floor while Shiroya and I waited next to the elevator on the fourth floor. We were told exactly what happened.
entries.literal: "After Katei said that Naomi didn't want to return, the others investigated the crystal floor while Shiroya and I waited next to the elevator on the fourth floor. We were told exactly what happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Sai guarded hallway A from the stairs while Katei guarded hallway B and the lobby.{w} As the hallway B rooms were inspected, Sai could've gone to the event room to take the gemstone and hide it in the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Sai guarded hallway A from the stairs while Katei guarded hallway B and the lobby.{w} As the hallway B rooms were inspected, Sai could've gone to the event room to take the gemstone and hide it in the storeroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, he let the others discover that it had disappeared and asked Akaro to go find us.
entries.literal: "Then, he let the others discover that it had disappeared and asked Akaro to go find us."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: When they came and told me what had happened, I thought you two had to get down here. Since we're dealing with this situation, I found it appropriate to join up and make sure nothing slipped away.
entries.literal: "When they came and told me what had happened, I thought you two had to get down here. Since we're dealing with this situation, I found it appropriate to join up and make sure nothing slipped away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why would he have done that?{w} ...At that point, we hadn't learned about the Sekimeiya's powers yet.{w} During the morning, Sai's attitude was different from how it was later. He often talked with me about what he thought and was visibly enjoying what was happening around him. When did that change, exactly?{w} I believe it was when we found out about time travel. He became a lot more reserved and hard to read. If he hid the Sekimeiya so early, his motive likely aligned to his original attitude.
entries.literal: "Why would he have done that?{w} ...At that point, we hadn't learned about the Sekimeiya's powers yet.{w} During the morning, Sai's attitude was different from how it was later. He often talked with me about what he thought and was visibly enjoying what was happening around him. When did that change, exactly?{w} I believe it was when we found out about time travel. He became a lot more reserved and hard to read. If he hid the Sekimeiya so early, his motive likely aligned to his original attitude."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The event room and hallway A weren't being recorded. He chose the storeroom, another place without cameras. Later on, he acted as if he'd found it there, so I don't think his intention was to keep it.{w} Did he do it for fun, or did he have a better reason? In any case, it's likely he already knew that he would point the finger at Katei, who he immediately accused.
entries.literal: "The event room and hallway A weren't being recorded. He chose the storeroom, another place without cameras. Later on, he acted as if he'd found it there, so I don't think his intention was to keep it.{w} Did he do it for fun, or did he have a better reason? In any case, it's likely he already knew that he would point the finger at Katei, who he immediately accused."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, going back a little, when we found the Past Sekimeiya in room B4, we thought it was the one that disappeared from the event room. After putting it in the cabinet, we split up and searched both hallways for the person who'd made a sound. During that time, the Past Sekimeiya was hidden somewhere else while the third Sekimeiya was in the storeroom.
entries.literal: "So, going back a little, when we found the Past Sekimeiya in room B4, we thought it was the one that disappeared from the event room. After putting it in the cabinet, we split up and searched both hallways for the person who'd made a sound. During that time, the Past Sekimeiya was hidden somewhere else while the third Sekimeiya was in the storeroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It must've been Sai again. The only choices were the people in hallway B.
entries.literal: "It must've been Sai again. The only choices were the people in hallway B."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I was told Shiroya and Akaro looked through the rooms while Sai watched the hallway like I did. We had to make sure the person we were searching for was found, so the search took a while. During the time Shiroya and Akaro were inside the crystal rooms, Sai had the chance to pick up the key in room B4, take the Sekimeiya from the event room, and then hide it somewhere in hallway B.{w} After that, he slipped the cabinet key into Shiroya's purse as soon as possible.
entries.literal: "I was told Shiroya and Akaro looked through the rooms while Sai watched the hallway like I did. We had to make sure the person we were searching for was found, so the search took a while. During the time Shiroya and Akaro were inside the crystal rooms, Sai had the chance to pick up the key in room B4, take the Sekimeiya from the event room, and then hide it somewhere in hallway B.{w} After that, he slipped the cabinet key into Shiroya's purse as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: By acting like he'd found the Sekimeiya in the storeroom, he removed any potential blame from himself.{w} I didn't really think about it, but he said we couldn't trust Katei's search and never ended up looking at all the other rooms Katei went through.
entries.literal: "By acting like he'd found the Sekimeiya in the storeroom, he removed any potential blame from himself.{w} I didn't really think about it, but he said we couldn't trust Katei's search and never ended up looking at all the other rooms Katei went through."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And still, I'm sure there's another reason Sai did that.{w} I don't know why, but everyone thought only one Sekimeiya existed. By finding the one that didn't work, he made sure we wouldn't search for the one he had hidden.
entries.literal: "And still, I'm sure there's another reason Sai did that.{w} I don't know why, but everyone thought only one Sekimeiya existed. By finding the one that didn't work, he made sure we wouldn't search for the one he had hidden."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see... That must be the answer to that question.{w} "Why is the Sekimeiya being hidden when it can easily be found?"{w} I wonder who knew the truth. I wonder who knew that three Sekimeiya existed.{w} The people who did kept hiding them because leaving the third one in the event room cabinet meant no one would look for others. The quality of their hiding spots hardly mattered—we just found one Sekimeiya and thought that was it. Maybe they were often poorly hidden precisely so that we'd find one and stop the search before coming across another.
entries.literal: "I see... That must be the answer to that question.{w} \"Why is the Sekimeiya being hidden when it can easily be found?\"{w} I wonder who knew the truth. I wonder who knew that three Sekimeiya existed.{w} The people who did kept hiding them because leaving the third one in the event room cabinet meant no one would look for others. The quality of their hiding spots hardly mattered—we just found one Sekimeiya and thought that was it. Maybe they were often poorly hidden precisely so that we'd find one and stop the search before coming across another."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro knew it from the beginning, and Sai learned it shortly after. They knew two real Sekimeiya existed alongside Xyn's fake. For twelve hours, they had a plan in mind: to keep one of the real Sekimeiya hidden.
entries.literal: "Akaro knew it from the beginning, and Sai learned it shortly after. They knew two real Sekimeiya existed alongside Xyn's fake. For twelve hours, they had a plan in mind: to keep one of the real Sekimeiya hidden."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If that was achieved, Ashiya would find two Sekimeiya, and they wouldn't search for the second real one. That was how they intended to pull it off and why they didn't want anyone else to know the truth. The Sekimeiya were hidden countless times, but the intent was rarely to keep them from being found.
entries.literal: "If that was achieved, Ashiya would find two Sekimeiya, and they wouldn't search for the second real one. That was how they intended to pull it off and why they didn't want anyone else to know the truth. The Sekimeiya were hidden countless times, but the intent was rarely to keep them from being found."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We still hadn't found the Naomi who'd made the sound, which meant that she had successfully escaped upstairs. That's why we searched through the higher floors.{w} Shiroya and I stayed on the fifth, and although we didn't hear anything, something strange happened with the elevator.
entries.literal: "We still hadn't found the Naomi who'd made the sound, which meant that she had successfully escaped upstairs. That's why we searched through the higher floors.{w} Shiroya and I stayed on the fifth, and although we didn't hear anything, something strange happened with the elevator."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Sai heard it three times. Based on that, it started from the crystal floor, which was not where we'd last left it...
entries.literal: "Sai heard it three times. Based on that, it started from the crystal floor, which was not where we'd last left it..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't believe Sai lied. Something happened during that time.
entries.literal: "I don't believe Sai lied. Something happened during that time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's because in the event room, we heard another sound. It was the bathroom's door closing.
entries.literal: "That's because in the event room, we heard another sound. It was the bathroom's door closing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, inside it, we found Naomi's second body.{w} However, I later traveled forty minutes to the past and appeared on the crystal floor before we'd all come back down.
entries.literal: "Then, inside it, we found Naomi's second body.{w} However, I later traveled forty minutes to the past and appeared on the crystal floor before we'd all come back down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I kept a close eye on the bathroom, but nothing happened until Naomi entered it...
entries.literal: "I kept a close eye on the bathroom, but nothing happened until Naomi entered it..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: First of all, why was Naomi not found? We inspected every floor but the attic. As I now understand the attic's footprints, I don't believe that Naomi went back there. Especially because she didn't have the key to unlock it.
entries.literal: "First of all, why was Naomi not found? We inspected every floor but the attic. As I now understand the attic's footprints, I don't believe that Naomi went back there. Especially because she didn't have the key to unlock it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Somehow, the search failed to find her.{w} A different person stayed on each floor, so it's possible one wasn't investigated—the floor the person who used the elevator was supposed to guard.{w} ...Erina and Isla were on the second floor. Sai was on the third floor. Akaro was on the fourth floor. Shiroya and I were on the fifth floor. Katei was on the sixth floor.
entries.literal: "Somehow, the search failed to find her.{w} A different person stayed on each floor, so it's possible one wasn't investigated—the floor the person who used the elevator was supposed to guard.{w} ...Erina and Isla were on the second floor. Sai was on the third floor. Akaro was on the fourth floor. Shiroya and I were on the fifth floor. Katei was on the sixth floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The strongest candidate to consider is Akaro.
entries.literal: "The strongest candidate to consider is Akaro."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We told him we'd left the elevator on the fifth floor, but for some reason, it was originally below Sai. If he called it from the fourth, Sai would've heard it.
entries.literal: "We told him we'd left the elevator on the fifth floor, but for some reason, it was originally below Sai. If he called it from the fourth, Sai would've heard it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, he used it to go to the crystal floor... Why, though?{w} I can't help but remember that it was him who proposed this arrangement. He wanted us to stay separated between different floors, leaving the crystal floor vacant.
entries.literal: "Then, he used it to go to the crystal floor... Why, though?{w} I can't help but remember that it was him who proposed this arrangement. He wanted us to stay separated between different floors, leaving the crystal floor vacant."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Later, he would've gone back to the fourth floor, and finally, he would've sent it to the fifth, where it was supposed to be. Shiroya and I wouldn't have noticed that.{w} It definitely ended up there: Sai confirmed it when he called it from the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "Later, he would've gone back to the fourth floor, and finally, he would've sent it to the fifth, where it was supposed to be. Shiroya and I wouldn't have noticed that.{w} It definitely ended up there: Sai confirmed it when he called it from the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't get it, though. Why would Akaro do that? He knew his trips up and down could be heard, didn't he?{w} And Erina and Isla didn't hear the elevator even once. I suppose it's possible Akaro stopped on floor 2 and then used the elevator to the crystal floor if he knew that wouldn't be heard, but if that happened, surely he would've done the same on floor 3 so that Sai wouldn't hear him either...
entries.literal: "I don't get it, though. Why would Akaro do that? He knew his trips up and down could be heard, didn't he?{w} And Erina and Isla didn't hear the elevator even once. I suppose it's possible Akaro stopped on floor 2 and then used the elevator to the crystal floor if he knew that wouldn't be heard, but if that happened, surely he would've done the same on floor 3 so that Sai wouldn't hear him either..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro had seen that one of the real Sekimeiya had been hidden in a cabinet with a damaged temperature wheel. It had changed colors, so he knew it wasn't the one Xyn had created.
entries.literal: "Akaro had seen that one of the real Sekimeiya had been hidden in a cabinet with a damaged temperature wheel. It had changed colors, so he knew it wasn't the one Xyn had created."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi A was going up the floors ahead of them, but she stopped on the fourth when she realized that was where Akaro would remain. She wanted to collect herself enough to talk to him; her shock at what Katei had done hadn't faded at all. ...However, before she did, he was gone.
entries.literal: "Naomi A was going up the floors ahead of them, but she stopped on the fourth when she realized that was where Akaro would remain. She wanted to collect herself enough to talk to him; her shock at what Katei had done hadn't faded at all. ...However, before she did, he was gone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro had a bad feeling. Something very strange was happening with the Sekimeiya, so he needed to see the cleaning cart for himself. When he did, he saw that the one he'd hidden was actually gone.
entries.literal: "Akaro had a bad feeling. Something very strange was happening with the Sekimeiya, so he needed to see the cleaning cart for himself. When he did, he saw that the one he'd hidden was actually gone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Who had taken it? Not only the one in the cart, but also one of the two Akaro had left in the event room before lying on the floor. Silently, Akaro continued watching Katei, but it could've been Naomi as well.{w} Katei was acting like only one Sekimeiya existed, and Akaro didn't know the reason. It was rational to conclude that one of them being in a cold cabinet indicated the other was as well.
entries.literal: "Who had taken it? Not only the one in the cart, but also one of the two Akaro had left in the event room before lying on the floor. Silently, Akaro continued watching Katei, but it could've been Naomi as well.{w} Katei was acting like only one Sekimeiya existed, and Akaro didn't know the reason. It was rational to conclude that one of them being in a cold cabinet indicated the other was as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: During the previous search, he had looked through that room. He knew there was another cabinet that had been set to 0 °C.{w} The other real Sekimeiya was there, and it was all he needed. He only had to keep one hidden, but there weren't many places he could think of.
entries.literal: "During the previous search, he had looked through that room. He knew there was another cabinet that had been set to 0 °C.{w} The other real Sekimeiya was there, and it was all he needed. He only had to keep one hidden, but there weren't many places he could think of."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He took the Future Sekimeiya out of the cabinet. When he did, it turned gray immediately, but nothing happened to him. Did it really have time travel powers? He had a hard time believing that, but it had just changed colors before him.
entries.literal: "He took the Future Sekimeiya out of the cabinet. When he did, it turned gray immediately, but nothing happened to him. Did it really have time travel powers? He had a hard time believing that, but it had just changed colors before him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In a rush, he chose to hide it in the men's bathroom. Inside the water tank seemed like a good idea.
entries.literal: "In a rush, he chose to hide it in the men's bathroom. Inside the water tank seemed like a good idea."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When I was staring at the bathroom door, Naomi appeared from the other side of hallway C. She likely came from above.{w} She was the Naomi who'd appeared in the attic, but her actions differed from the Naomi who'd been killed. Why? Why didn't she ask to talk to Katei? What was she doing, exactly, moving around through the building?
entries.literal: "When I was staring at the bathroom door, Naomi appeared from the other side of hallway C. She likely came from above.{w} She was the Naomi who'd appeared in the attic, but her actions differed from the Naomi who'd been killed. Why? Why didn't she ask to talk to Katei? What was she doing, exactly, moving around through the building?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Akaro's description of Naomi's face fell short of her actual expression. She was visibly terrified, breathing heavily, moving oddly, and stopping in place every few seconds."
entries.literal: "\"Akaro's description of Naomi's face fell short of her actual expression. She was visibly terrified, breathing heavily, moving oddly, and stopping in place every few seconds.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When I saw her face, there was no doubt in me that she'd seen her own dead body. She was avoiding being found, perhaps because she knew what her killer had done to her.
entries.literal: "When I saw her face, there was no doubt in me that she'd seen her own dead body. She was avoiding being found, perhaps because she knew what her killer had done to her."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What was she doing, then? When she made the sound and when she walked to that bathroom...
entries.literal: "What was she doing, then? When she made the sound and when she walked to that bathroom..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not sure, but... she was killed right there. Naomi said a few words before her body was pulled in.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure, but... she was killed right there. Naomi said a few words before her body was pulled in."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When Naomi entered the bathroom... someone else was there.
entries.literal: "When Naomi entered the bathroom... someone else was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, when I approached it, my footsteps were audible: her killer slammed the door shut and locked it.
entries.literal: "Then, when I approached it, my footsteps were audible: her killer slammed the door shut and locked it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, they couldn't have left before the point we all unlocked the door. They absolutely had to have disappeared from the bathroom.
entries.literal: "However, they couldn't have left before the point we all unlocked the door. They absolutely had to have disappeared from the bathroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How? When I inspected it by myself a bit later, no Sekimeiya was there. I don't believe it was taken out before that point either.
entries.literal: "How? When I inspected it by myself a bit later, no Sekimeiya was there. I don't believe it was taken out before that point either."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When that Naomi was killed, the third Sekimeiya was still in the event room. It's very likely the other two were hidden somewhere on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "When that Naomi was killed, the third Sekimeiya was still in the event room. It's very likely the other two were hidden somewhere on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did someone travel through time, bringing along Naomi's killer? If that's what happened, unless the Sekimeiya was on the second floor, I would've traveled too.
entries.literal: "Did someone travel through time, bringing along Naomi's killer? If that's what happened, unless the Sekimeiya was on the second floor, I would've traveled too."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I think the answer is different. I believe the Sekimeiya was inside the bathroom even though I didn't find it.
entries.literal: "I think the answer is different. I believe the Sekimeiya was inside the bathroom even though I didn't find it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After killing Naomi, her killer activated it. I had already run away, so I didn't travel.
entries.literal: "After killing Naomi, her killer activated it. I had already run away, so I didn't travel."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They traveled to the future. After all, I'm pretty sure the Past Sekimeiya was in one of hallway B's crystal rooms, which is where Shiroya and I later traveled from.{w} Maybe I should've pieced together the reason why no Sekimeiya was found in the bathroom...
entries.literal: "They traveled to the future. After all, I'm pretty sure the Past Sekimeiya was in one of hallway B's crystal rooms, which is where Shiroya and I later traveled from.{w} Maybe I should've pieced together the reason why no Sekimeiya was found in the bathroom..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: A while later, right after I couldn't find anything inside, I heard a sound coming from hallway A. It was Sai.
entries.literal: "A while later, right after I couldn't find anything inside, I heard a sound coming from hallway A. It was Sai."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He had traveled from the future, and in his hip pack was a disabled Sekimeiya that he didn't know about.
entries.literal: "He had traveled from the future, and in his hip pack was a disabled Sekimeiya that he didn't know about."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He appeared with it—if that was the Future Sekimeiya, the one in the bathroom would've disappeared! It would have instantly teleported. I should've made that connection.
entries.literal: "He appeared with it—if that was the Future Sekimeiya, the one in the bathroom would've disappeared! It would have instantly teleported. I should've made that connection."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, the person who traveled to the future... who was it? Who killed Naomi?{w} Knowing all of that, the answer has to be Akaro...
entries.literal: "So, the person who traveled to the future... who was it? Who killed Naomi?{w} Knowing all of that, the answer has to be Akaro..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When I approached the bathroom, the door was slammed. I knew the whole floor was about to be inspected, so I ran up the stairs.
entries.literal: "When I approached the bathroom, the door was slammed. I knew the whole floor was about to be inspected, so I ran up the stairs."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, eventually, the others walked up—they'd found the attic key.
entries.literal: "Then, eventually, the others walked up—they'd found the attic key."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: As soon as I could, I went back down. I tried to find Akaro, who had suddenly disappeared from the group. ...But I couldn't.
entries.literal: "As soon as I could, I went back down. I tried to find Akaro, who had suddenly disappeared from the group. ...But I couldn't."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I stopped myself when I saw the bathroom's door. It looked identical to how we'd seen it with the group when we found Akaro behind it, and I realized it had been me who'd left it like that. I concluded that no one else would touch the door.
entries.literal: "I stopped myself when I saw the bathroom's door. It looked identical to how we'd seen it with the group when we found Akaro behind it, and I realized it had been me who'd left it like that. I concluded that no one else would touch the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And it never happened. I watched from a distance for minutes, and when the group came from the attic, Akaro was already there. I can only think he teleported inside.{w} Why didn't he leave, though?
entries.literal: "And it never happened. I watched from a distance for minutes, and when the group came from the attic, Akaro was already there. I can only think he teleported inside.{w} Why didn't he leave, though?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's gotta be due to the mental state we found him in. He looked out of it and unresponsive, likely because he had just killed a second Naomi who couldn't have existed.{w} After locking the door, he touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom and went some amount of minutes into the future. Seeing as he appeared in the bathroom, it makes me think it was him who hid the Sekimeiya there in the past. That's why he knew where it was and why he rapidly activated it in an attempt to escape.
entries.literal: "That's gotta be due to the mental state we found him in. He looked out of it and unresponsive, likely because he had just killed a second Naomi who couldn't have existed.{w} After locking the door, he touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom and went some amount of minutes into the future. Seeing as he appeared in the bathroom, it makes me think it was him who hid the Sekimeiya there in the past. That's why he knew where it was and why he rapidly activated it in an attempt to escape."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But that doesn't explain the whole set of events. After we found Naomi's second body, we suddenly lost track of Akaro. We even looked all over the floor, but he wasn't anywhere, and Erina said he hadn't gone up.
entries.literal: "But that doesn't explain the whole set of events. After we found Naomi's second body, we suddenly lost track of Akaro. We even looked all over the floor, but he wasn't anywhere, and Erina said he hadn't gone up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The only explanation for all of this is that he traveled to the past. Later, he even admitted to having touched the Sekimeiya.{w} That makes a lot of sense. If Sai hid it in the crystal room that Shiroya and I later traveled from, we would've gone much more than forty minutes into the past.
entries.literal: "The only explanation for all of this is that he traveled to the past. Later, he even admitted to having touched the Sekimeiya.{w} That makes a lot of sense. If Sai hid it in the crystal room that Shiroya and I later traveled from, we would've gone much more than forty minutes into the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That makes me think that Akaro saw through Sai. Maybe he was aware that more than one Sekimeiya existed.{w} If that was the case, from his point of view, only Sai could've hidden the Past Sekimeiya. He knew the one we found in the storeroom wasn't the same one, so it wouldn't have been too hard to find out where it was. I remember that Shiroya found it quickly because she noticed a slight bump in one of the gem cabinets.
entries.literal: "That makes me think that Akaro saw through Sai. Maybe he was aware that more than one Sekimeiya existed.{w} If that was the case, from his point of view, only Sai could've hidden the Past Sekimeiya. He knew the one we found in the storeroom wasn't the same one, so it wouldn't have been too hard to find out where it was. I remember that Shiroya found it quickly because she noticed a slight bump in one of the gem cabinets."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He traveled to the past, which is why we didn't find him. I'm not sure what led him to do it, but that reset the Sekimeiya's timer, allowing Shiroya and I to only travel forty minutes back when we found it.
entries.literal: "He traveled to the past, which is why we didn't find him. I'm not sure what led him to do it, but that reset the Sekimeiya's timer, allowing Shiroya and I to only travel forty minutes back when we found it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Later, Akaro said that upon touching the Sekimeiya, he teleported. However, he assured us he hadn't traveled through time.{w} He said he'd seen us searching through the floor, but he was probably referring to the search from minutes prior.
entries.literal: "Later, Akaro said that upon touching the Sekimeiya, he teleported. However, he assured us he hadn't traveled through time.{w} He said he'd seen us searching through the floor, but he was probably referring to the search from minutes prior."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Specifically, when we went up the floors and the three elevator trips happened. It's also the time where he I think he stored the Future Sekimeiya in the bathroom, so seeing his past self might have drawn him there.
entries.literal: "Specifically, when we went up the floors and the three elevator trips happened. It's also the time where he I think he stored the Future Sekimeiya in the bathroom, so seeing his past self might have drawn him there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't know why he killed Naomi, but this has to be the truth. ...Was murdering her the cause of the state we found him in?{w} When we saw him, the first thing he did was ask Sai for the time, and when he heard it, he said that he hadn't traveled through time—that he'd only teleported.
entries.literal: "I don't know why he killed Naomi, but this has to be the truth. ...Was murdering her the cause of the state we found him in?{w} When we saw him, the first thing he did was ask Sai for the time, and when he heard it, he said that he hadn't traveled through time—that he'd only teleported."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wouldn't this explain it?{w} He went minutes to the past. I could probably calculate the exact amount, but that seems unnecessary.{w} There, he killed Naomi and immediately went to the future when he heard me approaching the bathroom.{w} If both travels were similar in length, upon being told the current time, he would've thought that he hadn't traveled through time at all, especially because he appeared in the bathroom when he went to the future. He barely moved, so there was no way he'd earlier gone to the past...{w} But there seemed to be more to it than that. Akaro's voice seemed deeper in denial.
entries.literal: "Wouldn't this explain it?{w} He went minutes to the past. I could probably calculate the exact amount, but that seems unnecessary.{w} There, he killed Naomi and immediately went to the future when he heard me approaching the bathroom.{w} If both travels were similar in length, upon being told the current time, he would've thought that he hadn't traveled through time at all, especially because he appeared in the bathroom when he went to the future. He barely moved, so there was no way he'd earlier gone to the past...{w} But there seemed to be more to it than that. Akaro's voice seemed deeper in denial."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the bathroom, when the door opened, what Akaro last expected was to see Naomi lying on the floor again.{w} He had been incredibly worried that she'd seen him missing in the event room. If that had happened, she was a massive threat.
entries.literal: "In the bathroom, when the door opened, what Akaro last expected was to see Naomi lying on the floor again.{w} He had been incredibly worried that she'd seen him missing in the event room. If that had happened, she was a massive threat."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, out of nowhere, she had appeared dead in a room. Akaro, much to his own disgust, was relieved by that.
entries.literal: "However, out of nowhere, she had appeared dead in a room. Akaro, much to his own disgust, was relieved by that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yet, for some reason, it hadn't ended there. Once he had progressed to different worries, Naomi had appeared dead a second time.{w} Akaro had no idea what was happening inside the tower. He only wanted his plan to succeed in order to have a future ahead of him.
entries.literal: "Yet, for some reason, it hadn't ended there. Once he had progressed to different worries, Naomi had appeared dead a second time.{w} Akaro had no idea what was happening inside the tower. He only wanted his plan to succeed in order to have a future ahead of him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why was the bathroom suddenly empty? Where had her body gone? ...Could he really have gone to the past? The last time, the Sekimeiya had merely changed colors when he'd touched it, but that time, he appeared in hallway C.
entries.literal: "Why was the bathroom suddenly empty? Where had her body gone? ...Could he really have gone to the past? The last time, the Sekimeiya had merely changed colors when he'd touched it, but that time, he appeared in hallway C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The third time he saw Naomi's face, her eyes were staring into his. It couldn't be real; he doubted the stability of his own mind.{w} When her mouth opened, the words Akaro had been dreading entered his ears. She knew he had left the event room, and she knew that he'd been concealing it.
entries.literal: "The third time he saw Naomi's face, her eyes were staring into his. It couldn't be real; he doubted the stability of his own mind.{w} When her mouth opened, the words Akaro had been dreading entered his ears. She knew he had left the event room, and she knew that he'd been concealing it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro lost himself in desperation. Naomi should've been dead—he couldn't comprehend how she'd come back. After a single, abrupt motion, she was on the floor, unresponsive.
entries.literal: "Akaro lost himself in desperation. Naomi should've been dead—he couldn't comprehend how she'd come back. After a single, abrupt motion, she was on the floor, unresponsive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Immediately after that, Akaro heard footsteps approaching from the hallway. He was barely able to make them out over the violent drumming in his ears. As fast as he could, he slammed the door and frantically looked around him.
entries.literal: "Immediately after that, Akaro heard footsteps approaching from the hallway. He was barely able to make them out over the violent drumming in his ears. As fast as he could, he slammed the door and frantically looked around him."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When I realized one of the keys the first Naomi had was the attic's, we went there for the first time.
entries.literal: "When I realized one of the keys the first Naomi had was the attic's, we went there for the first time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Sai pointed out that Naomi's footprints didn't make sense, and we found an empty suitcase on the sofa. ...It was the same one we saw in hallway C—it had come from another world alongside Naomi.
entries.literal: "Sai pointed out that Naomi's footprints didn't make sense, and we found an empty suitcase on the sofa. ...It was the same one we saw in hallway C—it had come from another world alongside Naomi."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's likely where she was keeping the Sekimeiya. To change worlds, both had to be powered on, so they didn't travel with Naomi. That's why the suitcase was empty, and it's why it wasn't in the attic in this world.
entries.literal: "That's likely where she was keeping the Sekimeiya. To change worlds, both had to be powered on, so they didn't travel with Naomi. That's why the suitcase was empty, and it's why it wasn't in the attic in this world."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And now that I think about it, someone reacted differently to both suitcases.{w} Katei.
entries.literal: "And now that I think about it, someone reacted differently to both suitcases.{w} Katei."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Before we entered the attic, when Katei went to grab the bathroom key, he brought the suitcase in hallway C to the security room. But he never did that for the one in the attic.
entries.literal: "Before we entered the attic, when Katei went to grab the bathroom key, he brought the suitcase in hallway C to the security room. But he never did that for the one in the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why...? That makes me think it's because Naomi brought it up there. That one wasn't a threat to him because he didn't know anything about it.
entries.literal: "Why...? That makes me think it's because Naomi brought it up there. That one wasn't a threat to him because he didn't know anything about it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We didn't find anything else of importance in the attic, so we went down to find Akaro. He was in a crystal floor bathroom and told us to leave him there for a while.
entries.literal: "We didn't find anything else of importance in the attic, so we went down to find Akaro. He was in a crystal floor bathroom and told us to leave him there for a while."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We ended up going back to the top... and in one of the bedrooms, I noticed the voice recorder in Isla's purse.
entries.literal: "We ended up going back to the top... and in one of the bedrooms, I noticed the voice recorder in Isla's purse."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now I know a lot more about the audio that we heard, but why was it there? Why did it travel to the past?
entries.literal: "Now I know a lot more about the audio that we heard, but why was it there? Why did it travel to the past?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Can I figure that out? How did the recorder from the future end up on December 15th?
entries.literal: "Can I figure that out? How did the recorder from the future end up on December 15th?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Thinking about it, it's very unlikely the device traveled to December 15th.{w} Isla said it was impossible someone dropped it in her purse, which means it was there when she entered the tower.
entries.literal: "Thinking about it, it's very unlikely the device traveled to December 15th.{w} Isla said it was impossible someone dropped it in her purse, which means it was there when she entered the tower."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If that's the case, why did she have it before December 15th?
entries.literal: "If that's the case, why did she have it before December 15th?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I think... I know the answer.{w} It has to be due to her "friend".
entries.literal: "I think... I know the answer.{w} It has to be due to her \"friend\"."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now I know that her friend was a version of her from another world. She met with our Isla quite a while before December 15th. She knew about the attack, so she traveled to the past at some point.
entries.literal: "Now I know that her friend was a version of her from another world. She met with our Isla quite a while before December 15th. She knew about the attack, so she traveled to the past at some point."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Apparently, when Sai and Akaro escaped from the attic, they met with "Isla". Even Erina heard her from the bedroom. She was dead at that point, so she probably wasn't the same Isla we'd been with.{w} Despite that, we never found her after we left the bedroom, so one explanation is that she traveled to the past at around that time.
entries.literal: "Apparently, when Sai and Akaro escaped from the attic, they met with \"Isla\". Even Erina heard her from the bedroom. She was dead at that point, so she probably wasn't the same Isla we'd been with.{w} Despite that, we never found her after we left the bedroom, so one explanation is that she traveled to the past at around that time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She went many days into the past, and the location where she appeared had to be identical to where she'd be in the proportional future. That means days after December 15th.
entries.literal: "She went many days into the past, and the location where she appeared had to be identical to where she'd be in the proportional future. That means days after December 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, what happened to the device after it recorded the audio? Isla saw Sai hiding it, and she ended up with it.{w} If the replicated location was from a time where she still had it in the future, she would've appeared with it in the past.
entries.literal: "So, what happened to the device after it recorded the audio? Isla saw Sai hiding it, and she ended up with it.{w} If the replicated location was from a time where she still had it in the future, she would've appeared with it in the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isla's "friend" had the recorder days before the event; that's how it got to the past. ...Why was it inside our Isla's purse, then?
entries.literal: "Isla's \"friend\" had the recorder days before the event; that's how it got to the past. ...Why was it inside our Isla's purse, then?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can't know that, but it's likely the recorder appeared inside her friend's purse. Then, both Islas tried to hide the existence of the "friend" from Erina.{w} Two identical purses were in the past. There was probably a mix-up at some point, like the original Isla mistakenly taking the wrong purse on the day of the event for some reason.
entries.literal: "I can't know that, but it's likely the recorder appeared inside her friend's purse. Then, both Islas tried to hide the existence of the \"friend\" from Erina.{w} Two identical purses were in the past. There was probably a mix-up at some point, like the original Isla mistakenly taking the wrong purse on the day of the event for some reason."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think I need to know exactly how it came to happen, but it had to be Isla's friend who caused the recording to exist in the past.
entries.literal: "I don't think I need to know exactly how it came to happen, but it had to be Isla's friend who caused the recording to exist in the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After we listened to it, Shiroya and I left the attic alone. Going down the floors, we came across Akaro, who kept walking up. Then, on the crystal floor, we saw that the Sekimeiya we left in the event room was no longer there.{w} Someone took the third Sekimeiya out of the cabinet. ...Who would've wanted to do that?{w} At first glance, Akaro seemed to be the only candidate. However, I know someone else was there.
