entries.literal: "After we listened to it, Shiroya and I left the attic alone. Going down the floors, we came across Akaro, who kept walking up. Then, on the crystal floor, we saw that the Sekimeiya we left in the event room was no longer there.{w} Someone took the third Sekimeiya out of the cabinet. ...Who would've wanted to do that?{w} At first glance, Akaro seemed to be the only candidate. However, I know someone else was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Shiroya and I found the Past Sekimeiya in a hallway B crystal room, unaware that it wasn't the same one that had just disappeared. That's most likely where Sai chose to hide it a while earlier.{w} What stands out to me is that he chose a room with functional cameras after previously leaving it in the storeroom. I wonder if he was forced to or if he had a reason, because it happened when we were searching both hallways...
entries.literal: "Shiroya and I found the Past Sekimeiya in a hallway B crystal room, unaware that it wasn't the same one that had just disappeared. That's most likely where Sai chose to hide it a while earlier.{w} What stands out to me is that he chose a room with functional cameras after previously leaving it in the storeroom. I wonder if he was forced to or if he had a reason, because it happened when we were searching both hallways..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It had been there since the previous time the Sekimeiya had disappeared, so it's worth noting that it wasn't found when we looked for Akaro, especially since he would've left the glass open after traveling.{w} ...Recalling how that search went, though, I'm pretty sure I get why that happened.
entries.literal: "It had been there since the previous time the Sekimeiya had disappeared, so it's worth noting that it wasn't found when we looked for Akaro, especially since he would've left the glass open after traveling.{w} ...Recalling how that search went, though, I'm pretty sure I get why that happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We activated it and went forty minutes to the past. Thanks to that travel, we learned about the existence of the range.
entries.literal: "We activated it and went forty minutes to the past. Thanks to that travel, we learned about the existence of the range."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After appearing in the security room, I witnessed what happened to the second Naomi. Then, I heard someone in hallway A: Sai.
entries.literal: "After appearing in the security room, I witnessed what happened to the second Naomi. Then, I heard someone in hallway A: Sai."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He was supposed to be in the attic. It's indisputable that he traveled through time. Due to his wristwatch, I'm sure he came from the future.
entries.literal: "He was supposed to be in the attic. It's indisputable that he traveled through time. Due to his wristwatch, I'm sure he came from the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Much later, he admitted to remembering the time I'd seen him, so it was definitely the same Sai who told the people in the attic not to follow us.{w} The way he traveled to the past confused me for a while. That's because he was surprised to see me; he didn't know I'd also traveled. If he traveled after Shiroya and I returned to the attic, he would've had to fake his surprise upon seeing me.
entries.literal: "Much later, he admitted to remembering the time I'd seen him, so it was definitely the same Sai who told the people in the attic not to follow us.{w} The way he traveled to the past confused me for a while. That's because he was surprised to see me; he didn't know I'd also traveled. If he traveled after Shiroya and I returned to the attic, he would've had to fake his surprise upon seeing me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You perfectly remember when we went up to the attic to get the lithium battery, right?
entries.literal: "You perfectly remember when we went up to the attic to get the lithium battery, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Of course.
entries.literal: "Of course."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: How did you do that?
entries.literal: "How did you do that?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I said you're incompetent, but at least you're doing your best, unlike the others.
entries.literal: "I said you're incompetent, but at least you're doing your best, unlike the others."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's my answer. I suppose it just appeared impressive from your point of view.
entries.literal: "That's my answer. I suppose it just appeared impressive from your point of view."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How did he travel before Shiroya and I returned? The others said he was there the whole time.{w} ...Is that really the case, though?{w} Shiroya told me what she heard when she was listening to them.
entries.literal: "How did he travel before Shiroya and I returned? The others said he was there the whole time.{w} ...Is that really the case, though?{w} Shiroya told me what she heard when she was listening to them."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes. He was leading the conversation, telling everyone not to follow us down. Akaro was there too, and he confirmed that he saw us. Sai told them all to wait for us because we'd be responsible for anything that happened after leaving of our own volition...
entries.literal: "Yes. He was leading the conversation, telling everyone not to follow us down. Akaro was there too, and he confirmed that he saw us. Sai told them all to wait for us because we'd be responsible for anything that happened after leaving of our own volition..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I see. So he wanted the others not to come down.
entries.literal: "...I see. So he wanted the others not to come down."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: He kept saying it. He never left, and the elevator was still there with the door open. The conversation started winding down, and when they talked about going to the bathroom, I left right away so nobody would see me.{w} I stayed in the living room for a couple minutes with the doors closed, but I think that they all took that time to go to the bathroom, so I started going down again to find you. I looked through every floor until I saw you right as I was about to start with this one.
entries.literal: "He kept saying it. He never left, and the elevator was still there with the door open. The conversation started winding down, and when they talked about going to the bathroom, I left right away so nobody would see me.{w} I stayed in the living room for a couple minutes with the doors closed, but I think that they all took that time to go to the bathroom, so I started going down again to find you. I looked through every floor until I saw you right as I was about to start with this one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That was all Sai needed to trick the others.{w} Everyone went to the bathroom, so when it was his turn, he could've gone to the crystal floor. He had hidden the Past Sekimeiya, so he traveled after us when it had already gathered a lot of energy.{w} There was something curious about Sai's behavior. He kept insisting that he hadn't traveled to the past, and he was in a rush. He tried to run away from me twice.{w} That's probably because he had to be ready to go back to the attic. As soon as his past self "went to the bathroom", he returned as if nothing had happened, which made the others say that he never left the attic.
entries.literal: "That was all Sai needed to trick the others.{w} Everyone went to the bathroom, so when it was his turn, he could've gone to the crystal floor. He had hidden the Past Sekimeiya, so he traveled after us when it had already gathered a lot of energy.{w} There was something curious about Sai's behavior. He kept insisting that he hadn't traveled to the past, and he was in a rush. He tried to run away from me twice.{w} That's probably because he had to be ready to go back to the attic. As soon as his past self \"went to the bathroom\", he returned as if nothing had happened, which made the others say that he never left the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't know about the actual specifics. Shiroya said it was possible she missed him when she was inspecting the office rooms, but when we returned to the attic, we didn't see Sai's footprints in the living room...{w} That's strange, since I don't think he could've taken the elevator back up. The key was in the attic's door, and he wouldn't have appeared with it, so he couldn't have activated the floor 7 button. Furthermore, it should have been disabled in the attic anyway.
entries.literal: "I don't know about the actual specifics. Shiroya said it was possible she missed him when she was inspecting the office rooms, but when we returned to the attic, we didn't see Sai's footprints in the living room...{w} That's strange, since I don't think he could've taken the elevator back up. The key was in the attic's door, and he wouldn't have appeared with it, so he couldn't have activated the floor 7 button. Furthermore, it should have been disabled in the attic anyway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not sure if this is exactly what happened, but maybe when Shiroya was in the attic, Sai, claiming to go to the bathroom, sent the elevator to the crystal floor and called it. Then, he went to the bathroom.{w} Afterward, he took the elevator down. If Shiroya was still in the attic, she wouldn't have heard it. Sai traveled to the past, and that's where I met up with him.{w} Entering the elevator on the crystal floor and waiting for his past self to call it was one route back to the attic.
entries.literal: "I'm not sure if this is exactly what happened, but maybe when Shiroya was in the attic, Sai, claiming to go to the bathroom, sent the elevator to the crystal floor and called it. Then, he went to the bathroom.{w} Afterward, he took the elevator down. If Shiroya was still in the attic, she wouldn't have heard it. Sai traveled to the past, and that's where I met up with him.{w} Entering the elevator on the crystal floor and waiting for his past self to call it was one route back to the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't know if his plan went this far or if I'm missing something else...{w} Maybe he did all of this just so he wouldn't be analyzed for what he wanted to do. He set it up so that Shiroya and I would be much easier to suspect.
entries.literal: "I don't know if his plan went this far or if I'm missing something else...{w} Maybe he did all of this just so he wouldn't be analyzed for what he wanted to do. He set it up so that Shiroya and I would be much easier to suspect."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But again, what about the cameras? They would've recorded him going down.{w} Later, he voiced his thoughts regarding that—he didn't think the recorded footage would ever see the light of the day. As far as he and the rest of us knew, the killer had willingly recorded themselves committing crimes.
entries.literal: "But again, what about the cameras? They would've recorded him going down.{w} Later, he voiced his thoughts regarding that—he didn't think the recorded footage would ever see the light of the day. As far as he and the rest of us knew, the killer had willingly recorded themselves committing crimes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What was it he wanted to do? He'd hidden a functional Sekimeiya, so I bet he wanted to know whether he'd really travel through time with it.{w} He took the third Sekimeiya away from the cabinet even though it was him who found it for us...
entries.literal: "What was it he wanted to do? He'd hidden a functional Sekimeiya, so I bet he wanted to know whether he'd really travel through time with it.{w} He took the third Sekimeiya away from the cabinet even though it was him who found it for us..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And the Future Sekimeiya... He appeared with it in his hip pack. I think he was genuinely surprised about that.
entries.literal: "And the Future Sekimeiya... He appeared with it in his hip pack. I think he was genuinely surprised about that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, when he ran away from me, he hid the Past Sekimeiya somewhere else. He knew I'd traveled through time, meaning that I was aware of its whereabouts.
entries.literal: "Then, when he ran away from me, he hid the Past Sekimeiya somewhere else. He knew I'd traveled through time, meaning that I was aware of its whereabouts."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There is one detail I'm still struggling to understand.
entries.literal: "There is one detail I'm still struggling to understand."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The screen on his wristwatch was blank. The fundamental answer behind that has to be the replicated location upon traveling to the past.
entries.literal: "The screen on his wristwatch was blank. The fundamental answer behind that has to be the replicated location upon traveling to the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But, even if the watch looped through time infinitely and didn't just crumble into dust, why did the date go up to the year 9,999? There's no chance the battery would've lasted that long, and it was swapping it for a new one that let the watch work again.
entries.literal: "But, even if the watch looped through time infinitely and didn't just crumble into dust, why did the date go up to the year 9,999? There's no chance the battery would've lasted that long, and it was swapping it for a new one that let the watch work again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The answer to that is clear: it's because a new battery was added before the location to be replicated took place in the future. Thanks to that, if the watch looped infinitely, the addition of the new battery would let each instance add up more time without the battery ever running out.
entries.literal: "The answer to that is clear: it's because a new battery was added before the location to be replicated took place in the future. Thanks to that, if the watch looped infinitely, the addition of the new battery would let each instance add up more time without the battery ever running out."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, this brings about another issue. Why didn't the watch work in the past?{w} After all, it worked again when we added the new battery. This means that minutes later, during the future location, the watch should've been working. It seems to be an impossibility that it wasn't working in the past, given both locations are supposed to be the same.
entries.literal: "However, this brings about another issue. Why didn't the watch work in the past?{w} After all, it worked again when we added the new battery. This means that minutes later, during the future location, the watch should've been working. It seems to be an impossibility that it wasn't working in the past, given both locations are supposed to be the same."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is there an answer to this? One that makes sense?
entries.literal: "...Is there an answer to this? One that makes sense?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If Sai traveled a second time before the future location, the battery would've instantly run out. However, I have no reason to believe that occurred. I think the answer could be something else.
entries.literal: "If Sai traveled a second time before the future location, the battery would've instantly run out. However, I have no reason to believe that occurred. I think the answer could be something else."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If Sai swapped back the batteries before the future location, it would explain the broken watch in the past. However, I have no reason to believe that occurred. I think the answer could be something else.
entries.literal: "If Sai swapped back the batteries before the future location, it would explain the broken watch in the past. However, I have no reason to believe that occurred. I think the answer could be something else."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now that I think more about it, it could be due to the lithium battery itself.{w} It was in the attic, a place that's been abandoned for many years. It was, I have to assume, a battery that the Ashiya family had when they lived there.
entries.literal: "Now that I think more about it, it could be due to the lithium battery itself.{w} It was in the attic, a place that's been abandoned for many years. It was, I have to assume, a battery that the Ashiya family had when they lived there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Lithium batteries discharge something like 2%% of their capacity every month. When we put it in the watch, it was probably almost entirely discharged.
entries.literal: "Lithium batteries discharge something like 2%% of their capacity every month. When we put it in the watch, it was probably almost entirely discharged."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The small energy it had was enough to let the loop cap the timer at 9,999, but it also ran out before the future location.
entries.literal: "The small energy it had was enough to let the loop cap the timer at 9,999, but it also ran out before the future location."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We eventually learned that, in the lobby, Sai asked Katei for another lithium battery. At that point, I don't actually think he should've traveled through time again. That happened because the battery we'd obtained from the attic had already run out.
entries.literal: "We eventually learned that, in the lobby, Sai asked Katei for another lithium battery. At that point, I don't actually think he should've traveled through time again. That happened because the battery we'd obtained from the attic had already run out."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}But does this really make sense, or am I missing something crucial? I just remembered...{w} Sai must have synced his watch to the computer after we saw the "9,999" date since it was working when Shiroya and I returned to the attic. The time would always have been set to that specific point before reaching the end of the loop, so it couldn't have kept counting up...
entries.literal: "...{w}But does this really make sense, or am I missing something crucial? I just remembered...{w} Sai must have synced his watch to the computer after we saw the \"9,999\" date since it was working when Shiroya and I returned to the attic. The time would always have been set to that specific point before reaching the end of the loop, so it couldn't have kept counting up..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Would the date have been able to reach "9,999" anyway? In the end, I'm not really sure I understand how that happened.
entries.literal: "Would the date have been able to reach \"9,999\" anyway? In the end, I'm not really sure I understand how that happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...After Shiroya and I reunited outside the security room, we went back to the attic, where we were told we'd been downstairs for fifty minutes. ...There, Sai's watch displayed the current time, but that was because he had seen it in the security room.
entries.literal: "...After Shiroya and I reunited outside the security room, we went back to the attic, where we were told we'd been downstairs for fifty minutes. ...There, Sai's watch displayed the current time, but that was because he had seen it in the security room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We explained everything. Most importantly, the Sekimeiya had disappeared from the event room. That's why we went to the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "We explained everything. Most importantly, the Sekimeiya had disappeared from the event room. That's why we went to the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we got there, Sai was already gone.
entries.literal: "When we got there, Sai was already gone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We were fast enough to see him in front of the cleaning room, where he'd hidden a Sekimeiya.{w} I thought something then...
entries.literal: "We were fast enough to see him in front of the cleaning room, where he'd hidden a Sekimeiya.{w} I thought something then..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Shiroya was looking around while I questioned Sai's ambiguous action. If he'd concealed the Sekimeiya in that room, I wasn't sure why he left upon realizing that we'd seen him. He had the opportunity to give up, but instead, he left for hallway C."
entries.literal: "\"Shiroya was looking around while I questioned Sai's ambiguous action. If he'd concealed the Sekimeiya in that room, I wasn't sure why he left upon realizing that we'd seen him. He had the opportunity to give up, but instead, he left for hallway C.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He likely wanted to travel through time, probably because he knew we were about to search the floor. But even though we'd seen him, he still had another Sekimeiya hidden somewhere else. In fact, at that point, he should've known where all three of them were, and he went toward hallway A...
entries.literal: "He likely wanted to travel through time, probably because he knew we were about to search the floor. But even though we'd seen him, he still had another Sekimeiya hidden somewhere else. In fact, at that point, he should've known where all three of them were, and he went toward hallway A..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And out of nowhere, I teleported. Shiroya saw the Sekimeiya's glow within the cleaning cart and made both of us appear in the attic.
entries.literal: "And out of nowhere, I teleported. Shiroya saw the Sekimeiya's glow within the cleaning cart and made both of us appear in the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At the time, we thought we'd gone to the past. That's not what happened, though.{w} We recognized our locations—we'd been there half an hour before we'd traveled. That means we went half an hour to the future.
entries.literal: "At the time, we thought we'd gone to the past. That's not what happened, though.{w} We recognized our locations—we'd been there half an hour before we'd traveled. That means we went half an hour to the future."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The staircase door is open, so this is past the time we unlocked the attic. There are a bunch of footprints next to the door, but I don't see ours. This must mean that you and I haven't gone down yet.{w} These are probably the ones that we left after going back up, when we found Akaro in the bathroom. We're not before that point since there are too many.
entries.literal: "The staircase door is open, so this is past the time we unlocked the attic. There are a bunch of footprints next to the door, but I don't see ours. This must mean that you and I haven't gone down yet.{w} These are probably the ones that we left after going back up, when we found Akaro in the bathroom. We're not before that point since there are too many."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That was a big misinterpretation.{w} We were told what caused those footprints. It was the search that occurred after Isla went missing; the ones Shiroya and I had left were long buried.{w} They were all slightly faded too. There was no chance we'd just traveled a few seconds back, which led me to be pretty certain of the time.
entries.literal: "That was a big misinterpretation.{w} We were told what caused those footprints. It was the search that occurred after Isla went missing; the ones Shiroya and I had left were long buried.{w} They were all slightly faded too. There was no chance we'd just traveled a few seconds back, which led me to be pretty certain of the time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How is that possible, though?{w} We heard a sound coming from the bedroom where we'd been. Who the hell was that? Nobody should've been there, right?
entries.literal: "How is that possible, though?{w} We heard a sound coming from the bedroom where we'd been. Who the hell was that? Nobody should've been there, right?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We hid ourselves, thinking we were escaping the sight of our past selves. ...It appears that didn't actually occur.
entries.literal: "We hid ourselves, thinking we were escaping the sight of our past selves. ...It appears that didn't actually occur."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And in the second level of the opposite bedroom, both of us fell asleep.{w} When we woke up, we had no idea how long we'd been there for. That's why, when we were told the time, we thought we'd slept for quite a while. In reality, the main reason a lot of time had passed was because we'd gone to the future.
entries.literal: "And in the second level of the opposite bedroom, both of us fell asleep.{w} When we woke up, we had no idea how long we'd been there for. That's why, when we were told the time, we thought we'd slept for quite a while. In reality, the main reason a lot of time had passed was because we'd gone to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe it. We'd really misunderstood so many things.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe it. We'd really misunderstood so many things."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we woke up, we had no idea what transpired on the crystal floor. Tired and still uneasy about our nonexistent past selves, we went to the living room.
entries.literal: "When we woke up, we had no idea what transpired on the crystal floor. Tired and still uneasy about our nonexistent past selves, we went to the living room."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Did we leave it like this?
entries.literal: "Did we leave it like this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "We were used to looking at the footprints in front of the door, but that was no longer possible. The door was closed, and the movement of it had erased every single footprint nearby, creating an empty arc."
entries.literal: "\"We were used to looking at the footprints in front of the door, but that was no longer possible. The door was closed, and the movement of it had erased every single footprint nearby, creating an empty arc.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We must have. This means that the group already left, though.
entries.literal: "We must have. This means that the group already left, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Even though the motion of the door wiped out the nearby marks, there were many around the entire room. They were much fainter than the last time I'd seen them, but I was still able to recognize that new ones existed."
entries.literal: "\"Even though the motion of the door wiped out the nearby marks, there were many around the entire room. They were much fainter than the last time I'd seen them, but I was still able to recognize that new ones existed.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The new footprints weren't from the time we walked to the crystal floor. ...Who did they belong to?
entries.literal: "The new footprints weren't from the time we walked to the crystal floor. ...Who did they belong to?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That was simple to solve—the remaining few gaps in that puzzle were all part of the same piece.
entries.literal: "...That was simple to solve—the remaining few gaps in that puzzle were all part of the same piece."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we came down, we saw that the cleaning cart had disappeared. What was strange was that the Sekimeiya was in one of the buckets which had been below it.{w} But that wasn't the Future Sekimeiya; it wasn't working.{w} Why was the third Sekimeiya there? Had it also been in the cart when we'd traveled? Shiroya said something else was there, but would the third Sekimeiya not have disappeared with the cart? ...And she said it was a dark object.{w} I'm not sure, but I think I can guess what happened to the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "When we came down, we saw that the cleaning cart had disappeared. What was strange was that the Sekimeiya was in one of the buckets which had been below it.{w} But that wasn't the Future Sekimeiya; it wasn't working.{w} Why was the third Sekimeiya there? Had it also been in the cart when we'd traveled? Shiroya said something else was there, but would the third Sekimeiya not have disappeared with the cart? ...And she said it was a dark object.{w} I'm not sure, but I think I can guess what happened to the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When Shiroya used it, the Future Sekimeiya remained in the cleaning room, but we only found the third Sekimeiya, which we decided to leave in Naomi's locker before going to the lobby.
entries.literal: "When Shiroya used it, the Future Sekimeiya remained in the cleaning room, but we only found the third Sekimeiya, which we decided to leave in Naomi's locker before going to the lobby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There, Sai explained what happened while we were absent.
entries.literal: "There, Sai explained what happened while we were absent."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He pointed out the fact that he was the first person to enter the cleaning room after our disappearance. Since we had followed him there, he knew it was possible we'd traveled.
entries.literal: "He pointed out the fact that he was the first person to enter the cleaning room after our disappearance. Since we had followed him there, he knew it was possible we'd traveled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Sai, showing the strongest reaction, approached the room while letting out a conspicuous grunt.{w} He opened the door and stayed still for some time. Then, he entered the small space. Before the others had time to wonder what he was doing, he exited and told them that it was empty."
entries.literal: "\"Sai, showing the strongest reaction, approached the room while letting out a conspicuous grunt.{w} He opened the door and stayed still for some time. Then, he entered the small space. Before the others had time to wonder what he was doing, he exited and told them that it was empty.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The powered-off Sekimeiya was there, and he put it in his hip pack. That's why he had appeared with it in the past...{w} In the cleaning room, the others were distracted by the missing cart, and Sai pointed out the third Sekimeiya in the bucket.{w} I'm still having trouble understanding the cause behind some of these details, though. He was only able to obtain the Future Sekimeiya like that because he had appeared with it and had hidden it in the cleaning room... This seems to be an event with no origin, so perhaps it's an indication that something else happened on top of it.
entries.literal: "The powered-off Sekimeiya was there, and he put it in his hip pack. That's why he had appeared with it in the past...{w} In the cleaning room, the others were distracted by the missing cart, and Sai pointed out the third Sekimeiya in the bucket.{w} I'm still having trouble understanding the cause behind some of these details, though. He was only able to obtain the Future Sekimeiya like that because he had appeared with it and had hidden it in the cleaning room... This seems to be an event with no origin, so perhaps it's an indication that something else happened on top of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "It was Sai who first questioned its status, as it somewhat contradicted a few things they'd concluded earlier. It was white, instead of the gray color they thought it'd become after teleporting two people and a whole cleaning cart."
entries.literal: "\"It was Sai who first questioned its status, as it somewhat contradicted a few things they'd concluded earlier. It was white, instead of the gray color they thought it'd become after teleporting two people and a whole cleaning cart.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Akaro saw us enter and never leave the cleaning room—they knew we traveled through time. However, there was another disappearance.{w} Katei's.
entries.literal: "Akaro saw us enter and never leave the cleaning room—they knew we traveled through time. However, there was another disappearance.{w} Katei's."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The remaining people searched through every room on the crystal floor, but they didn't find us.{w} When they were about to go up, Isla walked to room A5. That's when she fell into a cabinet and disappeared.
entries.literal: "The remaining people searched through every room on the crystal floor, but they didn't find us.{w} When they were about to go up, Isla walked to room A5. That's when she fell into a cabinet and disappeared."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I wonder what happened.{w} The cabinet she looked into is one that can be seen from the stairs, where she and Erina were waiting.{w} During the period Sai and Akaro investigated the rooms, I'm sure Sai quickly disposed of the Future Sekimeiya. That makes me think Isla saw him do that through the door's gap...
entries.literal: "...I wonder what happened.{w} The cabinet she looked into is one that can be seen from the stairs, where she and Erina were waiting.{w} During the period Sai and Akaro investigated the rooms, I'm sure Sai quickly disposed of the Future Sekimeiya. That makes me think Isla saw him do that through the door's gap..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What happened to her, though? I don't really have any good idea.
entries.literal: "What happened to her, though? I don't really have any good idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The situation around her death was inscrutable, so I thought further ahead for the time being.
entries.literal: "The situation around her death was inscrutable, so I thought further ahead for the time being."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When the others saw Isla disappeared, they were unable to find a Sekimeiya in room A5's cabinet.{w} I'd bet it was powered off, and there was very little light. Since Sai knew the Sekimeiya was there, it wouldn't surprise me if he grabbed it immediately before the others saw it. I'm not sure about that, though.
entries.literal: "When the others saw Isla disappeared, they were unable to find a Sekimeiya in room A5's cabinet.{w} I'd bet it was powered off, and there was very little light. Since Sai knew the Sekimeiya was there, it wouldn't surprise me if he grabbed it immediately before the others saw it. I'm not sure about that, though."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Everyone thought Isla had to be somewhere in the building. That made them search through every floor, but nobody was found.
entries.literal: "Everyone thought Isla had to be somewhere in the building. That made them search through every floor, but nobody was found."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isla wasn't found. Katei wasn't found. Shiroya and I weren't found.{w} Of course, we weren't found because we were in the process of traveling to the future. What about Katei, though?
entries.literal: "Isla wasn't found. Katei wasn't found. Shiroya and I weren't found.{w} Of course, we weren't found because we were in the process of traveling to the future. What about Katei, though?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think Katei could've been found either.
entries.literal: "I don't think Katei could've been found either."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Before we traveled to the future, we saw Sai in front of the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "Before we traveled to the future, we saw Sai in front of the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I wasn't sure what Sai planned to do, but we'd seen him standing in front of the door. Shiroya and I entered while Katei continued toward hallway C in pursuit of him."
entries.literal: "\"I wasn't sure what Sai planned to do, but we'd seen him standing in front of the door. Shiroya and I entered while Katei continued toward hallway C in pursuit of him.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we traveled to the future, Katei was actually very close to us. We went half an hour forward, so I'm sure the range picked him up.
entries.literal: "When we traveled to the future, Katei was actually very close to us. We went half an hour forward, so I'm sure the range picked him up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Half an hour earlier, he, Shiroya, and I were in the attic, so that's where we appeared in the future. Katei was in the rightmost bedroom.{w} He suddenly teleported there and left the room, disoriented. He's the one we heard approaching the door when we were in the hallway and who left the newer footprints in the living room.
entries.literal: "Half an hour earlier, he, Shiroya, and I were in the attic, so that's where we appeared in the future. Katei was in the rightmost bedroom.{w} He suddenly teleported there and left the room, disoriented. He's the one we heard approaching the door when we were in the hallway and who left the newer footprints in the living room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After failing to find anyone, Erina, Akaro, and Sai gave up and moved back to the lobby.{w} There was only silence for a long time until they heard a sound from hallway A.
entries.literal: "After failing to find anyone, Erina, Akaro, and Sai gave up and moved back to the lobby.{w} There was only silence for a long time until they heard a sound from hallway A."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was Katei. He had walked down after appearing in the bedroom, and Shiroya and I were about to fall asleep.
entries.literal: "It was Katei. He had walked down after appearing in the bedroom, and Shiroya and I were about to fall asleep."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Where did you go...? We searched for you.
entries.literal: "Where did you go...? We searched for you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Sai shot the first question, and an immediate answer came that left the three of them unsatisfied."
entries.literal: "\"Sai shot the first question, and an immediate answer came that left the three of them unsatisfied.\""

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I don't know. I think I experienced what Atsuki said... That teleportation. I've been searching for you.
entries.literal: "I don't know. I think I experienced what Atsuki said... That teleportation. I've been searching for you."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, they looked into the cabinet where Isla had disappeared.{w} She was there, already dead. The Sekimeiya, meanwhile, was nowhere to be found.
entries.literal: "Then, they looked into the cabinet where Isla had disappeared.{w} She was there, already dead. The Sekimeiya, meanwhile, was nowhere to be found."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After they waited in the lobby again, Shiroya and I appeared. We told them they hadn't found us because we'd been sleeping in the attic.
entries.literal: "After they waited in the lobby again, Shiroya and I appeared. We told them they hadn't found us because we'd been sleeping in the attic."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Understand that what you've told us is that you two spent all this time asleep in the attic. Despite this, you weren't found.
entries.literal: "Understand that what you've told us is that you two spent all this time asleep in the attic. Despite this, you weren't found."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...You didn't find Katei either, so you obviously didn't do a great job. And you were in a rush, so you kept yelling Isla's name while quickly looking. I bet you didn't look at the upper levels of the bedrooms, which is where we were, and since we were asleep, we didn't hear you.
entries.literal: "...You didn't find Katei either, so you obviously didn't do a great job. And you were in a rush, so you kept yelling Isla's name while quickly looking. I bet you didn't look at the upper levels of the bedrooms, which is where we were, and since we were asleep, we didn't hear you."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This only made sense from our point of view, but Sai never denied it.{w} Why? There's no way he really didn't look at the upper levels, is there?{w} Perhaps that was the first indication he had that traveling to the future was possible, and he consciously chose not to let us know. Since he should've been in hallway C when Katei disappeared, I wonder if he turned around and realized what had happened to him too.
entries.literal: "This only made sense from our point of view, but Sai never denied it.{w} Why? There's no way he really didn't look at the upper levels, is there?{w} Perhaps that was the first indication he had that traveling to the future was possible, and he consciously chose not to let us know. Since he should've been in hallway C when Katei disappeared, I wonder if he turned around and realized what had happened to him too."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In any case, when we went to see Isla with our own eyes, there was a major distinction: the Sekimeiya was there, emitting a faint glow.
entries.literal: "In any case, when we went to see Isla with our own eyes, there was a major distinction: the Sekimeiya was there, emitting a faint glow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell happened? That Sekimeiya was working, and we had hidden the third one in Naomi's locker. ...How did that one appear back in the cabinet?
entries.literal: "What the hell happened? That Sekimeiya was working, and we had hidden the third one in Naomi's locker. ...How did that one appear back in the cabinet?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't get it. I don't know what happened to Isla.{w} Is there a whole other factor that I'm missing about this? Did something else occur that I don't know about?
entries.literal: "I don't get it. I don't know what happened to Isla.{w} Is there a whole other factor that I'm missing about this? Did something else occur that I don't know about?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isla disappeared from the cabinet, but how? Did she go to the future? ...The Future Sekimeiya should've been powered off since we had just used it.{w} Even if that happened, did she reappear in that same cabinet, where she'd gone to look?{w} Why, though? She wasn't there in the past, was she? And why did she die?
entries.literal: "Isla disappeared from the cabinet, but how? Did she go to the future? ...The Future Sekimeiya should've been powered off since we had just used it.{w} Even if that happened, did she reappear in that same cabinet, where she'd gone to look?{w} Why, though? She wasn't there in the past, was she? And why did she die?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right, she yelled before falling in. What the hell does that mean? Did she go to the past?{w} Before, Sai had kept walking toward hallway A—perhaps he put the Future Sekimeiya where he had the past one, for whatever reason. Since the future one should've been powered off, Isla would've actually traveled back in time and not changed worlds. I can't know if the search took long enough for it to power back on, though.
entries.literal: "Right, she yelled before falling in. What the hell does that mean? Did she go to the past?{w} Before, Sai had kept walking toward hallway A—perhaps he put the Future Sekimeiya where he had the past one, for whatever reason. Since the future one should've been powered off, Isla would've actually traveled back in time and not changed worlds. I can't know if the search took long enough for it to power back on, though."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But... that still doesn't make sense, does it? If she saw herself, what happened to her other body? Why the hell was it even there? And if both Sekimeiya were active, she should've changed worlds... Also, I know Sai could only put one in his hip pack, so the other would've been seen.
entries.literal: "But... that still doesn't make sense, does it? If she saw herself, what happened to her other body? Why the hell was it even there? And if both Sekimeiya were active, she should've changed worlds... Also, I know Sai could only put one in his hip pack, so the other would've been seen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Most importantly, the Sekimeiya reappeared in that cabinet later. ...Did someone do this?{w} Or was it all an accident that didn't involve a murder?
entries.literal: "Most importantly, the Sekimeiya reappeared in that cabinet later. ...Did someone do this?{w} Or was it all an accident that didn't involve a murder?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's possible someone killed her, but who? Who would've had a motive to do that? Who could've done that?{w} There was a whole search, and the Future Sekimeiya had just been used. It's possible a killer with an elaborate plan carried this out, but that's completely out of place.
entries.literal: "It's possible someone killed her, but who? Who would've had a motive to do that? Who could've done that?{w} There was a whole search, and the Future Sekimeiya had just been used. It's possible a killer with an elaborate plan carried this out, but that's completely out of place."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I don't believe she was killed. Her cause of death was one of the strangest details.
entries.literal: "...I don't believe she was killed. Her cause of death was one of the strangest details."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It's tough, isn't it?
entries.literal: "It's tough, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What happened to Isla? Under the right circumstances, touching the Sekimeiya ended her life.{w} It wasn't an instant result, however. The complexity of what occurred might be a bit more involved than what you're imagining, as no world switches factored in.
entries.literal: "What happened to Isla? Under the right circumstances, touching the Sekimeiya ended her life.{w} It wasn't an instant result, however. The complexity of what occurred might be a bit more involved than what you're imagining, as no world switches factored in."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The cabinet, both Sekimeiya, everyone's actions... Everything contributed to allow Isla's tragic demise.
entries.literal: "The cabinet, both Sekimeiya, everyone's actions... Everything contributed to allow Isla's tragic demise."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This riddle will be left all to you, but know something:{w} when Isla looked into the cabinet for the first time, she saw the body of a young girl. It was her own, but that was far from her interpretation.{w} Inside the cabinet, she saw the image of her friend. Her mind and body both teetered on the edge, and she screamed as she toppled into that sarcophagus of a cabinet.
entries.literal: "This riddle will be left all to you, but know something:{w} when Isla looked into the cabinet for the first time, she saw the body of a young girl. It was her own, but that was far from her interpretation.{w} Inside the cabinet, she saw the image of her friend. Her mind and body both teetered on the edge, and she screamed as she toppled into that sarcophagus of a cabinet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But if she wasn't killed, I don't know what could've happened... There are too many aspects that I don't get.
entries.literal: "But if she wasn't killed, I don't know what could've happened... There are too many aspects that I don't get."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was frustrating. I'd had the information to solve everything so far, but I was lost when it came to Isla's death.
entries.literal: "It was frustrating. I'd had the information to solve everything so far, but I was lost when it came to Isla's death."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wish I could know what happened to her. She died right there, and she never revived. The Isla in the future wasn't the same person...
entries.literal: "I wish I could know what happened to her. She died right there, and she never revived. The Isla in the future wasn't the same person..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the voice recorder. The minutes had been ticking along, so I felt slightly rushed.
entries.literal: "I looked at the voice recorder. The minutes had been ticking along, so I felt slightly rushed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hated having to move on, but her death seemed to be surrounded by too many questions for me to solve.
entries.literal: "I hated having to move on, but her death seemed to be surrounded by too many questions for me to solve."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Afterward, we simply stayed in the lobby.{w} It didn't look like any of us had the strength to stand again, but that changed when Katei and Sai left out of the blue.
entries.literal: "Afterward, we simply stayed in the lobby.{w} It didn't look like any of us had the strength to stand again, but that changed when Katei and Sai left out of the blue."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Both of them said they went to the bathroom, but it's clear that's not what happened.
entries.literal: "Both of them said they went to the bathroom, but it's clear that's not what happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I thought about it, I realized I could draw a solid conclusion.
entries.literal: "When I thought about it, I realized I could draw a solid conclusion."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya that appeared next to Isla's dead body was working...
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya that appeared next to Isla's dead body was working..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I think it was the Past Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I think it was the Past Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's because I put it in the Sekimeiya cabinet, and when we locked ourselves in the attic, it was still there.
entries.literal: "That's because I put it in the Sekimeiya cabinet, and when we locked ourselves in the attic, it was still there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We were told that when Sai and Akaro escaped, Akaro forced Sai to tell him where he'd stashed one of the Sekimeiya. At that point, he touched it and appeared in January, meaning that the one in the event room was the Past Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "We were told that when Sai and Akaro escaped, Akaro forced Sai to tell him where he'd stashed one of the Sekimeiya. At that point, he touched it and appeared in January, meaning that the one in the event room was the Past Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And there is something strange about this. If I'm right, Sai hid the Future Sekimeiya immediately after Isla's disappearance. This means that when Akaro touched it, it had already gathered energy for a ridiculously long time. A lot more than what I believe he needed to travel 21 days.
entries.literal: "And there is something strange about this. If I'm right, Sai hid the Future Sekimeiya immediately after Isla's disappearance. This means that when Akaro touched it, it had already gathered energy for a ridiculously long time. A lot more than what I believe he needed to travel 21 days."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After Katei and Sai left the lobby, Shiroya and I came across an empty cabinet in room B4 that was set to 0 °C. That's what reset the stored time.
entries.literal: "After Katei and Sai left the lobby, Shiroya and I came across an empty cabinet in room B4 that was set to 0 °C. That's what reset the stored time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm not sure what happened exactly. Maybe Katei found the Sekimeiya and put it somewhere cold, but Sai saw that and removed it. The cabinet would've taken a bit to cool off, but a few minutes had passed...
entries.literal: "I'm not sure what happened exactly. Maybe Katei found the Sekimeiya and put it somewhere cold, but Sai saw that and removed it. The cabinet would've taken a bit to cool off, but a few minutes had passed..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After that, Shiroya discovered the storeroom's movable wall and the door with no handle.
entries.literal: "After that, Shiroya discovered the storeroom's movable wall and the door with no handle."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At the time, I was certain that secret place had been used by the culprit to escape the multiple searches we did.
entries.literal: "At the time, I was certain that secret place had been used by the culprit to escape the multiple searches we did."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think it was ever used by anyone who didn't want to be seen, though.{w} I saw a single set of fingerprints, identical to the ones I saw this morning. ...Since this morning, no one had opened that door from the hallway.
entries.literal: "I don't think it was ever used by anyone who didn't want to be seen, though.{w} I saw a single set of fingerprints, identical to the ones I saw this morning. ...Since this morning, no one had opened that door from the hallway."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Katei had the rusty key, and it fits the keyhole of that door. He definitely knew of its existence.
entries.literal: "Katei had the rusty key, and it fits the keyhole of that door. He definitely knew of its existence."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And immediately after that, Erina proposed that we confine ourselves. That's what led us to wait in the attic's bedroom, leaving the Past Sekimeiya behind in the event room.
entries.literal: "And immediately after that, Erina proposed that we confine ourselves. That's what led us to wait in the attic's bedroom, leaving the Past Sekimeiya behind in the event room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That marked the halfway point of our imprisonment. From there, though, everything only got crazier.
entries.literal: "That marked the halfway point of our imprisonment. From there, though, everything only got crazier."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Despite our efforts, Sai and Akaro managed to escape. I wouldn't be surprised if they left the way I imagined it, with a thought-up loop.
entries.literal: "Despite our efforts, Sai and Akaro managed to escape. I wouldn't be surprised if they left the way I imagined it, with a thought-up loop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I attempted to replicate that idea, but it didn't work. At the time, I thought of a number of reasons that could've prevented my success, but now I can think of even more.
entries.literal: "I attempted to replicate that idea, but it didn't work. At the time, I thought of a number of reasons that could've prevented my success, but now I can think of even more."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: First off, at some point, Akaro traveled days into the future. It's possible that even the Isla from another world traveled days into the past. If I'd walked to the crystal floor, maybe I would've been involved in one of those travels.
entries.literal: "First off, at some point, Akaro traveled days into the future. It's possible that even the Isla from another world traveled days into the past. If I'd walked to the crystal floor, maybe I would've been involved in one of those travels."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Secondly, my idea was to leave, travel to the past, unlock the door, and reenter the bedroom immediately after my departure. That meant that my future location would've been in the bedroom, so I wouldn't have been able to appear outside it in the past.
entries.literal: "Secondly, my idea was to leave, travel to the past, unlock the door, and reenter the bedroom immediately after my departure. That meant that my future location would've been in the bedroom, so I wouldn't have been able to appear outside it in the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Lastly, my plan entailed using the Sekimeiya we had hidden in Naomi's locker. It was the third Sekimeiya, so I highly doubt it would've ever worked.
entries.literal: "Lastly, my plan entailed using the Sekimeiya we had hidden in Naomi's locker. It was the third Sekimeiya, so I highly doubt it would've ever worked."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After both of them left, an Akaro with different memories showed up. Even another Isla was there.
entries.literal: "After both of them left, an Akaro with different memories showed up. Even another Isla was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What happened outside the bedroom? I only have Akaro's version.{w} He touched the Sekimeiya Sai had hidden, and went to the fu—
entries.literal: "What happened outside the bedroom? I only have Akaro's version.{w} He touched the Sekimeiya Sai had hidden, and went to the fu—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, what the fuck? This doesn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "Wait, what the fuck? This doesn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...More than twenty minutes had passed, so it was safe to step back into the kitchen.
entries.literal: "...More than twenty minutes had passed, so it was safe to step back into the kitchen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How did I not think this through? There's no way we went to January 5th.{w} For that, we should've been in the tower 21 days before the 15th.
entries.literal: "How did I not think this through? There's no way we went to January 5th.{w} For that, we should've been in the tower 21 days before the 15th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Akaro's clothes changed. I can't rule out that he was in the tower in the past. Our clothing didn't change, though. I certainly wasn't here in the past, so if I traveled 21 days to the future, I should've appeared far outside the tower.
entries.literal: "Akaro's clothes changed. I can't rule out that he was in the tower in the past. Our clothing didn't change, though. I certainly wasn't here in the past, so if I traveled 21 days to the future, I should've appeared far outside the tower."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell...?
entries.literal: "What the hell...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That broke my entire train of thought. It was a major contradiction regarding what I'd concluded.
entries.literal: "That broke my entire train of thought. It was a major contradiction regarding what I'd concluded."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What happened at the end of the day?
entries.literal: "What happened at the end of the day?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: 21 days before the 15th... That was November 24th.{w} I was not in the tower at that time.
entries.literal: "21 days before the 15th... That was November 24th.{w} I was not in the tower at that time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wonder what would happen if now I travel back in time to that day and go to the tower. ...I don't think that would explain it either.
entries.literal: "I wonder what would happen if now I travel back in time to that day and go to the tower. ...I don't think that would explain it either."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Needless to say, that won't happen. It would mean that Sai and Erina would have to be there as well...
entries.literal: "Needless to say, that won't happen. It would mean that Sai and Erina would have to be there as well..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell is this? How is it possible that we traveled to January 5th?
entries.literal: "What the hell is this? How is it possible that we traveled to January 5th?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is there another way? Could anything explain this...?
entries.literal: "Is there another way? Could anything explain this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought about our last minutes in the tower, right before {time=21.}{w} What exactly had caused the travel?
entries.literal: "I thought about our last minutes in the tower, right before {time=21.}{w} What exactly had caused the travel?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: One of the Sekimeiya was kept cold in the event room, which means that it was likely the Past Sekimeiya. The Future Sekimeiya must have been somewhere else, and it made us travel through time.
entries.literal: "One of the Sekimeiya was kept cold in the event room, which means that it was likely the Past Sekimeiya. The Future Sekimeiya must have been somewhere else, and it made us travel through time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But the replicated locations don't make any sense...!
entries.literal: "But the replicated locations don't make any sense...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to think about everything that had happened during the last segment of the day.{w} When I did, a possibility came to mind.
entries.literal: "I had to think about everything that had happened during the last segment of the day.{w} When I did, a possibility came to mind."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We were definitely on December 15th. The call with Suripo should confirm that. Then, given Isla's words and the evaporated water, I'm certain that we arrived on January 5th.
entries.literal: "We were definitely on December 15th. The call with Suripo should confirm that. Then, given Isla's words and the evaporated water, I'm certain that we arrived on January 5th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: By simply thinking about what happened during the last stretch, an obvious problem immediately comes up: we shouldn't have been able to travel 21 days through time.
entries.literal: "By simply thinking about what happened during the last stretch, an obvious problem immediately comes up: we shouldn't have been able to travel 21 days through time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: A bit after {time=20:30}, we found the powered-off Sekimeiya in the water tank, and we left it in the cold cabinet.
entries.literal: "A bit after {time=20:30}, we found the powered-off Sekimeiya in the water tank, and we left it in the cold cabinet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, we found Shiroya in a hallway A crystal room. I don't know who she really was, but she convinced me to wait in the lobby for the shutter to open.
entries.literal: "Then, we found Shiroya in a hallway A crystal room. I don't know who she really was, but she convinced me to wait in the lobby for the shutter to open."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Something I felt iffy about occurred then. Erina left, saying she was going to search for Sai. Later, when she came back, it sounded like she'd traveled through time.
entries.literal: "Something I felt iffy about occurred then. Erina left, saying she was going to search for Sai. Later, when she came back, it sounded like she'd traveled through time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya wasn't in the cabinet. I couldn't stand it anymore. I felt like everyone was lying to me.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya wasn't in the cabinet. I couldn't stand it anymore. I felt like everyone was lying to me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I searched hallway A by myself and found a Sekimeiya in the security room.
entries.literal: "I searched hallway A by myself and found a Sekimeiya in the security room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What's strange is that the Sekimeiya was scalding; it didn't make sense for Erina to have recently used it.{w} That makes me think it wasn't the same Sekimeiya that had just disappeared from the cabinet.
entries.literal: "What's strange is that the Sekimeiya was scalding; it didn't make sense for Erina to have recently used it.{w} That makes me think it wasn't the same Sekimeiya that had just disappeared from the cabinet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After I found the Sekimeiya in the water tank, something about Sai also seemed off.
entries.literal: "After I found the Sekimeiya in the water tank, something about Sai also seemed off."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}We still haven't searched the whole floor. I'll go leave the Sekimeiya in the event room, and we won't move it again.
entries.literal: "...{w}We still haven't searched the whole floor. I'll go leave the Sekimeiya in the event room, and we won't move it again."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: ...There's nothing else to find, is there? Do you seriously believe Shiroya will be here? We've already found the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...There's nothing else to find, is there? Do you seriously believe Shiroya will be here? We've already found the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I stared at Sai's eyes, a little disconcerted. His voice sounded noticeably more nervous and tense than it had recently."
entries.literal: "\"I stared at Sai's eyes, a little disconcerted. His voice sounded noticeably more nervous and tense than it had recently.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Is there something else to find here?
entries.literal: "...Is there something else to find here?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Hm? What would that be?
entries.literal: "Hm? What would that be?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He knew there was something left to be found—the Sekimeiya in the security room. He didn't care that we found one, but he was worried we would find the second one...
entries.literal: "He knew there was something left to be found—the Sekimeiya in the security room. He didn't care that we found one, but he was worried we would find the second one..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What's most important is that after I found it in the security room, I put it in the cabinet. But mere minutes later, we supposedly traveled to January 5th.
entries.literal: "What's most important is that after I found it in the security room, I put it in the cabinet. But mere minutes later, we supposedly traveled to January 5th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This seems impossible. One Sekimeiya had just been taken out of the cabinet while the other one had just been left inside. There was no time to build up the necessary energy to travel 21 days through time.
entries.literal: "This seems impossible. One Sekimeiya had just been taken out of the cabinet while the other one had just been left inside. There was no time to build up the necessary energy to travel 21 days through time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If the Future Sekimeiya was put in a hot place during those minutes, it could've gathered enough energy. However, that wouldn't explain the replicated location: I wasn't in the tower on November 24th.{w} So there is necessarily an answer that explains both mysteries at once.
entries.literal: "If the Future Sekimeiya was put in a hot place during those minutes, it could've gathered enough energy. However, that wouldn't explain the replicated location: I wasn't in the tower on November 24th.{w} So there is necessarily an answer that explains both mysteries at once."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could it really be what I'm imagining...?{w} Before the exit unlocked, the Future Sekimeiya was activated. I believe the location where that happened is a very important detail.
entries.literal: "Could it really be what I'm imagining...?{w} Before the exit unlocked, the Future Sekimeiya was activated. I believe the location where that happened is a very important detail."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was in the mechanical room. That's where the Future Sekimeiya was at {time=21.}{w} And it was Erina who activated it. She was in the mechanical room when the lights went off.
entries.literal: "It was in the mechanical room. That's where the Future Sekimeiya was at {time=21.}{w} And it was Erina who activated it. She was in the mechanical room when the lights went off."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She still wanted to go to the past; she never stopped saying that. It was her last chance to do so.{w} Before then, she used the Sekimeiya we left in the cabinet. However, when she came back to the lobby and asked us the time, she had gone to the future instead. Based on what happened later, that had to be the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "She still wanted to go to the past; she never stopped saying that. It was her last chance to do so.{w} Before then, she used the Sekimeiya we left in the cabinet. However, when she came back to the lobby and asked us the time, she had gone to the future instead. Based on what happened later, that had to be the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even so late into the day, Sai was still trying to keep the Sekimeiya hidden. He knew one was in the security room, and when Erina traveled to the future, it was his chance to take care of the other.
entries.literal: "Even so late into the day, Sai was still trying to keep the Sekimeiya hidden. He knew one was in the security room, and when Erina traveled to the future, it was his chance to take care of the other."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Erina came back, asking for the time. That's when we went to the event room and saw the empty cabinet.
entries.literal: "Erina came back, asking for the time. That's when we went to the event room and saw the empty cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I noticed the brief instant in which Erina's expression showed surprise. She was still in hallway B, staring at her left."
entries.literal: "\"I noticed the brief instant in which Erina's expression showed surprise. She was still in hallway B, staring at her left.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Did you see something?
entries.literal: "Did you see something?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I walked up to her, but I found nothing that stood out in the hallway."
entries.literal: "\"I walked up to her, but I found nothing that stood out in the hallway.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What she saw was Sai going through the mechanical room. That's where he left the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...What she saw was Sai going through the mechanical room. That's where he left the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Or do we use these last minutes to find Sai and the Sekimeiya? If he took it, he must have something in mind, and as much as I want to get out, I'm not fond of letting him do as he pleases.
entries.literal: "Or do we use these last minutes to find Sai and the Sekimeiya? If he took it, he must have something in mind, and as much as I want to get out, I'm not fond of letting him do as he pleases."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Y-Yes... Maybe we should search for him.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes... Maybe we should search for him."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Search complete. You all did an amazing job this time.
entries.literal: "Search complete. You all did an amazing job this time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But that's not all. Before, Erina noticed the mechanical room had been opened. That makes me think Sai was down there and came out when we went to the event room.{w} He knew I'd purposely left the cabinet unlocked. If he later hid the Sekimeiya in the mechanical room, he was probably scoping it out ahead of time.
entries.literal: "But that's not all. Before, Erina noticed the mechanical room had been opened. That makes me think Sai was down there and came out when we went to the event room.{w} He knew I'd purposely left the cabinet unlocked. If he later hid the Sekimeiya in the mechanical room, he was probably scoping it out ahead of time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After that, Sai didn't waver as I looked through hallway A. He knew I would find one Sekimeiya, but not the one he'd just hidden.
entries.literal: "After that, Sai didn't waver as I looked through hallway A. He knew I would find one Sekimeiya, but not the one he'd just hidden."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Once I put the Past Sekimeiya in the cabinet, all of us, including Shiroya, went back to the lobby and kept waiting where we'd been before.
entries.literal: "Once I put the Past Sekimeiya in the cabinet, all of us, including Shiroya, went back to the lobby and kept waiting where we'd been before."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Erina didn't speak once. She knew the Sekimeiya Sai had hidden was still under us, and she was waiting for it to gather energy.
entries.literal: "Erina didn't speak once. She knew the Sekimeiya Sai had hidden was still under us, and she was waiting for it to gather energy."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Before the exit unlocked, she disappeared from beside us—she went down to activate the Sekimeiya one final time.
entries.literal: "Before the exit unlocked, she disappeared from beside us—she went down to activate the Sekimeiya one final time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And she did. The ceiling of the mechanical room is very low, so the range encompassed us too, the people sitting right above it.
entries.literal: "And she did. The ceiling of the mechanical room is very low, so the range encompassed us too, the people sitting right above it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why did we go to January 5th, though? If that was the case, the range should've picked up everyone who'd been waiting outside the tower.{w} ...Somehow, Shiroya knew the travel would occur, and she ran away from us to avoid being involved...
entries.literal: "Why did we go to January 5th, though? If that was the case, the range should've picked up everyone who'd been waiting outside the tower.{w} ...Somehow, Shiroya knew the travel would occur, and she ran away from us to avoid being involved..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But why? Why 21 days into the future?{w} On the surface, it seems like Erina activating the Sekimeiya would never result in that. However... I think I can tell what the answer is by simply running through what would've happened after she touched it.
entries.literal: "But why? Why 21 days into the future?{w} On the surface, it seems like Erina activating the Sekimeiya would never result in that. However... I think I can tell what the answer is by simply running through what would've happened after she touched it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Sai frequently told us the current time. When Erina made us travel to the future, the Sekimeiya had gathered power for about fifteen minutes. At that point, we already knew that would result in roughly twenty minutes traveled.
entries.literal: "Sai frequently told us the current time. When Erina made us travel to the future, the Sekimeiya had gathered power for about fifteen minutes. At that point, we already knew that would result in roughly twenty minutes traveled."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, we traveled twenty minutes to the future.{w} What would the locations have been?
entries.literal: "So, we traveled twenty minutes to the future.{w} What would the locations have been?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Twenty minutes before the travel, Sai was in the mechanical room while Erina and I were in the lobby, sitting in the same spot.
entries.literal: "Twenty minutes before the travel, Sai was in the mechanical room while Erina and I were in the lobby, sitting in the same spot."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What occurred relied on Sai's location upon appearing.{w} By that point, I had also learned that fifteen minutes stored resulted in five minutes of the Sekimeiya's recovery phase. After Erina touched the Sekimeiya, it spent five minutes off and then gathered energy for fifteen more minutes until we appeared.
entries.literal: "What occurred relied on Sai's location upon appearing.{w} By that point, I had also learned that fifteen minutes stored resulted in five minutes of the Sekimeiya's recovery phase. After Erina touched the Sekimeiya, it spent five minutes off and then gathered energy for fifteen more minutes until we appeared."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we appeared, Sai was in the mechanical room, where he would hide the Sekimeiya. So the instant we appeared, he activated it again.{w} ...I'm not sure how that happened fluidly, but I can think of a couple things that make a lot of sense.{w} Immediately, we went twenty more minutes to the future, and when we appeared, the Sekimeiya had gathered energy for another fifteen minutes.
entries.literal: "When we appeared, Sai was in the mechanical room, where he would hide the Sekimeiya. So the instant we appeared, he activated it again.{w} ...I'm not sure how that happened fluidly, but I can think of a couple things that make a lot of sense.{w} Immediately, we went twenty more minutes to the future, and when we appeared, the Sekimeiya had gathered energy for another fifteen minutes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That time, the locations were from the time Erina had touched the Sekimeiya. In other words, she was in the mechanical room while Sai and I were in the lobby.{w} So, we went twenty more minutes to the future.
entries.literal: "That time, the locations were from the time Erina had touched the Sekimeiya. In other words, she was in the mechanical room while Sai and I were in the lobby.{w} So, we went twenty more minutes to the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's incredibly unlikely that the time matched up exactly and perfectly replicated the instant in which we had appeared twenty minutes before. However, it's possible that location was what we defaulted to, as it was the closest location in which we "existed". That's all I can really assume there.
entries.literal: "It's incredibly unlikely that the time matched up exactly and perfectly replicated the instant in which we had appeared twenty minutes before. However, it's possible that location was what we defaulted to, as it was the closest location in which we \"existed\". That's all I can really assume there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Again, when we appeared, it was Erina who instantly reactivated the Sekimeiya. This created a never-ending chain of twenty minutes jumping forward.
entries.literal: "Again, when we appeared, it was Erina who instantly reactivated the Sekimeiya. This created a never-ending chain of twenty minutes jumping forward."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Only two locations alternated: the one in which Sai was in the mechanical room, and the one in which Erina was. Meanwhile, I was in the lobby regardless.{w} This explains why I didn't see the sudden, instant flashing they talked about.
entries.literal: "Only two locations alternated: the one in which Sai was in the mechanical room, and the one in which Erina was. Meanwhile, I was in the lobby regardless.{w} This explains why I didn't see the sudden, instant flashing they talked about."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: For some reason, on January 5th, the tower was empty. Katei told us once that the lights turn off every night and are manually turned on in the morning. So, if nobody was in the tower in the morning, the lights would've remained off.{w} However, before all the lights turned off permanently, every twenty minutes, Sai and Erina alternated between being in the lobby and in the mechanical room. Although it lasted an instant each time, due to the darkness in the mechanical room and the light in the lobby, they perceived a "flashing light".
entries.literal: "For some reason, on January 5th, the tower was empty. Katei told us once that the lights turn off every night and are manually turned on in the morning. So, if nobody was in the tower in the morning, the lights would've remained off.{w} However, before all the lights turned off permanently, every twenty minutes, Sai and Erina alternated between being in the lobby and in the mechanical room. Although it lasted an instant each time, due to the darkness in the mechanical room and the light in the lobby, they perceived a \"flashing light\"."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On January 5th, the chain stopped. I don't know why, but we broke free of it, effectively traveling 21 days into the future.
entries.literal: "On January 5th, the chain stopped. I don't know why, but we broke free of it, effectively traveling 21 days into the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And the final location was from when Erina was in the mechanical room, which is why it didn't feel like we changed places. And... since she would've appeared and activated the Sekimeiya instantly in the previous location, that must mean it overlapped with part of her body upon arriving. That's why she started bleeding at the end of the chain. The tip of her finger was missing.
