entries.literal: "And the final location was from when Erina was in the mechanical room, which is why it didn't feel like we changed places. And... since she would've appeared and activated the Sekimeiya instantly in the previous location, that must mean it overlapped with part of her body upon arriving. That's why she started bleeding at the end of the chain. The tip of her finger was missing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did all that really happen? And none of us realized it...
entries.literal: "...Did all that really happen? And none of us realized it..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It explained things, but I still had a few doubts. Why had the tower been empty on January 5th? Why had the chain not gone on infinitely?
entries.literal: "It explained things, but I still had a few doubts. Why had the tower been empty on January 5th? Why had the chain not gone on infinitely?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So Akaro actually was in the tower on November 24th. ...His hair was longer and a different color.
entries.literal: "So Akaro actually was in the tower on November 24th. ...His hair was longer and a different color."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He traveled to the future while we were in the attic, but there's something I'm confused about.
entries.literal: "He traveled to the future while we were in the attic, but there's something I'm confused about."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I'm right, and the version of Isla who was there ended up being the "friend", she likely traveled before we left the bedroom. We weren't there for too long of a time, though, and we'd left the Past Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "If I'm right, and the version of Isla who was there ended up being the \"friend\", she likely traveled before we left the bedroom. We weren't there for too long of a time, though, and we'd left the Past Sekimeiya in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Akaro traveled to the future after he and Sai escaped, but since Isla was still there, she went to the past afterward.{w} Would there have been enough time to store the needed energy to go so far back?
entries.literal: "Akaro traveled to the future after he and Sai escaped, but since Isla was still there, she went to the past afterward.{w} Would there have been enough time to store the needed energy to go so far back?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The reason she was able to go many days back was...
entries.literal: "The reason she was able to go many days back was..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Actually, yes. It was due to a bed sheet that the world C group had obtained in world A. When it was brought to world B, they wrapped it around the Past Sekimeiya and world switched back to world C. However, the sheet remained around the Sekimeiya in world B.{w} When it powered back on, the sheet was still very hot. That's why it took a short time to reach the needed amount of energy.
entries.literal: "Actually, yes. It was due to a bed sheet that the world C group had obtained in world A. When it was brought to world B, they wrapped it around the Past Sekimeiya and world switched back to world C. However, the sheet remained around the Sekimeiya in world B.{w} When it powered back on, the sheet was still very hot. That's why it took a short time to reach the needed amount of energy."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's wrong. It was due to a bed sheet that the world C group had obtained in world A. When it was brought to world B, they wrapped it around the Past Sekimeiya and world switched back to world C. However, the sheet remained around the Sekimeiya in world B.{w} When it powered back on, the sheet was still very hot. That's why it took a short time to reach the needed amount of energy.
entries.literal: "That's wrong. It was due to a bed sheet that the world C group had obtained in world A. When it was brought to world B, they wrapped it around the Past Sekimeiya and world switched back to world C. However, the sheet remained around the Sekimeiya in world B.{w} When it powered back on, the sheet was still very hot. That's why it took a short time to reach the needed amount of energy."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Akaro and Sai escaped from the bedroom, Sai was forced to reveal the location of the Future Sekimeiya and was immediately knocked out.
entries.literal: "When Akaro and Sai escaped from the bedroom, Sai was forced to reveal the location of the Future Sekimeiya and was immediately knocked out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Isla A was there and heard it as well. Worried, she tried to get a response from the unconscious Sai, which only one person heard from the bedroom. Giving up, she went down in an attempt to prevent Akaro from damaging the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Isla A was there and heard it as well. Worried, she tried to get a response from the unconscious Sai, which only one person heard from the bedroom. Giving up, she went down in an attempt to prevent Akaro from damaging the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She found it powered off in one of the hallway B crystal rooms; Akaro was already gone. She knew the event room cabinet was equipped with temperature regulation, so she carried it there.
entries.literal: "She found it powered off in one of the hallway B crystal rooms; Akaro was already gone. She knew the event room cabinet was equipped with temperature regulation, so she carried it there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But after that, on the floor of hallway A, she found a sheet covering yet another Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "But after that, on the floor of hallway A, she found a sheet covering yet another Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Confused, she felt its surface, instantly vanishing from that place with the sheet. Immediately, she found herself on November 24th.
entries.literal: "Confused, she felt its surface, instantly vanishing from that place with the sheet. Immediately, she found herself on November 24th."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Someone else disappeared as well: Akaro A.{w} The bedroom where everyone stayed was directly above the event room, so the range reached him. From a locked bedroom, he appeared in an unlocked prison cell. That was when a policeman outside the building suddenly appeared 21 days in the past.
entries.literal: "Someone else disappeared as well: Akaro A.{w} The bedroom where everyone stayed was directly above the event room, so the range reached him. From a locked bedroom, he appeared in an unlocked prison cell. That was when a policeman outside the building suddenly appeared 21 days in the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai woke up. He was near the elevator, so Isla's travel had missed him and the people in the upper level of the bedroom.
entries.literal: "Sai woke up. He was near the elevator, so Isla's travel had missed him and the people in the upper level of the bedroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Disoriented, he walked to the event room and found out the others had left both Sekimeiya behind for him.
entries.literal: "Disoriented, he walked to the event room and found out the others had left both Sekimeiya behind for him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He still had to complete his plan: to get out of the bedroom, he had to travel to the past.
entries.literal: "He still had to complete his plan: to get out of the bedroom, he had to travel to the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once he was done, Sai had both Sekimeiya for himself. Eager to resolve the doubts he had, he brought them both to a room—B6.
entries.literal: "Once he was done, Sai had both Sekimeiya for himself. Eager to resolve the doubts he had, he brought them both to a room—B6."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unfortunately for him, he was only able to resolve his two major concerns before the world around him changed.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately for him, he was only able to resolve his two major concerns before the world around him changed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we left the bedroom... we quickly found out the third Sekimeiya had disappeared from Naomi's locker.
entries.literal: "When we left the bedroom... we quickly found out the third Sekimeiya had disappeared from Naomi's locker."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Who the hell did that? There's no way it teleported out.{w} ...Did anyone else have the key after all?
entries.literal: "Who the hell did that? There's no way it teleported out.{w} ...Did anyone else have the key after all?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yes, it was Akaro A.
entries.literal: "Yes, it was Akaro A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Akaro A.
entries.literal: "It was Akaro A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You might remember he world switched while he was in the staff room, and he had Naomi A's keys.
entries.literal: "You might remember he world switched while he was in the staff room, and he had Naomi A's keys."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While he waited in room B4, he wondered if he had access to that locker, and when he went to confirm it, he saw someone had hidden a Sekimeiya there.
entries.literal: "While he waited in room B4, he wondered if he had access to that locker, and when he went to confirm it, he saw someone had hidden a Sekimeiya there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Mystified, he took it out with no comprehension that he was no longer in his own world.
entries.literal: "Mystified, he took it out with no comprehension that he was no longer in his own world."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I wonder who it was. Maybe Sai, somehow.
entries.literal: "...I wonder who it was. Maybe Sai, somehow."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After that, Shiroya and I found a Sekimeiya on the floor of a hallway B room, B6.
entries.literal: "After that, Shiroya and I found a Sekimeiya on the floor of a hallway B room, B6."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we touched it, I'm pretty sure we went to the future...
entries.literal: "When we touched it, I'm pretty sure we went to the future..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We appeared where we'd been ten minutes before, so we went ten minutes to the future.
entries.literal: "We appeared where we'd been ten minutes before, so we went ten minutes to the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We thought we'd gone to the very recent past because the footprints we'd just left looked recent. Since we went shortly into the future, that didn't change.
entries.literal: "We thought we'd gone to the very recent past because the footprints we'd just left looked recent. Since we went shortly into the future, that didn't change."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And then, we concluded we'd gone five minutes to the past because we thought that we'd taken the elevator and caused the trip we heard before traveling. Instead, someone else used it from the attic after we left the bedroom...
entries.literal: "And then, we concluded we'd gone five minutes to the past because we thought that we'd taken the elevator and caused the trip we heard before traveling. Instead, someone else used it from the attic after we left the bedroom..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On the crystal floor, we went to the lobby because our past selves hadn't gone there. Who did we hear if not ourselves? There was someone moving through the hallways.
entries.literal: "On the crystal floor, we went to the lobby because our past selves hadn't gone there. Who did we hear if not ourselves? There was someone moving through the hallways."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "We heard an indistinct sound coming from hallway A, made by a door."
entries.literal: "\"We heard an indistinct sound coming from hallway A, made by a door.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's us. We just entered the event room.
entries.literal: "That's us. We just entered the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "We waited, and seconds later, the same sound came from hallway B. Unmistakably, a closing door had created it."
entries.literal: "\"We waited, and seconds later, the same sound came from hallway B. Unmistakably, a closing door had created it.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There aren't many people I can think of. Sai, Erina, Katei, and maybe the other Shiroya...
entries.literal: "There aren't many people I can think of. Sai, Erina, Katei, and maybe the other Shiroya..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But given the movements, I might know who it was...
entries.literal: "But given the movements, I might know who it was..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And that Shiroya... How the hell did she get there...!?
entries.literal: "And that Shiroya... How the hell did she get there...!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was she the Shiroya from this morning? Did she appear in the attic with Naomi and spend the whole day in the tower?
entries.literal: "Was she the Shiroya from this morning? Did she appear in the attic with Naomi and spend the whole day in the tower?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It can't be. We would've seen her, and what the hell was the deal with her clothes!? Or anything that she said!
entries.literal: "It can't be. We would've seen her, and what the hell was the deal with her clothes!? Or anything that she said!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She was the same Shiroya I'd been with. She remembered what we'd done. ...That's all I get.
entries.literal: "She was the same Shiroya I'd been with. She remembered what we'd done. ...That's all I get."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we returned to room B6, the Sekimeiya we used wasn't there. Since we'd gone to the future, someone had time to take it away.
entries.literal: "When we returned to room B6, the Sekimeiya we used wasn't there. Since we'd gone to the future, someone had time to take it away."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Instead, we found one in a cabinet drawer. It was considerably hot, so it was there for a long time.
entries.literal: "Instead, we found one in a cabinet drawer. It was considerably hot, so it was there for a long time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But we decided not to activate it and brought it to its cabinet.
entries.literal: "But we decided not to activate it and brought it to its cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If they had touched it, though, what would've happened? It has been a while since you asked for that.
entries.literal: "If they had touched it, though, what would've happened? It has been a while since you asked for that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki would've gone many hours back in time. The lights would not yet have turned on, and he would've found himself in the lobby.
entries.literal: "Atsuki would've gone many hours back in time. The lights would not yet have turned on, and he would've found himself in the lobby."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You remember, right? He spent a long time in the staff room. Eventually, after the light was turned on in the morning, he was killed by Ido, who had the suitcase ready to prepare the attack.
entries.literal: "You remember, right? He spent a long time in the staff room. Eventually, after the light was turned on in the morning, he was killed by Ido, who had the suitcase ready to prepare the attack."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before his eyesight failed, Atsuki saw four people he recognized.
entries.literal: "Before his eyesight failed, Atsuki saw four people he recognized."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Two men, a woman, and a girl."
entries.literal: "\"Two men, a woman, and a girl.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One was Shiroya. She was naturally encompassed by the range when Atsuki touched the Sekimeiya.{w} However, she didn't appear in the lobby with him. Strangely, she appeared in a bathroom on the crystal floor, and when she left, she was seen from the security room and addressed through the microphone.
entries.literal: "One was Shiroya. She was naturally encompassed by the range when Atsuki touched the Sekimeiya.{w} However, she didn't appear in the lobby with him. Strangely, she appeared in a bathroom on the crystal floor, and when she left, she was seen from the security room and addressed through the microphone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki recognized Ido and Suripo as well: he had seen both of them during the long wait before the event.
entries.literal: "Atsuki recognized Ido and Suripo as well: he had seen both of them during the long wait before the event."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The last person was Erina. She had been alive in room B4 next to Atsuki and Shiroya and appeared in the mechanical room.
entries.literal: "The last person was Erina. She had been alive in room B4 next to Atsuki and Shiroya and appeared in the mechanical room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, she had been unconscious. Therefore, despite appearing in the past, she took a while to awaken.
entries.literal: "However, she had been unconscious. Therefore, despite appearing in the past, she took a while to awaken."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two impossibilities prevented this from happening. One was the butterfly effect.
entries.literal: "Two impossibilities prevented this from happening. One was the butterfly effect."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Precisely. Atsuki died.
entries.literal: "Precisely. Atsuki died."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There should've been a world switch, but this is tied to the butterfly effect. After all, the Future Sekimeiya was between another Shiroya's hands, and that version of Shiroya couldn't have existed if they had gone to the past.
entries.literal: "There should've been a world switch, but this is tied to the butterfly effect. After all, the Future Sekimeiya was between another Shiroya's hands, and that version of Shiroya couldn't have existed if they had gone to the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya could have existed, but not Atsuki. That is because he died.
entries.literal: "Shiroya could have existed, but not Atsuki. That is because he died."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Perhaps that problem helped you figure out the Sekimeiya's mechanics. Because Atsuki died, he could never have appeared in the lobby—he wouldn't have been there in the future.
entries.literal: "Perhaps that problem helped you figure out the Sekimeiya's mechanics. Because Atsuki died, he could never have appeared in the lobby—he wouldn't have been there in the future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, there's something to recognize: he had a wound on his right hand, and in the darkness, he saw that he had a key shaped like the one for Naomi's locker. ...It was Ido's instead, though; his appearing location was where he would've ended up traveling to the future in a chain of travels.
entries.literal: "However, there's something to recognize: he had a wound on his right hand, and in the darkness, he saw that he had a key shaped like the one for Naomi's locker. ...It was Ido's instead, though; his appearing location was where he would've ended up traveling to the future in a chain of travels."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...That was when we found Katei dead in the security room.
entries.literal: "...That was when we found Katei dead in the security room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei walked out of the bedroom, Erina followed close behind.{w} She didn't believe Atsuki and Shiroya had killed Isla. ...Sai and Akaro had been with her the entire time.
entries.literal: "When Katei walked out of the bedroom, Erina followed close behind.{w} She didn't believe Atsuki and Shiroya had killed Isla. ...Sai and Akaro had been with her the entire time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, Katei had been missing during that time, and he hadn't explained himself.{w} She didn't trust him at all; he'd been lying all day. ...He had faked going to the bathroom to take advantage of Isla's death.
entries.literal: "However, Katei had been missing during that time, and he hadn't explained himself.{w} She didn't trust him at all; he'd been lying all day. ...He had faked going to the bathroom to take advantage of Isla's death."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the lowest floor, when Erina uttered his name, he turned around slowly.
entries.literal: "On the lowest floor, when Erina uttered his name, he turned around slowly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A single question was asked. "Where were you when we couldn't find you?"
entries.literal: "A single question was asked. \"Where were you when we couldn't find you?\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei realized the meaning behind that. Erina suspected him of causing Isla's death.{w} He sighed quietly and then spoke.
entries.literal: "Katei realized the meaning behind that. Erina suspected him of causing Isla's death.{w} He sighed quietly and then spoke."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I don't know exactly. When I was walking behind Sai, I suddenly appeared in the attic.
entries.literal: "I don't know exactly. When I was walking behind Sai, I suddenly appeared in the attic."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: It's the truth. It likely happened when Shiroya and Atsuki touched the Sekimeiya, remember?
entries.literal: "It's the truth. It likely happened when Shiroya and Atsuki touched the Sekimeiya, remember?"

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: Why didn't you say this before!? And that doesn't tell me anything! Why didn't we find you!?
entries.literal: "Why didn't you say this before!? And that doesn't tell me anything! Why didn't we find you!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei stared into Erina's eyes. Her voice had never sounded so harsh.
entries.literal: "Katei stared into Erina's eyes. Her voice had never sounded so harsh."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I said I experienced the teleportation, and I am telling you the truth. I was beyond confused when I appeared there.{w} When I came down, the three of you were in the lobby.
entries.literal: "I said I experienced the teleportation, and I am telling you the truth. I was beyond confused when I appeared there.{w} When I came down, the three of you were in the lobby."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Although Erina wavered, she quickly dismissed Katei's claim as nonsense.
entries.literal: "Although Erina wavered, she quickly dismissed Katei's claim as nonsense."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: You're not even making sense! You were hiding in the storeroom, weren't you?
entries.literal: "You're not even making sense! You were hiding in the storeroom, weren't you?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: What? No! There are cameras in hallway C. What I'm saying will be proven.
entries.literal: "What? No! There are cameras in hallway C. What I'm saying will be proven."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: ...I don't believe it. The cameras aren't recording.
entries.literal: "...I don't believe it. The cameras aren't recording."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Yes they are! Don't you see the light!?
entries.literal: "Yes they are! Don't you see the light!?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei saw nothing but hostility in Erina's face. Enough to appear as a threat.{w} Did she really think he had killed Isla? He didn't know anything about what had happened to her, but there was a way he could prove his innocence.
entries.literal: "Katei saw nothing but hostility in Erina's face. Enough to appear as a threat.{w} Did she really think he had killed Isla? He didn't know anything about what had happened to her, but there was a way he could prove his innocence."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: ...You still haven't explained anything. Why didn't you say this earlier, and why didn't we find you?
entries.literal: "...You still haven't explained anything. Why didn't you say this earlier, and why didn't we find you?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina had no idea what to believe. No one else could've harmed Isla, but who would have? Why would anyone have done that to her daughter? Part of her wanted to abandon everything and just stop thinking altogether, placidly waiting the month it would take her daughter to return.
entries.literal: "Erina had no idea what to believe. No one else could've harmed Isla, but who would have? Why would anyone have done that to her daughter? Part of her wanted to abandon everything and just stop thinking altogether, placidly waiting the month it would take her daughter to return."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: ...I'm not lying. Maybe I can prove myself.
entries.literal: "...I'm not lying. Maybe I can prove myself."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei started walking to the security room, gesturing at Erina to come with him.
entries.literal: "Katei started walking to the security room, gesturing at Erina to come with him."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: It has been a long time since I've checked. Perhaps the security system is working again, just like what happened to the computer.
entries.literal: "It has been a long time since I've checked. Perhaps the security system is working again, just like what happened to the computer."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In silence, Katei kneeled under the desk while Erina watched expectantly.
entries.literal: "In silence, Katei kneeled under the desk while Erina watched expectantly."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Again, there doesn't seem to be anything wrong with this.
entries.literal: "Again, there doesn't seem to be anything wrong with this."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As he stood up, he nonchalantly took a rusty key out of his pocket and left it in a drawer.
entries.literal: "As he stood up, he nonchalantly took a rusty key out of his pocket and left it in a drawer."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: This time, I won't forget to keep it somewhere safer.
entries.literal: "This time, I won't forget to keep it somewhere safer."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Katei sat on his chair and started up the three screens. As Erina stepped forward, he pressed the "archived footage" button.
entries.literal: "...Katei sat on his chair and started up the three screens. As Erina stepped forward, he pressed the \"archived footage\" button."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: O-Oh! I-It's working!
entries.literal: "O-Oh! I-It's working!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A list of cameras appeared on the screen. Erina read them without so much as a twitch.
entries.literal: "A list of cameras appeared on the screen. Erina read them without so much as a twitch."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Look! I'll show you that I was telling the truth!
entries.literal: "Look! I'll show you that I was telling the truth!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei selected one, a video of hallway C came up, mainly focusing on the bathrooms. Frustrated, Katei used the time bar to skip ahead.
entries.literal: "When Katei selected one, a video of hallway C came up, mainly focusing on the bathrooms. Frustrated, Katei used the time bar to skip ahead."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Here! I'm about to disappear!
entries.literal: "Here! I'm about to disappear!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Coming from hallway B, Sai stepped into C. Katei followed behind, and out of nowhere, his body vanished.
entries.literal: "Coming from hallway B, Sai stepped into C. Katei followed behind, and out of nowhere, his body vanished."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: See! That's when I appeared in the attic!
entries.literal: "See! That's when I appeared in the attic!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After he selected another camera and fast-forwarded further, Katei appeared from the second floor and entered hallway A.
entries.literal: "After he selected another camera and fast-forwarded further, Katei appeared from the second floor and entered hallway A."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Just like I said, I wasn't here when she disappeared! I have no idea what happened to her, but I didn't lie!
entries.literal: "Just like I said, I wasn't here when she disappeared! I have no idea what happened to her, but I didn't lie!"

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: ...Did you kill Naomi?
entries.literal: "...Did you kill Naomi?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Huh? Of course I didn't!
entries.literal: "Huh? Of course I didn't!"

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: Show me what happened.
entries.literal: "Show me what happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...{w}After a brief pause, Katei moved the cursor to a different camera.{w} He was calm. He knew very little incriminating footage was located in those folders.
entries.literal: "...{w}After a brief pause, Katei moved the cursor to a different camera.{w} He was calm. He knew very little incriminating footage was located in those folders."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once he clicked on room B4's camera, a message appeared on the screen.{w} "{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased".
entries.literal: "Once he clicked on room B4's camera, a message appeared on the screen.{w} \"{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased\"."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Wh-What!?{w} The killer erased it! H-How!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What!?{w} The killer erased it! H-How!?"

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: ...{w}{time=10:04}? Isn't that when we left you here?
entries.literal: "...{w}{time=10:04}? Isn't that when we left you here?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Huh? It might be, but why does that matter!? The system wasn't working for me at the time!
entries.literal: "Huh? It might be, but why does that matter!? The system wasn't working for me at the time!"

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: You killed Naomi, right?
entries.literal: "You killed Naomi, right?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei hung his head. He'd failed to remember the deletion time would be displayed.
entries.literal: "Katei hung his head. He'd failed to remember the deletion time would be displayed."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: ...I would never kill a person.
entries.literal: "...I would never kill a person."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: You d-did. And not only Naomi, right?
entries.literal: "You d-did. And not only Naomi, right?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: You're wrong! I promise I didn't do anything!
entries.literal: "You're wrong! I promise I didn't do anything!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei's excuses were poor; he wasn't trying anymore. Even if he convinced Erina, he was done for, as the deletion time pointed straight at him.
entries.literal: "Katei's excuses were poor; he wasn't trying anymore. Even if he convinced Erina, he was done for, as the deletion time pointed straight at him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His mind was someplace else entirely. He couldn't let that message be seen.
entries.literal: "His mind was someplace else entirely. He couldn't let that message be seen."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had already ended someone's life for his own sake. If he was quick, he could get himself out of there. ...And there were many more suspects than the first time.
entries.literal: "He had already ended someone's life for his own sake. If he was quick, he could get himself out of there. ...And there were many more suspects than the first time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei turned around, ready to deliver a sudden blow, but he didn't expect the one that came first.
entries.literal: "Katei turned around, ready to deliver a sudden blow, but he didn't expect the one that came first."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After a sharp collapse, Katei's body was on the floor, splashed with its own blood.
entries.literal: "After a sharp collapse, Katei's body was on the floor, splashed with its own blood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Next to him was Erina. Katei's fist had contacted her head, and she had also fallen on top of the blood.
entries.literal: "Next to him was Erina. Katei's fist had contacted her head, and she had also fallen on top of the blood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Only one of them was alive.
entries.literal: "Only one of them was alive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina suddenly awakened and saw Katei's blurry outline.
entries.literal: "Erina suddenly awakened and saw Katei's blurry outline."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had killed him. She remembered what had happened. However, she could hardly keep herself steady.
entries.literal: "She had killed him. She remembered what had happened. However, she could hardly keep herself steady."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She was unable to tell how much time had passed. The seconds had suddenly cut off for her, but she had to get out of there. Once she was able to stand, she walked to the door.
entries.literal: "She was unable to tell how much time had passed. The seconds had suddenly cut off for her, but she had to get out of there. Once she was able to stand, she walked to the door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She couldn't see anyone in the hallway, but the end was a bright blob. Suddenly, she felt the need to go somewhere.
entries.literal: "She couldn't see anyone in the hallway, but the end was a bright blob. Suddenly, she felt the need to go somewhere."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She approached the event room. Inside, a single drop of Katei's blood dripped off her.
entries.literal: "She approached the event room. Inside, a single drop of Katei's blood dripped off her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Paying it no mind, she slowly walked out through the other door.
entries.literal: "Paying it no mind, she slowly walked out through the other door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She walked in a straight line. Then, beyond a door, she saw a body beneath a curtain.
entries.literal: "She walked in a straight line. Then, beyond a door, she saw a body beneath a curtain."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had... avenged her. Naomi could at least rest in peace.
entries.literal: "She had... avenged her. Naomi could at least rest in peace."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Someone closed the door behind her, but she didn't hear it. ...Only two other people did, and they mistook it as their own action.
entries.literal: "Someone closed the door behind her, but she didn't hear it. ...Only two other people did, and they mistook it as their own action."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I think I can imagine what happened.{w} We then found Erina's body, but she was still alive, and after we were in the event room for a while, the other Shiroya woke me up.
entries.literal: "...I think I can imagine what happened.{w} We then found Erina's body, but she was still alive, and after we were in the event room for a while, the other Shiroya woke me up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why the hell was she there? And why did we not find her before? Did she avoid the searches with the Sekimeiya, knowing all of them were coming?
entries.literal: "Why the hell was she there? And why did we not find her before? Did she avoid the searches with the Sekimeiya, knowing all of them were coming?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She really must have been the Shiroya who disappeared with Naomi...
entries.literal: "She really must have been the Shiroya who disappeared with Naomi..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We couldn't find her, but suddenly, Sai attacked us.{w} I don't get that either...! Why did he want to kill us, and where did he even get that knife from!?
entries.literal: "We couldn't find her, but suddenly, Sai attacked us.{w} I don't get that either...! Why did he want to kill us, and where did he even get that knife from!?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I thought you'd overstepped, but it seems I was the one who had.
entries.literal: "I thought you'd overstepped, but it seems I was the one who had."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the fuck did that even mean?
entries.literal: "What the fuck did that even mean?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Before that point, he seemed to slow down when it became clear that I didn't know why he was chasing us. ...He snapped out of it suddenly, though.
entries.literal: "Before that point, he seemed to slow down when it became clear that I didn't know why he was chasing us. ...He snapped out of it suddenly, though."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Pensively, Sai glanced around the room. Suddenly, in visible shock, his whole body went one step backward."
entries.literal: "\"Pensively, Sai glanced around the room. Suddenly, in visible shock, his whole body went one step backward.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai saw the security camera behind Atsuki.
entries.literal: "Sai saw the security camera behind Atsuki."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Earlier, Sai had experienced his first world switch. It was Atsuki A who he thought he'd been chasing.
entries.literal: "Earlier, Sai had experienced his first world switch. It was Atsuki A who he thought he'd been chasing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He realized Atsuki B didn't seem to know what had occurred and that he hadn't been crying, but it was the camera's green light that stopped him, as it otherwise would've been possible for that Atsuki to be a future version of the one who'd punched him.{w} In world A, Sai had noticed the green lights were gone; the cameras hadn't been recording. When he unknowingly returned to world B, he even saw the message on the computer that matched with the lack of green lights.
entries.literal: "He realized Atsuki B didn't seem to know what had occurred and that he hadn't been crying, but it was the camera's green light that stopped him, as it otherwise would've been possible for that Atsuki to be a future version of the one who'd punched him.{w} In world A, Sai had noticed the green lights were gone; the cameras hadn't been recording. When he unknowingly returned to world B, he even saw the message on the computer that matched with the lack of green lights."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, when he saw the green light again, he understood he'd been recorded chasing behind Atsuki and Shiroya with a knife. If he killed them, he would be the culprit.
entries.literal: "However, when he saw the green light again, he understood he'd been recorded chasing behind Atsuki and Shiroya with a knife. If he killed them, he would be the culprit."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai didn't believe that footage would see the light of the day, but he couldn't risk his own life. As a result, he abandoned all intentions to use his knife as soon as that green light entered his eyes.
entries.literal: "Sai didn't believe that footage would see the light of the day, but he couldn't risk his own life. As a result, he abandoned all intentions to use his knife as soon as that green light entered his eyes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai began to think about what he'd experienced. The Sekimeiya had disappeared from room B6, where Atsuki and Shiroya had found one...
entries.literal: "Sai began to think about what he'd experienced. The Sekimeiya had disappeared from room B6, where Atsuki and Shiroya had found one..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They hadn't known yet that two existed: they thought the Sekimeiya had teleported to a drawer, meaning they might've missed that the Future Sekimeiya was still in that room.
entries.literal: "They hadn't known yet that two existed: they thought the Sekimeiya had teleported to a drawer, meaning they might've missed that the Future Sekimeiya was still in that room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki looked through every room in the hallway B and didn't find it after Sai had evaded detection there. He thought he could simply go twenty minutes back and obtain it before Atsuki's inspection, like he'd planned before dashing out of the event room.
entries.literal: "Atsuki looked through every room in the hallway B and didn't find it after Sai had evaded detection there. He thought he could simply go twenty minutes back and obtain it before Atsuki's inspection, like he'd planned before dashing out of the event room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But... what had he experienced? Where was the Atsuki who'd been crying in the attic?
entries.literal: "But... what had he experienced? Where was the Atsuki who'd been crying in the attic?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai had seen a dead body in the lobby near a pool of blood: Shiroya's.{w} Why was it not there anymore? Why had the pool of blood diminished?
entries.literal: "Sai had seen a dead body in the lobby near a pool of blood: Shiroya's.{w} Why was it not there anymore? Why had the pool of blood diminished?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't know, but he'd seen Shiroya dead. Her fate had to be death, but Sai couldn't explain the body's disappearance yet.
entries.literal: "He didn't know, but he'd seen Shiroya dead. Her fate had to be death, but Sai couldn't explain the body's disappearance yet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She would end up dead... Someone would kill Shiroya. Sai just had to work out the structure of events.
entries.literal: "She would end up dead... Someone would kill Shiroya. Sai just had to work out the structure of events."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He ran away and managed to hide in hallway B. I'm not sure what he did, but when he unlocked the cabinet, we spoke to him for a while. ...He was pretty confident that Shiroya would die and that the blood in the lobby was hers.
entries.literal: "He ran away and managed to hide in hallway B. I'm not sure what he did, but when he unlocked the cabinet, we spoke to him for a while. ...He was pretty confident that Shiroya would die and that the blood in the lobby was hers."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And that's when he and Shiroya disappeared from the event room.
entries.literal: "...And that's when he and Shiroya disappeared from the event room."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I also just said what my plan relies on: I must go back to the past, but I don't need to go too far. If I had another Sekimeiya hidden, what would the point of using this one be? I would just go back to the past with the other one I have, right?
entries.literal: "I also just said what my plan relies on: I must go back to the past, but I don't need to go too far. If I had another Sekimeiya hidden, what would the point of using this one be? I would just go back to the past with the other one I have, right?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: This is an actual question. If I know where another Sekimeiya is like you say, why would I not simply use that one?
entries.literal: "This is an actual question. If I know where another Sekimeiya is like you say, why would I not simply use that one?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Because it would've sent him to the future. He wanted to go to the past, and he knew the Sekimeiya in the cabinet was what he needed.
entries.literal: "...Because it would've sent him to the future. He wanted to go to the past, and he knew the Sekimeiya in the cabinet was what he needed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When he touched it, he and Shiroya appeared in the attic, which was inaccessible for me.{w} I'm not sure what happened there, but Shiroya told me Sai locked her in a bedroom.
entries.literal: "When he touched it, he and Shiroya appeared in the attic, which was inaccessible for me.{w} I'm not sure what happened there, but Shiroya told me Sai locked her in a bedroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On the crystal floor, I was able to open another locker...
entries.literal: "On the crystal floor, I was able to open another locker..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why did I find its key in the cleaning room? Why didn't we find it before that point?
entries.literal: "Why did I find its key in the cleaning room? Why didn't we find it before that point?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It should've been noticed plenty of times, when people were looking for the Sekimeiya. Maybe you realized that Akaro always went out of his way to look at that room before the cart disappeared.
entries.literal: "It should've been noticed plenty of times, when people were looking for the Sekimeiya. Maybe you realized that Akaro always went out of his way to look at that room before the cart disappeared."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...From the staff room, I used the Sekimeiya and appeared twenty minutes in the past, in the event room. I used that time to search through the upper floors, but I had locked myself out of the attic.{w} I ended up in the security room without finding anyone, but Erina had to be somewhere, likely with Miiya...
entries.literal: "...From the staff room, I used the Sekimeiya and appeared twenty minutes in the past, in the event room. I used that time to search through the upper floors, but I had locked myself out of the attic.{w} I ended up in the security room without finding anyone, but Erina had to be somewhere, likely with Miiya..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Many questions were eclipsed by a much bigger one: the note that I'd found on the floor of the staff room.
entries.literal: "Many questions were eclipsed by a much bigger one: the note that I'd found on the floor of the staff room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I touched the Sekimeiya and went twenty minutes to the past. Then, when I returned to the staff room, I found that note. It's very likely it fell from my pocket when I sat on the floor.
entries.literal: "I touched the Sekimeiya and went twenty minutes to the past. Then, when I returned to the staff room, I found that note. It's very likely it fell from my pocket when I sat on the floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I never wrote it. What the fuck was it doing in my pocket? I don't believe anyone else left it on the floor.{w} Wait, no. This doesn't even make sense.{w} Nobody could've put it in my pocket, so what I must assume is that I appeared with it when I traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "I never wrote it. What the fuck was it doing in my pocket? I don't believe anyone else left it on the floor.{w} Wait, no. This doesn't even make sense.{w} Nobody could've put it in my pocket, so what I must assume is that I appeared with it when I traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: From the staff room, I traveled and appeared in the event room. That makes sense—forty minutes later, we were all there when Erina was about to activate the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "From the staff room, I traveled and appeared in the event room. That makes sense—forty minutes later, we were all there when Erina was about to activate the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh, right, I'd forgotten about this too.
entries.literal: "Oh, right, I'd forgotten about this too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Still sounding groggy, she traced my gaze up to her purse and took out a small piece of paper."
entries.literal: "\"Still sounding groggy, she traced my gaze up to her purse and took out a small piece of paper.\""

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: I found this just now. I tried to read it, but my head hurt a lot. Do you know what it is?
entries.literal: "I found this just now. I tried to read it, but my head hurt a lot. Do you know what it is?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "She handed it to me, and I snatched it away, gripping it tightly. My hands started trembling as soon as I glanced at the words again and saw those familiar letters."
entries.literal: "\"She handed it to me, and I snatched it away, gripping it tightly. My hands started trembling as soon as I glanced at the words again and saw those familiar letters.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Erina found the note I threw away. When I took it, I immediately put it in my pocket so that the others wouldn't see it. That's why I appeared with it in the event room forty minutes earlier...
entries.literal: "Erina found the note I threw away. When I took it, I immediately put it in my pocket so that the others wouldn't see it. That's why I appeared with it in the event room forty minutes earlier..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, this is illogical. Where is its origin?{w} I appeared with it and I threw it away. Then, Erina found it and gave it to me, which is why I appeared with it. ...It doesn't have a beginning.
entries.literal: "However, this is illogical. Where is its origin?{w} I appeared with it and I threw it away. Then, Erina found it and gave it to me, which is why I appeared with it. ...It doesn't have a beginning."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I must have something backward. Otherwise, it doesn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "I must have something backward. Otherwise, it doesn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm... I assumed Erina found the note where I'd discarded it, behind the handrail in hallway B.{w} But she only said "I found this just now."
entries.literal: "Hm... I assumed Erina found the note where I'd discarded it, behind the handrail in hallway B.{w} But she only said \"I found this just now.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If she found it somewhere else, it makes sense. She gave it to me and I gripped it tightly, which is why I appeared with it in the past and saw it roughly folded. Then, I left it behind the handrail, and it remained there.
entries.literal: "If she found it somewhere else, it makes sense. She gave it to me and I gripped it tightly, which is why I appeared with it in the past and saw it roughly folded. Then, I left it behind the handrail, and it remained there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe this is it. After all, there's only one explanation behind that note—it came from another world.
entries.literal: "Maybe this is it. After all, there's only one explanation behind that note—it came from another world."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And Erina told us what happened right before that point. She met Miiya.
entries.literal: "...And Erina told us what happened right before that point. She met Miiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could Miiya have had that note...? Did I really write it in another world?
entries.literal: "Could Miiya have had that note...? Did I really write it in another world?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why was she there, and where did she go?
entries.literal: "Why was she there, and where did she go?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put my hand in my pocket, but the note wasn't there. It had disappeared at some point.
entries.literal: "I put my hand in my pocket, but the note wasn't there. It had disappeared at some point."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right. The next time I traveled to the past, I didn't appear with it.{w} But... why? I should have.
entries.literal: "Right. The next time I traveled to the past, I didn't appear with it.{w} But... why? I should have."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although that was what it seemed like, concluding why it had vanished was relatively simple.
entries.literal: "Although that was what it seemed like, concluding why it had vanished was relatively simple."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, it's like I thought earlier. I had the note when I traveled to the past. From the staff room, I appeared in hallway B and then slammed the storeroom door to create a new noise. After that, I waited in the bathroom on the second floor.{w} There, I put my hand in my pocket because I wanted to flush the note away. However, it wasn't there.{w} That's why I didn't appear with it. I wanted to flush it away, so if I had, I wouldn't have held the note in the future, and I never could've appeared with it.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's like I thought earlier. I had the note when I traveled to the past. From the staff room, I appeared in hallway B and then slammed the storeroom door to create a new noise. After that, I waited in the bathroom on the second floor.{w} There, I put my hand in my pocket because I wanted to flush the note away. However, it wasn't there.{w} That's why I didn't appear with it. I wanted to flush it away, so if I had, I wouldn't have held the note in the future, and I never could've appeared with it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: These details... I wonder how many I missed.{w} Now that I think about it, something similar happened that very same travel.{w} When I touched the Sekimeiya, I had the locker key in my hand. However, when I returned to the staff room with Shiroya, I had it in my pocket. I still appeared with it in the past, but it was in my pocket.
entries.literal: "These details... I wonder how many I missed.{w} Now that I think about it, something similar happened that very same travel.{w} When I touched the Sekimeiya, I had the locker key in my hand. However, when I returned to the staff room with Shiroya, I had it in my pocket. I still appeared with it in the past, but it was in my pocket."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...That's because if I'd appeared with it in my hand, I would've then put it in my pocket. That redundant action was canceled, and I simply appeared with it already inside.{w} Along the same line of thought, I didn't go to the bathroom many times, did I? I didn't feel the need to.{w} Maybe that happened due to my travels—if I'd felt that urge upon going back, I would've gone to the bathroom. Then, in the replicated location, that wouldn't have been needed anymore. My bladder just automatically emptied without me noticing.
entries.literal: "...That's because if I'd appeared with it in my hand, I would've then put it in my pocket. That redundant action was canceled, and I simply appeared with it already inside.{w} Along the same line of thought, I didn't go to the bathroom many times, did I? I didn't feel the need to.{w} Maybe that happened due to my travels—if I'd felt that urge upon going back, I would've gone to the bathroom. Then, in the replicated location, that wouldn't have been needed anymore. My bladder just automatically emptied without me noticing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...There certainly are mysteries I still can't solve. Maybe I can, but I'm failing to do so.
entries.literal: "...There certainly are mysteries I still can't solve. Maybe I can, but I'm failing to do so."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Miiya's existence, Shiroya's...
entries.literal: "Miiya's existence, Shiroya's..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In the event room, when Erina activated the Sekimeiya, the world around us changed, and Sai was the only one to travel through time.
entries.literal: "In the event room, when Erina activated the Sekimeiya, the world around us changed, and Sai was the only one to travel through time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had hidden the Past Sekimeiya in Ido's locker, so Sai went to the future.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had hidden the Past Sekimeiya in Ido's locker, so Sai went to the future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had just been in the attic's bedroom, so he reappeared there with Shiroya. That is how he unintentionally locked himself in that room.
entries.literal: "He had just been in the attic's bedroom, so he reappeared there with Shiroya. That is how he unintentionally locked himself in that room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When that happened, Shiroya was with us, but her clothes were different... She had appeared before me when I'd cried her name...
entries.literal: "When that happened, Shiroya was with us, but her clothes were different... She had appeared before me when I'd cried her name..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That was the real Shiroya, but what happened to her? How did she get there?
entries.literal: "That was the real Shiroya, but what happened to her? How did she get there?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was she the Shiroya from this morning, the one who'd traveled to the pa—
entries.literal: "Was she the Shiroya from this morning, the one who'd traveled to the pa—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her words came back to me. She had told me that she'd traveled to November 30th.
entries.literal: "Her words came back to me. She had told me that she'd traveled to November 30th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, what the hell...? There's a major contradiction with that.
entries.literal: "Wait, what the hell...? There's a major contradiction with that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She said that she appeared below the gem shop... but that can't be. She wouldn't have appeared there if she'd gone from December 15th to November 30th.
entries.literal: "She said that she appeared below the gem shop... but that can't be. She wouldn't have appeared there if she'd gone from December 15th to November 30th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That location was exactly where she was on November 30th.{w} The only way for her to appear there is if she went fifteen days into the future.{w} ...To December 30th.
entries.literal: "That location was exactly where she was on November 30th.{w} The only way for her to appear there is if she went fifteen days into the future.{w} ...To December 30th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Could she really have gone to the future? Did that occur without her realizing it?{w} Right, I didn't think about it earlier, but the Sekimeiya that sent us repeatedly to January 5th at {time=21:00} was the one that Shiroya activated in the bathroom.
entries.literal: "...Could she really have gone to the future? Did that occur without her realizing it?{w} Right, I didn't think about it earlier, but the Sekimeiya that sent us repeatedly to January 5th at {time=21:00} was the one that Shiroya activated in the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't know what had happened, but just the location where she'd appeared spelled it out clearly.
entries.literal: "I couldn't know what had happened, but just the location where she'd appeared spelled it out clearly."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, this is why...
entries.literal: "Wait, this is why..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's why the chain of travels forward stopped on January 5th! It's gotta be!
entries.literal: "It's why the chain of travels forward stopped on January 5th! It's gotta be!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Shiroya traveled to the future. She went to December 30th. Then, like she told me, she entered the tower through the storeroom days later—on January 5th.
entries.literal: "Shiroya traveled to the future. She went to December 30th. Then, like she told me, she entered the tower through the storeroom days later—on January 5th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She didn't tell me exactly what she did, but I know she was in the mechanical room. She told me that she found the attic key there.{w} So she was looking for something, and without realizing it, she moved the Future Sekimeiya in the mechanical room. The next time that all of us appeared, nobody instantly activated the next travel, so we stopped on the 5th. That has to be it!
entries.literal: "She didn't tell me exactly what she did, but I know she was in the mechanical room. She told me that she found the attic key there.{w} So she was looking for something, and without realizing it, she moved the Future Sekimeiya in the mechanical room. The next time that all of us appeared, nobody instantly activated the next travel, so we stopped on the 5th. That has to be it!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the voice recorder.
entries.literal: "I looked at the voice recorder."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: 58:42. It's almost been an hour already.
entries.literal: "58:42. It's almost been an hour already."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have much time.
entries.literal: "I didn't have much time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Although it once seemed impossible, saving Miiya from the explosion should be simple. Very soon, if I touch the Sekimeiya, I'll be sent back to a point before she died.{w} ...Then, I could stop it. I could change the past.
entries.literal: "...Although it once seemed impossible, saving Miiya from the explosion should be simple. Very soon, if I touch the Sekimeiya, I'll be sent back to a point before she died.{w} ...Then, I could stop it. I could change the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That would create the world that we want—the one we thought we'd have on that day.
entries.literal: "That would create the world that we want—the one we thought we'd have on that day."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...But there's still a big problem. If I do that, I can't live in it. Two versions of myself would remain.
entries.literal: "...But there's still a big problem. If I do that, I can't live in it. Two versions of myself would remain."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That had previously been a theoretical problem I hadn't needed to confront. However, it was the truth; although that world was attainable, it had no room for its creator.
entries.literal: "That had previously been a theoretical problem I hadn't needed to confront. However, it was the truth; although that world was attainable, it had no room for its creator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Given all I'd concluded, I could think of a slight workaround.
entries.literal: "Given all I'd concluded, I could think of a slight workaround."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could create that world and then leave it...
entries.literal: "I could create that world and then leave it..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I'm right, and touching the Sekimeiya when both ranges overlap will send me to the other world, I could do that after saving Miiya.{w} If it worked, although I'd end up in my original world, I would've at least facilitated the best one's existence.
entries.literal: "If I'm right, and touching the Sekimeiya when both ranges overlap will send me to the other world, I could do that after saving Miiya.{w} If it worked, although I'd end up in my original world, I would've at least facilitated the best one's existence."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But I don't get what's happening right now. Why was Miiya in the tower?{w} If I did what I'm thinking, I would make sure our past selves don't go to the event, as that would put them in danger again. So, then, why is Miiya here? ...And why have I not seen Shiroya anywhere?
entries.literal: "But I don't get what's happening right now. Why was Miiya in the tower?{w} If I did what I'm thinking, I would make sure our past selves don't go to the event, as that would put them in danger again. So, then, why is Miiya here? ...And why have I not seen Shiroya anywhere?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...That time before {time=21}, why did Shiroya say that she didn't want to save Miiya? It couldn't have been the real Shiroya, but I can't figure out a reason.
entries.literal: "...That time before {time=21}, why did Shiroya say that she didn't want to save Miiya? It couldn't have been the real Shiroya, but I can't figure out a reason."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...However, as I'd thought, doing what I'd proposed myself was simple. I only had to touch the Sekimeiya when the device displayed 65 minutes and 20 seconds.{w} As I could plan out the loop before executing it, there was a best-case scenario that I'd thought up.
entries.literal: "...However, as I'd thought, doing what I'd proposed myself was simple. I only had to touch the Sekimeiya when the device displayed 65 minutes and 20 seconds.{w} As I could plan out the loop before executing it, there was a best-case scenario that I'd thought up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I would appear on November 24th. That's 21 days before now, and it'll be January 5th in 21 days. Basically, if I think about what I'll do on January 5th, I can plan my arrival on November 24th.
entries.literal: "I would appear on November 24th. That's 21 days before now, and it'll be January 5th in 21 days. Basically, if I think about what I'll do on January 5th, I can plan my arrival on November 24th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After November 30th, once everything is done, I could touch the Sekimeiya to go to our previous world. There, I know I'll be able to use the Sekimeiya on January 5th after we break free from the chain of travels.{w} ...If I plan this out so I obtain both Sekimeiya on the 5th, I can appear with them on November 24th, which will allow me to use them immediately after the 30th.
entries.literal: "After November 30th, once everything is done, I could touch the Sekimeiya to go to our previous world. There, I know I'll be able to use the Sekimeiya on January 5th after we break free from the chain of travels.{w} ...If I plan this out so I obtain both Sekimeiya on the 5th, I can appear with them on November 24th, which will allow me to use them immediately after the 30th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What I can't be sure of is that doing so will bring me to the world I was in. It could send me anywhere else.
entries.literal: "What I can't be sure of is that doing so will bring me to the world I was in. It could send me anywhere else."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If that happens, though, won't it be the world where Shiroya is? The Shiroya who disappeared from this world earlier today?
entries.literal: "If that happens, though, won't it be the world where Shiroya is? The Shiroya who disappeared from this world earlier today?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Would that be consistent? Even though I would've altered this world, would I be sent to the same place where she went?
entries.literal: "...Would that be consistent? Even though I would've altered this world, would I be sent to the same place where she went?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had no idea where Shiroya was, but I remembered the time I'd told her that changing the past was possible. Without a doubt, she wanted Miiya to be saved, and the opportunity to accomplish it was finally real. Even with all that I'd concluded, I found myself entirely lost, merely aware that Miiya's death was reversible.
entries.literal: "I had no idea where Shiroya was, but I remembered the time I'd told her that changing the past was possible. Without a doubt, she wanted Miiya to be saved, and the opportunity to accomplish it was finally real. Even with all that I'd concluded, I found myself entirely lost, merely aware that Miiya's death was reversible."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If touching the Sekimeiya doesn't send me to our world, what that might mean is that on January 5th, I won't be able to have them. Then, I wouldn't appear with them on November 24th, so I suppose I'll know as soon as I travel.
entries.literal: "If touching the Sekimeiya doesn't send me to our world, what that might mean is that on January 5th, I won't be able to have them. Then, I wouldn't appear with them on November 24th, so I suppose I'll know as soon as I travel."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If that happens, I'll have to wait until December 15th to change worlds during the incident.
entries.literal: "If that happens, I'll have to wait until December 15th to change worlds during the incident."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}Was it a flawed plan? I went over it again, and I didn't think so. I intended to change history. There was no option to check a note a future self of mine would leave behind to assure my success.{w} Saving Miiya was achievable. I'd dearly wished for that, hoped it was possible, been denied, and arrived at a real chance for it. It was a surreal thought, but there was no longer a reason to doubt it.
entries.literal: "...{w}Was it a flawed plan? I went over it again, and I didn't think so. I intended to change history. There was no option to check a note a future self of mine would leave behind to assure my success.{w} Saving Miiya was achievable. I'd dearly wished for that, hoped it was possible, been denied, and arrived at a real chance for it. It was a surreal thought, but there was no longer a reason to doubt it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once it was created, I would let that world continue to exist by leaving it.{w} Would it be possible to find the Shiroya I'd been with? If so, would we be able to return to our world? Assuming we could do that, there would be nothing else to wish for.
entries.literal: "Once it was created, I would let that world continue to exist by leaving it.{w} Would it be possible to find the Shiroya I'd been with? If so, would we be able to return to our world? Assuming we could do that, there would be nothing else to wish for."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But I still can't wrap my head around Miiya's existence in the tower. Does that conflict with what I'm aiming for?{w} How was she here? If I save her, I know I'll make sure none of us go to the tower. How is it possible that she was here all day?
entries.literal: "But I still can't wrap my head around Miiya's existence in the tower. Does that conflict with what I'm aiming for?{w} How was she here? If I save her, I know I'll make sure none of us go to the tower. How is it possible that she was here all day?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't understand it, but it shouldn't be an issue regardless.{w} On top of that, I can't be content with just knowing that she was in the tower. I still need to act.
entries.literal: "I don't understand it, but it shouldn't be an issue regardless.{w} On top of that, I can't be content with just knowing that she was in the tower. I still need to act."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The note I found in my pocket could've come from Miiya. Erina said that she saw her minutes before we traveled to the world where she existed...{w} That note implied only one thing: Shiroya's death. If that world was this very same one I'm in, and Miiya came from it, could that be why I haven't seen Shiroya...? Is it because she's not here at all?
entries.literal: "The note I found in my pocket could've come from Miiya. Erina said that she saw her minutes before we traveled to the world where she existed...{w} That note implied only one thing: Shiroya's death. If that world was this very same one I'm in, and Miiya came from it, could that be why I haven't seen Shiroya...? Is it because she's not here at all?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I'm able to appear on November 24th with both Sekimeiya, I'll be able to freely travel back through time just in case there's any issue I can't foresee the first time around.
entries.literal: "If I'm able to appear on November 24th with both Sekimeiya, I'll be able to freely travel back through time just in case there's any issue I can't foresee the first time around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I exhaled slowly. I was ready to act. Even though the true shape of the universe was impossible to comprehend, I knew enough to be confident in myself.
entries.literal: "I exhaled slowly. I was ready to act. Even though the true shape of the universe was impossible to comprehend, I knew enough to be confident in myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And no matter what, it would lead to a result. No matter what it was, an outcome would arise from the labyrinthine structure that had formed around me.
entries.literal: "And no matter what, it would lead to a result. No matter what it was, an outcome would arise from the labyrinthine structure that had formed around me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can do it, can't I? I can easily appear on November 24th. It has to be that day because it's proportional to January 5th.{w} I don't think anyone's still in the tower right now, so the range should only affect me.
entries.literal: "I can do it, can't I? I can easily appear on November 24th. It has to be that day because it's proportional to January 5th.{w} I don't think anyone's still in the tower right now, so the range should only affect me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The time on the screen was 62:37. I'd taken the Past Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator as I'd pressed record, so I didn't have a lot of time to waste.
entries.literal: "The time on the screen was 62:37. I'd taken the Past Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator as I'd pressed record, so I didn't have a lot of time to waste."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In the past, I won't be able to stay at my house. That means I'll need money to stay somewhere else.
entries.literal: "In the past, I won't be able to stay at my house. That means I'll need money to stay somewhere else."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...But that's not an issue. What I figured out earlier will help me here.
entries.literal: "...But that's not an issue. What I figured out earlier will help me here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In November, I could very easily obtain the money my past self has saved. However, I'd like to avoid doing that so I don't cause any issues.{w} Instead, I can just duplicate it. I can take that money, which will allow me to have it on January 5th. Then, I'll appear with it on November 24th, so it won't be necessary to obtain it from my past self.
entries.literal: "In November, I could very easily obtain the money my past self has saved. However, I'd like to avoid doing that so I don't cause any issues.{w} Instead, I can just duplicate it. I can take that money, which will allow me to have it on January 5th. Then, I'll appear with it on November 24th, so it won't be necessary to obtain it from my past self."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Of course, to have it on January 5th, I have to not spend it. There's another way to solve this—just duplicate it again.
entries.literal: "Of course, to have it on January 5th, I have to not spend it. There's another way to solve this—just duplicate it again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My body shook with anticipation, jittering all the way down to my fingertips. I was closer to leaving the tower than I had been in what felt like eons.
entries.literal: "My body shook with anticipation, jittering all the way down to my fingertips. I was closer to leaving the tower than I had been in what felt like eons."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: On January 5th, if I'm able to get the Sekimeiya, that will happen inside the tower around the morning, after the point I traveled to the past. Since it's currently the afternoon, I'll appear at close to midnight on the 25th.
entries.literal: "On January 5th, if I'm able to get the Sekimeiya, that will happen inside the tower around the morning, after the point I traveled to the past. Since it's currently the afternoon, I'll appear at close to midnight on the 25th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...That's perfect.
entries.literal: "...That's perfect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped thinking and stepped closer to the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I stopped thinking and stepped closer to the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: 64:47. The seconds were rapidly going up.
entries.literal: "64:47. The seconds were rapidly going up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: 65. Only twenty more seconds.
entries.literal: "65. Only twenty more seconds."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The aura of heat around the Sekimeiya had compounded immensely, but my senses were honed in on the timer. I barely registered the temperature.
entries.literal: "The aura of heat around the Sekimeiya had compounded immensely, but my senses were honed in on the timer. I barely registered the temperature."

entries.text: Lucid Dream
entries.literal: "Lucid Dream"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: 65:19. That was the last number my eyes saw before my sight blackened.
entries.literal: "65:19. That was the last number my eyes saw before my sight blackened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Where—
entries.literal: "...Where—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Touching the Sekimeiya brought back the darkness. However, I immediately discerned where I was: the place where I'd thought I'd appear.
entries.literal: "Touching the Sekimeiya brought back the darkness. However, I immediately discerned where I was: the place where I'd thought I'd appear."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's the lobby. Since there's no light, it must be nighttime.
entries.literal: "It's the lobby. Since there's no light, it must be nighttime."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was something on my lap, and I knew what it was. A suitcase. It was open, and both Sekimeiya were in it.
entries.literal: "There was something on my lap, and I knew what it was. A suitcase. It was open, and both Sekimeiya were in it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It worked...! The Sekimeiya are here!{w} This is everything I need to confirm this'll work!{w} I'll go back to my world, and on January 5th, I'll be able to get both Sekimeiya!
entries.literal: "It worked...! The Sekimeiya are here!{w} This is everything I need to confirm this'll work!{w} I'll go back to my world, and on January 5th, I'll be able to get both Sekimeiya!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could feel that my clothing hadn't changed. When I looked around me, I saw the sight I'd been longing for: the sky. As my vision adjusted, the multitude of stars above me took shape. The shutter, the barrier to the outside, was gone.
entries.literal: "I could feel that my clothing hadn't changed. When I looked around me, I saw the sight I'd been longing for: the sky. As my vision adjusted, the multitude of stars above me took shape. The shutter, the barrier to the outside, was gone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up, speechless, and haltingly walked over to the door.
entries.literal: "I stood up, speechless, and haltingly walked over to the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see snow on the ground, illuminated by a handful of streetlights. It was right there, behind a screen of glass.
entries.literal: "I could see snow on the ground, illuminated by a handful of streetlights. It was right there, behind a screen of glass."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I placed my hand on the handle and gently pushed.{w} The door didn't open. As I'd expected, it was locked.{w} I couldn't go to the storeroom because the hallway cameras would record me...
entries.literal: "I placed my hand on the handle and gently pushed.{w} The door didn't open. As I'd expected, it was locked.{w} I couldn't go to the storeroom because the hallway cameras would record me..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put my hand in my pocket, hoping I would feel cold metal.
entries.literal: "I put my hand in my pocket, hoping I would feel cold metal."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Yes! It's here!
entries.literal: "Yes! It's here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a keyring with a dog-shaped keychain—the one I'd found in the coat of a staff member, which I could obtain on January 5th. Since it had been in the clothes that staff member had worn when entering the tower, it was possible one of the keys unlocked the door. Appearing with it guaranteed that one would.
entries.literal: "It was a keyring with a dog-shaped keychain—the one I'd found in the coat of a staff member, which I could obtain on January 5th. Since it had been in the clothes that staff member had worn when entering the tower, it was possible one of the keys unlocked the door. Appearing with it guaranteed that one would."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There were four keys, and one was bigger than the others. Once I found the keyhole below the handle, I inserted it.
entries.literal: "There were four keys, and one was bigger than the others. Once I found the keyhole below the handle, I inserted it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When it turned, my shoulders dropped, unable to believe the truth. I could set foot outside that place.
