entries.literal: "When it turned, my shoulders dropped, unable to believe the truth. I could set foot outside that place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And when the door opened, I did so without thinking. I was no longer in the building; there was snow around me, and I was holding the Sekimeiya. Most importantly, I had a plan I could enact successfully.
entries.literal: "And when the door opened, I did so without thinking. I was no longer in the building; there was snow around me, and I was holding the Sekimeiya. Most importantly, I had a plan I could enact successfully."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A lone key was in my pocket, isolated from the set—the rusty key I'd obtained in the security room. And in my other pocket, I found money.
entries.literal: "A lone key was in my pocket, isolated from the set—the rusty key I'd obtained in the security room. And in my other pocket, I found money."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could only stand there, feeling the cold air hit my face.
entries.literal: "I could only stand there, feeling the cold air hit my face."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe I'd really been able to walk out. I'd gotten far too used to being stopped. A faint buzz hummed around me, fading into the night. I took a step forward and was assaulted by tiredness.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe I'd really been able to walk out. I'd gotten far too used to being stopped. A faint buzz hummed around me, fading into the night. I took a step forward and was assaulted by tiredness."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So this is how I'll be on January 5th... I feel exhausted.
entries.literal: "So this is how I'll be on January 5th... I feel exhausted."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And I had to go somewhere. The cold was rapidly getting to me, and a full night was still ahead.
entries.literal: "And I had to go somewhere. The cold was rapidly getting to me, and a full night was still ahead."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Where do I go? There's a motel in the center of town, but I'm not sure it'll be open.
entries.literal: "...Where do I go? There's a motel in the center of town, but I'm not sure it'll be open."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept a replica of my keys outside my house, so I could silently sneak into my parents' room and stay there without alerting my own self. That wasn't something I wanted to do if I could help it.
entries.literal: "I kept a replica of my keys outside my house, so I could silently sneak into my parents' room and stay there without alerting my own self. That wasn't something I wanted to do if I could help it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I suppose I'll have to see.
entries.literal: "I suppose I'll have to see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around and saw a large shadow covering the stars. It was the tower, looking even bigger than I recalled.
entries.literal: "I turned around and saw a large shadow covering the stars. It was the tower, looking even bigger than I recalled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With the same key I'd used to leave, I locked the front door.
entries.literal: "With the same key I'd used to leave, I locked the front door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Once I'd taken a few steps, all light was gone. Fortunately, I could navigate the streets without a problem.
entries.literal: "...Once I'd taken a few steps, all light was gone. Fortunately, I could navigate the streets without a problem."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked, unable to hear any sounds beyond my own steps. As I got closer to the center, more faint lights dotted the streets. Soon, I stepped into the widest street and approached a building I'd never been to.
entries.literal: "I walked, unable to hear any sounds beyond my own steps. As I got closer to the center, more faint lights dotted the streets. Soon, I stepped into the widest street and approached a building I'd never been to."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a sign above the door. It read "Eagle Motel".
entries.literal: "There was a sign above the door. It read \"Eagle Motel\"."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it closed? I don't see anyone.
entries.literal: "Is it closed? I don't see anyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a bell near it, so I pressed it.
entries.literal: "There was a bell near it, so I pressed it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited, wondering if the sound had reached anyone.
entries.literal: "I waited, wondering if the sound had reached anyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took me a while to discern that a tall man was approaching me. He turned on the lights and opened the door from the inside, his eyes showing that he'd been about to fall asleep.
entries.literal: "It took me a while to discern that a tall man was approaching me. He turned on the lights and opened the door from the inside, his eyes showing that he'd been about to fall asleep."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: S-Sorry. Would it be possible for me to spend the night here?
entries.literal: "S-Sorry. Would it be possible for me to spend the night here?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: ...You don't have a reservation?
entries.literal: "...You don't have a reservation?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No... Something just came up, and I have nowhere to stay.
entries.literal: "No... Something just came up, and I have nowhere to stay."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: We have spare rooms, but it's ¥8,000 a night.
entries.literal: "We have spare rooms, but it's ¥8,000 a night."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's fine. I might have to stay a few days.
entries.literal: "That's fine. I might have to stay a few days."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I suddenly looked down at myself and noticed that my clothes still had very faint traces of smoke on them, although, I thought, not identical to how they'd been before traveling.
entries.literal: "I suddenly looked down at myself and noticed that my clothes still had very faint traces of smoke on them, although, I thought, not identical to how they'd been before traveling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I paid one night's rate and was given two keys—one for the front door and another for a bedroom.
entries.literal: "I paid one night's rate and was given two keys—one for the front door and another for a bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My attention was immediately grabbed by a digital clock on the table. It was {time=22:54} on November 24th, a Thursday.
entries.literal: "My attention was immediately grabbed by a digital clock on the table. It was {time=22:54} on November 24th, a Thursday."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I can't believe it. I traveled three weeks to the past.
entries.literal: "...I can't believe it. I traveled three weeks to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Within the tower, anything had seemed possible, but with the effect reflected in the real world, my mind couldn't accept it.
entries.literal: "Within the tower, anything had seemed possible, but with the effect reflected in the real world, my mind couldn't accept it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Both Sekimeiya were in the suitcase, and the smell of the tower still hung around me.
entries.literal: "Both Sekimeiya were in the suitcase, and the smell of the tower still hung around me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The room was linked to a bathroom with a shower and a kitchen. I had a lot of things to think about, but my body dropped on the bed, giving me no chance to do so.
entries.literal: "The room was linked to a bathroom with a shower and a kitchen. I had a lot of things to think about, but my body dropped on the bed, giving me no chance to do so."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait!{w} The money... I have to duplicate it.
entries.literal: "Wait!{w} The money... I have to duplicate it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd paid for a single night, so I had to duplicate that amount and then the entire sum. I got out of bed and approached the suitcase.
entries.literal: "I'd paid for a single night, so I had to duplicate that amount and then the entire sum. I got out of bed and approached the suitcase."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They've been outside for so long, I'm sure they don't have a lot of energy. I should be able to touch one without the range reaching anyone else here.{w} I wonder which is the future one. If I touch the past one, I'll just appear in the bathroom and stay there until my past self leaves.
entries.literal: "They've been outside for so long, I'm sure they don't have a lot of energy. I should be able to touch one without the range reaching anyone else here.{w} I wonder which is the future one. If I touch the past one, I'll just appear in the bathroom and stay there until my past self leaves."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd undressed before getting in bed since the room was warm. If I replicated my past location, the money I'd been holding would duplicate.{w} I placed the suitcase on the bed and separated both gemstones. Then, I touched one of them in the center of the room.
entries.literal: "I'd undressed before getting in bed since the room was warm. If I replicated my past location, the money I'd been holding would duplicate.{w} I placed the suitcase on the bed and separated both gemstones. Then, I touched one of them in the center of the room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My vision went dark, but I could hear something. ...I wasn't alone.
entries.literal: "My vision went dark, but I could hear something. ...I wasn't alone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, is this...?
entries.literal: "Wait, is this...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My bedroom. Not the motel's, but the one in my house. When I glanced at the source of the sound, I saw my own body sleeping in my bed.
entries.literal: "My bedroom. Not the motel's, but the one in my house. When I glanced at the source of the sound, I saw my own body sleeping in my bed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What!? Why am I here...?
entries.literal: "What!? Why am I here...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I slowly stepped back, unable to take my eyes off myself. It was November; that self of mine hadn't yet reunited with Shiroya and Miiya. By the time I reached the door, I started to understand what had happened.
entries.literal: "I slowly stepped back, unable to take my eyes off myself. It was November; that self of mine hadn't yet reunited with Shiroya and Miiya. By the time I reached the door, I started to understand what had happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: My clothes changed... I went to the future.
entries.literal: "My clothes changed... I went to the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I think I traveled farther than I expected. Maybe the Sekimeiya were gathering energy inside the suitcase even though the outside was so chilly. I must have traveled more than fifteen minutes through time, so the replicated location was from a time before I appeared in the lobby, when I was about to sleep in my old world.
entries.literal: "I think I traveled farther than I expected. Maybe the Sekimeiya were gathering energy inside the suitcase even though the outside was so chilly. I must have traveled more than fifteen minutes through time, so the replicated location was from a time before I appeared in the lobby, when I was about to sleep in my old world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Trying to prevent myself from being noticed, I approached the front door. ...It seemed I had replicated my body on November 24th, and it was fortunate I'd appeared when I'd already fallen asleep.
entries.literal: "Trying to prevent myself from being noticed, I approached the front door. ...It seemed I had replicated my body on November 24th, and it was fortunate I'd appeared when I'd already fallen asleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt the handle and opened the door. The sky brimmed with stars, and my clothes were no longer protecting me from the freezing air. I had left the motel bedroom empty, so I ran there.
entries.literal: "I felt the handle and opened the door. The sky brimmed with stars, and my clothes were no longer protecting me from the freezing air. I had left the motel bedroom empty, so I ran there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I had to ring the bell to enter. To my surprise, an older woman opened the door.
entries.literal: "Once again, I had to ring the bell to enter. To my surprise, an older woman opened the door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sorry, I had to go out for a bit. Where's the man from before?
entries.literal: "Sorry, I had to go out for a bit. Where's the man from before?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Oh, old Stanley? He sticks to a strict sleep schedule. Next time, don't ring the bell, just knock. He gets mean when you wake him up. Along with you now.
entries.literal: "Oh, old Stanley? He sticks to a strict sleep schedule. Next time, don't ring the bell, just knock. He gets mean when you wake him up. Along with you now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was still on the bed. There was no doubt it was the future one, as the clock showed {time=23:29.}
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was still on the bed. There was no doubt it was the future one, as the clock showed {time=23:29.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I didn't change worlds, so the range of the other Sekimeiya didn't reach me. I hope nobody else traveled with me.
entries.literal: "...I didn't change worlds, so the range of the other Sekimeiya didn't reach me. I hope nobody else traveled with me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat on the bed and panted, each inhalation bringing lancing pain. I was even more tired than before, and it took me a second to process why. The replicated location had been from when the past me was about to go to sleep.
entries.literal: "I sat on the bed and panted, each inhalation bringing lancing pain. I was even more tired than before, and it took me a second to process why. The replicated location had been from when the past me was about to go to sleep."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I didn't actually duplicate the money.
entries.literal: "...I didn't actually duplicate the money."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My old clothes were beside the bed, but I had to reset the Sekimeiya before attempting it again.{w} I sat up and walked to the kitchen.
entries.literal: "My old clothes were beside the bed, but I had to reset the Sekimeiya before attempting it again.{w} I sat up and walked to the kitchen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, there's a refrigerator here.
entries.literal: "Oh, there's a refrigerator here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was running, so I knew it would work to cool off the Sekimeiya. After putting both of them inside, I grabbed the money from the pocket of my other pants.
entries.literal: "It was running, so I knew it would work to cool off the Sekimeiya. After putting both of them inside, I grabbed the money from the pocket of my other pants."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took the Future Sekimeiya back out and waited a few seconds. Subsequently, I left the money on the floor and felt the surface of the gemstone.
entries.literal: "I took the Future Sekimeiya back out and waited a few seconds. Subsequently, I left the money on the floor and felt the surface of the gemstone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My sight hardly changed, but I knew I'd teleported. I was holding the stack of money, and the original bills were on the floor. I could use them while I kept the duplicated ones until January 5th.
entries.literal: "My sight hardly changed, but I knew I'd teleported. I was holding the stack of money, and the original bills were on the floor. I could use them while I kept the duplicated ones until January 5th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I have to duplicate a night's worth too since I already paid for it.
entries.literal: "I have to duplicate a night's worth too since I already paid for it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Future Sekimeiya was still powered off. I reset it to repeat the process, and once I'd duplicated the full amount of money, I left both Sekimeiya in the refrigerator again.
entries.literal: "The Future Sekimeiya was still powered off. I reset it to repeat the process, and once I'd duplicated the full amount of money, I left both Sekimeiya in the refrigerator again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I fell to the bed. I didn't bother taking off my clothes the second time since they were a lot lighter than before.
entries.literal: "I fell to the bed. I didn't bother taking off my clothes the second time since they were a lot lighter than before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I knew it, I could see the sun through the window.
entries.literal: "Before I knew it, I could see the sun through the window."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the clock, trying to remember where I was.{w} {time=10:09}, November 25th. It all came back to me when I saw those blurry numbers.
entries.literal: "I looked at the clock, trying to remember where I was.{w} {time=10:09}, November 25th. It all came back to me when I saw those blurry numbers."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I quickly got out of bed and checked the Sekimeiya in the refrigerator.
entries.literal: "I quickly got out of bed and checked the Sekimeiya in the refrigerator."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It doesn't seem like the Sekimeiya heat up inside, so they're fine here.
entries.literal: "It doesn't seem like the Sekimeiya heat up inside, so they're fine here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: November 25th. On this day... I hadn't even received Miiya's call yet. Right now, I was at home all alone.
entries.literal: "November 25th. On this day... I hadn't even received Miiya's call yet. Right now, I was at home all alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a little dizzy, so I put on my original clothes and walked out of the room to a cafeteria I'd seen downstairs.
entries.literal: "I felt a little dizzy, so I put on my original clothes and walked out of the room to a cafeteria I'd seen downstairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Fortunately, I had enough money to cover all the days I needed.{w} Once I felt rested, I went back up.
entries.literal: "Fortunately, I had enough money to cover all the days I needed.{w} Once I felt rested, I went back up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sat on the bed and went over what I would do.
entries.literal: "I sat on the bed and went over what I would do."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I'm in the past of the world where Miiya was alive. If I don't change the past, will she not die? ...Or was she in the tower for another reason?
entries.literal: "...I'm in the past of the world where Miiya was alive. If I don't change the past, will she not die? ...Or was she in the tower for another reason?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I have the Sekimeiya, so maybe I should see what happens on the 30th and then go to the past. I can't risk the plan getting ruined due to a difference in the events that I'm not aware of.
entries.literal: "I have the Sekimeiya, so maybe I should see what happens on the 30th and then go to the past. I can't risk the plan getting ruined due to a difference in the events that I'm not aware of."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If what happened on the 30th repeats, why would Miiya have been in the tower? ...Is there an explanation for that?
entries.literal: "If what happened on the 30th repeats, why would Miiya have been in the tower? ...Is there an explanation for that?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The concept of different worlds I have is rough, but I was thinking of something...
entries.literal: "The concept of different worlds I have is rough, but I was thinking of something..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I save Miiya, my plan was to go back to my initial world. I can't stay in this one. That would allow this world to exist, at the very least...
entries.literal: "If I save Miiya, my plan was to go back to my initial world. I can't stay in this one. That would allow this world to exist, at the very least..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But after saving her, I could travel to the other world with Miiya, which would result in the same effect. The other world would end up with her, while this one wouldn't.
entries.literal: "But after saving her, I could travel to the other world with Miiya, which would result in the same effect. The other world would end up with her, while this one wouldn't."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't bring myself to do that. ...I had already accepted Miiya's death once.{w} Even if I was able to bring her to our world, would that truly be better? I would just create avoidable pain in another.
entries.literal: "I couldn't bring myself to do that. ...I had already accepted Miiya's death once.{w} Even if I was able to bring her to our world, would that truly be better? I would just create avoidable pain in another."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But I believe it's possible the Miiya in the tower came from a different world—from one in which she didn't die. That would explain why she was there with no influence of mine.
entries.literal: "But I believe it's possible the Miiya in the tower came from a different world—from one in which she didn't die. That would explain why she was there with no influence of mine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything regarding other worlds was too hypothetical. I had to stick to what I'd planned.
entries.literal: "Everything regarding other worlds was too hypothetical. I had to stick to what I'd planned."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I'll make sure she doesn't die. I'll make this world into the one we wanted. In the end, I'll have to abandon it, but at least I'll know it exists.
entries.literal: "...I'll make sure she doesn't die. I'll make this world into the one we wanted. In the end, I'll have to abandon it, but at least I'll know it exists."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After November 30th, I'll go back in time and prevent her death. After that, I'll change worlds, hopefully arriving in the one I was in.
entries.literal: "After November 30th, I'll go back in time and prevent her death. After that, I'll change worlds, hopefully arriving in the one I was in."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If that works, I won't want to change the past any further. My goal will be to find the real Shiroya, who I'm sure will be there at one point. Maybe when she disappeared with Naomi, or maybe when she was in the tower with different clothes. Once I make it there, we can leave together.
entries.literal: "If that works, I won't want to change the past any further. My goal will be to find the real Shiroya, who I'm sure will be there at one point. Maybe when she disappeared with Naomi, or maybe when she was in the tower with different clothes. Once I make it there, we can leave together."

entries.text: That will work.
entries.literal: "That will work."

entries.text: That will not work.
entries.literal: "That will not work."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...It would work. Atsuki was sure of it.
entries.literal: "...It would work. Atsuki was sure of it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had to dispel his doubts and be confident he would succeed. There were five days until the 30th, but there was nothing he could do until then.
entries.literal: "He had to dispel his doubts and be confident he would succeed. There were five days until the 30th, but there was nothing he could do until then."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't leave the motel. It had all the food he needed and a bedroom to sleep in.
entries.literal: "He didn't leave the motel. It had all the food he needed and a bedroom to sleep in."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While the final day approached, he made sure the Sekimeiya worked. He traveled a few minutes through time and confirmed that all he'd learned still applied.
entries.literal: "While the final day approached, he made sure the Sekimeiya worked. He traveled a few minutes through time and confirmed that all he'd learned still applied."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: November 30th came. Atsuki was still in that room, although it would soon be his time to act.
entries.literal: "November 30th came. Atsuki was still in that room, although it would soon be his time to act."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't take his eyes off the clock. At {time=21}, he could hardly breathe, remembering what had once happened.
entries.literal: "He didn't take his eyes off the clock. At {time=21}, he could hardly breathe, remembering what had once happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...It must've already occurred by that point. Miiya was likely dead.
entries.literal: "...It must've already occurred by that point. Miiya was likely dead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He hated that it had been allowed to repeat, but otherwise his plan could've been hindered. Even though the time had passed, he couldn't go to the shop for fear of being recognized.
entries.literal: "He hated that it had been allowed to repeat, but otherwise his plan could've been hindered. Even though the time had passed, he couldn't go to the shop for fear of being recognized."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...He had to wait until the morning news to know if everything had repeated as he'd once experienced it.
entries.literal: "...He had to wait until the morning news to know if everything had repeated as he'd once experienced it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He stared at the ceiling all night. The moment the sun rose, he went to the cafeteria and turned on the television.
entries.literal: "He stared at the ceiling all night. The moment the sun rose, he went to the cafeteria and turned on the television."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: His eyes bored holes into the screen, waiting for the news to begin. Once it did, a mass of headlines were shown at once.
entries.literal: "His eyes bored holes into the screen, waiting for the news to begin. Once it did, a mass of headlines were shown at once."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...{w}He didn't see it. None of them had been about a gas explosion in Yushibana.
entries.literal: "...{w}He didn't see it. None of them had been about a gas explosion in Yushibana."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It couldn't be. There was no way that wouldn't have made the local news.
entries.literal: "It couldn't be. There was no way that wouldn't have made the local news."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He kept changing the channel, but there was no mention of what should have happened the previous night.
entries.literal: "He kept changing the channel, but there was no mention of what should have happened the previous night."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Had he made a mistake? When that thought occurred to him, he dashed out of the motel.
entries.literal: "Had he made a mistake? When that thought occurred to him, he dashed out of the motel."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He ran toward the stone buildings as fast as the snow allowed him.
entries.literal: "He ran toward the stone buildings as fast as the snow allowed him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When he reached the street, he was able to see it in the distance: there was light in Musashi Gemstones.{w} He didn't stop running. He burst through the door and gaped at the owner in disbelief.
entries.literal: "When he reached the street, he was able to see it in the distance: there was light in Musashi Gemstones.{w} He didn't stop running. He burst through the door and gaped at the owner in disbelief."

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Oh, you're back! What's with the rush?
entries.literal: "Oh, you're back! What's with the rush?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Wh-What?
entries.literal: "Wh-What?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He looked at the far side of the shop. The floor was intact.
entries.literal: "He looked at the far side of the shop. The floor was intact."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: D-Did anything happen yesterday?
entries.literal: "D-Did anything happen yesterday?"

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: Hm? What do you mean?
entries.literal: "Hm? What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: N-No?
entries.literal: "N-No?"

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: I don't know what you mean. What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "I don't know what you mean. What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After seeing the undamaged shelves, there was a question Atsuki had to ask.
entries.literal: "After seeing the undamaged shelves, there was a question Atsuki had to ask."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: What about th-the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "What about th-the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: gan
entries.text: The Seki... How do you know about that name!? I was planning to use it in the future!
entries.literal: "The Seki... How do you know about that name!? I was planning to use it in the future!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki bolted out of the shop, ignoring the owner's shouts. He ran to a nearby bus station, where he'd met Shiroya and Miiya on that final day.
entries.literal: "Atsuki bolted out of the shop, ignoring the owner's shouts. He ran to a nearby bus station, where he'd met Shiroya and Miiya on that final day."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was nothing there. Atsuki recalled having seen a flyer with the words "The Sekimeiya" stuck on the post.
entries.literal: "There was nothing there. Atsuki recalled having seen a flyer with the words \"The Sekimeiya\" stuck on the post."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Next, he ran to his own house.
entries.literal: "Next, he ran to his own house."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Th-There's light in the windows... I'm not in the hospital.
entries.literal: "Th-There's light in the windows... I'm not in the hospital."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He couldn't believe it. The explosion hadn't happened.
entries.literal: "He couldn't believe it. The explosion hadn't happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why? And what next? He had no idea what to do, so he stood paralyzed.
entries.literal: "Why? And what next? He had no idea what to do, so he stood paralyzed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, that was what he'd wanted. He hadn't done anything, but the result had been the same.
entries.literal: "However, that was what he'd wanted. He hadn't done anything, but the result had been the same."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Speechless, he waited in front of his house.
entries.literal: "Speechless, he waited in front of his house."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Light snow began to fall, but he kept watching his window. He could see a figure behind it, similar to his own.
entries.literal: "Light snow began to fall, but he kept watching his window. He could see a figure behind it, similar to his own."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He realized he'd been there for hours when his front door opened. ...It really was his own self, with an expression he'd personally long since abandoned.
entries.literal: "He realized he'd been there for hours when his front door opened. ...It really was his own self, with an expression he'd personally long since abandoned."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He didn't hide, but it didn't seem like he'd been seen. He saw his own body walking ahead, so he followed him.
entries.literal: "He didn't hide, but it didn't seem like he'd been seen. He saw his own body walking ahead, so he followed him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Eventually, they reached Seeuta D'ella Park. Miiya and Shiroya were there, waving at him.
entries.literal: "Eventually, they reached Seeuta D'ella Park. Miiya and Shiroya were there, waving at him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was what he'd most wanted. Those days were continuing beyond November 30th.
entries.literal: "It was what he'd most wanted. Those days were continuing beyond November 30th."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But there was something more pressing within Atsuki's mind.
entries.literal: "But there was something more pressing within Atsuki's mind."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It didn't make sense. It was a world... that didn't make sense.
entries.literal: "It didn't make sense. It was a world... that didn't make sense."

entries.text: Ending: Impossible Perfection
entries.literal: "Ending: Impossible Perfection"

entries.text: Lucid Dream
entries.literal: "Lucid Dream"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Will this work...?
entries.literal: "Will this work...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The most delicate part is altering the story of this world. When I changed the past, it was clear the result wasn't straightforward.
entries.literal: "The most delicate part is altering the story of this world. When I changed the past, it was clear the result wasn't straightforward."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It almost created a mesh of realities. Some people kept their memo—
entries.literal: "It almost created a mesh of realities. Some people kept their memo—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sudden realization shattered all my thoughts.
entries.literal: "The sudden realization shattered all my thoughts."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No... What am I thinking?{w} ...I didn't change the past at all.
entries.literal: "No... What am I thinking?{w} ...I didn't change the past at all."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I decided I'd try to change the past after I suffered that strange injury in the elevator... I used the Sekimeiya to travel more than half an hour to the past.
entries.literal: "I decided I'd try to change the past after I suffered that strange injury in the elevator... I used the Sekimeiya to travel more than half an hour to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I began to walk toward the event room to check the time, but voices stopped me."
entries.literal: "\"I began to walk toward the event room to check the time, but voices stopped me.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I got close to the door and focused my hearing."
entries.literal: "\"I got close to the door and focused my hearing.\""

entries.speaker: aki4
entries.text: ...just suddenly ran aw— ...honestly wasn't sure.
entries.literal: "...just suddenly ran aw— ...honestly wasn't sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I recognized the conversation. I'd arrived approximately a couple minutes before the point only Sai had traveled."
entries.literal: "\"I recognized the conversation. I'd arrived approximately a couple minutes before the point only Sai had traveled.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was a couple minutes before Sai disappeared in front of us us. That is to say, a couple minutes before we changed worlds.
entries.literal: "It was a couple minutes before Sai disappeared in front of us us. That is to say, a couple minutes before we changed worlds."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: To change the past, I produced a sound in hallway A. ...A sound we never heard.
entries.literal: "To change the past, I produced a sound in hallway A. ...A sound we never heard."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When I slammed the door, I thought I'd changed the past because we hadn't heard that sound in the event room. But... the reason we didn't hear it was because we'd gone to a different world.
entries.literal: "When I slammed the door, I thought I'd changed the past because we hadn't heard that sound in the event room. But... the reason we didn't hear it was because we'd gone to a different world."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And in that world, I ended up taking the elevator up to follow Shiroya.{w} That had to be when we came back. For some reason, we went back to our world.{w} That's what that injury signified—the elevator stopped abruptly because it wasn't moving in our world, and I cut myself with the handrail as my body overlapped with it.
entries.literal: "And in that world, I ended up taking the elevator up to follow Shiroya.{w} That had to be when we came back. For some reason, we went back to our world.{w} That's what that injury signified—the elevator stopped abruptly because it wasn't moving in our world, and I cut myself with the handrail as my body overlapped with it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "It couldn't have been going too fast, but as it ceased all movement, it propelled us upward, and we slammed to the floor."
entries.literal: "\"It couldn't have been going too fast, but as it ceased all movement, it propelled us upward, and we slammed to the floor.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I felt my right hand burning. I looked at it and saw a cut."
entries.literal: "\"I felt my right hand burning. I looked at it and saw a cut.\""

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: What!? You're bleeding!
entries.literal: "What!? You're bleeding!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I could only process the intense pain coming from the wound. While I couldn't comprehend how it had happened, I understood that I had cut my hand with the handrail when our bodies lifted, as it had been right above me."
entries.literal: "\"I could only process the intense pain coming from the wound. While I couldn't comprehend how it had happened, I understood that I had cut my hand with the handrail when our bodies lifted, as it had been right above me.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And that was the exact world we'd been in before: the Past Sekimeiya was back in the staff room, where I'd hidden it. It didn't teleport back there.{w} Akaro was gone, and Sai was once again the person we'd been with in the event room. Also, the blood I would leave on the staircase was surely already there.
entries.literal: "And that was the exact world we'd been in before: the Past Sekimeiya was back in the staff room, where I'd hidden it. It didn't teleport back there.{w} Akaro was gone, and Sai was once again the person we'd been with in the event room. Also, the blood I would leave on the staircase was surely already there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "The doors opened, so I dashed out of the elevator as fast as I could, forcing my eyes shut to suppress the pain."
entries.literal: "\"The doors opened, so I dashed out of the elevator as fast as I could, forcing my eyes shut to suppress the pain.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}So, when I went back in time and produced that "new" sound... I didn't actually change anything. When I slammed the door, the event room was already empty.{w} And then, despite the difference I would've caused, Erina and I still got out of the elevator on the third floor.
entries.literal: "...{w}So, when I went back in time and produced that \"new\" sound... I didn't actually change anything. When I slammed the door, the event room was already empty.{w} And then, despite the difference I would've caused, Erina and I still got out of the elevator on the third floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I thought I had created an incomprehensible mess of memories, but now I understand. It seemed like only Sai remembered the effect of my change because he was the only person there when I slammed the door. ...For him, the blood in the hallways was always there, whereas for Erina and me, it wasn't before we took the elevator.
entries.literal: "I thought I had created an incomprehensible mess of memories, but now I understand. It seemed like only Sai remembered the effect of my change because he was the only person there when I slammed the door. ...For him, the blood in the hallways was always there, whereas for Erina and me, it wasn't before we took the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I looked next to us, and as I thought, the other trail of blood was coming from the elevator. It was from the time I'd gone down after suffering the injury; the floor was proof of both realities at once."
entries.literal: "\"I looked next to us, and as I thought, the other trail of blood was coming from the elevator. It was from the time I'd gone down after suffering the injury; the floor was proof of both realities at once.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell? This means that I still have no idea if the past can be changed!
entries.literal: "What the hell? This means that I still have no idea if the past can be changed!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No... there's no way, is there? All that must mean is that it's not possible. It wasn't changed a single time. When I produced the Sekimeiya's travel formula, I made use of hypothetical worlds all different from each other, but the real one never changed...
entries.literal: "No... there's no way, is there? All that must mean is that it's not possible. It wasn't changed a single time. When I produced the Sekimeiya's travel formula, I made use of hypothetical worlds all different from each other, but the real one never changed..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I was out of my mind when I tried it with the storeroom door. I could travel to the past and close a door I've seen open, but if the past can't be changed, the explanation for that could be that I'd die of a sudden heart attack or something like that!
entries.literal: "I was out of my mind when I tried it with the storeroom door. I could travel to the past and close a door I've seen open, but if the past can't be changed, the explanation for that could be that I'd die of a sudden heart attack or something like that!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no other way to know but to try it, though. ...And doing so is incredibly risky.
entries.literal: "There's no other way to know but to try it, though. ...And doing so is incredibly risky."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now what!? Technically, I could never die after traveling to the past, or else there'd be no future location to replicate.{w} Would I die by touching the Sekimeiya, then? There's no way to verify any of this...!
entries.literal: "Now what!? Technically, I could never die after traveling to the past, or else there'd be no future location to replicate.{w} Would I die by touching the Sekimeiya, then? There's no way to verify any of this...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was suddenly stuck, with no way to know whether what I wanted to accomplish was achievable. At the very least, my past travels seemed to confirm that I'd be alive on January 5th and January 26th.
entries.literal: "I was suddenly stuck, with no way to know whether what I wanted to accomplish was achievable. At the very least, my past travels seemed to confirm that I'd be alive on January 5th and January 26th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is there a way to increase or decrease the chance that it's possible to change the past? Outright confirming it seems like it's off the table.
entries.literal: "Is there a way to increase or decrease the chance that it's possible to change the past? Outright confirming it seems like it's off the table."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the kitchen, where I had both Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I went to the kitchen, where I had both Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed them and determined which one was the past one.
entries.literal: "I grabbed them and determined which one was the past one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What can I really do to check this?
entries.literal: "...What can I really do to check this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a salt shaker next to the stove.
entries.literal: "There was a salt shaker next to the stove."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I think this is all I can do.
entries.literal: "...I think this is all I can do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left it on the floor of the bedroom. Then, I stepped back to the kitchen and closed the door.
entries.literal: "I left it on the floor of the bedroom. Then, I stepped back to the kitchen and closed the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited a few minutes, thinking about what I would do. Once I was certain, I took out the Past Sekimeiya and looked at the bedroom.
entries.literal: "I waited a few minutes, thinking about what I would do. Once I was certain, I took out the Past Sekimeiya and looked at the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The salt shaker was no longer on the floor. It was on the rightmost nightstand, next to a bunch of salt scattered around.
entries.literal: "The salt shaker was no longer on the floor. It was on the rightmost nightstand, next to a bunch of salt scattered around."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at it intensely; I'd known it was going to be there.
entries.literal: "I looked at it intensely; I'd known it was going to be there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I waited a bit before I touched the Sekimeiya in the kitchen. When I did, I went a few minutes back in time.
entries.literal: "Then, I waited a bit before I touched the Sekimeiya in the kitchen. When I did, I went a few minutes back in time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I appeared in the bathroom.{w} Silently, I glanced at the bedroom.
entries.literal: "I appeared in the bathroom.{w} Silently, I glanced at the bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The salt shaker was on the floor, next to the closed door. I picked it up and slowly brought it to the nightstand.
entries.literal: "The salt shaker was on the floor, next to the closed door. I picked it up and slowly brought it to the nightstand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...There was no salt on it. Its wooden surface was perfectly clean.
entries.literal: "...There was no salt on it. Its wooden surface was perfectly clean."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So far, I've experienced both what occurs when you travel to the past with no intentions to change it and when you travel to the past with intentions to specifically not change it. What I don't know is what happens when you travel to the past wanting to change it—when all your actions have that intent.
entries.literal: "So far, I've experienced both what occurs when you travel to the past with no intentions to change it and when you travel to the past with intentions to specifically not change it. What I don't know is what happens when you travel to the past wanting to change it—when all your actions have that intent."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...This might be a safe way to finally know.
entries.literal: "...This might be a safe way to finally know."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I gripped the salt shaker and held it over the nightstand.
entries.literal: "I gripped the salt shaker and held it over the nightstand."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I shake my hand, a bunch of salt will fall out. I've already seen a pattern of the scattered salt. However, my intention is not to repeat it. I want the past to change—I wish for that pattern to differ.
entries.literal: "If I shake my hand, a bunch of salt will fall out. I've already seen a pattern of the scattered salt. However, my intention is not to repeat it. I want the past to change—I wish for that pattern to differ."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Abruptly, I shook my hand, releasing countless bits of salt.
entries.literal: "Abruptly, I shook my hand, releasing countless bits of salt."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What would happen was not my call. I wanted the past to change, so if that was possible, I hoped the pattern would be different. If it wasn't possible, although I wouldn't do it on purpose, the pattern would be the same one I'd seen. The decision of whether the past would change was not mine; the universe would let me know instead. When my hand stopped still, I stared down.
entries.literal: "What would happen was not my call. I wanted the past to change, so if that was possible, I hoped the pattern would be different. If it wasn't possible, although I wouldn't do it on purpose, the pattern would be the same one I'd seen. The decision of whether the past would change was not mine; the universe would let me know instead. When my hand stopped still, I stared down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was identical. Every last bit of salt had ended up exactly where I'd seen it despite my wishes to change history.
entries.literal: "...It was identical. Every last bit of salt had ended up exactly where I'd seen it despite my wishes to change history."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I... see.
entries.literal: "I... see."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could blow on it; I could make it change. However, that's impossible. Anyone who would blow on it wouldn't have made it here in the first place.
entries.literal: "I could blow on it; I could make it change. However, that's impossible. Anyone who would blow on it wouldn't have made it here in the first place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With my head down, I walked back to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "With my head down, I walked back to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, my past self came out of the kitchen. He saw the salt pattern and went back in time.
entries.literal: "Soon, my past self came out of the kitchen. He saw the salt pattern and went back in time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It's funny. I thought I would appear in the bedroom instead, but I appeared in the bathroom.
entries.literal: "...It's funny. I thought I would appear in the bedroom instead, but I appeared in the bathroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Because I had no urge to leave. I had no idea what to do after that.
entries.literal: "...Because I had no urge to leave. I had no idea what to do after that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, I had to go eat something. When I got back, I sat on the bed, unable to clear my mind.
entries.literal: "Eventually, I had to go eat something. When I got back, I sat on the bed, unable to clear my mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And when I went to sleep, I was just as lost. The past couldn't be changed, so there was no point to anything.
entries.literal: "...And when I went to sleep, I was just as lost. The past couldn't be changed, so there was no point to anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got up wearing the same clothes. With a persistent feeling of impotence, I went down to the cafeteria.
entries.literal: "I got up wearing the same clothes. With a persistent feeling of impotence, I went down to the cafeteria."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After everything I'd been through, saving Miiya was still impossible. However, I had seen her in the tower. That was the wild card, and it was what confused me the most.
entries.literal: "After everything I'd been through, saving Miiya was still impossible. However, I had seen her in the tower. That was the wild card, and it was what confused me the most."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had she really come from another world? ...Had her existence been another mere illusion? I did all I could to refuse that.
entries.literal: "Had she really come from another world? ...Had her existence been another mere illusion? I did all I could to refuse that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If there was something I was sure of, it was that it wasn't up to me. It was evident the universe itself was what decided the outcome of everything.
entries.literal: "If there was something I was sure of, it was that it wasn't up to me. It was evident the universe itself was what decided the outcome of everything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A large part of my plan had been ripped to shreds, but the last bit was still in my mind. I could reunite with Shiroya. We could go back to our world and leave together.
entries.literal: "A large part of my plan had been ripped to shreds, but the last bit was still in my mind. I could reunite with Shiroya. We could go back to our world and leave together."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For that, I could change worlds at that very moment, but I knew everything would repeat. So in the world I was in, on December 15th, Miiya would be in the tower. ...I had to see that with my very own eyes.
entries.literal: "For that, I could change worlds at that very moment, but I knew everything would repeat. So in the world I was in, on December 15th, Miiya would be in the tower. ...I had to see that with my very own eyes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: {time=12:43.} November 28th...
entries.literal: "{time=12:43.} November 28th..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't left the motel once. I mustered the will to get up and lethargically exited the room.
entries.literal: "I hadn't left the motel once. I mustered the will to get up and lethargically exited the room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It'll happen in two days. Am I really not going to do anything just because I've convinced myself that there's no point?
entries.literal: "It'll happen in two days. Am I really not going to do anything just because I've convinced myself that there's no point?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't just that. I knew there was no point, and I didn't want to live through it again.
entries.literal: "It wasn't just that. I knew there was no point, and I didn't want to live through it again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I came back up, all I could do was fall on the bed again.
entries.literal: "When I came back up, all I could do was fall on the bed again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I shouldn't change worlds now. I have to wait here...
entries.literal: "I shouldn't change worlds now. I have to wait here..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But there are many days left until the 15th. It's November 28th, so the Sekimeiya were found just yesterda—
entries.literal: "But there are many days left until the 15th. It's November 28th, so the Sekimeiya were found just yesterda—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait.{w} This is wrong...{w} That can't be the case...!
entries.literal: "Wait.{w} This is wrong...{w} That can't be the case...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I ran to the kitchen, but I stopped myself before I opened the refrigerator.
entries.literal: "I ran to the kitchen, but I stopped myself before I opened the refrigerator."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No, I shouldn't open it. I have to think this through first.
entries.literal: "No, I shouldn't open it. I have to think this through first."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I entirely failed to consider this! Katei told us the Sekimeiya were found on November 27th...
entries.literal: "I entirely failed to consider this! Katei told us the Sekimeiya were found on November 27th..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's impossible, though! I have them right here!
entries.literal: "That's impossible, though! I have them right here!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In the attic, when I made a Sekimeiya travel with me, I couldn't duplicate it—the original one disappeared as soon as I appeared. Only one version of each can exist!
entries.literal: "In the attic, when I made a Sekimeiya travel with me, I couldn't duplicate it—the original one disappeared as soon as I appeared. Only one version of each can exist!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, when I appeared with them on the 24th, the ones on the mountain must've disappeared. It's already the 28th, and there's no way they were found yesterday!
entries.literal: "So, when I appeared with them on the 24th, the ones on the mountain must've disappeared. It's already the 28th, and there's no way they were found yesterday!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the shut door. The Sekimeiya had to be inside, but the past couldn't be changed. I couldn't witness its interior before thinking, as I hadn't actually seen the Sekimeiya since three days prior.
entries.literal: "I stared at the shut door. The Sekimeiya had to be inside, but the past couldn't be changed. I couldn't witness its interior before thinking, as I hadn't actually seen the Sekimeiya since three days prior."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I opened the door and either saw them there or didn't see them there, it would be a fact locked in place. Not knowing for sure whether they were there or not was far smarter.
entries.literal: "If I opened the door and either saw them there or didn't see them there, it would be a fact locked in place. Not knowing for sure whether they were there or not was far smarter."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It doesn't make any sense. I know the incident will occur on the 15th, so the Sekimeiya had to have been found.
entries.literal: "It doesn't make any sense. I know the incident will occur on the 15th, so the Sekimeiya had to have been found."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The event was announced tomorrow, on the 29th. That can't happen if the Sekimeiya aren't found on the 27th.
entries.literal: "The event was announced tomorrow, on the 29th. That can't happen if the Sekimeiya aren't found on the 27th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, it would happen. It had to, or else everything would've been entirely different on the 15th.
entries.literal: "However, it would happen. It had to, or else everything would've been entirely different on the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The tower had to be shut on the 15th, and I had to be there. ...That was how I could find Miiya and the real Shiroya.
entries.literal: "The tower had to be shut on the 15th, and I had to be there. ...That was how I could find Miiya and the real Shiroya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I had the Sekimeiya. If that had removed the ones on the mountain, the butterfly effect would surely be immense.{w} That was why I had to consider a certain question and why I hadn't opened the refrigerator. ...Was there a way for the Sekimeiya to have been found the day before?
entries.literal: "But I had the Sekimeiya. If that had removed the ones on the mountain, the butterfly effect would surely be immense.{w} That was why I had to consider a certain question and why I hadn't opened the refrigerator. ...Was there a way for the Sekimeiya to have been found the day before?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is there any chance? If they were found, they can't be here anymore. Similarly, if they're here, they couldn't have been found.{w} Is it impossible...? That can't be...
entries.literal: "...Is there any chance? If they were found, they can't be here anymore. Similarly, if they're here, they couldn't have been found.{w} Is it impossible...? That can't be..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was one important fact: I knew where the Sekimeiya had been found. Katei had described an area that matched with a place I knew very well.
entries.literal: "There was one important fact: I knew where the Sekimeiya had been found. Katei had described an area that matched with a place I knew very well."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If they're here right now... I could travel to the past and appear with them again as long as I know I'll have them in the future. Then, I could leave them on the mountain before the 27th.
entries.literal: "If they're here right now... I could travel to the past and appear with them again as long as I know I'll have them in the future. Then, I could leave them on the mountain before the 27th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That doesn't work, though! The past would be changing. If I ever appear with them in the past, the ones in here would disappear, and I wouldn't be able to travel in the first place.
entries.literal: "That doesn't work, though! The past would be changing. If I ever appear with them in the past, the ones in here would disappear, and I wouldn't be able to travel in the first place."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's... not possible. They couldn't have been found yesterday!{w} But the past can't change, can it? Does that mean they're not in the refrigerator anymore? If I never open it, should I assume that they made it to the mountain somehow?
entries.literal: "It's... not possible. They couldn't have been found yesterday!{w} But the past can't change, can it? Does that mean they're not in the refrigerator anymore? If I never open it, should I assume that they made it to the mountain somehow?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if... someone traveled to the past after I did, holding the Sekimeiya? That's a way they could've disappeared from here.
entries.literal: "What if... someone traveled to the past after I did, holding the Sekimeiya? That's a way they could've disappeared from here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was something like that what I had to assume? How the hell had the Sekimeiya even ended up on that mountain...? And why had they even gotten to Ashiya Tower given their powers?
entries.literal: "Was something like that what I had to assume? How the hell had the Sekimeiya even ended up on that mountain...? And why had they even gotten to Ashiya Tower given their powers?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled precisely what Katei had told us.
entries.literal: "I recalled precisely what Katei had told us."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Eventually, up that mountain is a small field that's pretty well-hidden. It's not easy to spot, and you have to deviate onto a smaller path. All I was told was that it's fairly tucked away.
entries.literal: "Eventually, up that mountain is a small field that's pretty well-hidden. It's not easy to spot, and you have to deviate onto a smaller path. All I was told was that it's fairly tucked away."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's where this was found.
entries.literal: "That's where this was found."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What he pointed at was the third Sekimeiya. The one that didn't work...
entries.literal: "What he pointed at was the third Sekimeiya. The one that didn't work..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where the hell did that one come from? There were three Sekimeiya since that morning.
entries.literal: "Where the hell did that one come from? There were three Sekimeiya since that morning."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What really happened on the 27th? Were those three Sekimeiya found? And was that really the same place Shiroya and I used to go to?
entries.literal: "What really happened on the 27th? Were those three Sekimeiya found? And was that really the same place Shiroya and I used to go to?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It can't be that only the third Sekimeiya was found. When Katei told us that story, he was definitely talking about all the Sekimeiya; they were all found by the same person. However, Katei never mentioned any other Sekimeiya existing that entire day. ...And I'm sure that he and Naomi knew about it.
entries.literal: "...It can't be that only the third Sekimeiya was found. When Katei told us that story, he was definitely talking about all the Sekimeiya; they were all found by the same person. However, Katei never mentioned any other Sekimeiya existing that entire day. ...And I'm sure that he and Naomi knew about it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, technically, I might have a way to make Katei's words into reality—that a Sekimeiya was found on the 27th. I only have to assume that he avoided saying when the others were.
entries.literal: "So, technically, I might have a way to make Katei's words into reality—that a Sekimeiya was found on the 27th. I only have to assume that he avoided saying when the others were."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If the first one was found on the 27th, this makes sense.
entries.literal: "If the first one was found on the 27th, this makes sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was another assumption I had to make: that I was no longer in possession of the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "There was another assumption I had to make: that I was no longer in possession of the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, when the loop I had to make was in my head, I was ready to open the door.
entries.literal: "Finally, when the loop I had to make was in my head, I was ready to open the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...A single Sekimeiya was there.
entries.literal: "...A single Sekimeiya was there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's the Past Sekimeiya. This is all I can do to fix my mistake.
entries.literal: "It's the Past Sekimeiya. This is all I can do to fix my mistake."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took it out as I glanced at the clock.
entries.literal: "I took it out as I glanced at the clock."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could still go to the past. I could make it back to the 27th.
entries.literal: "I could still go to the past. I could make it back to the 27th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once there, I had to take the Future Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator and bring it to the mountain so that it'd be found on that day.
entries.literal: "Once there, I had to take the Future Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator and bring it to the mountain so that it'd be found on that day."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, after the point I travel, the Past Sekimeiya will have to be left there too. It'll be found after the 27th, but that doesn't contradict anything that we were told.
entries.literal: "Then, after the point I travel, the Past Sekimeiya will have to be left there too. It'll be found after the 27th, but that doesn't contradict anything that we were told."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The temperature in the motel wasn't the same as the tower's, so the amount of time I had to store was different.
entries.literal: "The temperature in the motel wasn't the same as the tower's, so the amount of time I had to store was different."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Fortunately, the formula was the same, so after I noted down how far I traveled after storing two minutes, I knew how long I had to wait to make it a day back.
entries.literal: "Fortunately, the formula was the same, so after I noted down how far I traveled after storing two minutes, I knew how long I had to wait to make it a day back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a little over half an hour, but I couldn't touch it there due to the large range that would form.
entries.literal: "It was a little over half an hour, but I couldn't touch it there due to the large range that would form."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I'm certain it still gathers energy outside if it's in the suitcase, because when I touched the Sekimeiya after arriving here, I traveled a lot farther into the future than expected.
entries.literal: "...I'm certain it still gathers energy outside if it's in the suitcase, because when I touched the Sekimeiya after arriving here, I traveled a lot farther into the future than expected."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put the Sekimeiya and the clock inside the suitcase before walking down the stairs with the motel keys.
entries.literal: "I put the Sekimeiya and the clock inside the suitcase before walking down the stairs with the motel keys."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Below, I stepped out of the motel for the first time and walked toward one of the tallest mountains I could see past the buildings.
entries.literal: "Below, I stepped out of the motel for the first time and walked toward one of the tallest mountains I could see past the buildings."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept going until Airun's slope was before me, close to Ashiya Tower. Far in the past, there had been a path up the mountain, but I could no longer distinguish it.
entries.literal: "I kept going until Airun's slope was before me, close to Ashiya Tower. Far in the past, there had been a path up the mountain, but I could no longer distinguish it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I stepped up, my feet sank deep into the snow. The layer there was much thicker, and it showed clear signs of human presence.
entries.literal: "When I stepped up, my feet sank deep into the snow. The layer there was much thicker, and it showed clear signs of human presence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Soon, the trees began to cast many shadows around me, but I hadn't lost track of where I was. My legs continued moving autonomously until the sun was visible again.
entries.literal: "Soon, the trees began to cast many shadows around me, but I hadn't lost track of where I was. My legs continued moving autonomously until the sun was visible again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This place...
entries.literal: "This place..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A vast field surrounded by trees. It had been quite a few years since I'd been there, as evidenced by the tall grass that had grown in.
entries.literal: "A vast field surrounded by trees. It had been quite a few years since I'd been there, as evidenced by the tall grass that had grown in."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is where the Sekimeiya were found. I can't believe it.{w} How is that even possible? This was our special place...
entries.literal: "This is where the Sekimeiya were found. I can't believe it.{w} How is that even possible? This was our special place..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I trudged along and arrived at a cabin tucked next to the treeline.
entries.literal: "I trudged along and arrived at a cabin tucked next to the treeline."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now this place hasn't changed much...
entries.literal: "Now this place hasn't changed much..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who had been the last person to open that door? The inside looked exactly like the cabin in my memories. After taking a look around, I noticed something thrown away in a corner.
entries.literal: "Who had been the last person to open that door? The inside looked exactly like the cabin in my memories. After taking a look around, I noticed something thrown away in a corner."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's...
entries.literal: "That's..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a stuffed tiger, much smaller than I recalled. It didn't seem damaged, and it looked at me with the same smile as always. Sitting on the wood, it appeared to be waiting for Shiroya to come back and put him in the small pocket of her school bag, from where he would peek out at the vast mountain landscape.
entries.literal: "It was a stuffed tiger, much smaller than I recalled. It didn't seem damaged, and it looked at me with the same smile as always. Sitting on the wood, it appeared to be waiting for Shiroya to come back and put him in the small pocket of her school bag, from where he would peek out at the vast mountain landscape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I stepped back out, opened the suitcase, and looked at the clock. It was {time=14:03.}
entries.literal: "...I stepped back out, opened the suitcase, and looked at the clock. It was {time=14:03.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After that, I tested how far I'd travel if I kept the Sekimeiya in the suitcase for two minutes.
entries.literal: "After that, I tested how far I'd travel if I kept the Sekimeiya in the suitcase for two minutes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I appeared inside the cabin, next to the door. When I looked outside, I saw myself in the middle of the field.{w} 35 seconds later, I disappeared.
entries.literal: "I appeared inside the cabin, next to the door. When I looked outside, I saw myself in the middle of the field.{w} 35 seconds later, I disappeared."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see...
entries.literal: "I see..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So I'll have to keep it in the suitcase for about forty minutes. I want to make it to yesterday morning.
entries.literal: "So I'll have to keep it in the suitcase for about forty minutes. I want to make it to yesterday morning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya was on the grass, next to the suitcase and the clock. I put it inside at {time=14:05.}
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya was on the grass, next to the suitcase and the clock. I put it inside at {time=14:05.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to leave the suitcase there. Surprisingly, the cabin made for a good shelter from the cold.
entries.literal: "I had to leave the suitcase there. Surprisingly, the cabin made for a good shelter from the cold."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had a bed and a hatch in the floor, leading to an empty basement. There was much less dust than I had imagined, but I busied myself wiping it off.
entries.literal: "It had a bed and a hatch in the floor, leading to an empty basement. There was much less dust than I had imagined, but I busied myself wiping it off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't get over the fact that the Sekimeiya had been found there, but perhaps I was too full of myself for thinking that it could've been anything more than a coincidence.
entries.literal: "I couldn't get over the fact that the Sekimeiya had been found there, but perhaps I was too full of myself for thinking that it could've been anything more than a coincidence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I spent the last stretch sitting on a bed. I could see the suitcase through the window, and at {time=14:43}, I stood up.
entries.literal: "I spent the last stretch sitting on a bed. I could see the suitcase through the window, and at {time=14:43}, I stood up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the clock and walked outside.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the clock and walked outside."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'll have to touch it as soon as I open the suitcase.
entries.literal: "I'll have to touch it as soon as I open the suitcase."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I locked my eyes on those numbers. As soon as {time=14:45} appeared, I opened it.
entries.literal: "I locked my eyes on those numbers. As soon as {time=14:45} appeared, I opened it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That time, when my right hand reached for the Sekimeiya, my left one gripped the suitcase's handle.
entries.literal: "That time, when my right hand reached for the Sekimeiya, my left one gripped the suitcase's handle."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In an instant, the sun disappeared. I was in the motel, and seconds later, I noticed the faint noise surrounding me.
entries.literal: "In an instant, the sun disappeared. I was in the motel, and seconds later, I noticed the faint noise surrounding me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was my own self sleeping. When I glanced at the clock, I saw the red numbers I'd expected: {time=7:01.} November 27th.
entries.literal: "It was my own self sleeping. When I glanced at the clock, I saw the red numbers I'd expected: {time=7:01.} November 27th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt the motel keys in my pocket, and my hands weren't empty. One was holding the suitcase, while the other had a replica of the clock. However, its screen was blank.
entries.literal: "I felt the motel keys in my pocket, and my hands weren't empty. One was holding the suitcase, while the other had a replica of the clock. However, its screen was blank."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This again...
entries.literal: "This again..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd held them when I touched the Sekimeiya so that they wouldn't remain on the field. Only the Past Sekimeiya had been left there so that it was found later.
entries.literal: "I'd held them when I touched the Sekimeiya so that they wouldn't remain on the field. Only the Past Sekimeiya had been left there so that it was found later."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped to the kitchen without making noise. When I opened the refrigerator, I saw both Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I stepped to the kitchen without making noise. When I opened the refrigerator, I saw both Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the one on the left—the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the one on the left—the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I suppose I have to hurry. I didn't see the Future Sekimeiya in the field, which means that it'll be taken today.
entries.literal: "...I suppose I have to hurry. I didn't see the Future Sekimeiya in the field, which means that it'll be taken today."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I put it in the suitcase and walked out.
entries.literal: "I put it in the suitcase and walked out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The sun was beginning to rise. I took the same route back to Airun.
entries.literal: "The sun was beginning to rise. I took the same route back to Airun."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked up, carving a path through the trees. Eventually, I stopped myself and looked back.
entries.literal: "I walked up, carving a path through the trees. Eventually, I stopped myself and looked back."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I'm leaving the traces of footprints I saw.
entries.literal: "...I'm leaving the traces of footprints I saw."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept going up until I arrived at the field, covered by the shadows cast by the tall trees. Before I got to the cabin, I took the Sekimeiya out and left it on the ground.
entries.literal: "I kept going up until I arrived at the field, covered by the shadows cast by the tall trees. Before I got to the cabin, I took the Sekimeiya out and left it on the ground."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm sure I would've seen it if it had still been here.
entries.literal: "I'm sure I would've seen it if it had still been here."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, it's a lot dustier in here...{w} I suppose that makes sense; I have to stay until I can return to the motel.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's a lot dustier in here...{w} I suppose that makes sense; I have to stay until I can return to the motel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to spend a full night inside. I'd done it in the past, but a story from earlier in 2011 made me feel a little unnerved at the prospect...
entries.literal: "I had to spend a full night inside. I'd done it in the past, but a story from earlier in 2011 made me feel a little unnerved at the prospect..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It'll be fine. It's not so cold that I'm going to freeze, and it's only one night.
entries.literal: "It'll be fine. It's not so cold that I'm going to freeze, and it's only one night."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was nothing new. I just had to wait there like I'd been doing in the motel.
entries.literal: "It was nothing new. I just had to wait there like I'd been doing in the motel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Strangely, the cabin made it easy. The memories all came to me as I stared at the little tiger on the floor. I didn't want to take him with me—Shiroya and I would come back for the one in our world. After a while, I removed the dust from all the wooden furniture, doing my best not to breathe in.
entries.literal: "Strangely, the cabin made it easy. The memories all came to me as I stared at the little tiger on the floor. I didn't want to take him with me—Shiroya and I would come back for the one in our world. After a while, I removed the dust from all the wooden furniture, doing my best not to breathe in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The clock I had wasn't working, so I had to rely on the sun to know the time. Before it set, what I'd been expecting finally happened.
entries.literal: "The clock I had wasn't working, so I had to rely on the sun to know the time. Before it set, what I'd been expecting finally happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Through the window, I saw an old man emerging from the trees. He slowly got closer, stunned by the place he'd discovered.
