entries.literal: "Through the window, I saw an old man emerging from the trees. He slowly got closer, stunned by the place he'd discovered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I saw his face, I recognized him. He was the owner of Musashi Gemstones.
entries.literal: "When I saw his face, I recognized him. He was the owner of Musashi Gemstones."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He stopped in the middle of the field. He crouched down, and I saw the Sekimeiya between his gloves.
entries.literal: "He stopped in the middle of the field. He crouched down, and I saw the Sekimeiya between his gloves."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What the hell is going to happen with it? I know it'll be discovered that cold temperature is needed for it, but will it really be brought to Ashiya with no one having an understanding of its powers?
entries.literal: "...What the hell is going to happen with it? I know it'll be discovered that cold temperature is needed for it, but will it really be brought to Ashiya with no one having an understanding of its powers?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait... is he coming in here?
entries.literal: "Wait... is he coming in here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door to the cabin opened. Keeping my mouth shut, I waited until it closed again.
entries.literal: "The door to the cabin opened. Keeping my mouth shut, I waited until it closed again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once it did, I emerged from below. I could see the man walking away through the window.
entries.literal: "Once it did, I emerged from below. I could see the man walking away through the window."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...That's it, then. Everything happened as intended. Of course, the past didn't change.
entries.literal: "...That's it, then. Everything happened as intended. Of course, the past didn't change."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I sighed faintly before falling back on the bed.
entries.literal: "I sighed faintly before falling back on the bed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I'm getting really hungry, and I don't have water either.
entries.literal: "...I'm getting really hungry, and I don't have water either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the very least, I became tired fairly quickly. Soon, light stopped coming through the window, disappearing along with my awareness.
entries.literal: "At the very least, I became tired fairly quickly. Soon, light stopped coming through the window, disappearing along with my awareness."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was the third time I'd woken up on November 28th of 2011. I felt exhausted, and I had to walk all the way down the mountain path again.
entries.literal: "It was the third time I'd woken up on November 28th of 2011. I felt exhausted, and I had to walk all the way down the mountain path again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I should go as soon as possible, seeing as I still have some energy. ...I need to eat and use the bathroom too.
entries.literal: "I should go as soon as possible, seeing as I still have some energy. ...I need to eat and use the bathroom too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Yawning, I put the clock in the suitcase and drowsily moved through the rows of trees. The sun was well past the mountains, so I'd slept for a long time.{w} I entered the streets of Yushibana and walked to Eagle Motel.
entries.literal: "Yawning, I put the clock in the suitcase and drowsily moved through the rows of trees. The sun was well past the mountains, so I'd slept for a long time.{w} I entered the streets of Yushibana and walked to Eagle Motel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I quickly looked at the time: it was {time=10:29.}
entries.literal: "I quickly looked at the time: it was {time=10:29.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's still a while until my past self comes to the cafeteria, so I can be there until then.
entries.literal: "There's still a while until my past self comes to the cafeteria, so I can be there until then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was an open buffet, so nobody would be surprised by my eating habits when I came back down. I took my time, only accepting that I was full once about an hour had passed.
entries.literal: "It was an open buffet, so nobody would be surprised by my eating habits when I came back down. I took my time, only accepting that I was full once about an hour had passed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited, hidden from view, until my past self came down. Soon after I left, I reappeared from the stairs, holding the suitcase and wearing an uneasy expression.
entries.literal: "I waited, hidden from view, until my past self came down. Soon after I left, I reappeared from the stairs, holding the suitcase and wearing an uneasy expression."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally I could go back up. I unlocked the bedroom and staggered in.
entries.literal: "Finally I could go back up. I unlocked the bedroom and staggered in."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I don't have the Sekimeiya anymore. Now I can only change worlds on December 15th.
entries.literal: "...I don't have the Sekimeiya anymore. Now I can only change worlds on December 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd had them sitting in the refrigerator for so long without using them. It was undeniable that I could've obtained anything with them; Sai had once talked about winning the lottery with ease.{w} But I hadn't worried about that because of the single guarantee I possessed: on January 5th, I would have both Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I'd had them sitting in the refrigerator for so long without using them. It was undeniable that I could've obtained anything with them; Sai had once talked about winning the lottery with ease.{w} But I hadn't worried about that because of the single guarantee I possessed: on January 5th, I would have both Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can't rest easy for today just yet. In the afternoon, I have to make sure to be in possession of the keys, clock, and suitcase. Otherwise, they would've disappeared when I touched the Sekimeiya on Airun.
entries.literal: "I can't rest easy for today just yet. In the afternoon, I have to make sure to be in possession of the keys, clock, and suitcase. Otherwise, they would've disappeared when I touched the Sekimeiya on Airun."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Two days passed. It was November 30th, a day that would never fade from my memory. The Sekimeiya event had been announced the previous day, so everything would happen in the same way.
entries.literal: "Two days passed. It was November 30th, a day that would never fade from my memory. The Sekimeiya event had been announced the previous day, so everything would happen in the same way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't leave the room. By the time the evening came, I was stuck in a loop of reliving the explosion and its aftermath, shaking my head to drive those thoughts away, and having them return not long after.
entries.literal: "I didn't leave the room. By the time the evening came, I was stuck in a loop of reliving the explosion and its aftermath, shaking my head to drive those thoughts away, and having them return not long after."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And there was nothing I could do to stop it. If I'd tried to, I would have failed miserably.
entries.literal: "...And there was nothing I could do to stop it. If I'd tried to, I would have failed miserably."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I attempted to close my eyes, doubting I would ever fall asleep.
entries.literal: "I attempted to close my eyes, doubting I would ever fall asleep."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {time=7:11.} December 1st.{w} I'd gotten new batteries for the clock and confirmed it was accurate. I gingerly rubbed my eyes, grateful that I'd at least been able to sleep a little.
entries.literal: "{time=7:11.} December 1st.{w} I'd gotten new batteries for the clock and confirmed it was accurate. I gingerly rubbed my eyes, grateful that I'd at least been able to sleep a little."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I fully regained my senses, I quickly got up and dashed out of the room.
entries.literal: "When I fully regained my senses, I quickly got up and dashed out of the room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...The news. I need to see what happened.
entries.literal: "...The news. I need to see what happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had a fact to work with—Miiya would exist on December 15th. Nervous at what I'd find, I intently watched the television.
entries.literal: "I had a fact to work with—Miiya would exist on December 15th. Nervous at what I'd find, I intently watched the television."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The news was just starting. Before I could think, I saw text scrolling horizontally.
entries.literal: "The news was just starting. Before I could think, I saw text scrolling horizontally."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Gas explosion in Yushibana".{w} At a low volume, a reporter began to talk about it.
entries.literal: "\"Gas explosion in Yushibana\".{w} At a low volume, a reporter began to talk about it."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Last night, a gas explosion occurred at a gem shop in Yushibana. An unknown individual released smoke that knocked four people unconscious, and some time later, the explosion occurred due to a gas heater that had depleted its surrounding oxygen.{w} Given the size of the explosion, the flame had been out before the smoke's release. Since everyone present was unconscious, nobody was able to recognize the artificial smell of the gas, which had no way to leave the enclosed space. At {time=21}, when the lights were turned on, the presence of smoke and gas caused a dust explosion.
entries.literal: "Last night, a gas explosion occurred at a gem shop in Yushibana. An unknown individual released smoke that knocked four people unconscious, and some time later, the explosion occurred due to a gas heater that had depleted its surrounding oxygen.{w} Given the size of the explosion, the flame had been out before the smoke's release. Since everyone present was unconscious, nobody was able to recognize the artificial smell of the gas, which had no way to leave the enclosed space. At {time=21}, when the lights were turned on, the presence of smoke and gas caused a dust explosion."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: The blast hit two young girls who'd fallen unconscious, nineteen and twenty years of age. One of them was taken to the hospital after falling through the broken floor, but her condition is stable, as she was shielded by a shelf. The body of the other girl has not yet been found, but the chances that she is alive are slim.
entries.literal: "The blast hit two young girls who'd fallen unconscious, nineteen and twenty years of age. One of them was taken to the hospital after falling through the broken floor, but her condition is stable, as she was shielded by a shelf. The body of the other girl has not yet been found, but the chances that she is alive are slim."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: The other two people, a nineteen-year-old boy and the owner of the shop, were far enough from the heater that they avoided major damage.{w} The identity of the person who released the smoke is being investigated, as is their motive. Despite the outcome, it is unlikely that the explosion was intentional, and nothing has been reported as stolen.
entries.literal: "The other two people, a nineteen-year-old boy and the owner of the shop, were far enough from the heater that they avoided major damage.{w} The identity of the person who released the smoke is being investigated, as is their motive. Despite the outcome, it is unlikely that the explosion was intentional, and nothing has been reported as stolen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}I see. This is before they found her jaw. I don't even know why I thought I could expect anything else.
entries.literal: "...{w}I see. This is before they found her jaw. I don't even know why I thought I could expect anything else."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After hearing everything again, my heart dropped into a black abyss. It almost felt like I'd been told the news for the first time again.{w} ...I really was powerless. The immense power I'd been able to wield meant nothing.
entries.literal: "After hearing everything again, my heart dropped into a black abyss. It almost felt like I'd been told the news for the first time again.{w} ...I really was powerless. The immense power I'd been able to wield meant nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Over two weeks were left until the 15th. Miserable, I shut myself in the bedroom. Knowing what was coming wasn't enough—I wound up isolating myself from the world in the exact same way I had the first time.
entries.literal: "Over two weeks were left until the 15th. Miserable, I shut myself in the bedroom. Knowing what was coming wasn't enough—I wound up isolating myself from the world in the exact same way I had the first time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to see Shiroya. My thoughts were a mess, but all the uncertain possibilities ahead of me made me listless.
entries.literal: "I wanted to see Shiroya. My thoughts were a mess, but all the uncertain possibilities ahead of me made me listless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next time I stepped out of the motel was on December 9th, a Friday. Late in the evening, there was a place I wanted to go.
entries.literal: "The next time I stepped out of the motel was on December 9th, a Friday. Late in the evening, there was a place I wanted to go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the 15th, I would be able to use the Sekimeiya again. It was mandatory for me to be there and that the past would repeat.
entries.literal: "On the 15th, I would be able to use the Sekimeiya again. It was mandatory for me to be there and that the past would repeat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, naturally, I couldn't be in the lobby with everyone else. ...I had to enter the other way.
entries.literal: "However, naturally, I couldn't be in the lobby with everyone else. ...I had to enter the other way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Ashiya Tower was before me. I could see people through the door and light behind all the windows.
entries.literal: "Ashiya Tower was before me. I could see people through the door and light behind all the windows."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya have to be inside. Ashiya are waiting for Xyn's attack.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya have to be inside. Ashiya are waiting for Xyn's attack."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If I found them, perhaps I could change worlds before the incident, even though that wasn't my goal.
entries.literal: "If I found them, perhaps I could change worlds before the incident, even though that wasn't my goal."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I felt the rusty surface of a key in my pocket. I would have to use it to enter the tower without being seen.
entries.literal: "...I felt the rusty surface of a key in my pocket. I would have to use it to enter the tower without being seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before that, I stepped into the lobby. After being checked for any devices, I approached the reception desk and bought an entry pass to the hallways.
entries.literal: "Before that, I stepped into the lobby. After being checked for any devices, I approached the reception desk and bought an entry pass to the hallways."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to enter the tower in case I could pinpoint the Sekimeiya's location. I was curious to know if both had been found.
entries.literal: "I wanted to enter the tower in case I could pinpoint the Sekimeiya's location. I was curious to know if both had been found."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I was met with a "Forbidden Entry" sign on the door to the event room.
entries.literal: "However, I was met with a \"Forbidden Entry\" sign on the door to the event room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: As expected, they're being kept in here.{w} I shouldn't bother checking inside. That could bring me problems, and there's no way only one was found anyway...
entries.literal: "As expected, they're being kept in here.{w} I shouldn't bother checking inside. That could bring me problems, and there's no way only one was found anyway..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew the cameras around me were displaying my image in the security room. Katei shouldn't have been there, but someone was watching my movements.
entries.literal: "I knew the cameras around me were displaying my image in the security room. Katei shouldn't have been there, but someone was watching my movements."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I wonder if whoever's in the security room also knows about the storeroom's secret.
entries.literal: "...I wonder if whoever's in the security room also knows about the storeroom's secret."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if I was visiting the place normally, I entered a few crystal rooms and looked through their cabinets. All the gemstones were the same as on the 15th.
entries.literal: "As if I was visiting the place normally, I entered a few crystal rooms and looked through their cabinets. All the gemstones were the same as on the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, as I went through hallway A, I stopped myself before the storeroom. I opened its door curiously and peeked inside.
entries.literal: "Then, as I went through hallway A, I stopped myself before the storeroom. I opened its door curiously and peeked inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to see if my key would unlock the door. When I'd been in the tower, it hadn't unlocked that exit from the inside. I closed the door behind me and rapidly opened the secret wall.
entries.literal: "I wanted to see if my key would unlock the door. When I'd been in the tower, it hadn't unlocked that exit from the inside. I closed the door behind me and rapidly opened the secret wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The handle was there, and with the rusty key inserted into the keyhole, a rough turn unlocked it.
entries.literal: "The handle was there, and with the rusty key inserted into the keyhole, a rough turn unlocked it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door opened. Through a small gap, I could see the snowy grass next to the tower.
entries.literal: "The door opened. Through a small gap, I could see the snowy grass next to the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I frowned, but I couldn't waste time. As if nothing had happened, I stepped back to the hallway.
entries.literal: "I frowned, but I couldn't waste time. As if nothing had happened, I stepped back to the hallway."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The few people there didn't seem to mind me, so I walked back to the lobby.
entries.literal: "The few people there didn't seem to mind me, so I walked back to the lobby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why did it not work on the 15th? No matter how much I tried, the lock wouldn't budge...
entries.literal: "Why did it not work on the 15th? No matter how much I tried, the lock wouldn't budge..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Whatever the reason was, it had worked in my favor. Katei hadn't been able to escape, and if he had, when the others found the door, they would've been able to get out too. With things like that, I wouldn't have been able to figure out the mechanics behind the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Whatever the reason was, it had worked in my favor. Katei hadn't been able to escape, and if he had, when the others found the door, they would've been able to get out too. With things like that, I wouldn't have been able to figure out the mechanics behind the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't be calm, though. If the key wouldn't work on the 15th, perhaps I wouldn't be able to enter the tower.
entries.literal: "I couldn't be calm, though. If the key wouldn't work on the 15th, perhaps I wouldn't be able to enter the tower."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I haven't seen you here before, have I? Have you taken a look at this?
entries.literal: "I haven't seen you here before, have I? Have you taken a look at this?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to step out when a voice called for me.{w} It was the receptionist, who held out a green paper that I recognized.
entries.literal: "I was about to step out when a voice called for me.{w} It was the receptionist, who held out a green paper that I recognized."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...The Sekimeiya event, right? I've heard about it, yes.
entries.literal: "...The Sekimeiya event, right? I've heard about it, yes."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I'm glad you have. Have you decided if you'll come back?
entries.literal: "I'm glad you have. Have you decided if you'll come back?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I might.
entries.literal: "...I might."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Fantastic! I'll see you there, then.
entries.literal: "Fantastic! I'll see you there, then."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Huh.

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the flyer as she waved. By the time I stepped out of the building, the sun was completely gone. Only the cold was left, and nobody was outside.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the flyer as she waved. By the time I stepped out of the building, the sun was completely gone. Only the cold was left, and nobody was outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the left side of the building, hearing the woman's words replay in my mind.
entries.literal: "I walked to the left side of the building, hearing the woman's words replay in my mind."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Fantastic! I'll see you there, then.
entries.literal: "Fantastic! I'll see you there, then."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I did see her. I remember that.
entries.literal: "...I did see her. I remember that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the wall where the secret door was. Stepping on the tall grass, I felt the surface of the wall carefully until I was next to the storeroom.
entries.literal: "I went to the wall where the secret door was. Stepping on the tall grass, I felt the surface of the wall carefully until I was next to the storeroom."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is the door. I can see the keyhole too.
entries.literal: "This is the door. I can see the keyhole too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had left it slightly open, so it was easy to find. With the key, I verified that I could lock and unlock it from the outside.
entries.literal: "I had left it slightly open, so it was easy to find. With the key, I verified that I could lock and unlock it from the outside."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It works. I should be able to enter through it as long as it still works on the 15th...
entries.literal: "...It works. I should be able to enter through it as long as it still works on the 15th..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked away with the uneasiness that the receptionist's words had caused.
entries.literal: "I walked away with the uneasiness that the receptionist's words had caused."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I'll see you there, then.
entries.literal: "I'll see you there, then."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When Shiroya and I stepped into the tower, she didn't react to me at all. We were there extremely early and spent hours in the lobby, but it was as if she'd never seen me. That makes sense, of course—in that world, she hadn't.
entries.literal: "When Shiroya and I stepped into the tower, she didn't react to me at all. We were there extremely early and spent hours in the lobby, but it was as if she'd never seen me. That makes sense, of course—in that world, she hadn't."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But in this one, when Shiroya and I enter the tower, the receptionist won't react the same way, will she? ...Because of the brief conversation we just had.
entries.literal: "But in this one, when Shiroya and I enter the tower, the receptionist won't react the same way, will she? ...Because of the brief conversation we just had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Didn't that mean... that I'd changed the past? I had changed something that I'd experienced in the other world.
entries.literal: "Didn't that mean... that I'd changed the past? I had changed something that I'd experienced in the other world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I began to walk somewhere.
entries.literal: "...I began to walk somewhere."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Of course, this world isn't identical. What happened on the 15th was different, but none of that was related to my presence, was it?
entries.literal: "Of course, this world isn't identical. What happened on the 15th was different, but none of that was related to my presence, was it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...There might've been a big mistake in my reasoning.
entries.literal: "...There might've been a big mistake in my reasoning."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why was I not able to change the salt pattern? ...Because I had already seen it. In that sense, the past couldn't be changed.
entries.literal: "Why was I not able to change the salt pattern? ...Because I had already seen it. In that sense, the past couldn't be changed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, in this world, I never did experience the wait in the lobby before the hallway doors opened. I could've caused that event to differ from my world's, but I never truly changed this world's history.
entries.literal: "However, in this world, I never did experience the wait in the lobby before the hallway doors opened. I could've caused that event to differ from my world's, but I never truly changed this world's history."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I came to a very familiar street. It was my own, and I could see my house far ahead.
entries.literal: "I came to a very familiar street. It was my own, and I could see my house far ahead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was light behind two of the windows.
entries.literal: "There was light behind two of the windows."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Our sleep schedule was all over the place. I spent most nights awake.
entries.literal: "...{w}Our sleep schedule was all over the place. I spent most nights awake."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see my own outline, but I remembered staring through that window every night. For that reason, the image I'd always seen was still engraved in my mind.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see my own outline, but I remembered staring through that window every night. For that reason, the image I'd always seen was still engraved in my mind."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got closer to my house, hiding myself behind the gate.
entries.literal: "I got closer to my house, hiding myself behind the gate."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A lot of snow had piled up on it. Without thinking twice, I shook it all off.
entries.literal: "A lot of snow had piled up on it. Without thinking twice, I shook it all off."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}I was right. I changed my past, but not the past of the Atsuki from this world. In my memories, the snow piled on the gate never fell.
entries.literal: "...{w}I was right. I changed my past, but not the past of the Atsuki from this world. In my memories, the snow piled on the gate never fell."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No rule had changed. I hadn't erased what I'd lived through. What had once happened couldn't be reversed.
entries.literal: "No rule had changed. I hadn't erased what I'd lived through. What had once happened couldn't be reversed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However... I truly had power in the world I was in. It was a real second chance. I couldn't change my own past, but I had just changed the other Atsuki's past.
entries.literal: "However... I truly had power in the world I was in. It was a real second chance. I couldn't change my own past, but I had just changed the other Atsuki's past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd thought that everything would happen as the universe had decided—that my input would always be meaningless. ...But that wasn't the case. I had taken an action all by myself and changed something.
entries.literal: "I'd thought that everything would happen as the universe had decided—that my input would always be meaningless. ...But that wasn't the case. I had taken an action all by myself and changed something."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I locked up. Did that mean that I could've saved Miiya? If I hadn't waited in the motel, could I have prevented her death?
entries.literal: "I locked up. Did that mean that I could've saved Miiya? If I hadn't waited in the motel, could I have prevented her death?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Even if that was the case, I had already failed. I had failed to do it, and it was irreversible.
entries.literal: "Even if that was the case, I had already failed. I had failed to do it, and it was irreversible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Because I had seen the news. I had witnessed history of the world I was in, so it was no longer any different from my own. I'd had a chance, and I'd failed to notice it.
entries.literal: "Because I had seen the news. I had witnessed history of the world I was in, so it was no longer any different from my own. I'd had a chance, and I'd failed to notice it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The reporter had spelled out my negligence. I hadn't acted, so nothing had changed.
entries.literal: "The reporter had spelled out my negligence. I hadn't acted, so nothing had changed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No, that can't be...
entries.literal: "No, that can't be..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's the same case. Even though I have seen the news, in this world, I've never seen any physical indication that Miiya is dead. That was the biggest barrier in my world, and it doesn't exist here. The news report is the only real obstacle, and it's a crossable one.
entries.literal: "It's the same case. Even though I have seen the news, in this world, I've never seen any physical indication that Miiya is dead. That was the biggest barrier in my world, and it doesn't exist here. The news report is the only real obstacle, and it's a crossable one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I no longer had the Sekimeiya. I couldn't travel back to the 30th.
entries.literal: "I no longer had the Sekimeiya. I couldn't travel back to the 30th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: However, if I could... Miiya's death could be averted without the need to change the past. It isn't yet an impossibility...
entries.literal: "However, if I could... Miiya's death could be averted without the need to change the past. It isn't yet an impossibility..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And I knew everything that I'd lived through would repeat, so I could be certain that on the 15th, I would have the Sekimeiya for myself.
entries.literal: "And I knew everything that I'd lived through would repeat, so I could be certain that on the 15th, I would have the Sekimeiya for myself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Finally, it made sense, and my eyes went wide. The reason why Miiya had been in the tower... I understood everything, as it all aligned with what I had to do.
entries.literal: "...Finally, it made sense, and my eyes went wide. The reason why Miiya had been in the tower... I understood everything, as it all aligned with what I had to do."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I arrived at the motel, where I could be isolated from the world. Until I was certain about everything, I couldn't look at the news. Everything had to be in my head before the result was given to me.
entries.literal: "I arrived at the motel, where I could be isolated from the world. Until I was certain about everything, I couldn't look at the news. Everything had to be in my head before the result was given to me."

entries.text: Oubliette
entries.literal: "Oubliette"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The last days passed quickly. It was about to be December 15th once again.
entries.literal: "The last days passed quickly. It was about to be December 15th once again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew what I wanted to do, and I knew it would work.
entries.literal: "I knew what I wanted to do, and I knew it would work."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The end was still murky. I had to go back to my world, and I couldn't know how smoothly that would go until the time came. However, I had prepared extra steps before that point.
entries.literal: "The end was still murky. I had to go back to my world, and I couldn't know how smoothly that would go until the time came. However, I had prepared extra steps before that point."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the tower, more than one person had been a killer. Someone had caused the attack, trapping all of us there. Despite all that, the security cameras weren't reliable enough to prove anything. I couldn't stand the thought of letting those criminals run free after everything was over.
entries.literal: "In the tower, more than one person had been a killer. Someone had caused the attack, trapping all of us there. Despite all that, the security cameras weren't reliable enough to prove anything. I couldn't stand the thought of letting those criminals run free after everything was over."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: For that, I had obtained two things.
entries.literal: "For that, I had obtained two things."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In one hand, I had an empty USB drive. In the other, I had a roll of tape.
entries.literal: "In one hand, I had an empty USB drive. In the other, I had a roll of tape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In one hand, I had an empty USB drive. In the other, I had duct tape.
entries.literal: "In one hand, I had an empty USB drive. In the other, I had duct tape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While we'd been unconscious, someone had hidden the Sekimeiya in a hallway B crystal room. Perhaps there was more of the attack that they wanted to keep hidden.
entries.literal: "While we'd been unconscious, someone had hidden the Sekimeiya in a hallway B crystal room. Perhaps there was more of the attack that they wanted to keep hidden."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd thought of a way to expose what they'd kept as a well-hidden secret.
entries.literal: "I'd thought of a way to expose what they'd kept as a well-hidden secret."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped out of the motel when the sun had already risen. I couldn't be in the tower too early, or I'd conflict with what I needed.
entries.literal: "I stepped out of the motel when the sun had already risen. I couldn't be in the tower too early, or I'd conflict with what I needed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Basically all smoke residue had faded from my clothing, and I'd left the suitcase and my clothes from the 24th in the bedroom before departing. On the way, I grew nervous. ...Was it going to work?
entries.literal: "Basically all smoke residue had faded from my clothing, and I'd left the suitcase and my clothes from the 24th in the bedroom before departing. On the way, I grew nervous. ...Was it going to work?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had I overlooked something? Was there anything crucial I was missing?
entries.literal: "Had I overlooked something? Was there anything crucial I was missing?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the world I was in, I could save Miiya. I knew that for sure. My uncertainty went further than that.
entries.literal: "In the world I was in, I could save Miiya. I knew that for sure. My uncertainty went further than that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The news and the note I'd read in the tower... They signified the real problem.
entries.literal: "The news and the note I'd read in the tower... They signified the real problem."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: How would it be solved...? I'd only been able to come up with a vague idea.
entries.literal: "How would it be solved...? I'd only been able to come up with a vague idea."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see the tower in the distance. I still hadn't shaken off that unsettling feeling, but I knew it wouldn't disappear until everything was settled.
entries.literal: "I could see the tower in the distance. I still hadn't shaken off that unsettling feeling, but I knew it wouldn't disappear until everything was settled."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: People were by the entrance. I could see Suripo and the line of civilians from that day. However, the left wall was unguarded.
entries.literal: "People were by the entrance. I could see Suripo and the line of civilians from that day. However, the left wall was unguarded."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I surreptitiously approached it. Immediately, what I'd been very curious to see was apparent.
entries.literal: "I surreptitiously approached it. Immediately, what I'd been very curious to see was apparent."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It really is there...
entries.literal: "It really is there..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The rusty key was inserted in the outer keyhole.
entries.literal: "The rusty key was inserted in the outer keyhole."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Really? Does this really make sense?
entries.literal: "Really? Does this really make sense?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The reason why I hadn't been able to unlock that door from the inside... I had thought that if an identical key was on the opposite side, I might not have been able to turn it from the inside.{w} I wanted it to be there. I needed it to remain outside so that the door wouldn't be unlocked from the inside... so that Katei couldn't escape and so that the others couldn't leave when they found the door.{w} But... why was that key there? If it was just there because I'd known it would be there, that didn't really satisfy me.
entries.literal: "The reason why I hadn't been able to unlock that door from the inside... I had thought that if an identical key was on the opposite side, I might not have been able to turn it from the inside.{w} I wanted it to be there. I needed it to remain outside so that the door wouldn't be unlocked from the inside... so that Katei couldn't escape and so that the others couldn't leave when they found the door.{w} But... why was that key there? If it was just there because I'd known it would be there, that didn't really satisfy me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Am I supposed to assume that I'll leave it here the next time? Then, to still have it in the future, I'd have to get the key that Shiroya had.
entries.literal: "...Am I supposed to assume that I'll leave it here the next time? Then, to still have it in the future, I'd have to get the key that Shiroya had."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That had to be the answer. It meant that a future self of mine was already in the tower... But it was a bit hard to swallow. I would just be leaving the key behind to explain why I hadn't been able to unlock the door. If that was it, maybe there was more to it that I was missing, as the origin of the idea was unknown to me.
entries.literal: "That had to be the answer. It meant that a future self of mine was already in the tower... But it was a bit hard to swallow. I would just be leaving the key behind to explain why I hadn't been able to unlock the door. If that was it, maybe there was more to it that I was missing, as the origin of the idea was unknown to me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite the universe apparently deciding the outcomes of things by itself, actual ideas that went into effect had consistently originated from a human mind. I still thought that had to be the case, but it wasn't like I had a better explanation ready for the key.
entries.literal: "Despite the universe apparently deciding the outcomes of things by itself, actual ideas that went into effect had consistently originated from a human mind. I still thought that had to be the case, but it wasn't like I had a better explanation ready for the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I locked the door while it was open and stepped into the storeroom. Once inside, I was able to close the door behind me, leaving it locked. It was fortunate—and guaranteed—that the door worked like that, and once again, I wondered why the hell it existed in the first place.
entries.literal: "I locked the door while it was open and stepped into the storeroom. Once inside, I was able to close the door behind me, leaving it locked. It was fortunate—and guaranteed—that the door worked like that, and once again, I wondered why the hell it existed in the first place."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still had the rusty key in my pocket, but when I tried to use it from the inside, it wouldn't budge. As long as the other one was inserted, opening the door from the inside would be impossible.
entries.literal: "I still had the rusty key in my pocket, but when I tried to use it from the inside, it wouldn't budge. As long as the other one was inserted, opening the door from the inside would be impossible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got closer to the hallway. It would very soon be {time=9.}
entries.literal: "I got closer to the hallway. It would very soon be {time=9.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Katei won't be in the security room... Nobody will see me getting out of here.{w} I'll be recorded. Maybe the footage will actually be seen by the police. ...That doesn't matter, though.
entries.literal: "Katei won't be in the security room... Nobody will see me getting out of here.{w} I'll be recorded. Maybe the footage will actually be seen by the police. ...That doesn't matter, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I paid the utmost attention for any sound to use as a cue.
entries.literal: "I paid the utmost attention for any sound to use as a cue."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There it was. As soon as I heard footsteps, I opened the door.
entries.literal: "There it was. As soon as I heard footsteps, I opened the door."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I glanced toward the lobby, I saw two people. One was Katei, who'd just left the security room. The other was a man I'd never seen. He saw me exiting the storeroom, but he paid no mind as he kept approaching.
entries.literal: "When I glanced toward the lobby, I saw two people. One was Katei, who'd just left the security room. The other was a man I'd never seen. He saw me exiting the storeroom, but he paid no mind as he kept approaching."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't afford to waste time either. Casually, I walked to hallway C.
entries.literal: "I couldn't afford to waste time either. Casually, I walked to hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made it just in time to see the event room closing. The first group was there.{w} I had very little time; the second group would appear at any moment.
entries.literal: "I made it just in time to see the event room closing. The first group was there.{w} I had very little time; the second group would appear at any moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Fortunately, I was done in less than a minute. It had gone as smoothly as I'd hoped.
entries.literal: "Fortunately, I was done in less than a minute. It had gone as smoothly as I'd hoped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd wanted to record the movements through hallway B. In our world, Katei had hidden both Sekimeiya in room B4. I knew things wouldn't be identical, but I hoped the truth would be recorded nonetheless.
entries.literal: "I'd wanted to record the movements through hallway B. In our world, Katei had hidden both Sekimeiya in room B4. I knew things wouldn't be identical, but I hoped the truth would be recorded nonetheless."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Near the lobby, one of the security cameras viewed the entire hallway. It was high up, but I'd foreseen that problem. Thanks to the handrail and the corner, I'd been able to reach its lens.
entries.literal: "Near the lobby, one of the security cameras viewed the entire hallway. It was high up, but I'd foreseen that problem. Thanks to the handrail and the corner, I'd been able to reach its lens."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With the seconds I had left, I sprinted toward hallway C. I had to be somewhere during the attack.
entries.literal: "With the seconds I had left, I sprinted toward hallway C. I had to be somewhere during the attack."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The security room.
entries.literal: "The security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew the alarm would lock it. If that happened, Katei could be fast enough to erase the footage I wanted to preserve.{w} However, I could avoid that by staying inside. He had told us once that the door could be unlocked from the inside without the need for the key.
entries.literal: "I knew the alarm would lock it. If that happened, Katei could be fast enough to erase the footage I wanted to preserve.{w} However, I could avoid that by staying inside. He had told us once that the door could be unlocked from the inside without the need for the key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I looked at all the monitors, I felt like a needle was piercing my chest.
entries.literal: "When I looked at all the monitors, I felt like a needle was piercing my chest."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Miiya is here. She's wearing the tanzanite pendant...
entries.literal: "...Miiya is here. She's wearing the tanzanite pendant..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She and I were in the event room with Akaro. And... Shiroya was nowhere to be seen.{w} I couldn't believe it. No matter how much I stared at the footage, I couldn't believe that she was really a room away.{w} And the cabinet covered by that crimson curtain... Which Sekimeiya were there?
entries.literal: "She and I were in the event room with Akaro. And... Shiroya was nowhere to be seen.{w} I couldn't believe it. No matter how much I stared at the footage, I couldn't believe that she was really a room away.{w} And the cabinet covered by that crimson curtain... Which Sekimeiya were there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every monitor displayed different locations on the crystal floor except for one. One of the screens was covered by tape.{w} I kept my eyes peeled with anticipation. It was about to happen again. I would see that dense smoke appearing out of nowhere, and my vision would blacken.
entries.literal: "Every monitor displayed different locations on the crystal floor except for one. One of the screens was covered by tape.{w} I kept my eyes peeled with anticipation. It was about to happen again. I would see that dense smoke appearing out of nowhere, and my vision would blacken."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All at once, it happened, and I finally confirmed the truth.
entries.literal: "All at once, it happened, and I finally confirmed the truth."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did the smoke come from Akaro!?
entries.literal: "Did the smoke come from Akaro!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was how it had seemed. In an instant, all the cameras hit by the smoke displayed a black screen.
entries.literal: "That was how it had seemed. In an instant, all the cameras hit by the smoke displayed a black screen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It was Akaro. He was the one who released it.
entries.literal: "It was Akaro. He was the one who released it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Shiroya and I had appeared on that morning after traveling from January 5th, we'd been able to avoid falling unconscious by looking down as we'd run through the smoke. Akaro had to have thrown himself to the ground immediately to avoid inhaling it, as it had quickly risen to the ceiling.{w} I had to act again while I still could, but I waited a few seconds so that the exit to the outside would close.
entries.literal: "When Shiroya and I had appeared on that morning after traveling from January 5th, we'd been able to avoid falling unconscious by looking down as we'd run through the smoke. Akaro had to have thrown himself to the ground immediately to avoid inhaling it, as it had quickly risen to the ceiling.{w} I had to act again while I still could, but I waited a few seconds so that the exit to the outside would close."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then I opened the door slowly, crouching and covering my face. The smoke was there, but I was very close to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Then I opened the door slowly, crouching and covering my face. The smoke was there, but I was very close to the lobby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is someone here...?{w} Is it Katei?
entries.literal: "Is someone here...?{w} Is it Katei?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want them to hear me, so I took off my shoes. I could hear a person crawling on the floor, but when I opened my eyes, I only saw a dark silhouette near the wall.
entries.literal: "I didn't want them to hear me, so I took off my shoes. I could hear a person crawling on the floor, but when I opened my eyes, I only saw a dark silhouette near the wall."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The alarm... It's even louder than I remember.
entries.literal: "The alarm... It's even louder than I remember."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unable to breathe, I took a silent step toward the light. I was in time to see the shutter locking in place and the smaller lights turning off.
entries.literal: "Unable to breathe, I took a silent step toward the light. I was in time to see the shutter locking in place and the smaller lights turning off."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In hallway B, most of the smoke had already gotten stuck to the ceiling.
entries.literal: "In hallway B, most of the smoke had already gotten stuck to the ceiling."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Aside from the second group, nobody seemed to be there yet. Protecting my face, I reached for the camera's lens and removed the piece of tape.
entries.literal: "Aside from the second group, nobody seemed to be there yet. Protecting my face, I reached for the camera's lens and removed the piece of tape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I returned to the security room as fast as I could. Someone had still been in hallway A, but I didn't think they'd noticed me. I still had my shoes in my hand.
entries.literal: "I returned to the security room as fast as I could. Someone had still been in hallway A, but I didn't think they'd noticed me. I still had my shoes in my hand."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I noticed the deadbolt was sticking out of the door. The alarm had just locked it, but since I'd left it open, I was able to step back in, and I used the inner handle to close it again.
entries.literal: "I noticed the deadbolt was sticking out of the door. The alarm had just locked it, but since I'd left it open, I was able to step back in, and I used the inner handle to close it again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the monitors as I put them on. The one that had been covered by tape showed the dark hallway instead. Its screen was being assaulted by the remaining smoke, but it wasn't enough to conceal the entire image.
entries.literal: "I looked at the monitors as I put them on. The one that had been covered by tape showed the dark hallway instead. Its screen was being assaulted by the remaining smoke, but it wasn't enough to conceal the entire image."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In front of the computer, I clicked on the program that managed the cameras. From there, I accessed the archived footage.
entries.literal: "In front of the computer, I clicked on the program that managed the cameras. From there, I accessed the archived footage."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It's all here, but Katei will try to hide it. In this world, the computer was shut down too.
entries.literal: "...It's all here, but Katei will try to hide it. In this world, the computer was shut down too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the screen, the culprits finally came to light.{w} Akaro came out of the event room and looked both ways.
entries.literal: "On the screen, the culprits finally came to light.{w} Akaro came out of the event room and looked both ways."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...He did fake his unconsciousness. What is he planning to do...?
entries.literal: "...He did fake his unconsciousness. What is he planning to do...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once he confirmed he was alone, he walked to the cleaning room. From there, he went back to the event room, holding a glowing object between his hands.
entries.literal: "Once he confirmed he was alone, he walked to the cleaning room. From there, he went back to the event room, holding a glowing object between his hands."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell...? Is that a Sekimeiya?{w} No, I know what that must be. ...The third Sekimeiya. That's what the plan was about.
entries.literal: "What the hell...? Is that a Sekimeiya?{w} No, I know what that must be. ...The third Sekimeiya. That's what the plan was about."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A few seconds later, he came back out. I couldn't see his hands, but he walked back to the cleaning room again.
entries.literal: "A few seconds later, he came back out. I couldn't see his hands, but he walked back to the cleaning room again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...This is why only the third Sekimeiya was there when we woke up.{w} When does Katei come into the picture, though?
entries.literal: "...This is why only the third Sekimeiya was there when we woke up.{w} When does Katei come into the picture, though?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have to wait very long to find out. After Akaro had returned to the event room, Katei appeared from the lobby.{w} Keeping his head down, he stepped to the cleaning room.
entries.literal: "I didn't have to wait very long to find out. After Akaro had returned to the event room, Katei appeared from the lobby.{w} Keeping his head down, he stepped to the cleaning room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Was he working with Akaro?
entries.literal: "Was he working with Akaro?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was bewildered. He came out almost immediately with two Sekimeiya and walked back to the lobby.
entries.literal: "I was bewildered. He came out almost immediately with two Sekimeiya and walked back to the lobby."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He must be going to the storeroom, but he won't be able to escape with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "He must be going to the storeroom, but he won't be able to escape with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd caught the two culprits behind the attack on video. Feeling the rush, I inserted the USB drive into the computer.
entries.literal: "I'd caught the two culprits behind the attack on video. Feeling the rush, I inserted the USB drive into the computer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I located the file corresponding to that camera, I saved it on the drive.
entries.literal: "Once I located the file corresponding to that camera, I saved it on the drive."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: With this, I can bring it to the other world too.
entries.literal: "With this, I can bring it to the other world too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew Katei would try to erase the saved footage, so I created a hidden folder on the computer where I copied the file.
entries.literal: "I knew Katei would try to erase the saved footage, so I created a hidden folder on the computer where I copied the file."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And I hope the police will find it in this world.
entries.literal: "...And I hope the police will find it in this world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps something else of value would be recorded, but I preferred to cut it short.
entries.literal: "Perhaps something else of value would be recorded, but I preferred to cut it short."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...After all, I soon heard someone running outside the security room. Then, that person appeared in hallway B.
entries.literal: "...After all, I soon heard someone running outside the security room. Then, that person appeared in hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was Naomi. She ran all the way down holding Katei's suitcase, and as she disappeared, another door opened.{w} From room B4, Shiroya and I appeared—Naomi had drawn us out. Then, Shiroya stared at the camera intensely, as if she was looking directly at me. Before I could even process it, they ran behind the sound, quickly vanishing from the frame.
entries.literal: "It was Naomi. She ran all the way down holding Katei's suitcase, and as she disappeared, another door opened.{w} From room B4, Shiroya and I appeared—Naomi had drawn us out. Then, Shiroya stared at the camera intensely, as if she was looking directly at me. Before I could even process it, they ran behind the sound, quickly vanishing from the frame."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh, what? Did she notice something about the camera? She didn't tell me about it, but I remember having to tug her shirt so that she'd follow me.
entries.literal: "Huh, what? Did she notice something about the camera? She didn't tell me about it, but I remember having to tug her shirt so that she'd follow me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And what was Naomi's role? Given how likely it was that Katei had killed her once, she might have intercepted him after resisting the smoke.
entries.literal: "And what was Naomi's role? Given how likely it was that Katei had killed her once, she might have intercepted him after resisting the smoke."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw us going up the stairs in hallway C, so I changed the cameras. They were all assigned random numbers, but I managed to display the second floor through a camera that'd been showing a crystal room.
entries.literal: "I saw us going up the stairs in hallway C, so I changed the cameras. They were all assigned random numbers, but I managed to display the second floor through a camera that'd been showing a crystal room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With Naomi in the lead, our past selves ran all the way up.
entries.literal: "With Naomi in the lead, our past selves ran all the way up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, is that Katei...?
entries.literal: "Oh, is that Katei...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was tailing us, but he collapsed at the stairs two floors above. When he stood up, it seemed like he'd given up on catching us, and with his eyes shut tight, he slowly walked back down.
entries.literal: "He was tailing us, but he collapsed at the stairs two floors above. When he stood up, it seemed like he'd given up on catching us, and with his eyes shut tight, he slowly walked back down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the sixth floor, where Naomi unlocked the attic. She stepped in, shortly followed by me and Shiroya.
entries.literal: "I looked at the sixth floor, where Naomi unlocked the attic. She stepped in, shortly followed by me and Shiroya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Is Katei gonna come here? I should leave.
entries.literal: "...Is Katei gonna come here? I should leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I made the monitor display the initial crystal room again and stepped out.
entries.literal: "I made the monitor display the initial crystal room again and stepped out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the lobby, but a clear problem was about to arise.
entries.literal: "I went to the lobby, but a clear problem was about to arise."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: My past self is going to go to the storeroom very soon, so I can't stay there again.
entries.literal: "My past self is going to go to the storeroom very soon, so I can't stay there again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I'm remembering correctly, in this world, the group didn't go to the security room after waking up. ...I can't risk staying there, though.
entries.literal: "If I'm remembering correctly, in this world, the group didn't go to the security room after waking up. ...I can't risk staying there, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept cleaning the smoke off me. It had touched me again, so I likely looked similar to how I had in the morning.
entries.literal: "I kept cleaning the smoke off me. It had touched me again, so I likely looked similar to how I had in the morning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei was the first to return. At a slow pace, he scanned the floor.
entries.literal: "Katei was the first to return. At a slow pace, he scanned the floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I just remembered when he said he'd used the security room's microphone while we were unconscious. That really was a blatant lie, which Akaro immediately realized if they weren't working together. Also, Katei will probably be confused when he finds out the security room's unlocked.
entries.literal: "...I just remembered when he said he'd used the security room's microphone while we were unconscious. That really was a blatant lie, which Akaro immediately realized if they weren't working together. Also, Katei will probably be confused when he finds out the security room's unlocked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stayed behind the reception desk. Once Katei was next to Erina's group, someone else had come down.
entries.literal: "I stayed behind the reception desk. Once Katei was next to Erina's group, someone else had come down."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My past self, who went straight to the storeroom. I was unable to find the rusty key in hallway A, so I stayed inside.
entries.literal: "My past self, who went straight to the storeroom. I was unable to find the rusty key in hallway A, so I stayed inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...What was going to happen? I'd hidden in the storeroom for hours, but I knew the way things played out would be vastly different from my world's set of events.
entries.literal: "...What was going to happen? I'd hidden in the storeroom for hours, but I knew the way things played out would be vastly different from my world's set of events."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Eventually, everyone would disappear, and after that, my past self would bring both Sekimeiya to the attic to experiment with them...
entries.literal: "Eventually, everyone would disappear, and after that, my past self would bring both Sekimeiya to the attic to experiment with them..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to hold on until that point, when the Sekimeiya would be within reach again.
entries.literal: "I had to hold on until that point, when the Sekimeiya would be within reach again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to be found, but I knew it could happen. The Atsuki originally from that world wasn't a past self of mine—him seeing me wouldn't be a contradiction.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to be found, but I knew it could happen. The Atsuki originally from that world wasn't a past self of mine—him seeing me wouldn't be a contradiction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The seconds began to tick by. I had no place where I could safely stay, so I had to keep moving, my whole objective being to smoothly return to one particular point.
entries.literal: "The seconds began to tick by. I had no place where I could safely stay, so I had to keep moving, my whole objective being to smoothly return to one particular point."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't travel forward in time to speed up the process because I hadn't been in the tower in the proportional past. However, I doubted I would have been willing to do that anyway.{w} ...To skip that last time I had... where Miiya existed. When I heard her voice, I couldn't stop myself from getting closer to the door.
entries.literal: "I couldn't travel forward in time to speed up the process because I hadn't been in the tower in the proportional past. However, I doubted I would have been willing to do that anyway.{w} ...To skip that last time I had... where Miiya existed. When I heard her voice, I couldn't stop myself from getting closer to the door."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...ou okay? I'm so—
entries.literal: "...ou okay? I'm so—"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Don't worry. No— ...our fault.
entries.literal: "Don't worry. No— ...our fault."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was there. It was proof that my effort wasn't worthless. But I couldn't even see her.
entries.literal: "She was there. It was proof that my effort wasn't worthless. But I couldn't even see her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Aware that they could come to the lobby at any point, I walked away.
entries.literal: "...Aware that they could come to the lobby at any point, I walked away."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After learning that they'd been trapped, the group saw the shutter for the first time. Then, once they stepped into hallway A, they directed themselves to the dark crystal room, A5.
entries.literal: "After learning that they'd been trapped, the group saw the shutter for the first time. Then, once they stepped into hallway A, they directed themselves to the dark crystal room, A5."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't what we'd done. ...They weren't surprised to see its stained walls.
entries.literal: "It wasn't what we'd done. ...They weren't surprised to see its stained walls."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And the security room, which should've been their priority, had been ignored completely.
entries.literal: "And the security room, which should've been their priority, had been ignored completely."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, huh. The suitcase isn't here this time.{w} Naomi ran up to the attic with it, and I didn't see it. But the Sekimeiya were on the sofa. It has to be that the suitcase was brought to our world as well, which is why we saw two.
entries.literal: "Oh, huh. The suitcase isn't here this time.{w} Naomi ran up to the attic with it, and I didn't see it. But the Sekimeiya were on the sofa. It has to be that the suitcase was brought to our world as well, which is why we saw two."

entries.speaker: k4
entries.text: ...There's a reason why I believe Naomi hid upstairs if she's part of this, like I suspect. Above us are five desolate floors full of offices. However, there's a seventh floor that we call the attic, or the Ashiya floor.
entries.literal: "...There's a reason why I believe Naomi hid upstairs if she's part of this, like I suspect. Above us are five desolate floors full of offices. However, there's a seventh floor that we call the attic, or the Ashiya floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Unable to use the elevator, they all walked up the stairs.
entries.literal: "Unable to use the elevator, they all walked up the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could follow them. It was good to know what their movements would be and the events that were bound to unfold. In the future, I could put that information to use.
entries.literal: "I could follow them. It was good to know what their movements would be and the events that were bound to unfold. In the future, I could put that information to use."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had already noticed that Katei's behavior and the things he was saying were different. The group was going up to find Naomi, who had locked herself in the attic. Unknown to them, Shiroya and I had unlocked it, and Naomi was no longer in the building.
entries.literal: "I had already noticed that Katei's behavior and the things he was saying were different. The group was going up to find Naomi, who had locked herself in the attic. Unknown to them, Shiroya and I had unlocked it, and Naomi was no longer in the building."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: On the second floor, the group looked through the offices. As expected, nothing was found, and they moved on to the third floor.
entries.literal: "On the second floor, the group looked through the offices. As expected, nothing was found, and they moved on to the third floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The same occurred upstairs.
entries.literal: "The same occurred upstairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I followed them when they were going to the fourth, but all of a sudden, someone walked back down while I was following them.
entries.literal: "I followed them when they were going to the fourth, but all of a sudden, someone walked back down while I was following them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't run all the way down, so I was only able to enter the first partition.
entries.literal: "I couldn't run all the way down, so I was only able to enter the first partition."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's me and Miiya...!
entries.literal: "That's me and Miiya...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From behind a desk, I saw them walking beyond the glass, which greatly muddled their voices.
entries.literal: "From behind a desk, I saw them walking beyond the glass, which greatly muddled their voices."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before I could breathe, Erina and Isla came down as well. They appeared to be following the other two.
entries.literal: "Before I could breathe, Erina and Isla came down as well. They appeared to be following the other two."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Was that it? No one else seemed to be coming.{w} Why had they gone down alone? As I wondered that, a fifth person came from the upper floor.
entries.literal: "...Was that it? No one else seemed to be coming.{w} Why had they gone down alone? As I wondered that, a fifth person came from the upper floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro. He looked deep in thought as he walked.{w} While I was still fazed, the sixth person appeared. Sai trailed behind Akaro as he disappeared beyond the glass.
entries.literal: "Akaro. He looked deep in thought as he walked.{w} While I was still fazed, the sixth person appeared. Sai trailed behind Akaro as he disappeared beyond the glass."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What the hell are they doing?{w} I remember this. When I was in the storeroom, everyone came back on their own. I heard different footsteps walking beyond the wall.
entries.literal: "...What the hell are they doing?{w} I remember this. When I was in the storeroom, everyone came back on their own. I heard different footsteps walking beyond the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept waiting. After all, someone was missing.
entries.literal: "I kept waiting. After all, someone was missing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where's Katei? Why is he the only person who hasn't come down?
entries.literal: "Where's Katei? Why is he the only person who hasn't come down?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't hear anything. Was he still above me?
entries.literal: "I couldn't hear anything. Was he still above me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Assuming that he wasn't coming, I slowly emerged from the partition. Why in the world had they left Katei alone? Trying not to reveal my presence, I approached the staircase and went up to the fourth floor.
entries.literal: "Assuming that he wasn't coming, I slowly emerged from the partition. Why in the world had they left Katei alone? Trying not to reveal my presence, I approached the staircase and went up to the fourth floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...There he was. I saw him walking toward the offices, looking a little disoriented.
entries.literal: "...There he was. I saw him walking toward the offices, looking a little disoriented."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead of inspecting them, he kept going up to the fifth floor.
entries.literal: "Instead of inspecting them, he kept going up to the fifth floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was he going to the attic? If so, why had everyone else gone down?
entries.literal: "Was he going to the attic? If so, why had everyone else gone down?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From the second floor, I looked down as I kept myself hidden. I could see that someone was in the security room based on the light coming out of it.
entries.literal: "From the second floor, I looked down as I kept myself hidden. I could see that someone was in the security room based on the light coming out of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, the event room opened, and I could see a single person's lower legs.
entries.literal: "Then, the event room opened, and I could see a single person's lower legs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Those were Sai's shoes. It seemed everyone was separated, so I couldn't keep going down.
entries.literal: "Those were Sai's shoes. It seemed everyone was separated, so I couldn't keep going down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Let me guess. The Sekimeiya is about to have disappeared from the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Let me guess. The Sekimeiya is about to have disappeared from the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I entered the offices again and stepped into the second so that I wouldn't be seen through the glass.
entries.literal: "I entered the offices again and stepped into the second so that I wouldn't be seen through the glass."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I did so, I caught a glimpse of Katei. He was walking toward the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "As soon as I did so, I caught a glimpse of Katei. He was walking toward the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell? Did he not see me?
entries.literal: "What the hell? Did he not see me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He walked past without looking at me. However, his timing left me confused. ...It was like he'd been waiting for me to step aside.
entries.literal: "He walked past without looking at me. However, his timing left me confused. ...It was like he'd been waiting for me to step aside."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I couldn't see his hands since they were held to his side, away from me, and he was likely just in the attic... It hasn't been very long, though.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see his hands since they were held to his side, away from me, and he was likely just in the attic... It hasn't been very long, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't care about it anymore. When they had switched worlds, everyone had been alive. That was what mattered.
entries.literal: "I didn't care about it anymore. When they had switched worlds, everyone had been alive. That was what mattered."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At that time, everyone was alive...
entries.literal: "At that time, everyone was alive..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, what about later? The first time we'd changed worlds was still in my memories.
entries.literal: "However, what about later? The first time we'd changed worlds was still in my memories."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When Erina touched the Sekimeiya in the event room, was the world we appeared in this one? ...Did everyone come back, or was it an entirely different world?
entries.literal: "When Erina touched the Sekimeiya in the event room, was the world we appeared in this one? ...Did everyone come back, or was it an entirely different world?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's gotta be this one, right? Miiya was alive, and we were told Shiroya was the one who died. For them, she hadn't been in the tower yet.
entries.literal: "It's gotta be this one, right? Miiya was alive, and we were told Shiroya was the one who died. For them, she hadn't been in the tower yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I remembered it, something else I'd heard made me grimace.
entries.literal: "When I remembered it, something else I'd heard made me grimace."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: And you too, Erina! I thought you'd died!
entries.literal: "And you too, Erina! I thought you'd died!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Was that the fate lying in wait in the world I was in? Was it not going to be one free of suffering...?
entries.literal: "...Was that the fate lying in wait in the world I was in? Was it not going to be one free of suffering...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: People came from below. It sounded like it was the group of four: my other self, Miiya, Erina, and Isla. Ignoring the three partitions, they walked up.{w} I could hear their steps above me, but they rapidly faded. ...Their destination was likely the attic.
entries.literal: "People came from below. It sounded like it was the group of four: my other self, Miiya, Erina, and Isla. Ignoring the three partitions, they walked up.{w} I could hear their steps above me, but they rapidly faded. ...Their destination was likely the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, just as I remembered it, a single person came from the crystal floor and proceeded to walk up, their steps hardly audible. That was repeated two more times, until the number of people who'd left the crystal floor was seven. Everyone had been completely unconcerned with the offices and gone straight up.
entries.literal: "Then, just as I remembered it, a single person came from the crystal floor and proceeded to walk up, their steps hardly audible. That was repeated two more times, until the number of people who'd left the crystal floor was seven. Everyone had been completely unconcerned with the offices and gone straight up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...They're all above me again, then.
entries.literal: "...They're all above me again, then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I waited in case someone else was yet to appear. A while later, nobody had come, so I cautiously left.
entries.literal: "I waited in case someone else was yet to appear. A while later, nobody had come, so I cautiously left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What were they all doing? What had caused those bizarre movements...?
entries.literal: "What were they all doing? What had caused those bizarre movements...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, I had to stop myself when I heard distant voices.
entries.literal: "Once again, I had to stop myself when I heard distant voices."

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: ...ese would make the noise. Why did you not wa—
entries.literal: "...ese would make the noise. Why did you not wa—"

entries.speaker: k4
entries.text: Because I didn't feel like humoring your condescending attitude. Are you satisfied now?
entries.literal: "Because I didn't feel like humoring your condescending attitude. Are you satisfied now?"

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: Hardly. What do they open? And what's this thing? ...Tape?
entries.literal: "Hardly. What do they open? And what's this thing? ...Tape?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh...! I left the duct tape in the security room!{w} It sounds like Katei found it.
entries.literal: "Oh...! I left the duct tape in the security room!{w} It sounds like Katei found it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They kept going up. They wanted to see whether one of the keys Katei had would unlock the attic.
entries.literal: "They kept going up. They wanted to see whether one of the keys Katei had would unlock the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It did. Once it was unlocked, everyone walked in.
entries.literal: "It did. Once it was unlocked, everyone walked in."

entries.speaker: nm
