entries.text: He had the keys. That means he got the keyring that Naomi left behind.{w} Since the attic was locked just now, he definitely locked it while he was up here before.
entries.literal: "He had the keys. That means he got the keyring that Naomi left behind.{w} Since the attic was locked just now, he definitely locked it while he was up here before."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't get closer, so I waited behind. Some minutes later, I heard the elevator once.
entries.literal: "I couldn't get closer, so I waited behind. Some minutes later, I heard the elevator once."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What? Is it working?{w} They just tried it on this floor, and it wasn't...
entries.literal: "...What? Is it working?{w} They just tried it on this floor, and it wasn't..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I frowned, I heard people walking out of the attic.
entries.literal: "While I frowned, I heard people walking out of the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I abandoned my thoughts and hid inside the offices, which was all I could do to avoid detection.
entries.literal: "I abandoned my thoughts and hid inside the offices, which was all I could do to avoid detection."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: From there, I saw the people who were walking down.{w} Myself, Miiya, and Katei.
entries.literal: "From there, I saw the people who were walking down.{w} Myself, Miiya, and Katei."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya...
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei was behind them, holding a white Sekimeiya in his hands. Although the two at the front weren't seeing it, pain was written clear across his face.
entries.literal: "Katei was behind them, holding a white Sekimeiya in his hands. Although the two at the front weren't seeing it, pain was written clear across his face."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He's purposely avoiding touching it with his skin! He must be in pain because the Sekimeiya's gathered energy since it was taken out of the cabinet! I bet he can barely hold it.
entries.literal: "He's purposely avoiding touching it with his skin! He must be in pain because the Sekimeiya's gathered energy since it was taken out of the cabinet! I bet he can barely hold it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They disappeared from my sight. It seemed that the maximum number of occupants, four people, had taken the elevator down.
entries.literal: "They disappeared from my sight. It seemed that the maximum number of occupants, four people, had taken the elevator down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Why did he only have one Sekimeiya? What about the other one?
entries.literal: "...Why did he only have one Sekimeiya? What about the other one?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once there was some distance between us, I went down the floors myself.
entries.literal: "Once there was some distance between us, I went down the floors myself."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They're all in the security room. That means the computer's already shut down.
entries.literal: "They're all in the security room. That means the computer's already shut down."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Katei has to be responsible. I don't know why they didn't all go to the security room immediately, but this is the same thing he did in the other world.
entries.literal: "...Katei has to be responsible. I don't know why they didn't all go to the security room immediately, but this is the same thing he did in the other world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A while later, the group went to the lobby. I was able to hear that they'd moved to hallway B, but any distinct sounds quickly faded.
entries.literal: "A while later, the group went to the lobby. I was able to hear that they'd moved to hallway B, but any distinct sounds quickly faded."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Did they enter a room?
entries.literal: "...Did they enter a room?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The indistinct sound was coming from the event room. They'd most likely left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "The indistinct sound was coming from the event room. They'd most likely left the Sekimeiya in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was soon after when they experienced something unnatural for the first time that day.
entries.literal: "It was soon after when they experienced something unnatural for the first time that day."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei's shout was cut short. Then, voices of incredulity came from hallway A.
entries.literal: "Katei's shout was cut short. Then, voices of incredulity came from hallway A."

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: ...at the fuck?
entries.literal: "...at the fuck?"

entries.speaker: ak4
entries.text: What— ...just do?
entries.literal: "What— ...just do?"

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: ...this man just teleport?
entries.literal: "...this man just teleport?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A sudden sentence I didn't expect came.
entries.literal: "A sudden sentence I didn't expect came."

entries.speaker: k4
entries.text: I just...{w} traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "I just...{w} traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The reality of their situation was told to them. Naturally, it wasn't something anyone could easily accept.
entries.literal: "The reality of their situation was told to them. Naturally, it wasn't something anyone could easily accept."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Why did Katei say that? He just touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in hallway A. ...Why did he immediately say that he'd traveled to the past?
entries.literal: "...Why did Katei say that? He just touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in hallway A. ...Why did he immediately say that he'd traveled to the past?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't understand. In my world, he had been completely opposed to the idea of time travel existing for a very long time.
entries.literal: "I didn't understand. In my world, he had been completely opposed to the idea of time travel existing for a very long time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Despite what had happened, Katei made them shut the Sekimeiya away before walking to the security room.
entries.literal: "Despite what had happened, Katei made them shut the Sekimeiya away before walking to the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The others remained inside the event room. Wanting to know what they were saying, I approached it slowly.
entries.literal: "The others remained inside the event room. Wanting to know what they were saying, I approached it slowly."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...efinitely working with Naomi. ...isn't being tru—
entries.literal: "...efinitely working with Naomi. ...isn't being tru—"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Unlock i—
entries.literal: "Unlock i—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door wasn't fully shut, but it was difficult to hear what they were saying. I still managed to understand that they had the key to unlock the cabinet.
entries.literal: "The door wasn't fully shut, but it was difficult to hear what they were saying. I still managed to understand that they had the key to unlock the cabinet."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...do we touch it?
entries.literal: "...do we touch it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's me.
entries.literal: "That's me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized I'd made a sound. In an attempt to hear better, I'd revealed my presence.
entries.literal: "I realized I'd made a sound. In an attempt to hear better, I'd revealed my presence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When they opened the door, I was already in hallway C. I'd been able to react fast enough.
entries.literal: "When they opened the door, I was already in hallway C. I'd been able to react fast enough."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They started coming out to find who'd been there. A little nervous, I retreated to the second floor.
entries.literal: "They started coming out to find who'd been there. A little nervous, I retreated to the second floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...They're looking into every room. I bet they think Naomi made the sound.
entries.literal: "...They're looking into every room. I bet they think Naomi made the sound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I started to get a bit worried, but the sound stopped. They weren't continuing to the other floors.
entries.literal: "I started to get a bit worried, but the sound stopped. They weren't continuing to the other floors."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I looked down, I saw they were back in the event room.
entries.literal: "When I looked down, I saw they were back in the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped forward slowly, making sure not to reveal myself again. They had just learned about time travel, so I really wanted to hear what was happening.
entries.literal: "I stepped forward slowly, making sure not to reveal myself again. They had just learned about time travel, so I really wanted to hear what was happening."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What is my other self thinking?{w} What is he thinking now that he's witnessed time travel for the first time? The events of November 30th... Did they occur as I imagine? If so, I don't have to wonder.
entries.literal: "...What is my other self thinking?{w} What is he thinking now that he's witnessed time travel for the first time? The events of November 30th... Did they occur as I imagine? If so, I don't have to wonder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It seemed Katei was still in the security room, so I got closer to hallway B.
entries.literal: "It seemed Katei was still in the security room, so I got closer to hallway B."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What!?
entries.literal: "What!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All of a sudden, the cleaning room opened. I stepped aside immediately, but I was able to see who'd been there.
entries.literal: "All of a sudden, the cleaning room opened. I stepped aside immediately, but I was able to see who'd been there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Sai. His footsteps grew fainter as he walked to the event room.
entries.literal: "...Sai. His footsteps grew fainter as he walked to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, when I glanced at the hallway, he wasn't there.
entries.literal: "However, when I glanced at the hallway, he wasn't there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was gone. His disappearance stunned me long enough that I didn't react to a door opening.
entries.literal: "He was gone. His disappearance stunned me long enough that I didn't react to a door opening."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: By the time I realized what had happened, I was staring into Miiya's eyes. She looked at me from the event room with a curious frown.
entries.literal: "By the time I realized what had happened, I was staring into Miiya's eyes. She looked at me from the event room with a curious frown."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Should I get closer...?
entries.literal: "Should I get closer...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could hardly believe that I was seeing her alive and well. Strangely, her look didn't seem to share the same puzzlement.
entries.literal: "I could hardly believe that I was seeing her alive and well. Strangely, her look didn't seem to share the same puzzlement."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a step forward, unable to take my eyes off her.
entries.literal: "I took a step forward, unable to take my eyes off her."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: So, i-it worked...? You went to the past?
entries.literal: "So, i-it worked...? You went to the past?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...What?{w} Did the other Atsuki just touch the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...What?{w} Did the other Atsuki just touch the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Um... Y-Yes. I suppose so.
entries.literal: "Um... Y-Yes. I suppose so."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. That's why Sai disappeared as well.
entries.literal: "I see. That's why Sai disappeared as well."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I can't... I can't believe it, though.
entries.literal: "I can't... I can't believe it, though."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: Is Sai not here?
entries.literal: "Is Sai not here?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Oh, y-you're right. I don't think he's been here for a bit.
entries.literal: "Oh, y-you're right. I don't think he's been here for a bit."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He, Katei, and the other Atsuki were missing. The group seemed equally perplexed about Sai's and my own disappearance.
entries.literal: "He, Katei, and the other Atsuki were missing. The group seemed equally perplexed about Sai's and my own disappearance."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...They think I'm the Atsuki who just disappeared. If he traveled to the past, I should leave before he's back.
entries.literal: "...They think I'm the Atsuki who just disappeared. If he traveled to the past, I should leave before he's back."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: How is this possible...? I don't get it, but if you went to the past, why didn't you appear in this room? That's what happened to Katei.
entries.literal: "How is this possible...? I don't get it, but if you went to the past, why didn't you appear in this room? That's what happened to Katei."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Given what I saw, Katei traveled just a few seconds through time. He must have touched the Sekimeiya as soon as it was removed from the cabinet.
entries.literal: "Given what I saw, Katei traveled just a few seconds through time. He must have touched the Sekimeiya as soon as it was removed from the cabinet."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't think I traveled a few seconds through time, but actually minutes. About twenty, I'd say.
entries.literal: "I don't think I traveled a few seconds through time, but actually minutes. About twenty, I'd say."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled the time they'd unlocked the cabinet again. If the other Atsuki had just touched it, his experience surely resembled what I was describing.
entries.literal: "I recalled the time they'd unlocked the cabinet again. If the other Atsuki had just touched it, his experience surely resembled what I was describing."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Oh, what? That long ago, we were still in the attic, right?
entries.literal: "Oh, what? That long ago, we were still in the attic, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I nodded, the air around me felt somehow dense. The situation was so surreal that I could hardly believe I was really there.
entries.literal: "As I nodded, the air around me felt somehow dense. The situation was so surreal that I could hardly believe I was really there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw the Sekimeiya near the hallway B door, sitting on top of its cushion. It was clearly gray.
entries.literal: "I saw the Sekimeiya near the hallway B door, sitting on top of its cushion. It was clearly gray."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: L-Let me see.
entries.literal: "L-Let me see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I placed my hand on it.
entries.literal: "I placed my hand on it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's not doing anything, and it's cold. ...It must do nothing when it's this color.{w} It's just a thought, but maybe I traveled farther because it spent more time out of the cabinet. When Katei touched it, it had barely been out for any time at all.
entries.literal: "It's not doing anything, and it's cold. ...It must do nothing when it's this color.{w} It's just a thought, but maybe I traveled farther because it spent more time out of the cabinet. When Katei touched it, it had barely been out for any time at all."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While everyone observed me, I put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet. In mere seconds, its white color returned.
entries.literal: "While everyone observed me, I put the Sekimeiya in the cabinet. In mere seconds, its white color returned."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: This again.
entries.literal: "This again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I still can't believe what just happened to me, but I think we should go along with what Katei said and leave this in the cabinet until we can leave.
entries.literal: "...I still can't believe what just happened to me, but I think we should go along with what Katei said and leave this in the cabinet until we can leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The keyring was inserted in the cabinet, so I gave it to Miiya after locking the wheel manually.
entries.literal: "The keyring was inserted in the cabinet, so I gave it to Miiya after locking the wheel manually."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I doubt they'll actually do that, but it'd be best if they did. If the Sekimeiya stays in here, all those tragedies won't happen.
entries.literal: "I doubt they'll actually do that, but it'd be best if they did. If the Sekimeiya stays in here, all those tragedies won't happen."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I mean, what else would we do?
entries.literal: "...I mean, what else would we do?"

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: ...Did you make the sound in hallway B earlier?
entries.literal: "...Did you make the sound in hallway B earlier?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh, yeah, I did. That was when I realized I had really traveled through time. I moved to the second floor fast enough to stay out of sight.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah, I did. That was when I realized I had really traveled through time. I moved to the second floor fast enough to stay out of sight."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: That's just insane. ...Were we actually searching for you? Where the hell is Naomi, then?
entries.literal: "That's just insane. ...Were we actually searching for you? Where the hell is Naomi, then?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Actually, where is Sai? That's another good question.
entries.literal: "Actually, where is Sai? That's another good question."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: I know he was with us when we searched this hallway.
entries.literal: "I know he was with us when we searched this hallway."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Did he go somewhere...?
entries.literal: "Did he go somewhere...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro looked through multiple doors, but he didn't find Sai.
entries.literal: "Akaro looked through multiple doors, but he didn't find Sai."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: He's not here. Did you see what happened to him?
entries.literal: "He's not here. Did you see what happened to him?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...No. I was on the second floor, so all I know is that he didn't go up.
entries.literal: "...No. I was on the second floor, so all I know is that he didn't go up."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: He's still here, then...
entries.literal: "He's still here, then..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We heard faint sounds coming from the security room.
entries.literal: "We heard faint sounds coming from the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Only Katei was there. While everyone entered, I stayed near the hallway, ready to leave at any time.
entries.literal: "...Only Katei was there. While everyone entered, I stayed near the hallway, ready to leave at any time."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...Oh, I haven't been able to fix anything. I apologize.
entries.literal: "...Oh, I haven't been able to fix anything. I apologize."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: He's doing the same thing as in my world.
entries.literal: "He's doing the same thing as in my world."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I am completely lost; I don't even know what the issue is. Everything is properly arranged and connected, so unless no electricity is reaching the outlets, I'm out of ideas.
entries.literal: "I am completely lost; I don't even know what the issue is. Everything is properly arranged and connected, so unless no electricity is reaching the outlets, I'm out of ideas."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei crouched under the desk, inspecting things once again.
entries.literal: "Katei crouched under the desk, inspecting things once again."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: And you still haven't found Naomi... You were inspecting this floor just now, right?
entries.literal: "And you still haven't found Naomi... You were inspecting this floor just now, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Yes. She wasn't here.
entries.literal: "Yes. She wasn't here."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: That's very strange. She might have been able to keep dodging us, but there's no way that'll work for too long. There's no place where she could hide forever.
entries.literal: "That's very strange. She might have been able to keep dodging us, but there's no way that'll work for too long. There's no place where she could hide forever."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept looking at the staircase, wondering where the other Atsuki was. I was sure he had appeared in the past with Sai, but it was unusual that he hadn't shown himself yet.{w} The door to the lobby was open. As it was likely he was on a higher floor, I wanted to leave as soon as I saw him returning.
entries.literal: "I kept looking at the staircase, wondering where the other Atsuki was. I was sure he had appeared in the past with Sai, but it was unusual that he hadn't shown himself yet.{w} The door to the lobby was open. As it was likely he was on a higher floor, I wanted to leave as soon as I saw him returning."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait a second. Am I falling for it again?{w} Katei touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in hallway A. He had just been there, as he'd walked from the security room to the event room.{w} He appeared in a past location! He could've gone to the future.
entries.literal: "Wait a second. Am I falling for it again?{w} Katei touched the Sekimeiya and appeared in hallway A. He had just been there, as he'd walked from the security room to the event room.{w} He appeared in a past location! He could've gone to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could see the cabinet in the event room from where I was. What was inside it at that moment was the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I could see the cabinet in the event room from where I was. What was inside it at that moment was the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The only reason they think we went to the past is due to what Katei said. "I just... traveled to the past."
entries.literal: "The only reason they think we went to the past is due to what Katei said. \"I just... traveled to the past.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why the hell did he say that!? He was carefully holding the Sekimeiya without touching it with his skin, so he knew about its powers...{w} If he had traveled to the past before, it's very likely that's what he assumed just happened again. He went a couple seconds to the future, so he couldn't notice his own misinterpretation. Unless he lied on purpose, I guess.
entries.literal: "Why the hell did he say that!? He was carefully holding the Sekimeiya without touching it with his skin, so he knew about its powers...{w} If he had traveled to the past before, it's very likely that's what he assumed just happened again. He went a couple seconds to the future, so he couldn't notice his own misinterpretation. Unless he lied on purpose, I guess."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: ...Is there anything...{w} Oh, the elevator?
entries.literal: "...Is there anything...{w} Oh, the elevator?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Miiya saw that I'd been looking ahead. When she followed my line of sight, she noticed the elevator wasn't properly closed.
entries.literal: "Miiya saw that I'd been looking ahead. When she followed my line of sight, she noticed the elevator wasn't properly closed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's not closed, yeah.
entries.literal: "It's not closed, yeah."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What...?
entries.literal: "What...?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Oh, it's been like that for a while. I noticed it when we walked down from the attic and figured the others purposely left it like that.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's been like that for a while. I noticed it when we walked down from the attic and figured the others purposely left it like that."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: We didn't.
entries.literal: "We didn't."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: It must not have closed properly when you got off, then. I've seen it happen in the past.
entries.literal: "It must not have closed properly when you got off, then. I've seen it happen in the past."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm, I see. I didn't notice it.
entries.literal: "Hm, I see. I didn't notice it."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: Me neither.
entries.literal: "Me neither."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I wonder what I should do. I can't change my version of what happened, but the other Atsuki didn't travel to the past. ...Neither did Sai. That's why they're not back yet.
entries.literal: "I wonder what I should do. I can't change my version of what happened, but the other Atsuki didn't travel to the past. ...Neither did Sai. That's why they're not back yet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What I said still applies, though. They went about twenty minutes to the future. That's when they'll return.
entries.literal: "What I said still applies, though. They went about twenty minutes to the future. That's when they'll return."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: ...Wait, I just remembered the hallway B camera. The one that had its lens completely clean.
entries.literal: "...Wait, I just remembered the hallway B camera. The one that had its lens completely clean."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, they did notice it.
entries.literal: "Oh, they did notice it."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Excuse me...?
entries.literal: "Excuse me...?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Right, the one above the door to the lobby.
entries.literal: "Right, the one above the door to the lobby."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: Yeah, and the footage was being displayed up there.
entries.literal: "Yeah, and the footage was being displayed up there."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Are you serious?
entries.literal: "Are you serious?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That makes sense. When they went to the security room, the computer wasn't disabled yet.
entries.literal: "That makes sense. When they went to the security room, the computer wasn't disabled yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei and Akaro ran out of the room to confirm what we were saying.
entries.literal: "Katei and Akaro ran out of the room to confirm what we were saying."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: You saw it, right?
entries.literal: "You saw it, right?"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What the hell...? Was it cleaned?
entries.literal: "What the hell...? Was it cleaned?"

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: There's no way we would know.
entries.literal: "There's no way we would know."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...I don't have it anymore, but do you remember when—
entries.literal: "...I don't have it anymore, but do you remember when—"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Wait, where the hell is Sai?
entries.literal: "Wait, where the hell is Sai?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei was told that Sai had recently vanished. Before he could begin to spit out more of his nonsense, Akaro forced him to hold off.
entries.literal: "Katei was told that Sai had recently vanished. Before he could begin to spit out more of his nonsense, Akaro forced him to hold off."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: What were you gonna say? We've already searched for Sai, and the Sekimeiya's locked in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "What were you gonna say? We've already searched for Sai, and the Sekimeiya's locked in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...{w}The duct tape, remember? Sai took out my keyring, and it had a piece of duct tape attached to it. That piece had smoke residue on it.
entries.literal: "...{w}The duct tape, remember? Sai took out my keyring, and it had a piece of duct tape attached to it. That piece had smoke residue on it."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: I know it was duct tape because one side was still sticky, which means that it was only hit on the front side. In other words, it was stuck somewhere when the smoke was released.
entries.literal: "I know it was duct tape because one side was still sticky, which means that it was only hit on the front side. In other words, it was stuck somewhere when the smoke was released."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: Where did it even come from?
entries.literal: "Where did it even come from?"

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: ...{w}When I walked down to the crystal floor, searching for you, I found it hidden behind a handrail and put it in my pocket to inquire about it. That's when it got stuck to the keyring.
entries.literal: "...{w}When I walked down to the crystal floor, searching for you, I found it hidden behind a handrail and put it in my pocket to inquire about it. That's when it got stuck to the keyring."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hidden behind the handrail? I think it fell to the floor when I was here. He probably found it when he was unplugging some cables.
entries.literal: "Hidden behind the handrail? I think it fell to the floor when I was here. He probably found it when he was unplugging some cables."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been quiet for a while, so I decided to speak. My voice came out rougher than I intended.
entries.literal: "I'd been quiet for a while, so I decided to speak. My voice came out rougher than I intended."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So it was placed on the lens of that camera, which prevented the smoke from hitting it. Afterward, it was removed...{w} I'm confused about a few things. Why would someone do that? They had to already know the smoke attack would happen.
entries.literal: "So it was placed on the lens of that camera, which prevented the smoke from hitting it. Afterward, it was removed...{w} I'm confused about a few things. Why would someone do that? They had to already know the smoke attack would happen."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: And it was removed before we entered the security room.
entries.literal: "And it was removed before we entered the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei sighed, dramatically sitting on his chair.
entries.literal: "Katei sighed, dramatically sitting on his chair."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: What the hell is Naomi doing...? We can't even use the computer to figure anything out.{w} Do you all think Sai ran away on his own? Now we need to find both of them.
entries.literal: "What the hell is Naomi doing...? We can't even use the computer to figure anything out.{w} Do you all think Sai ran away on his own? Now we need to find both of them."

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: We lost track of him when we were searching this hallway, which would've been a good opportunity to sneak away. I have no idea why he'd do that, though.
entries.literal: "We lost track of him when we were searching this hallway, which would've been a good opportunity to sneak away. I have no idea why he'd do that, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei, clearly agitated, pressed the computer's power button again while looking at all the blank monitors.
entries.literal: "Katei, clearly agitated, pressed the computer's power button again while looking at all the blank monitors."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Maybe now you can believe that he was the one up to something. I'm just trying to do my job.
entries.literal: "Maybe now you can believe that he was the one up to something. I'm just trying to do my job."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: None of us responded. For some reason, everyone looked tired. It seemed no one had the will to go find Sai.
entries.literal: "None of us responded. For some reason, everyone looked tired. It seemed no one had the will to go find Sai."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I remained quiet along with them, but that was because I was counting the seconds. I figured it had been close to twenty minutes since the other Atsuki and Sai had disappeared.
entries.literal: "I remained quiet along with them, but that was because I was counting the seconds. I figured it had been close to twenty minutes since the other Atsuki and Sai had disappeared."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The empty screens were the only place anyone was looking. That was all I needed to silently escape, retreating until I was safely in the lobby.
entries.literal: "The empty screens were the only place anyone was looking. That was all I needed to silently escape, retreating until I was safely in the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody noticed that I'd left. Soon after my departure, Sai and the other Atsuki returned.
entries.literal: "Nobody noticed that I'd left. Soon after my departure, Sai and the other Atsuki returned."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wondered what would happen next. Would they realize what had occurred? Two Sekimeiya had been hidden somewhere, and just like in my world, their very existence was concealed.
entries.literal: "I wondered what would happen next. Would they realize what had occurred? Two Sekimeiya had been hidden somewhere, and just like in my world, their very existence was concealed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: During the time I'd been hiding in the storeroom, there was an extended period of complete silence; I'd only heard sporadic footsteps every now and then.
entries.literal: "During the time I'd been hiding in the storeroom, there was an extended period of complete silence; I'd only heard sporadic footsteps every now and then."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Although my perspective had grown wider, that was all that happened. However, I was able to understand it better from a distance, keeping my presence a secret thanks to the layout of the floor.
entries.literal: "Although my perspective had grown wider, that was all that happened. However, I was able to understand it better from a distance, keeping my presence a secret thanks to the layout of the floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The people in the security room split up. Atsuki, Miiya, Sai, and Katei went up the stairs. For a very long time, Atsuki and Miiya didn't come back.
entries.literal: "The people in the security room split up. Atsuki, Miiya, Sai, and Katei went up the stairs. For a very long time, Atsuki and Miiya didn't come back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Meanwhile, although calmness seemed to permeate the crystal floor, that was far from the truth.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, although calmness seemed to permeate the crystal floor, that was far from the truth."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai and Katei had returned. Everyone who I knew was on the crystal floor wanted the Sekimeiya. Not just the one in the cabinet, but the two hidden ones as well.
entries.literal: "Sai and Katei had returned. Everyone who I knew was on the crystal floor wanted the Sekimeiya. Not just the one in the cabinet, but the two hidden ones as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw it with my own eyes. When Katei thought no one was watching, he took the Future Sekimeiya. The cabinet was locked, so he had a spare key.
entries.literal: "I saw it with my own eyes. When Katei thought no one was watching, he took the Future Sekimeiya. The cabinet was locked, so he had a spare key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, he brought it to room B4. Strangely, like in the previous world, he chose not to hide it in the storeroom's secret area.
entries.literal: "Then, he brought it to room B4. Strangely, like in the previous world, he chose not to hide it in the storeroom's secret area."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At that point, I realized that I'd been mistaken. I wasn't the only one to notice Katei.
entries.literal: "At that point, I realized that I'd been mistaken. I wasn't the only one to notice Katei."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After he left, it was Akaro who entered that room, hiding the Sekimeiya behind his back as he stepped out.
entries.literal: "After he left, it was Akaro who entered that room, hiding the Sekimeiya behind his back as he stepped out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They both wanted to obtain all the Sekimeiya, and it became evident that Akaro and Katei weren't working together. Along with Sai, they continued silently working toward their objective.
entries.literal: "They both wanted to obtain all the Sekimeiya, and it became evident that Akaro and Katei weren't working together. Along with Sai, they continued silently working toward their objective."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At one point, Erina and Isla remained in one of hallway A's crystal rooms, while the other Atsuki and Miiya were likely in the attic. It was hard to decipher everyone's goal, but all I wanted was to let the minutes keep passing without interruptions.
entries.literal: "At one point, Erina and Isla remained in one of hallway A's crystal rooms, while the other Atsuki and Miiya were likely in the attic. It was hard to decipher everyone's goal, but all I wanted was to let the minutes keep passing without interruptions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It had been a while since Katei had entered one of the crystal rooms. ...I knew one of the Sekimeiya was there.
entries.literal: "It had been a while since Katei had entered one of the crystal rooms. ...I knew one of the Sekimeiya was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Had he activated it? I looked through the door and saw an open cabinet. Inside, there was a gray Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Had he activated it? I looked through the door and saw an open cabinet. Inside, there was a gray Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I figured that he would've traveled more than an hour through time, and the fact that I hadn't seen him yet seemed to imply he'd gone to the future.
entries.literal: "I figured that he would've traveled more than an hour through time, and the fact that I hadn't seen him yet seemed to imply he'd gone to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It appeared Katei was out of the picture, but Sai and Akaro were still around. When I saw them, they were looking for Katei, but they located the Future Sekimeiya instead.
entries.literal: "It appeared Katei was out of the picture, but Sai and Akaro were still around. When I saw them, they were looking for Katei, but they located the Future Sekimeiya instead."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Since they were together, neither one revealed their true colors, and they brought it to its cabinet.
entries.literal: "Since they were together, neither one revealed their true colors, and they brought it to its cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...However, as expected, it was Akaro who later took it out again.
entries.literal: "...However, as expected, it was Akaro who later took it out again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was witnessing a bizarre play. No matter how many details I was missing, their movements felt ridiculous. I considered that they might have been relocating the Sekimeiya so early in the off chance the shutter opened before the deadline.
entries.literal: "I was witnessing a bizarre play. No matter how many details I was missing, their movements felt ridiculous. I considered that they might have been relocating the Sekimeiya so early in the off chance the shutter opened before the deadline."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The same thing repeated. The Sekimeiya was found in one of the drawers in the lobby. That time, when they brought it to the cabinet, I heard what they were saying.
entries.literal: "The same thing repeated. The Sekimeiya was found in one of the drawers in the lobby. That time, when they brought it to the cabinet, I heard what they were saying."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were blaming the people who'd disappeared. Although they themselves were responsible, Katei, the other Atsuki, and Miiya were the hidden culprits according to their narrative. It appeared they had locked themselves up in the attic.
entries.literal: "They were blaming the people who'd disappeared. Although they themselves were responsible, Katei, the other Atsuki, and Miiya were the hidden culprits according to their narrative. It appeared they had locked themselves up in the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, the Sekimeiya didn't remain in the cabinet for long. However, as I saw it being brought to the lobby, a sound in hallway A caught my ear.
entries.literal: "Of course, the Sekimeiya didn't remain in the cabinet for long. However, as I saw it being brought to the lobby, a sound in hallway A caught my ear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other Atsuki and Miiya were back. I saw them in the security room.{w} I didn't understand what they'd been doing. ...Why would they have locked themselves in the attic? And why had they returned?{w} Suddenly, a sound drew them to the lobby.
entries.literal: "The other Atsuki and Miiya were back. I saw them in the security room.{w} I didn't understand what they'd been doing. ...Why would they have locked themselves in the attic? And why had they returned?{w} Suddenly, a sound drew them to the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I had already been in the tower for hours. I didn't think a lot of time was left until they would all vanish from the bottom floor.
entries.literal: "...I had already been in the tower for hours. I didn't think a lot of time was left until they would all vanish from the bottom floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd tried to keep my distance from everyone, but seeing Miiya again made me slowly approach the entrance area.
entries.literal: "I'd tried to keep my distance from everyone, but seeing Miiya again made me slowly approach the entrance area."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood next to the far door. ...Were they on the other side of it? I couldn't hear anyone.
entries.literal: "I stood next to the far door. ...Were they on the other side of it? I couldn't hear anyone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Instead, the faint voices I heard came from the event room.
entries.literal: "Instead, the faint voices I heard came from the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was instantly alarmed. If they looked at the hallway, I would be seen.{w} I couldn't go to the lobby, and walking back could lead to me being noticed.
entries.literal: "I was instantly alarmed. If they looked at the hallway, I would be seen.{w} I couldn't go to the lobby, and walking back could lead to me being noticed."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Wait. Erina and Isla aren't there anymore.
entries.literal: "...Wait. Erina and Isla aren't there anymore."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The door of room A1 was slightly open. It made me gasp at first, but I quickly saw that the room was empty.
entries.literal: "The door of room A1 was slightly open. It made me gasp at first, but I quickly saw that the room was empty."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Are they the ones in the event room, then?
entries.literal: "...Are they the ones in the event room, then?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have time to think, so I stepped in.
entries.literal: "I didn't have time to think, so I stepped in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stayed tense by the door, unaware of whether I could leave. Someone was in the event room, and I didn't know their identity.
entries.literal: "I stayed tense by the door, unaware of whether I could leave. Someone was in the event room, and I didn't know their identity."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...However, I couldn't hear anything from the lobby. Maybe they were no longer there.
entries.literal: "...However, I couldn't hear anything from the lobby. Maybe they were no longer there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I got closer to the wall and tried to listen through it.
entries.literal: "I got closer to the wall and tried to listen through it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Nothing.
entries.literal: "Nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to leave without being sure, but my fear was that Erina and Isla would return.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to leave without being sure, but my fear was that Erina and Isla would return."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could hear sporadic sounds, likely coming from the event room. They kept me trapped behind that door for minutes until I noticed someone walking on the other side.
entries.literal: "I could hear sporadic sounds, likely coming from the event room. They kept me trapped behind that door for minutes until I noticed someone walking on the other side."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Their faint steps went off to the lobby, which let me release the breath I'd been holding.
entries.literal: "Their faint steps went off to the lobby, which let me release the breath I'd been holding."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I put my ear against the wall, the area still sounded vacant. That time, though, I knew for sure that someone was there.
entries.literal: "When I put my ear against the wall, the area still sounded vacant. That time, though, I knew for sure that someone was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I focused intently. Suddenly, I heard an unexpected voice.
entries.literal: "I focused intently. Suddenly, I heard an unexpected voice."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...ou there?
entries.literal: "...ou there?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What?{w} ...Who is that?
entries.literal: "What?{w} ...Who is that?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...es! ...ower!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was shocked. That voice didn't belong to anyone who should've been in the tower.
entries.literal: "I was shocked. That voice didn't belong to anyone who should've been in the tower."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned my head abruptly. ...Had someone just come out of the security room?{w} I was fairly sure I'd sensed that, but I kept paying attention to the lobby.
entries.literal: "I turned my head abruptly. ...Had someone just come out of the security room?{w} I was fairly sure I'd sensed that, but I kept paying attention to the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next time I heard it, the intensity of the voice was higher.
entries.literal: "The next time I heard it, the intensity of the voice was higher."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Hey! ...there!
entries.literal: "Hey! ...there!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was enough to let me confirm who it was.
entries.literal: "That was enough to let me confirm who it was."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Suripo...! That's him!
entries.literal: "Suripo...! That's him!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was absurd for him to be inside, but I couldn't worry about it. I had to concentrate on what was happening behind the wall.
entries.literal: "It was absurd for him to be inside, but I couldn't worry about it. I had to concentrate on what was happening behind the wall."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Someone ran. That was all I could make out.{w} Then, a noise like someone collapsing.
entries.literal: "Someone ran. That was all I could make out.{w} Then, a noise like someone collapsing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}What? Is he gone?
entries.literal: "...{w}What? Is he gone?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next thing I heard didn't come from the direction of the lobby. It came from the wall behind me.
entries.literal: "The next thing I heard didn't come from the direction of the lobby. It came from the wall behind me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is... someone there?
entries.literal: "Is... someone there?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Behind it should've been one of hallway B's crystal rooms, B1.
entries.literal: "Behind it should've been one of hallway B's crystal rooms, B1."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...But, again, that was the last sound I heard before silence enveloped the building once more.
entries.literal: "...But, again, that was the last sound I heard before silence enveloped the building once more."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't been mistaken. I'd heard Suripo's voice coming from the lobby.
entries.literal: "I hadn't been mistaken. I'd heard Suripo's voice coming from the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could the shutter have unlocked? There was no way. I knew the tower would be sealed off for quite a while longer.
entries.literal: "Could the shutter have unlocked? There was no way. I knew the tower would be sealed off for quite a while longer."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How? How the hell was that Suripo? How did he get in?
entries.literal: "How? How the hell was that Suripo? How did he get in?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Did he enter through the storeroom?{w} No. What am I thinking? My past self is currently there.
entries.literal: "Did he enter through the storeroom?{w} No. What am I thinking? My past self is currently there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wanted to see it with my own eyes, but I couldn't afford to leave; I didn't know where anyone was.
entries.literal: "I wanted to see it with my own eyes, but I couldn't afford to leave; I didn't know where anyone was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Hallway A sounded empty as well, but I remained in that room. A short time later, faraway sounds made it clear I wasn't alone. I continued to bide my time in the hope that everyone else would congregate and I'd be able to slip away.
entries.literal: "Hallway A sounded empty as well, but I remained in that room. A short time later, faraway sounds made it clear I wasn't alone. I continued to bide my time in the hope that everyone else would congregate and I'd be able to slip away."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Wh—!

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After a few minutes had passed, a sudden gasp caused my eyes to shoot wide open. Miiya was behind the door, and I could hear myself as well.
entries.literal: "After a few minutes had passed, a sudden gasp caused my eyes to shoot wide open. Miiya was behind the door, and I could hear myself as well."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Oh...!{w} D-Did I just appear out of nowhere?
entries.literal: "Oh...!{w} D-Did I just appear out of nowhere?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What...? No, that's what happened to me.
entries.literal: "What...? No, that's what happened to me."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...Wait.
entries.literal: "...Wait."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Were you just in the mechanical room?
entries.literal: "Were you just in the mechanical room?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Yes... I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago.
entries.literal: "Yes... I touched the Sekimeiya a second ago."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I showed up here as soon as you did that. Are we in the past...?
entries.literal: "I showed up here as soon as you did that. Are we in the past...?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...{w}It teleported you as well? How come that didn't happen the other times?
entries.literal: "...{w}It teleported you as well? How come that didn't happen the other times?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: And both of us appeared here...
entries.literal: "And both of us appeared here..."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Hey! What the fuck...!? Where have you two been!?
entries.literal: "Hey! What the fuck...!? Where have you two been!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's Sai. I'm pretty sure he's in the event room.
entries.literal: "That's Sai. I'm pretty sure he's in the event room."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...Has anything happened?
entries.literal: "...Has anything happened?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What...!? You've been gone for over two hours! Answer the question!
entries.literal: "What...!? You've been gone for over two hours! Answer the question!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So this is the first time they've seen Miiya and the other Atsuki since they went upstairs.
entries.literal: "So this is the first time they've seen Miiya and the other Atsuki since they went upstairs."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They were in the security room earlier, though. They weren't seen because they traveled to the future. The Future Sekimeiya was brought to the lobby, and they activated it. They just appeared in front of the security room, where they were in the past.
entries.literal: "They were in the security room earlier, though. They weren't seen because they traveled to the future. The Future Sekimeiya was brought to the lobby, and they activated it. They just appeared in front of the security room, where they were in the past."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were in the event room, but I couldn't pick up anything.{w} That was until Sai yelled.
entries.literal: "They were in the event room, but I couldn't pick up anything.{w} That was until Sai yelled."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...H-Hey! What the fuck have you been doing!?
entries.literal: "...H-Hey! What the fuck have you been doing!?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: You found them too...?
entries.literal: "You found them too...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Akaro's voice came from the hallway.
entries.literal: "Akaro's voice came from the hallway."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...ere sleeping alo— ...you been?
entries.literal: "...ere sleeping alo— ...you been?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...I've been here.{w} *sigh*
entries.literal: "...I've been here.{w} *sigh*"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh...! Katei's here again!
entries.literal: "Oh...! Katei's here again!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...here this whole time. I didn't go anywhere.
entries.literal: "...here this whole time. I didn't go anywhere."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: His words suddenly connected the dots. I understood what had happened.
entries.literal: "His words suddenly connected the dots. I understood what had happened."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Right. Katei went to the future a while ago. The range was large, so I bet it barely reached outside the tower.{w} It reached far enough to include Suripo, and they went far forward in time.{w} The locations match. Before the attack, Suripo was in the lobby, near the front door. At the time, Katei was still in the security room. That's where they appeared just now.{w} Those locations are from a time before the smoke was released; Katei's clothes should have no smoke on them. They were pretty clean anyway, so I doubt anyone would notice that.
entries.literal: "...Right. Katei went to the future a while ago. The range was large, so I bet it barely reached outside the tower.{w} It reached far enough to include Suripo, and they went far forward in time.{w} The locations match. Before the attack, Suripo was in the lobby, near the front door. At the time, Katei was still in the security room. That's where they appeared just now.{w} Those locations are from a time before the smoke was released; Katei's clothes should have no smoke on them. They were pretty clean anyway, so I doubt anyone would notice that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei and Akaro had entered the event room, so I gave up on understanding what they were saying.
entries.literal: "Katei and Akaro had entered the event room, so I gave up on understanding what they were saying."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where the hell is Suripo now, though!?
entries.literal: "Where the hell is Suripo now, though!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Where was he when I was in the attic experimenting with the Sekimeiya? Did he change worlds as well?
entries.literal: "Where was he when I was in the attic experimenting with the Sekimeiya? Did he change worlds as well?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Wh...! ...you hear that!?
entries.literal: "Wh...! ...you hear that!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Huh?
entries.literal: "Huh?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My own voice shouted those words. I frowned, as I hadn't heard anything.
entries.literal: "My own voice shouted those words. I frowned, as I hadn't heard anything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everyone came out of the event room and approached the lobby.
entries.literal: "Everyone came out of the event room and approached the lobby."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Who...{w} is this?
entries.literal: "Who...{w} is this?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, Suripo's still there.
entries.literal: "Oh, Suripo's still there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It was the next person to talk who left me in a daze.
entries.literal: "...It was the next person to talk who left me in a daze."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Ah! Isla, stay over there!
entries.literal: "Ah! Isla, stay over there!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Isn't he...!?
entries.literal: "Isn't he...!?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Wait, I recognize him too. Wasn't he there?
entries.literal: "Wait, I recognize him too. Wasn't he there?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Y-Yes... That's where I s-saw him, while we were waiting. Fuck.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes... That's where I s-saw him, while we were waiting. Fuck."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That terror in my voice... It was easily recognizable.
entries.literal: "That terror in my voice... It was easily recognizable."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Don't tell me...
entries.literal: "Don't tell me..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They all stepped in.
entries.literal: "They all stepped in."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...een here at the tower recently. I don't know his name, but he was inves— ...attack.
entries.literal: "...een here at the tower recently. I don't know his name, but he was inves— ...attack."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...{w}This is a knife wound.
entries.literal: "...{w}This is a knife wound."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: No way... A knife wound?
entries.literal: "No way... A knife wound?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't believe what I was hearing. Suripo had been killed? ...I'd never looked at the lobby.
entries.literal: "I couldn't believe what I was hearing. Suripo had been killed? ...I'd never looked at the lobby."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: You've been missing for the last three hours. Just as you reappear— ...no coincidence.
entries.literal: "You've been missing for the last three hours. Just as you reappear— ...no coincidence."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What the hell are you talking about? How would I have left!?
entries.literal: "What the hell are you talking about? How would I have left!?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I cannot believe what I'm hearing! I've been here the entire time!
entries.literal: "I cannot believe what I'm hearing! I've been here the entire time!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Yes, look at this! This is why I thought it must've been a knife. It was his own!
entries.literal: "Yes, look at this! This is why I thought it must've been a knife. It was his own!"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...his knife is gone. ...saw that he had a knife right here—
entries.literal: "...his knife is gone. ...saw that he had a knife right here—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait... the knife was Suripo's?
entries.literal: "Wait... the knife was Suripo's?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If that's the case, the knife Sai chased us with... Where the hell did he get it from?
entries.literal: "If that's the case, the knife Sai chased us with... Where the hell did he get it from?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They found a walkie-talkie on him, but it seemed it had been damaged, and its battery was missing.
entries.literal: "They found a walkie-talkie on him, but it seemed it had been damaged, and its battery was missing."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This happened just now. When I heard him talking, he was having a conversation with the policemen outside.
entries.literal: "This happened just now. When I heard him talking, he was having a conversation with the policemen outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Who the hell would've killed Suripo immediately after seeing him? I distinctly remembered that someone had entered the lobby seconds before I'd heard his voice.
entries.literal: "Who the hell would've killed Suripo immediately after seeing him? I distinctly remembered that someone had entered the lobby seconds before I'd heard his voice."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And breaking the walkie-talkie... Was that done so that the group couldn't communicate with the outside, or was it done so that Suripo couldn't keep talking to them?
entries.literal: "And breaking the walkie-talkie... Was that done so that the group couldn't communicate with the outside, or was it done so that Suripo couldn't keep talking to them?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Listening to the conversation, I grew a bit more confused.{w} According to the other me, Suripo hadn't been dead six minutes previously, so nobody could've killed him.
entries.literal: "Listening to the conversation, I grew a bit more confused.{w} According to the other me, Suripo hadn't been dead six minutes previously, so nobody could've killed him."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But that's wrong. He was dead six minutes ago.{w} Why is he saying that? ...Six minutes ago, I bet that version of me was already traveling to the future. There's no way he saw the lobby. Miiya's agreeing with him, though.
entries.literal: "But that's wrong. He was dead six minutes ago.{w} Why is he saying that? ...Six minutes ago, I bet that version of me was already traveling to the future. There's no way he saw the lobby. Miiya's agreeing with him, though."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I kept listening, I understood that their misinterpretation was the same—they thought they had gone to the past. If that was the case, none of them could have killed Suripo.
entries.literal: "As I kept listening, I understood that their misinterpretation was the same—they thought they had gone to the past. If that was the case, none of them could have killed Suripo."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This doesn't make sense, though. Sai just said it's {time=13:23.}
entries.literal: "This doesn't make sense, though. Sai just said it's {time=13:23.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's what led Atsuki to say that Suripo was alive six minutes ago. At {time=13:17}, they'd seen the lobby was empty.
entries.literal: "That's what led Atsuki to say that Suripo was alive six minutes ago. At {time=13:17}, they'd seen the lobby was empty."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: For that to make sense, the other Atsuki had to know the time before traveling to the future. But if he knew the time before traveling, hearing the time Sai gave should've revealed that they went to the future.
entries.literal: "For that to make sense, the other Atsuki had to know the time before traveling to the future. But if he knew the time before traveling, hearing the time Sai gave should've revealed that they went to the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Oh!{w} That's not actually right!
entries.literal: "...{w}Oh!{w} That's not actually right!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At {time=13:17}, the lobby was empty. That was before they traveled to the future, and somehow, they knew what the time was. They just said that they touched the Sekimeiya in the mechanical room.
entries.literal: "At {time=13:17}, the lobby was empty. That was before they traveled to the future, and somehow, they knew what the time was. They just said that they touched the Sekimeiya in the mechanical room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: More than twenty minutes have passed since I saw them in the security room, which was right after the Future Sekimeiya was taken out of the cabinet. Since they reappeared in hallway A, they went ten minutes to the future once the Sekimeiya had gathered power for ten minutes. Something like that.
entries.literal: "More than twenty minutes have passed since I saw them in the security room, which was right after the Future Sekimeiya was taken out of the cabinet. Since they reappeared in hallway A, they went ten minutes to the future once the Sekimeiya had gathered power for ten minutes. Something like that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Atsuki and Miiya appeared at around {time=13:37.} The key to this is Sai's wristwatch.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Miiya appeared at around {time=13:37.} The key to this is Sai's wristwatch."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Earlier, Sai traveled to the future with Atsuki, which I deduced was almost twenty minutes to the future. So, ever since they appeared, Sai's watch has been more than half an hour behind. I'm sure that contributed to them thinking they'd gone to the past the first time.
entries.literal: "Earlier, Sai traveled to the future with Atsuki, which I deduced was almost twenty minutes to the future. So, ever since they appeared, Sai's watch has been more than half an hour behind. I'm sure that contributed to them thinking they'd gone to the past the first time."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Sai just said it's {time=13:23}, but his watch is still behind. The computer isn't on, so he's not going to recognize that.{w} That's what's making Atsuki and Miiya think they've gone to the past again. They think they appeared back at {time=13:23} and that Suripo has just been killed.
entries.literal: "Sai just said it's {time=13:23}, but his watch is still behind. The computer isn't on, so he's not going to recognize that.{w} That's what's making Atsuki and Miiya think they've gone to the past again. They think they appeared back at {time=13:23} and that Suripo has just been killed."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai went to the mechanical room, where he was told the Future Sekimeiya was. However, he came back claiming he hadn't found it.
entries.literal: "Sai went to the mechanical room, where he was told the Future Sekimeiya was. However, he came back claiming he hadn't found it."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...was right. They're lying.
entries.literal: "...was right. They're lying."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. They said that the point they traveled to the past just happened. That means the Future Sekimeiya should've still been there.
entries.literal: "I see. They said that the point they traveled to the past just happened. That means the Future Sekimeiya should've still been there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: In reality, it wouldn't surprise me if Suripo's killer took it several minutes ago. When the killer entered the lobby, the door to the mechanical room could easily have been left open by Miiya and the other Atsuki.
entries.literal: "In reality, it wouldn't surprise me if Suripo's killer took it several minutes ago. When the killer entered the lobby, the door to the mechanical room could easily have been left open by Miiya and the other Atsuki."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They went down and found the Sekimeiya. Then, after they came back up, Suripo was there.
entries.literal: "They went down and found the Sekimeiya. Then, after they came back up, Suripo was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Atsuki walked down the stairs to look for himself. Soon, he returned, admitting that the Sekimeiya was no longer there.
entries.literal: "Atsuki walked down the stairs to look for himself. Soon, he returned, admitting that the Sekimeiya was no longer there."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Added to the fact that Naomi hasn't been found, you can't possibly think we did this, right?
entries.literal: "Added to the fact that Naomi hasn't been found, you can't possibly think we did this, right?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: You didn't?
entries.literal: "You didn't?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: There's n-no way. I think Naomi's the first— ...ot only has she managed to remain hidden, but she also might have the same keys that we have.
entries.literal: "There's n-no way. I think Naomi's the first— ...ot only has she managed to remain hidden, but she also might have the same keys that we have."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: There are no cameras here, but we don't know if they're recording in the first place... —idn't inspect the whole building because you thought we were in the attic— ...have to be missing something that the culprit is aware of. Could there be a place we're ignoring?
entries.literal: "There are no cameras here, but we don't know if they're recording in the first place... —idn't inspect the whole building because you thought we were in the attic— ...have to be missing something that the culprit is aware of. Could there be a place we're ignoring?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...That's impossible.
entries.literal: "...That's impossible."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: If not, then one of you did this. Naomi's disappearance should be enough proof that we're missing something, though.
entries.literal: "If not, then one of you did this. Naomi's disappearance should be enough proof that we're missing something, though."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: We have to find her or whoever else is here. It's almost guara— ...since this morning, and we didn't find him. ...more likely than some hidden passage.
entries.literal: "We have to find her or whoever else is here. It's almost guara— ...since this morning, and we didn't find him. ...more likely than some hidden passage."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: If it's neither of those, there's still an answer with the Sekimeiya. This policeman could've come from the future if he touched the Sekimeiya after {time=21}, and Naomi could've left the tower by going far to the past. We found the Seki— ...where it is now.
entries.literal: "If it's neither of those, there's still an answer with the Sekimeiya. This policeman could've come from the future if he touched the Sekimeiya after {time=21}, and Naomi could've left the tower by going far to the past. We found the Seki— ...where it is now."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: We'll look everywhere. Not only could people still be hiding, but the Sekimeiya has to be somewhere too. I can't imagine the real person responsible doesn't know where.
entries.literal: "We'll look everywhere. Not only could people still be hiding, but the Sekimeiya has to be somewhere too. I can't imagine the real person responsible doesn't know where."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Go ahead and find Naomi for us.
entries.literal: "Go ahead and find Naomi for us."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The hallway A door opened, and they walked down to the far end. I got closer while being careful not to make any noise.
entries.literal: "The hallway A door opened, and they walked down to the far end. I got closer while being careful not to make any noise."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...possible someone's on this floor. Don't move—
entries.literal: "...possible someone's on this floor. Don't move—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait. Are they really gonna search this whole floor?
entries.literal: "Wait. Are they really gonna search this whole floor?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, what am I even saying!? Of course!
entries.literal: "Oh, what am I even saying!? Of course!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: My past self is about to leave the storeroom! I came out in the middle of a search.
entries.literal: "My past self is about to leave the storeroom! I came out in the middle of a search."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As soon as I comprehended my situation, I began to hear doors opening.
entries.literal: "As soon as I comprehended my situation, I began to hear doors opening."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the fuck? They're going to find me!
entries.literal: "What the fuck? They're going to find me!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: No. I wouldn't be found. I knew that.
entries.literal: "No. I wouldn't be found. I knew that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't want to be found. The time where everyone would disappear was very close. However, the steps in the hallway unnerved me all the same.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to be found. The time where everyone would disappear was very close. However, the steps in the hallway unnerved me all the same."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no way to avoid it. I couldn't hide anywhere.
entries.literal: "There was no way to avoid it. I couldn't hide anywhere."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya aren't here. I don't know where the future one is, but the past one is in hallway B.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya aren't here. I don't know where the future one is, but the past one is in hallway B."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A door opened very close to the room I was hiding in.
entries.literal: "A door opened very close to the room I was hiding in."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could hear cabinets being opened. Then, footsteps came toward me.{w} The doorknob shook slightly, and the door slowly opened.
entries.literal: "I could hear cabinets being opened. Then, footsteps came toward me.{w} The doorknob shook slightly, and the door slowly opened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw my own body stepping in. As he approached one of the cabinets, I knew there was only one thing I could do.
entries.literal: "I saw my own body stepping in. As he approached one of the cabinets, I knew there was only one thing I could do."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This is very imp—
entries.literal: "This is very imp—"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wha—
entries.literal: "Wha—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He turned around with a startled gasp. His reaction was even more drastic when he saw me.
entries.literal: "He turned around with a startled gasp. His reaction was even more drastic when he saw me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What!? Who are you!?{w} Are you... me?
entries.literal: "Wh-What!? Who are you!?{w} Are you... me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded, although it wasn't the entire truth.
entries.literal: "I nodded, although it wasn't the entire truth."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This is very important. Stay here until the search is finished.
entries.literal: "This is very important. Stay here until the search is finished."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He couldn't fathom what he was seeing. However, he had already traveled through time. What was being presented was simply a request that he could take for granted—the way he saw it, there was no reason not to trust what he himself was saying.
entries.literal: "He couldn't fathom what he was seeing. However, he had already traveled through time. What was being presented was simply a request that he could take for granted—the way he saw it, there was no reason not to trust what he himself was saying."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: W-Wait, why!? Why are you here!?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, why!? Why are you here!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Be quiet! It's so that I'm not found, and just trust me, please.
entries.literal: "Be quiet! It's so that I'm not found, and just trust me, please."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}He nodded. It was the same thing I would've done.
entries.literal: "...{w}He nodded. It was the same thing I would've done."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took a deep breath. Then, hesitantly, I approached the cabinets.
entries.literal: "I took a deep breath. Then, hesitantly, I approached the cabinets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to look through them so that the noise of looking through rooms continued.
entries.literal: "I had to look through them so that the noise of looking through rooms continued."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right, the third Sekimeiya's here. I'd forgotten that it was brought here before Erina and Isla came to this room.{w} This is the cabinet where my past self will see it. That means that the person who left this room was the Atsuki from this world.
entries.literal: "Right, the third Sekimeiya's here. I'd forgotten that it was brought here before Erina and Isla came to this room.{w} This is the cabinet where my past self will see it. That means that the person who left this room was the Atsuki from this world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I acted as if I hadn't found anything. When I was done, I walked to the door before glancing at Atsuki. From the despondent look in his eyes, I could tell that he was in a worse place mentally than I had been during the incident. He... I... looked horrible. Maybe he really was the Atsuki who'd written that note.
entries.literal: "I acted as if I hadn't found anything. When I was done, I walked to the door before glancing at Atsuki. From the despondent look in his eyes, I could tell that he was in a worse place mentally than I had been during the incident. He... I... looked horrible. Maybe he really was the Atsuki who'd written that note."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The whole group was in hallway C.
entries.literal: "The whole group was in hallway C."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As if nothing had happened, I walked to the security room first.
entries.literal: "As if nothing had happened, I walked to the security room first."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been able to camouflage myself in addition to something else.{w} If I hadn't been there, the Sekimeiya would've been found, but I could prevent that.
entries.literal: "I'd been able to camouflage myself in addition to something else.{w} If I hadn't been there, the Sekimeiya would've been found, but I could prevent that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just so that nothing else would happen, I could avoid "finding" them. It was better if no one used them during the time that remained.
entries.literal: "Just so that nothing else would happen, I could avoid \"finding\" them. It was better if no one used them during the time that remained."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Stay there! I'll look at the mechanical room again.
entries.literal: "Stay there! I'll look at the mechanical room again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I stepped into the lobby, I saw Suripo's body on the floor. Blood covered both him and the tiles, evidently caused by the knife wound I'd heard them discussing.
entries.literal: "When I stepped into the lobby, I saw Suripo's body on the floor. Blood covered both him and the tiles, evidently caused by the knife wound I'd heard them discussing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I still couldn't believe it; I hadn't expected that at all. Everyone else was alive, but Suripo's corpse had suddenly appeared in the lobby...
entries.literal: "I still couldn't believe it; I hadn't expected that at all. Everyone else was alive, but Suripo's corpse had suddenly appeared in the lobby..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't like doing it, but I crouched down and verified he was dead. Then, to avoid being suspected, I went to the mechanical room as if I was searching through the floor normally.
entries.literal: "I didn't like doing it, but I crouched down and verified he was dead. Then, to avoid being suspected, I went to the mechanical room as if I was searching through the floor normally."

entries.speaker: i
