entries.text: I began with hallway B. Immediately, I found a Sekimeiya in the first room, B1.
entries.literal: "I began with hallway B. Immediately, I found a Sekimeiya in the first room, B1."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt the hot air around it. It had been powered on for a while already.
entries.literal: "I felt the hot air around it. It had been powered on for a while already."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is the Future Sekimeiya.{w} When I was in the other crystal room, I heard someone here. After killing Suripo, this is where his killer left the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "This is the Future Sekimeiya.{w} When I was in the other crystal room, I heard someone here. After killing Suripo, this is where his killer left the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't until I entered the very last crystal room, B6, that I found the Past Sekimeiya. I had to quickly withdraw my hand. The air surrounding it was even hotter.
entries.literal: "It wasn't until I entered the very last crystal room, B6, that I found the Past Sekimeiya. I had to quickly withdraw my hand. The air surrounding it was even hotter."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There's nobody here. I didn't find the Sekimeiya or any potential hiding spot we don't know of. If Naomi's here, she's somehow above us.
entries.literal: "There's nobody here. I didn't find the Sekimeiya or any potential hiding spot we don't know of. If Naomi's here, she's somehow above us."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: ...Are you sure you were thorough? Do you know some cabinets have compartments inside? The Sekimeiya could be there.
entries.literal: "...Are you sure you were thorough? Do you know some cabinets have compartments inside? The Sekimeiya could be there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, I looked in all of them.
entries.literal: "Yes, I looked in all of them."

entries.speaker: k
entries.text: Even the ones with temperature regulation? Did you make sure to close them?
entries.literal: "Even the ones with temperature regulation? Did you make sure to close them?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Those too, yeah. It took me a bit to figure out how to open them.
entries.literal: "Those too, yeah. It took me a bit to figure out how to open them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew how suspicious what I was saying was. Some people knew the Sekimeiya were in the rooms I'd just investigated, but I didn't care.
entries.literal: "I knew how suspicious what I was saying was. Some people knew the Sekimeiya were in the rooms I'd just investigated, but I didn't care."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before proceeding, I looked at both bathrooms and opened the elevator.
entries.literal: "Before proceeding, I looked at both bathrooms and opened the elevator."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I'll keep it open so that it can't be used.
entries.literal: "...I'll keep it open so that it can't be used."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right. Let's go.
entries.literal: "All right. Let's go."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went up first, as I couldn't bring myself to look into anyone's eyes.
entries.literal: "I went up first, as I couldn't bring myself to look into anyone's eyes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Hm, nothing.
entries.literal: "Hm, nothing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait here.
entries.literal: "Wait here."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: Can I do it instead?
entries.literal: "Can I do it instead?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Huh? Yeah, sure.
entries.literal: "Huh? Yeah, sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Miiya entered the partitions. I'd really just talked to her as if she had never died...
entries.literal: "Miiya entered the partitions. I'd really just talked to her as if she had never died..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But I'd been able to see that she was suffering too. The world we were in wasn't yet what it could be.{w} I dug my fingernails into my palm, telling myself that the result would be worth everything.
entries.literal: "But I'd been able to see that she was suffering too. The world we were in wasn't yet what it could be.{w} I dug my fingernails into my palm, telling myself that the result would be worth everything."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: I didn't find anything.
entries.literal: "I didn't find anything."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You looked everywhere, right?
entries.literal: "You looked everywhere, right?"

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: Yes, but did the others not come with us?
entries.literal: "Yes, but did the others not come with us?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I think they stayed on the crystal floor and let us go by ourselves.
entries.literal: "I think they stayed on the crystal floor and let us go by ourselves."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: Really?
entries.literal: "Really?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, and we should continue. We have to find something. Be it Naomi or the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Yes, and we should continue. We have to find something. Be it Naomi or the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right now, the others have just found the secret area in the storeroom. My past self is already out of there.
entries.literal: "Right now, the others have just found the secret area in the storeroom. My past self is already out of there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We went to the third floor, which was empty. Then, quietly, we walked up the stairs again.
entries.literal: "We went to the third floor, which was empty. Then, quietly, we walked up the stairs again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When Miiya came out of the offices, I was about to keep going, but she was looking down at the floor.
entries.literal: "When Miiya came out of the offices, I was about to keep going, but she was looking down at the floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Nothing again?
entries.literal: "Nothing again?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She shook her head.
entries.literal: "She shook her head."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If she's in the attic, she won't be able to take the elevator down, but this is very strange.
entries.literal: "If she's in the attic, she won't be able to take the elevator down, but this is very strange."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We headed to the staircase.
entries.literal: "We headed to the staircase."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Are you all right?
entries.literal: "...Are you all right?"

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: ...Huh?{w} Yes.
entries.literal: "...Huh?{w} Yes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You look zoned out. Are you tired?
entries.literal: "You look zoned out. Are you tired?"

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: A bit. It's okay.
entries.literal: "A bit. It's okay."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right, but don't push yourself.
entries.literal: "All right, but don't push yourself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her mood seemed to have suddenly changed. She appeared a little disoriented, so I decided to look through the fifth floor offices while she stayed outside.
entries.literal: "Her mood seemed to have suddenly changed. She appeared a little disoriented, so I decided to look through the fifth floor offices while she stayed outside."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I don't really expect Naomi to be in these, but it all gets weirder every time we move on. Could a secret place that Katei doesn't know about exist...?{w} There's no way, right? If the answer is somehow a hidden spot, he must've made use of it as well.
entries.literal: "...I don't really expect Naomi to be in these, but it all gets weirder every time we move on. Could a secret place that Katei doesn't know about exist...?{w} There's no way, right? If the answer is somehow a hidden spot, he must've made use of it as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She didn't reply, opting to continue looking down instead. It made my stomach turn. She was alive, and I was sure she was pushing herself to be strong, but her sudden change had made it evident how hard it was.
entries.literal: "She didn't reply, opting to continue looking down instead. It made my stomach turn. She was alive, and I was sure she was pushing herself to be strong, but her sudden change had made it evident how hard it was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I felt like there was something else buried in her eyes. I didn't know if I was imagining it, but I grimaced and kept moving forward.
entries.literal: "...I felt like there was something else buried in her eyes. I didn't know if I was imagining it, but I grimaced and kept moving forward."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}You have the key, right?
entries.literal: "...{w}You have the key, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She nodded and took the keyring out of her purse.
entries.literal: "She nodded and took the keyring out of her purse."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No recent footprints...{w} It'll be fine if you stay here. If I don't find anyone, I'm gonna be pretty confused.
entries.literal: "No recent footprints...{w} It'll be fine if you stay here. If I don't find anyone, I'm gonna be pretty confused."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went through every room. As expected, they were all empty.
entries.literal: "I went through every room. As expected, they were all empty."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I don't get it. Was Naomi never with us?{w} How is this possible? I know we've already been here for a long time, but that doesn't make it any less confusing. Where the hell is the Sekimeiya, also?
entries.literal: "...{w}I don't get it. Was Naomi never with us?{w} How is this possible? I know we've already been here for a long time, but that doesn't make it any less confusing. Where the hell is the Sekimeiya, also?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's just go back down. I hope they trust what we tell them.{w} ...We can't even take the elevator, damn it.
entries.literal: "Let's just go back down. I hope they trust what we tell them.{w} ...We can't even take the elevator, damn it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She didn't have anything to say. We went all the way back down, but that awkward silence hung around me the entire time.
entries.literal: "She didn't have anything to say. We went all the way back down, but that awkward silence hung around me the entire time."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Where the hell are they?
entries.literal: "Where the hell are they?"

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: ...The storeroom?
entries.literal: "...The storeroom?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Oh. Well, I need to go to the bathroom. I'll be back.
entries.literal: "Oh. Well, I need to go to the bathroom. I'll be back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to leave. The real Atsuki would soon reappear.{w} But it was hard to turn around. Miiya was right there in front of me—a friend who I'd thought I'd never see again, and who I might have been looking at for the very last time.
entries.literal: "I had to leave. The real Atsuki would soon reappear.{w} But it was hard to turn around. Miiya was right there in front of me—a friend who I'd thought I'd never see again, and who I might have been looking at for the very last time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: As I walked to the bathroom, I noticed she was going to the storeroom. I stopped myself once she was inside.
entries.literal: "As I walked to the bathroom, I noticed she was going to the storeroom. I stopped myself once she was inside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached it, intrigued as to what they were talking about.
entries.literal: "I approached it, intrigued as to what they were talking about."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They'll go to the attic pretty soon. I can listen in without being seen.
entries.literal: "They'll go to the attic pretty soon. I can listen in without being seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I saw that they were all next to the secret door. I hid inside the crystal room at its left.
entries.literal: "I saw that they were all next to the secret door. I hid inside the crystal room at its left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I approached the wall and put my ear against it.
entries.literal: "I approached the wall and put my ear against it."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...ut Atsuki had just finished looking through the whole floor.
entries.literal: "...ut Atsuki had just finished looking through the whole floor."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Exactly.
entries.literal: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can hear them well enough.
entries.literal: "I can hear them well enough."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What I think is that this door leads outside. The storeroom now stretches farther out than the crystal rooms, and it's a hidden locked door that would explain the policeman's appearance and Naomi's vanishing.
entries.literal: "What I think is that this door leads outside. The storeroom now stretches farther out than the crystal rooms, and it's a hidden locked door that would explain the policeman's appearance and Naomi's vanishing."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: W-Wait, really...? If a policeman entered, why did nobody else?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, really...? If a policeman entered, why did nobody else?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They kept talking about the door. I knew it led outside, but it hadn't opened since that morning.
entries.literal: "They kept talking about the door. I knew it led outside, but it hadn't opened since that morning."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Finally, the other Atsuki returned.
entries.literal: "Finally, the other Atsuki returned."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What the fuck is this...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck is this...?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: There he is. Do you know how to pick a lock?
entries.literal: "There he is. Do you know how to pick a lock?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: What? N-No?
entries.literal: "What? N-No?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He was told about the discovery. Sai had noticed the storeroom was open while he was going up the stairs.
entries.literal: "He was told about the discovery. Sai had noticed the storeroom was open while he was going up the stairs."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Did you really not know about this?
entries.literal: "Did you really not know about this?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I promise I didn't. I also don't think this door leads outside. There's no way I wouldn't have ever noticed it.
entries.literal: "I promise I didn't. I also don't think this door leads outside. There's no way I wouldn't have ever noticed it."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: And it makes sense that you didn't know about it if it doesn't lead outside?
entries.literal: "And it makes sense that you didn't know about it if it doesn't lead outside?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...I'm just speechless. This room is practically unused, but I can't believe this existed.
entries.literal: "...I'm just speechless. This room is practically unused, but I can't believe this existed."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...{w}Now a few things make sense, at least. As you said, nobody was found, so Naomi must've been here at some point.
entries.literal: "...{w}Now a few things make sense, at least. As you said, nobody was found, so Naomi must've been here at some point."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Yes, yes. I'd like to advise you all on something.
entries.literal: "Yes, yes. I'd like to advise you all on something."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I've made sure that if this door is opened again, I'll be able to tell.
entries.literal: "I've made sure that if this door is opened again, I'll be able to tell."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...What? How?
entries.literal: "...What? How?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: I'm not telling you that. One of you could potentially manage to open this, so I'd rather not give you any indication of what I've done.
entries.literal: "I'm not telling you that. One of you could potentially manage to open this, so I'd rather not give you any indication of what I've done."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What is this about...?
entries.literal: "What is this about...?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...I think that's fair. It wouldn't be wise to demand that you tell us.
entries.literal: "...I think that's fair. It wouldn't be wise to demand that you tell us."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Just trust me. I will know if the door opens. However, it's possible it won't and that the plan already finished after the Sekimeiya was brought outside.
entries.literal: "Just trust me. I will know if the door opens. However, it's possible it won't and that the plan already finished after the Sekimeiya was brought outside."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Let's go to the attic.
entries.literal: "Let's go to the attic."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...To the attic? Why?
entries.literal: "...To the attic? Why?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Do you think I'll believe you were walking around for hours and we didn't see you? You either went through this door or were in the attic.
entries.literal: "Do you think I'll believe you were walking around for hours and we didn't see you? You either went through this door or were in the attic."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: He wasn't with us. We know that much.
entries.literal: "He wasn't with us. We know that much."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: You've said that before. I know.
entries.literal: "You've said that before. I know."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: How do you intend to know whether I was there? I won't allow anyone in lightly.
entries.literal: "How do you intend to know whether I was there? I won't allow anyone in lightly."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: No? Then how come they spent three hours sleeping there?
entries.literal: "No? Then how come they spent three hours sleeping there?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...I haven't forgotten about that.
entries.literal: "...I haven't forgotten about that."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: In the off chance Naomi's still in the tower, she's up there, being covered by the three of you. I want to go see it by myself, and I'm sure Akaro and Erina aren't content with your words alone.
entries.literal: "In the off chance Naomi's still in the tower, she's up there, being covered by the three of you. I want to go see it by myself, and I'm sure Akaro and Erina aren't content with your words alone."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They left the storeroom and the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "They left the storeroom and the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The rest happened as I'd already experienced it.
entries.literal: "The rest happened as I'd already experienced it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stayed in that room until my past self went up. I'd chosen to hide in one of the second floor bathrooms, an unlikely place to be revisited.
entries.literal: "I stayed in that room until my past self went up. I'd chosen to hide in one of the second floor bathrooms, an unlikely place to be revisited."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to hallway B. I knew Sai would be the first one to return and that he'd look through the hallway A rooms.
entries.literal: "I went to hallway B. I knew Sai would be the first one to return and that he'd look through the hallway A rooms."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It happened even sooner than I recalled. Evidently discontent with my search, he walked from room to room.{w} He didn't care about the third Sekimeiya; he'd been the one to leave it there. When he came to hallway B, I was already in a room in hallway A.
entries.literal: "It happened even sooner than I recalled. Evidently discontent with my search, he walked from room to room.{w} He didn't care about the third Sekimeiya; he'd been the one to leave it there. When he came to hallway B, I was already in a room in hallway A."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I just had to wait.{w} Sai would find the Future Sekimeiya and bring it to the event room. Then, the others would find the Past Sekimeiya and walk to the event room.
entries.literal: "I just had to wait.{w} Sai would find the Future Sekimeiya and bring it to the event room. Then, the others would find the Past Sekimeiya and walk to the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Future Sekimeiya would be activated in the event room—it was the one that had been gray, and I was far enough from its range. That would leave me alone in the tower with my past self.
entries.literal: "The Future Sekimeiya would be activated in the event room—it was the one that had been gray, and I was far enough from its range. That would leave me alone in the tower with my past self."

entries.text: Picture Frame
entries.literal: "Picture Frame"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: I'm sure everything has taken shape in your mind, but I wonder what shape that is.
entries.literal: "I'm sure everything has taken shape in your mind, but I wonder what shape that is."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You remember this world, don't you? In it, many things weren't what they seemed.
entries.literal: "You remember this world, don't you? In it, many things weren't what they seemed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Its real shape is the last key you will need to reach the peak.
entries.literal: "Its real shape is the last key you will need to reach the peak."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two people waited in the lobby. {time=9:00} was approaching.
entries.literal: "Two people waited in the lobby. {time=9:00} was approaching."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At that point, you may have realized something was wrong. Shiroya wasn't there; Miiya was occupying her place.{w} However, her name was spoken before the doors opened.
entries.literal: "At that point, you may have realized something was wrong. Shiroya wasn't there; Miiya was occupying her place.{w} However, her name was spoken before the doors opened."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Shiroya...?
entries.literal: "Shiroya...?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I'd managed to leave my mind empty, but I abruptly turned around when I heard a quiet voice coming from my left. A man was crouching next to me, and when he stood up, I saw his older face underneath white hair."
entries.literal: "\"I'd managed to leave my mind empty, but I abruptly turned around when I heard a quiet voice coming from my left. A man was crouching next to me, and when he stood up, I saw his older face underneath white hair.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei said Shiroya's name...
entries.literal: "Katei said Shiroya's name..."

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Is this yours? I think you dropped it.
entries.literal: "Is this yours? I think you dropped it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "He showed me a ticket that must've fallen from my purse when I'd stretched my muscles. I nodded and put it back inside, all while unnerved by his stiff motions."
entries.literal: "\"He showed me a ticket that must've fallen from my purse when I'd stretched my muscles. I nodded and put it back inside, all while unnerved by his stiff motions.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone brought an identification card to verify their own tickets. Of course, the tickets had everyone's names on them. Katei read Shiroya's name and called for her.
entries.literal: "Everyone brought an identification card to verify their own tickets. Of course, the tickets had everyone's names on them. Katei read Shiroya's name and called for her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya was there with her own purse, which contained three tickets. When she stretched, one fell out, meaning that her purse hadn't been closed. In world B, when Shiroya opened her purse, she unzipped it—the tickets couldn't have fallen from her purse, as it was closed since long before {time=9.}
entries.literal: "Miiya was there with her own purse, which contained three tickets. When she stretched, one fell out, meaning that her purse hadn't been closed. In world B, when Shiroya opened her purse, she unzipped it—the tickets couldn't have fallen from her purse, as it was closed since long before {time=9.}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hopefully, it was enjoyable to catch any of these details. However, although Shiroya's absence could be reasoned out, it wouldn't be surprising if your gut told you something was wrong before that. For everyone who'd gotten trapped in the tower, Shiroya was a girl who had died weeks ago.
entries.literal: "Hopefully, it was enjoyable to catch any of these details. However, although Shiroya's absence could be reasoned out, it wouldn't be surprising if your gut told you something was wrong before that. For everyone who'd gotten trapped in the tower, Shiroya was a girl who had died weeks ago."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the group went up the floors, Atsuki found the key for the security room. Everyone splitting up created the chances for individuals to accomplish what they needed.
entries.literal: "When the group went up the floors, Atsuki found the key for the security room. Everyone splitting up created the chances for individuals to accomplish what they needed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next time they reunited, Sai noticed the sound of keys coming from Katei's pocket. ...They were louder than they'd been before.
entries.literal: "The next time they reunited, Sai noticed the sound of keys coming from Katei's pocket. ...They were louder than they'd been before."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei was confronted, he showed them a set of keys belonging to Naomi. However, that's when he himself noticed something.
entries.literal: "When Katei was confronted, he showed them a set of keys belonging to Naomi. However, that's when he himself noticed something."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There were two identical keyrings in his pocket. That had made the metallic noise even easier to perceive.
entries.literal: "There were two identical keyrings in his pocket. That had made the metallic noise even easier to perceive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At that point, Katei had traveled to the past one time. Upon appearing, he hadn't realized that the keyring Naomi had left behind suddenly appeared in his pocket.{w} Then, when he came across it, he put it inside. In that way, he came into possession of two copies.
entries.literal: "At that point, Katei had traveled to the past one time. Upon appearing, he hadn't realized that the keyring Naomi had left behind suddenly appeared in his pocket.{w} Then, when he came across it, he put it inside. In that way, he came into possession of two copies."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Sai made him reveal it, he didn't know a second one remained in his pocket. That fact was what shaped Katei's actions.
entries.literal: "When Sai made him reveal it, he didn't know a second one remained in his pocket. That fact was what shaped Katei's actions."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In this world, he insisted the attic should be kept locked, and he made sure the Sekimeiya cabinet would always be. That way, he could unlock them with his secret set, setting up Atsuki and Miiya, who had the other one, as the only possible culprits.
entries.literal: "In this world, he insisted the attic should be kept locked, and he made sure the Sekimeiya cabinet would always be. That way, he could unlock them with his secret set, setting up Atsuki and Miiya, who had the other one, as the only possible culprits."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai thought of a way to know whether that set was Naomi's: if one of the keys opened the attic, Katei's lie would be exposed.
entries.literal: "Sai thought of a way to know whether that set was Naomi's: if one of the keys opened the attic, Katei's lie would be exposed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before they got there, he decided to test if something else Katei had said was invalid too. On the sixth floor, he attempted to call the elevator, which should've been disabled.{w} They waited, but it never came.
entries.literal: "Before they got there, he decided to test if something else Katei had said was invalid too. On the sixth floor, he attempted to call the elevator, which should've been disabled.{w} They waited, but it never came."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, at that point, the elevator was already working again.
entries.literal: "However, at that point, the elevator was already working again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The first time Katei traveled to the past, he walked to the crystal floor. He saw an Atsuki from another world, which later made him question what everyone was saying.
entries.literal: "The first time Katei traveled to the past, he walked to the crystal floor. He saw an Atsuki from another world, which later made him question what everyone was saying."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Most importantly, he saw people leaving the security room, which had strangely been unlocked. That was his opportunity to shut the computer down. Since he was alone and hadn't told everyone about the cameras' green lights, in this world, he was able to power off the entire security system too as opposed to just one camera.
entries.literal: "Most importantly, he saw people leaving the security room, which had strangely been unlocked. That was his opportunity to shut the computer down. Since he was alone and hadn't told everyone about the cameras' green lights, in this world, he was able to power off the entire security system too as opposed to just one camera."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later, when Sai called the elevator, Katei had already enabled it because he had found the attic key. However, it didn't come.
entries.literal: "Later, when Sai called the elevator, Katei had already enabled it because he had found the attic key. However, it didn't come."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei suddenly froze up; would they notice their mistake?
entries.literal: "Katei suddenly froze up; would they notice their mistake?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: ...The elevator was disabled. That's much more unlikely to have gone wrong. If it was working for some reason, the button would light up when it arrived.
entries.literal: "...The elevator was disabled. That's much more unlikely to have gone wrong. If it was working for some reason, the button would light up when it arrived."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The orange light never appeared—the elevator was already there, and you might recall that was the case in world B as well.
entries.literal: "The orange light never appeared—the elevator was already there, and you might recall that was the case in world B as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And not only that. Atsuki from world B was spying on the group, and when they entered the attic, he was on the sixth floor. He heard the elevator, but only once—when Isla, Erina, Sai, and Akaro took it down. Since it was called from the attic and Atsuki B only heard it once, it was originally on the sixth floor.
entries.literal: "And not only that. Atsuki from world B was spying on the group, and when they entered the attic, he was on the sixth floor. He heard the elevator, but only once—when Isla, Erina, Sai, and Akaro took it down. Since it was called from the attic and Atsuki B only heard it once, it was originally on the sixth floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Either way, nobody saw through his ruse, and thanks to that, Katei was able to set up a stronger illusion later on.
entries.literal: "Either way, nobody saw through his ruse, and thanks to that, Katei was able to set up a stronger illusion later on."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When everyone entered the attic, they saw the strange footprints on the floor. They led to the sofa, where the Future Sekimeiya was.
entries.literal: "When everyone entered the attic, they saw the strange footprints on the floor. They led to the sofa, where the Future Sekimeiya was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Most people believed the Sekimeiya should've been on the crystal floor. If that was the case, someone had to have brought it up very recently, but it didn't seem possible for them to have left the attic.
entries.literal: "Most people believed the Sekimeiya should've been on the crystal floor. If that was the case, someone had to have brought it up very recently, but it didn't seem possible for them to have left the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That made Sai call the elevator, and it actually did arrive.
entries.literal: "That made Sai call the elevator, and it actually did arrive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was the feint Katei aimed for—that the elevator had just been enabled. That someone had been in the security room after they'd all stepped into the attic.
entries.literal: "That was the feint Katei aimed for—that the elevator had just been enabled. That someone had been in the security room after they'd all stepped into the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Following that, when everyone saw that the computer had lost power, what he said was reinforced; it must have happened after they had tried to call the elevator on the sixth floor.
entries.literal: "Following that, when everyone saw that the computer had lost power, what he said was reinforced; it must have happened after they had tried to call the elevator on the sixth floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At the same time, the Sekimeiya had disappeared from the cabinet. From their perspective, it had been brought to the attic.{w} However, Sai knew the truth. Just like in worlds A and B, he had quickly hidden the fake Sekimeiya when everyone had split up, so the one they'd retrieved from the attic was different.
entries.literal: "At the same time, the Sekimeiya had disappeared from the cabinet. From their perspective, it had been brought to the attic.{w} However, Sai knew the truth. Just like in worlds A and B, he had quickly hidden the fake Sekimeiya when everyone had split up, so the one they'd retrieved from the attic was different."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was when everyone else learned about time travel. Right before their eyes, Katei went to the future.
entries.literal: "That was when everyone else learned about time travel. Right before their eyes, Katei went to the future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki reeled. He had to learn more about the Sekimeiya. He stayed close to it, and when the crystal floor had been inspected, he touched it.
entries.literal: "Atsuki reeled. He had to learn more about the Sekimeiya. He stayed close to it, and when the crystal floor had been inspected, he touched it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He went minutes to the future, but he wasn't alone. Sai had specifically gone to find the fake Sekimeiya he'd hidden, wondering whether it was still there, as well as whether it shared the same powers he'd witnessed. As he was returning to the event room from hallway B, he traveled with Atsuki.
entries.literal: "He went minutes to the future, but he wasn't alone. Sai had specifically gone to find the fake Sekimeiya he'd hidden, wondering whether it was still there, as well as whether it shared the same powers he'd witnessed. As he was returning to the event room from hallway B, he traveled with Atsuki."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki appeared in the attic, which was locked. The elevator had been left open on the crystal floor, so he couldn't leave through it either.{w} However, Sai appeared on the crystal floor since his group had left the attic earlier. He realized the elevator was open and allowed Atsuki to leave.
entries.literal: "Atsuki appeared in the attic, which was locked. The elevator had been left open on the crystal floor, so he couldn't leave through it either.{w} However, Sai appeared on the crystal floor since his group had left the attic earlier. He realized the elevator was open and allowed Atsuki to leave."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When they met, they thought they'd gone minutes to the past, although neither of them spoke about it. Atsuki recalled Sai had gone missing, so finding him in the past wasn't strange.{w} His misinterpretation arose due to Sai's watch, which had ended up minutes behind. When they returned to the others, they saw that everyone was in the security room.
entries.literal: "When they met, they thought they'd gone minutes to the past, although neither of them spoke about it. Atsuki recalled Sai had gone missing, so finding him in the past wasn't strange.{w} His misinterpretation arose due to Sai's watch, which had ended up minutes behind. When they returned to the others, they saw that everyone was in the security room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "As we turned around, we saw Sai staring at us next to the unassertive Atsuki."
entries.literal: "\"As we turned around, we saw Sai staring at us next to the unassertive Atsuki.\""

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Wh-Where were you!?
entries.literal: "Wh-Where were you!?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Me? I just took a detour to the bathroom.
entries.literal: "Me? I just took a detour to the bathroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai wasn't exactly aware of how blatant his lie was. According to his watch, he should've been missing for very little time, but it had been much longer than he thought since he'd vanished. He didn't reveal what had happened to him, and because of that, he was the only person aware of the Sekimeiya's range.
entries.literal: "Sai wasn't exactly aware of how blatant his lie was. According to his watch, he should've been missing for very little time, but it had been much longer than he thought since he'd vanished. He didn't reveal what had happened to him, and because of that, he was the only person aware of the Sekimeiya's range."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hours later, Suripo's dead body suddenly appeared. There's one last thing to settle.
entries.literal: "Hours later, Suripo's dead body suddenly appeared. There's one last thing to settle."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi still hadn't been found, and it seemed like nobody else could've committed the crime without having traveled through time. That belief led to a whole search with no result.
entries.literal: "Naomi still hadn't been found, and it seemed like nobody else could've committed the crime without having traveled through time. That belief led to a whole search with no result."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something very important was found, though: the storeroom's secret corridor.
entries.literal: "Something very important was found, though: the storeroom's secret corridor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Upon its discovery, you likely noticed that someone's actions differed from world B's.
entries.literal: "Upon its discovery, you likely noticed that someone's actions differed from world B's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world C, Sai did something to know whether the door was opened from that point on. That did not happen in world B.
entries.literal: "In world C, Sai did something to know whether the door was opened from that point on. That did not happen in world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The reason was the piece of duct tape they'd all seen. It had reminded Sai of his favorite novel, which made him think of setting up a check on that door.
entries.literal: "The reason was the piece of duct tape they'd all seen. It had reminded Sai of his favorite novel, which made him think of setting up a check on that door."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After that, everyone ended up in the attic, where they hoped they could calmly spend the rest of their isolation in the bedrooms.
entries.literal: "After that, everyone ended up in the attic, where they hoped they could calmly spend the rest of their isolation in the bedrooms."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Of course, that wouldn't happen. It was Sai who soon tried to go back down unnoticed.
entries.literal: "Of course, that wouldn't happen. It was Sai who soon tried to go back down unnoticed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What if Atsuki and Miiya hadn't alerted everyone to his departure?
entries.literal: "What if Atsuki and Miiya hadn't alerted everyone to his departure?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Shiroya and Atsuki stayed in the attic. Sai had gone to the crystal floor, but they didn't follow him down."
entries.literal: "\"Shiroya and Atsuki stayed in the attic. Sai had gone to the crystal floor, but they didn't follow him down.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Shiroya let out a sigh."
entries.literal: "\"Shiroya let out a sigh.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "They had no strength left, so they kept resting, trying to ignore what was happening around them."
entries.literal: "\"They had no strength left, so they kept resting, trying to ignore what was happening around them.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Indeed, your choice made Miiya become Shiroya.{w} The world changed drastically. The butterfly effect amplifies even a single unwitting change.
entries.literal: "Indeed, your choice made Miiya become Shiroya.{w} The world changed drastically. The butterfly effect amplifies even a single unwitting change."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In that world, Miiya couldn't have been saved. However, you wanted to know what would've happened if Sai was let loose. That caused Miiya to be replaced by Shiroya.
entries.literal: "In that world, Miiya couldn't have been saved. However, you wanted to know what would've happened if Sai was let loose. That caused Miiya to be replaced by Shiroya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was one of numerous changes, alongside...
entries.literal: "That was one of numerous changes, alongside..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene."{w} Exactly, it was Katei's absence. The storeroom's door hadn't been locked, so he'd been able to leave before everyone awakened. In that world, nobody had told the group about keeping the Sekimeiya cold.
entries.literal: "\"Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene.\"{w} Exactly, it was Katei's absence. The storeroom's door hadn't been locked, so he'd been able to leave before everyone awakened. In that world, nobody had told the group about keeping the Sekimeiya cold."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene."{w} It was Katei's absence. The storeroom's door hadn't been locked, so he'd been able to leave before everyone awakened. In that world, nobody had told the group about keeping the Sekimeiya cold.
entries.literal: "\"Six pairs of eyes saw the identical scene.\"{w} It was Katei's absence. The storeroom's door hadn't been locked, so he'd been able to leave before everyone awakened. In that world, nobody had told the group about keeping the Sekimeiya cold."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai roamed free for a long time, and on the crystal floor, he had access to both Sekimeiya. With his watch, he was able to figure out the basic mechanics behind traveling to the past and future.
entries.literal: "Sai roamed free for a long time, and on the crystal floor, he had access to both Sekimeiya. With his watch, he was able to figure out the basic mechanics behind traveling to the past and future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's how he came up with a plan to remain with the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "That's how he came up with a plan to remain with the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What did he do? When he came back up, he showed everyone what the Sekimeiya were capable of. Right now, you understand them a lot more than at that time.
entries.literal: "What did he do? When he came back up, he showed everyone what the Sekimeiya were capable of. Right now, you understand them a lot more than at that time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...However, you might still have trouble figuring out what Sai did. He had to pull out something fairly clever to trick everyone.
entries.literal: "...However, you might still have trouble figuring out what Sai did. He had to pull out something fairly clever to trick everyone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If you ever want to go back and attempt to see through his scenario, I hope you're able to beat him.
entries.literal: "If you ever want to go back and attempt to see through his scenario, I hope you're able to beat him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In reality, Atsuki and Miiya brought everyone to the crystal floor in an attempt to find Sai. Before he was seen, the Past Sekimeiya was found in room B6.{w} Sai was in the event room, and he suddenly heard people approaching. Hoping it would let him escape, he touched the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "In reality, Atsuki and Miiya brought everyone to the crystal floor in an attempt to find Sai. Before he was seen, the Past Sekimeiya was found in room B6.{w} Sai was in the event room, and he suddenly heard people approaching. Hoping it would let him escape, he touched the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki and Miiya brought everyone to the crystal floor in an attempt to find him. Before he was seen, the Past Sekimeiya was found in room B6.{w} Sai was in the event room, and he suddenly heard people approaching. Hoping it would let him escape, he touched the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Atsuki and Miiya brought everyone to the crystal floor in an attempt to find him. Before he was seen, the Past Sekimeiya was found in room B6.{w} Sai was in the event room, and he suddenly heard people approaching. Hoping it would let him escape, he touched the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Y—! You scared the fuck out of me!{w} Holy shit! What the fuck are you doing!? You almost hit me with the door!
entries.literal: "Y—! You scared the fuck out of me!{w} Holy shit! What the fuck are you doing!? You almost hit me with the door!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He thought he was safe as soon as he touched it, but the door still burst open.
entries.literal: "He thought he was safe as soon as he touched it, but the door still burst open."

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Don't you think that's a better question for you? What are you doing!?
entries.literal: "Don't you think that's a better question for you? What are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: I'm doing absolutely nothing.
entries.literal: "I'm doing absolutely nothing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "We turned to Katei, who hadn't interrupted us. He was perplexed, staring at his empty hands."
entries.literal: "\"We turned to Katei, who hadn't interrupted us. He was perplexed, staring at his empty hands.\""

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: What's up with you?
entries.literal: "What's up with you?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: ...Where's the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...Where's the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: What? I have no—
entries.literal: "What? I have no—"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: I-It disappeared. I legitimately felt it disappear.
entries.literal: "I-It disappeared. I legitimately felt it disappear."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Excuse me?
entries.literal: "Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both had disappeared, as a world switch had been triggered. Oblivious, they found themselves in world A.
entries.literal: "Both had disappeared, as a world switch had been triggered. Oblivious, they found themselves in world A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Sai spun and looked at the cabinet covered by the curtain. Then, he looked all around the room with a slight frown."
entries.literal: "\"Sai spun and looked at the cabinet covered by the curtain. Then, he looked all around the room with a slight frown.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I was also moderately puzzled. Katei couldn't have been lying. He didn't have the Sekimeiya, it wasn't on the floor, and he couldn't have hidden it anywhere without us seeing it."
entries.literal: "\"I was also moderately puzzled. Katei couldn't have been lying. He didn't have the Sekimeiya, it wasn't on the floor, and he couldn't have hidden it anywhere without us seeing it.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Out of nowhere, the cabinet was covered by its curtain. However, that was nothing compared to what awaited in hallway C.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, the cabinet was covered by its curtain. However, that was nothing compared to what awaited in hallway C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The panel to call the elevator was gone.{w} ...All of them were. They had been ripped off on every floor.
entries.literal: "The panel to call the elevator was gone.{w} ...All of them were. They had been ripped off on every floor."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Wait, we didn't lock it, did we?
entries.literal: "Wait, we didn't lock it, did we?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: You're right... I forgot to tell you to lock it because I was annoyed that Sai left.
entries.literal: "You're right... I forgot to tell you to lock it because I was annoyed that Sai left."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Whoa, then someone's definitely in here. Is it time to have a talk with Naomi? I wonder if she knows we can enter.
entries.literal: "Whoa, then someone's definitely in here. Is it time to have a talk with Naomi? I wonder if she knows we can enter."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the living room, their footprints had disappeared.
entries.literal: "In the living room, their footprints had disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And Katei was the lucky person who found the Future Sekimeiya in the open refrigerator. ...Opening it had been the last thing Sai A would ever do.
entries.literal: "And Katei was the lucky person who found the Future Sekimeiya in the open refrigerator. ...Opening it had been the last thing Sai A would ever do."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki wanted to look at the BIOS's time, but the security room was locked. In addition, Sai realized the mark he'd left in the storeroom was gone. ...He was convinced someone had opened it, so he marked it again.
entries.literal: "Atsuki wanted to look at the BIOS's time, but the security room was locked. In addition, Sai realized the mark he'd left in the storeroom was gone. ...He was convinced someone had opened it, so he marked it again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Of course, that was far from the truth, but it made them believe that someone else had entered the tower.
entries.literal: "Of course, that was far from the truth, but it made them believe that someone else had entered the tower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next time they attempted to enter the attic, it was locked again.
entries.literal: "The next time they attempted to enter the attic, it was locked again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "We all stared at the door in shock. It was locked."
entries.literal: "\"We all stared at the door in shock. It was locked.\""

entries.speaker: knn
entries.text: Someone else is certainly in this building. I left the attic just now.
entries.literal: "Someone else is certainly in this building. I left the attic just now."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The truth behind that was the secret keyring Katei still had. Long before he'd traveled to the future, he'd left it in the security room so that he couldn't be found with it. He'd been able to retrieve it when he'd appeared there.
entries.literal: "The truth behind that was the secret keyring Katei still had. Long before he'd traveled to the future, he'd left it in the security room so that he couldn't be found with it. He'd been able to retrieve it when he'd appeared there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd left the key inserted in the door because he knew what had happened with the elevator: it was in the attic despite the panel having vanished.{w} Inside, he'd found that world's attic key. He could keep everyone from entering the highest floor by locking the door in.{w} He left it by bringing the elevator to the sixth floor; he could keep it there as a hidden way up. Since he had his set of keys, he could always access the attic through the elevator he'd prepared.
entries.literal: "He'd left the key inserted in the door because he knew what had happened with the elevator: it was in the attic despite the panel having vanished.{w} Inside, he'd found that world's attic key. He could keep everyone from entering the highest floor by locking the door in.{w} He left it by bringing the elevator to the sixth floor; he could keep it there as a hidden way up. Since he had his set of keys, he could always access the attic through the elevator he'd prepared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But... it was found when Atsuki attempted to open it.{w} Inside, there were the bodies of Naomi C and Shiroya A.
entries.literal: "But... it was found when Atsuki attempted to open it.{w} Inside, there were the bodies of Naomi C and Shiroya A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The shock was natural. Naomi hadn't been seen for hours, and Shiroya had supposedly died weeks ago. It was undeniable that her existence was related to Atsuki and Miiya.
entries.literal: "The shock was natural. Naomi hadn't been seen for hours, and Shiroya had supposedly died weeks ago. It was undeniable that her existence was related to Atsuki and Miiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But nobody knew what had happened to the two women, and all they could do was bring them to the lobby.
entries.literal: "But nobody knew what had happened to the two women, and all they could do was bring them to the lobby."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: With the elevator, the group was able to reach the attic again, where they found the single key in its inner keyhole.
entries.literal: "With the elevator, the group was able to reach the attic again, where they found the single key in its inner keyhole."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Over thirty minutes later, a new dead body was found near the hallway C stairs.
entries.literal: "...Over thirty minutes later, a new dead body was found near the hallway C stairs."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Erina A's.
entries.literal: "It was Erina A's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina C, who they'd been with, was in room A1 with Isla. Meanwhile, the world A group was waiting in room B4. After Sai, Erina had been the second person to leave.
entries.literal: "Erina C, who they'd been with, was in room A1 with Isla. Meanwhile, the world A group was waiting in room B4. After Sai, Erina had been the second person to leave."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them."
entries.literal: "\"Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone saw Erina's body atop a pool of blood. Someone had just killed her, and Atsuki had heard her words before dying. ...She had confronted who she'd thought was the killer.{w} However, it quickly became clear that nobody could've easily committed the crime. Everyone stated what they'd been doing.
entries.literal: "Everyone saw Erina's body atop a pool of blood. Someone had just killed her, and Atsuki had heard her words before dying. ...She had confronted who she'd thought was the killer.{w} However, it quickly became clear that nobody could've easily committed the crime. Everyone stated what they'd been doing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki said that after being the first to leave the attic, he'd spent a few minutes on the second floor. He said that at one point, he heard the elevator once.{w} Miiya said that she'd left second and remained on the third floor until Atsuki ran up from below, letting her know what had happened.{w} Sai and Katei claimed to have been above them, and their versions of events seemed to confirm each other.{w} Akaro claimed to have left the attic last when Erina and Isla had still been sitting on the sofa, and that afterward, he'd stayed on the sixth floor alone.
entries.literal: "Atsuki said that after being the first to leave the attic, he'd spent a few minutes on the second floor. He said that at one point, he heard the elevator once.{w} Miiya said that she'd left second and remained on the third floor until Atsuki ran up from below, letting her know what had happened.{w} Sai and Katei claimed to have been above them, and their versions of events seemed to confirm each other.{w} Akaro claimed to have left the attic last when Erina and Isla had still been sitting on the sofa, and that afterward, he'd stayed on the sixth floor alone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The elevator was on the crystal floor. Since the panels hadn't been reattached, the "1" button must've been pressed from the attic.{w} It seemed like nobody could've performed a murder simply. The only way to get to the crystal floor after Atsuki's departure would've been by riding in the elevator with Erina and Isla. However, if that had happened, they couldn't have ended up above Atsuki when he'd gone to find everyone; nobody had seen them walking up, and the elevator hadn't been heard again.
entries.literal: "The elevator was on the crystal floor. Since the panels hadn't been reattached, the \"1\" button must've been pressed from the attic.{w} It seemed like nobody could've performed a murder simply. The only way to get to the crystal floor after Atsuki's departure would've been by riding in the elevator with Erina and Isla. However, if that had happened, they couldn't have ended up above Atsuki when he'd gone to find everyone; nobody had seen them walking up, and the elevator hadn't been heard again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There were three main options in everyone's minds, and one was correct.
entries.literal: "There were three main options in everyone's minds, and one was correct."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki hadn't been lying; everything he said was the truth.
entries.literal: "Atsuki hadn't been lying; everything he said was the truth."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: People they didn't know about were present in the building—the world A group. However, none of them had left room B4.
entries.literal: "People they didn't know about were present in the building—the world A group. However, none of them had left room B4."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The answer had to be the Sekimeiya. Someone would travel through time and kill Erina.
entries.literal: "The answer had to be the Sekimeiya. Someone would travel through time and kill Erina."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For them, that seemed like a fickle solution; there was no way to prove it. If that was the case, unless the culprit had already escaped, they had to search for them.
entries.literal: "For them, that seemed like a fickle solution; there was no way to prove it. If that was the case, unless the culprit had already escaped, they had to search for them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, for you, that solution might seem odd.
entries.literal: "However, for you, that solution might seem odd."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You know what happened in that world. The Past Sekimeiya was in room B4 with the world A group.{w} It was in the cabinet where Akaro had put it, and it wasn't activated until he and Isla world switched to world B.
entries.literal: "You know what happened in that world. The Past Sekimeiya was in room B4 with the world A group.{w} It was in the cabinet where Akaro had put it, and it wasn't activated until he and Isla world switched to world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After that, what happened to it? Shiroya B found it and was able to world switch to world B. Later on, Sai B found it was well and world switched back to world B.{w} Lastly, Atsuki A found it and also world switched to world B.
entries.literal: "After that, what happened to it? Shiroya B found it and was able to world switch to world B. Later on, Sai B found it was well and world switched back to world B.{w} Lastly, Atsuki A found it and also world switched to world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was it. The Past Sekimeiya from world A wasn't activated ever again.
entries.literal: "That was it. The Past Sekimeiya from world A wasn't activated ever again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So then, who killed Erina? How did her killer show up before her and push her off the stairs?
entries.literal: "So then, who killed Erina? How did her killer show up before her and push her off the stairs?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Her killer couldn't have world switched before her. After all, they would've had to appear from world C, where Atsuki was experimenting with the Sekimeiya in the attic.
entries.literal: "Her killer couldn't have world switched before her. After all, they would've had to appear from world C, where Atsuki was experimenting with the Sekimeiya in the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The Past Sekimeiya couldn't have been used to carry out her murder. The key to solving it was the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "The Past Sekimeiya couldn't have been used to carry out her murder. The key to solving it was the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the one that Katei had found in the kitchen refrigerator. He hid it somewhere in the attic, which he locked, intending to keep it away from the others.
entries.literal: "It was the one that Katei had found in the kitchen refrigerator. He hid it somewhere in the attic, which he locked, intending to keep it away from the others."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before the world C group arrived in world A, only one person had touched the Future Sekimeiya: Sai A. However, he immediately died where he arrived. In other words, nobody from world A could've killed Erina.
entries.literal: "Before the world C group arrived in world A, only one person had touched the Future Sekimeiya: Sai A. However, he immediately died where he arrived. In other words, nobody from world A could've killed Erina."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before her death, the world C group had been on the crystal floor; anyone who traveled to the future could've appeared there, bypassing Atsuki's view.
entries.literal: "Before her death, the world C group had been on the crystal floor; anyone who traveled to the future could've appeared there, bypassing Atsuki's view."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But that wouldn't have been all. After appearing there, they would've had to make it above him, and such a thing didn't seem simple. No Sekimeiya could've been activated on the crystal floor, and the elevator never went back up.
entries.literal: "But that wouldn't have been all. After appearing there, they would've had to make it above him, and such a thing didn't seem simple. No Sekimeiya could've been activated on the crystal floor, and the elevator never went back up."

entries.speaker: akinn
entries.text: People were leaving, and Isla said she wanted to come down too since she still hadn't seen all the gems. I noticed she was trying to cheer herself up a little despite the... two bodies we found, so even though I didn't want to leave, I went with her just so that it took her mind off it.
entries.literal: "People were leaving, and Isla said she wanted to come down too since she still hadn't seen all the gems. I noticed she was trying to cheer herself up a little despite the... two bodies we found, so even though I didn't want to leave, I went with her just so that it took her mind off it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "People were leaving". Erina and Isla were on the sofa then, and from their point of view, not everyone had left the attic.
entries.literal: "\"People were leaving\". Erina and Isla were on the sofa then, and from their point of view, not everyone had left the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There's only one person who could've done it.
entries.literal: "There's only one person who could've done it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I walked to the bedrooms and opened the left one. I needed to throw myself onto the bed and be alone for some time."
entries.literal: "\"I walked to the bedrooms and opened the left one. I needed to throw myself onto the bed and be alone for some time.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I stood in the middle of the floor 3 corridor. I didn't want to see the others, so I'd been thinking to myself."
entries.literal: "\"I stood in the middle of the floor 3 corridor. I didn't want to see the others, so I'd been thinking to myself.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "As anyone could've been anywhere, all I wanted was to wait. I could perceive faint footsteps above me, signaling someone was on the fourth floor. I approached a potted plant and sat next to it. I calmly felt the seconds pass, appreciating the sensation."
entries.literal: "\"As anyone could've been anywhere, all I wanted was to wait. I could perceive faint footsteps above me, signaling someone was on the fourth floor. I approached a potted plant and sat next to it. I calmly felt the seconds pass, appreciating the sensation.\""

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: A-Are you alone...!? Where are the others?
entries.literal: "A-Are you alone...!? Where are the others?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "He was pretty agitated, so I kept my composure and waited for him to tell me what had occurred. Everything about him gave away that he'd seen something frightful."
entries.literal: "\"He was pretty agitated, so I kept my composure and waited for him to tell me what had occurred. Everything about him gave away that he'd seen something frightful.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Erina's body lay facing down over a vast pool of blood, traces of which started in the middle of the staircase. I didn't have to walk farther down to know she was dead."
entries.literal: "\"Erina's body lay facing down over a vast pool of blood, traces of which started in the middle of the staircase. I didn't have to walk farther down to know she was dead.\""

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I-I think someone was on the floor above me at some point. Were you alone when you found her?
entries.literal: "I-I think someone was on the floor above me at some point. Were you alone when you found her?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I kept walking down while I silently wondered why he'd been alone. On the floor of hallway C, I pressed two fingers to Erina's body and waited for any perceptible movement."
entries.literal: "\"I kept walking down while I silently wondered why he'd been alone. On the floor of hallway C, I pressed two fingers to Erina's body and waited for any perceptible movement.\""

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone.
entries.literal: "It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "My heavy breathing was interrupting my words, and I didn't let my gaze stray from Erina. Being so close to her, I noticed that blood was coming out of the part of her head that hit the edge of a step."
entries.literal: "\"My heavy breathing was interrupting my words, and I didn't let my gaze stray from Erina. Being so close to her, I noticed that blood was coming out of the part of her head that hit the edge of a step.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "With what we'd talked about, could Erina's killer be identified? I didn't think so, but there was a chance I was failing to consider something."
entries.literal: "\"With what we'd talked about, could Erina's killer be identified? I didn't think so, but there was a chance I was failing to consider something.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "She was there, casually leaning against the line of cabinets. I could hardly believe what I was seeing, but there was no wariness in her eyes and not even a trace of blood near her."
entries.literal: "\"She was there, casually leaning against the line of cabinets. I could hardly believe what I was seeing, but there was no wariness in her eyes and not even a trace of blood near her.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Most people weren't aware that traveling to the future was possible. When Miiya noticed the peculiar smell again and touched the Sekimeiya, she immediately thought she'd traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "Most people weren't aware that traveling to the future was possible. When Miiya noticed the peculiar smell again and touched the Sekimeiya, she immediately thought she'd traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She appeared where she'd been in the past; it was what had happened before. That made her think she'd gone back in time.
entries.literal: "She appeared where she'd been in the past; it was what had happened before. That made her think she'd gone back in time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She was alone above the hallway C stairs when she suddenly heard Erina's voice.
entries.literal: "She was alone above the hallway C stairs when she suddenly heard Erina's voice."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them."
entries.literal: "\"Don't lie! It can only be you. You killed them.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina had seen the bodies in the lobby. Shiroya had died, but she'd just been in the crystal room. Sai hadn't come back.{w} ...Naomi was dead, and earlier in the day, what had happened with the elevator buttons convinced Erina that the killer was someone they'd been unable to find.
entries.literal: "Erina had seen the bodies in the lobby. Shiroya had died, but she'd just been in the crystal room. Sai hadn't come back.{w} ...Naomi was dead, and earlier in the day, what had happened with the elevator buttons convinced Erina that the killer was someone they'd been unable to find."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Miiya.
entries.literal: "...Miiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The way Miiya looked at her only made her more convinced. When she dismissed the accusation with quiet, cold words, Erina ran up the stairs in sheer agitation.
entries.literal: "The way Miiya looked at her only made her more convinced. When she dismissed the accusation with quiet, cold words, Erina ran up the stairs in sheer agitation."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She was quickly knocked back. In midair, she let out a yell that cut off upon impact.
entries.literal: "She was quickly knocked back. In midair, she let out a yell that cut off upon impact."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya wasn't sure what to do. She stared at Erina, processing the fact that she wasn't moving. Then, slowly, she took a few steps backward.
entries.literal: "Miiya wasn't sure what to do. She stared at Erina, processing the fact that she wasn't moving. Then, slowly, she took a few steps backward."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shock rushed through her when she heard footsteps approaching. Atsuki was about to see her.
entries.literal: "Shock rushed through her when she heard footsteps approaching. Atsuki was about to see her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: To hide from him, she rushed into one of the bathrooms on the second floor.
entries.literal: "To hide from him, she rushed into one of the bathrooms on the second floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The first thing Atsuki did was run down the stairs and check Erina's pulse, which allowed Miiya to escape toward the third floor.
entries.literal: "The first thing Atsuki did was run down the stairs and check Erina's pulse, which allowed Miiya to escape toward the third floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There, she heard someone above her. She'd looked at the security cameras and seen no green lights, which perhaps meant that she hadn't been recorded.
entries.literal: "There, she heard someone above her. She'd looked at the security cameras and seen no green lights, which perhaps meant that she hadn't been recorded."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nonetheless, she was completely certain that she'd changed the past.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, she was completely certain that she'd changed the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, after Atsuki came running from below, she soon realized that she couldn't easily explain what had happened.
entries.literal: "However, after Atsuki came running from below, she soon realized that she couldn't easily explain what had happened."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone.
entries.literal: "It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She attempted to hide her future knowledge. At that point in time, the elevator hadn't been opened yet; nobody knew it was usable despite the broken panels.{w} And despite the fact that they should have been together recently, Atsuki had told her he'd been alone. ...Did that mean that she'd overwritten her past self?
entries.literal: "She attempted to hide her future knowledge. At that point in time, the elevator hadn't been opened yet; nobody knew it was usable despite the broken panels.{w} And despite the fact that they should have been together recently, Atsuki had told her he'd been alone. ...Did that mean that she'd overwritten her past self?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I saw that the attic key was inserted into the door. We all entered to find the missing person."
entries.literal: "\"I saw that the attic key was inserted into the door. We all entered to find the missing person.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I stared at the floor's footprints—the proof that the past had changed. I had no idea how, but it was undeniable that it greatly had."
entries.literal: "\"I stared at the floor's footprints—the proof that the past had changed. I had no idea how, but it was undeniable that it greatly had.\""

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: ...Should I bring her to the lobby?
entries.literal: "...Should I bring her to the lobby?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: To the lobby? Why?
entries.literal: "To the lobby? Why?"

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: So she's with the others. Sorry, that was stupid of me. This time, this is actually where she died.
entries.literal: "So she's with the others. Sorry, that was stupid of me. This time, this is actually where she died."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I went quiet. I'd begun to form a small theory, but it appeared I was wrong. After that, I realized I had no idea what had actually happened."
entries.literal: "\"I went quiet. I'd begun to form a small theory, but it appeared I was wrong. After that, I realized I had no idea what had actually happened.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When everyone saw Erina's corpse and began to explain what they'd done, Miiya realized her perception was flawed.
entries.literal: "When everyone saw Erina's corpse and began to explain what they'd done, Miiya realized her perception was flawed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Had she only traveled a few seconds through time? She wasn't sure.
entries.literal: "Had she only traveled a few seconds through time? She wasn't sure."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When it was her turn to clear her name, she said she'd left the attic after Atsuki and that she'd stayed on the third floor.
entries.literal: "When it was her turn to clear her name, she said she'd left the attic after Atsuki and that she'd stayed on the third floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Did Atsuki notice that contradiction?
entries.literal: "...Did Atsuki notice that contradiction?"

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: I just wanted to be alone for a bit, but I didn't feel like staying put somewhere. However, I ended up spending the most time on the third floor, where I heard the elevator. I spent some time in the offices and some outside.
entries.literal: "I just wanted to be alone for a bit, but I didn't feel like staying put somewhere. However, I ended up spending the most time on the third floor, where I heard the elevator. I spent some time in the offices and some outside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone stated that the elevator had been heard once, so she'd been forced to go along with it.{w} However, if she'd really heard it, she should've known that the elevator had ended up on one of the first two floors.
entries.literal: "Everyone stated that the elevator had been heard once, so she'd been forced to go along with it.{w} However, if she'd really heard it, she should've known that the elevator had ended up on one of the first two floors."

entries.speaker: mnn
entries.text: It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone.
entries.literal: "It's not possible for us to take the elevator, so let's walk up. We should come across someone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, why had she said that they couldn't have taken the elevator up when she and Atsuki had seen the body? The panels hadn't been reattached—if the elevator had been above them, they wouldn't have been able to use it. However, if she'd heard it on the third floor, she should've known it was next to Erina's body.
entries.literal: "So, why had she said that they couldn't have taken the elevator up when she and Atsuki had seen the body? The panels hadn't been reattached—if the elevator had been above them, they wouldn't have been able to use it. However, if she'd heard it on the third floor, she should've known it was next to Erina's body."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Did Atsuki make that connection? Did he choose to omit the fact that he hadn't heard Miiya's footsteps above him?
entries.literal: "...Did Atsuki make that connection? Did he choose to omit the fact that he hadn't heard Miiya's footsteps above him?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In any case, they found out that Erina was still alive. She and Isla had been in room A1 since they'd taken the elevator down.
entries.literal: "In any case, they found out that Erina was still alive. She and Isla had been in room A1 since they'd taken the elevator down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The next time a Sekimeiya was found, it was in one of the attic's wardrobes.
entries.literal: "The next time a Sekimeiya was found, it was in one of the attic's wardrobes."

entries.speaker: ilnn
entries.text: Look what I found!
entries.literal: "Look what I found!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "With two hands, Isla was holding one of the bed sheets, folded up into a sphere. It was wrapped around something, and I could tell what Isla was going to say before she did."
entries.literal: "\"With two hands, Isla was holding one of the bed sheets, folded up into a sphere. It was wrapped around something, and I could tell what Isla was going to say before she did.\""

entries.speaker: ilnn
entries.text: It's the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It's the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: What? The Sekimeiya's on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "What? The Sekimeiya's on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: ilnn
entries.text: No, I have it here. It was in the, um... wardrobe.
entries.literal: "No, I have it here. It was in the, um... wardrobe."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the Future Sekimeiya that Miiya had activated. Within the sheet, it gathered energy very quickly.{w} The killer could've been hiding somewhere, so starting with the attic, they searched every floor.
