Since they had the Sekimeiya, they figured nobody could use it to hide from them.
entries.literal: "It was the Future Sekimeiya that Miiya had activated. Within the sheet, it gathered energy very quickly.{w} The killer could've been hiding somewhere, so starting with the attic, they searched every floor. Since they had the Sekimeiya, they figured nobody could use it to hide from them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But the search didn't yield any results...
entries.literal: "But the search didn't yield any results..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The world A group was in room B4, but they weren't found.
entries.literal: "The world A group was in room B4, but they weren't found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro, Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya remained there. Akaro and Isla world switched to world B, but Shiroya and Atsuki stayed behind.
entries.literal: "Akaro, Isla, Atsuki, and Shiroya remained there. Akaro and Isla world switched to world B, but Shiroya and Atsuki stayed behind."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The reason they weren't seen was that everyone else world switched.
entries.literal: "The reason they weren't seen was that everyone else world switched."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The world C group world switched...
entries.literal: "The world C group world switched..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When they were on an office floor. More specifically, on the second floor.
entries.literal: "When they were on an office floor. More specifically, on the second floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Isla A touched the Past Sekimeiya in the cabinet. Akaro had set it to 5 °C, so it had slowly gathered energy. Since the Future Sekimeiya was on the second floor, the overlapping ranges created a world switch.
entries.literal: "Isla A touched the Past Sekimeiya in the cabinet. Akaro had set it to 5 °C, so it had slowly gathered energy. Since the Future Sekimeiya was on the second floor, the overlapping ranges created a world switch."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Everyone but Shiroya B and Atsuki A world switched to world B. ...Alongside both groups, there was someone else who world switched as well.
entries.literal: "Everyone but Shiroya B and Atsuki A world switched to world B. ...Alongside both groups, there was someone else who world switched as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi C, who was in the lobby, world switched too.
entries.literal: "Naomi C, who was in the lobby, world switched too."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi and Shiroya were in the lobby, but only Naomi world switched. That happened because she was still alive.
entries.literal: "Naomi and Shiroya were in the lobby, but only Naomi world switched. That happened because she was still alive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Isla A touched the Past Sekimeiya, the Future Sekimeiya was just outside the partitions on the second floor.
entries.literal: "When Isla A touched the Past Sekimeiya, the Future Sekimeiya was just outside the partitions on the second floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Which was right above the lobby.{w} This is why Shiroya and Atsuki were the only two who didn't world switch—they were in hallway C.
entries.literal: "...Which was right above the lobby.{w} This is why Shiroya and Atsuki were the only two who didn't world switch—they were in hallway C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the world switch happened, Isla C had the Future Sekimeiya wrapped up deep inside the bed sheet. She didn't immediately notice its disappearance.
entries.literal: "When the world switch happened, Isla C had the Future Sekimeiya wrapped up deep inside the bed sheet. She didn't immediately notice its disappearance."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, what everyone did notice was that the elevator panel had reappeared. Not only on the second floor, but on all of them.
entries.literal: "However, what everyone did notice was that the elevator panel had reappeared. Not only on the second floor, but on all of them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya and Atsuki remained in world A with the corpses. When they went to the second floor, they saw the single Sekimeiya outside the partitions, which Shiroya was later able to use to return to world B.
entries.literal: "Shiroya and Atsuki remained in world A with the corpses. When they went to the second floor, they saw the single Sekimeiya outside the partitions, which Shiroya was later able to use to return to world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The moment everyone else world switched to world B, the world B group was in the attic. They had locked themselves in a bedroom.
entries.literal: "The moment everyone else world switched to world B, the world B group was in the attic. They had locked themselves in a bedroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And when the world C group saw the Sekimeiya in the cabinet, Isla unwrapped the bed sheet and saw that hers had disappeared. The Sekimeiya behind the glass was the Past Sekimeiya, which the world B group had left locked in the cabinet before going to the attic.
entries.literal: "And when the world C group saw the Sekimeiya in the cabinet, Isla unwrapped the bed sheet and saw that hers had disappeared. The Sekimeiya behind the glass was the Past Sekimeiya, which the world B group had left locked in the cabinet before going to the attic."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Wait, it's still here.
entries.literal: "Wait, it's still here."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Isla rapidly unwrapped the sheet to prove that she hadn't lied."
entries.literal: "\"Isla rapidly unwrapped the sheet to prove that she hadn't lied.\""

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Hang on, it's not here. The thread I left.
entries.literal: "Hang on, it's not here. The thread I left."

entries.speaker: ilnn
entries.text: It's not here...! The Sekimeiya!
entries.literal: "It's not here...! The Sekimeiya!"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...I-Is this what you're implying? That it was taken out of the cabinet since the thread is gone and then brought to the attic? Then, at some point, it teleported inside again?{w} I have another idea. Let me take the Sekimeiya. Akaro and Katei, you watch the stairs.
entries.literal: "...I-Is this what you're implying? That it was taken out of the cabinet since the thread is gone and then brought to the attic? Then, at some point, it teleported inside again?{w} I have another idea. Let me take the Sekimeiya. Akaro and Katei, you watch the stairs."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Why?
entries.literal: "Why?"

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: Because the last time it wasn't working, remember? I can test if it is now without activating it.
entries.literal: "Because the last time it wasn't working, remember? I can test if it is now without activating it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Sai grabbed the Sekimeiya with his sleeves, causing the curtain to fall, and put it in the middle of the sheet."
entries.literal: "\"Sai grabbed the Sekimeiya with his sleeves, causing the curtain to fall, and put it in the middle of the sheet.\""

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: It was very cold, so let's see if that changes.
entries.literal: "It was very cold, so let's see if that changes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "He wrapped it around with one layer of the cloth and waited a few seconds with his hand over it."
entries.literal: "\"He wrapped it around with one layer of the cloth and waited a few seconds with his hand over it.\""

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...It is getting hot—definitely.{w} All right, I'm sure there's someone on this floor. Don't take your eyes off the stairs. I'm not sure we'll find them, though.
entries.literal: "...It is getting hot—definitely.{w} All right, I'm sure there's someone on this floor. Don't take your eyes off the stairs. I'm not sure we'll find them, though."

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: Why do you say that?
entries.literal: "Why do you say that?"

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Back then, you said it was burning and you could hardly hold it. Is it possible it teleports when it gets too hot?
entries.literal: "Back then, you said it was burning and you could hardly hold it. Is it possible it teleports when it gets too hot?"

entries.speaker: ann
entries.text: And the next time we found it, it wasn't working. It could be that...
entries.literal: "And the next time we found it, it wasn't working. It could be that..."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: It's working now, but we can test it. If the outer layer of the sheet felt hot for Isla, it's possible that it making the sheet hot made it heat up even more quickly.
entries.literal: "It's working now, but we can test it. If the outer layer of the sheet felt hot for Isla, it's possible that it making the sheet hot made it heat up even more quickly."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Sai wrapped the Sekimeiya up completely once again."
entries.literal: "\"Sai wrapped the Sekimeiya up completely once again.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Inside the wrapped sheet, the Past Sekimeiya quickly gathered energy. When Sai touched it in hallway A, they world switched to world C, leaving the sheet behind. The Future Sekimeiya had been very close, and its range was considerable, as it would soon make Akaro travel weeks to the future.
entries.literal: "Inside the wrapped sheet, the Past Sekimeiya quickly gathered energy. When Sai touched it in hallway A, they world switched to world C, leaving the sheet behind. The Future Sekimeiya had been very close, and its range was considerable, as it would soon make Akaro travel weeks to the future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Without realizing it, they were back in their world. They had made a full loop.
entries.literal: "Without realizing it, they were back in their world. They had made a full loop."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They inspected the crystal floor, but nobody was found. Akaro and Isla A had remained in world B.{w} However, there were many things they noticed: Suripo's body had reappeared, and Shiroya's had disappeared. But Naomi was still there—she had returned to her world too, and the blood that had pooled below her had vanished.
entries.literal: "They inspected the crystal floor, but nobody was found. Akaro and Isla A had remained in world B.{w} However, there were many things they noticed: Suripo's body had reappeared, and Shiroya's had disappeared. But Naomi was still there—she had returned to her world too, and the blood that had pooled below her had vanished."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: ...Oh wait, look at Naomi's head.
entries.literal: "...Oh wait, look at Naomi's head."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "From the wound she had, quite a bit of blood was pouring out."
entries.literal: "\"From the wound she had, quite a bit of blood was pouring out.\""

entries.speaker: aknn
entries.text: Yes, more blood is coming out than before.
entries.literal: "Yes, more blood is coming out than before."

entries.speaker: sainn
entries.text: And it seems like it started just now, right? Otherwise, the pool on the floor would be much bigger.
entries.literal: "And it seems like it started just now, right? Otherwise, the pool on the floor would be much bigger."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They'd all returned to world C, but during the brief time they'd been in world B, Naomi's had been the only body in the lobby. She'd been bleeding from her head, so she'd left a large spot of blood on the polished floor.{w} That blood confused many people, but the person most thoroughly deceived by it was Sai B.{w} When he world switched to world A, only Shiroya's corpse was in the lobby, and there was blood next to her. Of course, he naturally assumed that it was hers, not Naomi's.{w} However, when he returned to world B, not only had the pool shrunk, but Shiroya's corpse had disappeared—she was still alive in that world.
entries.literal: "They'd all returned to world C, but during the brief time they'd been in world B, Naomi's had been the only body in the lobby. She'd been bleeding from her head, so she'd left a large spot of blood on the polished floor.{w} That blood confused many people, but the person most thoroughly deceived by it was Sai B.{w} When he world switched to world A, only Shiroya's corpse was in the lobby, and there was blood next to her. Of course, he naturally assumed that it was hers, not Naomi's.{w} However, when he returned to world B, not only had the pool shrunk, but Shiroya's corpse had disappeared—she was still alive in that world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world C, it became clear that understanding what had happened around them might've been out of everyone's grasp. Nobody had been found, but the bizarre occurrences within the tower hadn't stopped.
entries.literal: "In world C, it became clear that understanding what had happened around them might've been out of everyone's grasp. Nobody had been found, but the bizarre occurrences within the tower hadn't stopped."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The security room had unlocked, Erina's body had disappeared, the Sekimeiya had teleported...
entries.literal: "The security room had unlocked, Erina's body had disappeared, the Sekimeiya had teleported..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That time, Miiya had found it in room A1. It was the fake Sekimeiya, which they decided to leave in the event room for good.
entries.literal: "That time, Miiya had found it in room A1. It was the fake Sekimeiya, which they decided to leave in the event room for good."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After that, things finally slowed down.
entries.literal: "After that, things finally slowed down."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And a long time later, Miiya had the urge to lie down. She went to the attic, where she fell asleep.
entries.literal: "And a long time later, Miiya had the urge to lie down. She went to the attic, where she fell asleep."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When she woke up, the light suddenly turned on. That was the sign of a world switch.
entries.literal: "When she woke up, the light suddenly turned on. That was the sign of a world switch."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The exact appearance of the bed where she'd been had changed, but she couldn't notice that, as the light had been off. In the world where she appeared, the sheets had been messy as well.
entries.literal: "The exact appearance of the bed where she'd been had changed, but she couldn't notice that, as the light had been off. In the world where she appeared, the sheets had been messy as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Nobody was above her, and she heard sounds coming from the opposite bedroom. ...It was Shiroya, who'd been trapped there by Sai.
entries.literal: "Nobody was above her, and she heard sounds coming from the opposite bedroom. ...It was Shiroya, who'd been trapped there by Sai."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Is there anything wrong with this?
entries.literal: "Is there anything wrong with this?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Shiroya was locked behind that door. It follows that Miiya was in world B.
entries.literal: "...Shiroya was locked behind that door. It follows that Miiya was in world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, the first time a world switch happened from world C, everyone went to world A.
entries.literal: "However, the first time a world switch happened from world C, everyone went to world A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The world switch order is A - B - C - A... Why did Miiya go from world C to world B, then?
entries.literal: "The world switch order is A - B - C - A... Why did Miiya go from world C to world B, then?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If she had world switched while she slept, she would have died. By lying in bed, she pressed the mattress down. Upon changing worlds, her body would've been split in half by an uncompressed mattress.
entries.literal: "If she had world switched while she slept, she would have died. By lying in bed, she pressed the mattress down. Upon changing worlds, her body would've been split in half by an uncompressed mattress."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The reason does not follow the order you're accustomed to.
entries.literal: "The reason does not follow the order you're accustomed to."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Can you recall another time a backward world switch happened?
entries.literal: "Can you recall another time a backward world switch happened?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After Sai and Akaro escaped the attic's bedroom, Sai world switched to world A while in room B6. ...From world B, he went to world A.
entries.literal: "After Sai and Akaro escaped the attic's bedroom, Sai world switched to world A while in room B6. ...From world B, he went to world A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What about a third instance?
entries.literal: "What about a third instance?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yes. When Atsuki and Erina returned to world B, they had been in world C. Once again, they went from world C to world B.
entries.literal: "Yes. When Atsuki and Erina returned to world B, they had been in world C. Once again, they went from world C to world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Atsuki and Erina returned to world B, they had been in world C. Once again, they went from world C to world B.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki and Erina returned to world B, they had been in world C. Once again, they went from world C to world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Is there anything interesting that these examples share?
entries.literal: "Is there anything interesting that these examples share?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That is not the case.
entries.literal: "That is not the case."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The similarity is that neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world.
entries.literal: "The similarity is that neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Exactly. Neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world.
entries.literal: "Exactly. Neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's wrong. In Sai's case, it was his first time.
entries.literal: "That's wrong. In Sai's case, it was his first time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The similarity is that neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world.
entries.literal: "The similarity is that neither of the Sekimeiya were activated in their world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In Sai's case...
entries.literal: "In Sai's case..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Puzzled, he stepped into hallway B. ...What had just happened?{w} Out of nowhere, the Sekimeiya had disappeared.{w} He wondered if he'd traveled through time. Even though he hadn't touched the Sekimeiya, something peculiar had occurred."
entries.literal: "\"Puzzled, he stepped into hallway B. ...What had just happened?{w} Out of nowhere, the Sekimeiya had disappeared.{w} He wondered if he'd traveled through time. Even though he hadn't touched the Sekimeiya, something peculiar had occurred.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai world switched without touching the Sekimeiya, and he had both of them.
entries.literal: "Sai world switched without touching the Sekimeiya, and he had both of them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, then, why did he world switch? Is there another shared similarity?
entries.literal: "So, then, why did he world switch? Is there another shared similarity?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's not it. Both Sekimeiya had been used recently when Sai world switched.
entries.literal: "That's not it. Both Sekimeiya had been used recently when Sai world switched."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...It happened when they were pulled from the previous world.
entries.literal: "...It happened when they were pulled from the previous world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's not it.
entries.literal: "That's not it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It happened when they were pulled from the previous world.
entries.literal: "It happened when they were pulled from the previous world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Yes. It happened when they were pulled from the previous world.
entries.literal: "Yes. It happened when they were pulled from the previous world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Sai world switched from world B to world A, someone world switched from world A to world B.{w} ...Shiroya.
entries.literal: "When Sai world switched from world B to world A, someone world switched from world A to world B.{w} ...Shiroya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the storeroom, she touched the Sekimeiya to return to her world.
entries.literal: "In the storeroom, she touched the Sekimeiya to return to her world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Miiya world switched from world C to world B, someone world switched from world B to world C. In the event room, Erina, Atsuki, and Shiroya suddenly appeared in world C.
entries.literal: "When Miiya world switched from world C to world B, someone world switched from world B to world C. In the event room, Erina, Atsuki, and Shiroya suddenly appeared in world C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Every time a world switch was activated, it occurred in the world someone would be sent to as well. If someone was in the overlapping ranges of the next world, they would be pulled backward to the previous one. ...This swap begins to define the real meaning of the world switch.
entries.literal: "Every time a world switch was activated, it occurred in the world someone would be sent to as well. If someone was in the overlapping ranges of the next world, they would be pulled backward to the previous one. ...This swap begins to define the real meaning of the world switch."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Erina and Atsuki returned to world B in the elevator, they had been in world C.
entries.literal: "When Erina and Atsuki returned to world B in the elevator, they had been in world C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was Atsuki A—the person behind the "extra" elevator sound in world C.
entries.literal: "It was Atsuki A—the person behind the \"extra\" elevator sound in world C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He'd been escaping from Sai in world A and found both Sekimeiya, which brought him to world B.
entries.literal: "He'd been escaping from Sai in world A and found both Sekimeiya, which brought him to world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He hadn't experienced the Sekimeiya's powers yet. Startled by the burn, he thought both glowing gems had merely disappeared.
entries.literal: "He hadn't experienced the Sekimeiya's powers yet. Startled by the burn, he thought both glowing gems had merely disappeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world B, he saw the Future Sekimeiya on the floor of the event room, which Erina had activated. He touched it, and as the Past Sekimeiya was still active in Ido's locker, he world switched to world C.
entries.literal: "In world B, he saw the Future Sekimeiya on the floor of the event room, which Erina had activated. He touched it, and as the Past Sekimeiya was still active in Ido's locker, he world switched to world C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...He was only there momentarily.{w} After allowing Erina and his world B self to return to world B, he took the elevator up.
entries.literal: "...He was only there momentarily.{w} After allowing Erina and his world B self to return to world B, he took the elevator up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Out of nowhere, the elevator disappeared, and he fell all the way down onto that world's elevator, leaving him unconscious and wounded.
entries.literal: "Out of nowhere, the elevator disappeared, and he fell all the way down onto that world's elevator, leaving him unconscious and wounded."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was where the police found him—the only survivor of the incident.
entries.literal: "That was where the police found him—the only survivor of the incident."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The light suddenly turned on; Miiya was pulled to world B. She heard Shiroya's voice and silently left the attic.
entries.literal: "The light suddenly turned on; Miiya was pulled to world B. She heard Shiroya's voice and silently left the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the crystal floor, she found the Past Sekimeiya in Ido's locker, where Atsuki had kept it.
entries.literal: "On the crystal floor, she found the Past Sekimeiya in Ido's locker, where Atsuki had kept it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Despite being filled with questions, my mind was blank. My hand was drawn to the shape that had begun to take form behind the dark lines, and through the narrow space, I made contact, hoping with all my might that I would be brought to the awaited time."
entries.literal: "\"Despite being filled with questions, my mind was blank. My hand was drawn to the shape that had begun to take form behind the dark lines, and through the narrow space, I made contact, hoping with all my might that I would be brought to the awaited time.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After what had happened with Erina, Miiya had learned that traveling to the future with the Sekimeiya was possible. She wanted to be brought to {time=21}, out of the tower.{w} Through the slits in the locker, she activated it, and as Erina had just triggered the world switch, the Future Sekimeiya was powered off. Miiya went more than half an hour to the past and reset the Sekimeiya. When Atsuki B, who had originally hidden it there, later activated it, he only went forty minutes back in time.
entries.literal: "After what had happened with Erina, Miiya had learned that traveling to the future with the Sekimeiya was possible. She wanted to be brought to {time=21}, out of the tower.{w} Through the slits in the locker, she activated it, and as Erina had just triggered the world switch, the Future Sekimeiya was powered off. Miiya went more than half an hour to the past and reset the Sekimeiya. When Atsuki B, who had originally hidden it there, later activated it, he only went forty minutes back in time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya appeared in hallway A and immediately fell down. An interesting location.{w} After all, forty minutes after the point she traveled, she was back in world C. She and Atsuki were running to the event room, which was what had made her fall in the past. ...The replicated location was from world C, but it was applied in the past of world B.
entries.literal: "Miiya appeared in hallway A and immediately fell down. An interesting location.{w} After all, forty minutes after the point she traveled, she was back in world C. She and Atsuki were running to the event room, which was what had made her fall in the past. ...The replicated location was from world C, but it was applied in the past of world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At {time=18:21}, Miiya found Katei dead. Following that, she noticed the flickering green lights of the security cameras.
entries.literal: "At {time=18:21}, Miiya found Katei dead. Following that, she noticed the flickering green lights of the security cameras."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "The cabinet was covered by its curtain. If the Sekimeiya was behind it, it was possible someone else was soon to be on the crystal floor."
entries.literal: "\"The cabinet was covered by its curtain. If the Sekimeiya was behind it, it was possible someone else was soon to be on the crystal floor.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "It was possible"... She wasn't sure if she had gone to the past.{w} She couldn't know if she had gone to the future because she had slept for an unknown period of time. The computer's clock couldn't confirm anything for her.
entries.literal: "\"It was possible\"... She wasn't sure if she had gone to the past.{w} She couldn't know if she had gone to the future because she had slept for an unknown period of time. The computer's clock couldn't confirm anything for her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Then, in hallway B, she was found by Erina B, who didn't recognize her. They entered room B4 and found the Sekimeiya that Shiroya had left in a cabinet, which they brought to the event room.
entries.literal: "Then, in hallway B, she was found by Erina B, who didn't recognize her. They entered room B4 and found the Sekimeiya that Shiroya had left in a cabinet, which they brought to the event room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Miiya heard Atsuki's yells, she ran away without noticing that she'd dropped the note she'd been trying to prevent him from seeing. Erina had just reached into Miiya's purse to grab her keys, so it had remained slightly open.
entries.literal: "When Miiya heard Atsuki's yells, she ran away without noticing that she'd dropped the note she'd been trying to prevent him from seeing. Erina had just reached into Miiya's purse to grab her keys, so it had remained slightly open."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He and Shiroya were there, talking to each other. After Erina joined them, Miiya attempted to eavesdrop from afar.
entries.literal: "He and Shiroya were there, talking to each other. After Erina joined them, Miiya attempted to eavesdrop from afar."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They went to the event room, so Miiya entered the staff room to listen through the wall.
entries.literal: "They went to the event room, so Miiya entered the staff room to listen through the wall."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Minutes later, the same world switch that had pulled her to world B took place.
entries.literal: "Minutes later, the same world switch that had pulled her to world B took place."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She was the fourth person to world switch to world C. With her ear against the wall, both ranges encompassed her too.
entries.literal: "She was the fourth person to world switch to world C. With her ear against the wall, both ranges encompassed her too."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world C, the fake Sekimeiya was still in the event room, so it seemed like it teleported into the cabinet.
entries.literal: "In world C, the fake Sekimeiya was still in the event room, so it seemed like it teleported into the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two hours remained until {time=21.}
entries.literal: "Two hours remained until {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Fortunately, everyone was able to leave safely. That included Naomi, who was woken up by the loud noise of the shutter.
entries.literal: "Fortunately, everyone was able to leave safely. That included Naomi, who was woken up by the loud noise of the shutter."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, a single decision nearly sent everything spiraling into destruction.
entries.literal: "However, a single decision nearly sent everything spiraling into destruction."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Instead of the shutter, yells of pain that would've woken Naomi up before that time were almost let out. Disastrous yells that would've shattered everything that had been needed to get there.
entries.literal: "Instead of the shutter, yells of pain that would've woken Naomi up before that time were almost let out. Disastrous yells that would've shattered everything that had been needed to get there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They were yells that, in reality, nobody ever heard. At {time=21:04}, the police entered the building.{w} Even though everyone was alive, Suripo was dead on the floor. The officers could hardly believe their eyes while the survivors emerged.
entries.literal: "They were yells that, in reality, nobody ever heard. At {time=21:04}, the police entered the building.{w} Even though everyone was alive, Suripo was dead on the floor. The officers could hardly believe their eyes while the survivors emerged."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Two of whom knew what had happened. They knew that their lives after the 15th were ones that had been gifted to them.
entries.literal: "...Two of whom knew what had happened. They knew that their lives after the 15th were ones that had been gifted to them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Hopefully, you enjoyed this story.
entries.literal: "Hopefully, you enjoyed this story."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It's not made for everyone, but I'm glad you're still here. ...We're pretty high up.
entries.literal: "It's not made for everyone, but I'm glad you're still here. ...We're pretty high up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Let's see... You answered {} out of {} ({}%) questions correctly. I hope you're proud of that.
entries.literal: "Let's see... You answered {} out of {} ({}%) questions correctly. I hope you're proud of that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Of course, though, there's one last thing for you to see.{w}{w=0.3} The peak.
entries.literal: "Of course, though, there's one last thing for you to see.{w}{w=0.3} The peak."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Did you think you'd already seen it, maybe?
entries.literal: "Did you think you'd already seen it, maybe?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...What exactly is at the very top?
entries.literal: "...What exactly is at the very top?"

entries.text: The Peak
entries.literal: "The Peak"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The crystal floor was empty. Everyone had disappeared a long time earlier.
entries.literal: "The crystal floor was empty. Everyone had disappeared a long time earlier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My past self was in the attic. I'd been waiting at the bottom of the tower so that the large range of my past travel wouldn't reach me.
entries.literal: "My past self was in the attic. I'd been waiting at the bottom of the tower so that the large range of my past travel wouldn't reach me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's already been more than an hour. It should happen soon.
entries.literal: "It's already been more than an hour. It should happen soon."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What will happen after? Are the others gonna come back?
entries.literal: "What will happen after? Are the others gonna come back?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd been resting my mind, but the hours that remained were still an unknown area.
entries.literal: "I'd been resting my mind, but the hours that remained were still an unknown area."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The first time we changed worlds, did we appear in this world? I've been wondering that for a while...
entries.literal: "The first time we changed worlds, did we appear in this world? I've been wondering that for a while..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I'm pretty sure the people we met belonged to this world, but the world we went to could've been the one they were sent to. They don't necessarily have to return to this one.
entries.literal: "I'm pretty sure the people we met belonged to this world, but the world we went to could've been the one they were sent to. They don't necessarily have to return to this one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Hm...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I realized I had a new piece of information to work with.
entries.literal: "I realized I had a new piece of information to work with."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Actually, I'm pretty sure the world we were sent to was this very world.{w} Sai asked me how Shiroya got into the tower. For him, she'd never been there.
entries.literal: "...Actually, I'm pretty sure the world we were sent to was this very world.{w} Sai asked me how Shiroya got into the tower. For him, she'd never been there."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'd appreciate it if you told the truth, though. How did she get in?
entries.literal: "I'd appreciate it if you told the truth, though. How did she get in?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: She was with us from the beginning...
entries.literal: "She was with us from the beginning..."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: That's false. Since she seems to be with you, I really doubt you were stupid enough to make her enter through the storeroom. That's what's strange, but perhaps you did.{w} Let me see.
entries.literal: "That's false. Since she seems to be with you, I really doubt you were stupid enough to make her enter through the storeroom. That's what's strange, but perhaps you did.{w} Let me see."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Indifferent to my confusion and rage, Sai walked to hallway C."
entries.literal: "\"Indifferent to my confusion and rage, Sai walked to hallway C.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What are you doing!?
entries.literal: "What are you doing!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Instead of answering, he entered the storeroom.{w} Seconds later, he returned."
entries.literal: "\"Instead of answering, he entered the storeroom.{w} Seconds later, he returned.\""

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I just wanted to verify that she hasn't entered through the storeroom yet.
entries.literal: "I just wanted to verify that she hasn't entered through the storeroom yet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I get it now. He had marked the door in some way—he could tell whether it had opened. So, he went to the storeroom and confirmed that his mark was still there.
entries.literal: "I get it now. He had marked the door in some way—he could tell whether it had opened. So, he went to the storeroom and confirmed that his mark was still there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That implies that it was this world. The mark existed, as the door hadn't opened since he'd left it.
entries.literal: "That implies that it was this world. The mark existed, as the door hadn't opened since he'd left it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That means they'll return here. Just like we came back to our world, they'll come back here. It'll happen before {time=19.}
entries.literal: "That means they'll return here. Just like we came back to our world, they'll come back here. It'll happen before {time=19.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And that's not all...
entries.literal: "And that's not all..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Sai, what time is it?
entries.literal: "Sai, what time is it?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Uh...{w} it's {time=18:43.}

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: {time=18:43.}.. That was almost twenty minutes behind the real time I estimated. That made me think that after traveling, Sai's replicated location had been of twenty minutes prior, and his watch hadn't stopped working.
entries.literal: "{time=18:43.}.. That was almost twenty minutes behind the real time I estimated. That made me think that after traveling, Sai's replicated location had been of twenty minutes prior, and his watch hadn't stopped working."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now, I'm pretty sure that his watch was a bit more than twenty minutes behind, but it wasn't because he had traveled. It was the Sai from this world, who still had the time wrong from when he'd traveled to the future with the other version of me.{w} Later, when we returned to our world, Sai's time was accurate again, and I figured he must've synced it using the computer.
entries.literal: "Now, I'm pretty sure that his watch was a bit more than twenty minutes behind, but it wasn't because he had traveled. It was the Sai from this world, who still had the time wrong from when he'd traveled to the future with the other version of me.{w} Later, when we returned to our world, Sai's time was accurate again, and I figured he must've synced it using the computer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It happened even before I expected it. Suddenly, I heard a voice in hallway A.
entries.literal: "It happened even before I expected it. Suddenly, I heard a voice in hallway A."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...pen again.
entries.literal: "...pen again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wha—
entries.literal: "Wha—"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: But why is the sheet—
entries.literal: "But why is the sheet—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up immediately to hide.
entries.literal: "I stood up immediately to hide."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Everyone's there! Erina too, she's still alive!
entries.literal: "Everyone's there! Erina too, she's still alive!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was a bit closer to the staircase with Isla, and it seemed everyone had just appeared. I'd been sitting on the stairs, so they hadn't noticed me.
entries.literal: "She was a bit closer to the staircase with Isla, and it seemed everyone had just appeared. I'd been sitting on the stairs, so they hadn't noticed me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai went to the storeroom.
entries.literal: "Sai went to the storeroom."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...It hasn't been opened again.
entries.literal: "...It hasn't been opened again."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Fuck... Let's hurry. The Sekimeiya might've appeared on this floor.{w} I didn't think this through. If someone's actually here, there's a chance it'll allow them to escape.
entries.literal: "Fuck... Let's hurry. The Sekimeiya might've appeared on this floor.{w} I didn't think this through. If someone's actually here, there's a chance it'll allow them to escape."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Suddenly, they began to look through every room.
entries.literal: "Suddenly, they began to look through every room."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: They're really all back, and my past self is likely already gone from the attic.
entries.literal: "They're really all back, and my past self is likely already gone from the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What now, then? I need to have the Sekimeiya for myself...{w} Am I going to be found? The Sekimeiya are in the attic, so I can probably use the future one to escape from them.
entries.literal: "What now, then? I need to have the Sekimeiya for myself...{w} Am I going to be found? The Sekimeiya are in the attic, so I can probably use the future one to escape from them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That wasn't needed. They found the third Sekimeiya, but when they were done, they didn't move up to the second floor.
entries.literal: "That wasn't needed. They found the third Sekimeiya, but when they were done, they didn't move up to the second floor."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Are they not planning to keep going?
entries.literal: "...{w}Are they not planning to keep going?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They remained below, separate from each other.
entries.literal: "They remained below, separate from each other."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Why? Why would they search like that only to not continue? Did they only want to find the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Why? Why would they search like that only to not continue? Did they only want to find the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Maybe I get it. They don't know that the world around them just changed.{w} Perhaps they just looked through the whole building, ending at the crystal floor. If that's when they changed worlds, they must think that the whole building is empty.
entries.literal: "...{w}Maybe I get it. They don't know that the world around them just changed.{w} Perhaps they just looked through the whole building, ending at the crystal floor. If that's when they changed worlds, they must think that the whole building is empty."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...And if that's the case, as long as they stay there, I can move freely above them.
entries.literal: "...And if that's the case, as long as they stay there, I can move freely above them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now I'm sure I'm in the world we once went to. That means I can do everything I want.
entries.literal: "Now I'm sure I'm in the world we once went to. That means I can do everything I want."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The end of my plan had always been blurry. After everything else, I wanted to find Shiroya and return to our original world, sure that the reality I wanted to shape did exist. I'd never truly known how to do that until just then.
entries.literal: "The end of my plan had always been blurry. After everything else, I wanted to find Shiroya and return to our original world, sure that the reality I wanted to shape did exist. I'd never truly known how to do that until just then."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: We arrived in this world at {time=19.} At that time, I'll be able to meet Shiroya again.
entries.literal: "We arrived in this world at {time=19.} At that time, I'll be able to meet Shiroya again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She was with us. Her clothes were different, but she was the real one—she had lived through much more than I had imagined.{w} She'll be here at {time=19}, and she'll go to the attic all of a sudden. That's where I'll be.
entries.literal: "She was with us. Her clothes were different, but she was the real one—she had lived through much more than I had imagined.{w} She'll be here at {time=19}, and she'll go to the attic all of a sudden. That's where I'll be."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Then, I know we'll be able to return to our world. We merely have to be in the middle of the building.
entries.literal: "Then, I know we'll be able to return to our world. We merely have to be in the middle of the building."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When we took the elevator up, it stopped on the third floor. That was when we returned.{w} That must mean that the third floor was being encompassed by the ranges of both Sekimeiya, and someone activated one. If we're there at that time, I know for a fact we'll be able to return.
entries.literal: "When we took the elevator up, it stopped on the third floor. That was when we returned.{w} That must mean that the third floor was being encompassed by the ranges of both Sekimeiya, and someone activated one. If we're there at that time, I know for a fact we'll be able to return."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went up to the attic.
entries.literal: "I went up to the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: As I thought, I'm no longer here.
entries.literal: "As I thought, I'm no longer here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The kitchen was empty, but I could see my footprints on the floor. I had very recently traveled to the 24th of November.
entries.literal: "The kitchen was empty, but I could see my footprints on the floor. I had very recently traveled to the 24th of November."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Past Sekimeiya was on the marble countertop, already white again. By its side was the voice recorder with numbers on its screen.{w} 81:04.
entries.literal: "The Past Sekimeiya was on the marble countertop, already white again. By its side was the voice recorder with numbers on its screen.{w} 81:04."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Future Sekimeiya was still in the refrigerator, so I put the past one inside too.
entries.literal: "The Future Sekimeiya was still in the refrigerator, so I put the past one inside too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I began a new recording.
entries.literal: "I began a new recording."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to take the Past Sekimeiya back out, but my arm stopped itself.
entries.literal: "I was about to take the Past Sekimeiya back out, but my arm stopped itself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}My heartbeat picked up, causing my fingers to jitter on their own. A thought had suddenly come to me.
entries.literal: "...{w}My heartbeat picked up, causing my fingers to jitter on their own. A thought had suddenly come to me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It should be simple. I can travel to November 30th one more time. I know saving Miiya is within my reach—she's alive.{w} Then, I have to do what I just thought. I can enter the tower when the 15th comes. I can be in the attic at {time=19}, before Shiroya appears.
entries.literal: "...It should be simple. I can travel to November 30th one more time. I know saving Miiya is within my reach—she's alive.{w} Then, I have to do what I just thought. I can enter the tower when the 15th comes. I can be in the attic at {time=19}, before Shiroya appears."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Was that really the case, though?
entries.literal: "Was that really the case, though?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: According to my estimate, it should've been a little past {time=16.} Three hours still remained until {time=19.}
entries.literal: "According to my estimate, it should've been a little past {time=16.} Three hours still remained until {time=19.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My plan had been to use the Past Sekimeiya one more time after my past self's disappearance.
entries.literal: "My plan had been to use the Past Sekimeiya one more time after my past self's disappearance."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could live through November 30th a third time; I could save Miiya, as the news I'd read was the only obstacle in that pursuit.{w} In the world I was in, Shiroya didn't exist, but I had never seen her blood, no definitive proof of her death. Her absence was no real barrier.
entries.literal: "I could live through November 30th a third time; I could save Miiya, as the news I'd read was the only obstacle in that pursuit.{w} In the world I was in, Shiroya didn't exist, but I had never seen her blood, no definitive proof of her death. Her absence was no real barrier."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After that, I had to return with Shiroya to our world. The way to accomplish it was by being in the center of the building at close to {time=19:30.}
entries.literal: "After that, I had to return with Shiroya to our world. The way to accomplish it was by being in the center of the building at close to {time=19:30.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was how I had to do it. If I attempted to change worlds before that point by using the two Sekimeiya, it was very likely I would appear someplace else. After all, that was how the group from the world I was in had vanished earlier, and I was completely confident they hadn't appeared in our world.
entries.literal: "That was how I had to do it. If I attempted to change worlds before that point by using the two Sekimeiya, it was very likely I would appear someplace else. After all, that was how the group from the world I was in had vanished earlier, and I was completely confident they hadn't appeared in our world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It should've been doable—I'd never really considered otherwise. ...What made my arm stop was the connection I'd just made.
entries.literal: "It should've been doable—I'd never really considered otherwise. ...What made my arm stop was the connection I'd just made."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just before {time=19:30}, Sai had gone to the storeroom to check whether his mark had disappeared. At that time, the door hadn't opened yet.
entries.literal: "Just before {time=19:30}, Sai had gone to the storeroom to check whether his mark had disappeared. At that time, the door hadn't opened yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I left the attic; I didn't feel comfortable thinking there. If anyone came up with the elevator, I wouldn't hear them, so I chose to go to the sixth floor, where I would hear both the elevator and any approaching footsteps.
entries.literal: "...{w}I left the attic; I didn't feel comfortable thinking there. If anyone came up with the elevator, I wouldn't hear them, so I chose to go to the sixth floor, where I would hear both the elevator and any approaching footsteps."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Of course, my plan implied a future version of myself was in the tower. A version of myself who had been there since the morning.{w} I'd known that, which was why I'd followed the group's movements—so that I could give myself a route to hide throughout the day, aware of where to be at all times.
entries.literal: "...Of course, my plan implied a future version of myself was in the tower. A version of myself who had been there since the morning.{w} I'd known that, which was why I'd followed the group's movements—so that I could give myself a route to hide throughout the day, aware of where to be at all times."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could that really be the case, though?
entries.literal: "Could that really be the case, though?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I thought about it after having witnessed the whole series of events, my heartbeat grew erratic.
entries.literal: "When I thought about it after having witnessed the whole series of events, my heartbeat grew erratic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is it...?{w} Just before the group left this world, the whole building was searched, when I replaced the other Atsuki without anyone noticing. Naturally, my future self wasn't found—that would've been a paradox, as I would've seen myself before knowing where I would be.
entries.literal: "Is it...?{w} Just before the group left this world, the whole building was searched, when I replaced the other Atsuki without anyone noticing. Naturally, my future self wasn't found—that would've been a paradox, as I would've seen myself before knowing where I would be."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, why was that me not found? How will I avoid being found?{w} At the time, every single place was inspected except for the hidden area in the storeroom. However, I couldn't have been there, as my own past self already was.
entries.literal: "So, why was that me not found? How will I avoid being found?{w} At the time, every single place was inspected except for the hidden area in the storeroom. However, I couldn't have been there, as my own past self already was."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd had the thought in the back of my mind: if a similar problem arose, the storeroom's secret could aid me. ...That was no longer the case.
entries.literal: "I'd had the thought in the back of my mind: if a similar problem arose, the storeroom's secret could aid me. ...That was no longer the case."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: My future self merely has to be here at {time=19:30.} ...It's not exact, but I'll say the search happened at {time=14.}{w} My past self was in the storeroom from {time=9} to {time=14.} Immediately after I left it, the fake wall was found by this world's group.{w} I thought that in the worst-case scenario, I could enter through the storeroom after the attack. ...But that's not possible. As soon as it was found, Sai marked it, and I know that mark will still be there at {time=19:30}, right before we returned to our world.
entries.literal: "My future self merely has to be here at {time=19:30.} ...It's not exact, but I'll say the search happened at {time=14.}{w} My past self was in the storeroom from {time=9} to {time=14.} Immediately after I left it, the fake wall was found by this world's group.{w} I thought that in the worst-case scenario, I could enter through the storeroom after the attack. ...But that's not possible. As soon as it was found, Sai marked it, and I know that mark will still be there at {time=19:30}, right before we returned to our world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Knowing all that, it wasn't possible that a future self of mine would enter the tower after the {time=14} search.
entries.literal: "Knowing all that, it wasn't possible that a future self of mine would enter the tower after the {time=14} search."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: More importantly, it's very unlikely this would be possible either way. I shouldn't assume that I could enter through the storeroom without being seen. Technically, I could enter after {time=19:30} and travel to the past in order to be at the center of the building at the right time, but I don't know whether I'll be seen outside, and if I am, I'll be unable to travel back.{w} I shouldn't go back to the 30th with a plan that could fail, so I have to entirely rule out the storeroom.
entries.literal: "More importantly, it's very unlikely this would be possible either way. I shouldn't assume that I could enter through the storeroom without being seen. Technically, I could enter after {time=19:30} and travel to the past in order to be at the center of the building at the right time, but I don't know whether I'll be seen outside, and if I am, I'll be unable to travel back.{w} I shouldn't go back to the 30th with a plan that could fail, so I have to entirely rule out the storeroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That meant that for a future self of mine to be present at {time=19:30}, he would've had to be in the tower since a time before my past self had begun to wait in the storeroom.{w} Since I was aware of that, how could I avoid being found by the search at {time=14}?
entries.literal: "That meant that for a future self of mine to be present at {time=19:30}, he would've had to be in the tower since a time before my past self had begun to wait in the storeroom.{w} Since I was aware of that, how could I avoid being found by the search at {time=14}?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's one way—by traveling to the future.
entries.literal: "There's one way—by traveling to the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When could I have used the Future Sekimeiya to not be present at {time=14}?
entries.literal: "When could I have used the Future Sekimeiya to not be present at {time=14}?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: After the smoke was released, it was brought to the attic in a suitcase. The next time it moved was when Katei brought it to the crystal floor with the other Atsuki and Miiya.
entries.literal: "After the smoke was released, it was brought to the attic in a suitcase. The next time it moved was when Katei brought it to the crystal floor with the other Atsuki and Miiya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I remember how he looked when he had it in his hands. He was in pain because the Sekimeiya hadn't been activated since it had been taken out of the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I remember how he looked when he had it in his hands. He was in pain because the Sekimeiya hadn't been activated since it had been taken out of the cabinet."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If my future self had used it before he brought it down, it would've reset and spent a while powered off. There's no way Katei would've had to hold it carefully like he did.
entries.literal: "If my future self had used it before he brought it down, it would've reset and spent a while powered off. There's no way Katei would've had to hold it carefully like he did."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If I'd touched it at that point, I would've had to be in the storeroom during the night to appear in the tower in the future. Maybe that's possible, but there's too much uncertainty; there's clear room for failure.
entries.literal: "If I'd touched it at that point, I would've had to be in the storeroom during the night to appear in the tower in the future. Maybe that's possible, but there's too much uncertainty; there's clear room for failure."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could explain Katei's face in a different way: I could leave the Sekimeiya in a hot place as I touch it. However, both Sekimeiya were in the attic. I would have to find out which was which, keep the past one in the refrigerator due to its large range, and travel to the future.
entries.literal: "I could explain Katei's face in a different way: I could leave the Sekimeiya in a hot place as I touch it. However, both Sekimeiya were in the attic. I would have to find out which was which, keep the past one in the refrigerator due to its large range, and travel to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I'd once put some thought into the type of web I was entangled in. I'd considered that in order to work around what you'd observed, having observed too much could be a fatal flaw.
entries.literal: "...I'd once put some thought into the type of web I was entangled in. I'd considered that in order to work around what you'd observed, having observed too much could be a fatal flaw."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the time, I'd also come up with another concept in the form of thought-up loops, which were fundamentally similar to the way the Past Sekimeiya worked.
entries.literal: "At the time, I'd also come up with another concept in the form of thought-up loops, which were fundamentally similar to the way the Past Sekimeiya worked."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's uncertain whether traveling to the future before Katei brought the Sekimeiya down will work out smoothly. However, I have a way to know if it will.
entries.literal: "It's uncertain whether traveling to the future before Katei brought the Sekimeiya down will work out smoothly. However, I have a way to know if it will."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: A cue.{w} If I had a loop in my head, I could know whether it could be completed. If I thought about everything that I would do after touching the Past Sekimeiya, I could observe whether a cue I intended to leave would exist.
entries.literal: "A cue.{w} If I had a loop in my head, I could know whether it could be completed. If I thought about everything that I would do after touching the Past Sekimeiya, I could observe whether a cue I intended to leave would exist."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: So, could I do this? If it works, I'll draw a mark with a pen beneath a drawer on this floor...
entries.literal: "So, could I do this? If it works, I'll draw a mark with a pen beneath a drawer on this floor..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I went to the offices and walked up to the drawer I'd selected.
entries.literal: "I went to the offices and walked up to the drawer I'd selected."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It's not here. There's no mark.
entries.literal: "...It's not here. There's no mark."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There'd been clear uncertainty behind the loop I'd thought of, but thanks to the lack of the cue, the uncertainty could be erased—that loop wouldn't work.
entries.literal: "There'd been clear uncertainty behind the loop I'd thought of, but thanks to the lack of the cue, the uncertainty could be erased—that loop wouldn't work."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's impossible, then. I might be failing to realize the reason why it couldn't be executed. I don't know if it's just a tiny detail.
entries.literal: "It's impossible, then. I might be failing to realize the reason why it couldn't be executed. I don't know if it's just a tiny detail."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What about entering through the storeroom after {time=19:30} and then traveling to the past? Could that be possible?
entries.literal: "What about entering through the storeroom after {time=19:30} and then traveling to the past? Could that be possible?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If it is, I'll go back in time to a point after {time=14} and leave a mark beneath that drawer. If I need to, I'll travel back twice in order to make it to a point prior to now.
entries.literal: "If it is, I'll go back in time to a point after {time=14} and leave a mark beneath that drawer. If I need to, I'll travel back twice in order to make it to a point prior to now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was nothing there.
entries.literal: "There was nothing there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That makes sense. That means I couldn't enter the building through the storeroom without being seen from outside.
entries.literal: "That makes sense. That means I couldn't enter the building through the storeroom without being seen from outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was growing nervous. Miiya was alive—success must've awaited me.{w} ...But could I be sure of that?{w} It was a guarantee that Miiya was alive, but what about Shiroya? The circumstances around her were what left room for doubt.
entries.literal: "I was growing nervous. Miiya was alive—success must've awaited me.{w} ...But could I be sure of that?{w} It was a guarantee that Miiya was alive, but what about Shiroya? The circumstances around her were what left room for doubt."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: When the Future Sekimeiya was brought down from the attic, Katei used it. Then, the other Atsuki and Sai traveled minutes forward as well. There's no way I could travel before then.
entries.literal: "When the Future Sekimeiya was brought down from the attic, Katei used it. Then, the other Atsuki and Sai traveled minutes forward as well. There's no way I could travel before then."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But... the situation is the same later. I saw what happened to the Sekimeiya.{w} Sai, Akaro, and Katei moved them back and forth, but I remember it clearly—no place where the Future Sekimeiya was hidden was accessed by a future self of mine. My line of sight unconsciously blocked myself.
entries.literal: "But... the situation is the same later. I saw what happened to the Sekimeiya.{w} Sai, Akaro, and Katei moved them back and forth, but I remember it clearly—no place where the Future Sekimeiya was hidden was accessed by a future self of mine. My line of sight unconsciously blocked myself."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no way a future self of mine was on the crystal floor and wasn't seen by me or anyone who was there. The Future Sekimeiya wasn't activated, and neither was the past one.
entries.literal: "There's no way a future self of mine was on the crystal floor and wasn't seen by me or anyone who was there. The Future Sekimeiya wasn't activated, and neither was the past one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Katei did go a long time to the future, but even if I were to enter his travel's range, I wouldn't go past {time=14.}
entries.literal: "Katei did go a long time to the future, but even if I were to enter his travel's range, I wouldn't go past {time=14.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And when the Future Sekimeiya was hidden in the mechanical room, the other Atsuki and Miiya used it to go to the future.
entries.literal: "And when the Future Sekimeiya was hidden in the mechanical room, the other Atsuki and Miiya used it to go to the future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Suripo's killer brought it to a room in hallway B. When I was enacting the search, I felt the air around it, which was burning. There's no way I had touched it before then.
entries.literal: "Suripo's killer brought it to a room in hallway B. When I was enacting the search, I felt the air around it, which was burning. There's no way I had touched it before then."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...So is it not possible? Was there really no time where I could've gone to the future!?
entries.literal: "...So is it not possible? Was there really no time where I could've gone to the future!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought of using the Past Sekimeiya instead. Its only use would've been to travel seconds back to a room that had just been inspected. However, I'd also felt the air around it during the search, and it had been even hotter... That path was blocked too.
entries.literal: "I thought of using the Past Sekimeiya instead. Its only use would've been to travel seconds back to a room that had just been inspected. However, I'd also felt the air around it during the search, and it had been even hotter... That path was blocked too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}I felt lost. How the hell could I accomplish anything?
entries.literal: "...{w}I felt lost. How the hell could I accomplish anything?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Traveling to the future before the attack won't be doable, and after the 30th, Ashiya already had the Sekimeiya. The days up to the 15th are useless.{w} It was the owner of that gem shop who found the Sekimeiya. On the 30th, it's very likely they were in that box I saw...{w} But they were taken by the man who released the smoke, and he ran away with them.
entries.literal: "Traveling to the future before the attack won't be doable, and after the 30th, Ashiya already had the Sekimeiya. The days up to the 15th are useless.{w} It was the owner of that gem shop who found the Sekimeiya. On the 30th, it's very likely they were in that box I saw...{w} But they were taken by the man who released the smoke, and he ran away with them."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I know the smoke was released thanks to the news report I saw, so I can't obtain the Sekimeiya and save Miiya together. Not to mention that to appear in the tower on the 15th, I would also have to be there on the 15th of November.{w} I'm sure that after the man ran away with the box, he was caught. That's what Katei told us about, and it's the reason why the Sekimeiya returned to Ashiya. There's nothing I can do there.
entries.literal: "I know the smoke was released thanks to the news report I saw, so I can't obtain the Sekimeiya and save Miiya together. Not to mention that to appear in the tower on the 15th, I would also have to be there on the 15th of November.{w} I'm sure that after the man ran away with the box, he was caught. That's what Katei told us about, and it's the reason why the Sekimeiya returned to Ashiya. There's nothing I can do there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Just in case, I need to try it.{w} A loop where I go to November 15th and remain inside the tower. Then, on November 30th, I take that box with the Sekimeiya.{w} As fast as possible, I make sure Miiya won't die and run away. Then, I travel to the future and appear after the search that happened at {time=14.}{w} I'll tell the police about the Sekimeiya's location before I travel so that they can find them and return them to Ashiya.{w} If this can work, a mark will be under that drawer.
entries.literal: "Just in case, I need to try it.{w} A loop where I go to November 15th and remain inside the tower. Then, on November 30th, I take that box with the Sekimeiya.{w} As fast as possible, I make sure Miiya won't die and run away. Then, I travel to the future and appear after the search that happened at {time=14.}{w} I'll tell the police about the Sekimeiya's location before I travel so that they can find them and return them to Ashiya.{w} If this can work, a mark will be under that drawer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {tip=ohnoitdidntwork}It wasn't there{/tip}. It appeared that couldn't work either.
entries.literal: "{tip=ohnoitdidntwork}It wasn't there{/tip}. It appeared that couldn't work either."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept thinking about the events that had occurred throughout the day in case I could find the smallest opening, but it really seemed like there was no place for a future self of mine to exist.
entries.literal: "I kept thinking about the events that had occurred throughout the day in case I could find the smallest opening, but it really seemed like there was no place for a future self of mine to exist."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Does this mean that I can't be here at {time=19:30}? But that's the single guaranteed way I have to go back!
entries.literal: "Does this mean that I can't be here at {time=19:30}? But that's the single guaranteed way I have to go back!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I could change worlds in the morning instead, after Shiroya and Naomi did. That's a lot less likely to bring me to the world I want, though...!
entries.literal: "I could change worlds in the morning instead, after Shiroya and Naomi did. That's a lot less likely to bring me to the world I want, though...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Maybe there was no way to skip the {time=14} search, but what about another way around it?
entries.literal: "...Maybe there was no way to skip the {time=14} search, but what about another way around it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Atsuki from this world looked at the rooms in hallway A. Then, I took his place and looked through the rest of the crystal floor.{w} Finally, Miiya and I completed all the other floors.
entries.literal: "The Atsuki from this world looked at the rooms in hallway A. Then, I took his place and looked through the rest of the crystal floor.{w} Finally, Miiya and I completed all the other floors."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if... my future self was in one of the hallway A rooms? Technically, that's how I was able to not be found that time. I told the Atsuki from this world to stay put, and he did so because it was his own request.
entries.literal: "What if... my future self was in one of the hallway A rooms? Technically, that's how I was able to not be found that time. I told the Atsuki from this world to stay put, and he did so because it was his own request."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could I do the same? Could I ask him to ignore having seen me?
entries.literal: "Could I do the same? Could I ask him to ignore having seen me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wondered that, well aware of the answer.
entries.literal: "I wondered that, well aware of the answer."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I recalled the time he'd seen me.
entries.literal: "I recalled the time he'd seen me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I saw my own body stepping in. As he approached one of the cabinets, I knew there was only one thing I could do."
entries.literal: "\"I saw my own body stepping in. As he approached one of the cabinets, I knew there was only one thing I could do.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This is very imp—
entries.literal: "This is very imp—"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wha—
entries.literal: "Wha—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "He turned around with a startled gasp. His reaction was even more drastic when he saw me."
entries.literal: "\"He turned around with a startled gasp. His reaction was even more drastic when he saw me.\""

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What!? Who are you!?{w=0.7} Are you... me?
entries.literal: "Wh-What!? Who are you!?{w=0.7} Are you... me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I nodded, although it wasn't the entire truth."
entries.literal: "\"I nodded, although it wasn't the entire truth.\""

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This is very important. Stay here until the search is finished.
entries.literal: "This is very important. Stay here until the search is finished."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That reaction gave me the answer. That was the first time he'd seen another self of his.
entries.literal: "That reaction gave me the answer. That was the first time he'd seen another self of his."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Could my future self have told him to react that way? ...Word by word?{w} I didn't think that was how it worked; his reaction seemed completely genuine. Likely, the only way for me to make such a thing work would've been by considering it before seeing his reaction.
entries.literal: "Could my future self have told him to react that way? ...Word by word?{w} I didn't think that was how it worked; his reaction seemed completely genuine. Likely, the only way for me to make such a thing work would've been by considering it before seeing his reaction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nonetheless, I verified whether it would work. If a mark was below the next desk, it would.
entries.literal: "Nonetheless, I verified whether it would work. If a mark was below the next desk, it would."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, there was nothing.
entries.literal: "Once again, there was nothing."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I thought back to the look in Miiya's eyes. It had changed at one point.
entries.literal: "I thought back to the look in Miiya's eyes. It had changed at one point."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if she saw me? What if my future self was in the partitions on that floor?{w} Could he have told her to not reveal him?
entries.literal: "What if she saw me? What if my future self was in the partitions on that floor?{w} Could he have told her to not reveal him?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That felt a little strange. If that had happened, why would her look have changed in that way? I knew the answer couldn't be that I would instruct her to do so.
entries.literal: "That felt a little strange. If that had happened, why would her look have changed in that way? I knew the answer couldn't be that I would instruct her to do so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Not only that, but if I stayed in that partition, the reason would've been due to knowing how Miiya's demeanor changed. In short, the result would've caused the effect.
entries.literal: "Not only that, but if I stayed in that partition, the reason would've been due to knowing how Miiya's demeanor changed. In short, the result would've caused the effect."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Well, is that so? I did notice a while ago that there's something special about the offices on the fourth floor...{w} I'm pretty sure that nobody ever looked at them—neither in the morning nor later in the day. Miiya was the only person to inspect them. I spent the day following everyone to know where to be in a future loop.
entries.literal: "Well, is that so? I did notice a while ago that there's something special about the offices on the fourth floor...{w} I'm pretty sure that nobody ever looked at them—neither in the morning nor later in the day. Miiya was the only person to inspect them. I spent the day following everyone to know where to be in a future loop."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Could my future self really have been there all the time? Could that work?
entries.literal: "Could my future self really have been there all the time? Could that work?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tested it right away. If it could, a mark would be below a drawer...
entries.literal: "I tested it right away. If it could, a mark would be below a drawer..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's nothing! What the fuck!?
entries.literal: "There's nothing! What the fuck!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once again, it seemed my idea was deemed an impossibility by the universe. For one reason or another, it wasn't something that could occur.
entries.literal: "Once again, it seemed my idea was deemed an impossibility by the universe. For one reason or another, it wasn't something that could occur."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: You've gotta be joking. I'm certain Miiya and Shiroya can both be alive in this world, but can I not return to mine? Do I have to hope changing worlds at another time will work?
entries.literal: "You've gotta be joking. I'm certain Miiya and Shiroya can both be alive in this world, but can I not return to mine? Do I have to hope changing worlds at another time will work?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...It had to be at {time=19:30.} I was fairly certain about that.
entries.literal: "...It had to be at {time=19:30.} I was fairly certain about that."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If my future self had been in the attic when Shiroya and Naomi disappeared this morning, he would've appeared along with them. Even if not in the same world, I would reunite with Shiroya.
entries.literal: "If my future self had been in the attic when Shiroya and Naomi disappeared this morning, he would've appeared along with them. Even if not in the same world, I would reunite with Shiroya."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think that's possible, though. I would've had to be there before Naomi unlocked the attic. When I looked through the cameras, I saw that our past selves were right behind her.{w} Even then, because the range didn't reach me, I'm not sure it would've reached the kitchen. There's no way I could've been in the living room, and I didn't see my footprints anywhere.
