entries.literal: "I don't think that's possible, though. I would've had to be there before Naomi unlocked the attic. When I looked through the cameras, I saw that our past selves were right behind her.{w} Even then, because the range didn't reach me, I'm not sure it would've reached the kitchen. There's no way I could've been in the living room, and I didn't see my footprints anywhere."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...That's not even everything. I need to be certain the travel will work because there's no way I'll have another chance. If I intend to change worlds when Shiroya and Naomi did, even if it works, I'll end up in a different world from this one. This means that I'll be unable to leave a physical indication for me to see now...
entries.literal: "...That's not even everything. I need to be certain the travel will work because there's no way I'll have another chance. If I intend to change worlds when Shiroya and Naomi did, even if it works, I'll end up in a different world from this one. This means that I'll be unable to leave a physical indication for me to see now..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I don't think it would work, but what matters is that there's room for failure. I can't afford that.
entries.literal: "I don't think it would work, but what matters is that there's room for failure. I can't afford that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had been lost in thought for a while when something alerted me. Someone was walking up.
entries.literal: "I had been lost in thought for a while when something alerted me. Someone was walking up."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I quickly hid in the second partition and saw a single person walking past the glass. Fortunately, they hadn't seen me.
entries.literal: "I quickly hid in the second partition and saw a single person walking past the glass. Fortunately, they hadn't seen me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Miiya? Why is she alone?
entries.literal: "...Miiya? Why is she alone?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: All by herself, she went to the attic. She'd been yawning, so perhaps she wanted to rest on the beds.
entries.literal: "All by herself, she went to the attic. She'd been yawning, so perhaps she wanted to rest on the beds."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya are in the refrigerator. She shouldn't see them.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya are in the refrigerator. She shouldn't see them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't get distracted. I had to find a solution to my problem.
entries.literal: "I couldn't get distracted. I had to find a solution to my problem."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I attempted to come up with something else. There had to be something that would help me...!
entries.literal: "I attempted to come up with something else. There had to be something that would help me...!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if I let the Past Sekimeiya gather energy right now and I bring it somewhere so that its range reaches behind the tower?
entries.literal: "What if I let the Past Sekimeiya gather energy right now and I bring it somewhere so that its range reaches behind the tower?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I activate it and go a few minutes to the past, knowing that in the future, my future self will be right outside the tower, waiting to be encompassed. If I do that and think that I'll be in the tower in the future, will I appear inside it?
entries.literal: "I activate it and go a few minutes to the past, knowing that in the future, my future self will be right outside the tower, waiting to be encompassed. If I do that and think that I'll be in the tower in the future, will I appear inside it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Or would I run into the same issue as trying to appear with an item that I can't obtain? I need to test it.
entries.literal: "Or would I run into the same issue as trying to appear with an item that I can't obtain? I need to test it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I failed to see any cue.
entries.literal: "I failed to see any cue."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Really? ...Is it just because I couldn't enter the tower by my own means, or is there another reason...?
entries.literal: "Really? ...Is it just because I couldn't enter the tower by my own means, or is there another reason...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's gotta be something else. I could get into the tower through the storeroom and affect Sai's mark. That should allow the travel to put me inside the tower, which would bypass the mark. So, his mark would only be affected in a hypothetical world. It should work...!
entries.literal: "There's gotta be something else. I could get into the tower through the storeroom and affect Sai's mark. That should allow the travel to put me inside the tower, which would bypass the mark. So, his mark would only be affected in a hypothetical world. It should work...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Something else... There had to be something else.
entries.literal: "Something else... There had to be something else."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What if the Atsuki that Miiya has been with is my future self?
entries.literal: "What if the Atsuki that Miiya has been with is my future self?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It sounded interesting. Before that morning, I could've replaced the Atsuki of that world by making him stay outside the tower. Then, I could've hidden in plain sight by acting as the Atsuki who'd gotten trapped.
entries.literal: "It sounded interesting. Before that morning, I could've replaced the Atsuki of that world by making him stay outside the tower. Then, I could've hidden in plain sight by acting as the Atsuki who'd gotten trapped."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Of course, it was an impossibility: I would've observed my own movements all along, giving them no origin. However, if I had thought about that concept early enough, I felt it would've been viable.
entries.literal: "Of course, it was an impossibility: I would've observed my own movements all along, giving them no origin. However, if I had thought about that concept early enough, I felt it would've been viable."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: My thoughts went back to the search at {time=14.}
entries.literal: "My thoughts went back to the search at {time=14.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had thought about everything: my past self couldn't have been in the rooms I'd investigated. He couldn't have been in the rooms the other Atsuki had investigated. He couldn't have been in the places Miiya had investigated.
entries.literal: "I had thought about everything: my past self couldn't have been in the rooms I'd investigated. He couldn't have been in the rooms the other Atsuki had investigated. He couldn't have been in the places Miiya had investigated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And he couldn't have been traveling forward in time.
entries.literal: "And he couldn't have been traveling forward in time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Where the hell had he been, then? The answer I was looking for had to be somewhere as well.
entries.literal: "Where the hell had he been, then? The answer I was looking for had to be somewhere as well."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't forgotten about Miiya's change of attitude. She had come out of the fourth floor's partitions with an entirely different demeanor.
entries.literal: "I hadn't forgotten about Miiya's change of attitude. She had come out of the fourth floor's partitions with an entirely different demeanor."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Why? I knew my future self couldn't have been there.{w} So, then, what could she have seen?
entries.literal: "Why? I knew my future self couldn't have been there.{w} So, then, what could she have seen?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was clear the way I was handling my thoughts wasn't proper; I had to widen their scope.
entries.literal: "It was clear the way I was handling my thoughts wasn't proper; I had to widen their scope."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the end, only two things mattered: saving Miiya and returning to my world. The way I was thinking about it, those two aspects seemed to be incompatible.
entries.literal: "In the end, only two things mattered: saving Miiya and returning to my world. The way I was thinking about it, those two aspects seemed to be incompatible."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: How else could Miiya be saved, though? How the hell could the news I saw be bypassed?
entries.literal: "How else could Miiya be saved, though? How the hell could the news I saw be bypassed?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: There's no other way. I have to go back to the past again, to the 30th.
entries.literal: "There's no other way. I have to go back to the past again, to the 30th."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is what I determined. I can salvage this world's history. Since I'm from another world, I can save this one.
entries.literal: "This is what I determined. I can salvage this world's history. Since I'm from another world, I can save this one."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It has to be me—someone who hasn't observed the truth of this world yet. That's the only way.
entries.literal: "It has to be me—someone who hasn't observed the truth of this world yet. That's the only way."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It is the only way, isn't it?
entries.literal: "It is the only way, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I suppose it's not. Only one part of that is correct.{w} It doesn't have to be me, but the only reason I can do it is that I'm not from this world. Only someone who isn't from this world can divert this world's history from their own. That's a better way to put it.
entries.literal: "...I suppose it's not. Only one part of that is correct.{w} It doesn't have to be me, but the only reason I can do it is that I'm not from this world. Only someone who isn't from this world can divert this world's history from their own. That's a better way to put it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's... right. I'm not the only person who can do this. It can be anyone from another world.{w} And... at {time=19}, the Shiroya from my world will appear here and go to the attic.
entries.literal: "That's... right. I'm not the only person who can do this. It can be anyone from another world.{w} And... at {time=19}, the Shiroya from my world will appear here and go to the attic."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She can do this too. ...Would that make a difference, though? Would that solve any problems?
entries.literal: "She can do this too. ...Would that make a difference, though? Would that solve any problems?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can tell her what I've learned. I can tell her everything. ...If she went to the past and saved this world, would she be able to be here at {time=19:30}?
entries.literal: "I can tell her what I've learned. I can tell her everything. ...If she went to the past and saved this world, would she be able to be here at {time=19:30}?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: She couldn't have been in one of the rooms the Atsuki from this world investigated. The way he looked said more than enough. ...That means there's only one other possibility, but it doesn't make sense either.{w} It doesn't make sense.
entries.literal: "She couldn't have been in one of the rooms the Atsuki from this world investigated. The way he looked said more than enough. ...That means there's only one other possibility, but it doesn't make sense either.{w} It doesn't make sense."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I looked under the next drawer, it was clear that the universe disagreed with me.
entries.literal: "When I looked under the next drawer, it was clear that the universe disagreed with me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I almost burst out laughing at what I saw. Not only from the absurdity of it existing, but also from how cartoonish it was. Maybe Shiroya had doodled something so goofy-looking just to elicit that reaction.
entries.literal: "I almost burst out laughing at what I saw. Not only from the absurdity of it existing, but also from how cartoonish it was. Maybe Shiroya had doodled something so goofy-looking just to elicit that reaction."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Stunned, part of me refused what I was seeing. It flew in the face of what I knew. If that was the truth, what was the meaning behind that search? Why had nobody been found?
entries.literal: "Stunned, part of me refused what I was seeing. It flew in the face of what I knew. If that was the truth, what was the meaning behind that search? Why had nobody been found?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Did it really make more sense than the other ideas I'd envisioned? ...Perhaps it didn't matter. Success had been assured to me—I was extremely puzzled, but I felt relieved more than anything.
entries.literal: "Did it really make more sense than the other ideas I'd envisioned? ...Perhaps it didn't matter. Success had been assured to me—I was extremely puzzled, but I felt relieved more than anything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, that's right. The rusty key...
entries.literal: "Oh, that's right. The rusty key..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That finally made sense. Before I'd entered the tower, the fact that I'd seen it in the outer keyhole had been almost ridiculous.
entries.literal: "That finally made sense. Before I'd entered the tower, the fact that I'd seen it in the outer keyhole had been almost ridiculous."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: And...

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt a familiar sensation. In a few brief moments, swathes of problems still lingering in my mind slotted into place.
entries.literal: "I felt a familiar sensation. In a few brief moments, swathes of problems still lingering in my mind slotted into place."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: At {time=19:30}, that's who activated one of the Sekimeiya. That's why we returned to our world.
entries.literal: "At {time=19:30}, that's who activated one of the Sekimeiya. That's why we returned to our world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up slowly, my vision momentarily blurry. After some seconds, I began to approach the attic.
entries.literal: "I stood up slowly, my vision momentarily blurry. After some seconds, I began to approach the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see Miiya, but her footprints were visible.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see Miiya, but her footprints were visible."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was careful not to make a sound. The bedroom doors were closed, but it was very likely she was behind one of them.
entries.literal: "I was careful not to make a sound. The bedroom doors were closed, but it was very likely she was behind one of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I shut myself in the kitchen. The recorder was still there, counting up the seconds. It had been an hour and a half since I'd started a new recording.
entries.literal: "I shut myself in the kitchen. The recorder was still there, counting up the seconds. It had been an hour and a half since I'd started a new recording."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It must be about {time=17:30.}{w} I'll take the Sekimeiya out at {time=18:30.}
entries.literal: "...It must be about {time=17:30.}{w} I'll take the Sekimeiya out at {time=18:30.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's strange... I know we'll change worlds at {time=19:30}, so I'll take both Sekimeiya out so that can happen...
entries.literal: "It's strange... I know we'll change worlds at {time=19:30}, so I'll take both Sekimeiya out so that can happen..."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Doesn't that contradict what the universe just repeatedly denied? Won't I allow something to happen because I experienced the result first?
entries.literal: "Doesn't that contradict what the universe just repeatedly denied? Won't I allow something to happen because I experienced the result first?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Maybe there's something I'm missing. Maybe I don't really understand why it will happen.
entries.literal: "Maybe there's something I'm missing. Maybe I don't really understand why it will happen."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I suppose it doesn't really matter, though. All I know is that it'll repeat.
entries.literal: "...I suppose it doesn't really matter, though. All I know is that it'll repeat."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had to wait through the last stretch. I thought of going back to the sixth floor, but I chose to remain near the timer.
entries.literal: "I had to wait through the last stretch. I thought of going back to the sixth floor, but I chose to remain near the timer."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}The news that I heard matched our world's. It was identical to how it would've been without my input.
entries.literal: "...{w}The news that I heard matched our world's. It was identical to how it would've been without my input."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's why I imagined everything had happened the same way. Then, I realized that didn't have to be the case. The news was the only thing I'd observed in this world.
entries.literal: "That's why I imagined everything had happened the same way. Then, I realized that didn't have to be the case. The news was the only thing I'd observed in this world."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: One girl had been severely injured, and the other hadn't been found. It matched up with what I'd personally experienced, although it wasn't the end. Seeing as it was the only barrier in this world, I could've gone back in time, saved Miiya, and prevented Shiroya from being found.
entries.literal: "One girl had been severely injured, and the other hadn't been found. It matched up with what I'd personally experienced, although it wasn't the end. Seeing as it was the only barrier in this world, I could've gone back in time, saved Miiya, and prevented Shiroya from being found."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's what I thought as soon as I put together that I could alter this world's history. The news could remain consistent because it didn't lead to a single interpretation.{w} I also thought that everything finally made sense—that it was the reason why Miiya had been in the tower and why Shiroya had been absent. It fit with the plan I came up with, so I thought I finally understood this world.
entries.literal: "That's what I thought as soon as I put together that I could alter this world's history. The news could remain consistent because it didn't lead to a single interpretation.{w} I also thought that everything finally made sense—that it was the reason why Miiya had been in the tower and why Shiroya had been absent. It fit with the plan I came up with, so I thought I finally understood this world."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It didn't make as much sense as I thought. After all, I saw Miiya in the tower—I saw the result of a loop before I came up with it. The news hadn't actually been the only piece of this world I'd observed.{w} And maybe it makes real sense. ...I believe I know why I saw Miiya before I understood how she'd be saved.
entries.literal: "...It didn't make as much sense as I thought. After all, I saw Miiya in the tower—I saw the result of a loop before I came up with it. The news hadn't actually been the only piece of this world I'd observed.{w} And maybe it makes real sense. ...I believe I know why I saw Miiya before I understood how she'd be saved."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't step out of the kitchen. Miiya was close by, but I hadn't heard anything. If she hadn't silently left, she was sleeping in a bedroom.
entries.literal: "I didn't step out of the kitchen. Miiya was close by, but I hadn't heard anything. If she hadn't silently left, she was sleeping in a bedroom."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sixty more minutes had been added to the timer. It was finally {time=18:30.}
entries.literal: "Sixty more minutes had been added to the timer. It was finally {time=18:30.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At the same time that I took both Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator, I began a new recording.
entries.literal: "At the same time that I took both Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator, I began a new recording."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: This is it. When the timer hits sixty minutes, it'll be {time=19:30.}
entries.literal: "This is it. When the timer hits sixty minutes, it'll be {time=19:30.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I should keep waiting on the sixth floor. I don't know if Shiroya will use the elevator, but if she does, that's where she'll come out.
entries.literal: "I should keep waiting on the sixth floor. I don't know if Shiroya will use the elevator, but if she does, that's where she'll come out."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was about to leave when I heard someone behind the door.
entries.literal: "I was about to leave when I heard someone behind the door."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...!{w} Who's here?
entries.literal: "...!{w} Who's here?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Their steps approached one of the bedrooms and stepped inside.
entries.literal: "Their steps approached one of the bedrooms and stepped inside."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Is that all? Are they going to stay inside? I'm pretty sure whoever that was arrived with the elevator.
entries.literal: "Is that all? Are they going to stay inside? I'm pretty sure whoever that was arrived with the elevator."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood still, awaiting any other movement. ...But it seemed they would remain there.
entries.literal: "I stood still, awaiting any other movement. ...But it seemed they would remain there."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait a second. I might have overlooked something important.
entries.literal: "Wait a second. I might have overlooked something important."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Even though I never saw Miiya in our world, Erina apparently did. She was definitely there at one point and left that note behind, right?
entries.literal: "Even though I never saw Miiya in our world, Erina apparently did. She was definitely there at one point and left that note behind, right?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: But she didn't stay there, or we would've seen her.
entries.literal: "But she didn't stay there, or we would've seen her."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's odd. If Erina saw Miiya, it should've been at around this time. Slightly before it, actually.
entries.literal: "That's odd. If Erina saw Miiya, it should've been at around this time. Slightly before it, actually."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Isn't she here right now, though...?
entries.literal: "Isn't she here right now, though...?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a chance she was about to appear in our world. If that would happen, it was evident I didn't understand the details behind it.
entries.literal: "There was a chance she was about to appear in our world. If that would happen, it was evident I didn't understand the details behind it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps {time=19:30} wasn't the only time where returning would be possible. It could occur earlier too, at a time I wasn't aware of.
entries.literal: "Perhaps {time=19:30} wasn't the only time where returning would be possible. It could occur earlier too, at a time I wasn't aware of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If that time was still yet to happen, I had to get away from the Sekimeiya, or else I could disappear before Shiroya's arrival.
entries.literal: "If that time was still yet to happen, I had to get away from the Sekimeiya, or else I could disappear before Shiroya's arrival."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hid the Sekimeiya on a high cabinet shelf, as keeping them in a drawer would've severely messed with the temperature.
entries.literal: "I hid the Sekimeiya on a high cabinet shelf, as keeping them in a drawer would've severely messed with the temperature."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Then, I stepped onto the sixth floor, and like before, I entered the offices.
entries.literal: "Then, I stepped onto the sixth floor, and like before, I entered the offices."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Unless I've made a big mistake, she should be here in thirty minutes.
entries.literal: "Unless I've made a big mistake, she should be here in thirty minutes."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: If one of the Sekimeiya is activated before then for some reason, that'll cause the world change that could still happen. Since I know we'll return at {time=19:30}, though, I have a pretty strong guarantee that the Past Sekimeiya won't be the one activated.
entries.literal: "If one of the Sekimeiya is activated before then for some reason, that'll cause the world change that could still happen. Since I know we'll return at {time=19:30}, though, I have a pretty strong guarantee that the Past Sekimeiya won't be the one activated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was so close. It had been more than two weeks since I'd seen her.
entries.literal: "I was so close. It had been more than two weeks since I'd seen her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had plenty of things to say, but I wanted to know her story too. Why would she run up to the attic? Why were her clothes different? What had she done in January?
entries.literal: "I had plenty of things to say, but I wanted to know her story too. Why would she run up to the attic? Why were her clothes different? What had she done in January?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Just thinking about it made the time go by swiftly. The end was truly near.
entries.literal: "Just thinking about it made the time go by swiftly. The end was truly near."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood up and walked out. I was sure she was about to appear.
entries.literal: "I stood up and walked out. I was sure she was about to appear."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have the voice recorder with me, but it had been close to half an hour. I stood still, trying to perceive the faintest sound.
entries.literal: "I didn't have the voice recorder with me, but it had been close to half an hour. I stood still, trying to perceive the faintest sound."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: And it came. Finally, I heard what I'd been desperately wishing for.{w} Footsteps were approaching.
entries.literal: "And it came. Finally, I heard what I'd been desperately wishing for.{w} Footsteps were approaching."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What!?
entries.literal: "What!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It wasn't who I'd been expecting. Miiya and the Atsuki she'd been with were there, staring deep into my eyes.
entries.literal: "It wasn't who I'd been expecting. Miiya and the Atsuki she'd been with were there, staring deep into my eyes."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What the fuck...?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the fuck? Why are they here!? Miiya should be in the attic!
entries.literal: "What the fuck? Why are they here!? Miiya should be in the attic!"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Hey, answer me! You really were here... Are you really me? What the fuck is going on!?
entries.literal: "Hey, answer me! You really were here... Are you really me? What the fuck is going on!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I didn't think you'd be here.
entries.literal: "...I didn't think you'd be here."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What!? What does that mean!? You're me, right?
entries.literal: "Wh-What!? What does that mean!? You're me, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I am.

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What the fuck is happening, then!? I thought it was impossible that we'd see each other. Was that wrong?
entries.literal: "What the fuck is happening, then!? I thought it was impossible that we'd see each other. Was that wrong?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: In a way, yes.
entries.literal: "In a way, yes."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What the fuck...? Tell me, then! What's going on!? How the fuck can you even exist!?
entries.literal: "What the fuck...? Tell me, then! What's going on!? How the fuck can you even exist!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I'm sorry, I'm not sure how to answer that question.
entries.literal: "...I'm sorry, I'm not sure how to answer that question."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What...!?

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know exactly how you feel, I promise. I will tell you one thing, though, since we've already met: you shouldn't worry about anything.
entries.literal: "I know exactly how you feel, I promise. I will tell you one thing, though, since we've already met: you shouldn't worry about anything."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It must be too early. When we appeared in this world, Shiroya spent a short while on the crystal floor. It must not be time yet.
entries.literal: "It must be too early. When we appeared in this world, Shiroya spent a short while on the crystal floor. It must not be time yet."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: I shouldn't worry? There's no way you're actually me, right?
entries.literal: "I shouldn't worry? There's no way you're actually me, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...I am. I promise, it will all be fine.
entries.literal: "...I am. I promise, it will all be fine."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Wh-What...? How can you tell? And how would that even be possible!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What...? How can you tell? And how would that even be possible!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I know how it sounds, but I genuinely don't have time to explain, and I'm not sure I could.
entries.literal: "I know how it sounds, but I genuinely don't have time to explain, and I'm not sure I could."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What does that even mean...!?
entries.literal: "What does that even mean...!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Look, we're the same person. Just trust me, or yourself, on this. Sincerely, everything should turn out fine.
entries.literal: "Look, we're the same person. Just trust me, or yourself, on this. Sincerely, everything should turn out fine."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When he heard that, I saw my own body crumple down, and my heart ached. I didn't want to imagine how I felt.
entries.literal: "When he heard that, I saw my own body crumple down, and my heart ached. I didn't want to imagine how I felt."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You believe me, right? Like I said, I don't have much time.
entries.literal: "You believe me, right? Like I said, I don't have much time."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: But that c-can't be the case...! Shiroya... died again!
entries.literal: "But that c-can't be the case...! Shiroya... died again!"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Again? What do you mean?
entries.literal: "Again? What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Do you not know that? She was killed here, and her body disappeared from the lobby!
entries.literal: "Do you not know that? She was killed here, and her body disappeared from the lobby!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What...? What does that mean?
entries.literal: "What...? What does that mean?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It can't be. She won't be in the tower.{w} This is the same as before! Someone is telling me that Shiroya's fate within the tower is death. Why have so many people said that!?
entries.literal: "It can't be. She won't be in the tower.{w} This is the same as before! Someone is telling me that Shiroya's fate within the tower is death. Why have so many people said that!?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: It's not true! I've never seen her dead! That must be a mistake.{w} She'll be fine. It's impossible that she will die in the tower. We'll make sure of that.
entries.literal: "It's not true! I've never seen her dead! That must be a mistake.{w} She'll be fine. It's impossible that she will die in the tower. We'll make sure of that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You should believe what I say. I still don't fully understand how that works, but you have to trust me.
entries.literal: "You should believe what I say. I still don't fully understand how that works, but you have to trust me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...You can't explain it? Then there's no way you're actually telling the truth, right?
entries.literal: "...You can't explain it? Then there's no way you're actually telling the truth, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I am. While I can't be fully confident about what I'm saying, I'll just ask you to believe me.
entries.literal: "I am. While I can't be fully confident about what I'm saying, I'll just ask you to believe me."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: ...{w}Okay.

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Good. I suppose there's one thing you could do, then.
entries.literal: "...Good. I suppose there's one thing you could do, then."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: What?
entries.literal: "What?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait here a second.
entries.literal: "Wait here a second."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I turned around and went to the attic, where Miiya should've been.
entries.literal: "I turned around and went to the attic, where Miiya should've been."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The Sekimeiya are still here. Neither of them were activated.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya are still here. Neither of them were activated."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What the hell, then? I don't get what happened...!
entries.literal: "What the hell, then? I don't get what happened...!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was no time to wonder. After I grabbed the Future Sekimeiya, I dashed back out.
entries.literal: "There was no time to wonder. After I grabbed the Future Sekimeiya, I dashed back out."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Take this, but don't touch it.
entries.literal: "Take this, but don't touch it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I handed him the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I handed him the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You two should hurry back down. On the second floor, enter the second partition, leave the Sekimeiya on the floor, and wait there.
entries.literal: "You two should hurry back down. On the second floor, enter the second partition, leave the Sekimeiya on the floor, and wait there."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: On the second floor?
entries.literal: "On the second floor?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. From there, if anyone passes by, you should hear them. If you hear the elevator four times, you can go back down and place the Sekimeiya in its cabinet. Make sure that it isn't activated again.
entries.literal: "Yes. From there, if anyone passes by, you should hear them. If you hear the elevator four times, you can go back down and place the Sekimeiya in its cabinet. Make sure that it isn't activated again."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: However, it's possible that the first time, instead of hearing the elevator, you'll hear someone running up. If that happens, once you hear the elevator two times, you can go down and place the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
entries.literal: "However, it's possible that the first time, instead of hearing the elevator, you'll hear someone running up. If that happens, once you hear the elevator two times, you can go down and place the Sekimeiya in the cabinet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wasn't completely sure if Shiroya would walk up or take the elevator. However, a while after that, they would hear Erina and my past self taking it. That would be their cue to go down.
entries.literal: "I wasn't completely sure if Shiroya would walk up or take the elevator. However, a while after that, they would hear Erina and my past self taking it. That would be their cue to go down."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: O-Okay, and... after that, you're saying everything will be fine, right?
entries.literal: "O-Okay, and... after that, you're saying everything will be fine, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes. Wait patiently with everyone on the crystal floor and make sure to get out safely. I'll pray with you for what will happen after that.
entries.literal: "Yes. Wait patiently with everyone on the crystal floor and make sure to get out safely. I'll pray with you for what will happen after that."

entries.speaker: c2a
entries.text: All... All right.
entries.literal: "All... All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The other Atsuki didn't waste time. As soon as he said that, he ran back toward the stairs.
entries.literal: "The other Atsuki didn't waste time. As soon as he said that, he ran back toward the stairs."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Goodbye, Miiya.
entries.literal: "Goodbye, Miiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It took all I had in me to say that and nothing more. It was a second goodbye. I would never see her again.
entries.literal: "It took all I had in me to say that and nothing more. It was a second goodbye. I would never see her again."

entries.speaker: m2
entries.text: Goodbye.
entries.literal: "Goodbye."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Oblivious to the gravity of her farewell, she turned around and left my sight.
entries.literal: "Oblivious to the gravity of her farewell, she turned around and left my sight."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I could no longer hear their running, I found myself standing alone. ...I couldn't bring myself to move.
entries.literal: "Once I could no longer hear their running, I found myself standing alone. ...I couldn't bring myself to move."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: If nothing happened very soon, I would've been wrong about everything.
entries.literal: "If nothing happened very soon, I would've been wrong about everything."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I heard the elevator, all the tension within me was released. She was there.
entries.literal: "When I heard the elevator, all the tension within me was released. She was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She'd called the elevator from the crystal floor. I waited, and seconds later, I heard it again.
entries.literal: "She'd called the elevator from the crystal floor. I waited, and seconds later, I heard it again."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait, what? Why did I hear it again? Doesn't that mean that it's going to the attic?
entries.literal: "Wait, what? Why did I hear it again? Doesn't that mean that it's going to the attic?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, that's right! She had the key!
entries.literal: "Oh, that's right! She had the key!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I bolted off as fast as I could.
entries.literal: "I bolted off as fast as I could."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She was in the hallway. When she saw me, it was apparent we'd both been looking for each other.
entries.literal: "She was in the hallway. When she saw me, it was apparent we'd both been looking for each other."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There you are... You did come.{w} I'd forgotten you had the key to the attic.
entries.literal: "There you are... You did come.{w} I'd forgotten you had the key to the attic."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you... the Atsuki from this morning?
entries.literal: "Are you... the Atsuki from this morning?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. I'm glad I wasn't wrong.
entries.literal: "Yeah. I'm glad I wasn't wrong."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-You knew I would be here, right? You remembered what happened.
entries.literal: "Y-You knew I would be here, right? You remembered what happened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded slowly. I was right about everything. ...We had reunited in a world other than our own.
entries.literal: "I nodded slowly. I was right about everything. ...We had reunited in a world other than our own."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Have you been here all this time? When you disappeared this morning, I tried to find you, but I was in another world, right?
entries.literal: "Have you been here all this time? When you disappeared this morning, I tried to find you, but I was in another world, right?"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I see. So she really is the same person who was here this morning.
entries.literal: "I see. So she really is the same person who was here this morning."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I... think so. I learned a lot of things. It's been longer than you think since I saw you.
entries.literal: "I... think so. I learned a lot of things. It's been longer than you think since I saw you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What do you mean? You said the recording was real, right? What happened at {time=21}? And why did both of us appear at the start of today?
entries.literal: "What do you mean? You said the recording was real, right? What happened at {time=21}? And why did both of us appear at the start of today?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Why did we travel to this morning?{w} I know the answer now.
entries.literal: "...Why did we travel to this morning?{w} I know the answer now."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I remember what you told me. You said you traveled to the 30th of November, and that a few days later, you touched the Sekimeiya in the tower. Is that right?
entries.literal: "I remember what you told me. You said you traveled to the 30th of November, and that a few days later, you touched the Sekimeiya in the tower. Is that right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-Yes. That's when I appeared with you in the lobby.
entries.literal: "Y-Yes. That's when I appeared with you in the lobby."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, that's wrong. I know what happened to you.
entries.literal: "No, that's wrong. I know what happened to you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She frowned. It seemed she hadn't entertained the possibility.
entries.literal: "She frowned. It seemed she hadn't entertained the possibility."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You didn't go to November... You went to the future.
entries.literal: "You didn't go to November... You went to the future."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Wh-What? No I didn't. I went two weeks to the past.
entries.literal: "...Wh-What? No I didn't. I went two weeks to the past."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I don't know why you think that, but I believe you went to the future.{w} You said that you entered the tower in early December. I believe that was the 5th of January instead.
entries.literal: "I don't know why you think that, but I believe you went to the future.{w} You said that you entered the tower in early December. I believe that was the 5th of January instead."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: The 5th of January? That doesn't make any sense.
entries.literal: "The 5th of January? That doesn't make any sense."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Like I said, the recording was real. On the 5th of January, we were in the tower. That's why I appeared with you in the lobby when you touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "Like I said, the recording was real. On the 5th of January, we were in the tower. That's why I appeared with you in the lobby when you touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: N-No. No. How would I have gone to the future? There's no way.
entries.literal: "N-No. No. How would I have gone to the future? There's no way."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: With the Sekimeiya. There were two of them.
entries.literal: "With the Sekimeiya. There were two of them."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I... know. I saw that too. What do you mean, though?
entries.literal: "I... know. I saw that too. What do you mean, though?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I've thought about everything that happened. There always were two Sekimeiya, but only one of them made us go to the past. The other one made us go to the future instead.
entries.literal: "I've thought about everything that happened. There always were two Sekimeiya, but only one of them made us go to the past. The other one made us go to the future instead."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The one in the water tank sent you to the future, but that wasn't the first time. ...It wasn't the first time you'd traveled forward in time. There were others.
entries.literal: "The one in the water tank sent you to the future, but that wasn't the first time. ...It wasn't the first time you'd traveled forward in time. There were others."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She looked astonished. For a while, she didn't respond.
entries.literal: "She looked astonished. For a while, she didn't respond."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: A-Are you serious...?
entries.literal: "A-Are you serious...?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I am. I've been able to understand the Sekimeiya.{w} The Future Sekimeiya made us appear where we were in the past; I believe that could be part of your confusion. The Past Sekimeiya made us appear where we would be in the future.{w} ...And, if both ranges overlapped, the world around us would change instead.
entries.literal: "I am. I've been able to understand the Sekimeiya.{w} The Future Sekimeiya made us appear where we were in the past; I believe that could be part of your confusion. The Past Sekimeiya made us appear where we would be in the future.{w} ...And, if both ranges overlapped, the world around us would change instead."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: O{w=0.2}-Oh!{w=0.3} ...That makes sense. That's how I came back.
entries.literal: "O{w=0.2}-Oh!{w=0.3} ...That makes sense. That's how I came back."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She stared off into the hallway, working with the information I'd given her.
entries.literal: "She stared off into the hallway, working with the information I'd given her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When she opened her mouth again, she asked what she most wanted an answer to.
entries.literal: "When she opened her mouth again, she asked what she most wanted an answer to."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: So... what now? What will happen at {time=21}?
entries.literal: "So... what now? What will happen at {time=21}?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It'll be fine. We'll be able to leave.
entries.literal: "It'll be fine. We'll be able to leave."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She breathed a sigh of relief. Everything could finally end.
entries.literal: "She breathed a sigh of relief. Everything could finally end."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This isn't over yet, though. We have to do one more thing.
entries.literal: "This isn't over yet, though. We have to do one more thing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...We{w=0.6} are going to save Miiya.
entries.literal: "...We{w=0.6} are going to save Miiya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wh-What? Really...?{w} Can the past really be changed after all!?
entries.literal: "Wh-What? Really...?{w} Can the past really be changed after all!?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not it. The past is set in stone.{w} But in a different world, the past is no different from the future for us.
entries.literal: "That's not it. The past is set in stone.{w} But in a different world, the past is no different from the future for us."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Huh...?

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We can save her in this world. If you travel, you can save her.{w} ...It has to be you, though.
entries.literal: "We can save her in this world. If you travel, you can save her.{w} ...It has to be you, though."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.literal: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the kitchen. The recorder's timer showed 44:24.
entries.literal: "I walked to the kitchen. The recorder's timer showed 44:24."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That is the Past Sekimeiya. If you activate it when the timer reaches 63:14, you'll appear on November 30th. If you're there, Miiya will not die.{w} I can't come with you, though. If you activate it, anyone in the center of the building will go back to our world. If I travel to the past too, I won't be able to be there.{w} But, if it's you who does this, you will be. When December 15th comes, you'll be able to enter through the storeroom, and if you stay in the third partition on the fourth floor, you'll make it back to this point.
entries.literal: "That is the Past Sekimeiya. If you activate it when the timer reaches 63:14, you'll appear on November 30th. If you're there, Miiya will not die.{w} I can't come with you, though. If you activate it, anyone in the center of the building will go back to our world. If I travel to the past too, I won't be able to be there.{w} But, if it's you who does this, you will be. When December 15th comes, you'll be able to enter through the storeroom, and if you stay in the third partition on the fourth floor, you'll make it back to this point."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She looked overwhelmed. There was very little time left, so I was trying to explain everything rapidly.
entries.literal: "She looked overwhelmed. There was very little time left, so I was trying to explain everything rapidly."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: W-Wait, so, I'll be able to prevent her death? And then, at this time, both of us will go back to our world?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, so, I'll be able to prevent her death? And then, at this time, both of us will go back to our world?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I nodded, her eyes briefly widened.
entries.literal: "When I nodded, her eyes briefly widened."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The seconds were passing quickly, so I had to make sure I could say everything I needed to.
entries.literal: "The seconds were passing quickly, so I had to make sure I could say everything I needed to."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You will appear on November 30th where you will be on December 30th. If you think about where you'll be, that's where you'll appear.
entries.literal: "You will appear on November 30th where you will be on December 30th. If you think about where you'll be, that's where you'll appear."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...What?
entries.literal: "...What?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: On December 30th, you have to be in that gem shop so that you appear there in November.
entries.literal: "On December 30th, you have to be in that gem shop so that you appear there in November."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: In the gem shop? I don't think that will be possible. ...It was still closed.
entries.literal: "In the gem shop? I don't think that will be possible. ...It was still closed."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I-In that case, right outside it.{w} It was snowing on November 30th, wasn't it?
entries.literal: "I-In that case, right outside it.{w} It was snowing on November 30th, wasn't it?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I bit my lip. I didn't know what would happen if she were to appear right on top of falling snow, given what had happened to me with the elevator's railing.
entries.literal: "I bit my lip. I didn't know what would happen if she were to appear right on top of falling snow, given what had happened to me with the elevator's railing."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You'll have to be below a stone roof, where the snow won't hit you and there'll be none on the ground. Then, you'll be able to prevent Miiya from being hit by the explosion.{w} That's not all, though. There's something else very important. Your body can't be found.
entries.literal: "You'll have to be below a stone roof, where the snow won't hit you and there'll be none on the ground. Then, you'll be able to prevent Miiya from being hit by the explosion.{w} That's not all, though. There's something else very important. Your body can't be found."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: M-Mine?
entries.literal: "M-Mine?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded, although I still didn't fully understand that. ...Why was her body the one that had to go missing? If the news had to be merely followed, why couldn't Miiya's be the one that wouldn't be found despite her well-being? ...The only reason it had to be Shiroya's was because I knew Miiya was in the tower. I still felt like there was something else to all of that.
entries.literal: "I nodded, although I still didn't fully understand that. ...Why was her body the one that had to go missing? If the news had to be merely followed, why couldn't Miiya's be the one that wouldn't be found despite her well-being? ...The only reason it had to be Shiroya's was because I knew Miiya was in the tower. I still felt like there was something else to all of that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Then, early on the 15th, you'll be able to enter the tower through the storeroom. You still have the rusty key, right?
entries.literal: "Then, early on the 15th, you'll be able to enter the tower through the storeroom. You still have the rusty key, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She showed it to me.
entries.literal: "She showed it to me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You'll be able to stay in the third partition on the fourth floor. I know that'll work, because after {time=14}, you'll go to the sixth floor and leave some kind of indication for me under one of the drawers. The fifth desk from the left, in the first partition.{w} After that, you'll only need to leave momentarily at {time=15:30.} If you're in the floor 2 and 3 staircase, you'll avoid being inside the range of a travel. The range might actually reach the crystal floor, but if you're in a corner of the building a floor above, you'll avoid it. Just not in the crystal floor staircase since that's where I was at the time.
entries.literal: "You'll be able to stay in the third partition on the fourth floor. I know that'll work, because after {time=14}, you'll go to the sixth floor and leave some kind of indication for me under one of the drawers. The fifth desk from the left, in the first partition.{w} After that, you'll only need to leave momentarily at {time=15:30.} If you're in the floor 2 and 3 staircase, you'll avoid being inside the range of a travel. The range might actually reach the crystal floor, but if you're in a corner of the building a floor above, you'll avoid it. Just not in the crystal floor staircase since that's where I was at the time."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: O-Okay...
entries.literal: "O-Okay..."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm sorry. There's not much time left.
entries.literal: "I'm sorry. There's not much time left."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: 50:06. I had to leave soon to escape the range, and I wasn't sure if I'd explained myself well at all. {tip=rush}Something about the rush I was in felt paradoxical{/tip}, but I had no time to try to think about it.
entries.literal: "50:06. I had to leave soon to escape the range, and I wasn't sure if I'd explained myself well at all. {tip=rush}Something about the rush I was in felt paradoxical{/tip}, but I had no time to try to think about it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let me check that nobody's in the bedrooms anymore. I don't know what happened to them, but someone might still be here.
entries.literal: "Let me check that nobody's in the bedrooms anymore. I don't know what happened to them, but someone might still be here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the four separate bedrooms, which were all vacant. Meanwhile, I felt my fingers beginning to tremble. Shiroya was there again, and it seemed as if the future finally had a distinct shape.
entries.literal: "I looked at the four separate bedrooms, which were all vacant. Meanwhile, I felt my fingers beginning to tremble. Shiroya was there again, and it seemed as if the future finally had a distinct shape."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's it, then. Everything is ready.
entries.literal: "That's it, then. Everything is ready."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It will work. I'm sure.
entries.literal: "It will work. I'm sure."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Y-Yeah.
entries.literal: "Y-Yeah."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Can I ask, though? ...Why are your clothes like this?
entries.literal: "Can I ask, though? ...Why are your clothes like this?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: O-Oh. I put them on hoping I would come back to the point you saw me.
entries.literal: "O-Oh. I put them on hoping I would come back to the point you saw me."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Really? ...That's interesting.
entries.literal: "Really? ...That's interesting."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In fact, it seemed to go against most conclusions I'd made. There was no time to care, however.
entries.literal: "In fact, it seemed to go against most conclusions I'd made. There was no time to care, however."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Wait. You have the attic key. You should give it to me.
entries.literal: "Wait. You have the attic key. You should give it to me."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: You need it?
entries.literal: "You need it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, but you will on January 26th. If I don't take it now, you won't be able to have it.{w} Because, at {time=21} today, the police will find you, and they'll take this key from you if you have it. I need to keep it.
entries.literal: "No, but you will on January 26th. If I don't take it now, you won't be able to have it.{w} Because, at {time=21} today, the police will find you, and they'll take this key from you if you have it. I need to keep it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: And they won't take it if you have it?
entries.literal: "And they won't take it if you have it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...No.{w} I'd tell you why, but there's not enough time right now.
entries.literal: "...No.{w} I'd tell you why, but there's not enough time right now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Five minutes were left until she would travel to the past. For me, I was five minutes away from returning to our world with her.
entries.literal: "Five minutes were left until she would travel to the past. For me, I was five minutes away from returning to our world with her."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the Past Sekimeiya and left it on the highest cabinet shelf, where it wasn't easy to see.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the Past Sekimeiya and left it on the highest cabinet shelf, where it wasn't easy to see."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: If you activate it when it's there, in the instance that the people from this world come back up, it's possible they won't find it.
entries.literal: "If you activate it when it's there, in the instance that the people from this world come back up, it's possible they won't find it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}I should go. I'm sure your future self is currently on the fourth floor. She's been there for hours.{w} You understand everything I said, right?
entries.literal: "...{w}I should go. I'm sure your future self is currently on the fourth floor. She's been there for hours.{w} You understand everything I said, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I think so. When that screen says 63:14, I just have to touch the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "...I think so. When that screen says 63:14, I just have to touch the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You'll appear on the 30th, next to that gem shop.{w} I have to go now, but I guess I'm about to see you again. I'm sorry that there wasn't more time to explain.
entries.literal: "You'll appear on the 30th, next to that gem shop.{w} I have to go now, but I guess I'm about to see you again. I'm sorry that there wasn't more time to explain."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: A-All right. I'll see you.
entries.literal: "A-All right. I'll see you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But before I knew it, my body had jumped forward in a sudden impulse and was tightly embracing Shiroya. I couldn't stand the thought of anything going wrong from that point on.
entries.literal: "But before I knew it, my body had jumped forward in a sudden impulse and was tightly embracing Shiroya. I couldn't stand the thought of anything going wrong from that point on."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Right next to my ear, I felt her surprised breath, and after the initial shock, her hands slowly tightened up behind me. I couldn't believe what was happening, but I took advantage of it and rested my head on her shoulder.
entries.literal: "Right next to my ear, I felt her surprised breath, and after the initial shock, her hands slowly tightened up behind me. I couldn't believe what was happening, but I took advantage of it and rested my head on her shoulder."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I wished the moment could go on forever, but the clock was ticking. When I let go of her, I couldn't bring myself to say anything else or even look directly at her again.
entries.literal: "I wished the moment could go on forever, but the clock was ticking. When I let go of her, I couldn't bring myself to say anything else or even look directly at her again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was hard to turn around, but I had to. With my body still shaking, I trudged to the stairs, aware it was the last time my footprints would be left on that floor.
entries.literal: "It was hard to turn around, but I had to. With my body still shaking, I trudged to the stairs, aware it was the last time my footprints would be left on that floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: 63 minutes. Shiroya tightly gripped the device that had once been found in Isla's purse while her heart raced from Atsuki's sudden hug.
entries.literal: "63 minutes. Shiroya tightly gripped the device that had once been found in Isla's purse while her heart raced from Atsuki's sudden hug."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Her other hand was reaching high above her, close to the Sekimeiya as she withstood the immense heat around it.
entries.literal: "Her other hand was reaching high above her, close to the Sekimeiya as she withstood the immense heat around it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She hadn't traveled to the past, but she was about to. She stared firmly at the numbers on the screen and gradually moved her hand deeper into the heat.{w} After fourteen more seconds had gone by, she felt the hard touch.
entries.literal: "She hadn't traveled to the past, but she was about to. She stared firmly at the numbers on the screen and gradually moved her hand deeper into the heat.{w} After fourteen more seconds had gone by, she felt the hard touch."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Light snow was falling on a dim street in Yushibana. Despite the few lit windows, not one of them saw the figure of a young girl appearing by the entrance of a house, below a stone roof.
entries.literal: "Light snow was falling on a dim street in Yushibana. Despite the few lit windows, not one of them saw the figure of a young girl appearing by the entrance of a house, below a stone roof."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She found herself leaning on the cold wall and rapidly looked down. There, she was able to see some of the footprints she'd once left.
entries.literal: "She found herself leaning on the cold wall and rapidly looked down. There, she was able to see some of the footprints she'd once left."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She traced them up to an opaque door on the opposite side of the street. Wasting no time, she dashed over and opened it.
entries.literal: "She traced them up to an opaque door on the opposite side of the street. Wasting no time, she dashed over and opened it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Remnants of the smoke were in the air. It had already been released, but it wasn't too late.
entries.literal: "Remnants of the smoke were in the air. It had already been released, but it wasn't too late."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On the floor, she saw the first two people to fall unconscious—those who had already escaped danger.
entries.literal: "On the floor, she saw the first two people to fall unconscious—those who had already escaped danger."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Behind the shelves were two girls. One was being protected by the wooden structures, whereas the other was an open target.
entries.literal: "Behind the shelves were two girls. One was being protected by the wooden structures, whereas the other was an open target."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She crouched and grabbed the shoulders of the girl in red, shuffling backward to drop her behind the shield of shelves.
entries.literal: "She crouched and grabbed the shoulders of the girl in red, shuffling backward to drop her behind the shield of shelves."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Once that danger was removed, she stood up and looked at her own body on the floor. She didn't know the exact time, but her work wasn't finished yet.
entries.literal: "Once that danger was removed, she stood up and looked at her own body on the floor. She didn't know the exact time, but her work wasn't finished yet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She picked herself up by her shoulders and began to retreat.{w} However, a slight sound caused her to spin around, and her heart skipped a beat.
entries.literal: "She picked herself up by her shoulders and began to retreat.{w} However, a slight sound caused her to spin around, and her heart skipped a beat."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She didn't see the door opening because a wooden shelf was blocking it. However, soon after she heard its squeaky sound, the lights turned off.
entries.literal: "She didn't see the door opening because a wooden shelf was blocking it. However, soon after she heard its squeaky sound, the lights turned off."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was practically no time to react. During the instants before the light came back, the girl closed her eyes and attempted to cover her face with her arms.
entries.literal: "There was practically no time to react. During the instants before the light came back, the girl closed her eyes and attempted to cover her face with her arms."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The floor had been devastated, and she found herself falling with the rubble, the deadly light shrinking as she was consumed by familiar darkness.
entries.literal: "The floor had been devastated, and she found herself falling with the rubble, the deadly light shrinking as she was consumed by familiar darkness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She saw something shining above and heard very faint shouts. Her entire body was wracked with pain, but she was able to stand up.
entries.literal: "She saw something shining above and heard very faint shouts. Her entire body was wracked with pain, but she was able to stand up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When she looked around her, she saw there was light there too: an egg-shaped gemstone had rolled away, and it gave off a soft glow.
entries.literal: "When she looked around her, she saw there was light there too: an egg-shaped gemstone had rolled away, and it gave off a soft glow."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She heard a moan laced with pain. Her other self was conscious. She had been holding her as they'd fallen; that time, neither one of them had lapsed into a lengthy unconsciousness.
entries.literal: "She heard a moan laced with pain. Her other self was conscious. She had been holding her as they'd fallen; that time, neither one of them had lapsed into a lengthy unconsciousness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Her friend had told her something very important: her own body couldn't be found. She didn't understand why, but a realization immediately came to her.
entries.literal: "Her friend had told her something very important: her own body couldn't be found. She didn't understand why, but a realization immediately came to her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As she took a slow step back, she saw her own self awakening. It was difficult to make out, but she saw that the other her was staring at the distant gemstone.
entries.literal: "As she took a slow step back, she saw her own self awakening. It was difficult to make out, but she saw that the other her was staring at the distant gemstone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was when she understood... that the universe would do the rest—that she didn't have to enact something that was already meant to happen.
entries.literal: "That was when she understood... that the universe would do the rest—that she didn't have to enact something that was already meant to happen."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She stepped back. She knew the way out of there.
entries.literal: "She stepped back. She knew the way out of there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Meanwhile, the other girl approached the stone. The act of her touching it would be the {tip=force}driving force{/tip} behind a forthcoming attack in her town.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, the other girl approached the stone. The act of her touching it would be the {tip=force}driving force{/tip} behind a forthcoming attack in her town."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The girl found herself looking out upon a nostalgic view, but the snow was still piling up to form the scenery she'd once seen. Once more, she began walking to her empty apartment.
entries.literal: "The girl found herself looking out upon a nostalgic view, but the snow was still piling up to form the scenery she'd once seen. Once more, she began walking to her empty apartment."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But when she realized that it would soon be December 1st, her destination changed.
entries.literal: "But when she realized that it would soon be December 1st, her destination changed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had once felt a false sense of freedom walking down that path, but the kind she felt the second time was genuine; she knew where the path went.
entries.literal: "She had once felt a false sense of freedom walking down that path, but the kind she felt the second time was genuine; she knew where the path went."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It led to a place she hadn't thought existed, and one that she was eager to reach.
entries.literal: "It led to a place she hadn't thought existed, and one that she was eager to reach."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I arrived on the fourth floor and looked at the wall to my right. ...She had to be on the other side of it.
entries.literal: "I arrived on the fourth floor and looked at the wall to my right. ...She had to be on the other side of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Nobody had been found, but... she was there.
entries.literal: "Nobody had been found, but... she was there."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the door to the last partition.
entries.literal: "I opened the door to the last partition."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It's been a while.
entries.literal: "It's been a while."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Yeah.
entries.literal: "...Yeah."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She rose from the chair she'd been sitting in, but she looked worn out. Although I had just left the attic, for her, that had happened fifteen days in the past.
entries.literal: "She rose from the chair she'd been sitting in, but she looked worn out. Although I had just left the attic, for her, that had happened fifteen days in the past."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: D-Did everything work out?
entries.literal: "D-Did everything work out?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Before she could answer, we heard a noise.{w} It sounded like the elevator had opened.
entries.literal: "Before she could answer, we heard a noise.{w} It sounded like the elevator had opened."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...ody's here! I... didn't pre—
entries.literal: "...ody's here! I... didn't pre—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Has it been enough time already?
entries.literal: "Has it been enough time already?"

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...op the bleedi—
entries.literal: "...op the bleedi—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at Shiroya. We were back. It had really worked.{w} That was happening on the third floor, near the staircase. Our past selves had returned too, although they were unaware of it. Their voices hardly reached us, but I could understand them since I knew what they were saying.
entries.literal: "I looked at Shiroya. We were back. It had really worked.{w} That was happening on the third floor, near the staircase. Our past selves had returned too, although they were unaware of it. Their voices hardly reached us, but I could understand them since I knew what they were saying."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...A-Ats—{w} ...not bleedi—
entries.literal: "...A-Ats—{w} ...not bleedi—"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: That's right. My past self was waiting outside the offices after traveling to the past. Right now, Shiroya's in the attic, and Sai's on the crystal floor.
entries.literal: "That's right. My past self was waiting outside the offices after traveling to the past. Right now, Shiroya's in the attic, and Sai's on the crystal floor."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What were you gonna say?
entries.literal: "What were you gonna say?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Um, everything did go well, but...{w} I saw Miiya earlier. She came in here once, and I'm pretty sure she saw me.{w} She didn't say anything, though. I almost froze from the shock, but before I could react, she had already left.
entries.literal: "...Um, everything did go well, but...{w} I saw Miiya earlier. She came in here once, and I'm pretty sure she saw me.{w} She didn't say anything, though. I almost froze from the shock, but before I could react, she had already left."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: R-Really?
entries.literal: "R-Really?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She nodded, still puzzled.{w} So, it really had been like that. It had happened as I'd imagined it.{w} I didn't get it. I'd known that she wouldn't be found thanks to the drawing under the drawer. Before seeing it, I hadn't come up with a reason to explain why Miiya hadn't found her, but at that point, I had realized that one wasn't needed. If she simply stayed there, she wouldn't be found. ...I still couldn't understand what had happened.
entries.literal: "She nodded, still puzzled.{w} So, it really had been like that. It had happened as I'd imagined it.{w} I didn't get it. I'd known that she wouldn't be found thanks to the drawing under the drawer. Before seeing it, I hadn't come up with a reason to explain why Miiya hadn't found her, but at that point, I had realized that one wasn't needed. If she simply stayed there, she wouldn't be found. ...I still couldn't understand what had happened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: What about the you from the other world? Is she okay?
entries.literal: "What about the you from the other world? Is she okay?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes. She wasn't found at the site of the explosion, but she wasn't harmed.{w} ...Why couldn't she be found?
entries.literal: "Yes. She wasn't found at the site of the explosion, but she wasn't harmed.{w} ...Why couldn't she be found?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...To match the news report that I saw. I did travel to November too, before you did, but I failed to accomplish anything.
entries.literal: "...To match the news report that I saw. I did travel to November too, before you did, but I failed to accomplish anything."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I know. I saw you at the motel. I thought about staying there in case someone found me in my apartment.
entries.literal: "I know. I saw you at the motel. I thought about staying there in case someone found me in my apartment."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You were there?{w} By the way, what keeps happening to your clothes? They're the ones you entered the tower with again, but you didn't have them when you went to the past.
entries.literal: "You were there?{w} By the way, what keeps happening to your clothes? They're the ones you entered the tower with again, but you didn't have them when you went to the past."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, yeah. They're the ones from that world.
entries.literal: "Oh, yeah. They're the ones from that world."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...Ah. That time, right before {time=21}, I did think that something about her looked strange. It was so late into the day that I didn't realize it was the complete lack of smoke on her clothes. ...And her pendant is gone too—the thing that tied her with Miiya disappeared when she went to the future.
entries.literal: "...Ah. That time, right before {time=21}, I did think that something about her looked strange. It was so late into the day that I didn't realize it was the complete lack of smoke on her clothes. ...And her pendant is gone too—the thing that tied her with Miiya disappeared when she went to the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She took a digital watch out of her purse.
entries.literal: "She took a digital watch out of her purse."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You bought a watch? That's smart.
entries.literal: "You bought a watch? That's smart."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's {time=19:37.}

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Shiroya pointed out very faint footsteps coming from the other side of the wall. Although I hadn't noticed them, I knew she was right.
entries.literal: "Shiroya pointed out very faint footsteps coming from the other side of the wall. Although I hadn't noticed them, I knew she was right."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's us. Myself, Sai, and Erina. We're going to the attic.
entries.literal: "That's us. Myself, Sai, and Erina. We're going to the attic."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They went around the floor and disappeared up the next staircase.
entries.literal: "They went around the floor and disappeared up the next staircase."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Now what, then? I don't know what happened at the end.
entries.literal: "Now what, then? I don't know what happened at the end."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's go down first. I need to do something very important.
entries.literal: "Let's go down first. I need to do something very important."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had very little strength within me, and Shiroya looked dizzy when she moved. We took our time walking down, knowing full well that there was nobody left beneath us.
entries.literal: "I had very little strength within me, and Shiroya looked dizzy when she moved. We took our time walking down, knowing full well that there was nobody left beneath us."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Let's go to the security room.
entries.literal: "Let's go to the security room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Katei's dead body was there, filling the room with a stench I'd forgotten about. The monitors were working, which meant that someone had been there fifty minutes previously. Although it was slightly strange, I could barely bring myself to care.
entries.literal: "Katei's dead body was there, filling the room with a stench I'd forgotten about. The monitors were working, which meant that someone had been there fifty minutes previously. Although it was slightly strange, I could barely bring myself to care."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Actually... I bet I know why.
