Only Sai could have used the computer, and not too long ago, he traveled to the past from the event room with Shiroya.{w} That would've disabled his watch, but the next time we saw him, it was working. Every time that happened, he came here to sync it with the computer's time. There was a drawer with a bunch of batteries.
entries.literal: "Actually... I bet I know why. Only Sai could have used the computer, and not too long ago, he traveled to the past from the event room with Shiroya.{w} That would've disabled his watch, but the next time we saw him, it was working. Every time that happened, he came here to sync it with the computer's time. There was a drawer with a bunch of batteries."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What's that?
entries.literal: "What's that?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: A USB drive I brought to the tower in the other world. I have enough to put Katei and Akaro in jail with the footage on this.
entries.literal: "A USB drive I brought to the tower in the other world. I have enough to put Katei and Akaro in jail with the footage on this."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once the computer detected it, I saved two copies of the file. The normal folder with the saved footage was nowhere to be found, so I left them elsewhere. If necessary, I would reveal the location to the police. Then, I left the drive behind one of the drawers so that it could also be found.
entries.literal: "Once the computer detected it, I saved two copies of the file. The normal folder with the saved footage was nowhere to be found, so I left them elsewhere. If necessary, I would reveal the location to the police. Then, I left the drive behind one of the drawers so that it could also be found."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: By the way, you left the rusty key outside the storeroom, right? Was that so that it wouldn't open from the inside?
entries.literal: "By the way, you left the rusty key outside the storeroom, right? Was that so that it wouldn't open from the inside?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes.
entries.literal: "Yes."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's what I thought. Not completely sure how much sense it makes yet, but there's nothing I can do to fight it.{w} I have the rusty key right here too, by the way, but there's a slight problem. I'll need it on January 5th, and since you gave up yours, you'll also need this one on December 30th.
entries.literal: "That's what I thought. Not completely sure how much sense it makes yet, but there's nothing I can do to fight it.{w} I have the rusty key right here too, by the way, but there's a slight problem. I'll need it on January 5th, and since you gave up yours, you'll also need this one on December 30th."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh, I guess so.
entries.literal: "Oh, I guess so."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked under the desk. A Sekimeiya was there.
entries.literal: "I looked under the desk. A Sekimeiya was there."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: This is the Past Sekimeiya. My past self traveled with it very recently in the staff room, and Sai brought it here. It doesn't have a lot of power right now.
entries.literal: "This is the Past Sekimeiya. My past self traveled with it very recently in the staff room, and Sai brought it here. It doesn't have a lot of power right now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the rusty key on the floor of hallway A and closed the door.
entries.literal: "I left the rusty key on the floor of hallway A and closed the door."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We need to duplicate it. Otherwise, we won't be able to have it on those days.
entries.literal: "We need to duplicate it. Otherwise, we won't be able to have it on those days."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...{w}She didn't seem to know why that was the case.
entries.literal: "...{w}She didn't seem to know why that was the case."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'll go a very short distance back in time one last time. Since I left the key outside this room, my past self will be able to grab it and have it in the future. But since that will let me appear with it, I won't have to really grab it, which will duplicate it.
entries.literal: "I'll go a very short distance back in time one last time. Since I left the key outside this room, my past self will be able to grab it and have it in the future. But since that will let me appear with it, I won't have to really grab it, which will duplicate it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Will that actually work?
entries.literal: "Will that actually work?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes.{w} As soon as I leave, open the door.
entries.literal: "Yes.{w} As soon as I leave, open the door."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...All right.
entries.literal: "...All right."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stepped back and touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "I stepped back and touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The light went out, but I knew where I was before I looked around me.
entries.literal: "The light went out, but I knew where I was before I looked around me."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: The mechanical room.
entries.literal: "The mechanical room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I confirmed that the rusty key was in my pocket.
entries.literal: "I confirmed that the rusty key was in my pocket."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I went to hallway A, I saw it on the floor too.
entries.literal: "When I went to hallway A, I saw it on the floor too."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't have to wait very long until the security room opened.
entries.literal: "I didn't have to wait very long until the security room opened."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There we go, now we have two. Take this one.
entries.literal: "There we go, now we have two. Take this one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The movements of the rusty key were interesting. Shiroya had found it on January 5th, in our world. Then, she had traveled to December 15th and had still been holding it. Later, she had traveled to November 30th and had still been holding it. However, she'd used it to lock the storeroom from outside in the other world, which meant it couldn't be recovered.
entries.literal: "The movements of the rusty key were interesting. Shiroya had found it on January 5th, in our world. Then, she had traveled to December 15th and had still been holding it. Later, she had traveled to November 30th and had still been holding it. However, she'd used it to lock the storeroom from outside in the other world, which meant it couldn't be recovered."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When we had talked, she had told me about its location, so I'd been able to find it in the other world's security room as well. That was the key we had just duplicated.
entries.literal: "When we had talked, she had told me about its location, so I'd been able to find it in the other world's security room as well. That was the key we had just duplicated."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, it was the one she ended up with, and it was the one she would have on January 26th. As a result, when she had appeared on the 15th, she hadn't been holding the same key she'd found. The fact that she'd had to leave it outside the storeroom had made it transform.
entries.literal: "However, it was the one she ended up with, and it was the one she would have on January 26th. As a result, when she had appeared on the 15th, she hadn't been holding the same key she'd found. The fact that she'd had to leave it outside the storeroom had made it transform."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: What she'd appeared with had been a mesh of both. To obtain that key, both had been needed, and in a single instant, it had changed from the key of our world to the key of the other world.
entries.literal: "What she'd appeared with had been a mesh of both. To obtain that key, both had been needed, and in a single instant, it had changed from the key of our world to the key of the other world."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The powered-off Sekimeiya was on the floor, so I put it back where I'd found it; there was no reason to do otherwise.
entries.literal: "The powered-off Sekimeiya was on the floor, so I put it back where I'd found it; there was no reason to do otherwise."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: We need to go to the mechanical room. The others will come back soon.
entries.literal: "We need to go to the mechanical room. The others will come back soon."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: It's {time=19:45.} I'll travel to the past soon.{w} ...Sorry, to the future.
entries.literal: "It's {time=19:45.} I'll travel to the past soon.{w} ...Sorry, to the future."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. They must be coming down already.
entries.literal: "Yeah. They must be coming down already."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, you stayed at Eagle Motel too?
entries.literal: "So, you stayed at Eagle Motel too?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yes. I was there until today. I didn't realize the owner wasn't a native.
entries.literal: "Yes. I was there until today. I didn't realize the owner wasn't a native."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: We heard people above us. The group was beginning their wait near the shutter.
entries.literal: "We heard people above us. The group was beginning their wait near the shutter."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Will it be fine if we stay here?
entries.literal: "Will it be fine if we stay here?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Hm... Not quite.{w} Once you leave for the bathroom, they'll search everywhere for you.
entries.literal: "...Hm... Not quite.{w} Once you leave for the bathroom, they'll search everywhere for you."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, are they going to see us? They can't, right?
entries.literal: "Wait, are they going to see us? They can't, right?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No. If my past self saw me, that'd be a paradox.{w} But there's no simple way out of this. The Future Sekimeiya will be powered off and Sai will stay next to it when it repowers, and the Past Sekimeiya will send us too far to hide us since it'll build up energy until your past self leaves. I doubt touching it twice would work due to the powered-off time.
entries.literal: "No. If my past self saw me, that'd be a paradox.{w} But there's no simple way out of this. The Future Sekimeiya will be powered off and Sai will stay next to it when it repowers, and the Past Sekimeiya will send us too far to hide us since it'll build up energy until your past self leaves. I doubt touching it twice would work due to the powered-off time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: It was a very similar dilemma to the one I'd faced when searching the drawers for a marking. However, the answer was much clearer.
entries.literal: "It was a very similar dilemma to the one I'd faced when searching the drawers for a marking. However, the answer was much clearer."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Ah, I need to be found, then. If they find me, the search will stop before they realize you're here.
entries.literal: "Ah, I need to be found, then. If they find me, the search will stop before they realize you're here."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I nodded in the darkness.
entries.literal: "I nodded in the darkness."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: That's what you said, right? That I was still here even after I'd traveled from the bathroom.
entries.literal: "That's what you said, right? That I was still here even after I'd traveled from the bathroom."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: But what about at {time=21}? The shutter won't move, will it?
entries.literal: "But what about at {time=21}? The shutter won't move, will it?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No, it will.
entries.literal: "No, it will."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: What? Didn't you say that the recording was real?
entries.literal: "What? Didn't you say that the recording was real?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yes, but before the exit opened, we went to the future. We appeared on January 5th, where the recording occurred.{w} So, if you're out of that range, you'll stay here and be able to leave.
entries.literal: "Yes, but before the exit opened, we went to the future. We appeared on January 5th, where the recording occurred.{w} So, if you're out of that range, you'll stay here and be able to leave."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Oh... that's what happened.{w} Where will the range be?
entries.literal: "Oh... that's what happened.{w} Where will the range be?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Here. Just before {time=21:05}, Erina is going to activate it. The Future Sekimeiya has yet to be brought here.{w} It won't be a normal travel, though. When she touches it, she'll trigger a chain reaction that will bring us to January 5th. We'll go twenty minutes to the future repeatedly. Akaro will appear a bit later because he traveled directly from today to January 5th after escaping from the bedroom with Sai.
entries.literal: "Here. Just before {time=21:05}, Erina is going to activate it. The Future Sekimeiya has yet to be brought here.{w} It won't be a normal travel, though. When she touches it, she'll trigger a chain reaction that will bring us to January 5th. We'll go twenty minutes to the future repeatedly. Akaro will appear a bit later because he traveled directly from today to January 5th after escaping from the bedroom with Sai."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: W-Wait, a chain reaction...? Do we just have to avoid being here when that happens?
entries.literal: "W-Wait, a chain reaction...? Do we just have to avoid being here when that happens?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...{w}Not being here twenty minutes before it's activated would also avoid it.{w} It won't be so simple, though...{w} Only you will be able to do that.
entries.literal: "...{w}Not being here twenty minutes before it's activated would also avoid it.{w} It won't be so simple, though...{w} Only you will be able to do that."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Hm? ...Wh-Why?
entries.literal: "Hm? ...Wh-Why?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The people above us will search for you soon. They'll find you, and then the shutter will open. You can leave this place.{w} I can't do that, though. There's something very important that still has to happen.{w} On January 5th, I'll have to be in the tower in order to appear on November 24th with the Sekimeiya. If I stay here, I'll travel to the future one more time. That's when I'll finally be able to leave.
entries.literal: "The people above us will search for you soon. They'll find you, and then the shutter will open. You can leave this place.{w} I can't do that, though. There's something very important that still has to happen.{w} On January 5th, I'll have to be in the tower in order to appear on November 24th with the Sekimeiya. If I stay here, I'll travel to the future one more time. That's when I'll finally be able to leave."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Can't you just enter through the storeroom on the 5th?
entries.literal: "Can't you just enter through the storeroom on the 5th?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: No... there are a few reasons why I can't.{w} The 5th is 21 days away. It's possible that getting out today will prevent me from being in the tower in the future.{w} I don't know what the police will do. If they find any evidence that incriminates me, being here on the 5th might not be possible. I'm sure my parents will keep trying to make me leave with them too. ...Staying here is the only way to guarantee it, and it's what I thought I'd do before I touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "No... there are a few reasons why I can't.{w} The 5th is 21 days away. It's possible that getting out today will prevent me from being in the tower in the future.{w} I don't know what the police will do. If they find any evidence that incriminates me, being here on the 5th might not be possible. I'm sure my parents will keep trying to make me leave with them too. ...Staying here is the only way to guarantee it, and it's what I thought I'd do before I touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Technically, I knew I'd be in Yushibana on January 26th, but my parents had spent the previous two weeks telling me to go live with them. I feared they would give me no option after what had happened in the tower and force me to leave town until after January 5th.
entries.literal: "Technically, I knew I'd be in Yushibana on January 26th, but my parents had spent the previous two weeks telling me to go live with them. I feared they would give me no option after what had happened in the tower and force me to leave town until after January 5th."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: There are more reasons too. If both of us leave, the attic key will be taken from us, and we need it on the 26th. Leaving it somewhere until the 5th is risky, so I can just bring it there myself.
entries.literal: "There are more reasons too. If both of us leave, the attic key will be taken from us, and we need it on the 26th. Leaving it somewhere until the 5th is risky, so I can just bring it there myself."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...You're right. When I traveled to the 15th, I had the attic key, but the cabinet key was the only one that wasn't in my purse. I still don't get that.
entries.literal: "...You're right. When I traveled to the 15th, I had the attic key, but the cabinet key was the only one that wasn't in my purse. I still don't get that."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: The cabinet key? If the police found you with it, they would take it, so the only way to get it to the 26th would be by doing the same thing as with the attic's.{w} Did you ever need to unlock the cabinet?
entries.literal: "The cabinet key? If the police found you with it, they would take it, so the only way to get it to the 26th would be by doing the same thing as with the attic's.{w} Did you ever need to unlock the cabinet?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...No. I don't think so.
entries.literal: "...No. I don't think so."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I see. That's why, then. There's no reason to bring it to the 26th, so you didn't appear with it.
entries.literal: "I see. That's why, then. There's no reason to bring it to the 26th, so you didn't appear with it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Wait, so can't I do the same? We can both travel to the 5th.
entries.literal: "Wait, so can't I do the same? We can both travel to the 5th."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: That's not true. On November 30th, you appeared outside the gem shop, right?
entries.literal: "That's not true. On November 30th, you appeared outside the gem shop, right?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: So, on December 30th, you'll be out of the tower. That's why you can't stay here.
entries.literal: "So, on December 30th, you'll be out of the tower. That's why you can't stay here."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I... see.
entries.literal: "I... see."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: It'll be fine. I'll just take a little longer.
entries.literal: "It'll be fine. I'll just take a little longer."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Yeah.
entries.literal: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: You can stay at my house too. At least you'll be with Maxi and Umi.{w} You were on January 5th once already, right? Was the tower not open?
entries.literal: "You can stay at my house too. At least you'll be with Maxi and Umi.{w} You were on January 5th once already, right? Was the tower not open?"

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: N-No. I don't know why, but it seems it won't open again after today.
entries.literal: "N-No. I don't know why, but it seems it won't open again after today."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: ...Yeah, that's what I thought.
entries.literal: "...Yeah, that's what I thought."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a mountain of things I wanted to tell her, but we went silent for a while. Both of us were even more tired than we appeared, and we had to speak very quietly.
entries.literal: "There was a mountain of things I wanted to tell her, but we went silent for a while. Both of us were even more tired than we appeared, and we had to speak very quietly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Everything we'd gone through since we'd stepped into the tower was like an endless expanse of tangled web. I could hardly even recall what things had been like before I knew what the Sekimeiya were capable of.
entries.literal: "Everything we'd gone through since we'd stepped into the tower was like an endless expanse of tangled web. I could hardly even recall what things had been like before I knew what the Sekimeiya were capable of."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But we had taken that day to its conclusion. Without any doubt, we were going to make it end.
entries.literal: "But we had taken that day to its conclusion. Without any doubt, we were going to make it end."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: People had died in horrible ways. I didn't expect that the outside world would ever learn the full truth of what had happened within the tower, but at the very least, Shiroya and I knew. We had built a better reality out there through our own actions.
entries.literal: "People had died in horrible ways. I didn't expect that the outside world would ever learn the full truth of what had happened within the tower, but at the very least, Shiroya and I knew. We had built a better reality out there through our own actions."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Surprisingly, I wasn't sad that the world where we had saved Miiya wasn't our own. Ours wasn't perfect, and I had no idea what awaited us in the future... but all I wanted was to step outside with Shiroya.
entries.literal: "Surprisingly, I wasn't sad that the world where we had saved Miiya wasn't our own. Ours wasn't perfect, and I had no idea what awaited us in the future... but all I wanted was to step outside with Shiroya."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: They'll leave soon. There's only forty minutes left.
entries.literal: "They'll leave soon. There's only forty minutes left."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Yeah. They'll go to the attic and come back down.{w} By the way, can I borrow your watch? It'll be useful to have it.
entries.literal: "Yeah. They'll go to the attic and come back down.{w} By the way, can I borrow your watch? It'll be useful to have it."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Take it.
entries.literal: "Take it."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: Thanks.
entries.literal: "Thanks."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Our wait was short. When the time came, we heard the group walking to the hallway.
entries.literal: "Our wait was short. When the time came, we heard the group walking to the hallway."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: ...I guess I'll go.
entries.literal: "...I guess I'll go."

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: All right. I'll see you soon.
entries.literal: "All right. I'll see you soon."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Are you going to stay here? You won't be seen?
entries.literal: "Are you going to stay here? You won't be seen?"

entries.speaker: a
entries.text: I'm sure I'll be fine.
entries.literal: "I'm sure I'll be fine."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: Okay.
entries.literal: "Okay."

entries.speaker: s
entries.text: I'll see you.
entries.literal: "I'll see you."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Her shadowy figure slowly faded up the stairs.{w} I recalled the time we'd found her drowsy in room A1 and the words she'd told me in hallway C... They were words I'd hated before, but they had grown to bring me happiness.
entries.literal: "Her shadowy figure slowly faded up the stairs.{w} I recalled the time we'd found her drowsy in room A1 and the words she'd told me in hallway C... They were words I'd hated before, but they had grown to bring me happiness."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The next time I heard sounds above me, she was already with them.
entries.literal: "The next time I heard sounds above me, she was already with them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stayed behind the piled furniture in the corner of the room. Like I'd expected, a single person came down soon after.
entries.literal: "I stayed behind the piled furniture in the corner of the room. Like I'd expected, a single person came down soon after."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't see who they were, but it had to be Sai. He seemed to be looking around in the dark.{w} I feared he would find me until his movements slowed down. He kneeled under a table and stopped.
entries.literal: "I couldn't see who they were, but it had to be Sai. He seemed to be looking around in the dark.{w} I feared he would find me until his movements slowed down. He kneeled under a table and stopped."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I bet he's looking for a good place to hide the Sekimeiya. Did he find one under that table?
entries.literal: "I bet he's looking for a good place to hide the Sekimeiya. Did he find one under that table?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was doing my best to conceal my breathing, but he remained there for a long time. Finally, he seemed to decide he was done and walked up the stairs.
entries.literal: "I was doing my best to conceal my breathing, but he remained there for a long time. Finally, he seemed to decide he was done and walked up the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hardly had time to exhale before he was back. There was a glaring difference—the area between his hands was glowing.{w} Once more, he kneeled under the table and ran back up the stairs as soon as he was finished.
entries.literal: "I hardly had time to exhale before he was back. There was a glaring difference—the area between his hands was glowing.{w} Once more, he kneeled under the table and ran back up the stairs as soon as he was finished."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The Sekimeiya wasn't simply on the floor. From what I could see, he had tucked it just under the surface of the table—there seemed to be a tiny space where he'd left it.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya wasn't simply on the floor. From what I could see, he had tucked it just under the surface of the table—there seemed to be a tiny space where he'd left it."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...{w}Now, my past self will find the Past Sekimeiya in the security room, and we'll all wait out the last few minutes in the lobby.
entries.literal: "...{w}Now, my past self will find the Past Sekimeiya in the security room, and we'll all wait out the last few minutes in the lobby."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stared at the glowing numbers on the watch until {time=21:01} came. At that point, someone began to carefully descend the stairs.
entries.literal: "I stared at the glowing numbers on the watch until {time=21:01} came. At that point, someone began to carefully descend the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: While I couldn't see their face, I knew it was Erina. She stood still until something caught her eye.
entries.literal: "While I couldn't see their face, I knew it was Erina. She stood still until something caught her eye."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Perhaps Sai thought he had found a good hiding spot, but he hadn't factored in the mechanical room's darkness. The faint illumination gave it away after Erina looked around a little.
entries.literal: "Perhaps Sai thought he had found a good hiding spot, but he hadn't factored in the mechanical room's darkness. The faint illumination gave it away after Erina looked around a little."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: She approached it and crouched. Her figure covered the light, and suddenly, it was gone.
entries.literal: "She approached it and crouched. Her figure covered the light, and suddenly, it was gone."

entries.speaker: aki
entries.text: Wh—
entries.literal: "Wh—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, Erina was still there. Her outline had disappeared because the light had moved.{w} The faint ceiling light had turned off, and the Sekimeiya's glow couldn't be seen.
entries.literal: "However, Erina was still there. Her outline had disappeared because the light had moved.{w} The faint ceiling light had turned off, and the Sekimeiya's glow couldn't be seen."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I hadn't felt anything myself, but I knew. I was on January 5th of 2012. Since I'd been in the mechanical room during both recurring locations, I had traveled seamlessly, and as my vision was more adjusted to the darkness, I could make out that a few pieces of furniture had moved slightly.
entries.literal: "I hadn't felt anything myself, but I knew. I was on January 5th of 2012. Since I'd been in the mechanical room during both recurring locations, I had traveled seamlessly, and as my vision was more adjusted to the darkness, I could make out that a few pieces of furniture had moved slightly."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Oblivious, Erina crawled out. To her, the Sekimeiya had simply disappeared. Then, she walked to the stairs, likely thinking she had traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "Oblivious, Erina crawled out. To her, the Sekimeiya had simply disappeared. Then, she walked to the stairs, likely thinking she had traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...It's still there; the Sekimeiya's on the floor. It rolled up to the wall.
entries.literal: "...It's still there; the Sekimeiya's on the floor. It rolled up to the wall."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: Hey! What's going on!?
entries.literal: "Hey! What's going on!?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That time, when the door to the lobby opened, light didn't fill the stairs—the whole building was devoid of it.
entries.literal: "That time, when the door to the lobby opened, light didn't fill the stairs—the whole building was devoid of it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: The watch still showed {time=21:03}, but that was far from the real time. I could hear the others shouting above me. The shutter wasn't opening.
entries.literal: "The watch still showed {time=21:03}, but that was far from the real time. I could hear the others shouting above me. The shutter wasn't opening."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: I can't get out yet. I'll need to have both Sekimeiya after the watch shows {time=22:30.}
entries.literal: "I can't get out yet. I'll need to have both Sekimeiya after the watch shows {time=22:30.}"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was forcing Shiroya to wait, but I had to stay there for a little while longer.{w} When {time=21:50} came, I approached the stairs.
entries.literal: "I was forcing Shiroya to wait, but I had to stay there for a little while longer.{w} When {time=21:50} came, I approached the stairs."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: At that time, my past self had traveled to the past. The others were soon to notice my absence.
entries.literal: "At that time, my past self had traveled to the past. The others were soon to notice my absence."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I grabbed the Future Sekimeiya and stepped up the stairs. I could no longer see the walls of the lobby, but unfortunately, I knew I'd have to see them once more in the future.
entries.literal: "I grabbed the Future Sekimeiya and stepped up the stairs. I could no longer see the walls of the lobby, but unfortunately, I knew I'd have to see them once more in the future."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't shake off the anticipation of stepping out. Even though I'd already left once before, it didn't feel like it.
entries.literal: "I couldn't shake off the anticipation of stepping out. Even though I'd already left once before, it didn't feel like it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the crystal room the past me had traveled from, B5. After feeling the floor, I realized that the powered-off Past Sekimeiya was there.{w} For the time being, I went to the crystal room at my right and put both inside a temperature regulation cabinet, setting it to where I believed 0 °C was. It seemed the curtains were all still raised.
entries.literal: "I walked to the crystal room the past me had traveled from, B5. After feeling the floor, I realized that the powered-off Past Sekimeiya was there.{w} For the time being, I went to the crystal room at my right and put both inside a temperature regulation cabinet, setting it to where I believed 0 °C was. It seemed the curtains were all still raised."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I could've gone to the attic, but the last thing I wanted was to have to explain myself to anyone. ...My sole desire was for the final few minutes to elapse.
entries.literal: "I could've gone to the attic, but the last thing I wanted was to have to explain myself to anyone. ...My sole desire was for the final few minutes to elapse."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I walked to the lobby. I could feel the shutter with my hands.
entries.literal: "I walked to the lobby. I could feel the shutter with my hands."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I'd waited patiently all day, but I couldn't take it anymore. I needed time to move faster. The goal was right there, and I was the only person who knew.
entries.literal: "I'd waited patiently all day, but I couldn't take it anymore. I needed time to move faster. The goal was right there, and I was the only person who knew."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...Minutes after I had started staring at Shiroya's watch, I heard voices in the far hallway.
entries.literal: "...Minutes after I had started staring at Shiroya's watch, I heard voices in the far hallway."

entries.speaker: q4
entries.text: ...tsuki! Where the fuck—
entries.literal: "...tsuki! Where the fuck—"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I kept looking down. It was already past {time=22.}
entries.literal: "I kept looking down. It was already past {time=22.}"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Wait... are they actually searching for me?
entries.literal: "Wait... are they actually searching for me?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Sai's yells got closer and closer. It seemed he was looking in every room.
entries.literal: "Sai's yells got closer and closer. It seemed he was looking in every room."

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: This piece of shit! The Sekimeiya's not in the cabinet!
entries.literal: "This piece of shit! The Sekimeiya's not in the cabinet!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Fuck. There's no way he'll find them, right?
entries.literal: "Fuck. There's no way he'll find them, right?"

entries.speaker: sai4
entries.text: Look! I found the Sekimeiya!
entries.literal: "Look! I found the Sekimeiya!"

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What?{w} No. That's the third one.
entries.literal: "What?{w} No. That's the third one."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He had found it in another room in hallway B. He had plenty of energy to spare, as I heard him running to the event room and leaving it there. Fortunately, that caused him not to find the real ones.
entries.literal: "He had found it in another room in hallway B. He had plenty of energy to spare, as I heard him running to the event room and leaving it there. Fortunately, that caused him not to find the real ones."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki! I know you're here!
entries.literal: "Atsuki! I know you're here!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I didn't move. The darkness was all I needed to stay hidden.
entries.literal: "I didn't move. The darkness was all I needed to stay hidden."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He went to the mechanical room. Maybe he noticed the Sekimeiya he'd hidden was no longer there, but he didn't say anything. Afterward, he walked back with the others.{w} Akaro was there. Hopefully, the recording of him had been obtained by the police.{w} Erina and Isla were the last two. Their stories had been tragic in different ways. They were together again, but it was possible that Erina would never understand that the Isla she'd entered the tower with was gone.
entries.literal: "He went to the mechanical room. Maybe he noticed the Sekimeiya he'd hidden was no longer there, but he didn't say anything. Afterward, he walked back with the others.{w} Akaro was there. Hopefully, the recording of him had been obtained by the police.{w} Erina and Isla were the last two. Their stories had been tragic in different ways. They were together again, but it was possible that Erina would never understand that the Isla she'd entered the tower with was gone."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: What is going to happen with them? The police must've found her corpse, but now they'll see that she's still alive. ...I suppose the case is similar with Naomi.
entries.literal: "What is going to happen with them? The police must've found her corpse, but now they'll see that she's still alive. ...I suppose the case is similar with Naomi."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I felt their voices fading. They were going back up.
entries.literal: "I felt their voices fading. They were going back up."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Now that I think about it, it was when I traveled to {time=21:00} that my hand injury disappeared. Even though I only went 45 minutes to the past, it took me many days to reach the proportional future.
entries.literal: "Now that I think about it, it was when I traveled to {time=21:00} that my hand injury disappeared. Even though I only went 45 minutes to the past, it took me many days to reach the proportional future."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right now, I have Shiroya's watch and the rusty key. When I was briefly at {time=21:00}, I might not have realized that. However, after Shiroya made me travel to the 15th, there's no way I had them.{w} I suppose that makes sense since that location was based on a point much farther into the future. That's still a little strange, though, because Shiroya did have the rusty key.
entries.literal: "Right now, I have Shiroya's watch and the rusty key. When I was briefly at {time=21:00}, I might not have realized that. However, after Shiroya made me travel to the 15th, there's no way I had them.{w} I suppose that makes sense since that location was based on a point much farther into the future. That's still a little strange, though, because Shiroya did have the rusty key."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stopped myself there. I really didn't care anymore. No matter how many details had flown far over my head, I didn't care about any of them.
entries.literal: "I stopped myself there. I really didn't care anymore. No matter how many details had flown far over my head, I didn't care about any of them."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I stood there for what seemed like hours, but eventually, {time=22:30} came.
entries.literal: "I stood there for what seemed like hours, but eventually, {time=22:30} came."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I tried to force myself to breathe properly. It wasn't over yet.
entries.literal: "I tried to force myself to breathe properly. It wasn't over yet."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: In the staff room, there was a keyring that I needed and I could obtain. I already had it in my pocket, though.
entries.literal: "In the staff room, there was a keyring that I needed and I could obtain. I already had it in my pocket, though."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...I forgot that I need to go to the attic. I thought I'd never see that place again.
entries.literal: "...I forgot that I need to go to the attic. I thought I'd never see that place again."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: When I'd thought up the loop to appear on November 24th, I'd imagined appearing with the Sekimeiya in a suitcase. The one in the security room was locked away, so I had to get the one on the attic's sofa.
entries.literal: "When I'd thought up the loop to appear on November 24th, I'd imagined appearing with the Sekimeiya in a suitcase. The one in the security room was locked away, so I had to get the one on the attic's sofa."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I left the watch behind so that it wouldn't cast any light and gradually ascended. Every floor was dark, and my steps echoed more loudly than I liked.
entries.literal: "I left the watch behind so that it wouldn't cast any light and gradually ascended. Every floor was dark, and my steps echoed more loudly than I liked."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Once I reached the highest door, I saw that the living room was empty.
entries.literal: "Once I reached the highest door, I saw that the living room was empty."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was leaving my footprints behind, but it didn't matter. Once I'd taken the suitcase, I dashed back, leaving that place for good.
entries.literal: "I was leaving my footprints behind, but it didn't matter. Once I'd taken the suitcase, I dashed back, leaving that place for good."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I took both Sekimeiya from the cold of the cabinet with my bare hands. The instant I activated them, I traveled the smallest fraction of time. Enough for it to have no real effect.
entries.literal: "I took both Sekimeiya from the cold of the cabinet with my bare hands. The instant I activated them, I traveled the smallest fraction of time. Enough for it to have no real effect."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With the suitcase in hand, I descended to the lobby and sat on the floor. Then, I put the Sekimeiya inside it and placed both of my hands on them.{w} I suddenly realized a key had fallen from my pocket before I'd even taken it out willingly...
entries.literal: "With the suitcase in hand, I descended to the lobby and sat on the floor. Then, I put the Sekimeiya inside it and placed both of my hands on them.{w} I suddenly realized a key had fallen from my pocket before I'd even taken it out willingly..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...That had been my plan before I'd gone to the 24th. I'd wanted to appear with the Sekimeiya, but for that, they had to be powered off in the future. It was very hard to calculate the exact second I needed to have them, so the position I was in was a good way to cover a longer stretch of time.
entries.literal: "...That had been my plan before I'd gone to the 24th. I'd wanted to appear with the Sekimeiya, but for that, they had to be powered off in the future. It was very hard to calculate the exact second I needed to have them, so the position I was in was a good way to cover a longer stretch of time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Every time a Sekimeiya powered on, my hands would immediately power it off, resulting in no effect whatsoever. Furthermore, they emitted no light, so nobody could see me in the dark.
entries.literal: "Every time a Sekimeiya powered on, my hands would immediately power it off, resulting in no effect whatsoever. Furthermore, they emitted no light, so nobody could see me in the dark."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: However, I had calculated enough... I only had to be there for ten more minutes.
entries.literal: "However, I had calculated enough... I only had to be there for ten more minutes."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: They were the last ten minutes I'd spend trapped in that place. The suitcase was on my lap, and both of my hands were planted firmly on the Sekimeiya's surfaces, too far apart to overlap their minuscule ranges.{w} ...It was the end. I knew I was in the position where I'd appeared on the 24th.
entries.literal: "They were the last ten minutes I'd spend trapped in that place. The suitcase was on my lap, and both of my hands were planted firmly on the Sekimeiya's surfaces, too far apart to overlap their minuscule ranges.{w} ...It was the end. I knew I was in the position where I'd appeared on the 24th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I couldn't check the time anymore; the watch was hidden behind the reception desk. Instead, I counted the seconds inside my head.
entries.literal: "I couldn't check the time anymore; the watch was hidden behind the reception desk. Instead, I counted the seconds inside my head."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: ...She's there right now. I'm sure.
entries.literal: "...She's there right now. I'm sure."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Time had passed. It hadn't frozen—it hadn't forbidden me from taking the final step.
entries.literal: "Time had passed. It hadn't frozen—it hadn't forbidden me from taking the final step."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I closed the suitcase and stood up, grabbing the fallen key. Before anything else, I went to retrieve Shiroya's watch.
entries.literal: "I closed the suitcase and stood up, grabbing the fallen key. Before anything else, I went to retrieve Shiroya's watch."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I opened the hallway A door. Each step I took toward the storeroom was more surreal than the last. I took out the rusty key and suddenly understood why I wouldn't have it on the 26th.
entries.literal: "I opened the hallway A door. Each step I took toward the storeroom was more surreal than the last. I took out the rusty key and suddenly understood why I wouldn't have it on the 26th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was there; I could feel the dusty couch, and the wall wasn't blocking my way.
entries.literal: "I was there; I could feel the dusty couch, and the wall wasn't blocking my way."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: With bated breath, I approached the final door—the one that could only be opened from the outside.
entries.literal: "With bated breath, I approached the final door—the one that could only be opened from the outside."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...And it was open.
entries.literal: "...And it was open."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki, you son of a bitch! Open the fucking door!
entries.literal: "Atsuki, you son of a bitch! Open the fucking door!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I know you just left! I heard you talking with Shiroya! You better come back right now!
entries.literal: "I know you just left! I heard you talking with Shiroya! You better come back right now!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki! Piece of shit!
entries.literal: "Atsuki! Piece of shit!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: I'll convince everyone this was all your doing if you don't open this fucking door!
entries.literal: "I'll convince everyone this was all your doing if you don't open this fucking door!"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: At least tell the police we're here! I'm fucking hungry, man!
entries.literal: "At least tell the police we're here! I'm fucking hungry, man!"

entries.speaker: ak
entries.text: ...I don't think he's coming.
entries.literal: "...I don't think he's coming."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Can you just shut up?
entries.literal: "Can you just shut up?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Atsuki! You think I won't tell them that you left with the Sekimeiya!? This is your last chance to come back!
entries.literal: "Atsuki! You think I won't tell them that you left with the Sekimeiya!? This is your last chance to come back!"

entries.speaker: saicenter
entries.text: "Atsuki!"{w=1.1}{nw}

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While in a tip, saving and search jumps are disabled.
entries.literal: "While in a tip, saving and search jumps are disabled."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: An orb is used when an inline tip is not viable.
entries.literal: "An orb is used when an inline tip is not viable."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This could be to explain the setting, the chapter name, and so on.
entries.literal: "This could be to explain the setting, the chapter name, and so on."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world B, Katei assures the group that the event room, hallway A, and hallway B are the only places where the smoke was released. Despite the confidence behind his words, he misses room A5.
entries.literal: "In world B, Katei assures the group that the event room, hallway A, and hallway B are the only places where the smoke was released. Despite the confidence behind his words, he misses room A5."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This doesn't happen in world C, as in that one, he had time to look through the crystal floor. In world B, though, after hearing a sound in room B4, Katei was forced to stay with Erina's group.
entries.literal: "This doesn't happen in world C, as in that one, he had time to look through the crystal floor. In world B, though, after hearing a sound in room B4, Katei was forced to stay with Erina's group."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The reason why he doesn't mention room A5 is something that happened when Xyn was crafting their plan.
entries.literal: "The reason why he doesn't mention room A5 is something that happened when Xyn was crafting their plan."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Finally, both subordinates understood how serious their boss was and broke into a sweat. As they took off and draped their heavy attire on the back of their chairs, they began to process each step of what they would be performing."
entries.literal: "\"Finally, both subordinates understood how serious their boss was and broke into a sweat. As they took off and draped their heavy attire on the back of their chairs, they began to process each step of what they would be performing.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Katei was listening to Xyn putting together their plan, Ido eventually took off and leaned against his coat. That prevented Katei from clearly listening to the final part of their plan: the gemstones to be used as a fake out.
entries.literal: "When Katei was listening to Xyn putting together their plan, Ido eventually took off and leaned against his coat. That prevented Katei from clearly listening to the final part of their plan: the gemstones to be used as a fake out."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Even though the first six floors of the tower were searched through, nobody was found. Not because there was nobody to find, though—Naomi A was in the building.
entries.literal: "Even though the first six floors of the tower were searched through, nobody was found. Not because there was nobody to find, though—Naomi A was in the building."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In addition, she didn't have the attic key, so even though the last floor wasn't inspected, nobody was there. Why wasn't she found?
entries.literal: "In addition, she didn't have the attic key, so even though the last floor wasn't inspected, nobody was there. Why wasn't she found?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: During the search, Sai heard the elevator three times. That was Akaro's doing, but there's still an unexplained mystery: the starting position of the elevator.{w} It should've been on floor 5. Akaro knew that, so that's where he sent it in the end. However, before he called it, it was below the third floor.
entries.literal: "During the search, Sai heard the elevator three times. That was Akaro's doing, but there's still an unexplained mystery: the starting position of the elevator.{w} It should've been on floor 5. Akaro knew that, so that's where he sent it in the end. However, before he called it, it was below the third floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi A was responsible for that. She was aware another self of hers had been murdered, and she wanted to easily escape if she had to. She called it when everyone was on the crystal floor, and soon after that, she accidentally made a noise while trying to understand what the others were doing in the event room.
entries.literal: "Naomi A was responsible for that. She was aware another self of hers had been murdered, and she wanted to easily escape if she had to. She called it when everyone was on the crystal floor, and soon after that, she accidentally made a noise while trying to understand what the others were doing in the event room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That caused a search on the crystal floor, which Naomi A escaped by using the elevator so that she wouldn't be seen on the stairs. The elevator isn't very fast, so she took it to the second floor, where she waited to see if she'd be followed.
entries.literal: "That caused a search on the crystal floor, which Naomi A escaped by using the elevator so that she wouldn't be seen on the stairs. The elevator isn't very fast, so she took it to the second floor, where she waited to see if she'd be followed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Not long after that, the group went up to inspect the whole building, and they all stayed on different floors. Unable to access the attic, Naomi was cornered.
entries.literal: "Not long after that, the group went up to inspect the whole building, and they all stayed on different floors. Unable to access the attic, Naomi was cornered."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She went up a floor every time someone else did. When she saw Akaro staying on the fourth, she stopped. She had seen him gone from the event room when she'd awakened, and she didn't think he had killed her other self. Most importantly, Naomi realized that if she kept going up, she could end up stuck on Katei's floor, and she suspected him of her own murder.
entries.literal: "She went up a floor every time someone else did. When she saw Akaro staying on the fourth, she stopped. She had seen him gone from the event room when she'd awakened, and she didn't think he had killed her other self. Most importantly, Naomi realized that if she kept going up, she could end up stuck on Katei's floor, and she suspected him of her own murder."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Ready to be found by Akaro, Naomi stayed in the partitions of the fourth floor. However, he never came.
entries.literal: "Ready to be found by Akaro, Naomi stayed in the partitions of the fourth floor. However, he never came."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Sai travels to the past, he appears with the Future Sekimeiya in his hip pack. While unaware of this, he hides the fake Sekimeiya from the event room.
entries.literal: "When Sai travels to the past, he appears with the Future Sekimeiya in his hip pack. While unaware of this, he hides the fake Sekimeiya from the event room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later, once he slips away from Atsuki, he proceeds to hide the Future and Past Sekimeiya. Even later, he obtains the Future Sekimeiya from the cleaning room and puts it in his hip pack.
entries.literal: "Later, once he slips away from Atsuki, he proceeds to hide the Future and Past Sekimeiya. Even later, he obtains the Future Sekimeiya from the cleaning room and puts it in his hip pack."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That is the reason why he had appeared with it before, but if you follow his movements, you will notice that something is odd: Sai got the Future Sekimeiya from the cleaning room because he had appeared with it earlier and had hidden it there. However, he had appeared with it because he would have it in the future, which would only be possible because he had appeared with it.
entries.literal: "That is the reason why he had appeared with it before, but if you follow his movements, you will notice that something is odd: Sai got the Future Sekimeiya from the cleaning room because he had appeared with it earlier and had hidden it there. However, he had appeared with it because he would have it in the future, which would only be possible because he had appeared with it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...Where exactly does this start? When does the Future Sekimeiya enter this cycle?
entries.literal: "...Where exactly does this start? When does the Future Sekimeiya enter this cycle?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There are a handful of similar riddles left to be uncovered, and the answer is often different for each individual case.
entries.literal: "There are a handful of similar riddles left to be uncovered, and the answer is often different for each individual case."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Sai left the attic after Atsuki and Shiroya, he had a plan in mind. He traveled to the past from room B3 and appeared with the Future Sekimeiya on his person. However, due to what his plan entailed, he would've had the Future Sekimeiya in the future if it hadn't appeared in his hip pack.
entries.literal: "When Sai left the attic after Atsuki and Shiroya, he had a plan in mind. He traveled to the past from room B3 and appeared with the Future Sekimeiya on his person. However, due to what his plan entailed, he would've had the Future Sekimeiya in the future if it hadn't appeared in his hip pack."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Every time Sai travels to the past, the date of his watch changes to "9999-12-31", and its screen turns blank. This behavior will be one of the toughest questions Atsuki will face.
entries.literal: "Every time Sai travels to the past, the date of his watch changes to \"9999-12-31\", and its screen turns blank. This behavior will be one of the toughest questions Atsuki will face."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It seems to contradict the Sekimeiya's mechanics: infinite loops are needed to max out the watch's clock, yet the physical state of the watch doesn't deteriorate. This also happens with other devices such as the voice recorder and the digital clock in Eagle Motel.
entries.literal: "It seems to contradict the Sekimeiya's mechanics: infinite loops are needed to max out the watch's clock, yet the physical state of the watch doesn't deteriorate. This also happens with other devices such as the voice recorder and the digital clock in Eagle Motel."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What's the reason behind it? Unfortunately, Atsuki didn't come close to the right answer, as it's related to something he never considered.
entries.literal: "What's the reason behind it? Unfortunately, Atsuki didn't come close to the right answer, as it's related to something he never considered."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What Shiroya saw next to the Future Sekimeiya were smoke grenades. Not only the one Akaro had left there initially, but all of them.
entries.literal: "What Shiroya saw next to the Future Sekimeiya were smoke grenades. Not only the one Akaro had left there initially, but all of them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: To conceal evidence, Akaro later brought the handful of grenades to the cleaning cart, and the moment that Shiroya made it disappear, they disappeared as well.
entries.literal: "To conceal evidence, Akaro later brought the handful of grenades to the cleaning cart, and the moment that Shiroya made it disappear, they disappeared as well."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You might be wondering what happened in world C, where the cart never disappeared but no grenades were found.
entries.literal: "You might be wondering what happened in world C, where the cart never disappeared but no grenades were found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In that world, Akaro also had the chance to put all the grenades in the cart. Then, they were never found, the same way Ido's set of keys wasn't found.
entries.literal: "In that world, Akaro also had the chance to put all the grenades in the cart. Then, they were never found, the same way Ido's set of keys wasn't found."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the lower bedroom, Sai had an idea about how he could escape the locked room they had set up. He only needed Katei to be distracted for an instant—he didn't want him to leave.
entries.literal: "In the lower bedroom, Sai had an idea about how he could escape the locked room they had set up. He only needed Katei to be distracted for an instant—he didn't want him to leave."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai told him that Atsuki had been threatening them. At first, Katei didn't believe a word of it.{w} However, Akaro quickly realized that Sai might've needed his assistance: Sai was claiming that Akaro had been threatened as well, and he could easily deny it.
entries.literal: "Sai told him that Atsuki had been threatening them. At first, Katei didn't believe a word of it.{w} However, Akaro quickly realized that Sai might've needed his assistance: Sai was claiming that Akaro had been threatened as well, and he could easily deny it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Akaro confirmed it, Katei's look changed.{w} He didn't believe it. He'd seen Akaro's first reaction; they were lying. Most importantly, Akaro was claiming that Atsuki had been behind the attack, and Katei knew who Akaro was.{w} ...Why? Did both of them suspect that Katei was behind Isla's death? Perhaps they wanted to see whether he could accept another version of events—if he denied it without considering it, he might've given himself away.
entries.literal: "When Akaro confirmed it, Katei's look changed.{w} He didn't believe it. He'd seen Akaro's first reaction; they were lying. Most importantly, Akaro was claiming that Atsuki had been behind the attack, and Katei knew who Akaro was.{w} ...Why? Did both of them suspect that Katei was behind Isla's death? Perhaps they wanted to see whether he could accept another version of events—if he denied it without considering it, he might've given himself away."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei yelled Atsuki's name as he climbed up, unaware that the door of the bedroom was opening while his shouts concealed the sound.
entries.literal: "Katei yelled Atsuki's name as he climbed up, unaware that the door of the bedroom was opening while his shouts concealed the sound."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Where did Sai's knife come from?{w} Originally, it belonged to Suripo.
entries.literal: "Where did Sai's knife come from?{w} Originally, it belonged to Suripo."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After his death in world C, Akaro heard a sound coming from hallway A: it was Katei, who had appeared in the security room.
entries.literal: "After his death in world C, Akaro heard a sound coming from hallway A: it was Katei, who had appeared in the security room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro entered the hallway and prevented him from seeing the scene in the lobby. However, he hadn't had enough time to get rid of the knife, which he had under his shirt.
entries.literal: "Akaro entered the hallway and prevented him from seeing the scene in the lobby. However, he hadn't had enough time to get rid of the knife, which he had under his shirt."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later, when the group world switched to world A, Akaro finally had the chance to leave it behind after removing his fingerprints. It was there where Sai found it, after Shiroya pulled him to that world. Soon afterward, Sai returned to world B by world switching alone.
entries.literal: "Later, when the group world switched to world A, Akaro finally had the chance to leave it behind after removing his fingerprints. It was there where Sai found it, after Shiroya pulled him to that world. Soon afterward, Sai returned to world B by world switching alone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The knife eventually ended up in Shiroya B's hands, but it vanished from existence when she traveled to December 30th with it in her purse.
entries.literal: "The knife eventually ended up in Shiroya B's hands, but it vanished from existence when she traveled to December 30th with it in her purse."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki is able to find the right bedroom's key in the drawer, so had Sai failed to grab it? Had Sai ignored the fact that they could've locked themselves inside that room?
entries.literal: "Atsuki is able to find the right bedroom's key in the drawer, so had Sai failed to grab it? Had Sai ignored the fact that they could've locked themselves inside that room?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai thought he was still chasing Atsuki A, who had punched him in the face. The moment Atsuki A had run away, Sai had taken both bedroom keys to prevent him from staying inside one.
entries.literal: "Sai thought he was still chasing Atsuki A, who had punched him in the face. The moment Atsuki A had run away, Sai had taken both bedroom keys to prevent him from staying inside one."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the chase shifted to world B, Sai was unaware the world around him had changed. He entered the attic with the attic key from world A, and he didn't take the bedroom keys because he thought he had already taken them.
entries.literal: "When the chase shifted to world B, Sai was unaware the world around him had changed. He entered the attic with the attic key from world A, and he didn't take the bedroom keys because he thought he had already taken them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later, when he and Shiroya traveled to the attic's bedroom, Sai appeared with both bedroom keys, and they were still the ones from world A.
entries.literal: "Later, when he and Shiroya traveled to the attic's bedroom, Sai appeared with both bedroom keys, and they were still the ones from world A."

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: By the way, you never reattached the chain, right?
entries.literal: "By the way, you never reattached the chain, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: The chain? What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "The chain? What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: sai
entries.text: Nothing.
entries.literal: "Nothing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai had detached the bedroom chains in world A to prevent Atsuki from hiding in one, so that was further confirmation that the world around him had changed.
entries.literal: "Sai had detached the bedroom chains in world A to prevent Atsuki from hiding in one, so that was further confirmation that the world around him had changed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Sai delivers a fatal blow to Shiroya, he stares at her fallen corpse. Something doesn't seem to make sense from his point of view.
entries.literal: "When Sai delivers a fatal blow to Shiroya, he stares at her fallen corpse. Something doesn't seem to make sense from his point of view."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He had already stated it as fact before—Shiroya would die. He had seen her corpse in world A, so he was certain that death was her inevitable fate.
entries.literal: "He had already stated it as fact before—Shiroya would die. He had seen her corpse in world A, so he was certain that death was her inevitable fate."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The reason behind Sai's sudden confusion lies behind Shiroya's cause of death. When he saw her corpse in the lobby, he didn't see any physical wound. However, he'd just sliced the knife across her chest.
entries.literal: "The reason behind Sai's sudden confusion lies behind Shiroya's cause of death. When he saw her corpse in the lobby, he didn't see any physical wound. However, he'd just sliced the knife across her chest."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That causes Sai's momentary puzzlement, but he is able to instantly shrug it off and move on to his second victim.
entries.literal: "That causes Sai's momentary puzzlement, but he is able to instantly shrug it off and move on to his second victim."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai couldn't explain his recent experiences, but he was sure that something had happened to the world. The Atsuki who had punched him wasn't the same one he was speaking with, and the green lights on the cameras indicated that the state of the world was changing.
entries.literal: "Sai couldn't explain his recent experiences, but he was sure that something had happened to the world. The Atsuki who had punched him wasn't the same one he was speaking with, and the green lights on the cameras indicated that the state of the world was changing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He recognized that the Atsuki in front of him was the same person he'd been with since that morning, and by hearing what he said, Sai began to slightly comprehend what had happened.
entries.literal: "He recognized that the Atsuki in front of him was the same person he'd been with since that morning, and by hearing what he said, Sai began to slightly comprehend what had happened."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The first time the world had changed had been when both Sekimeiya had disappeared in room B6. Curious, Sai asked if that was where Atsuki and Shiroya had found the Sekimeiya, and upon having that confirmed, he learned something important.{w} Both Sekimeiya had been left behind there, and Atsuki and Shiroya had activated the one outside the drawer. That told Sai not only that they had gone to the future, but that when they had returned, someone had taken it.
entries.literal: "The first time the world had changed had been when both Sekimeiya had disappeared in room B6. Curious, Sai asked if that was where Atsuki and Shiroya had found the Sekimeiya, and upon having that confirmed, he learned something important.{w} Both Sekimeiya had been left behind there, and Atsuki and Shiroya had activated the one outside the drawer. That told Sai not only that they had gone to the future, but that when they had returned, someone had taken it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, they thought that the Sekimeiya had teleported to the drawer, when in truth, that one had also been there all along. Sai knew that the Sekimeiya in the event room was the past one and that he needed to use it in order to put together a plan he quickly came up with to take advantage of Atsuki's and Shiroya's story.
entries.literal: "However, they thought that the Sekimeiya had teleported to the drawer, when in truth, that one had also been there all along. Sai knew that the Sekimeiya in the event room was the past one and that he needed to use it in order to put together a plan he quickly came up with to take advantage of Atsuki's and Shiroya's story."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai is referring to the forum thread that Vaisude had posted in November. Back then, Sai had replied to it in a frivolous way, but it didn't take long for the Sekimeiya event to be announced. By the time that happened, the thread had already been locked.
entries.literal: "Sai is referring to the forum thread that Vaisude had posted in November. Back then, Sai had replied to it in a frivolous way, but it didn't take long for the Sekimeiya event to be announced. By the time that happened, the thread had already been locked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something was going to happen on December 15th—Sai knew that, and as proven by worlds A and C, he would've gone to the event even if he hadn't read that forum thread.
entries.literal: "Something was going to happen on December 15th—Sai knew that, and as proven by worlds A and C, he would've gone to the event even if he hadn't read that forum thread."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, in world B, the possibility of time travel was in his mind since the start. The moment that Atsuki traveled to the past, two things were confirmed to Sai.
entries.literal: "However, in world B, the possibility of time travel was in his mind since the start. The moment that Atsuki traveled to the past, two things were confirmed to Sai."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One: at one point during the day, a very large travel would occur. He had to be careful if he didn't want to be sent to November 24th, and he knew that traveling so far to the past would be possible.
entries.literal: "One: at one point during the day, a very large travel would occur. He had to be careful if he didn't want to be sent to November 24th, and he knew that traveling so far to the past would be possible."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two: the forum poster was somewhere around them. During the twelve hours in the tower, Sai kept wondering who "7md_ag" could be.
entries.literal: "Two: the forum poster was somewhere around them. During the twelve hours in the tower, Sai kept wondering who \"7md_ag\" could be."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At {time=10:04}, Katei had disabled the camera in room B4. He'd hidden both Sekimeiya there, so alongside removing the incriminating footage, he'd surreptitiously shut that camera down so that he could retrieve them later.
entries.literal: "At {time=10:04}, Katei had disabled the camera in room B4. He'd hidden both Sekimeiya there, so alongside removing the incriminating footage, he'd surreptitiously shut that camera down so that he could retrieve them later."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Atsuki and Shiroya found Katei's corpse, a message was on the computer: {time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki and Shiroya found Katei's corpse, a message was on the computer: {time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It had been there since Erina had attempted to display the footage from room B4. In other words, the message was only addressing that particular camera—none of the others had been disabled, as shown by the presence of the green lights.
entries.literal: "It had been there since Erina had attempted to display the footage from room B4. In other words, the message was only addressing that particular camera—none of the others had been disabled, as shown by the presence of the green lights."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki double-clicked on the camera selected on the list: "RECAM_12_01". It was the one Erina had attempted to display, so he was met with the same error.
entries.literal: "Atsuki double-clicked on the camera selected on the list: \"RECAM_12_01\". It was the one Erina had attempted to display, so he was met with the same error."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya noticed something when she world switched to world B. The camera in room B4 didn't have a green light, while all the others did.
entries.literal: "Miiya noticed something when she world switched to world B. The camera in room B4 didn't have a green light, while all the others did."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When worlds C and B meet, neither of their perspectives makes sense to the other. If you recall everything that happened in world C, you will understand the meaning behind all of Sai's and Akaro's words.
entries.literal: "When worlds C and B meet, neither of their perspectives makes sense to the other. If you recall everything that happened in world C, you will understand the meaning behind all of Sai's and Akaro's words."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before them, the two bodies that had vanished reappeared: Shiroya and a bloody Erina. In addition, they thought Shiroya had died weeks in the past.
entries.literal: "Before them, the two bodies that had vanished reappeared: Shiroya and a bloody Erina. In addition, they thought Shiroya had died weeks in the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Given the blood on Erina's clothes, what Sai and Akaro instantly assumed was that she was the body that had disappeared from next to the crystal floor stairs.
entries.literal: "Given the blood on Erina's clothes, what Sai and Akaro instantly assumed was that she was the body that had disappeared from next to the crystal floor stairs."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Well, you're not dead after all, but we felt your pulse..."
entries.literal: "\"Well, you're not dead after all, but we felt your pulse...\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And according to Erina, she didn't remember what had happened before she'd been attacked. Even though she was talking about a different attack, that led to Sai's strange statement: "Not even you have been here since {time=9}!"
entries.literal: "And according to Erina, she didn't remember what had happened before she'd been attacked. Even though she was talking about a different attack, that led to Sai's strange statement: \"Not even you have been here since {time=9}!\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Of course, Erina and Isla have been here the whole time, but not you." She was not thought to be the same Erina who'd been with them since the morning, as the way she'd come into existence was still a mystery to them.
entries.literal: "\"Of course, Erina and Isla have been here the whole time, but not you.\" She was not thought to be the same Erina who'd been with them since the morning, as the way she'd come into existence was still a mystery to them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Atsuki dashes out of the elevator, his eyes are closed due to the intense pain. That prevents him from seeing the trail of his own blood going from the storeroom toward the stairs.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki dashes out of the elevator, his eyes are closed due to the intense pain. That prevents him from seeing the trail of his own blood going from the storeroom toward the stairs."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later, that helps him mistakenly believe that he altered history, as he never saw a result of his actions after deciding to try to change the past.
entries.literal: "Later, that helps him mistakenly believe that he altered history, as he never saw a result of his actions after deciding to try to change the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki finds the event room to be cold—the glass of the cabinet isn't properly shut.
entries.literal: "Atsuki finds the event room to be cold—the glass of the cabinet isn't properly shut."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It had been open since Erina had taken the Future Sekimeiya out before world switching to world C. After the group's departure, the Sekimeiya fell to the floor, and the glass was not closed.
entries.literal: "It had been open since Erina had taken the Future Sekimeiya out before world switching to world C. After the group's departure, the Sekimeiya fell to the floor, and the glass was not closed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two people entered the event room before Atsuki's return: Sai and Atsuki A.
entries.literal: "Two people entered the event room before Atsuki's return: Sai and Atsuki A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Both of them noticed the cold, but neither of them closed the cabinet. Atsuki A touched the Future Sekimeiya and world switched to world C. Sai, who had locked Shiroya inside a bedroom a second time, arrived after Atsuki's vanishing and took the Sekimeiya from the floor, hiding it in the women's bathroom.
entries.literal: "Both of them noticed the cold, but neither of them closed the cabinet. Atsuki A touched the Future Sekimeiya and world switched to world C. Sai, who had locked Shiroya inside a bedroom a second time, arrived after Atsuki's vanishing and took the Sekimeiya from the floor, hiding it in the women's bathroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The smell released by the Sekimeiya as it gathered energy was often perceived in Ashiya Tower. It became the building's scent, and everyone grew used to it subconsciously.
entries.literal: "The smell released by the Sekimeiya as it gathered energy was often perceived in Ashiya Tower. It became the building's scent, and everyone grew used to it subconsciously."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, numerous times, the intensity of the smell seemed to increase. Why did this occur?
entries.literal: "However, numerous times, the intensity of the smell seemed to increase. Why did this occur?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If the group spent hours in the attic, upon walking down to the crystal floor, if one of the Sekimeiya had been gathering energy there, the smell would seem more prominent.{w} But that's not all. Noticing the smell often indicated something else.{w} A world switch.
entries.literal: "If the group spent hours in the attic, upon walking down to the crystal floor, if one of the Sekimeiya had been gathering energy there, the smell would seem more prominent.{w} But that's not all. Noticing the smell often indicated something else.{w} A world switch."

entries.speaker: c
