entries.text: When Atsuki and Erina were in world C, both real Sekimeiya were in the attic, so after returning to world B, Atsuki sensed that the smell was strangely strong.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki and Erina were in world C, both real Sekimeiya were in the attic, so after returning to world B, Atsuki sensed that the smell was strangely strong."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Atsuki travels to the past, he notices that blood has stopped coming out of his injury. Additionally, he feels very tired.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki travels to the past, he notices that blood has stopped coming out of his injury. Additionally, he feels very tired."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The relation between those results is direct: the body he appeared in had lost a lot of blood.
entries.literal: "The relation between those results is direct: the body he appeared in had lost a lot of blood."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, he never actually bled all that blood, so why did he appear in a body that had lost it?
entries.literal: "However, he never actually bled all that blood, so why did he appear in a body that had lost it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Not only that, but the injury was still there, so why was no more blood coming out of it?
entries.literal: "Not only that, but the injury was still there, so why was no more blood coming out of it?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before the time he will reach the replicated location in the future, Atsuki will rush to the crystal floor stairs and reopen his wound. To keep blood from flowing, he will bandage his hand with toilet paper.
entries.literal: "Before the time he will reach the replicated location in the future, Atsuki will rush to the crystal floor stairs and reopen his wound. To keep blood from flowing, he will bandage his hand with toilet paper."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That might help you answer the second question, but what about the first? When was all that blood lost? There's still a bit of time for you to find that answer.
entries.literal: "That might help you answer the second question, but what about the first? When was all that blood lost? There's still a bit of time for you to find that answer."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai claims to have heard Atsuki's door slam, but that is not the truth. When Atsuki made that noise, Sai was in the process of traveling to the future; Erina's world switch brought him back to the attic's bedroom, where Shiroya had been trapped.
entries.literal: "Sai claims to have heard Atsuki's door slam, but that is not the truth. When Atsuki made that noise, Sai was in the process of traveling to the future; Erina's world switch brought him back to the attic's bedroom, where Shiroya had been trapped."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why did he say that he had heard it, then?{w} He thought that Atsuki was testing him.
entries.literal: "Why did he say that he had heard it, then?{w} He thought that Atsuki was testing him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He thought that the intent behind that question was to figure out whether he had traveled to the future and whether such a thing was possible. To prevent Atsuki from learning the truth, he claimed to have heard a sound he could only have heard if he'd traveled to the past.
entries.literal: "He thought that the intent behind that question was to figure out whether he had traveled to the future and whether such a thing was possible. To prevent Atsuki from learning the truth, he claimed to have heard a sound he could only have heard if he'd traveled to the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina's mood seems to have changed since Atsuki left...
entries.literal: "Erina's mood seems to have changed since Atsuki left..."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When she made Atsuki and Shiroya world switch, to them, it seemed as if the Sekimeiya teleported to its cabinet—a Sekimeiya was there in world C.
entries.literal: "When she made Atsuki and Shiroya world switch, to them, it seemed as if the Sekimeiya teleported to its cabinet—a Sekimeiya was there in world C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was the fake Sekimeiya that the people of that world had left there before Miiya went to sleep in the attic. However, you might've noticed something strange.
entries.literal: "It was the fake Sekimeiya that the people of that world had left there before Miiya went to sleep in the attic. However, you might've noticed something strange."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later in that world, when Atsuki and Miiya went down after waiting on the second floor, the cabinet in the event room was empty. ...Who took the fake Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "Later in that world, when Atsuki and Miiya went down after waiting on the second floor, the cabinet in the event room was empty. ...Who took the fake Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Very few people would've had the chance, and it was Erina B who did. When her group arrived in world C, Atsuki went to the staff room to check if the Sekimeiya had disappeared from Ido's locker. He was followed by Shiroya, which gave Erina the perfect opportunity to silently take the fake Sekimeiya from the unlocked cabinet and put it in her purse.
entries.literal: "Very few people would've had the chance, and it was Erina B who did. When her group arrived in world C, Atsuki went to the staff room to check if the Sekimeiya had disappeared from Ido's locker. He was followed by Shiroya, which gave Erina the perfect opportunity to silently take the fake Sekimeiya from the unlocked cabinet and put it in her purse."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She still wanted to travel to the past, so she calmly waited with the others while she thought that the Sekimeiya she had was gathering energy.
entries.literal: "She still wanted to travel to the past, so she calmly waited with the others while she thought that the Sekimeiya she had was gathering energy."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When she and Atsuki stopped on the third floor and returned to world B, Atsuki took the elevator down, and a future self of his appeared from the partitions, claiming to have traveled to the past and stopped the wound's bleeding.{w} "Wait... What? There's no way." Erina couldn't help but react that way, as she had the Sekimeiya in her purse.
entries.literal: "When she and Atsuki stopped on the third floor and returned to world B, Atsuki took the elevator down, and a future self of his appeared from the partitions, claiming to have traveled to the past and stopped the wound's bleeding.{w} \"Wait... What? There's no way.\" Erina couldn't help but react that way, as she had the Sekimeiya in her purse."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The moment Atsuki left her alone next to the elevator, she reached inside her purse and attempted to travel through time. The Sekimeiya was there, but of course, nothing happened. That disappointment caused Erina's unresponsiveness when Atsuki returned with Sai.
entries.literal: "The moment Atsuki left her alone next to the elevator, she reached inside her purse and attempted to travel through time. The Sekimeiya was there, but of course, nothing happened. That disappointment caused Erina's unresponsiveness when Atsuki returned with Sai."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This also erased the fake Sekimeiya in world C and led to the existence of two in world B. Erina soon got rid of hers, but the one that Akaro A had hidden was still in the building, and it was the one that the police found at {time=21.}
entries.literal: "This also erased the fake Sekimeiya in world C and led to the existence of two in world B. Erina soon got rid of hers, but the one that Akaro A had hidden was still in the building, and it was the one that the police found at {time=21.}"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya feels as if she recognizes the smell in the gem shop, yet she isn't able to determine what it is... What exactly was in the air?
entries.literal: "Miiya feels as if she recognizes the smell in the gem shop, yet she isn't able to determine what it is... What exactly was in the air?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The answer is that two different smells were blending together—the smell of gas and the Sekimeiya's scent.{w} Miiya partly recognized the gas in the air, but due to the Sekimeiya's alien smell, she wasn't able to realize what it was.
entries.literal: "The answer is that two different smells were blending together—the smell of gas and the Sekimeiya's scent.{w} Miiya partly recognized the gas in the air, but due to the Sekimeiya's alien smell, she wasn't able to realize what it was."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On December 15th, Miiya and Shiroya were exposed to the Sekimeiya's smell once again, and they almost felt as if they'd smelled it once before.
entries.literal: "On December 15th, Miiya and Shiroya were exposed to the Sekimeiya's smell once again, and they almost felt as if they'd smelled it once before."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Eden is a perfect world that was given to Adam and Eve. In this world, everyone who was trapped in the tower survived, and Shiroya, who was thought to have died, reappeared on her birthday.
entries.literal: "Eden is a perfect world that was given to Adam and Eve. In this world, everyone who was trapped in the tower survived, and Shiroya, who was thought to have died, reappeared on her birthday."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It's a world that was given to Atsuki and Miiya, and just like Eden, it might look perfect at first glance; it's exactly what Atsuki and Shiroya wanted in world B.
entries.literal: "It's a world that was given to Atsuki and Miiya, and just like Eden, it might look perfect at first glance; it's exactly what Atsuki and Shiroya wanted in world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...But that is far from the case. Eden is a world doomed to fail.{w} Not only that, but it is a single step away from disaster. It only requires the forbidden fruit.
entries.literal: "...But that is far from the case. Eden is a world doomed to fail.{w} Not only that, but it is a single step away from disaster. It only requires the forbidden fruit."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The way Akaro initially portrays himself is quite different in worlds B and C. In world B, he hurries Naomi to unlock the cabinet.
entries.literal: "The way Akaro initially portrays himself is quite different in worlds B and C. In world B, he hurries Naomi to unlock the cabinet."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "We know, and don't need this introduction, so let's move along. You've been praising this find of yours in every advertisement. Let's see how your claims hold up."
entries.literal: "\"We know, and don't need this introduction, so let's move along. You've been praising this find of yours in every advertisement. Let's see how your claims hold up.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world C, however, he does the opposite. He stops Naomi to buy time.
entries.literal: "In world C, however, he does the opposite. He stops Naomi to buy time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The reason is the same in both cases: the smoke bombs were timed to go off very soon. In world B, he didn't want them to go off before the cabinet unlocked, while in world C, he didn't want them to go off after the cabinet opened so that there was no staining on the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "The reason is the same in both cases: the smoke bombs were timed to go off very soon. In world B, he didn't want them to go off before the cabinet unlocked, while in world C, he didn't want them to go off after the cabinet opened so that there was no staining on the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What causes the time difference between both worlds is the talk Atsuki and Shiroya have in hallway B before entering the event room. As such a thing doesn't occur in world C, Akaro is forced to take action, and after proving himself knowledgeable about Ashiya, he maintains that image, telling the group about Xyn as soon as they regain consciousness.
entries.literal: "What causes the time difference between both worlds is the talk Atsuki and Shiroya have in hallway B before entering the event room. As such a thing doesn't occur in world C, Akaro is forced to take action, and after proving himself knowledgeable about Ashiya, he maintains that image, telling the group about Xyn as soon as they regain consciousness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Katei questions out loud if Atsuki could've been the one to power off the computer. Once the conversation ends, he will talk to Miiya privately and tell her that Atsuki is lying to her. A bit later, even Sai will say something similar.
entries.literal: "Katei questions out loud if Atsuki could've been the one to power off the computer. Once the conversation ends, he will talk to Miiya privately and tell her that Atsuki is lying to her. A bit later, even Sai will say something similar."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In both cases, the answer relies on Atsuki B, who was also in the building. You might recall that he thought Katei must have seen him when he crossed through floor 2 holding the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "In both cases, the answer relies on Atsuki B, who was also in the building. You might recall that he thought Katei must have seen him when he crossed through floor 2 holding the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Aware of the Sekimeiya's powers, Katei could understand that his sighting of Atsuki was related to it. That's why he attempts to push the narrative that Atsuki was behind the computer's shutdown, certain that he was the one to take the fake Sekimeiya from the event room.
entries.literal: "Aware of the Sekimeiya's powers, Katei could understand that his sighting of Atsuki was related to it. That's why he attempts to push the narrative that Atsuki was behind the computer's shutdown, certain that he was the one to take the fake Sekimeiya from the event room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya doesn't notice that the Atsuki she's talking to is a different person than moments prior in the security room. Atsuki C had traveled to the future with Sai, and before his return, Atsuki B had occupied his place.
entries.literal: "Miiya doesn't notice that the Atsuki she's talking to is a different person than moments prior in the security room. Atsuki C had traveled to the future with Sai, and before his return, Atsuki B had occupied his place."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Some time after Sai and Atsuki C had appeared in the future, Sai had noticed that the elevator was open. Once he shut its door, it immediately ascended, as Atsuki had called it while trapped inside the attic.
entries.literal: "Some time after Sai and Atsuki C had appeared in the future, Sai had noticed that the elevator was open. Once he shut its door, it immediately ascended, as Atsuki had called it while trapped inside the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai and Atsuki met, but neither of them said that they had traveled through time. When Atsuki saw the time on Sai's watch, the idea that he had traveled to the past was reinforced: before traveling, Sai had disappeared to check if the Sekimeiya he'd hidden in the storeroom had powers as well, so it made sense to find him separated from the group in the past. For Sai, it meant that he had traveled alongside Atsuki when he'd been going back to the event room; he learned that more than one person could travel at once.
entries.literal: "Sai and Atsuki met, but neither of them said that they had traveled through time. When Atsuki saw the time on Sai's watch, the idea that he had traveled to the past was reinforced: before traveling, Sai had disappeared to check if the Sekimeiya he'd hidden in the storeroom had powers as well, so it made sense to find him separated from the group in the past. For Sai, it meant that he had traveled alongside Atsuki when he'd been going back to the event room; he learned that more than one person could travel at once."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When they returned to the security room, both of them believed that they had been gone for mere minutes, and they were not aware that an Atsuki had been with the group since their departure. That's why numerous things that Atsuki C says conflict with what Atsuki B did.
entries.literal: "When they returned to the security room, both of them believed that they had been gone for mere minutes, and they were not aware that an Atsuki had been with the group since their departure. That's why numerous things that Atsuki C says conflict with what Atsuki B did."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki B estimated that Atsuki C had traveled twenty minutes through time, but that wasn't that accurate. When Atsuki C gave his version, he said he traveled "a few minutes" to the past, aware that it couldn't have been as many as twenty because the attic had been locked.
entries.literal: "Atsuki B estimated that Atsuki C had traveled twenty minutes through time, but that wasn't that accurate. When Atsuki C gave his version, he said he traveled \"a few minutes\" to the past, aware that it couldn't have been as many as twenty because the attic had been locked."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Oh, yeah, it was earlier. Sai used it." Unaware that they'd talked about the elevator in the security room, Atsuki C affirms that Sai closed it—it's no speculation.
entries.literal: "\"Oh, yeah, it was earlier. Sai used it.\" Unaware that they'd talked about the elevator in the security room, Atsuki C affirms that Sai closed it—it's no speculation."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Later on, Miiya and Atsuki C will be in the mechanical room, and a similar situation will arise with neither of them noticing; Atsuki C doesn't know the theory that Atsuki B brought up regarding the Sekimeiya's power storage and will hear it for the first time from Miiya.
entries.literal: "Later on, Miiya and Atsuki C will be in the mechanical room, and a similar situation will arise with neither of them noticing; Atsuki C doesn't know the theory that Atsuki B brought up regarding the Sekimeiya's power storage and will hear it for the first time from Miiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "We don't know how long it's been here for, so it might not be a good idea."
entries.literal: "\"We don't know how long it's been here for, so it might not be a good idea.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "What do you mean?"
entries.literal: "\"What do you mean?\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Well, if the time you travel depends on how long it spends out of the cabinet, you could go really far back."
entries.literal: "\"Well, if the time you travel depends on how long it spends out of the cabinet, you could go really far back.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Oh... Hm, I see."
entries.literal: "\"Oh... Hm, I see.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai raises a good point: how is Katei able to know that he was missing for three hours?
entries.literal: "Sai raises a good point: how is Katei able to know that he was missing for three hours?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Even though Sai accuses him of having left the building, the truth is that he had traveled to the future with Suripo. That doesn't answer the question, though. How is he able to tell how long he's been absent for?
entries.literal: "Even though Sai accuses him of having left the building, the truth is that he had traveled to the future with Suripo. That doesn't answer the question, though. How is he able to tell how long he's been absent for?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The past location that was replicated was from the time Suripo was in the lobby. At that time, Katei was in the security room, so that's where he appeared.
entries.literal: "The past location that was replicated was from the time Suripo was in the lobby. At that time, Katei was in the security room, so that's where he appeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What he immediately saw was the BIOS screen that Atsuki and Miiya had left behind, which displayed the current time and revealed to him that he had traveled to the future.
entries.literal: "What he immediately saw was the BIOS screen that Atsuki and Miiya had left behind, which displayed the current time and revealed to him that he had traveled to the future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The reason why Akaro takes the walkie-talkie is not to try to repair it. What he wants is to justify the fingerprints that the police would have found on its surface.
entries.literal: "The reason why Akaro takes the walkie-talkie is not to try to repair it. What he wants is to justify the fingerprints that the police would have found on its surface."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something similar happened in world B, although it was Katei who thought of it.
entries.literal: "Something similar happened in world B, although it was Katei who thought of it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before Naomi A's body was found, he brought the suitcase from hallway C to the security room; he realized that he hadn't touched it when they'd found it, so he wanted everyone to see him touching it and leaving fingerprints.
entries.literal: "Before Naomi A's body was found, he brought the suitcase from hallway C to the security room; he realized that he hadn't touched it when they'd found it, so he wanted everyone to see him touching it and leaving fingerprints."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why does Isla call Miiya "Tanya"? Wasn't that Shiroya's nickname?
entries.literal: "Why does Isla call Miiya \"Tanya\"? Wasn't that Shiroya's nickname?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On November 30th, Atsuki bought both girls matching pendants. Even though they weren't real tanzanite, they were a convincing fake.
entries.literal: "On November 30th, Atsuki bought both girls matching pendants. Even though they weren't real tanzanite, they were a convincing fake."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya and Shiroya were wearing the pendant in their respective worlds, so Isla came up with the nickname "Tanya" for both of them.
entries.literal: "Miiya and Shiroya were wearing the pendant in their respective worlds, so Isla came up with the nickname \"Tanya\" for both of them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In room A1, Atsuki C met with Atsuki B, who took over the search and temporarily acted like Atsuki C. Minutes after that, Atsuki C timidly approached the storeroom and found everyone beside the secret door. There, he learned that he had completed the whole search without finding anything.
entries.literal: "In room A1, Atsuki C met with Atsuki B, who took over the search and temporarily acted like Atsuki C. Minutes after that, Atsuki C timidly approached the storeroom and found everyone beside the secret door. There, he learned that he had completed the whole search without finding anything."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That was all the information he had, so every time he was accused of having ignored something on purpose, he couldn't directly reference the search, as he wasn't sure about how it had unfolded. That's why he asks Miiya if she knows where the Sekimeiya could be, just in case she is aware of a potential hole in a search he didn't witness.
entries.literal: "That was all the information he had, so every time he was accused of having ignored something on purpose, he couldn't directly reference the search, as he wasn't sure about how it had unfolded. That's why he asks Miiya if she knows where the Sekimeiya could be, just in case she is aware of a potential hole in a search he didn't witness."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: How many dichotomies were altered in this scenario?
entries.literal: "How many dichotomies were altered in this scenario?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai claimed that the Sekimeiya's main two powers, traveling to the past and future, were but a fraction of their capabilities.
entries.literal: "Sai claimed that the Sekimeiya's main two powers, traveling to the past and future, were but a fraction of their capabilities."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya stopped existing and Shiroya took her place.
entries.literal: "Miiya stopped existing and Shiroya took her place."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Neither Ashiya nor Xyn ended up in possession of the real Sekimeiya. In this case, it was Sai who was able to keep both of them.
entries.literal: "Neither Ashiya nor Xyn ended up in possession of the real Sekimeiya. In this case, it was Sai who was able to keep both of them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was one more dichotomy that was altered, and knowing it will help you figure out Sai's tricks.
entries.literal: "There was one more dichotomy that was altered, and knowing it will help you figure out Sai's tricks."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: To achieve what he wanted, he altered the dichotomy between real and fake Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "To achieve what he wanted, he altered the dichotomy between real and fake Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world A, before Akaro knocked out Naomi, she told him that the Sekimeiya must always remain in a cold place and that they could break if they remained outside their cabinet. He'd already heard that from Ido, but Naomi's tone of voice made it sound much more important.
entries.literal: "In world A, before Akaro knocked out Naomi, she told him that the Sekimeiya must always remain in a cold place and that they could break if they remained outside their cabinet. He'd already heard that from Ido, but Naomi's tone of voice made it sound much more important."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That scared Akaro. Would both real Sekimeiya break if he kept them in the cleaning cart? Unaware that they were no longer there, Akaro concluded that he had to move them; he didn't know how long the shutter would stay there for, but he knew Ashiya Tower very well. Other cabinets with temperature functions existed.
entries.literal: "That scared Akaro. Would both real Sekimeiya break if he kept them in the cleaning cart? Unaware that they were no longer there, Akaro concluded that he had to move them; he didn't know how long the shutter would stay there for, but he knew Ashiya Tower very well. Other cabinets with temperature functions existed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Thanks to the security room key that he had found and Naomi's keyring, Akaro went to the attic. There, he found both real Sekimeiya and traveled through time.
entries.literal: "Thanks to the security room key that he had found and Naomi's keyring, Akaro went to the attic. There, he found both real Sekimeiya and traveled through time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As soon as he understood what happened, he created a plan and executed it. At the end of the plan, he put the Future Sekimeiya in the refrigerator, moved the suitcase, rejoined the group holding the Past Sekimeiya, and managed to keep it in a cold cabinet in B4 where everyone stayed for a long time.
entries.literal: "As soon as he understood what happened, he created a plan and executed it. At the end of the plan, he put the Future Sekimeiya in the refrigerator, moved the suitcase, rejoined the group holding the Past Sekimeiya, and managed to keep it in a cold cabinet in B4 where everyone stayed for a long time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, both times, Akaro made a mistake. He wasn't aware of how cold the temperature had to be, as above 0 ºC, the Sekimeiya would always gather energy.{w} Unlike Atsuki, he didn't tamper with the temperature setting, and in room B4, he set the cabinet to 5 ºC. During the time the Sekimeiya spent under those conditions, both of them gathered energy at a slow rate.
entries.literal: "However, both times, Akaro made a mistake. He wasn't aware of how cold the temperature had to be, as above 0 ºC, the Sekimeiya would always gather energy.{w} Unlike Atsuki, he didn't tamper with the temperature setting, and in room B4, he set the cabinet to 5 ºC. During the time the Sekimeiya spent under those conditions, both of them gathered energy at a slow rate."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Eventually, Sai left room B4 and started exploring the tower. At that point, the elevator was on floor 6, so he was able to see the hidden bodies and reach the attic.
entries.literal: "Eventually, Sai left room B4 and started exploring the tower. At that point, the elevator was on floor 6, so he was able to see the hidden bodies and reach the attic."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Up there, he found the Future Sekimeiya in the refrigerator. The instant he touched it, he was split in half by the door of room B4.
entries.literal: "Up there, he found the Future Sekimeiya in the refrigerator. The instant he touched it, he was split in half by the door of room B4."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Before his body appeared in the future, however, the door of the refrigerator was left open, which made Atsuki C notice that it was strangely cold in the attic. It was Katei C who found the Future Sekimeiya in the refrigerator, and he quickly hid it in a bedroom, where Miiya would soon activate it.
entries.literal: "Before his body appeared in the future, however, the door of the refrigerator was left open, which made Atsuki C notice that it was strangely cold in the attic. It was Katei C who found the Future Sekimeiya in the refrigerator, and he quickly hid it in a bedroom, where Miiya would soon activate it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The entire day, Miiya's thoughts carried mystery and ambiguity, rarely being organized or complete.
entries.literal: "The entire day, Miiya's thoughts carried mystery and ambiguity, rarely being organized or complete."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "How much longer would I have to play along for? Ever since she'd exited our lives, I'd kept telling myself that it would all eventually go back to how it was at the beginning."
entries.literal: "\"How much longer would I have to play along for? Ever since she'd exited our lives, I'd kept telling myself that it would all eventually go back to how it was at the beginning.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Regardless, I had to put on the same appearance, and it came naturally after the previous two weeks."
entries.literal: "\"Regardless, I had to put on the same appearance, and it came naturally after the previous two weeks.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Unlike Shiroya, she didn't fall into a coma, so she had been living with Atsuki for two weeks.
entries.literal: "Unlike Shiroya, she didn't fall into a coma, so she had been living with Atsuki for two weeks."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "She really was here, but..."
entries.literal: "\"She really was here, but...\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There was often something important to infer from her thoughts, especially after she murdered Erina.
entries.literal: "There was often something important to infer from her thoughts, especially after she murdered Erina."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had killed a person. She'd wondered many times what that would be like, and she finally knew. Until {time=21}, her mind kept going back to that moment, ever-present in her thoughts, trying to make sense of what had really happened at the time.
entries.literal: "She had killed a person. She'd wondered many times what that would be like, and she finally knew. Until {time=21}, her mind kept going back to that moment, ever-present in her thoughts, trying to make sense of what had really happened at the time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "She was there, casually leaning against the line of cabinets. I could hardly believe what I was seeing, but there was no wariness in her eyes and not even a trace of blood near her."
entries.literal: "\"She was there, casually leaning against the line of cabinets. I could hardly believe what I was seeing, but there was no wariness in her eyes and not even a trace of blood near her.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Miiya world switched to world B, she saw that the cameras' green lights had returned.
entries.literal: "When Miiya world switched to world B, she saw that the cameras' green lights had returned."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "...The computer. It reenabled the cameras. This really must mean that they weren't recording until now, right...?"
entries.literal: "\"...The computer. It reenabled the cameras. This really must mean that they weren't recording until now, right...?\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Hopeful, I entered one of the rooms."
entries.literal: "\"Hopeful, I entered one of the rooms.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Could that mean that her murder hadn't been recorded? Just as she was trying to rationalize that, Erina appeared in hallway B.
entries.literal: "Could that mean that her murder hadn't been recorded? Just as she was trying to rationalize that, Erina appeared in hallway B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Her clothes were caked in dried blood, and the wariness in her voice was back. In response, Miiya started to ask a question that she never finished.
entries.literal: "Her clothes were caked in dried blood, and the wariness in her voice was back. In response, Miiya started to ask a question that she never finished."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "A-Are you...?"{w}—"the Erina that I already killed?"
entries.literal: "\"A-Are you...?\"{w}—\"the Erina that I already killed?\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A lot more happened until {time=21.} Miiya saw another Atsuki and was told that Shiroya would come back to life. Although her mind was pulled from many different sides, in the event room, shortly before the shutter opened, she couldn't help but think about her own grim future.
entries.literal: "A lot more happened until {time=21.} Miiya saw another Atsuki and was told that Shiroya would come back to life. Although her mind was pulled from many different sides, in the event room, shortly before the shutter opened, she couldn't help but think about her own grim future."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "I didn't think anything good could come of it. After all, there was a killer in the room."
entries.literal: "\"I didn't think anything good could come of it. After all, there was a killer in the room.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Despite that, as the seconds ticked along, the answers I tried to reach changed more and more.{w} What would happen to me? ...I looked up to try to believe that nothing would, but I had no way to know."
entries.literal: "\"Despite that, as the seconds ticked along, the answers I tried to reach changed more and more.{w} What would happen to me? ...I looked up to try to believe that nothing would, but I had no way to know.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She looked up at the single camera in the room. The green light on it was no longer visible, but she had no way to know what that meant for her. As the final seconds passed by, Miiya continued to wonder if anyone would ever see the time she had pushed Erina off the stairs on the second floor.
entries.literal: "She looked up at the single camera in the room. The green light on it was no longer visible, but she had no way to know what that meant for her. As the final seconds passed by, Miiya continued to wonder if anyone would ever see the time she had pushed Erina off the stairs on the second floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Why does Atsuki B request that they leave the Sekimeiya on the ground on the second floor?
entries.literal: "Why does Atsuki B request that they leave the Sekimeiya on the ground on the second floor?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It's the Future Sekimeiya, and very soon, Shiroya B will travel all the way to November 30th. Since she is in the attic, what Atsuki wants is to prevent the range of the Future Sekimeiya from reaching Shiroya and causing a world switch.
entries.literal: "It's the Future Sekimeiya, and very soon, Shiroya B will travel all the way to November 30th. Since she is in the attic, what Atsuki wants is to prevent the range of the Future Sekimeiya from reaching Shiroya and causing a world switch."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He recalls the events that he lived through: he knows that a group of people is next to the elevator on the crystal floor. That's why the ground on the second floor is the best place to keep the Future Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "He recalls the events that he lived through: he knows that a group of people is next to the elevator on the crystal floor. That's why the ground on the second floor is the best place to keep the Future Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Miiya agrees that she should be dead. From her point of view, she should have died.
entries.literal: "Miiya agrees that she should be dead. From her point of view, she should have died."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On November 30th, she fell unconscious where a deadly explosion took place. However, when she woke up, her body had moved.
entries.literal: "On November 30th, she fell unconscious where a deadly explosion took place. However, when she woke up, her body had moved."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She had no idea what had happened—she'd begun to wonder if she was mistaken about the exact place she had fallen unconscious. Despite that... she should've died. To her, it didn't make sense that she was alive.
entries.literal: "She had no idea what had happened—she'd begun to wonder if she was mistaken about the exact place she had fallen unconscious. Despite that... she should've died. To her, it didn't make sense that she was alive."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Something disappeared from Miiya's purse. The proof that Shiroya had died was no longer there.
entries.literal: "Something disappeared from Miiya's purse. The proof that Shiroya had died was no longer there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was a note that Atsuki C had written days before December 15th, which Miiya had been careful not to reveal that she had in her purse.
entries.literal: "It was a note that Atsuki C had written days before December 15th, which Miiya had been careful not to reveal that she had in her purse."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, when did it vanish? Despite Miiya's speculation, it wasn't a change in history that got rid of it.
entries.literal: "So, when did it vanish? Despite Miiya's speculation, it wasn't a change in history that got rid of it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Miiya and Erina were together in room A5 in world B, Erina grabbed Miiya's set of keys from her purse with a quick motion. After that, Miiya dashed out of the room when she heard Atsuki calling Shiroya's name.
entries.literal: "When Miiya and Erina were together in room A5 in world B, Erina grabbed Miiya's set of keys from her purse with a quick motion. After that, Miiya dashed out of the room when she heard Atsuki calling Shiroya's name."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That caused the note to fall to the floor, and Erina picked it up. Minutes later, in the event room, she gave it to Atsuki B, which is how he obtained it originally, as it wasn't the same note that he'd already left behind a handrail.
entries.literal: "That caused the note to fall to the floor, and Erina picked it up. Minutes later, in the event room, she gave it to Atsuki B, which is how he obtained it originally, as it wasn't the same note that he'd already left behind a handrail."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If you follow the movements of the note, though, you might notice that something is off.
entries.literal: "If you follow the movements of the note, though, you might notice that something is off."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It only entered the tower in world C in Miiya's purse. Late into the day, when she went to world B, she dropped it and Erina picked it up.
entries.literal: "It only entered the tower in world C in Miiya's purse. Late into the day, when she went to world B, she dropped it and Erina picked it up."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Erina gave it to Atsuki B before the future location of one of his travels, which let him have it in the past.
entries.literal: "Erina gave it to Atsuki B before the future location of one of his travels, which let him have it in the past."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He first saw it in the staff room and immediately tossed it behind one of the hallway B handrails, where the police of that world found it.
entries.literal: "He first saw it in the staff room and immediately tossed it behind one of the hallway B handrails, where the police of that world found it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There's one last key to understanding this puzzle. Before Miiya dropped the note for Erina to obtain it, she had traveled back in time.
entries.literal: "There's one last key to understanding this puzzle. Before Miiya dropped the note for Erina to obtain it, she had traveled back in time."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I looked up and saw three slits in the door. Despite the darkness that should've existed behind them, I discerned a glow."
entries.literal: "\"I looked up and saw three slits in the door. Despite the darkness that should've existed behind them, I discerned a glow.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "It could only have been one thing. Despite being filled with questions, my mind was blank. My hand was drawn to the shape that had begun to take form behind the dark lines, and through the narrow space, I made contact, hoping with all my might that I would be brought to the awaited time."
entries.literal: "\"It could only have been one thing. Despite being filled with questions, my mind was blank. My hand was drawn to the shape that had begun to take form behind the dark lines, and through the narrow space, I made contact, hoping with all my might that I would be brought to the awaited time.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "However, hallway A was my next sight."
entries.literal: "\"However, hallway A was my next sight.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: {w=1.0}"Then, I fell to the floor immediately after appearing."
entries.literal: "{w=1.0}\"Then, I fell to the floor immediately after appearing.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She appeared in hallway A, dropped the note next to Erina in room A5, and then the replicated location took place. In world C, she and Atsuki ran to the crystal floor after Akaro. Since they were ahead, they didn't notice her pick up the note. Afterwards, she ran to catch up with Atsuki, which is why she had appeared in hallway A in world B and immediately fallen to the floor.
entries.literal: "She appeared in hallway A, dropped the note next to Erina in room A5, and then the replicated location took place. In world C, she and Atsuki ran to the crystal floor after Akaro. Since they were ahead, they didn't notice her pick up the note. Afterwards, she ran to catch up with Atsuki, which is why she had appeared in hallway A in world B and immediately fallen to the floor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So there's a large inconsistency. If she dropped the note before the replicated location, why did she have it when she appeared in hallway A? She must've had it, or else she couldn't have dropped it in room A5.
entries.literal: "So there's a large inconsistency. If she dropped the note before the replicated location, why did she have it when she appeared in hallway A? She must've had it, or else she couldn't have dropped it in room A5."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Do you remember something Atsuki B thought regarding the note?
entries.literal: "Do you remember something Atsuki B thought regarding the note?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I put my hand in my pocket, but the note wasn't there. It had disappeared at some point."
entries.literal: "\"I put my hand in my pocket, but the note wasn't there. It had disappeared at some point.\""

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Right. The next time I traveled to the past, I didn't appear with it.{w} But... why? I should have.
entries.literal: "Right. The next time I traveled to the past, I didn't appear with it.{w} But... why? I should have."

entries.speaker: nm
entries.text: Oh, it's like I thought earlier. I had the note when I traveled to the past. From the staff room, I appeared in hallway B and then slammed the storeroom door to create a new noise. After that, I waited in the bathroom on the second floor.{w} There, I put my hand in my pocket because I wanted to flush the note away. However, it wasn't there.{w} That's why I didn't appear with it. I wanted to flush it away, so if I had, I wouldn't have held the note in the future, and I never could've appeared with it.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's like I thought earlier. I had the note when I traveled to the past. From the staff room, I appeared in hallway B and then slammed the storeroom door to create a new noise. After that, I waited in the bathroom on the second floor.{w} There, I put my hand in my pocket because I wanted to flush the note away. However, it wasn't there.{w} That's why I didn't appear with it. I wanted to flush it away, so if I had, I wouldn't have held the note in the future, and I never could've appeared with it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: What he thinks happened makes sense, and it would've happened if not for something he didn't realize. By the time he traveled from the staff room, he had already dropped the note Erina had given him in the event room.
entries.literal: "What he thinks happened makes sense, and it would've happened if not for something he didn't realize. By the time he traveled from the staff room, he had already dropped the note Erina had given him in the event room."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Sai was the least of my concerns. I barely put any thought into punching him, but before I did, I saw a conspicuous smile all over his face. It only faded momentarily, returning right after the blow."
entries.literal: "\"Sai was the least of my concerns. I barely put any thought into punching him, but before I did, I saw a conspicuous smile all over his face. It only faded momentarily, returning right after the blow.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki had an altercation with Sai C near the elevator after Shiroya left them behind. At that time, the note fell from his pocket.
entries.literal: "Atsuki had an altercation with Sai C near the elevator after Shiroya left them behind. At that time, the note fell from his pocket."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And someone found it just minutes later. None other than Miiya herself.
entries.literal: "And someone found it just minutes later. None other than Miiya herself."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "We ran behind Akaro. I looked down and saw that there was still no blood on the floor or the staircase."
entries.literal: "\"We ran behind Akaro. I looked down and saw that there was still no blood on the floor or the staircase.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: What...!?

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "On the floor, below the elevator panel, there was a folded piece of paper. Atsuki and Akaro were ahead of me, so they didn't see me grabbing it and putting it in my purse."
entries.literal: "\"On the floor, below the elevator panel, there was a folded piece of paper. Atsuki and Akaro were ahead of me, so they didn't see me grabbing it and putting it in my purse.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Did it... not disappear after all?
entries.literal: "Did it... not disappear after all?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Akaro was in the storeroom, but I just followed behind Atsuki, completely lost for words. How the hell had that made it there?"
entries.literal: "\"Akaro was in the storeroom, but I just followed behind Atsuki, completely lost for words. How the hell had that made it there?\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Right before she ran through hallway A to satisfy her previous travel, she reobtained the note.
entries.literal: "Right before she ran through hallway A to satisfy her previous travel, she reobtained the note."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And at {time=21}, the police didn't find it in her shoe, where she had stored it as a last-ditch effort. So, even though only one note entered the tower in the morning, a copy of it reached the end of worlds B and C.
entries.literal: "And at {time=21}, the police didn't find it in her shoe, where she had stored it as a last-ditch effort. So, even though only one note entered the tower in the morning, a copy of it reached the end of worlds B and C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In the hour before the tower unlocked, the scent of death enveloped Ashiya Tower. Everyone reached the last stretch of their imprisonment just to fall victim to a sudden, gruesome massacre.
entries.literal: "In the hour before the tower unlocked, the scent of death enveloped Ashiya Tower. Everyone reached the last stretch of their imprisonment just to fall victim to a sudden, gruesome massacre."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...But what really took place inside the giant building? What was the cause behind the last second turn of events? Here are the facts you already know about:
entries.literal: "...But what really took place inside the giant building? What was the cause behind the last second turn of events? Here are the facts you already know about:"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: 1. When the police entered the tower, nobody was alive inside it.
entries.literal: "1. When the police entered the tower, nobody was alive inside it."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: 2. All the deaths were instant, and two people couldn't have killed each other simultaneously.
entries.literal: "2. All the deaths were instant, and two people couldn't have killed each other simultaneously."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: 3. No one committed suicide. Every single person who was trapped in the morning was attacked by another person.
entries.literal: "3. No one committed suicide. Every single person who was trapped in the morning was attacked by another person."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Those points alone raise a serious question: who killed the last person? Everyone who died was instantly killed by someone, so what happened to the last victim to fall dead?{w} Let's look at more facts surrounding the case:
entries.literal: "Those points alone raise a serious question: who killed the last person? Everyone who died was instantly killed by someone, so what happened to the last victim to fall dead?{w} Let's look at more facts surrounding the case:"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: 4. The police found and unlocked the hidden door in the storeroom. By doing so, they removed Sai's mark. In other words, that door hadn't been opened since Sai had marked it more than six hours earlier.
entries.literal: "4. The police found and unlocked the hidden door in the storeroom. By doing so, they removed Sai's mark. In other words, that door hadn't been opened since Sai had marked it more than six hours earlier."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: 5. The police found one of the Sekimeiya gray and on the floor in the event room.
entries.literal: "5. The police found one of the Sekimeiya gray and on the floor in the event room."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: 6. Everyone who died was killed by someone from their own world, and no killer world switched to another world. They all died in their own world, C, where they were found dead.
entries.literal: "6. Everyone who died was killed by someone from their own world, and no killer world switched to another world. They all died in their own world, C, where they were found dead."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: 7. Everyone who died was pierced by the same screwdriver. When the last person died, their killer threw it away, and the police found it next to the crystal floor stairs.{w} If you're curious, when the police analyzed it, they found two different sets of fingerprints on its handle.
entries.literal: "7. Everyone who died was pierced by the same screwdriver. When the last person died, their killer threw it away, and the police found it next to the crystal floor stairs.{w} If you're curious, when the police analyzed it, they found two different sets of fingerprints on its handle."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: One set of prints matched with Miiya's records. Do you know who else had wielded that screwdriver?
entries.literal: "One set of prints matched with Miiya's records. Do you know who else had wielded that screwdriver?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: A handful of fingerprints belonging to Naomi C overlapped those from Miiya. Does that make sense, though? Wasn't Naomi lying on the floor in the lobby?{w} What really happened when the police raided the building?
entries.literal: "A handful of fingerprints belonging to Naomi C overlapped those from Miiya. Does that make sense, though? Wasn't Naomi lying on the floor in the lobby?{w} What really happened when the police raided the building?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "In the lobby was the first indication of the bloodbath that had transpired. Dead eyes watched the officers from the floor, inviting them to a hell of corridors and blood."
entries.literal: "\"In the lobby was the first indication of the bloodbath that had transpired. Dead eyes watched the officers from the floor, inviting them to a hell of corridors and blood.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: They were Suripo's eyes—Naomi wasn't there.
entries.literal: "They were Suripo's eyes—Naomi wasn't there."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She wasn't anywhere. As you know, the moment the first police officer took a step into the building, no speck of life dwelled anywhere.
entries.literal: "She wasn't anywhere. As you know, the moment the first police officer took a step into the building, no speck of life dwelled anywhere."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: But that's hardly a problem, is it? The gray Sekimeiya that the police found indicates that someone activated it shortly before the shutters rose. It was the Future Sekimeiya, which had previously failed to let Katei escape from his pursuer. Whoever activated it would not have been present when the police entered the building.
entries.literal: "But that's hardly a problem, is it? The gray Sekimeiya that the police found indicates that someone activated it shortly before the shutters rose. It was the Future Sekimeiya, which had previously failed to let Katei escape from his pursuer. Whoever activated it would not have been present when the police entered the building."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Let me refresh your memory of something you were once told.
entries.literal: "Let me refresh your memory of something you were once told."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Fortunately, everyone was able to leave safely. That included Naomi, who was woken up by the loud noise of the shutter."
entries.literal: "\"Fortunately, everyone was able to leave safely. That included Naomi, who was woken up by the loud noise of the shutter.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "However, a single decision nearly sent everything spiraling into destruction."
entries.literal: "\"However, a single decision nearly sent everything spiraling into destruction.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Instead of the shutter, yells of pain that would've woken Naomi up before that time were almost let out. Disastrous yells that would've shattered everything that had been needed to get there."
entries.literal: "\"Instead of the shutter, yells of pain that would've woken Naomi up before that time were almost let out. Disastrous yells that would've shattered everything that had been needed to get there.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "They were yells that, in reality, nobody ever heard. At {time=21:04}, the police entered the building.{w} Even though everyone was alive, Suripo was dead on the floor. The officers could hardly believe their eyes while the survivors emerged."
entries.literal: "\"They were yells that, in reality, nobody ever heard. At {time=21:04}, the police entered the building.{w} Even though everyone was alive, Suripo was dead on the floor. The officers could hardly believe their eyes while the survivors emerged.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So, let's put together a plausible set of events.
entries.literal: "So, let's put together a plausible set of events."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world C, Naomi wasn't actually dead. The loud motion of the shutter woke her up at {time=21:04}, but in this imaginary world, Erina's and Isla's yells did so ahead of time.
entries.literal: "In world C, Naomi wasn't actually dead. The loud motion of the shutter woke her up at {time=21:04}, but in this imaginary world, Erina's and Isla's yells did so ahead of time."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In a groggy state, she saw the killer finishing off Katei in hallway C, and the only thing she could do was dash at them and use their own weapon to seek instant vengeance.
entries.literal: "In a groggy state, she saw the killer finishing off Katei in hallway C, and the only thing she could do was dash at them and use their own weapon to seek instant vengeance."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Naomi roamed around the tower and witnessed the five other corpses, the scent of blood mingling with the smell of the Sekimeiya to create an odor unlike anything she'd ever smelled before. When she entered the event room, the Future Sekimeiya, which Katei had activated, had already powered back on. She ran to it to put it inside its cabinet, but she traveled to the future the moment she contacted the gemstone.
entries.literal: "Naomi roamed around the tower and witnessed the five other corpses, the scent of blood mingling with the smell of the Sekimeiya to create an odor unlike anything she'd ever smelled before. When she entered the event room, the Future Sekimeiya, which Katei had activated, had already powered back on. She ran to it to put it inside its cabinet, but she traveled to the future the moment she contacted the gemstone."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When the police entered the building, no one was alive inside until Naomi reappeared. Everyone had been killed by someone else. The killer hadn't escaped through the storeroom or to another world. Everyone who had died was killed by someone from their own world. Every single person who had gotten trapped in the morning was attacked by another person—even Naomi, who was attacked and severely injured in world A by Akaro.
entries.literal: "When the police entered the building, no one was alive inside until Naomi reappeared. Everyone had been killed by someone else. The killer hadn't escaped through the storeroom or to another world. Everyone who had died was killed by someone from their own world. Every single person who had gotten trapped in the morning was attacked by another person—even Naomi, who was attacked and severely injured in world A by Akaro."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: This seems to answer most questions, but of course, what about all the other murders? What happened before Naomi's reawakening?
entries.literal: "This seems to answer most questions, but of course, what about all the other murders? What happened before Naomi's reawakening?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The truth is something that wouldn't be theorized even once by the police or anyone who dared tackle the case. In their world, that is.
entries.literal: "The truth is something that wouldn't be theorized even once by the police or anyone who dared tackle the case. In their world, that is."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: You know about the time where everyone waited in the event room, calmly spending the last few minutes of the day-long countdown. No one present had any idea of what it had taken for that young, red-haired girl to be sitting there against a wall, staring indifferently at the walls and approaching her long-awaited release.
entries.literal: "You know about the time where everyone waited in the event room, calmly spending the last few minutes of the day-long countdown. No one present had any idea of what it had taken for that young, red-haired girl to be sitting there against a wall, staring indifferently at the walls and approaching her long-awaited release."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At that time, the thought of killing anyone was nowhere in her mind, and that didn't change when an impulse drew her out of the room. It was all she could do to obstruct the predictions that a mysterious Atsuki had made, but she had no intention to go any further than that. She had already abandoned the thoughts of death.
entries.literal: "At that time, the thought of killing anyone was nowhere in her mind, and that didn't change when an impulse drew her out of the room. It was all she could do to obstruct the predictions that a mysterious Atsuki had made, but she had no intention to go any further than that. She had already abandoned the thoughts of death."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After all, she had already killed once. In world A, she had killed Erina, and repeating that act was not something she had even considered. While waiting in the event room, most of Miiya's thoughts were directed to her own well-being. The sight of the camera and not knowing whether her action had been recorded unnerved her.
entries.literal: "After all, she had already killed once. In world A, she had killed Erina, and repeating that act was not something she had even considered. While waiting in the event room, most of Miiya's thoughts were directed to her own well-being. The sight of the camera and not knowing whether her action had been recorded unnerved her."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So that begs the question that everyone would ask themselves. What drove someone to kill that many times mere minutes before their release? Completely ignorant to what she was doing, the moment Miiya rushed out of the event room, she created a world with only one survivor.
entries.literal: "So that begs the question that everyone would ask themselves. What drove someone to kill that many times mere minutes before their release? Completely ignorant to what she was doing, the moment Miiya rushed out of the event room, she created a world with only one survivor."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In this world, the shutter seems to unlock a few minutes before {time=21}, but that's merely a misunderstanding with Sai's wristwatch.
entries.literal: "In this world, the shutter seems to unlock a few minutes before {time=21}, but that's merely a misunderstanding with Sai's wristwatch."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Earlier in the day, Sai traveled to the future alongside Atsuki. However, both of them thought they had traveled to the past, so Sai never believed that the time on his watch was incorrect.
entries.literal: "Earlier in the day, Sai traveled to the future alongside Atsuki. However, both of them thought they had traveled to the past, so Sai never believed that the time on his watch was incorrect."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: It was several minutes ahead of the real time, but the computer had stopped working, and when they world switched to A, the security room was locked. The first time he thought that it might've been wrong was when he heard the shutter opening.
entries.literal: "It was several minutes ahead of the real time, but the computer had stopped working, and when they world switched to A, the security room was locked. The first time he thought that it might've been wrong was when he heard the shutter opening."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Suripo speaks with Larles, a seemingly idiosyncratic individual who was ushered away in the commotion. Though, not by a phone call, like she claimed.
entries.literal: "Suripo speaks with Larles, a seemingly idiosyncratic individual who was ushered away in the commotion. Though, not by a phone call, like she claimed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Observers witnessing her were quick to spot something like a second set of arms rummaging in her coat, but most brushed it off as cosplay. There were no records regarding her existence anywhere on Earth.
entries.literal: "Observers witnessing her were quick to spot something like a second set of arms rummaging in her coat, but most brushed it off as cosplay. There were no records regarding her existence anywhere on Earth."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: From the Doctor Who spin-off "Cwej: The Series". As per Kickstarter reward: Cameo Scene.
entries.literal: "From the Doctor Who spin-off \"Cwej: The Series\". As per Kickstarter reward: Cameo Scene."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The initial reports say that three people are missing, but the real number is four: Atsuki, Erina, Sai, and Akaro. The reason behind this misunderstanding is Naomi A's body.
entries.literal: "The initial reports say that three people are missing, but the real number is four: Atsuki, Erina, Sai, and Akaro. The reason behind this misunderstanding is Naomi A's body."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The police believed that at least eight people had been trapped, so when they found four dead bodies and Shiroya, they thought that only three people were unaccounted for.
entries.literal: "The police believed that at least eight people had been trapped, so when they found four dead bodies and Shiroya, they thought that only three people were unaccounted for."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Two of the dead bodies belonged to Naomi, so with a little more investigation, those numbers would be doubted.
entries.literal: "Two of the dead bodies belonged to Naomi, so with a little more investigation, those numbers would be doubted."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki tells Shiroya to appear below a stone roof, but he doesn't have enough time to fully explain why.
entries.literal: "Atsuki tells Shiroya to appear below a stone roof, but he doesn't have enough time to fully explain why."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: If Shiroya had appeared wide in the open, her body would've collided with the falling snow, but that's not all. The roof would've been needed even if no snow had been falling at the moment she appeared.
entries.literal: "If Shiroya had appeared wide in the open, her body would've collided with the falling snow, but that's not all. The roof would've been needed even if no snow had been falling at the moment she appeared."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's due to the snow on the ground. If there had been any, Shiroya's future location would've been slightly sunk into it, in her own footprints. Those would not yet have existed in the past, so Shiroya's feet would've collided with an even layer of snow, and she would have lost the bottom portions of her feet, bleeding profusely.
entries.literal: "That's due to the snow on the ground. If there had been any, Shiroya's future location would've been slightly sunk into it, in her own footprints. Those would not yet have existed in the past, so Shiroya's feet would've collided with an even layer of snow, and she would have lost the bottom portions of her feet, bleeding profusely."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The third chapter is called "Peripheral". The main story of this chapter happens outside of Ashiya Tower—it's the periphery of the story. Not only that, but its main goal resembles that of a computer peripheral.
entries.literal: "The third chapter is called \"Peripheral\". The main story of this chapter happens outside of Ashiya Tower—it's the periphery of the story. Not only that, but its main goal resembles that of a computer peripheral."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: An external part of the computer essential for the entire machine to work. If Shiroya hadn't been there to relay the group from Chapter 1 to Chapter 5, the entire structure would've collapsed.
entries.literal: "An external part of the computer essential for the entire machine to work. If Shiroya hadn't been there to relay the group from Chapter 1 to Chapter 5, the entire structure would've collapsed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Lastly, it references "peripheral vision", as this view is essential to solve the mysteries of this part of the story.
entries.literal: "Lastly, it references \"peripheral vision\", as this view is essential to solve the mysteries of this part of the story."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya's narrow field of view prevented her from noticing the truth around her, but if she had widened it ever so slightly, she would've taken notice of everything she was missing. Similarly, if your approach for this chapter had been different, your perception of it would've changed drastically.
entries.literal: "Shiroya's narrow field of view prevented her from noticing the truth around her, but if she had widened it ever so slightly, she would've taken notice of everything she was missing. Similarly, if your approach for this chapter had been different, your perception of it would've changed drastically."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Sai and Shiroya appear in the right bedroom of the attic, but the reason for that seems to be that they appeared inside it. After all, that's what lets them stay there until the time of the future location.
entries.literal: "Sai and Shiroya appear in the right bedroom of the attic, but the reason for that seems to be that they appeared inside it. After all, that's what lets them stay there until the time of the future location."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There are other instances where you might ask yourself similar questions. This seems like a paradox that appeared out of thin air.
entries.literal: "There are other instances where you might ask yourself similar questions. This seems like a paradox that appeared out of thin air."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: However, be certain that they all share something that makes them decipherable. There is no effect without a distinct cause.
entries.literal: "However, be certain that they all share something that makes them decipherable. There is no effect without a distinct cause."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Happy New Year!
entries.literal: "Happy New Year!"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In this imaginary world... the real story converged with your request. Shiroya never returned to the tower on January 5th, leading to many changes.
entries.literal: "In this imaginary world... the real story converged with your request. Shiroya never returned to the tower on January 5th, leading to many changes."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: She wasn't there to save the lives of everyone who had activated a chain of future travels at the end of December 15th. Because she didn't go to the tower on January 5th, her future self didn't exist on December 15th; Shiroya wasn't there at the end of the day to prevent Atsuki from unplugging the cabinet. As a result, he ended up traveling to the future, and the two fake Sekimeiya the police put in the cabinet at {time=21} never ended up breaking.
entries.literal: "She wasn't there to save the lives of everyone who had activated a chain of future travels at the end of December 15th. Because she didn't go to the tower on January 5th, her future self didn't exist on December 15th; Shiroya wasn't there at the end of the day to prevent Atsuki from unplugging the cabinet. As a result, he ended up traveling to the future, and the two fake Sekimeiya the police put in the cabinet at {time=21} never ended up breaking."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On January 1st, when Atsuki found Shiroya, he ran behind her without thinking, causing the final accident that would forever change her life.
entries.literal: "On January 1st, when Atsuki found Shiroya, he ran behind her without thinking, causing the final accident that would forever change her life."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At the scene, a police officer approached her to ask for her name. As he'd thought, she was one of the people who should've been in the tower on December 15th, so she was taken into a car.
entries.literal: "At the scene, a police officer approached her to ask for her name. As he'd thought, she was one of the people who should've been in the tower on December 15th, so she was taken into a car."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The rest of the missing people, however, were not found, which eventually put an end to Ashiya's desperate claims.
entries.literal: "The rest of the missing people, however, were not found, which eventually put an end to Ashiya's desperate claims."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Months passed. In this world, the storeroom's secret was never found—Katei had escaped in the morning, and the door was always unlocked. That's why Shiroya never attempted to reenter the tower once she was freed. Despite all of those changes, however, the chain of future travels still took place. You might be able to figure out why.
entries.literal: "Months passed. In this world, the storeroom's secret was never found—Katei had escaped in the morning, and the door was always unlocked. That's why Shiroya never attempted to reenter the tower once she was freed. Despite all of those changes, however, the chain of future travels still took place. You might be able to figure out why."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: And on October 4th, the tower was demolished, destroying the Future Sekimeiya. When the missing people appeared, their bodies collided with the fallen debris, killing them instantly. Days later, when the debris was being cleaned, the gruesome fate of the three missing people was finally known to all. Erina was discovered last, as she had appeared where the mechanical room had once been.
entries.literal: "And on October 4th, the tower was demolished, destroying the Future Sekimeiya. When the missing people appeared, their bodies collided with the fallen debris, killing them instantly. Days later, when the debris was being cleaned, the gruesome fate of the three missing people was finally known to all. Erina was discovered last, as she had appeared where the mechanical room had once been."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On December 15th, Isla A world switched to world B. There, she went many days into the past. When she touched the Sekimeiya, she was holding the purse she'd had in world A. Then, on November 24th, which purse did she appear with?
entries.literal: "On December 15th, Isla A world switched to world B. There, she went many days into the past. When she touched the Sekimeiya, she was holding the purse she'd had in world A. Then, on November 24th, which purse did she appear with?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Interestingly, she appeared with the purse from world B.{w} It had the voice recorder inside, and there were no tickets for the event.{w} It's strange, though, isn't it? Why did she not appear with the purse from world A, which she'd been holding?
entries.literal: "Interestingly, she appeared with the purse from world B.{w} It had the voice recorder inside, and there were no tickets for the event.{w} It's strange, though, isn't it? Why did she not appear with the purse from world A, which she'd been holding?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: While the two Islas tried to keep her identity hidden, the purses were swapped. Before going to the tower, Erina realized the tickets they'd bought weren't in the purse's pocket, so they printed them again. That's how the purse with the recorder was brought to the tower.
entries.literal: "While the two Islas tried to keep her identity hidden, the purses were swapped. Before going to the tower, Erina realized the tickets they'd bought weren't in the purse's pocket, so they printed them again. That's how the purse with the recorder was brought to the tower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Meanwhile, Isla A was left home with the original purse from world B. Inside were the tickets that Erina B had originally printed, but before January 5th, Shiroya took them.
entries.literal: "Meanwhile, Isla A was left home with the original purse from world B. Inside were the tickets that Erina B had originally printed, but before January 5th, Shiroya took them."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's why, when Isla A reentered the tower, she was holding the empty purse from world B. It's why, when she arrived in the past, the purse she had was world B's, and the recorder was inside.
entries.literal: "That's why, when Isla A reentered the tower, she was holding the empty purse from world B. It's why, when she arrived in the past, the purse she had was world B's, and the recorder was inside."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In other words, although two purses existed, they were the very same, as the Sekimeiya had joined them together.
entries.literal: "In other words, although two purses existed, they were the very same, as the Sekimeiya had joined them together."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Shiroya's phone says "No service", and she's unable to connect to her mother when she attempts to call her. The reason is the existence of a duplicate phone of hers.
entries.literal: "Shiroya's phone says \"No service\", and she's unable to connect to her mother when she attempts to call her. The reason is the existence of a duplicate phone of hers."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In this world, when December 15th came to an end, Shiroya was the only person found in Ashiya Tower; she was the version of Shiroya that had saved Miiya in world C.
entries.literal: "In this world, when December 15th came to an end, Shiroya was the only person found in Ashiya Tower; she was the version of Shiroya that had saved Miiya in world C."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Soon after being taken in by the police, she was released and went to temporarily live in Atsuki's house to take care of his pets. She reobtained the phone she had left outside the tower on the morning of the 15th, so when Shiroya's mother called her number, both her original and copied phone received the call.
entries.literal: "Soon after being taken in by the police, she was released and went to temporarily live in Atsuki's house to take care of his pets. She reobtained the phone she had left outside the tower on the morning of the 15th, so when Shiroya's mother called her number, both her original and copied phone received the call."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Depending on implementation, some phone services allow the use of the same phone number on multiple devices when notified beforehand. Shiroya's service provider noticed that two devices were receiving calls from the same source and terminated her phone's connection to prevent fraudulent use of the line, whether through her own fault or a third party's.
entries.literal: "Depending on implementation, some phone services allow the use of the same phone number on multiple devices when notified beforehand. Shiroya's service provider noticed that two devices were receiving calls from the same source and terminated her phone's connection to prevent fraudulent use of the line, whether through her own fault or a third party's."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Of course, they wouldn't terminate her service without notifying her by mail, but mail takes a few days to arrive.
entries.literal: "Of course, they wouldn't terminate her service without notifying her by mail, but mail takes a few days to arrive."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}Don't worry, he'll come back soon.
entries.literal: "...{w}Don't worry, he'll come back soon."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...He didn't react. Maxi had been staring at me in silence for hours. It must have been strange for him to see me in Atsuki's house for so long.
entries.literal: "...He didn't react. Maxi had been staring at me in silence for hours. It must have been strange for him to see me in Atsuki's house for so long."
