entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Much like him, all I could do was stare at the clock. January 1st was slowly coming to an end.
entries.literal: "Much like him, all I could do was stare at the clock. January 1st was slowly coming to an end."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: After ignoring me, Maxi approached the front door.
entries.literal: "After ignoring me, Maxi approached the front door."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You'll get to see him again in just four days. Even if you went to look for him, you wouldn't find him anywhere right now.
entries.literal: "You'll get to see him again in just four days. Even if you went to look for him, you wouldn't find him anywhere right now."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Because he was traveling to the future... It was insane to think about it so casually, but I was certain that Atsuki was nowhere in the world at that moment.
entries.literal: "Because he was traveling to the future... It was insane to think about it so casually, but I was certain that Atsuki was nowhere in the world at that moment."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Seventeen days had passed since December 15th. Before that, I'd been in Eagle Motel for fifteen days. That had been after spending five days in January, immediately after those initial twelve hours...
entries.literal: "Seventeen days had passed since December 15th. Before that, I'd been in Eagle Motel for fifteen days. That had been after spending five days in January, immediately after those initial twelve hours..."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I was confident I was finally at the exit of the sprawling labyrinth, and during the past few days, I'd had a lot of time to ruminate on many of the things that had happened.
entries.literal: "I was confident I was finally at the exit of the sprawling labyrinth, and during the past few days, I'd had a lot of time to ruminate on many of the things that had happened."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That time I entered the tower from the storeroom, after spending hours in front of the tower and under the unchanging sky... That'll happen in four days.
entries.literal: "That time I entered the tower from the storeroom, after spending hours in front of the tower and under the unchanging sky... That'll happen in four days."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Most of my thoughts had been directed to the brief interlude where I'd been in January by myself. Atsuki had told me that I'd gone to the future instead of the past, but that was all the information I had from him.
entries.literal: "Most of my thoughts had been directed to the brief interlude where I'd been in January by myself. Atsuki had told me that I'd gone to the future instead of the past, but that was all the information I had from him."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom and appeared under the gem shop. I first thought that I'd gone to November because I accessed the date settings on my phone and read November 30th. The time was {time=21:10.}
entries.literal: "I touched the Sekimeiya in the bathroom and appeared under the gem shop. I first thought that I'd gone to November because I accessed the date settings on my phone and read November 30th. The time was {time=21:10.}"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I realized something important a while ago. My phone was from November 30th. Not only that, but I was wearing the clothes from that day, and my whole body was wracked with pain because it had just fallen from the shop. However, I appeared on December 30th.
entries.literal: "I realized something important a while ago. My phone was from November 30th. Not only that, but I was wearing the clothes from that day, and my whole body was wracked with pain because it had just fallen from the shop. However, I appeared on December 30th."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And not on December 31st—on December 30th. Even though I heard fireworks welcoming the new year when I went home, I don't think I appeared in the past just a few hours earlier. After reading {time=21:10} and November 30th on my phone, I fell unconscious, and when I woke up, I felt as if I'd been there for an eternity. But according to the time, it had been less than half an hour.{w} There's no way. I was there for over a day. The body I'd appeared in had just fallen through the shop's floor, and I was unconscious until the next day, when I went home. I dreamed about many parts of my life for so long...
entries.literal: "And not on December 31st—on December 30th. Even though I heard fireworks welcoming the new year when I went home, I don't think I appeared in the past just a few hours earlier. After reading {time=21:10} and November 30th on my phone, I fell unconscious, and when I woke up, I felt as if I'd been there for an eternity. But according to the time, it had been less than half an hour.{w} There's no way. I was there for over a day. The body I'd appeared in had just fallen through the shop's floor, and I was unconscious until the next day, when I went home. I dreamed about many parts of my life for so long..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: November 30th and December 30th are both fifteen days apart from December 15th. On December 30th, the body I appeared in was the one from November 30th, which is why my phone displayed that date. That's how Atsuki said the Sekimeiya worked.{w} In the bathroom, I touched the Sekimeiya at about {time=20:30.} Since the body I appeared in was from November 30th at {time=21:00}, what that must mean is that the real time on December 30th was {time=20:00.} The time on my phone was always about one hour ahead.
entries.literal: "November 30th and December 30th are both fifteen days apart from December 15th. On December 30th, the body I appeared in was the one from November 30th, which is why my phone displayed that date. That's how Atsuki said the Sekimeiya worked.{w} In the bathroom, I touched the Sekimeiya at about {time=20:30.} Since the body I appeared in was from November 30th at {time=21:00}, what that must mean is that the real time on December 30th was {time=20:00.} The time on my phone was always about one hour ahead."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I remember when I first woke up underground. As opposed to every other time, instead of instantly appearing there, I woke up, as if something had been in between my travel and my awakening.
entries.literal: "I remember when I first woke up underground. As opposed to every other time, instead of instantly appearing there, I woke up, as if something had been in between my travel and my awakening."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I don't think I fully understand yet how the Sekimeiya functioned, but I might know why this happened. In this case, the body that was replicated was from after I'd fallen through the gem shop's floor. That means that it was already in a coma. When my future consciousness was placed within it, my body woke up.
entries.literal: "I don't think I fully understand yet how the Sekimeiya functioned, but I might know why this happened. In this case, the body that was replicated was from after I'd fallen through the gem shop's floor. That means that it was already in a coma. When my future consciousness was placed within it, my body woke up."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I've had time to notice a few things I didn't realize at the time. When I walked out of that tunnel, no snow was falling—it was not November 30th. The moon phase that I saw didn't match with that day either.
entries.literal: "I've had time to notice a few things I didn't realize at the time. When I walked out of that tunnel, no snow was falling—it was not November 30th. The moon phase that I saw didn't match with that day either."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I was really tired, so I don't know if that contributed to everything that I missed, but my first destination was the gem shop where I thought I'd just been. I saw the owner there, who might've been handling the repairs of his store or something, but I only recognized him when I saw his face...{w} because he was no longer wearing the shirt from that day, which had the shop's logo on both sides.
entries.literal: "I was really tired, so I don't know if that contributed to everything that I missed, but my first destination was the gem shop where I thought I'd just been. I saw the owner there, who might've been handling the repairs of his store or something, but I only recognized him when I saw his face...{w} because he was no longer wearing the shirt from that day, which had the shop's logo on both sides."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So I just went home, where everything looked like it had on November 30th. That's because after waking up from the coma, I was only there for one day before going to live with Atsuki.
entries.literal: "So I just went home, where everything looked like it had on November 30th. That's because after waking up from the coma, I was only there for one day before going to live with Atsuki."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I thought I had two weeks to change the past, and being free in those icy streets had made for an immense contrast.
entries.literal: "I thought I had two weeks to change the past, and being free in those icy streets had made for an immense contrast."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I fell asleep in no time, but I was woken up by the sound of fireworks. Although my phone displayed {time=1}, midnight had just hit, and the fireworks were marking the start of the new year. ...I saw them again last night, once more by myself.
entries.literal: "I fell asleep in no time, but I was woken up by the sound of fireworks. Although my phone displayed {time=1}, midnight had just hit, and the fireworks were marking the start of the new year. ...I saw them again last night, once more by myself."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It was 2012. My past self wasn't in a coma, and Atsuki wasn't secluded in his house. However, those beliefs let me feel temporarily at peace.
entries.literal: "It was 2012. My past self wasn't in a coma, and Atsuki wasn't secluded in his house. However, those beliefs let me feel temporarily at peace."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The next day was today. I didn't even think that the cereal bars I'd brought to Atsuki's house should've still been in the kitchen. I just ate some mixed nuts and went outside, where I ended up at Ina Café after wandering through the white streets.
entries.literal: "The next day was today. I didn't even think that the cereal bars I'd brought to Atsuki's house should've still been in the kitchen. I just ate some mixed nuts and went outside, where I ended up at Ina Café after wandering through the white streets."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Hello.
entries.literal: "Hello."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: He suddenly turned around.
entries.literal: "He suddenly turned around."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Ha—
entries.literal: "Ha—"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Shiroya...!
entries.literal: "Shiroya...!"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah. It's been a while.
entries.literal: "Yeah. It's been a while."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Oh my God! Y-You're all right!
entries.literal: "Oh my God! Y-You're all right!"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...So you know what happened. I am, yes.
entries.literal: "...So you know what happened. I am, yes."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Of course! You were in the news!
entries.literal: "Of course! You were in the news!"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I managed a bitter smile in response to his relieved expression."
entries.literal: "\"I managed a bitter smile in response to his relieved expression.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: He wasn't talking about the incident on November 30th... He was talking about the attack that had taken place in Ashiya Tower; the news about it reached everywhere.
entries.literal: "He wasn't talking about the incident on November 30th... He was talking about the attack that had taken place in Ashiya Tower; the news about it reached everywhere."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I'm so glad you were released so quickly! How are you?
entries.literal: "I'm so glad you were released so quickly! How are you?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I'm okay. I was released yesterday. Fortunately, nothing major happened to me.
entries.literal: "I'm okay. I was released yesterday. Fortunately, nothing major happened to me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: At {time=21}, a team of policemen raided the building, and they only found me. I was thoroughly interrogated, but they released me pretty quickly.
entries.literal: "At {time=21}, a team of policemen raided the building, and they only found me. I was thoroughly interrogated, but they released me pretty quickly."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: That's really good to hear. If you came to relax and try to forget about it, we don't have to talk about it.
entries.literal: "That's really good to hear. If you came to relax and try to forget about it, we don't have to talk about it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...It's fine. You don't have to worry.
entries.literal: "...It's fine. You don't have to worry."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Are you sure? I can't imagine what it must be like to lose someone close to you at your age. I'm so sorry.
entries.literal: "Are you sure? I can't imagine what it must be like to lose someone close to you at your age. I'm so sorry."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Darfee knew that Atsuki hadn't been found when the tower unlocked. I've read many of the articles that reported the news, and due to all the deaths and the impossibility that the missing people escaped, the worst was assumed by almost everyone.
entries.literal: "Darfee knew that Atsuki hadn't been found when the tower unlocked. I've read many of the articles that reported the news, and due to all the deaths and the impossibility that the missing people escaped, the worst was assumed by almost everyone."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}Thank you.
entries.literal: "...{w}Thank you."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Do you have any idea what happened? A lot of details weren't published.
entries.literal: "Do you have any idea what happened? A lot of details weren't published."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Unfortunately, no. It all happened suddenly, and we were just caught up in it.
entries.literal: "Unfortunately, no. It all happened suddenly, and we were just caught up in it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "He looked down, very clearly pitying me."
entries.literal: "\"He looked down, very clearly pitying me.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: As I was drinking my coffee, I saw a newspaper close to me.
entries.literal: "As I was drinking my coffee, I saw a newspaper close to me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It was the latest Yushinews edition. Naturally, the first thing I did was look at the date.{w} It said 12-01...
entries.literal: "It was the latest Yushinews edition. Naturally, the first thing I did was look at the date.{w} It said 12-01..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...{w}The Japanese date format is year-month-day, but I approached the newspaper intending to read the day's date. It didn't come to mind that Yushinews is a monthly newspaper.
entries.literal: "...{w}The Japanese date format is year-month-day, but I approached the newspaper intending to read the day's date. It didn't come to mind that Yushinews is a monthly newspaper."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I saw 12-01: 2012-January, as it was that month's edition. Instead, I interpreted it as December 1st.
entries.literal: "I saw 12-01: 2012-January, as it was that month's edition. Instead, I interpreted it as December 1st."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And when I flipped back the pages, I ended up at the "November" section. In chronological order, every edition begins with the previous month's most important news. That's where I read about the gas explosion and the escape from a prison cell.
entries.literal: "And when I flipped back the pages, I ended up at the \"November\" section. In chronological order, every edition begins with the previous month's most important news. That's where I read about the gas explosion and the escape from a prison cell."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Before leaving, Darfee told me that it was Sunday. It was the truth, and it was an immense contradiction with what I believed...{w} That even made me think later that Miiya had died on a Saturday, which wasn't the case. After waking up in the hospital, I spent the days secluded from the world, and the case wasn't too different before November 30th. The days of the week meant nothing to me at the time.
entries.literal: "Before leaving, Darfee told me that it was Sunday. It was the truth, and it was an immense contradiction with what I believed...{w} That even made me think later that Miiya had died on a Saturday, which wasn't the case. After waking up in the hospital, I spent the days secluded from the world, and the case wasn't too different before November 30th. The days of the week meant nothing to me at the time."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: On the way back, I ended up next to this house. Silently, I walked to the gate and looked up, where I saw light behind a window.
entries.literal: "On the way back, I ended up next to this house. Silently, I walked to the gate and looked up, where I saw light behind a window."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: ...I looked up at the ceiling light. I'd been living at Atsuki's house since I'd been released by the police so that I could take care of his pets.
entries.literal: "...I looked up at the ceiling light. I'd been living at Atsuki's house since I'd been released by the police so that I could take care of his pets."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: You saw me outside this morning, right?
entries.literal: "You saw me outside this morning, right?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: Maxi didn't react to my question, but I knew he hadn't been in the living room for most of the day. I recalled the moment I'd seen him by the gate, long ago.
entries.literal: "Maxi didn't react to my question, but I knew he hadn't been in the living room for most of the day. I recalled the moment I'd seen him by the gate, long ago."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I got startled as soon as I peeked through the bars of his front gate. I hadn't seen Maxi sitting in front of the wooden door, where there was no snow."
entries.literal: "\"I got startled as soon as I peeked through the bars of his front gate. I hadn't seen Maxi sitting in front of the wooden door, where there was no snow.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "He seemed afraid for an instant when he saw me, but then he ran to me, squeezing his head through the bars."
entries.literal: "\"He seemed afraid for an instant when he saw me, but then he ran to me, squeezing his head through the bars.\""

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Did seeing me scare you? You knew I was here, so it must've looked like I teleported out.
entries.literal: "Did seeing me scare you? You knew I was here, so it must've looked like I teleported out."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Curious to see me outside, he approached the gate but couldn't stop me from leaving. I found him waiting by the door, which is all he's done since I started living here. I think he's just waiting for Atsuki to come back.
entries.literal: "Curious to see me outside, he approached the gate but couldn't stop me from leaving. I found him waiting by the door, which is all he's done since I started living here. I think he's just waiting for Atsuki to come back."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: After that, I walked to my apartment. I noticed that people were looking at me, and I don't think that was just my imagination. One of the reasons I've stayed here is because most people recognize me as the only survivor of the 15th.
entries.literal: "After that, I walked to my apartment. I noticed that people were looking at me, and I don't think that was just my imagination. One of the reasons I've stayed here is because most people recognize me as the only survivor of the 15th."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...When I got home, I decided to change the past by calling my mom.
entries.literal: "...When I got home, I decided to change the past by calling my mom."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Shiroya...! How are you!?{w} I'm so glad you called! We were so worried!
entries.literal: "Shiroya...! How are you!?{w} I'm so glad you called! We were so worried!"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Hello...! Are you there? What happened? You're okay, right?
entries.literal: "Hello...! Are you there? What happened? You're okay, right?"

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I didn't want to speak, so I cut the line, my mom's voice leaving me still. Immediately, my phone received a call from her, which I waited out.{w} After that, it took a while until I received another one, but that was the last time she called me.
entries.literal: "I didn't want to speak, so I cut the line, my mom's voice leaving me still. Immediately, my phone received a call from her, which I waited out.{w} After that, it took a while until I received another one, but that was the last time she called me."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I knew what had happened. Earlier that day, I had finally talked to my mom, calming her down.{w} When the police had released me, the phone I'd left outside the tower on the 15th had been returned to me. In the future, when my mother had called me, both existing phones had received the call, and I'd picked it up from Atsuki's house.
entries.literal: "I knew what had happened. Earlier that day, I had finally talked to my mom, calming her down.{w} When the police had released me, the phone I'd left outside the tower on the 15th had been returned to me. In the future, when my mother had called me, both existing phones had received the call, and I'd picked it up from Atsuki's house."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: After going over all that I'd experienced, I cooked a slice of meat. It was disgusting. I can't believe I didn't realize it tasted awful due to being in the fridge for more than a month.
entries.literal: "After going over all that I'd experienced, I cooked a slice of meat. It was disgusting. I can't believe I didn't realize it tasted awful due to being in the fridge for more than a month."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And when the sun began to set, my phone showed {time=18.} Strangely, I was exhausted, so I didn't wait long before going to bed.
entries.literal: "And when the sun began to set, my phone showed {time=18.} Strangely, I was exhausted, so I didn't wait long before going to bed."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I woke up tomorrow, on January 2nd.
entries.literal: "I woke up tomorrow, on January 2nd."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That's when I found that thread from November 24th, long since locked.{w} I was so close to discovering the truth there. I wanted to find the first ever mention of the word "Sekimeiya" to learn where it had been before Ashiya's announcement, so I sorted the results by oldest first. That made me miss all the articles reporting on what had happened on the 15th.
entries.literal: "That's when I found that thread from November 24th, long since locked.{w} I was so close to discovering the truth there. I wanted to find the first ever mention of the word \"Sekimeiya\" to learn where it had been before Ashiya's announcement, so I sorted the results by oldest first. That made me miss all the articles reporting on what had happened on the 15th."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...But thanks to an attached picture, I was still able to reach Vaisude's apartment.
entries.literal: "...But thanks to an attached picture, I was still able to reach Vaisude's apartment."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: On the way, I saw that there was no light behind the windows in Ashiya Tower. It made sense to me because Katei had said that nobody had been recently working on the office floors, but that was a mistake, since they were lit up on the 15th.
entries.literal: "On the way, I saw that there was no light behind the windows in Ashiya Tower. It made sense to me because Katei had said that nobody had been recently working on the office floors, but that was a mistake, since they were lit up on the 15th."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It had been more than a month since Vaisude had traveled to the past. He would go live with his parents, where he had appeared on the 24th of November...
entries.literal: "It had been more than a month since Vaisude had traveled to the past. He would go live with his parents, where he had appeared on the 24th of November..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And I, the only person to have been found in the tower, visited him. He thought it was due to his forum thread, and he was surprised when I left without saying a word.
entries.literal: "And I, the only person to have been found in the tower, visited him. He thought it was due to his forum thread, and he was surprised when I left without saying a word."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Outside, I constantly felt eyes on me. What did Yushibana know about me? Slowly, I walked to its outskirts.
entries.literal: "Outside, I constantly felt eyes on me. What did Yushibana know about me? Slowly, I walked to its outskirts."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Next to my school, everything was silent. No classes were happening on a Monday, as it was during the winter holidays.
entries.literal: "Next to my school, everything was silent. No classes were happening on a Monday, as it was during the winter holidays."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...And that's where I felt a presence behind me—where I saw footprints running away.
entries.literal: "...And that's where I felt a presence behind me—where I saw footprints running away."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Who was it? That's something I'm not sure of yet. Who would've followed me in January? It could've been anyone who knew I was the only survivor of the attack.
entries.literal: "Who was it? That's something I'm not sure of yet. Who would've followed me in January? It could've been anyone who knew I was the only survivor of the attack."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But thankfully, nothing happened to me. I went home and tried to loosen up by cooking the food I'd bought.{w} Later that day, I received a call from an unknown number. Remembering the words Vaisude and I exchanged is pretty interesting.
entries.literal: "But thankfully, nothing happened to me. I went home and tried to loosen up by cooking the food I'd bought.{w} Later that day, I received a call from an unknown number. Remembering the words Vaisude and I exchanged is pretty interesting."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Hello?
entries.literal: "...Hello?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: O-Oh, you picked up. Good.{w} Hey there.{w} Are you Shiroya...?
entries.literal: "O-Oh, you picked up. Good.{w} Hey there.{w} Are you Shiroya...?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Huh? Yes. ...Who are you?
entries.literal: "Huh? Yes. ...Who are you?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: You were at my place earlier, remember? My name's Vaisude.{w} I just need to ask this first. You were in Ashiya Tower during the terrorist attack on December 15th, right?
entries.literal: "You were at my place earlier, remember? My name's Vaisude.{w} I just need to ask this first. You were in Ashiya Tower during the terrorist attack on December 15th, right?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}December 15th? What are you talking about?
entries.literal: "...{w}December 15th? What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Wh-What? You know all about it, right? That's why you came to my place.
entries.literal: "Wh-What? You know all about it, right? That's why you came to my place."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}I do, yeah. I was there.
entries.literal: "...{w}I do, yeah. I was there."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: I see. I knew I wasn't wrong.
entries.literal: "I see. I knew I wasn't wrong."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Both of us referred to the 15th like it had already happened, and I thought it was because we had traveled to the past from that day, not because I was in the future...
entries.literal: "Both of us referred to the 15th like it had already happened, and I thought it was because we had traveled to the past from that day, not because I was in the future..."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: There's a reason why I'm calling you. ...I don't know how this will sound, though.
entries.literal: "There's a reason why I'm calling you. ...I don't know how this will sound, though."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...What is it?
entries.literal: "...What is it?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: ...Do you know... what I experienced? You read my thread from November, didn't you? That's how you found my apartment.
entries.literal: "...Do you know... what I experienced? You read my thread from November, didn't you? That's how you found my apartment."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: What did you experience?
entries.literal: "What did you experience?"

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Exactly what I wrote about...! From the 15th of December, I suddenly appeared on the 24th of November!
entries.literal: "Exactly what I wrote about...! From the 15th of December, I suddenly appeared on the 24th of November!"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I see. You're right. I also traveled back in time.
entries.literal: "...I see. You're right. I also traveled back in time."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Wh— R-Really...!? So that is what happened! How, though!?{w} A lot more people had to have come with me, right?{w} Then what will happen in two weeks? Do you think it will repeat?
entries.literal: "Wh— R-Really...!? So that is what happened! How, though!?{w} A lot more people had to have come with me, right?{w} Then what will happen in two weeks? Do you think it will repeat?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: It's very possible, but I'm not sure everything will be identical.
entries.literal: "It's very possible, but I'm not sure everything will be identical."

entries.speaker: v
entries.text: Yeah, that wouldn't make sense. I have no idea how it'll come to occur, but it'll happen again. People will travel to the past. I can't believe it.
entries.literal: "Yeah, that wouldn't make sense. I have no idea how it'll come to occur, but it'll happen again. People will travel to the past. I can't believe it."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I'm as confused as you are.
entries.literal: "...I'm as confused as you are."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: "Then what will happen in two weeks? Do you think it will repeat?" I'm pretty sure I know why he said that.
entries.literal: "\"Then what will happen in two weeks? Do you think it will repeat?\" I'm pretty sure I know why he said that."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: On the 15th, the dead bodies were found by the police, and in Isla's purse, the voice recorder we played was found too.
entries.literal: "On the 15th, the dead bodies were found by the police, and in Isla's purse, the voice recorder we played was found too."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Its contents were summarized publicly, and I've read speculation regarding what it all means. Most people ignored the recording because it stated that the shutter wouldn't unlock when it clearly did.
entries.literal: "Its contents were summarized publicly, and I've read speculation regarding what it all means. Most people ignored the recording because it stated that the shutter wouldn't unlock when it clearly did."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But Vaisude must have known not to dismiss it—something else was hidden behind that audio. So, on January 2nd, something was still set to happen within two weeks. Perhaps the incident would repeat and someone would go to the past again to leave the recorder on December 15th.
entries.literal: "But Vaisude must have known not to dismiss it—something else was hidden behind that audio. So, on January 2nd, something was still set to happen within two weeks. Perhaps the incident would repeat and someone would go to the past again to leave the recorder on December 15th."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...The conversation between the two of us kept going and going, but neither of us realized how different the other's perspective was.
entries.literal: "...The conversation between the two of us kept going and going, but neither of us realized how different the other's perspective was."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I woke up pretty early on January 3rd. My phone showed {time=7:45}, but no light was making it through the gaps in the blinds.
entries.literal: "I woke up pretty early on January 3rd. My phone showed {time=7:45}, but no light was making it through the gaps in the blinds."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I felt the need to go out again, and when I opened the front door, I saw the sun rising from behind the mountains. ...It was an hour earlier than I thought, and light snow was starting to fall.
entries.literal: "I felt the need to go out again, and when I opened the front door, I saw the sun rising from behind the mountains. ...It was an hour earlier than I thought, and light snow was starting to fall."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That was the reason behind that foggy and soulless Yushibana. It culminated when I saw Ina Café closed, but when it was really {time=7:30}, the shutter rose.
entries.literal: "That was the reason behind that foggy and soulless Yushibana. It culminated when I saw Ina Café closed, but when it was really {time=7:30}, the shutter rose."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: So what have you been doing these last couple of days?
entries.literal: "So what have you been doing these last couple of days?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...{w}Not much. I went to Atsuki's house yesterday, and I was there for a while.
entries.literal: "...{w}Not much. I went to Atsuki's house yesterday, and I was there for a while."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Atsuki's house? You think being there helps you?
entries.literal: "Atsuki's house? You think being there helps you?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...I think so, yeah.
entries.literal: "...I think so, yeah."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I see.
entries.literal: "I see."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I could finally rest inside, and I did so for longer than I'd expected. I was only drawn out hours later when I saw someone I recognized in the distance.
entries.literal: "I could finally rest inside, and I did so for longer than I'd expected. I was only drawn out hours later when I saw someone I recognized in the distance."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It was Isla's friend, the Isla from the world I later ended up in. She had traveled from December 15th to November 24th, and for her, it had been a very long time since nobody had come back from the tower.
entries.literal: "It was Isla's friend, the Isla from the world I later ended up in. She had traveled from December 15th to November 24th, and for her, it had been a very long time since nobody had come back from the tower."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I followed her footprints up to her house, but I wasn't yet certain I wanted to change the past. When I felt a presence watching behind me again, I distanced myself from that place.
entries.literal: "I followed her footprints up to her house, but I wasn't yet certain I wanted to change the past. When I felt a presence watching behind me again, I distanced myself from that place."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: And I ended up high on that mountain, where I finally made the decision to change the past and do all I could to save everyone.
entries.literal: "And I ended up high on that mountain, where I finally made the decision to change the past and do all I could to save everyone."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: On the way back, I felt like the same person was following me, and that time, the police were ready to intercept them.
entries.literal: "On the way back, I felt like the same person was following me, and that time, the police were ready to intercept them."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...{w}Hm, thinking about it, I might actually be able to find out who it was.
entries.literal: "...{w}Hm, thinking about it, I might actually be able to find out who it was."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: S-Sorry, did you just arrest someone?
entries.literal: "S-Sorry, did you just arrest someone?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Hm? Yes. What's the matter?
entries.literal: "Hm? Yes. What's the matter?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I... was feeling like someone was following me just now. Could it have been this person?
entries.literal: "I... was feeling like someone was following me just now. Could it have been this person?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "The man frowned and took out a tiny scrapbook.
entries.literal: "\"The man frowned and took out a tiny scrapbook."

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: What's your name?
entries.literal: "What's your name?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Mine...?{w} ...It's Shiroya Mirana.
entries.literal: "Mine...?{w} ...It's Shiroya Mirana."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "He looked at me and silently wrote on the paper.{w} Then, he suddenly smiled, completely shifting his expression."
entries.literal: "\"He looked at me and silently wrote on the paper.{w} Then, he suddenly smiled, completely shifting his expression.\""

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: I see. You can stop worrying, then. If you think you were being followed, there's nothing to be afraid of.
entries.literal: "I see. You can stop worrying, then. If you think you were being followed, there's nothing to be afraid of."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: At the time, I thought his smile was a bit strange, but he also recognized me as the only survivor. He had just caught the person believed to be behind the attack, so he told me that I could stop worrying.
entries.literal: "At the time, I thought his smile was a bit strange, but he also recognized me as the only survivor. He had just caught the person believed to be behind the attack, so he told me that I could stop worrying."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: There's a reason why the police released me without further complications. Right now, there's one person believed to have orchestrated the attack—Akaro, even though the police haven't released his name.{w} That's because a recording was found on the computer in the tower, one which showed Akaro's and Katei's movements during the time the smoke was released. Before {time=21}, Atsuki saved that recording on the computer. He brought it from the world where Miiya was saved.
entries.literal: "There's a reason why the police released me without further complications. Right now, there's one person believed to have orchestrated the attack—Akaro, even though the police haven't released his name.{w} That's because a recording was found on the computer in the tower, one which showed Akaro's and Katei's movements during the time the smoke was released. Before {time=21}, Atsuki saved that recording on the computer. He brought it from the world where Miiya was saved."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: So, if the police believed they had caught a Xyn member, what's most likely is that it was Akaro.{w} I guess that's not all, though.
entries.literal: "So, if the police believed they had caught a Xyn member, what's most likely is that it was Akaro.{w} I guess that's not all, though."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Atsuki also told me that after Sai and Akaro escaped from the bedroom in the attic, Akaro traveled to the future and appeared on January 5th. He couldn't have been following me on January 3rd.{w} Rather, what it means is that it was the other Akaro. The one who killed me in another world and then arrived in ours with Isla.
entries.literal: "Atsuki also told me that after Sai and Akaro escaped from the bedroom in the attic, Akaro traveled to the future and appeared on January 5th. He couldn't have been following me on January 3rd.{w} Rather, what it means is that it was the other Akaro. The one who killed me in another world and then arrived in ours with Isla."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I traveled fifteen days to the future and appeared in the location where I'd been fifteen days in the past. The rule should be the opposite when you travel to the past. Vaisude appeared in his parents' house on November 24th, and by that amount of time in the future, he moved out to go live with them.
entries.literal: "I traveled fifteen days to the future and appeared in the location where I'd been fifteen days in the past. The rule should be the opposite when you travel to the past. Vaisude appeared in his parents' house on November 24th, and by that amount of time in the future, he moved out to go live with them."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That's gotta be why that Akaro appeared in a cell on November 24th. He would be caught by the police on January 3rd and put in a prison cell. In November, the cell was vacant and unlocked, so he was able to walk right out of it. That's why the image looked the same as in the article when I saw the cell on TV.
entries.literal: "That's gotta be why that Akaro appeared in a cell on November 24th. He would be caught by the police on January 3rd and put in a prison cell. In November, the cell was vacant and unlocked, so he was able to walk right out of it. That's why the image looked the same as in the article when I saw the cell on TV."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When the evening of the 3rd came, I stepped out of my apartment again. The place I went to had been constantly in my mind, as it was essential to construct the future I wanted.
entries.literal: "When the evening of the 3rd came, I stepped out of my apartment again. The place I went to had been constantly in my mind, as it was essential to construct the future I wanted."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: I came a while ago, but I'd forgotten to check if I'd won anything until now.{w} The number I had was for December 1st, I believe. I wonder, by the way, how long would it be valid for?
entries.literal: "I came a while ago, but I'd forgotten to check if I'd won anything until now.{w} The number I had was for December 1st, I believe. I wonder, by the way, how long would it be valid for?"

entries.speaker: ns
entries.text: Oh, it's still valid, don't worry. They last a whole year.{w} Anyway, December 1st? Let me see.
entries.literal: "Oh, it's still valid, don't worry. They last a whole year.{w} Anyway, December 1st? Let me see."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: 30-05-12-31-15-26. Bonus 24. I still remember it.
entries.literal: "30-05-12-31-15-26. Bonus 24. I still remember it."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: There was a small piece of paper on the table containing those numbers. I had bought it in the other world before going to Eagle Motel. However, the winning number had been different.
entries.literal: "There was a small piece of paper on the table containing those numbers. I had bought it in the other world before going to Eagle Motel. However, the winning number had been different."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: But that didn't matter. Even though it had been bought in another world, it was immensely valuable in the one I was in.
entries.literal: "But that didn't matter. Even though it had been bought in another world, it was immensely valuable in the one I was in."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: January 4th was the final day I'd set for myself. It didn't matter anymore, but I did the laundry to pass the time.
entries.literal: "January 4th was the final day I'd set for myself. It didn't matter anymore, but I did the laundry to pass the time."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I noticed that my favorite blue hoodie was missing. It was among the clothing I'd brought to Atsuki's house on December 9th.{w} Similarly, a shirt that brought bad memories and which I thought I'd left out of the washer was in the bucket. There were two versions of it, as it was the shirt I'd worn on November 30th, and I left it there both on December 8th and on January 1st.
entries.literal: "I noticed that my favorite blue hoodie was missing. It was among the clothing I'd brought to Atsuki's house on December 9th.{w} Similarly, a shirt that brought bad memories and which I thought I'd left out of the washer was in the bucket. There were two versions of it, as it was the shirt I'd worn on November 30th, and I left it there both on December 8th and on January 1st."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...I didn't want to spend the whole day at home, so I went to Ina again.
entries.literal: "...I didn't want to spend the whole day at home, so I went to Ina again."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: That's where I learned that a Xyn member had been arrested for the first time. The latest edition of Yushinews was still there, and it would stay there for the rest of the month.
entries.literal: "That's where I learned that a Xyn member had been arrested for the first time. The latest edition of Yushinews was still there, and it would stay there for the rest of the month."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The news said that the identity of the person they caught was unknown. I wonder if Akaro wasn't his real name...
entries.literal: "The news said that the identity of the person they caught was unknown. I wonder if Akaro wasn't his real name..."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Are you thinking about the news?
entries.literal: "Are you thinking about the news?"

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "Darfee addressed me after I'd been in thought for a few minutes."
entries.literal: "\"Darfee addressed me after I'd been in thought for a few minutes.\""

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: A bit. It just threw me off.
entries.literal: "A bit. It just threw me off."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: I see. Well, it's good that someone from that group finally got caught.
entries.literal: "I see. Well, it's good that someone from that group finally got caught."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Yeah, I agree.
entries.literal: "Yeah, I agree."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: ...Do you know about the Sekimeiya?
entries.literal: "...Do you know about the Sekimeiya?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Huh? ...What do you mean?
entries.literal: "Huh? ...What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Ashiya's event.
entries.literal: "Ashiya's event."

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: Hm? Yeah, of course.
entries.literal: "Hm? Yeah, of course."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: Well, nobody stole the Sekimeiya, right...?
entries.literal: "Well, nobody stole the Sekimeiya, right...?"

entries.speaker: d
entries.text: The Sekimeiya...? N-No. ...As far as I know, at least.
entries.literal: "The Sekimeiya...? N-No. ...As far as I know, at least."

entries.speaker: c3s
entries.text: All right, I just wanted to make sure since I haven't been paying attention to the news.
entries.literal: "All right, I just wanted to make sure since I haven't been paying attention to the news."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: From my perspective, what it all meant was that the past had changed, so I could go to Atsuki's house and prevent him from going to the tower in case something happened to me.
entries.literal: "From my perspective, what it all meant was that the past had changed, so I could go to Atsuki's house and prevent him from going to the tower in case something happened to me."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I had to wait for him to leave, which would never happen. As I waited, I realized that I could go back to Isla's house in the meantime.
entries.literal: "I had to wait for him to leave, which would never happen. As I waited, I realized that I could go back to Isla's house in the meantime."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When I rang the bell, nobody opened the door, and after knocking for some time, I noticed the door wasn't locked.
entries.literal: "When I rang the bell, nobody opened the door, and after knocking for some time, I noticed the door wasn't locked."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I'm just speculating, but when Isla traveled from December 15th to November 24th, it's likely she didn't appear with the keys to her house. Since Erina never came back from the tower, Isla would've had to keep the door unlocked when she left so that she could get back in.
entries.literal: "I'm just speculating, but when Isla traveled from December 15th to November 24th, it's likely she didn't appear with the keys to her house. Since Erina never came back from the tower, Isla would've had to keep the door unlocked when she left so that she could get back in."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Inside the house, I immediately found her purse. I took two tickets for the event on the 15th, which is pretty strange...{w} because if that was the purse of the Isla who'd traveled from the 15th, I'm not sure why the tickets would've been inside it.
entries.literal: "Inside the house, I immediately found her purse. I took two tickets for the event on the 15th, which is pretty strange...{w} because if that was the purse of the Isla who'd traveled from the 15th, I'm not sure why the tickets would've been inside it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...The recording was real. On January 5th, everyone who's currently traveling to the future will make it happen.{w} But what about Isla? She'll be there too, and she's not currently traveling through time. ...The Isla from this world died in the cabinet, and the other Isla should currently be alone in her house.
entries.literal: "...The recording was real. On January 5th, everyone who's currently traveling to the future will make it happen.{w} But what about Isla? She'll be there too, and she's not currently traveling through time. ...The Isla from this world died in the cabinet, and the other Isla should currently be alone in her house."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: How will that Isla end up inside the tower on January 5th—the exact day that everyone will awaken? I can only think of one thing.
entries.literal: "How will that Isla end up inside the tower on January 5th—the exact day that everyone will awaken? I can only think of one thing."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: After taking both tickets from her purse, I walked back home. Even though I didn't see anyone, Isla might have been careful about her situation. Maybe she noticed the strange footprints that went in and out of her house.
entries.literal: "After taking both tickets from her purse, I walked back home. Even though I didn't see anyone, Isla might have been careful about her situation. Maybe she noticed the strange footprints that went in and out of her house."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If she did, and retraced them to my apartment, she had the chance to follow my footprints all the way to the tower. I entered through the storeroom and left the door open, so that's one way she could've been there on the 5th.
entries.literal: "If she did, and retraced them to my apartment, she had the chance to follow my footprints all the way to the tower. I entered through the storeroom and left the door open, so that's one way she could've been there on the 5th."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: ...That Isla traveled from December 15th to November 24th. She went 21 days to the past.{w} 21 days after December 15th is January 5th. So her location upon appearing on November 24th may have been from January 5th.
entries.literal: "...That Isla traveled from December 15th to November 24th. She went 21 days to the past.{w} 21 days after December 15th is January 5th. So her location upon appearing on November 24th may have been from January 5th."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: If that's correct, it might be how the voice recorder went to the past, although I don't really know any details. What's strange is that if Isla appeared with the recorder on November 24th, the Isla from this world shouldn't have had it in her purse on the 15th.
entries.literal: "If that's correct, it might be how the voice recorder went to the past, although I don't really know any details. What's strange is that if Isla appeared with the recorder on November 24th, the Isla from this world shouldn't have had it in her purse on the 15th."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: An answer that explains two questions at once is that the purses were switched at some point before the 15th. That could be why the recorder ended up in the tower and why the tickets were still inside Isla's purse on January 4th.{w} If that's what happened, before going to the tower on December 15th, Isla or Erina must have realized that the tickets were no longer in the lower pocket of the purse and had to print them again.
entries.literal: "An answer that explains two questions at once is that the purses were switched at some point before the 15th. That could be why the recorder ended up in the tower and why the tickets were still inside Isla's purse on January 4th.{w} If that's what happened, before going to the tower on December 15th, Isla or Erina must have realized that the tickets were no longer in the lower pocket of the purse and had to print them again."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Back home, I felt the time rapidly passing. I had no idea what would happen the next day, when I would finally visit the tower.
entries.literal: "Back home, I felt the time rapidly passing. I had no idea what would happen the next day, when I would finally visit the tower."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: My thoughts were racing, I couldn't get to sleep, and suddenly it was deep in the night. Eventually, it was clear I was just going to stay awake, so I had the thought of leaving anyway because the tower was supposed to open early. I never turned off the heater before leaving, and I never made the connection that it hadn't been turned on when it was December 8th. I'll have to go turn it off on the 5th so I don't waste power.
entries.literal: "My thoughts were racing, I couldn't get to sleep, and suddenly it was deep in the night. Eventually, it was clear I was just going to stay awake, so I had the thought of leaving anyway because the tower was supposed to open early. I never turned off the heater before leaving, and I never made the connection that it hadn't been turned on when it was December 8th. I'll have to go turn it off on the 5th so I don't waste power."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Anyway, when I arrived, the tower was locked, and nobody seemed to be there.
entries.literal: "Anyway, when I arrived, the tower was locked, and nobody seemed to be there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I really thought that the world had stopped moving. For a moment, I believed I would die there.
entries.literal: "I really thought that the world had stopped moving. For a moment, I believed I would die there."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: The tower wouldn't open. It hadn't opened once since December 15th. The time discrepancy with my phone's clock was what made me think that the day wasn't starting.
entries.literal: "The tower wouldn't open. It hadn't opened once since December 15th. The time discrepancy with my phone's clock was what made me think that the day wasn't starting."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Something that added to the illusion was my phone saying "No service". I'm still not sure what the cause of that was, but the cold definitely didn't let me think properly. The ground in front of the tower was buried in snow, too. Ashiya hadn't been maintaining the plaza like they tended to do.
entries.literal: "Something that added to the illusion was my phone saying \"No service\". I'm still not sure what the cause of that was, but the cold definitely didn't let me think properly. The ground in front of the tower was buried in snow, too. Ashiya hadn't been maintaining the plaza like they tended to do."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I knew the secret of the building, though. I knew that a door probably existed in its left wall, and after feeling around carefully, I found it.
entries.literal: "I knew the secret of the building, though. I knew that a door probably existed in its left wall, and after feeling around carefully, I found it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I opened it just by pushing it lightly, which meant that it wasn't locked. I even saw that the handle inside was already taken off.
entries.literal: "I opened it just by pushing it lightly, which meant that it wasn't locked. I even saw that the handle inside was already taken off."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I bet the door was actually locked on the 15th due to how easily it opened in January. When the police interrogated me, they inquired about that secret area since they had found it open from the inside. They told me that they picked the lock and confirmed the door was really another exit.
entries.literal: "I bet the door was actually locked on the 15th due to how easily it opened in January. When the police interrogated me, they inquired about that secret area since they had found it open from the inside. They told me that they picked the lock and confirmed the door was really another exit."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Of course, since they didn't have the rusty key, they didn't lock the door again. That's why it was still unlocked on January 5th and not even properly closed. I got it to open just by putting my hand on it.
entries.literal: "Of course, since they didn't have the rusty key, they didn't lock the door again. That's why it was still unlocked on January 5th and not even properly closed. I got it to open just by putting my hand on it."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I entered the tower, which was as dark and cold as the outside world, its temperature no longer regulated for visitors. When I set foot in hallway A, I saw the green lights on the cameras. They were still recording.{w} But it's okay—I don't think it mattered. I was in the hallways, security room, lobby, mechanical room, and event room—all places that should've still been covered with smoke or that didn't have cameras in the first place.
entries.literal: "I entered the tower, which was as dark and cold as the outside world, its temperature no longer regulated for visitors. When I set foot in hallway A, I saw the green lights on the cameras. They were still recording.{w} But it's okay—I don't think it mattered. I was in the hallways, security room, lobby, mechanical room, and event room—all places that should've still been covered with smoke or that didn't have cameras in the first place."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: In the security room, I found Katei's rusty key. His body had already been taken away by the police, and I thought the room was all messy, as if someone had tried to find something.
entries.literal: "In the security room, I found Katei's rusty key. His body had already been taken away by the police, and I thought the room was all messy, as if someone had tried to find something."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: Then, above the breakers, I found the attic and Sekimeiya cabinet keys... And not only that.
entries.literal: "Then, above the breakers, I found the attic and Sekimeiya cabinet keys... And not only that."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "I tried to move, but the obstacles in the room didn't make it easy. Could the cabinet have been there? While it seemed like a good place, neither the lobby nor the mechanical room had cameras."
entries.literal: "\"I tried to move, but the obstacles in the room didn't make it easy. Could the cabinet have been there? While it seemed like a good place, neither the lobby nor the mechanical room had cameras.\""

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: "There were chairs and tables on the floor, so I had to move some aside to get to every part of the room. Even though it was impossible for anyone to be there, I kept trying to be silent and failing as I scattered things that I couldn't see."
entries.literal: "\"There were chairs and tables on the floor, so I had to move some aside to get to every part of the room. Even though it was impossible for anyone to be there, I kept trying to be silent and failing as I scattered things that I couldn't see.\""

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: According to Atsuki, the Sekimeiya that sent us to the future was there. While searching for the cabinet, I moved it accidentally, which stopped the chain of travels and made everyone arrive on that day.
entries.literal: "According to Atsuki, the Sekimeiya that sent us to the future was there. While searching for the cabinet, I moved it accidentally, which stopped the chain of travels and made everyone arrive on that day."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: As I was walking to the event room, I saw the reception desk lights flickering in the lobby. I turned around because I felt a presence behind me, and I don't think that was just paranoia.
entries.literal: "As I was walking to the event room, I saw the reception desk lights flickering in the lobby. I turned around because I felt a presence behind me, and I don't think that was just paranoia."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: It had to be Atsuki. He had to be there too since both of us traveled back to the 15th when I touched the Sekimeiya.
entries.literal: "It had to be Atsuki. He had to be there too since both of us traveled back to the 15th when I touched the Sekimeiya."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I moved to the event room and felt that it was much colder than the rest of the building. The cabinet wasn't closed...
entries.literal: "I moved to the event room and felt that it was much colder than the rest of the building. The cabinet wasn't closed..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: When the police entered the building on the 15th, only the Sekimeiya that sent us to the past was in the cabinet. Ashiya said that the Sekimeiya weren't stolen, which means that the police found another one and put it in the cabinet. Of course, it wasn't the one in the mechanical room...
entries.literal: "When the police entered the building on the 15th, only the Sekimeiya that sent us to the past was in the cabinet. Ashiya said that the Sekimeiya weren't stolen, which means that the police found another one and put it in the cabinet. Of course, it wasn't the one in the mechanical room..."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: I remember the rush they were in when they found me. What must have happened is that they didn't close the cabinet, so on January 5th, that Sekimeiya had been gathering energy at an incredibly slow rate. That's why I was able to activate it inside the cabinet.
entries.literal: "I remember the rush they were in when they found me. What must have happened is that they didn't close the cabinet, so on January 5th, that Sekimeiya had been gathering energy at an incredibly slow rate. That's why I was able to activate it inside the cabinet."

entries.speaker: n
entries.text: But I'm not exactly sure how everything came to happen. There was something else in the cabinet, and I activated the alarm out of nowhere... What matters is that Atsuki and I returned to December 15th.
entries.literal: "But I'm not exactly sure how everything came to happen. There was something else in the cabinet, and I activated the alarm out of nowhere... What matters is that Atsuki and I returned to December 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: That was all the time I'd lived in January. The second coming of January 5th was the light at the end of a long tunnel.
entries.literal: "That was all the time I'd lived in January. The second coming of January 5th was the light at the end of a long tunnel."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I looked at the clock and saw that I was close to entering the second day of the year. After a long yawn, I stood up from the couch. I'd been sleeping in the guest room, just like before the 15th.
entries.literal: "I looked at the clock and saw that I was close to entering the second day of the year. After a long yawn, I stood up from the couch. I'd been sleeping in the guest room, just like before the 15th."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I had been there all day, and my body felt weak. As soon as I stood, I noticed a weight in one of my pockets.
entries.literal: "I had been there all day, and my body felt weak. As soon as I stood, I noticed a weight in one of my pockets."

entries.speaker: i
entries.text: I reached my hand inside and took out a rusty key. There was one final use left for it, scheduled to happen in just three days. I gripped it tightly, ready to finally exit the labyrinth that we'd long ago been entrapped by.
entries.literal: "I reached my hand inside and took out a rusty key. There was one final use left for it, scheduled to happen in just three days. I gripped it tightly, ready to finally exit the labyrinth that we'd long ago been entrapped by."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In January, above the breakers, Shiroya finds the attic and Sekimeiya cabinet keys. Why were they there on January 5th, though?
entries.literal: "In January, above the breakers, Shiroya finds the attic and Sekimeiya cabinet keys. Why were they there on January 5th, though?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Wait, no. You're definitely lying."
entries.literal: "\"Wait, no. You're definitely lying.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "Me? I don't ever lie."
entries.literal: "\"Me? I don't ever lie.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: "You don't have any key on you. That proves you hid them, because you should have the cabinet key."
entries.literal: "\"You don't have any key on you. That proves you hid them, because you should have the cabinet key.\""

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...They were the keys that Sai had hidden after locking Shiroya in the attic's bedroom.
entries.literal: "...They were the keys that Sai had hidden after locking Shiroya in the attic's bedroom."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: At the end of December 15th, as soon as the shutter unlocked, the police were struck by a very strong smell. There, they saw an unidentifiable gas in the air as its source. It was the lingering range of the Sekimeiya.{w} When they raided the building with protective masks, a sole Sekimeiya was in the cabinet: the Past Sekimeiya. They knew another one had to be found, so they searched until one of the two fake Sekimeiya that existed was spotted in the attic.{w} They put it in the cabinet, but they were in a rush. That's why the glass wasn't properly closed.
entries.literal: "At the end of December 15th, as soon as the shutter unlocked, the police were struck by a very strong smell. There, they saw an unidentifiable gas in the air as its source. It was the lingering range of the Sekimeiya.{w} When they raided the building with protective masks, a sole Sekimeiya was in the cabinet: the Past Sekimeiya. They knew another one had to be found, so they searched until one of the two fake Sekimeiya that existed was spotted in the attic.{w} They put it in the cabinet, but they were in a rush. That's why the glass wasn't properly closed."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: As the days passed, the cold temperature led to the effect Xyn had designed: the fake Sekimeiya left behind a card with their name. However, their method also damaged the cabinet's interior.
entries.literal: "As the days passed, the cold temperature led to the effect Xyn had designed: the fake Sekimeiya left behind a card with their name. However, their method also damaged the cabinet's interior."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: ...And when Shiroya tried to open the glass all the way, it had been stuck. As soon as she applied a bit of force, one of the triggers for the alarm went off. However, there was no one for it to alert. Nobody had expected it to go off ever again.
entries.literal: "...And when Shiroya tried to open the glass all the way, it had been stuck. As soon as she applied a bit of force, one of the triggers for the alarm went off. However, there was no one for it to alert. Nobody had expected it to go off ever again."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Isla A traveled from December 15th to November 24th, she appeared with a burn mark on her finger. The Sekimeiya was immensely hot, so the burn would not have faded by the time the future position took place.
entries.literal: "When Isla A traveled from December 15th to November 24th, she appeared with a burn mark on her finger. The Sekimeiya was immensely hot, so the burn would not have faded by the time the future position took place."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: So then, why does Shiroya not appear with a burn mark when she travels from January 5th to December 15th? The number of days traveled is the same.
entries.literal: "So then, why does Shiroya not appear with a burn mark when she travels from January 5th to December 15th? The number of days traveled is the same."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: There's a key difference that prevented a burn from appearing on Shiroya's finger, and it becomes apparent when you track her movements.
entries.literal: "There's a key difference that prevented a burn from appearing on Shiroya's finger, and it becomes apparent when you track her movements."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: After appearing on December 15th, Shiroya will spend many hours in world A until she arrives in world C and once again travels to the past. She will travel to November 30th to save Miiya in that world.
entries.literal: "After appearing on December 15th, Shiroya will spend many hours in world A until she arrives in world C and once again travels to the past. She will travel to November 30th to save Miiya in that world."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: For her to reach January 26th, almost two months will pass. That amount of time is what causes her to appear with no burn mark.
entries.literal: "For her to reach January 26th, almost two months will pass. That amount of time is what causes her to appear with no burn mark."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Despite Sai's initial reaction to the attack being different in the three worlds, there's something he always did at the start: hide the fake Sekimeiya.{w} Doing that opposed Katei's and Akaro's intentions, as Sai was not yet aware that three different Sekimeiya existed. Although his motives were slightly different in each world, the main goal was always the same.
entries.literal: "Despite Sai's initial reaction to the attack being different in the three worlds, there's something he always did at the start: hide the fake Sekimeiya.{w} Doing that opposed Katei's and Akaro's intentions, as Sai was not yet aware that three different Sekimeiya existed. Although his motives were slightly different in each world, the main goal was always the same."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In world B, Sai took the fake Sekimeiya from the cabinet and hid it in the storeroom, where no cameras recorded him. In world C, when the group was inspecting the office floors, everyone was suddenly separated. That gave Sai the perfect chance to do the same thing.
entries.literal: "In world B, Sai took the fake Sekimeiya from the cabinet and hid it in the storeroom, where no cameras recorded him. In world C, when the group was inspecting the office floors, everyone was suddenly separated. That gave Sai the perfect chance to do the same thing."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In this world, A, Naomi C appeared before everyone. Unlike in the other worlds, she wanted to talk to Shiroya in addition to Akaro, as she had seen her world B self on the crystal floor separated from the group and wearing clothes from the attic—two versions of her existed at the same time, and Naomi, who had experienced time travel once, realized that Shiroya might have made contact with the Sekimeiya during the attack.
entries.literal: "In this world, A, Naomi C appeared before everyone. Unlike in the other worlds, she wanted to talk to Shiroya in addition to Akaro, as she had seen her world B self on the crystal floor separated from the group and wearing clothes from the attic—two versions of her existed at the same time, and Naomi, who had experienced time travel once, realized that Shiroya might have made contact with the Sekimeiya during the attack."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The three of them didn't return, so eventually, everyone walked to the crystal floor. Sai hurried to the event room, and as he yelled about the Sekimeiya's disappearance, he put it in his hip pack. Soon after, he hid it in room A5, where Atsuki C would find it hours later.
entries.literal: "The three of them didn't return, so eventually, everyone walked to the crystal floor. Sai hurried to the event room, and as he yelled about the Sekimeiya's disappearance, he put it in his hip pack. Soon after, he hid it in room A5, where Atsuki C would find it hours later."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro A says that one person was hospitalized, and he's referring to Atsuki. ...What about Gan, though?{w} The truth is that Gan was only sent to the hospital in world B.
entries.literal: "Akaro A says that one person was hospitalized, and he's referring to Atsuki. ...What about Gan, though?{w} The truth is that Gan was only sent to the hospital in world B."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Akaro A world switched to world B and then traveled to November 24th, he decided to walk away from Xyn's plan. He deeply regretted what he'd done in the tower, and he wished for history not to turn out the same way.
entries.literal: "When Akaro A world switched to world B and then traveled to November 24th, he decided to walk away from Xyn's plan. He deeply regretted what he'd done in the tower, and he wished for history not to turn out the same way."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He knew he was in the past—he possessed valuable information. One of the things he did was remove the storeroom's handle. However, the first action he took to alter history came days prior.
entries.literal: "He knew he was in the past—he possessed valuable information. One of the things he did was remove the storeroom's handle. However, the first action he took to alter history came days prior."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: On November 30th, he had accidentally killed a young girl. It was the perfect chance to prevent that.
entries.literal: "On November 30th, he had accidentally killed a young girl. It was the perfect chance to prevent that."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He knew that an explosion had occurred while everyone had been unconscious in the gem shop, so all he had to do was make sure that wouldn't repeat: he called Gan and told him to turn the heater off late on November 30th in order to prevent a disaster.
entries.literal: "He knew that an explosion had occurred while everyone had been unconscious in the gem shop, so all he had to do was make sure that wouldn't repeat: he called Gan and told him to turn the heater off late on November 30th in order to prevent a disaster."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Akaro was confident he had saved the girl—Gan had told him that he would turn off the gas. However, Akaro was unaware that Gan did no such thing. He didn't put any real stock in such a bizarre phone call.
entries.literal: "Akaro was confident he had saved the girl—Gan had told him that he would turn off the gas. However, Akaro was unaware that Gan did no such thing. He didn't put any real stock in such a bizarre phone call."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Afterward, the Sekimeiya were found, and mere days later, it was November 30th. The way events unfolded in world B slightly differed from world A.
entries.literal: "Afterward, the Sekimeiya were found, and mere days later, it was November 30th. The way events unfolded in world B slightly differed from world A."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Gan went to get the second Sekimeiya, he stopped himself in the middle of the shop. The moment he smelled the gas, the strange call came back to him.
entries.literal: "When Gan went to get the second Sekimeiya, he stopped himself in the middle of the shop. The moment he smelled the gas, the strange call came back to him."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: He glanced at the heater and approached it curiously just as dense smoke invaded the whole shop. He fell unconscious closer to the source of the explosion, so due to Akaro A's actions, Gan had to be sent to the hospital alongside Atsuki.
entries.literal: "He glanced at the heater and approached it curiously just as dense smoke invaded the whole shop. He fell unconscious closer to the source of the explosion, so due to Akaro A's actions, Gan had to be sent to the hospital alongside Atsuki."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The Past Sekimeiya, which Atsuki touches, has been in the storeroom for numerous hours, so why is it that he doesn't have a burn mark on his finger when he world switches?
entries.literal: "The Past Sekimeiya, which Atsuki touches, has been in the storeroom for numerous hours, so why is it that he doesn't have a burn mark on his finger when he world switches?"

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: That's because of the temperature in the storeroom's secret corridor—the coldest place in the tower.
entries.literal: "That's because of the temperature in the storeroom's secret corridor—the coldest place in the tower."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: When Atsuki touches the Sekimeiya, it has very little energy: the one with the massive range is in room A4, and it will remain undiscovered until June of 2012.
entries.literal: "When Atsuki touches the Sekimeiya, it has very little energy: the one with the massive range is in room A4, and it will remain undiscovered until June of 2012."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Along with Atsuki, almost a third of Japan disappears from the face of the Earth. Not only that, but they never appear anywhere.
entries.literal: "Along with Atsuki, almost a third of Japan disappears from the face of the Earth. Not only that, but they never appear anywhere."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: In this world, when the police entered the tower at {time=21}, they found a real Sekimeiya and a fake. As instructed, they made sure both were kept cold.
entries.literal: "In this world, when the police entered the tower at {time=21}, they found a real Sekimeiya and a fake. As instructed, they made sure both were kept cold."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: Atsuki was the only person they were able to find, and since that day, the tower spent many weeks abandoned. Each second that passed, the real Sekimeiya that hadn't been found kept gaining energy.
entries.literal: "Atsuki was the only person they were able to find, and since that day, the tower spent many weeks abandoned. Each second that passed, the real Sekimeiya that hadn't been found kept gaining energy."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The day that it was activated, its surface could've melted iron. The method through which that happened is a question of its own, but the effect became humanity's biggest mystery.
entries.literal: "The day that it was activated, its surface could've melted iron. The method through which that happened is a question of its own, but the effect became humanity's biggest mystery."

entries.speaker: c
entries.text: The range had been increasing every day, and it ended up taking away a third of Japan's population. The other real Sekimeiya was still refrigerated, so no world switch occurred. Given that the people who vanished didn't reappear anywhere, which Sekimeiya was activated? Did everyone go to the past or to the future?
